\ln Hia goweli kanoheha tsunetlvtanvsv Tsisa Galonedv, Dewi uwetsi, Equahami uwetsi.
\syll ᎯᎠ ᎪᏪᎵ ᎧᏃᎮᎭ ᏧᏁᏢᏔᏅᏒ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ, ᏕᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ, ᎡᏆᎭᎻ ᎤᏪᏥ.
\ft The book of the generation of Jesus Christ, the son of David, the son of Abraham.

\ln Equahami Esigi udenelei; Esigino Tsegaqui udenelei, Tsegaquino Tsuda ale nasgi anadanvtli gvwadenelei;
\syll ᎡᏆᎭᎻ ᎡᏏᎩ ᎤᏕᏁᎴᎢ; ᎡᏏᎩᏃ ᏤᎦᏈ ᎤᏕᏁᎴᎢ, ᏤᎦᏈᏃ ᏧᏓ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎾᏓᏅᏟ ᎬᏩᏕᏁᎴᎢ;
\ft Abraham begat Isaac; and Isaac begat Jacob; and Jacob begat Judas and his brethren;

\ln Tsudano Quelisi ale Sela gvwadenelei Tema dunanugowisei; Quelisino Isilami udenelei; Isilamino Elimi udenelei;
\syll ᏧᏓᏃ ᏇᎵᏏ ᎠᎴ ᏎᎳ ᎬᏩᏕᏁᎴᎢ ᏖᎹ ᏚᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᎢ; ᏇᎵᏏᏃ ᎢᏏᎳᎻ ᎤᏕᏁᎴᎢ; ᎢᏏᎳᎻᏃ ᎡᎵᎻ ᎤᏕᏁᎴᎢ;
\ft And Judas begat Phares and Zara of Thamar; and Phares begat Esrom; and Esrom begat Aram;

\ln Elimino Eminidaqui udenelei; Eminidaquino Nasoni udenelei; Nasonino Salima udenelei;
\syll ᎡᎵᎻᏃ ᎡᎻᏂᏓᏈ ᎤᏕᏁᎴᎢ; ᎡᎻᏂᏓᏈᏃ ᎾᏐᏂ ᎤᏕᏁᎴᎢ; ᎾᏐᏂᏃ ᏌᎵᎹ ᎤᏕᏁᎴᎢ;
\ft And Aram begat Aminadab; and Aminadab begat Naasson; and Naasson begat Salmon;

\ln Salimano Quosi udenelei Lehawi unalvgowisei; Quosino Oquedi udenelei Lusi unanugowisei; Oquedino Tsesi udenelei;
\syll ᏌᎵᎹᏃ ᏉᏏ ᎤᏕᏁᎴᎢ ᎴᎭᏫ ᎤᎾᎸᎪᏫᏎᎢ; ᏉᏏᏃ ᎣᏇᏗ ᎤᏕᏁᎴᎢ ᎷᏏ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᎢ; ᎣᏇᏗᏃ ᏤᏏ ᎤᏕᏁᎴᎢ;
\ft And Salmon begat Booz of Rachab; and Booz begat Obed of Ruth; and Obed begat Jesse;

\ln Tsesino Dewi ugvwiyuhi udenelei; Dewino ugvwiyuhi Solimanv udenelei Yulaya udayvdv unanugowisei;
\syll ᏤᏏᏃ ᏕᏫ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏕᏁᎴᎢ; ᏕᏫᏃ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏐᎵᎹᏅ ᎤᏕᏁᎴᎢ ᏳᎳᏯ ᎤᏓᏴᏛ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᎢ;
\ft And Jesse begat David the king; and David the king begat Solomon of her that had been the wife of Urias;

\ln Solimanvno Loquoma udenelei; Loquomano Equaya udenelei; Equayano Esi udenelei;
\syll ᏐᎵᎹᏅᏃ ᎶᏉᎹ ᎤᏕᏁᎴᎢ; ᎶᏉᎹᏃ ᎡᏆᏯ ᎤᏕᏁᎴᎢ; ᎡᏆᏯᏃ ᎡᏏ ᎤᏕᏁᎴᎢ;
\ft And Solomon begat Roboam; and Roboam begat Abia; and Abia begat Asa;

\ln Esino Tsosiqua udenelei.  Tsosiquano Tsolami udenelei; Tsolamino Osaya udenelei;
\syll ᎡᏏᏃ ᏦᏏᏆ ᎤᏕᏁᎴᎢ.  ᏦᏏᏆᏃ ᏦᎳᎻ ᎤᏕᏁᎴᎢ; ᏦᎳᎻᏃ ᎣᏌᏯ ᎤᏕᏁᎴᎢ;
\ft And Asa begat Josaphat; and Josaphat begat Joram; and Joram begat Ozias;

\ln Osayano Tsodami udenelei; Tsodamino Ehasi udenelei; Ehasino Hesigaya udenelei;
\syll ᎣᏌᏯᏃ ᏦᏓᎻ ᎤᏕᏁᎴᎢ; ᏦᏓᎻᏃ ᎡᎭᏏ ᎤᏕᏁᎴᎢ; ᎡᎭᏏᏃ ᎮᏏᎦᏯ ᎤᏕᏁᎴᎢ;
\ft And Ozias begat Joatham; and Joatham begat Achaz; and Achaz begat Ezekias;

\ln Hesigayano Manasi udenelei; Manasino Amoni udenelei; Amonino Tsosaya udenelei;
\syll ᎮᏏᎦᏯᏃ ᎹᎾᏏ ᎤᏕᏁᎴᎢ; ᎹᎾᏏᏃ ᎠᎼᏂ ᎤᏕᏁᎴᎢ; ᎠᎼᏂᏃ ᏦᏌᏯ ᎤᏕᏁᎴᎢ;
\ft And Ezekias begat Manasses; and Manasses begat Amon; and Amon begat Josias;

\ln Tsosayano Tsegonaya ale anadanvtli gvwadenelei; nahiyu Dadiloni tsiwidigegatinvstanei;
\syll ᏦᏌᏯᏃ ᏤᎪᎾᏯ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎾᏓᏅᏟ ᎬᏩᏕᏁᎴᎢ; ᏀᎢᏳ ᏓᏗᎶᏂ ᏥᏫᏗᎨᎦᏘᏅᏍᏔᏁᎢ;
\ft And Josias begat Jechonias and his brethren, about the time they were carried away to Babylon:

\ln Dadilonino widigegatinolv Tsegonaya Saladayili udenelei; Saladayilino Tsilaqueli udenelei;
\syll ᏓᏗᎶᏂᏃ ᏫᏗᎨᎦᏘᏃᎸ ᏤᎪᎾᏯ ᏌᎳᏓᏱᎵ ᎤᏕᏁᎴᎢ; ᏌᎳᏓᏱᎵᏃ ᏥᎳᏇᎵ ᎤᏕᏁᎴᎢ;
\ft And after they were brought to Babylon, Jechonias begat Salathiel; and Salathiel begat Zorobabel;

\ln Tsilaquelino Aquayadi udenelei, Aquayadino Ilayagimi udenelei; Ilayagimino Eso udenelei;
\syll ᏥᎳᏇᎵᏃ ᎠᏆᏯᏗ ᎤᏕᏁᎴᎢ, ᎠᏆᏯᏗᏃ ᎢᎳᏯᎩᎻ ᎤᏕᏁᎴᎢ; ᎢᎳᏯᎩᎻᏃ ᎡᏐ ᎤᏕᏁᎴᎢ;
\ft And Zorobabel begat Abiud; and Abiud begat Eliakim; and Eliakim begat Azor;

\ln Esono Sedogi udenelei; Sedogino Egimi udenelei; Egimino Ilayadi udenelei;
\syll ᎡᏐᏃ ᏎᏙᎩ ᎤᏕᏁᎴᎢ; ᏎᏙᎩᏃ ᎡᎩᎻ ᎤᏕᏁᎴᎢ; ᎡᎩᎻᏃ ᎢᎳᏯᏗ ᎤᏕᏁᎴᎢ;
\ft And Azor begat Sadoc; and Sadoc begat Achim; and Achim begat Eliud;

\ln Ilayadino Iliesa udenelei; Iliesano Madani udenelei; Madanino Tsegaqui udenelei;
\syll ᎢᎳᏯᏗᏃ ᎢᎵᎡᏌ ᎤᏕᏁᎴᎢ; ᎢᎵᎡᏌᏃ ᎹᏓᏂ ᎤᏕᏁᎴᎢ; ᎹᏓᏂᏃ ᏤᎦᏈ ᎤᏕᏁᎴᎢ;
\ft And Eliud begat Eleazar; and Eleazar begat Matthan; and Matthan begat Jacob;

\ln Tsegaquino Tsowa udenelei, nasgi Meli uyehi nasgi tsunanugowise Tsisa Galonedv tsanohahoi.
\syll ᏤᎦᏈᏃ ᏦᏩ ᎤᏕᏁᎴᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎺᎵ ᎤᏰᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏣᏃᎭᎰᎢ.
\ft And Jacob begat Joseph the husband of Mary, of whom was born Jesus, who is called Christ.

\ln Nasgino nigadv nunadanetliyvsv Equahami tsehe nahiyu nvdagvwadalenvdv Dewino tsehe nvdvsti nigadu nunadanetliyvsei; Dewino tsehe nahiyu nvligvwadalenvdv Dadilonino tsiwidigegatinvstane nahiyu nvdvsti nigadu nunadanetliyvsei; Dadilonino nahiyu tsiwidigegatinvstane udayudalenvdv Tsisano tsudene nahiyu nvdvsti nigadu nunadanetliyvsei.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏄᎾᏓᏁᏟᏴᏒ ᎡᏆᎭᎻ ᏤᎮ ᏀᎢᏳ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏕᏫᏃ ᏤᎮ ᏅᏛᏍᏘ ᏂᎦᏚ ᏄᎾᏓᏁᏟᏴᏎᎢ; ᏕᏫᏃ ᏤᎮ ᏀᎢᏳ ᏅᎵᎬᏩᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏓᏗᎶᏂᏃ ᏥᏫᏗᎨᎦᏘᏅᏍᏔᏁ ᏀᎢᏳ ᏅᏛᏍᏘ ᏂᎦᏚ ᏄᎾᏓᏁᏟᏴᏎᎢ; ᏓᏗᎶᏂᏃ ᏀᎢᏳ ᏥᏫᏗᎨᎦᏘᏅᏍᏔᏁ ᎤᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏥᏌᏃ ᏧᏕᏁ ᏀᎢᏳ ᏅᏛᏍᏘ ᏂᎦᏚ ᏄᎾᏓᏁᏟᏴᏎᎢ.
\ft So all the generations from Abraham to David are fourteen generations; and from David until the carrying away into Babylon are fourteen generations; and from the carrying away into Babylon unto Christ are fourteen generations.

\ln Nasgino hia nulistanidole udenv Tsisa Galonedv.  Nasgi Meli Tsisa utsi Tsowa udayvsdi, asiquo nidanatsegvna gesei, unelitse Galvquodiyu Adanvdo udanvtelvhi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏂᏙᎴ ᎤᏕᏅ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ.  ᎾᏍᎩ ᎺᎵ ᏥᏌ ᎤᏥ ᏦᏩ ᎤᏓᏴᏍᏗ, ᎠᏏᏉ ᏂᏓᎾᏤᎬᎾ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎤᏁᎵᏤ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᏓᏅᏖᎸᎯ.
\ft Now the birth of Jesus Christ was on this wise: When as his mother Mary was espoused to Joseph, before they came together, she was found with child of the Holy Ghost.

\ln Tsowa nasgi na tsunatsvsdi udanvtiyu gesv iyusdi, ale nudulisgvna gesv iyusdi gvnigesv udehohisdodiyi, udelidvquo iyvdv wvdatsiyakani, uwelisei.
\syll ᏦᏩ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏧᎾᏨᏍᏗ ᎤᏓᏅᏘᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏄᏚᎵᏍᎬᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎤᏕᎰᎯᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎤᏕᎵᏛᏉ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏮᏓᏥᏯᎧᏂ, ᎤᏪᎵᏎᎢ.
\ft Then Joseph her husband, being a just man, and not willing to make her a publick example, was minded to put her away privily.

\ln Aseno asiquo hia nasgi nusdeadanvtesgei, gvniyuquo dikahnawadidohi Yihowa unvsidv gvnigesv nudvnele asgidasgvi, hia nigawesgei; Tsowa, Dewi uwetsi, tlesdi tsasgalv hiyanvdiyi Meli tsadayvsdi, nasgiyeno na tsiganeli Galvquodiyu Adanvdo udanvtelvhi;
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᏏᏉ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏕᎠᏓᏅᏖᏍᎨᎢ, ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏱᎰᏩ ᎤᏅᏏᏛ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏄᏛᏁᎴ ᎠᏍᎩᏓᏍᎬᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎨᎢ; ᏦᏩ, ᏕᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᏣᏍᎦᎸ ᎯᏯᏅᏗᏱ ᎺᎵ ᏣᏓᏴᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ Ꮎ ᏥᎦᏁᎵ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᏓᏅᏖᎸᎯ;
\ft But while he thought on these things, behold, the angel of the Lord appeared unto him in a dream, saying, Joseph, thou son of David, fear not to take unto thee Mary thy wife: for that which is conceived in her is of the Holy Ghost.

\ln Ale dagananugowisi atsutsa, nasgino TsiSa dehiyovha, tsutseliyeno yvwi dodvsdelvhi dodagudalesi unisganvtsvi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏓᎦᎾᏄᎪᏫᏏ ᎠᏧᏣ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏥᏌ ᏕᎯᏲᎥᎭ, ᏧᏤᎵᏰᏃ ᏴᏫ ᏙᏛᏍᏕᎸᎯ ᏙᏓᎫᏓᎴᏏ ᎤᏂᏍᎦᏅᏨᎢ.
\ft And she shall bring forth a son, and thou shalt call his name JESUS: for he shall save his people from their sins.

\ln Nasgino hia nigadiyu nulistanidole udohiyudiyi ayelvsvi hia tsinuwese Yihowa adolehosgi agvdisgvi;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏂᏙᎴ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᏗᏱ ᎠᏰᎸᏒᎢ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏄᏪᏎ ᏱᎰᏩ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎠᎬᏗᏍᎬᎢ;
\ft Now all this was done, that it might be fulfilled which was spoken of the Lord by the prophet, saying,

\ln Gvniyuquo adv natsiyehvna ganelidv gesesdi, ale dagananugowisi atsutsa, nasgino Imanueli anosehesdi, nasgi anetlvtanvhi gesv hia nusdi gadvga, Unelanvhi igeladidoha.
\syll ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎠᏛ ᎾᏥᏰᎲᎾ ᎦᏁᎵᏛ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᎦᎾᏄᎪᏫᏏ ᎠᏧᏣ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎢᎹᏄᎡᎵ ᎠᏃᏎᎮᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏁᏢᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏍᏗ ᎦᏛᎦ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᎨᎳᏗᏙᎭ.
\ft Behold, a virgin shall be with child, and shall bring forth a son, and they shall call his name Emmanuel, which being interpreted is, God with us.

\ln Tsowano uyetsv ulvnvi dikahnawadidohi Yihowa nvdayunvsidv nuweselv nudvnelei, uyanvgequo udayvsdi.
\syll ᏦᏩᏃ ᎤᏰᏨ ᎤᎸᏅᎢ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏱᎰᏩ ᏅᏓᏳᏅᏏᏛ ᏄᏪᏎᎸ ᏄᏛᏁᎴᎢ, ᎤᏯᏅᎨᏉ ᎤᏓᏴᏍᏗ.
\ft Then Joseph being raised from sleep did as the angel of the Lord had bidden him, and took unto him his wife:

\ln Ale vtla yugadovsei gvni unanugowisv igvyi ehi uwetsi atsutsa, Tsisano suwoei.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᏳᎦᏙᎥᏎᎢ ᎬᏂ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏫᏒ ᎢᎬᏱ ᎡᎯ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎠᏧᏣ, ᏥᏌᏃ ᏑᏬᎡᎢ.
\ft And knew her not till she had brought forth her firstborn son: and he called his name JESUS.

\ln Tsisano udenv Gaduyi gaduhv Tsudiyi, nahiyu tsehe Elodv ugvwiyuhi, gvniyuquo unilutse Tsilusilimi anigatahnai nvdo dikalvgv iditlv tsunilosei,
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᏕᏅ ᎦᏚᏱ ᎦᏚᎲ ᏧᏗᏱ, ᏀᎢᏳ ᏤᎮ ᎡᎶᏛ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎤᏂᎷᏤ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎿᎢ ᏅᏙ ᏗᎧᎸᎬ ᎢᏗᏢ ᏧᏂᎶᏎᎢ,
\ft Now when Jesus was born in Bethlehem of Judaea in the days of Herod the king, behold, there came wise men from the east to Jerusalem,

\ln Hia nuniwesei; hatlv na tsudenv Ugvwiyuhi Anitsusi unatseliga, ogigohvyeno utseli noquisi dikalvgv iditlv, ale otsadadolisdaneliga.
\syll ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ; ᎭᏢ Ꮎ ᏧᏕᏅ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ, ᎣᎩᎪᎲᏰᏃ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏃᏈᏏ ᏗᎧᎸᎬ ᎢᏗᏢ, ᎠᎴ ᎣᏣᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎵᎦ.
\ft Saying, Where is he that is born King of the Jews? for we have seen his star in the east, and are come to worship him.

\ln Elodvno ugvwiyuhi udvganv nasgi, uwelihisdi udanvdadei, ale nigadv Tsilusilimi anehi.
\syll ᎡᎶᏛᏃ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏛᎦᏅ ᎾᏍᎩ, ᎤᏪᎵᎯᏍᏗ ᎤᏓᏅᏓᏕᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᎠᏁᎯ.
\ft When Herod the king had heard these things, he was troubled, and all Jerusalem with him.

\ln Dulawidvno nigadv nunigvwiyusv atsilv anelohi, ale yvwi dinowelanehi, dudvdvnei, nahna udedi gesv Galonedv.
\syll ᏚᎳᏫᏛᏃ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸ ᎠᏁᎶᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏴᏫ ᏗᏃᏪᎳᏁᎯ, ᏚᏛᏛᏁᎢ, ᏀᎾ ᎤᏕᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ.
\ft And when he had gathered all the chief priests and scribes of the people together, he demanded of them where Christ should be born.

\ln Hiano nigvwaweselei; Tsudiyi Gaduyi gaduhvi; hiayeno nuwanv uwowela adolehosgi;
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᎬᏩᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᏧᏗᏱ ᎦᏚᏱ ᎦᏚᎲᎢ; ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᏄᏩᏅ ᎤᏬᏪᎳ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ;
\ft And they said unto him, In Bethlehem of Judaea: for thus it is written by the prophet,

\ln Ale nihi Gaduyi gaduhv Tsudiyi, vtlasgini tsasdikani yigi, tsilodasuya nunigvwiyusv Tsudiyi, nihiyeno datsanugotsi diquatseli yvwi Isilidikanetsehi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏂᎯ ᎦᏚᏱ ᎦᏚᎲ ᏧᏗᏱ, ᎥᏝᏍᎩᏂ ᏣᏍᏗᎧᏂ ᏱᎩ, ᏥᎶᏓᏑᏯ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᏧᏗᏱ, ᏂᎯᏰᏃ ᏓᏣᏄᎪᏥ ᏗᏆᏤᎵ ᏴᏫ ᎢᏏᎵᏗᎧᏁᏤᎯ.
\ft And thou Bethlehem, in the land of Juda, art not the least among the princes of Juda: for out of thee shall come a Governor, that shall rule my people Israel.

\ln Hnaquono Elodv udelidv widuyanvhv nasgi anigatahnai, osdv dudvtisane iyuquo nasgi noquisi unanugotsvi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎡᎶᏛ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᏫᏚᏯᏅᎲ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎿᎢ, ᎣᏍᏛ ᏚᏛᏘᏌᏁ ᎢᏳᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏃᏈᏏ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏨᎢ.
\ft Then Herod, when he had privily called the wise men, inquired of them diligently what time the star appeared.

\ln Ale dunvse Gaduyi, hia nuwesei; Itsena osdv wetsiyoga nasgi usdi ayoli, iyuno etsiwadvhvha, isginonelilvha, ayvno nasquo witsilutsvha, ale tsiyadadolisdanelvha.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏚᏅᏎ ᎦᏚᏱ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎢᏤᎾ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏪᏥᏲᎦ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎠᏲᎵ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎡᏥᏩᏛᎲᎭ, ᎢᏍᎩᏃᏁᎵᎸᎭ, ᎠᏴᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏫᏥᎷᏨᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᏯᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎸᎭ.
\ft And he sent them to Bethlehem, and said, Go and search diligently for the young child; and when ye have found him, bring me word again, that I may come and worship him also.

\ln Unadvganonelvno ugvwiyuhi unanigisei, gvniyuquono noquisi, nasgi unigohvhi dikalvgv iditlv, igvyi unenvelei, gvni wulutsilv ale ulewistanv galvladitlv nahna atsili ehvi.
\syll ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏃᏁᎸᏃ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᎾᏂᎩᏎᎢ, ᎬᏂᏳᏉᏃ ᏃᏈᏏ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᎪᎲᎯ ᏗᎧᎸᎬ ᎢᏗᏢ, ᎢᎬᏱ ᎤᏁᏅᎡᎴᎢ, ᎬᏂ ᏭᎷᏥᎸ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎴᏫᏍᏔᏅ ᎦᎸᎳᏗᏢ ᏀᎾ ᎠᏥᎵ ᎡᎲᎢ.
\ft When they had heard the king, they departed; and, lo, the star, which they saw in the east, went before them, till it came and stood over where the young child was.

\ln Unigohvno nasgi noquisi, ulotanvhi unalihelitsei.
\syll ᎤᏂᎪᎲᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏃᏈᏏ, ᎤᎶᏔᏅᎯ ᎤᎾᎵᎮᎵᏤᎢ.
\ft When they saw the star, they rejoiced with exceeding great joy.

\ln Adanelvno uniyvlv unigohe ayotla ale utsi Meli, ale eladi dunadanvnei, unadadolisdanelei, ale tsugvwalodi unilanvdv dunisduisv uninelvne nvnalisgolvtanvhi, adelvdalonidv, ale uganasdv gawasvgi adla, ale mila.
\syll ᎠᏓᏁᎸᏃ ᎤᏂᏴᎸ ᎤᏂᎪᎮ ᎠᏲᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏥ ᎺᎵ, ᎠᎴ ᎡᎳᏗ ᏚᎾᏓᏅᏁᎢ, ᎤᎾᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎤᏂᎳᏅᏛ ᏚᏂᏍᏚᎢᏒ ᎤᏂᏁᎸᏁ ᏅᎾᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏅᎯ, ᎠᏕᎸᏓᎶᏂᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎦᎾᏍᏛ ᎦᏩᏒᎩ ᎠᏜ, ᎠᎴ ᎻᎳ.
\ft And when they were come into the house, they saw the young child with Mary his mother, and fell down, and worshipped him: and when they had opened their treasures, they presented unto him gifts; gold, and frankincense, and myrrh.

\ln Anasgidasgvno Unelanvhi dunetselv Elodvyi wunilohisdiyi nigesvna, unanigisv utsatiniquo iditlv wunilose iunenv unatseligohi.
\syll ᎠᎾᏍᎩᏓᏍᎬᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏚᏁᏤᎸ ᎡᎶᏛᏱ ᏭᏂᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎤᎾᏂᎩᏒ ᎤᏣᏘᏂᏉ ᎢᏗᏢ ᏭᏂᎶᏎ ᎢᎤᏁᏅ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎪᎯ.
\ft And being warned of God in a dream that they should not return to Herod, they departed into their own country another way.

\ln Unanigisvno gvniyuquo dikahnawadidohi unvsidv Yihowa gvnigesv nudvnele Tsowa asgidasgvi, hia nuweselei; Talehvga, ale tatinuga ayoli ale utsi ale haliti, Itsiqui wilohi, nahnano wehesdi gvni wigvnetselvha, Elodvyeno ase dvyoli usdi ayoli uhisdiyi.
\syll ᎤᎾᏂᎩᏒᏃ ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎤᏅᏏᏛ ᏱᎰᏩ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏄᏛᏁᎴ ᏦᏩ ᎠᏍᎩᏓᏍᎬᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᏔᎴᎲᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᏔᏘᏄᎦ ᎠᏲᎵ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏥ ᎠᎴ ᎭᎵᏘ, ᎢᏥᏈ ᏫᎶᎯ, ᏀᎾᏃ ᏪᎮᏍᏗ ᎬᏂ ᏫᎬᏁᏤᎸᎭ, ᎡᎶᏛᏰᏃ ᎠᏎ ᏛᏲᎵ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎠᏲᎵ ᎤᎯᏍᏗᏱ.
\ft And when they were departed, behold, the angel of the Lord appeareth to Joseph in a dream, saying, Arise, and take the young child and his mother, and flee into Egypt, and be thou there until I bring thee word: for Herod will seek the young child to destroy him.

\ln Hnaquono dulenv utinvse ayoli ale utsi svnoyi, ale Itsidvyi wulosei.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏚᎴᏅ ᎤᏘᏅᏎ ᎠᏲᎵ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏥ ᏒᏃᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏥᏛᏱ ᏭᎶᏎᎢ.
\ft When he arose, he took the young child and his mother by night, and departed into Egypt:

\ln Ale nahna wehe gvni Elodv uyohusv; udohiyune Unelanvhi unetsvi, adolehosgi tsuwvtanei, hia tsinuwesei; Itsiquiyi witsiyanvhv aquetsi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏀᎾ ᏪᎮ ᎬᏂ ᎡᎶᏛ ᎤᏲᎱᏒ; ᎤᏙᎯᏳᏁ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏁᏨᎢ, ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᏧᏮᏔᏁᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏥᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎢᏥᏈᏱ ᏫᏥᏯᏅᎲ ᎠᏇᏥ.
\ft And was there until the death of Herod: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken of the Lord by the prophet, saying, Out of Egypt have I called my son.

\ln Hnaquono Elodv udolehosv anigatahnai gvwalidastanvi, utsatanvhi utalawosei, ale udanvse widunihone nigadv diniyoli gaduyi anehi, ale nigadv nigvnadv nahnani, tali iyunadetiyvdv wasti, nahiyu nvdayudalenvdv tsidalisinahisdanehe tsidadvdvhelvvsge anigatahnai.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎡᎶᏛ ᎤᏙᎴᎰᏒ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎿᎢ ᎬᏩᎵᏓᏍᏔᏅᎢ, ᎤᏣᏔᏅᎯ ᎤᏔᎳᏬᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᏅᏎ ᏫᏚᏂᎰᏁ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏗᏂᏲᎵ ᎦᏚᏱ ᎠᏁᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏂᎬᎾᏛ ᏀᎾᏂ, ᏔᎵ ᎢᏳᎾᏕᏘᏴᏛ ᏩᏍᏘ, ᏀᎢᏳ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏥᏓᎵᏏᏀᎢᏍᏓᏁᎮ ᏥᏓᏛᏛᎮᎸᎥᏍᎨ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎿᎢ.
\ft Then Herod, when he saw that he was mocked of the wise men, was exceeding wroth, and sent forth, and slew all the children that were in Bethlehem, and in all the coasts thereof, from two years old and under, according to the time which he had diligently inquired of the wise men.

\ln Hnaquono udohiyune Tselimaya adolehosgi unetsvhi, ale tsinuwesei;
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᏁ ᏤᎵᎹᏯ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᏨᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᏄᏪᏎᎢ;
\ft Then was fulfilled that which was spoken by Jeremy the prophet, saying,

\ln Lemayi kanegv unadvganvgi, daniyvgvi, ale danatloyihvi, ale utsati unelugvi; letsili dasgonihv tsuwetsi, ale nudulisgvna gesv unuwohisdiyi, nvdigalisdodisgv nanehvnaquo gesvi.
\syll ᎴᎹᏱ ᎧᏁᎬ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅᎩ, ᏓᏂᏴᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᎾᏠᏱᎲᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᏁᎷᎬᎢ; ᎴᏥᎵ ᏓᏍᎪᏂᎲ ᏧᏪᏥ, ᎠᎴ ᏄᏚᎵᏍᎬᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏄᏬᎯᏍᏗᏱ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬ ᎾᏁᎲᎾᏉ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft In Rama was there a voice heard, lamentation, and weeping, and great mourning, Rachel weeping for her children, and would not be comforted, because they are not.

\ln Hnaquono Elodv uyohusv, gvniyuquo dikahnawadidohi Yihowa utseliga gvnigesv nudvnele Tsowa asgidasgv Itsiquiyi,
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎡᎶᏛ ᎤᏲᎱᏒ, ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏱᎰᏩ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏄᏛᏁᎴ ᏦᏩ ᎠᏍᎩᏓᏍᎬ ᎢᏥᏈᏱ,
\ft But when Herod was dead, behold, an angel of the Lord appeareth in a dream to Joseph in Egypt,

\ln Hia nuweselei; Talehvga ale hatinuga ayoli ale utsi, ale hena Isiliyi, hnaquoyeno duniyohusv ayoli gvnv tsuniyohvgi.
\syll ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᏔᎴᎲᎦ ᎠᎴ ᎭᏘᏄᎦ ᎠᏲᎵ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏥ, ᎠᎴ ᎮᎾ ᎢᏏᎵᏱ, ᎿᏉᏰᏃ ᏚᏂᏲᎱᏒ ᎠᏲᎵ ᎬᏅ ᏧᏂᏲᎲᎩ.
\ft Saying, Arise, and take the young child and his mother, and go into the land of Israel: for they are dead which sought the young child's life.

\ln Dulenvno utinvse ayoli ale utsi, ale Isiliyi wulutsei.
\syll ᏚᎴᏅᏃ ᎤᏘᏅᏎ ᎠᏲᎵ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏥ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏏᎵᏱ ᏭᎷᏤᎢ.
\ft And he arose, and took the young child and his mother, and came into the land of Israel.

\ln Aseno udvganv Atsila ugvwiyuhi gesv Tsudiyi udoda Elodv udanetliyvsdanelvi, usgale nahna wulohisdiyi; aseno Unelanvhi uweyatanvhi gesv asgidasgvi, Gelili wugolvstanei;
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏛᎦᏅ ᎠᏥᎳ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏧᏗᏱ ᎤᏙᏓ ᎡᎶᏛ ᎤᏓᏁᏟᏴᏍᏓᏁᎸᎢ, ᎤᏍᎦᎴ ᏀᎾ ᏭᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏪᏯᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏍᎩᏓᏍᎬᎢ, ᎨᎵᎵ ᏭᎪᎸᏍᏔᏁᎢ;
\ft But when he heard that Archelaus did reign in Judaea in the room of his father Herod, he was afraid to go thither: notwithstanding, being warned of God in a dream, he turned aside into the parts of Galilee:

\ln Gaduhvno Naselidi tsudoidv wulutsv nahna ehei.  Nasgino udohiyune anadolehosgi tsuninetsei, Naselidi ehi agosehesdi, tsunadvnei.
\syll ᎦᏚᎲᏃ ᎾᏎᎵᏗ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ ᏭᎷᏨ ᏀᎾ ᎡᎮᎢ.  ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᏁ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᏧᏂᏁᏤᎢ, ᎾᏎᎵᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎠᎪᏎᎮᏍᏗ, ᏧᎾᏛᏁᎢ.
\ft And he came and dwelt in a city called Nazareth: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophets, He shall be called a Nazarene.

\ln Nahiyu ulutse Tsani Didawosgi alitsidohvsge inage Tsudiyi,
\syll ᏀᎢᏳ ᎤᎷᏤ ᏣᏂ ᏗᏓᏬᏍᎩ ᎠᎵᏥᏙᎲᏍᎨ ᎢᎾᎨ ᏧᏗᏱ,
\ft In those days came John the Baptist, preaching in the wilderness of Judaea,

\ln Hia nigawesgei; Ditsinetliyvna detsadanvdvi, hnaquoyeno galvladi ehi ugvwiyuhi gesv esganiyu dayai.
\syll ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎨᎢ; ᏗᏥᏁᏟᏴᎾ ᏕᏣᏓᏅᏛᎢ, ᎿᏉᏰᏃ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎡᏍᎦᏂᏳ ᏓᏯᎢ.
\ft And saying, Repent ye: for the kingdom of heaven is at hand.

\ln Nasgi hia na tsikaneisdisge adolehosgi Isaya, hia tsinigawesgei; Uweluga gilo inagei, hia nigaweha; Osdv nitsvga Yihowa ulohisdiyi, dunvnv ditsitsinohisda.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ Ꮎ ᏥᎧᏁᎢᏍᏗᏍᎨ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎢᏌᏯ, ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᎦᏪᏍᎨᎢ; ᎤᏪᎷᎦ ᎩᎶ ᎢᎾᎨᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᎭ; ᎣᏍᏛ ᏂᏨᎦ ᏱᎰᏩ ᎤᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ, ᏚᏅᏅ ᏗᏥᏥᏃᎯᏍᏓ.
\ft For this is he that was spoken of by the prophet Esaias, saying, The voice of one crying in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the Lord, make his paths straight.

\ln Nasgino hia Tsani unuwe gemili ustiyenvhi, ganotsino udatlosdei, ulisdayvdino vle gese inageno ehi wadulisi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏣᏂ ᎤᏄᏪ ᎨᎻᎵ ᎤᏍᏘᏰᏅᎯ, ᎦᏃᏥᏃ ᎤᏓᏠᏍᏕᎢ, ᎤᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏃ ᎥᎴ ᎨᏎ ᎢᎾᎨᏃ ᎡᎯ ᏩᏚᎵᏏ.
\ft And the same John had his raiment of camel's hair, and a leathern girdle about his loins; and his meat was locusts and wild honey.

\ln Naquono wigvwalutsele Tsilusilimi ale nigadv Tsudiyi, ale nigadv nanvnadv Tsodani,
\syll ᎾᏉᏃ ᏫᎬᏩᎷᏤᎴ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏧᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎾᏅᎾᏛ ᏦᏓᏂ,
\ft Then went out to him Jerusalem, and all Judaea, and all the region round about Jordan,

\ln Tsodanino deuwoei, aninohvsge unisganvtsvi.
\syll ᏦᏓᏂᏃ ᏕᎤᏬᎡᎢ, ᎠᏂᏃᎲᏍᎨ ᎤᏂᏍᎦᏅᏨᎢ.
\ft And were baptized of him in Jordan, confessing their sins.

\ln Aseno dugohv unitsati Aniqualisi ale Anisadusi anilugv dadawosgvi, hia niduwehalei; Yo! inadv tsunetsi nihi! Gago itseyatanv etsaliediyi utalawohisdi tsvtsai?
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᏚᎪᎲ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏌᏚᏏ ᎠᏂᎷᎬ ᏓᏓᏬᏍᎬᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᎭᎴᎢ; Ᏺ ᎢᎾᏛ ᏧᏁᏥ ᏂᎯ ᎦᎪ ᎢᏤᏯᏔᏅ ᎡᏣᎵᎡᏗᏱ ᎤᏔᎳᏬᎯᏍᏗ ᏨᏣᎢ?
\ft But when he saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees come to his baptism, he said unto them, O generation of vipers, who hath warned you to flee from the wrath to come?

\ln Itsinanugowayogo adolehohisdodi detsinetliyvsv detsadanvdvi;
\syll ᎢᏥᎾᏄᎪᏩᏲᎪ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏙᏗ ᏕᏥᏁᏟᏴᏒ ᏕᏣᏓᏅᏛᎢ;
\ft Bring forth therefore fruits meet for repentance:

\ln Ale tlasdi hia nvdayotsiwesi itselisvgi doditsadanvdvi; Equahami ogidoda; itsvyoseyeno Unelanvhi yeliquo hia nvya yidegvda yidegotlvna Equahami tsuwetsi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏝᏍᏗ ᎯᎠ ᏅᏓᏲᏥᏪᏏ ᎢᏤᎵᏒᎩ ᏙᏗᏣᏓᏅᏛᎢ; ᎡᏆᎭᎻ ᎣᎩᏙᏓ; ᎢᏨᏲᏎᏰᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏰᎵᏉ ᎯᎠ ᏅᏯ ᏱᏕᎬᏓ ᏱᏕᎪᏢᎾ ᎡᏆᎭᎻ ᏧᏪᏥ.
\ft And think not to say within yourselves, We have Abraham to our father: for I say unto you, that God is able of these stones to raise up children unto Abraham.

\ln Ale nasquo gayula galuyasdi aha duhnasdetlv detlugvi; nasgino nigadv detlugv anosdv nanadadvsgvna digaleyvsdodi ale atsilvyi widadinvdi gesesdi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎦᏳᎳ ᎦᎷᏯᏍᏗ ᎠᎭ ᏚᎿᏍᏕᏢ ᏕᏡᎬᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏕᏡᎬ ᎠᏃᏍᏛ ᎾᎾᏓᏛᏍᎬᎾ ᏗᎦᎴᏴᏍᏙᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏥᎸᏱ ᏫᏓᏗᏅᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft And now also the axe is laid unto the root of the trees: therefore every tree which bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire.

\ln Ayv udohiyuhi ama detsvyawosdiha ditsinetliyvsdiyi detsadanvdv ugvwali; aseno nasgi na oni tsvdayai utlihiyu ulinigidiyu esgaquo ayv, tsulasulo vtla yeli yinigoi diginidasdiyi; nasgisgini Galvquodiyu Adanvdo ale atsilv dodatsawostani.
\syll ᎠᏴ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎠᎹ ᏕᏨᏯᏬᏍᏗᎭ ᏗᏥᏁᏟᏴᏍᏗᏱ ᏕᏣᏓᏅᏛ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎣᏂ ᏨᏓᏯᎢ ᎤᏟᎯᏳ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎠᏴ, ᏧᎳᏑᎶ ᎥᏝ ᏰᎵ ᏱᏂᎪᎢ ᏗᎩᏂᏓᏍᏗᏱ; ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏥᎸ ᏙᏓᏣᏬᏍᏔᏂ.
\ft I indeed baptize you with water unto repentance: but he that cometh after me is mightier than I, whose shoes I am not worthy to bear: he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost, and with fire:

\ln Nasgi galasowisdi utseliga ayeha, ale nigadv dagalasowisi, utselino ugatatanvhi dagatlisani dvni adananvdiyi utiyvhisgini dvgohvstani nigvtlosgvna atsilvyi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎳᏐᏫᏍᏗ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᎠᏰᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏓᎦᎳᏐᏫᏏ, ᎤᏤᎵᏃ ᎤᎦᏔᏔᏅᎯ ᏓᎦᏟᏌᏂ ᏛᏂ ᎠᏓᎾᏅᏗᏱ ᎤᏘᏴᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᏛᎪᎲᏍᏔᏂ ᏂᎬᏠᏍᎬᎾ ᎠᏥᎸᏱ.
\ft Whose fan is in his hand, and he will throughly purge his floor, and gather his wheat into the garner; but he will burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire.

\ln Hnaquono Tsisa Gelili tsulosei, Tsodani ulutse Tsani edohvi agawosdiyi uyelvsei.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎨᎵᎵ ᏧᎶᏎᎢ, ᏦᏓᏂ ᎤᎷᏤ ᏣᏂ ᎡᏙᎲᎢ ᎠᎦᏬᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏰᎸᏎᎢ.
\ft Then cometh Jesus from Galilee to Jordan unto John, to be baptized of him.

\ln Aseno Tsani dutlvwiselequo, hia nuwesei; Ayvsgini yisquawov; tsigono isgilutseha?
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᏣᏂ ᏚᏢᏫᏎᎴᏉ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎠᏴᏍᎩᏂ ᏱᏍᏆᏬᎥ; ᏥᎪᏃ ᎢᏍᎩᎷᏤᎭ?
\ft But John forbad him, saying, I have need to be baptized of thee, and comest thou to me?

\ln Tsisano tsunetsv hia nuweselei; Unelagi hela gohi gesvi, osiyuyeno nasgi iginadvnediyi ginisquadisdiyi nigav duyugodv gesvi.  Gila unelagi uweliselei.
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᏧᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎤᏁᎳᎩ ᎮᎳ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎣᏏᏳᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎩᎾᏛᏁᏗᏱ ᎩᏂᏍᏆᏗᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ.  ᎩᎳ ᎤᏁᎳᎩ ᎤᏪᎵᏎᎴᎢ.
\ft And Jesus answering said unto him, Suffer it to be so now: for thus it becometh us to fulfill all righteousness. Then he suffered him.

\ln Tsisano agawov, gilaquo iyvdv uhnalusei, amayi udanvsei, ale gvniyuquo galvladi tsatsisdugielei, ale wugohe Unelanvhi Udanvdo eladi nvtsudvhnadise guledisgonihi ditselidv; ale uweyalvtsei.
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᎠᎦᏬᎥ, ᎩᎳᏉ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎤᎿᎷᏎᎢ, ᎠᎹᏱ ᎤᏓᏅᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏣᏥᏍᏚᎩᎡᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏭᎪᎮ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏓᏅᏙ ᎡᎳᏗ ᏅᏧᏛᎿᏗᏎ ᎫᎴᏗᏍᎪᏂᎯ ᏗᏤᎵᏛ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᏪᏯᎸᏤᎢ.
\ft And Jesus, when he was baptized, went up straightway out of the water: and, lo, the heavens were opened unto him, and he saw the Spirit of God descending like a dove, and lighting upon him:

\ln Ale gvniyuquo hia nvtsuwese galvladi; Hia tsigeyui Aquetsi, nasgi osiyu tsitsiyelva.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎯᎠ ᏅᏧᏪᏎ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ; ᎯᎠ ᏥᎨᏳᎢ ᎠᏇᏥ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏏᏳ ᏥᏥᏰᎸᎠ.
\ft And lo a voice from heaven, saying, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.

\ln Hnaquono Adanvdo inage wutinvstane Tsisa, asgina ugoliyediyi ayelvsei.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎢᎾᎨ ᏭᏘᏅᏍᏔᏁ ᏥᏌ, ᎠᏍᎩᎾ ᎤᎪᎵᏰᏗᏱ ᎠᏰᎸᏎᎢ.
\ft Then was Jesus led up of the Spirit into the wilderness to be tempted of the devil.

\ln Nvgasgohino tsudodaquadv ale nvgasgohi tsusvhidv amatli uwanv gila uyosisanei
\syll ᏅᎦᏍᎪᎯᏃ ᏧᏙᏓᏆᏛ ᎠᎴ ᏅᎦᏍᎪᎯ ᏧᏒᎯᏛ ᎠᎹᏟ ᎤᏩᏅ ᎩᎳ ᎤᏲᏏᏌᏁᎢ
\ft And when he had fasted forty days and forty nights, he was afterward an hungred.

\ln Hnaquono ugoliyesgi ulutselv hia nuwesei; Iyuno nihi Unelanvhi Uwetsi gesesdi, hia nvya gadu unadotlvdiyi hinegi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎤᎪᎵᏰᏍᎩ ᎤᎷᏤᎸ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᏂᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎯᎠ ᏅᏯ ᎦᏚ ᎤᎾᏙᏢᏗᏱ ᎯᏁᎩ.
\ft And when the tempter came to him, he said, If thou be the Son of God, command that these stones be made bread.

\ln Aseno unetsv, hia nuwesei; Hia nigvnv gowela, yvwi vtla gaduquo uwasv yigvhnadisdi, nigavsgini kanohedv Unelanvhi aholi nvdayunanugotsvhi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏁᏨ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏅ ᎪᏪᎳ, ᏴᏫ ᎥᏝ ᎦᏚᏉ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏱᎬᎿᏗᏍᏗ, ᏂᎦᎥᏍᎩᏂ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎰᎵ ᏅᏓᏳᎾᏄᎪᏨᎯ.
\ft But he answered and said, It is written, Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of God.

\ln Hnaquono asgina galvquodiyu digaduhv wutinvstanei, ale wugilvtane usgoli udvnvdigalawiisdiyi;
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎠᏍᎩᎾ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᏗᎦᏚᎲ ᏭᏘᏅᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏭᎩᎸᏔᏁ ᎤᏍᎪᎵ ᎤᏛᏅᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ;
\ft Then the devil taketh him up into the holy city, and setteth him on a pinnacle of the temple,

\ln Hiano nuweselei; Iyuno nihi Unelanvhi Uwetsi gesesdi, hadalovda tsvsv; hiayeno nigvnv igowela; Ase dodakanetseli gutseli dinikahnawadidohi nisa gesv ugvwali, ale tsunoyeni getsasaladodesdi nasgi ilvhiyu nvyohi tsanasqualosdodiyi nigesvna.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᏂᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎭᏓᎶᎥᏓ ᏨᏒ; ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᏂᎬᏅ ᎢᎪᏪᎳ; ᎠᏎ ᏙᏓᎧᏁᏤᎵ ᎫᏤᎵ ᏗᏂᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏂᏌ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏃᏰᏂ ᎨᏣᏌᎳᏙᏕᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᏅᏲᎯ ᏣᎾᏍᏆᎶᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.
\ft And saith unto him, If thou be the Son of God, cast thyself down: for it is written, He shall give his angels charge concerning thee: and in their hands they shall bear thee up, lest at any time thou dash thy foot against a stone.

\ln Tsisa hia nuweselei; Hia nasquo nigvnv igowela; Tlesdi higoliyevgi Yihowa Tsanelanvhi.
\syll ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏂᎬᏅ ᎢᎪᏪᎳ; ᏞᏍᏗ ᎯᎪᎵᏰᎥᎩ ᏱᎰᏩ ᏣᏁᎳᏅᎯ.
\ft Jesus said unto him, It is written again, Thou shalt not tempt the Lord thy God.

\ln Hnaquale asgina utsati invigati odalv wiutinvstanei, ale dusehele nigav ayeli degotlvwadisv elanigvi, ale nasgi niduwodusvi;
\syll ᎿᏆᎴ ᎠᏍᎩᎾ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎢᏅᎢᎦᏘ ᎣᏓᎸ ᏫᎤᏘᏅᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏎᎮᎴ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎠᏰᎵ ᏕᎪᏢᏩᏗᏒ ᎡᎳᏂᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᏚᏬᏚᏒᎢ;
\ft Again, the devil taketh him up into an exceeding high mountain, and sheweth him all the kingdoms of the world, and the glory of them;

\ln Ale hia nuweselei; Hia nigadv yidegvyohisi, iyuno yitsadanvnv, ale yisquadadolisdanelv.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏱᏕᎬᏲᎯᏏ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᏱᏣᏓᏅᏅ, ᎠᎴ ᏱᏍᏆᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎸ.
\ft And saith unto him, All these things will I give thee, if thou wilt fall down and worship me.

\ln Hnaquono Tsisa hia nuweselei; Utli wilohi, Sedani, hiayeno nigvnv igowela; ase hiyadadolisdanehesdi Yihowa Tsanelanvhi, ale nasgiquo uwasvhiyu dehiyanelodesdi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎤᏟ ᏫᎶᎯ, ᏎᏓᏂ, ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᏂᎬᏅ ᎢᎪᏪᎳ; ᎠᏎ ᎯᏯᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᏱᎰᏩ ᏣᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩᏉ ᎤᏩᏒᎯᏳ ᏕᎯᏯᏁᎶᏕᏍᏗ.
\ft Then saith Jesus unto him, Get thee hence, Satan: for it is written, Thou shalt worship the Lord thy God, and him only shalt thou serve.

\ln Gilano asgina udanvelei, gvniyuquono dinikahnawadidohi unilutsei, ale gvwasdelvhidolei.
\syll ᎩᎳᏃ ᎠᏍᎩᎾ ᎤᏓᏅᎡᎴᎢ, ᎬᏂᏳᏉᏃ ᏗᏂᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎤᏂᎷᏤᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᏍᏕᎸᎯᏙᎴᎢ.
\ft Then the devil leaveth him, and, behold, angels came and ministered unto him.

\ln Tsisano udvganv Tsani atsisduhvi, Gelili wulosei.
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᏛᎦᏅ ᏣᏂ ᎠᏥᏍᏚᎲᎢ, ᎨᎵᎵ ᏭᎶᏎᎢ.
\ft Now when Jesus had heard that John was cast into prison, he departed into Galilee;

\ln Naselidino udanvsv gequani gelutse nahna wudenei, nasgi vdali amayulodi tsigaduha, Tsequalani ale Newatali unatseligohi,
\syll ᎾᏎᎵᏗᏃ ᎤᏓᏅᏒ ᎨᏆᏂ ᎨᎷᏤ ᏀᎾ ᏭᏕᏁᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎥᏓᎵ ᎠᎹᏳᎶᏗ ᏥᎦᏚᎭ, ᏤᏆᎳᏂ ᎠᎴ ᏁᏩᏔᎵ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎪᎯ,
\ft And leaving Nazareth, he came and dwelt in Capernaum, which is upon the sea coast, in the borders of Zabulon and Nephthalim:

\ln Udohiyudiyi adolehosgi Isaya tsunetsei, hia tsinuwesei;
\syll ᎤᏙᎯᏳᏗᏱ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎢᏌᏯ ᏧᏁᏤᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏥᏄᏪᏎᎢ;
\ft That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Esaias the prophet, saying,

\ln Tsequalani unatseligohi, ale Newatali unatseligohi, idali iditlv, Tsodani udiditlv, Gelili Tsunadalenvdv yvwi daninelvi,
\syll ᏤᏆᎳᏂ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎪᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏁᏩᏔᎵ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎪᎯ, ᎢᏓᎵ ᎢᏗᏢ, ᏦᏓᏂ ᎤᏗᏗᏢ, ᎨᎵᎵ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᏓᏂᏁᎸᎢ,
\ft The land of Zabulon, and the land of Nephthalim, by the way of the sea, beyond Jordan, Galilee of the Gentiles;

\ln Yvwi ulisigv tsaninvgi utsati igagati unigohv, nano ayohuhisdiyi gesv utseligohi ale udawadisgv tsaninvgi, igagati uninanugotselv.
\syll ᏴᏫ ᎤᎵᏏᎬ ᏣᏂᏅᎩ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎢᎦᎦᏘ ᎤᏂᎪᎲ, ᎾᏃ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏤᎵᎪᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᏩᏗᏍᎬ ᏣᏂᏅᎩ, ᎢᎦᎦᏘ ᎤᏂᎾᏄᎪᏤᎸ.
\ft The people which sat in darkness saw great light; and to them which sat in the region and shadow of death light is sprung up.

\ln Nahiyu Tsisa ulenvhe alitsidohvsgei, hia nigawesgei; ditsinetliyvna detsadanvdvi, hnaquoyeno galvladi ehi ugvwiyuhi gesv esganiyu dayai.
\syll ᏀᎢᏳ ᏥᏌ ᎤᎴᏅᎮ ᎠᎵᏥᏙᎲᏍᎨᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎨᎢ; ᏗᏥᏁᏟᏴᎾ ᏕᏣᏓᏅᏛᎢ, ᎿᏉᏰᏃ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎡᏍᎦᏂᏳ ᏓᏯᎢ.
\ft From that time Jesus began to preach, and to say, Repent: for the kingdom of heaven is at hand.

\ln Tsisano aisv Gelili vdalulodi dugohe anitali analinvtli, Sawani Quida tsanosehoi unvtlino Enidi, vdali anigayaluvsgeianigayaluvsgiyeno gesei.
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᎠᎢᏒ ᎨᎵᎵ ᎥᏓᎷᎶᏗ ᏚᎪᎮ ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏟ, ᏌᏩᏂ ᏈᏓ ᏣᏃᏎᎰᎢ ᎤᏅᏟᏃ ᎡᏂᏗ, ᎥᏓᎵ ᎠᏂᎦᏯᎷᎥᏍᎨᎢᎠᏂᎦᏯᎷᎥᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎨᏎᎢ.
\ft And Jesus, walking by the sea of Galilee, saw two brethren, Simon called Peter, and Andrew his brother, casting a net into the sea: for they were fishers.

\ln Hiano niduweselei; Sginisdawaduga, yvwino isdigayaluvsgi nvdasdvyvneli.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᏍᎩᏂᏍᏓᏩᏚᎦ, ᏴᏫᏃ ᎢᏍᏗᎦᏯᎷᎥᏍᎩ ᏅᏓᏍᏛᏴᏁᎵ.
\ft And he saith unto them, Follow me, and I will make you fishers of men.

\ln Gilaquono iyvdv duniyose digayaludi ale gvwasdawadvsei.
\syll ᎩᎳᏉᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏚᏂᏲᏎ ᏗᎦᏯᎷᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏛᏎᎢ.
\ft And they straightway left their nets, and followed him.

\ln Nahnano wiuwenv, anitali nvwanadale analinvtli dugohei, Tsimi Tsequidi uwetsi unvtlino Tsani, tsequidi unidoda tsiyuhi unatsaei, danotlvhisisge tsunigayaludi; widuyanvheno.
\syll ᏀᎾᏃ ᏫᎤᏪᏅ, ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴ ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏟ ᏚᎪᎮᎢ, ᏥᎻ ᏤᏈᏗ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎤᏅᏟᏃ ᏣᏂ, ᏤᏈᏗ ᎤᏂᏙᏓ ᏥᏳᎯ ᎤᎾᏣᎡᎢ, ᏓᏃᏢᎯᏏᏍᎨ ᏧᏂᎦᏯᎷᏗ; ᏫᏚᏯᏅᎮᏃ.
\ft And going on from thence, he saw other two brethren, James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, in a ship with Zebedee their father, mending their nets; and he called them.

\ln Gilaquono iyvdv duniyose tsiyu ale unidoda, ale gvwasdawadvsei.
\syll ᎩᎳᏉᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏚᏂᏲᏎ ᏥᏳ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏙᏓ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏛᏎᎢ.
\ft And they immediately left the ship and their father, and followed him.

\ln Tsisano nigvnadv Gelili edohei dadeyohvsge tsunilawiisdiyi, ale alitsidohvsge osdv kanohedv, Unelanvhi ugvwiyuhi gesv kanohesgei, ale dekanvwisge tsulilenvdv dunitlvgvi, ale tsudalenvdv vyugi yvwi unehvi.
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᏂᎬᎾᏛ ᎨᎵᎵ ᎡᏙᎮᎢ ᏓᏕᏲᎲᏍᎨ ᏧᏂᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎵᏥᏙᎲᏍᎨ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎧᏃᎮᏍᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᎧᏅᏫᏍᎨ ᏧᎵᎴᏅᏛ ᏚᏂᏢᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎥᏳᎩ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏁᎲᎢ.
\ft And Jesus went about all Galilee, teaching in their synagogues, and preaching the gospel of the kingdom, and healing all manner of sickness and all manner of disease among the people.

\ln Deganotsalvno nigvnadv Siliyi uyelisei; degvwatinoheleno nigadv tsunitlvgi, tsudalenvdv vyugi ale ehisdi uniyilidohi, ale nasquo anisgina digvwaniyai, ale nasquo tsunilvnotisgi, ale nasquo tsuninawisgi; dunvwaneno.
\syll ᏕᎦᏃᏣᎸᏃ ᏂᎬᎾᏛ ᏏᎵᏱ ᎤᏰᎵᏎᎢ; ᏕᎬᏩᏘᏃᎮᎴᏃ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏧᏂᏢᎩ, ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎥᏳᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎡᎯᏍᏗ ᎤᏂᏱᎵᏙᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏂᏍᎩᎾ ᏗᎬᏩᏂᏯᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏧᏂᎸᏃᏘᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏧᏂᎾᏫᏍᎩ; ᏚᏅᏩᏁᏃ.
\ft And his fame went throughout all Syria: and they brought unto him all sick people that were taken with divers diseases and torments, and those which were possessed with devils, and those which were lunatick, and those that had the palsy; and he healed them.

\ln Unitsatino yvwi gvwasdawadvsei nvdayunilosvhi gelili, AsgohinoGadugiyi, ale Tsilusilimi, ale Tsudiyi, ale Tsodani sgoniditlv.
\syll ᎤᏂᏣᏘᏃ ᏴᏫ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏛᏎᎢ ᏅᏓᏳᏂᎶᏒᎯ ᎨᎵᎵ, ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏃᎦᏚᎩᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏦᏓᏂ ᏍᎪᏂᏗᏢ.
\ft And there followed him great multitudes of people from Galilee, and from Decapolis, and from Jerusalem, and from Judaea, and from beyond Jordan.

\ln Unitsatino widugohv usahilv uhnalusei, uwenvno gvwasdawadidohi gvwalutselei.
\syll ᎤᏂᏣᏘᏃ ᏫᏚᎪᎲ ᎤᏌᎯᎸ ᎤᎿᎷᏎᎢ, ᎤᏪᏅᏃ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎬᏩᎷᏤᎴᎢ.
\ft And seeing the multitudes, he went up into a mountain: and when he was set, his disciples came unto him:

\ln Aholino usduisv duweyone hia nuwesei;
\syll ᎠᎰᎵᏃ ᎤᏍᏚᎢᏒ ᏚᏪᏲᏁ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ;
\ft And he opened his mouth, and taught them, saying,

\ln Osiyu iyunalisdanedi uyo iyunadvhnadegi dunadanvdvi; unatseliyeno galvladi ehi ugvwiyuhi gesvi.
\syll ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎤᏲ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᎿᏕᎩ ᏚᎾᏓᏅᏛᎢ; ᎤᎾᏤᎵᏰᏃ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Blessed are the poor in spirit: for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.

\ln Osiyu iyunalisdanedi uyo unadanvtawadegi, dvgetsinuwohistaniyeno.
\syll ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎤᏲ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏔᏩᏕᎩ, ᏛᎨᏥᏄᏬᎯᏍᏔᏂᏰᏃ.
\ft Blessed are they that mourn: for they shall be comforted.

\ln Osiyu iyunalisdanedi unadanvti, gadohiyeno unatseli iyulisdodi.
\syll ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ, ᎦᏙᎯᏰᏃ ᎤᎾᏤᎵ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗ.
\ft Blessed are the meek: for they shall inherit the earth.

\ln Osiyu iyunalisdanedi uniyosisgi ale unitadegisgi unadanvti iyunalisdodiyi; dvgetsikaliliyeno.
\syll ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎤᏂᏲᏏᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏔᏕᎩᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ; ᏛᎨᏥᎧᎵᎵᏰᏃ.
\ft Blessed are they which do hunger and thirst after righteousness: for they shall be filled.

\ln Osiyu iyunalisdanedi unadadolitsati, dvgetsidolitsiyeno.
\syll ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏙᎵᏣᏘ, ᏛᎨᏥᏙᎵᏥᏰᏃ.
\ft Blessed are the merciful: for they shall obtain mercy.

\ln Osiyu iyunalisdanedi tsudanvgalvdv tsuninawi, Unelanvhiyeno unigowadvdi;
\syll ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᏧᏓᏅᎦᎸᏛ ᏧᏂᎾᏫ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ ᎤᏂᎪᏩᏛᏗ;
\ft Blessed are the pure in heart: for they shall see God.

\ln Osiyu iyunalisdanedi anohisdisgi, Unelanvhiyeno tsuwetsi dvgegoseli.
\syll ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎠᏃᎯᏍᏗᏍᎩ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ ᏧᏪᏥ ᏛᎨᎪᏎᎵ.
\ft Blessed are the peacemakers: for they shall be called the children of God.

\ln Osiyu iyunalisdanedi uyo igegvnadegi duyugodv gesv unisdvdisgi, unatseliyeno galvladi ehi ugvwiyuhi gesvi.
\syll ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎤᏲ ᎢᎨᎬᎾᏕᎩ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏂᏍᏛᏗᏍᎩ, ᎤᎾᏤᎵᏰᏃ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Blessed are they which are persecuted for righteousness' sake: for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.

\ln Osiyu itsalisdanedi iyuno yvwi usonv nigetsiwesehesdi ale uyo nigetsvnehesdi, ale nigav tsudalenvdv usonv gayegogi getsinohesgesdi ayv gesv itsisdvdisgesdi.
\syll ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎢᏳᏃ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏐᏅ ᏂᎨᏥᏪᏎᎮᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏲ ᏂᎨᏨᏁᎮᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎤᏐᏅ ᎦᏰᎪᎩ ᎨᏥᏃᎮᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᏴ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏥᏍᏛᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
\ft Blessed are ye, when men shall revile you, and persecute you, and shall say all manner of evil against you falsely, for my sake.

\ln Itsaliheligesdi ale utsatanvhi osdv itsadanvtesdi, utsatiyeno etsaguyvedi galvladi; nasgiyayeno utsi nidunvnelvgi anadolehosgi igvyi tsinigetsenvelv.
\syll ᎢᏣᎵᎮᎵᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏣᏔᏅᎯ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏖᏍᏗ, ᎤᏣᏘᏰᏃ ᎡᏣᎫᏴᎡᏗ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ; ᎾᏍᎩᏯᏰᏃ ᎤᏥ ᏂᏚᏅᏁᎸᎩ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎢᎬᏱ ᏥᏂᎨᏤᏅᎡᎸ.
\ft Rejoice, and be exceeding glad: for great is your reward in heaven: for so persecuted they the prophets which were before you.

\ln Nihi ama elohi utseliga; iyusgini ama yutsisgolv gado yigalisdoda ama yadotlvna; vtla hnaquo gohusdi gvdodi yigagi, adinvdiquo uwasv, ale yvwiquo unalasdaedi.
\syll ᏂᎯ ᎠᎹ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ; ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᎹ ᏳᏥᏍᎪᎸ ᎦᏙ ᏱᎦᎵᏍᏙᏓ ᎠᎹ ᏯᏙᏢᎾ; ᎥᏝ ᎿᏉ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎬᏙᏗ ᏱᎦᎩ, ᎠᏗᏅᏗᏉ ᎤᏩᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᏴᏫᏉ ᎤᎾᎳᏍᏓᎡᏗ.
\ft Ye are the salt of the earth: but if the salt have lost his savour, wherewith shall it be salted? it is thenceforth good for nothing, but to be cast out, and to be trodden under foot of men.

\ln Nihi iga itsatisdisgi elohi.  Gaduhv usahilv tsigakahoi vtla yeli yvgayegvsgalvga.
\syll ᏂᎯ ᎢᎦ ᎢᏣᏘᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᎡᎶᎯ.  ᎦᏚᎲ ᎤᏌᎯᎸ ᏥᎦᎧᎰᎢ ᎥᏝ ᏰᎵ ᏴᎦᏰᎬᏍᎦᎸᎦ.
\ft Ye are the light of the world. A city that is set on an hill cannot be hid.

\ln Vtla ale yvwi anitsvsdvga atsvsdodi atlilosdi yanutlvdisgoi, gagodiyisgini anikahvsgoi, igano unatisdaneho nigadv galitsode aniyai.
\syll ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᏴᏫ ᎠᏂᏨᏍᏛᎦ ᎠᏨᏍᏙᏗ ᎠᏟᎶᏍᏗ ᏯᏄᏢᏗᏍᎪᎢ, ᎦᎪᏗᏱᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏂᎧᎲᏍᎪᎢ, ᎢᎦᏃ ᎤᎾᏘᏍᏓᏁᎰ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎦᎵᏦᏕ ᎠᏂᏯᎢ.
\ft Neither do men light a candle, and put it under a bushel, but on a candlestick; and it giveth light unto all that are in the house.

\ln Iga itsatisdisgv dunilvsadadehesdi yvwi, nasgino osdv detsilvwisdanehv anigowatisgesdi, ale anilvquodisgesdi Itsidoda galvladi ehi.
\syll ᎢᎦ ᎢᏣᏘᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᏚᏂᎸᏌᏓᏕᎮᏍᏗ ᏴᏫ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏕᏥᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᎠᏂᎪᏩᏘᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᎸᏉᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎢᏥᏙᏓ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ.
\ft Let your light so shine before men, that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father which is in heaven.

\ln Tlesdi dikahnawadvsdi ale anadolehosgi duyostanilv yisgiyelisehesdi; vtlasgini yidagiyostanilv, dagikalililvsgini.
\syll ᏞᏍᏗ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᏚᏲᏍᏔᏂᎸ ᏱᏍᎩᏰᎵᏎᎮᏍᏗ; ᎥᏝᏍᎩᏂ ᏱᏓᎩᏲᏍᏔᏂᎸ, ᏓᎩᎧᎵᎵᎸᏍᎩᏂ.
\ft Think not that I am come to destroy the law, or the prophets: I am not come to destroy, but to fulfill.

\ln Udohiyuhiyayeno hia nitsvweseha, gvni galvloi ale elohi anilosonvha saquo usdi ale saquo wusdigv dikahnawadvsdi vtla yvgalohi gvni nigadiyu akalitsvha.
\syll ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯᏰᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ, ᎬᏂ ᎦᎸᎶᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎠᏂᎶᏐᏅᎭ ᏌᏉ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏌᏉ ᏭᏍᏗᎬ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎥᏝ ᏴᎦᎶᎯ ᎬᏂ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᎠᎧᎵᏨᎭ.
\ft For verily I say unto you, Till heaven and earth pass, one jot or one tittle shall in no wise pass from the law, till all be fulfilled.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi gilo ayosdisgesdi saquo hia usdikani ulinetsvi, ale nasgi nusdesdi yvwi degeyohvsgesdi, nasgi usdikani agosehesdi galvladi ehi ugvwiyuhi gesvi; gilosgini dakahnawadegesdi, ale nasgi nusdesdi dadeyohvsgesdi, galvquodiyu agosehesdi galvladi ehi ugvwiyuhi gesvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎩᎶ ᎠᏲᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏌᏉ ᎯᎠ ᎤᏍᏗᎧᏂ ᎤᎵᏁᏨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᏴᏫ ᏕᎨᏲᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏍᏗᎧᏂ ᎠᎪᏎᎮᏍᏗ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎩᎶᏍᎩᏂ ᏓᎧᎿᏩᏕᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᏓᏕᏲᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᎪᏎᎮᏍᏗ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Whosoever therefore shall break one of these least commandments, and shall teach men so, he shall be called the least in the kingdom of heaven: but whosoever shall do and teach them, the same shall be called great in the kingdom of heaven.

\ln Hiayeno nitsvweseha, itsvno nasgi itsadanvti gesv niditsigonadvtanvna igesesdi dinowelisgi ale Aniqualisi, vtla galvladi ehi ugvwiyuhi gesv yvgetsiyvha.
\syll ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ, ᎢᏨᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏘ ᎨᏒ ᏂᏗᏥᎪᎾᏛᏔᏅᎾ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏗᏃᏪᎵᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏ, ᎥᏝ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏴᎨᏥᏴᎭ.
\ft For I say unto you, That except your righteousness shall exceed the righteousness of the scribes and Pharisees, ye shall in no case enter into the kingdom of heaven.

\ln Itsadvganvhi igi hia tsinigetsiwesele eti tsanehei; Tlesdi tsadalvgi; ale gilo adahihesdi gvwasdvdisdi gesesdi dinugodisgiyi.
\syll ᎢᏣᏛᎦᏅᎯ ᎢᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᎨᏥᏪᏎᎴ ᎡᏘ ᏣᏁᎮᎢ; ᏞᏍᏗ ᏣᏓᎸᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᎠᏓᎯᎮᏍᏗ ᎬᏩᏍᏛᏗᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏗᏄᎪᏗᏍᎩᏱ.
\ft Ye have heard that it was said by them of old time, Thou shalt not kill; and whosoever shall kill shall be in danger of the judgment:

\ln Aseno ayv hia nitsvweseha; Gilo dinadanvtli asgagesdi gohusdi nusdvdisgvna igesesdi, gvwasdvdisdi gesesdi dinugodisgiyi; gilono dinadanvtli Nitsadanvdvna igosehesdi, degalawiv gvwasdvdisdi gesesdi; gilono Tsanegu igosehesdi, gvwasdvdisdi gesesdi tsvsgino atsilvyi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᏴ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ; ᎩᎶ ᏗᎾᏓᏅᏟ ᎠᏍᎦᎨᏍᏗ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏄᏍᏛᏗᏍᎬᎾ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎬᏩᏍᏛᏗᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏗᏄᎪᏗᏍᎩᏱ; ᎩᎶᏃ ᏗᎾᏓᏅᏟ ᏂᏣᏓᏅᏛᎾ ᎢᎪᏎᎮᏍᏗ, ᏕᎦᎳᏫᎥ ᎬᏩᏍᏛᏗᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᎩᎶᏃ ᏣᏁᎫ ᎢᎪᏎᎮᏍᏗ, ᎬᏩᏍᏛᏗᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏨᏍᎩᏃ ᎠᏥᎸᏱ.
\ft But I say unto you, That whosoever is angry with his brother without a cause shall be in danger of the judgment: and whosoever shall say to his brother, Raca, shall be in danger of the council: but whosoever shall say, Thou fool, shall be in danger of hell fire.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi iyuno atsilvgelasdiyi hiyohihesdi tsadanedi, nahnano ihanvdadisgesdi disdadanvtli gohusdi tselisehvi,
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏳᏃ ᎠᏥᎸᎨᎳᏍᏗᏱ ᎯᏲᎯᎮᏍᏗ ᏣᏓᏁᏗ, ᏀᎾᏃ ᎢᎭᏅᏓᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏗᏍᏓᏓᏅᏟ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏤᎵᏎᎲᎢ,
\ft Therefore if thou bring thy gift to the altar, and there rememberest that thy brother hath ought against thee;

\ln Nahna atsilvgelasdiyi hihiyasgesdi tsadanedi ale hadanvsgesdi, igvyi osdv nisdvnehesdi disdadanvtli; gilano hilugesdi halisgolvdisgesdi tsadanedi.
\syll ᏀᎾ ᎠᏥᎸᎨᎳᏍᏗᏱ ᎯᎯᏯᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏣᏓᏁᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎭᏓᏅᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎢᎬᏱ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏂᏍᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᏗᏍᏓᏓᏅᏟ; ᎩᎳᏃ ᎯᎷᎨᏍᏗ ᎭᎵᏍᎪᎸᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏣᏓᏁᏗ.
\ft Leave there thy gift before the altar, and go thy way; first be reconciled to thy brother, and then come and offer thy gift.

\ln Nulaquo osdv nisdv tsayilidohi, asiquo isdaisvi, digugodisgiyinasi wiyitsakahvga tsayilidohi, digugodisgino didaniyisgiyi wiyitsakahvga, ale didasdudiyi yiwetsayvda.
\syll ᏄᎳᏉ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏂᏍᏛ ᏣᏱᎵᏙᎯ, ᎠᏏᏉ ᎢᏍᏓᎢᏒᎢ, ᏗᎫᎪᏗᏍᎩᏱᎾᏏ ᏫᏱᏣᎧᎲᎦ ᏣᏱᎵᏙᎯ, ᏗᎫᎪᏗᏍᎩᏃ ᏗᏓᏂᏱᏍᎩᏱ ᏫᏱᏣᎧᎲᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏓᏍᏚᏗᏱ ᏱᏪᏣᏴᏓ.
\ft Agree with thine adversary quickly, whiles thou art in the way with him; lest at any time the adversary deliver thee to the judge, and the judge deliver thee to the officer, and thou be cast into prison.

\ln Udohiyuhiya hia nigvweseha, Vtla yvdvgahinugoi, gvni ulisqualvdi ayeliiyadanvtedi haguyvhvha.
\syll ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏪᏎᎭ, ᎥᏝ ᏴᏛᎦᎯᏄᎪᎢ, ᎬᏂ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᎸᏗ ᎠᏰᎵᎢᏯᏓᏅᏖᏗ ᎭᎫᏴᎲᎭ.
\ft Verily I say unto thee, Thou shalt by no means come out thence, till thou hast paid the uttermost farthing.

\ln Itsadvganvhi igi hia tsinigetsiwesele eti tsanehei; Tlesdi tsadayonelvgi.
\syll ᎢᏣᏛᎦᏅᎯ ᎢᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᎨᏥᏪᏎᎴ ᎡᏘ ᏣᏁᎮᎢ; ᏞᏍᏗ ᏣᏓᏲᏁᎸᎩ.
\ft Ye have heard that it was said by them of old time, Thou shalt not commit adultery:

\ln Aseno ayv hia nitsvweseha; Gilo ageyv dakanisgesdi tsunanisidiyi udulisgesdi, gayula udayonelvhi gesesdi tsudanvdvi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᏴ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ; ᎩᎶ ᎠᎨᏴ ᏓᎧᏂᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏧᎾᏂᏏᏗᏱ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎦᏳᎳ ᎤᏓᏲᏁᎸᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏧᏓᏅᏛᎢ.
\ft But I say unto you, That whosoever looketh on a woman to lust after her hath committed adultery with her already in his heart.

\ln Iyuno higadoli higatisi detsodesdisgesdi, hadagatedoisgesdi, ale tsadegesdi; osiyuyeno itsalisdanedi saquoquo tsaligvhalvdv yitsayohuseha, ano unosdv hiyelv tsvsgino wiyetsadaineha.
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᎯᎦᏙᎵ ᎯᎦᏘᏏ ᏕᏦᏕᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎭᏓᎦᏖᏙᎢᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏣᏕᎨᏍᏗ; ᎣᏏᏳᏰᏃ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᏌᏉᏉ ᏣᎵᎬᎭᎸᏛ ᏱᏣᏲᎱᏎᎭ, ᎠᏃ ᎤᏃᏍᏛ ᎯᏰᎸ ᏨᏍᎩᏃ ᏫᏰᏣᏓᎢᏁᎭ.
\ft And if thy right eye offend thee, pluck it out, and cast it from thee: for it is profitable for thee that one of thy members should perish, and not that thy whole body should be cast into hell.

\ln Iyuno tsoyeni higatisi detsodesdisgesdi, hisqualisgesdi, ale tsadegesdi; osiyuyeno itsalisdanedi saquoquo tsaligvhalvdv yitsayohuseha, ano unosdv hiyelv tsvsgino wiyetsadaineha.
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᏦᏰᏂ ᎯᎦᏘᏏ ᏕᏦᏕᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎯᏍᏆᎵᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏣᏕᎨᏍᏗ; ᎣᏏᏳᏰᏃ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᏌᏉᏉ ᏣᎵᎬᎭᎸᏛ ᏱᏣᏲᎱᏎᎭ, ᎠᏃ ᎤᏃᏍᏛ ᎯᏰᎸ ᏨᏍᎩᏃ ᏫᏰᏣᏓᎢᏁᎭ.
\ft And if thy right hand offend thee, cut if off, and cast it from thee: for it is profitable for thee that one of thy members should perish, and not that thy whole body should be cast into hell.

\ln Hia igawedv igi; Gilo udalii igakahvsgesdi, ganvnehesdi goweli nasgi dunagalenvhvi.
\syll ᎯᎠ ᎢᎦᏪᏛ ᎢᎩ; ᎩᎶ ᎤᏓᎵᎢ ᎢᎦᎧᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎦᏅᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᎪᏪᎵ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᎾᎦᎴᏅᎲᎢ.
\ft It hath been said, Whosoever shall put away his wife, let him give her a writing of divorcement:

\ln Aseno ayv hia nitsvweseha; Gilo udalii igakahvsgesdi, tsunisinvhisgininonv igesesdi, udayonediyiquo nigvnisanehesdi; gilono atsikanvhi adayegesdi adayonehesdi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᏴ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ; ᎩᎶ ᎤᏓᎵᎢ ᎢᎦᎧᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᏧᏂᏏᏅᎯᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎤᏓᏲᏁᏗᏱᏉ ᏂᎬᏂᏌᏁᎮᏍᏗ; ᎩᎶᏃ ᎠᏥᎧᏅᎯ ᎠᏓᏰᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᏓᏲᏁᎮᏍᏗ.
\ft But I say unto you, That whosoever shall put away his wife, saving for the cause of fornication, causeth her to commit adultery: and whosoever shall marry her that is divorced committeth adultery.

\ln Ale itsadvganvhi igi hia tsinigetsiwesele eti tsanehei; Tlesdi tsayostanv tsaselitanvi, yihowasgini niyadvnehesdi nusdv tsanetsvi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎢᏣᏛᎦᏅᎯ ᎢᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᎨᏥᏪᏎᎴ ᎡᏘ ᏣᏁᎮᎢ; ᏞᏍᏗ ᏣᏲᏍᏔᏅ ᏣᏎᎵᏔᏅᎢ, ᏱᎰᏩᏍᎩᏂ ᏂᏯᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏣᏁᏨᎢ.
\ft Again, ye have heard that it hath been said by them of old time, Thou shalt not forswear thyself, but shalt perform unto the Lord thine oaths:

\ln Aseno ayv hia nitsvweseha; Tlesdi yitsaselitanesdi yitsaneistanesdi gohusdi, tlesdi galvladi yitsaneistanesdi, Unelanvhiyeno uwediyi nasgi;
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᏴ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ; ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏣᏎᎵᏔᏁᏍᏗ ᏱᏣᏁᎢᏍᏔᏁᏍᏗ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏱᏣᏁᎢᏍᏔᏁᏍᏗ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ ᎤᏪᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ;
\ft But I say unto you, Swear not at all; neither by heaven; for it is God's throne:

\ln Tlesdi ale elohi, tsulasidiyiyeno nasgi; ale Tsilusilimi, nasgiyeno atsilvquodi Ugvwiyuhi utseli gaduhvi;
\syll ᏞᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎡᎶᎯ, ᏧᎳᏏᏗᏱᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ, ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏗ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎦᏚᎲᎢ;
\ft Nor by the earth; for it is his footstool: neither by Jerusalem; for it is the city of the great King.

\ln Tlesdi ale hisgoli yitsaneistanesdi, tlayeno yeli saquo gitlv unegv ale gvhnage yinvgahvga.
\syll ᏞᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎯᏍᎪᎵ ᏱᏣᏁᎢᏍᏔᏁᏍᏗ, ᏝᏰᏃ ᏰᎵ ᏌᏉ ᎩᏢ ᎤᏁᎬ ᎠᎴ ᎬᎿᎨ ᏱᏅᎦᎲᎦ.
\ft Neither shalt thou swear by thy head, because thou canst not make one hair white or black.

\ln Itsinegvsgini hia nusdesdi, Vv, Vv; Vtla, Vtla; utliyeno tsinigao uyoquo gesv didalenisgoi.
\syll ᎢᏥᏁᎬᏍᎩᏂ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏍᏕᏍᏗ, ᎥᎥ, ᎥᎥ; ᎥᏝ, ᎥᏝ; ᎤᏟᏰᏃ ᏥᏂᎦᎣ ᎤᏲᏉ ᎨᏒ ᏗᏓᎴᏂᏍᎪᎢ.
\ft But let your communication be, Yea, yea; Nay, nay: for whatsoever is more than these cometh of evil.

\ln Itsadvganvhi igi hia igawedv gesvi, Agata agataquo dagvwalvsgesdi, kayugano kayugaquo dagvwalvsgesdi.
\syll ᎢᏣᏛᎦᏅᎯ ᎢᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎢᎦᏪᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎦᏔ ᎠᎦᏔᏉ ᏓᎬᏩᎸᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎧᏳᎦᏃ ᎧᏳᎦᏉ ᏓᎬᏩᎸᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
\ft Ye have heard that it hath been said, An eye for an eye, and a tooth for a tooth:

\ln Aseno ayv hia nitsaweseha; Tlesdi yitsatlegesdi usonv netsvnelvi; gilosgini higatisi tsagoqueluhvsgesdi, soi nasquo hiyalisgolvdanehesdi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᏴ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏣᏪᏎᎭ; ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏣᏞᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᏐᏅ ᏁᏨᏁᎸᎢ; ᎩᎶᏍᎩᏂ ᎯᎦᏘᏏ ᏣᎪᏇᎷᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᏐᎢ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎯᏯᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ.
\ft But I say unto you, That ye resist not evil: but whosoever shall smite thee on thy right cheek, turn to him the other also.

\ln Gilono udulisgesdi tsayilidasdiyi, ale tsanaediyi hawini tsanuwo, udvnohi nasquo hinvnehesdi.
\syll ᎩᎶᏃ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏣᏱᎵᏓᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏣᎾᎡᏗᏱ ᎭᏫᏂ ᏣᏄᏬ, ᎤᏛᏃᎯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎯᏅᏁᎮᏍᏗ.
\ft And if any man will sue thee at the law, and take away thy coat, let him have thy cloke also.

\ln Gilono sutlilodv isdenvsdiyi nitsvnehesdi, tali iyutlilodv isdegesdi.
\syll ᎩᎶᏃ ᏑᏟᎶᏛ ᎢᏍᏕᏅᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᏨᏁᎮᏍᏗ, ᏔᎵ ᎢᏳᏟᎶᏛ ᎢᏍᏕᎨᏍᏗ.
\ft And whosoever shall compel thee to go a mile, go with him twain.

\ln Tsatayosehi hinehesdi, tsadolvediyino udulisgi tlesdi iyvdv ihiyadvnelvgi.
\syll ᏣᏔᏲᏎᎯ ᎯᏁᎮᏍᏗ, ᏣᏙᎸᎡᏗᏱᏃ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎩ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎢᎯᏯᏛᏁᎸᎩ.
\ft Give to him that asketh thee, and from him that would borrow of thee turn not thou away.

\ln Itsadvganvhi igi hia igawedv gesvi; Higeyusesdi nav idisdadala, hisgagesdino tsasgagi.
\syll ᎢᏣᏛᎦᏅᎯ ᎢᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎢᎦᏪᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎯᎨᏳᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᎥ ᎢᏗᏍᏓᏓᎳ, ᎯᏍᎦᎨᏍᏗᏃ ᏣᏍᎦᎩ.
\ft Ye have heard that it hath been said, Thou shalt love thy neighbour, and hate thine enemy.

\ln Aseno ayv hia nitsvweseha; Detsigeyusesdi getsisgagi; osdv detsinetsehesdi getsisginvdisgi, osdv nidetsadvnehesdi getsiniquatihi, ale osdv iyunalisdanediyi itsadadolisdisgesdi gayegogi getsinohesgi ale uyo igetsvnehi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᏴ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ; ᏕᏥᎨᏳᏎᏍᏗ ᎨᏥᏍᎦᎩ; ᎣᏍᏛ ᏕᏥᏁᏤᎮᏍᏗ ᎨᏥᏍᎩᏅᏗᏍᎩ, ᎣᏍᏛ ᏂᏕᏣᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᎨᏥᏂᏆᏘᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᎢᏣᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎦᏰᎪᎩ ᎨᏥᏃᎮᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏲ ᎢᎨᏨᏁᎯ.
\ft But I say unto you, Love your enemies, bless them that curse you, do good to them that hate you, and pray for them which despitefully use you, and persecute you;

\ln Nasgino galvladi ehi Itsidoda tsuwetsi nitsalisdisgesdi; nasgiyeno utseli nvdo degananugowiseho uniyo ale anosdv, ale daganvdaneho unadanvti ale uninegutsidv.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎢᏥᏙᏓ ᏧᏪᏥ ᏂᏣᎵᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ; ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏅᏙ ᏕᎦᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᎰ ᎤᏂᏲ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏃᏍᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᎦᏅᏓᏁᎰ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏁᎫᏥᏛ.
\ft That ye may be the children of your Father which is in heaven: for he maketh his sun to rise on the evil and on the good, and sendeth rain on the just and on the unjust.

\ln Iyuyeno yiditsigeyuha getsigeyuhi, gado yetsaguyvdasi?  Tlasgo nasgi yinanadvneho ayeliadelv anigisidohi?
\syll ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᏱᏗᏥᎨᏳᎭ ᎨᏥᎨᏳᎯ, ᎦᏙ ᏰᏣᎫᏴᏓᏏ?  ᏝᏍᎪ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᎾᎾᏛᏁᎰ ᎠᏰᎵᎠᏕᎸ ᎠᏂᎩᏏᏙᎯ?
\ft For if ye love them which love you, what reward have ye? do not even the publicans the same?

\ln Iyu ale itsadanvtliquo unvsv yiditsiyoliha, gado itsadvnehv detsigonadvdi anisoi?  Tlasgo nasgi yinanadvneho ayeliadelv anigisidohi?
\syll ᎢᏳ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏟᏉ ᎤᏅᏒ ᏱᏗᏥᏲᎵᎭ, ᎦᏙ ᎢᏣᏛᏁᎲ ᏕᏥᎪᎾᏛᏗ ᎠᏂᏐᎢ?  ᏝᏍᎪ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᎾᎾᏛᏁᎰ ᎠᏰᎵᎠᏕᎸ ᎠᏂᎩᏏᏙᎯ?
\ft And if ye salute your brethren only, what do ye more than others? do not even the publicans so?

\ln Nihisgini nitsisganvna gesesdi nasgiya Itsidoda galvladi ehi nasganvna tsigi.
\syll ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᏂᏥᏍᎦᏅᎾ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎢᏥᏙᏓ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎾᏍᎦᏅᎾ ᏥᎩ.
\ft Be ye therefore perfect, even as your Father which is in heaven is perfect.

\ln Itseyatahesdi tlesdi yitsadanehesdi anigatahv yvwi getsigowadvdiyiquo yitsiyelvsgesdi, iyuyeno nasgiquo yinusdi vtla yvgetsaguyvsi Itsidoda galvladi ehi.
\syll ᎢᏤᏯᏔᎮᏍᏗ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏣᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎲ ᏴᏫ ᎨᏥᎪᏩᏛᏗᏱᏉ ᏱᏥᏰᎸᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩᏉ ᏱᏄᏍᏗ ᎥᏝ ᏴᎨᏣᎫᏴᏏ ᎢᏥᏙᏓ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ.
\ft Take heed that ye do not your alms before men, to be seen of them: otherwise ye have no reward of your Father which is in heaven.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi iyuno hadanehesdi tlesdi atselugi igvyi wiyinoyvlisdisgesdi nasgi tsinanadvneho unatlonasdi tsulawiisdiyi ale enaidasdiyi degalanvdvi, yvwiquo gvwanilvquododiyi tsuniyelvsoi; udohiyuhiya itsvyoseha, gegaguyvelv.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏳᏃ ᎭᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎠᏤᎷᎩ ᎢᎬᏱ ᏫᏱᏃᏴᎵᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᎾᎾᏛᏁᎰ ᎤᎾᏠᎾᏍᏗ ᏧᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᎡᎾᎢᏓᏍᏗᏱ ᏕᎦᎳᏅᏛᎢ, ᏴᏫᏉ ᎬᏩᏂᎸᏉᏙᏗᏱ ᏧᏂᏰᎸᏐᎢ; ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎢᏨᏲᏎᎭ, ᎨᎦᎫᏴᎡᎸ.
\ft Therefore when thou doest thine alms, do not sound a trumpet before thee, as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and in the streets, that they may have glory of men. Verily I say unto you, They have their reward.

\ln Nihisgini hadanehesdi tlesdi tsoyeni higasgani udolehosv higatisi tsoyeni nadvnehvi.
\syll ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎭᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏦᏰᏂ ᎯᎦᏍᎦᏂ ᎤᏙᎴᎰᏒ ᎯᎦᏘᏏ ᏦᏰᏂ ᎾᏛᏁᎲᎢ.
\ft But when thou doest alms, let not thy left hand know what thy right hand doeth:

\ln Nasgino hadanehv udelisv gesesdi, Tsadodano udelisv agowatisgi uwasv ase tsaguyvedi gesesdi gvnigesvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎭᏓᏁᎲ ᎤᏕᎵᏒ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᏣᏙᏓᏃ ᎤᏕᎵᏒ ᎠᎪᏩᏘᏍᎩ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎠᏎ ᏣᎫᏴᎡᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎬᏂᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft That thine alms may be in secret: and thy Father which seeth in secret himself shall reward thee openly.

\ln Iyu ale hadadolisdisgesdi, aha tlesdi nunasdv unatlonasdi yinitsasdesdi; nasgiyeno oso uniyelvso unadadolisdodiyi unalediyi digalawiisdiyi ale dunvsiyanv degalanvdv enaidasdiyi, yvwiquo gvwanigowadvdiyi unadulisgoi.  Udohiyuhiya itsvyoseha, gegaguyvelv.
\syll ᎢᏳ ᎠᎴ ᎭᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᎭ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏄᎾᏍᏛ ᎤᎾᏠᎾᏍᏗ ᏱᏂᏣᏍᏕᏍᏗ; ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎣᏐ ᎤᏂᏰᎸᏐ ᎤᎾᏓᏙᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᎾᎴᏗᏱ ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᏚᏅᏏᏯᏅ ᏕᎦᎳᏅᏛ ᎡᎾᎢᏓᏍᏗᏱ, ᏴᏫᏉ ᎬᏩᏂᎪᏩᏛᏗᏱ ᎤᎾᏚᎵᏍᎪᎢ.  ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎢᏨᏲᏎᎭ, ᎨᎦᎫᏴᎡᎸ.
\ft And when thou prayest, thou shalt not be as the hypocrites are: for they love to pray standing in the synagogues and in the corners of the streets, that they may be seen of men. Verily I say unto you, They have their reward.

\ln Nihisgini iyuno tadadolistanisesdi wiyvhihesdi kanvsulvi, hnaquono tsasdunesdi galohisdiyi, hiyadadolisdanehesdi tsadoda udelisv ehi, tsadolino udelisv agowatisgi ase tsaguyvedi gesesdi gvnigesvi.
\syll ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᏳᏃ ᏔᏓᏙᎵᏍᏔᏂᏎᏍᏗ ᏫᏴᎯᎮᏍᏗ ᎧᏅᏑᎸᎢ, ᎿᏉᏃ ᏣᏍᏚᏁᏍᏗ ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ, ᎯᏯᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᏣᏙᏓ ᎤᏕᎵᏒ ᎡᎯ, ᏣᏙᎵᏃ ᎤᏕᎵᏒ ᎠᎪᏩᏘᏍᎩ ᎠᏎ ᏣᎫᏴᎡᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎬᏂᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft But thou, when thou prayest, enter into thy closet, and when thou hast shut thy door, pray to thy Father which is in secret; and thy Father which seeth in secret shall reward thee openly.

\ln Aseno itsadadolisdisgesdi tlesdi asequo yitsvgutilosgesdi nasgi tsinanadvneho tsunadalenvdv yvwi; utsatiyeno otsinegv udagalisdotani dayogadvganeli anelisgoi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎢᏣᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎠᏎᏉ ᏱᏨᎫᏘᎶᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᎾᎾᏛᏁᎰ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ; ᎤᏣᏘᏰᏃ ᎣᏥᏁᎬ ᎤᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏔᏂ ᏓᏲᎦᏛᎦᏁᎵ ᎠᏁᎵᏍᎪᎢ.
\ft But when ye pray, use not vain repetitions, as the heathen do: for they think that they shall be heard for their much speaking.

\ln Nihisgini tlesdi nasgi nunasdv yinitsasdesdi, Itsidodayeno agataho iyusdi itsinigvgv asiquo netsitayoselvna tsigesoi.
\syll ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᎾᏍᏛ ᏱᏂᏣᏍᏕᏍᏗ, ᎢᏥᏙᏓᏰᏃ ᎠᎦᏔᎰ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏥᏂᎬᎬ ᎠᏏᏉ ᏁᏥᏔᏲᏎᎸᎾ ᏥᎨᏐᎢ.
\ft Be not ye therefore like unto them: for your Father knoweth what things ye have need of, before ye ask him.

\ln Nihisgini itsadadolisdisgv hia nusdesdi; Ogidoda galvladi gehi, galvquodiyu gesesdi detsadovi.
\syll ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᏣᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏍᏕᏍᏗ; ᎣᎩᏙᏓ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎨᎯ, ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏕᏣᏙᎥᎢ.
\ft After this manner therefore pray ye: Our Father which art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name.

\ln Tsagvwiyuhi gesv wigananugoi.  Ani elohi winigalisda hadanvtesgvi, nasgiya galvladi tsinigalisdiha.
\syll ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏫᎦᎾᏄᎪᎢ.  ᎠᏂ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏫᏂᎦᎵᏍᏓ ᎭᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏥᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᎭ.
\ft Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done in earth, as it is in heaven.

\ln Nidadodaquisv ogalisdayvdi sgivsi gohi iga.
\syll ᏂᏓᏙᏓᏈᏒ ᎣᎦᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗ ᏍᎩᎥᏏ ᎪᎯ ᎢᎦ.
\ft Give us this day our daily bread.

\ln Digesgivsiquono desgidugvi, nasgiya tsidigayotsineho tsotsidugi.
\syll ᏗᎨᏍᎩᎥᏏᏉᏃ ᏕᏍᎩᏚᎬᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏥᏗᎦᏲᏥᏁᎰ ᏦᏥᏚᎩ.
\ft And forgive us our debts, as we forgive our debtors.

\ln Ale tlesdi udagoliyediyi gesv widisgiyatinvstanvgi, sgiyudalesgesdiquosgini utsi gesvi.  Tsatseligayeno tsagvwiyuhi gesvi, ale tsalinigidiyi gesvi, ale etsalvquodiyu gesv nigohilvi.  Emenv.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎤᏓᎪᎵᏰᏗᏱ ᎨᏒ ᏫᏗᏍᎩᏯᏘᏅᏍᏔᏅᎩ, ᏍᎩᏳᏓᎴᏍᎨᏍᏗᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏥ ᎨᏒᎢ.  ᏣᏤᎵᎦᏰᏃ ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏣᎵᏂᎩᏗᏱ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎡᏣᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᏂᎪᎯᎸᎢ.  ᎡᎺᏅ.
\ft And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil: For thine is the kingdom, and the power, and the glory, for ever. Amen.

\ln Iyuyeno yvwi getsisganvtsehv yidigetsineha, nasquo itsidoda galvladi ehi itsidolisdi gesesdi.
\syll ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᏴᏫ ᎨᏥᏍᎦᏅᏤᎲ ᏱᏗᎨᏥᏁᎭ, ᎾᏍᏉ ᎢᏥᏙᏓ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎢᏥᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft For if ye forgive men their trespasses, your heavenly Father will also forgive you:

\ln Iyusgini nidigetsinehvna yigi yvwi getsisganvtsehvi, nasquo Itsidoda vtla yidogetsihvsi itsisganvtsvi.
\syll ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᏂᏗᎨᏥᏁᎲᎾ ᏱᎩ ᏴᏫ ᎨᏥᏍᎦᏅᏤᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᏉ ᎢᏥᏙᏓ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏙᎨᏥᎲᏏ ᎢᏥᏍᎦᏅᏨᎢ.
\ft But if ye forgive not men their trespasses, neither will your Father forgive your trespasses.

\ln Ale nasquo amatli itsvsgesdi, tlesdi nvnatlonasdi nunasdv yinitsasdesdi, unadadolisdi tsigeso dikanodiyi, nidatselvnayeno nidanvneho dunakadvi, yvwiquo unadolehohisdiyi unadulisgo amatli anvsgvi.  Udohiyuhiya nitsvweseha gegaguyvelv.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᎹᏟ ᎢᏨᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᏅᎾᏠᎾᏍᏗ ᏄᎾᏍᏛ ᏱᏂᏣᏍᏕᏍᏗ, ᎤᎾᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᏥᎨᏐ ᏗᎧᏃᏗᏱ, ᏂᏓᏤᎸᎾᏰᏃ ᏂᏓᏅᏁᎰ ᏚᎾᎧᏛᎢ, ᏴᏫᏉ ᎤᎾᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᎾᏚᎵᏍᎪ ᎠᎹᏟ ᎠᏅᏍᎬᎢ.  ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ ᎨᎦᎫᏴᎡᎸ.
\ft Moreover when ye fast, be not, as the hypocrites, of a sad countenance: for they disfigure their faces, that they may appear unto men to fast. Verily I say unto you, They have their reward.

\ln Nihisgini amatli hvsgesdi, hatlonesgesdi, ale hagvsquosgesdi,
\syll ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᎹᏟ ᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎭᏠᏁᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎭᎬᏍᏉᏍᎨᏍᏗ,
\ft But thou, when thou fastest, anoint thine head, and wash thy face;

\ln Nasgi tlesdi yvwiquo getsadolehohisediyi yitsayelisesdi amatli tsvsvi, Tsadodasgini udelisv ehi, Tsadodano udelisv agowatisgi, ase tsaguyvedi gvnigesvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏴᏫᏉ ᎨᏣᏙᎴᎰᎯᏎᏗᏱ ᏱᏣᏰᎵᏎᏍᏗ ᎠᎹᏟ ᏨᏒᎢ, ᏣᏙᏓᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏕᎵᏒ ᎡᎯ, ᏣᏙᏓᏃ ᎤᏕᎵᏒ ᎠᎪᏩᏘᏍᎩ, ᎠᏎ ᏣᎫᏴᎡᏗ ᎬᏂᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft That thou appear not unto men to fast, but unto thy Father which is in secret: and thy Father, which seeth in secret, shall reward thee openly.

\ln Tlesdi tsugvwalodi elohi yitsitlisisgesdi, tsisgoyv ale ayasdladisgi uniyosdodiyi ale aninosgisgi uniyvsdiyi ale uninosgisdiyi;
\syll ᏞᏍᏗ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏱᏥᏟᏏᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᏥᏍᎪᏴ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏯᏍᏜᏗᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᏲᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏃᏍᎩᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᏴᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏃᏍᎩᏍᏗᏱ;
\ft Lay not up for yourselves treasures upon earth, where moth and rust doth corrupt, and where thieves break through and steal:

\ln Galvladisgini witsitlisisgesdi tsugvwalodi, nahnani tsisgoyv ayasdladisgino uniyosdodiyi nigesvna gesvi, ale aninosgisgi uniyvsdiyi ale uninosgisdiyi nigesvna gesvi.
\syll ᎦᎸᎳᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᏫᏥᏟᏏᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ, ᏀᎾᏂ ᏥᏍᎪᏴ ᎠᏯᏍᏜᏗᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᏂᏲᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏃᏍᎩᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᏴᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏃᏍᎩᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft But lay up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where neither moth nor rust doth corrupt, and where thieves do not break through nor steal:

\ln Nahnayeno tsugvwalodi witsihvi ase nasquo widahesdi ditsadanvdo.
\syll ᏀᎾᏰᏃ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᏫᏥᎲᎢ ᎠᏎ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏫᏓᎮᏍᏗ ᏗᏣᏓᏅᏙ.
\ft For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.

\ln Agata ayelv iga gatisdisgi, iyusgini higadoli gohusdi nusdvna gesesdi, nigv hiyelvi ukalitsonvhi gesesdi igagati.
\syll ᎠᎦᏔ ᎠᏰᎸ ᎢᎦ ᎦᏘᏍᏗᏍᎩ, ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎯᎦᏙᎵ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏄᏍᏛᎾ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᏂᎬ ᎯᏰᎸᎢ ᎤᎧᎵᏦᏅᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎢᎦᎦᏘ.
\ft The light of the body is the eye: if therefore thine eye be single, thy whole body shall be full of light.

\ln Iyusgini higadoli uyo igesesdi, nigv hiyelvi ukalitsonvhi gesesdi ulisigi.  Iyusginino igagati hawini tsehv ulisigiquo igesesdi, nasgi ulisigi niga equohiyu!
\syll ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎯᎦᏙᎵ ᎤᏲ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᏂᎬ ᎯᏰᎸᎢ ᎤᎧᎵᏦᏅᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᎵᏏᎩ.  ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂᏃ ᎢᎦᎦᏘ ᎭᏫᏂ ᏤᎲ ᎤᎵᏏᎩᏉ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎵᏏᎩ ᏂᎦ ᎡᏉᎯᏳ
\ft But if thine eye be evil, thy whole body shall be full of darkness. If therefore the light that is in thee be darkness, how great is that darkness!

\ln Vtla gilo yeli anitali gvwanatlai gohusdi yidogvdvnisi, yiasgagayeno saquo yinvgeyuhano soi, ale yidouniyvha saquo yiganiquatihano soi.  Tlasgini yeli Unelanvhi ale Mamani gohusdiyidogetsadvnisi.
\syll ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᏰᎵ ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᎬᏩᎾᏝᎢ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏱᏙᎬᏛᏂᏏ, ᏱᎠᏍᎦᎦᏰᏃ ᏌᏉ ᏱᏅᎨᏳᎭᏃ ᏐᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏱᏙᎤᏂᏴᎭ ᏌᏉ ᏱᎦᏂᏆᏘᎭᏃ ᏐᎢ.  ᏝᏍᎩᏂ ᏰᎵ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎹᎹᏂ ᎪᎱᏍᏗᏱᏙᎨᏣᏛᏂᏏ.
\ft No man can serve two masters: for either he will hate the one, and love the other; or else he will hold to the one, and despise the other. Ye cannot serve God and mammon.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi hia nitsvweseha, Tlesdi yitselihisgesdi detsvnvi, iyusdi itsigisdiyi ale iyusdi itsaditasdiyi, tlesdi ale ditsiyelvi yitselihisgesdi iyusdi ditsanuwosdiyi.  Tlasgo agvnv utlihiyu yigi esgaquo alisdayvdi?  Ale tlasgo ayelvi esgaquo dinuwo?
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏤᎵᎯᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏕᏨᏅᎢ, ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏥᎩᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏣᏗᏔᏍᏗᏱ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏥᏰᎸᎢ ᏱᏤᎵᎯᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏗᏣᏄᏬᏍᏗᏱ.  ᏝᏍᎪ ᎠᎬᏅ ᎤᏟᎯᏳ ᏱᎩ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗ?  ᎠᎴ ᏝᏍᎪ ᎠᏰᎸᎢ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᏗᏄᏬ?
\ft Therefore I say unto you, Take no thought for your life, what ye shall eat, or what ye shall drink; nor yet for your body, what ye shall put on. Is not the life more than meat, and the body than raiment?

\ln Ditsakanvga tsisqua galvloi anehi, tlayeno yaniwisgoi, ale tla yaninetsaisgoi, tla ale dadanelv yanitlisisgoi, aseno Itsidoda galvladi ehi dogelohoi.  Tlasgo nihi utli yinetsilvquodi esgaquo nasgi?
\syll ᏗᏣᎧᏅᎦ ᏥᏍᏆ ᎦᎸᎶᎢ ᎠᏁᎯ, ᏝᏰᏃ ᏯᏂᏫᏍᎪᎢ, ᎠᎴ Ꮭ ᏯᏂᏁᏣᎢᏍᎪᎢ, Ꮭ ᎠᎴ ᏓᏓᏁᎸ ᏯᏂᏟᏏᏍᎪᎢ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎢᏥᏙᏓ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ ᏙᎨᎶᎰᎢ.  ᏝᏍᎪ ᏂᎯ ᎤᏟ ᏱᏁᏥᎸᏉᏗ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ?
\ft Behold the fowls of the air: for they sow not, neither do they reap, nor gather into barns; yet your heavenly Father feedeth them. Are ye not much better than they?

\ln Gagono nihi tsinitsadvnv udasuya uwelihisgvquo yeli saquo iyutlilodv yikanequotsa gvnvi?
\syll ᎦᎪᏃ ᏂᎯ ᏥᏂᏣᏛᏅ ᎤᏓᏑᏯ ᎤᏪᎵᎯᏍᎬᏉ ᏰᎵ ᏌᏉ ᎢᏳᏟᎶᏛ ᏱᎧᏁᏉᏣ ᎬᏅᎢ?
\ft Which of you by taking thought can add one cubit unto his stature?

\ln Ale gadono dinuwo dotselihisgoi?  Ditsadanvdvli tsutsilvhi tlogesi tsehi dadvsgvi.  Vtla yidunilvwisdanehoi, ale vtla yanisdohoi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎦᏙᏃ ᏗᏄᏬ ᏙᏤᎵᎯᏍᎪᎢ?  ᏗᏣᏓᏅᏛᎵ ᏧᏥᎸᎯ ᏠᎨᏏ ᏤᎯ ᏓᏛᏍᎬᎢ.  ᎥᏝ ᏱᏚᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎰᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᏯᏂᏍᏙᎰᎢ.
\ft And why take ye thought for raiment? Consider the lilies of the field, how they grow; they toil not, neither do they spin:

\ln Aseno hia nitsvweseha, nasquo solimanv nigav nuwodusvi tla nasgi yinusde dunuwvi saquo hia nusdvi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ, ᎾᏍᏉ ᏐᎵᎹᏅ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏄᏬᏚᏒᎢ Ꮭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᏄᏍᏕ ᏚᏄᏮᎢ ᏌᏉ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏍᏛᎢ.
\ft And yet I say unto you, That even Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these.

\ln Iyuyeno Unelanvhi nasgi yinigvneha yiganuwoha kanesga tlogesi ehi, gohi iga tseha, ugitsvnvno digadudiyi wunadinvdi tsigi, tlasgo utlihiyu yinidogetsinuwotsa, usdi itsohiyuhi?
\syll ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᏂᎬᏁᎭ ᏱᎦᏄᏬᎭ ᎧᏁᏍᎦ ᏠᎨᏏ ᎡᎯ, ᎪᎯ ᎢᎦ ᏤᎭ, ᎤᎩᏨᏅᏃ ᏗᎦᏚᏗᏱ ᏭᎾᏗᏅᏗ ᏥᎩ, ᏝᏍᎪ ᎤᏟᎯᏳ ᏱᏂᏙᎨᏥᏄᏬᏣ, ᎤᏍᏗ ᎢᏦᎯᏳᎯ?
\ft Wherefore, if God so clothe the grass of the field, which to day is, and to morrow is cast into the oven, shall he not much more clothe you, O ye of little faith?

\ln Nasgi iyusdi tlesdi yitselihisgesdi hia yinitsiwesgesdi; gado dayotsigi, ale gado dayotsaditahi, ale gado dayotsanuwoi?
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏤᎵᎯᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎯᎠ ᏱᏂᏥᏪᏍᎨᏍᏗ; ᎦᏙ ᏓᏲᏥᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᏙ ᏓᏲᏣᏗᏔᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᏙ ᏓᏲᏣᏄᏬᎢ?
\ft Therefore take no thought, saying, What shall we eat? or, What shall we drink? or, Wherewithal shall we be clothed?

\ln Nigadvyeno nasgi hia uniyoho Tsunatelenvdv yvwi.  Galvladiyeno ehi Itsidoda agataha nasgi hia nigadv itsinigvsehvi.
\syll ᏂᎦᏛᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎤᏂᏲᎰ ᏧᎾᏖᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ.  ᎦᎸᎳᏗᏰᏃ ᎡᎯ ᎢᏥᏙᏓ ᎠᎦᏔᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎢᏥᏂᎬᏎᎲᎢ.
\ft (For after all these things do the Gentiles seek:) for your heavenly Father knoweth that ye have need of all these things.

\ln Igvyisgini itsiyoga galvladi ehi ugvwiyuhi gesv ale utseli duyugodvi, hiano nigadiyu dayetsinequoeli.
\syll ᎢᎬᏱᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᏥᏲᎦ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏚᏳᎪᏛᎢ, ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏓᏰᏥᏁᏉᎡᎵ.
\ft But seek ye first the kingdom of God, and his righteousness; and all these things shall be added unto you.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi tlesdi ugitsvnv iyvdv yiwitselihisgesdi, ugitsvnvyeno uwasv tsudalenvdv dvdelihistani.  Yeliquo uyo iga uwehvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎤᎩᏨᏅ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏱᏫᏤᎵᎯᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎤᎩᏨᏅᏰᏃ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏛᏕᎵᎯᏍᏔᏂ.  ᏰᎵᏉ ᎤᏲ ᎢᎦ ᎤᏪᎲᎢ.
\ft Take therefore no thought for the morrow: for the morrow shall take thought for the things of itself. Sufficient unto the day is the evil thereof.

\ln Tlesdi tsitsadalawiseli nasgino nihi tlesdi etsilawiselvgi.
\syll ᏞᏍᏗ ᏥᏣᏓᎳᏫᏎᎵ ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏂᎯ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎡᏥᎳᏫᏎᎸᎩ.
\ft Judge not, that ye be not judged.

\ln Nasgiyeno nusdv itsadalawiselv ase nasquo dvetsilawiseli, ale nusdv itsadatlilosvlv nasquo dvetsatliloeli.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎢᏣᏓᎳᏫᏎᎸ ᎠᏎ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏛᎡᏥᎳᏫᏎᎵ, ᎠᎴ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎢᏣᏓᏟᎶᏒᎸ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏛᎡᏣᏟᎶᎡᎵ.
\ft For with what judgment ye judge, ye shall be judged: and with what measure ye mete, it shall be measured to you again.

\ln Ale gadono ihigowatisgo utlvdalvdv ugasuhvi disdadanvtli, nelisgvnano igeso unosdv ada tsvsv tsagasuhvi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎦᏙᏃ ᎢᎯᎪᏩᏘᏍᎪ ᎤᏢᏓᎸᏛ ᎤᎦᏑᎲᎢ ᏗᏍᏓᏓᏅᏟ, ᏁᎵᏍᎬᎾᏃ ᎢᎨᏐ ᎤᏃᏍᏛ ᎠᏓ ᏨᏒ ᏣᎦᏑᎲᎢ.
\ft And why beholdest thou the mote that is in thy brother's eye, but considerest not the beam that is in thine own eye?

\ln Ale gado yigalisdoda hia yiniwesi disdadanvtli, Gvlvsi utlvdalvdv tsagasuhvi, gvniyuquono unosdv ada tsvsv tsagasuha.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎦᏙ ᏱᎦᎵᏍᏙᏓ ᎯᎠ ᏱᏂᏪᏏ ᏗᏍᏓᏓᏅᏟ, ᎬᎸᏏ ᎤᏢᏓᎸᏛ ᏣᎦᏑᎲᎢ, ᎬᏂᏳᏉᏃ ᎤᏃᏍᏛ ᎠᏓ ᏨᏒ ᏣᎦᏑᎭ.
\ft Or how wilt thou say to thy brother, Let me pull out the mote out of thine eye; and, behold, a beam is in thine own eye?

\ln Tsatlonasdi!  igvyi hilv unosdv ada tsvsv tsagasuhvi, hnaquono gvnigesviyu tsagowadvdiyi gesesdi hilvediyi utlvdalvdv disdadanvtli ugasuhvi.
\syll ᏣᏠᎾᏍᏗ  ᎢᎬᏱ ᎯᎸ ᎤᏃᏍᏛ ᎠᏓ ᏨᏒ ᏣᎦᏑᎲᎢ, ᎿᏉᏃ ᎬᏂᎨᏒᎢᏳ ᏣᎪᏩᏛᏗᏱ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎯᎸᎡᏗᏱ ᎤᏢᏓᎸᏛ ᏗᏍᏓᏓᏅᏟ ᎤᎦᏑᎲᎢ.
\ft Thou hypocrite, first cast out the beam out of thine own eye; and then shalt thou see clearly to cast out the mote out of thy brother's eye.

\ln Tlesdi gohusdi galvquodi gili ditsinelvgi, tlesdi ale dagvnaiyunasdi ditsatseliga siqua widitsadinelvgi, yidanalasdavliquoyeno, ale yanagatahvna yvgetsidagalvvga.
\syll ᏞᏍᏗ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎦᎸᏉᏗ ᎩᎵ ᏗᏥᏁᎸᎩ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏓᎬᎾᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗ ᏗᏣᏤᎵᎦ ᏏᏆ ᏫᏗᏣᏗᏁᎸᎩ, ᏱᏓᎾᎳᏍᏓᎥᎵᏉᏰᏃ, ᎠᎴ ᏯᎾᎦᏔᎲᎾ ᏴᎨᏥᏓᎦᎸᎥᎦ.
\ft Give not that which is holy unto the dogs, neither cast ye your pearls before swine, lest they trample them under their feet, and turn again and rend you.

\ln Itsitayoha, ase dayetsineli; itsiyoga, ase datsiwadvhi; itsvniga, ase dayetsisduieli.
\syll ᎢᏥᏔᏲᎭ, ᎠᏎ ᏓᏰᏥᏁᎵ; ᎢᏥᏲᎦ, ᎠᏎ ᏓᏥᏩᏛᎯ; ᎢᏨᏂᎦ, ᎠᏎ ᏓᏰᏥᏍᏚᎢᎡᎵ.
\ft Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you:

\ln Giloyeno tsatayohiho atsinehoi, gilono tsuyoho awatisgoi, gilono tsiwigvniho atsisduiehoi.
\syll ᎩᎶᏰᏃ ᏣᏔᏲᎯᎰ ᎠᏥᏁᎰᎢ, ᎩᎶᏃ ᏧᏲᎰ ᎠᏩᏘᏍᎪᎢ, ᎩᎶᏃ ᏥᏫᎬᏂᎰ ᎠᏥᏍᏚᎢᎡᎰᎢ.
\ft For every one that asketh receiveth; and he that seeketh findeth; and to him that knocketh it shall be opened.

\ln Gagoge asgaya hia tsinitsadvnv, iyuno uwetsi gadu yutayoseha, nvyaquo yahvsi?
\syll ᎦᎪᎨ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᏣᏛᏅ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎦᏚ ᏳᏔᏲᏎᎭ, ᏅᏯᏉ ᏯᎲᏏ?
\ft Or what man is there of you, whom if his son ask bread, will he give him a stone?

\ln Ale atsadi yatayohiha, tsigo inadvquo yvganvvsi?
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎠᏣᏗ ᏯᏔᏲᎯᎭ, ᏥᎪ ᎢᎾᏛᏉ ᏴᎦᏅᎥᏏ?
\ft Or if he ask a fish, will he give him a serpent?

\ln Iyuno nihi itsiyoi yitsisinahi osdv gesv ditsinediyi ditsetsi, utlihiyu udohiyuhiya Itsidoda galvladi ehi osdv danehesdi gvwatayosehi.
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏥᏲᎢ ᏱᏥᏏᏀᎢ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎨᏒ ᏗᏥᏁᏗᏱ ᏗᏤᏥ, ᎤᏟᎯᏳ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎢᏥᏙᏓ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᎬᏩᏔᏲᏎᎯ.
\ft If ye then, being evil, know how to give good gifts unto your children, how much more shall your Father which is in heaven give good things to them that ask him?

\ln Nasgi iyusdi nigav gohusdi itsadulisgv yvwi igetsadvnediyi, nasgiya nasquo nidetsadvnehesdi; nasgiyeno hia nusdi dikahnawadvsdi ale anadolehosgi
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎢᏣᏚᎵᏍᎬ ᏴᏫ ᎢᎨᏣᏛᏁᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏂᏕᏣᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ; ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏍᏗ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ
\ft Therefore all things whatsoever ye would that men should do to you, do ye even so to them: for this is the law and the prophets.

\ln Ayadoli galohisdiyi itsiyvsda Ayateniyeno galohisdiyi ale ayateni nvnohi ayohuhisdiyi wigananugogvi, uni tsatano nahna anilosga.
\syll ᎠᏯᏙᎵ ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎢᏥᏴᏍᏓ ᎠᏯᏖᏂᏰᏃ ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏯᏖᏂ ᏅᏃᎯ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏫᎦᎾᏄᎪᎬᎢ, ᎤᏂ ᏣᏔᏃ ᏀᎾ ᎠᏂᎶᏍᎦ.
\ft Enter ye in at the strait gate: for wide is the gate, and broad is the way, that leadeth to destruction, and many there be which go in thereat:

\ln Ayadoliyuyeno galohisdiyi ale ayadoliyu nvnohi gvnidv wigananugogvi, ale anigayoliyu aniwatiha.
\syll ᎠᏯᏙᎵᏳᏰᏃ ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏯᏙᎵᏳ ᏅᏃᎯ ᎬᏂᏛ ᏫᎦᎾᏄᎪᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᎦᏲᎵᏳ ᎠᏂᏩᏘᎭ.
\ft Because strait is the gate, and narrow is the way, which leadeth unto life, and few there be that find it.

\ln Detseyadotsehesdi unatlonasdi anadolehosgi, awi uninodena ganega tsunanuwai tsigetsilutsehoi; aseno hawini gesv waya unigvvsgi gesoi.
\syll ᏕᏤᏯᏙᏤᎮᏍᏗ ᎤᎾᏠᎾᏍᏗ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ, ᎠᏫ ᎤᏂᏃᏕᎾ ᎦᏁᎦ ᏧᎾᏄᏩᎢ ᏥᎨᏥᎷᏤᎰᎢ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎭᏫᏂ ᎨᏒ ᏩᏯ ᎤᏂᎬᎥᏍᎩ ᎨᏐᎢ.
\ft Beware of false prophets, which come to you in sheep's clothing, but inwardly they are ravening wolves.

\ln Nusdv anadadvsgvi dodatsolistani.   Tsigo yvwi telvladi danadesgo tsisdunigisdihi?  Ale svgataiyunasdi tsigotsitsihi danadesgoi?
\syll ᏄᏍᏛ ᎠᎾᏓᏛᏍᎬᎢ ᏙᏓᏦᎵᏍᏔᏂ.   ᏥᎪ ᏴᏫ ᏖᎸᎳᏗ ᏓᎾᏕᏍᎪ ᏥᏍᏚᏂᎩᏍᏗᎯ?  ᎠᎴ ᏒᎦᏔᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗ ᏥᎪᏥᏥᎯ ᏓᎾᏕᏍᎪᎢ?
\ft Ye shall know them by their fruits. Do men gather grapes of thorns, or figs of thistles?

\ln Nasgisgini nusdi nigav osdv tlugv osdv adadvsgoi, uyono tlugv uyo adadvsgoi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ ᏄᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏡᎬ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎠᏓᏛᏍᎪᎢ, ᎤᏲᏃ ᏡᎬ ᎤᏲ ᎠᏓᏛᏍᎪᎢ.
\ft Even so every good tree bringeth forth good fruit; but a corrupt tree bringeth forth evil fruit.

\ln Osdv tlugv vtla yeli uyo yvgvdadvga, ale uyo tlugv vtla yeli osdv yvgvdadvga.
\syll ᎣᏍᏛ ᏡᎬ ᎥᏝ ᏰᎵ ᎤᏲ ᏴᎬᏓᏛᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏲ ᏡᎬ ᎥᏝ ᏰᎵ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏴᎬᏓᏛᎦ.
\ft A good tree cannot bring forth evil fruit, neither can a corrupt tree bring forth good fruit.

\ln Nigavsgini detlugv osdv nanadadvsgvna, digaleyvsdodi gesesdi, ale atsilvyi widadinvdi.
\syll ᏂᎦᎥᏍᎩᏂ ᏕᏡᎬ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎾᎾᏓᏛᏍᎬᎾ, ᏗᎦᎴᏴᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏥᎸᏱ ᏫᏓᏗᏅᏗ.
\ft Every tree that bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi dodatsolistani nusdv anadadvsgvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏙᏓᏦᎵᏍᏔᏂ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎠᎾᏓᏛᏍᎬᎢ.
\ft Wherefore by their fruits ye shall know them.

\ln Vtlayeno naniv, Tsagvwiyuhi, Tsagvwiyuhi, gvquosehi, galvladi ehi ugvwiyuhi gesv wuninanugoisdi yigi, nasgisgini na Edoda galvladi ehi adanvtesgv tsunilvwisdanehi.
\syll ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᎾᏂᎥ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎬᏉᏎᎯ, ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏭᏂᎾᏄᎪᎢᏍᏗ ᏱᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ Ꮎ ᎡᏙᏓ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎠᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ.
\ft Not every one that saith unto me, Lord, Lord, shall enter into the kingdom of heaven; but he that doeth the will of my Father which is in heaven.

\ln Nahiyu iga gesesdi unitsatisdi hia nvdagvgiwehali; Tsagvwiyuhi, Tsagvwiyuhi, tlasgo detsadov yotsvdisge yotsadolehosgei?  Ale tlasgo detsadov yotsvdisge anisgina yidotsinugowisgei?  Ale tlasgo detsadov yotsvdisge utsati usquanigodi yidogilvwisdanehei?
\syll ᏀᎢᏳ ᎢᎦ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᏂᏣᏘᏍᏗ ᎯᎠ ᏅᏓᎬᎩᏪᎭᎵ; ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᏝᏍᎪ ᏕᏣᏙᎥ ᏲᏨᏗᏍᎨ ᏲᏣᏙᎴᎰᏍᎨᎢ?  ᎠᎴ ᏝᏍᎪ ᏕᏣᏙᎥ ᏲᏨᏗᏍᎨ ᎠᏂᏍᎩᎾ ᏱᏙᏥᏄᎪᏫᏍᎨᎢ?  ᎠᎴ ᏝᏍᎪ ᏕᏣᏙᎥ ᏲᏨᏗᏍᎨ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᏱᏙᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎮᎢ?
\ft Many will say to me in that day, Lord, Lord, have we not prophesied in thy name? and in thy name have cast out devils? and in thy name done many wonderful works?

\ln Hnaquono hia nvdagatsiweseli; vtla ilvhiyu yitsvgatahei; utli witsilohi uyo ditsilvwisdanehi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏅᏓᎦᏥᏪᏎᎵ; ᎥᏝ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᏱᏨᎦᏔᎮᎢ; ᎤᏟ ᏫᏥᎶᎯ ᎤᏲ ᏗᏥᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ.
\ft And then will I profess unto them, I never knew you: depart from me, ye that work iniquity.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi naniv gilo hia tsinitsiwea anadvgisgesdi, ale nasgi nanadvnehesdi, agatahnai asgaya dodagatsiyatlilostani, nasgi nvyohi tsunesgehei;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎩᎶ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᏥᏪᎠ ᎠᎾᏛᎩᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᎾᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ, ᎠᎦᏔᎿᎢ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᏙᏓᎦᏥᏯᏟᎶᏍᏔᏂ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏲᎯ ᏧᏁᏍᎨᎮᎢ;
\ft Therefore whosoever heareth these sayings of mine, and doeth them, I will liken him unto a wise man, which built his house upon a rock:

\ln Hnaquono tsugahnanei, ale tsidunohuganei, ale tsunolvnei, nahna adanelv tsiduyilolei; aseno vtla yuyotsei, nvtsihiyeno gakahei.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏧᎦᎿᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᏚᏃᎱᎦᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏃᎸᏁᎢ, ᏀᎾ ᎠᏓᏁᎸ ᏥᏚᏱᎶᎴᎢ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏳᏲᏤᎢ, ᏅᏥᎯᏰᏃ ᎦᎧᎮᎢ.
\ft And the rain descended, and the floods came, and the winds blew, and beat upon that house; and it fell not: for it was founded upon a rock.

\ln Nanivno gilo hia tsinitsiwea anadvgisgesdi, nasgino nanadvnehvna igesesdi, unegu asgaya digegatlilosdodi gesesdi nasgi noyuhi tsunesgehei.
\syll ᎾᏂᎥᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᏥᏪᎠ ᎠᎾᏛᎩᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎾᎾᏛᏁᎲᎾ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎤᏁᎫ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᏗᎨᎦᏟᎶᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏃᏳᎯ ᏧᏁᏍᎨᎮᎢ.
\ft And every one that heareth these sayings of mine, and doeth them not, shall be likened unto a foolish man, which built his house upon the sand:

\ln Hnaquono tsugahnanei, ale tsidunohuganei, ale tsunolvnei, nahna adanelv tsiduyilolei, ale tsuyotsei, ale usgasediyu tsinulistane uyotsv.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏧᎦᎿᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᏚᏃᎱᎦᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏃᎸᏁᎢ, ᏀᎾ ᎠᏓᏁᎸ ᏥᏚᏱᎶᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏲᏤᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏍᎦᏎᏗᏳ ᏥᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁ ᎤᏲᏨ.
\ft And the rain descended, and the floods came, and the winds blew, and beat upon that house; and it fell: and great was the fall of it.

\ln Hiano nulistanei, nasgi Tsisa usquadv nasgi nigawesgvi, unisquanigose dadeyohvsgvi.

\syll ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎤᏁᎷᏁᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ; ᎥᏝ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏗᎦᏓᏛᏙᏗ ᏱᎩ ᏂᎯ, ᏥᏌ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏪᏥ, ᏥᎪ ᎠᏂ ᏣᎷᏥᎸ ᏍᎩᏂᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏙᏗᏱᏉ ᎠᏏᏉ ᎾᏍᏆᎵᏍᎬᎾ?
\ft And, behold, they cried out, saying, What have we to do with thee, Jesus, thou Son of God? art thou come hither to torment us before the time?

\ln Gehino iyvdv dinedohe unitsati sunadatlugi siqua analisdayvnidohei.
\syll ᎨᎯᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏗᏁᏙᎮ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏑᎾᏓᏡᎩ ᏏᏆ ᎠᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᏂᏙᎮᎢ.
\ft And there was a good way off from them an herd of many swine feeding.

\ln Anisginano gvwatayoselei, hia nigvwaweselei; iyuno sgininugowisvha, unanelagi sgineliselvha siqua sunadatlugi wigosdiyvsdiyi.
\syll ᎠᏂᏍᎩᎾᏃ ᎬᏩᏔᏲᏎᎴᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏩᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᏍᎩᏂᏄᎪᏫᏒᎭ, ᎤᎾᏁᎳᎩ ᏍᎩᏁᎵᏎᎸᎭ ᏏᏆ ᏑᎾᏓᏡᎩ ᏫᎪᏍᏗᏴᏍᏗᏱ.
\ft So the devils besought him, saying, If thou cast us out, suffer us to go away into the herd of swine.

\ln Hiano niduweselei; Sdena.  Uninugotsvno, siqua sunadatlugi widuniyvlei.  Ale gvniyuquo nigadv sunadatlugi siqua ayanuliyu unalisei, wunigasoase ganetlugi gvsvi, vdali wunalitadinvsei, ale amayi duniliwotsei.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᏍᏕᎾ.  ᎤᏂᏄᎪᏨᏃ, ᏏᏆ ᏑᎾᏓᏡᎩ ᏫᏚᏂᏴᎴᎢ.  ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏑᎾᏓᏡᎩ ᏏᏆ ᎠᏯᏄᎵᏳ ᎤᎾᎵᏎᎢ, ᏭᏂᎦᏐᎠᏎ ᎦᏁᏡᎩ ᎬᏒᎢ, ᎥᏓᎵ ᏭᎾᎵᏔᏗᏅᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎹᏱ ᏚᏂᎵᏬᏤᎢ.
\ft And he said unto them, Go. And when they were come out, they went into the herd of swine: and, behold, the whole herd of swine ran violently down a steep place into the sea, and perished in the waters.

\ln Dinigatiyano unalisei, digaduhv wunilosei, nigadv wuninohelei, ale anisgina gvwaniyai nunalisdanelvi.
\syll ᏗᏂᎦᏘᏯᏃ ᎤᎾᎵᏎᎢ, ᏗᎦᏚᎲ ᏭᏂᎶᏎᎢ, ᏂᎦᏛ ᏭᏂᏃᎮᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏍᎩᎾ ᎬᏩᏂᏯᎢ ᏄᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᎸᎢ.
\ft And they that kept them fled, and went their ways into the city, and told every thing, and what was befallen to the possessed of the devils.

\ln Gvniyuquono nigadiyu sgadugi tsuninugotsei, tsisa degvwatlosilei; gvwagohvno gvwatayosele udanvsdiyiquo unatseligohi gesvi.
\syll ᎬᏂᏳᏉᏃ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏍᎦᏚᎩ ᏧᏂᏄᎪᏤᎢ, ᏥᏌ ᏕᎬᏩᏠᏏᎴᎢ; ᎬᏩᎪᎲᏃ ᎬᏩᏔᏲᏎᎴ ᎤᏓᏅᏍᏗᏱᏉ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎪᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft And, behold, the whole city came out to meet Jesus: and when they saw him, they besought him that he would depart out of their coasts.

\ln Tsiyuhino utsanv, duwesotsei, uwasvno uweduhv wulutsei.
\syll ᏥᏳᎯᏃ ᎤᏣᏅ, ᏚᏪᏐᏤᎢ, ᎤᏩᏒᏃ ᎤᏪᏚᎲ ᏭᎷᏤᎢ.
\ft And he entered into a ship, and passed over, and came into his own city.

\ln Gvniyuquono gvwatinohele asgaya utlvgi ulvdalvvsgi ganvge atsesdogihi; Tsisano udolehosv anohiyuhvsgvi, hia nuwesele ulvdalvvsgi; Aquetsi, ugalisdiyuquo hadanvdada, tsasganvtsv etsadoligi.
\syll ᎬᏂᏳᏉᏃ ᎬᏩᏘᏃᎮᎴ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᏢᎩ ᎤᎸᏓᎸᎥᏍᎩ ᎦᏅᎨ ᎠᏤᏍᏙᎩᎯ; ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᏙᎴᎰᏒ ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎬᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴ ᎤᎸᏓᎸᎥᏍᎩ; ᎠᏇᏥ, ᎤᎦᎵᏍᏗᏳᏉ ᎭᏓᏅᏓᏓ, ᏣᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᎡᏣᏙᎵᎩ.
\ft And, behold, they brought to him a man sick of the palsy, lying on a bed: and Jesus seeing their faith said unto the sick of the palsy; Son, be of good cheer; thy sins be forgiven thee.

\ln Gvniyuquono igadv dinowelisgi hia nuniwese dunadanvdvi; hia asgaya Galvladi ehi asotlvisdiha.
\syll ᎬᏂᏳᏉᏃ ᎢᎦᏛ ᏗᏃᏪᎵᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎ ᏚᎾᏓᏅᏛᎢ; ᎯᎠ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎠᏐᏢᎢᏍᏗᎭ.
\ft And, behold, certain of the scribes said within themselves, This man blasphemeth.

\ln Tsisano agatahe nusdv anadanvtesgvi, hiano niduweselei; Gadono uyo itsadanvteha ditsinawiyi?
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᎠᎦᏔᎮ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎠᎾᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬᎢ, ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎦᏙᏃ ᎤᏲ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏖᎭ ᏗᏥᎾᏫᏱ?
\ft And Jesus knowing their thoughts said, Wherefore think ye evil in your hearts?

\ln Gadoge usdi utli ahidiyu kaneisdiyi, tsigo hia yinagawea, tsasganvtsv etsadoligi?  Hiage yinagawea, talehvga ale geda?
\syll ᎦᏙᎨ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎤᏟ ᎠᎯᏗᏳ ᎧᏁᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᏥᎪ ᎯᎠ ᏱᎾᎦᏪᎠ, ᏣᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᎡᏣᏙᎵᎩ?  ᎯᎠᎨ ᏱᎾᎦᏪᎠ, ᏔᎴᎲᎦ ᎠᎴ ᎨᏓ?
\ft For whether is easier, to say, Thy sins be forgiven thee; or to say, Arise, and walk?

\ln Adina itsadolehohisdiyi yvwi Uwetsi asganvtsv gvwadadolisdi gesv ani elohi, hnaquo hia nuwesele ulvdalvvsgi; Talehvga, tsatsesdo hinagi, ale ditsenvsv hena.
\syll ᎠᏗᎾ ᎢᏣᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎠᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᎬᏩᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏂ ᎡᎶᎯ, ᎿᏉ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴ ᎤᎸᏓᎸᎥᏍᎩ; ᏔᎴᎲᎦ, ᏣᏤᏍᏙ ᎯᎾᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏤᏅᏒ ᎮᎾ.
\ft But that ye may know that the Son of man hath power on earth to forgive sins, (then saith he to the sick of the palsy,) Arise, take up thy bed, and go unto thine house.

\ln Dulenvno tsuwenvsv wulosei.
\syll ᏚᎴᏅᏃ ᏧᏪᏅᏒ ᏭᎶᏎᎢ.
\ft And he arose, and departed to his house.

\ln Unitsatino unigohv, unisquanigosei, ale unilvquotane Unelanvhi nasgi tsulisgolvdanelvhi nasgi iyusdi tsunilvwisdanediyi yvwi.
\syll ᎤᏂᏣᏘᏃ ᎤᏂᎪᎲ, ᎤᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᎸᏉᏔᏁ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᏴᏫ.
\ft But when the multitudes saw it, they marvelled, and glorified God, which had given such power unto men.

\ln Tsisano nahna udanvsv, ugohvgi asgaya Madu tsudoidv, uwolvgi ayeli aguyvdiyi.  Hiano nuweselvgi; Sgisdawaduga.  Dulenvno usdawadvsvgi.
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᏀᎾ ᎤᏓᏅᏒ, ᎤᎪᎲᎩ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎹᏚ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ, ᎤᏬᎸᎩ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎠᎫᏴᏗᏱ.  ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏍᎩᏍᏓᏩᏚᎦ.  ᏚᎴᏅᏃ ᎤᏍᏓᏩᏛᏒᎩ.
\ft And as Jesus passed forth from thence, he saw a man, named Matthew, sitting at the receipt of custom: and he saith unto him, Follow me. And he arose, and followed him.

\ln Hiano nulistanvgi, ganvgv [alisdayvhvsgv] galitsode, gvniyuquo unitsadvgi adelv anigisidohi ale anisgana unilutsv unanitlvnvgi aninvdlav Tsisa ale gvwasdawadidohi.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎩ, ᎦᏅᎬ ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎬdata is invalid ᎦᎵᏦᏕ, ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎤᏂᏣᏛᎩ ᎠᏕᎸ ᎠᏂᎩᏏᏙᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᎾ ᎤᏂᎷᏨ ᎤᎾᏂᏢᏅᎩ ᎠᏂᏅᏜᎥ ᏥᏌ ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ.
\ft And it came to pass, as Jesus sat at meat in the house, behold, many publicans and sinners came and sat down with him and his disciples.

\ln Aniqualisino unadolehosv, hia nidu niweselv gvwasdawadidohi; Gadono Ditseyohvsgi adelv anigisidohi ale anisgana itsulaha ianalisdayvhvsga?
\syll ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏᏃ ᎤᎾᏙᎴᎰᏒ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚ ᏂᏪᏎᎸ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ; ᎦᏙᏃ ᏗᏤᏲᎲᏍᎩ ᎠᏕᎸ ᎠᏂᎩᏏᏙᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᎾ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎢᎠᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎦ?
\ft And when the Pharisees saw it, they said unto his disciples, Why eateth your Master with publicans and sinners?

\ln Tsisano udvganv hia niduweselvgi; Nidunitlvgvna vtla udulvdi yinunalisdaneho didanvwisgi, tsunitlvgisgini.
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᏛᎦᏅ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏂᏚᏂᏢᎬᎾ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏚᎸᏗ ᏱᏄᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᎰ ᏗᏓᏅᏫᏍᎩ, ᏧᏂᏢᎩᏍᎩᏂ.
\ft But when Jesus heard that, he said unto them, They that be whole need not a physician, but they that are sick.

\ln Itsenasgini, witsadeloqua gadvgv hia nasgi tsinigaweha; adadolisdi gesv aquaduliha, vtlano atsilvgelasdiyi gesvi.  Vtlayeno nanisganvna yiditsiyanvhilv, anisganasgini tsuninetliyvsdiyi dunadanvdvi.
\syll ᎢᏤᎾᏍᎩᏂ, ᏫᏣᏕᎶᏆ ᎦᏛᎬ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏂᎦᏪᎭ; ᎠᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏆᏚᎵᎭ, ᎥᏝᏃ ᎠᏥᎸᎨᎳᏍᏗᏱ ᎨᏒᎢ.  ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᎾᏂᏍᎦᏅᎾ ᏱᏗᏥᏯᏅᎯᎸ, ᎠᏂᏍᎦᎾᏍᎩᏂ ᏧᏂᏁᏟᏴᏍᏗᏱ ᏚᎾᏓᏅᏛᎢ.
\ft But go ye and learn what that meaneth, I will have mercy, and not sacrifice: for I am not come to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.

\ln Hnaquono Tsani gvwasdawadidohi [Tsisa] gvwalutselvgi, hia nigvwaweselvgi; Gadono ayv Aniqualisino yano amatli tsotsvsga, nihino getsasdawadidohi amatli nanvsgvna tsigi?
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏣᏂ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏥᏌdata is invalid ᎬᏩᎷᏤᎸᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏩᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎦᏙᏃ ᎠᏴ ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏᏃ ᏯᏃ ᎠᎹᏟ ᏦᏨᏍᎦ, ᏂᎯᏃ ᎨᏣᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎠᎹᏟ ᎾᏅᏍᎬᎾ ᏥᎩ?
\ft Then came to him the disciples of John, saying, Why do we and the Pharisees fast oft, but thy disciples fast not?

\ln Tsisano hia niduweselvgi; Tsigo yeli degegatsvsdisgv anigatahi yidanatloyiga asiquo udesvnilvhi uneladidohvi?  Aseno iga dvliyiloli dagetsiyanveli udesvnilvhi, gila hnaquo amatli dvnvni.
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏥᎪ ᏰᎵ ᏕᎨᎦᏨᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎯ ᏱᏓᎾᏠᏱᎦ ᎠᏏᏉ ᎤᏕᏒᏂᎸᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏗᏙᎲᎢ?  ᎠᏎᏃ ᎢᎦ ᏛᎵᏱᎶᎵ ᏓᎨᏥᏯᏅᎡᎵ ᎤᏕᏒᏂᎸᎯ, ᎩᎳ ᎿᏉ ᎠᎹᏟ ᏛᏅᏂ.
\ft And Jesus said unto them, Can the children of the bridechamber mourn, as long as the bridegroom is with them? but the days will come, when the bridegroom shall be taken from them, and then shall they fast.

\ln Vtla ale gilo itse yigalastlvdisgo uweti anuwogihi, galastlvdvyeno yvgatsagalvda anuwo, udatsagalvhvno utli equohiyu yinigalisda.
\syll ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏤ ᏱᎦᎳᏍᏢᏗᏍᎪ ᎤᏪᏘ ᎠᏄᏬᎩᎯ, ᎦᎳᏍᏢᏛᏰᏃ ᏴᎦᏣᎦᎸᏓ ᎠᏄᏬ, ᎤᏓᏣᎦᎸᎲᏃ ᎤᏟ ᎡᏉᎯᏳ ᏱᏂᎦᎵᏍᏓ.
\ft No man putteth a piece of new cloth unto an old garment, for that which is put in to fill it up taketh from the garment, and the rent is made worse.

\ln Vtla ale itse gigageaditasdi tsuweti disutlvdv yidanitlisdisgoi; disutlvdvyeno yidadatsagalv, ale gigageaditasdi yatsewogi, disutlvdvno yidayogi.  Itsesgini gigageaditasdi ditse disutlvdv danitlisdisgoi, itsulano dunisquanigodoi.
\syll ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏤ ᎩᎦᎨᎠᏗᏔᏍᏗ ᏧᏪᏘ ᏗᏑᏢᏛ ᏱᏓᏂᏟᏍᏗᏍᎪᎢ; ᏗᏑᏢᏛᏰᏃ ᏱᏓᏓᏣᎦᎸ, ᎠᎴ ᎩᎦᎨᎠᏗᏔᏍᏗ ᏯᏤᏬᎩ, ᏗᏑᏢᏛᏃ ᏱᏓᏲᎩ.  ᎢᏤᏍᎩᏂ ᎩᎦᎨᎠᏗᏔᏍᏗ ᏗᏤ ᏗᏑᏢᏛ ᏓᏂᏟᏍᏗᏍᎪᎢ, ᎢᏧᎳᏃ ᏚᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏙᎢ.
\ft Neither do men put new wine into old bottles: else the bottles break, and the wine runneth out, and the bottles perish: but they put new wine into new bottles, and both are preserved.

\ln Asiquo nasgi nidegawesehvgi, gvniyuquo gilo iyusdi nugvwiyusadegi ulutsv udadolisdanelvgi, hia nuwesvgi; Aquetsi ageyutsa gayula uyohusidena.  Adina hena, hiyasvnilvha, aha dvadvnidiquo.
\syll ᎠᏏᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᏕᎦᏪᏎᎲᎩ, ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ ᎤᎷᏨ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎸᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎠᏇᏥ ᎠᎨᏳᏣ ᎦᏳᎳ ᎤᏲᎱᏏᏕᎾ.  ᎠᏗᎾ ᎮᎾ, ᎯᏯᏒᏂᎸᎭ, ᎠᎭ ᏛᎠᏛᏂᏗᏉ.
\ft While he spake these things unto them, behold, there came a certain ruler, and worshipped him, saying, My daughter is even now dead: but come and lay thy hand upon her, and she shall live.

\ln Tsisano dulenv usdawadvsvgi, ale nasquo gvwasdawadidohi.
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᏚᎴᏅ ᎤᏍᏓᏩᏛᏒᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ.
\ft And Jesus arose, and followed him, and so did his disciples.

\ln Gvniyuquono ageyv utlvgi gigv uwenvehi taladu tsudetiyvda igvwalistanvhi, oniditlv uluhisdanelvgi, gadaluyadv unuwav usvnelvgi.
\syll ᎬᏂᏳᏉᏃ ᎠᎨᏴ ᎤᏢᎩ ᎩᎬ ᎤᏪᏅᎡᎯ ᏔᎳᏚ ᏧᏕᏘᏴᏓ ᎢᎬᏩᎵᏍᏔᏅᎯ, ᎣᏂᏗᏢ ᎤᎷᎯᏍᏓᏁᎸᎩ, ᎦᏓᎷᏯᏛ ᎤᏄᏩᎥ ᎤᏒᏁᎸᎩ.
\ft And, behold, a woman, which was diseased with an issue of blood twelve years, came behind him, and touched the hem of his garment:

\ln Hiayeno nuwese udanvdvi; iyuno unuwavquo yaquasvnilv, ase yaquadiwi.
\syll ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᏄᏪᏎ ᎤᏓᏅᏛᎢ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᎤᏄᏩᎥᏉ ᏯᏆᏒᏂᎸ, ᎠᏎ ᏯᏆᏗᏫ.
\ft For she said within herself, If I may but touch his garment, I shall be whole.

\ln Tsisano ugatahvsv ale ugohv, hia nuwesvgi; Aquetsi, ugalisdiquo hadanvdada.  Tsohiyusv tsadiwisda.  Ageyvno nahiyuquo udiwasvgi.
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᎦᏔᎲᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎪᎲ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎠᏇᏥ, ᎤᎦᎵᏍᏗᏉ ᎭᏓᏅᏓᏓ.  ᏦᎯᏳᏒ ᏣᏗᏫᏍᏓ.  ᎠᎨᏴᏃ ᏀᎢᏳᏉ ᎤᏗᏩᏒᎩ.
\ft But Jesus turned him about, and when he saw her, he said, Daughter, be of good comfort; thy faith hath made thee whole. And the woman was made whole from that hour.

\ln Tsisano nugvwiyusadegi ganelv ulutsv, ale dugohv dinitseluhisgi, ale yvwi daniyvgvi,
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ ᎦᏁᎸ ᎤᎷᏨ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᎪᎲ ᏗᏂᏤᎷᎯᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏴᏫ ᏓᏂᏴᎬᎢ,
\ft And when Jesus came into the ruler's house, and saw the minstrels and the people making a noise,

\ln Hia niduweselvgi; Itsadanvna, nagono uyohusvhi yigi ageyutsa; galihaquosgini.  Vgvwayetsastanvquono.
\syll ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎢᏣᏓᏅᎾ, ᎾᎪᏃ ᎤᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᏱᎩ ᎠᎨᏳᏣ; ᎦᎵᎭᏉᏍᎩᏂ.  ᎥᎬᏩᏰᏣᏍᏔᏅᏉᏃ.
\ft He said unto them, Give place: for the maid is not dead, but sleepeth. And they laughed him to scorn.

\ln Getsinugowisvno yvwi, uyvlvgi uwoyeni uniyvhvgi, ageyutsano dulenvgi.
\syll ᎨᏥᏄᎪᏫᏒᏃ ᏴᏫ, ᎤᏴᎸᎩ ᎤᏬᏰᏂ ᎤᏂᏴᎲᎩ, ᎠᎨᏳᏣᏃ ᏚᎴᏅᎩ.
\ft But when the people were put forth, he went in, and took her by the hand, and the maid arose.

\ln Nasgino hia dunotsalotsidolvi nahna nigvnadv duyelisidolvgi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏚᏃᏣᎶᏥᏙᎸᎢ ᏀᎾ ᏂᎬᎾᏛ ᏚᏰᎵᏏᏙᎸᎩ.
\ft And the fame hereof went abroad into all that land.

\ln Tsisano nahna udanvsv, anitali dinigewi anisgaya gvwasdawadvsvgi, unelugvgi hia naniwesgvgi, sginidoligi nihi Dewi Uwetsi.
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᏀᎾ ᎤᏓᏅᏒ, ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᏗᏂᎨᏫ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏛᏒᎩ, ᎤᏁᎷᎬᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏂᏪᏍᎬᎩ, ᏍᎩᏂᏙᎵᎩ ᏂᎯ ᏕᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ.

\syll ᎦᎵᏦᏕᏃ ᎤᏴᎸ, ᏗᏂᎨᏫ ᎬᏩᎷᏤᎸᎩ, ᏥᏌᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎢᏍᏙᎯᏳᎲᏍᎦᏍᎪ ᏰᎵ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎬᏆᏛᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ?  ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏩᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎥᎥ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ.
\ft And when he was come into the house, the blind men came to him: and Jesus saith unto them, Believe ye that I am able to do this? They said unto him, Yea, Lord.

\ln Hnaquono dusvnelv dinigadoli, hia nuwesvgi; Nusdv isdohiyuhvsgv nasgiya nisdalisdasi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏚᏒᏁᎸ ᏗᏂᎦᏙᎵ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᏄᏍᏛ ᎢᏍᏙᎯᏳᎲᏍᎬ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏂᏍᏓᎵᏍᏓᏏ.
\ft Then touched he their eyes, saying, According to your faith be it unto you.

\ln Dinigadolino dulisdugisvgi.  Tsisano dunvsdadelvgi, hia niduweselvgi; Tlesdi gilo udolehosvgi.
\syll ᏗᏂᎦᏙᎵᏃ ᏚᎵᏍᏚᎩᏒᎩ.  ᏥᏌᏃ ᏚᏅᏍᏓᏕᎸᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏞᏍᏗ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏙᎴᎰᏒᎩ.
\ft And their eyes were opened; and Jesus straitly charged them, saying, See that no man know it.
