\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏒᏉ ᏚᏂᏃᏣᎳᏅᎩ ᏀᎾ ᏂᎬᎾᏛᎢ.
\ft But they, when they were departed, spread abroad his fame in all that country.

\ln Hnaquono aninugogvi gvniyuquo gilo gvwatinohelvgi asgaya uwagewi, asgina uyai.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎠᏂᏄᎪᎬᎢ ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎩᎶ ᎬᏩᏘᏃᎮᎸᎩ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᏩᎨᏫ, ᎠᏍᎩᎾ ᎤᏯᎢ.
\ft As they went out, behold, they brought to him a dumb man possessed with a devil.

\ln Asginano atsinugowisv uwagewi uwonisvgi.  Unitsatino unisquanigosvgi, hia nuniwesvgi; vtla ilvhiyu nasgi iyusdi agohvhi yigi isiliyi.
\syll ᎠᏍᎩᎾᏃ ᎠᏥᏄᎪᏫᏒ ᎤᏩᎨᏫ ᎤᏬᏂᏒᎩ.  ᎤᏂᏣᏘᏃ ᎤᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏒᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᎥᏝ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᎪᎲᎯ ᏱᎩ ᎢᏏᎵᏱ.
\ft And when the devil was cast out, the dumb spake: and the multitudes marvelled, saying, It was never so seen in Israel.

\ln Aseno Aniqualisi hia nuniwesvgi; Anisgina unatseli ugvwiyuhi gvdiha tsideganugowisga anisgina.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᎠᏂᏍᎩᎾ ᎤᎾᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎬᏗᎭ ᏥᏕᎦᏄᎪᏫᏍᎦ ᎠᏂᏍᎩᎾ.
\ft But the Pharisees said, He casteth out devils through the prince of the devils.

\ln Tsisano nigav tsudvna degaduhv ale tsusdi degaduhv uwedolvgi, dadeyohvsgvgi tsunilawiisdiyi, ale alitsidohvsgvgi osdv kanohedv galvladi ehi ugvwiyuhi gesv kanohesgvgi, ale dekanvwisgv nigav dunitlvgv ale nigav vyugi yvwi uniyilidehvi.
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏧᏛᎾ ᏕᎦᏚᎲ ᎠᎴ ᏧᏍᏗ ᏕᎦᏚᎲ ᎤᏪᏙᎸᎩ, ᏓᏕᏲᎲᏍᎬᎩ ᏧᏂᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎵᏥᏙᎲᏍᎬᎩ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎧᏃᎮᏍᎬᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᎧᏅᏫᏍᎬ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏚᏂᏢᎬ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎥᏳᎩ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏂᏱᎵᏕᎲᎢ.
\ft And Jesus went about all the cities and villages, teaching in their synagogues, and preaching the gospel of the kingdom, and healing every sickness and every disease among the people.

\ln Dugohvno unitsati yvwi, duwedolitsvgi, udagalisdodisgvgi wanaquo danilogvi, ale unadigaleyotsvhi gesvi, nasgiya awi uninodena nehvna tsigeso unigatiya.
\syll ᏚᎪᎲᏃ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏴᏫ, ᏚᏪᏙᎵᏨᎩ, ᎤᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᏩᎾᏉ ᏓᏂᎶᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏗᎦᎴᏲᏨᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎠᏫ ᎤᏂᏃᏕᎾ ᏁᎲᎾ ᏥᎨᏐ ᎤᏂᎦᏘᏯ.
\ft But when he saw the multitudes, he was moved with compassion on them, because they fainted, and were scattered abroad, as sheep having no shepherd.

\ln Hnaquo hia niduwehalv gvwasdawadidohi; Equohiyu tlogesi ugadvnatsvhi, aseno anigayoliyu tsunilvwisdanehi.
\syll ᎿᏉ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᎭᎸ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ; ᎡᏉᎯᏳ ᏠᎨᏏ ᎤᎦᏛᎾᏨᎯ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᏂᎦᏲᎵᏳ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ.
\ft Then saith he unto his disciples, The harvest truly is plenteous, but the labourers are few;

\ln Nasgi iyusdi etsitayosi ulogedv tsunvsdiyi tsunilvwisdanehi ugadvnatselvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎡᏥᏔᏲᏏ ᎤᎶᎨᏛ ᏧᏅᏍᏗᏱ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᎤᎦᏛᎾᏤᎸᎢ.
\ft Pray ye therefore the Lord of the harvest, that he will send forth labourers into his harvest.

\ln Widuyanvhvno taladu iyanidv gvwasdawadidohi, dunelv anisgina tsuninugowisdiyi, ale tsunadanvwodiyi nigav dunitlvgv, ale nigav vyugi.
\syll ᏫᏚᏯᏅᎲᏃ ᏔᎳᏚ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ, ᏚᏁᎸ ᎠᏂᏍᎩᎾ ᏧᏂᏄᎪᏫᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᎾᏓᏅᏬᏗᏱ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏚᏂᏢᎬ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎥᏳᎩ.
\ft And when he had called unto him his twelve disciples, he gave them power against unclean spirits, to cast them out, and to heal all manner of sickness and all manner of disease.

\ln Hiano nasgi nusdi dunadov taladu iyanidv getsinvsidv.  Igvyiyi Sawani Quida tsanosehoi, Enidino nasgiquo unvtli, Tsimino Tsequidi uwetsi, Tsanino nasgiquo unvtli.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏗ ᏚᎾᏙᎥ ᏔᎳᏚ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏛ.  ᎢᎬᏱᏱ ᏌᏩᏂ ᏈᏓ ᏣᏃᏎᎰᎢ, ᎡᏂᏗᏃ ᎾᏍᎩᏉ ᎤᏅᏟ, ᏥᎻᏃ ᏤᏈᏗ ᎤᏪᏥ, ᏣᏂᏃ ᎾᏍᎩᏉ ᎤᏅᏟ.
\ft Now the names of the twelve apostles are these; The first, Simon, who is called Peter, and Andrew his brother; James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother;

\ln Quiligino, Wadalamino, Damino, Maduno adelv agisidohi, Tsimino Eliqui uwetsi, Lequiyano Dadiya tsanosehoi,
\syll ᏈᎵᎩᏃ, ᏩᏓᎳᎻᏃ, ᏓᎻᏃ, ᎹᏚᏃ ᎠᏕᎸ ᎠᎩᏏᏙᎯ, ᏥᎻᏃ ᎡᎵᏈ ᎤᏪᏥ, ᎴᏈᏯᏃ ᏓᏗᏯ ᏣᏃᏎᎰᎢ,
\ft Philip, and Bartholomew; Thomas, and Matthew the publican; James the son of Alphaeus, and Lebbaeus, whose surname was Thaddaeus;

\ln Sawanino Agenanidi, Tsudasino Isgaladi nasgi Tsisa tsulonuhelvgi.
\syll ᏌᏩᏂᏃ ᎠᎨᎾᏂᏗ, ᏧᏓᏏᏃ ᎢᏍᎦᎳᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏌ ᏧᎶᏄᎮᎸᎩ.
\ft Simon the Canaanite, and Judas Iscariot, who also betrayed him.

\ln Nasgi hia taladu iyanidv Tsisa dunvsvgi dunetselvno hia niduweselvgi; Tsunadalenvdv yvwi dinehv iditlv tlesdi witsilosvgi, ale Sameli anehi duniduhv tlesdi itsiyvlvgi
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏔᎳᏚ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᏥᏌ ᏚᏅᏒᎩ ᏚᏁᏤᎸᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᏗᏁᎲ ᎢᏗᏢ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏫᏥᎶᏒᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏌᎺᎵ ᎠᏁᎯ ᏚᏂᏚᎲ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎢᏥᏴᎸᎩ
\ft These twelve Jesus sent forth, and commanded them, saying, Go not into the way of the Gentiles, and into any city of the Samaritans enter ye not:

\ln Awisgini unalenahidv Isili sidanelv gesv ditsiwadvhuga.
\syll ᎠᏫᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᎾᎴᏀᎢᏛ ᎢᏏᎵ ᏏᏓᏁᎸ ᎨᏒ ᏗᏥᏩᏛᎱᎦ.
\ft But go rather to the lost sheep of the house of Israel.

\ln Itsaisvno itsalitsidohvsgesdi, hia nitsiwesgesdi; Galvladi ehi ugvwiyuhi gesv esganiyu dayai.
\syll ᎢᏣᎢᏒᏃ ᎢᏣᎵᏥᏙᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᏥᏪᏍᎨᏍᏗ; ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎡᏍᎦᏂᏳ ᏓᏯᎢ.
\ft And as ye go, preach, saying, The kingdom of heaven is at hand.

\ln Tsunitlvgi detsinvwisgesdi, adayesgi tsunitlvgi detsinvgalisgesdi, tsuniyohusvhi detsaledisgesdi, anisgina detsinugowisgesdi.  Asequo etsinelvhi, asequo itsadanehesdi.
\syll ᏧᏂᏢᎩ ᏕᏥᏅᏫᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᏓᏰᏍᎩ ᏧᏂᏢᎩ ᏕᏥᏅᎦᎵᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᏕᏣᎴᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᏂᏍᎩᎾ ᏕᏥᏄᎪᏫᏍᎨᏍᏗ.  ᎠᏎᏉ ᎡᏥᏁᎸᎯ, ᎠᏎᏉ ᎢᏣᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ.
\ft Heal the sick, cleanse the lepers, raise the dead, cast out devils: freely ye have received, freely give.

\ln Tlesdi detsadatlohv yitsadanelesdi dalonige adelv ale unegv adelv ale vtsayi,
\syll ᏞᏍᏗ ᏕᏣᏓᏠᎲ ᏱᏣᏓᏁᎴᏍᏗ ᏓᎶᏂᎨ ᎠᏕᎸ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎬ ᎠᏕᎸ ᎠᎴ ᎥᏣᏱ,
\ft Provide neither gold, nor silver, nor brass in your purses,

\ln Ale degalodi, ale tali ditsanuwo, ale dilasulo, ale didolanvsdi; tsulvwisdanehiyeno uwadvdi geso ulisdayvdi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏕᎦᎶᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏔᎵ ᏗᏣᏄᏬ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎳᏑᎶ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏙᎳᏅᏍᏗ; ᏧᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯᏰᏃ ᎤᏩᏛᏗ ᎨᏐ ᎤᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗ.
\ft Nor scrip for your journey, neither two coats, neither shoes, nor yet staves: for the workman is worthy of his meat.

\ln Ilvhitlvno udvna gaduhv ale usdi gaduhv itsilugesdi, itsadadvdvhvsgesdi gilo ehv udanvti, nahnano itsinesdi gvni vtsanigi.
\syll ᎢᎸᎯᏢᏃ ᎤᏛᎾ ᎦᏚᎲ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎦᏚᎲ ᎢᏥᎷᎨᏍᏗ, ᎢᏣᏓᏛᏛᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎩᎶ ᎡᎲ ᎤᏓᏅᏘ, ᏀᎾᏃ ᎢᏥᏁᏍᏗ ᎬᏂ ᎥᏣᏂᎩ.
\ft And into whatsoever city or town ye shall enter, inquire who in it is worthy; and there abide till ye go thence.

\ln Adanelvno itsiyvha itsiyolihesdi.
\syll ᎠᏓᏁᎸᏃ ᎢᏥᏴᎭ ᎢᏥᏲᎵᎮᏍᏗ.
\ft And when ye come into an house, salute it.

\ln Iyuno nahna aninela uwadohiyadv digvwanadanilvisdi igesesdi, nasgi uwadohiyadv itsatseli unilutsedi gesesdi; iyuno digvwanadanilvisdi nigesvna igesesdi, nasgi nvwadohiyadv itsvsvquo itsilutsedi igesesdi.
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᏀᎾ ᎠᏂᏁᎳ ᎤᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᏗᎬᏩᎾᏓᏂᎸᎢᏍᏗ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᎢᏣᏤᎵ ᎤᏂᎷᏤᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᏗᎬᏩᎾᏓᏂᎸᎢᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᎢᏨᏒᏉ ᎢᏥᎷᏤᏗ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft And if the house be worthy, let your peace come upon it: but if it be not worthy, let your peace return to you.

\ln Iyuno gilo niditsadanilvgvna igesesdi, ale itsinegv nadvgisgvna igesesdi, nahna galitsode ale gaduhv itsinugogi, detsinvgovdisgesdi gada ditsalasideni.
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᏂᏗᏣᏓᏂᎸᎬᎾ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏥᏁᎬ ᎾᏛᎩᏍᎬᎾ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᏀᎾ ᎦᎵᏦᏕ ᎠᎴ ᎦᏚᎲ ᎢᏥᏄᎪᎩ, ᏕᏥᏅᎪᎥᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎦᏓ ᏗᏣᎳᏏᏕᏂ.
\ft And whosoever shall not receive you, nor hear your words, when ye depart out of that house or city, shake off the dust of your feet.

\ln Udohiyuhiya hia nitsvyuweseha, esgaquo igai unigiliyoisdi gesesdi Sodami ale Gomali, digugododiyi iga gesesdi, utlihiyu nasgi na gaduhvi.
\syll ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏳᏪᏎᎭ, ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎤᏂᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏐᏓᎻ ᎠᎴ ᎪᎹᎵ, ᏗᎫᎪᏙᏗᏱ ᎢᎦ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎤᏟᎯᏳ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎦᏚᎲᎢ.
\ft Verily I say unto you, It shall be more tolerable for the land of Sodom and Gomorrha in the day of judgment, than for that city.

\ln Gvniyuquo itsvnvli awi uninodena tsaneladidoho wayohi nasgiyai; nasgi iyusdi inadv igetsisinasani gesasdi, ale guledinisgonihi igetsadanvti gesesdi.
\syll ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎢᏨᏅᎵ ᎠᏫ ᎤᏂᏃᏕᎾ ᏣᏁᎳᏗᏙᎰ ᏩᏲᎯ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᎾᏛ ᎢᎨᏥᏏᎾᏌᏂ ᎨᏌᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎫᎴᏗᏂᏍᎪᏂᎯ ᎢᎨᏣᏓᏅᏘ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft Behold, I send you forth as sheep in the midst of wolves: be ye therefore wise as serpents, and harmless as doves.

\ln Detseyadotsehesdi adina yvwi, degalawivyeno dodagetsatinoli, tsunilawiisdiyino dodagetsilivnili.
\syll ᏕᏤᏯᏙᏤᎮᏍᏗ ᎠᏗᎾ ᏴᏫ, ᏕᎦᎳᏫᎥᏰᏃ ᏙᏓᎨᏣᏘᏃᎵ, ᏧᏂᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱᏃ ᏙᏓᎨᏥᎵᎥᏂᎵ.
\ft But beware of men: for they will deliver you up to the councils, and they will scourge you in their synagogues;

\ln Ale ayv gesv nvdigalisdodisgesdi nunigvwiyusadegi ale unigvwiyuhi dunolv igvyiditlv detsatinohihesdi, nasgi unvsv ale Tsunadalenvdv yvwi unadolehohisdodi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏚᏃᎸ ᎢᎬᏱᏗᏢ ᏕᏣᏘᏃᎯᎮᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏅᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᎤᎾᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏙᏗ.
\ft And ye shall be brought before governors and kings for my sake, for a testimony against them and the Gentiles.

\ln Aseno hnaquo degetsatinohihesdi tlesdi yitselihisgesdi iyusdi itsineisdiyi ale itsiwesdiyi; nahiyuquoyeno etsinedi gesesdi itsiwesdiyi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎿᏉ ᏕᎨᏣᏘᏃᎯᎮᏍᏗ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏤᎵᎯᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏥᏁᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏥᏪᏍᏗᏱ; ᏀᎢᏳᏉᏰᏃ ᎡᏥᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎢᏥᏪᏍᏗᏱ.
\ft But when they deliver you up, take no thought how or what ye shall speak: for it shall be given you in that same hour what ye shall speak.

\ln Vtlayeno nihi yitsinegoi, Itsidodasgini Udanvdo kanegoi nihi itsvdisgoi.
\syll ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᏂᎯ ᏱᏥᏁᎪᎢ, ᎢᏥᏙᏓᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏓᏅᏙ ᎧᏁᎪᎢ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏨᏗᏍᎪᎢ.
\ft For it is not ye that speak, but the Spirit of your Father which speaketh in you.

\ln Asgayano dodayuyosi uyohuhisdiyi dinadanvtli, agayvligeno uwetsi dodayuyosi, ale oni tsunadvsvhi dodvnatlutani tsunigayvligei, ale nasgi nvdvnvnisani digetsiisdi gesesdi.
\syll ᎠᏍᎦᏯᏃ ᏙᏓᏳᏲᏏ ᎤᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏗᎾᏓᏅᏟ, ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᏃ ᎤᏪᏥ ᏙᏓᏳᏲᏏ, ᎠᎴ ᎣᏂ ᏧᎾᏛᏒᎯ ᏙᏛᎾᏡᏔᏂ ᏧᏂᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏛᏅᏂᏌᏂ ᏗᎨᏥᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft And the brother shall deliver up the brother to death, and the father the child: and the children shall rise up against their parents, and cause them to be put to death.

\ln Ale nanivquo yvwi getsisgagi gesesdi ayv daquadov nvdigalisdodisgesdi; aseno nasgi gvlisquadisgi atlinigvnehi atsisdelvdi gesesdi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏂᎥᏉ ᏴᏫ ᎨᏥᏍᎦᎩ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎠᏴ ᏓᏆᏙᎥ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᎩ ᎠᏟᏂᎬᏁᎯ ᎠᏥᏍᏕᎸᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft And ye shall be hated of all men for my name's sake: but he that endureth to the end shall be saved.

\ln Ale hnaquo uyo nigetsvhnadegesdi ilvhitlv gaduhvi, ilolisgesdi nvwalile digaduhv witsilosgesdi.  Udohiyuhiyayeno hia nitsvweseha, Vtla Isiliyi degaduhvi yigetsedonesdi hnaquo yvwi Uwetsi dagalutsi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎿᏉ ᎤᏲ ᏂᎨᏨᎿᏕᎨᏍᏗ ᎢᎸᎯᏢ ᎦᏚᎲᎢ, ᎢᎶᎵᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏅᏩᎵᎴ ᏗᎦᏚᎲ ᏫᏥᎶᏍᎨᏍᏗ.  ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯᏰᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ, ᎥᏝ ᎢᏏᎵᏱ ᏕᎦᏚᎲᎢ ᏱᎨᏤᏙᏁᏍᏗ ᎿᏉ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᏓᎦᎷᏥ.
\ft But when they persecute you in this city, flee ye into another: for verily I say unto you, Ye shall not have gone over the cities of Israel, till the Son of man be come.

\ln Dideloquasgi vtla utli yinatsilvquodoi esgaquo tsuweyohvsgi, ale atsinvsidasdi vtla utli yinatsilvquodoi svsgaquo unvsidohi.
\syll ᏗᏕᎶᏆᏍᎩ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏟ ᏱᎾᏥᎸᏉᏙᎢ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᏧᏪᏲᎲᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏟ ᏱᎾᏥᎸᏉᏙᎢ ᏒᏍᎦᏉ ᎤᏅᏏᏙᎯ.
\ft The disciple is not above his master, nor the servant above his lord.

\ln Yeliquoyeno dideloquasgi tsuweyohvsgi itsulahaquo yigi, ale atsinvsidasdi unvsidohi itsulahaquo yigi.  Iyuyeno tsudatihnai adanelv Quelitsiqua yunoselv, utli ahidiyu nasgi itsuniwesediyi dudatihnavi.
\syll ᏰᎵᏉᏰᏃ ᏗᏕᎶᏆᏍᎩ ᏧᏪᏲᎲᏍᎩ ᎢᏧᎳᎭᏉ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎤᏅᏏᏙᎯ ᎢᏧᎳᎭᏉ ᏱᎩ.  ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᏧᏓᏘᎿᎢ ᎠᏓᏁᎸ ᏇᎵᏥᏆ ᏳᏃᏎᎸ, ᎤᏟ ᎠᎯᏗᏳ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏧᏂᏪᏎᏗᏱ ᏚᏓᏘᎿᎥᎢ.
\ft It is enough for the disciple that he be as his master, and the servant as his lord. If they have called the master of the house Beelzebub, how much more shall they call them of his household?

\ln Nasgi iyusdi tlesdi yiditsisgaihesdi.  Vtlayeno gohusdi yigvsgala nasgi gvnigesv iyulisdodi nigesvna gesvi, vtla ale gohusdi udelidv yigi nasgi adolehohisdi nigesvna gesvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏗᏥᏍᎦᎢᎮᏍᏗ.  ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏱᎬᏍᎦᎳ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᏱᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Fear them not therefore: for there is nothing covered, that shall not be revealed; and hid, that shall not be known.

\ln Ulisigv itsvnetselvi igagadv itsi negesdi; etsadonvelvno gesv gasanali itsalitsidohvsgesdi.
\syll ᎤᎵᏏᎬ ᎢᏨᏁᏤᎸᎢ ᎢᎦᎦᏛ ᎢᏥ ᏁᎨᏍᏗ; ᎡᏣᏙᏅᎡᎸᏃ ᎨᏒ ᎦᏌᎾᎵ ᎢᏣᎵᏥᏙᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
\ft What I tell you in darkness, that speak ye in light: and what ye hear in the ear, that preach ye upon the housetops.

\ln Ale tlesdi yiditsisgaihesdi ayelvi anihihi, aseno adanvdo gvwanihisdi nigesvna tsigi.  Ugvwiyusesdisgini etsisgaihesdi nasgi digvwahisdi tsigi ayelvi ale adanvdo itsula tsvsginoi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏗᏥᏍᎦᎢᎮᏍᏗ ᎠᏰᎸᎢ ᎠᏂᎯᎯ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎬᏩᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏥᎩ.  ᎤᎬᏫᏳᏎᏍᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᎡᏥᏍᎦᎢᎮᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎬᏩᎯᏍᏗ ᏥᎩ ᎠᏰᎸᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎢᏧᎳ ᏨᏍᎩᏃᎢ.
\ft And fear not them which kill the body, but are not able to kill the soul: but rather fear him which is able to destroy both soul and body in hell.

\ln Tlasgo anitali tsisquaya saquo iyadanvtedi tsunagvwalodi yigi, aseno vtla saquo eladi unvisdi yigi Itsidoda udanvtelvhi nigesvna.
\syll ᏝᏍᎪ ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᏥᏍᏆᏯ ᏌᏉ ᎢᏯᏓᏅᏖᏗ ᏧᎾᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏌᏉ ᎡᎳᏗ ᎤᏅᎢᏍᏗ ᏱᎩ ᎢᏥᏙᏓ ᎤᏓᏅᏖᎸᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.
\ft Are not two sparrows sold for a farthing? and one of them shall not fall on the ground without your Father.

\ln Nasquosgini itsistiyegv itsisgoli nigadiyu diselvhi.
\syll ᎾᏍᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᏥᏍᏘᏰᎬ ᎢᏥᏍᎪᎵ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏗᏎᎸᎯ.
\ft But the very hairs of your head are all numbered.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi tlesdi yitsisgaihesdi; utliyeno nigav ditsagvwalodi nihi esgaquo unitsati tsisquaya.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏥᏍᎦᎢᎮᏍᏗ; ᎤᏟᏰᏃ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏗᏣᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᏂᎯ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏥᏍᏆᏯ.
\ft Fear ye not therefore, ye are of more value than many sparrows.

\ln Giloyeno gvnigesv naquvnehesdi yvwi anigatahvi, nasquo ayv nasgi gvnigesv udatsiyvneli Edoda galvladi ehi agatahvi.
\syll ᎩᎶᏰᏃ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎾᏋᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᏴᏫ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎤᏓᏥᏴᏁᎵ ᎡᏙᏓ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎠᎦᏔᎲᎢ.
\ft Whosoever therefore shall confess me before men, him will I confess also before my Father which is in heaven.

\ln Gilosgini iaquadayihesdi yvwi anigatahvi, nasquo ayv nasgi datsiyadayili Edoda galvladi ehi agatahvi.
\syll ᎩᎶᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᎠᏆᏓᏱᎮᏍᏗ ᏴᏫ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏓᏥᏯᏓᏱᎵ ᎡᏙᏓ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎠᎦᏔᎲᎢ.
\ft But whosoever shall deny me before men, him will I also deny before my Father which is in heaven.

\ln Tlesdi dohiyi unanugowisilv elohi, yisgiyelisehesdi; vtlasgini dohiyi yaginanugowisilv, ayelasdisgini ganvhidv.
\syll ᏞᏍᏗ ᏙᎯᏱ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏫᏏᎸ ᎡᎶᎯ, ᏱᏍᎩᏰᎵᏎᎮᏍᏗ; ᎥᏝᏍᎩᏂ ᏙᎯᏱ ᏯᎩᎾᏄᎪᏫᏏᎸ, ᎠᏰᎳᏍᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᎦᏅᎯᏛ.
\ft Think not that I am come to send peace on earth: I came not to send peace, but a sword.

\ln Ayvyeno agilutsilv, dinadasgagi iyulisdodiyi asgaya udodano, ale aganvgi ageyv utsino, ale udatsohiya utsohino;
\syll ᎠᏴᏰᏃ ᎠᎩᎷᏥᎸ, ᏗᎾᏓᏍᎦᎩ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᏙᏓᏃ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎦᏅᎩ ᎠᎨᏴ ᎤᏥᏃ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᏦᎯᏯ ᎤᏦᎯᏃ;
\ft For I am come to set a man at variance against his father, and the daughter against her mother, and the daughter in law against her mother in law.

\ln Gilono uwasvquo dudatihnav gvwasgagi gesesdi.
\syll ᎩᎶᏃ ᎤᏩᏒᏉ ᏚᏓᏘᎿᎥ ᎬᏩᏍᎦᎩ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft And a man's foes shall be they of his own household.

\ln Gilono utli nugeyusesdi udoda ale utsi esgaquo ayv nagigeyusesdi, vtla yeli nasgi ayv aquatseli igvwalisdodi yigesesdi.  Gilono utli nugeyusesdi uwetsi asgaya ale uwetsi ageyv esgaquo ayv nagigeyusesdi, vtla yeli nasgi ayv aquatseli igvwalisdodi yigesesdi.
\syll ᎩᎶᏃ ᎤᏟ ᏄᎨᏳᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᏙᏓ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏥ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎠᏴ ᎾᎩᎨᏳᏎᏍᏗ, ᎥᏝ ᏰᎵ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᎠᏆᏤᎵ ᎢᎬᏩᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ.  ᎩᎶᏃ ᎤᏟ ᏄᎨᏳᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎠᎨᏴ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎠᏴ ᎾᎩᎨᏳᏎᏍᏗ, ᎥᏝ ᏰᎵ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᎠᏆᏤᎵ ᎢᎬᏩᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft He that loveth father or mother more than me is not worthy of me: and he that loveth son or daughter more than me is not worthy of me.

\ln Gilo nayisgvna igesesdi utseli tsudahnawadv ale nagisdawadegvna igesesdi, vtla yeli ayv aquatseli igvwalisdodi yigesesdi.
\syll ᎩᎶ ᎾᏱᏍᎬᎾ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏧᏓᎿᏩᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎾᎩᏍᏓᏩᏕᎬᎾ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎥᏝ ᏰᎵ ᎠᏴ ᎠᏆᏤᎵ ᎢᎬᏩᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft And he that taketh not his cross, and followeth after me, is not worthy of me.

\ln Gilono gvnv iawatisgesdi, nasgi uyohusedi gesesdi; gilono iuyohusehesdi gvnv ayv nvdigalisdodisgesdi, nasgi uwadvdi gesesdi.
\syll ᎩᎶᏃ ᎬᏅ ᎢᎠᏩᏘᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏲᎱᏎᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᎩᎶᏃ ᎢᎤᏲᎱᏎᎮᏍᏗ ᎬᏅ ᎠᏴ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏩᏛᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft He that findeth his life shall lose it: and he that loseth his life for my sake shall find it.

\ln Gilono detsadanilvgesdi, nasgi ayv daquadanilvgesdi; gilono ayv daquadanilvgesdi, nasgi dadanilvgesdi nvdvginvsvhi
\syll ᎩᎶᏃ ᏕᏣᏓᏂᎸᎨᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᏓᏆᏓᏂᎸᎨᏍᏗ; ᎩᎶᏃ ᎠᏴ ᏓᏆᏓᏂᎸᎨᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏓᏓᏂᎸᎨᏍᏗ ᏅᏛᎩᏅᏒᎯ
\ft He that receiveth you receiveth me, and he that receiveth me receiveth him that sent me.

\ln Gilono dadanilvgesdi adolehosgi adolehosgi gesv udigalisdodigesdi, adolehosgi agaguyvdanedi gesv nasgi agaguyvdanehesdi; gilono dadanilvgesdi udanvti asgaya udanvti gesv udigalisdo disgesdi, udanvti asgaya agaguyvdanedi gesv nasgi agaguyvdanehesdi.
\syll ᎩᎶᏃ ᏓᏓᏂᎸᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎠᎦᎫᏴᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎦᎫᏴᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ; ᎩᎶᏃ ᏓᏓᏂᎸᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᏓᏅᏘ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᏓᏅᏘ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙ ᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎤᏓᏅᏘ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎠᎦᎫᏴᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎦᎫᏴᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ.
\ft He that receiveth a prophet in the name of a prophet shall receive a prophet's reward; and he that receiveth a righteous man in the name of a righteous man shall receive a righteous man's reward.

\ln Gilono saquo hia tsunasdi gesvi ulisquidiquo akalii uyvdla ama ahuvsgesdi agisdawadidohi gesv nvdigalisdodisgesdi, udohiyuhiya nitsvweseha, vtla nasgi uyohusedi yigesesdi agaguyvedi gesvi.
\syll ᎩᎶᏃ ᏌᏉ ᎯᎠ ᏧᎾᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ ᎤᎵᏍᏈᏗᏉ ᎠᎧᎵᎢ ᎤᏴᏜ ᎠᎹ ᎠᎱᎥᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᎩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ, ᎥᏝ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏲᎱᏎᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎠᎦᎫᏴᎡᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft And whosoever shall give to drink unto one of these little ones a cup of cold water only in the name of a disciple, verily I say unto you, he shall in no wise lose his reward.

\ln Hiano nulistanvgi; Tsisa usquadv dekanetsehv taladu iyanidv gvwasdawadidohi, unigisvgi nahnani, dudeyousvgi ale ulitsidonvsvgi duniduhnavi.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎩ; ᏥᏌ ᎤᏍᏆᏛ ᏕᎧᏁᏤᎲ ᏔᎳᏚ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ, ᎤᏂᎩᏒᎩ ᏀᎾᏂ, ᏚᏕᏲᎤᏒᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏥᏙᏅᏒᎩ ᏚᏂᏚᎿᎥᎢ.
\ft And it came to pass, when Jesus had made an end of commanding his twelve disciples, he departed thence to teach and to preach in their cities.

\ln Hnaquono Tsani tsatsisduhv tsudvganv nusdv dulvwisdanehv Galonedv, dotsunvse anitali gvwasdawadidohi,
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏣᏂ ᏣᏥᏍᏚᎲ ᏧᏛᎦᏅ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ, ᏙᏧᏅᏎ ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ,
\ft Now when John had heard in the prison the works of Christ, he sent two of his disciples,

\ln Hia nvdayuweselvgi; Nihisgo na uluhisdi tsigi, tsigoge nvwadale otsigatenohesdi?
\syll ᎯᎠ ᏅᏓᏳᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏂᎯᏍᎪ Ꮎ ᎤᎷᎯᏍᏗ ᏥᎩ, ᏥᎪᎨ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᎣᏥᎦᏖᏃᎮᏍᏗ?
\ft And said unto him, Art thou he that should come, or do we look for another?

\ln Tsisano unetsv hia niduweselvgi; tsisdena Tsani wiesdinohvsi nigav isdadvgisgvi ale isdigowatisgvi:
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏥᏍᏕᎾ ᏣᏂ ᏫᎡᏍᏗᏃᎲᏏ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎢᏍᏓᏛᎩᏍᎬᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏍᏗᎪᏩᏘᏍᎬᎢ:
\ft Jesus answered and said unto them, Go and shew John again those things which ye do hear and see:

\ln Dinigewi anigowatiha, diniyoulino anedoha, adayesgi tsunitlvgi dunadiwasga, tsunilienano anadvgiha, tsuniyohusvhino degegalediha uyono iyunadvhnadegi osdv kanohedv igegalitsidoneha.
\syll ᏗᏂᎨᏫ ᎠᏂᎪᏩᏘᎭ, ᏗᏂᏲᎤᎵᏃ ᎠᏁᏙᎭ, ᎠᏓᏰᏍᎩ ᏧᏂᏢᎩ ᏚᎾᏗᏩᏍᎦ, ᏧᏂᎵᎡᎾᏃ ᎠᎾᏛᎩᎭ, ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯᏃ ᏕᎨᎦᎴᏗᎭ ᎤᏲᏃ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᎿᏕᎩ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎢᎨᎦᎵᏥᏙᏁᎭ.
\ft The blind receive their sight, and the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, and the deaf hear, the dead are raised up, and the poor have the gospel preached to them.

\ln Ale osiyu iyulisdanedi giloniditsiyodesdisgvna igesesdi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎩᎶᏂᏗᏥᏲᏕᏍᏗᏍᎬᎾ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft And blessed is he, whosoever shall not be offended in me.

\ln Iunenvno Tsisa ulenvhvgi hia niduweselvgi unitsati Tsani dunohedanelvgi; Gado itsagatanvse inagei?  Wasonasgo unole utelvhesgvi?
\syll ᎢᎤᏁᏅᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎤᎴᏅᎲᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏣᏂ ᏚᏃᎮᏓᏁᎸᎩ; ᎦᏙ ᎢᏣᎦᏔᏅᏎ ᎢᎾᎨᎢ?  ᏩᏐᎾᏍᎪ ᎤᏃᎴ ᎤᏖᎸᎮᏍᎬᎢ?
\ft And as they departed, Jesus began to say unto the multitudes concerning John, What went ye out into the wilderness to see? A reed shaken with the wind?

\ln Gadoge itsagatanvsei?  Asgayasgo diwanage tsunuwai?  Gvniyuquo diwanage tsunanuwai unigvwiyuhi daninelv anehoi.
\syll ᎦᏙᎨ ᎢᏣᎦᏔᏅᏎᎢ?  ᎠᏍᎦᏯᏍᎪ ᏗᏩᎾᎨ ᏧᏄᏩᎢ?  ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᏗᏩᎾᎨ ᏧᎾᏄᏩᎢ ᎤᏂᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏓᏂᏁᎸ ᎠᏁᎰᎢ.
\ft But what went ye out for to see? A man clothed in soft raiment? behold, they that wear soft clothing are in kings' houses.

\ln Gadoge itsagatanvsei?  Adolehosgisgo?  Vv, itsvyoseha, ale utlihiyu esgaquo adolehosgi.
\syll ᎦᏙᎨ ᎢᏣᎦᏔᏅᏎᎢ?  ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩᏍᎪ?  ᎥᎥ, ᎢᏨᏲᏎᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏟᎯᏳ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ.
\ft But what went ye out for to see? A prophet? yea, I say unto you, and more than a prophet.

\ln Nasgisgini hia na gegowelv hia atsinohelvsgv tsinigvnv; Gvniyuquo, tsinvli tsinvsidasdi tsakadv igvyiditlv, nasgi datsadvnvisdaneli tsalohisdiyi igvyiditlv.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ ᎯᎠ Ꮎ ᎨᎪᏪᎸ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏥᏃᎮᎸᏍᎬ ᏥᏂᎬᏅ; ᎬᏂᏳᏉ, ᏥᏅᎵ ᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᏣᎧᏛ ᎢᎬᏱᏗᏢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏓᏣᏛᏅᎢᏍᏓᏁᎵ ᏣᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎢᎬᏱᏗᏢ.
\ft For this is he, of whom it is written, Behold, I send my messenger before thy face, which shall prepare thy way before thee.

\ln Udohiyuhiya hia nitsvweseha, Anigeyv gvwaninanugowisvhi tsigi vtla gilo yunanugotsv gvwadalinehidedi Tsani didawosgi; aseno usdikani galvladi ehi ugvwiyuhi gesv utli atsilvquodiyu esgaquo tsani.
\syll ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ, ᎠᏂᎨᏴ ᎬᏩᏂᎾᏄᎪᏫᏒᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᏳᎾᏄᎪᏨ ᎬᏩᏓᎵᏁᎯᏕᏗ ᏣᏂ ᏗᏓᏬᏍᎩ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏍᏗᎧᏂ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏟ ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᏣᏂ.
\ft Verily I say unto you, Among them that are born of women there hath not risen a greater than John the Baptist: notwithstanding he that is least in the kingdom of heaven is greater than he.

\ln Tsanino didawosgi unanugotsv nvdagvwadalenvdv gohi iyasti galvladi ehi ugvwiyuhi gesv ananelugieha, ananelugisgino gvsgaisdagi daniniyiha.
\syll ᏣᏂᏃ ᏗᏓᏬᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏨ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎪᎯ ᎢᏯᏍᏘ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎾᏁᎷᎩᎡᎭ, ᎠᎾᏁᎷᎩᏍᎩᏃ ᎬᏍᎦᎢᏍᏓᎩ ᏓᏂᏂᏱᎭ.
\ft And from the days of John the Baptist until now the kingdom of heaven suffereth violence, and the violent take it by force.

\ln Nanivyeno anadolehosgi ale dikahnawadvsdi anadolehosgvgi Tsani unanugotsilv iyasti.
\syll ᎾᏂᎥᏰᏃ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎬᎩ ᏣᏂ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏥᎸ ᎢᏯᏍᏘ.
\ft For all the prophets and the law prophesied until John.

\ln Iyuno digetsadanilvisdi gesesdi, nasgi hia Ilaya uluhisdi tsigesvgi.
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᏗᎨᏣᏓᏂᎸᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎢᎳᏯ ᎤᎷᎯᏍᏗ ᏥᎨᏒᎩ.
\ft And if ye will receive it, this is Elias, which was for to come.

\ln Gilo degalilugesdi udvgodiyi nasgi advgisgesdi.
\syll ᎩᎶ ᏕᎦᎵᎷᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᏛᎪᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏛᎩᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
\ft He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.

\ln Gadoge dodagatsiyatlilostani hia gohi tsaneha?  Diniyoliquo nasgiya ganododiyi tsaninoi ale tsiwidaniyanisgo unedasdi;
\syll ᎦᏙᎨ ᏙᏓᎦᏥᏯᏟᎶᏍᏔᏂ ᎯᎠ ᎪᎯ ᏣᏁᎭ?  ᏗᏂᏲᎵᏉ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎦᏃᏙᏗᏱ ᏣᏂᏃᎢ ᎠᎴ ᏥᏫᏓᏂᏯᏂᏍᎪ ᎤᏁᏓᏍᏗ;
\ft But whereunto shall I liken this generation? It is like unto children sitting in the markets, and calling unto their fellows,

\ln Ale hia tsinidaniwesehoi; atselugi ogvtanv detsvnogielv, aseno vtla yitsalisgisv; dotsiyvgvgi itsadvgodi, aseno vtla yiditsatloyilv.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᏓᏂᏪᏎᎰᎢ; ᎠᏤᎷᎩ ᎣᎬᏔᏅ ᏕᏨᏃᎩᎡᎸ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏣᎵᏍᎩᏒ; ᏙᏥᏴᎬᎩ ᎢᏣᏛᎪᏗ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏗᏣᏠᏱᎸ.
\ft And saying, We have piped unto you, and ye have not danced; we have mourned unto you, and ye have not lamented.

\ln Tsaniyeno ulutsvgi vtla yalisdayvhvsgei ale vtla yaditasgei, aseno nianiweha; Asgina uyaa.
\syll ᏣᏂᏰᏃ ᎤᎷᏨᎩ ᎥᏝ ᏯᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎨᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᏯᏗᏔᏍᎨᎢ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᏂᎠᏂᏪᎭ; ᎠᏍᎩᎾ ᎤᏯᎠ.
\ft For John came neither eating nor drinking, and they say, He hath a devil.

\ln Yvwi uwetsi ulutsv alisdayvhvsga ale aditasga, hiano nianiweha; Gvniyuquo asgaya ugvvsgi alisdayvdi ale gigageaditasdi, adelv anigisidohi ale anisdena unalii.  Aseno agatahnai tsuwetsi osiyu igvwayelvha.
\syll ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎤᎷᏨ ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎦ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏗᏔᏍᎦ, ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᎠᏂᏪᎭ; ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᎬᎥᏍᎩ ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎩᎦᎨᎠᏗᏔᏍᏗ, ᎠᏕᎸ ᎠᏂᎩᏏᏙᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏍᏕᎾ ᎤᎾᎵᎢ.  ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᎦᏔᎿᎢ ᏧᏪᏥ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᎬᏩᏰᎸᎭ.
\ft The Son of man came eating and drinking, and they say, Behold a man gluttonous, and a winebibber, a friend of publicans and sinners. But wisdom is justified of her children.

\ln Hnaquono ulenvhvgi dugvsgolvnvgi duniduhvi nahna utli igai usquanigodi dulvwisdanelvi, nvdagalisdodisgvgi dunadanvdv niduninetliyvsvna gesvi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎤᎴᏅᎲᎩ ᏚᎬᏍᎪᎸᏅᎩ ᏚᏂᏚᎲᎢ ᏀᎾ ᎤᏟ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸᎢ, ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᏚᎾᏓᏅᏛ ᏂᏚᏂᏁᏟᏴᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Then began he to upbraid the cities wherein most of his mighty works were done, because they repented not:

\ln Uyoiyu itsalisdanedi Golesini, uyoiyu itsalisdanedi Quetsayidi; iyuyeno usquanigodi degalvwisdanelv nihi itsehv yidogalvwisdanele Taya ale Sadoni, gohigi digvwaninetliyvdv yigese dunadanvdvi, tsusidena yidunanuwoe ale gosdu yunadanvliyeei.
\syll ᎤᏲᎢᏳ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎪᎴᏏᏂ, ᎤᏲᎢᏳ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᏇᏣᏱᏗ; ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᏕᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏤᎲ ᏱᏙᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎴ ᏔᏯ ᎠᎴ ᏌᏙᏂ, ᎪᎯᎩ ᏗᎬᏩᏂᏁᏟᏴᏛ ᏱᎨᏎ ᏚᎾᏓᏅᏛᎢ, ᏧᏏᏕᎾ ᏱᏚᎾᏄᏬᎡ ᎠᎴ ᎪᏍᏚ ᏳᎾᏓᏅᎵᏰᎡᎢ.
\ft Woe unto thee, Chorazin! woe unto thee, Bethsaida! for if the mighty works, which were done in you, had been done in Tyre and Sidon, they would have repented long ago in sackcloth and ashes.

\ln Aseno hia nitsvweseha; esgaquo igai unigiliyoisdi gesesdi Taya ale Sadoni, digugododiyi iga gesesdi, utlihiyu nihi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ; ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎤᏂᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏔᏯ ᎠᎴ ᏌᏙᏂ, ᏗᎫᎪᏙᏗᏱ ᎢᎦ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎤᏟᎯᏳ ᏂᎯ.
\ft But I say unto you, It shall be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon at the day of judgment, than for you.

\ln Nihino Gequani galvladi iyvdv tsetsasalada, tsvsginoi wvdayelovtani; iyuyeno usquanigodi degalvwisdanelv nihi itsehv yidogalvwisdanele Sodamiyi, asi gohi gesv yinigvwasdequo.
\syll ᏂᎯᏃ ᎨᏆᏂ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏤᏣᏌᎳᏓ, ᏨᏍᎩᏃᎢ ᏮᏓᏰᎶᎥᏔᏂ; ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᏕᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏤᎲ ᏱᏙᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎴ ᏐᏓᎻᏱ, ᎠᏏ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏱᏂᎬᏩᏍᏕᏉ.
\ft And thou, Capernaum, which art exalted unto heaven, shalt be brought down to hell: for if the mighty works, which have been done in thee, had been done in Sodom, it would have remained until this day.

\ln Aseno hia nitsvweseha; Esgaquo igai unigiliyoisdi gesesdi Solimi digugododiyi iga gesesdi, utlihiyu nihi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ; ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎤᏂᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏐᎵᎻ ᏗᎫᎪᏙᏗᏱ ᎢᎦ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎤᏟᎯᏳ ᏂᎯ.
\ft But I say unto you, That it shall be more tolerable for the land of Sodom in the day of judgment, than for thee.

\ln Nahiyu Tsisa unetsv hia nuwesvgi; Gvyalielitseha Edoda, Tsagvwiyuhi galvladi ale elohi, nasgi hia tsidehvsgalanelv anisinasani ale aneyatahi, diniyolino tsidehinanugowiselv.
\syll ᏀᎢᏳ ᏥᏌ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎬᏯᎵᎡᎵᏤᎭ ᎡᏙᏓ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎡᎶᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏕᎲᏍᎦᎳᏁᎸ ᎠᏂᏏᎾᏌᏂ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏁᏯᏔᎯ, ᏗᏂᏲᎵᏃ ᏥᏕᎯᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᎸ.
\ft At that time Jesus answered and said, I thank thee, O Father, Lord of heaven and earth, because thou hast hid these things from the wise and prudent, and hast revealed them unto babes.

\ln Vv, Edoda, nasgiyeno osiyu tsayelvnvhi.
\syll ᎥᎥ, ᎡᏙᏓ, ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎣᏏᏳ ᏣᏰᎸᏅᎯ.
\ft Even so, Father: for so it seemed good in thy sight.

\ln Nigav gohusdi dagiyohiselv Edoda, ale vtla gilo yagataha Uwetsi Udodaquo uwasv; vtla ale gilo yagataha agayvligei Uwetsi uwasv, gilono nasgi tsinanugowisi ela Uwetsi.
\syll ᏂᎦᎥ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏓᎩᏲᎯᏎᎸ ᎡᏙᏓ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᏯᎦᏔᎭ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎤᏙᏓᏉ ᎤᏩᏒ; ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᏯᎦᏔᎭ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎤᏩᏒ, ᎩᎶᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᎾᏄᎪᏫᏏ ᎡᎳ ᎤᏪᏥ.

\ft For my yoke is easy, and my burden is light.

\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏ ᎤᎾᏙᎴᎰᏒ ᎯᎠ ᏅᎬᏩᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎢᎬᏛᏁᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎤᎾᏙᏓᏆᏍᎬ ᎢᎦ ᎾᎾᏛᏁ ᎨᏣᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ.

\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏝᏍᎪ ᏱᏥᎪᎵᏰᎣ ᏕᏫ ᏄᏛᏁᎸ ᎠᎪᏄ ᏧᏲᏏᏍᎨ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏁᎯ,

\syll ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎠᏓᏁᎸ ᏧᏴᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎦᏙᏗ ᎦᏚ ᏧᎨᎢ, ᏰᎵ ᎬᏩᎩᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏥᎨᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏁᎯ, ᎠᏥᎸᏍᎩᏂᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᎤᏅᏒ?

\syll ᏝᏍᎪ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏱᏥᎪᎵᏰᎣ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᏙᏓᏆᏍᎬ ᎢᎦ ᎤᏛᎾ ᏗᎦᏔᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᏥᎸᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᎤᎾᏙᏓᏆᏍᎬ ᎠᏂᏲᏍᏗᏍᎬ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏍᎦᏅᏨᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ?
\ft Or have ye not read in the law, how that on the sabbath days the priests in the temple profane the sabbath, and are blameless?

\ln Aseno hia nitsvweseha; ani edoha utli atsilvquodiyu esgaquo udvna digalawiisdiyi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ; ᎠᏂ ᎡᏙᎭ ᎤᏟ ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎤᏛᎾ ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ.

\syll ᏱᏥᎦᏙᎥᏎᏍᎩᏂ ᎦᏛᎬ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏂᎦᏪᎠ, ᎠᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏆᏚᎵᎭ, ᎥᏝᏃ ᎠᏥᎸᎨᎳᏍᏗᏱ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎤᏂᏍᎦᏅᏨᎯ ᏱᏙᎨᏥᏰᎸᏁ ᏄᏂᏍᎦᏅᏨᎾ.

\ln Yvwiyeno Uwetsi Ugvwiyuhi nasquo unadodaquasgv iga.
\syll ᏴᏫᏰᏃ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᎾᏙᏓᏆᏍᎬ ᎢᎦ.
\ft For the Son of man is Lord even of the sabbath day.

\ln Nahnano iudanvsv, tsunilawiisdiyi wuyvlvgi.
\syll ᏀᎾᏃ ᎢᎤᏓᏅᏒ, ᏧᏂᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᏭᏴᎸᎩ.

\ln Gvniyuquono edohvgi asgaya uwoyeni uwaiselvhi.  Gvwadvdvnvgino hia nuniwesvgi; tsigo yeliquo gvdanvwodi unadodaquasgvi; gvwayilidasdiyi unadulisgvgi.
\syll ᎬᏂᏳᏉᏃ ᎡᏙᎲᎩ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᏬᏰᏂ ᎤᏩᎢᏎᎸᎯ.  ᎬᏩᏛᏛᏅᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᏥᎪ ᏰᎵᏉ ᎬᏓᏅᏬᏗ ᎤᎾᏙᏓᏆᏍᎬᎢ; ᎬᏩᏱᎵᏓᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᎾᏚᎵᏍᎬᎩ.
\ft And, behold, there was a man which had his hand withered. And they asked him, saying, Is it lawful to heal on the sabbath days? that they might accuse him.

\ln Hiano niduweselvgi; Tsigo asgaya udasuya itsehvi, iyuno saquo awi unodena yunatlaa, atalesvno yulvtsv unadodaquasgvi, nasgi wuniyvdi ale wulesdi nigesvna?
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏥᎪ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᏓᏑᏯ ᎢᏤᎲᎢ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᏌᏉ ᎠᏫ ᎤᏃᏕᎾ ᏳᎾᏝᎠ, ᎠᏔᎴᏒᏃ ᏳᎸᏨ ᎤᎾᏙᏓᏆᏍᎬᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏭᏂᏴᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏭᎴᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ?
\ft And he said unto them, What man shall there be among you, that shall have one sheep, and if it fall into a pit on the sabbath day, will he not lay hold on it, and lift it out?

\ln Nigavsgini utlihiyu atsilvquodiyu yvwi esgaquo awi unodena.  Nasgisgini iyusdi yeliquo osdv digalvwisdanedi unadodaquasgv iga.
\syll ᏂᎦᎥᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏟᎯᏳ ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᏴᏫ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎠᏫ ᎤᏃᏕᎾ.  ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏰᎵᏉ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎤᎾᏙᏓᏆᏍᎬ ᎢᎦ.
\ft How much then is a man better than a sheep? Wherefore it is lawful to do well on the sabbath days.

\ln Hnaquono hia nuweselv asgaya; Hadoyanvhida; udoyanvhidvgino.  Ale udiwasvgi, nasgiya soi nusdv nulistanvgi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ; ᎭᏙᏯᏅᎯᏓ; ᎤᏙᏯᏅᎯᏛᎩᏃ.  ᎠᎴ ᎤᏗᏩᏒᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏐᎢ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎩ.
\ft Then saith he to the man, Stretch forth thine hand. And he stretched it forth; and it was restored whole, like as the other.

\ln Hnaquono Aniqualisi uninugotsv uninohelv iyunvnediyi unihisdiyi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏ ᎤᏂᏄᎪᏨ ᎤᏂᏃᎮᎸ ᎢᏳᏅᏁᏗᏱ ᎤᏂᎯᏍᏗᏱ.

\ln Aseno Tsisa udolehosv nahna udanvsvgi; unitsatino gvwasdawadvsvgi; ale nigadv dunvwanvgi,
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎤᏙᎴᎰᏒ ᏀᎾ ᎤᏓᏅᏒᎩ; ᎤᏂᏣᏘᏃ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏛᏒᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏚᏅᏩᏅᎩ,

\ln Ale dunvsdadelv gvnigesv igvwanediyi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏚᏅᏍᏓᏕᎸ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᎬᏩᏁᏗᏱ.
\ft And charged them that they should not make him known:

\ln Udohiyudiyi ayelvsvgi Isaya adolehosgi tsunetsei, hia tsinuwesei;
\syll ᎤᏙᎯᏳᏗᏱ ᎠᏰᎸᏒᎩ ᎢᏌᏯ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᏧᏁᏤᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏥᏄᏪᏎᎢ;
\ft That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Esaias the prophet, saying,

\ln Gvniyuquo tsinvsidasdi tsiyasuyedv tsigeyui diquadanvdv iyvdv osdv tsiyelvi; datsineli aquadanvdo, ale Tsunadalenvdv yvwi duyugodv tsunanugowisedi gesesdi.
\syll ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᏥᏯᏑᏰᏛ ᏥᎨᏳᎢ ᏗᏆᏓᏅᏛ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏥᏰᎸᎢ; ᏓᏥᏁᎵ ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏙ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᏧᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft Behold my servant, whom I have chosen; my beloved, in whom my soul is well pleased: I will put my spirit upon him, and he shall shew judgment to the Gentiles.

\syll ᎥᏝ ᏧᏘᏲᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏪᎷᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏛᎦᏁᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎧᏁᎬ ᏕᎦᎳᏅᏛᎢ.
\ft He shall not strive, nor cry; neither shall any man hear his voice in the streets.

\ln Wasona uyedawotsvhi vtla tsusqualisdi yigesesdi, ale doledv tsugasvsdi vtla uwadladisdi yigesesdi, gvni adalinehidonvha duyugodv gesv dayelihisdisgvi.
\syll ᏩᏐᎾ ᎤᏰᏓᏬᏨᎯ ᎥᏝ ᏧᏍᏆᎵᏍᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏙᎴᏛ ᏧᎦᏒᏍᏗ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏩᏜᏗᏍᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎬᏂ ᎠᏓᎵᏁᎯᏙᏅᎭ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒ ᏓᏰᎵᎯᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ.
\ft A bruised reed shall he not break, and smoking flax shall he not quench, till he send forth judgment unto victory.

\ln Ale dudov Tsunadalenvdv yvwi analisgasdodisgesdi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏚᏙᎥ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᎠᎾᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
\ft And in his name shall the Gentiles trust.

\ln Hnaquono agatinohelvgi asgina uyai digewi ale uwagewi, ale unvwanvgi; nasgino digewi ale uwagewi uwonisvgi ale ugohvgi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎠᎦᏘᏃᎮᎸᎩ ᎠᏍᎩᎾ ᎤᏯᎢ ᏗᎨᏫ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏩᎨᏫ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏅᏩᏅᎩ; ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏗᎨᏫ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏩᎨᏫ ᎤᏬᏂᏒᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎪᎲᎩ.

\ln Nigadvno yvwi unisquanigosvgi, hia nuniwesvgi; Tlasgo hia Dewi Uwetsi yigi?
\syll ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏒᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᏝᏍᎪ ᎯᎠ ᏕᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᏱᎩ?
\ft And all the people were amazed, and said, Is not this the son of David?

\ln Aseno Aniqualisi unadvganv, hia nuniwesvgi; Hia vtla anisgina yidiganugowisga gvni tsusdelisgo Quelitsiqua ugvwiyuhi anisgina unatseliga.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᎯᎠ ᎥᏝ ᎠᏂᏍᎩᎾ ᏱᏗᎦᏄᎪᏫᏍᎦ ᎬᏂ ᏧᏍᏕᎵᏍᎪ ᏇᎵᏥᏆ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᏂᏍᎩᎾ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ.
\ft But when the Pharisees heard it, they said, This fellow doth not cast out devils, but by Beelzebub the prince of the devils.

\ln Ale tsisa agatahv nusdv anadanvtesgvi, hia niduweselvgi; Nigav ayeli gotlvsvi tali tsinadadisgo uwasvquo tsadatludisgo ayogoquo; ale nigav gaduhv ale adanelv tali tsinadadisgo uwasvquo tsadatludisgo vtla yinigvwasdoquo.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏥᏌ ᎠᎦᏔᎲ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎠᎾᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏂᎦᎥ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎪᏢᏒᎢ ᏔᎵ ᏥᎾᏓᏗᏍᎪ ᎤᏩᏒᏉ ᏣᏓᏡᏗᏍᎪ ᎠᏲᎪᏉ; ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎦᏚᎲ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏓᏁᎸ ᏔᎵ ᏥᎾᏓᏗᏍᎪ ᎤᏩᏒᏉ ᏣᏓᏡᏗᏍᎪ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏂᎬᏩᏍᏙᏉ.
\ft And Jesus knew their thoughts, and said unto them, Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation; and every city or house divided against itself shall not stand:

\ln Iyu ale Sedani Sedani yiganugowisga, tali nadadisgoi uwasvquo adatludisgoi; gadono yigalisdoda yinigvwasdiquo utseligohi?
\syll ᎢᏳ ᎠᎴ ᏎᏓᏂ ᏎᏓᏂ ᏱᎦᏄᎪᏫᏍᎦ, ᏔᎵ ᎾᏓᏗᏍᎪᎢ ᎤᏩᏒᏉ ᎠᏓᏡᏗᏍᎪᎢ; ᎦᏙᏃ ᏱᎦᎵᏍᏙᏓ ᏱᏂᎬᏩᏍᏗᏉ ᎤᏤᎵᎪᎯ?
\ft And if Satan cast out Satan, he is divided against himself; how shall then his kingdom stand?

\ln Iyuno ayv Quelitsiqua yagisdeli anisgina yiditsinugowisga, gago unisdelisgo ditsetsi tsidaninugowisgoi?  Nasgisgini digetsugodanehi gesesdi.
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᎠᏴ ᏇᎵᏥᏆ ᏯᎩᏍᏕᎵ ᎠᏂᏍᎩᎾ ᏱᏗᏥᏄᎪᏫᏍᎦ, ᎦᎪ ᎤᏂᏍᏕᎵᏍᎪ ᏗᏤᏥ ᏥᏓᏂᏄᎪᏫᏍᎪᎢ?  ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ ᏗᎨᏧᎪᏓᏁᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft And if I by Beelzebub cast out devils, by whom do your children cast them out? therefore they shall be your judges.

\ln Iyusgini ayv Unelanvhi Udanvdo yigvdi anisgina yiditsinugowisga, hnaquosgini galvladi ehi ugvwiyuhi gesv itsilutselv.
\syll ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏓᏅᏙ ᏱᎬᏗ ᎠᏂᏍᎩᎾ ᏱᏗᏥᏄᎪᏫᏍᎦ, ᎿᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏥᎷᏤᎸ.
\ft But if I cast out devils by the Spirit of God, then the kingdom of God is come unto you.

\ln Ale gado yadvga gilo ulinigidv asgaya ganelv yayvha ale uhnav yawonv, iyuno igvyi nulvlvna yigi nasgi ulinigidv asgaya?  Gila hnaquo yawonv ganelvi uhnavi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎦᏙ ᏯᏛᎦ ᎩᎶ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎦᏁᎸ ᏯᏴᎭ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎿᎥ ᏯᏬᏅ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎢᎬᏱ ᏄᎸᎸᎾ ᏱᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ?  ᎩᎳ ᎿᏉ ᏯᏬᏅ ᎦᏁᎸᎢ ᎤᎿᎥᎢ.
\ft Or else how can one enter into a strong man's house, and spoil his goods, except he first bind the strong man? and then he will spoil his house.

\ln Gilo naqualigonehvna, nasgi aquatludiha; gilono nosditlisisgvna, nasgi yadigaleyasga.
\syll ᎩᎶ ᎾᏆᎵᎪᏁᎲᎾ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏆᏡᏗᎭ; ᎩᎶᏃ ᏃᏍᏗᏟᏏᏍᎬᎾ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏯᏗᎦᎴᏯᏍᎦ.
\ft He that is not with me is against me; and he that gathereth not with me scattereth abroad.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi hia nitsvweseha; nigav nudalesv asganvisdi gesv ale asotlvdodi gesv getsidolisdiquo gesesdi yvwi; Galvquodiyusgini Adanvdo asotlvdodi gesv vtla getsidolisdi yigesesdi yvwi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ; ᏂᎦᎥ ᏄᏓᎴᏒ ᎠᏍᎦᏅᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏐᏢᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎨᏥᏙᎵᏍᏗᏉ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏴᏫ; ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎠᏐᏢᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎥᏝ ᎨᏥᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏴᏫ.
\ft Wherefore I say unto you, All manner of sin and blasphemy shall be forgiven unto men: but the blasphemy against the Holy Ghost shall not be forgiven unto men.

\ln Ale gilo gawonisgv atludisgesdi yvwi Uwetsi, atsidolisdiquo gesesdi; gilosgini gawonisgv atludisgesdi Galvquodiyu Adanvdo, vtla atsidolisdi yigesesdi gohi gesv ale nasquo soiyi digesvi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᎦᏬᏂᏍᎬ ᎠᏡᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ, ᎠᏥᏙᎵᏍᏗᏉ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᎩᎶᏍᎩᏂ ᎦᏬᏂᏍᎬ ᎠᏡᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᏥᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏐᎢᏱ ᏗᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft And whosoever speaketh a word against the Son of man, it shall be forgiven him: but whosoever speaketh against the Holy Ghost, it shall not be forgiven him, neither in this world, neither in the world to come.

\ln Tlugv osdv nitsvga udvno osdv, ale tlugv usonv nitsvga udvno usonvi; tlugvyeno golisdodi geso nusdv udvi.
\syll ᏡᎬ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏂᏨᎦ ᎤᏛᏃ ᎣᏍᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᏡᎬ ᎤᏐᏅ ᏂᏨᎦ ᎤᏛᏃ ᎤᏐᏅᎢ; ᏡᎬᏰᏃ ᎪᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏐ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎤᏛᎢ.
\ft Either make the tree good, and his fruit good; or else make the tree corrupt, and his fruit corrupt: for the tree is known by his fruit.

\ln Yo inadv tsunetsi nihi!  Tsinitsiyoiyv gado yigalisdoda osdv yitsiwonihi?  Utsadvyeno onawiyi owehvi vholi gawonisgoi.
\syll Ᏺ ᎢᎾᏛ ᏧᏁᏥ ᏂᎯ  ᏥᏂᏥᏲᎢᏴ ᎦᏙ ᏱᎦᎵᏍᏙᏓ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏱᏥᏬᏂᎯ?  ᎤᏣᏛᏰᏃ ᎣᎾᏫᏱ ᎣᏪᎲᎢ ᎥᎰᎵ ᎦᏬᏂᏍᎪᎢ.
\ft O generation of vipers, how can ye, being evil, speak good things? for out of the abundance of the heart the mouth speaketh.

\ln Osdv yvwi, osdv usquanigodv unawiyi, osdv gananugowisgoi.  Uyono yvwi, uyo usquanigodv uyo gananugowisgoi.
\syll ᎣᏍᏛ ᏴᏫ, ᎣᏍᏛ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏛ ᎤᎾᏫᏱ, ᎣᏍᏛ ᎦᎾᏄᎪᏫᏍᎪᎢ.  ᎤᏲᏃ ᏴᏫ, ᎤᏲ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏛ ᎤᏲ ᎦᎾᏄᎪᏫᏍᎪᎢ.
\ft A good man out of the good treasure of the heart bringeth forth good things: and an evil man out of the evil treasure bringeth forth evil things.

\ln Hiano nitsvweseha; Nigav uyo aniwonisgv yvwi, uninohedi gesesdi digugododiyi iga gesvi.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ; ᏂᎦᎥ ᎤᏲ ᎠᏂᏬᏂᏍᎬ ᏴᏫ, ᎤᏂᏃᎮᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏗᎫᎪᏙᏗᏱ ᎢᎦ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft But I say unto you, That every idle word that men shall speak, they shall give account thereof in the day of judgment.

\ln Hinegvyeno tsadudalesdodi gesesdi, ale hinegv tsasganvtsv ditsadugodanedi gesesdi.
\syll ᎯᏁᎬᏰᏃ ᏣᏚᏓᎴᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᏁᎬ ᏣᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᏗᏣᏚᎪᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft For by thy words thou shalt be justified, and by thy words thou shalt be condemned.

\ln Hnaquono gilo iyunasdi dinowelisgi ale Aniqualisi uninetsv, hia nuniwesvgi; Tadeyohvsgi, uyelvdv ogaduli itsvgowadvediyi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗ ᏗᏃᏪᎵᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏ ᎤᏂᏁᏨ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᏔᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ, ᎤᏰᎸᏛ ᎣᎦᏚᎵ ᎢᏨᎪᏩᏛᎡᏗᏱ.
\ft Then certain of the scribes and of the Pharisees answered, saying, Master, we would see a sign from thee.

\ln Unetsvno hia niduweselvgi; Gohi tsaneha uniyo ale dinadayonehi uyelvdv uniyohoi; aseno uyelvdv vtla getsinedi yigesesdi, Tsona adolehosgi utseliga uyelvdv uwasv.
\syll ᎤᏁᏨᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎪᎯ ᏣᏁᎭ ᎤᏂᏲ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎾᏓᏲᏁᎯ ᎤᏰᎸᏛ ᎤᏂᏲᎰᎢ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏰᎸᏛ ᎥᏝ ᎨᏥᏁᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᏦᎾ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᎤᏰᎸᏛ ᎤᏩᏒ.
\ft But he answered and said unto them, An evil and adulterous generation seeketh after a sign; and there shall no sign be given to it, but the sign of the prophet Jonas:

\ln Tsonayeno tsoi iga ale tsoi svnoyi atsadi equa usquoliyi tsayaei, nasquosgini yvwi Uwetsi tsoi iga ale tsoi svnoyi gadohi hawini ayaesdi.
\syll ᏦᎾᏰᏃ ᏦᎢ ᎢᎦ ᎠᎴ ᏦᎢ ᏒᏃᏱ ᎠᏣᏗ ᎡᏆ ᎤᏍᏉᎵᏱ ᏣᏯᎡᎢ, ᎾᏍᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᏦᎢ ᎢᎦ ᎠᎴ ᏦᎢ ᏒᏃᏱ ᎦᏙᎯ ᎭᏫᏂ ᎠᏯᎡᏍᏗ.
\ft For as Jonas was three days and three nights in the whale's belly; so shall the Son of man be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.

\ln Yvwi Niniwi tsanehvgi dodvnaleni dagvwanatlutani gohi tsaneha, digugododiyi iga gesvi, ale unisganvtsv gvnigesv udvnvneli; nasgiyeno dunadanvdv duninetliyvsvgi Tsona alitsidohvsgv nuwanisanvgi, gvniyuquono ani edoha utli atsilvquodiyu esgaquo Tsona.
\syll ᏴᏫ ᏂᏂᏫ ᏣᏁᎲᎩ ᏙᏛᎾᎴᏂ ᏓᎬᏩᎾᏡᏔᏂ ᎪᎯ ᏣᏁᎭ, ᏗᎫᎪᏙᏗᏱ ᎢᎦ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎤᏛᏅᏁᎵ; ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᏚᎾᏓᏅᏛ ᏚᏂᏁᏟᏴᏒᎩ ᏦᎾ ᎠᎵᏥᏙᎲᏍᎬ ᏄᏩᏂᏌᏅᎩ, ᎬᏂᏳᏉᏃ ᎠᏂ ᎡᏙᎭ ᎤᏟ ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᏦᎾ.
\ft The men of Nineveh shall rise in judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: because they repented at the preaching of Jonas; and, behold, a greater than Jonas is here.

\ln Ugvwiyuhi ageyv tsuganawv tsehei dodvleni dayunatlutani gohi tsaneha digugododiyi iga gesvi, ale unisganvtsv gvnigesv nvdagvneli; nasgiyeno gadohi wasdv iyvdv tsuwenvse udvganile Solimonv agatahnaiyu gesvi, gvniyuquono ani edoha utli atsilvquodiyu esgaquo Solimonv.
\syll ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᎨᏴ ᏧᎦᎾᏮ ᏤᎮᎢ ᏙᏛᎴᏂ ᏓᏳᎾᏡᏔᏂ ᎪᎯ ᏣᏁᎭ ᏗᎫᎪᏙᏗᏱ ᎢᎦ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏅᏓᎬᏁᎵ; ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎦᏙᎯ ᏩᏍᏛ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏧᏪᏅᏎ ᎤᏛᎦᏂᎴ ᏐᎵᎼᏅ ᎠᎦᏔᎿᎢᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎬᏂᏳᏉᏃ ᎠᏂ ᎡᏙᎭ ᎤᏟ ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᏐᎵᎼᏅ.
\ft The queen of the south shall rise up in the judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: for she came from the uttermost parts of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and, behold, a greater than Solomon is here.

\ln Iyuno gadaha adanvdo yvwihi ganugoi, ukayodvhi edohoi uyawesolvsdiyi uyohoi, aseno vtla yawatisgoi.
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᎦᏓᎭ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᏴᏫᎯ ᎦᏄᎪᎢ, ᎤᎧᏲᏛᎯ ᎡᏙᎰᎢ ᎤᏯᏪᏐᎸᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏲᎰᎢ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏯᏩᏘᏍᎪᎢ.
\ft When the unclean spirit is gone out of a man, he walketh through dry places, seeking rest, and findeth none.

\ln Hnaquono hia nigawesgoi; ditsinelv diginugotsv yvdvtsilosi.  Hnaquono wigalugi awatisgo usiwa geso ale gvnosadvhi ale goduisdoi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎪᎢ; ᏗᏥᏁᎸ ᏗᎩᏄᎪᏨ ᏴᏛᏥᎶᏏ.  ᎿᏉᏃ ᏫᎦᎷᎩ ᎠᏩᏘᏍᎪ ᎤᏏᏩ ᎨᏐ ᎠᎴ ᎬᏃᏌᏛᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎪᏚᎢᏍᏙᎢ.
\ft Then he saith, I will return into my house from whence I came out; and when he is come, he findeth it empty, swept, and garnished.

\ln Hnaquono iegoi widayanisgo uwanadale galiquogi anisgina utli iyuninegutsidv esgaquo uwasv, nahnano aniyvhihoi ale ananeladisgoi, onino nusdv na asgaya utli uyoiyu gesoi esgaquo igvyiyi.  Nasgisgini nunasdesdi gohi uninegutsidv tsaneha.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎢᎡᎪᎢ ᏫᏓᏯᏂᏍᎪ ᎤᏩᎾᏓᎴ ᎦᎵᏉᎩ ᎠᏂᏍᎩᎾ ᎤᏟ ᎢᏳᏂᏁᎫᏥᏛ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎤᏩᏒ, ᏀᎾᏃ ᎠᏂᏴᎯᎰᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎾᏁᎳᏗᏍᎪᎢ, ᎣᏂᏃ ᏄᏍᏛ Ꮎ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᏟ ᎤᏲᎢᏳ ᎨᏐᎢ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎢᎬᏱᏱ.  ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ ᏄᎾᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᎪᎯ ᎤᏂᏁᎫᏥᏛ ᏣᏁᎭ.
\ft Then goeth he, and taketh with himself seven other spirits more wicked than himself, and they enter in and dwell there: and the last state of that man is worse than the first. Even so shall it be also unto this wicked generation.

\ln Asiquo degawonedisgv yvwi, gvniyuquo utsi ale analinvtli doyitlv anidonavgi, unadulisgvgi gvwalinohedodiyi.
\syll ᎠᏏᏉ ᏕᎦᏬᏁᏗᏍᎬ ᏴᏫ, ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎤᏥ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏟ ᏙᏱᏢ ᎠᏂᏙᎾᎥᎩ, ᎤᎾᏚᎵᏍᎬᎩ ᎬᏩᎵᏃᎮᏙᏗᏱ.
\ft While he yet talked to the people, behold, his mother and his brethren stood without, desiring to speak with him.

\ln Gilono hia nuweselvgi; Gvniyuquo tsatsi ale itsalinvtli doyi anidonaa, getsalinohedodiyi unaduliha.
\syll ᎩᎶᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᏣᏥ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏣᎵᏅᏟ ᏙᏱ ᎠᏂᏙᎾᎠ, ᎨᏣᎵᏃᎮᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᎾᏚᎵᎭ.
\ft Then one said unto him, Behold, thy mother and thy brethren stand without, desiring to speak with thee.

\ln Unetsvno hia nuweselv unonelvhi; Gago etsi?  Ale gago otsalinvtli?
\syll ᎤᏁᏨᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸ ᎤᏃᏁᎸᎯ; ᎦᎪ ᎡᏥ?  ᎠᎴ ᎦᎪ ᎣᏣᎵᏅᏟ?
\ft But he answered and said unto him that told him, Who is my mother? and who are my brethren?

\ln Widusonvno gvwasdawadidohi hia nuwesvgi; Gvniyuquo etsi ale otsalinvtli.
\syll ᏫᏚᏐᏅᏃ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎡᏥ ᎠᎴ ᎣᏣᎵᏅᏟ.
\ft And he stretched forth his hand toward his disciples, and said, Behold my mother and my brethren!

\ln Giloyeno nadvnehesdi nusdv udulisgv Edoda galvladi ehi, nasgi vginvtli ale vgido ale etsi.
\syll ᎩᎶᏰᏃ ᎾᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎬ ᎡᏙᏓ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎥᎩᏅᏟ ᎠᎴ ᎥᎩᏙ ᎠᎴ ᎡᏥ.
\ft For whosoever shall do the will of my Father which is in heaven, the same is my brother, and sister, and mother.

\ln Nahiyu iga Tsisa unugotsvgi adanelvi, ale vdalulodi uwenvgi.
\syll ᏀᎢᏳ ᎢᎦ ᏥᏌ ᎤᏄᎪᏨᎩ ᎠᏓᏁᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏓᎷᎶᏗ ᎤᏪᏅᎩ.
\ft The same day went Jesus out of the house, and sat by the sea side.

\ln Unitsatino yvwi gvwadatluwistanvgi, nasgi iyusdi tsiyuhi utsanvgi, ale uwenvgi.  Nigadiyuno nasgi unitsati amayulodi anidonavgi.
\syll ᎤᏂᏣᏘᏃ ᏴᏫ ᎬᏩᏓᏡᏫᏍᏔᏅᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏥᏳᎯ ᎤᏣᏅᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏪᏅᎩ.  ᏂᎦᏗᏳᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎠᎹᏳᎶᏗ ᎠᏂᏙᎾᎥᎩ.
\ft And great multitudes were gathered together unto him, so that he went into a ship, and sat; and the whole multitude stood on the shore.

\ln Deuwonetanvno utsati tsudalenvdv dutlilosdanelvgi; hia nuwesvgi; Gvniyuquo, awisgi uwisvsei.
\syll ᏕᎤᏬᏁᏔᏅᏃ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏚᏟᎶᏍᏓᏁᎸᎩ; ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎬᏂᏳᏉ, ᎠᏫᏍᎩ ᎤᏫᏒᏎᎢ.
\ft And he spake many things unto them in parables, saying, Behold, a sower went forth to sow;

\ln Uwisvno igadv nvnohulodi ulageyadvtsei, tsisquano unilutse ale unutisonei.
\syll ᎤᏫᏒᏃ ᎢᎦᏛ ᏅᏃᎱᎶᏗ ᎤᎳᎨᏯᏛᏤᎢ, ᏥᏍᏆᏃ ᎤᏂᎷᏤ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏄᏘᏐᏁᎢ.
\ft And when he sowed, some seeds fell by the way side, and the fowls came and devoured them up:

\ln Igadvno nvyohi gesv ulageyadvtsei, gayoli gada galageyvi, gilaquono iyvdv uliyenei, nvdigalisdodisge sageiyu gesv gada.
\syll ᎢᎦᏛᏃ ᏅᏲᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎳᎨᏯᏛᏤᎢ, ᎦᏲᎵ ᎦᏓ ᎦᎳᎨᏴᎢ, ᎩᎳᏉᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎤᎵᏰᏁᎢ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨ ᏌᎨᎢᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎦᏓ.
\ft Some fell upon stony places, where they had not much earth: and forthwith they sprung up, because they had no deepness of earth:

\ln Aseno nvdo tsukalvtsv uleyvsei, niduhnasdetlvnano gesv iyusdi uhnasgvtsequo.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᏅᏙ ᏧᎧᎸᏨ ᎤᎴᏴᏎᎢ, ᏂᏚᎿᏍᏕᏢᎾᏃ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᎿᏍᎬᏤᏉ.
\ft And when the sun was up, they were scorched; and because they had no root, they withered away.

\ln Igadvno anugalvhi ulageyadvtsei, anugalvno tsudvsv unenulastanei.
\syll ᎢᎦᏛᏃ ᎠᏄᎦᎸᎯ ᎤᎳᎨᏯᏛᏤᎢ, ᎠᏄᎦᎸᏃ ᏧᏛᏒ ᎤᏁᏄᎳᏍᏔᏁᎢ.
\ft And some fell among thorns; and the thorns sprung up, and choked them:

\ln Igadvsgini osv gadohi ulageyadvtsei, nasgino ugatatanei, igadv asgohitsuqui unequotsei, igadvno sudalasgohi unequotsei, igadvno tsoasgohi unequotsei.
\syll ᎢᎦᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᎣᏒ ᎦᏙᎯ ᎤᎳᎨᏯᏛᏤᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᎦᏔᏔᏁᎢ, ᎢᎦᏛ ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏧᏈ ᎤᏁᏉᏤᎢ, ᎢᎦᏛᏃ ᏑᏓᎳᏍᎪᎯ ᎤᏁᏉᏤᎢ, ᎢᎦᏛᏃ ᏦᎠᏍᎪᎯ ᎤᏁᏉᏤᎢ.
\ft But other fell into good ground, and brought forth fruit, some an hundredfold, some sixtyfold, some thirtyfold.

\ln Gilo degalugesdi udvgodiyi wadvgvga.
\syll ᎩᎶ ᏕᎦᎷᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᏛᎪᏗᏱ ᏩᏛᎬᎦ.
\ft Who hath ears to hear, let him hear.

\ln Gvwasdawadidohino gvwalutselv hia nigvwaweselvgi; Gadono dehiwonedisgv tsidehatlilosdaneha?
\syll ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯᏃ ᎬᏩᎷᏤᎸ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏩᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎦᏙᏃ ᏕᎯᏬᏁᏗᏍᎬ ᏥᏕᎭᏟᎶᏍᏓᏁᎭ?
\ft And the disciples came, and said unto him, Why speakest thou unto them in parables?

\ln Unetsvno hia niduweselvgi; Nvdigalisdodisgini nihi etsinelvhi gesv itsolisdiyi udelidv gesv galvladi ehi ugv wiyuhi gesvi, nasgini vtla gegalisgolvdanelvhi yigi.
\syll ᎤᏁᏨᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᏂᎯ ᎡᏥᏁᎸᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏦᎵᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎤᎬ ᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏂ ᎥᏝ ᎨᎦᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᏱᎩ.
\ft He answered and said unto them, Because it is given unto you to know the mysteries of the kingdom of heaven, but to them it is not given.

\ln Giloyeno uhesdi atsinedi gesesdi, utsatino uhesdi; gilosgini nuhvna gesesdi atsigiediquo gesesdi nasgi nasquo uhvi.
\syll ᎩᎶᏰᏃ ᎤᎮᏍᏗ ᎠᏥᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎤᏣᏘᏃ ᎤᎮᏍᏗ; ᎩᎶᏍᎩᏂ ᏄᎲᎾ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎠᏥᎩᎡᏗᏉ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᎲᎢ.
\ft For whosoever hath, to him shall be given, and he shall have more abundance: but whosoever hath not, from him shall be taken away even that he hath.

\ln Nasgi nvdigalisdodiha tsidegatsiyatlilosdaneha, anigowatisgvyeno vtla yinadvgiha ale vtla yinoliga.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᏥᏕᎦᏥᏯᏟᎶᏍᏓᏁᎭ, ᎠᏂᎪᏩᏘᏍᎬᏰᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏱᎾᏛᎩᎭ ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏃᎵᎦ.
\ft Therefore speak I to them in parables: because they seeing see not; and hearing they hear not, neither do they understand.

\ln Ale anehv udohiyunv Isaya tsudolehosei, hia tsinuwesei; Itsadvgisgv itsadvgisgesdi, aseno vtla yitsoligesdi; ale itsigowatisgv itsigowatisgesdi, aseno vtla yitsadolehosgesdi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎠᏁᎲ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᏅ ᎢᏌᏯ ᏧᏙᎴᎰᏎᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏥᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎢᏣᏛᎩᏍᎬ ᎢᏣᏛᎩᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏦᎵᎨᏍᏗ; ᎠᎴ ᎢᏥᎪᏩᏘᏍᎬ ᎢᏥᎪᏩᏘᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏣᏙᎴᎰᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
\ft And in them is fulfilled the prophecy of Esaias, which saith, By hearing ye shall hear, and shall not understand; and seeing ye shall see, and shall not perceive:

\ln Hiayeno yvwi tsuninawi dulitsohvsv, ale danililugv gayoliyu dadvgiha, ale dinigadoli dunisdunv; nasgi dinigadoli digvwanigowadvdodi nigesvna iyulisdodiyi, ale danililugv digvwanadvgododinigesvna iyulisdodiyi, ale tsuninawi digvwanolisdodi nigesvna iyulisdodiyi, ale digvwanadanetliyvedi nigesvna dunadanvdv, ale digagatsinvwodi nigesvna iyulisdodiyi.
\syll ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᏴᏫ ᏧᏂᎾᏫ ᏚᎵᏦᎲᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᏂᎵᎷᎬ ᎦᏲᎵᏳ ᏓᏛᎩᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏂᎦᏙᎵ ᏚᏂᏍᏚᏅ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏂᎦᏙᎵ ᏗᎬᏩᏂᎪᏩᏛᏙᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᏂᎵᎷᎬ ᏗᎬᏩᎾᏛᎪᏙᏗᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏂᎾᏫ ᏗᎬᏩᏃᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎬᏩᎾᏓᏁᏟᏴᎡᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏚᎾᏓᏅᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎦᎦᏥᏅᏬᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
\ft For this people's heart is waxed gross, and their ears are dull of hearing, and their eyes they have closed; lest at any time they should see with their eyes, and hear with their ears, and should understand with their heart, and should be converted, and I should heal them.

\ln Nihisgini ditsigadoli digalvquotanvhi, nasgiyeno dagowatiha, ale detsililugvi, nasgiyeno dadvgiha;
\syll ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᏗᏥᎦᏙᎵ ᏗᎦᎸᏉᏔᏅᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᏓᎪᏩᏘᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᏥᎵᎷᎬᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᏓᏛᎩᎭ;
\ft But blessed are your eyes, for they see: and your ears, for they hear.

\ln Udohiyuhiyayeno hia nitsvweseha, unitsati anadolehosgi ale unadanvti unadulvdv utsigowadvdiyi hia nasgi tsitsigowatiha, aseno vtla unigohvhi yigi; ale unadvgodiyi hia nasgi tsitsadvgiha, aseno vtla unadvganvhi yigi.
\syll ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯᏰᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ, ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ ᎤᎾᏚᎸᏛ ᎤᏥᎪᏩᏛᏗᏱ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏥᎪᏩᏘᎭ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏂᎪᎲᎯ ᏱᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏛᎪᏗᏱ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏣᏛᎩᎭ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅᎯ ᏱᎩ.
\ft For verily I say unto you, That many prophets and righteous men have desired to see those things which ye see, and have not seen them; and to hear those things which ye hear, and have not heard them.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi nihi itsadvgvga datlilosdv awisgi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏣᏛᎬᎦ ᏓᏟᎶᏍᏛ ᎠᏫᏍᎩ.
\ft Hear ye therefore the parable of the sower.

\ln Iyuno gilo advgvga kanohedv galvladi ehi ugvnayuhi gesv ugvwali, nigoligvnano tsigesoi, hnaquo unegutsidv galugoi ale ugieho awisv unawiyi.  Nasgi hia unohulodi tsawisei.
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎠᏛᎬᎦ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎤᎬᎾᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ, ᏂᎪᎵᎬᎾᏃ ᏥᎨᏐᎢ, ᎿᏉ ᎤᏁᎫᏥᏛ ᎦᎷᎪᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎩᎡᎰ ᎠᏫᏒ ᎤᎾᏫᏱ.  ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎤᏃᎱᎶᏗ ᏣᏫᏎᎢ.
\ft When any one heareth the word of the kingdom, and understandeth it not, then cometh the wicked one, and catcheth away that which was sown in his heart. This is he which received seed by the way side.

\ln Hiano nasgi nvyohi tsawisei; nasgi tsadvgisgo kanohedv, ale gilaquo iyvdv ulihelitsvhi tsidadanilvgoi;
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏲᎯ ᏣᏫᏎᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᏣᏛᎩᏍᎪ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᎩᎳᏉ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎤᎵᎮᎵᏨᎯ ᏥᏓᏓᏂᎸᎪᎢ;
\ft But he that received the seed into stony places, the same is he that heareth the word, and anon with joy receiveth it;

\ln Aseno niduhnasdetlvnaquo gesoi, ale tlegaquo tsidakahnawadegoi; agiliyvyeno gananugoi ale kanohedv dvliyeilvsda agadeyadoda, gilaquo iyvdv duwodehihoi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᏂᏚᎿᏍᏕᏢᎾᏉ ᎨᏐᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏞᎦᏉ ᏥᏓᎧᎿᏩᏕᎪᎢ; ᎠᎩᎵᏴᏰᏃ ᎦᎾᏄᎪᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏛᎵᏰᎢᎸᏍᏓ ᎠᎦᏕᏯᏙᏓ, ᎩᎳᏉ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏚᏬᏕᎯᎰᎢ.
\ft Yet hath he not root in himself, but dureth for a while: for when tribulation or persecution ariseth because of the word, by and by he is offended.

\ln Hiano nasquo anugalvhi tsawisei, nasgi tsadvgisgo kanohedv, elohino uwelihisdi gesv ale genvisdi gesv udalidasdv aninenulasdisgo kanohedv, nasgino nagatadvsgvnaquo gesoi.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏄᎦᎸᎯ ᏣᏫᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏣᏛᎩᏍᎪ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ, ᎡᎶᎯᏃ ᎤᏪᎵᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎨᏅᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏓᎵᏓᏍᏛ ᎠᏂᏁᏄᎳᏍᏗᏍᎪ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎾᎦᏔᏛᏍᎬᎾᏉ ᎨᏐᎢ.
\ft He also that received seed among the thorns is he that heareth the word; and the care of this world, and the deceitfulness of riches, choke the word, and he becometh unfruitful.

\ln Nasgisgini na osv gadohi tsawisei; nasgi tsadvgisgo kanohedv ale tsigoligoi, ale nasquo tsagatadvsgoi, ale tsigananugowisgoi, igadv asgohitsuqui unequotsvhi, igadvno sudalasgohi, igadvno tsoasgohi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ Ꮎ ᎣᏒ ᎦᏙᎯ ᏣᏫᏎᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᏣᏛᎩᏍᎪ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎠᎴ ᏥᎪᎵᎪᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏣᎦᏔᏛᏍᎪᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᎦᎾᏄᎪᏫᏍᎪᎢ, ᎢᎦᏛ ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏧᏈ ᎤᏁᏉᏨᎯ, ᎢᎦᏛᏃ ᏑᏓᎳᏍᎪᎯ, ᎢᎦᏛᏃ ᏦᎠᏍᎪᎯ.
\ft But he that received seed into the good ground is he that heareth the word, and understandeth it; which also beareth fruit, and bringeth forth, some an hundredfold, some sixty, some thirty.

\ln Nvwadale dutlilosdanelvgi, hia nuwesvgi; Galvladi ehi ugvwiyuhi gesv nasgiyaquo asgaya osdv ugata ulogesv tsuwisei.
\syll ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᏚᏟᎶᏍᏓᏁᎸᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᏉ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎤᎦᏔ ᎤᎶᎨᏒ ᏧᏫᏎᎢ.
\ft Another parable put he forth unto them, saying, The kingdom of heaven is likened unto a man which sowed good seed in his field:

\ln Aseno yvwi unilinvtsv, usgaya ulutse uyo ugata uwise utsalesdi awisv usuyvnei; ale iuwenvse.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏂᎵᏅᏨ, ᎤᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᎷᏤ ᎤᏲ ᎤᎦᏔ ᎤᏫᏎ ᎤᏣᎴᏍᏗ ᎠᏫᏒ ᎤᏑᏴᏁᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎢᎤᏪᏅᏎ.
\ft But while men slept, his enemy came and sowed tares among the wheat, and went his way.

\ln Hnaquono uliyenv ale ugatatanv nasquo uyo unanugotsei.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎤᎵᏰᏅ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎦᏔᏔᏅ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᏲ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏤᎢ.
\ft But when the blade was sprung up, and brought forth fruit, then appeared the tares also.

\ln Hnaquono asgaya ganela tsunvsidasdi gvwalutselei, hia nigvwaweselei; sginvsidasdi, Tlasgo osdv ugata yitsawise tsalogesvi?  Gado digalisdodaha uyo tsuyega?
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎦᏁᎳ ᏧᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎬᏩᎷᏤᎴᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏩᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᏍᎩᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ, ᏝᏍᎪ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎤᎦᏔ ᏱᏣᏫᏎ ᏣᎶᎨᏒᎢ?  ᎦᏙ ᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏓᎭ ᎤᏲ ᏧᏰᎦ?
\ft So the servants of the householder came and said unto him, Sir, didst not thou sow good seed in thy field? from whence then hath it tares?

\ln Hiano niduweselei; Gilo agisgagi nasgi nudvnelv.  Tsunvsidasdi hia nigvwaselei; Tsadulisgono ogiyehisvsdiyi?
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎩᎶ ᎠᎩᏍᎦᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏛᏁᎸ.  ᏧᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏩᏎᎴᎢ; ᏣᏚᎵᏍᎪᏃ ᎣᎩᏰᎯᏒᏍᏗᏱ?
\ft He said unto them, An enemy hath done this. The servants said unto him, Wilt thou then that we go and gather them up?

\ln Aseno hia nuwesei; vtla, itsiyehisgvyeno uyo, yidetsihnasdetlvda nasquo utsalesdi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎥᏝ, ᎢᏥᏰᎯᏍᎬᏰᏃ ᎤᏲ, ᏱᏕᏥᎿᏍᏕᏢᏓ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᏣᎴᏍᏗ.
\ft But he said, Nay; lest while ye gather up the tares, ye root up also the wheat with them.

\ln Unelagi igulaha widadvhi gvni agadvnatsvha; hnaquono agadvnatsv hia nvdagatsiweseli anisgudesgi; Igvyi itsitlisa uyo, ale ditsodvtsa digohvsdodi, utsalesdisgini itsitlisa agisquanigododiyi.
\syll ᎤᏁᎳᎩ ᎢᎫᎳᎭ ᏫᏓᏛᎯ ᎬᏂ ᎠᎦᏛᎾᏨᎭ; ᎿᏉᏃ ᎠᎦᏛᎾᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏅᏓᎦᏥᏪᏎᎵ ᎠᏂᏍᎫᏕᏍᎩ; ᎢᎬᏱ ᎢᏥᏟᏌ ᎤᏲ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏦᏛᏣ ᏗᎪᎲᏍᏙᏗ, ᎤᏣᎴᏍᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᏥᏟᏌ ᎠᎩᏍᏆᏂᎪᏙᏗᏱ.
\ft Let both grow together until the harvest: and in the time of harvest I will say to the reapers, Gather ye together first the tares, and bind them in bundles to burn them: but gather the wheat into my barn.

\ln Nvwadale dutlilosdanelvgi, hia nuwesvgi; Galvladi ehi ugvwiyuhi gesv nasgiyaquo atsilv ugata, asgaya tsugise ale tsuwise ulogesvi.
\syll ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᏚᏟᎶᏍᏓᏁᎸᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᏉ ᎠᏥᎸ ᎤᎦᏔ, ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᏧᎩᏎ ᎠᎴ ᏧᏫᏎ ᎤᎶᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Another parable put he forth unto them, saying, The kingdom of heaven is like to a grain of mustard seed, which a man took, and sowed in his field:

\ln Nasgi udohiyusv tsiwodagonadvdi usdigiyu gesv nigav ugata, aseno advhi tsiwodagonadvdi udvniyu gesv nigav uyehnavi, ale tlugv tsinigalisdiha, nasgino tsisqua tsanilugoi, duwanigalv tsanahadisgoi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᏒ ᏥᏬᏓᎪᎾᏛᏗ ᎤᏍᏗᎩᏳ ᎨᏒ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎤᎦᏔ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᏛᎯ ᏥᏬᏓᎪᎾᏛᏗ ᎤᏛᏂᏳ ᎨᏒ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎤᏰᎿᎥᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏡᎬ ᏥᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏥᏍᏆ ᏣᏂᎷᎪᎢ, ᏚᏩᏂᎦᎸ ᏣᏀᎠᏗᏍᎪᎢ.
\ft Which indeed is the least of all seeds: but when it is grown, it is the greatest among herbs, and becometh a tree, so that the birds of the air come and lodge in the branches thereof.

\ln Nvwadale dutlilosdanelvgi, hia nuwosvgi; Galvladi ehi ugvwiyuhi gesv nasgiyaquo agododi, nasgi ageyv tsugise ale tsusuyvne tsoi iyutlilodv isv galvi, gvni nigadv ugosonv.
\syll ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᏚᏟᎶᏍᏓᏁᎸᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏬᏒᎩ; ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᏉ ᎠᎪᏙᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎨᏴ ᏧᎩᏎ ᎠᎴ ᏧᏑᏴᏁ ᏦᎢ ᎢᏳᏟᎶᏛ ᎢᏒ ᎦᎸᎢ, ᎬᏂ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎤᎪᏐᏅ.
\ft Another parable spake he unto them; The kingdom of heaven is like unto leaven, which a woman took, and hid in three measures of meal, till the whole was leavened.

\ln Nasgi hia nigadiyu Tsisa duwonetanvgi unitsati dutlilosdanelvgi, nidatlilosdanehvnano gesv vtla yiduwonetanei.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏥᏌ ᏚᏬᏁᏔᏅᎩ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏚᏟᎶᏍᏓᏁᎸᎩ, ᏂᏓᏟᎶᏍᏓᏁᎲᎾᏃ ᎨᏒ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏚᏬᏁᏔᏁᎢ.
\ft All these things spake Jesus unto the multitude in parables; and without a parable spake he not unto them:

\ln Udohiyudiyi ayelvsvgi adolehosgi tsunetsei, hia tsinuwesei; datsisduisi tsioli degatlilosdisgvi, datsineistani udelidv asquanigodv elohi tsudotlvnv nvdagvwadalenvdv.
\syll ᎤᏙᎯᏳᏗᏱ ᎠᏰᎸᏒᎩ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᏧᏁᏤᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏥᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᏓᏥᏍᏚᎢᏏ ᏥᎣᎵ ᏕᎦᏟᎶᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᏓᏥᏁᎢᏍᏔᏂ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᎠᏍᏆᏂᎪᏛ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏧᏙᏢᏅ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏓᎴᏅᏛ.
\ft That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, saying, I will open my mouth in parables; I will utter things which have been kept secret from the foundation of the world.

\ln Hnaquono Tsisa duyelihistanv unitsati, adanelv wuyvlvgi; gvwasdawadidohino gvwalutselvgi, hia nuniwesvgi; Disgiyosisasi datlilosdv uyo tsuliyene tlogesi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏥᏌ ᏚᏰᎵᎯᏍᏔᏅ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ, ᎠᏓᏁᎸ ᏭᏴᎸᎩ; ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯᏃ ᎬᏩᎷᏤᎸᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᏗᏍᎩᏲᏏᏌᏏ ᏓᏟᎶᏍᏛ ᎤᏲ ᏧᎵᏰᏁ ᏠᎨᏏ.
\ft Then Jesus sent the multitude away, and went into the house: and his disciples came unto him, saying, Declare unto us the parable of the tares of the field.

\ln Unetsvno hia niduweselvgi; nasgi na Osdv ugata tsuwisei nasgi yvwi Uwetsi;
\syll ᎤᏁᏨᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎤᎦᏔ ᏧᏫᏎᎢ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ;
\ft He answered and said unto them, He that soweth the good seed is the Son of man;

\ln Tlogesino nasgi elanigvi; osdv ugata nasgi galvladi ehi ugvwiyuhi gesv anehi; uyono tsuliyene nasgi unegutsidv tsuwetsi;
\syll ᏠᎨᏏᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᎳᏂᎬᎢ; ᎣᏍᏛ ᎤᎦᏔ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏁᎯ; ᎤᏲᏃ ᏧᎵᏰᏁ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎫᏥᏛ ᏧᏪᏥ;
\ft The field is the world; the good seed are the children of the kingdom; but the tares are the children of the wicked one;

\ln Agasgino nasgi tsuwisei, nasgi asgina; ugadvnaisdiyino gesv nasgi alisquadvha elohi; anisgudesgino nasgi dinikahnawadidohi.
\syll ᎠᎦᏍᎩᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏫᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᎩᎾ; ᎤᎦᏛᎾᎢᏍᏗᏱᏃ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎵᏍᏆᏛᎭ ᎡᎶᎯ; ᎠᏂᏍᎫᏕᏍᎩᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏂᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎯ.
\ft The enemy that sowed them is the devil; the harvest is the end of the world; and the reapers are the angels.

\ln Nasgino uyo tsanitlisisgo ale tsanagohvsdisgo atsilvyi, nasgiyasgini nasquo nusdesdi alisquadvha hia elohi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᏲ ᏣᏂᏟᏏᏍᎪ ᎠᎴ ᏣᎾᎪᎲᏍᏗᏍᎪ ᎠᏥᎸᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯᏍᎩᏂ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏄᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᎠᎵᏍᏆᏛᎭ ᎯᎠ ᎡᎶᎯ.
\ft As therefore the tares are gathered and burned in the fire; so shall it be in the end of this world.

\ln Yvwi Uwetsi dodaganvsi tsutseli dinikahnawadidohi, ale nasgi utseligohi dodvnotsalesi nigadv dinadadodesdisgi ale nigadv anisganvgi,
\syll ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᏙᏓᎦᏅᏏ ᏧᏤᎵ ᏗᏂᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏤᎵᎪᎯ ᏙᏛᏃᏣᎴᏏ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏗᎾᏓᏙᏕᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏅᎩ,
\ft The Son of man shall send forth his angels, and they shall gather out of his kingdom all things that offend, and them which do iniquity;

\ln Digotlvsvno atsilvyi widodvnadaesi; nahna daniyvgesdi ale danilvdagisgesdi daninudogvi.
\syll ᏗᎪᏢᏒᏃ ᎠᏥᎸᏱ ᏫᏙᏛᎾᏓᎡᏏ; ᏀᎾ ᏓᏂᏴᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏓᏂᎸᏓᎩᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏓᏂᏄᏙᎬᎢ.
\ft And shall cast them into a furnace of fire: there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth.

\ln Hnaquono unadanvti gvwanitalugisgi gesesdi Unidoda utseligohi, nvdo nasgiyai.  Gilo degalilugesdi udvgodiyi wadvgvga.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ ᎬᏩᏂᏔᎷᎩᏍᎩ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᏂᏙᏓ ᎤᏤᎵᎪᎯ, ᏅᏙ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ.  ᎩᎶ ᏕᎦᎵᎷᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᏛᎪᏗᏱ ᏩᏛᎬᎦ.
\ft Then shall the righteous shine forth as the sun in the kingdom of their Father. Who hath ears to hear, let him hear.

\ln Ale nasquo Galvladi ehi ugvwiyuhi gesv nasgiyaquo tsugvwalodi udelidv tlogesi tsahoi, nasgi iyu asgaya awadv, tsadelvsgoi, aliheligvno iyusti tsegoi tsiwiganadego nigadv usquanigodvi, ale tsiwuwasgo nasgi tlogesi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᏉ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᏠᎨᏏ ᏣᎰᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎠᏩᏛ, ᏣᏕᎸᏍᎪᎢ, ᎠᎵᎮᎵᎬᏃ ᎢᏳᏍᏘ ᏤᎪᎢ ᏥᏫᎦᎾᏕᎪ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏛᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᏭᏩᏍᎪ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏠᎨᏏ.
\ft Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto treasure hid in a field; the which when a man hath found, he hideth, and for joy thereof goeth and selleth all that he hath, and buyeth that field.

\ln Ale nasquo Galvladi ehi ugvwiyuhi gesv nasgiyaquo ganodisgi tsiduyohe tsuwoduhi dagvnaiyunasdi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᏉ ᎦᏃᏗᏍᎩ ᏥᏚᏲᎮ ᏧᏬᏚᎯ ᏓᎬᎾᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗ.
\ft Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto a merchant man, seeking goodly pearls:

\ln Nasgino hnaquo uwadvhv saquo utsati tsugvwalodi dagvna iyusdi uwenvse wunadinvse nigadv usquanigodvi, nasgino uwasei.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎿᏉ ᎤᏩᏛᎲ ᏌᏉ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᏓᎬᎾ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᏪᏅᏎ ᏭᎾᏗᏅᏎ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏛᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᏩᏎᎢ.
\ft Who, when he had found one pearl of great price, went and sold all that he had, and bought it.

\ln Ale nasquo Galvladi ehi ugvwiyuhi gesv nasgiyaquo agayaludi tsiwunadainvse amequohi, ale tsiduniniyvhe naniv tsunadalenvdv;
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᏉ ᎠᎦᏯᎷᏗ ᏥᏭᎾᏓᎢᏅᏎ ᎠᎺᏉᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᏚᏂᏂᏴᎮ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ;
\ft Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto a net, that was cast into the sea, and gathered of every kind:

\ln Nasgino hnaquo ukalitsv amayulodi uninasinolei, ale unanvnei, anosdvno ditelido dunilvtanei, uniyono dunadainvsei.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎿᏉ ᎤᎧᎵᏨ ᎠᎹᏳᎶᏗ ᎤᏂᎾᏏᏃᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏅᏁᎢ, ᎠᏃᏍᏛᏃ ᏗᏖᎵᏙ ᏚᏂᎸᏔᏁᎢ, ᎤᏂᏲᏃ ᏚᎾᏓᎢᏅᏎᎢ.
\ft Which, when it was full, they drew to shore, and sat down, and gathered the good into vessels, but cast the bad away.

\ln Nasgisgini nusdesdi elohi alisquadvha; dinikahnawadidohi dvnilutsi, dodvnagalenvtani uninegutsidv ale unadanvti;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ ᏄᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎠᎵᏍᏆᏛᎭ; ᏗᏂᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏛᏂᎷᏥ, ᏙᏛᎾᎦᎴᏅᏔᏂ ᎤᏂᏁᎫᏥᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ;
\ft So shall it be at the end of the world: the angels shall come forth, and sever the wicked from among the just,

\ln Uninegutsidvno widodvnadaesi digotlvsv atsilvyi, nahna daniyvgesdi ale danilvdagisgesdi daninudogvi.
\syll ᎤᏂᏁᎫᏥᏛᏃ ᏫᏙᏛᎾᏓᎡᏏ ᏗᎪᏢᏒ ᎠᏥᎸᏱ, ᏀᎾ ᏓᏂᏴᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏓᏂᎸᏓᎩᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏓᏂᏄᏙᎬᎢ.
\ft And shall cast them into the furnace of fire: there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth.

\ln Tsisano hia niduweselvgi; itsoligitsu nigadv hia?  vv, tsagvwiyuhi, vgvwoselvgi.
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎢᏦᎵᎩᏧ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎯᎠ?  ᎥᎥ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎥᎬᏬᏎᎸᎩ.
\ft Jesus saith unto them, Have ye understood all these things? They say unto him, Yea, Lord.

\ln Hnaquono hia niduweselvgi; Nasgi iyusdi gilo digowelisgi galvladi ehi ugvwiyuhi gesv ugvwali ageyonvhi tsigesoi, nasgiyaquo asgaya ganela tsidodigananugowisgo tsugvwalodi usquanigodv tsudalenvdv ditse ale tsuweti.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎩᎶ ᏗᎪᏪᎵᏍᎩ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᎠᎨᏲᏅᎯ ᏥᎨᏐᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯᏉ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎦᏁᎳ ᏥᏙᏗᎦᎾᏄᎪᏫᏍᎪ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏛ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏗᏤ ᎠᎴ ᏧᏪᏘ.
\ft Then said he unto them, Therefore every scribe which is instructed unto the kingdom of heaven is like unto a man that is an householder, which bringeth forth out of his treasure things new and old.

\ln Hiano nulistanvgi, hnaquo Tsisa usquadv hia nasgi datlilosdisgvi, unigisvgi.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎩ, ᎿᏉ ᏥᏌ ᎤᏍᏆᏛ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏓᏟᎶᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᎤᏂᎩᏒᎩ.
\ft And it came to pass, that when Jesus had finished these parables, he departed thence.

\ln Hnaquono uwasv utseligohi ulutsv tsunilawiisdiyi duweyonvgi; nasgi iyusdi unisquanigosvgi, ale hia nuniwesvgi; Gado ulisdotanv hia nasgi asgaya tsagata hnaa ale usquanigodi tsidulvwisdaneha?
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎤᏤᎵᎪᎯ ᎤᎷᏨ ᏧᏂᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᏚᏪᏲᏅᎩ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏒᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᎦᏙ ᎤᎵᏍᏙᏔᏅ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᏣᎦᏔ ᎿᎠ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᏥᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎭ?
\ft And when he was come into his own country, he taught them in their synagogue, insomuch that they were astonished, and said, Whence hath this man this wisdom, and these mighty works?

\ln Hiakani dinesgesgi uwetsi, Melikani utsi, alekani analinvtli Tsimi, ale Tsosi ale Sawani ale Tsudasi?
\syll ᎯᎠᎧᏂ ᏗᏁᏍᎨᏍᎩ ᎤᏪᏥ, ᎺᎵᎧᏂ ᎤᏥ, ᎠᎴᎧᏂ ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏟ ᏥᎻ, ᎠᎴ ᏦᏏ ᎠᎴ ᏌᏩᏂ ᎠᎴ ᏧᏓᏏ?
\ft Is not this the carpenter's son? is not his mother called Mary? and his brethren, James, and Joses, and Simon, and Judas?

\ln Alekani tsudo nigadv esgani tsaneha?  Gadono ulisdotanv hia nigadv tsuweha?
\syll ᎠᎴᎧᏂ ᏧᏙ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎡᏍᎦᏂ ᏣᏁᎭ?  ᎦᏙᏃ ᎤᎵᏍᏙᏔᏅ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏧᏪᎭ?
\ft And his sisters, are they not all with us? Whence then hath this man all these things?

\ln Vgvwagonelohiselvgino; aseno Tsisa hia niduweselvgi; Adolehosgi vtla natsilvquodvna yigesoi, uwasvsgininonv utseligohi ale uwasv ganelvi.
\syll ᎥᎬᏩᎪᏁᎶᎯᏎᎸᎩᏃ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎥᏝ ᎾᏥᎸᏉᏛᎾ ᏱᎨᏐᎢ, ᎤᏩᏒᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎤᏤᎵᎪᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎦᏁᎸᎢ.
\ft And they were offended in him. But Jesus said unto them, A prophet is not without honour, save in his own country, and in his own house.

\ln Vtlano yutsate usquanigodi nahna yidulvwisdanelei, nanohiyuhvsgena gesv nvdagalisdodisgvgi.
\syll ᎥᏝᏃ ᏳᏣᏖ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᏀᎾ ᏱᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎴᎢ, ᎾᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎨᎾ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬᎩ.
\ft And he did not many mighty works there because of their unbelief.

\ln Naneyu Elodv nvgi igadugi gesv sdadugi atsigatidisdi udvgane deganotsalv Tsisa.
\syll ᎾᏁᏳ ᎡᎶᏛ ᏅᎩ ᎢᎦᏚᎩ ᎨᏒ ᏍᏓᏚᎩ ᎠᏥᎦᏘᏗᏍᏗ ᎤᏛᎦᏁ ᏕᎦᏃᏣᎸ ᏥᏌ.
\ft At that time Herod the tetrarch heard of the fame of Jesus,

\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴ ᏧᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ; ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏣᏂ ᏗᏓᏪᏍᎩ; ᏙᎤᎴᏅ ᏧᏲᎱᏒᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗᏳ ᏥᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎭ.
\ft And said unto his servants, This is John the Baptist; he is risen from the dead; and therefore mighty works do shew forth themselves in him.

\ln Elodvyeno uniyvhe Tsani ale ulvlei ale usdune didasdudiyi,  Quiligi Elodv dinadanvtli udalii Elodisi tsudoidv usdvdisgei.
\syll ᎡᎶᏛᏰᏃ ᎤᏂᏴᎮ ᏣᏂ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎸᎴᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏍᏚᏁ ᏗᏓᏍᏚᏗᏱ,  ᏈᎵᎩ ᎡᎶᏛ ᏗᎾᏓᏅᏟ ᎤᏓᎵᎢ ᎡᎶᏗᏏ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ ᎤᏍᏛᏗᏍᎨᎢ.
\ft For Herod had laid hold on John, and bound him, and put him in prison for Herodias' sake, his brother Philip's wife.

\ln Tsaniyeno hia nuwesele Elodv; vtla duyugodv yigi nasgi tsadayeha.
\syll ᏣᏂᏰᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴ ᎡᎶᏛ; ᎥᏝ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᏱᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏣᏓᏰᎭ.
\ft For John said unto him, It is not lawful for thee to have her.

\ln Ale udulisge uhisdiyi, aseno dasgaihe yvwi, adolehosgiyeno uniyelvse Tsani.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎨ ᎤᎯᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᏓᏍᎦᎢᎮ ᏴᏫ, ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎤᏂᏰᎸᏎ ᏣᏂ.
\ft And when he would have put him to death, he feared the multitude, because they counted him as a prophet.

\ln Aseno hnaquo Elodv udenv iyu iga dunilawitsv, Elodisi uwetsi adv unalisgielei, ale ose uyelvne Elodv.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎿᏉ ᎡᎶᏛ ᎤᏕᏅ ᎢᏳ ᎢᎦ ᏚᏂᎳᏫᏨ, ᎡᎶᏗᏏ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎠᏛ ᎤᎾᎵᏍᎩᎡᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎣᏎ ᎤᏰᎸᏁ ᎡᎶᏛ.
\ft But when Herod's birthday was kept, the daughter of Herodias danced before them, and pleased Herod.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi uselitane uduisdanele unediyi nusdvquo utayolvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᏎᎵᏔᏁ ᎤᏚᎢᏍᏓᏁᎴ ᎤᏁᏗᏱ ᏄᏍᏛᏉ ᎤᏔᏲᎸᎢ.
\ft Whereupon he promised with an oath to give her whatsoever she would ask.

\ln Hnaquono utsi uweyonvhi nigesei hia nuwesei; Ani sgiyohelvha Tsani Didawosgi usgo atelido galodesdi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎤᏥ ᎤᏪᏲᏅᎯ ᏂᎨᏎᎢ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎠᏂ ᏍᎩᏲᎮᎸᎭ ᏣᏂ ᏗᏓᏬᏍᎩ ᎤᏍᎪ ᎠᏖᎵᏙ ᎦᎶᏕᏍᏗ.
\ft And she, being before instructed of her mother, said, Give me here John Baptist's head in a charger.

\ln Ugvwiyuhino uyoiyu uyelvnei, aseno uselitanvi, ale nasquo nasgi analisdayvhvsgi nvtsulisdotanei, unetse atsinediyi.
\syll ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᏃ ᎤᏲᎢᏳ ᎤᏰᎸᏁᎢ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏎᎵᏔᏅᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎩ ᏅᏧᎵᏍᏙᏔᏁᎢ, ᎤᏁᏤ ᎠᏥᏁᏗᏱ.
\ft And the king was sorry: nevertheless for the oath's sake, and them which sat with him at meat, he commanded it to be given her.

\ln Udanvseno wunisgudese Tsani didasdudiyi.
\syll ᎤᏓᏅᏎᏃ ᏭᏂᏍᎫᏕᏎ ᏣᏂ ᏗᏓᏍᏚᏗᏱ.
\ft And he sent, and beheaded John in the prison.

\ln Usgono uniyole atelidogihi, ale uninele adv, nasgino utsi wunelei.
\syll ᎤᏍᎪᏃ ᎤᏂᏲᎴ ᎠᏖᎵᏙᎩᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏁᎴ ᎠᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᏥ ᏭᏁᎴᎢ.
\ft And his head was brought in a charger, and given to the damsel: and she brought it to her mother.

\ln Gvwasdawadidohino unilutse ale uninese ayelvi, ale uninisanei, ale unenvse wuninonele Tsisa.
\syll ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯᏃ ᎤᏂᎷᏤ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏁᏎ ᎠᏰᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏂᏌᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᏅᏎ ᏭᏂᏃᏁᎴ ᏥᏌ.
\ft And his disciples came, and took up the body, and buried it, and went and told Jesus.

\ln Tsisano udvganv, tsiyu utsotanvgi nahna unigisvgi udayelilv inage wulosvgi.  Hnaquono yvwi unadvganv, eladi gvwasdawadvegi degaduhv dodayunenvsvgi.
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᏛᎦᏅ, ᏥᏳ ᎤᏦᏔᏅᎩ ᏀᎾ ᎤᏂᎩᏒᎩ ᎤᏓᏰᎵᎸ ᎢᎾᎨ ᏭᎶᏒᎩ.  ᎿᏉᏃ ᏴᏫ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅ, ᎡᎳᏗ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏛᎡᎩ ᏕᎦᏚᎲ ᏙᏓᏳᏁᏅᏒᎩ.

\ln Tsisano utsaisv dugohvgi unitsati yvwi, ale duwedolitsvgi, ale dunvwanvtsunitlvgi.
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᏣᎢᏒ ᏚᎪᎲᎩ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏴᏫ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏪᏙᎵᏨᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏅᏩᏅᏧᏂᏢᎩ.
\ft And Jesus went forth, and saw a great multitude, and was moved with compassion toward them, and he healed their sick.

\ln Usvno nulistanv gvwasdawadohi gvwalutselvgi hia nuniwesvgi; Ani inagequo, ale iga ulosonidi, tsitsenaquono giyosi hia unitsati yvwi, ale dodigaduhv wianilohi, nahna unvsv unalisdayvdi uniwasvha.
\syll ᎤᏒᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏙᎯ ᎬᏩᎷᏤᎸᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᎠᏂ ᎢᎾᎨᏉ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᎦ ᎤᎶᏐᏂᏗ, ᏥᏤᎾᏉᏃ ᎩᏲᏏ ᎯᎠ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏴᏫ, ᎠᎴ ᏙᏗᎦᏚᎲ ᏫᎠᏂᎶᎯ, ᏀᎾ ᎤᏅᏒ ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗ ᎤᏂᏩᏒᎭ.
\ft And when it was evening, his disciples came to him, saying, This is a desert place, and the time is now past; send the multitude away, that they may go into the villages, and buy themselves victuals.

\ln Aseno Tsisa hia niduweselvgi; Vtla ase vunenvsdi yigi, nihiquo ditselasda.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎥᏝ ᎠᏎ ᎥᎤᏁᏅᏍᏗ ᏱᎩ, ᏂᎯᏉ ᏗᏤᎳᏍᏓ.
\ft But Jesus said unto them, They need not depart; give ye them to eat.

\ln Hiano nvgvwaweselvgi; Ani hisgiquo gadu dogiha, taliquono atsadi.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏅᎬᏩᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎠᏂ ᎯᏍᎩᏉ ᎦᏚ ᏙᎩᎭ, ᏔᎵᏉᏃ ᎠᏣᏗ.
\ft And they say unto him, We have here but five loaves, and two fishes.

\ln Hiano nuwesvgi; Ani disgiyohisi.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎠᏂ ᏗᏍᎩᏲᎯᏏ.
\ft He said, Bring them hither to me.

\ln Dunetselvno unitsati kanesgohi gesv unanvdiyi, dugisvno hisgi gadu ale tali atsadi dunesv, galvladino widukananv ulihelitsvgi, ale dugvhaluyv dunelvgi gadu gvwasdawadidohi, nasgino gvwasdawadidohi unitsati widuninelvgi.
\syll ᏚᏁᏤᎸᏃ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎧᏁᏍᎪᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎾᏅᏗᏱ, ᏚᎩᏒᏃ ᎯᏍᎩ ᎦᏚ ᎠᎴ ᏔᎵ ᎠᏣᏗ ᏚᏁᏒ, ᎦᎸᎳᏗᏃ ᏫᏚᎧᎾᏅ ᎤᎵᎮᎵᏨᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᎬᎭᎷᏴ ᏚᏁᎸᎩ ᎦᏚ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏫᏚᏂᏁᎸᎩ.
\ft And he commanded the multitude to sit down on the grass, and took the five loaves, and the two fishes, and looking up to heaven, he blessed, and brake, and gave the loaves to his disciples, and the disciples to the multitude.

\ln Nigadvno unalisdayvnvgi ale dunolvsvgi, ale unutisvgi uligvhaluyvhi utiyvhi taladu iyakalii talutsa.
\syll ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᏅᎩ ᎠᎴ ᏚᏃᎸᏒᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏄᏘᏒᎩ ᎤᎵᎬᎭᎷᏴᎯ ᎤᏘᏴᎯ ᏔᎳᏚ ᎢᏯᎧᎵᎢ ᏔᎷᏣ.
\ft And they did all eat, and were filled: and they took up of the fragments that remained twelve baskets full.

\ln Unalisdayvnvhino hisgiha iyagayvli anisgaya nanivgi, nidanetlvdvna anigeyv ale diniyoli.
\syll ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᏅᎯᏃ ᎯᏍᎩᎭ ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ ᎾᏂᎥᎩ, ᏂᏓᏁᏢᏛᎾ ᎠᏂᎨᏴ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏂᏲᎵ.
\ft And they that had eaten were about five thousand men, beside women and children.

\syll ᎩᎳᏉᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏥᏌ ᏚᏅᏫᏍᏔᏅᎩ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏥᏳᎯ ᎤᎾᏦᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᎬᏱ ᏂᏚᏂᏐᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᏏ ᏓᏰᎵᎯᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ.
\ft And straightway Jesus constrained his disciples to get into a ship, and to go before him unto the other side, while he sent the multitudes away.

\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏚᏰᎵᎯᏍᏔᏅ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎣᏓᎸ ᎤᎿᎷᏒᎩ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏔᏅᏒᎩ.  ᎤᏒᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ ᏀᎾ ᎤᏩᏒᏉ ᎨᏒᎩ.
\ft And when he had sent the multitudes away, he went up into a mountain apart to pray: and when the evening was come, he was there alone.

\syll ᏥᏳᏃ ᎿᏉ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎥᏓᎵ ᏩᏂᏂᏒᎩ ᎤᏝᏗᏍᏔᏂᏙᎲ ᎠᎹ ᏓᎵᏍᏗᎳᏁᎬᎢ, ᎤᏃᎴᏰᏃ ᎢᎬᏱᏢ ᏓᏳᎦᏛᎩ.

\ln Hnaquono nvgine iyunadanetliyvdv gesv aniyawisgi svnoyi Tsisa widulutselvgi vdali gadui aisvgi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏅᎩᏁ ᎢᏳᎾᏓᏁᏟᏴᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏂᏯᏫᏍᎩ ᏒᏃᏱ ᏥᏌ ᏫᏚᎷᏤᎸᎩ ᎥᏓᎵ ᎦᏚᎢ ᎠᎢᏒᎩ.

\syll ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯᏃ ᎬᏩᎪᎲ ᎥᏓᎵ ᎦᏚᎩ; ᎠᎢᏒᎢ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏖᏔᏅᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᎾᏰᎯ ᎯᎠ.  ᎠᏂᏍᎦᎢᎲᏃ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏔᏅᎩ.
\ft And when the disciples saw him walking on the sea, they were troubled, saying, It is a spirit; and they cried out for fear.

\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎩᎳᏉ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏥᏌ ᏚᏁᏤᎸᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎤᎦᎵᏍᏗᏉ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏓᏓ, ᎠᏴᏉᏰᏃ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏥᏍᎦᎢᎮᏍᏗ.
\ft But straightway Jesus spake unto them, saying, Be of good cheer; it is I; be not afraid.

\syll ᏈᏓᏃ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᏂᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᏍᎩᏁᏥ ᏫᎬᎷᏤᏗᏱ ᎠᎹᏱ ᎦᏚᎢ.

\ln Ehena, udvnvgi.  Hnaquono Quida tsiyuhi utsaisv amayi gadui aisvgi Tsisa tsedohv wagadvgi.
\syll ᎡᎮᎾ, ᎤᏛᏅᎩ.  ᎿᏉᏃ ᏈᏓ ᏥᏳᎯ ᎤᏣᎢᏒ ᎠᎹᏱ ᎦᏚᎢ ᎠᎢᏒᎩ ᏥᏌ ᏤᏙᎲ ᏩᎦᏛᎩ.
\ft And he said, Come. And when Peter was come down out of the ship, he walked on the water, to go to Jesus.

\ln Aseno nvdolehosv asdayiyu ganolvvsgv usgalvgi, ale ulenvhv ganoyvgv uwelunvgi, Tsagvwiyuhi sgisdelv, udvnvgi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᏅᏙᎴᎰᏒ ᎠᏍᏓᏱᏳ ᎦᏃᎸᎥᏍᎬ ᎤᏍᎦᎸᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎴᏅᎲ ᎦᏃᏴᎬ ᎤᏪᎷᏅᎩ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏍᎩᏍᏕᎸ, ᎤᏛᏅᎩ.
\ft But when he saw the wind boisterous, he was afraid; and beginning to sink, he cried, saying, Lord, save me.

\ln Gilaquono iyvdv Tsisa wudoyanvhidv wuniyvhvgi, hia nuweselvgi; usdi tsohiyuhi, gadohi vtsadlasidvsi?
\syll ᎩᎳᏉᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏥᏌ ᏭᏙᏯᏅᎯᏛ ᏭᏂᏴᎲᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎤᏍᏗ ᏦᎯᏳᎯ, ᎦᏙᎯ ᎥᏣᏜᏏᏛᏏ?
\ft And immediately Jesus stretched forth his hand, and caught him, and said unto him, O thou of little faith, wherefore didst thou doubt?

\ln Tsiyuhino iunatsanv ganolvvsgv usuligotsvgi.

\ft And Jesus departed from thence, and came nigh unto the sea of Galilee; and went up into a mountain, and sat down there.

\ln Unitsatino yvwi gvwalutselvgi, danatinehv diniyouli, ale dinigewi, ale tsunvgewi, ale gohusdi usdv diniyelv tsuniyohuselvhi, ale unitsati nvwanadalei, ale Tsisa dulasgv nav duninvnvgi, dunvwanvgino.
\syll ᎤᏂᏣᏘᏃ ᏴᏫ ᎬᏩᎷᏤᎸᎩ, ᏓᎾᏘᏁᎲ ᏗᏂᏲᎤᎵ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏂᎨᏫ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏅᎨᏫ, ᎠᎴ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏍᏛ ᏗᏂᏰᎸ ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏎᎸᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᏌ ᏚᎳᏍᎬ ᎾᎥ ᏚᏂᏅᏅᎩ, ᏚᏅᏩᏅᎩᏃ.
\ft And great multitudes came unto him, having with them those that were lame, blind, dumb, maimed, and many others, and cast them down at Jesus' feet; and he healed them:

\ln Nasgi iyusdi unitsati gesv unisquanigosvgi, dunigohv tsunvgewi aniwonisgoi, ale ahusdi usdv diniyelv tsuniyohuselvhi uninosdv nunalistanvi, ale didiyouli, gvwanedasdi nulistanvi ale dinigewi gvwanigowadvdi nulistanvi; unilvquotanvgino Unelanvhi Isili unatseliga.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏒᎩ, ᏚᏂᎪᎲ ᏧᏅᎨᏫ ᎠᏂᏬᏂᏍᎪᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏍᏛ ᏗᏂᏰᎸ ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏎᎸᎯ ᎤᏂᏃᏍᏛ ᏄᎾᎵᏍᏔᏅᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏗᏲᎤᎵ, ᎬᏩᏁᏓᏍᏗ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎢ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏂᎨᏫ ᎬᏩᏂᎪᏩᏛᏗ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎢ; ᎤᏂᎸᏉᏔᏅᎩᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᏏᎵ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ.
\ft Insomuch that the multitude wondered, when they saw the dumb to speak, the maimed to be whole, the lame to walk, and the blind to see: and they glorified the God of Israel.

\ln Tsisano widuyanvhv gvwasdawadidohi, hia nuwesvgi; gatsiyadoliga hia unitsati gesvi, tsoiyeno nadodaqua ani gedohv anedoha, ale vtla yiniyeha unalisdayvdi.  Ale itla yaquaduliha dounenvsdiyi digvwaniyosisgi, wanayeno yidaniwanigalogi wanaisvi.
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᏫᏚᏯᏅᎲ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎦᏥᏯᏙᎵᎦ ᎯᎠ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏦᎢᏰᏃ ᎾᏙᏓᏆ ᎠᏂ ᎨᏙᎲ ᎠᏁᏙᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏂᏰᎭ ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗ.  ᎠᎴ ᎢᏝ ᏯᏆᏚᎵᎭ ᏙᎤᏁᏅᏍᏗᏱ ᏗᎬᏩᏂᏲᏏᏍᎩ, ᏩᎾᏰᏃ ᏱᏓᏂᏩᏂᎦᎶᎩ ᏩᎾᎢᏒᎢ.
\ft Then Jesus called his disciples unto him, and said, I have compassion on the multitude, because they continue with me now three days, and have nothing to eat: and I will not send them away fasting, lest they faint in the way.

\ln Gvwasdawadidohino hia nvgvwaweselvgi; Hatlvno yotsigi nasgi igai alisdayvdi inagei, nasgi iyunitsati yeli tsunolvhisdi?
\syll ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏅᎬᏩᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎭᏢᏃ ᏲᏥᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗ ᎢᎾᎨᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏂᏣᏘ ᏰᎵ ᏧᏃᎸᎯᏍᏗ?
\ft And his disciples say unto him, Whence should we have so much bread in the wilderness, as to fill so great a multitude?

\ln Tsisano hia niduweselvgi; Ilago gadu detsiyeha?  Galiquogi, ilvsgino tsunasdi atsadi, unadvnvgi.
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎢᎳᎪ ᎦᏚ ᏕᏥᏰᎭ?  ᎦᎵᏉᎩ, ᎢᎸᏍᎩᏃ ᏧᎾᏍᏗ ᎠᏣᏗ, ᎤᎾᏛᏅᎩ.
\ft And Jesus saith unto them, How many loaves have ye? And they said, Seven, and a few little fishes.

\ln Unitsatino dunetselvgi gadohi unanvdiyi.
\syll ᎤᏂᏣᏘᏃ ᏚᏁᏤᎸᎩ ᎦᏙᎯ ᎤᎾᏅᏗᏱ.
\ft And he commanded the multitude to sit down on the ground.

\ln Galiquogino gadu dugisvgi ale dunesv atsadi, ulihelitsvno, dugvhaluyvgi, ale gvwasdawadidohi widunelvgi, gvwasdawadidohino unitsati widuninelvgi.
\syll ᎦᎵᏉᎩᏃ ᎦᏚ ᏚᎩᏒᎩ ᎠᎴ ᏚᏁᏒ ᎠᏣᏗ, ᎤᎵᎮᎵᏨᏃ, ᏚᎬᎭᎷᏴᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏫᏚᏁᎸᎩ, ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯᏃ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏫᏚᏂᏁᎸᎩ.
\ft And he took the seven loaves and the fishes, and gave thanks, and brake them, and gave to his disciples, and the disciples to the multitude.

\ln Ale nigadv unalisdayvnvgi, ale dunolvsvgi.  Ale unutesvgi uligvhaluyvhi galiquogi iyakalii talutsa.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᏅᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏃᎸᏒᎩ.  ᎠᎴ ᎤᏄᏖᏒᎩ ᎤᎵᎬᎭᎷᏴᎯ ᎦᎵᏉᎩ ᎢᏯᎧᎵᎢ ᏔᎷᏣ.
\ft And they did all eat, and were filled: and they took up of the broken meat that was left seven baskets full.

\ln Unalisdayvhino nvgiha iyagayvli nanivgi anisgaya, nidanetlvdvna anigeyv ale diniyoli.
\syll ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᎯᏃ ᏅᎩᎭ ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ ᎾᏂᎥᎩ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ, ᏂᏓᏁᏢᏛᎾ ᎠᏂᎨᏴ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏂᏲᎵ.
\ft And they that did eat were four thousand men, beside women and children.

\ln Ale unitsati duyelihistanvgi, ale tsiyuhi wutsanvgi, ale magideli wunanugotsvgi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏚᏰᎵᎯᏍᏔᏅᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᏳᎯ ᏭᏣᏅᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎹᎩᏕᎵ ᏭᎾᏄᎪᏨᎩ.
\ft And he sent away the multitude, and took ship, and came into the coasts of Magdala,

\ln Aniqualisino ale Anisadusi unilutsvgi, gvwagoliyesgvno gvwatayoselvgi tsunanugowisediyi uyelvdv galvladi nvdayulosvhi.
\syll ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏᏃ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏌᏚᏏ ᎤᏂᎷᏨᎩ, ᎬᏩᎪᎵᏰᏍᎬᏃ ᎬᏩᏔᏲᏎᎸᎩ ᏧᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᏗᏱ ᎤᏰᎸᏛ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏅᏓᏳᎶᏒᎯ.
\ft The Pharisees also with the Sadducees came, and tempting desired him that he would shew them a sign from heaven.

\ln Unetsvno hia niduweselvgi; Usvnigalisda hia nitsiwesgoi; ulvgaliyisadv gesesdi, galvloyeno gigageiyu igi.
\syll ᎤᏁᏨᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎤᏒᏂᎦᎵᏍᏓ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏥᏪᏍᎪᎢ; ᎤᎸᎦᎵᏱᏌᏛ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎦᎸᎶᏰᏃ ᎩᎦᎨᎢᏳ ᎢᎩ.
\ft He answered and said unto them, When it is evening, ye say, It will be fair weather: for the sky is red.

\ln Sunaleno tsigesoi, Gohi iga tsigi dvgahnani, galvloyeno gigageiyu igi, ale igalogiliyeha, itsadisgoi.  Itsatlonasdi, yeliquo itsadolehosgo nusdv galvloi, tlasgono yeli getsadolehohisdi yigi uyelvdv iyu listanidasdi gesvi?
\syll ᏑᎾᎴᏃ ᏥᎨᏐᎢ, ᎪᎯ ᎢᎦ ᏥᎩ ᏛᎦᎿᏂ, ᎦᎸᎶᏰᏃ ᎩᎦᎨᎢᏳ ᎢᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᎦᎶᎩᎵᏰᎭ, ᎢᏣᏗᏍᎪᎢ.  ᎢᏣᏠᎾᏍᏗ, ᏰᎵᏉ ᎢᏣᏙᎴᎰᏍᎪ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎦᎸᎶᎢ, ᏝᏍᎪᏃ ᏰᎵ ᎨᏣᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏗ ᏱᎩ ᎤᏰᎸᏛ ᎢᏳ ᎵᏍᏔᏂᏓᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ?
\ft And in the morning, It will be foul weather to day: for the sky is red and lowring. O ye hypocrites, ye can discern the face of the sky; but can ye not discern the signs of the times?

\ln Uniyo ale uninegutsidv tsaneha uniyoho uyelvdvi, aseno vtla yvgagegalisgolvdasi uyelvdvi, Tsona adolehosgi utseli uyelvdv uwasv.  Dudanvelvno unigisvgi.
\syll ᎤᏂᏲ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏁᎫᏥᏛ ᏣᏁᎭ ᎤᏂᏲᎰ ᎤᏰᎸᏛᎢ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏴᎦᎨᎦᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏏ ᎤᏰᎸᏛᎢ, ᏦᎾ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎤᏰᎸᏛ ᎤᏩᏒ.  ᏚᏓᏅᎡᎸᏃ ᎤᏂᎩᏒᎩ.
\ft A wicked and adulterous generation seeketh after a sign; and there shall no sign be given unto it, but the sign of the prophet Jonas. And he left them, and departed.

\ln Gvwasdawadidohino dunisotsv unvgewisvhi gesvgi unadenodiyi.
\syll ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯᏃ ᏚᏂᏐᏨ ᎤᏅᎨᏫᏒᎯ ᎨᏒᎩ ᎤᎾᏕᏃᏗᏱ.
\ft And when his disciples were come to the other side, they had forgotten to take bread.

\ln Tsisano hia niduweselvgi; Itseyatahesdi agododi Aniqualisi ale Anisadusi unatseliga.
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎢᏤᏯᏔᎮᏍᏗ ᎠᎪᏙᏗ ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏌᏚᏏ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ.
\ft Then Jesus said unto them, Take heed and beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees.

\ln Uninohelvgino gesv unvsv, hia nuniwesvgi; Nigadenvna tsigi nvdigalisdodiha.
\syll ᎤᏂᏃᎮᎸᎩᏃ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏅᏒ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᏂᎦᏕᏅᎾ ᏥᎩ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ.
\ft And they reasoned among themselves, saying, It is because we have taken no bread.

\ln Tsisano nasgi udolehosv hia niduweselvgi; Usdi itsohiyuhi, gadono itsvsv gesv itsinoheha alisdayvdi nitsiyehvna gesvi?
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏙᎴᎰᏒ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎤᏍᏗ ᎢᏦᎯᏳᎯ, ᎦᏙᏃ ᎢᏨᏒ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏥᏃᎮᎭ ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗ ᏂᏥᏰᎲᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ?
\ft Which when Jesus perceived, he said unto them, O ye of little faith, why reason ye among yourselves, because ye have brought no bread?

\ln Tlasgo asi yitsoliga, ale tlasgo yitsanvta hisgi gadu ale hisgi iyagayvli tsinanivgi, ale iyakalii talutsa itsutesvi?
\syll ᏝᏍᎪ ᎠᏏ ᏱᏦᎵᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᏝᏍᎪ ᏱᏣᏅᏔ ᎯᏍᎩ ᎦᏚ ᎠᎴ ᎯᏍᎩ ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ ᏥᎾᏂᎥᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏯᎧᎵᎢ ᏔᎷᏣ ᎢᏧᏖᏒᎢ?
\ft Do ye not yet understand, neither remember the five loaves of the five thousand, and how many baskets ye took up?

\ln Ale galiquogi gadu nvgino iyagayvli tsinanivgi, ale iyakalii talatsa itsutesvi?
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎦᎵᏉᎩ ᎦᏚ ᏅᎩᏃ ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ ᏥᎾᏂᎥᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏯᎧᎵᎢ ᏔᎳᏣ ᎢᏧᏖᏒᎢ?
\ft Neither the seven loaves of the four thousand, and how many baskets ye took up?

\ln Gado digalisdodi nitsoligvna tsigi, nasgi hia tsinitsvwesi tlasgini gadu yitsidvga, itseyatahesdi agododi Aniqualisi Ale Anisadusi unatseliga, tsitsvyosi?
\syll ᎦᏙ ᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᏂᏦᎵᎬᎾ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᏨᏪᏏ ᏝᏍᎩᏂ ᎦᏚ ᏱᏥᏛᎦ, ᎢᏤᏯᏔᎮᏍᏗ ᎠᎪᏙᏗ ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏌᏚᏏ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ, ᏥᏨᏲᏏ?
\ft How is it that ye do not understand that I spake it not to you concerning bread, that ye should beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees?

\ln Hnaquono unolitsvgi nuninetsehvna gesv uneyadoisdiyi gadu agododi, danadeyohvsgvsgini Aniqualisi ale Anisadusi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎤᏃᎵᏨᎩ ᏄᏂᏁᏤᎲᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᏯᏙᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎦᏚ ᎠᎪᏙᏗ, ᏓᎾᏕᏲᎲᏍᎬᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏌᏚᏏ.
\ft Then understood they how that he bade them not beware of the leaven of bread, but of the doctrine of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees.

\ln Tsisano ulutsv Sisaliyi Queligiyi, dudvdvnvgi gvwasdawadidohi, hia niduweselvgi; Ayv yvwi Uwetsi tsigi gago gvquoseho yvwi?
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᎷᏨ ᏏᏌᎵᏱ ᏇᎵᎩᏱ, ᏚᏛᏛᏅᎩ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎠᏴ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᏥᎩ ᎦᎪ ᎬᏉᏎᎰ ᏴᏫ?
\ft When Jesus came into the coasts of Caesarea Philippi, he asked his disciples, saying, Whom do men say that I the Son of man am?

\ln Hiano nuniwesvgi; Igadv Tsani didawosgi [getsosehoi,] igadvno Ilaya, anisoino Tselimaya ale gilo iyusdi anadolehosgi gesvi.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᎢᎦᏛ ᏣᏂ ᏗᏓᏬᏍᎩ ᎨᏦᏎᎰᎢ,data is invalid ᎢᎦᏛᏃ ᎢᎳᏯ, ᎠᏂᏐᎢᏃ ᏤᎵᎹᏯ ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft And they said, Some say that thou art John the Baptist: some, Elias; and others, Jeremias, or one of the prophets.

\ln Hiano niduweselvgi; nihinano gago sgiyoseha?
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏂᎯᎾᏃ ᎦᎪ ᏍᎩᏲᏎᎭ?
\ft He saith unto them, But whom say ye that I am?

\ln Sawanino Quida unetsv hia nuwesvgi; Galonedv nihi, gvnidv Unelanvhi Uwetsi.
\syll ᏌᏩᏂᏃ ᏈᏓ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏂᎯ, ᎬᏂᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏪᏥ.
\ft And Simon Peter answered and said, Thou art the Christ, the Son of the living God.

\ln Tsisano unetsv hia nuweselvgi; Osiyu itsalisdanedi nihi Sawani Tsona uwetsi; vtlayeno uquedali ale gigv nasgi yitsananugowiselv, Edodasgini galvladi ehi.
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᏂᎯ ᏌᏩᏂ ᏦᎾ ᎤᏪᏥ; ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎠᎴ ᎩᎬ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᏣᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᎸ, ᎡᏙᏓᏍᎩᏂ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ.
\ft And Jesus answered and said unto him, Blessed art thou, Simon Barjona: for flesh and blood hath not revealed it unto thee, but my Father which is in heaven.

\ln Ayvno hia nigvweseha; Quida nihi ale nasgi ani hia nvyohi daganesgehi aquatseli tsunanelodi unadatlugvi, ale tsvsginoi dasduhvi esga iyunvnedi nigesvna gesesdi.
\syll ᎠᏴᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏪᏎᎭ; ᏈᏓ ᏂᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏂ ᎯᎠ ᏅᏲᎯ ᏓᎦᏁᏍᎨᎯ ᎠᏆᏤᎵ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏨᏍᎩᏃᎢ ᏓᏍᏚᎲᎢ ᎡᏍᎦ ᎢᏳᏅᏁᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft And I say also unto thee, That thou art Peter, and upon this rock I will build my church; and the gates of hell shall not prevail against it.

\ln Ale disduisdi galvladi ehi ugvwiyuhi gesv tsutseli dodagvdeli, nigavno gohusdi halvihesdi elohi, galvsdi gesesdi galvladi, nigavno gohusdi halvgisgesdi elohi galvgisdi gesesdi galvladi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏗᏍᏚᎢᏍᏗ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏧᏤᎵ ᏙᏓᎬᏕᎵ, ᏂᎦᎥᏃ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎭᎸᎢᎮᏍᏗ ᎡᎶᎯ, ᎦᎸᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ, ᏂᎦᎥᏃ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎭᎸᎩᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎦᎸᎩᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ.
\ft And I will give unto thee the keys of the kingdom of heaven: and whatsoever thou shalt bind on earth shall be bound in heaven: and whatsoever thou shalt loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven.

\ln Hnaquono dunvsdadelvgi gvwasdawadidohi gilo uninonediyi nasgi uwasv Galonedv gesvi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏚᏅᏍᏓᏕᎸᎩ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏂᏃᏁᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Then charged he his disciples that they should tell no man that he was Jesus the Christ.

\ln Hnaquono Tsisa ulenvhvgi dunonelvgi gvwasdawadidohi ase uwenvsdiyi gesv Tsilusilimi, Ale tsudalenvdv tsugiliyotsediyi dinilawigi ale nunigvwiyusv atsilvanelohi ale dinowelisgi; ale atsiisdiyi, ale tsoine iga tsulediyi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎤᎴᏅᎲᎩ ᏚᏃᏁᎸᎩ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎠᏎ ᎤᏪᏅᏍᏗᏱ ᎨᏒ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏧᎩᎵᏲᏤᏗᏱ ᏗᏂᎳᏫᎩ ᎠᎴ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏃᏪᎵᏍᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᎠᏥᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏦᎢᏁ ᎢᎦ ᏧᎴᏗᏱ.
\ft From that time forth began Jesus to shew unto his disciples, how that he must go unto Jerusalem, and suffer many things of the elders and chief priests and scribes, and be killed, and be raised again the third day.

\ln Hnaquono Quida iyvdv wutinvstanv ulenvhvgi udanvsdadelvgi, hia nuwesvgi, Unelanvhi wunvsdohi, Tsagvwiyuhi, vtla nasgi yinvgetsalisdasi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏈᏓ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏭᏘᏅᏍᏔᏅ ᎤᎴᏅᎲᎩ ᎤᏓᏅᏍᏓᏕᎸᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏭᏅᏍᏙᎯ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎥᏝ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᏅᎨᏣᎵᏍᏓᏏ.
\ft Then Peter took him, and began to rebuke him, saying, Be it far from thee, Lord: this shall not be unto thee.

\ln Ugatahvsvno hia natsiweselv Quida; Aquasohadv halehvga, Sedani, disquodesdisgiquo nihi, vtlayeno yadanvdeha Unelanvhi utseliga, yvwiquosgini unatseli hadanvdeha.
\syll ᎤᎦᏔᎲᏒᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏥᏪᏎᎸ ᏈᏓ; ᎠᏆᏐᎭᏛ ᎭᎴᎲᎦ, ᏎᏓᏂ, ᏗᏍᏉᏕᏍᏗᏍᎩᏉ ᏂᎯ, ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᏯᏓᏅᏕᎭ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᏴᏫᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᎾᏤᎵ ᎭᏓᏅᏕᎭ.
\ft But he turned, and said unto Peter, Get thee behind me, Satan: thou art an offence unto me: for thou savourest not the things that be of God, but those that be of men.

\ln Hnaquono Tsisa hia niduweselvgi gvwasdawadidohi; Iyuno gilo udulisgesdi agisduwadvsdiyi, adadayihesdi uwasv, ale tsudahnawadv ayisgesdi, ale agisdawadegesdi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᎩᏍᏚᏩᏛᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᏓᏓᏱᎮᏍᏗ ᎤᏩᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏓᎿᏩᏛ ᎠᏱᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎩᏍᏓᏩᏕᎨᏍᏗ.
\ft Then said Jesus unto his disciples, If any man will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.

\ln Giloyeno udulisgesdi usdelvdiyi gvnvi, uyohusedi gesesdi; gilono uyohusehesdi gvnvi, ayv nvdigalisdodisgesdi, uwadvdi gesesdi.
\syll ᎩᎶᏰᏃ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᏍᏕᎸᏗᏱ ᎬᏅᎢ, ᎤᏲᎱᏎᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᎩᎶᏃ ᎤᏲᎱᏎᎮᏍᏗ ᎬᏅᎢ, ᎠᏴ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎤᏩᏛᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft For whosoever will save his life shall lose it: and whosoever will lose his life for my sake shall find it.
