\syll ᎦᏙ ᏴᏫ ᏳᏁᏉᏥ ᎢᏳᏃ ᎡᎳᏂᎬ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏱᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ, ᎤᏓᏅᏙᏃ ᏳᏲᎱᏎᎸ; ᎠᎴ ᎦᏙ ᏯᎲᎦ ᏴᏫ ᏱᎦᏁᏟᏴᏍᏓ ᎤᏓᏅᏙ.
\ft For what is a man profited, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul? or what shall a man give in exchange for his soul?

\ln Yvwiyeno Uwetsi dagalutsi Udoda utseli galvquodiyu gesv unuwosdesdi, ale dinikahnawadidohi datinehesdi; hnaquono dodvguyveli naniv yvwi nusdv dunilvwisdanelvi.
\syll ᏴᏫᏰᏃ ᎤᏪᏥ ᏓᎦᎷᏥ ᎤᏙᏓ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏄᏬᏍᏕᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏂᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏓᏘᏁᎮᏍᏗ; ᎿᏉᏃ ᏙᏛᎫᏴᎡᎵ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏴᏫ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏚᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸᎢ.
\ft For the Son of man shall come in the glory of his Father with his angels; and then he shall reward every man according to his works.

\ln Udohiyuhiya hia nitsvweseha, Gilo ani danidoga vtla yvdvnadolehosi ayohuhisdi gesvi, gvni anigohvha yvwi Uwetsi nahna ugvwiyuhi gesv gananugotsilvha.
\syll ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ, ᎩᎶ ᎠᏂ ᏓᏂᏙᎦ ᎥᏝ ᏴᏛᎾᏙᎴᎰᏏ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎬᏂ ᎠᏂᎪᎲᎭ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᏀᎾ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎦᎾᏄᎪᏥᎸᎭ.
\ft Verily I say unto you, There be some standing here, which shall not taste of death, till they see the Son of man coming in his kingdom.

\ln Sudalino winusvlv Tsisa dutinvsvgi Quida, ale Tsimi ale Tsani Tsimi dinadanvtli, ale duhnalutanvgi inv igati odalv unvsv gesvi,
\syll ᏑᏓᎵᏃ ᏫᏄᏒᎸ ᏥᏌ ᏚᏘᏅᏒᎩ ᏈᏓ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᎻ ᎠᎴ ᏣᏂ ᏥᎻ ᏗᎾᏓᏅᏟ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᎿᎷᏔᏅᎩ ᎢᏅ ᎢᎦᏘ ᎣᏓᎸ ᎤᏅᏒ ᎨᏒᎢ,
\ft And after six days Jesus taketh Peter, James, and John his brother, and bringeth them up into an high mountain apart,

\ln Ale udanetliyvse danikanvi, ale ukadv digvwalvsada nulistanei nvdo idigvtselidv, ale unuwav igagadv tsinunegiyv nunegiyei.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᏁᏟᏴᏎ ᏓᏂᎧᏅᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎧᏛ ᏗᎬᏩᎸᏌᏓ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ ᏅᏙ ᎢᏗᎬᏤᎵᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏄᏩᎥ ᎢᎦᎦᏛ ᏥᏄᏁᎩᏴ ᏄᏁᎩᏰᎢ.
\ft And was transfigured before them: and his face did shine as the sun, and his raiment was white as the light.

\ln Ale gvniyuquo nahna gvnigesv nigvwanadvnele Mosi ale Ilaya gvwalinohedisgei.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᏀᎾ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᎬᏩᎾᏛᏁᎴ ᎼᏏ ᎠᎴ ᎢᎳᏯ ᎬᏩᎵᏃᎮᏗᏍᎨᎢ.
\ft And, behold, there appeared unto them Moses and Elias talking with him.

\ln Quidano unetsv hia nuwesele Tsisa; Tsagvwiyuhi, osiyu ani tsidedoha, iyuno osiyu yitsayelvnv, ani tsoi yidotsilitsodvga, saquo nihi tsatseliga, soino Mosi utseliga, soino Ilaya utseliga.
\syll ᏈᏓᏃ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴ ᏥᏌ; ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎣᏏᏳ ᎠᏂ ᏥᏕᏙᎭ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎣᏏᏳ ᏱᏣᏰᎸᏅ, ᎠᏂ ᏦᎢ ᏱᏙᏥᎵᏦᏛᎦ, ᏌᏉ ᏂᎯ ᏣᏤᎵᎦ, ᏐᎢᏃ ᎼᏏ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᏐᎢᏃ ᎢᎳᏯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ.
\ft Then answered Peter, and said unto Jesus, Lord, it is good for us to be here: if thou wilt, let us make here three tabernacles; one for thee, and one for Moses, and one for Elias.

\syll ᎠᏏᏉᏃ ᎦᏬᏂᏍᎨᎢ, ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎤᏍᎪᏍᏛ ᎤᎶᎩᎳ ᎤᎾᏓᏩᏗᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᏀᎾ ᎤᎶᎩᎸ ᏧᏁᏤᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏅᏧᏪᏎᎢ; ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏇᏥ ᏥᎨᏳᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏏᏳ ᏥᏰᎸᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᏣᏛᏓᏍᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ.
\ft While he yet spake, behold, a bright cloud overshadowed them: and behold a voice out of the cloud, which said, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased; hear ye him.

\ln Gvwasdawadidohino unadvganv duninvtse duniyasdusei, utsati unisgalei.
\syll ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯᏃ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅ ᏚᏂᏅᏤ ᏚᏂᏯᏍᏚᏎᎢ, ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᏂᏍᎦᎴᎢ.

\ln Tsisano ulutse dusvnilei, hia nuwesei; Ditsalehvga, ale tlesdi yitsisgaihesdi.
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᎷᏤ ᏚᏒᏂᎴᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᏗᏣᎴᎲᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏥᏍᎦᎢᎮᏍᏗ.

\ln Dunakananvno vtla gilo yunigohe Tsisa uwasv.
\syll ᏚᎾᎧᎾᏅᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᏳᏂᎪᎮ ᏥᏌ ᎤᏩᏒ.
\ft And when they had lifted up their eyes, they saw no man, save Jesus only.

\ln Tsunigasoasidisvno odalvi tsisa dunvsdadelei, hia nuwesei; Tlesdi gilo etsinonelvha nasgi tsitsigowadv gvni yvwi Uwetsi uyohusv dulenesdi.
\syll ᏧᏂᎦᏐᎠᏏᏗᏒᏃ ᎣᏓᎸᎢ ᏥᏌ ᏚᏅᏍᏓᏕᎴᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᏞᏍᏗ ᎩᎶ ᎡᏥᏃᏁᎸᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏥᎪᏩᏛ ᎬᏂ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎤᏲᎱᏒ ᏚᎴᏁᏍᏗ.

\syll ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯᏃ ᎬᏩᏛᏛᏁᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ; ᎦᏙᏃ ᏗᏃᏪᎵᏍᎩ, ᎢᎳᏯ ᎢᎬᏱ ᏓᎦᎷᏥ, ᏣᎾᏗᏍᎪᎢ?

\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎢᎳᏯ ᎢᎬᏱ ᎤᎷᎯᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏬᏢᎯᏐᏗ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ.
\ft And Jesus answered and said unto them, Elias truly shall first come, and restore all things.

\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ; ᎢᎳᏯ ᎦᏳᎳ ᎤᎷᏨ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᏱᎬᏬᎵᏦᎢ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎤᎾᏚᎵᏍᎬᎢ ᏂᎬᏩᏁᎸ.  ᎾᏍᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏁᎵ.

\ln Hnaquono gvwasdawadidohi unolitse Tsani Didawosgi kaneisdisgvi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎤᏃᎵᏤ ᏣᏂ ᏗᏓᏬᏍᎩ ᎧᏁᎢᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ.

\ln Hnaquono unitsati anedohv unilutsv, ulutselvgi asgaya duliniquanvnelvgi hia nuwesvgi;
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎠᏁᏙᎲ ᎤᏂᎷᏨ, ᎤᎷᏤᎸᎩ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᏚᎵᏂᏆᏅᏁᎸᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ;
\ft And when they were come to the multitude, there came to him a certain man, kneeling down to him, and saying,

\ln Tsagvwiyuhi, hiyadoligi atsutsa aquetsi, gvliyeno gvwahiha, ale utsati agiliyoga, yanogiyuyeno atsilvyi gvdvgoi ale amayi agvgoi.
\syll ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎯᏯᏙᎵᎩ ᎠᏧᏣ ᎠᏇᏥ, ᎬᎵᏰᏃ ᎬᏩᎯᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎠᎩᎵᏲᎦ, ᏯᏃᎩᏳᏰᏃ ᎠᏥᎸᏱ ᎬᏛᎪᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎹᏱ ᎠᎬᎪᎢ.
\ft Lord, have mercy on my son: for he is lunatick, and sore vexed: for ofttimes he falleth into the fire, and oft into the water.

\ln Gatsiyatinohelvgino getsasdawadidohi, aseno uninulvnvgi uninvwodiyi.

\ft And I brought him to thy disciples, and they could not cure him.

\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᏂᏦᎯᏳᏒᎾ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏣᎦᏔᎲᏛ ᎪᎯ ᏥᏤᎭ, ᎢᎳᎪ ᏂᎪᎯᎴᏍᏗ ᎢᏨᏰᎳᏗᏙᎮᏍᏗ?  ᎢᎳᎪ ᏂᎪᎯᎴᏍᏗ ᎤᎾᏁᎳᎩ ᎢᏨᏰᎵᏎᎮᏍᏗ?  ᏍᎩᏯᏘᏃᎯᏏ.

\ln Tsisano asgina usgatsvgi; asginano unugotsvgi atsutsa, ale nahiyuquo udiwasvgi.
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᎠᏍᎩᎾ ᎤᏍᎦᏨᎩ; ᎠᏍᎩᎾᏃ ᎤᏄᎪᏨᎩ ᎠᏧᏣ, ᎠᎴ ᏀᎢᏳᏉ ᎤᏗᏩᏒᎩ.
\ft And Jesus rebuked the devil; and he departed out of him: and the child was cured from that very hour.

\ln Hnaquono gvwasdawadidohi Tsisa gvwalutselvgi unvsv gesvi, hia nuniwesvgi; Gadono tsoginulvnvgi otsinugowisdiyi?
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎬᏩᎷᏤᎸᎩ ᎤᏅᏒ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᎦᏙᏃ ᏦᎩᏄᎸᏅᎩ ᎣᏥᏄᎪᏫᏍᏗᏱ?
\ft Then came the disciples to Jesus apart, and said, Why could not we cast him out?

\ln Tsisano hia niduweselvgi; nvdigalisdodiha nitsohiyusvna gesvi.  Udohiyuhiyayeno hia nitsvweseha; Iyuno yitsohiyuha nasquo atsilvquo ugata igidv, hia yinitsiwesi hia tsodalv, hadanvna itlv wilohi, aha udanvsdi; vtla ale gohusdi yigetsinulvhvsga.
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᏂᏦᎯᏳᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.  ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯᏰᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᏱᏦᎯᏳᎭ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏥᎸᏉ ᎤᎦᏔ ᎢᎩᏛ, ᎯᎠ ᏱᏂᏥᏪᏏ ᎯᎠ ᏦᏓᎸ, ᎭᏓᏅᎾ ᎢᏢ ᏫᎶᎯ, ᎠᎭ ᎤᏓᏅᏍᏗ; ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏱᎨᏥᏄᎸᎲᏍᎦ.
\ft And Jesus said unto them, Because of your unbelief: for verily I say unto you, If ye have faith as a grain of mustard seed, ye shall say unto this mountain, Remove hence to yonder place; and it shall remove; and nothing shall be impossible unto you.

\ln Hiasgininonv iyusdi vtla unugoisdi yigi, gvni yvdadolisdiha ale amatli yagvsga.
\syll ᎯᎠᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏄᎪᎢᏍᏗ ᏱᎩ, ᎬᏂ ᏴᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᎭ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎹᏟ ᏯᎬᏍᎦ.
\ft Howbeit this kind goeth not out but by prayer and fasting.

\ln Asino Gelili anedohvi Tsisa hia niduweselvgi; yvwi Uwetsi yvwi dodagetsiyohiseli,
\syll ᎠᏏᏃ ᎨᎵᎵ ᎠᏁᏙᎲᎢ ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᏴᏫ ᏙᏓᎨᏥᏲᎯᏎᎵ,
\ft And while they abode in Galilee, Jesus said unto them, The Son of man shall be betrayed into the hands of men:

\ln Ale nasgi dagvwali, ale tsoine iga dodvaleni.  Utsatanvhino uyo uniyelvnvgi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏓᎬᏩᎵ, ᎠᎴ ᏦᎢᏁ ᎢᎦ ᏙᏛᎠᎴᏂ.  ᎤᏣᏔᏅᎯᏃ ᎤᏲ ᎤᏂᏰᎸᏅᎩ.
\ft And they shall kill him, and the third day he shall be raised again. And they were exceeding sorry.

\ln Gequanino unilutsv ayeli adelv anigisidohi gvwalutsele Quida, hia nuniwesei; Tlasgo ditseyohvsgi ayeli yaguyisgoi?
\syll ᎨᏆᏂᏃ ᎤᏂᎷᏨ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎠᏕᎸ ᎠᏂᎩᏏᏙᎯ ᎬᏩᎷᏤᎴ ᏈᏓ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ; ᏝᏍᎪ ᏗᏤᏲᎲᏍᎩ ᎠᏰᎵ ᏯᎫᏱᏍᎪᎢ?
\ft And when they were come to Capernaum, they that received tribute money came to Peter, and said, Doth not your master pay tribute?

\ln Vv, udvnei.  Adanelvno ulutsv Tsisa uyosdodanelvgi, hia nuwesvgi; Gado heliha, Sawani; gago ayeli gvwanaguyveho unigvwiyuhi elohi anehi; tsunetsisgo, nvwanadalege?
\syll ᎥᎥ, ᎤᏛᏁᎢ.  ᎠᏓᏁᎸᏃ ᎤᎷᏨ ᏥᏌ ᎤᏲᏍᏙᏓᏁᎸᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎦᏙ ᎮᎵᎭ, ᏌᏩᏂ; ᎦᎪ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎬᏩᎾᎫᏴᎡᎰ ᎤᏂᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎠᏁᎯ; ᏧᏁᏥᏍᎪ, ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴᎨ?
\ft He saith, Yes. And when he was come into the house, Jesus prevented him, saying, What thinkest thou, Simon? of whom do the kings of the earth take custom or tribute? of their own children, or of strangers?

\ln Nvwanadalei, udadoselvgi Quida.  Tsisano hia nuweselvgi; Tsunetsisginigeno unanelagiquo.
\syll ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴᎢ, ᎤᏓᏙᏎᎸᎩ ᏈᏓ.  ᏥᏌᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏧᏁᏥᏍᎩᏂᎨᏃ ᎤᎾᏁᎳᎩᏉ.
\ft Peter saith unto him, Of strangers. Jesus saith unto him, Then are the children free.

\ln Aseno dinihnalvdosdiyi nigesvna, vdali hena, asudino witsadaesvha, igvyiyino hiyvgidv atsadi hinesvha, ale hisduisv aholi ayeliadelv tiwadvhi; nasgi higisvha ale dehinelvha ayv ginaguyvdi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᏗᏂᎿᎸᏙᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎥᏓᎵ ᎮᎾ, ᎠᏑᏗᏃ ᏫᏣᏓᎡᏒᎭ, ᎢᎬᏱᏱᏃ ᎯᏴᎩᏛ ᎠᏣᏗ ᎯᏁᏒᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᏍᏚᎢᏒ ᎠᎰᎵ ᎠᏰᎵᎠᏕᎸ ᏘᏩᏛᎯ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎩᏒᎭ ᎠᎴ ᏕᎯᏁᎸᎭ ᎠᏴ ᎩᎾᎫᏴᏗ.
\ft Notwithstanding, lest we should offend them, go thou to the sea, and cast an hook, and take up the fish that first cometh up; and when thou hast opened his mouth, thou shalt find a piece of money: that take, and give unto them for me and thee.

\ln Nahiyu Tsisa gvwalutselv gvwasdawadidohi, hia nigvwaweselvgi; Gago utlia tsilvquodiyu nahna galvladi ehi ugvwiyuhi gesvi.
\syll ᏀᎢᏳ ᏥᏌ ᎬᏩᎷᏤᎸ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏩᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎦᎪ ᎤᏟᎠ ᏥᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᏀᎾ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft At the same time came the disciples unto Jesus, saying, Who is the greatest in the kingdom of heaven?

\ln Tsisano ayoli wuyanvhv ayeli aninv uwekanvgi, ale hia nuwesvgi;
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᎠᏲᎵ ᏭᏯᏅᎲ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎠᏂᏅ ᎤᏪᎧᏅᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ;
\ft And Jesus called a little child unto him, and set him in the midst of them,

\ln Udohiyuhiya hia nitsvweseha; Iyuno nitsadanetliyvsvna igesesdi, ale diniyoli tsinunasdi nitsalistanvna igesesdi, vtla galvladi ehi ugvwiyuhi gesv yvgetsiyvha.
\syll ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᏂᏣᏓᏁᏟᏴᏒᎾ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏂᏲᎵ ᏥᏄᎾᏍᏗ ᏂᏣᎵᏍᏔᏅᎾ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎥᏝ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏴᎨᏥᏴᎭ.
\ft And said, Verily I say unto you, Except ye be converted, and become as little children, ye shall not enter into the kingdom of heaven.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi gilo udadolisdi gesesdi nasgiya hia ayoli, nasgi utli atsilvquodiyu gesesdi nahna galvladi ehi ugvwiyuhi gesvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏲᎵ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏟ ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏀᎾ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Whosoever therefore shall humble himself as this little child, the same is greatest in the kingdom of heaven.

\ln Ale gilo dadanilvgesdi saquo nasgi hia iyusdi ayoli daquadov nvdigalisdodisgesdi, ayv daquadanilvgesdi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᏓᏓᏂᎸᎨᏍᏗ ᏌᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏲᎵ ᏓᏆᏙᎥ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᏴ ᏓᏆᏓᏂᎸᎨᏍᏗ.
\ft And whoso shall receive one such little child in my name receiveth me.

\ln Gilosgini degodesdisgesdi saquo hia tsunasdiga gesv nasgi gvquohiyuhvsgi, utli osiyu asdosgi nvya yatsiyatlanv, ale asdvgv amequohi yatsigvyv.
\syll ᎩᎶᏍᎩᏂ ᏕᎪᏕᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏌᏉ ᎯᎠ ᏧᎾᏍᏗᎦ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏉᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ, ᎤᏟ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎠᏍᏙᏍᎩ ᏅᏯ ᏯᏥᏯᏝᏅ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏍᏛᎬ ᎠᎺᏉᎯ ᏯᏥᎬᏴ.
\ft But whoso shall offend one of these little ones which believe in me, it were better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck, and that he were drowned in the depth of the sea.

\ln Uniiyu iyulisdanedi gesesdi elohi nvdigalisdodiha dinadadodesdisgi, aseyeno dinadadodesdisgi uninanugoisdi; aseno uyoiyu iyulisdanedi nasgi na asgaya didadodesdisgi unanugowisvhi.
\syll ᎤᏂᎢᏳ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᏗᎾᏓᏙᏕᏍᏗᏍᎩ, ᎠᏎᏰᏃ ᏗᎾᏓᏙᏕᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᎾᏄᎪᎢᏍᏗ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏲᎢᏳ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᏗᏓᏙᏕᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏫᏒᎯ.
\ft Woe unto the world because of offences! for it must needs be that offences come; but woe to that man by whom the offence cometh!

\ln Nasgi iyusdi iyuno tsoyeni ale tsalasideni detsodesdisgesdi, hisqualisgesdi ale witsadegesdi; utli osiyu itsalisdanedi tsoyeni ale tsalasideni tsayohuselvhi yigi gvnidv digesv wiyitsayvlv, ano itsula yitiyesada ale itsula ditsalasideni wiyetsadainv nigvtlosgvna gesv atsilvyi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏳᏃ ᏦᏰᏂ ᎠᎴ ᏣᎳᏏᏕᏂ ᏕᏦᏕᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎯᏍᏆᎵᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏫᏣᏕᎨᏍᏗ; ᎤᏟ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᏦᏰᏂ ᎠᎴ ᏣᎳᏏᏕᏂ ᏣᏲᎱᏎᎸᎯ ᏱᎩ ᎬᏂᏛ ᏗᎨᏒ ᏫᏱᏣᏴᎸ, ᎠᏃ ᎢᏧᎳ ᏱᏘᏰᏌᏓ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏧᎳ ᏗᏣᎳᏏᏕᏂ ᏫᏰᏣᏓᎢᏅ ᏂᎬᏠᏍᎬᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏥᎸᏱ.
\ft Wherefore if thy hand or thy foot offend thee, cut them off, and cast them from thee: it is better for thee to enter into life halt or maimed, rather than having two hands or two feet to be cast into everlasting fire.

\ln Iyu ale higadoli detsodesdisgesdi, hadagatedoisgesdi ale witsadegesdi; utli osiyu itsalisdanedi saquo yikahna gvnidv digesv wiyitsayvlv, ano itsula yitikahna tsvsginoi atsilvyi wiyetsadainv.
\syll ᎢᏳ ᎠᎴ ᎯᎦᏙᎵ ᏕᏦᏕᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎭᏓᎦᏖᏙᎢᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏫᏣᏕᎨᏍᏗ; ᎤᏟ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᏌᏉ ᏱᎧᎿ ᎬᏂᏛ ᏗᎨᏒ ᏫᏱᏣᏴᎸ, ᎠᏃ ᎢᏧᎳ ᏱᏘᎧᎿ ᏨᏍᎩᏃᎢ ᎠᏥᎸᏱ ᏫᏰᏣᏓᎢᏅ.
\ft And if thine eye offend thee, pluck it out, and cast it from thee: it is better for thee to enter into life with one eye, rather than having two eyes to be cast into hell fire.

\ln Itseyatahesdi tsigayetsisotlvtani saquo hia tsunasdiga; hiayeno nitsvweseha; Galvladi tsosv tsunatseliga dinikahnawadidohi nigohilv anigowatisgo ukadv Edoda galvladi ehi.
\syll ᎢᏤᏯᏔᎮᏍᏗ ᏥᎦᏰᏥᏐᏢᏔᏂ ᏌᏉ ᎯᎠ ᏧᎾᏍᏗᎦ; ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ; ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏦᏒ ᏧᎾᏤᎵᎦ ᏗᏂᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎠᏂᎪᏩᏘᏍᎪ ᎤᎧᏛ ᎡᏙᏓ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ.
\ft Take heed that ye despise not one of these little ones; for I say unto you, That in heaven their angels do always behold the face of my Father which is in heaven.

\ln Yvwiyeno Uwetsi ulutsv usdelvhilv ulenalvhi.
\syll ᏴᏫᏰᏃ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎤᎷᏨ ᎤᏍᏕᎸᎯᎸ ᎤᎴᎾᎸᎯ.
\ft For the Son of man is come to save that which was lost.

\ln Gado itseliha; Iyuno gilo asgaya asgohitsuqui awi yidunatlaa, saquono yuleyoelv, tlasgo soonelasgohi soonelagali iyanidv yidigvdegoi, ale yidikanalusidoho gadusi yuyoho uleyoelvhi?
\syll ᎦᏙ ᎢᏤᎵᎭ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏧᏈ ᎠᏫ ᏱᏚᎾᏝᎠ, ᏌᏉᏃ ᏳᎴᏲᎡᎸ, ᏝᏍᎪ ᏐᎣᏁᎳᏍᎪᎯ ᏐᎣᏁᎳᎦᎵ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᏱᏗᎬᏕᎪᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏱᏗᎧᎾᎷᏏᏙᎰ ᎦᏚᏏ ᏳᏲᎰ ᎤᎴᏲᎡᎸᎯ?
\ft How think ye? if a man have an hundred sheep, and one of them be gone astray, doth he not leave the ninety and nine, and goeth into the mountains, and seeketh that which is gone astray?

\ln Iyuno awadv, udohiyuhiya itsvyoseha, utli nigao aliheligo nasgi gesv iyusdi, esgaquo soonelasgohi soonelagali iyanidv nunaleyovna.
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᎠᏩᏛ, ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎢᏨᏲᏎᎭ, ᎤᏟ ᏂᎦᎣ ᎠᎵᎮᎵᎪ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᏐᎣᏁᎳᏍᎪᎯ ᏐᎣᏁᎳᎦᎵ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᏄᎾᎴᏲᎥᎾ.
\ft And if so be that he find it, verily I say unto you, he rejoiceth more of that sheep, than of the ninety and nine which went not astray.

\ln Nasgiya nasquo vtla yuduli Itsidoda galvladi ehi, saquo hia tsunasdiga gesv tsuniyohuhisdiyi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎥᏝ ᏳᏚᎵ ᎢᏥᏙᏓ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ, ᏌᏉ ᎯᎠ ᏧᎾᏍᏗᎦ ᎨᏒ ᏧᏂᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗᏱ.
\ft Even so it is not the will of your Father which is in heaven, that one of these little ones should perish.

\ln Iyuno disdadanvtli itsasganvtsehesdi, hegesdi hinonehesdi usganvtsv isdvsvquo gesvi; iyuno itsadvdasdanehesdi, hiwadvhesdi disdadanvtli.
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᏗᏍᏓᏓᏅᏟ ᎢᏣᏍᎦᏅᏤᎮᏍᏗ, ᎮᎨᏍᏗ ᎯᏃᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᎤᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᎢᏍᏛᏒᏉ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᎢᏣᏛᏓᏍᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ, ᎯᏩᏛᎮᏍᏗ ᏗᏍᏓᏓᏅᏟ.
\ft Moreover if thy brother shall trespass against thee, go and tell him his fault between thee and him alone: if he shall hear thee, thou hast gained thy brother.

\ln Iyusginino nitsadvdasdanehvnaquo igesesdi, asiyvwi ale anitali dehatinegesdi, nasgino aninohesgv anitali ale anitsoi anigatahi nigadv tsanetsv asdayosgesdi.
\syll ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂᏃ ᏂᏣᏛᏓᏍᏓᏁᎲᎾᏉ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᏕᎭᏘᏁᎨᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎠᏂᏃᎮᏍᎬ ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏦᎢ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎯ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏣᏁᏨ ᎠᏍᏓᏲᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
\ft But if he will not hear thee, then take with thee one or two more, that in the mouth of two or three witnesses every word may be established.

\ln Iyuno nasgi nidadvdasdanehvnaquo igesesdi tsunanelodi unadatlugv hinohvsgesdi; iyusginino tsunanelodi unadatlugv nidadvdasdanehvna igesesdi, nvwadalequo yvwi ale ayeliquoadelv agisidohi nasgiya hiyadanvtesgesdi.
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᏓᏛᏓᏍᏓᏁᎲᎾᏉ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬ ᎯᏃᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ; ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂᏃ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬ ᏂᏓᏛᏓᏍᏓᏁᎲᎾ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᏅᏩᏓᎴᏉ ᏴᏫ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏰᎵᏉᎠᏕᎸ ᎠᎩᏏᏙᎯ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎯᏯᏓᏅᏖᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
\ft And if he shall neglect to hear them, tell it unto the church: but if he neglect to hear the church, let him be unto thee as an heathen man and a publican.

\ln Udohiyuhiya hia nitsvweseha; Nigav gohusdi itsalvihesdi elohi, galvsdi gesesdi galvladi; nigavno gohusdi itsalvgisgesdi elohi galvgisdi gesesdi galvladi.
\syll ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ; ᏂᎦᎥ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎢᏣᎸᎢᎮᏍᏗ ᎡᎶᎯ, ᎦᎸᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ; ᏂᎦᎥᏃ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎢᏣᎸᎩᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎦᎸᎩᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ.
\ft Verily I say unto you, Whatsoever ye shall bind on earth shall be bound in heaven: and whatsoever ye shall loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven.

\ln Alewo hia nitsvweseha; iyuno anitali nihi tsitsedoha analigohvsgesdi ani elohi nigavquo gohusdi anitayohihesdi, nasgi iyunadvnedi gesesdi Edoda galvladi ehi.
\syll ᎠᎴᏬ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᏂᎯ ᏥᏤᏙᎭ ᎠᎾᎵᎪᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᏂ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏂᎦᎥᏉ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎠᏂᏔᏲᎯᎮᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎡᏙᏓ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ.
\ft Again I say unto you, That if two of you shall agree on earth as touching any thing that they shall ask, it shall be done for them of my Father which is in heaven.

\ln Ilvhitlvyeno anitali ale anitsoi tsidanilawio ayv daquadov tsinvdigalisdodisgoi, nahna ayeli aquadasuyoi.
\syll ᎢᎸᎯᏢᏰᏃ ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏦᎢ ᏥᏓᏂᎳᏫᎣ ᎠᏴ ᏓᏆᏙᎥ ᏥᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎪᎢ, ᏀᎾ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎠᏆᏓᏑᏲᎢ.
\ft For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there am I in the midst of them.

\ln Hnaquono Quida ulutselv hia nuwesvgi; Tsagvwiyuhi, ilago nagisganvtsehesdi tsosdadanvtli, asiquo itsiyadoligesdi?  Galiquogisgo?
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏈᏓ ᎤᎷᏤᎸ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎢᎳᎪ ᎾᎩᏍᎦᏅᏤᎮᏍᏗ ᏦᏍᏓᏓᏅᏟ, ᎠᏏᏉ ᎢᏥᏯᏙᎵᎨᏍᏗ?  ᎦᎵᏉᎩᏍᎪ?
\ft Then came Peter to him, and said, Lord, how oft shall my brother sin against me, and I forgive him? till seven times?

\ln Tsisa hia nuweselvgi; Vtla galiquogiquo yigvyoseha, galiquasgohisgini galvquogi iyulosvhi.
\syll ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎥᏝ ᎦᎵᏉᎩᏉ ᏱᎬᏲᏎᎭ, ᎦᎵᏆᏍᎪᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎦᎸᏉᎩ ᎢᏳᎶᏒᎯ.
\ft Jesus saith unto him, I say not unto thee, Until seven times: but, Until seventy times seven.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi galvladi ehi ugvwiyuhi gesv nasgiyaquo gilo Ugvwiyuhi tsudanvtele osdv iyunvnediyi dudugv tsunvsidasdi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᏉ ᎩᎶ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏧᏓᏅᏖᎴ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎢᏳᏅᏁᏗᏱ ᏚᏚᎬ ᏧᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ.
\ft Therefore is the kingdom of heaven likened unto a certain king, which would take account of his servants.

\ln Hnaquono unalenvhv osdv nunvnelv, saquo agatinohele asgohi iyuquadinvdv adelv udugi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎤᎾᎴᏅᎲ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏄᏅᏁᎸ, ᏌᏉ ᎠᎦᏘᏃᎮᎴ ᎠᏍᎪᎯ ᎢᏳᏆᏗᏅᏛ ᎠᏕᎸ ᎤᏚᎩ.
\ft And when he had begun to reckon, one was brought unto him, which owed him ten thousand talents.

\ln Aseno gohusdi udayvdodi nuhvna gesv iyusdi, unatlai unetse atsinadinvdiyi ale udalii ale tsuwetsi ale nigav gohusdi uhvi, adayvdiyino.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏓᏴᏙᏗ ᏄᎲᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᎤᎾᏝᎢ ᎤᏁᏤ ᎠᏥᎾᏗᏅᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᎵᎢ ᎠᎴ ᏧᏪᏥ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᎲᎢ, ᎠᏓᏴᏗᏱᏃ.
\ft But forasmuch as he had not to pay, his lord commanded him to be sold, and his wife, and children, and all that he had, and payment to be made.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi atsinvsidasdi eladi udanvnei, ale udadolisdanelei, hia nuwesei; Sginatlai, sgidoligi sgigatida, nigadvno dagvyaguyveli.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎡᎳᏗ ᎤᏓᏅᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎴᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᏍᎩᎾᏝᎢ, ᏍᎩᏙᎵᎩ ᏍᎩᎦᏘᏓ, ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᏓᎬᏯᎫᏴᎡᎵ.
\ft The servant therefore fell down, and worshipped him, saying, Lord, have patience with me, and I will pay thee all.

\ln Nasgino atsinvsidasdi unatlai uwedolitsei, ale uwekanei, ale udugv unelagi uweliselei.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎠᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎤᎾᏝᎢ ᎤᏪᏙᎵᏤᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏪᎧᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏚᎬ ᎤᏁᎳᎩ ᎤᏪᎵᏎᎴᎢ.
\ft Then the lord of that servant was moved with compassion, and loosed him, and forgave him the debt.

\ln Aseno nasgi na atsinvsidasdi unugotsv, uwadvhe asiyvwi itsulaha getsinvsidasdi nasgi unetsvhi uguyvediyi asgohitsuqui agisi tsunagvwalodi; uniyvheno, ale uyvsgiyvhei; squaguyvsi tsigvduga, udvnei.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎤᏄᎪᏨ, ᎤᏩᏛᎮ ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᏨᎯ ᎤᎫᏴᎡᏗᏱ ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏧᏈ ᎠᎩᏏ ᏧᎾᎬᏩᎶᏗ; ᎤᏂᏴᎮᏃ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏴᏍᎩᏴᎮᎢ; ᏍᏆᎫᏴᏏ ᏥᎬᏚᎦ, ᎤᏛᏁᎢ.
\ft But the same servant went out, and found one of his fellowservants, which owed him an hundred pence: and he laid hands on him, and took him by the throat, saying, Pay me that thou owest.

\ln Itsulahano getsinvsidasdi dulasgv eladi udanvne udadolisdanelei, hia nuwesei; Sgidoligi sgigatida, nigadvno dagvyaguyveli.
\syll ᎢᏧᎳᎭᏃ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᏚᎳᏍᎬ ᎡᎳᏗ ᎤᏓᏅᏁ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎴᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᏍᎩᏙᎵᎩ ᏍᎩᎦᏘᏓ, ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᏓᎬᏯᎫᏴᎡᎵ.
\ft And his fellowservant fell down at his feet, and besought him, saying, Have patience with me, and I will pay thee all.

\ln Aseno vtla yuwohiyunei, didasdudiyiquo wulosei, ale nahna wuyvtane uguyvdiyi atsidugv igohidv.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏳᏬᎯᏳᏁᎢ, ᏗᏓᏍᏚᏗᏱᏉ ᏭᎶᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏀᎾ ᏭᏴᏔᏁ ᎤᎫᏴᏗᏱ ᎠᏥᏚᎬ ᎢᎪᎯᏛ.
\ft And he would not: but went and cast him into prison, till he should pay the debt.

\ln Naquono nasgi itsulaha getsinvsidasdi unadolehosv nulistanvi utsati uyo uniyelvnei, ale unilutse uninonele tsuninatlai nigadv nulistanidolvi.
\syll ᎾᏉᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎤᎾᏙᎴᎰᏒ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎢ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᏲ ᎤᏂᏰᎸᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᎷᏤ ᎤᏂᏃᏁᎴ ᏧᏂᎾᏝᎢ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏂᏙᎸᎢ.
\ft So when his fellowservants saw what was done, they were very sorry, and came and told unto their lord all that was done.

\ln Hnaquono unatlai wuyanvhv hia nuweselei; tsanegutsidv gvnvsidasdi, unelagi gvyeliselvgi nigadv nihi tsigvdugvgi, sgitayoselv iyusdi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎤᎾᏝᎢ ᏭᏯᏅᎲ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᏣᏁᎫᏥᏛ ᎬᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ, ᎤᏁᎳᎩ ᎬᏰᎵᏎᎸᎩ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏂᎯ ᏥᎬᏚᎬᎩ, ᏍᎩᏔᏲᏎᎸ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ.
\ft Then his lord, after that he had called him, said unto him, O thou wicked servant, I forgave thee all that debt, because thou desiredst me:

\ln Tlasgo nasquo nihi gahiyadolisdi yigese itsulaha esdinvsidasdi, nasgiya gvyadolitsvi?
\syll ᏝᏍᎪ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏂᎯ ᎦᎯᏯᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᏱᎨᏎ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎡᏍᏗᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎬᏯᏙᎵᏨᎢ?
\ft Shouldest not thou also have had compassion on thy fellowservant, even as I had pity on thee?

\ln Utalawuseno unatlai, ale widuyohisele dinadasduhvsgi uguyvhohvsdiyi nigadv atsidugv igohidv.
\syll ᎤᏔᎳᏭᏎᏃ ᎤᎾᏝᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏫᏚᏲᎯᏎᎴ ᏗᎾᏓᏍᏚᎲᏍᎩ ᎤᎫᏴᎰᎲᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎠᏥᏚᎬ ᎢᎪᎯᏛ.
\ft And his lord was wroth, and delivered him to the tormentors, till he should pay all that was due unto him.

\ln Nasgiya nasquo nvdatsvyvneli edoda galvladi ehi, iyuno ditsadanvdv iyvdv itsisiyvwiha gesv niditsidoligvna igesesdi itsadanvtli unisganvtsvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏅᏓᏨᏴᏁᎵ ᎡᏙᏓ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᏗᏣᏓᏅᏛ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎢᏥᏏᏴᏫᎭ ᎨᏒ ᏂᏗᏥᏙᎵᎬᎾ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏟ ᎤᏂᏍᎦᏅᏨᎢ.
\ft So likewise shall my heavenly Father do also unto you, if ye from your hearts forgive not every one his brother their trespasses.

\ln Hiano nulistanvgi, Tsisa usquadv nasgi hia nigawesgvi, Gelili udanvsvgi, Tsudiyi asdv wulutsvgi Tsodani asgoniditlv.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎩ, ᏥᏌ ᎤᏍᏆᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎬᎢ, ᎨᎵᎵ ᎤᏓᏅᏒᎩ, ᏧᏗᏱ ᎠᏍᏛ ᏭᎷᏨᎩ ᏦᏓᏂ ᎠᏍᎪᏂᏗᏢ.
\ft And it came to pass, that when Jesus had finished these sayings, he departed from Galilee, and came into the coasts of Judaea beyond Jordan;

\ln Unitsatino gvwasdawadvsvgi, ale nahna dunvwanvgi.
\syll ᎤᏂᏣᏘᏃ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏛᏒᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏀᎾ ᏚᏅᏩᏅᎩ.
\ft And great multitudes followed him; and he healed them there.

\ln Aniqualisi nasquo gvwalutselv gvwagoliyesgvgi, hia nigvwawesehvgi; Duyugodisgo asgaya udainvdiyi udalii nigavquo gohusdi yvdiliyeilvsdiha?
\syll ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎬᏩᎷᏤᎸ ᎬᏩᎪᎵᏰᏍᎬᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏩᏪᏎᎲᎩ; ᏚᏳᎪᏗᏍᎪ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᏓᎢᏅᏗᏱ ᎤᏓᎵᎢ ᏂᎦᎥᏉ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏴᏗᎵᏰᎢᎸᏍᏗᎭ?
\ft The Pharisees also came unto him, tempting him, and saying unto him, Is it lawful for a man to put away his wife for every cause?

\ln Unetsvno hia niduweselvgi; Tlasgo yitsigoliyeo, nasgi didalenisgv tsuwetlvnvhi asgaya ale ageyv duwotlvnvi?
\syll ᎤᏁᏨᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏝᏍᎪ ᏱᏥᎪᎵᏰᎣ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏓᎴᏂᏍᎬ ᏧᏪᏢᏅᎯ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎨᏴ ᏚᏬᏢᏅᎢ?
\ft And he answered and said unto them, Have ye not read, that he which made them at the beginning made them male and female,

\ln Ale hia nuwesvi; Nasgi iyusdi asgaya degvdegesdi udoda ale utsi, ale adlawisdisgesdi udalii, ale nasgi anitali saquoquo uniquedalvi?
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᏕᎬᏕᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᏙᏓ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏥ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏜᏫᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᏓᎵᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᏌᏉᏉ ᎤᏂᏇᏓᎸᎢ?
\ft And said, For this cause shall a man leave father and mother, and shall cleave to his wife: and they twain shall be one flesh?

\ln Nasgi iyusdi vtla hnaquo anitali yigi; saquoquosgini uniquedalvi.  Nasgi iyusdi Unelanvhi tsuwudatanvhi gesv tlesdi yvwi yidugalenvtanesdi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎥᏝ ᎿᏉ ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᏱᎩ; ᏌᏉᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏂᏇᏓᎸᎢ.  ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᏭᏓᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏴᏫ ᏱᏚᎦᎴᏅᏔᏁᏍᏗ.
\ft Wherefore they are no more twain, but one flesh. What therefore God hath joined together, let not man put asunder.

\ln Hiano nvgvwaweselvgi; Gadono Yisi tsunetse goweli ganvnediyi digalenvdodi, ale agehidasdiyi?
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏅᎬᏩᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎦᏙᏃ ᏱᏏ ᏧᏁᏤ ᎪᏪᎵ ᎦᏅᏁᏗᏱ ᏗᎦᎴᏅᏙᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎨᎯᏓᏍᏗᏱ?
\ft They say unto him, Why did Moses then command to give a writing of divorcement, and to put her away?

\ln Hiano niduweselvgi; disdayiyu gesv iyusdi ditsinawi Mosi unanelagi danigedohihesdi tsunadalii, itseliselvgi; didalenisgvsgini vtla nasgi yinusdei.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏗᏍᏓᏱᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏗᏥᎾᏫ ᎼᏏ ᎤᎾᏁᎳᎩ ᏓᏂᎨᏙᎯᎮᏍᏗ ᏧᎾᏓᎵᎢ, ᎢᏤᎵᏎᎸᎩ; ᏗᏓᎴᏂᏍᎬᏍᎩᏂ ᎥᏝ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᏄᏍᏕᎢ.
\ft He saith unto them, Moses because of the hardness of your hearts suffered you to put away your wives: but from the beginning it was not so.

\ln Aseno hia nitsvweseha; Gilo udalii iagehidohesdi tsunisinvhisgininonv igesesdi, nvwadaleno iadayegesdi, adayonehesdi.  Gilono atsigehidolvhi adayegesdi adayonehesdi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ; ᎩᎶ ᎤᏓᎵᎢ ᎢᎠᎨᎯᏙᎮᏍᏗ ᏧᏂᏏᏅᎯᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᏅᏩᏓᎴᏃ ᎢᎠᏓᏰᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᏓᏲᏁᎮᏍᏗ.  ᎩᎶᏃ ᎠᏥᎨᎯᏙᎸᎯ ᎠᏓᏰᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᏓᏲᏁᎮᏍᏗ.
\ft And I say unto you, Whosoever shall put away his wife, except it be for fornication, and shall marry another, committeth adultery: and whoso marrieth her which is put away doth commit adultery.

\ln Gvwasdawadidohi hia nigvwaweselvgi; Iyuno nasgi yinusdi asgaya udalii danatsehvi, vtla osiyu yigi adesvhvsdiyi.
\syll ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏩᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᏄᏍᏗ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᏓᎵᎢ ᏓᎾᏤᎲᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎣᏏᏳ ᏱᎩ ᎠᏕᏒᎲᏍᏗᏱ.
\ft His disciples say unto him, If the case of the man be so with his wife, it is not good to marry.

\ln Hiano niduweselvgi, Vtla naniv hia tsinitsi wi yidogvnadanilvgi, gegalisgolvdanelvhi unvsv.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ, ᎥᏝ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᏥ Ꮻ ᏱᏙᎬᎾᏓᏂᎸᎩ, ᎨᎦᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᎤᏅᏒ.
\ft But he said unto them, All men cannot receive this saying, save they to whom it is given.

\ln Anehayeno aninali nvwanasdo tsunitsi gvwaninanugowisv, ale aneha aninali yvwi gvwaninalidvhi, ale aneha aninali unvsv unadanalidvhi galvladi ehi ugvwiyuhi gesv diliyeilvsdisgvi.  Gilo digvwadanilvisdi gesesdi nasgi dadanilvgesdi.
\syll ᎠᏁᎭᏰᏃ ᎠᏂᎾᎵ ᏅᏩᎾᏍᏙ ᏧᏂᏥ ᎬᏩᏂᎾᏄᎪᏫᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏁᎭ ᎠᏂᎾᎵ ᏴᏫ ᎬᏩᏂᎾᎵᏛᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏁᎭ ᎠᏂᎾᎵ ᎤᏅᏒ ᎤᎾᏓᎾᎵᏛᎯ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏗᎵᏰᎢᎸᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ.  ᎩᎶ ᏗᎬᏩᏓᏂᎸᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏓᏓᏂᎸᎨᏍᏗ.
\ft For there are some eunuchs, which were so born from their mother's womb: and there are some eunuchs, which were made eunuchs of men: and there be eunuchs, which have made themselves eunuchs for the kingdom of heaven's sake. He that is able to receive it, let him receive it.

\ln Hnaquono dagatinohelvgi tsunasdi diniyoli nasgi tsusitadisdiyi ale udadolisdodiyi; gvwasdawadidohino duninvsdadelvgi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏓᎦᏘᏃᎮᎸᎩ ᏧᎾᏍᏗ ᏗᏂᏲᎵ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏏᏔᏗᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ; ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯᏃ ᏚᏂᏅᏍᏓᏕᎸᎩ.
\ft Then were there brought unto him little children, that he should put his hands on them, and pray: and the disciples rebuked them.

\ln Tsisano hia nuwesvgi; Unanelagi ditselisi tsunasdi diniyoli, ale tlesdi ditsinvsdadelvgi gvgilutsediyi; nasgiyeno nunasdi galvladi ehi ugvwiyuhi gesv.
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎤᎾᏁᎳᎩ ᏗᏤᎵᏏ ᏧᎾᏍᏗ ᏗᏂᏲᎵ, ᎠᎴ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏗᏥᏅᏍᏓᏕᎸᎩ ᎬᎩᎷᏤᏗᏱ; ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᏄᎾᏍᏗ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ.
\ft But Jesus said, Suffer little children, and forbid them not, to come unto me: for of such is the kingdom of heaven.

\ln Dusitadvno nahna udanvsvgi.
\syll ᏚᏏᏔᏛᏃ ᏀᎾ ᎤᏓᏅᏒᎩ.
\ft And he laid his hands on them, and departed thence.

\ln Gvniyuquono asiyvwi ulutselvgi hia nuweselvgi; Hosdv Tadeyohvsgi, gado usdi osdv gohusdi dagadvneli agiwadvdodi winasdvna gvnidv?
\syll ᎬᏂᏳᏉᏃ ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᎤᎷᏤᎸᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎰᏍᏛ ᏔᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ, ᎦᏙ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏓᎦᏛᏁᎵ ᎠᎩᏩᏛᏙᏗ ᏫᎾᏍᏛᎾ ᎬᏂᏛ?
\ft And, behold, one came and said unto him, Good Master, what good thing shall I do, that I may have eternal life?

\ln Hiano nuweselvgi; Gadono hosdv isquoseha?  Vtla gilo osdv yigi saquo uwasvhiyu, nasgi Unelanvhi.  Aseno tsadulisgesdi gvnidv digesv witsananugoisdiyi tisquanigoda dikahnawadvsdi.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎦᏙᏃ ᎰᏍᏛ ᎢᏍᏉᏎᎭ?  ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏱᎩ ᏌᏉ ᎤᏩᏒᎯᏳ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ.  ᎠᏎᏃ ᏣᏚᎵᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎬᏂᏛ ᏗᎨᏒ ᏫᏣᎾᏄᎪᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᏘᏍᏆᏂᎪᏓ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ.
\ft And he said unto him, Why callest thou me good? there is none good but one, that is, God: but if thou wilt enter into life, keep the commandments.

\ln Hia nuweselvgi; Gado usdi?  Tsisa hia nuweegi; Hia, Tlesdi tsadalvgi; Tlesdi tsadayonelvgi; Tlesdi tsanosgisvgi; danadayilidohv Tlesdi gayegogi tsanohelvgi;
\syll ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎦᏙ ᎤᏍᏗ?  ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᎡᎩ; ᎯᎠ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᏣᏓᎸᎩ; ᏞᏍᏗ ᏣᏓᏲᏁᎸᎩ; ᏞᏍᏗ ᏣᏃᏍᎩᏒᎩ; ᏓᎾᏓᏱᎵᏙᎲ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎦᏰᎪᎩ ᏣᏃᎮᎸᎩ;
\ft He saith unto him, Which? Jesus said, Thou shalt do no murder, Thou shalt not commit adultery, Thou shalt not steal, Thou shalt not bear false witness,

\ln Hilvquodesdi tsadoda ale tsatsi; ale nasquo hia; Tsvsv nitsadageyusv nigeyusesdi nav idisdadala.
\syll ᎯᎸᏉᏕᏍᏗ ᏣᏙᏓ ᎠᎴ ᏣᏥ; ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎯᎠ; ᏨᏒ ᏂᏣᏓᎨᏳᏒ ᏂᎨᏳᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᎥ ᎢᏗᏍᏓᏓᎳ.
\ft Honour thy father and thy mother: and, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.

\ln Awinv hia nuweselvgi; Hia nasgi nigadv dagikahnawadenv tsitsutsa gesv nvdagvwadalenvdv, gado asi agilula?
\syll ᎠᏫᏅ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏓᎩᎧᎿᏩᏕᏅ ᏥᏧᏣ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏓᎴᏅᏛ, ᎦᏙ ᎠᏏ ᎠᎩᎷᎳ?
\ft The young man saith unto him, All these things have I kept from my youth up: what lack I yet?

\ln Tsisa hia nuweselvgi; Iyuno tsasquadisdiyi tsadulisgesdi, hena, winaduga tsahnavi, ale tihvsi uyo iyunadvhnadegi, galvladino witsahesdi tsugvwalodi; ale tesv sgisdawadesvha.
\syll ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᏣᏍᏆᏗᏍᏗᏱ ᏣᏚᎵᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎮᎾ, ᏫᎾᏚᎦ ᏣᎿᎥᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏘᎲᏏ ᎤᏲ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᎿᏕᎩ, ᎦᎸᎳᏗᏃ ᏫᏣᎮᏍᏗ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ; ᎠᎴ ᏖᏒ ᏍᎩᏍᏓᏩᏕᏒᎭ.
\ft Jesus said unto him, If thou wilt be perfect, go and sell that thou hast, and give to the poor, and thou shalt have treasure in heaven: and come and follow me.

\ln Aseno awinv nasgi udvganv udanvsvgi uyoiyu uyelvnvgi, utsatiyeno uwehnaiyu gesvgi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᏫᏅ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏛᎦᏅ ᎤᏓᏅᏒᎩ ᎤᏲᎢᏳ ᎤᏰᎸᏅᎩ, ᎤᏣᏘᏰᏃ ᎤᏪᎿᎢᏳ ᎨᏒᎩ.
\ft But when the young man heard that saying, he went away sorrowful: for he had great possessions.

\ln Hnaquono tsisa hia niduweselv gvwasdawadidohi; Udohiyuhiya hia nitsvweseha; uwehnai yvwi asdayiyu wuyvsdiyi galvladi ehi ugvwiyuhi gesvi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ; ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ; ᎤᏪᎿᎢ ᏴᏫ ᎠᏍᏓᏱᏳ ᏭᏴᏍᏗᏱ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Then said Jesus unto his disciples, Verily I say unto you, That a rich man shall hardly enter into the kingdom of heaven.

\ln Alewo hia nitsvweseha; utli ahidiyu gemili ugadvlehisdiyi yvgi gasinenadvdiyi esgaquo uwehnai yvwi wuyvsdiyi Unelanvhi ugvwiyuhi gesvi.
\syll ᎠᎴᏬ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ; ᎤᏟ ᎠᎯᏗᏳ ᎨᎻᎵ ᎤᎦᏛᎴᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏴᎩ ᎦᏏᏁᎾᏛᏗᏱ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎤᏪᎿᎢ ᏴᏫ ᏭᏴᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft And again I say unto you, It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.

\ln Gvwasdawadidohino unadvganv utsatanvhi unisquanigosvgi, hia nuniwesvgi Gagono yeli yatsisdelv?
\syll ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯᏃ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅ ᎤᏣᏔᏅᎯ ᎤᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏒᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ ᎦᎪᏃ ᏰᎵ ᏯᏥᏍᏕᎸ?
\ft When his disciples heard it, they were exceedingly amazed, saying, Who then can be saved?

\ln Tsisano nasgi dukahnanv hia niduweselvgi; Yvwi gesv vtla nasgi yinvgalisda, Unelanvhisgini gesv nigav gohusdi iyulisdodiquo.
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᎧᎿᏅ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏴᏫ ᎨᏒ ᎥᏝ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᏅᎦᎵᏍᏓ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏒ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏉ.
\ft But Jesus beheld them, and said unto them, With men this is impossible; but with God all things are possible.

\ln Hnaquono Quida unetsv hia nuweselvgi; Gvniyuquo ayv nigadiyu dogiyosonv ale itsvsdawadenv; gadono ayv dayotsiwadvhi?
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏈᏓ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎠᏴ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏙᎩᏲᏐᏅ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏨᏍᏓᏩᏕᏅ; ᎦᏙᏃ ᎠᏴ ᏓᏲᏥᏩᏛᎯ?
\ft Then answered Peter and said unto him, Behold, we have forsaken all, and followed thee; what shall we have therefore?

\ln Tsisano hia niduweselvgi; Udohiyuhiya hia nitsvweseha; adanetliyvsvi, Yvwi Uwetsi ganvha galvquodiyu uwesgilvi, nihi sgisdawadvdv nasquo itsinesdi taladu degasgilvi, detsugodanehesdi taladu nanilasdalv Isili.
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ; ᎠᏓᏁᏟᏴᏒᎢ, ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎦᏅᎭ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎤᏪᏍᎩᎸᎢ, ᏂᎯ ᏍᎩᏍᏓᏩᏛᏛ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎢᏥᏁᏍᏗ ᏔᎳᏚ ᏕᎦᏍᎩᎸᎢ, ᏕᏧᎪᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᏔᎳᏚ ᎾᏂᎳᏍᏓᎸ ᎢᏏᎵ.
\ft And Jesus said unto them, Verily I say unto you, That ye which have followed me, in the regeneration when the Son of man shall sit in the throne of his glory, ye also shall sit upon twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.

\ln Ale naniv gilo tsunvdetsvhi daninelvi, ale analinvtli ale tsunido, ale tsunidoda, ale tsunitsi, ale tsunadalii, ale tsunetsi, ale gadohi, daquadov nvdigalisdodisgesdi, uniwadvdi gesesdi asgohitsuqui unequotsvhi, ale unatseli iyulisdodi gesesdi gvnidv winasdvna.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎩᎶ ᏧᏅᏕᏨᎯ ᏓᏂᏁᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏟ ᎠᎴ ᏧᏂᏙ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏂᏙᏓ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏂᏥ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᎾᏓᎵᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏁᏥ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᏙᎯ, ᏓᏆᏙᎥ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎤᏂᏩᏛᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏧᏈ ᎤᏁᏉᏨᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏤᎵ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎬᏂᏛ ᏫᎾᏍᏛᎾ.
\ft And every one that hath forsaken houses, or brethren, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or lands, for my name's sake, shall receive an hundredfold, and shall inherit everlasting life.

\ln Aseno unitsata igvyi tsigi oniyi gesesdi; oniyino tsigi igvyiigesesdi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏂᏣᏔ ᎢᎬᏱ ᏥᎩ ᎣᏂᏱ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᎣᏂᏱᏃ ᏥᎩ ᎢᎬᏱᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft But many that are first shall be last; and the last shall be first.

\ln Galvladiyeno utseligohi nasgiyaquo asgaya ganela, sunaleiyu tsuwenvse tsidunvsvse gohusdi anadvnehi telvladi duwisv tsunilvwisdanediyi.
\syll ᎦᎸᎳᏗᏰᏃ ᎤᏤᎵᎪᎯ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᏉ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎦᏁᎳ, ᏑᎾᎴᎢᏳ ᏧᏪᏅᏎ ᏥᏚᏅᏒᏎ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎠᎾᏛᏁᎯ ᏖᎸᎳᏗ ᏚᏫᏒ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ.
\ft For the kingdom of heaven is like unto a man that is an householder, which went out early in the morning to hire labourers into his vineyard.

\ln Hnaquono nasgi asgaya gohusdi anadvnehi dunugotanv agisi tsugvwalodi tsuguyvediyi siga, telvladi dotsuwisv dunvsei.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎠᎾᏛᏁᎯ ᏚᏄᎪᏔᏅ ᎠᎩᏏ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᏧᎫᏴᎡᏗᏱ ᏏᎦ, ᏖᎸᎳᏗ ᏙᏧᏫᏒ ᏚᏅᏎᎢ.
\ft And when he had agreed with the labourers for a penny a day, he sent them into his vineyard.

\ln Uwenvseno sooneline iyutlilodv kalawadisvi, ale dugohe nvwanadale ganododiyi anidonae gohusdi nanadvhvna,
\syll ᎤᏪᏅᏎᏃ ᏐᎣᏁᎵᏁ ᎢᏳᏟᎶᏛ ᎧᎳᏩᏗᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᎪᎮ ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴ ᎦᏃᏙᏗᏱ ᎠᏂᏙᎾᎡ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎾᎾᏛᎲᎾ,
\ft And he went out about the third hour, and saw others standing idle in the marketplace,

\ln Ale hia niduweselei; Itsena nasquo nihi telvladi dodiwisvi, duyugodvno gesv datsvyaguyveli.  Unenvseno.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎢᏤᎾ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏂᎯ ᏖᎸᎳᏗ ᏙᏗᏫᏒᎢ, ᏚᏳᎪᏛᏃ ᎨᏒ ᏓᏨᏯᎫᏴᎡᎵ.  ᎤᏁᏅᏎᏃ.
\ft And said unto them; Go ye also into the vineyard, and whatsoever is right I will give you. And they went their way.

\ln Taline iga iuwenvse ale nasquo tsoine iyutlilodv kalawadisv usvhiyeyi, nasgiya niudvnelei.
\syll ᏔᎵᏁ ᎢᎦ ᎢᎤᏪᏅᏎ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏦᎢᏁ ᎢᏳᏟᎶᏛ ᎧᎳᏩᏗᏒ ᎤᏒᎯᏰᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏂᎤᏛᏁᎴᎢ.
\ft Again he went out about the sixth and ninth hour, and did likewise.

\ln Hisgineno iyutlilodv kalawadisv taline iuwenvsei, ale duwadvhe nvwanadale anidonae gohusdi nanadvnehvna, hiano niduweselei; Gadono ani itsidonaa udodaquadv gohusdi nitsadvnehvna?
\syll ᎯᏍᎩᏁᏃ ᎢᏳᏟᎶᏛ ᎧᎳᏩᏗᏒ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎢᎤᏪᏅᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏩᏛᎮ ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴ ᎠᏂᏙᎾᎡ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎾᎾᏛᏁᎲᎾ, ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎦᏙᏃ ᎠᏂ ᎢᏥᏙᎾᎠ ᎤᏙᏓᏆᏛ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎲᎾ?
\ft And about the eleventh hour he went out, and found others standing idle, and saith unto them, Why stand ye here all the day idle?

\ln Tlayena gilo yoginvsv, unadvnei.  Hiano niduweselei; Nihi nasquo itsena telvladi dodiwisvi; duyugodvno gesv datsvyaguyveli.
\syll ᏝᏰᎾ ᎩᎶ ᏲᎩᏅᏒ, ᎤᎾᏛᏁᎢ.  ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᏂᎯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎢᏤᎾ ᏖᎸᎳᏗ ᏙᏗᏫᏒᎢ; ᏚᏳᎪᏛᏃ ᎨᏒ ᏓᏨᏯᎫᏴᎡᎵ.
\ft They say unto him, Because no man hath hired us. He saith unto them, Go ye also into the vineyard; and whatsoever is right, that shall ye receive.

\ln Usvno nulistanv, telvladi dawisv utseliga hia nuwesele adelv ugatidehi, Witiyanv gohusdi anadvnehi ale taguyvsi dunilvwisdanelvi, oniyi getsinvsvhi talenvda igvyiyino getsinvsvhi tisqualvda
\syll ᎤᏒᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ, ᏖᎸᎳᏗ ᏓᏫᏒ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴ ᎠᏕᎸ ᎤᎦᏘᏕᎯ, ᏫᏘᏯᏅ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎠᎾᏛᏁᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏔᎫᏴᏏ ᏚᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸᎢ, ᎣᏂᏱ ᎨᏥᏅᏒᎯ ᏔᎴᏅᏓ ᎢᎬᏱᏱᏃ ᎨᏥᏅᏒᎯ ᏘᏍᏆᎸᏓ
\ft So when even was come, the lord of the vineyard saith unto his steward, Call the labourers, and give them their hire, beginning from the last unto the first.

\ln Hisgineno iyutlilodv kalawadisv getsinvsvhi unilutsv, anisiyvwiha agisi tsugvwalodi gegaguyvelei.
\syll ᎯᏍᎩᏁᏃ ᎢᏳᏟᎶᏛ ᎧᎳᏩᏗᏒ ᎨᏥᏅᏒᎯ ᎤᏂᎷᏨ, ᎠᏂᏏᏴᏫᎭ ᎠᎩᏏ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎨᎦᎫᏴᎡᎴᎢ.
\ft And when they came that were hired about the eleventh hour, they received every man a penny.

\ln Igvyiyino getsinvsvhi unilutsv utli igai dayogaguyveli unelisei.  Aseno nasquo agisiquo tsugvwalodi anisiyvwiha igegaguyvelei.
\syll ᎢᎬᏱᏱᏃ ᎨᏥᏅᏒᎯ ᎤᏂᎷᏨ ᎤᏟ ᎢᎦᎢ ᏓᏲᎦᎫᏴᎡᎵ ᎤᏁᎵᏎᎢ.  ᎠᏎᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᎩᏏᏉ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎠᏂᏏᏴᏫᎭ ᎢᎨᎦᎫᏴᎡᎴᎢ.
\ft But when the first came, they supposed that they should have received more; and they likewise received every man a penny.

\ln Gegaguyvelvno, unigonelohiselequo asgaya ganela,
\syll ᎨᎦᎫᏴᎡᎸᏃ, ᎤᏂᎪᏁᎶᎯᏎᎴᏉ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎦᏁᎳ,
\ft And when they had received it, they murmured against the goodman of the house,

\ln Hia nuniwesei; Hia oniyi unilutsvhi saquoquo iyutlilodv dunilvwisdasi, itsulahaquono nvsgiyvga ayv nasgi gagesv ale udilegv iga tsogilvwisdanelvhi.
\syll ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ; ᎯᎠ ᎣᏂᏱ ᎤᏂᎷᏨᎯ ᏌᏉᏉ ᎢᏳᏟᎶᏛ ᏚᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏏ, ᎢᏧᎳᎭᏉᏃ ᏅᏍᎩᏴᎦ ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏗᎴᎬ ᎢᎦ ᏦᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸᎯ.
\ft Saying, These last have wrought but one hour, and thou hast made them equal unto us, which have borne the burden and heat of the day.

\ln Aseno asiyvwi unetsele hia nuweselei; Ginalii, vtla utsatini yinigvyvneha.  Tlasgo osi yitsayelvne agisi tsugvwalodi gvyaguyvediyi?
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᎤᏁᏤᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎩᎾᎵᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎤᏣᏘᏂ ᏱᏂᎬᏴᏁᎭ.  ᏝᏍᎪ ᎣᏏ ᏱᏣᏰᎸᏁ ᎠᎩᏏ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎬᏯᎫᏴᎡᏗᏱ?
\ft But he answered one of them, and said, Friend, I do thee no wrong: didst not thou agree with me for a penny?

\ln Higi tsatseliga ale tsihena.  Osi agiyelv tsiyaguyvediyi hia oniyi ulutsvhi nihi gvyaguyvelv igai.
\syll ᎯᎩ ᏣᏤᎵᎦ ᎠᎴ ᏥᎮᎾ.  ᎣᏏ ᎠᎩᏰᎸ ᏥᏯᎫᏴᎡᏗᏱ ᎯᎠ ᎣᏂᏱ ᎤᎷᏨᎯ ᏂᎯ ᎬᏯᎫᏴᎡᎸ ᎢᎦᎢ.
\ft Take that thine is, and go thy way: I will give unto this last, even as unto thee.

\ln Tlasgo duyugodv yigi nusdv gadanvtesgv iyaquvnediyi aquatseli gesvi?  Tsisa higadoli uyoiyu igi nvdigalisdodi ayv aquadanvtiyu gesvi?
\syll ᏝᏍᎪ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᏱᎩ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎦᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ ᎢᏯᏋᏁᏗᏱ ᎠᏆᏤᎵ ᎨᏒᎢ?  ᏥᏌ ᎯᎦᏙᎵ ᎤᏲᎢᏳ ᎢᎩ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᎠᏴ ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏘᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ?
\ft Is it not lawful for me to do what I will with mine own? Is thine eye evil, because I am good?

\ln Howano oniyi tsigi igvyi gesesdi, igvyino tsigi oniyi gesesdi.  Unitsatayeno getsiyanvhv, aseno anigayoliyu gegasuyesv.
\syll ᎰᏩᏃ ᎣᏂᏱ ᏥᎩ ᎢᎬᏱ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎢᎬᏱᏃ ᏥᎩ ᎣᏂᏱ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.  ᎤᏂᏣᏔᏰᏃ ᎨᏥᏯᏅᎲ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᏂᎦᏲᎵᏳ ᎨᎦᏑᏰᏒ.
\ft So the last shall be first, and the first last: for many be called, but few chosen.

\ln Tsisano Tsilusilimi wagadvi, taladu iyanidv anadasdawadidohi unanelagi iyvdv widutinvstanvgi, ale hia niduweselvgi;
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᏩᎦᏛᎢ, ᏔᎳᏚ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᎠᎾᏓᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎤᎾᏁᎳᎩ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏫᏚᏘᏅᏍᏔᏅᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ;
\ft And Jesus going up to Jerusalem took the twelve disciples apart in the way, and said unto them,

\ln Gvniyuquo Tsilusilimi widigati, ale yvwi Uwetsi dodayetsiyosi dodagetsoyohiseli nunigvwiyusv atsilvanelohi ale dinowelisgi, nasgino dodvnugolani uyohuhisdiyi,
\syll ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᏫᏗᎦᏘ, ᎠᎴ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᏙᏓᏰᏥᏲᏏ ᏙᏓᎨᏦᏲᎯᏎᎵ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏃᏪᎵᏍᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏙᏛᏄᎪᎳᏂ ᎤᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗᏱ,
\ft Behold, we go up to Jerusalem; and the Son of man shall be betrayed unto the chief priests and unto the scribes, and they shall condemn him to death,

\ln Ale gunasilenvdv yvwi dodvniyohiseli uniwetlvnanediyi, ale unilivnisdiyi, ale unadvdiyi tsudahnawadv gedvi; ale tsoine iga dodvaleni.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎫᎾᏏᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᏙᏛᏂᏲᎯᏎᎵ ᎤᏂᏪᏢᎾᏁᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᎵᎥᏂᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏛᏗᏱ ᏧᏓᎿᏩᏛ ᎨᏛᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᏦᎢᏁ ᎢᎦ ᏙᏛᎠᎴᏂ.
\ft And shall deliver him to the Gentiles to mock, and to scourge, and to crucify him: and the third day he shall rise again.

\ln Hnaquono ulutselvgi Tsequiti tsuwetsi unitsi, datinehvgi tsuwetsi aniwinv, eladi udanvnvgi, ale ahusdi utayosehvgi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎤᎷᏤᎸᎩ ᏤᏈᏘ ᏧᏪᏥ ᎤᏂᏥ, ᏓᏘᏁᎲᎩ ᏧᏪᏥ ᎠᏂᏫᏅ, ᎡᎳᏗ ᎤᏓᏅᏅᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏔᏲᏎᎲᎩ.
\ft Then came to him the mother of Zebedee's children with her sons, worshipping him, and desiring a certain thing of him.

\ln Hiano nuweselvgi; Gado tsaduliha?  Hia nvdayuweselvgi; Halisgolvda hia anitali diquetsi tsunidiyi tsatseligohi gesvi, saquo higatisi iditlv, soino higasgani.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎦᏙ ᏣᏚᎵᎭ?  ᎯᎠ ᏅᏓᏳᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎭᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᏗᏇᏥ ᏧᏂᏗᏱ ᏣᏤᎵᎪᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏌᏉ ᎯᎦᏘᏏ ᎢᏗᏢ, ᏐᎢᏃ ᎯᎦᏍᎦᏂ.
\ft And he said unto her, What wilt thou? She saith unto him, Grant that these my two sons may sit, the one on thy right hand, and the other on the left, in thy kingdom.

\ln Tsisano unetsv hia nuwesvgi; Tla yitsigataha nusdv itsitayohihvi.  Tsigo yeliquo getsaditasdi ulisquidi atlisdv ayv tsvdagaditahi, alesgo yeliquo yidetsawosda ayv nasgi tsvdayvquawostani?  Yeliquo, unadvnvgi.
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; Ꮭ ᏱᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎢᏥᏔᏲᎯᎲᎢ.  ᏥᎪ ᏰᎵᏉ ᎨᏣᏗᏔᏍᏗ ᎤᎵᏍᏈᏗ ᎠᏟᏍᏛ ᎠᏴ ᏨᏓᎦᏗᏔᎯ, ᎠᎴᏍᎪ ᏰᎵᏉ ᏱᏕᏣᏬᏍᏓ ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏨᏓᏴᏆᏬᏍᏔᏂ?  ᏰᎵᏉ, ᎤᎾᏛᏅᎩ.
\ft But Jesus answered and said, Ye know not what ye ask. Are ye able to drink of the cup that I shall drink of, and to be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with? They say unto him, We are able.

\ln Hiano niduweselvgi; Udohiyuhi aquatseli ulisquidi atlisdv datsaditahi, ale ayv vquawosdodi gesv dodayetsawostani.  Tsigatisisgini ale tsigasgani gilo uwediyi vtla ayv aquadanedi yigi, getsinedisgininonv gesesdi nasgi Edoda tsudanelanelvhi.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎠᏆᏤᎵ ᎤᎵᏍᏈᏗ ᎠᏟᏍᏛ ᏓᏣᏗᏔᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴ ᎥᏆᏬᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏙᏓᏰᏣᏬᏍᏔᏂ.  ᏥᎦᏘᏏᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᎴ ᏥᎦᏍᎦᏂ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏪᏗᏱ ᎥᏝ ᎠᏴ ᎠᏆᏓᏁᏗ ᏱᎩ, ᎨᏥᏁᏗᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᏙᏓ ᏧᏓᏁᎳᏁᎸᎯ.
\ft And he saith unto them, Ye shall drink indeed of my cup, and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with: but to sit on my right hand, and on my left, is not mine to give, but it shall be given to them for whom it is prepared of my Father.

\ln Asgohino iyanidv unadvganv utsati unitalawosvgi duniniquatilv anitali dinadanvtli.
\syll ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏃ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᏂᏔᎳᏬᏒᎩ ᏚᏂᏂᏆᏘᎸ ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᏗᎾᏓᏅᏟ.
\ft And when the ten heard it, they were moved with indignation against the two brethren.

\ln Tsisano widuyanvhv hia nuwesvgi; Itsigataha ayeli degotlvwadisv nunigvwiyusadegi aninego iyunadvnelidasdiyi yvwi, ale getsilvquodi aninetsidohv nanadvnehoi.
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᏫᏚᏯᏅᎲ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᎠᏰᎵ ᏕᎪᏢᏩᏗᏒ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ ᎠᏂᏁᎪ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᏁᎵᏓᏍᏗᏱ ᏴᏫ, ᎠᎴ ᎨᏥᎸᏉᏗ ᎠᏂᏁᏥᏙᎲ ᎾᎾᏛᏁᎰᎢ.
\ft But Jesus called them unto him, and said, Ye know that the princes of the Gentiles exercise dominion over them, and they that are great exercise authority upon them.

\ln Nihisgini tlesdi nasgi yinitsvnesdi; gilosgini atsilvquodi iyulisdodiyi udulisgesdi nasgi etsinvsidasdi gesesdi.
\syll ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᏂᏨᏁᏍᏗ; ᎩᎶᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏗ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft But it shall not be so among you: but whosoever will be great among you, let him be your minister;

\ln Ale gilo ugvwiyuhi iyulisdodiyi udulisgesdi nasgi etsinatlai gesesdi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᏥᎾᏝᎢ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft And whosoever will be chief among you, let him be your servant:

\ln Nasgiyaquo yvwi Uwetsi udanvsidasdiyi nuyolilvna tsigi, atsinvsidasdiyiquosgini, ale gvnvi ulisgolvdodiyi unitsati diguyvdodi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏯᏉ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎤᏓᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗᏱ ᏄᏲᎵᎸᎾ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗᏱᏉᏍᎩᏂ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏅᎢ ᎤᎵᏍᎪᎸᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏗᎫᏴᏙᏗ.
\ft Even as the Son of man came not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many.

\ln Tseligono unanigisv unitsati yvwi gvwasdawadvsvgi.
\syll ᏤᎵᎪᏃ ᎤᎾᏂᎩᏒ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏴᏫ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏛᏒᎩ.
\ft And as they departed from Jericho, a great multitude followed him.

\ln Gvniyuquono anitali dinigewi unohulodi dunolvgi, unadvganvno tsisa ulosvi unelunvgi, hia nuniwesvgi; Sginidoligi, Tsagvwiyuhi Dewi uwetsi.
\syll ᎬᏂᏳᏉᏃ ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᏗᏂᎨᏫ ᎤᏃᎱᎶᏗ ᏚᏃᎸᎩ, ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎤᎶᏒᎢ ᎤᏁᎷᏅᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᏍᎩᏂᏙᎵᎩ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏕᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ.
\ft And, behold, two blind men sitting by the way side, when they heard that Jesus passed by, cried out, saying, Have mercy on us, O Lord, thou Son of David.

\ln Unitsatino duninetselvgi elaweyi unvdiyi.  Aseno utliquo igai unelunvgi, hia nuniwesvgi, Sginidoligi, Tsagvwiyuhi Dewi uwetsi.
\syll ᎤᏂᏣᏘᏃ ᏚᏂᏁᏤᎸᎩ ᎡᎳᏪᏱ ᎤᏅᏗᏱ.  ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏟᏉ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎤᏁᎷᏅᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ, ᏍᎩᏂᏙᎵᎩ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏕᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ.
\ft And the multitude rebuked them, because they should hold their peace: but they cried the more, saying, Have mercy on us, O Lord, thou Son of David.

\ln Tsisano ulewistanv widuyanvhvgi, ale hia niduweselvgi; Gado isdaduli ayv isdvyadvnediyi?
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᎴᏫᏍᏔᏅ ᏫᏚᏯᏅᎲᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎦᏙ ᎢᏍᏓᏚᎵ ᎠᏴ ᎢᏍᏛᏯᏛᏁᏗᏱ?
\ft And Jesus stood still, and called them, and said, What will ye that I shall do unto you?

\ln Hia nuniwesvgi:  Tsagvwiyuhi, tsosdigadoli tsulisduisdiyi oginaduliha.
\syll ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ:  ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᏦᏍᏗᎦᏙᎵ ᏧᎵᏍᏚᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎣᎩᎾᏚᎵᎭ.
\ft They say unto him, Lord, that our eyes may be opened.

\ln Tsisano duwedolitsv dinigadoli dusvnelvgi, gilaquono iyvdv gvwanigowadvdi nulistanvgi; ale gvwasdawadvsvgi.
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᏚᏪᏙᎵᏨ ᏗᏂᎦᏙᎵ ᏚᏒᏁᎸᎩ, ᎩᎳᏉᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎬᏩᏂᎪᏩᏛᏗ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏛᏒᎩ.
\ft So Jesus had compassion on them, and touched their eyes: and immediately their eyes received sight, and they followed him.

\ln Hnaquono Tsilusilimi nav unilutsv, Svgadohi, Oliwa usahilvi iyvdv, Tsisa anitali gvwasdawadidohi dunvsvgi,
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᎾᎥ ᎤᏂᎷᏨ, ᏒᎦᏙᎯ, ᎣᎵᏩ ᎤᏌᎯᎸᎢ ᎢᏴᏛ, ᏥᏌ ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏚᏅᏒᎩ,
\ft And when they drew nigh unto Jerusalem, and were come to Bethphage, unto the mount of Olives, then sent Jesus two disciples,

\ln Hia niduweselvgi; isdena itlv na tsvdigaduha, gilaquono iyvdv dayesdiwadvhi soquilidigalianvhidv gelisadesdi, ale agina atinehesdi, desdelisadesvha, ale desginatinohelvha.
\syll ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎢᏍᏕᎾ ᎢᏢ Ꮎ ᏨᏗᎦᏚᎭ, ᎩᎳᏉᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏓᏰᏍᏗᏩᏛᎯ ᏐᏈᎵᏗᎦᎵᎠᏅᎯᏛ ᎨᎵᏌᏕᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎩᎾ ᎠᏘᏁᎮᏍᏗ, ᏕᏍᏕᎵᏌᏕᏒᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᏍᎩᎾᏘᏃᎮᎸᎭ.
\ft Saying unto them, Go into the village over against you, and straightway ye shall find an ass tied, and a colt with her: loose them, and bring them unto me.

\ln Iyuno gilo gohusdi isdoselvha, hia nesdiweselvha; Ugvwiyuhi duduliha; gilaquono iyvdv dodayuyosi.
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎢᏍᏙᏎᎸᎭ, ᎯᎠ ᏁᏍᏗᏪᏎᎸᎭ; ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏚᏚᎵᎭ; ᎩᎳᏉᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏙᏓᏳᏲᏏ.
\ft And if any man say ought unto you, ye shall say, The Lord hath need of them; and straightway he will send them.

\ln Nasgi hia nigadv nulistanvgi, udohiyudiyi ayelvsvi adolehosgi tsunetsei, hia tsinuwesei;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎩ, ᎤᏙᎯᏳᏗᏱ ᎠᏰᎸᏒᎢ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᏧᏁᏤᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏥᏄᏪᏎᎢ;
\ft All this was done, that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, saying,

\ln Hia netsiwesi Sayani uwetsi ageyv; Gvniyuquo Ugvwiyuhi tsatseli dayai, datsalutseli udadolisdiyu, ale ugilvdesdi soquilidigalianvhidv gohusdi advnehi uwetsi agina.
\syll ᎯᎠ ᏁᏥᏪᏏ ᏌᏯᏂ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎠᎨᏴ; ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏣᏤᎵ ᏓᏯᎢ, ᏓᏣᎷᏤᎵ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏳ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎩᎸᏕᏍᏗ ᏐᏈᎵᏗᎦᎵᎠᏅᎯᏛ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎠᏛᏁᎯ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎠᎩᎾ.
\ft Tell ye the daughter of Sion, Behold, thy King cometh unto thee, meek, and sitting upon an ass, and a colt the foal of an ass.

\ln Gvwasdawadidohino unenvsvgi, Tsisa nuniweselv nasgiya winunadvnelvgi;
\syll ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯᏃ ᎤᏁᏅᏒᎩ, ᏥᏌ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎸ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏫᏄᎾᏛᏁᎸᎩ;
\ft And the disciples went, and did as Jesus commanded them,

\ln Soquilidigalianvhidv ale agina dunatinolvgi; dinisohiyino tsunanuwo dunitlvnvgi, ale nahna unagilvtanvgi.
\syll ᏐᏈᎵᏗᎦᎵᎠᏅᎯᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎩᎾ ᏚᎾᏘᏃᎸᎩ; ᏗᏂᏐᎯᏱᏃ ᏧᎾᏄᏬ ᏚᏂᏢᏅᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏀᎾ ᎤᎾᎩᎸᏔᏅᎩ.
\ft And brought the ass, and the colt, and put on them their clothes, and they set him thereon.

\ln Utlino iyanii yvwi tsunanuwo duniyesdvnvgi nvnohi, igadvno dunvnigalvhvgi tsuweyota detlugvi, ale nvnohi duniyotanvnvgi.
\syll ᎤᏟᏃ ᎢᏯᏂᎢ ᏴᏫ ᏧᎾᏄᏬ ᏚᏂᏰᏍᏛᏅᎩ ᏅᏃᎯ, ᎢᎦᏛᏃ ᏚᏅᏂᎦᎸᎲᎩ ᏧᏪᏲᏔ ᏕᏡᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏅᏃᎯ ᏚᏂᏲᏔᏅᏅᎩ.
\ft And a very great multitude spread their garments in the way; others cut down branches from the trees, and strawed them in the way.

\ln Unitsatino igvyi anegi, ale oni anegi unelugvgi, hia naniwesgvgi; Hosana Dewi Uwetsi!  atsilvquodiyu gesesdi Yihowa deudov tsigaluhisdiha!  Hosana wasdv galvladiyu!
\syll ᎤᏂᏣᏘᏃ ᎢᎬᏱ ᎠᏁᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎣᏂ ᎠᏁᎩ ᎤᏁᎷᎬᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏂᏪᏍᎬᎩ; ᎰᏌᎾ ᏕᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ  ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏱᎰᏩ ᏕᎤᏙᎥ ᏥᎦᎷᎯᏍᏗᎭ  ᎰᏌᎾ ᏩᏍᏛ ᎦᎸᎳᏗᏳ
\ft And the multitudes that went before, and that followed, cried, saying, Hosanna to the Son of David: Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord; Hosanna in the highest.

\ln Tsilusilimino ulutsv nigv gaduhv unalitelvnvgi, hia naniwesgvgi; Gago hia?
\syll ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻᏃ ᎤᎷᏨ ᏂᎬ ᎦᏚᎲ ᎤᎾᎵᏖᎸᏅᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏂᏪᏍᎬᎩ; ᎦᎪ ᎯᎠ?
\ft And when he was come into Jerusalem, all the city was moved, saying, Who is this?

\ln Unitsatino hia nuniwesvgi; Hia Tsisa adolehosgi, Naselidi ehi Gelili gaduhvi.
\syll ᎤᏂᏣᏘᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᎯᎠ ᏥᏌ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ, ᎾᏎᎵᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎨᎵᎵ ᎦᏚᎲᎢ.
\ft And the multitude said, This is Jesus the prophet of Nazareth of Galilee.

\ln Tsisano wuyvlvgi udvnadigalawiisdiyi Unelanvhi utseliga, ale dunugowisvgi nigadv aninadegi ale uniwasgi nahna digalawiisdiyi, ale duluquadinvsvgi dunisgilv adelv dininetliyvsgi, ale gule dinisgonihi dininadegi unanvdiyi.
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᏭᏴᎸᎩ ᎤᏛᎾᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏄᎪᏫᏒᎩ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎠᏂᎾᏕᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏩᏍᎩ ᏀᎾ ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᎷᏆᏗᏅᏒᎩ ᏚᏂᏍᎩᎸ ᎠᏕᎸ ᏗᏂᏁᏟᏴᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎫᎴ ᏗᏂᏍᎪᏂᎯ ᏗᏂᎾᏕᎩ ᎤᎾᏅᏗᏱ.
\ft And Jesus went into the temple of God, and cast out all them that sold and bought in the temple, and overthrew the tables of the moneychangers, and the seats of them that sold doves,

\ln Hiano niduweselvgi; Hia nigvnvgowela; Aquatseli galitsode adadolisdodiyi galitsode dudoesdi; aseno hia aninosgisgi uniyvsdiyi nitsvnelv.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏅᎪᏪᎳ; ᎠᏆᏤᎵ ᎦᎵᏦᏕ ᎠᏓᏙᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎦᎵᏦᏕ ᏚᏙᎡᏍᏗ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏂᏃᏍᎩᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᏴᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᏨᏁᎸ.
\ft And said unto them, It is written, My house shall be called the house of prayer; but ye have made it a den of thieves.

\ln Dinigewino ale diniyouli gvwalutselvgi digalawiisdiyi, ale dunvwanvgi.
\syll ᏗᏂᎨᏫᏃ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏂᏲᎤᎵ ᎬᏩᎷᏤᎸᎩ ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏅᏩᏅᎩ.
\ft And the blind and the lame came to him in the temple; and he healed them.

\ln Hnaquono nunigvwiyusv atsilvanelohi ale dinowelisgi unadolehosv usquanigodiyu dulvwisdanehvi, ale diniyoli unelugv udvnadigalawiisdiyi hia naniwesgvi, Hosana Dewi Uwetsi!  utsati unisonvtselvgi;
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏃᏪᎵᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᏙᎴᎰᏒ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗᏳ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏂᏲᎵ ᎤᏁᎷᎬ ᎤᏛᎾᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏂᏪᏍᎬᎢ, ᎰᏌᎾ ᏕᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ  ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᏂᏐᏅᏤᎸᎩ;
\ft And when the chief priests and scribes saw the wonderful things that he did, and the children crying in the temple, and saying, Hosanna to the Son of David; they were sore displeased,

\ln Ale hia nigvwaweselvgi; Hadvgisgo hia tsinaniweha?  Tsisano hia niduweselvgi; Vv, Tlasgo hilvhiyu hia yitsigoliyeoi; Tsunasdi diniyoli ale dinisdai aniholi unugotsvhi tsawadvdotanv etsalvquododiyi?
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏩᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎭᏛᎩᏍᎪ ᎯᎠ ᏥᎾᏂᏪᎭ?  ᏥᏌᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎥᎥ, ᏝᏍᎪ ᎯᎸᎯᏳ ᎯᎠ ᏱᏥᎪᎵᏰᎣᎢ; ᏧᎾᏍᏗ ᏗᏂᏲᎵ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏂᏍᏓᎢ ᎠᏂᎰᎵ ᎤᏄᎪᏨᎯ ᏣᏩᏛᏙᏔᏅ ᎡᏣᎸᏉᏙᏗᏱ?
\ft And said unto him, Hearest thou what these say? And Jesus saith unto them, Yea; have ye never read, Out of the mouth of babes and sucklings thou hast perfected praise?

\ln Dudanvelvgino, ale gaduhv unugotsvgi, Quediniyi wulutsvgi, ale nahna usvlvgi.
\syll ᏚᏓᏅᎡᎸᎩᏃ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᏚᎲ ᎤᏄᎪᏨᎩ, ᏇᏗᏂᏱ ᏭᎷᏨᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏀᎾ ᎤᏒᎸᎩ.
\ft And he left them, and went out of the city into Bethany; and he lodged there.

\ln Sunaleno digaduhv wvagadvi agonu uyosisanvgi.
\syll ᏑᎾᎴᏃ ᏗᎦᏚᎲ ᏮᎠᎦᏛᎢ ᎠᎪᏄ ᎤᏲᏏᏌᏅᎩ.
\ft Now in the morning as he returned into the city, he hungered.

\ln Ugohvno svgataiyusdi tlugv nvnohulodi, nahna wulutsvgi; aseno vtla gohusdi yuwadvhei, ulasdusv uwasv; hiano nuweselvgi; Tlesdi ilvhiyu gohi iyudalenvdv yitsadatanesdi.  Gilaquono iyvdv svgataiyusdi tlugv uwayvsvgi.
\syll ᎤᎪᎲᏃ ᏒᎦᏔᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏡᎬ ᏅᏃᎱᎶᏗ, ᏀᎾ ᏭᎷᏨᎩ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏳᏩᏛᎮᎢ, ᎤᎳᏍᏚᏒ ᎤᏩᏒ; ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏞᏍᏗ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᎪᎯ ᎢᏳᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏱᏣᏓᏔᏁᏍᏗ.  ᎩᎳᏉᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏒᎦᏔᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏡᎬ ᎤᏩᏴᏒᎩ.
\ft And when he saw a fig tree in the way, he came to it, and found nothing thereon, but leaves only, and said unto it, Let no fruit grow on thee henceforward for ever. And presently the fig tree withered away.

\ln Gvwasdawadidohino unigohv unisquanigosvgi, hia nuniwesvgi; Natlegvquo gvyvhi svgataiyusdi tlugvi!
\syll ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯᏃ ᎤᏂᎪᎲ ᎤᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏒᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᎾᏞᎬᏉ ᎬᏴᎯ ᏒᎦᏔᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏡᎬᎢ
\ft And when the disciples saw it, they marvelled, saying, How soon is the fig tree withered away!

\ln Tsisa unetsv hia niduweselvgi; Udohiyuhiya hia nitsvweseha; iyuno yitsohiyuha, ale nitsadlasidvehvna yigi, vtla hiaquo svgataiyusdi tlugv tsinagvga yinvgetsadvga, nasquosgini hia yinitsiweselv hia tsodalv, Hadanvna, ale amequohi wetsaduga, ase nasgi iyulisdodi.
\syll ᏥᏌ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᏱᏦᎯᏳᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᏣᏜᏏᏛᎡᎲᎾ ᏱᎩ, ᎥᏝ ᎯᎠᏉ ᏒᎦᏔᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏡᎬ ᏥᎾᎬᎦ ᏱᏅᎨᏣᏛᎦ, ᎾᏍᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎯᎠ ᏱᏂᏥᏪᏎᎸ ᎯᎠ ᏦᏓᎸ, ᎭᏓᏅᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎺᏉᎯ ᏪᏣᏚᎦ, ᎠᏎ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗ.
\ft Jesus answered and said unto them, Verily I say unto you, If ye have faith, and doubt not, ye shall not only do this which is done to the fig tree, but also if ye shall say unto this mountain, Be thou removed, and be thou cast into the sea; it shall be done.

\ln Nigavno gohusdi itsitayohihesdi, itsadadolisdisgvi, itsohiyuhvsgesdi, itsiwatisgesdi.
\syll ᏂᎦᎥᏃ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎢᏥᏔᏲᎯᎮᏍᏗ, ᎢᏣᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᎢᏦᎯᏳᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎢᏥᏩᏘᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
\ft And all things, whatsoever ye shall ask in prayer, believing, ye shall receive.

\ln Udvnano digalawiisdiyi ulutsv, nunigvwiyusv atsilvanelohi ale tsunadvsonvhi yvwi anehv gvwalutselvgi dadeyohvsgvi, hia nuniwesvgi; Gado tsalisgasdodi hia nasgi tsidetsalvwisdaneha?  Ale gago tsanetselvhi?
\syll ᎤᏛᎾᏃ ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᎷᏨ, ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏧᎾᏛᏐᏅᎯ ᏴᏫ ᎠᏁᎲ ᎬᏩᎷᏤᎸᎩ ᏓᏕᏲᎲᏍᎬᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᎦᏙ ᏣᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏗ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏕᏣᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎭ?  ᎠᎴ ᎦᎪ ᏣᏁᏤᎸᎯ?
\ft And when he was come into the temple, the chief priests and the elders of the people came unto him as he was teaching, and said, By what authority doest thou these things? and who gave thee this authority?

\ln Tsisano unetsv hia niduweselvgi; ayv nasgi sudalegi datsvyadvdvni, iyuno nasgi isginonelv nasgi ayv datsvnoneli iyusdi aqualisgasdodvi, hia nasgi tsidagilvwisdaneha.
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏑᏓᎴᎩ ᏓᏨᏯᏛᏛᏂ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏍᎩᏃᏁᎸ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᏓᏨᏃᏁᎵ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏆᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏛᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏓᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎭ.
\ft And Jesus answered and said unto them, I also will ask you one thing, which if ye tell me, I in like wise will tell you by what authority I do these things.

\ln Tsani tsidadawosgvgi hatlv tsudalenei? Galvladisgo, yvwiquoge anehv tsudalenei?  Elaweyino unadanvtelvgi, hia naniwesgvgi; iyuno galvladi, yogadvnv, Gadono tla yietsoiyunei?  Yogosi.
\syll ᏣᏂ ᏥᏓᏓᏬᏍᎬᎩ ᎭᏢ ᏧᏓᎴᏁᎢ? ᎦᎸᎳᏗᏍᎪ, ᏴᏫᏉᎨ ᎠᏁᎲ ᏧᏓᎴᏁᎢ?  ᎡᎳᏪᏱᏃ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏖᎸᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏂᏪᏍᎬᎩ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ, ᏲᎦᏛᏅ, ᎦᏙᏃ Ꮭ ᏱᎡᏦᎢᏳᏁᎢ?  ᏲᎪᏏ.
\ft The baptism of John, whence was it? from heaven, or of men? And they reasoned with themselves, saying, If we shall say, From heaven; he will say unto us, Why did ye not then believe him?

\ln Iyuno yvwiquo anehv tsudalenei yogadvnv, dotsisgaihaquo yvwi; nigadvyeno adolehosgi uniyelvha Tsani.
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᏴᏫᏉ ᎠᏁᎲ ᏧᏓᎴᏁᎢ ᏲᎦᏛᏅ, ᏙᏥᏍᎦᎢᎭᏉ ᏴᏫ; ᏂᎦᏛᏰᏃ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᏰᎸᎭ ᏣᏂ.
\ft But if we shall say, Of men; we fear the people; for all hold John as a prophet.

\ln Uninetsvno hia nvgvwaweselv Tsisa; Vtla yotsigataha.  Hiano niduweselvgi; Vtla nasquo ayv yvgetsvnohvsi iyusdi aqualisgasdodvi hia nasgi tsidagilvwisdaneha.
\syll ᎤᏂᏁᏨᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏅᎬᏩᏪᏎᎸ ᏥᏌ; ᎥᏝ ᏲᏥᎦᏔᎭ.  ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎥᏝ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏴ ᏴᎨᏨᏃᎲᏏ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏆᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏛᎢ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏓᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎭ.
\ft And they answered Jesus, and said, We cannot tell. And he said unto them, Neither tell I you by what authority I do these things.

\ln Aseno gado itseliha?  Gilo asgaya anitali tsuwetsi anisgaya anehei; asiyvwino igvyi wulutselv, hia nuweselei; Aquetsi, hena gohi widitsalvwisdasi telvladi dagiwisvi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎦᏙ ᎢᏤᎵᎭ?  ᎩᎶ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᏧᏪᏥ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ ᎠᏁᎮᎢ; ᎠᏏᏴᏫᏃ ᎢᎬᏱ ᏭᎷᏤᎸ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎠᏇᏥ, ᎮᎾ ᎪᎯ ᏫᏗᏣᎸᏫᏍᏓᏏ ᏖᎸᎳᏗ ᏓᎩᏫᏒᎢ.
\ft But what think ye? A certain man had two sons; and he came to the first, and said, Son, go work to day in my vineyard.

\ln Tsunetsvno, vtla, udvnei; aseno oni unetliyvse udanvdvi, ale uwenvsei.
\syll ᏧᏁᏨᏃ, ᎥᏝ, ᎤᏛᏁᎢ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎣᏂ ᎤᏁᏟᏴᏎ ᎤᏓᏅᏛᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏪᏅᏎᎢ.
\ft He answered and said, I will not: but afterward he repented, and went.

\ln Soino wulutselv nasgiya nuweselei.  Tsunetsvno, dagesi, udvnei; aseno nuwenvsvnaquo igesei.
\syll ᏐᎢᏃ ᏭᎷᏤᎸ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ.  ᏧᏁᏨᏃ, ᏓᎨᏏ, ᎤᏛᏁᎢ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᏄᏪᏅᏒᎾᏉ ᎢᎨᏎᎢ.
\ft And he came to the second, and said likewise. And he answered and said, I go, sir: and went not.

\ln Gago hia anitali udoda unetsv nudvnelei?  Igvyi wulutselvhi, vgvwoselvgi.  Tsisano hia niduweselvgi; Udohiyuhiya hia nitsvweseha, adelv anigisidohi ale tsunatsesati anigeyv Unelanvhi ugvwiyuhi gesv waniyvhiha degetsigoniha.
\syll ᎦᎪ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᎤᏙᏓ ᎤᏁᏨ ᏄᏛᏁᎴᎢ?  ᎢᎬᏱ ᏭᎷᏤᎸᎯ, ᎥᎬᏬᏎᎸᎩ.  ᏥᏌᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ, ᎠᏕᎸ ᎠᏂᎩᏏᏙᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏧᎾᏤᏌᏘ ᎠᏂᎨᏴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏩᏂᏴᎯᎭ ᏕᎨᏥᎪᏂᎭ.
\ft Whether of them twain did the will of his father? They say unto him, The first. Jesus saith unto them, Verily I say unto you, That the publicans and the harlots go into the kingdom of God before you.

\ln Tsaniyeno duyugodv dulvwisdanehv itsilutselvgi, ale vtla yetsoiyunei, adelvsgini anigisidohi ale anigeyv tsunatsesati tsigvwohiyunvgi; nihino itsadolehosv vtla oni yiditsinetliyvse detsadanvdv etsoiyudiyi.
\syll ᏣᏂᏰᏃ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᎢᏥᎷᏤᎸᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᏰᏦᎢᏳᏁᎢ, ᎠᏕᎸᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏂᎩᏏᏙᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᎨᏴ ᏧᎾᏤᏌᏘ ᏥᎬᏬᎯᏳᏅᎩ; ᏂᎯᏃ ᎢᏣᏙᎴᎰᏒ ᎥᏝ ᎣᏂ ᏱᏗᏥᏁᏟᏴᏎ ᏕᏣᏓᏅᏛ ᎡᏦᎢᏳᏗᏱ.
\ft For John came unto you in the way of righteousness, and ye believed him not: but the publicans and the harlots believed him: and ye, when ye had seen it, repented not afterward, that ye might believe him.

\ln Nvwadale datlilosdv itsadvgvga; Ehe gilo asgaya ganela, nasgi telvladi duwisei, ale usoyole gvwaduwidv, ale usgose gigageaditasdi gotlvdiyi, ale unesgehe inv igati, ale dudolastane tlogesi tsunilvwisdanehi, invno wulosei.
\syll ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᏓᏟᎶᏍᏛ ᎢᏣᏛᎬᎦ; ᎡᎮ ᎩᎶ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎦᏁᎳ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏖᎸᎳᏗ ᏚᏫᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏐᏲᎴ ᎬᏩᏚᏫᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏍᎪᏎ ᎩᎦᎨᎠᏗᏔᏍᏗ ᎪᏢᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᏍᎨᎮ ᎢᏅ ᎢᎦᏘ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏙᎳᏍᏔᏁ ᏠᎨᏏ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ, ᎢᏅᏃ ᏭᎶᏎᎢ.
\ft Hear another parable: There was a certain householder, which planted a vineyard, and hedged it round about, and digged a winepress in it, and built a tower, and let it out to husbandmen, and went into a far country:

\ln Hnaquono navniyu gese unvnisdiyi dunvse tsunvsidasdi tlogesi tsunilvwisdanehi dinehvi, duninesvse unadadvnvhi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎾᎥᏂᏳ ᎨᏎ ᎤᏅᏂᏍᏗᏱ ᏚᏅᏎ ᏧᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᏠᎨᏏ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᏗᏁᎲᎢ, ᏚᏂᏁᏒᏎ ᎤᎾᏓᏛᏅᎯ.
\ft And when the time of the fruit drew near, he sent his servants to the husbandmen, that they might receive the fruits of it.

\ln Tlogesino tsunilvwisdanehi duniniyvhe tsunvsidasdi, asiyvwi unilvnilei, soino unilei, soino nvya dunvnistanei.
\syll ᏠᎨᏏᏃ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᏚᏂᏂᏴᎮ ᏧᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ, ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᎤᏂᎸᏂᎴᎢ, ᏐᎢᏃ ᎤᏂᎴᎢ, ᏐᎢᏃ ᏅᏯ ᏚᏅᏂᏍᏔᏁᎢ.
\ft And the husbandmen took his servants, and beat one, and killed another, and stoned another.

\ln Talineno dunvse nvwanadale tsunvsidasdi utli iyanii; nasgiyaquono nidunvnelei.
\syll ᏔᎵᏁᏃ ᏚᏅᏎ ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴ ᏧᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎤᏟ ᎢᏯᏂᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩᏯᏉᏃ ᏂᏚᏅᏁᎴᎢ.
\ft Again, he sent other servants more than the first: and they did unto them likewise.

\ln Oniyino uwetsi unvsei, hia nuwesei; Ase dvnilvquotani aquetsi.
\syll ᎣᏂᏱᏃ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎤᏅᏎᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎠᏎ ᏛᏂᎸᏉᏔᏂ ᎠᏇᏥ.
\ft But last of all he sent unto them his son, saying, They will reverence my son.

\ln Aseno tlogesi tsunilvwisdanehi unigohv uwetsi hia nidunadaweselei; Nasgi hia utseli iyulisdodi; ka ediluga, ale ediwonv utseli iyulisdodi tsigi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᏠᎨᏏ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᎤᏂᎪᎲ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᎾᏓᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗ; Ꭷ ᎡᏗᎷᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᎡᏗᏬᏅ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᏥᎩ.
\ft But when the husbandmen saw the son, they said among themselves, This is the heir; come, let us kill him, and let us seize on his inheritance.

\ln Uniniyvheno, ale uninugowise telvladi dawisvi, ale unilei.
\syll ᎤᏂᏂᏴᎮᏃ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏄᎪᏫᏎ ᏖᎸᎳᏗ ᏓᏫᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᎴᎢ.
\ft And they caught him, and cast him out of the vineyard, and slew him.

\ln Hnaquono nasgi telvladi dawisv utseliga galutsvha, gado dodagvneli na tlogesi tsunilvwisdanehi?
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏖᎸᎳᏗ ᏓᏫᏒ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᎦᎷᏨᎭ, ᎦᏙ ᏙᏓᎬᏁᎵ Ꮎ ᏠᎨᏏ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ?
\ft When the lord therefore of the vineyard cometh, what will he do unto those husbandmen?

\ln Hiano nvgvwaweselvgi; uyoiyu nidodagvneli dodvli nasgi na uniyoi, ale nvwanadale tlogesi tsunilvwisdanehi dodvdolastani, nasgi yeli gvwanaguyvdi nanvnasisvi.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏅᎬᏩᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎤᏲᎢᏳ ᏂᏙᏓᎬᏁᎵ ᏙᏛᎵ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᏂᏲᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴ ᏠᎨᏏ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᏙᏛᏙᎳᏍᏔᏂ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏰᎵ ᎬᏩᎾᎫᏴᏗ ᎾᏅᎾᏏᏒᎢ.
\ft They say unto him, He will miserably destroy those wicked men, and will let out his vineyard unto other husbandmen, which shall render him the fruits in their seasons.

\ln Tsisano hia niduweselvgi; tlasgo ilvhiyu yitsigoliyeo hia tsinigvnv tsigowela?  Ananesgesgi uniyoiselvhi nvya nugvwiyusv unvsiyv adi nulistanv; nasgi hia Yihowa nudvnelv, ale usquanigodiyu dedakanisgvi.
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏝᏍᎪ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᏱᏥᎪᎵᏰᎣ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᎬᏅ ᏥᎪᏪᎳ?  ᎠᎾᏁᏍᎨᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᏲᎢᏎᎸᎯ ᏅᏯ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎤᏅᏏᏴ ᎠᏗ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏱᎰᏩ ᏄᏛᏁᎸ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗᏳ ᏕᏓᎧᏂᏍᎬᎢ.
\ft Jesus saith unto them, Did ye never read in the scriptures, The stone which the builders rejected, the same is become the head of the corner: this is the Lord's doing, and it is marvellous in our eyes?

\ln Nasgi iyusdi hia nitsvweseha; Unelanvhi utseligohi dayetsigisvli, nvwanadaleno dagetsineli, nasgi yeli gvwaninanugowisdi udatanvhi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ; ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎪᎯ ᏓᏰᏥᎩᏒᎵ, ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴᏃ ᏓᎨᏥᏁᎵ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏰᎵ ᎬᏩᏂᎾᏄᎪᏫᏍᏗ ᎤᏓᏔᏅᎯ.
\ft Therefore say I unto you, The kingdom of God shall be taken from you, and given to a nation bringing forth the fruits thereof.

\ln Gilono ani nvyohi atlvtsvha dayusonvni, gilono usonvha dayuwedawotani.
\syll ᎩᎶᏃ ᎠᏂ ᏅᏲᎯ ᎠᏢᏨᎭ ᏓᏳᏐᏅᏂ, ᎩᎶᏃ ᎤᏐᏅᎭ ᏓᏳᏪᏓᏬᏔᏂ.
\ft And whosoever shall fall on this stone shall be broken: but on whomsoever it shall fall, it will grind him to powder.

\ln Hnaquono nunigvwiyusv atsilvanelohi ale Aniqualisi unadvganv datlilosdisgvi, unadolehosvgi unvsv getsidvgvi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅ ᏓᏟᎶᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᎤᎾᏙᎴᎰᏒᎩ ᎤᏅᏒ ᎨᏥᏛᎬᎢ.
\ft And when the chief priests and Pharisees had heard his parables, they perceived that he spake of them.

\ln Uniniyvdiyino unadanvtelv, unitsati yvwi dunisgalvgi, nasgiyeno adolehosgi gvwayelvsvgi.
\syll ᎤᏂᏂᏴᏗᏱᏃ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏖᎸ, ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏴᏫ ᏚᏂᏍᎦᎸᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎬᏩᏰᎸᏒᎩ.
\ft But when they sought to lay hands on him, they feared the multitude, because they took him for a prophet.

\ln Tsisano unetsv taline dutlilosdanelvgi, hia nuwesvgi;
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᏁᏨ ᏔᎵᏁ ᏚᏟᎶᏍᏓᏁᎸᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ;
\ft And Jesus answered and spake unto them again by parables, and said,

\ln Galvladi utseligohi nasgiyaquo gilo ugvwiyuhi tsudvnvistane tsagatsvsdodiyi uwetsi awinv,
\syll ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎤᏤᎵᎪᎯ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᏉ ᎩᎶ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏧᏛᏅᎢᏍᏔᏁ ᏣᎦᏨᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎠᏫᏅ,
\ft The kingdom of heaven is like unto a certain king, which made a marriage for his son,

\ln Ale tsidunvse tsunvsidasdi tsuniyanvhvsdiyi wigetsiyanvdv degegatsvsdisgv uniluhisdiyi; aseno diuniyulvnequo nvdayunenvsdiyi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏥᏚᏅᏎ ᏧᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᏧᏂᏯᏅᎲᏍᏗᏱ ᏫᎨᏥᏯᏅᏛ ᏕᎨᎦᏨᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᎤᏂᎷᎯᏍᏗᏱ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᏗᎤᏂᏳᎸᏁᏉ ᏅᏓᏳᏁᏅᏍᏗᏱ.
\ft And sent forth his servants to call them that were bidden to the wedding: and they would not come.

\ln Talineno nvwanadale tsunvsidasdi dunvsei, hia niduweselei; Hia winiditsiwesi wigetsiyanvdv; Gvniyuquo aquadvnvisdi alisdayvdi, diquatseli waga ale digalitsotanvhi dunilv, nigadiyuno advnvistanonvhi; degegatsvsdisgv itsilugi.
\syll ᏔᎵᏁᏃ ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴ ᏧᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᏚᏅᏎᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎯᎠ ᏫᏂᏗᏥᏪᏏ ᏫᎨᏥᏯᏅᏛ; ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎠᏆᏛᏅᎢᏍᏗ ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗ, ᏗᏆᏤᎵ ᏩᎦ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎦᎵᏦᏔᏅᎯ ᏚᏂᎸ, ᏂᎦᏗᏳᏃ ᎠᏛᏅᎢᏍᏔᏃᏅᎯ; ᏕᎨᎦᏨᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᎢᏥᎷᎩ.
\ft Again, he sent forth other servants, saying, Tell them which are bidden, Behold, I have prepared my dinner: my oxen and my fatlings are killed, and all things are ready: come unto the marriage.

\ln Aseno nvlisaliquo diuniyelvnei, ale utsatiniquo wunilosei, asiyvwi tsulogesvi, soino unododiyi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᏅᎵᏌᎵᏉ ᏗᎤᏂᏰᎸᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏣᏘᏂᏉ ᏭᏂᎶᏎᎢ, ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᏧᎶᎨᏒᎢ, ᏐᎢᏃ ᎤᏃᏙᏗᏱ.
\ft But they made light of it, and went their ways, one to his farm, another to his merchandise:

\ln Anisoino duniniyvhe tsunvsidasdi, ale digvwanisotlvtanei, ale dunilei.
\syll ᎠᏂᏐᎢᏃ ᏚᏂᏂᏴᎮ ᏧᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎬᏩᏂᏐᏢᏔᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏂᎴᎢ.
\ft And the remnant took his servants, and entreated them spitefully, and slew them.

\ln Hnaquono ugvwiyuhi udvganv utalawosei, ale dunvse tsutseli aniyawisgi, ale widunile nasgi tsunadalvhi, ale wunagohvstane uniduhvi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏛᎦᏅ ᎤᏔᎳᏬᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏅᏎ ᏧᏤᎵ ᎠᏂᏯᏫᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏫᏚᏂᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᎾᏓᎸᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏭᎾᎪᎲᏍᏔᏁ ᎤᏂᏚᎲᎢ.
\ft But when the king heard thereof, he was wroth: and he sent forth his armies, and destroyed those murderers, and burned up their city.

\ln Hnaquono hia niduwesele tsunvsidasdi; digegatsvsdodiyi advnvisdi, aseno wigetsiyanvdv vtla yeli yinanose uniluhisyi.
