\syll ᎠᏏᏉ ᏓᏂᎳᏫᎥ ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏ, ᏥᏌ ᏚᏛᏛᏅᎩ,
\ft While the Pharisees were gathered together, Jesus asked them,

\ln Hia nuwesvgi; Gado itseli etsadanvtesgv Galonedv, Gago uwetsi?  Dewi, vgvwoselvgi.
\syll ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎦᏙ ᎢᏤᎵ ᎡᏣᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ, ᎦᎪ ᎤᏪᏥ?  ᏕᏫ, ᎥᎬᏬᏎᎸᎩ.
\ft Saying, What think ye of Christ? whose son is he? They say unto him, The Son of David.

\ln Hia niduweselvgi; Gadono digalisdodiha, Dewi adanvdo uweyohvsgvi, Tsagvwiyuhi, tsigoseha?  Hia tsinigaweha;
\syll ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎦᏙᏃ ᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ, ᏕᏫ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᏪᏲᎲᏍᎬᎢ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᏥᎪᏎᎭ?  ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᎦᏪᎭ;
\ft He saith unto them, How then doth David in spirit call him Lord, saying,

\ln Yihowa hia nuweselvgi Ugvwiyuhi aquatseliga; Tsigatisi iditlv tsolesdi, gvni getsasgagi ditsalasidiyi gasgilo nigatsiyvnelvha;
\syll ᏱᎰᏩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᏆᏤᎵᎦ; ᏥᎦᏘᏏ ᎢᏗᏢ ᏦᎴᏍᏗ, ᎬᏂ ᎨᏣᏍᎦᎩ ᏗᏣᎳᏏᏗᏱ ᎦᏍᎩᎶ ᏂᎦᏥᏴᏁᎸᎭ;
\ft The LORD said unto my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand, till I make thine enemies thy footstool?

\ln Iyuyeno Dewi, Tsagvwiyuhi, yigoseha, Gado yigalisdoda uwetsi yigi?
\syll ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᏕᏫ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᏱᎪᏎᎭ, ᎦᏙ ᏱᎦᎵᏍᏙᏓ ᎤᏪᏥ ᏱᎩ?
\ft If David then call him Lord, how is he his son?

\ln Tla hnaquo yeli gilo sganetsvhi gvwanetsedi yigesei; tla ale gilo nahiyu iyudalenvdv yeli gagvwadvdvdi yigesei.
\syll Ꮭ ᎿᏉ ᏰᎵ ᎩᎶ ᏍᎦᏁᏨᎯ ᎬᏩᏁᏤᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ; Ꮭ ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᏀᎢᏳ ᎢᏳᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏰᎵ ᎦᎬᏩᏛᏛᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ.
\ft And no man was able to answer him a word, neither durst any man from that day forth ask him any more questions.

\ln Hnaquono Tsisa duwonetanvgi unitsati ale gvwasdawadidohi,
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏥᏌ ᏚᏬᏁᏔᏅᎩ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ,
\ft Then spake Jesus to the multitude, and to his disciples,

\ln Hia nuwesvgi; dinowelisgi ale Aniqualisi Mosi uwesgilv anina;
\syll ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᏗᏃᏪᎵᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏ ᎼᏏ ᎤᏪᏍᎩᎸ ᎠᏂᎾ;
\ft Saying, The scribes and the Pharisees sit in Moses' seat:

\ln Nasgi hiyusdi nigav gohusdi ditsikahnawaduga getsosehesdi detsikahnawadegesdi ale nasgi nitsadvnehesdi; aseno nasgi nanadvnehvi tlesdi yinitsadvnehesdi; aninegoyeno aseno vtla nasgi yinanadvnehoi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᏳᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏗᏥᎧᎿᏩᏚᎦ ᎨᏦᏎᎮᏍᏗ ᏕᏥᎧᎿᏩᏕᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᎾᏛᏁᎲᎢ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏂᏣᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ; ᎠᏂᏁᎪᏰᏃ ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᎾᎾᏛᏁᎰᎢ.
\ft All therefore whatsoever they bid you observe, that observe and do; but do not ye after their works: for they say, and do not.

\ln Danadalitlvsgoyeno digagedv dilisvsdi ale udeyadodi dilisvsdiyi, nasgino yvwi daninohatlahvsgoi; aseno unvsv vtla saquo aniyesadv yvgvnvda yidogvnitelvhvga.
\syll ᏓᎾᏓᎵᏢᏍᎪᏰᏃ ᏗᎦᎨᏛ ᏗᎵᏒᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏕᏯᏙᏗ ᏗᎵᏒᏍᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏴᏫ ᏓᏂᏃᎭᏝᎲᏍᎪᎢ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏅᏒ ᎥᏝ ᏌᏉ ᎠᏂᏰᏌᏛ ᏴᎬᏅᏓ ᏱᏙᎬᏂᏖᎸᎲᎦ.
\ft For they bind heavy burdens and grievous to be borne, and lay them on men's shoulders; but they themselves will not move them with one of their fingers.

\ln Nigadiyusgini dunilvwisdanehv yvwiquo gvwanigowadvdiyi uniyelvsoi.  Diyatena nidanvneho tsunagvdanosdi, ale daniyadvvsdisgo degadaluyadv tsunanuwo;
\syll ᏂᎦᏗᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᏚᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᏴᏫᏉ ᎬᏩᏂᎪᏩᏛᏗᏱ ᎤᏂᏰᎸᏐᎢ.  ᏗᏯᏖᎾ ᏂᏓᏅᏁᎰ ᏧᎾᎬᏓᏃᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᏂᏯᏛᎥᏍᏗᏍᎪ ᏕᎦᏓᎷᏯᏛ ᏧᎾᏄᏬ;
\ft But all their works they do for to be seen of men: they make broad their phylacteries, and enlarge the borders of their garments,

\ln Ale unilvquodo nugvwiyusv tsunanitlvdiyi danalisdayvhvsgvi, ale nugvwiyusv degasgilv digalawiisdiyi,
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᎸᏉᏙ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᏧᎾᏂᏢᏗᏱ ᏓᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᏕᎦᏍᎩᎸ ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ,
\ft And love the uppermost rooms at feasts, and the chief seats in the synagogues,

\ln Ale getsiyolisdiyi diganododiyi, ale Tadeyohvsgi, Tadeyohvsgi, gvwanosediyi yvwi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎨᏥᏲᎵᏍᏗᏱ ᏗᎦᏃᏙᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏔᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ, ᏔᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ, ᎬᏩᏃᏎᏗᏱ ᏴᏫ.
\ft And greetings in the markets, and to be called of men, Rabbi, Rabbi.

\ln Nihisgini tlesdi Tadeyohvsgi, yetsosehesdi; asiyvwiyeno Ditseyohvsgi, nasgi Galonedv; nigadvno nihi itsalinvtliquo.
\syll ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏔᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ, ᏰᏦᏎᎮᏍᏗ; ᎠᏏᏴᏫᏰᏃ ᏗᏤᏲᎲᏍᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ; ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏣᎵᏅᏟᏉ.
\ft But be not ye called Rabbi: for one is your Master, even Christ; and all ye are brethren.

\ln Ale tlesdi gilo edoda etsoselvgi ani elohi; asiyvwiquoyeno Itsidoda, nasgi galvladi tsvtseha.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎩᎶ ᎡᏙᏓ ᎡᏦᏎᎸᎩ ᎠᏂ ᎡᎶᎯ; ᎠᏏᏴᏫᏉᏰᏃ ᎢᏥᏙᏓ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏨᏤᎭ.
\ft And call no man your father upon the earth: for one is your Father, which is in heaven.

\ln Ale tlesdi Squatinidohi yetsosehesdi nihi, asiyvwiquoyeno Ditsatinidohi, nasgi Galonedv.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏍᏆᏘᏂᏙᎯ ᏰᏦᏎᎮᏍᏗ ᏂᎯ, ᎠᏏᏴᏫᏉᏰᏃ ᏗᏣᏘᏂᏙᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ.
\ft Neither be ye called masters: for one is your Master, even Christ.

\ln Gilosgini utli atsilvquodiyu gesesdi nihi itsehvi, nasgi etsinvsidasdi gesesdi.
\syll ᎩᎶᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏟ ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏤᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft But he that is greatest among you shall be your servant.

\ln Gilono uwasvquo iadasaladisgesdi eladi iyagvnedi gesesdi; gilono uwasvquo eladi nadadvnehesdi atsisaladodi gesesdi.
\syll ᎩᎶᏃ ᎤᏩᏒᏉ ᎢᎠᏓᏌᎳᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎡᎳᏗ ᎢᏯᎬᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᎩᎶᏃ ᎤᏩᏒᏉ ᎡᎳᏗ ᎾᏓᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᎠᏥᏌᎳᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft And whosoever shall exalt himself shall be abased; and he that shall humble himself shall be exalted.

\ln Nihisgini uyoiyu itsalisdanedi ditsowelisgi ale Itsiqualisi itsatlonasdi!  detsisdunehoyeno yvwi galvladi utseligohi; vtlayeno itsvsv yitsiyvhihoi, ale vtla unanelagi waniyvha yiditseliseho waniyvhihi.
\syll ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏲᎢᏳ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᏗᏦᏪᎵᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏥᏆᎵᏏ ᎢᏣᏠᎾᏍᏗ  ᏕᏥᏍᏚᏁᎰᏰᏃ ᏴᏫ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎤᏤᎵᎪᎯ; ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᎢᏨᏒ ᏱᏥᏴᎯᎰᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᎤᎾᏁᎳᎩ ᏩᏂᏴᎭ ᏱᏗᏤᎵᏎᎰ ᏩᏂᏴᎯᎯ.
\ft But woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye shut up the kingdom of heaven against men: for ye neither go in yourselves, neither suffer ye them that are entering to go in.

\ln Uyoiyu itsalisdanedi ditsowelisgi ale Itsiqualisi itsatlonasdi!  detsisvnehoyeno tsunosulotsvhi daninelvi, ale itsatlonasdv gohidiyu itsadadolisdisgoi.  Nasgi iyusdi utlihiyu igai itsigiliyoisdi gesesdi.
\syll ᎤᏲᎢᏳ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᏗᏦᏪᎵᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏥᏆᎵᏏ ᎢᏣᏠᎾᏍᏗ  ᏕᏥᏒᏁᎰᏰᏃ ᏧᏃᏑᎶᏨᎯ ᏓᏂᏁᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏣᏠᎾᏍᏛ ᎪᎯᏗᏳ ᎢᏣᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎪᎢ.  ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᏟᎯᏳ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎢᏥᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye devour widows' houses, and for a pretence make long prayer: therefore ye shall receive the greater damnation.

\ln Uyoiyu itsalisdanedi ditsowelisgi ale Itsiqualisi itsatlonasdi!  detsadeyohoyeno amequohi ale gadohi etsiyoho asiyvwi nusdv itsohiyusv gohiyuhvsgi iyetsvnediyi, ale nasgi netsvga tali iyuwagudi utli tsvsginoi uwetsi netsvneho esgaquo itsvsv.
\syll ᎤᏲᎢᏳ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᏗᏦᏪᎵᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏥᏆᎵᏏ ᎢᏣᏠᎾᏍᏗ  ᏕᏣᏕᏲᎰᏰᏃ ᎠᎺᏉᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎦᏙᎯ ᎡᏥᏲᎰ ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎢᏦᎯᏳᏒ ᎪᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᎢᏰᏨᏁᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏁᏨᎦ ᏔᎵ ᎢᏳᏩᎫᏗ ᎤᏟ ᏨᏍᎩᏃᎢ ᎤᏪᏥ ᏁᏨᏁᎰ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎢᏨᏒ.
\ft Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye compass sea and land to make one proselyte, and when he is made, ye make him twofold more the child of hell than yourselves.

\ln Uyoiyu itsalisdanedi, ditsigewi ditsadatinidohi!  hia itsiwesgi; Gilo iaselidvsgesdi ikaneisdisgesdi udvnvdigalawiisdiyi, asequoquo nasgi; gilosgini ikaneisdisgesdi adelv dalonige udvnadigalawiisdiyi ahvi, nasgi asdayiyu ududala.
\syll ᎤᏲᎢᏳ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ, ᏗᏥᎨᏫ ᏗᏣᏓᏘᏂᏙᎯ  ᎯᎠ ᎢᏥᏪᏍᎩ; ᎩᎶ ᎢᎠᏎᎵᏛᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎢᎧᏁᎢᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᏛᏅᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᏎᏉᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ; ᎩᎶᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᎧᏁᎢᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᏕᎸ ᏓᎶᏂᎨ ᎤᏛᎾᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᏓᏱᏳ ᎤᏚᏓᎳ.
\ft Woe unto you, ye blind guides, which say, Whosoever shall swear by the temple, it is nothing; but whosoever shall swear by the gold of the temple, he is a debtor!

\ln Itsinegu ale ditsigewi!  gado usdi utli galvquodiyu, adelvsgo dalonigei, udvnadigalawiisdiyige nasgi galvquodiyu tsinigvneha adelv dalonigei?
\syll ᎢᏥᏁᎫ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏥᎨᏫ  ᎦᏙ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎤᏟ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ, ᎠᏕᎸᏍᎪ ᏓᎶᏂᎨᎢ, ᎤᏛᎾᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱᎨ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᏥᏂᎬᏁᎭ ᎠᏕᎸ ᏓᎶᏂᎨᎢ?
\ft Ye fools and blind: for whether is greater, the gold, or the temple that sanctifieth the gold?

\ln Ale, gilo ikaneisdisgesdi atsilvgelasdiyi, asequoquo nasgi; gilosgini ikaneisdisgesdi alisgolvtanvhi nahna ahvi, nasgi asdayiyu ududala.
\syll ᎠᎴ, ᎩᎶ ᎢᎧᏁᎢᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᏥᎸᎨᎳᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᏎᏉᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ; ᎩᎶᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᎧᏁᎢᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏅᎯ ᏀᎾ ᎠᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᏓᏱᏳ ᎤᏚᏓᎳ.
\ft And, Whosoever shall swear by the altar, it is nothing; but whosoever sweareth by the gift that is upon it, he is guilty.

\ln Itsinegu ale ditsigewi!  gado usdi utli galvquodiyu, alisgolvtanvhisgo, atsilvgegelasdiyi, nasgi galvquodiyu tsinigvneha alisgolvtanvhi?
\syll ᎢᏥᏁᎫ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏥᎨᏫ  ᎦᏙ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎤᏟ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ, ᎠᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏅᎯᏍᎪ, ᎠᏥᎸᎨᎨᎳᏍᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᏥᏂᎬᏁᎭ ᎠᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏅᎯ?
\ft Ye fools and blind: for whether is greater, the gift, or the altar that sanctifieth the gift?

\ln Nasgi iyusdi gilo iaselidvsgesdi ikaneisdisgesdi atsilvgelasdiyi, kaneisdisgesdi nasgi ale nigav gohusdi nahna ahvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎩᎶ ᎢᎠᏎᎵᏛᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎢᎧᏁᎢᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᏥᎸᎨᎳᏍᏗᏱ, ᎧᏁᎢᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏀᎾ ᎠᎲᎢ.
\ft Whoso therefore shall swear by the altar, sweareth by it, and by all things thereon.

\ln Ale gilo ikaneisdisgesdi udvnvdigalawiisdiyi, kaneisdisgesdi nasgi ale nahna ganela.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᎢᎧᏁᎢᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᏛᏅᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᎧᏁᎢᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ ᏀᎾ ᎦᏁᎳ.
\ft And whoso shall swear by the temple, sweareth by it, and by him that dwelleth therein.

\ln Ale gilo ikaneisdisgesdi galvladi, kaneisdisgesdi Unelanvhi uwediyi ale nahna uwoli.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᎢᎧᏁᎢᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ, ᎧᏁᎢᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏪᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᏀᎾ ᎤᏬᎵ.
\ft And he that shall swear by heaven, sweareth by the throne of God, and by him that sitteth thereon.

\ln Uyoiyu itsalisdanedi ditsowelisgi ale Itsiqualisi itsatlonasdi!  asgohineyeno itsaguyisgo svtli ale esv ale gamini; detsinohiyasgono utli ulisgedvya gesv dikahnawadvsdi, duyugodv gesvi, ale adadolisdiyi, ale gohiyudiyi.  Nasgisgini hia yinitsadvnelei, ale soi nitsinohiyvnaquo yigesei.
\syll ᎤᏲᎢᏳ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᏗᏦᏪᎵᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏥᏆᎵᏏ ᎢᏣᏠᎾᏍᏗ  ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏁᏰᏃ ᎢᏣᎫᏱᏍᎪ ᏒᏟ ᎠᎴ ᎡᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎦᎻᏂ; ᏕᏥᏃᎯᏯᏍᎪᏃ ᎤᏟ ᎤᎵᏍᎨᏛᏯ ᎨᏒ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ, ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎪᎯᏳᏗᏱ.  ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ ᎯᎠ ᏱᏂᏣᏛᏁᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏐᎢ ᏂᏥᏃᎯᏴᎾᏉ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ.
\ft Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye pay tithe of mint and anise and cummin, and have omitted the weightier matters of the law, judgment, mercy, and faith: these ought ye to have done, and not to leave the other undone.

\ln Ditsigewi ditsadatinidohi!  dosv itsihnasolvsdisgi gemilino itsigisgi.
\syll ᏗᏥᎨᏫ ᏗᏣᏓᏘᏂᏙᎯ  ᏙᏒ ᎢᏥᎿᏐᎸᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᎨᎻᎵᏃ ᎢᏥᎩᏍᎩ.
\ft Ye blind guides, which strain at a gnat, and swallow a camel.

\ln Uyoiyu itsalisdanedi ditsowelisgi ale Itsiqualisi itsatlonasdi!  itsosulesgoyeno gaduiditlv ulisquidi ale atelido, aseno awiniditlv ukalitsvhi geso asequo adagiedi gesvi ale duyugodv nigesvna.
\syll ᎤᏲᎢᏳ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᏗᏦᏪᎵᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏥᏆᎵᏏ ᎢᏣᏠᎾᏍᏗ  ᎢᏦᏑᎴᏍᎪᏰᏃ ᎦᏚᎢᏗᏢ ᎤᎵᏍᏈᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏖᎵᏙ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᏫᏂᏗᏢ ᎤᎧᎵᏨᎯ ᎨᏐ ᎠᏎᏉ ᎠᏓᎩᎡᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ ᎠᎴ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.
\ft Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye make clean the outside of the cup and of the platter, but within they are full of extortion and excess.

\ln Hiqualisi tigewi!  igvyi hinvgalv awiniditlv ulisquidi ale atelido, gaduiditlvno nasquo tsudanvgalvdv gesesdi.
\syll ᎯᏆᎵᏏ ᏘᎨᏫ  ᎢᎬᏱ ᎯᏅᎦᎸ ᎠᏫᏂᏗᏢ ᎤᎵᏍᏈᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏖᎵᏙ, ᎦᏚᎢᏗᏢᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏧᏓᏅᎦᎸᏛ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft Thou blind Pharisee, cleanse first that which is within the cup and platter, that the outside of them may be clean also.

\ln Uyoiyu itsalisdanedi ditsowelisgi ale Itsiqualisi itsatlonasdi!  nasgiyaquoyeno nihi tsunegv idigvnelvhi datselisdvi, nasgi gaduiditlv udohiyuhi tsuwoduhiyu tsigesoi, aseno awiniditlv tsukalitsvhi tsigeso tsuniyohusvhi tsunigola ale nigav gadaha gesvi
\syll ᎤᏲᎢᏳ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᏗᏦᏪᎵᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏥᏆᎵᏏ ᎢᏣᏠᎾᏍᏗ  ᎾᏍᎩᏯᏉᏰᏃ ᏂᎯ ᏧᏁᎬ ᎢᏗᎬᏁᎸᎯ ᏓᏤᎵᏍᏛᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏚᎢᏗᏢ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᏧᏬᏚᎯᏳ ᏥᎨᏐᎢ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᏫᏂᏗᏢ ᏧᎧᎵᏨᎯ ᏥᎨᏐ ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᏧᏂᎪᎳ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎦᏓᎭ ᎨᏒᎢ
\ft Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye are like unto whited sepulchres, which indeed appear beautiful outward, but are within full of dead men's bones, and of all uncleanness.

\ln Nasgiyaquosgini nasquo nihi gaduiditlv itsadanvtiyu nvwasdoi yvwi digetsakanodiyi, aseno awiniditlv itsikalitsvhi geso itsatlonasdvi ale uyoi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏯᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏂᎯ ᎦᏚᎢᏗᏢ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏘᏳ ᏅᏩᏍᏙᎢ ᏴᏫ ᏗᎨᏣᎧᏃᏗᏱ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᏫᏂᏗᏢ ᎢᏥᎧᎵᏨᎯ ᎨᏐ ᎢᏣᏠᎾᏍᏛᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏲᎢ.
\ft Even so ye also outwardly appear righteous unto men, but within ye are full of hypocrisy and iniquity.

\ln Uyoiyu itsalisdanedi ditsowelisgi ale Itsiqualisi itsatlonasdi!  detsotlvhisisgoyeno deganisahv anadolehosgi, ale detsoduisdisgo datselisdv unadanvti;
\syll ᎤᏲᎢᏳ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᏗᏦᏪᎵᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏥᏆᎵᏏ ᎢᏣᏠᎾᏍᏗ  ᏕᏦᏢᎯᏏᏍᎪᏰᏃ ᏕᎦᏂᏌᎲ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᏦᏚᎢᏍᏗᏍᎪ ᏓᏤᎵᏍᏛ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ;
\ft Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! because ye build the tombs of the prophets, and garnish the sepulchres of the righteous,

\ln Hiano nitsiwesgoi; Iyuno ayv yotsehe nahiyu tsogidoda tsanehei, vtla yidogayotsaligonele gigv dunatsewelv anadolehosgi.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏥᏪᏍᎪᎢ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᎠᏴ ᏲᏤᎮ ᏀᎢᏳ ᏦᎩᏙᏓ ᏣᏁᎮᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᏱᏙᎦᏲᏣᎵᎪᏁᎴ ᎩᎬ ᏚᎾᏤᏪᎸ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ.
\ft And say, If we had been in the days of our fathers, we would not have been partakers with them in the blood of the prophets.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi itsvsv gvnigesv nitsadadvne nasgi ditsidoda gesv anadolehosgi tsunilvhi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏨᏒ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᏣᏓᏛᏁ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏥᏙᏓ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᏧᏂᎸᎯ.
\ft Wherefore ye be witnesses unto yourselves, that ye are the children of them which killed the prophets.

\ln Itsikalitsagoga ditsidoda unatlilovi.
\syll ᎢᏥᎧᎵᏣᎪᎦ ᏗᏥᏙᏓ ᎤᎾᏟᎶᎥᎢ.
\ft Fill ye up then the measure of your fathers.

\ln Inadv nihi!  unisgasedi inadv tsunetsi nihi!  gadono yigalisdoda yetsadiwisi agiliyoisdi digesv tsvsginoi?
\syll ᎢᎾᏛ ᏂᎯ  ᎤᏂᏍᎦᏎᏗ ᎢᎾᏛ ᏧᏁᏥ ᏂᎯ  ᎦᏙᏃ ᏱᎦᎵᏍᏙᏓ ᏰᏣᏗᏫᏏ ᎠᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗ ᏗᎨᏒ ᏨᏍᎩᏃᎢ?
\ft Ye serpents, ye generation of vipers, how can ye escape the damnation of hell?

\ln Nasgi iyusdi gvniyuquo detsinvli nahna ditsehv anadolehosgi ale anigatahnai ale dinowelisgi; igadvno dodatsili ale dodatsadvni dadahnawasdvi, igadvno dodatsilivnili ditsilawiisdiyi, ale uyo nidodatsvneli degaduhnavi;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᏕᏥᏅᎵ ᏀᎾ ᏗᏤᎲ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎿᎢ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏃᏪᎵᏍᎩ; ᎢᎦᏛᏃ ᏙᏓᏥᎵ ᎠᎴ ᏙᏓᏣᏛᏂ ᏓᏓᎿᏩᏍᏛᎢ, ᎢᎦᏛᏃ ᏙᏓᏥᎵᎥᏂᎵ ᏗᏥᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏲ ᏂᏙᏓᏨᏁᎵ ᏕᎦᏚᎿᎥᎢ;
\ft Wherefore, behold, I send unto you prophets, and wise men, and scribes: and some of them ye shall kill and crucify; and some of them shall ye scourge in your synagogues, and persecute them from city to city:

\ln Nasgi itsilutsediyi nigadv osdv gigv elohi utsewotsvhi, udanvti Equili ugigv nvdagvwadalenvdv, Tsegalaya ugigv Queligaya uwetsi nvdvsdi, nasgi tsetsilv udlanvdv udvnadigalawiisdiyi atsilvnogelasdiyi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏥᎷᏤᏗᏱ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎩᎬ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎤᏤᏬᏨᎯ, ᎤᏓᏅᏘ ᎡᏈᎵ ᎤᎩᎬ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏓᎴᏅᏛ, ᏤᎦᎳᏯ ᎤᎩᎬ ᏇᎵᎦᏯ ᎤᏪᏥ ᏅᏛᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏤᏥᎸ ᎤᏜᏅᏛ ᎤᏛᎾᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᏥᎸᏃᎨᎳᏍᏗᏱ.
\ft That upon you may come all the righteous blood shed upon the earth, from the blood of righteous Abel unto the blood of Zacharias son of Barachias, whom ye slew between the temple and the altar.

\ln Udohiyuhiya hia nitsvweseha; hia nasgi nigadv dayunaliyiloheli hia gohi tsaneha.
\syll ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ; ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏓᏳᎾᎵᏱᎶᎮᎵ ᎯᎠ ᎪᎯ ᏣᏁᎭ.
\ft Verily I say unto you, All these things shall come upon this generation.

\ln Tsilusilimi!  Tsilusilimi!  anadolehosgi tihihi, ale getsalutsediyi getsinvsvhi nvya dvnisdisgi!  yanogiyu aquadulisgv gatsiyatlisodiyi ditsetsi, nasgiya tsataga tsidegatlisisgo tsuwetsi anidv dikanogeni hawiniditlv; aseno vtla yitsadulisgei.
\syll ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ  ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ  ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᏘᎯᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎨᏣᎷᏤᏗᏱ ᎨᏥᏅᏒᎯ ᏅᏯ ᏛᏂᏍᏗᏍᎩ  ᏯᏃᎩᏳ ᎠᏆᏚᎵᏍᎬ ᎦᏥᏯᏟᏐᏗᏱ ᏗᏤᏥ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏣᏔᎦ ᏥᏕᎦᏟᏏᏍᎪ ᏧᏪᏥ ᎠᏂᏛ ᏗᎧᏃᎨᏂ ᎭᏫᏂᏗᏢ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏣᏚᎵᏍᎨᎢ.
\ft O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, thou that killest the prophets, and stonest them which are sent unto thee, how often would I have gathered thy children together, even as a hen gathereth her chickens under her wings, and ye would not!

\ln Gvniyuquo itsatseli galitsode nvta netsvnelv.
\syll ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎢᏣᏤᎵ ᎦᎵᏦᏕ ᏅᏔ ᏁᏨᏁᎸ.
\ft Behold, your house is left unto you desolate.

\ln Hiayeno nitsvweseha; vtla yvgesgigowadv gohi iyudalenvdv, gvni hia nitsiwesvha; Atsilvquodiyu nasgi Yihowa deudov tsigaluhisdiha.
\syll ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ; ᎥᏝ ᏴᎨᏍᎩᎪᏩᏛ ᎪᎯ ᎢᏳᏓᎴᏅᏛ, ᎬᏂ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏥᏪᏒᎭ; ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᎰᏩ ᏕᎤᏙᎥ ᏥᎦᎷᎯᏍᏗᎭ.
\ft For I say unto you, Ye shall not see me henceforth, till ye shall say, Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord.

\ln Tsisano unugotsvgi digalawiisdiyi udanvsvgi, gvwasdawadidohino gvwalutselv gvwanonelvgi nidusdv dadanelv udvnadigalawiisdiyi.
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᏄᎪᏨᎩ ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏓᏅᏒᎩ, ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯᏃ ᎬᏩᎷᏤᎸ ᎬᏩᏃᏁᎸᎩ ᏂᏚᏍᏛ ᏓᏓᏁᎸ ᎤᏛᎾᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ.
\ft And Jesus went out, and departed from the temple: and his disciples came to him for to shew him the buildings of the temple.

\ln Tsisano hia niduweselvgi; Tlasgo nigadv hia yiditsigowatiha?  Udohiyuhiya hia nitsvweseha; vtla saquounv nvya ani yidudasatlahesdi nasgi nigohvtanvna yigesesdi.
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏝᏍᎪ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎯᎠ ᏱᏗᏥᎪᏩᏘᎭ?  ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ; ᎥᏝ ᏌᏉᎤᏅ ᏅᏯ ᎠᏂ ᏱᏚᏓᏌᏝᎮᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎪᎲᏔᏅᎾ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft And Jesus said unto them, See ye not all these things? verily I say unto you, There shall not be left here one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down.

\ln Oliwayono usahilv uwolvi gvwasdawadidohi unvsv gesv gvwalutselvgi, hia nuniwesvgi; Sginohvsi hilago iyu hia nasgi nvdagalistani; ale gado usdi uyelvdv gesesdi tsaluhisdiyi, ale gohi gesv ulisquadisdiyi?
\syll ᎣᎵᏩᏲᏃ ᎤᏌᎯᎸ ᎤᏬᎸᎢ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎤᏅᏒ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏩᎷᏤᎸᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᏍᎩᏃᎲᏏ ᎯᎳᎪ ᎢᏳ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏔᏂ; ᎠᎴ ᎦᏙ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎤᏰᎸᏛ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏣᎷᎯᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᏗᏱ?
\ft And as he sat upon the mount of Olives, the disciples came unto him privately, saying, Tell us, when shall these things be? and what shall be the sign of thy coming, and of the end of the world?

\ln Tsisano unetsv hia niduweselvgi; Itseyatahesdi tlesdi gilo tsitsilonuheli;
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎢᏤᏯᏔᎮᏍᏗ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎩᎶ ᏥᏥᎶᏄᎮᎵ;
\ft And Jesus answered and said unto them, Take heed that no man deceive you.

\ln Unitsatesdiyeno ayv daquadov aniluhisdisgesdi, ayv Galonedv, anadisgesdi; ale unitsadasdi danilonuhesgesdi.
\syll ᎤᏂᏣᏖᏍᏗᏰᏃ ᎠᏴ ᏓᏆᏙᎥ ᎠᏂᎷᎯᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᏴ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ, ᎠᎾᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏣᏓᏍᏗ ᏓᏂᎶᏄᎮᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
\ft For many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ; and shall deceive many.

\ln Ale itsadvgisgesdi dahnawa ale aninohelidohv dahnaya; itseyatahesdi tlesdi uwelihisdi yinitsalisdanelesdi; nasgiyeno nigadiyu ase iyulisdodi, aseno ulisquadisdiyi gesv asi gesesdi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎢᏣᏛᎩᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏓᎿᏩ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏃᎮᎵᏙᎲ ᏓᎿᏯ; ᎢᏤᏯᏔᎮᏍᏗ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎤᏪᎵᎯᏍᏗ ᏱᏂᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᎴᏍᏗ; ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᎠᏎ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᏗᏱ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏏ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft And ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars: see that ye be not troubled: for all these things must come to pass, but the end is not yet.

\ln Tsunadalenvdvyeno yvwi dodvnaleni dodvnadatlutani, ale ayeli dunotlvwadisv dodvnadatlutani, ale dagonulosidohesdi, ale vyugihiyu nigalistanidohesdi, ale gadohi dalitelvnidohesdi.
\syll ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛᏰᏃ ᏴᏫ ᏙᏛᎾᎴᏂ ᏙᏛᎾᏓᏡᏔᏂ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏰᎵ ᏚᏃᏢᏩᏗᏒ ᏙᏛᎾᏓᏡᏔᏂ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᎪᏄᎶᏏᏙᎮᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏳᎩᎯᏳ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏔᏂᏙᎮᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᏙᎯ ᏓᎵᏖᎸᏂᏙᎮᏍᏗ.
\ft For nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom: and there shall be famines, and pestilences, and earthquakes, in divers places.

\ln Nasgi hia nigadv alenisgv gesv agiliya gesvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎠᎴᏂᏍᎬ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎩᎵᏯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft All these are the beginning of sorrows.

\ln Hnaquono nihi widodagetsiyosi itsigiliyoisdiyi, ale dodagetsili; ale nigadiyu nunadalesv yvwi getsisgagesdi ayv daquadov nvdigalisdodisgesdi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏂᎯ ᏫᏙᏓᎨᏥᏲᏏ ᎢᏥᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏙᏓᎨᏥᎵ; ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏄᎾᏓᎴᏒ ᏴᏫ ᎨᏥᏍᎦᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᏴ ᏓᏆᏙᎥ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
\ft Then shall they deliver you up to be afflicted, and shall kill you: and ye shall be hated of all nations for my name's sake.

\ln Hnaquono unitsatesdi dunodehihesdi, ale danadatludisgesdi ale danadasgagesdi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎤᏂᏣᏖᏍᏗ ᏚᏃᏕᎯᎮᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᎾᏓᏡᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏓᎾᏓᏍᎦᎨᏍᏗ.
\ft And then shall many be offended, and shall betray one another, and shall hate one another.

\ln Ale unitsatesdi unatlonasdi anadolehosgi aninanugogesdi, ale unitsatesdi danilonuhesgesdi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏣᏖᏍᏗ ᎤᎾᏠᎾᏍᏗ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎠᏂᎾᏄᎪᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏣᏖᏍᏗ ᏓᏂᎶᏄᎮᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
\ft And many false prophets shall rise, and shall deceive many.

\ln Ale utsadv asganvisdi gesv ehv nasgi iyusdi unitsatesdi adageyudi gesv unehv dvyvdladi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎤᏣᏛ ᎠᏍᎦᏅᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎡᎲ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᏂᏣᏖᏍᏗ ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎲ ᏛᏴᏜᏗ.
\ft And because iniquity shall abound, the love of many shall wax cold.

\ln Aseno nasgi na gvlisquadisgi atlinigvnehi nasgi atsisdelvdi gesesdi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎬᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᎩ ᎠᏟᏂᎬᏁᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏥᏍᏕᎸᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft But he that shall endure unto the end, the same shall be saved.

\ln Hiano nasgi osdv kanohedv galvladi utseligohi elanigv unalitsidoninidasdi gesesdi unadolehohisdiyi naniv tsunadalenvdv yvwi, gilano hnaquo dvlisquadili.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎤᏤᎵᎪᎯ ᎡᎳᏂᎬ ᎤᎾᎵᏥᏙᏂᏂᏓᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᎾᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ, ᎩᎳᏃ ᎿᏉ ᏛᎵᏍᏆᏗᎵ.
\ft And this gospel of the kingdom shall be preached in all the world for a witness unto all nations; and then shall the end come.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi hnaquo itsigohvha usgaisdiyu gvnosadvhi igvnehi, nasgi Denili adolehosgi tsuneistanei, gadogesdi galvquodiyu gesvi, (gilo agoliyesgesdi goligesdi,)
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎿᏉ ᎢᏥᎪᎲᎭ ᎤᏍᎦᎢᏍᏗᏳ ᎬᏃᏌᏛᎯ ᎢᎬᏁᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏕᏂᎵ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᏧᏁᎢᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᎦᏙᎨᏍᏗ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎩᎶ ᎠᎪᎵᏰᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎪᎵᎨᏍᏗ,
\ft When ye therefore shall see the abomination of desolation, spoken of by Daniel the prophet, stand in the holy place, (whoso readeth, let him understand:)

\ln Hnaquo Tsudiyi anini analisvha dotsodalv wanilosvha.
\syll ᎿᏉ ᏧᏗᏱ ᎠᏂᏂ ᎠᎾᎵᏒᎭ ᏙᏦᏓᎸ ᏩᏂᎶᏒᎭ.
\ft Then let them which be in Judaea flee into the mountains:

\ln Gilono gasanali ugilesdi tlesdi yvdiutloasesdi yugisolesdi gohusdi uhv ganelvi;
\syll ᎩᎶᏃ ᎦᏌᎾᎵ ᎤᎩᎴᏍᏗ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏴᏗᎤᏠᎠᏎᏍᏗ ᏳᎩᏐᎴᏍᏗ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᎲ ᎦᏁᎸᎢ;
\ft Let him which is on the housetop not come down to take any thing out of his house:

\ln Ale gilo tlogesi wedohi tlesdi yvdiutsvsesdi tsunuwo yidunesolesdi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᏠᎨᏏ ᏪᏙᎯ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏴᏗᎤᏨᏎᏍᏗ ᏧᏄᏬ ᏱᏚᏁᏐᎴᏍᏗ.
\ft Neither let him which is in the field return back to take his clothes.

\ln Ale uyoiyu iyunalisdanedi dininelidv ale tsunisdai nahiyu gesvi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎤᏲᎢᏳ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᏗᏂᏁᎵᏛ ᎠᎴ ᏧᏂᏍᏓᎢ ᏀᎢᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft And woe unto them that are with child, and to them that give suck in those days!

\ln Ale itsadadolisdisgesdi itsitayohihesdi gola ale unadodaquasgv itsalisdiyi nigesvna iyulisdodiyi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎢᏣᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎢᏥᏔᏲᎯᎮᏍᏗ ᎪᎳ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏙᏓᏆᏍᎬ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
\ft But pray ye that your flight be not in the winter, neither on the sabbath day:

\ln Nahiyuyeno utsatesdi agiliya, nasgi igai vtla ilvhiyu yinulistano elohi tsudotlvnv nvdagvwadalenvdv gohi iyasti, vtla ale ilvhiyu nasgi iyulisdodi yigesesdi.
\syll ᏀᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᎤᏣᏖᏍᏗ ᎠᎩᎵᏯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎥᏝ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᏱᏄᎵᏍᏔᏃ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏧᏙᏢᏅ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎪᎯ ᎢᏯᏍᏘ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft For then shall be great tribulation, such as was not since the beginning of the world to this time, no, nor ever shall be.

\ln Ale nahiyu iga nidasqualanvna yigi, vtla uquedali gayetsisdelvdi yigagi; aseno gegasuyedv gesv nvdigalisdodisgesdi nahiyu iga disqualodi gesesdi
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏀᎢᏳ ᎢᎦ ᏂᏓᏍᏆᎳᏅᎾ ᏱᎩ, ᎥᏝ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎦᏰᏥᏍᏕᎸᏗ ᏱᎦᎩ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎨᎦᏑᏰᏛ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏀᎢᏳ ᎢᎦ ᏗᏍᏆᎶᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ
\ft And except those days should be shortened, there should no flesh be saved: but for the elect's sake those days shall be shortened.

\ln Nahiyu gesv iyuno gilo hia nitsiwesehesdi, Gvniyuquo ani Galonedv edoha; ale ani; tlesdi tsitsohiyuni
\syll ᏀᎢᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏥᏪᏎᎮᏍᏗ, ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎠᏂ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎡᏙᎭ; ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂ; ᏞᏍᏗ ᏥᏦᎯᏳᏂ
\ft Then if any man shall say unto you, Lo, here is Christ, or there; believe it not.

\ln Dvninanugotsiyeno unatlonasdi Galonedv ale unatlonasdi anadolehosgi, ale aninanugowisgesdi galvquodiyu uyelvdv ale usquanigodi; nasgi iyusdi iyuno yeli igvwalisdodi yigi yidanilonuhvli nasquo gegasuyedv.
\syll ᏛᏂᎾᏄᎪᏥᏰᏃ ᎤᎾᏠᎾᏍᏗ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏠᎾᏍᏗ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᎾᏄᎪᏫᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎤᏰᎸᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏳᏃ ᏰᎵ ᎢᎬᏩᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᏱᎩ ᏱᏓᏂᎶᏄᎲᎵ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎨᎦᏑᏰᏛ.
\ft For there shall arise false Christs, and false prophets, and shall shew great signs and wonders; insomuch that, if it were possible, they shall deceive the very elect.

\ln Gvniyuquo nitsvnonelv.
\syll ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᏂᏨᏃᏁᎸ.
\ft Behold, I have told you before.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi iyuno hia nigetsiweselvha; Inage edoha; tlesdi nahna witsilosvgi; gvniyuquo udelisv kanvsulv ayaa; tlesdi tsitsohiyuni.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏳᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎨᏥᏪᏎᎸᎭ; ᎢᎾᎨ ᎡᏙᎭ; ᏞᏍᏗ ᏀᎾ ᏫᏥᎶᏒᎩ; ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎤᏕᎵᏒ ᎧᏅᏑᎸ ᎠᏯᎠ; ᏞᏍᏗ ᏥᏦᎯᏳᏂ.
\ft Wherefore if they shall say unto you, Behold, he is in the desert; go not forth: behold, he is in the secret chambers; believe it not.

\ln Anagalisgiyeno dikalvgv tsvdigananugogoi, wudeligvno iyvdv tsiwidigalvsadadisgoi, nasgiya nasquo nusdesdi yvwi Uwetsi galutsilvha.
\syll ᎠᎾᎦᎵᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᏗᎧᎸᎬ ᏨᏗᎦᎾᏄᎪᎪᎢ, ᏭᏕᎵᎬᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏥᏫᏗᎦᎸᏌᏓᏗᏍᎪᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏄᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎦᎷᏥᎸᎭ.
\ft For as the lightning cometh out of the east, and shineth even unto the west; so shall also the coming of the Son of man be.

\ln Ilvhitlvyeno gohusdi uliwotsvhi tsiganoi, nahna awohali anadatlisisgoi.
\syll ᎢᎸᎯᏢᏰᏃ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᎵᏬᏨᎯ ᏥᎦᏃᎢ, ᏀᎾ ᎠᏬᎭᎵ ᎠᎾᏓᏟᏏᏍᎪᎢ.
\ft For wheresoever the carcase is, there will the eagles be gathered together.

\ln Igvwenvdaquo oni nasgi nahiyu agiliya galosonvha, nvdo iga ehi dvlisihvsi, ale nvdo svnoyi ehi vtla iga yutisdesdi, ale noquisi dvninvgoasi, ale unitsati galvloi tsanikala dvnalitelvni.
\syll ᎢᎬᏪᏅᏓᏉ ᎣᏂ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏀᎢᏳ ᎠᎩᎵᏯ ᎦᎶᏐᏅᎭ, ᏅᏙ ᎢᎦ ᎡᎯ ᏛᎵᏏᎲᏏ, ᎠᎴ ᏅᏙ ᏒᏃᏱ ᎡᎯ ᎥᏝ ᎢᎦ ᏳᏘᏍᏕᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏃᏈᏏ ᏛᏂᏅᎪᎠᏏ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎦᎸᎶᎢ ᏣᏂᎧᎳ ᏛᎾᎵᏖᎸᏂ.
\ft Immediately after the tribulation of those days shall the sun be darkened, and the moon shall not give her light, and the stars shall fall from heaven, and the powers of the heavens shall be shaken:

\ln Hnaquono galvloi dagananugotsi yvwi uwetsi utseli uyelvdvi, ale hnaquo nigadv danilasdalv elohi dodvniyvlasi, ale dvnigohi yvwi Uwetsi tsaisesdi ulogilv galvloi, ulinigidiyu gesv ale utsati galvquodiyu gesv unuwosdesdi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎦᎸᎶᎢ ᏓᎦᎾᏄᎪᏥ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎤᏰᎸᏛᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎿᏉ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏓᏂᎳᏍᏓᎸ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏙᏛᏂᏴᎳᏏ, ᎠᎴ ᏛᏂᎪᎯ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᏣᎢᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᎶᎩᎸ ᎦᎸᎶᎢ, ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏄᏬᏍᏕᏍᏗ.
\ft And then shall appear the sign of the Son of man in heaven: and then shall all the tribes of the earth mourn, and they shall see the Son of man coming in the clouds of heaven with power and great glory.

\ln Hnaquono dodaganvsi tsunvsidasdi, ale asdayiyu dvnitseluhisi, ale dodvnitlisani gegasuyedv nvgi nidodigalosgv unole, galvlo iyvdv widulistinilv.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏙᏓᎦᏅᏏ ᏧᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏍᏓᏱᏳ ᏛᏂᏤᎷᎯᏏ, ᎠᎴ ᏙᏛᏂᏟᏌᏂ ᎨᎦᏑᏰᏛ ᏅᎩ ᏂᏙᏗᎦᎶᏍᎬ ᎤᏃᎴ, ᎦᎸᎶ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏫᏚᎵᏍᏘᏂᎸ.
\ft And he shall send his angels with a great sound of a trumpet, and they shall gather together his elect from the four winds, from one end of heaven to the other.

\ln Ka, itsadeloqua datlilosdv svgataiyusdi tlugvi; Iyuyeno duwanigalv didage nidegalisda, ale gilai tsigalasduhvsgoi, itsigataho gogi navniyu gesvi.
\syll Ꭷ, ᎢᏣᏕᎶᏆ ᏓᏟᎶᏍᏛ ᏒᎦᏔᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏡᎬᎢ; ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᏚᏩᏂᎦᎸ ᏗᏓᎨ ᏂᏕᎦᎵᏍᏓ, ᎠᎴ ᎩᎳᎢ ᏥᎦᎳᏍᏚᎲᏍᎪᎢ, ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎰ ᎪᎩ ᎾᎥᏂᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Now learn a parable of the fig tree; When his branch is yet tender, and putteth forth leaves, ye know that summer is nigh:

\ln Nasgiyasgini nasquo nihi, iyuno hnaquo hia nasgi tsudalenvdv itsigohvha, itsigatahesdi esganiyu gesvi, galohisdiyiquo gesvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏯᏍᎩᏂ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏂᎯ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎿᏉ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎢᏥᎪᎲᎭ, ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎮᏍᏗ ᎡᏍᎦᏂᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱᏉ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft So likewise ye, when ye shall see all these things, know that it is near, even at the doors.

\ln Udohiyuhiya hia nitsvweseha; Hia gohi tsaneha vtla yvdvnilosoni, gvni nigadv hia tsudalenvdv nigalistanvha.
\syll ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ; ᎯᎠ ᎪᎯ ᏣᏁᎭ ᎥᏝ ᏴᏛᏂᎶᏐᏂ, ᎬᏂ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎯᎠ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏔᏅᎭ.
\ft Verily I say unto you, This generation shall not pass, till all these things be fulfilled.

\ln Galvlo ale elohi dodagalosoni, ayvsgini aginetsvi vtla yvdagalosoni.
\syll ᎦᎸᎶ ᎠᎴ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏙᏓᎦᎶᏐᏂ, ᎠᏴᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᎩᏁᏨᎢ ᎥᏝ ᏴᏓᎦᎶᏐᏂ.
\ft Heaven and earth shall pass away, but my words shall not pass away.

\ln Aseno nahiyu iga gesv ale iyutlilodv kalawadisv vtla gilo yagataha, tla nasquo dinikahnawadidohi galvladi anehi, Edodasgini uwasvhiyu.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᏀᎢᏳ ᎢᎦ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏳᏟᎶᏛ ᎧᎳᏩᏗᏒ ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᏯᎦᏔᎭ, Ꮭ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏗᏂᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎠᏁᎯ, ᎡᏙᏓᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏩᏒᎯᏳ.
\ft But of that day and hour knoweth no man, no, not the angels of heaven, but my Father only.

\ln Nasgiyeno tsinusde nahiyu Noya tsehei, nasgiya nusdesdi yvwi Uwetsi galutsvha.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᏥᏄᏍᏕ ᏀᎢᏳ ᏃᏯ ᏤᎮᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎦᎷᏨᎭ.
\ft But as the days of Noe were, so shall also the coming of the Son of man be.

\ln Nahiyueno asi niganohugisgvna tsigesei, danalisdayvhvsgei, ale danaditasgei, ale danadesvhvsgei ale degetsiyegei, gvni nahiyu iga Noya utsanv tsiyuhi,
\syll ᏀᎢᏳᎡᏃ ᎠᏏ ᏂᎦᏃᎱᎩᏍᎬᎾ ᏥᎨᏎᎢ, ᏓᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᎾᏗᏔᏍᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᎾᏕᏒᎲᏍᎨᎢ ᎠᎴ ᏕᎨᏥᏰᎨᎢ, ᎬᏂ ᏀᎢᏳ ᎢᎦ ᏃᏯ ᎤᏣᏅ ᏥᏳᎯ,
\ft For as in the days that were before the flood they were eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage, until the day that Noe entered into the ark,

\ln Ale nanelisgvna tsigesei, gvni unohuganilv, ale nigadv dunigvtsv, nasgiyaquosgini nasquo nusdesdi yvwi Uwetsi galutsvha.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏁᎵᏍᎬᎾ ᏥᎨᏎᎢ, ᎬᏂ ᎤᏃᎱᎦᏂᎸ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏚᏂᎬᏨ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏄᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎦᎷᏨᎭ.
\ft And knew not until the flood came, and took them all away; so shall also the coming of the Son of man be.

\ln Hnaquono anitali tlogesi anedohesdi, asiyvwi atsiyanvdi gesesdi soino atsikahiyasdi gesesdi;
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᏠᎨᏏ ᎠᏁᏙᎮᏍᏗ, ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᎠᏥᏯᏅᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏐᎢᏃ ᎠᏥᎧᎯᏯᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ;
\ft Then shall two be in the field; the one shall be taken, and the other left.

\ln Anitali anigeyv anisdosgesdi asdosgiyi, asiyvwi atsiyanvdi gesesdi soino atsikahiyasdi gesesdi.
\syll ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᎠᏂᎨᏴ ᎠᏂᏍᏙᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᏍᏙᏍᎩᏱ, ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᎠᏥᏯᏅᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏐᎢᏃ ᎠᏥᎧᎯᏯᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft Two women shall be grinding at the mill; the one shall be taken, and the other left.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi itsiyawisgesdi, vtlayeno yitsigataha iyuquo uluhisdiyi itsatseli Ugvwiyuhi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏥᏯᏫᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᏱᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᎢᏳᏉ ᎤᎷᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎢᏣᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ.
\ft Watch therefore: for ye know not what hour your Lord doth come.

\ln Hiano itsanvtesdi, iyuno asgaya ganela yiagatahe iyuquo ganosgisgi uluhisdiyi, yuyawisei, ale vtla unelagi wagiyvsi galitsode yigvwelisei.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᎢᏣᏅᏖᏍᏗ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎦᏁᎳ ᏱᎠᎦᏔᎮ ᎢᏳᏉ ᎦᏃᏍᎩᏍᎩ ᎤᎷᎯᏍᏗᏱ, ᏳᏯᏫᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏁᎳᎩ ᏩᎩᏴᏏ ᎦᎵᏦᏕ ᏱᎬᏪᎵᏎᎢ.
\ft But know this, that if the goodman of the house had known in what watch the thief would come, he would have watched, and would not have suffered his house to be broken up.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi nihi nasquo itsadvnvisdesdi, nitselisgvnaquoyeno gesv iyu yvwi uwetsi dagalutsi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏂᎯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎢᏣᏛᏅᎢᏍᏕᏍᏗ, ᏂᏤᎵᏍᎬᎾᏉᏰᏃ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᏓᎦᎷᏥ.
\ft Therefore be ye also ready: for in such an hour as ye think not the Son of man cometh.

\ln Gagogeno agaliya ale asinasani atsinvsidasdi, nasgi unvsidohi nugvwiyusv iyuwanelvhi ganelv dudatihnavi, nasgi unalisdayvdi tsunediyi unalisdayvdiyi nigalistanisvi?
\syll ᎦᎪᎨᏃ ᎠᎦᎵᏯ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏏᎾᏌᏂ ᎠᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏅᏏᏙᎯ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎢᏳᏩᏁᎸᎯ ᎦᏁᎸ ᏚᏓᏘᎿᎥᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗ ᏧᏁᏗᏱ ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏔᏂᏒᎢ?
\ft Who then is a faithful and wise servant, whom his lord hath made ruler over his household, to give them meat in due season?

\ln Osiyu iyulisdanedi nasgi na atsinvsidasdi unvsidohi galutsvha uwadvhvha nasgi nadvnehvi.
\syll ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎤᏅᏏᏙᎯ ᎦᎷᏨᎭ ᎤᏩᏛᎲᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏛᏁᎲᎢ.
\ft Blessed is that servant, whom his lord when he cometh shall find so doing.

\ln Udohiyuhiya hia nitsvweseha; Nigadv uhnavi dvgatidistani.
\syll ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ; ᏂᎦᏛ ᎤᎿᎥᎢ ᏛᎦᏘᏗᏍᏔᏂ.
\ft Verily I say unto you, That he shall make him ruler over all his goods.

\ln Iyusginino nasgi na unegutsidv atsinvsidasdi hia nigawesgesdi tsudanvdvi; Aginvsidohi gohidiha uluhisdiyi;
\syll ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᏁᎫᏥᏛ ᎠᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏧᏓᏅᏛᎢ; ᎠᎩᏅᏏᏙᎯ ᎪᎯᏗᎭ ᎤᎷᎯᏍᏗᏱ;
\ft But and if that evil servant shall say in his heart, My lord delayeth his coming;

\ln Ale alenisgesdi dogalvnihesdi itsulaha getsinvsidasdi, ale itsulaha analisdayvhvsgesdi ale danaditasgesdi tsuniyvsdesgi,
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎠᎴᏂᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏙᎦᎸᏂᎮᏍᏗ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎠᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏓᎾᏗᏔᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏧᏂᏴᏍᏕᏍᎩ,
\ft And shall begin to smite his fellowservants, and to eat and drink with the drunken;

\ln Nasgi atsinvsidasdi unvsidohi dagalutsi nahiyu iga nadagatenohvna gesvi, ale iyu nelisgvna gesvi,
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎤᏅᏏᏙᎯ ᏓᎦᎷᏥ ᏀᎢᏳ ᎢᎦ ᎾᏓᎦᏖᏃᎲᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏳ ᏁᎵᏍᎬᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ,
\ft The lord of that servant shall come in a day when he looketh not for him, and in an hour that he is not aware of,

\ln Ale dodayugalisi, ale unatlonasdi wanehv wvdayuseheli; nahna daniyvgesdi ale danilvdagisgesdi daninudogvi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏙᏓᏳᎦᎵᏏ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏠᎾᏍᏗ ᏩᏁᎲ ᏮᏓᏳᏎᎮᎵ; ᏀᎾ ᏓᏂᏴᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏓᏂᎸᏓᎩᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏓᏂᏄᏙᎬᎢ.
\ft And shall cut him asunder, and appoint him his portion with the hypocrites: there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.

\ln Hnaquono galvladi ehi ugvwiyuhi gesv nasgiya gesesdi asgohi iyanidv anadv, nasgi tsiduninvse ditsvsdodi ale tsidunatlosvse adesvhvsgi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎠᏍᎪᎯ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᎠᎾᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏚᏂᏅᏎ ᏗᏨᏍᏙᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏥᏚᎾᏠᏒᏎ ᎠᏕᏒᎲᏍᎩ.
\ft Then shall the kingdom of heaven be likened unto ten virgins, which took their lamps, and went forth to meet the bridegroom.

\ln Hisgino iyanidv anigatahnai gesei, hisgino uninegu.
\syll ᎯᏍᎩᏃ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎿᎢ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎯᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᏂᏁᎫ.
\ft And five of them were wise, and five were foolish.

\ln Uninegu duninvse ditsvsdodi aseno goi nuninetsvsvna gesei,
\syll ᎤᏂᏁᎫ ᏚᏂᏅᏎ ᏗᏨᏍᏙᏗ ᎠᏎᏃ ᎪᎢ ᏄᏂᏁᏨᏒᎾ ᎨᏎᎢ,
\ft They that were foolish took their lamps, and took no oil with them:

\ln Anigatahnaisgini duninvse tsunitsvsdodi, ale nasquo goi uninetsvse dunitlistane ditelido.
\syll ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎿᎢᏍᎩᏂ ᏚᏂᏅᏎ ᏧᏂᏨᏍᏙᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎪᎢ ᎤᏂᏁᏨᏎ ᏚᏂᏟᏍᏔᏁ ᏗᏖᎵᏙ.
\ft But the wise took oil in their vessels with their lamps.

\ln Asino ugoniyoge adesvhvsgi, nigadv anilinvgei, ale unilinvtsei.
\syll ᎠᏏᏃ ᎤᎪᏂᏲᎨ ᎠᏕᏒᎲᏍᎩ, ᏂᎦᏛ ᎠᏂᎵᏅᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᎵᏅᏤᎢ.
\ft While the bridegroom tarried, they all slumbered and slept.

\ln Svnoyino ayeli gilo asdaya unetsei, hia nuwesei; Gvniyuquo adesvhvsgi dayai!  widetsatloi!
\syll ᏒᏃᏱᏃ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎩᎶ ᎠᏍᏓᏯ ᎤᏁᏤᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎠᏕᏒᎲᏍᎩ ᏓᏯᎢ  ᏫᏕᏣᏠᎢ
\ft And at midnight there was a cry made, Behold, the bridegroom cometh; go ye out to meet him.

\ln Hnaquono nigadv anadv unadidanesei, ale dunitsinosgalvhe dunitsvsdvi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎠᎾᏛ ᎤᎾᏗᏓᏁᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏂᏥᏃᏍᎦᎸᎮ ᏚᏂᏨᏍᏛᎢ.
\ft Then all those virgins arose, and trimmed their lamps.

\ln Unineguno hia niduniwesele anigatahnai; Igadv goi itsatseli sginevsi, dogvtlohisehayeno dogitsvsdvi.
\syll ᎤᏂᏁᎫᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏂᏪᏎᎴ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎿᎢ; ᎢᎦᏛ ᎪᎢ ᎢᏣᏤᎵ ᏍᎩᏁᎥᏏ, ᏙᎬᏠᎯᏎᎭᏰᏃ ᏙᎩᏨᏍᏛᎢ.
\ft And the foolish said unto the wise, Give us of your oil; for our lamps are gone out.

\ln Aseno anigatahnai uninetsv hia nuniwesei; Tlage yeli yidogegiyeliga nigadv, itsenaquosgini dininodisgv, itsvsv witsiwahi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎿᎢ ᎤᏂᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ; ᏝᎨ ᏰᎵ ᏱᏙᎨᎩᏰᎵᎦ ᏂᎦᏛ, ᎢᏤᎾᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᏗᏂᏃᏗᏍᎬ, ᎢᏨᏒ ᏫᏥᏩᎯ.
\ft But the wise answered, saying, Not so; lest there be not enough for us and you: but go ye rather to them that sell, and buy for yourselves.

\ln Uniwasenvno adesvhvsgi ulutsei, unadvnvisdino nasgi itsulaha tsagatsvsdodiyi wuniyvlei, ale unisdune galohisdiyi.
\syll ᎤᏂᏩᏎᏅᏃ ᎠᏕᏒᎲᏍᎩ ᎤᎷᏤᎢ, ᎤᎾᏛᏅᎢᏍᏗᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᏣᎦᏨᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏭᏂᏴᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏍᏚᏁ ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ.
\ft And while they went to buy, the bridegroom came; and they that were ready went in with him to the marriage: and the door was shut.

\ln Onino nasquo anisoi anadv unilutsei, hia nuniwesei; Tsagvwiyuhi, Tsagvwiyuhi, esgisdugi.
\syll ᎣᏂᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏂᏐᎢ ᎠᎾᏛ ᎤᏂᎷᏤᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ; ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎡᏍᎩᏍᏚᎩ.
\ft Afterward came also the other virgins, saying, Lord, Lord, open to us.

\ln Aseno tsunetsv hia nuwesei; Udohiyuhiya itsvyoseha, vtla yitsvgataha.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᏧᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎢᏨᏲᏎᎭ, ᎥᏝ ᏱᏨᎦᏔᎭ.
\ft But he answered and said, Verily I say unto you, I know you not.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi itsiyawisgesdi, vtlayeno yitsigataha nahiyu iga gesv ale iyutlilodv kalawadisv uluhisdiyi yvwi Uwetsi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏥᏯᏫᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᏱᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᏀᎢᏳ ᎢᎦ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏳᏟᎶᏛ ᎧᎳᏩᏗᏒ ᎤᎷᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ.
\ft Watch therefore, for ye know neither the day nor the hour wherein the Son of man cometh.

\ln Nasgiyaquoyeno gilo asgaya invtsiwvdigalosisei, ale tsiwiduyanvhe tsunvsidasdi, ale tsiduyohisele uhnavi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏯᏉᏰᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎢᏅᏥᏮᏗᎦᎶᏏᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᏫᏚᏯᏅᎮ ᏧᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᏚᏲᎯᏎᎴ ᎤᎿᎥᎢ.
\ft For the kingdom of heaven is as a man travelling into a far country, who called his own servants, and delivered unto them his goods.

\ln Asiyvwino hisgi iyagayvli adelv dunelei, soino tali iyagayvli, soino saquo iyagayvli, anisiyvwiha nasgi yeli igvwanadvnedi gesvi.  Hnaquono unigisei.
\syll ᎠᏏᏴᏫᏃ ᎯᏍᎩ ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ ᎠᏕᎸ ᏚᏁᎴᎢ, ᏐᎢᏃ ᏔᎵ ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ, ᏐᎢᏃ ᏌᏉ ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ, ᎠᏂᏏᏴᏫᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏰᎵ ᎢᎬᏩᎾᏛᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.  ᎿᏉᏃ ᎤᏂᎩᏎᎢ.
\ft And unto one he gave five talents, to another two, and to another one; to every man according to his several ability; and straightway took his journey.

\ln Hnaquono hisgi iyagayvli tsatsinelvhi uwenvse wunotanei, hisgino iyagayvli unequotselei.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎯᏍᎩ ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ ᏣᏥᏁᎸᎯ ᎤᏪᏅᏎ ᏭᏃᏔᏁᎢ, ᎯᏍᎩᏃ ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ ᎤᏁᏉᏤᎴᎢ.
\ft Then he that had received the five talents went and traded with the same, and made them other five talents.

\ln Nasquo ale na tali iyagayvli tsatsinelvhi nasquo tali iyagayvli unequotselei.
\syll ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᎴ Ꮎ ᏔᎵ ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ ᏣᏥᏁᎸᎯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏔᎵ ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ ᎤᏁᏉᏤᎴᎢ.
\ft And likewise he that had received two, he also gained other two.

\ln Saquosgini iyagayvli tsatsinelvhi uwenvsei, wusgoha gadohi, ale widuwasgalane unatlai tsutseli adelv.
\syll ᏌᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ ᏣᏥᏁᎸᎯ ᎤᏪᏅᏎᎢ, ᏭᏍᎪᎭ ᎦᏙᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏫᏚᏩᏍᎦᎳᏁ ᎤᎾᏝᎢ ᏧᏤᎵ ᎠᏕᎸ.
\ft But he that had received one went and digged in the earth, and hid his lord's money.

\ln Ilvhiyuno iyvdv ulutse nasgi getsinvsidasdi uninatlai, osdvno nunvnelei.
\syll ᎢᎸᎯᏳᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎤᎷᏤ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎤᏂᎾᏝᎢ, ᎣᏍᏛᏃ ᏄᏅᏁᎴᎢ.
\ft After a long time the lord of those servants cometh, and reckoneth with them.

\ln Hisgino iyagayvli tsatsinelvhi ulutsei, ale duyole nvwanadale hisgi iyagayvli adelv, hia nuwesei; Sginatlai, hisgi iyagayvli adelv desgiyohiselvgi; gvniyuquo nvwanadale hisgi iyadeyvli gvginequotselv.
\syll ᎯᏍᎩᏃ ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ ᏣᏥᏁᎸᎯ ᎤᎷᏤᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏲᎴ ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴ ᎯᏍᎩ ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ ᎠᏕᎸ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᏍᎩᎾᏝᎢ, ᎯᏍᎩ ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ ᎠᏕᎸ ᏕᏍᎩᏲᎯᏎᎸᎩ; ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴ ᎯᏍᎩ ᎢᏯᏕᏴᎵ ᎬᎩᏁᏉᏤᎸ.
\ft And so he that had received five talents came and brought other five talents, saying, Lord, thou deliveredst unto me five talents: behold, I have gained beside them five talents more.

\ln Unatlaino hia nuweselei; Osiyu!  hosdv ale higaliya etsanvsidasdi!  duyugodv nitsadvnelv usdi tsudalenvdv detsalvwisdanelvi; utsati tsudalenvdv tsagvwiyusadegi nvdagvyvneli; hiyvha osdv adanvdadisdiyi tsanatlai utseligohi.
\syll ᎤᎾᏝᎢᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎣᏏᏳ  ᎰᏍᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎯᎦᎵᏯ ᎡᏣᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ  ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎸ ᎤᏍᏗ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏕᏣᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸᎢ; ᎤᏣᏘ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏣᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ ᏅᏓᎬᏴᏁᎵ; ᎯᏴᎭ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎠᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗᏱ ᏣᎾᏝᎢ ᎤᏤᎵᎪᎯ.
\ft His lord said unto him, Well done, thou good and faithful servant: thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will make thee ruler over many things: enter thou into the joy of thy lord.

\ln Nasquono tali iyagayvli tsatsinelvhi ulutsv hia nuwesei; Sginatlai, tali iyagayvli adelv desgiyohiselvgi; gvniyuquo nvwanadale tali iyagayvli gvginequotselv.
\syll ᎾᏍᏉᏃ ᏔᎵ ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ ᏣᏥᏁᎸᎯ ᎤᎷᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᏍᎩᎾᏝᎢ, ᏔᎵ ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ ᎠᏕᎸ ᏕᏍᎩᏲᎯᏎᎸᎩ; ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴ ᏔᎵ ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ ᎬᎩᏁᏉᏤᎸ.
\ft He also that had received two talents came and said, Lord, thou deliveredst unto me two talents: behold, I have gained two other talents beside them.

\ln Unatlai hia nuweselei; Osiyu!  hosdv ale higaliya etsanvsidasdi!  duyugodv nitsadvnelv usdi tsudalenvdv detsalvwisdanelvi; utsati tsudalenvdv tsagvwiyusadegi nvdagvyvneli; hiyvha osdv adanvdadisdiyi tsanatlai utseligohi.
\syll ᎤᎾᏝᎢ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎣᏏᏳ  ᎰᏍᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎯᎦᎵᏯ ᎡᏣᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ  ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎸ ᎤᏍᏗ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏕᏣᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸᎢ; ᎤᏣᏘ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏣᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ ᏅᏓᎬᏴᏁᎵ; ᎯᏴᎭ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎠᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗᏱ ᏣᎾᏝᎢ ᎤᏤᎵᎪᎯ.
\ft His lord said unto him, Well done, good and faithful servant; thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will make thee ruler over many things: enter thou into the joy of thy lord.

\ln Hnaquono saquo iyagayvli tsatsinelvhi ulutsv hia nuwesei; Sginatlai, gvgatahvgi, hisdayiyu gesvi, ale hisgudesgvi nahna nitsawisvna gesvi, ale hutesgvi nahna nitsaleladvnvna gesvi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏌᏉ ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ ᏣᏥᏁᎸᎯ ᎤᎷᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᏍᎩᎾᏝᎢ, ᎬᎦᏔᎲᎩ, ᎯᏍᏓᏱᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᏍᎫᏕᏍᎬᎢ ᏀᎾ ᏂᏣᏫᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎱᏖᏍᎬᎢ ᏀᎾ ᏂᏣᎴᎳᏛᏅᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Then he which had received the one talent came and said, Lord, I knew thee that thou art an hard man, reaping where thou hast not sown, and gathering where thou hast not strawed:

\ln Ale tsisgaihvi aquenvsvgi, widagvsgalanvgi gadohi adelv ditsatseliga; gvniyuquo ani nasgi ditsatseliga.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏥᏍᎦᎢᎲᎢ ᎠᏇᏅᏒᎩ, ᏫᏓᎬᏍᎦᎳᏅᎩ ᎦᏙᎯ ᎠᏕᎸ ᏗᏣᏤᎵᎦ; ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎠᏂ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏣᏤᎵᎦ.
\ft And I was afraid, and went and hid thy talent in the earth: lo, there thou hast that is thine.

\ln Unatlaino unetsv hia nuweselei; Tsanegutsidv ale tsadanulvdi etsanvsidasdi!  higatahvgi tsisgudesgv nahna nagiwisvna gesvi, ale gutesgv nahna nagileladvnvna gesvi!
\syll ᎤᎾᏝᎢᏃ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᏣᏁᎫᏥᏛ ᎠᎴ ᏣᏓᏄᎸᏗ ᎡᏣᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ  ᎯᎦᏔᎲᎩ ᏥᏍᎫᏕᏍᎬ ᏀᎾ ᎾᎩᏫᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎫᏖᏍᎬ ᏀᎾ ᎾᎩᎴᎳᏛᏅᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ
\ft His lord answered and said unto him, Thou wicked and slothful servant, thou knewest that I reap where I sowed not, and gather where I have not strawed:

\ln Adelv dinisquanigodisgiyi yiwidotsane adelv diquatseliga, nasgino gohi tsitsilugi yidagigohe diquatseli ale uninequotsvhi.
\syll ᎠᏕᎸ ᏗᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗᏍᎩᏱ ᏱᏫᏙᏣᏁ ᎠᏕᎸ ᏗᏆᏤᎵᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎪᎯ ᏥᏥᎷᎩ ᏱᏓᎩᎪᎮ ᏗᏆᏤᎵ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏁᏉᏨᎯ.
\ft Thou oughtest therefore to have put my money to the exchangers, and then at my coming I should have received mine own with usury.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi tsidoetsigisiquo saquo iyagayvli adelv, asgohino iyagayvli tsuhi tsetsivsi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏥᏙᎡᏥᎩᏏᏉ ᏌᏉ ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ ᎠᏕᎸ, ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏃ ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ ᏧᎯ ᏤᏥᎥᏏ.
\ft Take therefore the talent from him, and give it unto him which hath ten talents.

\ln Giloyeno uhesdi atsinedi gesesdi, utsatino usquanigodesdi; gilosgini nuhvna gesesdi atsigiediquo gesesdi nasgi nasquo uhvi.
\syll ᎩᎶᏰᏃ ᎤᎮᏍᏗ ᎠᏥᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎤᏣᏘᏃ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏕᏍᏗ; ᎩᎶᏍᎩᏂ ᏄᎲᎾ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎠᏥᎩᎡᏗᏉ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᎲᎢ.
\ft For unto every one that hath shall be given, and he shall have abundance: but from him that hath not shall be taken away even that which he hath.

\ln Hiano gohusdi gvdodi nigesvna ganvsidasdi doyiditlv tsulisigv wetsadauga; nahna daniyvgesdi ale danilvdagisgesdi daninudogvi.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎬᏙᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎦᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᏙᏱᏗᏢ ᏧᎵᏏᎬ ᏪᏣᏓᎤᎦ; ᏀᎾ ᏓᏂᏴᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏓᏂᎸᏓᎩᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏓᏂᏄᏙᎬᎢ.
\ft And cast ye the unprofitable servant into outer darkness: there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.

\ln Iyuno hnaquo yvwi Uwetsi galutsvha uwasv utseliga galvquodiyu gesv unuwosdesdi, ale nigadv getsilvquodi dinikahnawadidohi datinehesdi, hnaquo dagani galvquodiyu uwesgilvi;
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᎿᏉ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎦᎷᏨᎭ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏄᏬᏍᏕᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎨᏥᎸᏉᏗ ᏗᏂᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏓᏘᏁᎮᏍᏗ, ᎿᏉ ᏓᎦᏂ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎤᏪᏍᎩᎸᎢ;
\ft When the Son of man shall come in his glory, and all the holy angels with him, then shall he sit upon the throne of his glory:

\ln Igvyiditlvno dodagetsilawidi nigadiyu nunadalesv yvwi, ale dodvgalenvtani nasgiya awidigatiya tsidagalenvdisgo tsutseli awi uninodena ale awi dinihanulvhi.
\syll ᎢᎬᏱᏗᏢᏃ ᏙᏓᎨᏥᎳᏫᏗ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏄᎾᏓᎴᏒ ᏴᏫ, ᎠᎴ ᏙᏛᎦᎴᏅᏔᏂ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎠᏫᏗᎦᏘᏯ ᏥᏓᎦᎴᏅᏗᏍᎪ ᏧᏤᎵ ᎠᏫ ᎤᏂᏃᏕᎾ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏫ ᏗᏂᎭᏄᎸᎯ.
\ft And before him shall be gathered all nations: and he shall separate them one from another, as a shepherd divideth his sheep from the goats:

\ln Awino uninodena agatisi iditlv dodagagotani, awino dinihanulvhi agasgani iditlv;
\syll ᎠᏫᏃ ᎤᏂᏃᏕᎾ ᎠᎦᏘᏏ ᎢᏗᏢ ᏙᏓᎦᎪᏔᏂ, ᎠᏫᏃ ᏗᏂᎭᏄᎸᎯ ᎠᎦᏍᎦᏂ ᎢᏗᏢ;
\ft And he shall set the sheep on his right hand, but the goats on the left.

\ln Hnaquono Ugvwiyuhi hia nidodagaweseli agatisi iditlv anidonai; Etsena, Edoda Itsilvquotanvhi, itsatseli winigalisda utseligohi etsalisgolvdanelvhi elohi tsudotlvnv nvdagvwadalenvdv.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏙᏓᎦᏪᏎᎵ ᎠᎦᏘᏏ ᎢᏗᏢ ᎠᏂᏙᎾᎢ; ᎡᏤᎾ, ᎡᏙᏓ ᎢᏥᎸᏉᏔᏅᎯ, ᎢᏣᏤᎵ ᏫᏂᎦᎵᏍᏓ ᎤᏤᎵᎪᎯ ᎡᏣᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏧᏙᏢᏅ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏓᎴᏅᏛ.
\ft Then shall the King say unto them on his right hand, Come, ye blessed of my Father, inherit the kingdom prepared for you from the foundation of the world:

\ln Agonuyeno agiyosisgvgi, vsgiyelastanvno; agitadegisgvgi, vsgiunvno; nvgigatahvna gesvgi, vsgiyvtanvgi;
\syll ᎠᎪᏄᏰᏃ ᎠᎩᏲᏏᏍᎬᎩ, ᎥᏍᎩᏰᎳᏍᏔᏅᏃ; ᎠᎩᏔᏕᎩᏍᎬᎩ, ᎥᏍᎩᎤᏅᏃ; ᏅᎩᎦᏔᎲᎾ ᎨᏒᎩ, ᎥᏍᎩᏴᏔᏅᎩ;
\ft For I was an hungred, and ye gave me meat: I was thirsty, and ye gave me drink: I was a stranger, and ye took me in:

\ln Agiyelvha gesvgi, dosginuwovgino; agitlvgvgi, vsgiyagatanilvgino; didasdudiyi vgisduhvgi, vsgiwadvhilvgino.
\syll ᎠᎩᏰᎸᎭ ᎨᏒᎩ, ᏙᏍᎩᏄᏬᎥᎩᏃ; ᎠᎩᏢᎬᎩ, ᎥᏍᎩᏯᎦᏔᏂᎸᎩᏃ; ᏗᏓᏍᏚᏗᏱ ᎥᎩᏍᏚᎲᎩ, ᎥᏍᎩᏩᏛᎯᎸᎩᏃ.
\ft Naked, and ye clothed me: I was sick, and ye visited me: I was in prison, and ye came unto me.

\ln Hnaquono unadanvti dvninetsi hia nvdagvwaweseli; Tsagvwiyuhi, ilagiyu itsvgosv tsayosisgei, itsvyelastaneno; ale tsatadegisgei, itsvuneno;
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ ᏛᏂᏁᏥ ᎯᎠ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏪᏎᎵ; ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎢᎳᎩᏳ ᎢᏨᎪᏒ ᏣᏲᏏᏍᎨᎢ, ᎢᏨᏰᎳᏍᏔᏁᏃ; ᎠᎴ ᏣᏔᏕᎩᏍᎨᎢ, ᎢᏨᎤᏁᏃ;
\ft Then shall the righteous answer him, saying, Lord, when saw we thee an hungred, and fed thee? or thirsty, and gave thee drink?

\ln Ilagiyu itsvgoe netsagatahvna, itsvyvtaneno; ale tsayelvha gesei, itsvnuwoeno;
\syll ᎢᎳᎩᏳ ᎢᏨᎪᎡ ᏁᏣᎦᏔᎲᎾ, ᎢᏨᏴᏔᏁᏃ; ᎠᎴ ᏣᏰᎸᎭ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎢᏨᏄᏬᎡᏃ;
\ft When saw we thee a stranger, and took thee in? or naked, and clothed thee?

\ln Ale ilagiyu itsvgoe tsatlvgei, ale didasdudiyi etsasduhei, itsvyagatanileno?
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎢᎳᎩᏳ ᎢᏨᎪᎡ ᏣᏢᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏓᏍᏚᏗᏱ ᎡᏣᏍᏚᎮᎢ, ᎢᏨᏯᎦᏔᏂᎴᏃ?
\ft Or when saw we thee sick, or in prison, and came unto thee?

\ln Ugvwiyuhino dakanetsi hia nidodagaweseli; Udohiyuhiya hia nitsvweseha, Nasgiyeno tsinetsadvnelv usdikani hia nasgi otsalinvtli, ayv nisgiyadvnelvgi.
\syll ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᏃ ᏓᎧᏁᏥ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏙᏓᎦᏪᏎᎵ; ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᏥᏁᏣᏛᏁᎸ ᎤᏍᏗᎧᏂ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏣᎵᏅᏟ, ᎠᏴ ᏂᏍᎩᏯᏛᏁᎸᎩ.
\ft And the King shall answer and say unto them, Verily I say unto you, Inasmuch as ye have done it unto one of the least of these my brethren, ye have done it unto me.

\ln Hiano nasquo nidodagaweseli agasgani iditlv anidonai; Sgiyadanvsi, etsisgatsvhi, winasdvna atsilvyi digesv witsilohi, nasgi asgina ale tsutseli dinikahnawadidohi gegotlvnanelvhi.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏂᏙᏓᎦᏪᏎᎵ ᎠᎦᏍᎦᏂ ᎢᏗᏢ ᎠᏂᏙᎾᎢ; ᏍᎩᏯᏓᏅᏏ, ᎡᏥᏍᎦᏨᎯ, ᏫᎾᏍᏛᎾ ᎠᏥᎸᏱ ᏗᎨᏒ ᏫᏥᎶᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᎩᎾ ᎠᎴ ᏧᏤᎵ ᏗᏂᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎨᎪᏢᎾᏁᎸᎯ.
\ft Then shall he say also unto them on the left hand, Depart from me, ye cursed, into everlasting fire, prepared for the devil and his angels:

\ln Agonuyeno agiyosisgvgi, vtlano yisgiyelastanei; agitadegisgvgi, vtlano yisgiunei;
\syll ᎠᎪᏄᏰᏃ ᎠᎩᏲᏏᏍᎬᎩ, ᎥᏝᏃ ᏱᏍᎩᏰᎳᏍᏔᏁᎢ; ᎠᎩᏔᏕᎩᏍᎬᎩ, ᎥᏝᏃ ᏱᏍᎩᎤᏁᎢ;
\ft For I was an hungred, and ye gave me no meat: I was thirsty, and ye gave me no drink:

\ln Nvgigatahvna gesvgi, vtlano yisgiyvtanei; agiyelvha gesvgi, vtlano yidisginuwoei; agitlvgvgi, ale didasdudiyi vgisduhvgi, vtlano yisgiwadvhilei.
\syll ᏅᎩᎦᏔᎲᎾ ᎨᏒᎩ, ᎥᏝᏃ ᏱᏍᎩᏴᏔᏁᎢ; ᎠᎩᏰᎸᎭ ᎨᏒᎩ, ᎥᏝᏃ ᏱᏗᏍᎩᏄᏬᎡᎢ; ᎠᎩᏢᎬᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏓᏍᏚᏗᏱ ᎥᎩᏍᏚᎲᎩ, ᎥᏝᏃ ᏱᏍᎩᏩᏛᎯᎴᎢ.
\ft I was a stranger, and ye took me not in: naked, and ye clothed me not: sick, and in prison, and ye visited me not.

\ln Nasquono nasgi dvninetsi, hia nvdagvwaweseli, Tsagvwiyuhi, ilagiyu itsvgoe tsayosisgei, ale tsatadegisgei, ale netsagatahvna gesei, ale tsayelvha gesei, ale tsatlvgei, ale didasdudiyi etsasduhei, nitsvsdelvhvnano gesei?
\syll ᎾᏍᏉᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏛᏂᏁᏥ, ᎯᎠ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏪᏎᎵ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎢᎳᎩᏳ ᎢᏨᎪᎡ ᏣᏲᏏᏍᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏣᏔᏕᎩᏍᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏁᏣᎦᏔᎲᎾ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏣᏰᎸᎭ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏣᏢᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏓᏍᏚᏗᏱ ᎡᏣᏍᏚᎮᎢ, ᏂᏨᏍᏕᎸᎲᎾᏃ ᎨᏎᎢ?
\ft Then shall they also answer him, saying, Lord, when saw we thee an hungred, or athirst, or a stranger, or naked, or sick, or in prison, and did not minister unto thee?

\ln Hnaquono dakanetsi hia nidodagaweseli; udohiyuhiya hia nitsvweseha, nasgiyeno netsadvnelvna gesv usdikani hia nasgi, ayv vtla yinisgiyadvnelei.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏓᎧᏁᏥ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏙᏓᎦᏪᏎᎵ; ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᏁᏣᏛᏁᎸᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏍᏗᎧᏂ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ, ᎠᏴ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏂᏍᎩᏯᏛᏁᎴᎢ.
\ft Then shall he answer them, saying, Verily I say unto you, Inasmuch as ye did it not to one of the least of these, ye did it not to me.

\ln Hiano nasgi winasdvna agiliyoisdiyi digesv wvdvnilosi; unadanvtisgini winasdvna gvnidv digesvi.
