\ln Aseno diqualenvhi gesesdi igvyi nvdatsvyenveli Gelili.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᏗᏆᎴᏅᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎢᎬᏱ ᏅᏓᏨᏰᏅᎡᎵ ᎨᎵᎵ.
\ft But after I am risen again, I will go before you into Galilee.

\ln Quida unetsv hia nuweselvgi; Nasquo nigadv yidunodelv nihi yinvdigalisdodiha, ase ayv vtla yidogvquodega.
\syll ᏈᏓ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎾᏍᏉ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏱᏚᏃᏕᎸ ᏂᎯ ᏱᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ, ᎠᏎ ᎠᏴ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏙᎬᏉᏕᎦ.
\ft Peter answered and said unto him, Though all men shall be offended because of thee, yet will I never be offended.

\ln Tsisano hia nuweselvgi; Udohiyuhiya hia nigvweseha; Gohiquo svnoyi tsigi asi tsataga naniyvgvna gesesdi tsoi nvdasquadayili.
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏪᏎᎭ; ᎪᎯᏉ ᏒᏃᏱ ᏥᎩ ᎠᏏ ᏣᏔᎦ ᎾᏂᏴᎬᎾ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏦᎢ ᏅᏓᏍᏆᏓᏱᎵ.
\ft Jesus said unto him, Verily I say unto thee, That this night, before the cock crow, thou shalt deny me thrice.

\ln Quidano hia nuweselvgi; nasquo itsulaha diyiniyohuhisdi yigi, ase vtla yvgagvyadayiga.  Nasgiya nasquo nigadv gvwasdawadidohi nasgi nuniwesvgi.
\syll ᏈᏓᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎾᏍᏉ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᏗᏱᏂᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᏎ ᎥᏝ ᏴᎦᎬᏯᏓᏱᎦ.  ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ.
\ft Peter said unto him, Though I should die with thee, yet will I not deny thee. Likewise also said all the disciples.

\ln Hnaquono Tsisa ale gvwasdawadidohi unilutsvgi Gesimini dudovi, hiano niduweselv gvwasdawadidohi; Ani itsinesdi gvni itlv wigadadolistanvha.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎤᏂᎷᏨᎩ ᎨᏏᎻᏂ ᏚᏙᎥᎢ, ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ; ᎠᏂ ᎢᏥᏁᏍᏗ ᎬᏂ ᎢᏢ ᏫᎦᏓᏙᎵᏍᏔᏅᎭ.
\ft Then cometh Jesus with them unto a place called Gethsemane, and saith unto the disciples, Sit ye here, while I go and pray yonder.

\ln Dutinvsvgino Quida ale anitali Tsequidi tsuwetsi, ale ulenvhe ehisdi udanvdadei, ale utsati gagediyu nulisdanele udanvdvi.
\syll ᏚᏘᏅᏒᎩᏃ ᏈᏓ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᏤᏈᏗ ᏧᏪᏥ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎴᏅᎮ ᎡᎯᏍᏗ ᎤᏓᏅᏓᏕᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎦᎨᏗᏳ ᏄᎵᏍᏓᏁᎴ ᎤᏓᏅᏛᎢ.
\ft And he took with him Peter and the two sons of Zebedee, and began to be sorrowful and very heavy.

\ln Hnaquono hia niduweselei; Aquadanvdv ukalitsvhi utsati ehisdi gesvi ayohuhisdi gesv igai.  Ani itsinesdi ale itsulaha idiyawisgesdi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏛ ᎤᎧᎵᏨᎯ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎡᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᎦᎢ.  ᎠᏂ ᎢᏥᏁᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎢᏗᏯᏫᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
\ft Then saith he unto them, My soul is exceeding sorrowful, even unto death: tarry ye here, and watch with me.

\ln Usdigidvno udiditlvsdodi iyvdv wulutsei, ale uliyasdunei, ale udadolistanei, hia nuwesei; Edoda, iyuno yeli igvwalisdodi gesesdi wagilohisiquo hia ulisquidi; vtlasgininonv ayv nusdv gadanvtesgvi, nihisgini.
\syll ᎤᏍᏗᎩᏛᏃ ᎤᏗᏗᏢᏍᏙᏗ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏭᎷᏤᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏯᏍᏚᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎡᏙᏓ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᏰᎵ ᎢᎬᏩᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏩᎩᎶᎯᏏᏉ ᎯᎠ ᎤᎵᏍᏈᏗ; ᎥᏝᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎠᏴ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎦᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬᎢ, ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ.
\ft And he went a little further, and fell on his face, and prayed, saying, O my Father, if it be possible, let this cup pass from me: nevertheless not as I will, but as thou wilt.

\ln Gvwasdawadidohino aninv diulutsv duwadvhe anilinei, hiano nuwesele Quida; Gadoquo, tlasgo tsiyawisgv saquo iyutlilodv igohidv getsiyawisdi yigi?
\syll ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯᏃ ᎠᏂᏅ ᏗᎤᎷᏨ ᏚᏩᏛᎮ ᎠᏂᎵᏁᎢ, ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏎᎴ ᏈᏓ; ᎦᏙᏉ, ᏝᏍᎪ ᏥᏯᏫᏍᎬ ᏌᏉ ᎢᏳᏟᎶᏛ ᎢᎪᎯᏛ ᎨᏥᏯᏫᏍᏗ ᏱᎩ?
\ft And he cometh unto the disciples, and findeth them asleep, and saith unto Peter, What, could ye not watch with me one hour?

\ln Itsiyawisgesdi ale itsadadolisdisgesdi nasgi udagoliyediyi gesv witsinanugoisdiyi nigesvna gesvi.  Adanvdo udohiyuhi udvnvisdi, uquedalvsgini wanagalahiyu.
\syll ᎢᏥᏯᏫᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏣᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏓᎪᎵᏰᏗᏱ ᎨᏒ ᏫᏥᎾᏄᎪᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.  ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎤᏛᏅᎢᏍᏗ, ᎤᏇᏓᎸᏍᎩᏂ ᏩᎾᎦᎳᎯᏳ.
\ft Watch and pray, that ye enter not into temptation: the spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.

\ln Talineno uwenvsei, wudadolistanei, hia winuwesei; Edoda, iyuno hia ulisquidi gvgilohisediquo nigesvna yigi, gvni yaquaditahv, nusdv hadanvtesgv winigalisda.
\syll ᏔᎵᏁᏃ ᎤᏪᏅᏎᎢ, ᏭᏓᏙᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏫᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎡᏙᏓ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎤᎵᏍᏈᏗ ᎬᎩᎶᎯᏎᏗᏉ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏱᎩ, ᎬᏂ ᏯᏆᏗᏔᎲ, ᏄᏍᏛ ᎭᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ ᏫᏂᎦᎵᏍᏓ.
\ft He went away again the second time, and prayed, saying, O my Father, if this cup may not pass away from me, except I drink it, thy will be done.

\ln Diulutsvno duwadvhe taline anilinaei, dinigadoliyeno digagediyu gesei.
\syll ᏗᎤᎷᏨᏃ ᏚᏩᏛᎮ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎠᏂᎵᎾᎡᎢ, ᏗᏂᎦᏙᎵᏰᏃ ᏗᎦᎨᏗᏳ ᎨᏎᎢ.
\ft And he came and found them asleep again: for their eyes were heavy.

\ln Talineno duwvdetse ale udanvsei, ale tsoine wudadolistanei, nasgiya winuwesei.
\syll ᏔᎵᏁᏃ ᏚᏮᏕᏤ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᏅᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏦᎢᏁ ᏭᏓᏙᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏫᏄᏪᏎᎢ.
\ft And he left them, and went away again, and prayed the third time, saying the same words.

\ln Hnaquono diulutsv gvwasdawadidohi aninvi, hia niduweselei; Hnaquo itsilinvgi ale itsiyawesolvga; gvniyuquo iyu gesv usqualvhidi, yvwino Uwetsi agatlutanv uninegutsidv yvwi degetsiyohiselv.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏗᎤᎷᏨ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎠᏂᏅᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎿᏉ ᎢᏥᎵᏅᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏥᏯᏪᏐᎸᎦ; ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎢᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏍᏆᎸᎯᏗ, ᏴᏫᏃ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎠᎦᏡᏔᏅ ᎤᏂᏁᎫᏥᏛ ᏴᏫ ᏕᎨᏥᏲᎯᏎᎸ.
\ft Then cometh he to his disciples, and saith unto them, Sleep on now, and take your rest: behold, the hour is at hand, and the Son of man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.

\ln Ditsalehvga!  idaisesdi!  gvniyuquo aquo dayai aquatludisgi.
\syll ᏗᏣᎴᎲᎦ  ᎢᏓᎢᏎᏍᏗ  ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎠᏉ ᏓᏯᎢ ᎠᏆᏡᏗᏍᎩ.
\ft Rise, let us be going: behold, he is at hand that doth betray me.

\ln Asiquono gawonisgvi gvniyuquo Tsudasi asiyvwi taladu iyanidv gesv ulutsvgi, ale datinehvgi unitsati yvwi, ayelasdidiganvhidv ale ada dininehi, nvdagvninvsidv nunigvwiyusv atsilvanelohi dinilawigi anehv yvwi.
\syll ᎠᏏᏉᏃ ᎦᏬᏂᏍᎬᎢ ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᏧᏓᏏ ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᏔᎳᏚ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎷᏨᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᏘᏁᎲᎩ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏴᏫ, ᎠᏰᎳᏍᏗᏗᎦᏅᎯᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏓ ᏗᏂᏁᎯ, ᏅᏓᎬᏂᏅᏏᏛ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᏗᏂᎳᏫᎩ ᎠᏁᎲ ᏴᏫ.
\ft And while he yet spake, lo, Judas, one of the twelve, came, and with him a great multitude with swords and staves, from the chief priests and elders of the people.

\ln Utludisgino tsunonelvhi gese unadolehohisdodi hia iyuwesvhi gesei; gilo tsiyadutsalanvha nasgi gesesdi, asdaya detsiniyvhvha.
\syll ᎤᏡᏗᏍᎩᏃ ᏧᏃᏁᎸᎯ ᎨᏎ ᎤᎾᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏙᏗ ᎯᎠ ᎢᏳᏪᏒᎯ ᎨᏎᎢ; ᎩᎶ ᏥᏯᏚᏣᎳᏅᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎠᏍᏓᏯ ᏕᏥᏂᏴᎲᎭ.
\ft Now he that betrayed him gave them a sign, saying, Whomsoever I shall kiss, that same is he: hold him fast.

\ln Ulisdiyuno Tsisa gadogv ulutsvgi, hia nuwesvgi; Dohiyi denadagowadv, Sginatlai; ale udutsalanvgi.
\syll ᎤᎵᏍᏗᏳᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎦᏙᎬ ᎤᎷᏨᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᏙᎯᏱ ᏕᎾᏓᎪᏩᏛ, ᏍᎩᎾᏝᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᏚᏣᎳᏅᎩ.
\ft And forthwith he came to Jesus, and said, Hail, master; and kissed him.

\ln Tsisano hia nuweselvgi; Ginalii, gadono vhilugi.  Hnaquono unilutsvgi ale degvwasitadvgi Tsisa, gvwaniyvhvgi.
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎩᎾᎵᎢ, ᎦᏙᏃ ᎥᎯᎷᎩ.  ᎿᏉᏃ ᎤᏂᎷᏨᎩ ᎠᎴ ᏕᎬᏩᏏᏔᏛᎩ ᏥᏌ, ᎬᏩᏂᏴᎲᎩ.
\ft And Jesus said unto him, Friend, wherefore art thou come? Then came they, and laid hands on Jesus, and took him.

\ln Ale gvniyuquo asiyvwi Tsisa anehi usaladanvgi kanogeni ulvhvgi ayelasdiganvhidv, ale uluyv ugvwiyuhi atsilvgelohi unvsidasdi, ale ulisdestanvgi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᏥᏌ ᎠᏁᎯ ᎤᏌᎳᏓᏅᎩ ᎧᏃᎨᏂ ᎤᎸᎲᎩ ᎠᏰᎳᏍᏗᎦᏅᎯᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎷᏴ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᏥᎸᎨᎶᎯ ᎤᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏍᏕᏍᏔᏅᎩ.
\ft And, behold, one of them which were with Jesus stretched out his hand, and drew his sword, and struck a servant of the high priest's, and smote off his ear.

\ln Hnaquono Tsisa hia nuweselvgi; Galadisdiyi tsihilada tsatseli ayelasdiganvhidv, nigadvyeno ayelasdiganvhidv aniyisgi ayelasdiganvhidv tsuniyohuhisdodi gesesdi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎦᎳᏗᏍᏗᏱ ᏥᎯᎳᏓ ᏣᏤᎵ ᎠᏰᎳᏍᏗᎦᏅᎯᏛ, ᏂᎦᏛᏰᏃ ᎠᏰᎳᏍᏗᎦᏅᎯᏛ ᎠᏂᏱᏍᎩ ᎠᏰᎳᏍᏗᎦᏅᎯᏛ ᏧᏂᏲᎱᎯᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft Then said Jesus unto him, Put up again thy sword into his place: for all they that take the sword shall perish with the sword.

\ln Tlasgo yadanvteha yeli gatsiyadadolisdanedi gesv Edoda, gilaquono iyvdv vtla taladuquo iyunadatlugi dinikahnawadidohi yidogvgikasi?
\syll ᏝᏍᎪ ᏯᏓᏅᏖᎭ ᏰᎵ ᎦᏥᏯᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎡᏙᏓ, ᎩᎳᏉᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎥᏝ ᏔᎳᏚᏉ ᎢᏳᎾᏓᏡᎩ ᏗᏂᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏱᏙᎬᎩᎧᏏ?
\ft Thinkest thou that I cannot now pray to my Father, and he shall presently give me more than twelve legions of angels?

\ln Aseno gado yigalisdoda yadohiyuhvga nusdv gowelvi, ase nasgi iyulisdodi tsigi?
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎦᏙ ᏱᎦᎵᏍᏙᏓ ᏯᏙᎯᏳᎲᎦ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎪᏪᎸᎢ, ᎠᏎ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᏥᎩ?
\ft But how then shall the scriptures be fulfilled, that thus it must be?

\ln Nahiyuno Tsisa hia niduweselvgi unitsati; Tsigo ganosgisgi tsitsiyoho nasgiya itsilugi sginiyvhiga, ayelasdidiganvhidv ale ada ditsinehi?  Nidugitsvnisv itsulaha idinvgi degadeyohvsgvgi udvnadigalawiisdiyi, vtlano yisginiyisgei.
\syll ᏀᎢᏳᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ; ᏥᎪ ᎦᏃᏍᎩᏍᎩ ᏥᏥᏲᎰ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎢᏥᎷᎩ ᏍᎩᏂᏴᎯᎦ, ᎠᏰᎳᏍᏗᏗᎦᏅᎯᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏓ ᏗᏥᏁᎯ?  ᏂᏚᎩᏨᏂᏒ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎢᏗᏅᎩ ᏕᎦᏕᏲᎲᏍᎬᎩ ᎤᏛᎾᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᎥᏝᏃ ᏱᏍᎩᏂᏱᏍᎨᎢ.
\ft In that same hour said Jesus to the multitudes, Are ye come out as against a thief with swords and staves for to take me? I sat daily with you teaching in the temple, and ye laid no hold on me.

\ln Aseno nigadv nasgi hia nulistanvgi udohiyudiyi anadolehosgi unowelanvhi.  Hnaquono nigadv gvwasdawadidohi gvwadetsvgi ale unalisvgi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎩ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᏗᏱ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎤᏃᏪᎳᏅᎯ.  ᎿᏉᏃ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎬᏩᏕᏨᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᎵᏒᎩ.
\ft But all this was done, that the scriptures of the prophets might be fulfilled. Then all the disciples forsook him, and fled.

\ln Tsisano uniniyvdv kayaquoi wunatinvstanvgi nasgi nugvwiyusv atsilvgelohi, nahna dinowelisgi ale dinilawigi danilawivi.
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᏂᏂᏴᏛ ᎧᏯᏉᎢ ᏭᎾᏘᏅᏍᏔᏅᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸᎨᎶᎯ, ᏀᎾ ᏗᏃᏪᎵᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏂᎳᏫᎩ ᏓᏂᎳᏫᎥᎢ.
\ft And they that had laid hold on Jesus led him away to Caiaphas the high priest, where the scribes and the elders were assembled.

\ln Quidano usdawadvse ge iyvdv tsaise nugvwiyusv atsilvgelohi diganelv gvdisgi, uyvlei, ale getsinvsidasdi itsulaha aninei, ugowadvdiyi uyelvse walisquadihihvi.
\syll ᏈᏓᏃ ᎤᏍᏓᏩᏛᏎ Ꭸ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏣᎢᏎ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸᎨᎶᎯ ᏗᎦᏁᎸ ᎬᏗᏍᎩ, ᎤᏴᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎠᏂᏁᎢ, ᎤᎪᏩᏛᏗᏱ ᎤᏰᎸᏎ ᏩᎵᏍᏆᏗᎯᎲᎢ.
\ft But Peter followed him afar off unto the high priest's palace, and went in, and sat with the servants, to see the end.

\ln Nunigvwiyusvno atsilvanelohi ale tsunadvsonvhi ale nigadv dinilawigi uniyole gayegogi uninohelvhi Tsisa utludisgi, nasgi unihisdiyi unadulisgei;
\syll ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒᏃ ᎠᏥᎸᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏧᎾᏛᏐᏅᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏗᏂᎳᏫᎩ ᎤᏂᏲᎴ ᎦᏰᎪᎩ ᎤᏂᏃᎮᎸᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎤᏡᏗᏍᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᎾᏚᎵᏍᎨᎢ;
\ft Now the chief priests, and elders, and all the council, sought false witness against Jesus, to put him to death;

\ln Aseno unatlotsequo; unitsatesgininonv gayegogi aninohesgi uninanugotsei, aseno unatlotsequo.  Oniyisgininonv anitali gayegogi aninohesgi unilutsei, hia nuniwesei;
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᎾᏠᏤᏉ; ᎤᏂᏣᏖᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎦᏰᎪᎩ ᎠᏂᏃᎮᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᎾᏄᎪᏤᎢ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᎾᏠᏤᏉ.  ᎣᏂᏱᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᎦᏰᎪᎩ ᎠᏂᏃᎮᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᎷᏤᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ;
\ft But found none: yea, though many false witnesses came, yet found they none. At the last came two false witnesses,

\ln Hia niduwesvgi; Yeliquo yitsiyosda Unelanvhi utseli udvnadigalawiisdiyi, tsoiquono tsudodaquadv [taline] yvganesgvli.
\syll ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏒᎩ; ᏰᎵᏉ ᏱᏥᏲᏍᏓ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎤᏛᎾᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᏦᎢᏉᏃ ᏧᏙᏓᏆᏛ ᏔᎵᏁdata is invalid ᏴᎦᏁᏍᎬᎵ.
\ft And said, This fellow said, I am able to destroy the temple of God, and to build it in three days.

\ln Nugvwiyusvno atsilvgelohi dulenei, hia nuweselei; Tlasgo yinega?  Gado hia anigatahv tsaninoheha tsigetsatludiha?
\syll ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒᏃ ᎠᏥᎸᎨᎶᎯ ᏚᎴᏁᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᏝᏍᎪ ᏱᏁᎦ?  ᎦᏙ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎲ ᏣᏂᏃᎮᎭ ᏥᎨᏣᏡᏗᎭ?
\ft And the high priest arose, and said unto him, Answerest thou nothing? what is it which these witness against thee?

\ln Aseno Tsisa elaweyiquo gesei.  Nugvwiyusvno atsilvgelohi iunetsv hia nuweselei; Gvlayosi Unelanvhi gvnidv hineisdodiyi, sginohvsi, tsigo nihi Galonedv Unelanvhi Uwetsi?
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎡᎳᏪᏱᏉ ᎨᏎᎢ.  ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒᏃ ᎠᏥᎸᎨᎶᎯ ᎢᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎬᎳᏲᏏ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎯᏁᎢᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᏍᎩᏃᎲᏏ, ᏥᎪ ᏂᎯ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏪᏥ?
\ft But Jesus held his peace. And the high priest answered and said unto him, I adjure thee by the living God, that thou tell us whether thou be the Christ, the Son of God.

\ln Tsisano hia nuweselei; Yeli niwi.  Aseno hia nitsvweseha; ilvhiyu dayetsigoi yvwi Uwetsi agatisi iditlv ulinigvgv uwolesdi, ale tsaisesdi ulogilv galvloi.
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᏰᎵ ᏂᏫ.  ᎠᏎᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ; ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᏓᏰᏥᎪᎢ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎠᎦᏘᏏ ᎢᏗᏢ ᎤᎵᏂᎬᎬ ᎤᏬᎴᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏣᎢᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᎶᎩᎸ ᎦᎸᎶᎢ.
\ft Jesus saith unto him, Thou hast said: nevertheless I say unto you, Hereafter shall ye see the Son of man sitting on the right hand of power, and coming in the clouds of heaven.

\ln Hnaquono nugvwiyusv atsilvgelohi dunuwav duwetsagalvhei; Asotlvisda, udvnei; gadono asi anigatahi yaninoheha?  Gvniyuquo hnaquo itsadvgvga asotlvisdisgvi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸᎨᎶᎯ ᏚᏄᏩᎥ ᏚᏪᏣᎦᎸᎮᎢ; ᎠᏐᏢᎢᏍᏓ, ᎤᏛᏁᎢ; ᎦᏙᏃ ᎠᏏ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎯ ᏯᏂᏃᎮᎭ?  ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎿᏉ ᎢᏣᏛᎬᎦ ᎠᏐᏢᎢᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ.
\ft Then the high priest rent his clothes, saying, He hath spoken blasphemy; what further need have we of witnesses? behold, now ye have heard his blasphemy.

\ln Gado itseliha?  Uninetsvno hia nuniwesei; Yeliquo gvwayohuhisdi.
\syll ᎦᏙ ᎢᏤᎵᎭ?  ᎤᏂᏁᏨᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ; ᏰᎵᏉ ᎬᏩᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ.
\ft What think ye? They answered and said, He is guilty of death.

\ln Hnaquono ukadv dunalitsisquei, ale asquinv degvwanasdisgei ale anisoi tsunoyeni degvwanasdisgei,
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎤᎧᏛ ᏚᎾᎵᏥᏍᏇᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏍᏈᏅ ᏕᎬᏩᎾᏍᏗᏍᎨᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏐᎢ ᏧᏃᏰᏂ ᏕᎬᏩᎾᏍᏗᏍᎨᎢ,
\ft Then did they spit in his face, and buffeted him; and others smote him with the palms of their hands,

\ln Hia naniwesgei; Sgiyadoleohisi, Galonedv, Gago tsitsvniga?
\syll ᎯᎠ ᎾᏂᏪᏍᎨᎢ; ᏍᎩᏯᏙᎴᎣᎯᏏ, ᎦᎶᏁᏛ, ᎦᎪ ᏥᏨᏂᎦ?
\ft Saying, Prophesy unto us, thou Christ, Who is he that smote thee?

\ln Quidano uwole udlanvdvi, ulutseleno adv hia nuwesei; Nihi nasquo sdedohvgi Tsisa Gelili ehi.
\syll ᏈᏓᏃ ᎤᏬᎴ ᎤᏜᏅᏛᎢ, ᎤᎷᏤᎴᏃ ᎠᏛ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᏂᎯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏍᏕᏙᎲᎩ ᏥᏌ ᎨᎵᎵ ᎡᎯ.
\ft Now Peter sat without in the palace: and a damsel came unto him, saying, Thou also wast with Jesus of Galilee.

\ln Aseno nigadv anigatahv udayilei, hia nuwesei; Vtla yitsigataha niwesgvi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎲ ᎤᏓᏱᎴᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎥᏝ ᏱᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᏂᏪᏍᎬᎢ.
\ft But he denied before them all, saying, I know not what thou sayest.

\ln Doyitlvno wulosv nvwadale ugohei, ale hia niduwesele nahna anedohi; Nasquo hia Tsisa Naselidi ehi danedohvgi.
\syll ᏙᏱᏢᏃ ᏭᎶᏒ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᎤᎪᎮᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴ ᏀᎾ ᎠᏁᏙᎯ; ᎾᏍᏉ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏌ ᎾᏎᎵᏗ ᎡᎯ ᏓᏁᏙᎲᎩ.
\ft And when he was gone out into the porch, another maid saw him, and said unto them that were there, This fellow was also with Jesus of Nazareth.

\ln Talineno udayilei, unelanvhi uneistanei; tla yitsigataha na asgaya, udvnei.
\syll ᏔᎵᏁᏃ ᎤᏓᏱᎴᎢ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏁᎢᏍᏔᏁᎢ; Ꮭ ᏱᏥᎦᏔᎭ Ꮎ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ, ᎤᏛᏁᎢ.
\ft And again he denied with an oath, I do not know the man.

\ln Gohiyino iyvdv gvwalutsele nav anidonai, hia nigvwawesele Quida; Udohiyuhi nasquo nihi itsedolvhi, hiwonisgvyeno gvnigesv nitsvneha.
\syll ᎪᎯᏱᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎬᏩᎷᏤᎴ ᎾᎥ ᎠᏂᏙᎾᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏩᏪᏎᎴ ᏈᏓ; ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏤᏙᎸᎯ, ᎯᏬᏂᏍᎬᏰᏃ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᏨᏁᎭ.
\ft And after a while came unto him they that stood by, and said to Peter, Surely thou also art one of them; for thy speech bewrayeth thee.

\ln Hnaquono ulenvhe usginvdei, ale unelanvhi uneistanei; Tla yitsigataha na asgaya, udvnei; gilaquono iyvdv tsataga uyvlasei.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎤᎴᏅᎮ ᎤᏍᎩᏅᏕᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏁᎢᏍᏔᏁᎢ; Ꮭ ᏱᏥᎦᏔᎭ Ꮎ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ, ᎤᏛᏁᎢ; ᎩᎳᏉᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏣᏔᎦ ᎤᏴᎳᏎᎢ.
\ft Then began he to curse and to swear, saying, I know not the man. And immediately the cock crew.

\ln Quidano unvdade Tsisa unetsvhi, hia tsinuweselei; Asi tsataga naniyvgvna gesesdi tsoi nvdasquadayili.  Unugotsvno ehisdi widutloyilei.
\syll ᏈᏓᏃ ᎤᏅᏓᏕ ᏥᏌ ᎤᏁᏨᎯ, ᎯᎠ ᏥᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎠᏏ ᏣᏔᎦ ᎾᏂᏴᎬᎾ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏦᎢ ᏅᏓᏍᏆᏓᏱᎵ.  ᎤᏄᎪᏨᏃ ᎡᎯᏍᏗ ᏫᏚᏠᏱᎴᎢ.
\ft And Peter remembered the word of Jesus, which said unto him, Before the cock crow, thou shalt deny me thrice. And he went out, and wept bitterly.

\ln Sunaleno nulistanv, nigadv nunigvwiyusv atsilvanelohi ale dinilawigi anehv awi uninohele iyunadvnediyi Tsisa unihisdiyi.
\syll ᏑᎾᎴᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ, ᏂᎦᏛ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏂᎳᏫᎩ ᎠᏁᎲ ᎠᏫ ᎤᏂᏃᎮᎴ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᏁᏗᏱ ᏥᏌ ᎤᏂᎯᏍᏗᏱ.
\ft When the morning was come, all the chief priests and elders of the people took counsel against Jesus to put him to death:

\ln Hnaquono unalvlv unelisanawidvhei, Quanidv Qualedi ugvwiyuhi widuniyohiselei.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎤᎾᎸᎸ ᎤᏁᎵᏌᎾᏫᏛᎮᎢ, ᏆᏂᏛ ᏆᎴᏗ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏫᏚᏂᏲᎯᏎᎴᎢ.
\ft And when they had bound him, they led him away, and delivered him to Pontius Pilate the governor.

\ln Hnaquono Tsudasi nasgi ulonuhelvhi udolehosv dagugodanelvi unetliyvse udanvdvi, ale nunigvwiyusv atsilvanelohi ale tsunadvsonvhi douyohele tsoasgohi ayeliadelv tsunagvwalodi,
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏧᏓᏏ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎶᏄᎮᎸᎯ ᎤᏙᎴᎰᏒ ᏓᎫᎪᏓᏁᎸᎢ ᎤᏁᏟᏴᏎ ᎤᏓᏅᏛᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏧᎾᏛᏐᏅᎯ ᏙᎤᏲᎮᎴ ᏦᎠᏍᎪᎯ ᎠᏰᎵᎠᏕᎸ ᏧᎾᎬᏩᎶᏗ,
\ft Then Judas, which had betrayed him, when he saw that he was condemned, repented himself, and brought again the thirty pieces of silver to the chief priests and elders,

\ln Hia nuwesei; tsisganvgi nusganvtsvna gigv tsigatluda.  Hiano nuniwesei; Gado nasgi ayv ogvdodi?  Tsvsv nasgi ditsalvwisdasi.
\syll ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᏥᏍᎦᏅᎩ ᏄᏍᎦᏅᏨᎾ ᎩᎬ ᏥᎦᏡᏓ.  ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ; ᎦᏙ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᎣᎬᏙᏗ?  ᏨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏣᎸᏫᏍᏓᏏ.
\ft Saying, I have sinned in that I have betrayed the innocent blood. And they said, What is that to us? see thou to that.

\ln Ale dudinv adelv nahna digalawiisdiyi, ale unugotsei, ale iyvdv wulosv, uwasv wudadvnei.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏚᏗᏅ ᎠᏕᎸ ᏀᎾ ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏄᎪᏤᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏭᎶᏒ, ᎤᏩᏒ ᏭᏓᏛᏁᎢ.
\ft And he cast down the pieces of silver in the temple, and departed, and went and hanged himself.

\ln Nunigvwiyusvno atsilvanelohi dunigisv adelv hia nuniwesei; vtla duyugodv yigagi adelvdidiyi yididihvsga, gigvyeno tsugvwalanvhi.
\syll ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒᏃ ᎠᏥᎸᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᏚᏂᎩᏒ ᎠᏕᎸ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ; ᎥᏝ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᏱᎦᎩ ᎠᏕᎸᏗᏗᏱ ᏱᏗᏗᎲᏍᎦ, ᎩᎬᏰᏃ ᏧᎬᏩᎳᏅᎯ.
\ft And the chief priests took the silver pieces, and said, It is not lawful for to put them into the treasury, because it is the price of blood.

\ln Uninohelvno, uniwahistane vti digotlvsgi ulogesvi nahna anedohi digetsinisodiyi.
\syll ᎤᏂᏃᎮᎸᏃ, ᎤᏂᏩᎯᏍᏔᏁ ᎥᏘ ᏗᎪᏢᏍᎩ ᎤᎶᎨᏒᎢ ᏀᎾ ᎠᏁᏙᎯ ᏗᎨᏥᏂᏐᏗᏱ.
\ft And they took counsel, and bought with them the potter's field, to bury strangers in.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi nasgi tlogesi gigv ulogesv anoseha gohi tsigi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏠᎨᏏ ᎩᎬ ᎤᎶᎨᏒ ᎠᏃᏎᎭ ᎪᎯ ᏥᎩ.
\ft Wherefore that field was called, The field of blood, unto this day.

\ln Hnaquono udohiyune tsunetse Tselimaya adolehosgi, hia tsinuwesei; Ale dunigisvgi tsoasgohi ayeliadelv nasgi na tsugvwatanvhi, nasgi tsatsigvwalotanvhi, Isili tsuwetsi tsunigvwalotanvhi,
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᏁ ᏧᏁᏤ ᏤᎵᎹᏯ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏥᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᏚᏂᎩᏒᎩ ᏦᎠᏍᎪᎯ ᎠᏰᎵᎠᏕᎸ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏧᎬᏩᏔᏅᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏣᏥᎬᏩᎶᏔᏅᎯ, ᎢᏏᎵ ᏧᏪᏥ ᏧᏂᎬᏩᎶᏔᏅᎯ,
\ft Then was fulfilled that which was spoken by Jeremy the prophet, saying, And they took the thirty pieces of silver, the price of him that was valued, whom they of the children of Israel did value;

\ln Ale uniwahistanvgi vti digotlvsgi ulogesvi, nasgiya Yihowa aqueyonvi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏩᎯᏍᏔᏅᎩ ᎥᏘ ᏗᎪᏢᏍᎩ ᎤᎶᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏱᎰᏩ ᎠᏇᏲᏅᎢ.
\ft And gave them for the potter's field, as the Lord appointed me.

\ln Tsisano gadoge igvyiditlv ugvwiyuhi uwolvi.  Ugvwiyuhino udvdvnei, hia nuwesei; nihisgo Tsagvwiyuhi Anitsusi unatseliga?  Tsisano hia nuweselei; Yeliniwi.
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᎦᏙᎨ ᎢᎬᏱᏗᏢ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏬᎸᎢ.  ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᏃ ᎤᏛᏛᏁᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᏂᎯᏍᎪ ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ?  ᏥᏌᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᏰᎵᏂᏫ.
\ft And Jesus stood before the governor: and the governor asked him, saying, Art thou the King of the Jews? And Jesus said unto him, Thou sayest.

\ln Nunigvwiyusvno atsilvanelohi ale dinilawigi gvwayilidolv vtla yunetsei.
\syll ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒᏃ ᎠᏥᎸᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏂᎳᏫᎩ ᎬᏩᏱᎵᏙᎸ ᎥᏝ ᏳᏁᏤᎢ.
\ft And when he was accused of the chief priests and elders, he answered nothing.

\ln Hnaquono Qualedi hia nuweselei; Tlasgo yadvgiha nigav gvnigesv nanvnehv anigatahi getsatludisgvi?
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏆᎴᏗ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᏝᏍᎪ ᏯᏛᎩᎭ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎾᏅᏁᎲ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎯ ᎨᏣᏡᏗᏍᎬᎢ?
\ft Then said Pilate unto him, Hearest thou not how many things they witness against thee?

\ln Aseno vtla saquounv yinunetsei, nasgi iyusdi ugvwiyuhi utsati usquanigosei.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏌᏉᎤᏅ ᏱᏄᏁᏤᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏎᎢ.
\ft And he answered him to never a word; insomuch that the governor marvelled greatly.

\ln Dilisdayvdiyino gesv iyui ugvwiyuhi tsuyohisedi geso saquo ayvgi, hiaquo anela yvwi.
\syll ᏗᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱᏃ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᎢ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏧᏲᎯᏎᏗ ᎨᏐ ᏌᏉ ᎠᏴᎩ, ᎯᎠᏉ ᎠᏁᎳ ᏴᏫ.
\ft Now at that feast the governor was wont to release unto the people a prisoner, whom they would.

\ln Nahiyuno diganotsali ayvgi unikahe Qualaqua tsudoidv.
\syll ᏀᎢᏳᏃ ᏗᎦᏃᏣᎵ ᎠᏴᎩ ᎤᏂᎧᎮ ᏆᎳᏆ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ.
\ft And they had then a notable prisoner, called Barabbas.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi hnaquo dunilawitsv Qualedi hia niduweselei; Gago itsaduli ditsvyohisediyi?  Qualaquasgo?  Tsisage Galonedv tsanosehoi?
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎿᏉ ᏚᏂᎳᏫᏨ ᏆᎴᏗ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎦᎪ ᎢᏣᏚᎵ ᏗᏨᏲᎯᏎᏗᏱ?  ᏆᎳᏆᏍᎪ?  ᏥᏌᎨ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏣᏃᏎᎰᎢ?
\ft Therefore when they were gathered together, Pilate said unto them, Whom will ye that I release unto you? Barabbas, or Jesus which is called Christ?

\ln Agataheyeno anvyugvquo nvdigalisdodisgv duniyosvi.
\syll ᎠᎦᏔᎮᏰᏃ ᎠᏅᏳᎬᏉ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬ ᏚᏂᏲᏒᎢ.
\ft For he knew that for envy they had delivered him.

\ln Uwolvno digugododiyi gasgilvi udalii tsudanvsei, hia nvtsuweselei; Tlesdi nihi gohusdi na nasganvna asgaya ugvwali yiditsalvwisdanelesdi, utsatiyeno tsigiliyogi gohi iga gasgidasgvi nasgi nvdigalisdodisgvi.
\syll ᎤᏬᎸᏃ ᏗᎫᎪᏙᏗᏱ ᎦᏍᎩᎸᎢ ᎤᏓᎵᎢ ᏧᏓᏅᏎᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏅᏧᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᏞᏍᏗ ᏂᎯ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ Ꮎ ᎾᏍᎦᏅᎾ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᏱᏗᏣᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎴᏍᏗ, ᎤᏣᏘᏰᏃ ᏥᎩᎵᏲᎩ ᎪᎯ ᎢᎦ ᎦᏍᎩᏓᏍᎬᎢ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬᎢ.
\ft When he was set down on the judgment seat, his wife sent unto him, saying, Have thou nothing to do with that just man: for I have suffered many things this day in a dream because of him.

\ln Aseno nunigvwiyusv atsilvanelohi ale dinilawigi dunisdiyetane unitsati gesv Qualaqua unitayosediyi, Tsisano unihisdiyi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏂᎳᏫᎩ ᏚᏂᏍᏗᏰᏔᏁ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎨᏒ ᏆᎳᏆ ᎤᏂᏔᏲᏎᏗᏱ, ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᏂᎯᏍᏗᏱ.
\ft But the chief priests and elders persuaded the multitude that they should ask Barabbas, and destroy Jesus.

\ln Ugvwiyuhino unetsv hia niduweselei; Gago hia anitali gesv itsaduli ditsvyohisediyi?  Qualaqua, unadvnei.
\syll ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᏃ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎦᎪ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏣᏚᎵ ᏗᏨᏲᎯᏎᏗᏱ?  ᏆᎳᏆ, ᎤᎾᏛᏁᎢ.
\ft The governor answered and said unto them, Whether of the twain will ye that I release unto you? They said, Barabbas.

\ln Qualedi hia niduweselei; Gadono datsiyvneli Tsisa, Galonedv tsanosehoi?  Wagadvvga, gvwosele nigadv.
\syll ᏆᎴᏗ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎦᏙᏃ ᏓᏥᏴᏁᎵ ᏥᏌ, ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏣᏃᏎᎰᎢ?  ᏩᎦᏛᎥᎦ, ᎬᏬᏎᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ.
\ft Pilate saith unto them, What shall I do then with Jesus which is called Christ? They all say unto him, Let him be crucified.

\ln Ugvwiyuhino hia nuwesei; Gadono, gado udvnelv usganvtsv?  Aseno utliquo nigae unelunei, wagadvvga, anadisgvi.
\syll ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎦᏙᏃ, ᎦᏙ ᎤᏛᏁᎸ ᎤᏍᎦᏅᏨ?  ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏟᏉ ᏂᎦᎡ ᎤᏁᎷᏁᎢ, ᏩᎦᏛᎥᎦ, ᎠᎾᏗᏍᎬᎢ.
\ft And the governor said, Why, what evil hath he done? But they cried out the more, saying, Let him be crucified.

\ln Qualedi udolehosv digvwasegogisdi nigesvna gesvi, ale unadasuyedv unalitalvnvgi, ama wonegisei, ale dusulehe unitsati anigatahvi, hia nuwesei; Ayv vtla agisganvtsvhi yigi hia nusganvtsvna yvwi ugigv.  Nihi itsagasayasda.
\syll ᏆᎴᏗ ᎤᏙᎴᎰᏒ ᏗᎬᏩᏎᎪᎩᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏓᏑᏰᏛ ᎤᎾᎵᏔᎸᏅᎩ, ᎠᎹ ᏬᏁᎩᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏑᎴᎮ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎲᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎠᏴ ᎥᏝ ᎠᎩᏍᎦᏅᏨᎯ ᏱᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏍᎦᏅᏨᎾ ᏴᏫ ᎤᎩᎬ.  ᏂᎯ ᎢᏣᎦᏌᏯᏍᏓ.
\ft When Pilate saw that he could prevail nothing, but that rather a tumult was made, he took water, and washed his hands before the multitude, saying, I am innocent of the blood of this just person: see ye to it.

\ln Nigadvno yvwi uninetsei, hia nuniwesei; Ugigv ayv ale tsogetsi oginvgalesdi.
\syll ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏂᏁᏤᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ; ᎤᎩᎬ ᎠᏴ ᎠᎴ ᏦᎨᏥ ᎣᎩᏅᎦᎴᏍᏗ.
\ft Then answered all the people, and said, His blood be on us, and on our children.

\ln Hnaquono Qualaqua deuyohiselei; ulivnonvno Tsisa duyose agadvdiyi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏆᎳᏆ ᏕᎤᏲᎯᏎᎴᎢ; ᎤᎵᎥᏃᏅᏃ ᏥᏌ ᏚᏲᏎ ᎠᎦᏛᏗᏱ.
\ft Then released he Barabbas unto them: and when he had scourged Jesus, he delivered him to be crucified.

\ln Hnaquono aniyawisgi ugvwiyuhi tsutseliga ugvwiyuhi ganelv uniyvtane Tsisa, ale nahna degvwaduwistane nigadv sunadatlugi aniyawisgi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎠᏂᏯᏫᏍᎩ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏧᏤᎵᎦ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎦᏁᎸ ᎤᏂᏴᏔᏁ ᏥᏌ, ᎠᎴ ᏀᎾ ᏕᎬᏩᏚᏫᏍᏔᏁ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏑᎾᏓᏡᎩ ᎠᏂᏯᏫᏍᎩ.
\ft Then the soldiers of the governor took Jesus into the common hall, and gathered unto him the whole band of soldiers.

\ln Duninuwesvno, gigage gasalena uninuwoei.
\syll ᏚᏂᏄᏪᏒᏃ, ᎩᎦᎨ ᎦᏌᎴᎾ ᎤᏂᏄᏬᎡᎢ.
\ft And they stripped him, and put on him a scarlet robe.

\ln Ale unisdeyonv alisdulo tsutsayosdi gotlvtanvhi, unisdulanei, ale ganasda agatisi iditlv unasvgaladistanei; ale danaliniquanvnehe ale anadehodisgei, hia naniwesgei; Itsvyoliga, Tsagvwiyuhi Anitsusi unatseliga.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏍᏕᏲᏅ ᎠᎵᏍᏚᎶ ᏧᏣᏲᏍᏗ ᎪᏢᏔᏅᎯ, ᎤᏂᏍᏚᎳᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᎾᏍᏓ ᎠᎦᏘᏏ ᎢᏗᏢ ᎤᎾᏒᎦᎳᏗᏍᏔᏁᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᏓᎾᎵᏂᏆᏅᏁᎮ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎾᏕᎰᏗᏍᎨᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏂᏪᏍᎨᎢ; ᎢᏨᏲᎵᎦ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ.
\ft And when they had platted a crown of thorns, they put it upon his head, and a reed in his right hand: and they bowed the knee before him, and mocked him, saying, Hail, King of the Jews!

\ln Dunalitsiqueno ale uniyvele ganasda ale unisqualvnistanei.
\syll ᏚᎾᎵᏥᏇᏃ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏴᎡᎴ ᎦᎾᏍᏓ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏍᏆᎸᏂᏍᏔᏁᎢ.
\ft And they spit upon him, and took the reed, and smote him on the head.

\ln Unadehotanonvno uninuwese gasalena, ale uwasv tsunuwe duninuwoei; ale unadvdiyi wunatinvstanei.
\syll ᎤᎾᏕᎰᏔᏃᏅᏃ ᎤᏂᏄᏪᏎ ᎦᏌᎴᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏧᏄᏪ ᏚᏂᏄᏬᎡᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏛᏗᏱ ᏭᎾᏘᏅᏍᏔᏁᎢ.
\ft And after that they had mocked him, they took the robe off from him, and put his own raiment on him, and led him away to crucify him.

\ln Uninugotsvno uniwadvhe asgaya Salini ehi Sawani tsudoidv; nasgi gvsgaisdagi nunvnele uwenvsdiyi tsudahnawadv.
\syll ᎤᏂᏄᎪᏨᏃ ᎤᏂᏩᏛᎮ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᏌᎵᏂ ᎡᎯ ᏌᏩᏂ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏍᎦᎢᏍᏓᎩ ᏄᏅᏁᎴ ᎤᏪᏅᏍᏗᏱ ᏧᏓᎿᏩᏛ.
\ft And as they came out, they found a man of Cyrene, Simon by name: him they compelled to bear his cross.

\ln Wunilutsvno Goligada dudovi, nasgi usqualugoi tsigadvga,
\syll ᏭᏂᎷᏨᏃ ᎪᎵᎦᏓ ᏚᏙᎥᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏍᏆᎷᎪᎢ ᏥᎦᏛᎦ,
\ft And when they were come unto a place called Golgotha, that is to say, a place of a skull,

\ln Tsunitsoyasdi uditasdi adaga asuyi uninenelei, unelvtanvno vtla yudulvhe uditasdiyi.
\syll ᏧᏂᏦᏯᏍᏗ ᎤᏗᏔᏍᏗ ᎠᏓᎦ ᎠᏑᏱ ᎤᏂᏁᏁᎴᎢ, ᎤᏁᎸᏔᏅᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏳᏚᎸᎮ ᎤᏗᏔᏍᏗᏱ.
\ft They gave him vinegar to drink mingled with gall: and when he had tasted thereof, he would not drink.

\ln Unadvneno ale duniyadole tsunuwo anasasdisgei; nasgino udohiyune adolehosgi tsunetsei, hia tsinuwesei; Diquanuwo duniyadolvgi, ale aquanuwo unasastanvgi.
\syll ᎤᎾᏛᏁᏃ ᎠᎴ ᏚᏂᏯᏙᎴ ᏧᏄᏬ ᎠᎾᏌᏍᏗᏍᎨᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᏁ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᏧᏁᏤᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏥᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᏗᏆᏄᏬ ᏚᏂᏯᏙᎸᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏆᏄᏬ ᎤᎾᏌᏍᏔᏅᎩ.
\ft And they crucified him, and parted his garments, casting lots: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, They parted my garments among them, and upon my vesture did they cast lots.

\ln Unanvneno ale uniyawise.
\syll ᎤᎾᏅᏁᏃ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏯᏫᏎ.
\ft And sitting down they watched him there;

\ln Uniyalvneno galvladitlv ulisdadvi iyusdi gesv uliyilidehvi, hia nigvne gowelei; HiAYo TsiSa UGvWiYuHi ANiTsuSi UNaTseLiGa.
\syll ᎤᏂᏯᎸᏁᏃ ᎦᎸᎳᏗᏢ ᎤᎵᏍᏓᏛᎢ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎵᏱᎵᏕᎲᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏁ ᎪᏪᎴᎢ; ᎯᎠᏲ ᏥᏌ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ.
\ft And set up over his head his accusation written, THIS IS JESUS THE KING OF THE JEWS.

\ln Nasquono itsulaha degegadvne anitali aninosgisgi, saquo agatisi iditlv, soino agasgani iditlv.
\syll ᎾᏍᏉᏃ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᏕᎨᎦᏛᏁ ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᎠᏂᏃᏍᎩᏍᎩ, ᏌᏉ ᎠᎦᏘᏏ ᎢᏗᏢ, ᏐᎢᏃ ᎠᎦᏍᎦᏂ ᎢᏗᏢ.
\ft Then were there two thieves crucified with him, one on the right hand, and another on the left.

\ln Navno anilosgi gagvwasotlvdei, ale danalisdvnehei,
\syll ᎾᎥᏃ ᎠᏂᎶᏍᎩ ᎦᎬᏩᏐᏢᏕᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᎾᎵᏍᏛᏁᎮᎢ,
\ft And they that passed by reviled him, wagging their heads,

\ln Hia naniwesgei; udvnadigalawiisdiyi hiyosdisgi, tsoiquono iga hiyeilidohi hanesgesgi, halisdelv tsvsv; iyuno nihi Unelanvhi Uwetsi gesesdi, dadahnawasdv ehatloahi.
\syll ᎯᎠ ᎾᏂᏪᏍᎨᎢ; ᎤᏛᎾᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎯᏲᏍᏗᏍᎩ, ᏦᎢᏉᏃ ᎢᎦ ᎯᏰᎢᎵᏙᎯ ᎭᏁᏍᎨᏍᎩ, ᎭᎵᏍᏕᎸ ᏨᏒ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᏂᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᏓᏓᎿᏩᏍᏛ ᎡᎭᏠᎠᎯ.
\ft And saying, Thou that destroyest the temple, and buildest it in three days, save thyself. If thou be the Son of God, come down from the cross.

\ln Nasquono nunigvwiyusv atsilvanelohi ale dinowelisgi ale dinilawigi aniyelisgvi hia naniwesgei;
\syll ᎾᏍᏉᏃ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏃᏪᎵᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏂᎳᏫᎩ ᎠᏂᏰᎵᏍᎬᎢ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏂᏪᏍᎨᎢ;
\ft Likewise also the chief priests mocking him, with the scribes and elders, said,

\ln Anisoi dasdelisgvgi, uwasvsgini vtla yvgvlisdelv.  Iyuno Ugvwiyuhi Isili unatseli gesesdi, hnaquo dadahnawasdv eatloahi, gilano dayedoiyuni.
\syll ᎠᏂᏐᎢ ᏓᏍᏕᎵᏍᎬᎩ, ᎤᏩᏒᏍᎩᏂ ᎥᏝ ᏴᎬᎵᏍᏕᎸ.  ᎢᏳᏃ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᏏᎵ ᎤᎾᏤᎵ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎿᏉ ᏓᏓᎿᏩᏍᏛ ᎡᎠᏠᎠᎯ, ᎩᎳᏃ ᏓᏰᏙᎢᏳᏂ.
\ft He saved others; himself he cannot save. If he be the King of Israel, let him now come down from the cross, and we will believe him.

\ln Unelanvhi ulisgasdodvgi; hnaquo wusdelv iyuno ulvquodesdi; hiayeno tsinigawesgvgi, Unelanvhi Edoda.
\syll ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏛᎩ; ᎿᏉ ᏭᏍᏕᎸ ᎢᏳᏃ ᎤᎸᏉᏕᏍᏗ; ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᏥᏂᎦᏪᏍᎬᎩ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎡᏙᏓ.
\ft He trusted in God; let him deliver him now, if he will have him: for he said, I am the Son of God.

\ln Aninosgisgino nasgi itsulaha digegadvnvhi nasquo gagvwasotlvdei.
\syll ᎠᏂᏃᏍᎩᏍᎩᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᏗᎨᎦᏛᏅᎯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎦᎬᏩᏐᏢᏕᎢ.
\ft The thieves also, which were crucified with him, cast the same in his teeth.

\ln Hnaquono iga udalenvdv tsoine iyutlilodv kalawadisv iyasti usvhiyeyi iditlv ulisihvsvgi nigv nasgi gadohi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎢᎦ ᎤᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏦᎢᏁ ᎢᏳᏟᎶᏛ ᎧᎳᏩᏗᏒ ᎢᏯᏍᏘ ᎤᏒᎯᏰᏱ ᎢᏗᏢ ᎤᎵᏏᎲᏒᎩ ᏂᎬ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏙᎯ.
\ft Now from the sixth hour there was darkness over all the land unto the ninth hour.

\ln Tsoineno iyutlilodv iyv katawadisv usvhiyeyi iditlv Tsisa unetse asdaya, hia nuwesei; Ila, Ila, lama saquadani?  Nasgi hia nusdi gadvgvi, Unelanvhi aquatseliga, Unelanvhi aquatseliga, gadono isquvdetsvquo?
\syll ᏦᎢᏁᏃ ᎢᏳᏟᎶᏛ ᎢᏴ ᎧᏔᏩᏗᏒ ᎤᏒᎯᏰᏱ ᎢᏗᏢ ᏥᏌ ᎤᏁᏤ ᎠᏍᏓᏯ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎢᎳ, ᎢᎳ, ᎳᎹ ᏌᏆᏓᏂ?  ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏍᏗ ᎦᏛᎬᎢ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᏆᏤᎵᎦ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᏆᏤᎵᎦ, ᎦᏙᏃ ᎢᏍᏋᏕᏨᏉ?
\ft And about the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, Eli, Eli, lama sabachthani? that is to say, My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me?

\ln Igadvno nahna anidonai nasgi unadvganv, Ilaya ayaniha hia, unadvnei.
\syll ᎢᎦᏛᏃ ᏀᎾ ᎠᏂᏙᎾᎢ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅ, ᎢᎳᏯ ᎠᏯᏂᎭ ᎯᎠ, ᎤᎾᏛᏁᎢ.
\ft Some of them that stood there, when they heard that, said, This man calleth for Elias.

\ln Gilaquono iyvdv asiyvwi dusqualvtanei, ale wunese duwoli, ale tsunitsoyasdi ukaliistanei, ganasdohino uwequadotanv wunvnele nasgi uditasdi.
\syll ᎩᎳᏉᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᏚᏍᏆᎸᏔᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏭᏁᏎ ᏚᏬᎵ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏂᏦᏯᏍᏗ ᎤᎧᎵᎢᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᎦᎾᏍᏙᎯᏃ ᎤᏪᏆᏙᏔᏅ ᏭᏅᏁᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏗᏔᏍᏗ.
\ft And straightway one of them ran, and took a spunge, and filled it with vinegar, and put it on a reed, and gave him to drink.

\ln Igadvno hia nuniwesei; Unelagi, idadolehohi, tsigono Ilaya dagalutsi dayusdelvhili.
\syll ᎢᎦᏛᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ; ᎤᏁᎳᎩ, ᎢᏓᏙᎴᎰᎯ, ᏥᎪᏃ ᎢᎳᏯ ᏓᎦᎷᏥ ᏓᏳᏍᏕᎸᎯᎵ.
\ft The rest said, Let be, let us see whether Elias will come to save him.

\ln Tsisano taline asdaya unetsv deuyose udanvdo.
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎠᏍᏓᏯ ᎤᏁᏨ ᏕᎤᏲᏎ ᎤᏓᏅᏙ.
\ft Jesus, when he had cried again with a loud voice, yielded up the ghost.

\ln Gvniyuquono anuwo ayedoladv udvnadigalawiisdiyi dulistluyei, galvladi tsulenvhe eladi wusquadistanei; ale gadohi ulitelvnei, ale nvya dunalistluyei.
\syll ᎬᏂᏳᏉᏃ ᎠᏄᏬ ᎠᏰᏙᎳᏛ ᎤᏛᎾᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᏚᎵᏍᏡᏰᎢ, ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏧᎴᏅᎮ ᎡᎳᏗ ᏭᏍᏆᏗᏍᏔᏁᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎦᏙᎯ ᎤᎵᏖᎸᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏅᏯ ᏚᎾᎵᏍᏡᏰᎢ.
\ft And, behold, the veil of the temple was rent in twain from the top to the bottom; and the earth did quake, and the rocks rent;

\ln Datselisdvno dulisduisei, ale unitsati unadanvti unilinvtsvhi unadidanesei,
\syll ᏓᏤᎵᏍᏛᏃ ᏚᎵᏍᏚᎢᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ ᎤᏂᎵᏅᏨᎯ ᎤᎾᏗᏓᏁᏎᎢ,
\ft And the graves were opened; and many bodies of the saints which slept arose,

\ln Ale datselisdv duninugotse tsulenvhi nigesei, ale galvquodiyu gaduhv uniyvlei, ale unitsate gvnigesv nidunadvnelei.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏓᏤᎵᏍᏛ ᏚᏂᏄᎪᏤ ᏧᎴᏅᎯ ᏂᎨᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎦᏚᎲ ᎤᏂᏴᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏣᏖ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᏚᎾᏛᏁᎴᎢ.
\ft And came out of the graves after his resurrection, and went into the holy city, and appeared unto many.

\ln Hnaquono asgohitsuqui didatinidohi ale nasgi na itsulaha Tsisa gvwayawisgi, unadolehosv gadohi alitelvhvsgvi, ale nasgi nulistanidolvi, utsate unisgalei, hia nuniwesei; Udohiyuhiya Unelanvhi Uwetsi gese hia.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏧᏈ ᏗᏓᏘᏂᏙᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᏥᏌ ᎬᏩᏯᏫᏍᎩ, ᎤᎾᏙᎴᎰᏒ ᎦᏙᎯ ᎠᎵᏖᎸᎲᏍᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏂᏙᎸᎢ, ᎤᏣᏖ ᎤᏂᏍᎦᎴᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ; ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎨᏎ ᎯᎠ.
\ft Now when the centurion, and they that were with him, watching Jesus, saw the earthquake, and those things that were done, they feared greatly, saying, Truly this was the Son of God.

\ln Nahnano anidonae unitsate anigeyv ge iyvdv dodinikanei, nasgi Tsisa Gelili nvdagvwasdawadvdv gvwasdelvhidolvhi,
\syll ᏀᎾᏃ ᎠᏂᏙᎾᎡ ᎤᏂᏣᏖ ᎠᏂᎨᏴ Ꭸ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏙᏗᏂᎧᏁᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏌ ᎨᎵᎵ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏛᏛ ᎬᏩᏍᏕᎸᎯᏙᎸᎯ,
\ft And many women were there beholding afar off, which followed Jesus from Galilee, ministering unto him:

\ln Nahna unadasuye Meli Magideli ehi, ale Meli Tsimi ale Tsosi unitsi, ale Tsequidi tsuwetsi unitsi.
\syll ᏀᎾ ᎤᎾᏓᏑᏰ ᎺᎵ ᎹᎩᏕᎵ ᎡᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎺᎵ ᏥᎻ ᎠᎴ ᏦᏏ ᎤᏂᏥ, ᎠᎴ ᏤᏈᏗ ᏧᏪᏥ ᎤᏂᏥ.
\ft Among which was Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James and Joses, and the mother of Zebedee's children.

\ln Usvno nulistanv ulutse uwehnai asgaya Alimadiyi ehi Tsowa tsudoidv, nasquo nasgi Tsisa usdawadidohi gesei;
\syll ᎤᏒᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ ᎤᎷᏤ ᎤᏪᎿᎢ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎠᎵᎹᏗᏱ ᎡᎯ ᏦᏩ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ, ᎾᏍᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏌ ᎤᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎨᏎᎢ;
\ft When the even was come, there came a rich man of Arimathaea, named Joseph, who also himself was Jesus' disciple:

\ln Qualediyi uwenvsei, Tsisa ayelvi wutayolei.  Hnaquono Qualedi unetse ayelvi tsuniyohisediyi.
\syll ᏆᎴᏗᏱ ᎤᏪᏅᏎᎢ, ᏥᏌ ᎠᏰᎸᎢ ᏭᏔᏲᎴᎢ.  ᎿᏉᏃ ᏆᎴᏗ ᎤᏁᏤ ᎠᏰᎸᎢ ᏧᏂᏲᎯᏎᏗᏱ.
\ft He went to Pilate, and begged the body of Jesus. Then Pilate commanded the body to be delivered.

\ln Tsowano ayelv unesv uwetsanulotane gadaha nigesvna anuwo unegv;
\syll ᏦᏩᏃ ᎠᏰᎸ ᎤᏁᏒ ᎤᏪᏣᏄᎶᏔᏁ ᎦᏓᎭ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎠᏄᏬ ᎤᏁᎬ;
\ft And when Joseph had taken the body, he wrapped it in a clean linen cloth,

\ln Ale unvne uwasv utseli itse didanisodiyi, nasgi uyohi utalesvi; equano nvya galohisdiyi atselisdv wuwesaqualelv udanvsei.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎤᏅᏁ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎢᏤ ᏗᏓᏂᏐᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏲᎯ ᎤᏔᎴᏒᎢ; ᎡᏆᏃ ᏅᏯ ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᏤᎵᏍᏛ ᏭᏪᏌᏆᎴᎸ ᎤᏓᏅᏎᎢ.
\ft And laid it in his own new tomb, which he had hewn out in the rock: and he rolled a great stone to the door of the sepulchre, and departed.

\ln Nahnano igvyiditlv didanisodiyi dunole Meli Magideli ehi ale soi Meli.
\syll ᏀᎾᏃ ᎢᎬᏱᏗᏢ ᏗᏓᏂᏐᏗᏱ ᏚᏃᎴ ᎺᎵ ᎹᎩᏕᎵ ᎡᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏐᎢ ᎺᎵ.
\ft And there was Mary Magdalene, and the other Mary, sitting over against the sepulchre.

\ln Ale ugitsvdv, advnvisdodiyi iga ulosonvhi, nunigvwiyusv atsilvanelohi ale Aniqualisi degvwalawitse Qualedi,
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎤᎩᏨᏛ, ᎠᏛᏅᎢᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎢᎦ ᎤᎶᏐᏅᎯ, ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏ ᏕᎬᏩᎳᏫᏤ ᏆᎴᏗ,
\ft Now the next day, that followed the day of the preparation, the chief priests and Pharisees came together unto Pilate,

\ln Hia nuniwesei; Tsagvwiyuhi, oganvta nasgi na adalonuhesgi, asiquo tsigvnvgi, hia tsinuwesvgi; Tsoinequo iga dodvgaleni.
\syll ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ; ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎣᎦᏅᏔ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᏓᎶᏄᎮᏍᎩ, ᎠᏏᏉ ᏥᎬᏅᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏥᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᏦᎢᏁᏉ ᎢᎦ ᏙᏛᎦᎴᏂ.
\ft Saying, Sir, we remember that that deceiver said, while he was yet alive, After three days I will rise again.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi hinegi asdaya iyunvnediyi atselisdvi tsoine iga igohidv, gvwasdawadidohiyeno svnoyi yanilugi yigvwanosgi, hiano yinidaniwesi yvwi; Tsuyohusv doulenv; oniyino unatlonuhelvi utli uyoiyu yigi esgaquo igvyiyi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎯᏁᎩ ᎠᏍᏓᏯ ᎢᏳᏅᏁᏗᏱ ᎠᏤᎵᏍᏛᎢ ᏦᎢᏁ ᎢᎦ ᎢᎪᎯᏛ, ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯᏰᏃ ᏒᏃᏱ ᏯᏂᎷᎩ ᏱᎬᏩᏃᏍᎩ, ᎯᎠᏃ ᏱᏂᏓᏂᏪᏏ ᏴᏫ; ᏧᏲᎱᏒ ᏙᎤᎴᏅ; ᎣᏂᏱᏃ ᎤᎾᏠᏄᎮᎸᎢ ᎤᏟ ᎤᏲᎢᏳ ᏱᎩ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎢᎬᏱᏱ.
\ft Command therefore that the sepulchre be made sure until the third day, lest his disciples come by night, and steal him away, and say unto the people, He is risen from the dead: so the last error shall be worse than the first.

\ln Qualedi hia niduweselei; Aniyawisgi detsikaha, itsena nasdayv igetsvnedi gee winitsvga.
\syll ᏆᎴᏗ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎠᏂᏯᏫᏍᎩ ᏕᏥᎧᎭ, ᎢᏤᎾ ᎾᏍᏓᏴ ᎢᎨᏨᏁᏗ ᎨᎡ ᏫᏂᏨᎦ.
\ft Pilate said unto them, Ye have a watch: go your way, make it as sure as ye can.

\ln Howano unenvse asdayiyu winunvnele atselisdvi, uniyelvtane nvyohi, ale dunikane anigatidisgi.
\syll ᎰᏩᏃ ᎤᏁᏅᏎ ᎠᏍᏓᏱᏳ ᏫᏄᏅᏁᎴ ᎠᏤᎵᏍᏛᎢ, ᎤᏂᏰᎸᏔᏁ ᏅᏲᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏂᎧᏁ ᎠᏂᎦᏘᏗᏍᎩ.
\ft So they went, and made the sepulchre sure, sealing the stone, and setting a watch.

\ln Unadodaquonvhino, gila iga nigalisdisgei alenisgv sunadodaquasdi gesv Meli Magideli ehi ale soi Meli unagatanile atselisdvi.
\syll ᎤᎾᏙᏓᏉᏅᎯᏃ, ᎩᎳ ᎢᎦ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᏍᎨᎢ ᎠᎴᏂᏍᎬ ᏑᎾᏙᏓᏆᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎺᎵ ᎹᎩᏕᎵ ᎡᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏐᎢ ᎺᎵ ᎤᎾᎦᏔᏂᎴ ᎠᏤᎵᏍᏛᎢ.
\ft In the end of the sabbath, as it began to dawn toward the first day of the week, came Mary Magdalene and the other Mary to see the sepulchre.

\ln Ale gvniyuquo utsati gadohi ulitelvnei, Yihowayeno utseli dikahnawadidohi galvladi tsutloasei, ulutsvno nvya uwesaqualele uhvse galohisdiyi ahvi; ale usgilanei.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎦᏙᎯ ᎤᎵᏖᎸᏁᎢ, ᏱᎰᏩᏰᏃ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏧᏠᎠᏎᎢ, ᎤᎷᏨᏃ ᏅᏯ ᎤᏪᏌᏆᎴᎴ ᎤᎲᏎ ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᎲᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᏍᎩᎳᏁᎢ.
\ft And, behold, there was a great earthquake: for the angel of the Lord descended from heaven, and came and rolled back the stone from the door, and sat upon it.

\ln Dikanodiyi anagalisgi nasgiya gesei, unuwavno vnotsi tsinunegiyv nunegiyei.
\syll ᏗᎧᏃᏗᏱ ᎠᎾᎦᎵᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎤᏄᏩᎥᏃ ᎥᏃᏥ ᏥᏄᏁᎩᏴ ᏄᏁᎩᏰᎢ.
\ft His countenance was like lightning, and his raiment white as snow:

\ln Anigatiyano anisgaihv duninawei, ale tsuniyohusvhi nasgiya nunalistanei.
\syll ᎠᏂᎦᏘᏯᏃ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᎢᎲ ᏚᏂᎾᏪᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᎾᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ.
\ft And for fear of him the keepers did shake, and became as dead men.

\ln Dikahnawadidohino unetsv hia niduwesele anigeyv; Tlesdi nihi yisdisgaihesdi, tsigatahayeno Tsisa agadvnvhi esdiyohvi.
\syll ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎯᏃ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴ ᎠᏂᎨᏴ; ᏞᏍᏗ ᏂᎯ ᏱᏍᏗᏍᎦᎢᎮᏍᏗ, ᏥᎦᏔᎭᏰᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎠᎦᏛᏅᎯ ᎡᏍᏗᏲᎲᎢ.
\ft And the angel answered and said unto the women, Fear not ye: for I know that ye seek Jesus, which was crucified.

\ln Vtla ani tigana, dulenvyeno nasgiya nuwesvi; Esdena esdagata Ugvwiyuhi atsinvnvi.
\syll ᎥᏝ ᎠᏂ ᏘᎦᎾ, ᏚᎴᏅᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᏪᏒᎢ; ᎡᏍᏕᎾ ᎡᏍᏓᎦᏔ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᏥᏅᏅᎢ.
\ft He is not here: for he is risen, as he said. Come, see the place where the Lord lay.

\ln Ale ulisdiyu isdena widisdinohvsi gvwasdawadidohi deulenv uyohusvi; ale gvniyuquo igvyi Gelili nvdayesi, nahna dayetsigoi.  Gvniyuquo isdvnohvsi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏍᏗᏳ ᎢᏍᏕᎾ ᏫᏗᏍᏗᏃᎲᏏ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏕᎤᎴᏅ ᎤᏲᎱᏒᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎢᎬᏱ ᎨᎵᎵ ᏅᏓᏰᏏ, ᏀᎾ ᏓᏰᏥᎪᎢ.  ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎢᏍᏛᏃᎲᏏ.
\ft And go quickly, and tell his disciples that he is risen from the dead; and, behold, he goeth before you into Galilee; there shall ye see him: lo, I have told you.

\ln Ulisdiyuno atselisdv unadanvsei, anisgaihe ale utsati analiheligei, ale dunisqualvtane gvwasdawadidohi duninonelvsei.
\syll ᎤᎵᏍᏗᏳᏃ ᎠᏤᎵᏍᏛ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏎᎢ, ᎠᏂᏍᎦᎢᎮ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎠᎾᎵᎮᎵᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏂᏍᏆᎸᏔᏁ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏚᏂᏃᏁᎸᏎᎢ.
\ft And they departed quickly from the sepulchre with fear and great joy; and did run to bring his disciples word.

\ln Anaisvno daninonelisv gvwasdawadidohi gvniyuquo Tsisa dunatlosei; Dohiyi dedadagowadv, udvnei.  Unilutsvno tsulasideni duniniyvhei, eladi nigvwadvnelei.
\syll ᎠᎾᎢᏒᏃ ᏓᏂᏃᏁᎵᏒ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᏥᏌ ᏚᎾᏠᏎᎢ; ᏙᎯᏱ ᏕᏓᏓᎪᏩᏛ, ᎤᏛᏁᎢ.  ᎤᏂᎷᏨᏃ ᏧᎳᏏᏕᏂ ᏚᏂᏂᏴᎮᎢ, ᎡᎳᏗ ᏂᎬᏩᏛᏁᎴᎢ.
\ft And as they went to tell his disciples, behold, Jesus met them, saying, All hail. And they came and held him by the feet, and worshipped him.

\ln Hnaquono Tsisa hia niduweselei, Tlesdi yisdisgaihesdi; isdena widisdinohvsi otsalinvtli Gelili wunilohisdiyi, nahnano dagvgigohi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏍᏗᏍᎦᎢᎮᏍᏗ; ᎢᏍᏕᎾ ᏫᏗᏍᏗᏃᎲᏏ ᎣᏣᎵᏅᏟ ᎨᎵᎵ ᏭᏂᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ, ᏀᎾᏃ ᏓᎬᎩᎪᎯ.
\ft Then said Jesus unto them, Be not afraid: go tell my brethren that they go into Galilee, and there shall they see me.

\ln Anaisvno gvniyuquo igadv uniyawisvhi unilutse gaduhvi, ale nunigvwiyusv atsilvanelohi duninonele nigadv nulistanidolvi.
\syll ᎠᎾᎢᏒᏃ ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎢᎦᏛ ᎤᏂᏯᏫᏒᎯ ᎤᏂᎷᏤ ᎦᏚᎲᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᏚᏂᏃᏁᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏂᏙᎸᎢ.
\ft Now when they were going, behold, some of the watch came into the city, and shewed unto the chief priests all the things that were done.

\ln Nasgino ale dinilawigi dunilawitsv ale uninohelv, utsati adelv duninele aniyawisgi,
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏂᎳᏫᎩ ᏚᏂᎳᏫᏨ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏃᎮᎸ, ᎤᏣᏘ ᎠᏕᎸ ᏚᏂᏁᎴ ᎠᏂᏯᏫᏍᎩ,
\ft And when they were assembled with the elders, and had taken counsel, they gave large money unto the soldiers,

\ln Hia nuniwesei; Hia nitsiwesvha; Gvwasdawadidohi svnoyi unilutsvgi, otsilinv gvwanosgisvgi.
\syll ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ; ᎯᎠ ᏂᏥᏪᏒᎭ; ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏒᏃᏱ ᎤᏂᎷᏨᎩ, ᎣᏥᎵᏅ ᎬᏩᏃᏍᎩᏒᎩ.
\ft Saying, Say ye, His disciples came by night, and stole him away while we slept.

\ln Iyuno nasgi advganv ugvwiyuhi, dayotsisdiyetani, ale datsvsdelvhi.
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏛᎦᏅ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᏓᏲᏥᏍᏗᏰᏔᏂ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᏨᏍᏕᎸᎯ.
\ft And if this come to the governor's ears, we will persuade him, and secure you.

\ln Dunigisvno adelv, nigetsiweselv nunadvnelei.  Nasgino hia kanohedv asi aninohelidoha Anitsusi.
\syll ᏚᏂᎩᏒᏃ ᎠᏕᎸ, ᏂᎨᏥᏪᏎᎸ ᏄᎾᏛᏁᎴᎢ.  ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎠᏏ ᎠᏂᏃᎮᎵᏙᎭ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ.
\ft So they took the money, and did as they were taught: and this saying is commonly reported among the Jews until this day.

\ln Hnaquono sadu iyanidv gvwasdawadidohi Gelili unenvsvgi tsodalv Tsisa unasehelvi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏌᏚ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎨᎵᎵ ᎤᏁᏅᏒᎩ ᏦᏓᎸ ᏥᏌ ᎤᎾᏎᎮᎸᎢ.
\ft Then the eleven disciples went away into Galilee, into a mountain where Jesus had appointed them.

\ln Gvwagohvno eladi nigvwadvnelvgi.  Aseno igadv unadlasidvelvquo.
\syll ᎬᏩᎪᎲᏃ ᎡᎳᏗ ᏂᎬᏩᏛᏁᎸᎩ.  ᎠᏎᏃ ᎢᎦᏛ ᎤᎾᏜᏏᏛᎡᎸᏉ.
\ft And when they saw him, they worshipped him: but some doubted.

\ln Tsisano ulutsv duwonetanvgi, hia nuwesvgi; Vginelv nigav digilvwisdanediyi galvladi ale elohi.
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᎷᏨ ᏚᏬᏁᏔᏅᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎥᎩᏁᎸ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏗᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎡᎶᎯ.
\ft And Jesus came and spake unto them, saying, All power is given unto me in heaven and in earth.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi itsena widitseyohvga nagadv nunadalesv yvwi, detsawosgesdi itsvdisgesdi dudov Agayvligei ale Uwetsi ale Galvquodiyu Adanvdo,
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏤᎾ ᏫᏗᏤᏲᎲᎦ ᎾᎦᏛ ᏄᎾᏓᎴᏒ ᏴᏫ, ᏕᏣᏬᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎢᏨᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏚᏙᎥ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎠᎴ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ,
\ft Go ye therefore, and teach all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Ghost:

\ln Detseyohvsgesdi tsunikahnawadvsdiyi nigav itsvnetselvi; gvniyuquono nigohilv itsvyeladidoha wigvlisquadisgi elohi.  Emenv.
\syll ᏕᏤᏲᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏧᏂᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎢᏨᏁᏤᎸᎢ; ᎬᏂᏳᏉᏃ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎢᏨᏰᎳᏗᏙᎭ ᏫᎬᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᎩ ᎡᎶᎯ.  ᎡᎺᏅ.
\ft Teaching them to observe all things whatsoever I have commanded you: and, lo, I am with you always, even unto the end of the world. Amen.

\ln Adalenisgv yisdv kanohedv, Tsisa Galonedv Unelanvhi Uwetsi utseliga.
\syll ᎠᏓᎴᏂᏍᎬ ᏱᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ, ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ.
\ft The beginning of the gospel of Jesus Christ, the Son of God;

\ln Nasgiya hia tsinigvnv tsigowela anadolehosgiyi; Gvniyuquo, tsinvli tsinvsidasdi tsakadv igvyiditlv, nasgi datsadvnvisdaneli tsalohisdiyi igvyiditlv.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᎬᏅ ᏥᎪᏪᎳ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩᏱ; ᎬᏂᏳᏉ, ᏥᏅᎵ ᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᏣᎧᏛ ᎢᎬᏱᏗᏢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏓᏣᏛᏅᎢᏍᏓᏁᎵ ᏣᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎢᎬᏱᏗᏢ.
\ft As it is written in the prophets, Behold, I send my messenger before thy face, which shall prepare thy way before thee.

\ln Uweluga gilo inagei, hia nigaweha; Etsadvnvisdasi Yihowa ulohisdiyi, dunvnv ditsitsinohisda.
\syll ᎤᏪᎷᎦ ᎩᎶ ᎢᎾᎨᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᎭ; ᎡᏣᏛᏅᎢᏍᏓᏏ ᏱᎰᏩ ᎤᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ, ᏚᏅᏅ ᏗᏥᏥᏃᎯᏍᏓ.
\ft The voice of one crying in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the Lord, make his paths straight.

\ln Tsani dadawosge inagei, ale alitsidohvsge kanohesge didawesdi gesv ganetliyvsdiyi odanvdv ugvwali nasgi gayvdatinediyi asganvtsvi.
\syll ᏣᏂ ᏓᏓᏬᏍᎨ ᎢᎾᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎵᏥᏙᎲᏍᎨ ᎧᏃᎮᏍᎨ ᏗᏓᏪᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎦᏁᏟᏴᏍᏗᏱ ᎣᏓᏅᏛ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏴᏓᏘᏁᏗᏱ ᎠᏍᎦᏅᏨᎢ.
\ft John did baptize in the wilderness, and preach the baptism of repentance for the remission of sins.

\ln Ale wigvwalutsele nigvnadv Tsudiyi ale Tsilusilimi anehi, ale nigadv nasgi dunawoe Tsodani uweyvi, unisganvtsv aninohvsgei.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏫᎬᏩᎷᏤᎴ ᏂᎬᎾᏛ ᏧᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᎠᏁᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᎾᏬᎡ ᏦᏓᏂ ᎤᏪᏴᎢ, ᎤᏂᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᎠᏂᏃᎲᏍᎨᎢ.
\ft And there went out unto him all the land of Judaea, and they of Jerusalem, and were all baptized of him in the river of Jordan, confessing their sins.

\ln Tsanino unuwe gemili usdiyenvhi, ganotsino udatlosdei; vleno ale wadulisi inage ehi alisdayvdisgei.
\syll ᏣᏂᏃ ᎤᏄᏪ ᎨᎻᎵ ᎤᏍᏗᏰᏅᎯ, ᎦᏃᏥᏃ ᎤᏓᏠᏍᏕᎢ; ᎥᎴᏃ ᎠᎴ ᏩᏚᎵᏏ ᎢᎾᎨ ᎡᎯ ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏍᎨᎢ.
\ft And John was clothed with camel's hair, and with a girdle of a skin about his loins; and he did eat locusts and wild honey;

\ln Alitsidohvsgeno hia nigawesgei; Utli ulinigidiyu esgaquo ayv oni dayai, nasgi tsulasulogihi dakanesadv vtla yeli yinigoi aquadisadadisdiyi ale digikaneyvdiyi.
\syll ᎠᎵᏥᏙᎲᏍᎨᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎨᎢ; ᎤᏟ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎠᏴ ᎣᏂ ᏓᏯᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᎳᏑᎶᎩᎯ ᏓᎧᏁᏌᏛ ᎥᏝ ᏰᎵ ᏱᏂᎪᎢ ᎠᏆᏗᏌᏓᏗᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎩᎧᏁᏴᏗᏱ.
\ft And preached, saying, There cometh one mightier than I after me, the latchet of whose shoes I am not worthy to stoop down and unloose.

\ln Ayv udohiyuhi ama detsvyawostanv, nasgisgini Galvquodiyu Adanvdo dodatsawostani.
\syll ᎠᏴ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎠᎹ ᏕᏨᏯᏬᏍᏔᏅ, ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᏙᏓᏣᏬᏍᏔᏂ.
\ft I indeed have baptized you with water: but he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost.

\ln Nahiyuno hia nulistanei, Tsisa Naselidi tsulose nasgi Gelili tsigaduha, ale Tsani udawoe Tsodani.
\syll ᏀᎢᏳᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᏥᏌ ᎾᏎᎵᏗ ᏧᎶᏎ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᎵᎵ ᏥᎦᏚᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᏣᏂ ᎤᏓᏬᎡ ᏦᏓᏂ.
\ft And it came to pass in those days, that Jesus came from Nazareth of Galilee, and was baptized of John in Jordan.

\ln Gilaquono iyvdv tsuhnalusv amayi tsudanvsv, ugohe galvloi ulisduidv gesei, ale Adanvdo guledisgonihi nasgiyai, tsutloasidise nasgi uweyalvtsei.
\syll ᎩᎳᏉᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏧᎿᎷᏒ ᎠᎹᏱ ᏧᏓᏅᏒ, ᎤᎪᎮ ᎦᎸᎶᎢ ᎤᎵᏍᏚᎢᏛ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎫᎴᏗᏍᎪᏂᎯ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ, ᏧᏠᎠᏏᏗᏎ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏪᏯᎸᏤᎢ.
\ft And straightway coming up out of the water, he saw the heavens opened, and the Spirit like a dove descending upon him:

\ln Ale hia nvtsuwese galvladi, nihi gvgeyui Aquetsi, nasgi osiyu gvyelvi tsigi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏅᏧᏪᏎ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ, ᏂᎯ ᎬᎨᏳᎢ ᎠᏇᏥ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎬᏰᎸᎢ ᏥᎩ.
\ft And there came a voice from heaven, saying, Thou art my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.

\ln Gilaquono iyvdv Adanvdo inage wutinvstanei.
\syll ᎩᎳᏉᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎢᎾᎨ ᏭᏘᏅᏍᏔᏁᎢ.
\ft And immediately the Spirit driveth him into the wilderness.

\ln Nahnano inage edohe nvgasgohi tsusvhidv, Sedani ugoliyesgei; ale inage ehnai degeladidohei; ale dinikahnawadidohi gvwasdelvhidohei.
\syll ᏀᎾᏃ ᎢᎾᎨ ᎡᏙᎮ ᏅᎦᏍᎪᎯ ᏧᏒᎯᏛ, ᏎᏓᏂ ᎤᎪᎵᏰᏍᎨᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎢᎾᎨ ᎡᎿᎢ ᏕᎨᎳᏗᏙᎮᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᏗᏂᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎬᏩᏍᏕᎸᎯᏙᎮᎢ.
\ft And he was there in the wilderness forty days, tempted of Satan; and was with the wild beasts; and the angels ministered unto him.

\ln Tsanino didasdudiyi natsiyvtanei, Tsisa Gelili ulutsei, alitsidohvsge osdv kanohedv Unelanvhi ugvwiyuhi gesv ugvwali,
\syll ᏣᏂᏃ ᏗᏓᏍᏚᏗᏱ ᎾᏥᏴᏔᏁᎢ, ᏥᏌ ᎨᎵᎵ ᎤᎷᏤᎢ, ᎠᎵᏥᏙᎲᏍᎨ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ,
\ft Now after that John was put in prison, Jesus came into Galilee, preaching the gospel of the kingdom of God,

\ln Ale hia nigawesgei, Hnaquo aliyiloga, ale Unelanvhi ugvwiyuhi gesv esganiyu dayai; ditsinetliyvna detsadanvdvi, ale itsohiyuhvga osdv kanohedv.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎨᎢ, ᎿᏉ ᎠᎵᏱᎶᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎡᏍᎦᏂᏳ ᏓᏯᎢ; ᏗᏥᏁᏟᏴᎾ ᏕᏣᏓᏅᏛᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏦᎯᏳᎲᎦ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ.
\ft And saying, The time is fulfilled, and the kingdom of God is at hand: repent ye, and believe the gospel.

\ln Gelilino vdali ulodi aisvi, dugohe Sawani ale Enidi nasgi dinadanvtli, vdali anigayaluvsgei; anigayaluvsgiyeno gesei.
\syll ᎨᎵᎵᏃ ᎥᏓᎵ ᎤᎶᏗ ᎠᎢᏒᎢ, ᏚᎪᎮ ᏌᏩᏂ ᎠᎴ ᎡᏂᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎾᏓᏅᏟ, ᎥᏓᎵ ᎠᏂᎦᏯᎷᎥᏍᎨᎢ; ᎠᏂᎦᏯᎷᎥᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎨᏎᎢ.
\ft Now as he walked by the sea of Galilee, he saw Simon and Andrew his brother casting a net into the sea: for they were fishers.

\ln Tsisano hia niduweselei; Sginisdawaduga, yvwino disdigayaluvsgi nvdasdvyvneli.
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᏍᎩᏂᏍᏓᏩᏚᎦ, ᏴᏫᏃ ᏗᏍᏗᎦᏯᎷᎥᏍᎩ ᏅᏓᏍᏛᏴᏁᎵ.
\ft And Jesus said unto them, Come ye after me, and I will make you to become fishers of men.

\ln Gilaquono iyvdv duniyose tsunigayaludi, ale gvwasdawadvsei.
\syll ᎩᎳᏉᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏚᏂᏲᏎ ᏧᏂᎦᏯᎷᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏛᏎᎢ.
\ft And straightway they forsook their nets, and followed him.

\ln Nahnano wiuwenv usdigidv, dugohe Tsimi, Tsequidi uwetsi, Tsanino nasgi dinadanvtli, nasgino nasquo unatsae tsiyuhi danotlvhisisge tsunigayaludi.
\syll ᏀᎾᏃ ᏫᎤᏪᏅ ᎤᏍᏗᎩᏛ, ᏚᎪᎮ ᏥᎻ, ᏤᏈᏗ ᎤᏪᏥ, ᏣᏂᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎾᏓᏅᏟ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᎾᏣᎡ ᏥᏳᎯ ᏓᏃᏢᎯᏏᏍᎨ ᏧᏂᎦᏯᎷᏗ.
\ft And when he had gone a little further thence, he saw James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, who also were in the ship mending their nets.

\ln Gilaquono iyvdv nasgi widuyanvhei; unvdetsvno unidoda Tsequidi gegaguyvehi tsuninvsidasdi itsulaha tsiyuhi unatsavi, gvwasdawadvsei.
\syll ᎩᎳᏉᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏫᏚᏯᏅᎮᎢ; ᎤᏅᏕᏨᏃ ᎤᏂᏙᏓ ᏤᏈᏗ ᎨᎦᎫᏴᎡᎯ ᏧᏂᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᏥᏳᎯ ᎤᎾᏣᎥᎢ, ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏛᏎᎢ.
\ft And straightway he called them: and they left their father Zebedee in the ship with the hired servants, and went after him.

\ln Gequanino wuniyvlei; gilaquono iyvdv digalawiisdiyi wuyvlv dudeyone unadodaquasgv iga.
\syll ᎨᏆᏂᏃ ᏭᏂᏴᎴᎢ; ᎩᎳᏉᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᏭᏴᎸ ᏚᏕᏲᏁ ᎤᎾᏙᏓᏆᏍᎬ ᎢᎦ.
\ft And they went into Capernaum; and straightway on the sabbath day he entered into the synagogue, and taught.

\ln Unisquanigoseno nusdv dadeyohvsgvi, dudeyoneyeno ulinigidv tsuho nasgiyai, vtlano dinowelisgi danadeyohvsgv nasgiya yigesei.
\syll ᎤᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏎᏃ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏓᏕᏲᎲᏍᎬᎢ, ᏚᏕᏲᏁᏰᏃ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᏧᎰ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ, ᎥᏝᏃ ᏗᏃᏪᎵᏍᎩ ᏓᎾᏕᏲᎲᏍᎬ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ.
\ft And they were astonished at his doctrine: for he taught them as one that had authority, and not as the scribes.

\ft And when he had looked round about on them with anger, being grieved for the hardness of their hearts, he saith unto the man, Stretch forth thine hand. And he stretched it out: and his hand was restored whole as the other.

\syll ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏᏃ ᎤᏂᏄᎪᏨ, ᎩᎳᏉ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏭᎾᎵᏃᎮᎴ ᎡᎶᏛ ᎬᏩᏍᏕᎵᏍᎩ ᎬᏩᏡᏗᏍᎬ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏅᏁᏗᏱ ᎤᏂᎯᏍᏗᏱ.
\ft And the Pharisees went forth, and straightway took counsel with the Herodians against him, how they might destroy him.

\ln Tsisano udanvse dutinvse gvwasdawadidohi vdali wunilosei; unitsatino gvwasdawadvsei, nvdayunilosvhi Gelili, ale Tsudiyi,
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᏓᏅᏎ ᏚᏘᏅᏎ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎥᏓᎵ ᏭᏂᎶᏎᎢ; ᎤᏂᏣᏘᏃ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏛᏎᎢ, ᏅᏓᏳᏂᎶᏒᎯ ᎨᎵᎵ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏗᏱ,
\ft But Jesus withdrew himself with his disciples to the sea: and a great multitude from Galilee followed him, and from Judaea,

\ln Ale Tsilusilimi, ale Idomiyi, ale Tsodani isgoniditlv; ale Daya ale Sadoni nav dinehi, utsati anigodiyu, nasgi unadvganv nigav usquanigodi deulvwisdanelv, gvwalutselei.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏙᎻᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏦᏓᏂ ᎢᏍᎪᏂᏗᏢ; ᎠᎴ ᏓᏯ ᎠᎴ ᏌᏙᏂ ᎾᎥ ᏗᏁᎯ, ᎤᏣᏘ ᎠᏂᎪᏗᏳ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᏕᎤᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸ, ᎬᏩᎷᏤᎴᎢ.
\ft And from Jerusalem, and from Idumaea, and from beyond Jordan; and they about Tyre and Sidon, a great multitude, when they had heard what great things he did, came unto him.

\ln Dunetseleno gvwasdawadidohi, nasgi tsiyu ugatidisdiyi, unitsati gesv iyusdi, nasgi gvwanenulasdodiyi nigesvna.
\syll ᏚᏁᏤᎴᏃ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏳ ᎤᎦᏘᏗᏍᏗᏱ, ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏩᏁᏄᎳᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.
\ft And he spake to his disciples, that a small ship should wait on him because of the multitude, lest they should throng him.

\ln Unitsateyeno dunvwanei; nasgi iyusdi gvwanenulasdisge gvwanotlisdodiyi unadulisgei, nigadv gohusdi dinalisdisgi.
\syll ᎤᏂᏣᏖᏰᏃ ᏚᏅᏩᏁᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎬᏩᏁᏄᎳᏍᏗᏍᎨ ᎬᏩᏃᏟᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᎾᏚᎵᏍᎨᎢ, ᏂᎦᏛ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏗᎾᎵᏍᏗᏍᎩ.
\ft For he had healed many; insomuch that they pressed upon him for to touch him, as many as had plagues.

\ln Ale digadaha didanvdo, iyuno gvwagowadv, eladi gvwadanvnehe, ale aneluhvsge, hia naniwesgei, Unelanvhi Uwetsi nihi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏗᎦᏓᎭ ᏗᏓᏅᏙ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎬᏩᎪᏩᏛ, ᎡᎳᏗ ᎬᏩᏓᏅᏁᎮ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏁᎷᎲᏍᎨ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏂᏪᏍᎨᎢ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏪᏥ ᏂᎯ.
\ft And unclean spirits, when they saw him, fell down before him, and cried, saying, Thou art the Son of God.

\ln Ulinigidvno dunetsele nasgi gvnigesv igvwanediyi nigesvna.
\syll ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛᏃ ᏚᏁᏤᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᎬᏩᏁᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.
\ft And he straitly charged them that they should not make him known.

\ln Uhnaluseno odalvi, ale duyanvhe nasgi udulisgv tsuyanvdiyi; ale gvwalutsehei.
\syll ᎤᎿᎷᏎᏃ ᎣᏓᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏯᏅᎮ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎬ ᏧᏯᏅᏗᏱ; ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᎷᏤᎮᎢ.
\ft And he goeth up into a mountain, and calleth unto him whom he would: and they came unto him.

\ln Ale dusuyese taladu iyanidv, nasgi gvwasdawadidasdiyi, ale nasgi tsunvsdiyi unalitsidonidasdiyi,
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏚᏑᏰᏎ ᏔᎳᏚ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏓᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏅᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᎾᎵᏥᏙᏂᏓᏍᏗᏱ,
\ft And he ordained twelve, that they should be with him, and that he might send them forth to preach,

\ln Ale tsulisgolvdanediyi dunitlvgv tsuninvwodiyi, ale anisgina tsuninugowisdiyi;
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏧᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᏚᏂᏢᎬ ᏧᏂᏅᏬᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏍᎩᎾ ᏧᏂᏄᎪᏫᏍᏗᏱ;
\ft And to have power to heal sicknesses, and to cast out devils:

\ln Sawanino Quida duwoei.
\syll ᏌᏩᏂᏃ ᏈᏓ ᏚᏬᎡᎢ.
\ft And Simon he surnamed Peter;

\ln Ale Tsimi Tsequidi uwetsi, ale Tsani Tsimi dinadanvtli; ale nasgi Quoanatsi duwoei, nasgi ayvdaqualosgi tsuwetsi gadvga;
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏥᎻ ᏤᏈᏗ ᎤᏪᏥ, ᎠᎴ ᏣᏂ ᏥᎻ ᏗᎾᏓᏅᏟ; ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏉᎠᎾᏥ ᏚᏬᎡᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴᏓᏆᎶᏍᎩ ᏧᏪᏥ ᎦᏛᎦ;
\ft And James the son of Zebedee, and John the brother of James; and he surnamed them Boanerges, which is, The sons of thunder:

\ln Ale Enidi, ale Quiligi, ale Quadolami, ale Madu, ale Dami, ale Tsimi Eliqui uwetsi, ale Dadiya, ale Sawani Agenanidi,
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎡᏂᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏈᎵᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏆᏙᎳᎻ, ᎠᎴ ᎹᏚ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᎻ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᎻ ᎡᎵᏈ ᎤᏪᏥ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᏗᏯ, ᎠᎴ ᏌᏩᏂ ᎠᎨᎾᏂᏗ,
\ft And Andrew, and Philip, and Bartholomew, and Matthew, and Thomas, and James the son of Alphaeus, and Thaddaeus, and Simon the Canaanite,

\ln Ale Tsudasi Isgaladi, nasgi squo tsulonuhelei; adanelvno wunilosei.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏧᏓᏏ ᎢᏍᎦᎳᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏍᏉ ᏧᎶᏄᎮᎴᎢ; ᎠᏓᏁᎸᏃ ᏭᏂᎶᏎᎢ.
\ft And Judas Iscariot, which also betrayed him: and they went into an house.

\ln Unitsatino taline dunilawitsolei, sgi iyusdi nasquo niutlisde gadu unigisdiyi.
\syll ᎤᏂᏣᏘᏃ ᏔᎵᏁ ᏚᏂᎳᏫᏦᎴᎢ, ᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏂᎤᏟᏍᏕ ᎦᏚ ᎤᏂᎩᏍᏗᏱ.
\ft And the multitude cometh together again, so that they could not so much as eat bread.

\ln Gohusdino tsuwanv unadvganv, unenvse gvwaniyvhvsei; hiayeno naniwesgei, ulvnotiha.
\syll ᎪᎱᏍᏗᏃ ᏧᏩᏅ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅ, ᎤᏁᏅᏎ ᎬᏩᏂᏴᎲᏎᎢ; ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᎾᏂᏪᏍᎨᎢ, ᎤᎸᏃᏘᎭ.
\ft And when his friends heard of it, they went out to lay hold on him: for they said, He is beside himself.

\ln Dinowelisgino Tsilusilimi nvdayunilosvhi, hia naniwesgei, Quelitsiqua uweha, ale ugvwiyuhi anisgina unatseliga gvdiha deganugowisga anisgina.
\syll ᏗᏃᏪᎵᏍᎩᏃ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᏅᏓᏳᏂᎶᏒᎯ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏂᏪᏍᎨᎢ, ᏇᎵᏥᏆ ᎤᏪᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᏂᏍᎩᎾ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ ᎬᏗᎭ ᏕᎦᏄᎪᏫᏍᎦ ᎠᏂᏍᎩᎾ.
\ft And the scribes which came down from Jerusalem said, He hath Beelzebub, and by the prince of the devils casteth he out devils.

\ln Nasgino widuyanvhv, hia niduwesele dutlilosdanelei, Gado yigalisdoda Sedani yiganugowa Sedani?
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏫᏚᏯᏅᎲ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴ ᏚᏟᎶᏍᏓᏁᎴᎢ, ᎦᏙ ᏱᎦᎵᏍᏙᏓ ᏎᏓᏂ ᏱᎦᏄᎪᏩ ᏎᏓᏂ?
\ft And he called them unto him, and said unto them in parables, How can Satan cast out Satan?

\ln Iyu ale ayeli gotlvsv tali yinudaa, uwasvquo yadatludiha, vtla yeli yinigvwasdiquo nasgi ayeli gotlvsvi.
\syll ᎢᏳ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎪᏢᏒ ᏔᎵ ᏱᏄᏓᎠ, ᎤᏩᏒᏉ ᏯᏓᏡᏗᎭ, ᎥᏝ ᏰᎵ ᏱᏂᎬᏩᏍᏗᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎪᏢᏒᎢ.
\ft And if a kingdom be divided against itself, that kingdom cannot stand.

\ln Iyu ale sidanelv gesv tali yinudaa, uwasvquo yadatludiha, nasgi sidanelv gesv vtla yeli yinigvwasdiquo.
\syll ᎢᏳ ᎠᎴ ᏏᏓᏁᎸ ᎨᏒ ᏔᎵ ᏱᏄᏓᎠ, ᎤᏩᏒᏉ ᏯᏓᏡᏗᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏏᏓᏁᎸ ᎨᏒ ᎥᏝ ᏰᎵ ᏱᏂᎬᏩᏍᏗᏉ.
\ft And if a house be divided against itself, that house cannot stand.

\ln Iyu ale Sedani yidulenv uwasv yidudagatilenv, ale tali yinudaa, vtla yeli yinigvwasdiquo, yiwastaquosgini ehvi.
\syll ᎢᏳ ᎠᎴ ᏎᏓᏂ ᏱᏚᎴᏅ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏱᏚᏓᎦᏘᎴᏅ, ᎠᎴ ᏔᎵ ᏱᏄᏓᎠ, ᎥᏝ ᏰᎵ ᏱᏂᎬᏩᏍᏗᏉ, ᏱᏩᏍᏔᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎡᎲᎢ.
\ft And if Satan rise up against himself, and be divided, he cannot stand, but hath an end.

\ln Vtla gilo ulinigidv asgaya ganelv yvgvyvha, ale yvgvwonv uhnavi, gvni igvyi yulvlv nasgi ulinigidv asgaya; gila hnaquo yawonv ganelv uhnavi.
\syll ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎦᏁᎸ ᏴᎬᏴᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᏴᎬᏬᏅ ᎤᎿᎥᎢ, ᎬᏂ ᎢᎬᏱ ᏳᎸᎸ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ; ᎩᎳ ᎿᏉ ᏯᏬᏅ ᎦᏁᎸ ᎤᎿᎥᎢ.
\ft No man can enter into a strong man's house, and spoil his goods, except he will first bind the strong man; and then he will spoil his house.

\ln Udohiyuhiya itsvyoseha, Nigav asganvisdi gesv, gagetsidolisdiquo gesesdi yvwi tsunetsi, ale asotlvisdodi gesv, nigav gvwanisotlvisdodi gesvi;
\syll ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎢᏨᏲᏎᎭ, ᏂᎦᎥ ᎠᏍᎦᏅᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ, ᎦᎨᏥᏙᎵᏍᏗᏉ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏴᏫ ᏧᏁᏥ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏐᏢᎢᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ, ᏂᎦᎥ ᎬᏩᏂᏐᏢᎢᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ;
\ft Verily I say unto you, All sins shall be forgiven unto the sons of men, and blasphemies wherewith soever they shall blaspheme:

\ln Gilosgini Galvquodiyu Adanvdo asotlvisdisgesdi, vtla ilvhiyu gayetsidolisdi yigesesdi, digayegugodanediquosgini winasdvna usdvdisdiyi;
\syll ᎩᎶᏍᎩᏂ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎠᏐᏢᎢᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎥᏝ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᎦᏰᏥᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᏗᎦᏰᎫᎪᏓᏁᏗᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᏫᎾᏍᏛᎾ ᎤᏍᏛᏗᏍᏗᏱ;
\ft But he that shall blaspheme against the Holy Ghost hath never forgiveness, but is in danger of eternal damnation:

\ln Nvdigalisdodisgei, gadaha adanvdo uyaa, unadvnvi.
\syll ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᎢ, ᎦᏓᎭ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᏯᎠ, ᎤᎾᏛᏅᎢ.
\ft Because they said, He hath an unclean spirit.

\ln Hnaquono gvwalutsele analinvtli, ale utsi, ale doyiditlv danidoge, unadanvse wigvwayanisgei.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎬᏩᎷᏤᎴ ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏟ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏥ, ᎠᎴ ᏙᏱᏗᏢ ᏓᏂᏙᎨ, ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏎ ᏫᎬᏩᏯᏂᏍᎨᎢ.
\ft There came then his brethren and his mother, and, standing without, sent unto him, calling him.

\ln Unitsatino anine gvwadatluwisdei; hiano nigvwaweselei, Gvniyuquo, tsatsi ale itsalinvtli doyiditlv digetsayoha.
\syll ᎤᏂᏣᏘᏃ ᎠᏂᏁ ᎬᏩᏓᏡᏫᏍᏕᎢ; ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᎬᏩᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎬᏂᏳᏉ, ᏣᏥ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏣᎵᏅᏟ ᏙᏱᏗᏢ ᏗᎨᏣᏲᎭ.
\ft And the multitude sat about him, and they said unto him, Behold, thy mother and thy brethren without seek for thee.

\ln Dunetseleno hia nuwesei, Gago etsi, ale otsalinvtli?
\syll ᏚᏁᏤᎴᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎦᎪ ᎡᏥ, ᎠᎴ ᎣᏣᎵᏅᏟ?
\ft And he answered them, saying, Who is my mother, or my brethren?

\ln Gvwaduwidvno dukahnanidolv uwolv nav anini dukananv hia nuwesei; Gvniyuquo etsi, ale otsalinvtli?
\syll ᎬᏩᏚᏫᏛᏃ ᏚᎧᎿᏂᏙᎸ ᎤᏬᎸ ᎾᎥ ᎠᏂᏂ ᏚᎧᎾᏅ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎡᏥ, ᎠᎴ ᎣᏣᎵᏅᏟ?
\ft And he looked round about on them which sat about him, and said, Behold my mother and my brethren!

\ln Giloyeno Unelanvhi udulisgv nadvnehesdi, nasgi tsosdadanvtli, ale vgido, ale etsi.
\syll ᎩᎶᏰᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎬ ᎾᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏦᏍᏓᏓᏅᏟ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᎩᏙ, ᎠᎴ ᎡᏥ.
\ft For whosoever shall do the will of God, the same is my brother, and my sister, and mother.

\ln Talineno ulenvhe dudeyone vdalulodi; unitsatino gvwadatluwistanei, nasgi iyusdi tsiyuhi utsanei, ale vdali atalv uwenei; nigadvno unitsati gesv vdalulodi doyi gesv anidonaei.
\syll ᏔᎵᏁᏃ ᎤᎴᏅᎮ ᏚᏕᏲᏁ ᎥᏓᎷᎶᏗ; ᎤᏂᏣᏘᏃ ᎬᏩᏓᏡᏫᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏥᏳᎯ ᎤᏣᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏓᎵ ᎠᏔᎸ ᎤᏪᏁᎢ; ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎨᏒ ᎥᏓᎷᎶᏗ ᏙᏱ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏂᏙᎾᎡᎢ.
\ft And he began again to teach by the sea side: and there was gathered unto him a great multitude, so that he entered into a ship, and sat in the sea; and the whole multitude was by the sea on the land.

\ln Ale utsate tsudalenvdv duweyone dutlilosdanelei, ale hia niduwesele dadeyohvsgvi,
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎤᏣᏖ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏚᏪᏲᏁ ᏚᏟᎶᏍᏓᏁᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴ ᏓᏕᏲᎲᏍᎬᎢ,
\ft And he taught them many things by parables, and said unto them in his doctrine,

\ln Itsadvdasda; Gvniyuquo, awisgi uwisvsei;
\syll ᎢᏣᏛᏓᏍᏓ; ᎬᏂᏳᏉ, ᎠᏫᏍᎩ ᎤᏫᏒᏎᎢ;
\ft Hearken; Behold, there went out a sower to sow:

\ln Hiano nulistane awisgvi, nasgi igadv nvnohulodi ulageyadvtsei, tsisquano galvloi aninohiidohi unilutse ale unigonei.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁ ᎠᏫᏍᎬᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎦᏛ ᏅᏃᎱᎶᏗ ᎤᎳᎨᏯᏛᏤᎢ, ᏥᏍᏆᏃ ᎦᎸᎶᎢ ᎠᏂᏃᎯᎢᏙᎯ ᎤᏂᎷᏤ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᎪᏁᎢ.
\ft And it came to pass, as he sowed, some fell by the way side, and the fowls of the air came and devoured it up.

\ln Igadvno nvyohi gesv ulageyadvtsei, nahna gayoliyu gesv gada; ale gilaquo iyvdv diuliyenei, nvdigalisdodisge sageiyu gesv gada;
\syll ᎢᎦᏛᏃ ᏅᏲᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎳᎨᏯᏛᏤᎢ, ᏀᎾ ᎦᏲᎵᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎦᏓ; ᎠᎴ ᎩᎳᏉ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏗᎤᎵᏰᏁᎢ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨ ᏌᎨᎢᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎦᏓ;
\ft And some fell on stony ground, where it had not much earth; and immediately it sprang up, because it had no depth of earth:

\ln Aseno nvdo igaehi tsukalvtsv uleyvsei; ale niduhnasdetlvna gesv iyusdi, uhnasgvtsequo.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᏅᏙ ᎢᎦᎡᎯ ᏧᎧᎸᏨ ᎤᎴᏴᏎᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᏂᏚᎿᏍᏕᏢᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᎤᎿᏍᎬᏤᏉ.
\ft But when the sun was up, it was scorched; and because it had no root, it withered away.

\ln Igadvno anugalvhi ulageyadvtsei; anugalvno tsudvsei, ale unenulastanei, ale nunanugowisvna gese ugata.
\syll ᎢᎦᏛᏃ ᎠᏄᎦᎸᎯ ᎤᎳᎨᏯᏛᏤᎢ; ᎠᏄᎦᎸᏃ ᏧᏛᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᏄᎳᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏄᎾᏄᎪᏫᏒᎾ ᎨᏎ ᎤᎦᏔ.
\ft And some fell among thorns, and the thorns grew up, and choked it, and it yielded no fruit.

\ln Igadvno osv gadohi ulageyadvtsei, ale uliyenei, ale advsgei, ale kanequogei, ale ugatatanei, igadv tsoasgohi iyuwagudi, igadvno sudalisgohi, igadvno asgohitsuqui.
\syll ᎢᎦᏛᏃ ᎣᏒ ᎦᏙᎯ ᎤᎳᎨᏯᏛᏤᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏰᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏛᏍᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎧᏁᏉᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎦᏔᏔᏁᎢ, ᎢᎦᏛ ᏦᎠᏍᎪᎯ ᎢᏳᏩᎫᏗ, ᎢᎦᏛᏃ ᏑᏓᎵᏍᎪᎯ, ᎢᎦᏛᏃ ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏧᏈ.
\ft And other fell on good ground, and did yield fruit that sprang up and increased; and brought forth, some thirty, and some sixty, and some an hundred.

\ln Hiano niduweselei, gilo degalilugesdi udvgodiyi, wadvgvga.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎩᎶ ᏕᎦᎵᎷᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᏛᎪᏗᏱ, ᏩᏛᎬᎦ.
\ft And he said unto them, He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.

\ln Uwasvno gesei, nasgi gvwasdawadidegi ale taladu iyanidv gvwadvdvne gadvgv nasgi datlilosdvi.
\syll ᎤᏩᏒᏃ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏕᎩ ᎠᎴ ᏔᎳᏚ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᎬᏩᏛᏛᏁ ᎦᏛᎬ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏓᏟᎶᏍᏛᎢ.
\ft And when he was alone, they that were about him with the twelve asked of him the parable.

\ln Hiano niduweselei.  Nihi etsinelv itsolisdiyi udelidv gesv Unelanvhi ugvwiyuhi gesvi; nasgini doyiditlv anedohi hia nasgi nigadv degegatlilosdanehoi;
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ.  ᏂᎯ ᎡᏥᏁᎸ ᎢᏦᎵᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩᏂ ᏙᏱᏗᏢ ᎠᏁᏙᎯ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏕᎨᎦᏟᎶᏍᏓᏁᎰᎢ;
\ft And he said unto them, Unto you it is given to know the mystery of the kingdom of God: but unto them that are without, all these things are done in parables:

\ln Nasgi anigowadisgv unigowadvdiyi, ale gvwanadolehohisdi nigesvna iyulisdodiyi; ale anadvgisgv unadvgodiyi, ale gvwanolisdi nigesvna iyulisdodiyi; nasgi tsunadanetliyvediyi nigesvna dunadanvdv, ale unisganvtsv gagetsinediyi nigesvna.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏂᎪᏩᏗᏍᎬ ᎤᏂᎪᏩᏛᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᎾᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ; ᎠᎴ ᎠᎾᏛᎩᏍᎬ ᎤᎾᏛᎪᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᏃᎵᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᎾᏓᏁᏟᏴᎡᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏚᎾᏓᏅᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᎦᎨᏥᏁᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.
\ft That seeing they may see, and not perceive; and hearing they may hear, and not understand; lest at any time they should be converted, and their sins should be forgiven them.

\ln Ale hia niduweselei, Tlasgo yitsoliga hia nasgi datlilosdvi?  Gadono yigalisdoda yidetsoligi nigadv datlilosdvi?
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏝᏍᎪ ᏱᏦᎵᎦ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏓᏟᎶᏍᏛᎢ?  ᎦᏙᏃ ᏱᎦᎵᏍᏙᏓ ᏱᏕᏦᎵᎩ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏓᏟᎶᏍᏛᎢ?
\ft And he said unto them, Know ye not this parable? and how then will ye know all parables?

\ln Nasgi awisgi kanohedv awisgoi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏫᏍᎩ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎠᏫᏍᎪᎢ.
\ft The sower soweth the word.

\ln Hiano nasgi nvnohulodi nahna kanohedv tsigetsiwiselei; hnaquono anadvgvga, Asgina galugo gilaquo iyvdv, ale agisgo kanohedv tsuninawiyi awisvhi.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏃᎱᎶᏗ ᏀᎾ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏥᎨᏥᏫᏎᎴᎢ; ᎿᏉᏃ ᎠᎾᏛᎬᎦ, ᎠᏍᎩᎾ ᎦᎷᎪ ᎩᎳᏉ ᎢᏴᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎩᏍᎪ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏧᏂᎾᏫᏱ ᎠᏫᏒᎯ.
\ft And these are they by the way side, where the word is sown; but when they have heard, Satan cometh immediately, and taketh away the word that was sown in their hearts.

\ln Hiano nasgi nasquo nvyohi tsigetsiwiselei; nasgi hnaquo kanohedv anadvgvga gilaquo iyvdv unalihelitsvhi danadanilvgoi;
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏅᏲᎯ ᏥᎨᏥᏫᏎᎴᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎿᏉ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎠᎾᏛᎬᎦ ᎩᎳᏉ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎤᎾᎵᎮᎵᏨᎯ ᏓᎾᏓᏂᎸᎪᎢ;
\ft And these are they likewise which are sown on stony ground; who, when they have heard the word, immediately receive it with gladness;

\ln Ale vtla yidunihnasdetloi, tlegaquosgini danikahnawadegoi; hnaquono, agiliya ale udeyadodi aliyeiloga kanohedv dvliyeilvsda, gilaquo iyvdv dunodehihoi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏚᏂᎿᏍᏕᏠᎢ, ᏞᎦᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᏓᏂᎧᎿᏩᏕᎪᎢ; ᎿᏉᏃ, ᎠᎩᎵᏯ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏕᏯᏙᏗ ᎠᎵᏰᎢᎶᎦ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏛᎵᏰᎢᎸᏍᏓ, ᎩᎳᏉ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏚᏃᏕᎯᎰᎢ.
\ft And have no root in themselves, and so endure but for a time: afterward, when affliction or persecution ariseth for the word's sake, immediately they are offended.

\ln Ale hia anugalvhi tsigetsiwiselei; nasgi hia kanohedv tsanadvgisgoi,
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏄᎦᎸᎯ ᏥᎨᏥᏫᏎᎴᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏣᎾᏛᎩᏍᎪᎢ,
\ft And these are they which are sown among thorns; such as hear the word,

\ln Uwelihisdino elohi ehi, ale genvisdi gesv udalidasdi gesvi, ale tsudalenvdv gohusdi adulvdi gesv, aniyvhihv aninenulasdisgo kanohedv, ale nasgi nagatadvsgvnaquo gesoi.
\syll ᎤᏪᎵᎯᏍᏗᏃ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎡᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎨᏅᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏓᎵᏓᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎠᏚᎸᏗ ᎨᏒ, ᎠᏂᏴᎯᎲ ᎠᏂᏁᏄᎳᏍᏗᏍᎪ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᎦᏔᏛᏍᎬᎾᏉ ᎨᏐᎢ.
\ft And the cares of this world, and the deceitfulness of riches, and the lusts of other things entering in, choke the word, and it becometh unfruitful.

\ln Hiano nasgi osv gadohi tsigetsiwiselei; nasgi anadvgisgi kanohedv, ale dinadanilvgi, ale anigatadvsgi, igadv tsoasgohi iyuwagudi, igadvno sudalasgohi, igadvno asgohitsuqui.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏒ ᎦᏙᎯ ᏥᎨᏥᏫᏎᎴᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎾᏛᎩᏍᎩ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎾᏓᏂᎸᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᏛᏍᎩ, ᎢᎦᏛ ᏦᎠᏍᎪᎯ ᎢᏳᏩᎫᏗ, ᎢᎦᏛᏃ ᏑᏓᎳᏍᎪᎯ, ᎢᎦᏛᏃ ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏧᏈ.
\ft And these are they which are sown on good ground; such as hear the word, and receive it, and bring forth fruit, some thirtyfold, some sixty, and some an hundred.

\ln Hiano niduweselei, Atsvsdodisgo aninohiho atlilosdi gakahv hawiniditlv unigodiyi, ale ganitlvwiquo?  Vtlano unigodiyi atsvsdodi gagodiyi?
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎠᏨᏍᏙᏗᏍᎪ ᎠᏂᏃᎯᎰ ᎠᏟᎶᏍᏗ ᎦᎧᎲ ᎭᏫᏂᏗᏢ ᎤᏂᎪᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᏂᏢᏫᏉ?  ᎥᏝᏃ ᎤᏂᎪᏗᏱ ᎠᏨᏍᏙᏗ ᎦᎪᏗᏱ?
\ft And he said unto them, Is a candle brought to be put under a bushel, or under a bed? and not to be set on a candlestick?

\ln Vtlayeno gohusdi yigvsgala nasgi gvnigesv igvnedi nigesvna; vtla ale gohusdi udelidv yinigvno, nasgi ase gvnigesv iyulisdodi nigesvna.
\syll ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏱᎬᏍᎦᎳ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᎬᏁᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ; ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᏱᏂᎬᏃ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏎ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.
\ft For there is nothing hid, which shall not be manifested; neither was any thing kept secret, but that it should come abroad.

\ln Gilo degalilugesdi udvgodiyi wadvgvga.
\syll ᎩᎶ ᏕᎦᎵᎷᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᏛᎪᏗᏱ ᏩᏛᎬᎦ.
\ft If any man have ears to hear, let him hear.

\ln Hiano niduweselei, Itseyatahesdi nusdv itsadvgisgvi; nusdv itsadatlilosvhv, nasgiya etsalinaloedi gesesdi; nihino itsadvgisgi etsinequoedi etsinedi gesesdi.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎢᏤᏯᏔᎮᏍᏗ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎢᏣᏛᎩᏍᎬᎢ; ᏄᏍᏛ ᎢᏣᏓᏟᎶᏒᎲ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎡᏣᎵᎾᎶᎡᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᏂᎯᏃ ᎢᏣᏛᎩᏍᎩ ᎡᏥᏁᏉᎡᏗ ᎡᏥᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft And he said unto them, Take heed what ye hear: with what measure ye mete, it shall be measured to you: and unto you that hear shall more be given.

\ln Giloyeno uhesdi, nasgi atsinedi gesesdi; gilono nuhvna gesesdi, nasgi atsigisvdi gesesdi nasquo uhvi.
\syll ᎩᎶᏰᏃ ᎤᎮᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏥᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᎩᎶᏃ ᏄᎲᎾ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏥᎩᏒᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᎲᎢ.
\ft For he that hath, to him shall be given: and he that hath not, from him shall be taken even that which he hath.

\ln Hiano nuwesei, Unelanvhi ugvwiyuhi gesv nasgiyaquo gilo asgaya ugata yuwisv gadohi;
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᏉ ᎩᎶ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᎦᏔ ᏳᏫᏒ ᎦᏙᎯ;
\ft And he said, So is the kingdom of God, as if a man should cast seed into the ground;

\ln Ale yulvnv, ale yadidiha digvwagitsvdi, ale ugata yuliyenv, ale yudvsv, nulisdotanv nudolehosvna.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏳᎸᏅ, ᎠᎴ ᏯᏗᏗᎭ ᏗᎬᏩᎩᏨᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎦᏔ ᏳᎵᏰᏅ, ᎠᎴ ᏳᏛᏒ, ᏄᎵᏍᏙᏔᏅ ᏄᏙᎴᎰᏒᎾ.
\ft And should sleep, and rise night and day, and the seed should spring and grow up, he knoweth not how.

\ln Gadohiyeno uwasvquo gananugowisgo ugatatanvhi; igvyiyi gesv ugalogv, hnaquono usgudadvi, onino ukalitsvhi ugatadv usgudadvi.
\syll ᎦᏙᎯᏰᏃ ᎤᏩᏒᏉ ᎦᎾᏄᎪᏫᏍᎪ ᎤᎦᏔᏔᏅᎯ; ᎢᎬᏱᏱ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎦᎶᎬ, ᎿᏉᏃ ᎤᏍᎫᏓᏛᎢ, ᎣᏂᏃ ᎤᎧᎵᏨᎯ ᎤᎦᏔᏛ ᎤᏍᎫᏓᏛᎢ.
\ft For the earth bringeth forth fruit of herself; first the blade, then the ear, after that the full corn in the ear.

\ln Hnaquono agadvnagi gilaquo iyvdv asgudesgoi, asgudesdiyiyeno uliyeiloloi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎠᎦᏛᎾᎩ ᎩᎳᏉ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎠᏍᎫᏕᏍᎪᎢ, ᎠᏍᎫᏕᏍᏗᏱᏰᏃ ᎤᎵᏰᎢᎶᎶᎢ.
\ft But when the fruit is brought forth, immediately he putteth in the sickle, because the harvest is come.

\ln Hiano nuwesei, Gado dodadatselastani Unelanvhi ugvwiyuhi gesvi?  Gadoge datlilosdv dodadatlilostani?
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎦᏙ ᏙᏓᏓᏤᎳᏍᏔᏂ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ?  ᎦᏙᎨ ᏓᏟᎶᏍᏛ ᏙᏓᏓᏟᎶᏍᏔᏂ?
\ft And he said, Whereunto shall we liken the kingdom of God? or with what comparison shall we compare it?

\ln Atsilvugata nasgiyai, nasgi gadohi tsawisoi, tsiwudagonadvdi usdigiyu esgaquo nigav ugata gadohi dahadvi.
\syll ᎠᏥᎸᎤᎦᏔ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏙᎯ ᏣᏫᏐᎢ, ᏥᏭᏓᎪᎾᏛᏗ ᎤᏍᏗᎩᏳ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎤᎦᏔ ᎦᏙᎯ ᏓᎭᏛᎢ.
\ft It is like a grain of mustard seed, which, when it is sown in the earth, is less than all the seeds that be in the earth:

\ln Aseno awisvhi tsigesoi, didvsgoi, ale utli equohiyu nigalisdisgo esgaquo nigav uyehnavi, ale tsequohiyu dayitlvsgoi; ale tsisqua udlanvdv aninohilidohi yeliquo udawadisdv hawiniditlv anahadisgoi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᏫᏒᎯ ᏥᎨᏐᎢ, ᏗᏛᏍᎪᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏟ ᎡᏉᎯᏳ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᏍᎪ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎤᏰᎿᎥᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏤᏉᎯᏳ ᏓᏱᏢᏍᎪᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᏥᏍᏆ ᎤᏜᏅᏛ ᎠᏂᏃᎯᎵᏙᎯ ᏰᎵᏉ ᎤᏓᏩᏗᏍᏛ ᎭᏫᏂᏗᏢ ᎠᏀᎠᏗᏍᎪᎢ.
\ft But when it is sown, it groweth up, and becometh greater than all herbs, and shooteth out great branches; so that the fowls of the air may lodge under the shadow of it.

\ln Nasgi nuwese utsate dutlilosdanelei, kanohedv dulitsidonelei, nasgi yeli gvwanadvgodi nigalisdisgvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏪᏎ ᎤᏣᏖ ᏚᏟᎶᏍᏓᏁᎴᎢ, ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏚᎵᏥᏙᏁᎴᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏰᎵ ᎬᏩᎾᏛᎪᏗ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ.
\ft And with many such parables spake he the word unto them, as they were able to hear it.

\ln Nidatlilosdanehvnasgini vtla yiduwonetanei; unvsvno gesei, nigadv nasgi duwosisanele gvwasdawadidohi.

\ft And Jesus went with him; and much people followed him, and thronged him.

\ln Gilono iyusdi ageyv taladu tsudetiyvdv gvwadalenvdv gigv uwenvehei,
\syll ᎩᎶᏃ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᎨᏴ ᏔᎳᏚ ᏧᏕᏘᏴᏛ ᎬᏩᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎩᎬ ᎤᏪᏅᎡᎮᎢ,
\ft And a certain woman, which had an issue of blood twelve years,

\ln Ale anigodiyu aniganagati utsati gvwagilvnvhi gesei, ale gohusdi uhv nigadv usvnvhi gese aguyisgvi, aseno vtla osiyu yinulisdanehei, kanequogequosgini utlvgvi;
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᎪᏗᏳ ᎠᏂᎦᎾᎦᏘ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎬᏩᎩᎸᏅᎯ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᎲ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎤᏒᏅᎯ ᎨᏎ ᎠᎫᏱᏍᎬᎢ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎣᏏᏳ ᏱᏄᎵᏍᏓᏁᎮᎢ, ᎧᏁᏉᎨᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏢᎬᎢ;
\ft And had suffered many things of many physicians, and had spent all that she had, and was nothing bettered, but rather grew worse,

\ln Nasgi udvganv Tsisa atsinohesgvi, oniditlv unvtidv nunadvnv uluhistane, ale usvnile unuwvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏛᎦᏅ ᏥᏌ ᎠᏥᏃᎮᏍᎬᎢ, ᎣᏂᏗᏢ ᎤᏅᏘᏛ ᏄᎾᏛᏅ ᎤᎷᎯᏍᏔᏁ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏒᏂᎴ ᎤᏄᏮᎢ.
\ft When she had heard of Jesus, came in the press behind, and touched his garment.

\ln Hiayeno nuwesei, Tsunuwoquo nasquo yidaquasvnilv, yaquadiwi.
\syll ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᏧᏄᏬᏉ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏱᏓᏆᏒᏂᎸ, ᏯᏆᏗᏫ.
\ft For she said, If I may touch but his clothes, I shall be whole.

\ln Gilaquono iyvdv gigv uwenvehv uyohistanei; udolehoseno ayelv udiwasv nasgi utlvgvi.
\syll ᎩᎳᏉᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎩᎬ ᎤᏪᏅᎡᎲ ᎤᏲᎯᏍᏔᏁᎢ; ᎤᏙᎴᎰᏎᏃ ᎠᏰᎸ ᎤᏗᏩᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏢᎬᎢ.
\ft And straightway the fountain of her blood was dried up; and she felt in her body that she was healed of that plague.

\ln Tsisano gilaquo iyvdv udolehosv uwasv gesv udanvwodi gesv unugotsvi, ugatahvse nahna unvtidv anidonavi, ale hia nuwesei, Gago dasvniga diquanuwo?
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᎩᎳᏉ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎤᏙᎴᎰᏒ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏓᏅᏬᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏄᎪᏨᎢ, ᎤᎦᏔᎲᏎ ᏀᎾ ᎤᏅᏘᏛ ᎠᏂᏙᎾᎥᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎦᎪ ᏓᏒᏂᎦ ᏗᏆᏄᏬ?
\ft And Jesus, immediately knowing in himself that virtue had gone out of him, turned him about in the press, and said, Who touched my clothes?

\ln Gvwasdawadidohino hia nigvwaweselei, Degigowadiha unitsati getsanenulasdisgv, tsigono Gago aquasvniga ihadiha?
\syll ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏩᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏕᎩᎪᏩᏗᎭ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎨᏣᏁᏄᎳᏍᏗᏍᎬ, ᏥᎪᏃ ᎦᎪ ᎠᏆᏒᏂᎦ ᎢᎭᏗᎭ?
\ft And his disciples said unto him, Thou seest the multitude thronging thee, and sayest thou, Who touched me?

\ln Gvwaduwidvno ugatenole ugowadvdiyi nasgi hia iyudvnelvhi.
\syll ᎬᏩᏚᏫᏛᏃ ᎤᎦᏖᏃᎴ ᎤᎪᏩᏛᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎢᏳᏛᏁᎸᎯ.
\ft And he looked round about to see her that had done this thing.

\ln Nasgino ageyv asgaihe ale uwenawisgei, agatahe nulisdanelvi, ulutse ale eladi udanvnelei, ale nigadv duyugodv unonelei.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎠᎨᏴ ᎠᏍᎦᎢᎮ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏪᎾᏫᏍᎨᎢ, ᎠᎦᏔᎮ ᏄᎵᏍᏓᏁᎸᎢ, ᎤᎷᏤ ᎠᎴ ᎡᎳᏗ ᎤᏓᏅᏁᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎤᏃᏁᎴᎢ.
\ft But the woman fearing and trembling, knowing what was done in her, came and fell down before him, and told him all the truth.

\ln Hiano nuweselei, Aquetsi, tsohiyusv tsadiwisda; nvwadohiyadv tsihena, ale tsadiwasvhi gesesdi tsatlvgvi.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎠᏇᏥ, ᏦᎯᏳᏒ ᏣᏗᏫᏍᏓ; ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᏥᎮᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᏣᏗᏩᏒᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏣᏢᎬᎢ.
\ft And he said unto her, Daughter, thy faith hath made thee whole; go in peace, and be whole of thy plague.

\ln Asiquo kanegei, nugvwiyusadegi digalawiisdiyi ganelv nvdayunadalenvhi unilutse hia nuniwesei, Uyohusv tsetsi; gadono asiquo ihiyadeyadodiha dideyohvsgi?
\syll ᎠᏏᏉ ᎧᏁᎨᎢ, ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎦᏁᎸ ᏅᏓᏳᎾᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᎤᏂᎷᏤ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ, ᎤᏲᎱᏒ ᏤᏥ; ᎦᏙᏃ ᎠᏏᏉ ᎢᎯᏯᏕᏯᏙᏗᎭ ᏗᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ?
\ft While he yet spake, there came from the ruler of the synagogue's house certain which said, Thy daughter is dead: why troublest thou the Master any further?

\ln Udvganvquono Tsisa nusdv uniwonisvi, hia nuwesele nugvwiyusadegi digalawiisdiyi, Tlesdi yisgaihesdi, tsohiyusesdiquo.
\syll ᎤᏛᎦᏅᏉᏃ ᏥᏌ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎤᏂᏬᏂᏒᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏍᎦᎢᎮᏍᏗ, ᏦᎯᏳᏎᏍᏗᏉ.
\ft As soon as Jesus heard the word that was spoken, he saith unto the ruler of the synagogue, Be not afraid, only believe.

\ln Vtla ale gilo yulisgolvdanele gvwasdawadvsdiyi, Quida, ale Tsimi, ale Tsani Tsimi dinadanvtli unvsv.
\syll ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᏳᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᎴ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏛᏍᏗᏱ, ᏈᏓ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᎻ, ᎠᎴ ᏣᏂ ᏥᎻ ᏗᎾᏓᏅᏟ ᎤᏅᏒ.
\ft And he suffered no man to follow him, save Peter, and James, and John the brother of James.

\ln Ulutseno ganelv nugvwiyusadegi digalawiisdiyi, ale dugahe unadasuyedv yvwi, ale utsati danatloyihv ale daniyvgvi.
\syll ᎤᎷᏤᏃ ᎦᏁᎸ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᎦᎮ ᎤᎾᏓᏑᏰᏛ ᏴᏫ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏓᎾᏠᏱᎲ ᎠᎴ ᏓᏂᏴᎬᎢ.
\ft And he cometh to the house of the ruler of the synagogue, and seeth the tumult, and them that wept and wailed greatly.

\ln Uyelvno hia niduweselei, Gadono itsadanoyvlisdiha, ale dotsatloyiha?  Vtla yuyohusv ageyutsa, galihaquosgini.
\syll ᎤᏰᎸᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎦᏙᏃ ᎢᏣᏓᏃᏴᎵᏍᏗᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᏙᏣᏠᏱᎭ?  ᎥᏝ ᏳᏲᎱᏒ ᎠᎨᏳᏣ, ᎦᎵᎭᏉᏍᎩᏂ.
\ft And when he was come in, he saith unto them, Why make ye this ado, and weep? the damsel is not dead, but sleepeth.

\ln Igvwadotlvtanequono.  Nigadvno dunugowisonv, hia nasgi ageyutsa udoda ale utsi ale nasgi anehi dutinvse, ale wuyvle nahna ageyutsa disonvi.
\syll ᎢᎬᏩᏙᏢᏔᏁᏉᏃ.  ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᏚᏄᎪᏫᏐᏅ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎨᏳᏣ ᎤᏙᏓ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏥ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏁᎯ ᏚᏘᏅᏎ, ᎠᎴ ᏭᏴᎴ ᏀᎾ ᎠᎨᏳᏣ ᏗᏐᏅᎢ.
\ft And they laughed him to scorn. But when he had put them all out, he taketh the father and the mother of the damsel, and them that were with him, and entereth in where the damsel was lying.

\ln Uwoyanesvno ageyutsa, hia nuweselei, Talida Gumi; nasgi anetlvtanvhi hia nusdi gadvga; Higeyutsa, gvyoseha, Talehvga.
\syll ᎤᏬᏯᏁᏒᏃ ᎠᎨᏳᏣ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏔᎵᏓ ᎫᎻ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏁᏢᏔᏅᎯ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏍᏗ ᎦᏛᎦ; ᎯᎨᏳᏣ, ᎬᏲᏎᎭ, ᏔᎴᎲᎦ.
\ft And he took the damsel by the hand, and said unto her, Talitha cumi; which is, being interpreted, Damsel, I say unto thee, arise.

\ln Gilaquono iyvdv ageyutsa dulenei, ale uwedolei; taladuyeno iyudetiyvdv gesei.  Utsatanvhino unisquanigosei.
\syll ᎩᎳᏉᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎠᎨᏳᏣ ᏚᎴᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏪᏙᎴᎢ; ᏔᎳᏚᏰᏃ ᎢᏳᏕᏘᏴᏛ ᎨᏎᎢ.  ᎤᏣᏔᏅᎯᏃ ᎤᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏎᎢ.
\ft And straightway the damsel arose, and walked; for she was of the age of twelve years. And they were astonished with a great astonishment.

\ln Ulinigidvno dunetsele dunvsdadele gilo udolehohisdiyi nasgi; ale unetsegohusdi ulisdayvdi uninediyi.
\syll ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛᏃ ᏚᏁᏤᎴ ᏚᏅᏍᏓᏕᎴ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᏤᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗ ᎤᏂᏁᏗᏱ.
\ft And he charged them straitly that no man should know it; and commanded that something should be given her to eat.

\ln Unugotseno nahnani, ale uwasv utseligohi wulutsei; gvwasdawadidohino gvwasdawadvsei.
\syll ᎤᏄᎪᏤᏃ ᏀᎾᏂ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎤᏤᎵᎪᎯ ᏭᎷᏤᎢ; ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯᏃ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏛᏎᎢ.
\ft And he went out from thence, and came into his own country; and his disciples follow him.

\ln Unadodaquasgvno uliyelolv, ulenvhe dudeyone digalawiisdiyi; unitsatino gvwadvganelv unisquanigosei, hia naniwesgei, Hatlv agiha hia asgaya hia nasgi igvwadvnedi tsigi?  Ale gado usdi agadovhisdi nasgi atsinelvhi tsigi, nasgi iyusdi usquanigodi tsidulvwisdaneha?
\syll ᎤᎾᏙᏓᏆᏍᎬᏃ ᎤᎵᏰᎶᎸ, ᎤᎴᏅᎮ ᏚᏕᏲᏁ ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ; ᎤᏂᏣᏘᏃ ᎬᏩᏛᎦᏁᎸ ᎤᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏎᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏂᏪᏍᎨᎢ, ᎭᏢ ᎠᎩᎭ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎬᏩᏛᏁᏗ ᏥᎩ?  ᎠᎴ ᎦᏙ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎠᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏥᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᏥᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎭ?
\ft And when the sabbath day was come, he began to teach in the synagogue: and many hearing him were astonished, saying, From whence hath this man these things? and what wisdom is this which is given unto him, that even such mighty works are wrought by his hands?

\ln Tlasgo nasgi hia dinesgesgi yigi, Meli uwetsi, Tsimi, ale Tsosi, ale Tsuda, ale Sawani analinvtli?  Ale tsudo tlasgo ani yigegadasuya?  Vgvwasonvtselvgino.
\syll ᏝᏍᎪ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏗᏁᏍᎨᏍᎩ ᏱᎩ, ᎺᎵ ᎤᏪᏥ, ᏥᎻ, ᎠᎴ ᏦᏏ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏓ, ᎠᎴ ᏌᏩᏂ ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏟ?  ᎠᎴ ᏧᏙ ᏝᏍᎪ ᎠᏂ ᏱᎨᎦᏓᏑᏯ?  ᎥᎬᏩᏐᏅᏤᎸᎩᏃ.
\ft Is not this the carpenter, the son of Mary, the brother of James, and Joses, and of Juda, and Simon? and are not his sisters here with us? And they were offended at him.

\ln Tsisano hia niduweselei; adolehosgi vtla natsilvquodvna yigesoi, utseligohisgininonv uwasv, ale tsuyvwi anehvi, ale uwasv ganelvi.
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎥᏝ ᎾᏥᎸᏉᏛᎾ ᏱᎨᏐᎢ, ᎤᏤᎵᎪᎯᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎤᏩᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏴᏫ ᎠᏁᎲᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎦᏁᎸᎢ.
\ft But Jesus said unto them, A prophet is not without honour, but in his own country, and among his own kin, and in his own house.

\ln Ale nahna vtla gohusdi usquanigodi digvwalvwisdanedi yigesei, uwasvsgininonv ilvsgi iyanidv tsunitlvgi dusitadv ale dunvwanvi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏀᎾ ᎥᏝ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᏗᎬᏩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ, ᎤᏩᏒᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎢᎸᏍᎩ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᏧᏂᏢᎩ ᏚᏏᏔᏛ ᎠᎴ ᏚᏅᏩᏅᎢ.
\ft And he could there do no mighty work, save that he laid his hands upon a few sick folk, and healed them.

\ln Ale usquanigose nanohiyuhvsgvna gesvi.  Ale uwedole uduwidv degaduwadisvi dadeyohvsgei.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏎ ᎾᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎬᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.  ᎠᎴ ᎤᏪᏙᎴ ᎤᏚᏫᏛ ᏕᎦᏚᏩᏗᏒᎢ ᏓᏕᏲᎲᏍᎨᎢ.
\ft And he marvelled because of their unbelief. And he went round about the villages, teaching.

\ln Taladuno iyanidv widuyanvhei, ale dunvsidole taliha tsuligonvdv, ale dulisgolvdanele tsuninugowisdiyi digadaha didanvdo;
\syll ᏔᎳᏚᏃ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᏫᏚᏯᏅᎮᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏅᏏᏙᎴ ᏔᎵᎭ ᏧᎵᎪᏅᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᎴ ᏧᏂᏄᎪᏫᏍᏗᏱ ᏗᎦᏓᎭ ᏗᏓᏅᏙ;
\ft And he called unto him the twelve, and began to send them forth by two and two; and gave them power over unclean spirits;

\ln Ale dunetsele nasgi gohusdi uniyvsdiyi nigesvna unalisdelvdodi anedohvi, adolanvsdi uwasv; vtla degalodi, ale gadu, ale vtsayi dunadatlohvi;
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏚᏁᏤᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏂᏴᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ ᎠᏁᏙᎲᎢ, ᎠᏙᎳᏅᏍᏗ ᎤᏩᏒ; ᎥᏝ ᏕᎦᎶᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᏚ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏣᏱ ᏚᎾᏓᏠᎲᎢ;
\ft And commanded them that they should take nothing for their journey, save a staff only; no scrip, no bread, no money in their purse:

\ln Tsunalasulvdiyisgini; ale tlesdi tali yiditsanuwosgesdi.
\syll ᏧᎾᎳᏑᎸᏗᏱᏍᎩᏂ; ᎠᎴ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏔᎵ ᏱᏗᏣᏄᏬᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
\ft But be shod with sandals; and not put on two coats.

\ln Ale hia niduweselei, adanelv ilvhitlv itsiyvhihesdi, nahnaquo itsanvvsgesdi gvni vtsanigi nahnani.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎠᏓᏁᎸ ᎢᎸᎯᏢ ᎢᏥᏴᎯᎮᏍᏗ, ᏀᎾᏉ ᎢᏣᏅᎥᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎬᏂ ᎥᏣᏂᎩ ᏀᎾᏂ.
\ft And he said unto them, In what place soever ye enter into an house, there abide till ye depart from that place.

\ln Ale gilo niditsadanilvgvna ale nitsadvdasdanehvna igesesdi, hnaquo nahna itsanigisgesdi, ditsalasideni gosdu detsinvgovdisgesdi, nasgi gohiyudisgi unatludisgi.  Udohiyuhiya hia nitsvweseha, esgaquo igai unigiliyoisdi gesesdi Sodami, ale Gomali, digugododiyi iga gesesdi, utlihiyu nahna gaduhvi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᏂᏗᏣᏓᏂᎸᎬᎾ ᎠᎴ ᏂᏣᏛᏓᏍᏓᏁᎲᎾ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎿᏉ ᏀᎾ ᎢᏣᏂᎩᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᏗᏣᎳᏏᏕᏂ ᎪᏍᏚ ᏕᏥᏅᎪᎥᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᎯᏳᏗᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᏡᏗᏍᎩ.  ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ, ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎤᏂᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏐᏓᎻ, ᎠᎴ ᎪᎹᎵ, ᏗᎫᎪᏙᏗᏱ ᎢᎦ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎤᏟᎯᏳ ᏀᎾ ᎦᏚᎲᎢ.

\ln Uninugotseno, wunalitsidone nasgi yvwi ase tsuninetliyvsdi gesv dunadanvdvi.
\syll ᎤᏂᏄᎪᏤᏃ, ᏭᎾᎵᏥᏙᏁ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏴᏫ ᎠᏎ ᏧᏂᏁᏟᏴᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏚᎾᏓᏅᏛᎢ.

\ft Therefore Herodias had a quarrel against him, and would have killed him; but she could not:

\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎡᎶᏗᏏ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎠᏛ ᎤᏴᎵᎸ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏍᎩᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᎡᎶᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎠᏂᏂᏜᎢ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎤᏂᏰᎸᏅ, ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴ ᎠᏛ, ᏍᎩᏔᏲᏏ ᎢᏳᏍᏗᏉ ᎮᎵᏍᎬᎢ, ᏓᎬᏁᎵᏃ.

\syll ᎤᏄᎪᏨᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏫᏄᏪᏎᎴ ᎤᏥ, ᎦᏙ ᏓᏥᏔᏲᎵ?  ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏣᏂ ᏗᏓᏬᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᎪᎵ.

\syll ᎢᎬᏪᏅᏛᏉᏃ ᎤᎵᏍᏗ ᎤᏴᎵᎴ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᏯᎥᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏔᏲᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎠᏆᏚᎵ ᎩᎳᏉ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏍᎩᏁᏗᏱ, ᎠᏖᎵᏙᎩᎯ, ᏣᏂ ᏗᏓᏬᏍᎩ ᎤᏍᎪ.

\syll ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᏃ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏝᏉ ᎤᏰᎸᏁᎢ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏎᎵᏔᏅᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎤᎾᏂᏜᏅᎯ ᏅᏧᎵᏍᏙᏔᏁ, ᎥᏝ ᎬᏩᎨᏳᏙᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ.
