\ft Send them away, that they may go into the country round about, and into the villages, and buy themselves bread: for they have nothing to eat.

\ln Dunetseleno hia niduweselei, Nihi ditselasda.  Hiano nigvwaweselei, Tsigo dayotsesi talitsuqui anigisi tsugvwalodi gadu wvdayogiwasi, ale dodayotselastani?
\syll ᏚᏁᏤᎴᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏂᎯ ᏗᏤᎳᏍᏓ.  ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᎬᏩᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏥᎪ ᏓᏲᏤᏏ ᏔᎵᏧᏈ ᎠᏂᎩᏏ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎦᏚ ᏮᏓᏲᎩᏩᏏ, ᎠᎴ ᏙᏓᏲᏤᎳᏍᏔᏂ?
\ft He answered and said unto them, Give ye them to eat. And they say unto him, Shall we go and buy two hundred pennyworth of bread, and give them to eat?

\ln Hiano niduweselei, Ilago gadu detsiyeha?  Witsagata.  Unadolehosvno, hia nuhiwesei, Hisgi, talino atsadi.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎢᎳᎪ ᎦᏚ ᏕᏥᏰᎭ?  ᏫᏣᎦᏔ.  ᎤᎾᏙᎴᎰᏒᏃ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᎯᏪᏎᎢ, ᎯᏍᎩ, ᏔᎵᏃ ᎠᏣᏗ.
\ft He saith unto them, How many loaves have ye? go and see. And when they knew, they say, Five, and two fishes.

\ln Dunetseleno unanitlvdiyi nigadv itse kanesgohi gesv tsunadatlunvdv.
\syll ᏚᏁᏤᎴᏃ ᎤᎾᏂᏢᏗᏱ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎢᏤ ᎧᏁᏍᎪᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏧᎾᏓᏡᏅᏛ.
\ft And he commanded them to make all sit down by companies upon the green grass.

\ln Unanitlvneno osdv dunadanvhnanei asgohitsuqui, ale hisgasgohi tsunadatlunvdv.
\syll ᎤᎾᏂᏢᏁᏃ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏚᎾᏓᏅᎿᏁᎢ ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏧᏈ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᏍᎦᏍᎪᎯ ᏧᎾᏓᏡᏅᏛ.
\ft And they sat down in ranks, by hundreds, and by fifties.

\ln Hisgino gadu dugisv ale tali atsadi dunesv, galvladi widukahnanei, ale ulihelitsei, ale dugvhaluye gadu, ale gvwasdawadidohi dunele tsuninediyi; talino atsadi nigadv duyadohelei.
\syll ᎯᏍᎩᏃ ᎦᏚ ᏚᎩᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏔᎵ ᎠᏣᏗ ᏚᏁᏒ, ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏫᏚᎧᎿᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᎮᎵᏤᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᎬᎭᎷᏰ ᎦᏚ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏚᏁᎴ ᏧᏂᏁᏗᏱ; ᏔᎵᏃ ᎠᏣᏗ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏚᏯᏙᎮᎴᎢ.
\ft And when he had taken the five loaves and the two fishes, he looked up to heaven, and blessed, and brake the loaves, and gave them to his disciples to set before them; and the two fishes divided he among them all.

\ln Nigadvno unalisdayvnei; ale dunolvsei.
\syll ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᏁᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᏚᏃᎸᏎᎢ.
\ft And they did all eat, and were filled.

\ln Unuteseno uligvhaluyvhi taladu dikalii talutsa, ale nasquo atsadi.
\syll ᎤᏄᏖᏎᏃ ᎤᎵᎬᎭᎷᏴᎯ ᏔᎳᏚ ᏗᎧᎵᎢ ᏔᎷᏣ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏣᏗ.
\ft And they took up twelve baskets full of the fragments, and of the fishes.

\ln Nasgino na gadu tsunigvhi hisgi iyagayvli iyvdv nanie anisgaya.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ Ꮎ ᎦᏚ ᏧᏂᎬᎯ ᎯᏍᎩ ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎾᏂᎡ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ.
\ft And they that did eat of the loaves were about five thousand men.

\ln Gilaquono iyvdv dunvwistane gvwasdawadidohi tsiyuhi unatsodiyi, ale igvyi tsunisohisdiyi, Quetsayidi wuniluhisdiyi, asiquo uwasv dayelihisdisgv unitsati.
\syll ᎩᎳᏉᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏚᏅᏫᏍᏔᏁ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏥᏳᎯ ᎤᎾᏦᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᎬᏱ ᏧᏂᏐᎯᏍᏗᏱ, ᏇᏣᏱᏗ ᏭᏂᎷᎯᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᏏᏉ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏓᏰᎵᎯᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ.
\ft And straightway he constrained his disciples to get into the ship, and to go to the other side before unto Bethsaida, while he sent away the people.

\ln Duyelihistanvno, odalv wulose udadolistanvsei.
\syll ᏚᏰᎵᎯᏍᏔᏅᏃ, ᎣᏓᎸ ᏭᎶᏎ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏔᏅᏎᎢ.
\ft And when he had sent them away, he departed into a mountain to pray.

\ln Usvno nulistanv tsiyu vdali ayeli aninisei, uwasvno doyi edohei.
\syll ᎤᏒᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ ᏥᏳ ᎥᏓᎵ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎠᏂᏂᏎᎢ, ᎤᏩᏒᏃ ᏙᏱ ᎡᏙᎮᎢ.
\ft And when even was come, the ship was in the midst of the sea, and he alone on the land.

\ln Dugoheno anigiliyogv anigawehihvi; wanigadvno idisi diganolvdisgei.  Nvgineno iyvdv aniyawisgv svnoyi dulutselei, vdali gadui aisei, ale yidulohiselei.
\syll ᏚᎪᎮᏃ ᎠᏂᎩᎵᏲᎬ ᎠᏂᎦᏪᎯᎲᎢ; ᏩᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᎢᏗᏏ ᏗᎦᏃᎸᏗᏍᎨᎢ.  ᏅᎩᏁᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎠᏂᏯᏫᏍᎬ ᏒᏃᏱ ᏚᎷᏤᎴᎢ, ᎥᏓᎵ ᎦᏚᎢ ᎠᎢᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏱᏚᎶᎯᏎᎴᎢ.
\ft And he saw them toiling in rowing; for the wind was contrary unto them: and about the fourth watch of the night he cometh unto them, walking upon the sea, and would have passed by them.

\ln Aseno wigvwagohv vdali gadui aisvi, utselvnvhi unelisei, ale unelunei.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᏫᎬᏩᎪᎲ ᎥᏓᎵ ᎦᏚᎢ ᎠᎢᏒᎢ, ᎤᏤᎸᏅᎯ ᎤᏁᎵᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎷᏁᎢ.
\ft But when they saw him walking upon the sea, they supposed it had been a spirit, and cried out:

\ln (Nigadvyeno gvwagohei, ale unadeyatanelei.)  Gilaquono iyvdv dulinohetanei, ale hia niduweselei, Ugalisdiquo itsadanvdada; ayvquo; tlesdi yitsisgaihesdi.
\syll ᏂᎦᏛᏰᏃ ᎬᏩᎪᎮᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏕᏯᏔᏁᎴᎢ.  ᎩᎳᏉᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏚᎵᏃᎮᏔᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎤᎦᎵᏍᏗᏉ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏓᏓ; ᎠᏴᏉ; ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏥᏍᎦᎢᎮᏍᏗ.
\ft For they all saw him, and were troubled. And immediately he talked with them, and saith unto them, Be of good cheer: it is I; be not afraid.

\ln Ugilawiseno widutsanele tsiyuhi; ganolvvsgvno useligotsei; ale ulosvstanvhi unadanvtetane dotsunadanvdvi, ale unisquanigosei.
\syll ᎤᎩᎳᏫᏎᏃ ᏫᏚᏣᏁᎴ ᏥᏳᎯ; ᎦᏃᎸᎥᏍᎬᏃ ᎤᏎᎵᎪᏤᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᎶᏒᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏖᏔᏁ ᏙᏧᎾᏓᏅᏛᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏎᎢ.
\ft And he went up unto them into the ship; and the wind ceased: and they were sore amazed in themselves beyond measure, and wondered.

\ln Vtlayeno yidunadanvtele gadu; tsuninawiyeno disdayiyu gesei.
\syll ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᏱᏚᎾᏓᏅᏖᎴ ᎦᏚ; ᏧᏂᎾᏫᏰᏃ ᏗᏍᏓᏱᏳ ᎨᏎᎢ.
\ft For they considered not the miracle of the loaves: for their heart was hardened.

\ln Dunisotsvno, Genisiladi wunilutsei, ale unitaladei.
\syll ᏚᏂᏐᏨᏃ, ᎨᏂᏏᎳᏗ ᏭᏂᎷᏤᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏔᎳᏕᎢ.
\ft And when they had passed over, they came into the land of Gennesaret, and drew to the shore.

\ln Tsiyuhino unatsaisv gilaquo iyvdv gvwolitsei.
\syll ᏥᏳᎯᏃ ᎤᎾᏣᎢᏒ ᎩᎳᏉ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎬᏬᎵᏤᎢ.
\ft And when they were come out of the ship, straightway they knew him,

\ln Ale nahna gvwaduwidv unedolei, ale tsunitlvgi duninidole ditsesdogihi dunitlvde, widaninohihe anadvgvga nahna edohvi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏀᎾ ᎬᏩᏚᏫᏛ ᎤᏁᏙᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏂᏢᎩ ᏚᏂᏂᏙᎴ ᏗᏤᏍᏙᎩᎯ ᏚᏂᏢᏕ, ᏫᏓᏂᏃᎯᎮ ᎠᎾᏛᎬᎦ ᏀᎾ ᎡᏙᎲᎢ.
\ft And ran through that whole region round about, and began to carry about in beds those that were sick, where they heard he was.

\ln Ale ilvhitlv wigalugi, tsusdi degaduhv, ale tsudvna degaduhv, ale iyvdv didanelohi gesvi, tsunitlvgi degalanvdv daninvvsgei, ale gvwatayosehe unasvnisdiyi, gadaluyadvquo nasquo unuwvi; nanivno nasgi gvwasvnilvhi dunadiwasgei.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎢᎸᎯᏢ ᏫᎦᎷᎩ, ᏧᏍᏗ ᏕᎦᏚᎲ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏛᎾ ᏕᎦᏚᎲ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏗᏓᏁᎶᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏧᏂᏢᎩ ᏕᎦᎳᏅᏛ ᏓᏂᏅᎥᏍᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᏔᏲᏎᎮ ᎤᎾᏒᏂᏍᏗᏱ, ᎦᏓᎷᏯᏛᏉ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᏄᏮᎢ; ᎾᏂᎥᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏩᏒᏂᎸᎯ ᏚᎾᏗᏩᏍᎨᎢ.
\ft And whithersoever he entered, into villages, or cities, or country, they laid the sick in the streets, and besought him that they might touch if it were but the border of his garment: and as many as touched him were made whole.

\ln Degvwalawitsoleno Aniqualisi, ale gilo iyunasgi dinowelisgi, Tsilusilimi nvdayunilosvhi.
\syll ᏕᎬᏩᎳᏫᏦᎴᏃ ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏ, ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏃᏪᎵᏍᎩ, ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᏅᏓᏳᏂᎶᏒᎯ.
\ft Then came together unto him the Pharisees, and certain of the scribes, which came from Jerusalem.

\ln Dunigohvno igadv gvwasdawadidohi gadu anigisgv digadaha tsunoyeni gvdi, (nasgi nidunasulehvna gadvga,) unisonvtselei.
\syll ᏚᏂᎪᎲᏃ ᎢᎦᏛ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎦᏚ ᎠᏂᎩᏍᎬ ᏗᎦᏓᎭ ᏧᏃᏰᏂ ᎬᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᏚᎾᏑᎴᎲᎾ ᎦᏛᎦ, ᎤᏂᏐᏅᏤᎴᎢ.
\ft And when they saw some of his disciples eat bread with defiled, that is to say, with unwashen, hands, they found fault.

\ln Aniqualisiyeno, ale nanivquo Anitsusi, iyuno osdv nidunasulehvna yigi, vtla yinalisdayvhvsgoi, danikahnawadego nuniwesv eti unadenvhi.
\syll ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏᏰᏃ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏂᎥᏉ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏂᏚᎾᏑᎴᎲᎾ ᏱᎩ, ᎥᏝ ᏱᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎪᎢ, ᏓᏂᎧᎿᏩᏕᎪ ᏄᏂᏪᏒ ᎡᏘ ᎤᎾᏕᏅᎯ.
\ft For the Pharisees, and all the Jews, except they wash their hands oft, eat not, holding the tradition of the elders.

\ln Ale ganododiyi dvnilohi, iyuno nidunasulehvna yigi, vtla yvgvnalisdayvhvga.  Ale utsata nudale gohusdi tsunikahnawadvsdi nunvnelv, nasgi tsulisquidi diguhilovi ale ditelido, ale vtsayidigotlvtanvhi ditelido, ale dinitlvdiyi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎦᏃᏙᏗᏱ ᏛᏂᎶᎯ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᏂᏚᎾᏑᎴᎲᎾ ᏱᎩ, ᎥᏝ ᏴᎬᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᎦ.  ᎠᎴ ᎤᏣᏔ ᏄᏓᎴ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏧᏂᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏄᏅᏁᎸ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᎵᏍᏈᏗ ᏗᎫᎯᎶᎥᎢ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏖᎵᏙ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏣᏱᏗᎪᏢᏔᏅᎯ ᏗᏖᎵᏙ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏂᏢᏗᏱ.
\ft And when they come from the market, except they wash, they eat not. And many other things there be, which they have received to hold, as the washing of cups, and pots, brasen vessels, and of tables.

\ln Hnaquono Aniqualisi ale dinowelisgi igvwadvdvne hia nigvwaweselei; Gadono getsasdawadidohi vtla yidanikahnawadega eti unadenvhi uninetsvi, nasgi nidunasulehvnaquo tsanalisdayvhvsga?
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏃᏪᎵᏍᎩ ᎢᎬᏩᏛᏛᏁ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏩᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎦᏙᏃ ᎨᏣᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏓᏂᎧᎿᏩᏕᎦ ᎡᏘ ᎤᎾᏕᏅᎯ ᎤᏂᏁᏨᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᏚᎾᏑᎴᎲᎾᏉ ᏣᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎦ?
\ft Then the Pharisees and scribes asked him, Why walk not thy disciples according to the tradition of the elders, but eat bread with unwashen hands?

\ln Dunetselvno hia niduweselei, Isaya yeliquo nuwesv udolehosv nihi itsatlonasdi itsineisdisgvi, hia tsinigvnv tsigowela, Hia nasgi yvwi gvgilvquodiha dunihanegalv danvdiha, tsuninawisgini invhiyu nidunvhnadega ayv naquadvnvi.
\syll ᏚᏁᏤᎸᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎢᏌᏯ ᏰᎵᏉ ᏄᏪᏒ ᎤᏙᎴᎰᏒ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏣᏠᎾᏍᏗ ᎢᏥᏁᎢᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᎬᏅ ᏥᎪᏪᎳ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏴᏫ ᎬᎩᎸᏉᏗᎭ ᏚᏂᎭᏁᎦᎸ ᏓᏅᏗᎭ, ᏧᏂᎾᏫᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᏅᎯᏳ ᏂᏚᏅᎿᏕᎦ ᎠᏴ ᎾᏆᏛᏅᎢ.
\ft He answered and said unto them, Well hath Esaias prophesied of you hypocrites, as it is written, This people honoureth me with their lips, but their heart is far from me.

\ln Aseno, asequoquo gvgilvquodiha tsidanadeyohvsga danadeyohvsgv yvwiquo uninetsvhi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ, ᎠᏎᏉᏉ ᎬᎩᎸᏉᏗᎭ ᏥᏓᎾᏕᏲᎲᏍᎦ ᏓᎾᏕᏲᎲᏍᎬ ᏴᏫᏉ ᎤᏂᏁᏨᎯ.
\ft Howbeit in vain do they worship me, teaching for doctrines the commandments of men.

\ln Iyvdvyeno nitsvne Unelanvhi unetsvhi, yvwi uninetsv dikahnawadvsdi nitsvneha, nasgi ditelido ale tsulisquidi diguhilovi; ale utsata nudaleha nasgiya utloyi detsilvwisdanehoi.
\syll ᎢᏴᏛᏰᏃ ᏂᏨᏁ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏁᏨᎯ, ᏴᏫ ᎤᏂᏁᏨ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏂᏨᏁᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏖᎵᏙ ᎠᎴ ᏧᎵᏍᏈᏗ ᏗᎫᎯᎶᎥᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᏣᏔ ᏄᏓᎴᎭ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎤᏠᏱ ᏕᏥᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎰᎢ.
\ft For laying aside the commandment of God, ye hold the tradition of men, as the washing of pots and cups: and many other such like things ye do.

\ln Ale hia niduweselei, osiquo nitsadvneha tsitsiyoiseha Unelanvhi unetsv, nasgi itsatseli dikahnawadvsdi itsisquanigododiyi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎣᏏᏉ ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎭ ᏥᏥᏲᎢᏎᎭ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏁᏨ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏣᏤᎵ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎢᏥᏍᏆᏂᎪᏙᏗᏱ.
\ft And he said unto them, Full well ye reject the commandment of God, that ye may keep your own tradition.

\ln Mosiyeno hia nuwesei, Hilvquodesdi tsadoda ale tsatsi; ale, Gilo asgi nvdisgesdi udoda ale utsi, ase uyohuhisdi gesesdi.
\syll ᎼᏏᏰᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎯᎸᏉᏕᏍᏗ ᏣᏙᏓ ᎠᎴ ᏣᏥ; ᎠᎴ, ᎩᎶ ᎠᏍᎩ ᏅᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᏙᏓ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏥ, ᎠᏎ ᎤᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft For Moses said, Honour thy father and thy mother; and, Whoso curseth father or mother, let him die the death:

\ln Nihisgini hia nitsiweha, Iyuno gilo hia nigawesehesdi udoda ale utsi, Goquani, (nasgi gadvgv, aqualisgolvtanvhi,) nigav getsalisdelvdodi gesv ayv gvsdelisgvi; [nasgi ududaledv gesesdi.]

\ft And his disciples answered him, From whence can a man satisfy these men with bread here in the wilderness?

\ln Dudvdvneno hia nuwesei; Ilago gadu detsiyeha?  Hiano nuniwesei, Galiquogi.
\syll ᏚᏛᏛᏁᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎢᎳᎪ ᎦᏚ ᏕᏥᏰᎭ?  ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ, ᎦᎵᏉᎩ.
\ft And he asked them, How many loaves have ye? And they said, Seven.

\ln Dunetseleno unitsati gadohi unanitlvdiyi; galiquogino gadu dugisv, ale ulihelitsv, dugvhaluyei, ale gvwasdawadidohi dunele nasgi igvyiditlv tsuninediyi; igvyiditlvno duninele unitsati yvwi.
\syll ᏚᏁᏤᎴᏃ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎦᏙᎯ ᎤᎾᏂᏢᏗᏱ; ᎦᎵᏉᎩᏃ ᎦᏚ ᏚᎩᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᎮᎵᏨ, ᏚᎬᎭᎷᏰᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏚᏁᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎬᏱᏗᏢ ᏧᏂᏁᏗᏱ; ᎢᎬᏱᏗᏢᏃ ᏚᏂᏁᎴ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏴᏫ.
\ft And he commanded the people to sit down on the ground: and he took the seven loaves, and gave thanks, and brake, and gave to his disciples to set before them; and they did set them before the people.

\ln Ale ilvsgi tsunasdi atsadi daninehei, ulihelitsvno unetse nasgi nasquo igvyiditlv tsuninvdiyi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎢᎸᏍᎩ ᏧᎾᏍᏗ ᎠᏣᏗ ᏓᏂᏁᎮᎢ, ᎤᎵᎮᎵᏨᏃ ᎤᏁᏤ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎢᎬᏱᏗᏢ ᏧᏂᏅᏗᏱ.
\ft And they had a few small fishes: and he blessed, and commanded to set them also before them.

\ln Unalisdayvneno, ale dunolvsei; unuteseno uligvhaluyvhi utiyvhi galiquogi iyakalii talutsa.
\syll ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᏁᏃ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏃᎸᏎᎢ; ᎤᏄᏖᏎᏃ ᎤᎵᎬᎭᎷᏴᎯ ᎤᏘᏴᎯ ᎦᎵᏉᎩ ᎢᏯᎧᎵᎢ ᏔᎷᏣ.
\ft So they did eat, and were filled: and they took up of the broken meat that was left seven baskets.

\ln Unalisdayvnvhino nvgi iyagayvli iyvdv naniei; duyelihistaneno.
\syll ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᏅᎯᏃ ᏅᎩ ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎾᏂᎡᎢ; ᏚᏰᎵᎯᏍᏔᏁᏃ.
\ft And they that had eaten were about four thousand: and he sent them away.

\ln Igvwenvdvno tsiyuhi utsane anehe gvwasdawadidohi, ale Daliminuda asdv wulutsei.
\syll ᎢᎬᏪᏅᏛᏃ ᏥᏳᎯ ᎤᏣᏁ ᎠᏁᎮ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᎵᎻᏄᏓ ᎠᏍᏛ ᏭᎷᏤᎢ.
\ft And straightway he entered into a ship with his disciples, and came into the parts of Dalmanutha.

\ln Aniqualisino unilutse ale unalenvhe gvwadvdvhelvnei, gvwatayosele tsunanugowisediyi uyelvdv galvladi nvdayulosvhi, gvwagoliyesgei.
\syll ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏᏃ ᎤᏂᎷᏤ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᎴᏅᎮ ᎬᏩᏛᏛᎮᎸᏁᎢ, ᎬᏩᏔᏲᏎᎴ ᏧᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᏗᏱ ᎤᏰᎸᏛ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏅᏓᏳᎶᏒᎯ, ᎬᏩᎪᎵᏰᏍᎨᎢ.
\ft And the Pharisees came forth, and began to question with him, seeking of him a sign from heaven, tempting him.

\ln Udanvdogihino hawini uliyetanei, ale hia nuwesei, Gadono gohi hia tsaneha uyelvdv uniyoha?  udohiyuhiya hia nitsvweseha, vtla gvnigesv igegvnedi yigesesdi uyelvdv hia gohi tsaneha.
\syll ᎤᏓᏅᏙᎩᎯᏃ ᎭᏫᏂ ᎤᎵᏰᏔᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎦᏙᏃ ᎪᎯ ᎯᎠ ᏣᏁᎭ ᎤᏰᎸᏛ ᎤᏂᏲᎭ?  ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ, ᎥᏝ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᎨᎬᏁᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᏰᎸᏛ ᎯᎠ ᎪᎯ ᏣᏁᎭ.
\ft And he sighed deeply in his spirit, and saith, Why doth this generation seek after a sign? verily I say unto you, There shall no sign be given unto this generation.

\ln Dudanvelvno, ale taline tsiyuhi utsanv, asgona wulosei.
\syll ᏚᏓᏅᎡᎸᏃ, ᎠᎴ ᏔᎵᏁ ᏥᏳᎯ ᎤᏣᏅ, ᎠᏍᎪᎾ ᏭᎶᏎᎢ.
\ft And he left them, and entering into the ship again departed to the other side.

\ln [Gvwasdawadidohino] unvgewisvhi gese gadu tsunadenvdiyi, vtla ale yulosvsde saquo gadu unilv tsiyuhi.
\syll ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯᏃdata is invalid ᎤᏅᎨᏫᏒᎯ ᎨᏎ ᎦᏚ ᏧᎾᏕᏅᏗᏱ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᏳᎶᏒᏍᏕ ᏌᏉ ᎦᏚ ᎤᏂᎸ ᏥᏳᎯ.
\ft Now the disciples had forgotten to take bread, neither had they in the ship with them more than one loaf.

\ln Dunetseleno hia nuwesei, Itsiyawisgesdi, Aniqualisi unatseli agododi itseyadotsehesdi, ale elodi utseli agododi.
\syll ᏚᏁᏤᎴᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎢᏥᏯᏫᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏ ᎤᎾᏤᎵ ᎠᎪᏙᏗ ᎢᏤᏯᏙᏤᎮᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎡᎶᏗ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎠᎪᏙᏗ.
\ft And he charged them, saying, Take heed, beware of the leaven of the Pharisees, and of the leaven of Herod.

\ln Unvsvno gesv unalinohele, hia nuniwesei, Nvdigalisdodiha gadu nididiyehvna gesvi.
\syll ᎤᏅᏒᏃ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎾᎵᏃᎮᎴ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎦᏚ ᏂᏗᏗᏰᎲᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft And they reasoned among themselves, saying, It is because we have no bread.

\ln Tsisano udolehosv hia niduweselei, Gadono itsalinoheha gadu niditsiyehvna gesv iyusdi?  Asiquosgo nitsadolehosgvna igi, ale nitsoligvna igi?  Asiquosgo asdaya nidetsvnv ditsinawi?
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᏙᎴᎰᏒ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎦᏙᏃ ᎢᏣᎵᏃᎮᎭ ᎦᏚ ᏂᏗᏥᏰᎲᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ?  ᎠᏏᏉᏍᎪ ᏂᏣᏙᎴᎰᏍᎬᎾ ᎢᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᏦᎵᎬᎾ ᎢᎩ?  ᎠᏏᏉᏍᎪ ᎠᏍᏓᏯ ᏂᏕᏨᏅ ᏗᏥᎾᏫ?
\ft And when Jesus knew it, he saith unto them, Why reason ye, because ye have no bread? perceive ye not yet, neither understand? have ye your heart yet hardened?

\ln Detsikanvsgo, nitsigowatisgvnano igi?  Detsililugasgo, nitsadvgisgvnano igi?  Ale nitsanvdadisgvnasgo igi?
\syll ᏕᏥᎧᏅᏍᎪ, ᏂᏥᎪᏩᏘᏍᎬᎾᏃ ᎢᎩ?  ᏕᏥᎵᎷᎦᏍᎪ, ᏂᏣᏛᎩᏍᎬᎾᏃ ᎢᎩ?  ᎠᎴ ᏂᏣᏅᏓᏗᏍᎬᎾᏍᎪ ᎢᎩ?
\ft Having eyes, see ye not? and having ears, hear ye not? and do ye not remember?

\ln Hisgi gadu dagigvhaluyv hisgi iyagayvli detsinelv, ilago iyakalii talutsa uligvhaluyvhi itsutesei?  Taladu igvwoselei.
\syll ᎯᏍᎩ ᎦᏚ ᏓᎩᎬᎭᎷᏴ ᎯᏍᎩ ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ ᏕᏥᏁᎸ, ᎢᎳᎪ ᎢᏯᎧᎵᎢ ᏔᎷᏣ ᎤᎵᎬᎭᎷᏴᎯ ᎢᏧᏖᏎᎢ?  ᏔᎳᏚ ᎢᎬᏬᏎᎴᎢ.
\ft When I brake the five loaves among five thousand, how many baskets full of fragments took ye up? They say unto him, Twelve.

\ln Galiquogino [gadu] nvgi iyagayvli detsinelv, ilago iyakalii talutsa uligvhaluyvhi itsutesei?  Galiquogi unadvnei.
\syll ᎦᎵᏉᎩᏃ ᎦᏚdata is invalid ᏅᎩ ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ ᏕᏥᏁᎸ, ᎢᎳᎪ ᎢᏯᎧᎵᎢ ᏔᎷᏣ ᎤᎵᎬᎭᎷᏴᎯ ᎢᏧᏖᏎᎢ?  ᎦᎵᏉᎩ ᎤᎾᏛᏁᎢ.
\ft And when the seven among four thousand, how many baskets full of fragments took ye up? And they said, Seven.

\ln Hiano niduweselei, Gado galisdodiha nitsoligvna tsigi?
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎦᏙ ᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᏂᏦᎵᎬᎾ ᏥᎩ?
\ft And he said unto them, How is it that ye do not understand?

\ln Quetsayidino wulutsei; digewino asgaya gvwatinohelei, ale unitayosele nasgi usvnisdiyi.
\syll ᏇᏣᏱᏗᏃ ᏭᎷᏤᎢ; ᏗᎨᏫᏃ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎬᏩᏘᏃᎮᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏔᏲᏎᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏒᏂᏍᏗᏱ.
\ft And he cometh to Bethsaida; and they bring a blind man unto him, and besought him to touch him.

\ln Digewino uwoyanesv, gaduhv unugowisei; digadolino dulitsisquv, ale dusitadv, gohusdisgo higowadvdiha?  Uwoselei.
\syll ᏗᎨᏫᏃ ᎤᏬᏯᏁᏒ, ᎦᏚᎲ ᎤᏄᎪᏫᏎᎢ; ᏗᎦᏙᎵᏃ ᏚᎵᏥᏍᏋ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏏᏔᏛ, ᎪᎱᏍᏗᏍᎪ ᎯᎪᏩᏛᏗᎭ?  ᎤᏬᏎᎴᎢ.
\ft And he took the blind man by the hand, and led him out of the town; and when he had spit on his eyes, and put his hands upon him, he asked him if he saw ought.

\ln Dukahnanvno, hia nuwesei, Yvwi gatsigowatiha anegiha detlugv nasgiyai.
\syll ᏚᎧᎿᏅᏃ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᏴᏫ ᎦᏥᎪᏩᏘᎭ ᎠᏁᎩᎭ ᏕᏡᎬ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ.
\ft And he looked up, and said, I see men as trees, walking.

\ln Hnaquono taline digadoli dusitadei, ale tsukanodiyi nuwanelei; ale udiwasei, ale naniv osiyu dagowadisgei.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏔᎵᏁ ᏗᎦᏙᎵ ᏚᏏᏔᏕᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᎧᏃᏗᏱ ᏄᏩᏁᎴᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᏗᏩᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎣᏏᏳ ᏓᎪᏩᏗᏍᎨᎢ.
\ft After that he put his hands again upon his eyes, and made him look up: and he was restored, and saw every man clearly.

\ln Ale unetsele tsuwenvsv wulohisdiyi, hia nuwesei, Tlesdi digaduhv witsayvlvgi, ale tlesdi gilo gaduhv ehi hinonelvgi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᏤᎴ ᏧᏪᏅᏒ ᏭᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᏗᎦᏚᎲ ᏫᏣᏴᎸᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎩᎶ ᎦᏚᎲ ᎡᎯ ᎯᏃᏁᎸᎩ.
\ft And he sent him away to his house, saying, Neither go into the town, nor tell it to any in the town.

\ln Tsisano unugotse ale nasgi gvwasdawadidohi, Sisaliyi Quiligi degaduhv wunilosei; wanaisvno dudvdvne gvwasdawadidohi, hia niduweselei, Gago gvquoseho yvwi?
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᏄᎪᏤ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ, ᏏᏌᎵᏱ ᏈᎵᎩ ᏕᎦᏚᎲ ᏭᏂᎶᏎᎢ; ᏩᎾᎢᏒᏃ ᏚᏛᏛᏁ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎦᎪ ᎬᏉᏎᎰ ᏴᏫ?
\ft And Jesus went out, and his disciples, into the towns of Caesarea Philippi: and by the way he asked his disciples, saying unto them, Whom do men say that I am?

\ln Hiano nuniwesei, Tsani Didawosgi; igadvsgini Ilaya [anadiha;] igadvno, Gilo iyusdi anadolehosgi.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ, ᏣᏂ ᏗᏓᏬᏍᎩ; ᎢᎦᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᎳᏯ ᎠᎾᏗᎭ;data is invalid ᎢᎦᏛᏃ, ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ.
\ft And they answered, John the Baptist: but some say, Elias; and others, One of the prophets.

\ln Hiano niduweselei, Nihinano gago sgiyoseha?  Quidano unetsv hia nuweselei, Galonedv nihi.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏂᎯᎾᏃ ᎦᎪ ᏍᎩᏲᏎᎭ?  ᏈᏓᏃ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏂᎯ.
\ft And he saith unto them, But whom say ye that I am? And Peter answereth and saith unto him, Thou art the Christ.

\ln Dunetseleno nasgi gilo uninonediyi nigesvna.
\syll ᏚᏁᏤᎴᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏂᏃᏁᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.
\ft And he charged them that they should tell no man of him.

\ln Ulenvheno duweyonei, nasgi yvwi Uwetsi utsati tsudalenvdv ugi liyoisdiyi; ale gvwayoisedi gesv dinilawigi, ale nunigvwiyusv atsilvanelohi ale dinowelisgi, ale atsiisdiyi gesvi, tsoineno iga tsulehisodi gesvi.
\syll ᎤᎴᏅᎮᏃ ᏚᏪᏲᏁᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎤᎩ ᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗᏱ; ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᏲᎢᏎᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏗᏂᎳᏫᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏃᏪᎵᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏥᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏦᎢᏁᏃ ᎢᎦ ᏧᎴᎯᏐᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft And he began to teach them, that the Son of man must suffer many things, and be rejected of the elders, and of the chief priests, and scribes, and be killed, and after three days rise again.

\ln Nasgino hia gvnigesv nuwesei.  Quidano uyanvhv ulenvhe ugvsgolvnei.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ.  ᏈᏓᏃ ᎤᏯᏅᎲ ᎤᎴᏅᎮ ᎤᎬᏍᎪᎸᏁᎢ.
\ft And he spake that saying openly. And Peter took him, and began to rebuke him.

\ln Aseno ugatahvsv, ale gvwasdawadidohi dukahnanv, Quida ugvsgolvnei, hia nuwesei, Aquasohadv halehvga Sedani; vtlayeno Unelanvhi utseli gesv osiyu yitsayelvha, yvwisgini unatseli gesvi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᎦᏔᎲᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏚᎧᎿᏅ, ᏈᏓ ᎤᎬᏍᎪᎸᏁᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎠᏆᏐᎭᏛ ᎭᎴᎲᎦ ᏎᏓᏂ; ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎨᏒ ᎣᏏᏳ ᏱᏣᏰᎸᎭ, ᏴᏫᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᎾᏤᎵ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft But when he had turned about and looked on his disciples, he rebuked Peter, saying, Get thee behind me, Satan: for thou savourest not the things that be of God, but the things that be of men.

\ln Widuyanvhvno yvwi, ale nasquo gvwasdawadidohi, hia niduweselei, Gilo udulisgesdi agisdawadvsdiyi, uwasv adadayihesdi, ale uwasv utseli tsudanawadv ayisgesdi, ale agisdawadegesdi.
\syll ᏫᏚᏯᏅᎲᏃ ᏴᏫ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎩᎶ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᎩᏍᏓᏩᏛᏍᏗᏱ, ᎤᏩᏒ ᎠᏓᏓᏱᎮᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏧᏓᎾᏩᏛ ᎠᏱᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎩᏍᏓᏩᏕᎨᏍᏗ.
\ft And when he had called the people unto him with his disciples also, he said unto them, Whosoever will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.

\ln Giloyeno udulisgesdi gvnv usdelvdiyi, nasgi uyohusehesdi; gilosgini gvnv uyohusehesdi ayv ale osdv kanohedv nvdigalisdodisgesdi, nasgi atsisdelvdi gesesdi.
\syll ᎩᎶᏰᏃ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎬᏅ ᎤᏍᏕᎸᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏲᎱᏎᎮᏍᏗ; ᎩᎶᏍᎩᏂ ᎬᏅ ᎤᏲᎱᏎᎮᏍᏗ ᎠᏴ ᎠᎴ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏥᏍᏕᎸᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft For whosoever will save his life shall lose it; but whosoever shall lose his life for my sake and the gospel's, the same shall save it.

\ln Gadoyeno yunequotsi yvwi, iyuno nigvnadv elohi utseli yinulistanv, uwasvno udanvdo yuyohuselv?
\syll ᎦᏙᏰᏃ ᏳᏁᏉᏥ ᏴᏫ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᏂᎬᎾᏛ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏱᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ, ᎤᏩᏒᏃ ᎤᏓᏅᏙ ᏳᏲᎱᏎᎸ?
\ft For what shall it profit a man, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul?

\ln Ale gado yahvga yvwi yiganetliyvsda udanvdo?
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎦᏙ ᏯᎲᎦ ᏴᏫ ᏱᎦᏁᏟᏴᏍᏓ ᎤᏓᏅᏙ?
\ft Or what shall a man give in exchange for his soul?

\ln Giloyeno aquadehosgesdi ayv, ale ayv tsinegvi, udasuyv ani dinadayonehi ale anisgana anehvi, nasgi nasquo yvwi Uwetsi udehohisdi gesesdi, galutsvha unuwosdesdi galvquodiyu gesv Udoda utseliga, anehesdi getsilvquodi dinikahnawadidohi.
\syll ᎩᎶᏰᏃ ᎠᏆᏕᎰᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᏴ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴ ᏥᏁᎬᎢ, ᎤᏓᏑᏴ ᎠᏂ ᏗᎾᏓᏲᏁᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᎾ ᎠᏁᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎤᏕᎰᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎦᎷᏨᎭ ᎤᏄᏬᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏙᏓ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎠᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᎨᏥᎸᏉᏗ ᏗᏂᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎯ.
\ft Whosoever therefore shall be ashamed of me and of my words in this adulterous and sinful generation; of him also shall the Son of man be ashamed, when he cometh in the glory of his Father with the holy angels.

\ln Hiano niduweselei, Udohiyuhiya hia nitsvweseha, nasgi gilo ani tsidanidoga, vtla yvdvnadolehosi ayohuhisdi gesvi, gvni unigohvhi gesesdi Unelanvhi ugvwiyuhi gesv ulinigidiyu gesv galutsvha.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎩᎶ ᎠᏂ ᏥᏓᏂᏙᎦ, ᎥᏝ ᏴᏛᎾᏙᎴᎰᏏ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎬᏂ ᎤᏂᎪᎲᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎦᎷᏨᎭ.
\ft And he said unto them, Verily I say unto you, That there be some of them that stand here, which shall not taste of death, till they have seen the kingdom of God come with power.

\ln Sudalino winusvlv Tsisa dutinvse Quida, ale Tsimi, ale Tsani, invno igati odalv duhnalutane iyvdv unvsv gesvi; ale udanetliyvse anigatahvi.
\syll ᏑᏓᎵᏃ ᏫᏄᏒᎸ ᏥᏌ ᏚᏘᏅᏎ ᏈᏓ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᎻ, ᎠᎴ ᏣᏂ, ᎢᏅᏃ ᎢᎦᏘ ᎣᏓᎸ ᏚᎿᎷᏔᏁ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎤᏅᏒ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᏁᏟᏴᏎ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎲᎢ.
\ft And after six days Jesus taketh with him Peter, and James, and John, and leadeth them up into an high mountain apart by themselves: and he was transfigured before them.

\ln Tsunuwono dutalugisgei, utsati tsunegiyu gesei vnotsi tsinunegiyv nasgiyai; nasgi vtla gilo digvgilosgi ani elohi ehi nasgi itsunegv yinidogagvga.
\syll ᏧᏄᏬᏃ ᏚᏔᎷᎩᏍᎨᎢ, ᎤᏣᏘ ᏧᏁᎩᏳ ᎨᏎᎢ ᎥᏃᏥ ᏥᏄᏁᎩᏴ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᏗᎬᎩᎶᏍᎩ ᎠᏂ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎡᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏧᏁᎬ ᏱᏂᏙᎦᎬᎦ.
\ft And his raiment became shining, exceeding white as snow; so as no fuller on earth can white them.

\ln Gvnigesvno nigvwanadvnele Ilaya ale Mosi; Tsisano gvwalinohedisgei.

\ft And there appeared unto them Elias with Moses: and they were talking with Jesus.

\ft And Peter answered and said to Jesus, Master, it is good for us to be here: and let us make three tabernacles; one for thee, and one for Moses, and one for Elias.

\ln Vtlayeno yagatahe iyuwesdiyi; utsatiyeno anisgaihei.
\syll ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᏯᎦᏔᎮ ᎢᏳᏪᏍᏗᏱ; ᎤᏣᏘᏰᏃ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᎢᎮᎢ.
\ft For he wist not what to say; for they were sore afraid.

\ln Ulogilvno unutlvtanei; kanegvno ulogilv tsunanugotsei, hia nigawesgei, Hia nasgi tsigeyui Aquetsi; nasgi etsadvdasdasi.
\syll ᎤᎶᎩᎸᏃ ᎤᏄᏢᏔᏁᎢ; ᎧᏁᎬᏃ ᎤᎶᎩᎸ ᏧᎾᏄᎪᏤᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎨᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᎨᏳᎢ ᎠᏇᏥ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᏣᏛᏓᏍᏓᏏ.
\ft And there was a cloud that overshadowed them: and a voice came out of the cloud, saying, This is my beloved Son: hear him.

\syll ᎩᎳᏉᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏚᎾᎧᎿᏂᏙᎸ, ᎥᏝ ᎿᏉ ᎩᎶ ᏳᏂᎪᎮᎢ, ᏥᏌ ᎤᏩᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏅᏒ.
\ft And suddenly, when they had looked round about, they saw no man any more, save Jesus only with themselves.

\ln Tsunigasoasidisvno odalvi, dunetsele nasgi gilo uninonediyi nigesvna nusdv unigohvi, gvni yvwi Uwetsi uyohusv tsulehisanvhi gesesdi duwoselei.
\syll ᏧᏂᎦᏐᎠᏏᏗᏒᏃ ᎣᏓᎸᎢ, ᏚᏁᏤᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏂᏃᏁᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎤᏂᎪᎲᎢ, ᎬᏂ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎤᏲᎱᏒ ᏧᎴᎯᏌᏅᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏚᏬᏎᎴᎢ.

\ln Nasgino nuwesv unagasayastanei, danadadvdvhvsge gadvgv ayohusv dilehisodi gesvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏄᏪᏒ ᎤᎾᎦᏌᏯᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᏓᎾᏓᏛᏛᎲᏍᎨ ᎦᏛᎬ ᎠᏲᎱᏒ ᏗᎴᎯᏐᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft And they kept that saying with themselves, questioning one with another what the rising from the dead should mean.

\ln Gvwadvdvneno hia nuniwesei, gadono dinowelisgi Ilaya igvyi dagalutsi tsanadisgoi?
\syll ᎬᏩᏛᏛᏁᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ, ᎦᏙᏃ ᏗᏃᏪᎵᏍᎩ ᎢᎳᏯ ᎢᎬᏱ ᏓᎦᎷᏥ ᏣᎾᏗᏍᎪᎢ?
\ft And they asked him, saying, Why say the scribes that Elias must first come?

\ln Unetsvno hia niduweselei, Ilaya udohiyuhi igvyi uluhisdi, ale nigadv uwotlvhisodi; ale nasquo hia nigvnvgowela yvwi Uwetsi atsinohesgvi, nasgi utsati tsudalenvdv ugiliyoisdi gesesdi, ale asequo dayetsiyelvni.
\syll ᎤᏁᏨᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎢᎳᏯ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎢᎬᏱ ᎤᎷᎯᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎤᏬᏢᎯᏐᏗ; ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏅᎪᏪᎳ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎠᏥᏃᎮᏍᎬᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎤᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏎᏉ ᏓᏰᏥᏰᎸᏂ.
\ft And he answered and told them, Elias verily cometh first, and restoreth all things; and how it is written of the Son of man, that he must suffer many things, and be set at nought.

\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ, ᎢᎳᏯ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎤᎷᏨ, ᎠᎴ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎤᎾᏚᎵᏍᎬ ᏂᎬᏩᏁᎸ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏂᎬᏅ ᎪᏪᎸ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏥᏃᎮᏍᎬᎢ.
\ft But I say unto you, That Elias is indeed come, and they have done unto him whatsoever they listed, as it is written of him.

\syll ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯᏃ ᎠᏁᏙᎲ ᎤᎷᏨ, ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏚᎪᎮ ᎬᏩᎾᏓᏡᏫᏍᏕᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏃᏪᎵᏍᎩ ᎬᏩᎾᏛᏛᎮᎸᎢᏍᎨᎢ.

\syll ᎩᎳᏉᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏴᏫ, ᎬᏩᎪᎲ, ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏎᎢ; ᎬᏩᏗᏝᎣᎮᎸᏃ ᎬᏩᏲᎵᎴᎢ.

\ln Dudvdvneno dinowelisgi, gado detsadvdvhelvvsga duwoselei?

\ft And he asked the scribes, What question ye with them?

\ln Asiyvwino nasgi unitsati gesv gela unetsv hia nuwesei, Tadeyohvsgi, gvyatinohisi aquetsi, uwagewi adanvdo uwei;
\syll ᎠᏏᏴᏫᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎨᏒ ᎨᎳ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᏔᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ, ᎬᏯᏘᏃᎯᏏ ᎠᏇᏥ, ᎤᏩᎨᏫ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᏪᎢ;
\ft And one of the multitude answered and said, Master, I have brought unto thee my son, which hath a dumb spirit;

\ln Ilvhitlvno uyilohisi ugilvsgoi; ale dahawoihoi, ale degalvdagisgo deganudogvi, ale ulvdehihoi; getsasdawadidohino gatsitayoselv uninugowisdiyi; aseno uninulvnvquo.
\syll ᎢᎸᎯᏢᏃ ᎤᏱᎶᎯᏏ ᎤᎩᎸᏍᎪᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᏓᎭᏬᎢᎰᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᎦᎸᏓᎩᏍᎪ ᏕᎦᏄᏙᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎸᏕᎯᎰᎢ; ᎨᏣᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯᏃ ᎦᏥᏔᏲᏎᎸ ᎤᏂᏄᎪᏫᏍᏗᏱ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏂᏄᎸᏅᏉ.
\ft And wheresoever he taketh him, he teareth him: and he foameth, and gnasheth with his teeth, and pineth away: and I spake to thy disciples that they should cast him out; and they could not.

\ln Unetselvno, hia nuwesei, Yo!  nitsohiyusvna gohi tsitseha!  ilago igohidv itsvyeladidohesdi?  Ilago igohidv unelagi itsvyelisehesdi?  Ani hiyatinoga.
\syll ᎤᏁᏤᎸᏃ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, Ᏺ  ᏂᏦᎯᏳᏒᎾ ᎪᎯ ᏥᏤᎭ  ᎢᎳᎪ ᎢᎪᎯᏛ ᎢᏨᏰᎳᏗᏙᎮᏍᏗ?  ᎢᎳᎪ ᎢᎪᎯᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᎩ ᎢᏨᏰᎵᏎᎮᏍᏗ?  ᎠᏂ ᎯᏯᏘᏃᎦ.
\ft He answereth him, and saith, O faithless generation, how long shall I be with you? how long shall I suffer you? bring him unto me.

\ln Udvdvneno udoda, Ilago nigohigi nasgi hia igvwalisdanelvhi?  Uwoselei.  Ayoliquo gesvi, udvnei;
\syll ᎤᏛᏛᏁᏃ ᎤᏙᏓ, ᎢᎳᎪ ᏂᎪᎯᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎢᎬᏩᎵᏍᏓᏁᎸᎯ?  ᎤᏬᏎᎴᎢ.  ᎠᏲᎵᏉ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᏛᏁᎢ;
\ft And he asked his father, How long is it ago since this came unto him? And he said, Of a child.

\ln Yanogiyuno atsilvyi ale asuyi udaegoi, nasgi uhisdiyi; iyusgininonv gohusdi getsadvnedi gesesdi, sgisdoligi, ale sgisdelv.
\syll ᏯᏃᎩᏳᏃ ᎠᏥᎸᏱ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏑᏱ ᎤᏓᎡᎪᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎯᏍᏗᏱ; ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎨᏣᏛᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᏍᎩᏍᏙᎵᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏍᎩᏍᏕᎸ.
\ft And ofttimes it hath cast him into the fire, and into the waters, to destroy him: but if thou canst do any thing, have compassion on us, and help us.

\ln Tsisano hia nuweselei, Iyuno getsohiyudi gesesdi, nigadiyu gohusdi igayegadvnedi gohiyuhvsgi.
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎨᏦᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎢᎦᏰᎦᏛᏁᏗ ᎪᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ.
\ft Jesus said unto him, If thou canst believe, all things are possible to him that believeth.

\ln Gilaquono iyvdv ayoli udoda uwelunei, ale digvgasawoihi hia nuwesei, Tsagvwiyuhi, goiyuhvsga; sgisdelvsi naquohiyusvna gesvi.
\syll ᎩᎳᏉᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎠᏲᎵ ᎤᏙᏓ ᎤᏪᎷᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎬᎦᏌᏬᎢᎯ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎪᎢᏳᎲᏍᎦ; ᏍᎩᏍᏕᎸᏏ ᎾᏉᎯᏳᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft And straightway the father of the child cried out, and said with tears, Lord, I believe; help thou mine unbelief.

\ln Tsisano ugohv nasgi unitsati ananelugisgv anadatlisisgvi, usgatse gadaha adanvdo, hia nuweselei, Tsvgewa ale ditsaliena adanvdo, gvnetseha, ehinugoi, ale tlesdi hnaquo ilvhiyu tsihiyvli.

\syll ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏᏃ ᎬᏩᎷᏤᎸ ᎬᏩᏛᏛᏁᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ, ᏚᏳᎪᏗᏍᎪ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᏓᎢᏅᏗᏱ ᎤᏓᎵᎢ?  ᎬᏩᎪᎵᏰᏍᎨᎢ.

\ft And Jesus answered and said, Verily I say unto you, There is no man that hath left house, or brethren, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or lands, for my sake, and the gospel's,

\ln Nasgi gohi gesv atsinedi nigesvna gesv asgohitsuqui iyuwagudi ulosvsdi dadanelvi, ale analinvtli, ale tsudo, ale tsutsi, ale tsuwetsi, ale degalogesvi, agiliyoisdi gesv tali udvdi; soiyino digesv ulisquadisdi nigesvna gvnidv.

\syll ᎤᏁᏅᏎᏃ, ᎠᎴ ᏭᏂᏩᏛᎮ ᎠᎩᎾ ᎨᎵᏌᏕ ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏳᎶᏗ ᏙᏱᏗᏢ, ᏀᎾ ᏕᎦᏅᏅ ᏓᏠᏍᎬᎢ; ᎤᏁᎵᏌᏕᏎᏃ.
\ft And they went their way, and found the colt tied by the door without in a place where two ways met; and they loose him.

\ln Gilono iyunasdi nahna dinidogi hia niduniweselei, Gadono iesdelisade agiwi?
\syll ᎩᎶᏃ ᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗ ᏀᎾ ᏗᏂᏙᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏂᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎦᏙᏃ ᎢᎡᏍᏕᎵᏌᏕ ᎠᎩᏫ?
\ft And certain of them that stood there said unto them, What do ye, loosing the colt?

\ln Ale nasgiyaquo Tsisa nuwesv unetsv niduniweselei:  duniyoseno.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᏉ ᏥᏌ ᏄᏪᏒ ᎤᏁᏨ ᏂᏚᏂᏪᏎᎴᎢ:  ᏚᏂᏲᏎᏃ.
\ft And they said unto them even as Jesus had commanded: and they let them go.

\ln Aginano Tsisa unatinohelei, ale tsunanuwo dunitlvnelei; Tsisano ugilvtanei.
\syll ᎠᎩᎾᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎤᎾᏘᏃᎮᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᎾᏄᏬ ᏚᏂᏢᏁᎴᎢ; ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᎩᎸᏔᏁᎢ.
\ft And they brought the colt to Jesus, and cast their garments on him; and he sat upon him.

\syll ᎤᏂᏣᏖᏃ ᏧᎾᏄᏬ ᏅᏃᎯ ᏚᏄᏰᏍᏛᏁᎢ; ᎢᎦᏛᏃ ᏕᏡᎬ ᏚᏅᏂᎦᎸᎮᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏅᏃᎯ ᏚᏂᎳᎨᏯᏛᏁᎢ.
\ft And many spread their garments in the way: and others cut down branches off the trees, and strawed them in the way.

\ln Igvyii anegi, ale oni anegi, unelugei, hia naniwesgei, Hosana, Galvquodiyu gesesdi Yihowa deudosdv tsigaluhisdida.
\syll ᎢᎬᏱᎢ ᎠᏁᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎣᏂ ᎠᏁᎩ, ᎤᏁᎷᎨᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏂᏪᏍᎨᎢ, ᎰᏌᎾ, ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏱᎰᏩ ᏕᎤᏙᏍᏛ ᏥᎦᎷᎯᏍᏗᏓ.
\ft And they that went before, and they that followed, cried, saying, Hosanna; Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord:

\syll ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏕᏫ ᎢᎩᏙᏓ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᎰᏩ ᏚᏙᏍᏛ ᏥᎦᎷᎯᏍᏗᎭ; ᎰᏌᎾ ᏩᏍᏛ ᎦᎸᎳᏗᏳ.
\ft Blessed be the kingdom of our father David, that cometh in the name of the Lord: Hosanna in the highest.

\ln Tsisano Tsilusilimi wuyvlei, ale utanvdigalawiisdiyi wuyvlei; hnaquono gvwaduwidv dukahnanidolv nigadv tsudalenvdv dukahnanv, ale hnaquo usvhiyvyi gesei, unugotse Quediniyi wulose anehe taladu iyanidv.
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᏭᏴᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏔᏅᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᏭᏴᎴᎢ; ᎿᏉᏃ ᎬᏩᏚᏫᏛ ᏚᎧᎿᏂᏙᎸ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏚᎧᎿᏅ, ᎠᎴ ᎿᏉ ᎤᏒᎯᏴᏱ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎤᏄᎪᏤ ᏇᏗᏂᏱ ᏭᎶᏎ ᎠᏁᎮ ᏔᎳᏚ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ.
\ft And Jesus entered into Jerusalem, and into the temple: and when he had looked round about upon all things, and now the eventide was come, he went out unto Bethany with the twelve.

\ln Ugitsvdvno Quediniyi tsunilosv agonu uyosisgei;
\syll ᎤᎩᏨᏛᏃ ᏇᏗᏂᏱ ᏧᏂᎶᏒ ᎠᎪᏄ ᎤᏲᏏᏍᎨᎢ;
\ft And on the morrow, when they were come from Bethany, he was hungry:

\ln Wugoheno ge iyvdv ditluge svgalaiyusdi, ulisdusei, wulutsei, yasegagi yitsiwadv gohusdi yuta uwelisei; nahnano wulutsv vtla gohusdi yuwadvhe ulisdusvquo uwasv; vtlayeno asi yusqualvhe svgataiyunasdi unvnisdiyi.
\syll ᏭᎪᎮᏃ Ꭸ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏗᏡᎨ ᏒᎦᎳᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᎤᎵᏍᏚᏎᎢ, ᏭᎷᏤᎢ, ᏯᏎᎦᎩ ᏱᏥᏩᏛ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏳᏔ ᎤᏪᎵᏎᎢ; ᏀᎾᏃ ᏭᎷᏨ ᎥᏝ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏳᏩᏛᎮ ᎤᎵᏍᏚᏒᏉ ᎤᏩᏒ; ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᎠᏏ ᏳᏍᏆᎸᎮ ᏒᎦᏔᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗ ᎤᏅᏂᏍᏗᏱ.
\ft And seeing a fig tree afar off having leaves, he came, if haply he might find any thing thereon: and when he came to it, he found nothing but leaves; for the time of figs was not yet.

\ln Tsisano unetsv hia nuweselei, Tlesdi gilo ilvhiyu tsiagi nihi tsadatanvhi gohi iyudalenvdv.  Gvwasdawadidohino unadvganei.
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᎩᎶ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᏥᎠᎩ ᏂᎯ ᏣᏓᏔᏅᎯ ᎪᎯ ᎢᏳᏓᎴᏅᏛ.  ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯᏃ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏁᎢ.
\ft And Jesus answered and said unto it, No man eat fruit of thee hereafter for ever. And his disciples heard it.

\ln Tsilusilimino unilutsei; Tsisano utanvdigatawiisdiyi wuyvlv, ulenvhe dunugowise aninadegi ale uniwaevsgi nahna utanvdigalawiisdiyi, ale duluquadinvse dunisgilv adelv dinitliyvsgi, ale unanvdiyi guledinisgonihi dininadegi;
\syll ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻᏃ ᎤᏂᎷᏤᎢ; ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᏔᏅᏗᎦᏔᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᏭᏴᎸ, ᎤᎴᏅᎮ ᏚᏄᎪᏫᏎ ᎠᏂᎾᏕᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏩᎡᎥᏍᎩ ᏀᎾ ᎤᏔᏅᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᎷᏆᏗᏅᏎ ᏚᏂᏍᎩᎸ ᎠᏕᎸ ᏗᏂᏟᏴᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏅᏗᏱ ᎫᎴᏗᏂᏍᎪᏂᎯ ᏗᏂᎾᏕᎩ;

\syll ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏁᎳᎩ ᏳᏪᎵᏎᎴ ᎩᎶ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎠᏖᎵᏙ ᎤᏴᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᏛᏅᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ.

\syll ᏚᏕᏲᏁᏃ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏝᏍᎪ ᎯᎠ ᏱᏂᎬᏅ ᏱᎪᏪᎳ, ᎠᏆᏤᎵ ᎠᏓᏁᎸ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᎤᎾᏓᏙᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏚᏙᎡᏍᏗ?  ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏂᏃᏍᎩᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᏴᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏍᏓᎦᎸ ᏂᏨᏁᎸ.
\ft And he taught, saying unto them, Is it not written, My house shall be called of all nations the house of prayer? but ye have made it a den of thieves.

\ln Dinowelisgino ale nunigvwiyusv atsilvanelohi unadvganei, ale uniyole iyunvnediyi unihisdiyi; gvwanayesgeyeno, nvdigalisdodisge nigadv yvwi unisquanigosgv nusdv dadeyohvsgvi.
\syll ᏗᏃᏪᎵᏍᎩᏃ ᎠᎴ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏲᎴ ᎢᏳᏅᏁᏗᏱ ᎤᏂᎯᏍᏗᏱ; ᎬᏩᎾᏰᏍᎨᏰᏃ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏍᎬ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏓᏕᏲᎲᏍᎬᎢ.
\ft And the scribes and chief priests heard it, and sought how they might destroy him: for they feared him, because all the people was astonished at his doctrine.

\ln Usvno nulistanv unugotse gaduhvi.
\syll ᎤᏒᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ ᎤᏄᎪᏤ ᎦᏚᎲᎢ.
\ft And when even was come, he went out of the city.

\ln Sunaleno anaisvi, unigohe egataiyusdi tlugv uwayvsvhi gese duhnasdetlv nvdagvwadalenvdv.
\syll ᏑᎾᎴᏃ ᎠᎾᎢᏒᎢ, ᎤᏂᎪᎮ ᎡᎦᏔᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏡᎬ ᎤᏩᏴᏒᎯ ᎨᏎ ᏚᎿᏍᏕᏢ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏓᎴᏅᏛ.
\ft And in the morning, as they passed by, they saw the fig tree dried up from the roots.

\ln Tsisano unetsv, hia niduweselei, Unelanvhi etsoiyusesdi.
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᏁᏨ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎡᏦᎢᏳᏎᏍᏗ.

\syll ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯᏰᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ, ᎩᎶ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᏎᎮᏍᏗ ᎯᎠ ᏦᏓᎸ, ᏪᏣᎲᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎺᏉᎯ ᏪᏣᏚᎦ; ᎠᎴ ᏄᏜᏏᏛᎡᎲᎾ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᎾᏫᏱ, ᎪᎯᏳᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎬ ᎠᏎ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎮᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏄᏪᏒᎢ.
\ft For verily I say unto you, That whosoever shall say unto this mountain, Be thou removed, and be thou cast into the sea; and shall not doubt in his heart, but shall believe that those things which he saith shall come to pass; he shall have whatsoever he saith.

\ln nasgi iyusdi hia nitsvweseha, Nigav gohusdi itsitayoha itsadadolisda, itsohiyuhvsgesdi etsinei gesvi, ale ase itsihesdi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ, ᏂᎦᎥ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎢᏥᏔᏲᎭ ᎢᏣᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓ, ᎢᏦᎯᏳᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎡᏥᏁᎢ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏎ ᎢᏥᎮᏍᏗ.
\ft Therefore I say unto you, What things soever ye desire, when ye pray, believe that ye receive them, and ye shall have them.

\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᎢᏣᎴᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎢᏣᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎨᏣᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᎡᏥᏍᎦᏅᏤᎸᎢ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎡᏤᎵᏎᎮᏍᏗ ᎩᎶᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎢᏥᏙᏓ ᎦᎸᏔᏗ ᏤᎭ ᎦᎨᏥᏁᏗᏱ ᎯᎠ ᎢᏥᏍᎦᏅᏨᎢ.
\ft And when ye stand praying, forgive, if ye have ought against any: that your Father also which is in heaven may forgive you your trespasses.

\syll ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᏂᏣᏓᏁᎲᎾ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎡᏥᏍᎦᏅᏤᎸᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎢᏥᏙᏓ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ ᏴᎨᏥᏙᎵᎩ ᎢᏥᏍᎦᏅᏨᎢ.
\ft But if ye do not forgive, neither will your Father which is in heaven forgive your trespasses.

\ln Tsilusilimino taline unilutsei; udvnvnodigalawiisdiyi edohei, gvwalutsele nunigvwiyusv atsilvanelohi, ale dinowelisgi, ale dinilawigi,

\ft And they come again to Jerusalem: and as he was walking in the temple, there come to him the chief priests, and the scribes, and the elders,

\ln Ale hia nigvwaweselei, Gado tsalisgasdodi hia nasgi tsihnadvneha?  Ale gago tsanele nasgi hia itsadvnediyi?
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏩᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎦᏙ ᏣᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏗ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᎿᏛᏁᎭ?  ᎠᎴ ᎦᎪ ᏣᏁᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎢᏣᏛᏁᏗᏱ?
\ft And say unto him, By what authority doest thou these things? and who gave thee this authority to do these things?

\ln Tsisano unetsv hia niduweselei, Ayv nasgi sudalegi dvtsvyadvdvni, ale sginohvsi, ayvno datsvnoneli nusdv aqualisgasdodv hia nasgi tsinigadvneha.
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏑᏓᎴᎩ ᏛᏨᏯᏛᏛᏂ, ᎠᎴ ᏍᎩᏃᎲᏏ, ᎠᏴᏃ ᏓᏨᏃᏁᎵ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎠᏆᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏛ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏂᎦᏛᏁᎭ.
\ft And Jesus answered and said unto them, I will also ask of you one question, and answer me, and I will tell you by what authority I do these things.

\syll ᏣᏂ ᏥᏓᏓᏬᏍᎬᎩ, ᎦᎸᎳᏍᎪ ᏧᏓᎴᏁᎢ, ᏴᏫᏉᎨ ᎠᏁᎲᎢ?  ᏍᎩᏃᎲᏏ.
\ft The baptism of John, was it from heaven, or of men? answer me.

\ln Unvsvno gesv unalinohelei, hia nuniwesei, Iyuno galvladi nvdayudalenvhi yigadvnv, hia yinigawi, Gadono tla yietsoiyunei?
\syll ᎤᏅᏒᏃ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎾᎵᏃᎮᎴᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᏱᎦᏛᏅ, ᎯᎠ ᏱᏂᎦᏫ, ᎦᏙᏃ Ꮭ ᏱᎡᏦᎢᏳᏁᎢ?
\ft And they reasoned with themselves, saying, If we shall say, From heaven; he will say, Why then did ye not believe him?

\ln Iyuno yvwiquo anehv yigadvnv,^nasgi danisgaihe yvwi; nigadvyeno yvwi adolehosgi udohiyuhi gvwayelvha Tsani.
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᏴᏫᏉ ᎠᏁᎲ ᏱᎦᏛᏅ,data is invalidᎾᏍᎩ ᏓᏂᏍᎦᎢᎮ ᏴᏫ; ᏂᎦᏛᏰᏃ ᏴᏫ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎬᏩᏰᎸᎭ ᏣᏂ.
\ft But if we shall say, Of men; they feared the people: for all men counted John, that he was a prophet indeed.

\ln Uninetsvno hia nuniwesele Tsisa, Vtla yotsigataha.  Tsisano unetsv hia niduweselei, Vtla nasquo ayv yvdatsvnoneli iyusdi aqualisgasdodv hia nasgi tsinigadvneha.
\syll ᎤᏂᏁᏨᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎴ ᏥᏌ, ᎥᏝ ᏲᏥᎦᏔᎭ.  ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏴ ᏴᏓᏨᏃᏁᎵ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏆᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏛ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏂᎦᏛᏁᎭ.
\ft And they answered and said unto Jesus, We cannot tell. And Jesus answering saith unto them, Neither do I tell you by what authority I do these things.

\ln Ulenvheno duwonetane datlilosdisgvi.  Gilo iyusdi telvladi duwisei, ale usoyile gvwaduwidv, ale usgose gigageaditasdi gotlvdiyi, ale unesgehe inv igati, ale dudolastane tlogesi tsunilvwisdanehi, ale inv wulosei.
\syll ᎤᎴᏅᎮᏃ ᏚᏬᏁᏔᏁ ᏓᏟᎶᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ.  ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏖᎸᎳᏗ ᏚᏫᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏐᏱᎴ ᎬᏩᏚᏫᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏍᎪᏎ ᎩᎦᎨᎠᏗᏔᏍᏗ ᎪᏢᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᏍᎨᎮ ᎢᏅ ᎢᎦᏘ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏙᎳᏍᏔᏁ ᏠᎨᏏ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏅ ᏭᎶᏎᎢ.
\ft And he began to speak unto them by parables. A certain man planted a vineyard, and set an hedge about it, and digged a place for the winefat, and built a tower, and let it out to husbandmen, and went into a far country.

\ln Unvnisdiyino gesv iyui, unvse unvsidasdi tlogesi tsunilvwisdanehi dinehvi, nasgi tlogesi tsunilvwisdanehi nvdagvwanediyi unequotsvhi telvladi dawisvi.
\syll ᎤᏅᏂᏍᏗᏱᏃ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᎢ, ᎤᏅᏎ ᎤᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᏠᎨᏏ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᏗᏁᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏠᎨᏏ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏁᏗᏱ ᎤᏁᏉᏨᎯ ᏖᎸᎳᏗ ᏓᏫᏒᎢ.
\ft And at the season he sent to the husbandmen a servant, that he might receive from the husbandmen of the fruit of the vineyard.

\ln Igvwaniyvheno, ale igvwalivnilei, ale asvha igvwanigistanei.
\syll ᎢᎬᏩᏂᏴᎮᏃ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᎬᏩᎵᎥᏂᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏒᎭ ᎢᎬᏩᏂᎩᏍᏔᏁᎢ.
\ft And they caught him, and beat him, and sent him away empty.

\ln Talineno nvwadale unvsidasdi unvse dinehvi; nasgino nvyaquo dogvwanistanei, ale igvwasonvne asgoli, ale igvwanigistane udehohisdi igvwanelvhi.
\syll ᏔᎵᏁᏃ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᎤᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎤᏅᏎ ᏗᏁᎲᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏅᏯᏉ ᏙᎬᏩᏂᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᎬᏩᏐᏅᏁ ᎠᏍᎪᎵ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᎬᏩᏂᎩᏍᏔᏁ ᎤᏕᎰᎯᏍᏗ ᎢᎬᏩᏁᎸᎯ.
\ft And again he sent unto them another servant; and at him they cast stones, and wounded him in the head, and sent him away shamefully handled.

\ln Talineno nvwadale unvsei; ale nasgi unilei; ale unitsate nvwanadalei; igadv danilivnihei, igadvno danihihei.
\syll ᏔᎵᏁᏃ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᎤᏅᏎᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᎴᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏣᏖ ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴᎢ; ᎢᎦᏛ ᏓᏂᎵᎥᏂᎮᎢ, ᎢᎦᏛᏃ ᏓᏂᎯᎮᎢ.
\ft And again he sent another; and him they killed, and many others; beating some, and killing some.

\ln Asino saquo uwetsi ehei, ugeyuhi, nasgi nasquo unvse oniyi dinehvi, hia nuwesei, Ase dvnilvquotani aquetsi.
\syll ᎠᏏᏃ ᏌᏉ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎡᎮᎢ, ᎤᎨᏳᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᏅᏎ ᎣᏂᏱ ᏗᏁᎲᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎠᏎ ᏛᏂᎸᏉᏔᏂ ᎠᏇᏥ.
\ft Having yet therefore one son, his wellbeloved, he sent him also last unto them, saying, They will reverence my son.

\ln Aseno nasgi na tlogesi tsunilvwisdanehi, hia nidunadaweselei, Hia nasgi tsugvwalodi wutiyelihisdi gesvi;  ka, ediluga, tsugvwalodino utiyedi igatseliga gesesdi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏠᎨᏏ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᎾᏓᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᏭᏘᏰᎵᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ;  Ꭷ, ᎡᏗᎷᎦ, ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗᏃ ᎤᏘᏰᏗ ᎢᎦᏤᎵᎦ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft But those husbandmen said among themselves, This is the heir; come, let us kill him, and the inheritance shall be ours.

\ln Gvwaniyvhvno gvwalei, ale telvladi dawisv doyiditlv wigvwadainvsei.
\syll ᎬᏩᏂᏴᎲᏃ ᎬᏩᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏖᎸᎳᏗ ᏓᏫᏒ ᏙᏱᏗᏢ ᏫᎬᏩᏓᎢᏅᏎᎢ.
\ft And they took him, and killed him, and cast him out of the vineyard.

\ln Gadono nasgi dvdvneli telvladi dawisv utseliga?  Dagalutsi ale dodvdvtani nasgi tlogesi tsunilvwisdanehi, ale nvwanadale dodvneli telvladi dawisvi.
\syll ᎦᏙᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏛᏛᏁᎵ ᏖᎸᎳᏗ ᏓᏫᏒ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ?  ᏓᎦᎷᏥ ᎠᎴ ᏙᏛᏛᏔᏂ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏠᎨᏏ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴ ᏙᏛᏁᎵ ᏖᎸᎳᏗ ᏓᏫᏒᎢ.
\ft What shall therefore the lord of the vineyard do? he will come and destroy the husbandmen, and will give the vineyard unto others.

\ln Tlasgono yitsigoliyeo hia nasgi tsinigvnv tsigowela?  Nasgi nvya, dinanesgesgi uniyoiselvhi nugvwiyusv unvsiyv adi nulistanv;
\syll ᏝᏍᎪᏃ ᏱᏥᎪᎵᏰᎣ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏂᎬᏅ ᏥᎪᏪᎳ?  ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏯ, ᏗᎾᏁᏍᎨᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᏲᎢᏎᎸᎯ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎤᏅᏏᏴ ᎠᏗ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ;
\ft And have ye not read this scripture; The stone which the builders rejected is become the head of the corner:

\ln Nasgi hia Yihowa nudvnelv, ale usquanigodiyu dedakanisgvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏱᎰᏩ ᏄᏛᏁᎸ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗᏳ ᏕᏓᎧᏂᏍᎬᎢ.
\ft This was the Lord's doing, and it is marvellous in our eyes?

\ln Unanelotaneno gvwaniyvdiyi, aseno unitsati yvwi danisgaihei; anigataheyeno unvsv getsidvgv nasgi dutlilostanvi; igvwadanveleno ale dunenvsei.
\syll ᎤᎾᏁᎶᏔᏁᏃ ᎬᏩᏂᏴᏗᏱ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏴᏫ ᏓᏂᏍᎦᎢᎮᎢ; ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎮᏰᏃ ᎤᏅᏒ ᎨᏥᏛᎬ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᏟᎶᏍᏔᏅᎢ; ᎢᎬᏩᏓᏅᎡᎴᏃ ᎠᎴ ᏚᏁᏅᏎᎢ.
\ft And they sought to lay hold on him, but feared the people: for they knew that he had spoken the parable against them: and they left him, and went their way.

\ln Duninvseno wigvwalutsediyi gilo iyunasdi Aniqualisi ale Elodv gvwasdelisgi, unisadvdiyi unadulisge gawonisgvi.
\syll ᏚᏂᏅᏎᏃ ᏫᎬᏩᎷᏤᏗᏱ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗ ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏ ᎠᎴ ᎡᎶᏛ ᎬᏩᏍᏕᎵᏍᎩ, ᎤᏂᏌᏛᏗᏱ ᎤᎾᏚᎵᏍᎨ ᎦᏬᏂᏍᎬᎢ.
\ft And they send unto him certain of the Pharisees and of the Herodians, to catch him in his words.

\ln Unilutsvno, hia nigvwaweselei, Tadeyohvsgi, otsigataha duyugodv hiwonisgv gesvi, ale gilo nitenayesgvna gesvi; vtlayeno nunasdv yvwi yitelvquodoi, Unelanvhisgini unvnv udohiyusv dehadeyohvsgoi; duyugodisgo ayeli anaguyisgv Sisa aguyvediyi, tlage?
\syll ᎤᏂᎷᏨᏃ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏩᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏔᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ, ᎣᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎯᏬᏂᏍᎬ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᏂᏖᎾᏰᏍᎬᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᏄᎾᏍᏛ ᏴᏫ ᏱᏖᎸᏉᏙᎢ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏅᏅ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᏒ ᏕᎭᏕᏲᎲᏍᎪᎢ; ᏚᏳᎪᏗᏍᎪ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎠᎾᎫᏱᏍᎬ ᏏᏌ ᎠᎫᏴᎡᏗᏱ, ᏝᎨ?
\ft And when they were come, they say unto him, Master, we know that thou art true, and carest for no man: for thou regardest not the person of men, but teachest the way of God in truth: Is it lawful to give tribute to Caesar, or not?

\ln Dayotsinitsu, tlage yvdayotsini?  Aseno agatahe unatlonasdvi, hia niduweselei, Gadono isgigoliyeha?  Esgivsi agisi tsugvwalodi nasgi agigowadvdiyi.
\syll ᏓᏲᏥᏂᏧ, ᏝᎨ ᏴᏓᏲᏥᏂ?  ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᎦᏔᎮ ᎤᎾᏠᎾᏍᏛᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎦᏙᏃ ᎢᏍᎩᎪᎵᏰᎭ?  ᎡᏍᎩᎥᏏ ᎠᎩᏏ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎩᎪᏩᏛᏗᏱ.
\ft Shall we give, or shall we not give? But he, knowing their hypocrisy, said unto them, Why tempt ye me? bring me a penny, that I may see it.

\ln Uniyoleno.  Hiano niduweselei, Gago hia dagatlilosdi, ale gago atsinoheha hia tsigawela?  Sisa, igvwoselei.
\syll ᎤᏂᏲᎴᏃ.  ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎦᎪ ᎯᎠ ᏓᎦᏟᎶᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᎪ ᎠᏥᏃᎮᎭ ᎯᎠ ᏥᎦᏪᎳ?  ᏏᏌ, ᎢᎬᏬᏎᎴᎢ.
\ft And they brought it. And he saith unto them, Whose is this image and superscription? And they said unto him, Caesar's.

\ln Tsisano unetli hia nisuweselei, Sisa etsaguyvsi Sisa utseliga, Unelanvhino Unelanvhi utseliga.  Igvwasquanigoseleno.
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᏁᏟ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏑᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏏᏌ ᎡᏣᎫᏴᏏ ᏏᏌ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ.  ᎢᎬᏩᏍᏆᏂᎪᏎᎴᏃ.
\ft And Jesus answering said unto them, Render to Caesar the things that are Caesar's, and to God the things that are God's. And they marvelled at him.

\ln Noquale Anisadusi igvwalutselei, nasgi ayohusv vtla dilehisodi yigi anadisgi; ale igvwadvdvnei, hia nuniwesei.
\syll ᏃᏆᎴ ᎠᏂᏌᏚᏏ ᎢᎬᏩᎷᏤᎴᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏲᎱᏒ ᎥᏝ ᏗᎴᎯᏐᏗ ᏱᎩ ᎠᎾᏗᏍᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᎢᎬᏩᏛᏛᏁᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ.
\ft Then come unto him the Sadducees, which say there is no resurrection; and they asked him, saying,

\ln Tadeyohvsgi, Mosi ogowelanelvgi hia nogiweselvgi, Analinvtli gilo ayohusgesdi, ale udalii igakahiyasgesdi, tsuwetsino nidigakahiyasgvna igesesdi, analinvtli ayanisgesdi udalii, ale nasgi analinvtli tsuwetsi dadvhisdanehesdi.
\syll ᏔᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ, ᎼᏏ ᎣᎪᏪᎳᏁᎸᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏃᎩᏪᏎᎸᎩ, ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏟ ᎩᎶ ᎠᏲᎱᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᎵᎢ ᎢᎦᎧᎯᏯᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᏧᏪᏥᏃ ᏂᏗᎦᎧᎯᏯᏍᎬᎾ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏟ ᎠᏯᏂᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᏓᎵᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏟ ᏧᏪᏥ ᏓᏛᎯᏍᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ.
\ft Master, Moses wrote unto us, If a man's brother die, and leave his wife behind him, and leave no children, that his brother should take his wife, and raise up seed unto his brother.

\ln Nasgino galiquogi analinvtli anehvgi;  igvyino ehi udesvnvgi, ale uyohusvgi tsuwetsi nanehvna.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎦᎵᏉᎩ ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏟ ᎠᏁᎲᎩ;  ᎢᎬᏱᏃ ᎡᎯ ᎤᏕᏒᏅᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏲᎱᏒᎩ ᏧᏪᏥ ᎾᏁᎲᎾ.
\ft Now there were seven brethren: and the first took a wife, and dying left no seed.

\ln Talineno wehi nasgi udayvsvgi, ale uyohusvgi; nasquono nasgi vtla tsuwetsi yiduwekahiyei; ale nasgiya nasquo tsoine wehi.
\syll ᏔᎵᏁᏃ ᏪᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏓᏴᏒᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏲᎱᏒᎩ; ᎾᏍᏉᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎥᏝ ᏧᏪᏥ ᏱᏚᏪᎧᎯᏰᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏦᎢᏁ ᏪᎯ.
\ft And the second took her, and died, neither left he any seed: and the third likewise.

\ln Ale nasgi galiquogi iyanidv unadayvsvgi, ale vtla yidunihikahiye tsunetsi; oniyino ageyv nasquo uyohusei.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎵᏉᎩ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᎤᎾᏓᏴᏒᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏚᏂᎯᎧᎯᏰ ᏧᏁᏥ; ᎣᏂᏱᏃ ᎠᎨᏴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᏲᎱᏎᎢ.
\ft And the seven had her, and left no seed: last of all the woman died also.

\ln Tsuniyohusvhino tsunalehisodi gesvi, nahiyu nasgi hia danalehisanvha, gago udalii gesesdi nasgi hia?  Galiquogiyeno iyanidv anadayehvgi.
\syll ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯᏃ ᏧᎾᎴᎯᏐᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏀᎢᏳ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏓᎾᎴᎯᏌᏅᎭ, ᎦᎪ ᎤᏓᎵᎢ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ?  ᎦᎵᏉᎩᏰᏃ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᎠᎾᏓᏰᎲᎩ.
\ft In the resurrection therefore, when they shall rise, whose wife shall she be of them? for the seven had her to wife.

\ln Tsisano unetsv hia niduweselvgi, Tlasgo yitsilidasdiha, yinvdigalisdodiha nitsoligvna gesv Goweli, ale Unelanvhi ulinigidiyu gesvi?
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ, ᏝᏍᎪ ᏱᏥᎵᏓᏍᏗᎭ, ᏱᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᏂᏦᎵᎬᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎪᏪᎵ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ?
\ft And Jesus answering said unto them, Do ye not therefore err, because ye know not the scriptures, neither the power of God?

\ln Nahiyuyeno tsunalehisodi gesv tsuniyohusvhi, vtla yidanadesvhvsgoi, vtla ale yidigetsiyegoi;  galvladisgini anehi getsinvsidasdi nunasdv nasgiya nunasdi.
\syll ᏀᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᏧᎾᎴᎯᏐᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯ, ᎥᏝ ᏱᏓᎾᏕᏒᎲᏍᎪᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᏱᏗᎨᏥᏰᎪᎢ;  ᎦᎸᎳᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏁᎯ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᏄᎾᏍᏛ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᎾᏍᏗ.
\ft For when they shall rise from the dead, they neither marry, nor are given in marriage; but are as the angels which are in heaven.

\ln Tsuniyohusvhino nasgi tsunalehisodi gesvi; tlasgo yitsigoliyeo Mosi utseli gowelihi, nasgi uweyodadv Unelanvhi ulinohetanvi, hia nuweselvi, Ayv Aquanelanvhi Equahami utseliga, ale Aquanelanvhi Esigi utseliga, ale Aquanelanvhi Tsegaqui utseliga.
\syll ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᎾᎴᎯᏐᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᏝᏍᎪ ᏱᏥᎪᎵᏰᎣ ᎼᏏ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎪᏪᎵᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏪᏲᏓᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎵᏃᎮᏔᏅᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎢ, ᎠᏴ ᎠᏆᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎡᏆᎭᎻ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏆᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎡᏏᎩ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏆᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏤᎦᏈ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ.
\ft And as touching the dead, that they rise: have ye not read in the book of Moses, how in the bush God spake unto him, saying, I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob?

\ln Vtla tsuniyohusvhi unatseli Unelanvhi yigi, dinvnodvsgini unatseli Unelanvhi; nasgi iyusdi utsati itsilidasdiha.
\syll ᎥᏝ ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᎤᎾᏤᎵ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏱᎩ, ᏗᏅᏃᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᎾᏤᎵ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎢᏥᎵᏓᏍᏗᎭ.
\ft He is not the God of the dead, but the God of the living: ye therefore do greatly err.

\ln Dinowelisgino gesv asiyvwi ulutselv, udvganv analinohesgvi, ale udolehosv osiyu nuwesv dunetselvi, udvdvnei, Gado usdi utli galvquodiyu nigadv dikahnawadvsdi gesvi?  Udvnei.
\syll ᏗᏃᏪᎵᏍᎩᏃ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᎤᎷᏤᎸ, ᎤᏛᎦᏅ ᎠᎾᎵᏃᎮᏍᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏙᎴᎰᏒ ᎣᏏᏳ ᏄᏪᏒ ᏚᏁᏤᎸᎢ, ᎤᏛᏛᏁᎢ, ᎦᏙ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎤᏟ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ?  ᎤᏛᏁᎢ.
\ft And one of the scribes came, and having heard them reasoning together, and perceiving that he had answered them well, asked him, Which is the first commandment of all?

\ln Tsisa unetsele hia nuweselei, Utli galvquodi nigadv dikahnawadvsdi gesv hia nasgi; Hadvgvga Isili; Yihowa Iganelanvhi saquohiyu Yihowa;
\syll ᏥᏌ ᎤᏁᏤᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎤᏟ ᎦᎸᏉᏗ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ; ᎭᏛᎬᎦ ᎢᏏᎵ; ᏱᎰᏩ ᎢᎦᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏌᏉᎯᏳ ᏱᎰᏩ;
\ft And Jesus answered him, The first of all the commandments is, Hear, O Israel; The Lord our God is one Lord:

\ln Ale higeyusesdi Yihowa Tsanelanvhi hvdisgesdi nigv tsanawi, ale nigvtsadanvdo, ale nigv tsadanvtediyi, ale nigav tsalinigvgvi.  Hia nasgi wudagonadvdv galvquodi dikahnawadvsdi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎯᎨᏳᏎᏍᏗ ᏱᎰᏩ ᏣᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎲᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏂᎬ ᏣᎾᏫ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎬᏣᏓᏅᏙ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎬ ᏣᏓᏅᏖᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏣᎵᏂᎬᎬᎢ.  ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏭᏓᎪᎾᏛᏛ ᎦᎸᏉᏗ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ.
\ft And thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind, and with all thy strength: this is the first commandment.

\ln Talineno gesvi, nasgiyaquo, hia nasgi nusdi, tsvsv nitsadageyusv nasgiya nigeyusesdi nav idisdadala.  Vtla nvwadale dikahnawadvsdi yaha utli igalvquodi esgaquo nasgi.
\syll ᏔᎵᏁᏃ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯᏉ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏗ, ᏨᏒ ᏂᏣᏓᎨᏳᏒ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏂᎨᏳᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᎥ ᎢᏗᏍᏓᏓᎳ.  ᎥᏝ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏯᎭ ᎤᏟ ᎢᎦᎸᏉᏗ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ.
\ft And the second is like, namely this, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself. There is none other commandment greater than these.

\ln Digowelisgino hia nuweselei; Ka, Tadeyohvsgi, duyugodv niwi; saquoquoyeno eha Unelanvhi; vtla ale nvwadale yeha nasgi uwasvhiyu;
\syll ᏗᎪᏪᎵᏍᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; Ꭷ, ᏔᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ, ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᏂᏫ; ᏌᏉᏉᏰᏃ ᎡᎭ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ; ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᏰᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏩᏒᎯᏳ;
\ft And the scribe said unto him, Well, Master, thou hast said the truth: for there is one God; and there is none other but he:

\ln Nasgino ageyudiyi gvdodiyi nigv onawiyi, ale nigv adanvtediyi, ale nigv adanvdo, ale nigav nolinigvgvi, ale nav iyunadala uwasv udageyusv nasgiya ugeyudiyi, utli galvquodiyu esgaquo nigadv digvwanosdv atsilv digelasdodi, ale alisgolvdodi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎠᎨᏳᏗᏱ ᎬᏙᏗᏱ ᏂᎬ ᎣᎾᏫᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎬ ᎠᏓᏅᏖᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎬ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏃᎵᏂᎬᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᎥ ᎢᏳᎾᏓᎳ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎤᏓᎨᏳᏒ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎤᎨᏳᏗᏱ, ᎤᏟ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏗᎬᏩᏃᏍᏛ ᎠᏥᎸ ᏗᎨᎳᏍᏙᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎵᏍᎪᎸᏙᏗ.
\ft And to love him with all the heart, and with all the understanding, and with all the soul, and with all the strength, and to love his neighbour as himself, is more than all whole burnt offerings and sacrifices.

\ln Tsisano ugohv agatahnai iyuwesdi nuwesv unetsvi, hia nuweselei, Vtla invhiyu yinitsadvhnadega Unelanvhi utseligohi gesvi.  Nahiyuno iyudalenvdv vtla gilo gohusdi gvwadvdvdi yigesei.
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᎪᎲ ᎠᎦᏔᎿᎢ ᎢᏳᏪᏍᏗ ᏄᏪᏒ ᎤᏁᏨᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎢᏅᎯᏳ ᏱᏂᏣᏛᎿᏕᎦ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎪᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.  ᏀᎢᏳᏃ ᎢᏳᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎬᏩᏛᏛᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ.
\ft And when Jesus saw that he answered discreetly, he said unto him, Thou art not far from the kingdom of God. And no man after that durst ask him any question.

\ln Tsisano unetsv dadeyohvsgv udvnvdigalawiisdiyi, hia nuwesei; Gadono dinowelisgi Galonedv Dewi uwetsi, tsanadisgoi?
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᏁᏨ ᏓᏕᏲᎲᏍᎬ ᎤᏛᏅᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎦᏙᏃ ᏗᏃᏪᎵᏍᎩ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏕᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ, ᏣᎾᏗᏍᎪᎢ?
\ft And Jesus answered and said, while he taught in the temple, How say the scribes that Christ is the Son of David?

\ln Dewiyeno uwasv Galvquodiyu Adanvdo uweyohvsgv hia nuwesei, Yihowa hia nuwesele aquatseli Ugvwiyuhi, Tsigatisi iditlv tsolesdi gvni getsasgagi ditsalasidiyi gasgilo nigatsiyvnelvha.
\syll ᏕᏫᏰᏃ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᏪᏲᎲᏍᎬ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᏱᎰᏩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴ ᎠᏆᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᏥᎦᏘᏏ ᎢᏗᏢ ᏦᎴᏍᏗ ᎬᏂ ᎨᏣᏍᎦᎩ ᏗᏣᎳᏏᏗᏱ ᎦᏍᎩᎶ ᏂᎦᏥᏴᏁᎸᎭ.
\ft For David himself said by the Holy Ghost, The Lord said to my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand, till I make thine enemies thy footstool.

\ln Dewiyeno uwasv Ugvwiyuhi igoseha; gadono digalesdodiha uwetsi igi?  Unitsatino yvwi unalihelitsvhi gvwadvdanelei.
\syll ᏕᏫᏰᏃ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᎪᏎᎭ; ᎦᏙᏃ ᏗᎦᎴᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎢᎩ?  ᎤᏂᏣᏘᏃ ᏴᏫ ᎤᎾᎵᎮᎵᏨᎯ ᎬᏩᏛᏓᏁᎴᎢ.
\ft David therefore himself calleth him Lord; and whence is he then his son? And the common people heard him gladly.

\ln Hiano niduwesele dadeyohvsgvi, Detseyadotsehesdi dinowelisgi osiyu tsuniyelv diganvhidv tsunanuwai unedasdiyi, ale getsiyolisdiyi diganododiyi,
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴ ᏓᏕᏲᎲᏍᎬᎢ, ᏕᏤᏯᏙᏤᎮᏍᏗ ᏗᏃᏪᎵᏍᎩ ᎣᏏᏳ ᏧᏂᏰᎸ ᏗᎦᏅᎯᏛ ᏧᎾᏄᏩᎢ ᎤᏁᏓᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎨᏥᏲᎵᏍᏗᏱ ᏗᎦᏃᏙᏗᏱ,
\ft And he said unto them in his doctrine, Beware of the scribes, which love to go in long clothing, and love salutations in the marketplaces,

\ln Ale nugvwiyusv degasgilv digalawiisdiyi, ale nugvwiyusv tsunanitlvdiyi danalisdayvhvgvi;
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᏕᎦᏍᎩᎸ ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᏧᎾᏂᏢᏗᏱ ᏓᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᎬᎢ;
\ft And the chief seats in the synagogues, and the uppermost rooms at feasts:

\ln Nasgi tsidanisvneho tsunosulotsvhi daninelvi, ale unatlonasdv gohidiyu tsanadadolisdisgoi; hia nasgi utli igai unigiliyoisdi digegugodanedi gesesdi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏓᏂᏒᏁᎰ ᏧᏃᏑᎶᏨᎯ ᏓᏂᏁᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏠᎾᏍᏛ ᎪᎯᏗᏳ ᏣᎾᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎪᎢ; ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏟ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎤᏂᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗ ᏗᎨᎫᎪᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft Which devour widows' houses, and for a pretence make long prayers: these shall receive greater damnation.

\ln Tsisano uwole adelvdidiyi tsuyugodi, ale ugohe nanadvnehv yvwi adelv danihvsgv adelvdidiyi; unitsatino tsunehnai utsati danihvsgei.
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᏬᎴ ᎠᏕᎸᏗᏗᏱ ᏧᏳᎪᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎪᎮ ᎾᎾᏛᏁᎲ ᏴᏫ ᎠᏕᎸ ᏓᏂᎲᏍᎬ ᎠᏕᎸᏗᏗᏱ; ᎤᏂᏣᏘᏃ ᏧᏁᎿᎢ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏓᏂᎲᏍᎨᎢ.
\ft And Jesus sat over against the treasury, and beheld how the people cast money into the treasury: and many that were rich cast in much.

\ln Gilono iyusdi uyo iyudvhnadegi uwosulotsvhi ulutsv, tali aginudvdi iyadanvtedi unei, nasgi ayeli iyadanvtedi igai tsigi.
\syll ᎩᎶᏃ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᏲ ᎢᏳᏛᎿᏕᎩ ᎤᏬᏑᎶᏨᎯ ᎤᎷᏨ, ᏔᎵ ᎠᎩᏄᏛᏗ ᎢᏯᏓᏅᏖᏗ ᎤᏁᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎢᏯᏓᏅᏖᏗ ᎢᎦᎢ ᏥᎩ.
\ft And there came a certain poor widow, and she threw in two mites, which make a farthing.

\ln Widuyanvhvno gvwasdawadidohi, hia niduweselei, Udohiyuhiya hia nitsvweseha, Hia nasgi uyo iyudvhnadegi uwosulotsvhi utli igai ahvga esgaquo nigadv nasgi adelvdidiyi tsanihvga.
\syll ᏫᏚᏯᏅᎲᏃ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏲ ᎢᏳᏛᎿᏕᎩ ᎤᏬᏑᎶᏨᎯ ᎤᏟ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎠᎲᎦ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏕᎸᏗᏗᏱ ᏣᏂᎲᎦ.
\ft And he called unto him his disciples, and saith unto them, Verily I say unto you, That this poor widow hath cast more in, than all they which have cast into the treasury:

\ln Nigadvyeno utsati unihv unotsaledv anihvga; nasgisginiunigidv gesv ahvga nigadv uhvi, nigadv ulisdelvdodi uhvi.
\syll ᏂᎦᏛᏰᏃ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᏂᎲ ᎤᏃᏣᎴᏛ ᎠᏂᎲᎦ; ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂᎤᏂᎩᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎲᎦ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎤᎲᎢ, ᏂᎦᏛ ᎤᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ ᎤᎲᎢ.
\ft For all they did cast in of their abundance; but she of her want did cast in all that she had, even all her living.

\ln Ganugoheno udvnvdigalawiisdiyi, asiyvwi nasgi gvwasdawadidohi hia nuweselei, Tadeyohvsgi, gvniyuquo na nideusdi nvya ale nideusdi dadanelvi?
\syll ᎦᏄᎪᎮᏃ ᎤᏛᏅᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏔᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ, ᎬᏂᏳᏉ Ꮎ ᏂᏕᎤᏍᏗ ᏅᏯ ᎠᎴ ᏂᏕᎤᏍᏗ ᏓᏓᏁᎸᎢ?
\ft And as he went out of the temple, one of his disciples saith unto him, Master, see what manner of stones and what buildings are here!

\ln Tsisano unetsv hia nuweselei, Dehigowadisgo hia nasgi tsequa dadanelvi?  Vtla saquo nvya kanohiyvhi yigesesdi yidudasatlahesdi, nasgi nigohvtanvna yigesesdi.
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏕᎯᎪᏩᏗᏍᎪ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏤᏆ ᏓᏓᏁᎸᎢ?  ᎥᏝ ᏌᏉ ᏅᏯ ᎧᏃᎯᏴᎯ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏱᏚᏓᏌᏝᎮᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎪᎲᏔᏅᎾ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft And Jesus answering said unto him, Seest thou these great buildings? there shall not be left one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down.

\ln Oliwayono usahilv uwolvi, udvnvdigalawiisdiyi adanelv tsuyugodi, Quida, ale Tsimi, ale Tsani, ale Enidi, unvsv gesv gvwadvdvnei, hia nuniwesei,
\syll ᎣᎵᏩᏲᏃ ᎤᏌᎯᎸ ᎤᏬᎸᎢ, ᎤᏛᏅᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᏓᏁᎸ ᏧᏳᎪᏗ, ᏈᏓ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᎻ, ᎠᎴ ᏣᏂ, ᎠᎴ ᎡᏂᏗ, ᎤᏅᏒ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏩᏛᏛᏁᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ,
\ft And as he sat upon the mount of Olives over against the temple, Peter and James and John and Andrew asked him privately,

\ln Sginohvsi, ilagiyu nasgi hia nvdagalistani?  Ale gado uyelvdv gesesdi nahiyu hia nasgi nigadv uliyeilohisdi gesvi?
\syll ᏍᎩᏃᎲᏏ, ᎢᎳᎩᏳ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏔᏂ?  ᎠᎴ ᎦᏙ ᎤᏰᎸᏛ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏀᎢᏳ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎤᎵᏰᎢᎶᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ?
\ft Tell us, when shall these things be? and what shall be the sign when all these things shall be fulfilled?

\ln Tsisano dunetselv, ulenvhe hia nuwesei, Itseyatahesdi, tlesdi gilo tsitsilonuheli.
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᏚᏁᏤᎸ, ᎤᎴᏅᎮ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎢᏤᏯᏔᎮᏍᏗ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᎩᎶ ᏥᏥᎶᏄᎮᎵ.
\ft And Jesus answering them began to say, Take heed lest any man deceive you:

\ln Unitsatesdiyeno ayv daquadosdv aniluhisdisgesdi, hia naniwesgesdi, ayv nasgi; ale unitsatesdi danilonuhesgesdi.
\syll ᎤᏂᏣᏖᏍᏗᏰᏃ ᎠᏴ ᏓᏆᏙᏍᏛ ᎠᏂᎷᎯᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏂᏪᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏣᏖᏍᏗ ᏓᏂᎶᏄᎮᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
\ft For many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ; and shall deceive many.

\ln Itsadvgisgesdino danvwa, ale aninohelidohv danvwa, tlesdi yitsadeyatanehesdi; nasgiyeno ase iyulisdodi; ulisquadisdiyisgini gesv asi gesesdi.
\syll ᎢᏣᏛᎩᏍᎨᏍᏗᏃ ᏓᏅᏩ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏃᎮᎵᏙᎲ ᏓᏅᏩ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏣᏕᏯᏔᏁᎮᏍᏗ; ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎠᏎ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗ; ᎤᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᏗᏱᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏏ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft And when ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars, be ye not troubled: for such things must needs be; but the end shall not be yet.

\ln Tsunadaledvyeno yvwi dodvnaleni dodvnadatlutani, ale ayeli degotlvwadisv dodvnadatlutani; ale gadohi dalitelvnidohesdi, ale dagonulosidohesdi ale udeyadodi nigalistanidohesdi; hia nasgi adalenisgv agiliya.
\syll ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏛᏰᏃ ᏴᏫ ᏙᏛᎾᎴᏂ ᏙᏛᎾᏓᏡᏔᏂ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏰᎵ ᏕᎪᏢᏩᏗᏒ ᏙᏛᎾᏓᏡᏔᏂ; ᎠᎴ ᎦᏙᎯ ᏓᎵᏖᎸᏂᏙᎮᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᎪᏄᎶᏏᏙᎮᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏕᏯᏙᏗ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏔᏂᏙᎮᏍᏗ; ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏓᎴᏂᏍᎬ ᎠᎩᎵᏯ.
\ft For nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom: and there shall be earthquakes in divers places, and there shall be famines and troubles: these are the beginnings of sorrows.

\ln Adina itseyatahesdi; danilawivyeno degetsiyosgesdi; tsunitawiisdiyino detsilivnihesdi; ale nunigvwiyusadegi ale unigvwiyuhi aninv tsetsatenohisdi gesesdi ayv gesv nvdigalisdodisgesdi, nasgi gohiyudisgi tsunigatilegi.
\syll ᎠᏗᎾ ᎢᏤᏯᏔᎮᏍᏗ; ᏓᏂᎳᏫᎥᏰᏃ ᏕᎨᏥᏲᏍᎨᏍᏗ; ᏧᏂᏔᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱᏃ ᏕᏥᎵᎥᏂᎮᏍᏗ; ᎠᎴ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᏂᏅ ᏤᏣᏖᏃᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎠᏴ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᎯᏳᏗᏍᎩ ᏧᏂᎦᏘᎴᎩ.
\ft But take heed to yourselves: for they shall deliver you up to councils; and in the synagogues ye shall be beaten: and ye shall be brought before rulers and kings for my sake, for a testimony against them.

\ln Osdvno kanohedv igvyi nigvnadv tsunewadisv yvwi alitsidodi gesesdi.
\syll ᎣᏍᏛᏃ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎢᎬᏱ ᏂᎬᎾᏛ ᏧᏁᏩᏗᏒ ᏴᏫ ᎠᎵᏥᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft And the gospel must first be published among all nations.

\ln Ale hnaquo detsatinegesdi, ale detsiyosgesdi, tlesdi igvyi gayehi yitselihisgesdi itsiwesdiyi itsineisdiyi, ale tlesdi igvyi gayehi yitsadanvtesgesdi; nusdvsgini wihiyu gesv etsinelv nasgi itsinegesdi; vtlayeno nihi yitsanegoi, Galvquodiyusgini Adanvdo.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎿᏉ ᏕᏣᏘᏁᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᏥᏲᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᎢᎬᏱ ᎦᏰᎯ ᏱᏤᎵᎯᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎢᏥᏪᏍᏗᏱ ᎢᏥᏁᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎢᎬᏱ ᎦᏰᎯ ᏱᏣᏓᏅᏖᏍᎨᏍᏗ; ᏄᏍᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᏫᎯᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎡᏥᏁᎸ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏥᏁᎨᏍᏗ; ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᏂᎯ ᏱᏣᏁᎪᎢ, ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ.
\ft But when they shall lead you, and deliver you up, take no thought beforehand what ye shall speak, neither do ye premeditate: but whatsoever shall be given you in that hour, that speak ye: for it is not ye that speak, but the Holy Ghost.

\ln Analinvtlino duyosgesdi analinvtli uyohuhihisdiyi; asgayano uwetsi duyosgesdi; ale digeganvgi danalehvsgesdi tsunigayvlige danatludisgesdi, ale nasgi nanvnisisgesdi degetsiihesdi.
\syll ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏟᏃ ᏚᏲᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏟ ᎤᏲᎱᎯᎯᏍᏗᏱ; ᎠᏍᎦᏯᏃ ᎤᏪᏥ ᏚᏲᏍᎨᏍᏗ; ᎠᎴ ᏗᎨᎦᏅᎩ ᏓᎾᎴᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏧᏂᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᏓᎾᏡᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏅᏂᏏᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏕᎨᏥᎢᎮᏍᏗ.
\ft Now the brother shall betray the brother to death, and the father the son; and children shall rise up against their parents, and shall cause them to be put to death.

\ln Ale nigadiyu yvwi getsisgagi gesesdi ayv tsuquadov nvdigalisdodisgesdi; gilosgini gvlisquadisgi dikahnawadegi, nasgi atsisdelvdi gesesdi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏴᏫ ᎨᏥᏍᎦᎩ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎠᏴ ᏧᏆᏙᎥ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ; ᎩᎶᏍᎩᏂ ᎬᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᎩ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏕᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏥᏍᏕᎸᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft And ye shall be hated of all men for my name's sake: but he that shall endure unto the end, the same shall be saved.

\ln Itsigowatisgesdisgini usgaisdi advdisgi Denili adolehosgi uneistanvhi, gadogesdi nahna gvwaledi nigesvna, (gilo agoliyesgesdi goligesdi,) hnaquo Tsudiyi anini analisvha dotsodalv wanilosvha.
\syll ᎢᏥᎪᏩᏘᏍᎨᏍᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏍᎦᎢᏍᏗ ᎠᏛᏗᏍᎩ ᏕᏂᎵ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎢᏍᏔᏅᎯ, ᎦᏙᎨᏍᏗ ᏀᎾ ᎬᏩᎴᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎩᎶ ᎠᎪᎵᏰᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎪᎵᎨᏍᏗ, ᎿᏉ ᏧᏗᏱ ᎠᏂᏂ ᎠᎾᎵᏒᎭ ᏙᏦᏓᎸ ᏩᏂᎶᏒᎭ.
\ft But when ye shall see the abomination of desolation, spoken of by Daniel the prophet, standing where it ought not, (let him that readeth understand,) then let them that be in Judaea flee to the mountains:

\ln Ale gilo gasanali ugilesdi, tlesdi yvditloasgesdi adanelv wiyayvhihesdi, ale tlesdi nahna wiyayvhihesdi wugisdiyi gohusdi uhnav ganelvi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᎦᏌᎾᎵ ᎤᎩᎴᏍᏗ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᏴᏗᏠᎠᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᏓᏁᎸ ᏫᏯᏴᎯᎮᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏀᎾ ᏫᏯᏴᎯᎮᏍᏗ ᏭᎩᏍᏗᏱ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᎿᎥ ᎦᏁᎸᎢ.
\ft And let him that is on the housetop not go down into the house, neither enter therein, to take any thing out of his house:

\ln Ale gilo tlogesi edohi tlesdi yvdiutsvsesdi unuwo yunesolesdi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᏠᎨᏏ ᎡᏙᎯ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏴᏗᎤᏨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᏄᏬ ᏳᏁᏐᎴᏍᏗ.
\ft And let him that is in the field not turn back again for to take up his garment.

\ln Ale uyoiyu iyunalisdanedi dininelidv, ale tsunisdai nahiyu gesesdi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎤᏲᎢᏳ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᏗᏂᏁᎵᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏂᏍᏓᎢ ᏀᎢᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft But woe to them that are with child, and to them that give suck in those days!

\ln Ale itsadadolisdisgesdi itsitayohihesdi gola itsalisdiyi nigesvna iyulisdodiyi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎢᏣᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎢᏥᏔᏲᎯᎮᏍᏗ ᎪᎳ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
\ft And pray ye that your flight be not in the winter.

\ln Nahiyuyeno gesesdi agiliya ehesdi, nasgi gotlvnvi nasgi Unelanvhi tsuwotlvne nvdagvwadalenvdv gohi iyasdi vtla nasgi iyusdi yudenoi, vtla ale udedi yigesesdi.
\syll ᏀᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎠᎩᎵᏯ ᎡᎮᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᏢᏅᎢ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᏬᏢᏁ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎪᎯ ᎢᏯᏍᏗ ᎥᏝ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏳᏕᏃᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏕᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft For in those days shall be affliction, such as was not from the beginning of the creation which God created unto this time, neither shall be.

\ln Ale Ugvwiyuhi nidugoladvna yigese nahiyu iga, vtla uquedali yigayetsisdelvhei; gegasuyedvsgini nvdigalisdodiha, nasgi tsusuyedv gesvi, nasgi dugoladv nahiyu iga.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏂᏚᎪᎳᏛᎾ ᏱᎨᏎ ᏀᎢᏳ ᎢᎦ, ᎥᏝ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᏱᎦᏰᏥᏍᏕᎸᎮᎢ; ᎨᎦᏑᏰᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏑᏰᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᎪᎳᏛ ᏀᎢᏳ ᎢᎦ.
\ft And except that the Lord had shortened those days, no flesh should be saved: but for the elect's sake, whom he hath chosen, he hath shortened the days.

\ln Hnaquono iyu gilo hia nitsiweselvha, Gvniyuquo ani Galonedv; ale gvniyuquo nahnani; tlesdi itsoiyunvgi;
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎢᏳ ᎩᎶ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏥᏪᏎᎸᎭ, ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎠᏂ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ; ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᏀᎾᏂ; ᏞᏍᏗ ᎢᏦᎢᏳᏅᎩ;
\ft And then if any man shall say to you, Lo, here is Christ; or, lo, he is there; believe him not:

\ln Galonedvyeno unatselvhi ale anadolehosgi unatselvhi dvninanugotsi, ale aninanugowisgesdi uyelvdv ale usquanigodi, nasgi tsunilonuhediyi, iyuno yeli yigi, nasquo gegasuyedv.
\syll ᎦᎶᏁᏛᏰᏃ ᎤᎾᏤᎸᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᏤᎸᎯ ᏛᏂᎾᏄᎪᏥ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᎾᏄᎪᏫᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᏰᎸᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏂᎶᏄᎮᏗᏱ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᏰᎵ ᏱᎩ, ᎾᏍᏉ ᎨᎦᏑᏰᏛ.
\ft For false Christs and false prophets shall rise, and shall shew signs and wonders, to seduce, if it were possible, even the elect.

\ln Nihisgini itseyatahesdi; gvniyuquo nigadv nitsvnonelv.
\syll ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᏤᏯᏔᎮᏍᏗ; ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏂᏨᏃᏁᎸ.
\ft But take ye heed: behold, I have foretold you all things.

\ln Nahiyusgini gesesdi, ulosonesdi nasgi agiliya, nvdo iga ehi dvlisihvsi, ale nvdo svnoyi ehi vtla iga yutesdedi;
\syll ᏀᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎤᎶᏐᏁᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎩᎵᏯ, ᏅᏙ ᎢᎦ ᎡᎯ ᏛᎵᏏᎲᏏ, ᎠᎴ ᏅᏙ ᏒᏃᏱ ᎡᎯ ᎥᏝ ᎢᎦ ᏳᏖᏍᏕᏗ;
\ft But in those days, after that tribulation, the sun shall be darkened, and the moon shall not give her light,

\ln Ale noquisi anikalv galvloi aninvgoasgesdi, ale unitsate galvlo tsanikala dvnalitelvni.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏃᏈᏏ ᎠᏂᎧᎸ ᎦᎸᎶᎢ ᎠᏂᏅᎪᎠᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏣᏖ ᎦᎸᎶ ᏣᏂᎧᎳ ᏛᎾᎵᏖᎸᏂ.
\ft And the stars of heaven shall fall, and the powers that are in heaven shall be shaken.

\ln Hnaquono dvnigohi yvwi Uwetsi tsaisesdi ulogilvi, unuwosdesdi utsati ulinigidiyu gesv ale galvquodiyu gesvi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏛᏂᎪᎯ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᏣᎢᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᎶᎩᎸᎢ, ᎤᏄᏬᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft And then shall they see the Son of man coming in the clouds with great power and glory.

\ln Hnaquono dodaganvsi tsutseli dinikahnawadidohi, ale dodagatlisani gegasuyedv tsutseliga widodvyanvhi nvgi nidodigalosgv unole, elohi wulistinilv nvdayudalenvdv galvlono wulistinilv wigalugi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏙᏓᎦᏅᏏ ᏧᏤᎵ ᏗᏂᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏙᏓᎦᏟᏌᏂ ᎨᎦᏑᏰᏛ ᏧᏤᎵᎦ ᏫᏙᏛᏯᏅᎯ ᏅᎩ ᏂᏙᏗᎦᎶᏍᎬ ᎤᏃᎴ, ᎡᎶᎯ ᏭᎵᏍᏘᏂᎸ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎦᎸᎶᏃ ᏭᎵᏍᏘᏂᎸ ᏫᎦᎷᎩ.
\ft And then shall he send his angels, and shall gather together his elect from the four winds, from the uttermost part of the earth to the uttermost part of heaven.

\ln Itsadeloquano svgataiyusdi tlugv datlilosdvi;  Uwanigalv hnaquo udage nigalisda, ale tsigalisduhvsgoi, itsigataho gogi navniyu gesvi;
\syll ᎢᏣᏕᎶᏆᏃ ᏒᎦᏔᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏡᎬ ᏓᏟᎶᏍᏛᎢ;  ᎤᏩᏂᎦᎸ ᎿᏉ ᎤᏓᎨ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏓ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᎦᎵᏍᏚᎲᏍᎪᎢ, ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎰ ᎪᎩ ᎾᎥᏂᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ;
\ft Now learn a parable of the fig tree; When her branch is yet tender, and putteth forth leaves, ye know that summer is near:

\ln Nasgiya nasquo nihi, hnaquo itsigowatisgesdi hia nasgi nigalistanidohvi, itsigatahesdi navniyu gesvi, galohisdiyiquo gesvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏂᎯ, ᎿᏉ ᎢᏥᎪᏩᏘᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏔᏂᏙᎲᎢ, ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎮᏍᏗ ᎾᎥᏂᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱᏉ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft So ye in like manner, when ye shall see these things come to pass, know that it is nigh, even at the doors.

\ln Udohiyuhiya hia nitsvwesehe, hia nasgi gohi tsaneha vtla yvdvnilosoni gvni hia nasgi nigadiyu nigalistanvha.
\syll ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎮ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᎯ ᏣᏁᎭ ᎥᏝ ᏴᏛᏂᎶᏐᏂ ᎬᏂ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏔᏅᎭ.
\ft Verily I say unto you, that this generation shall not pass, till all these things be done.

\ln Galvlo ale elohi dvnilosoni; ayvsgini aginetsv vtla yvdagalosoni.
\syll ᎦᎸᎶ ᎠᎴ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏛᏂᎶᏐᏂ; ᎠᏴᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᎩᏁᏨ ᎥᏝ ᏴᏓᎦᎶᏐᏂ.
\ft Heaven and earth shall pass away: but my words shall not pass away.

\ln Nahiyusgini iga gesv ale iyu kalawadisv vtla gilo yagataha, vtla nasquo dinikahnawadidohi galvladi anehi, tla naquono Uwetsi, agayvligesgini uwasv.
\syll ᏀᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᎦ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏳ ᎧᎳᏩᏗᏒ ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᏯᎦᏔᎭ, ᎥᏝ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏗᏂᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎠᏁᎯ, Ꮭ ᎾᏉᏃ ᎤᏪᏥ, ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏩᏒ.
\ft But of that day and that hour knoweth no man, no, not the angels which are in heaven, neither the Son, but the Father.

\ln Itseyatahesdi, itsiyawisgesdi ale itsadadolisdisgesdi; vtlayeno yitsigataha iyu gesvi.
\syll ᎢᏤᏯᏔᎮᏍᏗ, ᎢᏥᏯᏫᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏣᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ; ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᏱᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᎢᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Take ye heed, watch and pray: for ye know not when the time is.

\ln [Yvwiyeno Uwetsi] nasgiyaquo asgaya tsanigisgo ilvhitlv tsegoi, nasgi tsigvdego ganelvi, ale anigatiya tsinidegvneho tsunvsidasdi, ale anisiyvwiha tsuni lvwisdanedi tsidanehoi, ale galohisdiyi agatiya tsikanetseho uyawidiyi.
\syll ᏴᏫᏰᏃ ᎤᏪᏥdata is invalid ᎾᏍᎩᏯᏉ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᏣᏂᎩᏍᎪ ᎢᎸᎯᏢ ᏤᎪᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᎬᏕᎪ ᎦᏁᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᎦᏘᏯ ᏥᏂᏕᎬᏁᎰ ᏧᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏏᏴᏫᎭ ᏧᏂ ᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᏥᏓᏁᎰᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᎦᏘᏯ ᏥᎧᏁᏤᎰ ᎤᏯᏫᏗᏱ.
\ft For the Son of man is as a man taking a far journey, who left his house, and gave authority to his servants, and to every man his work, and commanded the porter to watch.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi itsiyawisgesdi; vtlayeno yitsigataha iyuquo uluhisdiyi ganela, usvi, ale svnoyi ayeli, ale tsataga aniyvgvi, ale sunalei;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏥᏯᏫᏍᎨᏍᏗ; ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᏱᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᎢᏳᏉ ᎤᎷᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎦᏁᎳ, ᎤᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏒᏃᏱ ᎠᏰᎵ, ᎠᎴ ᏣᏔᎦ ᎠᏂᏴᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏑᎾᎴᎢ;
\ft Watch ye therefore: for ye know not when the master of the house cometh, at even, or at midnight, or at the cockcrowing, or in the morning:

\ln Yigalugiyeno yayeloisda, yvtsiwadvda itsilinavi.
\syll ᏱᎦᎷᎩᏰᏃ ᏯᏰᎶᎢᏍᏓ, ᏴᏥᏩᏛᏓ ᎢᏥᎵᎾᎥᎢ.
\ft Lest coming suddenly he find you sleeping.

\ln Nasgino hia nihi tsinitsvweseha, nasgi nigadvquo nigatsiwesehaItsiyawisgesdi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎯ ᏥᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᏛᏉ ᏂᎦᏥᏪᏎᎭᎢᏥᏯᏫᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
\ft And what I say unto you I say unto all, Watch.

\ln Talino winusvlv kanohiyvgi dilisdayvdiyi ale nagotanvna gadu agisdiyi usqualvdi gesei, nunigvwisvno atsilvanelohi ale dinowelisgi uniyole iyunadvnediyi galonuhedv unvdodiyi uniniyvdiyi, ale unihisdiyi.
\syll ᏔᎵᏃ ᏫᏄᏒᎸ ᎧᏃᎯᏴᎩ ᏗᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᎾᎪᏔᏅᎾ ᎦᏚ ᎠᎩᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏍᏆᎸᏗ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏒᏃ ᎠᏥᎸᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏃᏪᎵᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᏲᎴ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᏁᏗᏱ ᎦᎶᏄᎮᏛ ᎤᏅᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᏂᏂᏴᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᎯᏍᏗᏱ.
\ft After two days was the feast of the passover, and of unleavened bread: and the chief priests and the scribes sought how they might take him by craft, and put him to death.

\ln Aseno vtlesdi dilisdayvdiyi iyu iga gesvi, yanalidelvhvgayeno yvwi, unadvnei.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏞᏍᏗ ᏗᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ ᎢᏳ ᎢᎦ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏯᎾᎵᏕᎸᎲᎦᏰᏃ ᏴᏫ, ᎤᎾᏛᏁᎢ.
\ft But they said, Not on the feast day, lest there be an uproar of the people.

\ln Quediniyino edohei, Aawani adayesgi utlvtsvhi ganelvi, ganvgeno alisdayvhvsgei, ageyv ulutse ayehe gugu nvya unegv gotlvtanvhi atlisde atlonedi nada tsudoidv, utsati tsugvwalodi; ale ulosv gugu, ale ulonetane asgoli.
\syll ᏇᏗᏂᏱᏃ ᎡᏙᎮᎢ, ᎠᎠᏩᏂ ᎠᏓᏰᏍᎩ ᎤᏢᏨᎯ ᎦᏁᎸᎢ, ᎦᏅᎨᏃ ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎨᎢ, ᎠᎨᏴ ᎤᎷᏤ ᎠᏰᎮ ᎫᎫ ᏅᏯ ᎤᏁᎬ ᎪᏢᏔᏅᎯ ᎠᏟᏍᏕ ᎠᏠᏁᏗ ᎾᏓ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ, ᎤᏣᏘ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᎶᏒ ᎫᎫ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎶᏁᏔᏁ ᎠᏍᎪᎵ.
\ft And being in Bethany in the house of Simon the leper, as he sat at meat, there came a woman having an alabaster box of ointment of spikenard very precious; and she brake the box, and poured it on his head.

\ln Gilono unadasuye unvyutse dotsunadanvdvi, ale hia nuniwesei, Gadono hia atsewogi atlonedi?
\syll ᎩᎶᏃ ᎤᎾᏓᏑᏰ ᎤᏅᏳᏤ ᏙᏧᎾᏓᏅᏛᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ, ᎦᏙᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏤᏬᎩ ᎠᏠᏁᏗ?
\ft And there were some that had indignation within themselves, and said, Why was this waste of the ointment made?

\syll ᏳᏂᎾᏗᏅᏎᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏠᏁᏗ ᏦᎢᏧᏈ ᎠᏂᎩᏏ ᏧᎾᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎤᎶᏒᏍᏗ ᏱᏚᎵᎬᏩᎳᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏲ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᎿᏕᎩ ᏗᎬᏁᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ.  ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᎪᏁᎶᎯᏎᎴᎢ.
\ft For it might have been sold for more than three hundred pence, and have been given to the poor. And they murmured against her.

\ln Tsisano hia nuwesei, Unelagi; gadono ietsadeyadodiha?  Osiyu deulvwisdasi tsinaquvga.
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎤᏁᎳᎩ; ᎦᏙᏃ ᎢᎡᏣᏕᏯᏙᏗᎭ?  ᎣᏏᏳ ᏕᎤᎸᏫᏍᏓᏏ ᏥᎾᏋᎦ.
\ft And Jesus said, Let her alone; why trouble ye her? she hath wrought a good work on me.

\syll ᎤᏲᏰᏃ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᎿᏕᎩ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎨᏤᎳᏗᏙᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏳᏉ ᎢᏤᎵᏍᎬᎢ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏱᏂᏕᏣᏛᏂᏏ; ᎠᏴᏍᎩᏂ ᎥᏝ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᏱᏨᏰᎳᏗᏙᎭ.
\ft For ye have the poor with you always, and whensoever ye will ye may do them good: but me ye have not always.

\ln Nigav igvwadvnedi gesv nadvga; igvyi gayehi galugi ulonediyi tsiyele vginisodiyi ugvwali.
\syll ᏂᎦᎥ ᎢᎬᏩᏛᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏛᎦ; ᎢᎬᏱ ᎦᏰᎯ ᎦᎷᎩ ᎤᎶᏁᏗᏱ ᏥᏰᎴ ᎥᎩᏂᏐᏗᏱ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ.
\ft She hath done what she could: she is come aforehand to anoint my body to the burying.

\ln Udohiyuhiya hia nitsvweseha, Ilvhitlv hia nasgi osdv kanohedv alitsidodi nigalisdisgesdi elohi nigvnadvi, hia nasgi tsinadvga nasquo uninohedi gesesdi nasgi aganvdadisdodi.
\syll ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ, ᎢᎸᎯᏢ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎠᎵᏥᏙᏗ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏂᎬᎾᏛᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᎾᏛᎦ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᏂᏃᎮᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎦᏅᏓᏗᏍᏙᏗ.
\ft Verily I say unto you, Wheresoever this gospel shall be preached throughout the whole world, this also that she hath done shall be spoken of for a memorial of her.

\ln Tsudasino Iyagaladi, asiyvwi nasgi taladu iyanidv gesvi, uwenvse nunigvwiyusv atsilvanelohi dininvi, nasgi tsuyohisediyi.
\syll ᏧᏓᏏᏃ ᎢᏯᎦᎳᏗ, ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏔᎳᏚ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᏪᏅᏎ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᏗᏂᏅᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏲᎯᏎᏗᏱ.
\ft And Judas Iscariot, one of the twelve, went unto the chief priests, to betray him unto them.

\ln Unadvganvno osiyu uniyelvnei, ale uniduisdanele adelv tsuninediyi.  Uyoleno osdv udlanvdadediyi tsuyohisediyi.
\syll ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅᏃ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎤᏂᏰᎸᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏚᎢᏍᏓᏁᎴ ᎠᏕᎸ ᏧᏂᏁᏗᏱ.  ᎤᏲᎴᏃ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎤᏜᏅᏓᏕᏗᏱ ᏧᏲᎯᏎᏗᏱ.
\ft And when they heard it, they were glad, and promised to give him money. And he sought how he might conveniently betray him.

\ln Igvyiyino iga nagotanvna gadu agisdiyi, nahiyu unilv kanohiyegi dilisdayvdiyi, gvwasdawadidohi hia nigvwaweselei, Hatlv tsaduli wogadvnvisdodiyi, kanohiyegi tsalisdayvdiyi?
\syll ᎢᎬᏱᏱᏃ ᎢᎦ ᎾᎪᏔᏅᎾ ᎦᏚ ᎠᎩᏍᏗᏱ, ᏀᎢᏳ ᎤᏂᎸ ᎧᏃᎯᏰᎩ ᏗᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ, ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏩᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎭᏢ ᏣᏚᎵ ᏬᎦᏛᏅᎢᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎧᏃᎯᏰᎩ ᏣᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ?
\ft And the first day of unleavened bread, when they killed the passover, his disciples said unto him, Where wilt thou that we go and prepare that thou mayest eat the passover?

\ln Dunvseno anitali gvwasdawadidohi, ale hia niduweselei, Digaduhv isdena, dodatsatlosino asgaya ayehesdi atelido ama atlisdesdi; esdisdawadesvha.
\syll ᏚᏅᏎᏃ ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏗᎦᏚᎲ ᎢᏍᏕᎾ, ᏙᏓᏣᏠᏏᏃ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎠᏰᎮᏍᏗ ᎠᏖᎵᏙ ᎠᎹ ᎠᏟᏍᏕᏍᏗ; ᎡᏍᏗᏍᏓᏩᏕᏒᎭ.
\ft And he sendeth forth two of his disciples, and saith unto them, Go ye into the city, and there shall meet you a man bearing a pitcher of water: follow him.

\ln Ilvhitlvno wayvlvha, hia nesdiweselvha asgaya ganela, Dideyohvsgi hia nigaweha, Hatlv anedohi uniyvsdiyi, nahna kanohiyegi itsulaha ogalisdayvdiyi gvgisdawadidohi.
\syll ᎢᎸᎯᏢᏃ ᏩᏴᎸᎭ, ᎯᎠ ᏁᏍᏗᏪᏎᎸᎭ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎦᏁᎳ, ᏗᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᎭ, ᎭᏢ ᎠᏁᏙᎯ ᎤᏂᏴᏍᏗᏱ, ᏀᎾ ᎧᏃᎯᏰᎩ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎣᎦᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ ᎬᎩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ.
\ft And wheresoever he shall go in, say ye to the goodman of the house, The Master saith, Where is the guestchamber, where I shall eat the passover with my disciples?

\syll ᏓᏍᏓᏎᎮᎵᏃ ᎤᏛᏅ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎧᏅᏑᎸᎢ, ᎦᏳᎳ ᎬᎿᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏛᏅᎢᏍᏔᏅᎯ; ᏀᎾ ᏍᎩᏯᏛᏅᎢᏍᏓᏁᎸᎭ.

\ln Usvno nulistanv ulutse datenehe taladu iyanidv.
\syll ᎤᏒᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ ᎤᎷᏤ ᏓᏖᏁᎮ ᏔᎳᏚ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ.

\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎠᏂᏅᏜᎡᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎨᎢ, ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ, ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᏣᏛᏅ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᏦᏍᏓᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎦ, ᏛᏆᏡᏔᏂ.

\syll ᎤᎾᎴᏅᎮᏃ ᎤᏲ ᎤᏂᏰᎸᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏩᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏌᏉ ᎬᏪᏒᏛ, ᏥᎪ ᎠᏴ?  ᏅᏩᏓᎴᏃ, ᏥᎪ ᎠᏴ?  ᎠᏗᏍᎨᎢ.
