\ft And he answered and said unto them, It is one of the twelve, that dippeth with me in the dish.

\ln Yvwi Uwetsi udohiyuhi uwenvsdi nasgiya nigvnv gowelv atsinohesgvi; aseno uyoiyu iyulisdanedi nasgi asgaya yvwi Uwetsi atludisgi!  osiyu yigese iyuno nasgi asgaya nudenvnaquo yigesei.
\syll ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎤᏪᏅᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏂᎬᏅ ᎪᏪᎸ ᎠᏥᏃᎮᏍᎬᎢ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏲᎢᏳ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎠᏡᏗᏍᎩ  ᎣᏏᏳ ᏱᎨᏎ ᎢᏳᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᏄᏕᏅᎾᏉ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ.
\ft The Son of man indeed goeth, as it is written of him: but woe to that man by whom the Son of man is betrayed! good were it for that man if he had never been born.

\ln Analisdayvhvsgvno Tsisa gadu ugisv, ale ulihelitsv, ugvhaluyei, ale dunelei, ale hia nuwesei, Itsigi, itsiga; hia nasgi ayv tsiyelvi.
\syll ᎠᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎬᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎦᏚ ᎤᎩᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᎮᎵᏨ, ᎤᎬᎭᎷᏰᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏁᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎢᏥᎩ, ᎢᏥᎦ; ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᏥᏰᎸᎢ.
\ft And as they did eat, Jesus took bread, and blessed, and brake it, and gave to them, and said, Take, eat: this is my body.

\ln Ale ulisquidi ugisv, ale ulihelitsv, nasgi dunelei; nigadvno nasgi unaditahei.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏍᏈᏗ ᎤᎩᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᎮᎵᏨ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᏁᎴᎢ; ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᏗᏔᎮᎢ.
\ft And he took the cup, and when he had given thanks, he gave it to them: and they all drank of it.

\ln Hiano niduweselei, hia nasgi ayv agigigv itsv kanohedv datlohisdvi, nasgi unitsati tsigegatsewelv.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᎠᎩᎩᎬ ᎢᏨ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏓᏠᎯᏍᏛᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏥᎨᎦᏤᏪᎸ.
\ft And he said unto them, This is my blood of the new testament, which is shed for many.

\ln Udohiyuhiya hia nitsvweseha, vtla hnaquo ilvhiyu yvgagadita telvladi unanugowisvhi, gvni nahiyu iga itse gaditahvha Unelanvhi utseligohi.
\syll ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ, ᎥᏝ ᎿᏉ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᏴᎦᎦᏗᏔ ᏖᎸᎳᏗ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏫᏒᎯ, ᎬᏂ ᏀᎢᏳ ᎢᎦ ᎢᏤ ᎦᏗᏔᎲᎭ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎪᎯ.
\ft Verily I say unto you, I will drink no more of the fruit of the vine, until that day that I drink it new in the kingdom of God.

\ln Duninogisvno, uninugotse Oliwayo odalv wunilosei.
\syll ᏚᏂᏃᎩᏒᏃ, ᎤᏂᏄᎪᏤ ᎣᎵᏩᏲ ᎣᏓᎸ ᏭᏂᎶᏎᎢ.
\ft And when they had sung an hymn, they went out into the mount of Olives.

\ln Tsisano hia niduweselei, nitsiv nihi dodatsodeli gohi svnoyi tsigi, ayv gesv nvdigalisdodisgesdi; hiayeno nigvnvigowela, Awi digatiya datsiyvnili, uninodenano dvnadigaleyotsi.
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏂᏥᎥ ᏂᎯ ᏙᏓᏦᏕᎵ ᎪᎯ ᏒᏃᏱ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᏴ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ; ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᏂᎬᏅᎢᎪᏪᎳ, ᎠᏫ ᏗᎦᏘᏯ ᏓᏥᏴᏂᎵ, ᎤᏂᏃᏕᎾᏃ ᏛᎾᏗᎦᎴᏲᏥ.
\ft And Jesus saith unto them, All ye shall be offended because of me this night: for it is written, I will smite the shepherd, and the sheep shall be scattered.

\ln Aseno hnaquo diqualenvhi gesesdi, igvyi datsvyenveli Gelili iyvdv.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎿᏉ ᏗᏆᎴᏅᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎢᎬᏱ ᏓᏨᏰᏅᎡᎵ ᎨᎵᎵ ᎢᏴᏛ.
\ft But after that I am risen, I will go before you into Galilee.

\ln Aseno Quida hia nuweselei, Nasquo nigadv yidunodestanv, ayv ase vtla.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᏈᏓ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎾᏍᏉ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏱᏚᏃᏕᏍᏔᏅ, ᎠᏴ ᎠᏎ ᎥᏝ.
\ft But Peter said unto him, Although all shall be offended, yet will not I.

\ln Tsisano hia nuweselei, Udohiyuhiya hia nigvweseha, Nasgi gohi iga, ale gohiquo svnoyi, asi taline naniyvgvna tsataga, tsoi nvdasquadayili.
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏪᏎᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᎯ ᎢᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᎪᎯᏉ ᏒᏃᏱ, ᎠᏏ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎾᏂᏴᎬᎾ ᏣᏔᎦ, ᏦᎢ ᏅᏓᏍᏆᏓᏱᎵ.
\ft And Jesus saith unto him, Verily I say unto thee, That this day, even in this night, before the cock crow twice, thou shalt deny me thrice.

\ln Aseno utli ulinigidv unetse hia nuwesei, Iyuno nasquo itsulaha diginiyohuhisdi yigi, ase vtla yvgagvyadayiga.  Nasgiya nasquo nuniwese nigadv.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏟ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᎤᏁᏤ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᏗᎩᏂᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᏎ ᎥᏝ ᏴᎦᎬᏯᏓᏱᎦ.  ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏄᏂᏪᏎ ᏂᎦᏛ.
\ft But he spake the more vehemently, If I should die with thee, I will not deny thee in any wise. Likewise also said they all.

\ln Geseminino dudov unilutsei; hiano niduwesele gvwasdawadidohi, Ani itsinesdi, wigadadolisdisgv igohidv.
\syll ᎨᏎᎻᏂᏃ ᏚᏙᎥ ᎤᏂᎷᏤᎢ; ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ, ᎠᏂ ᎢᏥᏁᏍᏗ, ᏫᎦᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᎢᎪᎯᏛ.
\ft And they came to a place which was named Gethsemane: and he saith to his disciples, Sit ye here, while I shall pray.

\ln Dutenvseno Quida ale Tsimi ale Tsani, ale ulenvhe utsati udeyatanelei, ale utsati ehisdi udanvdadei;
\syll ᏚᏖᏅᏎᏃ ᏈᏓ ᎠᎴ ᏥᎻ ᎠᎴ ᏣᏂ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎴᏅᎮ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᏕᏯᏔᏁᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎡᎯᏍᏗ ᎤᏓᏅᏓᏕᎢ;
\ft And he taketh with him Peter and James and John, and began to be sore amazed, and to be very heavy;

\ln Ale hia niduweselei, Aquadanvdo utsati udeyataneha ayohuhisdi nasgiyai; ani itsinesdi, ale itsiyawisgesdi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᏕᏯᏔᏁᎭ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ; ᎠᏂ ᎢᏥᏁᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏥᏯᏫᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
\ft And saith unto them, My soul is exceeding sorrowful unto death: tarry ye here, and watch.

\ln Usdigidvno iyvdv iuwenv, eladi udanvnei, ale udadolistane, utayolei, nasgi yeli igvwalisdodi yigi, nahiyu gesv ulohisediyiquo.
\syll ᎤᏍᏗᎩᏛᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎢᎤᏪᏅ, ᎡᎳᏗ ᎤᏓᏅᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏔᏁ, ᎤᏔᏲᎴᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏰᎵ ᎢᎬᏩᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᏱᎩ, ᏀᎢᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎶᎯᏎᏗᏱᏉ.
\ft And he went forward a little, and fell on the ground, and prayed that, if it were possible, the hour might pass from him.

\ln Ale hia nuwesei, Aqua, Edoda, nihi, gesv yeligayaquo igetsadvnedi nigavi; sgihvsiquo hia nasgi ulisquidi; vtlasgininonv ayv aquadulisgvi, nihisgini tsadulisgvi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎠᏆ, ᎡᏙᏓ, ᏂᎯ, ᎨᏒ ᏰᎵᎦᏯᏉ ᎢᎨᏣᏛᏁᏗ ᏂᎦᎥᎢ; ᏍᎩᎲᏏᏉ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎵᏍᏈᏗ; ᎥᏝᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎠᏴ ᎠᏆᏚᎵᏍᎬᎢ, ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᏣᏚᎵᏍᎬᎢ.
\ft And he said, Abba, Father, all things are possible unto thee; take away this cup from me: nevertheless not what I will, but what thou wilt.

\ln Iulutseno ale duwadvhe anilinaei, ale hia nuwesele Quida, Sawani, hilihaquotsu?  Tlasgo sutlilodvquo igohidv nasquo getsayawisdi yigesei?
\syll ᎢᎤᎷᏤᏃ ᎠᎴ ᏚᏩᏛᎮ ᎠᏂᎵᎾᎡᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴ ᏈᏓ, ᏌᏩᏂ, ᎯᎵᎭᏉᏧ?  ᏝᏍᎪ ᏑᏟᎶᏛᏉ ᎢᎪᎯᏛ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎨᏣᏯᏫᏍᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ?
\ft And he cometh, and findeth them sleeping, and saith unto Peter, Simon, sleepest thou? couldest not thou watch one hour?

\ln Itsiyawisgesdi ale itsadadolisdisgesdi nasgi tlesdi udalenasdiyi witsinanugotsvgi; Adanvdo udohiyuhi udvnvisdi, uquedalvsgini awanagalahiyu.
\syll ᎢᏥᏯᏫᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏣᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎤᏓᎴᎾᏍᏗᏱ ᏫᏥᎾᏄᎪᏨᎩ; ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎤᏛᏅᎢᏍᏗ, ᎤᏇᏓᎸᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏩᎾᎦᎳᎯᏳ.
\ft Watch ye and pray, lest ye enter into temptation. The spirit truly is ready, but the flesh is weak.

\ln Talineno iyvdv wulosv, udadolistanei, nuwesv nasgiya winuwesei.
\syll ᏔᎵᏁᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏭᎶᏒ, ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᏄᏪᏒ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏫᏄᏪᏎᎢ.
\ft And again he went away, and prayed, and spake the same words.

\ln Diulutsvno duwadvhe taline anilinaei, dinigadoliyeno digagediyu gesei, vtla ale yinigatahe iyuniwesdiyi uninetsediyi.
\syll ᏗᎤᎷᏨᏃ ᏚᏩᏛᎮ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎠᏂᎵᎾᎡᎢ, ᏗᏂᎦᏙᎵᏰᏃ ᏗᎦᎨᏗᏳ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᏱᏂᎦᏔᎮ ᎢᏳᏂᏪᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏂᏁᏤᏗᏱ.
\ft And when he returned, he found them asleep again, (for their eyes were heavy,) neither wist they what to answer him.

\ln Tsoineno widulutselei, ale hia niduweselei, getsilinesdiquo hnaquo, ale itsatsawesolvsda; Hnaquo galosonahnaquo asqualv nahiyu gesvi; gvniyuquo yvwi Uwetsi anisgana degetsiyohisi.
\syll ᏦᎢᏁᏃ ᏫᏚᎷᏤᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎨᏥᎵᏁᏍᏗᏉ ᎿᏉ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏣᏣᏪᏐᎸᏍᏓ; ᎿᏉ ᎦᎶᏐᏀᎾᏉ ᎠᏍᏆᎸ ᏀᎢᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᎾ ᏕᎨᏥᏲᎯᏏ.
\ft And he cometh the third time, and saith unto them, Sleep on now, and take your rest: it is enough, the hour is come; behold, the Son of man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.

\ln Ditsalehvga, idena; gvniyuquo aquatludisgi esganiyu dayai.
\syll ᏗᏣᎴᎲᎦ, ᎢᏕᎾ; ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎠᏆᏡᏗᏍᎩ ᎡᏍᎦᏂᏳ ᏓᏯᎢ.
\ft Rise up, let us go; lo, he that betrayeth me is at hand.

\ln Gilaquono iyvdv asiquo gawenisgei, tsunalvgotse, Tsudasi, asiyvwi taladu iyanidv gesv, datinehe unitsati, ayelasdidiganvhidv ale ada dininehi, nvdagvwaninvsidv nunigvwiyusv atsilvanelohi, ale dinowelisgi, ale dinilawigi.
\syll ᎩᎳᏉᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎠᏏᏉ ᎦᏪᏂᏍᎨᎢ, ᏧᎾᎸᎪᏤ, ᏧᏓᏏ, ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᏔᎳᏚ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᎨᏒ, ᏓᏘᏁᎮ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ, ᎠᏰᎳᏍᏗᏗᎦᏅᎯᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏓ ᏗᏂᏁᎯ, ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏂᏅᏏᏛ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸᎠᏁᎶᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏃᏪᎵᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏂᎳᏫᎩ.
\ft And immediately, while he yet spake, cometh Judas, one of the twelve, and with him a great multitude with swords and staves, from the chief priests and the scribes and the elders.

\ln Utludisgino gvnigesv itsuwanelvhi gese unadolehohisdodi, hia iyuwesvhi gesei, Gilo tsiyadutsalanvha, nasgi gesesdi, svtsiniyvhvha, etsatinawidvhvha gvwadudalesdi nigesvna netsvnesdi.
\syll ᎤᏡᏗᏍᎩᏃ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏧᏩᏁᎸᎯ ᎨᏎ ᎤᎾᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏙᏗ, ᎯᎠ ᎢᏳᏪᏒᎯ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎩᎶ ᏥᏯᏚᏣᎳᏅᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᏒᏥᏂᏴᎲᎭ, ᎡᏣᏘᎾᏫᏛᎲᎭ ᎬᏩᏚᏓᎴᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏁᏨᏁᏍᏗ.
\ft And he that betrayed him had given them a token, saying, Whomsoever I shall kiss, that same is he; take him, and lead him away safely.

\ln Ulutsvquono gilaquo iyvdv wulutselei, ale hia nuwesei, Disqueyohvsgi, Disqueyohvsgi; ale udutsalanei.
\syll ᎤᎷᏨᏉᏃ ᎩᎳᏉ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏭᎷᏤᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᏗᏍᏇᏲᎲᏍᎩ, ᏗᏍᏇᏲᎲᏍᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᏚᏣᎳᏁᎢ.
\ft And as soon as he was come, he goeth straightway to him, and saith, Master, master; and kissed him.

\ln Degvwasitadeno, ale gvwaniyvhei.
\syll ᏕᎬᏩᏏᏔᏕᏃ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᏂᏴᎮᎢ.
\ft And they laid their hands on him, and took him.

\ln Asiyvwino nav anidohnai, ayelasdiganvhidv ulvhei, ale nugvwiyusv atsilvgelohi unvsidasdi uluye ale ulisdestanei.
\syll ᎠᏏᏴᏫᏃ ᎾᎥ ᎠᏂᏙᎿᎢ, ᎠᏰᎳᏍᏗᎦᏅᎯᏛ ᎤᎸᎮᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸᎨᎶᎯ ᎤᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎤᎷᏰ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏍᏕᏍᏔᏁᎢ.
\ft And one of them that stood by drew a sword, and smote a servant of the high priest, and cut off his ear.

\ln Tsisano unetsv hia niduweselei, Tsigo ganosgisgi tsvtsetsiniyvhiso nasgiya itsilugi, ditsinehi ayelasdidiganvhidv ale ada ayv sginiyvhoga?
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏥᎪ ᎦᏃᏍᎩᏍᎩ ᏨᏤᏥᏂᏴᎯᏐ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎢᏥᎷᎩ, ᏗᏥᏁᎯ ᎠᏰᎳᏍᏗᏗᎦᏅᎯᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏓ ᎠᏴ ᏍᎩᏂᏴᎰᎦ?
\ft And Jesus answered and said unto them, Are ye come out, as against a thief, with swords and with staves to take me?

\ln Nidugitsvnisv itsvyeladidohvgi udvnvdigalawiisdiyi, degadeyohvsgvgi, ale vtla yisginiyvhei; udohiyudisgininonv nigvnv Gowelvi.
\syll ᏂᏚᎩᏨᏂᏒ ᎢᏨᏰᎳᏗᏙᎲᎩ ᎤᏛᏅᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᏕᎦᏕᏲᎲᏍᎬᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏍᎩᏂᏴᎮᎢ; ᎤᏙᎯᏳᏗᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᏂᎬᏅ ᎪᏪᎸᎢ.
\ft I was daily with you in the temple teaching, and ye took me not: but the scriptures must be fulfilled.

\ln Nigadiyuno gvwadetsonei, ale unalisei.
\syll ᏂᎦᏗᏳᏃ ᎬᏩᏕᏦᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᎵᏎᎢ.
\ft And they all forsook him, and fled.

\ln Gilono iyusdi awinv usdawadvsei, doledv anuwo udaquenvde uyelvha gesvi; aniwinvno gvwaniyvhei.
\syll ᎩᎶᏃ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏫᏅ ᎤᏍᏓᏩᏛᏎᎢ, ᏙᎴᏛ ᎠᏄᏬ ᎤᏓᏇᏅᏕ ᎤᏰᎸᎭ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎠᏂᏫᏅᏃ ᎬᏩᏂᏴᎮᎢ.
\ft And there followed him a certain young man, having a linen cloth cast about his naked body; and the young men laid hold on him:

\ln Doledvno anuwo uniyei, ale uyelvha dulitielei.
\syll ᏙᎴᏛᏃ ᎠᏄᏬ ᎤᏂᏰᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏰᎸᎭ ᏚᎵᏘᎡᎴᎢ.
\ft And he left the linen cloth, and fled from them naked.

\ln Tsisano nugvwiyusv atsilvgelohi tsuwolv wunatinvstanei; nasgino degvwalawie nigadv nunigvwiyusv atsilvanelohi, ale dinilawigi, ale dinowelisgi.
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸᎨᎶᎯ ᏧᏬᎸ ᏭᎾᏘᏅᏍᏔᏁᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏕᎬᏩᎳᏫᎡ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸᎠᏁᎶᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏂᎳᏫᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏃᏪᎵᏍᎩ.
\ft And they led Jesus away to the high priest: and with him were assembled all the chief priests and the elders and the scribes.

\ln Quidano ge iyvdv usdawadisei, nasgi nugvwiyusv atsilvgelohi diganelv wuyvlei, uwoleno getsinvsidasdi aninvi, ale godv uganawosgei.
\syll ᏈᏓᏃ Ꭸ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎤᏍᏓᏩᏗᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸᎨᎶᎯ ᏗᎦᏁᎸ ᏭᏴᎴᎢ, ᎤᏬᎴᏃ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎠᏂᏅᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎪᏛ ᎤᎦᎾᏬᏍᎨᎢ.
\ft And Peter followed him afar off, even into the palace of the high priest: and he sat with the servants, and warmed himself at the fire.

\ln Nunigvwiyusvno atsilvanelohi ale nigadv danilawiv uniyohe uninohelvhi Tsisa utludisgi, nasgi unihisdiyi, unatlotseno.
\syll ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒᏃ ᎠᏥᎸᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏓᏂᎳᏫᎥ ᎤᏂᏲᎮ ᎤᏂᏃᎮᎸᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎤᏡᏗᏍᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᎯᏍᏗᏱ, ᎤᎾᏠᏤᏃ.
\ft And the chief priests and all the council sought for witness against Jesus to put him to death; and found none.

\ln Unitsateyeno gayegogi aninohesgi gvwatludisgei, aseno aninohesgv vtla utloyi yigesei.
\syll ᎤᏂᏣᏖᏰᏃ ᎦᏰᎪᎩ ᎠᏂᏃᎮᏍᎩ ᎬᏩᏡᏗᏍᎨᎢ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᏂᏃᎮᏍᎬ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏠᏱ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ.
\ft For many bare false witness against him, but their witness agreed not together.

\ln Dunaleneno gilo iyunasdi ale gayegogi uninohele gvwatludisgvi, hia naniwesgei;
\syll ᏚᎾᎴᏁᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎦᏰᎪᎩ ᎤᏂᏃᎮᎴ ᎬᏩᏡᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏂᏪᏍᎨᎢ;
\ft And there arose certain, and bare false witness against him, saying,

\ln Ogadvganvgi hia nikawesgvgi, Datsiyostani hia udvnvdigalawiisdiyi, nasgi digoyi digvtanvhi gotlvnvhi, tsoiquono tsusvhidv dvtsiyilidoli dvganesgehi nvwadale digoyi digvtanvhi nigesvna.
\syll ᎣᎦᏛᎦᏅᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎧᏪᏍᎬᎩ, ᏓᏥᏲᏍᏔᏂ ᎯᎠ ᎤᏛᏅᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎪᏱ ᏗᎬᏔᏅᎯ ᎪᏢᏅᎯ, ᏦᎢᏉᏃ ᏧᏒᎯᏛ ᏛᏥᏱᎵᏙᎵ ᏛᎦᏁᏍᎨᎯ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᏗᎪᏱ ᏗᎬᏔᏅᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.
\ft We heard him say, I will destroy this temple that is made with hands, and within three days I will build another made without hands.

\ln Aseno nasquo nasgi uninohelvhi vtla utloyi yigesei.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᏃᎮᎸᎯ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏠᏱ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ.
\ft But neither so did their witness agree together.

\ln Nugvwiyusvno atsilvgelohi ayeli ulenv, udvdvne Tsisa, hia newesei, Tlasgo gohusdi yadiha?  Gado nasgi hia tsaninoheha getsatludisgvi?
\syll ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒᏃ ᎠᏥᎸᎨᎶᎯ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎤᎴᏅ, ᎤᏛᏛᏁ ᏥᏌ, ᎯᎠ ᏁᏪᏎᎢ, ᏝᏍᎪ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏯᏗᎭ?  ᎦᏙ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏣᏂᏃᎮᎭ ᎨᏣᏡᏗᏍᎬᎢ?
\ft And the high priest stood up in the midst, and asked Jesus, saying, Answerest thou nothing? what is it which these witness against thee?

\ln Aseno elawequo uwasei, ale vtla gohusdi yudvne tsvnetsei.  Nugvwiyusvno atsilvgelohi taline udvdvne, ale hia nuweselei, Nihisgo Galonedv, Atsilvquodi Uwetsi?
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎡᎳᏪᏉ ᎤᏩᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏳᏛᏁ ᏨᏁᏤᎢ.  ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒᏃ ᎠᏥᎸᎨᎶᎯ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎤᏛᏛᏁ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏂᎯᏍᎪ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ, ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏗ ᎤᏪᏥ?
\ft But he held his peace, and answered nothing. Again the high priest asked him, and said unto him, Art thou the Christ, the Son of the Blessed?

\ln Tsisano hia nuwesei, Ayv nasgi; ale dayetsigoi yvwi Uwetsi uwolesdi agatisi iditlv ulinigidv gesvi, ale tsaisesdi ulogilv galvloi.
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᏓᏰᏥᎪᎢ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎤᏬᎴᏍᏗ ᎠᎦᏘᏏ ᎢᏗᏢ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏣᎢᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᎶᎩᎸ ᎦᎸᎶᎢ.
\ft And Jesus said, I am: and ye shall see the Son of man sitting on the right hand of power, and coming in the clouds of heaven.

\ln Nugvwiyusvno atsilvgelohi dunuwav duwetsagalvhei, hia nuwesei, Gadono asi yidigaduli aninohesgi?
\syll ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒᏃ ᎠᏥᎸᎨᎶᎯ ᏚᏄᏩᎥ ᏚᏪᏣᎦᎸᎮᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎦᏙᏃ ᎠᏏ ᏱᏗᎦᏚᎵ ᎠᏂᏃᎮᏍᎩ?
\ft Then the high priest rent his clothes, and saith, What need we any further witnesses?

\ln Itsadvgvga asotlvisdisgvi; gado itseliha?  nigadvno degvwugodanele yeliquo gvwayohuhisdi gesvi.
\syll ᎢᏣᏛᎬᎦ ᎠᏐᏢᎢᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ; ᎦᏙ ᎢᏤᎵᎭ?  ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᏕᎬᏭᎪᏓᏁᎴ ᏰᎵᏉ ᎬᏩᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Ye have heard the blasphemy: what think ye? And they all condemned him to be guilty of death.

\ln Igadvno unalenvhe degvwalitsisquasgei, ale ukadv gvwutlvnehei, ale asquinv degvwanidisgei, ale hia nigvwawesehei, Hadolehohi; ale getsinvsidasdi degvwanihei.
\syll ᎢᎦᏛᏃ ᎤᎾᎴᏅᎮ ᏕᎬᏩᎵᏥᏍᏆᏍᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎧᏛ ᎬᏭᏢᏁᎮᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏍᏈᏅ ᏕᎬᏩᏂᏗᏍᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏩᏪᏎᎮᎢ, ᎭᏙᎴᎰᎯ; ᎠᎴ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᏕᎬᏩᏂᎮᎢ.
\ft And some began to spit on him, and to cover his face, and to buffet him, and to say unto him, Prophesy: and the servants did strike him with the palms of their hands.

\ln Quidano eladitlv nahna adanelv edohei, ulutse asiyvwi ageyv nugvwiyusv atsilvgelohi unvsidasdi.
\syll ᏈᏓᏃ ᎡᎳᏗᏢ ᏀᎾ ᎠᏓᏁᎸ ᎡᏙᎮᎢ, ᎤᎷᏤ ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᎠᎨᏴ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸᎨᎶᎯ ᎤᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ.
\ft And as Peter was beneath in the palace, there cometh one of the maids of the high priest:

\ln Nasgino ugohv Quida uganawosgvi, dukahnanei, ale hia nuwesei, Nihi nasquo tsisdedohvgi Tsisa Naselidi ehi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᎪᎲ ᏈᏓ ᎤᎦᎾᏬᏍᎬᎢ, ᏚᎧᎿᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᏂᎯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏥᏍᏕᏙᎲᎩ ᏥᏌ ᎾᏎᎵᏗ ᎡᎯ.
\ft And when she saw Peter warming himself, she looked upon him, and said, And thou also wast with Jesus of Nazareth.

\ln Aseno udayilei, hia nuwesei, Vtla yitsigataha, vtla ale yigoliga niwesgvi.  Unugotseno doyiditlv wayodatlahv wulosei; tsatagano uyvlisei.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏓᏱᎴᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᏱᏥᎦᏔᎭ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᏱᎪᎵᎦ ᏂᏪᏍᎬᎢ.  ᎤᏄᎪᏤᏃ ᏙᏱᏗᏢ ᏩᏲᏓᏝᎲ ᏭᎶᏎᎢ; ᏣᏔᎦᏃ ᎤᏴᎵᏎᎢ.
\ft But he denied, saying, I know not, neither understand I what thou sayest. And he went out into the porch; and the cock crew.

\ln Advno taline ugohei, ale ulenvhe hia niduwesele nav anidonai, hia nasgi nahna gela.
\syll ᎠᏛᏃ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎤᎪᎮᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎴᏅᎮ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴ ᎾᎥ ᎠᏂᏙᎾᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏀᎾ ᎨᎳ.
\ft And a maid saw him again, and began to say to them that stood by, This is one of them.

\ln Talineno udayilei.  Nigohilvnano oni nasgi nav anidonai taline hia nuniwesele Quida, Udohiyuhi nihi nahna hela; Geliliyeno hehi, ale gowonisgv utloyi igi.
\syll ᏔᎵᏁᏃ ᎤᏓᏱᎴᎢ.  ᏂᎪᎯᎸᎾᏃ ᎣᏂ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᎥ ᎠᏂᏙᎾᎢ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎴ ᏈᏓ, ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᏂᎯ ᏀᎾ ᎮᎳ; ᎨᎵᎵᏰᏃ ᎮᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎪᏬᏂᏍᎬ ᎤᏠᏱ ᎢᎩ.
\ft And he denied it again. And a little after, they that stood by said again to Peter, Surely thou art one of them: for thou art a Galilaean, and thy speech agreeth thereto.

\ln Aseno ulenvhe usginvde ale uselitane hia newesei, Vtla yitsigataha na asgaya nasgi tsetsinoheha.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᎴᏅᎮ ᎤᏍᎩᏅᏕ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏎᎵᏔᏁ ᎯᎠ ᏁᏪᏎᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᏱᏥᎦᏔᎭ Ꮎ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏤᏥᏃᎮᎭ.
\ft But he began to curse and to swear, saying, I know not this man of whom ye speak.

\ln Talineno uyvlise tsataga.  Quidano unvdade Tsisa nuwesvi, hia tsinuweselei, Asi tsataga tali nuyvlasvna gesesdi, tsoi nvdasquadayili.  Nasgino udanvtelv dutloyilei.
\syll ᏔᎵᏁᏃ ᎤᏴᎵᏎ ᏣᏔᎦ.  ᏈᏓᏃ ᎤᏅᏓᏕ ᏥᏌ ᏄᏪᏒᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏥᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎠᏏ ᏣᏔᎦ ᏔᎵ ᏄᏴᎳᏒᎾ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᏦᎢ ᏅᏓᏍᏆᏓᏱᎵ.  ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᏓᏅᏖᎸ ᏚᏠᏱᎴᎢ.
\ft And the second time the cock crew. And Peter called to mind the word that Jesus said unto him, Before the cock crow twice, thou shalt deny me thrice. And when he thought thereon, he wept.

\ln Gilaquono iyvdv wugitsvnv nunigvwiyusv atsilvanelohi, ale tsunadvsonvhi, ale dinowelisgi, ale nigadv dinilawigi unalinohelv unalvle Tsisa, ale  unatinawidvhei, ale Qualedi widuniyohiselei.
\syll ᎩᎳᏉᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏭᎩᏨᏅ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸᎠᏁᎶᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᎾᏛᏐᏅᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏃᏪᎵᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏗᏂᎳᏫᎩ ᎤᎾᎵᏃᎮᎸ ᎤᎾᎸᎴ ᏥᏌ, ᎠᎴ  ᎤᎾᏘᎾᏫᏛᎮᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏆᎴᏗ ᏫᏚᏂᏲᎯᏎᎴᎢ.
\ft And straightway in the morning the chief priests held a consultation with the elders and scribes and the whole council, and bound Jesus, and carried him away, and delivered him to Pilate.

\ln Qualedino udvdvne hia nuweselei, Nihisgo Tsagvwiyuhi Anitsusi unatseliga?  Unetsvno hia nuweselei, Yeliquo niwi.
\syll ᏆᎴᏗᏃ ᎤᏛᏛᏁ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏂᎯᏍᎪ ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ?  ᎤᏁᏨᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏰᎵᏉ ᏂᏫ.
\ft And Pilate asked him, Art thou the King of the Jews? And he answering said unto him, Thou sayest it.

\ln Nunigvwiyusvno atsilvanelohi utsate tsudalenvdv gvwuhisdisgei.
\syll ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒᏃ ᎠᏥᎸᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᎤᏣᏖ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎬᏭᎯᏍᏗᏍᎨᎢ.
\ft And the chief priests accused him of many things: but he answered nothing.

\ln Qualedino taline udvdvne hia nuwesei; Tlasgo gohusdi yadiha?  Gvniyuquo utsati tsudalenvdv aninoheha getsatludiha.
\syll ᏆᎴᏗᏃ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎤᏛᏛᏁ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᏝᏍᎪ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏯᏗᎭ?  ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎠᏂᏃᎮᎭ ᎨᏣᏡᏗᎭ.
\ft And Pilate asked him again, saying, Answerest thou nothing? behold how many things they witness against thee.

\ln Aseno Tsisa asi vtla gohusdi yadisgei; nasgi iyusdi Qualedi usquanigosei.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎠᏏ ᎥᏝ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏯᏗᏍᎨᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏆᎴᏗ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏎᎢ.
\ft But Jesus yet answered nothing; so that Pilate marvelled.

\ln Danalisdayvhvsgvno iyui dayohisehe asiyvwi ayvgi, nasgiquo anitayoha.
\syll ᏓᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎬᏃ ᎢᏳᎢ ᏓᏲᎯᏎᎮ ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᎠᏴᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩᏉ ᎠᏂᏔᏲᎭ.
\ft Now at that feast he released unto them one prisoner, whomsoever they desired.

\ln Asiyvwino ehe Qualaqua tsudoidv nasgi itsulaha degegalve gvwaligonelvhi unadasuyedv unalitelvnvhi, nasgi unadalvhi gese nahiyu unadasuyedv unalitelvnvi.
\syll ᎠᏏᏴᏫᏃ ᎡᎮ ᏆᎳᏆ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᏕᎨᎦᎸᎡ ᎬᏩᎵᎪᏁᎸᎯ ᎤᎾᏓᏑᏰᏛ ᎤᎾᎵᏖᎸᏅᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᏓᎸᎯ ᎨᏎ ᏀᎢᏳ ᎤᎾᏓᏑᏰᏛ ᎤᎾᎵᏖᎸᏅᎢ.
\ft And there was one named Barabbas, which lay bound with them that had made insurrection with him, who had committed murder in the insurrection.

\ln Unitsatino asdaya unalisdei, unalenvhe unitayole nasgiya nidudvnelv tsuwagutanvsv itsudvnediyi.
\syll ᎤᏂᏣᏘᏃ ᎠᏍᏓᏯ ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏕᎢ, ᎤᎾᎴᏅᎮ ᎤᏂᏔᏲᎴ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏂᏚᏛᏁᎸ ᏧᏩᎫᏔᏅᏒ ᎢᏧᏛᏁᏗᏱ.
\ft And the multitude crying aloud began to desire him to do as he had ever done unto them.

\ln Qualedino dunetsele hia nuwesei, Itsadulisgo Ugvwiyuhi Anitsusi unatseliga diyuyohisediyi.
\syll ᏆᎴᏗᏃ ᏚᏁᏤᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎢᏣᏚᎵᏍᎪ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ ᏗᏳᏲᎯᏎᏗᏱ.
\ft But Pilate answered them, saying, Will ye that I release unto you the King of the Jews?

\ln Agataheyeno nasgi nunigvwiyusv atsilvanelohi anvyutsehvquo nvdigalisdodisgv degvwayosvi.
\syll ᎠᎦᏔᎮᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᎠᏅᏳᏤᎲᏉ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬ ᏕᎬᏩᏲᏒᎢ.
\ft For he knew that the chief priests had delivered him for envy.

\ln Aseno nunigvyusv atsilvanelohi nunvnisane unitsati yvwi, nasgi Qualaqua unitayosdiyi tsuyohisediyi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᏄᏂᎬᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᏄᏅᏂᏌᏁ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏴᏫ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏆᎳᏆ ᎤᏂᏔᏲᏍᏗᏱ ᏧᏲᎯᏎᏗᏱ.
\ft But the chief priests moved the people, that he should rather release Barabbas unto them.

\ln Qualedino taline unetsv, hia niduweselei, Gadono itsaduli tsiyvnediyi nasgi na Ugvwiyuhi Anitsusi unatseliga tsetsoseha?
\syll ᏆᎴᏗᏃ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎤᏁᏨ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎦᏙᏃ ᎢᏣᏚᎵ ᏥᏴᏁᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ ᏤᏦᏎᎭ?
\ft And Pilate answered and said again unto them, What will ye then that I shall do unto him whom ye call the King of the Jews?

\ln Talineno unelunei hiyadvvga unadvnei.
\syll ᏔᎵᏁᏃ ᎤᏁᎷᏁᎢ ᎯᏯᏛᎥᎦ ᎤᎾᏛᏁᎢ.
\ft And they cried out again, Crucify him.

\ln Qualedino hia niduweselei, Gadono, gado usdi uyo dulvwisdanelv?  Aseno utliquo iyasdaya unelunei, hiyadvvga, unadvnei.
\syll ᏆᎴᏗᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎦᏙᏃ, ᎦᏙ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎤᏲ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸ?  ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏟᏉ ᎢᏯᏍᏓᏯ ᎤᏁᎷᏁᎢ, ᎯᏯᏛᎥᎦ, ᎤᎾᏛᏁᎢ.
\ft Then Pilate said unto them, Why, what evil hath he done? And they cried out the more exceedingly, Crucify him.

\ln Qualedino osiyu uyelvse osdv tsudanvdadisdodiyi unitsati, duyohisele Qualaqua, Tsisano ulivnilv duyose agadvdiyi.
\syll ᏆᎴᏗᏃ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎤᏰᎸᏎ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏧᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ, ᏚᏲᎯᏎᎴ ᏆᎳᏆ, ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᎵᎥᏂᎸ ᏚᏲᏎ ᎠᎦᏛᏗᏱ.
\ft And so Pilate, willing to content the people, released Barabbas unto them, and delivered Jesus, when he had scourged him, to be crucified.

\ln Aniyawisgino gvwatinawidvhe wigvwayvtane ugvwiyuhiyi adanelvi nasgi ugvwiyuhi tsatsilawitsediyi, nigadvno sunadatlugi widuniyanvhei.
\syll ᎠᏂᏯᏫᏍᎩᏃ ᎬᏩᏘᎾᏫᏛᎮ ᏫᎬᏩᏴᏔᏁ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᏱ ᎠᏓᏁᎸᎢ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏣᏥᎳᏫᏤᏗᏱ, ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᏑᎾᏓᏡᎩ ᏫᏚᏂᏯᏅᎮᎢ.
\ft And the soldiers led him away into the hall, called Praetorium; and they call together the whole band.

\ln Gigageno gvwanuweei, ale alisdulo tsutsayosdi gotlvtanvhi unisdeyonv, nasgi unisdulotanei.
\syll ᎩᎦᎨᏃ ᎬᏩᏄᏪᎡᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎵᏍᏚᎶ ᏧᏣᏲᏍᏗ ᎪᏢᏔᏅᎯ ᎤᏂᏍᏕᏲᏅ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᏍᏚᎶᏔᏁᎢ.
\ft And they clothed him with purple, and platted a crown of thorns, and put it about his head,

\ln Ale unalenvhe aniyolihei, itsvyoliga, Tsagvwiyuhi Anitsusi unatseliga, anadisgei.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᎴᏅᎮ ᎠᏂᏲᎵᎮᎢ, ᎢᏨᏲᎵᎦ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ, ᎠᎾᏗᏍᎨᎢ.
\ft And began to salute him, Hail, King of the Jews!

\ln Asgolino degvwanihe ganasda gvdi, ale degvwalitsisquasgei, ale danaliniquanvvsge gvwadadolisdanehei.
\syll ᎠᏍᎪᎵᏃ ᏕᎬᏩᏂᎮ ᎦᎾᏍᏓ ᎬᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᎬᏩᎵᏥᏍᏆᏍᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᎾᎵᏂᏆᏅᎥᏍᎨ ᎬᏩᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎮᎢ.
\ft And they smote him on the head with a reed, and did spit upon him, and bowing their knees worshipped him.

\ln Unadehotanonvno, gvwanuwese gigagei, ale uwasv tsunuwo degvwanuwoei, ale wigvwatinvstane gvwadvdiyi.
\syll ᎤᎾᏕᎰᏔᏃᏅᏃ, ᎬᏩᏄᏪᏎ ᎩᎦᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏧᏄᏬ ᏕᎬᏩᏄᏬᎡᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏫᎬᏩᏘᏅᏍᏔᏁ ᎬᏩᏛᏗᏱ.
\ft And when they had mocked him, they took off the purple from him, and put his own clothes on him, and led him out to crucify him.

\ln Gilono iyusdi Sawani tsudoidv Salini ehi aisei, dodigalogesv nvdayulosvhi, nasgi Eligi ale Luquasi unidoda, nasgi utseli tsudahnawadv uwenvsdiyi nunvnelei.
\syll ᎩᎶᏃ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏌᏩᏂ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ ᏌᎵᏂ ᎡᎯ ᎠᎢᏎᎢ, ᏙᏗᎦᎶᎨᏒ ᏅᏓᏳᎶᏒᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᎵᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎷᏆᏏ ᎤᏂᏙᏓ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏧᏓᎿᏩᏛ ᎤᏪᏅᏍᏗᏱ ᏄᏅᏁᎴᎢ.
\ft And they compel one Simon a Cyrenian, who passed by, coming out of the country, the father of Alexander and Rufus, to bear his cross.

\ln Goligadano dudov wigvwatinvtanei, nasgi anetlvtanvhi gesv usqualugo gadvga.
\syll ᎪᎵᎦᏓᏃ ᏚᏙᎥ ᏫᎬᏩᏘᏅᏔᏁᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏁᏢᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏍᏆᎷᎪ ᎦᏛᎦ.
\ft And they bring him unto the place Golgotha, which is, being interpreted, The place of a skull.

\ln Gvwaneneleno uditasdi gigageaditasdi mila asuli; aseno vtla yunegisei.
\syll ᎬᏩᏁᏁᎴᏃ ᎤᏗᏔᏍᏗ ᎩᎦᎨᎠᏗᏔᏍᏗ ᎻᎳ ᎠᏑᎵ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏳᏁᎩᏎᎢ.
\ft And they gave him to drink wine mingled with myrrh: but he received it not.

\ln Hnaquono dadahnawasdv gvwadvnv uniyadole tsunuwoi, unasesvhe unadolehohisdiyi nasgi anisiyvwiha tsuninesvsdi gesvi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏓᏓᎿᏩᏍᏛ ᎬᏩᏛᏅ ᎤᏂᏯᏙᎴ ᏧᏄᏬᎢ, ᎤᎾᏎᏒᎮ ᎤᎾᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏂᏏᏴᏫᎭ ᏧᏂᏁᏒᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft And when they had crucified him, they parted his garments, casting lots upon them, what every man should take.

\ln Soonelano iyutlilodv kalawadisv gesei, ale gvwadvnei.
\syll ᏐᎣᏁᎳᏃ ᎢᏳᏟᎶᏛ ᎧᎳᏩᏗᏒ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᏛᏁᎢ.
\ft And it was the third hour, and they crucified him.

\ln Galvladitlvno gowele nusdv aguisdvi, hia nigvnei, UGvWiYuHi ANiTsuSi UNaTseLiGa.
\syll ᎦᎸᎳᏗᏢᏃ ᎪᏪᎴ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎠᎫᎢᏍᏛᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏁᎢ, ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ.
\ft And the superscription of his accusation was written over, THE KING OF THE JEWS.

\ln Itsulahano degegadvne anitali dinadanasahvsgi; asiyvwi agatisiditlv, soino agasgani iditlv.
\syll ᎢᏧᎳᎭᏃ ᏕᎨᎦᏛᏁ ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᏗᎾᏓᎾᏌᎲᏍᎩ; ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᎠᎦᏘᏏᏗᏢ, ᏐᎢᏃ ᎠᎦᏍᎦᏂ ᎢᏗᏢ.
\ft And with him they crucify two thieves; the one on his right hand, and the other on his left.

\ln Gowelvno udohiyunei, hia tsinigaweha, unisganvtsvhi gegaselv agatloyastanvgi.
\syll ᎪᏪᎸᏃ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᏁᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᎦᏪᎭ, ᎤᏂᏍᎦᏅᏨᎯ ᎨᎦᏎᎸ ᎠᎦᏠᏯᏍᏔᏅᎩ.
\ft And the scripture was fulfilled, which saith, And he was numbered with the transgressors.

\ln Anilosgino gagvwasotlvdisgei, ale danalisdvnihe hia naniwesgei, Yo, udvnvdigalawiisdiyi hiyosdisgi, ale tsoiquoquo iga hiyilidohi hanesgesgi,
\syll ᎠᏂᎶᏍᎩᏃ ᎦᎬᏩᏐᏢᏗᏍᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᎾᎵᏍᏛᏂᎮ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏂᏪᏍᎨᎢ, Ᏺ, ᎤᏛᏅᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎯᏲᏍᏗᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏦᎢᏉᏉ ᎢᎦ ᎯᏱᎵᏙᎯ ᎭᏁᏍᎨᏍᎩ,
\ft And they that passed by railed on him, wagging their heads, and saying, Ah, thou that destroyest the temple, and buildest it in three days,

\ln Tsvsv halisdelv, ale ehatloahi dadahnawasdvi.
\syll ᏨᏒ ᎭᎵᏍᏕᎸ, ᎠᎴ ᎡᎭᏠᎠᎯ ᏓᏓᎿᏩᏍᏛᎢ.
\ft Save thyself, and come down from the cross.

\ln Nasgiya nasquo nunigvwiyusv atsilv anelohi ale dinowelisgi gvwadehodisgv, hia nidanadawesehei, Nvwanadale dasdelisgvgi; uwasv vtla yvgvlisdelv.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸ ᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏃᏪᎵᏍᎩ ᎬᏩᏕᎰᏗᏍᎬ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᏓᎾᏓᏪᏎᎮᎢ, ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴ ᏓᏍᏕᎵᏍᎬᎩ; ᎤᏩᏒ ᎥᏝ ᏴᎬᎵᏍᏕᎸ.
\ft Likewise also the chief priests mocking said among themselves with the scribes, He saved others; himself he cannot save.

\ln Galonedv Ugvwiyuhi Isili unatseliga hnaquo watloahi dadahnawasdvi, nasgi ogigowadvdiyi ale ogohiyudiyi.  Ale nasgi itsulaha digegadvnvhi gagvwasotlvdei.
\syll ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᏏᎵ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ ᎿᏉ ᏩᏠᎠᎯ ᏓᏓᎿᏩᏍᏛᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᎩᎪᏩᏛᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᎣᎪᎯᏳᏗᏱ.  ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᏗᎨᎦᏛᏅᎯ ᎦᎬᏩᏐᏢᏕᎢ.
\ft Let Christ the King of Israel descend now from the cross, that we may see and believe. And they that were crucified with him reviled him.

\ln Taladuno iyutlilodv uliyeilolv ulisihvse nigvnadv nahna gadohi, tsoi iyutlilodv iyasti.
\syll ᏔᎳᏚᏃ ᎢᏳᏟᎶᏛ ᎤᎵᏰᎢᎶᎸ ᎤᎵᏏᎲᏎ ᏂᎬᎾᏛ ᏀᎾ ᎦᏙᎯ, ᏦᎢ ᎢᏳᏟᎶᏛ ᎢᏯᏍᏘ.
\ft And when the sixth hour was come, there was darkness over the whole land until the ninth hour.

\ln Tsoine iyutlilodv uliyeilolv Tsisa asdaya uwelunei, hia nuwesei, Iloi, Iloi, lama saquadani?  Nasgi anetlvtanvhi hia nusdi gadvga, Aquanelanvhi, Aquanelanvhi, gadono vsquvdegi?
\syll ᏦᎢᏁ ᎢᏳᏟᎶᏛ ᎤᎵᏰᎢᎶᎸ ᏥᏌ ᎠᏍᏓᏯ ᎤᏪᎷᏁᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎢᎶᎢ, ᎢᎶᎢ, ᎳᎹ ᏌᏆᏓᏂ?  ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏁᏢᏔᏅᎯ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏍᏗ ᎦᏛᎦ, ᎠᏆᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎠᏆᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎦᏙᏃ ᎥᏍᏋᏕᎩ?
\ft And at the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, Eloi, Eloi, lama sabachthani? which is, being interpreted, My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me?

\ln Igadvno nav anidonai unadvganv, hia nuniwesei, Gvniyuquo, Ilaya ayaniha.
\syll ᎢᎦᏛᏃ ᎾᎥ ᎠᏂᏙᎾᎢ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ, ᎬᏂᏳᏉ, ᎢᎳᏯ ᎠᏯᏂᎭ.
\ft And some of them that stood by, when they heard it, said, Behold, he calleth Elias.

\ln Aseyvwino dusqualvtanv, ale duwoli tsunitsoyasdi wukaliistanv, ale ganasdohi uwequatanv, unenelv uditasdi; hia nuwesei, Unelagi, idadolehohi, tsigono Ilaya dagalutsi dayutlovtanili.
\syll ᎠᏎᏴᏫᏃ ᏚᏍᏆᎸᏔᏅ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏬᎵ ᏧᏂᏦᏯᏍᏗ ᏭᎧᎵᎢᏍᏔᏅ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᎾᏍᏙᎯ ᎤᏪᏆᏔᏅ, ᎤᏁᏁᎸ ᎤᏗᏔᏍᏗ; ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎤᏁᎳᎩ, ᎢᏓᏙᎴᎰᎯ, ᏥᎪᏃ ᎢᎳᏯ ᏓᎦᎷᏥ ᏓᏳᏠᎥᏔᏂᎵ.
\ft And one ran and filled a spunge full of vinegar, and put it on a reed, and gave him to drink, saying, Let alone; let us see whether Elias will come to take him down.

\ln Tsisano asdaya uwelunv, ulisquadelei.
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᎠᏍᏓᏯ ᎤᏪᎷᏅ, ᎤᎵᏍᏆᏕᎴᎢ.
\ft And Jesus cried with a loud voice, and gave up the ghost.

\ln Ayedoladvdino udvnvdigalawiisdiyi gadv udatsagalvhe tali nudadei, galvladi nvdayudalenvdv eladi wasdi.
\syll ᎠᏰᏙᎳᏛᏗᏃ ᎤᏛᏅᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎦᏛ ᎤᏓᏣᎦᎸᎮ ᏔᎵ ᏄᏓᏕᎢ, ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎡᎳᏗ ᏩᏍᏗ.
\ft And the veil of the temple was rent in twain from the top to the bottom.

\ln Asgohitsuquino ditinidohi aiditlv tsuyugodi gadogi, udolehosv nasgi uwelunvi, ale ulisquadelvi, hia nuwesei, Udohiyuhi hia asgaya Unelanvhi Uwetsi gesei.
\syll ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏧᏈᏃ ᏗᏘᏂᏙᎯ ᎠᎢᏗᏢ ᏧᏳᎪᏗ ᎦᏙᎩ, ᎤᏙᎴᎰᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏪᎷᏅᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᏕᎸᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎨᏎᎢ.
\ft And when the centurion, which stood over against him, saw that he so cried out, and gave up the ghost, he said, Truly this man was the Son of God.

\ln Anigeyvno nasquo ge iyvdv dodinikanei; nahnano anele Meli Sugideli ehi, ale Meli Tsimi usdi ale Tsosi unitsii, ale Salomi.
\syll ᎠᏂᎨᏴᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ Ꭸ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏙᏗᏂᎧᏁᎢ; ᏀᎾᏃ ᎠᏁᎴ ᎺᎵ ᏑᎩᏕᎵ ᎡᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎺᎵ ᏥᎻ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏦᏏ ᎤᏂᏥᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏌᎶᎻ.
\ft There were also women looking on afar off: among whom was Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James the less and of Joses, and Salome;

\ln Nasgi nasquo Gelili tsedohe gvwasdawadidohe ale gvwasdelvhidohei; ale unitsate nvwanadale anigeyv Tsilusilimi nvdagvwasdawadolvhi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎨᎵᎵ ᏤᏙᎮ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎮ ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᏍᏕᎸᎯᏙᎮᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏣᏖ ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴ ᎠᏂᎨᏴ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏙᎸᎯ.
\ft (Who also, when he was in Galilee, followed him, and ministered unto him;) and many other women which came up with him unto Jerusalem.

\ln Hnaquono usv nulistanv, nasgi advnvisdodiyi gesv iyusdi, nasgi unadodaquidena iga gesvi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎤᏒ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏛᏅᎢᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᏙᏓᏈᏕᎾ ᎢᎦ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft And now when the even was come, because it was the preparation, that is, the day before the sabbath,

\ln Tsowa Alimadiyi ehi atsilvquodi digalawigi, nasgi nasquo agatiye Unelanvhi ugvwiyuhi gesv uluhisdiyi, nasgi ulutsei, ale nasgaihvna wuyvle Qualediyi, ale utayole Tsisa ayelvi.

\ft There was in the days of Herod, the king of Judaea, a certain priest named Zacharias, of the course of Abia: and his wife was of the daughters of Aaron, and her name was Elisabeth.

\syll ᎠᎴ ᎢᏧᎳ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᎨᏎ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏙᏗᎧᏅᎢ, ᏓᏂᎧᎿᏩᏗᏎ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏁᏨ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᎵᏓᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏱᎰᏩ ᏧᏤᎵᎦ, ᎤᏐᏅ ᏂᎨᏥᎳᎾᏎᎲᎾ.

\syll ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏩᏍᏛ ᎦᎸᎳᏗᏳ ᎡᎯ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎠᎪᏎᎮᏍᏗ; ᏱᎰᏩᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏓᏳᏁᎵ ᎤᏙᏓ ᏕᏫ ᎤᏪᏍᎩᎸᎢ.
\ft He shall be great, and shall be called the Son of the Highest: and the Lord God shall give unto him the throne of his father David:

\ln Ale winasdvna ugvwiyuhi gesesdi Tsegaqui unetlvtanvdv gesv anehvi; ale nasgi ugvwiyuhi gesv wusditsihisdi nigesvna gesesdi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏫᎾᏍᏛᎾ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏤᎦᏈ ᎤᏁᏢᏔᏅᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏁᎲᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏭᏍᏗᏥᎯᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft And he shall reign over the house of Jacob for ever; and of his kingdom there shall be no end.

\ln Melino hia nuwesele dikahnawadidohi; Gado yigalisdoda nasgi yinigalisda, nitsigatahvnano tsigi asgaya?
\syll ᎺᎵᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎯ; ᎦᏙ ᏱᎦᎵᏍᏙᏓ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᏂᎦᎵᏍᏓ, ᏂᏥᎦᏔᎲᎾᏃ ᏥᎩ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ?
\ft Then said Mary unto the angel, How shall this be, seeing I know not a man?

\ln Dikahnawadidohino unetsv hia nuweselei; Galvquodiyu Adanvdo datsalutseli ale ulinigidiyu gesv wasdv Galvladiyu ehi datsadawadisdotani; nasgi iyusdi nasquo nasgi galvquodiyu tsvdatsadeneli Unelanvhi Uwetsi agosehesdi.
\syll ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎯᏃ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᏓᏣᎷᏤᎵ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᏩᏍᏛ ᎦᎸᎳᏗᏳ ᎡᎯ ᏓᏣᏓᏩᏗᏍᏙᏔᏂ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᏨᏓᏣᏕᏁᎵ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎠᎪᏎᎮᏍᏗ.
\ft And the angel answered and said unto her, The Holy Ghost shall come upon thee, and the power of the Highest shall overshadow thee: therefore also that holy thing which shall be born of thee shall be called the Son of God.

\ln Ale gvniyuquo isditloyi Lisi nasquo atsutsa unelitsv hnaquo agayvlige gesvi; ale gohi tsigi hnaquo sudaline kala gvwanelitsvhi nasgi dilulvvsgi nigesvna tsagosehvgi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎢᏍᏗᏠᏱ ᎵᏏ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏧᏣ ᎤᏁᎵᏨ ᎿᏉ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎪᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎿᏉ ᏑᏓᎵᏁ ᎧᎳ ᎬᏩᏁᎵᏨᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎷᎸᎥᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏣᎪᏎᎲᎩ.
\ft And, behold, thy cousin Elisabeth, she hath also conceived a son in her old age: and this is the sixth month with her, who was called barren.

\ln Unelanvhiyeno vtla gohusdi unulvdi yigesesdi.
\syll ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏄᎸᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft For with God nothing shall be impossible.

\ln Melino hia nuwesei; Gvniyuquo aquo unvsidasdi ageyv; Yihowa nasgiya nitsawesv winaqualisdasi.  Dikahnawadidohino udanvelei.
\syll ᎺᎵᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎠᏉ ᎤᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎠᎨᏴ; ᏱᎰᏩ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏂᏣᏪᏒ ᏫᎾᏆᎵᏍᏓᏏ.  ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎯᏃ ᎤᏓᏅᎡᎴᎢ.
\ft And Mary said, Behold the handmaid of the Lord; be it unto me according to thy word. And the angel departed from her.

\ln Melino nahiyu dulenei, uwanvtse odali gesv wulosei, Tsudiyi gaduhv wulutsei;
\syll ᎺᎵᏃ ᏀᎢᏳ ᏚᎴᏁᎢ, ᎤᏩᏅᏤ ᎣᏓᎵ ᎨᏒ ᏭᎶᏎᎢ, ᏧᏗᏱ ᎦᏚᎲ ᏭᎷᏤᎢ;
\ft And Mary arose in those days, and went into the hill country with haste, into a city of Juda;

\ln Ale wuyvle Tsegalaya ganelvi, ale uyolile Lisi
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏭᏴᎴ ᏤᎦᎳᏯ ᎦᏁᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏲᎵᎴ ᎵᏏ
\ft And entered into the house of Zacharias, and saluted Elisabeth.

\ln Hiano nulistanei, nasgi Lisi udvganv Meli uyolihvi, ayoli ganelisv ulitelvnei; ale Lisi ukalitse Galvquodiyu Adanvdo,
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎵᏏ ᎤᏛᎦᏅ ᎺᎵ ᎤᏲᎵᎲᎢ, ᎠᏲᎵ ᎦᏁᎵᏒ ᎤᎵᏖᎸᏁᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎵᏏ ᎤᎧᎵᏤ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ,
\ft And it came to pass, that, when Elisabeth heard the salutation of Mary, the babe leaped in her womb; and Elisabeth was filled with the Holy Ghost:

\ln Ale asdaya unetsei, hia nuwesei; Anigeyv anehv nihi wudagonadvdi etsalvquodiyu; ale galvquodiyu nasgi nihi tsvtinanugowisi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎠᏍᏓᏯ ᎤᏁᏤᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎠᏂᎨᏴ ᎠᏁᎲ ᏂᎯ ᏭᏓᎪᎾᏛᏗ ᎡᏣᎸᏉᏗᏳ; ᎠᎴ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎯ ᏨᏘᎾᏄᎪᏫᏏ.
\ft And she spake out with a loud voice, and said, Blessed art thou among women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb.

\ln Gadono dagalisdoda ayv nasgi tsinaqualisdasi, nasgi aquatseli Ugvwiyuhi utsi tsagilutsisi?
\syll ᎦᏙᏃ ᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏓ ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᎾᏆᎵᏍᏓᏏ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏆᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏥ ᏣᎩᎷᏥᏏ?
\ft And whence is this to me, that the mother of my Lord should come to me?

\ln Gvniyuquoyeno aquadvganvquo hinegv sgiyolihvi, ayoli tsinelisv ulitelvnv aliheligvi.
\syll ᎬᏂᏳᏉᏰᏃ ᎠᏆᏛᎦᏅᏉ ᎯᏁᎬ ᏍᎩᏲᎵᎲᎢ, ᎠᏲᎵ ᏥᏁᎵᏒ ᎤᎵᏖᎸᏅ ᎠᎵᎮᎵᎬᎢ.
\ft For, lo, as soon as the voice of thy salutation sounded in mine ears, the babe leaped in my womb for joy.

\ln Ale osiyu iyulisdanedi uwohiyunvhi; nasgiyeno nvtsuweselv Yihowa nasgi ase nvdagalistani.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎤᏬᎯᏳᏅᎯ; ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᏅᏧᏪᏎᎸ ᏱᎰᏩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏎ ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏔᏂ.
\ft And blessed is she that believed: for there shall be a performance of those things which were told her from the Lord.

\ln Melino hia nuwesei, Aquadanvdo utsati galvquodiha Yihowa,
\syll ᎺᎵᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᎭ ᏱᎰᏩ,
\ft And Mary said, My soul doth magnify the Lord,

\ln Ale aquadanvdo ulihelitselv Unelanvhi Agisdelisgi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᎵᎮᎵᏤᎸ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎩᏍᏕᎵᏍᎩ.
\ft And my spirit hath rejoiced in God my Saviour.

\ln Deukahnanvyeno uyo nudvhnadegv ageyv unvsidasdi; gvniyuquoyeno gohi iyudalenvdv nanadanetliyvsisv yvwi galvquodiyu gvquosehesdi.
\syll ᏕᎤᎧᎿᏅᏰᏃ ᎤᏲ ᏄᏛᎿᏕᎬ ᎠᎨᏴ ᎤᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ; ᎬᏂᏳᏉᏰᏃ ᎪᎯ ᎢᏳᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎾᎾᏓᏁᏟᏴᏏᏒ ᏴᏫ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎬᏉᏎᎮᏍᏗ.
\ft For he hath regarded the low estate of his handmaiden: for, behold, from henceforth all generations shall call me blessed.

\ln Ulinigidvyeno tsigi nasgi usquanigodiyu naquadvnelv; ale galvquodiyu nasgi deudovi.
\syll ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛᏰᏃ ᏥᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗᏳ ᎾᏆᏛᏁᎸ; ᎠᎴ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏕᎤᏙᎥᎢ.
\ft For he that is mighty hath done to me great things; and holy is his name.

\ln Ale udadolisdi gesv degananugowiseha gvwanayesgi nanadanetliyvsisvi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏕᎦᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᎭ ᎬᏩᎾᏰᏍᎩ ᎾᎾᏓᏁᏟᏴᏏᏒᎢ.
\ft And his mercy is on them that fear him from generation to generation.

\ln Kanogeni uwvtanv unanugowisv ulinigidv gesvi; unatlvquodi dotsunadanvdv dudigaleyastanv.
\syll ᎧᏃᎨᏂ ᎤᏮᏔᏅ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏫᏒ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎤᎾᏢᏉᏗ ᏙᏧᎾᏓᏅᏛ ᏚᏗᎦᎴᏯᏍᏔᏅ.
\ft He hath shewed strength with his arm; he hath scattered the proud in the imagination of their hearts.

\ln Tsunalinigidv duwekahvsv unanvdiyi, ale uyo iyunadvhnadegi dusaladanv.
\syll ᏧᎾᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᏚᏪᎧᎲᏒ ᎤᎾᏅᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏲ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᎿᏕᎩ ᏚᏌᎳᏓᏅ.
\ft He hath put down the mighty from their seats, and exalted them of low degree.

\ln Agonu tsuniyosisgi osdv gesv dukaliistanv, tsunehnaino asvha dounenvsdiyi niduwanelvgi.
\syll ᎠᎪᏄ ᏧᏂᏲᏏᏍᎩ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎨᏒ ᏚᎧᎵᎢᏍᏔᏅ, ᏧᏁᎿᎢᏃ ᎠᏒᎭ ᏙᎤᏁᏅᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᏚᏩᏁᎸᎩ.
\ft He hath filled the hungry with good things; and the rich he hath sent empty away.

\ln Isili unvsidasdi usdelvhv anvdadisgv udadolitsadvi,
\syll ᎢᏏᎵ ᎤᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎤᏍᏕᎸᎲ ᎠᏅᏓᏗᏍᎬ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏣᏛᎢ,
\ft He hath holpen his servant Israel, in remembrance of his mercy;

\ln Nasgiya niduweselv digigayvligei, Equahami, ale nasgi tsunetlvtanvdv gesv nigohilvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸ ᏗᎩᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ, ᎡᏆᎭᎻ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏁᏢᏔᏅᏛ ᎨᏒ ᏂᎪᎯᎸᎢ.
\ft As he spake to our fathers, to Abraham, and to his seed for ever.

\ln Melino tsoi iyanvdo iyvdv Lisiyi udenei, gilano uwasv tsuwenvsv wiulosei.
\syll ᎺᎵᏃ ᏦᎢ ᎢᏯᏅᏙ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎵᏏᏱ ᎤᏕᏁᎢ, ᎩᎳᏃ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏧᏪᏅᏒ ᏫᎤᎶᏎᎢ.
\ft And Mary abode with her about three months, and returned to her own house.

\ln Lisino hnaquo usqualvele udediyi ayoli, ale unanugowise atsutsa.
\syll ᎵᏏᏃ ᎿᏉ ᎤᏍᏆᎸᎡᎴ ᎤᏕᏗᏱ ᎠᏲᎵ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎ ᎠᏧᏣ.
\ft Now Elisabeth's full time came that she should be delivered; and she brought forth a son.

\ln Navno iyunadala ale gohusdi tsuwahna unadvgane Unelanvhi utsati uwedolitsvi, ale itsulaha unalihelitsei.
\syll ᎾᎥᏃ ᎢᏳᎾᏓᎳ ᎠᎴ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏧᏩᎿ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏁ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᏪᏙᎵᏨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎤᎾᎵᎮᎵᏤᎢ.
\ft And her neighbours and her cousins heard how the Lord had shewed great mercy upon her; and they rejoiced with her.

\ln Hiano nulistanei, nasgi tsuneline iga unihusdeselvha ayoli, ale Tsegalaya dunoei, udoda dudov dunostanei.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏁᎵᏁ ᎢᎦ ᎤᏂᎱᏍᏕᏎᎸᎭ ᎠᏲᎵ, ᎠᎴ ᏤᎦᎳᏯ ᏚᏃᎡᎢ, ᎤᏙᏓ ᏚᏙᎥ ᏚᏃᏍᏔᏁᎢ.
\ft And it came to pass, that on the eighth day they came to circumcise the child; and they called him Zacharias, after the name of his father.

\ln Utsino unetsv hia nuwesei; Vtlesdi; Tsanisgini agosehesdi.
\syll ᎤᏥᏃ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎥᏞᏍᏗ; ᏣᏂᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᎪᏎᎮᏍᏗ.
\ft And his mother answered and said, Not so; but he shall be called John.

\ln Hiano nigvwaweselei; Vtla gilo itsitloyi gesv nasgi yinusdi yidudov.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᎬᏩᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏥᏠᏱ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᏄᏍᏗ ᏱᏚᏙᎥ.
\ft And they said unto her, There is none of thy kindred that is called by this name.

\ln Udodano dananelodanehv unadvdvne nusdv udulisgv tsagosdiyi.
\syll ᎤᏙᏓᏃ ᏓᎾᏁᎶᏓᏁᎲ ᎤᎾᏛᏛᏁ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎬ ᏣᎪᏍᏗᏱ.
\ft And they made signs to his father, how he would have him called.

\ln Utayoleno digowelodiyi ale uwowelane hia nigawesgei; Tsani dudov.  Nigadvno unisquanigosei.
\syll ᎤᏔᏲᎴᏃ ᏗᎪᏪᎶᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏬᏪᎳᏁ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎨᎢ; ᏣᏂ ᏚᏙᎥ.  ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᎤᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏎᎢ.
\ft And he asked for a writing table, and wrote, saying, His name is John. And they marvelled all.

\ln Gilaquono iyvdv ahuli ulisduisei, ganogono udelisadesei, ale uwonise ulvquotane Unelanvhi.
\syll ᎩᎳᏉᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎠᎱᎵ ᎤᎵᏍᏚᎢᏎᎢ, ᎦᏃᎪᏃ ᎤᏕᎵᏌᏕᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏬᏂᏎ ᎤᎸᏉᏔᏁ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ.
\ft And his mouth was opened immediately, and his tongue loosed, and he spake, and praised God.

\ln Nahnano gvwaduwidv dininelv nigadv uninayesei; ale nigadv nasgi hia nulistanidolv dunotsalotse nigvnadv odali gesv Tsudiyi.
\syll ᏀᎾᏃ ᎬᏩᏚᏫᏛ ᏗᏂᏁᎸ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎤᏂᎾᏰᏎᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏂᏙᎸ ᏚᏃᏣᎶᏤ ᏂᎬᎾᏛ ᎣᏓᎵ ᎨᏒ ᏧᏗᏱ.
\ft And fear came on all that dwelt round about them: and all these sayings were noised abroad throughout all the hill country of Judaea.

\ln Nanivno nasgi unadvganvhi tsuninawiyi unisquanigotanei, hia naniwesgei; Gado usdesdi hia ayoli?  Yihowano usdelvhidohei.
\syll ᎾᏂᎥᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅᎯ ᏧᏂᎾᏫᏱ ᎤᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏔᏁᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏂᏪᏍᎨᎢ; ᎦᏙ ᎤᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏲᎵ?  ᏱᎰᏩᏃ ᎤᏍᏕᎸᎯᏙᎮᎢ.
\ft And all they that heard them laid them up in their hearts, saying, What manner of child shall this be! And the hand of the Lord was with him.

\ln Udodano Tsegalaya ukalitsvhi gese Galvquodiyu Adanvdo, ale udolehose hia nuwesei;
\syll ᎤᏙᏓᏃ ᏤᎦᎳᏯ ᎤᎧᎵᏨᎯ ᎨᏎ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏙᎴᎰᏎ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ;
\ft And his father Zacharias was filled with the Holy Ghost, and prophesied, saying,

\ln Galvquodiyu gesesdi Yihowa Unelanvhi Isili unatseliga; duwadvholvyeno ale duguyvhv tsutseliga yvwi.
\syll ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏱᎰᏩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᏏᎵ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ; ᏚᏩᏛᎰᎸᏰᏃ ᎠᎴ ᏚᎫᏴᎲ ᏧᏤᎵᎦ ᏴᏫ.
\ft Blessed be the Lord God of Israel; for he hath visited and redeemed his people,

\ln Ale iginanugowiselv uyonv igalisdelvdodi, Dewi unvsidasdi unetlvtanvdv gesv anehv unanugotsv;
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎢᎩᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᎸ ᎤᏲᏅ ᎢᎦᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ, ᏕᏫ ᎤᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᏢᏔᏅᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏁᎲ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏨ;
\ft And hath raised up an horn of salvation for us in the house of his servant David;

\ln Nasgiya nuwesv degvdisgv tsutseli getsilvquodi anadolehosgi unadenvhi tsigi didalenisgv nvdagvwadalenvdv;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᏪᏒ ᏕᎬᏗᏍᎬ ᏧᏤᎵ ᎨᏥᎸᏉᏗ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᏕᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ ᏗᏓᎴᏂᏍᎬ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏓᎴᏅᏛ;
\ft As he spake by the mouth of his holy prophets, which have been since the world began:

\ln Nasgi didadudalaediyi gegisgagi, ale asdaya nigegvnv didadudalaediyi nigadiyu geginiquatihi;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏓᏚᏓᎳᎡᏗᏱ ᎨᎩᏍᎦᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏍᏓᏯ ᏂᎨᎬᏅ ᏗᏓᏚᏓᎳᎡᏗᏱ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᎨᎩᏂᏆᏘᎯ;
\ft That we should be saved from our enemies, and from the hand of all that hate us;

\ln Iyudvnediyi duduisdanelv digigayvlige tsuwedolisdiyi, ale unvdadisdiyi utseli galvquodiyu kanohedv datlohisdvi,
\syll ᎢᏳᏛᏁᏗᏱ ᏚᏚᎢᏍᏓᏁᎸ ᏗᎩᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᏧᏪᏙᎵᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏓᏠᎯᏍᏛᎢ,
\ft To perform the mercy promised to our fathers, and to remember his holy covenant;

\ln Nasgi tsuselitane tsuduisdanele igigayvlige Equahami,
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏎᎵᏔᏁ ᏧᏚᎢᏍᏓᏁᎴ ᎢᎩᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᎡᏆᎭᎻ,
\ft The oath which he sware to our father Abraham,

\ln Nasgi gedadudalaelvhi gesv gegisgagi igalisgolvdanediyi nidinayesgvna edadadolisdanediyi,
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᏓᏚᏓᎳᎡᎸᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎨᎩᏍᎦᎩ ᎢᎦᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᏂᏗᎾᏰᏍᎬᎾ ᎡᏓᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ,
\ft That he would grant unto us, that we being delivered out of the hand of our enemies might serve him without fear,

\ln Nidisganvna ale duyugodv igedasdiyi agatahv nigohilv idalenidohvi.
\syll ᏂᏗᏍᎦᏅᎾ ᎠᎴ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎢᎨᏓᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᎦᏔᎲ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎢᏓᎴᏂᏙᎲᎢ.
\ft In holiness and righteousness before him, all the days of our life.

\ln Nihino hiyoli, wasdv Galvladiyu ehi utseli adolehosgi etsosehesdi, nihiyeno igvyi tiyenveli Yihowa, hiyadvnvisdanediyi ulohisdiyi;
\syll ᏂᎯᏃ ᎯᏲᎵ, ᏩᏍᏛ ᎦᎸᎳᏗᏳ ᎡᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎡᏦᏎᎮᏍᏗ, ᏂᎯᏰᏃ ᎢᎬᏱ ᏘᏰᏅᎡᎵ ᏱᎰᏩ, ᎯᏯᏛᏅᎢᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᎤᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ;
\ft And thou, child, shalt be called the prophet of the Highest: for thou shalt go before the face of the Lord to prepare his ways;

\ln Gvnigesv itsuwanediyi tsutseli yvwi nasgi unalisdelvdodi gesvi, gagetsinehv unisganvtsvi,
\syll ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏧᏩᏁᏗᏱ ᏧᏤᎵ ᏴᏫ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎦᎨᏥᏁᎲ ᎤᏂᏍᎦᏅᏨᎢ,
\ft To give knowledge of salvation unto his people by the remission of their sins,

\ln Yihowa udadolitsatiyu gesv Iganelanvhi, nasgi tsinigalisdodiha igagati diyelihisdisgi galvladi nvdayudalenvhi igiwadvhilvhi tsigi,
\syll ᏱᎰᏩ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏣᏘᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎢᎦᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏂᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎢᎦᎦᏘ ᏗᏰᎵᎯᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᎢᎩᏩᏛᎯᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ,
\ft Through the tender mercy of our God; whereby the dayspring from on high hath visited us,

\ln Iga tsutisdanediyi ulisigv ale ayohuhisdi gesv udawadisdodv tsanina, ale digatenvsdiyi nvwadohiyadv ganvnvi.
\syll ᎢᎦ ᏧᏘᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᎤᎵᏏᎬ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏓᏩᏗᏍᏙᏛ ᏣᏂᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎦᏖᏅᏍᏗᏱ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᎦᏅᏅᎢ.
\ft To give light to them that sit in darkness and in the shadow of death, to guide our feet into the way of peace.

\ln Ayolino advsgei ale kanequoge ulinigosgv udanvdvi, ale inagequo ehei gvni gvnigesv nidudvnelv Isili.
\syll ᎠᏲᎵᏃ ᎠᏛᏍᎨᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎧᏁᏉᎨ ᎤᎵᏂᎪᏍᎬ ᎤᏓᏅᏛᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᎾᎨᏉ ᎡᎮᎢ ᎬᏂ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᏚᏛᏁᎸ ᎢᏏᎵ.
\ft And the child grew, and waxed strong in spirit, and was in the deserts till the day of his shewing unto Israel.

\ln Nahiyuno hia nulistanei, nasgi Sisa Ogasda unetsvhi unanugotse nigvnadv elohi gegasesdiyi.
\syll ᏀᎢᏳᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏏᏌ ᎣᎦᏍᏓ ᎤᏁᏨᎯ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏤ ᏂᎬᎾᏛ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎨᎦᏎᏍᏗᏱ.
\ft And it came to pass in those days, that there went out a decree from Caesar Augustus, that all the world should be taxed.

\ln Nasgi hia unaselidole asi Salini Siliyi ugvwiyuhi nigesvna nigesei.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎤᎾᏎᎵᏙᎴ ᎠᏏ ᏌᎵᏂ ᏏᎵᏱ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏂᎨᏎᎢ.
\ft (And this taxing was first made when Cyrenius was governor of Syria.)

\ln Ale nigadv unenvse gegasesdiyi anisiyvwiha gesv dodaniduhvi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎤᏁᏅᏎ ᎨᎦᏎᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᏂᏏᏴᏫᎭ ᎨᏒ ᏙᏓᏂᏚᎲᎢ.
\ft And all went to be taxed, every one into his own city.

\ln Ale Tsowa nasquo Gelili unigisei unugotse Naselidi gaduhvi, wulutse Tsudiyi, Dewi tsuweduhvi, gaduyi tsudoidv, Dewiyeno unetlvtanvdv gesv nvdayudalenvhi gesei ugayvlige gesei ale Dewi,
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏦᏩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎨᎵᎵ ᎤᏂᎩᏎᎢ ᎤᏄᎪᏤ ᎾᏎᎵᏗ ᎦᏚᎲᎢ, ᏭᎷᏤ ᏧᏗᏱ, ᏕᏫ ᏧᏪᏚᎲᎢ, ᎦᏚᏱ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ, ᏕᏫᏰᏃ ᎤᏁᏢᏔᏅᏛ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᎨᏎᎢ ᎤᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᎨᏎᎢ ᎠᎴ ᏕᏫ,
\ft And Joseph also went up from Galilee, out of the city of Nazareth, into Judaea, unto the city of David, which is called Bethlehem; (because he was of the house and lineage of David:)

\ln Gegasesdiyi uyelvse uwasv ale Meli udayvsdi, nasgi ganelidv gesei.
\syll ᎨᎦᏎᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏰᎸᏎ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎺᎵ ᎤᏓᏴᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏁᎵᏛ ᎨᏎᎢ.
\ft To be taxed with Mary his espoused wife, being great with child.

\ln Hiano nulistanei, nasgi asi nahna anedohei, usqualvhe ayoli unanugowisdiyi.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏏ ᏀᎾ ᎠᏁᏙᎮᎢ, ᎤᏍᏆᎸᎮ ᎠᏲᎵ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏫᏍᏗᏱ.
\ft And so it was, that, while they were there, the days were accomplished that she should be delivered.

\ln Unanugowiseno igvyi ehi uwetsi atsutsa, ale uwetsanulanei, ale soquili unalisdayvdiyi ulvnei; vtlayeno yudlanvde tsunisvsdiyi adanelvi.
\syll ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᏃ ᎢᎬᏱ ᎡᎯ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎠᏧᏣ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏪᏣᏄᎳᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏐᏈᎵ ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ ᎤᎸᏁᎢ; ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᏳᏜᏅᏕ ᏧᏂᏒᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᏓᏁᎸᎢ.
\ft And she brought forth her firstborn son, and wrapped him in swaddling clothes, and laid him in a manger; because there was no room for them in the inn.

\ln Nahnano navi awidinigatiya anedohe udlanvdvi, awi danigatiye svnoyi.
\syll ᏀᎾᏃ ᎾᎥᎢ ᎠᏫᏗᏂᎦᏘᏯ ᎠᏁᏙᎮ ᎤᏜᏅᏛᎢ, ᎠᏫ ᏓᏂᎦᏘᏰ ᏒᏃᏱ.
\ft And there were in the same country shepherds abiding in the field, keeping watch over their flock by night.

\ln Gvniyuquono dikahnawadidohi Yihowa utseliga unilutselei, ale galvquodiyu dulvsadv Ugvwiyuhi utseliga dunaduwistanei ale utsatanvhi unisgalei.
\syll ᎬᏂᏳᏉᏃ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏱᎰᏩ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᎤᏂᎷᏤᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᏚᎸᏌᏛ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᏚᎾᏚᏫᏍᏔᏁᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏣᏔᏅᎯ ᎤᏂᏍᎦᎴᎢ.
\ft And, lo, the angel of the Lord came upon them, and the glory of the Lord shone round about them: and they were sore afraid.

\ln Dikahnawadidohino hia niduweselei; Tlesdi yitsisgaihesdi, gvniyuquoyeno itsvyohisi osdv kanohedv utsati alihelisdi, naniv yvwi unadvgodi.
\syll ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎯᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏥᏍᎦᎢᎮᏍᏗ, ᎬᏂᏳᏉᏰᏃ ᎢᏨᏲᎯᏏ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎠᎵᎮᎵᏍᏗ, ᎾᏂᎥ ᏴᏫ ᎤᎾᏛᎪᏗ.
\ft And the angel said unto them, Fear not: for, behold, I bring you good tidings of great joy, which shall be to all people.

\ln Gohiyeno iga itsadenelv Dewi uweduhvi, Itsisdelisgi nasgi Galonedv Ugvwiyuhi.
\syll ᎪᎯᏰᏃ ᎢᎦ ᎢᏣᏕᏁᎸ ᏕᏫ ᎤᏪᏚᎲᎢ, ᎢᏥᏍᏕᎵᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ.
\ft For unto you is born this day in the city of David a Saviour, which is Christ the Lord.

\ln Hiano nasgi itsadohihohisdodi gesesdi; Dayetsiwadvhi ayoli atsitsanulesdi, soquili unalisdayvdiyi ganvgesdi.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏣᏙᎯᎰᎯᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᏓᏰᏥᏩᏛᎯ ᎠᏲᎵ ᎠᏥᏣᏄᎴᏍᏗ, ᏐᏈᎵ ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ ᎦᏅᎨᏍᏗ.
\ft And this shall be a sign unto you; Ye shall find the babe wrapped in swaddling clothes, lying in a manger.

\ln Gilaquono iyvdv unitsati galvladi anehi gvwaligonele dikahnawadidohi, Unelanvhi anilvquodisgei, hia naniwesgei;
\syll ᎩᎳᏉᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎠᏁᎯ ᎬᏩᎵᎪᏁᎴ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎯ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᏂᎸᏉᏗᏍᎨᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏂᏪᏍᎨᎢ;
\ft And suddenly there was with the angel a multitude of the heavenly host praising God, and saying,

\ln Galvquodiyu gesesdi Unelanvhi wasdv galvladiyu, elohino dohio gesesdi, osdv gegadanvtesgesdi yvwi.
\syll ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏩᏍᏛ ᎦᎸᎳᏗᏳ, ᎡᎶᎯᏃ ᏙᎯᎣ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎣᏍᏛ ᎨᎦᏓᏅᏖᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏴᏫ.
\ft Glory to God in the highest, and on earth peace, good will toward men.

\ln Hnaquono hia nulistanei, nasgi dinikahnawadidohi gvwanadanvelv, galvladi wiunilosv, hia nidunadawesele awidinigatiya; Ka, hnaquo gaduyi idena, ale widadolehohi nasgi hia nulistanvi, nasgi Yihowa gvnigesv tsinigvnisi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏂᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎬᏩᎾᏓᏅᎡᎸ, ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏫᎤᏂᎶᏒ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᎾᏓᏪᏎᎴ ᎠᏫᏗᏂᎦᏘᏯ; Ꭷ, ᎿᏉ ᎦᏚᏱ ᎢᏕᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᏫᏓᏙᎴᎰᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᎰᏩ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏥᏂᎬᏂᏏ.
\ft And it came to pass, as the angels were gone away from them into heaven, the shepherds said one to another, Let us now go even unto Bethlehem, and see this thing which is come to pass, which the Lord hath made known unto us.

\ln Ulisdiyuno wunilutsei, ale duniwadvhe Meli ale Tsowa, ale ayoli soquili unalisdayvdiyi ganvgei.
\syll ᎤᎵᏍᏗᏳᏃ ᏭᏂᎷᏤᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏂᏩᏛᎮ ᎺᎵ ᎠᎴ ᏦᏩ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏲᎵ ᏐᏈᎵ ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ ᎦᏅᎨᎢ.
\ft And they came with haste, and found Mary, and Joseph, and the babe lying in a manger.

\ln Unigohvno uninohelidole nusdv getsinohehelv nasgi ayoli atsineisdisgvi.
\syll ᎤᏂᎪᎲᏃ ᎤᏂᏃᎮᎵᏙᎴ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎨᏥᏃᎮᎮᎸ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏲᎵ ᎠᏥᏁᎢᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ.
\ft And when they had seen it, they made known abroad the saying which was told them concerning this child.

\ln Nigadvno unadvganvhi unisquanigose nusdv gvwaninohehelv awidinigatiya.
\syll ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅᎯ ᎤᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏎ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎬᏩᏂᏃᎮᎮᎸ ᎠᏫᏗᏂᎦᏘᏯ.
\ft And all they that heard it wondered at those things which were told them by the shepherds.

\ln Melisgini nasgi hia nigadv usquanigotanei, ale nasgi udanvtehiloe tsudanvdvi.
\syll ᎺᎵᏍᎩᏂ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏔᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏓᏅᏖᎯᎶᎡ ᏧᏓᏅᏛᎢ.
\ft But Mary kept all these things, and pondered them in her heart.

\ln Awinodinigatiya iunatsvsei, anilvquodisge ale analihelitsehe unelanvhi nvdigalisdodisge nigav unadvganv ale unigohvi, nasgi nusdv getsinonelvi.
\syll ᎠᏫᏃᏗᏂᎦᏘᏯ ᎢᎤᎾᏨᏎᎢ, ᎠᏂᎸᏉᏗᏍᎨ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎾᎵᎮᎵᏤᎮ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᎪᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎨᏥᏃᏁᎸᎢ.
\ft And the shepherds returned, glorifying and praising God for all the things that they had heard and seen, as it was told unto them.

\ln Tsunelineno iga usqualvhv nasgi ahusdesedi gesv ayoli, TsiSa dunoei, nasgi dikahnawadidohi niduwoe asiquo natsineligvna gesei.
\syll ᏧᏁᎵᏁᏃ ᎢᎦ ᎤᏍᏆᎸᎲ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎱᏍᏕᏎᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏲᎵ, ᏥᏌ ᏚᏃᎡᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏂᏚᏬᎡ ᎠᏏᏉ ᎾᏥᏁᎵᎬᎾ ᎨᏎᎢ.
\ft And when eight days were accomplished for the circumcising of the child, his name was called JESUS, which was so named of the angel before he was conceived in the womb.

\ln Hnaquono usqualvhv unadanvgalvdiyi nasgiya nigvnv dikahnawadvsdi Mosi uwowelanvhi, Tsilusilimi uninole Yihowa unikanediyi;
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎤᏍᏆᎸᎲ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᎦᎸᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏂᎬᏅ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎼᏏ ᎤᏬᏪᎳᏅᎯ, ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᎤᏂᏃᎴ ᏱᎰᏩ ᎤᏂᎧᏁᏗᏱ;
\ft And when the days of her purification according to the law of Moses were accomplished, they brought him to Jerusalem, to present him to the Lord;

\ln Nasgiya nigvnv gowelv dikahnawadvsdiyi Mohowa tsatsiliga; Naniv igvyi unadenvhi anisgaya Yihowa Tsatsiyohiselvhi gegosehesdi;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏂᎬᏅ ᎪᏪᎸ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗᏱ ᎼᎰᏩ ᏣᏥᎵᎦ; ᎾᏂᎥ ᎢᎬᏱ ᎤᎾᏕᏅᎯ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ ᏱᎰᏩ ᏣᏥᏲᎯᏎᎸᎯ ᎨᎪᏎᎮᏍᏗ;
\ft (As it is written in the law of the Lord, Every male that openeth the womb shall be called holy to the Lord;)

\ln Ale atsilvgelasdi unalisgolvdodiyi nasgiya hia nigawesgv dikahnawadvsdi Yihowa utseliga; Anitali tsuledinisgonihi, ale anitali anidv woyi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎠᏥᎸᎨᎳᏍᏗ ᎤᎾᎵᏍᎪᎸᏙᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎬ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏱᎰᏩ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ; ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᏧᎴᏗᏂᏍᎪᏂᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᎠᏂᏛ ᏬᏱ.
\ft And to offer a sacrifice according to that which is said in the law of the Lord, A pair of turtledoves, or two young pigeons.

\ln Ale gvniyuquo gilo iyusdi asgaya Tsilusilimi ehe Simiyani tsudoidv; ale nasgi duyugodv iyadvnehi ale Unelanvhi dikahnawadegi gesei, agatiye Isili getsinuwohisdodiyi; Galvquodiyuno Adanvdo tali udvdidegei.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᎡᎮ ᏏᎻᏯᏂ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ; ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏕᎩ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎠᎦᏘᏰ ᎢᏏᎵ ᎨᏥᏄᏬᎯᏍᏙᏗᏱ; ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳᏃ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᏔᎵ ᎤᏛᏗᏕᎨᎢ.
\ft And, behold, there was a man in Jerusalem, whose name was Simeon; and the same man was just and devout, waiting for the consolation of Israel: and the Holy Ghost was upon him.

\ln Ale gvnigesv iyuwanelvhi gese Galvquodiyu Adanvdo, nasgi ayohuhisdi gesv ugowadvdi nigesvna gesv gvni Yihowa utseli Galonedv ugohvhi yigi
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏩᏁᎸᎯ ᎨᏎ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎪᏩᏛᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏂ ᏱᎰᏩ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᎪᎲᎯ ᏱᎩ
\ft And it was revealed unto him by the Holy Ghost, that he should not see death, before he had seen the Lord's Christ.

\ln Ale adanvdo udanvtehelvhi wulutse udvnadigalawiisdiyi; tsugayvligeno uniyvtanilv ayoli Tsisa nasgi nigvnv dikahnawadvsdi iyunadvnediyi,
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᏓᏅᏖᎮᎸᎯ ᏭᎷᏤ ᎤᏛᎾᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ; ᏧᎦᏴᎵᎨᏃ ᎤᏂᏴᏔᏂᎸ ᎠᏲᎵ ᏥᏌ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎬᏅ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᏁᏗᏱ,
\ft And he came by the Spirit into the temple: and when the parents brought in the child Jesus, to do for him after the custom of the law,

\ln Hnaquo nasgi unesei, ale ulvquotane Unelanvhi, hia nuwesei;
\syll ᎿᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎸᏉᏔᏁ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ;
\ft Then took he him up in his arms, and blessed God, and said,

\ln Tsagvwiyuhi, hnaquo hinvsidasdi nvwadohiyadv dehiyosga, nasgiya nitsawesv tsanetsvi;
\syll ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎿᏉ ᎯᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᏕᎯᏲᏍᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏂᏣᏪᏒ ᏣᏁᏨᎢ;
\ft Lord, now lettest thou thy servant depart in peace, according to thy word:

\ln Ditsigaliyeno gvdi tsigowadv tsatseli alisdelvdodi.
\syll ᏗᏥᎦᎵᏰᏃ ᎬᏗ ᏥᎪᏩᏛ ᏣᏤᎵ ᎠᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ.
\ft For mine eyes have seen thy salvation,

\ln Nasgi tsadanelanvhi tsigi naniv yvwi anigatahvi,
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏣᏓᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏴᏫ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎲᎢ,
\ft Which thou hast prepared before the face of all people;

\ln Igagati tsunilvsadadedi Tsunadalenvdv yvwi, ale galvquodiyu gesv ditsatseli yvwi Isili unatseliga.
\syll ᎢᎦᎦᏘ ᏧᏂᎸᏌᏓᏕᏗ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᏗᏣᏤᎵ ᏴᏫ ᎢᏏᎵ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ.
\ft A light to lighten the Gentiles, and the glory of thy people Israel.

\ln Tsowano ale ayoli utsi anisquanigosge nusdv atsineisdisgv nasgi.
\syll ᏦᏩᏃ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏲᎵ ᎤᏥ ᎠᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏍᎨ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎠᏥᏁᎢᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᎾᏍᎩ.
\ft And Joseph and his mother marvelled at those things which were spoken of him.

\ln Mimiyanino osdv dunetselei, ale hia nuwesele Meli ayoli utsi, Gvniyuquo hia nasgi ayoli atsikanv nasgi Isili anehi unitsati tsuninvisdiyi ale tsunalehisododiyi; ale uyelvdv unatludodi aniwonisgvi.
\syll ᎻᎻᏯᏂᏃ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏚᏁᏤᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴ ᎺᎵ ᎠᏲᎵ ᎤᏥ, ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏲᎵ ᎠᏥᎧᏅ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏏᎵ ᎠᏁᎯ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏧᏂᏅᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᏧᎾᎴᎯᏐᏙᏗᏱ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᏰᎸᏛ ᎤᎾᏡᏙᏗ ᎠᏂᏬᏂᏍᎬᎢ.
\ft And Simeon blessed them, and said unto Mary his mother, Behold, this child is set for the fall and rising again of many in Israel; and for a sign which shall be spoken against;

\ln Nasgi unitsati nusdv danadanvtesgv tsuninawiyi gvnigesv iyulisdodiyi: Vv, ayelasdiganvhidv nasquo tsvsv tsadanvdo datsatili.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏓᎾᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ ᏧᏂᎾᏫᏱ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ: ᎥᎥ, ᎠᏰᎳᏍᏗᎦᏅᎯᏛ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏨᏒ ᏣᏓᏅᏙ ᏓᏣᏘᎵ.
\ft (Yea, a sword shall pierce through thy own soul also,) that the thoughts of many hearts may be revealed.

\ln Ale gilo iyusdi ageyv Eni tsudoidv adolehosgi ehei, nasgi Quanueli uwetsi gesei, Esa anilasdalv utloyi, nasgi utsati agayvlige gesei, ale galiquogi itsudetiyvdv unaneladvhi gese asgaya advquo gesv tsunatsvdv;
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᎨᏴ ᎡᏂ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎡᎮᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏆᏄᎡᎵ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎡᏌ ᎠᏂᎳᏍᏓᎸ ᎤᏠᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᎵᏉᎩ ᎢᏧᏕᏘᏴᏛ ᎤᎾᏁᎳᏛᎯ ᎨᏎ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎠᏛᏉ ᎨᏒ ᏧᎾᏨᏛ;
\ft And there was one Anna, a prophetess, the daughter of Phanuel, of the tribe of Aser: she was of a great age, and had lived with an husband seven years from her virginity;

\ln Ale uwosulotsvhi gese nelasgohi nvgigali iyvdv iyudetiyvdv, nasgi vtla yidanvsge udvnadigalawiisdiyi, Unelanvhiquo dakahnawadisei amatli gvsgv ale adadolisdisgv nidulisinisv ale nidugitsvnisvi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎤᏬᏑᎶᏨᎯ ᎨᏎ ᏁᎳᏍᎪᎯ ᏅᎩᎦᎵ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎢᏳᏕᏘᏴᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏓᏅᏍᎨ ᎤᏛᎾᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏉ ᏓᎧᎿᏩᏗᏎᎢ ᎠᎹᏟ ᎬᏍᎬ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᏂᏚᎵᏏᏂᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏂᏚᎩᏨᏂᏒᎢ.
\ft And she was a widow of about fourscore and four years, which departed not from the temple, but served God with fastings and prayers night and day.

\ln Nasgino nasquo nahiyuquo ulutse ulihelitsele Yihowa, ale nasgi dekaneisdanehe nanivquo Tsilusilimi anehi anigatenohi aguyvdodi gesv unanugoisdiyi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏀᎢᏳᏉ ᎤᎷᏤ ᎤᎵᎮᎵᏤᎴ ᏱᎰᏩ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏕᎧᏁᎢᏍᏓᏁᎮ ᎾᏂᎥᏉ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᎠᏁᎯ ᎠᏂᎦᏖᏃᎯ ᎠᎫᏴᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᎢᏍᏗᏱ.
\ft And she coming in that instant gave thanks likewise unto the Lord, and spake of him to all them that looked for redemption in Jerusalem.

\ln Unisquadvno nigadv iyadvnelidasdi gesv nasgiya nigvnv dikahnawadvsdi Yihowa utseliga, iunatsvse Gelili wunilose, unvsv tsuniduhv Naselidi wunilutsei.
\syll ᎤᏂᏍᏆᏛᏃ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᎵᏓᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏂᎬᏅ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏱᎰᏩ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎢᎤᎾᏨᏎ ᎨᎵᎵ ᏭᏂᎶᏎ, ᎤᏅᏒ ᏧᏂᏚᎲ ᎾᏎᎵᏗ ᏭᏂᎷᏤᎢ.
\ft And when they had performed all things according to the law of the Lord, they returned into Galilee, to their own city Nazareth.

\ln Ayolino advsgei ale udanvdv alinigosgei, ukalitsvhi gese agadovhisdi gesvi; ale Unelanvhi udadolisdi gesv dukahnawadidohei.
\syll ᎠᏲᎵᏃ ᎠᏛᏍᎨᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᏅᏛ ᎠᎵᏂᎪᏍᎨᎢ, ᎤᎧᎵᏨᎯ ᎨᏎ ᎠᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏚᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎮᎢ.
\ft And the child grew, and waxed strong in spirit, filled with wisdom: and the grace of God was upon him.

\ln Tsugayvligeno Tsilusilimi anege nidadetiyvhisv kanohiyegi dilisdayvdiyi asqualisgv iyui.
\syll ᏧᎦᏴᎵᎨᏃ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᎠᏁᎨ ᏂᏓᏕᏘᏴᎯᏒ ᎧᏃᎯᏰᎩ ᏗᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ ᎠᏍᏆᎵᏍᎬ ᎢᏳᎢ.
\ft Now his parents went to Jerusalem every year at the feast of the passover.

\ln Taladuno iyudetiyvdv gese Tsilusilimi unenvha nasgiya iyunadvnedi gesv danalisdayvhvsgv iyui.
\syll ᏔᎳᏚᏃ ᎢᏳᏕᏘᏴᏛ ᎨᏎ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᎤᏁᏅᎭ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏓᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎬ ᎢᏳᎢ.
\ft And when he was twelve years old, they went up to Jerusalem after the custom of the feast.

\ln Unisquadvno igohidv dulisvsdvi, vunatsvsidisv ayoli Tsisa Tsilusilimi diudigiyei, Tsowano ale utsi vtla yinelisgei.
\syll ᎤᏂᏍᏆᏛᏃ ᎢᎪᎯᏛ ᏚᎵᏒᏍᏛᎢ, ᎥᎤᎾᏨᏏᏗᏒ ᎠᏲᎵ ᏥᏌ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᏗᎤᏗᎩᏰᎢ, ᏦᏩᏃ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏥ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏁᎵᏍᎨᎢ.
\ft And when they had fulfilled the days, as they returned, the child Jesus tarried behind in Jerusalem; and Joseph and his mother knew not of it.

\ln Nasgino sunadatlugi anaisv geladi anelisgv siga envsdi iyvdv unenvsei; gohusdino tsunvnv ale dinadagatahi aninv uniyolei.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏑᎾᏓᏡᎩ ᎠᎾᎢᏒ ᎨᎳᏗ ᎠᏁᎵᏍᎬ ᏏᎦ ᎡᏅᏍᏗ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎤᏁᏅᏎᎢ; ᎪᎱᏍᏗᏃ ᏧᏅᏅ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎾᏓᎦᏔᎯ ᎠᏂᏅ ᎤᏂᏲᎴᎢ.
\ft But they, supposing him to have been in the company, went a day's journey; and they sought him among their kinsfolk and acquaintance.

\ln Gvwatlotsvno iunatsvsei Tsilusilimi wunilose gvwayohei.
\syll ᎬᏩᏠᏨᏃ ᎢᎤᎾᏨᏎᎢ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᏭᏂᎶᏎ ᎬᏩᏲᎮᎢ.
\ft And when they found him not, they turned back again to Jerusalem, seeking him.

\ln Hiano nulistanei, nasgi tsoine iga uniwadvhe udvnohi digalawiisdiyi, uwole ayeli aninv dinadeyohvsgi dadvdasdanehe ale dadvdvhelvvsgei.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏦᎢᏁ ᎢᎦ ᎤᏂᏩᏛᎮ ᎤᏛᏃᎯ ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᎤᏬᎴ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎠᏂᏅ ᏗᎾᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ ᏓᏛᏓᏍᏓᏁᎮ ᎠᎴ ᏓᏛᏛᎮᎸᎥᏍᎨᎢ.
\ft And it came to pass, that after three days they found him in the temple, sitting in the midst of the doctors, both hearing them, and asking them questions.

\ln Nigadvno gvwadvganelvhi unisquanigose nosv goligvi, ale gvwadvdvhvsgv degawohiliyvsdanehvi.
\syll ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᎬᏩᏛᎦᏁᎸᎯ ᎤᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏎ ᏃᏒ ᎪᎵᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᏛᏛᎲᏍᎬ ᏕᎦᏬᎯᎵᏴᏍᏓᏁᎲᎢ.
\ft And all that heard him were astonished at his understanding and answers.

\ln Tsugayvligeno gvwagohv unisquanigosei; utsino hia nuweselei Aquetsi, gadono nvsginadvnisiquo?  Tsadoda isdvyohvgi uwelihisdi oginadanvtawadegvgi.
\syll ᏧᎦᏴᎵᎨᏃ ᎬᏩᎪᎲ ᎤᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏎᎢ; ᎤᏥᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ ᎠᏇᏥ, ᎦᏙᏃ ᏅᏍᎩᎾᏛᏂᏏᏉ?  ᏣᏙᏓ ᎢᏍᏛᏲᎲᎩ ᎤᏪᎵᎯᏍᏗ ᎣᎩᎾᏓᏅᏔᏩᏕᎬᎩ.
\ft And when they saw him, they were amazed: and his mother said unto him, Son, why hast thou thus dealt with us? behold, thy father and I have sought thee sorrowing.

\ln Hiano niduweselei; Gadono isginiyohei?  Tlasgo yisdigatahe Edodoyi ase aquedasdi gesvi?
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎦᏙᏃ ᎢᏍᎩᏂᏲᎮᎢ?  ᏝᏍᎪ ᏱᏍᏗᎦᏔᎮ ᎡᏙᏙᏱ ᎠᏎ ᎠᏇᏓᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ?
\ft And he said unto them, How is it that ye sought me? wist ye not that I must be about my Father's business?

\ln Aseno vtla yunolitse nasgi niduweselvi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏳᏃᎵᏤ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎢ.
\ft And they understood not the saying which he spake unto them.

\ln Dusdawadvseno, ale Naselidi wulutsei, ale deunelodei.  Utsisgini hia nasgi nigadv usquanigotane unawiyi.
\syll ᏚᏍᏓᏩᏛᏎᏃ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏎᎵᏗ ᏭᎷᏤᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᎤᏁᎶᏕᎢ.  ᎤᏥᏍᎩᏂ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏔᏁ ᎤᎾᏫᏱ.
\ft And he went down with them, and came to Nazareth, and was subject unto them: but his mother kept all these sayings in her heart.

\ln Ale Tsisa kanequotsise agatahnaiyu gesv ale advsgvi ale Unelanvhi ale yvwi gvwageyuhiyu gesvi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏥᏌ ᎧᏁᏉᏥᏎ ᎠᎦᏔᎿᎢᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏛᏍᎬᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏴᏫ ᎬᏩᎨᏳᎯᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft And Jesus increased in wisdom and stature, and in favour with God and man.

\ln Hisgigadusineno udetiyvsadisv Daquiliya Sisa ugvwiyuhi gesvi, Quvdiya Qualedi Tsudiyi tsaganelodi gesei, ale Elodv gelili sgadugi gesv atsigatidisdi gesei, unvtlino Quiligi Iduli ale Tlagonidi atsigatidisdi gesei, Lisaniyano Aquilini atsigatidisdi gesei;

\syll ᎡᎾᏃ ᎠᎴ ᎦᏱᏆ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏬᏂᏒᎯ ᎢᎾᎨ ᎤᎷᏤᎴ ᏣᏂ ᏤᎦᎳᏯ ᎤᏪᏥ.

\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎨᎦᏬᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏂᎸᏐᎸᎯ; Ᏺ ᎢᎾᏛ ᏧᏁᏥ ᏂᎯ  ᎦᎪ ᎢᏤᏯᏔᏅ ᎡᏣᎵᎡᏗᏱ ᎤᏔᎳᏬᎯᏍᏗ ᎤᎷᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ?

\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏥᎾᏄᎪᏩ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏙᏗ ᏕᏥᏁᏟᏴᏒ ᏕᏣᏓᏅᏛᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎢᏣᎴᏅᎲ ᎯᎠ ᎢᏥᏪᏒ ᏕᏣᏓᏅᏛᎢ; ᎡᏆᎭᎻ ᎣᎩᏙᏓ ᎠᏴ; ᎢᏨᏲᏎᏰᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏰᎵᏉ ᎯᎠ ᏅᏯ ᏱᏕᎬᏓ ᏱᏕᎪᏢᎾ ᎡᏆᎭᎻ ᏧᏪᏥ.

\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎦᏳᎳ ᎦᎷᏯᏍᏗ ᎠᏅᎯ ᏚᎿᏍᏕᏢ ᏕᏡᎬᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏕᏡᎬ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎾᏓᏛᏍᎬᎾ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏗᎦᎴᏴᏍᏙᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏥᎸᏱ ᏫᏓᏗᏅᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.

\syll ᎤᏂᏣᏘᏃ ᎠᏂᎦᏖᏃᎮᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛᏉ ᎠᏫ ᏙᏧᎾᏓᏅᏛ ᎬᏩᏓᏅᏖᏍᎨ ᏣᏂ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎨᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ;

\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎳᏐᏫᏍᏗ ᎠᏰᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏓᎦᎳᏐᏫᏏ ᎠᏲᏓᏝᎲᎢ, ᎤᏣᎴᏍᏗᏃ ᏓᎦᏟᏌᏂ ᏛᏂ ᎤᏗᏱ; ᎤᏬᎭᏄᎶᏔᏅᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᏛᎪᎲᏍᏔᏂ ᎠᏥᎸᏱ ᏂᎬᏠᏍᎬᎾ.

\ln Asginano usquadv nigadv ugoliyesgvi, udanvele ilvsgi igohidv.

\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ, ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎬᏩᏜᏫᏍᏗᏕᎨ ᎤᎾᏛᎪᏗᏱ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎤᎾᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎨᏂᏏᎳᏗ ᎥᏓᎷᎶᏗ ᎦᏙᎨᎢ.
\ft And it came to pass, that, as the people pressed upon him to hear the word of God, he stood by the lake of Gennesaret,

\ln Tsiyuno tali dugohe vdalulodi datalei; anigayaluvsgisgini unatsaidv gesei, ale danvgilosge gunigayaludi.
\syll ᏥᏳᏃ ᏔᎵ ᏚᎪᎮ ᎥᏓᎷᎶᏗ ᏓᏔᎴᎢ; ᎠᏂᎦᏯᎷᎥᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᎾᏣᎢᏛ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᏅᎩᎶᏍᎨ ᎫᏂᎦᏯᎷᏗ.
\ft And saw two ships standing by the lake: but the fishermen were gone out of them, and were washing their nets.

\ln Saquono atalv tsiyu utsanei nasgi Sawani utseliga gesei, ale utayosele usdigidv iyvdv wukadoyasdiyi.  Uweneno ale duweyone unitsati tsiyui gvwatsai.
\syll ᏌᏉᏃ ᎠᏔᎸ ᏥᏳ ᎤᏣᏁᎢ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏌᏩᏂ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏔᏲᏎᎴ ᎤᏍᏗᎩᏛ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏭᎧᏙᏯᏍᏗᏱ.  ᎤᏪᏁᏃ ᎠᎴ ᏚᏪᏲᏁ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏥᏳᎢ ᎬᏩᏣᎢ.
\ft And he entered into one of the ships, which was Simon's, and prayed him that he would thrust out a little from the land. And he sat down, and taught the people out of the ship.

\ln Hnaquono uyohistanv gawonisgv hia nuwesele Sawani, disdvgv winvsdv ale eladi niditsvga ditsigayaludi ditsiniyvdiyi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎤᏲᎯᏍᏔᏅ ᎦᏬᏂᏍᎬ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴ ᏌᏩᏂ, ᏗᏍᏛᎬ ᏫᏅᏍᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎡᎳᏗ ᏂᏗᏨᎦ ᏗᏥᎦᏯᎷᏗ ᏗᏥᏂᏴᏗᏱ.
\ft Now when he had left speaking, he said unto Simon, Launch out into the deep, and let down your nets for a draught.

\ln Sawanino unetse hia nuweselei; Tadeyohvsgi ulitsvdaquadv dogilvwisdasi vtlano gohusdi yotsiniyv; aseno nihi tsanetsv iyusdi dagvni agayaludi.
\syll ᏌᏩᏂᏃ ᎤᏁᏤ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᏔᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ ᎤᎵᏨᏓᏆᏛ ᏙᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏏ ᎥᏝᏃ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏲᏥᏂᏴ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᏂᎯ ᏣᏁᏨ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏓᎬᏂ ᎠᎦᏯᎷᏗ.
\ft And Simon answering said unto him, Master, we have toiled all the night, and have taken nothing: nevertheless at thy word I will let down the net.

\ln Nasgino nunadvnelv unitsati duniniyvhe atsadi; ale unigayaludi dunaligaliselei
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏄᎾᏛᏁᎸ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏚᏂᏂᏴᎮ ᎠᏣᏗ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᎦᏯᎷᏗ ᏚᎾᎵᎦᎵᏎᎴᎢ
\ft And when they had this done, they inclosed a great multitude of fishes: and their net brake.

\ln Dunanelotsineleno unaligohi soiyi tsiyuhi unatsai nvdagvwanisdelvhvsdiyi.  Unilutseno, ale itsula tsiyu dunikalilei, nasgino hnaquo deganoyvgei.
\syll ᏚᎾᏁᎶᏥᏁᎴᏃ ᎤᎾᎵᎪᎯ ᏐᎢᏱ ᏥᏳᎯ ᎤᎾᏣᎢ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏂᏍᏕᎸᎲᏍᏗᏱ.  ᎤᏂᎷᏤᏃ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏧᎳ ᏥᏳ ᏚᏂᎧᎵᎴᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎿᏉ ᏕᎦᏃᏴᎨᎢ.
\ft And they beckoned unto their partners, which were in the other ship, that they should come and help them. And they came, and filled both the ships, so that they began to sink.

\ln Sanonino Quida ugohv udanvne Tsisa dikanigeni navi, hia nigawesgei; Tsagvwiyuhi squadanvsi, tsisganahiyuyeno ayv.
\syll ᏌᏃᏂᏃ ᏈᏓ ᎤᎪᎲ ᎤᏓᏅᏁ ᏥᏌ ᏗᎧᏂᎨᏂ ᎾᎥᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎨᎢ; ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏍᏆᏓᏅᏏ, ᏥᏍᎦᏀᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᎠᏴ.
\ft When Simon Peter saw it, he fell down at Jesus' knees, saying, Depart from me; for I am a sinful man, O Lord.

\ln Usquanigoseyeno ale nigadv anehi unisquanigose nvdigalisdodisge naniv atsadi duniniyvhvi;
\syll ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏎᏰᏃ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎠᏁᎯ ᎤᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏎ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎠᏣᏗ ᏚᏂᏂᏴᎲᎢ;
\ft For he was astonished, and all that were with him, at the draught of the fishes which they had taken:

\ln Ale nasquo Tsimi ale Tsani Tsequidi tsuwetsi nasgi unaligohi tsigese Sawani.  Tsisano hia nuwesele Sawani; Tlesdi tsasgalvgi; gohi iyudalenvdv yvwi tiniyisgi gesesdi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏥᎻ ᎠᎴ ᏣᏂ ᏤᏈᏗ ᏧᏪᏥ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᎵᎪᎯ ᏥᎨᏎ ᏌᏩᏂ.  ᏥᏌᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴ ᏌᏩᏂ; ᏞᏍᏗ ᏣᏍᎦᎸᎩ; ᎪᎯ ᎢᏳᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᏘᏂᏱᏍᎩ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft And so was also James, and John, the sons of Zebedee, which were partners with Simon. And Jesus said unto Simon, Fear not; from henceforth thou shalt catch men.

\ln Uwatlavno dunitaladilv tsiyu, nigadv duniyosone ale gvwasdawadvsei.
\syll ᎤᏩᏝᎥᏃ ᏚᏂᏔᎳᏗᎸ ᏥᏳ, ᏂᎦᏛ ᏚᏂᏲᏐᏁ ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏛᏎᎢ.
\ft And when they had brought their ships to land, they forsook all, and followed him.

\ln Hiano nulistane ilvhitlv gaduhv edohvi, gvniyuquo asgaya nigv adayesgi utlvgi nahna edohei; nasgi Tsisaugohv uyasdusei, ale utayosele hia nuwesei, Tsagvwiyuhi, iyuno osiyu yitsayelvnv yeliquo yisginvgalv.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁ ᎢᎸᎯᏢ ᎦᏚᎲ ᎡᏙᎲᎢ, ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᏂᎬ ᎠᏓᏰᏍᎩ ᎤᏢᎩ ᏀᎾ ᎡᏙᎮᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏌᎤᎪᎲ ᎤᏯᏍᏚᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏔᏲᏎᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎣᏏᏳ ᏱᏣᏰᎸᏅ ᏰᎵᏉ ᏱᏍᎩᏅᎦᎸ.
\ft And it came to pass, when he was in a certain city, behold a man full of leprosy: who seeing Jesus fell on his face, and besought him, saying, Lord, if thou wilt, thou canst make me clean.

\ln Udoyanvhidvno usvnilei, hia nuwesei; Osiyu tsiyelvna; tsadanvgalvdv gesesdi.  Gilaquono iyvdv adayesgi utlvgv udanvelei.
\syll ᎤᏙᏯᏅᎯᏛᏃ ᎤᏒᏂᎴᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎣᏏᏳ ᏥᏰᎸᎾ; ᏣᏓᏅᎦᎸᏛ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.  ᎩᎳᏉᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎠᏓᏰᏍᎩ ᎤᏢᎬ ᎤᏓᏅᎡᎴᎢ.
\ft And he put forth his hand, and touched him, saying, I will: be thou clean. And immediately the leprosy departed from him.

\ln Unetseleno gilo unonediyi nigesvna; henaquosgini, [uwoselei,] wiyadananugowisi atsilvgelohi, ale Mosi unetsv tsadanvgalvhv alisgolvdodi wihvga, nasgi unadolehohisdodi.
\syll ᎤᏁᏤᎴᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏃᏁᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ; ᎮᎾᏉᏍᎩᏂ, ᎤᏬᏎᎴᎢ,data is invalid ᏫᏯᏓᎾᏄᎪᏫᏏ ᎠᏥᎸᎨᎶᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎼᏏ ᎤᏁᏨ ᏣᏓᏅᎦᎸᎲ ᎠᎵᏍᎪᎸᏙᏗ ᏫᎲᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏙᏗ.
\ft And he charged him to tell no man: but go, and shew thyself to the priest, and offer for thy cleansing, according as Moses commanded, for a testimony unto them.

\ln Aseno utliquo igai duyelise nasgi deganotsalvi.  Unitsatino dunilawitsole unadulisge unadvgodiyi ale tsunvwodiyi dunitlvgvi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏟᏉ ᎢᎦᎢ ᏚᏰᎵᏎ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏕᎦᏃᏣᎸᎢ.  ᎤᏂᏣᏘᏃ ᏚᏂᎳᏫᏦᎴ ᎤᎾᏚᎵᏍᎨ ᎤᎾᏛᎪᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᏧᏅᏬᏗᏱ ᏚᏂᏢᎬᎢ.
\ft But so much the more went there a fame abroad of him: and great multitudes came together to hear, and to be healed by him of their infirmities.

\ln Udanvseno inage wolose ale adadolisdisgei.
\syll ᎤᏓᏅᏎᏃ ᎢᎾᎨ ᏬᎶᏎ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎨᎢ.
\ft And he withdrew himself into the wilderness, and prayed.

\ln Ilvhiyuno hia nulistanei, nahiyu dadeyohvsgei, nahna anine Aniqualisi ale dikahnawadvsdi dinosisisgi degaduwadisv Gelili nvdawanilosvhi, ale Tsudiyi, ale Tsilusilimi; Ugvwiyuhino ulinigvgv dunadiwisdisgei.
\syll ᎢᎸᎯᏳᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᏀᎢᏳ ᏓᏕᏲᎲᏍᎨᎢ, ᏀᎾ ᎠᏂᏁ ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏗᏃᏏᏏᏍᎩ ᏕᎦᏚᏩᏗᏒ ᎨᎵᎵ ᏅᏓᏩᏂᎶᏒᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ; ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᏃ ᎤᎵᏂᎬᎬ ᏚᎾᏗᏫᏍᏗᏍᎨᎢ.
\ft And it came to pass on a certain day, as he was teaching, that there were Pharisees and doctors of the law sitting by, which were come out of every town of Galilee, and Judaea, and Jerusalem: and the power of the Lord was present to heal them.

\ln Ale gvniyuquo gilo iyunasdi anisgaya uninole atsesdogihi ganvge asgaya ulvdalvvsgi; unanelotaneno uniyvtanihisdiyi, ale [Tsisa] igvyitlv uninvnediyi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᏂᏃᎴ ᎠᏤᏍᏙᎩᎯ ᎦᏅᎨ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᎸᏓᎸᎥᏍᎩ; ᎤᎾᏁᎶᏔᏁᏃ ᎤᏂᏴᏔᏂᎯᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᏌdata is invalid ᎢᎬᏱᏢ ᎤᏂᏅᏁᏗᏱ.
\ft And, behold, men brought in a bed a man which was taken with a palsy: and they sought means to bring him in, and to lay him before him.

\ln Unatlotsvno iyunadvnediyi uniyvtanihisdiyi unitsati gesv iyusdi, gasanali unagilawisei, nahnano tsunigadvlehistane unatlovtanile utsesdo gvwatloyasdi unadatlugv ayeli, Tsisa igvyitlv uninvnelei.
\syll ᎤᎾᏠᏨᏃ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᏁᏗᏱ ᎤᏂᏴᏔᏂᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᎦᏌᎾᎵ ᎤᎾᎩᎳᏫᏎᎢ, ᏀᎾᏃ ᏧᏂᎦᏛᎴᎯᏍᏔᏁ ᎤᎾᏠᎥᏔᏂᎴ ᎤᏤᏍᏙ ᎬᏩᏠᏯᏍᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬ ᎠᏰᎵ, ᏥᏌ ᎢᎬᏱᏢ ᎤᏂᏅᏁᎴᎢ.
\ft And when they could not find by what way they might bring him in because of the multitude, they went upon the housetop, and let him down through the tiling with his couch into the midst before Jesus.

\ln Unohiyusvno udolehosv, hia nuweselei; Hisgaya, tsasganvtsv etsadoligi.
\syll ᎤᏃᎯᏳᏒᏃ ᎤᏙᎴᎰᏒ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎯᏍᎦᏯ, ᏣᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᎡᏣᏙᎵᎩ.
\ft And when he saw their faith, he said unto him, Man, thy sins are forgiven thee.

\ln Dinowelisgino ale Aniqualisi unadanvtele hia nuniwesei; Gago hia nasgi tsasotlvisdiha?  Gago gvwadadolisdi asganvtsvi?  Tlasgo unelanvhi uwasv?
\syll ᏗᏃᏪᎵᏍᎩᏃ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏖᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ; ᎦᎪ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏣᏐᏢᎢᏍᏗᎭ?  ᎦᎪ ᎬᏩᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎠᏍᎦᏅᏨᎢ?  ᏝᏍᎪ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏩᏒ?
\ft And the scribes and the Pharisees began to reason, saying, Who is this which speaketh blasphemies? Who can forgive sins, but God alone?

\ln Aseno Tsisa udolehosv nusdv danadanvtesgvi, unetse hia niduweselei; Gado itsadanvteha dodilodanvdvi?
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎤᏙᎴᎰᏒ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏓᎾᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬᎢ, ᎤᏁᏤ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎦᏙ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏖᎭ ᏙᏗᎶᏓᏅᏛᎢ?
\ft But when Jesus perceived their thoughts, he answering said unto them, What reason ye in your hearts?

\ln Gado usdi utli ahidiyu kaneisdiyi, Tsasganvtsv etsadoligi advdiyi; ale hia igawesdiyi, Talehvga ale heda?
\syll ᎦᏙ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎤᏟ ᎠᎯᏗᏳ ᎧᏁᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᏣᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᎡᏣᏙᎵᎩ ᎠᏛᏗᏱ; ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᎢᎦᏪᏍᏗᏱ, ᏔᎴᎲᎦ ᎠᎴ ᎮᏓ?
\ft Whether is easier, to say, Thy sins be forgiven thee; or to say, Rise up and walk?

\ln Aseno itsadolehohisdiyi Yvwi Uwetsi yeliquo ani elohi gvwadadolisdi gesv osganvtsvi, (hia nuwesele ulvdalvvsgi;) hia nigvweseha; Talehvga, tsatsesdo hinagi, ale ditsenvsv hena.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎢᏣᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᏰᎵᏉ ᎠᏂ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎬᏩᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎣᏍᎦᏅᏨᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴ ᎤᎸᏓᎸᎥᏍᎩ; ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏪᏎᎭ; ᏔᎴᎲᎦ, ᏣᏤᏍᏙ ᎯᎾᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏤᏅᏒ ᎮᎾ.
\ft But that ye may know that the Son of man hath power upon earth to forgive sins, (he said unto the sick of the palsy,) I say unto thee, Arise, and take up thy couch, and go into thine house.

\ln Gilaquono iyvdv udidvhe danikanvi, ale unese utsesdogi, ale tsuwenvsv wulosei, galvquodisge Unelanvhi.
\syll ᎩᎳᏉᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎤᏗᏛᎮ ᏓᏂᎧᏅᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᏎ ᎤᏤᏍᏙᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏪᏅᏒ ᏭᎶᏎᎢ, ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏍᎨ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ.
\ft And immediately he rose up before them, and took up that whereon he lay, and departed to his own house, glorifying God.

\ln Nigadiyuno utsatanvhi unisquanigosei, ale unilvquotane Unelanvhi, ale ukalitsvhi unayehisdi unadanvdadei, hia naniwesgei; Usquanigodiyu idigowadv gohi iga.
\syll ᏂᎦᏗᏳᏃ ᎤᏣᏔᏅᎯ ᎤᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᎸᏉᏔᏁ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎧᎵᏨᎯ ᎤᎾᏰᎯᏍᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏓᏕᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏂᏪᏍᎨᎢ; ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗᏳ ᎢᏗᎪᏩᏛ ᎪᎯ ᎢᎦ.
\ft And they were all amazed, and they glorified God, and were filled with fear, saying, We have seen strange things to day.

\ln Nasgino hia nulistanidolv unugotsei, ale ugohe adelv agisidohi Liwi tsudoidv, uwole ayeli ehi adelv aguyvdiyi; ale hia nuweselei, Sgisdawaduga.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏂᏙᎸ ᎤᏄᎪᏤᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎪᎮ ᎠᏕᎸ ᎠᎩᏏᏙᎯ ᎵᏫ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ, ᎤᏬᎴ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎡᎯ ᎠᏕᎸ ᎠᎫᏴᏗᏱ; ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏍᎩᏍᏓᏩᏚᎦ.
