\ln Nasgino itsulaha tsunigasoasv uwodalv ulenei.  Ale unitsati gvwasdawadidohi, ale unitsuquisdi yvwi nigvnadv Tsudiyi ale Tsilusilimi nvdayunilosvhi, ale Taya ale Sadoni amequohi ulodi nvdayunilosvhi, nasgi tsunilutse gvwadvganediyi, ale digetsinvwodiyi dunitlvgvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᏧᏂᎦᏐᎠᏒ ᎤᏬᏓᎸ ᎤᎴᏁᎢ.  ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏧᏈᏍᏗ ᏴᏫ ᏂᎬᎾᏛ ᏧᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᏅᏓᏳᏂᎶᏒᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏔᏯ ᎠᎴ ᏌᏙᏂ ᎠᎺᏉᎯ ᎤᎶᏗ ᏅᏓᏳᏂᎶᏒᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏂᎷᏤ ᎬᏩᏛᎦᏁᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎨᏥᏅᏬᏗᏱ ᏚᏂᏢᎬᎢ.
\ft And he came down with them, and stood in the plain, and the company of his disciples, and a great multitude of people out of all Judaea and Jerusalem, and from the sea coast of Tyre and Sidon, which came to hear him, and to be healed of their diseases;

\ln Ale anigadaha didanvdo gvwanadeyadodidegi [unilutsei]; ale degetsinvwanei.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᎦᏓᎭ ᏗᏓᏅᏙ ᎬᏩᎾᏕᏯᏙᏗᏕᎩ ᎤᏂᎷᏤᎢdata is invalid; ᎠᎴ ᏕᎨᏥᏅᏩᏁᎢ.
\ft And they that were vexed with unclean spirits: and they were healed.

\ln Nigadvno unitsati gesv anatlinigvnehe gvwasvnisdiyi.  Nasgiyeno gesv didalehvsge udanvwodi gesv ale dunadiwisdisge nanivi.
\syll ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎾᏟᏂᎬᏁᎮ ᎬᏩᏒᏂᏍᏗᏱ.  ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎨᏒ ᏗᏓᎴᎲᏍᎨ ᎤᏓᏅᏬᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏚᎾᏗᏫᏍᏗᏍᎨ ᎾᏂᎥᎢ.
\ft And the whole multitude sought to touch him: for there went virtue out of him, and healed them all.

\ln Dusaladaneno digadoli dukanane gvwasdawadidohi, hia nuwesei; Osiyu itsalisdanedi uyo itsadvhnadegi; itsatseliyeno Unelanvhi ugvwiyuhi gesvi.
\syll ᏚᏌᎳᏓᏁᏃ ᏗᎦᏙᎵ ᏚᎧᎾᏁ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎤᏲ ᎢᏣᏛᎿᏕᎩ; ᎢᏣᏤᎵᏰᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft And he lifted up his eyes on his disciples, and said, Blessed be ye poor: for yours is the kingdom of God.

\ln Osiyu itsalisdanedi ditsiyosisgi gohi gesvi; dodatsolvsiyeno.  Osiyu itsalisdanedi ditsatloyihi gohi gesvi; dvtsiyetsiyeno.
\syll ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᏗᏥᏲᏏᏍᎩ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᏙᏓᏦᎸᏏᏰᏃ.  ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᏗᏣᏠᏱᎯ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᏛᏥᏰᏥᏰᏃ.
\ft Blessed are ye that hunger now: for ye shall be filled. Blessed are ye that weep now: for ye shall laugh.

\ln Osiyu itsalisdanedi iyuno yvwi getsiniquatihesdi, ale getsadadaledisgesdi, ale gagetsisotlvdesdi, ale anisgagiyu gesesdi detsadov gohusdi uyo nasgiyai, Yvwi Uwetsi nvdigalisdodisgesdi.
\syll ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎢᏳᏃ ᏴᏫ ᎨᏥᏂᏆᏘᎮᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎨᏣᏓᏓᎴᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᎨᏥᏐᏢᏕᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᎩᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏕᏣᏙᎥ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏲ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ, ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
\ft Blessed are ye, when men shall hate you, and when they shall separate you from their company, and shall reproach you, and cast out your name as evil, for the Son of man's sake.

\ln Itsaliheligesdi nahiyu iga, ale detsalitadegesdi itsaliheligvi; gvniyuquoyeno utsati etsaguyvedi galvladi; nasgiyayeno tsunidoda nidunvnele anadolehosgi.
\syll ᎢᏣᎵᎮᎵᎨᏍᏗ ᏀᎢᏳ ᎢᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᏣᎵᏔᏕᎨᏍᏗ ᎢᏣᎵᎮᎵᎬᎢ; ᎬᏂᏳᏉᏰᏃ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎡᏣᎫᏴᎡᏗ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ; ᎾᏍᎩᏯᏰᏃ ᏧᏂᏙᏓ ᏂᏚᏅᏁᎴ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ.
\ft Rejoice ye in that day, and leap for joy: for, behold, your reward is great in heaven: for in the like manner did their fathers unto the prophets.

\ln Nihisgini ditsenai tsigi, uyo itsalisdanedi!  gayulayeno itsiha itsigalisdadisgi.
\syll ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᏗᏤᎾᎢ ᏥᎩ, ᎤᏲ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ  ᎦᏳᎳᏰᏃ ᎢᏥᎭ ᎢᏥᎦᎵᏍᏓᏗᏍᎩ.
\ft But woe unto you that are rich! for ye have received your consolation.

\ln Uyoiyu itsalisdanedi ditsolvsvhi!  dodvtsiyosisaniyeno.  Uyoiyu itsalisdanedi itsiyetsasgi tsigi gohi!  uyoyeno itsadanvtawadegesdi ale detsatloyihesdi.
\syll ᎤᏲᎢᏳ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᏗᏦᎸᏒᎯ  ᏙᏛᏥᏲᏏᏌᏂᏰᏃ.  ᎤᏲᎢᏳ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎢᏥᏰᏣᏍᎩ ᏥᎩ ᎪᎯ  ᎤᏲᏰᏃ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏔᏩᏕᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏕᏣᏠᏱᎮᏍᏗ.
\ft Woe unto you that are full! for ye shall hunger. Woe unto you that laugh now! for ye shall mourn and weep.

\ln Uyoiyu itsalisdanedi nahiyu nigadiyu yvwi osiyu getsinohesgesdi!  nasgiyayeno tsunigayvlige nidunilvquode unatlonasdi anadolehosgi.
\syll ᎤᏲᎢᏳ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᏀᎢᏳ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏴᏫ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎨᏥᏃᎮᏍᎨᏍᏗ  ᎾᏍᎩᏯᏰᏃ ᏧᏂᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᏂᏚᏂᎸᏉᏕ ᎤᎾᏠᎾᏍᏗ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ.
\ft Woe unto you, when all men shall speak well of you! for so did their fathers to the false prophets.

\ln Aseno hia nitsvweseha nihi tsisgiyadvganeha; Detsigeyusesdi getsisgagi, osdv nidetsadvnehesdi getsiniquatihi,
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ ᏂᎯ ᏥᏍᎩᏯᏛᎦᏁᎭ; ᏕᏥᎨᏳᏎᏍᏗ ᎨᏥᏍᎦᎩ, ᎣᏍᏛ ᏂᏕᏣᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᎨᏥᏂᏆᏘᎯ,
\ft But I say unto you which hear, Love your enemies, do good to them which hate you,

\ln Osdv detsinetsehesdi getsisginvdisgi, ale itsadadolisdisgesdi getsidolisdiyi gagetsisotlvdisgi.
\syll ᎣᏍᏛ ᏕᏥᏁᏤᎮᏍᏗ ᎨᏥᏍᎩᏅᏗᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏣᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎨᏥᏙᎵᏍᏗᏱ ᎦᎨᏥᏐᏢᏗᏍᎩ.
\ft Bless them that curse you, and pray for them which despitefully use you.

\ln Gilono higoqualii itsvnihesdi soiyi nasquo hiyalisgolvdanehesdi; gilono udvnohi tsanaehesdi, nasquo hawini tsanuwo tlesdi higeyutanvgi.
\syll ᎩᎶᏃ ᎯᎪᏆᎵᎢ ᎢᏨᏂᎮᏍᏗ ᏐᎢᏱ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎯᏯᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ; ᎩᎶᏃ ᎤᏛᏃᎯ ᏣᎾᎡᎮᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᏉ ᎭᏫᏂ ᏣᏄᏬ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎯᎨᏳᏔᏅᎩ.
\ft And unto him that smiteth thee on the one cheek offer also the other; and him that taketh away thy cloke forbid not to take thy coat also.

\ln Naniv getsatayosehi dehinehesdi; gohusdino tsanav tsagiehi tlesdi hitayoselvgi.
\syll ᎾᏂᎥ ᎨᏣᏔᏲᏎᎯ ᏕᎯᏁᎮᏍᏗ; ᎪᎱᏍᏗᏃ ᏣᎾᎥ ᏣᎩᎡᎯ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎯᏔᏲᏎᎸᎩ.
\ft Give to every man that asketh of thee; and of him that taketh away thy goods ask them not again.

\ln Nasgiyano nusdv itsadulisgv igetsadvnediyi yvwi, nasgiya nasquo nidetsadvnehesdi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏯᏃ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎢᏣᏚᎵᏍᎬ ᎢᎨᏣᏛᏁᏗᏱ ᏴᏫ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏂᏕᏣᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ.
\ft And as ye would that men should do to you, do ye also to them likewise.

\ln Iyuyeno getsigeyuhiquo [unvsv] yiditsigeyuha, gado itsiha gayetsalielitsedi gesvi?  Anisganayeno nasquo dunigeyuso gvwanigeyuhi.
\syll ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᎨᏥᎨᏳᎯᏉ ᎤᏅᏒdata is invalid ᏱᏗᏥᎨᏳᎭ, ᎦᏙ ᎢᏥᎭ ᎦᏰᏣᎵᎡᎵᏤᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ?  ᎠᏂᏍᎦᎾᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏚᏂᎨᏳᏐ ᎬᏩᏂᎨᏳᎯ.
\ft For if ye love them which love you, what thank have ye? for sinners also love those that love them.

\ln Iyu ale osdv yiniditsadvneha osdv igetsadvnehi, gado itsiha gayetsalielitsedi gesvi?  Anisganayeno nasquo nasgiya nanadvnehoi.
\syll ᎢᏳ ᎠᎴ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏱᏂᏗᏣᏛᏁᎭ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎢᎨᏣᏛᏁᎯ, ᎦᏙ ᎢᏥᎭ ᎦᏰᏣᎵᎡᎵᏤᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ?  ᎠᏂᏍᎦᎾᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᎾᏛᏁᎰᎢ.
\ft And if ye do good to them which do good to you, what thank have ye? for sinners also do even the same.

\ln Iyu ale dvgogineli ditselisehi yiditsadolasdiha; gado itsiha gayetsalielitsedi gesvi?  Anisganayeno nasquo anisgana danadolasdisgoi, nasgi igai taline vgetsinediyi.
\syll ᎢᏳ ᎠᎴ ᏛᎪᎩᏁᎵ ᏗᏤᎵᏎᎯ ᏱᏗᏣᏙᎳᏍᏗᎭ; ᎦᏙ ᎢᏥᎭ ᎦᏰᏣᎵᎡᎵᏤᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ?  ᎠᏂᏍᎦᎾᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᎾ ᏓᎾᏙᎳᏍᏗᏍᎪᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎦᎢ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎥᎨᏥᏁᏗᏱ.
\ft And if ye lend to them of whom ye hope to receive, what thank have ye? for sinners also lend to sinners, to receive as much again.

\ln Nihisgini detsigeyusesdi getsisgagi, ale osdv detsilvwisdaehesdi, ale itsadadolasdisgesdi udugi nitsvsvna vetsinidiyi gohusdi; utsatino etsaguyvedi gesesdi, wasdvno Galvladiyu ehi tsuwetsi gesesdi nihi; nasgiyeno osdv nidadvneho nunalihelitsadvna ale uniyoi.
\syll ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᏕᏥᎨᏳᏎᏍᏗ ᎨᏥᏍᎦᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏕᏥᎸᏫᏍᏓᎡᎮᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏣᏓᏙᎳᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᏚᎩ ᏂᏨᏒᎾ ᎥᎡᏥᏂᏗᏱ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ; ᎤᏣᏘᏃ ᎡᏣᎫᏴᎡᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᏩᏍᏛᏃ ᎦᎸᎳᏗᏳ ᎡᎯ ᏧᏪᏥ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏂᎯ; ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏂᏓᏛᏁᎰ ᏄᎾᎵᎮᎵᏣᏛᎾ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏲᎢ.
\ft But love ye your enemies, and do good, and lend, hoping for nothing again; and your reward shall be great, and ye shall be the children of the Highest: for he is kind unto the unthankful and to the evil.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi itsadadolitsatiyu gesesdi, nasgiya Itsidoda nasquo udadolitsadiyu tsigi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏣᏓᏙᎵᏣᏘᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎢᏥᏙᏓ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏣᏗᏳ ᏥᎩ.
\ft Be ye therefore merciful, as your Father also is merciful.

\ln Tlesdi itsadalawiselvgi, nihino vtla yvgayetsilawisi; tlesdi ditsadadugodanelvgi, nihino vtla yidogayetsugodasi; detsidoligesdi getsisganvtsehi, nihino ase etsidolisdi gesesdi;
\syll ᏞᏍᏗ ᎢᏣᏓᎳᏫᏎᎸᎩ, ᏂᎯᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏴᎦᏰᏥᎳᏫᏏ; ᏞᏍᏗ ᏗᏣᏓᏚᎪᏓᏁᎸᎩ, ᏂᎯᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏙᎦᏰᏧᎪᏓᏏ; ᏕᏥᏙᎵᎨᏍᏗ ᎨᏥᏍᎦᏅᏤᎯ, ᏂᎯᏃ ᎠᏎ ᎡᏥᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ;
\ft Judge not, and ye shall not be judged: condemn not, and ye shall not be condemned: forgive, and ye shall be forgiven:

\ln Itsadanehesdi, nihino ase etsinedi gesesdi; osdv atlilodv, asdayotanvhi, ale atelvnvhi, ale gvtsewogi, getsinedi gesesdi yvwi detsadatlohvi.  Nusdvyeno itsadatliloelv nasgiya nasquo etsatliloedi gesesdi;
\syll ᎢᏣᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ, ᏂᎯᏃ ᎠᏎ ᎡᏥᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᎣᏍᏛ ᎠᏟᎶᏛ, ᎠᏍᏓᏲᏔᏅᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏖᎸᏅᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏤᏬᎩ, ᎨᏥᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏴᏫ ᏕᏣᏓᏠᎲᎢ.  ᏄᏍᏛᏰᏃ ᎢᏣᏓᏟᎶᎡᎸ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎡᏣᏟᎶᎡᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ;
\ft Give, and it shall be given unto you; good measure, pressed down, and shaken together, and running over, shall men give into your bosom. For with the same measure that ye mete withal it shall be measured to you again.

\ln Hiano nuwese dutlilosdanelei; Tsigodigewi yeliquo yatinuga digewi?  tlasgo itsula atalesv yidogvnilvgi?
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏎ ᏚᏟᎶᏍᏓᏁᎴᎢ; ᏥᎪᏗᎨᏫ ᏰᎵᏉ ᏯᏘᏄᎦ ᏗᎨᏫ?  ᏝᏍᎪ ᎢᏧᎳ ᎠᏔᎴᏒ ᏱᏙᎬᏂᎸᎩ?
\ft And he spake a parable unto them, Can the blind lead the blind? shall they not both fall into the ditch?

\ln Dideloquasgi vtla utli yinatsilvquodo esgaquo tsuweyohvsgi; nanivsgini unisquadvhi tsuneyohvsgi nusdv nasgiya gesesdi.
\syll ᏗᏕᎶᏆᏍᎩ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏟ ᏱᎾᏥᎸᏉᏙ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᏧᏪᏲᎲᏍᎩ; ᎾᏂᎥᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏂᏍᏆᏛᎯ ᏧᏁᏲᎲᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft The disciple is not above his master: but every one that is perfect shall be as his master.

\ln Ale gadono ihigowatisgo utlvdalvdv ugasuhvi disdadanvtli, nelisgvnano igeso unosdv ada tsvsv tsagasuhvi?
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎦᏙᏃ ᎢᎯᎪᏩᏘᏍᎪ ᎤᏢᏓᎸᏛ ᎤᎦᏑᎲᎢ ᏗᏍᏓᏓᏅᏟ, ᏁᎵᏍᎬᎾᏃ ᎢᎨᏐ ᎤᏃᏍᏛ ᎠᏓ ᏨᏒ ᏣᎦᏑᎲᎢ?
\ft And why beholdest thou the mote that is in thy brother's eye, but perceivest not the beam that is in thine own eye?

\ln Ale gado yigalisdoda hia yiniwesi disdadanvtli; Dinadanvtli gvlvsi utlvdalvdv tsagasuhvi, tsvsvno nigowatisgvna unosdv ada tsvsv tsagasuhvi?  Tsatlonasdi!  igvyi hilv unosdv ada tsvsv tsagasuhvi, hnaquono gvnigesviyu tsagowadvdiyi gesesdi hilvediyi utlvdalvdv disdadanvtli ugasuhvi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎦᏙ ᏱᎦᎵᏍᏙᏓ ᎯᎠ ᏱᏂᏪᏏ ᏗᏍᏓᏓᏅᏟ; ᏗᎾᏓᏅᏟ ᎬᎸᏏ ᎤᏢᏓᎸᏛ ᏣᎦᏑᎲᎢ, ᏨᏒᏃ ᏂᎪᏩᏘᏍᎬᎾ ᎤᏃᏍᏛ ᎠᏓ ᏨᏒ ᏣᎦᏑᎲᎢ?  ᏣᏠᎾᏍᏗ  ᎢᎬᏱ ᎯᎸ ᎤᏃᏍᏛ ᎠᏓ ᏨᏒ ᏣᎦᏑᎲᎢ, ᎿᏉᏃ ᎬᏂᎨᏒᎢᏳ ᏣᎪᏩᏛᏗᏱ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎯᎸᎡᏗᏱ ᎤᏢᏓᎸᏛ ᏗᏍᏓᏓᏅᏟ ᎤᎦᏑᎲᎢ.
\ft Either how canst thou say to thy brother, Brother, let me pull out the mote that is in thine eye, when thou thyself beholdest not the beam that is in thine own eye? Thou hypocrite, cast out first the beam out of thine own eye, and then shalt thou see clearly to pull out the mote that is in thy brother's eye.

\ln Osdvyeno tlugv vtla uyo yadadvsgoi; ale uyo tlugv vtla osdv yadadvsgoi.
\syll ᎣᏍᏛᏰᏃ ᏡᎬ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏲ ᏯᏓᏛᏍᎪᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᏲ ᏡᎬ ᎥᏝ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏯᏓᏛᏍᎪᎢ.
\ft For a good tree bringeth not forth corrupt fruit; neither doth a corrupt tree bring forth good fruit.

\ln Tlugvyeno  golisdodi geso nusdv uwasv adadvsgvi; tsisdunigisdihiyeno vtla svgataiyunasdi yidanadesgo yvwi, ale anugalvhi vtla telvladi yidanadesgoi.
\syll ᏡᎬᏰᏃ  ᎪᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏐ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎠᏓᏛᏍᎬᎢ; ᏥᏍᏚᏂᎩᏍᏗᎯᏰᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏒᎦᏔᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗ ᏱᏓᎾᏕᏍᎪ ᏴᏫ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏄᎦᎸᎯ ᎥᏝ ᏖᎸᎳᏗ ᏱᏓᎾᏕᏍᎪᎢ.
\ft For every tree is known by his own fruit. For of thorns men do not gather figs, nor of a bramble bush gather they grapes.

\ln Osdv yvwi osdv usquanigodv unawiyi osdv gesv gananugowisgoi; uyono yvwi uyo usquanigodv unawiyi uyo gesv gananugowisgoi; utsadvyeno unawi uwehv aholi kanegoi.
\syll ᎣᏍᏛ ᏴᏫ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏛ ᎤᎾᏫᏱ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎦᎾᏄᎪᏫᏍᎪᎢ; ᎤᏲᏃ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏲ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏛ ᎤᎾᏫᏱ ᎤᏲ ᎨᏒ ᎦᎾᏄᎪᏫᏍᎪᎢ; ᎤᏣᏛᏰᏃ ᎤᎾᏫ ᎤᏪᎲ ᎠᎰᎵ ᎧᏁᎪᎢ.
\ft A good man out of the good treasure of his heart bringeth forth that which is good; and an evil man out of the evil treasure of his heart bringeth forth that which is evil: for of the abundance of the heart his mouth speaketh.

\ln Ale gadono Tsagvwiyuhi, Tsagvwiyuhi, isgiyosehoi, nitsiwesgvno nitsadvnehvna igesoi?
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎦᏙᏃ ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎢᏍᎩᏲᏎᎰᎢ, ᏂᏥᏪᏍᎬᏃ ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎲᎾ ᎢᎨᏐᎢ?
\ft And why call ye me, Lord, Lord, and do not the things which I say?

\ln Gilo agilutsehesdi, ale advgisgesdi nitsiwesgvi, ale nasgi nadvnehesdi, datsvnanugowiseli datselv nasgi;
\syll ᎩᎶ ᎠᎩᎷᏤᎮᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏛᎩᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏂᏥᏪᏍᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ, ᏓᏨᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᎵ ᏓᏤᎸ ᎾᏍᎩ;
\ft Whosoever cometh to me, and heareth my sayings, and doeth them, I will shew you to whom he is like:

\ln Asgaya datselv nasgi na tsunesgehei, ale hawini tsusgosei, ale gagusdvdi nvyohi tsutlanei; unohuganvno equoni nahna adanelv asdayiyu gvnilihihei, ale vtla gvwatelvdi yigesei; nvyohiyeno gakahei.
\syll ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᏓᏤᎸ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏧᏁᏍᎨᎮᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎭᏫᏂ ᏧᏍᎪᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᎫᏍᏛᏗ ᏅᏲᎯ ᏧᏝᏁᎢ; ᎤᏃᎱᎦᏅᏃ ᎡᏉᏂ ᏀᎾ ᎠᏓᏁᎸ ᎠᏍᏓᏱᏳ ᎬᏂᎵᎯᎮᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᎬᏩᏖᎸᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ; ᏅᏲᎯᏰᏃ ᎦᎧᎮᎢ.
\ft He is like a man which built an house, and digged deep, and laid the foundation on a rock: and when the flood arose, the stream beat vehemently upon that house, and could not shake it: for it was founded upon a rock.

\ln Nasgisgini na udvganvhi, nudvnelvnano, nasgi asgaya datselv nidugusdavna gadohiquo adanelv tsunesgehei; equonino nahna ulinigidiyu gvnilihihei, gilaquono iyvdv uwequeyvsei; usgasediyuno nulistane uyotsv nasgi adanelvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ Ꮎ ᎤᏛᎦᏅᎯ, ᏄᏛᏁᎸᎾᏃ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᏓᏤᎸ ᏂᏚᎫᏍᏓᎥᎾ ᎦᏙᎯᏉ ᎠᏓᏁᎸ ᏧᏁᏍᎨᎮᎢ; ᎡᏉᏂᏃ ᏀᎾ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ ᎬᏂᎵᎯᎮᎢ, ᎩᎳᏉᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎤᏪᏇᏴᏎᎢ; ᎤᏍᎦᏎᏗᏳᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁ ᎤᏲᏨ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏓᏁᎸᎢ.
\ft But he that heareth, and doeth not, is like a man that without a foundation built an house upon the earth; against which the stream did beat vehemently, and immediately it fell; and the ruin of that house was great.

\ln Hnaquono usquadv nigadv gawonisgv anadvgisgv yvwi, Gequani wuyvlei.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎤᏍᏆᏛ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎦᏬᏂᏍᎬ ᎠᎾᏛᎩᏍᎬ ᏴᏫ, ᎨᏆᏂ ᏭᏴᎴᎢ.
\ft Now when he had ended all his sayings in the audience of the people, he entered into Capernaum.

\ln Gilono iyusdi asgohitsuqui aniyawisgi ditenidohi unvsidasdi, osdv uyelvhi, utlvgei, ale uyohusidena gesei.
\syll ᎩᎶᏃ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏧᏈ ᎠᏂᏯᏫᏍᎩ ᏗᏖᏂᏙᎯ ᎤᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ, ᎣᏍᏛ ᎤᏰᎸᎯ, ᎤᏢᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏲᎱᏏᏕᎾ ᎨᏎᎢ.
\ft And a certain centurion's servant, who was dear unto him, was sick, and ready to die.

\ln Tsisano atsinohesgv udvganv, dunvse tsedohv dinilawigi Anitsusi tsunatseliga, wutayosehe nvdayuwenvsdiyi unvwodiyi unvsidisdi.
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᎠᏥᏃᎮᏍᎬ ᎤᏛᎦᏅ, ᏚᏅᏎ ᏤᏙᎲ ᏗᏂᎳᏫᎩ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᏧᎾᏤᎵᎦ, ᏭᏔᏲᏎᎮ ᏅᏓᏳᏪᏅᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏅᏬᏗᏱ ᎤᏅᏏᏗᏍᏗ.
\ft And when he heard of Jesus, he sent unto him the elders of the Jews, beseeching him that he would come and heal his servant.

\ln Tsisano gvwalutselv, utsati gvwasdi yetanei, hia naniwesgei; Udanvtiyu nasgi hia tsinvtiyadvneli;
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᎬᏩᎷᏤᎸ, ᎤᏣᏘ ᎬᏩᏍᏗ ᏰᏔᏁᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏂᏪᏍᎨᎢ; ᎤᏓᏅᏘᏳ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏅᏘᏯᏛᏁᎵ;
\ft And when they came to Jesus, they besought him instantly, saying, That he was worthy for whom he should do this:

\ln Ugeyuhiyuyeno igitloyi gesv yvwi, ale iganesgelv digilawiisdiyi.
\syll ᎤᎨᏳᎯᏳᏰᏃ ᎢᎩᏠᏱ ᎨᏒ ᏴᏫ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᎦᏁᏍᎨᎸ ᏗᎩᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ.
\ft For he loveth our nation, and he hath built us a synagogue.

\ln Tsisano dusdawadvsei.  Hnaquono navquo ulule didanelv, asgohitsuqui aniyawisgi ditinidohi dotsunvse tsulii nidodagvwatlohisdiyi, hia nvtsuweselei; Tsagvwiyuhi, tlesdi tsvsv tsadadeyadotanvgi; vtlayeno yeli yinigohi tsayvsdiyi tsinelvi tsinaquasdiquo;
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᏚᏍᏓᏩᏛᏎᎢ.  ᎿᏉᏃ ᎾᎥᏉ ᎤᎷᎴ ᏗᏓᏁᎸ, ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏧᏈ ᎠᏂᏯᏫᏍᎩ ᏗᏘᏂᏙᎯ ᏙᏧᏅᏎ ᏧᎵᎢ ᏂᏙᏓᎬᏩᏠᎯᏍᏗᏱ, ᎯᎠ ᏅᏧᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᏨᏒ ᏣᏓᏕᏯᏙᏔᏅᎩ; ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᏰᎵ ᏱᏂᎪᎯ ᏣᏴᏍᏗᏱ ᏥᏁᎸᎢ ᏥᎾᏆᏍᏗᏉ;
\ft Then Jesus went with them. And when he was now not far from the house, the centurion sent friends to him, saying unto him, Lord, trouble not thyself: for I am not worthy that thou shouldest enter under my roof:

\ln Vtla ale nasquo yeli nigoi yiquelise wigvlutsediyi; hinegiquosgini, tsinvsidasdino tsuyudiwasi.
\syll ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏰᎵ ᏂᎪᎢ ᏱᏇᎵᏎ ᏫᎬᎷᏤᏗᏱ; ᎯᏁᎩᏉᏍᎩᏂ, ᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗᏃ ᏧᏳᏗᏩᏏ.
\ft Wherefore neither thought I myself worthy to come unto thee: but say in a word, and my servant shall be healed.

\ln Ayvyeno nasquo diquadanelodiquo, ale digikaha aniyawisgi ale ayv degvquanelodoi, gilono Hena tsiyosi, egoi; nvwadaleno Ehena tsiyosi, diegoi; tsinvsidasdino Hia hnadvga tsiyosi, nasgi nadvnehoi.
\syll ᎠᏴᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏗᏆᏓᏁᎶᏗᏉ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎩᎧᎭ ᎠᏂᏯᏫᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴ ᏕᎬᏆᏁᎶᏙᎢ, ᎩᎶᏃ ᎮᎾ ᏥᏲᏏ, ᎡᎪᎢ; ᏅᏩᏓᎴᏃ ᎡᎮᎾ ᏥᏲᏏ, ᏗᎡᎪᎢ; ᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎿᏛᎦ ᏥᏲᏏ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏛᏁᎰᎢ.
\ft For I also am a man set under authority, having under me soldiers, and I say unto one, Go, and he goeth; and to another, Come, and he cometh; and to my servant, Do this, and he doeth it.

\ln Tsisano nasgi hia udvganv, usquanigoselei, ale ugatahvsei, ale hia niduweseli yvwi nasgi nvdagvwasdawadvdv; hia nitsvweseha; Vtla nasquo Isili anehv nasgi igai gohiyudi gesv yagiwadvhv.
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎤᏛᎦᏅ, ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎦᏔᎲᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎵ ᏴᏫ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏛᏛ; ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ; ᎥᏝ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎢᏏᎵ ᎠᏁᎲ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏯᎩᏩᏛᎲ.
\ft When Jesus heard these things, he marvelled at him, and turned him about, and said unto the people that followed him, I say unto you, I have not found so great faith, no, not in Israel.

\ln Nasgino na nvdagetsinvsidv, wiunilutsv didanelv, atsinvsidasdi utlvtsvhi uniwadvhe udiwasvhi igesei.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ Ꮎ ᏅᏓᎨᏥᏅᏏᏛ, ᏫᎤᏂᎷᏨ ᏗᏓᏁᎸ, ᎠᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎤᏢᏨᎯ ᎤᏂᏩᏛᎮ ᎤᏗᏩᏒᎯ ᎢᎨᏎᎢ.
\ft And they that were sent, returning to the house, found the servant whole that had been sick.

\ln Hiano nulistane ugitsvdv, nasgi digaduhv Nayini tsudoidv wuyvlei; yelino anigodiyu gvwasdawadidohi gvwasdawadvsei, ale unitsati yvwi.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁ ᎤᎩᏨᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎦᏚᎲ ᎾᏱᏂ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ ᏭᏴᎴᎢ; ᏰᎵᏃ ᎠᏂᎪᏗᏳ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏛᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏴᏫ.
\ft And it came to pass the day after, that he went into a city called Nain; and many of his disciples went with him, and much people.

\ln Hnaquono galohisdiyi gotlvsv gaduhv nav ulutsv, gvniyuquo asgaya uyohusvhi aninugowisge aninisei, uwasvhiyu uwetsi gese utsi, ale nasgi uwosulotsvhi gesei; unitsateno yvwi gaduhv anehi gvwasdawadisei.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎪᏢᏒ ᎦᏚᎲ ᎾᎥ ᎤᎷᏨ, ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᎠᏂᏄᎪᏫᏍᎨ ᎠᏂᏂᏎᎢ, ᎤᏩᏒᎯᏳ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎨᏎ ᎤᏥ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏬᏑᎶᏨᎯ ᎨᏎᎢ; ᎤᏂᏣᏖᏃ ᏴᏫ ᎦᏚᎲ ᎠᏁᎯ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏎᎢ.
\ft Now when he came nigh to the gate of the city, behold, there was a dead man carried out, the only son of his mother, and she was a widow: and much people of the city was with her.

\ln Ugvwiyuhino ugohv uwedolitsei, ale hia nuweselei; Tlesdi ditsatloyilvgi.
\syll ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᏃ ᎤᎪᎲ ᎤᏪᏙᎵᏤᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᏞᏍᏗ ᏗᏣᏠᏱᎸᎩ.
\ft And when the Lord saw her, he had compassion on her, and said unto her, Weep not.

\ln Ulutsvno usitade atsitlvdvi, gvwanegino unalenawistanei.  Hiano nuwesei; Hiwinv, Hadidv, gvyoseha.
\syll ᎤᎷᏨᏃ ᎤᏏᏔᏕ ᎠᏥᏢᏛᎢ, ᎬᏩᏁᎩᏃ ᎤᎾᎴᎾᏫᏍᏔᏁᎢ.  ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎯᏫᏅ, ᎭᏗᏛ, ᎬᏲᏎᎭ.
\ft And he came and touched the bier: and they that bare him stood still. And he said, Young man, I say unto thee, Arise.

\ln Uyohusvhino udidvhe uwenei, ale ulenvhe uwonisei; utsino uwekanelei.
\syll ᎤᏲᎱᏒᎯᏃ ᎤᏗᏛᎮ ᎤᏪᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎴᏅᎮ ᎤᏬᏂᏎᎢ; ᎤᏥᏃ ᎤᏪᎧᏁᎴᎢ.
\ft And he that was dead sat up, and began to speak. And he delivered him to his mother.

\ln Nigadvno uninayesei; ale unilvquotane Unelanvhi, hia naniwesgei; Atsilvquodi adolehosgi gananugogi idehvi; ale hia; Unelanvhi dawadvhiga tsutseli yvwi.
\syll ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᎤᏂᎾᏰᏎᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᎸᏉᏔᏁ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏂᏪᏍᎨᎢ; ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏗ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎦᎾᏄᎪᎩ ᎢᏕᎲᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ; ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏓᏩᏛᎯᎦ ᏧᏤᎵ ᏴᏫ.
\ft And there came a fear on all: and they glorified God, saying, That a great prophet is risen up among us; and, That God hath visited his people.

\ln Nasgino hia atsinohesgv Tsudiyi nigvnadv duyelisidolei, ale nahna gvwaduwidv gesvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏥᏃᎮᏍᎬ ᏧᏗᏱ ᏂᎬᎾᏛ ᏚᏰᎵᏏᏙᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏀᎾ ᎬᏩᏚᏫᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft And this rumour of him went forth throughout all Judaea, and throughout all the region round about.

\ln Tsanino gvwasdawadidohi nasgi hia nigadv gvwanonelei.
\syll ᏣᏂᏃ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎬᏩᏃᏁᎴᎢ.
\ft And the disciples of John shewed him of all these things.

\ln Tsanino anitali gvwasdawadidohi widuyanvhe Tsisa tsedohv dunvse hia winuwesei; Nihisgo uluhisdi tsigi?  Tsigoge nvwadale otsigadenohesdi?
\syll ᏣᏂᏃ ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏫᏚᏯᏅᎮ ᏥᏌ ᏤᏙᎲ ᏚᏅᏎ ᎯᎠ ᏫᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᏂᎯᏍᎪ ᎤᎷᎯᏍᏗ ᏥᎩ?  ᏥᎪᎨ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᎣᏥᎦᏕᏃᎮᏍᏗ?
\ft And John calling unto him two of his disciples sent them to Jesus, saying, Art thou he that should come? or look we for another?

\ln Anisgayano gvwalutselv, hia nuniwesei; Tsani Didawosgi tsogininvsv isdvlutsediyi, hia nvdigaweha; Nihisgo uluhisdi tsigesvgi?  Tsigoge nvwadale otsigatenohesdi?
\syll ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯᏃ ᎬᏩᎷᏤᎸ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ; ᏣᏂ ᏗᏓᏬᏍᎩ ᏦᎩᏂᏅᏒ ᎢᏍᏛᎷᏤᏗᏱ, ᎯᎠ ᏅᏗᎦᏪᎭ; ᏂᎯᏍᎪ ᎤᎷᎯᏍᏗ ᏥᎨᏒᎩ?  ᏥᎪᎨ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᎣᏥᎦᏖᏃᎮᏍᏗ?
\ft When the men were come unto him, they said, John Baptist hath sent us unto thee, saying, Art thou he that should come? or look we for another?

\ln Nahiyuquono dunvwane unitsati dunitlvgv ale vyugi duniyilidohv, ale uniyodidanvdo gvwaniyilidohvi; ale unitsati dinigewi gvwanigowadvdi nuwanelei.
\syll ᏀᎢᏳᏉᏃ ᏚᏅᏩᏁ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏚᏂᏢᎬ ᎠᎴ ᎥᏳᎩ ᏚᏂᏱᎵᏙᎲ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏲᏗᏓᏅᏙ ᎬᏩᏂᏱᎵᏙᎲᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏗᏂᎨᏫ ᎬᏩᏂᎪᏩᏛᏗ ᏄᏩᏁᎴᎢ.
\ft And in that same hour he cured many of their infirmities and plagues, and of evil spirits; and unto many that were blind he gave sight.

\ln Hnaquono Tsisa unetsv hia niduweselei; Tsisdena ale Tsani wesdinohvsi nusdv isdigohv ale nusdv isdadvganvi; nasgi dinigewi anigowatisgvi, diniyouli anedohvi, adayesgi tsunitlvgi getsinvgalisgvi, tsunilienv anadvgisgvi, tsuniyohusvhi degegaledisgvi, uyono iyunadvhnadegi osdv kanohedv gegalitsidonehvi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᏥᏍᏕᎾ ᎠᎴ ᏣᏂ ᏪᏍᏗᏃᎲᏏ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎢᏍᏗᎪᎲ ᎠᎴ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎢᏍᏓᏛᎦᏅᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏂᎨᏫ ᎠᏂᎪᏩᏘᏍᎬᎢ, ᏗᏂᏲᎤᎵ ᎠᏁᏙᎲᎢ, ᎠᏓᏰᏍᎩ ᏧᏂᏢᎩ ᎨᏥᏅᎦᎵᏍᎬᎢ, ᏧᏂᎵᎡᏅ ᎠᎾᏛᎩᏍᎬᎢ, ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᏕᎨᎦᎴᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᎤᏲᏃ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᎿᏕᎩ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎨᎦᎵᏥᏙᏁᎲᎢ.
\ft Then Jesus answering said unto them, Go your way, and tell John what things ye have seen and heard; how that the blind see, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised, to the poor the gospel is preached.

\ln Ale osiyu iyulisdanedi gilo ayv niditsiyodesdisgvna igesesdi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎩᎶ ᎠᏴ ᏂᏗᏥᏲᏕᏍᏗᏍᎬᎾ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft And blessed is he, whosoever shall not be offended in me.

\ln Hnaquono Tsani nidodayunvsidv iunenv, ulenvhe Tsani duneisdanele yvwi; Gado itsagatanvse inagei?  Wasonasgo unole utelvhesgvi?
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏣᏂ ᏂᏙᏓᏳᏅᏏᏛ ᎢᎤᏁᏅ, ᎤᎴᏅᎮ ᏣᏂ ᏚᏁᎢᏍᏓᏁᎴ ᏴᏫ; ᎦᏙ ᎢᏣᎦᏔᏅᏎ ᎢᎾᎨᎢ?  ᏩᏐᎾᏍᎪ ᎤᏃᎴ ᎤᏖᎸᎮᏍᎬᎢ?
\ft And when the messengers of John were departed, he began to speak unto the people concerning John, What went ye out into the wilderness for to see? A reed shaken with the wind?

\ln Gadoge itsagatanvsei?  Asgayasgo diwosgili tsunuwai?  Gvniyuquo tsuwoduhi tsunanuwai ale osdv dinalisdayvhvsgi unigvwiyuhi daninelv anehoi.
\syll ᎦᏙᎨ ᎢᏣᎦᏔᏅᏎᎢ?  ᎠᏍᎦᏯᏍᎪ ᏗᏬᏍᎩᎵ ᏧᏄᏩᎢ?  ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᏧᏬᏚᎯ ᏧᎾᏄᏩᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏗᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏓᏂᏁᎸ ᎠᏁᎰᎢ.
\ft But what went ye out for to see? A man clothed in soft raiment? Behold, they which are gorgeously apparelled, and live delicately, are in kings' courts.

\ln Gadoge itsagatanvsei?  Adolehosgisgo?  Vv, itsvyoseha, ale utli atsilvquodiyu esgaquo adolehosgi.
\syll ᎦᏙᎨ ᎢᏣᎦᏔᏅᏎᎢ?  ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩᏍᎪ?  ᎥᎥ, ᎢᏨᏲᏎᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏟ ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ.
\ft But what went ye out for to see? A prophet? Yea, I say unto you, and much more than a prophet.

\ln Nasgisgini hia atsinohesgv hia tsinigvnv tsigowela; Gvniyuquo tsinvli tsinvsidasdi tsakadv igvyiditlv, nasgi datsadvnvisdaneli tsalohisdiyi igvyiditlv.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏥᏃᎮᏍᎬ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᎬᏅ ᏥᎪᏪᎳ; ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᏥᏅᎵ ᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᏣᎧᏛ ᎢᎬᏱᏗᏢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏓᏣᏛᏅᎢᏍᏓᏁᎵ ᏣᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎢᎬᏱᏗᏢ.
\ft This is he, of whom it is written, Behold, I send my messenger before thy face, which shall prepare thy way before thee.

\ln Hiayeno nitsvweseha; Anigeyv gvwaninanugowisvhi tsigi vtla yudlasdi gilo adolehosgi utli iyatsiluquodi esgaquo Tsani Didawosgi; aseno usdikani Unelanvhi utseligohi gela utli atsilvquodiyu esgaquo Tsani.
\syll ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ; ᎠᏂᎨᏴ ᎬᏩᏂᎾᏄᎪᏫᏒᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎥᏝ ᏳᏜᏍᏗ ᎩᎶ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎤᏟ ᎢᏯᏥᎷᏉᏗ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᏣᏂ ᏗᏓᏬᏍᎩ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏍᏗᎧᏂ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎪᎯ ᎨᎳ ᎤᏟ ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᏣᏂ.
\ft For I say unto you, Among those that are born of women there is not a greater prophet than John the Baptist: but he that is least in the kingdom of God is greater than he.

\ln Nigadvno yvwi unadvganvhi, ale adelv anigisidohi, unilvquotane Unelanvhi, digegakastanvhiyeno gese Tsani tsudawosdodi gesvi.
\syll ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᏴᏫ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏕᎸ ᎠᏂᎩᏏᏙᎯ, ᎤᏂᎸᏉᏔᏁ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᏗᎨᎦᎧᏍᏔᏅᎯᏰᏃ ᎨᏎ ᏣᏂ ᏧᏓᏬᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft And all the people that heard him, and the publicans, justified God, being baptized with the baptism of John.

\ln Aniqualisisgini ale dikahnawadvsdi dinosisisgi Unelanvhi dudanvtehelvi uniyoisele unvsv unadatlutanei, nidigegawovna gesvi.
\syll ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏗᏃᏏᏏᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏚᏓᏅᏖᎮᎸᎢ ᎤᏂᏲᎢᏎᎴ ᎤᏅᏒ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᏔᏁᎢ, ᏂᏗᎨᎦᏬᎥᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft But the Pharisees and lawyers rejected the counsel of God against themselves, being not baptized of him.

\ln Ugvwiyuhino hia nuwesei; Gadogedodagatsiyatlilostani yvwi gohi tsaneha?  Ale gado danatselv?
\syll ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎦᏙᎨᏙᏓᎦᏥᏯᏟᎶᏍᏔᏂ ᏴᏫ ᎪᎯ ᏣᏁᎭ?  ᎠᎴ ᎦᏙ ᏓᎾᏤᎸ?
\ft And the Lord said, Whereunto then shall I liken the men of this generation? and to what are they like?

\ln Diniyoliquo nasgiya ganododiyi tsaninoi, ale tsiwidanadayanisgoi, hia tsiwinaniwesgoi; Atselugi ogvtanv detsvnogielv, aseno vtla yitsalisgisei; dotsiyvgv itsadvgodi, aseno vtla yiditsatloyilei.
\syll ᏗᏂᏲᎵᏉ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎦᏃᏙᏗᏱ ᏣᏂᏃᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᏫᏓᎾᏓᏯᏂᏍᎪᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏥᏫᎾᏂᏪᏍᎪᎢ; ᎠᏤᎷᎩ ᎣᎬᏔᏅ ᏕᏨᏃᎩᎡᎸ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏣᎵᏍᎩᏎᎢ; ᏙᏥᏴᎬ ᎢᏣᏛᎪᏗ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏗᏣᏠᏱᎴᎢ.
\ft They are like unto children sitting in the marketplace, and calling one to another, and saying, We have piped unto you, and ye have not danced; we have mourned to you, and ye have not wept.

\ln Tsaniyeno Didawosgi ulutsvgi vtla gadu yagisgei, vtla ale gigageaditasdi yaditasgei; hiano nitsiwese; Asgina uyaa.
\syll ᏣᏂᏰᏃ ᏗᏓᏬᏍᎩ ᎤᎷᏨᎩ ᎥᏝ ᎦᏚ ᏯᎩᏍᎨᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎩᎦᎨᎠᏗᏔᏍᏗ ᏯᏗᏔᏍᎨᎢ; ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏥᏪᏎ; ᎠᏍᎩᎾ ᎤᏯᎠ.
\ft For John the Baptist came neither eating bread nor drinking wine; and ye say, He hath a devil.

\ln Yvwi Uwetsi ulutsv alisdayvhvsga ale aditasga; hiano nitsiweha; Gvniyuquo asgaya ugvvsgi alisdayvdi ale gigageaditasdi aditasgi, adelv anigisidohi ale anisgana unalii.
\syll ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎤᎷᏨ ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎦ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏗᏔᏍᎦ; ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏥᏪᎭ; ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᎬᎥᏍᎩ ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎩᎦᎨᎠᏗᏔᏍᏗ ᎠᏗᏔᏍᎩ, ᎠᏕᎸ ᎠᏂᎩᏏᏙᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᎾ ᎤᎾᎵᎢ.
\ft The Son of man is come eating and drinking; and ye say, Behold a gluttonous man, and a winebibber, a friend of publicans and sinners!

\ln Aseno agatanai tsuwetsi nigadv osiyu igvwayelvha
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᎦᏔᎾᎢ ᏧᏪᏥ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᎬᏩᏰᎸᎭ
\ft But wisdom is justified of all her children.

\ln Gilono iyusdi Aqualisi utayosele ulisdayvnanediyi Wuyvleno Aqualisi ganelvi, ale uligiyusdanvne alisdayvdiyi.
\syll ᎩᎶᏃ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏆᎵᏏ ᎤᏔᏲᏎᎴ ᎤᎵᏍᏓᏴᎾᏁᏗᏱ ᏭᏴᎴᏃ ᎠᏆᎵᏏ ᎦᏁᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᎩᏳᏍᏓᏅᏁ ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ.
\ft And one of the Pharisees desired him that he would eat with him. And he went into the Pharisee's house, and sat down to meat.

\ln Gvniyuquono ageyv nahna gaduhv ehi, asganai, udolehosv Tsisa Aqualisi ganelv ganvgv alisdayvhvsgvi, uyole gugu nvya unegv gotlvtanvhi atlisde atlonedi,
\syll ᎬᏂᏳᏉᏃ ᎠᎨᏴ ᏀᎾ ᎦᏚᎲ ᎡᎯ, ᎠᏍᎦᎾᎢ, ᎤᏙᎴᎰᏒ ᏥᏌ ᎠᏆᎵᏏ ᎦᏁᎸ ᎦᏅᎬ ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎬᎢ, ᎤᏲᎴ ᎫᎫ ᏅᏯ ᎤᏁᎬ ᎪᏢᏔᏅᎯ ᎠᏟᏍᏕ ᎠᏠᏁᏗ,
\ft And, behold, a woman in the city, which was a sinner, when she knew that Jesus sat at meat in the Pharisee's house, brought an alabaster box of ointment,

\ln Ale ulene dudlasadv oniditlv datloyihei, ale ulenvhe tsulasideni duwosuletane tsugasawolvhi, ale dukayodotane usdiyegvi, ale dudutsalane tsulasideni, ale dulonetane atlonedi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎤᎴᏁ ᏚᏜᏌᏛ ᎣᏂᏗᏢ ᏓᏠᏱᎮᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎴᏅᎮ ᏧᎳᏏᏕᏂ ᏚᏬᏑᎴᏔᏁ ᏧᎦᏌᏬᎸᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᎧᏲᏙᏔᏁ ᎤᏍᏗᏰᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏚᏣᎳᏁ ᏧᎳᏏᏕᏂ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᎶᏁᏔᏁ ᎠᏠᏁᏗ.
\ft And stood at his feet behind him weeping, and began to wash his feet with tears, and did wipe them with the hairs of her head, and kissed his feet, and anointed them with the ointment.

\ln Aqualisino nasgi wuyanvdv ugohv, unetse tsudanvdv hia nigawesgei; Hia asgaya iyuno adolehosgi yigese yudolehose nasgi gesv ale iyusdiquo gesv hia ageyv tsunotlisdiha, asganayeno.
\syll ᎠᏆᎵᏏᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏭᏯᏅᏛ ᎤᎪᎲ, ᎤᏁᏤ ᏧᏓᏅᏛ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎨᎢ; ᎯᎠ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎢᏳᏃ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᏱᎨᏎ ᏳᏙᎴᎰᏎ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏳᏍᏗᏉ ᎨᏒ ᎯᎠ ᎠᎨᏴ ᏧᏃᏟᏍᏗᎭ, ᎠᏍᎦᎾᏰᏃ.
\ft Now when the Pharisee which had bidden him saw it, he spake within himself, saying, This man, if he were a prophet, would have known who and what manner of woman this is that toucheth him: for she is a sinner.

\ln Tsisano unetsv hia nuweselei; Sawani, agiha gohusdi gvyosedi.  Hiano nuwesei; Tadeyohvsgi, niwigoga.
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᏌᏩᏂ, ᎠᎩᎭ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎬᏲᏎᏗ.  ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᏔᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ, ᏂᏫᎪᎦ.
\ft And Jesus answering said unto him, Simon, I have somewhat to say unto thee. And he saith, Master, say on.

\ln Gilo iyusdi ehe tsudadugi, nasgi anitali tsudugi anehei; siyvwi hisgitsuqui anigisi tsunagvwalodi atsidugei, soino hisgasgohi.
\syll ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎡᎮ ᏧᏓᏚᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᏧᏚᎩ ᎠᏁᎮᎢ; ᏏᏴᏫ ᎯᏍᎩᏧᏈ ᎠᏂᎩᏏ ᏧᎾᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎠᏥᏚᎨᎢ, ᏐᎢᏃ ᎯᏍᎦᏍᎪᎯ.
\ft There was a certain creditor which had two debtors: the one owed five hundred pence, and the other fifty.

\ln Gohusdino nunihvna gesv unaguyvdodi, duyosequo itsula.  Nasgino sginohvsi, gago nasgi utli nudageyusesdi?
\syll ᎪᎱᏍᏗᏃ ᏄᏂᎲᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎾᎫᏴᏙᏗ, ᏚᏲᏎᏉ ᎢᏧᎳ.  ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏍᎩᏃᎲᏏ, ᎦᎪ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏟ ᏄᏓᎨᏳᏎᏍᏗ?
\ft And when they had nothing to pay, he frankly forgave them both. Tell me therefore, which of them will love him most?

\ln Sawani tsunetsv hia nuwesei; Asegeli nasgi na utli igai digvwayohiselvhi.  Hiano nuweselei; Duyugodv dehugoda.
\syll ᏌᏩᏂ ᏧᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎠᏎᎨᎵ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᏟ ᎢᎦᎢ ᏗᎬᏩᏲᎯᏎᎸᎯ.  ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᏕᎱᎪᏓ.
\ft Simon answered and said, I suppose that he, to whom he forgave most. And he said unto him, Thou hast rightly judged.

\ln Ageyvno gadogv iditlv wugatahvstanv hia natsiwesele Sawani; Higowatisgo hia ageyv?  Hinelv agiyvlvgi, ama vtla yisginenele diquosuledi diqualasideni; nasgisgini na daquosulisi diqualasideni tsugasawolvhi gvda, ale dagikayododasi ustiyegvi.
\syll ᎠᎨᏴᏃ ᎦᏙᎬ ᎢᏗᏢ ᏭᎦᏔᎲᏍᏔᏅ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏥᏪᏎᎴ ᏌᏩᏂ; ᎯᎪᏩᏘᏍᎪ ᎯᎠ ᎠᎨᏴ?  ᎯᏁᎸ ᎠᎩᏴᎸᎩ, ᎠᎹ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏍᎩᏁᏁᎴ ᏗᏉᏑᎴᏗ ᏗᏆᎳᏏᏕᏂ; ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ Ꮎ ᏓᏉᏑᎵᏏ ᏗᏆᎳᏏᏕᏂ ᏧᎦᏌᏬᎸᎯ ᎬᏓ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᎩᎧᏲᏙᏓᏏ ᎤᏍᏘᏰᎬᎢ.
\ft And he turned to the woman, and said unto Simon, Seest thou this woman? I entered into thine house, thou gavest me no water for my feet: but she hath washed my feet with tears, and wiped them with the hairs of her head.

\ln Vtla yisquatawedonei; hiasgini ageyv, agiyvlilv nvdagvwadalenvdv, vtla yusuligotsv daquadutsalanehv diqualasideni.
\syll ᎥᏝ ᏱᏍᏆᏔᏪᏙᏁᎢ; ᎯᎠᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᎨᏴ, ᎠᎩᏴᎵᎸ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏓᎴᏅᏛ, ᎥᏝ ᏳᏑᎵᎪᏨ ᏓᏆᏚᏣᎳᏁᎲ ᏗᏆᎳᏏᏕᏂ.
\ft Thou gavest me no kiss: but this woman since the time I came in hath not ceased to kiss my feet.

\ln Tsisgoli vtla yisgilonetane goi; hiasgini ageyv atlonedi dulonetanv diqualasideni.
\syll ᏥᏍᎪᎵ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏍᎩᎶᏁᏔᏁ ᎪᎢ; ᎯᎠᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᎨᏴ ᎠᏠᏁᏗ ᏚᎶᏁᏔᏅ ᏗᏆᎳᏏᏕᏂ.
\ft My head with oil thou didst not anoint: but this woman hath anointed my feet with ointment.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi hia nigvweseha; Usganvtsv, nasgi tsuquiya tsigi, atsidoligi, utsatiyeno udageyusei; gilosgini usdi atsidolitsvhi, nasgi usdi udageyusoi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏪᏎᎭ; ᎤᏍᎦᏅᏨ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏈᏯ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᏥᏙᎵᎩ, ᎤᏣᏘᏰᏃ ᎤᏓᎨᏳᏎᎢ; ᎩᎶᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎠᏥᏙᎵᏨᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎤᏓᎨᏳᏐᎢ.
\ft Wherefore I say unto thee, Her sins, which are many, are forgiven; for she loved much: but to whom little is forgiven, the same loveth little.

\ln Hiano nuwesele ageyv; Tsasganvtsv etsadoligi.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏎᎴ ᎠᎨᏴ; ᏣᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᎡᏣᏙᎵᎩ.
\ft And he said unto her, Thy sins are forgiven.

\ln Nasgino na itsulaha aninidlai analisdayvhvsgv unalenvhe dotsunadanvdv hia nuniwesei; Gago nasgi hia, asganvtsv nasquo tsidegadoliga?
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ Ꮎ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎠᏂᏂᏜᎢ ᎠᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎬ ᎤᎾᎴᏅᎮ ᏙᏧᎾᏓᏅᏛ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ; ᎦᎪ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ, ᎠᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏥᏕᎦᏙᎵᎦ?
\ft And they that sat at meat with him began to say within themselves, Who is this that forgiveth sins also?

\ln Hiano nuwesele ageyv, Tsohiyusv tsasdelv; nvwadohiyadv tsihena.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏎᎴ ᎠᎨᏴ, ᏦᎯᏳᏒ ᏣᏍᏕᎸ; ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᏥᎮᎾ.
\ft And he said to the woman, Thy faith hath saved thee; go in peace.

\ln Onino iyvdv hia nulistanei, nasgi degaduwadisv tsudvna ale tsusdi uwedonei, alitsidohvsge ale gvnigesv nigvnehe osdv kanohedv Unelanvhi ugvwiyuhi gesv kanohesgi, taladuno iyanidv unaligowadegei;
\syll ᎣᏂᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎯᎠ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏕᎦᏚᏩᏗᏒ ᏧᏛᎾ ᎠᎴ ᏧᏍᏗ ᎤᏪᏙᏁᎢ, ᎠᎵᏥᏙᎲᏍᎨ ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᎬᏁᎮ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎧᏃᎮᏍᎩ, ᏔᎳᏚᏃ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᎤᎾᎵᎪᏩᏕᎨᎢ;
\ft And it came to pass afterward, that he went throughout every city and village, preaching and shewing the glad tidings of the kingdom of God: and the twelve were with him,

\ln Ale gilo iyunasdi anigeyv digetsinvwanvhi uniyo didanvdo gvwanadeyadodisgv ale dunitlvgvi, nasgi Meli Magadeli ehi tsanosehoi, nasgi galiquogi anisgina gvwanugotselvhi,
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗ ᎠᏂᎨᏴ ᏗᎨᏥᏅᏩᏅᎯ ᎤᏂᏲ ᏗᏓᏅᏙ ᎬᏩᎾᏕᏯᏙᏗᏍᎬ ᎠᎴ ᏚᏂᏢᎬᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎺᎵ ᎹᎦᏕᎵ ᎡᎯ ᏣᏃᏎᎰᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎵᏉᎩ ᎠᏂᏍᎩᎾ ᎬᏩᏄᎪᏤᎸᎯ,
\ft And certain women, which had been healed of evil spirits and infirmities, Mary called Magdalene, out of whom went seven devils,

\ln Ale Tsoine udalii Tsusa nasgi Elodv utseli tsugvwalodi ugasayasdidegi, ale Susani, ale anigodiyu nvwanadale nasgi tsigvwasdelvdodisge gohusdi unihnavi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏦᎢᏁ ᎤᏓᎵᎢ ᏧᏌ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᎶᏛ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎤᎦᏌᏯᏍᏗᏕᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏑᏌᏂ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᎪᏗᏳ ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᎬᏩᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗᏍᎨ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏂᎿᎥᎢ.
\ft And Joanna the wife of Chuza Herod's steward, and Susanna, and many others, which ministered unto him of their substance.

\ln Anigodiyuno yvwi dunilawitsolv nasgi gvwalutselv degaduwadisv nidodayuninugotsvhi, unetse dutlilosdanelei;
\syll ᎠᏂᎪᏗᏳᏃ ᏴᏫ ᏚᏂᎳᏫᏦᎸ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏩᎷᏤᎸ ᏕᎦᏚᏩᏗᏒ ᏂᏙᏓᏳᏂᏄᎪᏨᎯ, ᎤᏁᏤ ᏚᏟᎶᏍᏓᏁᎴᎢ;
\ft And when much people were gathered together, and were come to him out of every city, he spake by a parable:

\ln Awisgi uwisvse utseli ugata; uwisvno igadv nvnohulodi ulageyadvtsei; unalasdaeleno ale tsisqua galanvdv aninohilidohi unigonei.
\syll ᎠᏫᏍᎩ ᎤᏫᏒᏎ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎤᎦᏔ; ᎤᏫᏒᏃ ᎢᎦᏛ ᏅᏃᎱᎶᏗ ᎤᎳᎨᏯᏛᏤᎢ; ᎤᎾᎳᏍᏓᎡᎴᏃ ᎠᎴ ᏥᏍᏆ ᎦᎳᏅᏛ ᎠᏂᏃᎯᎵᏙᎯ ᎤᏂᎪᏁᎢ.
\ft A sower went out to sow his seed: and as he sowed, some fell by the way side; and it was trodden down, and the fowls of the air devoured it.

\ln Igadvno nvyohi ulageyadvtsei; tsuliyenvquono uhnasgvtse nvdigalisdodisge nuwodewisvna gesvi.
\syll ᎢᎦᏛᏃ ᏅᏲᎯ ᎤᎳᎨᏯᏛᏤᎢ; ᏧᎵᏰᏅᏉᏃ ᎤᎿᏍᎬᏤ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨ ᏄᏬᏕᏫᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft And some fell upon a rock; and as soon as it was sprung up, it withered away, because it lacked moisture.

\ln Igadvno anugalvhi ulageyadvtsei; anugalvno itsulaha diudvsei, ale unenulastanei.
\syll ᎢᎦᏛᏃ ᎠᏄᎦᎸᎯ ᎤᎳᎨᏯᏛᏤᎢ; ᎠᏄᎦᎸᏃ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᏗᎤᏛᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᏄᎳᏍᏔᏁᎢ.
\ft And some fell among thorns; and the thorns sprang up with it, and choked it.

\ln Igadvno osv gadohi ulageyadvtsei, ale tsudvsei, ale ugatatanei unequotse asgohitsuqui iyuwagudi.  Nasgino hia nuwesv, ulistanei, hia nuwesei, Gilo degalilugesdi udvgodiyi wadvgvga
\syll ᎢᎦᏛᏃ ᎣᏒ ᎦᏙᎯ ᎤᎳᎨᏯᏛᏤᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏛᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎦᏔᏔᏁᎢ ᎤᏁᏉᏤ ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏧᏈ ᎢᏳᏩᎫᏗ.  ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒ, ᎤᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎩᎶ ᏕᎦᎵᎷᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᏛᎪᏗᏱ ᏩᏛᎬᎦ
\ft And other fell on good ground, and sprang up, and bare fruit an hundredfold. And when he had said these things, he cried, He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.

\ln Gvwasdawadidohino gvwadvdvne hia nigvwaweselei; Gado gadvga hia datlilosdvi.
\syll ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯᏃ ᎬᏩᏛᏛᏁ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏩᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎦᏙ ᎦᏛᎦ ᎯᎠ ᏓᏟᎶᏍᏛᎢ.
\ft And his disciples asked him, saying, What might this parable be?

\ln Hiano nuwesei; Nihi etsinelvhi itsolisdiyi udelidv gesv Unelanvhi ugvwiyuhi gesvi; anisoisgini digegatlilosdanedi; nasgi anigowatisgv gvwanigowadvdi nigesvna, ale anadvgisgv gvwanolisdi nigesvna.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᏂᎯ ᎡᏥᏁᎸᎯ ᎢᏦᎵᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎠᏂᏐᎢᏍᎩᏂ ᏗᎨᎦᏟᎶᏍᏓᏁᏗ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏂᎪᏩᏘᏍᎬ ᎬᏩᏂᎪᏩᏛᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎾᏛᎩᏍᎬ ᎬᏩᏃᎵᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.
\ft And he said, Unto you it is given to know the mysteries of the kingdom of God: but to others in parables; that seeing they might not see, and hearing they might not understand.

\ln Datlilosdvno hia nasgi nusdi; Ugata kanohedv Unelanvhi utseli gadvga.
\syll ᏓᏟᎶᏍᏛᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏗ; ᎤᎦᏔ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎦᏛᎦ.
\ft Now the parable is this: The seed is the word of God.

\ln Nvnohulodino tsulageyadvtsei nasgi anadvgisgi getsidvga; hnaquono asgina galugoi, ale agisgo ganugowisgo kanohedv tsuninawiyi, gagvwanohiyudi ale gagetsisdelvdi nigesvna iyulisdodiyi.
\syll ᏅᏃᎱᎶᏗᏃ ᏧᎳᎨᏯᏛᏤᎢ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎾᏛᎩᏍᎩ ᎨᏥᏛᎦ; ᎿᏉᏃ ᎠᏍᎩᎾ ᎦᎷᎪᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎩᏍᎪ ᎦᏄᎪᏫᏍᎪ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏧᏂᎾᏫᏱ, ᎦᎬᏩᏃᎯᏳᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎦᎨᏥᏍᏕᎸᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
\ft Those by the way side are they that hear; then cometh the devil, and taketh away the word out of their hearts, lest they should believe and be saved.

\ln Nano nvyohi tsulageyadvtsei, getsidvga nasgi anadvgvga ulihelisdiyu tsidanadanilvgo kanohedv; ale vtla yidunihnasdetloi; tlega anohiyuhvsgoi; ale getsigoliya anisuligogoi.
\syll ᎾᏃ ᏅᏲᎯ ᏧᎳᎨᏯᏛᏤᎢ, ᎨᏥᏛᎦ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎾᏛᎬᎦ ᎤᎵᎮᎵᏍᏗᏳ ᏥᏓᎾᏓᏂᎸᎪ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ; ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏚᏂᎿᏍᏕᏠᎢ; ᏞᎦ ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎪᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎨᏥᎪᎵᏯ ᎠᏂᏑᎵᎪᎪᎢ.
\ft They on the rock are they, which, when they hear, receive the word with joy; and these have no root, which for a while believe, and in time of temptation fall away.

\ln Nano anugalvhi tsulageyadvtsei getsidvga nasgi anadvgvga. ilvhitlv tsiwanilosgoi, elohino ehi uwelihisdi ale genvisdi gesv, ale osdv ayelvdi gesv aninenulasdisgoi, ale vtla yaninanugowisgo ugadvnatsvhi.
\syll ᎾᏃ ᎠᏄᎦᎸᎯ ᏧᎳᎨᏯᏛᏤᎢ ᎨᏥᏛᎦ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎾᏛᎬᎦ. ᎢᎸᎯᏢ ᏥᏩᏂᎶᏍᎪᎢ, ᎡᎶᎯᏃ ᎡᎯ ᎤᏪᎵᎯᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎨᏅᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎠᏰᎸᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏂᏁᏄᎳᏍᏗᏍᎪᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᏯᏂᎾᏄᎪᏫᏍᎪ ᎤᎦᏛᎾᏨᎯ.
\ft And that which fell among thorns are they, which, when they have heard, go forth, and are choked with cares and riches and pleasures of this life, and bring no fruit to perfection.

\ln Nano osv gadohi tsulageyadvtsei getsidvga nasgi nutlonasdvna ale osdv gesv uninawi gvdi anadvgvga kanohedv, anisquanigodisgoi, ale aninanugowisgo ugatatanvhi anvnidiyu gesoi.
\syll ᎾᏃ ᎣᏒ ᎦᏙᎯ ᏧᎳᎨᏯᏛᏤᎢ ᎨᏥᏛᎦ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏠᎾᏍᏛᎾ ᎠᎴ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏂᎾᏫ ᎬᏗ ᎠᎾᏛᎬᎦ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ, ᎠᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗᏍᎪᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᎾᏄᎪᏫᏍᎪ ᎤᎦᏔᏔᏅᎯ ᎠᏅᏂᏗᏳ ᎨᏐᎢ.
\ft But that on the good ground are they, which in an honest and good heart, having heard the word, keep it, and bring forth fruit with patience.

\ln Vtla ale gilo atsvsdvga atsvsdodi atelido yigutlvdisgoi, ale ganitlvwa yigakahvsgoi; gagodiyisgini gakahvsgoi, nasgi aniyvhihi unigowadvdiyi igagadvi.
\syll ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᎠᏨᏍᏛᎦ ᎠᏨᏍᏙᏗ ᎠᏖᎵᏙ ᏱᎫᏢᏗᏍᎪᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᏂᏢᏩ ᏱᎦᎧᎲᏍᎪᎢ; ᎦᎪᏗᏱᏍᎩᏂ ᎦᎧᎲᏍᎪᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏂᏴᎯᎯ ᎤᏂᎪᏩᏛᏗᏱ ᎢᎦᎦᏛᎢ.
\ft No man, when he hath lighted a candle, covereth it with a vessel, or putteth it under a bed; but setteth it on a candlestick, that they which enter in may see the light.

\ln Vtlayeno gohusdi udelidv yigi nasgi gvnigesv igvnedi nigesvna; vtla ale gohusdi yigvsgalv nasgi agadovhisdi ale gvnigesv igvnedi nigesvna.
\syll ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᏱᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᎬᏁᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ; ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏱᎬᏍᎦᎸ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᎬᏁᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.
\ft For nothing is secret, that shall not be made manifest; neither any thing hid, that shall not be known and come abroad.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi itseyatahesdi nusdv itsadvgisgvi, giloyeno uhesdi, nasgi atsinedi gesesdi; gilono nuhvna gesesdi, nasgi atsigiedi gesesdi nasgi na tsuho tsinvwasdoi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏤᏯᏔᎮᏍᏗ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎢᏣᏛᎩᏍᎬᎢ, ᎩᎶᏰᏃ ᎤᎮᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏥᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᎩᎶᏃ ᏄᎲᎾ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏥᎩᎡᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏧᎰ ᏥᏅᏩᏍᏙᎢ.
\ft Take heed therefore how ye hear: for whosoever hath, to him shall be given; and whosoever hath not, from him shall be taken even that which he seemeth to have.

\ln Hnaquono gvwalutsele utsi ale analinvtli, ale vtla nav wigagvwanilutsedi yigese nvdigalisdodisge yvwi unitsadvi.

\ln Aninisvno tsiyu ulvnei; unoleno uyilole vdalvi; unikalitseleno ama, ale unayehisdi nunalisdanelei.

\ft And they came to him, and awoke him, saying, Master, master, we perish. Then he arose, and rebuked the wind and the raging of the water: and they ceased, and there was a calm.

\syll ᏄᏁᏤᎶᏰᏃ ᎦᏓᎭ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᏄᎪᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ.  ᏯᏃᏉᏰᏃ ᎤᏂᏱᏍᎨᎢ; ᏧᏓᏕᏒᏛᏃ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎵᏰᏌᎾᎶ ᏓᎦᎸᏍᏗᏍᎨᎢ; ᏓᎦᎵᏍᎨᏃ ᏚᏓᎸᏍᏛᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏍᎩᎾ ᎢᎾᎨ ᏭᏱᎸᏍᏗᏍᎨᎢ.
\ft (For he had commanded the unclean spirit to come out of the man. For oftentimes it had caught him: and he was kept bound with chains and in fetters; and he brake the bands, and was driven of the devil into the wilderness.)

\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᏛᏛᏁ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎦᏙ ᏕᏣᏙᎥ?  ᎯᎠᏃ ᏅᏗᎤᏪᏎᎢ; ᏑᎾᏓᏡᎩ; ᎤᏂᏣᏖᏰᏃ ᎠᏂᏍᎩᎾ ᎬᏩᏴᎸᎯ ᎨᏎᎢ.

\ln Hnaquono anisgina gvwanugotse asgaya, ale siqua wigvwaniyvlei; sunadatlugino ayanuliyu unalise wunigasoase ganetlugi gesv vdalv wunilutse ale dunigvtsei.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎠᏂᏍᎩᎾ ᎬᏩᏄᎪᏤ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ, ᎠᎴ ᏏᏆ ᏫᎬᏩᏂᏴᎴᎢ; ᏑᎾᏓᏡᎩᏃ ᎠᏯᏄᎵᏳ ᎤᎾᎵᏎ ᏭᏂᎦᏐᎠᏎ ᎦᏁᏡᎩ ᎨᏒ ᎥᏓᎸ ᏭᏂᎷᏤ ᎠᎴ ᏚᏂᎬᏤᎢ.

\syll ᏥᎮᎾ ᏗᏤᏅᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏫᏅᎦ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎸ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ.  ᎤᏪᏅᏎᏃ,  ᎠᎴ  ᏭᏃᎮᎵᏙᎴ ᏂᎬᎢ ᎦᏚᎲ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᏄᏛᏁᎸ ᏥᏌ.

\ft And it came to pass, that, when Jesus was returned, the people gladly received him: for they were all waiting for him.

\ln Gvniyuquono ulutsele asgaya Tsela tsudoidv nugvwiyusadegi digalawiisdiyi; Tsisano dulasgv udanvnei, ale utayosele ganelv uyvsdiyi;

\ft And, behold, there came a man named Jairus, and he was a ruler of the synagogue: and he fell down at Jesus' feet, and besought him that he would come into his house:

\syll ᎠᎨᏴᏃ ᎤᏢᎨ ᎩᎬ ᎤᏪᏅᎡᎮ ᏔᎳᏚ ᏧᏕᏘᏴᏛ ᎬᏩᏓᎴᏅᎡᎸᎯ, ᎤᏒᏅᎯ ᎨᏎ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎤᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ ᏓᎫᏴᎡᎲ ᎠᏂᎦᎾᎦᏘ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᎬᏩᏅᏬᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ,

\ft Came behind him, and touched the border of his garment: and immediately her issue of blood stanched.

\ln Tsisano hia nuwesei; Gago aquasvniga?  Nigadvno unadayilv, Quida ale nasgi anehi hia nuniwesei; Tadeyohvsgi, unitsati getsadatluwisdidega ale getsanenulasdiha, tsigono Gago aquasvniga ihadiha?
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎦᎪ ᎠᏆᏒᏂᎦ?  ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᎤᎾᏓᏱᎸ, ᏈᏓ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏁᎯ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ; ᏔᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ, ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎨᏣᏓᏡᏫᏍᏗᏕᎦ ᎠᎴ ᎨᏣᏁᏄᎳᏍᏗᎭ, ᏥᎪᏃ ᎦᎪ ᎠᏆᏒᏂᎦ ᎢᎭᏗᎭ?
\ft And Jesus said, Who touched me? When all denied, Peter and they that were with him said, Master, the multitude throng thee and press thee, and sayest thou, Who touched me?

\ln Tsisano hia nuwesei, Gilo aquasvniga; gadolehosgayeno aquadanvwodi gesv aginugotselvi.
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎩᎶ ᎠᏆᏒᏂᎦ; ᎦᏙᎴᎰᏍᎦᏰᏃ ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏬᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎩᏄᎪᏤᎸᎢ.
\ft And Jesus said, Somebody hath touched me: for I perceive that virtue is gone out of me.

\ln Ageyeno udolehosv nudisgalvna gesvi, ulutse uwenawisgei, ale igvyitlv udanvnelei, nigadvno yvwi anigatahv unonele nvtsulisdotanv usvnilvi, ale nasgi gilaquo iyvdv udiwasvi.
\syll ᎠᎨᏰᏃ ᎤᏙᎴᎰᏒ ᏄᏗᏍᎦᎸᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᎷᏤ ᎤᏪᎾᏫᏍᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᎬᏱᏢ ᎤᏓᏅᏁᎴᎢ, ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᏴᏫ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎲ ᎤᏃᏁᎴ ᏅᏧᎵᏍᏙᏔᏅ ᎤᏒᏂᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎩᎳᏉ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎤᏗᏩᏒᎢ.
\ft And when the woman saw that she was not hid, she came trembling, and falling down before him, she declared unto him before all the people for what cause she had touched him and how she was healed immediately.

\ln Hiano nuweselei; Aquetsi, ugalisdi hadanvdada; tsohiyusv tsadiwisda; nvwadohiyadv tsihena.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎠᏇᏥ, ᎤᎦᎵᏍᏗ ᎭᏓᏅᏓᏓ; ᏦᎯᏳᏒ ᏣᏗᏫᏍᏓ; ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᏥᎮᎾ.
\ft And he said unto her, Daughter, be of good comfort: thy faith hath made thee whole; go in peace.

\ln Asiquo gawonisge gilo ulutse digalawiisdiyi ugvwiyusadegi ganelv nvdayulosvhi, hia nuweselei, Tsetsi uyohusv, tlesdi hiyadeyadotanv Dideyohvsgi.
\syll ᎠᏏᏉ ᎦᏬᏂᏍᎨ ᎩᎶ ᎤᎷᏤ ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ ᎦᏁᎸ ᏅᏓᏳᎶᏒᎯ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏤᏥ ᎤᏲᎱᏒ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᎯᏯᏕᏯᏙᏔᏅ ᏗᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ.
\ft While he yet spake, there cometh one from the ruler of the synagogue's house, saying to him, Thy daughter is dead; trouble not the Master.

\ln Aseno tsisa udvganv unetsele hia nuwesei; Tlesdi yisgaihesdi; tsohiyusesdiquo, dayudiwasino.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎤᏛᎦᏅ ᎤᏁᏤᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏍᎦᎢᎮᏍᏗ; ᏦᎯᏳᏎᏍᏗᏉ, ᏓᏳᏗᏩᏏᏃ.
\ft But when Jesus heard it, he answered him, saying, Fear not: believe only, and she shall be made whole.

\ln Adanelvno uyvlv, vtla gilo yulisgolvdanele uyvsdiyi, Quida ale Tsimi ale Tsani unvsv, ale ageyutsa udoda ale utsi.
\syll ᎠᏓᏁᎸᏃ ᎤᏴᎸ, ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᏳᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᎴ ᎤᏴᏍᏗᏱ, ᏈᏓ ᎠᎴ ᏥᎻ ᎠᎴ ᏣᏂ ᎤᏅᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎨᏳᏣ ᎤᏙᏓ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏥ.
\ft And when he came into the house, he suffered no man to go in, save Peter, and James, and John, and the father and the mother of the maiden.

\ln Nigadvno danatloyihe ale anisgonihei.  Aseno hia nuwesei; Tlesdi ditsatloyilvgi; vtla yuyohusv, galihaquosgini.
\syll ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᏓᎾᏠᏱᎮ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏍᎪᏂᎮᎢ.  ᎠᏎᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᏞᏍᏗ ᏗᏣᏠᏱᎸᎩ; ᎥᏝ ᏳᏲᎱᏒ, ᎦᎵᎭᏉᏍᎩᏂ.
\ft And all wept, and bewailed her: but he said, Weep not; she is not dead, but sleepeth.

\ln Igvwadotlvtaneno, anigataheyeno uyohusvhi gesvi.
\syll ᎢᎬᏩᏙᏢᏔᏁᏃ, ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎮᏰᏃ ᎤᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft And they laughed him to scorn, knowing that she was dead.

\ln Nigadvno dunugowisv ale uwoyanesv uyanvhe hia nuwesei; Higeyutsa, hadidv.
\syll ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᏚᏄᎪᏫᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏬᏯᏁᏒ ᎤᏯᏅᎮ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎯᎨᏳᏣ, ᎭᏗᏛ.
\ft And he put them all out, and took her by the hand, and called, saying, Maid, arise.

\ln Udanvdono ulutsisanelei, ale gilaquo iyvdv udidvhei; unetseno ulisdayvdi uninediyi.
\syll ᎤᏓᏅᏙᏃ ᎤᎷᏥᏌᏁᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎩᎳᏉ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎤᏗᏛᎮᎢ; ᎤᏁᏤᏃ ᎤᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗ ᎤᏂᏁᏗᏱ.
\ft And her spirit came again, and she arose straightway: and he commanded to give her meat.

\ln Tsugayvligeno unisquanigosei; aseno dunetsele gilo uninonediyi nigesvna nasgi nulistanvi.
\syll ᏧᎦᏴᎵᎨᏃ ᎤᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏎᎢ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᏚᏁᏤᎴ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏂᏃᏁᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎢ.
\ft And her parents were astonished: but he charged them that they should tell no man what was done.

\ln Widuyahvno taladu iyanidv gvwasdawadidohi, dunele naniv anisgina gvwanohiyudiyi, ale dunitlvgv tsunadanvwodiyi.
\syll ᏫᏚᏯᎲᏃ ᏔᎳᏚ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ, ᏚᏁᎴ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎠᏂᏍᎩᎾ ᎬᏩᏃᎯᏳᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏂᏢᎬ ᏧᎾᏓᏅᏬᏗᏱ.
\ft Then he called his twelve disciples together, and gave them power and authority over all devils, and to cure diseases.

\ln Dunvseno unalitsidonvsdiyi Unelanvhi ugvwiyuhi gesv ugvwali, ale tsunitlvgi tsuninvwodiyi
\syll ᏚᏅᏎᏃ ᎤᎾᎵᏥᏙᏅᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏂᏢᎩ ᏧᏂᏅᏬᏗᏱ
\ft And he sent them to preach the kingdom of God, and to heal the sick.

\ln Ale hia niduweselei, Tlesdi gohusdi itsadanelanvgi itsalisdelvdodi itsaisvi, tlesdi didolanvsdi, ale degalodi, ale gadu, ale adelv; ale itsisiyvwiha tlesdi tali ditsanuwo yiditsinehesdi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎢᏣᏓᏁᎳᏅᎩ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ ᎢᏣᎢᏒᎢ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᏗᏙᎳᏅᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᎦᎶᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᏚ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏕᎸ; ᎠᎴ ᎢᏥᏏᏴᏫᎭ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏔᎵ ᏗᏣᏄᏬ ᏱᏗᏥᏁᎮᏍᏗ.
\ft And he said unto them, Take nothing for your journey, neither staves, nor scrip, neither bread, neither money; neither have two coats apiece.

\ln Ilvhitlvno adanelv itsiyvhihesdi nahaquo itsinesdi, ale nahna itsanigisgesdi.
\syll ᎢᎸᎯᏢᏃ ᎠᏓᏁᎸ ᎢᏥᏴᎯᎮᏍᏗ ᏀᎠᏉ ᎢᏥᏁᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏀᎾ ᎢᏣᏂᎩᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
\ft And whatsoever house ye enter into, there abide, and thence depart.

\ln Gilono niditsadanilvgvna igesesdi, nahna gaduhv itsinugogesdi, ditsalasideni gosdu dunvgalv detsinvgovdisgesdi nasgi kanohesgi gesesdi unatludisgi.
\syll ᎩᎶᏃ ᏂᏗᏣᏓᏂᎸᎬᎾ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᏀᎾ ᎦᏚᎲ ᎢᏥᏄᎪᎨᏍᏗ, ᏗᏣᎳᏏᏕᏂ ᎪᏍᏚ ᏚᏅᎦᎸ ᏕᏥᏅᎪᎥᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎧᏃᎮᏍᎩ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᎾᏡᏗᏍᎩ.
\ft And whosoever will not receive you, when ye go out of that city, shake off the very dust from your feet for a testimony against them.

\ln Unanigisvno degaduwadisv unedole analitsidohvsge osdv kanohedv, ale danadanvwisge nigav anedohvi.
\syll ᎤᎾᏂᎩᏒᏃ ᏕᎦᏚᏩᏗᏒ ᎤᏁᏙᎴ ᎠᎾᎵᏥᏙᎲᏍᎨ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᎾᏓᏅᏫᏍᎨ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎠᏁᏙᎲᎢ.
\ft And they departed, and went through the towns, preaching the gospel, and healing every where.

\ln Elodvno nvgi igadugi gesv sgadugi atsigatidisdi udvgane nigadv deulvwisdanehvi; ale udeyatanelei, nvdigalisdodisge gilo Tsani uyohusv deulehisanv anadisgvi;
\syll ᎡᎶᏛᏃ ᏅᎩ ᎢᎦᏚᎩ ᎨᏒ ᏍᎦᏚᎩ ᎠᏥᎦᏘᏗᏍᏗ ᎤᏛᎦᏁ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏕᎤᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᏕᏯᏔᏁᎴᎢ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨ ᎩᎶ ᏣᏂ ᎤᏲᎱᏒ ᏕᎤᎴᎯᏌᏅ ᎠᎾᏗᏍᎬᎢ;
\ft Now Herod the tetrarch heard of all that was done by him: and he was perplexed, because that it was said of some, that John was risen from the dead;

\ln Gilono Ilaya gananugogi anadisgvi; igadvno gilo iyusdi ilvhiyu tsanehe anadolehosgi dulehisanv anadisgvi.
\syll ᎩᎶᏃ ᎢᎳᏯ ᎦᎾᏄᎪᎩ ᎠᎾᏗᏍᎬᎢ; ᎢᎦᏛᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᏣᏁᎮ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᏚᎴᎯᏌᏅ ᎠᎾᏗᏍᎬᎢ.
\ft And of some, that Elias had appeared; and of others, that one of the old prophets was risen again.

\ln Elodvno hia nuwesei, Tsani tsisgudesvgi; hiasgini gago, nasgi hia tsinusdi tsitsiyadvgiha?  Utlinigvneleno ugowadvdiyi.
\syll ᎡᎶᏛᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᏣᏂ ᏥᏍᎫᏕᏒᎩ; ᎯᎠᏍᎩᏂ ᎦᎪ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏄᏍᏗ ᏥᏥᏯᏛᎩᎭ?  ᎤᏟᏂᎬᏁᎴᏃ ᎤᎪᏩᏛᏗᏱ.
\ft And Herod said, John have I beheaded: but who is this, of whom I hear such things? And he desired to see him.

\ln Getsinvsidvno iunilutsv, gvwanonele nigadv nunadvnelvi.  Dutinvseno ale unvsv gesv inage wulose gaduhv nav Quetsayedi tsanosehoi.
\syll ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏛᏃ ᎢᎤᏂᎷᏨ, ᎬᏩᏃᏁᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏄᎾᏛᏁᎸᎢ.  ᏚᏘᏅᏎᏃ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏅᏒ ᎨᏒ ᎢᎾᎨ ᏭᎶᏎ ᎦᏚᎲ ᎾᎥ ᏇᏣᏰᏗ ᏣᏃᏎᎰᎢ.
\ft And the apostles, when they were returned, told him all that they had done. And he took them, and went aside privately into a desert place belonging to the city called Bethsaida.

\ln Yvwino unadolehosv gvwasdawadvsei; ale dudanilvtsei, duneisdanele Unelanvhi ugvwiyuhi gesv ugvwali, ale dunvwane udulvdi iyunalisdanehi digetsinvwodiyi.
\syll ᏴᏫᏃ ᎤᎾᏙᎴᎰᏒ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏛᏎᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᏚᏓᏂᎸᏤᎢ, ᏚᏁᎢᏍᏓᏁᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏅᏩᏁ ᎤᏚᎸᏗ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᏗᎨᏥᏅᏬᏗᏱ.
\ft And the people, when they knew it, followed him: and he received them, and spake unto them of the kingdom of God, and healed them that had need of healing.

\ln Igano hnaquo galosohvsgei gvwalusele taladu iyanidv ale hia nigvwawetselei, Tiyelihisda unitsati, nasgi wanena dodigaduhv ale dodigalogesv ani gvwaduwidv widunisvsdiyi, ale unalisdayvdi wuniwadvdiyi; aniyeno inagequo gesv idedoha.
\syll ᎢᎦᏃ ᎿᏉ ᎦᎶᏐᎲᏍᎨᎢ ᎬᏩᎷᏎᎴ ᏔᎳᏚ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏩᏪᏤᎴᎢ, ᏘᏰᎵᎯᏍᏓ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏩᏁᎾ ᏙᏗᎦᏚᎲ ᎠᎴ ᏙᏗᎦᎶᎨᏒ ᎠᏂ ᎬᏩᏚᏫᏛ ᏫᏚᏂᏒᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗ ᏭᏂᏩᏛᏗᏱ; ᎠᏂᏰᏃ ᎢᎾᎨᏉ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏕᏙᎭ.
\ft And when the day began to wear away, then came the twelve, and said unto him, Send the multitude away, that they may go into the towns and country round about, and lodge, and get victuals: for we are here in a desert place.

\ln Aseno hia niduweselei; Nihi ditselasda.  Hiano nuniwesei, Hisgiquo gadu dotsiyeha ale atsadi taliquoi; iyusgininonv yogiwasenv nigadv hia nasgi yvwi unalisdayvdi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᏂᎯ ᏗᏤᎳᏍᏓ.  ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ, ᎯᏍᎩᏉ ᎦᏚ ᏙᏥᏰᎭ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏣᏗ ᏔᎵᏉᎢ; ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᏲᎩᏩᏎᏅ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏴᏫ ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗ.
\ft But he said unto them, Give ye them to eat. And they said, We have no more but five loaves and two fishes; except we should go and buy meat for all this people.

\ln Hisgiyeno iyagayvli iyvdv nanie anisgaya.  Hiano niduwesele gvwasdawadidohi, Wananvvga hisgasgohi igunitsvdv gesesdi.
\syll ᎯᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎾᏂᎡ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ.  ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ, ᏩᎾᏅᎥᎦ ᎯᏍᎦᏍᎪᎯ ᎢᎫᏂᏨᏛ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft For they were about five thousand men. And he said to his disciples, Make them sit down by fifties in a company.

\ln Nasgino nunadvnelei, ale nigadv unanvdiyi nidunvlei.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏄᎾᏛᏁᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎤᎾᏅᏗᏱ ᏂᏚᏅᎴᎢ.
\ft And they did so, and made them all sit down.

\ln Hisgino gadu dugisei, ale tali atsadi dunesei; galvladino widukahnanv ulihelitsei, ale ugvhaluyei, ale dunele gvwasdawadidohi tsuninediyi unitsati.
\syll ᎯᏍᎩᏃ ᎦᏚ ᏚᎩᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏔᎵ ᎠᏣᏗ ᏚᏁᏎᎢ; ᎦᎸᎳᏗᏃ ᏫᏚᎧᎿᏅ ᎤᎵᎮᎵᏤᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎬᎭᎷᏰᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏁᎴ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏧᏂᏁᏗᏱ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ.
\ft Then he took the five loaves and the two fishes, and looking up to heaven, he blessed them, and brake, and gave to the disciples to set before the multitude.

\ln Unalisdayvneno, ale nigadv dunolvsei; ale unutese uligvhaluyvhi unatiyelvhi taladu iyakalii talutsa.
\syll ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᏁᏃ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏚᏃᎸᏎᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᏄᏖᏎ ᎤᎵᎬᎭᎷᏴᎯ ᎤᎾᏘᏰᎸᎯ ᏔᎳᏚ ᎢᏯᎧᎵᎢ ᏔᎷᏣ.
\ft And they did eat, and were all filled: and there was taken up of fragments that remained to them twelve baskets.

\ln Hiano nulistanei nasgi uwasv gesv adadolisdisgv gvwasdawadidohi anehei; dudvdvneno hia niduweselei, Gago gvquoseho yvwi?

\ln Hnaquono uninohele unvsv gesvi, nasgi na unadatlugv utli atsilvquodiyu gesvi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎤᏂᏃᎮᎴ ᎤᏅᏒ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬ ᎤᏟ ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Then there arose a reasoning among them, which of them should be greatest.

\ln Tsisano udolehosv nusdv danadanvtesgv dotsunadanvdvi, ayoli wuyanvhe ale uwolv nav uwekanei,
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᏙᎴᎰᏒ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏓᎾᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ ᏙᏧᎾᏓᏅᏛᎢ, ᎠᏲᎵ ᏭᏯᏅᎮ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏬᎸ ᎾᎥ ᎤᏪᎧᏁᎢ,
\ft And Jesus, perceiving the thought of their heart, took a child, and set him by him,

\ln Ale hia niduweselei, Gilo dadanilvgesdi hia ayoli ayv daquadov nvdigalisdodisgesdi, ayv daquadanilvgesdi; gilono ayv daquadanilvgesdi, dadanilvgesdi nvdvginvsidv, nasgiyeno usdikani nihi nigadv nitsadvnvi, nasgi atsilvquodiyu gesesdi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎩᎶ ᏓᏓᏂᎸᎨᏍᏗ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏲᎵ ᎠᏴ ᏓᏆᏙᎥ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᏴ ᏓᏆᏓᏂᎸᎨᏍᏗ; ᎩᎶᏃ ᎠᏴ ᏓᏆᏓᏂᎸᎨᏍᏗ, ᏓᏓᏂᎸᎨᏍᏗ ᏅᏛᎩᏅᏏᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎤᏍᏗᎧᏂ ᏂᎯ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏂᏣᏛᏅᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft And said unto them, Whosoever shall receive this child in my name receiveth me: and whosoever shall receive me receiveth him that sent me: for he that is least among you all, the same shall be great.

\ln Tsanino unetse hia nuwesei, Tadeyohvsgi, otsigovgi asiyvwi anisgina deganugowisgvgi detsadov gvdisgvgi; otsinvsdadelvgino nvdagalisdodisgvgi nigisdawadegvna gesvi.
\syll ᏣᏂᏃ ᎤᏁᏤ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᏔᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ, ᎣᏥᎪᎥᎩ ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᎠᏂᏍᎩᎾ ᏕᎦᏄᎪᏫᏍᎬᎩ ᏕᏣᏙᎥ ᎬᏗᏍᎬᎩ; ᎣᏥᏅᏍᏓᏕᎸᎩᏃ ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᏂᎩᏍᏓᏩᏕᎬᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft And John answered and said, Master, we saw one casting out devils in thy name; and we forbad him, because he followeth not with us.

\ln Tsisano hia nuweselvgi, Tlesdi etsinvsdadelvgi; giloyeno nigatludisgvna yigi nasgi igaligonehi.
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᎡᏥᏅᏍᏓᏕᎸᎩ; ᎩᎶᏰᏃ ᏂᎦᏡᏗᏍᎬᎾ ᏱᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎦᎵᎪᏁᎯ.
\ft And Jesus said unto him, Forbid him not: for he that is not against us is for us.

\ln Hiano nulistane hnaquo asqualisge galvladi tsagadanilvisdiyi, ulinigidiyu udanvte Tsilusilimi wulohisdiyi.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁ ᎿᏉ ᎠᏍᏆᎵᏍᎨ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏣᎦᏓᏂᎸᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ ᎤᏓᏅᏖ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᏭᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ.
\ft And it came to pass, when the time was come that he should be received up, he stedfastly set his face to go to Jerusalem,

\ln Dunvseno igvyi anegi; unenvseno, ale Sameli anehi uniduhv wuniyvlei, nasgi gvwadvnvisdanediyi.
\syll ᏚᏅᏎᏃ ᎢᎬᏱ ᎠᏁᎩ; ᎤᏁᏅᏎᏃ, ᎠᎴ ᏌᎺᎵ ᎠᏁᎯ ᎤᏂᏚᎲ ᏭᏂᏴᎴᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏩᏛᏅᎢᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ.
\ft And sent messengers before his face: and they went, and entered into a village of the Samaritans, to make ready for him.

\ln Vtlano yidigvwadanilvtsei, nvdigalisdodisge Tsilusilimi tsiwagado nvwasdei.
\syll ᎥᏝᏃ ᏱᏗᎬᏩᏓᏂᎸᏤᎢ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᏥᏩᎦᏙ ᏅᏩᏍᏕᎢ.
\ft And they did not receive him, because his face was as though he would go to Jerusalem.

\ln Gvwasdawadidohino Tsimi ale Tsani nasgi unigohv, hia nuniwesei, Tsagvwiyuhi, osiquosgo yiyelvna yogininetsv atsilv galvladi nvdayulohisdiyi ale unagohvsdodiyi nasgiya Ilaya nudvnelvi?
\syll ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯᏃ ᏥᎻ ᎠᎴ ᏣᏂ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᎪᎲ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎣᏏᏉᏍᎪ ᏱᏰᎸᎾ ᏲᎩᏂᏁᏨ ᎠᏥᎸ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏅᏓᏳᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᎪᎲᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎢᎳᏯ ᏄᏛᏁᎸᎢ?
\ft And when his disciples James and John saw this, they said, Lord, wilt thou that we command fire to come down from heaven, and consume them, even as Elias did?

\ln Aseno ugatahvsv dugvsgolvne hia nuwesei, Vtla yisdigataha nusdv adanvdo isdihvi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᎦᏔᎲᏒ ᏚᎬᏍᎪᎸᏁ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᏱᏍᏗᎦᏔᎭ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎢᏍᏗᎲᎢ.
\ft But he turned, and rebuked them, and said, Ye know not what manner of spirit ye are of.

\ln Yvwiyeno Uwetsi tsulutsilv vtla yvwi danvnv yidudvtanilv, dusdelvhilvquosgini.  Nvwadaleno digaduhv wunilosei.
\syll ᏴᏫᏰᏃ ᎤᏪᏥ ᏧᎷᏥᎸ ᎥᏝ ᏴᏫ ᏓᏅᏅ ᏱᏚᏛᏔᏂᎸ, ᏚᏍᏕᎸᎯᎸᏉᏍᎩᏂ.  ᏅᏩᏓᎴᏃ ᏗᎦᏚᎲ ᏭᏂᎶᏎᎢ.
\ft For the Son of man is not come to destroy men's lives, but to save them. And they went to another village.

\ln Anaisvno nvnohi hia nulistanei, gilo iyusdi hia nuweselei, Tsagvwiyuhi, dagvsdawadidoli nigav hedohvi.
\syll ᎠᎾᎢᏒᏃ ᏅᏃᎯ ᎯᎠ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᏓᎬᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎵ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎮᏙᎲᎢ.
\ft And it came to pass, that, as they went in the way, a certain man said unto him, Lord, I will follow thee whithersoever thou goest.

\ln Tsisano hia nuweselei, Tsula dunitalesoi, tsisquano galanvdv aninohilidohi dunanesdatlahoi; yvwisgini Uwetsi vtla ilvhitlv asgoli utlodiyi yigi.
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏧᎳ ᏚᏂᏔᎴᏐᎢ, ᏥᏍᏆᏃ ᎦᎳᏅᏛ ᎠᏂᏃᎯᎵᏙᎯ ᏚᎾᏁᏍᏓᏝᎰᎢ; ᏴᏫᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎥᏝ ᎢᎸᎯᏢ ᎠᏍᎪᎵ ᎤᏠᏗᏱ ᏱᎩ.
\ft And Jesus said unto him, Foxes have holes, and birds of the air have nests; but the Son of man hath not where to lay his head.

\ln Uwadaleno hia nuweselei, Sgisdawaduga.  Aseno hia nuwesei, Tsagvwiyuhi, squalisgolvdasi igvyi aquenvsdiyi witsinisodiyi edoda.
\syll ᎤᏩᏓᎴᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏍᎩᏍᏓᏩᏚᎦ.  ᎠᏎᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᏍᏆᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏏ ᎢᎬᏱ ᎠᏇᏅᏍᏗᏱ ᏫᏥᏂᏐᏗᏱ ᎡᏙᏓ.
\ft And he said unto another, Follow me. But he said, Lord, suffer me first to go and bury my father.

\ln Tsisa hia nuweselei, Tsuniyohusvhi daninisisgesdi digvwaniyohuhiselvhi; nihisgini hena walitsidohvga winohvli Unelanvhi ugvwiyuhi gesvi.
\syll ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᏓᏂᏂᏏᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏗᎬᏩᏂᏲᎱᎯᏎᎸᎯ; ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎮᎾ ᏩᎵᏥᏙᎲᎦ ᏫᏃᎲᎵ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Jesus said unto him, Let the dead bury their dead: but go thou and preach the kingdom of God.

\ln Nvwadaleno nasquo hia nuwesei, Tsagvwiyuhi, dagvsdawadidoli; aseno igvyi gena wigatsiyoliga nvdvnini diquenvsvi.
\syll ᏅᏩᏓᎴᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᏓᎬᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎵ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎢᎬᏱ ᎨᎾ ᏫᎦᏥᏲᎵᎦ ᏅᏛᏂᏂ ᏗᏇᏅᏒᎢ.
\ft And another also said, Lord, I will follow thee; but let me first go bid them farewell, which are at home at my house.

\ln Tsisano hia nuweselei, Vtla giloi, tsusitadvhi gadalugodi yiagatahvno, yeli Unelanvhi Ugvwiyuhi gesv wigvwayvsdi yigi.
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶᎢ, ᏧᏏᏔᏛᎯ ᎦᏓᎷᎪᏗ ᏱᎠᎦᏔᎲᏃ, ᏰᎵ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏫᎬᏩᏴᏍᏗ ᏱᎩ.
\ft And Jesus said unto him, No man, having put his hand to the plough, and looking back, is fit for the kingdom of God.

\ln Nasgino nulistanidolv, Ugvwiyuhi nvwanadale galiquasgohi iyanidv nasquo dusuyesei ale dunvse tali tsunaligonvdv igvyi nunenvsdiyi nigadv degaduwadisv ale nigvnadv, nahna uwasv wuluhisdi gesvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏂᏙᎸ, ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴ ᎦᎵᏆᏍᎪᎯ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏚᏑᏰᏎᎢ ᎠᎴ ᏚᏅᏎ ᏔᎵ ᏧᎾᎵᎪᏅᏛ ᎢᎬᏱ ᏄᏁᏅᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏕᎦᏚᏩᏗᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎬᎾᏛ, ᏀᎾ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏭᎷᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft After these things the Lord appointed other seventy also, and sent them two and two before his face into every city and place, whither he himself would come.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi hia niduweselei, Ugadvnatsvhi udohiyuhi utsata, tsunilvwisdanehisgini anigayoliyu; nasgi iyusdi etsadadolisdasi Ugvwiyuhi ugadvnatsvhi utseliga, nidodayunvsdiyi tsunilvwisdanehi nahna ugadvnatselvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎤᎦᏛᎾᏨᎯ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎤᏣᏔ, ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏂᎦᏲᎵᏳ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎡᏣᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏏ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᎦᏛᎾᏨᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᏂᏙᏓᏳᏅᏍᏗᏱ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᏀᎾ ᎤᎦᏛᎾᏤᎸᎢ.
\ft Therefore said he unto them, The harvest truly is great, but the labourers are few: pray ye therefore the Lord of the harvest, that he would send forth labourers into his harvest.

\ln Itsena; gvniyuquo itsvnvli uninodena anigina wayohi tsiwanilosgo nasgiyai.
\syll ᎢᏤᎾ; ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎢᏨᏅᎵ ᎤᏂᏃᏕᎾ ᎠᏂᎩᎾ ᏩᏲᎯ ᏥᏩᏂᎶᏍᎪ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ.
\ft Go your ways: behold, I send you forth as lambs among wolves.

\ln Tlesdi ditsinvsvgi adelv digalodi, ale degalodi, ale dilasulo; ale tlesdi gilo etsiyolilvgi itsaisvi.
\syll ᏞᏍᏗ ᏗᏥᏅᏒᎩ ᎠᏕᎸ ᏗᎦᎶᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᎦᎶᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎳᏑᎶ; ᎠᎴ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎩᎶ ᎡᏥᏲᎵᎸᎩ ᎢᏣᎢᏒᎢ.
\ft Carry neither purse, nor scrip, nor shoes: and salute no man by the way.

\ln Ilvhitlvno adanelv itsiyvhihesdi, igvyi, Nvwadohiyadv ehesdi ani adanelvi, itsadisgesdi.
\syll ᎢᎸᎯᏢᏃ ᎠᏓᏁᎸ ᎢᏥᏴᎯᎮᏍᏗ, ᎢᎬᏱ, ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᎡᎮᏍᏗ ᎠᏂ ᎠᏓᏁᎸᎢ, ᎢᏣᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
\ft And into whatsoever house ye enter, first say, Peace be to this house.

\ln Iyuno nvwadohiyadv uwetsi nahna ehesdi, nvwadohiyadv itsatseliga ulutsedi gesesdi; iyuno nahna nehvna igesesdi itsvsvquo itsilutsisanedi gesesdi.
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᎤᏪᏥ ᏀᎾ ᎡᎮᏍᏗ, ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᎢᏣᏤᎵᎦ ᎤᎷᏤᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᏀᎾ ᏁᎲᎾ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎢᏨᏒᏉ ᎢᏥᎷᏥᏌᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft And if the son of peace be there, your peace shall rest upon it: if not, it shall turn to you again.

\ln Ale nahnaquo adanelv itsinesdi, itsalisdayvdisgesdi ale itsaditasgesdi nusdv etsinehvi; tsulvwisdanehiyeno duyugodi aguyvediyi dulvwisdanelvi.  Tlesdi dadaneladisv yitsedolidohesdi
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏀᎾᏉ ᎠᏓᏁᎸ ᎢᏥᏁᏍᏗ, ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏣᏗᏔᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎡᏥᏁᎲᎢ; ᏧᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯᏰᏃ ᏚᏳᎪᏗ ᎠᎫᏴᎡᏗᏱ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸᎢ.  ᏞᏍᏗ ᏓᏓᏁᎳᏗᏒ ᏱᏤᏙᎵᏙᎮᏍᏗ
\ft And in the same house remain, eating and drinking such things as they give: for the labourer is worthy of his hire. Go not from house to house.

\ln Ale ilvhitlv gaduhv itsilugesdi, ale degetsadanilvgesdi, nusdv getselasdisgv itsalisdayvdisgesdi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎢᎸᎯᏢ ᎦᏚᎲ ᎢᏥᎷᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᎨᏣᏓᏂᎸᎨᏍᏗ, ᏄᏍᏛ ᎨᏤᎳᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
\ft And into whatsoever city ye enter, and they receive you, eat such things as are set before you:

\ln Ale detsinvwisgesdi tsunitlvgi nahna anehvi, ale hia nidetsiwesehesdi, Unelanvhi ugvwiyuhi gesv navniyu itsilutselv.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏕᏥᏅᏫᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏧᏂᏢᎩ ᏀᎾ ᎠᏁᎲᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏕᏥᏪᏎᎮᏍᏗ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎾᎥᏂᏳ ᎢᏥᎷᏤᎸ.
\ft And heal the sick that are therein, and say unto them, The kingdom of God is come nigh unto you.

\ln Ilvhitlvsgini gaduhv itsiyvhihesdi, nidigetsadanilvgvnano igesesdi, itsinugogesdi degalanvdv nahnani witsilosgesdi, hia nitsiwesgesdi,
\syll ᎢᎸᎯᏢᏍᎩᏂ ᎦᏚᎲ ᎢᏥᏴᎯᎮᏍᏗ, ᏂᏗᎨᏣᏓᏂᎸᎬᎾᏃ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎢᏥᏄᎪᎨᏍᏗ ᏕᎦᎳᏅᏛ ᏀᎾᏂ ᏫᏥᎶᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᏥᏪᏍᎨᏍᏗ,
\ft But into whatsoever city ye enter, and they receive you not, go your ways out into the streets of the same, and say,

\ln Nasquo gosduquo itsiduhv galageyvi, nasgi ogiyalvgvi otsinvgovdi itsviyeha; aseno hia nusdesdi itsigatahesdi, nasgi Unelanvhi ugvwiyuhi gesv navniyu itsilutselvi.

\syll ᎢᏨᏲᏎᏰᏃ ᎤᏂᏣᏛᎩ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᎾᏚᎸᎲᎩ ᏂᎯ ᏥᏥᎪᏩᏘ ᎤᏂᎪᏩᏛᏗᏱ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏳᏂᎪᎮᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏛᎪᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎯ ᏥᏣᏛᎩᎭ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏳᎾᏛᎦᏁᎢ
