\syll ᎤᎩᏨᏛᏃ ᎿᏉ ᎤᏂᎩᏒ, ᏔᎵ ᎠᏂᎩᏏ ᏧᎾᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᏑᎴᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏁᎴ ᎦᏁᎳ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎯᏍᏆᏂᎪᏕᏍᏗ, ᎢᎦᎢᏃ ᏫᎦᎶᏒᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᏣᎫᏴᎯᏙᎸᎢ, ᎢᏥᎷᏨᎭ ᎢᎬᏯᎫᏴᎡᎸᎭ.
\ft And on the morrow when he departed, he took out two pence, and gave them to the host, and said unto him, Take care of him; and whatsoever thou spendest more, when I come again, I will repay thee.

\ln Hiano nasgi tsoi iyanidv gesv, nihi hadanvtesgv, gago nav itsunadala nvwasdi nasgi dinadanasahvsgi tsidunadawadvtanei?
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏦᎢ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᎨᏒ, ᏂᎯ ᎭᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ, ᎦᎪ ᎾᎥ ᎢᏧᎾᏓᎳ ᏅᏩᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎾᏓᎾᏌᎲᏍᎩ ᏥᏚᎾᏓᏩᏛᏔᏁᎢ?
\ft Which now of these three, thinkest thou, was neighbour unto him that fell among the thieves?

\ln Hiano nuwesei, Nasgi na uwedolitsvhi.  Hnaquono Tsisa hia nuweselei, Hena, ale nihi nasgiya winadvga.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᏪᏙᎵᏨᎯ.  ᎿᏉᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎮᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎯ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏫᎾᏛᎦ.
\ft And he said, He that shewed mercy on him. Then said Jesus unto him, Go, and do thou likewise.

\ln Hiano nulistane anaisvi, nasgi ilvhitlv gaduhv ulutsei; gilono iyusdi ageyv Madi tsudoidv dudanilvtse ganelvi.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁ ᎠᎾᎢᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎸᎯᏢ ᎦᏚᎲ ᎤᎷᏤᎢ; ᎩᎶᏃ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᎨᏴ ᎹᏗ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ ᏚᏓᏂᎸᏤ ᎦᏁᎸᎢ.
\ft Now it came to pass, as they went, that he entered into a certain village: and a certain woman named Martha received him into her house.

\ln Ulvno ehe Meli tsudoidv, nasgi nasquo uwole Tsisa dulasgvi, ale udvdasde gawonisgvi.
\syll ᎤᎸᏃ ᎡᎮ ᎺᎵ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᏬᎴ ᏥᏌ ᏚᎳᏍᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏛᏓᏍᏕ ᎦᏬᏂᏍᎬᎢ.
\ft And she had a sister called Mary, which also sat at Jesus' feet, and heard his word.

\ln Madisgini uwelihisdisge utsati dulvwisdanehvi, ale ulutsele hia nuweselei, Tsagvwiyuhi, tlasgo gohusdi yeliha vgilv tsaquvdetsv tsagihiyasdanelv aquvsvquo gohusdi itsvyadvnediyi?  Nasgi iyusdi tinetsi dagisdelvdiyi.
\syll ᎹᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏪᎵᎯᏍᏗᏍᎨ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎷᏤᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᏝᏍᎪ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏰᎵᎭ ᎥᎩᎸ ᏣᏋᏕᏨ ᏣᎩᎯᏯᏍᏓᏁᎸ ᎠᏋᏒᏉ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎢᏨᏯᏛᏁᏗᏱ?  ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏘᏁᏥ ᏓᎩᏍᏕᎸᏗᏱ.
\ft But Martha was cumbered about much serving, and came to him, and said, Lord, dost thou not care that my sister hath left me to serve alone? bid her therefore that she help me.

\ln Tsisano unetsv hia nuweselei, Madi, Madi, utsati tsudalenvdv tsagasayasdv tselihisdiha ale tsadeyadodiha;
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎹᏗ, ᎹᏗ, ᎤᏣᏘ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏣᎦᏌᏯᏍᏛ ᏤᎵᎯᏍᏗᎭ ᎠᎴ ᏣᏕᏯᏙᏗᎭ;
\ft And Jesus answered and said unto her, Martha, Martha, thou art careful and troubled about many things:

\ln Sudalegiquo sgini udulvdi; ale Meli usuyesv nasgi osani gesvi, nasgi gayetsigiedi nigesvna tsigi.
\syll ᏑᏓᎴᎩᏉ ᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏚᎸᏗ; ᎠᎴ ᎺᎵ ᎤᏑᏰᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏌᏂ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏰᏥᎩᎡᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏥᎩ.
\ft But one thing is needful: and Mary hath chosen that good part, which shall not be taken away from her.

\ln Hiano nulistanei, nasgi adadolisdisgv ilvhitlv, usuligotsv, asiyvwi usdawadidohi hia nuweselei, Tsagvwiyuhi, sgiyeyohvga ogadadolisdodiyi, nasgi Tsani tsinudvnele tsiduweyone gvwasdawadidohi.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᎢᎸᎯᏢ, ᎤᏑᎵᎪᏨ, ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᎤᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᏍᎩᏰᏲᎲᎦ ᎣᎦᏓᏙᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏣᏂ ᏥᏄᏛᏁᎴ ᏥᏚᏪᏲᏁ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ.
\ft And it came to pass, that, as he was praying in a certain place, when he ceased, one of his disciples said unto him, Lord, teach us to pray, as John also taught his disciples.

\ln Hiano niduweselei, itsadadolisdisgesdi hia nitsiwesgesdi, Ogidoda galvladi hehi, Galvquodiyu gesesdi detsadovi; Tsvgvwiyuhi gesv wigananugoi; Hadanvtesgv winigalisda elohi nasgiya galvladi tsinigalisdiha.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎢᏣᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏥᏪᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎣᎩᏙᏓ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎮᎯ, ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏕᏣᏙᎥᎢ; ᏨᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏫᎦᎾᏄᎪᎢ; ᎭᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ ᏫᏂᎦᎵᏍᏓ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏥᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᎭ.
\ft And he said unto them, When ye pray, say, Our Father which art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name. Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done, as in heaven, so in earth.

\ln Ogalisdayvdi sginehesdi nidugitsvnisvi.
\syll ᎣᎦᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗ ᏍᎩᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᏂᏚᎩᏨᏂᏒᎢ.
\ft Give us day by day our daily bread.

\ln Ale digesgivsiquo ogisganvtsvi; ayvyeno nasquo digayotsineho nigadv tsotsidugi; ale tlesdi udagoliyediyi widisgiyatinvstanvgi; sgiyudalesgesdiquosgini uyo gesvi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏗᎨᏍᎩᎥᏏᏉ ᎣᎩᏍᎦᏅᏨᎢ; ᎠᏴᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏗᎦᏲᏥᏁᎰ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏦᏥᏚᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎤᏓᎪᎵᏰᏗᏱ ᏫᏗᏍᎩᏯᏘᏅᏍᏔᏅᎩ; ᏍᎩᏳᏓᎴᏍᎨᏍᏗᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏲ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft And forgive us our sins; for we also forgive every one that is indebted to us. And lead us not into temptation; but deliver us from evil.

\ln Hiano niduweselei, Gago hia tsinitsadvnv ulii yeha, ale enoyi ayeli yiwulutselv, ale hia yinuweselv, Ginalii, tsoi gadu disquadolasda;
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎦᎪ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᏣᏛᏅ ᎤᎵᎢ ᏰᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎡᏃᏱ ᎠᏰᎵ ᏱᏭᎷᏤᎸ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏱᏄᏪᏎᎸ, ᎩᎾᎵᎢ, ᏦᎢ ᎦᏚ ᏗᏍᏆᏙᎳᏍᏓ;
\ft And he said unto them, Which of you shall have a friend, and shall go unto him at midnight, and say unto him, Friend, lend me three loaves;

\ln Oginaliiyeno aisv agilutsi, vtla ale gohusdi yagiha tsiyelasdodi;
\syll ᎣᎩᎾᎵᎢᏰᏃ ᎠᎢᏒ ᎠᎩᎷᏥ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏯᎩᎭ ᏥᏰᎳᏍᏙᏗ;
\ft For a friend of mine in his journey is come to me, and I have nothing to set before him?

\ln Nasgino diyav yvdakanegi hia yinvdagawi, Tlesdi squadeyadotanvgi; galohisdiyi gayula asduha, diniyolino diquetsi otsinitlaa, vtla yeli yvgagadidv yidogagvvsi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏗᏯᎥ ᏴᏓᎧᏁᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏱᏅᏓᎦᏫ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᏍᏆᏕᏯᏙᏔᏅᎩ; ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎦᏳᎳ ᎠᏍᏚᎭ, ᏗᏂᏲᎵᏃ ᏗᏇᏥ ᎣᏥᏂᏝᎠ, ᎥᏝ ᏰᎵ ᏴᎦᎦᏗᏛ ᏱᏙᎦᎬᎥᏏ.
\ft And he from within shall answer and say, Trouble me not: the door is now shut, and my children are with me in bed; I cannot rise and give thee.

\ln Itsvyoseha gvwadidvdi nigesvna ale digvwanedi nigesvna yigi, unaliiquo gesv iyusdi, nasuligogvnasgini gesv iyusdi yadidv ale yideahvsi nigav dudulisgvi.
\syll ᎢᏨᏲᏎᎭ ᎬᏩᏗᏛᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎬᏩᏁᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏱᎩ, ᎤᎾᎵᎢᏉ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᎾᏑᎵᎪᎬᎾᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏯᏗᏛ ᎠᎴ ᏱᏕᎠᎲᏏ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏚᏚᎵᏍᎬᎢ.
\ft I say unto you, Though he will not rise and give him, because he is his friend, yet because of his importunity he will rise and give him as many as he needeth.

\ln Ale hia nitsvweseha, Itsitayoha, ase dayetsineli; itsiyoga, ase datsiwadvhi; itsvniga, ase dayetsisduieli;
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ, ᎢᏥᏔᏲᎭ, ᎠᏎ ᏓᏰᏥᏁᎵ; ᎢᏥᏲᎦ, ᎠᏎ ᏓᏥᏩᏛᎯ; ᎢᏨᏂᎦ, ᎠᏎ ᏓᏰᏥᏍᏚᎢᎡᎵ;
\ft And I say unto you, Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you.

\ln Nanivquoyeno gilo tsanitayohiho getsinehoi; gilono tsuyoho awatisgoi; gilono tsiwigvniho atsisduiehoi.
\syll ᎾᏂᎥᏉᏰᏃ ᎩᎶ ᏣᏂᏔᏲᎯᎰ ᎨᏥᏁᎰᎢ; ᎩᎶᏃ ᏧᏲᎰ ᎠᏩᏘᏍᎪᎢ; ᎩᎶᏃ ᏥᏫᎬᏂᎰ ᎠᏥᏍᏚᎢᎡᎰᎢ.
\ft For every one that asketh receiveth; and he that seeketh findeth; and to him that knocketh it shall be opened.

\ln Iyu ale gilo hia tsinitsadvnv itsigayvlige gesv uwetsi gadu yutayoseha, tsisa nvyaquo yahvsi?  Iyu ale atsadi yutayoseha, tsigo atsadi unvnedi gesv inadvquo yiganvvsi?
\syll ᎢᏳ ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᏣᏛᏅ ᎢᏥᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎦᏚ ᏳᏔᏲᏎᎭ, ᏥᏌ ᏅᏯᏉ ᏯᎲᏏ?  ᎢᏳ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏣᏗ ᏳᏔᏲᏎᎭ, ᏥᎪ ᎠᏣᏗ ᎤᏅᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᎾᏛᏉ ᏱᎦᏅᎥᏏ?
\ft If a son shall ask bread of any of you that is a father, will he give him a stone? or if he ask a fish, will he for a fish give him a serpent?

\ln Iyu ale uwetsi yutayoselv, tsigo gadogvadatsvyasdisgi yiganvvsi.
\syll ᎢᏳ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏪᏥ ᏳᏔᏲᏎᎸ, ᏥᎪ ᎦᏙᎬᎠᏓᏨᏯᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᏱᎦᏅᎥᏏ.
\ft Or if he shall ask an egg, will he offer him a scorpion?

\ln Nasgi iyusdi iyuno nihi itsiyoi, yitsisinahi osdv gesv ditsinediyi ditsetsi, utlihiyu nudvnvisdi Itsidoda galvladi ehi tsunediyi Galvquodiyu Adanvdo gvwatayosehi!
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏳᏃ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏥᏲᎢ, ᏱᏥᏏᏀᎢ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎨᏒ ᏗᏥᏁᏗᏱ ᏗᏤᏥ, ᎤᏟᎯᏳ ᏄᏛᏅᎢᏍᏗ ᎢᏥᏙᏓ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ ᏧᏁᏗᏱ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎬᏩᏔᏲᏎᎯ
\ft If ye then, being evil, know how to give good gifts unto your children: how much more shall your heavenly Father give the Holy Spirit to them that ask him?

\ln Asginano ganugowisgei, ale uwagewi gesei.  Hia no nulistanei, nasgi asgina unugotsv uwagewi uwonisei; yvwino unisquanigosei.
\syll ᎠᏍᎩᎾᏃ ᎦᏄᎪᏫᏍᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏩᎨᏫ ᎨᏎᎢ.  ᎯᎠ Ꮓ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᎩᎾ ᎤᏄᎪᏨ ᎤᏩᎨᏫ ᎤᏬᏂᏎᎢ; ᏴᏫᏃ ᎤᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏎᎢ.
\ft And he was casting out a devil, and it was dumb. And it came to pass, when the devil was gone out, the dumb spake; and the people wondered.

\ln Igadvsgini hia nuniwesei, Anisgina deganugowisga usdeliha Quelitsiqua ugvwiyuhi anisgina unatseliga.
\syll ᎢᎦᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ, ᎠᏂᏍᎩᎾ ᏕᎦᏄᎪᏫᏍᎦ ᎤᏍᏕᎵᎭ ᏇᎵᏥᏆ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᏂᏍᎩᎾ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ.
\ft But some of them said, He casteth out devils through Beelzebub the chief of the devils.

\ln Anisoino gvwagoliyesgv, gvwatayosele tsunanugowisediyi uyelvdv galvladi nvdayulosvhi.
\syll ᎠᏂᏐᎢᏃ ᎬᏩᎪᎵᏰᏍᎬ, ᎬᏩᏔᏲᏎᎴ ᏧᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᏗᏱ ᎤᏰᎸᏛ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏅᏓᏳᎶᏒᎯ.
\ft And others, tempting him, sought of him a sign from heaven.

\ln Aseno agatahe nusdv danadanvtesgv hia niduweselei, Nigav ayeli degotlvsvi tali tsinadadisgo uwasv tsadatludisgoi, ayogoquo; ale sidanelv tali tsinudao uwasv tsadatludisgo ayogoi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᎦᏔᎮ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏓᎾᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏂᎦᎥ ᎠᏰᎵ ᏕᎪᏢᏒᎢ ᏔᎵ ᏥᎾᏓᏗᏍᎪ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏣᏓᏡᏗᏍᎪᎢ, ᎠᏲᎪᏉ; ᎠᎴ ᏏᏓᏁᎸ ᏔᎵ ᏥᏄᏓᎣ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏣᏓᏡᏗᏍᎪ ᎠᏲᎪᎢ.
\ft But he, knowing their thoughts, said unto them, Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation; and a house divided against a house falleth.

\ln Iyu ale Sedani tali yinudaa uwasv yadatludiha, gado yigalisdoda yinigvwasdiquo utseligohi?  Nvdigalisdodiha Quelitsiqua usdeliha anisgina tsideganugowisga tsisgiyoseha.
\syll ᎢᏳ ᎠᎴ ᏎᏓᏂ ᏔᎵ ᏱᏄᏓᎠ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏯᏓᏡᏗᎭ, ᎦᏙ ᏱᎦᎵᏍᏙᏓ ᏱᏂᎬᏩᏍᏗᏉ ᎤᏤᎵᎪᎯ?  ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᏇᎵᏥᏆ ᎤᏍᏕᎵᎭ ᎠᏂᏍᎩᎾ ᏥᏕᎦᏄᎪᏫᏍᎦ ᏥᏍᎩᏲᏎᎭ.
\ft If Satan also be divided against himself, how shall his kingdom stand? because ye say that I cast out devils through Beelzebub.

\ln Iyuno Quelitsiqua yagisdeliha anisgina detsinugowisgvi, gago unisdeliha ditsetsi nasgi daninugowisgvi?  Nasgi iyusdi nasgi digetsugodanehi gesesdi.
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᏇᎵᏥᏆ ᏯᎩᏍᏕᎵᎭ ᎠᏂᏍᎩᎾ ᏕᏥᏄᎪᏫᏍᎬᎢ, ᎦᎪ ᎤᏂᏍᏕᎵᎭ ᏗᏤᏥ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏓᏂᏄᎪᏫᏍᎬᎢ?  ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎨᏧᎪᏓᏁᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft And if I by Beelzebub cast out devils, by whom do your sons cast them out? therefore shall they be your judges.

\ln Iyusgini ayv anisgina detsinugowisgv Unelanvhi gayesadv yigvdiha, vtla yudlasidvha Unelanvhi ugvwiyuhi gesv itsilutselvi.
\syll ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏴ ᎠᏂᏍᎩᎾ ᏕᏥᏄᎪᏫᏍᎬ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎦᏰᏌᏛ ᏱᎬᏗᎭ, ᎥᏝ ᏳᏜᏏᏛᎭ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏥᎷᏤᎸᎢ.
\ft But if I with the finger of God cast out devils, no doubt the kingdom of God is come upon you.

\ln Iyuno ulinigidv asgaya ulisgasdodi gvyehi yagatiya ganelvi nvwadohiyadv nusdv uhnavi.
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏗ ᎬᏰᎯ ᏯᎦᏘᏯ ᎦᏁᎸᎢ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎤᎿᎥᎢ.
\ft When a strong man armed keepeth his palace, his goods are in peace:

\ln Utlisgini iyulinigidv yunolilv ale yusegogisv, ugieho nigadv ulisgasdodi ulisgasdotanvi, ale ayadohiho tsugvwalodi udawonvhvi.
\syll ᎤᏟᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᏳᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᏳᏃᎵᎸ ᎠᎴ ᏳᏎᎪᎩᏒ, ᎤᎩᎡᎰ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎤᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏗ ᎤᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏔᏅᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏯᏙᎯᎰ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎤᏓᏬᏅᎲᎢ.
\ft But when a stronger than he shall come upon him, and overcome him, he taketh from him all his armour wherein he trusted, and divideth his spoils.

\ln Gilo naqualigonehvna tsigeso aquatludisgoquo; gilono nosditlisisgvna tsigeso adigaleyasgoquo.
\syll ᎩᎶ ᎾᏆᎵᎪᏁᎲᎾ ᏥᎨᏐ ᎠᏆᏡᏗᏍᎪᏉ; ᎩᎶᏃ ᏃᏍᏗᏟᏏᏍᎬᎾ ᏥᎨᏐ ᎠᏗᎦᎴᏯᏍᎪᏉ.
\ft He that is not with me is against me: and he that gathereth not with me scattereth.

\ln Iyuno gadaha adanvdo yvwi unugogi, edoho ukayodvhi gesvi, uyoho atsawesolvsdodiyi; utlogino, hia nigawesgoi, Dvgatsvsi diquenvsv diginugotsv wvdvtsilosi.
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᎦᏓᎭ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏄᎪᎩ, ᎡᏙᎰ ᎤᎧᏲᏛᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᏲᎰ ᎠᏣᏪᏐᎸᏍᏙᏗᏱ; ᎤᏠᎩᏃ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎪᎢ, ᏛᎦᏨᏏ ᏗᏇᏅᏒ ᏗᎩᏄᎪᏨ ᏮᏛᏥᎶᏏ.
\ft When the unclean spirit is gone out of a man, he walketh through dry places, seeking rest; and finding none, he saith, I will return unto my house whence I came out.

\ln Wigalugino awatisgo gvnosahvhi ale goduistanvhi gesoi.
\syll ᏫᎦᎷᎩᏃ ᎠᏩᏘᏍᎪ ᎬᏃᏌᎲᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎪᏚᎢᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏐᎢ.
\ft And when he cometh, he findeth it swept and garnished.

\ln Hnaquono egoi, ale widayanisgo galiquogi didanvdo nvwanadale utli iyuninegutsidv esgaquo uwasv; nasgino aniyvhiho ale nahna ananeladisgoi; oniyino nusdv na asgaya utli uyoiyu gesoi esgaquo igvyiyi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎡᎪᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏫᏓᏯᏂᏍᎪ ᎦᎵᏉᎩ ᏗᏓᏅᏙ ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴ ᎤᏟ ᎢᏳᏂᏁᎫᏥᏛ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎤᏩᏒ; ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎠᏂᏴᎯᎰ ᎠᎴ ᏀᎾ ᎠᎾᏁᎳᏗᏍᎪᎢ; ᎣᏂᏱᏃ ᏄᏍᏛ Ꮎ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᏟ ᎤᏲᎢᏳ ᎨᏐᎢ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎢᎬᏱᏱ.
\ft Then goeth he, and taketh to him seven other spirits more wicked than himself; and they enter in, and dwell there: and the last state of that man is worse than the first.

\ln Hiano nulistanei, asiquo nasgi hia nigawesgei, gilo iyusdi ageyv gela unadatlugv usaladane kanegv ale hia nuweselei; Osiyu iyulisdanedi nihi tsananugowisvhi ale nasgi tsasdvnvhi.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᎠᏏᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎨᎢ, ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᎨᏴ ᎨᎳ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬ ᎤᏌᎳᏓᏁ ᎧᏁᎬ ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᏂᎯ ᏣᎾᏄᎪᏫᏒᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏣᏍᏛᏅᎯ.
\ft And it came to pass, as he spake these things, a certain woman of the company lifted up her voice, and said unto him, Blessed is the womb that bare thee, and the paps which thou hast sucked.

\ln Aseno hia nuwesei, Vv, utlihiyusgini osdv iyunalisdanedi anadvgisgi kanohedv Unelanvhi utseliga ale nasgi anisquanigodisgi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎥᎥ, ᎤᏟᎯᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎠᎾᏛᎩᏍᎩ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗᏍᎩ.
\ft But he said, Yea rather, blessed are they that hear the word of God, and keep it.

\ln Hnaquono yvwi ganenuli unadatlisanv, ulenvhe hia nuwesei; Uniyo gohi tsaneha; uniyoha uyelvdvi; aseno vtla getsinanugowisedi yigesesdi uyelvdvi, Tsona adolehosgi utseli uyelvdv uwasv.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏴᏫ ᎦᏁᏄᎵ ᎤᎾᏓᏟᏌᏅ, ᎤᎴᏅᎮ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎤᏂᏲ ᎪᎯ ᏣᏁᎭ; ᎤᏂᏲᎭ ᎤᏰᎸᏛᎢ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎨᏥᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᏰᎸᏛᎢ, ᏦᎾ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎤᏰᎸᏛ ᎤᏩᏒ.
\ft And when the people were gathered thick together, he began to say, This is an evil generation: they seek a sign; and there shall no sign be given it, but the sign of Jonas the prophet.

\ln Tsonayeno uyelvdv tsinigegvnele Niniwi anehi, nasgiya nasquo yvwi Uwetsi uyelvdv nvdagegvneli gohi tsaneha.
\syll ᏦᎾᏰᏃ ᎤᏰᎸᏛ ᏥᏂᎨᎬᏁᎴ ᏂᏂᏫ ᎠᏁᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎤᏰᎸᏛ ᏅᏓᎨᎬᏁᎵ ᎪᎯ ᏣᏁᎭ.
\ft For as Jonas was a sign unto the Ninevites, so shall also the Son of man be to this generation.

\ln Ugvwiyuhi ageyv tsuganawv tsehei dodvnaleni gohi tsaneha digugododiyi gesesdi, ale tsunadugodanediyi nidodagvneli; nasgiyeno wasdv iyvdv gadohi tsunvse udvganile Solimanv agatanavi; gvniyuquono ani edoha utli iyatsilvquodi esgaquo Solimanv.
\syll ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᎨᏴ ᏧᎦᎾᏮ ᏤᎮᎢ ᏙᏛᎾᎴᏂ ᎪᎯ ᏣᏁᎭ ᏗᎫᎪᏙᏗᏱ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᎾᏚᎪᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᏂᏙᏓᎬᏁᎵ; ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᏩᏍᏛ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎦᏙᎯ ᏧᏅᏎ ᎤᏛᎦᏂᎴ ᏐᎵᎹᏅ ᎠᎦᏔᎾᎥᎢ; ᎬᏂᏳᏉᏃ ᎠᏂ ᎡᏙᎭ ᎤᏟ ᎢᏯᏥᎸᏉᏗ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᏐᎵᎹᏅ.
\ft The queen of the south shall rise up in the judgment with the men of this generation, and condemn them: for she came from the utmost parts of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and, behold, a greater than Solomon is here.

\ln Yvwi Niniwi tsanehe dodvnaleni gohi tsaneha digugodiyi gesesdi, ale tsunadugodanediyi nvdvnvneli; duninetliyvseyeno dunadanvdv Tsona dulitsidonelv; gvniyuquono ani edoha utli iyatsilvquodi esgaquo Tsona.
\syll ᏴᏫ ᏂᏂᏫ ᏣᏁᎮ ᏙᏛᎾᎴᏂ ᎪᎯ ᏣᏁᎭ ᏗᎫᎪᏗᏱ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᎾᏚᎪᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᏅᏛᏅᏁᎵ; ᏚᏂᏁᏟᏴᏎᏰᏃ ᏚᎾᏓᏅᏛ ᏦᎾ ᏚᎵᏥᏙᏁᎸ; ᎬᏂᏳᏉᏃ ᎠᏂ ᎡᏙᎭ ᎤᏟ ᎢᏯᏥᎸᏉᏗ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᏦᎾ.
\ft The men of Nineve shall rise up in the judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: for they repented at the preaching of Jonas; and, behold, a greater than Jonas is here.

\ln Vtla ale gilo atsvsdvga atsvsdodi udelisv yigakahvsgoi, vtla ale atlilosdi yigutlvdisgoi, gagodiyisgini gagodisgoi, nasgi nvdvniyvhihi unigowadvdiyi iga gadvi.
\syll ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᎠᏨᏍᏛᎦ ᎠᏨᏍᏙᏗ ᎤᏕᎵᏒ ᏱᎦᎧᎲᏍᎪᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏟᎶᏍᏗ ᏱᎫᏢᏗᏍᎪᎢ, ᎦᎪᏗᏱᏍᎩᏂ ᎦᎪᏗᏍᎪᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏛᏂᏴᎯᎯ ᎤᏂᎪᏩᏛᏗᏱ ᎢᎦ ᎦᏛᎢ.
\ft No man, when he hath lighted a candle, putteth it in a secret place, neither under a bushel, but on a candlestick, that they which come in may see the light.

\ln Agata ayelv iga atisdanehi; nasgi iyusdi, iyuno gohusdi nusdvna gesesdi higadoli, nigv hiyelv nasquo kaliwohi gesesdi iga gati; iyusgini higadoli uyo gesesdi nigv hiyelv nasquo kaliwohi gesesdi ulisigi.
\syll ᎠᎦᏔ ᎠᏰᎸ ᎢᎦ ᎠᏘᏍᏓᏁᎯ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏄᏍᏛᎾ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎯᎦᏙᎵ, ᏂᎬ ᎯᏰᎸ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎧᎵᏬᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎢᎦ ᎦᏘ; ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎯᎦᏙᎵ ᎤᏲ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏂᎬ ᎯᏰᎸ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎧᎵᏬᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᎵᏏᎩ.
\ft The light of the body is the eye: therefore when thine eye is single, thy whole body also is full of light; but when thine eye is evil, thy body also is full of darkness.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi heyatahesdi nasgi iga gati hawini tsehv tlesdi ulisigi yigesesdi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎮᏯᏔᎮᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎦ ᎦᏘ ᎭᏫᏂ ᏤᎲ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎤᎵᏏᎩ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft Take heed therefore that the light which is in thee be not darkness.

\ln Iyuno nigv hiyelv kaliwohi gesesdi iga gati, ilvhitlv nudadalvna ulisigi, nigv ukalitsvhi gesesdi iga gati, nasgiya atsvsdodi osdv adaweligisgv iga tsitsatisdanehoi.
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᏂᎬ ᎯᏰᎸ ᎧᎵᏬᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎢᎦ ᎦᏘ, ᎢᎸᎯᏢ ᏄᏓᏓᎸᎾ ᎤᎵᏏᎩ, ᏂᎬ ᎤᎧᎵᏨᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎢᎦ ᎦᏘ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎠᏨᏍᏙᏗ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎠᏓᏪᎵᎩᏍᎬ ᎢᎦ ᏥᏣᏘᏍᏓᏁᎰᎢ.
\ft If thy whole body therefore be full of light, having no part dark, the whole shall be full of light, as when the bright shining of a candle doth give thee light.

\ln Asiquono gawonisge gilo iyusdi Aqualisi utayosele ulisdayvnanediyi; uyvleno, ale uligiyusdanvnei.
\syll ᎠᏏᏉᏃ ᎦᏬᏂᏍᎨ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏆᎵᏏ ᎤᏔᏲᏎᎴ ᎤᎵᏍᏓᏴᎾᏁᏗᏱ; ᎤᏴᎴᏃ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᎩᏳᏍᏓᏅᏁᎢ.
\ft And as he spake, a certain Pharisee besought him to dine with him: and he went in, and sat down to meat.

\ln Aqualisino ugohv usquanigose niduwosulevna gesv asiquo nulisdayvnvna.
\syll ᎠᏆᎵᏏᏃ ᎤᎪᎲ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏎ ᏂᏚᏬᏑᎴᎥᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏏᏉ ᏄᎵᏍᏓᏴᏅᎾ.
\ft And when the Pharisee saw it, he marvelled that he had not first washed before dinner.

\ln Ugvwiyuhino hia nuweselei, Nihi Itsiqualisi ulisquidi ale atelido gaduiditlv detsinvgalisgoi; hawinisgini gesv itsikalitsvhi geso asequo adagiedi gesv ale asganai.
\syll ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏂᎯ ᎢᏥᏆᎵᏏ ᎤᎵᏍᏈᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏖᎵᏙ ᎦᏚᎢᏗᏢ ᏕᏥᏅᎦᎵᏍᎪᎢ; ᎭᏫᏂᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏥᎧᎵᏨᎯ ᎨᏐ ᎠᏎᏉ ᎠᏓᎩᎡᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏍᎦᎾᎢ.
\ft And the Lord said unto him, Now do ye Pharisees make clean the outside of the cup and the platter; but your inward part is full of ravening and wickedness.

\ln Itsinegu, tlasgo nasgi gaduiditlv ehi uwotlvnvhi nasquo hawiniditlv ehi yuwotlvnei?
\syll ᎢᏥᏁᎫ, ᏝᏍᎪ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏚᎢᏗᏢ ᎡᎯ ᎤᏬᏢᏅᎯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎭᏫᏂᏗᏢ ᎡᎯ ᏳᏬᏢᏁᎢ?
\ft Ye fools, did not he that made that which is without make that which is within also?

\ln Ugvwiyusesdisgini itsadanehesdi nusdv itsihvi; gvniyuquono nigadiyu itsadanvgalvelvhi gesesdi.
\syll ᎤᎬᏫᏳᏎᏍᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᏣᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎢᏥᎲᎢ; ᎬᏂᏳᏉᏃ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᎦᎸᎡᎸᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft But rather give alms of such things as ye have; and, behold, all things are clean unto you.

\ln Nihisgini Itsiqualisi uyoiyu itsalisdanedi!  Asgohineyeno gotsaledv itsaguyisgo svtli atli luwi ale nigav Uyehnavi, itsinohiyasgono duyugodv iyadvnedi gesv ale Unelanvhi ageyudi gesvi; nasgisgini yinitsadvnelei, ale soi nitsinohiyvnaquo yigesei.
\syll ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᏥᏆᎵᏏ ᎤᏲᎢᏳ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ  ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏁᏰᏃ ᎪᏣᎴᏛ ᎢᏣᎫᏱᏍᎪ ᏒᏟ ᎠᏟ ᎷᏫ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎤᏰᎿᎥᎢ, ᎢᏥᏃᎯᏯᏍᎪᏃ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ ᏱᏂᏣᏛᏁᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏐᎢ ᏂᏥᏃᎯᏴᎾᏉ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ.
\ft But woe unto you, Pharisees! for ye tithe mint and rue and all manner of herbs, and pass over judgment and the love of God: these ought ye to have done, and not to leave the other undone.

\ln Uyoiyu itsalisdanedi Itsiqualisi!  detsilvquodoyeno nugvwiyusv degasgilv digalawiisdiyi, ale etsiyolisdiyi diganododiyi.
\syll ᎤᏲᎢᏳ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎢᏥᏆᎵᏏ  ᏕᏥᎸᏉᏙᏰᏃ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᏕᎦᏍᎩᎸ ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎡᏥᏲᎵᏍᏗᏱ ᏗᎦᏃᏙᏗᏱ.
\ft Woe unto you, Pharisees! for ye love the uppermost seats in the synagogues, and greetings in the markets.

\ln Oyoiyuitsalisdanedi ditsowelisgi, ale Itsiqualisi, itsatlonasdi!  nihiyeno dadanisahv detsatselv nuwelisdvna tsigesoi, ale yvwi gadui anilosgi vtla yinadolehosgoi.
\syll ᎣᏲᎢᏳᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᏗᏦᏪᎵᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏥᏆᎵᏏ, ᎢᏣᏠᎾᏍᏗ  ᏂᎯᏰᏃ ᏓᏓᏂᏌᎲ ᏕᏣᏤᎸ ᏄᏪᎵᏍᏛᎾ ᏥᎨᏐᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏴᏫ ᎦᏚᎢ ᎠᏂᎶᏍᎩ ᎥᏝ ᏱᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎪᎢ.
\ft Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye are as graves which appear not, and the men that walk over them are not aware of them.

\ln Hnaquono asiyvwi dikahnawadvsdi digosisisgi unetse hia nuweselei, Tadeyohvsgi, nasgi hia tsiniweha ayv nasquo gesgisotlvdiha.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏗᎪᏏᏏᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᏤ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏔᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᏪᎭ ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎨᏍᎩᏐᏢᏗᎭ.
\ft Then answered one of the lawyers, and said unto him, Master, thus saying thou reproachest us also.

\ln Hiano nuwesei; Nihi nasquo dikahnawadvsdi ditsosisisgi uyoiyu itsalisdanedi!  detsisoquilvsgoyeno yvwi dilisvsdi udeyadodi dilisvsdiyi, itsvsvsgini vtla yvgetsinotlisda dilisvsdi yvgetsvda saquo itsiyesadvi.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᏂᎯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏗᏦᏏᏏᏍᎩ ᎤᏲᎢᏳ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ  ᏕᏥᏐᏈᎸᏍᎪᏰᏃ ᏴᏫ ᏗᎵᏒᏍᏗ ᎤᏕᏯᏙᏗ ᏗᎵᏒᏍᏗᏱ, ᎢᏨᏒᏍᎩᏂ ᎥᏝ ᏴᎨᏥᏃᏟᏍᏓ ᏗᎵᏒᏍᏗ ᏴᎨᏨᏓ ᏌᏉ ᎢᏥᏰᏌᏛᎢ.
\ft And he said, Woe unto you also, ye lawyers! for ye lade men with burdens grievous to be borne, and ye yourselves touch not the burdens with one of your fingers.

\ln Uyoiyu itsalisdanedi!  detsotlvhisisgoyeno anadolehosgi degetsinisahvi, ale ditsidoda deunilvgi.
\syll ᎤᏲᎢᏳ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ  ᏕᏦᏢᎯᏏᏍᎪᏰᏃ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᏕᎨᏥᏂᏌᎲᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏥᏙᏓ ᏕᎤᏂᎸᎩ.
\ft Woe unto you! for ye build the sepulchres of the prophets, and your fathers killed them.

\ln Udohiyuhiya gvnigesv nitsvneha nasgi osiyu itsiyelvsv nusdv dunilvwisdanelv ditsigayvligei; nasgiyeno udohiyuhi dunilvgi, nihino detsotlvhisiha degetsinisehvi.
\syll ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᏨᏁᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏥᏰᎸᏒ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏚᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸ ᏗᏥᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᏚᏂᎸᎩ, ᏂᎯᏃ ᏕᏦᏢᎯᏏᎭ ᏕᎨᏥᏂᏎᎲᎢ.
\ft Truly ye bear witness that ye allow the deeds of your fathers: for they indeed killed them, and ye build their sepulchres.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi nasquo hia nuwesv Unelanvhi agatanavi, Dagatsinvsi wigvwanilutsediyi anadolehosgi, ale getsinvsidv, nasgino igadv dodvnili ale dodvnigehidoli,
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎦᏔᎾᎥᎢ, ᏓᎦᏥᏅᏏ ᏫᎬᏩᏂᎷᏤᏗᏱ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎢᎦᏛ ᏙᏛᏂᎵ ᎠᎴ ᏙᏛᏂᎨᎯᏙᎵ,
\ft Therefore also said the wisdom of God, I will send them prophets and apostles, and some of them they shall slay and persecute:

\ln Nasgi nigadv anadolehosgi unigigv atsvnvhi gesv elohi tsudotlvnv nvdagvwadalenvdv getsitayosediyi gohi tsaneha;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᎩᎬ ᎠᏨᏅᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏧᏙᏢᏅ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎨᏥᏔᏲᏎᏗᏱ ᎪᎯ ᏣᏁᎭ;
\ft That the blood of all the prophets, which was shed from the foundation of the world, may be required of this generation;

\ln Equili ugigv nvdvlenvdv, Tsegilaya ugigv wasdi, nasgi tsulisquadele ayeli atsilvgelasdiyi udvnvnodigalawiisdiyi; udohiyuhiya itsvyoseha, getsitayosedi gesesdi gohi tsaneha.
\syll ᎡᏈᎵ ᎤᎩᎬ ᏅᏛᎴᏅᏛ, ᏤᎩᎳᏯ ᎤᎩᎬ ᏩᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᎵᏍᏆᏕᎴ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎠᏥᎸᎨᎳᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏛᏅᏃᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ; ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎢᏨᏲᏎᎭ, ᎨᏥᏔᏲᏎᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎪᎯ ᏣᏁᎭ.
\ft From the blood of Abel unto the blood of Zacharias, which perished between the altar and the temple: verily I say unto you, It shall be required of this generation.

\ln Uyoiyu itsalisdanedi nihi dikahnawadvsdi ditsosisisgi!  itsiyvwidvhvyeno asduisdi agadovhisdi gesvi; vtlayeno itsvsv yitsiyvlv, ale nasgi na aniyvhihi detsiyosdodanelv.
\syll ᎤᏲᎢᏳ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᏂᎯ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏗᏦᏏᏏᏍᎩ  ᎢᏥᏴᏫᏛᎲᏰᏃ ᎠᏍᏚᎢᏍᏗ ᎠᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᎢᏨᏒ ᏱᏥᏴᎸ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᏂᏴᎯᎯ ᏕᏥᏲᏍᏙᏓᏁᎸ.
\ft Woe unto you, lawyers! for ye have taken away the key of knowledge: ye entered not in yourselves, and them that were entering in ye hindered.

\ln Nasgino hia nidegawesehei, dinowelisgi ale Aniqualisi ulinigidv gvwanvwisdisgei, ale gvwaniladehe ugodidi tsudalenvdv unohediyi;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏕᎦᏪᏎᎮᎢ, ᏗᏃᏪᎵᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᎬᏩᏅᏫᏍᏗᏍᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᏂᎳᏕᎮ ᎤᎪᏗᏗ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎤᏃᎮᏗᏱ;
\ft And as he said these things unto them, the scribes and the Pharisees began to urge him vehemently, and to provoke him to speak of many things:

\ln Gvwayawisgei, ale uniyohe uniwadvediyi gohusdi gagvwalawisedi gesvi.
\syll ᎬᏩᏯᏫᏍᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏲᎮ ᎤᏂᏩᏛᎡᏗᏱ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎦᎬᏩᎳᏫᏎᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Laying wait for him, and seeking to catch something out of his mouth, that they might accuse him.

\ln Nahiyuquono deanilawie unitsuquisdi yvwi, nasgi iyusdi deanadalasdvdisgei, nasgi ulenvhe hia igvyv niduwesele gvwasdawadidohi, Itseyatahesdi agododi Aniqualisi unatseliga, nasgi atlonasdi tsigi.
\syll ᏀᎢᏳᏉᏃ ᏕᎠᏂᎳᏫᎡ ᎤᏂᏧᏈᏍᏗ ᏴᏫ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏕᎠᎾᏓᎳᏍᏛᏗᏍᎨᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎴᏅᎮ ᎯᎠ ᎢᎬᏴ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ, ᎢᏤᏯᏔᎮᏍᏗ ᎠᎪᏙᏗ ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏠᎾᏍᏗ ᏥᎩ.
\ft In the mean time, when there were gathered together an innumerable multitude of people, insomuch that they trode one upon another, he began to say unto his disciples first of all, Beware ye of the leaven of the Pharisees, which is hypocrisy.

\ln Vtlayeno gohusdi yigvsgala nasgi gvnigesv iyulisdodi nigesvna gesvi, vtla ale gohusdi udelidv yigi nasgi agadovhisdi nigesvna gesvi.
\syll ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏱᎬᏍᎦᎳ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᏱᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft For there is nothing covered, that shall not be revealed; neither hid, that shall not be known.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi nagav gohusdi ulisigv itsinetsv iga gadv advgodi gesesdi; nasgino na itsadonvlvi dekanvsulv, gasanali gvnigesv igvnedi gesesdi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎾᎦᎥ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᎵᏏᎬ ᎢᏥᏁᏨ ᎢᎦ ᎦᏛ ᎠᏛᎪᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᎾᏍᎩᏃ Ꮎ ᎢᏣᏙᏅᎸᎢ ᏕᎧᏅᏑᎸ, ᎦᏌᎾᎵ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᎬᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft Therefore whatsoever ye have spoken in darkness shall be heard in the light; and that which ye have spoken in the ear in closets shall be proclaimed upon the housetops.

\ln Ale itsvyoseha nihi igalii, Tlesdi yiditsisgaihesdi ayelv anihihi, hnaquono gohusidi utli iyvdv wigvwanadvnedi nigesvna tsigi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎢᏨᏲᏎᎭ ᏂᎯ ᎢᎦᎵᎢ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏗᏥᏍᎦᎢᎮᏍᏗ ᎠᏰᎸ ᎠᏂᎯᎯ, ᎿᏉᏃ ᎪᎱᏏᏗ ᎤᏟ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏫᎬᏩᎾᏛᏁᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏥᎩ.
\ft And I say unto you my friends, Be not afraid of them that kill the body, and after that have no more that they can do.

\ln Aseno datsvyeyatani nasgi etsinayesdi gesvi; Etsinayesgesdi nasgi na yudalv, yeliquo tsvsgino wigvwadadainvdi gesvi; vv, itsvyoseha Etsinayesgesdi nasgi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᏓᏨᏰᏯᏔᏂ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᏥᎾᏰᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎡᏥᎾᏰᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏳᏓᎸ, ᏰᎵᏉ ᏨᏍᎩᏃ ᏫᎬᏩᏓᏓᎢᏅᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎥᎥ, ᎢᏨᏲᏎᎭ ᎡᏥᎾᏰᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ.
\ft But I will forewarn you whom ye shall fear: Fear him, which after he hath killed hath power to cast into hell; yea, I say unto you, Fear him.

\ln Tlasgo hisgi tsisquaya tali iyadanvtedi yidanaligvwalvsgoi?  Vtlano saquo nasgi agvgewisvhi yigi Unelanvhi agatahvi.
\syll ᏝᏍᎪ ᎯᏍᎩ ᏥᏍᏆᏯ ᏔᎵ ᎢᏯᏓᏅᏖᏗ ᏱᏓᎾᎵᎬᏩᎸᏍᎪᎢ?  ᎥᏝᏃ ᏌᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎬᎨᏫᏒᎯ ᏱᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎦᏔᎲᎢ.
\ft Are not five sparrows sold for two farthings, and not one of them is forgotten before God?

\ln Nasquosgini itsisdiyegv itsisgoli nigadiyu diselvhi.  Nasgi iyusdi tlesdi yitsisgaihesdi; nihi utli igai ditsagvwalodi esgaquo unitsati tsisquaya.
\syll ᎾᏍᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᏥᏍᏗᏰᎬ ᎢᏥᏍᎪᎵ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏗᏎᎸᎯ.  ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏥᏍᎦᎢᎮᏍᏗ; ᏂᎯ ᎤᏟ ᎢᎦᎢ ᏗᏣᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏥᏍᏆᏯ.
\ft But even the very hairs of your head are all numbered. Fear not therefore: ye are of more value than many sparrows.

\ln Nasquo itsvyoseha, Gilo gvnigesv naquvnehesdi yvwi anigatahvi, nasgi yvwi Uwetsi gvnigesv nasquo nvdayuwaneli anigatahv dinikahnawadidohi Unelanvhi tsutseliga.
\syll ᎾᏍᏉ ᎢᏨᏲᏎᎭ, ᎩᎶ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎾᏋᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᏴᏫ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏅᏓᏳᏩᏁᎵ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎲ ᏗᏂᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᏤᎵᎦ.
\ft Also I say unto you, Whosoever shall confess me before men, him shall the Son of man also confess before the angels of God:

\ln Gilosgini aquadayihesdi yvwi anigatahvi, agadayisdi gesesdi anigatahv dinikahnawadidohi Unelanvhi tsutseliga.
\syll ᎩᎶᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏆᏓᏱᎮᏍᏗ ᏴᏫ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎲᎢ, ᎠᎦᏓᏱᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎲ ᏗᏂᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᏤᎵᎦ.
\ft But he that denieth me before men shall be denied before the angels of God.

\ln Ale gilo gawonisgv atludisgesdi yvwi Uwetsi, gayetsidolisdiquo gesesdi; gilosgini Galvquodiyu Adanvdo asotlvisdisgesdi vtla gayetsidolisdi yigesesdi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᎦᏬᏂᏍᎬ ᎠᏡᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ, ᎦᏰᏥᏙᎵᏍᏗᏉ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᎩᎶᏍᎩᏂ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎠᏐᏢᎢᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎥᏝ ᎦᏰᏥᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft And whosoever shall speak a word against the Son of man, it shall be forgiven him: but unto him that blasphemeth against the Holy Ghost it shall not be forgiven.

\ln Ale digalawiisdiyi detsatinohihesdi, ale nunigvwiyusadegiyi, ale unigvwiyuhiyi, tlesdi yitselihisgesdi nusdv ale iyusdi gesv itsadanetsediyi, ale itsiwesdiyi;
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᏕᏣᏘᏃᎯᎮᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᎬᏫᏳᎯᏱ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏤᎵᎯᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏣᏓᏁᏤᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏥᏪᏍᏗᏱ;
\ft And when they bring you unto the synagogues, and unto magistrates, and powers, take ye no thought how or what thing ye shall answer, or what ye shall say:

\ln Galvquodiyuyeno Adanvdo datseyoni nahiyu gesv itsiwesdiyi.
\syll ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳᏰᏃ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᏓᏤᏲᏂ ᏀᎢᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏥᏪᏍᏗᏱ.
\ft For the Holy Ghost shall teach you in the same hour what ye ought to say.

\ln Asiyvwino nasgi unadatlugv hia nuweselei, Tadeyohvsgi, hinetsi tsosdadanvtli tali iyoginidisdiyi tsugvwalodi utiyvhi.
\syll ᎠᏏᏴᏫᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏔᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ, ᎯᏁᏥ ᏦᏍᏓᏓᏅᏟ ᏔᎵ ᎢᏲᎩᏂᏗᏍᏗᏱ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎤᏘᏴᎯ.
\ft And one of the company said unto him, Master, speak to my brother, that he divide the inheritance with me.

\ln Hiano nuweselei, Hisgaya, gago disdvyugodanehi ale isdvyadohehi naquvnelv?
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎯᏍᎦᏯ, ᎦᎪ ᏗᏍᏛᏳᎪᏓᏁᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏍᏛᏯᏙᎮᎯ ᎾᏋᏁᎸ?
\ft And he said unto him, Man, who made me a judge or a divider over you?

\ln Ale hia niduweselei, Itseyadotsehesdi tsugvwalodi agvvhisdi gesvi; yvwiyeno gvnv vtla utsati uhnav yulisdelvdodi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎢᏤᏯᏙᏤᎮᏍᏗ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎠᎬᎥᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᏴᏫᏰᏃ ᎬᏅ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᎿᎥ ᏳᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ.
\ft And he said unto them, Take heed, and beware of covetousness: for a man's life consisteth not in the abundance of the things which he possesseth.

\ln Dutlilosdaneleno hia niduweselei, Gilo iyusdi uwehnai asgaya ulogesv utsati udvsvnelei;
\syll ᏚᏟᎶᏍᏓᏁᎴᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᏪᎿᎢ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᎶᎨᏒ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᏛᏒᏁᎴᎢ;
\ft And he spake a parable unto them, saying, The ground of a certain rich man brought forth plentifully:

\ln Udanvteleno uwasv tsudanvdvi, hia nuwesei, Gado dagadvneli, vtlayeno yeli yudlanvdv agidiyi aquadvhiselvhi.
\syll ᎤᏓᏅᏖᎴᏃ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏧᏓᏅᏛᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎦᏙ ᏓᎦᏛᏁᎵ, ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᏰᎵ ᏳᏜᏅᏛ ᎠᎩᏗᏱ ᎠᏆᏛᎯᏎᎸᎯ.
\ft And he thought within himself, saying, What shall I do, because I have no room where to bestow my fruits?

\ln Hiano nuwesei; Hia nvdagadvneli; dodatsiyostani aginvdiyi dadanelvi, tsudvnidino dadaganesgehi; nahnano datsini nigadv aquadvhiselvhi ale aginavi.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎯᎠ ᏅᏓᎦᏛᏁᎵ; ᏙᏓᏥᏲᏍᏔᏂ ᎠᎩᏅᏗᏱ ᏓᏓᏁᎸᎢ, ᏧᏛᏂᏗᏃ ᏓᏓᎦᏁᏍᎨᎯ; ᏀᎾᏃ ᏓᏥᏂ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎠᏆᏛᎯᏎᎸᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎩᎾᎥᎢ.
\ft And he said, This will I do: I will pull down my barns, and build greater; and there will I bestow all my fruits and my goods.

\ln Hiano nvdatsiweseli aquadanvdo; Aquadanvdogi, utsata tsasquanigodi tsugvwalodi utsati itsudetiyvdi tsalisdelvdodi; hatsawesolvsda, halisdayvhvsgesdi, haditasgesdi, haliheligesdi.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏅᏓᏥᏪᏎᎵ ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏙ; ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏙᎩ, ᎤᏣᏔ ᏣᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎢᏧᏕᏘᏴᏗ ᏣᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ; ᎭᏣᏪᏐᎸᏍᏓ, ᎭᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎭᏗᏔᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎭᎵᎮᎵᎨᏍᏗ.
\ft And I will say to my soul, Soul, thou hast much goods laid up for many years; take thine ease, eat, drink, and be merry.

\ln Aseno Unelanvhi hia nuweselei; Titsadanvdvna, gohiquo usvi tsadanvdo dayetsayanvsvli; gagono utseli gesesdi nasgi tsitsadanelanv.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᏘᏣᏓᏅᏛᎾ, ᎪᎯᏉ ᎤᏒᎢ ᏣᏓᏅᏙ ᏓᏰᏣᏯᏅᏒᎵ; ᎦᎪᏃ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏣᏓᏁᎳᏅ.
\ft But God said unto him, Thou fool, this night thy soul shall be required of thee: then whose shall those things be, which thou hast provided?

\ln Nasgi hia nusdi gilo tsadadatlisaneho tsugvwalodi uwasv utseliga, Unelanvhiyino iditlv nuwehnavna tsigesoi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏍᏗ ᎩᎶ ᏣᏓᏓᏟᏌᏁᎰ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏱᏃ ᎢᏗᏢ ᏄᏪᎿᎥᎾ ᏥᎨᏐᎢ.
\ft So is he that layeth up treasure for himself, and is not rich toward God.

\ln Hiano niduwesele Gvwasdawadidohi, nasgi iyusdi hia nitsvweseha, Tlesdi yitselihisgesdi detsvnvi, iyusdi itsalisdayvdiyi; ale ditsiyelvi, iyusdi ditsanuwosdiyi.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏤᎵᎯᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏕᏨᏅᎢ, ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ; ᎠᎴ ᏗᏥᏰᎸᎢ, ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏗᏣᏄᏬᏍᏗᏱ.
\ft And he said unto his disciples, Therefore I say unto you, Take no thought for your life, what ye shall eat; neither for the body, what ye shall put on.

\ln Agvnv utlihiyu esgaquo alisdayvdi, ale ayelv utlihiyu esgaquo dinuwo.
\syll ᎠᎬᏅ ᎤᏟᎯᏳ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏰᎸ ᎤᏟᎯᏳ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᏗᏄᏬ.
\ft The life is more than meat, and the body is more than raiment.

\ln Golanv ditsadanvdvli; vtlayeno yaniwisgoi, vtla ale yanisgudesgoi; vtla ale tsunadananvdiyi ale uninvdiyi yidadanelv; ale Unelanvhi degelohoi.  Nigav utli netsilvquodi nihi esgaquo tsisqua.
\syll ᎪᎳᏅ ᏗᏣᏓᏅᏛᎵ; ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᏯᏂᏫᏍᎪᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᏯᏂᏍᎫᏕᏍᎪᎢ; ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᏧᎾᏓᎾᏅᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏅᏗᏱ ᏱᏓᏓᏁᎸ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏕᎨᎶᎰᎢ.  ᏂᎦᎥ ᎤᏟ ᏁᏥᎸᏉᏗ ᏂᎯ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᏥᏍᏆ.
\ft Consider the ravens: for they neither sow nor reap; which neither have storehouse nor barn; and God feedeth them: how much more are ye better than the fowls?

\ln Gagono hia tsinitsadvnv uwelihisgvquo teli yiganvhida gvnvi saquo iyagiyusquidv.
\syll ᎦᎪᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᏣᏛᏅ ᎤᏪᎵᎯᏍᎬᏉ ᏖᎵ ᏱᎦᏅᎯᏓ ᎬᏅᎢ ᏌᏉ ᎢᏯᎩᏳᏍᏈᏛ.
\ft And which of you with taking thought can add to his stature one cubit?

\ln Iyuno nasgi usdikani gesv yeli igetsadvnedi nigesvna yigi, gadono asi nvwadale witselihisgoi?
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏍᏗᎧᏂ ᎨᏒ ᏰᎵ ᎢᎨᏣᏛᏁᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏱᎩ, ᎦᏙᏃ ᎠᏏ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᏫᏤᎵᎯᏍᎪᎢ?
\ft If ye then be not able to do that thing which is least, why take ye thought for the rest?

\ln Ditsadanvdvli tsutsilvhi dadvsgvi; Vtla yidunilvwisdanehoi, vtla ale yanisdohoi; aseno hia nitsvweseha, nasquo Solimanv nigav uwoduhiyu gesv vtla nasgi yinusde dunuwavi hia nasgi saquo nusdvi.
\syll ᏗᏣᏓᏅᏛᎵ ᏧᏥᎸᎯ ᏓᏛᏍᎬᎢ; ᎥᏝ ᏱᏚᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎰᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᏯᏂᏍᏙᎰᎢ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ, ᎾᏍᏉ ᏐᎵᎹᏅ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎤᏬᏚᎯᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎥᏝ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᏄᏍᏕ ᏚᏄᏩᎥᎢ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏌᏉ ᏄᏍᏛᎢ.
\ft Consider the lilies how they grow: they toil not, they spin not; and yet I say unto you, that Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these.

\ln Iyuyeno Unelanvhi nasgi yinigvneha yiganuwoha kanesga, nasgi gohi iga tlogesi tseha, ugitsvnvno digadudiyi wonadinvdi tsigi, utlihiyusgini nihi nidodatsinuwoi usdi itsohiyuhi!
\syll ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᏂᎬᏁᎭ ᏱᎦᏄᏬᎭ ᎧᏁᏍᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᎯ ᎢᎦ ᏠᎨᏏ ᏤᎭ, ᎤᎩᏨᏅᏃ ᏗᎦᏚᏗᏱ ᏬᎾᏗᏅᏗ ᏥᎩ, ᎤᏟᎯᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᏂᎯ ᏂᏙᏓᏥᏄᏬᎢ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎢᏦᎯᏳᎯ
\ft If then God so clothe the grass, which is to day in the field, and to morrow is cast into the oven; how much more will he clothe you, O ye of little faith?

\ln Ale tlesdi nihi yitsiyohesdi iyusdi itsalisdayvdiyi, ale iyusdi itsaditasdiyi, ale tlesdi tsutlvwidv yinidusdesdi detsadanvdvi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏂᎯ ᏱᏥᏲᎮᏍᏗ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏣᏗᏔᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏧᏢᏫᏛ ᏱᏂᏚᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᏕᏣᏓᏅᏛᎢ.
\ft And seek not ye what ye shall eat, or what ye shall drink, neither be ye of doubtful mind.

\ln Nasgiyeno nigadv hia tsunadalenvdv yvwi elohi danewadisv uniyohoi; Itsidodano agataho nasgi hia tsudalenvdv itsinigvgvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎯᎠ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏓᏁᏩᏗᏒ ᎤᏂᏲᎰᎢ; ᎢᏥᏙᏓᏃ ᎠᎦᏔᎰ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎢᏥᏂᎬᎬᎢ.
\ft For all these things do the nations of the world seek after: and your Father knoweth that ye have need of these things.

\ln Itsiyohesdisgini Unelanvhi ugvwiyuhi gesvi; nasgino hia nigadv tsudalenvdv etsatloyasdanedi gesesdi.
\syll ᎢᏥᏲᎮᏍᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎡᏣᏠᏯᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft But rather seek ye the kingdom of God; and all these things shall be added unto you.

\ln Tlesdi yitsisgaihesdi itsigayoli awi; Itsidodayeno osiyu uyelvha itsinediyi ugvwiyuhi gesvi.
\syll ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏥᏍᎦᎢᎮᏍᏗ ᎢᏥᎦᏲᎵ ᎠᏫ; ᎢᏥᏙᏓᏰᏃ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎤᏰᎸᎭ ᎢᏥᏁᏗᏱ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Fear not, little flock; for it is your Father's good pleasure to give you the kingdom.

\ln Itsinadegesdi itsihnavi ale itsadanelvvsgesdi; itsadanelesdi degalodi niduwetagvna, tsugvwalodi galvladi witsitlisisgesdi adisvhvsgi nigesvna, nahna wigvwaluhisdi nigesvna ganosgisgi, ale tsisgoya wigvwayosdodi nigesvna.
\syll ᎢᏥᎾᏕᎨᏍᏗ ᎢᏥᎿᎥᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏣᏓᏁᎸᎥᏍᎨᏍᏗ; ᎢᏣᏓᏁᎴᏍᏗ ᏕᎦᎶᏗ ᏂᏚᏪᏔᎬᎾ, ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏫᏥᏟᏏᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᏗᏒᎲᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᏀᎾ ᏫᎬᏩᎷᎯᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎦᏃᏍᎩᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᏍᎪᏯ ᏫᎬᏩᏲᏍᏙᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.
\ft Sell that ye have, and give alms; provide yourselves bags which wax not old, a treasure in the heavens that faileth not, where no thief approacheth, neither moth corrupteth.

\ln Nahnayeno witsihv tsugvwalodi, nahna nasquo widahesdi ditsinawi.
\syll ᏀᎾᏰᏃ ᏫᏥᎲ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ, ᏀᎾ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏫᏓᎮᏍᏗ ᏗᏥᎾᏫ.
\ft For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.

\ln Detsadatlohesdi, detsitsvsdvno dadaweligisgesdi.
\syll ᏕᏣᏓᏠᎮᏍᏗ, ᏕᏥᏨᏍᏛᏃ ᏓᏓᏪᎵᎩᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
\ft Let your loins be girded about, and your lights burning;

\ln Itsvsvno detsatselesdi anisgaya nasgi tsanigatiyo uninvsidohi, iyuquo uluhisdiyi degegatsvsdisgv wuwedolvhi; nasgino yulutsv ale yuwanilv, nasgi gilaquo iyvdv wigvwasduiediyi.
\syll ᎢᏨᏒᏃ ᏕᏣᏤᎴᏍᏗ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏣᏂᎦᏘᏲ ᎤᏂᏅᏏᏙᎯ, ᎢᏳᏉ ᎤᎷᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏕᎨᎦᏨᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᏭᏪᏙᎸᎯ; ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏳᎷᏨ ᎠᎴ ᏳᏩᏂᎸ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎩᎳᏉ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏫᎬᏩᏍᏚᎢᎡᏗᏱ.
\ft And ye yourselves like unto men that wait for their lord, when he will return from the wedding; that when he cometh and knocketh, they may open unto him immediately.

\ln Osiyu iyunalisdanedi nasgi getsinvsidasdi, uninvsidohi galutsvha dawadvhvha aniyawisgvi; udohiyuhiya itsayoseha dvdatloli uwasv, ale dodakanetseli unanitlvdiyi [unalisdayvdiyi,] ale dagalutsi dodvsdelvhi.
\syll ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ, ᎤᏂᏅᏏᏙᎯ ᎦᎷᏨᎭ ᏓᏩᏛᎲᎭ ᎠᏂᏯᏫᏍᎬᎢ; ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎢᏣᏲᏎᎭ ᏛᏓᏠᎵ ᎤᏩᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᏙᏓᎧᏁᏤᎵ ᎤᎾᏂᏢᏗᏱ ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ,data is invalid ᎠᎴ ᏓᎦᎷᏥ ᏙᏛᏍᏕᎸᎯ.
\ft Blessed are those servants, whom the lord when he cometh shall find watching: verily I say unto you, that he shall gird himself, and make them to sit down to meat, and will come forth and serve them.

\ln Iyuno taline ayawisdiyi gesv yulutsv, ale tsoine ayawisdiyi gesv yulutsv, ale yiduwadvhv nasgi nanadvnehvi, osiyu iyunalisdanedi nasgi getsinvsidasdi.
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎠᏯᏫᏍᏗᏱ ᎨᏒ ᏳᎷᏨ, ᎠᎴ ᏦᎢᏁ ᎠᏯᏫᏍᏗᏱ ᎨᏒ ᏳᎷᏨ, ᎠᎴ ᏱᏚᏩᏛᎲ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᎾᏛᏁᎲᎢ, ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ.
\ft And if he shall come in the second watch, or come in the third watch, and find them so, blessed are those servants.

\ln Hiano nasgi itsigatahesdi, nasgi iyu ganela yagatahe iyutlilodv aliyeilisv digalutsisv ganosgisgi, yuyawisei, ale vtla wagiyvsi adanelv yigvwelisei.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎮᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳ ᎦᏁᎳ ᏯᎦᏔᎮ ᎢᏳᏟᎶᏛ ᎠᎵᏰᎢᎵᏒ ᏗᎦᎷᏥᏒ ᎦᏃᏍᎩᏍᎩ, ᏳᏯᏫᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᏩᎩᏴᏏ ᎠᏓᏁᎸ ᏱᎬᏪᎵᏎᎢ.
\ft And this know, that if the goodman of the house had known what hour the thief would come, he would have watched, and not have suffered his house to be broken through.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi nihi nasquo itsadvnvisdesdi; yvwiyeno Uwetsi dagalutsi iyuquo aliyeilisv nitselisgvna gesvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏂᎯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎢᏣᏛᏅᎢᏍᏕᏍᏗ; ᏴᏫᏰᏃ ᎤᏪᏥ ᏓᎦᎷᏥ ᎢᏳᏉ ᎠᎵᏰᎢᎵᏒ ᏂᏤᎵᏍᎬᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Be ye therefore ready also: for the Son of man cometh at an hour when ye think not.

\ln Quidano hia nuweselei, Tsagvwiyuhi, ayvsgo hia nasgi desgiyatlilosdaneha, nigadvquoge?
\syll ᏈᏓᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎠᏴᏍᎪ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏕᏍᎩᏯᏟᎶᏍᏓᏁᎭ, ᏂᎦᏛᏉᎨ?
\ft Then Peter said unto him, Lord, speakest thou this parable unto us, or even to all?

\ln Ugvwiyuhino hia nuwesei, Gagono nasgi na osdv ale agatanai adanelv atsigatidisdi, nasgi unvsidohi nugvwiyusadegi nvdayuwaneli ganelvi, nasgi tsunediyi unalisdayvdi nidasqualvhisvi?
\syll ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎦᎪᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎦᏔᎾᎢ ᎠᏓᏁᎸ ᎠᏥᎦᏘᏗᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏅᏏᏙᎯ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ ᏅᏓᏳᏩᏁᎵ ᎦᏁᎸᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏁᏗᏱ ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗ ᏂᏓᏍᏆᎸᎯᏒᎢ?
\ft And the Lord said, Who then is that faithful and wise steward, whom his lord shall make ruler over his household, to give them their portion of meat in due season?

\ln Osiyu iyulisdanedi nasgi na atsinvsidasdi, nasgi unvsidohi galutsvha uwadvhv nasgi nadvnehvi.
\syll ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏅᏏᏙᎯ ᎦᎷᏨᎭ ᎤᏩᏛᎲ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏛᏁᎲᎢ.
\ft Blessed is that servant, whom his lord when he cometh shall find so doing.

\ln Udohiyuhiya itsvyoseha, nasgi ugvwiyusadegi nvdayuwaneli nigav uhnavi.
\syll ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎢᏨᏲᏎᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ ᏅᏓᏳᏩᏁᎵ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎤᎿᎥᎢ.
\ft Of a truth I say unto you, that he will make him ruler over all that he hath.

\ln Iyusgini nasgi na atsinvsidasdi hia nigawesv unawiyi, Aginvsidohi gohidiha uluhisdiyi; ale alenvhvha dogalivnihesdi anisgaya ale anigeyv getsinvsidasdi, ale alisdayvhvsgesdi ale aditasgesdi, ale uyvsdesgesdi;
\syll ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᏒ ᎤᎾᏫᏱ, ᎠᎩᏅᏏᏙᎯ ᎪᎯᏗᎭ ᎤᎷᎯᏍᏗᏱ; ᎠᎴ ᎠᎴᏅᎲᎭ ᏙᎦᎵᎥᏂᎮᏍᏗ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᎨᏴ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏗᏔᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏴᏍᏕᏍᎨᏍᏗ;
\ft But and if that servant say in his heart, My lord delayeth his coming; and shall begin to beat the menservants and maidens, and to eat and drink, and to be drunken;

\ln Nasgi na atsinvsidasdi unvsidohi dagalutsi iyuquo iga nadagatenohvna gesvi, ale iyuquo aliyeilisv nelisgvna gesvi, ale dodayugalisi, ale wvdayuseheli nunohiyusvna dinehvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎤᏅᏏᏙᎯ ᏓᎦᎷᏥ ᎢᏳᏉ ᎢᎦ ᎾᏓᎦᏖᏃᎲᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏳᏉ ᎠᎵᏰᎢᎵᏒ ᏁᎵᏍᎬᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏙᏓᏳᎦᎵᏏ, ᎠᎴ ᏮᏓᏳᏎᎮᎵ ᏄᏃᎯᏳᏒᎾ ᏗᏁᎲᎢ.
\ft The lord of that servant will come in a day when he looketh not for him, and at an hour when he is not aware, and will cut him in sunder, and will appoint him his portion with the unbelievers.

\ln Nasgino na atsinvsidasdi agatahi nusdv udulisgv unvsidohi, ale nudvnvistanvna igesesdi, ale nasgiya nusdv udulisgv nudvnelvna igesesdi, utsati iyagvnisdi gesesdi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ Ꮎ ᎠᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎠᎦᏔᎯ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎬ ᎤᏅᏏᏙᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏄᏛᏅᎢᏍᏔᏅᎾ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎬ ᏄᏛᏁᎸᎾ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎤᏣᏘ ᎢᏯᎬᏂᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft And that servant, which knew his lord's will, and prepared not himself, neither did according to his will, shall be beaten with many stripes.

\ln Nasgini nagatahvna gesv ale yeliquo gayetsilivnisdi iyudvnelvhi gesesdi nasgi gayoliquo iyagvnisdi gesesdi.  Yilono utsati atsinelvhi, utsati atsitayosedi gesesdi; ale gilo utsati digvwayohiselvhi yvwi, nasgi utli igai gvwatayosedi gesesdi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏂ ᎾᎦᏔᎲᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏰᎵᏉ ᎦᏰᏥᎵᎥᏂᏍᏗ ᎢᏳᏛᏁᎸᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏲᎵᏉ ᎢᏯᎬᏂᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.  ᏱᎶᏃ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎠᏥᏁᎸᎯ, ᎤᏣᏘ ᎠᏥᏔᏲᏎᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏗᎬᏩᏲᎯᏎᎸᎯ ᏴᏫ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏟ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎬᏩᏔᏲᏎᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft But he that knew not, and did commit things worthy of stripes, shall be beaten with few stripes. For unto whomsoever much is given, of him shall be much required: and to whom men have committed much, of him they will ask the more.

\ln Agilutsilv nasgi iyaquvnisodiyi atsilv gadohi uluhisdiyi; ale gado yaquadula iyuno gayula yutsistla?
\syll ᎠᎩᎷᏥᎸ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏯᏋᏂᏐᏗᏱ ᎠᏥᎸ ᎦᏙᎯ ᎤᎷᎯᏍᏗᏱ; ᎠᎴ ᎦᏙ ᏯᏆᏚᎳ ᎢᏳᏃ ᎦᏳᎳ ᏳᏥᏍᏝ?
\ft I am come to send fire on the earth; and what will I if it be already kindled?

\ln Aseno agiha adawosdi gesv vquawosdodi; ale nigav uwelihisdi aquadanvta gvni alisquadvha!
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᎩᎭ ᎠᏓᏬᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎥᏆᏬᏍᏙᏗ; ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎤᏪᎵᎯᏍᏗ ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏔ ᎬᏂ ᎠᎵᏍᏆᏛᎭ
\ft But I have a baptism to be baptized with; and how am I straitened till it be accomplished!

\ln Tsisa nvwadohiyadv dunelilv elohi sgiyeliseha?  Vtla itsvyoseha; taliquosgini iyunadadisdiyi;
\syll ᏥᏌ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᏚᏁᎵᎸ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏍᎩᏰᎵᏎᎭ?  ᎥᏝ ᎢᏨᏲᏎᎭ; ᏔᎵᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᏳᎾᏓᏗᏍᏗᏱ;
\ft Suppose ye that I am come to give peace on earth? I tell you, Nay; but rather division:

\ln Gohiyeno iyudalenvdv sidanelvhi gesv hisgi iyanidv tali nunadaesdi, tsoi iyanidv unaligosesdi anitali dunatludesdi, ale anitali unaligosesdi tsoi dunatludesdi.
\syll ᎪᎯᏰᏃ ᎢᏳᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏏᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎯᏍᎩ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᏔᎵ ᏄᎾᏓᎡᏍᏗ, ᏦᎢ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᎤᎾᎵᎪᏎᏍᏗ ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᏚᎾᏡᏕᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᎤᎾᎵᎪᏎᏍᏗ ᏦᎢ ᏚᎾᏡᏕᏍᏗ.
\ft For from henceforth there shall be five in one house divided, three against two, and two against three.

\ln Agayvligei tali nunadaesdi asgaya uwetsi, aganvgino asgaya tali nunadaesdi udoda; ale ageyv tali nunadaesdi ageyv uwetsi, ale aganvgi ageyv tali nunadaesdi utsi; utsohino tali nunadaesdi udatsohiya, ale udatsohiya tali nunadaesdi utsohi.
\syll ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ ᏔᎵ ᏄᎾᏓᎡᏍᏗ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᏪᏥ, ᎠᎦᏅᎩᏃ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᏔᎵ ᏄᎾᏓᎡᏍᏗ ᎤᏙᏓ; ᎠᎴ ᎠᎨᏴ ᏔᎵ ᏄᎾᏓᎡᏍᏗ ᎠᎨᏴ ᎤᏪᏥ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎦᏅᎩ ᎠᎨᏴ ᏔᎵ ᏄᎾᏓᎡᏍᏗ ᎤᏥ; ᎤᏦᎯᏃ ᏔᎵ ᏄᎾᏓᎡᏍᏗ ᎤᏓᏦᎯᏯ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᏦᎯᏯ ᏔᎵ ᏄᎾᏓᎡᏍᏗ ᎤᏦᎯ.
\ft The father shall be divided against the son, and the son against the father; the mother against the daughter, and the daughter against the mother; the mother in law against her daughter in law, and the daughter in law against her mother in law.

\ln Ale nasquo hia niduwesele yvwi, Ulogilv itsigowadv nvdo wudeligv dagalohi, gilaquo iyvdv hia nitsiwesgoi, ama dvyeili; nasgino nigalisdisgoi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴ ᏴᏫ, ᎤᎶᎩᎸ ᎢᏥᎪᏩᏛ ᏅᏙ ᏭᏕᎵᎬ ᏓᎦᎶᎯ, ᎩᎳᏉ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏥᏪᏍᎪᎢ, ᎠᎹ ᏛᏰᎢᎵ; ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᏍᎪᎢ.
\ft And he said also to the people, When ye see a cloud rise out of the west, straightway ye say, There cometh a shower; and so it is.

\ln Ale itsadolehohi tsuganawv diganolvdisgvi, hia nitsiwesgoi, Udilegiyu gesesdi; ale nasgi nigalisdisgoi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎢᏣᏙᎴᎰᎯ ᏧᎦᎾᏮ ᏗᎦᏃᎸᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᏥᏪᏍᎪᎢ, ᎤᏗᎴᎩᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᏍᎪᎢ.
\ft And when ye see the south wind blow, ye say, There will be heat; and it cometh to pass.

\ln Itsatlonasdi!  yeliquo itsadolehosgo nusdv galvladi, ale elohi; gadono digalisdodiha nitsadolehosgvna tsigi gohi gesvi?
\syll ᎢᏣᏠᎾᏍᏗ  ᏰᎵᏉ ᎢᏣᏙᎴᎰᏍᎪ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎡᎶᎯ; ᎦᏙᏃ ᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᏂᏣᏙᎴᎰᏍᎬᎾ ᏥᎩ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ?
\ft Ye hypocrites, ye can discern the face of the sky and of the earth; but how is it that ye do not discern this time?

\ln Ale gadono itsvsv gesv digetsugododi nigesvna igi duyugodv gesvi?
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎦᏙᏃ ᎢᏨᏒ ᎨᏒ ᏗᎨᏧᎪᏙᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᎩ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ?
\ft Yea, and why even of yourselves judge ye not what is right?

\ln Iyuno tsayilidohi digugodisgiyi sdaisesdi, asiquo wisdaisvi, hatlinigvnelvha hiyadulilaediyi; digugodisgiyi nasi wiyitsatinoga, digugodisgino didaniyisgiyi wiyidetsayohi, didaniyisgino didasdudiyi wiyitsayvda.
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᏣᏱᎵᏙᎯ ᏗᎫᎪᏗᏍᎩᏱ ᏍᏓᎢᏎᏍᏗ, ᎠᏏᏉ ᏫᏍᏓᎢᏒᎢ, ᎭᏟᏂᎬᏁᎸᎭ ᎯᏯᏚᎵᎳᎡᏗᏱ; ᏗᎫᎪᏗᏍᎩᏱ ᎾᏏ ᏫᏱᏣᏘᏃᎦ, ᏗᎫᎪᏗᏍᎩᏃ ᏗᏓᏂᏱᏍᎩᏱ ᏫᏱᏕᏣᏲᎯ, ᏗᏓᏂᏱᏍᎩᏃ ᏗᏓᏍᏚᏗᏱ ᏫᏱᏣᏴᏓ.
\ft When thou goest with thine adversary to the magistrate, as thou art in the way, give diligence that thou mayest be delivered from him; lest he hale thee to the judge, and the judge deliver thee to the officer, and the officer cast thee into prison.

\ln Gvyoseha, vtla nahna yvdvgahinugoi, gvni tsaguyvhesdi ulisqualvdi aginudvdi iyadanvtedi.
\syll ᎬᏲᏎᎭ, ᎥᏝ ᏀᎾ ᏴᏛᎦᎯᏄᎪᎢ, ᎬᏂ ᏣᎫᏴᎮᏍᏗ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᎸᏗ ᎠᎩᏄᏛᏗ ᎢᏯᏓᏅᏖᏗ.
\ft I tell thee, thou shalt not depart thence, till thou hast paid the very last mite.

\ln Nasgino anedohe gilo gvwanonelvhi gvwaneisdanelvhi Gelili anehi, nasgi unigigv Queledi dusuyedanelv atsilvanelohvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎠᏁᏙᎮ ᎩᎶ ᎬᏩᏃᏁᎸᎯ ᎬᏩᏁᎢᏍᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᎨᎵᎵ ᎠᏁᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᎩᎬ ᏇᎴᏗ ᏚᏑᏰᏓᏁᎸ ᎠᏥᎸᎠᏁᎶᎲᎢ.
\ft There were present at that season some that told him of the Galilaeans, whose blood Pilate had mingled with their sacrifices.

\ln Tsisano dunetsele hia niduweselei, Itsadanvtesgvsgo hia nasgi Gelili anehi tsunigonadvtanvhi gese anisganahiyu gesv nigadv Gelili anehi, nvdigalisdodiha nasgi tsinunalisdanelei?
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᏚᏁᏤᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬᏍᎪ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᎵᎵ ᎠᏁᎯ ᏧᏂᎪᎾᏛᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏎ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏀᎢᏳ ᎨᏒ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎨᎵᎵ ᎠᏁᎯ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏄᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᎴᎢ?
\ft And Jesus answering said unto them, Suppose ye that these Galilaeans were sinners above all the Galilaeans, because they suffered such things?

\ln Vtla itsvyoseha; nihisgini niditsinetliyvsvna igesesdi detsadanvdvi, nigadv nasgiya datsadisvni.
\syll ᎥᏝ ᎢᏨᏲᏎᎭ; ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᏂᏗᏥᏁᏟᏴᏒᎾ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏕᏣᏓᏅᏛᎢ, ᏂᎦᏛ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏓᏣᏗᏒᏂ.
\ft I tell you, Nay: but, except ye repent, ye shall all likewise perish.

\ln Ale na neladu iyanidv Salomi invigati adanelv tsunasonei, ale tsidunilei, tsigo itsadanvtesgv tsunigonadvtanvhi gese anisganahiyu gesv nigadv Tsilusilimi anehi?
\syll ᎠᎴ Ꮎ ᏁᎳᏚ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᏌᎶᎻ ᎢᏅᎢᎦᏘ ᎠᏓᏁᎸ ᏧᎾᏐᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᏚᏂᎴᎢ, ᏥᎪ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ ᏧᏂᎪᎾᏛᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏎ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏀᎢᏳ ᎨᏒ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᎠᏁᎯ?
\ft Or those eighteen, upon whom the tower in Siloam fell, and slew them, think ye that they were sinners above all men that dwelt in Jerusalem?

\ln Vtla itsvyoseha; nihisgini niditsinetliyvsvna igesesdi detsadanvdvi, nigadv nasgiya dawadisvni.
\syll ᎥᏝ ᎢᏨᏲᏎᎭ; ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᏂᏗᏥᏁᏟᏴᏒᎾ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏕᏣᏓᏅᏛᎢ, ᏂᎦᏛ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏓᏩᏗᏒᏂ.
\ft I tell you, Nay: but, except ye repent, ye shall all likewise perish.

\ln Hia nasquo nuwese dutlilosdanelei; Gilo iyusdi, egataiyusdi tlugv uwise telvladi duwisvi; ulutseno uyole udatanvhi, ale vtla yuwadvhei.
\syll ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏄᏪᏎ ᏚᏟᎶᏍᏓᏁᎴᎢ; ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᎡᎦᏔᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏡᎬ ᎤᏫᏎ ᏖᎸᎳᏗ ᏚᏫᏒᎢ; ᎤᎷᏤᏃ ᎤᏲᎴ ᎤᏓᏔᏅᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᏳᏩᏛᎮᎢ.
\ft He spake also this parable; A certain man had a fig tree planted in his vineyard; and he came and sought fruit thereon, and found none.

\ln Hnaquono hia nuwesele osdv iyuwahnadegi telvladi duwisvi, Gvniyuquo, hnaquo tsoi nadetiyv tsilugvgi agiyohvgi udatanvhi hia nasgi egataiyusdi tlugvi, ale vtla yitsiwatiha; hileyvsda; gadono iugedi gadohi?
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎢᏳᏩᎿᏕᎩ ᏖᎸᎳᏗ ᏚᏫᏒᎢ, ᎬᏂᏳᏉ, ᎿᏉ ᏦᎢ ᎾᏕᏘᏴ ᏥᎷᎬᎩ ᎠᎩᏲᎲᎩ ᎤᏓᏔᏅᎯ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᎦᏔᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏡᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏥᏩᏘᎭ; ᎯᎴᏴᏍᏓ; ᎦᏙᏃ ᎢᎤᎨᏗ ᎦᏙᎯ?
\ft Then said he unto the dresser of his vineyard, Behold, these three years I come seeking fruit on this fig tree, and find none: cut it down; why cumbereth it the ground?

\ln Unetsvno hia nuweselei, Tsagvwiyuhi, unelagi hela gohi nasquo tsudetiyvsadi, gvni gasgosidolvha, ale osdv gada tsinvha.
\syll ᎤᏁᏨᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎤᏁᎳᎩ ᎮᎳ ᎪᎯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏧᏕᏘᏴᏌᏗ, ᎬᏂ ᎦᏍᎪᏏᏙᎸᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎦᏓ ᏥᏅᎭ.
\ft And he answering said unto him, Lord, let it alone this year also, till I shall dig about it, and dung it:

\ln Iyuno iadatanvha, unelagiquo gesesdi; iyuno nutanvna yigi, gila oni hileyvstanvha.
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᎢᎠᏓᏔᏅᎭ, ᎤᏁᎳᎩᏉ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᏄᏔᏅᎾ ᏱᎩ, ᎩᎳ ᎣᏂ ᎯᎴᏴᏍᏔᏅᎭ.
\ft And if it bear fruit, well: and if not, then after that thou shalt cut it down.

\ln Dadeyohvsgeno ilvhitlv adanelv digalawiisdiyi unadodaquasgvi;
\syll ᏓᏕᏲᎲᏍᎨᏃ ᎢᎸᎯᏢ ᎠᏓᏁᎸ ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᎾᏙᏓᏆᏍᎬᎢ;
\ft And he was teaching in one of the synagogues on the sabbath.

\ln Gvniyuquono nahna edohe ageyv adanvdo vyugi gotlvsgi uyai neladu iyudetiyvdv igvwalistanvhi gesei, ale udisadei, ale gvwatlisdv ulitsinohisdodiyi gesei.
\syll ᎬᏂᏳᏉᏃ ᏀᎾ ᎡᏙᎮ ᎠᎨᏴ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎥᏳᎩ ᎪᏢᏍᎩ ᎤᏯᎢ ᏁᎳᏚ ᎢᏳᏕᏘᏴᏛ ᎢᎬᏩᎵᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏗᏌᏕᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᏟᏍᏛ ᎤᎵᏥᏃᎯᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎨᏎᎢ.
\ft And, behold, there was a woman which had a spirit of infirmity eighteen years, and was bowed together, and could in no wise lift up herself.

\ln Tsisano ugohv wuyanvhei, ale hia nuweselei, Higeyv, tsatlvgv etsudalagi.
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᎪᎲ ᏭᏯᏅᎮᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎯᎨᏴ, ᏣᏢᎬ ᎡᏧᏓᎳᎩ.
\ft And when Jesus saw her, he called her to him, and said unto her, Woman, thou art loosed from thine infirmity.

\ln Dusitadeno; ale gilaquo iyvdv gatsinosdv nulistanei, ale ulvquotane Unelanvhi.
\syll ᏚᏏᏔᏕᏃ; ᎠᎴ ᎩᎳᏉ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎦᏥᏃᏍᏛ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎸᏉᏔᏁ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ.
\ft And he laid his hands on her: and immediately she was made straight, and glorified God.

\ln Digalawiisdiyino nugvwiyusadegi uhnalvhi unetsei, nvdigalisdodisge Tsisa udanvwanv unadodaquasgv iga; ale hia niduwesele yvwi, Sudali iga duyugodi tsunilvwisdanediyi yvwi; nahiyusgini itsilugesdi ale detsinvwisgesdi, tlesdino unadodaquasgv iga.
\syll ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱᏃ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ ᎤᎿᎸᎯ ᎤᏁᏤᎢ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨ ᏥᏌ ᎤᏓᏅᏩᏅ ᎤᎾᏙᏓᏆᏍᎬ ᎢᎦ; ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴ ᏴᏫ, ᏑᏓᎵ ᎢᎦ ᏚᏳᎪᏗ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᏴᏫ; ᏀᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᏥᎷᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏕᏥᏅᏫᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᏞᏍᏗᏃ ᎤᎾᏙᏓᏆᏍᎬ ᎢᎦ.
\ft And the ruler of the synagogue answered with indignation, because that Jesus had healed on the sabbath day, and said unto the people, There are six days in which men ought to work: in them therefore come and be healed, and not on the sabbath day.

\ln Ugvwiyuhino hnaquo unetsele hia nuweselei, Tsatlonasdi!  tlasgo nihi itsisiyvwiha gesv unadodaquasgv yetselisadesgo digelasdiyi itsatseli waga ale soquilidigalianvhidv, ale yetsatinego ama yetsaditastanegoi?
\syll ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᏃ ᎿᏉ ᎤᏁᏤᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏣᏠᎾᏍᏗ  ᏝᏍᎪ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏥᏏᏴᏫᎭ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎾᏙᏓᏆᏍᎬ ᏰᏤᎵᏌᏕᏍᎪ ᏗᎨᎳᏍᏗᏱ ᎢᏣᏤᎵ ᏩᎦ ᎠᎴ ᏐᏈᎵᏗᎦᎵᎠᏅᎯᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᏰᏣᏘᏁᎪ ᎠᎹ ᏰᏣᏗᏔᏍᏔᏁᎪᎢ?
\ft The Lord then answered him, and said, Thou hypocrite, doth not each one of you on the sabbath loose his ox or his ass from the stall, and lead him away to watering?

\ln Hiano ageyv Equahami uwetsi tsigi, nasgi Sedani hnaquo gvniyu neladu tsudediyvdv gvwalvlvhi tsigi, tlasgo yiduyugode unadodaquasgv agalvsvdiyi hia nasgi udalvsdvi?
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᎠᎨᏴ ᎡᏆᎭᎻ ᎤᏪᏥ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏎᏓᏂ ᎿᏉ ᎬᏂᏳ ᏁᎳᏚ ᏧᏕᏗᏴᏛ ᎬᏩᎸᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᏝᏍᎪ ᏱᏚᏳᎪᏕ ᎤᎾᏙᏓᏆᏍᎬ ᎠᎦᎸᏒᏗᏱ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏓᎸᏍᏛᎢ?
\ft And ought not this woman, being a daughter of Abraham, whom Satan hath bound, lo, these eighteen years, be loosed from this bond on the sabbath day?

\ln Nasgino hia nuwesv, nigadv digvwagadilegi unadehosei; nigadvno yvwi analihelige nvdigalisdodisge nigadv galvquodiyu nasgi deulvwisdanehvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒ, ᏂᎦᏛ ᏗᎬᏩᎦᏗᎴᎩ ᎤᎾᏕᎰᏎᎢ; ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᏴᏫ ᎠᎾᎵᎮᎵᎨ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏕᎤᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎢ.
\ft And when he had said these things, all his adversaries were ashamed: and all the people rejoiced for all the glorious things that were done by him.

\ln Hnaquono hia nuwesei, Gado datselv Unelanvhi ugvwiyuhi gesvi?  Ale gado dodagatlilostani?
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎦᏙ ᏓᏤᎸ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ?  ᎠᎴ ᎦᏙ ᏙᏓᎦᏟᎶᏍᏔᏂ?
\ft Then said he, Unto what is the kingdom of God like? and whereunto shall I resemble it?

\ln Atsilvugata datselv, nasgi asgaya tsugise ale uwisvdiyi tsiwudinvsei; ale udvsei, ale equohiyu nulistane tlugvi; ale tsisqua galvlo aninohilidohi duwanigalv unahadadei.
\syll ᎠᏥᎸᎤᎦᏔ ᏓᏤᎸ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᏧᎩᏎ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏫᏒᏗᏱ ᏥᏭᏗᏅᏎᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᏛᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎡᏉᎯᏳ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁ ᏡᎬᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᏥᏍᏆ ᎦᎸᎶ ᎠᏂᏃᎯᎵᏙᎯ ᏚᏩᏂᎦᎸ ᎤᏀᎠᏓᏕᎢ.
\ft It is like a grain of mustard seed, which a man took, and cast into his garden; and it grew, and waxed a great tree; and the fowls of the air lodged in the branches of it.

\ln Alewo hia nuwesei, gado dodagatlilostani Unelanvhi ugvwiyuhi gesvi?
\syll ᎠᎴᏬ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎦᏙ ᏙᏓᎦᏟᎶᏍᏔᏂ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ?
\ft And again he said, Whereunto shall I liken the kingdom of God?

\ln Agododi nasgiyai, nasgi ageyv tsugise ale tsusuyvne tsoi iyutlilodv isv galvi, gvni nigadv uwotisonv.
\syll ᎠᎪᏙᏗ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎨᏴ ᏧᎩᏎ ᎠᎴ ᏧᏑᏴᏁ ᏦᎢ ᎢᏳᏟᎶᏛ ᎢᏒ ᎦᎸᎢ, ᎬᏂ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎤᏬᏘᏐᏅ.
\ft It is like leaven, which a woman took and hid in three measures of meal, till the whole was leavened.

\ln Ugadvlesidoleno uwedole tsudvna degaduhv ale tsusdi degaduhvi, dadeyohvsgei, ale Tsilusilimi wagatei.
\syll ᎤᎦᏛᎴᏏᏙᎴᏃ ᎤᏪᏙᎴ ᏧᏛᎾ ᏕᎦᏚᎲ ᎠᎴ ᏧᏍᏗ ᏕᎦᏚᎲᎢ, ᏓᏕᏲᎲᏍᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᏩᎦᏖᎢ.
\ft And he went through the cities and villages, teaching, and journeying toward Jerusalem.

\ln Asiyvwino hia nuweselei, Tsagvwiyuhi, anigayoliquosgo getsisdelvdi gesesdi?  Hiano niduweselei,
\syll ᎠᏏᏴᏫᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎠᏂᎦᏲᎵᏉᏍᎪ ᎨᏥᏍᏕᎸᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ?  ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ,
\ft Then said one unto him, Lord, are there few that be saved? And he said unto them,

\ln Itsatlinigvnehesdi itsiyvsdiyi ayadoli galohisdiyi; unitsatiyeno, itsvyoseha, dayuniyoli uniyvsdiyi, ale vtla yeli wigvwaniyvsdi yigesesdi.
\syll ᎢᏣᏟᏂᎬᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᎢᏥᏴᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᏯᏙᎵ ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ; ᎤᏂᏣᏘᏰᏃ, ᎢᏨᏲᏎᎭ, ᏓᏳᏂᏲᎵ ᎤᏂᏴᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᏰᎵ ᏫᎬᏩᏂᏴᏍᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft Strive to enter in at the strait gate: for many, I say unto you, will seek to enter in, and shall not be able.

\ln Iyuno hnaquo Asgaya ganela dalenvha ale asdunvha galohisdiyi, nihino itsalenvhv doyiditlv itsidonavi, ale itsvnihesdi galohisdiyi hia nitsewesgesdi, Tsagvwiyuhi, Tsagvwiyuhi, esgisduisi; ale dikanetsv hia nvditsiweselvha, vtla yitsigataha ditsadalenvi;
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᎿᏉ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎦᏁᎳ ᏓᎴᏅᎭ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏍᏚᏅᎭ ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ, ᏂᎯᏃ ᎢᏣᎴᏅᎲ ᏙᏱᏗᏢ ᎢᏥᏙᎾᎥᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏨᏂᎮᏍᏗ ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏤᏪᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎡᏍᎩᏍᏚᎢᏏ; ᎠᎴ ᏗᎧᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏅᏗᏥᏪᏎᎸᎭ, ᎥᏝ ᏱᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᏗᏣᏓᎴᏅᎢ;
\ft When once the master of the house is risen up, and hath shut to the door, and ye begin to stand without, and to knock at the door, saying, Lord, Lord, open unto us; and he shall answer and say unto you, I know you not whence ye are:

\ln Hnaquo datsalenvhi hia nvdatsiwesi, Ogalisdayvnvgi ale ogaditahvgi higatahvi, ale detsadeyonvgi ogiduhv edasdiyi degalanvdvi.
\syll ᎿᏉ ᏓᏣᎴᏅᎯ ᎯᎠ ᏅᏓᏥᏪᏏ, ᎣᎦᎵᏍᏓᏴᏅᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎣᎦᏗᏔᎲᎩ ᎯᎦᏔᎲᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᏣᏕᏲᏅᎩ ᎣᎩᏚᎲ ᎡᏓᏍᏗᏱ ᏕᎦᎳᏅᏛᎢ.
\ft Then shall ye begin to say, We have eaten and drunk in thy presence, and thou hast taught in our streets.

\ln Aseno hia nvdagawesi, itsvyoseha, vtla yitsigataha ditsadalenvi; sgiyadanvsi, nitsiv uyo ditsilvwisdanehi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏅᏓᎦᏪᏏ, ᎢᏨᏲᏎᎭ, ᎥᏝ ᏱᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᏗᏣᏓᎴᏅᎢ; ᏍᎩᏯᏓᏅᏏ, ᏂᏥᎥ ᎤᏲ ᏗᏥᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ.
\ft But he shall say, I tell you, I know you not whence ye are; depart from me, all ye workers of iniquity.

\ln Nahna daniyvgesdi ale danilvdagisgesdi daninudogvi, nahiyu detsigohvha Equahami ale Esigi ale Tsegaqui ale nigadv anadolehosgi, Unelanvhi ugvwiyuhi gesv nahna aniyaesdi, itsvsvno etsinugowisvhi gesesdi.
\syll ᏀᎾ ᏓᏂᏴᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏓᏂᎸᏓᎩᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏓᏂᏄᏙᎬᎢ, ᏀᎢᏳ ᏕᏥᎪᎲᎭ ᎡᏆᎭᎻ ᎠᎴ ᎡᏏᎩ ᎠᎴ ᏤᎦᏈ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏀᎾ ᎠᏂᏯᎡᏍᏗ, ᎢᏨᏒᏃ ᎡᏥᏄᎪᏫᏒᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft There shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth, when ye shall see Abraham, and Isaac, and Jacob, and all the prophets, in the kingdom of God, and you yourselves thrust out.

\ln Dikalvgvno iditlv dinilosgesdi, ale wudeligvi, ale tsuyvtlvi, ale tsuganawvi, ale ananvvsgesdi Unelanvhi nahna ugvwiyuhi gesvi.
\syll ᏗᎧᎸᎬᏃ ᎢᏗᏢ ᏗᏂᎶᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏭᏕᎵᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏴᏢᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᎦᎾᏮᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎾᏅᎥᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏀᎾ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft And they shall come from the east, and from the west, and from the north, and from the south, and shall sit down in the kingdom of God.

\ln Ale gvniyuquo aneha oni tsigi, nasgi igvyi gesesdi, ale aneha igvyi tsigi, nasgi oni gesesidi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎠᏁᎭ ᎣᏂ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎬᏱ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏁᎭ ᎢᎬᏱ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏂ ᎨᏎᏏᏗ.
\ft And, behold, there are last which shall be first, and there are first which shall be last.

\ln Nahiyuquono iga gilo iyunasdi aniqualisi unilutse hia nigvwaweselei, Hinugoi, ale hadanvna ani; Elodv nasi uduli tsahisdiyi.
\syll ᏀᎢᏳᏉᏃ ᎢᎦ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗ ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏ ᎤᏂᎷᏤ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏩᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎯᏄᎪᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎭᏓᏅᎾ ᎠᏂ; ᎡᎶᏛ ᎾᏏ ᎤᏚᎵ ᏣᎯᏍᏗᏱ.
\ft The same day there came certain of the Pharisees, saying unto him, Get thee out, and depart hence: for Herod will kill thee.

\ln Hiano niduweselei, Itsena, ale hia winetsiwesi na gula, Gvniyuquo anisgina detsinugowisga, ale degadanvwiha gohi iga ale ugitsvnvi, tsoineno iga agisquadvhi gesesdi.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎢᏤᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏫᏁᏥᏪᏏ Ꮎ ᎫᎳ, ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎠᏂᏍᎩᎾ ᏕᏥᏄᎪᏫᏍᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᎦᏓᏅᏫᎭ ᎪᎯ ᎢᎦ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎩᏨᏅᎢ, ᏦᎢᏁᏃ ᎢᎦ ᎠᎩᏍᏆᏛᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft And he said unto them, Go ye, and tell that fox, Behold, I cast out devils, and I do cures to day and to morrow, and the third day I shall be perfected.

\ln Asesgininonv aquedasdi nigalisdiha gohi iga, ale ugitsvnvi, ale ugitsvdv; vtlayeno adolehosgi yeli ilvhitlv gayetsiisdi yigi, Tsilusilimi uwasv.
\syll ᎠᏎᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎠᏇᏓᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᎭ ᎪᎯ ᎢᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎩᏨᏅᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎩᏨᏛ; ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᏰᎵ ᎢᎸᎯᏢ ᎦᏰᏥᎢᏍᏗ ᏱᎩ, ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᎤᏩᏒ.
\ft Nevertheless I must walk to day, and to morrow, and the day following: for it cannot be that a prophet perish out of Jerusalem.

\ln Tsilusilimi!  Tsilusilimi!  anadolehosgi tihihi, ale nvya dvnisdisgi getsalutsediyi getsinvsvhi; yanogiyu aquadulisgv gatsiyatlisodiyi ditsetsi, nasgiya tsataga tsidegatlisisgo tsuwetsi anidv awiniditlv dikanogeni, aseno vtla yitsadulisgei!
\syll ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ  ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ  ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᏘᎯᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏅᏯ ᏛᏂᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᎨᏣᎷᏤᏗᏱ ᎨᏥᏅᏒᎯ; ᏯᏃᎩᏳ ᎠᏆᏚᎵᏍᎬ ᎦᏥᏯᏟᏐᏗᏱ ᏗᏤᏥ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏣᏔᎦ ᏥᏕᎦᏟᏏᏍᎪ ᏧᏪᏥ ᎠᏂᏛ ᎠᏫᏂᏗᏢ ᏗᎧᏃᎨᏂ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏣᏚᎵᏍᎨᎢ
\ft O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, which killest the prophets, and stonest them that are sent unto thee; how often would I have gathered thy children together, as a hen doth gather her brood under her wings, and ye would not!

\syll ᎤᏂᏣᏘᏃ ᏴᏫ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏛᏎᎢ; ᎤᎦᏔᎲᏒᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ,

\ln Gilo ayv agilutsehesdi nidiganiquatihvnano igesesdi udoda, ale utsi, ale udalii, ale tsuwetsi, ale analinvtli, ale tsudo, vv, ale uwasv nasquo gvnvi, vtla yeli agisdawadidohi yinvgalisda.
\syll ᎩᎶ ᎠᏴ ᎠᎩᎷᏤᎮᏍᏗ ᏂᏗᎦᏂᏆᏘᎲᎾᏃ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᏙᏓ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏥ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᎵᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏪᏥ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏟ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏙ, ᎥᎥ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎬᏅᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᏰᎵ ᎠᎩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏱᏅᎦᎵᏍᏓ.
\ft If any man come to me, and hate not his father, and mother, and wife, and children, and brethren, and sisters, yea, and his own life also, he cannot be my disciple.

\ln Ale gilo utseli tsudahnawadv nayisgvna ale nagisdawadegvna igesesdi, vtla yeli agisdawadidohi yinvgalisda.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏧᏓᎿᏩᏛ ᎾᏱᏍᎬᎾ ᎠᎴ ᎾᎩᏍᏓᏩᏕᎬᎾ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎥᏝ ᏰᎵ ᎠᎩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏱᏅᎦᎵᏍᏓ.
\ft And whosoever doth not bear his cross, and come after me, cannot be my disciple.

\ln Gagoyeno hia tsinitsadvnv, yadanvte inv igati unesgediyi, vtla igvyi yigahvsgo yasehiho igai tsugvwatanihisdi gesvi, udolehohisdiyi yeli gvwasquadisdodi igai uhvi.
\syll ᎦᎪᏰᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᏣᏛᏅ, ᏯᏓᏅᏖ ᎢᏅ ᎢᎦᏘ ᎤᏁᏍᎨᏗᏱ, ᎥᏝ ᎢᎬᏱ ᏱᎦᎲᏍᎪ ᏯᏎᎯᎰ ᎢᎦᎢ ᏧᎬᏩᏔᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏰᎵ ᎬᏩᏍᏆᏗᏍᏙᏗ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎤᎲᎢ.
\ft For which of you, intending to build a tower, sitteth not down first, and counteth the cost, whether he have sufficient to finish it?

\ln Iyuyeno gagusdvdi tsudvhi yigi, ale gvwasquadisdi nigesvna yigi, nigadv anigowatisgi yanalenv yigvwadehodv,
\syll ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᎦᎫᏍᏛᏗ ᏧᏛᎯ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᏍᏆᏗᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏱᎩ, ᏂᎦᏛ ᎠᏂᎪᏩᏘᏍᎩ ᏯᎾᎴᏅ ᏱᎬᏩᏕᎰᏛ,
\ft Lest haply, after he hath laid the foundation, and is not able to finish it, all that behold it begin to mock him,

\ln Hia yinaniwi, hia asgaya ulenvhvgi anesgesgvi, ale vtla yeli gvwasquadisdi yigesei.
\syll ᎯᎠ ᏱᎾᏂᏫ, ᎯᎠ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᎴᏅᎲᎩ ᎠᏁᏍᎨᏍᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᏰᎵ ᎬᏩᏍᏆᏗᏍᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ.
\ft Saying, This man began to build, and was not able to finish.

\ln Ale gago iyusdi ugvwiyuhi, dahnawa yinvdvnvneli nvwadale ugvwiyuhi, vtla igvyi yigahvsgo ale yadanvtesgo yeliquo asgohi iyagayvli datinehv digvwanatliyvdi gesv tsugatilegi talasgohi iyagayvli datinehvi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎦᎪ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᏓᎿᏩ ᏱᏅᏛᏅᏁᎵ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎥᏝ ᎢᎬᏱ ᏱᎦᎲᏍᎪ ᎠᎴ ᏯᏓᏅᏖᏍᎪ ᏰᎵᏉ ᎠᏍᎪᎯ ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ ᏓᏘᏁᎲ ᏗᎬᏩᎾᏟᏴᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏧᎦᏘᎴᎩ ᏔᎳᏍᎪᎯ ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ ᏓᏘᏁᎲᎢ.
\ft Or what king, going to make war against another king, sitteth not down first, and consulteth whether he be able with ten thousand to meet him that cometh against him with twenty thousand?

\ln Iyuno yeli nigesvna yigi, asi soi invhiyu tsvtsaisoi, deganvsgo tsunvsidv atayohiho dohiyi iyunvnediyi.
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᏰᎵ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᏏ ᏐᎢ ᎢᏅᎯᏳ ᏨᏣᎢᏐᎢ, ᏕᎦᏅᏍᎪ ᏧᏅᏏᏛ ᎠᏔᏲᎯᎰ ᏙᎯᏱ ᎢᏳᏅᏁᏗᏱ.
\ft Or else, while the other is yet a great way off, he sendeth an ambassage, and desireth conditions of peace.

\ln Nasgiya nasquo nihi, iyuno gilo niduyosohvsgvna igesesdi nigadv utseli gesvi, vtla yeli agisdawadegi yinvgalisda.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏂᎯ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᏂᏚᏲᏐᎲᏍᎬᎾ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᏰᎵ ᎠᎩᏍᏓᏩᏕᎩ ᏱᏅᎦᎵᏍᏓ.
\ft So likewise, whosoever he be of you that forsaketh not all that he hath, he cannot be my disciple.

\ln ~Ama osiyu; iyusgini ~ama yutsisgolv, gado tigalisdoda ~ama yadotlvna.
\syll ᎠᎹ ᎣᏏᏳ; ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᎹ ᏳᏥᏍᎪᎸ, ᎦᏙ ᏘᎦᎵᏍᏙᏓ ᎠᎹ ᏯᏙᏢᎾ.
\ft Salt is good: but if the salt have lost his savour, wherewith shall it be seasoned?

\ln Vtla hnaquo tlogesi galageyadvdi ale osdv gada gatlugv gvdi yigesoi; wunadegoquo.  Gilo degalilugesdi udvgodiyi wadvgvga.
\syll ᎥᏝ ᎿᏉ ᏠᎨᏏ ᎦᎳᎨᏯᏛᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎦᏓ ᎦᏡᎬ ᎬᏗ ᏱᎨᏐᎢ; ᏭᎾᏕᎪᏉ.  ᎩᎶ ᏕᎦᎵᎷᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᏛᎪᏗᏱ ᏩᏛᎬᎦ.
\ft It is neither fit for the land, nor yet for the dunghill; but men cast it out. He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.

\ln Hnaquono nav gvwalutsele nigadv adelv anigisidohi ale anisgana gvwadvdasdanediyi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎾᎥ ᎬᏩᎷᏤᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎠᏕᎸ ᎠᏂᎩᏏᏙᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᎾ ᎬᏩᏛᏓᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ.
\ft Then drew near unto him all the publicans and sinners for to hear him.

\ln Aniqualisino ale dinuwelisgi unisonvtsele hia nuniwesei, hia asgaya dadanilvgo anisganai, ale itsulaha analisdayvhvsgoi.
\syll ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏᏃ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏄᏪᎵᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᏐᏅᏤᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᏓᏓᏂᎸᎪ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᎾᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎠᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎪᎢ.
\ft And the Pharisees and scribes murmured, saying, This man receiveth sinners, and eateth with them.

\ln Hiano nuwese dutlilostanelei,
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏎ ᏚᏟᎶᏍᏔᏁᎴᎢ,
\ft And he spake this parable unto them, saying,

\ln Gago hia tsinitsadvnv, asgohitsuqui yidunatlaa uninodena, iyuno saquo yuyohuselv, vtla yidigvdego inage anedohv soonelasgohi soonelagali iyanidv, ale yuyolego uyohuselvhi, gvni awadv?
\syll ᎦᎪ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᏣᏛᏅ, ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏧᏈ ᏱᏚᎾᏝᎠ ᎤᏂᏃᏕᎾ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᏌᏉ ᏳᏲᎱᏎᎸ, ᎥᏝ ᏱᏗᎬᏕᎪ ᎢᎾᎨ ᎠᏁᏙᎲ ᏐᎣᏁᎳᏍᎪᎯ ᏐᎣᏁᎳᎦᎵ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᏳᏲᎴᎪ ᎤᏲᎱᏎᎸᎯ, ᎬᏂ ᎠᏩᏛ?
\ft What man of you, having an hundred sheep, if he lose one of them, doth not leave the ninety and nine in the wilderness, and go after that which is lost, until he find it?

\ln Iyuno awadv anohatlvvsgoi aliheligoi.
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᎠᏩᏛ ᎠᏃᎭᏢᎥᏍᎪᎢ ᎠᎵᎮᎵᎪᎢ.
\ft And when he hath found it, he layeth it on his shoulders, rejoicing.

\ln Vgalugino uwenvsv widayanisgo tsulii ale nav iyunadala, hia nidegawesehoi, Itsulaha idaliheligi; itsiwadvhvyeno unodena tsagiyohusehvgi.
\syll ᎥᎦᎷᎩᏃ ᎤᏪᏅᏒ ᏫᏓᏯᏂᏍᎪ ᏧᎵᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎾᎥ ᎢᏳᎾᏓᎳ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᏕᎦᏪᏎᎰᎢ, ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎢᏓᎵᎮᎵᎩ; ᎢᏥᏩᏛᎲᏰᏃ ᎤᏃᏕᎾ ᏣᎩᏲᎱᏎᎲᎩ.
\ft And when he cometh home, he calleth together his friends and neighbours, saying unto them, Rejoice with me; for I have found my sheep which was lost.

\ln Itsvyoseha, nasquosgini utlihiyu nanaliheligesdi galvladi tsosv saquo asgana ganetliyvsgesdi udanvdvi, esgaquo iyvdv soonelasgohi soonelagali iyanidv unadanvti anisgaya tsuninetliyvsdi nunalisdanehvna dunadanvdvi.
\syll ᎢᏨᏲᏎᎭ, ᎾᏍᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏟᎯᏳ ᎾᎾᎵᎮᎵᎨᏍᏗ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏦᏒ ᏌᏉ ᎠᏍᎦᎾ ᎦᏁᏟᏴᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᏓᏅᏛᎢ, ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏐᎣᏁᎳᏍᎪᎯ ᏐᎣᏁᎳᎦᎵ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ ᏧᏂᏁᏟᏴᏍᏗ ᏄᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᎲᎾ ᏚᎾᏓᏅᏛᎢ.
\ft I say unto you, that likewise joy shall be in heaven over one sinner that repenteth, more than over ninety and nine just persons, which need no repentance.

\ln Ale gago iyusdi ageyv asgohi yiduha agisi tsunagvwalodi, iyuno saquo yuyohuselv, vtla yatsvsdvsgo atsvsdodi ale yigvnosasgo galitsode, ale ulisinahisdi yuyoho gvni awadv?
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎦᎪ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᎨᏴ ᎠᏍᎪᎯ ᏱᏚᎭ ᎠᎩᏏ ᏧᎾᎬᏩᎶᏗ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᏌᏉ ᏳᏲᎱᏎᎸ, ᎥᏝ ᏯᏨᏍᏛᏍᎪ ᎠᏨᏍᏙᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏱᎬᏃᏌᏍᎪ ᎦᎵᏦᏕ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏏᏀᎢᏍᏗ ᏳᏲᎰ ᎬᏂ ᎠᏩᏛ?
\ft Either what woman having ten pieces of silver, if she lose one piece, doth not light a candle, and sweep the house, and seek diligently till she find it?

\ln Iyuno awadv widayanisgo tsulii ale nav iyunadala, hia nigawesgoi, Itsulaha idaliheligi; agiwadvhvyeno adelv tsagiyohusehvgi.
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᎠᏩᏛ ᏫᏓᏯᏂᏍᎪ ᏧᎵᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎾᎥ ᎢᏳᎾᏓᎳ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎪᎢ, ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎢᏓᎵᎮᎵᎩ; ᎠᎩᏩᏛᎲᏰᏃ ᎠᏕᎸ ᏣᎩᏲᎱᏎᎲᎩ.
\ft And when she hath found it, she calleth her friends and her neighbours together, saying, Rejoice with me; for I have found the piece which I had lost.

\ln Nasquosgini itsvyoseha analiheligo dinikahnawadidohi Unelanvhi tsutseliga saquo asgana ganetliyvna udanvdvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᏨᏲᏎᎭ ᎠᎾᎵᎮᎵᎪ ᏗᏂᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᏤᎵᎦ ᏌᏉ ᎠᏍᎦᎾ ᎦᏁᏟᏴᎾ ᎤᏓᏅᏛᎢ.
\ft Likewise, I say unto you, there is joy in the presence of the angels of God over one sinner that repenteth.

\ln Hiano nuwesei, Gilo iyusdi asgaya anitali tsuwetsi anisgaya anehei.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᏧᏪᏥ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ ᎠᏁᎮᎢ.
\ft And he said, A certain man had two sons:

\ln Onino ehi hia nuwesele udoda, Edoda, aquatseli iyulisdodi gesv tsugvwalodi tsahvi sgihvsi.  Talino niduwedele nigav tsugvwalodi uhvi.
\syll ᎣᏂᏃ ᎡᎯ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴ ᎤᏙᏓ, ᎡᏙᏓ, ᎠᏆᏤᎵ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᏣᎲᎢ ᏍᎩᎲᏏ.  ᏔᎵᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏕᎴ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎤᎲᎢ.
\ft And the younger of them said to his father, Father, give me the portion of goods that falleth to me. And he divided unto them his living.

\ln Iyusgiquono winusvlv uwetsi oni ehi nigadv uwetlisanei, ale unigise inv wulosei, nahnano nunelvna ehvi wutsewidole tsugvwalodi uhvi.
\syll ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏉᏃ ᏫᏄᏒᎸ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎣᏂ ᎡᎯ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎤᏪᏟᏌᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᎩᏎ ᎢᏅ ᏭᎶᏎᎢ, ᏀᎾᏃ ᏄᏁᎸᎾ ᎡᎲᎢ ᏭᏤᏫᏙᎴ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎤᎲᎢ.
\ft And not many days after the younger son gathered all together, and took his journey into a far country, and there wasted his substance with riotous living.

\ln Ale nigadv utsewonv utsati dugonulose nahnani, hnaquono ulenvhe udulvhvnei.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎤᏤᏬᏅ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏚᎪᏄᎶᏎ ᏀᎾᏂ, ᎿᏉᏃ ᎤᎴᏅᎮ ᎤᏚᎸᎲᏁᎢ.
\ft And when he had spent all, there arose a mighty famine in that land; and he began to be in want.

\ln Uwenvseno uligonele nahna ehi asgaya; dotsulogesvno siqua digelolv unvsei.
\syll ᎤᏪᏅᏎᏃ ᎤᎵᎪᏁᎴ ᏀᎾ ᎡᎯ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ; ᏙᏧᎶᎨᏒᏃ ᏏᏆ ᏗᎨᎶᎸ ᎤᏅᏎᎢ.
\ft And he went and joined himself to a citizen of that country; and he sent him into his fields to feed swine.

\ln Ale udulisge tsuweyesdiyi kalisetsi unadadvnvhi siqua unalisdayvdi, aseno vtla gilo yidunvnehei.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎨ ᏧᏪᏰᏍᏗᏱ ᎧᎵᏎᏥ ᎤᎾᏓᏛᏅᎯ ᏏᏆ ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᏱᏚᏅᏁᎮᎢ.
\ft And he would fain have filled his belly with the husks that the swine did eat: and no man gave unto him.

\ln Udanvtisanvno hia nuwesei; Nunitsata gegaguyvehi getsinvsidasdi edoda tsutseliga ulosvstanvhi uniha unalisdayvdi, ayvno agonuquo agihiha!
\syll ᎤᏓᏅᏘᏌᏅᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᏄᏂᏣᏔ ᎨᎦᎫᏴᎡᎯ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎡᏙᏓ ᏧᏤᎵᎦ ᎤᎶᏒᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎤᏂᎭ ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗ, ᎠᏴᏃ ᎠᎪᏄᏉ ᎠᎩᎯᎭ
\ft And when he came to himself, he said, How many hired servants of my father's have bread enough and to spare, and I perish with hunger!

\ln Dodagaleni, edoda wvdatsilutseli, hia winvdatsiweseli; Edoda, Galvladi tsisganvtselv, ale nihi higatahvi.
\syll ᏙᏓᎦᎴᏂ, ᎡᏙᏓ ᏮᏓᏥᎷᏤᎵ, ᎯᎠ ᏫᏅᏓᏥᏪᏎᎵ; ᎡᏙᏓ, ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏥᏍᎦᏅᏤᎸ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎯ ᎯᎦᏔᎲᎢ.
\ft I will arise and go to my father, and will say unto him, Father, I have sinned against heaven, and before thee,

\ln Ale vtla hnaquo yeli aquetsi gesquosedi yigi; tinvsidasdiquo taguyvehi nunasdv nasgiya nisquvga.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᎿᏉ ᏰᎵ ᎠᏇᏥ ᎨᏍᏉᏎᏗ ᏱᎩ; ᏘᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗᏉ ᏔᎫᏴᎡᎯ ᏄᎾᏍᏛ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏂᏍᏋᎦ.
\ft And am no more worthy to be called thy son: make me as one of thy hired servants.

\ln Ale dulene udoda wulutselei.  Aseno asi invhiyu tsaisei udoda wugohei, ale uwedolitsei, ale dusqualvtanei, ale agiligeni uweyalvtsei, ale utawedonei.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏚᎴᏁ ᎤᏙᏓ ᏭᎷᏤᎴᎢ.  ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᏏ ᎢᏅᎯᏳ ᏣᎢᏎᎢ ᎤᏙᏓ ᏭᎪᎮᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏪᏙᎵᏤᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏍᏆᎸᏔᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎩᎵᎨᏂ ᎤᏪᏯᎸᏤᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏔᏪᏙᏁᎢ.
\ft And he arose, and came to his father. But when he was yet a great way off, his father saw him, and had compassion, and ran, and fell on his neck, and kissed him.

\ln Uwetsino hia nuweselei; Edoda, Galvladi tsisganvtselv, ale nihi higatahvi; ale tla hnaquo aquetsi gesquosedi yigi.
\syll ᎤᏪᏥᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎡᏙᏓ, ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏥᏍᎦᏅᏤᎸ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎯ ᎯᎦᏔᎲᎢ; ᎠᎴ Ꮭ ᎿᏉ ᎠᏇᏥ ᎨᏍᏉᏎᏗ ᏱᎩ.
\ft And the son said unto him, Father, I have sinned against heaven, and in thy sight, and am no more worthy to be called thy son.

\ln Aseno udoda hia niduwesele tsunvsidasdi; Osani anuwo witsinagi, etsinuwotsa, ale etsiyesusdoga, ale tsetsalasulvga.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏙᏓ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴ ᏧᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ; ᎣᏌᏂ ᎠᏄᏬ ᏫᏥᎾᎩ, ᎡᏥᏄᏬᏣ, ᎠᎴ ᎡᏥᏰᏑᏍᏙᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᏤᏣᎳᏑᎸᎦ.
\ft But the father said to his servants, Bring forth the best robe, and put it on him; and put a ring on his hand, and shoes on his feet:

\ln Ale galitsotanvhi waga agina witsiyanv, ale etsiluga; ale idalisdayvhvga, osdv idadanvdada.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎦᎵᏦᏔᏅᎯ ᏩᎦ ᎠᎩᎾ ᏫᏥᏯᏅ, ᎠᎴ ᎡᏥᎷᎦ; ᎠᎴ ᎢᏓᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᎦ, ᎣᏍᏛ ᎢᏓᏓᏅᏓᏓ.
\ft And bring hither the fatted calf, and kill it; and let us eat, and be merry:

\ln Hiayeno aquetsi uyohusvhi gesvgi, talineno ieha, ale edatlotsvhi gesvgi, iatsiwadvhvno; unalenvheno osdv unadanvdadei.
\syll ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᎠᏇᏥ ᎤᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᎨᏒᎩ, ᏔᎵᏁᏃ ᎢᎡᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎡᏓᏠᏨᎯ ᎨᏒᎩ, ᎢᎠᏥᏩᏛᎲᏃ; ᎤᎾᎴᏅᎮᏃ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏓᏕᎢ.
\ft For this my son was dead, and is alive again; he was lost, and is found. And they began to be merry.

\ln Udaniligeno uwetsi tlogesi wedohei; diuwenvno ale adanelv nav ulutsv, daninogisgv ale analisgisgv udvganei
\syll ᎤᏓᏂᎵᎨᏃ ᎤᏪᏥ ᏠᎨᏏ ᏪᏙᎮᎢ; ᏗᎤᏪᏅᏃ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏓᏁᎸ ᎾᎥ ᎤᎷᏨ, ᏓᏂᏃᎩᏍᎬ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎾᎵᏍᎩᏍᎬ ᎤᏛᎦᏁᎢ
\ft Now his elder son was in the field: and as he came and drew nigh to the house, he heard musick and dancing.

\ln Wuyanvheno asiyvwi atsinvsidasdi, ale udvdvne uyelvdv nasgi nanadvnehvi.
\syll ᏭᏯᏅᎮᏃ ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᎠᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏛᏛᏁ ᎤᏰᎸᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᎾᏛᏁᎲᎢ.
\ft And he called one of the servants, and asked what these things meant.

\ln Nasgino hia nuweselei; Etsanvtli ulutsv, tsadodano galitsotanvhi waga agina ulv, dohiyi unanugotsilv iyusdi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎡᏣᏅᏟ ᎤᎷᏨ, ᏣᏙᏓᏃ ᎦᎵᏦᏔᏅᎯ ᏩᎦ ᎠᎩᎾ ᎤᎸ, ᏙᎯᏱ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏥᎸ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ.
\ft And he said unto him, Thy brother is come; and thy father hath killed the fatted calf, because he hath received him safe and sound.

\ln Utalawoseno, ale winuyvlvnaquo gesei; nasgi iyusdi udoda tsunugotse usdiyetanei.
\syll ᎤᏔᎳᏬᏎᏃ, ᎠᎴ ᏫᏄᏴᎸᎾᏉ ᎨᏎᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᏙᏓ ᏧᏄᎪᏤ ᎤᏍᏗᏰᏔᏁᎢ.
\ft And he was angry, and would not go in: therefore came his father out, and intreated him.

\ln Unetsvno hia nuwesele udoda; Gvniyuquo utsata nadetiyv gvsdelvhida, alevtla ilvhiyu naquohiyunvna yigi tsanetsvi, aseno vtla ilvhiyu awiagina asenulvhi yisgikaneloi, osdv ogadanvdadisdodi diqualii.
\syll ᎤᏁᏨᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴ ᎤᏙᏓ; ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎤᏣᏔ ᎾᏕᏘᏴ ᎬᏍᏕᎸᎯᏓ, ᎠᎴᎥᏝ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᎾᏉᎯᏳᏅᎾ ᏱᎩ ᏣᏁᏨᎢ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᎠᏫᎠᎩᎾ ᎠᏎᏄᎸᎯ ᏱᏍᎩᎧᏁᎶᎢ, ᎣᏍᏛ ᎣᎦᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏙᏗ ᏗᏆᎵᎢ.
\ft And he answering said to his father, Lo, these many years do I serve thee, neither transgressed I at any time thy commandment: and yet thou never gavest me a kid, that I might make merry with my friends:

\ln Hiasgini tsetsi ulutsonvhiquo, nasgi tsasvnelvhi tsugvwalodi anigeyvhi uninegutsidv uweladidolvi, ihielv galitsotanvhi waga agina.
\syll ᎯᎠᏍᎩᏂ ᏤᏥ ᎤᎷᏦᏅᎯᏉ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏣᏒᏁᎸᎯ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎠᏂᎨᏴᎯ ᎤᏂᏁᎫᏥᏛ ᎤᏪᎳᏗᏙᎸᎢ, ᎢᎯᎡᎸ ᎦᎵᏦᏔᏅᎯ ᏩᎦ ᎠᎩᎾ.
\ft But as soon as this thy son was come, which hath devoured thy living with harlots, thou hast killed for him the fatted calf.

\ln Hiano nuweselei; Aquetsi, nigohilvquo itsulaha ininelv, ale tsatseliquo nigav aginavi.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎠᏇᏥ, ᏂᎪᎯᎸᏉ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎢᏂᏁᎸ, ᎠᎴ ᏣᏤᎵᏉ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎠᎩᎾᎥᎢ.
\ft And he said unto him, Son, thou art ever with me, and all that I have is thine.

\ln Duyugodvgi osdv igadanvdadisdiyi, ale igilihelisdiyi; hiayeno etsanvtli uyohusvhi gesvgi, talineno ieha, ale edatlotsvhi gesvi, iatsiwadvhvno.
\syll ᏚᏳᎪᏛᎩ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎢᎦᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᎩᎵᎮᎵᏍᏗᏱ; ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᎡᏣᏅᏟ ᎤᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᎨᏒᎩ, ᏔᎵᏁᏃ ᎢᎡᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎡᏓᏠᏨᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎢᎠᏥᏩᏛᎲᏃ.
\ft It was meet that we should make merry, and be glad: for this thy brother was dead, and is alive again; and was lost, and is found.

\ln Ale nasquo hia niduwesele gvwasdawadidohi, Gilo iyusdi ehe uwehnai asgaya nasgi uwekahe ugasayasdidegi uhnavi; ale nasgi atsilawisehv tsugvwalodi udatsewelv atsinonelei.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ, ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎡᎮ ᎤᏪᎿᎢ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏪᎧᎮ ᎤᎦᏌᏯᏍᏗᏕᎩ ᎤᎿᎥᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏥᎳᏫᏎᎲ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎤᏓᏤᏪᎸ ᎠᏥᏃᏁᎴᎢ.
\ft And he said also unto his disciples, There was a certain rich man, which had a steward; and the same was accused unto him that he had wasted his goods.

\ln Wuyanvheno hia nuweselei, Gado digalisdodiha tsinusdi tsigvyadvgiha?  Gvnigesv nvga nusdv detsalvwisdanelv tsagasayasdidegi gesvi; gohiyeno iyudalenvdv vtla hnaquo tsagasayasdidegi yigesesdi.
\syll ᏭᏯᏅᎮᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎦᏙ ᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᏥᏄᏍᏗ ᏥᎬᏯᏛᎩᎭ?  ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏅᎦ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏕᏣᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸ ᏣᎦᏌᏯᏍᏗᏕᎩ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎪᎯᏰᏃ ᎢᏳᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎥᏝ ᎿᏉ ᏣᎦᏌᏯᏍᏗᏕᎩ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft And he called him, and said unto him, How is it that I hear this of thee? give an account of thy stewardship; for thou mayest be no longer steward.

\ln Ugasayasdidegino hia nuwese uwasv tsudanvdvi, Gado dagadvneli, aginvsidohiyeno agigieha aquagasayasdidegi gesvi?  Tlano yeli gvquasgosdi yigi; aquaduladidasdiyino igadeosga.
\syll ᎤᎦᏌᏯᏍᏗᏕᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏧᏓᏅᏛᎢ, ᎦᏙ ᏓᎦᏛᏁᎵ, ᎠᎩᏅᏏᏙᎯᏰᏃ ᎠᎩᎩᎡᎭ ᎠᏆᎦᏌᏯᏍᏗᏕᎩ ᎨᏒᎢ?  ᏝᏃ ᏰᎵ ᎬᏆᏍᎪᏍᏗ ᏱᎩ; ᎠᏆᏚᎳᏗᏓᏍᏗᏱᏃ ᎢᎦᏕᎣᏍᎦ.
\ft Then the steward said within himself, What shall I do? for my lord taketh away from me the stewardship: I cannot dig; to beg I am ashamed.

\ln Degugoda iyaquadvnediyi, nasgi vgisadesv aquagasayasdidegi gesv digagvquadanilvisdi iyulisdodiyi daninelvi.
\syll ᏕᎫᎪᏓ ᎢᏯᏆᏛᏁᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎥᎩᏌᏕᏒ ᎠᏆᎦᏌᏯᏍᏗᏕᎩ ᎨᏒ ᏗᎦᎬᏆᏓᏂᎸᎢᏍᏗ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏓᏂᏁᎸᎢ.
\ft I am resolved what to do, that, when I am put out of the stewardship, they may receive me into their houses.

\ln Howano widuyanvhe nigadv unvsidohi tsudugi, igvyiyino hia nuweselei, Ilago igai tsaduga aginvsidohi.
\syll ᎰᏩᏃ ᏫᏚᏯᏅᎮ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎤᏅᏏᏙᎯ ᏧᏚᎩ, ᎢᎬᏱᏱᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎢᎳᎪ ᎢᎦᎢ ᏣᏚᎦ ᎠᎩᏅᏏᏙᎯ.
\ft So he called every one of his lord's debtors unto him, and said unto the first, How much owest thou unto my lord?

\ln Hiano nuwesei, Asgohitsuqui iyutlilodv goi.  Hiano nuwesei, hinagi goweli etsadugvi, ale nula hihvga, ale hisgisgohi howelvga.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏧᏈ ᎢᏳᏟᎶᏛ ᎪᎢ.  ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎯᎾᎩ ᎪᏪᎵ ᎡᏣᏚᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏄᎳ ᎯᎲᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᏍᎩᏍᎪᎯ ᎰᏪᎸᎦ.
\ft And he said, An hundred measures of oil. And he said unto him, Take thy bill, and sit down quickly, and write fifty.

\ln Nvwadaleno hia nuweselei, nihina ilago etsaduga?  Hiano nuwesei, asgohitsuqui iyutlilodv utsalesdi.  Hiano nuweselei, Hinagi goweli etsadugvi, ale nelasgohi howelvga.
\syll ᏅᏩᏓᎴᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏂᎯᎾ ᎢᎳᎪ ᎡᏣᏚᎦ?  ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏧᏈ ᎢᏳᏟᎶᏛ ᎤᏣᎴᏍᏗ.  ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎯᎾᎩ ᎪᏪᎵ ᎡᏣᏚᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏁᎳᏍᎪᎯ ᎰᏪᎸᎦ.
\ft Then said he to another, And how much owest thou? And he said, An hundred measures of wheat. And he said unto him, Take thy bill, and write fourscore.

\ln Unadlaino ulvquotane niduyugodvna iyadvnahi ugasayasdidegi, udigalisdosge usinasanvtsvi; elohiyeno tsuwetsi unvsv anehvi, utli nanisinasanv esgaquo igagati tsuwetsi.
\syll ᎤᎾᏜᎢᏃ ᎤᎸᏉᏔᏁ ᏂᏚᏳᎪᏛᎾ ᎢᏯᏛᏀᎢ ᎤᎦᏌᏯᏍᏗᏕᎩ, ᎤᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏍᎨ ᎤᏏᎾᏌᏅᏨᎢ; ᎡᎶᎯᏰᏃ ᏧᏪᏥ ᎤᏅᏒ ᎠᏁᎲᎢ, ᎤᏟ ᎾᏂᏏᎾᏌᏅ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎢᎦᎦᏘ ᏧᏪᏥ.
\ft And the lord commended the unjust steward, because he had done wisely: for the children of this world are in their generation wiser than the children of light.

\ln Ale itsvyoseha, itsaliida udalidasdi genvisdi gesvi; nasgi esga nitsalisdanelv ulisquadisdi nigesvna wadediyi gesv gagetsadanilvisdi gesesdi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎢᏨᏲᏎᎭ, ᎢᏣᎵᎢᏓ ᎤᏓᎵᏓᏍᏗ ᎨᏅᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᏍᎦ ᏂᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᎸ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏩᏕᏗᏱ ᎨᏒ ᎦᎨᏣᏓᏂᎸᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft And I say unto you, Make to yourselves friends of the mammon of unrighteousness; that, when ye fail, they may receive you into everlasting habitations.

\ln Gilo duyugodv iyadvnehi gayoli gesvi, nasquo duyugodv nadvneho ugodidi gesvi; niduyugodvnano iyadvnehi usdi gesv, nasquo niduyugodvna nadvneho ugodidi gesvi.
\syll ᎩᎶ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᎯ ᎦᏲᎵ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᏉ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎾᏛᏁᎰ ᎤᎪᏗᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᏂᏚᏳᎪᏛᎾᏃ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᎯ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ, ᎾᏍᏉ ᏂᏚᏳᎪᏛᎾ ᎾᏛᏁᎰ ᎤᎪᏗᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft He that is faithful in that which is least is faithful also in much: and he that is unjust in the least is unjust also in much.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi iyuno duyugodv nitsadvnehvna igesesdi udalidasdi genvisdi gesv gohusdi itsvdisgvi, gago yitsigatidisda nudalidasdvna genvisdi gesvi?
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏳᏃ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎲᎾ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᏓᎵᏓᏍᏗ ᎨᏅᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎢᏨᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᎦᎪ ᏱᏥᎦᏘᏗᏍᏓ ᏄᏓᎵᏓᏍᏛᎾ ᎨᏅᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ?
\ft If therefore ye have not been faithful in the unrighteous mammon, who will commit to your trust the true riches?

\ln Iyuno duyugodv nitsadvnelvna yigi nvwadale utseliga gesvi, gago datsineli itsvsv itsatseli gesvi?
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎸᎾ ᏱᎩ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎦᎪ ᏓᏥᏁᎵ ᎢᏨᏒ ᎢᏣᏤᎵ ᎨᏒᎢ?
\ft And if ye have not been faithful in that which is another man's, who shall give you that which is your own?

\ln Vtla gilo atsinvsidasdi yeli anitali gvwanvsidohi gohusdi yidogvdvnisi; yiasgagayeno saquo yiugeyuhano soi; yidouniyvquale saquo yiganiquatihano soi.  Tlasgini yeli Unelanvhi ale mamani gohusdi yidogetsadvnisi.
\syll ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᎠᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᏰᎵ ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᎬᏩᏅᏏᏙᎯ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏱᏙᎬᏛᏂᏏ; ᏱᎠᏍᎦᎦᏰᏃ ᏌᏉ ᏱᎤᎨᏳᎭᏃ ᏐᎢ; ᏱᏙᎤᏂᏴᏆᎴ ᏌᏉ ᏱᎦᏂᏆᏘᎭᏃ ᏐᎢ.  ᏝᏍᎩᏂ ᏰᎵ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎹᎹᏂ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏱᏙᎨᏣᏛᏂᏏ.
\ft No servant can serve two masters: for either he will hate the one, and love the other; or else he will hold to the one, and despise the other. Ye cannot serve God and mammon.

\ln Aniqualisino nasquo, nasgi adelv unigvvsgi tsigesei, nasgi hia nigadv unadvganei; ale gvwadehotanei.
\syll ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏕᎸ ᎤᏂᎬᎥᏍᎩ ᏥᎨᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏁᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᏕᎰᏔᏁᎢ.
\ft And the Pharisees also, who were covetous, heard all these things: and they derided him.

\ln Hiano niduweselei, Nihi kani duyugodv itsadvnehi nvwasdoi yvwi anigatahvi; Unelanvhisgini dagataha ditsinawi; nasgiyeno galvquodiyu tsuniyelvso yvwi, uniquatisdiyu Unelanvhi dakanisgvi.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏂᎯ ᎧᏂ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎢᏣᏛᏁᎯ ᏅᏩᏍᏙᎢ ᏴᏫ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎲᎢ; ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᏓᎦᏔᎭ ᏗᏥᎾᏫ; ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᏧᏂᏰᎸᏐ ᏴᏫ, ᎤᏂᏆᏘᏍᏗᏳ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏓᎧᏂᏍᎬᎢ.
\ft And he said unto them, Ye are they which justify yourselves before men; but God knoweth your hearts: for that which is highly esteemed among men is abomination in the sight of God.

\ln Dikahnawadvsdi ale anadolehosgi detsehvgi Tsani unanugotsilv iyasdi; nahiyu nvdagvwadalenvdv Unelanvhi ugvwiyuhi gesv aninoheha analitsidohvsga, ale naniv yvwi ananelugi aniyvhiha.
\syll ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᏕᏤᎲᎩ ᏣᏂ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏥᎸ ᎢᏯᏍᏗ; ᏀᎢᏳ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏂᏃᎮᎭ ᎠᎾᎵᏥᏙᎲᏍᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏴᏫ ᎠᎾᏁᎷᎩ ᎠᏂᏴᎯᎭ.
\ft The law and the prophets were until John: since that time the kingdom of God is preached, and every man presseth into it.

\ln Ale utli ahidiyu galvloi ale elohi unilosohvsdiyi, ano saquo usdikani dikahnawadvsdi esga iyulisdodiyi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎤᏟ ᎠᎯᏗᏳ ᎦᎸᎶᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎤᏂᎶᏐᎲᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᏃ ᏌᏉ ᎤᏍᏗᎧᏂ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎡᏍᎦ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
\ft And it is easier for heaven and earth to pass, than one tittle of the law to fail.

\ln Gilo udalii iadaegesdi, ale nvwadale adayegesdi, adayonehesdi; gilono agadainvdv adayegesdi adayonehesdi.
\syll ᎩᎶ ᎤᏓᎵᎢ ᎢᎠᏓᎡᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᎠᏓᏰᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᏓᏲᏁᎮᏍᏗ; ᎩᎶᏃ ᎠᎦᏓᎢᏅᏛ ᎠᏓᏰᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᏓᏲᏁᎮᏍᏗ.
\ft Whosoever putteth away his wife, and marrieth another, committeth adultery: and whosoever marrieth her that is put away from her husband committeth adultery.

\ln Gilo iyusdi asgaya uwehnai ehei, gigage ale usidoli doledv dinuwo danuwosgei, ale nidadodaquisv osdv dalisdayvhvsgei.
\syll ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᏪᎿᎢ ᎡᎮᎢ, ᎩᎦᎨ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏏᏙᎵ ᏙᎴᏛ ᏗᏄᏬ ᏓᏄᏬᏍᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᏓᏙᏓᏈᏒ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏓᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎨᎢ.
\ft There was a certain rich man, which was clothed in purple and fine linen, and fared sumptuously every day:

\ln Ale nasquo ehe gilo iyusdi uyo iyudvhnadegi Lasila tsudoidv, nasgi atsinisine uwehnai utseli galohisdiyi, tsutsidala gesei,
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎡᎮ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᏲ ᎢᏳᏛᎿᏕᎩ ᎳᏏᎳ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏥᏂᏏᏁ ᎤᏪᎿᎢ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ, ᏧᏥᏓᎳ ᎨᏎᎢ,
\ft And there was a certain beggar named Lazarus, which was laid at his gate, full of sores,

\ln Ale udulisge agelasdodiyi unvgoosvhi uwehnai uwesgilvi; ale nasquo gili unilutse duniganade dutsidalvi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎨ ᎠᎨᎳᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᏅᎪᎣᏒᎯ ᎤᏪᎿᎢ ᎤᏪᏍᎩᎸᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎩᎵ ᎤᏂᎷᏤ ᏚᏂᎦᎾᏕ ᏚᏥᏓᎸᎢ.
\ft And desiring to be fed with the crumbs which fell from the rich man's table: moreover the dogs came and licked his sores.

\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏲ ᎢᏳᏛᎿᏕᎩ ᎤᏲᎱᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏂᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎬᏩᏅᏎ ᎡᏆᎭᎻ ᎦᏁᏥᎢ ᏫᎬᏪᎧᏁᎢ.  ᎤᏪᎿᎢᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᏲᎱᏎᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏥᏂᏌᏁᎢ.
\ft And it came to pass, that the beggar died, and was carried by the angels into Abraham's bosom: the rich man also died, and was buried;

\ln Ale tsvsginoi dusaladane digadoli agiliyogei, ale nahna inv wugohe Equahami, ale Lasila Equahami ganetsii.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏨᏍᎩᏃᎢ ᏚᏌᎳᏓᏁ ᏗᎦᏙᎵ ᎠᎩᎵᏲᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏀᎾ ᎢᏅ ᏭᎪᎮ ᎡᏆᎭᎻ, ᎠᎴ ᎳᏏᎳ ᎡᏆᎭᎻ ᎦᏁᏥᎢ.
\ft And in hell he lift up his eyes, being in torments, and seeth Abraham afar off, and Lazarus in his bosom.

\ln Ale uwelune hia nuwesei; Edoda Equahami, sgidoligi, ale ehinvli Lasila, ale nasgi usgoli gayesadv amohi wahuda, ale wagidoolvsdasi tsinogoi; tsigiliyogayeno ani adaweligisgvi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎤᏪᎷᏁ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎡᏙᏓ ᎡᏆᎭᎻ, ᏍᎩᏙᎵᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎡᎯᏅᎵ ᎳᏏᎳ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏍᎪᎵ ᎦᏰᏌᏛ ᎠᎼᎯ ᏩᎱᏓ, ᎠᎴ ᏩᎩᏙᎣᎸᏍᏓᏏ ᏥᏃᎪᎢ; ᏥᎩᎵᏲᎦᏰᏃ ᎠᏂ ᎠᏓᏪᎵᎩᏍᎬᎢ.
\ft And he cried and said, Father Abraham, have mercy on me, and send Lazarus, that he may dip the tip of his finger in water, and cool my tongue; for I am tormented in this flame.

\ln Aseno Equahami hia nuwesei; Aquetsi, hanvdada, nihi asi tsalenidohvgi hiwatisgv tsatseliga osdv, ale Lasila nasquo awatisgvgi utseliga uyoi.  Aseno hnaquo atsinuwohistanv, nihino ihigiliyoga.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎡᏆᎭᎻ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎠᏇᏥ, ᎭᏅᏓᏓ, ᏂᎯ ᎠᏏ ᏣᎴᏂᏙᎲᎩ ᎯᏩᏘᏍᎬ ᏣᏤᎵᎦ ᎣᏍᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᎳᏏᎳ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏩᏘᏍᎬᎩ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᎤᏲᎢ.  ᎠᏎᏃ ᎿᏉ ᎠᏥᏄᏬᎯᏍᏔᏅ, ᏂᎯᏃ ᎢᎯᎩᎵᏲᎦ.
\ft But Abraham said, Son, remember that thou in thy lifetime receivedst thy good things, and likewise Lazarus evil things: but now he is comforted, and thou art tormented.

\ln Aleno nasquo ayv otsehv nihino itsehv nahna ayeli gesv equohiyu udlanvdvi gotlvha, nasgi iyusdi gilo yunaduliha ani unadalesdiyi ditsehv wunilohisdiyi, vtla yeli yinvgvnadvga, ale nasquo ani otsehvi vtla yvgvnilugi nahna nvdayunilohisdiyi yunaduliha.
\syll ᎠᎴᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏴ ᎣᏤᎲ ᏂᎯᏃ ᎢᏤᎲ ᏀᎾ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎨᏒ ᎡᏉᎯᏳ ᎤᏜᏅᏛᎢ ᎪᏢᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎩᎶ ᏳᎾᏚᎵᎭ ᎠᏂ ᎤᎾᏓᎴᏍᏗᏱ ᏗᏤᎲ ᏭᏂᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ, ᎥᏝ ᏰᎵ ᏱᏅᎬᎾᏛᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏂ ᎣᏤᎲᎢ ᎥᏝ ᏴᎬᏂᎷᎩ ᏀᎾ ᏅᏓᏳᏂᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏳᎾᏚᎵᎭ.
\ft And beside all this, between us and you there is a great gulf fixed: so that they which would pass from hence to you cannot; neither can they pass to us, that would come from thence.

\ln Hiano nuwesei; adina edoda, gvtayoseha, hinvsdiyi edoda diganelvi;
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎠᏗᎾ ᎡᏙᏓ, ᎬᏔᏲᏎᎭ, ᎯᏅᏍᏗᏱ ᎡᏙᏓ ᏗᎦᏁᎸᎢ;
\ft Then he said, I pray thee therefore, father, that thou wouldest send him to my father's house:

\ln Hisgiyeno naniv otsalinvtli aneha; nasgino yiwidekanohvsi nasquoyeno ani agiliyoisdiyi gesv yanilugi.
\syll ᎯᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎣᏣᎵᏅᏟ ᎠᏁᎭ; ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏱᏫᏕᎧᏃᎲᏏ ᎾᏍᏉᏰᏃ ᎠᏂ ᎠᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎨᏒ ᏯᏂᎷᎩ.

\ln Equahami hia nuweselei; Mosi ale anadolehosgi duneha; nasgi widanadvdasdasi.
\syll ᎡᏆᎭᎻ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎼᏏ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᏚᏁᎭ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᏫᏓᎾᏛᏓᏍᏓᏏ.
\ft Abraham saith unto him, They have Moses and the prophets; let them hear them.

\ln Hiano nuwesei, Tlesdi edoda Equahami, iyusgini gilo uyohusvhi yiwunilutselv ase yidaninetliyvna danadanvdvi.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᎡᏙᏓ ᎡᏆᎭᎻ, ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᏱᏭᏂᎷᏤᎸ ᎠᏎ ᏱᏓᏂᏁᏟᏴᎾ ᏓᎾᏓᏅᏛᎢ.
\ft And he said, Nay, father Abraham: but if one went unto them from the dead, they will repent.

\ln Aseno hia nuweselei; iyuno nidanadvdasdanehvna yigi Mosi ale anadolehosgi, vtla nasquo yvgvnohiyuhvga, nasquo gilo uyohusvhi yidulenv.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᏂᏓᎾᏛᏓᏍᏓᏁᎲᎾ ᏱᎩ ᎼᏏ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ, ᎥᏝ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏴᎬᏃᎯᏳᎲᎦ, ᎾᏍᏉ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᏱᏚᎴᏅ.
\ft And he said unto him, If they hear not Moses and the prophets, neither will they be persuaded, though one rose from the dead.

\ln Hnaquono hia niduwesele gvwasdawadidohi, ase didadodesdisgi unanugoisdi; aseno uyoiyu iyulisdanedi nasgi na unanugowisvhi!
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ, ᎠᏎ ᏗᏓᏙᏕᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᎢᏍᏗ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏲᎢᏳ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏫᏒᎯ
