\syll ᎤᏟ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᏱᎨᏎ ᏅᏯ ᎠᏍᏙᏍᎩ ᏯᏥᏯᏝᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎺᏉᎯ ᏱᏩᎦᏓᎢᏅᏎᎢ, ᎠᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᏧᎾᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏧᏬᏕᏍᏗᏱ.

\syll ᎢᏳ ᎠᎴ ᎦᎵᏉᎩ ᏂᏣᏍᎦᏅᏤᎮᏍᏗ ᏏᎦ ᎨᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᎵᏉᎩ ᏂᏣᎷᏤᎮᏍᏗ ᏏᎦ ᎨᏒ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᏣᏪᏎᎮᏍᏗ, ᎤᏲ ᎠᎩᏰᎸᎭ, ᎠᏎ ᎯᏯᏙᎵᎨᏍᏗᏉ.
\ft And if he trespass against thee seven times in a day, and seven times in a day turn again to thee, saying, I repent; thou shalt forgive him.

\ln Getsinvsidvno hia nuniwesele Ugvwiyuhi, Sginequosi ogohiyusvi.
\syll ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏛᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎴ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᏍᎩᏁᏉᏏ ᎣᎪᎯᏳᏒᎢ.
\ft And the apostles said unto the Lord, Increase our faith.

\ln Ugvwiyuhino hia nuwesei, Iyuno atsilvugata tsinigv igidv gohiyudi gesv yitsiha, hia yinitsiwesi hia guwatsunegv tsitluga, Widetsanasdetlvda, ale amequohi wetsakahvga, ale yitsohiyuhvga.
\syll ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎠᏥᎸᎤᎦᏔ ᏥᏂᎬ ᎢᎩᏛ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏱᏥᎭ, ᎯᎠ ᏱᏂᏥᏪᏏ ᎯᎠ ᎫᏩᏧᏁᎬ ᏥᏡᎦ, ᏫᏕᏣᎾᏍᏕᏢᏓ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎺᏉᎯ ᏪᏣᎧᎲᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᏱᏦᎯᏳᎲᎦ.
\ft And the Lord said, If ye had faith as a grain of mustard seed, ye might say unto this sycamine tree, Be thou plucked up by the root, and be thou planted in the sea; and it should obey you.

\ln Aseno gago hia tsinitsadvnv, etsinvsidasdi yigadalugiha, ale yigelolvvsga, tlogesi nvdayulosonvhi, gilaquo iyvdv hia yinetsiwesi, Hena walisdayvhvga?
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎦᎪ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᏣᏛᏅ, ᎡᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᏱᎦᏓᎷᎩᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᏱᎨᎶᎸᎥᏍᎦ, ᏠᎨᏏ ᏅᏓᏳᎶᏐᏅᎯ, ᎩᎳᏉ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎯᎠ ᏱᏁᏥᏪᏏ, ᎮᎾ ᏩᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᎦ?
\ft But which of you, having a servant plowing or feeding cattle, will say unto him by and by, when he is come from the field, Go and sit down to meat?

\ln Tlasgo hia yigvwagvwiyu yinvgayetsiwesi, Hadvnvisda aqualisdayvdiyi, ale hadatloga, ale sgisdelvhida galisdayvhvsgv ale gaditasgv igvhidv; onino tsvsv halisdayvnvha ale haditahvha?
\syll ᏝᏍᎪ ᎯᎠ ᏱᎬᏩᎬᏫᏳ ᏱᏅᎦᏰᏥᏪᏏ, ᎭᏛᏅᎢᏍᏓ ᎠᏆᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎭᏓᏠᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᏍᎩᏍᏕᎸᎯᏓ ᎦᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎬ ᎠᎴ ᎦᏗᏔᏍᎬ ᎢᎬᎯᏛ; ᎣᏂᏃ ᏨᏒ ᎭᎵᏍᏓᏴᏅᎭ ᎠᎴ ᎭᏗᏔᎲᎭ?
\ft And will not rather say unto him, Make ready wherewith I may sup, and gird thyself, and serve me, till I have eaten and drunken; and afterward thou shalt eat and drink?

\ln Agalielitsehosgo nasgi atsinvsidasdi natsiweselv nudvnelvi?  Vtla agiyelvha.
\syll ᎠᎦᎵᎡᎵᏤᎰᏍᎪ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎾᏥᏪᏎᎸ ᏄᏛᏁᎸᎢ?  ᎥᏝ ᎠᎩᏰᎸᎭ.
\ft Doth he thank that servant because he did the things that were commanded him? I trow not.

\ln Nasgiya nasquo nihi, hnaquo nigadv nutsiweselv nitsadvnehonvha, hia nitsiwesvha, Gohusdi ogvdodi nigesvna oginvsidasdi; iyogadvnediquo gesv nogadvnelv.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏂᎯ, ᎿᏉ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏄᏥᏪᏎᎸ ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎰᏅᎭ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᏥᏪᏒᎭ, ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎣᎬᏙᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎣᎩᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ; ᎢᏲᎦᏛᏁᏗᏉ ᎨᏒ ᏃᎦᏛᏁᎸ.
\ft So likewise ye, when ye shall have done all those things which are commanded you, say, We are unprofitable servants: we have done that which was our duty to do.

\ln Hiano nulistane nasgi Tsilusilimi wagatei, Sameliyi ale Gelili ayeli ulosei.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᏩᎦᏖᎢ, ᏌᎺᎵᏱ ᎠᎴ ᎨᎵᎵ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎤᎶᏎᎢ.
\ft And it came to pass, as he went to Jerusalem, that he passed through the midst of Samaria and Galilee.

\ln Ilvhitlvno gaduhv wayvhihvi asgohi iyanidv anisgaya adayesgi tsunitlvgi degvwatlosei, inv tsunalenvnei;
\syll ᎢᎸᎯᏢᏃ ᎦᏚᎲ ᏩᏴᎯᎲᎢ ᎠᏍᎪᎯ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ ᎠᏓᏰᏍᎩ ᏧᏂᏢᎩ ᏕᎬᏩᏠᏎᎢ, ᎢᏅ ᏧᎾᎴᏅᏁᎢ;
\ft And as he entered into a certain village, there met him ten men that were lepers, which stood afar off:

\ln Ale unisaladane aninegv hia nuniwesei, Tsisa Tadeyohvsgi, sgiyadoligi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏌᎳᏓᏁ ᎠᏂᏁᎬ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ, ᏥᏌ ᏔᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ, ᏍᎩᏯᏙᎵᎩ.
\ft And they lifted up their voices, and said, Jesus, Master, have mercy on us.

\ln Dugohvno, hia niduweselei, Itsena atsilvanelohi gvnigesv winiditsadvnisi.  Hiano nulistanei, anaisvquo dunadanvgalvhei.
\syll ᏚᎪᎲᏃ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎢᏤᎾ ᎠᏥᎸᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏫᏂᏗᏣᏛᏂᏏ.  ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᎠᎾᎢᏒᏉ ᏚᎾᏓᏅᎦᎸᎮᎢ.
\ft And when he saw them, he said unto them, Go shew yourselves unto the priests. And it came to pass, that, as they went, they were cleansed.

\ln Asiyvwino, udolehosv atsinvwanvi, diutsvsei, ale asdaya unetse ulvquotane Unelanvhi,
\syll ᎠᏏᏴᏫᏃ, ᎤᏙᎴᎰᏒ ᎠᏥᏅᏩᏅᎢ, ᏗᎤᏨᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏍᏓᏯ ᎤᏁᏤ ᎤᎸᏉᏔᏁ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ,
\ft And one of them, when he saw that he was healed, turned back, and with a loud voice glorified God,

\ln Ale udanvne uliyasdune dulasgv navi, alihelitsehei.  Ale Sameliyi ehi gesei.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᏅᏁ ᎤᎵᏯᏍᏚᏁ ᏚᎳᏍᎬ ᎾᎥᎢ, ᎠᎵᎮᎵᏤᎮᎢ.  ᎠᎴ ᏌᎺᎵᏱ ᎡᎯ ᎨᏎᎢ.
\ft And fell down on his face at his feet, giving him thanks: and he was a Samaritan.

\ln Tsisano unetsv hia nuwesei, Tlasgo asgohi yigetsinvgalvei?  Aseno soonela iyanidv hatlv?
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᏝᏍᎪ ᎠᏍᎪᎯ ᏱᎨᏥᏅᎦᎸᎡᎢ?  ᎠᏎᏃ ᏐᎣᏁᎳ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᎭᏢ?
\ft And Jesus answering said, Were there not ten cleansed? but where are the nine?

\ln Vtla yigetsiwadv nvdayunatsvdv Unelanvhi anilvquodisgi, hia nvwadale yvwi uwasv.
\syll ᎥᏝ ᏱᎨᏥᏩᏛ ᏅᏓᏳᎾᏨᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᏂᎸᏉᏗᏍᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏩᏒ.
\ft There are not found that returned to give glory to God, save this stranger.

\ln Hiano nuwesele nasgi, Talehvga, ale tsihena; tsohiyusv tsadiwisda.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏎᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ, ᏔᎴᎲᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᎮᎾ; ᏦᎯᏳᏒ ᏣᏗᏫᏍᏓ.
\ft And he said unto him, Arise, go thy way: thy faith hath made thee whole.

\ln Aniqualisino gvwadvdvnv iyuquo uluhisdiyi Unelanvhi ugvwiyuhi gesv, dunetselei, hia nuwesei, Unelanvhi ugvwiyuhi gesv vtla gvgowadvdi yigesesdi galutsvha.
\syll ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏᏃ ᎬᏩᏛᏛᏅ ᎢᏳᏉ ᎤᎷᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ, ᏚᏁᏤᎴᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎥᏝ ᎬᎪᏩᏛᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎦᎷᏨᎭ.
\ft And when he was demanded of the Pharisees, when the kingdom of God should come, he answered them and said, The kingdom of God cometh not with observation:

\ln Vtla ale hia yinigvniwesgesdi, Gvniyuquo ani!  ale, Gvniyuquo nahnani!  gvniyuquoyeno Unelanvhi ugvwiyuhi gesv itseladidoha.
\syll ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏱᏂᎬᏂᏪᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎠᏂ  ᎠᎴ, ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᏀᎾᏂ  ᎬᏂᏳᏉᏰᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏤᎳᏗᏙᎭ.
\ft Neither shall they say, Lo here! or, lo there! for, behold, the kingdom of God is within you.

\ln Hiano niduwesele gvwasdawadidohi, dvsqualvhi nahiyu gesv itsadulisgesdi itsigowadvdiyi saquo iga yvwi Uwetsi utseliga, ale vtla yvgetsigowadv.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ, ᏛᏍᏆᎸᎯ ᏀᎢᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏣᏚᎵᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎢᏥᎪᏩᏛᏗᏱ ᏌᏉ ᎢᎦ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᏴᎨᏥᎪᏩᏛ.
\ft And he said unto the disciples, The days will come, when ye shall desire to see one of the days of the Son of man, and ye shall not see it.

\ln Ale hia nigetsiwesehesdi, Gvniyuquo ani; ale Gvniyuquo nahnani; tlesdi itsenvsvgi, ale tlesdi ditsisdawadvsvgi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎨᏥᏪᏎᎮᏍᏗ, ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎠᏂ; ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᏀᎾᏂ; ᏞᏍᏗ ᎢᏤᏅᏒᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏗᏥᏍᏓᏩᏛᏒᎩ.
\ft And they shall say to you, See here; or, see there: go not after them, nor follow them.

\ln Nasgiyayeno anagalisgi saquo iditlv galvloi tsvdigalisgoi, utsatinino iditlv galvloi tsiwidigalvsadadisgoi; nasgi nasquo nusdesdi yvwi Uwetsi utseli iga aliyilolvha.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏯᏰᏃ ᎠᎾᎦᎵᏍᎩ ᏌᏉ ᎢᏗᏢ ᎦᎸᎶᎢ ᏨᏗᎦᎵᏍᎪᎢ, ᎤᏣᏘᏂᏃ ᎢᏗᏢ ᎦᎸᎶᎢ ᏥᏫᏗᎦᎸᏌᏓᏗᏍᎪᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏄᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎢᎦ ᎠᎵᏱᎶᎸᎭ.
\ft For as the lightning, that lighteneth out of the one part under heaven, shineth unto the other part under heaven; so shall also the Son of man be in his day.

\ln Aseno igvyi utsati tsudalenvdv ugiliyoisdi, ale digvwayohisdi gesesdi gohi tsaneha.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎢᎬᏱ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎤᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎬᏩᏲᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎪᎯ ᏣᏁᎭ.
\ft But first must he suffer many things, and be rejected of this generation.

\ln Ale nasgiya tsinusde nahiyu Noya tsehei, nasgi nasquo nusdesdi nahiyu yvwi Uwetsi utseli iga aliyilolvha.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏥᏄᏍᏕ ᏀᎢᏳ ᏃᏯ ᏤᎮᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏄᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᏀᎢᏳ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎢᎦ ᎠᎵᏱᎶᎸᎭ.
\ft And as it was in the days of Noe, so shall it be also in the days of the Son of man.

\ln Danalisdayvhvsgei, danaditasgei, danadesvhvsgei, degetsiyegei, gvni nahiyu iga Noya utsanv tsiyuhi, ale unohuganilv ale nigadv dunigvtsonv.
\syll ᏓᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎨᎢ, ᏓᎾᏗᏔᏍᎨᎢ, ᏓᎾᏕᏒᎲᏍᎨᎢ, ᏕᎨᏥᏰᎨᎢ, ᎬᏂ ᏀᎢᏳ ᎢᎦ ᏃᏯ ᎤᏣᏅ ᏥᏳᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏃᎱᎦᏂᎸ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏚᏂᎬᏦᏅ.
\ft They did eat, they drank, they married wives, they were given in marriage, until the day that Noe entered into the ark, and the flood came, and destroyed them all.

\ln Nasgiya nasquo tsinusde nahiyu Lodv tsehei; danalisdayvhvsgei danaditasgei, uniwaevsgei, aninotanvvsgei, daniwisvvsgei, dananesgesgei;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏥᏄᏍᏕ ᏀᎢᏳ ᎶᏛ ᏤᎮᎢ; ᏓᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎨᎢ ᏓᎾᏗᏔᏍᎨᎢ, ᎤᏂᏩᎡᎥᏍᎨᎢ, ᎠᏂᏃᏔᏅᎥᏍᎨᎢ, ᏓᏂᏫᏒᎥᏍᎨᎢ, ᏓᎾᏁᏍᎨᏍᎨᎢ;
\ft Likewise also as it was in the days of Lot; they did eat, they drank, they bought, they sold, they planted, they builded;

\ln Aseno nahiyuquo iga Lodv Sodami unugotsv, galvladi tsugahnane atsilv ale sagonige adawelagisgi, nigadiyuno dunihonei.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᏀᎢᏳᏉ ᎢᎦ ᎶᏛ ᏐᏓᎻ ᎤᏄᎪᏨ, ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏧᎦᎿᏁ ᎠᏥᎸ ᎠᎴ ᏌᎪᏂᎨ ᎠᏓᏪᎳᎩᏍᎩ, ᏂᎦᏗᏳᏃ ᏚᏂᎰᏁᎢ.
\ft But the same day that Lot went out of Sodom it rained fire and brimstone from heaven, and destroyed them all.

\ln Nasgiya nusdesdi nahiyu iga yvwi Uwetsi gananugonilvha.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᏀᎢᏳ ᎢᎦ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎦᎾᏄᎪᏂᎸᎭ.
\ft Even thus shall it be in the day when the Son of man is revealed.

\ln Nahiyu iga gilo gasanali ugilesdi, uhnavno galitsode ahesdi, tlesdi nvdayutloasvgi uwidvdiyi; ale gilo tlogesi wiedohesdi, tlesdi nasquo nvdayutsvsvgi.
\syll ᏀᎢᏳ ᎢᎦ ᎩᎶ ᎦᏌᎾᎵ ᎤᎩᎴᏍᏗ, ᎤᎿᎥᏃ ᎦᎵᏦᏕ ᎠᎮᏍᏗ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᏅᏓᏳᏠᎠᏒᎩ ᎤᏫᏛᏗᏱ; ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᏠᎨᏏ ᏫᎡᏙᎮᏍᏗ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏅᏓᏳᏨᏒᎩ.
\ft In that day, he which shall be upon the housetop, and his stuff in the house, let him not come down to take it away: and he that is in the field, let him likewise not return back.

\ln Etsanvdada Lodv udalii.
\syll ᎡᏣᏅᏓᏓ ᎶᏛ ᎤᏓᎵᎢ.
\ft Remember Lot's wife.

\ln Gilo uwasv gvnv usdelvdiyi uyohesdi uyohusedi gesesdi; gilono uyohusehesdi, nasgi usdelvdi gesesdi.
\syll ᎩᎶ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎬᏅ ᎤᏍᏕᎸᏗᏱ ᎤᏲᎮᏍᏗ ᎤᏲᎱᏎᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᎩᎶᏃ ᎤᏲᎱᏎᎮᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏍᏕᎸᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft Whosoever shall seek to save his life shall lose it; and whosoever shall lose his life shall preserve it.

\ln Itseyoseha, nahiyu svnoyi gesesdi anitali saquo atsesdogihi daninvgesdi; asiyvwi atsiyanvdi gesesdi, soino atsikahiyasdi gesesdi.
\syll ᎢᏤᏲᏎᎭ, ᏀᎢᏳ ᏒᏃᏱ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᏌᏉ ᎠᏤᏍᏙᎩᎯ ᏓᏂᏅᎨᏍᏗ; ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᎠᏥᏯᏅᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᏐᎢᏃ ᎠᏥᎧᎯᏯᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft I tell you, in that night there shall be two men in one bed; the one shall be taken, and the other shall be left.

\ln Anitali anigeyv itsulaha anisdosgesdi; asiyvwi atsiyanvdi gesesdi, soino atsikahiyasdi gesesdi.
\syll ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᎠᏂᎨᏴ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎠᏂᏍᏙᏍᎨᏍᏗ; ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᎠᏥᏯᏅᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᏐᎢᏃ ᎠᏥᎧᎯᏯᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft Two women shall be grinding together; the one shall be taken, and the other left.

\ln Anitali tlogesi anedohesdi; asiyvwi atsiyanvdi gesesdi, soino atsikahiyasdi gesesdi.
\syll ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᏠᎨᏏ ᎠᏁᏙᎮᏍᏗ; ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᎠᏥᏯᏅᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᏐᎢᏃ ᎠᏥᎧᎯᏯᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft Two men shall be in the field; the one shall be taken, and the other left.

\ln Uninetsvno hia nigvwaweselei, Hatlv, Tsagvwiyuhi?  Hiano niduweselei, Ilvhitlv gohusdi uliwotsvhi tsiganoi, nahna awohali anadatlisisgoi.
\syll ᎤᏂᏁᏨᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏩᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎭᏢ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ?  ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎢᎸᎯᏢ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᎵᏬᏨᎯ ᏥᎦᏃᎢ, ᏀᎾ ᎠᏬᎭᎵ ᎠᎾᏓᏟᏏᏍᎪᎢ.
\ft And they answered and said unto him, Where, Lord? And he said unto them, Wheresoever the body is, thither will the eagles be gathered together.

\ln Dutlilosdaneleno, hia nusde ugvwalei, nasgi yvwi nigohilv unadadolisdodiyi, ale tsuniyaweisdi nigesvna;
\syll ᏚᏟᎶᏍᏓᏁᎴᏃ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏍᏕ ᎤᎬᏩᎴᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏴᏫ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎤᎾᏓᏙᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏂᏯᏪᎢᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ;
\ft And he spake a parable unto them to this end, that men ought always to pray, and not to faint;

\ln Hia nuwesei, Ehe digugodisgi ilvhitlv gaduhvi, nasgi Unelanvhi niganayesgvna, ale yvwi nidunelodvna;
\syll ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎡᎮ ᏗᎫᎪᏗᏍᎩ ᎢᎸᎯᏢ ᎦᏚᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏂᎦᎾᏰᏍᎬᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᏴᏫ ᏂᏚᏁᎶᏛᎾ;
\ft Saying, There was in a city a judge, which feared not God, neither regarded man:

\ln Ale uwosulotsvhi nahna gaduhv ehei; nasgino ulutselei, hia nigawesgei, Duyugodv nisginadvnisi tsosdadayilidohi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎤᏬᏑᎶᏨᎯ ᏀᎾ ᎦᏚᎲ ᎡᎮᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᎷᏤᎴᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎨᎢ, ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᏂᏍᎩᎾᏛᏂᏏ ᏦᏍᏓᏓᏱᎵᏙᎯ.
\ft And there was a widow in that city; and she came unto him, saying, Avenge me of mine adversary.

\ln Aseno uquosane ilvsgi igohidv; onisgini hia niuwese uwasv tsudanvdvi, Tlasgininonv yitsinayesga Unelanvhi, ale vtla yiditsiyanelodi yvwi;
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏉᏌᏁ ᎢᎸᏍᎩ ᎢᎪᎯᏛ; ᎣᏂᏍᎩᏂ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎤᏪᏎ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏧᏓᏅᏛᎢ, ᏝᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᏱᏥᎾᏰᏍᎦ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏗᏥᏯᏁᎶᏗ ᏴᏫ;
\ft And he would not for a while: but afterward he said within himself, Though I fear not God, nor regard man;

\ln Aseno hia uwosulotsvhi tsaquadeyadodiha nvdagalisdotani duyugodv nvdatsiyadvneli, nigohilvyeno galugv yidagiyaweisda.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎤᏬᏑᎶᏨᎯ ᏣᏆᏕᏯᏙᏗᎭ ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏔᏂ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᏅᏓᏥᏯᏛᏁᎵ, ᏂᎪᎯᎸᏰᏃ ᎦᎷᎬ ᏱᏓᎩᏯᏪᎢᏍᏓ.
\ft Yet because this widow troubleth me, I will avenge her, lest by her continual coming she weary me.

\ln Ugvwiyuhino hia nuwesei, Itsagasayasda niduyugodvna iyadvnehi digugodisgi nigawesgvi.
\syll ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎢᏣᎦᏌᏯᏍᏓ ᏂᏚᏳᎪᏛᎾ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᎯ ᏗᎫᎪᏗᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎬᎢ.
\ft And the Lord said, Hear what the unjust judge saith.

\ln Tlasgono Unelanvhi duyugodv yinidogvdvnisi uwasv tsutseli gegasuyvdv, nasgi digvwagitsvdi tsigvwadadolisdaneha, nasquo gohidiyu yidadohideha?
\syll ᏝᏍᎪᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᏱᏂᏙᎬᏛᏂᏏ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏧᏤᎵ ᎨᎦᏑᏴᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎬᏩᎩᏨᏗ ᏥᎬᏩᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎭ, ᎾᏍᏉ ᎪᎯᏗᏳ ᏱᏓᏙᎯᏕᎭ?
\ft And shall not God avenge his own elect, which cry day and night unto him, though he bear long with them?

\ln Itsvyoseha tlegiyu dodagulesi.  Aseno, yvwi Uwetsi galutsvha, gohiyudisgo gesv dvwadvhi elohi?
\syll ᎢᏨᏲᏎᎭ ᏞᎩᏳ ᏙᏓᎫᎴᏏ.  ᎠᏎᏃ, ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎦᎷᏨᎭ, ᎪᎯᏳᏗᏍᎪ ᎨᏒ ᏛᏩᏛᎯ ᎡᎶᎯ?
\ft I tell you that he will avenge them speedily. Nevertheless when the Son of man cometh, shall he find faith on the earth?

\ln Hiano dutlilosdanele gilo iyunasdi unvsv anadalvquodisgi, nanisganvna unatselvhi, uwanadaleno nvlisali diniyelvsgi.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏚᏟᎶᏍᏓᏁᎴ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗ ᎤᏅᏒ ᎠᎾᏓᎸᏉᏗᏍᎩ, ᎾᏂᏍᎦᏅᎾ ᎤᎾᏤᎸᎯ, ᎤᏩᎾᏓᎴᏃ ᏅᎵᏌᎵ ᏗᏂᏰᎸᏍᎩ.
\ft And he spake this parable unto certain which trusted in themselves that they were righteous, and despised others:

\ln Anitali anisgaya udvnadigalawiisdiyi unadadolistanvsei, asiyvwi Aqualisi gesei, soino adelvagisidohi.
\syll ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᏛᎾᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᎾᏓᏙᎵᏍᏔᏅᏎᎢ, ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᎠᏆᎵᏏ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᏐᎢᏃ ᎠᏕᎸᎠᎩᏏᏙᎯ.
\ft Two men went up into the temple to pray; the one a Pharisee, and the other a publican.

\ln Aqualisi ulene uwasv gesvi udadolistane hia nuwesei; Tsanelanvhi gvyalielitseha anisoi yvwi nunasdvi nasgi naquasdvna tsigi, nasgi asequo anadagiehi tsigi, ale niduyugodvna iyanadvnehi, ale dinadayonehi, ale nasquo hia adelvagisidohi nasgi nusdv naquasdvna tsigi.
\syll ᎠᏆᎵᏏ ᎤᎴᏁ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎨᏒᎢ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏔᏁ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᏣᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎬᏯᎵᎡᎵᏤᎭ ᎠᏂᏐᎢ ᏴᏫ ᏄᎾᏍᏛᎢ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏆᏍᏛᎾ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏎᏉ ᎠᎾᏓᎩᎡᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᏚᏳᎪᏛᎾ ᎢᏯᎾᏛᏁᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎾᏓᏲᏁᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏕᎸᎠᎩᏏᏙᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎾᏆᏍᏛᎾ ᏥᎩ.
\ft The Pharisee stood and prayed thus with himself, God, I thank thee, that I am not as other men are, extortioners, unjust, adulterers, or even as this publican.

\ln Sunadodaquasdi gesv tali amatli nigvsgoi; ale nigav aginav asgohine gotsaledv tsivsgoi.
\syll ᏑᎾᏙᏓᏆᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏔᎵ ᎠᎹᏟ ᏂᎬᏍᎪᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎠᎩᎾᎥ ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏁ ᎪᏣᎴᏛ ᏥᎥᏍᎪᎢ.
\ft I fast twice in the week, I give tithes of all that I possess.

\ln Adelvnoagisidohi inv tsulenei, vtla yeli galvladi widigvwakanodi yigesei, ganetsiquosgini uwanilei, hia nuwesei; Tsanelanvhi, sgidoligi tsisganai.
\syll ᎠᏕᎸᏃᎠᎩᏏᏙᎯ ᎢᏅ ᏧᎴᏁᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᏰᎵ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏫᏗᎬᏩᎧᏃᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ, ᎦᏁᏥᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏩᏂᎴᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᏣᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᏍᎩᏙᎵᎩ ᏥᏍᎦᎾᎢ.
\ft And the publican, standing afar off, would not lift up so much as his eyes unto heaven, but smote upon his breast, saying, God be merciful to me a sinner.

\ln Itsvyoseha, hia nasgi asgaya ududaledv tsuwenvsv wulosei, soino vtla.  Giloyeno uwasv iadasaladisgesdi eladi iyagvnedi gesesdi, gilono uwasv eladi niadadvnehesdi atsisaladodi gesesdi.
\syll ᎢᏨᏲᏎᎭ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᏚᏓᎴᏛ ᏧᏪᏅᏒ ᏭᎶᏎᎢ, ᏐᎢᏃ ᎥᏝ.  ᎩᎶᏰᏃ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎢᎠᏓᏌᎳᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎡᎳᏗ ᎢᏯᎬᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎩᎶᏃ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎡᎳᏗ ᏂᎠᏓᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᎠᏥᏌᎳᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft I tell you, this man went down to his house justified rather than the other: for every one that exalteth himself shall be abased; and he that humbleth himself shall be exalted.

\ln Ale nasquo degvwatinohele tsunasdi diniyoli, nasgi tsusitadisdiyi; aseno gvwasdawadidohi unadolehosv dunigvsgolvnei.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏕᎬᏩᏘᏃᎮᎴ ᏧᎾᏍᏗ ᏗᏂᏲᎵ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏏᏔᏗᏍᏗᏱ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎤᎾᏙᎴᎰᏒ ᏚᏂᎬᏍᎪᎸᏁᎢ.
\ft And they brought unto him also infants, that he would touch them: but when his disciples saw it, they rebuked them.

\ln Tsisano widuyanvhv hia nuwesei, Unanelagi ditselisi diniyoli gvgilutsediyi, ale tlesdi ditsinvsdadelvgi; nasgiyeno nunasdi nahna unelanvhi ugvwiyuhi gesvi.
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᏫᏚᏯᏅᎲ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎤᎾᏁᎳᎩ ᏗᏤᎵᏏ ᏗᏂᏲᎵ ᎬᎩᎷᏤᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏗᏥᏅᏍᏓᏕᎸᎩ; ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᏄᎾᏍᏗ ᏀᎾ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft But Jesus called them unto him, and said, Suffer little children to come unto me, and forbid them not: for of such is the kingdom of God.

\ln Udohiyuhiya hia nitsvweseha, Gilo Unelanvhi ugvwiyuhi gesv nidadanilvgvna igesesdi nasgiya ayoli tsidadanilvgoi, vtla nahna uyvsdi yigesesdi.
\syll ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ, ᎩᎶ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏂᏓᏓᏂᎸᎬᎾ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎠᏲᎵ ᏥᏓᏓᏂᎸᎪᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᏀᎾ ᎤᏴᏍᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft Verily I say unto you, Whosoever shall not receive the kingdom of God as a little child shall in no wise enter therein.

\ln Gilono iyusdi nugvwiyusadegi udvdvne, hia nuwesei, Hosdv Tadeyohvsgi, gado yaquadvnelv winasdvna gvnidv yitsiwadv?
\syll ᎩᎶᏃ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ ᎤᏛᏛᏁ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎰᏍᏛ ᏔᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ, ᎦᏙ ᏯᏆᏛᏁᎸ ᏫᎾᏍᏛᎾ ᎬᏂᏛ ᏱᏥᏩᏛ?
\ft And a certain ruler asked him, saying, Good Master, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?

\ln Tsisano hia nuweselei, Gadono hosdv isquoseha?  Vtla gilo osdv yigi saquo uwasvhiyu, nasgi Unelanvhi.
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎦᏙᏃ ᎰᏍᏛ ᎢᏍᏉᏎᎭ?  ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏱᎩ ᏌᏉ ᎤᏩᏒᎯᏳ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ.
\ft And Jesus said unto him, Why callest thou me good? none is good, save one, that is, God.

\ln Dehigatahaquo dikahnawadvsdi, Tlesdi tsadayonelvgi, Tlesdi tsadalvgi, tlesdi tsanosgisvgi, Tlesdi gayegogi tsanohelvgi, Degilvquodesdi tsadoda ale tsatsi.
\syll ᏕᎯᎦᏔᎭᏉ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᏣᏓᏲᏁᎸᎩ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᏣᏓᎸᎩ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᏣᏃᏍᎩᏒᎩ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᎦᏰᎪᎩ ᏣᏃᎮᎸᎩ, ᏕᎩᎸᏉᏕᏍᏗ ᏣᏙᏓ ᎠᎴ ᏣᏥ.
\ft Thou knowest the commandments, Do not commit adultery, Do not kill, Do not steal, Do not bear false witness, Honour thy father and thy mother.

\ln Hiano nuwesei, Hia nasgi nigadv dagikanawadenv tsitsutsa gesv nvdagvwadale nvdv.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏓᎩᎧᎾᏩᏕᏅ ᏥᏧᏣ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏓᎴ ᏅᏛ.
\ft And he said, All these have I kept from my youth up.

\ln Tsisano nasgi hia udvganv, hia nuweselei, Asi sudalegi tsalula; hinaduga nigadv tsanavi, ale tiyadohisi uyo iyunadvhnadegi, galvladino witsahesdi tsugvwalodi; tesvno sgisdawadesvha.
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎤᏛᎦᏅ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎠᏏ ᏑᏓᎴᎩ ᏣᎷᎳ; ᎯᎾᏚᎦ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏣᎾᎥᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏘᏯᏙᎯᏏ ᎤᏲ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᎿᏕᎩ, ᎦᎸᎳᏗᏃ ᏫᏣᎮᏍᏗ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ; ᏖᏒᏃ ᏍᎩᏍᏓᏩᏕᏒᎭ.
\ft Now when Jesus heard these things, he said unto him, Yet lackest thou one thing: sell all that thou hast, and distribute unto the poor, and thou shalt have treasure in heaven: and come, follow me.

\ln Nasgino hia udvganv utsati uyo uyelvnei; utsatiyeno uwehnaiyu gesei.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎤᏛᎦᏅ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᏲ ᎤᏰᎸᏁᎢ; ᎤᏣᏘᏰᏃ ᎤᏪᎿᎢᏳ ᎨᏎᎢ.
\ft And when he heard this, he was very sorrowful: for he was very rich.

\ln Tsisano ugohv utsati uyo uyelvsvi, hia nuwesei, Nigav asdayiyu tsunehnai Unelanvhi ugvwiyuhi digesv wuniyvsdiyi!
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᎪᎲ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᏲ ᎤᏰᎸᏒᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᏂᎦᎥ ᎠᏍᏓᏱᏳ ᏧᏁᎿᎢ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏗᎨᏒ ᏭᏂᏴᏍᏗᏱ
\ft And when Jesus saw that he was very sorrowful, he said, How hardly shall they that have riches enter into the kingdom of God!

\ln Utliyeno ahidiyu gemili ugadvlehisdiyi yvgi gasanenadvdiyi ano uwehnai yvwi wuyvsdiyi Unelanvhi ugvwiyuhi digesvi.
\syll ᎤᏟᏰᏃ ᎠᎯᏗᏳ ᎨᎻᎵ ᎤᎦᏛᎴᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏴᎩ ᎦᏌᏁᎾᏛᏗᏱ ᎠᏃ ᎤᏪᎿᎢ ᏴᏫ ᏭᏴᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏗᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft For it is easier for a camel to go through a needle's eye, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.

\ln Unadvganvhino hia nuniwesei, Gagono yeli yatsisdelv?
\syll ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅᎯᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ, ᎦᎪᏃ ᏰᎵ ᏯᏥᏍᏕᎸ?
\ft And they that heard it said, Who then can be saved?

\ln Hiano nuwesei, Nasgi yvwi yeli igvwanadvnedi nigesvna tsigi, yeliquo igvwadvnedi Unelanvhi.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏴᏫ ᏰᎵ ᎢᎬᏩᎾᏛᏁᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏥᎩ, ᏰᎵᏉ ᎢᎬᏩᏛᏁᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ.
\ft And he said, The things which are impossible with men are possible with God.

\ln Hnaquono Quida hia niuwesei, Gvniyuquo ayv nigadiyu dogiyosonv, ale itsvsdawadenv.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏈᏓ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎤᏪᏎᎢ, ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎠᏴ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏙᎩᏲᏐᏅ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏨᏍᏓᏩᏕᏅ.
\ft Then Peter said, Lo, we have left all, and followed thee.

\ln Hiano niduweselei, Udohiyuhiya hia nitsvweseha, Vtla gilo tsuwvdetsvhi yigi ganelvi, ale tsugayvligei, ale analinvtli, ale udalii, ale tsuwetsi, nvdayulisdotanvhi Unelanvhi ugvwiyuhi gesvi,
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ, ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᏧᏮᏕᏨᎯ ᏱᎩ ᎦᏁᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏟ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᎵᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏪᏥ, ᏅᏓᏳᎵᏍᏙᏔᏅᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ,
\ft And he said unto them, Verily I say unto you, There is no man that hath left house, or parents, or brethren, or wife, or children, for the kingdom of God's sake,

\ln Nasgi atsinedi nigesvna gesv utsati iyuwagudi gohi gesvi, soiyino digesv gvnidv winasdvna.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏥᏁᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎢᏳᏩᎫᏗ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏐᎢᏱᏃ ᏗᎨᏒ ᎬᏂᏛ ᏫᎾᏍᏛᎾ.
\ft Who shall not receive manifold more in this present time, and in the world to come life everlasting.

\ln Hnaquono taladu iyanidv iyvdv widutinvstanei, ale hia niduweselei, Gvniyuquo Tsilusilimi widigati, ale nigav dunowelv anadolehosgi yvwi Uwetsi atsinohesgv nasgi iyulisdodi gesesdi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏔᎳᏚ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏫᏚᏘᏅᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᏫᏗᎦᏘ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏚᏃᏪᎸ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎠᏥᏃᎮᏍᎬ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft Then he took unto him the twelve, and said unto them, Behold, we go up to Jerusalem, and all things that are written by the prophets concerning the Son of man shall be accomplished.

\ln Tsunadalenvdvyeno yvwi dodagetsiyohiseli, ale dayegadehotani, ale dagayetsisotlvtani, ale dodayegalitsisqui,

\ln Unetsvno hia niduweselei, Ayv nasquo sudalegi datsvyadvdvni; ale sginohvsi;
\syll ᎤᏁᏨᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏑᏓᎴᎩ ᏓᏨᏯᏛᏛᏂ; ᎠᎴ ᏍᎩᏃᎲᏏ;
\ft And he answered and said unto them, I will also ask you one thing; and answer me:

\ln Tsani tsudawosdi gesvi, galvladisgo tsudalenei, yvwiquoge anehvi.
\syll ᏣᏂ ᏧᏓᏬᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎦᎸᎳᏗᏍᎪ ᏧᏓᎴᏁᎢ, ᏴᏫᏉᎨ ᎠᏁᎲᎢ.
\ft The baptism of John, was it from heaven, or of men?

\ln Dotsunadanvdvno unadanvtele hia naniwesgei, Iyuno galvladi, yogadvnv, hia yinogiwesi, Gadono tla yietsoiyunei?
\syll ᏙᏧᎾᏓᏅᏛᏃ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏖᎴ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏂᏪᏍᎨᎢ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ, ᏲᎦᏛᏅ, ᎯᎠ ᏱᏃᎩᏪᏏ, ᎦᏙᏃ Ꮭ ᏱᎡᏦᎢᏳᏁᎢ?
\ft And they reasoned with themselves, saying, If we shall say, From heaven; he will say, Why then believed ye him not?

\ln Iyuno Yvwiquo anehvi, yogadvnv, nigadvquo yvwi nvya yidegogvnisda; Tsaniyeno adolehosgi gesvgi, aneliha.
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᏴᏫᏉ ᎠᏁᎲᎢ, ᏲᎦᏛᏅ, ᏂᎦᏛᏉ ᏴᏫ ᏅᏯ ᏱᏕᎪᎬᏂᏍᏓ; ᏣᏂᏰᏃ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎨᏒᎩ, ᎠᏁᎵᎭ.
\ft But and if we say, Of men; all the people will stone us: for they be persuaded that John was a prophet.

\ln Uninetsvno, Vtla yotsigataha tsudalenvi, unadvnei.
\syll ᎤᏂᏁᏨᏃ, ᎥᏝ ᏲᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᎢ, ᎤᎾᏛᏁᎢ.
\ft And they answered, that they could not tell whence it was.

\ln Tsisano hia niduweselei, Vtla nasquo ayv yvgetsvnohvsi iyusdi gesv aqualisgasdodv hia nasgi tsidagilvwisdaneha.
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏴ ᏴᎨᏨᏃᎲᏏ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏆᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏛ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏓᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎭ.
\ft And Jesus said unto them, Neither tell I you by what authority I do these things.

\ln Ale hnaquo ulenvhe nasgi hia dutlilosdanele yvwi; Gilo iyusdi asgaya telvladi duwisei, ale dudolastane tlogesi wunilvwisdanehi, ale inv wulose gohidv wuwedolei.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎿᏉ ᎤᎴᏅᎮ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏚᏟᎶᏍᏓᏁᎴ ᏴᏫ; ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᏖᎸᎳᏗ ᏚᏫᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏙᎳᏍᏔᏁ ᏠᎨᏏ ᏭᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏅ ᏭᎶᏎ ᎪᎯᏛ ᏭᏪᏙᎴᎢ.
\ft Then began he to speak to the people this parable; A certain man planted a vineyard, and let it forth to husbandmen, and went into a far country for a long time.

\ln Nahiyuno unvnisdiyi gesv unvsidasdi unvse tlogesi tsunilvwisdanehi dinehvi, nasgi nidodagvwanvnediyi unadadvnvhi telvladi dawisvi; aseno tlogesi tsunilvwisdanehi unilivnilv asvha unigehidolei.
\syll ᏀᎢᏳᏃ ᎤᏅᏂᏍᏗᏱ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎤᏅᏎ ᏠᎨᏏ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᏗᏁᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᏙᏓᎬᏩᏅᏁᏗᏱ ᎤᎾᏓᏛᏅᎯ ᏖᎸᎳᏗ ᏓᏫᏒᎢ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᏠᎨᏏ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᎤᏂᎵᎥᏂᎸ ᎠᏒᎭ ᎤᏂᎨᎯᏙᎴᎢ.
\ft And at the season he sent a servant to the husbandmen, that they should give him of the fruit of the vineyard: but the husbandmen beat him, and sent him away empty.

\ln Ale taline nvwadale unvse unvsidasdi gagvwanisotlvtanv, asvha unigehidolei.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏔᎵᏁ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᎤᏅᏎ ᎤᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎦᎬᏩᏂᏐᏢᏔᏅ, ᎠᏒᎭ ᎤᏂᎨᎯᏙᎴᎢ.
\ft And again he sent another servant: and they beat him also, and entreated him shamefully, and sent him away empty.

\ln Alewo tsoine unvsei; nasgino nasquo unisonvnv uninugowisei.
\syll ᎠᎴᏬ ᏦᎢᏁ ᎤᏅᏎᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᏂᏐᏅᏅ ᎤᏂᏄᎪᏫᏎᎢ.
\ft And again he sent a third: and they wounded him also, and cast him out.

\ln Hnaquono telvladi dawisv utseliga, hia nuwesei, Gado dagadvneli?  Aquetsi tsigeyui datsinvsi; yanilvquoda yigi nasgi anigohvha.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏖᎸᎳᏗ ᏓᏫᏒ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎦᏙ ᏓᎦᏛᏁᎵ?  ᎠᏇᏥ ᏥᎨᏳᎢ ᏓᏥᏅᏏ; ᏯᏂᎸᏉᏓ ᏱᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏂᎪᎲᎭ.
\ft Then said the lord of the vineyard, What shall I do? I will send my beloved son: it may be they will reverence him when they see him.

\ln Aseno tlogesi tsunilvwisdanehi unigohv, unvsv gesv unalinohele hia nidunadaweselei, Hia nasgi utiyedi tsigi tsugvwalodi, Ka, ediluga, nasgino tsugvwalodi utiyasdanedi gesv igatseli yinigalisda.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᏠᎨᏏ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᎤᏂᎪᎲ, ᎤᏅᏒ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎾᎵᏃᎮᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᎾᏓᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏘᏰᏗ ᏥᎩ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ, Ꭷ, ᎡᏗᎷᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎤᏘᏯᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᏱᏂᎦᎵᏍᏓ.
\ft But when the husbandmen saw him, they reasoned among themselves, saying, This is the heir: come, let us kill him, that the inheritance may be ours.

\ln Howano uninugowisv telvladi dawisvi, unilei.  Nasgi iyusdi nasgi na telvladi dawisv utseliga gado dodagvneli nasgi?
\syll ᎰᏩᏃ ᎤᏂᏄᎪᏫᏒ ᏖᎸᎳᏗ ᏓᏫᏒᎢ, ᎤᏂᎴᎢ.  ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏖᎸᎳᏗ ᏓᏫᏒ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᎦᏙ ᏙᏓᎬᏁᎵ ᎾᏍᎩ?
\ft So they cast him out of the vineyard, and killed him. What therefore shall the lord of the vineyard do unto them?

\ln Dagalutsi ale dodvdvtani nasgi na tlogesi tsunilvwisdanehi, ale nvwanadale dodvneli telvladi dawisvi.  Nasgino unadvganelv, Vtlesdi, unadvnei.
\syll ᏓᎦᎷᏥ ᎠᎴ ᏙᏛᏛᏔᏂ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏠᎨᏏ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴ ᏙᏛᏁᎵ ᏖᎸᎳᏗ ᏓᏫᏒᎢ.  ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏁᎸ, ᎥᏞᏍᏗ, ᎤᎾᏛᏁᎢ.
\ft He shall come and destroy these husbandmen, and shall give the vineyard to others. And when they heard it, they said, God forbid.

\ln Dukahnanvno, hia nuwesei, Gadono nasgi hia tsinigvnv tsigowela, Dinanesgesgi uniyoiselvhi nvya nasgi nugvwiyusv unvsiyv adi nulistanv?
\syll ᏚᎧᎿᏅᏃ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎦᏙᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᎬᏅ ᏥᎪᏪᎳ, ᏗᎾᏁᏍᎨᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᏲᎢᏎᎸᎯ ᏅᏯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎤᏅᏏᏴ ᎠᏗ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ?
\ft And he beheld them, and said, What is this then that is written, The stone which the builders rejected, the same is become the head of the corner?

\ln Gilo nasgi nahna nvyohi atlvtsvha dayusonvni; gilono nasgi usonvha dayuwedawotani.
\syll ᎩᎶ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏀᎾ ᏅᏲᎯ ᎠᏢᏨᎭ ᏓᏳᏐᏅᏂ; ᎩᎶᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏐᏅᎭ ᏓᏳᏪᏓᏬᏔᏂ.
\ft Whosoever shall fall upon that stone shall be broken; but on whomsoever it shall fall, it will grind him to powder.

\ln Nunigvwiyusvno atsilvanelohi ale dinowelisgi nahiyuquo unanelotane uniniyvdiyi, aseno dunisgale yvwi; unadolehoseyeno nasgi hia dutlilostanv unvsv getsidvgvi.
\syll ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒᏃ ᎠᏥᎸᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏃᏪᎵᏍᎩ ᏀᎢᏳᏉ ᎤᎾᏁᎶᏔᏁ ᎤᏂᏂᏴᏗᏱ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᏚᏂᏍᎦᎴ ᏴᏫ; ᎤᎾᏙᎴᎰᏎᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏚᏟᎶᏍᏔᏅ ᎤᏅᏒ ᎨᏥᏛᎬᎢ.
\ft And the chief priests and the scribes the same hour sought to lay hands on him; and they feared the people: for they perceived that he had spoken this parable against them.

\ln Gvwagasayasdeno, ale dotsuninvse anadagasayasdisgi, nasgi unadanvti unatsalvdiyi nasgi gvwagonelohisediyi gawonisgvi, nasgino widuniyohisediyi uyeilidasdiyi ugvwiyuhi.
\syll ᎬᏩᎦᏌᏯᏍᏕᏃ, ᎠᎴ ᏙᏧᏂᏅᏎ ᎠᎾᏓᎦᏌᏯᏍᏗᏍᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ ᎤᎾᏣᎸᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏩᎪᏁᎶᎯᏎᏗᏱ ᎦᏬᏂᏍᎬᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏫᏚᏂᏲᎯᏎᏗᏱ ᎤᏰᎢᎵᏓᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ.
\ft And they watched him, and sent forth spies, which should feign themselves just men, that they might take hold of his words, that so they might deliver him unto the power and authority of the governor.

\ln Gvwadvdvneno hia nuniwesei, Tadeyohvsgi, otsigataha hiwonisgv ale dehadeyohvsgv duyugodv gesei, ale nitilvquododvna gesv nunasdv yvwi, Unelanvhisgini utseli ganvnv udohiyuhiya dehadeyohvsgvi;
\syll ᎬᏩᏛᏛᏁᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ, ᏔᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ, ᎣᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᎯᏬᏂᏍᎬ ᎠᎴ ᏕᎭᏕᏲᎲᏍᎬ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᏘᎸᏉᏙᏛᎾ ᎨᏒ ᏄᎾᏍᏛ ᏴᏫ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎦᏅᏅ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᏕᎭᏕᏲᎲᏍᎬᎢ;
\ft And they asked him, saying, Master, we know that thou sayest and teachest rightly, neither acceptest thou the person of any, but teachest the way of God truly:

\ln Duyugodisgo Sisa edaguyvediyi ayeli aguyvdi gesvi, tlage?
\syll ᏚᏳᎪᏗᏍᎪ ᏏᏌ ᎡᏓᎫᏴᎡᏗᏱ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎠᎫᏴᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏝᎨ?
\ft Is it lawful for us to give tribute unto Caesar, or no?

\ln Aseno udolehose anisinasanvgvi, ale hia niduweselei, Gadono isgisadvvsga?
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏙᎴᎰᏎ ᎠᏂᏏᎾᏌᏅᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎦᏙᏃ ᎢᏍᎩᏌᏛᎥᏍᎦ?
\ft But he perceived their craftiness, and said unto them, Why tempt ye me?

\ln Tsigowadv agisi tsugvwalodi.  Gago dagatlilosdi, ale gago atsinoheha hia tsigowela?  Uninetseno, Sisa, unadvnei.
\syll ᏥᎪᏩᏛ ᎠᎩᏏ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ.  ᎦᎪ ᏓᎦᏟᎶᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᎪ ᎠᏥᏃᎮᎭ ᎯᎠ ᏥᎪᏪᎳ?  ᎤᏂᏁᏤᏃ, ᏏᏌ, ᎤᎾᏛᏁᎢ.
\ft Shew me a penny. Whose image and superscription hath it? They answered and said, Caesar's.

\ln Hiano niduweselii, Sisa adina etsaguyvsi Sisa utseliga, Unelanvhino Unelanvhi utseliga.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎵᎢ, ᏏᏌ ᎠᏗᎾ ᎡᏣᎫᏴᏏ ᏏᏌ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ.
\ft And he said unto them, Render therefore unto Caesar the things which be Caesar's, and unto God the things which be God's.

\ln Kanegvno vtla yeli gagvwanigonelohisedi yigese yvwi anigatahvi; unisquanigoseno nuwesv unetsvi, ale elaweyi unvnei.
\syll ᎧᏁᎬᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏰᎵ ᎦᎬᏩᏂᎪᏁᎶᎯᏎᏗ ᏱᎨᏎ ᏴᏫ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎲᎢ; ᎤᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏎᏃ ᏄᏪᏒ ᎤᏁᏨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎡᎳᏪᏱ ᎤᏅᏁᎢ.
\ft And they could not take hold of his words before the people: and they marvelled at his answer, and held their peace.

\ln Hnaquono gilo iyunasdi Anisadusi, nasgi tsanadayiha ayohusv dilehisodi gesvi, gvwalutselv gvwadvdvnei,
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗ ᎠᏂᏌᏚᏏ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏣᎾᏓᏱᎭ ᎠᏲᎱᏒ ᏗᎴᎯᏐᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎬᏩᎷᏤᎸ ᎬᏩᏛᏛᏁᎢ,
\ft Then came to him certain of the Sadducees, which deny that there is any resurrection; and they asked him,

\ln Hia nuniwesei,  Tadeyohvsgi, Mosi ogowenelvgi hia nogiweselvgi, Gilo dinadanvtli ayohusgesdi udalii uwekahesdi, ale tsuwetsi nanehvna ayohusgesdi, nasgi dinadanvtli adayegesdi udayvdv, ale dadvhisdanehesdi tsuwetsi dinadanvtli.
\syll ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ,  ᏔᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ, ᎼᏏ ᎣᎪᏪᏁᎸᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏃᎩᏪᏎᎸᎩ, ᎩᎶ ᏗᎾᏓᏅᏟ ᎠᏲᎱᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᏓᎵᎢ ᎤᏪᎧᎮᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏪᏥ ᎾᏁᎲᎾ ᎠᏲᎱᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎾᏓᏅᏟ ᎠᏓᏰᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᏓᏴᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᏛᎯᏍᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᏧᏪᏥ ᏗᎾᏓᏅᏟ.
\ft Saying, Master, Moses wrote unto us, If any man's brother die, having a wife, and he die without children, that his brother should take his wife, and raise up seed unto his brother.

\ln Nasgino anehvgi galiquogi iyanidv analinvtli; udaniligeno udesvnvgi, ale uyohusv tsuwetsi nanehvna.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎠᏁᎲᎩ ᎦᎵᏉᎩ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏟ; ᎤᏓᏂᎵᎨᏃ ᎤᏕᏒᏅᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏲᎱᏒ ᏧᏪᏥ ᎾᏁᎲᎾ.
\ft There were therefore seven brethren: and the first took a wife, and died without children.

\ln Ale taline wehi nasgi udayvsvgi, ale uyohusv tsuwetsi nanehvna.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏔᎵᏁ ᏪᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏓᏴᏒᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏲᎱᏒ ᏧᏪᏥ ᎾᏁᎲᎾ.
\ft And the second took her to wife, and he died childless.

\ln Ale tsoine wehi udayvsvgi; ale nasgiya nasquo galiquogi iyanidv; ale tsunetsi nanehvna duniyohusvgi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏦᎢᏁ ᏪᎯ ᎤᏓᏴᏒᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎦᎵᏉᎩ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ; ᎠᎴ ᏧᏁᏥ ᎾᏁᎲᎾ ᏚᏂᏲᎱᏒᎩ.
\ft And the third took her; and in like manner the seven also: and they left no children, and died.

\ln Oniyino ageyv nasquo uyohusvgi.
\syll ᎣᏂᏱᏃ ᎠᎨᏴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᏲᎱᏒᎩ.
\ft Last of all the woman died also.

\ln Nasgino hnaquo dilehisodi nigalistanilvha, gago udalii gesesdi nasgi, galiquogiyeno iyanidv unadayvdv igi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎿᏉ ᏗᎴᎯᏐᏗ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏔᏂᎸᎭ, ᎦᎪ ᎤᏓᎵᎢ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ, ᎦᎵᏉᎩᏰᏃ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᎤᎾᏓᏴᏛ ᎢᎩ.
\ft Therefore in the resurrection whose wife of them is she? for seven had her to wife.

\ln Tsisano unetsv hia niduweselei, Ani elohi anehi danadesvhvsgoi ale degetsiyegoi;
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎠᏂ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎠᏁᎯ ᏓᎾᏕᏒᎲᏍᎪᎢ ᎠᎴ ᏕᎨᏥᏰᎪᎢ;
\ft And Jesus answering said unto them, The children of this world marry, and are given in marriage:

\ln Nasgisgini soiyi digesv ale ayohusv dilehisodi gesv yeliquo gvwanateladisdi getsiyelvhi, vtla yidanadesvhvsgoi, vtla ale yidigetsiyegoi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ ᏐᎢᏱ ᏗᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏲᎱᏒ ᏗᎴᎯᏐᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏰᎵᏉ ᎬᏩᎾᏖᎳᏗᏍᏗ ᎨᏥᏰᎸᎯ, ᎥᏝ ᏱᏓᎾᏕᏒᎲᏍᎪᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᏱᏗᎨᏥᏰᎪᎢ.
\ft But they which shall be accounted worthy to obtain that world, and the resurrection from the dead, neither marry, nor are given in marriage:

\ln Vtla ale hnaquo digvwaniyohuhisdi yigesesdi; dinikahnawadidohisgini galvladi anehi nunasdv nasgiya nunasdesdi; ale Unelanvhi tsuwetsi nasgi, ayohusv dilehisodi gesv tsuwetsi gesv iyusdi.
\syll ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎿᏉ ᏗᎬᏩᏂᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᏗᏂᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎠᏁᎯ ᏄᎾᏍᏛ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᎾᏍᏕᏍᏗ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᏪᏥ ᎾᏍᎩ, ᎠᏲᎱᏒ ᏗᎴᎯᏐᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏧᏪᏥ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ.
\ft Neither can they die any more: for they are equal unto the angels; and are the children of God, being the children of the resurrection.

\ln Nano tsuniyohusvhi tsunalehisodi gesv, Yisi gvnigesv nuwanele uweyodadvi, nahiyu Yihowa Unelanvhi Equahami utseliga, ale Unelanvhi Esigi utseliga, ale Unelanvhi Tsegaqui utseliga, tsuwoselei.
\syll ᎾᏃ ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᏧᎾᎴᎯᏐᏗ ᎨᏒ, ᏱᏏ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏄᏩᏁᎴ ᎤᏪᏲᏓᏛᎢ, ᏀᎢᏳ ᏱᎰᏩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎡᏆᎭᎻ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎡᏏᎩ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏤᎦᏈ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᏧᏬᏎᎴᎢ.
\ft Now that the dead are raised, even Moses shewed at the bush, when he calleth the Lord the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.

\ln Unelanvhiyeno vtla tsuniyohusvhi unatseliga yigi, dinvnodvsgini; nasgiyeno adanvtesgv nigadiyu dinvnodv.
\syll ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ ᏱᎩ, ᏗᏅᏃᏛᏍᎩᏂ; ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎠᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏗᏅᏃᏛ.
\ft For he is not a God of the dead, but of the living: for all live unto him.

\ln Hnaquono gilo iyunasdi dinowelisgi uninetse hia nuniwesei, Tadeyohvsgi, yeligaya niwi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗ ᏗᏃᏪᎵᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᏁᏤ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ, ᏔᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ, ᏰᎵᎦᏯ ᏂᏫ.
\ft Then certain of the scribes answering said, Master, thou hast well said.

\ln Nahiyuno iyudalenvdv anisgaihe gohusdi gvwadvdvdiyi.
\syll ᏀᎢᏳᏃ ᎢᏳᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᎢᎮ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎬᏩᏛᏛᏗᏱ.
\ft And after that they durst not ask him any question at all.

\ln Hiano niduweselei, gado digalisdodiha Galonedv Dewi uwetsi tsanadiha?
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎦᏙ ᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏕᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᏣᎾᏗᎭ?
\ft And he said unto them, How say they that Christ is David's son?

\ln Dewino uwasv hia nigaweha Dikanogisdiyi goweli, Yihowa hia nuwesele Ugvwiyuhi aquatseliga, Tsigatisi iditlv tsolesdi,
\syll ᏕᏫᏃ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᎭ ᏗᎧᏃᎩᏍᏗᏱ ᎪᏪᎵ, ᏱᎰᏩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᏆᏤᎵᎦ, ᏥᎦᏘᏏ ᎢᏗᏢ ᏦᎴᏍᏗ,
\ft And David himself saith in the book of Psalms, The LORD said unto my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand,

\ln Gvni getsasgagi ditsalasidiyi gasgilo nigatsiyvnelvha.
\syll ᎬᏂ ᎨᏣᏍᎦᎩ ᏗᏣᎳᏏᏗᏱ ᎦᏍᎩᎶ ᏂᎦᏥᏴᏁᎸᎭ.
\ft Till I make thine enemies thy footstool.

\ln Dewiyeno Tsagvwiyuhi goseha; gadono digalisdodiha uwetsi igi?
\syll ᏕᏫᏰᏃ ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎪᏎᎭ; ᎦᏙᏃ ᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎢᎩ?
\ft David therefore calleth him Lord, how is he then his son?

\ln Hnaquono nigadv yvwi unadvdasdv, hia niduwesele gvwasdawadidohi,
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏴᏫ ᎤᎾᏛᏓᏍᏛ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ,
\ft Then in the audience of all the people he said unto his disciples,

\ln Detseyadotsehesdi dinowelisgi, nasgi tsunadulisgo diganvhidv tsunanuwai unedasdiyi, ale osiyu tsuniyelvha getsiyolisdiyi diganododiyi, ale nugvwiyusv degasgilv digalawiisdiyi, ale nugvwiyusv dinatlvdiyi danalisdayvhvsgvi;
\syll ᏕᏤᏯᏙᏤᎮᏍᏗ ᏗᏃᏪᎵᏍᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᎾᏚᎵᏍᎪ ᏗᎦᏅᎯᏛ ᏧᎾᏄᏩᎢ ᎤᏁᏓᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎣᏏᏳ ᏧᏂᏰᎸᎭ ᎨᏥᏲᎵᏍᏗᏱ ᏗᎦᏃᏙᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᏕᎦᏍᎩᎸ ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᏗᎾᏢᏗᏱ ᏓᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎬᎢ;
\ft Beware of the scribes, which desire to walk in long robes, and love greetings in the markets, and the highest seats in the synagogues, and the chief rooms at feasts;

\ln Nasgi tsidanisvneho tsunosulotsvhi daninelvi, ale unatlonasdv gohidiyu tsanadadolisdisgoi; nasgi utlihiyu igai unigiliyoisdi gesesdi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏓᏂᏒᏁᎰ ᏧᏃᏑᎶᏨᎯ ᏓᏂᏁᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏠᎾᏍᏛ ᎪᎯᏗᏳ ᏣᎾᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎪᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏟᎯᏳ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎤᏂᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft Which devour widows' houses, and for a shew make long prayers: the same shall receive greater damnation.

\ln Dukahnanvno dugohe tsunehnai anihvsge adelvdidiyi unalisgolvtanvhi.
\syll ᏚᎧᎿᏅᏃ ᏚᎪᎮ ᏧᏁᎿᎢ ᎠᏂᎲᏍᎨ ᎠᏕᎸᏗᏗᏱ ᎤᎾᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏅᎯ.
\ft And he looked up, and saw the rich men casting their gifts into the treasury.

\ln Ale nasquo ugohe gilo iyusdi uyo iyudvhnadegi uwosulotsvhi nahna ahvsge tali aginudvdi iyadanvtedi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᎪᎮ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᏲ ᎢᏳᏛᎿᏕᎩ ᎤᏬᏑᎶᏨᎯ ᏀᎾ ᎠᎲᏍᎨ ᏔᎵ ᎠᎩᏄᏛᏗ ᎢᏯᏓᏅᏖᏗ.
\ft And he saw also a certain poor widow casting in thither two mites.

\ln Hiano nuwesei, Udohiyuhiya itsvyoseha, hia nasgi uyo iyudvhnadegi uwosulotsvhi utli igai ahvga esgaquo nigadv anisoi.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎢᏨᏲᏎᎭ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏲ ᎢᏳᏛᎿᏕᎩ ᎤᏬᏑᎶᏨᎯ ᎤᏟ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎠᎲᎦ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎠᏂᏐᎢ.
\ft And he said, Of a truth I say unto you, that this poor widow hath cast in more than they all:

\ln Hiayeno nigadv utsati unihv unotsaledv anihvga Unelanvhi alisgolvdanedi gesvi; hiasgini uyo iyudvhnadegi gesv nigadiyu ulisdelvdodi uhvahvga.
\syll ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᏂᎲ ᎤᏃᏣᎴᏛ ᎠᏂᎲᎦ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎯᎠᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏲ ᎢᏳᏛᎿᏕᎩ ᎨᏒ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᎤᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ ᎤᎲᎠᎲᎦ.
\ft For all these have of their abundance cast in unto the offerings of God: but she of her penury hath cast in all the living that she had.

\ln Igadvno unineistanv udvnadigalawiisdiyi, nigav goduisdv gvtanvnvya tsuwoduhi ale dilisgolvtanvhi, hia nuwesei;
\syll ᎢᎦᏛᏃ ᎤᏂᏁᎢᏍᏔᏅ ᎤᏛᎾᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᏂᎦᎥ ᎪᏚᎢᏍᏛ ᎬᏔᏅᏅᏯ ᏧᏬᏚᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏅᎯ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ;
\ft And as some spake of the temple, how it was adorned with goodly stones and gifts, he said,

\ln Hiano nasgi tsidetsigowadiha, dvsqualvhi, nasgi vtla saquounv nvya yidudasatlahesdi nasgi nigohvtanvna yigesesdi.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏕᏥᎪᏩᏗᎭ, ᏛᏍᏆᎸᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎥᏝ ᏌᏉᎤᏅ ᏅᏯ ᏱᏚᏓᏌᏝᎮᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎪᎲᏔᏅᎾ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft As for these things which ye behold, the days will come, in the which there shall not be left one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down.

\ln Gvwadvdvneno hia nuniwesei, Tadeyohvsgi, ilagono iyu hia nasgi nvdagalistani?  Ale gado usdi uyelvdv gesesdi nahiyu hia nasgi tsudalenvdv aliyeilolvha?
\syll ᎬᏩᏛᏛᏁᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ, ᏔᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ, ᎢᎳᎪᏃ ᎢᏳ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏔᏂ?  ᎠᎴ ᎦᏙ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎤᏰᎸᏛ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏀᎢᏳ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎠᎵᏰᎢᎶᎸᎭ?
\ft And they asked him, saying, Master, but when shall these things be? and what sign will there be when these things shall come to pass?

\ln Hiano nuwesei, Itseyatahesdi tlesdi tsietsilonastani; unitsatesdiyeno ayv daquadov aniluhisdisgesdi, Ayv [Galonedv] anadisgesdi, ale hnaquo usqualvhidi; nasgi iyusdi tlesdi ditsisdawadvsvgi.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎢᏤᏯᏔᎮᏍᏗ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏥᎡᏥᎶᎾᏍᏔᏂ; ᎤᏂᏣᏖᏍᏗᏰᏃ ᎠᏴ ᏓᏆᏙᎥ ᎠᏂᎷᎯᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᏴ ᎦᎶᏁᏛdata is invalid ᎠᎾᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎿᏉ ᎤᏍᏆᎸᎯᏗ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏗᏥᏍᏓᏩᏛᏒᎩ.
\ft And he said, Take heed that ye be not deceived: for many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ; and the time draweth near: go ye not therefore after them.

\ln Aseno itsadvgisgesdi danvwa ale tsudalenvdv nigalistanidohvi, tlesdi yitsisgaihesdi; hiayeno nasgi ase igvyi iyulisdodi, vtlasgini igvwenvdvquo ulisquadisdi yigesesdi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎢᏣᏛᎩᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏓᏅᏩ ᎠᎴ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏔᏂᏙᎲᎢ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏥᏍᎦᎢᎮᏍᏗ; ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏎ ᎢᎬᏱ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗ, ᎥᏝᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᎬᏪᏅᏛᏉ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft But when ye shall hear of wars and commotions, be not terrified: for these things must first come to pass; but the end is not by and by.

\ln Hnaquono hia niduweselei, Tsunadalenvdv yvwi dodvnaleni dodvnadatlutani, ale ayeli dudotlvwadisv dodvnadatlutani;
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᏙᏛᎾᎴᏂ ᏙᏛᎾᏓᏡᏔᏂ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏰᎵ ᏚᏙᏢᏩᏗᏒ ᏙᏛᎾᏓᏡᏔᏂ;
\ft Then said he unto them, Nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom:

\ln Ale gadohi utsati dalitelvnidohesdi, ale dagonulosidohesdi; ale vyugihiyu nigalistanidohesdi; ale unayehisdiyu ale usquanigodi uyelvdv gananugogesdi galvloi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎦᏙᎯ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏓᎵᏖᎸᏂᏙᎮᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᎪᏄᎶᏏᏙᎮᏍᏗ; ᎠᎴ ᎥᏳᎩᎯᏳ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏔᏂᏙᎮᏍᏗ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏰᎯᏍᏗᏳ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᎤᏰᎸᏛ ᎦᎾᏄᎪᎨᏍᏗ ᎦᎸᎶᎢ.
\ft And great earthquakes shall be in divers places, and famines, and pestilences; and fearful sights and great signs shall there be from heaven.

\ln Aseno asi nasgi hia nigadv nulistanvna gesesdi dodagetsiniyvhi ale uyo nvdagetsvneli, degetsiyosgesdi tsunilawiisdiyi, ale didasdudiyi, ale detsadinohihesdi unigvwiyuhi ale nunigvwiyusadegi dunolv igvyiditlv ayv daquadov nvdigalisdodisgesdi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᏏ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎾ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏙᏓᎨᏥᏂᏴᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏲ ᏅᏓᎨᏨᏁᎵ, ᏕᎨᏥᏲᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏧᏂᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏓᏍᏚᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᏣᏗᏃᎯᎮᏍᏗ ᎤᏂᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ ᏚᏃᎸ ᎢᎬᏱᏗᏢ ᎠᏴ ᏓᏆᏙᎥ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
\ft But before all these, they shall lay their hands on you, and persecute you, delivering you up to the synagogues, and into prisons, being brought before kings and rulers for my name's sake.

\ln Ale nasgi kanohesgi itsalisde lvdodi nigalisdisgesdi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎧᏃᎮᏍᎩ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏕ ᎸᏙᏗ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
\ft And it shall turn to you for a testimony.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi niditsugodesdi detsadanvdvi asiquo udalulesdi, itsadanvtehisodiyi nigesvna itsiwesdiyi itsalisdelisgvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏂᏗᏧᎪᏕᏍᏗ ᏕᏣᏓᏅᏛᎢ ᎠᏏᏉ ᎤᏓᎷᎴᏍᏗ, ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏖᎯᏐᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᏥᏪᏍᏗᏱ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏕᎵᏍᎬᎢ.
\ft Settle it therefore in your hearts, not to meditate before what ye shall answer:

\ln Ayvyeno datsvneli itsiwesdiyi ale agadovhisdi gesv nasgi nigadv getsaquidisgi yeli digvwanigatilvsdi ale gvwaniselugisdi nigesvna gesesdi.
\syll ᎠᏴᏰᏃ ᏓᏨᏁᎵ ᎢᏥᏪᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎨᏣᏈᏗᏍᎩ ᏰᎵ ᏗᎬᏩᏂᎦᏘᎸᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᏂᏎᎷᎩᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft For I will give you a mouth and wisdom, which all your adversaries shall not be able to gainsay nor resist.

\ln Ale degetsiyosgesdi ditsigayvligei, ale itsalinvtli, ale gohusdi ditsadadvhna, ale ditsalii; ale nasgi nvdvnvnisani gilo nihi tsetsiisdi gesesdi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏕᎨᏥᏲᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏗᏥᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏣᎵᏅᏟ, ᎠᎴ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏗᏣᏓᏛᎿ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏣᎵᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏛᏅᏂᏌᏂ ᎩᎶ ᏂᎯ ᏤᏥᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft And ye shall be betrayed both by parents, and brethren, and kinsfolks, and friends; and some of you shall they cause to be put to death.

\ln Ale nigadiyu yvwi getsisgagi gesesdi yvwi daquadov nvdigalisdodisgesdi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏴᏫ ᎨᏥᏍᎦᎩ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏴᏫ ᏓᏆᏙᎥ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
\ft And ye shall be hated of all men for my name's sake.

\ln Aseno vtla saquounv itsisdiyegv itsisgoli uyohuhisdi yigesesdi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏌᏉᎤᏅ ᎢᏥᏍᏗᏰᎬ ᎢᏥᏍᎪᎵ ᎤᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft But there shall not an hair of your head perish.

\ln Ditsvnidiyu gesv detsisdelvdodisgesdi ditsadanvdogi.
\syll ᏗᏨᏂᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᏕᏥᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏗᏣᏓᏅᏙᎩ.
\ft In your patience possess ye your souls.

\ln Tsilusilimino itsigowatisgesdi aniyawisgi hnaquo dunaduwisdesdi, itsigatahesdi nasgi uyoisdi gesv usqualvhidisvi.
\syll ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻᏃ ᎢᏥᎪᏩᏘᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᏂᏯᏫᏍᎩ ᎿᏉ ᏚᎾᏚᏫᏍᏕᏍᏗ, ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎮᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏲᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏍᏆᎸᎯᏗᏒᎢ.
\ft And when ye shall see Jerusalem compassed with armies, then know that the desolation thereof is nigh.

\ln Hnaquo nasgi Tsudiyi anehi analisvha odali wanilosvha; ale nasgi ayeli gesv anedohi aninugotsvha; iyvdvno wuwagudv dinehi tlesdi nahna yuniyvlesdi.
\syll ᎿᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏗᏱ ᎠᏁᎯ ᎠᎾᎵᏒᎭ ᎣᏓᎵ ᏩᏂᎶᏒᎭ; ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏁᏙᎯ ᎠᏂᏄᎪᏨᎭ; ᎢᏴᏛᏃ ᏭᏩᎫᏛ ᏗᏁᎯ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏀᎾ ᏳᏂᏴᎴᏍᏗ.
\ft Then let them which are in Judaea flee to the mountains; and let them which are in the midst of it depart out; and let not them that are in the countries enter thereinto.

\ln Utlegiyeno nahiyu gesv uliyilohisdi gesesdi, nasgi nigadiyu gowelanvhi gesv nasgi iyulisdodiyi.
\syll ᎤᏞᎩᏰᏃ ᏀᎢᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎵᏱᎶᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᎪᏪᎳᏅᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
\ft For these be the days of vengeance, that all things which are written may be fulfilled.

\ln Dininelidvsgini ale tsunisdai uyoiyu iyunalisdanedi gesesdi nahiyu gesvi!  utsatiyeno agiliya ehesdi ani gadohi, ale utalawohisdi gesv unilutsedi gesesdi hia yvwi.
\syll ᏗᏂᏁᎵᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᎴ ᏧᏂᏍᏓᎢ ᎤᏲᎢᏳ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏀᎢᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ  ᎤᏣᏘᏰᏃ ᎠᎩᎵᏯ ᎡᎮᏍᏗ ᎠᏂ ᎦᏙᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏔᎳᏬᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏂᎷᏤᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎯᎠ ᏴᏫ.
\ft But woe unto them that are with child, and to them that give suck, in those days! for there shall be great distress in the land, and wrath upon this people.

\ln Ayelasdinoganvhidv tsuninvisdodi gesesdi, ale digetsiyvginvhi Tsunadalenvdv yvwi danewadisv widigegatinvsdvdi gesesdi; Tsilusilimino Tsunadalenvdv yvwi unalasdaedi gesesdi, gvni asquadvha tsunadalenvdv yvwi gegadanelanelvhi gesvi.
\syll ᎠᏰᎳᏍᏗᏃᎦᏅᎯᏛ ᏧᏂᏅᎢᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎨᏥᏴᎩᏅᎯ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᏓᏁᏩᏗᏒ ᏫᏗᎨᎦᏘᏅᏍᏛᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻᏃ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᎤᎾᎳᏍᏓᎡᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎬᏂ ᎠᏍᏆᏛᎭ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᎨᎦᏓᏁᎳᏁᎸᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft And they shall fall by the edge of the sword, and shall be led away captive into all nations: and Jerusalem shall be trodden down of the Gentiles, until the times of the Gentiles be fulfilled.

\ln Uyelvdvno agowadvdi gesesdi nvdo iga ehi kalvi, ale nvdo svnoyi ehi kalvi, ale noquisi anikalvi; ale elohi tsunadalenvdv yvwi anehv uwelihisdi, ale udeyadodi nvdayunalisdaneli; amequohi ale ama dalisdilanegv usquanoyvgesdi;
\syll ᎤᏰᎸᏛᏃ ᎠᎪᏩᏛᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏅᏙ ᎢᎦ ᎡᎯ ᎧᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏅᏙ ᏒᏃᏱ ᎡᎯ ᎧᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏃᏈᏏ ᎠᏂᎧᎸᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᎠᏁᎲ ᎤᏪᎵᎯᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏕᏯᏙᏗ ᏅᏓᏳᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᎵ; ᎠᎺᏉᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎹ ᏓᎵᏍᏗᎳᏁᎬ ᎤᏍᏆᏃᏴᎨᏍᏗ;
\ft And there shall be signs in the sun, and in the moon, and in the stars; and upon the earth distress of nations, with perplexity; the sea and the waves roaring;

\ln Yvwi dunadanvdv dulvdehihesdi nvdigalisdodisgesdi aninayesgv ale anigatenohv nasgi tsudalenvdv elanigv unanugoisdi gesvi; unitsatiyeno galvlo tsanikala dvnalitelvni.
\syll ᏴᏫ ᏚᎾᏓᏅᏛ ᏚᎸᏕᎯᎮᏍᏗ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᏂᎾᏰᏍᎬ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᎦᏖᏃᎲ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎡᎳᏂᎬ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎤᏂᏣᏘᏰᏃ ᎦᎸᎶ ᏣᏂᎧᎳ ᏛᎾᎵᏖᎸᏂ.
\ft Men's hearts failing them for fear, and for looking after those things which are coming on the earth: for the powers of heaven shall be shaken.

\ln Hnaquono dvnigohi yvwi Uwetsi tsaisesdi ulogilvi ulinigidv ale utsati galvquodi nvtsudvhnadisesdi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏛᏂᎪᎯ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᏣᎢᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᎶᎩᎸᎢ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎦᎸᏉᏗ ᏅᏧᏛᎿᏗᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft And then shall they see the Son of man coming in a cloud with power and great glory.

\ln Nasgino hia tsudalenvdv alenvhvha nasgi nigalisdisgesdi, hnaquo galvladi widitsakananvha, ale detsisaladanvha ditsisgoli; etsudalesdiyeno gesv navniyu tsaisesdi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎠᎴᏅᎲᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎿᏉ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏫᏗᏣᎧᎾᏅᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᏥᏌᎳᏓᏅᎭ ᏗᏥᏍᎪᎵ; ᎡᏧᏓᎴᏍᏗᏰᏃ ᎨᏒ ᎾᎥᏂᏳ ᏣᎢᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft And when these things begin to come to pass, then look up, and lift up your heads; for your redemption draweth nigh.

\ln Unetseno dutlilosdanelei; Ditsakanvga egataiyusdi tlugvi, ale nigav detlugvi;
\syll ᎤᏁᏤᏃ ᏚᏟᎶᏍᏓᏁᎴᎢ; ᏗᏣᎧᏅᎦ ᎡᎦᏔᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏡᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏕᏡᎬᎢ;
\ft And he spake to them a parable; Behold the fig tree, and all the trees;

\ln Hnaquo gila tsigalasduhvsgoi, nasgi itsigowadv itsvsvquo gesv itsigatahogogi hnaquo navniyu gesvi.
\syll ᎿᏉ ᎩᎳ ᏥᎦᎳᏍᏚᎲᏍᎪᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏥᎪᏩᏛ ᎢᏨᏒᏉ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎰᎪᎩ ᎿᏉ ᎾᎥᏂᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft When they now shoot forth, ye see and know of your own selves that summer is now nigh at hand.

\ln Nasgiya nasquo nihi hia nasgi tsudalenvdv nigalisdisgv itsigowatisgesdi, itsigatahesdi Unelanvhi ugvwiyuhi gesv navniyu gesvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏂᎯ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᎢᏥᎪᏩᏘᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎮᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎾᎥᏂᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft So likewise ye, when ye see these things come to pass, know ye that the kingdom of God is nigh at hand.

\ln Udohiyuhiya hia nitsvweseha, Gohi tsaneha vtla yvdvnilosoni gvni nasgi hia nigadiyu nigalistanvha.
\syll ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ, ᎪᎯ ᏣᏁᎭ ᎥᏝ ᏴᏛᏂᎶᏐᏂ ᎬᏂ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏔᏅᎭ.
\ft Verily I say unto you, This generation shall not pass away, till all be fulfilled.

\ln Galvloi ale elohi dvnilosoni; aginetsvsgini vtla yvdagalosoni.
\syll ᎦᎸᎶᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏛᏂᎶᏐᏂ; ᎠᎩᏁᏨᏍᎩᏂ ᎥᏝ ᏴᏓᎦᎶᏐᏂ.
\ft Heaven and earth shall pass away: but my words shall not pass away.

\ln Ale itsadagasayasdesdi itsvsv gesvi, tlesdi ilvhiyu detsadanvdv gagedv yinitsalisdanehesdi yinvdigalisdodisgesdi itsilosvsdisgv itsalisdayvhvsgvi, ale detsiyvsdesgvi, ale elohi adanvtedi gesvi, nasgino nahiyu iga nitselisgvna itsilutsediyi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎢᏣᏓᎦᏌᏯᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᎢᏨᏒ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᏕᏣᏓᏅᏛ ᎦᎨᏛ ᏱᏂᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᏱᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎢᏥᎶᏒᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᏥᏴᏍᏕᏍᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎠᏓᏅᏖᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏀᎢᏳ ᎢᎦ ᏂᏤᎵᏍᎬᎾ ᎢᏥᎷᏤᏗᏱ.
\ft And take heed to yourselves, lest at any time your hearts be overcharged with surfeiting, and drunkenness, and cares of this life, and so that day come upon you unawares.

\ln Tsasadoyeno igagadv dayunilutseli nigvnadv dinehi.
\syll ᏣᏌᏙᏰᏃ ᎢᎦᎦᏛ ᏓᏳᏂᎷᏤᎵ ᏂᎬᎾᏛ ᏗᏁᎯ.
\ft For as a snare shall it come on all them that dwell on the face of the whole earth.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi itsiyawisgesdi nigohilvi, itsadadolisdisgesdi, nasgino yeliquo hia nigadv tsudalenvdv uliyeilohisdi tsigi gvwanadiwisedi, ale yvwi Uwetse uwolv igvyiditlv gvwanaledi gayetselisedi yinigalisda.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏥᏯᏫᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏂᎪᎯᎸᎢ, ᎢᏣᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏰᎵᏉ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎤᎵᏰᎢᎶᎯᏍᏗ ᏥᎩ ᎬᏩᎾᏗᏫᏎᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏤ ᎤᏬᎸ ᎢᎬᏱᏗᏢ ᎬᏩᎾᎴᏗ ᎦᏰᏤᎵᏎᏗ ᏱᏂᎦᎵᏍᏓ.
\ft Watch ye therefore, and pray always, that ye may be accounted worthy to escape all these things that shall come to pass, and to stand before the Son of man.

\ln Igano gesv dadeyohvsge udvnadigalawiisdiyi; usvno ganugogei, ale Oliwayohi tsanoseho odalv usvhihei.
\syll ᎢᎦᏃ ᎨᏒ ᏓᏕᏲᎲᏍᎨ ᎤᏛᎾᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ; ᎤᏒᏃ ᎦᏄᎪᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎣᎵᏩᏲᎯ ᏣᏃᏎᎰ ᎣᏓᎸ ᎤᏒᎯᎮᎢ.
\ft And in the day time he was teaching in the temple; and at night he went out, and abode in the mount that is called the mount of Olives.

\ln Nigadvno yvwi sunaleiyu gvwalutsehe udvnadigalawiisdiyi gvwadvdasdanediyi.
\syll ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᏴᏫ ᏑᎾᎴᎢᏳ ᎬᏩᎷᏤᎮ ᎤᏛᎾᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎬᏩᏛᏓᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ.
\ft And all the people came early in the morning to him in the temple, for to hear him.

\ln Nagotanvnano gadu agisdiyi usqualvhidisei, nasgi Kanohiyeno dilisdayvdiyi tsidudoa.
\syll ᎾᎪᏔᏅᎾᏃ ᎦᏚ ᎠᎩᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏍᏆᎸᎯᏗᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎧᏃᎯᏰᏃ ᏗᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ ᏥᏚᏙᎠ.
\ft Now the feast of unleavened bread drew nigh, which is called the Passover.

\ln Nunigvwiyusvno atsilvanelohi ale dinowelisgi uniyole iyunvnediyi unihisdiyi; danisgaiheyeno yvwi.
\syll ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒᏃ ᎠᏥᎸᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏃᏪᎵᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᏲᎴ ᎢᏳᏅᏁᏗᏱ ᎤᏂᎯᏍᏗᏱ; ᏓᏂᏍᎦᎢᎮᏰᏃ ᏴᏫ.
\ft And the chief priests and scribes sought how they might kill him; for they feared the people.

\ln Hnaquono Sedani uyvsele Tsudasi Isgaladi tsudoidv, nasgi gela gese taladu iyanidv gesvi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏎᏓᏂ ᎤᏴᏎᎴ ᏧᏓᏏ ᎢᏍᎦᎳᏗ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᎳ ᎨᏎ ᏔᎳᏚ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Then entered Satan into Judas surnamed Iscariot, being of the number of the twelve.

\ln Uwenvseno widulinohetane nunigvwiyusv atsilvanelohi ale dinadaniyisgi, iyuwanediyi [Tsisa] tsuyohisediyi.
\syll ᎤᏪᏅᏎᏃ ᏫᏚᎵᏃᎮᏔᏁ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎾᏓᏂᏱᏍᎩ, ᎢᏳᏩᏁᏗᏱ ᏥᏌdata is invalid ᏧᏲᎯᏎᏗᏱ.
\ft And he went his way, and communed with the chief priests and captains, how he might betray him unto them.

\ln Unalihelitseno, ale gvwanetsele adelv digvwanediyi.
\syll ᎤᎾᎵᎮᎵᏤᏃ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᏁᏤᎴ ᎠᏕᎸ ᏗᎬᏩᏁᏗᏱ.
\ft And they were glad, and covenanted to give him money.

\ln Uduistaneno, ale uyole tsuyohisediyi, nahiyu unigonelv unitsati.
\syll ᎤᏚᎢᏍᏔᏁᏃ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏲᎴ ᏧᏲᎯᏎᏗᏱ, ᏀᎢᏳ ᎤᏂᎪᏁᎸ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ.
\ft And he promised, and sought opportunity to betray him unto them in the absence of the multitude.

\ln Hnaquono usqualvhe nagotanvna gesv gadu agisdiyi, nasgi kanohiyegi dilisdayvdiyi ahisdi gesvi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎤᏍᏆᎸᎮ ᎾᎪᏔᏅᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎦᏚ ᎠᎩᏍᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎧᏃᎯᏰᎩ ᏗᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ ᎠᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Then came the day of unleavened bread, when the passover must be killed.

\ln [Tsisano] dunvse Quida ale Tsani, hia nuwesei, Isdena wisdadvnvisda kanohiyegi, nasgi igalisdayvdiyi.
\syll ᏥᏌᏃdata is invalid ᏚᏅᏎ ᏈᏓ ᎠᎴ ᏣᏂ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎢᏍᏕᎾ ᏫᏍᏓᏛᏅᎢᏍᏓ ᎧᏃᎯᏰᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎦᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ.
\ft And he sent Peter and John, saying, Go and prepare us the passover, that we may eat.

\ln Hiano nigvwaweselei, Hatlv tsaduliha oginadvnvisdodiyi?
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᎬᏩᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎭᏢ ᏣᏚᎵᎭ ᎣᎩᎾᏛᏅᎢᏍᏙᏗᏱ?
\ft And they said unto him, Where wilt thou that we prepare?

\ln Hiano niduweselei, Gvniyuquo, gaduhv isdiyvlvha, asgaya dodatsatlosi, ayehesdi atelido ama atlisdesdi; esdisdawadesvha adanelv wuyvlvi wisdilutsvha.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎬᏂᏳᏉ, ᎦᏚᎲ ᎢᏍᏗᏴᎸᎭ, ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᏙᏓᏣᏠᏏ, ᎠᏰᎮᏍᏗ ᎠᏖᎵᏙ ᎠᎹ ᎠᏟᏍᏕᏍᏗ; ᎡᏍᏗᏍᏓᏩᏕᏒᎭ ᎠᏓᏁᎸ ᏭᏴᎸᎢ ᏫᏍᏗᎷᏨᎭ.
\ft And he said unto them, Behold, when ye are entered into the city, there shall a man meet you, bearing a pitcher of water; follow him into the house where he entereth in.

\ln Hiano nesdiweselvha asgaya ganela, Dideyohvsgi hia nvditsaweseha, Hatlv anedohi uniyvsdiyi nahna kanohiyegi itsulaha ogalisdayvdiyi gvgisdawadidohi?
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏁᏍᏗᏪᏎᎸᎭ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎦᏁᎳ, ᏗᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏅᏗᏣᏪᏎᎭ, ᎭᏢ ᎠᏁᏙᎯ ᎤᏂᏴᏍᏗᏱ ᏀᎾ ᎧᏃᎯᏰᎩ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎣᎦᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ ᎬᎩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ?
\ft And ye shall say unto the goodman of the house, The Master saith unto thee, Where is the guestchamber, where I shall eat the passover with my disciples?

\ln Dasdasehelino udvna galvladi kanvsulv osdv igvnelvhi; nahna isdadvnvistanvha.
\syll ᏓᏍᏓᏎᎮᎵᏃ ᎤᏛᎾ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎧᏅᏑᎸ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎢᎬᏁᎸᎯ; ᏀᎾ ᎢᏍᏓᏛᏅᎢᏍᏔᏅᎭ.
\ft And he shall shew you a large upper room furnished: there make ready.

\ln Unenvseno ale wuniwadvhe nasgiya niduweselvi; unadvnvistaneno kanohiyegi dilisdayvdiyi.
\syll ᎤᏁᏅᏎᏃ ᎠᎴ ᏭᏂᏩᏛᎮ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎢ; ᎤᎾᏛᏅᎢᏍᏔᏁᏃ ᎧᏃᎯᏰᎩ ᏗᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ.
\ft And they went, and found as he had said unto them: and they made ready the passover.

\ln Usqualvhvno nahiyu gesvi, unisinei, ale nasquo taladu iyanidv getsinvsidv.
\syll ᎤᏍᏆᎸᎲᏃ ᏀᎢᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᏂᏏᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏔᎳᏚ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏛ.
\ft And when the hour was come, he sat down, and the twelve apostles with him.

\ln Hiano niduweselei, Utsati aquadulisgvgi hia kanohiyegi itsulaha igalisdayvdiyi asiquo nagigiliyotsvna.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎤᏣᏘ ᎠᏆᏚᎵᏍᎬᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎧᏃᎯᏰᎩ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎢᎦᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ ᎠᏏᏉ ᎾᎩᎩᎵᏲᏨᎾ.
\ft And he said unto them, With desire I have desired to eat this passover with you before I suffer:

\ln Itsvyoseyeno vtla hnaquo hia nasgi yvgagalisdayvda gvni ulisquadvhi gesesdi unelanvhi nahna ugvwiyuhi gesvi.
\syll ᎢᏨᏲᏎᏰᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎿᏉ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏴᎦᎦᎵᏍᏓᏴᏓ ᎬᏂ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᏛᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏀᎾ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft For I say unto you, I will not any more eat thereof, until it be fulfilled in the kingdom of God.

\ln Ugisvno ulisquidi, ale ulihelitsv, hia nuwesei; Hia itsigi ale itsiyadoga itsvsv gesvi.
\syll ᎤᎩᏒᏃ ᎤᎵᏍᏈᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᎮᎵᏨ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎯᎠ ᎢᏥᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏥᏯᏙᎦ ᎢᏨᏒ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft And he took the cup, and gave thanks, and said, Take this, and divide it among yourselves:

\ln Hiayeno nitsvweseha, Vtla yvgagadita telvladi unenvhi gvni Unelanvhi ugvwiyuhi gesv aliyeilolvha.
\syll ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ, ᎥᏝ ᏴᎦᎦᏗᏔ ᏖᎸᎳᏗ ᎤᏁᏅᎯ ᎬᏂ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎵᏰᎢᎶᎸᎭ.
\ft For I say unto you, I will not drink of the fruit of the vine, until the kingdom of God shall come.

\ln Gaduno ugisei, ale ulihelitsv, ugvhaluyei, ale dunelei, hia nuwesei, Hia nasgi ayv tsiyelvi, nasgi nihi etsaguyvtanvhi tsigi, hia nasgi nitsadvnehesdi ayv sgiyanvdadisgesdi.
\syll ᎦᏚᏃ ᎤᎩᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᎮᎵᏨ, ᎤᎬᎭᎷᏰᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏁᎴᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᏥᏰᎸᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎯ ᎡᏣᎫᏴᏔᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᎠᏴ ᏍᎩᏯᏅᏓᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
\ft And he took bread, and gave thanks, and brake it, and gave unto them, saying, This is my body which is given for you: this do in remembrance of me.

\ln Nasgiya nasquo ulisquidi [nvgise] unalisdayvnonv, hia nuwesei, hia nasgi ulisquidi itse kanohedv datlohisdvi ayv agigigvhi, nasgi nihi itsatsewotselvhi tsigi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᎵᏍᏈᏗ ᏅᎩᏎdata is invalid ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᏃᏅ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎵᏍᏈᏗ ᎢᏤ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏓᏠᎯᏍᏛᎢ ᎠᏴ ᎠᎩᎩᎬᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏣᏤᏬᏤᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ.
\ft Likewise also the cup after supper, saying, This cup is the new testament in my blood, which is shed for you.

\ln Aseno gvniyuquo nasgi uwoyeni aquatludisgi oginatequaloha ani gasgilvi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏬᏰᏂ ᎠᏆᏡᏗᏍᎩ ᎣᎩᎾᏖᏆᎶᎭ ᎠᏂ ᎦᏍᎩᎸᎢ.
\ft But, behold, the hand of him that betrayeth me is with me on the table.

\ln Ale udohiyuhiya ayv Uwetsi dayesi nasgiya dudugotanvi, aseno uyoiyu iyulisdanedi nasgi na asgaya utludisgi
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎠᏴ ᎤᏪᏥ ᏓᏰᏏ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏚᏚᎪᏔᏅᎢ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏲᎢᏳ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᏡᏗᏍᎩ
\ft And truly the Son of man goeth, as it was determined: but woe unto that man by whom he is betrayed!

\ln Unalenvheno dunadadvdvne unvsv gesv, nasgi nvdidvnelisv hia.
\syll ᎤᎾᎴᏅᎮᏃ ᏚᎾᏓᏛᏛᏁ ᎤᏅᏒ ᎨᏒ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏗᏛᏁᎵᏒ ᎯᎠ.
\ft And they began to inquire among themselves, which of them it was that should do this thing.

\ln Ale nasquo anadisvhihe nasgi na unvsv gesv utli atsilvquodiyu iyulisdodi gesvi
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᎾᏗᏒᎯᎮ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᏅᏒ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏟ ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ
\ft And there was also a strife among them, which of them should be accounted the greatest.

\ln Hiano niduweselei, unigvwiyuhi tsunadalenvdv yvwi tsunatseliga, digvwananelodvdiyi nanvneho yvwi; ale nasgi digvwananelododi iyanvnehi osdv idinadvnehi gegosehoi.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎤᏂᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᏧᎾᏤᎵᎦ, ᏗᎬᏩᎾᏁᎶᏛᏗᏱ ᎾᏅᏁᎰ ᏴᏫ; ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎬᏩᎾᏁᎶᏙᏗ ᎢᏯᏅᏁᎯ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎢᏗᎾᏛᏁᎯ ᎨᎪᏎᎰᎢ.
\ft And he said unto them, The kings of the Gentiles exercise lordship over them; and they that exercise authority upon them are called benefactors.

\ln Nihisgini vtlesdi nasgi yinitsvnesdi; nasgisgini na nihi nitsadvnv utli iyatsilvquodi; nasgi awinage nasgiya gesesdi; nasgiya na nugvwiyusadegi disdelvhidohi nasgiya gesesdi.
\syll ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎥᏞᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᏂᏨᏁᏍᏗ; ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ Ꮎ ᏂᎯ ᏂᏣᏛᏅ ᎤᏟ ᎢᏯᏥᎸᏉᏗ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏫᎾᎨ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᎾᏍᎩᏯ Ꮎ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ ᏗᏍᏕᎸᎯᏙᎯ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft But ye shall not be so: but he that is greatest among you, let him be as the younger; and he that is chief, as he that doth serve.

\ln Gagoyeno utli atsilvquodiyu, alisdayvhvsgi ano adasdelvhidohi?  Tlasgo nasgi na alisdayvhvsgi?  Ayvsgini itsvyeladidoha adasdelvhidohi nasgiyai.
\syll ᎦᎪᏰᏃ ᎤᏟ ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏗᏳ, ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎩ ᎠᏃ ᎠᏓᏍᏕᎸᎯᏙᎯ?  ᏝᏍᎪ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎩ?  ᎠᏴᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᏨᏰᎳᏗᏙᎭ ᎠᏓᏍᏕᎸᎯᏙᎯ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ.
\ft For whether is greater, he that sitteth at meat, or he that serveth? is not he that sitteth at meat? but I am among you as he that serveth.

\ln Nihisgini nasgi nitsisuligogvna igedolvhi uyo naqualisdanelidohvi;
\syll ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᏥᏑᎵᎪᎬᎾ ᎢᎨᏙᎸᎯ ᎤᏲ ᎾᏆᎵᏍᏓᏁᎵᏙᎲᎢ;
\ft Ye are they which have continued with me in my temptations.

\ln Ale itsvyalisgolvdaneha itsigvwiyuhi itsalisdodiyi, nasgiya Edoda ayv tsaqualisgolvdanelv;
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎢᏨᏯᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᎭ ᎢᏥᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎡᏙᏓ ᎠᏴ ᏣᏆᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᎸ;
\ft And I appoint unto you a kingdom, as my Father hath appointed unto me;

\ln Nasgi itsalisdayvdiyi ale itsaditasdiyi agisgilv nahna agigvwiyuhi gesvi, ale itsanvdiyi unigvwiyuhi tsunidiyi degasgilvi, ditsugodanediyi taladu nanilasdalv Isili.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏣᏗᏔᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᎩᏍᎩᎸ ᏀᎾ ᎠᎩᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏣᏅᏗᏱ ᎤᏂᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏧᏂᏗᏱ ᏕᎦᏍᎩᎸᎢ, ᏗᏧᎪᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᏔᎳᏚ ᎾᏂᎳᏍᏓᎸ ᎢᏏᎵ.
\ft That ye may eat and drink at my table in my kingdom, and sit on thrones judging the twelve tribes of Israel.

\ln Ugvwiyuhino hia nuwesei, Sawani, Sawani, gvniyuquo, Sedani utayolv agalisgolvdanediyi itsvgusdodiyi utsalesdi tsanvgusdisgo nasgiyai.
\syll ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᏌᏩᏂ, ᏌᏩᏂ, ᎬᏂᏳᏉ, ᏎᏓᏂ ᎤᏔᏲᎸ ᎠᎦᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᎢᏨᎫᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᏣᎴᏍᏗ ᏣᏅᎫᏍᏗᏍᎪ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ.
\ft And the Lord said, Simon, Simon, behold, Satan hath desired to have you, that he may sift you as wheat:

\ln Aseno aquadadolistanv etsasdelvdiyi, nasgi tsohiyusv udalidvdodiyi nigesvna; tsagatahvdvno gesesdi dehalinigohistanvha itsalinvtli.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᏆᏓᏙᎵᏍᏔᏅ ᎡᏣᏍᏕᎸᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏦᎯᏳᏒ ᎤᏓᎵᏛᏙᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ; ᏣᎦᏔᎲᏛᏃ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏕᎭᎵᏂᎪᎯᏍᏔᏅᎭ ᎢᏣᎵᏅᏟ.
\ft But I have prayed for thee, that thy faith fail not: and when thou art converted, strengthen thy brethren.

\ln Hiano nuweselei; Tsagvwiyuhi, aquadvnvisdi gvsdawadvsdiyi nasquo didasdudiyi ale ayohuhisdi gesvi.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎠᏆᏛᏅᎢᏍᏗ ᎬᏍᏓᏩᏛᏍᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏗᏓᏍᏚᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft And he said unto him, Lord, I am ready to go with thee, both into prison, and to death.

\ln Hiano nuwesei gvyoseha Quida, tsataga vtla yvdvyvlasi gohi iga gvni tsoi itsadayilvhi gesesdi ayv sgigatahvi.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ ᎬᏲᏎᎭ ᏈᏓ, ᏣᏔᎦ ᎥᏝ ᏴᏛᏴᎳᏏ ᎪᎯ ᎢᎦ ᎬᏂ ᏦᎢ ᎢᏣᏓᏱᎸᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎠᏴ ᏍᎩᎦᏔᎲᎢ.
\ft And he said, I tell thee, Peter, the cock shall not crow this day, before that thou shalt thrice deny that thou knowest me.

\ln Hiano niduweselei, Tsitsvnvsvgi niditsinehvna adelvdigalodi, ale degalodi, ale dilasulo, gohusdisgo itsinigvsehei?  Vtla gohusdi, unadvnei.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏥᏨᏅᏒᎩ ᏂᏗᏥᏁᎲᎾ ᎠᏕᎸᏗᎦᎶᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᎦᎶᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎳᏑᎶ, ᎪᎱᏍᏗᏍᎪ ᎢᏥᏂᎬᏎᎮᎢ?  ᎥᏝ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ, ᎤᎾᏛᏁᎢ.
\ft And he said unto them, When I sent you without purse, and scrip, and shoes, lacked ye any thing? And they said, Nothing.

\ln Hnaquono hia niduweselei, Gohisgini tsigi, gilo adelvdigalodi unaesdi, ganegesdi, ale nasquo degalodi; gilono ayelasdi ganvhidv nuwayvna gesesdi, wiganaduga unuwo ale wuwahi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎪᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᏥᎩ, ᎩᎶ ᎠᏕᎸᏗᎦᎶᏗ ᎤᎾᎡᏍᏗ, ᎦᏁᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏕᎦᎶᏗ; ᎩᎶᏃ ᎠᏰᎳᏍᏗ ᎦᏅᎯᏛ ᏄᏩᏴᎾ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᏫᎦᎾᏚᎦ ᎤᏄᏬ ᎠᎴ ᏭᏩᎯ.
\ft Then said he unto them, But now, he that hath a purse, let him take it, and likewise his scrip: and he that hath no sword, let him sell his garment, and buy one.

\ln Itsvyosehayeno, hia nasgi tsigowela ase asi dvdohiyuni ayv nvdagvnisani; "Ale anisgana gegaselvi nasgi agatloyastanvgi;" ayvyeno aginohesgv ase nasgi nvdagalistani.
\syll ᎢᏨᏲᏎᎭᏰᏃ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᎪᏪᎳ ᎠᏎ ᎠᏏ ᏛᏙᎯᏳᏂ ᎠᏴ ᏅᏓᎬᏂᏌᏂ; data is invalidᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᎾ ᎨᎦᏎᎸᎢ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎦᏠᏯᏍᏔᏅᎩ;data is invalid ᎠᏴᏰᏃ ᎠᎩᏃᎮᏍᎬ ᎠᏎ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏔᏂ.
\ft For I say unto you, that this that is written must yet be accomplished in me, And he was reckoned among the transgressors: for the things concerning me have an end.

\ln Hiano nuniwesei, Tsagvwiyuhi, gvniyuquo, ani tali ayelasdidiganvhidv; hiano nisuweselei, Yeliquo nasgi.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎬᏂᏳᏉ, ᎠᏂ ᏔᎵ ᎠᏰᎳᏍᏗᏗᎦᏅᎯᏛ; ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏑᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏰᎵᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ.
\ft And they said, Lord, behold, here are two swords. And he said unto them, It is enough.

\ln Ale tsunugotsv, uwenvse Oliwayo usahilvi nasgi iyudvnedi gesvi; ale gvwasdawadidohi nasquo gvwasdawadvsei.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏧᏄᎪᏨ, ᎤᏪᏅᏎ ᎣᎵᏩᏲ ᎤᏌᎯᎸᎢ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏛᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏛᏎᎢ.
\ft And he came out, and went, as he was wont, to the mount of Olives; and his disciples also followed him.

\ln Nahnano wulutsu, hia niduweselei, Itsadadolisda udalenasdiyi gesv witsiyvsdiyi nigesvna gesvi.
\syll ᏀᎾᏃ ᏭᎷᏧ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎢᏣᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓ ᎤᏓᎴᎾᏍᏗᏱ ᎨᏒ ᏫᏥᏴᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft And when he was at the place, he said unto them, Pray that ye enter not into temptation.

\ln Dudanveleno nvya wigvdinvdi iyvdv ale duliniquane udadolistanei,
\syll ᏚᏓᏅᎡᎴᏃ ᏅᏯ ᏫᎬᏗᏅᏗ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎠᎴ ᏚᎵᏂᏆᏁ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ,
\ft And he was withdrawn from them about a stone's cast, and kneeled down, and prayed,

\ln Hia nuwesei, Edoda, iyuno osiyu yitsayelvnv sgihvsiquo hia ulisquidi; aseno vtlesdi ayv gadanvtesgvi, nihisgini hadanvtesgv winigalisda.
\syll ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎡᏙᏓ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎣᏏᏳ ᏱᏣᏰᎸᏅ ᏍᎩᎲᏏᏉ ᎯᎠ ᎤᎵᏍᏈᏗ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏞᏍᏗ ᎠᏴ ᎦᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬᎢ, ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎭᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ ᏫᏂᎦᎵᏍᏓ.
\ft Saying, Father, if thou be willing, remove this cup from me: nevertheless not my will, but thine, be done.

\ln Gvnigesvno nudvnele dikahnawadidohi galvladi nvdayulosvhi, ulinigohisdisgei.
\syll ᎬᏂᎨᏒᏃ ᏄᏛᏁᎴ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏅᏓᏳᎶᏒᎯ, ᎤᎵᏂᎪᎯᏍᏗᏍᎨᎢ.
\ft And there appeared an angel unto him from heaven, strengthening him.

\ln Utsatino ehisdi udanvte utli iyulinigidv udadolistanei; ale ali uhihv nasgiya gese gigv equohiyu gadohi tsiwidigawogoi.
\syll ᎤᏣᏘᏃ ᎡᎯᏍᏗ ᎤᏓᏅᏖ ᎤᏟ ᎢᏳᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎠᎵ ᎤᎯᎲ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎨᏎ ᎩᎬ ᎡᏉᎯᏳ ᎦᏙᎯ ᏥᏫᏗᎦᏬᎪᎢ.
\ft And being in an agony he prayed more earnestly: and his sweat was as it were great drops of blood falling down to the ground.

\ln Dulenvno adadolisdisgv ale widoulutselv gvwasdawadidohi, duwadvhe danilihe uyo uniyelvsv iyusdi.
\syll ᏚᎴᏅᏃ ᎠᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᎠᎴ ᏫᏙᎤᎷᏤᎸ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ, ᏚᏩᏛᎮ ᏓᏂᎵᎮ ᎤᏲ ᎤᏂᏰᎸᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ.
\ft And when he rose up from prayer, and was come to his disciples, he found them sleeping for sorrow,

\ln Hiano niduweselei, Gadono itsilinaa?  Ditsalehvga itsadadolisdi, nasgi udalenasdiyi gesv witsiyvsdiyi nigesvna.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎦᏙᏃ ᎢᏥᎵᎾᎠ?  ᏗᏣᎴᎲᎦ ᎢᏣᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏓᎴᎾᏍᏗᏱ ᎨᏒ ᏫᏥᏴᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.
\ft And said unto them, Why sleep ye? rise and pray, lest ye enter into temptation.

\ln Asiquono kanegei, gvniyuquo unitsati, nano Tsudasi tsagosehei, nasgi taladu iyanidv gesv gela, igvyi aise, ale nav ulutsele Tsisa tsutawedonisei,
\syll ᎠᏏᏉᏃ ᎧᏁᎨᎢ, ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ, ᎾᏃ ᏧᏓᏏ ᏣᎪᏎᎮᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏔᎳᏚ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎨᎳ, ᎢᎬᏱ ᎠᎢᏎ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᎥ ᎤᎷᏤᎴ ᏥᏌ ᏧᏔᏪᏙᏂᏎᎢ,
\ft And while he yet spake, behold a multitude, and he that was called Judas, one of the twelve, went before them, and drew near unto Jesus to kiss him.

\ln Tsisano hia nuweselei, Tsudasi, hiyatawodohvsgvsgo hilonuediha yvwi Uwetsi?
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏧᏓᏏ, ᎯᏯᏔᏬᏙᎲᏍᎬᏍᎪ ᎯᎶᏄᎡᏗᎭ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ?
\ft But Jesus said unto him, Judas, betrayest thou the Son of man with a kiss?

\ln Navno anedohi unadolehosv nusdv wigvwaliyeilohisdi gesv, hia nigvwaweselei, Tsagvwiyuhi, ayelasdisgoganvhidv dodayotsiluyastani?
\syll ᎾᎥᏃ ᎠᏁᏙᎯ ᎤᎾᏙᎴᎰᏒ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏫᎬᏩᎵᏰᎢᎶᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏩᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎠᏰᎳᏍᏗᏍᎪᎦᏅᎯᏛ ᏙᏓᏲᏥᎷᏯᏍᏔᏂ?
\ft When they which were about him saw what would follow, they said unto him, Lord, shall we smite with the sword?

\ln Asiyvwino uluye nugvwiyusv atsilvgelohi unvsidasdi, ale ulisdestane agatisi galeni.
\syll ᎠᏏᏴᏫᏃ ᎤᎷᏰ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸᎨᎶᎯ ᎤᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏍᏕᏍᏔᏁ ᎠᎦᏘᏏ ᎦᎴᏂ.
\ft And one of them smote the servant of the high priest, and cut off his right ear.

\ln Tsisano unetsv hia nuwesei, Unanelagi, nasgiquo igai  Usvneleno galeni ale unvwanei
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎤᎾᏁᎳᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩᏉ ᎢᎦᎢ  ᎤᏒᏁᎴᏃ ᎦᎴᏂ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏅᏩᏁᎢ
\ft And Jesus answered and said, Suffer ye thus far. And he touched his ear, and healed him.

\ln Hnaquono Tsisa hia niduwesele nunigvwiyusv atsilvanelohi, ale osdv iyunvhnadegi udvnadigalawiisdiyi, ale dinilawigi, nasgi gvwaniyvhilvhi, Itsilugisgo adanasahvsgi tsetsiyoho nasgiyai, ayelasdidiganvhidv ale ada tsidetsineha?
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸᎠᏁᎶᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎢᏳᏅᎿᏕᎩ ᎤᏛᎾᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏂᎳᏫᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏩᏂᏴᎯᎸᎯ, ᎢᏥᎷᎩᏍᎪ ᎠᏓᎾᏌᎲᏍᎩ ᏤᏥᏲᎰ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ, ᎠᏰᎳᏍᏗᏗᎦᏅᎯᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏓ ᏥᏕᏥᏁᎭ?
\ft Then Jesus said unto the chief priests, and captains of the temple, and the elders, which were come to him, Be ye come out, as against a thief, with swords and staves?

\ln Nisugitsvnisv itsvyeladidohv udvnadigalawiisdiyi, vtla yitsanelotane sginiyvdiyi; aseno itsatseliga gohi tsigi, ale ulisigi ulinigvgvi.
\syll ᏂᏑᎩᏨᏂᏒ ᎢᏨᏰᎳᏗᏙᎲ ᎤᏛᎾᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᎥᏝ ᏱᏣᏁᎶᏔᏁ ᏍᎩᏂᏴᏗᏱ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎢᏣᏤᎵᎦ ᎪᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏏᎩ ᎤᎵᏂᎬᎬᎢ.
\ft When I was daily with you in the temple, ye stretched forth no hands against me: but this is your hour, and the power of darkness.

\ln Hnaquono gvwaniyvhei, ale gvwatinvse ale wigvwayvtane nugvwiyusv atsilvgelohi diganelvi.  Quidano inv oni dilisdawadisei.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎬᏩᏂᏴᎮᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᏘᏅᏎ ᎠᎴ ᏫᎬᏩᏴᏔᏁ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸᎨᎶᎯ ᏗᎦᏁᎸᎢ.  ᏈᏓᏃ ᎢᏅ ᎣᏂ ᏗᎵᏍᏓᏩᏗᏎᎢ.
\ft Then took they him, and led him, and brought him into the high priest's house. And Peter followed afar off.

\ln Hnaquono udlanvdv ayeli unotanv, ale itsulaha unanvnv, Quida uwene aninvi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎤᏜᏅᏛ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎤᏃᏔᏅ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎤᎾᏅᏅ, ᏈᏓ ᎤᏪᏁ ᎠᏂᏅᎢ.
\ft And when they had kindled a fire in the midst of the hall, and were set down together, Peter sat down among them.

\ln Gilono iyusdi adv ugohv atsilvyulodi uwolvi, ale uyanvsvhi dukahnanv, hia nuwesei, Hia asgaya nasquo danedohvgi nasgi.
\syll ᎩᎶᏃ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏛ ᎤᎪᎲ ᎠᏥᎸᏳᎶᏗ ᎤᏬᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏯᏅᏒᎯ ᏚᎧᎿᏅ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏓᏁᏙᎲᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ.
\ft But a certain maid beheld him as he sat by the fire, and earnestly looked upon him, and said, This man was also with him.

\ln Aseno udayile hia nuwesei, Higeyv, vtla yitsigataha nasgi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏓᏱᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎯᎨᏴ, ᎥᏝ ᏱᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ.
\ft And he denied him, saying, Woman, I know him not.

\ln Gohiyino iyvdv nvwadale ugohv, hia nuwesei, Nihi nasquo nahna helv igi.  Quidano hia nuwesei, Hisgaya, vtla ayv nahna gelv yigi.
\syll ᎪᎯᏱᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᎤᎪᎲ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᏂᎯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏀᎾ ᎮᎸ ᎢᎩ.  ᏈᏓᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎯᏍᎦᏯ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᏴ ᏀᎾ ᎨᎸ ᏱᎩ.
\ft And after a little while another saw him, and said, Thou art also of them. And Peter said, Man, I am not.

\ln Onino sutlilodv iyvdv igohidv, nvwadale nasgi udohiyuhi gesv usdayidei, hia nuwesei; Udohiyuhi hia nasquo danedohvgi; Geliliyeno dehi igi.
\syll ᎣᏂᏃ ᏑᏟᎶᏛ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎢᎪᎯᏛ, ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏍᏓᏱᏕᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏓᏁᏙᎲᎩ; ᎨᎵᎵᏰᏃ ᏕᎯ ᎢᎩ.
\ft And about the space of one hour after another confidently affirmed, saying, Of a truth this fellow also was with him: for he is a Galilaean.

\ln Quidano hia nuwesei; Hisgaya, vtla yigoliga niwesgvi.  Gilaquono iyvdv, asiquo kanegei, tsataga uyvlasei.
\syll ᏈᏓᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎯᏍᎦᏯ, ᎥᏝ ᏱᎪᎵᎦ ᏂᏪᏍᎬᎢ.  ᎩᎳᏉᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ, ᎠᏏᏉ ᎧᏁᎨᎢ, ᏣᏔᎦ ᎤᏴᎳᏎᎢ.
\ft And Peter said, Man, I know not what thou sayest. And immediately, while he yet spake, the cock crew.

\ln Ugvwiyuhino ugatahvsv dukahnane Quida.  Quidano unvdade unetsv Ugvwiyuhi, hia tsinuweselei; Asiquo nuyvlasvna tsataga tsoi nvdasquadayili.
\syll ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᏃ ᎤᎦᏔᎲᏒ ᏚᎧᎿᏁ ᏈᏓ.  ᏈᏓᏃ ᎤᏅᏓᏕ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎯᎠ ᏥᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎠᏏᏉ ᏄᏴᎳᏒᎾ ᏣᏔᎦ ᏦᎢ ᏅᏓᏍᏆᏓᏱᎵ.
\ft And the Lord turned, and looked upon Peter. And Peter remembered the word of the Lord, how he had said unto him, Before the cock crow, thou shalt deny me thrice.

\ln Unugotseno Quida, ale ehisdi dutloyilei
\syll ᎤᏄᎪᏤᏃ ᏈᏓ, ᎠᎴ ᎡᎯᏍᏗ ᏚᏠᏱᎴᎢ
\ft And Peter went out, and wept bitterly.

\ln Anisgayano Tsisa digvwaniyvhi gagvwasotlvde ale degvwanihei.
\syll ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯᏃ ᏥᏌ ᏗᎬᏩᏂᏴᎯ ᎦᎬᏩᏐᏢᏕ ᎠᎴ ᏕᎬᏩᏂᎮᎢ.
\ft And the men that held Jesus mocked him, and smote him.

\ln Degvwagadutlvnvno ukadv degvwanihei, gvwadvdvhvsge hia naniwesgei, Hadolehohi, gago tsitsvniga?
\syll ᏕᎬᏩᎦᏚᏢᏅᏃ ᎤᎧᏛ ᏕᎬᏩᏂᎮᎢ, ᎬᏩᏛᏛᎲᏍᎨ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏂᏪᏍᎨᎢ, ᎭᏙᎴᎰᎯ, ᎦᎪ ᏥᏨᏂᎦ?
\ft And when they had blindfolded him, they struck him on the face, and asked him, saying, Prophesy, who is it that smote thee?

\ln Ale utsati asi iyudalegi gohusdi gvwosehe gvwasotlvisdisgvi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎠᏏ ᎢᏳᏓᎴᎩ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎬᏬᏎᎮ ᎬᏩᏐᏢᎢᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ.
\ft And many other things blasphemously spake they against him.

\ln Igaquono nulistanv dinilawigi yvwi anehv ale nunigvwiyusv atsilvanelohi ale dinowelisgi dunilawitsei, ale danilawiv gvwatinole hia nuniwesei;
\syll ᎢᎦᏉᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ ᏗᏂᎳᏫᎩ ᏴᏫ ᎠᏁᎲ ᎠᎴ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏃᏪᎵᏍᎩ ᏚᏂᎳᏫᏤᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᏂᎳᏫᎥ ᎬᏩᏘᏃᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ;
\ft And as soon as it was day, the elders of the people and the chief priests and the scribes came together, and led him into their council, saying,

\ln Nihisgo galonedv?  Sginohvsi.  Hiano niduweselei, Iyuno yitsvnonelv vtla yvgetsohiyuhvga;
\syll ᏂᎯᏍᎪ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ?  ᏍᎩᏃᎲᏏ.  ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᏱᏨᏃᏁᎸ ᎥᏝ ᏴᎨᏦᎯᏳᎲᎦ;
\ft Art thou the Christ? tell us. And he said unto them, If I tell you, ye will not believe:

\ln Ale nasquo yitsvyadvdvnv vtla yvgesginetsi, ale vtla yidogesgiyohi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏱᏨᏯᏛᏛᏅ ᎥᏝ ᏴᎨᏍᎩᏁᏥ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏙᎨᏍᎩᏲᎯ.
\ft And if I also ask you, ye will not answer me, nor let me go.

\ln Ilvhiyu dvsqualvhi yvwi Uwetsi dagani agatisiditlv ulinigidv Unelanvhi uwolvi.
\syll ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᏛᏍᏆᎸᎯ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᏓᎦᏂ ᎠᎦᏘᏏᏗᏢ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏬᎸᎢ.
\ft Hereafter shall the Son of man sit on the right hand of the power of God.

\ln Hnaquono hia nuniwese nigadv, Nihisgo Unelanvhi Uwetsi?  Hiano niduweselei, Yeli nitsiwi, ayvyeno nasgi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎ ᏂᎦᏛ, ᏂᎯᏍᎪ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏪᏥ?  ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏰᎵ ᏂᏥᏫ, ᎠᏴᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ.
\ft Then said they all, Art thou then the Son of God? And he said unto them, Ye say that I am.

\ln Hiano nuniwesei, Gadono igvdodi asi gohiyudisgi?  Igvsvyeno edadvgasi uwasv kanegvi.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ, ᎦᏙᏃ ᎢᎬᏙᏗ ᎠᏏ ᎪᎯᏳᏗᏍᎩ?  ᎢᎬᏒᏰᏃ ᎡᏓᏛᎦᏏ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎧᏁᎬᎢ.
\ft And they said, What need we any further witness? for we ourselves have heard of his own mouth.

\ln Nigadvno nasgi unitsati gesv dunalenv Qualedi wigvwatinohelei.
\syll ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎨᏒ ᏚᎾᎴᏅ ᏆᎴᏗ ᏫᎬᏩᏘᏃᎮᎴᎢ.
\ft And the whole multitude of them arose, and led him unto Pilate.

\ln Ale unalenvhe gvwuhisdisge hia naniwesgei, Hia nasgi dotsiwadvhvgi dedalenasdisgvgi yvwi, ale dekanvsdadehvgi ayeli adelv Sisa aguyvediyi, hia nikawesgvgi, ayv agigvwiyuhi, Galonedv.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᎴᏅᎮ ᎬᏭᎯᏍᏗᏍᎨ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏂᏪᏍᎨᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏙᏥᏩᏛᎲᎩ ᏕᏓᎴᎾᏍᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᏴᏫ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᎧᏅᏍᏓᏕᎲᎩ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎠᏕᎸ ᏏᏌ ᎠᎫᏴᎡᏗᏱ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᎧᏪᏍᎬᎩ, ᎠᏴ ᎠᎩᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎦᎶᏁᏛ.
\ft And they began to accuse him, saying, We found this fellow perverting the nation, and forbidding to give tribute to Caesar, saying that he himself is Christ a King.

\ln Qualedino udvdvne, hia nuwesei, Nihisgo Tsagvwiyuhi Anitsusi unatseliga?  Unetseleno hia nuwesei, nasgi niwi.
\syll ᏆᎴᏗᏃ ᎤᏛᏛᏁ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᏂᎯᏍᎪ ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ?  ᎤᏁᏤᎴᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᏫ.
\ft And Pilate asked him, saying, Art thou the King of the Jews? And he answered him and said, Thou sayest it.

\ln Qualedino hia nigawesele nunigvwiyusv atsilvanelohi ale yvwi, Vtla yitsiwati usganvtsv hia asgaya.
\syll ᏆᎴᏗᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᏎᎴ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏴᏫ, ᎥᏝ ᏱᏥᏩᏘ ᎤᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ.
\ft Then said Pilate to the chief priests and to the people, I find no fault in this man.

\ln Aseno unisdayide hia naniwesgei, Datelvhvsga hia yvwi, dadeyonidoha Tsudiyi nigvnadvi, Gelili nvdagvwadalenvdv ani iyasti.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏂᏍᏓᏱᏕ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏂᏪᏍᎨᎢ, ᏓᏖᎸᎲᏍᎦ ᎯᎠ ᏴᏫ, ᏓᏕᏲᏂᏙᎭ ᏧᏗᏱ ᏂᎬᎾᏛᎢ, ᎨᎵᎵ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎠᏂ ᎢᏯᏍᏘ.
\ft And they were the more fierce, saying, He stirreth up the people, teaching throughout all Jewry, beginning from Galilee to this place.

\ln Qualedino udvganv Gelili anineisdisgv udvdvne, Gelilisgo ehi hia asgaya, udvnei.
\syll ᏆᎴᏗᏃ ᎤᏛᎦᏅ ᎨᎵᎵ ᎠᏂᏁᎢᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᎤᏛᏛᏁ, ᎨᎵᎵᏍᎪ ᎡᎯ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ, ᎤᏛᏁᎢ.
\ft When Pilate heard of Galilee, he asked whether the man were a Galilaean.

\ln Udolehosvquono Elodv ugvwiyuhi gesv nahna edi gesvi, Elodv wuwekanelei, nasgi Elodv uwasv Tsilusilimi edohe nahiyui.
\syll ᎤᏙᎴᎰᏒᏉᏃ ᎡᎶᏛ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏀᎾ ᎡᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎡᎶᏛ ᏭᏪᎧᏁᎴᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᎶᏛ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᎡᏙᎮ ᏀᎢᏳᎢ.
\ft And as soon as he knew that he belonged unto Herod's jurisdiction, he sent him to Herod, who himself also was at Jerusalem at that time.

\ln Elodvno ugohv Tsisa, utsati ose uyelvnei; gohidiyuyeno nvwadulisge ugowadvdiyi, nvdigalisdidodisge utsati tsudalenvdv atsinohesgv udvganvi, ale udugi uwase ugowadvdiyi gohusdi usquanigodi dulvwisdanehvi.
\syll ᎡᎶᏛᏃ ᎤᎪᎲ ᏥᏌ, ᎤᏣᏘ ᎣᏎ ᎤᏰᎸᏁᎢ; ᎪᎯᏗᏳᏰᏃ ᏅᏩᏚᎵᏍᎨ ᎤᎪᏩᏛᏗᏱ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏗᏙᏗᏍᎨ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎠᏥᏃᎮᏍᎬ ᎤᏛᎦᏅᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎤᏩᏎ ᎤᎪᏩᏛᏗᏱ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎢ.
\ft And when Herod saw Jesus, he was exceeding glad: for he was desirous to see him of a long season, because he had heard many things of him; and he hoped to have seen some miracle done by him.

\ln Udvdvhelvneno utsati tsudalenvdv, aseno vtla yunetselei.
\syll ᎤᏛᏛᎮᎸᏁᏃ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏳᏁᏤᎴᎢ.
\ft Then he questioned with him in many words; but he answered him nothing.

\ln Nunigvwiyusvno atsilvanelohi ale dinowelisgi danidoge ulinigidv gvwuhisdisgei.
\syll ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒᏃ ᎠᏥᎸᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏃᏪᎵᏍᎩ ᏓᏂᏙᎨ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᎬᏭᎯᏍᏗᏍᎨᎢ.
\ft And the chief priests and scribes stood and vehemently accused him.

\ln Elodvno ale tsutseli aniyawisgi gagvwasotlvtanei, ale gvwadehotanei, ale digvwalvsadv anuwo uninuwov Qualedi taline wunikanelei.
\syll ᎡᎶᏛᏃ ᎠᎴ ᏧᏤᎵ ᎠᏂᏯᏫᏍᎩ ᎦᎬᏩᏐᏢᏔᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᏕᎰᏔᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎬᏩᎸᏌᏛ ᎠᏄᏬ ᎤᏂᏄᏬᎥ ᏆᎴᏗ ᏔᎵᏁ ᏭᏂᎧᏁᎴᎢ.
\ft And Herod with his men of war set him at nought, and mocked him, and arrayed him in a gorgeous robe, and sent him again to Pilate.

\ln Nahiyuno iga Qualedi ale Elodv unaliidei; dinadasgagiyuyeno iyulistanvhi gese nahiyu iyasti.
\syll ᏀᎢᏳᏃ ᎢᎦ ᏆᎴᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎡᎶᏛ ᎤᎾᎵᎢᏕᎢ; ᏗᎾᏓᏍᎦᎩᏳᏰᏃ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏎ ᏀᎢᏳ ᎢᏯᏍᏘ.
\ft And the same day Pilate and Herod were made friends together: for before they were at enmity between themselves.

\ln Qualedino dulawidv nunigvwiyusv atsilvanelohi, ale nunigvwiyusadegi, ale unitsati gesv yvwi,
\syll ᏆᎴᏗᏃ ᏚᎳᏫᏛ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸᎠᏁᎶᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎨᏒ ᏴᏫ,
\ft And Pilate, when he had called together the chief priests and the rulers and the people,

\ln Hia niduweselei, Sgiyatinohelv hia asgaya yvwi dunadanvdv dilenasdisgi nasgiyai; gvniyuquono tsigoliyevhi tsigi itsigatahvi, vtla gohusdi yitsiwati usganvtsv hia asgaya nasgi nusdv etsuisdisgvi;
\syll ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏍᎩᏯᏘᏃᎮᎸ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᏴᏫ ᏚᎾᏓᏅᏛ ᏗᎴᎾᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ; ᎬᏂᏳᏉᏃ ᏥᎪᎵᏰᎥᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎲᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏱᏥᏩᏘ ᎤᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎡᏧᎢᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ;
\ft Said unto them, Ye have brought this man unto me, as one that perverteth the people: and, behold, I, having examined him before you, have found no fault in this man touching those things whereof ye accuse him:

\ln Elodv ale nasquo vtla; nahnayeno itsenvsdiyi itsvnetselvgi; gvniyuquono vtla gohusdi yeli gvwayohuhisdi gesv yinudvnelv.
\syll ᎡᎶᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎥᏝ; ᏀᎾᏰᏃ ᎢᏤᏅᏍᏗᏱ ᎢᏨᏁᏤᎸᎩ; ᎬᏂᏳᏉᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏰᎵ ᎬᏩᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏱᏄᏛᏁᎸ.
\ft No, nor yet Herod: for I sent you to him; and, lo, nothing worthy of death is done unto him.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi tsilivnilvha datsiyakani.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏥᎵᎥᏂᎸᎭ ᏓᏥᏯᎧᏂ.
\ft I will therefore chastise him, and release him.

\ln Aseyeno saquo tsuyohisedi geso dilisdayvdiyi gesv iyui.
\syll ᎠᏎᏰᏃ ᏌᏉ ᏧᏲᎯᏎᏗ ᎨᏐ ᏗᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᎢ.
\ft (For of necessity he must release one unto them at the feast.)

\ln Uneluneno saquo igagadv, hia nuniwesei, Hiluga hia asgaya, Qualaquano disgiyohisi.
\syll ᎤᏁᎷᏁᏃ ᏌᏉ ᎢᎦᎦᏛ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ, ᎯᎷᎦ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ, ᏆᎳᏆᏃ ᏗᏍᎩᏲᎯᏏ.
\ft And they cried out all at once, saying, Away with this man, and release unto us Barabbas:

\ln Nasgi Qualaqua udasuyedv unalitelvnv nahna gaduhv ale udalvi atsisdvdistane didasdudiyi atsiyvtanvhi gesei.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏆᎳᏆ ᎤᏓᏑᏰᏛ ᎤᎾᎵᏖᎸᏅ ᏀᎾ ᎦᏚᎲ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᎸᎢ ᎠᏥᏍᏛᏗᏍᏔᏁ ᏗᏓᏍᏚᏗᏱ ᎠᏥᏴᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏎᎢ.
\ft (Who for a certain sedition made in the city, and for murder, was cast into prison.)

\ln Qualedino udulisgv Tsisa uwegodiyi nvtsulisdotane taline dunetselei.
\syll ᏆᎴᏗᏃ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎬ ᏥᏌ ᎤᏪᎪᏗᏱ ᏅᏧᎵᏍᏙᏔᏁ ᏔᎵᏁ ᏚᏁᏤᎴᎢ.
\ft Pilate therefore, willing to release Jesus, spake again to them.

\ln Aseno unelune hia nuniwesei, Hisdvvga, hiyadvvga.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏁᎷᏁ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ, ᎯᏍᏛᎥᎦ, ᎯᏯᏛᎥᎦ.
\ft But they cried, saying, Crucify him, crucify him.

\ln Tsoineno hia niduweselei, Gadono, gado usdi uyo dulvwisdanelv?  Vtla yitsiwadveha gohusdi yeli gvwayohuhisdi gesvi;  nasgi iyusdi datsilivnili ale dodatsiyosi.
\syll ᏦᎢᏁᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎦᏙᏃ, ᎦᏙ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎤᏲ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸ?  ᎥᏝ ᏱᏥᏩᏛᎡᎭ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏰᎵ ᎬᏩᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ;  ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏓᏥᎵᎥᏂᎵ ᎠᎴ ᏙᏓᏥᏲᏏ.
\ft And he said unto them the third time, Why, what evil hath he done? I have found no cause of death in him: I will therefore chastise him, and let him go.

\ln Aseno unatlinigvnele asdaya aninegvi, anitayohihe agadvdiyi.  Nasgino na ale nunigvwiyusv atsilvanelohi aninegv ugvwiyutsei.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᎾᏟᏂᎬᏁᎴ ᎠᏍᏓᏯ ᎠᏂᏁᎬᎢ, ᎠᏂᏔᏲᎯᎮ ᎠᎦᏛᏗᏱ.  ᎾᏍᎩᏃ Ꮎ ᎠᎴ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᎠᏂᏁᎬ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᏤᎢ.
\ft And they were instant with loud voices, requiring that he might be crucified. And the voices of them and of the chief priests prevailed.

\ln Qualedino unetse nusdv unadulisgv iyulisdodiyi.
\syll ᏆᎴᏗᏃ ᎤᏁᏤ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎤᎾᏚᎵᏍᎬ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
\ft And Pilate gave sentence that it should be as they required.

\ln Ale duwekanele nasgi tsunitayolei, didasdudiyi atsiyvtanvhi tsigesei tsusdvdisge udasuyedv unalitelvnv ale udalvi; Tsisasgini duyohisele unadulisgv iyunvnediyi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏚᏪᎧᏁᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏂᏔᏲᎴᎢ, ᏗᏓᏍᏚᏗᏱ ᎠᏥᏴᏔᏅᎯ ᏥᎨᏎᎢ ᏧᏍᏛᏗᏍᎨ ᎤᏓᏑᏰᏛ ᎤᎾᎵᏖᎸᏅ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᎸᎢ; ᏥᏌᏍᎩᏂ ᏚᏲᎯᏎᎴ ᎤᎾᏚᎵᏍᎬ ᎢᏳᏅᏁᏗᏱ.
\ft And he released unto them him that for sedition and murder was cast into prison, whom they had desired; but he delivered Jesus to their will.

\ln Gvwatiniseno uniniyvhe gilo iyusdi Sawani tsudoidv, Salini ehi, dodigalogesv nvdayulosvhi, nasgino unanotladistane tsudahnawadv, nasgi Tsisa aisv oniditlv uwenvsdiyi.
\syll ᎬᏩᏘᏂᏎᏃ ᎤᏂᏂᏴᎮ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏌᏩᏂ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ, ᏌᎵᏂ ᎡᎯ, ᏙᏗᎦᎶᎨᏒ ᏅᏓᏳᎶᏒᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᎾᏃᏝᏗᏍᏔᏁ ᏧᏓᎿᏩᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏌ ᎠᎢᏒ ᎣᏂᏗᏢ ᎤᏪᏅᏍᏗᏱ.
\ft And as they led him away, they laid hold upon one Simon, a Cyrenian, coming out of the country, and on him they laid the cross, that he might bear it after Jesus.

\ln Gvwasdawadiseno unitsati yvwi, ale anigeyv, nasgi nasquo daniyvge ale gvwasgonihei.
\syll ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏎᏃ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏴᏫ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᎨᏴ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏓᏂᏴᎨ ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᏍᎪᏂᎮᎢ.
\ft And there followed him a great company of people, and of women, which also bewailed and lamented him.

\ln Tsisano dugatahvelv hia nuwesei, Itsigeyv Tsilusilimi tsuwetsi, tlesdi ayv sgisgonilvgi, itsvsvsgini ditsadasgoniga, ale ditsetsi ditsisgoniga.
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᏚᎦᏔᎲᎡᎸ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎢᏥᎨᏴ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᏧᏪᏥ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᎠᏴ ᏍᎩᏍᎪᏂᎸᎩ, ᎢᏨᏒᏍᎩᏂ ᏗᏣᏓᏍᎪᏂᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏤᏥ ᏗᏥᏍᎪᏂᎦ.
\ft But Jesus turning unto them said, Daughters of Jerusalem, weep not for me, but weep for yourselves, and for your children.

\ln Gvniyuyeno dvliyeiloli iga, nahiyu hia nvdvniwesi, Osiyu iyunalisdanedi dinalulvvsgi nigesvna, ale tsunadananugowisvhi nigesvna, ale tsunadasdvnvhi nigesvna.
\syll ᎬᏂᏳᏰᏃ ᏛᎵᏰᎢᎶᎵ ᎢᎦ, ᏀᎢᏳ ᎯᎠ ᏅᏛᏂᏪᏏ, ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᏗᎾᎷᎸᎥᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᎾᏓᎾᏄᎪᏫᏒᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᎾᏓᏍᏛᏅᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.
\ft For, behold, the days are coming, in the which they shall say, Blessed are the barren, and the wombs that never bare, and the paps which never gave suck.

\ln Hnaquono dvnalenvhi hia nidodvniweseli dodalvi, Sgiyasovga; ale dusahilvi, Sgiyutlvvga.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏛᎾᎴᏅᎯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏙᏛᏂᏪᏎᎵ ᏙᏓᎸᎢ, ᏍᎩᏯᏐᎥᎦ; ᎠᎴ ᏚᏌᎯᎸᎢ, ᏍᎩᏳᏢᎥᎦ.
\ft Then shall they begin to say to the mountains, Fall on us; and to the hills, Cover us.

\ln Iyuyeno itse tlugv nasgi yinvdvnvneli, gado gvnedi gesesdi ukayodv tlugvi?
\syll ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᎢᏤ ᏡᎬ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᏅᏛᏅᏁᎵ, ᎦᏙ ᎬᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᎧᏲᏛ ᏡᎬᎢ?
