\ft Saying, The Son of man must be delivered into the hands of sinful men, and be crucified, and the third day rise again.

\ln Unanvdadeno unetsvi,
\syll ᎤᎾᏅᏓᏕᏃ ᎤᏁᏨᎢ,
\ft And they remembered his words,

\ln Ale atselisdv diunatsvsei nasgi hia nigadv nulistanidolv duninonele sadu iyanidv, ale nigadv anisoi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎠᏤᎵᏍᏛ ᏗᎤᎾᏨᏎᎢ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏂᏙᎸ ᏚᏂᏃᏁᎴ ᏌᏚ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎠᏂᏐᎢ.
\ft And returned from the sepulchre, and told all these things unto the eleven, and to all the rest.

\ln Nasgi hia Meli Magideli ehi, ale Tsoana, ale Meli Tsimi utsi, ale nvwanadale anigeyv anehi, nasgi tsiwigvwaninonele getsinvsidv.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎺᎵ ᎹᎩᏕᎵ ᎡᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏦᎠᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᎺᎵ ᏥᎻ ᎤᏥ, ᎠᎴ ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴ ᎠᏂᎨᏴ ᎠᏁᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏫᎬᏩᏂᏃᏁᎴ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏛ.
\ft It was Mary Magdalene, and Joanna, and Mary the mother of James, and other women that were with them, which told these things unto the apostles.

\ln Uninohelvhino asequoquo nvwasdei, ale vtla yigegoiyunei.
\syll ᎤᏂᏃᎮᎸᎯᏃ ᎠᏎᏉᏉ ᏅᏩᏍᏕᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᏱᎨᎪᎢᏳᏁᎢ.
\ft And their words seemed to them as idle tales, and they believed them not.

\ln Quidano dulenv, dusqualvtane atselisdv wulosei; udisdunvno dugohe doledv dinuwo unelagi iyvdv doganei, udanvseno asquanigosge nasgi nulistanidolvi.
\syll ᏈᏓᏃ ᏚᎴᏅ, ᏚᏍᏆᎸᏔᏁ ᎠᏤᎵᏍᏛ ᏭᎶᏎᎢ; ᎤᏗᏍᏚᏅᏃ ᏚᎪᎮ ᏙᎴᏛ ᏗᏄᏬ ᎤᏁᎳᎩ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏙᎦᏁᎢ, ᎤᏓᏅᏎᏃ ᎠᏍᏆᏂᎪᏍᎨ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏂᏙᎸᎢ.
\ft Then arose Peter, and ran unto the sepulchre; and stooping down, he beheld the linen clothes laid by themselves, and departed, wondering in himself at that which was come to pass.

\ln Ale gvniyuquo, nahiyuquo iga anitali unadasdawadidolvhi digaduhv Emeyasi tsudoidv wanigatei, nasgi tsunela iyvdv iyutlilodv nidudale Tsilusilimi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᏳᏉ, ᏀᎢᏳᏉ ᎢᎦ ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᎤᎾᏓᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎸᎯ ᏗᎦᏚᎲ ᎡᎺᏯᏏ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ ᏩᏂᎦᏖᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏁᎳ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎢᏳᏟᎶᏛ ᏂᏚᏓᎴ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ.
\ft And, behold, two of them went that same day to a village called Emmaus, which was from Jerusalem about threescore furlongs.

\ln Analinohesgvno aninohesge nigadv nasgi nulistanidolvi.
\syll ᎠᎾᎵᏃᎮᏍᎬᏃ ᎠᏂᏃᎮᏍᎨ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏂᏙᎸᎢ.
\ft And they talked together of all these things which had happened.

\ln Hiano nulistane nasgi asiquo analinohesge ale danadadvdvhvsgei, Tsisa uwasv nav ulutsv nasgi unenvstanei.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏏᏉ ᎠᎾᎵᏃᎮᏍᎨ ᎠᎴ ᏓᎾᏓᏛᏛᎲᏍᎨᎢ, ᏥᏌ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎾᎥ ᎤᎷᏨ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᏅᏍᏔᏁᎢ.
\ft And it came to pass, that, while they communed together and reasoned, Jesus himself drew near, and went with them.

\ln Aseno dinigadoli degetsiniyvele nasgi gvwolisdiyi nigesvna.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᏗᏂᎦᏙᎵ ᏕᎨᏥᏂᏴᎡᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏬᎵᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.
\ft But their eyes were holden that they should not know him.

\ln Hiano nisuweselei, Gado isdinoheha hia nasgi tsisdalinoheha isdaisvi ale uyoquo tsinvwasdi tsisdadanvta?
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏑᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎦᏙ ᎢᏍᏗᏃᎮᎭ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏍᏓᎵᏃᎮᎭ ᎢᏍᏓᎢᏒᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏲᏉ ᏥᏅᏩᏍᏗ ᏥᏍᏓᏓᏅᏔ?
\ft And he said unto them, What manner of communications are these that ye have one to another, as ye walk, and are sad?

\ln Asiyvwino nasgi Tlioqua tsudoidv unetsv hia nuweselei, Tsigo hedohiquo nihi Tsilusilimi, ale nigatahvnaquo nasgi nahna nulistanidolv gohi tsigi?
\syll ᎠᏏᏴᏫᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏟᎣᏆ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏥᎪ ᎮᏙᎯᏉ ᏂᎯ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏔᎲᎾᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏀᎾ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏂᏙᎸ ᎪᎯ ᏥᎩ?
\ft And the one of them, whose name was Cleopas, answering said unto him, Art thou only a stranger in Jerusalem, and hast not known the things which are come to pass therein these days?

\ln Hiano niduweselei, Gado usdi?  Hiano nigvwaweselei, Tsisa Naselidi tsehvgi nulisdanelvi, nasgi adolehosgi tsigesvgi, ulinigidv dulvwisdanelv ale dadeyohvsgv tsigese Unelanvhi agatahv ale nigadv yvwi anigatahvi.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎦᏙ ᎤᏍᏗ?  ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᎬᏩᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏥᏌ ᎾᏎᎵᏗ ᏤᎲᎩ ᏄᎵᏍᏓᏁᎸᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᏥᎨᏒᎩ, ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸ ᎠᎴ ᏓᏕᏲᎲᏍᎬ ᏥᎨᏎ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎦᏔᎲ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏴᏫ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎲᎢ.
\ft And he said unto them, What things? And they said unto him, Concerning Jesus of Nazareth, which was a prophet mighty in deed and word before God and all the people:

\ln Ale nasgi nunigvwiyusv atsilvanelohi ale tsogatseli nunigvwiyusadegi tsidegvwayose tsagugodanediyi uyohuhisdiyi, ale tsigvwadvnvgi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏦᎦᏤᎵ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ ᏥᏕᎬᏩᏲᏎ ᏣᎫᎪᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᎤᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᎬᏩᏛᏅᎩ.
\ft And how the chief priests and our rulers delivered him to be condemned to death, and have crucified him.

\ln Aseno udugi ogvsvgi nasgi Isili didayisgi gesvi.  Ale nasquo gohi iga tsigi tsoine ugitsiha nasgi hia igvwalistanvhi;
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎣᎬᏒᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏏᎵ ᏗᏓᏱᏍᎩ ᎨᏒᎢ.  ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎪᎯ ᎢᎦ ᏥᎩ ᏦᎢᏁ ᎤᎩᏥᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎢᎬᏩᎵᏍᏔᏅᎯ;
\ft But we trusted that it had been he which should have redeemed Israel: and beside all this, to day is the third day since these things were done.

\ln Vv, ale nasquo gilo iyunasdi anigeyv ogadatlugv anela usquanigodi gogadanvdadistanvgi, nasgi gila tsugitsisgo atselisdv wunedolvhi;
\syll ᎥᎥ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗ ᎠᏂᎨᏴ ᎣᎦᏓᏡᎬ ᎠᏁᎳ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᎪᎦᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏔᏅᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎩᎳ ᏧᎩᏥᏍᎪ ᎠᏤᎵᏍᏛ ᏭᏁᏙᎸᎯ;
\ft Yea, and certain women also of our company made us astonished, which were early at the sepulchre;

\ln Wunatlotsvno ayelvi, unilutsei, hia nuniwesei, dinikahnawadidohi nasquo dotsigowadv nasgi gvnv gogosi, unadvnei.
\syll ᏭᎾᏠᏨᏃ ᎠᏰᎸᎢ, ᎤᏂᎷᏤᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ, ᏗᏂᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏙᏥᎪᏩᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏅ ᎪᎪᏏ, ᎤᎾᏛᏁᎢ.
\ft And when they found not his body, they came, saying, that they had also seen a vision of angels, which said that he was alive.

\ln Ale gilo iyusdi nasgi otsehi unenvsvgi atselisdvi, ale wuniwadvhe nasgiya nusde anigeyv nuniwesvi; nasgisgini na vtla yunigohei.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏤᎯ ᎤᏁᏅᏒᎩ ᎠᏤᎵᏍᏛᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏭᏂᏩᏛᎮ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᏍᏕ ᎠᏂᎨᏴ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ Ꮎ ᎥᏝ ᏳᏂᎪᎮᎢ.
\ft And certain of them which were with us went to the sepulchre, and found it even so as the women had said: but him they saw not.

\ln Hnaquono hia niduweselei, Itsinegutsi, ale itsadanvdv itsisganoliyu itsohiyudiyi nigav nuniwesv anadolehosgi!
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎢᏥᏁᎫᏥ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏛ ᎢᏥᏍᎦᏃᎵᏳ ᎢᏦᎯᏳᏗᏱ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏄᏂᏪᏒ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ
\ft Then he said unto them, O fools, and slow of heart to believe all that the prophets have spoken:

\ln Tlasgo hia nasgi iyusdi ase ugiliyoisdi yigese Galonedv, ale wuyvsdi yigese galvquodiyu utseli digesvi.
\syll ᏝᏍᎪ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏎ ᎤᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗ ᏱᎨᏎ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᏭᏴᏍᏗ ᏱᎨᏎ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏗᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Ought not Christ to have suffered these things, and to enter into his glory?

\ln Ulenvtanvno Mosi, ale nigadv anadolehosgi, duwosisanele nagav gowelv nasgi uwasv unohesgvi.
\syll ᎤᎴᏅᏔᏅᏃ ᎼᏏ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ, ᏚᏬᏏᏌᏁᎴ ᎾᎦᎥ ᎪᏪᎸ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎤᏃᎮᏍᎬᎢ.
\ft And beginning at Moses and all the prophets, he expounded unto them in all the scriptures the things concerning himself.

\ln Navno unilutse gaduhv nahna wanigadvi; utlino iyvdv tsiwvdigalosiso iyusdi nudvnelei.
\syll ᎾᎥᏃ ᎤᏂᎷᏤ ᎦᏚᎲ ᏀᎾ ᏩᏂᎦᏛᎢ; ᎤᏟᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏥᏮᏗᎦᎶᏏᏐ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏄᏛᏁᎴᎢ.
\ft And they drew nigh unto the village, whither they went: and he made as though he would have gone further.

\ln Aseno igvwasdiyetanei, hia nuniwesei, Ayv sginisvsi, hnaquoyeno usvhiyehiyu, ale eladiyu wikala.  Uyvleno dodisvselisei.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎢᎬᏩᏍᏗᏰᏔᏁᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ, ᎠᏴ ᏍᎩᏂᏒᏏ, ᎿᏉᏰᏃ ᎤᏒᎯᏰᎯᏳ, ᎠᎴ ᎡᎳᏗᏳ ᏫᎧᎳ.  ᎤᏴᎴᏃ ᏙᏗᏒᏎᎵᏎᎢ.
\ft But they constrained him, saying, Abide with us: for it is toward evening, and the day is far spent. And he went in to tarry with them.

\ln Hiano nulistane nasgi ganvgei dinalisdayvnisei, gadu ugisv ulihelitsei, ale ugvhaluyv dunelei.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏅᎨᎢ ᏗᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᏂᏎᎢ, ᎦᏚ ᎤᎩᏒ ᎤᎵᎮᎵᏤᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎬᎭᎷᏴ ᏚᏁᎴᎢ.
\ft And it came to pass, as he sat at meat with them, he took bread, and blessed it, and brake, and gave to them.

\ln Dinigadolino dulisduisei, ale igvwolitsei, ale ulidvtane danikanvi.
\syll ᏗᏂᎦᏙᎵᏃ ᏚᎵᏍᏚᎢᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᎬᏬᎵᏤᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏛᏔᏁ ᏓᏂᎧᏅᎢ.
\ft And their eyes were opened, and they knew him; and he vanished out of their sight.

\ln Hiano nidunadaweselei, Tlasgo digininawi tsudilegiyu yigese hawini tsiginalinohedisgv didaisvi, ale tsideginosisanehv goweli?
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᎾᏓᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏝᏍᎪ ᏗᎩᏂᎾᏫ ᏧᏗᎴᎩᏳ ᏱᎨᏎ ᎭᏫᏂ ᏥᎩᎾᎵᏃᎮᏗᏍᎬ ᏗᏓᎢᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᏕᎩᏃᏏᏌᏁᎲ ᎪᏪᎵ?
\ft And they said one to another, Did not our heart burn within us, while he talked with us by the way, and while he opened to us the scriptures?

\ln Nahiyuquono aliyeilisv dunalenei, ale Tsilusilimi taline wiunilosei, ale duniwadvhe danilawie sadu iyanidv, ale nasgi gvwanadatluwasdidegi,
\syll ᏀᎢᏳᏉᏃ ᎠᎵᏰᎢᎵᏒ ᏚᎾᎴᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᏔᎵᏁ ᏫᎤᏂᎶᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏂᏩᏛᎮ ᏓᏂᎳᏫᎡ ᏌᏚ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏩᎾᏓᏡᏩᏍᏗᏕᎩ,
\ft And they rose up the same hour, and returned to Jerusalem, and found the eleven gathered together, and them that were with them,

\ln Hia naniwesgei, Ugvwiyuhi dulenv udohiyuhi, ale Sawani gvnigesv nudvnelv.
\syll ᎯᎠ ᎾᏂᏪᏍᎨᎢ, ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏚᎴᏅ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏌᏩᏂ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏄᏛᏁᎸ.
\ft Saying, The Lord is risen indeed, and hath appeared to Simon.

\ln Ale uninohele nulistanidolv anaisvi, ale nasgi unolistanv gadu agvhaluyasgvi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏃᎮᎴ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏂᏙᎸ ᎠᎾᎢᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏃᎵᏍᏔᏅ ᎦᏚ ᎠᎬᎭᎷᏯᏍᎬᎢ.
\ft And they told what things were done in the way, and how he was known of them in breaking of bread.

\ln Asiquono nasgi naniwesgei, Tsisa uwasv ulenile ayeli aninvi, ale hia niduweselei, Nvwadohiyadv itsatseliga gesesdi.
\syll ᎠᏏᏉᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏂᏪᏍᎨᎢ, ᏥᏌ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎤᎴᏂᎴ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎠᏂᏅᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᎢᏣᏤᎵᎦ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft And as they thus spake, Jesus himself stood in the midst of them, and saith unto them, Peace be unto you.

\ln Aseno uninayesei, ale unisgalei, adanvdo otsigowadv anelisgei.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏂᎾᏰᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏍᎦᎴᎢ, ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎣᏥᎪᏩᏛ ᎠᏁᎵᏍᎨᎢ.
\ft But they were terrified and affrighted, and supposed that they had seen a spirit.

\ln Hiano niduweselei, gadono itsadeyataneha?  Ale gadono tsutlvwidv nitsalisdane doditsadanvdvi?
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎦᏙᏃ ᎢᏣᏕᏯᏔᏁᎭ?  ᎠᎴ ᎦᏙᏃ ᏧᏢᏫᏛ ᏂᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁ ᏙᏗᏣᏓᏅᏛᎢ?
\ft And he said unto them, Why are ye troubled? and why do thoughts arise in your hearts?

\ln Ditsakanvga diquoyeni ale diqualasideni, aquvsvquo hia tsinaquadvnv; sgiyasvniga ale itsadolehohi; adanvdoyeno vtla yuquedala, ale vtla tsugola yidulv nasgiya tsitsigowatiha ayv nidaquvnvi.

\ft No man hath seen God at any time; the only begotten Son, which is in the bosom of the Father, he hath declared him.

\ln Ale nasgi hia Tsani unohelvhi, nahiyu Anitsusi Tsilusilimi dotsuninvsv atsilvanelohi ale Aniliwi gvwadvdvdiyi, hia iyuniwesdiyi; Gago nihi?
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏣᏂ ᎤᏃᎮᎸᎯ, ᏀᎢᏳ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᏙᏧᏂᏅᏒ ᎠᏥᎸᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᎵᏫ ᎬᏩᏛᏛᏗᏱ, ᎯᎠ ᎢᏳᏂᏪᏍᏗᏱ; ᎦᎪ ᏂᎯ?
\ft And this is the record of John, when the Jews sent priests and Levites from Jerusalem to ask him, Who art thou?

\ln Ale u'nonvgi, ale vtla yudayilei, u'nonvquosgini hia nuwesvgi; Vtla ayv Galonedv yigi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎤᏃᏅᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᏳᏓᏱᎴᎢ, ᎤᏃᏅᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎥᏝ ᎠᏴ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏱᎩ.
\ft And he confessed, and denied not; but confessed, I am not the Christ.

\ln Ale vgvwadvdvnvgi hia nuniwesvgi; Gagoge?  Ilayasgo nihi?  Hiano nuwesvgi; Vtla.  Tsigoge na adolehosgi nihi?  Vtla, udvnvgi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎥᎬᏩᏛᏛᏅᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᎦᎪᎨ?  ᎢᎳᏯᏍᎪ ᏂᎯ?  ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎥᏝ.  ᏥᎪᎨ Ꮎ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᏂᎯ?  ᎥᏝ, ᎤᏛᏅᎩ.
\ft And they asked him, What then? Art thou Elias? And he saith, I am not. Art thou that prophet? And he answered, No.

\ln Hnaquono hia nvgvwaweselvgi; Gago nihi?  Widotsinonediyiyeno nvdagoginvsvhi; Gado hadiha tsvsv hadanohesgvi?
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏅᎬᏩᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎦᎪ ᏂᎯ?  ᏫᏙᏥᏃᏁᏗᏱᏰᏃ ᏅᏓᎪᎩᏅᏒᎯ; ᎦᏙ ᎭᏗᎭ ᏨᏒ ᎭᏓᏃᎮᏍᎬᎢ?
\ft Then said they unto him, Who art thou? that we may give an answer to them that sent us. What sayest thou of thyself?

\ln Hia nuwesvgi; Ayv nasgi na uwelugi hia tsinigawe inagei; Itsitsinohisda nvnohi Ugvwiyuhi utseliga; nasgi nuwesv Isaya adolehosgi.
\syll ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᏪᎷᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᎦᏪ ᎢᎾᎨᎢ; ᎢᏥᏥᏃᎯᏍᏓ ᏅᏃᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏪᏒ ᎢᏌᏯ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ.
\ft He said, I am the voice of one crying in the wilderness, Make straight the way of the Lord, as said the prophet Esaias.

\ln Nasgino na nvdagetsinvsidv Aniqualisiyi unaligohi gesvgi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ Ꮎ ᏅᏓᎨᏥᏅᏏᏛ ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏᏱ ᎤᎾᎵᎪᎯ ᎨᏒᎩ.
\ft And they which were sent were of the Pharisees.

\ln Gvwadvdvnvgino hia nigvwaweselvgi; Gadono tsidehadawosga, iyuno nihi nasgi na Galonedv ale Ilaya ale nasgi na adolehosgi nigesvna yigi?
\syll ᎬᏩᏛᏛᏅᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏩᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎦᏙᏃ ᏥᏕᎭᏓᏬᏍᎦ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᏂᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎢᎳᏯ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏱᎩ?
\ft And they asked him, and said unto him, Why baptizest thou then, if thou be not that Christ, nor Elias, neither that prophet?

\ln Tsani dunetselvgi, hia nuwesvgi, Ayv ama degadawosdiha; aseno gadoga gilo itsidonav udasuya nasgi netsigatahvna;
\syll ᏣᏂ ᏚᏁᏤᎸᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ, ᎠᏴ ᎠᎹ ᏕᎦᏓᏬᏍᏗᎭ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎦᏙᎦ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏥᏙᎾᎥ ᎤᏓᏑᏯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏁᏥᎦᏔᎲᎾ;
\ft John answered them, saying, I baptize with water: but there standeth one among you, whom ye know not;

\ln Nasgisgini na oni tsvdayai, igvyi tsagaledi; nasgi tsulasulo degolvsadv vtla yeli yinigoi disgikaneyvdiyi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ Ꮎ ᎣᏂ ᏨᏓᏯᎢ, ᎢᎬᏱ ᏣᎦᎴᏗ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᎳᏑᎶ ᏕᎪᎸᏌᏛ ᎥᏝ ᏰᎵ ᏱᏂᎪᎢ ᏗᏍᎩᎧᏁᏴᏗᏱ.
\ft He it is, who coming after me is preferred before me, whose shoe's latchet I am not worthy to unloose.

\ln Nasgi hia nulistanidolvgi Digasohisdiyi Tsodani sgoniditlv nahna Tsani dadawosgvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏂᏙᎸᎩ ᏗᎦᏐᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏦᏓᏂ ᏍᎪᏂᏗᏢ ᏀᎾ ᏣᏂ ᏓᏓᏬᏍᎬᎢ.
\ft These things were done in Bethabara beyond Jordan, where John was baptizing.

\ln Ale ugitsvdv Tsani wugohvgi Tsisa gadogv iditlv dvgadvgi, ale hia nuwesvgi; Tsetsaganvga Awiagina Unelanvhi utseliga, nasgi ahvsgi elohi unisganvtsvi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎤᎩᏨᏛ ᏣᏂ ᏭᎪᎲᎩ ᏥᏌ ᎦᏙᎬ ᎢᏗᏢ ᏛᎦᏛᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᏤᏣᎦᏅᎦ ᎠᏫᎠᎩᎾ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎲᏍᎩ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎤᏂᏍᎦᏅᏨᎢ.
\ft The next day John seeth Jesus coming unto him, and saith, Behold the Lamb of God, which taketh away the sin of the world.

\ln Nasgisgini hia na tsitsineisdisgvgi; Oni dayai igvyi agaledi tsigadisgvgi, nasgiyeno ehvgi asi nigevna tsigesvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ ᎯᎠ Ꮎ ᏥᏥᏁᎢᏍᏗᏍᎬᎩ; ᎣᏂ ᏓᏯᎢ ᎢᎬᏱ ᎠᎦᎴᏗ ᏥᎦᏗᏍᎬᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎡᎲᎩ ᎠᏏ ᏂᎨᎥᎾ ᏥᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft This is he of whom I said, After me cometh a man which is preferred before me: for he was before me.

\ln Ale ayv vtla yitsigatahei; aseno nasgi Isili getsinanugowisediyi nvtsulisdotanv agilutsv ama degadawosdiha.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏥᎦᏔᎮᎢ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏏᎵ ᎨᏥᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᏗᏱ ᏅᏧᎵᏍᏙᏔᏅ ᎠᎩᎷᏨ ᎠᎹ ᏕᎦᏓᏬᏍᏗᎭ.
\ft And I knew him not: but that he should be made manifest to Israel, therefore am I come baptizing with water.

\ln Ale Tsani unohelvgi hia nuwesvgi; Agigohvgi Adanvdo guledisgonihi nasgiya dayunetlunvgi galvladi, ale nasgi dugilvtsvgi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏣᏂ ᎤᏃᎮᎸᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎠᎩᎪᎲᎩ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎫᎴᏗᏍᎪᏂᎯ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏓᏳᏁᏡᏅᎩ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᎩᎸᏨᎩ.
\ft And John bare record, saying, I saw the Spirit descending from heaven like a dove, and it abode upon him.

\ln Ale ayv vtla yitsigatahei; aseno nasgi na nvdvginvsidv ama diquadawosdodiyi nasgi hia nagiweselvgi; Gilo higovha Adanvdo anetluhvsgvi dugilvtsvha, nasgi Galvquodiyu Adanvdo didawosdisgi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏥᎦᏔᎮᎢ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏅᏛᎩᏅᏏᏛ ᎠᎹ ᏗᏆᏓᏬᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎾᎩᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎩᎶ ᎯᎪᎥᎭ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎠᏁᏡᎲᏍᎬᎢ ᏚᎩᎸᏨᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᏗᏓᏬᏍᏗᏍᎩ.
\ft And I knew him not: but he that sent me to baptize with water, the same said unto me, Upon whom thou shalt see the Spirit descending, and remaining on him, the same is he which baptizeth with the Holy Ghost.

\ln Agigohvgino ale aginohelvgi nasgi Unelanvhi Uwetsi gesvi.
\syll ᎠᎩᎪᎲᎩᏃ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎩᏃᎮᎸᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft And I saw, and bare record that this is the Son of God.

\ln Alewo ugitsvdv Tsani gadogvgi, ale anitali gvwasdawadidohi danidogvgi.
\syll ᎠᎴᏬ ᎤᎩᏨᏛ ᏣᏂ ᎦᏙᎬᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏓᏂᏙᎬᎩ.
\ft Again the next day after John stood, and two of his disciples;

\ln Dukahnanvno Tsisa aisvi hia nuwesvgi; Tsetsaganvga Awiagina Unelanvhi utseliga;
\syll ᏚᎧᎿᏅᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎠᎢᏒᎢ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᏤᏣᎦᏅᎦ ᎠᏫᎠᎩᎾ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ;
\ft And looking upon Jesus as he walked, he saith, Behold the Lamb of God!

\ln Nasgino na anitali gvwasdawadidohi unadvganvgi unetsv; ale nasgi unisdawadvsvgi Tsisa.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ Ꮎ ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅᎩ ᎤᏁᏨ; ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᏍᏓᏩᏛᏒᎩ ᏥᏌ.
\ft And the two disciples heard him speak, and they followed Jesus.

\ln Tsisano ugatahvsv, ale gvwasdawadisv dugohv, hia niduweselvgi; Gado isdiyoha?  Hiano nigvwaweselvgi; Taquinasgi anetlvtanvhi gadvga Tadeyohvsgihatlv ditsenv.
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᎦᏔᎲᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏒ ᏚᎪᎲ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎦᏙ ᎢᏍᏗᏲᎭ?  ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᎬᏩᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏔᏈᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏁᏢᏔᏅᎯ ᎦᏛᎦ ᏔᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩᎭᏢ ᏗᏤᏅ.
\ft Then Jesus turned, and saw them following, and saith unto them, What seek ye? They said unto him, Rabbi, (which is to say, being interpreted, Master,) where dwellest thou?

\ln Hia niduweselvgi; Idena, wisdagata.  Unenvsvgino ale unagatanvgi ganelvi, ale itsulaha unedolvhi nahiyu iga; nvgineyeno iyutlilodv kalawadisv gesvgi.
\syll ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎢᏕᎾ, ᏫᏍᏓᎦᏔ.  ᎤᏁᏅᏒᎩᏃ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᎦᏔᏅᎩ ᎦᏁᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎤᏁᏙᎸᎯ ᏀᎢᏳ ᎢᎦ; ᏅᎩᏁᏰᏃ ᎢᏳᏟᎶᏛ ᎧᎳᏩᏗᏒ ᎨᏒᎩ.
\ft He saith unto them, Come and see. They came and saw where he dwelt, and abode with him that day: for it was about the tenth hour.

\ln Asiyvwi nasgi na anitali Tsani unadvganelvhi, ale [Tsisa] unisdawadvdv, nasgi Enidi gesvgi, Sawani Quida dinadanvtli.
\syll ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᏣᏂ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏁᎸᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᏌdata is invalid ᎤᏂᏍᏓᏩᏛᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᏂᏗ ᎨᏒᎩ, ᏌᏩᏂ ᏈᏓ ᏗᎾᏓᏅᏟ.
\ft One of the two which heard John speak, and followed him, was Andrew, Simon Peter's brother.

\ln Igvyi uwadvhvgi utseli unili Sawani, ale hia nuweselvgi; Otsiwadvhv Mesaya; (nasgi anetlvtanvhi Galonedv gadvga.)
\syll ᎢᎬᏱ ᎤᏩᏛᎲᎩ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎤᏂᎵ ᏌᏩᏂ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎣᏥᏩᏛᎲ ᎺᏌᏯ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏁᏢᏔᏅᎯ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎦᏛᎦ.
\ft He first findeth his own brother Simon, and saith unto him, We have found the Messias, which is, being interpreted, the Christ.

\ln Ale nasgi utinolvgi Tsisa edohvi.  Tsisano dukahnanv hia nuwesvgi; Sawani nihi, Tsona uwetsi, Siquasi detsadoesdi; nasgi anetlvtanvhi Quida gadvga.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏘᏃᎸᎩ ᏥᏌ ᎡᏙᎲᎢ.  ᏥᏌᏃ ᏚᎧᎿᏅ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᏌᏩᏂ ᏂᎯ, ᏦᎾ ᎤᏪᏥ, ᏏᏆᏏ ᏕᏣᏙᎡᏍᏗ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏁᏢᏔᏅᎯ ᏈᏓ ᎦᏛᎦ.
\ft And he brought him to Jesus. And when Jesus beheld him, he said, Thou art Simon the son of Jona: thou shalt be called Cephas, which is by interpretation, A stone.

\ln Ugitsvdv Tsisa udulisgvgi Gelili uwenvsdiyi; Quiligino uwadvhvgi, ale nasgi hia nuweselvgi; Sgisdawaduga.
\syll ᎤᎩᏨᏛ ᏥᏌ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎬᎩ ᎨᎵᎵ ᎤᏪᏅᏍᏗᏱ; ᏈᎵᎩᏃ ᎤᏩᏛᎲᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏍᎩᏍᏓᏩᏚᎦ.

\ln Quiligi Quetsayidi ehi gesvgi, Enidi ale Quida uniduhvi.
\syll ᏈᎵᎩ ᏇᏣᏱᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎨᏒᎩ, ᎡᏂᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏈᏓ ᎤᏂᏚᎲᎢ.
\ft Now Philip was of Bethsaida, the city of Andrew and Peter.

\ln Quilino uwadvhvgi Nedanili, ale hia nuweselvgi; Otsiwadvhv nasgi Mosi guwowela tsikanoheha dikahnawadvsdi gowelihi, ale anadolehosgi tsaninoheha, nasgi Tsisa Naselidi ehi Tsowa uwetsi.
\syll ᏈᎵᏃ ᎤᏩᏛᎲᎩ ᏁᏓᏂᎵ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎣᏥᏩᏛᎲ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎼᏏ ᎫᏬᏪᎳ ᏥᎧᏃᎮᎭ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎪᏪᎵᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᏣᏂᏃᎮᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏌ ᎾᏎᎵᏗ ᎡᎯ ᏦᏩ ᎤᏪᏥ.
\ft Philip findeth Nathanael, and saith unto him, We have found him, of whom Moses in the law, and the prophets, did write, Jesus of Nazareth, the son of Joseph.

\ln Nedanilino hia nuweselvgi; Yelisgo gohusdi osdv nvdagvwananugoisdi Naselidi?  Quiligi hia nuweselvgi; Inena, wagata.
\syll ᏁᏓᏂᎵᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏰᎵᏍᎪ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᎾᏄᎪᎢᏍᏗ ᎾᏎᎵᏗ?  ᏈᎵᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎢᏁᎾ, ᏩᎦᏔ.
\ft And Nathanael said unto him, Can there any good thing come out of Nazareth? Philip saith unto him, Come and see.

\ln Tsisa wugohvgi Nedanili, gadogv iditlv dvgadvgi; hiano nuwesvgi, nasgi uneistanvgi; Gvniyuquo udohiyuhiya Isili uwetsi, nasgi galonuhedv nudasuyvna.
\syll ᏥᏌ ᏭᎪᎲᎩ ᏁᏓᏂᎵ, ᎦᏙᎬ ᎢᏗᏢ ᏛᎦᏛᎩ; ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎢᏍᏔᏅᎩ; ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎢᏏᎵ ᎤᏪᏥ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎶᏄᎮᏛ ᏄᏓᏑᏴᎾ.
\ft Jesus saw Nathanael coming to him, and saith of him, Behold an Israelite indeed, in whom is no guile!

\ln Nedanili hia nuweselvgi; Gado digalisdodi isgigataha?  Tsisa unetsv hia nuweselvgi; Asiquo quiligi winitsayanisgvna tsigesvgi, egataiyusdi Tlugvi hawiniditlv tsitsolvgi, wigvgovgi.
\syll ᏁᏓᏂᎵ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎦᏙ ᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᎢᏍᎩᎦᏔᎭ?  ᏥᏌ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎠᏏᏉ ᏈᎵᎩ ᏫᏂᏣᏯᏂᏍᎬᎾ ᏥᎨᏒᎩ, ᎡᎦᏔᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏡᎬᎢ ᎭᏫᏂᏗᏢ ᏥᏦᎸᎩ, ᏫᎬᎪᎥᎩ.
\ft Nathanael saith unto him, Whence knowest thou me? Jesus answered and said unto him, Before that Philip called thee, when thou wast under the fig tree, I saw thee.

\ft And needed not that any should testify of man: for he knew what was in man.

\ln Asgaya ehvgi Nigadimasi tsudoidv, Aniqualisiyi utseligohi, Anitsusi digvwanelodi gesvgi.
\syll ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎡᎲᎩ ᏂᎦᏗᎹᏏ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ, ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏᏱ ᎤᏤᎵᎪᎯ, ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᏗᎬᏩᏁᎶᏗ ᎨᏒᎩ.
\ft There was a man of the Pharisees, named Nicodemus, a ruler of the Jews:

\ln Nasgi Tsisa ulutselvgi svnoyi hia nuweselvgi; Disqueyohvsgi, otsigataha tadeyohvsgi gesv Unelanvhi nvdatsanvsidv gesvi:  vtlayeno gilo nasgi hia usquanigodi tsidetsalvwisdaneha yidogvwalvwisdasi, Unelanvhi nidukahnawadidohvnayigi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏌ ᎤᎷᏤᎸᎩ ᏒᏃᏱ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏗᏍᏇᏲᎲᏍᎩ, ᎣᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᏔᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏅᏓᏣᏅᏏᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ:  ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᏥᏕᏣᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎭ ᏱᏙᎬᏩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏏ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏂᏚᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎲᎾᏱᎩ.
\ft The same came to Jesus by night, and said unto him, Rabbi, we know that thou art a teacher come from God: for no man can do these miracles that thou doest, except God be with him.

\ln Tsisa unetsv hia nuweselvgi; Udo hiyuhiya, udohiyuhiya hia nigvweseha, Gilo taline udenvhi nigesvna igesesdi vtla yvgvgowadv nahna Unelanvhi ugvwi yuhi gesvi.
\syll ᏥᏌ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎤᏙ ᎯᏳᎯᏯ, ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏪᏎᎭ, ᎩᎶ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎤᏕᏅᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎥᏝ ᏴᎬᎪᏩᏛ ᏀᎾ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎬᏫ ᏳᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Jesus answered and said unto him, Verily, verily, I say unto thee, Except a man be born again, he cannot see the kingdom of God.

\ln Nigadimasino hia nuweselvgi; Gado yigalisdoda yvwi yadehvga hnaquo agayvlige yigi?  Tsigo taline utsisiyi wiyayvha, yadehvga?
\syll ᏂᎦᏗᎹᏏᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎦᏙ ᏱᎦᎵᏍᏙᏓ ᏴᏫ ᏯᏕᎲᎦ ᎿᏉ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᏱᎩ?  ᏥᎪ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎤᏥᏏᏱ ᏫᏯᏴᎭ, ᏯᏕᎲᎦ?
\ft Nicodemus saith unto him, How can a man be born when he is old? can he enter the second time into his mother's womb, and be born?

\ln Tsisa unetsvgi; Udohiyuhiya, udohiyuhiya hia nigvweseha, Gilo ama ale Adanvdo gvwananugowisvhi nigesvna igesesdi, vtla yvgvyvha nahna Unelanvhi ugvwiyuhi gesvi.
\syll ᏥᏌ ᎤᏁᏨᎩ; ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ, ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏪᏎᎭ, ᎩᎶ ᎠᎹ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎬᏩᎾᏄᎪᏫᏒᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎥᏝ ᏴᎬᏴᎭ ᏀᎾ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Jesus answered, Verily, verily, I say unto thee, Except a man be born of water and of the Spirit, he cannot enter into the kingdom of God.

\ln Nasgi na uquedali unanugowisvhi uquedaliquo gesoi; nasgi na adanvdo unanugowisvhi Adanvdo gesoi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏫᏒᎯ ᎤᏇᏓᎵᏉ ᎨᏐᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏫᏒᎯ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎨᏐᎢ.
\ft That which is born of the flesh is flesh; and that which is born of the Spirit is spirit.

\ln Tlesdi tsasquanigosvgi ase taline itsadedi, tsigvyosi.
\syll ᏞᏍᏗ ᏣᏍᏆᏂᎪᏒᎩ ᎠᏎ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎢᏣᏕᏗ, ᏥᎬᏲᏏ.
\ft Marvel not that I said unto thee, Ye must be born again.

\ln Unole udulisdvquo ititlv wiganolvdisgoi, ale unoyvgv hadvgisgoi, aseno vtla yigataho digadvi ale wagadvi; nasgiyasgini nusdi naniv gilo nasgi Adanvdo tsunanugowisvhi.
\syll ᎤᏃᎴ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᏛᏉ ᎢᏘᏢ ᏫᎦᏃᎸᏗᏍᎪᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏃᏴᎬ ᎭᏛᎩᏍᎪᎢ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏱᎦᏔᎰ ᏗᎦᏛᎢ ᎠᎴ ᏩᎦᏛᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩᏯᏍᎩᏂ ᏄᏍᏗ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎩᎶ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᏧᎾᏄᎪᏫᏒᎯ.
\ft The wind bloweth where it listeth, and thou hearest the sound thereof, but canst not tell whence it cometh, and whither it goeth: so is every one that is born of the Spirit.

\ln Nigadimasi unetsv hia nuweselvgi; Gado yigalisdoda nasgi yinusdi?
\syll ᏂᎦᏗᎹᏏ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎦᏙ ᏱᎦᎵᏍᏙᏓ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᏄᏍᏗ?
\ft Nicodemus answered and said unto him, How can these things be?

\ln Tsisa unetsv hia nuweselvgi; Tsigo tadeyohvsgi Isili anehvi, nigatahvnano igi nasgi hia.
\syll ᏥᏌ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏥᎪ ᏔᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ ᎢᏏᎵ ᎠᏁᎲᎢ, ᏂᎦᏔᎲᎾᏃ ᎢᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ.
\ft Jesus answered and said unto him, Art thou a master of Israel, and knowest not these things?

\ln Udohiyuhiya, udohiyuhiya hia nigvweseha; Onigatahv otsinegoi, ale ogigohvhi otsinohesgoi, aseno vtla yiditsadanilvgo otsinohesgvi.
\syll ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ, ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏪᏎᎭ; ᎣᏂᎦᏔᎲ ᎣᏥᏁᎪᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎣᎩᎪᎲᎯ ᎣᏥᏃᎮᏍᎪᎢ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏗᏣᏓᏂᎸᎪ ᎣᏥᏃᎮᏍᎬᎢ.
\ft Verily, verily, I say unto thee, We speak that we do know, and testify that we have seen; and ye receive not our witness.

\ln Iyuno elohi nigalistanidohv itsvnohehelv nitsohiyuhvsgvna yigi, gado yigalisdoda yitsohiyuhvga, galvladi nigalistanidohv yitsvnohehelv?
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏔᏂᏙᎲ ᎢᏨᏃᎮᎮᎸ ᏂᏦᎯᏳᎲᏍᎬᎾ ᏱᎩ, ᎦᏙ ᏱᎦᎵᏍᏙᏓ ᏱᏦᎯᏳᎲᎦ, ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏔᏂᏙᎲ ᏱᏨᏃᎮᎮᎸ?
\ft If I have told you earthly things, and ye believe not, how shall ye believe, if I tell you of heavenly things?

\ln Vtlayeno gilo galvladi wiyulosoi, galvladi nvdayulosvhi uwasv, yvwi Uwetsi, nasgi galvladi tseha.
\syll ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏫᏳᎶᏐᎢ, ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏅᏓᏳᎶᏒᎯ ᎤᏩᏒ, ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏤᎭ.
\ft And no man hath ascended up to heaven, but he that came down from heaven, even the Son of man which is in heaven.

\ln Ale Mosi inadv tsusaladane inagei, nasgiya nasquo yvwi Uwetsi dayetsisaladini,
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎼᏏ ᎢᎾᏛ ᏧᏌᎳᏓᏁ ᎢᎾᎨᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᏓᏰᏥᏌᎳᏗᏂ,
\ft And as Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, even so must the Son of man be lifted up:

\ln Nasgi gilo gohiyuhvsgesdi, uyohuhisdiyi nigesvna, gvnidvsgini uwadvdi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎩᎶ ᎪᎯᏳᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎤᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎬᏂᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏩᏛᏗ.
\ft That whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have eternal life.

\ln Nasgiyeno nigavgi Unelanvhi ugeyusvgi elohi, deuyosvgi utseliga Uwetsi nasgi uwasvhiyu udenelvhi, gilo nasgi yigohiyuhvsga uyohuhisdiyi nigesvna, gvnidvquosgini uwadvdi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᏂᎦᎥᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎨᏳᏒᎩ ᎡᎶᎯ, ᏕᎤᏲᏒᎩ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏩᏒᎯᏳ ᎤᏕᏁᎸᎯ, ᎩᎶ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᎪᎯᏳᎲᏍᎦ ᎤᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎬᏂᏛᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏩᏛᏗ.
\ft For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have everlasting life.

\ln Unelanvhiyeno vtla elohi uluhisdiyi yvtsunvsv Uwetsi tsuwudanediyi elohi, nasgisgini iyuwanisodiyi elohi atsisdelvdiyi.
\syll ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎤᎷᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏴᏧᏅᏒ ᎤᏪᏥ ᏧᏭᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᎡᎶᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏐᏗᏱ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎠᏥᏍᏕᎸᏗᏱ.
\ft For God sent not his Son into the world to condemn the world; but that the world through him might be saved.

\ln Gilo nasgi na tsigohiyuhvsgoi, vtla usganvtsvhi tsudugotanvhi yigesoi, nasgisgini na nigohiyuhvsgvna nasgi gayula usganvtsvhi tsudugotanvhi gesoi, nvdigalisdodisgo nuwohiyunvna gesv Unelanvhi Uwetsi deudov nasgi uwasvhiyu udenelvhi.
\syll ᎩᎶ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏥᎪᎯᏳᎲᏍᎪᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎤᏍᎦᏅᏨᎯ ᏧᏚᎪᏔᏅᎯ ᏱᎨᏐᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ Ꮎ ᏂᎪᎯᏳᎲᏍᎬᎾ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏳᎳ ᎤᏍᎦᏅᏨᎯ ᏧᏚᎪᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏐᎢ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎪ ᏄᏬᎯᏳᏅᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏪᏥ ᏕᎤᏙᎥ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏩᏒᎯᏳ ᎤᏕᏁᎸᎯ.
\ft He that believeth on him is not condemned: but he that believeth not is condemned already, because he hath not believed in the name of the only begotten Son of God.

\ln Ale nasgi hia nvdigalisdodiha unisganvtsv tsidunadugodaneha, nasgi igagati elohi unanugotsilv, ale yvwi utli uniyelvnv ulisigi esgaquo igagati, dunilvwisdanehvyeno uyoiyu gesvgi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎤᏂᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᏥᏚᎾᏚᎪᏓᏁᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎦᎦᏘ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏥᎸ, ᎠᎴ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏟ ᎤᏂᏰᎸᏅ ᎤᎵᏏᎩ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎢᎦᎦᏘ, ᏚᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᏰᏃ ᎤᏲᎢᏳ ᎨᏒᎩ.
\ft And this is the condemnation, that light is come into the world, and men loved darkness rather than light, because their deeds were evil.

\ln Uyoyeno tsulvwisdanehi asgago igagati, ale vtla yigalugo igagadvi, nvdigalisdodisgo nudulisgvna gesv gvnigesv iyulisdodiyi nusdv dulvwisdanehvi.
\syll ᎤᏲᏰᏃ ᏧᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᎠᏍᎦᎪ ᎢᎦᎦᏘ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᏱᎦᎷᎪ ᎢᎦᎦᏛᎢ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎪ ᏄᏚᎵᏍᎬᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎢ.
\ft For every one that doeth evil hateth the light, neither cometh to the light, lest his deeds should be reproved.

\ln Duyugodvsgini tsulvwisdanehi igagadv galugoi, udulisgo gvnigesv iyulisdodiyi Unelanvhi osiyu uyelvdi dulvwisdanehvi.
\syll ᏚᏳᎪᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᏧᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᎢᎦᎦᏛ ᎦᎷᎪᎢ, ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎪ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎤᏰᎸᏗ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎢ.
\ft But he that doeth truth cometh to the light, that his deeds may be made manifest, that they are wrought in God.

\ln Nasgino nulistanidolv, Tsisa ale gvwasdawadidohi Tsudiyi wunilosvgi, nahnano unedolvgi, ale dudawovgi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏂᏙᎸ, ᏥᏌ ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏧᏗᏱ ᏭᏂᎶᏒᎩ, ᏀᎾᏃ ᎤᏁᏙᎸᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏓᏬᎥᎩ.
\ft After these things came Jesus and his disciples into the land of Judaea; and there he tarried with them, and baptized.

\ln Tsanino nasquo Inoni dadawosgvgi, Selimi navi, nahnayeno utsadvgi ama.  Anilugvgino ale degegawosgvgi.
\syll ᏣᏂᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎢᏃᏂ ᏓᏓᏬᏍᎬᎩ, ᏎᎵᎻ ᎾᎥᎢ, ᏀᎾᏰᏃ ᎤᏣᏛᎩ ᎠᎹ.  ᎠᏂᎷᎬᎩᏃ ᎠᎴ ᏕᎨᎦᏬᏍᎬᎩ.
\ft And John also was baptizing in Aenon near to Salim, because there was much water there: and they came, and were baptized.

\ln Tsaniyeno vtla asi didasdudiyi yatsiyvdisgei.
\syll ᏣᏂᏰᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎠᏏ ᏗᏓᏍᏚᏗᏱ ᏯᏥᏴᏗᏍᎨᎢ.
\ft For John was not yet cast into prison.

\ln Hnaquono kanohedi nunalisdanelvgi Tsani gvwasdawadidohi Anitsusino adanvgalvdiyi ugvwali.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎧᏃᎮᏗ ᏄᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᎸᎩ ᏣᏂ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎠᏂᏧᏏᏃ ᎠᏓᏅᎦᎸᏗᏱ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ.
\ft Then there arose a question between some of John's disciples and the Jews about purifying.

\ln Tsanino unilitselvgi, hia nuniweselvgi; Tadeyohvsgi, nasgi natsisdedohvgi Tsodani sgoniditlv, nasgi tsinohesgvgi, gvniyuquo nasgi dadawoa, ale nigadvquo gvwalutseha.
\syll ᏣᏂᏃ ᎤᏂᎵᏤᎸᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏔᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏥᏍᏕᏙᎲᎩ ᏦᏓᏂ ᏍᎪᏂᏗᏢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏃᎮᏍᎬᎩ, ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏓᏓᏬᎠ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛᏉ ᎬᏩᎷᏤᎭ.
\ft And they came unto John, and said unto him, Rabbi, he that was with thee beyond Jordan, to whom thou barest witness, behold, the same baptizeth, and all men come to him.

\ln Tsani unetsv hia nuwesvgi; Yvwi vtla gohusdi yvgvwadv gvni galvladi nvdayetsinelvhi yigi.
\syll ᏣᏂ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᏴᏫ ᎥᏝ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏴᎬᏩᏛ ᎬᏂ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏅᏓᏰᏥᏁᎸᎯ ᏱᎩ.
\ft John answered and said, A man can receive nothing, except it be given him from heaven.

\ln Nihi itsvsv itsigatahi hia tsinitsiwesgvgi; Ayv vtla Galonedv yigi, vginvsidvquosgini igvyi tsiyenvehi.
\syll ᏂᎯ ᎢᏨᏒ ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎯ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᏥᏪᏍᎬᎩ; ᎠᏴ ᎥᏝ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏱᎩ, ᎥᎩᏅᏏᏛᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᎬᏱ ᏥᏰᏅᎡᎯ.
\ft Ye yourselves bear me witness, that I said, I am not the Christ, but that I am sent before him.

\ln Udayvsdi uwekahi nasgi adesvhvsgi; aseno adesvhvsgi unalii, nasgi tsigadogo ale tsudvganehoi, utsalanvhi aliheligo nvdigalisdodisgo adesvhvsgi kanegvi.  Nasgisgini ayv galieligv ukalitsv.
\syll ᎤᏓᏴᏍᏗ ᎤᏪᎧᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏕᏒᎲᏍᎩ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᏕᏒᎲᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᎵᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᎦᏙᎪ ᎠᎴ ᏧᏛᎦᏁᎰᎢ, ᎤᏣᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎵᎮᎵᎪ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎪ ᎠᏕᏒᎲᏍᎩ ᎧᏁᎬᎢ.  ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏴ ᎦᎵᎡᎵᎬ ᎤᎧᎵᏨ.
\ft He that hath the bride is the bridegroom: but the friend of the bridegroom, which standeth and heareth him, rejoiceth greatly because of the bridegroom's voice: this my joy therefore is fulfilled.

\ln Nasgi na ase dvdvnosi, ayvsgini ase datsiyolotsi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᏎ ᏛᏛᏃᏏ, ᎠᏴᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏎ ᏓᏥᏲᎶᏥ.
\ft He must increase, but I must decrease.

\ln Galvladi nvdayulosvhi utli atsilvquodiyu esgaquo nanivi.  Elohi unanugotsvhi elohiquo ehi gesoi, ale gawonisgv elohiquo ehi gesoi, galvladisgini nvdayulosvhi utli galvquodiyu esgaquo nanivi.
\syll ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏅᏓᏳᎶᏒᎯ ᎤᏟ ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎾᏂᎥᎢ.  ᎡᎶᎯ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏨᎯ ᎡᎶᎯᏉ ᎡᎯ ᎨᏐᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᏬᏂᏍᎬ ᎡᎶᎯᏉ ᎡᎯ ᎨᏐᎢ, ᎦᎸᎳᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᏅᏓᏳᎶᏒᎯ ᎤᏟ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎾᏂᎥᎢ.
\ft He that cometh from above is above all: he that is of the earth is earthly, and speaketh of the earth: he that cometh from heaven is above all.

\ln Ale nasgi ugohvi udvganvnasgi kanoheha, aseno vtla gilo yidadanilvga nasgi unohelvi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎪᎲᎢ ᎤᏛᎦᏅᎾᏍᎩ ᎧᏃᎮᎭ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᏱᏓᏓᏂᎸᎦ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏃᎮᎸᎢ.
\ft And what he hath seen and heard, that he testifieth; and no man receiveth his testimony.

\ln Nasgisgini na tsudanilvtsvhisgini unohelvi nasgi usdayidv Unelanvhi gvwatsigodi nigesvna gesvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ Ꮎ ᏧᏓᏂᎸᏨᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏃᎮᎸᎢ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏍᏓᏱᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎬᏩᏥᎪᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft He that hath received his testimony hath set to his seal that God is true.

\ln Nasgiyeno Unelanvhi unvsidv, Unelanvhi uwonihisdi gesv gawoniha; Unelanvhiyeno vtla utlilodvquo Adanvdo yuneha.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏅᏏᏛ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎦᏬᏂᎭ; ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏟᎶᏛᏉ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᏳᏁᎭ.
\ft For he whom God hath sent speaketh the words of God: for God giveth not the Spirit by measure unto him.

\ln Agayvlige ugeyuhiyu Uwetsi, ale nigadiyu gohusdi duyohiselv.
\syll ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᎤᎨᏳᎯᏳ ᎤᏪᏥ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏚᏲᎯᏎᎸ.
\ft The Father loveth the Son, and hath given all things into his hand.

\ln Nasgi na gohiyuhvsgi [Unelanvhi] Uwetsi, nasgi gvnidv alisquadisgi negesvna utseliga, nasgisgini Uwetsi gohiyuhvsgi nigesvna vtla gvnidv ugowadvdi yigi; Unelanvhiquosgini utalawohisdi gesv ulinohiyeha.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎪᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯdata is invalid ᎤᏪᏥ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎠᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᎩ ᏁᎨᏒᎾ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎪᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎥᏝ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎤᎪᏩᏛᏗ ᏱᎩ; ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏔᎳᏬᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎵᏃᎯᏰᎭ.
\ft He that believeth on the Son hath everlasting life: and he that believeth not the Son shall not see life; but the wrath of God abideth on him.

\ln Ugvwiyuhino udvganv Aniqualisi unadvganv Tsisa utli iyanii gvwasdawadegi nidegvnehv ale degawosgvi, esgaquo Tsani,
\syll ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᏃ ᎤᏛᎦᏅ ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅ ᏥᏌ ᎤᏟ ᎢᏯᏂᎢ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏕᎩ ᏂᏕᎬᏁᎲ ᎠᎴ ᏕᎦᏬᏍᎬᎢ, ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᏣᏂ,
\ft When therefore the Lord knew how the Pharisees had heard that Jesus made and baptized more disciples than John,

\ln (Vtlasgininonv Tsisa uwasv yidadawosgei, gvwasdawadidohiquosgini,)
\syll ᎥᏝᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᏥᏌ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏱᏓᏓᏬᏍᎨᎢ, ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯᏉᏍᎩᏂ,
\ft (Though Jesus himself baptized not, but his disciples,)

\ln Tsudiyi unigisvgi ale taline Gelili wvulosvgi.
\syll ᏧᏗᏱ ᎤᏂᎩᏒᎩ ᎠᎴ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎨᎵᎵ ᏮᎤᎶᏒᎩ.
\ft He left Judaea, and departed again into Galilee.

\ln Ale Sameliyi ase ulohisdi gesvgi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏌᎺᎵᏱ ᎠᏎ ᎤᎶᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎩ.
\ft And he must needs go through Samaria.

\ln Hnaquono Sameliyi gaduhv ulutsvgi Saga tsudoidv nasgi nav tsigaduha gada ahv Tsegaqui tsunele uwetsi Tsowa.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏌᎺᎵᏱ ᎦᏚᎲ ᎤᎷᏨᎩ ᏌᎦ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᎥ ᏥᎦᏚᎭ ᎦᏓ ᎠᎲ ᏤᎦᏈ ᏧᏁᎴ ᎤᏪᏥ ᏦᏩ.
\ft Then cometh he to a city of Samaria, which is called Sychar, near to the parcel of ground that Jacob gave to his son Joseph.

\ln Nahnano atalesvgi ama tsunitlvdiyi Tsegaqui utseliga; Tsisano duyawetsv aisv uwenvgi atalesvi; taladuno iyvdv iyutlilodv kalawadisv gesvgi.
\syll ᏀᎾᏃ ᎠᏔᎴᏒᎩ ᎠᎹ ᏧᏂᏢᏗᏱ ᏤᎦᏈ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ; ᏥᏌᏃ ᏚᏯᏪᏨ ᎠᎢᏒ ᎤᏪᏅᎩ ᎠᏔᎴᏒᎢ; ᏔᎳᏚᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎢᏳᏟᎶᏛ ᎧᎳᏩᏗᏒ ᎨᏒᎩ.
\ft Now Jacob's well was there. Jesus therefore, being wearied with his journey, sat thus on the well: and it was about the sixth hour.

\ln Nahna ulutse ageyv Sameliyi ehi ama utlvhilei; Tsisa hia nuweselei; Aquaditasdi sginehvsi.
\syll ᏀᎾ ᎤᎷᏤ ᎠᎨᏴ ᏌᎺᎵᏱ ᎡᎯ ᎠᎹ ᎤᏢᎯᎴᎢ; ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎠᏆᏗᏔᏍᏗ ᏍᎩᏁᎲᏏ.
\ft There cometh a woman of Samaria to draw water: Jesus saith unto her, Give me to drink.

\ln Gvwasdawadidohiyeno digaduhv wanedohvgi alisdayvdi uniwasvsvgi.
\syll ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯᏰᏃ ᏗᎦᏚᎲ ᏩᏁᏙᎲᎩ ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗ ᎤᏂᏩᏒᏒᎩ.
\ft (For his disciples were gone away unto the city to buy meat.)

\ln Hnaquono nasgi ageyv Sameliyi ehi hia nuweselei; Gado digalisdodiha nihi Hitsusi aditasdi isgitayoseha tsigeyv Sameliyi gei.  (Anitsusiyeno ale Sameliyi anehi vtla yidunadagasayasdoi.)
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎨᏴ ᏌᎺᎵᏱ ᎡᎯ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎦᏙ ᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᏂᎯ ᎯᏧᏏ ᎠᏗᏔᏍᏗ ᎢᏍᎩᏔᏲᏎᎭ ᏥᎨᏴ ᏌᎺᎵᏱ ᎨᎢ.  ᎠᏂᏧᏏᏰᏃ ᎠᎴ ᏌᎺᎵᏱ ᎠᏁᎯ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏚᎾᏓᎦᏌᏯᏍᏙᎢ.
\ft Then saith the woman of Samaria unto him, How is it that thou, being a Jew, askest drink of me, which am a woman of Samaria? for the Jews have no dealings with the Samaritans.

\ln Tsisa unetsei hia nuweselei; Iyuno yihigatahe Unelanvhi udanedi tsigi, ale yihigatahe hia nasgi tsinitsaweseha, Aquaditasdi sginehvsi; tsvsv yitayoselei, ale yitsanenele gvnidv ama.
\syll ᏥᏌ ᎤᏁᏤᎢ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᏱᎯᎦᏔᎮ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏓᏁᏗ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏱᎯᎦᏔᎮ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏂᏣᏪᏎᎭ, ᎠᏆᏗᏔᏍᏗ ᏍᎩᏁᎲᏏ; ᏨᏒ ᏱᏔᏲᏎᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏱᏣᏁᏁᎴ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎠᎹ.
\ft Jesus answered and said unto her, If thou knewest the gift of God, and who it is that saith to thee, Give me to drink; thou wouldest have asked of him, and he would have given thee living water.

\ln Ageyv hia nuweselei, Hisgaya, vtla gohusdi yiyeha atlvdi, hawiniyuno atalesvi, hatlvno tsanegisv nasgi gvnidv ama?
\syll ᎠᎨᏴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎯᏍᎦᏯ, ᎥᏝ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏱᏰᎭ ᎠᏢᏗ, ᎭᏫᏂᏳᏃ ᎠᏔᎴᏒᎢ, ᎭᏢᏃ ᏣᏁᎩᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎠᎹ?
\ft The woman saith unto him, Sir, thou hast nothing to draw with, and the well is deep: from whence then hast thou that living water?

\ln Tsisa utli etsalvquodiyu nihi, esgaquo igidoda Tsegaqui nasgi iginelvhi hia atalesvi, ale nahna uwasv uditahvi ale dunaditahvi tsuwetsi ale unatlanavi.
\syll ᏥᏌ ᎤᏟ ᎡᏣᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᏂᎯ, ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎢᎩᏙᏓ ᏤᎦᏈ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎩᏁᎸᎯ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏔᎴᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏀᎾ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎤᏗᏔᎲᎢ ᎠᎴ ᏚᎾᏗᏔᎲᎢ ᏧᏪᏥ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏝᎾᎥᎢ.
\ft Art thou greater than our father Jacob, which gave us the well, and drank thereof himself, and his children, and his cattle?

\ln Tsisa unetsei hia nuweselei; Gilo yuditahv hia ama talinequo utadegodi;
\syll ᏥᏌ ᎤᏁᏤᎢ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎩᎶ ᏳᏗᏔᎲ ᎯᎠ ᎠᎹ ᏔᎵᏁᏉ ᎤᏔᏕᎪᏗ;
\ft Jesus answered and said unto her, Whosoever drinketh of this water shall thirst again:

\ln Gilosgini yuditahv nasgi ama ayv tsinenedi tsigi vtla iyuhiyu utadegodi yigi, ayvsgini tsinenedi tsigi ama, hawini ayelv ama ganugogv gesesdi, wigananugogesdi gvnidv alisquadisgi nigesvna digesvi.
\syll ᎩᎶᏍᎩᏂ ᏳᏗᏔᎲ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎹ ᎠᏴ ᏥᏁᏁᏗ ᏥᎩ ᎥᏝ ᎢᏳᎯᏳ ᎤᏔᏕᎪᏗ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᏴᏍᎩᏂ ᏥᏁᏁᏗ ᏥᎩ ᎠᎹ, ᎭᏫᏂ ᎠᏰᎸ ᎠᎹ ᎦᏄᎪᎬ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᏫᎦᎾᏄᎪᎨᏍᏗ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎠᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏗᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft But whosoever drinketh of the water that I shall give him shall never thirst; but the water that I shall give him shall be in him a well of water springing up into everlasting life.

\ln Ageyv hia nuweselei; Hisgaya, hia nasgi ama sginehvsi, tlesdino agitadeganvgi, ale tlesdi ani agitlvhilvgi.
\syll ᎠᎨᏴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎯᏍᎦᏯ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎹ ᏍᎩᏁᎲᏏ, ᏞᏍᏗᏃ ᎠᎩᏔᏕᎦᏅᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎠᏂ ᎠᎩᏢᎯᎸᎩ.
\ft The woman saith unto him, Sir, give me this water, that I thirst not, neither come hither to draw.

\ln Tsisa hia nuweselei; Tsayehi wiyanv, anino isdilutsvha.
\syll ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᏣᏰᎯ ᏫᏯᏅ, ᎠᏂᏃ ᎢᏍᏗᎷᏨᎭ.
\ft Jesus saith unto her, Go, call thy husband, and come hither.

\ln Ageyvno unetsei hia nuweselei; Vtla yeha agiyehi.  Tsisa hia nuweselei; Yeli niwi, vtla yeha agiyehi, tsadv;
\syll ᎠᎨᏴᏃ ᎤᏁᏤᎢ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎥᏝ ᏰᎭ ᎠᎩᏰᎯ.  ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᏰᎵ ᏂᏫ, ᎥᏝ ᏰᎭ ᎠᎩᏰᎯ, ᏣᏛ;
\ft The woman answered and said, I have no husband. Jesus said unto her, Thou hast well said, I have no husband:

\ln Hisgiyeno nanivgi getsayehi, gohino tsitsakaha vtla tsayehi yigi; nasgi tsiniwi duyugodv niwi.
\syll ᎯᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎾᏂᎥᎩ ᎨᏣᏰᎯ, ᎪᎯᏃ ᏥᏣᎧᎭ ᎥᏝ ᏣᏰᎯ ᏱᎩ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏂᏫ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᏂᏫ.
\ft For thou hast had five husbands; and he whom thou now hast is not thy husband: in that saidst thou truly.

\ln Ageyv hia nuweselei; Hisgaya, gadoleosga hadolehosgi gesvi.
\syll ᎠᎨᏴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎯᏍᎦᏯ, ᎦᏙᎴᎣᏍᎦ ᎭᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft The woman saith unto him, Sir, I perceive that thou art a prophet.

\ln Tsogigayvlige anadadolisdisgvgi ani odalvi, aseno nihi hia nitsiwesgoi; Tsilusilimisgini nahna ugvwiyuha adadolisdodiyi.
\syll ᏦᎩᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᎠᎾᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᎠᏂ ᎣᏓᎸᎢ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᏂᎯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏥᏪᏍᎪᎢ; ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻᏍᎩᏂ ᏀᎾ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎭ ᎠᏓᏙᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
\ft Our fathers worshipped in this mountain; and ye say, that in Jerusalem is the place where men ought to worship.

\ln Tsisa hia nuweselei; Higeyv, squohiyuhvga, dvsqualvhi nahiyu vtla ani odalvi, ale nasquo Tsilusilimi, yigayetsadadolisdanehesdi Agayvligei.
\syll ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎯᎨᏴ, ᏍᏉᎯᏳᎲᎦ, ᏛᏍᏆᎸᎯ ᏀᎢᏳ ᎥᏝ ᎠᏂ ᎣᏓᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ, ᏱᎦᏰᏣᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ.
\ft Jesus saith unto her, Woman, believe me, the hour cometh, when ye shall neither in this mountain, nor yet at Jerusalem, worship the Father.

\ln Nihi itsadadolisdaneha gohusdi nasgi nitsigatahvna; ayvsgini otsigataha iyusdi otsadadolisdanehvi; Anitsusiyeno anehv alisdelvdodi gesv nvdayunanugoisdi.
\syll ᏂᎯ ᎢᏣᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎭ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᏥᎦᏔᎲᎾ; ᎠᏴᏍᎩᏂ ᎣᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎣᏣᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎲᎢ; ᎠᏂᏧᏏᏰᏃ ᎠᏁᎲ ᎠᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏓᏳᎾᏄᎪᎢᏍᏗ.
\ft Ye worship ye know not what: we know what we worship: for salvation is of the Jews.

\ln Aseno dvsqualvhi, ale hnaquo usqualvhv, nasgi udohiyusv anadadolisdisgi dvnadadolisdaneli Agayvlige dodvnvtani tsunadanvdo ale duyugodvi; Agayvligeyeno duyoho nasgi iyunasdi gvwadadolisdanehi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᏛᏍᏆᎸᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎿᏉ ᎤᏍᏆᎸᎲ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᏒ ᎠᎾᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᏛᎾᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎵ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᏙᏛᏅᏔᏂ ᏧᎾᏓᏅᏙ ᎠᎴ ᏚᏳᎪᏛᎢ; ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᏰᏃ ᏚᏲᎰ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗ ᎬᏩᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎯ.

\ft God is a Spirit: and they that worship him must worship him in spirit and in truth.

\ft The woman saith unto him, I know that Messias cometh, which is called Christ: when he is come, he will tell us all things.

\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏚᏛᏛᏅᎩ ᎢᏳᎢ ᎤᎴᏅᎲ ᏏᏲᏍᏛ ᏄᎵᏍᏓᏁᎸᎢ.  ᎤᏒᎯ ᏌᏉ ᎢᏳᏟᎶᏛ ᎧᎳᏩᏗᏒ ᏄᏗᎴᎲᏍᎬᎾ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎩ, ᎥᎬᏬᏎᎸᎩ.
\ft Then inquired he of them the hour when he began to amend. And they said unto him, Yesterday at the seventh hour the fever left him.

\ln Nasgino udoda udolehosvgi nahiyu gesv Tsisa hia nuweselvi; Tsetsi gvnv.  Uwasvno uwohiyunvgi ale nasquo nigadv tsutseli sidanelvhi gesvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᏙᏓ ᎤᏙᎴᎰᏒᎩ ᏀᎢᏳ ᎨᏒ ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎢ; ᏤᏥ ᎬᏅ.  ᎤᏩᏒᏃ ᎤᏬᎯᏳᏅᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏧᏤᎵ ᏏᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft So the father knew that it was at the same hour, in the which Jesus said unto him, Thy son liveth: and himself believed, and his whole house.

\ln Nasgi hia taline usquanigodi dulvwisdanelv Tsisa Gelili ulutsonvhi, Tsudiyi nvdayulosvhi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸ ᏥᏌ ᎨᎵᎵ ᎤᎷᏦᏅᎯ, ᏧᏗᏱ ᏅᏓᏳᎶᏒᎯ.
\ft This is again the second miracle that Jesus did, when he was come out of Judaea into Galilee.

\ln Nasgino nulistanidolv, usqualvhvgi Anitsusi tsunalisdayvdiyi; ale Tsisa Tsilusilimi uwenvsvgi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏂᏙᎸ, ᎤᏍᏆᎸᎲᎩ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᏧᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ; ᎠᎴ ᏥᏌ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᎤᏪᏅᏒᎩ.
\ft After this there was a feast of the Jews; and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.

\ln Tsilusilimini awi uniyvsdiyi nav adawosdiyi gotlvha nasgi Aniquilu uniwonihisdi gesv Tludesdi deudov; nahnani hisgi dayodatlaha.
\syll ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻᏂ ᎠᏫ ᎤᏂᏴᏍᏗᏱ ᎾᎥ ᎠᏓᏬᏍᏗᏱ ᎪᏢᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏂᏈᎷ ᎤᏂᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏡᏕᏍᏗ ᏕᎤᏙᎥ; ᏀᎾᏂ ᎯᏍᎩ ᏓᏲᏓᏝᎭ.
\ft Now there is at Jerusalem by the sheep market a pool, which is called in the Hebrew tongue Bethesda, having five porches.

\ln Nahna aninidlavgi unitsati tsunitlvgi, ale dinigewi, ale diniyouli, ale unvisvhi, anigatiyvgi ulitelvdiyi ama.
\syll ᏀᎾ ᎠᏂᏂᏜᎥᎩ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏧᏂᏢᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏂᎨᏫ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏂᏲᎤᎵ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏅᎢᏒᎯ, ᎠᏂᎦᏘᏴᎩ ᎤᎵᏖᎸᏗᏱ ᎠᎹ.
\ft In these lay a great multitude of impotent folk, of blind, halt, withered, waiting for the moving of the water.

\ln Iyvdvhayeno dikahnawadidohi galutsihihvgi adawosdiyi, ale atelvhvsgvgi ama, gilono nasgi tsudalenvtanvhi udunvhi hnaquo atelvnvhi tsigeso ama, udiwasgvgi nigav gohusdi vyugi uyilidohvi.
\syll ᎢᏴᏛᎭᏰᏃ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎦᎷᏥᎯᎲᎩ ᎠᏓᏬᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏖᎸᎲᏍᎬᎩ ᎠᎹ, ᎩᎶᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏔᏅᎯ ᎤᏚᏅᎯ ᎿᏉ ᎠᏖᎸᏅᎯ ᏥᎨᏐ ᎠᎹ, ᎤᏗᏩᏍᎬᎩ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎥᏳᎩ ᎤᏱᎵᏙᎲᎢ.
\ft For an angel went down at a certain season into the pool, and troubled the water: whosoever then first after the troubling of the water stepped in was made whole of whatsoever disease he had.

\ln Ale nahna ganvgvgi gilo iyusdi asgaya, tsoasgohi nelagali iyudetiyvdv gvwatlvtsvhi nudiwasgvna gesvgi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏀᎾ ᎦᏅᎬᎩ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ, ᏦᎠᏍᎪᎯ ᏁᎳᎦᎵ ᎢᏳᏕᏘᏴᏛ ᎬᏩᏢᏨᎯ ᏄᏗᏩᏍᎬᎾ ᎨᏒᎩ.
\ft And a certain man was there, which had an infirmity thirty and eight years.

\ln Tsisano ugohvgi nasgi asgaya ganvgvi, ale udolehosv gesvgi, gohidiyu igvwalistanvhi gesvi, hia nuweselvgi; Tsadulisgo etsanvwodiyi?
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᎪᎲᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎦᏅᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏙᎴᎰᏒ ᎨᏒᎩ, ᎪᎯᏗᏳ ᎢᎬᏩᎵᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏣᏚᎵᏍᎪ ᎡᏣᏅᏬᏗᏱ?
\ft When Jesus saw him lie, and knew that he had been now a long time in that case, he saith unto him, Wilt thou be made whole?

\ln Utlvgi unetsv hia nuweselvgi; Hisgaya, vtla gilo yedoho ama alitelvhvga, adawosdiyi wagikahvsgi; asiquoyeno tsiwigaisoi, gilo dagigonisgoi igvyi watloasgoi.
\syll ᎤᏢᎩ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎯᏍᎦᏯ, ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᏰᏙᎰ ᎠᎹ ᎠᎵᏖᎸᎲᎦ, ᎠᏓᏬᏍᏗᏱ ᏩᎩᎧᎲᏍᎩ; ᎠᏏᏉᏰᏃ ᏥᏫᎦᎢᏐᎢ, ᎩᎶ ᏓᎩᎪᏂᏍᎪᎢ ᎢᎬᏱ ᏩᏠᎠᏍᎪᎢ.
\ft The impotent man answered him, Sir, I have no man, when the water is troubled, to put me into the pool: but while I am coming, another steppeth down before me.

\ln Tsisa hia nuweselvgi; Talehvga, hinagi tsatsesdo, ale heda.
\syll ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏔᎴᎲᎦ, ᎯᎾᎩ ᏣᏤᏍᏙ, ᎠᎴ ᎮᏓ.
\ft Jesus saith unto him, Rise, take up thy bed, and walk.

\ln Gilaquono iyvdv nasgi asgaya udiwasvgi, ale unesvgi utsesdo, ale uwedolvgi.  Ale unadodaquasgv gesvgi nahiyu iga.
\syll ᎩᎳᏉᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᏗᏩᏒᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᏒᎩ ᎤᏤᏍᏙ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏪᏙᎸᎩ.  ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏙᏓᏆᏍᎬ ᎨᏒᎩ ᏀᎢᏳ ᎢᎦ.
\ft And immediately the man was made whole, and took up his bed, and walked: and on the same day was the sabbath.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi Anitsusi hia nuniwesele atsinvwanvhi; Gohi unadodaquasgvi, vtla duyugodv yigi tsatsesdo tsanidasdiyi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎴ ᎠᏥᏅᏩᏅᎯ; ᎪᎯ ᎤᎾᏙᏓᏆᏍᎬᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᏱᎩ ᏣᏤᏍᏙ ᏣᏂᏓᏍᏗᏱ.
\ft The Jews therefore said unto him that was cured, It is the sabbath day: it is not lawful for thee to carry thy bed.

\ln Hia niduweselei; Aginvwanvhi hia nagiweselvgi; Hinagi tsatsesdo, ale heda.
\syll ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎠᎩᏅᏩᏅᎯ ᎯᎠ ᎾᎩᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎯᎾᎩ ᏣᏤᏍᏙ, ᎠᎴ ᎮᏓ.
\ft He answered them, He that made me whole, the same said unto me, Take up thy bed, and walk.

\ln Hnaquono unadvdvnei, hia nuniwesei; Gago iyusdi nasgi asgaya, Tsatsesdo hinagi ale heda, tsoselvhi?
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎤᎾᏛᏛᏁᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ; ᎦᎪ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ, ᏣᏤᏍᏙ ᎯᎾᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎮᏓ, ᏦᏎᎸᎯ?
\ft Then asked they him, What man is that which said unto thee, Take up thy bed, and walk?

\ln Ale nasgi atsinvwanvhi vtla yagatahe nasgi gesvi; Tsisayeno udelidv udanvsvgi; unitsadvyeno nahna anedohvgi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏥᏅᏩᏅᎯ ᎥᏝ ᏯᎦᏔᎮ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᏥᏌᏰᏃ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᎤᏓᏅᏒᎩ; ᎤᏂᏣᏛᏰᏃ ᏀᎾ ᎠᏁᏙᎲᎩ.
\ft And he that was healed wist not who it was: for Jesus had conveyed himself away, a multitude being in that place.

\ln Onino Tsisa nasgi uwadvhvgi udvnvdigalawiisdiyi, ale hia nuweselvgi; Gvniyuquo etsanvwanv; tlesdi hnaquo ilvhiyu yitsasganvtsesdi, utliyeno iyuyo yitsalutsisi.
\syll ᎣᏂᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏩᏛᎲᎩ ᎤᏛᏅᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎡᏣᏅᏩᏅ; ᏞᏍᏗ ᎿᏉ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᏱᏣᏍᎦᏅᏤᏍᏗ, ᎤᏟᏰᏃ ᎢᏳᏲ ᏱᏣᎷᏥᏏ.
\ft Afterward Jesus findeth him in the temple, and said unto him, Behold, thou art made whole: sin no more, lest a worse thing come unto thee.

\ln Nasgi asgaya udanvsvgi, ale widunonelvgi Anitsusi, Tsisa unvwanvhi gesvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᏓᏅᏒᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏫᏚᏃᏁᎸᎩ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ, ᏥᏌ ᎤᏅᏩᏅᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft The man departed, and told the Jews that it was Jesus, which had made him whole.

\ln Ale nasgi iyusdi Anitsusi unadeyadotanvgi Tsisa, ale uniyolvgi unihisdiyi, nvdagalisdodisgvgi nasgi nudvnelv unadodaquasgv iga.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎤᎾᏕᏯᏙᏔᏅᎩ ᏥᏌ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏲᎸᎩ ᎤᏂᎯᏍᏗᏱ, ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏛᏁᎸ ᎤᎾᏙᏓᏆᏍᎬ ᎢᎦ.
\ft And therefore did the Jews persecute Jesus, and sought to slay him, because he had done these things on the sabbath day.

\ln Aseno Tsisa dunetselvgi [hia niduweselvgi,] Edoda gohi iyasti dulvwisdanehoi, ayvno nasquo dagilvwisdanehoi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᏥᏌ ᏚᏁᏤᎸᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ,data is invalid ᎡᏙᏓ ᎪᎯ ᎢᏯᏍᏘ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎰᎢ, ᎠᏴᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏓᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎰᎢ.
\ft But Jesus answered them, My Father worketh hitherto, and I work.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi Anitsusi utli igai unadulvhvgi unihisdiyi, nvdagalisdodisgvgi vtla unadodaquasgvquo uwasv uyostanvi, nasquosgini Unelanvhi Udoda udvnvi, itsulaha Unelanvhi nadadvnehvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎤᏟ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎤᎾᏚᎸᎲᎩ ᎤᏂᎯᏍᏗᏱ, ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᎥᏝ ᎤᎾᏙᏓᏆᏍᎬᏉ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎤᏲᏍᏔᏅᎢ, ᎾᏍᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏙᏓ ᎤᏛᏅᎢ, ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎾᏓᏛᏁᎲᎢ.
\ft Therefore the Jews sought the more to kill him, because he not only had broken the sabbath, but said also that God was his Father, making himself equal with God.

\ln Hnaquono Tsisa unetsv hia niduweselvgi; Udohiyuhiya udohiyuhiya hia nitsvweseha; [Unelanvhi] Uwetsi vtla yeliga gohusdi uwasv gesv yidogvwalvwisdasi, agowatisgvsgini Udoda dulvwisdanehvi; nasgiyeno nusdv dulvwisdanehvi nasgi nasquo Uwetsi dulvwisdanehoi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ; ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯdata is invalid ᎤᏪᏥ ᎥᏝ ᏰᎵᎦ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎨᏒ ᏱᏙᎬᏩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏏ, ᎠᎪᏩᏘᏍᎬᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏙᏓ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎢ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᏪᏥ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎰᎢ.
\ft Then answered Jesus and said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, The Son can do nothing of himself, but what he seeth the Father do: for what things soever he doeth, these also doeth the Son likewise.

\ln Agayvligeyeno ugeyuhiyu Uwetsi, ale gananugowiseho nigadv uwasv dulvwisdanehvi; ale utli igai digalvwisdanedi dagananugowiseli esgaquo hia; nasgi itsisquanigohisdiyi.
\syll ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᏰᏃ ᎤᎨᏳᎯᏳ ᎤᏪᏥ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᎰ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᏟ ᎢᎦᎢ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᏓᎦᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᎵ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎯᎠ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏥᏍᏆᏂᎪᎯᏍᏗᏱ.
\ft For the Father loveth the Son, and sheweth him all things that himself doeth: and he will shew him greater works than these, that ye may marvel.

\ln Agayvligeyeno tsidaledisgo tsuniyohusvhi, ale dinvnodv tsinidegvnehoi, nasgiyasgini Uwetsi dinvnodv nidegvneho naniv nasgiquo ela.
\syll ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᏰᏃ ᏥᏓᎴᏗᏍᎪ ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏅᏃᏛ ᏥᏂᏕᎬᏁᎰᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏪᏥ ᏗᏅᏃᏛ ᏂᏕᎬᏁᎰ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎾᏍᎩᏉ ᎡᎳ.
\ft For as the Father raiseth up the dead, and quickeneth them; even so the Son quickeneth whom he will.

\ln Agayvligeyeno nasquo vtla gilo yidigugodanehoi, duyohiselvsgini Uwetsi nagadv digugododi gesvi,
\syll ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᏱᏗᎫᎪᏓᏁᎰᎢ, ᏚᏲᎯᏎᎸᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎾᎦᏛ ᏗᎫᎪᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ,
\ft For the Father judgeth no man, but hath committed all judgment unto the Son:

\ln Nasgi nigadv unilvquododiyi Uwetsi, nasgiya tsinanilvquodiha Agayvligei.  Gilo nigalvquodisgvna tsigeso Unelanvhi Uwetsi, vtla yigalvquodisgo Agayvlige nasgi nvdayunvsidv.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎤᏂᎸᏉᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᏪᏥ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏥᎾᏂᎸᏉᏗᎭ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ.  ᎩᎶ ᏂᎦᎸᏉᏗᏍᎬᎾ ᏥᎨᏐ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏪᏥ, ᎥᏝ ᏱᎦᎸᏉᏗᏍᎪ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏓᏳᏅᏏᏛ.
\ft That all men should honour the Son, even as they honour the Father. He that honoureth not the Son honoureth not the Father which hath sent him.

\ln Udohiyuhiya, udohiyuhiya hia nitsvweseha; Advgisgi tsinegvi, ale gohiyuhvsgi nvdvginvsidv nasgi uha gvnidv nalisquadisgvna, ale nasgi vtla tsudugododi yigi usganvtsvi, ayohuhisdisgini gesv udanvsv, gvnidv digesv wulosv.
\syll ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ, ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ; ᎠᏛᎩᏍᎩ ᏥᏁᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎪᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᏅᏛᎩᏅᏏᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎭ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎾᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᎬᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎥᏝ ᏧᏚᎪᏙᏗ ᏱᎩ ᎤᏍᎦᏅᏨᎢ, ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏓᏅᏒ, ᎬᏂᏛ ᏗᎨᏒ ᏭᎶᏒ.
\ft Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that heareth my word, and believeth on him that sent me, hath everlasting life, and shall not come into condemnation; but is passed from death unto life.

\ln Udohiyuhiya, udohiyuhiya hia nitsvweseha; Dvsqualvhi ale hnaquo usqualvhv tsuniyohusvhi unadvgodiyi Unelanvhi Uwetsi kanegvi, ale unadvganvhi unadvnidisdi gesesdi.
\syll ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ, ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ; ᏛᏍᏆᎸᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎿᏉ ᎤᏍᏆᎸᎲ ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᎤᎾᏛᎪᏗᏱ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎧᏁᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅᎯ ᎤᎾᏛᏂᏗᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft Verily, verily, I say unto you, The hour is coming, and now is, when the dead shall hear the voice of the Son of God: and they that hear shall live.

\ln Agayvligeyeno gvnidv utseliga tsigi, nasgiya nasquo unelv Uwetsi gvnidv utseliga iyulisdodiyi.
\syll ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᏰᏃ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᏁᎸ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
\ft For as the Father hath life in himself; so hath he given to the Son to have life in himself;

\ln Ale nasquo unelv tsuwugododiyi, nvtsulisdotanv yvwi Uwetsi gesvi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᏁᎸ ᏧᏭᎪᏙᏗᏱ, ᏅᏧᎵᏍᏙᏔᏅ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft And hath given him authority to execute judgment also, because he is the Son of man.

\ln Tlesdi nasgi hia itsisquanigosvgi, dvsqualvhiyeno nahiyu datselisdv aniyai nigadv dvnadvgani kanegvi,
\syll ᏞᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎢᏥᏍᏆᏂᎪᏒᎩ, ᏛᏍᏆᎸᎯᏰᏃ ᏀᎢᏳ ᏓᏤᎵᏍᏛ ᎠᏂᏯᎢ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏛᎾᏛᎦᏂ ᎧᏁᎬᎢ,
\ft Marvel not at this: for the hour is coming, in the which all that are in the graves shall hear his voice,

\ln Ale dvninanugotsi, nasgi na osdv tsunilvwisdanelvhi gvnidv gesv widodvnaletani, uyono tsunilvwisdanelvhi udasdvdisdi gesv widodvnaletani.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏛᏂᎾᏄᎪᏥ, ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎨᏒ ᏫᏙᏛᎾᎴᏔᏂ, ᎤᏲᏃ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᎤᏓᏍᏛᏗᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏫᏙᏛᎾᎴᏔᏂ.
\ft And shall come forth; they that have done good, unto the resurrection of life; and they that have done evil, unto the resurrection of damnation.

\ln Vtla gohusdi aquvsv gesv yeli yidogvgilvwisdasi; gadvgisgv nasgiya degugodisgoi, ale daquogotanv duyugodv gesoi; nvdigalisdodisgo nagiyohvna gesv aquvsv gadanvtesgvi, agiyohvsgini adanvtesgv Edoda nasgi nvdvginvsidv.
\syll ᎥᏝ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎠᏋᏒ ᎨᏒ ᏰᎵ ᏱᏙᎬᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏏ; ᎦᏛᎩᏍᎬ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏕᎫᎪᏗᏍᎪᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᏉᎪᏔᏅ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏐᎢ; ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎪ ᎾᎩᏲᎲᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏋᏒ ᎦᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬᎢ, ᎠᎩᏲᎲᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ ᎡᏙᏓ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏛᎩᏅᏏᏛ.
\ft I can of mine own self do nothing: as I hear, I judge: and my judgment is just; because I seek not mine own will, but the will of the Father which hath sent me.

\ln Iyuno aquvsv yigadanoheha, tsinohesgv vtla yigvwadohiyuha.
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᎠᏋᏒ ᏱᎦᏓᏃᎮᎭ, ᏥᏃᎮᏍᎬ ᎥᏝ ᏱᎬᏩᏙᎯᏳᎭ.
\ft If I bear witness of myself, my witness is not true.

\ln Nvwadale eha ayv aginohesgi, ale tsigataha udohiyuhi gesv nasgi kanohesgvi, ayv aginohesgvi.
\syll ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᎡᎭ ᎠᏴ ᎠᎩᏃᎮᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎧᏃᎮᏍᎬᎢ, ᎠᏴ ᎠᎩᏃᎮᏍᎬᎢ.
\ft There is another that beareth witness of me; and I know that the witness which he witnesseth of me is true.

\ln Tsani tsuwolv itsadanvsvgi, ale nasgi duyugodv unohelvgi.
\syll ᏣᏂ ᏧᏬᎸ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏒᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎤᏃᎮᎸᎩ.
\ft Ye sent unto John, and he bare witness unto the truth.

\ln Aseno ayv vtla yidigadanilvga yvwi aginohesgvi, aseno nasgi hia nitsiwea etsisdelvdiyi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᏴ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏗᎦᏓᏂᎸᎦ ᏴᏫ ᎠᎩᏃᎮᏍᎬᎢ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏥᏪᎠ ᎡᏥᏍᏕᎸᏗᏱ.
\ft But I receive not testimony from man: but these things I say, that ye might be saved.

\ln Nasgi adaweligisgi ale tsulvsada atsvsdodi gesvgi; nihino tlega osiyu itsiyelvsvgi itsalihelisdiyi nasgi iga utisdvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏓᏪᎵᎩᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ ᏧᎸᏌᏓ ᎠᏨᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎩ; ᏂᎯᏃ ᏞᎦ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏥᏰᎸᏒᎩ ᎢᏣᎵᎮᎵᏍᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎦ ᎤᏘᏍᏛᎢ.
\ft He was a burning and a shining light: and ye were willing for a season to rejoice in his light.

\ln Aseno utli galvquodiyu aginohesgi aqueha esgaquo Tsani; digalvwisdanediyeno Agayvlige aginelvhi agisquadisdiyi, nasgi tsidagilvwisdaneha, aginohesgo ayv Agayvligei nvdvginvsidv gesvi;
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏟ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᎩᏃᎮᏍᎩ ᎠᏇᎭ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᏣᏂ; ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗᏰᏃ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᎠᎩᏁᎸᎯ ᎠᎩᏍᏆᏗᏍᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏓᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎭ, ᎠᎩᏃᎮᏍᎪ ᎠᏴ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ ᏅᏛᎩᏅᏏᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ;
\ft But I have greater witness than that of John: for the works which the Father hath given me to finish, the same works that I do, bear witness of me, that the Father hath sent me.

\ln Ale Agayvlige nvdvginvsidv nasgi aginohelv.  Vtla ilvhiyu yigetsadvgano kanegvi, ale yigetsigoho nusdvi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᏅᏛᎩᏅᏏᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎩᏃᎮᎸ.  ᎥᏝ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᏱᎨᏣᏛᎦᏃ ᎧᏁᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏱᎨᏥᎪᎰ ᏄᏍᏛᎢ.
\ft And the Father himself, which hath sent me, hath borne witness of me. Ye have neither heard his voice at any time, nor seen his shape.

\ln Ale nasgi unetsvi vtla yitsiyaa, nasgiyeno na nvdayunvsidv vtla yetsoiyuhvsga.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᏨᎢ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏥᏯᎠ, ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ Ꮎ ᏅᏓᏳᏅᏏᏛ ᎥᏝ ᏰᏦᎢᏳᎲᏍᎦ.
\ft And ye have not his word abiding in you: for whom he hath sent, him ye believe not.

\ln Ditsigoliya goweli, nahnayeno nalisquadisgvna gvnidv itsiha itsiyelvha, ale nasgi na goweli ayv aginohesgi.
\syll ᏗᏥᎪᎵᏯ ᎪᏪᎵ, ᏀᎾᏰᏃ ᎾᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᎬᎾ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎢᏥᎭ ᎢᏥᏰᎸᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎪᏪᎵ ᎠᏴ ᎠᎩᏃᎮᏍᎩ.
\ft Search the scriptures; for in them ye think ye have eternal life: and they are they which testify of me.

\ln Aseno vtla yitsaduliha sgilutsediyi gvnidv itsatseliga iyulisdodiyi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏣᏚᎵᎭ ᏍᎩᎷᏤᏗᏱ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎢᏣᏤᎵᎦ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
\ft And ye will not come to me, that ye might have life.

\ln Yvwi gvgilvquodisgv vtla yidigadanilvga;
\syll ᏴᏫ ᎬᎩᎸᏉᏗᏍᎬ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏗᎦᏓᏂᎸᎦ;
\ft I receive not honour from men.

\ln Aseno itsvgataha, Unelanvhi etsigeyuiyu nigesvna gesvi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎢᏨᎦᏔᎭ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎡᏥᎨᏳᎢᏳ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft But I know you, that ye have not the love of God in you.

\ln Ayv Edoda deudov agiluhistanv, vtlano yidisgiyadanilvga.  Iyuno nvwadale uwasv denvdov yuluhistanv, nasgi ase yidetsadanilvgi.
\syll ᎠᏴ ᎡᏙᏓ ᏕᎤᏙᎥ ᎠᎩᎷᎯᏍᏔᏅ, ᎥᏝᏃ ᏱᏗᏍᎩᏯᏓᏂᎸᎦ.  ᎢᏳᏃ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏕᏅᏙᎥ ᏳᎷᎯᏍᏔᏅ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏎ ᏱᏕᏣᏓᏂᎸᎩ.
\ft I am come in my Father's name, and ye receive me not: if another shall come in his own name, him ye will receive.

\ln Gado yigalisdoda yitsohiyuhvga, itsvsv detsadalvquodisgv tsidetsadanilvga, nitsiyohvnano tsigi vdadilvquododi gesv nasgi Unelanvhi uwasvhiyu nvdayulisgolvdodi tsigi?
\syll ᎦᏙ ᏱᎦᎵᏍᏙᏓ ᏱᏦᎯᏳᎲᎦ, ᎢᏨᏒ ᏕᏣᏓᎸᏉᏗᏍᎬ ᏥᏕᏣᏓᏂᎸᎦ, ᏂᏥᏲᎲᎾᏃ ᏥᎩ ᎥᏓᏗᎸᏉᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏩᏒᎯᏳ ᏅᏓᏳᎵᏍᎪᎸᏙᏗ ᏥᎩ?
\ft How can ye believe, which receive honour one of another, and seek not the honour that cometh from God only?

\ln Tlesdi Agayvligei dakanoneli dayoguhistani yisgiyelisehesdi; asiyvwi eha itsuhisdisgi, Mosi, nasgi tsetsanelodi tsigi.
\syll ᏞᏍᏗ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ ᏓᎧᏃᏁᎵ ᏓᏲᎫᎯᏍᏔᏂ ᏱᏍᎩᏰᎵᏎᎮᏍᏗ; ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᎡᎭ ᎢᏧᎯᏍᏗᏍᎩ, ᎼᏏ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏤᏣᏁᎶᏗ ᏥᎩ.
\ft Do not think that I will accuse you to the Father: there is one that accuseth you, even Moses, in whom ye trust.

\ln Iyuyeno Mosi yietsoiyuhvsgei ayv yisgiyoiyunei, nasgiyeno ayv aginohesgvi uwowelanvgi.
\syll ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᎼᏏ ᏱᎡᏦᎢᏳᎲᏍᎨᎢ ᎠᏴ ᏱᏍᎩᏲᎢᏳᏁᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎠᏴ ᎠᎩᏃᎮᏍᎬᎢ ᎤᏬᏪᎳᏅᎩ.
\ft For had ye believed Moses, ye would have believed me: for he wrote of me.

\ln Aseno nitsohiyuhvsgvna yigi nasgi uwowelanvhi, gado yigalisdoda yitsohiyuhvga ayv tsinegvi?
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᏂᏦᎯᏳᎲᏍᎬᎾ ᏱᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏬᏪᎳᏅᎯ, ᎦᏙ ᏱᎦᎵᏍᏙᏓ ᏱᏦᎯᏳᎲᎦ ᎠᏴ ᏥᏁᎬᎢ?
\ft But if ye believe not his writings, how shall ye believe my words?

\ln Nasgino nulistanidolv, Tsisa duwesotsvgi gelili vdalvi, nasgi Daquiliya vdalv tsidudov.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏂᏙᎸ, ᏥᏌ ᏚᏪᏐᏨᎩ ᎨᎵᎵ ᎥᏓᎸᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏓᏈᎵᏯ ᎥᏓᎸ ᏥᏚᏙᎥ.
\ft After these things Jesus went over the sea of Galilee, which is the sea of Tiberias.

\ln Ale unitsatanvhi gvwasdawadvsvgi, nvdagalisdodisgvgi anigowatisgv nasgi unisquanigodi nidadvnehv gunitlvgi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏣᏔᏅᎯ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏛᏒᎩ, ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᎠᏂᎪᏩᏘᏍᎬ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᏂᏓᏛᏁᎲ ᎫᏂᏢᎩ.
\ft And a great multitude followed him, because they saw his miracles which he did on them that were diseased.

\ln Tsisano uhnalusvgi odalvi, ale nahna uwenvgi, ale nasquo gvwasdawadidohi.
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᎿᎷᏒᎩ ᎣᏓᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏀᎾ ᎤᏪᏅᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ.
\ft And Jesus went up into a mountain, and there he sat with his disciples.

\ln Kanohiyegino dilisdayvdiyi Anitsusi unatseliga usqualvhidena gesvgi.
\syll ᎧᏃᎯᏰᎩᏃ ᏗᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ ᎤᏍᏆᎸᎯᏕᎾ ᎨᏒᎩ.
\ft And the passover, a feast of the Jews, was nigh.

\ln Tsisano dusaladanv digadoli, ale dugohv unitsati digvwalutselisvi, hia nuweselvgi Quiligi; Hatlv dagiwasi gadu hia unigisdi.
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᏚᏌᎳᏓᏅ ᏗᎦᏙᎵ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᎪᎲ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏗᎬᏩᎷᏤᎵᏒᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ ᏈᎵᎩ; ᎭᏢ ᏓᎩᏩᏏ ᎦᏚ ᎯᎠ ᎤᏂᎩᏍᏗ.
\ft When Jesus then lifted up his eyes, and saw a great company come unto him, he saith unto Philip, Whence shall we buy bread, that these may eat?

\ln Ale nasgi hia nuwesvgi atsigoliyesgvgi, uwasvyeno agatahvgi iyudvnediyi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ ᎠᏥᎪᎵᏰᏍᎬᎩ, ᎤᏩᏒᏰᏃ ᎠᎦᏔᎲᎩ ᎢᏳᏛᏁᏗᏱ.
\ft And this he said to prove him: for he himself knew what he would do.

\ln Quiligi hia nuweselvgi; Talitsuqui anigisi tsunagvwalodi tsugvwalodi gadu vtla yeli yigagi, nasgi anisiyvwiha usdi unigisvsdiyi.
\syll ᏈᎵᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏔᎵᏧᏈ ᎠᏂᎩᏏ ᏧᎾᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎦᏚ ᎥᏝ ᏰᎵ ᏱᎦᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏂᏏᏴᏫᎭ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎤᏂᎩᏒᏍᏗᏱ.
\ft Philip answered him, Two hundred pennyworth of bread is not sufficient for them, that every one of them may take a little.

\ln Gvwasdawadidohi gesv asiyvwi, Enidi tsudoidv, Sawani Quida dinadanvtli, hia nuweselvgi;
\syll ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏏᏴᏫ, ᎡᏂᏗ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ, ᏌᏩᏂ ᏈᏓ ᏗᎾᏓᏅᏟ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ;
\ft One of his disciples, Andrew, Simon Peter's brother, saith unto him,

\ln Asiyvwi awinutsa ani edoha, nasgi dayeha hisgi utsalesdiiyusdi gadu, ale tali tsunasdi atsadi deganeha; aseno asequokani nasgi, hiano tsinunitsata?
\syll ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᎠᏫᏄᏣ ᎠᏂ ᎡᏙᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏓᏰᎭ ᎯᏍᎩ ᎤᏣᎴᏍᏗᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎦᏚ, ᎠᎴ ᏔᎵ ᏧᎾᏍᏗ ᎠᏣᏗ ᏕᎦᏁᎭ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᏎᏉᎧᏂ ᎾᏍᎩ, ᎯᎠᏃ ᏥᏄᏂᏣᏔ?
\ft There is a lad here, which hath five barley loaves, and two small fishes: but what are they among so many?

\ln Ale Tsisa hia nuwesvgi; wananvvga yvwi.  Nahnano utsadvgi ganulvsvgi.  Howano unanvnvgi anisgaya hisgiha iyagayvli iyvdv iyanii.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᏩᎾᏅᎥᎦ ᏴᏫ.  ᏀᎾᏃ ᎤᏣᏛᎩ ᎦᏄᎸᏒᎩ.  ᎰᏩᏃ ᎤᎾᏅᏅᎩ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ ᎯᏍᎩᎭ ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎢᏯᏂᎢ.
\ft And Jesus said, Make the men sit down. Now there was much grass in the place. So the men sat down, in number about five thousand.

\ln Ale Tsisa gadu dugisvgi, ale ulihelitsv duyadohelvgi gvwasdawadidohi, gvwasdawadidohino duniyadohelvgi unanvnvhi, ale nasquo atsadi nigav dunadulisgvi.

\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏍᏗ ᎠᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏛᎩᏅᏏᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏗᎩᏲᎯᏎᎸᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎠᎩᏲᎱᏎᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᏗᎦᎴᏙᏗᏱᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᎸᏗ ᎢᎦ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft And this is the Father's will which hath sent me, that of all which he hath given me I should lose nothing, but should raise it up again at the last day.

\ln Ale nasgi hia nusdi adanvtesgv Agayvlige nvdvginvsidv, nasgi gilo agowatisgi Uwetsi, ale nasgi gohiyuhvsgi, nalisquadisgvna gvnidv utseliga iyulisdodiyi; ale nasgi ayv dodatsiyaletani ulisqualvdi iga gesesdi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏍᏗ ᎠᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᏅᏛᎩᏅᏏᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎩᎶ ᎠᎪᏩᏘᏍᎩ ᎤᏪᏥ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ, ᎾᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᎬᎾ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ; ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᏙᏓᏥᏯᎴᏔᏂ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᎸᏗ ᎢᎦ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft And this is the will of him that sent me, that every one which seeth the Son, and believeth on him, may have everlasting life: and I will raise him up at the last day.

\ln Hnaquono Anitsusi gvwagonelohiselvgi nvdagalisdodisgvgi hia nuwesvi, ayv nasgi na gadu galvladi nvdadvlosvhi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎬᏩᎪᏁᎶᎯᏎᎸᎩ ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎢ, ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎦᏚ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏅᏓᏛᎶᏒᎯ.
\ft The Jews then murmured at him, because he said, I am the bread which came down from heaven.

\ln Hiano nuniwesvgi; Tlasgo hia nasgi na Tsisa yigi, Tsowa uwetsi, nasgi udoda ale utsi didigatahi tsigi?  Gadono ulisdotanv, galvladi nvdvquatloasvhi, tsadiha?
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᏝᏍᎪ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏥᏌ ᏱᎩ, ᏦᏩ ᎤᏪᏥ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏙᏓ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏥ ᏗᏗᎦᏔᎯ ᏥᎩ?  ᎦᏙᏃ ᎤᎵᏍᏙᏔᏅ, ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏅᏛᏆᏠᎠᏒᎯ, ᏣᏗᎭ?
\ft And they said, Is not this Jesus, the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we know? how is it then that he saith, I came down from heaven?

\ln Nasgi iyusdi Tsisa unetsvgi hia niduweselvgi; Tlesdi yitsigonelosgesdi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏥᏌ ᎤᏁᏨᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏥᎪᏁᎶᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
\ft Jesus therefore answered and said unto them, Murmur not among yourselves.

\ln Vtla gilo yeli yvgvgilutsisi, gvni Agayvligei nvdvginvsidv usesvdv yigi; ale ayv nasgi dodatsiyaletani ulisqualvdi iga gesesdi.
\syll ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᏰᎵ ᏴᎬᎩᎷᏥᏏ, ᎬᏂ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ ᏅᏛᎩᏅᏏᏛ ᎤᏎᏒᏛ ᏱᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏙᏓᏥᏯᎴᏔᏂ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᎸᏗ ᎢᎦ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft No man can come to me, except the Father which hath sent me draw him: and I will raise him up at the last day.

\ln Hia nigvnv gowela anadolehosgiyi; "Ale nigadv Unelanvhi tsuweyonvhi gesesdi."  Nasgi iyusdi nigadv unadvganelvhi ale unadeloquaelvhi Agayvligei, gvgilutsehoi.
\syll ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏅ ᎪᏪᎳ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩᏱ; data is invalidᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᏪᏲᏅᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.data is invalid  ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏁᎸᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏕᎶᏆᎡᎸᎯ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ, ᎬᎩᎷᏤᎰᎢ.
\ft It is written in the prophets, And they shall be all taught of God. Every man therefore that hath heard, and hath learned of the Father, cometh unto me.

\ln Vtlasgininonv gilo Agayvligei ugohvhi yigi, na uwasv Unelanvhiyi nvdayudalenvhi; nasgi ugohvhi Agayvligei.
\syll ᎥᏝᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎩᎶ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ ᎤᎪᎲᎯ ᏱᎩ, Ꮎ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏱ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎪᎲᎯ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ.
\ft Not that any man hath seen the Father, save he which is of God, he hath seen the Father.

\ln Udohiyuhiya udohiyuhiya hia nitsvweseha, Aquohiyuhvsgi uha alisquadisgi nigesvna gvnidv.
\syll ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ, ᎠᏉᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᎤᎭ ᎠᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎬᏂᏛ.
\ft Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that believeth on me hath everlasting life.

\ln Ayv nasgi na gadu advnidisdodi.
\syll ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎦᏚ ᎠᏛᏂᏗᏍᏙᏗ.
\ft I am that bread of life.

\ln Ditsigayvligei mana analisdayvdisgvgi inagei, ale duniyohusv;
\syll ᏗᏥᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ ᎹᎾ ᎠᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᎢᎾᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏂᏲᎱᏒ;
\ft Your fathers did eat manna in the wilderness, and are dead.

\ln Hia nasgi nusdi gadu galvladi nvdayulosvhi, nasgi gilo yugv vtla yvgvyohuhi.
\syll ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏗ ᎦᏚ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏅᏓᏳᎶᏒᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎩᎶ ᏳᎬ ᎥᏝ ᏴᎬᏲᎱᎯ.
\ft This is the bread which cometh down from heaven, that a man may eat thereof, and not die.

\ln Ayv nasgi na gadu gvnidv galvladi nvdayulosvhi.  Iyuno gilo agisgesdi nasgi hia gadu, alisquadisgi nigesvna gvnesdi.  Ale nasgi na gadu tsvdatsineli nasgi ayv agiwiya, nasgi tsidodvgiyosi elohi udvnidisdodi.
\syll ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎦᏚ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏅᏓᏳᎶᏒᎯ.  ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎠᎩᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎦᏚ, ᎠᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎬᏁᏍᏗ.  ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎦᏚ ᏨᏓᏥᏁᎵ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᎠᎩᏫᏯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏙᏛᎩᏲᏏ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎤᏛᏂᏗᏍᏙᏗ.
\ft I am the living bread which came down from heaven: if any man eat of this bread, he shall live for ever: and the bread that I will give is my flesh, which I will give for the life of the world.

\ln Hnaquono Anitsusi unvsvquo dunatiyolvgi, hia nuniwesvgi, Gado yigalisdoda hia asgaya yigihvsi uwasv uwiya igalisdayvdodi?
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎤᏅᏒᏉ ᏚᎾᏘᏲᎸᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ, ᎦᏙ ᏱᎦᎵᏍᏙᏓ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᏱᎩᎲᏏ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎤᏫᏯ ᎢᎦᎵᏍᏓᏴᏙᏗ?
\ft The Jews therefore strove among themselves, saying, How can this man give us his flesh to eat?

\ln Hnaquono Tsisa hia niduweselvgi; Udohiyuhiya udohiyuhiya hia nitsvwe seha; Iyuno nitsigvna yvwi Uwetsi uwiya, ale ugigv itsaditahv yigi, vtla gvnidv yitsiyaa.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪ ᏎᎭ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᏂᏥᎬᎾ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎤᏫᏯ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎩᎬ ᎢᏣᏗᏔᎲ ᏱᎩ, ᎥᏝ ᎬᏂᏛ ᏱᏥᏯᎠ.
\ft Then Jesus said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Except ye eat the flesh of the Son of man, and drink his blood, ye have no life in you.

\ln Agiwiya agisgi, ale agigigv aditasgi, gvnidv alisquadisgi nigesvna utseliga, ale nasgi ayv dodatsiyaletani ulisqualvdi iga gesesdi.
\syll ᎠᎩᏫᏯ ᎠᎩᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎩᎩᎬ ᎠᏗᏔᏍᎩ, ᎬᏂᏛ ᎠᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᏙᏓᏥᏯᎴᏔᏂ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᎸᏗ ᎢᎦ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft Whoso eateth my flesh, and drinketh my blood, hath eternal life; and I will raise him up at the last day.

\ln Agiwiyayeno udohiyusv alisdayvdi, ale agigigv udohiyusv aditasdi.
\syll ᎠᎩᏫᏯᏰᏃ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᏒ ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎩᎩᎬ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᏒ ᎠᏗᏔᏍᏗ.
\ft For my flesh is meat indeed, and my blood is drink indeed.

\ln Agiwiya agisgi, ale agigigv aditasgi, nasgi agiyaa, ayv ale nasgi tsiyaa.
\syll ᎠᎩᏫᏯ ᎠᎩᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎩᎩᎬ ᎠᏗᏔᏍᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎩᏯᎠ, ᎠᏴ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏯᎠ.
\ft He that eateth my flesh, and drinketh my blood, dwelleth in me, and I in him.

\ln Nasgiyai gvnidv Agayvligei aginvsidv tsigi, ale Agayvlige tsinvdigalisdodiha ayv tsigvnv, nasgiyai ayv aqualisdayvdisgi nasgi ayv nvdigalisdodisgesdi gvnesdi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ ᎠᎩᏅᏏᏛ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᏥᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎠᏴ ᏥᎬᏅ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ ᎠᏴ ᎠᏆᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎬᏁᏍᏗ.
\ft As the living Father hath sent me, and I live by the Father: so he that eateth me, even he shall live by me.

\ln Nasgi hia na gadu galvladi nvdayulosvhi; vtla nasgiya ditsigayvligei mana tsanigisgei, ale nasgi tsuniyohusvhi tsigi; hia gadu agisgi alisquadisgi nigesvna gvnesdi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ Ꮎ ᎦᏚ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏅᏓᏳᎶᏒᎯ; ᎥᏝ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏗᏥᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ ᎹᎾ ᏣᏂᎩᏍᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᏥᎩ; ᎯᎠ ᎦᏚ ᎠᎩᏍᎩ ᎠᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎬᏁᏍᏗ.
\ft This is that bread which came down from heaven: not as your fathers did eat manna, and are dead: he that eateth of this bread shall live for ever.

\ln Nasgi hia nuwesvgi digalawiisdiyi, dadeyohvsgv Gequani.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᏓᏕᏲᎲᏍᎬ ᎨᏆᏂ.
\ft These things said he in the synagogue, as he taught in Capernaum.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi unitsadvgi gvwasdawadidohi unadvganv, hia nuniwesvgi; Nasgi hia asdayiyu kanohedv; gago yeli yadvgvga?
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᏂᏣᏛᎩ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏍᏓᏱᏳ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ; ᎦᎪ ᏰᎵ ᏯᏛᎬᎦ?
\ft Many therefore of his disciples, when they had heard this, said, This is an hard saying; who can hear it?

\ln Hnaquono Tsisa tsudanvdv udolehosv gvwasdawadidohi unigonelosgvi, hia niduweselvgi; Tsigo nasgi hia detsodesdiha?
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏥᏌ ᏧᏓᏅᏛ ᎤᏙᎴᎰᏒ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎤᏂᎪᏁᎶᏍᎬᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏥᎪ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏕᏦᏕᏍᏗᎭ?
\ft When Jesus knew in himself that his disciples murmured at it, he said unto them, Doth this offend you?

\ln Iyunano yetsigov yvwi Uwetsi yulisaladanv nahna tsudalenv yiwolosv?
\syll ᎢᏳᎾᏃ ᏰᏥᎪᎥ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᏳᎵᏌᎳᏓᏅ ᏀᎾ ᏧᏓᎴᏅ ᏱᏬᎶᏒ?
\ft What and if ye shall see the Son of man ascend up where he was before?

\ln Adanvdosgini adadvnidisgi; uquedali vtla gvwadasdelvdi yigi.  Kanohedv ayv tsitsvwonediha nasgi adanvdo, ale nasgi gvnidv.
\syll ᎠᏓᏅᏙᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏓᏛᏂᏗᏍᎩ; ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎥᏝ ᎬᏩᏓᏍᏕᎸᏗ ᏱᎩ.  ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎠᏴ ᏥᏨᏬᏁᏗᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏂᏛ.
\ft It is the spirit that quickeneth; the flesh profiteth nothing: the words that I speak unto you, they are spirit, and they are life.

\ln Aseno itsadasuya nitsohiyuhvsgvna.  Tsisayeno didalenisgv nidagataho nasgi na nanohiyuhvsgvna, ale nagatahoi nasgi na utludisgi iyulisdodi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎢᏣᏓᏑᏯ ᏂᏦᎯᏳᎲᏍᎬᎾ.  ᏥᏌᏰᏃ ᏗᏓᎴᏂᏍᎬ ᏂᏓᎦᏔᎰ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎾᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎬᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᎦᏔᎰᎢ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᏡᏗᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗ.
\ft But there are some of you that believe not. For Jesus knew from the beginning who they were that believed not, and who should betray him.

\ln Ale hia nasquo nuwesvgi; Nasgi iyusdi hia tsinitsvweselvgi; vtla gilo yvgvgilutsi, gvni Edoda unelvhi yigi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᏨᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᏴᎬᎩᎷᏥ, ᎬᏂ ᎡᏙᏓ ᎤᏁᎸᎯ ᏱᎩ.
\ft And he said, Therefore said I unto you, that no man can come unto me, except it were given unto him of my Father.

\ln Ale nahiyu iyudalenvdv unitsadv gvwasdawadidohi unatsvsvgi, ale vtla hnaquo ilvhiyu yunedolei.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏀᎢᏳ ᎢᏳᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎤᏂᏣᏛ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎤᎾᏨᏒᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᎿᏉ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᏳᏁᏙᎴᎢ.
\ft From that time many of his disciples went back, and walked no more with him.

\ln Hnaquono Tsisa hia niduweselv taladu iyanidv; Tsigo nasquo nihi dvtsadanvsi?
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸ ᏔᎳᏚ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ; ᏥᎪ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏂᎯ ᏛᏣᏓᏅᏏ?
\ft Then said Jesus unto the twelve, Will ye also go away?

\ln Hnaquono Sawani Quida hia nuweselvgi; Tsagvwiyuhi, gago tsuwolv wvdayotsilosi?  Nihi tsasquanigodi kanohedv alisquadisgi nigesvna advnidisdodi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏌᏩᏂ ᏈᏓ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎦᎪ ᏧᏬᎸ ᏮᏓᏲᏥᎶᏏ?  ᏂᎯ ᏣᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎠᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎠᏛᏂᏗᏍᏙᏗ.
\ft Then Simon Peter answered him, Lord, to whom shall we go? thou hast the words of eternal life.

\ln Ale otsohiyuhvsga, ale otsigataha nihi nasgi Galonedv gesvi, gvnidv Unelanvhi Uwetsi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎣᏦᎯᏳᎲᏍᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᎣᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᏂᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎬᏂᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏪᏥ.
\ft And we believe and are sure that thou art that Christ, the Son of the living God.

\ln Tsisa hia niduweselvgi.  Tlasgo nihi taladu itsidv yitsvyasuyesei?  Aseno asiyvwi udasuya asgina igi.
\syll ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ.  ᏝᏍᎪ ᏂᎯ ᏔᎳᏚ ᎢᏥᏛ ᏱᏨᏯᏑᏰᏎᎢ?  ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᎤᏓᏑᏯ ᎠᏍᎩᎾ ᎢᎩ.
\ft Jesus answered them, Have not I chosen you twelve, and one of you is a devil?

\ln Nasgi nuwesv Tsudasi Isgaladi Sawani uwetsi atsidvgvgi; nasgiyeno utludisgi iyulisdodi gesvgi, taladu iyanidv gesv nahna gela gesvgi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏪᏒ ᏧᏓᏏ ᎢᏍᎦᎳᏗ ᏌᏩᏂ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎠᏥᏛᎬᎩ; ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎤᏡᏗᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎩ, ᏔᎳᏚ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᎨᏒ ᏀᎾ ᎨᎳ ᎨᏒᎩ.
\ft He spake of Judas Iscariot the son of Simon: for he it was that should betray him, being one of the twelve.

\ln Nasgino nulistanidolv Tsisa Gelili uwedolvgi; Vtlayeno yudulisge Tsudiyi uwedasdiyi, nvdagalisdodisgvgi Anitsusi ananelodisgv gvwahisdiyi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏂᏙᎸ ᏥᏌ ᎨᎵᎵ ᎤᏪᏙᎸᎩ; ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᏳᏚᎵᏍᎨ ᏧᏗᏱ ᎤᏪᏓᏍᏗᏱ, ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎠᎾᏁᎶᏗᏍᎬ ᎬᏩᎯᏍᏗᏱ.
\ft After these things Jesus walked in Galilee: for he would not walk in Jewry, because the Jews sought to kill him.

\ln Anitsusi degalitsodvitsunalisdayvdiyi usqualvhidisvgi.
\syll ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᏕᎦᎵᏦᏛᎢᏧᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ ᎤᏍᏆᎸᎯᏗᏒᎩ.
\ft Now the Jews' feast of tabernacles was at hand.

\ln Analinvtlino hia nigvwaweselvgi; Hadanvna, ale Tsudiyi wilohi, nasgino getsasdawadidohi nasquo anigohvha nusdv detsalvwisdanehvi.
\syll ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏟᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏩᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎭᏓᏅᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏗᏱ ᏫᎶᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎨᏣᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏂᎪᎲᎭ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏕᏣᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎢ.
\ft His brethren therefore said unto him, Depart hence, and go into Judaea, that thy disciples also may see the works that thou doest.

\ln Vtlayeno gilo atsigatahi iyulisdodiyi tsudulisgoi udelidv yidulvwisdanehoi.  Iyuno nasgi hia hnadvnehesdi, elohi gvnigesv niyadvnisi.
\syll ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎠᏥᎦᏔᎯ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏧᏚᎵᏍᎪᎢ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᏱᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎰᎢ.  ᎢᏳᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎿᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ, ᎡᎶᎯ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᏯᏛᏂᏏ.
\ft For there is no man that doeth any thing in secret, and he himself seeketh to be known openly. If thou do these things, shew thyself to the world.

\ln Analinvtliyeno nasquo vtla yigvwohiyuhvsgei.
\syll ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏟᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎥᏝ ᏱᎬᏬᎯᏳᎲᏍᎨᎢ.
\ft For neither did his brethren believe in him.

\ln Hnaquono Tsisa hia niduweselvgi; Vtla asi yagisqualveha; nihisgini nigohilvquo itsisqualvehoi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎥᏝ ᎠᏏ ᏯᎩᏍᏆᎸᎡᎭ; ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᏂᎪᎯᎸᏉ ᎢᏥᏍᏆᎸᎡᎰᎢ.
\ft Then Jesus said unto them, My time is not yet come: but your time is always ready.

\ln Elohi vtla itsisgagi yinvgalisda; ayvsgini agisgaga, nvdigalisdodiha tsitsinoheha nasgi dulvwisdanehv uyoiyu gesvi.
\syll ᎡᎶᎯ ᎥᏝ ᎢᏥᏍᎦᎩ ᏱᏅᎦᎵᏍᏓ; ᎠᏴᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᎩᏍᎦᎦ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᏥᏥᏃᎮᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᎤᏲᎢᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft The world cannot hate you; but me it hateth, because I testify of it, that the works thereof are evil.

\ln Nihi dodinalisdayvhvsgv itsena; vtla asi ayv dodinalisdayvhvsgv yvdagesi; vtlayeno asi yagisqualvelv.
\syll ᏂᎯ ᏙᏗᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎬ ᎢᏤᎾ; ᎥᏝ ᎠᏏ ᎠᏴ ᏙᏗᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎬ ᏴᏓᎨᏏ; ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᎠᏏ ᏯᎩᏍᏆᎸᎡᎸ.
\ft Go ye up unto this feast: I go not up yet unto this feast; for my time is not yet full come.

\ln Nasgi hia niduweselv, asiquo uwedolvgi Gelili.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸ, ᎠᏏᏉ ᎤᏪᏙᎸᎩ ᎨᎵᎵ.
\ft When he had said these words unto them, he abode still in Galilee.

\ln Aseno analinvtli unenvdv nigesoi, hnaquo nasquo dodinalisdayvhvsgv uwenvsvgi, vtla gvnigesvi, udelidvquosgini iyusdi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏟ ᎤᏁᏅᏛ ᏂᎨᏐᎢ, ᎿᏉ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏙᏗᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎬ ᎤᏪᏅᏒᎩ, ᎥᏝ ᎬᏂᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᏕᎵᏛᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ.
\ft But when his brethren were gone up, then went he also up unto the feast, not openly, but as it were in secret.

\ln Hnaquono Anitsusi gvwayolvgi danalisdayvhvsgvi, ale hia nuniwesvgi; Hatlv nasgi edoha?
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎬᏩᏲᎸᎩ ᏓᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᎭᏢ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᏙᎭ?
\ft Then the Jews sought him at the feast, and said, Where is he?

\ln Utsadvno udelidv danalinohelidohvgi yvwi nasgi gvwanohesgvi; igadvyeno hia naniwesgvgi; Osiyu asgaya; igadvno, vtla, degalonuhequo yvwi, anadisgvgi.
\syll ᎤᏣᏛᏃ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᏓᎾᎵᏃᎮᎵᏙᎲᎩ ᏴᏫ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏩᏃᎮᏍᎬᎢ; ᎢᎦᏛᏰᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏂᏪᏍᎬᎩ; ᎣᏏᏳ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ; ᎢᎦᏛᏃ, ᎥᏝ, ᏕᎦᎶᏄᎮᏉ ᏴᏫ, ᎠᎾᏗᏍᎬᎩ.
\ft And there was much murmuring among the people concerning him: for some said, He is a good man: others said, Nay; but he deceiveth the people.

\ln Aseno vtla gilo gvnigesv yunohesgei, udagalisdodisgvgi daninayesgv Anitsusi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏳᏃᎮᏍᎨᎢ, ᎤᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᏓᏂᎾᏰᏍᎬ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ.
\ft Howbeit no man spake openly of him for fear of the Jews.

\ln Hnaquono ayeli iyvdv aliyeilisv danalisdayvhvsgvi Tsisa udvnvdigalawiisdiyi uyvlvgi, ale dudeyonvgi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎠᎵᏰᎢᎵᏒ ᏓᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎬᎢ ᏥᏌ ᎤᏛᏅᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏴᎸᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏕᏲᏅᎩ.
\ft Now about the midst of the feast Jesus went up into the temple, and taught.

\ln Anitsusino unisquanigosvgi, ale nuniwesvgi; Gado ulisdotanv hia asgaya goweli disinasiyu tsigi, tsudeloquavhino nigesvna?
\syll ᎠᏂᏧᏏᏃ ᎤᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏒᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᎦᏙ ᎤᎵᏍᏙᏔᏅ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎪᏪᎵ ᏗᏏᎾᏏᏳ ᏥᎩ, ᏧᏕᎶᏆᎥᎯᏃ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ?
\ft And the Jews marvelled, saying, How knoweth this man letters, having never learned?

\ln Tsisa dunetselvgi, hia nuwesvgi; Tsidegadeyohvsga, vtla aquatseliga yigi, utseligasgini nvdvginvsidv.
\syll ᏥᏌ ᏚᏁᏤᎸᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᏥᏕᎦᏕᏲᎲᏍᎦ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᏆᏤᎵᎦ ᏱᎩ, ᎤᏤᎵᎦᏍᎩᏂ ᏅᏛᎩᏅᏏᏛ.
\ft Jesus answered them, and said, My doctrine is not mine, but his that sent me.

\ln Iyuno gilo udulisgesdi nasgi nusdv udulisgv tsulvwisdanediyi, ase udolehohisdi nasgi hia tsidegadeyohvsga Unelanvhi nvdayudalenvhi gesesdi, ale tsiwonisgv aquvsvquo aquadanvtelvhi igesesdi.
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎬ ᏧᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ, ᎠᏎ ᎤᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏕᎦᏕᏲᎲᏍᎦ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᏬᏂᏍᎬ ᎠᏋᏒᏉ ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏖᎸᎯ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft If any man will do his will, he shall know of the doctrine, whether it be of God, or whether I speak of myself.

\ln Gilo uwasv udanvtedv tsigawonisgoi, uwasvquo atsilvquodiyu iyulisdodiyi uyohoi; gilosgini nvdayunvsidv atsilvquodiyu iyulisdodiyi tsuyohoi, nasgi duyugodv gesoi, ale vtla atlonasdi gesv yudasuyoi.
\syll ᎩᎶ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎤᏓᏅᏖᏛ ᏥᎦᏬᏂᏍᎪᎢ, ᎤᏩᏒᏉ ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᏲᎰᎢ; ᎩᎶᏍᎩᏂ ᏅᏓᏳᏅᏏᏛ ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏧᏲᎰᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏐᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᎠᏠᎾᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏳᏓᏑᏲᎢ.
\ft He that speaketh of himself seeketh his own glory: but he that seeketh his glory that sent him, the same is true, and no unrighteousness is in him.

\ln Tlasgo Mosi yitsinele dikahnawadvsdi?  Aseno vtla gilo yudasuya dikahnawadvsdi nigawesgv yinadvneha.  Gadono itsaduli sgiisdiyi?
\syll ᏝᏍᎪ ᎼᏏ ᏱᏥᏁᎴ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ?  ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᏳᏓᏑᏯ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎬ ᏱᎾᏛᏁᎭ.  ᎦᏙᏃ ᎢᏣᏚᎵ ᏍᎩᎢᏍᏗᏱ?
\ft Did not Moses give you the law, and yet none of you keepeth the law? Why go ye about to kill me?

\ln Unitsati uninetsvgi, hia nuniwesvgi; Asgina tsayaa; gago uduli tsahisdiyi?
\syll ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎤᏂᏁᏨᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᎠᏍᎩᎾ ᏣᏯᎠ; ᎦᎪ ᎤᏚᎵ ᏣᎯᏍᏗᏱ?
\ft The people answered and said, Thou hast a devil: who goeth about to kill thee?

\ln Tsisa unetsvgi, hia niduweselvgi; Sudalegi dagilvwisdanelv, nitsivno itsisquanigosga.
\syll ᏥᏌ ᎤᏁᏨᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏑᏓᎴᎩ ᏓᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸ, ᏂᏥᎥᏃ ᎢᏥᏍᏆᏂᎪᏍᎦ.
\ft Jesus answered and said unto them, I have done one work, and ye all marvel.

\ln Mosi ahusdesdi gesv itsinelvgi; vtlasgininonv Mosi unanugowisvhi yigi, anigayvligesgini uninanugowisvhi; nihino unadodaquasgvno ietsiusdeseho asgaya.
\syll ᎼᏏ ᎠᎱᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏥᏁᎸᎩ; ᎥᏝᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎼᏏ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏫᏒᎯ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᏂᎦᏴᎵᎨᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏂᎾᏄᎪᏫᏒᎯ; ᏂᎯᏃ ᎤᎾᏙᏓᏆᏍᎬᏃ ᎢᎡᏥᎤᏍᏕᏎᎰ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ.
\ft Moses therefore gave unto you circumcision; (not because it is of Moses, but of the fathers;) and ye on the sabbath day circumcise a man.

\ln Iyuno asgaya unadodaquasgv iga yatsiusdeseha, yinvdigalisdodiha dikahnawadvsdi Mosi utseli uyoisdi nigesvna gesvi, tsigo isgisgaga nvdigalisdodiha asgaya nigv ayelv tsitsinvwanv unadodaquasgv iga?
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᎾᏙᏓᏆᏍᎬ ᎢᎦ ᏯᏥᎤᏍᏕᏎᎭ, ᏱᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎼᏏ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎤᏲᎢᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏥᎪ ᎢᏍᎩᏍᎦᎦ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᏂᎬ ᎠᏰᎸ ᏥᏥᏅᏩᏅ ᎤᎾᏙᏓᏆᏍᎬ ᎢᎦ?
\ft If a man on the sabbath day receive circumcision, that the law of Moses should not be broken; are ye angry at me, because I have made a man every whit whole on the sabbath day?

\ln Tlesdi detsakanisgvquo yiditsugodisgesdi, duyugodvsgini detsugodisgesdi.
\syll ᏞᏍᏗ ᏕᏣᎧᏂᏍᎬᏉ ᏱᏗᏧᎪᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᏚᏳᎪᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᏕᏧᎪᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
\ft Judge not according to the appearance, but judge righteous judgment.

\ln Hnaquono igadv Tsilusilimi anehi hia nuniwesvgi, Tlasgo nasgi na hia yigi tsunaduli unihisdiyi?
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎢᎦᏛ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᎠᏁᎯ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ, ᏝᏍᎪ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎯᎠ ᏱᎩ ᏧᎾᏚᎵ ᎤᏂᎯᏍᏗᏱ?
\ft Then said some of them of Jerusalem, Is not this he, whom they seek to kill?

\ln Gvniyuquono nasgaihvna gawoniha, ale vtla gohusdi yanoseha.  Tsisa unigvwiyuhi udohiyuhi anigataha nasgi udohiyuhiya Galonedv gesvi?
\syll ᎬᏂᏳᏉᏃ ᎾᏍᎦᎢᎲᎾ ᎦᏬᏂᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏯᏃᏎᎭ.  ᏥᏌ ᎤᏂᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ?
\ft But, lo, he speaketh boldly, and they say nothing unto him. Do the rulers know indeed that this is the very Christ?

\ln Aseno idigataha hia asgaya tsudalenvi, Galonedvsgini galutsvha vtla gilo yigvgatahesdi tsudalenvi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎢᏗᎦᏔᎭ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᎢ, ᎦᎶᏁᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᎦᎷᏨᎭ ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᏱᎬᎦᏔᎮᏍᏗ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᎢ.
\ft Howbeit we know this man whence he is: but when Christ cometh, no man knoweth whence he is.

\ln Hnaquono Tsisa uwelunvgi udvnvdigalawiisdiyi dadeyohvsgvi, hia nuwesvgi; Sgigataha, ale nasquo itsigataha diquadalenvi; ale vtla aquvsvquo aquadanvtedv yagilutsv, nvdvginvsidvsgini duyugodvi, nasgi netsigatahvna tsigi.
