\ln Asiquono aniyilisv gvwadvdvhvsgv udatsinohistanvgi hia niduweselvgi; Gilo udasuyesdi usganvtsvhi nigesvna nasgi igvyi widadalenvda nvya wigvnisda.
\syll ᎠᏏᏉᏃ ᎠᏂᏱᎵᏒ ᎬᏩᏛᏛᎲᏍᎬ ᎤᏓᏥᏃᎯᏍᏔᏅᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎩᎶ ᎤᏓᏑᏰᏍᏗ ᎤᏍᎦᏅᏨᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎬᏱ ᏫᏓᏓᎴᏅᏓ ᏅᏯ ᏫᎬᏂᏍᏓ.
\ft So when they continued asking him, he lifted up himself, and said unto them, He that is without sin among you, let him first cast a stone at her.

\ln Talineno udisadadv, gadohi uwowelanvgi.
\syll ᏔᎵᏁᏃ ᎤᏗᏌᏓᏛ, ᎦᏙᎯ ᎤᏬᏪᎳᏅᎩ.
\ft And again he stooped down, and wrote on the ground.

\ln Nasgino unadvganv, ale tsunadanvdo gvwanuhistanv, uninugotsvgi saquo udvnidv udanilige dudalenvtanvgi, oniyi wigvwadvnvgi; Tsisano uwasv nulistanvgi, ageyvno ayeli gadogvgi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᎾᏓᏅᏙ ᎬᏩᏄᎯᏍᏔᏅ, ᎤᏂᏄᎪᏨᎩ ᏌᏉ ᎤᏛᏂᏛ ᎤᏓᏂᎵᎨ ᏚᏓᎴᏅᏔᏅᎩ, ᎣᏂᏱ ᏫᎬᏩᏛᏅᎩ; ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎩ, ᎠᎨᏴᏃ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎦᏙᎬᎩ.
\ft And they which heard it, being convicted by their own conscience, went out one by one, beginning at the eldest, even unto the last: and Jesus was left alone, and the woman standing in the midst.

\ln Tsisano udatsinohistanv, ale ageyvquo uwasv ugohv, hia nuweselvgi; Higeyv, hatlv na getsuhisdisgi?  Tlasgo gilo tsasganvtsvi yidegugoda?
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᏓᏥᏃᎯᏍᏔᏅ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎨᏴᏉ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎤᎪᎲ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎯᎨᏴ, ᎭᏢ Ꮎ ᎨᏧᎯᏍᏗᏍᎩ?  ᏝᏍᎪ ᎩᎶ ᏣᏍᎦᏅᏨᎢ ᏱᏕᎫᎪᏓ?
\ft When Jesus had lifted up himself, and saw none but the woman, he said unto her, Woman, where are those thine accusers? hath no man condemned thee?

\ln Hia nuwesvgi; Vtla gilo, Tsagvwiyuhi.  Tsisano hia nuweselvgi; Vtla nasquo ayv tsasganvtsv yidigugodiha.  Tsihena, ale tlesdi ilvhiyu hnaquo yitsasganvtsesdi.
\syll ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ.  ᏥᏌᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎥᏝ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏴ ᏣᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᏱᏗᎫᎪᏗᎭ.  ᏥᎮᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᎿᏉ ᏱᏣᏍᎦᏅᏤᏍᏗ.
\ft She said, No man, Lord. And Jesus said unto her, Neither do I condemn thee: go, and sin no more.

\ln Alewo Tsiso duwonetanvgi, hia niduweselvgi; Ayv elohi iga tsiyatisdanehi; gilo agisdawadegesdi vtla ulisigv yigayedohesdi; advnidisdodisgini iga utseliga gesesdi.
\syll ᎠᎴᏬ ᏥᏐ ᏚᏬᏁᏔᏅᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎠᏴ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎢᎦ ᏥᏯᏘᏍᏓᏁᎯ; ᎩᎶ ᎠᎩᏍᏓᏩᏕᎨᏍᏗ ᎥᏝ ᎤᎵᏏᎬ ᏱᎦᏰᏙᎮᏍᏗ; ᎠᏛᏂᏗᏍᏙᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᎦ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft Then spake Jesus again unto them, saying, I am the light of the world: he that followeth me shall not walk in darkness, but shall have the light of life.

\ln Hnaquono Aniqualisi hia nvgvwaweselvgi; Tsvsvquo hadanoheha, hinohesgv vtla yudohiyuha.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏ ᎯᎠ ᏅᎬᏩᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏨᏒᏉ ᎭᏓᏃᎮᎭ, ᎯᏃᎮᏍᎬ ᎥᏝ ᏳᏙᎯᏳᎭ.
\ft The Pharisees therefore said unto him, Thou bearest record of thyself; thy record is not true.

\ln Tsisa unetsvgi, hia niduweselvgi; Aquvsvquo nasquo yigadanoheha, ase tsinohesgv udohiyuha; tsigatahayeno diquadalenvi ale witsigadvi.  Nihisgini vtla yitsigataha diquadalenvi ale witsigadvi.
\syll ᏥᏌ ᎤᏁᏨᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎠᏋᏒᏉ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏱᎦᏓᏃᎮᎭ, ᎠᏎ ᏥᏃᎮᏍᎬ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎭ; ᏥᎦᏔᎭᏰᏃ ᏗᏆᏓᎴᏅᎢ ᎠᎴ ᏫᏥᎦᏛᎢ.  ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᏗᏆᏓᎴᏅᎢ ᎠᎴ ᏫᏥᎦᏛᎢ.
\ft Jesus answered and said unto them, Though I bear record of myself, yet my record is true: for I know whence I came, and whither I go; but ye cannot tell whence I come, and whither I go.

\ln Nihi detsugodisgo uquedaliquo tsuwogododi gesvi; ayv vtla gilo yiditsiyugodanehoi.
\syll ᏂᎯ ᏕᏧᎪᏗᏍᎪ ᎤᏇᏓᎵᏉ ᏧᏬᎪᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎠᏴ ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᏱᏗᏥᏳᎪᏓᏁᎰᎢ.
\ft Ye judge after the flesh; I judge no man.

\ln Aseno nasquo yidigugodiha, daquegotanv suyugodv yigi.  Vtlayeno aquvsvquo yigi, Agayvligeyeno nvdvginvsidv oginaligoha.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏱᏗᎫᎪᏗᎭ, ᏓᏇᎪᏔᏅ ᏑᏳᎪᏛ ᏱᎩ.  ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᎠᏋᏒᏉ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᏰᏃ ᏅᏛᎩᏅᏏᏛ ᎣᎩᎾᎵᎪᎭ.
\ft And yet if I judge, my judgment is true: for I am not alone, but I and the Father that sent me.

\ln Ale nasquo gowela ditsikahnawadvsdiyi nasgi anitali uninohelvhi gesv udohiyuhiya gesvi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎪᏪᎳ ᏗᏥᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᎤᏂᏃᎮᎸᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft It is also written in your law, that the testimony of two men is true.

\ln Ayv aquvsv gadanohesgi, Agayvligeno nvdvginvsidv nasquo ayv aginoheha.
\syll ᎠᏴ ᎠᏋᏒ ᎦᏓᏃᎮᏍᎩ, ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᏃ ᏅᏛᎩᏅᏏᏛ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏴ ᎠᎩᏃᎮᎭ.
\ft I am one that bear witness of myself, and the Father that sent me beareth witness of me.

\ln Hnaquo hia nvgvwaweselvgi, Hatlv Tsadoda?  Tsisa hia niduweselvgi; Vtla ayv yisgigataha, ale vtla yetsigataha Edoda.  Iyuno ayv yisgigatahei, nasquo yetsigatahe Edoda.
\syll ᎿᏉ ᎯᎠ ᏅᎬᏩᏪᏎᎸᎩ, ᎭᏢ ᏣᏙᏓ?  ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎥᏝ ᎠᏴ ᏱᏍᎩᎦᏔᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᏰᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᎡᏙᏓ.  ᎢᏳᏃ ᎠᏴ ᏱᏍᎩᎦᏔᎮᎢ, ᎾᏍᏉ ᏰᏥᎦᏔᎮ ᎡᏙᏓ.
\ft Then said they unto him, Where is thy Father? Jesus answered, Ye neither know me, nor my Father: if ye had known me, ye should have known my Father also.

\ln Nasgi hia nuwesvgi Tsisa adelv disquanigodiyi, nahiyu dadeyohvsgv udvudigalawiisdiyi; ale vtla gilo yuniyvhei, vtlayeno asi yusqualvehei.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ ᏥᏌ ᎠᏕᎸ ᏗᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗᏱ, ᏀᎢᏳ ᏓᏕᏲᎲᏍᎬ ᎤᏛᎤᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ; ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᏳᏂᏴᎮᎢ, ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᎠᏏ ᏳᏍᏆᎸᎡᎮᎢ.
\ft These words spake Jesus in the treasury, as he taught in the temple: and no man laid hands on him; for his hour was not yet come.

\ln Hnaquono Tsisa taline hia niduweselvgi; Dagadanvsi, nihino sgiyohesdi, ale ase asgani gesv dodatsiyohusi, ale witsigadv vtla wiyvgetsilugi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏥᏌ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏓᎦᏓᏅᏏ, ᏂᎯᏃ ᏍᎩᏲᎮᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏎ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᎨᏒ ᏙᏓᏥᏲᎱᏏ, ᎠᎴ ᏫᏥᎦᏛ ᎥᏝ ᏫᏴᎨᏥᎷᎩ.
\ft Then said Jesus again unto them, I go my way, and ye shall seek me, and shall die in your sins: whither I go, ye cannot come.

\ln Hnaquono Anitsusi hia nuniwesvgi, Tsigo uwasv dvdali?  Hia tsinigaweha; Witsigadv vtla wiyvgetsilugi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ, ᏥᎪ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏛᏓᎵ?  ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᎦᏪᎭ; ᏫᏥᎦᏛ ᎥᏝ ᏫᏴᎨᏥᎷᎩ.
\ft Then said the Jews, Will he kill himself? because he saith, Whither I go, ye cannot come.

\ln Hiano niduweselvgi; Nihi eladi itsadalenvhi; ayv galvladi nvdvquadalenvhi.  Nihi ani elohi itsadalenvhi; ayv vtla ani elohi aquadalenvhi yigi.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏂᎯ ᎡᎳᏗ ᎢᏣᏓᎴᏅᎯ; ᎠᏴ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏅᏛᏆᏓᎴᏅᎯ.  ᏂᎯ ᎠᏂ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎢᏣᏓᎴᏅᎯ; ᎠᏴ ᎥᏝ ᎠᏂ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎠᏆᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᏱᎩ.
\ft And he said unto them, Ye are from beneath; I am from above: ye are of this world; I am not of this world.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi hia nitsvwesi; ase getsisganiquo gesv dodatsiyohusi; iyuyeno nitsohiyuhvsgvna igesesdi ayv nasgi gesvi, ase getsisgani gesv dodatsiyohusi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏏ; ᎠᏎ ᎨᏥᏍᎦᏂᏉ ᎨᏒ ᏙᏓᏥᏲᎱᏏ; ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᏂᏦᎯᏳᎲᏍᎬᎾ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᏎ ᎨᏥᏍᎦᏂ ᎨᏒ ᏙᏓᏥᏲᎱᏏ.
\ft I said therefore unto you, that ye shall die in your sins: for if ye believe not that I am he, ye shall die in your sins.

\ln Hnaquono hia nvgvwaweselvgi; Gagonihi?  Tsisano hia niduweselvgi; Nasgiquo tsitsvyosehoi, udohiyuhiya nasgiquo.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏅᎬᏩᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎦᎪᏂᎯ?  ᏥᏌᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎾᏍᎩᏉ ᏥᏨᏲᏎᎰᎢ, ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎾᏍᎩᏉ.
\ft Then said they unto him, Who art thou? And Jesus saith unto them, Even the same that I said unto you from the beginning.

\ln Utsati gohusdi agiha itsvyosedi, ale ditsvyugodanedi; aseno nvdvginvsidv duyugodvi; ayvno elohi tsinoheheha nasgi nusdv tsiyadvganelvi.
\syll ᎤᏣᏘ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎠᎩᎭ ᎢᏨᏲᏎᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏨᏳᎪᏓᏁᏗ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᏅᏛᎩᏅᏏᏛ ᏚᏳᎪᏛᎢ; ᎠᏴᏃ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏥᏃᎮᎮᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏥᏯᏛᎦᏁᎸᎢ.
\ft I have many things to say and to judge of you: but he that sent me is true; and I speak to the world those things which I have heard of him.

\ln Vtla yunolitse Agayvlige gadvgv nasgi degawonedisgvi.
\syll ᎥᏝ ᏳᏃᎵᏤ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᎦᏛᎬ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏕᎦᏬᏁᏗᏍᎬᎢ.
\ft They understood not that he spake to them of the Father.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi Tsisa hia niduweselvgi; Yvwi Uwetsi etsisaladanvha, hnaquo datsadolehosi ayv nasgi gesvi, ale aquvsvquo aquadanvtedv gohusdi nidagilvwisdanehvna gesvi, Edodaquosgini aqueyonv nasgi tsinohesgvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎡᏥᏌᎳᏓᏅᎭ, ᎿᏉ ᏓᏣᏙᎴᎰᏏ ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏋᏒᏉ ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏖᏛ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏂᏓᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎡᏙᏓᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏇᏲᏅ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏃᎮᏍᎬᎢ.
\ft Then said Jesus unto them, When ye have lifted up the Son of man, then shall ye know that I am he, and that I do nothing of myself; but as my Father hath taught me, I speak these things.

\ln Nvdvginvsidv oginaligoha; Agayvlige vtla yaquvdetsv, nigohilvyeno dagilvwisdaneho osdv uyelvdi.
\syll ᏅᏛᎩᏅᏏᏛ ᎣᎩᎾᎵᎪᎭ; ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᎥᏝ ᏯᏋᏕᏨ, ᏂᎪᎯᎸᏰᏃ ᏓᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎰ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎤᏰᎸᏗ.
\ft And he that sent me is with me: the Father hath not left me alone; for I do always those things that please him.

\ln Asiquo nasgi hia nigawesgvgi, unitsadv gvwohiyunvgi.
\syll ᎠᏏᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎬᎩ, ᎤᏂᏣᏛ ᎬᏬᎯᏳᏅᎩ.
\ft As he spake these words, many believed on him.

\ln Hnaquo Tsisa hia niduweselvgi Anitsusi gvwohiyuhvsgi; Iyuno detsikahnawadisesdi aginetsvi, udohiyuhiya sgisdawadidohi gesesdi.
\syll ᎿᏉ ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎬᏬᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᏕᏥᎧᎿᏩᏗᏎᏍᏗ ᎠᎩᏁᏨᎢ, ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᏍᎩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft Then said Jesus to those Jews which believed on him, If ye continue in my word, then are ye my disciples indeed;

\ln Ale datsigadovsi duyugodvi, duyugodvno nidetsinatlavna nvdatsvneli.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏓᏥᎦᏙᎥᏏ ᏚᏳᎪᏛᎢ, ᏚᏳᎪᏛᏃ ᏂᏕᏥᎾᏝᎥᎾ ᏅᏓᏨᏁᎵ.
\ft And ye shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you free.

\ln Gvwanetselv hia nigvwaweselvgi; Ayv Equahami unetlvtanvdv, ale vtla ilvhiyu gilo yidoginatlvnoi, gadono nidetsinatlavna nvdayetsvneli, tsadiha?
\syll ᎬᏩᏁᏤᎸ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏩᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎠᏴ ᎡᏆᎭᎻ ᎤᏁᏢᏔᏅᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᎩᎶ ᏱᏙᎩᎾᏢᏃᎢ, ᎦᏙᏃ ᏂᏕᏥᎾᏝᎥᎾ ᏅᏓᏰᏨᏁᎵ, ᏣᏗᎭ?
\ft They answered him, We be Abraham's seed, and were never in bondage to any man: how sayest thou, Ye shall be made free?

\ln Tsisa dunetselv hia niduweselvgi; Udohiyuhiya udohiyuhiya hia nitsvweseha; Gilo tsasganvgoi asgani unatlai gesoi.
\syll ᏥᏌ ᏚᏁᏤᎸ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ; ᎩᎶ ᏣᏍᎦᏅᎪᎢ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᎤᎾᏝᎢ ᎨᏐᎢ.
\ft Jesus answered them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Whosoever committeth sin is the servant of sin.

\ln Atsinatlaino vtla adanelv nigohilv ehi yigesoi; Aganvgisgini nigohilv ehoi.
\syll ᎠᏥᎾᏝᎢᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎠᏓᏁᎸ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎡᎯ ᏱᎨᏐᎢ; ᎠᎦᏅᎩᏍᎩᏂ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎡᎰᎢ.
\ft And the servant abideth not in the house for ever: but the Son abideth ever.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi iyuno Aganvgi nidetsinatlavna yinitsvnelv udohiyusv nidetsinatlavna yigi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏳᏃ ᎠᎦᏅᎩ ᏂᏕᏥᎾᏝᎥᎾ ᏱᏂᏨᏁᎸ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᏒ ᏂᏕᏥᎾᏝᎥᎾ ᏱᎩ.
\ft If the Son therefore shall make you free, ye shall be free indeed.

\ln Tsigataha nihi Equahami unetlvtanvdv gesvi; aseno itsaduli sgiisdiyi, nvdigalisdodiha tsinegv detsadanvdv winayvhihvna gesvi.
\syll ᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᏂᎯ ᎡᏆᎭᎻ ᎤᏁᏢᏔᏅᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎢᏣᏚᎵ ᏍᎩᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᏥᏁᎬ ᏕᏣᏓᏅᏛ ᏫᎾᏴᎯᎲᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft I know that ye are Abraham's seed; but ye seek to kill me, because my word hath no place in you.

\ln Nusdv agigohv Edodoyi nasgi tsinegoi; nihino nusdv itsigohv itsidodoyi nasgi nitsadvnehoi.
\syll ᏄᏍᏛ ᎠᎩᎪᎲ ᎡᏙᏙᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏁᎪᎢ; ᏂᎯᏃ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎢᏥᎪᎲ ᎢᏥᏙᏙᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎰᎢ.
\ft I speak that which I have seen with my Father: and ye do that which ye have seen with your father.

\ln Uninetsv hia nvgvwaweselvgi; Equahami ogidoda.  Tsisa hia niduweselvgi; Iyuno nihi Equahami tsuwetsi yigi, Equahami tsulvwisdanedi gesv yiditsilvwisdaneha.
\syll ᎤᏂᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏅᎬᏩᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎡᏆᎭᎻ ᎣᎩᏙᏓ.  ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᏂᎯ ᎡᏆᎭᎻ ᏧᏪᏥ ᏱᎩ, ᎡᏆᎭᎻ ᏧᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏱᏗᏥᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎭ.
\ft They answered and said unto him, Abraham is our father. Jesus saith unto them, If ye were Abraham's children, ye would do the works of Abraham.

\ln Aseno itsaduli sgiisdiyi ayv duyugodv itsvnonelvhi, nasgi Unelanvhi tsiyadvganelvhi gesvi; vtla nasgi yinadvnehe Equahami.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎢᏣᏚᎵ ᏍᎩᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᏴ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎢᏨᏃᏁᎸᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏥᏯᏛᎦᏁᎸᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎥᏝ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᎾᏛᏁᎮ ᎡᏆᎭᎻ.
\ft But now ye seek to kill me, a man that hath told you the truth, which I have heard of God: this did not Abraham.

\ln Itsidoda tsulvwisdanedi gesv detsilvwisdanehoi.  Hnaquono hia nvgvwaweselvgi; vtla udelidv dinisinvhi oginanugotsvhi yigi; saquo eha Ogidodanasgi Unelanvhi.
\syll ᎢᏥᏙᏓ ᏧᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏕᏥᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎰᎢ.  ᎿᏉᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏅᎬᏩᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎥᏝ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᏗᏂᏏᏅᎯ ᎣᎩᎾᏄᎪᏨᎯ ᏱᎩ; ᏌᏉ ᎡᎭ ᎣᎩᏙᏓᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ.
\ft Ye do the deeds of your father. Then said they to him, We be not born of fornication; we have one Father, even God.

\ln Tsisa hia niduweselvgi; Iyuno Unelanvhi Itsidoda yigi, sgigeyuiyu yigi; Unelanvhiyiyeno diquadalenv agilutsilv; ale vtla aquvsvquo aquadanvtedvyagilutsilv, diginvsvsgini.
\syll ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᏥᏙᏓ ᏱᎩ, ᏍᎩᎨᏳᎢᏳ ᏱᎩ; ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏱᏰᏃ ᏗᏆᏓᎴᏅ ᎠᎩᎷᏥᎸ; ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᎠᏋᏒᏉ ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏖᏛᏯᎩᎷᏥᎸ, ᏗᎩᏅᏒᏍᎩᏂ.
\ft Jesus said unto them, If God were your Father, ye would love me: for I proceeded forth and came from God; neither came I of myself, but he sent me.

\ln Gadono tla yitsoliga tsiwonisgvi?  Nvdigalisdodisgini tsinegv yeli getsadvgodi nigesvna gesvi.
\syll ᎦᏙᏃ Ꮭ ᏱᏦᎵᎦ ᏥᏬᏂᏍᎬᎢ?  ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᏥᏁᎬ ᏰᎵ ᎨᏣᏛᎪᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Why do ye not understand my speech? even because ye cannot hear my word.

\ln Itsidoda asgina nvdatsadalenvhi nihi, ale itsidoda uyo dulvwisdanehv itsadvnediyi itsaduliha.  Nasgi yvwi dihihi nigeso didalenisgvi, ale udohiyuhi gesv vtla yidukahnawadvsei, vtlayeno udohiyuhi gesv yuweha.  Gayegogi kanegi utseligaquo kanegoi; gayegogiyeno nasgi, ale ugayvlige gayegogi gesvi.
\syll ᎢᏥᏙᏓ ᎠᏍᎩᎾ ᏅᏓᏣᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᏂᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏥᏙᏓ ᎤᏲ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᎢᏣᏛᏁᏗᏱ ᎢᏣᏚᎵᎭ.  ᎾᏍᎩ ᏴᏫ ᏗᎯᎯ ᏂᎨᏐ ᏗᏓᎴᏂᏍᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏚᎧᎿᏩᏛᏎᎢ, ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏳᏪᎭ.  ᎦᏰᎪᎩ ᎧᏁᎩ ᎤᏤᎵᎦᏉ ᎧᏁᎪᎢ; ᎦᏰᎪᎩᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᎦᏰᎪᎩ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Ye are of your father the devil, and the lusts of your father ye will do. He was a murderer from the beginning, and abode not in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaketh a lie, he speaketh of his own: for he is a liar, and the father of it.

\ln Aseno duyugodv tsinegv nvdigalisdodiha vtla yisgiyoiyuhvsga.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᏥᏁᎬ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏍᎩᏲᎢᏳᎲᏍᎦ.
\ft And because I tell you the truth, ye believe me not.

\ln Gago udasuya hia tsinitsadvnv gvnigesv igvwanedi agisganvtsvhi gesvi?  Iyuno duyugodv yitsinega, gadono tla yisgiyoiyuhvsga?
\syll ᎦᎪ ᎤᏓᏑᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᏣᏛᏅ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᎬᏩᏁᏗ ᎠᎩᏍᎦᏅᏨᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ?  ᎢᏳᏃ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᏱᏥᏁᎦ, ᎦᏙᏃ Ꮭ ᏱᏍᎩᏲᎢᏳᎲᏍᎦ?
\ft Which of you convinceth me of sin? And if I say the truth, why do ye not believe me?

\ln Nasgi Unelanvhi nvdayudalenvhi gesv nasgi advgisgo Unelanvhi kanegvi; nihi nitsadvgisgvna tsigi nvdigalisdodi Unelanvhi nvdatsadalenvhi nigesvna gesvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏛᎩᏍᎪ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎧᏁᎬᎢ; ᏂᎯ ᏂᏣᏛᎩᏍᎬᎾ ᏥᎩ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏅᏓᏣᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft He that is of God heareth God's words: ye therefore hear them not, because ye are not of God.

\ln Hnaquono Anitsusi Uninetsvgi, hia nuniweselvgi; Tlasgo duyugodv yotsinega, Sameliyi hehi ale asgina tsayai, tsitsvyoseha?
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎤᏂᏁᏨᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏝᏍᎪ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᏲᏥᏁᎦ, ᏌᎺᎵᏱ ᎮᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏍᎩᎾ ᏣᏯᎢ, ᏥᏨᏲᏎᎭ?
\ft Then answered the Jews, and said unto him, Say we not well that thou art a Samaritan, and hast a devil?

\ln Tsisa hia niduweselvgi; Vtla asgina yagiyaa, tsilvquodiquosgini Edoda; nihino ayv gesgisotlvisdiha.
\syll ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎥᏝ ᎠᏍᎩᎾ ᏯᎩᏯᎠ, ᏥᎸᏉᏗᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎡᏙᏓ; ᏂᎯᏃ ᎠᏴ ᎨᏍᎩᏐᏢᎢᏍᏗᎭ.
\ft Jesus answered, I have not a devil; but I honour my Father, and ye do dishonour me.

\ln Aseno vtla yagiyoha aquvsv vgilvquodiyi; eha uyohi ale digugodisgi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏯᎩᏲᎭ ᎠᏋᏒ ᎥᎩᎸᏉᏗᏱ; ᎡᎭ ᎤᏲᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎫᎪᏗᏍᎩ.
\ft And I seek not mine own glory: there is one that seeketh and judgeth.

\ln Udohiyuhiya udohiyuhiya hia nitsvweseha, Iyuno gilo asquanigodisgesdi tsinegvi, nasgi vtla ilvhiyu ayohuhisdi gesv ugowadvdi yigesesdi.
\syll ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎠᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏥᏁᎬᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎥᏝ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎪᏩᏛᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft Verily, verily, I say unto you, If a man keep my saying, he shall never see death.

\ln Hnaquono anitsusi hia nvgvwaweselvgi; Hnaquo otsadolehohi asgina tsayavi.  Equahami uyohusv, ale anadolehosgi, nihino hia nihiweha; Iyuno gilo asquanigodisgesdi tsinegvi, nasgi vtla ilvhiyu ayohuhisdi gesv udolehosdi yigesesdi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎯᎠ ᏅᎬᏩᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎿᏉ ᎣᏣᏙᎴᎰᎯ ᎠᏍᎩᎾ ᏣᏯᎥᎢ.  ᎡᏆᎭᎻ ᎤᏲᎱᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ, ᏂᎯᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎯᏪᎭ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎠᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏥᏁᎬᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎥᏝ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏙᎴᎰᏍᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft Then said the Jews unto him, Now we know that thou hast a devil. Abraham is dead, and the prophets; and thou sayest, If a man keep my saying, he shall never taste of death.

\ln Tsigo nihi utli etsalvquodiyu esgaquo Equahami ogidoda, tsuyohusv?  Ale nasquo anadolehosgi duniyohusv.  Gago nihi hatselvsga?
\syll ᏥᎪ ᏂᎯ ᎤᏟ ᎡᏣᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎡᏆᎭᎻ ᎣᎩᏙᏓ, ᏧᏲᎱᏒ?  ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᏚᏂᏲᎱᏒ.  ᎦᎪ ᏂᎯ ᎭᏤᎸᏍᎦ?
\ft Art thou greater than our father Abraham, which is dead? and the prophets are dead: whom makest thou thyself?

\ln Tsisa hia niduweselvgi; Iyuno aquvsv yigadalvquodiha, vgilvquodiyu asequoquo yigi; Edodasgini agilvquodisgi, nasgi ayv Oganelanvhi tsitsadiha.
\syll ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᎠᏋᏒ ᏱᎦᏓᎸᏉᏗᎭ, ᎥᎩᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏎᏉᏉ ᏱᎩ; ᎡᏙᏓᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᎩᎸᏉᏗᏍᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᎣᎦᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏥᏣᏗᎭ.
\ft Jesus answered, If I honour myself, my honour is nothing: it is my Father that honoureth me; of whom ye say, that he is your God:

\ln Aseno vtla yetsigataha, ayvsgini tsigataha; iyuno vtla yitsigataha yidudiha tsiyegogiquo yigi, nihi tsinitsasdi nasgiyai; aseno tsigataha, ale unetsv agisquanigodi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏰᏥᎦᏔᎭ, ᎠᏴᏍᎩᏂ ᏥᎦᏔᎭ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᏱᏚᏗᎭ ᏥᏰᎪᎩᏉ ᏱᎩ, ᏂᎯ ᏥᏂᏣᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᏥᎦᏔᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎠᎩᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ.
\ft Yet ye have not known him; but I know him: and if I should say, I know him not, I shall be a liar like unto you: but I know him, and keep his saying.

\ln Itsidoda Equahami alihelisdi udugi uwasv ugowadvdiyi gohi gesv ayv gevi, ale ugohvgi ale osiyu udanvdadvgi.
\syll ᎢᏥᏙᏓ ᎡᏆᎭᎻ ᎠᎵᎮᎵᏍᏗ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎤᎪᏩᏛᏗᏱ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏴ ᎨᎥᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎪᎲᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎤᏓᏅᏓᏛᎩ.
\ft Your father Abraham rejoiced to see my day: and he saw it, and was glad.

\ln Hnaquono Anitsusi hia nvgvweselvgi; vtla asi hisgisgohi itsadetiyvdv yigi; Tsisano higovhi igi Equahami?
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎯᎠ ᏅᎬᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎥᏝ ᎠᏏ ᎯᏍᎩᏍᎪᎯ ᎢᏣᏕᏘᏴᏛ ᏱᎩ; ᏥᏌᏃ ᎯᎪᎥᎯ ᎢᎩ ᎡᏆᎭᎻ?
\ft Then said the Jews unto him, Thou art not yet fifty years old, and hast thou seen Abraham?

\ln Tsisa hia niduweselvgi; Udohiyuhiya udohiyuhiya hia nitsvweseha; Asiquo Equahami nehvna tsigesvgi, Ayv nigeoi.
\syll ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ; ᎠᏏᏉ ᎡᏆᎭᎻ ᏁᎲᎾ ᏥᎨᏒᎩ, ᎠᏴ ᏂᎨᎣᎢ.
\ft Jesus said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Before Abraham was, I am.

\ln Hnaquono nvya dunigisvgi, digvwanisdodi, aseno Tsisa udisgalanvgi, ale udvnvdigalawiisdiyi unugotsvgi, ayeli anidonav ugadvlesvstanvgi, ale ulosonvgi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏅᏯ ᏚᏂᎩᏒᎩ, ᏗᎬᏩᏂᏍᏙᏗ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎤᏗᏍᎦᎳᏅᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏛᏅᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏄᎪᏨᎩ, ᎠᏰᎵ ᎠᏂᏙᎾᎥ ᎤᎦᏛᎴᏒᏍᏔᏅᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎶᏐᏅᎩ.
\ft Then took they up stones to cast at him: but Jesus hid himself, and went out of the temple, going through the midst of them, and so passed by.

\ln [Tsisano] ulosv ugohvgi asgaya, nasgi digewi nigese udenv.
\syll ᏥᏌᏃdata is invalid ᎤᎶᏒ ᎤᎪᎲᎩ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎨᏫ ᏂᎨᏎ ᎤᏕᏅ.
\ft And as Jesus passed by, he saw a man which was blind from his birth.

\ln Gvwasdawadidohino gvwadvdvnvgi, hia nuniwesvgi; Tadeyohvsgi, gago usganvtsei, hiasgo, tsugayvligeige, digewi tsudenei?
\syll ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯᏃ ᎬᏩᏛᏛᏅᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᏔᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ, ᎦᎪ ᎤᏍᎦᏅᏤᎢ, ᎯᎠᏍᎪ, ᏧᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢᎨ, ᏗᎨᏫ ᏧᏕᏁᎢ?
\ft And his disciples asked him, saying, Master, who did sin, this man, or his parents, that he was born blind?

\ln Tsisa hia niduweselvgi; Vtla hia yusganvtsv, vtla ale tsugayvligei; Unelanvhiquosgini tsulvwisdanedi gesv gvnigesv iyulisdodiyi nasgi agvdisgvi.
\syll ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎥᏝ ᎯᎠ ᏳᏍᎦᏅᏨ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᏧᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ; ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᏧᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎬᏗᏍᎬᎢ.
\ft Jesus answered, Neither hath this man sinned, nor his parents: but that the works of God should be made manifest in him.

\ln Ase digilvwisdanedi nvdvginvsidv tsulvwisdanedi gesv asiquo iga tsigi; svnoyi dayai, nahiyu yeli gilo digvwalvwisdanedi nigesvna.
\syll ᎠᏎ ᏗᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᏅᏛᎩᏅᏏᏛ ᏧᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏏᏉ ᎢᎦ ᏥᎩ; ᏒᏃᏱ ᏓᏯᎢ, ᏀᎢᏳ ᏰᎵ ᎩᎶ ᏗᎬᏩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.
\ft I must work the works of him that sent me, while it is day: the night cometh, when no man can work.

\ln Nigohilv elohi gedohvi, ayv elohi iga gatsiyatisdanehi.
\syll ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎨᏙᎲᎢ, ᎠᏴ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎢᎦ ᎦᏥᏯᏘᏍᏓᏁᎯ.
\ft As long as I am in the world, I am the light of the world.

\ln Nasgi nuwesv gadohi ulitsisquvgi, ale nasgi tlawota uwotlvtanvgi ulitsisquvhi, ale nasgi tlawota dunvliyedanelvgi digewi digadoli,
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏪᏒ ᎦᏙᎯ ᎤᎵᏥᏍᏋᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏝᏬᏔ ᎤᏬᏢᏔᏅᎩ ᎤᎵᏥᏍᏋᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏝᏬᏔ ᏚᏅᎵᏰᏓᏁᎸᎩ ᏗᎨᏫ ᏗᎦᏙᎵ,
\ft When he had thus spoken, he spat on the ground, and made clay of the spittle, and he anointed the eyes of the blind man with the clay,

\ln Ale hia nuweselvgi; Hena wadosuli Salomi tsvdalvi,^nasgi anetlvtanvhi Atsinvsidv gadvga.  Uwenvsvgino ale wudosulevgi, ulutsvno agowatisgvgi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎮᎾ ᏩᏙᏑᎵ ᏌᎶᎻ ᏨᏓᎸᎢ,data is invalidᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏁᏢᏔᏅᎯ ᎠᏥᏅᏏᏛ ᎦᏛᎦ.  ᎤᏪᏅᏒᎩᏃ ᎠᎴ ᏭᏙᏑᎴᎥᎩ, ᎤᎷᏨᏃ ᎠᎪᏩᏘᏍᎬᎩ.
\ft And said unto him, Go, wash in the pool of Siloam, (which is by interpretation, Sent.) He went his way therefore, and washed, and came seeing.

\ln Hnaquono na nav dininela, ale unigohidolvhi digewi gesvi, hia nuniwesvgi; Tlasgo hia nasgi yigi na tsuwolv ale tsaduladisgvgi?
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ Ꮎ ᎾᎥ ᏗᏂᏁᎳ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᎪᎯᏙᎸᎯ ᏗᎨᏫ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᏝᏍᎪ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᎩ Ꮎ ᏧᏬᎸ ᎠᎴ ᏣᏚᎳᏗᏍᎬᎩ?
\ft The neighbours therefore, and they which before had seen him that he was blind, said, Is not this he that sat and begged?

\ln Igadv, nasgi, unadvnvgi; igadvno, danatselv unadvnvgi.  Uwasvsgini, Ayv nasgi, udvnvgi.
\syll ᎢᎦᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ, ᎤᎾᏛᏅᎩ; ᎢᎦᏛᏃ, ᏓᎾᏤᎸ ᎤᎾᏛᏅᎩ.  ᎤᏩᏒᏍᎩᏂ, ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᎩ, ᎤᏛᏅᎩ.
\ft Some said, This is he: others said, He is like him: but he said, I am he.

\ln Hnaquono hia nvgvwaweselvgi, Gado ulisdotane tigadoli dulisduisei?
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏅᎬᏩᏪᏎᎸᎩ, ᎦᏙ ᎤᎵᏍᏙᏔᏁ ᏘᎦᏙᎵ ᏚᎵᏍᏚᎢᏎᎢ?
\ft Therefore said they unto him, How were thine eyes opened?

\ln Unetsv hia nuwesvgi; Asgaya Tsisa tsidudov tlawota uwotlvnvgi, ale dunvliyev ditsigadoli; hiano nagiweselvgi; Salomi tsvdalvi hena ale wadosuli; aquenvno ale waquadosulei yeli gvgigowadvdi nulistanvgi.
\syll ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᏥᏌ ᏥᏚᏙᎥ ᏝᏬᏔ ᎤᏬᏢᏅᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏅᎵᏰᎥ ᏗᏥᎦᏙᎵ; ᎯᎠᏃ ᎾᎩᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏌᎶᎻ ᏨᏓᎸᎢ ᎮᎾ ᎠᎴ ᏩᏙᏑᎵ; ᎠᏇᏅᏃ ᎠᎴ ᏩᏆᏙᏑᎴᎢ ᏰᎵ ᎬᎩᎪᏩᏛᏗ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎩ.
\ft He answered and said, A man that is called Jesus made clay, and anointed mine eyes, and said unto me, Go to the pool of Siloam, and wash: and I went and washed, and I received sight.

\ln Hnaquono hia nvgvwaweselvgi; Hatlv edoha?  Vtla yitsigataha, nvdvnvgi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏅᎬᏩᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎭᏢ ᎡᏙᎭ?  ᎥᏝ ᏱᏥᎦᏔᎭ, ᏅᏛᏅᎩ.
\ft Then said they unto him, Where is he? He said, I know not.

\ln Aniqualisi dunatinohelv nasgi digewi iyulistanvhi.
\syll ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏ ᏚᎾᏘᏃᎮᎸ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎨᏫ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏔᏅᎯ.
\ft They brought to the Pharisees him that aforetime was blind.

\ln Unadodaquasgvno iga gesvgi Tsisa tlawota uwotlvnv ale digadoli dusduisv.
\syll ᎤᎾᏙᏓᏆᏍᎬᏃ ᎢᎦ ᎨᏒᎩ ᏥᏌ ᏝᏬᏔ ᎤᏬᏢᏅ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎦᏙᎵ ᏚᏍᏚᎢᏒ.
\ft And it was the sabbath day when Jesus made the clay, and opened his eyes.

\ln Ale hnaquo Aniqualisi nasquo vgvwadvdvnvgi nulisdotanv gvwagowadvdi nulistanvi.  Hiano niduweselvgi; Ditsigadoli tlawota dunvliyevgi, aquadosulevgino ale itsigowatiha.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎿᏉ ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎥᎬᏩᏛᏛᏅᎩ ᏄᎵᏍᏙᏔᏅ ᎬᏩᎪᏩᏛᏗ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎢ.  ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏗᏥᎦᏙᎵ ᏝᏬᏔ ᏚᏅᎵᏰᎥᎩ, ᎠᏆᏙᏑᎴᎥᎩᏃ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏥᎪᏩᏘᎭ.
\ft Then again the Pharisees also asked him how he had received his sight. He said unto them, He put clay upon mine eyes, and I washed, and do see.

\ln Hnaquono igadv Aniqualisi hia nuniwesvgi; Nasgi hia asgaya vtla Unelanvhi nvdayudalenvhi yigi, tlayeno yasquanigodiha unadodaquasgvi.  Igadvno hia nuniwesvgi; Gado yigalisdoda yvwi asganai nasgi iyusdi usquanigodi yidulvwisdasi?  Talino nunadadvgi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎢᎦᏛ ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᏱᎩ, ᏝᏰᏃ ᏯᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗᎭ ᎤᎾᏙᏓᏆᏍᎬᎢ.  ᎢᎦᏛᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᎦᏙ ᏱᎦᎵᏍᏙᏓ ᏴᏫ ᎠᏍᎦᎾᎢ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᏱᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏏ?  ᏔᎵᏃ ᏄᎾᏓᏛᎩ.
\ft Therefore said some of the Pharisees, This man is not of God, because he keepeth not the sabbath day. Others said, How can a man that is a sinner do such miracles? And there was a division among them.

\ln Talineno hia nuniweselvgi digewi; Gado nihi hadiha nasgi hinohesgvi tsidetsasduielv tigadoli?  Adolehosgi, udvnvgi.
\syll ᏔᎵᏁᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎸᎩ ᏗᎨᏫ; ᎦᏙ ᏂᎯ ᎭᏗᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᏃᎮᏍᎬᎢ ᏥᏕᏣᏍᏚᎢᎡᎸ ᏘᎦᏙᎵ?  ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ, ᎤᏛᏅᎩ.
\ft They say unto the blind man again, What sayest thou of him, that he hath opened thine eyes? He said, He is a prophet.

\ln Aseno Anitsusi vtla yanohiyuhvsge digewi iyulistanvhi gesv ale gvwagowadvdi nulistanvi, gvni widuniyanvhv tsugayvlige nasgi na gvwagowadvdi iyulisdanelvhi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎥᏝ ᏯᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎨ ᏗᎨᏫ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᎪᏩᏛᏗ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎢ, ᎬᏂ ᏫᏚᏂᏯᏅᎲ ᏧᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎬᏩᎪᏩᏛᏗ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏓᏁᎸᎯ.
\ft But the Jews did not believe concerning him, that he had been blind, and received his sight, until they called the parents of him that had received his sight.

\ln Dunadvdvnvgino, nasgi hia nuniwesvgi; Hiasgo nihi isdetsi, nasgi digewi udenvgi tsisdadiha?  Gadono ulisdotanv gohi tsagowatiha?
\syll ᏚᎾᏛᏛᏅᎩᏃ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᎯᎠᏍᎪ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏍᏕᏥ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎨᏫ ᎤᏕᏅᎩ ᏥᏍᏓᏗᎭ?  ᎦᏙᏃ ᎤᎵᏍᏙᏔᏅ ᎪᎯ ᏣᎪᏩᏘᎭ?
\ft And they asked them, saying, Is this your son, who ye say was born blind? how then doth he now see?

\ln Tsugayvlige duninetselv hia niduniweselvgi; Osdigataha hia oginetsi gesvi, ale digewi udenvi;
\syll ᏧᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᏚᏂᏁᏤᎸ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏂᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎣᏍᏗᎦᏔᎭ ᎯᎠ ᎣᎩᏁᏥ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎨᏫ ᎤᏕᏅᎢ;
\ft His parents answered them and said, We know that this is our son, and that he was born blind:

\ln Aseno nvtsulisdotanvi gohi tsagowatiha vtla yosdigataha; ale ayv vtla yosdigataha nasgi na tsusduielvhi gesv digadoli.  Hnaquo adinona udvna, etsadvdvhvga, uwasv dakanoheli.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᏅᏧᎵᏍᏙᏔᏅᎢ ᎪᎯ ᏣᎪᏩᏘᎭ ᎥᏝ ᏲᏍᏗᎦᏔᎭ; ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴ ᎥᏝ ᏲᏍᏗᎦᏔᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏧᏍᏚᎢᎡᎸᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏗᎦᏙᎵ.  ᎿᏉ ᎠᏗᏃᎾ ᎤᏛᎾ, ᎡᏣᏛᏛᎲᎦ, ᎤᏩᏒ ᏓᎧᏃᎮᎵ.
\ft But by what means he now seeth, we know not; or who hath opened his eyes, we know not: he is of age; ask him: he shall speak for himself.

\ln Nasgi nuniwesvgi tsugayvligei, nvdagalisdodisgvgi danisgaihv Anitsusi; gayulayeno anitsusi tsunugotanvhi gesvgi, nasgi iyu gilo yunetsv nasgi galonedv gesv atsinugowisdiyi digalawiisdiyi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ ᏧᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ, ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᏓᏂᏍᎦᎢᎲ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ; ᎦᏳᎳᏰᏃ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᏧᏄᎪᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳ ᎩᎶ ᏳᏁᏨ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏥᏄᎪᏫᏍᏗᏱ ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ.
\ft These words spake his parents, because they feared the Jews: for the Jews had agreed already, that if any man did confess that he was Christ, he should be put out of the synagogue.

\ln Nasgi nvdayulisdotanvgi tsugayvlige hia nuniwesv; Hnaquo udvna, uwasv etsadvdvhvga.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏓᏳᎵᏍᏙᏔᏅᎩ ᏧᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒ; ᎿᏉ ᎤᏛᎾ, ᎤᏩᏒ ᎡᏣᏛᏛᎲᎦ.
\ft Therefore said his parents, He is of age; ask him.

\ln Hnaquono taline wuniyanvhvgi asgaya digewi iyulistanvhi; hiano nuniweselvgi; Hilvquoda Unelanvhi, ayv otsigataha nasgi hia asgaya asgana gesvi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏔᎵᏁ ᏭᏂᏯᏅᎲᎩ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᏗᎨᏫ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏔᏅᎯ; ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎯᎸᏉᏓ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎠᏴ ᎣᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎠᏍᎦᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Then again called they the man that was blind, and said unto him, Give God the praise: we know that this man is a sinner.

\ln Hnaquono unetsvgi hia nuwesvgi; Iyuno asgana yigi vtla yitsigataha; sudalegi tsigataha; ditsigewi tsigesvgi hnaquo itsigowatiha.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎤᏁᏨᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᎠᏍᎦᎾ ᏱᎩ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏥᎦᏔᎭ; ᏑᏓᎴᎩ ᏥᎦᏔᎭ; ᏗᏥᎨᏫ ᏥᎨᏒᎩ ᎿᏉ ᎢᏥᎪᏩᏘᎭ.
\ft He answered and said, Whether he be a sinner or no, I know not: one thing I know, that, whereas I was blind, now I see.

\ln Hnaquono taline hia nuniweselvgi; Gado tsvnele detsasduiele tigadoli?
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎦᏙ ᏨᏁᎴ ᏕᏣᏍᏚᎢᎡᎴ ᏘᎦᏙᎵ?
\ft Then said they to him again, What did he to thee? how opened he thine eyes?

\ln Unetsv hia niduweselvgi; gayula itsvnonelv, aseno vtla yitsadvdastanei; gadono itsaduli taline itsadvgodiyi?  Nasquosgo nihi itsaduliha etsisdawadidohi itsalisdodiyi.
\syll ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎦᏳᎳ ᎢᏨᏃᏁᎸ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏣᏛᏓᏍᏔᏁᎢ; ᎦᏙᏃ ᎢᏣᏚᎵ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎢᏣᏛᎪᏗᏱ?  ᎾᏍᏉᏍᎪ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏣᏚᎵᎭ ᎡᏥᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
\ft He answered them, I have told you already, and ye did not hear: wherefore would ye hear it again? will ye also be his disciples?

\ln Hnaquono gagvwanisotlvtanvgi, ale hia nuniwesvgi; Nihi nasgi hisdawadidohi, ayvsgini Mosi otsisdawadidohi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎦᎬᏩᏂᏐᏢᏔᏅᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᏂᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ, ᎠᏴᏍᎩᏂ ᎼᏏ ᎣᏥᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ.
\ft Then they reviled him, and said, Thou art his disciple; but we are Moses' disciples.

\ln Otsigataha Unelanvhi Mosi uwonetanvi; nasgini hia vtla yotsigatahatsudalenvi.
\syll ᎣᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎼᏏ ᎤᏬᏁᏔᏅᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩᏂ ᎯᎠ ᎥᏝ ᏲᏥᎦᏔᎭᏧᏓᎴᏅᎢ.
\ft We know that God spake unto Moses: as for this fellow, we know not from whence he is.

\ln Nasgi asgaya unetsv hia niduweselvgi; Ho usquanigodiyu nasgi, nitsigatahvna tsigi tsudalenvi, ano tsidagisduielv ditsigadoli.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; Ꮀ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗᏳ ᎾᏍᎩ, ᏂᏥᎦᏔᎲᎾ ᏥᎩ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᎢ, ᎠᏃ ᏥᏓᎩᏍᏚᎢᎡᎸ ᏗᏥᎦᏙᎵ.
\ft The man answered and said unto them, Why herein is a marvellous thing, that ye know not from whence he is, and yet he hath opened mine eyes.

\ln Idigatahayeno Unelanvhi nidadvganehvna gesv anisganai, iyusgini gilo Unelanvhi adadolisdanehi yigi, ale nasgi adanvtesgv iyadvnehi yigi, nasgi advganehoi.
\syll ᎢᏗᎦᏔᎭᏰᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏂᏓᏛᎦᏁᎲᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᎾᎢ, ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᎯ ᏱᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏛᎦᏁᎰᎢ.
\ft Now we know that God heareth not sinners: but if any man be a worshipper of God, and doeth his will, him he heareth.

\ln Elohi tsudotlvnv nvdagvwadalenvdv vtla yigegadvgano gilo dusduielv digadoli digewi udenvhi.
\syll ᎡᎶᎯ ᏧᏙᏢᏅ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎥᏝ ᏱᎨᎦᏛᎦᏃ ᎩᎶ ᏚᏍᏚᎢᎡᎸ ᏗᎦᏙᎵ ᏗᎨᏫ ᎤᏕᏅᎯ.
\ft Since the world began was it not heard that any man opened the eyes of one that was born blind.

\ln Iyuno hia nasgi asgaya Unelanvhi nvdayudalenvhi nigesvna yigi, vtla yeli gohusdi yidogvwalvwisdasi.
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏱᎩ, ᎥᏝ ᏰᎵ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏱᏙᎬᏩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏏ.
\ft If this man were not of God, he could do nothing.

\ln Uninetsv hia nvgvwaweselvgi; nvhvi asgani gesv tsadenvgi, Tsigono ayv isgiyeyohvsga?  Vgvwanugowisvgino.
\syll ᎤᏂᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏅᎬᏩᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏅᎲᎢ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᎨᏒ ᏣᏕᏅᎩ, ᏥᎪᏃ ᎠᏴ ᎢᏍᎩᏰᏲᎲᏍᎦ?  ᎥᎬᏩᏄᎪᏫᏒᎩᏃ.
\ft They answered and said unto him, Thou wast altogether born in sins, and dost thou teach us? And they cast him out.

\ln Tsisa udvganvgi gvwanugowisvi; uwadvhvno hia nuweselvgi; Hiyoiyuhvsgasgo Unelanvhi Uwetsi?
\syll ᏥᏌ ᎤᏛᎦᏅᎩ ᎬᏩᏄᎪᏫᏒᎢ; ᎤᏩᏛᎲᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎯᏲᎢᏳᎲᏍᎦᏍᎪ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏪᏥ?
\ft Jesus heard that they had cast him out; and when he had found him, he said unto him, Dost thou believe on the Son of God?

\ln Nasgi unetsv hia nuwesvgi; Gago nasgi, Tsagvwiyuhi, nasgi tsiyoiyudiyi?
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎦᎪ ᎾᏍᎩ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏲᎢᏳᏗᏱ?
\ft He answered and said, Who is he, Lord, that I might believe on him?

\ln Tsisa hia nuweselvgi; Higovhi, ale nasgi na tsitsalinohediha.
\syll ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎯᎪᎥᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏥᏣᎵᏃᎮᏗᎭ.
\ft And Jesus said unto him, Thou hast both seen him, and it is he that talketh with thee.

\ln Hiano nuwesvgi; Goiyuhvsga, Tsagvwiyuhi; udadolisdanelvgino.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎪᎢᏳᎲᏍᎦ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ; ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎸᎩᏃ.
\ft And he said, Lord, I believe. And he worshipped him.

\ln Tsisano hia nuwesvgi; Diwogododiyi agiyelvha elohi agilutsilv, nasgi na nanigowatisgvna unigowadvdiyi, ale nasgi na anigowatisgi dinigewi iyunalisdodiyi.
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᏗᏬᎪᏙᏗᏱ ᎠᎩᏰᎸᎭ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎠᎩᎷᏥᎸ, ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎾᏂᎪᏩᏘᏍᎬᎾ ᎤᏂᎪᏩᏛᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᏂᎪᏩᏘᏍᎩ ᏗᏂᎨᏫ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
\ft And Jesus said, For judgment I am come into this world, that they which see not might see; and that they which see might be made blind.

\ln Aniqualisino edohv anedohi nasgi unadvganvgi, ale hia nvgvwaweselvgi; Tsigo nasquo ayv tsotsigewi?
\syll ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏᏃ ᎡᏙᎲ ᎠᏁᏙᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏅᎬᏩᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏥᎪ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏴ ᏦᏥᎨᏫ?
\ft And some of the Pharisees which were with him heard these words, and said unto him, Are we blind also?

\ln Tsisa hia niduweselvgi; Iyuno ditsigewi yigesei vtla yigetsisganvgei, aseno otsigowatiha itsadiha; nasgi nvdigalisdodiha itsisganahiyu gesv alinohiyasga.
\syll ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᏗᏥᎨᏫ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ ᎥᏝ ᏱᎨᏥᏍᎦᏅᎨᎢ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎣᏥᎪᏩᏘᎭ ᎢᏣᏗᎭ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎢᏥᏍᎦᏀᎢᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎵᏃᎯᏯᏍᎦ.
\ft Jesus said unto them, If ye were blind, ye should have no sin: but now ye say, We see; therefore your sin remaineth.

\ln Udohiyuhiya, udohiyuhiya hia nitsvweseha; Nasgi na galohisdiyi ayvsdisgi nigesvna awi uninodena uniyvsdiyi, utsatiniquosgini galvsdisgi, nasgi ganosgisgi ale adanasahvsgi.
\syll ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ, ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ; ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᏴᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎠᏫ ᎤᏂᏃᏕᎾ ᎤᏂᏴᏍᏗᏱ, ᎤᏣᏘᏂᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎦᎸᏍᏗᏍᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏃᏍᎩᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏓᎾᏌᎲᏍᎩ.
\ft Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that entereth not by the door into the sheepfold, but climbeth up some other way, the same is a thief and a robber.

\ln Nasgisgini na galohisdiyi ayvsdisgi nasgi awi uninodena digatiya.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ Ꮎ ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᏴᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏫ ᎤᏂᏃᏕᎾ ᏗᎦᏘᏯ.
\ft But he that entereth in by the door is the shepherd of the sheep.

\ln Nasgi galohisdiyi agatiya usduiehoi, ale awi anadvgisgo kanegvi, ale dunadov dayanisgo awi tsutseliga, ale datinisvsgini deganugowisgoi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏍᏚᎢᎡᎰᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏫ ᎠᎾᏛᎩᏍᎪ ᎧᏁᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᎾᏙᎥ ᏓᏯᏂᏍᎪ ᎠᏫ ᏧᏤᎵᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᏘᏂᏒᏍᎩᏂ ᏕᎦᏄᎪᏫᏍᎪᎢ.
\ft To him the porter openeth; and the sheep hear his voice: and he calleth his own sheep by name, and leadeth them out.

\ln Deganugowano tsutseliga awi, igvyi dalenehoi, ale awi gvwasdawadegoi; anoligoyeno kanegvi;
\syll ᏕᎦᏄᎪᏩᏃ ᏧᏤᎵᎦ ᎠᏫ, ᎢᎬᏱ ᏓᎴᏁᎰᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏫ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏕᎪᎢ; ᎠᏃᎵᎪᏰᏃ ᎧᏁᎬᎢ;
\ft And when he putteth forth his own sheep, he goeth before them, and the sheep follow him: for they know his voice.

\ln Nvwadalesgini vtla yvgvnisdawaduga, analiehoquo, vtlayeno yanoligo nvwanadale aninegvi.
\syll ᏅᏩᏓᎴᏍᎩᏂ ᎥᏝ ᏴᎬᏂᏍᏓᏩᏚᎦ, ᎠᎾᎵᎡᎰᏉ, ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᏯᏃᎵᎪ ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴ ᎠᏂᏁᎬᎢ.
\ft And a stranger will they not follow, but will flee from him: for they know not the voice of strangers.

\ln Nasgi hia datlilosdv Tsisa duwonetanvgi; aseno vtla yunolitse nasgi nusdv duwonetanvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏓᏟᎶᏍᏛ ᏥᏌ ᏚᏬᏁᏔᏅᎩ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏳᏃᎵᏤ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏚᏬᏁᏔᏅᎢ.
\ft This parable spake Jesus unto them: but they understood not what things they were which he spake unto them.

\ln Hnaquono taline Tsisa hia niduweselvgi; Udohiyuhiya udohiyuhiya hia nitsvweseha, Ayv galohisdiyi awi unatseliga.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏔᎵᏁ ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ, ᎠᏴ ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᏫ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ.
\ft Then said Jesus unto them again, Verily, verily, I say unto you, I am the door of the sheep.

\ln Nigadv igvyi unilutsvhi ayv oni, nasgi aninosgisgi ale anadanasahvsgi.  Aseno awi vtla yigvwanadvganelei.
\syll ᏂᎦᏛ ᎢᎬᏱ ᎤᏂᎷᏨᎯ ᎠᏴ ᎣᏂ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏂᏃᏍᎩᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎾᏓᎾᏌᎲᏍᎩ.  ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᏫ ᎥᏝ ᏱᎬᏩᎾᏛᎦᏁᎴᎢ.
\ft All that ever came before me are thieves and robbers: but the sheep did not hear them.

\ln Galohisdiyi ayv; Iyuno gilo ayv agiyvsdisgesdi, ase  atsisdelvdi gesesdi, ale uyvsdi ale unugoisdi gesesdi, ale uwadvdi gesesdi ganulvsvi.
\syll ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᏴ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎠᏴ ᎠᎩᏴᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᏎ  ᎠᏥᏍᏕᎸᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏴᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏄᎪᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏩᏛᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎦᏄᎸᏒᎢ.
\ft I am the door: by me if any man enter in, he shall be saved, and shall go in and out, and find pasture.

\ln Ganosgisgi galugoi, unosgisdiyiquo ale udahisdiyiquo uyelvsoi:  Ayv agilutsilv, gvnidv unatseliga iyulisdodiyi, ale utsatanvhi unatseliga itsvlisdodiyi.
\syll ᎦᏃᏍᎩᏍᎩ ᎦᎷᎪᎢ, ᎤᏃᏍᎩᏍᏗᏱᏉ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᎯᏍᏗᏱᏉ ᎤᏰᎸᏐᎢ:  ᎠᏴ ᎠᎩᎷᏥᎸ, ᎬᏂᏛ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏣᏔᏅᎯ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ ᎢᏨᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
\ft The thief cometh not, but for to steal, and to kill, and to destroy: I am come that they might have life, and that they might have it more abundantly.

\ln Ayv aquadanvti awiditsigatiya.  Udanvti awidigatiya gvnvi eladi daneho awi.
\syll ᎠᏴ ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏘ ᎠᏫᏗᏥᎦᏘᏯ.  ᎤᏓᏅᏘ ᎠᏫᏗᎦᏘᏯ ᎬᏅᎢ ᎡᎳᏗ ᏓᏁᎰ ᎠᏫ.
\ft I am the good shepherd: the good shepherd giveth his life for the sheep.

\ln Atsinvsidvsgini, awidigatiya nigesvna, ale awi tsutseliga nigesvna, waya tsaisvi wagowadv, degvdego awi ale alitisgoi; wayano deganiyisgo ale dadigaleyasgo awi.
\syll ᎠᏥᏅᏏᏛᏍᎩᏂ, ᎠᏫᏗᎦᏘᏯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏫ ᏧᏤᎵᎦ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᏩᏯ ᏣᎢᏒᎢ ᏩᎪᏩᏛ, ᏕᎬᏕᎪ ᎠᏫ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎵᏘᏍᎪᎢ; ᏩᏯᏃ ᏕᎦᏂᏱᏍᎪ ᎠᎴ ᏓᏗᎦᎴᏯᏍᎪ ᎠᏫ.
\ft But he that is an hireling, and not the shepherd, whose own the sheep are not, seeth the wolf coming, and leaveth the sheep, and fleeth: and the wolf catcheth them, and scattereth the sheep.

\ln Atsinvsidv alitisgoi nvdigalisdodisgo atsinvsidvquo gesvi.
\syll ᎠᏥᏅᏏᏛ ᎠᎵᏘᏍᎪᎢ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎪ ᎠᏥᏅᏏᏛᏉ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft The hireling fleeth, because he is an hireling, and careth not for the sheep.

\ln Ayv aquadanvti awiditsigatiya; ale detsigataha diquatseliga, ale diquatseliga gvgigataha,
\syll ᎠᏴ ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏘ ᎠᏫᏗᏥᎦᏘᏯ; ᎠᎴ ᏕᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᏗᏆᏤᎵᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏆᏤᎵᎦ ᎬᎩᎦᏔᎭ,
\ft I am the good shepherd, and know my sheep, and am known of mine.

\ln Nasgiya Agayvlige tsagigataha, ale ayv Agayvlige tsitsigataha.  Ale gvnv eladi detsineha awi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᏣᎩᎦᏔᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᏥᏥᎦᏔᎭ.  ᎠᎴ ᎬᏅ ᎡᎳᏗ ᏕᏥᏁᎭ ᎠᏫ.
\ft As the Father knoweth me, even so know I the Father: and I lay down my life for the sheep.

\ln Ale nunadale awi dagikaha, nasgi vtla hia uniyvsdiyi yaniyaa; nasgi nasquo ase dodagatinoli, ale dvnadvgani tsinegvi; ale sunadatlugi nvdvnalistani; ale saquo gesesdi awidigatiya.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏄᎾᏓᎴ ᎠᏫ ᏓᎩᎧᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎥᏝ ᎯᎠ ᎤᏂᏴᏍᏗᏱ ᏯᏂᏯᎠ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏎ ᏙᏓᎦᏘᏃᎵ, ᎠᎴ ᏛᎾᏛᎦᏂ ᏥᏁᎬᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᏑᎾᏓᏡᎩ ᏅᏛᎾᎵᏍᏔᏂ; ᎠᎴ ᏌᏉ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎠᏫᏗᎦᏘᏯ.
\ft And other sheep I have, which are not of this fold: them also I must bring, and they shall hear my voice; and there shall be one fold, and one shepherd.

\ln Eladi tsitsivsga gvnvi nasgi taline agigisisodi tsigi nasgi nvdigalisdodiha Agayvlige agigeyuha.
\syll ᎡᎳᏗ ᏥᏥᎥᏍᎦ ᎬᏅᎢ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎠᎩᎩᏏᏐᏗ ᏥᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᎠᎩᎨᏳᎭ.
\ft Therefore doth my Father love me, because I lay down my life, that I might take it again.

\ln Vtla gilo yvdvgigieli, aquvsvquosgini aquadanvtedv eladi datsini.  Agiha yeliquo eladi gvgidi gesvi, ale agiha yeliquo gvgigisisodi gesvi.  Nasgi hia nusdi Edoda aginetselv.
\syll ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᏴᏛᎩᎩᎡᎵ, ᎠᏋᏒᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏖᏛ ᎡᎳᏗ ᏓᏥᏂ.  ᎠᎩᎭ ᏰᎵᏉ ᎡᎳᏗ ᎬᎩᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎩᎭ ᏰᎵᏉ ᎬᎩᎩᏏᏐᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.  ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏍᏗ ᎡᏙᏓ ᎠᎩᏁᏤᎸ.
\ft No man taketh it from me, but I lay it down of myself. I have power to lay it down, and I have power to take it again. This commandment have I received of my Father.

\ln Hnaquono taline tali nunadadvgi Anitsusi nvdagalisdodisgvgi nasgi nuwesvi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏔᎵᏁ ᏔᎵ ᏄᎾᏓᏛᎩ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏪᏒᎢ.
\ft There was a division therefore again among the Jews for these sayings.

\ln Unitsadvgino unadasuyvgi hia nuniwesvgi; Asgina uyaa, ale ulvnotiha; gadono ietsadvdasdaneha?
\syll ᎤᏂᏣᏛᎩᏃ ᎤᎾᏓᏑᏴᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᎠᏍᎩᎾ ᎤᏯᎠ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎸᏃᏘᎭ; ᎦᏙᏃ ᎢᎡᏣᏛᏓᏍᏓᏁᎭ?
\ft And many of them said, He hath a devil, and is mad; why hear ye him?

\ln Igadvno hia nuniwesvgi; Nasgi hia tsinigawe tsikanega vtla asgina uyai uneisdi yigi; tsigo asgina yeli yidasduisi digewi digadoli.
\syll ᎢᎦᏛᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᎦᏪ ᏥᎧᏁᎦ ᎥᏝ ᎠᏍᎩᎾ ᎤᏯᎢ ᎤᏁᎢᏍᏗ ᏱᎩ; ᏥᎪ ᎠᏍᎩᎾ ᏰᎵ ᏱᏓᏍᏚᎢᏏ ᏗᎨᏫ ᏗᎦᏙᎵ.
\ft Others said, These are not the words of him that hath a devil. Can a devil open the eyes of the blind?

\ln Digalawiisdiyino uninvgalvhv danalisdayvhvsgvgi Tsilusilimi, ale gola gesvgi.
\syll ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱᏃ ᎤᏂᏅᎦᎸᎲ ᏓᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎬᎩ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ, ᎠᎴ ᎪᎳ ᎨᏒᎩ.
\ft And it was at Jerusalem the feast of the dedication, and it was winter.

\ln Tsisano edohvgi udvnvdigalawiisdiyi, Solimanv utseliga ayodatlahvi.
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᎡᏙᎲᎩ ᎤᏛᏅᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᏐᎵᎹᏅ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᎠᏲᏓᏝᎲᎢ.
\ft And Jesus walked in the temple in Solomon's porch.

\ln Hnaquono Anitsusi gvwadatluwistanvgi, hia nigvwaweselvgi; Hilago nvdagohitsi sgiyeliisdisgesdi?  Iyuno nihi galonedv gesesdi, sginohvsi duyugodvi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎬᏩᏓᏡᏫᏍᏔᏅᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏩᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎯᎳᎪ ᏅᏓᎪᎯᏥ ᏍᎩᏰᎵᎢᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ?  ᎢᏳᏃ ᏂᎯ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᏍᎩᏃᎲᏏ ᏚᏳᎪᏛᎢ.
\ft Then came the Jews round about him, and said unto him, How long dost thou make us to doubt? If thou be the Christ, tell us plainly.

\ln Tsisa unetsvgi hia duniweselvgi; Itsvnonelvgi, aseno vtla yisgiyoiyunei.  Digalvwisdanedi tsidagilvwisdaneha Edoda dudosdvi, nasgi gvnigesv naquvneha.
\syll ᏥᏌ ᎤᏁᏨᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏚᏂᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎢᏨᏃᏁᎸᎩ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏍᎩᏲᎢᏳᏁᎢ.  ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᏥᏓᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎭ ᎡᏙᏓ ᏚᏙᏍᏛᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎾᏋᏁᎭ.
\ft Jesus answered them, I told you, and ye believed not: the works that I do in my Father's name, they bear witness of me.

\syll ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏦᎯᏳᎲᏍᎦ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᏂᎯ ᎠᏫ ᏗᏆᏤᎵᎦ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏥᏂᏨᏪᏎᎸᎩ.

\ln Awi diquatseliga anadvgisgo tsinegvi, ale ayv gatsigataha, ale gvnisdawadegoi,

\ft My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me:

\ln Ale alisquadisgi nigesvna gvnidv gatsinehoi, vtlano ilvhiyu tsuniyohuhisdi yigi, ale vtla gilo diquasugalvdodi yigi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎠᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎦᏥᏁᎰᎢ, ᎥᏝᏃ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᏧᏂᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᏗᏆᏑᎦᎸᏙᏗ ᏱᎩ.

\syll ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎡᏙᏓ ᏗᎩᎧᏁᎸᎯ ᎤᏟ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎾᏂᎥᎢ, ᎥᏝᏃ ᏰᎵ ᎩᎶ ᎡᏙᏓ ᏗᎬᏩᏑᎦᎸᏙᏗ ᏱᎩ.
\ft My Father, which gave them me, is greater than all; and no man is able to pluck them out of my Father's hand.

\ft I and my Father are one.

\ln Hnaquono Anitsusi taline nvya dunigisvgi digvwanisdodi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᏔᎵᏁ ᏅᏯ ᏚᏂᎩᏒᎩ ᏗᎬᏩᏂᏍᏙᏗ.

\ft Jesus answered them, Many good works have I shewed you from my Father; for which of those works do ye stone me?

\syll ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎤᏂᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏅᎬᏩᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎣᏍᏛ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎥᏝ ᏴᎨᏣᏍᏛᏓ ᏅᏯ ᏱᏙᎨᏨᏴᏂᏍᏓ, ᎯᏐᏢᎢᏍᏗᏍᎬᏍᎩᏂ, ᏂᎯ ᏴᏫᏉ ᏥᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏣᏤᎸᏍᎦ.
\ft The Jews answered him, saying, For a good work we stone thee not; but for blasphemy; and because that thou, being a man, makest thyself God.

\syll ᏥᏌ ᏚᏁᏤᎸᎩ; ᏝᏍᎪ ᎯᎠ ᏱᏂ ᎬᏅ ᏱᎪᏪᎳ ᏗᏥᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗᏱ; ᏂᎯ ᎢᏨᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎠᏆᏛᏅᎩ?
\ft Jesus answered them, Is it not written in your law, I said, Ye are gods?

\ln Iyuno itsanelanvhi tsuwoselvhi yigi, kanohedv Unelanvhi utseliga getsinetselvhi, ale goweli uyoisdi nigesvna yigi,
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᎢᏣᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᏬᏎᎸᎯ ᏱᎩ, ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᎨᏥᏁᏤᎸᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎪᏪᎵ ᎤᏲᎢᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏱᎩ,

\ft Say ye of him, whom the Father hath sanctified, and sent into the world, Thou blasphemest; because I said, I am the Son of God?

\ln Iyuno Edoda utseli digalvwisdanedi gesv nidagilvwisdanehvna igesesdi, tlesdi sgiyoiyunvgi
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᎡᏙᏓ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏂᏓᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎾ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᏍᎩᏲᎢᏳᏅᎩ
\ft If I do not the works of my Father, believe me not.

\ln Iyusgini nasgi utseli yidagilvwisdaneha, nasquo ayv nisgiyoiyuhvsgvna yigi, ase itsohiyuhvsgesdi nasgi na digalvwisdanedi gesvi; nasgino yeli getsadolehohisdi ale getsohiyudi yigi Agayvligei, agiyavi ale nasgi ayv tsiyavi
\syll ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏱᏓᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎭ, ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏴ ᏂᏍᎩᏲᎢᏳᎲᏍᎬᎾ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᏎ ᎢᏦᎯᏳᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏰᎵ ᎨᏣᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎨᏦᎯᏳᏗ ᏱᎩ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ, ᎠᎩᏯᎥᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᏥᏯᎥᎢ
\ft But if I do, though ye believe not me, believe the works: that ye may know, and believe, that the Father is in me, and I in him.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi taline unanelotanvgi gvwaniyvdiyi; aseno dudiwiselvgi,

\ft Therefore they sought again to take him: but he escaped out of their hand,

\ln Ale Tsodani sgona wulosvgi, nahna Tsani igvyiyi dudawovi.  Nahnano uwedolvgi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏦᏓᏂ ᏍᎪᎾ ᏭᎶᏒᎩ, ᏀᎾ ᏣᏂ ᎢᎬᏱᏱ ᏚᏓᏬᎥᎢ.  ᏀᎾᏃ ᎤᏪᏙᎸᎩ.
\ft And went away again beyond Jordan into the place where John at first baptized; and there he abode.

\ln Unitsadvno gvwalutselvgi, ale hia nuniwesvgi; Tsani vtla usquanigodi yidulvwisdanehei, aseno nigav Tsani nuwesv unohelv hia nasgi asgaya, udohiyuhiya gesei.
\syll ᎤᏂᏣᏛᏃ ᎬᏩᎷᏤᎸᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᏣᏂ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᏱᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎮᎢ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏣᏂ ᏄᏪᏒ ᎤᏃᎮᎸ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ, ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎨᏎᎢ.
\ft And many resorted unto him, and said, John did no miracle: but all things that John spake of this man were true.

\ln Nahnano unitsadv gvwohiyunvgi
\syll ᏀᎾᏃ ᎤᏂᏣᏛ ᎬᏬᎯᏳᏅᎩ
\ft And many believed on him there.

\ln Gilono iyusdi asgaya utlvgvgi, Lasila tsudoidv, Quediniyi ehi, Meli ale ulvi Madi uniduhvi.
\syll ᎩᎶᏃ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᏢᎬᎩ, ᎳᏏᎳ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ, ᏇᏗᏂᏱ ᎡᎯ, ᎺᎵ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎸᎢ ᎹᏗ ᎤᏂᏚᎲᎢ.
\ft Now a certain man was sick, named Lazarus, of Bethany, the town of Mary and her sister Martha.

\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎺᎵ ᎠᏠᏁᏗ ᏧᎶᏁᏔᏁ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏍᏘᏰᎬ ᏧᏩᏔᏁ ᏥᏚᏅᎦᎸᎡᎴ ᏧᎳᏏᏕᏂ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏙ ᎳᏏᎳ ᎤᏢᎬᎩ.
\ft (It was that Mary which anointed the Lord with ointment, and wiped his feet with her hair, whose brother Lazarus was sick.)

\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏧᏙ ᏓᏳᎾᏓᏅᏒᎩ ᎤᏛᎪᏗ, ᎯᎠ ᏅᏓᏳᏂᏪᏒᎩ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎯᎨᏳᎢ ᏥᎩ ᎤᏢᎦ.
\ft Therefore his sisters sent unto him, saying, Lord, behold, he whom thou lovest is sick.

\ln Tsisano udvganv hia nuwesvgi; Hia nasgi tsutlvgavtla uyohuhisdi yigi, atsilvquododiyiquosgini Unelanvhi, nasgino Unelanvhi Uwetsi atsilvquodiyu iyulisdodiyi.
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᏛᎦᏅ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏢᎦᎥᏝ ᎤᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏙᏗᏱᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
\ft When Jesus heard that, he said, This sickness is not unto death, but for the glory of God, that the Son of God might be glorified thereby.

\ln Tsisano tsugeyuhiyugesvgi Madi ale ulvi ale Lasila.
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᏧᎨᏳᎯᏳᎨᏒᎩ ᎹᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎸᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎳᏏᎳ.
\ft Now Jesus loved Martha, and her sister, and Lazarus.

\syll ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎯᎠ ᏅᎬᏩᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏔᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ, ᎥᏝ ᏱᎪᎯᎩ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎤᎾᏁᎶᏔᏅᎩ ᏅᏯ ᏗᎨᏨᏂᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᏔᎵᏁᏍᎪᏃ ᏀᎾ ᏮᏛᎯᎶᏏ?
\ft His disciples say unto him, Master, the Jews of late sought to stone thee; and goest thou thither again?

\ln Tsisa unetsvgi; Tlasgo taladu iyutlilodv yigi siga?  Iyuno gilo iga tsedohoi, vtla yiduwodehihoi, nvdigalisdodisgo agowatisgv iga ani elohi dulvsadvi.
\syll ᏥᏌ ᎤᏁᏨᎩ; ᏝᏍᎪ ᏔᎳᏚ ᎢᏳᏟᎶᏛ ᏱᎩ ᏏᎦ?  ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎢᎦ ᏤᏙᎰᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᏱᏚᏬᏕᎯᎰᎢ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎪ ᎠᎪᏩᏘᏍᎬ ᎢᎦ ᎠᏂ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏚᎸᏌᏛᎢ.
\ft Jesus answered, Are there not twelve hours in the day? If any man walk in the day, he stumbleth not, because he seeth the light of this world.

\ln Gilosgini enoyi tsedohoi, duwodehihoi, nvdigalisdodisgo iga nidulvsadadehvna gesvi.
\syll ᎩᎶᏍᎩᏂ ᎡᏃᏱ ᏤᏙᎰᎢ, ᏚᏬᏕᎯᎰᎢ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎪ ᎢᎦ ᏂᏚᎸᏌᏓᏕᎲᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft But if a man walk in the night, he stumbleth, because there is no light in him.

\ln Nasgi hia nuwesvgi; hnaquono hia nuduweselvgi; Lasila igalii galiha; aseno dagesi, wvdatsiyestani.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎿᏉᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎳᏏᎳ ᎢᎦᎵᎢ ᎦᎵᎭ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᏓᎨᏏ, ᏮᏓᏥᏰᏍᏔᏂ.
\ft These things said he: and after that he saith unto them, Our friend Lazarus sleepeth; but I go, that I may awake him out of sleep.

\ln Gvwasdawadidohino hia nuniwesvgi; Tsagvwiyuhi, iyuno yigaliha dayudiwasiquo.
\syll ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᏱᎦᎵᎭ ᏓᏳᏗᏩᏏᏉ.
\ft Then said his disciples, Lord, if he sleep, he shall do well.

\ln Aseno uyohusv gadvgvgi nasgi nuwesv Tsisa:  nasgisgini na agalihvquo tsoyawesoliho gadvga unelisvgi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏲᎱᏒ ᎦᏛᎬᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏪᏒ ᏥᏌ:  ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ Ꮎ ᎠᎦᎵᎲᏉ ᏦᏯᏪᏐᎵᎰ ᎦᏛᎦ ᎤᏁᎵᏒᎩ.
\ft Howbeit Jesus spake of his death: but they thought that he had spoken of taking of rest in sleep.

\ln Hnaquono gvnigesv Tsisa hia niduweselvgi; Lasila uyohusv;
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎳᏏᎳ ᎤᏲᎱᏒ;
\ft Then said Jesus unto them plainly, Lazarus is dead.

\ln Ale osiyu agiyelvha nahna winigedohvna tsigesvgi, nihi nvdigalisdodiha, itsohiyudiyi.  Aseno ediwadvhuga.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎠᎩᏰᎸᎭ ᏀᎾ ᏫᏂᎨᏙᎲᎾ ᏥᎨᏒᎩ, ᏂᎯ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ, ᎢᏦᎯᏳᏗᏱ.  ᎠᏎᏃ ᎡᏗᏩᏛᎱᎦ.
\ft And I am glad for your sakes that I was not there, to the intent ye may believe; nevertheless let us go unto him.

\ln Hnaquono Dami, Didima tsudoidv, hia niduweselvgi unaligohi anadasdawadidohi, Nasquo ayv idena, ayohusvha igatloyastanvha.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏓᎻ, ᏗᏗᎹ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ ᎤᎾᎵᎪᎯ ᎠᎾᏓᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ, ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏴ ᎢᏕᎾ, ᎠᏲᎱᏒᎭ ᎢᎦᏠᏯᏍᏔᏅᎭ.
\ft Then said Thomas, which is called Didymus, unto his fellowdisciples, Let us also go, that we may die with him.

\ln Hnaquono Tsisa ulutsv udolehusvgi gayula nvgi tsudodaquodv gvwaninvnvhi gesv atselisdvi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎤᎷᏨ ᎤᏙᎴᎱᏒᎩ ᎦᏳᎳ ᏅᎩ ᏧᏙᏓᏉᏛ ᎬᏩᏂᏅᏅᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏤᎵᏍᏛᎢ.
\ft Then when Jesus came, he found that he had lain in the grave four days already.

\ln Nasgi Quedinino gaduhv Tsilusilimi nav gesvgi, talihaquo iyutlilodv.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏇᏗᏂᏃ ᎦᏚᎲ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᎾᎥ ᎨᏒᎩ, ᏔᎵᎭᏉ ᎢᏳᏟᎶᏛ.
\ft Now Bethany was nigh unto Jerusalem, about fifteen furlongs off:

\ln Ale unitsadv Anitsusi gvwanilutselvgi Madi ale Meli gvwaninuwohistanilvgi unido uyohusv iyusdi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏣᏛ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎬᏩᏂᎷᏤᎸᎩ ᎹᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎺᎵ ᎬᏩᏂᏄᏬᎯᏍᏔᏂᎸᎩ ᎤᏂᏙ ᎤᏲᎱᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ.
\ft And many of the Jews came to Martha and Mary, to comfort them concerning their brother.

\ln Hnaquono Madi udvganvquo Tsisa tsaisvi widutlosvgi.  Melisgini galitsodequo gvwolvgi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎹᏗ ᎤᏛᎦᏅᏉ ᏥᏌ ᏣᎢᏒᎢ ᏫᏚᏠᏒᎩ.  ᎺᎵᏍᎩᏂ ᎦᎵᏦᏕᏉ ᎬᏬᎸᎩ.
\ft Then Martha, as soon as she heard that Jesus was coming, went and met him: but Mary sat still in the house.

\ln Hnaquono Madi ale nuweselvgi Tsisa; Tsagvwiyuhi, iyuno ani yihedohei, vtla yigvwayohuse vgido.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎹᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ ᏥᏌ; ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎠᏂ ᏱᎮᏙᎮᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᏱᎬᏩᏲᎱᏎ ᎥᎩᏙ.
\ft Then said Martha unto Jesus, Lord, if thou hadst been here, my brother had not died.

\ln Aseno tsigataha nasquo gohi gesv nigav gohusdi yitayoselv Unelanvhi, tsanediquo gesv Unelanvhi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏱᏔᏲᏎᎸ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᏣᏁᏗᏉ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ.
\ft But I know, that even now, whatsoever thou wilt ask of God, God will give it thee.

\ln Tsisa hia nuweselvgi; Etsado dodvalehisani.
\syll ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎡᏣᏙ ᏙᏛᎠᎴᎯᏌᏂ.
\ft Jesus saith unto her, Thy brother shall rise again.

\ln Madi hia nuweselvgi; Tsigataha dodilehisanisv dilehisodi gesv ulisqualvdi iga gesesdi.
\syll ᎹᏗ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᏙᏗᎴᎯᏌᏂᏒ ᏗᎴᎯᏐᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᎸᏗ ᎢᎦ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft Martha saith unto him, I know that he shall rise again in the resurrection at the last day.

\ln Tsisa hia nuweselvgi; Ayv dilehisodi gesv ale gvnidv.  Gilo aquohiyuhvsgesdi, iyu nasquo uyohusvhi yigi, gvnesdi.
\syll ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎠᏴ ᏗᎴᎯᏐᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᏛ.  ᎩᎶ ᎠᏉᎯᏳᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎢᏳ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᏱᎩ, ᎬᏁᏍᏗ.
\ft Jesus said unto her, I am the resurrection, and the life: he that believeth in me, though he were dead, yet shall he live:

\ln Gilono gvnesdi ale aquohiyuhvsgesdi, vtla ilvhiyu uyohuhisdi yigesesdi.  Hohiyuhvsgasgo nasgi hia?
\syll ᎩᎶᏃ ᎬᏁᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏉᎯᏳᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎥᏝ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᎤᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ.  ᎰᎯᏳᎲᏍᎦᏍᎪ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ?
\ft And whosoever liveth and believeth in me shall never die. Believest thou this?

\ln Hia nuweselvgi; Vv, Tsagvwiyuhi; goiyuhvsga nihi Galonedv gesvhi, Unelanvhi Uwetsi, nasgi elohi uluhisdi tsigesvgi.
\syll ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎥᎥ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ; ᎪᎢᏳᎲᏍᎦ ᏂᎯ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎨᏒᎯ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏪᏥ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎤᎷᎯᏍᏗ ᏥᎨᏒᎩ.
\ft She saith unto him, Yea, Lord: I believe that thou art the Christ, the Son of God, which should come into the world.

\ln Nasgino nuwesv udanvsvgi, ale udelidv wuyanvhvgi ulvi Meli, hia nuwesvgi; Dideyohvsgi galugi ale ditsayaniha.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏄᏪᏒ ᎤᏓᏅᏒᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᏭᏯᏅᎲᎩ ᎤᎸᎢ ᎺᎵ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᏗᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ ᎦᎷᎩ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏣᏯᏂᎭ.
\ft And when she had so said, she went her way, and called Mary her sister secretly, saying, The Master is come, and calleth for thee.

\ln Nasgi udvganv yilaquo iyvdv dulenvgi, ale wulutselvgi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏛᎦᏅ ᏱᎳᏉ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏚᎴᏅᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏭᎷᏤᎸᎩ.
\ft As soon as she heard that, she arose quickly, and came unto him.

\ln Tsisano vtla asi yigaluge gaduhvi, nahnaquosgini Madi widutlosv edohvgi.
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎠᏏ ᏱᎦᎷᎨ ᎦᏚᎲᎢ, ᏀᎾᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎹᏗ ᏫᏚᏠᏒ ᎡᏙᎲᎩ.
\ft Now Jesus was not yet come into the town, but was in that place where Martha met him.

\ln Hnaquono Anitsusi galitsode uwelv anini, ale gvwanuwohisdisgi, unigohv Meli ulisdiyu dulenv ale unugotsv gvwasdawadvsvgi, hia nuniwesvgi; Diganisahv wagati nahna wvdvsgonili.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎦᎵᏦᏕ ᎤᏪᎸ ᎠᏂᏂ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᏄᏬᎯᏍᏗᏍᎩ, ᎤᏂᎪᎲ ᎺᎵ ᎤᎵᏍᏗᏳ ᏚᎴᏅ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏄᎪᏨ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏛᏒᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᏗᎦᏂᏌᎲ ᏩᎦᏘ ᏀᎾ ᏮᏛᏍᎪᏂᎵ.
\ft The Jews then which were with her in the house, and comforted her, when they saw Mary, that she rose up hastily and went out, followed her, saying, She goeth unto the grave to weep there.

\ln Melino ulutsv Tsisa edohvi, ale ugohv, dulasgv eladi udanvnvgi, hia nuweselvgi; Tsagvwiyuhi, iyuno ani yihedohei, vtla vgido yigvwayohusei.
\syll ᎺᎵᏃ ᎤᎷᏨ ᏥᏌ ᎡᏙᎲᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎪᎲ, ᏚᎳᏍᎬ ᎡᎳᏗ ᎤᏓᏅᏅᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎠᏂ ᏱᎮᏙᎮᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎥᎩᏙ ᏱᎬᏩᏲᎱᏎᎢ.
\ft Then when Mary was come where Jesus was, and saw him, she fell down at his feet, saying unto him, Lord, if thou hadst been here, my brother had not died.

\ln Tsisano ugohv datloyihvi, ale dugohv Anitsusi nasgi unisdawadolvhi danatloyihvi, ehisdi udanvdadvgi, ale udeyadodi nulisdanelvgi.
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᎪᎲ ᏓᏠᏱᎲᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᎪᎲ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᏍᏓᏩᏙᎸᎯ ᏓᎾᏠᏱᎲᎢ, ᎡᎯᏍᏗ ᎤᏓᏅᏓᏛᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏕᏯᏙᏗ ᏄᎵᏍᏓᏁᎸᎩ.
\ft When Jesus therefore saw her weeping, and the Jews also weeping which came with her, he groaned in the spirit, and was troubled,

\ln Ale hia nuwesvgi; Hatlv etsinvnei?  Tsagvwiyuhi, ehagata, gvwoselvgi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎭᏢ ᎡᏥᏅᏁᎢ?  ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎡᎭᎦᏔ, ᎬᏬᏎᎸᎩ.
\ft And said, Where have ye laid him? They said unto him, Lord, come and see.

\ln Tsisa dutloyilvgi.
\syll ᏥᏌ ᏚᏠᏱᎸᎩ.
\ft Jesus wept.

\ln Hnaquono Anitsusi hia nuniwesvgi; Gvniyuquo nigae ugeyuhiyu gesei.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᏂᎦᎡ ᎤᎨᏳᎯᏳ ᎨᏎᎢ.
\ft Then said the Jews, Behold how he loved him!

\ln Igadvno unadasuyvgi hia nuniwesvgi; Tlasgo hia digewi digadoli tsusduielvhi, nasquo nasgi yinigvwanisane nuyohusvna yigagese hia asgaya?
\syll ᎢᎦᏛᏃ ᎤᎾᏓᏑᏴᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᏝᏍᎪ ᎯᎠ ᏗᎨᏫ ᏗᎦᏙᎵ ᏧᏍᏚᎢᎡᎸᎯ, ᎾᏍᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᏂᎬᏩᏂᏌᏁ ᏄᏲᎱᏒᎾ ᏱᎦᎨᏎ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ?
\ft And some of them said, Could not this man, which opened the eyes of the blind, have caused that even this man should not have died?

\ln Tsisano taline ehisdi udanvdadv atselisdv ulutsvgi.  Usdagalv gesvgi, ale nvya asdudvgi.
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎡᎯᏍᏗ ᎤᏓᏅᏓᏛ ᎠᏤᎵᏍᏛ ᎤᎷᏨᎩ.  ᎤᏍᏓᎦᎸ ᎨᏒᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏅᏯ ᎠᏍᏚᏛᎩ.
\ft Jesus therefore again groaning in himself cometh to the grave. It was a cave, and a stone lay upon it.

\ln Tsisa hia nuwesvgi, Nvya itsihvna.  Madi uyohusvhi udo, hia nuweselvgi; Tsagvwiyuhi, gohi ase asvga, nvgiyeno nusvha gayetsinisanvhi.
\syll ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ, ᏅᏯ ᎢᏥᎲᎾ.  ᎹᏗ ᎤᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᎤᏙ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎪᎯ ᎠᏎ ᎠᏒᎦ, ᏅᎩᏰᏃ ᏄᏒᎭ ᎦᏰᏥᏂᏌᏅᎯ.
\ft Jesus said, Take ye away the stone. Martha, the sister of him that was dead, saith unto him, Lord, by this time he stinketh: for he hath been dead four days.

\ln Tsisa hia nuweselvgi; Tlasgo hia yinigvweselei; iyuno hohiyuhvsgesdi, tsagowadvdi gesesdi galvquodiyu gesv unelanvhi utseliga.
\syll ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏝᏍᎪ ᎯᎠ ᏱᏂᎬᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᎰᎯᏳᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᏣᎪᏩᏛᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ.
\ft Jesus saith unto her, Said I not unto thee, that, if thou wouldest believe, thou shouldest see the glory of God?

\ln Hnaquono nvya unihvsgi uyohusvhi ganvi.  Tsisano dusaladanvgi digadoli, hia nuwesvgi; Edoda, gvyalielitseha tsisquadvganelv.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏅᏯ ᎤᏂᎲᏍᎩ ᎤᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᎦᏅᎢ.  ᏥᏌᏃ ᏚᏌᎳᏓᏅᎩ ᏗᎦᏙᎵ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎡᏙᏓ, ᎬᏯᎵᎡᎵᏤᎭ ᏥᏍᏆᏛᎦᏁᎸ.
\ft Then they took away the stone from the place where the dead was laid. And Jesus lifted up his eyes, and said, Father, I thank thee that thou hast heard me.

\ln Ale tsigataha nigohilvi squadvganehvi; aseno yvwi ani tsanidonaa nvdagalisdoda nasgi tsinitsiwi, unohiyudiyi nihi nvdasginvsidv gesvi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᏂᎪᎯᎸᎢ ᏍᏆᏛᎦᏁᎲᎢ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᏴᏫ ᎠᏂ ᏣᏂᏙᎾᎠ ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏓ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏂᏥᏫ, ᎤᏃᎯᏳᏗᏱ ᏂᎯ ᏅᏓᏍᎩᏅᏏᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft And I knew that thou hearest me always: but because of the people which stand by I said it, that they may believe that thou hast sent me.

\ln Nasgino nuwesv, asdaya uwelunvgi, hia nuwesvgi; Lasila, ehinugoi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏄᏪᏒ, ᎠᏍᏓᏯ ᎤᏪᎷᏅᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎳᏏᎳ, ᎡᎯᏄᎪᎢ.
\ft And when he thus had spoken, he cried with a loud voice, Lazarus, come forth.

\ln Uyohusvhino dayunugotsvgi, tsuwoyeni ale tsulasideni dudalvsdvgi digalvdalvdv dinuwo, ukadvno ayatlo udalvsdvgi.  Tsisa hia niduweselvgi; Etsalvsv ale tsetsiyohi.
\syll ᎤᏲᎱᏒᎯᏃ ᏓᏳᏄᎪᏨᎩ, ᏧᏬᏰᏂ ᎠᎴ ᏧᎳᏏᏕᏂ ᏚᏓᎸᏍᏛᎩ ᏗᎦᎸᏓᎸᏛ ᏗᏄᏬ, ᎤᎧᏛᏃ ᎠᏯᏠ ᎤᏓᎸᏍᏛᎩ.  ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎡᏣᎸᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏤᏥᏲᎯ.
\ft And he that was dead came forth, bound hand and foot with graveclothes: and his face was bound about with a napkin. Jesus saith unto them, Loose him, and let him go.

\ln Ale unitsadvgi unadasuyvgi Anitsusi Meli gvwalutselvhi, ale unigohvhi nasgi Tsisa nudvnelvi, gvwohiyunvgi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏣᏛᎩ ᎤᎾᏓᏑᏴᎩ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎺᎵ ᎬᏩᎷᏤᎸᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᎪᎲᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏌ ᏄᏛᏁᎸᎢ, ᎬᏬᎯᏳᏅᎩ.
\ft Then many of the Jews which came to Mary, and had seen the things which Jesus did, believed on him.

\ln Igadvsgini Aniqualisi dininv wunilosvgi, ale widuninonelvgi Tsisa nudvnelvgi.
\syll ᎢᎦᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏ ᏗᏂᏅ ᏭᏂᎶᏒᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏫᏚᏂᏃᏁᎸᎩ ᏥᏌ ᏄᏛᏁᎸᎩ.
\ft But some of them went their ways to the Pharisees, and told them what things Jesus had done.

\ln Hnaquono nunigvwiyusv atsilvanelohi ale Aniquolisi dunilawidvgi, ale hia nuniwesvgi; Gado idadvneha?  Hiayeno asgaya utsata usquanigodi dulvwisdaneha.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏉᎵᏏ ᏚᏂᎳᏫᏛᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᎦᏙ ᎢᏓᏛᏁᎭ?  ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᏣᏔ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎭ.
\ft Then gathered the chief priests and the Pharisees a council, and said, What do we? for this man doeth many miracles.

\ln Iyuno nasgi unelagi yedeliseha, nigadiyu dagvwohiyuni, Anilomino dvnilutsi ale dagegigieli igatseligohi ale digatseli yvwi dodagegiyanveli.

\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏓᏳᎵᏍᏙᏔᏅᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏴᏫ ᏕᎬᏩᏠᏒᎩ, ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅᎩᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸᎢ.
\ft For this cause the people also met him, for that they heard that he had done this miracle.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi Aniqualisi hia nidunadaweselvgi; Itsadolehosgasgo nitsaliyeilegvna tsigi?  Gvniyuquo elohi usdawadenv.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᎾᏓᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎢᏣᏙᎴᎰᏍᎦᏍᎪ ᏂᏣᎵᏰᎢᎴᎬᎾ ᏥᎩ?  ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎤᏍᏓᏩᏕᏅ.
\ft The Pharisees therefore said among themselves, Perceive ye how ye prevail nothing? behold, the world is gone after him.

\ln Gilono iyunasdi anigoi anelvgi unalidolistanilvhi dilisdayvdiyi.
\syll ᎩᎶᏃ ᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗ ᎠᏂᎪᎢ ᎠᏁᎸᎩ ᎤᎾᎵᏙᎵᏍᏔᏂᎸᎯ ᏗᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ.
\ft And there were certain Greeks among them that came up to worship at the feast:

\ln Ale nasgi gvwalutselvgi Quiligi, Quetsayidi gaduhv Gelili ehi, ale gvwatayoselvgi hia nuniwesvgi, ogaduliha otsigowadvdiyi Tsisa.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏩᎷᏤᎸᎩ ᏈᎵᎩ, ᏇᏣᏱᏗ ᎦᏚᎲ ᎨᎵᎵ ᎡᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᏔᏲᏎᎸᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ, ᎣᎦᏚᎵᎭ ᎣᏥᎪᏩᏛᏗᏱ ᏥᏌ.
\ft The same came therefore to Philip, which was of Bethsaida of Galilee, and desired him, saying, Sir, we would see Jesus.

\ln Quiligi ulutsvgi ale Enidi wunonelvgi; hnaquono Enidi ale Quiligi Tsisa wuninonelvgi.
\syll ᏈᎵᎩ ᎤᎷᏨᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎡᏂᏗ ᏭᏃᏁᎸᎩ; ᎿᏉᏃ ᎡᏂᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏈᎵᎩ ᏥᏌ ᏭᏂᏃᏁᎸᎩ.
\ft Philip cometh and telleth Andrew: and again Andrew and Philip tell Jesus.

\ln Tsisano dunetselvgi hia nuwesvgi; Hnaquo usqualvhv yvwi Uwetsi atsilvquododiyi.
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᏚᏁᏤᎸᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎿᏉ ᎤᏍᏆᎸᎲ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏙᏗᏱ.
\ft And Jesus answered them, saying, The hour is come, that the Son of man should be glorified.

\ln Udohiyuhiya, udohiyuhiya hia nitsvweseha; Iyuno saquo utsalesdi ugata eladi nuwotsvna ale nugosvna yigi, uwasvquo geso nigohilvi; iyusgini ugohi utsado kanequogoi.
\syll ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ, ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᏌᏉ ᎤᏣᎴᏍᏗ ᎤᎦᏔ ᎡᎳᏗ ᏄᏬᏨᎾ ᎠᎴ ᏄᎪᏒᎾ ᏱᎩ, ᎤᏩᏒᏉ ᎨᏐ ᏂᎪᎯᎸᎢ; ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᎪᎯ ᎤᏣᏙ ᎧᏁᏉᎪᎢ.
\ft Verily, verily, I say unto you, Except a corn of wheat fall into the ground and die, it abideth alone: but if it die, it bringeth forth much fruit.

\ln Gilo ugeyusesdi gvnvi uyohusedi gesesdi; gilono asgagesdi gvnvi ani elohi gesvi, nasgi usquanigododi gesesdi gvnidv winasdvna digesv gvdisgi.
\syll ᎩᎶ ᎤᎨᏳᏎᏍᏗ ᎬᏅᎢ ᎤᏲᎱᏎᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᎩᎶᏃ ᎠᏍᎦᎨᏍᏗ ᎬᏅᎢ ᎠᏂ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎬᏂᏛ ᏫᎾᏍᏛᎾ ᏗᎨᏒ ᎬᏗᏍᎩ.
\ft He that loveth his life shall lose it; and he that hateth his life in this world shall keep it unto life eternal.

\ln Iyuno gilo tsinvsidasdi nigalisdisgesdi, nasgi agisdawadegesdi; gevno nahna nasquo tsinvsidasdi ehesdi.  Iyuno gilo tsinvsidasdi nigalisdisgesdi, nasgi Edoda ulvquododi gesesdi.
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎩᏍᏓᏩᏕᎨᏍᏗ; ᎨᎥᏃ ᏀᎾ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎡᎮᏍᏗ.  ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᏙᏓ ᎤᎸᏉᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft If any man serve me, let him follow me; and where I am, there shall also my servant be: if any man serve me, him will my Father honour.

\ln Hnaquo aquadanvdo udeyataneha; gadono dagadvni?  [Hiasgo nvdatsiwesi,] Edoda, squudalagi gohi gesvi?  Aseno nasgi iyusdi tsagisqualve gohi agisqualvediyi agilutsilv.
\syll ᎿᏉ ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᏕᏯᏔᏁᎭ; ᎦᏙᏃ ᏓᎦᏛᏂ?  ᎯᎠᏍᎪ ᏅᏓᏥᏪᏏ,data is invalid ᎡᏙᏓ, ᏍᏊᏓᎳᎩ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ?  ᎠᏎᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏣᎩᏍᏆᎸᎡ ᎪᎯ ᎠᎩᏍᏆᎸᎡᏗᏱ ᎠᎩᎷᏥᎸ.
\ft Now is my soul troubled; and what shall I say? Father, save me from this hour: but for this cause came I unto this hour.

\ln Edoda, hilvquoda detsadovi.  Hnaquono galvladi dayunetsvgi, hia nvdayuwesvgi; gayula agilvquotanv, ale taline dvtsilvquotani.
\syll ᎡᏙᏓ, ᎯᎸᏉᏓ ᏕᏣᏙᎥᎢ.  ᎿᏉᏃ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏓᏳᏁᏨᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏅᏓᏳᏪᏒᎩ; ᎦᏳᎳ ᎠᎩᎸᏉᏔᏅ, ᎠᎴ ᏔᎵᏁ ᏛᏥᎸᏉᏔᏂ.
\ft Father, glorify thy name. Then came there a voice from heaven, saying, I have both glorified it, and will glorify it again.

\ln Yvwino nav anidonai unadvganv, ayvdaqualotsa, unadvnvgi.  Igadvno hia nuniwesvgi; Dikahnawadidohi dayuwoneda.
\syll ᏴᏫᏃ ᎾᎥ ᎠᏂᏙᎾᎢ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅ, ᎠᏴᏓᏆᎶᏣ, ᎤᎾᏛᏅᎩ.  ᎢᎦᏛᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏓᏳᏬᏁᏓ.
\ft The people therefore, that stood by, and heard it, said that it thundered: others said, An angel spake to him.

\syll ᏥᏌ ᎤᏁᏨ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎥᏝ ᎠᏴ ᎨᏒ ᏱᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏓ, ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏓ, ᎯᎠ ᎧᏁᎬ ᏥᎦᎾᏄᎪᏥᎦ.

\ln Hnaquo hia elohi dodayegugodaneli, hnaquo ugvwiyuhi hia elohi utseliga dayetsinugowisi.
\syll ᎿᏉ ᎯᎠ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏙᏓᏰᎫᎪᏓᏁᎵ, ᎿᏉ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎯᎠ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᏓᏰᏥᏄᎪᏫᏏ.
\ft Now is the judgment of this world: now shall the prince of this world be cast out.

\ln Aseno iyuno elohi vgisaladanvha, naniv yvwi dodagasesvhi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎢᏳᏃ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎥᎩᏌᎳᏓᏅᎭ, ᎾᏂᎥ ᏴᏫ ᏙᏓᎦᏎᏒᎯ.
\ft And I, if I be lifted up from the earth, will draw all men unto me.

\ln Nasgi hia nuwesvgi, nasgi iyulisdanediyi uyohuhisdiyi gadvgvgi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᎤᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎦᏛᎬᎩ.
\ft This he said, signifying what death he should die.

\ln Yvwi uninetsv hia nigvwaweselvgi, Ayv ogadvganv dikahnawadvsdiyi nasgi Galonedv ulisquadisdi nigesvna ehvi; Gadono yvwi Uwetsi ase dayetsisaladani ihadiha?  Gago nasgi na yvwi Uwetsi?
\syll ᏴᏫ ᎤᏂᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏩᏪᏎᎸᎩ, ᎠᏴ ᎣᎦᏛᎦᏅ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎡᎲᎢ; ᎦᏙᏃ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎠᏎ ᏓᏰᏥᏌᎳᏓᏂ ᎢᎭᏗᎭ?  ᎦᎪ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ?
\ft The people answered him, We have heard out of the law that Christ abideth for ever: and how sayest thou, The Son of man must be lifted up? who is this Son of man?

\ln Hnaquono Tsisa hia niduweselvgi; Asitlega iga dulvsadv itsedohvi; itsedohesdi nigohilv iga detsilvsadadehvi; ulisiginasi yitsutlvda; giloyeno ulisigv tsedohoi, vtla yagataho wagadvi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎠᏏᏞᎦ ᎢᎦ ᏚᎸᏌᏛ ᎢᏤᏙᎲᎢ; ᎢᏤᏙᎮᏍᏗ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎢᎦ ᏕᏥᎸᏌᏓᏕᎲᎢ; ᎤᎵᏏᎩᎾᏏ ᏱᏧᏢᏓ; ᎩᎶᏰᏃ ᎤᎵᏏᎬ ᏤᏙᎰᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᏯᎦᏔᎰ ᏩᎦᏛᎢ.

\syll ᎠᏏ ᎢᎦ ᏥᏕᏥᎸᏌᏓᏕᎭ, ᎢᏦᎯᏳᎲᎦ ᎢᎦ ᏚᎸᏌᏛᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏂᎯ ᎢᎦ ᏚᎸᏌᏛ ᏧᏪᏥ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.  ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ ᏥᏌ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᏅᏒᎩ ᏚᏗᏍᎦᎳᏁᎸᎩ.
\ft While ye have light, believe in the light, that ye may be the children of light. These things spake Jesus, and departed, and did hide himself from them.

\ln Utsadisgininonv usquanigodi tsulvwisdanelvhi gesvgi anigatahvi, aseno vtla yigvwohiyunei.
\syll ᎤᏣᏗᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᏧᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᎨᏒᎩ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎲᎢ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏱᎬᏬᎯᏳᏁᎢ.
\ft But though he had done so many miracles before them, yet they believed not on him:

\ln Nasgino udohiyunvgi unetsv Isaya adolehosgi, hia tsinuwesei; "Tsagvwiyuhi, gago uwohiyunv oginohelvi?  Ale gago atsinanugowiselv Ugvwiyuhi kanogeni?"
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᏅᎩ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎢᏌᏯ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏥᏄᏪᏎᎢ; data is invalidᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎦᎪ ᎤᏬᎯᏳᏅ ᎣᎩᏃᎮᎸᎢ?  ᎠᎴ ᎦᎪ ᎠᏥᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᎸ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎧᏃᎨᏂ?data is invalid
\ft That the saying of Esaias the prophet might be fulfilled, which he spake, Lord, who hath believed our report? and to whom hath the arm of the Lord been revealed?

\ln Nasgi iyusidi vtla yeli gvwanohiyudi yigesei; talineyeno Isaya hia nuwesei.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏏᏗ ᎥᏝ ᏰᎵ ᎬᏩᏃᎯᏳᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ; ᏔᎵᏁᏰᏃ ᎢᏌᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ.
\ft Therefore they could not believe, because that Esaias said again,

\ln "Dusdunelv dinigadoli, ale dusdayidelv tsuninawi; digvwanigowadvdodi nigesvna dinigadoli, ale gvwanolisdodi nigesvna uninawi, ale nasgi digvwanadanetliyvedi nigesvna, ale digagatsinvwodi nigesvna."
\syll data is invalidᏚᏍᏚᏁᎸ ᏗᏂᎦᏙᎵ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏍᏓᏱᏕᎸ ᏧᏂᎾᏫ; ᏗᎬᏩᏂᎪᏩᏛᏙᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏗᏂᎦᏙᎵ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᏃᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎤᏂᎾᏫ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎬᏩᎾᏓᏁᏟᏴᎡᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎦᎦᏥᏅᏬᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.data is invalid
\ft He hath blinded their eyes, and hardened their heart; that they should not see with their eyes, nor understand with their heart, and be converted, and I should heal them.

\ln Nasgi nuwese Isaya, nahiyu tsugohe galvquodiyu gesv utseliga, ale nasgi tsunohelei.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏪᏎ ᎢᏌᏯ, ᏀᎢᏳ ᏧᎪᎮ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏃᎮᎴᎢ.

\ln Unitsadvgisgininonv nasquo unigvwiyuhi gvwohiyunvgi; aseno Aniqualisi nvdagalisdodisgvgi vtla gvnigesv yinunvnelei, digalawiisdiyi yidoginugowa anelisgvgi.
\syll ᎤᏂᏣᏛᎩᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᏂᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎬᏬᎯᏳᏅᎩ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏ ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᎥᏝ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏱᏄᏅᏁᎴᎢ, ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᏱᏙᎩᏄᎪᏩ ᎠᏁᎵᏍᎬᎩ.
\ft Nevertheless among the chief rulers also many believed on him; but because of the Pharisees they did not confess him, lest they should be put out of the synagogue:

\ln Utliyeno uniyelvsvgi yvwi unadalvquododi gesv esgaquo Unelanvhi udalvquododi gesvi.
\syll ᎤᏟᏰᏃ ᎤᏂᏰᎸᏒᎩ ᏴᏫ ᎤᎾᏓᎸᏉᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏓᎸᏉᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft For they loved the praise of men more than the praise of God.

\ln Tsisano uwelunvgi hia nuwesvgi, Gilo aquohiyuhvsgi vtla ayv yaquohiyuhvsga, nvdvginvsidvsgini gohiyuhvsgoi.
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᏪᎷᏅᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ, ᎩᎶ ᎠᏉᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᎥᏝ ᎠᏴ ᏯᏉᎯᏳᎲᏍᎦ, ᏅᏛᎩᏅᏏᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᎪᎯᏳᎲᏍᎪᎢ.
\ft Jesus cried and said, He that believeth on me, believeth not on me, but on him that sent me.
