\ft And he that seeth me seeth him that sent me.

\ln Ayv igagati elohi agilutsilv, nasgi gilo aquohiyuhvsgesdi vtla hnaquo ulisigv udedi yigesesdi.
\syll ᎠᏴ ᎢᎦᎦᏘ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎠᎩᎷᏥᎸ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎩᎶ ᎠᏉᎯᏳᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎥᏝ ᎿᏉ ᎤᎵᏏᎬ ᎤᏕᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft I am come a light into the world, that whosoever believeth on me should not abide in darkness.

\ln Iyuno gilo advgisgesdi tsinegvi, nigohiyuhvsgvnano igesesdi, vtla ayv yiditsiyugodaneha; vtlayeno elohi yiditsiyugodanelilv, tsisdelvhilvsgini elohi.
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎠᏛᎩᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏥᏁᎬᎢ, ᏂᎪᎯᏳᎲᏍᎬᎾᏃ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᏴ ᏱᏗᏥᏳᎪᏓᏁᎭ; ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏱᏗᏥᏳᎪᏓᏁᎵᎸ, ᏥᏍᏕᎸᎯᎸᏍᎩᏂ ᎡᎶᎯ.
\ft And if any man hear my words, and believe not, I judge him not: for I came not to judge the world, but to save the world.

\ln Agisonvisdisgi ale didanilvgi nigesvna tsinegvi tsuwogodanehi uweha.  Kanohedv aginetsvhi nasgi tsuwogodanedi gesesdi ulisqualvdi iga gesesdi.
\syll ᎠᎩᏐᏅᎢᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏓᏂᎸᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏥᏁᎬᎢ ᏧᏬᎪᏓᏁᎯ ᎤᏪᎭ.  ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎠᎩᏁᏨᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏬᎪᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᎸᏗ ᎢᎦ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft He that rejecteth me, and receiveth not my words, hath one that judgeth him: the word that I have spoken, the same shall judge him in the last day.

\ln Vtlayeno aquvsvquo aquadanvtedv aginetsvhi yigi, Agayvligeisgini nvdvginvsidv, nasgi aginetselv iyagiwesdiyi agiwonihisdiyi.
\syll ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᎠᏋᏒᏉ ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏖᏛ ᎠᎩᏁᏨᎯ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢᏍᎩᏂ ᏅᏛᎩᏅᏏᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎩᏁᏤᎸ ᎢᏯᎩᏪᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᎩᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗᏱ.
\ft For I have not spoken of myself; but the Father which sent me, he gave me a commandment, what I should say, and what I should speak.

\ln Ale tsigataha nasgi unetsvhi winasdvna gvnidv gesvi.  Nasgi iyusdi nigav tsinegvi, nasgiya Agayvligei nagiweselvi, nasgi nitsiwea.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᏨᎯ ᏫᎾᏍᏛᎾ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ.  ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏥᏁᎬᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ ᎾᎩᏪᏎᎸᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᏥᏪᎠ.
\ft And I know that his commandment is life everlasting: whatsoever I speak therefore, even as the Father said unto me, so I speak.

\ln Asino unosvgi kanohiyegi dilisdayvdiyi, Tsisa agatahiyu gesvgi usqualvelv ani elohi udanvsdiyi, Agayvligesdvyi wulohisdiyi, tsugeyuhiyu iyulistanvhi gesvgi tsutseliga elohi anehi, gvlisquadisgi tsugeyuhiyu gesvgi.
\syll ᎠᏏᏃ ᎤᏃᏒᎩ ᎧᏃᎯᏰᎩ ᏗᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ, ᏥᏌ ᎠᎦᏔᎯᏳ ᎨᏒᎩ ᎤᏍᏆᎸᎡᎸ ᎠᏂ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎤᏓᏅᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᏍᏛᏱ ᏭᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ, ᏧᎨᏳᎯᏳ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒᎩ ᏧᏤᎵᎦ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎠᏁᎯ, ᎬᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᎩ ᏧᎨᏳᎯᏳ ᎨᏒᎩ.
\ft Now before the feast of the passover, when Jesus knew that his hour was come that he should depart out of this world unto the Father, having loved his own which were in the world, he loved them unto the end.

\ln asginano hnaquo ulanelvhi gesvgi unawiyi Tsudasi Isgaladi Sawani uwetsi nasgi ulonuhediyi, unalisdayvnonvno,
\syll ᎠᏍᎩᎾᏃ ᎿᏉ ᎤᎳᏁᎸᎯ ᎨᏒᎩ ᎤᎾᏫᏱ ᏧᏓᏏ ᎢᏍᎦᎳᏗ ᏌᏩᏂ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎶᏄᎮᏗᏱ, ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᏃᏅᏃ,
\ft And supper being ended, the devil having now put into the heart of Judas Iscariot, Simon's son, to betray him;

\ln Tsisa agatahiyu gesvgi Agayvligei nigav gohusdi deuyohiselvi; ale Unelanvhiyi nvdayudalenvhi gesvi, ale Unelanvhiyi wulohisdi gesvi,
\syll ᏥᏌ ᎠᎦᏔᎯᏳ ᎨᏒᎩ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏕᎤᏲᎯᏎᎸᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏱ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏱ ᏭᎶᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ,
\ft Jesus knowing that the Father had given all things into his hands, and that he was come from God, and went to God;

\ln Ulisdayvnvi deulenvgi ale unuwesvgi, ale unesvgi anuwodisuledi, udatlostanvgi;
\syll ᎤᎵᏍᏓᏴᏅᎢ ᏕᎤᎴᏅᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏄᏪᏒᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᏒᎩ ᎠᏄᏬᏗᏑᎴᏗ, ᎤᏓᏠᏍᏔᏅᎩ;
\ft He riseth from supper, and laid aside his garments; and took a towel, and girded himself.

\ln Hnaquono atelido ama utlistanvgi, ale ulenvhvgi duwosulelv gvwasdawadidohi tsunalasideni, ale dunvgalvelvgi anuwodisuledi nasgi udatlosdv uwatanvgi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎠᏖᎵᏙ ᎠᎹ ᎤᏟᏍᏔᏅᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎴᏅᎲᎩ ᏚᏬᏑᎴᎸ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏧᎾᎳᏏᏕᏂ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏅᎦᎸᎡᎸᎩ ᎠᏄᏬᏗᏑᎴᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏓᏠᏍᏛ ᎤᏩᏔᏅᎩ.
\ft After that he poureth water into a bason, and began to wash the disciples' feet, and to wipe them with the towel wherewith he was girded.

\ln Hnaquono Sawani Quida uwolv ulutsvgi.  Quidano hia nuweselvgi; Tsagvwiyuhi, tsigo nihi dodasquosuleli diqualasideni?
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏌᏩᏂ ᏈᏓ ᎤᏬᎸ ᎤᎷᏨᎩ.  ᏈᏓᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᏥᎪ ᏂᎯ ᏙᏓᏍᏉᏑᎴᎵ ᏗᏆᎳᏏᏕᏂ?
\ft Then cometh he to Simon Peter: and Peter saith unto him, Lord, dost thou wash my feet?

\ln Tsisa unetsv hia nuweselvgi; Hia tsinigadvneha vtla gohi gesv yigataha, onisgini tigadovsi.
\syll ᏥᏌ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᎦᏛᏁᎭ ᎥᏝ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏱᎦᏔᎭ, ᎣᏂᏍᎩᏂ ᏘᎦᏙᎥᏏ.
\ft Jesus answered and said unto him, What I do thou knowest not now; but thou shalt know hereafter.

\ln Quida hia nuweselvgi; Vtla ilvhiyuhi yidodasquosuleli diqualasideni.  Tsisa unetselvgi; Iyuno nigvyosulevna yigi vtla tsatseliga yudasuya aquatseliga gesvi.
\syll ᏈᏓ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎥᏝ ᎢᎸᎯᏳᎯ ᏱᏙᏓᏍᏉᏑᎴᎵ ᏗᏆᎳᏏᏕᏂ.  ᏥᏌ ᎤᏁᏤᎸᎩ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᏂᎬᏲᏑᎴᎥᎾ ᏱᎩ ᎥᏝ ᏣᏤᎵᎦ ᏳᏓᏑᏯ ᎠᏆᏤᎵᎦ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Peter saith unto him, Thou shalt never wash my feet. Jesus answered him, If I wash thee not, thou hast no part with me.

\ln Sawani Quida hia nuweselvgi; Tsagvwiyuhi, vtla diqualasideniquo tsuwasv, nasquosgini diquoyeni ale tsisgoli.
\syll ᏌᏩᏂ ᏈᏓ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎥᏝ ᏗᏆᎳᏏᏕᏂᏉ ᏧᏩᏒ, ᎾᏍᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᏗᏉᏰᏂ ᎠᎴ ᏥᏍᎪᎵ.
\ft Simon Peter saith unto him, Lord, not my feet only, but also my hands and my head.

\ln Tsisa hia nuweselvgi; Gilo udosulisadv tsigesoi tsulasideniquo tsuwasv tsuwosuledi gesoi; nigvno udanvgalvdv gesoi.  Ale nihi itsadanvgalvdv, aseno vtla nitsiv yigi.
\syll ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎩᎶ ᎤᏙᏑᎵᏌᏛ ᏥᎨᏐᎢ ᏧᎳᏏᏕᏂᏉ ᏧᏩᏒ ᏧᏬᏑᎴᏗ ᎨᏐᎢ; ᏂᎬᏃ ᎤᏓᏅᎦᎸᏛ ᎨᏐᎢ.  ᎠᎴ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᎦᎸᏛ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏂᏥᎥ ᏱᎩ.
\ft Jesus saith to him, He that is washed needeth not save to wash his feet, but is clean every whit: and ye are clean, but not all.

\ln Agatahiyuyeno gesvgi nasgi na ulonuhesgi; nasgi iyusdi, Vtla nitsiv itsadanvgalvdv yigi, udvnvgi.
\syll ᎠᎦᏔᎯᏳᏰᏃ ᎨᏒᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᎶᏄᎮᏍᎩ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᎥᏝ ᏂᏥᎥ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᎦᎸᏛ ᏱᎩ, ᎤᏛᏅᎩ.
\ft For he knew who should betray him; therefore said he, Ye are not all clean.

\ln Hnaquono duwosuleonelv tsunalasideni, ale iunuwov; ale taline iuwenv, hia niduweselvgi; Itsigatahasgo hia nasgi tsinitsvyadvnisi?
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏚᏬᏑᎴᎣᏁᎸ ᏧᎾᎳᏏᏕᏂ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᎤᏄᏬᎥ; ᎠᎴ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎢᎤᏪᏅ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎭᏍᎪ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏂᏨᏯᏛᏂᏏ?
\ft So after he had washed their feet, and had taken his garments, and was set down again, he said unto them, Know ye what I have done to you?

\ln Tadeyohvsgi, ale Tsagvwiyuhi, sgiyosehoi; ale duyugodv nitsiwesgoi, nasgiyeno nusdi.
\syll ᏔᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᏍᎩᏲᏎᎰᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᏂᏥᏪᏍᎪᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᏄᏍᏗ.
\ft Ye call me Master and Lord: and ye say well; for so I am.

\ln Iyuno ayv Agigvwiyuhi itsatseliga ale Ditsvyeyohvsgi ditsalasideni yiditsvyosuleha, nasquosgini itsvsv itsalasideni yiditsadadosuleha.
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᎠᏴ ᎠᎩᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᏣᏤᎵᎦ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏨᏰᏲᎲᏍᎩ ᏗᏣᎳᏏᏕᏂ ᏱᏗᏨᏲᏑᎴᎭ, ᎾᏍᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᏨᏒ ᎢᏣᎳᏏᏕᏂ ᏱᏗᏣᏓᏙᏑᎴᎭ.
\ft If I then, your Lord and Master, have washed your feet; ye also ought to wash one another's feet.

\ln Itsadeloquasdiyeno itsvvsi, nasgiya nitsvyadvnelv itsadvnediyi.
\syll ᎢᏣᏕᎶᏆᏍᏗᏰᏃ ᎢᏨᎥᏏ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏂᏨᏯᏛᏁᎸ ᎢᏣᏛᏁᏗᏱ.
\ft For I have given you an example, that ye should do as I have done to you.

\ln Udohiyuhiya udohiyuhiya hia nitsvweseha; Atsinatlai vtla utli atsilvquodiyu yigesoi, esgaquo unatlai; ale vtla atsinvsidv utli atsilvquodiyu yigesoi, esgaquo nvdayunvsidv.
\syll ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ; ᎠᏥᎾᏝᎢ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏟ ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᏱᎨᏐᎢ, ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎤᎾᏝᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᎠᏥᏅᏏᏛ ᎤᏟ ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᏱᎨᏐᎢ, ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᏅᏓᏳᏅᏏᏛ.
\ft Verily, verily, I say unto you, The servant is not greater than his lord; neither he that is sent greater than he that sent him.

\ln Iyuno nasgi hia yitsigataha, Osiyu yitsadanvta nasgi yinitsadvneha.
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏱᏥᎦᏔᎭ, ᎣᏏᏳ ᏱᏣᏓᏅᏔ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᏂᏣᏛᏁᎭ.
\ft If ye know these things, happy are ye if ye do them.

\ln Vtla nitsiv yitsvyadvga; gatsigataha gatsiyasuyedv gesvi; aseno udohiyudiyi gowelvi, "Itsulaha osdalisdayvhvsgi usaladanv gadigeni aquatludisgvi."
\syll ᎥᏝ ᏂᏥᎥ ᏱᏨᏯᏛᎦ; ᎦᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᎦᏥᏯᏑᏰᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᏗᏱ ᎪᏪᎸᎢ, data is invalidᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎣᏍᏓᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎩ ᎤᏌᎳᏓᏅ ᎦᏗᎨᏂ ᎠᏆᏡᏗᏍᎬᎢ.data is invalid
\ft I speak not of you all: I know whom I have chosen: but that the scripture may be fulfilled, He that eateth bread with me hath lifted up his heel against me.

\ln Hnaquo itsvnoneha, asiquo nasgi nulistanvna, nasgi hnaquo nigalistanvha itsohiyudiyi ayv nasgi gesvi.
\syll ᎿᏉ ᎢᏨᏃᏁᎭ, ᎠᏏᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎾ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎿᏉ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏔᏅᎭ ᎢᏦᎯᏳᏗᏱ ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Now I tell you before it come, that, when it is come to pass, ye may believe that I am he.

\ln Udohiyuhiya udohiyuhiya hia nitsvweseha; Gilo dadanilvgesdi tsinvsidv, ayv daquadanilvgesdi, gilono ayv daquadanilvgesdi, nvdvginvsidv dadanilvgesdi.
\syll ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ; ᎩᎶ ᏓᏓᏂᎸᎨᏍᏗ ᏥᏅᏏᏛ, ᎠᏴ ᏓᏆᏓᏂᎸᎨᏍᏗ, ᎩᎶᏃ ᎠᏴ ᏓᏆᏓᏂᎸᎨᏍᏗ, ᏅᏛᎩᏅᏏᏛ ᏓᏓᏂᎸᎨᏍᏗ.
\ft Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that receiveth whomsoever I send receiveth me; and he that receiveth me receiveth him that sent me.

\ln Tsisa nasgi nuwesv udeyatanelv udanvdvi, ale gvnigesv nuwanelvgi, hia nuwesvgi; Udohiyuhiya udohiyuhiha hia nitsvweseha; hia tsinitsadvnv asiyvwi udasuya dvgilonuheli.
\syll ᏥᏌ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏪᏒ ᎤᏕᏯᏔᏁᎸ ᎤᏓᏅᏛᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏄᏩᏁᎸᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᎭ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ; ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᏣᏛᏅ ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᎤᏓᏑᏯ ᏛᎩᎶᏄᎮᎵ.
\ft When Jesus had thus said, he was troubled in spirit, and testified, and said, Verily, verily, I say unto you, that one of you shall betray me.

\ln Hnaquono gvwasdawadidohi dunadakahnanvgi unatlogvgi nasgi atsidvga unelisdiyi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏚᎾᏓᎧᎿᏅᎩ ᎤᎾᏠᎬᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏥᏛᎦ ᎤᏁᎵᏍᏗᏱ.
\ft Then the disciples looked one on another, doubting of whom he spake.

\ln Asiyvwino gvwasdawadidohi gesv Tsisa ganetsiyi gasdvgalvgi, nasgi Tsisa ugeyuhi.
\syll ᎠᏏᏴᏫᏃ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏥᏌ ᎦᏁᏥᏱ ᎦᏍᏛᎦᎸᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏌ ᎤᎨᏳᎯ.
\ft Now there was leaning on Jesus' bosom one of his disciples, whom Jesus loved.

\ln Sawanino Quida nasgi ulisguwiselvgi udvdvdiyi nasgi gesvi gadvgvi.
\syll ᏌᏩᏂᏃ ᏈᏓ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎵᏍᎫᏫᏎᎸᎩ ᎤᏛᏛᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᏒᎢ ᎦᏛᎬᎢ.
\ft Simon Peter therefore beckoned to him, that he should ask who it should be of whom he spake.

\ln Hnaquono Tsisa ganetsii usdvgali hia nuweselvgi; Tsagvwiyuhi, gago?
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎦᏁᏥᎢ ᎤᏍᏛᎦᎵ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎦᎪ?
\ft He then lying on Jesus' breast saith unto him, Lord, who is it?

\ln Tsisa unetsvgi; Nasgi gesesdi agvhalvdv tsinelvha nasgi aquunvhi gesesdi.  Uwunvno agvhalvdv unelvgi Tsudasi Isgaladi Sawani uwetsi.
\syll ᏥᏌ ᎤᏁᏨᎩ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎠᎬᎭᎸᏛ ᏥᏁᎸᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏊᏅᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.  ᎤᏭᏅᏃ ᎠᎬᎭᎸᏛ ᎤᏁᎸᎩ ᏧᏓᏏ ᎢᏍᎦᎳᏗ ᏌᏩᏂ ᎤᏪᏥ.
\ft Jesus answered, He it is, to whom I shall give a sop, when I have dipped it. And when he had dipped the sop, he gave it to Judas Iscariot, the son of Simon.

\ln Agvhalvdvno atsinelv Sedani uyvselvgi.  Hnaquono Tsisa hia nuweselvgi; Nasgi itsadvnedi gesv nulaquo hnadvga.
\syll ᎠᎬᎭᎸᏛᏃ ᎠᏥᏁᎸ ᏎᏓᏂ ᎤᏴᏎᎸᎩ.  ᎿᏉᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏣᏛᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏄᎳᏉ ᎿᏛᎦ.
\ft And after the sop Satan entered into him. Then said Jesus unto him, That thou doest, do quickly.

\ln Vtlano gilo aninvdlai yuwolitse nusdv gadvgv nasgi nuweselvi.
\syll ᎥᏝᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎠᏂᏅᏜᎢ ᏳᏬᎵᏤ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎦᏛᎬ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎢ.
\ft Now no man at the table knew for what intent he spake this unto him.

\ln Tsudasiyeno degalodi ganehv nvdayulisdotanvgi igadv, hia Tsisa nigawesi unelisvgi; Gohusdi tsawahi dilisdayvdiyi gesv iyu gohusdi igvdodi; ale hia yigi; gohusdi tihvsi uyo iyunadvhnadegi.
\syll ᏧᏓᏏᏰᏃ ᏕᎦᎶᏗ ᎦᏁᎲ ᏅᏓᏳᎵᏍᏙᏔᏅᎩ ᎢᎦᏛ, ᎯᎠ ᏥᏌ ᏂᎦᏪᏏ ᎤᏁᎵᏒᎩ; ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏣᏩᎯ ᏗᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎢᎬᏙᏗ; ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏱᎩ; ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏘᎲᏏ ᎤᏲ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᎿᏕᎩ.
\ft For some of them thought, because Judas had the bag, that Jesus had said unto him, Buy those things that we have need of against the feast; or, that he should give something to the poor.

\ln Hnaquono nasgi, agvhalvdv ugisv, gilaquo iyvdv unugotsvgi, ale svnoyi gesvgi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ, ᎠᎬᎭᎸᏛ ᎤᎩᏒ, ᎩᎳᏉ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎤᏄᎪᏨᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏒᏃᏱ ᎨᏒᎩ.
\ft He then having received the sop went immediately out: and it was night.

\ln Nasgino unugotsv, Tsisa hia nuwesvgi; Hnaquo yvwi uwetsi atsilvquoda, nasgino nigvnisa Unelanvhi atsilvquoda.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᏄᎪᏨ, ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎿᏉ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏓ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏂᎬᏂᏌ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏓ.
\ft Therefore, when he was gone out, Jesus said, Now is the Son of man glorified, and God is glorified in him.

\ln Iyuno nasgi yinuwanisanv Unelanvhi yatsilvquotanv, Unelanvhi uwasv nvdagvnisani nasgi dayulvquotani, ale gilaquo iyvdv dayulvquotani.
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᏄᏩᏂᏌᏅ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏯᏥᎸᏉᏔᏅ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏅᏓᎬᏂᏌᏂ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏓᏳᎸᏉᏔᏂ, ᎠᎴ ᎩᎳᏉ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏓᏳᎸᏉᏔᏂ.
\ft If God be glorified in him, God shall also glorify him in himself, and shall straightway glorify him.

\ln Ditsiyoli, asi tlega itsvyeladidoha; sgiyohesdi; ale nasgiya Anitsusi tsinigatsiweselvgi, "Witsigadv vtla wiyvgetsilohi," tsigatsiyoselvgi, nasgiya nasquo hnaquo nihi nitsvweseha.
\syll ᏗᏥᏲᎵ, ᎠᏏ ᏞᎦ ᎢᏨᏰᎳᏗᏙᎭ; ᏍᎩᏲᎮᏍᏗ; ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᏥᏂᎦᏥᏪᏎᎸᎩ, data is invalidᏫᏥᎦᏛ ᎥᏝ ᏫᏴᎨᏥᎶᎯ,data is invalid ᏥᎦᏥᏲᏎᎸᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎿᏉ ᏂᎯ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ.
\ft Little children, yet a little while I am with you. Ye shall seek me: and as I said unto the Jews, Whither I go, ye cannot come; so now I say to you.

\ln Itse dikahnawadvsdi itsvvsi, ditsadageyuhiyu iyulisdodiyi; Nasgiya itsvgeyuiyu nulistanvi, nasgi nasquo ditsadageyuhiyu iyulisdodiyi.
\syll ᎢᏤ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎢᏨᎥᏏ, ᏗᏣᏓᎨᏳᎯᏳ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ; ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎢᏨᎨᏳᎢᏳ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏗᏣᏓᎨᏳᎯᏳ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
\ft A new commandment I give unto you, That ye love one another; as I have loved you, that ye also love one another.

\ln Nasgi naniv unadolehohisdodi gesesdi sgisdawadidohi gesvi, iyuno ditsadageyuhiyu yigi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎤᎾᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏍᎩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᏗᏣᏓᎨᏳᎯᏳ ᏱᎩ.
\ft By this shall all men know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another.

\ln Sawani Quida hia nuweselvgi, Tsagvwiyuhi, hatlv hai?  Tsisa unetselvgi; Witsigadv vtla hnaquo yvgesgisdawaduga; onisgini dasgisdawadesi.
\syll ᏌᏩᏂ ᏈᏓ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎭᏢ ᎭᎢ?  ᏥᏌ ᎤᏁᏤᎸᎩ; ᏫᏥᎦᏛ ᎥᏝ ᎿᏉ ᏴᎨᏍᎩᏍᏓᏩᏚᎦ; ᎣᏂᏍᎩᏂ ᏓᏍᎩᏍᏓᏩᏕᏏ.
\ft Simon Peter said unto him, Lord, whither goest thou? Jesus answered him, Whither I go, thou canst not follow me now; but thou shalt follow me afterwards.

\ln Quida hia nuweselvgi; Tsagvwiyuhi, gadono vtla yeli hnaquo gagvsdawadvsdi yigi?  Nihi nvdagalisdotani eladi datsini gvnvi.
\syll ᏈᏓ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎦᏙᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏰᎵ ᎿᏉ ᎦᎬᏍᏓᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏱᎩ?  ᏂᎯ ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏔᏂ ᎡᎳᏗ ᏓᏥᏂ ᎬᏅᎢ.
\ft Peter said unto him, Lord, why cannot I follow thee now? I will lay down my life for thy sake.

\ln Tsisa unetselvgi; Tsisa ayv nvdagalisdotani eladi tini hvnvi?  Udohiyuhiya, udohiyuhiya hia nigvweseha; Tsatagatsvyai vtla yvdvyvlasi gvni tsoi isquadayilvhi gesesdi.
\syll ᏥᏌ ᎤᏁᏤᎸᎩ; ᏥᏌ ᎠᏴ ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏔᏂ ᎡᎳᏗ ᏘᏂ ᎲᏅᎢ?  ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ, ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏪᏎᎭ; ᏣᏔᎦᏨᏯᎢ ᎥᏝ ᏴᏛᏴᎳᏏ ᎬᏂ ᏦᎢ ᎢᏍᏆᏓᏱᎸᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft Jesus answered him, Wilt thou lay down thy life for my sake? Verily, verily, I say unto thee, The cock shall not crow, till thou hast denied me thrice.

\ln Tlesdi itsadanvdo yudestanehesdi; etsoiyuhvga Unelanvhi, ale nasquo ayv sgiyoiyuhvga.
\syll ᏞᏍᏗ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏙ ᏳᏕᏍᏔᏁᎮᏍᏗ; ᎡᏦᎢᏳᎲᎦ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏴ ᏍᎩᏲᎢᏳᎲᎦ.
\ft Let not your heart be troubled: ye believe in God, believe also in me.

\ln Edoda ganelvi utsata dadanelv.  Iyuno nasgi nusdvna yigesei, yitsvnonelei.  Gadvnvistani itsiyvsdiyi.
\syll ᎡᏙᏓ ᎦᏁᎸᎢ ᎤᏣᏔ ᏓᏓᏁᎸ.  ᎢᏳᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏛᎾ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ, ᏱᏨᏃᏁᎴᎢ.  ᎦᏛᏅᎢᏍᏔᏂ ᎢᏥᏴᏍᏗᏱ.
\ft In my Father's house are many mansions: if it were not so, I would have told you. I go to prepare a place for you.

\ln Iyuno yaquadvnvistanenv itsiyvsdiyi, taline dvtsilutsi ale aquvsv aquolv dodatsvyadanilvtsi, nasgi ayv gev nasquo nahna itsadediyi.
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᏯᏆᏛᏅᎢᏍᏔᏁᏅ ᎢᏥᏴᏍᏗᏱ, ᏔᎵᏁ ᏛᏥᎷᏥ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏋᏒ ᎠᏉᎸ ᏙᏓᏨᏯᏓᏂᎸᏥ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᎨᎥ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏀᎾ ᎢᏣᏕᏗᏱ.
\ft And if I go and prepare a place for you, I will come again, and receive you unto myself; that where I am, there ye may be also.

\ln Ale ayv witsigadv itsigataha, ale wiganvnv itsigataha.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴ ᏫᏥᎦᏛ ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᏫᎦᏅᏅ ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎭ.
\ft And whither I go ye know, and the way ye know.

\ln Dami hia nuweselvgi; Tsagvwiyuhi, vtla yotsigataha wigadvi; gadono yigalisdoda yotsigataha wiganvnvi.
\syll ᏓᎻ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎥᏝ ᏲᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᏫᎦᏛᎢ; ᎦᏙᏃ ᏱᎦᎵᏍᏙᏓ ᏲᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᏫᎦᏅᏅᎢ.
\ft Thomas saith unto him, Lord, we know not whither thou goest; and how can we know the way?

\ln Tsisa hia nuweselvgi; Ayv nasgi nvnohi, ale duyugodvi, ale gvnidv.  Vtla gilo Agayvligei yigalutsehoi, gvni ayv agilohiselvhi tsigesoi.
\syll ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏃᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏳᎪᏛᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᏛ.  ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ ᏱᎦᎷᏤᎰᎢ, ᎬᏂ ᎠᏴ ᎠᎩᎶᎯᏎᎸᎯ ᏥᎨᏐᎢ.
\ft Jesus saith unto him, I am the way, the truth, and the life: no man cometh unto the Father, but by me.

\ln Iyuno ayv yisgigatahei nasquo Edoda yetsigatahei; Gohino iyudalenvdv etsigataha ale etsigowadvhv.
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᎠᏴ ᏱᏍᎩᎦᏔᎮᎢ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎡᏙᏓ ᏰᏥᎦᏔᎮᎢ; ᎪᎯᏃ ᎢᏳᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎡᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᎠᎴ ᎡᏥᎪᏩᏛᎲ.
\ft If ye had known me, ye should have known my Father also: and from henceforth ye know him, and have seen him.

\ln Quiligi hia nuweselvgi; Tsagvwiyuhi, sginanugowisi Agayvligei, hnaquono yeliga dayotsiyelvni.
\syll ᏈᎵᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᏍᎩᎾᏄᎪᏫᏏ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ, ᎿᏉᏃ ᏰᎵᎦ ᏓᏲᏥᏰᎸᏂ.
\ft Philip saith unto him, Lord, shew us the Father, and it sufficeth us.

\ln Tsisa hia nuweselvgi; Tsisa nigohigi itsulaha ineda, asisgono vtla yisgigadovsga, Quiligi; gilo ayv agigohvhi tsigesoi, ugohvhi geso Agayvligei; gadono hia nihiwea; Sginanugowisi Agayvligei?
\syll ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏥᏌ ᏂᎪᎯᎩ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎢᏁᏓ, ᎠᏏᏍᎪᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏍᎩᎦᏙᎥᏍᎦ, ᏈᎵᎩ; ᎩᎶ ᎠᏴ ᎠᎩᎪᎲᎯ ᏥᎨᏐᎢ, ᎤᎪᎲᎯ ᎨᏐ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ; ᎦᏙᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎯᏪᎠ; ᏍᎩᎾᏄᎪᏫᏏ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ?
\ft Jesus saith unto him, Have I been so long time with you, and yet hast thou not known me, Philip? he that hath seen me hath seen the Father; and how sayest thou then, Shew us the Father?

\ln Tlasgo yohiyuhvsga ayv Agayvligei tsiyavi, ale Agayvlige ayv agiyavi?  Kanohedv tsitsvnohehehoi, vtla aquvsvquo aquadanvtedv yitsinegoi, Agayvligeisgini tsagiyaa nasgi dulvwisdanehoi.
\syll ᏝᏍᎪ ᏲᎯᏳᎲᏍᎦ ᎠᏴ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ ᏥᏯᎥᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᎠᏴ ᎠᎩᏯᎥᎢ?  ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏥᏨᏃᎮᎮᎰᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᏋᏒᏉ ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏖᏛ ᏱᏥᏁᎪᎢ, ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢᏍᎩᏂ ᏣᎩᏯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎰᎢ.
\ft Believest thou not that I am in the Father, and the Father in me? the words that I speak unto you I speak not of myself: but the Father that dwelleth in me, he doeth the works.

\ln Sgiyoiyuhvga ayv Agayvligei tsiyavi, ale Agayvligei ayv agiyavi, iyuno nisgiyoiyuhvsgvna igesesdi, dagilvwisdanehvquo winigalisdoda sgiyoiyuhvga.
\syll ᏍᎩᏲᎢᏳᎲᎦ ᎠᏴ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ ᏥᏯᎥᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ ᎠᏴ ᎠᎩᏯᎥᎢ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᏂᏍᎩᏲᎢᏳᎲᏍᎬᎾ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᏓᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᏉ ᏫᏂᎦᎵᏍᏙᏓ ᏍᎩᏲᎢᏳᎲᎦ.
\ft Believe me that I am in the Father, and the Father in me: or else believe me for the very works' sake.

\ln Udohiyuhiya udohiyuhiya hia nitsvweseha; Aquohiyuhvsgi, ayv tsidagilvwisdaneha nasquonasgi dodayulvwisdaneli, ale utli usquanigodiyu dodayulvwisdaneli esgaquo hia; Edodoyiyeno gai,
\syll ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ; ᎠᏉᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ, ᎠᏴ ᏥᏓᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎭ ᎾᏍᏉᎾᏍᎩ ᏙᏓᏳᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎵ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏟ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗᏳ ᏙᏓᏳᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎵ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎯᎠ; ᎡᏙᏙᏱᏰᏃ ᎦᎢ,
\ft Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that believeth on me, the works that I do shall he do also; and greater works than these shall he do; because I go unto my Father.

\ln Nigavno gohusdi daquodov itsitayosdisgesdi, nasgi iyaquadvnedi gesesdi, Agayvligei atsilvquododiyi Uwetsi iyuwanisanvhi gesvi.
\syll ᏂᎦᎥᏃ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏓᏉᏙᎥ ᎢᏥᏔᏲᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏯᏆᏛᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏅᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft And whatsoever ye shall ask in my name, that will I do, that the Father may be glorified in the Son.

\ln Iyuno gohusdi daquadov itsitayosdisgesdi, nasgi ase iyaquadvnedi.
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏓᏆᏙᎥ ᎢᏥᏔᏲᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏎ ᎢᏯᏆᏛᏁᏗ.
\ft If ye shall ask any thing in my name, I will do it.

\ln Iyuno sgigeyuiyu gesesdi, itsisquanigoda aquatseli dikahnawadvsdi;
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᏍᎩᎨᏳᎢᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎢᏥᏍᏆᏂᎪᏓ ᎠᏆᏤᎵ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ;
\ft If ye love me, keep my commandments.

\ln Ale Agayvlige ayv datsitayoseli, nasgino datsalisgolvdaneli nvwadale Itsinvwohisdisgi, nasgi alisquadisgi nigesvna itseladidohi,
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᎠᏴ ᏓᏥᏔᏲᏎᎵ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏓᏣᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᎵ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᎢᏥᏅᏬᎯᏍᏗᏍᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᏤᎳᏗᏙᎯ,
\ft And I will pray the Father, and he shall give you another Comforter, that he may abide with you for ever;

\ln Nasgi na gayegogi nigesvna Adanvdo, nasgi elohi digvwadanilvisdi nigesvna tsigi, nasgi yugowatiha ale vtla yugataha; nihisgini etsigataha, itseladidohayeno, ale nasgi itsiyaesdi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎦᏰᎪᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏗᎬᏩᏓᏂᎸᎢᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏳᎪᏩᏘᎭ ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᏳᎦᏔᎭ; ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎡᏥᎦᏔᎭ, ᎢᏤᎳᏗᏙᎭᏰᏃ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏥᏯᎡᏍᏗ.
\ft Even the Spirit of truth; whom the world cannot receive, because it seeth him not, neither knoweth him: but ye know him; for he dwelleth with you, and shall be in you.

\ln Vtla itsadaniyadv yvdatsvyvdetsi; dvtsvlutseli.
\syll ᎥᏝ ᎢᏣᏓᏂᏯᏛ ᏴᏓᏨᏴᏕᏥ; ᏛᏨᎷᏤᎵ.
\ft I will not leave you comfortless: I will come to you.

\ln Asi tlega, hnaquo elohi vtla yagigowatisgesdi, nihisgini sgigowatisgesdi, ayvyeno gvnv, ale nihi nasquo detsvnesdi.
\syll ᎠᏏ ᏞᎦ, ᎿᏉ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎥᏝ ᏯᎩᎪᏩᏘᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᏍᎩᎪᏩᏘᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᏴᏰᏃ ᎬᏅ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏕᏨᏁᏍᏗ.
\ft Yet a little while, and the world seeth me no more; but ye see me: because I live, ye shall live also.

\ln Nahiyu datsadolehosi ayv Edoda tsiyavi, ale nihi sgiyavi, ale ayv itsvyavi.
\syll ᏀᎢᏳ ᏓᏣᏙᎴᎰᏏ ᎠᏴ ᎡᏙᏓ ᏥᏯᎥᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎯ ᏍᎩᏯᎥᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴ ᎢᏨᏯᎥᎢ.
\ft At that day ye shall know that I am in my Father, and ye in me, and I in you.

\ln Nasgi na dikahnawadvsdi aquatseliga usquanigodi ale dikahnawadegi, nasgi ayv agigeyuhi, ale ayv agigeyuhi ugeyuhi gesesdi Edoda, ale ayv tsigeyuiyu gesesdi, ale gvnigesv nvdatsiyadvneli.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎠᏆᏤᎵᎦ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏕᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᎠᎩᎨᏳᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴ ᎠᎩᎨᏳᎯ ᎤᎨᏳᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎡᏙᏓ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴ ᏥᎨᏳᎢᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏅᏓᏥᏯᏛᏁᎵ.
\ft He that hath my commandments, and keepeth them, he it is that loveth me: and he that loveth me shall be loved of my Father, and I will love him, and will manifest myself to him.

\ln Tsudasi, vtla Isgaladi, hia nuweselvgi; Tsagvwiyuhi, gado dagalisdotani gvnigesv ayv nvdvsgiyadvneli, vtlano elohi?
\syll ᏧᏓᏏ, ᎥᏝ ᎢᏍᎦᎳᏗ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎦᏙ ᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏔᏂ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎠᏴ ᏅᏛᏍᎩᏯᏛᏁᎵ, ᎥᏝᏃ ᎡᎶᎯ?
\ft Judas saith unto him, not Iscariot, Lord, how is it that thou wilt manifest thyself unto us, and not unto the world?

\ln Tsisa unetsvgi, hia nuweselvgi; Iyuno gilo agigeyuhi yigi, nasgi tsukahnawadvsdi aginetsvi; Edodano ugeyuhi iyulisdodi, ale dayosdilutseli, ale ganelvi dayosdaneladi.
\syll ᏥᏌ ᎤᏁᏨᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎠᎩᎨᏳᎯ ᏱᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎠᎩᏁᏨᎢ; ᎡᏙᏓᏃ ᎤᎨᏳᎯ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᏲᏍᏗᎷᏤᎵ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᏁᎸᎢ ᏓᏲᏍᏓᏁᎳᏗ.
\ft Jesus answered and said unto him, If a man love me, he will keep my words: and my Father will love him, and we will come unto him, and make our abode with him.

\ln Agigeyuhi nigesvna vtla yidakahnawadego aginetsvi.  Kanohedvno tsitsadvgia, vtla ayv aquatseliga yigi, agayvligesgini nvdvginvsidv utseliga.
\syll ᎠᎩᎨᏳᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏓᎧᎿᏩᏕᎪ ᎠᎩᏁᏨᎢ.  ᎧᏃᎮᏛᏃ ᏥᏣᏛᎩᎠ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᏴ ᎠᏆᏤᎵᎦ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᏍᎩᏂ ᏅᏛᎩᏅᏏᏛ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ.
\ft He that loveth me not keepeth not my sayings: and the word which ye hear is not mine, but the Father's which sent me.

\ln Nasgi itsvnohehelv asi tsitsvyeladidoha.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏨᏃᎮᎮᎸ ᎠᏏ ᏥᏨᏰᎳᏗᏙᎭ.
\ft These things have I spoken unto you, being yet present with you.

\ln Adanvwohisdisgisgini, galvquodiyu Adanvdo, nasgi Agayvligei nvdayunvsdi tsigi daquadosdvi, nasgi nigadv datseyoni, ale datsanvdadistani nigav itsvnetselvi.
\syll ᎠᏓᏅᏬᎯᏍᏗᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ, ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ ᏅᏓᏳᏅᏍᏗ ᏥᎩ ᏓᏆᏙᏍᏛᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏓᏤᏲᏂ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᏣᏅᏓᏗᏍᏔᏂ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎢᏨᏁᏤᎸᎢ.
\ft But the Comforter, which is the Holy Ghost, whom the Father will send in my name, he shall teach you all things, and bring all things to your remembrance, whatsoever I have said unto you.

\ln Nvwadohiyadv itsviyasi; nvwadohiyadv aquatseliga itsvvsi.  Vtla elohi tsadaneho nasgi iyusdi yitsvvsi; tlesdi itsadanvdo yudeyatanehesdi, ale tlesdi yasgaihesdi.
\syll ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᎢᏨᎢᏯᏏ; ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᎠᏆᏤᎵᎦ ᎢᏨᎥᏏ.  ᎥᏝ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏣᏓᏁᎰ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏱᏨᎥᏏ; ᏞᏍᏗ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏙ ᏳᏕᏯᏔᏁᎮᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏯᏍᎦᎢᎮᏍᏗ.
\ft Peace I leave with you, my peace I give unto you: not as the world giveth, give I unto you. Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be afraid.

\ln Itsadvganvhi, dvgesi ale dvtsvlutseli, tsitsvyoselvgi.  Iyuno sgigeyuiyu yigi, yitsaliheliga yinvdigalisdodiha Agayvligesdvyi witsigati tsaquadvnvgi; Edodayeno utli atsilvquodiyu esgaquo ayv.
\syll ᎢᏣᏛᎦᏅᎯ, ᏛᎨᏏ ᎠᎴ ᏛᏨᎷᏤᎵ, ᏥᏨᏲᏎᎸᎩ.  ᎢᏳᏃ ᏍᎩᎨᏳᎢᏳ ᏱᎩ, ᏱᏣᎵᎮᎵᎦ ᏱᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᏍᏛᏱ ᏫᏥᎦᏘ ᏣᏆᏛᏅᎩ; ᎡᏙᏓᏰᏃ ᎤᏟ ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎠᏴ.
\ft Ye have heard how I said unto you, I go away, and come again unto you. If ye loved me, ye would rejoice, because I said, I go unto the Father: for my Father is greater than I.

\ln Hnaquono asiquo nasqualisgvna gesv itsvnohvsi, nasgi asqualvhvha itsohiyudiyi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎠᏏᏉ ᎾᏍᏆᎵᏍᎬᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏨᏃᎲᏏ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᏆᎸᎲᎭ ᎢᏦᎯᏳᏗᏱ.
\ft And now I have told you before it come to pass, that, when it is come to pass, ye might believe.

\ln Gohi iyudalenvdv vtla utsati yvgetsvyalinoheda; ugvwiyuhiyeno hia elohi utseliga dayai; vtlano gohusdi utseli yaqueha.
\syll ᎪᎯ ᎢᏳᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏴᎨᏨᏯᎵᏃᎮᏓ; ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᏰᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᏓᏯᎢ; ᎥᏝᏃ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏯᏇᎭ.
\ft Hereafter I will not talk much with you: for the prince of this world cometh, and hath nothing in me.

\ln Aseno elohi udolehohisdiyi Agayvligei tsigeyuiyu gesvi, ale Agayvligei aginetselvi nasgi nigadvnehvi.  Ditsalehvga, idena.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎤᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ ᏥᎨᏳᎢᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ ᎠᎩᏁᏤᎸᎢ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᏛᏁᎲᎢ.  ᏗᏣᎴᎲᎦ, ᎢᏕᎾ.
\ft But that the world may know that I love the Father; and as the Father gave me commandment, even so I do. Arise, let us go hence.

\ln Telvladiya ayv, Edodano digalogisgi.
\syll ᏖᎸᎳᏗᏯ ᎠᏴ, ᎡᏙᏓᏃ ᏗᎦᎶᎩᏍᎩ.
\ft I am the true vine, and my Father is the husbandman.

\ln Nigav daquvnigalvi nanadadvvsgvna tsigeso degvnigalisgoi; nigadvno anadadvvsgi degvnigaluwosgoi utli igai unadadvdiyi uyelvsoi.
\syll ᏂᎦᎥ ᏓᏋᏂᎦᎸᎢ ᎾᎾᏓᏛᎥᏍᎬᎾ ᏥᎨᏐ ᏕᎬᏂᎦᎵᏍᎪᎢ; ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᎠᎾᏓᏛᎥᏍᎩ ᏕᎬᏂᎦᎷᏬᏍᎪᎢ ᎤᏟ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎤᎾᏓᏛᏗᏱ ᎤᏰᎸᏐᎢ.
\ft Every branch in me that beareth not fruit he taketh away: and every branch that beareth fruit, he purgeth it, that it may bring forth more fruit.

\ln Hnaquo nihi itsadanvgalvtanv kanohedv nasgi itsvnetselvhi tsigi.
\syll ᎿᏉ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᎦᎸᏔᏅ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏨᏁᏤᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ.
\ft Now ye are clean through the word which I have spoken unto you.

\ln Sgiyaesdi, aseno itsvyaesdi.  Nasgiya uwanigalvi uwasv yeli gvwadadvdi nigesvna tsigeso gvni utelvladv tsuwanigaloi, nasquosgini nihi vtla yeliga gvni ayv yisgiyaa.
\syll ᏍᎩᏯᎡᏍᏗ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎢᏨᏯᎡᏍᏗ.  ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎤᏩᏂᎦᎸᎢ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏰᎵ ᎬᏩᏓᏛᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏥᎨᏐ ᎬᏂ ᎤᏖᎸᎳᏛ ᏧᏩᏂᎦᎶᎢ, ᎾᏍᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᏂᎯ ᎥᏝ ᏰᎵᎦ ᎬᏂ ᎠᏴ ᏱᏍᎩᏯᎠ.
\ft Abide in me, and I in you. As the branch cannot bear fruit of itself, except it abide in the vine; no more can ye, except ye abide in me.

\ln Utelvladvi ayv, duwanigalvi nihi.  Ayv agiyai, ayvno tsiyai, nasgi utsado anadadvvsgoi.  Vtlayeno ayv vtla yeli gohusdi yvgetsadvga.
\syll ᎤᏖᎸᎳᏛᎢ ᎠᏴ, ᏚᏩᏂᎦᎸᎢ ᏂᎯ.  ᎠᏴ ᎠᎩᏯᎢ, ᎠᏴᏃ ᏥᏯᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏣᏙ ᎠᎾᏓᏛᎥᏍᎪᎢ.  ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᎠᏴ ᎥᏝ ᏰᎵ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏴᎨᏣᏛᎦ.
\ft I am the vine, ye are the branches: He that abideth in me, and I in him, the same bringeth forth much fruit: for without me ye can do nothing.

\ln Iyuno gilo nagiyavna tsigesoi, agadaegoi nasgiya uwanigalanvhi tsunadaegoi, ale gvyvsgoi; yvwino danitlisisgoi, atsilvyino widunadegoi, ale dagohvsgoi.
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎾᎩᏯᎥᎾ ᏥᎨᏐᎢ, ᎠᎦᏓᎡᎪᎢ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎤᏩᏂᎦᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᎾᏓᎡᎪᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏴᏍᎪᎢ; ᏴᏫᏃ ᏓᏂᏟᏏᏍᎪᎢ, ᎠᏥᎸᏱᏃ ᏫᏚᎾᏕᎪᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᎪᎲᏍᎪᎢ.
\ft If a man abide not in me, he is cast forth as a branch, and is withered; and men gather them, and cast them into the fire, and they are burned.

\ln Iyuno nihi sgiyaesdi, ale aginetsv itsiyaesdi, nigav itsadulisgv itsitayohihesdi, ale nasgi ase iyetsadvnedi gesesdi.
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᏂᎯ ᏍᎩᏯᎡᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎩᏁᏨ ᎢᏥᏯᎡᏍᏗ, ᏂᎦᎥ ᎢᏣᏚᎵᏍᎬ ᎢᏥᏔᏲᎯᎮᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏎ ᎢᏰᏣᏛᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft If ye abide in me, and my words abide in you, ye shall ask what ye will, and it shall be done unto you.

\ln Utsadv itsadadvvsgv nasgi nvdagalisdotani Edoda dayetsilvquotani; howano sgisdawadidohi gesesdi.
\syll ᎤᏣᏛ ᎢᏣᏓᏛᎥᏍᎬ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏔᏂ ᎡᏙᏓ ᏓᏰᏥᎸᏉᏔᏂ; ᎰᏩᏃ ᏍᎩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft Herein is my Father glorified, that ye bear much fruit; so shall ye be my disciples.

\ln Edoda agigeyuhiyu tsigi, nasgiya nasquo itsvgeyuiyu nihi.  Nvwasdidisesdiquo itsvgeyuiyu gesvi.
\syll ᎡᏙᏓ ᎠᎩᎨᏳᎯᏳ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎢᏨᎨᏳᎢᏳ ᏂᎯ.  ᏅᏩᏍᏗᏗᏎᏍᏗᏉ ᎢᏨᎨᏳᎢᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft As the Father hath loved me, so have I loved you: continue ye in my love.

\ln Iyuno yitsisquanigodi dikahnawadvsdi aquatseliga, yinvwasdidiquo itsvgeyuiyu gesvi; nasgiya tsagisquanigotanv dikahnawadvsdi Edoda utseliga, ale tsinvwasdidiquo agigeyuhiyu gesvi.
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᏱᏥᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎠᏆᏤᎵᎦ, ᏱᏅᏩᏍᏗᏗᏉ ᎢᏨᎨᏳᎢᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏣᎩᏍᏆᏂᎪᏔᏅ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎡᏙᏓ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᏅᏩᏍᏗᏗᏉ ᎠᎩᎨᏳᎯᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft If ye keep my commandments, ye shall abide in my love; even as I have kept my Father's commandments, and abide in his love.

\ln Nasgi hia nusdi itsvwonetanv, nvwasdidisesdiquo gatsiyalieligv aquelisv, ale analiheligv ukalitsvhi gesesdi aquelisv.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏍᏗ ᎢᏨᏬᏁᏔᏅ, ᏅᏩᏍᏗᏗᏎᏍᏗᏉ ᎦᏥᏯᎵᎡᎵᎬ ᎠᏇᎵᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎾᎵᎮᎵᎬ ᎤᎧᎵᏨᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎠᏇᎵᏒ.
\ft These things have I spoken unto you, that my joy might remain in you, and that your joy might be full.

\ln Dikahnawadvsdi aquatseliga hia nusdi, Ditsadageyuhiyu iyulisdodiyi, nasgiya itsvgeyuiyu nulistanvi.
\syll ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎠᏆᏤᎵᎦ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏍᏗ, ᏗᏣᏓᎨᏳᎯᏳ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎢᏨᎨᏳᎢᏳ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎢ.
\ft This is my commandment, That ye love one another, as I have loved you.

\ln Vtla gilo udageyuhiyu gesv yvgvgonadvda ulii diyohuhisehi.
\syll ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏓᎨᏳᎯᏳ ᎨᏒ ᏴᎬᎪᎾᏛᏓ ᎤᎵᎢ ᏗᏲᎱᎯᏎᎯ.
\ft Greater love hath no man than this, that a man lay down his life for his friends.

\ln Nihi ayv igalii, iyuno nigav itsvnetsehv yinitsadvneha.
\syll ᏂᎯ ᎠᏴ ᎢᎦᎵᎢ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎢᏨᏁᏤᎲ ᏱᏂᏣᏛᏁᎭ.
\ft Ye are my friends, if ye do whatsoever I command you.

\ln Gohi iyudalenvdv vtla itsvnvsidasdi yitsvyoseha; atsinvsidasdiyeno vtla yagataho unatlei nadvnehvi.  Nihisgini igalii itsvyoseha; nigavyeno gohusdi Edoda tsiyadvganelvi nasgi itsvnanugowiselv.
\syll ᎪᎯ ᎢᏳᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎥᏝ ᎢᏨᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᏱᏨᏲᏎᎭ; ᎠᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗᏰᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏯᎦᏔᎰ ᎤᎾᏞᎢ ᎾᏛᏁᎲᎢ.  ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᎦᎵᎢ ᎢᏨᏲᏎᎭ; ᏂᎦᎥᏰᏃ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎡᏙᏓ ᏥᏯᏛᎦᏁᎸᎢ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏨᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᎸ.
\ft Henceforth I call you not servants; for the servant knoweth not what his lord doeth: but I have called you friends; for all things that I have heard of my Father I have made known unto you.

\ln Vtla nihi ayv sgiyasuyedv yigi, ayvsgini nihi itsvyasuyedv, ale detsvyakanv itsenvsdiyi unequotsvhi itsinanugowisdiyi, ale unequotsvhi itsatseliga galosohvsgi nigesvna iyulisdodiyi, nigavno gohusdi etsitayosehesdi Agayvligei, ayv daquadov itsitayosdisgesdi, nasgi itsinediyi.
\syll ᎥᏝ ᏂᎯ ᎠᏴ ᏍᎩᏯᏑᏰᏛ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᏴᏍᎩᏂ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏨᏯᏑᏰᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᏨᏯᎧᏅ ᎢᏤᏅᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏁᏉᏨᎯ ᎢᏥᎾᏄᎪᏫᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᏉᏨᎯ ᎢᏣᏤᎵᎦ ᎦᎶᏐᎲᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᏂᎦᎥᏃ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎡᏥᏔᏲᏎᎮᏍᏗ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ, ᎠᏴ ᏓᏆᏙᎥ ᎢᏥᏔᏲᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏥᏁᏗᏱ.
\ft Ye have not chosen me, but I have chosen you, and ordained you, that ye should go and bring forth fruit, and that your fruit should remain: that whatsoever ye shall ask of the Father in my name, he may give it you.

\ln Nasgi hia nusdi itsvnetseha ditsadageyuhiyu iyulisdodiyi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏍᏗ ᎢᏨᏁᏤᎭ ᏗᏣᏓᎨᏳᎯᏳ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
\ft These things I command you, that ye love one another.

\ln Iyuno elohi itsisgagiyu yigi, itsigataha ayv igvyi agisgagiyu nulistanv nihi oni.
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎢᏥᏍᎦᎩᏳ ᏱᎩ, ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᎠᏴ ᎢᎬᏱ ᎠᎩᏍᎦᎩᏳ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ ᏂᎯ ᎣᏂ.
\ft If the world hate you, ye know that it hated me before it hated you.

\ln Iyuno elohi itsaligohi yigesei, elohi tsugeyuhiyu yigese tsutseliga.  Aseno elohi itsaligohi nigesvna tsigi, itsvyasuyedvsgini elohi tsigi, nasgi nvdigalisdodiha elohi itsisgaga.
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎢᏣᎵᎪᎯ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ, ᎡᎶᎯ ᏧᎨᏳᎯᏳ ᏱᎨᏎ ᏧᏤᎵᎦ.  ᎠᏎᏃ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎢᏣᎵᎪᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏥᎩ, ᎢᏨᏯᏑᏰᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎢᏥᏍᎦᎦ.
\ft If ye were of the world, the world would love his own: but because ye are not of the world, but I have chosen you out of the world, therefore the world hateth you.

\ln Itsanvtesdi hia tsinitsvweselvgi; Atsinatlai vtla utli atsilvquodiyu yigeso esgaquo unatlai.  Iyuno ayv gvgisotlvtanvhi yigi, nihi nasquo dagetsisotlvtani.  Iyuno ayv aginetsv unisquanigotanvhi yigi, nihi nasquo itsinetsv dvnisquanigotani.
\syll ᎢᏣᏅᏖᏍᏗ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᏨᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎠᏥᎾᏝᎢ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏟ ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᏱᎨᏐ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎤᎾᏝᎢ.  ᎢᏳᏃ ᎠᏴ ᎬᎩᏐᏢᏔᏅᎯ ᏱᎩ, ᏂᎯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏓᎨᏥᏐᏢᏔᏂ.  ᎢᏳᏃ ᎠᏴ ᎠᎩᏁᏨ ᎤᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏔᏅᎯ ᏱᎩ, ᏂᎯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎢᏥᏁᏨ ᏛᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏔᏂ.
\ft Remember the word that I said unto you, The servant is not greater than his lord. If they have persecuted me, they will also persecute you; if they have kept my saying, they will keep yours also.

\ln Aseno nasgi hia nigadv tsudalenvdv nvdagetsvneli nvdigalisdodisgesdi daquadovi, nigvwagatahvna gesv iyusdi nvdvginvsidv.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏅᏓᎨᏨᏁᎵ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏓᏆᏙᎥᎢ, ᏂᎬᏩᎦᏔᎲᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏅᏛᎩᏅᏏᏛ.
\ft But all these things will they do unto you for my name's sake, because they know not him that sent me.

\ln Iyuno nagilutsvna ale nigatsiwonetanvna yigesei, vtla asgani yigvwanehei; gohisgini vtla yuneha unutlvdodi unisganvtsvi.
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᎾᎩᎷᏨᎾ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏥᏬᏁᏔᏅᎾ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᏱᎬᏩᏁᎮᎢ; ᎪᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎥᏝ ᏳᏁᎭ ᎤᏄᏢᏙᏗ ᎤᏂᏍᎦᏅᏨᎢ.
\ft If I had not come and spoken unto them, they had not had sin: but now they have no cloke for their sin.

\ln Nasgi na agisgagi ayv, nasquo asgagiyu geso Edoda.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᎩᏍᎦᎩ ᎠᏴ, ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏍᎦᎩᏳ ᎨᏐ ᎡᏙᏓ.
\ft He that hateth me hateth my Father also.

\ln Iyuno anehv nidagilvwisdanehvna yigesei gilo tsulvwisdanelvhi nigesvna tsigi, vtla asgani yigvwanehei; aseno hnaquo itsula goginigohv ale goginisgagiyu nulistanv itsula ayv Edodano.
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᎠᏁᎲ ᏂᏓᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎾ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ ᎩᎶ ᏧᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏥᎩ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᏱᎬᏩᏁᎮᎢ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎿᏉ ᎢᏧᎳ ᎪᎩᏂᎪᎲ ᎠᎴ ᎪᎩᏂᏍᎦᎩᏳ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ ᎢᏧᎳ ᎠᏴ ᎡᏙᏓᏃ.
\ft If I had not done among them the works which none other man did, they had not had sin: but now have they both seen and hated both me and my Father.

\ln Aseno [nasgi nulistanvgi] udohiyudiyi ayelvsv ulinetsv hia tsinigvnv tsigowela tsunikahnawadvsdiyi; "Asequo gvgisgagvgi."
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎩdata is invalid ᎤᏙᎯᏳᏗᏱ ᎠᏰᎸᏒ ᎤᎵᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᎬᏅ ᏥᎪᏪᎳ ᏧᏂᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗᏱ; data is invalidᎠᏎᏉ ᎬᎩᏍᎦᎬᎩ.data is invalid
\ft But this cometh to pass, that the word might be fulfilled that is written in their law, They hated me without a cause.

\ln Aseno adanvwohisdisgi galutsvha, nasgi Agayvligesdvyi nvdatsinvsdi tsigi nihi itsilutsediyi, gayegogi nigesvna Adanvdo agayvligesdvyi nvdvdalehvsgi, nasgi dvginoheli gvnigesv nvdvquvneli.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᏓᏅᏬᎯᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᎦᎷᏨᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᏍᏛᏱ ᏅᏓᏥᏅᏍᏗ ᏥᎩ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏥᎷᏤᏗᏱ, ᎦᏰᎪᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᏍᏛᏱ ᏅᏛᏓᎴᎲᏍᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏛᎩᏃᎮᎵ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏅᏛᏋᏁᎵ.
\ft But when the Comforter is come, whom I will send unto you from the Father, even the Spirit of truth, which proceedeth from the Father, he shall testify of me:

\ln Nihino nasquo itsinohesgi gesesdi, itsulahayeno ideda didalenisgv nvdagvwadalenvdv.
\syll ᏂᎯᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎢᏥᏃᎮᏍᎩ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎢᏧᎳᎭᏰᏃ ᎢᏕᏓ ᏗᏓᎴᏂᏍᎬ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏓᎴᏅᏛ.
\ft And ye also shall bear witness, because ye have been with me from the beginning.

\ln Nasgi hia nusdi itsvnohehelv, ditsodesdiyi nigesvna.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏍᏗ ᎢᏨᏃᎮᎮᎸ, ᏗᏦᏕᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.
\ft These things have I spoken unto you, that ye should not be offended.

\ln Digalawiisdiyi dayetsinugowisi; vv, dvsqualvhi, gilo itsihihesdi, Unelanvhi nitsiyadvneha, elisgesdi.
\syll ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᏓᏰᏥᏄᎪᏫᏏ; ᎥᎥ, ᏛᏍᏆᎸᎯ, ᎩᎶ ᎢᏥᎯᎮᏍᏗ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏂᏥᏯᏛᏁᎭ, ᎡᎵᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
\ft They shall put you out of the synagogues: yea, the time cometh, that whosoever killeth you will think that he doeth God service.

\ln Nasgi hia nanadvnehesdi nvdigalisdodisgesdi nanigatahvna gesv Agayvligei, ale ayv nigvgigatahvna gesvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎾᎾᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎾᏂᎦᏔᎲᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴ ᏂᎬᎩᎦᏔᎲᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft And these things will they do unto you, because they have not known the Father, nor me.

\ln Aseno nasgi hia nusdi itsvnohvsi, asqualvhv itsanvdadisdiyi nasgi itsvnonelvi.  Ale vtla nasgi igvyiyiquo yitsvnonelei, itsulaha idedohv nvdagalisdodisgvgi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏍᏗ ᎢᏨᏃᎲᏏ, ᎠᏍᏆᎸᎲ ᎢᏣᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏨᏃᏁᎸᎢ.  ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎬᏱᏱᏉ ᏱᏨᏃᏁᎴᎢ, ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎢᏕᏙᎲ ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬᎩ.
\ft But these things have I told you, that when the time shall come, ye may remember that I told you of them. And these things I said not unto you at the beginning, because I was with you.

\ln Hnaquono nvdvginvsidv tsuwolv witsigati, vtlano gilo nihi nitsadvnv yudasuya yaquadvdvhvsga, hia yinigawe; Hatlv wigati?
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏅᏛᎩᏅᏏᏛ ᏧᏬᎸ ᏫᏥᎦᏘ, ᎥᏝᏃ ᎩᎶ ᏂᎯ ᏂᏣᏛᏅ ᏳᏓᏑᏯ ᏯᏆᏛᏛᎲᏍᎦ, ᎯᎠ ᏱᏂᎦᏪ; ᎭᏢ ᏫᎦᏘ?
\ft But now I go my way to him that sent me; and none of you asketh me, Whither goest thou?

\ln Aseno nasgi nitsvweselv nvdigalisdodiha, uyo adanvdadisdi gesv ukalilv itsinawi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎸ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ, ᎤᏲ ᎠᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎧᎵᎸ ᎢᏥᎾᏫ.
\ft But because I have said these things unto you, sorrow hath filled your heart.

\ln Aseno udohiyuhiya itsvnoneha; osiyu itsalisdanedi tsvdagesi; iyuyeno naquenvsvna yigi, adanvwohisdisgi vtla yvgetsilutsisi; yaquenvsgini nvdatsinvsdi gesesdi itsilutsediyi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎢᏨᏃᏁᎭ; ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᏨᏓᎨᏏ; ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᎾᏇᏅᏒᎾ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᏓᏅᏬᎯᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᎥᏝ ᏴᎨᏥᎷᏥᏏ; ᏯᏇᏅᏍᎩᏂ ᏅᏓᏥᏅᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎢᏥᎷᏤᏗᏱ.
\ft Nevertheless I tell you the truth; It is expedient for you that I go away: for if I go not away, the Comforter will not come unto you; but if I depart, I will send him unto you.

\ln Nasgino galutsvha gvnigesv nvdagvneli elohi asgani gesvi, ale duyugodv gesvi, ale digugododi gesvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎦᎷᏨᎭ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏅᏓᎬᏁᎵ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎫᎪᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft And when he is come, he will reprove the world of sin, and of righteousness, and of judgment:

\ln Asgani gesvi, nigvquohiyuhvsgvna gesv iyusdi;
\syll ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏂᎬᏉᎯᏳᎲᏍᎬᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ;
\ft Of sin, because they believe not on me;

\ln Duyugodv gesvi, Edodoyi witsigadvi, ale hnaquo nisgigowatisgvna gesv iyusdi;
\syll ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎡᏙᏙᏱ ᏫᏥᎦᏛᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎿᏉ ᏂᏍᎩᎪᏩᏘᏍᎬᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ;
\ft Of righteousness, because I go to my Father, and ye see me no more;

\ln Digugododi gesvi, ugvwiyuhi hia elohi utseliga tsagugodanedi gesv iyusdi.
\syll ᏗᎫᎪᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎯᎠ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᏣᎫᎪᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ.
\ft Of judgment, because the prince of this world is judged.

\ln Asi utsata agilula gohusdi itsvnonedi, aseno gohi gesv vtla yeli nasgi getsadvgodi yigi;
\syll ᎠᏏ ᎤᏣᏔ ᎠᎩᎷᎳ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎢᏨᏃᏁᏗ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎥᏝ ᏰᎵ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᏣᏛᎪᏗ ᏱᎩ;
\ft I have yet many things to say unto you, but ye cannot bear them now.

\ln Galutsvhasgini nasgi na gayegogi nigesvna Adanvdo, nigav udohiyuhi gesv dodatsatinidoli, vtlayeno uwasvquo udanvtedv yikanegesdi, nigavsgini advgisgesdi nasgi kanegesdi; Ale datsinanugowiseli tsudalenvdv oni iyulistanidasdi gesvi.
\syll ᎦᎷᏨᎭᏍᎩᏂ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎦᏰᎪᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ, ᏂᎦᎥ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏙᏓᏣᏘᏂᏙᎵ, ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᎤᏩᏒᏉ ᎤᏓᏅᏖᏛ ᏱᎧᏁᎨᏍᏗ, ᏂᎦᎥᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏛᎩᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎧᏁᎨᏍᏗ; ᎠᎴ ᏓᏥᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᎵ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎣᏂ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏔᏂᏓᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Howbeit when he, the Spirit of truth, is come, he will guide you into all truth: for he shall not speak of himself; but whatsoever he shall hear, that shall he speak: and he will shew you things to come.

\ln Nasgi dvgilvquotani ayv, aquatseliyeno gesv dvgisi ale datsinanugowiseli.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏛᎩᎸᏉᏔᏂ ᎠᏴ, ᎠᏆᏤᎵᏰᏃ ᎨᏒ ᏛᎩᏏ ᎠᎴ ᏓᏥᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᎵ.
\ft He shall glorify me: for he shall receive of mine, and shall shew it unto you.

\ln Nigav Agayvlige uhv aquatseliga, nasgi iyusdi hia tsinitsiwi, aquatseliga gesv dvgisi ale datsinanugowiseli.
\syll ᏂᎦᎥ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᎤᎲ ᎠᏆᏤᎵᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᏥᏫ, ᎠᏆᏤᎵᎦ ᎨᏒ ᏛᎩᏏ ᎠᎴ ᏓᏥᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᎵ.
\ft All things that the Father hath are mine: therefore said I, that he shall take of mine, and shall shew it unto you.

\ln Nigohilvnaquo hnaquo vtla yisgigowatisgesdi; ale hnaquo taline nigohilvnaquo isgigowatisgesdi; nvdigalisdodiha Agayvligesdvyi witsigadvi.
\syll ᏂᎪᎯᎸᎾᏉ ᎿᏉ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏍᎩᎪᏩᏘᏍᎨᏍᏗ; ᎠᎴ ᎿᏉ ᏔᎵᏁ ᏂᎪᎯᎸᎾᏉ ᎢᏍᎩᎪᏩᏘᏍᎨᏍᏗ; ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᏍᏛᏱ ᏫᏥᎦᏛᎢ.
\ft A little while, and ye shall not see me: and again, a little while, and ye shall see me, because I go to the Father.

\ln Hnaquono igadv gvwasdawadidohi hia nidunadaweselvgi; Gado gadvga hia tsinigiweseha; Nigohilvnaquo hnaquo vtla yisgigowatisgesdi, ale hnaquo taline nigohilvnaquo isgigowatisgesdi?  ale Nvdigalisdodiha Agayvligesdvyi witsigadvi?
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎢᎦᏛ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᎾᏓᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎦᏙ ᎦᏛᎦ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᎩᏪᏎᎭ; ᏂᎪᎯᎸᎾᏉ ᎿᏉ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏍᎩᎪᏩᏘᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎿᏉ ᏔᎵᏁ ᏂᎪᎯᎸᎾᏉ ᎢᏍᎩᎪᏩᏘᏍᎨᏍᏗ?  ᎠᎴ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᏍᏛᏱ ᏫᏥᎦᏛᎢ?
\ft Then said some of his disciples among themselves, What is this that he saith unto us, A little while, and ye shall not see me: and again, a little while, and ye shall see me: and, Because I go to the Father?

\ln Nasgi iyusdi hia nuniwesvgi, Gado gadvga Nigohilvnaquo tsadiha?  Vtla yotsoliga nusdv gadvgvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ, ᎦᏙ ᎦᏛᎦ ᏂᎪᎯᎸᎾᏉ ᏣᏗᎭ?  ᎥᏝ ᏲᏦᎵᎦ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎦᏛᎬᎢ.
\ft They said therefore, What is this that he saith, A little while? we cannot tell what he saith.

\ln Tsisano agatahvgi unadulisgv gvwadvdvdiyi, Hiano niduweselvgi; tsigodetsadadvdvhvsga gadvgvi hia tsinagiwesvgi; nigohilvnaquo hnaquo vtla yisgigowatisgesdi, ale hnaquo taline nigohilvnaquo isgigowatisgesdi?
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᎠᎦᏔᎲᎩ ᎤᎾᏚᎵᏍᎬ ᎬᏩᏛᏛᏗᏱ, ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏥᎪᏕᏣᏓᏛᏛᎲᏍᎦ ᎦᏛᎬᎢ ᎯᎠ ᏥᎾᎩᏪᏒᎩ; ᏂᎪᎯᎸᎾᏉ ᎿᏉ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏍᎩᎪᏩᏘᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎿᏉ ᏔᎵᏁ ᏂᎪᎯᎸᎾᏉ ᎢᏍᎩᎪᏩᏘᏍᎨᏍᏗ?
\ft Now Jesus knew that they were desirous to ask him, and said unto them, Do ye inquire among yourselves of that I said, A little while, and ye shall not see me: and again, a little while, and ye shall see me?

\ln Udohiyuhiya udohiyuhiya hia nitsvweseha; nihi detsiyvgesdi ale itsisgonihesdi, elohisgini aliheligesdi; nihino uyo itsadanvtesdi, aseno uyo itsadanvdv ulihelisdi wvdvdanetliyvstani.
\syll ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ; ᏂᎯ ᏕᏥᏴᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏥᏍᎪᏂᎮᏍᏗ, ᎡᎶᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᎵᎮᎵᎨᏍᏗ; ᏂᎯᏃ ᎤᏲ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏖᏍᏗ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏲ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏛ ᎤᎵᎮᎵᏍᏗ ᏮᏛᏓᏁᏟᏴᏍᏔᏂ.
\ft Verily, verily, I say unto you, That ye shall weep and lament, but the world shall rejoice: and ye shall be sorrowful, but your sorrow shall be turned into joy.

\ln Ageyv uyo udanvdo tsadehvsgo ayoli, usqualvelv nvdigalisdodisgoi; aseno hnaquo gananugowa ayoli, vtla hnaquo yanvdadisgo ehisdi udanvdadvi, nvdigalisdodisgo aliheligv yvwi unanugowisv svlohi.
\syll ᎠᎨᏴ ᎤᏲ ᎤᏓᏅᏙ ᏣᏕᎲᏍᎪ ᎠᏲᎵ, ᎤᏍᏆᎸᎡᎸ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎪᎢ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎿᏉ ᎦᎾᏄᎪᏩ ᎠᏲᎵ, ᎥᏝ ᎿᏉ ᏯᏅᏓᏗᏍᎪ ᎡᎯᏍᏗ ᎤᏓᏅᏓᏛᎢ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎪ ᎠᎵᎮᎵᎬ ᏴᏫ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏫᏒ ᏒᎶᎯ.
\ft A woman when she is in travail hath sorrow, because her hour is come: but as soon as she is delivered of the child, she remembereth no more the anguish, for joy that a man is born into the world.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi nihi gohi gesv uyo itsadanvta; aseno taline dvtsvgoi, ale itsinawi dvlihelitsi, itsaliheligvno vtla gilo yvgetsigisi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏂᎯ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏲ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏔ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᏔᎵᏁ ᏛᏨᎪᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏥᎾᏫ ᏛᎵᎮᎵᏥ, ᎢᏣᎵᎮᎵᎬᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᏴᎨᏥᎩᏏ.
\ft And ye now therefore have sorrow: but I will see you again, and your heart shall rejoice, and your joy no man taketh from you.

\ln Nahiyuno iga vtla gohusdi yisgiyadvdvhvsgesdi.  Udohiyuhiya udohiyuhiya hia nitsvweseha; Nigav gohusdi Agayvlige etsitayosehesdi, daquadov itsvdisgesdi, ase etsinedi gesesdi.
\syll ᏀᎢᏳᏃ ᎢᎦ ᎥᏝ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏱᏍᎩᏯᏛᏛᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ.  ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ; ᏂᎦᎥ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᎡᏥᏔᏲᏎᎮᏍᏗ, ᏓᏆᏙᎥ ᎢᏨᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᏎ ᎡᏥᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft And in that day ye shall ask me nothing. Verily, verily, I say unto you, Whatsoever ye shall ask the Father in my name, he will give it you.

\ln Gohi iyasdi vtla gohusdi yitsitayostano ayv daquodovi.  Itsitayoha dayetsinelino, itsaliheligv ukaliisdiyi.
\syll ᎪᎯ ᎢᏯᏍᏗ ᎥᏝ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏱᏥᏔᏲᏍᏔᏃ ᎠᏴ ᏓᏉᏙᎥᎢ.  ᎢᏥᏔᏲᎭ ᏓᏰᏥᏁᎵᏃ, ᎢᏣᎵᎮᎵᎬ ᎤᎧᎵᎢᏍᏗᏱ.
\ft Hitherto have ye asked nothing in my name: ask, and ye shall receive, that your joy may be full.

\ln Nasgi hia nusdi itsvnohehelv utsosdi golisdiyi aquvtanv; aseno dvsqualvhi hnaquo vtla yitsvyalinohedisgesdi utsosdi golisdiyi gvdi, gvnigesviyusgini datsvnanugowiseli Agayvligei.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏍᏗ ᎢᏨᏃᎮᎮᎸ ᎤᏦᏍᏗ ᎪᎵᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᏋᏔᏅ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᏛᏍᏆᎸᎯ ᎿᏉ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏨᏯᎵᏃᎮᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᏦᏍᏗ ᎪᎵᏍᏗᏱ ᎬᏗ, ᎬᏂᎨᏒᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᏓᏨᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᎵ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ.
\ft These things have I spoken unto you in proverbs: but the time cometh, when I shall no more speak unto you in proverbs, but I shall shew you plainly of the Father.

\ln Nahiyu iga daquadov itsitayosdisgesdi; vtlano Agayvlige datsiyadadolisdaneli nihi itsisdelvdiyi yitsvyoseha;
\syll ᏀᎢᏳ ᎢᎦ ᏓᏆᏙᎥ ᎢᏥᏔᏲᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ; ᎥᏝᏃ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᏓᏥᏯᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎵ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏥᏍᏕᎸᏗᏱ ᏱᏨᏲᏎᎭ;
\ft At that day ye shall ask in my name: and I say not unto you, that I will pray the Father for you:

\ln Agayvligeyeno uwasv itsigeyuha, nvdigalisdodiha sgigeyuiyu gesvi, ale itsohiyunv Unelanvhiyi nvdvquadalenvhi gesvi.
\syll ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᏰᏃ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎢᏥᎨᏳᎭ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᏍᎩᎨᏳᎢᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏦᎯᏳᏅ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏱ ᏅᏛᏆᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft For the Father himself loveth you, because ye have loved me, and have believed that I came out from God.

\ln Agayvligesdvyi diquadalenv, elohi agilutsilv; taline elohi dvgadanvsi, Agayvligesdvyi wvdvtsilosi.
\syll ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᏍᏛᏱ ᏗᏆᏓᎴᏅ, ᎡᎶᎯ ᎠᎩᎷᏥᎸ; ᏔᎵᏁ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏛᎦᏓᏅᏏ, ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᏍᏛᏱ ᏮᏛᏥᎶᏏ.
\ft I came forth from the Father, and am come into the world: again, I leave the world, and go to the Father.

\ln Gvwasdawadidohi hia nvgvwaweselvgi; Gvniyuquo hnaquo gvnigesviyu hinega, vtlano utsosdi golisdiyi yinega.
\syll ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎯᎠ ᏅᎬᏩᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎿᏉ ᎬᏂᎨᏒᎢᏳ ᎯᏁᎦ, ᎥᏝᏃ ᎤᏦᏍᏗ ᎪᎵᏍᏗᏱ ᏱᏁᎦ.
\ft His disciples said unto him, Lo, now speakest thou plainly, and speakest no proverb.

\ln Hnaquo otsigataha nigav gohusdi higatahiyu gesvi, ale asequoquo gesv gilo yitsvdvdvhvsga.  Nasgi udigalisdodiha otsohiyuhvsga Unelanvhiyi nvdatsadalenvhi gesvi.
\syll ᎿᏉ ᎣᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎯᎦᏔᎯᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏎᏉᏉ ᎨᏒ ᎩᎶ ᏱᏨᏛᏛᎲᏍᎦ.  ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎣᏦᎯᏳᎲᏍᎦ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏱ ᏅᏓᏣᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Now are we sure that thou knowest all things, and needest not that any man should ask thee: by this we believe that thou camest forth from God.

\ln Tsisa hia niduweselvgi; Tsigo hnaquo itsohiyuhvsga?
\syll ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏥᎪ ᎿᏉ ᎢᏦᎯᏳᎲᏍᎦ?
\ft Jesus answered them, Do ye now believe?

\ln Gvniyuquo dvsqualvhi, vv, hnaquousqualvhv, itsadigaleyoisdiyi, nitsiv itsisiyvwiha doditsenvsv iditlv, ale dasgiyvdetsi aquvsvquo gesesdi; vtlasgininonv aquve yigi, Agayvligeyeno tali nvdvdidega.
\syll ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᏛᏍᏆᎸᎯ, ᎥᎥ, ᎿᏉᎤᏍᏆᎸᎲ, ᎢᏣᏗᎦᎴᏲᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᏂᏥᎥ ᎢᏥᏏᏴᏫᎭ ᏙᏗᏤᏅᏒ ᎢᏗᏢ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᏍᎩᏴᏕᏥ ᎠᏋᏒᏉ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᎥᏝᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎠᏋᎡ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᏰᏃ ᏔᎵ ᏅᏛᏗᏕᎦ.
\ft Behold, the hour cometh, yea, is now come, that ye shall be scattered, every man to his own, and shall leave me alone: and yet I am not alone, because the Father is with me.

\ln Nasgi nusdi hia itsvnohehelv ayv nvwadohiyadv itsvyadanvdadisdodiyi.  Elohi udeyadodi datsiwadvhi; aseno ugalisdiquo itsadanvtesdi; ayv tsisegogisv elohi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏗ ᎯᎠ ᎢᏨᏃᎮᎮᎸ ᎠᏴ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᎢᏨᏯᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏙᏗᏱ.  ᎡᎶᎯ ᎤᏕᏯᏙᏗ ᏓᏥᏩᏛᎯ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᎦᎵᏍᏗᏉ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏖᏍᏗ; ᎠᏴ ᏥᏎᎪᎩᏒ ᎡᎶᎯ.
\ft These things I have spoken unto you, that in me ye might have peace. In the world ye shall have tribulation: but be of good cheer; I have overcome the world.

\ln Nasgi hia nuwesvgi Tsisa, ale dusaladanvgi digadoli galvladi widukahnanvgi, hia nuwesvgi; Edoda, hnaquo usqualvhv; hilvquoda Tsetsi, Tsetsi nasquo nihi tsalvquododiyi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ ᏥᏌ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏌᎳᏓᏅᎩ ᏗᎦᏙᎵ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏫᏚᎧᎿᏅᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎡᏙᏓ, ᎿᏉ ᎤᏍᏆᎸᎲ; ᎯᎸᏉᏓ ᏤᏥ, ᏤᏥ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏂᎯ ᏣᎸᏉᏙᏗᏱ.
\ft These words spake Jesus, and lifted up his eyes to heaven, and said, Father, the hour is come; glorify thy Son, that thy Son also may glorify thee:

\ln Hiyalisgolvdanelvyeno nigav uquedali, tsunediyi nalisquadisgvna gvnidv naniv tekanelvhi gesvi.
\syll ᎯᏯᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᎸᏰᏃ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ, ᏧᏁᏗᏱ ᎾᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᎬᎾ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏖᎧᏁᎸᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft As thou hast given him power over all flesh, that he should give eternal life to as many as thou hast given him.

\ln Hiano nasgi nusdi gvnidv nalisquadisgvnanasgi getsagadovhisdiyi nihi tsvsvhiyu udohiyusv Tsanelanvhi, ale unigadovhisdiyi Tsisa Galonedv nasgi na hinvsidv tsigi.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏗ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎾᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᎬᎾᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᏣᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎯ ᏨᏒᎯᏳ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᏒ ᏣᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎯᏅᏏᏛ ᏥᎩ.
\ft And this is life eternal, that they might know thee the only true God, and Jesus Christ, whom thou hast sent.

\ln Gvlvquotanv elohi; agisquadv digalvwisdanedi sginelvhi tsigi digilvwisdanediyi.
\syll ᎬᎸᏉᏔᏅ ᎡᎶᎯ; ᎠᎩᏍᏆᏛ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᏍᎩᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ ᏗᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ.
\ft I have glorified thee on the earth: I have finished the work which thou gavest me to do.

\ln Hnaquono, nihi Edoda, sgilvquoda tsvsv ditsolvi, nasgiya vgilvquodiyu tsigesvgi ditsolv asiquo nigvnadv nadalenisgvna tsigesvgi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ, ᏂᎯ ᎡᏙᏓ, ᏍᎩᎸᏉᏓ ᏨᏒ ᏗᏦᎸᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎥᎩᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᏥᎨᏒᎩ ᏗᏦᎸ ᎠᏏᏉ ᏂᎬᎾᏛ ᎾᏓᎴᏂᏍᎬᎾ ᏥᎨᏒᎩ.
\ft And now, O Father, glorify thou me with thine own self with the glory which I had with thee before the world was.

\ln Detsadov gvnigesv nigatsiyvnelv anisgaya elohi tasuyedv disgikanelvhi tsigi.  Ditsatseliga gesvgi, ale desgikanelvgi; ale unisquanigotanv kanohedv tsatseliga.
\syll ᏕᏣᏙᎥ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᎦᏥᏴᏁᎸ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏔᏑᏰᏛ ᏗᏍᎩᎧᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ.  ᏗᏣᏤᎵᎦ ᎨᏒᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᏍᎩᎧᏁᎸᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏔᏅ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏣᏤᎵᎦ.
\ft I have manifested thy name unto the men which thou gavest me out of the world: thine they were, and thou gavest them me; and they have kept thy word.

\ln Hnaquono anigatahiyu nulistanv, nigav gohusdi sginelvhi tsigi, nihi nvdayudalehvhi gesvi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎯᏳ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ, ᏂᎦᎥ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏍᎩᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᏂᎯ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᎲᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Now they have known that all things whatsoever thou hast given me are of thee.

\ln Detsinelvyeno kanohedv nasgi sginelvhi tsigi; ale nasgi dunadanilvtsv, ale unigadovsv udohiyusv nihi tehv nvdvquadalenvhi gesvi; ale unohiyunv nihi nvdasginvsidv gesvi.
\syll ᏕᏥᏁᎸᏰᏃ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏍᎩᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᎾᏓᏂᎸᏨ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᎦᏙᎥᏒ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᏒ ᏂᎯ ᏖᎲ ᏅᏛᏆᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᏃᎯᏳᏅ ᏂᎯ ᏅᏓᏍᎩᏅᏏᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft For I have given unto them the words which thou gavest me; and they have received them, and have known surely that I came out from thee, and they have believed that thou didst send me.

\ln Nasgi gatsiyadadolisdaneha; vtla elohi yitsiyadadolisdaneha, nasgiquosgini na disgikanelvhi tsigi; nihiyeno ditsatseliga.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏥᏯᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎭ; ᎥᏝ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏱᏥᏯᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩᏉᏍᎩᏂ Ꮎ ᏗᏍᎩᎧᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ; ᏂᎯᏰᏃ ᏗᏣᏤᎵᎦ.
\ft I pray for them: I pray not for the world, but for them which thou hast given me; for they are thine.

\ln Nigadvno aquatseliga nihi tsatseliga, nihino tsatseliga ayv aquatseliga; ale nasgi nvdigalisdodiha vgilvquodiha.
\syll ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᎠᏆᏤᎵᎦ ᏂᎯ ᏣᏤᎵᎦ, ᏂᎯᏃ ᏣᏤᎵᎦ ᎠᏴ ᎠᏆᏤᎵᎦ; ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎥᎩᎸᏉᏗᎭ.
\ft And all mine are thine, and thine are mine; and I am glorified in them.

\ln Hnaquono ayv vtla elohi yigea, hiasgini elohi aneha, ayvno ditsolv witsigati.  Etsalvquodiyu Edoda, tsvsv detsadov hvdisgesdi dehisquanigodesdi disgikanelvhi, saquoquo iyunalisdodiyi, nasgiya nihi ayvno saquoquo tsigi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎠᏴ ᎥᏝ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏱᎨᎠ, ᎯᎠᏍᎩᏂ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎠᏁᎭ, ᎠᏴᏃ ᏗᏦᎸ ᏫᏥᎦᏘ.  ᎡᏣᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎡᏙᏓ, ᏨᏒ ᏕᏣᏙᎥ ᎲᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏕᎯᏍᏆᏂᎪᏕᏍᏗ ᏗᏍᎩᎧᏁᎸᎯ, ᏌᏉᏉ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏂᎯ ᎠᏴᏃ ᏌᏉᏉ ᏥᎩ.
\ft And now I am no more in the world, but these are in the world, and I come to thee. Holy Father, keep through thine own name those whom thou hast given me, that they may be one, as we are.

\ln Asi elohi tsigatsiyeladidohvgi, detsadov detsisquanigododvgi; nasgi disgikanelvhi gatsisquanigotanv, ale vtla asiyvwi yuyohusv na uwasv ayohuhisdi uwetsi, udohiyudiyi gowelvi.
\syll ᎠᏏ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏥᎦᏥᏰᎳᏗᏙᎲᎩ, ᏕᏣᏙᎥ ᏕᏥᏍᏆᏂᎪᏙᏛᎩ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏍᎩᎧᏁᎸᎯ ᎦᏥᏍᏆᏂᎪᏔᏅ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᏳᏲᎱᏒ Ꮎ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎤᏪᏥ, ᎤᏙᎯᏳᏗᏱ ᎪᏪᎸᎢ.
\ft While I was with them in the world, I kept them in thy name: those that thou gavest me I have kept, and none of them is lost, but the son of perdition; that the scripture might be fulfilled.

\ln Hnaquono ditsolv witsigati, nasgino hia nitsiwea ani elohi, gvquoliheligv unikaliisdiyi unadanvdvi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏗᏦᎸ ᏫᏥᎦᏘ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏥᏪᎠ ᎠᏂ ᎡᎶᎯ, ᎬᏉᎵᎮᎵᎬ ᎤᏂᎧᎵᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏛᎢ.
\ft And now come I to thee; and these things I speak in the world, that they might have my joy fulfilled in themselves.

\ln Detsinelv kanohedv tsatseliga; elohino disgagiyu nulistanv, elohi anehi nigesvna gesv iyusdi, nasgiya ayv elohi gei nigesvna tsigi.
\syll ᏕᏥᏁᎸ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏣᏤᎵᎦ; ᎡᎶᎯᏃ ᏗᏍᎦᎩᏳ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ, ᎡᎶᎯ ᎠᏁᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎠᏴ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎨᎢ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏥᎩ.
\ft I have given them thy word; and the world hath hated them, because they are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.

\ln Vtla elohi dikahvsdiyi yitsitayohiha, tiyosdodanediyiquosgini uyo gesvi.
\syll ᎥᏝ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏗᎧᎲᏍᏗᏱ ᏱᏥᏔᏲᎯᎭ, ᏘᏲᏍᏙᏓᏁᏗᏱᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏲ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft I pray not that thou shouldest take them out of the world, but that thou shouldest keep them from the evil.

\ln Vtla elohi anehi yigi, nasgiya ayv elohi gei nigesvna tsigi.
\syll ᎥᏝ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎠᏁᎯ ᏱᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎠᏴ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎨᎢ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏥᎩ.
\ft They are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.

\ln Gayegogi nigesvna tsatseliga tenvgalvda; kanohedv tsatseliga nasgi gayegogi nigesvna.
\syll ᎦᏰᎪᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏣᏤᎵᎦ ᏖᏅᎦᎸᏓ; ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏣᏤᎵᎦ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏰᎪᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.
\ft Sanctify them through thy truth: thy word is truth.

\ln Nihi elohi agiluhisdiyi sginvsidv tsigi, nasgiya nasquo ayv elohi gatsinvli nasgi.
\syll ᏂᎯ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎠᎩᎷᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏍᎩᏅᏏᏛ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏴ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎦᏥᏅᎵ ᎾᏍᎩ.
\ft As thou hast sent me into the world, even so have I also sent them into the world.

\ln Ale nasgi hia gesv nvdigalisdodiha gadanvgalia, nasquo unvsv gayegogi nigesvna unahnanvgalvdodiyi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎦᏓᏅᎦᎵᎠ, ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᏅᏒ ᎦᏰᎪᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎤᏀᎾᏅᎦᎸᏙᏗᏱ.
\ft And for their sakes I sanctify myself, that they also might be sanctified through the truth.

\ln Ale vtla hiaquo na unvsv yigatsiyadadolisdaneha, nasquosgini na analitsidohvsgv gvquohiyuhvsgi iyulisdodi tsigi gatsiyadadolisdaneha;
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᎯᎠᏉ Ꮎ ᎤᏅᏒ ᏱᎦᏥᏯᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎭ, ᎾᏍᏉᏍᎩᏂ Ꮎ ᎠᎾᎵᏥᏙᎲᏍᎬ ᎬᏉᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᏥᎩ ᎦᏥᏯᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎭ;
\ft Neither pray I for these alone, but for them also which shall believe on me through their word;

\ln Nasgi nigadv saquoquo iyunalisdodiyi, nasgiya nihi Edoda tsisgiyaa, ale ayv tsigvyaa, nasgi nasquo saquoquo igalisdodiyi; nasgino elohi uwohiyudiyi nihi nvdasginvsidv gesvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏌᏉᏉ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏂᎯ ᎡᏙᏓ ᏥᏍᎩᏯᎠ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴ ᏥᎬᏯᎠ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏌᏉᏉ ᎢᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ; ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎤᏬᎯᏳᏗᏱ ᏂᎯ ᏅᏓᏍᎩᏅᏏᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft That they all may be one; as thou, Father, art in me, and I in thee, that they also may be one in us: that the world may believe that thou hast sent me.

\ln Ale nasgi vgilvquododi gesv nihi sginelvhi tsigi, nasgi gatsinelv, saquo iyunalisdodiyi, nasgiya nihi ayvno saquoquo tsigi;
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎥᎩᎸᏉᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏂᎯ ᏍᎩᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏥᏁᎸ, ᏌᏉ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏂᎯ ᎠᏴᏃ ᏌᏉᏉ ᏥᎩ;
\ft And the glory which thou gavest me I have given them; that they may be one, even as we are one:

\ln Ayv nasgi gatsiyavi, ale nihi ayv sgiyavi, nasgi tsuyugodiya saquoquo iyunalisdodiyi, nasgino elohi ugadovhisdiyi nvdasginvsidv gesvi, ale nasgi tigeyuhiyu gesvi, nasgiya sgigeyuiyu tsigi.
\syll ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏥᏯᎥᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎯ ᎠᏴ ᏍᎩᏯᎥᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏳᎪᏗᏯ ᏌᏉᏉ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎤᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏅᏓᏍᎩᏅᏏᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏘᎨᏳᎯᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏍᎩᎨᏳᎢᏳ ᏥᎩ.
\ft I in them, and thou in me, that they may be made perfect in one; and that the world may know that thou hast sent me, and hast loved them, as thou hast loved me.

\ln Edoda, aquaduli nasquo disgikanelvhi ayv gevi nasgi itsulaha ogadediyi, nasgino unigowadvdiyi vgilvquodvi, nasgi sginelvhi tsigi; sgigeyuhiyuyeno gesvgi asi elohi nadalenisgvna tsigesvgi.
\syll ᎡᏙᏓ, ᎠᏆᏚᎵ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏗᏍᎩᎧᏁᎸᎯ ᎠᏴ ᎨᎥᎢ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎣᎦᏕᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᏂᎪᏩᏛᏗᏱ ᎥᎩᎸᏉᏛᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏍᎩᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ; ᏍᎩᎨᏳᎯᏳᏰᏃ ᎨᏒᎩ ᎠᏏ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎾᏓᎴᏂᏍᎬᎾ ᏥᎨᏒᎩ.
\ft Father, I will that they also, whom thou hast given me, be with me where I am; that they may behold my glory, which thou hast given me: for thou lovedst me before the foundation of the world.

\ln Tsadanvti Edoda, elohi vtla tsagatahi yigi, ayvsgini gvwatahiyu, ale hia anigatahiyu sginvsidv gesvi.
\syll ᏣᏓᏅᏘ ᎡᏙᏓ, ᎡᎶᎯ ᎥᏝ ᏣᎦᏔᎯ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᏴᏍᎩᏂ ᎬᏩᏔᎯᏳ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎯᏳ ᏍᎩᏅᏏᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft O righteous Father, the world hath not known thee: but I have known thee, and these have known that thou hast sent me.

\ln Ayvno detsadov gatsinanugowiselv, ale ase dagatsinanugowiseli, uneladisdodiyi ayv sgigeyuhiyu gesvi, ale ayv nasgi gatsiyai iyulisdodiyi.
\syll ᎠᏴᏃ ᏕᏣᏙᎥ ᎦᏥᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᎸ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏎ ᏓᎦᏥᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᎵ, ᎤᏁᎳᏗᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎠᏴ ᏍᎩᎨᏳᎯᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏥᏯᎢ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
\ft And I have declared unto them thy name, and will declare it: that the love wherewith thou hast loved me may be in them, and I in them.

\ln Nasgi hia Tsisa nuwesv, gvwasdawadidohi dutinvsvgi, unugotsvgi duwesotsvgi Gitloni uweyvi, nahna awisvdiyi gotlvsvgi, nahna uyvlvgi, ale nasquo gvwasdawadidohi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏌ ᏄᏪᏒ, ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏚᏘᏅᏒᎩ, ᎤᏄᎪᏨᎩ ᏚᏪᏐᏨᎩ ᎩᏠᏂ ᎤᏪᏴᎢ, ᏀᎾ ᎠᏫᏒᏗᏱ ᎪᏢᏒᎩ, ᏀᎾ ᎤᏴᎸᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ.
\ft When Jesus had spoken these words, he went forth with his disciples over the brook Cedron, where was a garden, into the which he entered, and his disciples.

\ln Tsudasino utludisgi nasquo agatahiyu gesvgi nahnani, Tsisayeno ale gvwasdawadidohi yanogiyu nahna danilawigvgi.
\syll ᏧᏓᏏᏃ ᎤᏡᏗᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᎦᏔᎯᏳ ᎨᏒᎩ ᏀᎾᏂ, ᏥᏌᏰᏃ ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏯᏃᎩᏳ ᏀᎾ ᏓᏂᎳᏫᎬᎩ.
\ft And Judas also, which betrayed him, knew the place: for Jesus ofttimes resorted thither with his disciples.

\ln Hnaquono Tsudasi dutinenv sunadatlugi aniyawisgi, ale dinadaniyisgi, nunigvwiyusv atsilvanelohi ale Aniquolisi nvdayunadalenvhi, nahna ulutsvgi, daninehvgi ditsvsdodi ale dilisgasdodoi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏧᏓᏏ ᏚᏘᏁᏅ ᏑᎾᏓᏡᎩ ᎠᏂᏯᏫᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎾᏓᏂᏱᏍᎩ, ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏉᎵᏏ ᏅᏓᏳᎾᏓᎴᏅᎯ, ᏀᎾ ᎤᎷᏨᎩ, ᏓᏂᏁᎲᎩ ᏗᏨᏍᏙᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏙᎢ.
\ft Judas then, having received a band of men and officers from the chief priests and Pharisees, cometh thither with lanterns and torches and weapons.

\ln Tsisano agatahiyu gesv nigav iyulisdanedi gesvi, uwenvsvgi hia winiduweselvgi; Gago etsiyoha?
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᎠᎦᏔᎯᏳ ᎨᏒ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᏪᏅᏒᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏫᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎦᎪ ᎡᏥᏲᎭ?
\ft Jesus therefore, knowing all things that should come upon him, went forth, and said unto them, Whom seek ye?

\ln Hia nvgvwaweselvgi; Tsisa Naselidi ehi.  Tsisa hia niduweselvgi; Ayv nasgi.  Tsudasino nasgi utludisgi nasquo gadogvgi anidonavi.
\syll ᎯᎠ ᏅᎬᏩᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏥᏌ ᎾᏎᎵᏗ ᎡᎯ.  ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᎩ.  ᏧᏓᏏᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏡᏗᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎦᏙᎬᎩ ᎠᏂᏙᎾᎥᎢ.
\ft They answered him, Jesus of Nazareth. Jesus saith unto them, I am he. And Judas also, which betrayed him, stood with them.

\ln Hnaquono, Ayv nasgi, duwoselv, unasinvsvgi, eladi widuninvtsvgi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ, ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᎩ, ᏚᏬᏎᎸ, ᎤᎾᏏᏅᏒᎩ, ᎡᎳᏗ ᏫᏚᏂᏅᏨᎩ.

\ln Hnaquono taline doudvdvnvgi, Gago etsiyoha?  Duweselvgi hiano nuniwesvgi; Tsisa Naselidi ehi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏔᎵᏁ ᏙᎤᏛᏛᏅᎩ, ᎦᎪ ᎡᏥᏲᎭ?  ᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᏥᏌ ᎾᏎᎵᏗ ᎡᎯ.
\ft Then asked he them again, Whom seek ye? And they said, Jesus of Nazareth.

\ln Tsisa hia niduweselvgi, Gayula itsvnonelv ayv nasgi gesvi.  Iyuno ayv sgiyohesdi, hia unanelagi wanadanvna;
\syll ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ, ᎦᏳᎳ ᎢᏨᏃᏁᎸ ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᏒᎢ.  ᎢᏳᏃ ᎠᏴ ᏍᎩᏲᎮᏍᏗ, ᎯᎠ ᎤᎾᏁᎳᎩ ᏩᎾᏓᏅᎾ;
\ft Jesus answered, I have told you that I am he: if therefore ye seek me, let these go their way:

\ln Udohiyudiyi unetsv hia nuwesvi; "Disgikanelvhi vtla asiyvwi sgiyohuselv."
\syll ᎤᏙᎯᏳᏗᏱ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎢ; data is invalidᏗᏍᎩᎧᏁᎸᎯ ᎥᏝ ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᏍᎩᏲᎱᏎᎸ.data is invalid
\ft That the saying might be fulfilled, which he spake, Of them which thou gavest me have I lost none.

\ln Hnaquono Sawani Quida ayelasdiganvhidv ganehvi, ulvhvgi, ale uluyvgi nugvwiyusv atsilvgelohi unvsidasdi, ale nasgi agatisi galeni ulisdestanvgi.  Nasgi atsinvsidasdi Maliga tsudoidv gesvgi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏌᏩᏂ ᏈᏓ ᎠᏰᎳᏍᏗᎦᏅᎯᏛ ᎦᏁᎲᎢ, ᎤᎸᎲᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎷᏴᎩ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸᎨᎶᎯ ᎤᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎦᏘᏏ ᎦᎴᏂ ᎤᎵᏍᏕᏍᏔᏅᎩ.  ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎹᎵᎦ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ ᎨᏒᎩ.
\ft Then Simon Peter having a sword drew it, and smote the high priest's servant, and cut off his right ear. The servant's name was Malchus.

\ln Hnaquono Tsisa hia nuweselvgi Quida; Tsihilada tsatseli ayelasdiganvhidv galadisdiyi; ulisquidi edoda aginelvhi, tlasgo Yvdagaditahi?
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ ᏈᏓ; ᏥᎯᎳᏓ ᏣᏤᎵ ᎠᏰᎳᏍᏗᎦᏅᎯᏛ ᎦᎳᏗᏍᏗᏱ; ᎤᎵᏍᏈᏗ ᎡᏙᏓ ᎠᎩᏁᎸᎯ, ᏝᏍᎪ ᏴᏓᎦᏗᏔᎯ?
\ft Then said Jesus unto Peter, Put up thy sword into the sheath: the cup which my Father hath given me, shall I not drink it?

\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏑᎾᏓᏡᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏯᏫᏍᎩ ᏗᏘᏂᏙᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎾᏓᏂᏱᏍᎩ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᏧᏂᏁᏤᎸᎯ, ᎬᏩᏂᏴᎲᎩ ᏥᏌ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᎸᎸᎩ.
\ft Then the band and the captain and officers of the Jews took Jesus, and bound him,

\ln Ale Ena tsuwolvi igvyi wigvwatinvstanvgi, nasgiyeno Kayiqua uhnatsiyvgi, ale nasgi nugvwiyusv atsilvgelohi gesvgi nahiyu udetiyvsadisvi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎡᎾ ᏧᏬᎸᎢ ᎢᎬᏱ ᏫᎬᏩᏘᏅᏍᏔᏅᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎧᏱᏆ ᎤᎿᏥᏴᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸᎨᎶᎯ ᎨᏒᎩ ᏀᎢᏳ ᎤᏕᏘᏴᏌᏗᏒᎢ.
\ft And led him away to Annas first; for he was father in law to Caiaphas, which was the high priest that same year.

\ln Nasgi hia Kayiqua tsidunetsele Anitsusi, hia tsiniduweselei; utli osiyu igalisdanedi asiyvwi yiduyohuhihalv yvwi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎧᏱᏆ ᏥᏚᏁᏤᎴ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ, ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎤᏟ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᎦᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᏱᏚᏲᎱᎯᎭᎸ ᏴᏫ.
\ft Now Caiaphas was he, which gave counsel to the Jews, that it was expedient that one man should die for the people.

\ln Sawanino Quida usdawadvsvgi Tsisa, ale nasquo nvwadale adasdawadidohi.  Nasgi adasdawadidohi nugvwiyusv atsilvgelohi ugatahi gesvgi; itsulahano Tsisa uniyvlvgi udlanvdvi nugvwiyusv atsilvgelohi ganelvi.
\syll ᏌᏩᏂᏃ ᏈᏓ ᎤᏍᏓᏩᏛᏒᎩ ᏥᏌ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᎠᏓᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ.  ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏓᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸᎨᎶᎯ ᎤᎦᏔᎯ ᎨᏒᎩ; ᎢᏧᎳᎭᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎤᏂᏴᎸᎩ ᎤᏜᏅᏛᎢ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸᎨᎶᎯ ᎦᏁᎸᎢ.
\ft And Simon Peter followed Jesus, and so did another disciple: that disciple was known unto the high priest, and went in with Jesus into the palace of the high priest.

\ln Quidasgini doyiditlvquo galohisdiyi ulenvgi.  Hnaquono nasgi na soi adasdawadidohi, nugvwiyusv atsilvgelohi ugatahi, unugotsvgi, wulinohetanvgi adv galohisdiyi agatiya, ale uyvtanvgi Quida.
\syll ᏈᏓᏍᎩᏂ ᏙᏱᏗᏢᏉ ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᎴᏅᎩ.  ᎿᏉᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏐᎢ ᎠᏓᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ, ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸᎨᎶᎯ ᎤᎦᏔᎯ, ᎤᏄᎪᏨᎩ, ᏭᎵᏃᎮᏔᏅᎩ ᎠᏛ ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᎦᏘᏯ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏴᏔᏅᎩ ᏈᏓ.
\ft But Peter stood at the door without. Then went out that other disciple, which was known unto the high priest, and spake unto her that kept the door, and brought in Peter.

\ln Hnaquono nasgi adv, galohisdiyi agatiya, hia nuweselv Quida; Nihika nasquo hia asgaya hisdawadidohi?  Vtla, udvnvgi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏛ, ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᎦᏘᏯ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸ ᏈᏓ; ᏂᎯᎧ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎯᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ?  ᎥᏝ, ᎤᏛᏅᎩ.
\ft Then saith the damsel that kept the door unto Peter, Art not thou also one of this man's disciples? He saith, I am not.

\ln Getsinvsidasdino ale dinadaniyisgi nahna anadonavgi, kanosga unodotanvhi gesvgi, uyvtlvgiyeno, ale uniganawosgvgi.  Quidano gelvgi gadogvgi ale uganawosgvgi.
\syll ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗᏃ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎾᏓᏂᏱᏍᎩ ᏀᎾ ᎠᎾᏙᎾᎥᎩ, ᎧᏃᏍᎦ ᎤᏃᏙᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒᎩ, ᎤᏴᏢᎩᏰᏃ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᎦᎾᏬᏍᎬᎩ.  ᏈᏓᏃ ᎨᎸᎩ ᎦᏙᎬᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎦᎾᏬᏍᎬᎩ.
\ft And the servants and officers stood there, who had made a fire of coals; for it was cold: and they warmed themselves: and Peter stood with them, and warmed himself.

\ln Hnaquono nugvwiyusv atsilvgelohi udvdvnvgi Tsisa, gvwasdawadidohi ale nusdv dadeyohvsgv ugvwali.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸᎨᎶᎯ ᎤᏛᏛᏅᎩ ᏥᏌ, ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏓᏕᏲᎲᏍᎬ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ.
\ft The high priest then asked Jesus of his disciples, and of his doctrine.

\ln Tsisa hia nuweselvgi; Gvnigesv gatsiwonedisgvgi elohi; yanogiyu degadeyohvsgv digalawiisdiyi degotlvwadisvi, ale udvnvdigalawiisdiyi, nahna Anitsusi nigohilv tsunilawitsohisdiyi tsigi, udelidvno vtla gohusdi aquadvnvhi yigi.
\syll ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎦᏥᏬᏁᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᎡᎶᎯ; ᏯᏃᎩᏳ ᏕᎦᏕᏲᎲᏍᎬ ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᏕᎪᏢᏩᏗᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏛᏅᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᏀᎾ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᏧᏂᎳᏫᏦᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏥᎩ, ᎤᏕᎵᏛᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎠᏆᏛᏅᎯ ᏱᎩ.
\ft Jesus answered him, I spake openly to the world; I ever taught in the synagogue, and in the temple, whither the Jews always resort; and in secret have I said nothing.

\ln Gadono ayv isquadvdvhvsga?  Nasgi na tadvdvhvga unadvganvhi nasgi nigatsiweselvi.  Gvniyuquo anigataha nagiwesvi.
\syll ᎦᏙᏃ ᎠᏴ ᎢᏍᏆᏛᏛᎲᏍᎦ?  ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏔᏛᏛᎲᎦ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᏥᏪᏎᎸᎢ.  ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎭ ᎾᎩᏪᏒᎢ.
\ft Why askest thou me? ask them which heard me, what I have said unto them: behold, they know what I said.

\ln Nasgino nuwesv, asiyvwi didaniyisgi nav gadogi usidvnilvgi Tsisa, hia nuwesvgi; Nasgisgo niwese hinetseha nugvwiyusv atsilvgelohi?
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏄᏪᏒ, ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᏗᏓᏂᏱᏍᎩ ᎾᎥ ᎦᏙᎩ ᎤᏏᏛᏂᎸᎩ ᏥᏌ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎪ ᏂᏪᏎ ᎯᏁᏤᎭ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸᎨᎶᎯ?
\ft And when he had thus spoken, one of the officers which stood by struck Jesus with the palm of his hand, saying, Answerest thou the high priest so?

\ln Tsisa hia nuweselvgi; Iyuno usonv aginetsesdi, nasgi higatahi winigalisda usonv aginetsvi; iyusgini osiyu aginetsesdi, gadono tsisquvniha?
\syll ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᎤᏐᏅ ᎠᎩᏁᏤᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎦᏔᎯ ᏫᏂᎦᎵᏍᏓ ᎤᏐᏅ ᎠᎩᏁᏨᎢ; ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎠᎩᏁᏤᏍᏗ, ᎦᏙᏃ ᏥᏍᏋᏂᎭ?
\ft Jesus answered him, If I have spoken evil, bear witness of the evil: but if well, why smitest thou me?

\ln Enayeno unetsvhi gesvgi agalvidv agatinvsdiyi Kayiqua nugvwiyusv atsilvgelohi tsuwenvsvi.
\syll ᎡᎾᏰᏃ ᎤᏁᏨᎯ ᎨᏒᎩ ᎠᎦᎸᎢᏛ ᎠᎦᏘᏅᏍᏗᏱ ᎧᏱᏆ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸᎨᎶᎯ ᏧᏪᏅᏒᎢ.
\ft Now Annas had sent him bound unto Caiaphas the high priest.

\ln Sawanino Quida gadogvgi uganawosgvgi.  Hnaquono hia nvgvwaweselvgi; Nihika nasquo hia hisdawadidohi?  Udayilvgi, Vtla, udvnvgi.
\syll ᏌᏩᏂᏃ ᏈᏓ ᎦᏙᎬᎩ ᎤᎦᎾᏬᏍᎬᎩ.  ᎿᏉᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏅᎬᏩᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏂᎯᎧ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎯᎠ ᎯᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ?  ᎤᏓᏱᎸᎩ, ᎥᏝ, ᎤᏛᏅᎩ.
\ft And Simon Peter stood and warmed himself. They said therefore unto him, Art not thou also one of his disciples? He denied it, and said, I am not.

\ln Asiyvwi nugvwiyusv atsilvgelohi tsunvsidasdi, gohusdi uwana Quida ulisdesvhi, hia nuweselvgi; Tlasgo yigvgoe tsisdedohvgi awisvdiyi?
\syll ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸᎨᎶᎯ ᏧᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ, ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏩᎾ ᏈᏓ ᎤᎵᏍᏕᏒᎯ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏝᏍᎪ ᏱᎬᎪᎡ ᏥᏍᏕᏙᎲᎩ ᎠᏫᏒᏗᏱ?

\ln Quidano taline udayilvgi.  Gilaquono iyvdv tsataga uyvlasvgi.
\syll ᏈᏓᏃ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎤᏓᏱᎸᎩ.  ᎩᎳᏉᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏣᏔᎦ ᎤᏴᎳᏒᎩ.
\ft Peter then denied again: and immediately the cock crew.

\ln Hnaquo Kayiqua ganelv unatihnawidvhvgi Tsisa, digugododiyi wunatinvstanvgi; ale sunale gesvgi.  Unvsvsgini vtla digugododiyi yunenvsei, gadaha yinotsalisda anelisgvgi, kanohiyegi dilisdayvdiyi tsunalisdayvdiyi uniyelvsvgi.
\syll ᎿᏉ ᎧᏱᏆ ᎦᏁᎸ ᎤᎾᏘᎿᏫᏛᎲᎩ ᏥᏌ, ᏗᎫᎪᏙᏗᏱ ᏭᎾᏘᏅᏍᏔᏅᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᏑᎾᎴ ᎨᏒᎩ.  ᎤᏅᏒᏍᎩᏂ ᎥᏝ ᏗᎫᎪᏙᏗᏱ ᏳᏁᏅᏎᎢ, ᎦᏓᎭ ᏱᏃᏣᎵᏍᏓ ᎠᏁᎵᏍᎬᎩ, ᎧᏃᎯᏰᎩ ᏗᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ ᏧᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ ᎤᏂᏰᎸᏒᎩ.

\ln Qualedino dayunugotsvgi anidonav ulutsvgi, hia nuwesvgi; Gado etsuisdiha hia asgaya?
\syll ᏆᎴᏗᏃ ᏓᏳᏄᎪᏨᎩ ᎠᏂᏙᎾᎥ ᎤᎷᏨᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎦᏙ ᎡᏧᎢᏍᏗᎭ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ?
\ft Pilate then went out unto them, and said, What accusation bring ye against this man?

\ln Uninetsvgi hia ugvwaweselvgi; Iyuno usganvtsvhi nigesvna yigesei vtla yidogetsvyohiselei.
\syll ᎤᏂᏁᏨᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎤᎬᏩᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᎤᏍᎦᏅᏨᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏙᎨᏨᏲᎯᏎᎴᎢ.
\ft They answered and said unto him, If he were not a malefactor, we would not have delivered him up unto thee.

\ln Hnaquono Qualedi hia niduweselvgi; Etsatihnawidv, itsvsv ditsikahnawadvsdi itsvda etsiyilida.  Hnaquono Anitsusi hia nvgvwaweselvgi; Vtla ulinetsvhi yigi yvwi otsihisdiyi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏆᎴᏗ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎡᏣᏘᎿᏫᏛ, ᎢᏨᏒ ᏗᏥᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎢᏨᏓ ᎡᏥᏱᎵᏓ.  ᎿᏉᏃ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎯᎠ ᏅᎬᏩᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎥᏝ ᎤᎵᏁᏨᎯ ᏱᎩ ᏴᏫ ᎣᏥᎯᏍᏗᏱ.
\ft Then said Pilate unto them, Take ye him, and judge him according to your law. The Jews therefore said unto him, It is not lawful for us to put any man to death:

\ln [Nasgi nulistanvgi] udohiyudiyi Tsisa unetsvi, gadvgv iyulisdanediyi uyohuhisdiyi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎩdata is invalid ᎤᏙᎯᏳᏗᏱ ᏥᏌ ᎤᏁᏨᎢ, ᎦᏛᎬ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᎤᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗᏱ.
\ft That the saying of Jesus might be fulfilled, which he spake, signifying what death he should die.

\ln Hnaquono Qualedi taline digugodiyi uyvlvgi, ale Tsisa wuyanvhvgi, hia nuweselvgi, Nihisgo Tsagvwiyuhi Anitsusi unatseliga?
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏆᎴᏗ ᏔᎵᏁ ᏗᎫᎪᏗᏱ ᎤᏴᎸᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᏌ ᏭᏯᏅᎲᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ, ᏂᎯᏍᎪ ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ?
\ft Then Pilate entered into the judgment hall again, and called Jesus, and said unto him, Art thou the King of the Jews?
