\syll ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏥᎪ ᏨᏒ ᏣᏓᏅᏖᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏂᏪᎠ, ᎩᎶᎨ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᏣᏃᎮᎮᎴᎢ?
\ft Jesus answered him, Sayest thou this thing of thyself, or did others tell it thee of me?

\ln Qualedi hia nuwesvgi; Tsigo ayv Tsitsusi?  Ditsatseliga yvwi, ale nunigvwiyusv atsilvanelohi degetsayosv gado tsadvnelv.
\syll ᏆᎴᏗ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᏥᎪ ᎠᏴ ᏥᏧᏏ?  ᏗᏣᏤᎵᎦ ᏴᏫ, ᎠᎴ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᏕᎨᏣᏲᏒ ᎦᏙ ᏣᏛᏁᎸ.
\ft Pilate answered, Am I a Jew? Thine own nation and the chief priests have delivered thee unto me: what hast thou done?

\ln Tsisa hia nuwesvgi; Agigvwiyuhi gesv vtla ani elohi ehi yigi.  Iyuno agigvwiyuhi gesv ani elohi ehi yigesei, diquatseliga yidunatliyvhei, tlesdi Anitsusi digetsiyohiselvgi, yunelisei.  Aseno vtla ani udalenvhi yigi agigvwiyuhi gesvi.
\syll ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎠᎩᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎥᏝ ᎠᏂ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎡᎯ ᏱᎩ.  ᎢᏳᏃ ᎠᎩᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏂ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎡᎯ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ, ᏗᏆᏤᎵᎦ ᏱᏚᎾᏟᏴᎮᎢ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᏗᎨᏥᏲᎯᏎᎸᎩ, ᏳᏁᎵᏎᎢ.  ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎠᏂ ᎤᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᏱᎩ ᎠᎩᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Jesus answered, My kingdom is not of this world: if my kingdom were of this world, then would my servants fight, that I should not be delivered to the Jews: but now is my kingdom not from hence.

\ln Hnaquono Qualedi hia nuweselvgi; Tsagvwiyuhiyekani?  Tsisa hia nuwesvgi; Yeli niwi, agigvwiyuhiyeno ayv.  Tsinohesgi udohiyusv iyaqualisdodiyi, nasgi iyusdi aquadenvgi, ale nasgi nvdayulisdotanvgi elohi aginanugotsilvgi.  Naniv udohiyusv unigeyuhi anadvgisgo tsinegvi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏆᎴᏗ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯᏰᎧᏂ?  ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᏰᎵ ᏂᏫ, ᎠᎩᎬᏫᏳᎯᏰᏃ ᎠᏴ.  ᏥᏃᎮᏍᎩ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᏒ ᎢᏯᏆᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏆᏕᏅᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏓᏳᎵᏍᏙᏔᏅᎩ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎠᎩᎾᏄᎪᏥᎸᎩ.  ᎾᏂᎥ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᏒ ᎤᏂᎨᏳᎯ ᎠᎾᏛᎩᏍᎪ ᏥᏁᎬᎢ.
\ft Pilate therefore said unto him, Art thou a king then? Jesus answered, Thou sayest that I am a king. To this end was I born, and for this cause came I into the world, that I should bear witness unto the truth. Every one that is of the truth heareth my voice.

\ln Qualedi hia nuweselvgi; Gado usdi udohiyusv gesvi?  Nasgino hia nuwesv, taline unugotsvgi Anitsusi anidonav wulosvgi, ale hia winiduweselvgi; Vtla yitsiwatiha usganvtsvi.
\syll ᏆᎴᏗ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎦᏙ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᏒ ᎨᏒᎢ?  ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒ, ᏔᎵᏁ ᎤᏄᎪᏨᎩ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎠᏂᏙᎾᎥ ᏭᎶᏒᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏫᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎥᏝ ᏱᏥᏩᏘᎭ ᎤᏍᎦᏅᏨᎢ.
\ft Pilate saith unto him, What is truth? And when he had said this, he went out again unto the Jews, and saith unto them, I find in him no fault at all.

\ln Aseno dikahnawadvsdi itsiha, ditsvyohisediyi asiyvwi kanohiyegi dilisdayvdiyi asqualisgv iyui.  Nasgi iyusdi itsadulisgo ditsvyosediyi Ugvwiyuhi Anitsusi unatseliga?
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎢᏥᎭ, ᏗᏨᏲᎯᏎᏗᏱ ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᎧᏃᎯᏰᎩ ᏗᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ ᎠᏍᏆᎵᏍᎬ ᎢᏳᎢ.  ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏣᏚᎵᏍᎪ ᏗᏨᏲᏎᏗᏱ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ?
\ft But ye have a custom, that I should release unto you one at the passover: will ye therefore that I release unto you the King of the Jews?

\ln Hnaquono nigadv taline unelunvgi, Hia nuniwesvgi; vtlasdi hia asgaya, Qualaquasgini.  Nasgi Qualaqua adanasahvsgi gesvgi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎤᏁᎷᏅᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᎥᏝᏍᏗ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ, ᏆᎳᏆᏍᎩᏂ.  ᎾᏍᎩ ᏆᎳᏆ ᎠᏓᎾᏌᎲᏍᎩ ᎨᏒᎩ.
\ft Then cried they all again, saying, Not this man, but Barabbas. Now Barabbas was a robber.

\ln Hnaquono Qualedi uniyvhvgi Tsisa ale ulivnilvgi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏆᎴᏗ ᎤᏂᏴᎲᎩ ᏥᏌ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᎥᏂᎸᎩ.
\ft Then Pilate therefore took Jesus, and scourged him.

\ln Aniyawisgino unisdeyolv tsutsayosdi alisdulo unotlvnvgi ale gvwasdulanvgi, ale gigage anuwo gvwanuwovgi,
\syll ᎠᏂᏯᏫᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᏂᏍᏕᏲᎸ ᏧᏣᏲᏍᏗ ᎠᎵᏍᏚᎶ ᎤᏃᏢᏅᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᏍᏚᎳᏅᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎩᎦᎨ ᎠᏄᏬ ᎬᏩᏄᏬᎥᎩ,
\ft And the soldiers platted a crown of thorns, and put it on his head, and they put on him a purple robe,

\ln Ale hia nuniwesvgi; Itsvyoliga Tsagvwiyuhi Anitsusi unatseliga.  Ale degvwasidvnilvgi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᎢᏨᏲᎵᎦ ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ.  ᎠᎴ ᏕᎬᏩᏏᏛᏂᎸᎩ.
\ft And said, Hail, King of the Jews! and they smote him with their hands.

\ln Hnaquono Qualedi taline unugotsvgi, hia winiduweselvgi; Gvniyuquo itsvnanugowisi, itsadolehohisdiyi usganvtsv nagiwadvhvna gesvi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏆᎴᏗ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎤᏄᎪᏨᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏫᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎢᏨᎾᏄᎪᏫᏏ, ᎢᏣᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᎾᎩᏩᏛᎲᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Pilate therefore went forth again, and saith unto them, Behold, I bring him forth to you, that ye may know that I find no fault in him.

\ln Tsisano dayunanugotsvgi, ulisdulvgi alisdulo tsutsayosdi gotlvtanvhi, ale unuwvgi gigage anuwo.  Qualedino hia niduweselvgi; Gvniyuquo hia nasgi asgaya.
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᏓᏳᎾᏄᎪᏨᎩ, ᎤᎵᏍᏚᎸᎩ ᎠᎵᏍᏚᎶ ᏧᏣᏲᏍᏗ ᎪᏢᏔᏅᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏄᏮᎩ ᎩᎦᎨ ᎠᏄᏬ.  ᏆᎴᏗᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ.
\ft Then came Jesus forth, wearing the crown of thorns, and the purple robe. And Pilate saith unto them, Behold the man!

\ln Hnaquono nunigvwiyusv atsilvanelohi ale dinadaniyisgi gvwagohv, unelunvgi, hia nuniwesvgi; Hiyadvvga!  hiyadvvga! Qualedi hia niduweselvgi; Nihi etsadihnawidv, ale etsadvvga; ayvyeno vtla yitsiwatiha usganvtsvi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎾᏓᏂᏱᏍᎩ ᎬᏩᎪᎲ, ᎤᏁᎷᏅᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᎯᏯᏛᎥᎦ  ᎯᏯᏛᎥᎦ ᏆᎴᏗ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏂᎯ ᎡᏣᏗᎿᏫᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᎡᏣᏛᎥᎦ; ᎠᏴᏰᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏥᏩᏘᎭ ᎤᏍᎦᏅᏨᎢ.
\ft When the chief priests therefore and officers saw him, they cried out, saying, Crucify him, crucify him. Pilate saith unto them, Take ye him, and crucify him: for I find no fault in him.

\ln Anitsusi hia winvgvwaweselvgi; Dikahnawadvsdi ogiha, tsogikahnawadvsdino nigvnv yeliquo gvwayohuhisdi, Unelanvhiyeno Uwetsi utselvnvgi.
\syll ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎯᎠ ᏫᏅᎬᏩᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎣᎩᎭ, ᏦᎩᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗᏃ ᏂᎬᏅ ᏰᎵᏉ ᎬᏩᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎤᏤᎸᏅᎩ.
\ft The Jews answered him, We have a law, and by our law he ought to die, because he made himself the Son of God.

\ln Hnaquono Qualedi nasgi udvganv utli igai usgalvgi;
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏆᎴᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏛᎦᏅ ᎤᏟ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎤᏍᎦᎸᎩ;
\ft When Pilate therefore heard that saying, he was the more afraid;

\ln Ale taline uyvlvgi digugododiyi, hia winuweselvgi Tsisa; Hatlv nvdatsadalenvhi?  Aseno Tsisa vtla yunetselei.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎤᏴᎸᎩ ᏗᎫᎪᏙᏗᏱ, ᎯᎠ ᏫᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ ᏥᏌ; ᎭᏢ ᏅᏓᏣᏓᎴᏅᎯ?  ᎠᏎᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎥᏝ ᏳᏁᏤᎴᎢ.
\ft And went again into the judgment hall, and saith unto Jesus, Whence art thou? But Jesus gave him no answer.

\ln Hnaquono Qualedi hia nuweselvgi; Tlasgo yisginetseha?  Tlasgo yigataha yeliquo gagvyadvdi gesvi, ale yeliquo digagvyohisdi gesvi?
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏆᎴᏗ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏝᏍᎪ ᏱᏍᎩᏁᏤᎭ?  ᏝᏍᎪ ᏱᎦᏔᎭ ᏰᎵᏉ ᎦᎬᏯᏛᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏰᎵᏉ ᏗᎦᎬᏲᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ?
\ft Then saith Pilate unto him, Speakest thou not unto me? knowest thou not that I have power to crucify thee, and have power to release thee?

\ln Tsisa hia nuweselvgi; Vtla yigetsaha yeli ayv gohusdi squvnediyi, galvladi nvdayetsalisgolvdanelvhi nigesvna yigi.  Nasgi iyusdi, ayv digiyosvhi nihi ditsayohiselvhi utli equohiyu usganvtsv.
\syll ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎥᏝ ᏱᎨᏣᎭ ᏰᎵ ᎠᏴ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏍᏋᏁᏗᏱ, ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏅᏓᏰᏣᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏱᎩ.  ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᎠᏴ ᏗᎩᏲᏒᎯ ᏂᎯ ᏗᏣᏲᎯᏎᎸᎯ ᎤᏟ ᎡᏉᎯᏳ ᎤᏍᎦᏅᏨ.
\ft Jesus answered, Thou couldest have no power at all against me, except it were given thee from above: therefore he that delivered me unto thee hath the greater sin.

\ln Nahiyuno iyudalenvdv Qualedi uyolvgi vuwegodiyi.  Aseno Anitsusi unelunvgi, hia nuniwesvgi; Iyuno hia asgaya ihiyakanvha vtla Sisa isdalii yigagesesdi.  Gilo ugvwiyuhi atselvsgi, kanegv Sisa atludisgoi.
\syll ᏀᎢᏳᏃ ᎢᏳᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏆᎴᏗ ᎤᏲᎸᎩ ᎥᎤᏪᎪᏗᏱ.  ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎤᏁᎷᏅᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎢᎯᏯᎧᏅᎭ ᎥᏝ ᏏᏌ ᎢᏍᏓᎵᎢ ᏱᎦᎨᏎᏍᏗ.  ᎩᎶ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᏤᎸᏍᎩ, ᎧᏁᎬ ᏏᏌ ᎠᏡᏗᏍᎪᎢ.
\ft And from thenceforth Pilate sought to release him: but the Jews cried out, saying, If thou let this man go, thou art not Caesar's friend: whosoever maketh himself a king speaketh against Caesar.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi Qualedi nasgi udvganv unugowisvgi Tsisa, ale uwenvgi digugododiyi gasgilvi, Nvyaayesdav deudovi, Anitsusisgini uniwonihisdi gesv Gequada deudov.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏆᎴᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏛᎦᏅ ᎤᏄᎪᏫᏒᎩ ᏥᏌ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏪᏅᎩ ᏗᎫᎪᏙᏗᏱ ᎦᏍᎩᎸᎢ, ᏅᏯᎠᏰᏍᏓᎥ ᏕᎤᏙᎥᎢ, ᎠᏂᏧᏏᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏂᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎨᏆᏓ ᏕᎤᏙᎥ.
\ft When Pilate therefore heard that saying, he brought Jesus forth, and sat down in the judgment seat in a place that is called the Pavement, but in the Hebrew, Gabbatha.

\ln Kanohiyegino dilisdayvdiyi advnvisdodiyi iga gesvgi, ale taladu iyutlilodv iyvdv kalawadisv gesvgi, Qualedino hia niduweselvgi Anitsusi; Gvniyuquo Ugvwiyuhi itsatseliga!
\syll ᎧᏃᎯᏰᎩᏃ ᏗᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ ᎠᏛᏅᎢᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎢᎦ ᎨᏒᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏔᎳᏚ ᎢᏳᏟᎶᏛ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎧᎳᏩᏗᏒ ᎨᏒᎩ, ᏆᎴᏗᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ; ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᏣᏤᎵᎦ
\ft And it was the preparation of the passover, and about the sixth hour: and he saith unto the Jews, Behold your King!

\ln Aseno unelunvquo hia nuniwesvgi; Hiluga!  hiluga!  hiyadvvga!  Qualedi hia niduweselvgi; Datsiyadvnisgo itsatseliga Ugvwiyuhi?  Nunigvwiyusv atsilvanelohi hia nuniweselvgi; Vtla yogikaha ugvwiyuhi, Sisa uwasv!
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏁᎷᏅᏉ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᎯᎷᎦ  ᎯᎷᎦ  ᎯᏯᏛᎥᎦ  ᏆᎴᏗ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏓᏥᏯᏛᏂᏍᎪ ᎢᏣᏤᎵᎦ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ?  ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎥᏝ ᏲᎩᎧᎭ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᏏᏌ ᎤᏩᏒ
\ft But they cried out, Away with him, away with him, crucify him. Pilate saith unto them, Shall I crucify your King? The chief priest answered, We have no king but Caesar.

\ln Hnaquono duyohiselvgi unadvdiyi.  Uniniyvdvgino Tsisa ale unatinawidvhvgi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏚᏲᎯᏎᎸᎩ ᎤᎾᏛᏗᏱ.  ᎤᏂᏂᏴᏛᎩᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏘᎾᏫᏛᎲᎩ.
\ft Then delivered he him therefore unto them to be crucified. And they took Jesus, and led him away.

\ln Tsisano tsudahnawadv ganehvgi unugotsvgi, usqualugo dudov ulutsvgi, nasgi Goligada dudov Anitsusi uniwonihisdi gesv anvdisgvi;
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᏧᏓᎿᏩᏛ ᎦᏁᎲᎩ ᎤᏄᎪᏨᎩ, ᎤᏍᏆᎷᎪ ᏚᏙᎥ ᎤᎷᏨᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᎵᎦᏓ ᏚᏙᎥ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎤᏂᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏅᏗᏍᎬᎢ;
\ft And he bearing his cross went forth into a place called the place of a skull, which is called in the Hebrew Golgotha:

\ln Nahnani gvwadvnvgi, ale anitali nvwanadale itsulaha degegadvnvgi itsula iditlv Tsisano ayeli.
\syll ᏀᎾᏂ ᎬᏩᏛᏅᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᏕᎨᎦᏛᏅᎩ ᎢᏧᎳ ᎢᏗᏢ ᏥᏌᏃ ᎠᏰᎵ.
\ft Where they crucified him, and two other with him, on either side one, and Jesus in the midst.

\ln Qualedino uwowelanvgi agoliyedi, ale dadahnawasdv uweyalvnvgi; hia nigvnv gowelvgi; TsiSa NaSeLiDi EHi, UGvWiWaHi ANiTsuSi UNaTseLiGa.
\syll ᏆᎴᏗᏃ ᎤᏬᏪᎳᏅᎩ ᎠᎪᎵᏰᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᏓᎿᏩᏍᏛ ᎤᏪᏯᎸᏅᎩ; ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏅ ᎪᏪᎸᎩ; ᏥᏌ ᎾᏎᎵᏗ ᎡᎯ, ᎤᎬᏫᏩᎯ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ.
\ft And Pilate wrote a title, and put it on the cross. And the writing was, JESUS OF NAZARETH THE KING OF THE JEWS.

\ln Hia nasgi agoliyedi unitsadv Anitsusi anigoliyesgvgi, Tsisayeno agadvnv gaduhv nav gesvgi, Anitsusino, ale Anigoi, ale Anilomi tsuniwonihisdi gesv gowelvgi.
\syll ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎪᎵᏰᏗ ᎤᏂᏣᏛ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎠᏂᎪᎵᏰᏍᎬᎩ, ᏥᏌᏰᏃ ᎠᎦᏛᏅ ᎦᏚᎲ ᎾᎥ ᎨᏒᎩ, ᎠᏂᏧᏏᏃ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᎪᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᎶᎻ ᏧᏂᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎪᏪᎸᎩ.
\ft This title then read many of the Jews: for the place where Jesus was crucified was nigh to the city: and it was written in Hebrew, and Greek, and Latin.

\ln Hnaquono nunigvwiyusv atsilvanelohi Anitsusi tsunatseliga hia nuniweselvgi Qualedi; Tlesdi hia itsvnelv tsowelanvgi; Ugvwiyuhi Anitsusi unatseliga; hiasgini; Agigvwiyuhi Anitsusi unatseliga adisgvgi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᏧᎾᏤᎵᎦ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎸᎩ ᏆᎴᏗ; ᏞᏍᏗ ᎯᎠ ᎢᏨᏁᎸ ᏦᏪᎳᏅᎩ; ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ; ᎯᎠᏍᎩᏂ; ᎠᎩᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ ᎠᏗᏍᎬᎩ.
\ft Then said the chief priests of the Jews to Pilate, Write not, The King of the Jews; but that he said, I am King of the Jews.

\ln Qualedi hia nuwesvgi; Tsinaquvnelv tsaquowelanv, hnaquo ase aquowelanv.
\syll ᏆᎴᏗ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᏥᎾᏋᏁᎸ ᏣᏉᏪᎳᏅ, ᎿᏉ ᎠᏎ ᎠᏉᏪᎳᏅ.
\ft Pilate answered, What I have written I have written.

\ln Hnaquono aniyawisgi, Tsisa gvwadvnv, duninesvgi tsunuwo, nvgi nidunidvgi, saquo igadvhi asiyvwi ayawisgi utseliga nunvnelvgi; ale nasquo hawini unuwovhi.  Nasgi hawini anuwo vtla gayewidv yigesei, nigv gvnvhi gesvgi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎠᏂᏯᏫᏍᎩ, ᏥᏌ ᎬᏩᏛᏅ, ᏚᏂᏁᏒᎩ ᏧᏄᏬ, ᏅᎩ ᏂᏚᏂᏛᎩ, ᏌᏉ ᎢᎦᏛᎯ ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᎠᏯᏫᏍᎩ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᏄᏅᏁᎸᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎭᏫᏂ ᎤᏄᏬᎥᎯ.  ᎾᏍᎩ ᎭᏫᏂ ᎠᏄᏬ ᎥᏝ ᎦᏰᏫᏛ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ, ᏂᎬ ᎬᏅᎯ ᎨᏒᎩ.
\ft Then the soldiers, when they had crucified Jesus, took his garments, and made four parts, to every soldier a part; and also his coat: now the coat was without seam, woven from the top throughout.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi hia nidunadaweselvgi; Tlesdi igitsagalvisvgi, idasehiquosgini idadolehohi utseliga iyulisdodi gesvi; udohiyudiyi gowelv hia tsinigvnv; Duniyadolvgi diquanuwo, ale aquanuwosdi unasastanvgi.  Hia nasgi aniyawisgi nunadvnelvgi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᎾᏓᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏞᏍᏗ ᎢᎩᏣᎦᎸᎢᏒᎩ, ᎢᏓᏎᎯᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᏓᏙᎴᎰᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎤᏙᎯᏳᏗᏱ ᎪᏪᎸ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᎬᏅ; ᏚᏂᏯᏙᎸᎩ ᏗᏆᏄᏬ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏆᏄᏬᏍᏗ ᎤᎾᏌᏍᏔᏅᎩ.  ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏂᏯᏫᏍᎩ ᏄᎾᏛᏁᎸᎩ.
\ft They said therefore among themselves, Let us not rend it, but cast lots for it, whose it shall be: that the scripture might be fulfilled, which saith, They parted my raiment among them, and for my vesture they did cast lots. These things therefore the soldiers did.

\ln Navno dadahnawasdv Tsisa gadvi anidonavgi utsi, unino ulvi Meli Tlioqua udalii, Melino Magideli ehi.
\syll ᎾᎥᏃ ᏓᏓᎿᏩᏍᏛ ᏥᏌ ᎦᏛᎢ ᎠᏂᏙᎾᎥᎩ ᎤᏥ, ᎤᏂᏃ ᎤᎸᎢ ᎺᎵ ᏟᎣᏆ ᎤᏓᎵᎢ, ᎺᎵᏃ ᎹᎩᏕᎵ ᎡᎯ.
\ft Now there stood by the cross of Jesus his mother, and his mother's sister, Mary the wife of Cleophas, and Mary Magdalene.

\ln Tsisano ugohv utsi, ale ugohv nav gadogv usdawadidohi ugeyuhi, hia nuweselvgi utsi; Higeyv, Gvniyuquo tsetsi.
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᎪᎲ ᎤᏥ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎪᎲ ᎾᎥ ᎦᏙᎬ ᎤᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎤᎨᏳᎯ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ ᎤᏥ; ᎯᎨᏴ, ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᏤᏥ.
\ft When Jesus therefore saw his mother, and the disciple standing by, whom he loved, he saith unto his mother, Woman, behold thy son!

\ln Hnaquono hia nvuweselvgi usdawadidohi; Gvniyuquo tsatsii.  Nahiyuquono nasgi usdawadidohi tsuwenvsv wutinvstanvgi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏅᎤᏪᏎᎸᎩ ᎤᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ; ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᏣᏥᎢ.  ᏀᎢᏳᏉᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏧᏪᏅᏒ ᏭᏘᏅᏍᏔᏅᎩ.
\ft Then saith he to the disciple, Behold thy mother! And from that hour that disciple took her unto his own home.

\ln Hnaquono Tsisa agatahiyu gesv nigav hnaquo ulisquadvi, gowelv udohiyudiyi, Agitadegiha, udvnvgi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎠᎦᏔᎯᏳ ᎨᏒ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎿᏉ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᏛᎢ, ᎪᏪᎸ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᏗᏱ, ᎠᎩᏔᏕᎩᎭ, ᎤᏛᏅᎩ.
\ft After this, Jesus knowing that all things were now accomplished, that the scripture might be fulfilled, saith, I thirst.

\ln Nahnano vgakahvgi atelido tsunitsoyasdi akaliwohi; duwoilino tsunitsoyasdi unikaliistanvgi, ale nasgi hisiqui uniquadotanvgi, aholi nav uniwasatanvgi.
\syll ᏀᎾᏃ ᎥᎦᎧᎲᎩ ᎠᏖᎵᏙ ᏧᏂᏦᏯᏍᏗ ᎠᎧᎵᏬᎯ; ᏚᏬᎢᎵᏃ ᏧᏂᏦᏯᏍᏗ ᎤᏂᎧᎵᎢᏍᏔᏅᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᏏᏈ ᎤᏂᏆᏙᏔᏅᎩ, ᎠᎰᎵ ᎾᎥ ᎤᏂᏩᏌᏔᏅᎩ.
\ft Now there was set a vessel full of vinegar: and they filled a spunge with vinegar, and put it upon hyssop, and put it to his mouth.

\ln Tsisano tsunitsoyasdi unegisv hia nuwesvgi; Hnaquo alisquada; ulisguwisvno deuyosvgi udanvdo.
\syll ᏥᏌᏃ ᏧᏂᏦᏯᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎩᏒ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎿᏉ ᎠᎵᏍᏆᏓ; ᎤᎵᏍᎫᏫᏒᏃ ᏕᎤᏲᏒᎩ ᎤᏓᏅᏙ.
\ft When Jesus therefore had received the vinegar, he said, It is finished: and he bowed his head, and gave up the ghost.

\ln Anitsusino unitayoselvgi Qualedi dininvsgeni digetsisqualisediyi ale digetsinesdiyi, nvdayulisdotanvgi advnvisdodiyi iga gesvi, tlesdi unadodaquasgv yidigadesdi anelisgvgi, nasgiyeno unadodaquasgv iga galvquodiyu gesvgi.
\syll ᎠᏂᏧᏏᏃ ᎤᏂᏔᏲᏎᎸᎩ ᏆᎴᏗ ᏗᏂᏅᏍᎨᏂ ᏗᎨᏥᏍᏆᎵᏎᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎨᏥᏁᏍᏗᏱ, ᏅᏓᏳᎵᏍᏙᏔᏅᎩ ᎠᏛᏅᎢᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎢᎦ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᎤᎾᏙᏓᏆᏍᎬ ᏱᏗᎦᏕᏍᏗ ᎠᏁᎵᏍᎬᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎤᎾᏙᏓᏆᏍᎬ ᎢᎦ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒᎩ.
\ft The Jews therefore, because it was the preparation, that the bodies should not remain upon the cross on the sabbath day, (for that sabbath day was an high day,) besought Pilate that their legs might be broken, and that they might be taken away.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi aniyawisgi unilutsvgi, dunisqualisvgi diganvsgeni igvyiyi gadi ale soi itsulaha Tsisa digegadvnvhi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏂᏯᏫᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᎷᏨᎩ, ᏚᏂᏍᏆᎵᏒᎩ ᏗᎦᏅᏍᎨᏂ ᎢᎬᏱᏱ ᎦᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏐᎢ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᏥᏌ ᏗᎨᎦᏛᏅᎯ.
\ft Then came the soldiers, and brake the legs of the first, and of the other which was crucified with him.

\ln Tsisasgini gadv wunilutsv, ale unadolehosv gayula uyohusvhi gesvi, vtla yidunisqualise diganvsgeni;
\syll ᏥᏌᏍᎩᏂ ᎦᏛ ᏭᏂᎷᏨ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏙᎴᎰᏒ ᎦᏳᎳ ᎤᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᏱᏚᏂᏍᏆᎵᏎ ᏗᎦᏅᏍᎨᏂ;
\ft But when they came to Jesus, and saw that he was dead already, they brake not his legs:

\ln Asiyvwisgini ayawisgi, didatisdi uwetistanvgi asquogeni, gilaquono iyvdv nahna dayutsvtsvgi gigv ale ama.
\syll ᎠᏏᏴᏫᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏯᏫᏍᎩ, ᏗᏓᏘᏍᏗ ᎤᏪᏘᏍᏔᏅᎩ ᎠᏍᏉᎨᏂ, ᎩᎳᏉᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏀᎾ ᏓᏳᏨᏨᎩ ᎩᎬ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎹ.
\ft But one of the soldiers with a spear pierced his side, and forthwith came there out blood and water.

\ln Nasgino na ugohvhi unohelvgi, kanohesgvno udohiyuha, ale agataha udohiyuhi kanohesgvi, nasgi getsohiyudi iyulisdodiyi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ Ꮎ ᎤᎪᎲᎯ ᎤᏃᎮᎸᎩ, ᎧᏃᎮᏍᎬᏃ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎦᏔᎭ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎧᏃᎮᏍᎬᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᏦᎯᏳᏗ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
\ft And he that saw it bare record, and his record is true: and he knoweth that he saith true, that ye might believe.

\ln Nasgiyeno hia nulistanvgi udohiyudiyi gowelv hia tsinigvnv; "Vtla saquo ugola tsulisqualisdi yigesesdi."
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎩ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᏗᏱ ᎪᏪᎸ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᎬᏅ; data is invalidᎥᏝ ᏌᏉ ᎤᎪᎳ ᏧᎵᏍᏆᎵᏍᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ.data is invalid
\ft For these things were done, that the scripture should be fulfilled, A bone of him shall not be broken.

\ln Alewo nvwadale gowelv hia nigawaha; "Dodagvwakanani digvwetilvhi."
\syll ᎠᎴᏬ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᎪᏪᎸ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏩᎭ; data is invalidᏙᏓᎬᏩᎧᎾᏂ ᏗᎬᏪᏘᎸᎯ.data is invalid
\ft And again another scripture saith, They shall look on him whom they pierced.

\ln Nasgino nulistanidolv oni Tsowa Alimadiyi ehi, Tsisa asdawadidohi gesvgi, aseno udelidvquo Anitsusi dasgaihvi nvdagalisdodisgvgi, nasgi Tsowa utayoselvgi Qualedi unesdiyi Tsisa ayelvi.  Qualedino ulisgolvdanelvgi.  Howano ulutsvgi unesvgi Tsisa ayelvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏂᏙᎸ ᎣᏂ ᏦᏩ ᎠᎵᎹᏗᏱ ᎡᎯ, ᏥᏌ ᎠᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎨᏒᎩ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏕᎵᏛᏉ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᏓᏍᎦᎢᎲᎢ ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏦᏩ ᎤᏔᏲᏎᎸᎩ ᏆᎴᏗ ᎤᏁᏍᏗᏱ ᏥᏌ ᎠᏰᎸᎢ.  ᏆᎴᏗᏃ ᎤᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᎸᎩ.  ᎰᏩᏃ ᎤᎷᏨᎩ ᎤᏁᏒᎩ ᏥᏌ ᎠᏰᎸᎢ.
\ft And after this Joseph of Arimathaea, being a disciple of Jesus, but secretly for fear of the Jews, besought Pilate that he might take away the body of Jesus: and Pilate gave him leave. He came therefore, and took the body of Jesus.

\ln Nasquono vulutsvgi Nigadimasi, nasgi igvyiyi Tsisa enoyi ulutselvhi, uyolvgi didlastanvhi mila elawino, asgohitsuqui iyvdv iyudagedv.
\syll ᎾᏍᏉᏃ ᎥᎤᎷᏨᎩ ᏂᎦᏗᎹᏏ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎬᏱᏱ ᏥᏌ ᎡᏃᏱ ᎤᎷᏤᎸᎯ, ᎤᏲᎸᎩ ᏗᏜᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎻᎳ ᎡᎳᏫᏃ, ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏧᏈ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎢᏳᏓᎨᏛ.
\ft And there came also Nicodemus, which at the first came to Jesus by night, and brought a mixture of myrrh and aloes, about an hundred pound weight.

\ln Hnaquono uninesvgi Tsisa ayelvi ale doledv anuwo unitsanulotanvgi, ale nasquo digawasvgi dunitsanulanvgi, nasgiya iyunadvnedi gesv Anitsusi danadanisa.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎤᏂᏁᏒᎩ ᏥᏌ ᎠᏰᎸᎢ ᎠᎴ ᏙᎴᏛ ᎠᏄᏬ ᎤᏂᏣᏄᎶᏔᏅᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏗᎦᏩᏒᎩ ᏚᏂᏣᏄᎳᏅᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᏓᎾᏓᏂᏌ.
\ft Then took they the body of Jesus, and wound it in linen clothes with the spices, as the manner of the Jews is to bury.

\ln Nahnano agadvnv awiediyi gotlvsvgi; nahnano awisvdiyi itse didanisodiyi gotlvsvgi gilo atsinisanv asi nigesvna.
\syll ᏀᎾᏃ ᎠᎦᏛᏅ ᎠᏫᎡᏗᏱ ᎪᏢᏒᎩ; ᏀᎾᏃ ᎠᏫᏒᏗᏱ ᎢᏤ ᏗᏓᏂᏐᏗᏱ ᎪᏢᏒᎩ ᎩᎶ ᎠᏥᏂᏌᏅ ᎠᏏ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.
\ft Now in the place where he was crucified there was a garden; and in the garden a new sepulchre, wherein was never man yet laid.

\ln Nahnano uninvnvgi Tsisa nvdagalisdodisgvgi Anitsusi unatseliga advnvisdodiyi iga gesvi; didanisodiyiyeno navquo gesvgi.
\syll ᏀᎾᏃ ᎤᏂᏅᏅᎩ ᏥᏌ ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ ᎠᏛᏅᎢᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎢᎦ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᏗᏓᏂᏐᏗᏱᏰᏃ ᎾᎥᏉ ᎨᏒᎩ.
\ft There laid they Jesus therefore because of the Jews' preparation day; for the sepulchre was nigh at hand.

\ln alenisgvino iga sunadodaquasdi gesvi, Meli Magideli ehi sunaleiyu, asiquo ulisigvgi, ulutsvgi atselisdvi, ale ugohvgi nvya ahvdv gesvgi atselisdvi.
\syll ᎠᎴᏂᏍᎬᎢᏃ ᎢᎦ ᏑᎾᏙᏓᏆᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎺᎵ ᎹᎩᏕᎵ ᎡᎯ ᏑᎾᎴᎢᏳ, ᎠᏏᏉ ᎤᎵᏏᎬᎩ, ᎤᎷᏨᎩ ᎠᏤᎵᏍᏛᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎪᎲᎩ ᏅᏯ ᎠᎲᏛ ᎨᏒᎩ ᎠᏤᎵᏍᏛᎢ.
\ft The first day of the week cometh Mary Magdalene early, when it was yet dark, unto the sepulchre, and seeth the stone taken away from the sepulchre.

\ln Hnaquono dusqualvtanvgi, Sawani Quida wulutselvgi, ale nasquo soi adasdawadidohi, nasgi tsisa ugeyuhi, hia winiduweselvgi; Uninesv uninugowisv Ugvwiyuhi atselisdvi, ale vtla yotsigatahawuninvnvi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏚᏍᏆᎸᏔᏅᎩ, ᏌᏩᏂ ᏈᏓ ᏭᎷᏤᎸᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏐᎢ ᎠᏓᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏌ ᎤᎨᏳᎯ, ᎯᎠ ᏫᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎤᏂᏁᏒ ᎤᏂᏄᎪᏫᏒ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᏤᎵᏍᏛᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᏲᏥᎦᏔᎭᏭᏂᏅᏅᎢ.
\ft Then she runneth, and cometh to Simon Peter, and to the other disciple, whom Jesus loved, and saith unto them, They have taken away the Lord out of the sepulchre, and we know not where they have laid him.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi Quida unugotsvgi, ale soi adasdawadidohi, ale atselisdv unilutsvgi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏈᏓ ᎤᏄᎪᏨᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏐᎢ ᎠᏓᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏤᎵᏍᏛ ᎤᏂᎷᏨᎩ.
\ft Peter therefore went forth, and that other disciple, and came to the sepulchre.

\ln Hnaquono nasgi anitali itsulaha dunisqualvtanvgi; soino adasdawadidohi dudagiyvgi, igvyi atselisdv ulutsvgi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᏚᏂᏍᏆᎸᏔᏅᎩ; ᏐᎢᏃ ᎠᏓᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏚᏓᎩᏴᎩ, ᎢᎬᏱ ᎠᏤᎵᏍᏛ ᎤᎷᏨᎩ.
\ft So they ran both together: and the other disciple did outrun Peter, and came first to the sepulchre.

\ln Nasgino udisadadv dugohvgi doledv dinuwo deganvgi; aseno vtla yuyvlei.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᏗᏌᏓᏛ ᏚᎪᎲᎩ ᏙᎴᏛ ᏗᏄᏬ ᏕᎦᏅᎩ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏳᏴᎴᎢ.
\ft And he stooping down, and looking in, saw the linen clothes lying; yet went he not in.

\ln Hnaquono Sawani Quida oniquo ulutsvgi, ale atselisdv wuyvlvgi, ale dugohvgi doledv dinuwo deganvi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏌᏩᏂ ᏈᏓ ᎣᏂᏉ ᎤᎷᏨᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏤᎵᏍᏛ ᏭᏴᎸᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᎪᎲᎩ ᏙᎴᏛ ᏗᏄᏬ ᏕᎦᏅᎢ.
\ft Then cometh Simon Peter following him, and went into the sepulchre, and seeth the linen clothes lie,

\ln Ayatlono unisdulotanvhi vtla doledv dinuwo deganv yiganei, unelagi gaquenvhi iyvdv wiganvgi.
\syll ᎠᏯᏠᏃ ᎤᏂᏍᏚᎶᏔᏅᎯ ᎥᏝ ᏙᎴᏛ ᏗᏄᏬ ᏕᎦᏅ ᏱᎦᏁᎢ, ᎤᏁᎳᎩ ᎦᏇᏅᎯ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏫᎦᏅᎩ.
\ft And the napkin, that was about his head, not lying with the linen clothes, but wrapped together in a place by itself.

\ln Hnaquono nasquo soi adasdawadidohi, igvyi ulutsvhi atselisdv, uyvlvgi; ale ugohvgi ale uwohiyunvgi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏐᎢ ᎠᏓᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ, ᎢᎬᏱ ᎤᎷᏨᎯ ᎠᏤᎵᏍᏛ, ᎤᏴᎸᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᎪᎲᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏬᎯᏳᏅᎩ.
\ft Then went in also that other disciple, which came first to the sepulchre, and he saw, and believed.

\ln Tlayeno asi yanolige gadvgv gowelvi, nasgi uyohusv tsulehisodi gesvi.
\syll ᏝᏰᏃ ᎠᏏ ᏯᏃᎵᎨ ᎦᏛᎬ ᎪᏪᎸᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏲᎱᏒ ᏧᎴᎯᏐᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft For as yet they knew not the scripture, that he must rise again from the dead.

\ln Hnaquono anadasdawadidohi unadanvsvgi, taline dotsunenvsv wunilosvgi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎠᎾᏓᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏒᎩ, ᏔᎵᏁ ᏙᏧᏁᏅᏒ ᏭᏂᎶᏒᎩ.
\ft Then the disciples went away again unto their own home.

\ln Melisgini atselisdv doyiditlv galohisdiyi gadogvgi, datloyihvgi; datloyihvgi udisadadvgi, atselisdv hawini widukananvgi,
\syll ᎺᎵᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏤᎵᏍᏛ ᏙᏱᏗᏢ ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎦᏙᎬᎩ, ᏓᏠᏱᎲᎩ; ᏓᏠᏱᎲᎩ ᎤᏗᏌᏓᏛᎩ, ᎠᏤᎵᏍᏛ ᎭᏫᏂ ᏫᏚᎧᎾᏅᎩ,
\ft But Mary stood without at the sepulchre weeping: and as she wept, she stooped down, and looked into the sepulchre,

\ln Ale widugohvgi unegv dunatsanvdvgi anitali dinikahnawadidohi dunolvgi, saquo ulistinvi, soino dudlasatanvi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏫᏚᎪᎲᎩ ᎤᏁᎬ ᏚᎾᏣᏅᏛᎩ ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᏗᏂᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏚᏃᎸᎩ, ᏌᏉ ᎤᎵᏍᏘᏅᎢ, ᏐᎢᏃ ᏚᏜᏌᏔᏅᎢ.
\ft And seeth two angels in white sitting, the one at the head, and the other at the feet, where the body of Jesus had lain.

\ln Hiano nvgvwaweselvgi; Higeyv, gadono dohatloyiha?  Hiano niduweselvgi; Nvdigalisdodiha uninesv Ugvwiyuhi aquatseliga, ale uninvnv nitsigatahvna gesvi.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏅᎬᏩᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎯᎨᏴ, ᎦᏙᏃ ᏙᎭᏠᏱᎭ?  ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎤᏂᏁᏒ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᏆᏤᎵᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏅᏅ ᏂᏥᎦᏔᎲᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft And they say unto her, Woman, why weepest thou? She saith unto them, Because they have taken away my Lord, and I know not where they have laid him.

\ln Nasgino nuwesv ugatahvsvgi; ale ugohvgi Tsisa gadogvgi, ale vtla yuwolitse Tsisa gesvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏄᏪᏒ ᎤᎦᏔᎲᏒᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᎪᎲᎩ ᏥᏌ ᎦᏙᎬᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᏳᏬᎵᏤ ᏥᏌ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft And when she had thus said, she turned herself back, and saw Jesus standing, and knew not that it was Jesus.

\ln Tsisa hia nuweselvgi; Higeyv, gadono dohatloyiha?  gago hiyoha?  Awisvdiyi osdv iyuwahnadegi uwelisvgi, hia nuweselvgi; Hisgaya, iyuno nihi hinawidvhesdi, sginohvsi winvnvi, ayvno datsinawidvhi.
\syll ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎯᎨᏴ, ᎦᏙᏃ ᏙᎭᏠᏱᎭ?  ᎦᎪ ᎯᏲᎭ?  ᎠᏫᏒᏗᏱ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎢᏳᏩᎿᏕᎩ ᎤᏪᎵᏒᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎯᏍᎦᏯ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᏂᎯ ᎯᎾᏫᏛᎮᏍᏗ, ᏍᎩᏃᎲᏏ ᏫᏅᏅᎢ, ᎠᏴᏃ ᏓᏥᎾᏫᏛᎯ.
\ft Jesus saith unto her, Woman, why weepest thou? whom seekest thou? She, supposing him to be the gardener, saith unto him, Sir, if thou have borne him hence, tell me where thou hast laid him, and I will take him away.

\ln Tsisa hia nuweselvgi; Meli.  Meli ugatahvsv hia nuweselvgi; Laquoni, nasgi gadvgvi, Disqueyohvsgi.
\syll ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎺᎵ.  ᎺᎵ ᎤᎦᏔᎲᏒ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎳᏉᏂ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏛᎬᎢ, ᏗᏍᏇᏲᎲᏍᎩ.
\ft Jesus saith unto her, Mary. She turned herself, and saith unto him, Rabboni; which is to say, Master.

\ln Tsisa hia nuweselvgi; Tlesdi squasvnilvgi, tlayeno asi edodoyi wiyaqualisaladanv; henaquosgini otsalinvtli dininvi, hiano winigiwesi; Edodoyi aqualisaladanidi ale nihi Itsidodoyi; Aquatseliga Unelanvhiyi, ale itsatseliga Unelanvhiyi.
\syll ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏞᏍᏗ ᏍᏆᏒᏂᎸᎩ, ᏝᏰᏃ ᎠᏏ ᎡᏙᏙᏱ ᏫᏯᏆᎵᏌᎳᏓᏅ; ᎮᎾᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎣᏣᎵᏅᏟ ᏗᏂᏅᎢ, ᎯᎠᏃ ᏫᏂᎩᏪᏏ; ᎡᏙᏙᏱ ᎠᏆᎵᏌᎳᏓᏂᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏥᏙᏙᏱ; ᎠᏆᏤᎵᎦ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏣᏤᎵᎦ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏱ.
\ft Jesus saith unto her, Touch me not; for I am not yet ascended to my Father: but go to my brethren, and say unto them, I ascend unto my Father, and your Father; and to my God, and your God.

\ln Meli Magideli ehi ulutsvgi ale dunonelvgi anadasdawadidohi ugohv Ugvwiyuhi, ale nasgi nuwesv ulinohetanvi.
\syll ᎺᎵ ᎹᎩᏕᎵ ᎡᎯ ᎤᎷᏨᎩ ᎠᎴ ᏚᏃᏁᎸᎩ ᎠᎾᏓᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎤᎪᎲ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏪᏒ ᎤᎵᏃᎮᏔᏅᎢ.
\ft Mary Magdalene came and told the disciples that she had seen the Lord, and that he had spoken these things unto her.

\ln Hnaquono nahiyu iga usvi, alenisgv sunadodaquasdi gesvi, galohisdiyi dasduhvgi anadasdawadidohi danilawivi, nvdagalisdodisgv danisgaihv Anitsusi, ulutsvgi Tsisa, ayeli ulenvgi, hia niduweselvgi; Nvwadohiyadv itsatseliga gesesdi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏀᎢᏳ ᎢᎦ ᎤᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴᏂᏍᎬ ᏑᎾᏙᏓᏆᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏓᏍᏚᎲᎩ ᎠᎾᏓᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏓᏂᎳᏫᎥᎢ, ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬ ᏓᏂᏍᎦᎢᎲ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ, ᎤᎷᏨᎩ ᏥᏌ, ᎠᏰᎵ ᎤᎴᏅᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᎢᏣᏤᎵᎦ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft Then the same day at evening, being the first day of the week, when the doors were shut where the disciples were assembled for fear of the Jews, came Jesus and stood in the midst, and saith unto them, Peace be unto you.

\ln Nasgino nuwesv, dunanugowiselvgi tsuwoyeni ale asquageni.  Hnaquono gvwasdawadidohi osdv unadanvdadvgi unigohv Ugvwiyuhi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏄᏪᏒ, ᏚᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᎸᎩ ᏧᏬᏰᏂ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏍᏆᎨᏂ.  ᎿᏉᏃ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏓᏛᎩ ᎤᏂᎪᎲ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ.
\ft And when he had so said, he shewed unto them his hands and his side. Then were the disciples glad, when they saw the Lord.

\ln Hnaquono taline Tsisa hia niduweselvgi; Nvwadohiyadv itsatseliga gesesdi.  Edoda aginvsvi nasgiya itsvnvli.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏔᎵᏁ ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᎢᏣᏤᎵᎦ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.  ᎡᏙᏓ ᎠᎩᏅᏒᎢ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎢᏨᏅᎵ.
\ft Then said Jesus to them again, Peace be unto you: as my Father hath sent me, even so send I you.

\ln Nasgino nuwesv, dutsotahvgi, hia niduweselvgi; Galvquodiyu Adanvdo ditsadanilvgi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏄᏪᏒ, ᏚᏦᏔᎲᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᏗᏣᏓᏂᎸᎩ.
\ft And when he had said this, he breathed on them, and saith unto them, Receive ye the Holy Ghost:

\ln Gilo usganvtsv detsiyosgesdi diyosvhi gesesdi, gilono usganvtsv detsiniyisgesdi diganiyvdi gesesdi.
\syll ᎩᎶ ᎤᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᏕᏥᏲᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏗᏲᏒᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎩᎶᏃ ᎤᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᏕᏥᏂᏱᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏗᎦᏂᏴᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft Whose soever sins ye remit, they are remitted unto them; and whose soever sins ye retain, they are retained.

\ln Aseno Dami, taladu iyanidv gela, didima tsudoidv, vtla yigele Tsisa ulutsv.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᏓᎻ, ᏔᎳᏚ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᎨᎳ, ᏗᏗᎹ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ, ᎥᏝ ᏱᎨᎴ ᏥᏌ ᎤᎷᏨ.
\ft But Thomas, one of the twelve, called Didymus, was not with them when Jesus came.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi anisoi anadasdawadidohi hia nigvwaweselvgi; Otsigov Ugvwiyuhi.  Aseno hia niduweselvgi; Vtla yvgagoiyuhvga gvni tsuwoyeni yvgi duyelvsv yidagigohv, ale tsiyesadv yaquvtanv yaginotlistanv yvgi duyelvsvi, ale asquageni yaquasonadv.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏂᏐᎢ ᎠᎾᏓᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏩᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎣᏥᎪᎥ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ.  ᎠᏎᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎥᏝ ᏴᎦᎪᎢᏳᎲᎦ ᎬᏂ ᏧᏬᏰᏂ ᏴᎩ ᏚᏰᎸᏒ ᏱᏓᎩᎪᎲ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᏰᏌᏛ ᏯᏋᏔᏅ ᏯᎩᏃᏟᏍᏔᏅ ᏴᎩ ᏚᏰᎸᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏍᏆᎨᏂ ᏯᏆᏐᎾᏛ.
\ft The other disciples therefore said unto him, We have seen the Lord. But he said unto them, Except I shall see in his hands the print of the nails, and put my finger into the print of the nails, and thrust my hand into his side, I will not believe.

\ln Tsunelineno iga taline gvwasdawadidohi aniyavgi galitsode, ale Dami gelvgi.  Tsisa ulutsvgi, digalohisdiyi dasduhvgi, ayeli ulenvgi, hia nuwesvgi; Nvwadohiyadv itsatseliga gesesdi.
\syll ᏧᏁᎵᏁᏃ ᎢᎦ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎠᏂᏯᎥᎩ ᎦᎵᏦᏕ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᎻ ᎨᎸᎩ.  ᏥᏌ ᎤᎷᏨᎩ, ᏗᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏓᏍᏚᎲᎩ, ᎠᏰᎵ ᎤᎴᏅᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᎢᏣᏤᎵᎦ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft And after eight days again his disciples were within, and Thomas with them: then came Jesus, the doors being shut, and stood in the midst, and said, Peace be unto you.

\ln Hnaquono hia nuweselvgi Dami; Esga envga hiyesadvi, tigoliya diquoyeni, ale esga envga tsoyeni tsisquageni wasonada, ale tlesdi nohiyuhvsgvna yigesesdi, hohiyuhvsgisgini gesesdi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ ᏓᎻ; ᎡᏍᎦ ᎡᏅᎦ ᎯᏰᏌᏛᎢ, ᏘᎪᎵᏯ ᏗᏉᏰᏂ, ᎠᎴ ᎡᏍᎦ ᎡᏅᎦ ᏦᏰᏂ ᏥᏍᏆᎨᏂ ᏩᏐᎾᏓ, ᎠᎴ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎬᎾ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎰᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft Then saith he to Thomas, reach hither thy finger, and behold my hands; and reach hither thy hand, and thrust it into my side: and be not faithless, but believing.

\ln Dami unetsvgi, hia nuweselvgi; Tsagvwiyuhi aquatseliga, ale Tsanelanvhi aquatseliga!
\syll ᏓᎻ ᎤᏁᏨᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᏆᏤᎵᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᏣᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᏆᏤᎵᎦ
\ft And Thomas answered and said unto him, My Lord and my God.

\ln Tsisa hia nuweselvgi; Tsisgigowadv nvdagalisdoda hohiyuhvsga; osiyu iyunalisdanedi gvgigohvhi nigesvna aseno tsigvquohiyuhvsgoi.
\syll ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏥᏍᎩᎪᏩᏛ ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏓ ᎰᎯᏳᎲᏍᎦ; ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎬᎩᎪᎲᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎠᏎᏃ ᏥᎬᏉᎯᏳᎲᏍᎪᎢ.
\ft Jesus saith unto him, Thomas, because thou hast seen me, thou hast believed: blessed are they that have not seen, and yet have believed.

\ln Ale utsadvgi utli igai usquanigodi dulvwisdanelv Tsisa gvwasdawadidohi anigatahvi, ani gowelihi nigowelvna;
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎤᏣᏛᎩ ᎤᏟ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸ ᏥᏌ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎲᎢ, ᎠᏂ ᎪᏪᎵᎯ ᏂᎪᏪᎸᎾ;
\ft And many other signs truly did Jesus in the presence of his disciples, which are not written in this book:

\ln Hiasgini gowela itsohiyudiyi Tsisa Galonedv gesvi, ale nasgi Unelanvhi Uwetsi gesvi, itsohiyuhvsgvno gvnidv itsatseli iyulisdodiyi, nasgi dudov nvdayuliyeilvsdodiyi.
\syll ᎯᎠᏍᎩᏂ ᎪᏪᎳ ᎢᏦᎯᏳᏗᏱ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎢᏦᎯᏳᎲᏍᎬᏃ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎢᏣᏤᎵ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᏙᎥ ᏅᏓᏳᎵᏰᎢᎸᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
\ft But these are written, that ye might believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God; and that believing ye might have life through his name.

\ln Nasgino nulistanidolv, Tsisa taline gvnigesv nidudvnelvgi gvwasdawadidohi Taquiliya vdalvi.  Hiano nulistanidolvgi gvnigesv nudvnelvgi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏂᏙᎸ, ᏥᏌ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᏚᏛᏁᎸᎩ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏔᏈᎵᏯ ᎥᏓᎸᎢ.  ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏂᏙᎸᎩ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏄᏛᏁᎸᎩ.
\ft After these things Jesus shewed himself again to the disciples at the sea of Tiberias; and on this wise shewed he himself.

\ln Itsulaha aninvgi Sawani Quida, ale Dami Didima tsudoidv, ale Nedanili Gelili ehi Geni gaduhvi, ale Tsequidi tsuwetsi, ale anitali nvwanadale gvwasdawadidohi.
\syll ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎠᏂᏅᎩ ᏌᏩᏂ ᏈᏓ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᎻ ᏗᏗᎹ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᏁᏓᏂᎵ ᎨᎵᎵ ᎡᎯ ᎨᏂ ᎦᏚᎲᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏤᏈᏗ ᏧᏪᏥ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ.
\ft There were together Simon Peter, and Thomas called Didymus, and Nathanael of Cana in Galilee, and the sons of Zebedee, and two other of his disciples.

\ln Sawani Quida hia niduweselvgi; Tsigayaluni.  Hia nvgvwaweselvgi; Ayv nasquo dadesi.  Unenvsvgi, gilaquono iyvdv tsiyuhi unatsanvgi; nahiyuno svnoyi vtla gohusdi yuniniyvhei.
\syll ᏌᏩᏂ ᏈᏓ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏥᎦᏯᎷᏂ.  ᎯᎠ ᏅᎬᏩᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏓᏕᏏ.  ᎤᏁᏅᏒᎩ, ᎩᎳᏉᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏥᏳᎯ ᎤᎾᏣᏅᎩ; ᏀᎢᏳᏃ ᏒᏃᏱ ᎥᏝ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏳᏂᏂᏴᎮᎢ.
\ft Simon Peter saith unto them, I go a fishing. They say unto him, We also go with thee. They went forth, and entered into a ship immediately; and that night they caught nothing.

\ln Sunaleno nulistanv, Tsisa uwatlav gadogvgi; aseno gvwasdawadidohi vtla yanigatahe Tsisa gesvi.
\syll ᏑᎾᎴᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ, ᏥᏌ ᎤᏩᏝᎥ ᎦᏙᎬᎩ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎥᏝ ᏯᏂᎦᏔᎮ ᏥᏌ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft But when the morning was now come, Jesus stood on the shore: but the disciples knew not that it was Jesus.

\ln Hnaquono Tsisa hia niduweselvgi; Ditsiyoli, itsinisaatsu?  vtla, unadvnvgi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏗᏥᏲᎵ, ᎢᏥᏂᏌᎠᏧ?  ᎥᏝ, ᎤᎾᏛᏅᎩ.
\ft Then Jesus saith unto them, Children, have ye any meat? They answered him, No.

\ln Hiano niduweselvgi; Tsiyuhi agatisiditlv itsigayaluvga, dodatsiwadvhino.  Howano unigayalunvgi, hnaquono vtla yeli gvwanasehisdi yigesei, nvdagalisdodisgvgi unitsadv atsadi.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏥᏳᎯ ᎠᎦᏘᏏᏗᏢ ᎢᏥᎦᏯᎷᎥᎦ, ᏙᏓᏥᏩᏛᎯᏃ.  ᎰᏩᏃ ᎤᏂᎦᏯᎷᏅᎩ, ᎿᏉᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏰᎵ ᎬᏩᎾᏎᎯᏍᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ, ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᎤᏂᏣᏛ ᎠᏣᏗ.
\ft And he said unto them, Cast the net on the right side of the ship, and ye shall find. They cast therefore, and now they were not able to draw it for the multitude of fishes.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi adasdawadidohi Tsisa ugeyuhi hia nuweselvgi Quida; Ugvwiyuhi nasgi.  Hnaquono Sawani Quida udvganv nasgi Ugvwiyuhi gesvi, gadui unuwosdi udatlostanvgi, nidunuwavnayeno gesvgi, ale vdali wulitadinvsvgi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏓᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎤᎨᏳᎯ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ ᏈᏓ; ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ.  ᎿᏉᏃ ᏌᏩᏂ ᏈᏓ ᎤᏛᎦᏅ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎦᏚᎢ ᎤᏄᏬᏍᏗ ᎤᏓᏠᏍᏔᏅᎩ, ᏂᏚᏄᏩᎥᎾᏰᏃ ᎨᏒᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏓᎵ ᏭᎵᏔᏗᏅᏒᎩ.
\ft Therefore that disciple whom Jesus loved saith unto Peter, It is the Lord. Now when Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord, he girt his fisher's coat unto him, (for he was naked,) and did cast himself into the sea.

\ln Anisoino anadasdawadidohi tsiyu unatsodvgi, unilutsvgi, vtlayeno invhiyu yigese doyi, talitsuquiquo iyaligiyusquidv iyvdv nvwasdvgi, agayaludi atsadi akaliwohi aninasinehvgi.
\syll ᎠᏂᏐᎢᏃ ᎠᎾᏓᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏥᏳ ᎤᎾᏦᏛᎩ, ᎤᏂᎷᏨᎩ, ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᎢᏅᎯᏳ ᏱᎨᏎ ᏙᏱ, ᏔᎵᏧᏈᏉ ᎢᏯᎵᎩᏳᏍᏈᏛ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏅᏩᏍᏛᎩ, ᎠᎦᏯᎷᏗ ᎠᏣᏗ ᎠᎧᎵᏬᎯ ᎠᏂᎾᏏᏁᎲᎩ.
\ft And the other disciples came in a little ship; (for they were not far from land, but as it were two hundred cubits,) dragging the net with fishes.

\ln Unadugisvno unigohvgi atsilvha godvgi, atsadino vgvdavgi, ale gadu dahvgi.
\syll ᎤᎾᏚᎩᏒᏃ ᎤᏂᎪᎲᎩ ᎠᏥᎸᎭ ᎪᏛᎩ, ᎠᏣᏗᏃ ᎥᎬᏓᎥᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᏚ ᏓᎲᎩ.
\ft As soon then as they were come to land, they saw a fire of coals there, and fish laid thereon, and bread.

\ln Tsisa hia niduweselvgi; Editsinuga igadv atsadi gilaquo tsidetsiniyv.
\syll ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎡᏗᏥᏄᎦ ᎢᎦᏛ ᎠᏣᏗ ᎩᎳᏉ ᏥᏕᏥᏂᏴ.
\ft Jesus saith unto them, Bring of the fish which ye have now caught.

\ln Sawani Quida wutsanvgi, ale doyi wunasinolvgi agayaludi akaliwohi tsanequa atsadi, sgohitsuqui hisgisgohi tsoigali univgi.  Nasgisvgano nanivmu aseno agayaludi vtla yuyotsei.
\syll ᏌᏩᏂ ᏈᏓ ᏭᏣᏅᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏙᏱ ᏭᎾᏏᏃᎸᎩ ᎠᎦᏯᎷᏗ ᎠᎧᎵᏬᎯ ᏣᏁᏆ ᎠᏣᏗ, ᏍᎪᎯᏧᏈ ᎯᏍᎩᏍᎪᎯ ᏦᎢᎦᎵ ᎤᏂᎥᎩ.  ᎾᏍᎩᏒᎦᏃ ᎾᏂᎥᎽ ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᎦᏯᎷᏗ ᎥᏝ ᏳᏲᏤᎢ.
\ft Simon Peter went up, and drew the net to land full of great fishes, and hundred and fifty and three: and for all there were so many, yet was not the net broken.

\ln Tsisa hia niduweselvgi; Etsalisdayvnuga.  Vtlano gilo anadasdawadidohi, Gago nihi, gvwosedi yigesei, anigatahvgiyeno Ugvwiyuhi gesvi.
\syll ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎡᏣᎵᏍᏓᏴᏄᎦ.  ᎥᏝᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎠᎾᏓᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ, ᎦᎪ ᏂᎯ, ᎬᏬᏎᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ, ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎲᎩᏰᏃ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Jesus saith unto them, Come and dine. And none of the disciples durst ask him, Who art thou? knowing that it was the Lord.

\ln Tsisa ulutsvgi ugisvgi gadu ale dunelvgi, ale nasquo atsadi dunvnelvgi.
\syll ᏥᏌ ᎤᎷᏨᎩ ᎤᎩᏒᎩ ᎦᏚ ᎠᎴ ᏚᏁᎸᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏣᏗ ᏚᏅᏁᎸᎩ.
\ft Jesus then cometh, and taketh bread, and giveth them, and fish likewise.

\ln Nasgi hia hnaquo tsoine Tsisa gvnigesv nidudvnelv gvwasdawadidohi uyohusv dulenv nvdayudalenvdv.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎿᏉ ᏦᎢᏁ ᏥᏌ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᏚᏛᏁᎸ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎤᏲᎱᏒ ᏚᎴᏅ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᏛ.
\ft This is now the third time that Jesus shewed himself to his disciples, after that he was risen from the dead.

\ln Hnaquono unalisdayvnonv, Tsisa hia nuweselvgi Sawani Quida; Sawani, Tsona uwetsi, nihi utli nisgigeyuha esgaquo hia?  Hia nuweselvgi; Vv, Tsagvwiyuhi, higataha gvgeyuiyu gesvi.  Hia nuweselvgi; Dehelohesdi diquatseliga uninodena anigina.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᏃᏅ, ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ ᏌᏩᏂ ᏈᏓ; ᏌᏩᏂ, ᏦᎾ ᎤᏪᏥ, ᏂᎯ ᎤᏟ ᏂᏍᎩᎨᏳᎭ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎯᎠ?  ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎥᎥ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎯᎦᏔᎭ ᎬᎨᏳᎢᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ.  ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏕᎮᎶᎮᏍᏗ ᏗᏆᏤᎵᎦ ᎤᏂᏃᏕᎾ ᎠᏂᎩᎾ.
\ft So when they had dined, Jesus saith to Simon Peter, Simon, son of Jonas, lovest thou me more than these? He saith unto him, Yea, Lord; thou knowest that I love thee. He saith unto him, Feed my lambs.

\ln Talina hia nvuweselvgi; Sawani, Tsona uwetsi, sgigeyuhatsu?  Hia nuweselvgi; Vv Tsagvwiyuhi, higataha gvgeyuiyu gesvi.  Hia nuweselvgi; Dehelohesdi diquatseliga uninodena.
\syll ᏔᎵᎾ ᎯᎠ ᏅᎤᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏌᏩᏂ, ᏦᎾ ᎤᏪᏥ, ᏍᎩᎨᏳᎭᏧ?  ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎥᎥ ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎯᎦᏔᎭ ᎬᎨᏳᎢᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ.  ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏕᎮᎶᎮᏍᏗ ᏗᏆᏤᎵᎦ ᎤᏂᏃᏕᎾ.
\ft He saith to him again the second time, Simon, son of Jonas, lovest thou me? He saith unto him, Yea, Lord; thou knowest that I love thee. He saith unto him, Feed my sheep.

\ln Tsoine hia nuweselvgi; Sawani, Tsona uwetsi, sgigeyuhatsu?  Quida uyoiyu udanvdadvgi nvdayulisdotanvgi tsoine sgigeyuhatsu uwoselvi.  Hiano nuweselvgi; Tsagvwiyuhi nigav gohusdi higataha, higataha gvgeyuiyu gesvi.  Tsisa hia nuweselvgi; Dehelohesdi diquatseliga uninodena.
\syll ᏦᎢᏁ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏌᏩᏂ, ᏦᎾ ᎤᏪᏥ, ᏍᎩᎨᏳᎭᏧ?  ᏈᏓ ᎤᏲᎢᏳ ᎤᏓᏅᏓᏛᎩ ᏅᏓᏳᎵᏍᏙᏔᏅᎩ ᏦᎢᏁ ᏍᎩᎨᏳᎭᏧ ᎤᏬᏎᎸᎢ.  ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎯᎦᏔᎭ, ᎯᎦᏔᎭ ᎬᎨᏳᎢᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ.  ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏕᎮᎶᎮᏍᏗ ᏗᏆᏤᎵᎦ ᎤᏂᏃᏕᎾ.
\ft He saith unto him the third time, Simon, son of Jonas, lovest thou me? Peter was grieved because he said unto him the third time, Lovest thou me? And he said unto him, Lord, thou knowest all things; thou knowest that I love thee. Jesus saith unto him, Feed my sheep.

\ln Udohiyuhiya, udohiyuhiya hia nigvweseha; Hiwinv tsigesvgi tsvsv hadatlohihvgi, ale tsadulisgv hedohvgi; tsadvsonvhisgini gesesdi dotasolvtani, nvwadaleno datsatloli, ale nitsadulisgvna gesv wvdatsatinvstani.
\syll ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ, ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏪᏎᎭ; ᎯᏫᏅ ᏥᎨᏒᎩ ᏨᏒ ᎭᏓᏠᎯᎲᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏣᏚᎵᏍᎬ ᎮᏙᎲᎩ; ᏣᏛᏐᏅᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏙᏔᏐᎸᏔᏂ, ᏅᏩᏓᎴᏃ ᏓᏣᏠᎵ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᏣᏚᎵᏍᎬᎾ ᎨᏒ ᏮᏓᏣᏘᏅᏍᏔᏂ.
\ft Verily, verily, I say unto thee, When thou wast young, thou girdedst thyself, and walkedst whither thou wouldest: but when thou shalt be old, thou shalt stretch forth thy hands, and another shall gird thee, and carry thee whither thou wouldest not.

\ln Nasgi nuwesvgi uwedvtsvgi iyulisdanediyi uyohuhisdiyi gesvi, nasgino ulvquododiyi Unelanvhi.  Nasgino newesv, hia nuweselvgi; Sgisdawaduga.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ ᎤᏪᏛᏨᎩ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᎤᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᎸᏉᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ.  ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏁᏪᏒ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏍᎩᏍᏓᏩᏚᎦ.
\ft This spake he, signifying by what death he should glorify God. And when he had spoken this, he saith unto him, Follow me.

\ln Quidano ugatahvsv ugohvgi adasdawadisvgi Tsisa ugeyuhi adasdawadidohi, nasgi usdvgalvnvhi Tsisa ganetsiyi analisdayvhvsgvi, ale hia iyuwedv tsigi; Tsagvwiyuhi, gago nasgi tsatludisgi.
\syll ᏈᏓᏃ ᎤᎦᏔᎲᏒ ᎤᎪᎲᎩ ᎠᏓᏍᏓᏩᏗᏒᎩ ᏥᏌ ᎤᎨᏳᎯ ᎠᏓᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏍᏛᎦᎸᏅᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᏁᏥᏱ ᎠᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᎢᏳᏪᏛ ᏥᎩ; ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎦᎪ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏣᏡᏗᏍᎩ.
\ft Then Peter, turning about, seeth the disciple whom Jesus loved following; which also leaned on his breast at supper, and said, Lord, which is he that betrayeth thee?

\ln Quida nasgi ugohv, hia nuweselvgi Tsisa; Tsagvwiyuhi, hianano gadoi?
\syll ᏈᏓ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎪᎲ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ ᏥᏌ; ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎯᎠᎾᏃ ᎦᏙᎢ?
\ft Peter seeing him saith to Jesus, Lord, and what shall this man do?

\ln Tsisa hia nuweselvgi; Iyuno tsilutsvha gvdisgi ehesdi yaquelisv, gado nasgi tsvdodi?  Sgisdawadugaquo.
\syll ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᏥᎷᏨᎭ ᎬᏗᏍᎩ ᎡᎮᏍᏗ ᏯᏇᎵᏒ, ᎦᏙ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏨᏙᏗ?  ᏍᎩᏍᏓᏩᏚᎦᏉ.
\ft Jesus saith unto him, If I will that he tarry till I come, what is that to thee? follow thou me.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi anadanvtli anehv uyelisvgi hia naniwesgvi, nasgi adasdawadidohi vtla advyohusi.  Aseno Tsisa vtla yvdvyohusi vtla yuwoselei, hiaquosgini nuweselvgi; Iyuno tsilutsvha gvdisgi ehesdi yaquelisv, gado nasgi tsvdodi.

\syll ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳᏃ ᎾᏂᏪᏍᎨ ᎨᏥᏪᏍᎨ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏛ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎾᏅᏁᎲ ᏕᏅᎴᎯᏌᏅ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ; ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎨᎦᏓᏅᏖᏍᎨᎢ.
\ft And with great power gave the apostles witness of the resurrection of the Lord Jesus: and great grace was upon them all.

\ln Vtla ale gilo yudasuye yunigvgei, nanivyeno gada ale dadanelv tsunihi duninadinvsei, nasgino uninadinvdv tsugvwalanvhi uniyolei,
\syll ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᏳᏓᏑᏰ ᏳᏂᎬᎨᎢ, ᎾᏂᎥᏰᏃ ᎦᏓ ᎠᎴ ᏓᏓᏁᎸ ᏧᏂᎯ ᏚᏂᎾᏗᏅᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᏂᎾᏗᏅᏛ ᏧᎬᏩᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏂᏲᎴᎢ,
\ft Neither was there any among them that lacked: for as many as were possessors of lands or houses sold them, and brought the prices of the things that were sold,

\ln Ale unine getsinvsidv tsunalasidenulodi, nanivno nasgiya uninigvsehv getsiyadohehei.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏁ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏛ ᏧᎾᎳᏏᏕᏄᎶᏗ, ᎾᏂᎥᏃ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎤᏂᏂᎬᏎᎲ ᎨᏥᏯᏙᎮᎮᎢ.
\ft And laid them down at the apostles' feet: and distribution was made unto every man according as he had need.

\ln Tsosino getsinvsidv Quaniqua tsidunoei, nasgi gadvgv osdv adanvdadisdi uwetsi, Aliwi Saqui udenvhi,
\syll ᏦᏏᏃ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏛ ᏆᏂᏆ ᏥᏚᏃᎡᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏛᎬ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎠᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗ ᎤᏪᏥ, ᎠᎵᏫ ᏌᏈ ᎤᏕᏅᎯ,
\ft And Joses, who by the apostles was surnamed Barnabas, (which is, being interpreted, The son of consolation,) a Levite, and of the country of Cyprus,

\ln Gada uhei, unadinvsei, ale adelv duyolei, ale nasgi deune getsinvsidv tsunalasidenulodi.
\syll ᎦᏓ ᎤᎮᎢ, ᎤᎾᏗᏅᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏕᎸ ᏚᏲᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏕᎤᏁ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏛ ᏧᎾᎳᏏᏕᏄᎶᏗ.
\ft Having land, sold it, and brought the money, and laid it at the apostles' feet.

\ln Gilono iyusdi asgaya Eninaya tsudoidv, udaliino Saquoli uninadinvse gohusdi unihvi,
\syll ᎩᎶᏃ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎡᏂᎾᏯ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ, ᎤᏓᎵᎢᏃ ᏌᏉᎵ ᎤᏂᎾᏗᏅᏎ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏂᎲᎢ,
\ft But a certain man named Ananias, with Sapphira his wife, sold a possession,

\ln Ale uhiye igadv tsugvwalanvhi, ale udalii nasquo agatahei; uyoleno igadv, ale getsinvsidv tsunalasidenulodi unei.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎤᎯᏰ ᎢᎦᏛ ᏧᎬᏩᎳᏅᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᎵᎢ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᎦᏔᎮᎢ; ᎤᏲᎴᏃ ᎢᎦᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏛ ᏧᎾᎳᏏᏕᏄᎶᏗ ᎤᏁᎢ.
\ft And kept back part of the price, his wife also being privy to it, and brought a certain part, and laid it at the apostles' feet.

\ln Quidano hia nuwesei; Eninaya, gadono Sedani tsanawi itsakalielv, hiyatsigonediyi Galvquodiyu Adanvdo, ale tsahiyasdiyi igadv nasgi gada tsugvwalanvhi.
\syll ᏈᏓᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎡᏂᎾᏯ, ᎦᏙᏃ ᏎᏓᏂ ᏣᎾᏫ ᎢᏣᎧᎵᎡᎸ, ᎯᏯᏥᎪᏁᏗᏱ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ, ᎠᎴ ᏣᎯᏯᏍᏗᏱ ᎢᎦᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏓ ᏧᎬᏩᎳᏅᎯ.
\ft But Peter said, Ananias, why hath Satan filled thine heart to lie to the Holy Ghost, and to keep back part of the price of the land?

\ln Tsinvwasdvquo tlasgo tsatseligaya yigesei?  Tsanadinvno tlasgo yitsahe hadanvtesgvquo itsvnediyi?  Gadono hia nasgi niusdi itsotlvnv tsanawiyi?  Vtlasgini yvwiquo yigiyatsigonelv, Unelanvhisgini hiyatsigonelv.
\syll ᏥᏅᏩᏍᏛᏉ ᏝᏍᎪ ᏣᏤᎵᎦᏯ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ?  ᏣᎾᏗᏅᏃ ᏝᏍᎪ ᏱᏣᎮ ᎭᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬᏉ ᎢᏨᏁᏗᏱ?  ᎦᏙᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎤᏍᏗ ᎢᏦᏢᏅ ᏣᎾᏫᏱ?  ᎥᏝᏍᎩᏂ ᏴᏫᏉ ᏱᎩᏯᏥᎪᏁᎸ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎯᏯᏥᎪᏁᎸ.
\ft Whiles it remained, was it not thine own? and after it was sold, was it not in thine own power? why hast thou conceived this thing in thine heart? thou hast not lied unto men, but unto God.

\ln Eninayano nasgi udvganv unvtse ale ulisquadelei.  Nanivno nasgi nulistanvi unadvganvhi utsatanvhi uninayesei.
\syll ᎡᏂᎾᏯᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏛᎦᏅ ᎤᏅᏤ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᏕᎴᎢ.  ᎾᏂᎥᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎢ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅᎯ ᎤᏣᏔᏅᎯ ᎤᏂᎾᏰᏎᎢ.
\ft And Ananias hearing these words fell down, and gave up the ghost: and great fear came on all them that heard these things.

\ln aniwinvno dunalene ale unitsanulanei, uninawidvhvno wuninisanei.
\syll ᎠᏂᏫᏅᏃ ᏚᎾᎴᏁ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏣᏄᎳᏁᎢ, ᎤᏂᎾᏫᏛᎲᏃ ᏭᏂᏂᏌᏁᎢ.
\ft And the young men arose, wound him up, and carried him out, and buried him.

\ln Tsoihano iyutlilodv iyvdv oni udalii uyvlilei, nagatahvna gese nulistanvi,
\syll ᏦᎢᎭᏃ ᎢᏳᏟᎶᏛ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎣᏂ ᎤᏓᎵᎢ ᎤᏴᎵᎴᎢ, ᎾᎦᏔᎲᎾ ᎨᏎ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎢ,
\ft And it was about the space of three hours after, when his wife, not knowing what was done, came in.

\ln Quidano hia ninvweselei; Sginohvsi, tsigo nasgiquo igai desdagvwalanele nasgi gadohi?  Hiano nuwesei; Vv, nasgiquo igai.
\syll ᏈᏓᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏅᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᏍᎩᏃᎲᏏ, ᏥᎪ ᎾᏍᎩᏉ ᎢᎦᎢ ᏕᏍᏓᎬᏩᎳᏁᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏙᎯ?  ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎥᎥ, ᎾᏍᎩᏉ ᎢᎦᎢ.
\ft And Peter answered unto her, Tell me whether ye sold the land for so much? And she said, Yea, for so much.

\ln Hnaquono Quida hia nuweselei; Gadono tsisdaligonv esdigoliyediyi Ugvwiyuhi utseli Adanvdo?  Gvniyuquo aquo galohisdiyi tsunalasideni tsayehi gvwanisanvhi, nasgino nihi dvgetsanawidvhi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏈᏓ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎦᏙᏃ ᏥᏍᏓᎵᎪᏅ ᎡᏍᏗᎪᎵᏰᏗᏱ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ?  ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎠᏉ ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏧᎾᎳᏏᏕᏂ ᏣᏰᎯ ᎬᏩᏂᏌᏅᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏂᎯ ᏛᎨᏣᎾᏫᏛᎯ.
\ft Then Peter said unto her, How is it that ye have agreed together to tempt the Spirit of the Lord? behold, the feet of them which have buried thy husband are at the door, and shall carry thee out.

\ln Gilaquono iyvdv tsulasidenulodi unvtsei, ale ulisquadelei.  Aniwinvno uniyvlv uniwadvhe uyohusvhi igesei, uninawidvhvno wuninisane uyehi wiganvi.
\syll ᎩᎳᏉᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏧᎳᏏᏕᏄᎶᏗ ᎤᏅᏤᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᏕᎴᎢ.  ᎠᏂᏫᏅᏃ ᎤᏂᏴᎸ ᎤᏂᏩᏛᎮ ᎤᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᎢᎨᏎᎢ, ᎤᏂᎾᏫᏛᎲᏃ ᏭᏂᏂᏌᏁ ᎤᏰᎯ ᏫᎦᏅᎢ.
\ft Then fell she down straightway at his feet, and yielded up the ghost: and the young men came in, and found her dead, and, carrying her forth, buried her by her husband.

\ln Nigadvno tsunanelodi unadatlugv utsatanvhi uninayesei, ale nasquo nigadv hia nasgi nulistanv anadvgisgi.
\syll ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬ ᎤᏣᏔᏅᎯ ᎤᏂᎾᏰᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ ᎠᎾᏛᎩᏍᎩ.
\ft And great fear came upon all the church, and upon as many as heard these things.

\ln Getsinvsidvno utsate uyelvdv ale usquanigodi dunilvwisdanehe yvwi anehvi.  Nigadvno saquo igagadv anine Solimanv utseli ayodatlahvi.
\syll ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏛᏃ ᎤᏣᏖ ᎤᏰᎸᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᏚᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎮ ᏴᏫ ᎠᏁᎲᎢ.  ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᏌᏉ ᎢᎦᎦᏛ ᎠᏂᏁ ᏐᎵᎹᏅ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎠᏲᏓᏝᎲᎢ.
\ft And by the hands of the apostles were many signs and wonders wrought among the people; (and they were all with one accord in Solomon's porch.

\ln Anisoino anisgaihe gvwanaligonediyi; unitsatisgini yvwi gvwanilvquodiyu gesei.
\syll ᎠᏂᏐᎢᏃ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᎢᎮ ᎬᏩᎾᎵᎪᏁᏗᏱ; ᎤᏂᏣᏘᏍᎩᏂ ᏴᏫ ᎬᏩᏂᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏎᎢ.
\ft And of the rest durst no man join himself to them: but the people magnified them.

\ln Anohiyuhvsgino utli nigae gvwanequotsele Ugvwiyuhi, unitsatanvhi gese anisgaya ale anigeyv.
\syll ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᏟ ᏂᎦᎡ ᎬᏩᏁᏉᏤᎴ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎤᏂᏣᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏎ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᎨᏴ.
\ft And believers were the more added to the Lord, multitudes both of men and women.)

\ln Dudlanvdvyeno daninohihe tsunitlvgi, ditsesdo ale diganitli danitlvdisgei nasgi udawadisdvquo nasquo Quida aisvi igadv unutlvdodiyi.
\syll ᏚᏜᏅᏛᏰᏃ ᏓᏂᏃᎯᎮ ᏧᏂᏢᎩ, ᏗᏤᏍᏙ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎦᏂᏟ ᏓᏂᏢᏗᏍᎨᎢ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏓᏩᏗᏍᏛᏉ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏈᏓ ᎠᎢᏒᎢ ᎢᎦᏛ ᎤᏄᏢᏙᏗᏱ.
\ft Insomuch that they brought forth the sick into the streets, and laid them on beds and couches, that at the least the shadow of Peter passing by might overshadow some of them.

\ln Nasquono unitsate degaduwadisv nvdayunilosvhi Tsilusilimi anilugei, danatenohihe tsunitlvgi ale anisgina gvwaniyilidohi; nigadvno degetsinvwanei.
\syll ᎾᏍᏉᏃ ᎤᏂᏣᏖ ᏕᎦᏚᏩᏗᏒ ᏅᏓᏳᏂᎶᏒᎯ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᎠᏂᎷᎨᎢ, ᏓᎾᏖᏃᎯᎮ ᏧᏂᏢᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏍᎩᎾ ᎬᏩᏂᏱᎵᏙᎯ; ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᏕᎨᏥᏅᏩᏁᎢ.
\ft There came also a multitude out of the cities round about unto Jerusalem, bringing sick folks, and them which were vexed with unclean spirits: and they were healed every one.

\ln Hnaquono nugvwiyusv atsilvgelohi dulenv ale nigadv gvwaligonehi, nasgi Anisadusi tsunadoidv tsigi, unikalitse unitalawosgvi;
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸᎨᎶᎯ ᏚᎴᏅ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎬᏩᎵᎪᏁᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏂᏌᏚᏏ ᏧᎾᏙᎢᏛ ᏥᎩ, ᎤᏂᎧᎵᏤ ᎤᏂᏔᎳᏬᏍᎬᎢ;
\ft Then the high priest rose up, and all they that were with him, (which is the sect of the Sadducees,) and were filled with indignation,

\ln Ale duniniyvhe getsinvsidv ale didasdudiyi duniyvtanei.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏚᏂᏂᏴᎮ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏛ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏓᏍᏚᏗᏱ ᏚᏂᏴᏔᏁᎢ.
\ft And laid their hands on the apostles, and put them in the common prison.

\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᏒᏃᏱ ᏚᏍᏚᎢᏎ ᏗᏓᏍᏚᏗᏱ ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ, ᏚᏄᎪᏫᏒᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ;
\ft But the angel of the Lord by night opened the prison doors, and brought them forth, and said,

\ln Itsena, udvnvdigalawiisdiyi witsalehvga ale widitsiwoneda yvwi widitsinohvsi nigadv kanohedv hia nasgi gvnidv ugvwali.
\syll ᎢᏤᎾ, ᎤᏛᏅᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᏫᏣᎴᎲᎦ ᎠᎴ ᏫᏗᏥᏬᏁᏓ ᏴᏫ ᏫᏗᏥᏃᎲᏏ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ.
\ft Go, stand and speak in the temple to the people all the words of this life.

\ln Nasgino unadvganv gila tsugitsisgoi wuniyvle udvnvdigalawiisdiyi ale dunadeyonei.  Aseno nugvwiyusv atsilvgelohi ulutsv, ale nasgi gvwaligonehi, dunitlisane dinilawigi, ale nigadv nunigvwiyusadegi Isili tsuwetsi tsunatseliga, ale widayanvhv unadanvse didasdudiyi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅ ᎩᎳ ᏧᎩᏥᏍᎪᎢ ᏭᏂᏴᎴ ᎤᏛᏅᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᏚᎾᏕᏲᏁᎢ.  ᎠᏎᏃ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸᎨᎶᎯ ᎤᎷᏨ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏩᎵᎪᏁᎯ, ᏚᏂᏟᏌᏁ ᏗᏂᎳᏫᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ ᎢᏏᎵ ᏧᏪᏥ ᏧᎾᏤᎵᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᏫᏓᏯᏅᎲ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏎ ᏗᏓᏍᏚᏗᏱ.
\ft And when they heard that, they entered into the temple early in the morning, and taught. But the high priest came, and they that were with him, and called the council together, and all the senate of the children of Israel and sent to the prison to have them brought.

\ln Aseno dinadaniyisgi wunilutsv widunatlotse didasdudiyi, diunatsvsvno uninonei,
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᏗᎾᏓᏂᏱᏍᎩ ᏭᏂᎷᏨ ᏫᏚᎾᏠᏤ ᏗᏓᏍᏚᏗᏱ, ᏗᎤᎾᏨᏒᏃ ᎤᏂᏃᏁᎢ,
\ft But when the officers came, and found them not in the prison, they returned, and told,

\ln Hia nuniwesei; Didasdudiyi udohiyuhi ogiwadvhv ulinigidiyu asduhvgi, ale anigatiya anidonav doyiditlv galohisdiyulodi, aseno ogisduisv vtla gilo yotsiwadvhe yiyaei.
\syll ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ; ᏗᏓᏍᏚᏗᏱ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎣᎩᏩᏛᎲ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ ᎠᏍᏚᎲᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᎦᏘᏯ ᎠᏂᏙᎾᎥ ᏙᏱᏗᏢ ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏳᎶᏗ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎣᎩᏍᏚᎢᏒ ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᏲᏥᏩᏛᎮ ᏱᏯᎡᎢ.
\ft Saying, The prison truly found we shut with all safety, and the keepers standing without before the doors: but when we had opened, we found no man within.

\ln Hnaquono atsilvgelohi ale osdv iyuwahnadegi udvnvdigalawiisdiyi, ale nunigvwiyusv atsilvanelohi, nasgi hia nuniwesv unadvganv, nasgi unadanvtetanei, Hatlv wvdvsditsi hia, unelisei.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎠᏥᎸᎨᎶᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎢᏳᏩᎿᏕᎩ ᎤᏛᏅᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸᎠᏁᎶᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏖᏔᏁᎢ, ᎭᏢ ᏮᏛᏍᏗᏥ ᎯᎠ, ᎤᏁᎵᏎᎢ.
\ft Now when the high priest and the captain of the temple and the chief priests heard these things, they doubted of them whereunto this would grow.

\ln Hnaquono gilo ulutse uninonele hia nuwesei; Gvniyuquo nasgi anisgaya didasdudiyi tsidetsiyvtanvgi aniyaa udvnvdigalawiisdiyi, anidonaa, ale daneyohvsga yvwi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎤᎷᏤ ᎤᏂᏃᏁᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ ᏗᏓᏍᏚᏗᏱ ᏥᏕᏥᏴᏔᏅᎩ ᎠᏂᏯᎠ ᎤᏛᏅᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᏂᏙᎾᎠ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᏁᏲᎲᏍᎦ ᏴᏫ.
\ft Then came one and told them, saying, Behold, the men whom ye put in prison are standing in the temple, and teaching the people.

\ln Hnaquono osdv iyuwahnadegi ale dinadaniyisgi gvsgaisdagi nidunvnelvna widuniyanvhei; danisgaiheyeno unitsati, nvya yidegogvnisda anelisgei.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎢᏳᏩᎿᏕᎩ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎾᏓᏂᏱᏍᎩ ᎬᏍᎦᎢᏍᏓᎩ ᏂᏚᏅᏁᎸᎾ ᏫᏚᏂᏯᏅᎮᎢ; ᏓᏂᏍᎦᎢᎮᏰᏃ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ, ᏅᏯ ᏱᏕᎪᎬᏂᏍᏓ ᎠᏁᎵᏍᎨᎢ.
\ft Then went the captain with the officers, and brought them without violence: for they feared the people, lest they should have been stoned.

\ln Dunatinolvno degalawiv igvyiditlv sunikanei.  Nugvwiyusvno atsilvgelohi dudvdvnei,
\syll ᏚᎾᏘᏃᎸᏃ ᏕᎦᎳᏫᎥ ᎢᎬᏱᏗᏢ ᏑᏂᎧᏁᎢ.  ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒᏃ ᎠᏥᎸᎨᎶᎯ ᏚᏛᏛᏁᎢ,
\ft And when they had brought them, they set them before the council: and the high priest asked them,

\ln Hia nuwesei; Tlasgo ulinigidvya yitsvnvsdadele ditsadeyodiyi hia nasgi deudov itsvdodiyi?  Gvniyuquono detsadeyohvsgv Tsilusilimi itsikaliistanv, ale nasgi asgaya ugigv ogisdvdisdiyi, itsiyelvha.
\syll ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᏝᏍᎪ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛᏯ ᏱᏨᏅᏍᏓᏕᎴ ᏗᏣᏕᏲᏗᏱ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏕᎤᏙᎥ ᎢᏨᏙᏗᏱ?  ᎬᏂᏳᏉᏃ ᏕᏣᏕᏲᎲᏍᎬ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᎢᏥᎧᎵᎢᏍᏔᏅ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᎩᎬ ᎣᎩᏍᏛᏗᏍᏗᏱ, ᎢᏥᏰᎸᎭ.
\ft Saying, Did not we straitly command you that ye should not teach in this name? and, behold, ye have filled Jerusalem with your doctrine, and intend to bring this man's blood upon us.

\ln Quidano ale getsinvsidv uninetsv hia nuniwesei; Unelanvhi otsohiyudi, vtlano yvwi.
\syll ᏈᏓᏃ ᎠᎴ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏛ ᎤᏂᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ; ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎣᏦᎯᏳᏗ, ᎥᏝᏃ ᏴᏫ.
\ft Then Peter and the other apostles answered and said, We ought to obey God rather than men.

\ln Unelanvhi digidoda unatseliga deuletanv Tsisa, nasgi tsetsilvgi gedv tsetsadvnvgi.
\syll ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏗᎩᏙᏓ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ ᏕᎤᎴᏔᏅ ᏥᏌ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏤᏥᎸᎩ ᎨᏛ ᏤᏣᏛᏅᎩ.
\ft The God of our fathers raised up Jesus, whom ye slew and hanged on a tree.

\ln Nasgi Unelanvhi usaladanv agatisi uwoyeni uwatanv, Ugvwiyuhi ale Adasdelisgi iyulisdodiyi, Isili tsunediyi tsuninetliyvsdiyi dunadanvdvi, ale gagetsinediyi unisganvtsvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏌᎳᏓᏅ ᎠᎦᏘᏏ ᎤᏬᏰᏂ ᎤᏩᏔᏅ, ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏓᏍᏕᎵᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎢᏏᎵ ᏧᏁᏗᏱ ᏧᏂᏁᏟᏴᏍᏗᏱ ᏚᎾᏓᏅᏛᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᎨᏥᏁᏗᏱ ᎤᏂᏍᎦᏅᏨᎢ.
\ft Him hath God exalted with his right hand to be a Prince and a Saviour, for to give repentance to Israel, and forgiveness of sins.

\syll ᎠᏴᏃ ᏧᏤᎵ ᎣᏥᏃᎮᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏍᏛᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎬᏬᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ.
\ft And we are his witnesses of these things; and so is also the Holy Ghost, whom God hath given to them that obey him.

\ln Nasgino unadvganv dunitile tsuninawiyi, ale tsunihisdiyi uniyilidolei.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅ ᏚᏂᏘᎴ ᏧᏂᎾᏫᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏂᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏂᏱᎵᏙᎴᎢ.
\ft When they heard that, they were cut to the heart, and took counsel to slay them.

\ln Hnaquono degalawivi gilo iyusdi dulene Aqualisi Gemeli tsudoidv dikahnawadvsdi digosisisgi naniv yvwi gvwalvquodi, ale unetse getsinvsidv tlega tsunikahvsdiyi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏕᎦᎳᏫᎥᎢ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏚᎴᏁ ᎠᏆᎵᏏ ᎨᎺᎵ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏗᎪᏏᏏᏍᎩ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏴᏫ ᎬᏩᎸᏉᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᏤ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏛ ᏞᎦ ᏧᏂᎧᎲᏍᏗᏱ.
\ft Then stood there up one in the council, a Pharisee, named Gamaliel, a doctor of the law, had in reputation among all the people, and commanded to put the apostles forth a little space;

\ln Hiano niduweselei; Itsisgaya Isili tsuwetsi itseyatahesdi nusdv itsadanvtesgv idiyunediyi hia anisgaya.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎢᏥᏍᎦᏯ ᎢᏏᎵ ᏧᏪᏥ ᎢᏤᏯᏔᎮᏍᏗ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ ᎢᏗᏳᏁᏗᏱ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ.
\ft And said unto them, Ye men of Israel, take heed to yourselves what ye intend to do as touching these men.

\ln Ilvhiyuyeno tsunanugotse Dudasi gilo tsutselvsei, anisgaya nvgitsuqui iyvdv iyanidv tsigvwaligonelei, nasgi tsatsilei, ale nigadv nasgi gvwohiyunvhi tsunadigaleyotse ale tsiwigvwaniyotsidolequo.
\syll ᎢᎸᎯᏳᏰᏃ ᏧᎾᏄᎪᏤ ᏚᏓᏏ ᎩᎶ ᏧᏤᎸᏎᎢ, ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ ᏅᎩᏧᏈ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᏥᎬᏩᎵᎪᏁᎴᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏣᏥᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏬᎯᏳᏅᎯ ᏧᎾᏗᎦᎴᏲᏤ ᎠᎴ ᏥᏫᎬᏩᏂᏲᏥᏙᎴᏉ.
\ft For before these days rose up Theudas, boasting himself to be somebody; to whom a number of men, about four hundred, joined themselves: who was slain; and all, as many as obeyed him, were scattered, and brought to nought.

\ln Onino tsunanugotse Tsudasi Gelili ehi tsanaselidohe iyui, ale unitsati yvwi tsidutihnawidvhei, nasgino nasquo tsiuyohusei ale nigadv naniv gvwohiyunvhi tsunadigaleyotsei.
\syll ᎣᏂᏃ ᏧᎾᏄᎪᏤ ᏧᏓᏏ ᎨᎵᎵ ᎡᎯ ᏣᎾᏎᎵᏙᎮ ᎢᏳᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏴᏫ ᏥᏚᏘᎿᏫᏛᎮᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏥᎤᏲᎱᏎᎢ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎬᏬᎯᏳᏅᎯ ᏧᎾᏗᎦᎴᏲᏤᎢ.
\ft After this man rose up Judas of Galilee in the days of the taxing, and drew away much people after him: he also perished; and all, even as many as obeyed him, were dispersed.

\ln Hnaquono hia nitsvweseha, Tlesdi ditsalisalanelv hia anisgaya, unanelagi ditselisi, iyuyeno hia anadanvtesgv ale dunilvwisdanehv yvwiquo nvdayudalenvhi igesesdi, uyotsidasdiquo;
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᏗᏣᎵᏌᎳᏁᎸ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ, ᎤᎾᏁᎳᎩ ᏗᏤᎵᏏ, ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎠᎾᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ ᎠᎴ ᏚᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᏴᏫᏉ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎤᏲᏥᏓᏍᏗᏉ;
\ft And now I say unto you, Refrain from these men, and let them alone: for if this counsel or this work be of men, it will come to nought:

\ln Unelanvhisgini nvdayudalenvhi igesesdi, vtla yeli yvgetsiyosda; yaligadudagiyeno Unelanvhiquo tsetsatliyvehi gesvi.
\syll ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎥᏝ ᏰᎵ ᏴᎨᏥᏲᏍᏓ; ᏯᎵᎦᏚᏓᎩᏰᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏉ ᏤᏣᏟᏴᎡᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft But if it be of God, ye cannot overthrow it; lest haply ye be found even to fight against God.

\ln Nasgino gvwohiyunei; widuniyanvhvno getsinvsidv ale dunilivnilv, duninvsdadele Tsisa dudov unineisdodiyi, ale dunikanei.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎬᏬᎯᏳᏁᎢ; ᏫᏚᏂᏯᏅᎲᏃ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏛ ᎠᎴ ᏚᏂᎵᎥᏂᎸ, ᏚᏂᏅᏍᏓᏕᎴ ᏥᏌ ᏚᏙᎥ ᎤᏂᏁᎢᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏂᎧᏁᎢ.
\ft And to him they agreed: and when they had called the apostles, and beaten them, they commanded that they should not speak in the name of Jesus, and let them go.

\ln Uninugotseno degalawivi analihelige yeli udehohisdi igvwanalisdanedi gesv nasgi deudov nvdigalisdosgvi.
\syll ᎤᏂᏄᎪᏤᏃ ᏕᎦᎳᏫᎥᎢ ᎠᎾᎵᎮᎵᎨ ᏰᎵ ᎤᏕᎰᎯᏍᏗ ᎢᎬᏩᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏕᎤᏙᎥ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏍᎬᎢ.
\ft And they departed from the presence of the council, rejoicing that they were counted worthy to suffer shame for his name.

\ln Nidugitsvnisvno udvnvdigalawiisdiyi ale dadaneladisv nanisuligogvna gese danadeyohvsge ale analitsidohvsge osdv kanohedv Tsisa Galonedv ugvwali.
\syll ᏂᏚᎩᏨᏂᏒᏃ ᎤᏛᏅᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᏓᏓᏁᎳᏗᏒ ᎾᏂᏑᎵᎪᎬᎾ ᎨᏎ ᏓᎾᏕᏲᎲᏍᎨ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎾᎵᏥᏙᎲᏍᎨ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ.

\ln Nahiyuno anohiyuhvsgi unitsatanv, Anigoi uniwonihisdi aniwonisgi gohusdi danosehe Aniquilu, nvdigalisdodisge nigegagasayasdvna gesv tsunatseli anigeyv tsunosulotsvhi nidugitsvnisv aniyadohihvi.
\syll ᏀᎢᏳᏃ ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᏣᏔᏅ, ᎠᏂᎪᎢ ᎤᏂᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᎠᏂᏬᏂᏍᎩ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏓᏃᏎᎮ ᎠᏂᏈᎷ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨ ᏂᎨᎦᎦᏌᏯᏍᏛᎾ ᎨᏒ ᏧᎾᏤᎵ ᎠᏂᎨᏴ ᏧᏃᏑᎶᏨᎯ ᏂᏚᎩᏨᏂᏒ ᎠᏂᏯᏙᎯᎲᎢ.
\ft And in those days, when the number of the disciples was multiplied, there arose a murmuring of the Grecians against the Hebrews, because their widows were neglected in the daily ministration.

\ln Hnaquono taladu iyanidv unitsati anohiyuhvsgi widuniyanvhv hia nuniwesei; Vtla duyugodv yigagi iyuno yidogiyosga Unelanvhi utseli kanohedv degasgilvno yidogilvwisdaneha.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏔᎳᏚ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᏫᏚᏂᏯᏅᎲ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ; ᎥᏝ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᏱᎦᎩ ᎢᏳᏃ ᏱᏙᎩᏲᏍᎦ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏕᎦᏍᎩᎸᏃ ᏱᏙᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎭ.
\ft Then the twelve called the multitude of the disciples unto them, and said, It is not reason that we should leave the word of God, and serve tables.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi, idadanvtli, itsvsv itsadatlugv ditsasuyagi galiquogi iyanidv anisgaya osdv getsinohesgi unikalitsvhi Galvquodiyu Adanvdo ale anigatanai, nasgi hia tsunilvwisdanediyi digayotsinetsedi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᎢᏓᏓᏅᏟ, ᎢᏨᏒ ᎢᏣᏓᏡᎬ ᏗᏣᏑᏯᎩ ᎦᎵᏉᎩ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎨᏥᏃᎮᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᎧᎵᏨᎯ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎾᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᏗᎦᏲᏥᏁᏤᏗ.
\ft Wherefore, brethren, look ye out among you seven men of honest report, full of the Holy Ghost and wisdom, whom we may appoint over this business.

\ln Ayvsgini nigahilv adadolisdodi gesv ale kanohedv dodayogilvwisdanedi.
\syll ᎠᏴᏍᎩᏂ ᏂᎦᎯᎸ ᎠᏓᏙᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏙᏓᏲᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ.
\ft But we will give ourselves continually to prayer, and to the ministry of the word.

\ln Nasgino nuniwesvi osiyu uniyelvne nigadv unitsati gesvi; ale unasuyese Sdiwi, asgaya ukalitsvhi uwohiyusv ale Galvquodiyu Adanvdo, ale Quiligi ale Quogola ale Nagena ale Tamani ale Quamina ale Nigi Vtiogi ehi Anitsusi tsuligonelvhi;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎢ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎤᏂᏰᎸᏁ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏑᏰᏎ ᏍᏗᏫ, ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᎧᎵᏨᎯ ᎤᏬᎯᏳᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ, ᎠᎴ ᏈᎵᎩ ᎠᎴ ᏉᎪᎳ ᎠᎴ ᎾᎨᎾ ᎠᎴ ᏔᎹᏂ ᎠᎴ ᏆᎻᎾ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎩ ᎥᏘᎣᎩ ᎡᎯ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᏧᎵᎪᏁᎸᎯ;
\ft And the saying pleased the whole multitude: and they chose Stephen, a man full of faith and of the Holy Ghost, and Philip, and Prochorus, and Nicanor, and Timon, and Parmenas, and Nicolas a proselyte of Antioch:

\ln Nasgino getsinvsidv aninv igvyiditlv dunikanei; [getsinvsidvno] unadadolistanv dunasitadei.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏛ ᎠᏂᏅ ᎢᎬᏱᏗᏢ ᏚᏂᎧᏁᎢ; ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏛᏃdata is invalid ᎤᎾᏓᏙᎵᏍᏔᏅ ᏚᎾᏏᏔᏕᎢ.
\ft Whom they set before the apostles: and when they had prayed, they laid their hands on them.

\ln Kanohedvno Unelanvhi utseli kanequogei, nanivno anohiyuhvsgi utsati aninequoge Tsilusilimi, unitsatino atsilvanelohi unohiyune gohiyudi gesvi.

\syll ᏍᏗᏫᏃ ᎤᎧᎵᏨᎯ ᎤᏬᎯᏳᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏂᎬᎬ  ᎤᏣᏖ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏰᎸᏛ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎮ ᏴᏫ ᎠᏁᎲᎢ.
\ft And Stephen, full of faith and power, did great wonders and miracles among the people.

\syll ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᎦᏓ ᎠᏂ ᏳᏁᎴᎢ ᏂᎤᏟᏍᏕ ᏏᎳᏏᏅᎯᏉ ᎢᎩᏛ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏚᎢᏍᏓᏁᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎢᏳᏩᏁᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᏢᏔᏅᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏏᏉ ᎤᏪᏥ ᏁᎲᎾ ᎨᏎᎢ.

\ln Eladino unvtsv udvgane gilo kanegvi hia nuwesehvi; Sola, Sola, gadono uyo nisquvneha?
\syll ᎡᎳᏗᏃ ᎤᏅᏨ ᎤᏛᎦᏁ ᎩᎶ ᎧᏁᎬᎢ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎲᎢ; ᏐᎳ, ᏐᎳ, ᎦᏙᏃ ᎤᏲ ᏂᏍᏋᏁᎭ?
\ft And he fell to the earth, and heard a voice saying unto him, Saul, Saul, why persecutest thou me?

\ln Hiano nuwesei; Gago nihi, Tsagvwiyuhi?  Ugvwiyuhino hia nuwesei; Ayv Tsisa uyo tsiniyvneha:  udeyadodiyu ditsahvtesdiyi digosdaya.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎦᎪ ᏂᎯ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ?  ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎠᏴ ᏥᏌ ᎤᏲ ᏥᏂᏴᏁᎭ:  ᎤᏕᏯᏙᏗᏳ ᏗᏣᎲᏖᏍᏗᏱ ᏗᎪᏍᏓᏯ.
\ft And he said, Who art thou, Lord? And the Lord said, I am Jesus whom thou persecutest: it is hard for thee to kick against the pricks.

\ln Nasgino uwenawe ale usquanigose hia nuwesei; Tsagvwiyuhi, gado tsaduli aquadvnediyi?  Ugvwiyuhino hia nuweselei; Talehvga, digaduhv hena, dayetsanonelino itsadvnediyi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᏪᎾᏪ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏎ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎦᏙ ᏣᏚᎵ ᎠᏆᏛᏁᏗᏱ?  ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᏔᎴᎲᎦ, ᏗᎦᏚᎲ ᎮᎾ, ᏓᏰᏣᏃᏁᎵᏃ ᎢᏣᏛᏁᏗᏱ.
\ft And he trembling and astonished said, Lord, what wilt thou have me to do? And the Lord said unto him, Arise, and go into the city, and it shall be told thee what thou must do.

\ln Anehino aniwinv tsunvgewi nasgiya danidogei, anadvgisge kanegvi, aseno vtla gilo yanigowatisgei.
\syll ᎠᏁᎯᏃ ᎠᏂᏫᏅ ᏧᏅᎨᏫ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏓᏂᏙᎨᎢ, ᎠᎾᏛᎩᏍᎨ ᎧᏁᎬᎢ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᏯᏂᎪᏩᏘᏍᎨᎢ.
\ft And the men which journeyed with him stood speechless, hearing a voice, but seeing no man.

\ln Solano deulenv eladi ganvi, ale digadoli dulisduisv vtla gilo yugohei, gvwoyinvseno Demasga wigvwayvtanei.
\syll ᏐᎳᏃ ᏕᎤᎴᏅ ᎡᎳᏗ ᎦᏅᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎦᏙᎵ ᏚᎵᏍᏚᎢᏒ ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᏳᎪᎮᎢ, ᎬᏬᏱᏅᏎᏃ ᏕᎹᏍᎦ ᏫᎬᏩᏴᏔᏁᎢ.
\ft And Saul arose from the earth; and when his eyes were opened, he saw no man: but they led him by the hand, and brought him into Damascus.

\ln Tsoino tsusvhidv nagowadisgvna gesei, ale nalisdayvhvsgvna ale naditasgvna gesei.
\syll ᏦᎢᏃ ᏧᏒᎯᏛ ᎾᎪᏩᏗᏍᎬᎾ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎬᎾ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏗᏔᏍᎬᎾ ᎨᏎᎢ.
\ft And he was three days without sight, and neither did eat nor drink.

\ln Gilono iyusdi tsunelodi ehe Demasga, Eninaya tsudoidv; nasgino unelawisehv Ugvwiyuhi hia nuweselei; Eninaya.  Hiano nuwesei; Ani, Tsagvwiyuhi.
\syll ᎩᎶᏃ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏧᏁᎶᏗ ᎡᎮ ᏕᎹᏍᎦ, ᎡᏂᎾᏯ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ; ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏫᏎᎲ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎡᏂᎾᏯ.  ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎠᏂ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ.
\ft And there was a certain disciple at Damascus, named Ananias; and to him said the Lord in a vision, Ananias. And he said, Behold, I am here, Lord.

\ln Hiano nuwesele Ugvwiyuhi; Talehvga, hena digalanvdv Gatsinosdv tsidudov, Tsudasino ganelv wiyoga Sola tsudoidv Dasa ehi.  Gvniyuyeno adadolisdiha,
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏎᎴ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ; ᏔᎴᎲᎦ, ᎮᎾ ᏗᎦᎳᏅᏛ ᎦᏥᏃᏍᏛ ᏥᏚᏙᎥ, ᏧᏓᏏᏃ ᎦᏁᎸ ᏫᏲᎦ ᏐᎳ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ ᏓᏌ ᎡᎯ.  ᎬᏂᏳᏰᏃ ᎠᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᎭ,
\ft And the Lord said unto him, Arise, and go into the street which is called Straight, and inquire in the house of Judas for one called Saul, of Tarsus: for, behold, he prayeth,

\ln Ale unelawisehv ugohv asgaya Eninaya tsudoidv uyvlilv ale usitadv vugowadvdiyi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏫᏎᎲ ᎤᎪᎲ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎡᏂᎾᏯ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ ᎤᏴᎵᎸ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏏᏔᏛ ᎥᎤᎪᏩᏛᏗᏱ.
\ft And hath seen in a vision a man named Ananias coming in, and putting his hand on him, that he might receive his sight.

\ln Eninayano hia nuwesei; Tsagvwiyuhi, tsiyadvganelv hia asgaya unitsata gvginonelv utsati uyo niduwanelv ditsatseli unadanvti Tsilusilimi.
\syll ᎡᏂᎾᏯᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᏥᏯᏛᎦᏁᎸ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᏂᏣᏔ ᎬᎩᏃᏁᎸ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᏲ ᏂᏚᏩᏁᎸ ᏗᏣᏤᎵ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ.
\ft Then Ananias answered, Lord, I have heard by many of this man, how much evil he hath done to thy saints at Jerusalem:

\ln Anino uha gvwanetselvhi nunigvwiyusv atsilvanelohi tsulvsdiyi nigadv detsadov anineisdisgi.
\syll ᎠᏂᏃ ᎤᎭ ᎬᏩᏁᏤᎸᎯ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᏧᎸᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏕᏣᏙᎥ ᎠᏂᏁᎢᏍᏗᏍᎩ.
\ft And here he hath authority from the chief priests to bind all that call on thy name.

\ln Aseno Ugvwiyuhi hia nuweselei; Hena, nasgiyeno tsiyasuyedv atelido aquatseliga daquadov ayidohi anigatahv tsunadalenvdv yvwi ale unigvwiyuhi ale Isili tsuwetsi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎮᎾ, ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᏥᏯᏑᏰᏛ ᎠᏖᎵᏙ ᎠᏆᏤᎵᎦ ᏓᏆᏙᎥ ᎠᏱᏙᎯ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎲ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏏᎵ ᏧᏪᏥ.
\ft But the Lord said unto him, Go thy way: for he is a chosen vessel unto me, to bear my name before the Gentiles, and kings, and the children of Israel:

\ln Gvnigesvyeno nvdatsiyvneli nutsadv ase ugiliyoisdiyi daquadov nvdigalisdodisgvi.
\syll ᎬᏂᎨᏒᏰᏃ ᏅᏓᏥᏴᏁᎵ ᏄᏣᏛ ᎠᏎ ᎤᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᏓᏆᏙᎥ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬᎢ.
\ft For I will shew him how great things he must suffer for my name's sake.

\ln Eninayano uwenvsei, ale adanelv uyvlei, dusitadvno hia nuwesei; Sola vginvtli, Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa, nasgi gvnigesv tsinitsadvnele taisvi diginvsv vtsagowadvdiyi ale tsakaliisdiyi Galvquodiyu Adanvdo.
\syll ᎡᏂᎾᏯᏃ ᎤᏪᏅᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏓᏁᎸ ᎤᏴᎴᎢ, ᏚᏏᏔᏛᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᏐᎳ ᎥᎩᏅᏟ, ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏥᏂᏣᏛᏁᎴ ᏔᎢᏒᎢ ᏗᎩᏅᏒ ᎥᏣᎪᏩᏛᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᏣᎧᎵᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ.
\ft And Ananias went his way, and entered into the house; and putting his hands on him said, Brother Saul, the Lord, even Jesus, that appeared unto thee in the way as thou camest, hath sent me, that thou mightest receive thy sight, and be filled with the Holy Ghost.

\ln Gilaquono iyvdv dugatanvgoase uwatsisgalv iyusdi, ale gilaquo iyvdv gvwagowadvdi nulistanei; dulenvno agawoei.
\syll ᎩᎳᏉᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏚᎦᏔᏅᎪᎠᏎ ᎤᏩᏥᏍᎦᎸ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎩᎳᏉ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎬᏩᎪᏩᏛᏗ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ; ᏚᎴᏅᏃ ᎠᎦᏬᎡᎢ.
\ft And immediately there fell from his eyes as it had been scales: and he received sight forthwith, and arose, and was baptized.

\ln Ulisdayvnvno ulinigosei.  Solano ilvsgi tsusvhidv duweladidole anohiyuhvsgi Demasga anehi.
\syll ᎤᎵᏍᏓᏴᏅᏃ ᎤᎵᏂᎪᏎᎢ.  ᏐᎳᏃ ᎢᎸᏍᎩ ᏧᏒᎯᏛ ᏚᏪᎳᏗᏙᎴ ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᏕᎹᏍᎦ ᎠᏁᎯ.
\ft And when he had received meat, he was strengthened. Then was Saul certain days with the disciples which were at Damascus.

\ln Igvwenvdvno digalawiisdiyi degotlvwadisv ulitsidonei, unohele Galonedv nasgi Unelanvhi uwetsi gesvi.
\syll ᎢᎬᏪᏅᏛᏃ ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᏕᎪᏢᏩᏗᏒ ᎤᎵᏥᏙᏁᎢ, ᎤᏃᎮᎴ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft And straightway he preached Christ in the synagogues, that he is the Son of God.

\ln Nigadvno unadvganvhi unisquanigosei, ale hia nuniwesei; tlasgo nasgi hia yigi tsidagiliyoisdodisgv Tsilusilimi hia denvdov anineisdisgi?  Ale nasgi iyusdi ani ulutsvgi, nasgi tsulvsdi widutinohediyi nunigvwiyusv atsilvanelohi.
\syll ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅᎯ ᎤᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ; ᏝᏍᎪ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏱᎩ ᏥᏓᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᎯᎠ ᏕᏅᏙᎥ ᎠᏂᏁᎢᏍᏗᏍᎩ?  ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏂ ᎤᎷᏨᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᎸᏍᏗ ᏫᏚᏘᏃᎮᏗᏱ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸᎠᏁᎶᎯ.
\ft But all that heard him were amazed, and said; Is not this he that destroyed them which called on this name in Jerusalem, and came hither for that intent, that he might bring them bound unto the chief priests?

\ln Aseno Sola kanequogequo ulinigosgvi, ale aniwonisgv dugonadvtane Anitsusi Demasga anehi, gvnigesv nigvnehe nasgi hia Galonedv gesvi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᏐᎳ ᎧᏁᏉᎨᏉ ᎤᎵᏂᎪᏍᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏬᏂᏍᎬ ᏚᎪᎾᏛᏔᏁ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᏕᎹᏍᎦ ᎠᏁᎯ, ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᎬᏁᎮ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft But Saul increased the more in strength, and confounded the Jews which dwelt at Damascus, proving that this is very Christ.

\ln Yelino uwohitsv Anitsusi uninohele unihisdiyi.
\syll ᏰᎵᏃ ᎤᏬᎯᏨ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎤᏂᏃᎮᎴ ᎤᏂᎯᏍᏗᏱ.
\ft And after that many days were fulfilled, the Jews took counsel to kill him:

\ln Aseno nasgi dunugotanvi udvgane Sola.  Nigohilvno iga ale svnoyi digalohisdiyi dunihalune unihisdiyi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᏄᎪᏔᏅᎢ ᎤᏛᎦᏁ ᏐᎳ.  ᏂᎪᎯᎸᏃ ᎢᎦ ᎠᎴ ᏒᏃᏱ ᏗᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏚᏂᎭᎷᏁ ᎤᏂᎯᏍᏗᏱ.
\ft But their laying await was known of Saul. And they watched the gates day and night to kill him.

\ln Aseno tsunanelodi uniyanvhe svnoyi ale talutsa uniyotane unatlovtane asoyvi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎤᏂᏯᏅᎮ ᏒᏃᏱ ᎠᎴ ᏔᎷᏣ ᎤᏂᏲᏔᏁ ᎤᎾᏠᎥᏔᏁ ᎠᏐᏴᎢ.
\ft Then the disciples took him by night, and let him down by the wall in a basket.

\ln Solano Tsilusilimi ulutsv tsunanelodi tsuligonediyi uyelvnei.  Nigadvno gvwasgaihei, ale vtla yanohiyuhvsge tsunelodi gesvi.
\syll ᏐᎳᏃ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᎤᎷᏨ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᏧᎵᎪᏁᏗᏱ ᎤᏰᎸᏁᎢ.  ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᎬᏩᏍᎦᎢᎮᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᏯᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎨ ᏧᏁᎶᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft And when Saul was come to Jerusalem, he assayed to join himself to the disciples: but they were all afraid of him, and believed not that he was a disciple.

\ln Aseno Quaniqua wuyanvhv dutinohele getsinvsidv, ale dunonele Ugvwiyuhi ugohvi aisvi, ale nasgi uwonetanvi, ale nasgaihvna Tsisa deudov uneistanvi Demasga.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᏆᏂᏆ ᏭᏯᏅᎲ ᏚᏘᏃᎮᎴ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏃᏁᎴ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᎪᎲᎢ ᎠᎢᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏬᏁᏔᏅᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎦᎢᎲᎾ ᏥᏌ ᏕᎤᏙᎥ ᎤᏁᎢᏍᏔᏅᎢ ᏕᎹᏍᎦ.
\ft But Barnabas took him, and brought him to the apostles, and declared unto them how he had seen the Lord in the way, and that he had spoken to him, and how he had preached boldly at Damascus in the name of Jesus.

\ln Nasgino itsulaha anedohe Tsilusilimi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎠᏁᏙᎮ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ.
\ft And he was with them coming in and going out at Jerusalem.

\ln Nasgaihvnano kaneisdisge deudov Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa, ale Anigoi uniwonisdi aniwonisgi anadisvhihe aniwonisgvi.  Aseno unanelotane gvwahisdiyi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎦᎢᎲᎾᏃ ᎧᏁᎢᏍᏗᏍᎨ ᏕᎤᏙᎥ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᎪᎢ ᎤᏂᏬᏂᏍᏗ ᎠᏂᏬᏂᏍᎩ ᎠᎾᏗᏒᎯᎮ ᎠᏂᏬᏂᏍᎬᎢ.  ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᎾᏁᎶᏔᏁ ᎬᏩᎯᏍᏗᏱ.
\ft And he spake boldly in the name of the Lord Jesus, and disputed against the Grecians: but they went about to slay him.

\ln Analinvtlisgini nasgi unadvganv, Sisaliyi wunatinolei, hnaquono Dasa wuninvsei.
\syll ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏟᏍᎩᏂ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅ, ᏏᏌᎵᏱ ᏭᎾᏘᏃᎴᎢ, ᎿᏉᏃ ᏓᏌ ᏭᏂᏅᏎᎢ.
\ft Which when the brethren knew, they brought him down to Caesarea, and sent him forth to Tarsus.

\ln Hnaquono tsunanelodi unadatlu gv nvwadohiyadv nunalisdanele nigvnadv Tsudiyi ale Gelili ale Sameliyi, ale gegalinigohistanei, ale anaise nahna ganayehisdi gesv Ugvwiyuhi, ale osdv unigalisdadisgv Galvquodiyu Adanvdo, aninequogei.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏡ Ꭼ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᏄᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᎴ ᏂᎬᎾᏛ ᏧᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᎨᎵᎵ ᎠᎴ ᏌᎺᎵᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎨᎦᎵᏂᎪᎯᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎾᎢᏎ ᏀᎾ ᎦᎾᏰᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎤᏂᎦᎵᏍᏓᏗᏍᎬ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ, ᎠᏂᏁᏉᎨᎢ.
\ft Then had the churches rest throughout all Judaea and Galilee and Samaria, and were edified; and walking in the fear of the Lord, and in the comfort of the Holy Ghost, were multiplied.

\ln Hiano nulistanei, Quida nigvnadv uwedolv nasquo widulutsele unadanvti Lida anehi.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᏈᏓ ᏂᎬᎾᏛ ᎤᏪᏙᎸ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏫᏚᎷᏤᎴ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ ᎵᏓ ᎠᏁᎯ.
\ft And it came to pass, as Peter passed throughout all quarters, he came down also to the saints which dwelt at Lydda.

\ln Nahnano uwadvhe gilo iyusdi asgaya Iniya tsudoidv, tsunela itsudetiyvdv gvwanisinvhi gese ganitli ulvdalvvsgei.
\syll ᏀᎾᏃ ᎤᏩᏛᎮ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎢᏂᏯ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ, ᏧᏁᎳ ᎢᏧᏕᏘᏴᏛ ᎬᏩᏂᏏᏅᎯ ᎨᏎ ᎦᏂᏟ ᎤᎸᏓᎸᎥᏍᎨᎢ.
\ft And there he found a certain man named Aeneas, which had kept his bed eight years, and was sick of the palsy.

\ln Quidano hia nuwesele nasgi; Iniya, Tsisa Galonedv tsanvwvga; talehvga, ale hiyesdvisa tsanisidiyi.  Gilaquono iyvdv dulenei.
\syll ᏈᏓᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ; ᎢᏂᏯ, ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏣᏅᏮᎦ; ᏔᎴᎲᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᏰᏍᏛᎢᏌ ᏣᏂᏏᏗᏱ.  ᎩᎳᏉᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏚᎴᏁᎢ.
\ft And Peter said unto him, Aeneas, Jesus Christ maketh thee whole: arise, and make thy bed. And he arose immediately.

\ln Nigadvno Lida ale Seloni anehi gvwagohei, ale Ugvwiyuhi iditlv wunagatahvstanei.
\syll ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᎵᏓ ᎠᎴ ᏎᎶᏂ ᎠᏁᎯ ᎬᏩᎪᎮᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᏗᏢ ᏭᎾᎦᏔᎲᏍᏔᏁᎢ.
\ft And all that dwelt at Lydda and Saron saw him, and turned to the Lord.

\ln Tsoquino ehe gilo iyusdi ageyv tsunelodi, Daquidi tsudoidv, nasgi anetlvtanvhi Dagi gadvga, nasgi hia ukalitsvhi gese osdv dulvwisdanehvi ale adanelvvsgvi.
\syll ᏦᏈᏃ ᎡᎮ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᎨᏴ ᏧᏁᎶᏗ, ᏓᏈᏗ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏁᏢᏔᏅᎯ ᏓᎩ ᎦᏛᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎤᎧᎵᏨᎯ ᎨᏎ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏓᏁᎸᎥᏍᎬᎢ.
\ft Now there was at Joppa a certain disciple named Tabitha, which by interpretation is called Dorcas: this woman was full of good works and almsdeeds which she did.

\ln Hiano nulistane nahiyui, nasgi utlvtsv uyohusei, nasgino unawov galvladi kanvsulv uninvnei.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁ ᏀᎢᏳᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏢᏨ ᎤᏲᎱᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᎾᏬᎥ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎧᏅᏑᎸ ᎤᏂᏅᏁᎢ.
\ft And it came to pass in those days, that she was sick, and died: whom when they had washed, they laid her in an upper chamber.

\ln Lidano ale Tsoqui nav nidudalei, anohiyuhvsgino unadvganv Quida edohv Lida, anitali anisgaya duninvse wunitayosediyi udohidisdiyi nigesvna nidodayuwadvhvsdiyi.
\syll ᎵᏓᏃ ᎠᎴ ᏦᏈ ᎾᎥ ᏂᏚᏓᎴᎢ, ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅ ᏈᏓ ᎡᏙᎲ ᎵᏓ, ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ ᏚᏂᏅᏎ ᏭᏂᏔᏲᏎᏗᏱ ᎤᏙᎯᏗᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏂᏙᏓᏳᏩᏛᎲᏍᏗᏱ.
\ft And forasmuch as Lydda was nigh to Joppa, and the disciples had heard that Peter was there, they sent unto him two men, desiring him that he would not delay to come to them.

\ln Quidano dulenv dusdawadvsei; ulutsvno galvladi kanvsulv wigvwayvtanei; nigadvno anigeyv tsunosulotsvhi gadogv nav anidonae daniyvgei, ale daninanugowisge hawini dinuwo ale tsudalenvdv dinuwo nasgi Dagi tsuweyewisvhi asi uneladidohei.
\syll ᏈᏓᏃ ᏚᎴᏅ ᏚᏍᏓᏩᏛᏎᎢ; ᎤᎷᏨᏃ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎧᏅᏑᎸ ᏫᎬᏩᏴᏔᏁᎢ; ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᎠᏂᎨᏴ ᏧᏃᏑᎶᏨᎯ ᎦᏙᎬ ᎾᎥ ᎠᏂᏙᎾᎡ ᏓᏂᏴᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᏂᎾᏄᎪᏫᏍᎨ ᎭᏫᏂ ᏗᏄᏬ ᎠᎴ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏗᏄᏬ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏓᎩ ᏧᏪᏰᏫᏒᎯ ᎠᏏ ᎤᏁᎳᏗᏙᎮᎢ.
\ft Then Peter arose and went with them. When he was come, they brought him into the upper chamber: and all the widows stood by him weeping, and shewing the coats and garments which Dorcas made, while she was with them.

\ln Quidano nigadv dunugowisv duliniquanvne ale udadolistanei, dedvnvno iditlv wugatahvstanv, Daquidi talehvga, udvnei.  Dusduiseno digadoli, Quidano ugohv, udidvhe uwenei.
\syll ᏈᏓᏃ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏚᏄᎪᏫᏒ ᏚᎵᏂᏆᏅᏁ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᏕᏛᏅᏃ ᎢᏗᏢ ᏭᎦᏔᎲᏍᏔᏅ, ᏓᏈᏗ ᏔᎴᎲᎦ, ᎤᏛᏁᎢ.  ᏚᏍᏚᎢᏎᏃ ᏗᎦᏙᎵ, ᏈᏓᏃ ᎤᎪᎲ, ᎤᏗᏛᎮ ᎤᏪᏁᎢ.
\ft But Peter put them all forth, and kneeled down, and prayed; and turning him to the body said, Tabitha, arise. And she opened her eyes: and when she saw Peter, she sat up.

\ln Uwoyanesvno deuletanei; widuyanvhvno unadanvti ale tsunosulotsvhi, deunanugowisele gvnodv.
\syll ᎤᏬᏯᏁᏒᏃ ᏕᎤᎴᏔᏁᎢ; ᏫᏚᏯᏅᎲᏃ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ ᎠᎴ ᏧᏃᏑᎶᏨᎯ, ᏕᎤᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᎴ ᎬᏃᏛ.
\ft And he gave her his hand, and lifted her up, and when he had called the saints and widows, presented her alive.

\ln Tsoquino nigvnadv unadvganei, ale unitsate unohiyune Ugvwiyuhi.
\syll ᏦᏈᏃ ᏂᎬᎾᏛ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏣᏖ ᎤᏃᎯᏳᏁ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ.
\ft And it was known throughout all Joppa; and many believed in the Lord.

\ln Hiano nulistanei, yeli uwohitse udene Tsoqui, disuwisgi Sawani tsudoidv ganelvi.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᏰᎵ ᎤᏬᎯᏤ ᎤᏕᏁ ᏦᏈ, ᏗᏑᏫᏍᎩ ᏌᏩᏂ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ ᎦᏁᎸᎢ.
\ft And it came to pass, that he tarried many days in Joppa with one Simon a tanner.

\ln Gilono iyusdi asgaya ehe Sisaliyi, Kaniliya tsudoidv, asgohitsuqui ditinidohi, gela Idali tsunadoidv unadatlugv.
\syll ᎩᎶᏃ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎡᎮ ᏏᏌᎵᏱ, ᎧᏂᎵᏯ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ, ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏧᏈ ᏗᏘᏂᏙᎯ, ᎨᎳ ᎢᏓᎵ ᏧᎾᏙᎢᏛ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬ.
\ft There was a certain man in Caesarea called Cornelius, a centurion of the band called the Italian band,

\syll ᎤᏓᏅᏘ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎦᎾᏰᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎦᏁᎸ ᎠᏂᎮ, ᎤᏣᏘ ᏗᏁᎸᎥᏍᎩ ᏴᏫ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎠᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎯ.
\ft A devout man, and one that feared God with all his house, which gave much alms to the people, and prayed to God always.

\ln Nasgi tsoiha iyutlilodv kalawadisv gvnigesviyu ugohe dikahnawadidohi Unelanvhi utseli ulutselei, ale hia nuweselei; Kaniliya.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏦᎢᎭ ᎢᏳᏟᎶᏛ ᎧᎳᏩᏗᏒ ᎬᏂᎨᏒᎢᏳ ᎤᎪᎮ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎤᎷᏤᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎧᏂᎵᏯ.
\ft He saw in a vision evidently about the ninth hour of the day an angel of God coming in to him, and saying unto him, Cornelius.

\ln Dukahnanvno ale usgalv hia nuwesei; Gadoi, Tsagvwiyuhi.  Hiano nuweselei; Hadadolisdisgv ale hadanelvvsgv dulisaladanv anvdadisdodi iyulisdodiyi Unelanvhi agatahvi.
\syll ᏚᎧᎿᏅᏃ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏍᎦᎸ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎦᏙᎢ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ.  ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎭᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᎠᎴ ᎭᏓᏁᎸᎥᏍᎬ ᏚᎵᏌᎳᏓᏅ ᎠᏅᏓᏗᏍᏙᏗ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎦᏔᎲᎢ.
\ft And when he looked on him, he was afraid, and said, What is it, Lord? And he said unto him, Thy prayers and thine alms are come up for a memorial before God.

\ln Ka, Tsoqui tinvli aniwinv, wiyanv Sawani Quida tsudoidv,
\syll Ꭷ, ᏦᏈ ᏘᏅᎵ ᎠᏂᏫᏅ, ᏫᏯᏅ ᏌᏩᏂ ᏈᏓ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ,
\ft And now send men to Joppa, and call for one Simon, whose surname is Peter:

\ln Nasgi uwola gilo iyusdi ganelv Sawani tsudoidv, disuwisgi, nasgi amayulodi tsiganelv, nasgi datsanoneli itsadvnediyi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏬᎳ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎦᏁᎸ ᏌᏩᏂ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ, ᏗᏑᏫᏍᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎹᏳᎶᏗ ᏥᎦᏁᎸ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏓᏣᏃᏁᎵ ᎢᏣᏛᏁᏗᏱ.
\ft He lodgeth with one Simon a tanner, whose house is by the sea side: he shall tell thee what thou oughtest to do.

\ln Dikahnawadidohino udanvsv nasgi Kaniliya uwonetanvhi, anitali widuyanvhe adanelv tsunvsidasdi ale saquo ayawisgi Unelanvhi adadolisdanehi nigohilv gvwagatidisgi gesv gela.
\syll ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎯᏃ ᎤᏓᏅᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎧᏂᎵᏯ ᎤᏬᏁᏔᏅᎯ, ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᏫᏚᏯᏅᎮ ᎠᏓᏁᎸ ᏧᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏌᏉ ᎠᏯᏫᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏗᏍᎩ ᎨᏒ ᎨᎳ.
\ft And when the angel which spake unto Cornelius was departed, he called two of his household servants, and a devout soldier of them that waited on him continually;

\ln Nasgino nigadv dunohehelv, Tsoqui dunvsei.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏚᏃᎮᎮᎸ, ᏦᏈ ᏚᏅᏎᎢ.
\ft And when he had declared all these things unto them, he sent them to Joppa.

\ln Ugitsvdvno anaise ale hnaquo navnige unilule digaduhvi, Quida ugilawise gasanali udadolistanvse taladu iyutlilodv iyvdv kalawadisvi.
\syll ᎤᎩᏨᏛᏃ ᎠᎾᎢᏎ ᎠᎴ ᎿᏉ ᎾᎥᏂᎨ ᎤᏂᎷᎴ ᏗᎦᏚᎲᎢ, ᏈᏓ ᎤᎩᎳᏫᏎ ᎦᏌᎾᎵ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏔᏅᏎ ᏔᎳᏚ ᎢᏳᏟᎶᏛ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎧᎳᏩᏗᏒᎢ.
\ft On the morrow, as they went on their journey, and drew nigh unto the city, Peter went up upon the housetop to pray about the sixth hour:

\ln Utsatino uyosisanei, ale udulisge ulisdayvdiyi, aseno asiquo anadvnvisdisge tsagaliho nasgiya nulisdanelei.
\syll ᎤᏣᏘᏃ ᎤᏲᏏᏌᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎨ ᎤᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᏏᏉ ᎠᎾᏛᏅᎢᏍᏗᏍᎨ ᏣᎦᎵᎰ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᎵᏍᏓᏁᎴᎢ.
\ft And he became very hungry, and would have eaten: but while they made ready, he fell into a trance,

\ln Ugoheno galvladi ulisduidv gesei, ale gohusdi iyusdi atelido eladi nvtsusdidise, nasgiya equa anuwo, nvgi dunvsiyv tsidegalvoi, nasgino eladi igvnelvhi tsigeso elohi iyvdv.
\syll ᎤᎪᎮᏃ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎤᎵᏍᏚᎢᏛ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏖᎵᏙ ᎡᎳᏗ ᏅᏧᏍᏗᏗᏎ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎡᏆ ᎠᏄᏬ, ᏅᎩ ᏚᏅᏏᏴ ᏥᏕᎦᎸᎣᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎡᎳᏗ ᎢᎬᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎨᏐ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎢᏴᏛ.
\ft And saw heaven opened, and a certain vessel descending unto him, as it had been a great sheet knit at the four corners, and let down to the earth:

\syll ᏀᎾᏃ ᎠᏂᏯᎡ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏅᎩ ᏗᏂᏅᏌᏗ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎠᏁᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᎾᎨ ᎠᏁᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎾᏓᎾᏏᏂᏙᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᎸᎶ ᎠᏂᏃᎯᎵᏙᎯ.

\syll ᎠᏥᏁᏤᎴᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏅᏗᎠᏥᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᏈᏓ, ᏔᎴᎲᎦ, ᎯᎷᎦ ᎠᎴ ᎭᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᎦ, ᎠᎪᏎᎴᎢ.
\ft And there came a voice to him, Rise, Peter; kill, and eat.

\ln Quidano hia nuwesei; Tlesdi, Tsagvwiyuhi, tleyeno ilvhiyu yagigo gohusdi gadaha ale niganvgalvhvna.
\syll ᏈᏓᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᏞᏍᏗ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᏞᏰᏃ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᏯᎩᎪ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎦᏓᎭ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏅᎦᎸᎲᎾ.
\ft But Peter said, Not so, Lord; for I have never eaten any thing that is common or unclean.

\ln Talineno hia nvdiatsiweselii; Unelanvhi unvgalvdv nasgi tlesdi gadaha yosehesdi.
\syll ᏔᎵᏁᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏅᏗᎠᏥᏪᏎᎵᎢ; ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏅᎦᎸᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎦᏓᎭ ᏲᏎᎮᏍᏗ.
\ft And the voice spake unto him again the second time, What God hath cleansed, that call not thou common.

\ln Nasgi hia tsoi nulistanei, hnaquono atelido taline galvladi wiulisaladanei.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏦᎢ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᎿᏉᏃ ᎠᏖᎵᏙ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏫᎤᎵᏌᎳᏓᏁᎢ.
\ft This was done thrice: and the vessel was received up again into heaven.

\ln Asiquono Quida adanvtesge nusdv gadvgv nasgi unelawiselvi, gvniyuquo aniwinv nasgi Kaniliya nidodayunvsvhi unadadvdvnvhi gese Sawani ganelvi, ale anidonae galohisdiyulodi;
\syll ᎠᏏᏉᏃ ᏈᏓ ᎠᏓᏅᏖᏍᎨ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎦᏛᎬ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏫᏎᎸᎢ, ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎠᏂᏫᏅ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎧᏂᎵᏯ ᏂᏙᏓᏳᏅᏒᎯ ᎤᎾᏓᏛᏛᏅᎯ ᎨᏎ ᏌᏩᏂ ᎦᏁᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏙᎾᎡ ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏳᎶᏗ;
\ft Now while Peter doubted in himself what this vision which he had seen should mean, behold, the men which were sent from Cornelius had made inquiry for Simon's house, and stood before the gate,

\ln Wunalistanvno unadadvdvnei; Anisgo uwola Sawani Quida tsudoidv, unadvnei.
\syll ᏭᎾᎵᏍᏔᏅᏃ ᎤᎾᏓᏛᏛᏁᎢ; ᎠᏂᏍᎪ ᎤᏬᎳ ᏌᏩᏂ ᏈᏓ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ, ᎤᎾᏛᏁᎢ.
\ft And called, and asked whether Simon, which was surnamed Peter, were lodged there.

\ln Asiquono Quida adanvtesge unelawiselvi, Adanvdo hia nuweselei, gvniyuquo anitsoi aniwinv getsayoha.
