\ft While Peter yet spake these words, the Holy Ghost fell on all them which heard the word.

\ln Digetsiusdeselvhino anohiyuhvsgi nigadv Quida nvdagvwasdawadvdv utsati unisquanigosei, nvdigalisdodisge tsunadalenvdv yvwi nasquo getsisonvyelv getsinelv Galvquodiyu Adanvdo.
\syll ᏗᎨᏥᎤᏍᏕᏎᎸᎯᏃ ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏈᏓ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏛᏛ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏎᎢ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎨᏥᏐᏅᏰᎸ ᎨᏥᏁᎸ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ.
\ft And they of the circumcision which believed were astonished, as many as came with Peter, because that on the Gentiles also was poured out the gift of the Holy Ghost.

\ln Dunadvganeleyeno tsudalenvdv daniwonisgv ale anilvquodisgv Unelanvhi.  Hnaquono Quida unetse hia nuwesei;
\syll ᏚᎾᏛᎦᏁᎴᏰᏃ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏓᏂᏬᏂᏍᎬ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᎸᏉᏗᏍᎬ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ.  ᎿᏉᏃ ᏈᏓ ᎤᏁᏤ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ;
\ft For they heard them speak with tongues, and magnify God. Then answered Peter,

\ln Tsigo gilo yunvsdohi ama hia nasgi digegawosdiyi nasgi nasquo Galvquodiyu Adanvdo tsigetsinelv nasgiya ayv eginelvi?
\syll ᏥᎪ ᎩᎶ ᏳᏅᏍᏙᎯ ᎠᎹ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎨᎦᏬᏍᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᏥᎨᏥᏁᎸ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎠᏴ ᎡᎩᏁᎸᎢ?
\ft Can any man forbid water, that these should not be baptized, which have received the Holy Ghost as well as we?

\ln Deunetseleno digegawosdiyi deudosdv Ugvwiyuhi.  Hnaquono gvwatayosele ilvsgi tsusvhidv uwediyi.
\syll ᏕᎤᏁᏤᎴᏃ ᏗᎨᎦᏬᏍᏗᏱ ᏕᎤᏙᏍᏛ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ.  ᎿᏉᏃ ᎬᏩᏔᏲᏎᎴ ᎢᎸᏍᎩ ᏧᏒᎯᏛ ᎤᏪᏗᏱ.
\ft And he commanded them to be baptized in the name of the Lord. Then prayed they him to tarry certain days.

\ln Getsinvsidvno ale analinvtli Tsudiyi anehi unadvgane nasgi tsunadalenvdv yvwi nasquo dunadanilvtsv kanohedv Unelanvhi utseliga.
\syll ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏛᏃ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏟ ᏧᏗᏱ ᎠᏁᎯ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏁ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏚᎾᏓᏂᎸᏨ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ.
\ft And the apostles and brethren that were in Judaea heard that the Gentiles had also received the word of God.

\ln Quidano Tsilusilimi wulutsv digetsiusdeselvhi degvwagatilvsei,
\syll ᏈᏓᏃ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᏭᎷᏨ ᏗᎨᏥᎤᏍᏕᏎᎸᎯ ᏕᎬᏩᎦᏘᎸᏎᎢ,
\ft And when Peter was come up to Jerusalem, they that were of the circumcision contended with him,

\ln Hia nuniweei; nidigetsiusdeselvna dehiyvselei, ale nasgi itsulaha itsalisdayvnei.
\syll ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᎡᎢ; ᏂᏗᎨᏥᎤᏍᏕᏎᎸᎾ ᏕᎯᏴᏎᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏴᏁᎢ.
\ft Saying, Thou wentest in to men uncircumcised, and didst eat with them.

\ln Aseno Quida ulenvhe dunohehele nigadv osdv uyilvsei, hia nuwesei;
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᏈᏓ ᎤᎴᏅᎮ ᏚᏃᎮᎮᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎤᏱᎸᏎᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ;
\ft But Peter rehearsed the matter from the beginning, and expounded it by order unto them, saying,

\ln Tsoqui gaduhv gedohvgi gadadolisdisgvgi; tsagalihono nasgiya naqualisdanelv aquanelawiselvgi, atelido agigohvgi eladi nvdayusdidisvgi, equa anuwo nasgiyai galvladi nvdayudalenvhi, nvgi nidunvsiyv tsiduniniyvsoi; ale ayv agilutselvgi.
\syll ᏦᏈ ᎦᏚᎲ ᎨᏙᎲᎩ ᎦᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎬᎩ; ᏣᎦᎵᎰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏆᎵᏍᏓᏁᎸ ᎠᏆᏁᎳᏫᏎᎸᎩ, ᎠᏖᎵᏙ ᎠᎩᎪᎲᎩ ᎡᎳᏗ ᏅᏓᏳᏍᏗᏗᏒᎩ, ᎡᏆ ᎠᏄᏬ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ, ᏅᎩ ᏂᏚᏅᏏᏴ ᏥᏚᏂᏂᏴᏐᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴ ᎠᎩᎷᏤᎸᎩ.
\ft I was in the city of Joppa praying: and in a trance I saw a vision, A certain vessel descend, as it had been a great sheet, let down from heaven by four corners; and it came even to me:

\ln Nasgino aquagadostanv aquadanvtelvgi ale detsigovgi nvgi dininvsadi elohi anehi ale inage anehi ale anadanasinidohi ale galvlo aninohilidohi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎠᏆᎦᏙᏍᏔᏅ ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏖᎸᎩ ᎠᎴ ᏕᏥᎪᎥᎩ ᏅᎩ ᏗᏂᏅᏌᏗ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎠᏁᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎢᎾᎨ ᎠᏁᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎾᏓᎾᏏᏂᏙᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎦᎸᎶ ᎠᏂᏃᎯᎵᏙᎯ.
\ft Upon the which when I had fastened mine eyes, I considered, and saw fourfooted beasts of the earth, and wild beasts, and creeping things, and fowls of the air.

\ln Kanegvno aquadvganvgi hia nagiweselvgi; Talehvga Quida, hiluga ale halisdayvhvga.
\syll ᎧᏁᎬᏃ ᎠᏆᏛᎦᏅᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎾᎩᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏔᎴᎲᎦ ᏈᏓ, ᎯᎷᎦ ᎠᎴ ᎭᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᎦ.
\ft And I heard a voice saying unto me, Arise, Peter; slay and eat.

\ln Aseno hia nagiwesvgi; Tlesdi, Tsagvwiyuhi, tlayeno ilvhiyu gohusdi gadaha ale niganvgalvhvna yuyvlo tsioli.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎾᎩᏪᏒᎩ; ᏞᏍᏗ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᏝᏰᏃ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎦᏓᎭ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏅᎦᎸᎲᎾ ᏳᏴᎶ ᏥᎣᎵ.
\ft But I said, Not so, Lord: for nothing common or unclean hath at any time entered into my mouth.

\ln Aseno kanegv taline hia nvdvagiweselvgi galvladi dvulosvgi; Unelanvhi unvgalvdv nasgi tlesdi gadaha yosehesdi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎧᏁᎬ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎯᎠ ᏅᏛᎠᎩᏪᏎᎸᎩ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏛᎤᎶᏒᎩ; ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏅᎦᎸᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎦᏓᎭ ᏲᏎᎮᏍᏗ.
\ft But the voice answered me again from heaven, What God hath cleansed, that call not thou common.

\ln Tsoino nasgi hia nulistanvgi, nigadvno galvladi taline wulisaladanvgi.
\syll ᏦᎢᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎩ, ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏔᎵᏁ ᏭᎵᏌᎳᏓᏅᎩ.
\ft And this was done three times: and all were drawn up again into heaven.

\ln Gvniyuquono gilaquo iyvdv tsoi iyanidv anisgaya anidonav adanelv nahna aquolvi, gvgiyanvholvhi Sisaliyi nvdagetsinvsvhi.
\syll ᎬᏂᏳᏉᏃ ᎩᎳᏉ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏦᎢ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ ᎠᏂᏙᎾᎥ ᎠᏓᏁᎸ ᏀᎾ ᎠᏉᎸᎢ, ᎬᎩᏯᏅᎰᎸᎯ ᏏᏌᎵᏱ ᏅᏓᎨᏥᏅᏒᎯ.
\ft And, behold, immediately there were three men already come unto the house where I was, sent from Caesarea unto me.

\ln Adanvdono hia nagiweselvgi; gohusdi niditsatlvwisehvna tisdawaduga.  Nasquono hia nasgi sudali iyanidv idadanvtli gvqualigonelvgi, ale nasgi asgaya diganelv wogiyvlvgi.
\syll ᎠᏓᏅᏙᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎾᎩᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏂᏗᏣᏢᏫᏎᎲᎾ ᏘᏍᏓᏩᏚᎦ.  ᎾᏍᏉᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏑᏓᎵ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᎢᏓᏓᏅᏟ ᎬᏆᎵᎪᏁᎸᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᏗᎦᏁᎸ ᏬᎩᏴᎸᎩ.
\ft And the spirit bade me go with them, nothing doubting. Moreover these six brethren accompanied me, and we entered into the man's house:

\ln Nasgino oginonelvgi ugohvi dikahnawadidohi uwasv ganelvi nasgi gadoge hia nuweselei; Tsoqui tinvli aniwinv, ale wiyanv Sawani Quida tsudoidv;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎣᎩᏃᏁᎸᎩ ᎤᎪᎲᎢ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎦᏁᎸᎢ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏙᎨ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᏦᏈ ᏘᏅᎵ ᎠᏂᏫᏅ, ᎠᎴ ᏫᏯᏅ ᏌᏩᏂ ᏈᏓ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ;
\ft And he shewed us how he had seen an angel in his house, which stood and said unto him, Send men to Joppa, and call for Simon, whose surname is Peter;

\ln Nasgi datsanoneli itsadvnediyi tsalisdelvdiyi nihi ale nigadv ditsatseli sidanelvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏓᏣᏃᏁᎵ ᎢᏣᏛᏁᏗᏱ ᏣᎵᏍᏕᎸᏗᏱ ᏂᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏗᏣᏤᎵ ᏏᏓᏁᎸᎢ.
\ft Who shall tell thee words, whereby thou and all thy house shall be saved.

\ln Aqualenvhvno agiwonisv Galvquodiyu Adanvdo eladi nudvnelvgi, unilutsegi, nasgiya ayv tsigilutselv didalenisgvi.
\syll ᎠᏆᎴᏅᎲᏃ ᎠᎩᏬᏂᏒ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎡᎳᏗ ᏄᏛᏁᎸᎩ, ᎤᏂᎷᏤᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎠᏴ ᏥᎩᎷᏤᎸ ᏗᏓᎴᏂᏍᎬᎢ.
\ft And as I began to speak, the Holy Ghost fell on them, as on us at the beginning.

\ln Hnaquono aquanvdadvgi Ugvwiyuhi unetsvi, hia tsinuwesvgi; Tsani udohiyuhi ama dadawosdisgvgi, nihisgini Galvquodiyu Adanvdo dodayetsawostani.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎠᏆᏅᏓᏛᎩ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏁᏨᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏥᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᏣᏂ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎠᎹ ᏓᏓᏬᏍᏗᏍᎬᎩ, ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᏙᏓᏰᏣᏬᏍᏔᏂ.
\ft Then remembered I the word of the Lord, how that he said, John indeed baptized with water; but ye shall be baptized with the Holy Ghost.

\ln Iyuno Unelanvhi tsunelvhi yigi udanedi gesv nasgiya tsiginelvgi ayv nasgi edoiyunvhi Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv, gado ayv gese yeli gatsiyosdodanedi gese Unelanvhi.
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᏁᎸᎯ ᏱᎩ ᎤᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏥᎩᏁᎸᎩ ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᏙᎢᏳᏅᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ, ᎦᏙ ᎠᏴ ᎨᏎ ᏰᎵ ᎦᏥᏲᏍᏙᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏎ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ.
\ft Forasmuch then as God gave them the like gift as he did unto us, who believed on the Lord Jesus Christ; what was I, that I could withstand God?

\ln Unadvganvno nasgi elawe unvnei, ale unilvquotane Unelanvhi, hia nuniwesei:  nasquokani Unelanvhi tsunadalenvdv yvwi deunelv dunadanvdv tsuninetliyvsdiyi gvnidv waliyilohihi.
\syll ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᎳᏪ ᎤᏅᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᎸᏉᏔᏁ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ:  ᎾᏍᏉᎧᏂ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᏕᎤᏁᎸ ᏚᎾᏓᏅᏛ ᏧᏂᏁᏟᏴᏍᏗᏱ ᎬᏂᏛ ᏩᎵᏱᎶᎯᎯ.
\ft When they heard these things, they held their peace, and glorified God, saying, Then hath God also to the Gentiles granted repentance unto life.

\ln Unadigaleyotsvhino nahiyu uyo tsinunalisdanele, tsvtsudalenvhe Sdiwi, Quinisi iyvdv wunedolei, ale Saqui, ale Vtiogi, Anitsusiquo unvsv kanohedv daninohehehei.
\syll ᎤᎾᏗᎦᎴᏲᏨᎯᏃ ᏀᎢᏳ ᎤᏲ ᏥᏄᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᎴ, ᏨᏧᏓᎴᏅᎮ ᏍᏗᏫ, ᏈᏂᏏ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏭᏁᏙᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏌᏈ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏘᎣᎩ, ᎠᏂᏧᏏᏉ ᎤᏅᏒ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏓᏂᏃᎮᎮᎮᎢ.
\ft Now they which were scattered abroad upon the persecution that arose about Stephen travelled as far as Phenice, and Cyprus, and Antioch, preaching the word to none but unto the Jews only.

\ln Nasgino igadv Saqui ale Salini anehi gesei, nasgi Vtiogi wunilutsv duniwonetane Anigoi, aninohesge osdv kanohedv Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa ugvwali.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎢᎦᏛ ᏌᏈ ᎠᎴ ᏌᎵᏂ ᎠᏁᎯ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎥᏘᎣᎩ ᏭᏂᎷᏨ ᏚᏂᏬᏁᏔᏁ ᎠᏂᎪᎢ, ᎠᏂᏃᎮᏍᎨ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ.
\ft And some of them were men of Cyprus and Cyrene, which, when they were come to Antioch, spake unto the Grecians, preaching the Lord Jesus.

\ln Ugvwiyuhino uwoyeni tali udvdidegei, unitseteno unohiyunei, Ugvwiyuhino iditlv wunagatahvstanei.
\syll ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᏃ ᎤᏬᏰᏂ ᏔᎵ ᎤᏛᏗᏕᎨᎢ, ᎤᏂᏤᏖᏃ ᎤᏃᎯᏳᏁᎢ, ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᏃ ᎢᏗᏢ ᏭᎾᎦᏔᎲᏍᏔᏁᎢ.
\ft And the hand of the Lord was with them: and a great number believed, and turned unto the Lord.

\ln Tsunanelodino unadatlugv Tsilusilimi anehi nasgi hia unadvganei, uninvseno Quaniqua Vteogi iyvdv wuwedasdiyi.
\syll ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗᏃ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᎠᏁᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏁᎢ, ᎤᏂᏅᏎᏃ ᏆᏂᏆ ᎥᏖᎣᎩ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏭᏪᏓᏍᏗᏱ.
\ft Then tidings of these things came unto the ears of the church which was in Jerusalem: and they sent forth Barnabas, that he should go as far as Antioch.

\ln Nasgi wulutsv ale ugohv Unelanvhi udadolisdi gesvi, ulihelitsei, ale dutayosele nigadv ulinigidv unadanvdadisdiyi tsuniniyvdiyi Ugvwiyuhi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏭᎷᏨ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎪᎲ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᎵᎮᎵᏤᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏔᏲᏎᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗᏱ ᏧᏂᏂᏴᏗᏱ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ.
\ft Who, when he came, and had seen the grace of God, was glad, and exhorted them all, that with purpose of heart they would cleave unto the Lord.

\ln Udanvtiyeno gese asgaya, ale ukalitsvhi gese Galvquodiyu Adanvdo ale gohiyudi gesvi.  Unitsateno yvwi gvwanequotsele Ugvwiyuhi.
\syll ᎤᏓᏅᏘᏰᏃ ᎨᏎ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎧᎵᏨᎯ ᎨᏎ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎠᎴ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.  ᎤᏂᏣᏖᏃ ᏴᏫ ᎬᏩᏁᏉᏤᎴ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ.
\ft For he was a good man, and full of the Holy Ghost and of faith: and much people was added unto the Lord.

\ln Hnaquono Quaniqua Dasa wulose uyolvse Sola;
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏆᏂᏆ ᏓᏌ ᏭᎶᏎ ᎤᏲᎸᏎ ᏐᎳ;
\ft Then departed Barnabas to Tarsus, for to seek Saul:

\ln Uwadvhvno Vteogi utinolei.  Hiano nulistanei, nasgi sudetiyvdv nahna tsunanelodi unadatlugv danilawigei, ale unitsate yvwi duneyonei.  Vteogino igvyiyi Anigalonedv gegosele anohiyuhvsgi.
\syll ᎤᏩᏛᎲᏃ ᎥᏖᎣᎩ ᎤᏘᏃᎴᎢ.  ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏑᏕᏘᏴᏛ ᏀᎾ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬ ᏓᏂᎳᏫᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏣᏖ ᏴᏫ ᏚᏁᏲᏁᎢ.  ᎥᏖᎣᎩᏃ ᎢᎬᏱᏱ ᎠᏂᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎨᎪᏎᎴ ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ.
\ft And when he had found him, he brought him unto Antioch. And it came to pass, that a whole year they assembled themselves with the church, and taught much people. And the disciples were called Christians first in Antioch.

\ln Nahiyuno Tsilusilimi nvdayunilosvhi anadolehosgi unilutse Vteogi.
\syll ᏀᎢᏳᏃ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᏅᏓᏳᏂᎶᏒᎯ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᎷᏤ ᎥᏖᎣᎩ.

\syll ᎤᏂᏴᎲᏃ ᏗᏓᏍᏚᏗᏱ ᎤᏴᏔᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏲᎯᏎᎴ ᏅᎩ ᎢᏗᏂᎢᏛ ᏅᎩ ᏄᎾᏓᏡᎬ ᎠᏂᏯᏫᏍᎩ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏗᏍᎩ, ᎧᏃᎯᏰᎩ ᏗᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ ᎤᎶᏐᏅᎯ ᏴᏫ ᏧᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᏗᏱ ᎤᏰᎸᏎᎢ.
\ft And when he had apprehended him, he put him in prison, and delivered him to four quaternions of soldiers to keep him; intending after Easter to bring him forth to the people.

\ft Peter therefore was kept in prison: but prayer was made without ceasing of the church unto God for him.

\ft And when Herod would have brought him forth, the same night Peter was sleeping between two soldiers, bound with two chains: and the keepers before the door kept the prison.

\ln Gvniyuquono dikahnawadidohi Ugvwiyuhi utseli ulenile ganvgvi, igano udotse didasdudiyi; uwanilvno Quida asquageni, deuletanei, hia nuwesei; Talehvga tlegiyu.  Tsudadesvdvno dudoase tsuwoyeni.

\syll ᎢᎬᏱᏱᏃ ᎠᎴ ᏔᎵᏁ, ᎠᏂᏯᏫᏍᎬ ᎤᏂᎶᏒ ᏭᏂᎷᏤ ᏔᎷᎩᏍᎩ ᏗᏍᏚᏛ ᏗᎦᏚᎲ ᏫᎦᎾᏄᎪᎢᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏩᏒᏉ ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏚᎢᎡᎴᎢ.  ᎤᏂᏄᎪᏨᏃ ᏌᏉ ᎦᎳᏅᏛ ᎤᏂᎶᏎᎢ, ᎩᎳᏉᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎤᏓᏓᎴᏔᏁᎢ.

\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᏬᎵᏨ ᏈᏓ ᎦᏬᏂᏍᎬᎢ ᎣᏒ ᎤᏰᎸᏒ ᏅᏓᎵᏍᏙᏔᏁ ᏄᏍᏚᎢᏒᎾᏉ ᎨᏎ ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ, ᏚᏍᏆᎸᏔᏁᏉ ᏭᏴᎴᎢ ᎠᎴ ᏭᏃᏁ ᏈᏓ ᎦᏙᎬ ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏳᎶᏗ.

\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᎬᏩᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏣᎸᏃᏘᏉ.  ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏍᏓᏱᏕᏉ ᎧᏁᎬᎢ, ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏗ, ᎤᏛᏁᎢ.  ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ; ᏓᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎯᏉ.

\syll ᏓᏒᏍᏛᏃ ᎤᏍᏆᎸᎲ ᎡᎶᏛ ᎤᏄᏬᎥ ᎤᏂᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᎾᏄᏬᏍᏗ, ᎤᏪᏁ ᎢᏅ ᎢᎦᏘ ᎦᏍᎩᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᎵᏥᏙᏁᎴᎢ.

\ft And the word of the Lord was published throughout all the region.

\ln Aseno Anitsusi dunitelvne getsilvquodi anigeyv Unelanvhi anadadolisdanehi, ale nahna gaduhv digeganelodi anisgaya, ale nasgi nunvnisane gagetsisotlvdodiyi Quola ale Quaniqua, ale dunigehidole unatseligohi gesvi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᏚᏂᏖᎸᏁ ᎨᏥᎸᏉᏗ ᎠᏂᎨᏴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎾᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏀᎾ ᎦᏚᎲ ᏗᎨᎦᏁᎶᏗ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏅᏂᏌᏁ ᎦᎨᏥᏐᏢᏙᏗᏱ ᏉᎳ ᎠᎴ ᏆᏂᏆ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏂᎨᎯᏙᎴ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎪᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft But the Jews stirred up the devout and honourable women, and the chief men of the city, and raised persecution against Paul and Barnabas, and expelled them out of their coasts.

\ln Aseno duninvgovdanelequo gosdu tsunalasideni udanvliyevi, Igoniyano wunilutsei.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᏚᏂᏅᎪᎥᏓᏁᎴᏉ ᎪᏍᏚ ᏧᎾᎳᏏᏕᏂ ᎤᏓᏅᎵᏰᎥᎢ, ᎢᎪᏂᏯᏃ ᏭᏂᎷᏤᎢ.
\ft But they shook off the dust of their feet against them, and came unto Iconium.

\ln Anohiyuhvsgino unikalitsvhi gese analiheligvi ale Galvquodiyu Adanvdo.
\syll ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᏂᎧᎵᏨᎯ ᎨᏎ ᎠᎾᎵᎮᎵᎬᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ.
\ft And the disciples were filled with joy, and with the Holy Ghost.

\ln Hiano nulistane Igoniya, nasgi itsulaha wuniyvle Anitsusi tsunilawiisdiyi, ale nusdv aniwonisgv nvtsulisdotane unitsati Anitsusi ale nasquo Anigoi unohiyunei.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁ ᎢᎪᏂᏯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᏭᏂᏴᎴ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᏧᏂᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎠᏂᏬᏂᏍᎬ ᏅᏧᎵᏍᏙᏔᏁ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏂᎪᎢ ᎤᏃᎯᏳᏁᎢ.
\ft And it came to pass in Iconium, that they went both together into the synagogue of the Jews, and so spake, that a great multitude both of the Jews and also of the Greeks believed.

\ln Aseno nunohiyusvna Anitsusi dunitelvne tsunadalenvdv yvwi dunadanvdvi, nasgino nunvnisane dinisgagi nulistane analinvtli.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᏄᏃᎯᏳᏒᎾ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᏚᏂᏖᎸᏁ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᏚᎾᏓᏅᏛᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏄᏅᏂᏌᏁ ᏗᏂᏍᎦᎩ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁ ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏟ.
\ft But the unbelieving Jews stirred up the Gentiles, and made their minds evil affected against the brethren.

\ln Uwohitseno nahna unedolei, nanisgaihvna aniwonisge nvdigalisdodisge unalisgasdodv Ugvwiyuhi, nasgi asdayidisge kanohedv uwasv udadolitsadv kanohesgi, danehe tsunoyeni tsunvdodiyi uyelvdv ale usquanigodi tsunilvwisdanediyi.
\syll ᎤᏬᎯᏤᏃ ᏀᎾ ᎤᏁᏙᎴᎢ, ᎾᏂᏍᎦᎢᎲᎾ ᎠᏂᏬᏂᏍᎨ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨ ᎤᎾᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏛ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᏓᏱᏗᏍᎨ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏣᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏍᎩ, ᏓᏁᎮ ᏧᏃᏰᏂ ᏧᏅᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᏰᎸᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ.
\ft Long time therefore abode they speaking boldly in the Lord, which gave testimony unto the word of his grace, and granted signs and wonders to be done by their hands.

\ln Unitsatino nahna gaduhv anehi tali nunadadei; igadv Anitsusi dunaligonelei, igadvno getsinvsidv.
\syll ᎤᏂᏣᏘᏃ ᏀᎾ ᎦᏚᎲ ᎠᏁᎯ ᏔᎵ ᏄᎾᏓᏕᎢ; ᎢᎦᏛ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᏚᎾᎵᎪᏁᎴᎢ, ᎢᎦᏛᏃ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏛ.
\ft But the multitude of the city was divided: and part held with the Jews, and part with the apostles.

\ln Tsunadalenvdvno yvwi ale Anitsusi ale digeganelodi ananelugisge digvwanisotlvdodiyi ale nvya tsunvnisdodiyi,
\syll ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛᏃ ᏴᏫ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎨᎦᏁᎶᏗ ᎠᎾᏁᎷᎩᏍᎨ ᏗᎬᏩᏂᏐᏢᏙᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᏅᏯ ᏧᏅᏂᏍᏙᏗᏱ,
\ft And when there was an assault made both of the Gentiles, and also of the Jews with their rulers, to use them despitefully, and to stone them,

\ln Nasgi unadvganei, ale dunalitisei, Lisdi ale Daqui Ligeoniya degaduhv wunilosei, ale nahna gvwaduwidv gesvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᎾᎵᏘᏎᎢ, ᎵᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏓᏈ ᎵᎨᎣᏂᏯ ᏕᎦᏚᎲ ᏭᏂᎶᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏀᎾ ᎬᏩᏚᏫᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft They were ware of it, and fled unto Lystra and Derbe, cities of Lycaonia, and unto the region that lieth round about:

\ln Nahnano anedohe analitsidohvsge osdv kanohedv.
\syll ᏀᎾᏃ ᎠᏁᏙᎮ ᎠᎾᎵᏥᏙᎲᏍᎨ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ.
\ft And there they preached the gospel.

\ln Gilono iyusdi asgaya uwole Lisdi ayouli tsulasideni, nayoule udenv, ilvhiyu uwedolvhi nigesvna.
\syll ᎩᎶᏃ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᏬᎴ ᎵᏍᏗ ᎠᏲᎤᎵ ᏧᎳᏏᏕᏂ, ᎾᏲᎤᎴ ᎤᏕᏅ, ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᎤᏪᏙᎸᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.
\ft And there sat a certain man at Lystra, impotent in his feet, being a cripple from his mother's womb, who never had walked:

\ln Nasgi udvgane gawonisgv Quola, nasgi uyanvsvhi dukahnanv ale udolehosv uhv gohiyudi gesv anvwodi,
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏛᎦᏁ ᎦᏬᏂᏍᎬ ᏉᎳ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏯᏅᏒᎯ ᏚᎧᎿᏅ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏙᎴᎰᏒ ᎤᎲ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏅᏬᏗ,
\ft The same heard Paul speak: who stedfastly beholding him, and perceiving that he had faith to be healed,

\ln Hia nuwese asdaya; Gatsinosdv halehvga.  Dulitadinvseno ale uwedolei.
\syll ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎ ᎠᏍᏓᏯ; ᎦᏥᏃᏍᏛ ᎭᎴᎲᎦ.  ᏚᎵᏔᏗᏅᏎᏃ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏪᏙᎴᎢ.
\ft Said with a loud voice, Stand upright on thy feet. And he leaped and walked.

\ln Unitsatino unigohv nudvnelv Quola unisaladane aninegvi, Ligeoniya anehi uniwonihisdi unvtane hia nuniwesei; Galvladi anehi anatloasiga yvwi nunasdv nasgiya iyunasdi.
\syll ᎤᏂᏣᏘᏃ ᎤᏂᎪᎲ ᏄᏛᏁᎸ ᏉᎳ ᎤᏂᏌᎳᏓᏁ ᎠᏂᏁᎬᎢ, ᎵᎨᎣᏂᏯ ᎠᏁᎯ ᎤᏂᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᎤᏅᏔᏁ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ; ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎠᏁᎯ ᎠᎾᏠᎠᏏᎦ ᏴᏫ ᏄᎾᏍᏛ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗ.
\ft And when the people saw what Paul had done, they lifted up their voices, saying in the speech of Lycaonia, The gods are come down to us in the likeness of men.

\ln Quaniquano Tsuquida dunoei, Quolano Maguli dunoei, nasgiyeno nugvwiyusv alitsidohvsgi gesei.
\syll ᏆᏂᏆᏃ ᏧᏈᏓ ᏚᏃᎡᎢ, ᏉᎳᏃ ᎹᎫᎵ ᏚᏃᎡᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᎵᏥᏙᎲᏍᎩ ᎨᏎᎢ.
\ft And they called Barnabas, Jupiter; and Paul, Mercurius, because he was the chief speaker.

\ln Hnaquono atsilvgelosehi Tsuquida nasgi gaduhv igvyiditlv gotlvsvi, galohisdiyulodi dutinole waga ale digodvidv unitsilvnvhi deunolei, nasgi uwasv ale unitsati gesv atsilvunelasdiyi uyelvsei.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎠᏥᎸᎨᎶᏎᎯ ᏧᏈᏓ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏚᎲ ᎢᎬᏱᏗᏢ ᎪᏢᏒᎢ, ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏳᎶᏗ ᏚᏘᏃᎴ ᏩᎦ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎪᏛᎢᏛ ᎤᏂᏥᎸᏅᎯ ᏕᎤᏃᎴᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏥᎸᎤᏁᎳᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏰᎸᏎᎢ.
\ft Then the priest of Jupiter, which was before their city, brought oxen and garlands unto the gates, and would have done sacrifice with the people.

\ln Aseno getsinvsidv Quaniqua ale Quola unadvganv dunitsagalvhe tsunanuwo, unitsatino yvwi dinedohv widunaditlvstanei, unelunei,
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏛ ᏆᏂᏆ ᎠᎴ ᏉᎳ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅ ᏚᏂᏣᎦᎸᎮ ᏧᎾᏄᏬ, ᎤᏂᏣᏘᏃ ᏴᏫ ᏗᏁᏙᎲ ᏫᏚᎾᏗᏢᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᎤᏁᎷᏁᎢ,
\ft Which when the apostles, Barnabas and Paul, heard of, they rent their clothes, and ran in among the people, crying out,

\ln Hia naniwesgei; Itsisgaya, gadono nasgi hia nitsadvneha?  Ayv nasquo yvwiquo nasgiya nitsalisdanehv iyoginalisdanehi, ale itsvyalitsidoneha ditsiyohisdiyi hia asequoquo nitsadvnehvi, witsagatahvsdiyino gvnidv Unelanvhi iditlv, nasgi uwotlvnvhi tsigi galvloi ale gadohi ale amequohi ale naniv nahna anehi;
\syll ᎯᎠ ᎾᏂᏪᏍᎨᎢ; ᎢᏥᏍᎦᏯ, ᎦᏙᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎭ?  ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏴᏫᏉ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏂᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᎢᏲᎩᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏨᏯᎵᏥᏙᏁᎭ ᏗᏥᏲᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏎᏉᏉ ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎲᎢ, ᏫᏣᎦᏔᎲᏍᏗᏱᏃ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᏗᏢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏬᏢᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎦᎸᎶᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎦᏙᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎺᏉᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏀᎾ ᎠᏁᎯ;
\ft And saying, Sirs, why do ye these things? We also are men of like passions with you, and preach unto you that ye should turn from these vanities unto the living God, which made heaven, and earth, and the sea, and all things that are therein:

\ln Nasgi ilvhiyu tsigesvgi unanelagi unvsv duninvnv wanilohi duwelisele nigadv nunadalesv yvwi;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᏥᎨᏒᎩ ᎤᎾᏁᎳᎩ ᎤᏅᏒ ᏚᏂᏅᏅ ᏩᏂᎶᎯ ᏚᏪᎵᏎᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏄᎾᏓᎴᏒ ᏴᏫ;
\ft Who in times past suffered all nations to walk in their own ways.

\ln Vtlasgininonv waginigohi gvnigesv iyaquvnehi yuwelisei, nasgi osdv dulvwisdanehvi, ale igiganodanehvi galvladi digalosgvi, ale igalisgolvdanehv utsati gohusdi udvhisdiyi nidadetiyvhisvi, diginawi dakaliisdisgv alisdayvdi ale ulihelisdi.
\syll ᎥᏝᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᏩᎩᏂᎪᎯ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏯᏋᏁᎯ ᏳᏪᎵᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᎩᎦᏃᏓᏁᎲᎢ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏗᎦᎶᏍᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᎦᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᎲ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏛᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᏓᏕᏘᏴᎯᏒᎢ, ᏗᎩᎾᏫ ᏓᎧᎵᎢᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᎮᎵᏍᏗ.
\ft Nevertheless he left not himself without witness, in that he did good, and gave us rain from heaven, and fruitful seasons, filling our hearts with food and gladness.

\ln Nasgino naniwesgvi ganila duniyosdodanele unitsati atsilvgvwanelediyi anadanvtesgvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎾᏂᏪᏍᎬᎢ ᎦᏂᎳ ᏚᏂᏲᏍᏙᏓᏁᎴ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎠᏥᎸᎬᏩᏁᎴᏗᏱ ᎠᎾᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬᎢ.
\ft And with these sayings scarce restrained they the people, that they had not done sacrifice unto them.

\ln Aseno unilutse Anitsusi Vtiogi ale Igoniya nvdayunilosvhi, nasgi dunitayosele unitsati, Quolano nvya degvwanistanv gvwanasanawidvhe gaduhv gvwanuhisei, uyohusv anelisgei.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏂᎷᏤ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎥᏘᎣᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎢᎪᏂᏯ ᏅᏓᏳᏂᎶᏒᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᏂᏔᏲᏎᎴ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ, ᏉᎳᏃ ᏅᏯ ᏕᎬᏩᏂᏍᏔᏅ ᎬᏩᎾᏌᎾᏫᏛᎮ ᎦᏚᎲ ᎬᏩᏄᎯᏎᎢ, ᎤᏲᎱᏒ ᎠᏁᎵᏍᎨᎢ.
\ft And there came thither certain Jews from Antioch and Iconium, who persuaded the people, and, having stoned Paul, drew him out of the city, supposing he had been dead.

\ln Aseno unaligohi degvwaduwisdei dulenei, ale digaduhv wuyvlei.  Ugitsvdvno Quaniqua unanigisei, Daqui wunilosei.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᎾᎵᎪᎯ ᏕᎬᏩᏚᏫᏍᏕᎢ ᏚᎴᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎦᏚᎲ ᏭᏴᎴᎢ.  ᎤᎩᏨᏛᏃ ᏆᏂᏆ ᎤᎾᏂᎩᏎᎢ, ᏓᏈ ᏭᏂᎶᏎᎢ.
\ft Howbeit, as the disciples stood round about him, he rose up, and came into the city: and the next day he departed with Barnabas to Derbe.

\ln Unalitsidonelvno osdv kanohedv nasgi gaduhvi, ale anigodiyu dunaligotanv, taline Lisdi ale Igoniya ale Vtiogi wiunilosei,
\syll ᎤᎾᎵᏥᏙᏁᎸᏃ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏚᎲᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᎪᏗᏳ ᏚᎾᎵᎪᏔᏅ, ᏔᎵᏁ ᎵᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎢᎪᏂᏯ ᎠᎴ ᎥᏘᎣᎩ ᏫᎤᏂᎶᏎᎢ,
\ft And when they had preached the gospel to that city, and had taught many, they returned again to Lystra, and to Iconium, and Antioch,

\ln Danalinigohisdisge dunadanvdv anohiyuhvsgi, danitayosehe tsuniyohisdiyi nigesvna gohiyudi gesvi, ale daninonehe utsati agiliyv igilohisdi gesv Unelanvhi utseligohi wigiyvsdiyi.
\syll ᏓᎾᎵᏂᎪᎯᏍᏗᏍᎨ ᏚᎾᏓᏅᏛ ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ, ᏓᏂᏔᏲᏎᎮ ᏧᏂᏲᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᏂᏃᏁᎮ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎠᎩᎵᏴ ᎢᎩᎶᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎪᎯ ᏫᎩᏴᏍᏗᏱ.
\ft Confirming the souls of the disciples, and exhorting them to continue in the faith, and that we must through much tribulation enter into the kingdom of God.

\ln Dunikanvno digeganeloti tsunanelodi dunadatluwadisvi, ale unadadolistanv amatli anvsgvi, duniyohisele Ugvwiyuhi nasgi Ugvwiyuhi unohiyunvhi.
\syll ᏚᏂᎧᏅᏃ ᏗᎨᎦᏁᎶᏘ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᏚᎾᏓᏡᏩᏗᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏓᏙᎵᏍᏔᏅ ᎠᎹᏟ ᎠᏅᏍᎬᎢ, ᏚᏂᏲᎯᏎᎴ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏃᎯᏳᏅᎯ.
\ft And when they had ordained them elders in every church, and had prayed with fasting, they commended them to the Lord, on whom they believed.

\ln Quasidiyino unilosonv Quamiquiliyi wunilutsei.
\syll ᏆᏏᏗᏱᏃ ᎤᏂᎶᏐᏅ ᏆᎻᏈᎵᏱ ᏭᏂᎷᏤᎢ.
\ft And after they had passed throughout Pisidia, they came to Pamphylia.

\ln Quagino kanohedv unalitsidonv Atadaya wunilutsei.

\ft Known unto God are all his works from the beginning of the world.

\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏴ ᎦᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏓᏕᏯᏙᏙᏗᏱᏉ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᎠᏁᎲ ᎤᎾᏖᎴᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᏗᏢ ᏭᎾᎦᏔᎲᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ;

\syll ᏗᏙᏪᎳᏁᏗᏱᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᏧᏂᏲᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎦᏓᎭ ᎢᏧᎵᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏗᏰᎸᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᏗᏂᏏᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎬᏬᏍᏔᏅᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎩᎬ.

\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎤᏂᏰᎸᏁ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏛ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎨᎦᏁᎶᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬ ᏧᏂᏅᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ ᏧᎾᏑᏰᏛ ᎤᏅᏒ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏓᏏ ᏆᏏᏆ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ ᎠᎴ ᏌᏱᎳ ᎨᏥᎸᏉᏗ ᎠᎾᏓᏅᏢᎢ, ᏉᎳ ᎠᎴ ᏆᏂᏆ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎤᏁᏅᏍᏗᏱ ᎥᏘᏍᎩ,
\ft Then pleased it the apostles and elders, with the whole church, to send chosen men of their own company to Antioch with Paul and Barnabas; namely, Judas surnamed Barsabas, and Silas, chief men among the brethren:

\ln Nasgino uninvsdi unowelane hia nunvnelei; Oginvsidv ale tsoganelodi ale otsadanvtli witsvyoliga itsadanvtli ditsadalenvdv yvwi Vtisgi ale Siliyi ale Silisiyi itsehi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᏂᏅᏍᏗ ᎤᏃᏪᎳᏁ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏅᏁᎴᎢ; ᎣᎩᏅᏏᏛ ᎠᎴ ᏦᎦᏁᎶᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎣᏣᏓᏅᏟ ᏫᏨᏲᎵᎦ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏟ ᏗᏣᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᎥᏘᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ ᏏᎵᏱ ᎠᎴ ᏏᎵᏏᏱ ᎢᏤᎯ.
\ft And they wrote letters by them after this manner; The apostles and elders and brethren send greeting unto the brethren which are of the Gentiles in Antioch and Syria and Cilicia:

\ln Ogvdvganv gilo iyunasdi gogadasuyedv aniwonisgv getsadeyadotanvi degetsigatahvehv ditsadanvdo, hia naniwesgvi; Ase tsetsiusdesedi ale dikahnawadvsdi itsisquanigododi; nasgi iyusdi tsotsinetselvhi nigesvna;
\syll ᎣᎬᏛᎦᏅ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗ ᎪᎦᏓᏑᏰᏛ ᎠᏂᏬᏂᏍᎬ ᎨᏣᏕᏯᏙᏔᏅᎢ ᏕᎨᏥᎦᏔᎲᎡᎲ ᏗᏣᏓᏅᏙ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏂᏪᏍᎬᎢ; ᎠᏎ ᏤᏥᎤᏍᏕᏎᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎢᏥᏍᏆᏂᎪᏙᏗ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏦᏥᏁᏤᎸᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ;
\ft Forasmuch as we have heard, that certain which went out from us have troubled you with words, subverting your souls, saying, Ye must be circumcised, and keep the law: to whom we gave no such commandment:

\ln Nasgi nvtsulisdotanv osiyu ogiyelvnv nigadv saquo igagadv, ditsehv tsotsinvsdiyi tsotsasuyedv anisgaya tsunisdawadvsdiyi tsotsigeyuhi Quaniqua ale Quola,
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏧᎵᏍᏙᏔᏅ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎣᎩᏰᎸᏅ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏌᏉ ᎢᎦᎦᏛ, ᏗᏤᎲ ᏦᏥᏅᏍᏗᏱ ᏦᏣᏑᏰᏛ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ ᏧᏂᏍᏓᏩᏛᏍᏗᏱ ᏦᏥᎨᏳᎯ ᏆᏂᏆ ᎠᎴ ᏉᎳ,
\ft It seemed good unto us, being assembled with one accord, to send chosen men unto you with our beloved Barnabas and Paul,

\ln Nasgi anisgaya danvnv tsunalisgolvtanvhi, igatseli Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv deudov nvdigalisdidodisgvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ ᏓᏅᏅ ᏧᎾᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏅᎯ, ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏕᎤᏙᎥ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏗᏙᏗᏍᎬᎢ.
\ft Men that have hazarded their lives for the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi dotsinvli Tsudasi ale Sayila, nasgi nasquo aninegvi utloyi dagetsinoheheli.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏙᏥᏅᎵ ᏧᏓᏏ ᎠᎴ ᏌᏱᎳ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏂᏁᎬᎢ ᎤᏠᏱ ᏓᎨᏥᏃᎮᎮᎵ.
\ft We have sent therefore Judas and Silas, who shall also tell you the same things by mouth.

\ln Osiyuyeno uyelvnv Galvquodiyu Adanvdo, ale ayv osiyu sgiyelvnv, gohusdi ditsvyayenvdodiyi nigesvna, hia uwasv nasgi ase iyadvnedi tsigi;
\syll ᎣᏏᏳᏰᏃ ᎤᏰᎸᏅ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴ ᎣᏏᏳ ᏍᎩᏰᎸᏅ, ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏗᏨᏯᏰᏅᏙᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎯᎠ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏎ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᏗ ᏥᎩ;
\ft For it seemed good to the Holy Ghost, and to us, to lay upon you no greater burden than these necessary things;

\ln Nasgi ditsiyohisdiyi alisdayvdi Unelanvhi diyelvhi dilisgolvdanelvhi, ale gigv, ale gohusdi gvwostanvhi, ale udelidv dinisidi gesvi.  Iyuno nasgi yiditseyadotselv osiyu yinitsadvga.  Dohiyi nitsadvhnadegesdi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏥᏲᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏗᏰᎸᎯ ᏗᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᎸᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎩᎬ, ᎠᎴ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎬᏬᏍᏔᏅᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᏗᏂᏏᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.  ᎢᏳᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᏗᏤᏯᏙᏤᎸ ᎣᏏᏳ ᏱᏂᏣᏛᎦ.  ᏙᎯᏱ ᏂᏣᏛᎿᏕᎨᏍᏗ.
\ft That ye abstain from meats offered to idols, and from blood, and from things strangled, and from fornication: from which if ye keep yourselves, ye shall do well. Fare ye well.

\ln Nasgino degetsiyosv Vtiogi wunilutsei, dunilawidvno unitsati duninvnele nasgi goweli.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏕᎨᏥᏲᏒ ᎥᏘᎣᎩ ᏭᏂᎷᏤᎢ, ᏚᏂᎳᏫᏛᏃ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏚᏂᏅᏁᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᏪᎵ.
\ft So when they were dismissed, they came to Antioch: and when they had gathered the multitude together, they delivered the epistle:

\ln Nasgino unigoliyev, unalihelitse nvdigalisdodisge nasgi adagalisdadisgi gesvi
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᏂᎪᎵᏰᎥ, ᎤᎾᎵᎮᎵᏤ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏓᎦᎵᏍᏓᏗᏍᎩ ᎨᏒᎢ
\ft Which when they had read, they rejoiced for the consolation.

\ln Tsudasino ale Sayila, utsate ikanetsvhi duniwonetane anadanvtli ale dunalinigohistanei, nasquoyeno unvsv anadolehosgi gesei.
\syll ᏧᏓᏏᏃ ᎠᎴ ᏌᏱᎳ, ᎤᏣᏖ ᎢᎧᏁᏨᎯ ᏚᏂᏬᏁᏔᏁ ᎠᎾᏓᏅᏟ ᎠᎴ ᏚᎾᎵᏂᎪᎯᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᎾᏍᏉᏰᏃ ᎤᏅᏒ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎨᏎᎢ.
\ft And Judas and Silas, being prophets also themselves, exhorted the brethren with many words, and confirmed them.

\ln Ilvsgino nuwohitsv unedolv, nvwadohiyadv degvwaniyose anadanvtli getsinvsidv dinehv wunilohisdiyi.
\syll ᎢᎸᏍᎩᏃ ᏄᏬᎯᏨ ᎤᏁᏙᎸ, ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᏕᎬᏩᏂᏲᏎ ᎠᎾᏓᏅᏟ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏛ ᏗᏁᎲ ᏭᏂᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ.
\ft And after they had tarried there a space, they were let go in peace from the brethren unto the apostles.

\ln Aseno Sayila osiyu uyelvne nahnaquo udigiyasdiyi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᏌᏱᎳ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎤᏰᎸᏁ ᏀᎾᏉ ᎤᏗᎩᏯᏍᏗᏱ.
\ft Notwithstanding it pleased Silas to abide there still.

\ln Quolano ale Quaniqua nasquo gvnedohe Vtiogi danadeyohvsgei, ale analitsidohvsge kanohedv Ugvwiyuhi utseliga, ale nasquo unitsate nvwanadalei.
\syll ᏉᎳᏃ ᎠᎴ ᏆᏂᏆ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎬᏁᏙᎮ ᎥᏘᎣᎩ ᏓᎾᏕᏲᎲᏍᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎾᎵᏥᏙᎲᏍᎨ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᏂᏣᏖ ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴᎢ.
\ft Paul also and Barnabas continued in Antioch, teaching and preaching the word of the Lord, with many others also.

\ln Ilvsgino winusvlv Quola hia nuweselvgi Quaniqua; Ka taline tsidoniwadvhuga idadanvtli nigav degaduwadisv nahna ginalitsidonidolv kanohedv Ugvwiyuhi utseliga, winadolehohi nunadvhnadegvi.
\syll ᎢᎸᏍᎩᏃ ᏫᏄᏒᎸ ᏉᎳ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ ᏆᏂᏆ; Ꭷ ᏔᎵᏁ ᏥᏙᏂᏩᏛᎱᎦ ᎢᏓᏓᏅᏟ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏕᎦᏚᏩᏗᏒ ᏀᎾ ᎩᎾᎵᏥᏙᏂᏙᎸ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᏫᎾᏙᎴᎰᎯ ᏄᎾᏛᎿᏕᎬᎢ.
\ft And some days after Paul said unto Barnabas, Let us go again and visit our brethren in every city where we have preached the word of the Lord, and see how they do.

\ln Quaniquano udulisgvgi unatinvsdiyi Tsani Maga tsudoidv.
\syll ᏆᏂᏆᏃ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎬᎩ ᎤᎾᏘᏅᏍᏗᏱ ᏣᏂ ᎹᎦ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ.
\ft And Barnabas determined to take with them John, whose surname was Mark.

\ln Aseno Quola vtla osiyu yuyelvne unatinvsdiyi, nasgiyeno unadadaledanele Quamiquiliyi, ale vtla yunaligonele dunilvwisdanelidohvi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᏉᎳ ᎥᏝ ᎣᏏᏳ ᏳᏰᎸᏁ ᎤᎾᏘᏅᏍᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎤᎾᏓᏓᎴᏓᏁᎴ ᏆᎻᏈᎵᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᏳᎾᎵᎪᏁᎴ ᏚᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎵᏙᎲᎢ.
\ft But Paul thought not good to take him with them, who departed from them from Pamphylia, and went not with them to the work.

\ln Ale utsati uniyotlohiselvgi, nasgi iyusdi widegvwanagalenvhvgi; Quaniquano utinvsvgi Maga, ale tsiyuhi wutsanv Saqui wulosvgi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᏂᏲᏠᎯᏎᎸᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏫᏕᎬᏩᎾᎦᎴᏅᎲᎩ; ᏆᏂᏆᏃ ᎤᏘᏅᏒᎩ ᎹᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᏳᎯ ᏭᏣᏅ ᏌᏈ ᏭᎶᏒᎩ.
\ft And the contention was so sharp between them, that they departed asunder one from the other: and so Barnabas took Mark, and sailed unto Cyprus;

\ln Quolano usuyesv Sayila, unigisvgi, anadanvtli degvwayosv Unelanvhi uwedolisdiyi.
\syll ᏉᎳᏃ ᎤᏑᏰᏒ ᏌᏱᎳ, ᎤᏂᎩᏒᎩ, ᎠᎾᏓᏅᏟ ᏕᎬᏩᏲᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏪᏙᎵᏍᏗᏱ.
\ft And Paul chose Silas, and departed, being recommended by the brethren unto the grace of God.

\ln Siliyino ale Silisiyi ulosvgi, dalinigohisdisgvgi tsunanelodi dunadatluwadisvi.
\syll ᏏᎵᏱᏃ ᎠᎴ ᏏᎵᏏᏱ ᎤᎶᏒᎩ, ᏓᎵᏂᎪᎯᏍᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᏚᎾᏓᏡᏩᏗᏒᎢ.
\ft And he went through Syria and Cilicia, confirming the churches.

\ln Daquino ale Lisdi wulutsvgi, gvniyuquono nahna ehvgi gilo igesdi gohiyuhvsgi, Dimadi tsudoidv, Atsusi, ageyv gohiyuhvsgi utsi gesvgi, udodasgini Agoi gesvgi.
\syll ᏓᏈᏃ ᎠᎴ ᎵᏍᏗ ᏭᎷᏨᎩ, ᎬᏂᏳᏉᏃ ᏀᎾ ᎡᎲᎩ ᎩᎶ ᎢᎨᏍᏗ ᎪᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ, ᏗᎹᏗ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ, ᎠᏧᏏ, ᎠᎨᏴ ᎪᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᎤᏥ ᎨᏒᎩ, ᎤᏙᏓᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᎪᎢ ᎨᏒᎩ.
\ft Then came he to Derbe and Lystra: and, behold, a certain disciple was there, named Timotheus, the son of a certain woman, which was a Jewess, and believed; but his father was a Greek:

\ln Nasgi osiyu gvwanohesgi gesvgi anadanvtli Lisdi ale Igoniya anehi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎬᏩᏃᎮᏍᎩ ᎨᏒᎩ ᎠᎾᏓᏅᏟ ᎵᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎢᎪᏂᏯ ᎠᏁᎯ.
\ft Which was well reported of by the brethren that were at Lystra and Iconium.

\ln Nasgi Quola udulvhvgi utinvsdiyi; uhusdeselvgino nvdayulisdotanvgi Anitsusi nahna danewadisvi, nigadvyeno anigatahvgi udoda Agoi gesvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏉᎳ ᎤᏚᎸᎲᎩ ᎤᏘᏅᏍᏗᏱ; ᎤᎱᏍᏕᏎᎸᎩᏃ ᏅᏓᏳᎵᏍᏙᏔᏅᎩ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᏀᎾ ᏓᏁᏩᏗᏒᎢ, ᏂᎦᏛᏰᏃ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎲᎩ ᎤᏙᏓ ᎠᎪᎢ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Him would Paul have to go forth with him; and took and circumcised him because of the Jews which were in those quarters: for they knew all that his father was a Greek.

\ln Degaduwadisvno anilosgvi, daniyohisehvgi unisquanigododi dikahnawadvsdi, nasgi tsunugotanvhi getsinvsidv ale digeganelodi Tsilusilimi anehi.
\syll ᏕᎦᏚᏩᏗᏒᏃ ᎠᏂᎶᏍᎬᎢ, ᏓᏂᏲᎯᏎᎲᎩ ᎤᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏙᏗ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏄᎪᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏛ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎨᎦᏁᎶᏗ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᎠᏁᎯ.
\ft And as they went through the cities, they delivered them the decrees for to keep, that were ordained of the apostles and elders which were at Jerusalem.

\ln Tsunanelodino dunadatluwadisv dunalinigosvgi gohiyudi gesvi, ale nidugitsvnisv anigodosgvgi.
\syll ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗᏃ ᏚᎾᏓᏡᏩᏗᏒ ᏚᎾᎵᏂᎪᏒᎩ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᏚᎩᏨᏂᏒ ᎠᏂᎪᏙᏍᎬᎩ.
\ft And so were the churches established in the faith, and increased in number daily.

\ln Unilosonvno Quitsiyi ale Gelesiyi, ale Galvquodiyu Adanvdo uninvsdadelv unalitsidodiyi kanohedv Esiyi,
\syll ᎤᏂᎶᏐᏅᏃ ᏈᏥᏱ ᎠᎴ ᎨᎴᏏᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᏂᏅᏍᏓᏕᎸ ᎤᎾᎵᏥᏙᏗᏱ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎡᏏᏱ,
\ft Now when they had gone throughout Phrygia and the region of Galatia, and were forbidden of the Holy Ghost to preach the word in Asia,

\ln Misiyi wunilutsv, unadanvtelvgi Quidiniyi wunilohisdiyi, aseno vtla unanelagi yiduwelisele Adanvdo.
\syll ᎻᏏᏱ ᏭᏂᎷᏨ, ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏖᎸᎩ ᏈᏗᏂᏱ ᏭᏂᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎤᎾᏁᎳᎩ ᏱᏚᏪᎵᏎᎴ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ.
\ft After they were come to Mysia, they assayed to go into Bithynia: but the Spirit suffered them not.

\ln Misiyino unilosv, Tloasi wunilutsvgi.
\syll ᎻᏏᏱᏃ ᎤᏂᎶᏒ, ᏠᎠᏏ ᏭᏂᎷᏨᎩ.
\ft And they passing by Mysia came down to Troas.

\ln Quolano unelawiselvgi svnoyi; gilo iyusdi asgaya Masidoni ehi gadogei, utayosehei, hia nuwesehei; Masidoni wilugi, ale wisgisdelv.
\syll ᏉᎳᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏫᏎᎸᎩ ᏒᏃᏱ; ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎹᏏᏙᏂ ᎡᎯ ᎦᏙᎨᎢ, ᎤᏔᏲᏎᎮᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎮᎢ; ᎹᏏᏙᏂ ᏫᎷᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏫᏍᎩᏍᏕᎸ.
\ft And a vision appeared to Paul in the night; There stood a man of Macedonia, and prayed him, saying, Come over into Macedonia, and help us.

\ln Unelawiselvno gilaquo iyvdv oganelotanvgi Masidoni wogilohisdiyi, otsadolehosgvgi Ugvwiyuhi ogiyanisgvi nasgi tsotsalitsidonediyi osdv kanohedv.
\syll ᎤᏁᎳᏫᏎᎸᏃ ᎩᎳᏉ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎣᎦᏁᎶᏔᏅᎩ ᎹᏏᏙᏂ ᏬᎩᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ, ᎣᏣᏙᎴᎰᏍᎬᎩ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎣᎩᏯᏂᏍᎬᎢ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏦᏣᎵᏥᏙᏁᏗᏱ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ.
\ft And after he had seen the vision, immediately we endeavored to go into Macedonia, assuredly gathering that the Lord had called us for to preach the gospel unto them.

\ln Nasgino Tloasi tsiyuhi ogatsanv tsuyugodi woginvstanvgi, Sematlesi woginolvgi; ugitsvdvno Niaqualisi woginolvgi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏠᎠᏏ ᏥᏳᎯ ᎣᎦᏣᏅ ᏧᏳᎪᏗ ᏬᎩᏅᏍᏔᏅᎩ, ᏎᎹᏞᏏ ᏬᎩᏃᎸᎩ; ᎤᎩᏨᏛᏃ ᏂᎠᏆᎵᏏ ᏬᎩᏃᎸᎩ.
\ft Therefore loosing from Troas, we came with a straight course to Samothracia, and the next day to Neapolis;

\ln Nahnano wiogatsanv, Quiligiyi woginolvgi, nasgi nugvwiyusv gaduhv nahna iditlv Masidoni, ale nasgi unadanvdv uniduhv tsigi.  Nahnano gaduhv ilvsgi tsusvhidv ogedolvgi.
\syll ᏀᎾᏃ ᏫᎣᎦᏣᏅ, ᏈᎵᎩᏱ ᏬᎩᏃᎸᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎦᏚᎲ ᏀᎾ ᎢᏗᏢ ᎹᏏᏙᏂ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏛ ᎤᏂᏚᎲ ᏥᎩ.  ᏀᎾᏃ ᎦᏚᎲ ᎢᎸᏍᎩ ᏧᏒᎯᏛ ᎣᎨᏙᎸᎩ.
\ft And from thence to Philippi, which is the chief city of that part of Macedonia, and a colony: and we were in that city abiding certain days.

\ln Unadodaquasgvno gaduhv oginugotsvgi, equonulodi wogilosvgi adadolisdodiyi gesvi; oganvnvno dotsiwonetanv anigeyv nahna unadatlisanvhi.
\syll ᎤᎾᏙᏓᏆᏍᎬᏃ ᎦᏚᎲ ᎣᎩᏄᎪᏨᎩ, ᎡᏉᏄᎶᏗ ᏬᎩᎶᏒᎩ ᎠᏓᏙᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎣᎦᏅᏅᏃ ᏙᏥᏬᏁᏔᏅ ᎠᏂᎨᏴ ᏀᎾ ᎤᎾᏓᏟᏌᏅᎯ.
\ft And on the sabbath we went out of the city by a river side, where prayer was wont to be made; and we sat down, and spake unto the women which resorted thither.

\ln Gilono iyusdi ageyv Lidi tsudoidv, gigage dinuwo ganodisgi, Dayidali gaduhv ehi, Unelanvhi adadolistanehi, udvdastanvgi.  Nasgi unawiyi Ugvwiyuhi usduisvgi, udvdasdodiyi Quola kanegvi.
\syll ᎩᎶᏃ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᎨᏴ ᎵᏗ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ, ᎩᎦᎨ ᏗᏄᏬ ᎦᏃᏗᏍᎩ, ᏓᏱᏓᎵ ᎦᏚᎲ ᎡᎯ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᏓᏙᎵᏍᏔᏁᎯ, ᎤᏛᏓᏍᏔᏅᎩ.  ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᏫᏱ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏍᏚᎢᏒᎩ, ᎤᏛᏓᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏉᎳ ᎧᏁᎬᎢ.
\ft And a certain woman named Lydia, a seller of purple, of the city of Thyatira, which worshipped God, heard us: whose heart the Lord opened, that she attended unto the things which were spoken of Paul.

\ln Agawovno uwasv ale nasgi dudatinavi, ogitayoselvgi, hia nuwesvgi; Iyuno udohiyusv Ugvwiyuhi gohiyuhvsgi sgiyelisehesdi, tsinelv itsiyvha ale nahna itsinesdi.  Ogisdiyedisgvno ogisegogisvgi.
\syll ᎠᎦᏬᎥᏃ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᏓᏘᎾᎥᎢ, ᎣᎩᏔᏲᏎᎸᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᏒ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎪᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᏍᎩᏰᎵᏎᎮᏍᏗ, ᏥᏁᎸ ᎢᏥᏴᎭ ᎠᎴ ᏀᎾ ᎢᏥᏁᏍᏗ.  ᎣᎩᏍᏗᏰᏗᏍᎬᏃ ᎣᎩᏎᎪᎩᏒᎩ.
\ft And when she was baptized, and her household, she besought us, saying, If ye have judged me to be faithful to the Lord, come into my house, and abide there. And she constrained us.

\ln Hiano nulistanvgi, adadolisdodiyi ogenv, gilo iyusdi adv, adanvdo adonisgi uyai, dogatlosvgi, nasgi utsadv tsugvwalodi dawadvehvgi gvwanatlai adonisgv gvdisgi.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎩ, ᎠᏓᏙᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎣᎨᏅ, ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏛ, ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎠᏙᏂᏍᎩ ᎤᏯᎢ, ᏙᎦᏠᏒᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏣᏛ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᏓᏩᏛᎡᎲᎩ ᎬᏩᎾᏝᎢ ᎠᏙᏂᏍᎬ ᎬᏗᏍᎩ.
\ft And it came to pass, as we went to prayer, a certain damsel possessed with a spirit of divination met us, which brought her masters much gain by soothsaying:

\ln Nasgi ogisdawadisv Quola ale ayv, uwelunvgi hia nuwesvgi; Hia anisgaya Unelanvhi wasdv galvladiyu ehi tsunvsidasdi, nasgi gvnigesv tsinigegvneha nvnohi alisdelvdodi gesvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᎩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏒ ᏉᎳ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴ, ᎤᏪᎷᏅᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎯᎠ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏩᏍᏛ ᎦᎸᎳᏗᏳ ᎡᎯ ᏧᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏥᏂᎨᎬᏁᎭ ᏅᏃᎯ ᎠᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft The same followed Paul and us, and cried, saying, These men are the servants of the most high God, which shew unto us the way of salvation.

\ln Ale utsadv nusvlvgi nasgi nadvnehvgi; aseno Quola udeyatanelv ugatahvsvgi, hia nuweselvgi nasgi adanvdo; Gvnetsi Tsisa Galonedv deudov gvdiha, nasgi gohugotsediyi.  Nahiyuquono unugotsvgi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎤᏣᏛ ᏄᏒᎸᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏛᏁᎲᎩ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᏉᎳ ᎤᏕᏯᏔᏁᎸ ᎤᎦᏔᎲᏒᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ; ᎬᏁᏥ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏕᎤᏙᎥ ᎬᏗᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᎱᎪᏤᏗᏱ.  ᏀᎢᏳᏉᏃ ᎤᏄᎪᏨᎩ.
\ft And this did she many days. But Paul, being grieved, turned and said to the spirit, I command thee in the name of Jesus Christ to come out of her. And he came out the same hour.

\ln Gvwanatlaino unadolehosv udugi unvsv tsugvwalodi uniwadvdiyi uyotsvi, dininiyvhvgi Quola ale Sayila, ale nasgi ganododiyi widunatinohelvgi digeganelodi.
\syll ᎬᏩᎾᏝᎢᏃ ᎤᎾᏙᎴᎰᏒ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎤᏅᏒ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎤᏂᏩᏛᏗᏱ ᎤᏲᏨᎢ, ᏗᏂᏂᏴᎲᎩ ᏉᎳ ᎠᎴ ᏌᏱᎳ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏃᏙᏗᏱ ᏫᏚᎾᏘᏃᎮᎸᎩ ᏗᎨᎦᏁᎶᏗ.
\ft And when her masters saw that the hope of their gains was gone, they caught Paul and Silas, and drew them into the marketplace unto the rulers,

\ln Ale dinugodisgi widunatinohelvgi, hia nuniwesvgi; Hia anisgaya Aatsusi utsatanvhi anadeyadodiha igiduhvi,
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏗᏄᎪᏗᏍᎩ ᏫᏚᎾᏘᏃᎮᎸᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᎯᎠ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ ᎠᎠᏧᏏ ᎤᏣᏔᏅᎯ ᎠᎾᏕᏯᏙᏗᎭ ᎢᎩᏚᎲᎢ,
\ft And brought them to the magistrates, saying, These men, being Jews, do exceedingly trouble our city,

\ln Ale gvnigesv nanvneha dikahnawadvsdi nasgi yeli digeginiyvdi ale digegikahnawadvsdi nigesvna, Idilomi gesv iyusdi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎾᏅᏁᎭ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏰᎵ ᏗᎨᎩᏂᏴᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎨᎩᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎢᏗᎶᎻ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ.
\ft And teach customs, which are not lawful for us to receive, neither to observe, being Romans.

\ln Unitsatino gesv degvwanigatilvsvgi; dinugodisgino duninuwesv uninetsvgi digetsilivnisdiyi.
\syll ᎤᏂᏣᏘᏃ ᎨᏒ ᏕᎬᏩᏂᎦᏘᎸᏒᎩ; ᏗᏄᎪᏗᏍᎩᏃ ᏚᏂᏄᏪᏒ ᎤᏂᏁᏨᎩ ᏗᎨᏥᎵᎥᏂᏍᏗᏱ.
\ft And the multitude rose up together against them: and the magistrates rent off their clothes, and commanded to beat them.

\ln Utsatino nidunvnilv, didasdudiyi duniyvtanvgi, uninetselvgi nasgi atsigatidisdi osdv tsugatidisdiyi.
\syll ᎤᏣᏘᏃ ᏂᏚᏅᏂᎸ, ᏗᏓᏍᏚᏗᏱ ᏚᏂᏴᏔᏅᎩ, ᎤᏂᏁᏤᎸᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏥᎦᏘᏗᏍᏗ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏧᎦᏘᏗᏍᏗᏱ.
\ft And when they had laid many stripes upon them, they cast them into prison, charging the jailor to keep them safely:

\ln Nasgino natsiweselv atsinetselv, widuyvtanvgi didasdudiyi gotlvsv galitsode hawini, ale asdaya dunvsedonv adohi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎾᏥᏪᏎᎸ ᎠᏥᏁᏤᎸ, ᏫᏚᏴᏔᏅᎩ ᏗᏓᏍᏚᏗᏱ ᎪᏢᏒ ᎦᎵᏦᏕ ᎭᏫᏂ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏍᏓᏯ ᏚᏅᏎᏙᏅ ᎠᏙᎯ.
\ft Who, having received such a charge, thrust them into the inner prison, and made their feet fast in the stocks.

\ln svnoyino ayeli Quola ale Sayila unadadolistanei, ale Unelanvhi duninogistanei; digetsisduhino nasgi unadvganei.
\syll ᏒᏃᏱᏃ ᎠᏰᎵ ᏉᎳ ᎠᎴ ᏌᏱᎳ ᎤᎾᏓᏙᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏚᏂᏃᎩᏍᏔᏁᎢ; ᏗᎨᏥᏍᏚᎯᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏁᎢ.
\ft And at midnight Paul and Silas prayed, and sang praises unto God: and the prisoners heard them.

\ln Uyeloistaneno gadohi ulitelvnei; ale didasdutiyi dulisdayidisdv dulitelvnei, gilaquono iyvdv nigadv dasduhv dulisduisei, ale naniv dunadalvsdv dutlvsvhei.
\syll ᎤᏰᎶᎢᏍᏔᏁᏃ ᎦᏙᎯ ᎤᎵᏖᎸᏁᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᏗᏓᏍᏚᏘᏱ ᏚᎵᏍᏓᏱᏗᏍᏛ ᏚᎵᏖᎸᏁᎢ, ᎩᎳᏉᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏓᏍᏚᎲ ᏚᎵᏍᏚᎢᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏚᎾᏓᎸᏍᏛ ᏚᏢᏒᎮᎢ.
\ft And suddenly there was a great earthquake, so that the foundations of the prison were shaken: and immediately all the doors were opened, and every one's bands were loosed.

\ln Didasdudiyino agatiya, uyetsv ale udolehosv galohisdiyi didasdudiyi tsulisduidv gesvi, ulvhe ayelasdi ganvhidv, ale uwasv didalisei, digetsisduhi unalisv elisgei.
\syll ᏗᏓᏍᏚᏗᏱᏃ ᎠᎦᏘᏯ, ᎤᏰᏨ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏙᎴᎰᏒ ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏗᏓᏍᏚᏗᏱ ᏧᎵᏍᏚᎢᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᎸᎮ ᎠᏰᎳᏍᏗ ᎦᏅᎯᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏗᏓᎵᏎᎢ, ᏗᎨᏥᏍᏚᎯ ᎤᎾᎵᏒ ᎡᎵᏍᎨᎢ.
\ft And the keeper of the prison awaking out of his sleep, and seeing the prison doors open, he drew out his sword, and would have killed himself, supposing that the prisoners had been fled.

\ln Aseno Quola asdaya ulistanei, hia nuwesei; Tlesdi tsvsv gohusdi uyo itsadadvnelvgi, aniyeno nigadv otsiyaa.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᏉᎳ ᎠᏍᏓᏯ ᎤᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᏞᏍᏗ ᏨᏒ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏲ ᎢᏣᏓᏛᏁᎸᎩ, ᎠᏂᏰᏃ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎣᏥᏯᎠ.
\ft But Paul cried with a loud voice, saying, Do thyself no harm: for we are all here.

\ln Atsvsdodino utayolv ulisdi wuyvlei, ale wulutse uwenawisgei, udanvnile igvyitlv Quola ale Sayila dunolvi.
\syll ᎠᏨᏍᏙᏗᏃ ᎤᏔᏲᎸ ᎤᎵᏍᏗ ᏭᏴᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏭᎷᏤ ᎤᏪᎾᏫᏍᎨᎢ, ᎤᏓᏅᏂᎴ ᎢᎬᏱᏢ ᏉᎳ ᎠᎴ ᏌᏱᎳ ᏚᏃᎸᎢ.
\ft Then he called for a light, and sprang in, and came trembling, and fell down before Paul and Silas,

\ln Dunugowisvno hia nuwesei; Isdisgaya, gado dagadvneli vgisdelvdiyi?
\syll ᏚᏄᎪᏫᏒᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎢᏍᏗᏍᎦᏯ, ᎦᏙ ᏓᎦᏛᏁᎵ ᎥᎩᏍᏕᎸᏗᏱ?
\ft And brought them out, and said, Sirs, what must I do to be saved?

\ln Hiano nuniwesei; Hiyoiyuhvga Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv, dayetsasdelvhino, nihi ale detsadatinavi.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ; ᎯᏲᎢᏳᎲᎦ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ, ᏓᏰᏣᏍᏕᎸᎯᏃ, ᏂᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏕᏣᏓᏘᎾᎥᎢ.
\ft And they said, Believe on the Lord Jesus Christ, and thou shalt be saved, and thy house.

\ln Ugvwiyuhino utseli kanohedv uninohehele nasgi, ale nigadv nasgi ganelvi aniyai.
\syll ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᏃ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎤᏂᏃᎮᎮᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏁᎸᎢ ᎠᏂᏯᎢ.
\ft And they spake unto him the word of the Lord, and to all that were in his house.

\ln Nahiyuquono svnoyi duyanvhei, ale duwosulele degetsilivnilvi; ale gilaquo iyvdv agawoe uwasv ale nigadv tsutseliga.
\syll ᏀᎢᏳᏉᏃ ᏒᏃᏱ ᏚᏯᏅᎮᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏬᏑᎴᎴ ᏕᎨᏥᎵᎥᏂᎸᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎩᎳᏉ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎠᎦᏬᎡ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏧᏤᎵᎦ.
\ft And he took them the same hour of the night, and washed their stripes; and was baptized, he and all his, straightway.

\ln Ganelvno duyvtanilv duwelastanei, ale gohiyuhvsgv Unelanvhi ulihelitsei, ale nasquo nigadv ganelvi.
\syll ᎦᏁᎸᏃ ᏚᏴᏔᏂᎸ ᏚᏪᎳᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎪᎯᏳᎲᏍᎬ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎵᎮᎵᏤᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎦᏁᎸᎢ.
\ft And when he had brought them into his house, he set meat before them, and rejoiced, believing in God with all his house.

\ln Sunaleno nulistanv dinugodisgi duninvse dinadaniyisgi, hia winuniwesdiyi; Tikahvga na anisgaya.
\syll ᏑᎾᎴᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ ᏗᏄᎪᏗᏍᎩ ᏚᏂᏅᏎ ᏗᎾᏓᏂᏱᏍᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏫᏄᏂᏪᏍᏗᏱ; ᏘᎧᎲᎦ Ꮎ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ.
\ft And when it was day, the magistrates sent the serjeants, saying, Let those men go.

\ln Didasdudiyino agatiya nasgi nvtsuniwesv unonele Quola; Dinugodisgi dvnadanvli disdvyagodiyi; ka, sdinugoi ale nvwadohiwadv isdena.
\syll ᏗᏓᏍᏚᏗᏱᏃ ᎠᎦᏘᏯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏧᏂᏪᏒ ᎤᏃᏁᎴ ᏉᎳ; ᏗᏄᎪᏗᏍᎩ ᏛᎾᏓᏅᎵ ᏗᏍᏛᏯᎪᏗᏱ; Ꭷ, ᏍᏗᏄᎪᎢ ᎠᎴ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏩᏛ ᎢᏍᏕᎾ.
\ft And the keeper of the prison told this saying to Paul, The magistrates have sent to let you go: now therefore depart, and go in peace.

\ln Aseno quola hia niduweselei, gvnigesv degoginilivnilv tsudugotanvhi nigesvna oginisganvtsvi, Osdilomi, ale didasdudiyi degoginiyvtanv, tsigono hnaquo udelidv igogininugowisga?  Udohiyuhi vtla, unvsvsgini wanilugi wigogininugowa.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᏉᎳ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏕᎪᎩᏂᎵᎥᏂᎸ ᏧᏚᎪᏔᏅᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎣᎩᏂᏍᎦᏅᏨᎢ, ᎣᏍᏗᎶᎻ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏓᏍᏚᏗᏱ ᏕᎪᎩᏂᏴᏔᏅ, ᏥᎪᏃ ᎿᏉ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᎢᎪᎩᏂᏄᎪᏫᏍᎦ?  ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎥᏝ, ᎤᏅᏒᏍᎩᏂ ᏩᏂᎷᎩ ᏫᎪᎩᏂᏄᎪᏩ.
\ft But Paul said unto them, They have beaten us openly uncondemned, being Romans, and have cast us into prison; and now do they thrust us out privily? nay verily; but let them come themselves and fetch us out.

\ln Dinadaniyisgino nasgi hia nuniwesv duninonele dinugodisgi.  Unisgaleno unadvganv Anilomi gesvi.
\syll ᏗᎾᏓᏂᏱᏍᎩᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒ ᏚᏂᏃᏁᎴ ᏗᏄᎪᏗᏍᎩ.  ᎤᏂᏍᎦᎴᏃ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅ ᎠᏂᎶᎻ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft And the serjeants told these words unto the magistrates: and they feared, when they heard that they were Romans.

\ln Unilutseno ale dunisdiyetanei; duninugowisvno dunitayosele nahna gaduhv unadanvsdiyi.
\syll ᎤᏂᎷᏤᏃ ᎠᎴ ᏚᏂᏍᏗᏰᏔᏁᎢ; ᏚᏂᏄᎪᏫᏒᏃ ᏚᏂᏔᏲᏎᎴ ᏀᎾ ᎦᏚᎲ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏍᏗᏱ.
\ft And they came and besought them, and brought them out, and desired them to depart out of the city.

\ln Uninugotsvno didasdudiyi Lidi ganelv wuniyvlvgi; dunigohvno anadanvtli, dunigalisdadvgi, ale unanigisvgi.
\syll ᎤᏂᏄᎪᏨᏃ ᏗᏓᏍᏚᏗᏱ ᎵᏗ ᎦᏁᎸ ᏭᏂᏴᎸᎩ; ᏚᏂᎪᎲᏃ ᎠᎾᏓᏅᏟ, ᏚᏂᎦᎵᏍᏓᏛᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏂᎩᏒᎩ.
\ft And they went out of the prison, and entered into the house of Lydia and when they had seen the brethren, they comforted them, and departed.

\ln Vquigoliyino ale Aqualoniya unedonv, Desiloniga wunilutsvgi, nahna Anitsusi danilawiisdiyi adanelvgi.
\syll ᎥᏈᎪᎵᏱᏃ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏆᎶᏂᏯ ᎤᏁᏙᏅ, ᏕᏏᎶᏂᎦ ᏭᏂᎷᏨᎩ, ᏀᎾ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᏓᏂᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᏓᏁᎸᎩ.
\ft Now when they had passed through Amphipolis and Apollonia, they came to Thessalonica, where was a synagogue of the Jews:

\ln Quolano, nasgi iyudvnedi gesv nudvnelvgi, duyvselvgi, ale tsoi nunadodaquasgv goweli gvdisgv degawonedisgvgi,
\syll ᏉᎳᏃ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏛᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏄᏛᏁᎸᎩ, ᏚᏴᏎᎸᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏦᎢ ᏄᎾᏙᏓᏆᏍᎬ ᎪᏪᎵ ᎬᏗᏍᎬ ᏕᎦᏬᏁᏗᏍᎬᎩ,
\ft And Paul, as his manner was, went in unto them, and three sabbath days reasoned with them out of the scriptures,

\ln degosisisgvgi ale gvnigesv nigvnehvgi Galonedv ase ugiliyoisdi gesvi, ale uyohusv tsulihisodi gesvi; ale hia nasgi Tsisa ayv tsitsvyalitsidoneha nasgi Galonedv, adisgvgi.
\syll ᏕᎪᏏᏏᏍᎬᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᎬᏁᎲᎩ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎠᏎ ᎤᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏲᎱᏒ ᏧᎵᎯᏐᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏌ ᎠᏴ ᏥᏨᏯᎵᏥᏙᏁᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ, ᎠᏗᏍᎬᎩ.
\ft Opening and alleging, that Christ must needs have suffered, and risen again from the dead; and that this Jesus, whom I preach unto you, is Christ.

\ln Igadvno unadasuyv unohiyunvgi, ale dunaligonelvgi Quola ale Sayila, ale unitsatanvhi Anigoi Unelanvhi anadadolisdanehi, ale anigayoliquo nigesvna nunigvwiyusv anigeyv.
\syll ᎢᎦᏛᏃ ᎤᎾᏓᏑᏴ ᎤᏃᎯᏳᏅᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᎾᎵᎪᏁᎸᎩ ᏉᎳ ᎠᎴ ᏌᏱᎳ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏣᏔᏅᎯ ᎠᏂᎪᎢ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎾᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᎦᏲᎵᏉ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏂᎨᏴ.
\ft And some of them believed, and consorted with Paul and Silas; and of the devout Greeks a great multitude, and of the chief women not a few.

\ln Aseno Anitsusi nunohiyusvna, anvyugv nvdayulisdotanvgi, widuniyanvhvgi gilo iyunasdi uninegutsidv unedohi, dunitlisanvno unitelvnvgi gaduhvi; dunigatilenvno Tsesani ganelvi, yvwi tsuninugowisediyi unanelotanvgi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᏄᏃᎯᏳᏒᎾ, ᎠᏅᏳᎬ ᏅᏓᏳᎵᏍᏙᏔᏅᎩ, ᏫᏚᏂᏯᏅᎲᎩ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗ ᎤᏂᏁᎫᏥᏛ ᎤᏁᏙᎯ, ᏚᏂᏟᏌᏅᏃ ᎤᏂᏖᎸᏅᎩ ᎦᏚᎲᎢ; ᏚᏂᎦᏘᎴᏅᏃ ᏤᏌᏂ ᎦᏁᎸᎢ, ᏴᏫ ᏧᏂᏄᎪᏫᏎᏗᏱ ᎤᎾᏁᎶᏔᏅᎩ.
\ft But the Jews which believed not, moved with envy, took unto them certain lewd fellows of the baser sort, and gathered a company, and set all the city on an uproar, and assaulted the house of Jason, and sought to bring them out to the people.

\ln Widunatlotsvno widuninasanesvgi Tsesani ale gilo iyunasdi anadanvtli, gaduhv getsigatidisdi widunatinohelvgi, unelugvgi hia naniwesgvgi; hia elohi tsuniluquadinvdv, nasquo ani iunilutsv;
\syll ᏫᏚᎾᏠᏨᏃ ᏫᏚᏂᎾᏌᏁᏒᎩ ᏤᏌᏂ ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗ ᎠᎾᏓᏅᏟ, ᎦᏚᎲ ᎨᏥᎦᏘᏗᏍᏗ ᏫᏚᎾᏘᏃᎮᎸᎩ, ᎤᏁᎷᎬᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏂᏪᏍᎬᎩ; ᎯᎠ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏧᏂᎷᏆᏗᏅᏛ, ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏂ ᎢᎤᏂᎷᏨ;
\ft And when they found them not, they drew Jason and certain brethren unto the rulers of the city, crying, These that have turned the world upside down are come hither also;

\ln Nasgi Tsesani dudanilvtsv; ale nasgi nigadv dunilvwisdanehv anatludiha Sisa unetsvi, hia naniweha; Nvwadale ugvwiyuhi eha, nasgi Tsisa.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏤᏌᏂ ᏚᏓᏂᎸᏨ; ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏚᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᎠᎾᏡᏗᎭ ᏏᏌ ᎤᏁᏨᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏂᏪᎭ; ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎡᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏌ.
\ft Whom Jason hath received: and these all do contrary to the decrees of Caesar, saying that there is another king, one Jesus.

\ln Dunadeyadotanvgino yvwi ale gaduhv getsigatidisdi, nasgi hia unadvganv.
\syll ᏚᎾᏕᏯᏙᏔᏅᎩᏃ ᏴᏫ ᎠᎴ ᎦᏚᎲ ᎨᏥᎦᏘᏗᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅ.
\ft And they troubled the people and the rulers of the city, when they heard these things.

\ln Tsesanino ale anisoi tali gvwanadvdanehi duniwadvhv dogetsikanvgi.
\syll ᏤᏌᏂᏃ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏐᎢ ᏔᎵ ᎬᏩᎾᏛᏓᏁᎯ ᏚᏂᏩᏛᎲ ᏙᎨᏥᎧᏅᎩ.
\ft And when they had taken security of Jason, and of the other, they let them go.

\ln Analinvtlino gilaquo iyvdv dunatinawidvhvgi Quola ale Sayila, Quiliya svnoyi widunatinvstanvgi.  Nasgino nahna wunilutsv, Anitsusi tsunilawiisdiyi wuniyvlvgi.
\syll ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏟᏃ ᎩᎳᏉ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏚᎾᏘᎾᏫᏛᎲᎩ ᏉᎳ ᎠᎴ ᏌᏱᎳ, ᏈᎵᏯ ᏒᏃᏱ ᏫᏚᎾᏘᏅᏍᏔᏅᎩ.  ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏀᎾ ᏭᏂᎷᏨ, ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᏧᏂᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᏭᏂᏴᎸᎩ.
\ft And the brethren immediately sent away Paul and Silas by night unto Berea: who coming thither went into the synagogue of the Jews.

\ln Nasgi hia utli anosiyu gesvgi esgaquo Desiloniga anehi, dunadanilvtsvgiyeno kanohedv ale nidugitsvnisv danigoliyesgvgi goweli, nasgi nusdv ale nasgi nusdvna gesv unadolehohisdiyi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎤᏟ ᎠᏃᏏᏳ ᎨᏒᎩ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᏕᏏᎶᏂᎦ ᎠᏁᎯ, ᏚᎾᏓᏂᎸᏨᎩᏰᏃ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎠᎴ ᏂᏚᎩᏨᏂᏒ ᏓᏂᎪᎵᏰᏍᎬᎩ ᎪᏪᎵ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏛᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎾᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏗᏱ.
\ft These were more noble than those in Thessalonica, in that they received the word with all readiness of mind, and searched the scriptures daily, whether those things were so.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi unitsadvgi nasgi unohiyunvgi, ale getsilvquodi Anigoi anigeyv, ale anisgaya anigayoliquo nigesvna.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᏂᏣᏛᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏃᎯᏳᏅᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎨᏥᎸᏉᏗ ᎠᏂᎪᎢ ᎠᏂᎨᏴ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ ᎠᏂᎦᏲᎵᏉ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.
\ft Therefore many of them believed; also of honourable women which were Greeks, and of men, not a few.

\ln Aseno Anitsusi Desiloniga anehi, unadvganv Quola nasquo Quiliya alitsidohvsgv Unelanvhi utseliga kanohedv, nahna nasquo wunilutsvgi, yvwi dunitelvnvgi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᏕᏏᎶᏂᎦ ᎠᏁᎯ, ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅ ᏉᎳ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏈᎵᏯ ᎠᎵᏥᏙᎲᏍᎬ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ, ᏀᎾ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏭᏂᎷᏨᎩ, ᏴᏫ ᏚᏂᏖᎸᏅᎩ.
\ft But when the Jews of Thessalonica had knowledge that the word of God was preached of Paul at Berea, they came thither also, and stirred up the people.

\ln Hnaquono gilaquo iyvdv anadanvtli gvwatihnawidvhvgi Quola, amequohi iditlv wigvwatinvstanvgi.  Sayilasgini ale Dimadi nahnaquo unadigiyvgi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎩᎳᏉ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎠᎾᏓᏅᏟ ᎬᏩᏘᎿᏫᏛᎲᎩ ᏉᎳ, ᎠᎺᏉᎯ ᎢᏗᏢ ᏫᎬᏩᏘᏅᏍᏔᏅᎩ.  ᏌᏱᎳᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎹᏗ ᏀᎾᏉ ᎤᎾᏗᎩᏴᎩ.
\ft And then immediately the brethren sent away Paul to go as it were to the sea: but Silas and Timotheus abode there still.

\ln Quolano gvwatihnawidvdv Ediniyi wigvwatinolvgi; ale nasgi getsinetselv Sayila Dimadino unadvgodi, nulisdvquo gvwalutsediyi, unanigisvgi.
\syll ᏉᎳᏃ ᎬᏩᏘᎿᏫᏛᏛ ᎡᏗᏂᏱ ᏫᎬᏩᏘᏃᎸᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᏥᏁᏤᎸ ᏌᏱᎳ ᏗᎹᏗᏃ ᎤᎾᏛᎪᏗ, ᏄᎵᏍᏛᏉ ᎬᏩᎷᏤᏗᏱ, ᎤᎾᏂᎩᏒᎩ.
\ft And they that conducted Paul brought him unto Athens: and receiving a commandment unto Silas and Timotheus for to come to him with all speed, they departed.

\ln Asiquono Quola nasgi dagatiyvgi Ediniyi, tsudanvdv utsati udeyatanelvgi, udolehosv gaduhv Unelanvhi diyelvhi didadolisdanehi gesvi.
\syll ᎠᏏᏉᏃ ᏉᎳ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏓᎦᏘᏴᎩ ᎡᏗᏂᏱ, ᏧᏓᏅᏛ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᏕᏯᏔᏁᎸᎩ, ᎤᏙᎴᎰᏒ ᎦᏚᎲ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏗᏰᎸᎯ ᏗᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Now while Paul waited for them at Athens, his spirit was stirred in him, when he saw the city wholly given to idolatry.

\ln Nasgino iyusdi degawonedisgvgi digalawiisdiyi Anitsusi ale Unelanvhi anadadolisdanehi, ale nidugitsvnisv ganodidiyi degawonedisgvgi nahna tsuwadvtanvhi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏕᎦᏬᏁᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎾᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᏚᎩᏨᏂᏒ ᎦᏃᏗᏗᏱ ᏕᎦᏬᏁᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᏀᎾ ᏧᏩᏛᏔᏅᎯ.
\ft Therefore disputed he in the synagogue with the Jews, and with the devout persons, and in the market daily with them that met with him.

\ln Gilono iyunasdi anigatahnai Aniquigula ale Anisdoiga gvwalinohetanvgi; igadvno hia nuniwesvgi; Gado uduli udvdiyi hia nuyelvdvna gawonisgi; anisoino hia; Nvwanadale yvwi tsunatseli galvladi anehi digananugowisgi nvwasdi; nvdagalisdodisgvgi dalitsidonehvi Tsisa ale dilehisodi gesv ugvwali.
\syll ᎩᎶᏃ ᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎿᎢ ᎠᏂᏈᎫᎳ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏍᏙᎢᎦ ᎬᏩᎵᏃᎮᏔᏅᎩ; ᎢᎦᏛᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᎦᏙ ᎤᏚᎵ ᎤᏛᏗᏱ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏰᎸᏛᎾ ᎦᏬᏂᏍᎩ; ᎠᏂᏐᎢᏃ ᎯᎠ; ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴ ᏴᏫ ᏧᎾᏤᎵ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎠᏁᎯ ᏗᎦᎾᏄᎪᏫᏍᎩ ᏅᏩᏍᏗ; ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᏓᎵᏥᏙᏁᎲᎢ ᏥᏌ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎴᎯᏐᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ.
\ft Then certain philosophers of the Epicureans, and of the Stoicks, encountered him. And some said, What will this babbler say? other some, He seemeth to be a setter forth of strange gods: because he preached unto them Jesus, and the resurrection.

\ln Wigvwayanvhvno Elioquiga gvwatinolvgi, hia nuniwesvgi; Tsigo gayogadvgodiquo nusdv nasgi hia itse dideyodi gesv nasgi tsinoheha?
\syll ᏫᎬᏩᏯᏅᎲᏃ ᎡᎵᎣᏈᎦ ᎬᏩᏘᏃᎸᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᏥᎪ ᎦᏲᎦᏛᎪᏗᏉ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎢᏤ ᏗᏕᏲᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏃᎮᎭ?
\ft And they took him, and brought him unto Areopagus, saying, May we know what this new doctrine, whereof thou speakest, is?

\ln Gohusdiyeno usquanigodi dehinanugowiseha tsotsileni; nasgi iyusdi ogaduliha ogadolehohisdiyi nasgi nusdv gadvgvi.
\syll ᎪᎱᏍᏗᏰᏃ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᏕᎯᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᎭ ᏦᏥᎴᏂ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎣᎦᏚᎵᎭ ᎣᎦᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎦᏛᎬᎢ.
\ft For thou bringest certain strange things to our ears: we would know therefore what these things mean.

\ln Nigadvyeno Ediniyi anehi ale ilvhitlv dinehi nahna anedohi vtla gohusdi yidunilvwisdanehei, aninohesgv uwasv ale anadvgisgv gohusdi itsei.
\syll ᏂᎦᏛᏰᏃ ᎡᏗᏂᏱ ᎠᏁᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎢᎸᎯᏢ ᏗᏁᎯ ᏀᎾ ᎠᏁᏙᎯ ᎥᏝ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏱᏚᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎮᎢ, ᎠᏂᏃᎮᏍᎬ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎾᏛᎩᏍᎬ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎢᏤᎢ.
\ft (For all the Athenians and strangers which were there spent their time in nothing else, but either to tell, or to hear some new thing.)

\ln Hnaquono Quola deulenv ayeli Elioquiga, hia nuwesvgi; Itsisgaya Ediniyi itsehi, gadoleosga itsikalitsvhi gesv detsinayesgv galvladi anehi.

\syll ᎨᎵᏲᏃ ᏂᎯᏳ ᎡᎧᏯ ᎠᏥᎦᏘᏗᏍᏛᎢ, ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᏌᏉ ᎢᎦᎦᏛ ᎬᏩᏁᎷᎩᎡᎸᎩ ᏉᎳ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᏘᏃᎸ ᏗᎫᎪᏙᏗᏱ ᎦᏍᎩᎸᎢ,
\ft And when Gallio was the deputy of Achaia, the Jews made insurrection with one accord against Paul, and brought him to the judgment seat,

\ln Hia nuniwesvgi; hia nasgi dasdiyediha yvwi Unelanvhi anadadolisdanehv dikahnawadvsdi uniyosdodiyi.
\syll ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏓᏍᏗᏰᏗᎭ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎾᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎤᏂᏲᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
\ft Saying, This fellow persuadeth men to worship God contrary to the law.

\ln Hnaquono Quola dvsduisisvgi aholi, Geliyo hia niduweselvgi Anitsusi; Iyuno uyo iyudvnelvhi yigi, ale usganvtsvhi yigi, Itsitsusi, duyugodv yigi itsvyadvdasdanediyi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏉᎳ ᏛᏍᏚᎢᏏᏒᎩ ᎠᎰᎵ, ᎨᎵᏲ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᎤᏲ ᎢᏳᏛᏁᎸᎯ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏍᎦᏅᏨᎯ ᏱᎩ, ᎢᏥᏧᏏ, ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᏱᎩ ᎢᏨᏯᏛᏓᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ.
\ft And when Paul was now about to open his mouth, Gallio said unto the Jews, If it were a matter of wrong or wicked lewdness, O ye Jews, reason would that I should bear with you:

\ln Iyusgini kanetsvhi ale gohusdi dudov ale dikahnawadvsdi itsatseliga kanohedi yigi, itsvsv ditsilvwisdasi, vtlayeno nasgi iyusdi ayv yidogagugoda.
\syll ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎧᏁᏨᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏚᏙᎥ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎢᏣᏤᎵᎦ ᎧᏃᎮᏗ ᏱᎩ, ᎢᏨᏒ ᏗᏥᎸᏫᏍᏓᏏ, ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏴ ᏱᏙᎦᎫᎪᏓ.
\ft But if it be a question of words and names, and of your law, look ye to it; for I will be no judge of such matters.

\ln Dugehidolvgino digugododiyi gasgilvi.
\syll ᏚᎨᎯᏙᎸᎩᏃ ᏗᎫᎪᏙᏗᏱ ᎦᏍᎩᎸᎢ.
\ft And he drave them from the judgment seat.

\ln Hnaquono nigadv Anigoi uniniyvhv Sosdini Anitsusi tsunilawiisdiyi nugvwiyusv atsigatidisdi, unilivnilvgi igvyitlv digugododiyi gasgilvi.  Geliyono vtla yugasayastane nasgi nusdidegvi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎠᏂᎪᎢ ᎤᏂᏂᏴᎲ ᏐᏍᏗᏂ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᏧᏂᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎦᏘᏗᏍᏗ, ᎤᏂᎵᎥᏂᎸᎩ ᎢᎬᏱᏢ ᏗᎫᎪᏙᏗᏱ ᎦᏍᎩᎸᎢ.  ᎨᎵᏲᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏳᎦᏌᏯᏍᏔᏁ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏗᏕᎬᎢ.
\ft Then all the Greeks took Sosthenes, the chief ruler of the synagogue, and beat him before the judgment seat. And Gallio cared for none of those things.

\ln Quolano asi uwohitsvgi uwedolvgi; hnaquono duyolilv anadanvtli, tsiyuhi wutsanvgi Siliyi wulosvgi; ale nasquo Quisila ale Equila gvwasdawadvsvgi, ulisdoyehvhi gesvgi Svtliya iyvdv, Unelanvhiyeno uduisdanelvhi gesvgi.
\syll ᏉᎳᏃ ᎠᏏ ᎤᏬᎯᏨᎩ ᎤᏪᏙᎸᎩ; ᎿᏉᏃ ᏚᏲᎵᎸ ᎠᎾᏓᏅᏟ, ᏥᏳᎯ ᏭᏣᏅᎩ ᏏᎵᏱ ᏭᎶᏒᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏈᏏᎳ ᎠᎴ ᎡᏈᎳ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏛᏒᎩ, ᎤᎵᏍᏙᏰᎲᎯ ᎨᏒᎩ ᏒᏟᏯ ᎢᏴᏛ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ ᎤᏚᎢᏍᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᎨᏒᎩ.
\ft And Paul after this tarried there yet a good while, and then took his leave of the brethren, and sailed thence into Syria, and with him Priscilla and Aquila; having shorn his head in Cenchrea: for he had a vow.

\ln Equisano wulutsvgi ale nahna duwadehvgi, uwasvsgini digalawiisdiyi wuyvlvgi ale duwonetanvgi Anitsusi.
\syll ᎡᏈᏌᏃ ᏭᎷᏨᎩ ᎠᎴ ᏀᎾ ᏚᏩᏕᎲᎩ, ᎤᏩᏒᏍᎩᏂ ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᏭᏴᎸᎩ ᎠᎴ ᏚᏬᏁᏔᏅᎩ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ.
\ft And he came to Ephesus, and left them there: but he himself entered into the synagogue, and reasoned with the Jews.

\ln Gvwatayoselvno uwohiisdiyi tsuweladidasdiyi vtla yuwohiyunei;
\syll ᎬᏩᏔᏲᏎᎸᏃ ᎤᏬᎯᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᏧᏪᎳᏗᏓᏍᏗᏱ ᎥᏝ ᏳᏬᎯᏳᏁᎢ;
\ft When they desired him to tarry longer time with them, he consented not;

\ln Duyolilvquosgini hia nuwesvgi; Ase agisquanigododi Tsilusilimi hia dilisdayvdiyi tsvdvsqualvhi.  Aseno taline dvtsvwadvhili, iyuno Unelanvhi usiyu yuyelvnv.  Equisano tsiyuhi wutsanvgi.
\syll ᏚᏲᎵᎸᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎠᏎ ᎠᎩᏍᏆᏂᎪᏙᏗ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᎯᎠ ᏗᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ ᏨᏛᏍᏆᎸᎯ.  ᎠᏎᏃ ᏔᎵᏁ ᏛᏨᏩᏛᎯᎵ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏏᏳ ᏳᏰᎸᏅ.  ᎡᏈᏌᏃ ᏥᏳᎯ ᏭᏣᏅᎩ.
\ft But bade them farewell, saying, I must by all means keep this feast that cometh in Jerusalem: but I will return again unto you, if God will. And he sailed from Ephesus.

\ln Sisaliyino udugisv, ale tsunanelodi unadatlugv widuyolilv, Vtiogi wulosvgi.
\syll ᏏᏌᎵᏱᏃ ᎤᏚᎩᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬ ᏫᏚᏲᎵᎸ, ᎥᏘᎣᎩ ᏭᎶᏒᎩ.
\ft And when he had landed at Caesarea, and gone up, and saluted the church, he went down to Antioch.

\ln Yelino uwohitsv uwedolv, unigisvgi, ale Gelesiyi ale Quitsiyi osdv uyilvsvgi uwesolvgi, dalinigohisdisgvgi nigadv anohiyuhvsgi
\syll ᏰᎵᏃ ᎤᏬᎯᏨ ᎤᏪᏙᎸ, ᎤᏂᎩᏒᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎨᎴᏏᏱ ᎠᎴ ᏈᏥᏱ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎤᏱᎸᏒᎩ ᎤᏪᏐᎸᎩ, ᏓᎵᏂᎪᎯᏍᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ
\ft And after he had spent some time there, he departed, and went over all the country of Galatia and Phrygia in order, strengthening all the disciples.

\ln Gilono iyusdi Atsusi Aquola tsudoidv, Eligiyi udvsvhi, asinasdv uwonihisdiyi, ale digalvquodi goweli disinasdv, Equisa ulutsvgi.
\syll ᎩᎶᏃ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏧᏏ ᎠᏉᎳ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ, ᎡᎵᎩᏱ ᎤᏛᏒᎯ, ᎠᏏᎾᏍᏛ ᎤᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎦᎸᏉᏗ ᎪᏪᎵ ᏗᏏᎾᏍᏛ, ᎡᏈᏌ ᎤᎷᏨᎩ.
\ft And a certain Jew named Apollos, born at Alexandria, an eloquent man, and mighty in the scriptures, came to Ephesus.

\ln Nasgi hia ageyonvhi gesvgi Ugvwiyuhi unvnvi, ale ulinigidv gesv udanvdvi, kanohesgvgi ale dadeyohvsgvgi nasuligogvna Ugvwiyuhi utseli ugvwali gesvi, Tsani utseli didawosdi uwasv agatahvgi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎠᎨᏲᏅᎯ ᎨᏒᎩ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏅᏅᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏓᏅᏛᎢ, ᎧᏃᎮᏍᎬᎩ ᎠᎴ ᏓᏕᏲᎲᏍᎬᎩ ᎾᏑᎵᎪᎬᎾ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏣᏂ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏗᏓᏬᏍᏗ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎠᎦᏔᎲᎩ.
\ft This man was instructed in the way of the Lord; and being fervent in the spirit, he spake and taught diligently the things of the Lord, knowing only the baptism of John.

\ln Nasgi ulenvhvgi nasgaihvna uwonisvgi digalawiisdiyi.  Nasgino Equila ale Quisila unadvganelv uniyanvhvgi, ale utli iyosdv dunosisanelvgi Unelanvhi utseli ganvnvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎴᏅᎲᎩ ᎾᏍᎦᎢᎲᎾ ᎤᏬᏂᏒᎩ ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ.  ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎡᏈᎳ ᎠᎴ ᏈᏏᎳ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏁᎸ ᎤᏂᏯᏅᎲᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏟ ᎢᏲᏍᏛ ᏚᏃᏏᏌᏁᎸᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎦᏅᏅᎢ.
\ft And he began to speak boldly in the synagogue: whom when Aquila and Priscilla had heard, they took him unto them, and expounded unto him the way of God more perfectly.

\ln Udulvhvno Ekaya uwenvsdiyi, anadanvtli unowelanvgi dinitayoselvgi anohiyuhvsgi digvwadanilvisdiyi; nasgino wulutsv, utsati dusdelvhvgi Unelanvhi udadolitsadv iyuwanisadv unohiyunvhi.
\syll ᎤᏚᎸᎲᏃ ᎡᎧᏯ ᎤᏪᏅᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎾᏓᏅᏟ ᎤᏃᏪᎳᏅᎩ ᏗᏂᏔᏲᏎᎸᎩ ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᏗᎬᏩᏓᏂᎸᎢᏍᏗᏱ; ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏭᎷᏨ, ᎤᏣᏘ ᏚᏍᏕᎸᎲᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏣᏛ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ ᎤᏃᎯᏳᏅᎯ.
\ft And when he was disposed to pass into Achaia, the brethren wrote, exhorting the disciples to receive him: who, when he was come, helped them much which had believed through grace:

\ln Ulinigidvyayeno gawonisgv gvdisgv unohiyudiyi nuwanelvgi Anitsusi degalawivi, digalvquodi goweli degvdisgvi gvnigesv nigvnehv Tsisa nasgi Galonedv gesvi.
\syll ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛᏯᏰᏃ ᎦᏬᏂᏍᎬ ᎬᏗᏍᎬ ᎤᏃᎯᏳᏗᏱ ᏄᏩᏁᎸᎩ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᏕᎦᎳᏫᎥᎢ, ᏗᎦᎸᏉᏗ ᎪᏪᎵ ᏕᎬᏗᏍᎬᎢ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᎬᏁᎲ ᏥᏌ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft For he mightily convinced the Jews, and that publickly, shewing by the scriptures that Jesus was Christ.

\ln Hiano nulistanvgi, nahiyu Aquola golinidiyi edohvgi, Quola ayeli gesv ulosv, Equisa wulutsvgi.  Duwadvhvno gilo iyunasdi anohiyuhvsgi,
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎩ, ᏀᎢᏳ ᎠᏉᎳ ᎪᎵᏂᏗᏱ ᎡᏙᎲᎩ, ᏉᎳ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎶᏒ, ᎡᏈᏌ ᏭᎷᏨᎩ.  ᏚᏩᏛᎲᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗ ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ,
\ft And it came to pass, that, while Apollos was at Corinth, Paul having passed through the upper coasts came to Ephesus: and finding certain disciples,

\ln Hia niduweselvgi; Etsinelvsgo galvquodiyu adanvdo getsohiyunvhi?  Hiano nvgvwaweselvgi; vtla ogadvganvhiunv yigi Galvquodiyu Adanvdo ehvi.
\syll ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎡᏥᏁᎸᏍᎪ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎨᏦᎯᏳᏅᎯ?  ᎯᎠᏃ ᏅᎬᏩᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎥᏝ ᎣᎦᏛᎦᏅᎯᎤᏅ ᏱᎩ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎡᎲᎢ.
\ft He said unto them, Have ye received the Holy Ghost since ye believed? And they said unto him, We have not so much as heard whether there be any Holy Ghost.

\ln Hiano niduweselvgi; Gado usdi didawosdodi gesv detsawostanei?  Tsani tsudawosdodi gesv, unadvnvgi.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎦᏙ ᎤᏍᏗ ᏗᏓᏬᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏕᏣᏬᏍᏔᏁᎢ?  ᏣᏂ ᏧᏓᏬᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ, ᎤᎾᏛᏅᎩ.
\ft And he said unto them, Unto what then were ye baptized? And they said, Unto John's baptism.

\ln Quolano hia nuwesvgi; Tsani udohiyuhi dadawosdisgvgi didawosdodi ganetliyvsdi gesv odanvdv ugvwali, dekanetsehv yvwi, unohiyudiyi oni nvdayegi, nasgi Galonedv Tsisa degosehvgi.
\syll ᏉᎳᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᏣᏂ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᏓᏓᏬᏍᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᏗᏓᏬᏍᏙᏗ ᎦᏁᏟᏴᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎣᏓᏅᏛ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ, ᏕᎧᏁᏤᎲ ᏴᏫ, ᎤᏃᎯᏳᏗᏱ ᎣᏂ ᏅᏓᏰᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏥᏌ ᏕᎪᏎᎲᎩ.
\ft Then said Paul, John verily baptized with the baptism of repentance, saying unto the people, that they should believe on him which should come after him, that is, on Christ Jesus.

\ln Nasgino unadvganv Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa dudov degegawostanvgi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᏚᏙᎥ ᏕᎨᎦᏬᏍᏔᏅᎩ.
\ft When they heard this, they were baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.

\ln Hnaquono Quola dusitadv, Galvquodiyu Adanvdo unilutselvgi, duniwonisvgino tsudalenvdv digawonihisdi gesvi, ale unadolehosvgi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏉᎳ ᏚᏏᏔᏛ, ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᏂᎷᏤᎸᎩ, ᏚᏂᏬᏂᏒᎩᏃ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏗᎦᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏙᎴᎰᏒᎩ.
\ft And when Paul had laid his hands upon them, the Holy Ghost came on them; and they spake with tongues, and prophesied.

\ln Nasgino anisgaya nigadv taladu iyvdv nanivgi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏔᎳᏚ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎾᏂᎥᎩ.
\ft And all the men were about twelve.

\ln Digalawiisdiyino wuyvlv nasgaihvna gawonisgvgi, tsoi iyanvdo igahidv degawonedisgvgi ale dasdiyedisgvgi unohiyudiyi Unelanvhi utseligohi ugvwali.
\syll ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱᏃ ᏭᏴᎸ ᎾᏍᎦᎢᎲᎾ ᎦᏬᏂᏍᎬᎩ, ᏦᎢ ᎢᏯᏅᏙ ᎢᎦᎯᏛ ᏕᎦᏬᏁᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᎠᎴ ᏓᏍᏗᏰᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᎤᏃᎯᏳᏗᏱ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎪᎯ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ.
\ft And he went into the synagogue, and spake boldly for the space of three months, disputing and persuading the things concerning the kingdom of God.

\ln Gilono iyunasdi unisdayosv ale nunohiyunvna nulistanv, ale osonvquo uninohelv nasgi ganvnv ugvwali unitsati anigatahvi, dudanvelvgi, ale dudadaletanvgi anohiyuhvsgi degawonedisgvgi nidugitsvnisv gilo iyusdi Dalana tsudoidv tsudeyodiyi.
\syll ᎩᎶᏃ ᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗ ᎤᏂᏍᏓᏲᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏄᏃᎯᏳᏅᎾ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ, ᎠᎴ ᎣᏐᏅᏉ ᎤᏂᏃᎮᎸ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏅᏅ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎲᎢ, ᏚᏓᏅᎡᎸᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏓᏓᎴᏔᏅᎩ ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᏕᎦᏬᏁᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᏂᏚᎩᏨᏂᏒ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏓᎳᎾ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ ᏧᏕᏲᏗᏱ.
\ft But when divers were hardened, and believed not, but spake evil of that way before the multitude, he departed from them, and separated the disciples, disputing daily in the school of one Tyrannus.

\ln Nasgino hia nudvnelvgi tali tsudetiyvdv igohidv, nasgi nvdayulisdotanvgi nigadv Esiyi anehi Anitsusi ale Anigoi unadvganvgi kanohedv Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa utseliga.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏛᏁᎸᎩ ᏔᎵ ᏧᏕᏘᏴᏛ ᎢᎪᎯᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏓᏳᎵᏍᏙᏔᏅᎩ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎡᏏᏱ ᎠᏁᎯ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᎪᎢ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅᎩ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ.
\ft And this continued by the space of two years; so that all they which dwelt in Asia heard the word of the Lord Jesus, both Jews and Greeks.

\ln Ale Unelanvhi yano iyulisdodi nigesvna usquanigodi dulvwisdanehvgi Quola agvdisgvgi;
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏯᏃ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎩ ᏉᎳ ᎠᎬᏗᏍᎬᎩ;
\ft And God wrought special miracles by the hands of Paul:

\ln Ayelvyeno tsudalenvhi diyatlo ale ditlesado daninohehvgi tsunitlvgi, vyugino alidvdisgvgi, uniyono didanvdo gvwaninugogvgi.
\syll ᎠᏰᎸᏰᏃ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᏗᏯᏠ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏞᏌᏙ ᏓᏂᏃᎮᎲᎩ ᏧᏂᏢᎩ, ᎥᏳᎩᏃ ᎠᎵᏛᏗᏍᎬᎩ, ᎤᏂᏲᏃ ᏗᏓᏅᏙ ᎬᏩᏂᏄᎪᎬᎩ.
\ft So that from his body were brought unto the sick handkerchiefs or aprons, and the diseases departed from them, and the evil spirits went out of them.

\ln Gilono iyunasdi Anitsusi nvnedohi, anisgina dininugowisgi, unadanvtele Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa deudov tsunineisdanediyi uniyo didanvdo tsuniyai, hia nuniwesei; Itsvneisdasi Tsisa, nasgi Quola alitsidohvsgv tsiganoheha.
\syll ᎩᎶᏃ ᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᏅᏁᏙᎯ, ᎠᏂᏍᎩᎾ ᏗᏂᏄᎪᏫᏍᎩ, ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏖᎴ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᏕᎤᏙᎥ ᏧᏂᏁᎢᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᎤᏂᏲ ᏗᏓᏅᏙ ᏧᏂᏯᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ; ᎢᏨᏁᎢᏍᏓᏏ ᏥᏌ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏉᎳ ᎠᎵᏥᏙᎲᏍᎬ ᏥᎦᏃᎮᎭ.
\ft Then certain of the vagabond Jews, exorcists, took upon them to call over them which had evil spirits the name of the Lord Jesus, saying, We adjure you by Jesus whom Paul preacheth.

\ln Aneheno galiquogi iyanidv Siwi tsudoidv tsuwetsi Atsusi nugvwiyue atsilvgelohi nasgi nanadvnehei.
\syll ᎠᏁᎮᏃ ᎦᎵᏉᎩ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᏏᏫ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ ᏧᏪᏥ ᎠᏧᏏ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᎡ ᎠᏥᎸᎨᎶᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᎾᏛᏁᎮᎢ.
\ft And there were seven sons of one Sceva, a Jew, and chief of the priests, which did so.

\ln Uyono adanvdo unetsv hia nuwesei; Tsisa tsigataha, ale Quola tsigataha, nihisgini gago itsasdi?
\syll ᎤᏲᏃ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᏥᏌ ᏥᎦᏔᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᏉᎳ ᏥᎦᏔᎭ, ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎦᎪ ᎢᏣᏍᏗ?
\ft And the evil spirit answered and said, Jesus I know, and Paul I know; but who are ye?

\ln Asgayano uyo adanvdo uyai dunelugielei, ale esga niduwanelei, ale dusegogisei, nasgi iyusdi unalise nahna adanelv uninugotse tsuniyelviha ale digetsisonvnvhi.
\syll ᎠᏍᎦᏯᏃ ᎤᏲ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᏯᎢ ᏚᏁᎷᎩᎡᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎡᏍᎦ ᏂᏚᏩᏁᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏎᎪᎩᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᎾᎵᏎ ᏀᎾ ᎠᏓᏁᎸ ᎤᏂᏄᎪᏤ ᏧᏂᏰᎸᎢᎭ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎨᏥᏐᏅᏅᎯ.
\ft And the man in whom the evil spirit was leaped on them, and overcame them, and prevailed against them, so that they fled out of that house naked and wounded.

\ln Ale nasgi hia unadvganvgi nigadv Anitsusi ale Anigoi Equisa anehi; nigadvno uninayesvgi, ale Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa dudov galvquodiyu nulistanvgi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅᎩ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᎪᎢ ᎡᏈᏌ ᎠᏁᎯ; ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᎤᏂᎾᏰᏒᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᏚᏙᎥ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎩ.
\ft And this was known to all the Jews and Greeks also dwelling at Ephesus; and fear fell on them all, and the name of the Lord Jesus was magnified.

\ln Unitsadvgino unohiyunvhi unilutsvgi, aninohvsgv ale gvnigesv nanvnehvdunilvwisdanelvi.
\syll ᎤᏂᏣᏛᎩᏃ ᎤᏃᎯᏳᏅᎯ ᎤᏂᎷᏨᎩ, ᎠᏂᏃᎲᏍᎬ ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎾᏅᏁᎲᏚᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸᎢ.
\ft And many that believed came, and confessed, and shewed their deeds.

\ln Nasquo unitsadvgi usquanigodi anadvnelisgi dunitlisanvgi goweli, ale dunagohvstanvgi nigadv anigatahvi.  Unaselvno tsugvwalodihi unadolehosvgi hisgasgohi iyagayvli gesv uninegv adelv.
\syll ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᏂᏣᏛᎩ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᎠᎾᏛᏁᎵᏍᎩ ᏚᏂᏟᏌᏅᎩ ᎪᏪᎵ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᎾᎪᎲᏍᏔᏅᎩ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎲᎢ.  ᎤᎾᏎᎸᏃ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗᎯ ᎤᎾᏙᎴᎰᏒᎩ ᎯᏍᎦᏍᎪᎯ ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏂᏁᎬ ᎠᏕᎸ.
\ft Many of them also which used curious arts brought their books together, and burned them before all men: and they counted the price of them, and found it fifty thousand pieces of silver.

\ln Nasgi tsulinigvgvgi udvnosvgi ale uyelisvgi kanohedv Unelanvhi utseliga.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᎵᏂᎬᎬᎩ ᎤᏛᏃᏒᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏰᎵᏒᎩ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ.
\ft So mightily grew the word of God and prevailed.

\ln Nasgino hia nulistanidolv, Quola udanvtelvgi udanvdvi, hnaquo Masidoni ale Ekaya ulosonvhi, Tsilusilimi wulohisdiyi, hia nuwesvgi; nahna gvquedonvhi gesesdi Lomi nasquo ase dvtsigoi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏂᏙᎸ, ᏉᎳ ᎤᏓᏅᏖᎸᎩ ᎤᏓᏅᏛᎢ, ᎿᏉ ᎹᏏᏙᏂ ᎠᎴ ᎡᎧᏯ ᎤᎶᏐᏅᎯ, ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᏭᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᏀᎾ ᎬᏇᏙᏅᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎶᎻ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏎ ᏛᏥᎪᎢ.
\ft After these things were ended, Paul purposed in the spirit, when he had passed through Macedonia and Achaia, to go to Jerusalem, saying, After I have been there, I must also see Rome.

\ln Howano Masidoni deunvsvgi anitali gvwasdelvhidohi, Dimadi ale Ilasda, uwasvsgini udigiyvgi Esiyi ilvsgi igohidv.
\syll ᎰᏩᏃ ᎹᏏᏙᏂ ᏕᎤᏅᏒᎩ ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᎬᏩᏍᏕᎸᎯᏙᎯ, ᏗᎹᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎢᎳᏍᏓ, ᎤᏩᏒᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏗᎩᏴᎩ ᎡᏏᏱ ᎢᎸᏍᎩ ᎢᎪᎯᏛ.
\ft So he sent into Macedonia two of them that ministered unto him, Timotheus and Erastus; but he himself stayed in Asia for a season.

\ln Nahiyuno vtla usdiquo udeyadodi yinulistanei, nvdagalisdodisgvgi nasgi ganvnv ugvwali.
\syll ᏀᎢᏳᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏍᏗᏉ ᎤᏕᏯᏙᏗ ᏱᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏅᏅ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ.
\ft And the same time there arose no small stir about that way.

\ln Giloyeno iyusdi Dimitliya tsudoidv, adelv atlvnvvsgi, adelv digotlvtanvhi dadanelv degotlvnanehv Dayeni, vtla usdiquo tsugvwalodi yidawadvehe anotlvnvvsgi.
\syll ᎩᎶᏰᏃ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏗᎻᏟᏯ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ, ᎠᏕᎸ ᎠᏢᏅᎥᏍᎩ, ᎠᏕᎸ ᏗᎪᏢᏔᏅᎯ ᏓᏓᏁᎸ ᏕᎪᏢᎾᏁᎲ ᏓᏰᏂ, ᎥᏝ ᎤᏍᏗᏉ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᏱᏓᏩᏛᎡᎮ ᎠᏃᏢᏅᎥᏍᎩ.
\ft For a certain man named Demetrius, a silversmith, which made silver shrines for Diana, brought no small gain unto the craftsmen;

\ln Nasgi duwetlisanv ale nvwanadale nasgi iyusdi tsunilvwisdanehi duwetlisanv hia nuwesvgi; Itsisgaya, itsigataha hia nasgi digalvwisdanedi gesv tsugvwalodi idiwadvdisgvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᏪᏟᏌᏅ ᎠᎴ ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᏚᏪᏟᏌᏅ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎢᏥᏍᎦᏯ, ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎢᏗᏩᏛᏗᏍᎬᎢ.
\ft Whom he called together with the workmen of like occupation, and said, Sirs, ye know that by this craft we have our wealth.

\ln Ale itsigowatiha ale itsadvgiha, vtla Equisaquo uwasv, nasquosgini alequo nigvnadv Esiyi, hia Quola dasdiyedisgv dugatahvsv unitsati yvwi, hia nidegawesehvi, vtla galvladi anehi yigi gilo tsuwoyeniquo tsuwotlvtanvhi tsigi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎢᏥᎪᏩᏘᎭ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏣᏛᎩᎭ, ᎥᏝ ᎡᏈᏌᏉ ᎤᏩᏒ, ᎾᏍᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᎴᏉ ᏂᎬᎾᏛ ᎡᏏᏱ, ᎯᎠ ᏉᎳ ᏓᏍᏗᏰᏗᏍᎬ ᏚᎦᏔᎲᏒ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏴᏫ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᏕᎦᏪᏎᎲᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎠᏁᎯ ᏱᎩ ᎩᎶ ᏧᏬᏰᏂᏉ ᏧᏬᏢᏔᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ.
\ft Moreover ye see and hear, that not alone at Ephesus, but almost throughout all Asia, this Paul hath persuaded and turned away much people, saying that they be no gods, which are made with hands:

\ln Ale vtla hiaquo digilvwisdanedi gesv uwasv unelagi wigvwayotsidasdi yigi; nasquosgini adanelv galvquodiyu galvladi ehi Dayeni utseliga asequoquo igvwalistanidasdi, ale nasgi atsilvquodiyu gesv wigvwayotsidasdi, nasgi nigadv Esiyi ale nigvnadv elohi tsigvwalvquodiha.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᎯᎠᏉ ᏗᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᎩ ᏫᎬᏩᏲᏥᏓᏍᏗ ᏱᎩ; ᎾᏍᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏓᏁᎸ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ ᏓᏰᏂ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᎠᏎᏉᏉ ᎢᎬᏩᎵᏍᏔᏂᏓᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᏫᎬᏩᏲᏥᏓᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎡᏏᏱ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎬᎾᏛ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏥᎬᏩᎸᏉᏗᎭ.
\ft So that not only this our craft is in danger to be set at nought; but also that the temple of the great goddess Diana should be despised, and her magnificence should be destroyed, whom all Asia and the world worshippeth.

\ln Nasgino unadvganv unitalawosgvi unikalitsvgi, ale unelunvgi hia nuniwesvgi; Galvquodiyu Dayeni Equisa anehi unatseliga.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅ ᎤᏂᏔᎳᏬᏍᎬᎢ ᎤᏂᎧᎵᏨᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎷᏅᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᏓᏰᏂ ᎡᏈᏌ ᎠᏁᎯ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ.
\ft And when they heard these sayings, they were full of wrath, and cried out, saying, Great is Diana of the Ephesians.

\ln Nigvno gaduhv unadasuyedvquo nulistanvgi, duniniyvhvno Gaya ale Elistaga Masidoni anehi, Quola unaligohi anedohvi, ulenonvhi unanelugisvgi wuniyvlvgi unadvnelvdiyi.
\syll ᏂᎬᏃ ᎦᏚᎲ ᎤᎾᏓᏑᏰᏛᏉ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎩ, ᏚᏂᏂᏴᎲᏃ ᎦᏯ ᎠᎴ ᎡᎵᏍᏔᎦ ᎹᏏᏙᏂ ᎠᏁᎯ, ᏉᎳ ᎤᎾᎵᎪᎯ ᎠᏁᏙᎲᎢ, ᎤᎴᏃᏅᎯ ᎤᎾᏁᎷᎩᏒᎩ ᏭᏂᏴᎸᎩ ᎤᎾᏛᏁᎸᏗᏱ.
\ft And the whole city was filled with confusion: and having caught Gaius and Aristarchus, men of Macedonia, Paul's companions in travel, they rushed with one accord into the theatre.

\ln Quolano widuyvsediyi yvwi udanvtelv, anohiyuhvsgi gvwanvsdadelvgi.
\syll ᏉᎳᏃ ᏫᏚᏴᏎᏗᏱ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏓᏅᏖᎸ, ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᎬᏩᏅᏍᏓᏕᎸᎩ.
\ft And when Paul would have entered in unto the people, the disciples suffered him not.

\ln Gilono iyunasdi digeganelodi Esiyi anehi, Quola tsulii, unadanvsvgi wigvwatayoselvgi, wuyvsdiyi nigesvna unadvnelvdiyi.
\syll ᎩᎶᏃ ᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗ ᏗᎨᎦᏁᎶᏗ ᎡᏏᏱ ᎠᏁᎯ, ᏉᎳ ᏧᎵᎢ, ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏒᎩ ᏫᎬᏩᏔᏲᏎᎸᎩ, ᏭᏴᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎤᎾᏛᏁᎸᏗᏱ.
\ft And certain of the chief of Asia, which were his friends, sent unto him, desiring him that he would not adventure himself into the theatre.

\ln Unelunvhi tsudalenvdvquo niduniwesvgi; danilawivyeno unadasuyedvquo gesvgi, ale utli iyanidv vtla yanigatahe nvdigalisdodisgv unadatlisanvi.
\syll ᎤᏁᎷᏅᎯ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛᏉ ᏂᏚᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᏓᏂᎳᏫᎥᏰᏃ ᎤᎾᏓᏑᏰᏛᏉ ᎨᏒᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏟ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᎥᏝ ᏯᏂᎦᏔᎮ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬ ᎤᎾᏓᏟᏌᏅᎢ.
\ft Some therefore cried one thing, and some another: for the assembly was confused; and the more part knew not wherefore they were come together.

\ln Wunoyanesvgino Eligi unitsati anidonavi, nasgi Anitsusi aninvwisdisgvgi; Eligino udelvnv uwoyeni udulisgvgi uwasv alisdelisgvi tsuwonedodiyi yvwi.
\syll ᏭᏃᏯᏁᏒᎩᏃ ᎡᎵᎩ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎠᏂᏙᎾᎥᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎠᏂᏅᏫᏍᏗᏍᎬᎩ; ᎡᎵᎩᏃ ᎤᏕᎸᏅ ᎤᏬᏰᏂ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎬᎩ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎠᎵᏍᏕᎵᏍᎬᎢ ᏧᏬᏁᏙᏗᏱ ᏴᏫ.
\ft And they drew Alexander out of the multitude, the Jews putting him forward. And Alexander beckoned with the hand, and would have made his defence unto the people.

\ln Aseno unadolehosv Atsusi gesvi, saquo tsikanego nasgiya nigadv unelunvgi, taliha iyutlilodv igohidv hia naniwesgvgi; Galvquodiyu Dayeni Equisa anehi unatseliga.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᎾᏙᎴᎰᏒ ᎠᏧᏏ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏌᏉ ᏥᎧᏁᎪ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎤᏁᎷᏅᎩ, ᏔᎵᎭ ᎢᏳᏟᎶᏛ ᎢᎪᎯᏛ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏂᏪᏍᎬᎩ; ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᏓᏰᏂ ᎡᏈᏌ ᎠᏁᎯ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ.
\ft But when they knew that he was a Jew, all with one voice about the space of two hours cried out, Great is Diana of the Ephesians.

\ln Digowelisgino duyosdodanelv yvwi, hia nuwesvgi; Itsisgaya Equisa itsehi, gago eha nagatahvna gaduhv Equisa nasgi edadadolisdanehi gesv galvquodiyu galvladi ehi Dayeni, ale Tsuquodo nvdayuloosvhi ditlilostanvhi?
\syll ᏗᎪᏪᎵᏍᎩᏃ ᏚᏲᏍᏙᏓᏁᎸ ᏴᏫ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎢᏥᏍᎦᏯ ᎡᏈᏌ ᎢᏤᎯ, ᎦᎪ ᎡᎭ ᎾᎦᏔᎲᎾ ᎦᏚᎲ ᎡᏈᏌ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᏓᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ ᏓᏰᏂ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏉᏙ ᏅᏓᏳᎶᎣᏒᎯ ᏗᏟᎶᏍᏔᏅᎯ?
