\ln Gvnigesv nigatsiyvnehv Anitsusi ale nasquo Anigoi nasgi Unelanvhi ganetliyvedi gesv odanvdvi, ale gohiyudi gesv Ugvwiyuhi igatseli Tsisa Galonedv.
\syll ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᎦᏥᏴᏁᎲ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏂᎪᎢ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎦᏁᏟᏴᎡᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎣᏓᏅᏛᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ.
\ft Testifying both to the Jews, and also to the Greeks, repentance toward God, and faith toward our Lord Jesus Christ.

\ln Hnaquono gvniyuquo aquadanvdv galvidv Tsilusilimi witsigati, nitsigatahvna nvdiqualisdanelisv nahnani,
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏛ ᎦᎸᎢᏛ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᏫᏥᎦᏘ, ᏂᏥᎦᏔᎲᎾ ᏅᏗᏆᎵᏍᏓᏁᎵᏒ ᏀᎾᏂ,
\ft And now, behold, I go bound in the spirit unto Jerusalem, not knowing the things that shall befall me there:

\ln Galvquodiyusgininonv Adanvdo gvnigesv nigvneha degaduwadisvi, nasgi gvgigatiyv vqualvsdi gesv ale uyo iyaqualisdanedi gesvi.
\syll ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᎬᏁᎭ ᏕᎦᏚᏩᏗᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᎩᎦᏘᏴ ᎥᏆᎸᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏲ ᎢᏯᏆᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Save that the Holy Ghost witnesseth in every city, saying that bonds and afflictions abide me.

\ln Aseno nasgi hia tsudalenvdv vtla gohusdi yagitelvhvsga, ale nasquo gvnv vtla utsati yagilvquodi, iyuno ulihelisdi yaquadanvta yagisquadv galenidohvi, ale Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa aginelvhi digalvwisdanedi gesvi, gvnigesv nigvnehv osdv kanohedv Unelanvhi gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv kanohesgi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎥᏝ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏯᎩᏖᎸᎲᏍᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎬᏅ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏯᎩᎸᏉᏗ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎤᎵᎮᎵᏍᏗ ᏯᏆᏓᏅᏔ ᏯᎩᏍᏆᏛ ᎦᎴᏂᏙᎲᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎠᎩᏁᎸᎯ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᎬᏁᎲ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎧᏃᎮᏍᎩ.
\ft But none of these things move me, neither count I my life dear unto myself, so that I might finish my course with joy, and the ministry, which I have received of the Lord Jesus, to testify the gospel of the grace of God.

\ln Hnaquono gvniyuquo tsigataha nihi nitsivi, itsvyeladidolvhi galitsidohvsgv tsinohesgv Unelanvhi utseligohi, aquakadv hnaquo itsigowadvdi nigesvna gesvi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᏂᎯ ᏂᏥᎥᎢ, ᎢᏨᏰᎳᏗᏙᎸᎯ ᎦᎵᏥᏙᎲᏍᎬ ᏥᏃᎮᏍᎬ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎪᎯ, ᎠᏆᎧᏛ ᎿᏉ ᎢᏥᎪᏩᏛᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft And now, behold, I know that ye all, among whom I have gone preaching the kingdom of God, shall see my face no more.

\ln Nasgino iyusdi gohi iga itsigatahi nitsvyvga, gilo unigigv naquadanvgalvna gesvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎪᎯ ᎢᎦ ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎯ ᏂᏨᏴᎦ, ᎩᎶ ᎤᏂᎩᎬ ᎾᏆᏓᏅᎦᎸᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Wherefore I take you to record this day, that I am pure from the blood of all men.

\ln Vtlayeno agisgalvhi yigi gvnigesv itsvyvnediyi nigav Unelanvhi udanvtelvi.
\syll ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᎠᎩᏍᎦᎸᎯ ᏱᎩ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏨᏴᏁᏗᏱ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏓᏅᏖᎸᎢ.
\ft For I have not shunned to declare unto you all the counsel of God.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi itsadagasayasdesdi itsvsv, ale detsigasayasdesdi nigadv sunadatlugi gesvi, nasgi ditsigatiya itsvnelvhi tsigi Galvquodiyu Adanvdo, ditselasdiyi tsunanelodi unadatlugv Unelanvhi tsutseliga, nasgi uwasv ugigv tsuguyvtanvhi tsigi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏣᏓᎦᏌᏯᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᎢᏨᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᏥᎦᏌᏯᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏑᎾᏓᏡᎩ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏥᎦᏘᏯ ᎢᏨᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ, ᏗᏤᎳᏍᏗᏱ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᏤᎵᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎤᎩᎬ ᏧᎫᏴᏔᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ.
\ft Take heed therefore unto yourselves, and to all the flock, over the which the Holy Ghost hath made you overseers, to feed the church of God, which he hath purchased with his own blood.

\ln Hiayeno nasgi tsigataha, hnaquo aginelesdi, unigvvsgi waya dagetsadasuyvni, nidanidoligvna gesesdi sunadatlugi gesvi.
\syll ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᎦᏔᎭ, ᎿᏉ ᎠᎩᏁᎴᏍᏗ, ᎤᏂᎬᎥᏍᎩ ᏩᏯ ᏓᎨᏣᏓᏑᏴᏂ, ᏂᏓᏂᏙᎵᎬᎾ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏑᎾᏓᏡᎩ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft For I know this, that after my departing shall grievous wolves enter in among you, not sparing the flock.

\ln Ale nasquo itsvsv itsadatlugv dvninanugotsi anisgaya utsatini naniwesgesdi aniwonisgesdi, anohiyuhvsgi tsunatihnawidvdiyi uniyelvsesdi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎢᏨᏒ ᎢᏣᏓᏡᎬ ᏛᏂᎾᏄᎪᏥ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᏣᏘᏂ ᎾᏂᏪᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᏂᏬᏂᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᏧᎾᏘᎿᏫᏛᏗᏱ ᎤᏂᏰᎸᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft Also of your own selves shall men arise, speaking perverse things, to draw away disciples after them.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi itsiyawisgesdi, ale itsanvtesdi tsoi tsudetiyvdv nitsisuligogvna svnoyi ale iga digatsigasawoihi itsisiyvwiha itsvyeyatanvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏥᏯᏫᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏣᏅᏖᏍᏗ ᏦᎢ ᏧᏕᏘᏴᏛ ᏂᏥᏑᎵᎪᎬᎾ ᏒᏃᏱ ᎠᎴ ᎢᎦ ᏗᎦᏥᎦᏌᏬᎢᎯ ᎢᏥᏏᏴᏫᎭ ᎢᏨᏰᏯᏔᏅᎢ.
\ft Therefore watch, and remember, that by the space of three years I ceased not to warn every one night and day with tears.

\ln Ka, idadanvtli, hnaquo detsvyohi Unelanvhi itsidolisdiyi, uwvdodiyi, kanohedv gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv kanohesgi, nasgi yeli getsanesgedi tsigi, ale itsatseli yeli igetsvnedi tsigi nasgi nigadv unadanvti igegvnelvhi unatseli iyulisdodi gesvi.
\syll Ꭷ, ᎢᏓᏓᏅᏟ, ᎿᏉ ᏕᏨᏲᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᏥᏙᎵᏍᏗᏱ, ᎤᏮᏙᏗᏱ, ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎧᏃᎮᏍᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏰᎵ ᎨᏣᏁᏍᎨᏗ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏣᏤᎵ ᏰᎵ ᎢᎨᏨᏁᏗ ᏥᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ ᎢᎨᎬᏁᎸᎯ ᎤᎾᏤᎵ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft And now, brethren, I commend you to God, and to the word of his grace, which is able to build you up, and to give you an inheritance among all them which are sanctified.

\ln Vtla gilo tsiyadulvelvhi yigi adelv unegv ale adelv dalonige ale dinuwo.
\syll ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᏥᏯᏚᎸᎡᎸᎯ ᏱᎩ ᎠᏕᎸ ᎤᏁᎬ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏕᎸ ᏓᎶᏂᎨ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏄᏬ.
\ft I have coveted no man's silver, or gold, or apparel.

\ln Itsvsvyeno itsigataha hia nasgi diquoyeni daquvtanvhi agiwadvhv aginigvsehv aquvsv ale nasquo otsehi.
\syll ᎢᏨᏒᏰᏃ ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏉᏰᏂ ᏓᏋᏔᏅᎯ ᎠᎩᏩᏛᎲ ᎠᎩᏂᎬᏎᎲ ᎠᏋᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎣᏤᎯ.
\ft Yea, ye yourselves know, that these hands have ministered unto my necessities, and to them that were with me.

\ln Nigadv gvnigesv nitsvyvnelv nasgi itsadvnediyi detsilvwisdanehv ditsisdelvdiyi diniwanagalai, ale itsanvdadisdiyi tsunetse Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa, hia tsinuwesei, "Utli osiyu adanvdadisdi yvdaneha, esgaquo yvdadineha."
\syll ᏂᎦᏛ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᏨᏴᏁᎸ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏣᏛᏁᏗᏱ ᏕᏥᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᏗᏥᏍᏕᎸᏗᏱ ᏗᏂᏩᎾᎦᎳᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏣᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗᏱ ᏧᏁᏤ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ, ᎯᎠ ᏥᏄᏪᏎᎢ, data is invalidᎤᏟ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗ ᏴᏓᏁᎭ, ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᏴᏓᏗᏁᎭ.data is invalid
\ft I have shewed you all things, how that so labouring ye ought to support the weak, and to remember the words of the Lord Jesus, how he said, It is more blessed to give than to receive.

\ln Nasgino hia nuwesv, duliniquanvnvgi ale nigadv anigatahv udadolistanvgi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒ, ᏚᎵᏂᏆᏅᏅᎩ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎲ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏔᏅᎩ.
\ft And when he had thus spoken, he kneeled down, and prayed with them all.

\ln Nagadvno utsati dunatloyilvgi, ale Quola agiligeni uniyalvtsv gvwatawedonvgi.
\syll ᎾᎦᏛᏃ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏚᎾᏠᏱᎸᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏉᎳ ᎠᎩᎵᎨᏂ ᎤᏂᏯᎸᏨ ᎬᏩᏔᏪᏙᏅᎩ.
\ft And they all wept sore, and fell on Paul's neck, and kissed him,

\ln Uyo uniyelvsvgi ho ugvwiyusv nvdagalisdodisgv unetsv nasgi ukadv hnaquo unigowadvdi nigesvna gesvi.  Tsiyuno ditalvi wigvwekanvgi.
\syll ᎤᏲ ᎤᏂᏰᎸᏒᎩ Ꮀ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎧᏛ ᎿᏉ ᎤᏂᎪᏩᏛᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.  ᏥᏳᏃ ᏗᏔᎸᎢ ᏫᎬᏪᎧᏅᎩ.
\ft Sorrowing most of all for the words which he spake, that they should see his face no more. And they accompanied him unto the ship.

\ln Nasgino dogagalenvhv ale tsiyuhi ogatsanv, tsuyugodi woginvstanvgi Goosi wogilutsvgi, ugitsvdvno Lodiyi, nahnano wiogenv Quateli wogilutsvgi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏙᎦᎦᎴᏅᎲ ᎠᎴ ᏥᏳᎯ ᎣᎦᏣᏅ, ᏧᏳᎪᏗ ᏬᎩᏅᏍᏔᏅᎩ ᎪᎣᏏ ᏬᎩᎷᏨᎩ, ᎤᎩᏨᏛᏃ ᎶᏗᏱ, ᏀᎾᏃ ᏫᎣᎨᏅ ᏆᏖᎵ ᏬᎩᎷᏨᎩ.
\ft And it came to pass, that after we were gotten from them, and had launched, we came with a straight course unto Coos, and the day following unto Rhodes, and from thence unto Patara:

\ln Ogiyvwadvhvno tsiyu Quinisi aninisvi, ogatsanvgi ogiyvwidvhvgi.
\syll ᎣᎩᏴᏩᏛᎲᏃ ᏥᏳ ᏈᏂᏏ ᎠᏂᏂᏒᎢ, ᎣᎦᏣᏅᎩ ᎣᎩᏴᏫᏛᎲᎩ.
\ft And finding a ship sailing over unto Phenicia, we went aboard, and set forth.

\ln Hnaquono ogigohv Saqui, ale agatisiditlv ogilosv, Siliyi woginvstanvgi, Dayano ogatsaisvgi; nahnayeno tsiyu ulinesalv ulinesalesdi gesvgi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎣᎩᎪᎲ ᏌᏈ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎦᏘᏏᏗᏢ ᎣᎩᎶᏒ, ᏏᎵᏱ ᏬᎩᏅᏍᏔᏅᎩ, ᏓᏯᏃ ᎣᎦᏣᎢᏒᎩ; ᏀᎾᏰᏃ ᏥᏳ ᎤᎵᏁᏌᎸ ᎤᎵᏁᏌᎴᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎩ.
\ft Now when we had discovered Cyprus, we left it on the left hand, and sailed into Syria, and landed at Tyre: for there the ship was to unlade her burden.

\ln Dotsiwadvhvno anohiyuhvsgi nahna oganvnvgi galiquogi tsudodaquadv; nasgi Quola hia nigvwaweselvgi adanvdo iyuwanisadv; tlesdi Tsilusilimi tsenvsvgi.
\syll ᏙᏥᏩᏛᎲᏃ ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᏀᎾ ᎣᎦᏅᏅᎩ ᎦᎵᏉᎩ ᏧᏙᏓᏆᏛ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᏉᎳ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏩᏪᏎᎸᎩ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ; ᏞᏍᏗ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᏤᏅᏒᎩ.
\ft And finding disciples, we tarried there seven days: who said to Paul through the Spirit, that he should not go up to Jerusalem.

\ln Nasgino galiquogi tsudodaquadv ulosonv, oganigisvgi, wotsigadv iditlv wogilosvgi; nigadvno nasgi, ale tsunadalii ale tsunetsi digvnatinehi gaduhv wigananugogv widegogikanvgi.  Amayulodino dogaliniquanvnv ogadadolistanvgi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎦᎵᏉᎩ ᏧᏙᏓᏆᏛ ᎤᎶᏐᏅ, ᎣᎦᏂᎩᏒᎩ, ᏬᏥᎦᏛ ᎢᏗᏢ ᏬᎩᎶᏒᎩ; ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᎾᏓᎵᎢ ᎠᎴ ᏧᏁᏥ ᏗᎬᎾᏘᏁᎯ ᎦᏚᎲ ᏫᎦᎾᏄᎪᎬ ᏫᏕᎪᎩᎧᏅᎩ.  ᎠᎹᏳᎶᏗᏃ ᏙᎦᎵᏂᏆᏅᏅ ᎣᎦᏓᏙᎵᏍᏔᏅᎩ.
\ft And when we had accomplished those days, we departed and went our way; and they all brought us on our way, with wives and children, till we were out of the city: and we kneeled down on the shore, and prayed.

\ln Dogadayolilvno, tsiyuhi ogatsanvgi; nasgino dotsunenvsv wvunilosvgi.
\syll ᏙᎦᏓᏲᎵᎸᏃ, ᏥᏳᎯ ᎣᎦᏣᏅᎩ; ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏙᏧᏁᏅᏒ ᏮᎤᏂᎶᏒᎩ.
\ft And when we had taken our leave one of another, we took ship; and they returned home again.

\ln Ogisquadvno oganvtawadisv daya tsoganigisvi dolimayi ogilutsvgi, ale dotsiyolilv anadanvtli, nahna sudodaquadv ogedolvgi.
\syll ᎣᎩᏍᏆᏛᏃ ᎣᎦᏅᏔᏩᏗᏒ ᏓᏯ ᏦᎦᏂᎩᏒᎢ ᏙᎵᎹᏱ ᎣᎩᎷᏨᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏙᏥᏲᎵᎸ ᎠᎾᏓᏅᏟ, ᏀᎾ ᏑᏙᏓᏆᏛ ᎣᎨᏙᎸᎩ.
\ft And when we had finished our course from Tyre, we came to Ptolemais, and saluted the brethren, and abode with them one day.

\ln Ugitsvdvno Quola ogaligohi oganigisvgi Sisaliyi wogilutsvgi.  Wogiyvlvno ganelv Quiligi ali tsidonidohi, nasgi galvquogi iyanidv agaligotanvhi, nahna oganvnvgi.
\syll ᎤᎩᏨᏛᏃ ᏉᎳ ᎣᎦᎵᎪᎯ ᎣᎦᏂᎩᏒᎩ ᏏᏌᎵᏱ ᏬᎩᎷᏨᎩ.  ᏬᎩᏴᎸᏃ ᎦᏁᎸ ᏈᎵᎩ ᎠᎵ ᏥᏙᏂᏙᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎸᏉᎩ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᎠᎦᎵᎪᏔᏅᎯ, ᏀᎾ ᎣᎦᏅᏅᎩ.
\ft And the next day we that were of Paul's company departed, and came unto Caesarea: and we entered into the house of Philip the evangelist, which was one of the seven; and abode with him.

\ln Nasgino tsuwetsi nvgi iyanidv anehvgi anadv anadolehosgi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏧᏪᏥ ᏅᎩ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᎠᏁᎲᎩ ᎠᎾᏛ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ.
\ft And the same man had four daughters, virgins, which did prophesy.

\ln Uwohitsvno nahna oganvnv, gilo iyusdi adolehosgi ulutsvgi, Egiwa tsudoidv, Tsudiyi nvdayulosvhi.
\syll ᎤᏬᎯᏨᏃ ᏀᎾ ᎣᎦᏅᏅ, ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎤᎷᏨᎩ, ᎡᎩᏩ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ, ᏧᏗᏱ ᏅᏓᏳᎶᏒᎯ.
\ft And as we tarried there many days, there came down from Judaea a certain prophet, named Agabus.

\ln Nasgino ulutsv otsedohv, ale unesv Quola udatlosdi, ale dulvlv uwasv tsuwoyeni, ale tsulasideni, hia nuwesvgi; Hia nigawea Galvquodiyu Adanvdo; nasgi hia nvdvnvneli Anitsusi Tsilusilimi dvnalvli asgaya hia adatlosdi utseliga, ale tsunadalenvdv yvwi widodvniyohiseli.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᎷᏨ ᎣᏤᏙᎲ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᏒ ᏉᎳ ᎤᏓᏠᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᎸᎸ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏧᏬᏰᏂ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᎳᏏᏕᏂ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᎠ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏅᏛᏅᏁᎵ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᏛᎾᎸᎵ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏓᏠᏍᏗ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᏫᏙᏛᏂᏲᎯᏎᎵ.
\ft And when he was come unto us, he took Paul's girdle, and bound his own hands and feet, and said, Thus saith the Holy Ghost, So shall the Jews at Jerusalem bind the man that owneth this girdle, and shall deliver him into the hands of the Gentiles.

\ln Nasgino hia ogadvganv, ayv ale nahna anehi otsisdiyetanvgi Tsilusilimi uwenvsdiyi nigesvna.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎣᎦᏛᎦᏅ, ᎠᏴ ᎠᎴ ᏀᎾ ᎠᏁᎯ ᎣᏥᏍᏗᏰᏔᏅᎩ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᎤᏪᏅᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.
\ft And when we heard these things, both we, and they of that place, besought him not to go up to Jerusalem.

\ln Aseno Quola unetsv hia nuwesvgi; Gado itsiyelvdi, tsidetsiyvga ale tsitsidawodiha aginawi; aquadvnvisdiyeno, vtla vqualvsdiyiquo uwasv, nasquosgini agiyohuhisdiyi Tsilusilimi, nvdigalisdodisgv dudov Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᏉᎳ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎦᏙ ᎢᏥᏰᎸᏗ, ᏥᏕᏥᏴᎦ ᎠᎴ ᏥᏥᏓᏬᏗᎭ ᎠᎩᎾᏫ; ᎠᏆᏛᏅᎢᏍᏗᏰᏃ, ᎥᏝ ᎥᏆᎸᏍᏗᏱᏉ ᎤᏩᏒ, ᎾᏍᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᎩᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬ ᏚᏙᎥ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ.
\ft Then Paul answered, What mean ye to weep and to break mine heart? for I am ready not to be bound only, but also to die at Jerusalem for the name of the Lord Jesus.

\ln Oninulvnvno otsisdiyedisgvi, ogisuligotsvgi, hia nogiwesvgi; Ugvwiyuhi adanvtesgv winigalisda.
\syll ᎣᏂᏄᎸᏅᏃ ᎣᏥᏍᏗᏰᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᎣᎩᏑᎵᎪᏨᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏃᎩᏪᏒᎩ; ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ ᏫᏂᎦᎵᏍᏓ.
\ft And when he would not be persuaded, we ceased, saying, The will of the Lord be done.

\ln Nahiyuno gesv ulosonv, ogitlisanvgi ogiyidasdi, ale Tsilusilimi wogilosvgi.
\syll ᏀᎢᏳᏃ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎶᏐᏅ, ᎣᎩᏟᏌᏅᎩ ᎣᎩᏱᏓᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᏬᎩᎶᏒᎩ.
\ft And after those days we took up our carriages, and went up to Jerusalem.

\ln Nasquono vgogisdawadvsvgi ilvsgi iyanidv anohiyuhvsgi Sisaliyi anehi, ale unatinvsvgi gilo iyusdi Nesani tsudoidv Saqui ehi, ilvhiyu gvwohiyunvhi, nasgi ganelv oganvdiyi uniyelvsvgi.
\syll ᎾᏍᏉᏃ ᎥᎪᎩᏍᏓᏩᏛᏒᎩ ᎢᎸᏍᎩ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᏏᏌᎵᏱ ᎠᏁᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏘᏅᏒᎩ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏁᏌᏂ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ ᏌᏈ ᎡᎯ, ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᎬᏬᎯᏳᏅᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏁᎸ ᎣᎦᏅᏗᏱ ᎤᏂᏰᎸᏒᎩ.
\ft There went with us also certain of the disciples of Caesarea, and brought with them one Mnason of Cyprus, an old disciple, with whom we should lodge.

\ln Tsilusilimino wogilutsv, anadanvtli ulihelitsvhi degogadanilvtsvgi.
\syll ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻᏃ ᏬᎩᎷᏨ, ᎠᎾᏓᏅᏟ ᎤᎵᎮᎵᏨᎯ ᏕᎪᎦᏓᏂᎸᏨᎩ.
\ft And when we were come to Jerusalem, the brethren received us gladly.

\ln Ogitsvdvno Quola Tsimi tsuwolv itsulaha ogenvsvgi, nigadvno digeganelodi anigatahvgi.
\syll ᎣᎩᏨᏛᏃ ᏉᎳ ᏥᎻ ᏧᏬᎸ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎣᎨᏅᏒᎩ, ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᏗᎨᎦᏁᎶᏗ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎲᎩ.
\ft And the day following Paul went in with us unto James; and all the elders were present.

\ln Deuyolilvno osdv uyilvsvgi unohelvgi nusdv Unelanvhi deulvwisdanelv tsunadalenvdv yvwi danewadisvi, nasgi Quola agvdisgvi.
\syll ᏕᎤᏲᎵᎸᏃ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎤᏱᎸᏒᎩ ᎤᏃᎮᎸᎩ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏕᎤᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᏓᏁᏩᏗᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏉᎳ ᎠᎬᏗᏍᎬᎢ.
\ft And when he had saluted them, he declared particularly what things God had wrought among the Gentiles by his ministry.

\ln Unadvganvno nasgi, unilvquotanvgi Ugvwiyuhi.  Hia nigvwaweselvgi; Idalinvtli, hadolehosga nunitsuquisdv Anitsusi unohiyunvhi; nigadvno utsati unilvquodiyu dikahnawadvsdi.
\syll ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ, ᎤᏂᎸᏉᏔᏅᎩ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ.  ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏩᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᎭᏙᎴᎰᏍᎦ ᏄᏂᏧᏈᏍᏛ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎤᏃᎯᏳᏅᎯ; ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᏂᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ.
\ft And when they heard it, they glorified the Lord, and said unto him, Thou seest, brother, how many thousands of Jews there are which believe; and they are all zealous of the law:

\ln Ale getsadvganelv deheyohvsgvi nigadv Ianitsusi, nasgi tsunadasuya tsunadalenvdv yvwi danewadisvi, tsuniyohisdiyi Mosi, hia niwesgvi; Tlesdi yiditsihusdesehesdi diniyoli, ale tlesdi dikahnawadvsdi yitsisdawadegesdi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎨᏣᏛᎦᏁᎸ ᏕᎮᏲᎲᏍᎬᎢ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎢᎠᏂᏧᏏ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᎾᏓᏑᏯ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᏓᏁᏩᏗᏒᎢ, ᏧᏂᏲᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎼᏏ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᏪᏍᎬᎢ; ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏗᏥᎱᏍᏕᏎᎮᏍᏗ ᏗᏂᏲᎵ, ᎠᎴ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏱᏥᏍᏓᏩᏕᎨᏍᏗ.
\ft And they are informed of thee, that thou teachest all the Jews which are among the Gentiles to forsake Moses, saying that they ought not to circumcise their children, neither to walk after the customs.

\ln Gadono advnedi?  Ase unadatlisodi unitsati, dvnadvganiyeno tsalutsvi.
\syll ᎦᏙᏃ ᎠᏛᏁᏗ?  ᎠᏎ ᎤᎾᏓᏟᏐᏗ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ, ᏛᎾᏛᎦᏂᏰᏃ ᏣᎷᏨᎢ.
\ft What is it therefore? the multitude must needs come together: for they will hear that thou art come.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi hia nitsvwesehv hnadvga.  Nvgi iyanidv anisgaya gogeladidoha Unelanvhi nunadulinunelv.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎲ ᎿᏛᎦ.  ᏅᎩ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ ᎪᎨᎳᏗᏙᎭ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏄᎾᏚᎵᏄᏁᎸ.
\ft Do therefore this that we say to thee: We have four men which have a vow on them;

\ln Nasgi tatinuga, ale itsulaha itsadanvgalv, ale itsulaha itsaguyv, nasgino dinisgoli deanalisdoyehvha; ale nigadv anadolehosvha nusdv getsadvganelvi asequoquo gesvi, ale anadolehosvha tsvsv nasquo duyugodv halenidohvi, dikahnawadvsdi hisdawadegvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏔᏘᏄᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᎦᎸ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎢᏣᎫᏴ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏗᏂᏍᎪᎵ ᏕᎠᎾᎵᏍᏙᏰᎲᎭ; ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏒᎭ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎨᏣᏛᎦᏁᎸᎢ ᎠᏎᏉᏉ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏒᎭ ᏨᏒ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎭᎴᏂᏙᎲᎢ, ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎯᏍᏓᏩᏕᎬᎢ.
\ft Them take, and purify thyself with them, and be at charges with them, that they may shave their heads: and all may know that those things, whereof they were informed concerning thee, are nothing; but that thou thyself also walkest orderly, and keepest the law.

\ln Tsunadalenvdvsgini yvwi unohiyunvhi tsigi, dotsowelanelv dogugotanv unisquanigododiyi nigesvna gohusdi nasgi iyusdi tsuneyadotsediquosgini uwasv Unelanvhi diyelvhi dilisgolvdanelvhi, ale gigv ale gohusdi gvwostanvhi ale udelidv dinisidi gesvi.
\syll ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏃᎯᏳᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᏙᏦᏪᎳᏁᎸ ᏙᎫᎪᏔᏅ ᎤᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏙᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏧᏁᏯᏙᏤᏗᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏗᏰᎸᎯ ᏗᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᎸᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎩᎬ ᎠᎴ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎬᏬᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᏗᏂᏏᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft As touching the Gentiles which believe, we have written and concluded that they observe no such thing, save only that they keep themselves from things offered to idols, and from blood, and from strangled, and from fornication.

\ln Hnaquono quola duyanvhvgi anisgaya, ugitsvdvno itsulaha unadanvgalvhvgi, digalawiisdiyi wuniyvlvgi, kanohvsgvgi ulisquadv igohidv adanvgalvdi gesvi, nasgi alisquadisgvi adanedi gesv anisiyvwiha unalisgolvdodi gesvi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏉᎳ ᏚᏯᏅᎲᎩ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ, ᎤᎩᏨᏛᏃ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᎦᎸᎲᎩ, ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᏭᏂᏴᎸᎩ, ᎧᏃᎲᏍᎬᎩ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᏛ ᎢᎪᎯᏛ ᎠᏓᏅᎦᎸᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᎬᎢ ᎠᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏂᏏᏴᏫᎭ ᎤᎾᎵᏍᎪᎸᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Then Paul took the men, and the next day purifying himself with them entered into the temple, to signify the accomplishment of the days of purification, until that an offering should be offered for every one of them.

\ln Hnaquono nasgi galiquogi iga dulisquadidisvgi, Anitsusi Esiyi nvdayunilosvhi gvwagohv digalawiisdiyi, dunitelvnvgi nigadv yvwi, ale gvwaniyvhvgi,
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎵᏉᎩ ᎢᎦ ᏚᎵᏍᏆᏗᏗᏒᎩ, ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎡᏏᏱ ᏅᏓᏳᏂᎶᏒᎯ ᎬᏩᎪᎲ ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᏚᏂᏖᎸᏅᎩ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏴᏫ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᏂᏴᎲᎩ,
\ft And when the seven days were almost ended, the Jews which were of Asia, when they saw him in the temple, stirred up all the people, and laid hands on him,

\ln Unelunvgi hia nuniwesvgi; Itsisgaya, Isili tsuwetsi, sgisdelv!  Hia nasgi asgaya nasgi tsidegeyohvsga naniv yvwi nigvnadvi, tsidatludiha hia yvwi ale dikahnawadvsdi ale ani gesvi, ale nasquo digalawiisdiyi tsiduyvtanilv Anigoi, ale gadaha tsinuwanelv ani galvquodiyu gesvi.
\syll ᎤᏁᎷᏅᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᎢᏥᏍᎦᏯ, ᎢᏏᎵ ᏧᏪᏥ, ᏍᎩᏍᏕᎸ  ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏕᎨᏲᎲᏍᎦ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏴᏫ ᏂᎬᎾᏛᎢ, ᏥᏓᏡᏗᎭ ᎯᎠ ᏴᏫ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᏥᏚᏴᏔᏂᎸ ᎠᏂᎪᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᏓᎭ ᏥᏄᏩᏁᎸ ᎠᏂ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Crying out, Men of Israel, help: This is the man, that teacheth all men every where against the people, and the law, and this place: and further brought Greeks also into the temple, and hath polluted this holy place.

\ln Gayulayeno unigohvhi gesvgi Tloquama Equisa ehi, nasgi Quola anedohv gaduhvi, nasgi Quola uyvtanilv digalawiisdiyi anelisgvgi.
\syll ᎦᏳᎳᏰᏃ ᎤᏂᎪᎲᎯ ᎨᏒᎩ ᏠᏆᎹ ᎡᏈᏌ ᎡᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏉᎳ ᎠᏁᏙᎲ ᎦᏚᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏉᎳ ᎤᏴᏔᏂᎸ ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᏁᎵᏍᎬᎩ.
\ft (For they had seen before with him in the city Trophimus an Ephesian, whom they supposed that Paul had brought into the temple.)

\ln Nigadvno gaduhv unalitelvnvgi, ale yvwi unadatlisanvgi, ale Quola uniniyvhvgi uninasanawidvhvgi digalawiisdiyi uninugowisvgi; gilaquono iyvdv galohisdiyi dunisdunvgi.
\syll ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᎦᏚᎲ ᎤᎾᎵᏖᎸᏅᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏴᏫ ᎤᎾᏓᏟᏌᏅᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏉᎳ ᎤᏂᏂᏴᎲᎩ ᎤᏂᎾᏌᎾᏫᏛᎲᎩ ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏂᏄᎪᏫᏒᎩ; ᎩᎳᏉᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏚᏂᏍᏚᏅᎩ.
\ft And all the city was moved, and the people ran together: and they took Paul, and drew him out of the temple: and forthwith the doors were shut.

\ln Asiquono unihisdiyi anadanvtesgvgi, sunadatlugi gesv aniyawisdi ditinidohi udvganvgi nigadv Tsilusilimi analitelvhvsgvi;
\syll ᎠᏏᏉᏃ ᎤᏂᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᎾᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬᎩ, ᏑᎾᏓᏡᎩ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏂᏯᏫᏍᏗ ᏗᏘᏂᏙᎯ ᎤᏛᎦᏅᎩ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᎠᎾᎵᏖᎸᎲᏍᎬᎢ;
\ft And as they went about to kill him, tidings came unto the chief captain of the band, that all Jerusalem was in an uproar.

\ln Nasgi na gilaquo iyvdv widuyanvhv aniyawisgi ale asgohitsuqui dinatinidohi, ale dinedohv wuditlvstanvgi.  Dunigohvno nugvwiyusv didatinidohi ale aniyawisgi, unisuligotsvgi anilvnihv Quola.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎩᎳᏉ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏫᏚᏯᏅᎲ ᎠᏂᏯᏫᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏧᏈ ᏗᎾᏘᏂᏙᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏁᏙᎲ ᏭᏗᏢᏍᏔᏅᎩ.  ᏚᏂᎪᎲᏃ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᏗᏓᏘᏂᏙᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏯᏫᏍᎩ, ᎤᏂᏑᎵᎪᏨᎩ ᎠᏂᎸᏂᎲ ᏉᎳ.
\ft Who immediately took soldiers and centurions, and ran down unto them: and when they saw the chief captain and the soldiers, they left beating of Paul.

\ln Hnaquono nugvwiyusv didatinidohi nav ulutsv, uniyvhvgi, ale unetsvgi tali tsudadesvdv tsagalvsdodiyi, ale udvdvnvgi iyusdi gesv, asgaya, ale nudvnelvi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᏗᏓᏘᏂᏙᎯ ᎾᎥ ᎤᎷᏨ, ᎤᏂᏴᎲᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᏨᎩ ᏔᎵ ᏧᏓᏕᏒᏛ ᏣᎦᎸᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏛᏛᏅᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ, ᎠᏍᎦᏯ, ᎠᎴ ᏄᏛᏁᎸᎢ.
\ft Then the chief captain came near, and took him, and commanded him to be bound with two chains; and demanded who he was, and what he had done.

\ln Unitsatino unelunvgi tsudalenvdvquo nuniwesvgi.  Unulvnvno duyugodv udolehohisdiyi nvdigalisdodisgv udasuyedv analitelvhvsgvi, unetsvgi disoyv wagatinvsdodiyi.
\syll ᎤᏂᏣᏘᏃ ᎤᏁᎷᏅᎩ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛᏉ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ.  ᎤᏄᎸᏅᏃ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎤᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬ ᎤᏓᏑᏰᏛ ᎠᎾᎵᏖᎸᎲᏍᎬᎢ, ᎤᏁᏨᎩ ᏗᏐᏴ ᏩᎦᏘᏅᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
\ft And some cried one thing, some another, among the multitude: and when he could not know the certainty for the tumult, he commanded him to be carried into the castle.

\ln Quolano agilawisdiyi ulutsv aniyawisgi gvwanvsvgi, nvdagalisdodisgvgi gvsgaisdagi nanadvnehv unitsati.
\syll ᏉᎳᏃ ᎠᎩᎳᏫᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᎷᏨ ᎠᏂᏯᏫᏍᎩ ᎬᏩᏅᏒᎩ, ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᎬᏍᎦᎢᏍᏓᎩ ᎾᎾᏛᏁᎲ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ.
\ft And when he came upon the stairs, so it was, that he was borne of the soldiers for the violence of the people.

\ln Unitsatiyeno yvwi gvwasdawadvsvgi, aneluhvsgvgi hia naniwesgvgi; hiluga.
\syll ᎤᏂᏣᏘᏰᏃ ᏴᏫ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏛᏒᎩ, ᎠᏁᎷᎲᏍᎬᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏂᏪᏍᎬᎩ; ᎯᎷᎦ.
\ft For the multitude of the people followed after, crying, Away with him.

\ln Hnaquono Quola disoyv wvdayetsiyvtanisvi, hia nuweselvgi nugvwiyusv didatinidohi; Tsisa yeli gohusdi gagvyosedi?  Nasgino hia nuwesvgi; Tsigo Anigoi uniwonihisdi gesv yeli getsawonihisdi?
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏉᎳ ᏗᏐᏴ ᏮᏓᏰᏥᏴᏔᏂᏒᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᏗᏓᏘᏂᏙᎯ; ᏥᏌ ᏰᎵ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎦᎬᏲᏎᏗ?  ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᏥᎪ ᎠᏂᎪᎢ ᎤᏂᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏰᎵ ᎨᏣᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ?
\ft And as Paul was to be led into the castle, he said unto the chief captain, May I speak unto thee? Who said, Canst thou speak Greek?

\ln Tlasgo nihi yigi na Itsiquiyi tsehvgi, ilvhiyu udasuyedv unalitelvdiyi tsinuwanelvgi, ale tsidutihnawidvhvgi inage tsiwidutinvstanvgi nvgi iyagayvli iyanidv anisgaya yvwi dinihihi?
\syll ᏝᏍᎪ ᏂᎯ ᏱᎩ Ꮎ ᎢᏥᏈᏱ ᏤᎲᎩ, ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᎤᏓᏑᏰᏛ ᎤᎾᎵᏖᎸᏗᏱ ᏥᏄᏩᏁᎸᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᏚᏘᎿᏫᏛᎲᎩ ᎢᎾᎨ ᏥᏫᏚᏘᏅᏍᏔᏅᎩ ᏅᎩ ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ ᏴᏫ ᏗᏂᎯᎯ?
\ft Art not thou that Egyptian, which before these days madest an uproar, and leddest out into the wilderness four thousand men that were murderers?

\ln Quolano hia nuwesvgi; Ayv Tsitsusi Silisiyi gei Dasa gaduhvi, vtla esgaquo uwohadv gaduhvi gei yigi; ale gvtayoseha unelagi squelisediyi ditsiwonedodiyi yvwi.
\syll ᏉᎳᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎠᏴ ᏥᏧᏏ ᏏᎵᏏᏱ ᎨᎢ ᏓᏌ ᎦᏚᎲᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎤᏬᎭᏛ ᎦᏚᎲᎢ ᎨᎢ ᏱᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᎬᏔᏲᏎᎭ ᎤᏁᎳᎩ ᏍᏇᎵᏎᏗᏱ ᏗᏥᏬᏁᏙᏗᏱ ᏴᏫ.
\ft But Paul said, I am a man which am a Jew of Tarsus, a city in Cilicia, a citizen of no mean city: and, I beseech thee, suffer me to speak unto the people.

\ln Unelagino uweliselv, Quola ulenvgi agilawisdiyi, uwoyeni yvwi dutelvnanelvgi; utsatino elawe unvnv, duwonetanvgi Anitsusi uniwonihisdi uwvtanvgi, hia nuwesvgi;
\syll ᎤᏁᎳᎩᏃ ᎤᏪᎵᏎᎸ, ᏉᎳ ᎤᎴᏅᎩ ᎠᎩᎳᏫᏍᏗᏱ, ᎤᏬᏰᏂ ᏴᏫ ᏚᏖᎸᎾᏁᎸᎩ; ᎤᏣᏘᏃ ᎡᎳᏪ ᎤᏅᏅ, ᏚᏬᏁᏔᏅᎩ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎤᏂᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᎤᏮᏔᏅᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ;
\ft And when he had given him licence, Paul stood on the stairs, and beckoned with the hand unto the people. And when there was made a great silence, he spake unto them in the Hebrew tongue, saying,

\ln Itsisgaya idadanvtli ale digidoda, itsadvdasda hia aqualisdelvdodi hnaquo tsvdatsiwonisi.
\syll ᎢᏥᏍᎦᏯ ᎢᏓᏓᏅᏟ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎩᏙᏓ, ᎢᏣᏛᏓᏍᏓ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏆᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ ᎿᏉ ᏨᏓᏥᏬᏂᏏ.
\ft Men, brethren, and fathers, hear ye my defence which I make now unto you.

\ln Unadvganvno Anitsusi uniwonihisdi gesv gvdisgv uniwonedisgvi, utli igai elawe unvnvgi; hiano nuwesvgi;
\syll ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅᏃ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎤᏂᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏗᏍᎬ ᎤᏂᏬᏁᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᎤᏟ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎡᎳᏪ ᎤᏅᏅᎩ; ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ;
\ft (And when they heard that he spake in the Hebrew tongue to them, they kept the more silence: and he saith,)

\ln Ayv Tsitsusi Silisiyi aquadenvhi Dasa gaduhvi, aseno ani gaduhv aquadvsvhi, Gemeli dulasgvi vqueyonvhi wunigudv dikahnawadvsdi gesv digigayvlige geginelvhi, ulinigidiyuno aquadanvdvgi detsigahnawadisv Unelanvhi nasgiya nitsiv nihi tsinusdi tsitsadanvta gohi iga tsigi.
\syll ᎠᏴ ᏥᏧᏏ ᏏᎵᏏᏱ ᎠᏆᏕᏅᎯ ᏓᏌ ᎦᏚᎲᎢ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᏂ ᎦᏚᎲ ᎠᏆᏛᏒᎯ, ᎨᎺᎵ ᏚᎳᏍᎬᎢ ᎥᏇᏲᏅᎯ ᏭᏂᎫᏛ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏗᎩᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᎨᎩᏁᎸᎯ, ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳᏃ ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏛᎩ ᏕᏥᎦᎿᏩᏗᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏂᏥᎥ ᏂᎯ ᏥᏄᏍᏗ ᏥᏣᏓᏅᏔ ᎪᎯ ᎢᎦ ᏥᎩ.
\ft I am verily a man which am a Jew, born in Tarsus, a city in Cilicia, yet brought up in this city at the feet of Gamaliel, and taught according to the perfect manner of the law of the fathers, and was zealous toward God, as ye all are this day.

\ln Ale gvniyohusgi gatsiyadeyadodisgvgi hia ganvnv dinikahnawadegi, degatsiyalvihvgi ale didasdudiyi degatsiyvdisgvgi anisgaya ale anigeyv.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᏲᎱᏍᎩ ᎦᏥᏯᏕᏯᏙᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎦᏅᏅ ᏗᏂᎧᎿᏩᏕᎩ, ᏕᎦᏥᏯᎸᎢᎲᎩ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏓᏍᏚᏗᏱ ᏕᎦᏥᏴᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᎨᏴ.
\ft And I persecuted this way unto the death, binding and delivering into prisons both men and women.

\ln Nugvwiyusvno atsilvgelohi nasquo gvnigesv naquvneha, ale nigadv digeganelodi gesvi, nasgi nasquo goweli degvginvnelvgi idalinvtli tsunigowadvdi, ale Demasga wagilosvgi, detsiyanvhvsv nahna anehi digegalvidv digatsiyatinohisdiyi Tsilusilimi, getsigiliyoisdodiyi.
\syll ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒᏃ ᎠᏥᎸᎨᎶᎯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎾᏋᏁᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏗᎨᎦᏁᎶᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎪᏪᎵ ᏕᎬᎩᏅᏁᎸᎩ ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ ᏧᏂᎪᏩᏛᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᎹᏍᎦ ᏩᎩᎶᏒᎩ, ᏕᏥᏯᏅᎲᏒ ᏀᎾ ᎠᏁᎯ ᏗᎨᎦᎸᎢᏛ ᏗᎦᏥᏯᏘᏃᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ, ᎨᏥᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
\ft As also the high priest doth bear me witness, and all the estate of the elders: from whom also I received letters unto the brethren, and went to Damascus, to bring them which were there bound unto Jerusalem, for to be punished.

\ln Nasgino hia naqualisdanelvgi gaisvi, Demasga nav wagilutsv, 'iga ayeli iyvdv, uyeloistanvgi utsati dulvsadadvgi galvladi nvdayulosvhi daquaduwistanvgi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏆᎵᏍᏓᏁᎸᎩ ᎦᎢᏒᎢ, ᏕᎹᏍᎦ ᎾᎥ ᏩᎩᎷᏨ, ᎢᎦ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎢᏴᏛ, ᎤᏰᎶᎢᏍᏔᏅᎩ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏚᎸᏌᏓᏛᎩ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏅᏓᏳᎶᏒᎯ ᏓᏆᏚᏫᏍᏔᏅᎩ.
\ft And it came to pass, that, as I made my journey, and was come nigh unto Damascus about noon, suddenly there shone from heaven a great light round about me.

\ln Eladino aginvtsvgi, kanegvno aquadvganvgi, hia nagiweselvgi; Sola, Sola, gadono uyo nisquvneha?
\syll ᎡᎳᏗᏃ ᎠᎩᏅᏨᎩ, ᎧᏁᎬᏃ ᎠᏆᏛᎦᏅᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᎩᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏐᎳ, ᏐᎳ, ᎦᏙᏃ ᎤᏲ ᏂᏍᏋᏁᎭ?
\ft And I fell unto the ground, and heard a voice saying unto me, Saul, Saul, why persecutest thou me?

\ln Ayvno aginetsv hia nagiwesvgi; gago nihi, Tsagvwiyuhi?  Hiano nagiweselvgi, ayv Tsisa Naseliti tsesgi, nasgi uyo tsiniyvneha.
\syll ᎠᏴᏃ ᎠᎩᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᎾᎩᏪᏒᎩ; ᎦᎪ ᏂᎯ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ?  ᎯᎠᏃ ᎾᎩᏪᏎᎸᎩ, ᎠᏴ ᏥᏌ ᎾᏎᎵᏘ ᏤᏍᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏲ ᏥᏂᏴᏁᎭ.
\ft And I answered, Who art thou, Lord? And he said unto me, I am Jesus of Nazareth, whom thou persecutest.

\ln Otsehino udohiyuhi anigowatisgvgi iga gadvi, ale anisgaihvgi, aseno vtla yunadvgane kanegv agiwonedisgi.
\syll ᎣᏤᎯᏃ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎠᏂᎪᏩᏘᏍᎬᎩ ᎢᎦ ᎦᏛᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᎢᎲᎩ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏳᎾᏛᎦᏁ ᎧᏁᎬ ᎠᎩᏬᏁᏗᏍᎩ.
\ft And they that were with me saw indeed the light, and were afraid; but they heard not the voice of him that spake to me.

\ln Hiano nagiwesvgi, Gado dagadvneli, Tsagvwiyuhi?  Ugvwiyuhino hia nagiweselvgi; Talehvga, Demasga hena, nahnano dayetsaquaneli nigav dudugotanv itsadvnediyi.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᎾᎩᏪᏒᎩ, ᎦᏙ ᏓᎦᏛᏁᎵ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ?  ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎾᎩᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏔᎴᎲᎦ, ᏕᎹᏍᎦ ᎮᎾ, ᏀᎾᏃ ᏓᏰᏣᏆᏁᎵ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏚᏚᎪᏔᏅ ᎢᏣᏛᏁᏗᏱ.
\ft And I said, What shall I do, Lord? And the Lord said unto me, Arise, and go into Damascus; and there it shall be told thee of all things which are appointed for thee to do.

\ln Aginulvnvno agigowadvdiyi, nvdigalisdodisgv digvwalvsada nasgi iga gadvi, otsehi gvquoyinenv, Demasga wagiyvlvgi.
\syll ᎠᎩᏄᎸᏅᏃ ᎠᎩᎪᏩᏛᏗᏱ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬ ᏗᎬᏩᎸᏌᏓ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎦ ᎦᏛᎢ, ᎣᏤᎯ ᎬᏉᏱᏁᏅ, ᏕᎹᏍᎦ ᏩᎩᏴᎸᎩ.
\ft And when I could not see for the glory of that light, being led by the hand of them that were with me, I came into Damascus.

\ln Gilono iyusdi Eninaya tsudoidv, udanvti dikahnawadvsdi asdawadegi, nigadv Anitsusi nahna anehi osdv gvwanohesgi,
\syll ᎩᎶᏃ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎡᏂᎾᏯ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ, ᎤᏓᏅᏘ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎠᏍᏓᏩᏕᎩ, ᏂᎦᏛ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᏀᎾ ᎠᏁᎯ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎬᏩᏃᎮᏍᎩ,
\ft And one Ananias, a devout man according to the law, having a good report of all the Jews which dwelt there,

\ln Agilutselv ulenilvgi, hia nagiweselvgi; dinadanvtli Sola, tsihigowadv.  Nahiyuquono dotsiyagahnanvgi.
\syll ᎠᎩᎷᏤᎸ ᎤᎴᏂᎸᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᎩᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏗᎾᏓᏅᏟ ᏐᎳ, ᏥᎯᎪᏩᏛ.  ᏀᎢᏳᏉᏃ ᏙᏥᏯᎦᎿᏅᎩ.
\ft Came unto me, and stood, and said unto me, Brother Saul, receive thy sight. And the same hour I looked up upon him.

\ln Hiano nuwesvgi; Unelanvhi digigayvlige unatseliga tsasuyesv, tsagadovhisdiyi nusdv adanvtesgvi, ale higowadvdiyi nasgi na nasganvna, ale aholi gananugogv kanegv tsadvgodiyi.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏗᎩᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ ᏣᏑᏰᏒ, ᏣᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎠᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎪᏩᏛᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎾᏍᎦᏅᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎰᎵ ᎦᎾᏄᎪᎬ ᎧᏁᎬ ᏣᏛᎪᏗᏱ.
\ft And he said, The God of our fathers hath chosen thee, that thou shouldest know his will, and see that Just One, and shouldest hear the voice of his mouth.

\ln Hinohesgiyeno gesesdi naniv yvwi anehvi nusdv tsagohvi ale tsadvganvi.
\syll ᎯᏃᎮᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏴᏫ ᎠᏁᎲᎢ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏣᎪᎲᎢ ᎠᎴ ᏣᏛᎦᏅᎢ.
\ft For thou shalt be his witness unto all men of what thou hast seen and heard.

\ln Ka, gadono ihadohidiha?  Talehvga, ale wetsawotsa, ale hosuli tsasganvtsvi, hitayohihesdi hvdisgesdi deudov Ugvwiyuhi.
\syll Ꭷ, ᎦᏙᏃ ᎢᎭᏙᎯᏗᎭ?  ᏔᎴᎲᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᏪᏣᏬᏣ, ᎠᎴ ᎰᏑᎵ ᏣᏍᎦᏅᏨᎢ, ᎯᏔᏲᎯᎮᏍᏗ ᎲᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏕᎤᏙᎥ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ.
\ft And now why tarriest thou? arise, and be baptized, and wash away thy sins, calling on the name of the Lord.

\ln Hiano naqualisdanelv Tsilusilimi iagilutsv, nasgi gadadolisdisgv udvnv digalawiisdiyi, tsagaliho iyusdi naqualisdanelvgi;
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᎾᏆᎵᏍᏓᏁᎸ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᎢᎠᎩᎷᏨ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᎤᏛᏅ ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᏣᎦᎵᎰ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎾᏆᎵᏍᏓᏁᎸᎩ;
\ft And it came to pass, that, when I was come again to Jerusalem, even while I prayed in the temple, I was in a trance;

\ln Ale tsigovgi hia nagiwesehvgi; natlegvquo iyvdv hinugoi Tsilusilimi; vtlayeno yidodvniniyvhi ayv sginohesgvi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏥᎪᎥᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎾᎩᏪᏎᎲᎩ; ᎾᏞᎬᏉ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎯᏄᎪᎢ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ; ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᏱᏙᏛᏂᏂᏴᎯ ᎠᏴ ᏍᎩᏃᎮᏍᎬᎢ.
\ft And saw him saying unto me, Make haste, and get thee quickly out of Jerusalem: for they will not receive thy testimony concerning me.

\ln Ale hia nagiwesvgi; Tsagvwiyuhi, anigataha detsisdunidolvi ale detsilvnilidolvi getsohiyuhvsgi digalawiisdiyi degotlvwadisvi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᎾᎩᏪᏒᎩ; ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎭ ᏕᏥᏍᏚᏂᏙᎸᎢ ᎠᎴ ᏕᏥᎸᏂᎵᏙᎸᎢ ᎨᏦᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᏕᎪᏢᏩᏗᏒᎢ.
\ft And I said, Lord, they know that I imprisoned and beat in every synagogue them that believed on thee:

\ln Ale tsanohesgi Sdiwi ugigv utsewotsv ayv nasquo nav tsidogvgi ale osiyu agiyelvsvgi uyohusvi, ale detsigatiyvgi tsunanuwo nasgi gvwahihi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏣᏃᎮᏍᎩ ᏍᏗᏫ ᎤᎩᎬ ᎤᏤᏬᏨ ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎾᎥ ᏥᏙᎬᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎠᎩᏰᎸᏒᎩ ᎤᏲᎱᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᏥᎦᏘᏴᎩ ᏧᎾᏄᏬ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏩᎯᎯ.
\ft And when the blood of thy martyr Stephen was shed, I also was standing by, and consenting unto his death, and kept the raiment of them that slew him.

\ln Hiano nagiweselvgi; Hadanvna, dagvnvsiyeno inv tsunadalenvdv yvwi dinehvi.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᎾᎩᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎭᏓᏅᎾ, ᏓᎬᏅᏏᏰᏃ ᎢᏅ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᏗᏁᎲᎢ.
\ft And he said unto me, Depart: for I will send thee far hence unto the Gentiles.

\ln Gvwadvdasdanehvgino gvni nasgi hia nuwesv, hnaquono unisaladanvgi aninegv hia nuniwesvgi; elohi wagatihnawidv nasgiquo iyusdi yvwi; vtlayeno yeli gvnesdi gayelisdi yigi.
\syll ᎬᏩᏛᏓᏍᏓᏁᎲᎩᏃ ᎬᏂ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒ, ᎿᏉᏃ ᎤᏂᏌᎳᏓᏅᎩ ᎠᏂᏁᎬ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᎡᎶᎯ ᏩᎦᏘᎿᏫᏛ ᎾᏍᎩᏉ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏴᏫ; ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᏰᎵ ᎬᏁᏍᏗ ᎦᏰᎵᏍᏗ ᏱᎩ.
\ft And they gave him audience unto this word, and then lifted up their voices, and said, Away with such a fellow from the earth: for it is not fit that he should live.

\ln Asiquono unelugvgi ale dunadaegvgi tsunanuwo ale gosdu unadesidohvgi;
\syll ᎠᏏᏉᏃ ᎤᏁᎷᎬᎩ ᎠᎴ ᏚᎾᏓᎡᎬᎩ ᏧᎾᏄᏬ ᎠᎴ ᎪᏍᏚ ᎤᎾᏕᏏᏙᎲᎩ;
\ft And as they cried out, and cast off their clothes, and threw dust into the air,

\ln Nugvwiyusv didatinidohi unetsvgi disoyv watsiyvdodiyi, ale atsilivnihv atsigoliyediyi, udulisgvgi udolehohisdiyi nvdigalisdodisgv nigav aneluhvsgv gvwatludisgvi.
\syll ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᏗᏓᏘᏂᏙᎯ ᎤᏁᏨᎩ ᏗᏐᏴ ᏩᏥᏴᏙᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏥᎵᎥᏂᎲ ᎠᏥᎪᎵᏰᏗᏱ, ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎬᎩ ᎤᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎠᏁᎷᎲᏍᎬ ᎬᏩᏡᏗᏍᎬᎢ.
\ft The chief captain commanded him to be brought into the castle, and bade that he should be examined by scourging; that he might know wherefore they cried so against him.

\ln Gvwalivnisdiyino gvwatinolv, Quola hia nuweselvgi nav gadogi asgohitsuqui ditinidohi; Yeliquosgo dikanawadvsdi nigvnv gayetsilivnisdi asgaya Alomi, usganvtsv tsudugotanvhi nigesvna yigi?
\syll ᎬᏩᎵᎥᏂᏍᏗᏱᏃ ᎬᏩᏘᏃᎸ, ᏉᎳ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ ᎾᎥ ᎦᏙᎩ ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏧᏈ ᏗᏘᏂᏙᎯ; ᏰᎵᏉᏍᎪ ᏗᎧᎾᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏂᎬᏅ ᎦᏰᏥᎵᎥᏂᏍᏗ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎠᎶᎻ, ᎤᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᏧᏚᎪᏔᏅᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏱᎩ?
\ft And as they bound him with thongs, Paul said unto the centurion that stood by, Is it lawful for you to scourge a man that is a Roman, and uncondemned?

\ln Asgohitsuquino ditinidohi, nasgi udvganv, wunonelvgi nugvwiyusv didatinidohi, hia winuwesvgi; Heyatahesdi hia tsinvtadvneli; hiayeno asgaya Alomi.
\syll ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏧᏈᏃ ᏗᏘᏂᏙᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏛᎦᏅ, ᏭᏃᏁᎸᎩ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᏗᏓᏘᏂᏙᎯ, ᎯᎠ ᏫᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎮᏯᏔᎮᏍᏗ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏅᏔᏛᏁᎵ; ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎠᎶᎻ.
\ft When the centurion heard that, he went and told the chief captain, saying, Take heed what thou doest: for this man is a Roman.

\ln Hnaquono nugvwiyusv didatinidohi ulutsv, hia nuweselvgi; Sginohvsi, Hilomisgo nihi?  Vv, udvnvgi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᏗᏓᏘᏂᏙᎯ ᎤᎷᏨ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏍᎩᏃᎲᏏ, ᎯᎶᎻᏍᎪ ᏂᎯ?  ᎥᎥ, ᎤᏛᏅᎩ.
\ft Then the chief captain came, and said unto him, Tell me, art thou a Roman? He said, Yea.

\ln Nugvwiyusvno didatinidohi hia nuwesvgi; utseti aquaguyvdv hia nasgi aquadatseligaya gesvi.  Quolano hia nuwesvgi; Ayvsgini aquadatseligaya aquadenvgi.
\syll ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒᏃ ᏗᏓᏘᏂᏙᎯ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎤᏤᏘ ᎠᏆᎫᏴᏛ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏆᏓᏤᎵᎦᏯ ᎨᏒᎢ.  ᏉᎳᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎠᏴᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏆᏓᏤᎵᎦᏯ ᎠᏆᏕᏅᎩ.
\ft And the chief captain answered, With a great sum obtained I this freedom. And Paul said, But I was free born.

\ln Hnaquono gilaquo iyvdv gvwadanvelvgi gvwagoliyesgi; nasquono nugvwiyvsv didatinidohi asgaihvgi, udolehosv Alomi gesvi, ale nvdagalisdodisgvgi nasgi ulvlvi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎩᎳᏉ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎬᏩᏓᏅᎡᎸᎩ ᎬᏩᎪᎵᏰᏍᎩ; ᎾᏍᏉᏃ ᏄᎬᏫᏴᏒ ᏗᏓᏘᏂᏙᎯ ᎠᏍᎦᎢᎲᎩ, ᎤᏙᎴᎰᏒ ᎠᎶᎻ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎸᎸᎢ.
\ft Then straightway they departed from him which should have examined him: and the chief captain also was afraid, after he knew that he was a Roman, and because he had bound him.

\ln Ugitsvdvno udulisgv iyusdi duyugodv udolehohisdiyi nvdagalisdodisgv Anitsusi gvwuhisdisgvi, ulvsvhvgi, ale unetsvgi nunigvwiyusv atsilvanelohi ale nigadv dinilawigi, unadatlisodiyi, ale utinolvgi Quola, aninvigvyitlv uwekanvgi.
\syll ᎤᎩᏨᏛᏃ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎬ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎤᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎬᏭᎯᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᎤᎸᏒᎲᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᏨᎩ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏗᏂᎳᏫᎩ, ᎤᎾᏓᏟᏐᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏘᏃᎸᎩ ᏉᎳ, ᎠᏂᏅᎢᎬᏱᏢ ᎤᏪᎧᏅᎩ.
\ft On the morrow, because he would have known the certainty wherefore he was accused of the Jews, he loosed him from his bands, and commanded the chief priests and all their council to appear, and brought Paul down, and set him before them.

\ln Quolano uyanvsvhi dukahnanv dinilawigi, hia nuwesvgi; Itsisgaya idadanvtli, gohi iga iyasdi, aquadanvdo aquasehehv dagilvwisdanehvgi nigav duyugodv gesv Unelanvhi agatahvi.
\syll ᏉᎳᏃ ᎤᏯᏅᏒᎯ ᏚᎧᎿᏅ ᏗᏂᎳᏫᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎢᏥᏍᎦᏯ ᎢᏓᏓᏅᏟ, ᎪᎯ ᎢᎦ ᎢᏯᏍᏗ, ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏙ ᎠᏆᏎᎮᎲ ᏓᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎩ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎦᏔᎲᎢ.
\ft And Paul, earnestly beholding the council, said, Men and brethren, I have lived in all good conscience before God until this day.

\ln Eninayano nugvwiyusv atsilvgelohi dunitselvgi gadogv nav anidonai aholi gvwanisdiyi.
\syll ᎡᏂᎾᏯᏃ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸᎨᎶᎯ ᏚᏂᏤᎸᎩ ᎦᏙᎬ ᎾᎥ ᎠᏂᏙᎾᎢ ᎠᎰᎵ ᎬᏩᏂᏍᏗᏱ.
\ft And the high priest Ananias commanded them that stood by him to smite him on the mouth.

\ln Quolano hia nuweselvgi; Unelanvhi datsvnili nihi, asoyi unegv igvnelvhi; tsolayeno geli disquegodanediyi nasgiwo dikahnawadvsdi nigawesgvi?  Tsigono ihinega vquvnisdiyi dikahnawadvsdi dohigatilega?
\syll ᏉᎳᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏓᏨᏂᎵ ᏂᎯ, ᎠᏐᏱ ᎤᏁᎬ ᎢᎬᏁᎸᎯ; ᏦᎳᏰᏃ ᎨᎵ ᏗᏍᏇᎪᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩᏬ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎬᎢ?  ᏥᎪᏃ ᎢᎯᏁᎦ ᎥᏋᏂᏍᏗᏱ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏙᎯᎦᏘᎴᎦ?
\ft Then said Paul unto him, God shall smite thee, thou whited wall: for sittest thou to judge me after the law, and commandest me to be smitten contrary to the law?

\ln Navno anidonai hia nuniwesvgi; tsigo gahisotlvdiha nugvwiyusv atsilvgelohi Unelanvhi utseliga?
\syll ᎾᎥᏃ ᎠᏂᏙᎾᎢ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᏥᎪ ᎦᎯᏐᏢᏗᎭ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸᎨᎶᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ?
\ft And they that stood by said, Revilest thou God's high priest?

\ln Quolano hia nuwesvgi; Idadanvtli, vtla yigelisge nugvwiyusv atsilvgelohi gesvi; hiayeno tsinigvnv tsigowela; "Tlesdi usonv yinetsehesdi tsaganelodi ditsatseli yvwi unatseliga."
\syll ᏉᎳᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎢᏓᏓᏅᏟ, ᎥᏝ ᏱᎨᎵᏍᎨ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸᎨᎶᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᏥᏂᎬᏅ ᏥᎪᏪᎳ; data is invalidᏞᏍᏗ ᎤᏐᏅ ᏱᏁᏤᎮᏍᏗ ᏣᎦᏁᎶᏗ ᏗᏣᏤᎵ ᏴᏫ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ.data is invalid
\ft Then said Paul, I wist not, brethren, that he was the high priest: for it is written, Thou shalt not speak evil of the ruler of thy people.

\ln Quolano udolehosv igadv Anisadusi gesvi, igadvno Aniqualisi, uwelunvgi degalawivi hia nuwesvgi; Itsisgaya idadanvtli, ayv Tsiqualisi, Aqualisi uwetsi; udugi gvdi gesv ale ayohusv dilehisodi gesv nvdigalisdodiha aqualiyilideha.
\syll ᏉᎳᏃ ᎤᏙᎴᎰᏒ ᎢᎦᏛ ᎠᏂᏌᏚᏏ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎢᎦᏛᏃ ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏ, ᎤᏪᎷᏅᎩ ᏕᎦᎳᏫᎥᎢ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎢᏥᏍᎦᏯ ᎢᏓᏓᏅᏟ, ᎠᏴ ᏥᏆᎵᏏ, ᎠᏆᎵᏏ ᎤᏪᏥ; ᎤᏚᎩ ᎬᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏲᎱᏒ ᏗᎴᎯᏐᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎠᏆᎵᏱᎵᏕᎭ.
\ft But when Paul perceived that the one part were Sadducees, and the other Pharisees, he cried out in the council, Men and brethren, I am a Pharisee, the son of a Pharisee: of the hope and resurrection of the dead I am called in question.

\ln Nasgino nuwesv, uniyotlohiselvgi Aniqualisi ale Anisadusi, unitsatino gesv tali nunadadvgi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏄᏪᏒ, ᎤᏂᏲᏠᎯᏎᎸᎩ ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏌᏚᏏ, ᎤᏂᏣᏘᏃ ᎨᏒ ᏔᎵ ᏄᎾᏓᏛᎩ.
\ft And when he had so said, there arose a dissension between the Pharisees and the Sadducees: and the multitude was divided.

\ln Anisadusiyeno hia naniwesegoi; Vtla dilehisodi yigi, vtla ale yeha dikahnawadidohi ale adanvdo; Aniqualisisgini itsula anohiyuhvsga.
\syll ᎠᏂᏌᏚᏏᏰᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏂᏪᏎᎪᎢ; ᎥᏝ ᏗᎴᎯᏐᏗ ᏱᎩ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᏰᎭ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ; ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᏧᎳ ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎦ.
\ft For the Sadducees say that there is no resurrection, neither angel, nor spirit: but the Pharisees confess both.

\ln Utsatino unelunvgi; dinowelisgino Aniqualisi unaligosv unaligohi dunalenv unadisvgi, hia nuniwesvgi; Vtla gohusdi uyo yotsiwadveha hia asgaya, iyusgini adanvdo ale dikahnawadidohi unetselvhi gesesdi, tlesdi Unelanvhi tsedatliyvelvgi.
\syll ᎤᏣᏘᏃ ᎤᏁᎷᏅᎩ; ᏗᏃᏪᎵᏍᎩᏃ ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏ ᎤᎾᎵᎪᏒ ᎤᎾᎵᎪᎯ ᏚᎾᎴᏅ ᎤᎾᏗᏒᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᎥᏝ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏲ ᏲᏥᏩᏛᎡᎭ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ, ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎤᏁᏤᎸᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏤᏓᏟᏴᎡᎸᎩ.
\ft And there arose a great cry: and the scribes that were of the Pharisees' part arose, and strove, saying, We find no evil in this man: but if a spirit or an angel hath spoken to him, let us not fight against God.

\ln Utsatino uniyotlohiselv, nugvwiyusv didatinidohi asgaihvi Quola yigvwedagalvvga elisgvi, dunetselvgi aniyawisgi unenvsdiyi ale widunasugalvdodiyi, ale uniyvtanihisdiyi disoyvi.
\syll ᎤᏣᏘᏃ ᎤᏂᏲᏠᎯᏎᎸ, ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᏗᏓᏘᏂᏙᎯ ᎠᏍᎦᎢᎲᎢ ᏉᎳ ᏱᎬᏪᏓᎦᎸᎥᎦ ᎡᎵᏍᎬᎢ, ᏚᏁᏤᎸᎩ ᎠᏂᏯᏫᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᏅᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᏫᏚᎾᏑᎦᎸᏙᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏴᏔᏂᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏗᏐᏴᎢ.
\ft And when there arose a great dissension, the chief captain, fearing lest Paul should have been pulled in pieces of them, commanded the soldiers to go down, and to take him by force from among them, and to bring him into the castle.
