\ft And as he reasoned of righteousness, temperance, and judgment to come Felix trembled, and answered, Go thy way for this time; when I have a convenient season, I will call for thee.

\ln Ale nasquo udugi uwasvgi Quola adelv tsunediyi, nasgino tsuyohisdiyi; nasgi iyusdi utli yanogiyu adanvsgvgi wayanisgvgi, ale alinohedisgvgi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎤᏩᏒᎩ ᏉᎳ ᎠᏕᎸ ᏧᏁᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏧᏲᎯᏍᏗᏱ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᏟ ᏯᏃᎩᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏍᎬᎩ ᏩᏯᏂᏍᎬᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎵᏃᎮᏗᏍᎬᎩ.
\ft He hoped also that money should have been given him of Paul, that he might loose him: wherefore he sent for him the oftener, and communed with him.

\ln Talino winudeiyvhv Quilisi uwenvi Quosiya Quesda uwetanvgi; Quilisino udulisgvi Anitsusi osdv tsudanvdadisdodiyi, uwekahiyvgi Quola agalvidv.
\syll ᏔᎵᏃ ᏫᏄᏕᎢᏴᎲ ᏈᎵᏏ ᎤᏪᏅᎢ ᏉᏏᏯ ᏇᏍᏓ ᎤᏪᏔᏅᎩ; ᏈᎵᏏᏃ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎬᎢ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏧᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎤᏪᎧᎯᏴᎩ ᏉᎳ ᎠᎦᎸᎢᏛ.
\ft But after two years Porcius Festus came into Felix' room: and Felix, willing to shew the Jews a pleasure, left Paul bound.

\ln Hnaquono Quesda nahna sgadugi atsigatidisdv ulutsv, tsoi winusvlv, Sisaliyi unigisvgi Tsilusilimi wulosvgi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏇᏍᏓ ᏀᎾ ᏍᎦᏚᎩ ᎠᏥᎦᏘᏗᏍᏛ ᎤᎷᏨ, ᏦᎢ ᏫᏄᏒᎸ, ᏏᏌᎵᏱ ᎤᏂᎩᏒᎩ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᏭᎶᏒᎩ.
\ft Now when Festus was come into the province, after three days he ascended from Caesarea to Jerusalem.

\ln Hnaquono nugvwiyusv atsilvgelohi ale unigvwiyuhi Anitsusi tsunatsega gvwanohehelvgi anuhisdisgv Quola ale gvwasdiyetanvgi,
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸᎨᎶᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᏧᎾᏤᎦ ᎬᏩᏃᎮᎮᎸᎩ ᎠᏄᎯᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᏉᎳ ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᏍᏗᏰᏔᏅᎩ,
\ft Then the high priest and the chief of the Jews informed him against Paul, and besought him,

\ln Gvwatayoselvgi tsudanvtehediyi nasgi anuhisdisgvi, nasgi udanvsdiyi Tsilusilimi agatinohisdiyi; wunihalugeyeno nvnohi unihisdiyi uniyelvsei.
\syll ᎬᏩᏔᏲᏎᎸᎩ ᏧᏓᏅᏖᎮᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏄᎯᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏓᏅᏍᏗᏱ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᎠᎦᏘᏃᎯᏍᏗᏱ; ᏭᏂᎭᎷᎨᏰᏃ ᏅᏃᎯ ᎤᏂᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏂᏰᎸᏎᎢ.
\ft And desired favour against him, that he would send for him to Jerusalem, laying wait in the way to kill him.

\ln Aseno Quesda unetsvgi Quola agatidisdiyi Sisaliyi, ale uwasv nigohilvnaquo nahna wulohisdiyi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᏇᏍᏓ ᎤᏁᏨᎩ ᏉᎳ ᎠᎦᏘᏗᏍᏗᏱ ᏏᏌᎵᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏂᎪᎯᎸᎾᏉ ᏀᎾ ᏭᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ.
\ft But Festus answered, that Paul should be kept at Caesarea, and that he himself would depart shortly thither.

\ln Hiano nuwesvgi; nasgi iyusdi nihi yitsadasuya yeli igetsadvnedi gesesdi idesvha wetsiyilidolvha nasgi na asgaya, iyuno usganvtsvhi gesesdi.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏂᎯ ᏱᏣᏓᏑᏯ ᏰᎵ ᎢᎨᏣᏛᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎢᏕᏒᎭ ᏪᏥᏱᎵᏙᎸᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎤᏍᎦᏅᏨᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft Let them therefore, said he, which among you are able, go down with me, and accuse this man, if there be any wickedness in him.

\ln Asgohino uditlvsdodi nusvlv duweladidolv, Sisaliyi wulosvgi; ugitsvdvno digugododiyi gasgilv uwolvi unetsvgi Quola watsiyanvdiyi.
\syll ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏃ ᎤᏗᏢᏍᏙᏗ ᏄᏒᎸ ᏚᏪᎳᏗᏙᎸ, ᏏᏌᎵᏱ ᏭᎶᏒᎩ; ᎤᎩᏨᏛᏃ ᏗᎫᎪᏙᏗᏱ ᎦᏍᎩᎸ ᎤᏬᎸᎢ ᎤᏁᏨᎩ ᏉᎳ ᏩᏥᏯᏅᏗᏱ.
\ft And when he had tarried among them more than ten days, he went down unto Caesarea; and the next day sitting on the judgment seat commanded Paul to be brought.

\ln Ulutsvno, Anitsusi Tsilusilimi nvdayulosvhi gvwaduwidv unalenvnvgi, ale utsadvgi ale gagedv anuhisdisgvgi Quola, nasgi udohiyusv gvnigesv igvwanvnedi nigesvna gesvgi.
\syll ᎤᎷᏨᏃ, ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᏅᏓᏳᎶᏒᎯ ᎬᏩᏚᏫᏛ ᎤᎾᎴᏅᏅᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏣᏛᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎦᎨᏛ ᎠᏄᎯᏍᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᏉᎳ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᏒ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᎬᏩᏅᏁᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎩ.
\ft And when he was come, the Jews which came down from Jerusalem stood round about, and laid many and grievous complaints against Paul, which they could not prove.

\ln Uwasvno alisdelisgv unetsvgi hia nuwesvgi; Vtla usdiunv agisganvtsvhi yigi Anitsusi tsunikahnawadvsdi unihvi, vtla ale udvnvdigalawiisdiyi tsisganvtselvhi yigi, vtla ale Sisa gohusdi tsisganvtselvhi yigi.
\syll ᎤᏩᏒᏃ ᎠᎵᏍᏕᎵᏍᎬ ᎤᏁᏨᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎥᏝ ᎤᏍᏗᎤᏅ ᎠᎩᏍᎦᏅᏨᎯ ᏱᎩ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᏧᏂᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎤᏂᎲᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏛᏅᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᏥᏍᎦᏅᏤᎸᎯ ᏱᎩ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᏏᏌ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏥᏍᎦᏅᏤᎸᎯ ᏱᎩ.
\ft While he answered for himself, Neither against the law of the Jews, neither against the temple, nor yet against Caesar, have I offended any thing at all.

\ln Aseno Quesda udulisgvi Anitsusi osdv tsudanvdadisdodiyi nvdayulisdotanv, unetselvgi Quola hia nuweselvgi; Tsadulisgo Tsilusilimi tsenvsdiyi ale nahna hia nasgi digvyugodanediyi?
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᏇᏍᏓ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎬᎢ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏧᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏅᏓᏳᎵᏍᏙᏔᏅ, ᎤᏁᏤᎸᎩ ᏉᎳ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏣᏚᎵᏍᎪ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᏤᏅᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᏀᎾ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎬᏳᎪᏓᏁᏗᏱ?
\ft But Festus, willing to do the Jews a pleasure, answered Paul, and said, Wilt thou go up to Jerusalem, and there be judged of these things before me?

\ln Quolano hia nuwesvgi; Sisa uwesgilv digugododiyi tsidoga, nahna aqualiyeilidediyi.  Anitsusi vtla gohusdi gatsisganvtselvhi yigi, nasgi osiyu nihi tsigataha.
\syll ᏉᎳᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᏏᏌ ᎤᏪᏍᎩᎸ ᏗᎫᎪᏙᏗᏱ ᏥᏙᎦ, ᏀᎾ ᎠᏆᎵᏰᎢᎵᏕᏗᏱ.  ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎥᏝ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎦᏥᏍᎦᏅᏤᎸᎯ ᏱᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏏᏳ ᏂᎯ ᏥᎦᏔᎭ.
\ft Then said Paul, I stand at Caesar's judgment seat, where I ought to be judged: to the Jews have I done no wrong, as thou very well knowest.

\ln Iyuyeno tsisgana yigi, ale gvgiyohuhisdi igai agisganvtsvhi yigi, vtla yidogvquatlvwisi agiyohuhisdiyi; iyusgini nudohiyusvna yigi hia nasgi tsigvquehisdiha, vtla gilo yeli digvwaniyohisedi yigi ayv.  Sisoi witsivsda.
\syll ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᏥᏍᎦᎾ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᎩᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎠᎩᏍᎦᏅᏨᎯ ᏱᎩ, ᎥᏝ ᏱᏙᎬᏆᏢᏫᏏ ᎠᎩᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗᏱ; ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᏄᏙᎯᏳᏒᎾ ᏱᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᎬᏇᎯᏍᏗᎭ, ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᏰᎵ ᏗᎬᏩᏂᏲᎯᏎᏗ ᏱᎩ ᎠᏴ.  ᏏᏐᎢ ᏫᏥᎥᏍᏓ.
\ft For if I be an offender, or have committed any thing worthy of death, I refuse not to die: but if there be none of these things whereof these accuse me, no man may deliver me unto them. I appeal unto Caesar.

\ln Hnaquono Quesda dulinohetanv dinilawigi, hia nuwesvgi; Sisoitsu wihvsda?  Sisoi tesi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏇᏍᏓ ᏚᎵᏃᎮᏔᏅ ᏗᏂᎳᏫᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᏏᏐᎢᏧ ᏫᎲᏍᏓ?  ᏏᏐᎢ ᏖᏏ.
\ft Then Festus, when he had conferred with the council, answered, Hast thou appealed unto Caesar? unto Caesar shalt thou go.

\ln Ilvsgino winusvlv Sisaliyi unilutsvgi ugvwiyuhi Egiliqui ale Quanisi, uniyolililvgi Quesda.
\syll ᎢᎸᏍᎩᏃ ᏫᏄᏒᎸ ᏏᏌᎵᏱ ᎤᏂᎷᏨᎩ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎡᎩᎵᏈ ᎠᎴ ᏆᏂᏏ, ᎤᏂᏲᎵᎵᎸᎩ ᏇᏍᏓ.
\ft And after certain days king Agrippa and Bernice came unto Caesarea to salute Festus.

\ln Ilvsgino nuwohitsv nahna unedolv, Quesda unohehelvgi ugvwiyuhi nusdv Quola uliyilidehvi, hia nuwesvgi; Gilo iyusdi asgaya ayvgi atsikaha Quilisi uwekahiyvhi.
\syll ᎢᎸᏍᎩᏃ ᏄᏬᎯᏨ ᏀᎾ ᎤᏁᏙᎸ, ᏇᏍᏓ ᎤᏃᎮᎮᎸᎩ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏉᎳ ᎤᎵᏱᎵᏕᎲᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎠᏴᎩ ᎠᏥᎧᎭ ᏈᎵᏏ ᎤᏪᎧᎯᏴᎯ.
\ft And when they had been there many days, Festus declared Paul's cause unto the king, saying, There is a certain man left in bonds by Felix:

\ln Nasgi gvginohehelvgi nunigvwiyusv atsilvanelohi ale dinilawigi Anitsusi tsunatseliga, Tsilusilimi tsiwigedohvgi, anitayohihvgi usganvtsv tsudugododiyi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᎩᏃᎮᎮᎸᎩ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏂᎳᏫᎩ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᏧᎾᏤᎵᎦ, ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᏥᏫᎨᏙᎲᎩ, ᎠᏂᏔᏲᎯᎲᎩ ᎤᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᏧᏚᎪᏙᏗᏱ.
\ft About whom, when I was at Jerusalem, the chief priests and the elders of the Jews informed me, desiring to have judgment against him.

\ln Nasgino hia nigatsiweselvgi; Anilomi vtla nasgi yinunvnv, nasgi tsuniyohisdiyi gilo uyohuhisdiyi, gvni aguisdisgi gvwuhisdisgi dunakadv tsugohvhi tsigeso ale agalisgolvdanelvhi tsigeso uwasv alisdelisgv uneisdiyi unohediyi usganvtsv aguisdisgv ugvwali.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏥᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎠᏂᎶᎻ ᎥᏝ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᏄᏅᏅ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏂᏲᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗᏱ, ᎬᏂ ᎠᎫᎢᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᎬᏭᎯᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᏚᎾᎧᏛ ᏧᎪᎲᎯ ᏥᎨᏐ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎦᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎨᏐ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎠᎵᏍᏕᎵᏍᎬ ᎤᏁᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏃᎮᏗᏱ ᎤᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᎠᎫᎢᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ.
\ft To whom I answered, It is not the manner of the Romans to deliver any man to die, before that he which is accused have the accusers face to face, and have licence to answer for himself concerning the crime laid against him.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi ani unilutsilv, nulisdvquo ugitsvdv digugododiyi gasgilv aginvgi, ale aginetsvgi nasgi asgaya watsiyanvdiyi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏂ ᎤᏂᎷᏥᎸ, ᏄᎵᏍᏛᏉ ᎤᎩᏨᏛ ᏗᎫᎪᏙᏗᏱ ᎦᏍᎩᎸ ᎠᎩᏅᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎩᏁᏨᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᏩᏥᏯᏅᏗᏱ.
\ft Therefore, when they were come hither, without any delay on the morrow I sat on the judgment seat, and commanded the man to be brought forth.

\ln Nasgi gvwuhisdisgi dunalenv, vtla gohusdi yuninanugowise nasgi yaninanugowa aquelisv nasgi anuhisdisgvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏭᎯᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᏚᎾᎴᏅ, ᎥᏝ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏳᏂᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏯᏂᎾᏄᎪᏩ ᎠᏇᎵᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏄᎯᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ.
\ft Against whom when the accusers stood up, they brought none accusation of such things as I supposed:

\ln Anuhisdisgvsgini gohusdiquo usdi nasgi kanohedi gesv unvsvquo unatselidv Unelanvhi tsunikahnawadvsdi gesvi, ale gilo iyusdi Tsisa, uyohusvhi, nasgi eha adisge geli Quola.
\syll ᎠᏄᎯᏍᏗᏍᎬᏍᎩᏂ ᎪᎱᏍᏗᏉ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎧᏃᎮᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏅᏒᏉ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᏂᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏥᏌ, ᎤᏲᎱᏒᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᎭ ᎠᏗᏍᎨ ᎨᎵ ᏉᎳ.
\ft But had certain questions against him of their own superstition, and of one Jesus, which was dead, whom Paul affirmed to be alive.

\ln Ale nasgi iyusdi kanohedv gesv daquatlvwisehvi nvdayulisdotanvgi, hia nvtsiweselvgi [Quola]; tsadulisgo Tsilusilimi tsenvsdiyi nahnano hia nasgi nigadv tsetsugodanediyi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎨᏒ ᏓᏆᏢᏫᏎᎲᎢ ᏅᏓᏳᎵᏍᏙᏔᏅᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏅᏥᏪᏎᎸᎩ ᏉᎳdata is invalid; ᏣᏚᎵᏍᎪ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᏤᏅᏍᏗᏱ ᏀᎾᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏤᏧᎪᏓᏁᏗᏱ.
\ft And because I doubted of such manner of questions, I asked him whether he would go to Jerusalem, and there be judged of these matters.

\ln Aseno Quola unetsv atsigatidisdiyi, ale Ogasda tsuwugodanediyi, aginetsvgi atsigatidisdiyi, gvni gvquadanvsdi yinulistanv, Sisoi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᏉᎳ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎠᏥᎦᏘᏗᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎣᎦᏍᏓ ᏧᏭᎪᏓᏁᏗᏱ, ᎠᎩᏁᏨᎩ ᎠᏥᎦᏘᏗᏍᏗᏱ, ᎬᏂ ᎬᏆᏓᏅᏍᏗ ᏱᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ, ᏏᏐᎢ.
\ft But when Paul had appealed to be reserved unto the hearing of Augustus, I commanded him to be kept till I might send him to Caesar.

\ln Hnaquono Egiliqui hia nuweselvgi Quesda; ayv nasquo aquvsv aquaduliha tsiyadvganediyi nasgi asgaya.  Hiano nuwesvgi; ugitsvnv tiyadvganeli.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎡᎩᎵᏈ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ ᏇᏍᏓ; ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏋᏒ ᎠᏆᏚᎵᎭ ᏥᏯᏛᎦᏁᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ.  ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎤᎩᏨᏅ ᏘᏯᏛᎦᏁᎵ.
\ft Then Agrippa said unto Festus, I would also hear the man myself. To morrow, said he, thou shalt hear him.

\ln Howano ugitsvdv utsati unatsanvhi unilutsv Egiliqui ale Quanisi, nasgino didayilidasdiyi uniyvlv, ale nunigvwiyusv dinadatinidohi, ale getsilvquodi nahna gaduhv anehi, Quesda unetsv, Quola watsiyanvhvgi.
\syll ᎰᏩᏃ ᎤᎩᏨᏛ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᎾᏣᏅᎯ ᎤᏂᎷᏨ ᎡᎩᎵᏈ ᎠᎴ ᏆᏂᏏ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏗᏓᏱᎵᏓᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏂᏴᎸ, ᎠᎴ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᏗᎾᏓᏘᏂᏙᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎨᏥᎸᏉᏗ ᏀᎾ ᎦᏚᎲ ᎠᏁᎯ, ᏇᏍᏓ ᎤᏁᏨ, ᏉᎳ ᏩᏥᏯᏅᎲᎩ.
\ft And on the morrow, when Agrippa was come, and Bernice, with great pomp, and was entered into the place of hearing, with the chief captains, and principal men of the city, at Festus' commandment Paul was brought forth.

\ln Quesdano hia nuwesvgi; tsagvwiyuhi Egiliqui, ale nasquo nigadv itsisgaya ani tsidina; etsigowadiha hia asgaya, nasgi; anuhisdisgv nigadv unitsati Anitsusi tsigvgilutselvgi Tsilusilimi, ale nasquo ani, hia tsinaniwesgvgi; vtla osiyu yigagi asiquo yigvnv.
\syll ᏇᏍᏓᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎡᎩᎵᏈ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎢᏥᏍᎦᏯ ᎠᏂ ᏥᏗᎾ; ᎡᏥᎪᏩᏗᎭ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ, ᎾᏍᎩ; ᎠᏄᎯᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᏥᎬᎩᎷᏤᎸᎩ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏂ, ᎯᎠ ᏥᎾᏂᏪᏍᎬᎩ; ᎥᏝ ᎣᏏᏳ ᏱᎦᎩ ᎠᏏᏉ ᏱᎬᏅ.
\ft And Festus said, King Agrippa, and all men which are here present with us, ye see this man, about whom all the multitude of the Jews have dealt with me, both at Jerusalem, and also here, crying that he ought not to live any longer.

\ln Aquadolehosvno nusganvtsvna gesv yeli gvwayohuhisdi gesvi, ale uwasv Ogasdoi wuhvstanv, daquegotanv agatinvsdiyi.
\syll ᎠᏆᏙᎴᎰᏒᏃ ᏄᏍᎦᏅᏨᎾ ᎨᏒ ᏰᎵ ᎬᏩᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎣᎦᏍᏙᎢ ᏭᎲᏍᏔᏅ, ᏓᏇᎪᏔᏅ ᎠᎦᏘᏅᏍᏗᏱ.
\ft But when I found that he had committed nothing worthy of death, and that he himself hath appealed to Augustus, I have determined to send him.

\ln Nasgi tsinohesgvi, vtla gohusdi usquanigodi yagiha gatsiyowelanedi ugvwiyuhi; nasgi iyusdi itsvyatinohisi, ale nihi ho ugvwiyuha gvwatinohisi, tsagvwiyuhi Egiliqui, nasgino edigoliyevhi gesesdi, gohusdi yeli gvquowelodi gesesdi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏃᎮᏍᎬᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᏯᎩᎭ ᎦᏥᏲᏪᎳᏁᏗ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏨᏯᏘᏃᎯᏏ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎯ Ꮀ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎭ ᎬᏩᏘᏃᎯᏏ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎡᎩᎵᏈ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎡᏗᎪᎵᏰᎥᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏰᎵ ᎬᏉᏪᎶᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft Of whom I have no certain thing to write unto my lord. Wherefore I have brought him forth before you, and specially before thee, O king Agrippa, that, after examination had, I might have somewhat to write.

\ln Vtlayeno yidogvwayugodi gelia, iyuno yigadanvsga agatinvsdiyi ayvgi, nagineistanvnano yigi nusdv aguisdisgvi.
\syll ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᏱᏙᎬᏩᏳᎪᏗ ᎨᎵᎠ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᏱᎦᏓᏅᏍᎦ ᎠᎦᏘᏅᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᏴᎩ, ᎾᎩᏁᎢᏍᏔᏅᎾᏃ ᏱᎩ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎠᎫᎢᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ.
\ft For it seemeth to me unreasonable to send a prisoner, and not withal to signify the crimes laid against him.

\ln Hnaquono Egiliqui hia nuweselvgi Quola; Tsvsv halisdelisgv getsaneisdi nigalisda.  Hnaquono Quola udoyanvhidv uwasv alisdelisgv uwonisvgi, hia nuwesvgi;
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎡᎩᎵᏈ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ ᏉᎳ; ᏨᏒ ᎭᎵᏍᏕᎵᏍᎬ ᎨᏣᏁᎢᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏓ.  ᎿᏉᏃ ᏉᎳ ᎤᏙᏯᏅᎯᏛ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎠᎵᏍᏕᎵᏍᎬ ᎤᏬᏂᏒᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ;
\ft Then Agrippa said unto Paul, Thou art permitted to speak for thyself. Then Paul stretched forth the hand, and answered for himself:

\ln Tsagvwiyuhi Egiliquo, galieliga gohi iga tsigi higatahv galisdelisgv tsvdatsineistani nigav gvquehisdisgvi Anitsusi.
\syll ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎡᎩᎵᏉ, ᎦᎵᎡᎵᎦ ᎪᎯ ᎢᎦ ᏥᎩ ᎯᎦᏔᎲ ᎦᎵᏍᏕᎵᏍᎬ ᏨᏓᏥᏁᎢᏍᏔᏂ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎬᏇᎯᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ.
\ft I think myself happy, king Agrippa, because I shall answer for myself this day before thee touching all the things whereof I am accused of the Jews:

\ln Ho ugvwiyuha nvdigalisdodiha higatahiyu tsigi nigadv dikahnawadvsdi ale kanohedi gesv Anitsusi tsiduneha.  Nasgino iyusdi gvtayoseha niditsayawegvna squadvganediyi.
\syll Ꮀ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎭ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎯᎦᏔᎯᏳ ᏥᎩ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎧᏃᎮᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᏥᏚᏁᎭ.  ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎬᏔᏲᏎᎭ ᏂᏗᏣᏯᏪᎬᎾ ᏍᏆᏛᎦᏁᏗᏱ.
\ft Especially because I know thee to be expert in all customs and questions which are among the Jews: wherefore I beseech thee to hear me patiently.

\ln Nusdv aqualenidolv tsiwinutsa nvtsulistanv nvdagvwadalenvdv, nasgi igvyiyi gatsiyeladidolvgi diquatseli yvwi Tsilusilimi, nigadv Anitsusi anigataha,
\syll ᏄᏍᏛ ᎠᏆᎴᏂᏙᎸ ᏥᏫᏄᏣ ᏅᏧᎵᏍᏔᏅ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏓᎴᏅᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎬᏱᏱ ᎦᏥᏰᎳᏗᏙᎸᎩ ᏗᏆᏤᎵ ᏴᏫ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ, ᏂᎦᏛ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎭ,
\ft My manner of life from my youth, which was at the first among mine own nation at Jerusalem, know all the Jews;

\ln Nasgi gvgigatahvgi didalenisgv nvdagvwadalenvdv, iyuno yuninohelv, anigatahiyuyeno Aqualisi ulenidasdi aqualenidolvi, detsisdawadisv unadatselidv unaligohi wunigudv dinikahnawadegi ogatseli Unelanvhi tsotsikahnawadvsdi gesvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᎩᎦᏔᎲᎩ ᏗᏓᎴᏂᏍᎬ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏓᎴᏅᏛ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᏳᏂᏃᎮᎸ, ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎯᏳᏰᏃ ᎠᏆᎵᏏ ᎤᎴᏂᏓᏍᏗ ᎠᏆᎴᏂᏙᎸᎢ, ᏕᏥᏍᏓᏩᏗᏒ ᎤᎾᏓᏤᎵᏛ ᎤᎾᎵᎪᎯ ᏭᏂᎫᏛ ᏗᏂᎧᎿᏩᏕᎩ ᎣᎦᏤᎵ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏦᏥᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Which knew me from the beginning, if they would testify, that after the most straitest sect of our religion I lived a Pharisee.

\ln Gohino itsidoga igvgiyilidoha, agisdvdiha udugi gvdi gesv nasgi Unelanvhi tsiduduisdanele tsogigayvligei;
\syll ᎪᎯᏃ ᎢᏥᏙᎦ ᎢᎬᎩᏱᎵᏙᎭ, ᎠᎩᏍᏛᏗᎭ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎬᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏥᏚᏚᎢᏍᏓᏁᎴ ᏦᎩᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ;
\ft And now I stand and am judged for the hope of the promise made of God unto our fathers:

\ln Nasgi getsiduisdanelv unaliyilohisdiyi udugi unvha taladu notsilasdalvi, ulinigidiyu tsidanikahnawadi Unelanvhi digvwagitsvdi.  Nasgi udugi gvdi gesv nvdigalisdodiha, tsagvwiyuhi Egiliqui, Anitsusi gvquehisdiha.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᏥᏚᎢᏍᏓᏁᎸ ᎤᎾᎵᏱᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎤᏅᎭ ᏔᎳᏚ ᏃᏥᎳᏍᏓᎸᎢ, ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ ᏥᏓᏂᎧᎿᏩᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏗᎬᏩᎩᏨᏗ.  ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎬᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎡᎩᎵᏈ, ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎬᏇᎯᏍᏗᎭ.
\ft Unto which promise our twelve tribes, instantly serving God day and night, hope to come. For which hope's sake, king Agrippa, I am accused of the Jews.

\ln Gadono gagohiyudi nigesvna itsiyelvso Unelanvhi tsuledodi gesv tsuniyohusvhi?
\syll ᎦᏙᏃ ᎦᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᏥᏰᎸᏐ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᎴᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯ?
\ft Why should it be thought a thing incredible with you, that God should raise the dead?

\ln Ayv udohiyuhi hia nigelisgvgi; duyugodv yinigadvneha utsati gohusdi yidagilvwisdane gatludisgv deudov Tsisa Naseliti tsehvgi.
\syll ᎠᏴ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎨᎵᏍᎬᎩ; ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᏱᏂᎦᏛᏁᎭ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏱᏓᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁ ᎦᏡᏗᏍᎬ ᏕᎤᏙᎥ ᏥᏌ ᎾᏎᎵᏘ ᏤᎲᎩ.
\ft I verily thought with myself, that I ought to do many things contrary to the name of Jesus of Nazareth.

\ln Howano nasgi naquadvnelvgi Tsilusilimi; ale unitsadvgi unadanvti detsisdunvgi didasdudiyi, gvginetselvhi gesvgi nunigvwiyusv atsilvanelohi; degetsilugano tsinegvgi gatsiyatludisgvi.
\syll ᎰᏩᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏆᏛᏁᎸᎩ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏣᏛᎩ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ ᏕᏥᏍᏚᏅᎩ ᏗᏓᏍᏚᏗᏱ, ᎬᎩᏁᏤᎸᎯ ᎨᏒᎩ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸᎠᏁᎶᎯ; ᏕᎨᏥᎷᎦᏃ ᏥᏁᎬᎩ ᎦᏥᏯᏡᏗᏍᎬᎢ.
\ft Which thing I also did in Jerusalem: and many of the saints did I shut up in prison, having received authority from the chief priests; and when they were put to death, I gave my voice against them.

\ln Ale yanogiyu uyo nigatsiyvnehv digalawiisdiyi degesadisvi, ale unisotlvisdodiyi nigatsiyvnehvgi; utsatanvhino gatsiniquatihv nadagalisdodisgvgi uyo nigatsiyvnehv nvwadale dodigaduhv wigatsigehoihvgi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏯᏃᎩᏳ ᎤᏲ ᏂᎦᏥᏴᏁᎲ ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᏕᎨᏌᏗᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏐᏢᎢᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏂᎦᏥᏴᏁᎲᎩ; ᎤᏣᏔᏅᎯᏃ ᎦᏥᏂᏆᏘᎲ ᎾᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᎤᏲ ᏂᎦᏥᏴᏁᎲ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᏙᏗᎦᏚᎲ ᏫᎦᏥᎨᎰᎢᎲᎩ.
\ft And I punished them oft in every synagogue, and compelled them to blaspheme; and being exceedingly mad against them, I persecuted them even unto strange cities.

\ln Demasgano witsigadvi, nunigvwiyusv atsilvanelohi gvginetselvi,
\syll ᏕᎹᏍᎦᏃ ᏫᏥᎦᏛᎢ, ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᎬᎩᏁᏤᎸᎢ,
\ft Whereupon as I went to Damascus with authority and commission from the chief priests,

\ln Tsagvwiyuhi, gaisv iga ayeli agigohvgi igagadvi, galvladi nvdayulosvhi, nasgi usgosvi utli gesvgi esgaquo nvdo, daquaduwistanvgi ayv ale nasquo otsehi.
\syll ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎦᎢᏒ ᎢᎦ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎠᎩᎪᎲᎩ ᎢᎦᎦᏛᎢ, ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏅᏓᏳᎶᏒᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏍᎪᏒᎢ ᎤᏟ ᎨᏒᎩ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᏅᏙ, ᏓᏆᏚᏫᏍᏔᏅᎩ ᎠᏴ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎣᏤᎯ.
\ft At midday, O king, I saw in the way a light from heaven, above the brightness of the sun, shining round about me and them which journeyed with me.

\ln Nigadvno eladi doginvtsv, kanegv aquadvganvgi aginetsehvgi, Anitsusi uniwonihisdi gvdisgvgi; hia nigawesgvgi Sola, Sola, gadono uyo nisquvneha?  Udeyadodiyu ditsahvtesdiyi digosdaya.
\syll ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᎡᎳᏗ ᏙᎩᏅᏨ, ᎧᏁᎬ ᎠᏆᏛᎦᏅᎩ ᎠᎩᏁᏤᎲᎩ, ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎤᏂᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᎬᏗᏍᎬᎩ; ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎬᎩ ᏐᎳ, ᏐᎳ, ᎦᏙᏃ ᎤᏲ ᏂᏍᏋᏁᎭ?  ᎤᏕᏯᏙᏗᏳ ᏗᏣᎲᏖᏍᏗᏱ ᏗᎪᏍᏓᏯ.
\ft And when we were all fallen to the earth, I heard a voice speaking unto me, and saying in the Hebrew tongue, Saul, Saul, why persecutest thou me? it is hard for thee to kick against the pricks.

\ln Hiano nagiwesvgi; Gago nihi, Tsagvwiyuhi?  Hiano nuwesvgi; Asi Tsisa nasgi uyo tsiniyvneha.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᎾᎩᏪᏒᎩ; ᎦᎪ ᏂᎯ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ?  ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎠᏏ ᏥᏌ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏲ ᏥᏂᏴᏁᎭ.
\ft And I said, Who art thou, Lord? And he said, I am Jesus whom thou persecutest.

\ln Aseno talehvga, ale halehvga, hiayeno nvdigalisdoteha gvnigesv tsinigvyadvnisi, halitsidohvsgi igvyvnediyi ale hinohesgi hia nasgi tsigowadv, ale asi gvnanugowisedi tsigi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᏔᎴᎲᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᎭᎴᎲᎦ, ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏖᎭ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏥᏂᎬᏯᏛᏂᏏ, ᎭᎵᏥᏙᎲᏍᎩ ᎢᎬᏴᏁᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᎯᏃᎮᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᎪᏩᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏏ ᎬᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᏗ ᏥᎩ.
\ft But rise, and stand upon thy feet: for I have appeared unto thee for this purpose, to make thee a minister and a witness both of these things which thou hast seen, and of those things in the which I will appear unto thee;

\ln Gvwadalesgesdi getsatludisgv hia yvwi ale tsunadalenvdv yvwi, nasgi dinehv hnaquo gvnvli,
\syll ᎬᏩᏓᎴᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎨᏣᏡᏗᏍᎬ ᎯᎠ ᏴᏫ ᎠᎴ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏁᎲ ᎿᏉ ᎬᏅᎵ,
\ft Delivering thee from the people, and from the Gentiles, unto whom now I send thee,

\ln Tisduiediyi dinigadoli, ale ulisigv nunadvnv tigolvsdiyi igagadv iditlv witigatahvsdiyi, ale Sedani utseligohi nunadvnv tigolvsdiyi dotigatahvsdiyi Unelanvhi iditlv witigatahvsdodiyi; nasgi digagetsinediyi unisganvtsvi, ale gvwaniwadvdi iyulisdodiyi unatseliga iyulisdodi gesv getsinvgalvdv nvdigalisdodisgv vquohiyudi gesvi.
\syll ᏘᏍᏚᎢᎡᏗᏱ ᏗᏂᎦᏙᎵ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏏᎬ ᏄᎾᏛᏅ ᏘᎪᎸᏍᏗᏱ ᎢᎦᎦᏛ ᎢᏗᏢ ᏫᏘᎦᏔᎲᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏎᏓᏂ ᎤᏤᎵᎪᎯ ᏄᎾᏛᏅ ᏘᎪᎸᏍᏗᏱ ᏙᏘᎦᏔᎲᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᏗᏢ ᏫᏘᎦᏔᎲᏍᏙᏗᏱ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎦᎨᏥᏁᏗᏱ ᎤᏂᏍᎦᏅᏨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᏂᏩᏛᏗ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎨᏥᏅᎦᎸᏛ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬ ᎥᏉᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft To open their eyes, and to turn them from darkness to light, and from the power of Satan unto God, that they may receive forgiveness of sins, and inheritance among them which are sanctified by faith that is in me.

\ln Nasgi iyusidi, tsagvwiyuhi Egiliqui, vtla naquohiyunvna yigese galvladi nvdayulosvhi agigohvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏏᏗ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎡᎩᎵᏈ, ᎥᏝ ᎾᏉᎯᏳᏅᎾ ᏱᎨᏎ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏅᏓᏳᎶᏒᎯ ᎠᎩᎪᎲᎢ.
\ft Whereupon, O king Agrippa, I was not disobedient unto the heavenly vision:

\ln Gatsinonelvgiyeno igvyi Demasga anehi, ale tsilusilimi anehi, ale nigvnadv Tsudiyi ale nasquo tsunadalenvdv yvwi, nasgi tsuninetliyvsdiyi dunadanvdvi, ale Unelanvhi iditlv wunagatahvsdodiyi, ale tsunilvwisdanediyi adolehohisdodi gesv duninetliyvsv dunadanvdvi.
\syll ᎦᏥᏃᏁᎸᎩᏰᏃ ᎢᎬᏱ ᏕᎹᏍᎦ ᎠᏁᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᎠᏁᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎬᎾᏛ ᏧᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏂᏁᏟᏴᏍᏗᏱ ᏚᎾᏓᏅᏛᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᏗᏢ ᏭᎾᎦᏔᎲᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏚᏂᏁᏟᏴᏒ ᏚᎾᏓᏅᏛᎢ.
\ft But shewed first unto them of Damascus, and at Jerusalem, and throughout all the coasts of Judaea, and then to the Gentiles, that they should repent and turn to God, and do works meet for repentance.

\ln Nasgi nvdayulisdotanvgi Anitsusi gvginiyvhvgi udvnv digalawiisdiyi, gvgihisdiyi uniyelvsvgi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏓᏳᎵᏍᏙᏔᏅᎩ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎬᎩᏂᏴᎲᎩ ᎤᏛᏅ ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᎬᎩᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏂᏰᎸᏒᎩ.
\ft For these causes the Jews caught me in the temple, and went about to kill me.

\ln Unelanvhino agisdelvhvi nvdigalisdodiha asi galenidoha gohi iga tsigi, gvnigesv nigatsiyvneha nigetsilvquodvna ale nasquo getsilvquodi, gohusdi nitsinohesgvna na uwasv anadolehosgi ale Mosi unanugoisdi unadvnvhi tsigi;
\syll ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏃ ᎠᎩᏍᏕᎸᎲᎢ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎠᏏ ᎦᎴᏂᏙᎭ ᎪᎯ ᎢᎦ ᏥᎩ, ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᎦᏥᏴᏁᎭ ᏂᎨᏥᎸᏉᏛᎾ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎨᏥᎸᏉᏗ, ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏂᏥᏃᎮᏍᎬᎾ Ꮎ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎼᏏ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᎢᏍᏗ ᎤᎾᏛᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ;
\ft Having therefore obtained help of God, I continue unto this day, witnessing both to small and great, saying none other things than those which the prophets and Moses did say should come:

\ln Nasgi Galonedv ugiliyoisdiyi, ale nasgi igvyi uyohusv tsulehisodiyi, ale igagati tsunanugowisediyi hia yvwi ale tsunadalenvdv yvwi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎬᏱ ᎤᏲᎱᏒ ᏧᎴᎯᏐᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᎦᎦᏘ ᏧᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᏗᏱ ᎯᎠ ᏴᏫ ᎠᎴ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ.
\ft That Christ should suffer, and that he should be the first that should rise from the dead, and should shew light unto the people, and to the Gentiles.

\ln Asiquono nasgi nigawesgvgi, uwasv alisdelisgvi, Quesda hia asdaya nuwesvgi; tsalvnotiha Quola, utsati goweli tisinasiyu gesv nasgi tsalvnododiha.
\syll ᎠᏏᏉᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎬᎩ, ᎤᏩᏒ ᎠᎵᏍᏕᎵᏍᎬᎢ, ᏇᏍᏓ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏍᏓᏯ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᏣᎸᏃᏘᎭ ᏉᎳ, ᎤᏣᏘ ᎪᏪᎵ ᏘᏏᎾᏏᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏣᎸᏃᏙᏗᎭ.
\ft And as he thus spake for himself, Festus said with a loud voice, Paul, thou art beside thyself; much learning doth make thee mad.

\ln Aseno hia nuwesvgi; vtla yagilvnotiha, hosdv Quesda, tsinegaquosgini duyugodv gesvi ale nolvnotisgvna kaneisdi gesvi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎥᏝ ᏯᎩᎸᏃᏘᎭ, ᎰᏍᏛ ᏇᏍᏓ, ᏥᏁᎦᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ ᎠᎴ ᏃᎸᏃᏘᏍᎬᎾ ᎧᏁᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft But he said, I am not mad, most noble Festus; but speak forth the words of truth and soberness.

\ln Ugvwiyuhiyeno nasgi hia agataha, nasgi nasquo udvdasdv nitsisgaihvna tsitsinega; tsigatahayeno hia nasgi gohusdi agvsgalanelvhi nigesvna gesvi, tleyeno unvsiyv hia digalvwisdanelvhi yigi.
\syll ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎠᎦᏔᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᏛᏓᏍᏛ ᏂᏥᏍᎦᎢᎲᎾ ᏥᏥᏁᎦ; ᏥᎦᏔᎭᏰᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎠᎬᏍᎦᎳᏁᎸᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏞᏰᏃ ᎤᏅᏏᏴ ᎯᎠ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᏱᎩ.
\ft For the king knoweth of these things, before whom also I speak freely: for I am persuaded that none of these things are hidden from him; for this thing was not done in a corner.

\ln Tsagvwiyuhi Egiliqui, dehohiyuhvsgasgo anadolehosgi?  Tsigataha dehohiyuhvsgvi.
\syll ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎡᎩᎵᏈ, ᏕᎰᎯᏳᎲᏍᎦᏍᎪ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ?  ᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᏕᎰᎯᏳᎲᏍᎬᎢ.
\ft King Agrippa, believest thou the prophets? I know that thou believest.

\ln Hnaquono Egiliqui hia nuweselvgi Quola; alequo nisgisegogia Galonedv tsiyoiyuhvsgi iyaqualisdodiyi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎡᎩᎵᏈ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ ᏉᎳ; ᎠᎴᏉ ᏂᏍᎩᏎᎪᎩᎠ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏥᏲᎢᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᎢᏯᏆᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
\ft Then Agrippa said unto Paul, Almost thou persuadest me to be a Christian.

\ln Quolano hia nuwesvgi; Unelanvhi tsiyadulveha, vtla nihiquo tsvsv, nasquosgini nigadv tsigvquadvganeha gohi iga tsigi, nasgi, vtla alequo naquasdvi, nasgiyasgini naquasdv itsalisdodiyi, hia nasgi tsvqualvv uwasv.
\syll ᏉᎳᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏥᏯᏚᎸᎡᎭ, ᎥᏝ ᏂᎯᏉ ᏨᏒ, ᎾᏍᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏥᎬᏆᏛᎦᏁᎭ ᎪᎯ ᎢᎦ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴᏉ ᎾᏆᏍᏛᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯᏍᎩᏂ ᎾᏆᏍᏛ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏨᏆᎸᎥ ᎤᏩᏒ.
\ft And Paul said, I would to God, that not only thou, but also all that hear me this day, were both almost, and altogether such as I am, except these bonds.

\ln Nasgino nuwesv, ugvwiyuhi dulenvgi, ale atsigatidisdi ugvwiyuhi, ale Quanisi, ale nasgi unanvnvhi,
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏄᏪᏒ, ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏚᎴᏅᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏥᎦᏘᏗᏍᏗ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏆᏂᏏ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᏅᏅᎯ,
\ft And when he had thus spoken, the king rose up, and the governor, and Bernice, and they that sat with them:

\ln Iyvdvno wunilosv, unvsv gesv unalinohelvgi, hia nuniwesvgi; Hia asgaya vtla gohusdi yidulvwisdaneha gvwayohuhisdi ale gayegalvsdi gesvi.
\syll ᎢᏴᏛᏃ ᏭᏂᎶᏒ, ᎤᏅᏒ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎾᎵᏃᎮᎸᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᎯᎠ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎥᏝ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏱᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎭ ᎬᏩᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎦᏰᎦᎸᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft And when they were gone aside, they talked between themselves, saying, This man doeth nothing worthy of death or of bonds.

\ln Egiliquino hia nuweselvgi Quesda; hia asgaya digayetsiyohisdiquo yigesei, iyuno Sisoi winuhvstanvna yigesei.
\syll ᎡᎩᎵᏈᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ ᏇᏍᏓ; ᎯᎠ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᏗᎦᏰᏥᏲᎯᏍᏗᏉ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᏏᏐᎢ ᏫᏄᎲᏍᏔᏅᎾ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ.
\ft Then said Agrippa unto Festus, This man might have been set at liberty, if he had not appealed unto Caesar.

\ln Hnaquono dudugotanv Idali wuginvsdodiyi tsiyu, duniyosvgi Quola ale gilo iyunasdi nvwanadale aniyvgi, nasgi duniyohiselv gilo iyusdi asgohitsuqui ditinidohi, Tsuliyasi tsudoidv, gela sunadatlugi gesv Ogasda tsutseliga.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏚᏚᎪᏔᏅ ᎢᏓᎵ ᏭᎩᏅᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏥᏳ, ᏚᏂᏲᏒᎩ ᏉᎳ ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗ ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴ ᎠᏂᏴᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᏂᏲᎯᏎᎸ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏧᏈ ᏗᏘᏂᏙᎯ, ᏧᎵᏯᏏ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ, ᎨᎳ ᏑᎾᏓᏡᎩ ᎨᏒ ᎣᎦᏍᏓ ᏧᏤᎵᎦ.
\ft And when it was determined that we should sail into Italy, they delivered Paul and certain other prisoners unto one named Julius, a centurion of Augustus' band.

\ln Ogatsanvno tsiyuhi Etlimidi ehi ogikadoyvgi, Esiyi uloditlv oginvsdodiyi ogiyelvsvgi, gilo iyusdi, Elisdaga tsudoidv, Masidoni Desaloniga gaduhv ehi, otsehvgi.
\syll ᎣᎦᏣᏅᏃ ᏥᏳᎯ ᎡᏟᎻᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎣᎩᎧᏙᏴᎩ, ᎡᏏᏱ ᎤᎶᏗᏢ ᎣᎩᏅᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎣᎩᏰᎸᏒᎩ, ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᎡᎵᏍᏓᎦ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ, ᎹᏏᏙᏂ ᏕᏌᎶᏂᎦ ᎦᏚᎲ ᎡᎯ, ᎣᏤᎲᎩ.
\ft And entering into a ship of Adramyttium, we launched, meaning to sail by the coasts of Asia; one Aristarchus, a Macedonian of Thessalonica, being with us.

\ln Ugitsvdvno Sadoni oginotlotsvgi.  Tsuliyasino osdv nudvnelvgi Quola, ulisgolvdanelvgiyeno tsulii tsuwadvhvsdiyi, ale nasgi gvwasquanigododiyi.
\syll ᎤᎩᏨᏛᏃ ᏌᏙᏂ ᎣᎩᏃᏠᏨᎩ.  ᏧᎵᏯᏏᏃ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏄᏛᏁᎸᎩ ᏉᎳ, ᎤᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᎸᎩᏰᏃ ᏧᎵᎢ ᏧᏩᏛᎲᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏩᏍᏆᏂᎪᏙᏗᏱ.
\ft And the next day we touched at Sidon. And Julius courteously entreated Paul, and gave him liberty to go unto his friends to refresh himself.

\ln Nahnano wiogikadoyv Saqui hawiniditlv oginvstanvgi, ganolvvsgvyeno igvyiditlv dayugadvgi.
\syll ᏀᎾᏃ ᏫᎣᎩᎧᏙᏴ ᏌᏈ ᎭᏫᏂᏗᏢ ᎣᎩᏅᏍᏔᏅᎩ, ᎦᏃᎸᎥᏍᎬᏰᏃ ᎢᎬᏱᏗᏢ ᏓᏳᎦᏛᎩ.
\ft And when we had launched from thence, we sailed under Cyprus, because the winds were contrary.

\ln Ogilosonvno amequohi, Silisiyi ale Quamiquiliyi tsuyugodi, Lisiyi wogilutsvgi, Mali deudov gaduhvi.
\syll ᎣᎩᎶᏐᏅᏃ ᎠᎺᏉᎯ, ᏏᎵᏏᏱ ᎠᎴ ᏆᎻᏈᎵᏱ ᏧᏳᎪᏗ, ᎵᏏᏱ ᏬᎩᎷᏨᎩ, ᎹᎵ ᏕᎤᏙᎥ ᎦᏚᎲᎢ.
\ft And when we had sailed over the sea of Cilicia and Pamphylia, we came to Myra, a city of Lycia.

\ln Nahnano asgohitsuqui ditinidohi uyvwadvhvgi tsiyu Idali aninisvgi, Eligiyi ehi, nahnano dogiyanvgi.
\syll ᏀᎾᏃ ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏧᏈ ᏗᏘᏂᏙᎯ ᎤᏴᏩᏛᎲᎩ ᏥᏳ ᎢᏓᎵ ᎠᏂᏂᏒᎩ, ᎡᎵᎩᏱ ᎡᎯ, ᏀᎾᏃ ᏙᎩᏯᏅᎩ.
\ft And there the centurion found a ship of Alexandria sailing into Italy; and he put us therein.

\ln Uwohitsvno ganila oginenv, ale asiquo nogilosonvna gesv Nada, Tlidi hawiniditlv woginvstanvgi, Salamoni tsuyugodi, ganolvvsgvyeno ogiyosdo danehvgi.
\syll ᎤᏬᎯᏨᏃ ᎦᏂᎳ ᎣᎩᏁᏅ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏏᏉ ᏃᎩᎶᏐᏅᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏓ, ᏟᏗ ᎭᏫᏂᏗᏢ ᏬᎩᏅᏍᏔᏅᎩ, ᏌᎳᎼᏂ ᏧᏳᎪᏗ, ᎦᏃᎸᎥᏍᎬᏰᏃ ᎣᎩᏲᏍᏙ ᏓᏁᎲᎩ.
\ft And when we had sailed slowly many days, and scarce were come over against Cnidus, the wind not suffering us, we sailed under Crete, over against Salmone;

\ln Usegatsvhino nahna ogilosonv, wogilutsvgi osdv Ditaladisdiyi dudovi, nav gaduhv Lesiyi tsudoidv.
\syll ᎤᏎᎦᏨᎯᏃ ᏀᎾ ᎣᎩᎶᏐᏅ, ᏬᎩᎷᏨᎩ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏗᏔᎳᏗᏍᏗᏱ ᏚᏙᎥᎢ, ᎾᎥ ᎦᏚᎲ ᎴᏏᏱ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ.
\ft And, hardly passing it, came unto a place which is called The fair havens; nigh whereunto was the city of Lasea.

\ln Uwohitsvno, ale unayehisdiyu nulistanv tsiyu ganidasdiyi, nvdigalisdodisgv amatli gvdi gesv ulosonvi, Quola duweyatanvgi,
\syll ᎤᏬᎯᏨᏃ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏰᎯᏍᏗᏳ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ ᏥᏳ ᎦᏂᏓᏍᏗᏱ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬ ᎠᎹᏟ ᎬᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎶᏐᏅᎢ, ᏉᎳ ᏚᏪᏯᏔᏅᎩ,
\ft Now when much time was spent, and when sailing was now dangerous, because the fast was now already past, Paul admonished them,

\ln Hia niduweselvgi; Itsisgaya, gadoleosga hia nasgi tsiyu tsidini gohusdi digalisdanelisvi, ale utsadv digiyohuselisvi, vtla alinesalvquo ale tsiyu uwasv, nasquosgini dedvnvi.
\syll ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎢᏥᏍᎦᏯ, ᎦᏙᎴᎣᏍᎦ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏳ ᏥᏗᏂ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏗᎦᎵᏍᏓᏁᎵᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏣᏛ ᏗᎩᏲᎱᏎᎵᏒᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎵᏁᏌᎸᏉ ᎠᎴ ᏥᏳ ᎤᏩᏒ, ᎾᏍᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᏕᏛᏅᎢ.
\ft And said unto them, Sirs, I perceive that this voyage will be with hurt and much damage, not only of the lading and ship, but also of our lives.

\ln Aseno asgohitsuqui ditinidohi utli niduwohiyusvgi kanetsidohi ale utseliga tsiyu aninegvi, esgaquo Quola nigawesgvi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏧᏈ ᏗᏘᏂᏙᎯ ᎤᏟ ᏂᏚᏬᎯᏳᏒᎩ ᎧᏁᏥᏙᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᏥᏳ ᎠᏂᏁᎬᎢ, ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᏉᎳ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎬᎢ.
\ft Nevertheless the centurion believed the master and the owner of the ship, more than those things which were spoken by Paul.

\ln Ditaladisdiyino nosvna gesv nahna ugoladiyvdiyi, utli iyanii uninetsvgi nasquo nahna uniyvwidvdiyi, yeli Quinisi wigayoginohisdi ale wigayogagoladiyvdi yigi anelisgvgi, nasgi nahna Tlidi ditaladisdiyi, ale nasgi wudeligv iditlv wugati.
\syll ᏗᏔᎳᏗᏍᏗᏱᏃ ᏃᏒᎾ ᎨᏒ ᏀᎾ ᎤᎪᎳᏗᏴᏗᏱ, ᎤᏟ ᎢᏯᏂᎢ ᎤᏂᏁᏨᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏀᎾ ᎤᏂᏴᏫᏛᏗᏱ, ᏰᎵ ᏈᏂᏏ ᏫᎦᏲᎩᏃᎯᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏫᎦᏲᎦᎪᎳᏗᏴᏗ ᏱᎩ ᎠᏁᎵᏍᎬᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏀᎾ ᏟᏗ ᏗᏔᎳᏗᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏭᏕᎵᎬ ᎢᏗᏢ ᏭᎦᏘ.
\ft And because the haven was not commodious to winter in, the more part advised to depart thence also, if by any means they might attain to Phenice, and there to winter; which is an haven of Crete, and lieth toward the south west and north west.

\ln Hnaquono tsuganawv iditlv tsunolvtanv, nasgi igadulisgv nigalisda unelisv, unikadoyvgi, Tlidi navi uninvstanvgi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏧᎦᎾᏮ ᎢᏗᏢ ᏧᏃᎸᏔᏅ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎦᏚᎵᏍᎬ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏓ ᎤᏁᎵᏒ, ᎤᏂᎧᏙᏴᎩ, ᏟᏗ ᎾᎥᎢ ᎤᏂᏅᏍᏔᏅᎩ.
\ft And when the south wind blew softly, supposing that they had obtained their purpose, loosing thence, they sailed close by Crete.

\ln Aseno nuwohitsvnaquo oni, uyilolvgi unole Yulotlidv tsudoidv.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᏄᏬᎯᏨᎾᏉ ᎣᏂ, ᎤᏱᎶᎸᎩ ᎤᏃᎴ ᏳᎶᏟᏛ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ.
\ft But not long after there arose against it a tempestuous wind, called Euroclydon.

\ln Hnaquono ganolvvsgv uniyvhv tsiyu, ale nasgi unulvnv unole tsugadv wulohisdiyi unelagi kanuhisesdi ogelisvgi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎦᏃᎸᎥᏍᎬ ᎤᏂᏴᎲ ᏥᏳ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏄᎸᏅ ᎤᏃᎴ ᏧᎦᏛ ᏭᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏁᎳᎩ ᎧᏄᎯᏎᏍᏗ ᎣᎨᎵᏒᎩ.
\ft And when the ship was caught, and could not bear up into the wind, we let her drive.

\ln Hawiniditlvno oginvstanv gohusdi usdi amayeli uwekahv, Tlodi tsudoidv, usegatsvhiquo digayoginiyvdi nulistanvgi usdi tsiyu.
\syll ᎭᏫᏂᏗᏢᏃ ᎣᎩᏅᏍᏔᏅ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎠᎹᏰᎵ ᎤᏪᎧᎲ, ᏠᏗ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ, ᎤᏎᎦᏨᎯᏉ ᏗᎦᏲᎩᏂᏴᏗ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎩ ᎤᏍᏗ ᏥᏳ.
\ft And running under a certain island which is called Clauda, we had much work to come by the boat:

\ln Nasgino unisaladanv, dilisdelvdodi dunvtanvgi, unalvlvgi tsiyu; anisgaihvno usdanalv uninotlohisdiyi nasgi nvdayulisdotanvgi eladi nidunvnelvgi dayedoladvi, uninuhisvquono.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᏂᏌᎳᏓᏅ, ᏗᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ ᏚᏅᏔᏅᎩ, ᎤᎾᎸᎸᎩ ᏥᏳ; ᎠᏂᏍᎦᎢᎲᏃ ᎤᏍᏓᎾᎸ ᎤᏂᏃᏠᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏓᏳᎵᏍᏙᏔᏅᎩ ᎡᎳᏗ ᏂᏚᏅᏁᎸᎩ ᏓᏰᏙᎳᏛᎢ, ᎤᏂᏄᎯᏒᏉᏃ.
\ft Which when they had taken up, they used helps, undergirding the ship; and, fearing lest they should fall into the quicksands, strake sail, and so were driven.

\ln Unoleno utsati ogitladistanidolv, ugitsvdv unalinesalesvgi.
\syll ᎤᏃᎴᏃ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎣᎩᏝᏗᏍᏔᏂᏙᎸ, ᎤᎩᏨᏛ ᎤᎾᎵᏁᏌᎴᏒᎩ.
\ft And we being exceedingly tossed with a tempest, the next day they lightened the ship;

\ln Tsoineno iga ogvsv tsogoyeni dogvtanvgi, ogatinvsvgi utseligaya ulinesalv tsiyu.
\syll ᏦᎢᏁᏃ ᎢᎦ ᎣᎬᏒ ᏦᎪᏰᏂ ᏙᎬᏔᏅᎩ, ᎣᎦᏘᏅᏒᎩ ᎤᏤᎵᎦᏯ ᎤᎵᏁᏌᎸ ᏥᏳ.
\ft And the third day we cast out with our own hands the tackling of the ship.

\ln Uwohitsvno naninanugogvna nulistanv nvdo ale noquisi, ale gayoliquo nigesvna oginolvnv, hnaquo gayogadvnidisdi gesv udugi ogvsv ulidvtanvgi.
\syll ᎤᏬᎯᏨᏃ ᎾᏂᎾᏄᎪᎬᎾ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ ᏅᏙ ᎠᎴ ᏃᏈᏏ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᏲᎵᏉ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎣᎩᏃᎸᏅ, ᎿᏉ ᎦᏲᎦᏛᏂᏗᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎣᎬᏒ ᎤᎵᏛᏔᏅᎩ.
\ft And when neither sun nor stars in many days appeared, and no small tempest lay on us, all hope that we should be saved was then taken away.

\ln Hnaquono gohidiyu gayogalisdayvnvhi nulistanv Quola dulenvgi ayeli unatsavi, ale hia nuwesvgi; Itsisgaya, yisgiyoiyunei, ale nvditsikadoyvnaquo yigese Tlidi, vtla nasgi hia usonv yinigetsalisdanele ale yigetsigolohiselei.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎪᎯᏗᏳ ᎦᏲᎦᎵᏍᏓᏴᏅᎯ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ ᏉᎳ ᏚᎴᏅᎩ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎤᎾᏣᎥᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎢᏥᏍᎦᏯ, ᏱᏍᎩᏲᎢᏳᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏅᏗᏥᎧᏙᏴᎾᏉ ᏱᎨᏎ ᏟᏗ, ᎥᏝ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎤᏐᏅ ᏱᏂᎨᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᎴ ᎠᎴ ᏱᎨᏥᎪᎶᎯᏎᎴᎢ.
\ft But after long abstinence Paul stood forth in the midst of them, and said, Sirs, ye should have hearkened unto me, and not have loosed from Crete, and to have gained this harm and loss.

\ln naquono itsvtayoseha ugalisdi itsadanvdadisdiyi; hiayeno tsinitsadvnv vtla gilogvnv yvgvwayohusi, tsiyu uwasv dagiyohuseli.
\syll ᎾᏉᏃ ᎢᏨᏔᏲᏎᎭ ᎤᎦᎵᏍᏗ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗᏱ; ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᏥᏂᏣᏛᏅ ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶᎬᏅ ᏴᎬᏩᏲᎱᏏ, ᏥᏳ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏓᎩᏲᎱᏎᎵ.
\ft And now I exhort you to be of good cheer: for there shall be no loss of any man's life among you, but of the ship.

\ln Gohiyeno svnoyi tsigesvgi uloditlv aqualenelv dikahnawadidohi Unelanvhi utseliga, nasgi Unelanvhi ayv aginatlai tsigi ale nasgi tsidetsigahnawadega,
\syll ᎪᎯᏰᏃ ᏒᏃᏱ ᏥᎨᏒᎩ ᎤᎶᏗᏢ ᎠᏆᎴᏁᎸ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᏴ ᎠᎩᎾᏝᎢ ᏥᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏕᏥᎦᎿᏩᏕᎦ,
\ft For there stood by me this night the angel of God, whose I am, and whom I serve,

\ln Hia nuwesvgi; Tlesdi yisgaihesdi, Quola, Sisa uwolv igvyiditlv ase taleni; gvniyuquono Unelanvhi gatsakanelv nigadv tsiyuhi tsitsatsaa.
\syll ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏍᎦᎢᎮᏍᏗ, ᏉᎳ, ᏏᏌ ᎤᏬᎸ ᎢᎬᏱᏗᏢ ᎠᏎ ᏔᎴᏂ; ᎬᏂᏳᏉᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎦᏣᎧᏁᎸ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏥᏳᎯ ᏥᏣᏣᎠ.
\ft Saying, Fear not, Paul; thou must be brought before Caesar: and, lo, God hath given thee all them that sail with thee.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi itsisgaya, ugalisdi itsadanvdada; tsiyoiyuhvsgayeno Unelanvhi, nagiweselv nasgiya iyulisdodiyi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏥᏍᎦᏯ, ᎤᎦᎵᏍᏗ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏓᏓ; ᏥᏲᎢᏳᎲᏍᎦᏰᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎾᎩᏪᏎᎸ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
\ft Wherefore, sirs, be of good cheer: for I believe God, that it shall be even as it was told me.

\ln Asesgininonv gohusdi usdi amayeli uwekahv dagitladitseli.
\syll ᎠᏎᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎠᎹᏰᎵ ᎤᏪᎧᎲ ᏓᎩᏝᏗᏤᎵ.
\ft Howbeit we must be cast upon a certain island.

\ln Nigadusineno ulisinv, amequohi Etliya tsudoidv oginolvtanidohvi, svnoyi ayeli tsiyu aninidohi ilvhitlv gadohi navnige otsini unelisvgi.
\syll ᏂᎦᏚᏏᏁᏃ ᎤᎵᏏᏅ, ᎠᎺᏉᎯ ᎡᏟᏯ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ ᎣᎩᏃᎸᏔᏂᏙᎲᎢ, ᏒᏃᏱ ᎠᏰᎵ ᏥᏳ ᎠᏂᏂᏙᎯ ᎢᎸᎯᏢ ᎦᏙᎯ ᎾᎥᏂᎨ ᎣᏥᏂ ᎤᏁᎵᏒᎩ.
\ft But when the fourteenth night was come, as we were driven up and down in Adria, about midnight the shipmen deemed that they drew near to some country;

\ln Nasdvgvno unatlilov unadolehosvgi talasgohi igolunvdi gesvi; usdigidvno uditlvsdodi iunenv taline unatlilovgi, unadolehosvgi hisgigaduquo igolunvdi gesvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᏛᎬᏃ ᎤᎾᏟᎶᎥ ᎤᎾᏙᎴᎰᏒᎩ ᏔᎳᏍᎪᎯ ᎢᎪᎷᏅᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎤᏍᏗᎩᏛᏃ ᎤᏗᏢᏍᏙᏗ ᎢᎤᏁᏅ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎤᎾᏟᎶᎥᎩ, ᎤᎾᏙᎴᎰᏒᎩ ᎯᏍᎩᎦᏚᏉ ᎢᎪᎷᏅᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft And sounded, and found it twenty fathoms: and when they had gone a little further, they sounded again, and found it fifteen fathoms.

\ln Hnaquono unisgalv nvyohi unitladitsediyi, oniditlv widunadinvsvgi nvgi talugisgi tsiyu diganahisdodi, ale unadulvhvgi iga iyulisdodiyi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎤᏂᏍᎦᎸ ᏅᏲᎯ ᎤᏂᏝᏗᏤᏗᏱ, ᎣᏂᏗᏢ ᏫᏚᎾᏗᏅᏒᎩ ᏅᎩ ᏔᎷᎩᏍᎩ ᏥᏳ ᏗᎦᏀᎢᏍᏙᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏚᎸᎲᎩ ᎢᎦ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
\ft Then fearing lest we should have fallen upon rocks, they cast four anchors out of the stern, and wished for the day.

\ln Tsiyuno aninidohi unalisdiyi uniyelvnv, ale hnaquo usdi tsiyu anitaladisgvi, anatlonasdisgv talugisgi tsiyu diganahisdodi igvyvditlv tsiwidotsunadesiso utloyi nanadvnehvi.
\syll ᏥᏳᏃ ᎠᏂᏂᏙᎯ ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏂᏰᎸᏅ, ᎠᎴ ᎿᏉ ᎤᏍᏗ ᏥᏳ ᎠᏂᏔᎳᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᎠᎾᏠᎾᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᏔᎷᎩᏍᎩ ᏥᏳ ᏗᎦᏀᎢᏍᏙᏗ ᎢᎬᏴᏗᏢ ᏥᏫᏙᏧᎾᏕᏏᏐ ᎤᏠᏱ ᎾᎾᏛᏁᎲᎢ.
\ft And as the shipmen were about to flee out of the ship, when they had let down the boat into the sea, under colour as though they would have cast anchors out of the foreship,

\ln Quola hia niduweselvgi asgohitsuqui ditinidohi ale aniyawisgi; Iyuno hia nasgi tsiyuhi nunatsavna yigi vtla yvgetsadvnida.
\syll ᏉᎳ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏧᏈ ᏗᏘᏂᏙᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏯᏫᏍᎩ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏳᎯ ᏄᎾᏣᎥᎾ ᏱᎩ ᎥᏝ ᏴᎨᏣᏛᏂᏓ.
\ft Paul said to the centurion and to the soldiers, Except these abide in the ship, ye cannot be saved.

\ln Hnaquono aniyawisgi dunigalisvgi asdeyidv usdi tsiyu gadosadisdvi, ale nasgi uwohosvgi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎠᏂᏯᏫᏍᎩ ᏚᏂᎦᎵᏒᎩ ᎠᏍᏕᏱᏛ ᎤᏍᏗ ᏥᏳ ᎦᏙᏌᏗᏍᏛᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏬᎰᏒᎩ.
\ft Then the soldiers cut off the ropes of the boat, and let her fall off.

\ln Igano nvdagalistanisvgi, Quola dutayoselvgi nigadv unalisdayvdiyi, hia nuwesvgi; Gohi hnaquo nigadusine iga tsitsigatiyv ale nitsalisdayvsgvna gohusdi nitsigisgvna tsigi.
\syll ᎢᎦᏃ ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏔᏂᏒᎩ, ᏉᎳ ᏚᏔᏲᏎᎸᎩ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎪᎯ ᎿᏉ ᏂᎦᏚᏏᏁ ᎢᎦ ᏥᏥᎦᏘᏴ ᎠᎴ ᏂᏣᎵᏍᏓᏴᏍᎬᎾ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏂᏥᎩᏍᎬᎾ ᏥᎩ.
\ft And while the day was coming on, Paul besought them all to take meat, saying, This day is the fourteenth day that ye have tarried and continued fasting, having taken nothing.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi itsvtayoseha itsalisdayvdiyi, nasgiyeno hia itsalisdelvdodi; hiayeno tsinitsadvnv vtla gilo saquounv ustiyenvhi adagadoasi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏨᏔᏲᏎᎭ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ; ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᏥᏂᏣᏛᏅ ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᏌᏉᎤᏅ ᎤᏍᏘᏰᏅᎯ ᎠᏓᎦᏙᎠᏏ.
\ft Wherefore I pray you to take some meat: for this is for your health: for there shall not an hair fall from the head of any of you.

\ln Nasgino nuwesv, gadu ugisvgi ale ulihelitselvgi Unelanvhi nigadv anigatahvi, ugvhaluyvno ulenvhvgi ulisdayvnvgi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏄᏪᏒ, ᎦᏚ ᎤᎩᏒᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᎮᎵᏤᎸᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎲᎢ, ᎤᎬᎭᎷᏴᏃ ᎤᎴᏅᎲᎩ ᎤᎵᏍᏓᏴᏅᎩ.
\ft And when he had thus spoken, he took bread, and gave thanks to God in presence of them all: and when he had broken it, he began to eat.

\ln Hnaquono nigadv ugalisdiyu unadanvdadvgi, ale nasquo unalisdayvnvgi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎤᎦᎵᏍᏗᏳ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏓᏛᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᏅᎩ.
\ft Then were they all of good cheer, and they also took some meat.

\ln Nigadvno tsiyuhi ogatsai talitsuqui galiquasgohi sudaligali notsivgi yvwi.
\syll ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᏥᏳᎯ ᎣᎦᏣᎢ ᏔᎵᏧᏈ ᎦᎵᏆᏍᎪᎯ ᏑᏓᎵᎦᎵ ᏃᏥᎥᎩ ᏴᏫ.
\ft And we were in all in the ship two hundred threescore and sixteen souls.

\ln Hnaquono yeli unalisdayvnv, unadasakahvstanvgi tsiyu, utsalesdi amequohi wunadinvsvgi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏰᎵ ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᏅ, ᎤᎾᏓᏌᎧᎲᏍᏔᏅᎩ ᏥᏳ, ᎤᏣᎴᏍᏗ ᎠᎺᏉᎯ ᏭᎾᏗᏅᏒᎩ.
\ft And when they had eaten enough, they lightened the ship, and cast out the wheat into the sea.

\ln Hnaquono iga nulistanv vtla yunolitse nahna gadohi; aseno unigohv amequohi wuwanigalvi, yeli gvdugisdi gesvi, nahna wuninvsdodiyi tsiyu uniyelvnvgi, iyuno yeli yigi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎢᎦ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ ᎥᏝ ᏳᏃᎵᏤ ᏀᎾ ᎦᏙᎯ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏂᎪᎲ ᎠᎺᏉᎯ ᏭᏩᏂᎦᎸᎢ, ᏰᎵ ᎬᏚᎩᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏀᎾ ᏭᏂᏅᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏥᏳ ᎤᏂᏰᎸᏅᎩ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᏰᎵ ᏱᎩ.
\ft And when it was day, they knew not the land: but they discovered a certain creek with a shore, into the which they were minded, if it were possible, to thrust in the ship.

\ln Hnaquono dunigalisv degadosadisdv talugisgi tsiyu diganahisdodi, amequohi duniyohiselvgi, ale dunikaneyvhvgi gasadvsdi degalvsdvi, ale ganolvvsgvi uniyedoladvnvgi usdi ayedoladvdi; doyino widunugotanvgi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏚᏂᎦᎵᏒ ᏕᎦᏙᏌᏗᏍᏛ ᏔᎷᎩᏍᎩ ᏥᏳ ᏗᎦᏀᎢᏍᏙᏗ, ᎠᎺᏉᎯ ᏚᏂᏲᎯᏎᎸᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏂᎧᏁᏴᎲᎩ ᎦᏌᏛᏍᏗ ᏕᎦᎸᏍᏛᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᏃᎸᎥᏍᎬᎢ ᎤᏂᏰᏙᎳᏛᏅᎩ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎠᏰᏙᎳᏛᏗ; ᏙᏱᏃ ᏫᏚᏄᎪᏔᏅᎩ.
\ft And when they had taken up the anchors, they committed themselves unto the sea, and loosed the rudder bands, and hoised up the mainsail to the wind, and made toward shore.

\ln Talino amequohi degesv wunaliyilolv, tsiyu unitladitselvgi gadohi; igvyiditlvno asdayiyu nulistanv, vtla yeli gvwalitelvdi yigesei, oniditlvsgini uyotsvgi nvdayulisdotanvgi ulinigidiyu dalisdilanegv amequohi.
\syll ᏔᎵᏃ ᎠᎺᏉᎯ ᏕᎨᏒ ᏭᎾᎵᏱᎶᎸ, ᏥᏳ ᎤᏂᏝᏗᏤᎸᎩ ᎦᏙᎯ; ᎢᎬᏱᏗᏢᏃ ᎠᏍᏓᏱᏳ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ, ᎥᏝ ᏰᎵ ᎬᏩᎵᏖᎸᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ, ᎣᏂᏗᏢᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏲᏨᎩ ᏅᏓᏳᎵᏍᏙᏔᏅᎩ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ ᏓᎵᏍᏗᎳᏁᎬ ᎠᎺᏉᎯ.
\ft And falling into a place where two seas met, they ran the ship aground; and the forepart stuck fast, and remained unmoveable, but the hinder part was broken with the violence of the waves.

\ln Aniyawisgino tsunihisdiyi unadanvtelvgi aniyvgi; giloyeno yayvinuga yadugi ale yalidi anelisgvgi.
\syll ᎠᏂᏯᏫᏍᎩᏃ ᏧᏂᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏖᎸᎩ ᎠᏂᏴᎩ; ᎩᎶᏰᏃ ᏯᏴᎢᏄᎦ ᏯᏚᎩ ᎠᎴ ᏯᎵᏗ ᎠᏁᎵᏍᎬᎩ.
\ft And the soldiers' counsel was to kill the prisoners, lest any of them should swim out, and escape.

\ln Aseno asgohitsuqui ditinidohi duyosdodanelvgi nusdv anadanvtesgv nvdayulisdotanvgi udulisgv usdelvdiyi Quola, ale dunetselvgi yeli gvwanayvinvsdi gesv, igvyi unalitadinvdiyi ale wunadugisdiyi,
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏧᏈ ᏗᏘᏂᏙᎯ ᏚᏲᏍᏙᏓᏁᎸᎩ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎠᎾᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ ᏅᏓᏳᎵᏍᏙᏔᏅᎩ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎬ ᎤᏍᏕᎸᏗᏱ ᏉᎳ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏁᏤᎸᎩ ᏰᎵ ᎬᏩᎾᏴᎢᏅᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ, ᎢᎬᏱ ᎤᎾᎵᏔᏗᏅᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᏭᎾᏚᎩᏍᏗᏱ,
\ft But the centurion, willing to save Paul, kept them from their purpose; and commanded that they which could swim should cast themselves first into the sea, and get to land:

\ln Anisoino igadv tsuyadena tsunagilvdodiyi, igadvno tsiyu tsulitlvlvdv.  Ale nasgi nulistanvgi, nigadv unadvnidvgi unadugisvgi.
\syll ᎠᏂᏐᎢᏃ ᎢᎦᏛ ᏧᏯᏕᎾ ᏧᎾᎩᎸᏙᏗᏱ, ᎢᎦᏛᏃ ᏥᏳ ᏧᎵᏢᎸᏛ.  ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎩ, ᏂᎦᏛ ᎤᎾᏛᏂᏛᎩ ᎤᎾᏚᎩᏒᎩ.
\ft And the rest, some on boards, and some on broken pieces of the ship. And so it came to pass, that they escaped all safe to land.

\ln Unadvnidvno gila unadolehosvgi nasgi amayeli Miladi dudovi,
\syll ᎤᎾᏛᏂᏛᏃ ᎩᎳ ᎤᎾᏙᎴᎰᏒᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎹᏰᎵ ᎻᎳᏗ ᏚᏙᎥᎢ,
\ft And when they were escaped, then they knew that the island was called Melita.

\ln Nvwanadaleno yvwi nahna anehi utsati osiyu gogisquanigotanvgi; unotanvyeno degogadanilvtsvgi nigadv, nvdagalisdodisgvgi agasgvi ale uyvtlvi.
\syll ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴᏃ ᏴᏫ ᏀᎾ ᎠᏁᎯ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎪᎩᏍᏆᏂᎪᏔᏅᎩ; ᎤᏃᏔᏅᏰᏃ ᏕᎪᎦᏓᏂᎸᏨᎩ ᏂᎦᏛ, ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᎠᎦᏍᎬᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏴᏢᎢ.
\ft And the barbarous people shewed us no little kindness: for they kindled a fire, and received us every one, because of the present rain, and because of the cold.

\ln Quolano widuwudesv sinugitlanvhi ada, ale duhvtanv, inadv udilegv dayunanugotsvgi uwoyeni uweteladvtsvgi.
\syll ᏉᎳᏃ ᏫᏚᏭᏕᏒ ᏏᏄᎩᏝᏅᎯ ᎠᏓ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᎲᏔᏅ, ᎢᎾᏛ ᎤᏗᎴᎬ ᏓᏳᎾᏄᎪᏨᎩ ᎤᏬᏰᏂ ᎤᏪᏖᎳᏛᏨᎩ.
\ft And when Paul had gathered a bundle of sticks, and laid them on the fire, there came a viper out of the heat, and fastened on his hand.

\ln Nasgino nvwanadale yvwi unigohv inadv gateladv uwoyeni, hia nidunadaweselvgi; vtla yutlasidvha hia asgaya yvwi dihihi gesvi; udohiyuhisgininonv nasgi amequohi adiwisi, aseno utlegi vtla gvnesdi yuweliseha.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏂᎪᎲ ᎢᎾᏛ ᎦᏖᎳᏛ ᎤᏬᏰᏂ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᎾᏓᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎥᏝ ᏳᏝᏏᏛᎭ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᏴᏫ ᏗᎯᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎺᏉᎯ ᎠᏗᏫᏏ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏞᎩ ᎥᏝ ᎬᏁᏍᏗ ᏳᏪᎵᏎᎭ.
\ft And when the barbarians saw the venomous beast hang on his hand, they said among themselves, No doubt this man is a murderer, whom, though he hath escaped the sea, yet vengeance suffereth not to live.

\ln Atsilvyino wudovtanvgi inadv, ale vtla gohusdi yulistanei.
\syll ᎠᏥᎸᏱᏃ ᏭᏙᎥᏔᏅᎩ ᎢᎾᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏳᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ.
\ft And he shook off the beast into the fire, and felt no harm.

\ln Aseno unagadostanvgi, dagotisi ale uyohusvhi daganvtsi dvyeloistani, anelisgvgi; aseno uwohitsv unagadostanv, ale unadolehosv gohusdi nulisdanelvna gesvi, uninetliyvsvgi nusdv anadanvtesgvi, ale galvladi ehi, unadvnvgi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᎾᎦᏙᏍᏔᏅᎩ, ᏓᎪᏘᏏ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᏓᎦᏅᏥ ᏛᏰᎶᎢᏍᏔᏂ, ᎠᏁᎵᏍᎬᎩ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏬᎯᏨ ᎤᎾᎦᏙᏍᏔᏅ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏙᎴᎰᏒ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏄᎵᏍᏓᏁᎸᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᏂᏁᏟᏴᏒᎩ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎠᎾᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ, ᎤᎾᏛᏅᎩ.
\ft Howbeit they looked when he should have swollen, or fallen down dead suddenly: but after they had looked a great while, and saw no harm come to him, they changed their minds, and said that he was a god.

\ln Nahnano nav dulogesvgi nugvwiyusv asgaya nahna amayeli uwekahvi, Quatliya tsudoidv; nasgi dogadanilvtsvgi, ale tsoi tsusvhidv udolisdosiyu ogisquanigotanvgi ganelvi.
\syll ᏀᎾᏃ ᎾᎥ ᏚᎶᎨᏒᎩ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᏀᎾ ᎠᎹᏰᎵ ᎤᏪᎧᎲᎢ, ᏆᏟᏯ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᏙᎦᏓᏂᎸᏨᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏦᎢ ᏧᏒᎯᏛ ᎤᏙᎵᏍᏙᏏᏳ ᎣᎩᏍᏆᏂᎪᏔᏅᎩ ᎦᏁᎸᎢ.
\ft In the same quarters were possessions of the chief man of the island, whose name was Publius; who received us, and lodged us three days courteously.

\ln Hiano nulistanvgi, nasgi Quatliya udoda ganvgvgi udilehvsgvgi ale gigv duwagusgvgi, nasgi Quola uyvlvgi ganvgvi, udadolistanvno ale dusitadv unvwanvgi.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏆᏟᏯ ᎤᏙᏓ ᎦᏅᎬᎩ ᎤᏗᎴᎲᏍᎬᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎩᎬ ᏚᏩᎫᏍᎬᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏉᎳ ᎤᏴᎸᎩ ᎦᏅᎬᎢ, ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏔᏅᏃ ᎠᎴ ᏚᏏᏔᏛ ᎤᏅᏩᏅᎩ.
\ft And it came to pass, that the father of Publius lay sick of a fever and of a bloody flux: to whom Paul entered in, and prayed, and laid his hands on him, and healed him.

\ln Nasgino nulistanv, nvwanadale nasquo tsunitlvgi nahna amayeli anehi unilutsvgi, ale degetsinvwanvgi;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ, ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏧᏂᏢᎩ ᏀᎾ ᎠᎹᏰᎵ ᎠᏁᎯ ᎤᏂᎷᏨᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᎨᏥᏅᏩᏅᎩ;
\ft So when this was done, others also, which had diseases in the island, came, and were healed:

\ln Nasgi nasquo gogilvquodisgvi utsadvgi goginelvnvgi; ioganigisvno gogalinesalanelvgi tsudalelanvdv ogalisdelvdodi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎪᎩᎸᏉᏗᏍᎬᎢ ᎤᏣᏛᎩ ᎪᎩᏁᎸᏅᎩ; ᎢᎣᎦᏂᎩᏒᏃ ᎪᎦᎵᏁᏌᎳᏁᎸᎩ ᏧᏓᎴᎳᏅᏛ ᎣᎦᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ.
\ft Who also honoured us with many honours; and when we departed, they laded us with such things as were necessary.

\ln Tsoino iyanvdo ulosonv oganigisvgi, ogatsanvgi tsiyuhi Eligiyi ehi, nahna amayeli sigoladiyisgi unitaladvhi, nasgi golisdodi Kasda ale Quolatsi gowelvgi.
\syll ᏦᎢᏃ ᎢᏯᏅᏙ ᎤᎶᏐᏅ ᎣᎦᏂᎩᏒᎩ, ᎣᎦᏣᏅᎩ ᏥᏳᎯ ᎡᎵᎩᏱ ᎡᎯ, ᏀᎾ ᎠᎹᏰᎵ ᏏᎪᎳᏗᏱᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᏔᎳᏛᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᎧᏍᏓ ᎠᎴ ᏉᎳᏥ ᎪᏪᎸᎩ.
\ft And after three months we departed in a ship of Alexandria, which had wintered in the isle, whose sign was Castor and Pollux.

\ln Salegusino ogadugisv, nahna tsoi nogisvlvgi.
\syll ᏌᎴᎫᏏᏃ ᎣᎦᏚᎩᏒ, ᏀᎾ ᏦᎢ ᏃᎩᏒᎸᎩ.
\ft And landing at Syracuse, we tarried there three days.

\ln Nahnano wiogenv agolvdv woginvstanvgi, Litsiya wogilutsvgi.  Sudodaquadvno ulosonv tsuganawv iditlv dayunolvtanvgi; ugitsvdvno Quedioli wogilutsvgi.
\syll ᏀᎾᏃ ᏫᎣᎨᏅ ᎠᎪᎸᏛ ᏬᎩᏅᏍᏔᏅᎩ, ᎵᏥᏯ ᏬᎩᎷᏨᎩ.  ᏑᏙᏓᏆᏛᏃ ᎤᎶᏐᏅ ᏧᎦᎾᏮ ᎢᏗᏢ ᏓᏳᏃᎸᏔᏅᎩ; ᎤᎩᏨᏛᏃ ᏇᏗᎣᎵ ᏬᎩᎷᏨᎩ.
\ft And from thence we fetched a compass, and came to Rhegium: and after one day the south wind blew, and we came the next day to Puteoli:

\ln Nahna dotsiwadvhvgi otsadanvtli, ale gogitayoselvgi galvquogi tsusvhidv daninelv oganvdiyi.  Hnaquono Lomi widuyugodv wogilosvgi.
\syll ᏀᎾ ᏙᏥᏩᏛᎲᎩ ᎣᏣᏓᏅᏟ, ᎠᎴ ᎪᎩᏔᏲᏎᎸᎩ ᎦᎸᏉᎩ ᏧᏒᎯᏛ ᏓᏂᏁᎸ ᎣᎦᏅᏗᏱ.  ᎿᏉᏃ ᎶᎻ ᏫᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᏬᎩᎶᏒᎩ.
\ft Where we found brethren, and were desired to tarry with them seven days: and so we went toward Rome.

\ln Nahnano anadanvtli digogadvganv, Equiyoi iyvdv ale TsoiIdilisdayvdiyi degogatlosilvgi; Quola nasgi dugohv ulihelitselvgi Unelanvhi, ale ugalisdi udanvdadvgi.
\syll ᏀᎾᏃ ᎠᎾᏓᏅᏟ ᏗᎪᎦᏛᎦᏅ, ᎡᏈᏲᎢ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎠᎴ ᏦᎢᎢᏗᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ ᏕᎪᎦᏠᏏᎸᎩ; ᏉᎳ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᎪᎲ ᎤᎵᎮᎵᏤᎸᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎦᎵᏍᏗ ᎤᏓᏅᏓᏛᎩ.
\ft And from thence, when the brethren heard of us, they came to meet us as far as Appii forum, and The three taverns: whom when Paul saw, he thanked God, and took courage.

\ln Lomino wogilutsv, asgohitsuqui ditinidohi aniyvgi duyohiselvgi ugvwiyuhianigatiya ditinidohi; Quolasgini agalisgolvnelvgi unelagi uwasv udediyi, ale ayawisgi ugatidisdiyi.
\syll ᎶᎻᏃ ᏬᎩᎷᏨ, ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏧᏈ ᏗᏘᏂᏙᎯ ᎠᏂᏴᎩ ᏚᏲᎯᏎᎸᎩ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᎠᏂᎦᏘᏯ ᏗᏘᏂᏙᎯ; ᏉᎳᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᎦᎵᏍᎪᎸᏁᎸᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᎩ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎤᏕᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏯᏫᏍᎩ ᎤᎦᏘᏗᏍᏗᏱ.
\ft And when we came to Rome, the centurion delivered the prisoners to the captain of the guard: but Paul was suffered to dwell by himself with a soldier that kept him.

\ln Tsoino winusvlv hia nulistanvgi; Quola duwetlisanvgi nunigvwiyusv Anitsusi; unadatlisanvno hia niduweselvgi; Itsisgaya idadanvtli, ayv vtla gohusdi gatsisganvtselvhi yigi digatseli yvwi, vtla ale agiyostanvhi yigi dikahnawadvsdi digigayvlige geginelvhi; aseno Tsilusilimi tsiyvgi dagvquatinawidvhvgi degvgiyosvgi Anilomiyi.
\syll ᏦᎢᏃ ᏫᏄᏒᎸ ᎯᎠ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎩ; ᏉᎳ ᏚᏪᏟᏌᏅᎩ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ; ᎤᎾᏓᏟᏌᏅᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎢᏥᏍᎦᏯ ᎢᏓᏓᏅᏟ, ᎠᏴ ᎥᏝ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎦᏥᏍᎦᏅᏤᎸᎯ ᏱᎩ ᏗᎦᏤᎵ ᏴᏫ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎩᏲᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᏱᎩ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏗᎩᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᎨᎩᏁᎸᎯ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᏥᏴᎩ ᏓᎬᏆᏘᎾᏫᏛᎲᎩ ᏕᎬᎩᏲᏒᎩ ᎠᏂᎶᎻᏱ.
\ft And it came to pass, that after three days Paul called the chief of the Jews together: and when they were come together, he said unto them, Men and brethren, though I have committed nothing against the people, or customs of our fathers, yet was I delivered prisoner from Jerusalem into the hands of the Romans.

\ln Nasgi gvgigoliyev, yidigvgiyosei, vtlayeno gohusdi ayohuhisdi gvgisdvdisdi yigvgiwadvelei.

\ln Utsatiyeno aquaduli itsvgowadvdiyi, nasgi ditsvyohisediyi gohusdi usdi adanvdo ulisdelvdodi gesvi, nasgi ditsalinigohisdiyi wuliyilohisdiyi;
\syll ᎤᏣᏘᏰᏃ ᎠᏆᏚᎵ ᎢᏨᎪᏩᏛᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏨᏲᎯᏎᏗᏱ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏣᎵᏂᎪᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏭᎵᏱᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ;
\ft For I long to see you, that I may impart unto you some spiritual gift, to the end ye may be established;

\ln Nasgi hia nusdi, nasgi ayv itsulaha igikalisdohisdiyi gvtanvhi ayv nihino utloyi igohiyusvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎢᎩᎧᎵᏍᏙᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎬᏔᏅᎯ ᎠᏴ ᏂᎯᏃ ᎤᏠᏱ ᎢᎪᎯᏳᏒᎢ.
\ft That is, that I may be comforted together with you by the mutual faith both of you and me.

\ln Nasgino idalinvtli vtla nanigatahvnaquo gesesdi yitsvyeliseha, nasgi utsati iyuwagudi daquegotanv witsvlutsediyi, nasgi gohusdi ugatatanvhi nihi nasquo itsehv agigowadvdiyi agiyelvsvgi, nasgiya nusdv anisoi tsunadalenvdv yvwi danewadisvi; aseno gohi iyasdi aquadanuleha.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ ᎥᏝ ᎾᏂᎦᏔᎲᎾᏉ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏱᏨᏰᎵᏎᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎢᏳᏩᎫᏗ ᏓᏇᎪᏔᏅ ᏫᏨᎷᏤᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᎦᏔᏔᏅᎯ ᏂᎯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎢᏤᎲ ᎠᎩᎪᏩᏛᏗᏱ ᎠᎩᏰᎸᏒᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎠᏂᏐᎢ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᏓᏁᏩᏗᏒᎢ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎪᎯ ᎢᏯᏍᏗ ᎠᏆᏓᏄᎴᎭ.
\ft Now I would not have you ignorant, brethren, that oftentimes I purposed to come unto you, (but was let hitherto,) that I might have some fruit among you also, even as among other Gentiles.

\ln Gvgiduga itsula Anigoi ale nvwanadale yvwi, anigatanai ale anigatanai nigesvna.
\syll ᎬᎩᏚᎦ ᎢᏧᎳ ᎠᏂᎪᎢ ᎠᎴ ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴ ᏴᏫ, ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎾᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎾᎢ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.
\ft I am debtor both to the Greeks, and to the Barbarians; both to the wise, and to the unwise.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi igvquadvnedi gesv igai, aquadvnvisdiquo osdv kanohedv itsvyalitsidonediyi Lomi nasquo itsehi nihi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᎬᏆᏛᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᎦᎢ, ᎠᏆᏛᏅᎢᏍᏗᏉ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎢᏨᏯᎵᏥᏙᏁᏗᏱ ᎶᎻ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎢᏤᎯ ᏂᎯ.
\ft So, as much as in me is, I am ready to preach the gospel to you that are at Rome also.

\ln Vtlayeno yigadeosga osdv kanohedv Galonedv utseliga; nasgiyeno Unelanvhi ulinigidiyu gesv gvnigesv igvnehi, nasgi nahna analisdelvdodisgv naniv anohiyuhvsgi; Anitsusi igvyi, ale nasquo Anigoi.
\syll ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᏱᎦᏕᎣᏍᎦ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ; ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᎬᏁᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏀᎾ ᎠᎾᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗᏍᎬ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ; ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎢᎬᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏂᎪᎢ.
\ft For I am not ashamed of the gospel of Christ: for it is the power of God unto salvation to every one that believeth; to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.

\ln Nahnayeno gvnigesv igvnelvhi nusdv udadudalesdodi gesv Unelanvhi, gohiyudi gesv nvdvdalehvsgi, ale gohiyudi gesv wasquadisdisgi; nasgiya nigvnvgowelvi, Duyugodvsgini iyadvnehi gohiyudi gesv udvnidisdesdi.
\syll ᏀᎾᏰᏃ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᎬᏁᎸᎯ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎤᏓᏚᏓᎴᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏛᏓᎴᎲᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏩᏍᏆᏗᏍᏗᏍᎩ; ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏂᎬᏅᎪᏪᎸᎢ, ᏚᏳᎪᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᎯ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏛᏂᏗᏍᏕᏍᏗ.
\ft For therein is the righteousness of God revealed from faith to faith: as it is written, The just shall live by faith.

\ln Unalanvhiyeno utalawohisdi gesv gvnigesv igvnelvhi galvloi tsvdidalehvsga tsidagatilega nudalesv Unelanvhi nunilvquodvna gesv, ale niduyugodvna iyunadvnedi gesv yvwi, nasgi duyugodv tsaninahisdiha uyo dunilvwisdanehvi;
\syll ᎤᎾᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ ᎤᏔᎳᏬᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᎬᏁᎸᎯ ᎦᎸᎶᎢ ᏨᏗᏓᎴᎲᏍᎦ ᏥᏓᎦᏘᎴᎦ ᏄᏓᎴᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏄᏂᎸᏉᏛᎾ ᎨᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᏚᏳᎪᏛᎾ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏴᏫ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᏣᏂᏀᎢᏍᏗᎭ ᎤᏲ ᏚᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎢ;
\ft For the wrath of God is revealed from heaven against all ungodliness and unrighteousness of men, who hold the truth in unrighteousness;

\ln Nvdigalisdodiha nasgi na Unelanvhi yeli gvgadovhisdodi gesv gvnigesv igvnelvhi anehvi; Unelanvhiyeno dunanugowiselv.
\syll ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏰᎵ ᎬᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᎬᏁᎸᎯ ᎠᏁᎲᎢ; ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ ᏚᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᎸ.
\ft Because that which may be known of God is manifest in them; for God hath shewed it unto them.

\ln Nasgiyeno digvgowadvdi nigesvna gesv tsutseliga gvnigesviyu digvgowadvdi igi elohi tsudotlvnv nvdagvwadalenvdv, digagolisdodi igi tsudalenvdv digotlvnvhi gesvi, nasgi nvtsudalenvhvna ulinigidiyu gesvi, ale Unelanvhi gesvi; nasgi iyusdi vtla yuniha tsunatlvwisdodi;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᏗᎬᎪᏩᏛᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒ ᏧᏤᎵᎦ ᎬᏂᎨᏒᎢᏳ ᏗᎬᎪᏩᏛᏗ ᎢᎩ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏧᏙᏢᏅ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏓᎴᏅᏛ, ᏗᎦᎪᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᎢᎩ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏗᎪᏢᏅᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏧᏓᎴᏅᎲᎾ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎥᏝ ᏳᏂᎭ ᏧᎾᏢᏫᏍᏙᏗ;
\ft For the invisible things of him from the creation of the world are clearly seen, being understood by the things that are made, even his eternal power and Godhead; so that they are without excuse:

\ln Unigadovsvyeno Unelanvhi, vtla Unelanvhi galvquododi gesv yunilvquodotanei, vtla ale yanaliheligei, anadanvtesgvsgini asequoquo nulistanei, ale tsunegu tsuninawi dulisihvsei;
\syll ᎤᏂᎦᏙᎥᏒᏰᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎥᏝ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎦᎸᏉᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏳᏂᎸᏉᏙᏔᏁᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᏯᎾᎵᎮᎵᎨᎢ, ᎠᎾᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏎᏉᏉ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏁᎫ ᏧᏂᎾᏫ ᏚᎵᏏᎲᏎᎢ;
\ft Because that, when they knew God, they glorified him not as God, neither were thankful; but became vain in their imaginations, and their foolish heart was darkened.

\ln Anigatanai anatselvsgvi, uninegu nunalistanei;
\syll ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎾᎢ ᎠᎾᏤᎸᏍᎬᎢ, ᎤᏂᏁᎫ ᏄᎾᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ;
\ft Professing themselves to be wise, they became fools,

\ln Ale uninetliyvse galvquodiyu gesv Unelanvhi ayohusgi nigesvna utseliga, ayohusgi yvwi ditlilostanvhi nasgiya nunvnelei, ale tsisqua, ale nvgi dininvsadi, ale anadanasinidohi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏁᏟᏴᏎ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᏲᎱᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎠᏲᎱᏍᎩ ᏴᏫ ᏗᏟᎶᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᏅᏁᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᏍᏆ, ᎠᎴ ᏅᎩ ᏗᏂᏅᏌᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎾᏓᎾᏏᏂᏙᎯ.
\ft And changed the glory of the uncorruptible God into an image made like to corruptible man, and to birds, and fourfooted beasts, and creeping things.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi Unelanvhi nasquo deuyose gadaha tsunilvwisdanediyi unvdodiyi unvsv tsuninawiyi unasulvnvdi gesvi, tsunisotlvisdodiyi diniyelv unvsvquo nidanadadvnehvi;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏕᎤᏲᏎ ᎦᏓᎭ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᎤᏅᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᏅᏒ ᏧᏂᎾᏫᏱ ᎤᎾᏑᎸᏅᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏧᏂᏐᏢᎢᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏗᏂᏰᎸ ᎤᏅᏒᏉ ᏂᏓᎾᏓᏛᏁᎲᎢ;
\ft Wherefore God also gave them up to uncleanness through the lusts of their own hearts, to dishonour their own bodies between themselves:

\ln Nasgi udohiyusv Unelanvhi unohesgi uninetliyvstane gayegogi gesvi, ale utli igai unadadolisdanele ale gohusdi unadvnele agotlvnvhiquo gesv esgaquo igai uwotlvnvhi, nasgi galvquododi tsigi nigohilvi.  Emenv.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏃᎮᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᏁᏟᏴᏍᏔᏁ ᎦᏰᎪᎩ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏟ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎤᎾᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎴ ᎠᎴ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᎾᏛᏁᎴ ᎠᎪᏢᏅᎯᏉ ᎨᏒ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎤᏬᏢᏅᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎸᏉᏙᏗ ᏥᎩ ᏂᎪᎯᎸᎢ.  ᎡᎺᏅ.
\ft Who changed the truth of God into a lie, and worshipped and served the creature more than the Creator, who is blessed for ever. Amen.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi Unelanvhi deuyosvgi udehohisdi unadulvnvdiyi; nasquoyeno anigeyv tsunatseliga nasgi ahv iyunadvnedi gesv uninetliyvstane nasgi ahv iyunadvnedi nigesvna gesvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏕᎤᏲᏒᎩ ᎤᏕᎰᎯᏍᏗ ᎤᎾᏚᎸᏅᏗᏱ; ᎾᏍᏉᏰᏃ ᎠᏂᎨᏴ ᏧᎾᏤᎵᎦ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎲ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏂᏁᏟᏴᏍᏔᏁ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎲ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᏁᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft For this cause God gave them up unto vile affections: for even their women did change the natural use into that which is against nature:

\ln Ale nasquo anisgaya duniyosge iyunadvnedi gesv nasgi anigeyv geganelanvhi ugvwali gesvi, utsati danadadelayosge unvsvquo gesvi; anisgaya anisgayaquo gohusdi danadadvdisge dunilvwisdanehe nasgi udehohisdi gesvi, ale unvsv gesv unaliwadvehe duyugodv gegaguyvedi gesv nasgi unilidasdisgvi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ ᏚᏂᏲᏍᎨ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏂᎨᏴ ᎨᎦᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᏣᏘ ᏓᎾᏓᏕᎳᏲᏍᎨ ᎤᏅᏒᏉ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯᏉ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏓᎾᏓᏛᏗᏍᎨ ᏚᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎮ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏕᎰᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏅᏒ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎾᎵᏩᏛᎡᎮ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᎦᎫᏴᎡᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᎵᏓᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ.
\ft And likewise also the men, leaving the natural use of the woman, burned in their lust one toward another; men with men working that which is unseemly, and receiving in themselves that recompence of their error which was meet.

\ln Ale nasgi Osi nuniyelvsvna tsigese nusdv Unelanvhi unigadovsv unisquanigododiyi, Unelanvhi deuyose getsisonvistanvhi iyunalisdodiyi dunadanvdvi, nasgi igvdvnedi nigesvna gesv iyunadvnediyi;
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏏ ᏄᏂᏰᎸᏒᎾ ᏥᎨᏎ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏂᎦᏙᎥᏒ ᎤᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏙᏗᏱ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏕᎤᏲᏎ ᎨᏥᏐᏅᎢᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏚᎾᏓᏅᏛᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎬᏛᏁᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᏁᏗᏱ;
\ft And even as they did not like to retain God in their knowledge, God gave them over to a reprobate mind, to do those things which are not convenient;

\ln Unikalitsvhi gesv nudalesv niduyugodvna gesvi, udelidv dinisidi gesvi, uyo iyadadvnedi gesvi, tsugvwalodi agvvhisdi gesvi, uniyo gesvi; unikalitsvhi advyugedi gesvi, didahisdi gesvi, ditiyosdi gesvi, atlonuhedv, uyo digalvwisdanedi gesvi; anadonvihi,
\syll ᎤᏂᎧᎵᏨᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏄᏓᎴᏒ ᏂᏚᏳᎪᏛᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᏗᏂᏏᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᏲ ᎢᏯᏓᏛᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎠᎬᎥᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᏂᏲ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎤᏂᎧᎵᏨᎯ ᎠᏛᏳᎨᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏗᏓᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏗᏘᏲᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᏠᏄᎮᏛ, ᎤᏲ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎠᎾᏙᏅᎢᎯ,
\ft Being filled with all unrighteousness, fornication, wickedness, covetousness, maliciousness; full of envy, murder, debate, deceit, malignity; whisperers,

\ln Uyo dinadanohelidohi, Unelanvhi aniniquatihi, gvwanadasotlvdi; unatlvquodi, unatlvquasadi, anoluwatisgi tsudalenvdv uyoi, nidunohiyusvna tsunigayvligei,
\syll ᎤᏲ ᏗᎾᏓᏃᎮᎵᏙᎯ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᏂᏂᏆᏘᎯ, ᎬᏩᎾᏓᏐᏢᏗ; ᎤᎾᏢᏉᏗ, ᎤᎾᏢᏆᏌᏗ, ᎠᏃᎷᏩᏘᏍᎩ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎤᏲᎢ, ᏂᏚᏃᎯᏳᏒᎾ ᏧᏂᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ,
\ft Backbiters, haters of God, despiteful, proud, boasters, inventors of evil things, disobedient to parents,

\ln Nunolitsadvna, kanohedv dunatlohisdv aniyosdisgi, gohusdi tsunvna nidunigeyusvna, gvwanohisdi nigesvna, nunadadolitsadvna;
\syll ᏄᏃᎵᏣᏛᎾ, ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏚᎾᏠᎯᏍᏛ ᎠᏂᏲᏍᏗᏍᎩ, ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏧᏅᎾ ᏂᏚᏂᎨᏳᏒᎾ, ᎬᏩᏃᎯᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᏄᎾᏓᏙᎵᏣᏛᎾ;
\ft Without understanding, covenantbreakers, without natural affection, implacable, unmerciful:

\ln Nasgi tsanigataha nusdv degugodisgv Unelanvhi, nasgi gilo nasgi iyusdi tsulvwisdanehi yeliquo digvwaniyohuhisdi gesvi, vtla nasgiquo nanadvnehv uwasv yigi, osiyusgini duniyelvha nasgi iyanadvnehi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏣᏂᎦᏔᎭ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏕᎫᎪᏗᏍᎬ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎩᎶ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏧᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᏰᎵᏉ ᏗᎬᏩᏂᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎾᏍᎩᏉ ᎾᎾᏛᏁᎲ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏱᎩ, ᎣᏏᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᏚᏂᏰᎸᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏯᎾᏛᏁᎯ.
\ft Who knowing the judgment of God, that they which commit such things are worthy of death, not only do the same, but have pleasure in them that do them.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi vtla ditsatlvwisdodi yitsaha, nihi yvwi nitsivquo ditsugodisgi; nahnayeno nvwadale dehiyugodanehv tsvsv dehadadugodaneha; nihiyeno dugodisgi nasgiya nihadvneha.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎥᏝ ᏗᏣᏢᏫᏍᏙᏗ ᏱᏣᎭ, ᏂᎯ ᏴᏫ ᏂᏥᎥᏉ ᏗᏧᎪᏗᏍᎩ; ᏀᎾᏰᏃ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᏕᎯᏳᎪᏓᏁᎲ ᏨᏒ ᏕᎭᏓᏚᎪᏓᏁᎭ; ᏂᎯᏰᏃ ᏚᎪᏗᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏂᎭᏛᏁᎭ.
\ft Therefore thou art inexcusable, O man, whosoever thou art that judgest: for wherein thou judgest another, thou condemnest thyself; for thou that judgest doest the same things.

\ln Aseno idigataha nasgi Unelanvhi degugodisgv duyugodv gesvi, nasgi degugodanehv nasgi iyanadvnehi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎢᏗᎦᏔᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏕᎫᎪᏗᏍᎬ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏕᎫᎪᏓᏁᎲ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏯᎾᏛᏁᎯ.
\ft But we are sure that the judgment of God is according to truth against them which commit such things.

\ln Tsigono hadanvtesgv nihi yvwi, nasgi dugodanehi tsigi nasgi iyanadvnehi, ale nasgiya ihadvnehi tsigi, tadudalaeli Unelanvhi tsuwugododi gesvi?
\syll ᏥᎪᏃ ᎭᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ ᏂᎯ ᏴᏫ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᎪᏓᏁᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏯᎾᏛᏁᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎢᎭᏛᏁᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᏔᏚᏓᎳᎡᎵ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᏭᎪᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ?
\ft And thinkest thou this, O man, that judgest them which do such things, and doest the same, that thou shalt escape the judgment of God?

\ln Tsigoge nvlisaliquo hiyelvsga nutsuquisdv udanvtiyu gesv ale gvnidiyu gesvi, ale gohidiyu unelagi svlisgvi, nigatahvnaquo gesv nasgi Unelanvhi udanvtiyu gesv tsatinegv tsanetliyvsdi gesv tsadanvdvi?
\syll ᏥᎪᎨ ᏅᎵᏌᎵᏉ ᎯᏰᎸᏍᎦ ᏄᏧᏈᏍᏛ ᎤᏓᏅᏘᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᏗᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎪᎯᏗᏳ ᎤᏁᎳᎩ ᏒᎵᏍᎬᎢ, ᏂᎦᏔᎲᎾᏉ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏓᏅᏘᏳ ᎨᏒ ᏣᏘᏁᎬ ᏣᏁᏟᏴᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏣᏓᏅᏛᎢ?
\ft Or despisest thou the riches of his goodness and forbearance and longsuffering; not knowing that the goodness of God leadeth thee to repentance?

\ln Nasgiyasgini hisdayiyu gesv ale tsanetliyvdv nigesvna tsanawi hitlisiha utalawohisdi gesv tsatseli iyulisdodi nahiyu iga aliyilolvha udalawohisdi gesv ale Unelanvhi duyugodv tsuwugododi gesv gananugowisvha;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏯᏍᎩᏂ ᎯᏍᏓᏱᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏣᏁᏟᏴᏛ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏣᎾᏫ ᎯᏟᏏᎭ ᎤᏔᎳᏬᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏣᏤᎵ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᏀᎢᏳ ᎢᎦ ᎠᎵᏱᎶᎸᎭ ᎤᏓᎳᏬᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᏧᏭᎪᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎦᎾᏄᎪᏫᏒᎭ;
\ft But after thy hardness and impenitent heart treasurest up unto thyself wrath against the day of wrath and revelation of the righteous judgment of God;

\ln Nasgi naniv tsuguyvedi tsigi nasgiya nusdv dunilvwisdanelvi;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏧᎫᏴᎡᏗ ᏥᎩ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏚᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸᎢ;
\ft Who will render to every man according to his deeds:

\ln Nasgi osdv dunilvwisdanehv dinvnidiyu gvnaisv tsuniyasdiha digvwalvsadv ale galvquodiyu gesv ale ayohuhisdi nigesvna gesvi, alisquadisgi nigesvna gvnidv tsuguyvdanedi tsigi;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏚᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᏗᏅᏂᏗᏳ ᎬᎾᎢᏒ ᏧᏂᏯᏍᏗᎭ ᏗᎬᏩᎸᏌᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎬᏂᏛ ᏧᎫᏴᏓᏁᏗ ᏥᎩ;
\ft To them who by patient continuance in well doing seek for glory and honour and immortality, eternal life:

\ln Nasgini [Unelanvhi] dinigatilegi tsigi, ale nanohiyuhvsgvna tsigi duyugodv gesvi, niduyugodvnasgini gesv anohiyuhvsgi tsigi; utalawohisdi ale uhnalvhi gesv unilutsedi gesesdi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯdata is invalid ᏗᏂᎦᏘᎴᎩ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎬᎾ ᏥᎩ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏂᏚᏳᎪᏛᎾᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᏥᎩ; ᎤᏔᎳᏬᎯᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎿᎸᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏂᎷᏤᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft But unto them that are contentious, and do not obey the truth, but obey unrighteousness, indignation and wrath,

\ln Udeyadodi gesv ale uwelihisdi gesv unilutsedi gesesdi naniv anisiyvwiha gesvi, nasgi uyo iyanadvnehi, Anitsusi igvyi, ale nasquo Anigoi;
\syll ᎤᏕᏯᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏪᎵᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏂᎷᏤᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎠᏂᏏᏴᏫᎭ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏲ ᎢᏯᎾᏛᏁᎯ, ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎢᎬᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏂᎪᎢ;
\ft Tribulation and anguish, upon every soul of man that doeth evil, of the Jew first, and also of the Gentile;

\ln Digvwalvsadvsgini ale galvquodiyu gesv, ale nvwadohiyadv unilutsedi gesesdi naniv anisiyvwiha gesv osdv iyanadvnehi, Anitsusi igvyi, ale nasquo Anigoi;
\syll ᏗᎬᏩᎸᏌᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᎴ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᎤᏂᎷᏤᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎠᏂᏏᏴᏫᎭ ᎨᏒ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎢᏯᎾᏛᏁᎯ, ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎢᎬᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏂᎪᎢ;
\ft But glory, honour, and peace, to every man that worketh good, to the Jew first, and also to the Gentile:

\ln Unelanvhiyeno vtla gilo digalvquodisgi yigi.
\syll ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᏗᎦᎸᏉᏗᏍᎩ ᏱᎩ.
\ft For there is no respect of persons with God.

\ln Nanivyeno gilo unisganvtsvhi dikahnawadvsdi nunihvna nasquo dikahnawadvsdi nigvtanvna unigiliyoisdi; ale naniv gilo unisganvtsvhi dikahnawadvsdi unihi, nasgi dikahnawadvsdi gegvdanedi digegugodanedi gesesdi,
\syll ᎾᏂᎥᏰᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏂᏍᎦᏅᏨᎯ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏄᏂᎲᎾ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏂᎬᏔᏅᎾ ᎤᏂᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗ; ᎠᎴ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏂᏍᎦᏅᏨᎯ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎤᏂᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎨᎬᏓᏁᏗ ᏗᎨᎫᎪᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ,
\ft For as many as have sinned without law shall also perish without law: and as many as have sinned in the law shall be judged by the law;

\ln Vtlayeno dikahnawadvsdi anadvgisgi nanisganvna yigi Unelanvhi dakanvi, dikahnawadvsdisgini nigawesgv iyanadvnehi nasgi unadudalesdi gesesdi.
\syll ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎠᎾᏛᎩᏍᎩ ᎾᏂᏍᎦᏅᎾ ᏱᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏓᎧᏅᎢ, ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎬ ᎢᏯᎾᏛᏁᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᏚᏓᎴᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft (For not the hearers of the law are just before God, but the doers of the law shall be justified.

\ln Tsunadalenvdvyeno yvwi dikahnawadvsdi nunihvna tsigi, unvsv unadanvtedv dikahnawadvsdi nigawesgv yinanadvneha, nasgi hia, dikahnawadvsdi nunihvna tsigi, unvsvquo gesv dikahnawadvsdi nanalisdiha;
\syll ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛᏰᏃ ᏴᏫ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏄᏂᎲᎾ ᏥᎩ, ᎤᏅᏒ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏖᏛ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎬ ᏱᎾᎾᏛᏁᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ, ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏄᏂᎲᎾ ᏥᎩ, ᎤᏅᏒᏉ ᎨᏒ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎾᎾᎵᏍᏗᎭ;
\ft For when the Gentiles, which have not the law, do by nature the things contained in the law, these, having not the law, are a law unto themselves:

\ln Nasgi gvnigesv nanvneha dikahnawadvsdi nigawesgv iyadvnedi gesv tsuninawiyi gowelvi, dunadanvdv nasquo gohiyudodisgvi, ale anadanvtesgv danadaduhisdisgv, ale danadadudalesgvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎾᏅᏁᎭ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎬ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏧᏂᎾᏫᏱ ᎪᏪᎸᎢ, ᏚᎾᏓᏅᏛ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎪᎯᏳᏙᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎾᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ ᏓᎾᏓᏚᎯᏍᏗᏍᎬ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᎾᏓᏚᏓᎴᏍᎬᎢ.
\ft Which shew the work of the law written in their hearts, their conscience also bearing witness, and their thoughts the mean while accusing or else excusing one another;)

\ln Nahiyu iga Unelanvhi udelidv gesv yvwi unatseliga degugodanelvha, Tsisa Galonedv agvdisgvi, nasgiya nigawesgv aquatseli osdv kanohedv.
\syll ᏀᎢᏳ ᎢᎦ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᎨᏒ ᏴᏫ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ ᏕᎫᎪᏓᏁᎸᎭ, ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎠᎬᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎬ ᎠᏆᏤᎵ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ.
\ft In the day when God shall judge the secrets of men by Jesus Christ according to my gospel.

\ln Gvniyuquo, Atsusi detsadov, ale dikahnawadvsdi tsalisgasdodi, ale hiyatlvquasdodi Unelanvhi,
\syll ᎬᏂᏳᏉ, ᎠᏧᏏ ᏕᏣᏙᎥ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏣᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᏯᏢᏆᏍᏙᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ,
\ft Behold, thou art called a Jew, and restest in the law, and makest thy boast of God,

\ln Ale higataha nusdv osiyu uyelvdi gesvi, ale higowatiha tsudalenvdv tsudalehnai gesvi, etseyonvhi dikahnawadvsdiyi;
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎯᎦᏔᎭ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎤᏰᎸᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎪᏩᏘᎭ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏧᏓᎴᎿᎢ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎡᏤᏲᏅᎯ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗᏱ;
\ft And knowest his will, and approvest the things that are more excellent, being instructed out of the law;

\ln Ale vtla yitsadlasidveha tsvsv tatinidohi gesv dinigewi, iga tatisdanehi gesv ulisigv anini,
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏣᏜᏏᏛᎡᎭ ᏨᏒ ᏔᏘᏂᏙᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏗᏂᎨᏫ, ᎢᎦ ᏔᏘᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎵᏏᎬ ᎠᏂᏂ,
\ft And art confident that thou thyself art a guide of the blind, a light of them which are in darkness,

\ln Teyohvsgi gesv nunadanvdvna, diniyoli teyohvsgi, nasgi tsasquanigodi agadovhisdi gesv ale duyugodv gesv ditlilostanvhi dikahnawadvsdiyi gowelvi.
\syll ᏖᏲᎲᏍᎩ ᎨᏒ ᏄᎾᏓᏅᏛᎾ, ᏗᏂᏲᎵ ᏖᏲᎲᏍᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏣᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᎠᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒ ᏗᏟᎶᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗᏱ ᎪᏪᎸᎢ.
\ft An instructor of the foolish, a teacher of babes, which hast the form of knowledge and of the truth in the law.

\ln Nasgino nihi nvwadale hiyeyohvsgi tsigi, tlasgo tsvsv yadadeyohvsga?  Nihi halitsidohvsgv tlesdi tsanosgisvgi tsadiha, tsigo ihinosgiha?
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏂᎯ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᎯᏰᏲᎲᏍᎩ ᏥᎩ, ᏝᏍᎪ ᏨᏒ ᏯᏓᏕᏲᎲᏍᎦ?  ᏂᎯ ᎭᎵᏥᏙᎲᏍᎬ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏣᏃᏍᎩᏒᎩ ᏣᏗᎭ, ᏥᎪ ᎢᎯᏃᏍᎩᎭ?
\ft Thou therefore which teachest another, teachest thou not thyself? thou that preachest a man should not steal, dost thou steal?

\ln Nihi, tlesdi tsadayonelvgi tsadiha, tsigo ihadayoneha?  nihi, Unelenvhi diyelvhi tsidehiniquatiha, tsigo nihi gohusdi galvquodi hisotlvdiha?
\syll ᏂᎯ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᏣᏓᏲᏁᎸᎩ ᏣᏗᎭ, ᏥᎪ ᎢᎭᏓᏲᏁᎭ?  ᏂᎯ, ᎤᏁᎴᏅᎯ ᏗᏰᎸᎯ ᏥᏕᎯᏂᏆᏘᎭ, ᏥᎪ ᏂᎯ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎦᎸᏉᏗ ᎯᏐᏢᏗᎭ?
\ft Thou that sayest a man should not commit adultery, dost thou commit adultery? thou that abhorrest idols, dost thou commit sacrilege?

\ln Nihi dikahnawadvsdi tsatlvquadodiha, hiyosdisgvsgo dikahnawadvsdi asotlvhi niyvne Unelanvhi?
\syll ᏂᎯ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏣᏢᏆᏙᏗᎭ, ᎯᏲᏍᏗᏍᎬᏍᎪ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎠᏐᏢᎯ ᏂᏴᏁ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ?
\ft Thou that makest thy boast of the law, through breaking the law dishonourest thou God?

\ln Unelanvhiyeno dudov gvwanisotlvdi tsunadalenvdv yvwi anehvi nihi itsvnisadv, nasgiya nigvnv gowelvi.
\syll ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ ᏚᏙᎥ ᎬᏩᏂᏐᏢᏗ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᎠᏁᎲᎢ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏨᏂᏌᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏂᎬᏅ ᎪᏪᎸᎢ.
\ft For the name of God is blasphemed among the Gentiles through you, as it is written.

\ln Ahusdesdiyeno gesv udohiyuhi tsasdeliha iyuno dikahnawadvsdi nigawesgv yihnadvneha; iyusgini hiyosdisgi yigi dikahnawadvsdi, etsahusdeselvhi gesv etsahusdeselvhiquo nigesvna nigalisdiha.
\syll ᎠᎱᏍᏕᏍᏗᏰᏃ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᏣᏍᏕᎵᎭ ᎢᏳᏃ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎬ ᏱᎿᏛᏁᎭ; ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎯᏲᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᏱᎩ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ, ᎡᏣᎱᏍᏕᏎᎸᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎡᏣᎱᏍᏕᏎᎸᎯᏉ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᎭ.
\ft For circumcision verily profiteth, if thou keep the law: but if thou be a breaker of the law, thy circumcision is made uncircumcision.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi iyuno atsiusdeselvhi nigesvna yasquanigodiha dikahnawadvsdi nasgiya nigvnvi, tlasgo natsiusdeselvna gesv atsiusdeselvhi gesv atsiyelvnanedi yigagi?
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏳᏃ ᎠᏥᎤᏍᏕᏎᎸᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏯᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗᎭ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏂᎬᏅᎢ, ᏝᏍᎪ ᎾᏥᎤᏍᏕᏎᎸᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏥᎤᏍᏕᏎᎸᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏥᏰᎸᎾᏁᏗ ᏱᎦᎩ?
\ft Therefore if the uncircumcision keep the righteousness of the law, shall not his uncircumcision be counted for circumcision?

\ln Ale tlasgo atsiusdeselvhi nigesvna, nasgi udenvquo nusdv dikahnawadvsdi asquanigodisgi yidogetsugodasi nihi, goweli ale ahusdesdi gesv digvdi dikahnawadvsdi hiyosdisgi?
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏝᏍᎪ ᎠᏥᎤᏍᏕᏎᎸᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏕᏅᏉ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎠᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗᏍᎩ ᏱᏙᎨᏧᎪᏓᏏ ᏂᎯ, ᎪᏪᎵ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎱᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏗᎬᏗ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎯᏲᏍᏗᏍᎩ?
\ft And shall not uncircumcision which is by nature, if it fulfill the law, judge thee, who by the letter and circumcision dost transgress the law?

\ln Vtlayeno nasgi na Atsusi yigi, gaduquo iditlv Atsusi yigi; vtla ale nasgi na ahusdesdi gesv yigi, gaduquo iditlv uquedalvquo yigi;
\syll ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᏧᏏ ᏱᎩ, ᎦᏚᏉ ᎢᏗᏢ ᎠᏧᏏ ᏱᎩ; ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᎱᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏱᎩ, ᎦᏚᏉ ᎢᏗᏢ ᎤᏇᏓᎸᏉ ᏱᎩ;
\ft For he is not a Jew, which is one outwardly; neither is that circumcision, which is outward in the flesh:

\ln Nasgisgini na Atsusi, nasgi hawiniditlv Atsusi tsigi, ale nasgi na ahusdesdi gesv unawiyi ehi tsigi, udanvdogihi ehi, vtlano goweliquo nigawesgv dikahnawadegi; nasgi vtla yvwiquo gvwalvquododi yigi, Unelanvhisgini.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ Ꮎ ᎠᏧᏏ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎭᏫᏂᏗᏢ ᎠᏧᏏ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᎱᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎾᏫᏱ ᎡᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎤᏓᏅᏙᎩᎯ ᎡᎯ, ᎥᏝᏃ ᎪᏪᎵᏉ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎬ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏕᎩ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎥᏝ ᏴᏫᏉ ᎬᏩᎸᏉᏙᏗ ᏱᎩ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏍᎩᏂ.
\ft But he is a Jew, which is one inwardly; and circumcision is that of the heart, in the spirit, and not in the letter; whose praise is not of men, but of God.

\ln Gadogeno usdv utli nudvnv Atsusi?  ale gado usdv gvwadasdelvdi ahusdesdi gesvi?
\syll ᎦᏙᎨᏃ ᎤᏍᏛ ᎤᏟ ᏄᏛᏅ ᎠᏧᏏ?  ᎠᎴ ᎦᏙ ᎤᏍᏛ ᎬᏩᏓᏍᏕᎸᏗ ᎠᎱᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ?
\ft What advantage then hath the Jew? or what profit is there of circumcision?

\ln Utsati nigav nudalesvi; nugvwiyusv adina nvdigalisdodi nasgi gegagenvyv Unelanvhi unetsvi.
\syll ᎤᏣᏘ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏄᏓᎴᏒᎢ; ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏗᎾ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᎦᎨᏅᏴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏁᏨᎢ.
\ft Much every way: chiefly, because that unto them were committed the oracles of God.

\ln Gadono iyu igadv nunohiyunvna yigi?  Tsigo nunohiyunvna gesv asequoquo yinigvga Unelanvhi gagohiyudi gesvi?
\syll ᎦᏙᏃ ᎢᏳ ᎢᎦᏛ ᏄᏃᎯᏳᏅᎾ ᏱᎩ?  ᏥᎪ ᏄᏃᎯᏳᏅᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏎᏉᏉ ᏱᏂᎬᎦ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎦᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ?
\ft For what if some did not believe? shall their unbelief make the faith of God without effect?

\ln Gvwatlisdi; Vv, Unelanvhi duyugodv kanegi gesesdi, nanivno yvwi aniyegogi gesesdi; Nasgiya hia nigvnv gowelvi, nasgi nisganvna iyulisdodiyi hinegvi, ale tsadasegogisdiyi hnaquo dehugotanvha.
\syll ᎬᏩᏟᏍᏗ; ᎥᎥ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎧᏁᎩ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎾᏂᎥᏃ ᏴᏫ ᎠᏂᏰᎪᎩ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏅ ᎪᏪᎸᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᏍᎦᏅᎾ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎯᏁᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏣᏓᏎᎪᎩᏍᏗᏱ ᎿᏉ ᏕᎱᎪᏔᏅᎭ.
\ft God forbid: yea, let God be true, but every man a liar; as it is written, That thou mightest be justified in thy sayings, and mightest overcome when thou art judged.

\ln Aseno iyuno niduyugodvna nogadvnelv gvnigesv yinigvneha duyugodv iyadvnehi gesv Unelanvhi, gado dadadvni?  asganvgasgo Unelanvhi nasgi tsidasdvdisdodiha?  (yvwiquo iyuwesdi nitsiweha).
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎢᏳᏃ ᏂᏚᏳᎪᏛᎾ ᏃᎦᏛᏁᎸ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏱᏂᎬᏁᎭ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎦᏙ ᏓᏓᏛᏂ?  ᎠᏍᎦᏅᎦᏍᎪ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏓᏍᏛᏗᏍᏙᏗᎭ?  ᏴᏫᏉ ᎢᏳᏪᏍᏗ ᏂᏥᏪᎭ.
\ft But if our unrighteousness commend the righteousness of God, what shall we say? Is God unrighteous who taketh vengeance? (I speak as a man)

\ln Gvwatlisdi; iyuyeno nasgi yinusdi gado yigalisdoda Unelanvhi elohi yidegugodasi?
\syll ᎬᏩᏟᏍᏗ; ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᏄᏍᏗ ᎦᏙ ᏱᎦᎵᏍᏙᏓ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏱᏕᎫᎪᏓᏏ?
\ft God forbid: for then how shall God judge the world?

\ln Iyuyeno duyugodv kanegi gesv Unelanvhi utli igai unequotsvhi yigi nasgi galvquodiyu nuwanehvi ayv gatsigohvsgv yinvdigalisdodiha, gadono ayv nasquo asiquo dvquugodaneha tsisgana nasgiyai?
\syll ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎧᏁᎩ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏟ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎤᏁᏉᏨᎯ ᏱᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᏄᏩᏁᎲᎢ ᎠᏴ ᎦᏥᎪᎲᏍᎬ ᏱᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ, ᎦᏙᏃ ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏏᏉ ᏛᏊᎪᏓᏁᎭ ᏥᏍᎦᎾ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ?
\ft For if the truth of God hath more abounded through my lie unto his glory; why yet am I also judged as a sinner?

\ln Alesgo vtla nasgi hia yugvwiyuha, (nasgi gayogisotlvdv tsigoginoheha, ale gilo nasgi naniwe tsigogoseha,) Uyo degilvwisdanehesdi nasgi osdv gesv uliyeilvsdiyi?  nasgi unisganvtsv tsunadugodanediyi duyugodi.
\syll ᎠᎴᏍᎪ ᎥᏝ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏳᎬᏫᏳᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏲᎩᏐᏢᏛ ᏥᎪᎩᏃᎮᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏂᏪ ᏥᎪᎪᏎᎭ, ᎤᏲ ᏕᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎵᏰᎢᎸᏍᏗᏱ?  ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᏧᎾᏚᎪᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᏚᏳᎪᏗ.
\ft And not rather, (as we be slanderously reported, and as some affirm that we say,) Let us do evil, that good may come? whose damnation is just.

\ln Gadoge ugvwiyuha?  utlisgo nidohi?  Vtla usdigidv unv; gayulayeno degugotanv nasgi itsula Anitsusi ale tsunadalenvdv yvwi, nigadiyu asganvisdi gesv unadanuyvdvi.
\syll ᎦᏙᎨ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎭ?  ᎤᏟᏍᎪ ᏂᏙᎯ?  ᎥᏝ ᎤᏍᏗᎩᏛ ᎤᏅ; ᎦᏳᎳᏰᏃ ᏕᎫᎪᏔᏅ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏧᎳ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎠᎴ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ, ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᎠᏍᎦᏅᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎾᏓᏄᏴᏛᎢ.
\ft What then? are we better than they? No, in no wise: for we have before proved both Jews and Gentiles, that they are all under sin;

\ln Nasgiya hia tsinigvnv tsigowela, Vtla gilo osiyu iyadvnehi yigi, vtla, saquo unv.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᎬᏅ ᏥᎪᏪᎳ, ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᎯ ᏱᎩ, ᎥᏝ, ᏌᏉ ᎤᏅ.
\ft As it is written, There is none righteous, no, not one:

\ln Vtla gilo goligi yigi; vtla gilo Unelanvhi uyohi yigi.
\syll ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᎪᎵᎩ ᏱᎩ; ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏲᎯ ᏱᎩ.
\ft There is none that understandeth, there is none that seeketh after God.

\ln Nanivquo unatlesv ganvnvi, iyunasdihaquo gohusdi digvdodi nigesvna nunalistanv; vtla gilo osiyu iyadvnehi yigi, vtla saquo unv.
\syll ᎾᏂᎥᏉ ᎤᎾᏞᏒ ᎦᏅᏅᎢ, ᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗᎭᏉ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏗᎬᏙᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏄᎾᎵᏍᏔᏅ; ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᎯ ᏱᎩ, ᎥᏝ ᏌᏉ ᎤᏅ.
\ft They are all gone out of the way, they are together become unprofitable; there is none that doeth good, no, not one.

\ln Unigisdiyi didanisodiyi ulisduidv tsigeso nasgiyai; dininogoi anadalonuhedisgoi, inadv duninehv adahihi dunihanegalv hawiniditlv dunineha.
\syll ᎤᏂᎩᏍᏗᏱ ᏗᏓᏂᏐᏗᏱ ᎤᎵᏍᏚᎢᏛ ᏥᎨᏐ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ; ᏗᏂᏃᎪᎢ ᎠᎾᏓᎶᏄᎮᏗᏍᎪᎢ, ᎢᎾᏛ ᏚᏂᏁᎲ ᎠᏓᎯᎯ ᏚᏂᎭᏁᎦᎸ ᎭᏫᏂᏗᏢ ᏚᏂᏁᎭ.
\ft Their throat is an open sepulchre; with their tongues they have used deceit; the poison of asps is under their lips:

\ln Nasgi diniholi dikaliwohi adasginvdisdi gesv ale uyvsdi gesvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏂᎰᎵ ᏗᎧᎵᏬᎯ ᎠᏓᏍᎩᏅᏗᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏴᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Whose mouth is full of cursing and bitterness:

\ln Tsunalasideni diyanuliyu gigv unadatsewediyi.
\syll ᏧᎾᎳᏏᏕᏂ ᏗᏯᏄᎵᏳ ᎩᎬ ᎤᎾᏓᏤᏪᏗᏱ.
\ft Their feet are swift to shed blood:

\ln Advdisgi gesv ale uyo adanvdadisdi gesv tali udvdidego anedohvi.
\syll ᎠᏛᏗᏍᎩ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏲ ᎠᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏔᎵ ᎤᏛᏗᏕᎪ ᎠᏁᏙᎲᎢ.
\ft Destruction and misery are in their ways:

\ln Nvwadohiyadvno ganvnv vtla unigadovsvhi yigi.
\syll ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛᏃ ᎦᏅᏅ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏂᎦᏙᎥᏒᎯ ᏱᎩ.
\ft And the way of peace have they not known:

\ln Unelanvhi ganayehisdi gesv vtla igvyiditlv yinusdi dinikanvi.
\syll ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎦᎾᏰᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎥᏝ ᎢᎬᏱᏗᏢ ᏱᏄᏍᏗ ᏗᏂᎧᏅᎢ.
\ft There is no fear of God before their eyes.

\ln Ale idigataha nasgi nigav nigawesgv dikahnawadvsdi uninetseha nasgi dikahnawadvsdi getsinenuhi; nasgi naniv diniholi digetsisdunediyi, ale elanigv anehi unisganvtsvhi tsudugotanvhi iyulisdodiyi Unelanvhi agatahvi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎢᏗᎦᏔᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎬ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎤᏂᏁᏤᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎨᏥᏁᏄᎯ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏗᏂᎰᎵ ᏗᎨᏥᏍᏚᏁᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎡᎳᏂᎬ ᎠᏁᎯ ᎤᏂᏍᎦᏅᏨᎯ ᏧᏚᎪᏔᏅᎯ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎦᏔᎲᎢ.
\ft Now we know that what things soever the law saith, it saith to them who are under the law: that every mouth may be stopped, and all the world may become guilty before God.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi dikahnawadvsdi nigawesgv nudvnehv vtla gilo uquedali yvgvdudalesda nasgi agatahvi; dikahnawadvsdiyeno asganvisdi gesv agadovhisdodi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎬ ᏄᏛᏁᎲ ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᏴᎬᏚᏓᎴᏍᏓ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎦᏔᎲᎢ; ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗᏰᏃ ᎠᏍᎦᏅᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏙᏗ.
\ft Therefore by the deeds of the law there shall no flesh be justified in his sight: for by the law is the knowledge of sin.

\ln Unelanvhisgini udadudalesdodi gesv, dikahnawadvsdi gvdodi nigesvna, gvnigesv igvnelvhi, gohiyudotanvhi dikahnawadvsdi ale anadolehosgv dunowelvi;
\syll ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏓᏚᏓᎴᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ, ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎬᏙᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᎬᏁᎸᎯ, ᎪᎯᏳᏙᏔᏅᎯ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎬ ᏚᏃᏪᎸᎢ;
\ft But now the righteousness of God without the law is manifested, being witnessed by the law and the prophets;

\ln Nasgi Unelanvhi udagadalesdi gesvi, nasgi Tsisa Galonedv gohiyudi tsvdidalehvsga, ale nasgi naniv anohiyuhvsgi unilutsedi ale nasgi naniv unatseli iyulisdodi tsigi; vtlayeno tsunadalehnai yigi;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏓᎦᏓᎴᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᏨᏗᏓᎴᎲᏍᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᎷᏤᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎤᎾᏤᎵ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᏥᎩ; ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᎿᎢ ᏱᎩ;
\ft Even the righteousness of God which is by faith of Jesus Christ unto all and upon all them that believe: for there is no difference:

\ln Nigadiyuyeno unisganvtsvhi, ale esga unohasv Unelanvhi udalvquododi gesvi;
\syll ᏂᎦᏗᏳᏰᏃ ᎤᏂᏍᎦᏅᏨᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎡᏍᎦ ᎤᏃᎭᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏓᎸᏉᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ;
\ft For all have sinned, and come short of the glory of God;

\ln Gegudaledv nidigetsigvwalodanelvna gvtanvhi gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv nvdayudalenvhi aguyvdoi gesv Galonedv Tsisa uwehvi;
\syll ᎨᎫᏓᎴᏛ ᏂᏗᎨᏥᎬᏩᎶᏓᏁᎸᎾ ᎬᏔᏅᎯ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᎠᎫᏴᏙᎢ ᎨᏒ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏥᏌ ᎤᏪᎲᎢ;
\ft Being justified freely by his grace through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus:

\ln Nasgi [Tsisa Galonedv] Unelanvhi gvnigesv tsinuwanelv alisgolvtanvhi gohisdodi gesvi, nasgi gohiyudiyi ugigv; tsunanugowisediyi nasgi duyugodv iyadvnehi gesvi, nasgi gayula asganvtsvhi gesv gagvwadanedi gesvi, nasgi Unelanvhi gvnidiyu gesv iyuwanisanvhi;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛdata is invalid ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏥᏄᏩᏁᎸ ᎠᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏅᎯ ᎪᎯᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᎯᏳᏗᏱ ᎤᎩᎬ; ᏧᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏳᎳ ᎠᏍᎦᏅᏨᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎦᎬᏩᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎬᏂᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏅᎯ;
\ft Whom God hath set forth to be a propitiation through faith in his blood, to declare his righteousness for the remission of sins that are past, through the forbearance of God;

\ln Tsunanugowisediyi gohi gesv nasgi duyugodv iyadvnehi gesvi; nasgi duyugodv iyadvnehi iyulisdodiyi, ale gudalesgi nasgi na gohiyuhvsgi Tsisa.
\syll ᏧᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᏗᏱ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᎯ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎫᏓᎴᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎪᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᏥᏌ.
\ft To declare, I say, at this time his righteousness: that he might be just, and the justifier of him which believeth in Jesus.

\ln Hatlvgeno atlvquasdi gesvi?  Iyvdv igvnelvhi.  Gado usdi dikahnawadvsdi gvtanvhi?  digalvwisdanediyisgo adanetsehi?  Vtla; dikahnawadvsdisgini gvtanvhi gohiyudi gesv adanetsehi.
\syll ᎭᏢᎨᏃ ᎠᏢᏆᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ?  ᎢᏴᏛ ᎢᎬᏁᎸᎯ.  ᎦᏙ ᎤᏍᏗ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎬᏔᏅᎯ?  ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱᏍᎪ ᎠᏓᏁᏤᎯ?  ᎥᏝ; ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᎬᏔᏅᎯ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏓᏁᏤᎯ.
\ft Where is boasting then? It is excluded. By what law? of works? Nay: but by the law of faith.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi dedugodiha nasgi yvwi gohiyudi gesv adudalesdisgv dikahnawadvsdi nigvnv nudvnelvna.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏕᏚᎪᏗᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏴᏫ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏚᏓᎴᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏂᎬᏅ ᏄᏛᏁᎸᎾ.
\ft Therefore we conclude that a man is justified by faith without the deeds of the law.

\ln Unelanvhisgo Anitsusiquo unvsv unatseliga?  tlasgo nasquo tsunadalenvdv yvwi unatseliga yigi?  Vv, tsunadalenvdv nasquo yvwi unatseliga.
\syll ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏍᎪ ᎠᏂᏧᏏᏉ ᎤᏅᏒ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ?  ᏝᏍᎪ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ ᏱᎩ?  ᎥᎥ, ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏴᏫ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ.
\ft Is he the God of the Jews only? is he not also of the Gentiles? Yes, of the Gentiles also:

\ln Saquohiyuyeno Unelanvhi nasgi gohiyudi gesv tsidegudalesdiha digetsiusdeselvhi, ale nidigetsiusdeselvna gohiyudi gesv tsidegudalesdiha.
\syll ᏌᏉᎯᏳᏰᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏥᏕᎫᏓᎴᏍᏗᎭ ᏗᎨᏥᎤᏍᏕᏎᎸᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᏗᎨᏥᎤᏍᏕᏎᎸᎾ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏥᏕᎫᏓᎴᏍᏗᎭ.
\ft Seeing it is one God, which shall justify the circumcision by faith, and uncircumcision through faith.

\ln Nasgisgono iyusdi asequoquo nidvneha dikahnawadvsdi gohiyudi gesv idvdiha?  Gvwatlisdi; idisdayidisgini dikahnawadvsdi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎪᏃ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏎᏉᏉ ᏂᏛᏁᎭ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏛᏗᎭ?  ᎬᏩᏟᏍᏗ; ᎢᏗᏍᏓᏱᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ.
\ft Do we then make void the law through faith? God forbid: yea, we establish the law.

\ln Nasgino tsinusdi gado dadadvni Equahami igidoda uwadvhv uquedali gesv nvdayudalenvdv?
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏥᏄᏍᏗ ᎦᏙ ᏓᏓᏛᏂ ᎡᏆᎭᎻ ᎢᎩᏙᏓ ᎤᏩᏛᎲ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᏛ?
\ft What shall we say then that Abraham our father, as pertaining to the flesh, hath found?

\ln Iyuyeno Equahami dulvwisdanehv ududalestanvhi yigi, uha utlvquisdodi; aseno vtla [yuha,] Unelanvhi agatahvi.
\syll ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᎡᏆᎭᎻ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᎤᏚᏓᎴᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᏱᎩ, ᎤᎭ ᎤᏢᏈᏍᏙᏗ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏳᎭ,data is invalid ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎦᏔᎲᎢ.
\ft For if Abraham were justified by works, he hath whereof to glory; but not before God.

\ln Gadoyeno adiha galvquodi goweli?  Equahami uwohiyune Unelanvhi, nasgino duyugodv iyadvnedi gesv atsiyelvnanelei.
\syll ᎦᏙᏰᏃ ᎠᏗᎭ ᎦᎸᏉᏗ ᎪᏪᎵ?  ᎡᏆᎭᎻ ᎤᏬᎯᏳᏁ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏥᏰᎸᎾᏁᎴᎢ.
\ft For what saith the scripture? Abraham believed God, and it was counted unto him for righteousness.

\ln Giloyeno tsulvwisdanehi agaguyvedi gesv vtla gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv yinvdigalisdodisgo utseli yatsiyelvnanehoi, udadugvsgini nvdigalisdodisgo utseli atsiyelvnanehoi.
\syll ᎩᎶᏰᏃ ᏧᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᎠᎦᎫᏴᎡᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎥᏝ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏱᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎪ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏯᏥᏰᎸᎾᏁᎰᎢ, ᎤᏓᏚᎬᏍᎩᏂ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎪ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎠᏥᏰᎸᎾᏁᎰᎢ.
\ft Now to him that worketh is the reward not reckoned of grace, but of debt.

\ln Nasgini nidulvwisdanehvna, gohiyuhvsgiquosgini nasgi na gudalesgi asganai, nasgi uwohiyusv duyugodv iyadvnedi gesv atsiyelvnanehoi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏂ ᏂᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎾ, ᎪᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎫᏓᎴᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᎦᎾᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏬᎯᏳᏒ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏥᏰᎸᎾᏁᎰᎢ.
\ft But to him that worketh not, but believeth on him that justifieth the ungodly, his faith is counted for righteousness.

\ln Nasgiya nasquo Dewi tsikaneisdiha osdv iyulisdanedi gesv yvwi, nasgi na Unelanvhi duyugodv iyadvnedi gesv nasgiya uyelvnaneha nidulvwisdanelvna gesvi,
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏕᏫ ᏥᎧᏁᎢᏍᏗᎭ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏴᏫ, ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎤᏰᎸᎾᏁᎭ ᏂᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ,
\ft Even as David also describeth the blessedness of the man, unto whom God imputeth righteousness without works,

\ln [Hia tsinigaweha,] Osiyu iyunalisdanedi unisganvtsv gagetsinelvhi, ale uyo nunadvnelv gegutlvnanelvhi;
\syll ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᎦᏪᎭ,data is invalid ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎤᏂᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᎦᎨᏥᏁᎸᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏲ ᏄᎾᏛᏁᎸ ᎨᎫᏢᎾᏁᎸᎯ;
\ft Saying, Blessed are they whose iniquities are forgiven, and whose sins are covered.

\ln Osi iyulisdanedi yvwi nasgi na Ugvwiyuhi usganvtsv nuwugosdisgvna gesvi.
\syll ᎣᏏ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᏴᏫ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᏄᏭᎪᏍᏗᏍᎬᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Blessed is the man to whom the Lord will not impute sin.

\ln Hiano nasgi osiyu iyudalisdanedi gesv digetsiusdeselvhiquosgo unilutseha, tsigoge nasquo digetsiusdeselvhi nigesvna?  Gohiyudiyeno gesv duyugodv iyadvnedi gesv atsiyelvnanele Equahami idadiha.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏳᏓᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏗᎨᏥᎤᏍᏕᏎᎸᎯᏉᏍᎪ ᎤᏂᎷᏤᎭ, ᏥᎪᎨ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏗᎨᏥᎤᏍᏕᏎᎸᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ?  ᎪᎯᏳᏗᏰᏃ ᎨᏒ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏥᏰᎸᎾᏁᎴ ᎡᏆᎭᎻ ᎢᏓᏗᎭ.
\ft Cometh this blessedness then upon the circumcision only, or upon the uncircumcision also? for we say that faith was reckoned to Abraham for righteousness.

\ln Ilagiyuno nasgi nusde atsiyelvnanelei?  tsigo atsiusdeselvhi tsigesei?  tsigoge atsiusdeselvhi nigesvna tsigesei?  Vtla atsiusdeselvhi tsigesei, atsiusdeselvhisgini nigesvna tsigesei.
\syll ᎢᎳᎩᏳᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏕ ᎠᏥᏰᎸᎾᏁᎴᎢ?  ᏥᎪ ᎠᏥᎤᏍᏕᏎᎸᎯ ᏥᎨᏎᎢ?  ᏥᎪᎨ ᎠᏥᎤᏍᏕᏎᎸᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏥᎨᏎᎢ?  ᎥᏝ ᎠᏥᎤᏍᏕᏎᎸᎯ ᏥᎨᏎᎢ, ᎠᏥᎤᏍᏕᏎᎸᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏥᎨᏎᎢ.
\ft How was it then reckoned? when he was in circumcision, or in uncircumcision? Not in circumcision, but in uncircumcision.

\ln Ale atsinele ahusdesdi gesv uyelvdvi, asdayidisgi duyugodv iyadvnedi gesv atsiyelvnanehvi nvdayudalenvhi uwohiyusv asi natsiusdeselvna tsigesei; nasgi unidoda iyulisdodiyi naniv anohiyuhvsgi, nidigetsiusdeselvna gesvi; nasgi duyugodv iyadvnedi gesv nasgi nasquo getsiyelvnanediyi;
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎠᏥᏁᎴ ᎠᎱᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏰᎸᏛᎢ, ᎠᏍᏓᏱᏗᏍᎩ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏥᏰᎸᎾᏁᎲᎢ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᎤᏬᎯᏳᏒ ᎠᏏ ᎾᏥᎤᏍᏕᏎᎸᎾ ᏥᎨᏎᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᏙᏓ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ, ᏂᏗᎨᏥᎤᏍᏕᏎᎸᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎨᏥᏰᎸᎾᏁᏗᏱ;
\ft And he received the sign of circumcision, a seal of the righteousness of the faith which he had yet being uncircumcised: that he might be the father of all them that believe, though they be not circumcised; that righteousness might be imputed unto them also:
