\ln Ale nasquo digetsiusdeselvhi unidoda iyulisdodiyi, nasgi digetsiusdeselvhi uwasv nigesvna tsigi, nasquosgini anisdawadegi tsigi dulasinvsv igidoda Equahami, nasgi tsuwohiyuse atsiusdeselvhi asi nigesvna tsigesei.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏗᎨᏥᎤᏍᏕᏎᎸᎯ ᎤᏂᏙᏓ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎨᏥᎤᏍᏕᏎᎸᎯ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏂᏍᏓᏩᏕᎩ ᏥᎩ ᏚᎳᏏᏅᏒ ᎢᎩᏙᏓ ᎡᏆᎭᎻ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏬᎯᏳᏎ ᎠᏥᎤᏍᏕᏎᎸᎯ ᎠᏏ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏥᎨᏎᎢ.
\ft And the father of circumcision to them who are not of the circumcision only, but who also walk in the steps of that faith of our father Abraham, which he had being yet uncircumcised.

\ln Tsatsiduisdaneleyeno utseli iyulisdodiyi elohi, vtla Equahami ale nasgi unetlvtanvdv gesv dikahnawadvsdi nvdayudalenvhi yigesei, gohiyudisgini adudalesdodi gesv nvdayudalenvhi gesei.
\syll ᏣᏥᏚᎢᏍᏓᏁᎴᏰᏃ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎡᎶᎯ, ᎥᏝ ᎡᏆᎭᎻ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᏢᏔᏅᏛ ᎨᏒ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ, ᎪᎯᏳᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏚᏓᎴᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᎨᏎᎢ.
\ft For the promise, that he should be the heir of the world, was not to Abraham, or to his seed, through the law, but through the righteousness of faith.

\ln Iyuyeno dikahnawadvsdi analisgasdodisgi unatseli yinigegvneha, hnaquo asequo nigalisdiha gohiyudi gesvi, ale aduisdv gohusdi gvgodi nigesvna nigalisdiha.
\syll ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎠᎾᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏗᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᏤᎵ ᏱᏂᎨᎬᏁᎭ, ᎿᏉ ᎠᏎᏉ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᎭ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏚᎢᏍᏛ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎬᎪᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᎭ.
\ft For if they which are of the law be heirs, faith is made void, and the promise made of none effect:

\ln Dikahnawadvsdiyeno utalawohisdi gesv waliyeilohiha; dikahnawadvsdiyeno nahna nahvna gesv, nahna dikahnawadvsdi ayosdodi gesv vtla yeha.
\syll ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗᏰᏃ ᎤᏔᎳᏬᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏩᎵᏰᎢᎶᎯᎭ; ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗᏰᏃ ᏀᎾ ᏀᎥᎾ ᎨᏒ, ᏀᎾ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎠᏲᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎥᏝ ᏰᎭ.
\ft Because the law worketh wrath: for where no law is, there is no transgression.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi gohiyudi gesv alisgasdodiha, nasgi gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv nvdayudalediyi; nasgi aduistanvhi gesv ulinigidiyu iyunalisdanediyi naniv unetlvtanvdv gesvi; vtla nasgi unvsv tsunetlvtanvdv gesv nasgiya dikahnawadvsdi nigvnvi, nasquosgini nasgi tsunetlvtanvdv gesv Equahami uwohiyusv nasgiya unohiyunvhi iyuwanisadv, nasgi Equahami nidiv igidoda tsigi,
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏗᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏗᏱ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏚᎢᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎤᏁᏢᏔᏅᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎥᏝ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏅᏒ ᏧᏁᏢᏔᏅᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏂᎬᏅᎢ, ᎾᏍᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏁᏢᏔᏅᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎡᏆᎭᎻ ᎤᏬᎯᏳᏒ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎤᏃᎯᏳᏅᎯ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᏆᎭᎻ ᏂᏗᎥ ᎢᎩᏙᏓ ᏥᎩ,
\ft Therefore it is of faith, that it might be by grace; to the end the promise might be sure to all the seed; not to that only which is of the law, but to that also which is of the faith of Abraham; who is the father of us all,

\ln (Nasgiya hia tsinigvnv tsigowela, unitsati tsunadalenvdv yvwi unidoda nigvyvga,) agatahv Unelanvhi nasgi tsigohiyuhvsgei, nasgi digvnidisgi tsigi tsuniyohusvhi, ale diyanisgi tsigi tsunadalenvdv nasgi nanehvna gesvi, nasgi tsaneho nasgiyai;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᎬᏅ ᏥᎪᏪᎳ, ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏂᏙᏓ ᏂᎬᏴᎦ, ᎠᎦᏔᎲ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᎪᎯᏳᎲᏍᎨᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎬᏂᏗᏍᎩ ᏥᎩ ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏯᏂᏍᎩ ᏥᎩ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏁᎲᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏣᏁᎰ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ;
\ft (As it is written, I have made thee a father of many nations,) before him whom he believed, even God, who quickeneth the dead, and calleth those things which be not as though they were.

\ln Nasgi udugi gagvdi nigesvna tsigesei udugi gvdi gesv tsuwohiyunei, nasgi unitsati tsunadalenvdv yvwi unidoda iyulisdodiyi, nasgiya hia igawedv tsigi, Nasgiya nunitsuquisdesdi tsanetlvtanvhi;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎦᎬᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏥᎨᏎᎢ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎬᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏧᏬᎯᏳᏁᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏂᏙᏓ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎯᎠ ᎢᎦᏪᏛ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᏂᏧᏈᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᏣᏁᏢᏔᏅᎯ;
\ft Who against hope believed in hope, that he might become the father of many nations; according to that which was spoken, So shall thy seed be.

\ln Ale wanagala nigesvna gesv uwohiyusvi, vtla yudanvtele uwasv ayeli uliwotsvhi gesvi, hnaquo asgohitsuqui iyvdv iyudetiyvdv gesvi, vtla ale yudanvtele ulosvsdanelvhi gesv Seli tsudananugowisdiyi;
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏩᎾᎦᎳ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏬᎯᏳᏒᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᏳᏓᏅᏖᎴ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎤᎵᏬᏨᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎿᏉ ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏧᏈ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎢᏳᏕᏘᏴᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᏳᏓᏅᏖᎴ ᎤᎶᏒᏍᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏎᎵ ᏧᏓᎾᏄᎪᏫᏍᏗᏱ;
\ft And being not weak in faith, he considered not his own body now dead, when he was about an hundred years old, neither yet the deadness of Sara's womb:

\ln Vtla yudlasidvehe Unelanvhi uduistanvi nuwohiyusvna gesv iyusdi; ulinigidiyusgini gese uwohiyusvi, galvquodisge Unelanvhi,
\syll ᎥᏝ ᏳᏜᏏᏛᎡᎮ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏚᎢᏍᏔᏅᎢ ᏄᏬᎯᏳᏒᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ; ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏎ ᎤᏬᎯᏳᏒᎢ, ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏍᎨ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ,
\ft He staggered not at the promise of God through unbelief; but was strong in faith, giving glory to God;

\ln Ale ukalitsvhi uwohiyusei nasgi nusdv uduistanv yeliquo nasquo igvwadvnedi gesvi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎤᎧᎵᏨᎯ ᎤᏬᎯᏳᏎᎢ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎤᏚᎢᏍᏔᏅ ᏰᎵᏉ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎢᎬᏩᏛᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft And being fully persuaded that, what he had promised, he was able also to perform.

\ln Ale nasgi iyusdi duyugodv iyadvnedi gesv atsiyelvnanele nasgi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏥᏰᎸᎾᏁᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ.
\ft And therefore it was imputed to him for righteousness.

\ln Vtla ale uwasvquo gesv yinvdigalisdodisge gowelanvhi tsigi, nasgi [duyugodv iyadvnedi gesv] tsatsiyelvnanelei;
\syll ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏩᏒᏉ ᎨᏒ ᏱᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨ ᎪᏪᎳᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᏗ ᎨᏒdata is invalid ᏣᏥᏰᎸᎾᏁᎴᎢ;
\ft Now it was not written for his sake alone, that it was imputed to him;

\ln Ayvsgini gesv nasquo nvdigalisdodisgei, nasgi [duyugodv iyadvnedi gesv] egiyelvnanedi tsigi, edohiyuhvsgi nasgi tsuletanvhi uyohusv Tsisa igatseli Ugvwiyuhi;
\syll ᎠᏴᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᏗ ᎨᏒdata is invalid ᎡᎩᏰᎸᎾᏁᏗ ᏥᎩ, ᎡᏙᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᎴᏔᏅᎯ ᎤᏲᎱᏒ ᏥᏌ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ;
\ft But for us also, to whom it shall be imputed, if we believe on him that raised up Jesus our Lord from the dead;

\ln Nasgi tsidatsiyose ayv igisganvtsv tsinvdigalisdodisgei, ale tsidagaletane ayv igadudalesdiyi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏓᏥᏲᏎ ᎠᏴ ᎢᎩᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᏥᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᏓᎦᎴᏔᏁ ᎠᏴ ᎢᎦᏚᏓᎴᏍᏗᏱ.
\ft Who was delivered for our offences, and was raised again for our justification.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi gohiyudi gesv igadudalestanvhi tsigi, nvwadohiyadv nigvnv Unelavhi igatseli Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv iyuwanisadv;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᎦᏚᏓᎴᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᏂᎬᏅ ᎤᏁᎳᎥᎯ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ;
\ft Therefore being justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ:

\ln Nasgi nasquo iyuwanisadv gohiyudi idvdisgv gegiluhisdi tsinulistanv hia nasgi gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesvi, nasgi nahna tsidedidoga, ale tsidaliheliga udugi igvsv galvquodiyu gesv Unelanvhi utseli eginediyi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎢᏛᏗᏍᎬ ᎨᎩᎷᎯᏍᏗ ᏥᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏀᎾ ᏥᏕᏗᏙᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᏓᎵᎮᎵᎦ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎢᎬᏒ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎡᎩᏁᏗᏱ.
\ft By whom also we have access by faith into this grace wherein we stand, and rejoice in hope of the glory of God.

\ln Ale vtla nasgiquo yinigav, nasquosgini agiliya igilutsehv idaliheligoi; nvdigalisdodisgo idigatahv agiliyoisdi gesv agvnidiyu nadadvnehvi;
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᎾᏍᎩᏉ ᏱᏂᎦᎥ, ᎾᏍᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᎩᎵᏯ ᎢᎩᎷᏤᎲ ᎢᏓᎵᎮᎵᎪᎢ; ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎪ ᎢᏗᎦᏔᎲ ᎠᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎬᏂᏗᏳ ᎾᏓᏛᏁᎲᎢ;
\ft And not only so, but we glory in tribulations also: knowing that tribulation worketh patience;

\ln Agvnidiyuno gesv owasv odagadovhisdi gesv nadadvnehvi; owasvno odagadovhisdi gesv udugi gvdi gesv adawadvehvi;
\syll ᎠᎬᏂᏗᏳᏃ ᎨᏒ ᎣᏩᏒ ᎣᏓᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏓᏛᏁᎲᎢ; ᎣᏩᏒᏃ ᎣᏓᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎬᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏓᏩᏛᎡᎲᎢ;
\ft And patience, experience; and experience, hope:

\ln Nasgino udugi gvdi gesv vtla adehohisdiyi yvgvdawadvsi; nvdigalisdodiha Unelanvhi ageyudi gesv egisonvyelv diginawiyi, Galvquodiyu Adanvdo iyuwanisadv, nasgi eginelvhi tsigi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎬᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎥᏝ ᎠᏕᎰᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏴᎬᏓᏩᏛᏏ; ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎡᎩᏐᏅᏰᎸ ᏗᎩᎾᏫᏱ, ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᎩᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ.
\ft And hope maketh not ashamed; because the love of God is shed abroad in our hearts by the Holy Ghost which is given unto us.

\ln Nidigalinigvgvnayeno ase tsigesei, nahiyu aselvhi gesv Galonedv igiyohuhisele idisganai.
\syll ᏂᏗᎦᎵᏂᎬᎬᎾᏰᏃ ᎠᏎ ᏥᎨᏎᎢ, ᏀᎢᏳ ᎠᏎᎸᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎢᎩᏲᎱᎯᏎᎴ ᎢᏗᏍᎦᎾᎢ.
\ft For when we were yet without strength, in due time Christ died for the ungodly.

\ln Usegatsvhiyeno udanvti asgaya gilo yayohuhisi; yasegagisgininonv osdv asgaya gilo gvwayohuhisedi yinigagi.
\syll ᎤᏎᎦᏨᎯᏰᏃ ᎤᏓᏅᏘ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎩᎶ ᏯᏲᎱᎯᏏ; ᏯᏎᎦᎩᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎩᎶ ᎬᏩᏲᎱᎯᏎᏗ ᏱᏂᎦᎩ.
\ft For scarcely for a righteous man will one die: yet peradventure for a good man some would even dare to die.

\ln Unelanvhisgini gananugowisga igigeyuhiyu gesvi, nasgi asi idisgana tsigesei Galonedv igiyohuhiselei.
\syll ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎦᎾᏄᎪᏫᏍᎦ ᎢᎩᎨᏳᎯᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏏ ᎢᏗᏍᎦᎾ ᏥᎨᏎᎢ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎢᎩᏲᎱᎯᏎᎴᎢ.
\ft But God commendeth his love toward us, in that, while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.

\ln Nasgino tsinusdi, nasgi ugigv igadudalestanvhi tsigi, utlihi udohiyuhiya egisdelvdi gesesdi egudalesdi utalawohisdi gesv nasgi iyuwanisadv.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏥᏄᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎩᎬ ᎢᎦᏚᏓᎴᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎤᏟᎯ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎡᎩᏍᏕᎸᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎡᎫᏓᎴᏍᏗ ᎤᏔᎳᏬᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ.
\ft Much more then, being now justified by his blood, we shall be saved from wrath through him.

\ln Iyuyeno, asi edisgagi tsigesvgi edoisdanelvhi yigi Unelanvhi gvtanvhi Uwetsi uyohusvi, hnaquo gohi edoisdanelvhi tsigi, utlihi udohiyuhiya egisdelvdi gesesdi nasgi gvnodv gesv iyusdi.
\syll ᎢᏳᏰᏃ, ᎠᏏ ᎡᏗᏍᎦᎩ ᏥᎨᏒᎩ ᎡᏙᎢᏍᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᏱᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎬᏔᏅᎯ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎤᏲᎱᏒᎢ, ᎿᏉ ᎪᎯ ᎡᏙᎢᏍᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎤᏟᎯ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎡᎩᏍᏕᎸᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏃᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ.
\ft For if, when we were enemies, we were reconciled to God by the death of his Son, much more, being reconciled, we shall be saved by his life.

\ln Vtla ale nasgiquo yinigav, Unelanvhisgini nasquo edalieliga, igatseli Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv iyuwanisadv, nasgi iyuwanisadv gohi gesv iginelvhi tsigi gohisdodi gesvi.
\syll ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩᏉ ᏱᏂᎦᎥ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎡᏓᎵᎡᎵᎦ, ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎢᎩᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎪᎯᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft And not only so, but we also joy in God through our Lord Jesus Christ, by whom we have now received the atonement.

\ln Nasgino, saquo asgaya iyuwanisadv asgani elohi tsunanugotsv, ale ayohuhisdi gesv [tsunanugotsv;] asgani iyuwanisadv ale nasgi tsinigalisdodiha ayohuhisdi gesv nigadiyu yvwi tsunilutselv, nigadiyuyeno unisganvtsv^
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ, ᏌᏉ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏧᎾᏄᎪᏨ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏧᎾᏄᎪᏨ;data is invalid ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏂᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏴᏫ ᏧᏂᎷᏤᎸ, ᏂᎦᏗᏳᏰᏃ ᎤᏂᏍᎦᏅᏨdata is invalid
\ft Wherefore, as by one man sin entered into the world, and death by sin; and so death passed upon all men, for that all have sinned:

\ln Dikahnawadvsdiyeno ulinetsv asgani neho elohi; aseno vtla unisganvtsvhi getsiyelvdi yigi nahna dikahnawadvsdi nahvna gesvi.
\syll ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗᏰᏃ ᎤᎵᏁᏨ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᏁᎰ ᎡᎶᎯ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏂᏍᎦᏅᏨᎯ ᎨᏥᏰᎸᏗ ᏱᎩ ᏀᎾ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏀᎥᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft (For until the law sin was in the world: but sin is not imputed when there is no law.

\ln Asesgininonv ayohuhisdi gesv ehvgi Adawi tsehe nvdagvwadalenvdv Mosino tsehe wigvsti, nasgi nasquo anehv nunisganvtsvna gesv nasgiya nudvnelv usganvtsv Adawi, nasgi uluhisdi tsigesv tsagatlilosdodi tsigesei.
\syll ᎠᏎᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎡᎲᎩ ᎠᏓᏫ ᏤᎮ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎼᏏᏃ ᏤᎮ ᏫᎬᏍᏘ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏁᎲ ᏄᏂᏍᎦᏅᏨᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᏛᏁᎸ ᎤᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᎠᏓᏫ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎷᎯᏍᏗ ᏥᎨᏒ ᏣᎦᏟᎶᏍᏙᏗ ᏥᎨᏎᎢ.
\ft Nevertheless death reigned from Adam to Moses, even over them that had not sinned after the similitude of Adam's transgression, who is the figure of him that was to come.

\ln Aseno vtla nasgiya tsinusde asganvtsvi, nasgi nasquo yinusde gvwagatiya adanedi gesvi.  Iyuyeno asiyvwi usganvtsv unitsati tsuniyohuhistanvhi yigi; utlihiyu igai unitsati utsati unilutselv gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv Unelanvhi, ale udanedi gesv gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv nvdayudalenvhi tsigi, nasgi asiyvwi asgaya iyuwanisadv, nasgi Tsisa Galonedv.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏥᏄᏍᏕ ᎠᏍᎦᏅᏨᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏱᏄᏍᏕ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎠᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.  ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᎤᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏧᏂᏲᎱᎯᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᏱᎩ; ᎤᏟᎯᏳ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᏂᎷᏤᎸ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ.
\ft But not as the offence, so also is the free gift. For if through the offence of one many be dead, much more the grace of God, and the gift by grace, which is by one man, Jesus Christ, hath abounded unto many.

\ln Ale vtla nasgiya asiyvwiquo usganvtsvhi iyuwanisadv [digegugodanedi tsinulistane] nasgiya yinusdi udanedi gesvi; Asganvtsvyeno digugododi gesv saquoquo iyasganvtsvhi nvdayudalenvhi; Gvwagatiyasgini udanedi gesv utsati iyasganvtsvhi adudalesdodi ugvwala.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎠᏏᏴᏫᏉ ᎤᏍᎦᏅᏨᎯ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ ᏗᎨᎫᎪᏓᏁᏗ ᏥᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁdata is invalid ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏱᏄᏍᏗ ᎤᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎠᏍᎦᏅᏨᏰᏃ ᏗᎫᎪᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏌᏉᏉ ᎢᏯᏍᎦᏅᏨᎯ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ; ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎢᏯᏍᎦᏅᏨᎯ ᎠᏚᏓᎴᏍᏙᏗ ᎤᎬᏩᎳ.
\ft And not as it was by one that sinned, so is the gift: for the judgment was by one to condemnation, but the free gift is of many offences unto justification.

\ln Iyuyeno saquo yvwi usganvtsv yinvdigalisdodiha ayohuhisdi gesv yeha nasgi asiyvwi iyuwanisadv; utlihiyu nudalulvna nasgi utsati getsinelvhi tsigi udadolisdi gesv ale gvwagatiya adudalesdodi gesvi, nasgi gvnidv digesv unigvwiyuhi gesesdi asiyvwi iyuwanisadv, nasgi Tsisa Galonedv.
\syll ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᏌᏉ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᏱᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏰᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ; ᎤᏟᎯᏳ ᏄᏓᎷᎸᎾ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎨᏥᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎠᏚᏓᎴᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏂᏛ ᏗᎨᏒ ᎤᏂᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ.
\ft For if by one man's offence death reigned by one; much more they which receive abundance of grace and of the gift of righteousness shall reign in life by one, Jesus Christ.)

\ln Nasgi iyusdi nasgi asiyvwi usganvtsv iyuwanisadv asganvtsv digugododi gesv nigadiyu yvwi tsunilutselv; nasgiya nasquo asiyvwi duyugodv nudvnelv iyuwanisadv gvwagatiya udanedi gesv unilutselv nigadiyu yvwi gegudalesdiyi gvnidv uniwadvdiyi ugvwala.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᎤᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ ᎠᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᏗᎫᎪᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏴᏫ ᏧᏂᎷᏤᎸ; ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᏄᏛᏁᎸ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏂᎷᏤᎸ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏴᏫ ᎨᎫᏓᎴᏍᏗᏱ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎤᏂᏩᏛᏗᏱ ᎤᎬᏩᎳ.
\ft Therefore as by the offence of one judgment came upon all men to condemnation; even so by the righteousness of one the free gift came upon all men unto justification of life.

\ln Asiyvwiyeno yvwi nuwohiyunvna gesv iyuwanisadv unitsati anisgana tsinunalistanv, nasgiya nasquo asiyvwi uwohiyunv nvdagalisdotani unitsati anisgana nigesvna nvdvnalistani.
\syll ᎠᏏᏴᏫᏰᏃ ᏴᏫ ᏄᏬᎯᏳᏅᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᎾ ᏥᏄᎾᎵᏍᏔᏅ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᎤᏬᎯᏳᏅ ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏔᏂ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᎾ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏅᏛᎾᎵᏍᏔᏂ.
\ft For as by one man's disobedience many were made sinners, so by the obedience of one shall many be made righteous.

\ln Dikahnawadvsdisgini udotlvne asganvisdi gesv unequoisdiyi.  Aseno nahna asganvisdi gesv unequotsidegv nahna gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv utlihiyu unequotsidegvgi;
\syll ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏙᏢᏁ ᎠᏍᎦᏅᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᏉᎢᏍᏗᏱ.  ᎠᏎᏃ ᏀᎾ ᎠᏍᎦᏅᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᏉᏥᏕᎬ ᏀᎾ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏟᎯᏳ ᎤᏁᏉᏥᏕᎬᎩ;
\ft Moreover the law entered, that the offence might abound. But where sin abounded, grace did much more abound:

\ln Nasgino asgani tsugvwiyusadegvgi ayohuhisdi gesv gananugowisgvi, nasgiya nasquo gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv ugvwiyusadegi iyulisdodiyi gvnidv gananugowisgv gvtanvhi adudalesdodi gesv Tsisa Galonedv Ugvwiyuhi igatseli iyuwanisadv.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᏧᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎬᎩ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎦᎾᏄᎪᏫᏍᎬᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎦᎾᏄᎪᏫᏍᎬ ᎬᏔᏅᎯ ᎠᏚᏓᎴᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ.
\ft That as sin hath reigned unto death, even so might grace reign through righteousness unto eternal life by Jesus Christ our Lord.

\ln Gadogeno dadadvni?  Tsigo asiquo gedisganvgesdi nasgi iyuwanisodiyi unequoisdiyi gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesvi?
\syll ᎦᏙᎨᏃ ᏓᏓᏛᏂ?  ᏥᎪ ᎠᏏᏉ ᎨᏗᏍᎦᏅᎨᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏐᏗᏱ ᎤᏁᏉᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ?
\ft What shall we say then? Shall we continue in sin, that grace may abound?

\ln Gvwatlisdi.  Ayv digiyohusvhi asganvisdi gesv ugvwali, gado yidulisdoda yeli asi nahna yvdalenida?
\syll ᎬᏩᏟᏍᏗ.  ᎠᏴ ᏗᎩᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᎠᏍᎦᏅᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ, ᎦᏙ ᏱᏚᎵᏍᏙᏓ ᏰᎵ ᎠᏏ ᏀᎾ ᏴᏓᎴᏂᏓ?
\ft God forbid. How shall we, that are dead to sin, live any longer therein?

\ln Tlasgo yitsigataha, nasgi nidiv tsegawovhi gesv Tsisa Galonedv dedadayohisehvi, nasgi uyohusv ugvwali degawovi?
\syll ᏝᏍᎪ ᏱᏥᎦᏔᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᏗᎥ ᏤᎦᏬᎥᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏕᏓᏓᏲᎯᏎᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏲᎱᏒ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᏕᎦᏬᎥᎢ?
\ft Know ye not, that so many of us as were baptized into Jesus Christ were baptized into his death?

\ln Nasgi iyusdi nasgi tsegawovhi tsigi, Galonedv itsulaha deginisanvgi, ale nasgi digiyohusvhi nulistanvgi; nasgi Galonedv uyohusv tsidagaletanei Agayvlige galvquodiyu gesv gvtanvhi, nasgiya nasquo ayv idalenidohv itse yidalenidoha.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏤᎦᏬᎥᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᏕᎩᏂᏌᏅᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎩᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎩ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏲᎱᏒ ᏥᏓᎦᎴᏔᏁᎢ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏔᏅᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏴ ᎢᏓᎴᏂᏙᎲ ᎢᏤ ᏱᏓᎴᏂᏙᎭ.
\ft Therefore we are buried with him by baptism into death: that like as Christ was raised up from the dead by the glory of the Father, even so we also should walk in newness of life.

\ln Iyuyeno nasgi uyohusv didatselidv iyegvnelvhi gesesdi, nasquosgini dulehisanv didatselidv iyegvnedi gesesdi.
\syll ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏲᎱᏒ ᏗᏓᏤᎵᏛ ᎢᏰᎬᏁᎸᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᏚᎴᎯᏌᏅ ᏗᏓᏤᎵᏛ ᎢᏰᎬᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft For if we have been planted together in the likeness of his death, we shall be also in the likeness of his resurrection:

\ln Hiayeno nasgi idigataha, nasgi igatseli uwetsi asgaya dadahnawasdv agadvnv itsulaha nasgi [galonedv] agadvnvi, nasgi asganvisdi gesv ayelv ehv uyohuhisdiyi, gohi iyudalenvdv asgani diginatlvdiyi nigesvna.
\syll ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏗᎦᏔᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᏓᏓᎿᏩᏍᏛ ᎠᎦᏛᏅ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎶᏁᏛdata is invalid ᎠᎦᏛᏅᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᎦᏅᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏰᎸ ᎡᎲ ᎤᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗᏱ, ᎪᎯ ᎢᏳᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᏗᎩᎾᏢᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.
\ft Knowing this, that our old man is crucified with him, that the body of sin might be destroyed, that henceforth we should not serve sin.

\ln Nasgiyeno na uyohusvhi ududalaelvhi geso asgani.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ Ꮎ ᎤᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᎤᏚᏓᎳᎡᎸᎯ ᎨᏐ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ.
\ft For he that is dead is freed from sin.

\ln Iyuyeno Galonedv itsulaha digiyohusvhi gesesdi, idohiyuhvsga itsulaha didvnodv iyulisdodiyi;
\syll ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᏗᎩᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎢᏙᎯᏳᎲᏍᎦ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᏗᏛᏃᏛ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ;
\ft Now if we be dead with Christ, we believe that we shall also live with him:

\ln Idigatahayeno nasgi Galonedv uyohusv tsagaletanvhi gesvi, vtla taline uyohuhisdi yigi; ayohuhisdi gesv vtla hnaquo udalinehidehi yigi.
\syll ᎢᏗᎦᏔᎭᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏲᎱᏒ ᏣᎦᎴᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎤᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᏱᎩ; ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎥᏝ ᎿᏉ ᎤᏓᎵᏁᎯᏕᎯ ᏱᎩ.
\ft Knowing that Christ being raised from the dead dieth no more; death hath no more dominion over him.

\ln Nasgiyeno uyohusvhi tsigi, asgani ugvwali saquo nuyohusvgi; asgini gvnodv tsigi, Unelanvhi utseli ugvwali gvnodv.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎤᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᏌᏉ ᏄᏲᎱᏒᎩ; ᎠᏍᎩᏂ ᎬᏃᏛ ᏥᎩ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᎬᏃᏛ.
\ft For in that he died, he died unto sin once: but in that he liveth, he liveth unto God.

\ln Nasgiya nasquo nihi itsvsv gesv udohiyuhi ditsiyohusvhi gesv itsadadanvtesgesdi asgani ugvwali, Unelanvhisgini utseli ugvwali ditsvnodv gesv Tsisa Galonedv igatseli Ugvwiyuhi iyuwanisadv.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏨᏒ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᏗᏥᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏣᏓᏓᏅᏖᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᏗᏨᏃᏛ ᎨᏒ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ.
\ft Likewise reckon ye also yourselves to be dead indeed unto sin, but alive unto God through Jesus Christ our Lord.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi tlesdi asgani yugvwiyusadegesdi diyogi ditsiyelvi, nasgi [asgani] itsohiyudiyi nahna [ditsiyelv] udulvnvvsgvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᏳᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎨᏍᏗ ᏗᏲᎩ ᏗᏥᏰᎸᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᎦᏂdata is invalid ᎢᏦᎯᏳᏗᏱ ᏀᎾ ᏗᏥᏰᎸdata is invalid ᎤᏚᎸᏅᎥᏍᎬᎢ.
\ft Let not sin therefore reign in your mortal body, that ye should obey it in the lusts thereof.

\ln Ale tlesdi asgani tsetsiyohiselvgi ditsiyelv ududadewisvi, nasgi ditsvdodiyi niduyugodvna ditsilvwisdanediyi; Unelanvhisgini itsvsv tsetsadayohisi, nasgi iyunadvnedi unadvnidvhi tsuniyohusvhi gesv ale ditsiyelv ududadewisv Unelanvhi detsiyohiselvgi nasgi ditsvdodiyi duyugodv ditsilvwisdanediyi,
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᏤᏥᏲᎯᏎᎸᎩ ᏗᏥᏰᎸ ᎤᏚᏓᏕᏫᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏨᏙᏗᏱ ᏂᏚᏳᎪᏛᎾ ᏗᏥᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ; ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᏨᏒ ᏤᏣᏓᏲᎯᏏ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᏁᏗ ᎤᎾᏛᏂᏛᎯ ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏥᏰᎸ ᎤᏚᏓᏕᏫᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏕᏥᏲᎯᏎᎸᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏨᏙᏗᏱ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᏗᏥᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ,
\ft Neither yield ye your members as instruments of unrighteousness unto sin: but yield yourselves unto God, as those that are alive from the dead, and your members as instruments of righteousness unto God.

\ln Asganiyeno vtla yigetsadalinehidehesdi; vtlayeno dikahnawadvsdiyi yitsadanuyvdi, gvwagatiyasgini udadolisdi gesv itsadanuyvdi.
\syll ᎠᏍᎦᏂᏰᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏱᎨᏣᏓᎵᏁᎯᏕᎮᏍᏗ; ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗᏱ ᏱᏣᏓᏄᏴᏗ, ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏣᏓᏄᏴᏗ.
\ft For sin shall not have dominion over you: for ye are not under the law, but under grace.

\ln Gadono?  idisganvgesdisgo, nvdigalisdodisgesdi dikahnawadvsdiyi nigadanuyvdvna gesvi, gvwagatiyasgini udadolisdi gesv igadanuyvdvi?  gvwatlisdi.
\syll ᎦᏙᏃ?  ᎢᏗᏍᎦᏅᎨᏍᏗᏍᎪ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎦᏓᏄᏴᏛᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᎦᏓᏄᏴᏛᎢ?  ᎬᏩᏟᏍᏗ.
\ft What then? shall we sin, because we are not under the law, but under grace? God forbid.

\ln Tlasgo yitsigataha, nasgi gilo yidetsadayohiselv itsinvsidohv etsoiyudiyi, nasgi itsinatlai gesv etsoiyuhvsgi; nasquo asgani yigi ayohuhisdi gesv gvdisgi yigi, ale gohiyudi gesv yigi, adudalesdi gesv gvdisgi?
\syll ᏝᏍᎪ ᏱᏥᎦᏔᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎩᎶ ᏱᏕᏣᏓᏲᎯᏎᎸ ᎢᏥᏅᏏᏙᎲ ᎡᏦᎢᏳᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏥᎾᏝᎢ ᎨᏒ ᎡᏦᎢᏳᎲᏍᎩ; ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᏱᎩ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏗᏍᎩ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᏚᏓᎴᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏗᏍᎩ?
\ft Know ye not, that to whom ye yield yourselves servants to obey, his servants ye are to whom ye obey; whether of sin unto death, or of obedience unto righteousness?

\ln Adina Unelanvhi alihelitsedi gesesdi, nasgi udohiyuhi asgani ditsinatlai tsigesvgi, aseno ditsinawi gvdi itsohiyunv nasgi nusdv dideyodi gesv nasgi tsetsiyohiselvhi gesvi.
\syll ᎠᏗᎾ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎵᎮᎵᏤᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᏗᏥᎾᏝᎢ ᏥᎨᏒᎩ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᏗᏥᎾᏫ ᎬᏗ ᎢᏦᎯᏳᏅ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏗᏕᏲᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏤᏥᏲᎯᏎᎸᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft But God be thanked, that ye were the servants of sin, but ye have obeyed from the heart that form of doctrine which was delivered you.

\ln Nasgino asgani gesv niditsinatlavna tsinulistanv, duyugodv gesv ditsinatlai nulistanvgi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᎨᏒ ᏂᏗᏥᎾᏝᎥᎾ ᏥᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ, ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒ ᏗᏥᎾᏝᎢ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎩ.
\ft Being then made free from sin, ye became the servants of righteousness.

\ln Yvwi iyuniwesdi nitsiweha, nvdigalisdodiha itsiquedalv wanagalahiyu gesvi; ditsiyelvyeno itsadudadewisv tsidetsiyosvgi gadaha ale uyo gesv uninatlai iyulisdodiyi, nasgi uyo ditsilvwisdanediyi; nasgiya nasquo gohi gesvi, ditsiyelv itsadudadewisv ditsiyohi uninatlai iyulisdodiyi, nasgi itsisgana nigesvna iyulisdodiyi.
\syll ᏴᏫ ᎢᏳᏂᏪᏍᏗ ᏂᏥᏪᎭ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎢᏥᏇᏓᎸ ᏩᎾᎦᎳᎯᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᏗᏥᏰᎸᏰᏃ ᎢᏣᏚᏓᏕᏫᏒ ᏥᏕᏥᏲᏒᎩ ᎦᏓᎭ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏲ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏂᎾᏝᎢ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏲ ᏗᏥᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ; ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏗᏥᏰᎸ ᎢᏣᏚᏓᏕᏫᏒ ᏗᏥᏲᎯ ᎤᏂᎾᏝᎢ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏥᏍᎦᎾ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
\ft I speak after the manner of men because of the infirmity of your flesh: for as ye have yielded your members servants to uncleanness and to iniquity unto iniquity; even so now yield your members servants to righteousness unto holiness.

\ln Nahiyuyeno asgani ditsinatlai tsigesvgi, duyugodv gesv niditsinatlavna gesvgi.
\syll ᏀᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᏗᏥᎾᏝᎢ ᏥᎨᏒᎩ, ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒ ᏂᏗᏥᎾᏝᎥᎾ ᎨᏒᎩ.
\ft For when ye were the servants of sin, ye were free from righteousness.

\ln Nahiyuno tsigesvgi gado usdi itsinequotsehe nasgi gohi tsitsadehosga?  ayohuhisdiyeno gesv wuliyeilohisdi nasgi.
\syll ᏀᎢᏳᏃ ᏥᎨᏒᎩ ᎦᏙ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎢᏥᏁᏉᏤᎮ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᎯ ᏥᏣᏕᎰᏍᎦ?  ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗᏰᏃ ᎨᏒ ᏭᎵᏰᎢᎶᎯᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ.
\ft What fruit had ye then in those things whereof ye are now ashamed? for the end of those things is death.

\ln Gohisgini gesv asgani niditsinatlavna tsigi, ale Unelanvhi ditsinatlai tsinulistanv, itsinequovhi itsiha nitsisganvna itsvnehi, walisquadihihvno wusditsihisdi nigesvna gvnidv.
\syll ᎪᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᏂᏗᏥᎾᏝᎥᎾ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏗᏥᎾᏝᎢ ᏥᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ, ᎢᏥᏁᏉᎥᎯ ᎢᏥᎭ ᏂᏥᏍᎦᏅᎾ ᎢᏨᏁᎯ, ᏩᎵᏍᏆᏗᎯᎲᏃ ᏭᏍᏗᏥᎯᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎬᏂᏛ.
\ft But now being made free from sin, and become servants to God, ye have your fruit unto holiness, and the end everlasting life.

\ln Asganiyeno udaguyvedi gesv ayohuhisdi gesv igi; Unelanvhisgini gvwagatiya udanedi gesv gvnidv wusditsihisdi nigesvna, Tsisa Galonedv Ugvwiyuhi igatseliga iyuwanisadv.
\syll ᎠᏍᎦᏂᏰᏃ ᎤᏓᎫᏴᎡᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᎩ; ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏂᏛ ᏭᏍᏗᏥᎯᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᎦᏤᎵᎦ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ.
\ft For the wages of sin is death; but the gift of God is eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.

\ln Tlasgo yitsigataha, adalinvtli, (dikahnawadvsdiyeno anigatahi gatsiwonediha,) nasgi dikahnawadvsdi unatlav yvwi nigohilv ehvi?
\syll ᏝᏍᎪ ᏱᏥᎦᏔᎭ, ᎠᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗᏰᏃ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎯ ᎦᏥᏬᏁᏗᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎤᎾᏝᎥ ᏴᏫ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎡᎲᎢ?
\ft Know ye not, brethren, (for I speak to them that know the law,) how that the law hath dominion over a man as long as he liveth?

\ln Ageyvyeno tsidatsehoi, dikahnawadvsdi ududalvdo uyehi unaneladisdiyi igohidv alenidohv uyehi; uyehisgini uyohusvhi yigi, ududaledv geso dikahnawadvsdi ududalvdv uyehi unaneladisdiyi.
\syll ᎠᎨᏴᏰᏃ ᏥᏓᏤᎰᎢ, ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎤᏚᏓᎸᏙ ᎤᏰᎯ ᎤᎾᏁᎳᏗᏍᏗᏱ ᎢᎪᎯᏛ ᎠᎴᏂᏙᎲ ᎤᏰᎯ; ᎤᏰᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᏱᎩ, ᎤᏚᏓᎴᏛ ᎨᏐ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎤᏚᏓᎸᏛ ᎤᏰᎯ ᎤᎾᏁᎳᏗᏍᏗᏱ.
\ft For the woman which hath an husband is bound by the law to her husband so long as he liveth; but if the husband be dead, she is loosed from the law of her husband.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi, iyuno asiquo ehv uyehi, nvwadale asgaya yidunatsenv, adayonehi agosehesdi; iyusgini uyehi uyohusvhi yigi, ududaledv geso dikahnawadvsdi ududalvdvi; nasgino vtla adayonehi yigi, unelagi nvwadale asgaya yidanatseha.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎠᏏᏉ ᎡᎲ ᎤᏰᎯ, ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᏱᏚᎾᏤᏅ, ᎠᏓᏲᏁᎯ ᎠᎪᏎᎮᏍᏗ; ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏰᎯ ᎤᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᏱᎩ, ᎤᏚᏓᎴᏛ ᎨᏐ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎤᏚᏓᎸᏛᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎠᏓᏲᏁᎯ ᏱᎩ, ᎤᏁᎳᎩ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᏱᏓᎾᏤᎭ.
\ft So then if, while her husband liveth, she be married to another man, she shall be called an adulteress: but if her husband be dead, she is free from that law; so that she is no adulteress, though she be married to another man.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi idalinvtli nihi nasquo ditsiyohusvhi nitsalistanv dikahnawadvsdi ugvwali, Galonedv ayelv iyuwanisadv; nasgi nvwadale ditsatsvsdiyi ayelvsvgi, nasgi ayohusv tsagaletanvhi gesvi, nasgi ugatatanvhi edinanugowisediyi Unelanvhi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ ᏂᎯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏗᏥᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᏂᏣᎵᏍᏔᏅ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ, ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎠᏰᎸ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᏗᏣᏨᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᏰᎸᏒᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏲᎱᏒ ᏣᎦᎴᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎦᏔᏔᏅᎯ ᎡᏗᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᏗᏱ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ.
\ft Wherefore, my brethren, ye also are become dead to the law by the body of Christ; that ye should be married to another, even to him who is raised from the dead, that we should bring forth fruit unto God.

\ln Uquedalvquoyeno asi tsidehvi, asganvisdi gesv udulvnvvsgvi, nasgi dikahnawadvsdi iyuwanisadv gesvi, nasgi dulvwisdanehvgi didiyelv ududadewisvi ugatatanvhi ayohuhisdi gesv edinanugowisediyi.
\syll ᎤᏇᏓᎸᏉᏰᏃ ᎠᏏ ᏥᏕᎲᎢ, ᎠᏍᎦᏅᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏚᎸᏅᎥᏍᎬᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎩ ᏗᏗᏰᎸ ᎤᏚᏓᏕᏫᏒᎢ ᎤᎦᏔᏔᏅᎯ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎡᏗᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᏗᏱ.
\ft For when we were in the flesh, the motions of sins, which were by the law, did work in our members to bring forth fruit unto death.

\ln Gohisgini gesv dikahnawadvsdi edadudalaelv, nvdigalisdodiha uyohusvhi gesv diginatlvnvhi gesvi; nasgi itse adanvdo igvdodiyi gohusdi edadvnediyi, vtlano gowelvquo igvdodiyi nasgiya nigadvnelv tsuwagutanvsvi.
\syll ᎪᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏒ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎡᏓᏚᏓᎳᎡᎸ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎤᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏗᎩᎾᏢᏅᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏤ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎢᎬᏙᏗᏱ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎡᏓᏛᏁᏗᏱ, ᎥᏝᏃ ᎪᏪᎸᏉ ᎢᎬᏙᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏂᎦᏛᏁᎸ ᏧᏩᎫᏔᏅᏒᎢ.
\ft But now we are delivered from the law, that being dead wherein we were held; that we should serve in newness of spirit, and not in the oldness of the letter.

\ln Gadogeno dadadvni?  Tsigo dikahnawadvsdi asganiquo?  gvwatlisdi.  Vtlasgini asgani yigvgigadovse vtla dikahnawadvsdi; Vtlayeno yigatsigatahe uyo adulvnvdi gesvi, iyuno dikahnawadvsdi hia nuwesvna yigesei, Tlesdi tsadadulvelvgi.
\syll ᎦᏙᎨᏃ ᏓᏓᏛᏂ?  ᏥᎪ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎠᏍᎦᏂᏉ?  ᎬᏩᏟᏍᏗ.  ᎥᏝᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᏱᎬᎩᎦᏙᎥᏎ ᎥᏝ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ; ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᏱᎦᏥᎦᏔᎮ ᎤᏲ ᎠᏚᎸᏅᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎾ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᏣᏓᏚᎸᎡᎸᎩ.
\ft What shall we say then? Is the law sin? God forbid. Nay, I had not known sin, but by the law: for I had not known lust, except the law had said, Thou shalt not covet.

\ln Asganisgini ulinetsv gvdisgvi nudalesv uyo aquadulvnvdiyi naquvnelvgi.  Vtlayeno dikahnawadvsdi asgani uyohusvhi yigi.
\syll ᎠᏍᎦᏂᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᎵᏁᏨ ᎬᏗᏍᎬᎢ ᏄᏓᎴᏒ ᎤᏲ ᎠᏆᏚᎸᏅᏗᏱ ᎾᏋᏁᎸᎩ.  ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᎤᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᏱᎩ.
\ft But sin, taking occasion by the commandment, wrought in me all manner of concupiscence. For without the law sin was dead.

\ln Ilvhiyuyeno tsigesv dikahnawadvsdi nidaquanelodvna gesv iyui gvnodv gesvgi; ulinetsvsgini ulutsv, asgani udvnidvgi, ayvno agiyohusvgi.
\syll ᎢᎸᎯᏳᏰᏃ ᏥᎨᏒ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏂᏓᏆᏁᎶᏛᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᎢ ᎬᏃᏛ ᎨᏒᎩ; ᎤᎵᏁᏨᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᎷᏨ, ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᎤᏛᏂᏛᎩ, ᎠᏴᏃ ᎠᎩᏲᎱᏒᎩ.
\ft For I was alive without the law once: but when the commandment came, sin revived, and I died.

\ln Ale nasgi ulinetsv gvnidv adanehi gesv adahihiquo naqualisdanelvgi ayv.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎵᏁᏨ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎠᏓᏁᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏓᎯᎯᏉ ᎾᏆᎵᏍᏓᏁᎸᎩ ᎠᏴ.
\ft And the commandment, which was ordained to life, I found to be unto death.

\ln Asganiyeno ulinetsv gvdisgv agilonuhelvgi, ale nasgi agihistanvgi.
\syll ᎠᏍᎦᏂᏰᏃ ᎤᎵᏁᏨ ᎬᏗᏍᎬ ᎠᎩᎶᏄᎮᎸᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎩᎯᏍᏔᏅᎩ.
\ft For sin, taking occasion by the commandment, deceived me, and by it slew me.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi dikahnawadvsdi nasganvna; ale nasgi ulinetsv nasganvna, ale duyugodvi, ale osiyu.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎦᏅᎾ; ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎵᏁᏨ ᎾᏍᎦᏅᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏳᎪᏛᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎣᏏᏳ.
\ft Wherefore the law is holy, and the commandment holy, and just, and good.

\ln Tsigono nasgi na osdv gesv agihihiquo nulistanei?  gvwatlisdi.  Asganisgini, nasgi gvnigesv iyulisdodiyi nasgi nusdv asgani, dulvwisdanehvgi agihisdiyi gvdisgvgi nasgi na osdv gesvi; nasgi asgani ulinetsv iyuwanisadv utsati asganahiyu iyulisdodiyi.
\syll ᏥᎪᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎩᎯᎯᏉ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ?  ᎬᏩᏟᏍᏗ.  ᎠᏍᎦᏂᏍᎩᏂ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ, ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎩ ᎠᎩᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎬᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᎤᎵᏁᏨ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎠᏍᎦᏀᎢᏳ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
\ft Was then that which is good made death unto me? God forbid. But sin, that it might appear sin, working death in me by that which is good; that sin by the commandment might become exceeding sinful.

\ln Idigatahayeno nasgi dikahnawadvsdi adanvdo utloyi gesvi; ayvsgini uquedali aquatinidohi, vginadinvdv asgani aginatlvdiyi.
\syll ᎢᏗᎦᏔᎭᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᏠᏱ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎠᏴᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎠᏆᏘᏂᏙᎯ, ᎥᎩᎾᏗᏅᏛ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᎠᎩᎾᏢᏗᏱ.
\ft For we know that the law is spiritual: but I am carnal, sold under sin.

\ln Nusdvyeno dagilvwisdanehvi, vtla osiyu yagiyelvha; nusdvsgini aquadulisgvi vtla nasgi yinigadvnehoi; nasgisgini tsiniquatihvi, nasgi nigadvnehoi.
\syll ᏄᏍᏛᏰᏃ ᏓᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎣᏏᏳ ᏯᎩᏰᎸᎭ; ᏄᏍᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏆᏚᎵᏍᎬᎢ ᎥᏝ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᏂᎦᏛᏁᎰᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ ᏥᏂᏆᏘᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᏛᏁᎰᎢ.
\ft For that which I do I allow not: for what I would, that do I not; but what I hate, that do I.

\ln Nasgino iyu naquadulisgvna gesv nasgi yinigadvneha, dikahnawadvsdi osiyu gesv goiyuhvsga.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎢᏳ ᎾᏆᏚᎵᏍᎬᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᏂᎦᏛᏁᎭ, ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎪᎢᏳᎲᏍᎦ.
\ft If then I do that which I would not, I consent unto the law that it is good.

\ln Nasgino tsinusdi vtla hnaquo ayv nasgi yinigadvneha, asganisgini nasgi tsagiyaa.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏥᏄᏍᏗ ᎥᏝ ᎿᏉ ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᏂᎦᏛᏁᎭ, ᎠᏍᎦᏂᏍᎩᏂ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏣᎩᏯᎠ.
\ft Now then it is no more I that do it, but sin that dwelleth in me.

\ln Tsigatahayeno nasgi ayv gesvi, (nasgi agiquedalv yadvnv,) gohusdi osdv nulitloyasdvna gesvi; adulvdiyiyeno agiha; nasgisgini na osdv gesv iyadvnediyi vtla yitsiwatiha.
\syll ᏥᎦᏔᎭᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎩᏇᏓᎸ ᏯᏛᏅ, ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏄᎵᏠᏯᏍᏛᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎠᏚᎸᏗᏱᏰᏃ ᎠᎩᎭ; ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ Ꮎ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᏗᏱ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏥᏩᏘᎭ.
\ft For I know that in me (that is, in my flesh,) dwelleth no good thing: for to will is present with me; but how to perform that which is good I find not.

\ln Osdvyeno iyadvnediyi aquadulisgvi, vtla nasgi yinigadvnehoi; uyosgini nasgi naquadulisgvna gesvi, nasgi nigadvnehoi.
\syll ᎣᏍᏛᏰᏃ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᏗᏱ ᎠᏆᏚᎵᏍᎬᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᏂᎦᏛᏁᎰᎢ; ᎤᏲᏍᎩᏂ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏆᏚᎵᏍᎬᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᏛᏁᎰᎢ.
\ft For the good that I would I do not: but the evil which I would not, that I do.

\ln Nasgino iyuno ayv naquadulisgvna gesv nasgi yinigadvneha, vtla ayv hnaquo nasgi yinigagadvneha, asganisgini nasgi tsagiyaa.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎢᏳᏃ ᎠᏴ ᎾᏆᏚᎵᏍᎬᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᏂᎦᏛᏁᎭ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᏴ ᎿᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᏂᎦᎦᏛᏁᎭ, ᎠᏍᎦᏂᏍᎩᏂ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏣᎩᏯᎠ.
\ft Now if I do that I would not, it is no more I that do it, but sin that dwelleth in me.

\ln Nasgino naquo tsiwatiha hia dikahnawadvsdi, nasgi osdv iyaquadvnediyi aquadulv, uyo gesv dagikahnawadidohoi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎾᏉ ᏥᏩᏘᎭ ᎯᎠ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎢᏯᏆᏛᏁᏗᏱ ᎠᏆᏚᎸ, ᎤᏲ ᎨᏒ ᏓᎩᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎰᎢ.
\ft I find then a law, that, when I would do good, evil is present with me.

\ln Osiyuyeno agiyelvha dikahnawadvsdi Unelanvhi utseliga gvdiha hawini aquehv yvwi.
\syll ᎣᏏᏳᏰᏃ ᎠᎩᏰᎸᎭ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᎬᏗᎭ ᎭᏫᏂ ᎠᏇᎲ ᏴᏫ.
\ft For I delight in the law of God after the inward man:

\ln Aseno itsigowatiha nvwadale dikahnawadvsdi tsiyelv aquadudadewisvi, nasgi digatilegi dikahnawadvsdi aquadanvdogihi ahvi, ale tsiyvgi iyaquvnehi aquudalvvsgi dikahnawadvsdiyi asgani utseliga, nasgi tsiyelv aquadudadewisv ahvi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎢᏥᎪᏩᏘᎭ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏥᏰᎸ ᎠᏆᏚᏓᏕᏫᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎦᏘᎴᎩ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏙᎩᎯ ᎠᎲᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᏴᎩ ᎢᏯᏋᏁᎯ ᎠᏊᏓᎸᎥᏍᎩ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏰᎸ ᎠᏆᏚᏓᏕᏫᏒ ᎠᎲᎢ.
\ft But I see another law in my members, warring against the law of my mind, and bringing me into captivity to the law of sin which is in my members.

\ln Uyosdvquo naquasdi ayv!  gago dvquudalesi hia nasgi tsiyelv adahihi aquadudalvdvi.
\syll ᎤᏲᏍᏛᏉ ᎾᏆᏍᏗ ᎠᏴ  ᎦᎪ ᏛᏊᏓᎴᏏ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏰᎸ ᎠᏓᎯᎯ ᎠᏆᏚᏓᎸᏛᎢ.
\ft O wretched man that I am! who shall deliver me from the body of this death?

\ln Unelanvhi tsiyalielitseha Tsisa Galonedv Ugvwiyuhi igatseliga iyuwanisadv.  Nasgino aquadanvtediyi gvdiha, ayvquo nasgi dikahnawadvsdi Unelanvhi utseli detsiganawadega, agiquedalvsgini gesv gvdi dikahnawadvsdi asgani utseli detsigahnawadega.
\syll ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏥᏯᎵᎡᎵᏤᎭ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᎦᏤᎵᎦ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ.  ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏖᏗᏱ ᎬᏗᎭ, ᎠᏴᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏕᏥᎦᎾᏩᏕᎦ, ᎠᎩᏇᏓᎸᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏗ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏕᏥᎦᎿᏩᏕᎦ.
\ft I thank God through Jesus Christ our Lord. So then with the mind I myself serve the law of God; but with the flesh the law of sin.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi vtla hnaquo waha digvwanadugodanedi gesv nasgi na Tsisa Galonedv gvwayai, nasgi uquedali gesv nanisdawadegvna tsigi, adanvdosgini tsanisdawadega.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎥᏝ ᎿᏉ ᏩᎭ ᏗᎬᏩᎾᏚᎪᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎬᏩᏯᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏂᏍᏓᏩᏕᎬᎾ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᏓᏅᏙᏍᎩᏂ ᏣᏂᏍᏓᏩᏕᎦ.
\ft There is therefore now no condemnation to them which are in Christ Jesus, who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit.

\ln Adanvdoyeno gvnidv adanehi, nasgi gvnidv Galonedv Tsisa tsvdidalehvsga, nasgi Adanvdo utseli dikahnawadvsdi aquudalesv asgani ale ayohuhisdi gesv unatseli dikahnawadvsdiyi aquadudalvi.
\syll ᎠᏓᏅᏙᏰᏃ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎠᏓᏁᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏥᏌ ᏨᏗᏓᎴᎲᏍᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎠᏊᏓᎴᏒ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎾᏤᎵ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᏆᏚᏓᎸᎢ.
\ft For the law of the Spirit of life in Christ Jesus hath made me free from the law of sin and death.

\ln Dikahnawadvsdiyeno igvwadvnedi nigesvna gesvi, nvdigalisdodisgv awanagalahiyu gesv uquedali iyuwanisadv,^ Unelanvhi uwasv Uwetsi tsunvse nasgiya ditlilostanvhi asgana uquedali, ale asgani tsugvwalei, duwugodanele usegogise asganvisdi gesv uquedalv ayavi;
\syll ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗᏰᏃ ᎢᎬᏩᏛᏁᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬ ᎠᏩᎾᎦᎳᎯᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ,data is invalid ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎤᏪᏥ ᏧᏅᏎ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏗᏟᎶᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎠᏍᎦᎾ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᏧᎬᏩᎴᎢ, ᏚᏭᎪᏓᏁᎴ ᎤᏎᎪᎩᏎ ᎠᏍᎦᏅᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏇᏓᎸ ᎠᏯᎥᎢ;
\ft For what the law could not do, in that it was weak through the flesh, God sending his own Son in the likeness of sinful flesh, and for sin, condemned sin in the flesh:

\ln Nasgi nvdayulisdododiyi dikahnawadvsdi nigawesgv nasgiya duyugodv igadvnehohvsdiyi, ayv uquedali gesv idisdawadegi nigesvna tsigi, Adanvdosgini idisdawadegi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏓᏳᎵᏍᏙᏙᏗᏱ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎬ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎢᎦᏛᏁᎰᎲᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᏴ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏗᏍᏓᏩᏕᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᏓᏅᏙᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᏗᏍᏓᏩᏕᎩ.
\ft That the righteousness of the law might be fulfilled in us, who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit.

\ln Nasgiyeno uquedali tsunatinidohi uquedaliquo utseli ugvwali unagasayasdoi, nasgisgini na Adanvdo tsunatinidohi Adanvdoquo utseli ugvwali unagasayasdoi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᏧᎾᏘᏂᏙᎯ ᎤᏇᏓᎵᏉ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᎤᎾᎦᏌᏯᏍᏙᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ Ꮎ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᏧᎾᏘᏂᏙᎯ ᎠᏓᏅᏙᏉ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᎤᎾᎦᏌᏯᏍᏙᎢ.
\ft For they that are after the flesh do mind the things of the flesh; but they that are after the Spirit the things of the Spirit.

\ln Uquedaliyeno agasayasdodiyi ayohuhisdi gesv waliyeilohiha; adanvdosgini adesayasdodiyi gvnidv ale nvwadohiyadv digesv waliyeilohiha.
\syll ᎤᏇᏓᎵᏰᏃ ᎠᎦᏌᏯᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏩᎵᏰᎢᎶᎯᎭ; ᎠᏓᏅᏙᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏕᏌᏯᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎠᎴ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᏗᎨᏒ ᏩᎵᏰᎢᎶᎯᎭ.
\ft For to be carnally minded is death; but to be spiritually minded is life and peace.

\ln Uquedaliyeno agasayasdodiyi gesv nasgi Unelanvhi digatilegi; vtlayeno dikahnawadvsdi Unelanvhi utseli dikahnawadegi yigi, vtla ale udogiyuhi nasgi yeli yinvgvdvga;
\syll ᎤᏇᏓᎵᏰᏃ ᎠᎦᏌᏯᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏗᎦᏘᎴᎩ; ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏕᎩ ᏱᎩ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏙᎩᏳᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏰᎵ ᏱᏅᎬᏛᎦ;
\ft Because the carnal mind is enmity against God: for it is not subject to the law of God, neither indeed can be.

\ln Nasgino uquedali tsunatinidohi gesv vtla Unelanvhi osdv uyelvdi yinvgvnadvga.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᏧᎾᏘᏂᏙᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎤᏰᎸᏗ ᏱᏅᎬᎾᏛᎦ.
\ft So then they that are in the flesh cannot please God.

\ln Nihisgini vtla uquedali ditsatinidohi yigi, Adanvdosgini ditsatinidohi, iyuno howa Unelanvhi Udanvdo yitsiyaa.  Ale iyu gilo Galonedv Udanvdo nuwehvna igesesdi, nasgi na vtla [Galonedv] utseli yigagi.
\syll ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᏗᏣᏘᏂᏙᎯ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᏓᏅᏙᏍᎩᏂ ᏗᏣᏘᏂᏙᎯ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎰᏩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏓᏅᏙ ᏱᏥᏯᎠ.  ᎠᎴ ᎢᏳ ᎩᎶ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏓᏅᏙ ᏄᏪᎲᎾ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎥᏝ ᎦᎶᏁᏛdata is invalid ᎤᏤᎵ ᏱᎦᎩ.
\ft But ye are not in the flesh, but in the Spirit, if so be that the Spirit of God dwell in you. Now if any man have not the Spirit of Christ, he is none of his.

\ln Iyusgini Galonedv itsiyaesdi, ayelv udohiyuhi uyohusvhi asgani nvdigalisdodiha; Adanvdosgini gvnodv duyugodv iyadvnedi gesv nvdigalisdodiha.
\syll ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎢᏥᏯᎡᏍᏗ, ᎠᏰᎸ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎤᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ; ᎠᏓᏅᏙᏍᎩᏂ ᎬᏃᏛ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ.
\ft And if Christ be in you, the body is dead because of sin; but the Spirit is life because of righteousness.

\ln Iyusgini Tsisa uyohusv tsuletanvhi Udanvdo itsiyaesdi, nasgi Galonedv uyohusv tsuletanvhi nasquo dodagvnohistani diyohusgi ditsiyelvi dagvtani Udanvdo nasgi tsitsiyaa.
\syll ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᏥᏌ ᎤᏲᎱᏒ ᏧᎴᏔᏅᎯ ᎤᏓᏅᏙ ᎢᏥᏯᎡᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏲᎱᏒ ᏧᎴᏔᏅᎯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏙᏓᎬᏃᎯᏍᏔᏂ ᏗᏲᎱᏍᎩ ᏗᏥᏰᎸᎢ ᏓᎬᏔᏂ ᎤᏓᏅᏙ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏥᏯᎠ.
\ft But if the Spirit of him that raised up Jesus from the dead dwell in you, he that raised up Christ from the dead shall also quicken your mortal bodies by his Spirit that dwelleth in you.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi idalinvtli, egiduga, vtla uquedali yigiduga, nasgi uquedali igisdawadidasdiyi idehvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᎡᎩᏚᎦ, ᎥᏝ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᏱᎩᏚᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎢᎩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏓᏍᏗᏱ ᎢᏕᎲᎢ.
\ft Therefore, brethren, we are debtors, not to the flesh, to live after the flesh.

\ln Iyuyeno itsehv uquedali gesv itsisdawadidohesdi, dodatsiyohusi; iyusgini Adanvdo gvdi ayelv dulvwisdanehv itsihihesdi, detsvnesdi.
\syll ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᎢᏤᎲ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏥᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎮᏍᏗ, ᏙᏓᏥᏲᎱᏏ; ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎬᏗ ᎠᏰᎸ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᎢᏥᎯᎮᏍᏗ, ᏕᏨᏁᏍᏗ.
\ft For if ye live after the flesh, ye shall die: but if ye through the Spirit do mortify the deeds of the body, ye shall live.

\ln Nanivyeno giloi Unelanvhi Udanvdo tsunatinidohi, nasgi Unelanvhi tsuwetsi.
\syll ᎾᏂᎥᏰᏃ ᎩᎶᎢ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏓᏅᏙ ᏧᎾᏘᏂᏙᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᏪᏥ.
\ft For as many as are led by the Spirit of God, they are the sons of God.

\ln Vtlayeno Adanvdo atsinatlai taline etsinelvhi yigi, nasgi itsinayehisdiyi; tsuwetsisgini igegvnelvhi unadanvdo etsinelv, nasgi idvdisgv, Aqua!  Edoda!  tsidadisgoi.
\syll ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎠᏥᎾᏝᎢ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎡᏥᏁᎸᎯ ᏱᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏥᎾᏰᎯᏍᏗᏱ; ᏧᏪᏥᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᎨᎬᏁᎸᎯ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏙ ᎡᏥᏁᎸ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏛᏗᏍᎬ, ᎠᏆ  ᎡᏙᏓ  ᏥᏓᏗᏍᎪᎢ.
\ft For ye have not received the spirit of bondage again to fear; but ye have received the Spirit of adoption, whereby we cry, Abba, Father.

\ln Adanvdoyeno uwasv daligoneha digadanvdo gvnigesv nanvnehv, nasgi ayv Unelanvhi tsuwetsi gesvi.
\syll ᎠᏓᏅᏙᏰᏃ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏓᎵᎪᏁᎭ ᏗᎦᏓᏅᏙ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎾᏅᏁᎲ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᏪᏥ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft The Spirit itself beareth witness with our spirit, that we are the children of God:

\ln Ale iyu tsuwetsi yigi, hnaquo igatiyehi tsugvwalodi; igatiyedi tsugvwalodi Unelanvhi udanedi gesvi, ale Galonedv itsulaha igatiyedi; iyuno howa yigatloyasdiha agiliyogvi, nasquo igatloyasdodi gesesdi atsilvquodisgvi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎢᏳ ᏧᏪᏥ ᏱᎩ, ᎿᏉ ᎢᎦᏘᏰᎯ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ; ᎢᎦᏘᏰᏗ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎢᎦᏘᏰᏗ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᎰᏩ ᏱᎦᏠᏯᏍᏗᎭ ᎠᎩᎵᏲᎬᎢ, ᎾᏍᏉ ᎢᎦᏠᏯᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏗᏍᎬᎢ.
\ft And if children, then heirs; heirs of God, and joint-heirs with Christ; if so be that we suffer with him, that we may be also glorified together.

\ln Gadanvtesgvyeno hia nasgi gohi agiliyoisdi gesv vtla digvtlilosdodi yigi galvquodiyu gesv nasgi eginanugowisedi gesvi.
\syll ᎦᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬᏰᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᎯ ᎠᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎥᏝ ᏗᎬᏟᎶᏍᏙᏗ ᏱᎩ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᎩᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft For I reckon that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which shall be revealed in us.

\ln Ulinigidvyeno udugi uwasv aganelanvhi gesv agatiya getsinanugowisv Unelanvhi tsuwetsi.
\syll ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛᏰᏃ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎠᎦᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎦᏘᏯ ᎨᏥᎾᏄᎪᏫᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᏪᏥ.
\ft For the earnest expectation of the creature waiteth for the manifestation of the sons of God.

\ln Aganelanvhiyeno ayogi nagvnelei, vtla osiyu uyelvsv iyusdi, osiyusgini uyelvnv iyusdi nasgi na nasgi iyuwanelvhi, udugi uwvdiyi uyelvnv,
\syll ᎠᎦᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ ᎠᏲᎩ ᎾᎬᏁᎴᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎤᏰᎸᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᎣᏏᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏰᎸᏅ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏩᏁᎸᎯ, ᎤᏚᎩ ᎤᏮᏗᏱ ᎤᏰᎸᏅ,
\ft For the creature was made subject to vanity, not willingly, but by reason of him who hath subjected the same in hope,

\ln Nasgi aganelanvhi uwasv nasquo ududalesdiyi ayogi gesv unatlavi, galvquodiyu nidigetsinatlavna gesv Unelanvhi tsuwetsi unatseliga widigetsigodiyi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎦᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᏚᏓᎴᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᏲᎩ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎾᏝᎥᎢ, ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᏂᏗᎨᏥᎾᏝᎥᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᏪᏥ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ ᏫᏗᎨᏥᎪᏗᏱ.
\ft Because the creature itself also shall be delivered from the bondage of corruption into the glorious liberty of the children of God.

\ln Idigatahayeno nasgi naniv geganelanvhi gesv itsulaha uniliyedisgv ale anigiliyogv gohi iyasdi.
\syll ᎢᏗᎦᏔᎭᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎨᎦᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎤᏂᎵᏰᏗᏍᎬ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᎩᎵᏲᎬ ᎪᎯ ᎢᏯᏍᏗ.
\ft For we know that the whole creation groaneth and travaileth in pain together until now.

\ln Vtla ale unvsvquo, igvsvsgini nasquo nasgi igvyiyi unanugowisvhi ~adanvdo tsigeha, ayv nasquo igvsv gesv hawini degiliyediha, idigatiyv tsuwetsi igegvnedi, nasgi didiyelv tsuguyvdiyi tsuwudalesdiyi.
\syll ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏅᏒᏉ, ᎢᎬᏒᏍᎩᏂ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎬᏱᏱ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏫᏒᎯ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᏥᎨᎭ, ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎢᎬᏒ ᎨᏒ ᎭᏫᏂ ᏕᎩᎵᏰᏗᎭ, ᎢᏗᎦᏘᏴ ᏧᏪᏥ ᎢᎨᎬᏁᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏗᏰᎸ ᏧᎫᏴᏗᏱ ᏧᏭᏓᎴᏍᏗᏱ.
\ft And not only they, but ourselves also, which have the firstfruits of the Spirit, even we ourselves groan within ourselves, waiting for the adoption, to wit, the redemption of our body.

\ln Udugiquoyeno igvha egisdelvdiyi; udugisgini owasv agohvhi tsigesoi vtla udugi yowasoi; Gohusdiyeno tsvgowatisgoi, gadono asi udugi yigayowaha?
\syll ᎤᏚᎩᏉᏰᏃ ᎢᎬᎭ ᎡᎩᏍᏕᎸᏗᏱ; ᎤᏚᎩᏍᎩᏂ ᎣᏩᏒ ᎠᎪᎲᎯ ᏥᎨᏐᎢ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏚᎩ ᏲᏩᏐᎢ; ᎪᎱᏍᏗᏰᏃ ᏨᎪᏩᏘᏍᎪᎢ, ᎦᏙᏃ ᎠᏏ ᎤᏚᎩ ᏱᎦᏲᏩᎭ?
\ft For we are saved by hope: but hope that is seen is not hope: for what a man seeth, why doth he yet hope for?

\ln Iyusgini igigohvhi nigesvna gesv udugi yigvha, hnaquo didvnidiyu idigatiyo nasgi.
\syll ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᎩᎪᎲᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏚᎩ ᏱᎬᎭ, ᎿᏉ ᏗᏛᏂᏗᏳ ᎢᏗᎦᏘᏲ ᎾᏍᎩ.
\ft But if we hope for that we see not, then do we with patience wait for it.

\ln Nasgiya nasquo Adanvdo igisdeliha didiwanagalahiyu gesvi; vtlayeno yidigataha iyusdi duyugodv gesv igitayosdiyi idadadolisdisgvi; Adanvdosgini uwasv igalisdiyedaneha uliyedisgv gvdiha nasgi ganeisdi nigesvna gesvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎢᎩᏍᏕᎵᎭ ᏗᏗᏩᎾᎦᎳᎯᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᏱᏗᎦᏔᎭ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎢᎩᏔᏲᏍᏗᏱ ᎢᏓᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ; ᎠᏓᏅᏙᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎢᎦᎵᏍᏗᏰᏓᏁᎭ ᎤᎵᏰᏗᏍᎬ ᎬᏗᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏁᎢᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Likewise the Spirit also helpeth our infirmities: for we know not what we should pray for as we ought: but the Spirit itself maketh intercession for us with groanings which cannot be uttered.

\ln Ale nasgi na digoliyesdi tsunawi agataha nusdv adanvtelidohv Adanvdo nvdigalisdodi unadanvti dalisdiyedanehv nasgiya Unelanvhi osiyu uyelvdi gesvi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏗᎪᎵᏰᏍᏗ ᏧᎾᏫ ᎠᎦᏔᎭ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎠᏓᏅᏖᎵᏙᎲ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ ᏓᎵᏍᏗᏰᏓᏁᎲ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎤᏰᎸᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft And he that searcheth the hearts knoweth what is the mind of the Spirit, because he maketh intercession for the saints according to the will of God.

\ln Ale idigataha nasgi nigav nidulistanidohv unatequalosv osdv iyunalisdanediyi dunilvwisdanehv Unelanvhi unigeyuhi, nasgi na getsiyanvdv tsigi nasgiya udanvtelvi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎢᏗᎦᏔᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏂᏚᎵᏍᏔᏂᏙᎲ ᎤᎾᏖᏆᎶᏒ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᏚᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏂᎨᏳᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎨᏥᏯᏅᏛ ᏥᎩ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎤᏓᏅᏖᎸᎢ.
\ft And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God, to them who are the called according to his purpose.

\ln Nasgiyeno gayula tsinidagatahoi, nasgi nasquo nidusuyeso Uwetsi nusdv nasgiya iyunalisdodiyi, nasgi igvyi ehi iyulisdodiyi unitsati analinvtli anehvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎦᏳᎳ ᏥᏂᏓᎦᏔᎰᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏂᏚᏑᏰᏐ ᎤᏪᏥ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎬᏱ ᎡᎯ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏟ ᎠᏁᎲᎢ.
\ft For whom he did foreknow, he also did predestinate to be conformed to the image of his Son, that he might be the firstborn among many brethren.

\ln Nasgino gayula tsinidusuyesoi nasgi nasquo duyanvhei; ale nasgi tsuyanvdv gesvi, nasgi nasquo duwudalesei; ale nasgi tsuwudaledv gesv, nasgi nasquo galvquodiyu niduwanelei.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎦᏳᎳ ᏥᏂᏚᏑᏰᏐᎢ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏚᏯᏅᎮᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏯᏅᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏚᏭᏓᎴᏎᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏭᏓᎴᏛ ᎨᏒ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᏂᏚᏩᏁᎴᎢ.
\ft Moreover whom he did predestinate, them he also called: and whom he called, them he also justified: and whom he justified, them he also glorified.

\ln Gadono dadadvni hia nasgi tsinusdi?  iyuno Unelanvhi yigisdeliha gago yigatluda?
\syll ᎦᏙᏃ ᏓᏓᏛᏂ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏄᏍᏗ?  ᎢᏳᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏱᎩᏍᏕᎵᎭ ᎦᎪ ᏱᎦᏡᏓ?
\ft What shall we then say to these things? If God be for us, who can be against us?

\ln Nasgi na nugeyunvna tsigese uwasv Uwetsi, tsiduyosequosgini ayv nidiv igisdelisgvi, gado yigalisdoda nasgi degiyohisehv asequo digegiyohisedi nigesvna yinigalisda nigadiyu gohusdi?
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏄᎨᏳᏅᎾ ᏥᎨᏎ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎤᏪᏥ, ᏥᏚᏲᏎᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏴ ᏂᏗᎥ ᎢᎩᏍᏕᎵᏍᎬᎢ, ᎦᏙ ᏱᎦᎵᏍᏙᏓ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏕᎩᏲᎯᏎᎲ ᎠᏎᏉ ᏗᎨᎩᏲᎯᏎᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏱᏂᎦᎵᏍᏓ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ?
\ft He that spared not his own Son, but delivered him up for us all, how shall he not with him also freely give us all things?

\ln Gago unisganvtsv dodaguhistani Unalenvhi tsusuyedv?  tsigo Unelanvhi, nasgi unudalesgi?
\syll ᎦᎪ ᎤᏂᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᏙᏓᎫᎯᏍᏔᏂ ᎤᎾᎴᏅᎯ ᏧᏑᏰᏛ?  ᏥᎪ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏄᏓᎴᏍᎩ?
\ft Who shall lay any thing to the charge of God's elect? It is God that justifieth.

\ln Gago tsunugodanehi?  Galonedvsgo, nasgi tsunihusei, vv, ale nasquo nasgi tsidulehisanv, nasgi nasquo Unelanvhi agadisiditlv tsuwola, nasgi nasquo tsigalisdiyedaneha?
\syll ᎦᎪ ᏧᏄᎪᏓᏁᎯ?  ᎦᎶᏁᏛᏍᎪ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏂᎱᏎᎢ, ᎥᎥ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏚᎴᎯᏌᏅ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎦᏗᏏᏗᏢ ᏧᏬᎳ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏥᎦᎵᏍᏗᏰᏓᏁᎭ?
\ft Who is he that condemneth? It is Christ that died, yea rather, that is risen again, who is even at the right hand of God, who also maketh intercession for us.

\ln Gago iyvdv nvdagvneli Galonedv igigesvi?  tsigo agiliyoisdi gesvi, ale uwelihisdi adanvdadisdi gesvi, ale uyo iyvdadvnedi gesvi, ale udagonulohisdi gesvi, ale digiyelvha gesvi, ale unayehisdi gesvi, ale ayelasdiganvhidv?
\syll ᎦᎪ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏅᏓᎬᏁᎵ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎢᎩᎨᏒᎢ?  ᏥᎪ ᎠᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏪᎵᎯᏍᏗ ᎠᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏲ ᎢᏴᏓᏛᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᎪᏄᎶᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎩᏰᎸᎭ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏰᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏰᎳᏍᏗᎦᏅᎯᏛ?
\ft Who shall separate us from the love of Christ? shall tribulation, or distress, or persecution, or famine, or nakedness, or peril, or sword?

\ln Nasgiya hia tsinigvnv tsigowela, Nihi gesv nvdigalisdodiha dogiiha nigohilvi; uninodenaquo dihisdi nasgiya ogiyelva;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᎬᏅ ᏥᎪᏪᎳ, ᏂᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᏙᎩᎢᎭ ᏂᎪᎯᎸᎢ; ᎤᏂᏃᏕᎾᏉ ᏗᎯᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎣᎩᏰᎸᎠ;
\ft As it is written, For thy sake we are killed all the day long; we are accounted as sheep for the slaughter.

\ln Aseno hia nasgi nigadv tsudalenvdv gesv idadasegogisgi ale utli igai, nasgi na igigeyuhiyu iyulistanvhi tsigi iyuwanisadv.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏓᏓᏎᎪᎩᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏟ ᎢᎦᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎢᎩᎨᏳᎯᏳ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ.
\ft Nay, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him that loved us.

\ln Ulinigidvyeno aquohiyuha, nasgi vtla ayohuhisdi gesvi, ale advnidisdi gesvi, ale dinikahnawadidohi, ale nunigvwiyusadegi, ale getsilvquodi, ale gohusdi gohi tseha, ale gohusdi asi unanugoisdi tsigi,
\syll ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛᏰᏃ ᎠᏉᎯᏳᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎥᏝ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏛᏂᏗᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏂᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎨᏥᎸᏉᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎪᎯ ᏤᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎠᏏ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᎢᏍᏗ ᏥᎩ,
\ft For I am persuaded, that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor powers, nor things present, nor things to come,

\ln Vtla ale galvladiyu gesvi, ale hawiniyu gesvi, vtla ale nvwadale anelanvhi gesvi, yeli iyvdv igvwanedi yigesesdi Unelanvhi igigeyusvi, nasgi Galonedv Tsisa Ugvwiyuhi igatseli nvdayudalenvhi tsigi.
\syll ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎦᎸᎳᏗᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎭᏫᏂᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᎠᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏰᎵ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎢᎬᏩᏁᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᎩᎨᏳᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏥᏌ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ.
\ft Nor height, nor depth, nor any other creature, shall be able to separate us from the love of God, which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.

\ln Udohiyuhiya tsinega Galonedv agatahvi, vtla yigatsigovsga, aquadanvdv nasquo aquohiyudanehi nigalisdiha galvquodiyu Adanvdo iyuwanisadv,
\syll ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᏥᏁᎦ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎠᎦᏔᎲᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᏱᎦᏥᎪᎥᏍᎦ, ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏛ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏉᎯᏳᏓᏁᎯ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᎭ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ,
\ft I say the truth in Christ, I lie not, my conscience also bearing me witness in the Holy Ghost,

\ln Nasgi utsati ehisdi aquadanvtawadegv ale nigohilv uyo agiyelvsv aginawiyi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎡᎯᏍᏗ ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏔᏩᏕᎬ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎤᏲ ᎠᎩᏰᎸᏒ ᎠᎩᎾᏫᏱ.
\ft That I have great heaviness and continual sorrow in my heart.

\ln Gvquadulvdiquoyeno aquvsv gesv vgisgatsvhi iyulisdodiyi vquadadaledodiyi Galonedv ehvi gatsisdelisgv otsadanvtli, gohusdi diquvnv a uquedali gesvi;
\syll ᎬᏆᏚᎸᏗᏉᏰᏃ ᎠᏋᏒ ᎨᏒ ᎥᎩᏍᎦᏨᎯ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎥᏆᏓᏓᎴᏙᏗᏱ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎡᎲᎢ ᎦᏥᏍᏕᎵᏍᎬ ᎣᏣᏓᏅᏟ, ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏗᏋᏅ Ꭰ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎨᏒᎢ;
\ft For I could wish that myself were accursed from Christ for my brethren, my kinsmen according to the flesh:

\ln Nasgi Isili tsunetlvtanvdv tsigi; nasgi unatseliga tsigi [Unelanvhi] tsuwetsi igegvnedi gesvi, ale galvquodiyu gesvi, ale kanohedv datlohisdvi, ale dikahnawadvsdi getsinedi gesvi, ale Unelanvhi utseli digalvwisdanedi gesvi, ale aduisdodi gesvi;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏏᎵ ᏧᏁᏢᏔᏅᏛ ᏥᎩ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ ᏥᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯdata is invalid ᏧᏪᏥ ᎢᎨᎬᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏓᏠᎯᏍᏛᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎨᏥᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏚᎢᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ;
\ft Who are Israelites; to whom pertaineth the adoption, and the glory, and the covenants, and the giving of the law, and the service of God, and the promises;

\ln Nasgi tsunidoda tsigi anigayvligei, ale nasgi anehvi, a aquedali gesv tsulutse Galonedv, nasgi Unelanvhi tsigi, nudalesv ugvwiyusadegi, winasdvna galvquododi.  Emanv.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏂᏙᏓ ᏥᎩ ᎠᏂᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏁᎲᎢ, Ꭰ ᎠᏇᏓᎵ ᎨᏒ ᏧᎷᏤ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᏄᏓᎴᏒ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ, ᏫᎾᏍᏛᎾ ᎦᎸᏉᏙᏗ.  ᎡᎹᏅ.
\ft Whose are the fathers, and of whom as concerning the flesh Christ came, who is over all, God blessed for ever. Amen.

\ln Vtla adina Unelanvhi unetsv asequoquo tsinulistano nasgiya [yitsinega,] vtlayeno nigadv Isili yigi nasgi Isili tsunetlvtanvdv tsigi.
\syll ᎥᏝ ᎠᏗᎾ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎠᏎᏉᏉ ᏥᏄᎵᏍᏔᏃ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏱᏥᏁᎦ,data is invalid ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎢᏏᎵ ᏱᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏏᎵ ᏧᏁᏢᏔᏅᏛ ᏥᎩ.
\ft Not as though the word of God hath taken none effect. For they are not all Israel, which are of Israel:

\ln Vtla ale Equahami tsunetlvtanvdv tsigi nasgi yinvdigalisdodiha nigadv tsuwetsi yigi; Esigiquosgini dudov getsiyanvdisgesdi tsanetlvtanvhi.
\syll ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎡᏆᎭᎻ ᏧᏁᏢᏔᏅᏛ ᏥᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏧᏪᏥ ᏱᎩ; ᎡᏏᎩᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᏚᏙᎥ ᎨᏥᏯᏅᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏣᏁᏢᏔᏅᎯ.
\ft Neither, because they are the seed of Abraham, are they all children: but, In Isaac shall thy seed be called.

\ln Nasgi yadvnv, Uquedali gesv unadetanvhi gesvi, nasgi hia vtla Unelanvhi tsuwetsi yigi; aduisdvsgini unadetanvhi gesv nasgi tsuwetsi tsuyelvdi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏯᏛᏅ, ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎾᏕᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᏪᏥ ᏱᎩ; ᎠᏚᎢᏍᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᎾᏕᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏪᏥ ᏧᏰᎸᏗ.
\ft That is, They which are the children of the flesh, these are not the children of God: but the children of the promise are counted for the seed.

\ln Hiayeno nusdi ulinetsv aduisdvi.  Hiaquo iyu datsilutsi, ale Seli dagananugowisi atsutsa.
\syll ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᏄᏍᏗ ᎤᎵᏁᏨ ᎠᏚᎢᏍᏛᎢ.  ᎯᎠᏉ ᎢᏳ ᏓᏥᎷᏥ, ᎠᎴ ᏎᎵ ᏓᎦᎾᏄᎪᏫᏏ ᎠᏧᏣ.
\ft For this is the word of promise, At this time will I come, and Sara shall have a son.

\ln Vtla ale nasgiquo yinusdi; Liquegisgini nasquo unelitsv, nasgi asiyvwi atsinelitselv, nasgi igidoda Esigi;
\syll ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩᏉ ᏱᏄᏍᏗ; ᎵᏇᎩᏍᎩᏂ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᏁᎵᏨ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᎠᏥᏁᎵᏤᎸ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎩᏙᏓ ᎡᏏᎩ;
\ft And not only this; but when Rebecca also had conceived by one, even by our father Isaac;

\ln Diniyoliyeno asi nanadehvsgvna gesei, ale asi gohusdi osdv ale uyoi nanadvnehvna gesei, nasgi udanvtelv Unelanvhi nasgiya tsusuyesdi gesv uyoisdi nigesvna iyulisdodiyi, vtla dunilvwisdanehv nvdigalisdodisgvi, nasgiyasgini diyanisgi udanvtelvi;
\syll ᏗᏂᏲᎵᏰᏃ ᎠᏏ ᎾᎾᏕᎲᏍᎬᎾ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏏ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏲᎢ ᎾᎾᏛᏁᎲᎾ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏓᏅᏖᎸ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏧᏑᏰᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏲᎢᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎥᏝ ᏚᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯᏍᎩᏂ ᏗᏯᏂᏍᎩ ᎤᏓᏅᏖᎸᎢ;
\ft (For the children being not yet born, neither having done any good or evil, that the purpose of God according to election might stand, not of works, but of him that calleth;)

\ln hia natsiweselei, Udanilige dunelodesdi oni ehi;
\syll ᎯᎠ ᎾᏥᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎤᏓᏂᎵᎨ ᏚᏁᎶᏕᏍᏗ ᎣᏂ ᎡᎯ;
\ft It was said unto her, The elder shall serve the younger.

\ln Nasgiya hia tsinigvnv tsigowela, Tsegaqui osiyu tsiyelvnv, Isosgini tsiniquatilv.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᎬᏅ ᏥᎪᏪᎳ, ᏤᎦᏈ ᎣᏏᏳ ᏥᏰᎸᏅ, ᎢᏐᏍᎩᏂ ᏥᏂᏆᏘᎸ.
\ft As it is written, Jacob have I loved, but Esau have I hated.

\ln Nasgino tsinusdi gado dadadvni?  Tsigo niduyugodvna gesv uweha Unelanvhi?  Gvwatlisdi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏥᏄᏍᏗ ᎦᏙ ᏓᏓᏛᏂ?  ᏥᎪ ᏂᏚᏳᎪᏛᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏪᎭ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ?  ᎬᏩᏟᏍᏗ.
\ft What shall we say then? Is there unrighteousness with God? God forbid.

\ln Osiyeno hia natsiweseha, tsiyadolisdi gesesdi nasgi na tsiyadoligi gelisgesdi, ale uwedolisdi tsiyadanvdadisdi gesesdi nasgi na uwedolisdi tsiyadanvdada gelisgesdi.
\syll ᎣᏏᏰᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏥᏪᏎᎭ, ᏥᏯᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏥᏯᏙᎵᎩ ᎨᎵᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏪᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᏥᏯᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᏪᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᏥᏯᏓᏅᏓᏓ ᎨᎵᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
\ft For he saith to Moses, I will have mercy on whom I will have mercy, and I will have compassion on whom I will have compassion.

\ln Nasgino tsinusdi vtla gilo udulvhv yinvdigalisdodiha, vtla ale dusqualvtanv yinvdigalisdodiha, Unalanvhisgini udanvtelvi nasgi digadoligi tsigi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏥᏄᏍᏗ ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏚᎸᎲ ᏱᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᏚᏍᏆᎸᏔᏅ ᏱᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ, ᎤᎾᎳᏅᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏓᏅᏖᎸᎢ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎦᏙᎵᎩ ᏥᎩ.
\ft So then it is not of him that willeth, nor of him that runneth, but of God that sheweth mercy.

\ln Gowelihiyeno hia natsiwese Quedayo, nasgi hia nvdigalisdodiha degvyaletanv, Nasgi aginanugowisdiyi aqualinigidiyu gesv nihi gvyvdisgvi, ale nasgi ayv daquadov tsunotsaloisdiyi elohi nigvnadvi.
\syll ᎪᏪᎵᎯᏰᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏥᏪᏎ ᏇᏓᏲ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᏕᎬᏯᎴᏔᏅ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎩᎾᏄᎪᏫᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᏆᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᏂᎯ ᎬᏴᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᏓᏆᏙᎥ ᏧᏃᏣᎶᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏂᎬᎾᏛᎢ.
\ft For the scripture saith unto Pharaoh, Even for this same purpose have I raised thee up, that I might shew my power in thee, and that my name might be declared throughout all the earth.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi gadoligo nasgi na tsiyadoligi ela, ale gilo tsisdayida ela asdayidisgoi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎦᏙᎵᎪ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏥᏯᏙᎵᎩ ᎡᎳ, ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᏥᏍᏓᏱᏓ ᎡᎳ ᎠᏍᏓᏱᏗᏍᎪᎢ.
\ft Therefore hath he mercy on whom he will have mercy, and whom he will he hardeneth.

\ln Hia ka geli nvdvsgiweseli, Gadono asiquo esga ayelvsga?  gagoyeno dugatilenv nusdv adanvtesgvi?
\syll ᎯᎠ Ꭷ ᎨᎵ ᏅᏛᏍᎩᏪᏎᎵ, ᎦᏙᏃ ᎠᏏᏉ ᎡᏍᎦ ᎠᏰᎸᏍᎦ?  ᎦᎪᏰᏃ ᏚᎦᏘᎴᏅ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎠᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬᎢ?
\ft Thou wilt say then unto me, Why doth he yet find fault? For who hath resisted his will?

\ln Aseno nihi yvwiquo gago itsasdi tsinetseha dehigatilegv Unelanvhi?  Tsigo gohusdi atlvnvhi hia nvdagaweseli nasgi uwotlvnvhi, Gadono nasgi hia nisquvnelv isquotlvnv?
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᏂᎯ ᏴᏫᏉ ᎦᎪ ᎢᏣᏍᏗ ᏥᏁᏤᎭ ᏕᎯᎦᏘᎴᎬ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ?  ᏥᎪ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎠᏢᏅᎯ ᎯᎠ ᏅᏓᎦᏪᏎᎵ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏬᏢᏅᎯ, ᎦᏙᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏍᏋᏁᎸ ᎢᏍᏉᏢᏅ?
\ft Nay but, O man, who art thou that repliest against God? Shall the thing formed say to him that formed it, Why hast thou made me thus?

\ln Tlasgo diwali digotlvsgi yuha adanvtesgv iyuwanelidasdiyi gadaquala, nasgiquo ganaqualvsv agvhalvdv saquo atelido uwotlvdiyi galvquododi, nvwadaleno galvquododi nigesvna?
\syll ᏝᏍᎪ ᏗᏩᎵ ᏗᎪᏢᏍᎩ ᏳᎭ ᎠᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ ᎢᏳᏩᏁᎵᏓᏍᏗᏱ ᎦᏓᏆᎳ, ᎾᏍᎩᏉ ᎦᎾᏆᎸᏒ ᎠᎬᎭᎸᏛ ᏌᏉ ᎠᏖᎵᏙ ᎤᏬᏢᏗᏱ ᎦᎸᏉᏙᏗ, ᏅᏩᏓᎴᏃ ᎦᎸᏉᏙᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ?
\ft Hath not the potter power over the clay, of the same lump to make one vessel unto honour, and another unto dishonour?

\ln [Gadono yusdi,] iyuno Unelanvhi udulisgv gvnigesv iyuwanediyi utalawohisdi gesvi, ale ulinigvgv unanugowisdiyi, gvnidiyu gesv gvdisgv gohidiyu unelagi yiduweliselv ditelido utalawohisdi gesv ditlisdi, didvnvistanvhi didvdodiyi;
\syll ᎦᏙᏃ ᏳᏍᏗ,data is invalid ᎢᏳᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎬ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏩᏁᏗᏱ ᎤᏔᎳᏬᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏂᎬᎬ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏫᏍᏗᏱ, ᎬᏂᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏗᏍᎬ ᎪᎯᏗᏳ ᎤᏁᎳᎩ ᏱᏚᏪᎵᏎᎸ ᏗᏖᎵᏙ ᎤᏔᎳᏬᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏗᏟᏍᏗ, ᏗᏛᏅᎢᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᏗᏛᏙᏗᏱ;
\ft What if God, willing to shew his wrath, and to make his power known, endured with much longsuffering the vessels of wrath fitted to destruction:

\ln Ale nasgi [udulisgv] gvnigesv iyuwanediyi utseli utsatanvhi galvquodiyu gesv degvdisgv ditelido udadolisdi gesv ditlisdi, nasgi tsudvnvistanvhi tsinigese galvquodiyu digesv wunadediyi,
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎬdata is invalid ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏩᏁᏗᏱ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎤᏣᏔᏅᎯ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᏕᎬᏗᏍᎬ ᏗᏖᎵᏙ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏗᏟᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏛᏅᎢᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᏥᏂᎨᏎ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᏗᎨᏒ ᏭᎾᏕᏗᏱ,
\ft And that he might make known the riches of his glory on the vessels of mercy, which he had afore prepared unto glory,

\ln Nasgi ayv, igiyanvdv tsigi, vtla Anitsusiquo unvsv anehvi, nasquosgini tsunadalenvdv yvwi anehvi;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ, ᎢᎩᏯᏅᏛ ᏥᎩ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᏂᏧᏏᏉ ᎤᏅᏒ ᎠᏁᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᎠᏁᎲᎢ;
\ft Even us, whom he hath called, not of the Jews only, but also of the Gentiles?

\ln Nasgiya nasquo hia tsinigawe Hosia uwowelvi; diquatseli yvwi gatsiyosehesdi nasgi na diquatseli yvwi nigesvna tsigesvgi; ale tsigeyui (tsiyosehesdi,) nasgi na tsigeyui nigesvna tsigesvgi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᎦᏪ ᎰᏏᎠ ᎤᏬᏪᎸᎢ; ᏗᏆᏤᎵ ᏴᏫ ᎦᏥᏲᏎᎮᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏗᏆᏤᎵ ᏴᏫ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏥᎨᏒᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᏥᎨᏳᎢ ᏥᏲᏎᎮᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏥᎨᏳᎢ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏥᎨᏒᎩ.
\ft As he saith also in Osee, I will call them my people, which were not my people; and her beloved, which was not beloved.

\ln Ale hia nvdagalistani, nahnani hia nigetsiweselvi, Nihi vtla ayv diquatseli yvwi yigi; Nahnani gvnidv Unelanvhi tsuwetsi gegosehesdi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏔᏂ, ᏀᎾᏂ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎨᏥᏪᏎᎸᎢ, ᏂᎯ ᎥᏝ ᎠᏴ ᏗᏆᏤᎵ ᏴᏫ ᏱᎩ; ᏀᎾᏂ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᏪᏥ ᎨᎪᏎᎮᏍᏗ.
\ft And it shall come to pass, that in the place where it was said unto them, Ye are not my people; there shall they be called the children of the living God.

\ln Isaya nasquo hia nigaweha Isili dekaneisdisgvi; Isili tsuwetsi nasquo noyu amequohi galageyv nasgiya yinunatsuquisdi, unalinohiyvhi ase getsisdelvdi gesesdi.
\syll ᎢᏌᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᎭ ᎢᏏᎵ ᏕᎧᏁᎢᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ; ᎢᏏᎵ ᏧᏪᏥ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏃᏳ ᎠᎺᏉᎯ ᎦᎳᎨᏴ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏱᏄᎾᏧᏈᏍᏗ, ᎤᎾᎵᏃᎯᏴᎯ ᎠᏎ ᎨᏥᏍᏕᎸᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft Esaias also crieth concerning Israel, Though the number of the children of Israel be as the sand of the sea, a remnant shall be saved:

\ln Dvsquadiyeno digalvwisdanedi gesvi, ale duyugodv gvdi ulisdiyu nasgi nvdvdvneli; ulisdiyeno nvdvdvneli nusdv duwugotanv elohi.
\syll ᏛᏍᏆᏗᏰᏃ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎬᏗ ᎤᎵᏍᏗᏳ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏛᏛᏁᎵ; ᎤᎵᏍᏗᏰᏃ ᏅᏛᏛᏁᎵ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏚᏭᎪᏔᏅ ᎡᎶᎯ.
\ft For he will finish the work, and cut it short in righteousness: because a short work will the Lord make upon the earth.

\ln Ale nasgiya Isaya gayula hia tsinuwesoi, iyuno Yihowa unitsati tsudatinai niginohiyelvna yigese ulinohiyvhi, Sodamiquo yididatselei, ale Gomali nusdv nasgiya yinigasdei.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎢᏌᏯ ᎦᏳᎳ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏄᏪᏐᎢ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᏱᎰᏩ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏧᏓᏘᎾᎢ ᏂᎩᏃᎯᏰᎸᎾ ᏱᎨᏎ ᎤᎵᏃᎯᏴᎯ, ᏐᏓᎻᏉ ᏱᏗᏓᏤᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎪᎹᎵ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏱᏂᎦᏍᏕᎢ.
\ft And as Esaias said before, Except the Lord of Sabaoth had left us a seed, we had been as Sodoma, and been made like unto Gomorrha.

\ln Nasgino tsinusdi gado dadadvni?  Nasgi na tsunadalenvdv yvwi, nasgi adudalesdi gesv nunisdawadvsvna gesv, nasgi adudalesdi gesv uniwadvhv, nasgi gohiyudi gesv adudalesdodi tsigi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏥᏄᏍᏗ ᎦᏙ ᏓᏓᏛᏂ?  ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏚᏓᎴᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏄᏂᏍᏓᏩᏛᏒᎾ ᎨᏒ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏚᏓᎴᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏂᏩᏛᎲ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏚᏓᎴᏍᏙᏗ ᏥᎩ.
\ft What shall we say then? That the Gentiles, which followed not after righteousness, have attained to righteousness, even the righteousness which is of faith.

\ln Isilisgini unisdawadvdv dikahnawadvsdi adudalesdodi gesvi, nasgi vtla yuniwadvhv dikahnawadvsdi adudalesdodi gesvi.
\syll ᎢᏏᎵᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏂᏍᏓᏩᏛᏛ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎠᏚᏓᎴᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎥᏝ ᏳᏂᏩᏛᎲ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎠᏚᏓᎴᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft But Israel, which followed after the law of righteousness, hath not attained to the law of righteousness.

\ln Gadono?  Nvdigalisdodiha nasgi gohiyudi gesv nunvtanvna gesvi, dikahnawadvsdisgini nigawesgv iyadvnedi gesv unvtanvi; dunodestaneyeno nasgi na nvya didadodehihi gesvi;
\syll ᎦᏙᏃ?  ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏄᏅᏔᏅᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎬ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏅᏔᏅᎢ; ᏚᏃᏕᏍᏔᏁᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏅᏯ ᏗᏓᏙᏕᎯᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ;
\ft Wherefore? Because they sought it not by faith, but as it were by the works of the law. For they stumbled at that stumblingstone;

\ln Nasgiya hia tsinigvnv tsigawela, Gvniyuquo Sayani datsini nvya didadodehihi, ale nvya adahnasqualosdisgi; ale gilo gohiyuhvsgesdi nasgi vtla udehohisdi yigesesdi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᎬᏅ ᏥᎦᏪᎳ, ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᏌᏯᏂ ᏓᏥᏂ ᏅᏯ ᏗᏓᏙᏕᎯᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏅᏯ ᎠᏓᎿᏍᏆᎶᏍᏗᏍᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᎪᎯᏳᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏕᎰᎯᏍᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft As it is written, Behold, I lay in Sion a stumblingstone and rock of offence: and whosoever believeth on him shall not be ashamed.

\ln Idalinvtli, aginawiyi iyvdv aquaduliha, ale tsiyadadolisdaneha Unelanvhi Isili ugvwali, nasgi getsisdelvdiyi.
\syll ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᎠᎩᎾᏫᏱ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎠᏆᏚᎵᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᏯᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎭ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᏏᎵ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᏥᏍᏕᎸᏗᏱ.
\ft Brethren, my heart's desire and prayer to God for Israel is, that they might be saved.

\ln Gatsiyoiyudanehiyeno nasgi utsati unadulisgv Unelanvhi gohusdi unadvnediyi; aseno vtla agadohehisdi gesv yanvdiha.
\syll ᎦᏥᏲᎢᏳᏓᏁᎯᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᎾᏚᎵᏍᎬ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᎾᏛᏁᏗᏱ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎠᎦᏙᎮᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏯᏅᏗᎭ.
\ft For I bear them record that they have a zeal of God, but not according to knowledge.

\ln Nanigatahvnayeno gesv nusdv Unelanvhi udadudalesdodi gesvi, ale anatlinigvnehv unisdayidisdiyi unvsv unatseli unadudalesdodi gesvi, vtla tsunadayohiselvhi yigi Unelanvhi udadudalesdodi gesvi.
\syll ᎾᏂᎦᏔᎲᎾᏰᏃ ᎨᏒ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏓᏚᏓᎴᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎾᏟᏂᎬᏁᎲ ᎤᏂᏍᏓᏱᏗᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏅᏒ ᎤᎾᏤᎵ ᎤᎾᏚᏓᎴᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᏧᎾᏓᏲᎯᏎᎸᎯ ᏱᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏓᏚᏓᎴᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft For they being ignorant of God's righteousness, and going about to establish their own righteousness, have not submitted themselves unto the righteousness of God.

\ln Dikahnawadvsdiyeno ugvwale Galonedv unadudalesdodiyi naniv anohiyuhvsgi.
\syll ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗᏰᏃ ᎤᎬᏩᎴ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᎾᏚᏓᎴᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ.
\ft For Christ is the end of the law for righteousness to every one that believeth.

\ln Mosiyeno kanoheha nusdv udadudalesdodi gesv dikahnawadvsdi, hia tsinigaweha, Gilo yvwi nasgi nadvnehesdi gvnidv awadvdisgesdi.
\syll ᎼᏏᏰᏃ ᎧᏃᎮᎭ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎤᏓᏚᏓᎴᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ, ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᎦᏪᎭ, ᎩᎶ ᏴᏫ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎠᏩᏛᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
\ft For Moses describeth the righteousness which is of the law, That the man which doeth those things shall live by them.

\ln Gohiyudisgini adudalesdodi gesv hia nigaweha, Tlesdi tsanawiyi hia yiniwesgesdi, Gago galvloi dayesi?  (nasgi Galonedv agatlovdodiyi;)
\syll ᎪᎯᏳᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏚᏓᎴᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᎭ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᏣᎾᏫᏱ ᎯᎠ ᏱᏂᏪᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎦᎪ ᎦᎸᎶᎢ ᏓᏰᏏ?  ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎠᎦᏠᎥᏙᏗᏱ;
\ft But the righteousness which is of faith speaketh on this wise, Say not in thine heart, Who shall ascend into heaven? (that is, to bring Christ down from above:)

\ln Ale gago asdvgi gesv wvdagalosi?  (nasgi Galonedv uyohusv tsuledodiyi;)
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎦᎪ ᎠᏍᏛᎩ ᎨᏒ ᏮᏓᎦᎶᏏ?  ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏲᎱᏒ ᏧᎴᏙᏗᏱ;
\ft Or, Who shall descend into the deep? (that is, to bring up Christ again from the dead.)

\ln Aseno gado adiha?  Kanohedv hehv navniyu nusdidega, nasgi hiholiquo, ale tsanawiyiquo eha; nasgi hia kanohedv gohiyudi gesv kanohesgi, nasgi ayv tsotsalitsidohvsga;
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎦᏙ ᎠᏗᎭ?  ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎮᎲ ᎾᎥᏂᏳ ᏄᏍᏗᏕᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎰᎵᏉ, ᎠᎴ ᏣᎾᏫᏱᏉ ᎡᎭ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎧᏃᎮᏍᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᏦᏣᎵᏥᏙᎲᏍᎦ;
\ft But what saith it? The word is nigh thee, even in thy mouth, and in thy heart: that is, the word of faith, which we preach;

\ln Nasgi iyuno hiholi yitsvtanv gvnigesv yiniyvnelv Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa, ale tsanawiyi iyvdv yitsohiyunv Unelanvhi deuletanv uyohusvi, ase etsasdelvdi gesesdi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏃ ᎯᎰᎵ ᏱᏨᏔᏅ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏱᏂᏴᏁᎸ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ, ᎠᎴ ᏣᎾᏫᏱ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏱᏦᎯᏳᏅ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏕᎤᎴᏔᏅ ᎤᏲᎱᏒᎢ, ᎠᏎ ᎡᏣᏍᏕᎸᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft That if thou shalt confess with thy mouth the Lord Jesus, and shalt believe in thine heart that God hath raised him from the dead, thou shalt be saved.

\ln Onawiyeno gvdi agohiyuhvsgo odudalesdi nigalistaniga; ale vholi gvdi gvnigesv nagvneho vdadisdelvdi nigalistaniga.
\syll ᎣᎾᏫᏰᏃ ᎬᏗ ᎠᎪᎯᏳᎲᏍᎪ ᎣᏚᏓᎴᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏔᏂᎦ; ᎠᎴ ᎥᎰᎵ ᎬᏗ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎾᎬᏁᎰ ᎥᏓᏗᏍᏕᎸᏗ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏔᏂᎦ.
\ft For with the heart man believeth unto righteousness; and with the mouth confession is made unto salvation.

\ln Goweliyeno hia nigaweha, Gilo nasgi gohiyuhvsgesdi vtla udehohisdi yigesesdi.
\syll ᎪᏪᎵᏰᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᎭ, ᎩᎶ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᎯᏳᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏕᎰᎯᏍᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft For the scripture saith, Whosoever believeth on him shall not be ashamed.

\ln Vtlayeno yidunadalenaa Anitsusi ano Anigoi; nasgiquoyeno Ugvwiyuhi naniv unatseliga utsati uwehnaiyu tsusdelvdiyi naniv gvwadadolisdanehi.
\syll ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᏱᏚᎾᏓᎴᎾᎠ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎠᏃ ᎠᏂᎪᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩᏉᏰᏃ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᏪᎿᎢᏳ ᏧᏍᏕᎸᏗᏱ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎬᏩᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎯ.
\ft For there is no difference between the Jew and the Greek: for the same Lord over all is rich unto all that call upon him.

\ln Nanivquoyeno gilo anadadolisdisgesdi dudov Ugvwiyuhi anineisdisgesdi getsisdelvdi gesesdi.
\syll ᎾᏂᎥᏉᏰᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎠᎾᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏚᏙᎥ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᏂᏁᎢᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎨᏥᏍᏕᎸᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft For whosoever shall call upon the name of the Lord shall be saved.

\ln Gadono yigalisdoda yanadadolisdasi gilo nunohiyusvna yigi ehvi?  ale gado yigalisdoda yanohiyuhvga gilo ehv nasgi unadvganvhi nigesvna yigi ehvi?  ale gado yigalisdoda yanadvgvga gilo alitsidohvsgi nunehvna yigi?
\syll ᎦᏙᏃ ᏱᎦᎵᏍᏙᏓ ᏯᎾᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏏ ᎩᎶ ᏄᏃᎯᏳᏒᎾ ᏱᎩ ᎡᎲᎢ?  ᎠᎴ ᎦᏙ ᏱᎦᎵᏍᏙᏓ ᏯᏃᎯᏳᎲᎦ ᎩᎶ ᎡᎲ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏱᎩ ᎡᎲᎢ?  ᎠᎴ ᎦᏙ ᏱᎦᎵᏍᏙᏓ ᏯᎾᏛᎬᎦ ᎩᎶ ᎠᎵᏥᏙᎲᏍᎩ ᏄᏁᎲᎾ ᏱᎩ?
\ft How then shall they call on him in whom they have not believed? and how shall they believe in him of whom they have not heard? and how shall they hear without a preacher?

\ln Ale gado yigalisdoda yanalitsidohvga iyuno nigetsinvsvna yigi?  nasgiya hia tsinigvnv tsigowela, niduwoduha tsunalasideni nasgi na osdv kanohedv nvwadohiyadv adanehi analitsidohvsgi, Osdv kanohedv analitsidohvsgi nasgi osdv ugvwali gesvi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎦᏙ ᏱᎦᎵᏍᏙᏓ ᏯᎾᎵᏥᏙᎲᎦ ᎢᏳᏃ ᏂᎨᏥᏅᏒᎾ ᏱᎩ?  ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᎬᏅ ᏥᎪᏪᎳ, ᏂᏚᏬᏚᎭ ᏧᎾᎳᏏᏕᏂ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᎠᏓᏁᎯ ᎠᎾᎵᏥᏙᎲᏍᎩ, ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎠᎾᎵᏥᏙᎲᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft And how shall they preach, except they be sent? as it is written, How beautiful are the feet of them that preach the gospel of peace, and bring glad tidings of good things!

\ln Aseno vtla naniv unohiyunvhi yigi osdv kanohedv.  Isayayeno hia nigaweha, Yihowa, gago uwohiyunv otsinohesgvi?
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎤᏃᎯᏳᏅᎯ ᏱᎩ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ.  ᎢᏌᏯᏰᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᎭ, ᏱᎰᏩ, ᎦᎪ ᎤᏬᎯᏳᏅ ᎣᏥᏃᎮᏍᎬᎢ?
\ft But they have not all obeyed the gospel. For Esaias saith, Lord, who hath believed our report?

\ln Nasgino hia tsinusdi gohiyudi gesv advgodiyi didalehvsga, advgodiyino Unelanvhi utseli kanohedv didalehvsga.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏄᏍᏗ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏛᎪᏗᏱ ᏗᏓᎴᎲᏍᎦ, ᎠᏛᎪᏗᏱᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏗᏓᎴᎲᏍᎦ.
\ft So then faith cometh by hearing, and hearing by the word of God.

\ln Aseno ayv hia nitsiweha, Tlasgo yunadvganv?  Vv, Udohiyuhi, unadanoyvlisdv duyelisv elanigvi, ale aniwonisgv elohi wasdv iyvdv duyelisv.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᏴ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏥᏪᎭ, ᏝᏍᎪ ᏳᎾᏛᎦᏅ?  ᎥᎥ, ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ, ᎤᎾᏓᏃᏴᎵᏍᏛ ᏚᏰᎵᏒ ᎡᎳᏂᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏬᏂᏍᎬ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏩᏍᏛ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏚᏰᎵᏒ.
\ft But I say, Have they not heard? Yes verily, their sound went into all the earth, and their words unto the ends of the world.

\ln Aseno ayv nitsiweha, Tlasgo yanigatahe Isili?  igvyi gesv Mosi hia nigaweha, itsadvyugediyi nvdatsvyvneli dagatsiyvtani nasgi na ayeli unotlvhi nigesvna gesvi, ale nunadanvdvna yvwi gatsiyvdisgv datsvnalvstani.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᏴ ᏂᏥᏪᎭ, ᏝᏍᎪ ᏯᏂᎦᏔᎮ ᎢᏏᎵ?  ᎢᎬᏱ ᎨᏒ ᎼᏏ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᎭ, ᎢᏣᏛᏳᎨᏗᏱ ᏅᏓᏨᏴᏁᎵ ᏓᎦᏥᏴᏔᏂ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎤᏃᏢᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏄᎾᏓᏅᏛᎾ ᏴᏫ ᎦᏥᏴᏗᏍᎬ ᏓᏨᎾᎸᏍᏔᏂ.
\ft But I say, Did not Israel know? First Moses saith, I will provoke you to jealousy by them that are no people, and by a foolish nation I will anger you.

\ln Aseno Isaya niganayesgvna hia nigaweha, Gvgiwadvhvgi nasgi na nigvgiyolvna gesvi; gvnigesv nigvquvnelvgi anehv nasgi na nanadvdvhvsgvna gesv gevi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎢᏌᏯ ᏂᎦᎾᏰᏍᎬᎾ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᎭ, ᎬᎩᏩᏛᎲᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏂᎬᎩᏲᎸᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᎬᏋᏁᎸᎩ ᎠᏁᎲ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎾᎾᏛᏛᎲᏍᎬᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎨᎥᎢ.
\ft But Esaias is very bold, and saith, I was found of them that sought me not; I was made manifest unto them that asked not after me.

\ln Isilisgini hia nidegaweseha, Udodaquadv daquaselidvgi gatsiyanisgv nunohiyusvna ale unigonelohisati yvwi.
\syll ᎢᏏᎵᏍᎩᏂ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏕᎦᏪᏎᎭ, ᎤᏙᏓᏆᏛ ᏓᏆᏎᎵᏛᎩ ᎦᏥᏯᏂᏍᎬ ᏄᏃᎯᏳᏒᎾ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᎪᏁᎶᎯᏌᏘ ᏴᏫ.
\ft But to Israel he saith, All day long I have stretched forth my hands unto a disobedient and gainsaying people.

\ln Nasgino hia nitsiweha, Tsigo Unelanvhi iyvdv niduwanelv tsutseli yvwi?  Gvwatlisdi.  Ayvyeno nasquo tsiisili, Equahami unetlvtanvdv nvdvquadalenvhi, Queni anilasdalv gela.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏥᏪᎭ, ᏥᎪ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏂᏚᏩᏁᎸ ᏧᏤᎵ ᏴᏫ?  ᎬᏩᏟᏍᏗ.  ᎠᏴᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏥᎢᏏᎵ, ᎡᏆᎭᎻ ᎤᏁᏢᏔᏅᏛ ᏅᏛᏆᏓᎴᏅᎯ, ᏇᏂ ᎠᏂᎳᏍᏓᎸ ᎨᎳ.
\ft I say then, Hath God cast away his people? God forbid. For I also am an Israelite, of the seed of Abraham, of the tribe of Benjamin.

\ln Unelanvhi vtla iyvdv yiniduwanelv tsutseli yvwi nasgi gayula tsinidagatahoi.  Tlasgo yitsigataha nigawesgv goweli nahna Ilaya atsinohesgvi?  nasgi atayohihv deatludisgv Isili hia nigawesgvi,
\syll ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎥᏝ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏱᏂᏚᏩᏁᎸ ᏧᏤᎵ ᏴᏫ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏳᎳ ᏥᏂᏓᎦᏔᎰᎢ.  ᏝᏍᎪ ᏱᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎬ ᎪᏪᎵ ᏀᎾ ᎢᎳᏯ ᎠᏥᏃᎮᏍᎬᎢ?  ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏔᏲᎯᎲ ᏕᎠᏡᏗᏍᎬ ᎢᏏᎵ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎬᎢ,
\ft God hath not cast away his people which he foreknew. Wot ye not what the scripture saith of Elias? how he maketh intercession to God against Israel, saying,

\ln Yihowa, denvnilv ditsatseli anadolehosgi, ale atsilv digelasdiyi ditsatseli duniyostanv; ale aquvsvhiyu aqualinohiyv, ale ayv gvgihisdiyi uniyoha.
\syll ᏱᎰᏩ, ᏕᏅᏂᎸ ᏗᏣᏤᎵ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏥᎸ ᏗᎨᎳᏍᏗᏱ ᏗᏣᏤᎵ ᏚᏂᏲᏍᏔᏅ; ᎠᎴ ᎠᏋᏒᎯᏳ ᎠᏆᎵᏃᎯᏴ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴ ᎬᎩᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏂᏲᎭ.
\ft Lord, they have killed thy prophets, and digged down thine altars; and I am left alone, and they seek my life.

\ln Aseno gado adiha Unelanvhi uwohiliyvsdanehvi?  gvqualinohiyediyi naquvnelv galiquogi iyagayvli iyanidv anisgaya nasgi nidunaliniquanvnelvna Queali.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎦᏙ ᎠᏗᎭ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏬᎯᎵᏴᏍᏓᏁᎲᎢ?  ᎬᏆᎵᏃᎯᏰᏗᏱ ᎾᏋᏁᎸ ᎦᎵᏉᎩ ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᏚᎾᎵᏂᏆᏅᏁᎸᎾ ᏇᎠᎵ.
\ft But what saith the answer of God unto him? I have reserved to myself seven thousand men, who have not bowed the knee to the image of Baal.

\ln Nasgiyano nasquo gohi gesvi unalinohiyvhi aneha nasgiya gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv uwatanv dusuyesvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏯᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ ᎤᎾᎵᏃᎯᏴᎯ ᎠᏁᎭ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏩᏔᏅ ᏚᏑᏰᏒᎢ.
\ft Even so then at this present time also there is a remnant according to the election of grace.

\ln Iyuno gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv iyuwanisanvhi yigi; hnaquo vtla digalvwisdanedi gesv iyuwanisanvhi yigi; iyuno nasgi yinusdi, gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv vtla hnaquo gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv yigagi.  Iyusgini digalvwisdanedi gesv iyuwanisanvhi yigi, hnaquo vtla gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv iyuwanisanvhi yigi; iyuno nasgi yinusdi, digalvwisdanedi gesv vtla hnaquo digalvwisdanedi gesv yigagi.
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏅᎯ ᏱᎩ; ᎿᏉ ᎥᏝ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏅᎯ ᏱᎩ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᏄᏍᏗ, ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎥᏝ ᎿᏉ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏱᎦᎩ.  ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏅᎯ ᏱᎩ, ᎿᏉ ᎥᏝ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏅᎯ ᏱᎩ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᏄᏍᏗ, ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎥᏝ ᎿᏉ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏱᎦᎩ.
\ft And if by grace, then is it no more of works: otherwise grace is no more grace. But if it be of works, then is it no more grace: otherwise work is no more work.

\ln Gadono [wigvdvdi nigalisdiha?] Isili vtla yuwadvhv nasgi tsuyohvgi; gegasuyedvsgini gesv uniwadvhv, anisoino dunigusiyotsvgi.
\syll ᎦᏙᏃ ᏫᎬᏛᏗ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᎭ?data is invalid ᎢᏏᎵ ᎥᏝ ᏳᏩᏛᎲ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏲᎲᎩ; ᎨᎦᏑᏰᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏂᏩᏛᎲ, ᎠᏂᏐᎢᏃ ᏚᏂᎫᏏᏲᏨᎩ.
\ft What then? Israel hath not obtained that which he seeketh for; but the election hath obtained it, and the rest were blinded

\ln Nasgiya hia tsinigvnv tsigowela, Unelanvhi dunelv adalitadisgi adanvdo, ale dinigadoli digvwanigowadvdodi nigesvna, ale dinileni digvwanadvgododi nigesvna, gohi gesv iyasdi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᎬᏅ ᏥᎪᏪᎳ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏚᏁᎸ ᎠᏓᎵᏔᏗᏍᎩ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏂᎦᏙᎵ ᏗᎬᏩᏂᎪᏩᏛᏙᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏂᎴᏂ ᏗᎬᏩᎾᏛᎪᏙᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏯᏍᏗ.
\ft (According as it is written, God hath given them the spirit of slumber, eyes that they should not see, and ears that they should not hear;) unto this day.

\ln Ale Dewi hia nigaweha, Alisdayvdiyi unisgilv unesgi, ale unisadvvsgi, ale tsunodehihi, ale unisdvdisdodi winunalisdasi;
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏕᏫ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᎭ, ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ ᎤᏂᏍᎩᎸ ᎤᏁᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏌᏛᎥᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏃᏕᎯᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏍᏛᏗᏍᏙᏗ ᏫᏄᎾᎵᏍᏓᏏ;
\ft And David saith, Let their table be made a snare, and a trap, and a stumbling block, and a recompence unto them:

\ln Dinigadoli widigegalisihvsdasi, nasgi unigowadvdiyi nigesvna, ale nigohilv dunadisadadegesdi.
\syll ᏗᏂᎦᏙᎵ ᏫᏗᎨᎦᎵᏏᎲᏍᏓᏏ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᎪᏩᏛᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᏚᎾᏗᏌᏓᏕᎨᏍᏗ.
\ft Let their eyes be darkened, that they may not see, and bow down their back always.

\ln Hia adina nitsiweha, Tsigo dunodelv yeli tsuninvisdiyi ayelvsei?  Gvwatlisdi; nasgisgini duninvtsv nuwanisanv alisdelvdodi gesv unilutselv tsunadalenvdv yvwi, nasgi unadvyugediyi iyunvnisodiyi.
\syll ᎯᎠ ᎠᏗᎾ ᏂᏥᏪᎭ, ᏥᎪ ᏚᏃᏕᎸ ᏰᎵ ᏧᏂᏅᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᏰᎸᏎᎢ?  ᎬᏩᏟᏍᏗ; ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ ᏚᏂᏅᏨ ᏄᏩᏂᏌᏅ ᎠᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏂᎷᏤᎸ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᏛᏳᎨᏗᏱ ᎢᏳᏅᏂᏐᏗᏱ.
\ft I say then, Have they stumbled that they should fall? God forbid: but rather through their fall salvation is come unto the Gentiles, for to provoke them to jealousy.

\ln Iyuno nasgi duninvtsv unenvisdisgi yigi elohi, ale nasgi esga nunalisdanehv unenvisdisgi yigi tsunadalenvdv yvwi, nigav ulosvsdesdi anikalitsvha.
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᏂᏅᏨ ᎤᏁᏅᎢᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᏱᎩ ᎡᎶᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᏍᎦ ᏄᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᎤᏁᏅᎢᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᏱᎩ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ, ᏂᎦᎥ ᎤᎶᏒᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᎠᏂᎧᎵᏨᎭ.
\ft Now if the fall of them be the riches of the world, and the diminishing of them the riches of the Gentiles; how much more their fullness?

\ln Nihiyeno itsvwonediha ditsadalenvdv yvwi, nvdigalisdodiha ayv vginvsidv gesv tsunadalenvdv yvwi gatsiyalitsidonediyi, tsilvquodiha nusdv vquasvgalodvi;
\syll ᏂᎯᏰᏃ ᎢᏨᏬᏁᏗᎭ ᏗᏣᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎠᏴ ᎥᎩᏅᏏᏛ ᎨᏒ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᎦᏥᏯᎵᏥᏙᏁᏗᏱ, ᏥᎸᏉᏗᎭ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎥᏆᏒᎦᎶᏛᎢ;
\ft For I speak to you Gentiles, inasmuch as I am the apostle of the Gentiles, I magnify mine office:

\ln Nasgi iyuno yeli igvquadvnedi yigi, nasgi iyaquvnisodiyi unatlinigvnediyi ogitloyi gesvi, ale nasgi igadv gatsisdelvdiyi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏃ ᏰᎵ ᎢᎬᏆᏛᏁᏗ ᏱᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏯᏋᏂᏐᏗᏱ ᎤᎾᏟᏂᎬᏁᏗᏱ ᎣᎩᏠᏱ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎦᏛ ᎦᏥᏍᏕᎸᏗᏱ.
\ft If by any means I may provoke to emulation them which are my flesh, and might save some of them.

\ln Iyuyeno nasgi getsisonvistanvi unohisdanehi yinigalisdi elohi, gado ulisdodi gesesdi degegadanilvtsvha, duniyohusvsgini dunalehisanv gesesdi.
\syll ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᏥᏐᏅᎢᏍᏔᏅᎢ ᎤᏃᎯᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᏱᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗ ᎡᎶᎯ, ᎦᏙ ᎤᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏕᎨᎦᏓᏂᎸᏨᎭ, ᏚᏂᏲᎱᏒᏍᎩᏂ ᏚᎾᎴᎯᏌᏅ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft For if the casting away of them be the reconciling of the world, what shall the receiving of them be, but life from the dead?

\ln Iyuyeno igvyiyi ugvdvnatsvhi galvquodiyu yigi, nigadv nasquo [galvquodiyu;] iyu ale duhnasdetlv galvquodiyu yigi, nasgiya nasquo duwanigalvi.
\syll ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᎢᎬᏱᏱ ᎤᎬᏛᎾᏨᎯ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᏱᎩ, ᏂᎦᏛ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ;data is invalid ᎢᏳ ᎠᎴ ᏚᎿᏍᏕᏢ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᏱᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏚᏩᏂᎦᎸᎢ.
\ft For if the firstfruit be holy, the lump is also holy: and if the root be holy, so are the branches.

\ln Iyuno duwanigalv igadv yidigvnigalesv, nihino inagehehi oliwa tlugv nahna yiwiyetsayitlvtanv, ale nasgiya unalisdelodv yitseladisdi yitsalisdelvdi duhnasdetlv ale galitsonv oliwa tlugvi;
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᏚᏩᏂᎦᎸ ᎢᎦᏛ ᏱᏗᎬᏂᎦᎴᏒ, ᏂᎯᏃ ᎢᎾᎨᎮᎯ ᎣᎵᏩ ᏡᎬ ᏀᎾ ᏱᏫᏰᏣᏱᏢᏔᏅ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏕᎶᏛ ᏱᏤᎳᏗᏍᏗ ᏱᏣᎵᏍᏕᎸᏗ ᏚᎿᏍᏕᏢ ᎠᎴ ᎦᎵᏦᏅ ᎣᎵᏩ ᏡᎬᎢ;
\ft And if some of the branches be broken off, and thou, being a wild olive tree, wert graffed in among them, and with them partakest of the root and fatness of the olive tree;

\ln Tlesdi yitatlvquisehesdi duwanigalvi.  Iyusgini yatlvquisga, vtla nihi duhnasdetlv yitinanugowisga, duhnasdetlvsgini nihi getsananugowisga.
\syll ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏔᏢᏈᏎᎮᏍᏗ ᏚᏩᏂᎦᎸᎢ.  ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᏯᏢᏈᏍᎦ, ᎥᏝ ᏂᎯ ᏚᎿᏍᏕᏢ ᏱᏘᎾᏄᎪᏫᏍᎦ, ᏚᎿᏍᏕᏢᏍᎩᏂ ᏂᎯ ᎨᏣᎾᏄᎪᏫᏍᎦ.
\ft Boast not against the branches. But if thou boast, thou bearest not the root, but the root thee.

\ln Hia adina geli nvdvhiwesi, duwanigalv dunvnigalvhvgi, Nasgi ayv vquvyitlvdiyi nahnani.
\syll ᎯᎠ ᎠᏗᎾ ᎨᎵ ᏅᏛᎯᏪᏏ, ᏚᏩᏂᎦᎸ ᏚᏅᏂᎦᎸᎲᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᎥᏋᏱᏢᏗᏱ ᏀᎾᏂ.
\ft Thou wilt say then, The branches were broken off, that I might be graffed in.

\ln Udohiyuhi; Nunohiyusvna gesv nvdayulisdotanvgi degetsinigalvhvgi; ale nihi tsidoga tsohiyusv nigvnisiha.  Tlesdiquo utli yitsatselvsesdi, hinayesgesdisgini;
\syll ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ; ᏄᏃᎯᏳᏒᎾ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏓᏳᎵᏍᏙᏔᏅᎩ ᏕᎨᏥᏂᎦᎸᎲᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᏂᎯ ᏥᏙᎦ ᏦᎯᏳᏒ ᏂᎬᏂᏏᎭ.  ᏞᏍᏗᏉ ᎤᏟ ᏱᏣᏤᎸᏎᏍᏗ, ᎯᎾᏰᏍᎨᏍᏗᏍᎩᏂ;
\ft Well; because of unbelief they were broken off, and thou standest by faith. Be not highminded, but fear:

\ln Iyuyeno Unelanvhi nidugeyunvna yigi nvnehiya duwanigalvi, nihi nasquo nitsageyunvnaquo yigi.
\syll ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏂᏚᎨᏳᏅᎾ ᏱᎩ ᏅᏁᎯᏯ ᏚᏩᏂᎦᎸᎢ, ᏂᎯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏂᏣᎨᏳᏅᎾᏉ ᏱᎩ.
\ft For if God spared not the natural branches, take heed lest he also spare not thee.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi hagasayasda udanvteyu gesv ale asdayiyu gesv Unelanvhi; asdayiyu nidegvnehv nasgi na tsuninvtsvhi; nihisgini udanvtiyu gesv tsananugowisehvi; iyuno yinvwasdidi detsaniyvsv udanvtiyu gesvi; Vtlayeno nasgi nihi nasquo etsvnagalesdi gesesdi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎭᎦᏌᏯᏍᏓ ᎤᏓᏅᏖᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏍᏓᏱᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ; ᎠᏍᏓᏱᏳ ᏂᏕᎬᏁᎲ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏧᏂᏅᏨᎯ; ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏓᏅᏘᏳ ᎨᏒ ᏣᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᎲᎢ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᏱᏅᏩᏍᏗᏗ ᏕᏣᏂᏴᏒ ᎤᏓᏅᏘᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎡᏨᎾᎦᎴᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft Behold therefore the goodness and severity of God: on them which fell, severity; but toward thee, goodness, if thou continue in his goodness: otherwise thou also shalt be cut off.

\ln Ale nasgi na nasquo, iyuno igvwasdihaquo nigesvna igesesdi nunohiyusvna gesvi, getsiyitlvdi gesesdi; Unelanvhiyeno yeliquo taline digvwayitlvdi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎾᏍᏉ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎢᎬᏩᏍᏗᎭᏉ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏄᏃᎯᏳᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎨᏥᏱᏢᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ ᏰᎵᏉ ᏔᎵᏁ ᏗᎬᏩᏱᏢᏗ.
\ft And they also, if they abide not still in unbelief, shall be graffed in: for God is able to graff them in again.

\ln Iyuyeno nihi inage ehiya oliwa tlugv tsvyitlvnvhi yigi, ale nahna hehiya nigesvna gesv osdv oliwa tlugv yetsvyitlvnv, utlihiyusgini ahitiyu nasgi na nahna anehiya tsigi, getsiyitlvdi nahna unvsv unatseligaya oliwa tlugvi.
\syll ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᏂᎯ ᎢᎾᎨ ᎡᎯᏯ ᎣᎵᏩ ᏡᎬ ᏨᏱᏢᏅᎯ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏀᎾ ᎮᎯᏯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎣᎵᏩ ᏡᎬ ᏰᏨᏱᏢᏅ, ᎤᏟᎯᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᎯᏘᏳ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏀᎾ ᎠᏁᎯᏯ ᏥᎩ, ᎨᏥᏱᏢᏗ ᏀᎾ ᎤᏅᏒ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦᏯ ᎣᎵᏩ ᏡᎬᎢ.
\ft For if thou wert cut out of the olive tree which is wild by nature, and wert graffed contrary to nature into a good olive tree: how much more shall these, which be the natural branches, be graffed into their own olive tree?

\ln Vtlayeno yaquaduli, idalinvtli, nitsigatahvnaquo iyulisdodiyi hia nasgi udelidv gesvi, (itsigatanaiquoyeno yinvtsalisda itsvsv itsadanvtesgvi,) nasgi agusiyoisdi gesv unilutselv igadv Isili, gvni unitsati gesv tsunadalenvdv yvwi uniyvlvhi gesesdi,
\syll ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᏯᏆᏚᎵ, ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᏂᏥᎦᏔᎲᎾᏉ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎾᎢᏉᏰᏃ ᏱᏅᏣᎵᏍᏓ ᎢᏨᏒ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎫᏏᏲᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏂᎷᏤᎸ ᎢᎦᏛ ᎢᏏᎵ, ᎬᏂ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎨᏒ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏂᏴᎸᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ,
\ft For I would not, brethren, that ye should be ignorant of this mystery, lest ye should be wise in your own conceits; that blindness in part is happened to Israel, until the fullness of the Gentiles be come in.

\ln Nasgino nvdagalistani nigadiyu Isili getsisdelvdi gesesdi; Nasgiya hia tsinigvnv tsigowela, Sayani nvdayudalenvhi dagalutsi digudalesgi, ale iyvdv nvdagvneli Unelanvhi nunilvquodvna gesv igaqui uwehvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏔᏂ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᎢᏏᎵ ᎨᏥᏍᏕᎸᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᎬᏅ ᏥᎪᏪᎳ, ᏌᏯᏂ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᏓᎦᎷᏥ ᏗᎫᏓᎴᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏅᏓᎬᏁᎵ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏄᏂᎸᏉᏛᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎢᎦᏈ ᎤᏪᎲᎢ.
\ft And so all Israel shall be saved: as it is written, There shall come out of Sion the Deliverer, and shall turn away ungodliness from Jacob:

\ln Hiayeno nasgi nusdi kanohedv degatsiyatloisdanelvi, nahiyu gatsivedi nigalistanvha unisganvtsvi.
\syll ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏗ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏕᎦᏥᏯᏠᎢᏍᏓᏁᎸᎢ, ᏀᎢᏳ ᎦᏥᎥᎡᏗ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏔᏅᎭ ᎤᏂᏍᎦᏅᏨᎢ.
\ft For this is my covenant unto them, when I shall take away their sins.

\ln Osdvno kanohedv ugvwali gesvi, getsisgagi nunalistanv nihi gesv nvdigalisdodiha; dasuyesgvsgini ugvwali, getsigeyuha anigayvlige gesv nvdigalisdodiha.
\syll ᎣᏍᏛᏃ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎨᏥᏍᎦᎩ ᏄᎾᎵᏍᏔᏅ ᏂᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ; ᏓᏑᏰᏍᎬᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ, ᎨᏥᎨᏳᎭ ᎠᏂᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ.
\ft As concerning the gospel, they are enemies for your sakes: but as touching the election, they are beloved for the fathers' sakes.

\ln Unelanvhiyeno udanedi gesv ale udayanvdi gesv tlaquo uyelvdi nigesvna gesoi.
\syll ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ ᎤᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᏯᏅᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏝᏉ ᎤᏰᎸᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏐᎢ.
\ft For the gifts and calling of God are without repentance.

\ln Nihiyeno tsuwagutanvsv netsoiyusvna tsigesvgi Unelanvhi, aseno gohi etsidolitsvhi igi nvdigalisdodiha nasgi nunohiyusvna gesvi;
\syll ᏂᎯᏰᏃ ᏧᏩᎫᏔᏅᏒ ᏁᏦᎢᏳᏒᎾ ᏥᎨᏒᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎪᎯ ᎡᏥᏙᎵᏨᎯ ᎢᎩ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏃᎯᏳᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ;
\ft For as ye in times past have not believed God, yet have now obtained mercy through their unbelief:

\ln Nasgiya nasquo nasgi hia gohi gesv vtla yunohiyunv, nasgi udadolisdi gesv itsatseli iyuwanisodiyi nasgi nasquo getsidolisdi iyulisdodiyi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎥᏝ ᏳᏃᎯᏳᏅ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏣᏤᎵ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏐᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎨᏥᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
\ft Even so have these also now not believed, that through your mercy they also may obtain mercy.

\ln Unelanvhiyeno duwugotanv nigadiyu nunohiyusvna gesvi, nasgi nigadiyu tsuwedolisdi iyulisdodiyi.
\syll ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ ᏚᏭᎪᏔᏅ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏄᏃᎯᏳᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏧᏪᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
\ft For God hath concluded them all in unbelief, that he might have mercy upon all.

\ln Nasewiniyv utsatanvhi agadosaniyu gesv ale agatanaiyu gesv Unelanvhi!  nigavquo gvgoliyedi nigesvna nusdv degugodisgvi, ale uwedasdiyi gesv gagoluwadvdi nigesvna!
\syll ᎾᏎᏫᏂᏴ ᎤᏣᏔᏅᎯ ᎠᎦᏙᏌᏂᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎦᏔᎾᎢᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ  ᏂᎦᎥᏉ ᎬᎪᎵᏰᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏕᎫᎪᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏪᏓᏍᏗᏱ ᎨᏒ ᎦᎪᎷᏩᏛᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ
\ft O the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and knowledge of God! how unsearchable are his judgments, and his ways past finding out!

\ln Gagoyeno ugadovso nusdv udanvdv Yihowa?  ale gago unatequalono unadanvteloi?
\syll ᎦᎪᏰᏃ ᎤᎦᏙᎥᏐ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎤᏓᏅᏛ ᏱᎰᏩ?  ᎠᎴ ᎦᎪ ᎤᎾᏖᏆᎶᏃ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏖᎶᎢ?
\ft For who hath known the mind of the Lord? or who hath been his counseller?

\ln Ale gago dudalenvtanv unelv, ale taline dvagaguyveli?
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎦᎪ ᏚᏓᎴᏅᏔᏅ ᎤᏁᎸ, ᎠᎴ ᏔᎵᏁ ᏛᎠᎦᎫᏴᎡᎵ?
\ft Or who hath first given to him, and it shall be recompensed unto him again?

\ln Nasgiyeno gesv nvdayudalenvhi nigadiyu tsudalenvdv, ale nasgi iyuwanisadv, ale nasgi ugvwala; [ale] nasgi galvquododi gesesdi nigohilvi.  Emenv.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎬᏩᎳ; ᎠᎴdata is invalid ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎸᏉᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏂᎪᎯᎸᎢ.  ᎡᎺᏅ.
\ft For of him, and through him, and to him, are all things: to whom be glory for ever. Amen.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi, idalinvtli, itsvsdiyediha Unelanvhi udadolitsatiyu gesv iyusdi, nasgi ditsiyelv ditsalisgolvdodiyi gvnodv atsilv gelasdi, gohusdi nusdvna, digvwadanilvisdi Unelanvhi, detsadanvdv gvdi gohusdi etsadvnehvi.
