\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᎢᏨᏍᏗᏰᏗᎭ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏣᏘᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏥᏰᎸ ᏗᏣᎵᏍᎪᎸᏙᏗᏱ ᎬᏃᏛ ᎠᏥᎸ ᎨᎳᏍᏗ, ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏄᏍᏛᎾ, ᏗᎬᏩᏓᏂᎸᎢᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᏕᏣᏓᏅᏛ ᎬᏗ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎡᏣᏛᏁᎲᎢ.
\ft I beseech you therefore, brethren, by the mercies of God, that ye present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable unto God, which is your reasonable service.

\ln Ale tlesdi elohi anehi nunasdv yinitsvsdesdi; ditsadanetliyvdvsgini gesesdi ditse idigvnelvhi gesv detsadanvdvi, nasgi getsigoliyedi iyulisdodiyi nusdv udulisgv Unelanvhi, nasgi osdv gesvi, ale digvwadanilvisdi gesvi, ale akalii gesvi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎠᏁᎯ ᏄᎾᏍᏛ ᏱᏂᏨᏍᏕᏍᏗ; ᏗᏣᏓᏁᏟᏴᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏗᏤ ᎢᏗᎬᏁᎸᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏕᏣᏓᏅᏛᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᏥᎪᎵᏰᏗ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎬ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎬᏩᏓᏂᎸᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎧᎵᎢ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft And be not conformed to this world: but be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind, that ye may prove what is that good, and acceptable, and perfect, will of God.

\ln Gvwagatiyayeno udadolisdi gesv gvdisgv, nasgi vginelvhi tsigi, hia nigatsiweseha nanivquo tsigetsadasuya; tlesdiquo yanilosvsdisgesdi anadanvtesgv nasgi tsiduyugodi unadanvtediyi, unalisinahisdisgini gesesdi anadanvtesgvi, nasgiya nusdv gohiyudi gesv Unelanvhi dutliloelv anisiyvwihai.
\syll ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯᏰᏃ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏗᏍᎬ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎥᎩᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏥᏪᏎᎭ ᎾᏂᎥᏉ ᏥᎨᏣᏓᏑᏯ; ᏞᏍᏗᏉ ᏯᏂᎶᏒᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᎾᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏚᏳᎪᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏖᏗᏱ, ᎤᎾᎵᏏᏀᎢᏍᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎠᎾᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏚᏟᎶᎡᎸ ᎠᏂᏏᏴᏫᎭᎢ.
\ft For I say, through the grace given unto me, to every man that is among you, not to think of himself more highly than he ought to think; but to think soberly, according as God hath dealt to every man the measure of faith.

\ln Utsatiyeno tsidegahitlewisv saquo ayelv gesvi, ale nagadv degahitlewisv utloyi nigesvna tsigi gohusdi gvtanidasdi gesvi;
\syll ᎤᏣᏘᏰᏃ ᏥᏕᎦᎯᏞᏫᏒ ᏌᏉ ᎠᏰᎸ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᎦᏛ ᏕᎦᎯᏞᏫᏒ ᎤᏠᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏥᎩ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎬᏔᏂᏓᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ;
\ft For as we have many members in one body, and all members have not the same office:

\ln Nasgiya nasquo ayv, igitsati tsigi, saquoquo ayelv nidalisdiha Galonedv dedanelodvi, ale nidiv idisiyvwiha igadudadewisv.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏴ, ᎢᎩᏣᏘ ᏥᎩ, ᏌᏉᏉ ᎠᏰᎸ ᏂᏓᎵᏍᏗᎭ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏕᏓᏁᎶᏛᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᏗᎥ ᎢᏗᏏᏴᏫᎭ ᎢᎦᏚᏓᏕᏫᏒ.
\ft So we, being many, are one body in Christ, and every one members one of another.

\ln Nasgino tsudalehnai eginelvnvhi tsigi nasgiya gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv iginelvi, iyuno adolehohisdi yigi, nasgiya gohiyudi gesv egatliloelv idvdisgesdi [idadolehosgesdi;]
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏧᏓᎴᎿᎢ ᎡᎩᏁᎸᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᎩᏁᎸᎢ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏗ ᏱᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎡᎦᏟᎶᎡᎸ ᎢᏛᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎢᏓᏙᎴᎰᏍᎨᏍᏗ;data is invalid
\ft Having then gifts differing according to the grace that is given to us, whether prophecy, let us prophesy according to the proportion of faith;

\ln Iyu ale idiyadohihesdi, idiyadohihvquo degilvwisdanehesdi; ale gilo dadeyohvsgesdi, dideyodiquo gesv dulvwisdanehesdi;
\syll ᎢᏳ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏗᏯᏙᎯᎮᏍᏗ, ᎢᏗᏯᏙᎯᎲᏉ ᏕᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ; ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᏓᏕᏲᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᏗᏕᏲᏗᏉ ᎨᏒ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ;
\ft Or ministry, let us wait on our ministering: or he that teacheth, on teaching;

\ln Ale gilo digawonedisgi gesesdi, digawonedodiquo gesv dulvwisdanehesdi; ale gilo dayadohehesdi, nugeyuhvsgvna nasgi nadvnehesdi; gilo tsaganelodi gesesdi, osdv ugasayasdi gesesdi; gilo adadoligesdi, ukalisdi udanvdv nasgi nadvnehesdi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᏗᎦᏬᏁᏗᏍᎩ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᏗᎦᏬᏁᏙᏗᏉ ᎨᏒ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ; ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᏓᏯᏙᎮᎮᏍᏗ, ᏄᎨᏳᎲᏍᎬᎾ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ; ᎩᎶ ᏣᎦᏁᎶᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎣᏍᏛ ᎤᎦᏌᏯᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᎩᎶ ᎠᏓᏙᎵᎨᏍᏗ, ᎤᎧᎵᏍᏗ ᎤᏓᏅᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ.
\ft Or he that exhorteth, on exhortation: he that giveth, let him do it with simplicity; he that ruleth, with diligence; he that sheweth mercy, with cheerfulness.

\ln Adageyudi gesv nutlonasdvna gesesdi.  Itsiniquatihesdi na uyo gesvi; detsiniyvsesdi osdv gesvi.
\syll ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏄᏠᎾᏍᏛᎾ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.  ᎢᏥᏂᏆᏘᎮᏍᏗ Ꮎ ᎤᏲ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᏕᏥᏂᏴᏎᏍᏗ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Let love be without dissimulation. Abhor that which is evil; cleave to that which is good.

\ln Analinvtli tsunadageyudi gesv gvdi osdv detsadageyusesdi; didalvquododi gesv itsvdisgv detsadagvwiyudisgesdi.
\syll ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏟ ᏧᎾᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏗ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏕᏣᏓᎨᏳᏎᏍᏗ; ᏗᏓᎸᏉᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏨᏗᏍᎬ ᏕᏣᏓᎬᏫᏳᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
\ft Be kindly affectioned one to another with brotherly love; in honour preferring one another;

\ln Detsilvwisdanehv tlesdi itsadanulvdi yigesesdi; ulinigidv detsadanvtesdi; gohusdi etsadvnehesdi Ugvwiyuhi.
\syll ᏕᏥᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎢᏣᏓᏄᎸᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᏕᏣᏓᏅᏖᏍᏗ; ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎡᏣᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ.
\ft Not slothful in business; fervent in spirit; serving the Lord;

\ln Udugi itsvsv itsaliheligesdi; ditsvnidiyu gesesdi itsigiliyogvi; itsadadolisdisgesdi nigohilvi;
\syll ᎤᏚᎩ ᎢᏨᏒ ᎢᏣᎵᎮᎵᎨᏍᏗ; ᏗᏨᏂᏗᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎢᏥᎩᎵᏲᎬᎢ; ᎢᏣᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏂᎪᎯᎸᎢ;
\ft Rejoicing in hope; patient in tribulation; continuing instant in prayer;

\ln Unadanvti uninigvsehv detsiyadohehesdi; itsigaliyiyu gesesdi ditsadasquanigododiyi.
\syll ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ ᎤᏂᏂᎬᏎᎲ ᏕᏥᏯᏙᎮᎮᏍᏗ; ᎢᏥᎦᎵᏱᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏗᏣᏓᏍᏆᏂᎪᏙᏗᏱ.
\ft Distributing to the necessity of saints; given to hospitality.

\ln Osdv detsinetsehesdi uyo igetsvhnadegi; osdvquo detsinetsehesdi, ale tlesdi yiditsisginvdisgesdi.
\syll ᎣᏍᏛ ᏕᏥᏁᏤᎮᏍᏗ ᎤᏲ ᎢᎨᏨᎿᏕᎩ; ᎣᏍᏛᏉ ᏕᏥᏁᏤᎮᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏗᏥᏍᎩᏅᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
\ft Bless them which persecute you: bless, and curse not.

\ln Nasgi na analiheligi itsulaha itsaliheligesdi, ale nasgi na dinatloyihi itsulaha detsatloyihesdi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᎾᎵᎮᎵᎩ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎢᏣᎵᎮᎵᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏗᎾᏠᏱᎯ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᏕᏣᏠᏱᎮᏍᏗ.
\ft Rejoice with them that do rejoice, and weep with them that weep.

\ln Utloyihaquo gesesdi detsadadanvtesgvi.  Tlesdi yitsagasayasdesdi gohusdi galvquodi gesvi, detseladidohesdisgini unadadolisdi.  Tlesdi itsigatanai yitsadayelvsesdi.
\syll ᎤᏠᏱᎭᏉ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏕᏣᏓᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬᎢ.  ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏣᎦᏌᏯᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎦᎸᏉᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏕᏤᎳᏗᏙᎮᏍᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᎾᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ.  ᏞᏍᏗ ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎾᎢ ᏱᏣᏓᏰᎸᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft Be of the same mind one toward another. Mind not high things, but condescend to men of low estate. Be not wise in your own conceits.

\ln Usonv nitsvnehesdi gilo tlesdi yitsatlegesdi usonv yinetsvnehesdi.  Igvyi nitsadanvtesgesdi osdv itsadvnelidasdi gesv nigadv anigatahvi.
\syll ᎤᏐᏅ ᏂᏨᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᎩᎶ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏣᏞᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᏐᏅ ᏱᏁᏨᏁᎮᏍᏗ.  ᎢᎬᏱ ᏂᏣᏓᏅᏖᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎢᏣᏛᏁᎵᏓᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎲᎢ.
\ft Recompense to no man evil for evil. Provide things honest in the sight of all men.

\ln Iyuno yeli gesesdi nigav igetsadvnedi gesv itsatlinigvnehesdi dohiyi itsadediyi naniv yvwi.
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᏰᎵ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎢᎨᏣᏛᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏣᏟᏂᎬᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᏙᎯᏱ ᎢᏣᏕᏗᏱ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏴᏫ.
\ft If it be possible, as much as lieth in you, live peaceably with all men.

\ln Itsvgeyui, tlesdi yitsatlegesdi, itsilanvdadehesdisgini utalawohisdi gesvi; hiayeno nigvnv gowela, Atleisdi gesv ayv aquatseliga; ayv dagaguyvhi, adiha Yihowa.
\syll ᎢᏨᎨᏳᎢ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏣᏞᎨᏍᏗ, ᎢᏥᎳᏅᏓᏕᎮᏍᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏔᎳᏬᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᏂᎬᏅ ᎪᏪᎳ, ᎠᏞᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏴ ᎠᏆᏤᎵᎦ; ᎠᏴ ᏓᎦᎫᏴᎯ, ᎠᏗᎭ ᏱᎰᏩ.
\ft Dearly beloved, avenge not yourselves, but rather give place unto wrath: for it is written, Vengeance is mine; I will repay, saith the Lord.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi, iyuno tsasgagi agonu uyosisgesdi, hiyelohesdi; iyuno utadegisgesdi, hiuvsgesdi; nasgiyeno hnadvnehv tsinosga tsutsistli dehitlusgesdi asgoli.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᏣᏍᎦᎩ ᎠᎪᏄ ᎤᏲᏏᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎯᏰᎶᎮᏍᏗ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᎤᏔᏕᎩᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎯᎤᎥᏍᎨᏍᏗ; ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎿᏛᏁᎲ ᏥᏃᏍᎦ ᏧᏥᏍᏟ ᏕᎯᏡᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᏍᎪᎵ.
\ft Therefore if thine enemy hunger, feed him; if he thirst, give him drink: for in so doing thou shalt heap coals of fire on his head.

\ln Tlesdi usonv netsvnelv yitsadalinehidelesdi, usonvsgini netsvnelv hiyadalinehidehesdi osdv hnadvnehvi.
\syll ᏞᏍᏗ ᎤᏐᏅ ᏁᏨᏁᎸ ᏱᏣᏓᎵᏁᎯᏕᎴᏍᏗ, ᎤᏐᏅᏍᎩᏂ ᏁᏨᏁᎸ ᎯᏯᏓᎵᏁᎯᏕᎮᏍᏗ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎿᏛᏁᎲᎢ.
\ft Be not overcome of evil, but overcome evil with good.

\ln Nanivquo dunohiyusesdi ayeli degotlvwadisvi.  Vtlayeno ayeli yudotlvha Unelanvhi nvdayudalenvhi nigesvna; ayeli tsidegotlvha Unelanvhi udanvtelvhi digotlvnvhi.
\syll ᎾᏂᎥᏉ ᏚᏃᎯᏳᏎᏍᏗ ᎠᏰᎵ ᏕᎪᏢᏩᏗᏒᎢ.  ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᎠᏰᎵ ᏳᏙᏢᎭ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ; ᎠᏰᎵ ᏥᏕᎪᏢᎭ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏓᏅᏖᎸᎯ ᏗᎪᏢᏅᎯ.
\ft Let every soul be subject unto the higher powers. For there is no power but of God: the powers that be are ordained of God.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi gilo dagatilegesdi ayeli gotlvsvi, dagatilegesdi Unelanvhi udanvtelvhi gotlvnvhi gesvi; nasgino dinigatilegi tsunadugodanediyi aniwadvdisgesdi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎩᎶ ᏓᎦᏘᎴᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎪᏢᏒᎢ, ᏓᎦᏘᎴᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏓᏅᏖᎸᎯ ᎪᏢᏅᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏗᏂᎦᏘᎴᎩ ᏧᎾᏚᎪᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᎠᏂᏩᏛᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
\ft Whosoever therefore resisteth the power, resisteth the ordinance of God: and they that resist shall receive to themselves damnation.

\ln Nunigvwiyusadegiyeno vtla diganayehisdi yigi osdv yidolvwisdaneha, uyosgini yidolvwisdaneha.  Tsadulisgono tsanayehisdiyi nigesvna ayeli gotlvsvi?  osdv hnadvnehesdi, nasgino tsalvquododi gesesdi.
\syll ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩᏰᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏗᎦᎾᏰᎯᏍᏗ ᏱᎩ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏱᏙᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎭ, ᎤᏲᏍᎩᏂ ᏱᏙᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎭ.  ᏣᏚᎵᏍᎪᏃ ᏣᎾᏰᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎪᏢᏒᎢ?  ᎣᏍᏛ ᎿᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏣᎸᏉᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft For rulers are not a terror to good works, but to the evil. Wilt thou then not be afraid of the power? do that which is good, and thou shalt have praise of the same:

\ln Nasgiyeno [nugvwiyusadegi] Unelanvhi unvsidasdi nihi osdv itsalisdanedi tsulvwisdanehi.  Iyusgini uyoquo dotsalvwisdanehesdi, hisgaihesdi; vtlayeno aseno yiganeha ayelasdiganvhidv; Unelanvhiyeno unvsidasdi nasgi, utlegi, asdvdisdisgi nasgi na uyo tsulvwisdanehi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩdata is invalid ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᏂᎯ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᏧᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ.  ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏲᏉ ᏙᏣᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ, ᎯᏍᎦᎢᎮᏍᏗ; ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᎠᏎᏃ ᏱᎦᏁᎭ ᎠᏰᎳᏍᏗᎦᏅᎯᏛ; ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ ᎤᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ, ᎤᏞᎩ, ᎠᏍᏛᏗᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᏲ ᏧᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ.
\ft For he is the minister of God to thee for good. But if thou do that which is evil, be afraid; for he beareth not the sword in vain: for he is the minister of God, a revenger to execute wrath upon him that doeth evil.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi ase itsohiyudi gesesdi, vtla udasdvdisdiquo gesv iyusdi, tsodanvdvsgini nasquo osehehv iyusdi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏎ ᎢᏦᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎥᏝ ᎤᏓᏍᏛᏗᏍᏗᏉ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᏦᏓᏅᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎣᏎᎮᎲ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ.
\ft Wherefore ye must needs be subject, not only for wrath, but also for conscience sake.

\ln Nasgi nasquo nvdigalisdodisgesdi ayeli aguyvdi gesv itsaguyisgesdi; Unelanvhiyeno tsunvsidasdi nasgi, dunilvwisdaneha nigohilv nasgi hia.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎠᎫᏴᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏣᎫᏱᏍᎨᏍᏗ; ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ ᏧᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ, ᏚᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎭ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ.
\ft For for this cause pay ye tribute also: for they are God's ministers, attending continually upon this very thing.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi nigadiyu diguyvedi gesv detsaguyvehesdi; ayeli etsaguyvedi gesv ayeli etsaguyvehesdi; itsinotanvdiyi itsalisgolvdanelv etsaguyvedi gesv etsaguyvehesdi; nasgi etsinayeisdi gesv nasgi na etsinayesgesdi; nasgi etsilvquododi gesv nasgi na etsilvquodesdi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏗᎫᏴᎡᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏕᏣᎫᏴᎡᎮᏍᏗ; ᎠᏰᎵ ᎡᏣᎫᏴᎡᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎡᏣᎫᏴᎡᎮᏍᏗ; ᎢᏥᏃᏔᏅᏗᏱ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᎸ ᎡᏣᎫᏴᎡᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎡᏣᎫᏴᎡᎮᏍᏗ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᏥᎾᏰᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎡᏥᎾᏰᏍᎨᏍᏗ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᏥᎸᏉᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎡᏥᎸᏉᏕᏍᏗ.
\ft Render therefore to all their dues: tribute to whom tribute is due; custom to whom custom; fear to whom fear; honour to whom honour.

\ln Tlesdi gilo yitsidugesdi gohusdi, ditsadageyudiyi uwasv; giloyeno nvwadale yugeyuha ukalilv dikahnawadvsdi nigawesgvi.
\syll ᏞᏍᏗ ᎩᎶ ᏱᏥᏚᎨᏍᏗ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ, ᏗᏣᏓᎨᏳᏗᏱ ᎤᏩᏒ; ᎩᎶᏰᏃ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᏳᎨᏳᎭ ᎤᎧᎵᎸ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎬᎢ.
\ft Owe no man any thing, but to love one another: for he that loveth another hath fulfilled the law.

\ln Hiayeno nasgi [dikahnawadvsdi,] Tlesdi tsadayonelvgi, tlesdi tsadalvgi, Tlesdi tsanosgisvgi, Tlesdi gayegogi tsanohelvgi, Tlesdi gohusdi yitsagvvsgesdi, ale nigav nvwadale dikahnawadvsdi, hiaquo igawedv tsigi nahna adotsalvsga usquala kaneisdi gesvi, Tsvsv nitsadageyusv nasgiya nigeyusesdi nav idisdadala.
\syll ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ,data is invalid ᏞᏍᏗ ᏣᏓᏲᏁᎸᎩ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᏣᏓᎸᎩ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᏣᏃᏍᎩᏒᎩ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᎦᏰᎪᎩ ᏣᏃᎮᎸᎩ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏱᏣᎬᎥᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ, ᎯᎠᏉ ᎢᎦᏪᏛ ᏥᎩ ᏀᎾ ᎠᏙᏣᎸᏍᎦ ᎤᏍᏆᎳ ᎧᏁᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏨᏒ ᏂᏣᏓᎨᏳᏒ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏂᎨᏳᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᎥ ᎢᏗᏍᏓᏓᎳ.
\ft For this, Thou shalt not commit adultery, Thou shalt not kill, Thou shalt not steal, Thou shalt not bear false witness, Thou shalt not covet; and if there be any other commandment, it is briefly comprehended in this saying, namely, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.

\ln Adageyudi gesv vtla uyo yinuwaneho nav iyunadala; nasgi iyusdi adageyudi gesv akaliiha dikahnawadvsdi nigawesgvi.
\syll ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏲ ᏱᏄᏩᏁᎰ ᎾᎥ ᎢᏳᎾᏓᎳ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎧᎵᎢᎭ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎬᎢ.
\ft Love worketh no ill to his neighbour: therefore love is the fulfilling of the law.

\ln Ale nasgi, tsidigataha iyvdv aliyilisvi, nasgi nahiyu ayeisdiyi idilihv hnaquo uliyeilolv; gohiyeno egisdelvdiyi gesv utli navniyu ano igvyiyi digohiyunvi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ, ᏥᏗᎦᏔᎭ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎠᎵᏱᎵᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏀᎢᏳ ᎠᏰᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎢᏗᎵᎲ ᎿᏉ ᎤᎵᏰᎢᎶᎸ; ᎪᎯᏰᏃ ᎡᎩᏍᏕᎸᏗᏱ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏟ ᎾᎥᏂᏳ ᎠᏃ ᎢᎬᏱᏱ ᏗᎪᎯᏳᏅᎢ.
\ft And that, knowing the time, that now it is high time to awake out of sleep: for now is our salvation nearer than when we believed.

\ln Svnoyi asqualoga, hnaquo ugitsvnidi; nasgi iyusdi iyvdv nidvga ulisigv digalvwisdanedi gesvi, ale idanuwosda alisgasdodo igagadv ehi.
\syll ᏒᏃᏱ ᎠᏍᏆᎶᎦ, ᎿᏉ ᎤᎩᏨᏂᏗ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏂᏛᎦ ᎤᎵᏏᎬ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏓᏄᏬᏍᏓ ᎠᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏙ ᎢᎦᎦᏛ ᎡᎯ.
\ft The night is far spent, the day is at hand: let us therefore cast off the works of darkness, and let us put on the armour of light.

\ln Duyugodv gesesdi idehvi, iga nigeso nasgiyai; vtlasdino alisganawasdi gesvi, ale udayvsdesdi gesvi, ale udelidv dinisidi gesvi, ale nolisinahisdvna alenidasdi gesvi, vtlesdino adisvsdi gesvi ale didadvyutsedi gesvi.
\syll ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎢᏕᎲᎢ, ᎢᎦ ᏂᎨᏐ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ; ᎥᏝᏍᏗᏃ ᎠᎵᏍᎦᎾᏩᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᏴᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᏗᏂᏏᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏃᎵᏏᏀᎢᏍᏛᎾ ᎠᎴᏂᏓᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎥᏞᏍᏗᏃ ᎠᏗᏒᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏓᏛᏳᏤᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Let us walk honestly, as in the day; not in rioting and drunkenness, not in chambering and wantonness, not in strife and envying.

\ln Ugvwiyuhisgini Tsisa Galonedv etsanuwosda, ale tlesdi yitsadvnvisdanelesdi uquedali gesvi, nasgi ugvvsgv itsadvnediyi.
\syll ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎡᏣᏄᏬᏍᏓ, ᎠᎴ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏣᏛᏅᎢᏍᏓᏁᎴᏍᏗ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎬᎥᏍᎬ ᎢᏣᏛᏁᏗᏱ.
\ft But put ye on the Lord Jesus Christ, and make not provision for the flesh, to fulfill the lusts thereof.

\ln Gilo wanagala gesesdi uwohiyusvi detsadanilvgesdi, vtla adina ditsugododiyiquo nusdv adanvdesgvi.
\syll ᎩᎶ ᏩᎾᎦᎳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᏬᎯᏳᏒᎢ ᏕᏣᏓᏂᎸᎨᏍᏗ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᏗᎾ ᏗᏧᎪᏙᏗᏱᏉ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎠᏓᏅᏕᏍᎬᎢ.
\ft Him that is weak in the faith receive ye, but not to doubtful disputations.

\ln Asiyvwi nigavquo gohusdi gvwalisdayvdodi gesv uwohiyusoi; gilono awanagala advsvvsgiquo alisdayvdisgoi.
\syll ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᏂᎦᎥᏉ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎬᏩᎵᏍᏓᏴᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏬᎯᏳᏐᎢ; ᎩᎶᏃ ᎠᏩᎾᎦᎳ ᎠᏛᏒᎥᏍᎩᏉ ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏍᎪᎢ.
\ft For one believeth that he may eat all things: another, who is weak, eateth herbs.

\ln Tlesdi nasgi na alisdayvhvsgi nvlisaliquo yuyelvnesdi na nalisdayvhvsgvna; ale tlesdi nasgi na nalisdayvhvsgvna yiduwugodanelesdi na alisdayvhvsgi; Unelanvhiyeno dudanilvtsv.
\syll ᏞᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎩ ᏅᎵᏌᎵᏉ ᏳᏰᎸᏁᏍᏗ Ꮎ ᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎬᎾ; ᎠᎴ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎬᎾ ᏱᏚᏭᎪᏓᏁᎴᏍᏗ Ꮎ ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎩ; ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ ᏚᏓᏂᎸᏨ.
\ft Let not him that eateth despise him that eateth not; and let not him which eateth not judge him that eateth: for God hath received him.

\ln Gago nihi tsidehiyugodane nvwadale unvsidasdi?  uwasvquo unvsidohi ulisgasdodi gadogv ale ganvgvi.  Vv, atsiyosdodanedi gesesdi unvisdiyi; Unelanvhiyeno yeliquo ulediyi igvwanedi.
\syll ᎦᎪ ᏂᎯ ᏥᏕᎯᏳᎪᏓᏁ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᎤᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ?  ᎤᏩᏒᏉ ᎤᏅᏏᏙᎯ ᎤᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏗ ᎦᏙᎬ ᎠᎴ ᎦᏅᎬᎢ.  ᎥᎥ, ᎠᏥᏲᏍᏙᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᏅᎢᏍᏗᏱ; ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ ᏰᎵᏉ ᎤᎴᏗᏱ ᎢᎬᏩᏁᏗ.
\ft Who art thou that judgest another man's servant? to his own master he standeth or falleth. Yea, he shall be holden up: for God is able to make him stand.

\ln Gilo utli nulvquodo gohusdi usdi iga esgaquo nvwadale iga; gilono nigavquo iga dulvquodoi.  Naniv gilo akalii unohiyusesdi unvsv dotsunadanvdvi.
\syll ᎩᎶ ᎤᏟ ᏄᎸᏉᏙ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎢᎦ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᎢᎦ; ᎩᎶᏃ ᏂᎦᎥᏉ ᎢᎦ ᏚᎸᏉᏙᎢ.  ᎾᏂᎥ ᎩᎶ ᎠᎧᎵᎢ ᎤᏃᎯᏳᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᏅᏒ ᏙᏧᎾᏓᏅᏛᎢ.
\ft One man esteemeth one day above another: another esteemeth every day alike. Let every man be fully persuaded in his own mind.

\ln Gilo tsulvquodo iga Ugvwiyuhi galvquodanehoi; gilono nulvquodvna tsigeso iga, Ugvwiyuhi galvquodisgo nulvquodvna gesvi.  Gilo tsalisdayvhvsgoi, Ugvwiyuhi alisdayvnanehoi; Unelanvhiyeno alihelitsehoi; ale gilo nalisdayvhvsgvna tsigesoi, Ugvwiyuhi galvquododisgo nalisdayvhvsgvna gesvi, ale Unelanvhi alihelitsehoi.
\syll ᎩᎶ ᏧᎸᏉᏙ ᎢᎦ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎦᎸᏉᏓᏁᎰᎢ; ᎩᎶᏃ ᏄᎸᏉᏛᎾ ᏥᎨᏐ ᎢᎦ, ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏍᎪ ᏄᎸᏉᏛᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.  ᎩᎶ ᏣᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎪᎢ, ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᎾᏁᎰᎢ; ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ ᎠᎵᎮᎵᏤᎰᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎬᎾ ᏥᎨᏐᎢ, ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎦᎸᏉᏙᏗᏍᎪ ᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎬᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎵᎮᎵᏤᎰᎢ.
\ft He that regardeth the day, regardeth it unto the Lord; and he that regardeth not the day, to the Lord he doth not regard it. He that eateth, eateth to the Lord, for he giveth God thanks; and he that eateth not, to the Lord he eateth not, and giveth God thanks.

\ln Vtlayeno gilo iganelagiya yigi idehvi, vtla ale gilo unelagiya yigi ayohusgvi.
\syll ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎢᎦᏁᎳᎩᏯ ᏱᎩ ᎢᏕᎲᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏁᎳᎩᏯ ᏱᎩ ᎠᏲᎱᏍᎬᎢ.
\ft For none of us liveth to himself, and no man dieth to himself.

\ln Iyuyeno yidalenidoha, Ugvwiyuhi edalenideha; ale iyu yididiyohusga, Ugvwiyuhi ediyohuhiseha; nasgino iyusdi iyuno yidalenidoha, ale yididiyohusga, Ugvwiyuhi edatseliga.
\syll ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᏱᏓᎴᏂᏙᎭ, ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎡᏓᎴᏂᏕᎭ; ᎠᎴ ᎢᏳ ᏱᏗᏗᏲᎱᏍᎦ, ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎡᏗᏲᎱᎯᏎᎭ; ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏳᏃ ᏱᏓᎴᏂᏙᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᏱᏗᏗᏲᎱᏍᎦ, ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎡᏓᏤᎵᎦ.
\ft For whether we live, we live unto the Lord; and whether we die, we die unto the Lord: whether we live therefore, or die, we are the Lord's.

\ln Nasgiyeno hia ugvwale Galonedv tsuyohusei, ale tsidulehisanei, ale tsuwanosei, nasgi Ugvwiyuhi iyulisdodiyi tsuniyohusvhi ale nasquo dinvnodv unatseliga.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎤᎬᏩᎴ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏧᏲᎱᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᏚᎴᎯᏌᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏩᏃᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏗᏅᏃᏛ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ.
\ft For to this end Christ both died, and rose, and revived, that he might be Lord both of the dead and living.

\ln Ale nihi, gadono dohiyugodaneha isdalinvtli?  ale nihi nasquo, gadono nvlisaliquo ihiyelvsga isdalinvtli?  nigadiyuyeno igvyiditlv wigaledi gesesdi Galonedv tsuwugododiyi uwesgilvi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏂᎯ, ᎦᏙᏃ ᏙᎯᏳᎪᏓᏁᎭ ᎢᏍᏓᎵᏅᏟ?  ᎠᎴ ᏂᎯ ᎾᏍᏉ, ᎦᏙᏃ ᏅᎵᏌᎵᏉ ᎢᎯᏰᎸᏍᎦ ᎢᏍᏓᎵᏅᏟ?  ᏂᎦᏗᏳᏰᏃ ᎢᎬᏱᏗᏢ ᏫᎦᎴᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏧᏭᎪᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᏪᏍᎩᎸᎢ.
\ft But why dost thou judge thy brother? or why dost thou set at nought thy brother? for we shall all stand before the judgment seat of Christ.

\ln Hiayeno nigvnv gowela, Gev nudohiyusvi, adiha Yihowa, nigadiyu dodagvqualiniquanvneli ayv, ale nigadiyu gvnigesv nvdagvwaneli Unelanvhi.
\syll ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᏂᎬᏅ ᎪᏪᎳ, ᎨᎥ ᏄᏙᎯᏳᏒᎢ, ᎠᏗᎭ ᏱᎰᏩ, ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏙᏓᎬᏆᎵᏂᏆᏅᏁᎵ ᎠᏴ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏁᎵ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ.
\ft For it is written, As I live, saith the Lord, every knee shall bow to me, and every tongue shall confess to God.

\ln Nasgino tsinusdi nidiv idisiyvwiha gesv gvnigesv iyedvnedi gesesdi Unelanvhi nigadvnelidolvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏥᏄᏍᏗ ᏂᏗᎥ ᎢᏗᏏᏴᏫᎭ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏰᏛᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏂᎦᏛᏁᎵᏙᎸᎢ.
\ft So then every one of us shall give account of himself to God.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi tlesdi gohi iyudalenvdv yididadadugodanehesdi; hiasgini ugvwiyusesdi detsugodisgesdi, nasgi adadodesdisgi ale ustlvnisdisgi itsidiyi nigesvna itsalinvtli ulohisdiyi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎪᎯ ᎢᏳᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏱᏗᏓᏓᏚᎪᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ; ᎯᎠᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᏎᏍᏗ ᏕᏧᎪᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏓᏙᏕᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏍᏢᏂᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᎢᏥᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᏣᎵᏅᏟ ᎤᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ.
\ft Let us not therefore judge one another any more: but judge this rather, that no man put a stumblingblock or an occasion to fall in his brother's way.

\ln Tsigataha, ale aquohiyudi naquvnelv Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa, nasgi gohusdi uwasvquo gesv gadaha nigesvna gesvi; gilosgini gohusdi gadaha ayelvsgi, nasgi gadaha nulisdanehoi.
\syll ᏥᎦᏔᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏉᎯᏳᏗ ᎾᏋᏁᎸ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏩᏒᏉ ᎨᏒ ᎦᏓᎭ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎩᎶᏍᎩᏂ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎦᏓᎭ ᎠᏰᎸᏍᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏓᎭ ᏄᎵᏍᏓᏁᎰᎢ.
\ft I know, and am persuaded by the Lord Jesus, that there is nothing unclean of itself: but to him that esteemeth any thing to be unclean, to him it is unclean.

\ln Iyusgini disdadanvtli alisdayvdi yinvdigalisdodiha ehisdi yiyadanvdadistanv, hnaquo vtla adageyudi gesv yvdiha nasgi hnadvnehvi.  Tlesdi halisdayvhvsgv hidvdotanvgi nasgi na Galonedv uyohuhiselvhi.
\syll ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᏗᏍᏓᏓᏅᏟ ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗ ᏱᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎡᎯᏍᏗ ᏱᏯᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏔᏅ, ᎿᏉ ᎥᏝ ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏴᏗᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎿᏛᏁᎲᎢ.  ᏞᏍᏗ ᎭᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎬ ᎯᏛᏙᏔᏅᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏲᎱᎯᏎᎸᎯ.
\ft But if thy brother be grieved with thy meat, now walkest thou not charitably. Destroy not him with thy meat, for whom Christ died.

\ln Nasgino tlesdi osiyu nitsadvnehv usonv yuninohelesdi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎣᏏᏳ ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎲ ᎤᏐᏅ ᏳᏂᏃᎮᎴᏍᏗ.
\ft Let not then your good be evil spoken of:

\ln Unelanvhiyeno utseligohi vtla alisdayvdiquo ale aditasdiquo gesv yigi; duyugodvsgini gesvi, ale nvwadohiyadv gesvi, ale alihelisdi gesvi galvquodiyu Adanvdo iyuwanisadv.
\syll ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ ᎤᏤᎵᎪᎯ ᎥᏝ ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏉ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏗᏔᏍᏗᏉ ᎨᏒ ᏱᎩ; ᏚᏳᎪᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎵᎮᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ.
\ft For the kingdom of God is not meat and drink; but righteousness, and peace, and joy in the Holy Ghost.

\ln Giloyeno nasgi hia uwvdidegv Galonedv gohusdi advnehesdi, nasgi Unelanvhi digvwadanilvisdi gesesdi, ale osiyu gagvwayelvdi gesesdi yvwi.
\syll ᎩᎶᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎤᏮᏗᏕᎬ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎠᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏗᎬᏩᏓᏂᎸᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎦᎬᏩᏰᎸᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏴᏫ.
\ft For he that in these things serveth Christ is acceptable to God, and approved of men.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi idisdawadisesdi nasgi dohi igvnehi gesvi, ale nasgi digegadalinigohisdodi gesvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏗᏍᏓᏩᏗᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏙᎯ ᎢᎬᏁᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎨᎦᏓᎵᏂᎪᎯᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Let us therefore follow after the things which make for peace, and things wherewith one may edify another.

\ln Tlesdi Unelanvhi utseli digalvwisdanedi gesv yitsayostanesdi alisdayvdiquo yinvtsulisdotanesdi.  Nudalesvyeno gohusdi udohiyuhi gadaha nigesvna; uyosgini nadvneho nasgi na yvwi alisdayvhvsgv gilo yidigodesdiha.
\syll ᏞᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏱᏣᏲᏍᏔᏁᏍᏗ ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏉ ᏱᏅᏧᎵᏍᏙᏔᏁᏍᏗ.  ᏄᏓᎴᏒᏰᏃ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎦᏓᎭ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ; ᎤᏲᏍᎩᏂ ᎾᏛᏁᎰ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏴᏫ ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎬ ᎩᎶ ᏱᏗᎪᏕᏍᏗᎭ.
\ft For meat destroy not the work of God. All things indeed are pure; but it is evil for that man who eateth with offence.

\ln Utli usiyu hawiya agisdiyi nigesvna, ale gigageaditasdi aditasdiyi nigesvna, ale gohusdi advnediyi nigesvna, nasgi disdadanvtli tsuwodesdisgi, ale ustlvnisdisgi, ale awanagala iyuwanehi.
\syll ᎤᏟ ᎤᏏᏳ ᎭᏫᏯ ᎠᎩᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᎩᎦᎨᎠᏗᏔᏍᏗ ᎠᏗᏔᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎠᏛᏁᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏍᏓᏓᏅᏟ ᏧᏬᏕᏍᏗᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏍᏢᏂᏍᏗᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏩᎾᎦᎳ ᎢᏳᏩᏁᎯ.
\ft It is good neither to eat flesh, nor to drink wine, nor any thing whereby thy brother stumbleth, or is offended, or is made weak.

\ln Gohiyudisgo gesv tseha?  tsatselidv tsohiyusesdi Unelanvhi agatahvi.  Nvwadohisdv udanvtesdi gilo nusdv osiyu uyelvsv gvdisgv uwasv nidadadugodanehvna igesesdi.
\syll ᎪᎯᏳᏗᏍᎪ ᎨᏒ ᏤᎭ?  ᏣᏤᎵᏛ ᏦᎯᏳᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎦᏔᎲᎢ.  ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏍᏛ ᎤᏓᏅᏖᏍᏗ ᎩᎶ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎤᏰᎸᏒ ᎬᏗᏍᎬ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏂᏓᏓᏚᎪᏓᏁᎲᎾ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft Hast thou faith? have it to thyself before God. Happy is he that condemneth not himself in that thing which he alloweth.

\ln Gilosgini tsutlvwisehi degugodisgo usganvtsv iyuno yulisdayvnv, nvdigalisdodisgo nuwohiyusvna gesv alisdayvhvsgvi; nigavyeno gohusdi gohiyudi gesv nvdidalehvsgvna yigi asgani gesoi.
\syll ᎩᎶᏍᎩᏂ ᏧᏢᏫᏎᎯ ᏕᎫᎪᏗᏍᎪ ᎤᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᎢᏳᏃ ᏳᎵᏍᏓᏴᏅ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎪ ᏄᏬᎯᏳᏒᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎬᎢ; ᏂᎦᎥᏰᏃ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏗᏓᎴᎲᏍᎬᎾ ᏱᎩ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᎨᏐᎢ.
\ft And he that doubteth is damned if he eat, because he eateth not of faith: for whatsoever is not of faith is sin.

\ln Ayvno digalinigidv tsigi unelagi yidideliseha daniwanagalv diniwanagalai, ale vtla igvsvquo osdv igiyelvdi yinigedadvnelidoha.
\syll ᎠᏴᏃ ᏗᎦᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᏥᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᎩ ᏱᏗᏕᎵᏎᎭ ᏓᏂᏩᎾᎦᎸ ᏗᏂᏩᎾᎦᎳᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᎢᎬᏒᏉ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎢᎩᏰᎸᏗ ᏱᏂᎨᏓᏛᏁᎵᏙᎭ.
\ft We then that are strong ought to bear the infirmities of the weak, and not to please ourselves.

\ln Nidiv idisiyvwiha gesv nav igadala osdv uyelvdi gesv nidadvnehesdi nasgi osdv gesv ulinigohisdiyi ugvwali.
\syll ᏂᏗᎥ ᎢᏗᏏᏴᏫᎭ ᎨᏒ ᎾᎥ ᎢᎦᏓᎳ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎤᏰᎸᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏂᏓᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎵᏂᎪᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ.
\ft Let every one of us please his neighbour for his good to edification.

\ln Galonedvyeno nasquo vtla uwasvquo osiyu uyelvdi yinadvnehei; Hiasgini tsinigvnv tsigowela nasgiya [nulisdanelei,] gagvwanadasotlvdv nasgi na gagetsasotlvtanvi ayv agilutselvgi.
\syll ᎦᎶᏁᏛᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏩᏒᏉ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎤᏰᎸᏗ ᏱᎾᏛᏁᎮᎢ; ᎯᎠᏍᎩᏂ ᏥᏂᎬᏅ ᏥᎪᏪᎳ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᎵᏍᏓᏁᎴᎢ,data is invalid ᎦᎬᏩᎾᏓᏐᏢᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎦᎨᏣᏐᏢᏔᏅᎢ ᎠᏴ ᎠᎩᎷᏤᎸᎩ.
\ft For even Christ pleased not himself; but, as it is written, The reproaches of them that reproached thee fell on me.

\ln Nudalesvyeno gohusdi eti gowelanvhi gesv ayv igadeloquasdi ayelvse gowelanei, nasgi didvnidiyu nigvnehv ale ugalisdi igadanvdadisdisgv goweli nasgi udugi igvhi iyulisdodiyi.
\syll ᏄᏓᎴᏒᏰᏃ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎡᏘ ᎪᏪᎳᏅᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏴ ᎢᎦᏕᎶᏆᏍᏗ ᎠᏰᎸᏎ ᎪᏪᎳᏁᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏛᏂᏗᏳ ᏂᎬᏁᎲ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎦᎵᏍᏗ ᎢᎦᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᎪᏪᎵ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎢᎬᎯ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
\ft For whatsoever things were written aforetime were written for our learning, that we through patience and comfort of the scriptures might have hope.

\ln Nasgino Unelanvhi agvnidiyu ale ugalisdi iyadadvnehi itsinedi gesesdi utloyiquo itsadanvdadisdiyi, nasgiya Galonedv Tsisa adanvtesgvi;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎬᏂᏗᏳ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎦᎵᏍᏗ ᎢᏯᏓᏛᏁᎯ ᎢᏥᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᏠᏱᏉ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏥᏌ ᎠᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬᎢ;
\ft Now the God of patience and consolation grant you to be likeminded one toward another according to Christ Jesus:

\ln Nasgi saquo detsadanvdvi ale saquo itsiholi itsvdodiyi etsilvquododiyi Unelanvhi nasgi na Udoda Ugvwiyuhi igatseli Tsisa Galonedv.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏌᏉ ᏕᏣᏓᏅᏛᎢ ᎠᎴ ᏌᏉ ᎢᏥᎰᎵ ᎢᏨᏙᏗᏱ ᎡᏥᎸᏉᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᏙᏓ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ.
\ft That ye may with one mind and one mouth glorify God, even the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi detsadadanilvgesdiquo, nasgiya nasquo Galonedv degadanilvtsv ayv, nasgi galvquodiyu iyagvnediyi Unelanvhi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏕᏣᏓᏓᏂᎸᎨᏍᏗᏉ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏕᎦᏓᏂᎸᏨ ᎠᏴ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎢᏯᎬᏁᏗᏱ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ.
\ft Wherefore receive ye one another, as Christ also received us to the glory of God.

\ln Ale hia nitsiweha, nasgi Tsisa Galonedv digetsiusdeselvhi uninvsidasdi nulistanvgi gvnigesv iyuwanediyi gayegogi nigesvna gesv Unelanvhi, tsusdayidisdiyi getsiduisdanelvhi gesv anigayvligei.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏥᏪᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏗᎨᏥᎤᏍᏕᏎᎸᎯ ᎤᏂᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎩ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏩᏁᏗᏱ ᎦᏰᎪᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᏧᏍᏓᏱᏗᏍᏗᏱ ᎨᏥᏚᎢᏍᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏂᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ.
\ft Now I say that Jesus Christ was a minister of the circumcision for the truth of God, to confirm the promises made unto the fathers:

\ln Ale nasgi tsunadalenvdv yvwi unilvquododiyi Unelanvhi udadolisdiyu gesv iyusdi; nasgiya hia tsinigvnv tsigowela, Nasgi iyusdi dagvneistani anehv tsunadalenvdv yvwi, ale dodatsinogistani detsadovi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏂᎸᏉᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ; ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᎬᏅ ᏥᎪᏪᎳ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏓᎬᏁᎢᏍᏔᏂ ᎠᏁᎲ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ, ᎠᎴ ᏙᏓᏥᏃᎩᏍᏔᏂ ᏕᏣᏙᎥᎢ.
\ft And that the Gentiles might glorify God for his mercy; as it is written, For this cause I will confess to thee among the Gentiles, and sing unto thy name.

\ln Talineno hia nigaweha, Itsaliheligi ditsadalenvdv yvwi, ditsaligohvsi tsutseli yvwi.
\syll ᏔᎵᏁᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᎭ, ᎢᏣᎵᎮᎵᎩ ᏗᏣᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ, ᏗᏣᎵᎪᎲᏏ ᏧᏤᎵ ᏴᏫ.
\ft And again he saith, Rejoice, ye Gentiles, with his people.

\ln Talineno, Etsilvquoda Yihowa, nigadiyu ditsadalenvdv yvwi; ale etsilvquoda, nitsivquo yvwi.
\syll ᏔᎵᏁᏃ, ᎡᏥᎸᏉᏓ ᏱᎰᏩ, ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏗᏣᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ; ᎠᎴ ᎡᏥᎸᏉᏓ, ᏂᏥᎥᏉ ᏴᏫ.
\ft And again, Praise the Lord, all ye Gentiles; and laud him, all ye people.

\ln Talineno Isaya hia nigaweha; Uhnasdetlv gananugogesdi Tsesiyi, ale asiyvwi dodvleni ugvwiyusadegi iyulisdodiyi tsunadalenvdv yvwi anehvi; nasgi tsunadalenvdv yvwi dagvwalisgasdotani.
\syll ᏔᎵᏁᏃ ᎢᏌᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᎭ; ᎤᎿᏍᏕᏢ ᎦᎾᏄᎪᎨᏍᏗ ᏤᏏᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᏙᏛᎴᏂ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᎠᏁᎲᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᏓᎬᏩᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏔᏂ.
\ft And again, Esaias saith, There shall be a root of Jesse, and he that shall rise to reign over the Gentiles; in him shall the Gentiles trust.

\ln Nasgino Unelanvhi udugi gvdi gesv adanehi itsikaliisdi gesesdi nudalesv ulihelisdi gesv ale nvwadohiyadv gesv itsohiyusv iyuwanisadv, nasgi utsatanvhi iyulisdodiyi udugi itsvsvi, galvquodiyu Adanvdo ulinigvgv iyuwanisadv.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎬᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏓᏁᎯ ᎢᏥᎧᎵᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏄᏓᎴᏒ ᎤᎵᎮᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏦᎯᏳᏒ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏣᏔᏅᎯ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎢᏨᏒᎢ, ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᎵᏂᎬᎬ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ.
\ft Now the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that ye may abound in hope, through the power of the Holy Ghost.

\ln Ale aquvsv nasquo aquohiyuha nihi itsvyadanvtesgvi, idalinvtli, nasgi nihi nasquo osdv gesv itsikalii gesvi, ale nudalesv agadovhisdigesv itsikalivi, yeliquo nasquo digetsadagvsgolvdi gesvi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎠᏋᏒ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏉᎯᏳᎭ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏨᏯᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬᎢ, ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏥᎧᎵᎢ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏄᏓᎴᏒ ᎠᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗᎨᏒ ᎢᏥᎧᎵᎥᎢ, ᏰᎵᏉ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏗᎨᏣᏓᎬᏍᎪᎸᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft And I myself also am persuaded of you, my brethren, that ye also are full of goodness, filled with all knowledge, able also to admonish one another.

\ln Aseno idalinvtli, utli igai nitsinayesgvna witsvyowelasi itsvyanvdadisdisgvi, nvdigalisdodiha Unelanvhi aginelv gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesvi,
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᎤᏟ ᎢᎦᎢ ᏂᏥᎾᏰᏍᎬᎾ ᏫᏨᏲᏪᎳᏏ ᎢᏨᏯᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎩᏁᎸ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ,
\ft Nevertheless, brethren, I have written the more boldly unto you in some sort, as putting you in mind, because of the grace that is given to me of God,

\ln Nasgi Tsisa Galonedv aginvsidohi iyaqualisdodiyi tsunadalenvdv yvwi anehvi, galvquodiyu dagilvwisdanehv osdv kanohedv Unelanvhi utseliga gvdisgvi, nasgi galisgolvdisgv tsunadalenvdv yvwi gatsiyalisgolvdisgvi tsudanilvisdi iyulisdodiyi, galvquodiyu iyuwanelvhi galvquodiyu Adanvdo.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎠᎩᏅᏏᏙᎯ ᎢᏯᏆᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᎠᏁᎲᎢ, ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᏓᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᎬᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎵᏍᎪᎸᏗᏍᎬ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᎦᏥᏯᎵᏍᎪᎸᏗᏍᎬᎢ ᏧᏓᏂᎸᎢᏍᏗ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎢᏳᏩᏁᎸᎯ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ.
\ft That I should be the minister of Jesus Christ to the Gentiles, ministering the gospel of God, that the offering up of the Gentiles might be acceptable, being sanctified by the Holy Ghost.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi agiha aquatlvquododi Tsisa Galonedv iyuwanisadv, nasgi nahna Unelanvhi utseli ugvwali gesvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᎩᎭ ᎠᏆᏢᏉᏙᏗ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏀᎾ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft I have therefore whereof I may glory through Jesus Christ in those things which pertain to God.

\ln Vtlayeno yeli yvgatsineisda nasgi Galonedv nudvnelvna gesv ayv aquvdisgvi, tsunadalenvdv yvwi gvwanohiyudi nidegvnehvi, kanohedv ale digalvwisdanedi gesv gvdisgvi,
\syll ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᏰᎵ ᏴᎦᏥᏁᎢᏍᏓ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏄᏛᏁᎸᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏴ ᎠᏋᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᎬᏩᏃᎯᏳᏗ ᏂᏕᎬᏁᎲᎢ, ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏗᏍᎬᎢ,
\ft For I will not dare to speak of any of those things which Christ hath not wrought by me, to make the Gentiles obedient, by word and deed,

\ln [Ale] gvdisgv uyelvdvi ale usquanigodi, Unelanvhi Udanvdo ulinigidiyu gesv gvdisgvi; nasgi Tsilusilimi udalenvdv, ale uduwidv Ililigami wasdi, ukalitsvhi aqualitsidonv osdv kanohedv Galonedv utseliga;
\syll ᎠᎴdata is invalid ᎬᏗᏍᎬ ᎤᏰᎸᏛᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏗᏍᎬᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᎤᏓᎴᏅᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏚᏫᏛ ᎢᎵᎵᎦᎻ ᏩᏍᏗ, ᎤᎧᎵᏨᎯ ᎠᏆᎵᏥᏙᏅ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ;
\ft Through mighty signs and wonders, by the power of the Spirit of God; so that from Jerusalem, and round about unto Illyricum, I have fully preached the gospel of Christ.

\ln Nasgino nusdvgi aquatlinigvnelvgi osdv kanohedv aqualitsidodiyi, vtla nahna Galonedv atsineistanvi, gilo unvhi gagusdvdi aquanesgesdiyi nigesvna;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏄᏍᏛᎩ ᎠᏆᏟᏂᎬᏁᎸᎩ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎠᏆᎵᏥᏙᏗᏱ, ᎥᏝ ᏀᎾ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎠᏥᏁᎢᏍᏔᏅᎢ, ᎩᎶ ᎤᏅᎯ ᎦᎫᏍᏛᏗ ᎠᏆᏁᏍᎨᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ;
\ft Yea, so have I strived to preach the gospel, not where Christ was named, lest I should build upon another man's foundation:

\ln Nasgiyasgini hia tsinigvnv tsigowela, Nasgi getsineisdanelvhi nigesvna gesvi, nasgi dvnigohi; ale nasgi na unadvganvhi nigesvna gesv nasgi dvnolitsi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏯᏍᎩᏂ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᎬᏅ ᏥᎪᏪᎳ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᏥᏁᎢᏍᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏛᏂᎪᎯ; ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏛᏃᎵᏥ.
\ft But as it is written, To whom he was not spoken of, they shall see: and they that have not heard shall understand.

\ln Nasgi nasquo nvdigalisdodiha utsati tsudalenvdv agiyosdodasi witsvlutsediyi;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎠᎩᏲᏍᏙᏓᏏ ᏫᏨᎷᏤᏗᏱ;
\ft For which cause also I have been much hindered from coming to you.

\ln Gohisgini hnaquo ilvhitlv nudlanvdvna tsigi ani uduwidv, ale ilvsgi nadetiyv utsati tsinvquadulisgo witsvlutsediyi;
\syll ᎪᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎿᏉ ᎢᎸᎯᏢ ᏄᏜᏅᏛᎾ ᏥᎩ ᎠᏂ ᎤᏚᏫᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᎸᏍᎩ ᎾᏕᏘᏴ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏥᏅᏆᏚᎵᏍᎪ ᏫᏨᎷᏤᏗᏱ;
\ft But now having no more place in these parts, and having a great desire these many years to come unto you;

\ln Iyuno Squaniyi gesvha, witsvlutsedi gesesdi; udugiyeno aquvha itsvgowadvdiyi nahna witsigatesdi, ale nahna iditlv wisgiyagodiyi, iyuno igvyi alequo yeli nagiyelvnesdi itsvyeladidolvi.
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᏍᏆᏂᏱ ᎨᏒᎭ, ᏫᏨᎷᏤᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᎤᏚᎩᏰᏃ ᎠᏋᎭ ᎢᏨᎪᏩᏛᏗᏱ ᏀᎾ ᏫᏥᎦᏖᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏀᎾ ᎢᏗᏢ ᏫᏍᎩᏯᎪᏗᏱ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎢᎬᏱ ᎠᎴᏉ ᏰᎵ ᎾᎩᏰᎸᏁᏍᏗ ᎢᏨᏰᎳᏗᏙᎸᎢ.
\ft Whensoever I take my journey into Spain, I will come to you: for I trust to see you in my journey, and to be brought on my way thitherward by you, if first I be somewhat filled with your company.

\ln Gohisgini tsigi aquesidi Tsilusilimi gatsisdelvhi unadanvti.
\syll ᎪᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᏥᎩ ᎠᏇᏏᏗ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᎦᏥᏍᏕᎸᎯ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ.
\ft But now I go unto Jerusalem to minister unto the saints.

\ln Osiyuyeno uniyelvnv Masidoni ale Egaya anehi gohusdi unidiyi nvyo iyunadvhnadegi unadanvti Tsilusilimi anehi unalisdelvdodi.
\syll ᎣᏏᏳᏰᏃ ᎤᏂᏰᎸᏅ ᎹᏏᏙᏂ ᎠᎴ ᎡᎦᏯ ᎠᏁᎯ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏂᏗᏱ ᏅᏲ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᎿᏕᎩ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᎠᏁᎯ ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ.
\ft For it hath pleased them of Macedonia and Achaia to make a certain contribution for the poor saints which are at Jerusalem.

\ln Osiyu uniyelvnv udohiyuhi; ale nasgi gvwaniduga.  Iyuyeno tsunadalenvdv yvwi uneladistanvhi yigi nasgi unatseli tsudalenvdv adanvdo ulisdelvdodi ugvwali, iyunadvnedi nasquo nunalisdanehvgi nasgi tsunisdelvdiyi uquedali ulisdelvdodi ugvwali.
\syll ᎣᏏᏳ ᎤᏂᏰᎸᏅ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ; ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏩᏂᏚᎦ.  ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏁᎳᏗᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᏱᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᏤᎵ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ, ᎢᏳᎾᏛᏁᏗ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏄᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᎲᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏂᏍᏕᎸᏗᏱ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎤᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ.
\ft It hath pleased them verily; and their debtors they are. For if the Gentiles have been made partakers of their spiritual things, their duty is also to minister unto them in carnal things.

\ln Nasgino iyusdi hnaquo nasgi hia tsisquadvha, ale nudlasidvsvna nigatsiyvnelv unigowadvdiyi, hia nasgi udatanvhi, witsvloisdanedi gesesdi Squaniyi witsigatesdi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎿᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏍᏆᏛᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᏄᏜᏏᏛᏒᎾ ᏂᎦᏥᏴᏁᎸ ᎤᏂᎪᏩᏛᏗᏱ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏓᏔᏅᎯ, ᏫᏨᎶᎢᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏍᏆᏂᏱ ᏫᏥᎦᏖᏍᏗ.
\ft When therefore I have performed this, and have sealed to them this fruit, I will come by you into Spain.

\ln Ale tsigataha, nasgi hnaquo witsvlutselvha nigav osdv udanedi gesv osdv kanohedv Galonedv utseliga tsiyehesdi witsvlutsedi gesesdi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏥᎦᏔᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎿᏉ ᏫᏨᎷᏤᎸᎭ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎤᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᏥᏰᎮᏍᏗ ᏫᏨᎷᏤᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft And I am sure that, when I come unto you, I shall come in the fullness of the blessing of the gospel of Christ.

\ln Ale itsvsdiyediha idalinvtli, Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv nvdigalisdodiha, ale nvdigalisdodiha adageyudi gesv Adanvdo udanedi gesvi, nasgi sgiyaligonediyi Unelanvhi edadadolisdanehv ayv gesv ugvwali,
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎢᏨᏍᏗᏰᏗᎭ ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏍᎩᏯᎵᎪᏁᏗᏱ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎡᏓᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᎠᏴ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ,
\ft Now I beseech you, brethren, for the Lord Jesus Christ's sake, and for the love of the Spirit, that ye strive together with me in your prayers to God for me;

\ln Nasgi gatsiyadudalaediyi nasgi na anohiyuhvsgi nigesvna Tsudiyi anehi; ale nasgi gatsiyvehv Tsilusilimi anehi, tsunadanilvisdiyiquo unadanvti;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏥᏯᏚᏓᎳᎡᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏧᏗᏱ ᎠᏁᎯ; ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏥᏴᎡᎲ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᎠᏁᎯ, ᏧᎾᏓᏂᎸᎢᏍᏗᏱᏉ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ;
\ft That I may be delivered from them that do not believe in Judaea; and that my service which I have for Jerusalem may be accepted of the saints;

\ln Ale nasgi ayv osiyu uyelvnvhi Unelanvhi, ulihelisdi aquadanvdv witsvlutsediyi, ale itsulaha nihi digigalisdohisdiyi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎤᏰᎸᏅᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎤᎵᎮᎵᏍᏗ ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏛ ᏫᏨᎷᏤᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᏂᎯ ᏗᎩᎦᎵᏍᏙᎯᏍᏗᏱ.
\ft That I may come unto you with joy by the will of God, and may with you be refreshed.

\ln Unelanvhino nvwadohiyadv adanehi nitsiv itseladidohesdi.  Emenv
\syll ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏃ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᎠᏓᏁᎯ ᏂᏥᎥ ᎢᏤᎳᏗᏙᎮᏍᏗ.  ᎡᎺᏅ
\ft Now the God of peace be with you all. Amen.

\ln Gvnigesv nitsvyvneha ogido Quigi, nasgi ayadohihi tsunanelodi unadatlugv Etliya;
\syll ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᏨᏴᏁᎭ ᎣᎩᏙ ᏈᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏯᏙᎯᎯ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬ ᎡᏟᏯ;
\ft I commend unto you Phebe our sister, which is a servant of the church which is at Cenchrea:

\ln Nasgi tsetsadanilvisdiyi Ugvwiyuhi gesv nvdayulisdodiyi, nasgiya tsiduyugodi iyunadvnediyi unadanvti, ale nasgi etsisdelvdiyi nigavquo gohusdi etsisdelvdiyi udulisgvi; nasgiyeno unitsati tsusdelvdv, ale ayv nasquo agisdelvdv.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏤᏣᏓᏂᎸᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏓᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏥᏚᏳᎪᏗ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᏁᏗᏱ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᏥᏍᏕᎸᏗᏱ ᏂᎦᎥᏉ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎡᏥᏍᏕᎸᏗᏱ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎬᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏧᏍᏕᎸᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᎩᏍᏕᎸᏛ.
\ft That ye receive her in the Lord, as becometh saints, and that ye assist her in whatsoever business she hath need of you: for she hath been a succourer of many, and of myself also.

\ln Detsiyolilvha Quisila ale Equila, itsulaha tsogilvwisdanehi Galonedv utseli digalvwisdanedi gesvi.
\syll ᏕᏥᏲᎵᎸᎭ ᏈᏏᎳ ᎠᎴ ᎡᏈᎳ, ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᏦᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Greet Priscilla and Aquila my helpers in Christ Jesus:

\ln Nasgi ayv gvnv anisdelisgvi, unvsv diniyvtseni eladi duninvnv; nasgi, vtla aquvsvquo yigatsiyalielitseha, nasquosgini nigadv tsunanelodi dunadatluwadisv tsunadalenvdv yvwi danewadisvi;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᎬᏅ ᎠᏂᏍᏕᎵᏍᎬᎢ, ᎤᏅᏒ ᏗᏂᏴᏤᏂ ᎡᎳᏗ ᏚᏂᏅᏅ; ᎾᏍᎩ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᏋᏒᏉ ᏱᎦᏥᏯᎵᎡᎵᏤᎭ, ᎾᏍᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᏚᎾᏓᏡᏩᏗᏒ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᏓᏁᏩᏗᏒᎢ;
\ft Who have for my life laid down their own necks: unto whom not only I give thanks, but also all the churches of the Gentiles.

\ln Ale nasquo detsiyolilvha tsunanelodi unadatlugv nahna aninelvi.  Etsiyolilvha utsati tsigeyui Iquinida, nasgi igvyiyi ugadvnatsvhi tsinigalisdiha Egaya Galonedv alisgolvdanedi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏕᏥᏲᎵᎸᎭ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬ ᏀᎾ ᎠᏂᏁᎸᎢ.  ᎡᏥᏲᎵᎸᎭ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏥᎨᏳᎢ ᎢᏈᏂᏓ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎬᏱᏱ ᎤᎦᏛᎾᏨᎯ ᏥᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᎭ ᎡᎦᏯ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎠᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᏗ.
\ft Likewise greet the church that is in their house. Salute my wellbeloved Epaenetus, who is the firstfruits of Achaia unto Christ.

\ln Meli etsiyolilvha, utsati tsulvwisdanelvhi tsigi ayv ogisdelisgvi.
\syll ᎺᎵ ᎡᏥᏲᎵᎸᎭ, ᎤᏣᏘ ᏧᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎠᏴ ᎣᎩᏍᏕᎵᏍᎬᎢ.
\ft Greet Mary, who bestowed much labour on us.

\ln Vtloniga ale Tsuniya detsiyolilvha, nasgi gohusdi diquvnv, ale itsulaha tsogiyvginvhi, nasgi getsilvquodi tsigi getsinvsidv anehvi; nasgi nasquo igvyi Galonedv tsunanelodi iyunalistanvhi ayv oni.
\syll ᎥᏠᏂᎦ ᎠᎴ ᏧᏂᏯ ᏕᏥᏲᎵᎸᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏗᏋᏅ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᏦᎩᏴᎩᏅᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᏥᎸᏉᏗ ᏥᎩ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏛ ᎠᏁᎲᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎢᎬᏱ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎠᏴ ᎣᏂ.
\ft Salute Andronicus and Junia, my kinsmen, and my fellowprisoners, who are of note among the apostles, who also were in Christ before me.

\ln Amitliya etsiyolilvha, nasgi tsigeyui itsulaha osdohiyuhvsgi Ugvwiyuhi.
\syll ᎠᎻᏟᏯ ᎡᏥᏲᎵᎸᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᎨᏳᎢ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎣᏍᏙᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ.
\ft Greet Amplias my beloved in the Lord.

\ln Aqueni etsiyolilvha itsulaha tsogilvwisdanehi Galonedv utseli digalvwisdanedi gesvi; ale Sdegi tsigeyui.
\syll ᎠᏇᏂ ᎡᏥᏲᎵᎸᎭ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᏦᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᏍᏕᎩ ᏥᎨᏳᎢ.
\ft Salute Urbane, our helper in Christ, and Stachys my beloved.

\ln Aqueli etsiyolilvha, tsagadanilvtsvhi Galonedv gohiyuhvsgi gesvi.  Elisdaquula dudatinav anela detsiyolilvha.
\syll ᎠᏇᎵ ᎡᏥᏲᎵᎸᎭ, ᏣᎦᏓᏂᎸᏨᎯ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎪᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᎨᏒᎢ.  ᎡᎵᏍᏓᏊᎳ ᏚᏓᏘᎾᎥ ᎠᏁᎳ ᏕᏥᏲᎵᎸᎭ.
\ft Salute Apelles approved in Christ. Salute them which are of Aristobulus' household.

\ln Elodani gohusdi aquvnv etsiyolilvha. Nasisa dudatinav nasgi Ugvwiyuhi anohiyuhvsgi gesv detsiyolilvha.
\syll ᎡᎶᏓᏂ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎠᏋᏅ ᎡᏥᏲᎵᎸᎭ. ᎾᏏᏌ ᏚᏓᏘᎾᎥ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᎨᏒ ᏕᏥᏲᎵᎸᎭ.
\ft Salute Herodion my kinsman. Greet them that be of the household of Narcissus, which are in the Lord.

\ln Dlaquina ale Dlaquosi detsiyolilvha, nasgi Ugvwiyuhi utseli tsunilvwisdanehi tsigi.  Etsiyolilvha atsigeyui Quasi, utsati tsulvwisdanelvhi tsigi Ugvwiyuhi utseliga.
\syll ᏜᏈᎾ ᎠᎴ ᏜᏉᏏ ᏕᏥᏲᎵᎸᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᏥᎩ.  ᎡᏥᏲᎵᎸᎭ ᎠᏥᎨᏳᎢ ᏆᏏ, ᎤᏣᏘ ᏧᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ.
\ft Salute Tryphena and Tryphosa, who labour in the Lord. Salute the beloved Persis, which laboured much in the Lord.

\ln Luqua etsiyolilvha, nasgi agasuyedv Ugvwiyuhi gohiyuhvsgi, ale nasgi oginitsi.
\syll ᎷᏆ ᎡᏥᏲᎵᎸᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎦᏑᏰᏛ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎪᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᎩᏂᏥ.
\ft Salute Rufus chosen in the Lord, and his mother and mine.

\ln Detsiyolilvha Asinitlida, Quiligani, Hamasi, Quatloquasi, Hamisi, ale analinvtli nasgi itsulaha tsaneha.
\syll ᏕᏥᏲᎵᎸᎭ ᎠᏏᏂᏟᏓ, ᏈᎵᎦᏂ, ᎭᎹᏏ, ᏆᏠᏆᏏ, ᎭᎻᏏ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏟ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᏣᏁᎭ.
\ft Salute Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermas, Patrobas, Hermes, and the brethren which are with them.

\ln Detsiyolilvha Qualolaga, ale Tsulia, Nilia, ale nasgi udo, ale Olimiqua, ale nanivquo unadanvti nasgi itsulaha tsaneha.
\syll ᏕᏥᏲᎵᎸᎭ ᏆᎶᎳᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᎵᎠ, ᏂᎵᎠ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏙ, ᎠᎴ ᎣᎵᎻᏆ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏂᎥᏉ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᏣᏁᎭ.
\ft Salute Philologus, and Julia, Nereus, and his sister, and Olympas, and all the saints which are with them.

\ln Itsvsv gesv detsadayolihesdi itsvdisgesdi galvquodiyu didadowedovhisdi gesvi.  Tsunanelodi dunadatluwadisv Galonedv tsutseliga wigetsiyoliha.
\syll ᎢᏨᏒ ᎨᏒ ᏕᏣᏓᏲᎵᎮᏍᏗ ᎢᏨᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᏗᏓᏙᏪᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.  ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᏚᎾᏓᏡᏩᏗᏒ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏧᏤᎵᎦ ᏫᎨᏥᏲᎵᎭ.
\ft Salute one another with an holy kiss. The churches of Christ salute you.

\ln Alewo idalinvtli, itsvsdiyediha ditsagasayasdodiyi digalenvdiyi ale udahnasqualosdiyi iyanvnehi, digatilvsdiyi dideyonvhi gesv nusdv itsadeloquavi; ale detsadanvehesdi.
\syll ᎠᎴᏬ ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᎢᏨᏍᏗᏰᏗᎭ ᏗᏣᎦᏌᏯᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏗᎦᎴᏅᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᎿᏍᏆᎶᏍᏗᏱ ᎢᏯᏅᏁᎯ, ᏗᎦᏘᎸᏍᏗᏱ ᏗᏕᏲᏅᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎢᏣᏕᎶᏆᎥᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᏕᏣᏓᏅᎡᎮᏍᏗ.
\ft Now I beseech you, brethren, mark them which cause divisions and offences contrary to the doctrine which ye have learned; and avoid them.

\ln Nasgiyeno iyunasdi vtla Ugvwiyuhi igatseli Tsisa Galonedv gohusdi yanadvneha, unvsvquosgini unisquoliyi; ale uwoduhi ale osdv gawonihisdi gesv anvdisgvi danilonuhesgo tsuninawi naneyatahvna.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗ ᎥᏝ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏯᎾᏛᏁᎭ, ᎤᏅᏒᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏂᏍᏉᎵᏱ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᏬᏚᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎦᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏅᏗᏍᎬᎢ ᏓᏂᎶᏄᎮᏍᎪ ᏧᏂᎾᏫ ᎾᏁᏯᏔᎲᎾ.
\ft For they that are such serve not our Lord Jesus Christ, but their own belly; and by good words and fair speeches deceive the hearts of the simple.

\ln Itsohiyusvyeno dunotsalotsv naniv yvwi anehvi.  Nasgi iyusdi galiheliga nihi gesv nvdigalisdodiha; asesgininonv aquaduliha itsigatanai itsalisdodiyi osdv gesv ugvwali, ano uyo gesv ugvwali nitsigatanavna.
\syll ᎢᏦᎯᏳᏒᏰᏃ ᏚᏃᏣᎶᏨ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏴᏫ ᎠᏁᎲᎢ.  ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎦᎵᎮᎵᎦ ᏂᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ; ᎠᏎᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎠᏆᏚᎵᎭ ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎾᎢ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ, ᎠᏃ ᎤᏲ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᏂᏥᎦᏔᎾᎥᎾ.
\ft For your obedience is come abroad unto all men. I am glad therefore on your behalf: but yet I would have you wise unto that which is good, and simple concerning evil.

\ln Ale Unelanvhi nvwadohiyadv adanehi nigohilvnaquo Sedani uwedawidodi nvdagalisdani ditsalasideni hawiniditlv.  Gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv igatseli Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv itseladidohesdi.  Emenv.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᎠᏓᏁᎯ ᏂᎪᎯᎸᎾᏉ ᏎᏓᏂ ᎤᏪᏓᏫᏙᏗ ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏓᏂ ᏗᏣᎳᏏᏕᏂ ᎭᏫᏂᏗᏢ.  ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎢᏤᎳᏗᏙᎮᏍᏗ.  ᎡᎺᏅ.
\ft And the God of peace shall bruise Satan under your feet shortly. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you. Amen.

\ln Dimadi itsulaha tsoginilvwisdanehi, ale Lusiya, ale Tsesani, ale Sosiqueda gohusdi diquvnv, wigetsiyoliga.
\syll ᏗᎹᏗ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᏦᎩᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎷᏏᏯ, ᎠᎴ ᏤᏌᏂ, ᎠᎴ ᏐᏏᏇᏓ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏗᏋᏅ, ᏫᎨᏥᏲᎵᎦ.
\ft Timotheus my workfellow, and Lucius, and Jason, and Sosipater, my kinsmen, salute you.

\ln Ayv dasiya, hia goweli aquawelanvhi witsvyoliga Ugvwiyuhi gesv nvdigalisdodiha.
\syll ᎠᏴ ᏓᏏᏯ, ᎯᎠ ᎪᏪᎵ ᎠᏆᏪᎳᏅᎯ ᏫᏨᏲᎵᎦ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ.
\ft I Tertius, who wrote this epistle, salute you in the Lord.

\ln Gaya agisquanigodisgi ale nanivquo tsunanelodi unadatlugv disquanigodisgi, witsiyoliga.  Ilasda, ayeli ehi gaduhv ahv agatiya, witsiyoliga, ale Quoda, idalinvtli.
\syll ᎦᏯ ᎠᎩᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏂᎥᏉ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬ ᏗᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗᏍᎩ, ᏫᏥᏲᎵᎦ.  ᎢᎳᏍᏓ, ᎠᏰᎵ ᎡᎯ ᎦᏚᎲ ᎠᎲ ᎠᎦᏘᏯ, ᏫᏥᏲᎵᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᏉᏓ, ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ.
\ft Gaius mine host, and of the whole church, saluteth you. Erastus the chamberlain of the city saluteth you, and Quartus a brother.

\ln Gvwagatiya udadosdi gesv igatseli Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv itseladidohesdi nitsivi.  Emenv.
\syll ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎢᏤᎳᏗᏙᎮᏍᏗ ᏂᏥᎥᎢ.  ᎡᎺᏅ.
\ft The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.

\ln Nasgino yeliquo ditsalinigohisdodi tsigi nasgiya nigawesgv osdv kanohedv aquatseliga, ale nasgiya Tsisa Galonedv agalitsidonvi, nasgiya gvnigesv igvnelvhi gesv udelidv, nasgi elohi tsudalenvhv nvdagvwadalenvdv adelistanvhi tsigesei,
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏰᎵᏉ ᏗᏣᎵᏂᎪᎯᏍᏙᏗ ᏥᎩ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎬ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎠᏆᏤᎵᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎠᎦᎵᏥᏙᏅᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᎬᏁᎸᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᎲ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎠᏕᎵᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᏥᎨᏎᎢ,
\ft Now to him that is of power to stablish you according to my gospel, and the preaching of Jesus Christ, according to the revelation of the mystery, which was kept secret since the world began,

\ln Gohisgini hnaquo gvnigesv igvnelvhi, ale anadolehosgi tsunowelanvhi digvtanvhi nasgiya adanvtesgv alisquadisgi nigesvna ehi Unelanvhi gvnigesv igegvlvhi nigadiyu tsunadalenvdv yvwi, nasgi gohiyudi gesv unohiyudiyi ugvwali^
\syll ᎪᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎿᏉ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᎬᏁᎸᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᏧᏃᏪᎳᏅᎯ ᏗᎬᏔᏅᎯ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎠᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ ᎠᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎡᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᎨᎬᎸᎯ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏃᎯᏳᏗᏱ ᎤᎬᏩᎵdata is invalid
\ft But now is made manifest, and by the scriptures of the prophets, according to the commandment of the everlasting God, made known to all nations for the obedience of faith:

\ln Unelanvhi uwasvhiyu agatanai tsigi, galvquododi gesesdi Tsisa Galonedv iyuwanisadv nigohilvi.  Emenv.
\syll ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏩᏒᎯᏳ ᎠᎦᏔᎾᎢ ᏥᎩ, ᎦᎸᏉᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ ᏂᎪᎯᎸᎢ.  ᎡᎺᏅ.
\ft To God only wise, be glory through Jesus Christ for ever. Amen.

\ln Quola, aquasuyedv aginvsidv Tsisa Galonedv, nasgiya Unelanvhi udanvtelvi, ale Sosdini iginvtli,
\syll ᏉᎳ, ᎠᏆᏑᏰᏛ ᎠᎩᏅᏏᏛ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏓᏅᏖᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏐᏍᏗᏂ ᎢᎩᏅᏟ,
\ft Paul, called to be an apostle of Jesus Christ through the will of God, and Sosthenes our brother,

\ln Witsvyowelasi ditsanelodi itsadatlugv Unelanvhi utseliga, nasgi Golinidiyi tsitsadatluga, nasgi itsisgana nigesvna iyetsvnelvhi Tsisa Galonedv iyuwanisadv, etsiyanvdv itsadanvti, ale naniv nigav degesadisv Tsisa Galonedv igatseli Ugvwiyuhi dudov anineisdisgi, nasgi itsulaquo nasgi unatseliga ale ayv igatseliga;
\syll ᏫᏨᏲᏪᎳᏏ ᏗᏣᏁᎶᏗ ᎢᏣᏓᏡᎬ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᎵᏂᏗᏱ ᏥᏣᏓᏡᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏥᏍᎦᎾ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᏰᏨᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ, ᎡᏥᏯᏅᏛ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏘ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏕᎨᏌᏗᏒ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏚᏙᎥ ᎠᏂᏁᎢᏍᏗᏍᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏧᎳᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴ ᎢᎦᏤᎵᎦ;
\ft Unto the church of God which is at Corinth, to them that are sanctified in Christ Jesus, called to be saints, with all that in every place call upon the name of Jesus Christ our Lord, both theirs and ours:

\ln Itsatseli gesesdi gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv ale nvwadohiyadv itsalisgolvtanelvhi Unelanvhi Igidoda, ale Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv.
\syll ᎢᏣᏤᎵ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏁᎸᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᎩᏙᏓ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ.
\ft Grace be unto you, and peace, from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.

\ln Nigohilv tsiyalielitseho Unelanvhi aquatseliga, nihi gesv iyusdi, nvdigalisdodisgo gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv Unelanvhi, nasgi Tsisa Galonedv iyuwanisadv etsinelvhi tsigi.
\syll ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᏥᏯᎵᎡᎵᏤᎰ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᏆᏤᎵᎦ, ᏂᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎪ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ ᎡᏥᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ.
\ft I thank my God always on your behalf, for the grace of God which is given you by Jesus Christ;

\ln Nasgi itsenvistanvhi tsigi nigav nudalesvi^nigav dideyodi gesv ale nigav adedovhisdi gesvi;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏤᏅᎢᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏄᏓᎴᏒᎢdata is invalidᏂᎦᎥ ᏗᏕᏲᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎠᏕᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ;
\ft That in every thing ye are enriched by him, in all utterance, and in all knowledge;

\ln Nasgiya Galonedv atsinohelv gagohiyudi netsvnelvi;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎠᏥᏃᎮᎸ ᎦᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᏁᏨᏁᎸᎢ;
\ft Even as the testimony of Christ was confirmed in you:

\ln Nasgi esga nitsohasgvna gesv sudalegi unv gvwagatiya udalisgolvdanedi gesvi; itsigatenohv uluhisdi gesv igatseli Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᏍᎦ ᏂᏦᎭᏍᎬᎾ ᎨᏒ ᏑᏓᎴᎩ ᎤᏅ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎢᏥᎦᏖᏃᎲ ᎤᎷᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ;
\ft So that ye come behind in no gift; waiting for the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ:

\ln Nasgi nasquo tsvdatsalinigohistani ulisquadisdi gesv gvdisgi, nasgi gayetsuisdodi nigesvna iyulisdodiyi nahiyu iga gesesdi Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv utseliga.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏨᏓᏣᎵᏂᎪᎯᏍᏔᏂ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏗᏍᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏰᏧᎢᏍᏙᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏀᎢᏳ ᎢᎦ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ.
\ft Who shall also confirm you unto the end, that ye may be blameless in the day of our Lord Jesus Christ.

\ln Unelanvhi nudalidasdvna, nasgi itsiyanvdv tsigi itsaligodiyi nasgi Uwetsi Tsisa Galonedv igatseli Ugvwiyuhi.
\syll ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏄᏓᎵᏓᏍᏛᎾ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏥᏯᏅᏛ ᏥᎩ ᎢᏣᎵᎪᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏪᏥ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ.
\ft God is faithful, by whom ye were called unto the fellowship of his Son Jesus Christ our Lord.

\ln Nasgino idalinvtli itsvtayoseha dudov gvdiha Ugvwiyuhi igatseliga Tsisa Galonedv, nasgi utloyiha itsineisdiyi, ale ditsagalenvdisgi nitsehvna iyulisdodiyi; ukalitsvhiquosgini ditsadudododiyi utloyiquo itsadanvtelidohvi, ale utloyiquo detsugodisgvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ ᎢᏨᏔᏲᏎᎭ ᏚᏙᎥ ᎬᏗᎭ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᎦᏤᎵᎦ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏠᏱᎭ ᎢᏥᏁᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏣᎦᎴᏅᏗᏍᎩ ᏂᏤᎲᎾ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ; ᎤᎧᎵᏨᎯᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᏗᏣᏚᏙᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᏠᏱᏉ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏖᎵᏙᎲᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏠᏱᏉ ᏕᏧᎪᏗᏍᎬᎢ.
\ft Now I beseech you, brethren, by the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that ye all speak the same thing, and that there be no divisions among you; but that ye be perfectly joined together in the same mind and in the same judgment.

\ln Vginonelvhiyeno igi idalinvtli nihi etsinohesgvi, nasgi Tloi dudatinav getsinohesgvi, nasgi ditsiyosdi gesv itsehvi.
\syll ᎥᎩᏃᏁᎸᎯᏰᏃ ᎢᎩ ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ ᏂᎯ ᎡᏥᏃᎮᏍᎬᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏠᎢ ᏚᏓᏘᎾᎥ ᎨᏥᏃᎮᏍᎬᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏥᏲᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏤᎲᎢ.
\ft For it hath been declared unto me of you, my brethren, by them which are of the house of Chloe, that there are contentions among you.

\ln Hia nasgi nitsiweha, nasgi itsisiyvwiha gesv hia nitsiwesgvi, ayv Quola tsiyaligonehi; ayvno Aquola; ayvno Siquasi; ayvno Galonedv.
\syll ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᏥᏪᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏥᏏᏴᏫᎭ ᎨᏒ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏥᏪᏍᎬᎢ, ᎠᏴ ᏉᎳ ᏥᏯᎵᎪᏁᎯ; ᎠᏴᏃ ᎠᏉᎳ; ᎠᏴᏃ ᏏᏆᏏ; ᎠᏴᏃ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ.
\ft Now this I say, that every one of you saith, I am of Paul; and I of Apollos; and I of Cephas; and I of Christ.

\ln Ilvsgisgo iyatsidvhi Galonedv?  Quolasgo dadahnawasdv agadvne itsisdelvdiyi?  alesgo Quola dudov detsawostanei?
\syll ᎢᎸᏍᎩᏍᎪ ᎢᏯᏥᏛᎯ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ?  ᏉᎳᏍᎪ ᏓᏓᎿᏩᏍᏛ ᎠᎦᏛᏁ ᎢᏥᏍᏕᎸᏗᏱ?  ᎠᎴᏍᎪ ᏉᎳ ᏚᏙᎥ ᏕᏣᏬᏍᏔᏁᎢ?
\ft Is Christ divided? was Paul crucified for you? or were ye baptized in the name of Paul?

\ln Unelanvhi tsiyalielitseha nigalisdodiha nasgi itsehv gilo nitsiyawovna gesv Tlisqua ale Gaya unvsv;
\syll ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏥᏯᎵᎡᎵᏤᎭ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏤᎲ ᎩᎶ ᏂᏥᏯᏬᎥᎾ ᎨᏒ ᏟᏍᏆ ᎠᎴ ᎦᏯ ᎤᏅᏒ;
\ft I thank God that I baptized none of you, but Crispus and Gaius;

\ln Giloyeno uwasvquo dudov dadawosdiha, yigvquoseha.
\syll ᎩᎶᏰᏃ ᎤᏩᏒᏉ ᏚᏙᎥ ᏓᏓᏬᏍᏗᎭ, ᏱᎬᏉᏎᎭ.
\ft Lest any should say that I had baptized in mine own name.

\ln Ale nasquo Sdiquena dudatinav degatsiyawovgi; nvwadaleno vtla yiquanvta tsiyawovi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏍᏗᏇᎾ ᏚᏓᏘᎾᎥ ᏕᎦᏥᏯᏬᎥᎩ; ᏅᏩᏓᎴᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏆᏅᏔ ᏥᏯᏬᎥᎢ.
\ft And I baptized also the household of Stephanas: besides, I know not whether I baptized any other.

\ln Galonedvyeno vtla yiginvse diquadawosdiyi, aqualitsidodiyisgini osdv kanohedv; vtla alisinahisdi gesv gawonihisdiyi aquvdodiyi, Galonedvyeno utseli tsudahnawadv asequoquo yinvgalisda.
\syll ᎦᎶᏁᏛᏰᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏱᎩᏅᏎ ᏗᏆᏓᏬᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᏆᎵᏥᏙᏗᏱᏍᎩᏂ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ; ᎥᏝ ᎠᎵᏏᏀᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎦᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᏋᏙᏗᏱ, ᎦᎶᏁᏛᏰᏃ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏧᏓᎿᏩᏛ ᎠᏎᏉᏉ ᏱᏅᎦᎵᏍᏓ.
\ft For Christ sent me not to baptize, but to preach the gospel: not with wisdom of words, lest the cross of Christ should be made of none effect.

\ln Dadahnawasdvyeno kanohedi gesv alisganedv uniyelvha nasgi na tsuniyohuhisdi tsigi; ayvsgini egisdelvdi tsigi Unelanvhi ulinigvgv igiyelvhi.
\syll ᏓᏓᎿᏩᏍᏛᏰᏃ ᎧᏃᎮᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎵᏍᎦᏁᏛ ᎤᏂᏰᎸᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏧᏂᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᏥᎩ; ᎠᏴᏍᎩᏂ ᎡᎩᏍᏕᎸᏗ ᏥᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎵᏂᎬᎬ ᎢᎩᏰᎸᎯ.
\ft For the preaching of the cross is to them that perish foolishness; but unto us which are saved it is the power of God.

\ln Hiayeno nigvnv igawela, datsidvtani anisinasv anisinasani, ale asequo nvdagatsiyvneli aneyatahi aneyatahvi.
\syll ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᏂᎬᏅ ᎢᎦᏪᎳ, ᏓᏥᏛᏔᏂ ᎠᏂᏏᎾᏒ ᎠᏂᏏᎾᏌᏂ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏎᏉ ᏅᏓᎦᏥᏴᏁᎵ ᎠᏁᏯᏔᎯ ᎠᏁᏯᏔᎲᎢ.
\ft For it is written, I will destroy the wisdom of the wise, and will bring to nothing the understanding of the prudent.

\ln Hatlv asinasani?  hatlv digowelisgi?  hatlv gawonisgv adisvhihi ani elohi ehi?  tlasgo Unelanvhi alisganedvquo yinuwanelv asinasanv elohi?
\syll ᎭᏢ ᎠᏏᎾᏌᏂ?  ᎭᏢ ᏗᎪᏪᎵᏍᎩ?  ᎭᏢ ᎦᏬᏂᏍᎬ ᎠᏗᏒᎯᎯ ᎠᏂ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎡᎯ?  ᏝᏍᎪ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎵᏍᎦᏁᏛᏉ ᏱᏄᏩᏁᎸ ᎠᏏᎾᏌᏅ ᎡᎶᎯ?
\ft Where is the wise? where is the scribe? where is the disputer of this world? hath not God made foolish the wisdom of this world?

\ln Unelanvhiyeno asinasaniyu gesv tsinuwanisane elohi anisinasanv anvdisgv Unelanvhi nigvwagatahvna tsigesei, Unelanvhi osi uyelvne alisganedv alitsidodi gesv uwvdodiyi tsusdelvdiyi anohiyuhvsgi.
\syll ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ ᎠᏏᎾᏌᏂᏳ ᎨᏒ ᏥᏄᏩᏂᏌᏁ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎠᏂᏏᎾᏌᏅ ᎠᏅᏗᏍᎬ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏂᎬᏩᎦᏔᎲᎾ ᏥᎨᏎᎢ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎣᏏ ᎤᏰᎸᏁ ᎠᎵᏍᎦᏁᏛ ᎠᎵᏥᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏮᏙᏗᏱ ᏧᏍᏕᎸᏗᏱ ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ.
\ft For after that in the wisdom of God the world by wisdom knew not God, it pleased God by the foolishness of preaching to save them that believe.

\ln Anitsusiyeno uyelvdv anitayohiha, Anigoino asinasaniyu gesv uniyoha;
\syll ᎠᏂᏧᏏᏰᏃ ᎤᏰᎸᏛ ᎠᏂᏔᏲᎯᎭ, ᎠᏂᎪᎢᏃ ᎠᏏᎾᏌᏂᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏂᏲᎭ;
\ft For the Jews require a sign, and the Greeks seek after wisdom:

\ln Ayvsgini Galonedv dadahnawasdv agadvnvhi otsalitsidohvsga, nasgi Anitsusi tsunodesdisgi, Anigoino alisganedv uniyelvhi;
\syll ᎠᏴᏍᎩᏂ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏓᏓᎿᏩᏍᏛ ᎠᎦᏛᏅᎯ ᎣᏣᎵᏥᏙᎲᏍᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᏧᏃᏕᏍᏗᏍᎩ, ᎠᏂᎪᎢᏃ ᎠᎵᏍᎦᏁᏛ ᎤᏂᏰᎸᎯ;
\ft But we preach Christ crucified, unto the Jews a stumblingblock, and unto the Greeks foolishness;

\ln Nasgini getsiyanvdv tsigi, itsulaquo Anitsusi ale Anigoi, Galonedv Unelanvhi ulinigidiyu gesv ale asinasaniyu gesv uniyelvhi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏥᏯᏅᏛ ᏥᎩ, ᎢᏧᎳᏉ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᎪᎢ, ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏏᎾᏌᏂᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏂᏰᎸᎯ.
\ft But unto them which are called, both Jews and Greeks, Christ the power of God, and the wisdom of God.

\ln Alisganedvyeno Unelanvhi utseli utli nasinahi esgaquo yvwi; ale awanagala gesv Unelanvhi utseli utli nulinigvga esgaquo yvwi.
\syll ᎠᎵᏍᎦᏁᏛᏰᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎤᏟ ᎾᏏᏀᎢ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᏴᏫ; ᎠᎴ ᎠᏩᎾᎦᎳ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎤᏟ ᏄᎵᏂᎬᎦ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᏴᏫ.
\ft Because the foolishness of God is wiser than men; and the weakness of God is stronger than men.

\ln Itsigowadihayeno, idalinvtli, nusdv etsiyanvhvi, nasgi vtla yunitsata anisinasani uquedali ugvwali gesvi, vtla ale yunitsata tsunalinigidv, vtla ale yunitsata getsilvquodi;
\syll ᎢᏥᎪᏩᏗᎭᏰᏃ, ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᏄᏍᏛ ᎡᏥᏯᏅᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎥᏝ ᏳᏂᏣᏔ ᎠᏂᏏᎾᏌᏂ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᏳᏂᏣᏔ ᏧᎾᎵᏂᎩᏛ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᏳᏂᏣᏔ ᎨᏥᎸᏉᏗ;
\ft For ye see your calling, brethren, how that not many wise men after the flesh, not many mighty, not many noble, are called:

\ln Unelanvhisgini dusuyesv unalisganisdv getsiyelvhi ane elohi, nasgi tsudehohisdodiyi anigatanai; ale Unelanvhi dusuyesv aniwanagala getsiyelvhi ani elohi, nasgi tsudehohisdodiyi tsunalinigidv;
\syll ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᏚᏑᏰᏒ ᎤᎾᎵᏍᎦᏂᏍᏛ ᎨᏥᏰᎸᎯ ᎠᏁ ᎡᎶᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏕᎰᎯᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎾᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏚᏑᏰᏒ ᎠᏂᏩᎾᎦᎳ ᎨᏥᏰᎸᎯ ᎠᏂ ᎡᎶᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏕᎰᎯᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏧᎾᎵᏂᎩᏛ;
\ft But God hath chosen the foolish things of the world to confound the wise; and God hath chosen the weak things of the world to confound the things which are mighty;

\ln Ale esga unohadv ani elohi, ale nvlisali getsiyelvhi Unelanvhi dusuyesv, ale nasgi nanehvna gesvi, nasgi asequoquo iyunalisdodiyi nasgi tsaneha;
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎡᏍᎦ ᎤᏃᎭᏛ ᎠᏂ ᎡᎶᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏅᎵᏌᎵ ᎨᏥᏰᎸᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏚᏑᏰᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏁᎲᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏎᏉᏉ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏣᏁᎭ;
\ft And base things of the world, and things which are despised, hath God chosen, yea, and things which are not, to bring to nought things that are:

\ln Nasgi gilo uquedali gesv utlvquisdiyi nigesvna nasgi agatahvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏢᏈᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎦᏔᎲᎢ.
\ft That no flesh should glory in his presence.

\ln Nihisgini nasgi itsinanugowisvhi igi, Tsisa Galonedv iyuwanisadv, nasgi agadovhisdi gesv ale duyugodv gesv ale nasganvna igvnedi gesv, ale aguyvdodi gesv, ayv igvnelvhi tsigi Unelanvhi;
\syll ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏥᎾᏄᎪᏫᏒᎯ ᎢᎩ, ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎦᏅᎾ ᎢᎬᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎫᏴᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ, ᎠᏴ ᎢᎬᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ;
\ft But of him are ye in Christ Jesus, who of God is made unto us wisdom, and righteousness, and sanctification, and redemption:

\ln Nasgiya hia tsinigvnv tsigowela, Gilo atlvquisgesdi Yihowa atlvquasdodisgesdi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᎬᏅ ᏥᎪᏪᎳ, ᎩᎶ ᎠᏢᏈᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏱᎰᏩ ᎠᏢᏆᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
\ft That, according as it is written, He that glorieth, let him glory in the Lord.

\ln Ale ayv idalinvtli, witsvlutselv, vtla osani gawonihisdi gesv ale agadovhisdi gesv yitsvluhisdanelei, itsvnonehv gohiyudisgi Unelanvhi utseliga.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴ ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᏫᏨᎷᏤᎸ, ᎥᏝ ᎣᏌᏂ ᎦᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏱᏨᎷᎯᏍᏓᏁᎴᎢ, ᎢᏨᏃᏁᎲ ᎪᎯᏳᏗᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ.
\ft And I, brethren, when I came to you, came not with excellency of speech or of wisdom, declaring unto you the testimony of God.

\ln Daquugotanvgiyeno nasgi gohusdi agigadovhisdiyi nigesvna nihi itsehv, uwasvhiyu Tsisa Galonedv ale nasgi dadahnawasdv agadvnvhi.
\syll ᏓᏊᎪᏔᏅᎩᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎠᎩᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏤᎲ, ᎤᏩᏒᎯᏳ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏓᏓᎿᏩᏍᏛ ᎠᎦᏛᏅᎯ.
\ft For I determined not to know any thing among you, save Jesus Christ, and him crucified.

\ln Ale tsiwanagalvi, ale tsinayesgvi, ale utsati aginawisgv itsvyeladidohvgi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏥᏩᎾᎦᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᎾᏰᏍᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎠᎩᎾᏫᏍᎬ ᎢᏨᏰᎳᏗᏙᎲᎩ.
\ft And I was with you in weakness, and in fear, and in much trembling.

\ln Ale tsiwonisgv ale galitsidohvsgvi vtla yvwi utseli adasdiyedisgi agadovgosdi gesv yigvdisgei, Adanvdosgini ale ulinigidi gesv nudlasidvsvna nigvnehvi;
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏥᏬᏂᏍᎬ ᎠᎴ ᎦᎵᏥᏙᎲᏍᎬᎢ ᎥᏝ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎠᏓᏍᏗᏰᏗᏍᎩ ᎠᎦᏙᎥᎪᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏱᎬᏗᏍᎨᎢ, ᎠᏓᏅᏙᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏄᏜᏏᏛᏒᎾ ᏂᎬᏁᎲᎢ;
\ft And my speech and my preaching was not with enticing words of man's wisdom, but in demonstration of the Spirit and of power:

\ln Nasgi itsohiyusv yvwi anigatahnavi nulisgasdodvna iyulisdodiyi, Unelanvhisgi ulinigidiyu gesvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏦᎯᏳᏒ ᏴᏫ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎿᎥᎢ ᏄᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏛᎾ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏍᎩ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft That your faith should not stand in the wisdom of men, but in the power of God.

\ln Agadovhisdisgininonv gesv otsvdisgo otsiwonihi gohusdi nunilulotsehvna; vtla adina elohi utseli agadovhisdi gesvi, vtla ale unigvwiyuhi elohi anehi unatseliga, nasgi asequoquo igalisdisgi tsigi.
\syll ᎠᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎨᏒ ᎣᏨᏗᏍᎪ ᎣᏥᏬᏂᎯ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏄᏂᎷᎶᏤᎲᎾ; ᎥᏝ ᎠᏗᎾ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎠᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎠᏁᎯ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏎᏉᏉ ᎢᎦᎵᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᏥᎩ.
\ft Howbeit we speak wisdom among them that are perfect: yet not the wisdom of this world, nor of the princes of this world, that come to nought:

\ln Ayvsgini otsiwonisgo otsvdisgo agadovhisdi gesv Unelanvhi utseliga, udelidv gesvi, nasgi gvsgali, nasgi iyulisdodiyi tsiduwugotane Unelanvhi elohi asi nigesvna tsigesei, tsugvwale ayv egilvquododiyi.
\syll ᎠᏴᏍᎩᏂ ᎣᏥᏬᏂᏍᎪ ᎣᏨᏗᏍᎪ ᎠᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏍᎦᎵ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏥᏚᏭᎪᏔᏁ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎠᏏ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏥᎨᏎᎢ, ᏧᎬᏩᎴ ᎠᏴ ᎡᎩᎸᏉᏙᏗᏱ.
\ft But we speak the wisdom of God in a mystery, even the hidden wisdom, which God ordained before the world unto our glory:

\ln Nasgi vtla gilo digeganelodi elohi anehi yinigatahei; yianigataheyeno vtla galvquodiyu Ugvwiyuhi dadahnawasdv yigvwanadvnei;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᏗᎨᎦᏁᎶᏗ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎠᏁᎯ ᏱᏂᎦᏔᎮᎢ; ᏱᎠᏂᎦᏔᎮᏰᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏓᏓᎿᏩᏍᏛ ᏱᎬᏩᎾᏛᏁᎢ;
\ft Which none of the princes of this world knew: for had they known it, they would not have crucified the Lord of glory.

\ln Nasgiyasgini hia tsinigvnv tsigowela, Gilo ugohvhi nigesvna, ale udvganvhi nigesvna, ale yvwi unawiyi uyvlvhi nigesvna, nasgi nusdv Unelanvhi dudvnvisdanelv nasgi gvwageyuhi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏯᏍᎩᏂ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᎬᏅ ᏥᎪᏪᎳ, ᎩᎶ ᎤᎪᎲᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏛᎦᏅᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᏴᏫ ᎤᎾᏫᏱ ᎤᏴᎸᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏚᏛᏅᎢᏍᏓᏁᎸ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏩᎨᏳᎯ.
\ft But as it is written, Eye hath not seen, nor ear heard, neither have entered into the heart of man, the things which God hath prepared for them that love him.

\ln Aseno Unelanvhi gvnigesv nigvnelv Udanvdo uwvtanv; Adanvdoyeno nigav tsudalenvdv agoliyesgoi, nasquo gvsgali gesv Unelanvhi utseliga.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᎬᏁᎸ ᎤᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᏮᏔᏅ; ᎠᏓᏅᏙᏰᏃ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎠᎪᎵᏰᏍᎪᎢ, ᎾᏍᏉ ᎬᏍᎦᎵ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ.
\ft But God hath revealed them unto us by his Spirit: for the Spirit searcheth all things, yea, the deep things of God.

\ln Gagoyeno iyusdi yvwi tsudalenvdv yvwi tsutseliga agataha?  uwasvquosgini yvwi udanvdo nasgi tsuyaa.  Nasgiya nasquo tsudalenvdv Unelanvhi tsutseliga vtla gilo yagataha, Unelanvhi Udanvdo uwasv.
\syll ᎦᎪᏰᏃ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏴᏫ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᏧᏤᎵᎦ ᎠᎦᏔᎭ?  ᎤᏩᏒᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏓᏅᏙ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏯᎠ.  ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᏤᎵᎦ ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᏯᎦᏔᎭ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᏩᏒ.
\ft For what man knoweth the things of a man, save the spirit of man which is in him? even so the things of God knoweth no man, but the Spirit of God.

\ln Ale ayv vtla adanvdo elohi ehi yidogadanilvtsv, Adanvdosgini Unelanvhiyi nvdayudalenvhi, nasgi ogigadovhisdiyi nasgi gvwagatiya oginelvhi gesv Unelanvhi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴ ᎥᏝ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎡᎯ ᏱᏙᎦᏓᏂᎸᏨ, ᎠᏓᏅᏙᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏱ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᎩᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎣᎩᏁᎸᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ.
\ft Now we have received, not the spirit of the world, but the spirit which is of God; that we might know the things that are freely given to us of God.

\ln Nasgi nasquo otsinohesgoi, vtla yotsvdisgo gawonihisdi yvwi utseli agadovhisdi gesv tsudeyonvhi, Galvquotiyusgini Adanvdo tsudeyonvhi; adanvdo ulisgolvtanvhi gvnigesv nidotsvneho adanvdo unehi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎣᏥᏃᎮᏍᎪᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᏲᏨᏗᏍᎪ ᎦᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎠᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏧᏕᏲᏅᎯ, ᎦᎸᏉᏘᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᏧᏕᏲᏅᎯ; ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏅᎯ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᏙᏨᏁᎰ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᏁᎯ.
\ft Which things also we speak, not in the words which man's wisdom teacheth, but which the Holy Ghost teacheth; comparing spiritual things with spiritual.

\ln Yvwisgini udanetliyvdv nigesvna gesv vtla yidadanilvgo Unelanvhi Udanvdo ulisgolvtanvhi; alisganedvquoyeno duyelvsoi; vtla ale digvwolisdi yigesoi, nvdigalisdodisgo adanvdo gvdi digvgowadvdi gesvi.
\syll ᏴᏫᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏓᏁᏟᏴᏛ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏓᏓᏂᎸᎪ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏅᎯ; ᎠᎵᏍᎦᏁᏛᏉᏰᏃ ᏚᏰᎸᏐᎢ; ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎬᏬᎵᏍᏗ ᏱᎨᏐᎢ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎪ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎬᏗ ᏗᎬᎪᏩᏛᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft But the natural man receiveth not the things of the Spirit of God: for they are foolishness unto him: neither can he know them, because they are spiritually discerned.

\ln Nasgini adanvdo uwehi nigav agowatisgoi, aseno uwasv nusdv vtla gilo yugowatisgoi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᏪᎯ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎠᎪᏩᏘᏍᎪᎢ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᏳᎪᏩᏘᏍᎪᎢ.
\ft But he that is spiritual judgeth all things, yet he himself is judged of no man.

\ln Gagoge ugadovso Yihowa udanvdvi, nasgi yeli gvweyodi igvwalisdodi?  ayvsgini Galonedv udanvdv igeha.
\syll ᎦᎪᎨ ᎤᎦᏙᎥᏐ ᏱᎰᏩ ᎤᏓᏅᏛᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏰᎵ ᎬᏪᏲᏗ ᎢᎬᏩᎵᏍᏙᏗ?  ᎠᏴᏍᎩᏂ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏓᏅᏛ ᎢᎨᎭ.
\ft For who hath known the mind of the Lord, that he may instruct him? But we have the mind of Christ.

\ln Ale ayv, idalinvtli, vtla adanvdo tsunatinidohi nasgiya getsvwonedodi yigesei, uquedaliquosgini tsunatinidohi nasgiyai, nasgiyaquo tsunasdi diniyoli Galonedv dunadudadv gesvi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴ, ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᏧᎾᏘᏂᏙᎯ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎨᏨᏬᏁᏙᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ, ᎤᏇᏓᎵᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᏧᎾᏘᏂᏙᎯ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯᏉ ᏧᎾᏍᏗ ᏗᏂᏲᎵ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏚᎾᏚᏓᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft And I, brethren, could not speak unto you as unto spiritual, but as unto carnal, even as unto babes in Christ.

\ln Unvdi itsvyelasdisgvgi vtlano gohusdi agisdi; tsuwagutanvsvyeno vtla yeli getsigisdi yigesei, ale gohi gesv vtla asi yeli yigi.
\syll ᎤᏅᏗ ᎢᏨᏰᎳᏍᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᎥᏝᏃ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎠᎩᏍᏗ; ᏧᏩᎫᏔᏅᏒᏰᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏰᎵ ᎨᏥᎩᏍᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎥᏝ ᎠᏏ ᏰᎵ ᏱᎩ.
\ft I have fed you with milk, and not with meat: for hitherto ye were not able to bear it, neither yet now are ye able.

\ln Asiquoyeno uquedali detsatinidoha; nasgiyeno tsitseha advyugedi gesvi, ale adisvsdi gesvi, ale ilvsdi iyadadisdi gesvi, tlasgo uquedali itsatinidohi yigi, ale yvwiquo unedasdi nasgiya yitsadoha?
\syll ᎠᏏᏉᏰᏃ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᏕᏣᏘᏂᏙᎭ; ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᏥᏤᎭ ᎠᏛᏳᎨᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏗᏒᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᎸᏍᏗ ᎢᏯᏓᏗᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏝᏍᎪ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎢᏣᏘᏂᏙᎯ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏴᏫᏉ ᎤᏁᏓᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏱᏣᏙᎭ?
\ft For ye are yet carnal: for whereas there is among you envying, and strife, and divisions, are ye not carnal, and walk as men?

\ln Asiyvwiyeno hia tsinigawesgoi, ayv Quola tsiyaligonehi, nvwadaleno, ayv Aquola tsiyaligonehi; tlasgo uquedali ditsatinidohi yigi?
\syll ᎠᏏᏴᏫᏰᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᎦᏪᏍᎪᎢ, ᎠᏴ ᏉᎳ ᏥᏯᎵᎪᏁᎯ, ᏅᏩᏓᎴᏃ, ᎠᏴ ᎠᏉᎳ ᏥᏯᎵᎪᏁᎯ; ᏝᏍᎪ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᏗᏣᏘᏂᏙᎯ ᏱᎩ?
\ft For while one saith, I am of Paul; and another, I am of Apollos; are ye not carnal?

\ln Gagogeno iyusdi Quola, ale Aquola gago?  tlasgo getsinvsidasdiquo yigi, nasgi iyunvnisadv tsitsohiyunvgi, nasgiya Ugvwiyuhi anisiyvwiha dunelvi?
\syll ᎦᎪᎨᏃ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏉᎳ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏉᎳ ᎦᎪ?  ᏝᏍᎪ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗᏉ ᏱᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏅᏂᏌᏛ ᏥᏦᎯᏳᏅᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᏂᏏᏴᏫᎭ ᏚᏁᎸᎢ?
\ft Who then is Paul, and who is Apollos, but ministers by whom ye believed, even as the Lord gave to every man?

\ln Ayv agiwisvgi, Aquola ama usdutlvgi; Unelanvhisgini unequoisdiyi nuwanelvgi.
\syll ᎠᏴ ᎠᎩᏫᏒᎩ, ᎠᏉᎳ ᎠᎹ ᎤᏍᏚᏢᎩ; ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏁᏉᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᏄᏩᏁᎸᎩ.
\ft I have planted, Apollos watered; but God gave the increase.

\ln Nasgino na awisgi vtla gohusdi yigi, na ale ama asdutlisgi, Unelanvhisgini unequoisdiyi igvnehi tsigi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ Ꮎ ᎠᏫᏍᎩ ᎥᏝ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏱᎩ, Ꮎ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎹ ᎠᏍᏚᏟᏍᎩ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏁᏉᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎢᎬᏁᎯ ᏥᎩ.
\ft So then neither is he that planteth any thing, neither he that watereth; but God that giveth the increase.

\ln Nasgino na awisgi ale na ama asdutlisgi saquoquo nanalisdiha; ale naniv anisiyvwiha gegaguyvedi gesesdi unatseligaya gegaguyvdanedi gesv, nasgiya nusdv unvsv deunilvwisdanelvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ Ꮎ ᎠᏫᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ Ꮎ ᎠᎹ ᎠᏍᏚᏟᏍᎩ ᏌᏉᏉ ᎾᎾᎵᏍᏗᎭ; ᎠᎴ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎠᏂᏏᏴᏫᎭ ᎨᎦᎫᏴᎡᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦᏯ ᎨᎦᎫᏴᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎤᏅᏒ ᏕᎤᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸᎢ.
\ft Now he that planteth and he that watereth are one: and every man shall receive his own reward according to his own labour.

\ln Ayvyeno Unelanvhi itsulaha tsogilvwisdanehi, nihi Unelanvhi ulogesvi, nihi Unelanvhi unesgehvhi.
\syll ᎠᏴᏰᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᏦᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ, ᏂᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎶᎨᏒᎢ, ᏂᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏁᏍᎨᎲᎯ.
\ft For we are labourers together with God: ye are God's husbandry, ye are God's building.

\ln Nasgiya Unelanvhi gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv ayv vginelvi, nasgiya asinasani nugvwiyusv dinesgesgi iyudvnedi naquadvnelv gagusdvdi aginv, nvwadaleno nahna unesgehv.  Aseno naniv gilo aneyatahesdi nusdv ananesgesgv nahnani.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏴ ᎥᎩᏁᎸᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎠᏏᎾᏌᏂ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᏗᏁᏍᎨᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏛᏁᏗ ᎾᏆᏛᏁᎸ ᎦᎫᏍᏛᏗ ᎠᎩᏅ, ᏅᏩᏓᎴᏃ ᏀᎾ ᎤᏁᏍᎨᎲ.  ᎠᏎᏃ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎩᎶ ᎠᏁᏯᏔᎮᏍᏗ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎠᎾᏁᏍᎨᏍᎬ ᏀᎾᏂ.
\ft According to the grace of God which is given unto me, as a wise masterbuilder, I have laid the foundation, and another buildeth thereon. But let every man take heed how he buildeth thereupon.

\ln Nvwadaleyeno gagusdvdi vtla gilo gvwadi yigi nasgi uwasv gayula anvhi tsigi, nasgi Tsisa Galonedv tsigi.
\syll ᏅᏩᏓᎴᏰᏃ ᎦᎫᏍᏛᏗ ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᎬᏩᏗ ᏱᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎦᏳᎳ ᎠᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏥᎩ.
\ft For other foundation can no man lay than that is laid, which is Jesus Christ.

\ln Nasgino iyu gilo nasgi hia gagusdvdihi yutlanv, adelv dalonige yunesgetanv, adelv unegv, digalvquodi nvya, ada, kanesga, asgudesvhi ulinohiyvhi,
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎢᏳ ᎩᎶ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎦᎫᏍᏛᏗᎯ ᏳᏝᏅ, ᎠᏕᎸ ᏓᎶᏂᎨ ᏳᏁᏍᎨᏔᏅ, ᎠᏕᎸ ᎤᏁᎬ, ᏗᎦᎸᏉᏗ ᏅᏯ, ᎠᏓ, ᎧᏁᏍᎦ, ᎠᏍᎫᏕᏒᎯ ᎤᎵᏃᎯᏴᎯ,
\ft Now if any man build upon this foundation gold, silver, precious stones, wood, hay, stubble;

\ln Naniv yvwi dunilvwisdanelv gvnigesv igvnedi gesesdi; nahiyuyeno unanugowisdi gesesdi; ale atsilv ugoliyedi gesesdi naniv yvwi dunilvwisdanelv iyusdi nasgi gesvi.
\syll ᎾᏂᎥ ᏴᏫ ᏚᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᎬᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᏀᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏫᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᎠᎴ ᎠᏥᎸ ᎤᎪᎵᏰᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏴᏫ ᏚᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Every man's work shall be made manifest: for the day shall declare it, because it shall be revealed by fire; and the fire shall try every man's work of what sort it is.

\ln Iyuno gilo dulvwisdanelv yinegvwasdiquo nahna unesgehvi, nasgi agaguyvedi gesesdi.
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸ ᏱᏁᎬᏩᏍᏗᏉ ᏀᎾ ᎤᏁᏍᎨᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎦᎫᏴᎡᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft If any man's work abide which he hath built thereupon, he shall receive a reward.

\ln Iyuno gilo dulvwisdanelv yagohvstanv, nasgi uyohusehesdi; uwasvsgini atsisdelvdi gesesdi; aseno atsilv tsatsisdelvtano nasgiyai.
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸ ᏯᎪᎲᏍᏔᏅ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏲᎱᏎᎮᏍᏗ; ᎤᏩᏒᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏥᏍᏕᎸᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᏥᎸ ᏣᏥᏍᏕᎸᏔᏃ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ.
\ft If any man's work shall be burned, he shall suffer loss: but he himself shall be saved; yet so as by fire.

\ln Tlasgo yitsigataha nihi Unelanvhi ganelv gesvi, ale nasgi Unelanvhi Udanvdo itsiyavi?
\syll ᏝᏍᎪ ᏱᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᏂᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎦᏁᎸ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏓᏅᏙ ᎢᏥᏯᎥᎢ?
\ft Know ye not that ye are the temple of God, and that the Spirit of God dwelleth in you?

\ln Iyuno gilo yuyostanv Unelanvhi ganelvi, nasgi Unelanvhi dayuyostani; Unelanvhiyeno ganelv galvquodiyu, nasgina nihi tsigi.
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᏳᏲᏍᏔᏅ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎦᏁᎸᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏓᏳᏲᏍᏔᏂ; ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ ᎦᏁᎸ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ, ᎾᏍᎩᎾ ᏂᎯ ᏥᎩ.
\ft If any man defile the temple of God, him shall God destroy; for the temple of God is holy, which temple ye are.

\ln Tlesdi gilo uwasv tsiadalidastani.  Iyuno gilo nihi itsehvi agatahnai yinvwasdi ani elohi gesvi, nasgi unegu winigalisda, nasgi agatahnai iyulisdodiyi.
\syll ᏞᏍᏗ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏥᎠᏓᎵᏓᏍᏔᏂ.  ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏤᎲᎢ ᎠᎦᏔᎿᎢ ᏱᏅᏩᏍᏗ ᎠᏂ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎫ ᏫᏂᎦᎵᏍᏓ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎦᏔᎿᎢ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
\ft Let no man deceive himself. If any man among you seemeth to be wise in this world, let him become a fool, that he may be wise.

\ln Agadovhisdiyeno gesv ani elohi ehi alisganedvquo Unelanvhi adanvtesgvi; hiayeno nigvnv igowela, Deganiyiha anigatahnai gvdiha unvsv anisinasanvi.
\syll ᎠᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗᏰᏃ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏂ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎡᎯ ᎠᎵᏍᎦᏁᏛᏉ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬᎢ; ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᏂᎬᏅ ᎢᎪᏪᎳ, ᏕᎦᏂᏱᎭ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎿᎢ ᎬᏗᎭ ᎤᏅᏒ ᎠᏂᏏᎾᏌᏅᎢ.
\ft For the wisdom of this world is foolishness with God. For it is written, He taketh the wise in their own craftiness.

\ln Alewo, Yihowa agataha anadanvtesgv anigatahnai, nasgi asequoquo gesvi.
\syll ᎠᎴᏬ, ᏱᎰᏩ ᎠᎦᏔᎭ ᎠᎾᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎿᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏎᏉᏉ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft And again, The Lord knoweth the thoughts of the wise, that they are vain.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi tlesdi gilo yvwiquo yidatlvquasdodisgesdi; nigadiyuyeno tsudalenvdv itsatseliga;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎩᎶ ᏴᏫᏉ ᏱᏓᏢᏆᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ; ᏂᎦᏗᏳᏰᏃ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎢᏣᏤᎵᎦ;
\ft Therefore let no man glory in men. For all things are yours;

\ln Nasquo quola yigi, ale Aquola, ale Siquasi, ale elohi, ale gvnidv, ale ayohuhisdi, ale gohusdi gohi gesv, ale gohusdi asi tsigesesdi; nigadiyu itsatseliga;
\syll ᎾᏍᏉ ᏉᎳ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏉᎳ, ᎠᎴ ᏏᏆᏏ, ᎠᎴ ᎡᎶᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎠᏏ ᏥᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᎢᏣᏤᎵᎦ;
\ft Whether Paul, or Apollos, or Cephas, or the world, or life, or death, or things present, or things to come; all are yours;

\ln Ale nihi Galonedv tsutseliga; Galonedvno Unelanvhi utseliga.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏂᎯ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏧᏤᎵᎦ; ᎦᎶᏁᏛᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ.
\ft And ye are Christ's; and Christ is God's.

\ln Naniv gilo gogadanvtesgv Galonedv oginvsidasdi nasgiya gogadanvtesgesdi, ale ogagasayasdidegi udelidv gesv Unelanvhi utseliga.
\syll ᎾᏂᎥ ᎩᎶ ᎪᎦᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎣᎩᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎪᎦᏓᏅᏖᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎣᎦᎦᏌᏯᏍᏗᏕᎩ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ.
\ft Let a man so account of us, as of the ministers of Christ, and stewards of the mysteries of God.

\ln Ale nasquo unagasayasdidegi udugi gegvso duyugodv iyunadvnediyi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᎾᎦᏌᏯᏍᏗᏕᎩ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎨᎬᏐ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᏁᏗᏱ.
\ft Moreover it is required in stewards, that a man be found faithful.

\ln Ayvsgini gadanvtesgv nvlisaliquo nihi disgiyugodanediyi, ale awiquo tsuwugododi gesvi; vv, vtla aquvsv yidigadadugodaneha;
\syll ᎠᏴᏍᎩᏂ ᎦᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ ᏅᎵᏌᎵᏉ ᏂᎯ ᏗᏍᎩᏳᎪᏓᏁᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏫᏉ ᏧᏭᎪᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎥᎥ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᏋᏒ ᏱᏗᎦᏓᏚᎪᏓᏁᎭ;
\ft But with me it is a very small thing that I should be judged of you, or of man's judgment: yea, I judge not mine own self.

\ln Vtlayeno gohusdi yitsigataha aquvsv aquadalawisedi; aseno vtla nasgi yaquudaleha; Ugvwiyuhisgini nasgi diquugodanehi.
\syll ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏱᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᎠᏋᏒ ᎠᏆᏓᎳᏫᏎᏗ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏯᏊᏓᎴᎭ; ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏊᎪᏓᏁᎯ.
\ft For I know nothing by myself; yet am I not hereby justified: but he that judgeth me is the Lord.

\ln Nasgisgini iyusdi tlesdi ditsugotanvgi asiquo nusqualvhvna, gvni Ugvwiyuhi galutsvha, nasgi iga gadv tsidodagananugowisi ulisigv digvsgali tsigi, ale gvnigesv nidodagvneli tsuninawiyi nusdv dunadanvtelvi; hnaquono naniv getsilvquododi gesv Unelanvhiyi nvdayudalenvhi gesesdi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏗᏧᎪᏔᏅᎩ ᎠᏏᏉ ᏄᏍᏆᎸᎲᎾ, ᎬᏂ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎦᎷᏨᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎦ ᎦᏛ ᏥᏙᏓᎦᎾᏄᎪᏫᏏ ᎤᎵᏏᎬ ᏗᎬᏍᎦᎵ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᏙᏓᎬᏁᎵ ᏧᏂᎾᏫᏱ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏚᎾᏓᏅᏖᎸᎢ; ᎿᏉᏃ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎨᏥᎸᏉᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏱ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft Therefore judge nothing before the time, until the Lord come, who both will bring to light the hidden things of darkness, and will make manifest the counsels of the hearts: and then shall every man have praise of God.

\ln Ali nasgi hia tsudalenvdv, idalinvtli, degatlilosdisgv aquvsv gadaneisda ale Aquola tsineisda nihi gesv nvdigalisdodiha; nasgi sgiyadeloquaediyi itsadanvtesgv itsilosvsdodiyi nigesvna nigvnv gowelvi, nasgi gilo utlvquisdiyi nigesvna asiyvwi galvquodisgv nvwadaleno atludisgvi.
\syll ᎠᎵ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ, ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᏕᎦᏟᎶᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᎠᏋᏒ ᎦᏓᏁᎢᏍᏓ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏉᎳ ᏥᏁᎢᏍᏓ ᏂᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᏍᎩᏯᏕᎶᏆᎡᏗᏱ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ ᎢᏥᎶᏒᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏂᎬᏅ ᎪᏪᎸᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏢᏈᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏍᎬ ᏅᏩᏓᎴᏃ ᎠᏡᏗᏍᎬᎢ.
\ft And these things, brethren, I have in a figure transferred to myself and to Apollos for your sakes; that ye might learn in us not to think of men above that which is written, that no one of you be puffed up for one against another.

\ln Gagoge nvwadale nitsvnelv?  ale gado tsaha nasgi netsanelvna gesvi?  iyuno etsanelvhi yigi, gadono ihatlvquisga netsanelvnaquo tsigeso nasgiyai?
\syll ᎦᎪᎨ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᏂᏨᏁᎸ?  ᎠᎴ ᎦᏙ ᏣᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏁᏣᏁᎸᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ?  ᎢᏳᏃ ᎡᏣᏁᎸᎯ ᏱᎩ, ᎦᏙᏃ ᎢᎭᏢᏈᏍᎦ ᏁᏣᏁᎸᎾᏉ ᏥᎨᏐ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ?
\ft For who maketh thee to differ from another? and what hast thou that thou didst not receive? now if thou didst receive it, why dost thou glory, as if thou hadst not received it?

\ln Hnaquo itsikalitsvhi, hnaquo itsehnaiyu, itsigvwiyuhi gesvi ayv nitsvyaligonelvna, ale yohi udohiyuhi itsigvwiyuhi yigi, ayv nasquo itsulaha igigvwiyuhi iyulisdodiyi.
\syll ᎿᏉ ᎢᏥᎧᎵᏨᎯ, ᎿᏉ ᎢᏤᎿᎢᏳ, ᎢᏥᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ ᎠᏴ ᏂᏨᏯᎵᎪᏁᎸᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᏲᎯ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎢᏥᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎢᎩᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
\ft Now ye are full, now ye are rich, ye have reigned as kings without us: and I would to God ye did reign, that we also might reign with you.

\ln Gadanvtesgvyeno Unelanvhi gvnigesv nogvnelv ayv oginvsidv oniyi gesvi, tsogiyohuhisdiyi nasgiyai; digogakanodiyeno nogalistanv elohi ale dinikahnawadidohi ale yvwi.
\syll ᎦᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬᏰᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏃᎬᏁᎸ ᎠᏴ ᎣᎩᏅᏏᏛ ᎣᏂᏱ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏦᎩᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ; ᏗᎪᎦᎧᏃᏗᏰᏃ ᏃᎦᎵᏍᏔᏅ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏂᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏴᏫ.
\ft For I think that God hath set forth us the apostles last, as it were appointed to death: for we are made a spectacle unto the world, and to angels, and to men.

\ln Oginegu ayv Galonedv gesv nvdigalisdodiha, nihisgini itsigatahnai Galonedv gesv nvdigalisdodiha; tsotsiwanagala ayv, nihisgini ditsalinigidiyu; etsilvquodiyu nihi, ayvsgini oginiquatihi.
\syll ᎣᎩᏁᎫ ᎠᏴ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ, ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎿᎢ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ; ᏦᏥᏩᎾᎦᎳ ᎠᏴ, ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᏗᏣᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ; ᎡᏥᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᏂᎯ, ᎠᏴᏍᎩᏂ ᎣᎩᏂᏆᏘᎯ.
\ft We are fools for Christ's sake, but ye are wise in Christ; we are weak, but ye are strong; ye are honourable, but we are despised.

\ln Gohi gesv iyasdi, agonu dogiyosiha, ale dogitadegiha, ale tsogiyelvsai, ale asquinv dogvnisdiha, ale ilvhitlv ogenvsv nigesvna;
\syll ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏯᏍᏗ, ᎠᎪᏄ ᏙᎩᏲᏏᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᏙᎩᏔᏕᎩᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᏦᎩᏰᎸᏌᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏍᏈᏅ ᏙᎬᏂᏍᏗᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᎸᎯᏢ ᎣᎨᏅᏒ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ;
\ft Even unto this present hour we both hunger, and thirst, and are naked, and are buffeted, and have no certain dwellingplace;

\ln Ale asdaya dogilvwisdanehoi, ogvsv tsogoyeni dotsvdisgo gohusdi otsadvnehoi.  Gayogisotlvdisgv osdv dotsinetsehoi; uyo nogvnehv unelagi otselisgoi;
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎠᏍᏓᏯ ᏙᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎰᎢ, ᎣᎬᏒ ᏦᎪᏰᏂ ᏙᏨᏗᏍᎪ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎣᏣᏛᏁᎰᎢ.  ᎦᏲᎩᏐᏢᏗᏍᎬ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏙᏥᏁᏤᎰᎢ; ᎤᏲ ᏃᎬᏁᎲ ᎤᏁᎳᎩ ᎣᏤᎵᏍᎪᎢ;
\ft And labour, working with our own hands: being reviled, we bless; being persecuted, we suffer it:

\ln Oginohesgvi, otsitayohihoquo; uneilvdi elohi ehi nasgiya nagalistanv, ale gadaha gesv nagav tsudalenvdv asdvgosvhi nogalistanv gohi iyasdi.
\syll ᎣᎩᏃᎮᏍᎬᎢ, ᎣᏥᏔᏲᎯᎰᏉ; ᎤᏁᎢᎸᏗ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎡᎯ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᎦᎵᏍᏔᏅ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᏓᎭ ᎨᏒ ᎾᎦᎥ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎠᏍᏛᎪᏒᎯ ᏃᎦᎵᏍᏔᏅ ᎪᎯ ᎢᏯᏍᏗ.
\ft Being defamed, we intreat: we are made as the filth of the world, and are the offscouring of all things unto this day.

\ln Vtla itsvsdeohisdodiyi yigiyelv hia nasgi tsitsvyowelaneha; diquetsisgini itsvgeyui nasgiyai itsvyanvdadisdiha.
\syll ᎥᏝ ᎢᏨᏍᏕᎣᎯᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏱᎩᏰᎸ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏨᏲᏪᎳᏁᎭ; ᏗᏇᏥᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᏨᎨᏳᎢ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ ᎢᏨᏯᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗᎭ.
\ft I write not these things to shame you, but as my beloved sons I warn you.

\ln Nasquoyeno asgohi iyagayvli yinaniv digetseyohvsgi Galonedv detsanelodvi, aseno vtla yanigodi ditsidoda; Galonedvyeno Tsisa detsanelodv osdv kanohedv gvdi sgiyadenelvgi.
\syll ᎾᏍᏉᏰᏃ ᎠᏍᎪᎯ ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ ᏱᎾᏂᎥ ᏗᎨᏤᏲᎲᏍᎩ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏕᏣᏁᎶᏛᎢ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏯᏂᎪᏗ ᏗᏥᏙᏓ; ᎦᎶᏁᏛᏰᏃ ᏥᏌ ᏕᏣᏁᎶᏛ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎬᏗ ᏍᎩᏯᏕᏁᎸᎩ.
\ft For though ye have ten thousand instructors in Christ, yet have ye not many fathers: for in Christ Jesus I have begotten you through the gospel.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi itsvsdiyediha ayv sgiyadeloquaehi itsalisdodiyi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏨᏍᏗᏰᏗᎭ ᎠᏴ ᏍᎩᏯᏕᎶᏆᎡᎯ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
\ft Wherefore I beseech you, be ye followers of me.

\ln Nasgi nvdigalisdodiha tsinvsvgi Dimadi itsiwadvhvsdiyi, nasgi tsigeyui tsigi aquetsi, ale duyugodv iyadvnehi Ugvwiyuhi dakahnawadegvi; nasgi datsanvdadistani nusdv gedohv Galonedv detsigahnawadegvi, nasgiya degadeyohvsgv nigav degesadisv dunadatluwadisv tsunanelodi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᏥᏅᏒᎩ ᏗᎹᏗ ᎢᏥᏩᏛᎲᏍᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᎨᏳᎢ ᏥᎩ ᎠᏇᏥ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏓᎧᎿᏩᏕᎬᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᏓᏣᏅᏓᏗᏍᏔᏂ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎨᏙᎲ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏕᏥᎦᎿᏩᏕᎬᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏕᎦᏕᏲᎲᏍᎬ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏕᎨᏌᏗᏒ ᏚᎾᏓᏡᏩᏗᏒ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ.
\ft For this cause have I sent unto you Timotheus, who is my beloved son, and faithful in the Lord, who shall bring you into remembrance of my ways which be in Christ, as I teach every where in every church.

\ln Nasgino igadv dunadequvhisdi tsiwinvditsvlutselisvnaquo tsigeso nasgiyai.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎢᎦᏛ ᏚᎾᏕᏋᎯᏍᏗ ᏥᏫᏅᏗᏨᎷᏤᎵᏒᎾᏉ ᏥᎨᏐ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ.
\ft Now some are puffed up, as though I would not come to you.

\ln Aseno wvdatsvlutseli nigohilvna, iyuno Ugvwiyuhi osiyu yuyelvnv; ale wvdagadoleosi, vtla aniwonisgvquo nasgi tsunadequvhisdi, dunalinigvgvsgini nusdvi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᏮᏓᏨᎷᏤᎵ ᏂᎪᎯᎸᎾ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎣᏏᏳ ᏳᏰᎸᏅ; ᎠᎴ ᏮᏓᎦᏙᎴᎣᏏ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᏂᏬᏂᏍᎬᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᎾᏕᏋᎯᏍᏗ, ᏚᎾᎵᏂᎬᎬᏍᎩᏂ ᏄᏍᏛᎢ.
\ft But I will come to you shortly, if the Lord will, and will know, not the speech of them which are puffed up, but the power.

\ln Unelanvhiyeno utseligohi gesv vtla gawonihisdiquo gesv yidulasidi, ulinigidiyusgini gesvi.
\syll ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ ᎤᏤᎵᎪᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎥᏝ ᎦᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗᏉ ᎨᏒ ᏱᏚᎳᏏᏗ, ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft For the kingdom of God is not in word, but in power.

\ln Gadono itsaduliha?  tsigo ganasda tsinei wvdatsvlutseli?  tsigoge adageyudiyu gesv, ale udanvti adanvdo gvdi wvdatsvlutseli?
\syll ᎦᏙᏃ ᎢᏣᏚᎵᎭ?  ᏥᎪ ᎦᎾᏍᏓ ᏥᏁᎢ ᏮᏓᏨᎷᏤᎵ?  ᏥᎪᎨ ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᏅᏘ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎬᏗ ᏮᏓᏨᎷᏤᎵ?
\ft What will ye? shall I come unto you with a rod, or in love, and in the spirit of meekness?

\ln Nigavquo aninoheha nasgi udelidv dinisidi gesv itsehvi, ale nasgi iyusdi udelidv dinisidi gesv nasgi tsunadalenvdv yvwi vtla gvwaninohedi nasquo yigi, nasgi gilo udoda udalii udayvsdiyi.
\syll ᏂᎦᎥᏉ ᎠᏂᏃᎮᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᏗᏂᏏᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏤᎲᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᏗᏂᏏᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᎥᏝ ᎬᏩᏂᏃᎮᏗ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏱᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏙᏓ ᎤᏓᎵᎢ ᎤᏓᏴᏍᏗᏱ.
\ft It is reported commonly that there is fornication among you, and such fornication as is not so much as named among the Gentiles, that one should have his father's wife.

\ln Dotsadequvhisdiquono nihi, ale vtla uyoquo yitsiyelvnv, nasgi hia iyudvnelvhi gayetsinugowisdi itsadatlugv iyulisdodiyi ugvwali.
\syll ᏙᏣᏕᏋᎯᏍᏗᏉᏃ ᏂᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏲᏉ ᏱᏥᏰᎸᏅ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎢᏳᏛᏁᎸᎯ ᎦᏰᏥᏄᎪᏫᏍᏗ ᎢᏣᏓᏡᎬ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ.
\ft And ye are puffed up, and have not rather mourned, that he that hath done this deed might be taken away from among you.

\ln Ayvyeno udohiyuhi agigonela tsiyelv gesvi, tsigatawadegasgini aquadanvdogihi, gayula tsitsigatawadego nasgiyai detsiyugodanelv nasgi hia iyudvnelvhi,
\syll ᎠᏴᏰᏃ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎠᎩᎪᏁᎳ ᏥᏰᎸ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏥᎦᏔᏩᏕᎦᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏙᎩᎯ, ᎦᏳᎳ ᏥᏥᎦᏔᏩᏕᎪ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ ᏕᏥᏳᎪᏓᏁᎸ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎢᏳᏛᏁᎸᎯ,
\ft For I verily, as absent in body, but present in spirit, have judged already, as though I were present, concerning him that hath so done this deed,

\ln Itsadatlisahesdi, aquadanvdono agatawadegesdi, ulinigidiyu gesv igatseli Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv tali udvdesdi, Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv dudov itsvdodiyi,
\syll ᎢᏣᏓᏟᏌᎮᏍᏗ, ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏙᏃ ᎠᎦᏔᏩᏕᎨᏍᏗ, ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏔᎵ ᎤᏛᏕᏍᏗ, ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏚᏙᎥ ᎢᏨᏙᏗᏱ,
\ft In the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, when ye are gathered together, and my spirit, with the power of our Lord Jesus Christ,

\ln Nasgi Sedani tsetsiyohisediyi nasgi hia, nasgi uyoisdiyi uquedalvi, udanvdono asdelvdiyi nahiyu Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa utseli iga gesesdi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏎᏓᏂ ᏤᏥᏲᎯᏎᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏲᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏇᏓᎸᎢ, ᎤᏓᏅᏙᏃ ᎠᏍᏕᎸᏗᏱ ᏀᎢᏳ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎢᎦ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft To deliver such an one unto Satan for the destruction of the flesh, that the spirit may be saved in the day of the Lord Jesus.

\ln Itsatlvquasgv vtla osiyu yigi.  Vtlasgo yitsigataha usdi agododi nigadv galv agodisgvi.
\syll ᎢᏣᏢᏆᏍᎬ ᎥᏝ ᎣᏏᏳ ᏱᎩ.  ᎥᏝᏍᎪ ᏱᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎠᎪᏙᏗ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎦᎸ ᎠᎪᏗᏍᎬᎢ.
\ft Your glorying is not good. Know ye not that a little leaven leaveneth the whole lump?

\ln Nasgi iyusdi itsinugowa uweti agododi, nasgi galv itse itsalisdodiyi, nasgiya netsagolanvna tsigi.  Nasquoyeno Galonedv kanohiyegi igatseli igiyohuhiselv;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏥᏄᎪᏩ ᎤᏪᏘ ᎠᎪᏙᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎸ ᎢᏤ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏁᏣᎪᎳᏅᎾ ᏥᎩ.  ᎾᏍᏉᏰᏃ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎧᏃᎯᏰᎩ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᎢᎩᏲᎱᎯᏎᎸ;
\ft Purge out therefore the old leaven, that ye may be a new lump, as ye are unleavened. For even Christ our passover is sacrificed for us:

\ln Nasgi iyusdi igisquanigodesdi dilisdayvdiyi gesvi, vtlesdi uweti agododi gvdi, ale vtlesdi uyo ale asgani gesv agododi gvdi, nidagotanvnasgini gadu nutlonasdvna gesv ale gayegogi nigesvna gvdi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᎩᏍᏆᏂᎪᏕᏍᏗ ᏗᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎥᏞᏍᏗ ᎤᏪᏘ ᎠᎪᏙᏗ ᎬᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏞᏍᏗ ᎤᏲ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎪᏙᏗ ᎬᏗ, ᏂᏓᎪᏔᏅᎾᏍᎩᏂ ᎦᏚ ᏄᏠᎾᏍᏛᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎦᏰᎪᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎬᏗ.
\ft Therefore let us keep the feast, not with old leaven, neither with the leaven of malice and wickedness; but with the unleavened bread of sincerity and truth.

\ln Itsvyowelanelvgi nasgi itsulaha itsedasdiyi nigesvna udelidv dinanisihvsgi;
\syll ᎢᏨᏲᏪᎳᏁᎸᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎢᏤᏓᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᏗᎾᏂᏏᎲᏍᎩ;
\ft I wrote unto you in an epistle not to company with fornicators:

\ln Vtla adina hnaquo ase [itsedasdiyi nigesvna] nasquo elohi dinikahnawadegi udelidv dinanisihvsgi ale unigvvsgi, ale ulosvsdi anadagiehi, ale Unelanvhi ditlilostanvhi dinadadolisdanehi; iyuyeno nasgi yinusdi, ase itsinugoisdi yigi elohi.
\syll ᎥᏝ ᎠᏗᎾ ᎿᏉ ᎠᏎ ᎢᏤᏓᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾdata is invalid ᎾᏍᏉ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏗᏂᎧᎿᏩᏕᎩ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᏗᎾᏂᏏᎲᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᎬᎥᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎶᏒᏍᏗ ᎠᎾᏓᎩᎡᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏗᏟᎶᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᏗᎾᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎯ; ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᏄᏍᏗ, ᎠᏎ ᎢᏥᏄᎪᎢᏍᏗ ᏱᎩ ᎡᎶᎯ.
\ft Yet not altogether with the fornicators of this world, or with the covetous, or extortioners, or with idolaters; for then must ye needs go out of the world.

\ln Gohisgini itsvyowelasi itsulaha itsedasdiyi nigesvna, iyuno gilo analinvtli agosehi yigi nasgi udelidv dinisihvsgi yigi, ale ugvvsgi yigi, ale Unelanvhi ditlilostanvhi adadolisdanehi yigi, ale adasohehi, ale uyvsdesgi, ale ulosvsdi adagiehi; nasgi iyusdi vtlasdi nasquo itsulaha yitsalisdayvnesdi.
\syll ᎪᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᏨᏲᏪᎳᏏ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎢᏤᏓᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏟ ᎠᎪᏎᎯ ᏱᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᏗᏂᏏᎲᏍᎩ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎬᎥᏍᎩ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏗᏟᎶᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎠᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏓᏐᎮᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏴᏍᏕᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎶᏒᏍᏗ ᎠᏓᎩᎡᎯ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎥᏝᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᏱᏣᎵᏍᏓᏴᏁᏍᏗ.
\ft But now I have written unto you not to keep company, if any man that is called a brother be a fornicator, or covetous, or an idolater, or a railer, or a drunkard, or an extortioner; with such an one no not to eat.
