\ln Nasgiya nasquo nihi, nasgi utsati tsitsaduli digalvwisdanedi adanvdo udanedi gesvi, itsiyohesdi ditsadadalinehidediyi nasgi tsunanelodi unadatlugv ditsalinigohisdodiyi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏂᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏥᏣᏚᎵ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎢᏥᏲᎮᏍᏗ ᏗᏣᏓᏓᎵᏁᎯᏕᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬ ᏗᏣᎵᏂᎪᎯᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
\ft Even so ye, forasmuch as ye are zealous of spiritual gifts, seek that ye may excel to the edifying of the church.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi gilo nvwanadale uniwonihisdi gawonisgesdi, adadolisdisgesdi atayohihesdi atsisdelvdiyi unetlvdodiyi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎩᎶ ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴ ᎤᏂᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᎦᏬᏂᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᏔᏲᎯᎮᏍᏗ ᎠᏥᏍᏕᎸᏗᏱ ᎤᏁᏢᏙᏗᏱ.
\ft Wherefore let him that speaketh in an unknown tongue pray that he may interpret.

\ln Iyuyeno yigadadolisdi yigvdiha nvwanadale uniwonihisdi gesvi, aquadanvdo adadolisdisgoi;  aquadanvdvsgini vtla yigananugowisgo osdv gesvi.
\syll ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᏱᎦᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᏱᎬᏗᎭ ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴ ᎤᏂᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏙ ᎠᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎪᎢ;  ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᎥᏝ ᏱᎦᎾᏄᎪᏫᏍᎪ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft For if I pray in an unknown tongue, my spirit prayeth, but my understanding is unfruitful.

\ln Gado howa usdi?  aquadanvdo gvdisgesdi gadadolisdisgesdi, ale gagolisdi gadadolisdisgesdi; ale aquadanvdo gvdisgesdi detsinogisgesdi ale gagolisdi detsinogisgesdi.
\syll ᎦᏙ ᎰᏩ ᎤᏍᏗ?  ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏙ ᎬᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎦᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᎪᎵᏍᏗ ᎦᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ; ᎠᎴ ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏙ ᎬᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏕᏥᏃᎩᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎦᎪᎵᏍᏗ ᏕᏥᏃᎩᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
\ft What is it then? I will pray with the spirit, and I will pray with the understanding also: I will sing with the spirit, and I will sing with the understanding also.

\ln Nasgiyeno nusdv yigi, hnaquo halihelitsv tsadanvdo hvtanvha, gado yigalisdoda nasgi na nagatanavna uwediyi yuwola, yeli Emenv yadv haliheligi?  nigoligvnayeno yigi niwesgvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏱᎩ, ᎿᏉ ᎭᎵᎮᎵᏨ ᏣᏓᏅᏙ ᎲᏔᏅᎭ, ᎦᏙ ᏱᎦᎵᏍᏙᏓ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎾᎦᏔᎾᎥᎾ ᎤᏪᏗᏱ ᏳᏬᎳ, ᏰᎵ ᎡᎺᏅ ᏯᏛ ᎭᎵᎮᎵᎩ?  ᏂᎪᎵᎬᎾᏰᏃ ᏱᎩ ᏂᏪᏍᎬᎢ.
\ft Else when thou shalt bless with the spirit, how shall he that occupieth the room of the unlearned say Amen at thy giving of thanks, seeing he understandeth not what thou sayest?

\ln Nihiyeno udohiyuhi osiyu niweha haliheligvi, soisgini vtla yulinigohisdiha.
\syll ᏂᎯᏰᏃ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎣᏏᏳ ᏂᏪᎭ ᎭᎵᎮᎵᎬᎢ, ᏐᎢᏍᎩᏂ ᎥᏝ ᏳᎵᏂᎪᎯᏍᏗᎭ.
\ft For thou verily givest thanks well, but the other is not edified.

\ln Tsiyalielitseha Aquanelanvhi, nasgi utli igai digvgiwonihisdi gesv tsudalenvdv digawonihisdi gesv esgaquo nihi nitsivi;
\syll ᏥᏯᎵᎡᎵᏤᎭ ᎠᏆᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏟ ᎢᎦᎢ ᏗᎬᎩᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏗᎦᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᏂᎯ ᏂᏥᎥᎢ;
\ft I thank my God, I speak with tongues more than ye all:

\ln Aseno tsunanelodi unadatlugv utli gvgiyelvdi nahna hisgiquo ikanetsvhi agineisdiyi aquadanvdv aquvdodiyi, nasgi nvwanadale nasquo gatsiyeyodiyi, ano asgohi iyagayvli ikanetsvhi agineisdiyi nvwanadale uniwonihisdi gesv aquvdodiyi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬ ᎤᏟ ᎬᎩᏰᎸᏗ ᏀᎾ ᎯᏍᎩᏉ ᎢᎧᏁᏨᎯ ᎠᎩᏁᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏛ ᎠᏋᏙᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎦᏥᏰᏲᏗᏱ, ᎠᏃ ᎠᏍᎪᎯ ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ ᎢᎧᏁᏨᎯ ᎠᎩᏁᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴ ᎤᏂᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏋᏙᏗᏱ.
\ft Yet in the church I had rather speak five words with my understanding, that by my voice I might teach others also, than ten thousand words in an unknown tongue.

\ln Idalinvtli, tlesdi ditsiyoli yigesesdi detsadanvdvi; adasgaisdisgininonv gesv ditsiyoli gesesdi, detsadanvdvsgini ditsadvnaya gesesdi.
\syll ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᏗᏥᏲᎵ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏕᏣᏓᏅᏛᎢ; ᎠᏓᏍᎦᎢᏍᏗᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎨᏒ ᏗᏥᏲᎵ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᏕᏣᏓᏅᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᏗᏣᏛᎾᏯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft Brethren, be not children in understanding: howbeit in malice be ye children, but in understanding be men.

\ln Dikahnawadvsdiyi hia nigvnv gowela, Nvwadale diniwonisgi ale nvwadale tsunihanegali dagatsiyvtani gadatsiwonetani hia nasgi yvwi; aseno asi vtla yigvquadvganehesdi, adiha Yihowa.
\syll ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗᏱ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏅ ᎪᏪᎳ, ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᏗᏂᏬᏂᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᏧᏂᎭᏁᎦᎵ ᏓᎦᏥᏴᏔᏂ ᎦᏓᏥᏬᏁᏔᏂ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏴᏫ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᏏ ᎥᏝ ᏱᎬᏆᏛᎦᏁᎮᏍᏗ, ᎠᏗᎭ ᏱᎰᏩ.
\ft In the law it is written, With men of other tongues and other lips will I speak unto this people; and yet for all that will they not hear me, saith the Lord.

\ln Nasgino tsudalenvdv digawonihisdi gesv gohiyudisgi ayelvha, vtla anohiyuhvsgi unohiyudanehi yigi, asgini anohiyuhvsgi nigesvna; adolehohisdisgini gesv vtla anohiyuhvsgi nigesvna [unohiyudanehi] yigi, anohiyuhvsgisgini.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏗᎦᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎪᎯᏳᏗᏍᎩ ᎠᏰᎸᎭ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᎤᏃᎯᏳᏓᏁᎯ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ; ᎠᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏒ ᎥᏝ ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎤᏃᎯᏳᏓᏁᎯdata is invalid ᏱᎩ, ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ.
\ft Wherefore tongues are for a sign, not to them that believe, but to them that believe not: but prophesying serveth not for them that believe not, but for them which believe.

\ln Nasgino tsinusdi iyuno tsunanelodi unadatlugv nigadv ilvhitlv yidunilawitsonv, ale nigadv tsudalenvdv digawonihisdi gesv yidaniwoniha, yuniyvlilvno nahnani nanigatanavna, ale anohiyuhvsgini nigesvna, tlasgo dunilvnotiha yvgvnadv?
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏥᏄᏍᏗ ᎢᏳᏃ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎢᎸᎯᏢ ᏱᏚᏂᎳᏫᏦᏅ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏗᎦᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏱᏓᏂᏬᏂᎭ, ᏳᏂᏴᎵᎸᏃ ᏀᎾᏂ ᎾᏂᎦᏔᎾᎥᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩᏂ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᏝᏍᎪ ᏚᏂᎸᏃᏘᎭ ᏴᎬᎾᏛ?
\ft If therefore the whole church be come together into one place, and all speak with tongues, and there come in those that are unlearned, or unbelievers, will they not say that ye are mad?

\ln Iyusgini nigadv yanadolehosga, yuyvlilvno gilo gohiyuhvsgi nigesvna, ale gilo nagatanavna, naniv gvwohiyudanehoi, ale naniv degvwugodanehoi;
\syll ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏯᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎦ, ᏳᏴᎵᎸᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎪᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᎾᎦᏔᎾᎥᎾ, ᎾᏂᎥ ᎬᏬᎯᏳᏓᏁᎰᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏕᎬᏭᎪᏓᏁᎰᎢ;
\ft But if all prophesy, and there come in one that believeth not, or one unlearned, he is convinced of all, he is judged of all:

\ln Nasgino udelidv usquanigodv unawiyi gvnigesv yinigalisda; nasgino yaliyesduhvga Unelanvhi yadadolisdasi, ale yideganotsalvga Unelanvhi udohiyuhiya itsadasuyvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏛ ᎤᎾᏫᏱ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏱᏂᎦᎵᏍᏓ; ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏯᎵᏰᏍᏚᎲᎦ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏯᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏏ, ᎠᎴ ᏱᏕᎦᏃᏣᎸᎦ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎢᏣᏓᏑᏴᎢ.
\ft And thus are the secrets of his heart made manifest; and so falling down on his face he will worship God, and report that God is in you of a truth.

\ln Gado howa usdi, idalinvtli?  iyuno detsilawigi, itsisiyvwiha dikanogidv itsadvnvisdoi, dideyodi itsadvnvisdoi, tsudalenvdv digawonihisdi itsadvnvisdoi, gvnigesv igvnedi itsadvnvisdoi, anetlvdodi itsadvnvisdoi.  Nigadv adina detsilvwisdanehv ditsadalinigohisdodiyi ugvwalesdi.
\syll ᎦᏙ ᎰᏩ ᎤᏍᏗ, ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ?  ᎢᏳᏃ ᏕᏥᎳᏫᎩ, ᎢᏥᏏᏴᏫᎭ ᏗᎧᏃᎩᏛ ᎢᏣᏛᏅᎢᏍᏙᎢ, ᏗᏕᏲᏗ ᎢᏣᏛᏅᎢᏍᏙᎢ, ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏗᎦᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᎢᏣᏛᏅᎢᏍᏙᎢ, ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᎬᏁᏗ ᎢᏣᏛᏅᎢᏍᏙᎢ, ᎠᏁᏢᏙᏗ ᎢᏣᏛᏅᎢᏍᏙᎢ.  ᏂᎦᏛ ᎠᏗᎾ ᏕᏥᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᏗᏣᏓᎵᏂᎪᎯᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᎬᏩᎴᏍᏗ.
\ft How is it then, brethren? when ye come together, everyone of you hath a psalm, hath a doctrine, hath a tongue, hath a revelation, hath an interpretation. Let all things be done unto edifying.

\ln Iyuno gilo nvwanadale tsuniwonihisdi gesv yigawoniha, anitali, ale tsoi iyvdv wasdesdi daniwonisegesdi saquo uwesvdv; asiyvwino anetlvdisgesdi.
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴ ᏧᏂᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏱᎦᏬᏂᎭ, ᎠᏂᏔᎵ, ᎠᎴ ᏦᎢ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏩᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᏓᏂᏬᏂᏎᎨᏍᏗ ᏌᏉ ᎤᏪᏒᏛ; ᎠᏏᏴᏫᏃ ᎠᏁᏢᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
\ft If any man speak in an unknown tongue, let it be by two, or at the most by three, and that by course; and let one interpret.

\ln Iyusgini anetlvdisgi nedohvna igesesdi, elawequo uwasesdi tsunanelodi unadatlugvi; uwasvquo adalinohedisgesdi, ale Unelanvhi alinohedisgesdi.
\syll ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏁᏢᏗᏍᎩ ᏁᏙᎲᎾ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎡᎳᏪᏉ ᎤᏩᏎᏍᏗ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬᎢ; ᎤᏩᏒᏉ ᎠᏓᎵᏃᎮᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎵᏃᎮᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
\ft But if there be no interpreter, let him keep silence in the church; and let him speak to himself, and to God.

\ln Anadolehosgi anitaliha aniwonisgesgi, anisoino danugodisgesdi.
\syll ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎠᏂᏔᎵᎭ ᎠᏂᏬᏂᏍᎨᏍᎩ, ᎠᏂᏐᎢᏃ ᏓᏄᎪᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
\ft Let the prophets speak two or three, and let the other judge.

\ln Iyuno gohusdi yatsinanugowiselv gilo nav uwoli, igvyi ulenvdv elawe gvsgesdi.
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏯᏥᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᎸ ᎩᎶ ᎾᎥ ᎤᏬᎵ, ᎢᎬᏱ ᎤᎴᏅᏛ ᎡᎳᏪ ᎬᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
\ft If any thing be revealed to another that sitteth by, let the first hold his peace.

\ln Nitsivyeno yeli getsidolehohisdi saquo uwesvdv; nasgi naniv unadeloquasdiyi, ale naniv unigalisdadisdiyi.
\syll ᏂᏥᎥᏰᏃ ᏰᎵ ᎨᏥᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏗ ᏌᏉ ᎤᏪᏒᏛ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎤᎾᏕᎶᏆᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎤᏂᎦᎵᏍᏓᏗᏍᏗᏱ.
\ft For ye may all prophesy one by one, that all may learn, and all may be comforted.

\ln Ale anadolehosgi tsunatseli didanvdo danohiyuhvsgo anadolehosgi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᏧᎾᏤᎵ ᏗᏓᏅᏙ ᏓᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎪ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ.
\ft And the spirits of the prophets are subject to the prophets.

\ln Unelanvhiyeno vtla tsudalenvdv gesv igvnehi yigi, nvwadohiyadvsgini gesvi, nasgiya tsinusdi nigadv dunadatluwadisv unadanvti.
\syll ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎢᎬᏁᎯ ᏱᎩ, ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏥᏄᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏚᎾᏓᏡᏩᏗᏒ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ.
\ft For God is not the author of confusion, but of peace, as in all churches of the saints.

\ln Anigeyv ditsatseli elawequo unvsesdi tsunanelodi dunadatluwadisvi; vtlayeno gegalisgolvdanelvhi yigi nasgi uniwonihisdiyi; unohiyudiyiquosgini, nasgiya nasquo tsinigawe dikahnawadvsdi.
\syll ᎠᏂᎨᏴ ᏗᏣᏤᎵ ᎡᎳᏪᏉ ᎤᏅᏎᏍᏗ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᏚᎾᏓᏡᏩᏗᏒᎢ; ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᎨᎦᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᏱᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗᏱ; ᎤᏃᎯᏳᏗᏱᏉᏍᎩᏂ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏥᏂᎦᏪ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ.
\ft Let your women keep silence in the churches: for it is not permitted unto them to speak; but they are commanded to be under obedience, as also saith the law.

\ln Iyu ale yunaduli gohusdi unadeloquasdiyi, digvwaniyehi tsunadvdvhvsgesdi dotsunenvsvi; udehohisdiyuyeno anigeyv uniwonihisdiyi tsunanelodi unadatlugvi.
\syll ᎢᏳ ᎠᎴ ᏳᎾᏚᎵ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᎾᏕᎶᏆᏍᏗᏱ, ᏗᎬᏩᏂᏰᎯ ᏧᎾᏛᏛᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏙᏧᏁᏅᏒᎢ; ᎤᏕᎰᎯᏍᏗᏳᏰᏃ ᎠᏂᎨᏴ ᎤᏂᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬᎢ.
\ft And if they will learn any thing, let them ask their husbands at home: for it is a shame for women to speak in the church.

\ln Tsigo nihi itsehv tsudalene kanohedv Unelanvhi utseliga?  tsigoge nihiquo itsvsv itsilutselei?
\syll ᏥᎪ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏤᎲ ᏧᏓᎴᏁ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ?  ᏥᎪᎨ ᏂᎯᏉ ᎢᏨᏒ ᎢᏥᎷᏤᎴᎢ?
\ft What? came the word of God out from you? or came it unto you only?

\ln Iyuno gilo adanvtesgv gadoleosgi ale adanvdo udanedi agihi ielisgesdi, nasgi gvnigesv nigvnehesdi nasgi hia tsiwitsvyowelaneha ugvwiyuhi unetsvhi gesvi.
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎠᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ ᎦᏙᎴᎣᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᏓᏁᏗ ᎠᎩᎯ ᎢᎡᎵᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᎬᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏫᏨᏲᏪᎳᏁᎭ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏁᏨᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft If any man think himself to be a prophet, or spiritual, let him acknowledge that the things that I write unto you are the commandments of the Lord.

\ln Iyusgini gilo nagatahvna igesesdi, unelagiquo nagatahvna gesesdi.
\syll ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎩᎶ ᎾᎦᏔᎲᎾ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎤᏁᎳᎩᏉ ᎾᎦᏔᎲᎾ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft But if any man be ignorant, let him be ignorant.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi idalinvtli, itsadulisgesdi itsadolehohisdiyi, ale tlesdi yitsinvsdosgesdi gawonihisdiyi tsunadalenvdv tsuniwonihisdi gesvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᎢᏣᏚᎵᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎢᏣᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏥᏅᏍᏙᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎦᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏧᏂᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Wherefore, brethren, covet to prophesy, and forbid not to speak with tongues.

\ln Nigadv detsilvwisdanehv uwoduhi ale osdv a'yilvdv gesesdi.
\syll ᏂᎦᏛ ᏕᏥᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᎤᏬᏚᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎠᏱᎸᏛ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft Let all things be done decently and in order.

\ln Alewo idalinvtli, gvnigesv nitsvyvneha osdv kanohedv, nasgi tsitsvyalitsidonelvgi, ale nasgi nasquo tsidetsadanilvtsv, ale nasgi ulinigidv tsidetsiniyvha;
\syll ᎠᎴᏬ ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᏨᏴᏁᎭ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏨᏯᎵᏥᏙᏁᎸᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏥᏕᏣᏓᏂᎸᏨ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᏥᏕᏥᏂᏴᎭ;
\ft Moreover, brethren, I declare unto you the gospel which I preached unto you, which also ye have received, and wherein ye stand;

\ln Nasgi nasquo tsitsalisdelvdodi, iyuno asdaya yiditsiniyv nasgi tsitsvyalitsidonelvgi, iyusgininonv asequoquo yigi itsohiyusvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏥᏣᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎠᏍᏓᏯ ᏱᏗᏥᏂᏴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏨᏯᎵᏥᏙᏁᎸᎩ, ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎠᏎᏉᏉ ᏱᎩ ᎢᏦᎯᏳᏒᎢ.
\ft By which also ye are saved, if ye keep in memory what I preached unto you, unless ye have believed in vain.

\ln Igvyiyiyeno gesv detsayohiselvgi nasgi nasquo ayv tsvgiyohiselvgi, nasgi Galonedv ayv igisganvtsv igiyohuhiselvi, nasgiya nigvnv gowelihi;
\syll ᎢᎬᏱᏱᏰᏃ ᎨᏒ ᏕᏣᏲᎯᏎᎸᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏴ ᏨᎩᏲᎯᏎᎸᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎠᏴ ᎢᎩᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᎢᎩᏲᎱᎯᏎᎸᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏂᎬᏅ ᎪᏪᎵᎯ;
\ft For I delivered unto you first of all that which I also received, how that Christ died for our sins according to the scriptures;

\ln Ale nasgi atsinisanvi, ale nasgi tsoine iga doulehisanv nasgiya nigvnvgowelihi;
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏥᏂᏌᏅᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏦᎢᏁ ᎢᎦ ᏙᎤᎴᎯᏌᏅ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏂᎬᏅᎪᏪᎵᎯ;
\ft And that he was buried, and that he rose again the third day according to the scriptures:

\ln Ale nasgi Siquasi ugohvi, hnaquono taladu iyanidv.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏏᏆᏏ ᎤᎪᎲᎢ, ᎿᏉᏃ ᏔᎳᏚ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ.
\ft And that he was seen of Cephas, then of the twelve:

\ln Onino hisgitsuqui ulosvsdi iyanidv analinvtli itsulaha gvwagohei; nasgino [gvwagohvhi] utli iyanidv analenido asi gohi gesvi, igadvsgininonv dunilinvtsv.
\syll ᎣᏂᏃ ᎯᏍᎩᏧᏈ ᎤᎶᏒᏍᏗ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏟ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎬᏩᎪᎮᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎬᏩᎪᎲᎯdata is invalid ᎤᏟ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᎠᎾᎴᏂᏙ ᎠᏏ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎢᎦᏛᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᏚᏂᎵᏅᏨ.
\ft After that, he was seen of above five hundred brethren at once; of whom the greater part remain unto this present, but some are fallen asleep.

\ln Onino Tsimi ugohei; hnaquono nigadv getsinvsidv [igvwagohei.]
\syll ᎣᏂᏃ ᏥᎻ ᎤᎪᎮᎢ; ᎿᏉᏃ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏛ ᎢᎬᏩᎪᎮᎢ.data is invalid
\ft After that, he was seen of James; then of all the apostles.

\ln Oniyino nasquo ayv vtsigovgi, nasgiya gilo udediyi nusqualvhvnaquo tsadehvsgo tsadagowatisgoi.
\syll ᎣᏂᏱᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏴ ᎥᏥᎪᎥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏕᏗᏱ ᏄᏍᏆᎸᎲᎾᏉ ᏣᏕᎲᏍᎪ ᏣᏓᎪᏩᏘᏍᎪᎢ.
\ft And last of all he was seen of me also, as of one born out of due time.

\ln Ayvyeno aquasdikani oginvsidv gesvi, nasgi vtla yeli atsinvsidv gayvquosedi yigi, nvdigalisdodiha uyo nigatsiyvnelv tsunanelodi unadatlugv Unelanvhi utseliga.
\syll ᎠᏴᏰᏃ ᎠᏆᏍᏗᎧᏂ ᎣᎩᏅᏏᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎥᏝ ᏰᎵ ᎠᏥᏅᏏᏛ ᎦᏴᏉᏎᏗ ᏱᎩ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎤᏲ ᏂᎦᏥᏴᏁᎸ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ.
\ft For I am the least of the apostles, that am not meet to be called an apostle, because I persecuted the church of God.

\ln Aseno gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv Unelanvhi iyuwanisadv ayv naquasdv naquasdi; ale nasgi gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv vginelvhi tsigi, vtla asequoquo yinulistanv; utliyeno igai dagilvwisdanehv esgaquo nasgi na nanivi; vtlasgininonv ayv, Unelanvhisgini gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv digikahnawadidolvhi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ ᎠᏴ ᎾᏆᏍᏛ ᎾᏆᏍᏗ; ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎥᎩᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᏎᏉᏉ ᏱᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ; ᎤᏟᏰᏃ ᎢᎦᎢ ᏓᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎾᏂᎥᎢ; ᎥᏝᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎠᏴ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏗᎩᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎸᎯ.
\ft But by the grace of God I am what I am: and his grace which was bestowed upon me was not in vain; but I laboured more abundantly than they all: yet not I, but the grace of God which was with me.

\ln Adina iyuno ayv yigi, ale nasgi na yigi, nasgi notsiweha otsalitsidohvsga, ale nasgi nusdi itsohiyunv.
\syll ᎠᏗᎾ ᎢᏳᏃ ᎠᏴ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏱᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏃᏥᏪᎭ ᎣᏣᎵᏥᏙᎲᏍᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏗ ᎢᏦᎯᏳᏅ.
\ft Therefore whether it were I or they, so we preach, and so ye believed.

\ln Nasgino iyu Galonedv uyohusvhi deulehisanv yagalitsidohvsga, gadono igadv getsadasuyv hia nianiweha, vtla tsunalehisodi yigi tsuniyohusvhi?
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎢᏳ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᏕᎤᎴᎯᏌᏅ ᏯᎦᎵᏥᏙᎲᏍᎦ, ᎦᏙᏃ ᎢᎦᏛ ᎨᏣᏓᏑᏴ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎠᏂᏪᎭ, ᎥᏝ ᏧᎾᎴᎯᏐᏗ ᏱᎩ ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯ?
\ft Now if Christ be preached that he rose from the dead, how say some among you that there is no resurrection of the dead?

\ln Iyuno tsunalehisodi nigesvna yigi tsuniyohusvhi, hnaquo Galonedv vtla tsulehisanvhi yigi.
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᏧᎾᎴᎯᏐᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏱᎩ ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯ, ᎿᏉ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎥᏝ ᏧᎴᎯᏌᏅᎯ ᏱᎩ.
\ft But if there be no resurrection of the dead, then is Christ not risen:

\ln Iyu ale Galonedv tsulehisanvhi nigesvna yigi, hnaquo otsalitsidohvsgv asequoquo nigalisdiha, ale itsohiyusv nasquo asequoquo nigalisdiha.
\syll ᎢᏳ ᎠᎴ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏧᎴᎯᏌᏅᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏱᎩ, ᎿᏉ ᎣᏣᎵᏥᏙᎲᏍᎬ ᎠᏎᏉᏉ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏦᎯᏳᏒ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏎᏉᏉ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᎭ.
\ft And if Christ be not risen, then is our preaching vain, and your faith is also vain.

\ln ale nasquo gvnigesv nigalisdiha gayegogi otsinohesgi gesv Unelanvhi; otsinohelvyeno Unelanvhi nasgi uyohusv deuletanv Galonedv; tsulelanvhi nigesvna tsigi, iyuno howa tsunalehisodi nigesvna yigi tsuniyohusvhi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᎭ ᎦᏰᎪᎩ ᎣᏥᏃᎮᏍᎩ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ; ᎣᏥᏃᎮᎸᏰᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏲᎱᏒ ᏕᎤᎴᏔᏅ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ; ᏧᎴᎳᏅᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏥᎩ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎰᏩ ᏧᎾᎴᎯᏐᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏱᎩ ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯ.
\ft Yea, and we are found false witnesses of God; because we have testified of God that he raised up Christ: whom he raised not up, if so be that the dead rise not.

\ln Tsuniyohusvhiyeno tsunalehisodi nigesvna yigi, hnaquo Galonedv vtla tsulehisanvhi yigi.
\syll ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯᏰᏃ ᏧᎾᎴᎯᏐᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏱᎩ, ᎿᏉ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎥᏝ ᏧᎴᎯᏌᏅᎯ ᏱᎩ.
\ft For if the dead rise not, then is not Christ raised:

\ln Iyu ale Galonedv tsulehisanvhi nigvsvna yigi, itsohiyusv asequoquo nigalisdiha; asiquo itsisganvtsv itsadudala.
\syll ᎢᏳ ᎠᎴ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏧᎴᎯᏌᏅᎯ ᏂᎬᏒᎾ ᏱᎩ, ᎢᏦᎯᏳᏒ ᎠᏎᏉᏉ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᎭ; ᎠᏏᏉ ᎢᏥᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᎢᏣᏚᏓᎳ.
\ft And if Christ be not raised, your faith is vain; ye are yet in your sins.

\ln Ale nasquo na Galonedv unohiyuhi unilinvtsvhi tsigi gvwaniyotsidolvquo.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ Ꮎ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏃᎯᏳᎯ ᎤᏂᎵᏅᏨᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎬᏩᏂᏲᏥᏙᎸᏉ.
\ft Then they also which are fallen asleep in Christ are perished.

\ln Iyuno aniquo idehv uwasv udugi yigvha Galonedv igisdelvdiyi, naniv yvwi dedigonadvdi uyo nigadvnvi.
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᎠᏂᏉ ᎢᏕᎲ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎤᏚᎩ ᏱᎬᎭ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎢᎩᏍᏕᎸᏗᏱ, ᎾᏂᎥ ᏴᏫ ᏕᏗᎪᎾᏛᏗ ᎤᏲ ᏂᎦᏛᏅᎢ.
\ft If in this life only we have hope in Christ, we are of all men most miserable.

\ln Aseno Galonedv deulehisanv uyohusvi, ale tsudalenvtanvhi nulistanv nasgi unilinvtsvhi tsigesvgi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏕᎤᎴᎯᏌᏅ ᎤᏲᎱᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏔᏅᎯ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᎵᏅᏨᎯ ᏥᎨᏒᎩ.
\ft But now is Christ risen from the dead, and become the firstfruits of them that slept.

\ln Nasgiyeno yvwi iyuwanisadv tsigi ahohuhisdi gesv tseha, yvwi nasquo iyuwanisadv ayohusv dilehisodi tsigi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᏴᏫ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ ᏥᎩ ᎠᎰᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏤᎭ, ᏴᏫ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ ᎠᏲᎱᏒ ᏗᎴᎯᏐᏗ ᏥᎩ.
\ft For since by man came death, by man came also the resurrection of the dead.

\ln Adawiyeno iyuwanisadv nigadiyu tsidaniyohusga, nasgiya nasquo Galonedv iyuwanisadv nigadiyu dinvnodv nvdvgegvneli.
\syll ᎠᏓᏫᏰᏃ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏥᏓᏂᏲᎱᏍᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏗᏅᏃᏛ ᏅᏛᎨᎬᏁᎵ.
\ft For as in Adam all die, even so in Christ shall all be made alive.

\ln Aseno naniv unatselidvha; Galonedv tsudalenvtanvhi; onino nasgi na Galonedv tsutseli gesv nahiyu galutsvha.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᏛᎭ; ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏔᏅᎯ; ᎣᏂᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏧᏤᎵ ᎨᏒ ᏀᎢᏳ ᎦᎷᏨᎭ.
\ft But every man in his own order: Christ the firstfruits; afterward they that are Christ's at his coming.

\ln Hnaquo dvlisquadi, nahiyu ugvwiyuhi gesv tsuyohiselvhi gesesdi Unelanvhi, nasgi Agayvligei; nahiyu advtanonvha nigadiyu unigvwiyusadegi gesv ale nigadiyu digeganelodi gesv, ale dunalinigvgvi.
\syll ᎿᏉ ᏛᎵᏍᏆᏗ, ᏀᎢᏳ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏧᏲᎯᏎᎸᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ; ᏀᎢᏳ ᎠᏛᏔᏃᏅᎭ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᎤᏂᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏗᎨᎦᏁᎶᏗ ᎨᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᎾᎵᏂᎬᎬᎢ.
\ft Then cometh the end, when he shall have delivered up the kingdom to God, even the Father; when he shall have put down all rule and all authority and power.

\ln Aseyeno nvwasdesdiquo Ugvwiyuhi gesvi, gvni nigadv gvwasgagi dulasgv hawiniditlv nidegvnelvha.
\syll ᎠᏎᏰᏃ ᏅᏩᏍᏕᏍᏗᏉ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎬᏂ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎬᏩᏍᎦᎩ ᏚᎳᏍᎬ ᎭᏫᏂᏗᏢ ᏂᏕᎬᏁᎸᎭ.
\ft For he must reign, till he hath put all enemies under his feet.

\ln Ayohuhisdi gesv nasgi ulisqualvdi usgagi atsidvdodi gesvi.
\syll ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᎸᏗ ᎤᏍᎦᎩ ᎠᏥᏛᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft The last enemy that shall be destroyed is death.

\ln Nigadiyuyeno tsudalenvdv dulasgv hawiniditlv igvnelvhi.  Aseno, nigadiyu tsudalenvdv hawiniditlv iyagvnelvhi tsadiha, gvnigesv nigalisdiha nagatloyasdvna gesv nasgi na nigadv tsudalenvdv hawiniditlv iyuwanelvhi.
\syll ᏂᎦᏗᏳᏰᏃ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏚᎳᏍᎬ ᎭᏫᏂᏗᏢ ᎢᎬᏁᎸᎯ.  ᎠᏎᏃ, ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎭᏫᏂᏗᏢ ᎢᏯᎬᏁᎸᎯ ᏣᏗᎭ, ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᎭ ᎾᎦᏠᏯᏍᏛᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎭᏫᏂᏗᏢ ᎢᏳᏩᏁᎸᎯ.
\ft For he hath put all things under his feet. But when he saith, all things are put under him, it is manifest that he is excepted, which did put all things under him.

\ln Nahiyuno nigadiyu tsudalenvdv hawiniditlv iyagvnelvhi gesesdi, hnaquo nasquo Uwetsi uwasv hawiniditlv nvdvdvneli nasgi na nigadv tsudalenvdv hawiniditlv iyuwanelvhi, nasgi Unelanvhi nigav igvnisisgi iyulisdodiyi naniv anehvi.
\syll ᏀᎢᏳᏃ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎭᏫᏂᏗᏢ ᎢᏯᎬᏁᎸᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎿᏉ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎭᏫᏂᏗᏢ ᏅᏛᏛᏁᎵ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎭᏫᏂᏗᏢ ᎢᏳᏩᏁᎸᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎢᎬᏂᏏᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎠᏁᎲᎢ.
\ft And when all things shall be subdued unto him, then shall the Son also himself be subject unto him that put all things under him, that God may be all in all.

\ln Iyuno nasgi nusdvna yigi, gado dvnadvneli tsuniyohusvhi tsinvdigalisdodisgo tsidegegawosgoi?  iyuno tsuniyohusvhi ase tsunalehisodi nigesvna igesesdi, gadono tsuniyohusvhi nvdigalisdodisgo dogegawosgoi?
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏛᎾ ᏱᎩ, ᎦᏙ ᏛᎾᏛᏁᎵ ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᏥᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎪ ᏥᏕᎨᎦᏬᏍᎪᎢ?  ᎢᏳᏃ ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᎠᏎ ᏧᎾᎴᎯᏐᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎦᏙᏃ ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎪ ᏙᎨᎦᏬᏍᎪᎢ?
\ft Else what shall they do which are baptized for the dead, if the dead rise not at all? why are they then baptized for the dead?

\ln Ale gadono unayehisdi nigadvhnadega nigohilvi?
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎦᏙᏃ ᎤᎾᏰᎯᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᏛᎿᏕᎦ ᏂᎪᎯᎸᎢ?
\ft And why stand we in jeopardy every hour?

\ln Tsineisdiha nasgi na ulihelisdi tsagiha nihi tsinvdigalisdodiha, nasgi Tsisa Galonedv Ugvwiyuhi ogatseli tsvdidalehvsga, tsiyohusgo nidugitsvnisvi.
\syll ᏥᏁᎢᏍᏗᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᎵᎮᎵᏍᏗ ᏣᎩᎭ ᏂᎯ ᏥᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎣᎦᏤᎵ ᏨᏗᏓᎴᎲᏍᎦ, ᏥᏲᎱᏍᎪ ᏂᏚᎩᏨᏂᏒᎢ.
\ft I protest by your rejoicing which I have in Christ Jesus our Lord, I die daily.

\ln Iyuno yvwi iyunadvnedi iyaquadvnelvhi yigi, nvgi dininvsadi unisgasedi ogalilvhi yigi Equisa gaduhvi, gado gvginequotsedi osdv gesv, iyuno tsuniyohusvhi tsunalehisodi nigesvna yigi?  idalisdayvhvsgesdi, ale idaditasgesdi; sunalequoyeno dodadiyohusi.
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᏴᏫ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᏁᏗ ᎢᏯᏆᏛᏁᎸᎯ ᏱᎩ, ᏅᎩ ᏗᏂᏅᏌᏗ ᎤᏂᏍᎦᏎᏗ ᎣᎦᎵᎸᎯ ᏱᎩ ᎡᏈᏌ ᎦᏚᎲᎢ, ᎦᏙ ᎬᎩᏁᏉᏤᏗ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎨᏒ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᏧᎾᎴᎯᏐᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏱᎩ?  ᎢᏓᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏓᏗᏔᏍᎨᏍᏗ; ᏑᎾᎴᏉᏰᏃ ᏙᏓᏗᏲᎱᏏ.
\ft If after the manner of men I have fought with beasts at Ephesus, what advantageth it me, if the dead rise not? let us eat and drink; for to morrow we die.

\ln Tlesdi etsilidastanvgi; nayo dilinohelidasdi gesv ayosdisgo osdv digalvwisdanedi gesvi.
\syll ᏞᏍᏗ ᎡᏥᎵᏓᏍᏔᏅᎩ; ᎾᏲ ᏗᎵᏃᎮᎵᏓᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏲᏍᏗᏍᎪ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Be not deceived: evil communications corrupt good manners.

\ln Itsiyegi duyugodv itsadvnediyi, ale tlesdi yitsisganvgesdi; igadvyeno vtla yanigataha Unelanvhi; udehohisdiyu itsvnoheha nasgi hia tsinitsiweha.
\syll ᎢᏥᏰᎩ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎢᏣᏛᏁᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏥᏍᎦᏅᎨᏍᏗ; ᎢᎦᏛᏰᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏯᏂᎦᏔᎭ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ; ᎤᏕᎰᎯᏍᏗᏳ ᎢᏨᏃᎮᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᏥᏪᎭ.
\ft Awake to righteousness, and sin not; for some have not the knowledge of God: I speak this to your shame.

\ln Aseno gilo hia yinvgawi, Gado dagegvneli dodagegaletani tsuniyohusvhi?  ale gado usdesdi udotlvsv diniyelv anilutsvha?
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎯᎠ ᏱᏅᎦᏫ, ᎦᏙ ᏓᎨᎬᏁᎵ ᏙᏓᎨᎦᎴᏔᏂ ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯ?  ᎠᎴ ᎦᏙ ᎤᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᎤᏙᏢᏒ ᏗᏂᏰᎸ ᎠᏂᎷᏨᎭ?
\ft But some man will say, How are the dead raised up? and with what body do they come?

\ln Tsanegu!  nasgi tsiwisgoi vtla yvgvliyehvga gvni ugohi;
\syll ᏣᏁᎫ  ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏫᏍᎪᎢ ᎥᏝ ᏴᎬᎵᏰᎲᎦ ᎬᏂ ᎤᎪᎯ;
\ft Thou fool, that which thou sowest is not quickened, except it die:

\ln Ale nasgi tsiwisgoi, vtla nasgi ayelv udotlvdi gesv yiwisgoi, ugatahaquosgini, utsalesdiquo yigi, ale gohusdiquo usdi nvwadale yigi;
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏫᏍᎪᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏰᎸ ᎤᏙᏢᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏱᏫᏍᎪᎢ, ᎤᎦᏔᎭᏉᏍᎩᏂ, ᎤᏣᎴᏍᏗᏉ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎪᎱᏍᏗᏉ ᎤᏍᏗ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᏱᎩ;
\ft And that which thou sowest, thou sowest not that body that shall be, but bare grain, it may chance of wheat, or of some other grain:

\ln Unelanvhisgini aneho ayelv nasgiya osi uyelvnvi, ale nudalesv ugata utseligaya ayelvi.
\syll ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏁᎰ ᎠᏰᎸ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎣᏏ ᎤᏰᎸᏅᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏄᏓᎴᏒ ᎤᎦᏔ ᎤᏤᎵᎦᏯ ᎠᏰᎸᎢ.
\ft But God giveth it a body as it hath pleased him, and to every seed his own body.

\ln Nigadv uquedali gesv vtla utloyiha yigi; yvwiyeno uniquedalv sudalegi; nvwadaleno nvgi dininvsadi uniquedalvi, nvwadaleno atsadi, nvwadaleno tsisqua.
\syll ᏂᎦᏛ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎨᏒ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏠᏱᎭ ᏱᎩ; ᏴᏫᏰᏃ ᎤᏂᏇᏓᎸ ᏑᏓᎴᎩ; ᏅᏩᏓᎴᏃ ᏅᎩ ᏗᏂᏅᏌᏗ ᎤᏂᏇᏓᎸᎢ, ᏅᏩᏓᎴᏃ ᎠᏣᏗ, ᏅᏩᏓᎴᏃ ᏥᏍᏆ.
\ft All flesh is not the same flesh: but there is one kind of flesh of men, another flesh of beasts, another of fishes, and another of birds.

\ln Ale nasquo galvladi aneha digotlvnvhi, ale elohi aneha digotlvnvhi; aseno tsuwoduhiyu gesv galvladi anehi nvwadalei, ale tsuwoduhiyu gesv elohi anehi nvwadalei.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎠᏁᎭ ᏗᎪᏢᏅᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎠᏁᎭ ᏗᎪᏢᏅᎯ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᏧᏬᏚᎯᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎠᏁᎯ ᏅᏩᏓᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏬᏚᎯᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎠᏁᎯ ᏅᏩᏓᎴᎢ.
\ft There are also celestial bodies, and bodies terrestrial: but the glory of the celestial is one, and the glory of the terrestrial is another.

\ln Nvdo iga ehi utselidv uwoduhiyu gesvi, ale uwoduhiyu gesv nvdo svnoyi ehi nvwadalei, ale tsunoduhiyu gesv noquisi nvwadalei; ale noquisi kalv uwoduhiyu gesv nvwadale nusdo noquisi nusdv uwoduhiyu gesvi.
\syll ᏅᏙ ᎢᎦ ᎡᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᏛ ᎤᏬᏚᎯᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏬᏚᎯᏳ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏙ ᏒᏃᏱ ᎡᎯ ᏅᏩᏓᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏃᏚᎯᏳ ᎨᏒ ᏃᏈᏏ ᏅᏩᏓᎴᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᏃᏈᏏ ᎧᎸ ᎤᏬᏚᎯᏳ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᏄᏍᏙ ᏃᏈᏏ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎤᏬᏚᎯᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft There is one glory of the sun, and another glory of the moon, and another glory of the stars: for one star differeth from another star in glory.

\ln Nasgiya nasquo nusdi tsunalehisodi gesv tsuniyohusvhi.  Ayogi awisvhi gesoi; ayogi nigesvna diledodi gesesdi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏄᏍᏗ ᏧᎾᎴᎯᏐᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯ.  ᎠᏲᎩ ᎠᏫᏒᎯ ᎨᏐᎢ; ᎠᏲᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏗᎴᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft So also is the resurrection of the dead. It is sown in corruption; it is raised in incorruption:

\ln Galvquodi nigesvna awisvhi gesoi, galvquodiyu diledodi gesesdi; awanagala awisvhi gesoi, ulinigidv diledodi gesesdi;
\syll ᎦᎸᏉᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎠᏫᏒᎯ ᎨᏐᎢ, ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᏗᎴᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᎠᏩᎾᎦᎳ ᎠᏫᏒᎯ ᎨᏐᎢ, ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᏗᎴᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ;
\ft It is sown in dishonour; it is raised in glory: it is sown in weakness; it is raised in power:

\ln Idiwisgo uquedali ayelv awisvhi gesoi, adanvdo udotlvsv diledodi gesesdi.  Uquedali ayelv eha, ale adanvdo udotlvsv eha.
\syll ᎢᏗᏫᏍᎪ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎠᏰᎸ ᎠᏫᏒᎯ ᎨᏐᎢ, ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᏙᏢᏒ ᏗᎴᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.  ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎠᏰᎸ ᎡᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᏙᏢᏒ ᎡᎭ.
\ft It is sown a natural body; it is raised a spiritual body. There is a natural body, and there is a spiritual body.

\ln Nasgiyano hia nigvnv gawela, igvyiyi yvwi Adawi gvnodv nulistanei; oniyino Adawi adanvdo gvnidv dinehi nulistanei.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏯᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏅ ᎦᏪᎳ, ᎢᎬᏱᏱ ᏴᏫ ᎠᏓᏫ ᎬᏃᏛ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ; ᎣᏂᏱᏃ ᎠᏓᏫ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎬᏂᏛ ᏗᏁᎯ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ.
\ft And so it is written, The first man Adam was made a living soul; the last Adam was made a quickening spirit.

\ln Aseno vtla igvyi yigese nasgi na adanvdo tsigi, nasgisgini na aquedali tsigi; onino iyvdv nasgi na adanvdo tsigi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎢᎬᏱ ᏱᎨᏎ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ Ꮎ ᎠᏇᏓᎵ ᏥᎩ; ᎣᏂᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᏥᎩ.
\ft Howbeit that was not first which is spiritual, but that which is natural; and afterward that which is spiritual.

\ln Igvyiyi asgaya gadohi nvdayudalenvhi, gadaquo gesei; taline asgaya Ugvwiyuhi galvladi nvdayudalenvhi.
\syll ᎢᎬᏱᏱ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎦᏙᎯ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ, ᎦᏓᏉ ᎨᏎᎢ; ᏔᎵᏁ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ.
\ft The first man is of the earth, earthy: the second man is the Lord from heaven.

\ln Nusdv nasgi na gadaquo agotlvtanvhi tsigi, nasgiya nasquo nunasdi gadaquo gegotlvtanvhi; ale nusdv nasgi na galvladi ehi, nasgiya nasquo nunasdi galvladi anehi.
\syll ᏄᏍᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎦᏓᏉ ᎠᎪᏢᏔᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏄᎾᏍᏗ ᎦᏓᏉ ᎨᎪᏢᏔᏅᎯ; ᎠᎴ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏄᎾᏍᏗ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎠᏁᎯ.
\ft As is the earthy, such are they also that are earthy: and as is the heavenly, such are they also that are heavenly.

\ln Ale gada agotlvtanvhi nusdv nasgiya tsinigasdi, nasgiya nasquo nigasdesdi nusdv galvladi ehi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎦᏓ ᎠᎪᏢᏔᏅᎯ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏥᏂᎦᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏂᎦᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ.
\ft And as we have borne the image of the earthy, we shall also bear the image of the heavenly.

\ln Nasgino hia nitsiweha idalinvtli, nasgi uquedali gesv ale gigv vtla unatseli igvwalisdodi yigi Unelanvhi utseligohi; vtla ale ayogi gesv utseli igvwalisdodi yigi ayohi nigesvna gesvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏥᏪᎭ ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎩᎬ ᎥᏝ ᎤᎾᏤᎵ ᎢᎬᏩᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᏱᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎪᎯ; ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏲᎩ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎢᎬᏩᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᏱᎩ ᎠᏲᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Now this I say, brethren, that flesh and blood cannot inherit the kingdom of God; neither doth corruption inherit incorruption.

\ln Gvniyuquo, itsvnanugowise udelidv gesvi; vtla nigadv yvdadilinvtsi, nigadiyusgini eginetliyvsdi gesesdi
\syll ᎬᏂᏳᏉ, ᎢᏨᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎥᏝ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏴᏓᏗᎵᏅᏥ, ᏂᎦᏗᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎡᎩᏁᏟᏴᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ
\ft Behold, I shew you a mystery; We shall not all sleep, but we shall all be changed,

\ln Gilaquo iyvdv, tsidvgatanawisdiquo igohidv, ulisqualvdi atselugi nigalistanvha; atselugiyeno dayunoyvlasi, tsuniyohusvhino dodagegaletani aniyogi negesvna, ayvno dayeginetliyvsi.
\syll ᎩᎳᏉ ᎢᏴᏛ, ᏥᏛᎦᏔᎾᏫᏍᏗᏉ ᎢᎪᎯᏛ, ᎤᎵᏍᏆᎸᏗ ᎠᏤᎷᎩ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏔᏅᎭ; ᎠᏤᎷᎩᏰᏃ ᏓᏳᏃᏴᎳᏏ, ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯᏃ ᏙᏓᎨᎦᎴᏔᏂ ᎠᏂᏲᎩ ᏁᎨᏒᎾ, ᎠᏴᏃ ᏓᏰᎩᏁᏟᏴᏏ.
\ft In a moment, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trump: for the trumpet shall sound, and the dead shall be raised incorruptible, and we shall be changed.

\ln Hiayeno ayogi gesv ayogi nigesvna dvnuwostani, ale hia nasgi ayohusgi gesv ayohusgi nigesvna dvnuwostani.
\syll ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᎠᏲᎩ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏲᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏛᏄᏬᏍᏔᏂ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏲᎱᏍᎩ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏲᎱᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏛᏄᏬᏍᏔᏂ.
\ft For this corruptible must put on incorruption, and this mortal must put on immortality.

\ln Nasgino hnaquo hia ayogi gesv ayogi nigesvna gesv unuwostanesdi, ale hia nasgi ayohusgi ayohusgi nigesvna gesv unuwostanesdi, hnaquo nulistanesdi hia igawedv gesv tsigowela, Adalinehidisgi gesv ugisonv ayohuhisdi gesvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎿᏉ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏲᎩ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏲᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏄᏬᏍᏔᏁᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏲᎱᏍᎩ ᎠᏲᎱᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏄᏬᏍᏔᏁᏍᏗ, ᎿᏉ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁᏍᏗ ᎯᎠ ᎢᎦᏪᏛ ᎨᏒ ᏥᎪᏪᎳ, ᎠᏓᎵᏁᎯᏗᏍᎩ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎩᏐᏅ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft So when this corruptible shall have put on incorruption, and this mortal shall have put on immortality, then shall be brought to pass the saying that is written, Death is swallowed up in victory.

\ln Nihi ayohuhisdi gesvi, hatlv tsadatsvyasdigesvi?  nihi didanisodiyi gesvi, hatlv tsadasegogisdi gesvi?
\syll ᏂᎯ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎭᏢ ᏣᏓᏨᏯᏍᏗᎨᏒᎢ?  ᏂᎯ ᏗᏓᏂᏐᏗᏱ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎭᏢ ᏣᏓᏎᎪᎩᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ?
\ft O death, where is thy sting? O grave, where is thy victory?

\ln Ayohusdi udatsvyasdi gesv, nasgi asgani; asganino ulinigohisdisgi nasgi dikahnawadvsdi.
\syll ᎠᏲᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏓᏨᏯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ; ᎠᏍᎦᏂᏃ ᎤᎵᏂᎪᎯᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ.
\ft The sting of death is sin; and the strength of sin is the law.

\ln Aseno Unelanvhi alihelitsedi gesesdi, nasgi tsigineha igadasegogisdiyi, tsvdidalehvsga Ugvwiyuhi igatseli Tsisa Galonedv.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎵᎮᎵᏤᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᎩᏁᎭ ᎢᎦᏓᏎᎪᎩᏍᏗᏱ, ᏨᏗᏓᎴᎲᏍᎦ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ.
\ft But thanks be to God, which giveth us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi, itsvgeyui idalinvtli, ditsalinigidiyu gesesdi, gayetsitelvdi nigesvna gesesdi, nigohilv utsati detsilvwisdanehesdi Ugvwiyuhi utseli digalvwisdanedi gesvi, itsigatahayeno nasgi itsalinigvnehv Ugvwiyuhi utseli detsilvwisdanehv asequoquo nigesvna gesvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᎢᏨᎨᏳᎢ ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᏗᏣᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎦᏰᏥᏖᎸᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏕᏥᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎭᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏣᎵᏂᎬᏁᎲ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏕᏥᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᎠᏎᏉᏉ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Therefore, my beloved brethren, be ye stedfast, unmoveable, always abounding in the work of the Lord, forasmuch as ye know that your labour is not in vain in the Lord.

\ln Nano gatlisodi gesv unadanvti unalisdelvdodi ugvwali, nasgiya tsigatsinetselvi tsunanelodi dunadatlugv Gelesiyi, nasgiya nitsadvnehesdi.
\syll ᎾᏃ ᎦᏟᏐᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏥᎦᏥᏁᏤᎸᎢ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᏚᎾᏓᏡᎬ ᎨᎴᏏᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ.
\ft Now concerning the collection for the saints, as I have given order to the churches of Galatia, even so do ye.

\ln Igvyiyi iga sunadodaquasdi gesv itsisiyvwiha itsadanelvsgesdi nasgiya nusdv Unelanvhi itsinequoelvi, nasgino tlesdi witsilutsvha gila wigatlisodi yigesesdi.
\syll ᎢᎬᏱᏱ ᎢᎦ ᏑᎾᏙᏓᏆᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏥᏏᏴᏫᎭ ᎢᏣᏓᏁᎸᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᏥᏁᏉᎡᎸᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏫᏥᎷᏨᎭ ᎩᎳ ᏫᎦᏟᏐᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft Upon the first day of the week let every one of you lay by him in store, as God hath prospered him, that there be no gatherings when I come.

\ln Witsilutsvno nasgi na osiyu ditsiyelvnvhi, nasgi digatsiyagenvdisdi gesesdi goweli, nasgi aniyegi tsilusilimi nihi itsalisgolvtanvhi.
\syll ᏫᏥᎷᏨᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎣᏏᏳ ᏗᏥᏰᎸᏅᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎦᏥᏯᎨᏅᏗᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎪᏪᎵ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏂᏰᎩ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏅᎯ.
\ft And when I come, whomsoever ye shall approve by your letters, them will I send to bring your liberality unto Jerusalem.

\ln Iyu ale duyugodesdi nasquo ayv aquenvsdiyi, nasgi dayotsenvstani.
\syll ᎢᏳ ᎠᎴ ᏚᏳᎪᏕᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏴ ᎠᏇᏅᏍᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏓᏲᏤᏅᏍᏔᏂ.
\ft And if it be meet that I go also, they shall go with me.

\ln Ale wvdatsvlutseli, Masidoni ayeli agilosvhi gesesdi; masidoniyeno ayeli agilohisdiyi nigalisdiha.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏮᏓᏨᎷᏤᎵ, ᎹᏏᏙᏂ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎠᎩᎶᏒᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᎹᏏᏙᏂᏰᏃ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎠᎩᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᎭ.
\ft Now I will come unto you, when I shall pass through Macedonia: for I do pass through Macedonia.

\ln Ale wigvquadedi yinigagi, ale nasquo yaquagoladiyv itsehvi, nasgi sgiyatinvsdiyi gaisv ilvhitlv witsigadvi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏫᎬᏆᏕᏗ ᏱᏂᎦᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏯᏆᎪᎳᏗᏴ ᎢᏤᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏍᎩᏯᏘᏅᏍᏗᏱ ᎦᎢᏒ ᎢᎸᎯᏢ ᏫᏥᎦᏛᎢ.
\ft And it may be that I will abide, yea, and winter with you, that ye may bring me on my journey whithersoever I go.

\ln Vtlayeno yaquaduli gohi gesv gaisv itsvgowadvdiyi; aseno udugi aquvha ilvsgi igohidv itsvyadenediyi, iyuno Ugvwiyuhi osiyu yuyelvnv.
\syll ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᏯᏆᏚᎵ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎦᎢᏒ ᎢᏨᎪᏩᏛᏗᏱ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎠᏋᎭ ᎢᎸᏍᎩ ᎢᎪᎯᏛ ᎢᏨᏯᏕᏁᏗᏱ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎣᏏᏳ ᏳᏰᎸᏅ.
\ft For I will not see you now by the way; but I trust to tarry a while with you, if the Lord permit.

\ln Equisasgini gedohesdi hisgasgohine iga iyasdi.
\syll ᎡᏈᏌᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏙᎮᏍᏗ ᎯᏍᎦᏍᎪᎯᏁ ᎢᎦ ᎢᏯᏍᏗ.
\ft But I will tarry at Ephesus until Pentecost.

\ln Equohiyuyeno vgilanvdadelv ale utsati gohusdi gagvdodi, ale unitsata dinigatilegi.
\syll ᎡᏉᎯᏳᏰᏃ ᎥᎩᎳᏅᏓᏕᎸ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎦᎬᏙᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏣᏔ ᏗᏂᎦᏘᎴᎩ.
\ft For a great door and effectual is opened unto me, and there are many adversaries.

\ln Iyuno Dimadi wigalutsvha, itsagasayasdesdi niganayesgvnaquo itseladidasdiyi; dulvwisdaneyeno Ugvwiyuhi utseli digalvwisdanedi, utloyiquo ayv.
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᏗᎹᏗ ᏫᎦᎷᏨᎭ, ᎢᏣᎦᏌᏯᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᎾᏰᏍᎬᎾᏉ ᎢᏤᎳᏗᏓᏍᏗᏱ; ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏰᏃ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ, ᎤᏠᏱᏉ ᎠᏴ.
\ft Now if Timotheus come, see that he may be with you without fear: for he worketh the work of the Lord, as I also do.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi tlesdi gilo yuniquatihesdi; nvwadohiyadvquosgini tsetsanigistanvha, nasgi ayv agilutsediyi; tsigatenohayeno uluhisdiyi analinvtli anilutsvha.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎩᎶ ᏳᏂᏆᏘᎮᏍᏗ; ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᏤᏣᏂᎩᏍᏔᏅᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᎠᎩᎷᏤᏗᏱ; ᏥᎦᏖᏃᎭᏰᏃ ᎤᎷᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏟ ᎠᏂᎷᏨᎭ.
\ft Let no man therefore despise him: but conduct him forth in peace, that he may come unto me: for I look for him with the brethren.

\ln Ano Aquola iginvtli, utsati tsisdiyeda witsilutsediyi unenvsdodiyi analinvtli; aseno vtla yudulv ase gohi gesv uwenvsdiyi; wvdagalutsi adina udlanvdadelvha.
\syll ᎠᏃ ᎠᏉᎳ ᎢᎩᏅᏟ, ᎤᏣᏘ ᏥᏍᏗᏰᏓ ᏫᏥᎷᏤᏗᏱ ᎤᏁᏅᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏟ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏳᏚᎸ ᎠᏎ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏪᏅᏍᏗᏱ; ᏮᏓᎦᎷᏥ ᎠᏗᎾ ᎤᏜᏅᏓᏕᎸᎭ.
\ft As touching our brother Apollos, I greatly desired him to come unto you with the brethren: but his will was not at all to come at this time; but he will come when he shall have convenient time.

\ln Itsiyawisgesdi, ulinigidv detsiniyvsesdi gohiyudi gesvi, itsisgaya gesesdi, ditsalinigidiyu gesesdi.
\syll ᎢᏥᏯᏫᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᏕᏥᏂᏴᏎᏍᏗ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎢᏥᏍᎦᏯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᏗᏣᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft Watch ye, stand fast in the faith, quit you like men, be strong.

\ln Nigadv detsilvwisdanehv adageyudi gesv itsvdisgesdi.
\syll ᏂᎦᏛ ᏕᏥᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏨᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
\ft Let all your things be done with charity.

\ln Alewo idalinvtli, detsigataha Sdiquena dudatinavi, nasgi igvyi udatanvhi gesv Agaya, ale nasgi dunadayosv tsunisdelvhidasdiyi unadanvti;
\syll ᎠᎴᏬ ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᏕᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᏍᏗᏇᎾ ᏚᏓᏘᎾᎥᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎬᏱ ᎤᏓᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎦᏯ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᎾᏓᏲᏒ ᏧᏂᏍᏕᎸᎯᏓᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ;
\ft I beseech you, brethren, (ye know the house of Stephanas, that it is the firstfruits of Achaia, and that they have addicted themselves to the ministry of the saints,)

\ln Itsvtayoseha nihi ditsohiyudiyi nasgi iyunasdi, ale naniv itsulaha tsunilvwisdanehi analinigvnehi.
\syll ᎢᏨᏔᏲᏎᎭ ᏂᎯ ᏗᏦᎯᏳᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᎠᎾᎵᏂᎬᏁᎯ.
\ft That ye submit yourselves unto such, and to every one that helpeth with us, and laboureth.

\ln Galieliga gvgilutselv Sdiquena ale Quoduneda ale Agayiga; nihiyeno tsitsilulotsehvgi anikalisisa nasgi.
\syll ᎦᎵᎡᎵᎦ ᎬᎩᎷᏤᎸ ᏍᏗᏇᎾ ᎠᎴ ᏉᏚᏁᏓ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎦᏱᎦ; ᏂᎯᏰᏃ ᏥᏥᎷᎶᏤᎲᎩ ᎠᏂᎧᎵᏏᏌ ᎾᏍᎩ.
\ft I am glad of the coming of Stephanas and Fortunatus and Achaicus: for that which was lacking on your part they have supplied.

\ln Anigalisdadayeno aquadanvdo, ale nihi ditsadanvdo.  Nasgi iyusdi detsilvquodesdiquo nasgi iyunasdi.
\syll ᎠᏂᎦᎵᏍᏓᏓᏰᏃ ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏙ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎯ ᏗᏣᏓᏅᏙ.  ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏕᏥᎸᏉᏕᏍᏗᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗ.
\ft For they have refreshed my spirit and yours: therefore acknowledge ye them that are such.

\ln Tsunanelodi dunadatluwadisv Esiyi wigetsiyoliha.  Equila ale Quisila utsati wigetsiyoliha Ugvwiyuhi tsunanelodi unadayolisdi gesvi, gvwanaligoneha tsunanelodi unadatlugv nasgi aninelvi.
\syll ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᏚᎾᏓᏡᏩᏗᏒ ᎡᏏᏱ ᏫᎨᏥᏲᎵᎭ.  ᎡᏈᎳ ᎠᎴ ᏈᏏᎳ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏫᎨᏥᏲᎵᎭ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏲᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎬᏩᎾᎵᎪᏁᎭ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏂᏁᎸᎢ.
\ft The churches of Asia salute you. Aquila and Priscilla salute you much in the Lord, with the church that is in their house.

\ln Nigadv idalinvtli wigetsiyoliha.  Detsadayolisdisgesdi galvquodiyu didadowedovsdi gesvi.
\syll ᏂᎦᏛ ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ ᏫᎨᏥᏲᎵᎭ.  ᏕᏣᏓᏲᎵᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᏗᏓᏙᏪᏙᎥᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft All the brethren greet you. Greet ye one another with an holy kiss.

\ln Ayv Quola aquadayolisdi gesv aquvsv aquoyeni aquvtanvhi aquowelanvhi.
\syll ᎠᏴ ᏉᎳ ᎠᏆᏓᏲᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏋᏒ ᎠᏉᏰᏂ ᎠᏋᏔᏅᎯ ᎠᏉᏪᎳᏅᎯ.
\ft The salutation of me Paul with mine own hand.

\ln Iyuno gilo nugeyusvna igesesdi Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv, nasgi atsisginvdvhi gesesdi.  Ugvwiyuhi dagalutsi.
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᏄᎨᏳᏒᎾ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏥᏍᎩᏅᏛᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.  ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏓᎦᎷᏥ.
\ft If any man love not the Lord Jesus Christ, let him be Anathema Maranatha.

\ln Gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv igatseli Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv detsikahnawadidohesdi.
\syll ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏕᏥᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎮᏍᏗ.
\ft The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.

\ln Ayv aquadageyudi gesv detsikahnawadidohesdi nitsivi, Tsisa Galonedv gesv nvdigalisdodisgesdi.  Emenv.
\syll ᎠᏴ ᎠᏆᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏕᏥᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎮᏍᏗ ᏂᏥᎥᎢ, ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ.  ᎡᎺᏅ.
\ft My love be with you all in Christ Jesus. Amen.

\ln Quola, Tsisa Galonedv aginvsidv nasgiya Unelanvhi udanvtelvi, ale Dimadi iginvtli, witsvyowelasi ditsanelodi itsadatlugv Unelanvhi utseliga Golinidiyi tsitsadatlugv, ale nigadv itsadanvti nigvnadv Agaya itsehvi;
\syll ᏉᎳ, ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎠᎩᏅᏏᏛ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏓᏅᏖᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎹᏗ ᎢᎩᏅᏟ, ᏫᏨᏲᏪᎳᏏ ᏗᏣᏁᎶᏗ ᎢᏣᏓᏡᎬ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᎪᎵᏂᏗᏱ ᏥᏣᏓᏡᎬ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏘ ᏂᎬᎾᏛ ᎠᎦᏯ ᎢᏤᎲᎢ;
\ft Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, and Timothy our brother, unto the church of God which is at Corinth, with all the saints which are in all Achaia:

\ln Gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv ale nvwadohiyadv itseladidohesdi nvdayunalisgolvtanvhi Unelanvhi Igidoda, ale Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv.
\syll ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᎢᏤᎳᏗᏙᎮᏍᏗ ᏅᏓᏳᎾᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏅᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᎩᏙᏓ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ.
\ft Grace be to you and peace from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.

\ln Galvquododi gesesdi Unelanvhi, nasgi Udoda Ugvwiyuhi igatseli Tsisa Galonedv, udadolitsati Agayvligei, nasgi Unelanvhi nigav adagalisdadisgi;
\syll ᎦᎸᏉᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏙᏓ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ, ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏣᏘ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎠᏓᎦᎵᏍᏓᏗᏍᎩ;
\ft Blessed be God, even the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies, and the God of all comfort;

\ln Nasgi ogigalisdadisgi tsigi nigav tsudalenvdv otsigiliyogvi, nasgi iyuwanisodiyi yeli digayotsigalisdadisdi anigiliyogi, gayogvdodi nasgi adagalisdadisgi ogvsv ogigalisdadisdisgv Unelanvhi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᎩᎦᎵᏍᏓᏗᏍᎩ ᏥᎩ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎣᏥᎩᎵᏲᎬᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏐᏗᏱ ᏰᎵ ᏗᎦᏲᏥᎦᎵᏍᏓᏗᏍᏗ ᎠᏂᎩᎵᏲᎩ, ᎦᏲᎬᏙᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏓᎦᎵᏍᏓᏗᏍᎩ ᎣᎬᏒ ᎣᎩᎦᎵᏍᏓᏗᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ.
\ft Who comforteth us in all our tribulation, that we may be able to comfort them which are in any trouble, by the comfort wherewith we ourselves are comforted of God.

\ln Nasgiyayeno Galonedv ugiliyotsv utsati tsotsigiliyoga, nasgiya nasquo utsata ogineha adagalisdadisgi Galonedv gesv nvdayudalenvhi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏯᏰᏃ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᎩᎵᏲᏨ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏦᏥᎩᎵᏲᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᏣᏔ ᎣᎩᏁᎭ ᎠᏓᎦᎵᏍᏓᏗᏍᎩ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ.
\ft For as the sufferings of Christ abound in us, so our consolation also aboundeth by Christ.

\ln Iyu ale nasquo yotsigiliyoga, itsigalisdadisdi ale itsalisdelvdodi ugvwala, nasgi tsitsiwadveha ditsvnidiyu itsigiliyoisdiyi ayv otsigiliyogv utloyi; iyu ale ugalisdi yogadanvta, itsigalisdadisdi ale itsalisdelvdodi ugvwala.
\syll ᎢᏳ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏲᏥᎩᎵᏲᎦ, ᎢᏥᎦᎵᏍᏓᏗᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ ᎤᎬᏩᎳ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏥᏩᏛᎡᎭ ᏗᏨᏂᏗᏳ ᎢᏥᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᏴ ᎣᏥᎩᎵᏲᎬ ᎤᏠᏱ; ᎢᏳ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎦᎵᏍᏗ ᏲᎦᏓᏅᏔ, ᎢᏥᎦᎵᏍᏓᏗᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ ᎤᎬᏩᎳ.
\ft And whether we be afflicted, it is for your consolation and salvation, which is effectual in the enduring of the same sufferings which we also suffer: or whether we be comforted, it is for your consolation and salvation.

\ln Ale udugi itsvyvsv ulinigidiyu, nvdigalisdodiha tsotsigataha, nasgi itsatloyasdisgv agiliyoisdi gesvi, nasgiya nasquo itsatloyasdodi gesesdi ugalisdi gesvi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎢᏨᏴᏒ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᏦᏥᎦᏔᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏣᏠᏯᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᎠᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎢᏣᏠᏯᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᎦᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft And our hope of you is stedfast, knowing, that as ye are partakers of the sufferings, so shall ye be also of the consolation.

\ln Vtlayeno yogaduliha, idalinvli, nitsigatahvnaquo iyulisdodiyi nasgi udeyadodi ogilutselv Esiyi, nasgi ulosvstanvhi gagedv ogilutselvi, ulosvstanvhi nidogalinigvgvi, nasgino nvdagalisdodisgvgi ogalvyolilvgi tsogadvnidisdiyi;
\syll ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᏲᎦᏚᎵᎭ, ᎢᏓᎵᏅᎵ, ᏂᏥᎦᏔᎲᎾᏉ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏕᏯᏙᏗ ᎣᎩᎷᏤᎸ ᎡᏏᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎶᏒᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎦᎨᏛ ᎣᎩᎷᏤᎸᎢ, ᎤᎶᏒᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᏂᏙᎦᎵᏂᎬᎬᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᎣᎦᎸᏲᎵᎸᎩ ᏦᎦᏛᏂᏗᏍᏗᏱ;
\ft For we would not, brethren, have you ignorant of our trouble which came to us in Asia, that we were pressed out of measure, above strength, insomuch that we despaired even of life:

\ln Aseno ogihvgi tsogiyohuhisdiyi dudugotanvi, nasgi yigvsvquo ogadalisgasdodiyi nigesvna, Unelanvhisgini otsalisgasdodiyi, nasgi na tsuniyohusvhi dilehisodisgi;
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎣᎩᎲᎩ ᏦᎩᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏚᏚᎪᏔᏅᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᎬᏒᏉ ᎣᎦᏓᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎣᏣᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᏗᎴᎯᏐᏗᏍᎩ;
\ft But we had the sentence of death in ourselves, that we should not trust in ourselves, but in God which raiseth the dead:

\ln Nasgi na ogudaledv nasgi iyunayehisdi ayohuhisdi gesvi, ale nasgi na asi tsogudaleha; nasgi udugi tsotsvnaneha asiquo ogudalesdiyi;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎣᎫᏓᎴᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᎾᏰᎯᏍᏗ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᏏ ᏦᎫᏓᎴᎭ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏚᎩ ᏦᏨᎾᏁᎭ ᎠᏏᏉ ᎣᎫᏓᎴᏍᏗᏱ;
\ft Who delivered us from so great a death, and doth deliver: in whom we trust that he will yet deliver us;

\ln Nihi nasquo sgisdelisgv itsadadolisdisgv ogisdelvdiyi, nasgi ogidolitsv unitsati iyunvnisadv nvdayulisdodiyi unitsati unalihelitsediyi [Unelanvhi] ayv gesv iyusdi.
\syll ᏂᎯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏍᎩᏍᏕᎵᏍᎬ ᎢᏣᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᎣᎩᏍᏕᎸᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᎩᏙᎵᏨ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎢᏳᏅᏂᏌᏛ ᏅᏓᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎤᎾᎵᎮᎵᏤᏗᏱ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯdata is invalid ᎠᏴ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ.
\ft Ye also helping together by prayer for us, that for the gift bestowed upon us by the means of many persons thanks may be given by many on our behalf.

\ln Hiayeno nvdigalisdodiha tsotsaliheliga, nasgi tsogadanvdogi gohiyudisgvi, notsvdisgvna uquedaliquo ugvwali agadovhisdi gesvi, Unelanvhisgini gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv ogisdelisgvi, nutlonasdvna gesv otsvdisgv ogedolv ani elohi gesvi; ale ho ugvwiyuha nihi itsehvi.
\syll ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᏦᏣᎵᎮᎵᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏦᎦᏓᏅᏙᎩ ᎪᎯᏳᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᏃᏨᏗᏍᎬᎾ ᎤᏇᏓᎵᏉ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᎠᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎣᎩᏍᏕᎵᏍᎬᎢ, ᏄᏠᎾᏍᏛᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎣᏨᏗᏍᎬ ᎣᎨᏙᎸ ᎠᏂ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎠᎴ Ꮀ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎭ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏤᎲᎢ.
\ft For our rejoicing is this, the testimony of our conscience, that in simplicity and godly sincerity, not with fleshly wisdom, but by the grace of God, we have had our conversation in the world, and more abundantly to you-ward.

\ln Vtlayeno nvwadale gohusdi yitsvyowelaneha, nasgi na uwasv tsitsigataha ale nasquo tsidetsadanilvtsv; ale udugi aquvha gvlisquadisgi ditsadanilvisdiyi gesvi;
\syll ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏱᏨᏲᏪᎳᏁᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏥᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏥᏕᏣᏓᏂᎸᏨ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎠᏋᎭ ᎬᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᎩ ᏗᏣᏓᏂᎸᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎨᏒᎢ;
\ft For we write none other things unto you, than what ye read or acknowledge; and I trust ye shall acknowledge even to the end;

\ln Nasgiya nasquo yeliganage disgiyadanilvtsvhi tsigi, nasgi ayv gesv itsvyalielisdisgvi, nasgiya sgiyalielisdodi tsigi, nahiyu Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa utseli iga gesesdi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏰᎵᎦᎾᎨ ᏗᏍᎩᏯᏓᏂᎸᏨᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏨᏯᎵᎡᎵᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏍᎩᏯᎵᎡᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᏥᎩ, ᏀᎢᏳ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎢᎦ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft As also ye have acknowledged us in part, that we are your rejoicing, even as ye also are ours in the day of the Lord Jesus.

\ln Nasgino hia nusdv aquohiyusv aquadanvtelvgi gohi gesv asi nasqualisgvna witsvlutsediyi, nasgi iyuwanisodiyi taline osdv itsadanvdadisdiyi;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎠᏉᎯᏳᏒ ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏖᎸᎩ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏏ ᎾᏍᏆᎵᏍᎬᎾ ᏫᏨᎷᏤᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏐᏗᏱ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗᏱ;
\ft And in this confidence I was minded to come unto you before, that ye might have a second benefit;

\ln Ale witsvloisdanediyi Masidoni wagiluhisdiyi, ale Masidoni diganigisv taline nvdatsvlutsediyi, ale Tsudiyi witsigadv sgiyatinvsdiyi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏫᏨᎶᎢᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᎹᏏᏙᏂ ᏩᎩᎷᎯᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎹᏏᏙᏂ ᏗᎦᏂᎩᏒ ᏔᎵᏁ ᏅᏓᏨᎷᏤᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏗᏱ ᏫᏥᎦᏛ ᏍᎩᏯᏘᏅᏍᏗᏱ.
\ft And to pass by you into Macedonia, and to come again out of Macedonia unto you, and of you to be brought on my way toward Judaea.

\ln Nasgino tsinusdv tsaquadanvtelvgi, nvlisaliquosgo agiyelvhi gesei?  ale gohusdi gadanvdvli, tsigo uquedali udanvtedi gadatesgoi, nasgino ayv tsinegv hiaquo yinusdi, vv, vv, ale vtla, vtla?
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏥᏄᏍᏛ ᏣᏆᏓᏅᏖᎸᎩ, ᏅᎵᏌᎵᏉᏍᎪ ᎠᎩᏰᎸᎯ ᎨᏎᎢ?  ᎠᎴ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎦᏓᏅᏛᎵ, ᏥᎪ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎤᏓᏅᏖᏗ ᎦᏓᏖᏍᎪᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎠᏴ ᏥᏁᎬ ᎯᎠᏉ ᏱᏄᏍᏗ, ᎥᎥ, ᎥᎥ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ, ᎥᏝ?
\ft When I therefore was thus minded, did I use lightness? or the things that I purpose, do I purpose according to the flesh, that with me there should be yea yea, and nay nay?

\ln Unelanvhisgini nudalidasdvna tsigi, nasgi [nudohiyuha] ayv itsvnetsehv vv ale vtla nigesvna gesvi.
\syll ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᏄᏓᎵᏓᏍᏛᎾ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏙᎯᏳᎭdata is invalid ᎠᏴ ᎢᏨᏁᏤᎲ ᎥᎥ ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft But as God is true, our word toward you was not yea and nay.

\ln Unelanvhiyeno Uwetsi Tsisa Galonedv, nasgi itsehv itsvyalitsidonelvhi tsigi, nasgi ayv, ale Siliwena, ale Dimadi itsvyalitsidonelvhi tsigi, vv ale vtla udvdiyi vtla yogadvnei, vvsgini uwasv udvdiyi gvnigesv nogvnelvgi.
\syll ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ ᎤᏪᏥ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏤᎲ ᎢᏨᏯᎵᏥᏙᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ, ᎠᎴ ᏏᎵᏪᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎹᏗ ᎢᏨᏯᎵᏥᏙᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎥᎥ ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏛᏗᏱ ᎥᏝ ᏲᎦᏛᏁᎢ, ᎥᎥᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎤᏛᏗᏱ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏃᎬᏁᎸᎩ.
\ft For the Son of God, Jesus Christ, who was preached among you by us, even by me and Silvanus and Timotheus, was not yea and nay, but in him was yea.

\ln Nagadvyeno uduistanvi Unelanvhi nasgi na iyuwanisadv, vv gvdvdi, ale udohiyuhiya geso nasgi iyuwanisadv, nasgi Unelanvhi atsilvquododiyi ayv iyogvnediyi.
\syll ᎾᎦᏛᏰᏃ ᎤᏚᎢᏍᏔᏅᎢ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ, ᎥᎥ ᎬᏛᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎨᏐ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏙᏗᏱ ᎠᏴ ᎢᏲᎬᏁᏗᏱ.
\ft For all the promises of God in him are yea, and in him Amen, unto the glory of God by us.

\ln Nasgino ayv ale nihi itsulaha digalinigohisdisgi Galonedv edatseliga gesvi, ale igilonevhi, nasgi na Unelanvhi;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎠᏴ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᏗᎦᎵᏂᎪᎯᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎡᏓᏤᎵᎦ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᎩᎶᏁᎥᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ;
\ft Now he which stablisheth us with you in Christ, and hath anointed us, is God;

\ln Nasgi na nasquo igiyelvtanvhi tsigi, ale iginelvhi tsigi diginawiyi Adanvdo agatidisdodi gesvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎢᎩᏰᎸᏔᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᎩᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ ᏗᎩᎾᏫᏱ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎠᎦᏘᏗᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Who hath also sealed us, and given the earnest of the Spirit in our hearts.

\ln Ale Unelanvhi tsitayoseha agatahi iyulisdodiyi aquadanvdo uwohiyudanediyi, nasgi itsvgeyuvsgv nvdigalisdodisgv asi Golinidiyi winitsilugvna tsigi;
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏥᏔᏲᏎᎭ ᎠᎦᏔᎯ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᏬᎯᏳᏓᏁᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏨᎨᏳᎥᏍᎬ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬ ᎠᏏ ᎪᎵᏂᏗᏱ ᏫᏂᏥᎷᎬᎾ ᏥᎩ;
\ft Moreover I call God for a record upon my soul, that to spare you I came not as yet unto Corinth.

\ln Vtla adina itsvyadanvtehehi gesv itsohiyusvi, otsisdelisgiquosgini gesv itsaliheligvi; itsohiyusvyeno nigalisdodi asi tsidetsidoga.
\syll ᎥᏝ ᎠᏗᎾ ᎢᏨᏯᏓᏅᏖᎮᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏦᎯᏳᏒᎢ, ᎣᏥᏍᏕᎵᏍᎩᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏣᎵᎮᎵᎬᎢ; ᎢᏦᎯᏳᏒᏰᏃ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᎠᏏ ᏥᏕᏥᏙᎦ.
\ft Not for that we have dominion over your faith, but are helpers of your joy: for by faith ye stand.

\ln Aseno hia nusdvgi aquvsv gesv daquugotanvgi, nasgi taline witsvlutsediyi nigesvna uyo gvquadanvti.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏍᏛᎩ ᎠᏋᏒ ᎨᏒ ᏓᏊᎪᏔᏅᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏔᎵᏁ ᏫᏨᎷᏤᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎤᏲ ᎬᏆᏓᏅᏘ.
\ft But I determined this with myself, that I would not come again to you in heaviness.

\ln Iyuyeno uyo yitsvyadanvdadistanv, gago osdv yaquadanvdadisda, nasgiquo na uwasv uyo tsiyadanvdadistanvhi?
\syll ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᎤᏲ ᏱᏨᏯᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏔᏅ, ᎦᎪ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏯᏆᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏓ, ᎾᏍᎩᏉ Ꮎ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎤᏲ ᏥᏯᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏔᏅᎯ?
\ft For if I make you sorry, who is he then that maketh me glad, but the same which is made sorry by me?

\ln Ale nasgi tsinusdv tsiwitsvyowelanelvgi, tlesdiquo nahna witsilutsvha, uyo yigvquadanvdadistanesdi nasgi na ulihelisdi gvquadanvdadisdodi tsigi, aquelisvgi; nitsivquo itsvyoiyuha nasgi nusdv aqualihelisdisgv nasquo nasgi nihi nitsiv itsalihelisdisgvi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏄᏍᏛ ᏥᏫᏨᏲᏪᎳᏁᎸᎩ, ᏞᏍᏗᏉ ᏀᎾ ᏫᏥᎷᏨᎭ, ᎤᏲ ᏱᎬᏆᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏔᏁᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᎵᎮᎵᏍᏗ ᎬᏆᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏙᏗ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᏇᎵᏒᎩ; ᏂᏥᎥᏉ ᎢᏨᏲᎢᏳᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎠᏆᎵᎮᎵᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎯ ᏂᏥᎥ ᎢᏣᎵᎮᎵᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ.
\ft And I wrote this same unto you, lest, when I came, I should have sorrow from them of whom I ought to rejoice; having confidence in you all, that my joy is the joy of you all.

\ln Utsatiyeno agiliya gesv, ale ehisdi aquadanvtawadegv witsvyowelanelvgi utsati digatsigasawoihi gesvi; vtla adina uyo unadanvdadisdodi gesesdi yaquelisei, itsigadovhisdiyiquosgini nasgi utsatanvhi itsvgeyuiyu gesvi.
\syll ᎤᏣᏘᏰᏃ ᎠᎩᎵᏯ ᎨᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᎡᎯᏍᏗ ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏔᏩᏕᎬ ᏫᏨᏲᏪᎳᏁᎸᎩ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏗᎦᏥᎦᏌᏬᎢᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎥᏝ ᎠᏗᎾ ᎤᏲ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏯᏇᎵᏎᎢ, ᎢᏥᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗᏱᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏣᏔᏅᎯ ᎢᏨᎨᏳᎢᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft For out of much affliction and anguish of heart I wrote unto you with many tears; not that ye should be grieved, but that ye might know the love which I have more abundantly unto you.

\ln Iyusgininonv gilo ehisdi tsudanvdadistanvhi gesesdi, vtla ayvquo ehisdi yaquadanvdadistanv; nihisgini nitsiv yeli ehisdi itsadanvdadistanv; nasgi tsilosvsdanediyi nigesvna tsilawisehvi.
\syll ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎩᎶ ᎡᎯᏍᏗ ᏧᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᏴᏉ ᎡᎯᏍᏗ ᏯᏆᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏔᏅ; ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᏂᏥᎥ ᏰᎵ ᎡᎯᏍᏗ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏔᏅ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᎶᏒᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏥᎳᏫᏎᎲᎢ.
\ft But if any have caused grief, he hath not grieved me, but in part: that I may not overcharge you all.

\ln Aliquo nasgi iyusdi [asgaya] nvsdvdvi nasgi unitsati tsigvwasdvdistanv.
\syll ᎠᎵᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏍᎦᏯdata is invalid ᏅᏍᏛᏛᎢ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏥᎬᏩᏍᏛᏗᏍᏔᏅ.
\ft Sufficient to such a man is this punishment, which was inflicted of many.

\ln Nasgino gohi gesv yetsidolitsvquo, ale yetsigalisdadv, yinvsegagi nasgi utsati uyo uyelvsv yunoyvtisda.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏰᏥᏙᎵᏨᏉ, ᎠᎴ ᏰᏥᎦᎵᏍᏓᏛ, ᏱᏅᏎᎦᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᏲ ᎤᏰᎸᏒ ᏳᏃᏴᏘᏍᏓ.
\ft So that contrariwise ye ought rather to forgive him, and comfort him, lest perhaps such a one should be swallowed up with overmuch sorrow.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi itsvtayoseha etsisdayidediyi etsigeyuiyu gesvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏨᏔᏲᏎᎭ ᎡᏥᏍᏓᏱᏕᏗᏱ ᎡᏥᎨᏳᎢᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Wherefore I beseech you that ye would confirm your love toward him.

\ln Nasgiyeno hia ho ugvwalvgi tsiwitsvyowelanelvgi, nasgi itsvgoliyesgvgi, nasgi nigav tsudalenvdv nitsvwesehv nitsadvnehv ale nitsadvnehvna gesvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎯᎠ Ꮀ ᎤᎬᏩᎸᎩ ᏥᏫᏨᏲᏪᎳᏁᎸᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏨᎪᎵᏰᏍᎬᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎲ ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎲ ᎠᎴ ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎲᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft For to this end also did I write, that I might know the proof of you, whether ye be obedient in all things.

\ln Gilo yetsivelv gohusdi usganvtsv, ayv nasquo tsiveha; iyuyeno ayv gohusdi asganvtsvi yitsivsga, nasgi tsivelvhi nihi gesv nvdayulisdotanvgi tsivelvgi Galonedv agatahvi;
\syll ᎩᎶ ᏰᏥᎥᎡᎸ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏍᎦᏅᏨ, ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏥᎥᎡᎭ; ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᎠᏴ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎠᏍᎦᏅᏨᎢ ᏱᏥᎥᏍᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᎥᎡᎸᎯ ᏂᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏓᏳᎵᏍᏙᏔᏅᎩ ᏥᎥᎡᎸᎩ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎠᎦᏔᎲᎢ;
\ft To whom ye forgive any thing, I forgive also: for if I forgave any thing, to whom I forgave it, for your sakes forgave I it in the person of Christ;

\ln Nasgi Asgina igilonuhediyi nigesvna; vtlayeno yigigonelv nasgi adanvtelidohvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᎩᎾ ᎢᎩᎶᏄᎮᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ; ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᏱᎩᎪᏁᎸ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏓᏅᏖᎵᏙᎲᎢ.
\ft Lest Satan should get an advantage of us: for we are not ignorant of his devices.

\ln Alewo Tloasi digilutsv osdv kanohedv Galonedv utseli aqualitsidonilv, ale galohisdiyi agisdugielv Ugvwiyuhi,
\syll ᎠᎴᏬ ᏠᎠᏏ ᏗᎩᎷᏨ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎠᏆᎵᏥᏙᏂᎸ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᎩᏍᏚᎩᎡᎸ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ,
\ft Furthermore, when I came to Troas to preach Christ's gospel, and a door was opened unto me of the Lord,

\ln Vtla dohi gvquadanvdadisdi yigese diquadanvdvi, nvdagalisdodisgvgi Dadasi vginvtli nitsiwadvhvna gesvi; vgatsiyvdetsvgino nahna Aquanigisvgi Masidoni wagilutsvgi.
\syll ᎥᏝ ᏙᎯ ᎬᏆᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗ ᏱᎨᏎ ᏗᏆᏓᏅᏛᎢ, ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᏓᏓᏏ ᎥᎩᏅᏟ ᏂᏥᏩᏛᎲᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎥᎦᏥᏴᏕᏨᎩᏃ ᏀᎾ ᎠᏆᏂᎩᏒᎩ ᎹᏏᏙᏂ ᏩᎩᎷᏨᎩ.
\ft I had no rest in my spirit, because I found not Titus my brother: but taking my leave of them, I went from thence into Macedonia.

\ln Nasgino alihelitsedi gesesdi Unelanvhi nasgi nigohilv igalihelisdiyi tsinigvneha igadalinehidv ugvwali Galonedv edalisgasdodvi, ale gvnigesv tsinigvneha gawasvgv uwasv atsigadovhisdi gesv ayv igvdisgv nigav degesadisvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎠᎵᎮᎵᏤᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎢᎦᎵᎮᎵᏍᏗᏱ ᏥᏂᎬᏁᎭ ᎢᎦᏓᎵᏁᎯᏛ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎡᏓᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏛᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏥᏂᎬᏁᎭ ᎦᏩᏒᎬ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎠᏥᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏴ ᎢᎬᏗᏍᎬ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏕᎨᏌᏗᏒᎢ.
\ft Now thanks be unto God, which always causeth us to triumph in Christ, and maketh manifest the savour of his knowledge by us in every place.

\ln Ayvyeno uganasdv gawasvgi Unelanvhi uwewasvisdi notsalisdiha Galonedv utseliga, nasgi getsisdelvdi tsigi, ale nasgi tsuniyohuhisdi tsigi.
\syll ᎠᏴᏰᏃ ᎤᎦᎾᏍᏛ ᎦᏩᏒᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏪᏩᏒᎢᏍᏗ ᏃᏣᎵᏍᏗᎭ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᏥᏍᏕᎸᏗ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏂᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᏥᎩ.
\ft For we are unto God a sweet savour of Christ, in them that are saved, and in them that perish:

\ln Nasgi sunadalegi gesv adahihi gawasvgi nasgi unihihi nidotsalisdaneha; anisoino adadvnidisgi gawasvgi nasgi unvnidisgi nidotsalisdaneha.  Gagono yeli gayegagenvdisdi hia nasgi digalvwisdanedi gesvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏑᎾᏓᎴᎩ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏓᎯᎯ ᎦᏩᏒᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᎯᎯ ᏂᏙᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᎭ; ᎠᏂᏐᎢᏃ ᎠᏓᏛᏂᏗᏍᎩ ᎦᏩᏒᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏅᏂᏗᏍᎩ ᏂᏙᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᎭ.  ᎦᎪᏃ ᏰᎵ ᎦᏰᎦᎨᏅᏗᏍᏗ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft To the one we are the savour of death unto death; and to the other the savour of life unto life. And who is sufficient for these things?

\ln Vtsayeno tsunitsataquo tsinunasdi yinogasdi, nasgi aniyosdisgi kanohedv Unelanvhi utseliga; nogatlonasdvnasgini gesv tsotsvdisgoi, Unelanvhisgini tsinigvnisisgo nasgiyai, Unelanvhi agatahv otsineisdi Galonedv.
\syll ᎥᏣᏰᏃ ᏧᏂᏣᏔᏉ ᏥᏄᎾᏍᏗ ᏱᏃᎦᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏂᏲᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ; ᏃᎦᏠᎾᏍᏛᎾᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏒ ᏦᏨᏗᏍᎪᎢ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᏥᏂᎬᏂᏏᏍᎪ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎦᏔᎲ ᎣᏥᏁᎢᏍᏗ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ.
\ft For we are not as many, which corrupt the word of God: but as of sincerity, but as of God, in the sight of God speak we in Christ.

\ln Tsigo taline otsaleni ogvsv otsadalvquodiha?  tsigoge ase widitsvnohedi nogalisdaneha, goweli ogilvquodisgi gilo tsinunalisdanehoi, ale nihi disginvnelvhi sgilvquodisgi?
\syll ᏥᎪ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎣᏣᎴᏂ ᎣᎬᏒ ᎣᏣᏓᎸᏉᏗᎭ?  ᏥᎪᎨ ᎠᏎ ᏫᏗᏨᏃᎮᏗ ᏃᎦᎵᏍᏓᏁᎭ, ᎪᏪᎵ ᎣᎩᎸᏉᏗᏍᎩ ᎩᎶ ᏥᏄᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᎰᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎯ ᏗᏍᎩᏅᏁᎸᎯ ᏍᎩᎸᏉᏗᏍᎩ?
\ft Do we begin again to commend ourselves? or need we, as some others, epistles of commendation to you, or letters of commendation from you?

\ln Nihi goweli ogatseliga, tsigowela tsoginawihi, naniv yvwi tsanigataha ale tsanigoliyea.
\syll ᏂᎯ ᎪᏪᎵ ᎣᎦᏤᎵᎦ, ᏥᎪᏪᎳ ᏦᎩᎾᏫᎯ, ᎾᏂᎥ ᏴᏫ ᏣᏂᎦᏔᎭ ᎠᎴ ᏣᏂᎪᎵᏰᎠ.
\ft Ye are our epistle written in our hearts, known and read of all men:

\ln Gvnigesviyu iyetsvnelvhi nihi Galonedv utseli goweli gesvi, ayv tsogilvwisdanelvhi, gowelanvhi gowelodi gvtanvhi nigesvna, Adanvdosgini Unelanvhi gvnidv utseli gvtanvhi; vtla nvyohi digowelodiyi digowelanvhi yigi, uquedalisgini gesv digowelodiyi onawiyi.
\syll ᎬᏂᎨᏒᎢᏳ ᎢᏰᏨᏁᎸᎯ ᏂᎯ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎪᏪᎵ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᏴ ᏦᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸᎯ, ᎪᏪᎳᏅᎯ ᎪᏪᎶᏗ ᎬᏔᏅᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎠᏓᏅᏙᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎬᏔᏅᎯ; ᎥᏝ ᏅᏲᎯ ᏗᎪᏪᎶᏗᏱ ᏗᎪᏪᎳᏅᎯ ᏱᎩ, ᎤᏇᏓᎵᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏒ ᏗᎪᏪᎶᏗᏱ ᎣᎾᏫᏱ.
\ft Forasmuch as ye are manifestly declared to be the epistle of Christ ministered by us, written not with ink, but with the Spirit of the living God; not in tables of stone, but in fleshy tables of the heart.

\ln Nasgino nusdi yitsalisgasdodv Unelanvhi Galonedv iyuwanisadv.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏄᏍᏗ ᏱᏣᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ.
\ft And such trust have we through Christ to God-ward:

\ln Vtlasgininonv ogvsv gesv yeli gayogadanvtedi yigi gohusdi ogvsvquo gesv nvdvdalehvsgi, yeliquosgini igayogadvnedi gesv Unelanvhiyi didalehvsga.
\syll ᎥᏝᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎣᎬᏒ ᎨᏒ ᏰᎵ ᎦᏲᎦᏓᏅᏖᏗ ᏱᎩ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎣᎬᏒᏉ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏛᏓᎴᎲᏍᎩ, ᏰᎵᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᎦᏲᎦᏛᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏱ ᏗᏓᎴᎲᏍᎦ.
\ft Not that we are sufficient of ourselves to think any thing as of ourselves; but our sufficiency is of God;

\ln Nasgi nasquo yeli igayogadvnedi tsinogvnelv tsogilvwisdanediyi nahna itse kanohedv datlohisdvi; vtla adina nusdv gowelvi, adanvdosgini dadeyohvsgvi; nusdvyeno gowelv adahihoquo, adanvdosgini adadvnidisgoi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏰᎵ ᎢᎦᏲᎦᏛᏁᏗ ᏥᏃᎬᏁᎸ ᏦᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᏀᎾ ᎢᏤ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏓᏠᎯᏍᏛᎢ; ᎥᏝ ᎠᏗᎾ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎪᏪᎸᎢ, ᎠᏓᏅᏙᏍᎩᏂ ᏓᏕᏲᎲᏍᎬᎢ; ᏄᏍᏛᏰᏃ ᎪᏪᎸ ᎠᏓᎯᎰᏉ, ᎠᏓᏅᏙᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏓᏛᏂᏗᏍᎪᎢ.
\ft Who also hath made us able ministers of the new testament; not of the letter, but of the spirit: for the letter killeth, but the spirit giveth life.

\ln Iyuno digalvwisdanedi adahihi gesv ugvwali tsigowele tsayelole nvyohi galvquodiyu tsigesei, nasgi Isili tsuwetsi gohidv digvwanakanodi nigesvna tsigese Mosi ukadvi, tsinvdigalisdodisge digvwalvsadv gesv ukadvi; nasgi ahvsdiquo tsigesei;
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎠᏓᎯᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᏥᎪᏪᎴ ᏣᏰᎶᎴ ᏅᏲᎯ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᏥᎨᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏏᎵ ᏧᏪᏥ ᎪᎯᏛ ᏗᎬᏩᎾᎧᏃᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏥᎨᏎ ᎼᏏ ᎤᎧᏛᎢ, ᏥᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨ ᏗᎬᏩᎸᏌᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎧᏛᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎲᏍᏗᏉ ᏥᎨᏎᎢ;
\ft But if the ministration of death, written and engraven in stones, was glorious, so that the children of Israel could not stedfastly behold the face of Moses for the glory of his countenance; which glory was to be done away:

\ln Tlasgo ho yugvwiyusesdi galvquodiyu yigesesdi Adanvdo ugvwali gesv digalvwisdanedi?
\syll ᏝᏍᎪ Ꮀ ᏳᎬᏫᏳᏎᏍᏗ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᎨᏒ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ?
\ft How shall not the ministration of the spirit be rather glorious?

\ln Iyuyeno digalvwisdanedi didadugodanehi gesv gananuwisgi galvquodiyu yigi, ho ugvwiyuha udagonadvdi galvquodiyu adadudalesgi gesv digalvwisdanedi.
\syll ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᏗᏓᏚᎪᏓᏁᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎦᎾᏄᏫᏍᎩ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᏱᎩ, Ꮀ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎭ ᎤᏓᎪᎾᏛᏗ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏚᏓᎴᏍᎩ ᎨᏒ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ.
\ft For if the ministration of condemnation be glory, much more doth the ministration of righteousness exceed in glory.

\ln Nasgiyeno nasquo galvquodiyu igvnelvhi tsigese vtla howa galvquodiyu yigesei, nvdigalisdodisge gvwadagonadvdv galvquodiyu gesv soi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎢᎬᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎨᏎ ᎥᏝ ᎰᏩ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨ ᎬᏩᏓᎪᎾᏛᏛ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᏐᎢ.
\ft For even that which was made glorious had no glory in this respect, by reason of the glory that excelleth.

\ln Iyuyeno nasgi na ahvdv tsigi galvquodiyu yigesei, utlihiyu wudagonadvdi galvquodiyu nasgi na tsinvwasdiquo.
\syll ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᎲᏛ ᏥᎩ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ, ᎤᏟᎯᏳ ᏭᏓᎪᎾᏛᏗ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏥᏅᏩᏍᏗᏉ.
\ft For if that which is done away was glorious, much more that which remaineth is glorious.

\ln Nasgino na tsinusdi udugi tsogvha, utsati ahidiyu gagolisdi otsiwoniha;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ Ꮎ ᏥᏄᏍᏗ ᎤᏚᎩ ᏦᎬᎭ, ᎤᏣᏘ ᎠᎯᏗᏳ ᎦᎪᎵᏍᏗ ᎣᏥᏬᏂᎭ;
\ft Seeing then that we have such hope, we use great plainness of speech:

\ln Itlano Mosi tsinudvnele [yinotsadvneha] tsuligvdulane nasgi Isili tsuwetsi widigvwanakanodi nigesvna iyulisdodiyi wasdv nasgi na ahvdv tsigi.
\syll ᎢᏝᏃ ᎼᏏ ᏥᏄᏛᏁᎴ ᏱᏃᏣᏛᏁᎭdata is invalid ᏧᎵᎬᏚᎳᏁ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏏᎵ ᏧᏪᏥ ᏫᏗᎬᏩᎾᎧᏃᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏩᏍᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᎲᏛ ᏥᎩ.
\ft And not as Moses, which put a vail over his face, that the children of Israel could not stedfastly look to the end of that which is abolished:

\ln Dunadanvdvsgini tsusganoliyu gesei; gohiyeno iyasdi nvwasdiquo nasgi na aligvdulo ahvdv nigesvna iyuno danigoliya uweti kanohedv datlohisdv gowelvi; Galonedvyeno nigvnisisgo ahvdv nigesoi.
\syll ᏚᎾᏓᏅᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᏧᏍᎦᏃᎵᏳ ᎨᏎᎢ; ᎪᎯᏰᏃ ᎢᏯᏍᏗ ᏅᏩᏍᏗᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᎵᎬᏚᎶ ᎠᎲᏛ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᏳᏃ ᏓᏂᎪᎵᏯ ᎤᏪᏘ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏓᏠᎯᏍᏛ ᎪᏪᎸᎢ; ᎦᎶᏁᏛᏰᏃ ᏂᎬᏂᏏᏍᎪ ᎠᎲᏛ ᏂᎨᏐᎢ.
\ft But their minds were blinded: for until this day remaineth the same vail untaken away in the reading of the old testament; which vail is done away in Christ.

\ln Gilahiyuquosgini gohi iga iyasdi iyuno Mosi datsigoliya aligvdulo tsuninawi duwutlvdoi.
\syll ᎩᎳᎯᏳᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎪᎯ ᎢᎦ ᎢᏯᏍᏗ ᎢᏳᏃ ᎼᏏ ᏓᏥᎪᎵᏯ ᎠᎵᎬᏚᎶ ᏧᏂᎾᏫ ᏚᏭᏢᏙᎢ.
\ft But even unto this day, when Moses is read, the vail is upon their heart.

\ln Asesgininonv, Ugvwiyuhiyi widagatahvstanvha, nasgi na aligvdulo iyvdv igvnedi nvdagalistani.
\syll ᎠᏎᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ, ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᏱ ᏫᏓᎦᏔᎲᏍᏔᏅᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᎵᎬᏚᎶ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎢᎬᏁᏗ ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏔᏂ.
\ft Nevertheless when it shall turn to the Lord, the vail shall be taken away.

\ln Ale Ugvwiyuhi nasgi na Adanvdo; ilvhitlvno nudvhnadegv Ugvwiyuhi utseli Adanvdo, nahna eha owasv odatseligaya gesvi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ; ᎢᎸᎯᏢᏃ ᏄᏛᎿᏕᎬ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ, ᏀᎾ ᎡᎭ ᎣᏩᏒ ᎣᏓᏤᎵᎦᏯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Now the Lord is that Spirit: and where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is liberty.

\ln Ayvsgini nidiv nidigaligvdulvna adagediyi nasgiya dedakanisgv galvquodiyu gesv Ugvwiyuhi utseliga, idadanetliyvha nasgiya nusdv nidalisdiha, galvquodiyu gesv igihv kanequotsega, Ugvwiyuhi Udanvdo iyuwanisadv nasgiyai.
\syll ᎠᏴᏍᎩᏂ ᏂᏗᎥ ᏂᏗᎦᎵᎬᏚᎸᎾ ᎠᏓᎨᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏕᏓᎧᏂᏍᎬ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎢᏓᏓᏁᏟᏴᎭ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏂᏓᎵᏍᏗᎭ, ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎢᎩᎲ ᎧᏁᏉᏤᎦ, ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏓᏅᏙ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ.
\ft But we all, with open face beholding as in a glass the glory of the Lord, are changed into the same image from glory to glory, even as by the Spirit of the Lord.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi, nasgi hia digalvwisdanedi tsogiha, nasgiya ogidolitsvi, vtla yidogiyawega;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᏦᎩᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎣᎩᏙᎵᏨᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᏱᏙᎩᏯᏪᎦ;
\ft Therefore seeing we have this ministry, as we have received mercy, we faint not;

\ln Dogiyosvsgini tsudalenvdv gvsgali udehohisdi gesvi, ale vtla yotsedoha asinasanvisdi gesvi, vtla ale ogatlonasdv yidogilvwisdaneha kanohedv gesv Unelanvhi utseliga, gvnigesvsgini notsvnehv gayegogi nigesvna gesvi, gogilvquododiyi notsvneha naniv yvwi dunadanvdv gvdi Unelanvhi agatahvi.
\syll ᏙᎩᏲᏒᏍᎩᏂ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎬᏍᎦᎵ ᎤᏕᎰᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᏲᏤᏙᎭ ᎠᏏᎾᏌᏅᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎣᎦᏠᎾᏍᏛ ᏱᏙᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎭ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎬᏂᎨᏒᏍᎩᏂ ᏃᏨᏁᎲ ᎦᏰᎪᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎪᎩᎸᏉᏙᏗᏱ ᏃᏨᏁᎭ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏴᏫ ᏚᎾᏓᏅᏛ ᎬᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎦᏔᎲᎢ.
\ft But have renounced the hidden things of dishonesty, not walking in craftiness, nor handling the word of God deceitfully; but by manifestation of the truth commending ourselves to every man's conscience in the sight of God.

\ln Iyusgini osdv kanohedv ogatseli nasquo gvsgali igesesdi, nasgi na getsidvdodi gesv gegvsgalanelv.
\syll ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎣᎦᏤᎵ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎬᏍᎦᎵ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎨᏥᏛᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎨᎬᏍᎦᎳᏁᎸ.
\ft But if our gospel be hid, it is hid to them that are lost:

\ln Nasgi na nanohiyuhvsgvna nasgi hia elohi unelanvhi uyelvhi dulisihvsdanelv dunadanvdvi, nasgi tsunilvsadadediyi nigesvna igagadv utisdv galvquodiyu osdv kanohedv Galonedv utseliga, nasgi Unelanvhi nasgiya tsigi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎾᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎬᎾ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏰᎸᎯ ᏚᎵᏏᎲᏍᏓᏁᎸ ᏚᎾᏓᏅᏛᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏂᎸᏌᏓᏕᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᎦᎦᏛ ᎤᏘᏍᏛ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏥᎩ.
\ft In whom the god of this world hath blinded the minds of them which believe not, lest the light of the glorious gospel of Christ, who is the image of God, should shine unto them.

\ln Vtlayeno ogvsv yotsadanoheha otsalitsidohvsgvi, Galonedvsgini Tsisa Ugvwiyuhi; ayvno nihi oginvsidasdi gesv nasgi Tsisa nvdigalisdodisgvi.
\syll ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᎣᎬᏒ ᏲᏣᏓᏃᎮᎭ ᎣᏣᎵᏥᏙᎲᏍᎬᎢ, ᎦᎶᏁᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᏥᏌ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ; ᎠᏴᏃ ᏂᎯ ᎣᎩᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏌ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬᎢ.
\ft For we preach not ourselves, but Christ Jesus the Lord; and ourselves your servants for Jesus' sake.

\ln Unelanvhiyeno nasgi na tsunetse igagati ulisigv tsulvsadadisdiyi, dulvsadadilv tsoginawiyi, nasgi oginediyi igagati agadovhisdodi galvquodiyu gesv Unelanvhi utseliga, nasgi Tsisa Galonedv ukadv tsvdidalehvsga.
\syll ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏧᏁᏤ ᎢᎦᎦᏘ ᎤᎵᏏᎬ ᏧᎸᏌᏓᏗᏍᏗᏱ, ᏚᎸᏌᏓᏗᎸ ᏦᎩᎾᏫᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᎩᏁᏗᏱ ᎢᎦᎦᏘ ᎠᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏙᏗ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᎧᏛ ᏨᏗᏓᎴᎲᏍᎦ.
\ft For God, who commanded the light to shine out of darkness, hath shined in our hearts, to give the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ.

\ln Aseno hia nasgi tsugvwalodi gadaquo digotlvtanvhi degilodi, nasgi utsati ulinigidv gesv Unelanvhi utseli iyulisdodiyi, vtlano ayv.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎦᏓᏉ ᏗᎪᏢᏔᏅᎯ ᏕᎩᎶᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎥᏝᏃ ᎠᏴ.
\ft But we have this treasure in earthen vessels, that the excellency of the power may be of God, and not of us.

\ln Ogadeyadodiha gvwaduwidvquo, aseno vtla yogigilvsga; uwelihisdi ogadanvtawadega, aseno vtla ogalihvyolilvhi yigi;
\syll ᎣᎦᏕᏯᏙᏗᎭ ᎬᏩᏚᏫᏛᏉ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏲᎩᎩᎸᏍᎦ; ᎤᏪᎵᎯᏍᏗ ᎣᎦᏓᏅᏔᏩᏕᎦ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎣᎦᎵᎲᏲᎵᎸᎯ ᏱᎩ;
\ft We are troubled on every side, yet not distressed; we are perplexed, but not in despair;

\ln Uyo nogvnadegoi, aseno vtla ogvdetsvhi yigi; dogistlvnistanv, aseno vtla ogidvtanvhi yigi.
\syll ᎤᏲ ᏃᎬᎾᏕᎪᎢ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎣᎬᏕᏨᎯ ᏱᎩ; ᏙᎩᏍᏢᏂᏍᏔᏅ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎣᎩᏛᏔᏅᎯ ᏱᎩ.
\ft Persecuted, but not forsaken; cast down, but not destroyed;

\ln Nigohilv tsotsiyelv otsiyidoho uyohusv Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa, nasgi nasquo gvnv Tsisa gvnigesv iyulisdodiyi ayv tsotsiyelvi.
\syll ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᏦᏥᏰᎸ ᎣᏥᏱᏙᎰ ᎤᏲᎱᏒ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎬᏅ ᏥᏌ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎠᏴ ᏦᏥᏰᎸᎢ.
\ft Always bearing about in the body the dying of the Lord Jesus, that the life also of Jesus might be made manifest in our body.

\ln Ayvyeno tsotseha nigohilvquo tsogiyohusidena Tsisa ogisdvdisgvi, nasgi gvnv nasquo Tsisa gvnigesv iyulisdodiyi ayv ayohusgi ogiquedalvi.
\syll ᎠᏴᏰᏃ ᏦᏤᎭ ᏂᎪᎯᎸᏉ ᏦᎩᏲᎱᏏᏕᎾ ᏥᏌ ᎣᎩᏍᏛᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏅ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏥᏌ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎠᏴ ᎠᏲᎱᏍᎩ ᎣᎩᏇᏓᎸᎢ.
\ft For we which live are alway delivered unto death for Jesus' sake, that the life also of Jesus might be made manifest in our mortal flesh.

\ln Nasgino ayohuhisdi gesv ogiyilidoha ayv, nihisgini gvnidv.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎣᎩᏱᎵᏙᎭ ᎠᏴ, ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎬᏂᏛ.
\ft So then death worketh in us, but life in you.

\ln Utloyiquo tsogiha adanvdo gohiyudodi gesvi, hia nasgiya tsinigvnv tsigowela, aquohiyunv, ale nasgi iyusdi aginetsv; ayv nasquo otsohiyuhvsga, ale nasgi iyusdi otsinega.
\syll ᎤᏠᏱᏉ ᏦᎩᎭ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎪᎯᏳᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏥᏂᎬᏅ ᏥᎪᏪᎳ, ᎠᏉᎯᏳᏅ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᎩᏁᏨ; ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎣᏦᎯᏳᎲᏍᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎣᏥᏁᎦ.
\ft We having the same spirit of faith, according as it is written, I believed, and therefore have I spoken; we also believe, and therefore speak;

\ln Otsigatahayeno nasgi na Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa tsuletanvhi, nasquo ayv Tsisa agvdisgv dodayogaletani, ale ayv nihino itsulaha widigiyosihisdi gesesdi.
\syll ᎣᏥᎦᏔᎭᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᏧᎴᏔᏅᎯ, ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏴ ᏥᏌ ᎠᎬᏗᏍᎬ ᏙᏓᏲᎦᎴᏔᏂ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴ ᏂᎯᏃ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᏫᏗᎩᏲᏏᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft Knowing that he which raised up the Lord Jesus shall raise up us also by Jesus, and shall present us with you.

\ln Nigadiyuyeno tsudalenvdv tseha nihi nvdigalisdodiha; nasgi utsati gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv iyuwanisodiyi Unelanvhi utsati galvquododi iyulisdodiyi unitsati analiheligvi.
\syll ᏂᎦᏗᏳᏰᏃ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏤᎭ ᏂᎯ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏐᏗᏱ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎦᎸᏉᏙᏗ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎠᎾᎵᎮᎵᎬᎢ.
\ft For all things are for your sakes, that the abundant grace might through the thanksgiving of many redound to the glory of God.

\ln Nasgi nvdigalisdodiha vtla yidogiyawega; udohiyuhisgininonv gaduiditlv ehi gesv ogiwanagalotseha, hawiniditlvsgini ehi gesv ogalinigohiseha nidadodaquisvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏙᎩᏯᏪᎦ; ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎦᏚᎢᏗᏢ ᎡᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎣᎩᏩᎾᎦᎶᏤᎭ, ᎭᏫᏂᏗᏢᏍᎩᏂ ᎡᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎣᎦᎵᏂᎪᎯᏎᎭ ᏂᏓᏙᏓᏈᏒᎢ.
\ft For which cause we faint not; but though our outward man perish, yet the inward man is renewed day by day.

\ln Udasakayeno otsigiliyogv tlegaquo tsigi ogiwadveha utsati ulosvstanvhi iyudagedv alisquadisgi nigesvna galvquodiyu gesvi;
\syll ᎤᏓᏌᎧᏰᏃ ᎣᏥᎩᎵᏲᎬ ᏞᎦᏉ ᏥᎩ ᎣᎩᏩᏛᎡᎭ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᎶᏒᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎢᏳᏓᎨᏛ ᎠᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ;
\ft For our light affliction, which is but for a moment, worketh for us a far more exceeding and eternal weight of glory;

\ln Nidotsakanisgvna gesv nasgi digvgowadvdi tsigi, nasgisgini na digvgowadvdi nigesvna tsigi; nasgiyeno digvgowadvdi tsigi digalosohvsgi; nasgisgini na digvgowadvdi nigesvna tsigi digalosohvsgi nigesvna.
\syll ᏂᏙᏣᎧᏂᏍᎬᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎬᎪᏩᏛᏗ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ Ꮎ ᏗᎬᎪᏩᏛᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏥᎩ; ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᏗᎬᎪᏩᏛᏗ ᏥᎩ ᏗᎦᎶᏐᎲᏍᎩ; ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ Ꮎ ᏗᎬᎪᏩᏛᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏥᎩ ᏗᎦᎶᏐᎲᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.
\ft While we look not at the things which are seen, but at the things which are not seen: for the things which are seen are temporal; but the things which are not seen are eternal.

\ln Otsigatahayeno nasgi iyuno elohi ehi otsinelv ogilitsodv yuyotsv, ogiha adanelv Unelanvhi nvdayudalenvhi, adanelv tsuwoyi digvtanvhi nigesvna anesgehvhi, ayogi nigesvna galvloi didanelv.
\syll ᎣᏥᎦᏔᎭᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏃ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎡᎯ ᎣᏥᏁᎸ ᎣᎩᎵᏦᏛ ᏳᏲᏨ, ᎣᎩᎭ ᎠᏓᏁᎸ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ, ᎠᏓᏁᎸ ᏧᏬᏱ ᏗᎬᏔᏅᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎠᏁᏍᎨᎲᎯ, ᎠᏲᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎦᎸᎶᎢ ᏗᏓᏁᎸ.
\ft For we know that if our earthly house of this tabernacle were dissolved, we have a building of God, an house not made with hands, eternal in the heavens.

\ln Aniyeno otsiyav ogiliyediha, utsati ogaduliha oganuwosdodiyi otsinelv nasgi na galvlo nvdayudalenvhi;
\syll ᎠᏂᏰᏃ ᎣᏥᏯᎥ ᎣᎩᎵᏰᏗᎭ, ᎤᏣᏘ ᎣᎦᏚᎵᎭ ᎣᎦᏄᏬᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎣᏥᏁᎸ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎦᎸᎶ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ;
\ft For in this we groan, earnestly desiring to be clothed upon with our house which is from heaven:

\ln Iyuno howa yidoganuwav, vtla tsogiyelvha yigagesesdi.
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᎰᏩ ᏱᏙᎦᏄᏩᎥ, ᎥᏝ ᏦᎩᏰᎸᎭ ᏱᎦᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft If so be that being clothed we shall not be found naked.

\ln Ayvyeno hia ani galitsodv tsotsiyaa ogiliyediha, nigalisdodiha gagedv nogadvhnadegvi; vtla tsoginuwesdiyi ogadulisgv yinvdigalisdodiha; tsoginuwosdiyisgini; nasgi ayohusgi gesv atsigisdiyi gvnidv ugisohvsdiyi.
\syll ᎠᏴᏰᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏂ ᎦᎵᏦᏛ ᏦᏥᏯᎠ ᎣᎩᎵᏰᏗᎭ, ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎦᎨᏛ ᏃᎦᏛᎿᏕᎬᎢ; ᎥᏝ ᏦᎩᏄᏪᏍᏗᏱ ᎣᎦᏚᎵᏍᎬ ᏱᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ; ᏦᎩᏄᏬᏍᏗᏱᏍᎩᏂ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏲᎱᏍᎩ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏥᎩᏍᏗᏱ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎤᎩᏐᎲᏍᏗᏱ.
\ft For we that are in this tabernacle do groan, being burdened: not for that we would be unclothed, but clothed upon, that mortality might be swallowed up of life.

\ln Nasgino na igotlvnvhi hia nasgi ugvwali gesv nasgi Unelanvhi, nasgi nasquo tsoginelv Adanvdo agadidisdodi gesvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ Ꮎ ᎢᎪᏢᏅᎯ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏦᎩᏁᎸ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎠᎦᏗᏗᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Now he that hath wrought us for the selfsame thing is God, who also hath given unto us the earnest of the Spirit.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi nigohilv ugalisdi ogadanvtawadegoi, ale otsigataha nasgi nigohilv otsinelv ani tsotsiyelvi, Ugvwiyuhi ehv ogigonelvi;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎤᎦᎵᏍᏗ ᎣᎦᏓᏅᏔᏩᏕᎪᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎣᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎣᏥᏁᎸ ᎠᏂ ᏦᏥᏰᎸᎢ, ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎡᎲ ᎣᎩᎪᏁᎸᎢ;
\ft Therefore we are always confident, knowing that, whilst we are at home in the body, we are absent from the Lord:

\ln Gohiyudiyeno gesv otsvdiha otsedohvi, vtlano agowadvdi gesvi.
\syll ᎪᎯᏳᏗᏰᏃ ᎨᏒ ᎣᏨᏗᎭ ᎣᏤᏙᎲᎢ, ᎥᏝᏃ ᎠᎪᏩᏛᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft (For we walk by faith, not by sight:)

\ln Ale ugalisdi ogadanvtawadegoi, ale utli gayogiyelvdi ayelv ogigoneloisdiyi, ale Ugvwiyuhi ehv woganeladisdiyi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎤᎦᎵᏍᏗ ᎣᎦᏓᏅᏔᏩᏕᎪᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏟ ᎦᏲᎩᏰᎸᏗ ᎠᏰᎸ ᎣᎩᎪᏁᎶᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎡᎲ ᏬᎦᏁᎳᏗᏍᏗᏱ.
\ft We are confident, I say, and willing rather to be absent from the body, and to be present with the Lord.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi otsalinigvneha, nasquo nahna yiwotsinela, ale yogigonela, tsogadanilvisdiyi iyulisdodiyi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎣᏣᎵᏂᎬᏁᎭ, ᎾᏍᏉ ᏀᎾ ᏱᏬᏥᏁᎳ, ᎠᎴ ᏲᎩᎪᏁᎳ, ᏦᎦᏓᏂᎸᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
\ft Wherefore we labour, that, whether present or absent, we may be accepted of him.

\ln Ayvyeno nidiv igvyiditlv wiginanugoisdi gesesdi Galonedv tsuwugododiyi gasgilvi; nasgi nidiv idisiyvwiha eginediyi nusdv degilvwisdanelv didiyelv gvdi, nasgiya nigadvnelidolvi, osiyu yinagi, ale uyo yinagi.
\syll ᎠᏴᏰᏃ ᏂᏗᎥ ᎢᎬᏱᏗᏢ ᏫᎩᎾᏄᎪᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏧᏭᎪᏙᏗᏱ ᎦᏍᎩᎸᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᏗᎥ ᎢᏗᏏᏴᏫᎭ ᎡᎩᏁᏗᏱ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏕᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸ ᏗᏗᏰᎸ ᎬᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏂᎦᏛᏁᎵᏙᎸᎢ, ᎣᏏᏳ ᏱᎾᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏲ ᏱᎾᎩ.
\ft For we must all appear before the judgment seat of Christ; that every one may receive the things done in his body, according to that he hath done, whether it be good or bad.

\ln Nasgino tsotsigataha ganayeisdi gesv Ugvwiyuhi, dotsisdiyedi yvwi; ale gvnigesv notsalisdiha Unelanvhi agatahvi; ale udugi aquvha gvnigesv iyaqualisdodiyi nasquo nihi detsadanvdvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏦᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᎦᎾᏰᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᏙᏥᏍᏗᏰᏗ ᏴᏫ; ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏃᏣᎵᏍᏗᎭ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎦᏔᎲᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎠᏋᎭ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏯᏆᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏂᎯ ᏕᏣᏓᏅᏛᎢ.
\ft Knowing therefore the terror of the Lord, we persuade men; but we are made manifest unto God; and I trust also are made manifest in your consciences.

\ln Vtlayeno nihi sgilvquodiyu iyulisdodiyi yotsiniladiha; itsvnehasgini sgilvquododiyi, nasgi gohusdi yuniha tsunawohiliyvsdanedi, itsvyeliseha, nasgi gaduquo ehi anatlvquododisgi tsigi, dotsunadanvdvno anatlvquododisgi nigesvna.
\syll ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᏂᎯ ᏍᎩᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏲᏥᏂᎳᏗᎭ; ᎢᏨᏁᎭᏍᎩᏂ ᏍᎩᎸᏉᏙᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏳᏂᎭ ᏧᎾᏬᎯᎵᏴᏍᏓᏁᏗ, ᎢᏨᏰᎵᏎᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏚᏉ ᎡᎯ ᎠᎾᏢᏉᏙᏗᏍᎩ ᏥᎩ, ᏙᏧᎾᏓᏅᏛᏃ ᎠᎾᏢᏉᏙᏗᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.
\ft For we commend not ourselves again unto you, but give you occasion to glory on our behalf, that ye may have somewhat to answer them which glory in appearance, and not in heart.

\ln Iyuyeno yidogilvnodiha, Unelanvhiquo nvdigalisdodiha; iyu ale dohi yidogadanvta, nihiquo nvdigalisdodiha.
\syll ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᏱᏙᎩᎸᏃᏗᎭ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏉ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ; ᎢᏳ ᎠᎴ ᏙᎯ ᏱᏙᎦᏓᏅᏔ, ᏂᎯᏉ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ.
\ft For whether we be beside ourselves, it is to God: or whether we be sober, it is for your cause.

\ln Galonedvyeno udageyudi gesv dogatinega; hiayeno nusdi dotsugodiha, nasgi, iyuno asiyvwi naniv yiduyohuhiselv, hnaquo nasgi naniv duniyohusvgi;
\syll ᎦᎶᏁᏛᏰᏃ ᎤᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏙᎦᏘᏁᎦ; ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᏄᏍᏗ ᏙᏧᎪᏗᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏱᏚᏲᎱᎯᏎᎸ, ᎿᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏚᏂᏲᎱᏒᎩ;
\ft For the love of Christ constraineth us; because we thus judge, that if one died for all, then were all dead:

\ln Nasgino naniv duyohuhiselei, nasgi na dinvnodv tsigi gohi gesv iyudalenvdv unvsvquo unatseli ugvwali unalenidasdiyi nigesvna, nasgisgini na utseli ugvwali tsuyohuhiselvhi ale tsulehisanvhi tsigi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏚᏲᎱᎯᏎᎴᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏗᏅᏃᏛ ᏥᎩ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎤᏅᏒᏉ ᎤᎾᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᎤᎾᎴᏂᏓᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ Ꮎ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᏧᏲᎱᎯᏎᎸᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏧᎴᎯᏌᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ.
\ft And that he died for all, that they which live should not henceforth live unto themselves, but unto him which died for them, and rose again.

\ln Nasgi iyusidi gohi gesv iyudalenvdv vtla gilo yotsigataha nasgiya uquedali agatahvi.  Ale nasquo iyu Galonedv otsigadovsvhi yigi uquedali agatahv nasgiyai, aseno gohi gesv iyudalenvdv vtla hnaquo yotsigataha.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏏᏗ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᏲᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎠᎦᏔᎲᎢ.  ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎢᏳ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎣᏥᎦᏙᎥᏒᎯ ᏱᎩ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎠᎦᏔᎲ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎥᏝ ᎿᏉ ᏲᏥᎦᏔᎭ.
\ft Wherefore henceforth know we no man after the flesh: yea, though we have known Christ after the flesh, yet now henceforth know we him no more.

\ln Nasgi iyusidi, iyuno gilo Galonedvyi ayaesdi nasgi itse nagvnelv; tsudalenvdv uweti gesv ulosonv; gvniyuquo, nigadiyu tsudalenvdv itse nulistanv.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏏᏗ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎦᎶᏁᏛᏱ ᎠᏯᎡᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏤ ᎾᎬᏁᎸ; ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎤᏪᏘ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎶᏐᏅ; ᎬᏂᏳᏉ, ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎢᏤ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ.
\ft Therefore if any man be in Christ, he is a new creature: old things are passed away; behold, all things are become new.

\ln Ale nigadiyu tsudalenvdv Unelanvhi iyuwanisadv, nasgi dohi tsinuwanelv edisgagi gesv Tsisa Galonedv agvdisgvi, ale ayv ogasvgalotanv dohi igvnehi digalvwisdanedi;
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏙᎯ ᏥᏄᏩᏁᎸ ᎡᏗᏍᎦᎩ ᎨᏒ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎠᎬᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴ ᎣᎦᏒᎦᎶᏔᏅ ᏙᎯ ᎢᎬᏁᎯ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ;
\ft And all things are of God, who hath reconciled us to himself by Jesus Christ, and hath given to us the ministry of reconciliation;

\ln Hia nasgi Unelanvhi dohi nigvnehvgi elohi gvwasgagi gesv Galonedv gvdisgvgi, unisganvtsv unisganvtsvhi nidayelvnanehvna; ale ayv ogasvlotanv kanohedv dohi igvnehi.
\syll ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏙᎯ ᏂᎬᏁᎲᎩ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎬᏩᏍᎦᎩ ᎨᏒ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎬᏗᏍᎬᎩ, ᎤᏂᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᎤᏂᏍᎦᏅᏨᎯ ᏂᏓᏰᎸᎾᏁᎲᎾ; ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴ ᎣᎦᏒᎶᏔᏅ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏙᎯ ᎢᎬᏁᎯ.
\ft To wit, that God was in Christ, reconciling the world unto himself, not imputing their trespasses unto them; and hath committed unto us the word of reconciliation.

\ln Nasgino ayv oginvsidv Galonedv otsadanetliyvstanelvhi; nasgiyaquo Unelanvhi tsitsisdiyedisgo ayv tsogvdisgoi, Galonedv otsadanetliyvsdaneha, itsvtayoseha Unelanvhi dohi itsvnediyi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎠᏴ ᎣᎩᏅᏏᏛ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎣᏣᏓᏁᏟᏴᏍᏔᏁᎸᎯ; ᎾᏍᎩᏯᏉ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏥᏥᏍᏗᏰᏗᏍᎪ ᎠᏴ ᏦᎬᏗᏍᎪᎢ, ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎣᏣᏓᏁᏟᏴᏍᏓᏁᎭ, ᎢᏨᏔᏲᏎᎭ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏙᎯ ᎢᏨᏁᏗᏱ.
\ft Now then we are ambassadors for Christ, as though God did beseech you by us: we pray you in Christ's stead, be ye reconciled to God.

\ln Nasgiyeno asgani nagatahvna tsigesei, nasgi asgana uyelvnv ayv gesv nvtsulisdotanv, nasgi iyuwanisodiyi ayv nidisganvna igiyelvdiyi Unelanvhi degakanisgvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᎾᎦᏔᎲᎾ ᏥᎨᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᎦᎾ ᎤᏰᎸᏅ ᎠᏴ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏧᎵᏍᏙᏔᏅ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏐᏗᏱ ᎠᏴ ᏂᏗᏍᎦᏅᎾ ᎢᎩᏰᎸᏗᏱ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏕᎦᎧᏂᏍᎬᎢ.
\ft For he hath made him to be sin for us, who knew no sin; that we might be made the righteousness of God in him.

\ln Ayvno tsogilvwisdanehi otsisdelisgi nasquo itsvsdiyediha asequoquo etsinediyi nigesvna gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv Unelanvhi.
\syll ᎠᏴᏃ ᏦᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᎣᏥᏍᏕᎵᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎢᏨᏍᏗᏰᏗᎭ ᎠᏎᏉᏉ ᎡᏥᏁᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ.
\ft We then, as workers together with him, beseech you also that ye receive not the grace of God in vain.

\ln Hiayeno nigaweha, gvwadvganelv nahiyu didanilvtsvhi gesvi, ale nahiyu iga gayvdadisdelvdi gesv gvsdelvhv; (gvniyuquo, gohi hnaquo nahiyu didanilvtsvhi gesvi; gvniyuquo, gohi hnaquo nahiyu iga gayvdadisdelvdi gesvi;)
\syll ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᏂᎦᏪᎭ, ᎬᏩᏛᎦᏁᎸ ᏀᎢᏳ ᏗᏓᏂᎸᏨᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏀᎢᏳ ᎢᎦ ᎦᏴᏓᏗᏍᏕᎸᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏍᏕᎸᎲ; ᎬᏂᏳᏉ, ᎪᎯ ᎿᏉ ᏀᎢᏳ ᏗᏓᏂᎸᏨᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎬᏂᏳᏉ, ᎪᎯ ᎿᏉ ᏀᎢᏳ ᎢᎦ ᎦᏴᏓᏗᏍᏕᎸᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ;
\ft (For he saith, I have heard thee in a time accepted, and in the day of salvation have I succoured thee: behold, now is the accepted time; behold, now is the day of salvation.)

\ln Gohusdi notsadvnehvna gvwadadodesdodi gesvi, hia nasgi digalvwisdanedi gesv usonv gvwaninohedi nigesvna iyulisdodiyi;
\syll ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏃᏣᏛᏁᎲᎾ ᎬᏩᏓᏙᏕᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏐᏅ ᎬᏩᏂᏃᎮᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ;
\ft Giving no offence in any thing, that the ministry be not blamed:

\ln Nigavsgini nudalesv dogilvwisdanehv gvnigesv notsvneho Unelanvhi gohusdi otsadvnehi gesvi, utsati tsotsvnidiyu gesvi, otsigiliyogvi, oginigvsehvi, ehisdi ogadanvtawadegvi,
\syll ᏂᎦᎥᏍᎩᏂ ᏄᏓᎴᏒ ᏙᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏃᏨᏁᎰ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎣᏣᏛᏁᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᏣᏘ ᏦᏨᏂᏗᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎣᏥᎩᎵᏲᎬᎢ, ᎣᎩᏂᎬᏎᎲᎢ, ᎡᎯᏍᏗ ᎣᎦᏓᏅᏔᏩᏕᎬᎢ,
\ft But in all things approving ourselves as the ministers of God, in much patience, in afflictions, in necessities, in distresses,

\ln Dogilinihvi, ogiyvginvi, udadasgedv unalitelvnvi, dogilvwisdanehvi, otsiyawisgvi, amatli otsvsgvi,
\syll ᏙᎩᎵᏂᎲᎢ, ᎣᎩᏴᎩᏅᎢ, ᎤᏓᏓᏍᎨᏛ ᎤᎾᎵᏖᎸᏅᎢ, ᏙᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎢ, ᎣᏥᏯᏫᏍᎬᎢ, ᎠᎹᏟ ᎣᏨᏍᎬᎢ,
\ft In stripes, in imprisonments, in tumults, in labours, in watchings, in fastings;

\ln Nogadanvgalvna gesvi, agadovhisdi gesvi, gohidoyu unelagi otselisegvi, ogadanvtiyu gesvi, Galvquodiyu Adanvdo ogehvi, nutlonasdvna adageyudi ogehvi.
\syll ᏃᎦᏓᏅᎦᎸᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎪᎯᏙᏳ ᎤᏁᎳᎩ ᎣᏤᎵᏎᎬᎢ, ᎣᎦᏓᏅᏘᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎣᎨᎲᎢ, ᏄᏠᎾᏍᏛᎾ ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎣᎨᎲᎢ.
\ft By pureness, by knowledge, by longsuffering, by kindness, by the Holy Ghost, by love unfeigned,

\ln Gayegogi nigesvna kanohedv otsvdisgvi, ulinigidv gesv Unelanvhi utseli otsvdisgvi, duyugodv gesv agatisiditlv ale agasganiditlv ogatsanvdvi,
\syll ᎦᏰᎪᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎣᏨᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎣᏨᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎦᏘᏏᏗᏢ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎦᏍᎦᏂᏗᏢ ᎣᎦᏣᏅᏛᎢ,
\ft By the word of truth, by the power of God, by the armour of righteousness on the right hand and on the left,

\ln Ogilvquodiyu gesv ale nogilvquodvna gesvi, uyo oginohesgv ale osdv oginohesgvi; ogatlonasdi tsigeso nasgiyai, aseno nogatlonasdvna gesvi,
\syll ᎣᎩᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏃᎩᎸᏉᏛᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᏲ ᎣᎩᏃᎮᏍᎬ ᎠᎴ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎣᎩᏃᎮᏍᎬᎢ; ᎣᎦᏠᎾᏍᏗ ᏥᎨᏐ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᏃᎦᏠᎾᏍᏛᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ,
\ft By honour and dishonour, by evil report and good report: as deceivers, and yet true;

\ln Nogigatahvna nasgiyai, aseno osiyu ogigatahi gesvi; tsidotsiyohusgo nasgiyai, gvniyuquono tsotsvnodv; ogisdvdistanvhi, ogilvhino nigesvna;
\syll ᏃᎩᎦᏔᎲᎾ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎣᎩᎦᏔᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᏥᏙᏥᏲᎱᏍᎪ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ, ᎬᏂᏳᏉᏃ ᏦᏨᏃᏛ; ᎣᎩᏍᏛᏗᏍᏔᏅᎯ, ᎣᎩᎸᎯᏃ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ;
\ft As unknown, and yet well known; as dying, and, behold, we live; as chastened, and not killed;

\ln Uyo tsogadanvtawadego nasgiya, aseno yano otsaliheligoi; uyo tsinogadvhnadego nasgiya, aseno unitsati dotsenvisdisgoi; gohusdi nogihvna tsigeso nasgiya, aseno nigadiyu tsudalenvdv ogatseliga.
\syll ᎤᏲ ᏦᎦᏓᏅᏔᏩᏕᎪ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᏯᏃ ᎣᏣᎵᎮᎵᎪᎢ; ᎤᏲ ᏥᏃᎦᏛᎿᏕᎪ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏙᏤᏅᎢᏍᏗᏍᎪᎢ; ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏃᎩᎲᎾ ᏥᎨᏐ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎣᎦᏤᎵᎦ.
\ft As sorrowful, yet alway rejoicing; as poor, yet making many rich; as having nothing, and yet possessing all things.

\ln Detsvsdugielv tsotsiholi, Itsigolinidi, tsoginawi detsvyadvnohisdanelv.
\syll ᏕᏨᏍᏚᎩᎡᎸ ᏦᏥᎰᎵ, ᎢᏥᎪᎵᏂᏗ, ᏦᎩᎾᏫ ᏕᏨᏯᏛᏃᎯᏍᏓᏁᎸ.
\ft O ye Corinthians, our mouth is open unto you, our heart is enlarged.

\ln Vtla yiditsasdigvselv ayv tsoginawi; itsvsvsgini ditsinawi dusdigvsv.
\syll ᎥᏝ ᏱᏗᏣᏍᏗᎬᏎᎸ ᎠᏴ ᏦᎩᎾᏫ; ᎢᏨᏒᏍᎩᏂ ᏗᏥᎾᏫ ᏚᏍᏗᎬᏒ.
\ft Ye are not straitened in us, but ye are straitened in your own bowels.

\ln Nasgino utloyiquo sgiyaguyvdanehv ^diquetsi tsigatsiwonedisgo nasgiya itsvwonediha^nasquo nihi ditsadvnohi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᏠᏱᏉ ᏍᎩᏯᎫᏴᏓᏁᎲ data is invalidᏗᏇᏥ ᏥᎦᏥᏬᏁᏗᏍᎪ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎢᏨᏬᏁᏗᎭdata is invalidᎾᏍᏉ ᏂᎯ ᏗᏣᏛᏃᎯ.
\ft Now for a recompence in the same, (I speak as unto my children,) be ye also enlarged.

\ln Tlesdi niditsadoligvna itsulaha yidetsigilanaladisgesdi nanohiyuhvsgvna; gadoyeno usdi dunadudadv duyugodv gesv ale niduyugodvna gesvi?  ale gado usdi saquo nunvnv igagati ale ulisigi?
\syll ᏞᏍᏗ ᏂᏗᏣᏙᎵᎬᎾ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᏱᏕᏥᎩᎳᎾᎳᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎾᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎬᎾ; ᎦᏙᏰᏃ ᎤᏍᏗ ᏚᎾᏚᏓᏛ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏂᏚᏳᎪᏛᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ?  ᎠᎴ ᎦᏙ ᎤᏍᏗ ᏌᏉ ᏄᏅᏅ ᎢᎦᎦᏘ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏏᎩ?
\ft Be ye not unequally yoked together with unbelievers: for what fellowship hath righteousness with unrighteousness? and what communion hath light with darkness?

\ln Ale gado usdi utloyi nunvnv Galonedv ale Quiliyali?  ale gado usdi itsulaquo unatseliga geso gohiyuhvsgi ale gohiyuhvsgi nigesvna?
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎦᏙ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎤᏠᏱ ᏄᏅᏅ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎠᎴ ᏈᎵᏯᎵ?  ᎠᎴ ᎦᏙ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎢᏧᎳᏉ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ ᎨᏐ ᎪᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎪᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ?
\ft And what concord hath Christ with Belial? or what part hath he that believeth with an infidel?

\ln Ale gado usdi didoligi nigalisdiha Unelanvhi utseli adanelv ale Unelanvhi ditlilostanvhi?  nihiyeno nasgi gvnidv Unelanvhi utseliga uneladisdiyi; nasgiya Unelanvhi hia tsinuwesv, Nasgi na gatsiyaesdi, ale anehv gedohesdi; ale ayv gatsiyanelanvhi gesesdi, ale unvsv diquatseli yvwi gesesdi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎦᏙ ᎤᏍᏗ ᏗᏙᎵᎩ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᎭ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎠᏓᏁᎸ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏗᏟᎶᏍᏔᏅᎯ?  ᏂᎯᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᎤᏁᎳᏗᏍᏗᏱ; ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏄᏪᏒ, ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎦᏥᏯᎡᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏁᎲ ᎨᏙᎮᏍᏗ; ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴ ᎦᏥᏯᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏅᏒ ᏗᏆᏤᎵ ᏴᏫ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft And what agreement hath the temple of God with idols? for ye are the temple of the living God; as God hath said, I will dwell in them, and walk in them; and I will be their God, and they shall be my people.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi etsinugo itsadasuyv anehvi, ale itsateledv gesesdi, adiha Ugvwiyuhi, ale tlesdi itsasvnilvgi gohusdi gadahai; ayvno dodatsvyadanilvtsi,
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎡᏥᏄᎪ ᎢᏣᏓᏑᏴ ᎠᏁᎲᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏣᏖᎴᏛ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎠᏗᎭ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎢᏣᏒᏂᎸᎩ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎦᏓᎭᎢ; ᎠᏴᏃ ᏙᏓᏨᏯᏓᏂᎸᏥ,
\ft Wherefore come out from among them, and be ye separate, saith the Lord, and touch not the unclean thing; and I will receive you,

\ln Ale ayv Itsidoda gesesdi, nihino diquetsi gesesdi itsisgaya ale itsigeyv, adiha Ugvwiyuhi winasdvna ulinigidv.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴ ᎢᏥᏙᏓ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᏂᎯᏃ ᏗᏇᏥ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎢᏥᏍᎦᏯ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏥᎨᏴ, ᎠᏗᎭ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏫᎾᏍᏛᎾ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ.
\ft And will be a Father unto you, and ye shall be my sons and daughters, saith the Lord Almighty.

\ln Hiano nasgi tsinusdi egiduisdanelvhi tsigi, itsvgeyui, idadanvgalv idihvna nudalesv gadaha gesv igiquedalv, ale igadanvdogihi, idisquadisgesdi duyugodv gesvi, Unelanvhi edinayesgvi.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏄᏍᏗ ᎡᎩᏚᎢᏍᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎢᏨᎨᏳᎢ, ᎢᏓᏓᏅᎦᎸ ᎢᏗᎲᎾ ᏄᏓᎴᏒ ᎦᏓᎭ ᎨᏒ ᎢᎩᏇᏓᎸ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᎦᏓᏅᏙᎩᎯ, ᎢᏗᏍᏆᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎡᏗᎾᏰᏍᎬᎢ.
\ft Having therefore these promises, dearly beloved, let us cleanse ourselves from all filthiness of the flesh and spirit, perfecting holiness in the fear of God.
