\ln Disgiyadanilvgi; vtla gilo utsatini yinotsvnelv, vtla gilo asgana yinotsvnelv, vtla gilo yotsilonuelv.
\syll ᏗᏍᎩᏯᏓᏂᎸᎩ; ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏣᏘᏂ ᏱᏃᏨᏁᎸ, ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᎠᏍᎦᎾ ᏱᏃᏨᏁᎸ, ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᏲᏥᎶᏄᎡᎸ.
\ft Receive us; we have wronged no man, we have corrupted no man, we have defrauded no man.

\ln Hia nasgi tsinitsiweha vtla ditsvyugodanediyi yagiyelvha; gayulayeno hia tsiniagiwesv, tsoginawiyi itsiyaa, ogadvnvisdiquo itsulaha diginiyohuhisdiyi, ale itsulaha igadediyi.
\syll ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏂᏥᏪᎭ ᎥᏝ ᏗᏨᏳᎪᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᏯᎩᏰᎸᎭ; ᎦᏳᎳᏰᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᎠᎩᏪᏒ, ᏦᎩᎾᏫᏱ ᎢᏥᏯᎠ, ᎣᎦᏛᏅᎢᏍᏗᏉ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᏗᎩᏂᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎢᎦᏕᏗᏱ.
\ft I speak not this to condemn you: for I have said before, that ye are in our hearts to die and live with you.

\ln Utsati itsvyoiyuha; utsati itsvlvquodisgoi; agikalitsvhi ugalisdi gesvi; utsatanvhi ulihelisdi aquadanvtawadego nigav otsigiliyotsidohvi.
\syll ᎤᏣᏘ ᎢᏨᏲᎢᏳᎭ; ᎤᏣᏘ ᎢᏨᎸᏉᏗᏍᎪᎢ; ᎠᎩᎧᎵᏨᎯ ᎤᎦᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎤᏣᏔᏅᎯ ᎤᎵᎮᎵᏍᏗ ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏔᏩᏕᎪ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎣᏥᎩᎵᏲᏥᏙᎲᎢ.
\ft Great is my boldness of speech toward you, great is my glorying of you: I am filled with comfort, I am exceeding joyful in all our tribulation.

\ln Masidoniyeno wogilutsv, vtla ogiquedalv gvwatsawesolvsdodi yigesei, gvwadunadvsgini ogadeyadodigvgi; doyiditlv alidv gesvi, hawinino iditlv otsinayesgvi.
\syll ᎹᏏᏙᏂᏰᏃ ᏬᎩᎷᏨ, ᎥᏝ ᎣᎩᏇᏓᎸ ᎬᏩᏣᏪᏐᎸᏍᏙᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ, ᎬᏩᏚᎾᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᎣᎦᏕᏯᏙᏗᎬᎩ; ᏙᏱᏗᏢ ᎠᎵᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎭᏫᏂᏃ ᎢᏗᏢ ᎣᏥᎾᏰᏍᎬᎢ.
\ft For, when we were come into Macedonia, our flesh had no rest, but we were troubled on every side; without were fightings, within were fears.

\ln Unelanvhisgininonv digalisdadisgi uwelihisdi unadanvtawadegi, ogigalisdadistanvgi Dadasi ulutsvi;
\syll ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᏗᎦᎵᏍᏓᏗᏍᎩ ᎤᏪᎵᎯᏍᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏔᏩᏕᎩ, ᎣᎩᎦᎵᏍᏓᏗᏍᏔᏅᎩ ᏓᏓᏏ ᎤᎷᏨᎢ;
\ft Nevertheless God, that comforteth those that are cast down, comforted us by the coming of Titus;

\ln Vtlasgininonv ulutsvquo uwasv, ugalisdisgini nasquo udanvdadvi nihi gesv iyusdi, oginonelv nihi utsati itsadulisgvi, uyo itsiyelvsvhi, utsati sgigeyuiyu gesvi; nasgi iyusdi utli igai aqualihelitsvgi.
\syll ᎥᏝᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎤᎷᏨᏉ ᎤᏩᏒ, ᎤᎦᎵᏍᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᏓᏅᏓᏛᎢ ᏂᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᎣᎩᏃᏁᎸ ᏂᎯ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎢᏣᏚᎵᏍᎬᎢ, ᎤᏲ ᎢᏥᏰᎸᏒᎯ, ᎤᏣᏘ ᏍᎩᎨᏳᎢᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᏟ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎠᏆᎵᎮᎵᏨᎩ.
\ft And not by his coming only, but by the consolation wherewith he was comforted in you, when he told us your earnest desire, your mourning, your fervent mind toward me; so that I rejoiced the more.

\ln Udohiyuhisgininonv uyo itsvyadanvdadistanvgi goweli witsvnvnelvi, vtla uyo yagiyelvha, uyosgininonv agiyelvsvgi; itsigowatiyeno nasgi goweli uyo itsadanvdadistanvi, aseno tlegaquo.
\syll ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎤᏲ ᎢᏨᏯᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏔᏅᎩ ᎪᏪᎵ ᏫᏨᏅᏁᎸᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎤᏲ ᏯᎩᏰᎸᎭ, ᎤᏲᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎠᎩᏰᎸᏒᎩ; ᎢᏥᎪᏩᏘᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᏪᎵ ᎤᏲ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏔᏅᎢ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᏞᎦᏉ.
\ft For though I made you sorry with a letter, I do not repent, though I did repent: for I perceive that the same epistle hath made you sorry, though it were but for a season.

\ln Gohino tsigi galieliga, vtla adina uyo itsadanvdadv yinvdigalisdodiha, nvdigalisdodihasgini digetsinetliyvsdi detsada nvdv iyvdv uyo itsadanvdadvi; uyoyeno itsadanvdadvgi nasgiya Unelanvhi digvwadanilvisdi tsigi, nasgi nvdayulisdodiyi gohusdi esga itsvyvnediyi nigesvna.
\syll ᎪᎯᏃ ᏥᎩ ᎦᎵᎡᎵᎦ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᏗᎾ ᎤᏲ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏓᏛ ᏱᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭᏍᎩᏂ ᏗᎨᏥᏁᏟᏴᏍᏗ ᏕᏣᏓ ᏅᏛ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎤᏲ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏓᏛᎢ; ᎤᏲᏰᏃ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏓᏛᎩ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏗᎬᏩᏓᏂᎸᎢᏍᏗ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏓᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎡᏍᎦ ᎢᏨᏴᏁᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.
\ft Now I rejoice, not that ye were made sorry, but that ye sorrowed to repentance: for ye were made sorry after a godly manner, that ye might receive damage by us in nothing.

\ln Uyoyeno adanvdadisdi Unelanvhi digvwadanilvisdi gesv ganetliyvsdi gesv odanvdv waliyeilohiha vdadisdelvdiyi wigalugi, nasgi uyo ayelvdi nigesvna; elohisdini ehi uyo adanvdadisdi gesv ayohuhisdi gesv waliyeilohiha.
\syll ᎤᏲᏰᏃ ᎠᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏗᎬᏩᏓᏂᎸᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎦᏁᏟᏴᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎣᏓᏅᏛ ᏩᎵᏰᎢᎶᎯᎭ ᎥᏓᏗᏍᏕᎸᏗᏱ ᏫᎦᎷᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏲ ᎠᏰᎸᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ; ᎡᎶᎯᏍᏗᏂ ᎡᎯ ᎤᏲ ᎠᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏩᎵᏰᎢᎶᎯᎭ.
\ft For godly sorrow worketh repentance to salvation not to be repented of: but the sorrow of the world worketh death.

\ln Gvniyuquoyeno hia nasgi uyo tsitsadanvdadvgi nasgi digvwadanilvisdi gesv Unelanvhi, nigav itsalinigvnedi gesv wuliyeilolv; nigav ditsatlvwisdodi itsiyohvi, vv nigav itsiniquatihvi, vv, nigav itsinayesgvi, vv, nigav utsati itsasulisgvi, vvi, nigav ulinigidv itsadanvdvi, vv, nigav adasdvdisdodi gesvi!  nigav tsudalenvdv gvnigesv nitsvnelv nitsisganvna gesv hia nasgi kanohedi tsigi.
\syll ᎬᏂᏳᏉᏰᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏲ ᏥᏣᏓᏅᏓᏛᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎬᏩᏓᏂᎸᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᏂᎦᎥ ᎢᏣᎵᏂᎬᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏭᎵᏰᎢᎶᎸ; ᏂᎦᎥ ᏗᏣᏢᏫᏍᏙᏗ ᎢᏥᏲᎲᎢ, ᎥᎥ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎢᏥᏂᏆᏘᎲᎢ, ᎥᎥ, ᏂᎦᎥ ᎢᏥᎾᏰᏍᎬᎢ, ᎥᎥ, ᏂᎦᎥ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎢᏣᏑᎵᏍᎬᎢ, ᎥᎥᎢ, ᏂᎦᎥ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏛᎢ, ᎥᎥ, ᏂᎦᎥ ᎠᏓᏍᏛᏗᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ  ᏂᎦᎥ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᏨᏁᎸ ᏂᏥᏍᎦᏅᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎧᏃᎮᏗ ᏥᎩ.
\ft For behold this selfsame thing, that ye sorrowed after a godly sort, what carefulness it wrought in you, yea, what clearing of yourselves, yea, what indignation, yea, what fear, yea, what vehement desire, yea, what zeal, yea, what revenge! In all things ye have approved yourselves to be clear in this matter.

\ln Nasgi tsinusdi udohiyuhisgininonv witsvyowelanelvgi, aseno vtla utsatini iyudvnelvhi yugvwalei, vtla ale na utsatini iyagadvnelvhi yugvwalei; asgini itsvsquanigodiyu gesv Unelanvhi agatahv gvnigesv itsalisdanediyi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏄᏍᏗ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᏫᏨᏲᏪᎳᏁᎸᎩ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏣᏘᏂ ᎢᏳᏛᏁᎸᎯ ᏳᎬᏩᎴᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ Ꮎ ᎤᏣᏘᏂ ᎢᏯᎦᏛᏁᎸᎯ ᏳᎬᏩᎴᎢ; ᎠᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᏨᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎦᏔᎲ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ.
\ft Wherefore, though I wrote unto you, I did it not for his cause that had done the wrong, nor for his cause that suffered wrong, but that our care for you in the sight of God might appear unto you.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi nihi ugalisdi itsadanvdv ayv ogigalisdadvgi; vv, ale utli igai ogalihelisdi nulistanvgi, Dadasi aliheligv iyusdi, nvdagalisdodisgvgi nasgi udanvdo nitsiv etsigalisdadelvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏂᎯ ᎤᎦᎵᏍᏗ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏛ ᎠᏴ ᎣᎩᎦᎵᏍᏓᏛᎩ; ᎥᎥ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏟ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎣᎦᎵᎮᎵᏍᏗ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎩ, ᏓᏓᏏ ᎠᎵᎮᎵᎬ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏓᏅᏙ ᏂᏥᎥ ᎡᏥᎦᎵᏍᏓᏕᎸᎢ.
\ft Therefore we were comforted in your comfort: yea, and exceedingly the more joyed we for the joy of Titus, because his spirit was refreshed by you all.

\ln Iyuyeno tsiyatlvquiselvhi gesesdi, nihi itsvneisdisgvi, vtla yigadeosga; nigadiyusgini tsudalenvdv itsvwonetanvi udohiyuhiya tsigi, nasgiyaquo ogatlvquasvi, nasgi Dadasi otsatlvquaselvi, udohiyuhiya nulistanv.
\syll ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᏥᏯᏢᏈᏎᎸᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᏂᎯ ᎢᏨᏁᎢᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᏱᎦᏕᎣᏍᎦ; ᏂᎦᏗᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎢᏨᏬᏁᏔᏅᎢ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯᏉ ᎣᎦᏢᏆᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏓᏓᏏ ᎣᏣᏢᏆᏎᎸᎢ, ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ.
\ft For if I have boasted any thing to him of you, I am not ashamed; but as we spake all things to you in truth, even so our boasting, which I made before Titus, is found a truth.

\ln Ale unawiyi itsigeyuhiyu gesv utsati unequotsv, unvdadv itsohiyuhiyu gesv nitsivi, nasgi itsinayesgi ale ditsinawisgi detsadanilvtsvi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏫᏱ ᎢᏥᎨᏳᎯᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᏁᏉᏨ, ᎤᏅᏓᏛ ᎢᏦᎯᏳᎯᏳ ᎨᏒ ᏂᏥᎥᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏥᎾᏰᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏥᎾᏫᏍᎩ ᏕᏣᏓᏂᎸᏨᎢ.
\ft And his inward affection is more abundant toward you, whilst he remembereth the obedience of you all, how with fear and trembling ye received him.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi galieliga, getsvyoiyudi gesv nudalesv gohusdi ugvwali.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎦᎵᎡᎵᎦ, ᎨᏨᏲᎢᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏄᏓᎴᏒ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ.
\ft I rejoice therefore that I have confidence in you in all things.

\ln Alewo idalinvtli, gvnigesv nitsvyvneha, Unelanvhi gvwagatiya udanedi gesv nasgi dunelv tsunanelodi dunadatluwadisv Masidoni anehi;
\syll ᎠᎴᏬ ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᏨᏴᏁᎭ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᏁᎸ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᏚᎾᏓᏡᏩᏗᏒ ᎹᏏᏙᏂ ᎠᏁᎯ;
\ft Moreover, brethren, we do you to wit of the grace of God bestowed on the churches of Macedonia;

\ln Nasgi utsati adagoliyesgi anigiliyogv, utsati analiheligv ale utsati uyo nunadvhnadegv galvquodiyu nuwanelv nunigeyuhnavna gesvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎠᏓᎪᎵᏰᏍᎩ ᎠᏂᎩᎵᏲᎬ, ᎤᏣᏘ ᎠᎾᎵᎮᎵᎬ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᏲ ᏄᎾᏛᎿᏕᎬ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᏄᏩᏁᎸ ᏄᏂᎨᏳᎿᎥᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft How that in a great trial of affliction the abundance of their joy and their deep poverty abounded unto the riches of their liberality.

\ln Gatsiyoiyudanehayeno nasgi nidunalinigvgv iyvdv, vv, ale anilosvsdisgv niganalinigvgvi, unaligatliyvhiquo unvsv unadanvtedv;
\syll ᎦᏥᏲᎢᏳᏓᏁᎭᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᏚᎾᎵᏂᎬᎬ ᎢᏴᏛ, ᎥᎥ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᎶᏒᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᏂᎦᎾᎵᏂᎬᎬᎢ, ᎤᎾᎵᎦᏟᏴᎯᏉ ᎤᏅᏒ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏖᏛ;
\ft For to their power, I bear record, yea, and beyond their power they were willing of themselves;

\ln Utsati gogisdiyedisgv gogitayosehvgi nasgi uninvhi tsogadanilvisdiyi, ale ogatequalodiyi tsotsisdelvdiyi tsunanelodi.
\syll ᎤᏣᏘ ᎪᎩᏍᏗᏰᏗᏍᎬ ᎪᎩᏔᏲᏎᎲᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᏅᎯ ᏦᎦᏓᏂᎸᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎣᎦᏖᏆᎶᏗᏱ ᏦᏥᏍᏕᎸᏗᏱ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ.
\ft Praying us with much intreaty that we would receive the gift, and take upon us the fellowship of the ministering to the saints.

\ln Ale [nasgi nunadvnelvgi] vtla nasgiya nusdv udugi ogvnvi, igvyisgini unvsv Ugvwiyuhi dunadayohiselvgi, ale ayv degogadayohiselvgi, Unelanvhi osiyu ayelvsgv nvdayulisdotanvgi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᎾᏛᏁᎸᎩdata is invalid ᎥᏝ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎣᎬᏅᎢ, ᎢᎬᏱᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏅᏒ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏚᎾᏓᏲᎯᏎᎸᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴ ᏕᎪᎦᏓᏲᎯᏎᎸᎩ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎠᏰᎸᏍᎬ ᏅᏓᏳᎵᏍᏙᏔᏅᎩ.
\ft And this they did, not as we hoped, but first gave their own selves to the Lord, and unto us by the will of God.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi Dadasi otsitayoselvgi, nasgi nusdv ulenvhvi, nasgiya iyudvnediyi usquadisdiyi itsehv utloyi itsadanediyi nitsvnehvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏓᏓᏏ ᎣᏥᏔᏲᏎᎸᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎤᎴᏅᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎢᏳᏛᏁᏗᏱ ᎤᏍᏆᏗᏍᏗᏱ ᎢᏤᎲ ᎤᏠᏱ ᎢᏣᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᏂᏨᏁᎲᎢ.
\ft Insomuch that we desired Titus, that as he had begun, so he would also finish in you the same grace also.

\ln Nasgino nigav tsudalenvdv utsati tsitsiha, nasgi gohiyudi gesvi, ale gawonihisdi gesvi, ale agadovhisdi gesvi, ale nigav tsudalenvdv itsigaliyvi, ale ayv sgigeyuiyu gesvi, hia nasgi adanedi gesv nasquo utsati itsihesdi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏥᏥᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎢᏥᎦᎵᏴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴ ᏍᎩᎨᏳᎢᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎢᏥᎮᏍᏗ.
\ft Therefore, as ye abound in every thing, in faith, and utterance, and knowledge, and in all diligence, and in your love to us, see that ye abound in this grace also.

\ln Vtla yitsinega nasgi hia ase itsadvnediyi, anisoisgini unaligaliyvnv nvdigalisdodiha, ale agigoliyediyi adageyudi gesv itsihv nutlonasdvna gesvi.
\syll ᎥᏝ ᏱᏥᏁᎦ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏎ ᎢᏣᏛᏁᏗᏱ, ᎠᏂᏐᎢᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᎾᎵᎦᎵᏴᏅ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎩᎪᎵᏰᏗᏱ ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏥᎲ ᏄᏠᎾᏍᏛᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft I speak not by commandment, but by occasion of the forwardness of others, and to prove the sincerity of your love.

\ln Itsigatahayeno gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv Ugvwiyuhi igatseliga Tsisa Galonedv, nasgi uwenaiyu tsigesei, aseno nihi gesv nvdigalisdodisgv uyo iyudvhnadegi nulistanvi, nasgi uwasv uyo iyudvhnadegi gesv iyuwanisodiyi nihi ditsehnai itsalisdodiyi.
\syll ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎭᏰᏃ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᎦᏤᎵᎦ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏪᎾᎢᏳ ᏥᎨᏎᎢ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᏂᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬ ᎤᏲ ᎢᏳᏛᎿᏕᎩ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎤᏲ ᎢᏳᏛᎿᏕᎩ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏐᏗᏱ ᏂᎯ ᏗᏤᎿᎢ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
\ft For ye know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, that, though he was rich, yet for your sakes he became poor, that ye through his poverty might be rich.

\ln Ale ani nasgi nusdv gadanvtesgv gvnigesv nigvneha; osiyuyeno igetsalisdanedi, nasgi gayula itsalenvdv tsigi, hnaquo sudetiyvdv, vtla itsadvnediyiquo nasgi, nasquosgini osiyu itsiyelvdiyi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎦᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᎬᏁᎭ; ᎣᏏᏳᏰᏃ ᎢᎨᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏳᎳ ᎢᏣᎴᏅᏛ ᏥᎩ, ᎿᏉ ᏑᏕᏘᏴᏛ, ᎥᏝ ᎢᏣᏛᏁᏗᏱᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ, ᎾᏍᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏥᏰᎸᏗᏱ.
\ft And herein I give my advice: for this is expedient for you, who have begun before, not only to do, but also to be forward a year ago.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi hnaquo itsisquada nasgi iyadvnedi gesvi, nasgi itsigaliyiyu nigesv itsadulvdiyi, nasgi nasquo nusdesdi itsisquadisgvi, itsvdisgv nasgi nusdv itsihvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎿᏉ ᎢᏥᏍᏆᏓ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏥᎦᎵᏱᏳ ᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏣᏚᎸᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏄᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᎢᏥᏍᏆᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᎢᏨᏗᏍᎬ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎢᏥᎲᎢ.
\ft Now therefore perform the doing of it; that as there was a readiness to will, so there may be a performance also out of that which ye have.

\ln Iyuyeno igvyi gesv gilo yagaliyv tsudanvdvi, tsagadanilvtsedi geso nasgiya nusdv uhvi, vtlano nasgiya nuhvna gesvi.
\syll ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᎢᎬᏱ ᎨᏒ ᎩᎶ ᏯᎦᎵᏴ ᏧᏓᏅᏛᎢ, ᏣᎦᏓᏂᎸᏤᏗ ᎨᏐ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎤᎲᎢ, ᎥᏝᏃ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᎲᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft For if there be first a willing mind, it is accepted according to that a man hath, and not according to that he hath not.

\ln Vtla adina nvwanadale digetsigodiyi nihino asdaya iyetsvnediyi yigadiha;
\syll ᎥᏝ ᎠᏗᎾ ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴ ᏗᎨᏥᎪᏗᏱ ᏂᎯᏃ ᎠᏍᏓᏯ ᎢᏰᏨᏁᏗᏱ ᏱᎦᏗᎭ;
\ft For I mean not that other men be eased, and ye burdened:

\ln Igvwasdihasgini [itsidiyi;] nasgi gohi gesv utsati itsihv yiditsisdelvdiha uninigvsehvi, nasgino nasquo utsati unihv getsisdelvdiyi itsinigvsehvi, nasgi igvwasdiha itsidiyi.
\syll ᎢᎬᏩᏍᏗᎭᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᏥᏗᏱ;data is invalid ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎢᏥᎲ ᏱᏗᏥᏍᏕᎸᏗᎭ ᎤᏂᏂᎬᏎᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᏂᎲ ᎨᏥᏍᏕᎸᏗᏱ ᎢᏥᏂᎬᏎᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎬᏩᏍᏗᎭ ᎢᏥᏗᏱ.
\ft But by an equality, that now at this time your abundance may be a supply for their want, that their abundance also may be a supply for your want: that there may be equality:

\ln Nasgiya hia tsinigvnv tsigowela, Nasgi ugodi uwutedv vtla yutiyehei; nano gayoli uwutedv vtla yululotsehei.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᎬᏅ ᏥᎪᏪᎳ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎪᏗ ᎤᏭᏖᏛ ᎥᏝ ᏳᏘᏰᎮᎢ; ᎾᏃ ᎦᏲᎵ ᎤᏭᏖᏛ ᎥᏝ ᏳᎷᎶᏤᎮᎢ.
\ft As it is written, He that had gathered much had nothing over; and he that had gathered little had no lack.

\ln Aseno Unelanvhi alihelitsedi gesesdi, nasgi Dadasi unawiyi tsulanelv nasgi igai ditseluisdiyi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎵᎮᎵᏤᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏓᏓᏏ ᎤᎾᏫᏱ ᏧᎳᏁᎸ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎦᎢ ᏗᏤᎷᎢᏍᏗᏱ.
\ft But thanks be to God, which put the same earnest care into the heart of Titus for you.

\ln Udohiyuhiyeno dudanilvtsvgi tsiwonetanvi; aseno utlihiyu nuligaliyvsv nvdayulisdotanvgi, uwasvquo udanvtedv itsiwadvhvsvgi.
\syll ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏰᏃ ᏚᏓᏂᎸᏨᎩ ᏥᏬᏁᏔᏅᎢ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏟᎯᏳ ᏄᎵᎦᎵᏴᏒ ᏅᏓᏳᎵᏍᏙᏔᏅᎩ, ᎤᏩᏒᏉ ᎤᏓᏅᏖᏛ ᎢᏥᏩᏛᎲᏒᎩ.
\ft For indeed he accepted the exhortation; but being more forward, of his own accord he went unto you.

\ln Ale yitsinvli nasgi anegi na idalinvtli, nigvnadv dunadatluwadisv tsunanelodi gvwalvquodiyu tsigi osdv kanohedv tsinvdigalisdodiha;
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏱᏥᏅᎵ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏁᎩ Ꮎ ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᏂᎬᎾᏛ ᏚᎾᏓᏡᏩᏗᏒ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎬᏩᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᏥᎩ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏥᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ;
\ft And we have sent with him the brother, whose praise is in the gospel throughout all the churches;

\ln Ale vtla nasgiquo yinigav, nasquosgini dunadatluwadisv tsunanelodi gvwasuyesvgi ayv itsulaha ogenvsdiyi ogiyvsdiyi hia nasgi adanedi, nasgi tsidogilvwisdaneha, galvquodiyu iyulisdodiyi Ugvwiyuhi uwasv, ale [gvnigesv igvwanediyi] itsaligaliyvsv doditsadanvdvi;
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᎾᏍᎩᏉ ᏱᏂᎦᎥ, ᎾᏍᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᏚᎾᏓᏡᏩᏗᏒ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎬᏩᏑᏰᏒᎩ ᎠᏴ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎣᎨᏅᏍᏗᏱ ᎣᎩᏴᏍᏗᏱ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏓᏁᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏙᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎭ, ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏩᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᎬᏩᏁᏗᏱdata is invalid ᎢᏣᎵᎦᎵᏴᏒ ᏙᏗᏣᏓᏅᏛᎢ;
\ft And not that only, but who was also chosen of the churches to travel with us with this grace, which is administered by us to the glory of the same Lord, and declaration of your ready mind:

\ln Hia nasgi otsiyosdodisgvi, gilo gohusdi gogelisediyi hia nasgi utsati ugvwali gohusdi ogvnedi tsinigalisdiha;
\syll ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏥᏲᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᎩᎶ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎪᎨᎵᏎᏗᏱ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎣᎬᏁᏗ ᏥᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᎭ;
\ft Avoiding this, that no man should blame us in this abundance which is administered by us:

\ln Igvyi gayehi otsagasayasdisgv osiyu ayelvdi gesvi, vtla Ugvwiyuhiquo agatahvi, yvwisgini nasquo anigatahvi.
\syll ᎢᎬᏱ ᎦᏰᎯ ᎣᏣᎦᏌᏯᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎠᏰᎸᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᏉ ᎠᎦᏔᎲᎢ, ᏴᏫᏍᎩᏂ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎲᎢ.
\ft Providing for honest things, not only in the sight of the Lord, but also in the sight of men.

\ln Ale otsinvli itsulaha anegi otsalinvtli, nasgi uwagutilodv otsigoliyedv ogadolehosvhi utsati agaliyiyu gesvi, aseno gohi gesv utli nagaliyv, nvdigalisdodiha utsati itsohiyusvi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎣᏥᏅᎵ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎠᏁᎩ ᎣᏣᎵᏅᏟ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏩᎫᏘᎶᏛ ᎣᏥᎪᎵᏰᏛ ᎣᎦᏙᎴᎰᏒᎯ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎠᎦᎵᏱᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏟ ᎾᎦᎵᏴ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎢᏦᎯᏳᏒᎢ.
\ft And we have sent with them our brother, whom we have oftentimes proved diligent in many things, but now much more diligent, upon the great confidence which I have in you.

\ln Dadasino gesvi, oginaligohi nasgi, ale itsulaha tsoginilvwisdanehi nihi gohusdi itsvyadvnehvi; otsalinvtlino gesv tsunanelodi dunadatluwadisv gvwaninvsidv nasgi, ale galvquodiyu iyanvnehi Galonedv.
\syll ᏓᏓᏏᏃ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎣᎩᎾᎵᎪᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᏦᎩᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᏂᎯ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎢᏨᏯᏛᏁᎲᎢ; ᎣᏣᎵᏅᏟᏃ ᎨᏒ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᏚᎾᏓᏡᏩᏗᏒ ᎬᏩᏂᏅᏏᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎢᏯᏅᏁᎯ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ.
\ft Whether any do inquire of Titus, he is my partner and fellowhelper concerning you: or our brethren be inquired of, they are the messengers of the churches, and the glory of Christ.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi anigatahv tsunanelodi dunadatluwadisvi, gvnigesv nidetsvnelvha nasgi gohiyudisgi adageyudi gesv itsehvi, ale ogatlvquasv nihi itsvneisdisgvi asequo nigesvna gesvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎲ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᏚᎾᏓᏡᏩᏗᏒᎢ, ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᏕᏨᏁᎸᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᎯᏳᏗᏍᎩ ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏤᎲᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎣᎦᏢᏆᏒ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏨᏁᎢᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ ᎠᏎᏉ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Wherefore shew ye to them, and before the churches, the proof of your love, and of our boasting on your behalf.

\ln Nano unadanvti disdelvdiyi ugvwali, asequoquo yitsvyowelaneha.
\syll ᎾᏃ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ ᏗᏍᏕᎸᏗᏱ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ, ᎠᏎᏉᏉ ᏱᏨᏲᏪᎳᏁᎭ.
\ft For as touching the ministering to the saints, it is superfluous for me to write to you:

\ln Tsigatahayeno digaliyiyu gesv detsadanvdvi, nasgi itsvneisdisgv Masidoni anehi gatsiyatlvquiseha, [gatsinoneha] nasgi Ekaya hnaquo sudetiyvdv gvwadvnvistanvhi gesvi; ale nihi ulinigidv itsadanvdv unitsata unitelvnv.
\syll ᏥᎦᏔᎭᏰᏃ ᏗᎦᎵᏱᏳ ᎨᏒ ᏕᏣᏓᏅᏛᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏨᏁᎢᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᎹᏏᏙᏂ ᎠᏁᎯ ᎦᏥᏯᏢᏈᏎᎭ, ᎦᏥᏃᏁᎭdata is invalid ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᎧᏯ ᎿᏉ ᏑᏕᏘᏴᏛ ᎬᏩᏛᏅᎢᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᏂᎯ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏛ ᎤᏂᏣᏔ ᎤᏂᏖᎸᏅ.
\ft For I know the forwardness of your mind, for which I boast of you to them of Macedonia, that Achaia was ready a year ago; and your zeal hath provoked very many.

\ln Aseno gatsinvli otsalinvtli, nasgi asequoquo iyulisdodiyi nigesvna otsatlvquisgv itsvneisdisgvi; nasgi itsadvnvistanvhi yigi, nasgiya nagiwesvi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎦᏥᏅᎵ ᎣᏣᎵᏅᏟ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏎᏉᏉ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎣᏣᏢᏈᏍᎬ ᎢᏨᏁᎢᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏣᏛᏅᎢᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᏱᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᎩᏪᏒᎢ.
\ft Yet have I sent the brethren, lest our boasting of you should be in vain in this behalf; that, as I said, ye may be ready:

\ln Iyuyeno yinvwasegatsv Masidoni anehi yigvgisdawadenv, yitsvwadvtanvno nitsadvnvistanvna, ayv, (vtlayeno nihi yigadiha,) yotsadehohi hia nasgi utsati ogohiyuhi ogatlvquisvi.
\syll ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᏱᏅᏩᏎᎦᏨ ᎹᏏᏙᏂ ᎠᏁᎯ ᏱᎬᎩᏍᏓᏩᏕᏅ, ᏱᏨᏩᏛᏔᏅᏃ ᏂᏣᏛᏅᎢᏍᏔᏅᎾ, ᎠᏴ, ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᏂᎯ ᏱᎦᏗᎭ, ᏲᏣᏕᎰᎯ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎣᎪᎯᏳᎯ ᎣᎦᏢᏈᏒᎢ.
\ft Lest haply if they of Macedonia come with me, and find you unprepared, we (that we say not, ye) should be ashamed in this same confident boasting.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi ase yigatsinetselv analinvtli aquelisvgi igvyi wigetsilutsediyi, ale igvyi wunadvnvisdodiyi itsidi gesv, nasgi gayula kaneistanvhi tsigi, nasgi advnvistanonvhi yigi, nasgiya osiyu itsiyelvhi itsinvhi gesvi, vtlano itsigeyunvhi nasgiyai.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏎ ᏱᎦᏥᏁᏤᎸ ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏟ ᎠᏇᎵᏒᎩ ᎢᎬᏱ ᏫᎨᏥᎷᏤᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᎬᏱ ᏭᎾᏛᏅᎢᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎢᏥᏗ ᎨᏒ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏳᎳ ᎧᏁᎢᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏛᏅᎢᏍᏔᏃᏅᎯ ᏱᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏥᏰᎸᎯ ᎢᏥᏅᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎥᏝᏃ ᎢᏥᎨᏳᏅᎯ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ.
\ft Therefore I thought it necessary to exhort the brethren, that they would go before unto you, and make up beforehand your bounty, whereof ye had notice before, that the same might be ready, as a matter of bounty, and not as of covetousness.

\ln Hiasgini [nusdi;] Gilo gayoli awisgi, nasgi na nasquo gayoli usgudesdi gesesdi; ale gilo ugodi awisgi nasgi na nasquo ugodi usgudesdi gesesdi.
\syll ᎯᎠᏍᎩᏂ ᏄᏍᏗ;data is invalid ᎩᎶ ᎦᏲᎵ ᎠᏫᏍᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎦᏲᎵ ᎤᏍᎫᏕᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᎤᎪᏗ ᎠᏫᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᎪᏗ ᎤᏍᎫᏕᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft But this I say, He which soweth sparingly shall reap also sparingly; and he which soweth bountifully shall reap also bountifully.

\ln Naniv gilo nasgiya nusdv anadanvtesgv tsuninawiyi [anihvsgesdi;] vtlasdi tlaquo uniyelvhi, vtla ale ase unidiyi tsinigegvneho iyusdi; Unelanvhiyeno ugeyuha ugalisdi udaneti ahvsgi.
\syll ᎾᏂᎥ ᎩᎶ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎠᎾᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ ᏧᏂᎾᏫᏱ ᎠᏂᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ;data is invalid ᎥᏝᏍᏗ ᏝᏉ ᎤᏂᏰᎸᎯ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏎ ᎤᏂᏗᏱ ᏥᏂᎨᎬᏁᎰ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ; ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ ᎤᎨᏳᎭ ᎤᎦᎵᏍᏗ ᎤᏓᏁᏘ ᎠᎲᏍᎩ.
\ft Every man according as he purposeth in his heart, so let him give; not grudgingly, or of necessity: for God loveth a cheerful giver.

\ln Unelanvhiyeno yeliquo getsinedi utsati nudalesv gohusdi, nasgi nihi nigohilv nitsinigvsehvna gesv nigav tsudalenvdv, osdv gesv utsati digetsilvwisdanedi iyulisdodiyi.
\syll ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ ᏰᎵᏉ ᎨᏥᏁᏗ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏄᏓᎴᏒ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎯ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᏂᏥᏂᎬᏎᎲᎾ ᎨᏒ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ, ᎣᏍᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏗᎨᏥᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
\ft And God is able to make all grace abound toward you; that ye, always having all sufficiency in all things, may abound to every good work:

\ln Nasgiya hia tsinigvnv tsigowela, Dudigaleyastanv; uyo iyunadvhnadegi dunelv; udanvtiyu gesv nvwasdiquo nigohilvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᎬᏅ ᏥᎪᏪᎳ, ᏚᏗᎦᎴᏯᏍᏔᏅ; ᎤᏲ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᎿᏕᎩ ᏚᏁᎸ; ᎤᏓᏅᏘᏳ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏩᏍᏗᏉ ᏂᎪᎯᎸᎢ.
\ft (As it is written, He hath dispersed abroad; he hath given to the poor: his righteousness remaineth for ever.

\ln Nasgino na ugata awisgi unehi tsigi, ale gadu alisdayvdodi adanehi tsigi, itsinedi gesesdi ale ugodadisdi gesesdi itsiwisdi gesvi, ale unequosdi gesesdi itsadanvtiyu gesv ugatatanvhi;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ Ꮎ ᎤᎦᏔ ᎠᏫᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᏚ ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᏙᏗ ᎠᏓᏁᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎢᏥᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎪᏓᏗᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎢᏥᏫᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᏉᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏘᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎦᏔᏔᏅᎯ;
\ft Now he that ministereth seed to the sower both minister bread for your food, and multiply your seed sown, and increase the fruits of your righteousness;)

\ln Nudalesv gohusdi itsenvistanvhi gesv, nasgi utsati getsadanedi gesvi, nasgi iyugvnisodiyi agalihelitsediyi Unelanvhi.
\syll ᏄᏓᎴᏒ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎢᏤᏅᎢᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎨᏣᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᎬᏂᏐᏗᏱ ᎠᎦᎵᎮᎵᏤᏗᏱ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ.
\ft Being enriched in every thing to all bountifulness, which causeth through us thanksgiving to God.

\ln Hiayeno ayatasdi gesv itsinvhi, vtla unadanvti uninigvsehv akaliihi uwasv yigi, nasquosgini utsati unalihelitsedi Unelanvhi nigvneha;
\syll ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᎠᏯᏔᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏥᏅᎯ, ᎥᏝ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ ᎤᏂᏂᎬᏎᎲ ᎠᎧᎵᎢᎯ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏱᎩ, ᎾᏍᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᎾᎵᎮᎵᏤᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏂᎬᏁᎭ;
\ft For the administration of this service not only supplieth the want of the saints, but is abundant also by many thanksgivings unto God;

\ln Anigowadisgvyeno iyusdi nasgi hia unalisdelvdodi gesv Unelanvhi dvnilvquotani nigalisdodisgesdi gvnigesv nitsvnehv itsohiyusv osdv kanohedv Galonedv utseliga, ale nigalisdodisgesdi nitsigeyuhnavna gesv detsinehv nasgi, ale nanivquo;
\syll ᎠᏂᎪᏩᏗᏍᎬᏰᏃ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏛᏂᎸᏉᏔᏂ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᏨᏁᎲ ᎢᏦᎯᏳᏒ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏂᏥᎨᏳᎿᎥᎾ ᎨᏒ ᏕᏥᏁᎲ ᎾᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏂᎥᏉ;
\ft Whiles by the experiment of this ministration they glorify God for your professed subjection unto the gospel of Christ, and for your liberal distribution unto them, and unto all men;

\ln Ale nasgi iyusdi anadadolisdisgv getsineisdisgesdi, utsati getsigeyusv nvdigalisdodisgv utsati gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv Unelanvhi itsinelvi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᎾᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᎨᏥᏁᎢᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎤᏣᏘ ᎨᏥᎨᏳᏒ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᏥᏁᎸᎢ.
\ft And by their prayer for you, which long after you for the exceeding grace of God in you.

\ln Unelanvhi alihelitsedi gesesdi nigalisdodiha nasgi udanedi gesv ganohehohvsdi nigesvna tsigi.
\syll ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎵᎮᎵᏤᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎦᏃᎮᎰᎲᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏥᎩ.
\ft Thanks be unto God for his unspeakable gift.

\ln Nasgino ayv Quola aquvsv itsvsdiyediha tsineisdiha udolisdosiyu gesv ale udanvtiyu gesv Galonedv, ayv nasgi tsitsvyeladidoho aquadanayesdi tsigehoi, aseno agigonelv nitsvnayesgvna tsigi nihi^
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎠᏴ ᏉᎳ ᎠᏋᏒ ᎢᏨᏍᏗᏰᏗᎭ ᏥᏁᎢᏍᏗᎭ ᎤᏙᎵᏍᏙᏏᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᏅᏘᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ, ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏨᏰᎳᏗᏙᎰ ᎠᏆᏓᎾᏰᏍᏗ ᏥᎨᎰᎢ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᎩᎪᏁᎸ ᏂᏨᎾᏰᏍᎬᎾ ᏥᎩ ᏂᎯdata is invalid
\ft Now I Paul myself beseech you by the meekness and gentleness of Christ, who in presence am base among you, but being absent am bold toward you:

\ln Aseno itsvtayoseha itsvyeladidohv naquadanayesdvna iyaqualisdodiyi nigesvna, nasgiya naquadanayesdvna gatsiyvdanedi tsagiyelvha igadv, nasgi uquedali adanvtesgv danikahnawadi tsigogeliseha.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎢᏨᏔᏲᏎᎭ ᎢᏨᏰᎳᏗᏙᎲ ᎾᏆᏓᎾᏰᏍᏛᎾ ᎢᏯᏆᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏆᏓᎾᏰᏍᏛᎾ ᎦᏥᏴᏓᏁᏗ ᏣᎩᏰᎸᎭ ᎢᎦᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎠᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ ᏓᏂᎧᎿᏩᏗ ᏥᎪᎨᎵᏎᎭ.
\ft But I beseech you, that I may not be bold when I am present with that confidence, wherewith I think to be bold against some, which think of us as if we walked according to the flesh.

\ln Udohiyuhisgininonv uquedalv utsedoha, aseno vtla uquedali tsutliyvdodi gesv yidotsatliyvdiha;
\syll ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎤᏇᏓᎸ ᎤᏤᏙᎭ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᏧᏟᏴᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏱᏙᏣᏟᏴᏗᎭ;
\ft For though we walk in the flesh, we do not war after the flesh:

\ln (Ogalisdelvdodiyeno gesv danvwa otsaisv vtla uquedali tsuwadodi yigi, tsulinigidiyusgini Unelanvhi iyuwanisadv, dasoyovdisgv ulinigidv dasoyvi.)
\syll ᎣᎦᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗᏰᏃ ᎨᏒ ᏓᏅᏩ ᎣᏣᎢᏒ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᏧᏩᏙᏗ ᏱᎩ, ᏧᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ, ᏓᏐᏲᎥᏗᏍᎬ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᏓᏐᏴᎢ.
\ft (For the weapons of our warfare are not carnal, but mighty through God to the pulling down of strong holds;)

\ln Eladi nidotsvneho adanvtedi gesv, ale nudalesv inv igati nasgi adalisaladisgi Unelanvhi utseli agadovhisdi gesv digatilegi, ale dotsisegogisgo dotsatinego nudalesv adanvtedi gesv Galonedv gvwohiyudiyi notsvnehoi;
\syll ᎡᎳᏗ ᏂᏙᏨᏁᎰ ᎠᏓᏅᏖᏗ ᎨᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᏄᏓᎴᏒ ᎢᏅ ᎢᎦᏘ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏓᎵᏌᎳᏗᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎠᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏗᎦᏘᎴᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏙᏥᏎᎪᎩᏍᎪ ᏙᏣᏘᏁᎪ ᏄᏓᎴᏒ ᎠᏓᏅᏖᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎬᏬᎯᏳᏗᏱ ᏃᏨᏁᎰᎢ;
\ft Casting down imaginations, and every high thing that exalteth itself against the knowledge of God, and bringing into captivity every thought to the obedience of Christ;

\ln Ale ogadvnvisdi tsotsisdvdisdodiyi naniv nunohiyusvna gesvi, nahiyu itsohiyusv ukalitsvhi gesesdi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎣᎦᏛᏅᎢᏍᏗ ᏦᏥᏍᏛᏗᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏄᏃᎯᏳᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏀᎢᏳ ᎢᏦᎯᏳᏒ ᎤᎧᎵᏨᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft And having in a readiness to revenge all disobedience, when your obedience is fulfilled.

\ln Tsigo gaduiditlv nusdv dikanodiyi gohusdi detsakanisgoi?  iyuno gilo uwasvquo adalisgasdodisgesdi Galonedv tsiyatseli ayv ielisgesdi, uwasv gesv taline hia nasgi tsiadanvdvli, nasgi nasgiya Galonedv utseli gesv nasgi, nasgiya nasquo ayv Galonedv otsatseliga.
\syll ᏥᎪ ᎦᏚᎢᏗᏢ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏗᎧᏃᏗᏱ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏕᏣᎧᏂᏍᎪᎢ?  ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏩᏒᏉ ᎠᏓᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏥᏯᏤᎵ ᎠᏴ ᎢᎡᎵᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎤᏩᏒ ᎨᏒ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᎠᏓᏅᏛᎵ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏴ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎣᏣᏤᎵᎦ.
\ft Do ye look on things after the outward appearance? If any man trust to himself that he is Christ's, let him of himself think this again, that, as he is Christ's, even so are we Christ's.

\ln Iyuyeno nasquo utli igai yaquatlvquistanv nusdv ogasvgalvi, nasgi Ugvwiyuhi tsoginelv itsalisdelvdodi gesvi, vtlano eladi iyetsvnedodi gesvi, vtla yigagadeosga.
\syll ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᏟ ᎢᎦᎢ ᏯᏆᏢᏈᏍᏔᏅ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎣᎦᏒᎦᎸᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏦᎩᏁᎸ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎥᏝᏃ ᎡᎳᏗ ᎢᏰᏨᏁᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᏱᎦᎦᏕᎣᏍᎦ.
\ft For though I should boast somewhat more of our authority, which the Lord hath given us for edification, and not for your destruction, I should not be ashamed:

\ln Tlesdi adina itsvyowelanehv itsvsgasdanediyiquo tsagiyelvso yinvwasdesdi.
\syll ᏞᏍᏗ ᎠᏗᎾ ᎢᏨᏲᏪᎳᏁᎲ ᎢᏨᏍᎦᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱᏉ ᏣᎩᏰᎸᏐ ᏱᏅᏩᏍᏕᏍᏗ.
\ft That I may not seem as if I would terrify you by letters.

\ln Degowelisgvyeno digagediyu ale tsulinigidiyu, udohiyu, anadiha; ayelvsgini yoweladidoha awanagalahiyu, gawonisgvno gvdehododiquo.
\syll ᏕᎪᏪᎵᏍᎬᏰᏃ ᏗᎦᎨᏗᏳ ᎠᎴ ᏧᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ, ᎤᏙᎯᏳ, ᎠᎾᏗᎭ; ᎠᏰᎸᏍᎩᏂ ᏲᏪᎳᏗᏙᎭ ᎠᏩᎾᎦᎳᎯᏳ, ᎦᏬᏂᏍᎬᏃ ᎬᏕᎰᏙᏗᏉ.
\ft For his letters, say they, are weighty and powerful; but his bodily presence is weak, and his speech contemptible.

\ln Nasgi iyelisgi hia nasgi nusdesdi adanvtesgesdi, nasgi ayv nasgiya nogasdv otsiwonisgv dotsowelisgvi, nahna winotsedohvna gesvi, nasgiya nasquo nogasdesdi dogilvwisdanehv hnaquo nahna wotsedohesdi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏰᎵᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᎠᏓᏅᏖᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏃᎦᏍᏛ ᎣᏥᏬᏂᏍᎬ ᏙᏦᏪᎵᏍᎬᎢ, ᏀᎾ ᏫᏃᏤᏙᎲᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏃᎦᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᏙᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᎿᏉ ᏀᎾ ᏬᏤᏙᎮᏍᏗ.
\ft Let such an one think this, that, such as we are in word by letters when we are absent, such will we be also in deed when we are present.

\ln Vtlayeno yeli gayogalitloyasdodi yigi, ale digayogadatlilosdodi yigi nunasdv nasgi unvsv anadalvquodisgi; nasgiyeno unvsv gesv unvsvquo nunasdv danadatlilosdisgv, ale unvsvquo danadatselasdisgv vtla yunadanvta.
\syll ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᏰᎵ ᎦᏲᎦᎵᏠᏯᏍᏙᏗ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎦᏲᎦᏓᏟᎶᏍᏙᏗ ᏱᎩ ᏄᎾᏍᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏅᏒ ᎠᎾᏓᎸᏉᏗᏍᎩ; ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎤᏅᏒ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏅᏒᏉ ᏄᎾᏍᏛ ᏓᎾᏓᏟᎶᏍᏗᏍᎬ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏅᏒᏉ ᏓᎾᏓᏤᎳᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᎥᏝ ᏳᎾᏓᏅᏔ.
\ft For we dare not make ourselves of the number, or compare ourselves with some that commend themselves: but they measuring themselves by themselves, and comparing themselves among themselves, are not wise.

\ln Ayvsgini vtla yvgayotsatlvqui agayotsilosvsda atlilovi; nasgiyaquosgini wasdv iyvdv atlilov Unelanvhi dogiyohiselvi, nasgi atlilosdi nihi ditsehv wigalugi.
\syll ᎠᏴᏍᎩᏂ ᎥᏝ ᏴᎦᏲᏣᏢᏈ ᎠᎦᏲᏥᎶᏒᏍᏓ ᎠᏟᎶᎥᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩᏯᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᏩᏍᏛ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎠᏟᎶᎥ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏙᎩᏲᎯᏎᎸᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏟᎶᏍᏗ ᏂᎯ ᏗᏤᎲ ᏫᎦᎷᎩ.
\ft But we will not boast of things without our measure, but according to the measure of the rule which God hath distributed to us, a measure to reach even unto you.

\ln Vtlayeno yotsilosvsdiha ogatlilosvlvi, nasgiya nihi ditsehv wigayogiluhisdi nigesvna tsigeso iyusdi; nihiyeno nasquo ditsehv iyvdv wogilutsv otsalitsidohvsgv osdv kanohedv Galonedv utseliga;
\syll ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᏲᏥᎶᏒᏍᏗᎭ ᎣᎦᏟᎶᏒᎸᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏂᎯ ᏗᏤᎲ ᏫᎦᏲᎩᎷᎯᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏥᎨᏐ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ; ᏂᎯᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏗᏤᎲ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏬᎩᎷᏨ ᎣᏣᎵᏥᏙᎲᏍᎬ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ;
\ft For we stretch not ourselves beyond our measure, as though we reached not unto you: for we are come as far as to you also in preaching the gospel of Christ:

\ln Notsatlvquisdisgvna atlilov doyiditlv gesvi, nasgi anisoi yvwi dunilvwisdanelvi; udugisgini ogvsvi, nasgi itsohiyusv hnaquo unequotsvhi gesesdi, nihi sginequoediyi sgisdelvdiyi wasdv iyvdv ogatliloelv wogilosvsdodiyi,
\syll ᏃᏣᏢᏈᏍᏗᏍᎬᎾ ᎠᏟᎶᎥ ᏙᏱᏗᏢ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏂᏐᎢ ᏴᏫ ᏚᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸᎢ; ᎤᏚᎩᏍᎩᏂ ᎣᎬᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏦᎯᏳᏒ ᎿᏉ ᎤᏁᏉᏨᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᏂᎯ ᏍᎩᏁᏉᎡᏗᏱ ᏍᎩᏍᏕᎸᏗᏱ ᏩᏍᏛ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎣᎦᏟᎶᎡᎸ ᏬᎩᎶᏒᏍᏙᏗᏱ,
\ft Not boasting of things without our measure, that is, of other men's labours; but having hope, when your faith is increased, that we shall be enlarged by you according to our rule abundantly,

\ln Ogalitsidodiyi osdv kanohedv ditsehv udiditlv, vtlano ogatlvquisdiyi nvdigalisdodisgv nvwadade gilo wasdv iyvdv agatliloelvi, gayula ogadvnvisdanelvhi gesvi.
\syll ᎣᎦᎵᏥᏙᏗᏱ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏗᏤᎲ ᎤᏗᏗᏢ, ᎥᏝᏃ ᎣᎦᏢᏈᏍᏗᏱ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬ ᏅᏩᏓᏕ ᎩᎶ ᏩᏍᏛ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎠᎦᏟᎶᎡᎸᎢ, ᎦᏳᎳ ᎣᎦᏛᏅᎢᏍᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft To preach the gospel in the regions beyond you, and not to boast in another man's line of things made ready to our hand.

\ln Gilosgini atlvquisgesdi Ugvwiyuhi atlvquisdisgesdi.
\syll ᎩᎶᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏢᏈᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᏢᏈᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
\ft But he that glorieth, let him glory in the Lord.

\ln Vtlayeno nasgi na uwasv adalvquodisgi tsagadanilvisdi yigi, nasgisgini na Ugvwiyuhi ulvquotanvhi.
\syll ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎠᏓᎸᏉᏗᏍᎩ ᏣᎦᏓᏂᎸᎢᏍᏗ ᏱᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ Ꮎ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᎸᏉᏔᏅᎯ.
\ft For not he that commendeth himself is approved, but whom the Lord commendeth.

\ln Yohiquo usdigidv unelagi gesgiyelisedi yigi aginegu gesvi; ale udohiyuhi unelagi sgiyelisi.
\syll ᏲᎯᏉ ᎤᏍᏗᎩᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᎩ ᎨᏍᎩᏰᎵᏎᏗ ᏱᎩ ᎠᎩᏁᎫ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᎩ ᏍᎩᏰᎵᏏ.
\ft Would to God ye could bear with me a little in my folly: and indeed bear with me.

\ln Detsvyelugayeno Unelanvhi digvwada nilvisdi advyugedi gesv gvdiha; saquoyeno asgaya ditsatsvsdiyi nitsvyvnelv, nasgi ulisinahisdi adv igagadv Galonedv widitsvyohisediyi.
\syll ᏕᏨᏰᎷᎦᏰᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏗᎬᏩᏓ ᏂᎸᎢᏍᏗ ᎠᏛᏳᎨᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏗᎭ; ᏌᏉᏰᏃ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᏗᏣᏨᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᏨᏴᏁᎸ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎵᏏᏀᎢᏍᏗ ᎠᏛ ᎢᎦᎦᏛ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏫᏗᏨᏲᎯᏎᏗᏱ.
\ft For I am jealous over you with godly jealousy: for I have espoused you to one husband, that I may present you as a chaste virgin to Christ.

\ln Aseno tsinayesga, nasgiya na inadv tsulonuhele Iwi asinasanv tsigvdisgei, nasgiya detsadanvdv yidagolvna ditsiyohisdiyi yinigvga nutlonasdvna gesv Galonedv utseliga.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᏥᎾᏰᏍᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ Ꮎ ᎢᎾᏛ ᏧᎶᏄᎮᎴ ᎢᏫ ᎠᏏᎾᏌᏅ ᏥᎬᏗᏍᎨᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏕᏣᏓᏅᏛ ᏱᏓᎪᎸᎾ ᏗᏥᏲᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏱᏂᎬᎦ ᏄᏠᎾᏍᏛᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ.
\ft But I fear, lest by any means, as the serpent beguiled Eve through his subtilty, so your minds should be corrupted from the simplicity that is in Christ.

\ln Giloyeno itsilutsehi nvwadale Tsisa alitsidohvsgesdi, nasgi na ayv otsalitsidonvhi nigesvna, iyu ale nvwadale adanvdo dotsadanilvtsvha, nasgi na ditsadanilvtsvhi nigesvna, ale nvwadale osdv kanohedv, nasgi na ditsadanilvtsvhi nigesvna, osiyuquo unelagi yitselisv.
\syll ᎩᎶᏰᏃ ᎢᏥᎷᏤᎯ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᏥᏌ ᎠᎵᏥᏙᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᏴ ᎣᏣᎵᏥᏙᏅᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎢᏳ ᎠᎴ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᏙᏣᏓᏂᎸᏨᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏗᏣᏓᏂᎸᏨᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏗᏣᏓᏂᎸᏨᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎣᏏᏳᏉ ᎤᏁᎳᎩ ᏱᏤᎵᏒ.
\ft For if he that cometh preacheth another Jesus, whom we have not preached, or if ye receive another spirit, which ye have not received, or another gospel, which ye have not accepted, ye might well bear with him.

\ln Gadanvtesgvyeno vtla usdi unv esga yigatsiyoasga nunigvwiyusv getsinvsidv gesvi.
\syll ᎦᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬᏰᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎤᏅ ᎡᏍᎦ ᏱᎦᏥᏲᎠᏍᎦ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft For I suppose I was not a whit behind the very chiefest apostles.

\ln Unelagi nvqueyonvna yigi agiwonihisdiyi, aseno vtla nasgi yinusdi tsigatanavi; nigavquosgini nogasdv gvnigesv nogalistanv naniv anigatahv nihi itsehvi.
\syll ᎤᏁᎳᎩ ᏅᏇᏲᏅᎾ ᏱᎩ ᎠᎩᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᏄᏍᏗ ᏥᎦᏔᎾᎥᎢ; ᏂᎦᎥᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᏃᎦᏍᏛ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏃᎦᎵᏍᏔᏅ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎲ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏤᎲᎢ.
\ft But though I be rude in speech, yet not in knowledge; but we have been throughly made manifest among you in all things.

\ln Tsigo tsisganvgi eladi tsinaquadadvnelv, nihi etsisaladodiyi, nasgi niditsvgvwalodanelvna tsigi osdv kanohedv Unelanvhi utseliga itsvyalitsidonelvi?
\syll ᏥᎪ ᏥᏍᎦᏅᎩ ᎡᎳᏗ ᏥᎾᏆᏓᏛᏁᎸ, ᏂᎯ ᎡᏥᏌᎳᏙᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᏗᏨᎬᏩᎶᏓᏁᎸᎾ ᏥᎩ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᎢᏨᏯᎵᏥᏙᏁᎸᎢ?
\ft Have I committed an offence in abasing myself that ye might be exalted, because I have preached to you the gospel of God freely?

\ln Degatsinasanv nvwanadale tsunanelodi dunadatluwadisvi, tsigisgvgi gvquaguyvehvi, nihi gohusdi itsvyadvnediyi.
\syll ᏕᎦᏥᎾᏌᏅ ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᏚᎾᏓᏡᏩᏗᏒᎢ, ᏥᎩᏍᎬᎩ ᎬᏆᎫᏴᎡᎲᎢ, ᏂᎯ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎢᏨᏯᏛᏁᏗᏱ.
\ft I robbed other churches, taking wages of them, to do you service.

\ln Ale nahiyu tsitsvyeladidohvgi ale aquadulvhvvga, vtla gilo yaquaguyisgei; nasgiyeno aginigvsehvi, otsalinvtli Masidoni nvdayunilosvhi gvginehvgi; ale nigavquo aquatlinigvnelv itsvsoquilvdiyi nigesvna, ale asiquo nasgi nigadvnehesdi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏀᎢᏳ ᏥᏨᏰᎳᏗᏙᎲᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏆᏚᎸᎲᎥᎦ, ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᏯᏆᎫᏱᏍᎨᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎠᎩᏂᎬᏎᎲᎢ, ᎣᏣᎵᏅᏟ ᎹᏏᏙᏂ ᏅᏓᏳᏂᎶᏒᎯ ᎬᎩᏁᎲᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᎥᏉ ᎠᏆᏟᏂᎬᏁᎸ ᎢᏨᏐᏈᎸᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏏᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ.
\ft And when I was present with you, and wanted, I was chargeable to no man: for that which was lacking to me the brethren which came from Macedonia supplied: and in all things I have kept myself from being burdensome unto you, and so will I keep myself.

\ln Nasgiya Galonedv utseli gayegogi nigesvna gesv tsagiyaa, vtla vgiyohisdanedi yigesesdi hia nasgi gatlvquisgv Ekaya nigvnadvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎦᏰᎪᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒ ᏣᎩᏯᎠ, ᎥᏝ ᎥᎩᏲᎯᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏢᏈᏍᎬ ᎡᎧᏯ ᏂᎬᎾᏛᎢ.
\ft As the truth of Christ is in me, no man shall stop me of this boasting in the regions of Achaia.

\ln Gadono?  tsigo nitsvgeyusvna gesv iyusdi?  Unelanvhi agataha.
\syll ᎦᏙᏃ?  ᏥᎪ ᏂᏨᎨᏳᏒᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ?  ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎦᏔᎭ.
\ft Wherefore? because I love you not? God knoweth.

\ln Aseno nigadvnehv nasgi nigagadvnehesdi, nasgi gatsiyosdodanediyi unadlanvdadediyi nasgi na tsunaduliha unadlanvdadediyi; nasgi nahna anatlvquisgv nasgi ayv nogasdv nasgiya nunasdv gvnigesv yinigalisda.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᏂᎦᏛᏁᎲ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᎦᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏥᏲᏍᏙᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᎤᎾᏜᏅᏓᏕᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏧᎾᏚᎵᎭ ᎤᎾᏜᏅᏓᏕᏗᏱ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᏀᎾ ᎠᎾᏢᏈᏍᎬ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᏃᎦᏍᏛ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᎾᏍᏛ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏱᏂᎦᎵᏍᏓ.
\ft But what I do, that I will do, that I may cut off occasion from them which desire occasion; that wherein they glory, they may be found even as we.

\ln Hiayeno nasgi na unatlonasgi getsinvsidv, unadalidasdi tsunilvwisdanehi, Galonedv tsutseli getsinvsidv anatselvsgi.
\syll ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᎾᏠᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏛ, ᎤᎾᏓᎵᏓᏍᏗ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ, ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏧᏤᎵ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏛ ᎠᎾᏤᎸᏍᎩ.
\ft For such are false apostles, deceitful workers, transforming themselves into the apostles of Christ.

\ln Vtla ale yusquanigodi; Sedaniyeno uwasv dikahnawadidohi igagadv ehi atselvsgoi.
\syll ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᏳᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ; ᏎᏓᏂᏰᏃ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎢᎦᎦᏛ ᎡᎯ ᎠᏤᎸᏍᎪᎢ.
\ft And no marvel; for Satan himself is transformed into an angel of light.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi vtla utsati usquanigodiyu yigi nasquo nasgi tsunvsidasdi duyugodv gesv getsinvsidasdi yanatselvsga; nasgi ulisqualvdi iyunalisdanedi gesv nasgiya dunilvwisdanelv gesesdi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗᏳ ᏱᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᏯᎾᏤᎸᏍᎦ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᎸᏗ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏚᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft Therefore it is no great thing if his ministers also be transformed as the ministers of righteousness; whose end shall be according to their works.

\ln Taline hia nitsiweha, Tlesdi gilo unegu yaquelisehesdi; iyu adina nasgi nusdesdi, ase aginegu nasgiya disgiyadanilvgi, nasgi ayv usdi aquatlvquisdiyi.
\syll ᏔᎵᏁ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏥᏪᎭ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏁᎫ ᏯᏇᎵᏎᎮᏍᏗ; ᎢᏳ ᎠᏗᎾ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏕᏍᏗ, ᎠᏎ ᎠᎩᏁᎫ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏗᏍᎩᏯᏓᏂᎸᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎠᏆᏢᏈᏍᏗᏱ.
\ft I say again, Let no man think me a fool; if otherwise, yet as a fool receive me, that I may boast myself a little.

\ln Nasgi hia nitsiwesgv tsinegv vtla Ugvwiyuhi iyuwesdi yitsinega, aginegusgini nasgiya tsinega, hia nasgi nitsinayesgvna gesv tsigvdiha tsigatlvquasga.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏥᏪᏍᎬ ᏥᏁᎬ ᎥᏝ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᏳᏪᏍᏗ ᏱᏥᏁᎦ, ᎠᎩᏁᎫᏍᎩᏂ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏥᏁᎦ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᏥᎾᏰᏍᎬᎾ ᎨᏒ ᏥᎬᏗᎭ ᏥᎦᏢᏆᏍᎦ.
\ft That which I speak, I speak it not after the Lord, but as it were foolishly, in this confidence of boasting.

\ln Nasgino tsunitsata tsanatlvquisga uquedali gvdodi gesvi, ayv nasquo dagatlvquasi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏧᏂᏣᏔ ᏣᎾᏢᏈᏍᎦ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎬᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏓᎦᏢᏆᏏ.
\ft Seeing that many glory after the flesh, I will glory also.

\ln Unineguyeno unanelagi dotseliseha osiyu itsiyelvha, nihi itsigatanai gesv iyusdi.
\syll ᎤᏂᏁᎫᏰᏃ ᎤᎾᏁᎳᎩ ᏙᏤᎵᏎᎭ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏥᏰᎸᎭ, ᏂᎯ ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎾᎢ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ.
\ft For ye suffer fools gladly, seeing ye yourselves are wise.

\ln Unelagiyeno itselisgo iyuno gilo yiditsinatlvnv, iyuno gilo asvha yinitsvnelv, iyuno gilo [gohusdi itsihv] yitsigielv, iyuno gilo uwasv yudalisaladanv, iyuno gilo detsakadv yitsvnilv.
\syll ᎤᏁᎳᎩᏰᏃ ᎢᏤᎵᏍᎪ ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᏱᏗᏥᎾᏢᏅ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎠᏒᎭ ᏱᏂᏨᏁᎸ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎢᏥᎲdata is invalid ᏱᏥᎩᎡᎸ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏳᏓᎵᏌᎳᏓᏅ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᏕᏣᎧᏛ ᏱᏨᏂᎸ.
\ft For ye suffer, if a man bring you into bondage, if a man devour you, if a man take of you, if a man exalt himself, if a man smite you on the face.

\ln Udehohisdi gesv ugvwali tsinega, nasgi tsotsiwanagala gogosehvi.  Nahnasgininonv gilo gvwanayehisdi nigesvna gesv (unegu uneisdi tsinega,) ayv nasquo nitsinayesgvna.
\syll ᎤᏕᎰᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᏥᏁᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏦᏥᏩᎾᎦᎳ ᎪᎪᏎᎲᎢ.  ᏀᎾᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎩᎶ ᎬᏩᎾᏰᎯᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎫ ᎤᏁᎢᏍᏗ ᏥᏁᎦ, ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏂᏥᎾᏰᏍᎬᎾ.
\ft I speak as concerning reproach, as though we had been weak. Howbeit whereinsoever any is bold, (I speak foolishly,) I am bold also.

\ln Tsigo Inaquilu nasgi?  ayv nasquo. Tsigo Aniisili?  ayv nasquo.  Equahamisgo tsunetlvtanvdv nasgi?  ayv nasquo.
\syll ᏥᎪ ᎢᎾᏈᎷ ᎾᏍᎩ?  ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᏉ. ᏥᎪ ᎠᏂᎢᏏᎵ?  ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᏉ.  ᎡᏆᎭᎻᏍᎪ ᏧᏁᏢᏔᏅᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ?  ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᏉ.
\ft Are they Hebrews? so am I. Are they Israelites? so am I. Are they the seed of Abraham? so am I.

\ln Tsigo Galonedv tsunvsidasdi nasgi?  (unegu uneisdi tsinega,) ayv utlii; dagilvwisdanehv utli igai; vgilivnilv utlihiyu igai; digasdudiyi vgiyvtanvi utli igai; agiyohusidena gesv yanoquo;
\syll ᏥᎪ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏧᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ?  ᎤᏁᎫ ᎤᏁᎢᏍᏗ ᏥᏁᎦ, ᎠᏴ ᎤᏟᎢ; ᏓᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᎤᏟ ᎢᎦᎢ; ᎥᎩᎵᎥᏂᎸ ᎤᏟᎯᏳ ᎢᎦᎢ; ᏗᎦᏍᏚᏗᏱ ᎥᎩᏴᏔᏅᎢ ᎤᏟ ᎢᎦᎢ; ᎠᎩᏲᎱᏏᏕᎾ ᎨᏒ ᏯᏃᏉ;
\ft Are they ministers of Christ? (I speak as a fool) I am more; in labours more abundant, in stripes above measure, in prisons more frequent, in deaths oft.

\ln Anitsusi hisgi nigvgilivnilvgi iyusdiha saquo galulogi nvgasgohi igvquvnisdiyi;
\syll ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎯᏍᎩ ᏂᎬᎩᎵᎥᏂᎸᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗᎭ ᏌᏉ ᎦᎷᎶᎩ ᏅᎦᏍᎪᎯ ᎢᎬᏋᏂᏍᏗᏱ;
\ft Of the Jews five times received I forty stripes save one.

\ln Tsoi iyuwagudi ganasda degvgilivnistanvgi; saquo nvya nidegvquvnistanvgi; tsoi iyuwagudi tsiyu aquatsodv uyotsvgi; ulitsvdaquadv ale udodaquadv asdvgv naquadvnvgi;
\syll ᏦᎢ ᎢᏳᏩᎫᏗ ᎦᎾᏍᏓ ᏕᎬᎩᎵᎥᏂᏍᏔᏅᎩ; ᏌᏉ ᏅᏯ ᏂᏕᎬᏋᏂᏍᏔᏅᎩ; ᏦᎢ ᎢᏳᏩᎫᏗ ᏥᏳ ᎠᏆᏦᏛ ᎤᏲᏨᎩ; ᎤᎵᏨᏓᏆᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏙᏓᏆᏛ ᎠᏍᏛᎬ ᎾᏆᏛᏅᎩ;
\ft Thrice was I beaten with rods, once was I stoned, thrice I suffered shipwreck, a night and a day I have been in the deep;

\ln Gedohv yanoquo; equoni degeyv unayehisdiyu gesvi; dinadanasahvsgi uninayehisdiyu gesvi; diquatseli yvwi uninayehisdiyu gesvi; tsunadalenvdv yvwi uninayehisdiyu gesvi; gaduhv unayehisdiyu gesvi; inage gesv unayehisdiyu gesvi; amequohi unayehisdiyu gesvi; unatlonasdi otsalinvtli uninayehisdiyu gesvi;
\syll ᎨᏙᎲ ᏯᏃᏉ; ᎡᏉᏂ ᏕᎨᏴ ᎤᎾᏰᎯᏍᏗᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᏗᎾᏓᎾᏌᎲᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᎾᏰᎯᏍᏗᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᏗᏆᏤᎵ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏂᎾᏰᎯᏍᏗᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏂᎾᏰᎯᏍᏗᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎦᏚᎲ ᎤᎾᏰᎯᏍᏗᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎢᎾᎨ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎾᏰᎯᏍᏗᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎠᎺᏉᎯ ᎤᎾᏰᎯᏍᏗᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎤᎾᏠᎾᏍᏗ ᎣᏣᎵᏅᏟ ᎤᏂᎾᏰᎯᏍᏗᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ;
\ft In journeyings often, in perils of waters, in perils of robbers, in perils by mine own countrymen, in perils by the heathen, in perils in the city, in perils in the wilderness, in perils in the sea, in perils among false brethren;

\ln Dagiyawetsidolv ale ehisdi naqualisdanelvi; yanogiyu nitsilvsgvna gesvi; agonu agiyosisgvi ale agitadegisgvi; yanogiyu amatli gvsgvi; uyvtlv ale agiyelvha gesvi.
\syll ᏓᎩᏯᏪᏥᏙᎸ ᎠᎴ ᎡᎯᏍᏗ ᎾᏆᎵᏍᏓᏁᎸᎢ; ᏯᏃᎩᏳ ᏂᏥᎸᏍᎬᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎠᎪᏄ ᎠᎩᏲᏏᏍᎬᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎩᏔᏕᎩᏍᎬᎢ; ᏯᏃᎩᏳ ᎠᎹᏟ ᎬᏍᎬᎢ; ᎤᏴᏢ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎩᏰᎸᎭ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft In weariness and painfulness, in watchings often, in hunger and thirst, in fastings often, in cold and nakedness.

\ln Nidatloyasdvna tsudalenvdv, nasgi nidugitsvnisv tsagilutseha, nasgi na diquagasayasdodiyi nigadv tsunanelodi dunadatluwadisvi.
\syll ᏂᏓᏠᏯᏍᏛᎾ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᏚᎩᏨᏂᏒ ᏣᎩᎷᏤᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏗᏆᎦᏌᏯᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᏚᎾᏓᏡᏩᏗᏒᎢ.
\ft Beside those things that are without, that which cometh upon me daily, the care of all the churches.

\ln Gago awanagaloi, ayvno nitsiwanigalvna gesoi?  gago duwodehihoi, ayvno nitsileyvsgvna gesoi?
\syll ᎦᎪ ᎠᏩᎾᎦᎶᎢ, ᎠᏴᏃ ᏂᏥᏩᏂᎦᎸᎾ ᎨᏐᎢ?  ᎦᎪ ᏚᏬᏕᎯᎰᎢ, ᎠᏴᏃ ᏂᏥᎴᏴᏍᎬᎾ ᎨᏐᎢ?
\ft Who is weak, and I am not weak? who is offended, and I burn not?

\ln Iyuno ase aquatlvquisdi gesesdi, tsiwanagaliyu gesv ugvwali dagatlvquasi.
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᎠᏎ ᎠᏆᏢᏈᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᏥᏩᎾᎦᎵᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᏓᎦᏢᏆᏏ.
\ft If I must needs glory, I will glory of the things which concern mine infirmities.

\ln Ugvwiyuhi igatseli Tsisa Galonedv utseli Unelanvhi ale udoda, nasgi nigohilv galvquododi tsigi, agataha  nigatsigovsgvna gesvi.
\syll ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏙᏓ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎦᎸᏉᏙᏗ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᎦᏔᎭ  ᏂᎦᏥᎪᎥᏍᎬᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft The God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, which is blessed for evermore, knoweth that I lie not.

\ln Demasga wigedohv nugvwiyusedegi Elida ugvwiyuhi uwekanvhi, ayawisgvgi Anidemasga uniduhvi nasgi udulisgv aginiyvdiyi;
\syll ᏕᎹᏍᎦ ᏫᎨᏙᎲ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏎᏕᎩ ᎡᎵᏓ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏪᎧᏅᎯ, ᎠᏯᏫᏍᎬᎩ ᎠᏂᏕᎹᏍᎦ ᎤᏂᏚᎲᎢ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎬ ᎠᎩᏂᏴᏗᏱ;
\ft In Damascus the governor under Aretas the king kept the city of the Damascenes with a garrison, desirous to apprehend me:

\ln Atsolanvno dagvginugowisvgi talutsagihi gvquatsodi gvquatlovtanvgi asoyulodi, ale tsiyadiwiselvgi.
\syll ᎠᏦᎳᏅᏃ ᏓᎬᎩᏄᎪᏫᏒᎩ ᏔᎷᏣᎩᎯ ᎬᏆᏦᏗ ᎬᏆᏠᎥᏔᏅᎩ ᎠᏐᏳᎶᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᏯᏗᏫᏎᎸᎩ.
\ft And through a window in a basket was I let down by the wall, and escaped his hands.

\ln Vtla gvwadasdelvdi yigi udohiyuhi aquatlvquisdiyi; nasgi iyusdi datsineistani [gilo] unelawiselv ale Ugvwiyuhi gvnigesv nuwanelvi.
\syll ᎥᏝ ᎬᏩᏓᏍᏕᎸᏗ ᏱᎩ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎠᏆᏢᏈᏍᏗᏱ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏓᏥᏁᎢᏍᏔᏂ ᎩᎶdata is invalid ᎤᏁᎳᏫᏎᎸ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏄᏩᏁᎸᎢ.
\ft It is not expedient for me doubtless to glory. I will come to visions and revelations of the Lord.

\ln Tsigatahvgi asgaya Galonedv gohiyuhvsgi, hnaquo nigadu nadetiyv, (ayav ayelv vtla yitsigataha, ale ayelv nayavna gesv vtla yitsigataha; Unelanvhi agataha;) nasgi hia agatinawidvhvgi tsoine galvlo digesv wagatinolvgi.
\syll ᏥᎦᏔᎲᎩ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎪᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ, ᎿᏉ ᏂᎦᏚ ᎾᏕᏘᏴ, ᎠᏯᎥ ᎠᏰᎸ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏥᎦᏔᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏰᎸ ᎾᏯᎥᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏥᎦᏔᎭ; ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎦᏔᎭ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎠᎦᏘᎾᏫᏛᎲᎩ ᏦᎢᏁ ᎦᎸᎶ ᏗᎨᏒ ᏩᎦᏘᏃᎸᎩ.
\ft I knew a man in Christ above fourteen years ago, (whether in the body, I cannot tell; or whether out of the body, I cannot tell: God knoweth;) such an one caught up to the third heaven.

\ln Ale tsigatahi gesvgi nasgi, (ayelv ayav, ale ayelv nayavna gesv vtla yitsigataha; Unelanvhi agataha;)
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏥᎦᏔᎯ ᎨᏒᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ, ᎠᏰᎸ ᎠᏯᎥ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏰᎸ ᎾᏯᎥᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏥᎦᏔᎭ; ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎦᏔᎭ;
\ft And I knew such a man, (whether in the body, or out of the body, I cannot tell: God knoweth;)

\ln Nasgi na agatinawidvhvgi nvwadohiyadv digesv wagatinolvgi, ale udvganvgi aniwonisgv igawesdi nigesvna, niduyugodvna gesv yvwi nasgi iyuwesdiyi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᎦᏘᎾᏫᏛᎲᎩ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᏗᎨᏒ ᏩᎦᏘᏃᎸᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏛᎦᏅᎩ ᎠᏂᏬᏂᏍᎬ ᎢᎦᏪᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᏂᏚᏳᎪᏛᎾ ᎨᏒ ᏴᏫ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏪᏍᏗᏱ.
\ft How that he was caught up into paradise, and heard unspeakable words, which it is not lawful for a man to utter.

\ln Nasgi na tsineisdisgv yigatlvqui; aquvsvsgini gadaneisdisgv vtla yvgagatlvqui, tsiwanagaliyu gesv uwasv.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏥᏁᎢᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᏱᎦᏢᏈ; ᎠᏋᏒᏍᎩᏂ ᎦᏓᏁᎢᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᎥᏝ ᏴᎦᎦᏢᏈ, ᏥᏩᎾᎦᎵᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏩᏒ.
\ft Of such an one will I glory: yet of myself I will not glory, but in mine infirmities.

\ln Iyuyeno yaquaduli aquatlvquisdiyi, vtla aginegu yigagesesdi; udohiyuhiyeno gesv yitsinohvli; aseno unelagi vgela, nvdigalisdodiha gilo aquadanvtesgv utli yiniagilvquodi ano naquasdv agigowatisgvi, ale nusdv aquadvgisgvi.
\syll ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᏯᏆᏚᎵ ᎠᏆᏢᏈᏍᏗᏱ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎩᏁᎫ ᏱᎦᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏰᏃ ᎨᏒ ᏱᏥᏃᎲᎵ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᎩ ᎥᎨᎳ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎩᎶ ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ ᎤᏟ ᏱᏂᎠᎩᎸᏉᏗ ᎠᏃ ᎾᏆᏍᏛ ᎠᎩᎪᏩᏘᏍᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎠᏆᏛᎩᏍᎬᎢ.
\ft For though I would desire to glory, I shall not be a fool; for I will say the truth: but now I forbear, lest any man should think of me above that which he seeth me to be, or that he heareth of me.

\ln Nasgino ulosvstanvhi aqualisaladodiyi nigesvna iyulisdodiyi nvdigalisdodisgv utsati vginanugowiselvgi, agitsayohihi vginelvgi agiquedalvi, Sedani unvsidv aquvnihi, nasgi ulosvstanvhi aqualisaladodiyi nigesvna iyulisdodiyi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᎶᏒᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎠᏆᎵᏌᎳᏙᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎥᎩᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᎸᎩ, ᎠᎩᏣᏲᎯᎯ ᎥᎩᏁᎸᎩ ᎠᎩᏇᏓᎸᎢ, ᏎᏓᏂ ᎤᏅᏏᏛ ᎠᏋᏂᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎶᏒᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎠᏆᎵᏌᎳᏙᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
\ft And lest I should be exalted above measure through the abundance of the revelations, there was given to me a thorn in the flesh, the messenger of Satan to buffet me, lest I should be exalted above measure.

\ln Nasgi hia ugvwali tsoi nitsitayoselvgi Ugvwiyuhi nasgi aquadanvediyi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᏦᎢ ᏂᏥᏔᏲᏎᎸᎩ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏆᏓᏅᎡᏗᏱ.
\ft For this thing I besought the Lord thrice, that it might depart from me.

\ln Hiano nagiweselvgi, Gvwagatiya aquadadolisdi gesv yeliquo getsalisdelvdodi; aqualinigvgvyeno ukalitsvhi igvnelvhi nahna wanagala gesvi.  Nasgi iyusdi utsati aqualihelitsvhi utli agiyelvha aquatlvquisdiyi tsiwanagaliyu gesvi, nasgi ulinigidiyu gesv Galonedv aquutlvdodiyi.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᎾᎩᏪᏎᎸᎩ, ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎠᏆᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏰᎵᏉ ᎨᏣᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ; ᎠᏆᎵᏂᎬᎬᏰᏃ ᎤᎧᎵᏨᎯ ᎢᎬᏁᎸᎯ ᏀᎾ ᏩᎾᎦᎳ ᎨᏒᎢ.  ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎠᏆᎵᎮᎵᏨᎯ ᎤᏟ ᎠᎩᏰᎸᎭ ᎠᏆᏢᏈᏍᏗᏱ ᏥᏩᎾᎦᎵᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎠᏊᏢᏙᏗᏱ.
\ft And he said unto me, My grace is sufficient for thee: for my strength is made perfect in weakness. Most gladly therefore will I rather glory in my infirmities, that the power of Christ may rest upon me.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi galieliga tsiwanagaliyu gesvi, gayvgisotlvdvi, aginigidv gesvi, uyo nvquvhnadegvi, ehisdi aquadanvtawadegv Galonedv nvdigalisdodisgvi; tsiwanigaliyuyeno tsigeso, nahiyu aqualinigidiyu gesoi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎦᎵᎡᎵᎦ ᏥᏩᎾᎦᎵᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎦᏴᎩᏐᏢᏛᎢ, ᎠᎩᏂᎩᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᏲ ᏅᏋᎿᏕᎬᎢ, ᎡᎯᏍᏗ ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏔᏩᏕᎬ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬᎢ; ᏥᏩᏂᎦᎵᏳᏰᏃ ᏥᎨᏐ, ᏀᎢᏳ ᎠᏆᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ ᎨᏐᎢ.
\ft Therefore I take pleasure in infirmities, in reproaches, in necessities, in persecutions, in distresses for Christ's sake: for when I am weak, then am I strong.

\ln Aginegu naqualistanv gatlvquasgvi; nihi nisgiyvnisasi; nihiyeno sgilvquododi gesvgi; vtlayeno sudalegi unv esga yigatsiyoasga nunigvwiyusv getsinvsidv, nasquo ayv gohusdi nigesvna yigi.
\syll ᎠᎩᏁᎫ ᎾᏆᎵᏍᏔᏅ ᎦᏢᏆᏍᎬᎢ; ᏂᎯ ᏂᏍᎩᏴᏂᏌᏏ; ᏂᎯᏰᏃ ᏍᎩᎸᏉᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎩ; ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᏑᏓᎴᎩ ᎤᏅ ᎡᏍᎦ ᏱᎦᏥᏲᎠᏍᎦ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏛ, ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏴ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏱᎩ.
\ft I am become a fool in glorying; ye have compelled me: for I ought to have been commended of you: for in nothing am I behind the very chiefest apostles, though I be nothing.

\ln Udohiyuhiya adolehohisdodi vginvsidv gesv digalvwisdanelvhi nigalisdiha itsehvi, gvtanvhi utsati gvnidiyu gesvi, uyelvdvi, usquanigodi degalvwisdanelvi, ale ulinigidv degalvwisdanelvi.
\syll ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏙᏗ ᎥᎩᏅᏏᏛ ᎨᏒ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᎭ ᎢᏤᎲᎢ, ᎬᏔᏅᎯ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎬᏂᏗᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᏰᎸᏛᎢ, ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᏕᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᏕᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸᎢ.
\ft Truly the signs of an apostle were wrought among you in all patience, in signs, and wonders, and mighty deeds.

\ln Gadono usdi nasgi nahna esga detsohasga disoi tsunanelodi dunadatluwadisvi, hia uwasv, nasgi ayv aquvsv gagedv nitsvyvnelvna gesvi?  gesgivsiquo adina hia nasgi utsatini nitsvyadvnelvi.
\syll ᎦᏙᏃ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏀᎾ ᎡᏍᎦ ᏕᏦᎭᏍᎦ ᏗᏐᎢ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᏚᎾᏓᏡᏩᏗᏒᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᎤᏩᏒ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᎠᏋᏒ ᎦᎨᏛ ᏂᏨᏴᏁᎸᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ?  ᎨᏍᎩᎥᏏᏉ ᎠᏗᎾ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏣᏘᏂ ᏂᏨᏯᏛᏁᎸᎢ.
\ft For what is it wherein ye were inferior to other churches, except it be that I myself was not burdensome to you? forgive me this wrong.

\ln Gvniyuquo, tsoine aquadvnvisdi witsvlutsediyi; vtla ale gagedv yinvgetsvyvga; vtlayeno gohusdi itsihv yigiyoha, nihisgini itsvyoha; diniyoliyeno vtla tsunigayvlige tsunadanelanedi yigi, anigayvligesgini tsunetsi tsunadanelanedi gesoi.
\syll ᎬᏂᏳᏉ, ᏦᎢᏁ ᎠᏆᏛᏅᎢᏍᏗ ᏫᏨᎷᏤᏗᏱ; ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎦᎨᏛ ᏱᏅᎨᏨᏴᎦ; ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎢᏥᎲ ᏱᎩᏲᎭ, ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᏨᏲᎭ; ᏗᏂᏲᎵᏰᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏧᏂᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᏧᎾᏓᏁᎳᏁᏗ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᏂᎦᏴᎵᎨᏍᎩᏂ ᏧᏁᏥ ᏧᎾᏓᏁᎳᏁᏗ ᎨᏐᎢ.
\ft Behold, the third time I am ready to come to you; and I will not be burdensome to you: for I seek not yours, but you: for the children ought not to lay up for the parents, but the parents for the children.

\ln Ale utsati osiyu agiyelvsesdi aquaguyvhidasdiyi ale aquvsv aquadisvhvsdiyi ditsadanvdo detsisdelisgvi, nasquo kanequogv itsvgeyusvi ugayolohisdiyi yinigvneha sgigeyusvi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎠᎩᏰᎸᏎᏍᏗ ᎠᏆᎫᏴᎯᏓᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏋᏒ ᎠᏆᏗᏒᎲᏍᏗᏱ ᏗᏣᏓᏅᏙ ᏕᏥᏍᏕᎵᏍᎬᎢ, ᎾᏍᏉ ᎧᏁᏉᎬ ᎢᏨᎨᏳᏒᎢ ᎤᎦᏲᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏱᏂᎬᏁᎭ ᏍᎩᎨᏳᏒᎢ.
\ft And I will very gladly spend and be spent for you; though the more abundantly I love you, the less I be loved.

\ln Adina unelagi nasgi nusdesdi, nasgi gagedv nitsvyvnelvna gesvi; aseno tsisinasaniyu gesv, galonuhedv aquvtanvgi detsvniyvhvgi.
\syll ᎠᏗᎾ ᎤᏁᎳᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏕᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎨᏛ ᏂᏨᏴᏁᎸᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᏥᏏᎾᏌᏂᏳ ᎨᏒ, ᎦᎶᏄᎮᏛ ᎠᏋᏔᏅᎩ ᏕᏨᏂᏴᎲᎩ.
\ft But be it so, I did not burden you: nevertheless, being crafty, I caught you with guile.

\ln Tsigo itsvlonuesge gatsiyvdisge gilo gatsinvsidv wigetsilutselvhi?
\syll ᏥᎪ ᎢᏨᎶᏄᎡᏍᎨ ᎦᏥᏴᏗᏍᎨ ᎩᎶ ᎦᏥᏅᏏᏛ ᏫᎨᏥᎷᏤᎸᎯ?
\ft Did I make a gain of you by any of them whom I sent unto you?

\ln Dadasi tsitayoselvgi, ale anegi vtsinvsvgi idalinvtli.  Tsigo Dadasi itsilonuhelei?  tlasgo utloyiquo adanvdo yosdvdisge osdedohvi?  tlasgo saquo yigese dosdalasinidohvi?
\syll ᏓᏓᏏ ᏥᏔᏲᏎᎸᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏁᎩ ᎥᏥᏅᏒᎩ ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ.  ᏥᎪ ᏓᏓᏏ ᎢᏥᎶᏄᎮᎴᎢ?  ᏝᏍᎪ ᎤᏠᏱᏉ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᏲᏍᏛᏗᏍᎨ ᎣᏍᏕᏙᎲᎢ?  ᏝᏍᎪ ᏌᏉ ᏱᎨᏎ ᏙᏍᏓᎳᏏᏂᏙᎲᎢ?
\ft I desired Titus, and with him I sent a brother. Did Titus make a gain of you? walked we not in the same spirit? walked we not in the same steps?

\ln Alewo, tsigo otsalisdeli itseliha itsigatahvi?  Unelanvhi agatahv otsinega Galonedv tsuweyonvhi nasgiyai; aseno itsvgeyui, nigav nihi itsalinigohisdodi ugvwali [otsinega.]
\syll ᎠᎴᏬ, ᏥᎪ ᎣᏣᎵᏍᏕᎵ ᎢᏤᎵᎭ ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎲᎢ?  ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎦᏔᎲ ᎣᏥᏁᎦ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏧᏪᏲᏅᎯ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎢᏨᎨᏳᎢ, ᏂᎦᎥ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏣᎵᏂᎪᎯᏍᏙᏗ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᎣᏥᏁᎦ.data is invalid
\ft Again, think ye that we excuse ourselves unto you? we speak before God in Christ: but we do all things, dearly beloved, for your edifying.

\ln Tsinayesgayeno nasgi witsilutsvha nasgi nitsasdvnaquo gesv nusdv aquadulisgv itsvwadvdiyi, ale aquvsv gesv sgigowadvdiyi nasgiya nitsadulisgvna gesvi; ale agiwadvdiyi ditiyosdi gesvi, advyugedi gesvi, atalawohisdi gesvi, adisvsdi gesvi, uyo didanohelidasdi gesvi, adonvdi gesvi, utli atselvdi gesvi, tsudalenvdv igvnedi gesvi;
\syll ᏥᎾᏰᏍᎦᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏫᏥᎷᏨᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᏣᏍᏛᎾᏉ ᎨᏒ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎠᏆᏚᎵᏍᎬ ᎢᏨᏩᏛᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏋᏒ ᎨᏒ ᏍᎩᎪᏩᏛᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏂᏣᏚᎵᏍᎬᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎠᎩᏩᏛᏗᏱ ᏗᏘᏲᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᏛᏳᎨᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᏔᎳᏬᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᏗᏒᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᏲ ᏗᏓᏃᎮᎵᏓᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᏙᏅᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᏟ ᎠᏤᎸᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎢᎬᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ;
\ft For I fear, lest, when I come, I shall not find you such as I would, and that I shall be found unto you such as ye would not: lest there be debates, envyings, wraths, strifes, backbitings, whisperings, swellings, tumults:

\ln Ale [tsinayesga,] taline witsilutsvha, Aquanelanvhi aquadehohisdodiyi itsigatahvi, ale gatsisgonisdiyi unitsati gayula unisganvtsvhi tsigi, ale uyo nuniyelvnvna tsigi gadaha nunadvnelvi, ale udelidv dunanisinvi, ale unalisotlvistanvi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏥᎾᏰᏍᎦ,data is invalid ᏔᎵᏁ ᏫᏥᎷᏨᎭ, ᎠᏆᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᏆᏕᎰᎯᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎲᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᏥᏍᎪᏂᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎦᏳᎳ ᎤᏂᏍᎦᏅᏨᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏲ ᏄᏂᏰᎸᏅᎾ ᏥᎩ ᎦᏓᎭ ᏄᎾᏛᏁᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᏚᎾᏂᏏᏅᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᎵᏐᏢᎢᏍᏔᏅᎢ.
\ft And lest, when I come again, my God will humble me among you, and that I shall bewail many which have sinned already, and have not repented of the uncleanness and fornication and lasciviousness which they have committed.

\ln Gohi nasgi tsoine hnaquo tsiwvdatsvlutseli.  Anitali ale tsoi anigatahi digvdodi gesesdi asdayidisdi nigav kanohedi gesvi.
\syll ᎪᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏦᎢᏁ ᎿᏉ ᏥᏮᏓᏨᎷᏤᎵ.  ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᎠᎴ ᏦᎢ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎯ ᏗᎬᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎠᏍᏓᏱᏗᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎧᏃᎮᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft This is the third time I am coming to you. In the mouth of two or three witnesses shall every word be established.

\ln Gayula hia nagiwesv, ale igvyi gayehi hia nitsiweha, taline tsiwitsigataho nasgiyai, ale agigonelv gohi gesv gatsiyowelaneha nasgi na gayula unisganvtsvhi tsigi, ale nigadvquo anisoi, nasgi iyu taline yiwiagilutsv, vtla yvgagalisinvda;
\syll ᎦᏳᎳ ᎯᎠ ᎾᎩᏪᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᎬᏱ ᎦᏰᎯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏥᏪᎭ, ᏔᎵᏁ ᏥᏫᏥᎦᏔᎰ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎩᎪᏁᎸ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎦᏥᏲᏪᎳᏁᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎦᏳᎳ ᎤᏂᏍᎦᏅᏨᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛᏉ ᎠᏂᏐᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳ ᏔᎵᏁ ᏱᏫᎠᎩᎷᏨ, ᎥᏝ ᏴᎦᎦᎵᏏᏅᏓ;
\ft I told you before, and foretell you, as if I were present, the second time; and being absent now I write to them which heretofore have sinned, and to all other, that, if I come again, I will not spare:

\ln Nigalisdodiha tsitsiyoha gohiyudisgi Galonedv ayv aquvdisgv kanegvi, nasgi itsigatahv vtla awanagala yigi, ulinigidiyusgini igvnelvhi itsehvi,
\syll ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᏥᏥᏲᎭ ᎪᎯᏳᏗᏍᎩ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎠᏴ ᎠᏋᏗᏍᎬ ᎧᏁᎬᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎲ ᎥᏝ ᎠᏩᎾᎦᎳ ᏱᎩ, ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᎬᏁᎸᎯ ᎢᏤᎲᎢ,
\ft Since ye seek a proof of Christ speaking in me, which to you-ward is not weak, but is mighty in you.

\ln Udohiyuhisgininonv awanagalahiyu gesv dadanawasdv agadvnvgi, aseno gvnodv iyagvnelvhi gvtanvhi ulinigidiyu gesv Unelanvhi.  Ayv nasquo nasgi otsiyav tsotsiwanagalahiyu, aseno itsulaha dotsvnesdi nasgi, Unelanvhi ulinigidiyu gesv itsvyvdanehv nihi.
\syll ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎠᏩᎾᎦᎳᎯᏳ ᎨᏒ ᏓᏓᎾᏩᏍᏛ ᎠᎦᏛᏅᎩ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎬᏃᏛ ᎢᏯᎬᏁᎸᎯ ᎬᏔᏅᎯ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ.  ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏥᏯᎥ ᏦᏥᏩᎾᎦᎳᎯᏳ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᏙᏨᏁᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏨᏴᏓᏁᎲ ᏂᎯ.
\ft For though he was crucified through weakness, yet he liveth by the power of God. For we also are weak in him, but we shall live with him by the power of God toward you.

\ln Itsadagoliya itsvsv, nasgi itsohiyuhi yigi, ale itsohiyuhi nigesvna yigi; itsadolehohi nitsasdvi.  Tlasgo itsvsv yitsadagataha nasgi Tsisa Galonedv itsiyavi, iyusgininonv etsisonvistanvhi yigi.
\syll ᎢᏣᏓᎪᎵᏯ ᎢᏨᏒ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏦᎯᏳᎯ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏦᎯᏳᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏱᎩ; ᎢᏣᏙᎴᎰᎯ ᏂᏣᏍᏛᎢ.  ᏝᏍᎪ ᎢᏨᏒ ᏱᏣᏓᎦᏔᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎢᏥᏯᎥᎢ, ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎡᏥᏐᏅᎢᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᏱᎩ.
\ft Examine yourselves, whether ye be in the faith; prove your own selves. Know ye not your own selves, how that Jesus Christ is in you, except ye be reprobates?

\ln Aseno udugi gvsga nasgi itsigadovhisdiyi nasgi ayv ogisonvistanvhi nigesvna gesvi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎬᏍᎦ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏥᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᎣᎩᏐᏅᎢᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft But I trust that ye shall know that we are not reprobates.

\ln Unelanvhisgini tsitayoseha nasgi nihi gohusdi usonv ditsilvwisdanediyi nigesvna; vtla ayv osiyu ogiyelvsv gvnigesv iyulisdodiyi aquadulisgv yinvdigalisdodiha, nihisgini nasgi na duyugodv gesv itsadvnediyi, unelagi ogisonvistanvhi yinvwasdi.
\syll ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᏥᏔᏲᏎᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎯ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏐᏅ ᏗᏥᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ; ᎥᏝ ᎠᏴ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎣᎩᏰᎸᏒ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎠᏆᏚᎵᏍᎬ ᏱᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ, ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏣᏛᏁᏗᏱ, ᎤᏁᎳᎩ ᎣᎩᏐᏅᎢᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᏱᏅᏩᏍᏗ.
\ft Now I pray to God that ye do no evil; not that we should appear approved, but that ye should do that which is honest, though we be as reprobates.

\ln Vtlayeno yeli yvgayotsatluda udohiyuhi gesvi, yotsisdelvsgini udohiyuhi gesvi.
\syll ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᏰᎵ ᏴᎦᏲᏣᏡᏓ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏲᏥᏍᏕᎸᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft For we can do nothing against the truth, but for the truth.

\ln Osiyuyeno ogiyelvha tsotsiwanagala tsigesoi, nihino tsidetsalinigvgoi; hiano nasquo ogaduliha, nasgi nitsigolvna itsalisdodiyi.
\syll ᎣᏏᏳᏰᏃ ᎣᎩᏰᎸᎭ ᏦᏥᏩᎾᎦᎳ ᏥᎨᏐᎢ, ᏂᎯᏃ ᏥᏕᏣᎵᏂᎬᎪᎢ; ᎯᎠᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎣᎦᏚᎵᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᏥᎪᎸᎾ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
\ft For we are glad, when we are weak, and ye are strong: and this also we wish, even your perfection.

\ln Nasgi nvdigalisdodiha hia nasgi tsinusdi tsitsvyowelaneha agigonelvi, nasgi nahiyu tsigatahesdi gvsgaisdagi aquvtanidasdiyi nigesvna, nasgiya igvquadvnedi aqualisgolvdanelv Ugvwiyuhi, nasgi tsunalinigohisdi gesvi, vtlano unidvdodi gesvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏄᏍᏗ ᏥᏨᏲᏪᎳᏁᎭ ᎠᎩᎪᏁᎸᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏀᎢᏳ ᏥᎦᏔᎮᏍᏗ ᎬᏍᎦᎢᏍᏓᎩ ᎠᏋᏔᏂᏓᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎢᎬᏆᏛᏁᏗ ᎠᏆᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᎸ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᎾᎵᏂᎪᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎥᏝᏃ ᎤᏂᏛᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Therefore I write these things being absent, lest being present I should use sharpness, according to the power which the Lord hath given me to edification, and not to destruction.

\ln Ulisqualvdino, idalinvtli, nvwadohiyadvquo nitsadvhnadegesdi.  Gohusdi nitsigolvna gesesdi, ugalisdiquo detsadanvtesdi, utloyiquo gesesdi detsadanvdvi, nvwadohiyadvquo itsehesdi; Unelanvhino adageyudi gesv ale nvwadohiyadv adanehi tsigi, itseladidohesdi.
\syll ᎤᎵᏍᏆᎸᏗᏃ, ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛᏉ ᏂᏣᏛᎿᏕᎨᏍᏗ.  ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏂᏥᎪᎸᎾ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎤᎦᎵᏍᏗᏉ ᏕᏣᏓᏅᏖᏍᏗ, ᎤᏠᏱᏉ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏕᏣᏓᏅᏛᎢ, ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛᏉ ᎢᏤᎮᏍᏗ; ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏃ ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᎠᏓᏁᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎢᏤᎳᏗᏙᎮᏍᏗ.
\ft Finally, brethren, farewell. Be perfect, be of good comfort, be of one mind, live in peace; and the God of love and peace shall be with you.

\ln Detsadayolihesdi itsvdisgesdi galvquodiyu didatawedovsdi gesvi.
\syll ᏕᏣᏓᏲᎵᎮᏍᏗ ᎢᏨᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᏗᏓᏔᏪᏙᎥᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Greet one another with an holy kiss.

\ln Nigadv unadanvti wigetsiyoliha.
\syll ᏂᎦᏛ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ ᏫᎨᏥᏲᎵᎭ.
\ft All the saints salute you.

\ln Gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv, ale udageyudi gesv Unelanvhi, ale udadudadodi gesv Galvquodiyu Adanvdo detsikahnawadidohesdi nitsivi.  Emenv.
\syll ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᏚᏓᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᏕᏥᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎮᏍᏗ ᏂᏥᎥᎢ.  ᎡᎺᏅ.
\ft The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, and the love of God, and the communion of the Holy Ghost, be with you all. Amen.

\ln Quola, vginvsidv, yvwi gvginvsidv nigesvna, ale yvwi gvginetselvhi nigesvna, Tsisasgini Galonedv, ale Unelanvhi Agayvlige nasgi tsuletanvhi tsigi uyohusvi nasgi gvginetselvhi;
\syll ᏉᎳ, ᎥᎩᏅᏏᏛ, ᏴᏫ ᎬᎩᏅᏏᏛ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᏴᏫ ᎬᎩᏁᏤᎸᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᏥᏌᏍᎩᏂ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᎴᏔᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎤᏲᎱᏒᎢ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᎩᏁᏤᎸᎯ;
\ft Paul, an apostle, (not of men, neither by man, but by Jesus Christ, and God the Father, who raised him from the dead;)

\ln Ale nigadv idalinvtli tsotsedoha, witsvyowelasi ditsanelodi detsadatluwadisv Gelesiyi;
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ ᏦᏤᏙᎭ, ᏫᏨᏲᏪᎳᏏ ᏗᏣᏁᎶᏗ ᏕᏣᏓᏡᏩᏗᏒ ᎨᎴᏏᏱ;
\ft And all the brethren which are with me, unto the churches of Galatia:

\ln Gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv ale nvwadohiyadv getseladidohesdi, getsalisgolvdanelvhi Unelanvhi Agayvligei, ale igatseli Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv,
\syll ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᎨᏤᎳᏗᏙᎮᏍᏗ, ᎨᏣᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ,
\ft Grace be to you and peace from God the Father, and from our Lord Jesus Christ,

\ln Nasgi tsidudayose ayv igisganvtsv tsisdi galisdodisgei, nasgi igudalesdiyi gohi gesv ehv uyoi, nasgiya nusdv adanvtesgv Unelanvhi ale Igidoda;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏚᏓᏲᏎ ᎠᏴ ᎢᎩᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᏥᏍᏗ ᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎫᏓᎴᏍᏗᏱ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎡᎲ ᎤᏲᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎠᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎢᎩᏙᏓ;
\ft Who gave himself for our sins, that he might deliver us from this present evil world, according to the will of God and our Father:

\ln Nasgi galvquododi gesesdi nigohilv ale nigohilvi.  Emenv.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎸᏉᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎪᎯᎸᎢ.  ᎡᎺᏅ.
\ft To whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.

\ln Agisquanigosga tsinatlegv etsadanvelv nasgi na itsiyanvdv witsikanvhi gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv Galonedv, nvwadale osdv kanohedv tsitsigvwiyutanv.
\syll ᎠᎩᏍᏆᏂᎪᏍᎦ ᏥᎾᏞᎬ ᎡᏣᏓᏅᎡᎸ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎢᏥᏯᏅᏛ ᏫᏥᎧᏅᎯ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ, ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏥᏥᎬᏫᏳᏔᏅ.
\ft I marvel that ye are so soon removed from him that called you into the grace of Christ unto another gospel:

\ln Nasgi nvwadale nigesvna tsigi; anehasgininonv getsadeyadodisgi, ale uninetliyvsdiyi unadulisgi osdv kanohedv Galonedv utseliga.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏥᎩ; ᎠᏁᎭᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎨᏣᏕᏯᏙᏗᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏁᏟᏴᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᎾᏚᎵᏍᎩ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ.
\ft Which is not another; but there be some that trouble you, and would pervert the gospel of Christ.

\ln Iyusgini nasquo ayv, ale dikahnawadidohi galvladi nvdayulosvhi, nvwadale osdv kanohedv yitsvyalitsidonelv, nasgi gayula itsvyalitsidonelvhi nigesvna, nasgi atsisgatsvhi gesesdi.
\syll ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏴ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏅᏓᏳᎶᏒᎯ, ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏱᏨᏯᎵᏥᏙᏁᎸ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏳᎳ ᎢᏨᏯᎵᏥᏙᏁᎸᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏥᏍᎦᏨᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft But though we, or an angel from heaven, preach any other gospel unto you than that which we have preached unto you, let him be accursed.

\ln Nasgi gayula iyogiwedv tsigi, utloyiquo hia gohi gesv nitsiweha, Iyuno gilo itsalitsidonehesdi nvwadale osdv kanohedv, nano nasgi gayula ditsadanilvtsvhi tsigi, nasgi atsisgatsvhi gesesdi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏳᎳ ᎢᏲᎩᏪᏛ ᏥᎩ, ᎤᏠᏱᏉ ᎯᎠ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏂᏥᏪᎭ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏣᎵᏥᏙᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ, ᎾᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏳᎳ ᏗᏣᏓᏂᎸᏨᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏥᏍᎦᏨᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft As we said before, so say I now again, If any man preach any other gospel unto you than that ye have received, let him be accursed.

\ln Gohiyeno gesv tsigo yvwi diqualii nidegvneha?  Unelanvhige?  tsigoge osdv uniyelvdi yvwi agiyoha?  iyuyeno osdv uniyelvdi yvwi asi yagiyoha, vtla Galonedv aginvsidohi yigagi.
\syll ᎪᎯᏰᏃ ᎨᏒ ᏥᎪ ᏴᏫ ᏗᏆᎵᎢ ᏂᏕᎬᏁᎭ?  ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᎨ?  ᏥᎪᎨ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎤᏂᏰᎸᏗ ᏴᏫ ᎠᎩᏲᎭ?  ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎤᏂᏰᎸᏗ ᏴᏫ ᎠᏏ ᏯᎩᏲᎭ, ᎥᏝ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎠᎩᏅᏏᏙᎯ ᏱᎦᎩ.
\ft For do I now persuade men, or God? or do I seek to please men? for if I yet pleased men, I should not be the servant of Christ.

\ln Aseno itsvnoneha idalinvtli, nasgi hia osdv kanohedv tsaqualitsidonvgi, vtla yvwi tsudeyonvhi yigi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎢᏨᏃᏁᎭ ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏣᏆᎵᏥᏙᏅᎩ, ᎥᏝ ᏴᏫ ᏧᏕᏲᏅᎯ ᏱᎩ.
\ft But I certify you, brethren, that the gospel which was preached of me is not after man.

\ln Vtlayeno yvwi digvgiyohiselvhi yigi, vtla ale gilo aqueyonvhi yigi, Tsisa Galonedvsgini gvnigesv iyaquvnelvhi.
\syll ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᏴᏫ ᏗᎬᎩᏲᎯᏎᎸᎯ ᏱᎩ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᎠᏇᏲᏅᎯ ᏱᎩ, ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏯᏋᏁᎸᎯ.
\ft For I neither received it of man, neither was I taught it, but by the revelation of Jesus Christ.

\ln Itsadvganvyeno nusdv tsuwagutanvsv aqualenidolv Anitsusi tsunatseli dikahnawadvsdi detsigahnawadisvi, nasgi ulosvstanvhi gatsiyadeyadotanv tsunanelodi unadatlugvi Unelanvhi tsutseliga, ale detsidvtanvi.
\syll ᎢᏣᏛᎦᏅᏰᏃ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏧᏩᎫᏔᏅᏒ ᎠᏆᎴᏂᏙᎸ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᏧᎾᏤᎵ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏕᏥᎦᎿᏩᏗᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎶᏒᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎦᏥᏯᏕᏯᏙᏔᏅ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬᎢ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᏤᎵᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᏥᏛᏔᏅᎢ.
\ft For ye have heard of my conversation in time past in the Jews' religion, how that beyond measure I persecuted the church of God, and wasted it:

\ln Ale aginequotsehv Anitsusi tsunatseli dikahnawadvsdi tsigadovsgvi detsigonadvdvgi unitsati idigayogadvnv diquatseli yvwi, utli igai ulinigidv aquadanvdvgi daquelugvgi digigayvlige uninohelvhi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎠᎩᏁᏉᏤᎲ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᏧᎾᏤᎵ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏥᎦᏙᎥᏍᎬᎢ ᏕᏥᎪᎾᏛᏛᎩ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎢᏗᎦᏲᎦᏛᏅ ᏗᏆᏤᎵ ᏴᏫ, ᎤᏟ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏛᎩ ᏓᏇᎷᎬᎩ ᏗᎩᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᎤᏂᏃᎮᎸᎯ.
\ft And profited in the Jews' religion above many my equals in mine own nation, being more exceedingly zealous of the traditions of my fathers.

\ln Aseno hnaquo osiyu uyelvnv Unelanvhi, nasgi nahiyu etsi aginanugowisv nvdagvwadalenvdv aquadadaletanvhi tsigi, ale gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv agiyanvtanvhi tsigi,
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎿᏉ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎤᏰᎸᏅ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏀᎢᏳ ᎡᏥ ᎠᎩᎾᏄᎪᏫᏒ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎠᏆᏓᏓᎴᏔᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎩᏯᏅᏔᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ,
\ft But when it pleased God, who separated me from my mother's womb, and called me by his grace,

\ln Nasgi Uwetsi aginanugowisediyi, nasgi ayv galitsidohvsgv gvnigesv itsiyvnediyi tsunadalenvdv yvwi anehvi; gilaquo iyvdv, vtla uniquedali ale gigv uninehi yidigatsiyanelotanei;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎠᎩᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᎦᎵᏥᏙᎲᏍᎬ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏥᏴᏁᏗᏱ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᎠᏁᎲᎢ; ᎩᎳᏉ ᎢᏴᏛ, ᎥᏝ ᎤᏂᏇᏓᎵ ᎠᎴ ᎩᎬ ᎤᏂᏁᎯ ᏱᏗᎦᏥᏯᏁᎶᏔᏁᎢ;
\ft To reveal his Son in me, that I might preach him among the heathen; immediately I conferred not with flesh and blood:

\ln Vtla ale Tsilusilimi yiwagilosei, yigatsiwadvhvse igvyi getsinvsidv iyunalistanvhi ayv oni; Alequiyisgini wagilosvgi, ale taline Demasga dvagilutsvgi.
\syll ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᏱᏩᎩᎶᏎᎢ, ᏱᎦᏥᏩᏛᎲᏎ ᎢᎬᏱ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏛ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎠᏴ ᎣᏂ; ᎠᎴᏈᏱᏍᎩᏂ ᏩᎩᎶᏒᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏔᎵᏁ ᏕᎹᏍᎦ ᏛᎠᎩᎷᏨᎩ.
\ft Neither went I up to Jerusalem to them which were apostles before me; but I went into Arabia, and returned again unto Damascus.

\ln Hnaquono tsoi winudetiyvhv Tsilusilimi aquenvsvgi Quida vtsiwadvhvsvgi, hisgigaduno tsusvhidv ganelv aginvgi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏦᎢ ᏫᏄᏕᏘᏴᎲ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᎠᏇᏅᏒᎩ ᏈᏓ ᎥᏥᏩᏛᎲᏒᎩ, ᎯᏍᎩᎦᏚᏃ ᏧᏒᎯᏛ ᎦᏁᎸ ᎠᎩᏅᎩ.
\ft Then after three years I went up to Jerusalem to see Peter, and abode with him fifteen days.

\ln Anisoisgini getsinvsidv vtla gilo yitsigoe Tsimi uwasv Ugvwiyuhi analinvtli.
\syll ᎠᏂᏐᎢᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏛ ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᏱᏥᎪᎡ ᏥᎻ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏟ.
\ft But other of the apostles saw I none, save James the Lord's brother.

\ln Nasgino hia tsitsvyowelaneha, gvniyuquo, Unelanvhi agatahvi, vtla yigatsigovsga.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏨᏲᏪᎳᏁᎭ, ᎬᏂᏳᏉ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎦᏔᎲᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᏱᎦᏥᎪᎥᏍᎦ.
\ft Now the things which I write unto you, behold, before God, I lie not.

\ln Onino Siliyi ale Silisiyi wagilosvgi.
\syll ᎣᏂᏃ ᏏᎵᏱ ᎠᎴ ᏏᎵᏏᏱ ᏩᎩᎶᏒᎩ.
\ft Afterwards I came into the regions of Syria and Cilicia;

\ln Ale vtla anigatahi yigese aquakadv nasgitsunanelodi dunadatluwadisv Tsudiyi, nasgi Galonedv digvwanelodi;
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎯ ᏱᎨᏎ ᎠᏆᎧᏛ ᎾᏍᎩᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᏚᎾᏓᏡᏩᏗᏒ ᏧᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏗᎬᏩᏁᎶᏗ;
\ft And was unknown by face unto the churches of Judaea which were in Christ:

\ln Unadvganvhiquosgininonv gesei hia naniwesgvi, Nasgi na uyo tsinigvhnadegv tsuwagutanvsv, hnaquo alitsidohvsga ikanoheha gohiyudi gesv nasgi ilvhiyu tsadvdisgvgi.
\syll ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅᎯᏉᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎨᏎᎢ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏂᏪᏍᎬᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᏲ ᏥᏂᎬᎿᏕᎬ ᏧᏩᎫᏔᏅᏒ, ᎿᏉ ᎠᎵᏥᏙᎲᏍᎦ ᎢᎧᏃᎮᎭ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᏣᏛᏗᏍᎬᎩ.
\ft But they had heard only, That he which persecuted us in times past now preacheth the faith which once he destroyed.

\ln Unilvquotaneno Unelanvhi ayv nvdigalisdodisgei.
\syll ᎤᏂᎸᏉᏔᏁᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᏴ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᎢ.
\ft And they glorified God in me.

\ln Hnaquono nigadu winudetiyvhv oni, taline Tsilusilimi aquenvsvgi osdehvgi Quaniqua, ale Dadasi nasquo vtsiyatinvsvgi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏂᎦᏚ ᏫᏄᏕᏘᏴᎲ ᎣᏂ, ᏔᎵᏁ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᎠᏇᏅᏒᎩ ᎣᏍᏕᎲᎩ ᏆᏂᏆ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᏓᏏ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎥᏥᏯᏘᏅᏒᎩ.
\ft Then fourteen years after I went up again to Jerusalem with Barnabas, and took Titus with me also.

\ln Ale gvnigesv nvquvnelvi nvdayulisdotanvgi aquenvsvgi, ale gvnigesv nigatsiyvnelv osdv kanohedv nasgi tsunadalenvdv yvwi gatsiyalitsidonehvi; anisiyvwihasgini udelidv gvnigesv nigatsiyvnelvgi dininotsali gesvi, yasegagi asequo yidotsisqualvda ale asequo yidagisqualvtanv aquelisvgi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏅᏋᏁᎸᎢ ᏅᏓᏳᎵᏍᏙᏔᏅᎩ ᎠᏇᏅᏒᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᎦᏥᏴᏁᎸ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᎦᏥᏯᎵᏥᏙᏁᎲᎢ; ᎠᏂᏏᏴᏫᎭᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᎦᏥᏴᏁᎸᎩ ᏗᏂᏃᏣᎵ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏯᏎᎦᎩ ᎠᏎᏉ ᏱᏙᏥᏍᏆᎸᏓ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏎᏉ ᏱᏓᎩᏍᏆᎸᏔᏅ ᎠᏇᎵᏒᎩ.
\ft And I went up by revelation, and communicated unto them that gospel which I preach among the Gentiles, but privately to them which were of reputation, lest by any means I should run, or had run, in vain.

\ln Aseno vtla nasquo Dadasi, nasgi osdehi, Agoi nigesv, ase atsiusdesedi yigesei;
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏓᏓᏏ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏍᏕᎯ, ᎠᎪᎢ ᏂᎨᏒ, ᎠᏎ ᎠᏥᎤᏍᏕᏎᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ;
\ft But neither Titus, who was with me, being a Greek, was compelled to be circumcised:

\ln Ale nvdagalisdodisgvgi unatlonasdi analinvtli nuwelisdvna getsiyvtanilvhi, nasgi nvdelidv uniyvlilv unigedvdiyi ogadatseligaya gesv Tsisa Galonedv iyuwanisadv ogihvi, tsoginatlai igogvnediyi;
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᎤᎾᏠᎾᏍᏗ ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏟ ᏄᏪᎵᏍᏛᎾ ᎨᏥᏴᏔᏂᎸᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏕᎵᏛ ᎤᏂᏴᎵᎸ ᎤᏂᎨᏛᏗᏱ ᎣᎦᏓᏤᎵᎦᏯ ᎨᏒ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ ᎣᎩᎲᎢ, ᏦᎩᎾᏝᎢ ᎢᎪᎬᏁᏗᏱ;
\ft And that because of false brethren unawares brought in, who came in privily to spy out our liberty which we have in Christ Jesus, that they might bring us into bondage:

\ln Nasgi vtla sutlilodv unv igohidv unanelagi yidotseliselei eladi nidotsadvnehvi; nasgi osdv kanehedv udohiyuhi gesv igvwasdiha igvwasdiha itseladidasdiyi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎥᏝ ᏑᏟᎶᏛ ᎤᏅ ᎢᎪᎯᏛ ᎤᎾᏁᎳᎩ ᏱᏙᏤᎵᏎᎴᎢ ᎡᎳᏗ ᏂᏙᏣᏛᏁᎲᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏁᎮᏛ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎢᎬᏩᏍᏗᎭ ᎢᎬᏩᏍᏗᎭ ᎢᏤᎳᏗᏓᏍᏗᏱ.
\ft To whom we gave place by subjection, no, not for an hour; that the truth of the gospel might continue with you.

\ln Nasginino yeli dininotsvli gesvi, nasgi nunasdvi vtla gohusdi aquvnehi yigi, Unelanvhiyeno vtla yigalvquodiha gilo nusdvi; nasgiyeno dininotsali gesv vtla gohusdi yigvginequoelei;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏂᏃ ᏰᎵ ᏗᏂᏃᏨᎵ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᎾᏍᏛᎢ ᎥᏝ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎠᏋᏁᎯ ᏱᎩ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏱᎦᎸᏉᏗᎭ ᎩᎶ ᏄᏍᏛᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᏗᏂᏃᏣᎵ ᎨᏒ ᎥᏝ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏱᎬᎩᏁᏉᎡᎴᎢ;
\ft But of these who seemed to be somewhat, (whatsoever they were, it maketh no matter to me: God accepteth no man's person:) for they who seemed to be somewhat in conference added nothing to me:

\ln Asgini iditlv, unigohv nasgi osdv kanohedv nidigetsiusdeselvna [unadvgodiyi] ayv vquagenvdvi, nasgiya digetsinvsdeselvhi [unadvgodiyi] osdv kanohedv Quida tsagagenvdei;
\syll ᎠᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᏗᏢ, ᎤᏂᎪᎲ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏂᏗᎨᏥᎤᏍᏕᏎᎸᎾ ᎤᎾᏛᎪᏗᏱdata is invalid ᎠᏴ ᎥᏆᎨᏅᏛᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏗᎨᏥᏅᏍᏕᏎᎸᎯ ᎤᎾᏛᎪᏗᏱdata is invalid ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏈᏓ ᏣᎦᎨᏅᏕᎢ;
\ft But contrariwise, when they saw that the gospel of the uncircumcision was committed unto me, as the gospel of the circumcision was unto Peter;

\ln (Nasgini Quida ulinigidv iyuwanehi atsinvsidv gesv digetsiusdeselvhi unetseliga, nasgi nasquo ayv aqualinigidv naquvnehvgi tsunadalenvdv yvwi detsiyalitsidonehvi;)
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏂ ᏈᏓ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᎢᏳᏩᏁᎯ ᎠᏥᏅᏏᏛ ᎨᏒ ᏗᎨᏥᎤᏍᏕᏎᎸᎯ ᎤᏁᏤᎵᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏴ ᎠᏆᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᎾᏋᏁᎲᎩ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᏕᏥᏯᎵᏥᏙᏁᎲᎢ;
\ft (For he that wrought effectually in Peter to the apostleship of the circumcision, the same was mighty in me toward the Gentiles:)

\ln Ale Tsimi, ale Siquasi, ale Tsani, nasgi diligusdo getsiyelvi, unigohv gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv nasgi vginelvi, anigatisiditlv degoginasadetanvgi ayv ale Quaniqua gvnigesv igvnehi dogadudadvi; ayv tsunadalenvdv yvwi dinehv woginilohisdiyi ugvwali, unvsvno digetsiusdeselvhi dinehvi;
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏥᎻ, ᎠᎴ ᏏᏆᏏ, ᎠᎴ ᏣᏂ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎵᎫᏍᏙ ᎨᏥᏰᎸᎢ, ᎤᏂᎪᎲ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎥᎩᏁᎸᎢ, ᎠᏂᎦᏘᏏᏗᏢ ᏕᎪᎩᎾᏌᏕᏔᏅᎩ ᎠᏴ ᎠᎴ ᏆᏂᏆ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᎬᏁᎯ ᏙᎦᏚᏓᏛᎢ; ᎠᏴ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᏗᏁᎲ ᏬᎩᏂᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ, ᎤᏅᏒᏃ ᏗᎨᏥᎤᏍᏕᏎᎸᎯ ᏗᏁᎲᎢ;
\ft And when James, Cephas, and John, who seemed to be pillars, perceived the grace that was given unto me, they gave to me and Barnabas the right hands of fellowship; that we should go unto the heathen, and they unto the circumcision.

\ln Sudalegisgininonv [unadulisgvgi,] nasgi tsosdanvdadisdiyi uyo iyunadvhnadegi; nasgiya nasquo aqualigaliyvsvgi nasgi iyaquadvnediyi.
\syll ᏑᏓᎴᎩᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎤᎾᏚᎵᏍᎬᎩ,data is invalid ᎾᏍᎩ ᏦᏍᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏲ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᎿᏕᎩ; ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏆᎵᎦᎵᏴᏒᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏯᏆᏛᏁᏗᏱ.
\ft Only they would that we should remember the poor; the same which I also was forward to do.

\ln Aseno Quida Vdiogi wulutsv gvnigesv detsigatilvsvgi, gayeguisdodiyeno gesvgi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᏈᏓ ᎥᏗᎣᎩ ᏭᎷᏨ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏕᏥᎦᏘᎸᏒᎩ, ᎦᏰᎫᎢᏍᏙᏗᏰᏃ ᎨᏒᎩ.
\ft But when Peter was come to Antioch, I withstood him to the face, because he was to be blamed.

\ln Asiquoyeno gilo iyunasdi Tsimiyi nvdinilosgvna gesvi, tsunadalenvdv yvwi itsulaha analisdayvhvsgvgi; aseno nasgi unilutsv, udanvsvgi dudadaledanelvgi, deganayesgvgi nasgi digetsinvsdeselvhi.
\syll ᎠᏏᏉᏰᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗ ᏥᎻᏱ ᏅᏗᏂᎶᏍᎬᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎠᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎬᎩ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᎷᏨ, ᎤᏓᏅᏒᎩ ᏚᏓᏓᎴᏓᏁᎸᎩ, ᏕᎦᎾᏰᏍᎬᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎨᏥᏅᏍᏕᏎᎸᎯ.
\ft For before that certain came from James, he did eat with the Gentiles: but when they were come, he withdrew and separated himself, fearing them which were of the circumcision.

\ln Ale anisoi Anitsusi unatlonastanvgi nasquo vgvwaligonelvgi; nasgi iyusdi Quaniqua nasquo vgvwatinawidvtanvgi anatlonasdisgvi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏐᎢ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎤᎾᏠᎾᏍᏔᏅᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎥᎬᏩᎵᎪᏁᎸᎩ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏆᏂᏆ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎥᎬᏩᏘᎾᏫᏛᏔᏅᎩ ᎠᎾᏠᎾᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ.
\ft And the other Jews dissembled likewise with him; insomuch that Barnabas also was carried away with their dissimulation.

\ln Aseno  agigohv niduyugodvna nanadvnehvi, nasgiya duyugodv dadeyohvsgv osdv kanohedv, nigadv anigatahv hia nvtsiweselvgi Quida, iyuno nihi, Hitsusi tsigi, tsunadalenvdv yvwi nunasdv nasgiya yinusdi yeha, Anitsusino nusdv anehv nasgiya nusdvna yigi hehvi, gadono Anitsusi nusdv anehv nasgiya unadediyi tsinidehvneha tsunadalenvdv yvwi?
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ  ᎠᎩᎪᎲ ᏂᏚᏳᎪᏛᎾ ᎾᎾᏛᏁᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᏓᏕᏲᎲᏍᎬ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ, ᏂᎦᏛ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎲ ᎯᎠ ᏅᏥᏪᏎᎸᎩ ᏈᏓ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᏂᎯ, ᎯᏧᏏ ᏥᎩ, ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᏄᎾᏍᏛ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏱᏄᏍᏗ ᏰᎭ, ᎠᏂᏧᏏᏃ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎠᏁᎲ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᏍᏛᎾ ᏱᎩ ᎮᎲᎢ, ᎦᏙᏃ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎠᏁᎲ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎤᎾᏕᏗᏱ ᏥᏂᏕᎲᏁᎭ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ?
\ft But when I saw that they walked not uprightly according to the truth of the gospel, I said unto Peter before them all, If thou, being a Jew, livest after the manner of Gentiles, and not as do the Jews, why compellest thou the Gentiles to live as do the Jews?

\ln Ayv Iditsusi igadenvhi tsigi, anisganano tsunadalenvdv yvwi nunasdv igadenvhi nigesvna tsigi,
\syll ᎠᏴ ᎢᏗᏧᏏ ᎢᎦᏕᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᏂᏍᎦᎾᏃ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᏄᎾᏍᏛ ᎢᎦᏕᏅᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏥᎩ,
\ft We who are Jews by nature, and not sinners of the Gentiles,

\ln Tsidigatahasgini nasgi yvwi dikahnawadvsdi nigawesgv nadvnehv nadudalesdisgvna gesvi, gohiyudisgini gesv Tsisa Galonedv, nasgi ayv edoiyunv Tsisa Galonedv, nasgi igadudalesdodiyi gohiyudi gesv Galonedv, vtlano dikahnawadvsdi nigawesgv nidadvnehvi; dikahnawadvsdiyeno nigawesgv nadvnehv vtla gilo uquedali yvgvdudalesda.
\syll ᏥᏗᎦᏔᎭᏍᎩᏂ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏴᏫ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎬ ᎾᏛᏁᎲ ᎾᏚᏓᎴᏍᏗᏍᎬᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎪᎯᏳᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏒ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᎡᏙᎢᏳᏅ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎦᏚᏓᎴᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ, ᎥᏝᏃ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎬ ᏂᏓᏛᏁᎲᎢ; ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗᏰᏃ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎬ ᎾᏛᏁᎲ ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᏴᎬᏚᏓᎴᏍᏓ.
\ft Knowing that a man is not justified by the works of the law, but by the faith of Jesus Christ, even we have believed in Jesus Christ, that we might be justified by the faith of Christ, and not by the works of the law: for by the works of the law shall no flesh be justified.

\ln Iyusgini, igiyohv Galonedv igudalesdiyi, gvnigesv yinulistanv igvsv nasquo idisganahiyu gesvi, Galonedvsgo asgana asdelisgi nigalisdiha?  gvwatlisdi.
\syll ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂ, ᎢᎩᏲᎲ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎢᎫᏓᎴᏍᏗᏱ, ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏱᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ ᎢᎬᏒ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎢᏗᏍᎦᏀᎢᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎦᎶᏁᏛᏍᎪ ᎠᏍᎦᎾ ᎠᏍᏕᎵᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᎭ?  ᎬᏩᏟᏍᏗ.
\ft But if, while we seek to be justified by Christ, we ourselves also are found sinners, is therefore Christ the minister of sin? God forbid.

\ln Iyuyeno nasgi digiyostanvhi gesv taline yidoganesgeha, agisganvtsvhi gesv gvnigesv yinigvneha.
\syll ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎩᏲᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏔᎵᏁ ᏱᏙᎦᏁᏍᎨᎭ, ᎠᎩᏍᎦᏅᏨᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏱᏂᎬᏁᎭ.
\ft For if I build again the things which I destroyed, I make myself a transgressor.

\ln Ayvyeno dikahnawadvsdi iyuwanisadv agiyohusvhiquo dikahnawadvsdi ahvi, nasgi Unelanvhi utseli ugvwali aqualenidasdiyi.
\syll ᎠᏴᏰᏃ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ ᎠᎩᏲᎱᏒᎯᏉ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎠᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᎠᏆᎴᏂᏓᏍᏗᏱ.
\ft For I through the law am dead to the law, that I might live unto God.

\ln Dadahnawasdv itsulaha Galonedv doginadvnv; aseno ayv gvnodv igi, vtlasgininonv hnaquo ayv yigi, Galonedvsgini gvnodv agiyaa; nusdvno hnaquo galenidohv ani uquedali gevi, galenidoha tsiyalisgasdodv Unelanvhi Uwetsi; nasgi agigeyuhiyu tsigesvgi, ale uwasv tsidudayose ayv agisdelisgvi.
\syll ᏓᏓᎿᏩᏍᏛ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏙᎩᎾᏛᏅ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᏴ ᎬᏃᏛ ᎢᎩ, ᎥᏝᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎿᏉ ᎠᏴ ᏱᎩ, ᎦᎶᏁᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᎬᏃᏛ ᎠᎩᏯᎠ; ᏄᏍᏛᏃ ᎿᏉ ᎦᎴᏂᏙᎲ ᎠᏂ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎨᎥᎢ, ᎦᎴᏂᏙᎭ ᏥᏯᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏪᏥ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎩᎨᏳᎯᏳ ᏥᎨᏒᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏥᏚᏓᏲᏎ ᎠᏴ ᎠᎩᏍᏕᎵᏍᎬᎢ.
\ft I am crucified with Christ: nevertheless I live; yet not I, but Christ liveth in me: and the life which I now live in the flesh I live by the faith of the Son of God, who loved me, and gave himself for me.

\ln Vtla yitsiyosdise gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv Unelanvhi; iyuyeno adudalesdi gesv dikahnawadvsdi yvdidalehvsga, hnaquo galonedv asequoquo yuyotlesv.
\syll ᎥᏝ ᏱᏥᏲᏍᏗᏎ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ; ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᎠᏚᏓᎴᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏴᏗᏓᎴᎲᏍᎦ, ᎿᏉ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎠᏎᏉᏉ ᏳᏲᏞᏒ.
\ft I do not frustrate the grace of God: for if righteousness come by the law, then Christ is dead in vain.

\ln Itsinegu Gelesiyi itsehi, gago itsilonastanv, nasgi itsohiyudiyi nigesvna nitsvnelv udohiyuhi gesvi, nihi detsikanv Tsisa Galonedv gvnigesv nagvnelv dadahnawasdv gadv itsehvi.
\syll ᎢᏥᏁᎫ ᎨᎴᏏᏱ ᎢᏤᎯ, ᎦᎪ ᎢᏥᎶᎾᏍᏔᏅ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏦᎯᏳᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏂᏨᏁᎸ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏂᎯ ᏕᏥᎧᏅ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎾᎬᏁᎸ ᏓᏓᎿᏩᏍᏛ ᎦᏛ ᎢᏤᎲᎢ.
\ft O foolish Galatians, who hath bewitched you, that ye should not obey the truth, before whose eyes Jesus Christ hath been evidently set forth, crucified among you?

\ln Hia nasgi uwasv sginonediyi aquaduliha; Adanvdosgo detsiyohisele nvdigalisdodisge dikahnawadvsdi nigawesgv nitsadvnehvi, tsigoge nvdigalisdodisge itsohiyuhi itsadvgisgvi?
\syll ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏍᎩᏃᏁᏗᏱ ᎠᏆᏚᎵᎭ; ᎠᏓᏅᏙᏍᎪ ᏕᏥᏲᎯᏎᎴ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎬ ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎲᎢ, ᏥᎪᎨ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨ ᎢᏦᎯᏳᎯ ᎢᏣᏛᎩᏍᎬᎢ?
\ft This only would I learn of you, Received ye the Spirit by the works of the law, or by the hearing of faith?

\ln Nigavquosgo itsinegu?  Adanvdo gvdi tsitsalenvhv, uquedalisgo gvdi itsisquadiha?
\syll ᏂᎦᎥᏉᏍᎪ ᎢᏥᏁᎫ?  ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎬᏗ ᏥᏣᎴᏅᎲ, ᎤᏇᏓᎵᏍᎪ ᎬᏗ ᎢᏥᏍᏆᏗᎭ?
\ft Are ye so foolish? having begun in the Spirit, are ye now made perfect by the flesh?

\ln Tsigo nasgi nigav tsudalenvdv asequoquo itsigiliyotsv?  iyuno howa asequoquo yigi.
\syll ᏥᎪ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎠᏎᏉᏉ ᎢᏥᎩᎵᏲᏨ?  ᎢᏳᏃ ᎰᏩ ᎠᏎᏉᏉ ᏱᎩ.
\ft Have ye suffered so many things in vain? if it be yet in vain.

\ln Nasgino na Adanvdo itsinehi tsigi, ale usquanigodi tsulvwisdanehi tsigi itsehvi, tsigo dikahnawadvsdi nigawesgv nadvnehv nvdigalisdodiha?  tsigoge uwohiyuhi advgisgv nvdigalisdodiha?
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ Ꮎ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎢᏥᏁᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᏧᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎢᏤᎲᎢ, ᏥᎪ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎬ ᎾᏛᏁᎲ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ?  ᏥᎪᎨ ᎤᏬᎯᏳᎯ ᎠᏛᎩᏍᎬ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ?
\ft He therefore that ministereth to you the Spirit, and worketh miracles among you, doeth he it by the works of the law, or by the hearing of faith?

\ln Nasgiya Equahami tsuwohiyune Unelanvhi, ale duyugodv tsinudvnelo tsatsiyelvnanelei.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎡᏆᎭᎻ ᏧᏬᎯᏳᏁ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᏥᏄᏛᏁᎶ ᏣᏥᏰᎸᎾᏁᎴᎢ.
\ft Even as Abraham believed God, and it was accounted to him for righteousness.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi itsigatahesdi nasgi na anohiyuhvsgi gesv, nasgi Equahami tsuwetsi gesvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎮᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᎨᏒ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᏆᎭᎻ ᏧᏪᏥ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Know ye therefore that they which are of faith, the same are the children of Abraham.

\ln Gowelino galvquodi igvyi gayehi tsagowatisge nasgi Unelanvhi gohiyudi gvdi dodigudalesisv tsunadalenvdv yvwi, igvyi gayehi osdv kanohedv gvnigesv nagvnele Equahami, hia natsiweselei, Nihi nvdvnisani nigadv yvwi danewadisv elanigv osdv iyunalisdanedi gesesdi.
\syll ᎪᏪᎵᏃ ᎦᎸᏉᏗ ᎢᎬᏱ ᎦᏰᎯ ᏣᎪᏩᏘᏍᎨ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎬᏗ ᏙᏗᎫᏓᎴᏏᏒ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ, ᎢᎬᏱ ᎦᏰᎯ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎾᎬᏁᎴ ᎡᏆᎭᎻ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏥᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏂᎯ ᏅᏛᏂᏌᏂ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏴᏫ ᏓᏁᏩᏗᏒ ᎡᎳᏂᎬ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft And the scripture, foreseeing that God would justify the heathen through faith, preached before the gospel unto Abraham, saying, In thee shall all nations be blessed.

\ln Howano nasgi anohiyuhvsgi gesv osdv nunalisdaneho gegatloyasdisgo osdv nulisdanelv uwohiyuhisdi Equahami.
\syll ᎰᏩᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᎨᏒ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏄᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᎰ ᎨᎦᏠᏯᏍᏗᏍᎪ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏄᎵᏍᏓᏁᎸ ᎤᏬᎯᏳᎯᏍᏗ ᎡᏆᎭᎻ.
\ft So then they which be of faith are blessed with faithful Abraham.

\ln Nanivyeno dikahnawadvsdi nigawesgv iyadvnediyi analisgasdodisgi, nasgi getsisgatsvhi; hiayeno nigvnv igvwela, Getsisgatsvhi gesesdi naniv gilo nidanikahnawadegvna igesesdi nanadvnehv nigadv tsudalenvdv dikahnawadvsdiyi gowelvi.
\syll ᎾᏂᎥᏰᏃ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎬ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᏗᏱ ᎠᎾᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏗᏍᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᏥᏍᎦᏨᎯ; ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᏂᎬᏅ ᎢᎬᏪᎳ, ᎨᏥᏍᎦᏨᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎩᎶ ᏂᏓᏂᎧᎿᏩᏕᎬᎾ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᎾᏛᏁᎲ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗᏱ ᎪᏪᎸᎢ.
\ft For as many as are of the works of the law are under the curse: for it is written, Cursed is every one that continueth not in all things which are written in the book of the law to do them.

\ln Aseno gilo dikahnawadvsdi nadudalesdisgvna gesv Unelanvhi agatahv gvnigesviyu; Nasgiyeno duyugodv iyadvnehi gohiyudi gesv udvnidisdesdi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎩᎶ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎾᏚᏓᎴᏍᏗᏍᎬᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎦᏔᎲ ᎬᏂᎨᏒᎢᏳ; ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᎯ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏛᏂᏗᏍᏕᏍᏗ.
\ft But that no man is justified by the law in the sight of God, it is evident: for, The just shall live by faith.

\ln Dikahnawadvsdiyeno vtla gohiyudi gesv alisdelvdodi yinigvneha; hiasgini, Gilo yvwi nasgi nadvnehesdi nasgi udvnidisdesdi.
\syll ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗᏰᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ ᏱᏂᎬᏁᎭ; ᎯᎠᏍᎩᏂ, ᎩᎶ ᏴᏫ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏛᏂᏗᏍᏕᏍᏗ.
\ft And the law is not of faith: but, The man that doeth them shall live in them.

\ln Galonedv igaguyvhv igudalesv dikahnawadvsdi udasgaisdodi gesvi, atsisgatsvhi nulistanv ayv igisdelisgvi; hiayeno nigvnv igowela, Atsisgatsvhi gilo tlugv agadvnvhi.
\syll ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎢᎦᎫᏴᎲ ᎢᎫᏓᎴᏒ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎤᏓᏍᎦᎢᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᏥᏍᎦᏨᎯ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ ᎠᏴ ᎢᎩᏍᏕᎵᏍᎬᎢ; ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᏂᎬᏅ ᎢᎪᏪᎳ, ᎠᏥᏍᎦᏨᎯ ᎩᎶ ᏡᎬ ᎠᎦᏛᏅᎯ.
\ft Christ hath redeemed us from the curse of the law, being made a curse for us: for it is written, Cursed is every one that hangeth on a tree:

\ln Nasgi osdv nagadvnelv Equahami nasgi unilutsediyi tsunadalenvdv yvwi Tsisa Galonedv nvdayudalenvhi; nasgi etsinediyi Adanvdo aduisdv gohiyudi gvdodi gesvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎾᎦᏛᏁᎸ ᎡᏆᎭᎻ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᎷᏤᏗᏱ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᏥᏁᏗᏱ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎠᏚᎢᏍᏛ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎬᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft That the blessing of Abraham might come on the Gentiles through Jesus Christ; that we might receive the promise of the Spirit through faith.

\ln Idalinvtli, yvwi unineisdi tsinega; Nasquo yvwiquo kanohedv dunatlohisdv asdayidvhi yigi, vtla gilo yvgvyosda, ale vtla aganequotsa.
\syll ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᏴᏫ ᎤᏂᏁᎢᏍᏗ ᏥᏁᎦ; ᎾᏍᏉ ᏴᏫᏉ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏚᎾᏠᎯᏍᏛ ᎠᏍᏓᏱᏛᎯ ᏱᎩ, ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᏴᎬᏲᏍᏓ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᎠᎦᏁᏉᏣ.
\ft Brethren, I speak after the manner of men; Though it be but a man's covenant, yet if it be confirmed, no man disannulleth, or addeth thereto.

\ln Ale Equahami ale nasgi unetlvtanvdv gesv tsudalenvdv getsiduisdanelei.  Vtla hia yinigaweha, ale nihi ditsanetlvtanvhi, ilvsgi tsigeso nasgiyai; saquoquosgini tsigeso nasgiya, [hia nigaweha,] ale nihi tsanetlvtanvhi; nasgi Galonedv tsigi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎡᏆᎭᎻ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᏢᏔᏅᏛ ᎨᏒ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎨᏥᏚᎢᏍᏓᏁᎴᎢ.  ᎥᏝ ᎯᎠ ᏱᏂᎦᏪᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎯ ᏗᏣᏁᏢᏔᏅᎯ, ᎢᎸᏍᎩ ᏥᎨᏐ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ; ᏌᏉᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᏥᎨᏐ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᎭ,data is invalid ᎠᎴ ᏂᎯ ᏣᏁᏢᏔᏅᎯ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏥᎩ.
\ft Now to Abraham and his seed were the promises made. He saith not, And to seeds, as of many; but as of one, And to thy seed, which is Christ.

\ln Ale hia nasgi nitsiweha, Nasgi kanohedv datlohisdv Galonedv ugvwali nasgi Unelanvhi gayula gvwasdayidvhi tsigesei, dikahnawadvsdi nvgitsuqui tsoasgohi winudetiyvhv oni gananugowisvhi tsigi, vtla gvwayosdodi yigi, nasgi yeli asequo iyuwanediyi aduisdvi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᏥᏪᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏓᏠᎯᏍᏛ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎦᏳᎳ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏱᏛᎯ ᏥᎨᏎᎢ, ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏅᎩᏧᏈ ᏦᎠᏍᎪᎯ ᏫᏄᏕᏘᏴᎲ ᎣᏂ ᎦᎾᏄᎪᏫᏒᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎥᏝ ᎬᏩᏲᏍᏙᏗ ᏱᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏰᎵ ᎠᏎᏉ ᎢᏳᏩᏁᏗᏱ ᎠᏚᎢᏍᏛᎢ.
\ft And this I say, that the covenant, that was confirmed before of God in Christ, the law, which was four hundred and thirty years after, cannot disannul, that it should make the promise of none effect.

\ln Iyuyeno otseli iyulisdodi gesv dikahnawadvsdi ahv yvdidalehvsga, vtla aduisdv yvdigvdalehvsga; Unelanvhisgini Equahami ulisgolvdanele aduisdisgv uwvtanei.
\syll ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᎣᏤᎵ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎠᎲ ᏴᏗᏓᎴᎲᏍᎦ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᏚᎢᏍᏛ ᏴᏗᎬᏓᎴᎲᏍᎦ; ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎡᏆᎭᎻ ᎤᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᎴ ᎠᏚᎢᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᎤᏮᏔᏁᎢ.
\ft For if the inheritance be of the law, it is no more of promise: but God gave it to Abraham by promise.

\ln Gadono gvdodi dikahnawadvsdi?  asganvisdi gesv nvdigalisdodisge wigudatanvhi gesei, nasgi unetlvtanvhi atsiduisdanelvhi gesv unanugoisdi gesv gvdisgi; [ale nasgi dikahnawadvsdi] dinikahnawadidohi osdv nunvhnadege nasgi tsusvgale ayeli nelenehi.
\syll ᎦᏙᏃ ᎬᏙᏗ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ?  ᎠᏍᎦᏅᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨ ᏫᎫᏓᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᏢᏔᏅᎯ ᎠᏥᏚᎢᏍᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏗᏍᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗdata is invalid ᏗᏂᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏄᏅᎿᏕᎨ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏒᎦᎴ ᎠᏰᎵ ᏁᎴᏁᎯ.
