\ft Wherefore then serveth the law? It was added because of transgressions, till the seed should come to whom the promise was made; and it was ordained by angels in the hand of a mediator.

\ln Nasgino ayeli dilenehi tsigeso vtla asiyvwiquo ayeli alenehi yigesoi, Unelanvhisgini asiyvwiquo.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎠᏰᎵ ᏗᎴᏁᎯ ᏥᎨᏐ ᎥᏝ ᎠᏏᏴᏫᏉ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎠᎴᏁᎯ ᏱᎨᏐᎢ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏏᏴᏫᏉ.
\ft Now a mediator is not a mediator of one, but God is one.

\ln Dikahnawadvsdisgono datludiha Unelanvhi duduistanvi?  gvwatlisdi, iyuyeno dikahnawadvsdi yvwi getsinelvhi yigese, nasgi yeli gvnidv gvwadanedi gesvi, udohiyuhiya dikahnawadvsdi ahv adudalesdi gesv yvdidalehvsgei.
\syll ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗᏍᎪᏃ ᏓᏡᏗᎭ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏚᏚᎢᏍᏔᏅᎢ?  ᎬᏩᏟᏍᏗ, ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏴᏫ ᎨᏥᏁᎸᎯ ᏱᎨᏎ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏰᎵ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎬᏩᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎠᎲ ᎠᏚᏓᎴᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏴᏗᏓᎴᎲᏍᎨᎢ.
\ft Is the law then against the promises of God? God forbid: for if there had been a law given which could have given life, verily righteousness should have been by the law.

\ln Aseno goweli galvquodi gvnigesv nigvneha nigadiyu unisganvtsvhi gesvi, nasgi aduisdv Tsisa Galonedv gohiyudi gesv nvdvdalehvsgi, nasgi getsinediyi anohiyuhvsgi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎪᏪᎵ ᎦᎸᏉᏗ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᎬᏁᎭ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᎤᏂᏍᎦᏅᏨᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏚᎢᏍᏛ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏛᏓᎴᎲᏍᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᏥᏁᏗᏱ ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ.
\ft But the scripture hath concluded all under sin, that the promise by faith of Jesus Christ might be given to them that believe.

\ln Gohiyudisgini gesv asi nigananugogvna tsigesei, dikahnawadvsdi ahv hawiniditlv nigadvnvgi, egisduhvgi gohiyudi gesv oni gvnigesv igvnedi gesv iyasdi.
\syll ᎪᎯᏳᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏏ ᏂᎦᎾᏄᎪᎬᎾ ᏥᎨᏎᎢ, ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎠᎲ ᎭᏫᏂᏗᏢ ᏂᎦᏛᏅᎩ, ᎡᎩᏍᏚᎲᎩ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎣᏂ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᎬᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏯᏍᏗ.
\ft But before faith came, we were kept under the law, shut up unto the faith which should afterwards be revealed.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi dikahnawadvsdi digeyohvsgi gesvgi, Galonedvyi digatinegi, nasgi gohiyudi gesv igadudalesdodiyi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏗᎨᏲᎲᏍᎩ ᎨᏒᎩ, ᎦᎶᏁᏛᏱ ᏗᎦᏘᏁᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᎦᏚᏓᎴᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
\ft Wherefore the law was our schoolmaster to bring us unto Christ, that we might be justified by faith.

\ln Gohiyudisgini gesv tsunanugotsv, vtla hnaquo dideyohvsgi digatinidohi yigi.
\syll ᎪᎯᏳᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏒ ᏧᎾᏄᎪᏨ, ᎥᏝ ᎿᏉ ᏗᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ ᏗᎦᏘᏂᏙᎯ ᏱᎩ.
\ft But after that faith is come, we are no longer under a schoolmaster.

\ln Nitsivyeno Unelanvhi tsuwetsi nitsalistanv Galonedv Tsisa etsoiyusv nvdigalisdodiha.
\syll ᏂᏥᎥᏰᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᏪᏥ ᏂᏣᎵᏍᏔᏅ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏥᏌ ᎡᏦᎢᏳᏒ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ.
\ft For ye are all the children of God by faith in Christ Jesus.

\ln Nitsivyeno tsetsawovhi tsigi Galonedv etsaligonehvi, nasgi Galonedv etsanuwov.
\syll ᏂᏥᎥᏰᏃ ᏤᏣᏬᎥᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎡᏣᎵᎪᏁᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎡᏣᏄᏬᎥ.
\ft For as many of you as have been baptized into Christ have put on Christ.

\ln Vtlayeha Atsusi, ale Agoi, vtla atsinatlai, ale natsinatlavna, vtla asgaya, ale ageyv, nitsivyeno igetsasdiha Galonedv Tsisa etsiyavi.
\syll ᎥᏝᏰᎭ ᎠᏧᏏ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎪᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᏥᎾᏝᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏥᎾᏝᎥᎾ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎨᏴ, ᏂᏥᎥᏰᏃ ᎢᎨᏣᏍᏗᎭ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏥᏌ ᎡᏥᏯᎥᎢ.
\ft There is neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither bond nor free, there is neither male nor female: for ye are all one in Christ Jesus.

\ln Iyu ale Galonedv tsutseli yigi nihi, hnaquo Equahami unetlvtanvdv nitsalisdiha, ale itsatseliga utiyvhi nasgiya nigvnv aduisdvi.
\syll ᎢᏳ ᎠᎴ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏧᏤᎵ ᏱᎩ ᏂᎯ, ᎿᏉ ᎡᏆᎭᎻ ᎤᏁᏢᏔᏅᏛ ᏂᏣᎵᏍᏗᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏣᏤᎵᎦ ᎤᏘᏴᎯ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏂᎬᏅ ᎠᏚᎢᏍᏛᎢ.
\ft And if ye be Christ's, then are ye Abraham's seed, and heirs according to the promise.

\ln Nasgino hia nitsiweha, Nasgi utiyedi gesvi, ayoli gesv igohidv, vtla yidunadalehnao atsinatlai, nugvwiyusadegi egano nudalesv gohusdi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏥᏪᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏘᏰᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᏲᎵ ᎨᏒ ᎢᎪᎯᏛ, ᎥᏝ ᏱᏚᎾᏓᎴᎿᎣ ᎠᏥᎾᏝᎢ, ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ ᎡᎦᏃ ᏄᏓᎴᏒ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ.
\ft Now I say, That the heir, as long as he is a child, differeth nothing from a servant, though he be lord of all;

\ln Deunelodosgini digvweyohvsgi ale unadesayasdidegi agayvligei dusvsdv gvdisgi.
\syll ᏕᎤᏁᎶᏙᏍᎩᏂ ᏗᎬᏪᏲᎲᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏕᏌᏯᏍᏗᏕᎩ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ ᏚᏒᏍᏛ ᎬᏗᏍᎩ.
\ft But is under tutors and governors until the time appointed of the father.

\ln Nasgiya nasquo ayv, asi didiyoli tsigesvgi, tseginatlai gesvgi, igadanuyvdvgi dilenvdodi dideloquasdi elohi ehi gesvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏴ, ᎠᏏ ᏗᏗᏲᎵ ᏥᎨᏒᎩ, ᏤᎩᎾᏝᎢ ᎨᏒᎩ, ᎢᎦᏓᏄᏴᏛᎩ ᏗᎴᏅᏙᏗ ᏗᏕᎶᏆᏍᏗ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎡᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Even so we, when we were children, were in bondage under the elements of the world:

\ln Aseno nahiyu aselvhi gesv akalii usqualvhvi, Unelanvhi tsunvse Uwetsi ageyv unanugowisei, dikahnawadvsdi ahv udanuyvdei,
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᏀᎢᏳ ᎠᏎᎸᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎧᎵᎢ ᎤᏍᏆᎸᎲᎢ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᏅᏎ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎠᎨᏴ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᎢ, ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎠᎲ ᎤᏓᏄᏴᏕᎢ,
\ft But when the fullness of the time was come, God sent forth his Son, made of a woman, made under the law,

\ln Tsuduyvdiyi tsuwudalesdiyi uyelvse nasgi unadanuyvdi dikahnawadvsdi ahvi, nasgi ayv tsuwetsi iyegvnediyi.
\syll ᏧᏚᏴᏗᏱ ᏧᏭᏓᎴᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏰᎸᏎ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᏓᏄᏴᏗ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎠᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᏧᏪᏥ ᎢᏰᎬᏁᏗᏱ.
\ft To redeem them that were under the law, that we might receive the adoption of sons.

\ln Nasgino tsuwetsi tsinitsalistanv, nasgi nvdigalisdodiha, Unelanvhi tsunvsv Uwetsi Udanvdo ditsadanvdogihi, uweluga hia nigaweha, Aqua, Edoda.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏧᏪᏥ ᏥᏂᏣᎵᏍᏔᏅ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᏅᏒ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎤᏓᏅᏙ ᏗᏣᏓᏅᏙᎩᎯ, ᎤᏪᎷᎦ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᎭ, ᎠᏆ, ᎡᏙᏓ.
\ft And because ye are sons, God hath sent forth the Spirit of his Son into your hearts, crying, Abba, Father.

\ln Nasgi nvdigalisdodiha vtla hnaquo etsanatlai yigi, uwetsiquosgini; ale iyu uwetsi yigi, hnaquo tsugvwalodi Unelanvhi udanedi gesv tsatiyehi, Galonedv iyuwanisanvhi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎥᏝ ᎿᏉ ᎡᏣᎾᏝᎢ ᏱᎩ, ᎤᏪᏥᏉᏍᎩᏂ; ᎠᎴ ᎢᏳ ᎤᏪᏥ ᏱᎩ, ᎿᏉ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏣᏘᏰᎯ, ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏅᎯ.
\ft Wherefore thou art no more a servant, but a son; and if a son, then an heir of God through Christ.

\ln Aseno nahiyui, Unelanvhi netsigatahvna tsigesvgi, gohusdi detsikahnawadidohvgi nasgi udohiyuhi unanelanvhi nigesvna gesvi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᏀᎢᏳᎢ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏁᏥᎦᏔᎲᎾ ᏥᎨᏒᎩ, ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏕᏥᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎲᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎤᎾᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Howbeit then, when ye knew not God, ye did service unto them which by nature are no gods.

\ln Aseno gohi tsigi, hnaquo etsigadovsvhi tsigi Unelanvhi, ale yadvnv Unelanvhi itsigadovsvhi tsigi, gado digalisdodiha itsatsvha dotsalisgasdodiha awanagala ale uyo iyudvhnadegi dilenvdodi dideloquasdi, nasgi asi nahna tsitsaduli tsetsinatla taline itsalisdodiyi?
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎪᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎿᏉ ᎡᏥᎦᏙᎥᏒᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏯᏛᏅ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᏥᎦᏙᎥᏒᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎦᏙ ᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎢᏣᏨᎭ ᏙᏣᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎠᏩᎾᎦᎳ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏲ ᎢᏳᏛᎿᏕᎩ ᏗᎴᏅᏙᏗ ᏗᏕᎶᏆᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏏ ᏀᎾ ᏥᏣᏚᎵ ᏤᏥᎾᏝ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ?
\ft But now, after that ye have known God, or rather are known of God, how turn ye again to the weak and beggarly elements, whereunto ye desire again to be in bondage?

\ln Detsisquanigodo dadodaquegvi, ale datsolanegvi, ale dasqualvhegvi, ale dadetiyvhegvi.
\syll ᏕᏥᏍᏆᏂᎪᏙ ᏓᏙᏓᏇᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᏦᎳᏁᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᏍᏆᎸᎮᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᏕᏘᏴᎮᎬᎢ.
\ft Ye observe days, and months, and times, and years.

\ln Itsvnayeisehaquo, asequoquo gohusdi yigatsiyadvnelv gelisgv iyusdi.
\syll ᎢᏨᎾᏰᎢᏎᎭᏉ, ᎠᏎᏉᏉ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏱᎦᏥᏯᏛᏁᎸ ᎨᎵᏍᎬ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ.
\ft I am afraid of you, lest I have bestowed upon you labour in vain.

\ln Idalinvtli, itsvtayoseha ayv naquasdv nasgiya itsalisdodiyi; nitsasdvyeno nasgiya naquasdi ayv, vtla gohusdi usonv isgiyvnelvhi yigi;
\syll ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᎢᏨᏔᏲᏎᎭ ᎠᏴ ᎾᏆᏍᏛ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ; ᏂᏣᏍᏛᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏆᏍᏗ ᎠᏴ, ᎥᏝ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏐᏅ ᎢᏍᎩᏴᏁᎸᎯ ᏱᎩ;
\ft Brethren, I beseech you, be as I am; for I am as ye are: ye have not injured me at all.

\ln Aseno itsigataha awanagalahiyu gesv agiquedalvi itsvyalitsidonelv osdv kanohedv igvyiyi;
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᎠᏩᎾᎦᎳᎯᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎩᏇᏓᎸᎢ ᎢᏨᏯᎵᏥᏙᏁᎸ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎢᎬᏱᏱ;
\ft Ye know how through infirmity of the flesh I preached the gospel unto you at the first.

\ln Ale tsigvliyogv nasgi agiquedalv tsaquehvgi, vtla nvlisali yitsiyelvnei, ale vtla yitsiyoiselei; desgiyadanilvtsvgisgini dikahnawadidohi Unelanvhi utseli nasgiyai, ale Galonedv Tsisa nasgiyai.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏥᎬᎵᏲᎬ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎩᏇᏓᎸ ᏣᏇᎲᎩ, ᎥᏝ ᏅᎵᏌᎵ ᏱᏥᏰᎸᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏥᏲᎢᏎᎴᎢ; ᏕᏍᎩᏯᏓᏂᎸᏨᎩᏍᎩᏂ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏥᏌ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ.
\ft And my temptation which was in my flesh ye despised not, nor rejected; but received me as an angel of God, even as Christ Jesus.

\ln Nasgino nigavgi nvwadohiyadv itsadanvdvgi!  itsvyoiyudanehayeno, nasgi iyuno yeli nasgi igvwalisdodi yigesei, itsvsv yiditsadagatedoisei, ale ayv yidisginelei.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏂᎦᎥᎩ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏛᎩ  ᎢᏨᏲᎢᏳᏓᏁᎭᏰᏃ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏃ ᏰᎵ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎬᏩᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ, ᎢᏨᏒ ᏱᏗᏣᏓᎦᏖᏙᎢᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴ ᏱᏗᏍᎩᏁᎴᎢ.
\ft Where is then the blessedness ye spake of? for I bear you record, that, if it had been possible, ye would have plucked out your own eyes, and have given them to me.

\ln Tsigono sgisgagi nulistanv nigalisdodiha udohiyuhi gesv itsvnonelvi?
\syll ᏥᎪᏃ ᏍᎩᏍᎦᎩ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏨᏃᏁᎸᎢ?
\ft Am I therefore become your enemy, because I tell you the truth?

\ln Utsati getsigeyuha, aseno vtla osdv ugvwali yigi; ale nihi yigetsalisduda, nasgi utsati ditsigeyuhiyu iyulisdodiyi.
\syll ᎤᏣᏘ ᎨᏥᎨᏳᎭ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᏱᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᏂᎯ ᏱᎨᏣᎵᏍᏚᏓ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏗᏥᎨᏳᎯᏳ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
\ft They zealously affect you, but not well; yea, they would exclude you, that ye might affect them.

\ln Osiyusgini nigohilv utsati itsigeyudiyi osdv gesvi, vtlano nahiyuquo itsvyeladidohv uwasv.
\syll ᎣᏏᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎢᏥᎨᏳᏗᏱ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎥᏝᏃ ᏀᎢᏳᏉ ᎢᏨᏰᎳᏗᏙᎲ ᎤᏩᏒ.
\ft But it is good to be zealously affected always in a good thing, and not only when I am present with you.

\ln Diquetsi ditsasdii, nasgi taline itsvnelitsvhi tsigi [idigvtselidv] itsadediyi, gvni Galonedv adotlvnvha detsadanvdvi,
\syll ᏗᏇᏥ ᏗᏣᏍᏗᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎢᏨᏁᎵᏨᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎢᏗᎬᏤᎵᏛdata is invalid ᎢᏣᏕᏗᏱ, ᎬᏂ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎠᏙᏢᏅᎭ ᏕᏣᏓᏅᏛᎢ,
\ft My little children, of whom I travail in birth again until Christ be formed in you,

\ln Gvquadulvdi nigalisdi gohi gesv itsvyeladidasdiyi, ale aginetliyvsdiyi tsinegvi; uyayeno itsvyvsga.
\syll ᎬᏆᏚᎸᏗ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏨᏰᎳᏗᏓᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎩᏁᏟᏴᏍᏗᏱ ᏥᏁᎬᎢ; ᎤᏯᏰᏃ ᎢᏨᏴᏍᎦ.
\ft I desire to be present with you now, and to change my voice; for I stand in doubt of you.

\ln Sginohvsi, nihi itsadulisgi dikahnawadvsdi ahv itsadanuyvdodiyi, tlasgo yitsadvgiha dikahnawadvsdi?
\syll ᏍᎩᏃᎲᏏ, ᏂᎯ ᎢᏣᏚᎵᏍᎩ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎠᎲ ᎢᏣᏓᏄᏴᏙᏗᏱ, ᏝᏍᎪ ᏱᏣᏛᎩᎭ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ?
\ft Tell me, ye that desire to be under the law, do ye not hear the law?

\ln Hiayeno nigvnv igowela, nasgi Equahami anitali tsuwetsi anehei, asiyvwi atsinatlai ageyv unanugowisvhi, soino natsinatlavna ageyv unanugowisvhi.
\syll ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᏂᎬᏅ ᎢᎪᏪᎳ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᏆᎭᎻ ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᏧᏪᏥ ᎠᏁᎮᎢ, ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᎠᏥᎾᏝᎢ ᎠᎨᏴ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏫᏒᎯ, ᏐᎢᏃ ᎾᏥᎾᏝᎥᎾ ᎠᎨᏴ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏫᏒᎯ.
\ft For it is written, that Abraham had two sons, the one by a bondmaid, the other by a freewoman.

\ln Nano atsinatlai ageyv unanugowisvhi, uquedali udetanei; nasgiya natsinatlavna ageyv unanugowisvhi aduisdv nasgiya udenei.
\syll ᎾᏃ ᎠᏥᎾᏝᎢ ᎠᎨᏴ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏫᏒᎯ, ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎤᏕᏔᏁᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏥᎾᏝᎥᎾ ᎠᎨᏴ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏫᏒᎯ ᎠᏚᎢᏍᏛ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎤᏕᏁᎢ.
\ft But he who was of the bondwoman was born after the flesh; but he of the freewoman was by promise.

\ln Hia nasgi datlilosdi; hiayeno nasgi tali kanohedv datlohisdv datlilosdi; saquo gesv Sanayi odalv tsvdidalehvsga, nasgi tsidegananugowisga digetsinatlvdi gesvi, nasgi Hega tsidatlilosdi.
\syll ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏓᏟᎶᏍᏗ; ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏔᎵ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏓᏠᎯᏍᏛ ᏓᏟᎶᏍᏗ; ᏌᏉ ᎨᏒ ᏌᎾᏱ ᎣᏓᎸ ᏨᏗᏓᎴᎲᏍᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏕᎦᎾᏄᎪᏫᏍᎦ ᏗᎨᏥᎾᏢᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎮᎦ ᏥᏓᏟᎶᏍᏗ.
\ft Which things are an allegory: for these are the two covenants; the one from the mount Sinai, which gendereth to bondage, which is Agar.

\ln Hiayeno nasgi Hega Sanayi odalv datlilosdi, Elequia tsodalv, nasgi Tsilusilimi nasgiya tsigi, nasgi gohi nusdvi, nasgiyeno degetsinatlaa uwasv ale nasgi tsuwetsi.
\syll ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎮᎦ ᏌᎾᏱ ᎣᏓᎸ ᏓᏟᎶᏍᏗ, ᎡᎴᏈᎠ ᏦᏓᎸ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᎯ ᏄᏍᏛᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᏕᎨᏥᎾᏝᎠ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏪᏥ.
\ft For this Agar is mount Sinai in Arabia, and answereth to Jerusalem which now is, and is in bondage with her children.

\ln Tsilusilimisgini galvladi tsvdigaduha nasgi natsinatlavna, nasgi ayv nidiv igitsi.
\syll ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻᏍᎩᏂ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏨᏗᎦᏚᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏥᎾᏝᎥᎾ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᏂᏗᎥ ᎢᎩᏥ.
\ft But Jerusalem which is above is free, which is the mother of us all.

\ln Hiayeno nigvnv igowela, Haliheligi talulvvsgi nigesvna, nasgi nitadananugowisgvna; halenv heluhvga, nihi nitinanugowisgvna; nayeno, natsiyehvna utli naniv duwekaha tsuwetsi esgaquo na atsiyehi.
\syll ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᏂᎬᏅ ᎢᎪᏪᎳ, ᎭᎵᎮᎵᎩ ᏔᎷᎸᎥᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᏔᏓᎾᏄᎪᏫᏍᎬᎾ; ᎭᎴᏅ ᎮᎷᎲᎦ, ᏂᎯ ᏂᏘᎾᏄᎪᏫᏍᎬᎾ; ᎾᏰᏃ, ᎾᏥᏰᎲᎾ ᎤᏟ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏚᏪᎧᎭ ᏧᏪᏥ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ Ꮎ ᎠᏥᏰᎯ.
\ft For it is written, Rejoice, thou barren that bearest not; break forth and cry, thou that travailest not: for the desolate hath many more children than she which hath an husband.

\ln Nasgino ayv, idalinvtli, aduisdv igadetanvhi nasgiya Esigi tsinusdei.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎠᏴ, ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᎠᏚᎢᏍᏛ ᎢᎦᏕᏔᏅᎯ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎡᏏᎩ ᏥᏄᏍᏕᎢ.
\ft Now we, brethren, as Isaac was, are the children of promise.

\ln Nasgino nahiyu tsigesei, nasgi uquedali udetanvhi tsadeyadodisge nasgi na Adanvdo udetanvhi, nasgiya nusdi gohi gesvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏀᎢᏳ ᏥᎨᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎤᏕᏔᏅᎯ ᏣᏕᏯᏙᏗᏍᎨ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᏕᏔᏅᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᏍᏗ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft But as then he that was born after the flesh persecuted him that was born after the Spirit, even so it is now.

\ln Aseno gado adiha goweli?  Hinugowa atsinatlai ageyv ale nasgi uwetsi; atsinatlaiyeno ageyv uwetsi, vtla uweladisdodi yigesesdi utseli iyulisdodi gesv natsinatlavna ageyv uwetsi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎦᏙ ᎠᏗᎭ ᎪᏪᎵ?  ᎯᏄᎪᏩ ᎠᏥᎾᏝᎢ ᎠᎨᏴ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏪᏥ; ᎠᏥᎾᏝᎢᏰᏃ ᎠᎨᏴ ᎤᏪᏥ, ᎥᏝ ᎤᏪᎳᏗᏍᏙᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏥᎾᏝᎥᎾ ᎠᎨᏴ ᎤᏪᏥ.
\ft Nevertheless what saith the scripture? Cast out the bondwoman and her son: for the son of the bondwoman shall not be heir with the son of the freewoman.

\ln Nasgino idalinvtli, vtla atsinatlai ageyv tsuwetsi yigi ayv, natsinatlavnasgini.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᏥᎾᏝᎢ ᎠᎨᏴ ᏧᏪᏥ ᏱᎩ ᎠᏴ, ᎾᏥᎾᏝᎥᎾᏍᎩᏂ.
\ft So then, brethren, we are not children of the bondwoman, but of the free.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi ulinigidv detsidogesdi nasgi nahna nideginatlavna gesv Galonedv nigaginatlavna nigvnelvi, ale tlesdi taline tsietsigilanaladistani adanatlvvsgi agilanalo.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᏕᏥᏙᎨᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏀᎾ ᏂᏕᎩᎾᏝᎥᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏂᎦᎩᎾᏝᎥᎾ ᏂᎬᏁᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏔᎵᏁ ᏥᎡᏥᎩᎳᎾᎳᏗᏍᏔᏂ ᎠᏓᎾᏢᎥᏍᎩ ᎠᎩᎳᎾᎶ.
\ft Stand fast therefore in the liberty wherewith Christ hath made us free, and be not entangled again with the yoke of bondage.

\ln Gvniyuquo, ayv Quola hia nitsvweseha, nasgi iyuno yidetsiusdeselv, Galonedv vtla gohusdi yvgayetsalisdelvdoda.
\syll ᎬᏂᏳᏉ, ᎠᏴ ᏉᎳ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏃ ᏱᏕᏥᎤᏍᏕᏎᎸ, ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎥᏝ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏴᎦᏰᏣᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏓ.
\ft Behold, I Paul say unto you, that if ye be circumcised, Christ shall profit you nothing.

\ln Ale taline igatsiyoiyudaneha naniv nasgi digetsiusdeselvhi, nasgi anadudalvvsga nigadv dikahnawadvsdi nigawesgv iyunadvnehohvsdiyi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎢᎦᏥᏲᎢᏳᏓᏁᎭ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎨᏥᎤᏍᏕᏎᎸᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎾᏚᏓᎸᎥᏍᎦ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎬ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᏁᎰᎲᏍᏗᏱ.
\ft For I testify again to every man that is circumcised, that he is a debtor to do the whole law.

\ln Galonedv gohusdi gayetsalisdelvdodi nigesvna nigalisda, nihi dikahnawadvsdi itsadudalesdisgi; detsiyohi gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesvi.
\syll ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎦᏰᏣᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏓ, ᏂᎯ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎢᏣᏚᏓᎴᏍᏗᏍᎩ; ᏕᏥᏲᎯ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Christ is become of no effect unto you, whosoever of you are justified by the law; ye are fallen from grace.

\ln Ayvyeno Adanvdv iyuwanisadv idigatiyv udugi igvsv igadudalesdodiyi gohiyudi gesvi.
\syll ᎠᏴᏰᏃ ᎠᏓᏅᏛ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ ᎢᏗᎦᏘᏴ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎢᎬᏒ ᎢᎦᏚᏓᎴᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft For we through the Spirit wait for the hope of righteousness by faith.

\ln Galonedvyeno Tsisa utseli dikahnawadvsdi gesv ahusdesdi gesv vtla gohusdi gvdodi yigi, ale ahusdesdi nigesvna gesvi; gohiyudisgini gesv nasgi adageyudi gesv tsuwvdidiso dulvwisdanehvi.
\syll ᎦᎶᏁᏛᏰᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎱᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎥᏝ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎬᏙᏗ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎱᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎪᎯᏳᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏧᏮᏗᏗᏐ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎢ.
\ft For in Jesus Christ neither circumcision availeth anything, nor uncircumcision; but faith which worketh by love.

\ln Osiyu itsadogiyasgvgi; gago itsiyosdodanele, nasgi digetsikahnawadvsdi nigesvna nulistanv udohiyuhi gesvi?
\syll ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏣᏙᎩᏯᏍᎬᎩ; ᎦᎪ ᎢᏥᏲᏍᏙᏓᏁᎴ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎨᏥᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ?
\ft Ye did run well; who did hinder you that ye should not obey the truth?

\ln Hia nasgi etsisdiyetanvhi tsigi vtla itsiyanvdv udanvtelvhi yigi.
\syll ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᏥᏍᏗᏰᏔᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎥᏝ ᎢᏥᏯᏅᏛ ᎤᏓᏅᏖᎸᎯ ᏱᎩ.
\ft This persuasion cometh not of him that calleth you.

\ln Usdi agododi nigadv galv agodisgoi.
\syll ᎤᏍᏗ ᎠᎪᏙᏗ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎦᎸ ᎠᎪᏗᏍᎪᎢ.
\ft A little leaven leaveneth the whole lump.

\ln Ugvwiyuhi tsiyalisgasdodi, nihi itsehv Ugvwali nasgi utloyiquo iyulisdodiyi detsadanvdvi; nasgisgini na itsadeyadodisgi usdvdisdi gesesdi, unelagi gilo gagesesdi.
\syll ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏯᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏗ, ᏂᎯ ᎢᏤᎲ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏠᏱᏉ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏕᏣᏓᏅᏛᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ Ꮎ ᎢᏣᏕᏯᏙᏗᏍᎩ ᎤᏍᏛᏗᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎤᏁᎳᎩ ᎩᎶ ᎦᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft I have confidence in you through the Lord, that ye will be none otherwise minded: but he that troubleth you shall bear his judgment, whosoever he be.

\ln Ale ayv idalinvtli, iyuno ahusdesdi gesv asi yigalitsidohvsga, gadono asiquo uyo nivquvhnadega?  hnaquo ahvdv nigalisdiha didadodesdisgi gesv dadahnawasdvi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴ ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎠᎱᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏏ ᏱᎦᎵᏥᏙᎲᏍᎦ, ᎦᏙᏃ ᎠᏏᏉ ᎤᏲ ᏂᎥᏋᎿᏕᎦ?  ᎿᏉ ᎠᎲᏛ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᎭ ᏗᏓᏙᏕᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᎨᏒ ᏓᏓᎿᏩᏍᏛᎢ.
\ft And I, brethren, if I yet preach circumcision, why do I yet suffer persecution? then is the offence of the cross ceased.

\ln Osiyu yitsiyelvna nasquo yidigetsikahvsv getsadeyadodisgi tsigi.
\syll ᎣᏏᏳ ᏱᏥᏰᎸᎾ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏱᏗᎨᏥᎧᎲᏒ ᎨᏣᏕᏯᏙᏗᏍᎩ ᏥᎩ.
\ft I would they were even cut off which trouble you.

\ln Nihiyeno, idalinvtli, etsiyanvdv itsadatseli itsalisdodiyi; adina tlesdi nasgi itsadatseli gesv yitsvdisgesdi nasgi uquedali udulvhvvsgv itsadvnediyi tsitsilanvdadelo nasgiyai; adageyudisgini itsvdisgv osdv nidetsadadvnehesdi.
\syll ᏂᎯᏰᏃ, ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᎡᏥᏯᏅᏛ ᎢᏣᏓᏤᎵ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ; ᎠᏗᎾ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏣᏓᏤᎵ ᎨᏒ ᏱᏨᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎤᏚᎸᎲᎥᏍᎬ ᎢᏣᏛᏁᏗᏱ ᏥᏥᎳᏅᏓᏕᎶ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ; ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᏨᏗᏍᎬ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏂᏕᏣᏓᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ.
\ft For, brethren, ye have been called unto liberty; only use not liberty for an occasion to the flesh, but by love serve one another.

\ln Nigavyeno dikahnawadvsdi dulinetsv saquoquo ikanetsvhi akaliiha, hiaquo nasgi, Nav idisdadala higeyusesdi nasgiya tsvsv nitsadageyusvi.
\syll ᏂᎦᎥᏰᏃ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏚᎵᏁᏨ ᏌᏉᏉ ᎢᎧᏁᏨᎯ ᎠᎧᎵᎢᎭ, ᎯᎠᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ, ᎾᎥ ᎢᏗᏍᏓᏓᎳ ᎯᎨᏳᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏨᏒ ᏂᏣᏓᎨᏳᏒᎢ.
\ft For all the law is fulfilled in one word, even in this; Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.

\ln Iyusgini dotsadasgalogesdi ale dotsadayaohvsgesdi, itseyatahesdi tlesdi tsidotsadadvtani.
\syll ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᏙᏣᏓᏍᎦᎶᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏙᏣᏓᏯᎣᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎢᏤᏯᏔᎮᏍᏗ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏥᏙᏣᏓᏛᏔᏂ.
\ft But if ye bite and devour one another, take heed that ye be not consumed one of another.

\ln Nasgino hia nitsiweha, Adanvdogihi itsaisesdi, uquedalino ugvvsgv vtla yinigetsadvnehesdi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏥᏪᎭ, ᎠᏓᏅᏙᎩᎯ ᎢᏣᎢᏎᏍᏗ, ᎤᏇᏓᎵᏃ ᎤᎬᎥᏍᎬ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏂᎨᏣᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ.
\ft This I say then, Walk in the Spirit, and ye shall not fulfill the lust of the flesh.

\ln Uquedaliyeno udulisgv dagatilego Adanvdo, ale Adanvdo udulisgv dagatilego uquedali; nasgino hia dinadatludisgi nigalisdiha; nasgino nigalisdodiha nusdv itsadulisgv vtla yinvgetsadvga.
\syll ᎤᏇᏓᎵᏰᏃ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎬ ᏓᎦᏘᎴᎪ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎬ ᏓᎦᏘᎴᎪ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ; ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏗᎾᏓᏡᏗᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᎭ; ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎢᏣᏚᎵᏍᎬ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏅᎨᏣᏛᎦ.
\ft For the flesh lusteth against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh: and these are contrary the one to the other: so that ye cannot do the things that ye would.

\ln Adanvdosgini yiditsatinidoha, vtla dikahnawadvsdi ahv yigetsadudalv.
\syll ᎠᏓᏅᏙᏍᎩᏂ ᏱᏗᏣᏘᏂᏙᎭ, ᎥᏝ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎠᎲ ᏱᎨᏣᏚᏓᎸ.
\ft But if ye be led of the Spirit, ye are not under the law.

\ln Nasgino uquedali nusdv deulvwisdanehv gvnigesviyu; hia nasgi nusdi^Adayonedi gesvi, udelidv dinisidi gesvi, gadaha digalvwisdanedi gesvi, unegutsidv gesvi,
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏕᎤᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᎬᏂᎨᏒᎢᏳ; ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏗdata is invalidᎠᏓᏲᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᏗᏂᏏᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎦᏓᎭ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᏁᎫᏥᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ,
\ft Now the works of the flesh are manifest, which are these; Adultery, fornication, uncleanness, lasciviousness,

\ln Unelanvhi diyelvhi didadolisdanedi gesvi, adonvdi gesvi, adadaquisdi gesvi, didiyosdi gesvi, didadvyutsedi gesvi, atalawohisdi gesvi, didasohedi gesvi, tali iyadadisdi gesvi, unadatselidv gesvi,
\syll ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏗᏰᎸᎯ ᏗᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᏙᏅᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᏓᏓᏈᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏗᏗᏲᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏗᏓᏛᏳᏤᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᏔᎳᏬᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏗᏓᏐᎮᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏔᎵ ᎢᏯᏓᏗᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᎾᏓᏤᎵᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ,
\ft Idolatry, witchcraft, hatred, variance, emulations, wrath, strife, seditions, heresies,

\ln Advyugedi gesvi, didahisdi gesvi, udayvsdesdi gesvi, tsuniyvsdesgi tsunilawiisdi gesvi, ale nasgi iyusdidani; hia nasgi gayula nitsvnoneha, nasgiya nasquo itsvnonelvhi tsigi tsuwagutanvsvi, na nasgi iyanadvnehi vtla unatseli yinvgalisda Unelanvhi utseligohi.
\syll ᎠᏛᏳᎨᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏗᏓᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᏓᏴᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏧᏂᏴᏍᏕᏍᎩ ᏧᏂᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗᏓᏂ; ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏳᎳ ᏂᏨᏃᏁᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎢᏨᏃᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ ᏧᏩᎫᏔᏅᏒᎢ, Ꮎ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏯᎾᏛᏁᎯ ᎥᏝ ᎤᎾᏤᎵ ᏱᏅᎦᎵᏍᏓ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎪᎯ.
\ft Envyings, murders, drunkenness, revellings, and such like: of the which I tell you before, as I have also told you in time past, that they which do such things shall not inherit the kingdom of God.

\ln Adanvdosgini gananugowisga, adageyudi gesvi, ulihelisdi, nvwadohiyadv, gvnidiyu gesvi, udanvti gesvi, osdv gesvi, gohiyudi gesvi,
\syll ᎠᏓᏅᏙᏍᎩᏂ ᎦᎾᏄᎪᏫᏍᎦ, ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᎵᎮᎵᏍᏗ, ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ, ᎬᏂᏗᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᏓᏅᏘ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎣᏍᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ,
\ft But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness, goodness, faith,

\ln Udanvti gesvi, alisinahisdodi gesvi; nasgi iyusdidani digatilegi dikahnawadvsdi vtla yaha.
\syll ᎤᏓᏅᏘ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎵᏏᏀᎢᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗᏓᏂ ᏗᎦᏘᎴᎩ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎥᏝ ᏯᎭ.
\ft Meekness, temperance: against such there is no law.

\ln Nasgino na Galonedv tsutseliga tsigi dadahnawasdv unadvnv uquedali gesv gvwatloyasdi udulvhvdi gesv ale ugvvhisdi gesvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ Ꮎ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏧᏤᎵᎦ ᏥᎩ ᏓᏓᎿᏩᏍᏛ ᎤᎾᏛᏅ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏩᏠᏯᏍᏗ ᎤᏚᎸᎲᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎬᎥᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft And they that are Christ's have crucified the flesh with the affections and lusts.

\ln Iyuno Adanvdogihi idehesdi, nasquo Adanvdo degatinisv idaisesdi.
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᎠᏓᏅᏙᎩᎯ ᎢᏕᎮᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᏕᎦᏘᏂᏒ ᎢᏓᎢᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft If we live in the Spirit, let us also walk in the Spirit.

\ln Tlesdi yigadulisgesdi na galvquodiyu gesv gohusdi gvdodi nigesvna tsigi; [tlesdi] yididadahnalvsdisgesdi, ale yididadadvyutsehesdi.
\syll ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᎦᏚᎵᏍᎨᏍᏗ Ꮎ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎬᏙᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏥᎩ; ᏞᏍᏗdata is invalid ᏱᏗᏓᏓᎿᎸᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏱᏗᏓᏓᏛᏳᏤᎮᏍᏗ.
\ft Let us not be desirous of vain glory, provoking one another, envying one another.

\ln Idalinvtli, iyuno gilo yusegatselv yusganvtsv, nihi adanvdo ditsatinidohi etsiyanisodi gesesdi nasgi iyudvnelvhi udadolisdi itsadanvdvi, heyatahesdi tsvsv gesv yinvsegagi nihi nasquo yetsagoliya.
\syll ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᏳᏎᎦᏤᎸ ᏳᏍᎦᏅᏨ, ᏂᎯ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᏗᏣᏘᏂᏙᎯ ᎡᏥᏯᏂᏐᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏛᏁᎸᎯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏛᎢ, ᎮᏯᏔᎮᏍᏗ ᏨᏒ ᎨᏒ ᏱᏅᏎᎦᎩ ᏂᎯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏰᏣᎪᎵᏯ.
\ft Brethren, if a man be overtaken in a fault, ye which are spiritual, restore such an one in the spirit of meekness; considering thyself, lest thou also be tempted.

\ln Detsalinvwisdidegv detsadayvehesdi, nasgino nitsadvnehv itsikaliihesdi Galonedv utseli dikahnawadvsdi.
\syll ᏕᏣᎵᏅᏫᏍᏗᏕᎬ ᏕᏣᏓᏴᎡᎮᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎲ ᎢᏥᎧᎵᎢᎮᏍᏗ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ.
\ft Bear ye one another's burdens, and so fulfill the law of Christ.

\ln Iyuyeno gilo yeli gilo utselvsesdi, giloquono nigesvna igesesdi, uwasvquo yadalidasdiha.
\syll ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᎩᎶ ᏰᎵ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏤᎸᏎᏍᏗ, ᎩᎶᏉᏃ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎤᏩᏒᏉ ᏯᏓᎵᏓᏍᏗᎭ.
\ft For if a man think himself to be something, when he is nothing, he deceiveth himself.

\ln Aseno naniv gilo anigoliyesgesdi unvsv dunilvwisdanehvi, hnaquono unvsv gesv unihesdi unalihelisdodi, vtlano nvwanadale gesvi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎩᎶ ᎠᏂᎪᎵᏰᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᏅᏒ ᏚᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎢ, ᎿᏉᏃ ᎤᏅᏒ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏂᎮᏍᏗ ᎤᎾᎵᎮᎵᏍᏙᏗ, ᎥᏝᏃ ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft But let every man prove his own work, and then shall he have rejoicing in himself alone, and not in another.

\ln Nanivyeno unvsv dunalinvwisdidegv aniyehesdi.
\syll ᎾᏂᎥᏰᏃ ᎤᏅᏒ ᏚᎾᎵᏅᏫᏍᏗᏕᎬ ᎠᏂᏰᎮᏍᏗ.
\ft For every man shall bear his own burden.

\ln Nasgi na kanohedv ageyonvhi a'nehesdi nasgi na uweyohvsgi nudalesv osdv gesvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎠᎨᏲᏅᎯ ᎠᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᏪᏲᎲᏍᎩ ᏄᏓᎴᏒ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Let him that is taught in the word communicate unto him that teacheth in all good things.

\ln Tlesdi yitsilidastanesdi; vtla gayetsilonuedi yigi Unelanvhi; nusdvyeno gilo awisgvi, nasgi nasquo nusdesdi gatlisisgesdi.
\syll ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏥᎵᏓᏍᏔᏁᏍᏗ; ᎥᏝ ᎦᏰᏥᎶᏄᎡᏗ ᏱᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ; ᏄᏍᏛᏰᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎠᏫᏍᎬᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏄᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᎦᏟᏏᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
\ft Be not deceived; God is not mocked: for whatsoever a man soweth, that shall he also reap.

\ln Nasgiyeno na uwasv uquedali awisgesdi, nasgi uquedali unanugowisvhi ayogi gatlisisgesdi; nasgisgini na Adanvdogihi awisgesdi, nasgi Adanvdo unanugowisvhi gvnidv ulisquadisdi nigesvna gatlisisgesdi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ Ꮎ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎠᏫᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏫᏒᎯ ᎠᏲᎩ ᎦᏟᏏᏍᎨᏍᏗ; ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ Ꮎ ᎠᏓᏅᏙᎩᎯ ᎠᏫᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏫᏒᎯ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎦᏟᏏᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
\ft For he that soweth to his flesh shall of the flesh reap corruption; but he that soweth to the Spirit shall of the Spirit reap life everlasting.

\ln Ale tlesdi yidigiyawegesdi osdv degilvwisdanehvi; nahiyuyeno asqualvhvha igitlisodi gesesdi, iyuno nididiwanagalogvna igesesdi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏗᎩᏯᏪᎨᏍᏗ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏕᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎢ; ᏀᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᎠᏍᏆᎸᎲᎭ ᎢᎩᏟᏐᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᏂᏗᏗᏩᎾᎦᎶᎬᎾ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft And let us not be weary in well doing: for in due season we shall reap, if we faint not.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi yeli igegadvnedi didlanvdadisgesdi, naniv osdv nidedadvnehesdi, ho ugvwiyusesdi nasgi na anohiyuhvsgi sidanelvhi unadatlugvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏰᎵ ᎢᎨᎦᏛᏁᏗ ᏗᏜᏅᏓᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎾᏂᎥ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏂᏕᏓᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ, Ꮀ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᏏᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬᎢ.
\ft As we have therefore opportunity, let us do good unto all men, especially unto them who are of the household of faith.

\ln Itsigowatiha niganvhisv goweli itsvyowelanelvi, aquvsv aquoyeni aquvtanvhi.
\syll ᎢᏥᎪᏩᏘᎭ ᏂᎦᏅᎯᏒ ᎪᏪᎵ ᎢᏨᏲᏪᎳᏁᎸᎢ, ᎠᏋᏒ ᎠᏉᏰᏂ ᎠᏋᏔᏅᎯ.
\ft Ye see how large a letter I have written unto you with mine own hand.

\ln Naniv unadulisgi osdv iyulisdodiyi digegaganvdiyi uquedali gesvi, nasgi ase tsetsiusdesediyi nigetsvnehoi; nunadulisgvna gesv iyusdi getsigiliyoisdodiyi unisdvdisdiyi Galonedv utseli dadahnawasdvi.
\syll ᎾᏂᎥ ᎤᎾᏚᎵᏍᎩ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏗᎨᎦᎦᏅᏗᏱ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏎ ᏤᏥᎤᏍᏕᏎᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏨᏁᎰᎢ; ᏄᎾᏚᎵᏍᎬᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎨᏥᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᏂᏍᏛᏗᏍᏗᏱ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏓᏓᎿᏩᏍᏛᎢ.
\ft As many as desire to make a fair shew in the flesh, they constrain you to be circumcised; only lest they should suffer persecution for the cross of Christ.

\ln Vtlayeno nasquo unvsv nasgi digetsiusdeselvhi yunisquanigodi dikahnawadvsdi; nihisgini tsetsiusdesediyi unaduliha, nasgi itsiquedalv unatlvquisdiyi.
\syll ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᏅᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎨᏥᎤᏍᏕᏎᎸᎯ ᏳᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ; ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᏤᏥᎤᏍᏕᏎᏗᏱ ᎤᎾᏚᎵᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏥᏇᏓᎸ ᎤᎾᏢᏈᏍᏗᏱ.
\ft For neither they themselves who are circumcised keep the law; but desire to have you circumcised, that they may glory in your flesh.

\ln aseno gvwatlisdi gohusdi aquatlvquisdodiyi uwasvsgininonv dadahnawasdv igatseli Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv utseliga, nasgi tsinvdigalisdodiha, nasgi elohi dadahnawasdv agadvnvhi tsigi ayv gesv iditlv, ale ayv vquadvnvhi tsigi elohi gesv iditlv.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎬᏩᏟᏍᏗ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎠᏆᏢᏈᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᏩᏒᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᏓᏓᎿᏩᏍᏛ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏓᏓᎿᏩᏍᏛ ᎠᎦᏛᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎠᏴ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏗᏢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴ ᎥᏆᏛᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏗᏢ.
\ft But God forbid that I should glory, save in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, by whom the world is crucified unto me, and I unto the world.

\ln GalonedvyenoTsisa dinelododi gesv ahusdesdi gesv vtla gohusdi gvdodi yigi, ale ahusdesdi nigesvna gesvi; itsesgini iyagvnelvhi gesvi.
\syll ᎦᎶᏁᏛᏰᏃᏥᏌ ᏗᏁᎶᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎱᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎥᏝ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎬᏙᏗ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎱᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎢᏤᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᏯᎬᏁᎸᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision availeth anything, nor uncircumcision, but a new creature.

\ln Nanivno nasgi hia dikahnawadvsdi dinikahnawadegi, nvwadohiyadv ale udadolisdi gesv wuneladida, ale nasquo Isili Unelanvhi tsutseliga wuneladida.
\syll ᎾᏂᎥᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏗᏂᎧᎿᏩᏕᎩ, ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏭᏁᎳᏗᏓ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎢᏏᎵ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᏤᎵᎦ ᏭᏁᎳᏗᏓ.
\ft And as many as walk according to this rule, peace be on them, and mercy, and upon the Israel of God.

\ln Gohi iyudalenvdv tlesdi gilo yaquadeyadotanesdi; tsiyelvyeno daginelvha asolehohisdodi Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa tsiyatseli gesvi.
\syll ᎪᎯ ᎢᏳᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎩᎶ ᏯᏆᏕᏯᏙᏔᏁᏍᏗ; ᏥᏰᎸᏰᏃ ᏓᎩᏁᎸᎭ ᎠᏐᎴᎰᎯᏍᏙᏗ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᏥᏯᏤᎵ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft From henceforth let no man trouble me: for I bear in my body the marks of the Lord Jesus.

\ln Idalinvtli, gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv igatseli Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv dakahnawadidohesdi ditsadanvdo.  Emenv.
\syll ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏓᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎮᏍᏗ ᏗᏣᏓᏅᏙ.  ᎡᎺᏅ.
\ft Brethren, the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen.

\ln Quola, Tsisa Galonedv aginvsidv nasgiya Unelanvhi adanvtesgvi, witsvyowelasi itsadanvti Equisa itsehi, ale etsohiyuhvsgi Galonedv Tsisa,
\syll ᏉᎳ, ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎠᎩᏅᏏᏛ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬᎢ, ᏫᏨᏲᏪᎳᏏ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏘ ᎡᏈᏌ ᎢᏤᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎡᏦᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏥᏌ,
\ft Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, to the saints which are at Ephesus, and to the faithful in Christ Jesus:

\ln Gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv ale nvwadohiyadv itsatseli gesesdi nvdayunalisgolvtanvhi Unelanvhi Igidoda, ale Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv.
\syll ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᎢᏣᏤᎵ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏅᏓᏳᎾᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏅᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᎩᏙᏓ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ.
\ft Grace be to you, and peace, from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.

\ln Galvquododi gesesdi Unelanvhi ale Udoda Ugvwiyuhi igatseli Tsisa Galonedv, nasgi Galonedv iyuwanisanvhi osdv igadvnelvhi tsigi, iginelvhi nigav osdv gesv adanvdo ugvwali, nasgi tsudalenvdv tsosv ehi ugvwali.
\syll ᎦᎸᏉᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏙᏓ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏅᎯ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎢᎦᏛᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎢᎩᏁᎸᎯ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏦᏒ ᎡᎯ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ.
\ft Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who hath blessed us with all spiritual blessings in heavenly places in Christ:

\ln Nasgiya igasuyesv nasgi na agvdisgvi asi elohi nadotlvsgvna gesvi, nasgi nidisganvna igalisdodiyi, ale gohusdi neguisdvna iyulisdodiyi nasgi agatahv adageyudi gesv idvdisgvi;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎢᎦᏑᏰᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᎬᏗᏍᎬᎢ ᎠᏏ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎾᏙᏢᏍᎬᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᏗᏍᎦᏅᎾ ᎢᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏁᎫᎢᏍᏛᎾ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎦᏔᎲ ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏛᏗᏍᎬᎢ;
\ft According as he hath chosen us in him before the foundation of the world, that we should be holy and without blame before him in love:

\ln Nasgi nigasuyesoi tsuwetsi igvnediyi agvdisgv Tsisa Galonedv, nasgiya osiyu uyelvdi gesvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᏑᏰᏐᎢ ᏧᏪᏥ ᎢᎬᏁᏗᏱ ᎠᎬᏗᏍᎬ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎤᏰᎸᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Having predestinated us unto the adoption of children by Jesus Christ to himself, according to the good pleasure of his will,

\ln Nasgi iyuwanisodiyi galvquodiyu iyulisdodiyi gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesvi, nahna igidolitsvhi tsigi nasgi atsigeyui iyuwanisadv;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏐᏗᏱ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏀᎾ ᎢᎩᏙᎵᏨᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏥᎨᏳᎢ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ;
\ft To the praise of the glory of his grace, wherein he hath made us accepted in the beloved.

\ln Nasgi iyuwanisadv egaguyvdv tsigi ugigv gvtanvhi, egidolitsvhi igisganvtsvi, nasgiya nutsuquisdv gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesvi;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ ᎡᎦᎫᏴᏛ ᏥᎩ ᎤᎩᎬ ᎬᏔᏅᎯ, ᎡᎩᏙᎵᏨᎯ ᎢᎩᏍᎦᏅᏨᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᏧᏈᏍᏛ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ;
\ft In whom we have redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of sins, according to the riches of his grace;

\ln Nasgi utsati iginelvhi tsigi gvdisgv nigav agadohehisdi gesv ale alisinahisdodi gesvi;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎢᎩᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎬᏗᏍᎬ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎠᎦᏙᎮᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎵᏏᏀᎢᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ;
\ft Wherein he hath abounded toward us in all wisdom and prudence;

\ln Nasgi iginanugowiselvhi tsigi udelidv udanvtelvhi, nasgiya osiyu uyelvnvi, nasgi uwasv gesv udanvtelvhi gesvi;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎩᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᎤᏓᏅᏖᎸᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎤᏰᎸᏅᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏓᏅᏖᎸᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ;
\ft Having made known unto us the mystery of his will, according to his good pleasure which he hath purposed in himself:

\ln Nasgi nahiyu aselvhi gesv aliyeilolvha tsuwetlisodiyi saquo itsuwanediyi Galonedv tsuyohisedi galvlohi ale nasquo elohi tseha; nasgi tsuyohisedi,
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏀᎢᏳ ᎠᏎᎸᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎵᏰᎢᎶᎸᎭ ᏧᏪᏟᏐᏗᏱ ᏌᏉ ᎢᏧᏩᏁᏗᏱ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏧᏲᎯᏎᏗ ᎦᎸᎶᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏤᎭ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏲᎯᏎᏗ,
\ft That in the dispensation of the fullness of times he might gather together in one all things in Christ, both which are in heaven, and which are on earth; even in him:

\ln Nasgi nasquo tsinvdigalisdodi egalisgolvdanelvhi tsigi igatseli iyulisdodi gesvi, egasuyedv tsigi nasgiya nusdv udanvtelvi, nasgi na tsidulvwisdaneha nigav tsudalenvdv nasgiya uwasv udanvdv duwugotanilvi;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏥᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᎡᎦᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎡᎦᏑᏰᏛ ᏥᎩ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎤᏓᏅᏖᎸᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏥᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎭ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎤᏓᏅᏛ ᏚᏭᎪᏔᏂᎸᎢ;
\ft In whom also we have obtained an inheritance, being predestinated according to the purpose of him who worketh all things after the counsel of his own will:

\ln Nasgi ayv igvyiyi otsalisgasdotanvhi Galonedv iyogvnisodiyi galvquodiyu iyulisdodiyi atsilvquodiyu gesvi;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᎢᎬᏱᏱ ᎣᏣᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏔᏅᎯ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎢᏲᎬᏂᏐᏗᏱ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ;
\ft That we should be to the praise of his glory, who first trusted in Christ.

\ln Nasgi nihi nasquo [tsetsalisgasdotanvgi] hnaquo itsadvganv gayegogi nigesvna kanohedv, nasgi osdv kanohedv itsalisdelvdodi tsigi; nasgi nasquo etsoiyunv, hnaquo itsiyelvtanvgi Galvquodiyu Adanvdo nasgi aduistanvhi gesvi,
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏤᏣᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏔᏅᎩdata is invalid ᎿᏉ ᎢᏣᏛᎦᏅ ᎦᏰᎪᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ ᏥᎩ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎡᏦᎢᏳᏅ, ᎿᏉ ᎢᏥᏰᎸᏔᏅᎩ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏚᎢᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ,
\ft In whom ye also trusted, after that ye heard the word of truth, the gospel of your salvation: in whom also after that ye believed, ye were sealed with that holy Spirit of promise,

\ln Nasgi agatidisdodi tsigi igatseli iyulisdodi gesvi, gvni igatseliga nidvnelvha aguyvdv awasvhi igatseliga, nasgi galvquodiyu iyulisdodiyi atsilvquodiyu gesvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎦᏘᏗᏍᏙᏗ ᏥᎩ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎬᏂ ᎢᎦᏤᎵᎦ ᏂᏛᏁᎸᎭ ᎠᎫᏴᏛ ᎠᏩᏒᎯ ᎢᎦᏤᎵᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Which is the earnest of our inheritance until the redemption of the purchased possession, unto the praise of his glory.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi nasquo ayv aquadvganv etsoiyusv Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa, ale detsigeyusv naniv unadanvti,
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏴ ᎠᏆᏛᎦᏅ ᎡᏦᎢᏳᏒ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᏥᎨᏳᏒ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ,
\ft Wherefore I also, after I heard of your faith in the Lord Jesus, and love unto all the saints,

\ln Vtla yitsisuligogo [Unelanvhi] tsiyalielitsehv nihi nvdigalisdodisgvi, nihi itsvneisdisgv gadadolisdisgvi;
\syll ᎥᏝ ᏱᏥᏑᎵᎪᎪ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯdata is invalid ᏥᏯᎵᎡᎵᏤᎲ ᏂᎯ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᏂᎯ ᎢᏨᏁᎢᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᎦᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ;
\ft Cease not to give thanks for you, making mention of you in my prayers;

\ln Nasgi Unelanvhi, igatseli Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa galonedv utseliga, Agayvlige galvquodiyu tsigi, nasgi itsinediyi adanvdo agadovhisdodi ale adananugowisehi, nasgi uwasv etsigadovhisdiyi;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏥᏁᏗᏱ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎠᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏙᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏓᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎡᏥᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗᏱ;
\ft That the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of glory, may give unto you the spirit of wisdom and revelation in the knowledge of him:

\ln Nasgi na itsolisdodi gesv dakanviga tsetsadisdanediyi; nasgi itsigadovhisdiyi nusdv udugi gvdi gesv, nasgi udayanvdi gesvi, ale nigav galvquodiyu gesv unadanvti unatseli iyulisdodi gesv nasgi tsunedi tsigi,
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎢᏦᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏓᎧᏅᎢᎦ ᏤᏣᏗᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏥᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎬᏗ ᎨᏒ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏓᏯᏅᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ ᎤᎾᏤᎵ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏁᏗ ᏥᎩ,
\ft The eyes of your understanding being enlightened; that ye may know what is the hope of his calling, and what the riches of the glory of his inheritance in the saints,

\ln Ale nusdv wudagonadvdv equohiyu gesv ulunigvgv gvnigesv nigvnelv igohiyunvhi tsigi, nasgiya dulvwisdanehv utsatanvhi ulinigidv gesvi,
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏭᏓᎪᎾᏛᏛ ᎡᏉᎯᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎷᏂᎬᎬ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᎬᏁᎸ ᎢᎪᎯᏳᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᎤᏣᏔᏅᎯ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ,
\ft And what is the exceeding greatness of his power to usward who believe, according to the working of his mighty power,

\ln Nasgi Galonedv tsinudv'nelei uyohusv tsiduletanei, ale uwasv agatisiditlv tsuwekanei galvladi digesvi,
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏥᏄᏛᏁᎴᎢ ᎤᏲᎱᏒ ᏥᏚᎴᏔᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎠᎦᏘᏏᏗᏢ ᏧᏪᎧᏁᎢ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏗᎨᏒᎢ,
\ft Which he wrought in Christ, when he raised him from the dead, and set him at his own right hand in the heavenly places,

\ln Utli galvladiyu esgaquo naniv digeganelodi gesvi, ale ulinigidiyu gesvi, ale gegagenvyv gesvi, ale unigvwiyusedegi gesvi, ale naniv dunadoadisv digovhi tsigi, vtla aniquo uwasv gohi tsigi, nasquosgini nahnani asi uliyeilohisdi tsigi,
\syll ᎤᏟ ᎦᎸᎳᏗᏳ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏗᎨᎦᏁᎶᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎨᎦᎨᏅᏴ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᎬᏫᏳᏎᏕᎩ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏚᎾᏙᎠᏗᏒ ᏗᎪᎥᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᏂᏉ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎪᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᏀᎾᏂ ᎠᏏ ᎤᎵᏰᎢᎶᎯᏍᏗ ᏥᎩ,
\ft Far above all principality, and power, and might, and dominion, and every name that is named, not only in this world, but also in that which is to come:

\ln Ale nudalesv gohusdi dulasgv hawiniditlv tsiniduwanelv, ale nasgi ugvwiyusadegi tsinagvnelv nudalesv gohusdi tsunanelodi unadatlugv anehvi,
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏄᏓᎴᏒ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏚᎳᏍᎬ ᎭᏫᏂᏗᏢ ᏥᏂᏚᏩᏁᎸ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ ᏥᎾᎬᏁᎸ ᏄᏓᎴᏒ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬ ᎠᏁᎲᎢ,
\ft And hath put all things under his feet, and gave him to be the head over all things to the church,

\ln Nasgi ayeli tsigi, nasgi ukaliihi, nasgi uwasv nigadiyu nigvnadv akaliihi tsigi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏰᎵ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎧᎵᎢᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏂᎬᎾᏛ ᎠᎧᎵᎢᎯ ᏥᎩ.
\ft Which is his body, the fullness of him that filleth all in all.

\ln Nihino ditsiyohusvhi tsigesv utsatini nitsadvnelv ale itsisganvtsvi;^
\syll ᏂᎯᏃ ᏗᏥᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᏥᎨᏒ ᎤᏣᏘᏂ ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎸ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏥᏍᎦᏅᏨᎢ;data is invalid
\ft And you hath he quickened, who were dead in trespasses and sins;

\ln Nahnani tsuwagutanvsv itsedolvi nasgiya iyunadvnedi gesv elohv anehi, nasgiya [udulisgv] ganolesgv ehi egvwiyusadegi, nasgi adanvdo gohi gesv tsidulvwisdane dunadanvdv gohiyudi nigesvna gesv tsuwetsi;
\syll ᏀᎾᏂ ᏧᏩᎫᏔᏅᏒ ᎢᏤᏙᎸᎢ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎡᎶᎲ ᎠᏁᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎬdata is invalid ᎦᏃᎴᏍᎬ ᎡᎯ ᎡᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏥᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁ ᏚᎾᏓᏅᏛ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒ ᏧᏪᏥ;
\ft Wherein in time past ye walked according to the course of this world, according to the prince of the power of the air, the spirit that now worketh in the children of disobedience:

\ln Nasgi nasquo tsuwagutanvsv nidiv gedaligonehvgi nahna igiquedalv ugvvsgvi, ale uquedalv ale adanvtedi gesv unadulisgv nidadvnehvgi; ale digadenv nigasdv utalawohisdi gesv tsuwetsi gesvgi, nasgiyaquo anisoi nunasdvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏧᏩᎫᏔᏅᏒ ᏂᏗᎥ ᎨᏓᎵᎪᏁᎲᎩ ᏀᎾ ᎢᎩᏇᏓᎸ ᎤᎬᎥᏍᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏇᏓᎸ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏓᏅᏖᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎾᏚᎵᏍᎬ ᏂᏓᏛᏁᎲᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᏗᎦᏕᏅ ᏂᎦᏍᏛ ᎤᏔᎳᏬᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏧᏪᏥ ᎨᏒᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯᏉ ᎠᏂᏐᎢ ᏄᎾᏍᏛᎢ.
\ft Among whom also we all had our conversation in times past in the lusts of our flesh, fulfilling the desires of the flesh and of the mind; and were by nature the children of wrath, even as others.

\ln Aseno Unelanvhi uwehnaiyu tsigi udadolisdi gesvi, tsinvdigalisdodisge utsati udageyudi gesv tsuwatane ayv igigeyuhiyu tsinulistanei,
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏪᎿᎢᏳ ᏥᎩ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏥᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏧᏩᏔᏁ ᎠᏴ ᎢᎩᎨᏳᎯᏳ ᏥᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ,
\ft But God, who is rich in mercy, for his great love wherewith he loved us,

\ln Nasgi asganvisdi gesv digiyohusvhi tsigesvgi, igvnidv igatloyastanv Galonedv agvnidvi, (gvwagatiya nvdadolisdi gesv etsisdelvtanv;)
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᎦᏅᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏗᎩᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᏥᎨᏒᎩ, ᎢᎬᏂᏛ ᎢᎦᏠᏯᏍᏔᏅ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎠᎬᏂᏛᎢ, ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᏅᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎡᏥᏍᏕᎸᏔᏅ;
\ft Even when we were dead in sins, hath quickened us together with Christ, (by grace ye are saved;)

\ln Ale itsulaha degalehisotanv, ale itsulaha iganvdiyi nigvnelv galvladi digesv Galonedv Tsisa iyuwanisadv;
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᏕᎦᎴᎯᏐᏔᏅ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎢᎦᏅᏗᏱ ᏂᎬᏁᎸ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏗᎨᏒ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏥᏌ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ;
\ft And hath raised us up together, and made us sit together in heavenly places in Christ Jesus:

\ln Nasgi na wuwagudidisv gvnigesv iyuwanediyi nigav uwehnaiyu gesv gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesvi, nigav osdv nigadvnehv Galonedv Tsisa nvdayudalenvhi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏭᏩᎫᏗᏗᏒ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏩᏁᏗᏱ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎤᏪᎿᎢᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏂᎦᎥ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏂᎦᏛᏁᎲ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏥᏌ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ.
\ft That in the ages to come he might shew the exceeding riches of his grace in his kindness toward us through Christ Jesus.

\ln Gvwagatiyayeno udadolisdi gesv etsisdelvdotanvhi gohiyudi gesv gvtanvhi; ale nasgi vtla itsvsv gesv nvdayudalenvhi; Unelanvhi ulisgolvtanvhi;
\syll ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯᏰᏃ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎡᏥᏍᏕᎸᏙᏔᏅᎯ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏔᏅᎯ; ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎥᏝ ᎢᏨᏒ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ; ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏅᎯ;
\ft For by grace are ye saved through faith; and that not of yourselves: it is the gift of God:

\ln Vtla digalvwisdanedi gesv iyuwanisadv yigi, nasgi gilo utlvquisdiyi nigesvna iyulisdodiyi.
\syll ᎥᏝ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ ᏱᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏢᏈᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
\ft Not of works, lest any man should boast.

\ln Nasgiyeno ayv igotlvnvhi, Galonedv Tsisa iyuwanisadv egotlvnvhi osdv digilvwisdanediyi, Unelanvhi nasgi tsinigadvnvisdanetli nahna igedasdiyi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎠᏴ ᎢᎪᏢᏅᎯ, ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏥᏌ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ ᎡᎪᏢᏅᎯ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏗᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏂᎦᏛᏅᎢᏍᏓᏁᏟ ᏀᎾ ᎢᎨᏓᏍᏗᏱ.
\ft For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus unto good works, which God hath before ordained that we should walk in them.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi itsanvtesdi nasgi nihi tsuwagutanvsv ditsadalenvdv yvwi uquedali gesvi, nidigetsiusdeselvna getsoselvhi nasgi na digetsiusdeselvhi gegosehi tsigi, nasgi uquedalv digetsiusdeselvhi digoyi digvtanvhi;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏣᏅᏖᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎯ ᏧᏩᎫᏔᏅᏒ ᏗᏣᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏂᏗᎨᏥᎤᏍᏕᏎᎸᎾ ᎨᏦᏎᎸᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏗᎨᏥᎤᏍᏕᏎᎸᎯ ᎨᎪᏎᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏇᏓᎸ ᏗᎨᏥᎤᏍᏕᏎᎸᎯ ᏗᎪᏱ ᏗᎬᏔᏅᎯ;
\ft Wherefore remember, that ye being in time past Gentiles in the flesh, who are called Uncircumcision by that which is called the Circumcision in the flesh made by hands;

\ln Nasgi nahiyu tsigese Galonedv nitsehvna gesei, nitselvnaquo gese Isili ayeli unotlvsvi, ale itsigonela gese kanohedv datlohisdv aduisdvi, udugi nitsvsvna, ale Unelanvhi nitsehvna gese ani elohi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏀᎢᏳ ᏥᎨᏎ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏂᏤᎲᎾ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᏂᏤᎸᎾᏉ ᎨᏎ ᎢᏏᎵ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎤᏃᏢᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏥᎪᏁᎳ ᎨᏎ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏓᏠᎯᏍᏛ ᎠᏚᎢᏍᏛᎢ, ᎤᏚᎩ ᏂᏨᏒᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏂᏤᎲᎾ ᎨᏎ ᎠᏂ ᎡᎶᎯ.
\ft That at that time ye were without Christ, being aliens from the commonwealth of Israel, and strangers from the covenants of promise, having no hope, and without God in the world:

\ln Gohisgini tsigi, Galonedv Tsisa iyuwanisadv, nihi, invhiyu tsinitsadvhnadegvgi, nav detsatinolv gvtanvhi ugigv Galonedv.
\syll ᎪᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᏥᎩ, ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏥᏌ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ, ᏂᎯ, ᎢᏅᎯᏳ ᏥᏂᏣᏛᎿᏕᎬᎩ, ᎾᎥ ᏕᏣᏘᏃᎸ ᎬᏔᏅᎯ ᎤᎩᎬ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ.
\ft But now in Christ Jesus ye who sometimes were far off are made nigh by the blood of Christ.

\ln Igohisdanehiyeno nasgi, itsula saquoquo igvnelvhi, ale uyostanvhi igadadaledisgi asoyvi;
\syll ᎢᎪᎯᏍᏓᏁᎯᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ, ᎢᏧᎳ ᏌᏉᏉ ᎢᎬᏁᎸᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏲᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎢᎦᏓᏓᎴᏗᏍᎩ ᎠᏐᏴᎢ;
\ft For he is our peace, who hath made both one, and hath broken down the middle wall of partition between us;

\ln Uquedalv gvdisgv udvtanv didadasgagi igvnehi, nasgi yadvnv dikahnawadvsdi ulinetsvi tsudalenvdv iyadvnelidasdi gesvi; nasgi anitali gesv saquo itse yvwi uwotlvdiyi uwasv iyuwanisodiyi, nasgino dohi iyuwanediyi;
\syll ᎤᏇᏓᎸ ᎬᏗᏍᎬ ᎤᏛᏔᏅ ᏗᏓᏓᏍᎦᎩ ᎢᎬᏁᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏯᏛᏅ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎤᎵᏁᏨᎢ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᎵᏓᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᎨᏒ ᏌᏉ ᎢᏤ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏬᏢᏗᏱ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏐᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏙᎯ ᎢᏳᏩᏁᏗᏱ;
\ft Having abolished in his flesh the enmity, even the law of commandments contained in ordinances; for to make in himself of twain one new man, so making peace;

\ln Ale nasgi iyuwanisodiyi itsula saquo ayelv nunadvnv dohiyi iyunvnediyi Unelanvhi, dadahnawasdv uwvdodiyi, nasgi uwvtanv ulv danadasgagvi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏐᏗᏱ ᎢᏧᎳ ᏌᏉ ᎠᏰᎸ ᏄᎾᏛᏅ ᏙᎯᏱ ᎢᏳᏅᏁᏗᏱ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᏓᏓᎿᏩᏍᏛ ᎤᏮᏙᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏮᏔᏅ ᎤᎸ ᏓᎾᏓᏍᎦᎬᎢ.
\ft And that he might reconcile both unto God in one body by the cross, having slain the enmity thereby:

\ln Ale ulutsei ale ulitsidone itsinohihele nasgi dohi itsiwadvehi gesvi, nihi inv itsadvhnadegi, ale nasgi na nav iyunadvhnadegi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎤᎷᏤᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏥᏙᏁ ᎢᏥᏃᎯᎮᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏙᎯ ᎢᏥᏩᏛᎡᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏂᎯ ᎢᏅ ᎢᏣᏛᎿᏕᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎾᎥ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᎿᏕᎩ.
\ft And came and preached peace to you which were afar off, and to them that were nigh.

\ln Nasgiyeno iyuwanisadv ayv itsula, saquo Adanvdo gvdi, Agayvlige wigayedilutsedi nulistanv.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ ᎠᏴ ᎢᏧᎳ, ᏌᏉ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎬᏗ, ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᏫᎦᏰᏗᎷᏤᏗ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ.
\ft For through him we both have access by one Spirit unto the Father.

\ln Nasgino tsinusdi vtla hnaquo netsadale, ale itsedohiquo yigi, unadanvtisgini itsulaha itsehi, Unelanvhi gadatinav itela;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏥᏄᏍᏗ ᎥᏝ ᎿᏉ ᏁᏣᏓᎴ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏤᏙᎯᏉ ᏱᎩ, ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎢᏤᎯ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎦᏓᏘᎾᎥ ᎢᏖᎳ;
\ft Now therefore ye are no more strangers and foreigners, but fellowcitizens with the saints, and of the household of God;

\ln Etsanesgehvhi gesv etsitlanvhi getsinvsidv ale anadolehosgi etsigusdvtanvhi, Tsisa Galonedv uwasv nugvwiyusv unvsiyv a'nvhi nvya iyulistanvhi;
\syll ᎡᏣᏁᏍᎨᎲᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎡᏥᏝᏅᎯ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎡᏥᎫᏍᏛᏔᏅᎯ, ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎤᏅᏏᏴ ᎠᏅᎯ ᏅᏯ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏔᏅᎯ;
\ft And are built upon the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Jesus Christ himself being the chief corner stone;

\ln Nahnani nigv adanelv osdv didadoligi igvnelvhi, advsgoi galvquodi adanelv nigalisdisgo Ugvwiyuhiyi atlanvhi;
\syll ᏀᎾᏂ ᏂᎬ ᎠᏓᏁᎸ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏗᏓᏙᎵᎩ ᎢᎬᏁᎸᎯ, ᎠᏛᏍᎪᎢ ᎦᎸᏉᏗ ᎠᏓᏁᎸ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᏍᎪ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᏱ ᎠᏝᏅᎯ;
\ft In whom all the building fitly framed together groweth unto an holy temple in the Lord:

\ln Nahnani nasquo nihi tsetsadlastanvhi etsanesgehvhi etsitlanvhi, Unelanvhi uneladisdiyi Adanvdo gvdisgvi.
\syll ᏀᎾᏂ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏂᎯ ᏤᏣᏜᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎡᏣᏁᏍᎨᎲᎯ ᎡᏥᏝᏅᎯ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏗᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎬᏗᏍᎬᎢ.
\ft In whom ye also are builded together for an habitation of God through the Spirit.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi ayv Quola tsiyvgi Tsisa Galonedv agisdvdisgv vgiyvginvhi nihi gesv ditsadalenvdv nvdigalisdodisgvi^
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏴ ᏉᎳ ᏥᏴᎩ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎠᎩᏍᏛᏗᏍᎬ ᎥᎩᏴᎩᏅᎯ ᏂᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏗᏣᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬᎢdata is invalid
\ft For this cause I Paul, the prisoner of Jesus Christ for you Gentiles,

\ln Iyuno howa itsadvganvhi yigi Unelanvhi gvwagadiya udadolisdi gesv ayv vginelvi nahna digilvwisdanediyi nihi osdv itsvyadvnediyi;
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᎰᏩ ᎢᏣᏛᎦᏅᎯ ᏱᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎬᏩᎦᏗᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏴ ᎥᎩᏁᎸᎢ ᏀᎾ ᏗᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᏂᎯ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎢᏨᏯᏛᏁᏗᏱ;
\ft If ye have heard of the dispensation of the grace of God which is given me to youward:

\ln Nasgi gvnigesv nuwanelv aginanugowiselvgi udelidv gesvi, gayula ilvsgi ikanetsvhi gvdi tsitsvyowelanelv,
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏄᏩᏁᎸ ᎠᎩᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᎸᎩ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎦᏳᎳ ᎢᎸᏍᎩ ᎢᎧᏁᏨᎯ ᎬᏗ ᏥᏨᏲᏪᎳᏁᎸ,
\ft How that by revelation he made known unto me the mystery; (as I wrote afore in few words,

\ln Nasgi itsigoliyevha datsolisdotani goligv udelidv Galonedv utseliga;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏥᎪᎵᏰᎥᎭ ᏓᏦᎵᏍᏙᏔᏂ ᎪᎵᎬ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ;
\ft Whereby, when ye read, ye may understand my knowledge in the mystery of Christ)

\ln Nasgi tsuwegutanvsv vtla gvnigesv igegvnelvhi yigese yvwi tsunetsi, nasgiya gohi gvnigesv tsinigegvneha tsutseli getsilvquodi getsinvsidv ale anadolehosgi Adanvdo gvdi;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏪᎫᏔᏅᏒ ᎥᏝ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᎨᎬᏁᎸᎯ ᏱᎨᏎ ᏴᏫ ᏧᏁᏥ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎪᎯ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏥᏂᎨᎬᏁᎭ ᏧᏤᎵ ᎨᏥᎸᏉᏗ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎬᏗ;
\ft Which in other ages was not made known unto the sons of men, as it is now revealed unto his holy apostles and prophets by the Spirit;

\ln Nasgi (kanohesgi) tsunadalenvdv yvwi utloyiquo unatseli nigegvnehvi, ale nasgiquo ayeli anehi gesvi, ale Galonedv agvdisgv uduistanv Uneladisdisgvi, Osdv Kanohedv gvtanvhi gvnigesv igvnelvhi;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎧᏃᎮᏍᎩ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏠᏱᏉ ᎤᎾᏤᎵ ᏂᎨᎬᏁᎲᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩᏉ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎠᏁᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎠᎬᏗᏍᎬ ᎤᏚᎢᏍᏔᏅ ᎤᏁᎳᏗᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎬᏔᏅᎯ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᎬᏁᎸᎯ;
\ft That the Gentiles should be fellowheirs, and of the same body, and partakers of his promise in Christ by the gospel:

\ln Nasgi nahna ayv digilvwisdanehi ayvquvnelvhi tsigi, nasgiya Unelanvhi gvwagatiya udadolesdi gesv vqualisgolvdanelvhi tsigi gvwanulvdi nigesvna gesv ulinigidiyu gesv iyuwanisadv.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏀᎾ ᎠᏴ ᏗᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᎠᏴᏋᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎴᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎥᏆᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎬᏩᏄᎸᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ.
\ft Whereof I was made a minister, according to the gift of the grace of God given unto me by the effectual working of his power.

\ln Ayv wudagonadvdv aquasdikani tsigi naniv unadanvti gesv, hia nasgi gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv vginelv, nasgi ugvwalvgi aqualitsidodiyi tsunadalenvdv yvwi anehv gvgoliyedi nigesvna uwehnaiyu gesv Galonedv;
\syll ᎠᏴ ᏭᏓᎪᎾᏛᏛ ᎠᏆᏍᏗᎧᏂ ᏥᎩ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ ᎨᏒ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎥᎩᏁᎸ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎬᏩᎸᎩ ᎠᏆᎵᏥᏙᏗᏱ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᎠᏁᎲ ᎬᎪᎵᏰᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎤᏪᎿᎢᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ;
\ft Unto me, who am less than the least of all saints, is this grace given, that I should preach among the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ;

\ln Ale naniv yvwi gvnigesv igatsiyvnediyi nusdv nasgi udelidv gesvi, nasgi didalenisgv elohi nvdagvwadalenvdv gvsgalanvhi tsigi Unelanvhi ehvi, nasgi nigadiyu tsudalenvdv uwotlvnvnvhi tsigi Tsisa Galonedv agvdisgvi;
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏴᏫ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᎦᏥᏴᏁᏗᏱ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏓᎴᏂᏍᎬ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎬᏍᎦᎳᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎡᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎤᏬᏢᏅᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎠᎬᏗᏍᎬᎢ;
\ft And to make all men see what is the fellowship of the mystery, which from the beginning of the world hath been hid in God, who created all things by Jesus Christ:

\ln Ugvwalvgi nasgi gohi getsilvquodi gesv ale tsunalinigidv gesv galvladiyu degesadisvi, unigadovhisdiyi utsati iyudalegi agadovhisdodi gesv Unelanvhi, gegvdisgv tsunanetlidi unadatlugvi;
\syll ᎤᎬᏩᎸᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏥᎸᏉᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏧᎾᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎦᎸᎳᏗᏳ ᏕᎨᏌᏗᏒᎢ, ᎤᏂᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎢᏳᏓᎴᎩ ᎠᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎨᎬᏗᏍᎬ ᏧᎾᏁᏟᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬᎢ;
\ft To the intent that now unto the principalities and powers in heavenly places might be known by the church the manifold wisdom of God,

\ln Nasgiya nvtsudalenvhvna udanvtelvi, galonedv tsisa ugvwiyuhi igatseli tsagvdisge tsudanvtelei;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏅᏧᏓᎴᏅᎲᎾ ᎤᏓᏅᏖᎸᎢ, ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏥᏌ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᏣᎬᏗᏍᎨ ᏧᏓᏅᏖᎴᎢ;
\ft According to the eternal purpose which he purposed in Christ Jesus our Lord:

\ln Nasgi iyuwanisadv nidinayesgvna ale gayedilutsedi nulistanv tali udvdi edalisgasdodv nvdigalisdodiha nasgi edoiyusvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ ᏂᏗᎾᏰᏍᎬᎾ ᎠᎴ ᎦᏰᏗᎷᏤᏗ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ ᏔᎵ ᎤᏛᏗ ᎡᏓᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏛ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᏙᎢᏳᏒᎢ.
\ft In whom we have boldness and access with confidence by the faith of him.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi itsvtayoseha ditsiwanagaloisdiyiquo nigesvna ayv itsvgiliyotsehv iyusdi, nasgi galvquodiyu itsvnehi tsigi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏨᏔᏲᏎᎭ ᏗᏥᏩᎾᎦᎶᎢᏍᏗᏱᏉ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎠᏴ ᎢᏨᎩᎵᏲᏤᎲ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎢᏨᏁᎯ ᏥᎩ.
\ft Wherefore I desire that ye faint not at my tribulations for you, which is your glory.

\ln Nasgi nvdigalisdodiha detsiyaliniquanvneha Ugvwiyuhi igatseliga Tsisa Galonedv Udoda,
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᏕᏥᏯᎵᏂᏆᏅᏁᎭ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᎦᏤᎵᎦ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏙᏓ,
\ft For this cause I bow my knees unto the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ,

\ln Nasgi digegostanvhi tsigi naniv sidanelvhi gesvi, galvlo ale elohi anehi,
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎨᎪᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏏᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎦᎸᎶ ᎠᎴ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎠᏁᎯ,
\ft Of whom the whole family in heaven and earth is named,

\ln Nasgi itsalisgolvdanediyi, nasgiya uwehnaiyu gesv galvquodiyu gesv uhvi, nasgi utsati ditsalinigohisdodiyi detsadanvdvi Udanvdo uwvdodiyi;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎤᏪᎿᎢᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏗᏣᎵᏂᎪᎯᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏕᏣᏓᏅᏛᎢ ᎤᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᏮᏙᏗᏱ;
\ft That he would grant you, according to the riches of his glory, to be strengthened with might by his Spirit in the inner man;

\ln Nasgi Galonedv uneladisdiyi ditsinawiyi gohiyudi gvdodi gesvi; nasgi nihi adageyudi gesv ditsalinasdetladistanvhi ale ditsalisdayidistanvhi gesvi,
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏗᏍᏗᏱ ᏗᏥᎾᏫᏱ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎬᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎯ ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏗᏣᎵᎾᏍᏕᏝᏗᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏣᎵᏍᏓᏱᏗᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ,
\ft That Christ may dwell in your hearts by faith; that ye, being rooted and grounded in love,

\ln Nasgi nihi ale naniv unadanvti yeliquo getsolisdi iyulisdodiyi, nasgi nayadvvi ale niganvhisvi, ale nahawiniyvi, ale nigadvi;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ ᏰᎵᏉ ᎨᏦᎵᏍᏗ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏯᏛᎥᎢ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏅᎯᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏀᎠᏫᏂᏴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛᎢ;
\ft May be able to comprehend with all saints what is the breadth, and length, and depth, and height;

\ln Ale itsigadovhisdiyi Galonedv udageyudi gesvi, nasgi agadovhisdi gesv tsigalosvsdiha, nasgi etsikaliisdodiyi nasgi nigadv akalii Unelanvhi utseliga.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎢᏥᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏥᎦᎶᏒᏍᏗᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᏥᎧᎵᎢᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎠᎧᎵᎢ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ.
\ft And to know the love of Christ, which passeth knowledge, that ye might be filled with all the fullness of God.

\ln Nasgino na yeliquo igvwadvnedi tsigi, utsati ulosvsdi igai iditayohihvi, ale idadanvtesgvi, nasgiya utloyi ulinigidv gesv tsidulvwisdaneha ayv degadanvdvi,
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ Ꮎ ᏰᎵᏉ ᎢᎬᏩᏛᏁᏗ ᏥᎩ, ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᎶᏒᏍᏗ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎢᏗᏔᏲᎯᎲᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏓᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎤᏠᏱ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᎨᏒ ᏥᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎭ ᎠᏴ ᏕᎦᏓᏅᏛᎢ,
\ft Now unto him that is able to do exceeding abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that worketh in us,

\ln Nasgi gvwalvquododi gesesdi tsunanelodi unadatlugvi, Galonedv Tsisa iyuwanisadv, nigohilv degesadisvi, alisquadisgi nigesvna gesvi.  Emenv.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏩᎸᏉᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬᎢ, ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏥᏌ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ, ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᏕᎨᏌᏗᏒᎢ, ᎠᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.  ᎡᎺᏅ.
\ft Unto him be glory in the church by Christ Jesus throughout all ages, world without end. Amen.

\ln Nasgi nvdigalisdodiha ayv tsiyvgi Ugvwiyuhi agisdvdisgv vgiyvginvhi, itsvtayoseha itsalenidasdiyi nasgiya nusdv adayanvdodi gesv nasgi nihi etsiyanvtanvhi tsigi;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎠᏴ ᏥᏴᎩ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᎩᏍᏛᏗᏍᎬ ᎥᎩᏴᎩᏅᎯ, ᎢᏨᏔᏲᏎᎭ ᎢᏣᎴᏂᏓᏍᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎠᏓᏯᏅᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎯ ᎡᏥᏯᏅᏔᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ;
\ft I therefore, the prisoner of the Lord, beseech you that ye walk worthy of the vocation wherewith ye are called,

\ln Itsvdisgesdi utsati udadolisdi gesvi ale udanvti gesvi, ulitloyasdesdi gvnidiyu gesvi, ale unelagi didadelisedi gesv adageyudi gesv gvdi;
\syll ᎢᏨᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᏅᏘ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᎵᏠᏯᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᎬᏂᏗᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᎩ ᏗᏓᏕᎵᏎᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏗ;
\ft With all lowliness and meekness, with longsuffering, forbearing one another in love;

\ln Itsatlinigvnehesdi itsisquanigododiyi saquo nidetsvnv detsadanvdvi, nvwadohiyadv detsadaniyvdvi.
\syll ᎢᏣᏟᏂᎬᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᎢᏥᏍᏆᏂᎪᏙᏗᏱ ᏌᏉ ᏂᏕᏨᏅ ᏕᏣᏓᏅᏛᎢ, ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᏕᏣᏓᏂᏴᏛᎢ.
\ft Endeavouring to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace.

\ln Saquo [eha] ayelvi, ale saquo Adanvdo, nasgiya saquo udugi itsvdiyi etsiyanvdv tsigi, nasgi etsiyanvhv tsvdidalehvsga;
\syll ᏌᏉ ᎡᎭdata is invalid ᎠᏰᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏌᏉ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏌᏉ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎢᏨᏗᏱ ᎡᏥᏯᏅᏛ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᏥᏯᏅᎲ ᏨᏗᏓᎴᎲᏍᎦ;
\ft There is one body, and one Spirit, even as ye are called in one hope of your calling;

\ln Saquo Ugvwiyuhi, saquo gohiyudi gesvi, saquo didawosdi gesvi;
\syll ᏌᏉ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᏌᏉ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏌᏉ ᏗᏓᏬᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ;
\ft One Lord, one faith, one baptism,

\ln Saquo naniv Unanelanvhi ale Unidoda, nasgi naniv unatseli ugvwiyuhi, ale nigav degesadisv tsiduyelisidega, ale nihi nitsiv tsitsiyaa.
\syll ᏌᏉ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎤᎾᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏙᏓ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎤᎾᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏕᎨᏌᏗᏒ ᏥᏚᏰᎵᏏᏕᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎯ ᏂᏥᎥ ᏥᏥᏯᎠ.
\ft One God and Father of all, who is above all, and through all, and in you all.

\ln Aseno nidiv idisiyvwiha eginelv gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv nasgiya atlilov Galonedv udanedi gesvi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᏂᏗᎥ ᎢᏗᏏᏴᏫᎭ ᎡᎩᏁᎸ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎠᏟᎶᎥ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft But unto every one of us is given grace according to the measure of the gift of Christ.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi hia nigaweha, Nahiyu dulenvgalvladi wulosv, duyvgine digetsiyvginvhi, ale dunele yvwi udanedi gesvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᎭ, ᏀᎢᏳ ᏚᎴᏅᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏭᎶᏒ, ᏚᏴᎩᏁ ᏗᎨᏥᏴᎩᏅᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏁᎴ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Wherefore he saith, When he ascended up on high, he led captivity captive, and gave gifts unto men.

\ln Nasgino tsulenvhi tsadiha, gado gadvga, iyuno igvyiyi nasquo tsutloasv eladitlv degesadisv elohi ulutsv nigadvgvna yigi?
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏧᎴᏅᎯ ᏣᏗᎭ, ᎦᏙ ᎦᏛᎦ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎢᎬᏱᏱ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏧᏠᎠᏒ ᎡᎳᏗᏢ ᏕᎨᏌᏗᏒ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎤᎷᏨ ᏂᎦᏛᎬᎾ ᏱᎩ?
\ft (Now that he ascended, what is it but that he also descended first into the lower parts of the earth?

\ln Nasgi na tsvtsutloasei nasgiquo nasquo tsidulenei galvladitlv nigav galvloi degesadisv tsiwulutsei, nasgi tsukaliisdiyi nigav nudalesv gohusdi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏨᏧᏠᎠᏎᎢ ᎾᏍᎩᏉ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏥᏚᎴᏁᎢ ᎦᎸᎳᏗᏢ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎦᎸᎶᎢ ᏕᎨᏌᏗᏒ ᏥᏭᎷᏤᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᎧᎵᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏄᏓᎴᏒ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ.
\ft He that descended is the same also that ascended up far above all heavens, that he might fill all things.)

\ln Igadvno getsinvsidv duwekanei; igadvno, anadolehosgi; igadvno, analitsidonidohi; igadvno, dinigatiya ale dinadeyohvsgi;
\syll ᎢᎦᏛᏃ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏛ ᏚᏪᎧᏁᎢ; ᎢᎦᏛᏃ, ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ; ᎢᎦᏛᏃ, ᎠᎾᎵᏥᏙᏂᏙᎯ; ᎢᎦᏛᏃ, ᏗᏂᎦᏘᏯ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎾᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ;
\ft And he gave some, apostles; and some, prophets; and some, evangelists; and some, pastors and teachers;

\ln Nunigolvna igegvnediyi unadanvti, alitsidodi gesv tsunilvwisdanediyi, Galonedv ayelv unalinigohisdodiyi;
\syll ᏄᏂᎪᎸᎾ ᎢᎨᎬᏁᏗᏱ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ, ᎠᎵᏥᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ, ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎠᏰᎸ ᎤᎾᎵᏂᎪᎯᏍᏙᏗᏱ;
\ft For the perfecting of the saints, for the work of the ministry, for the edifying of the body of Christ:

\ln Gvni nidiv widiyilolvha saquo iyulisdodiyi Unelanvhi Uwetsi edohiyusvi ale edigatahvi^digadvnaya idisgaya igalisdodiyi^akalii atlilov Galonedv nigadv igalisdodiyi;
\syll ᎬᏂ ᏂᏗᎥ ᏫᏗᏱᎶᎸᎭ ᏌᏉ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎡᏙᎯᏳᏒᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎡᏗᎦᏔᎲᎢdata is invalidᏗᎦᏛᎾᏯ ᎢᏗᏍᎦᏯ ᎢᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱdata is invalidᎠᎧᎵᎢ ᎠᏟᎶᎥ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎢᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ;
\ft Till we all come in the unity of the faith, and of the knowledge of the Son of God, unto a perfect man, unto the measure of the stature of the fullness of Christ:

\ln Nasgi gohi iyudalenvdv hnaquo didiyoli nigesvna iyulisdodiyi, iginolvtanidasdiyi nigesvna nigavquo dideyodi gesv ganolvtanidohvi, unadalidasdiyu gesv yvwi, anisinasanv anigatiyv unadalonuhediyi;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᎯ ᎢᏳᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎿᏉ ᏗᏗᏲᎵ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎢᎩᏃᎸᏔᏂᏓᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏂᎦᎥᏉ ᏗᏕᏲᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎦᏃᎸᏔᏂᏙᎲᎢ, ᎤᎾᏓᎵᏓᏍᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᏴᏫ, ᎠᏂᏏᎾᏌᏅ ᎠᏂᎦᏘᏴ ᎤᎾᏓᎶᏄᎮᏗᏱ;
\ft That we henceforth be no more children, tossed to and fro, and carried about with every wind of doctrine, by the sleight of men, and cunning craftiness, whereby they lie in wait to deceive;

\ln Duyugodvsgini kaneisdi gesv idvdisgv adageyudi gesv tali idvdisgvi, digadvhisdiyi nasgi nigav nudalesv nasgi digadudadewisdiyi nasgi asgoli tsigi, nasgi Galonedv;
\syll ᏚᏳᎪᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᎧᏁᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏛᏗᏍᎬ ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏔᎵ ᎢᏛᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᏗᎦᏛᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏄᏓᎴᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎦᏚᏓᏕᏫᏍᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᎪᎵ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ;
\ft But speaking the truth in love, may grow up into him in all things, which is the head, even Christ:

\ln Nasgi gesv tsvdidalehvsga nigv ayelv osdv didoligi tsigi, ale tsidududadewisdi nigav duhitlvnav tsidulisdelvdodi, nasgiya atlilov tsulvwisdanediyi tsudatselidv degesadisvi, kanequosgo ayelvi, adalinigohisdisgo uwasv adageyudi gesvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᏒ ᏨᏗᏓᎴᎲᏍᎦ ᏂᎬ ᎠᏰᎸ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏗᏙᎵᎩ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᏚᏚᏓᏕᏫᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏚᎯᏢᎾᎥ ᏥᏚᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎠᏟᎶᎥ ᏧᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᏧᏓᏤᎵᏛ ᏕᎨᏌᏗᏒᎢ, ᎧᏁᏉᏍᎪ ᎠᏰᎸᎢ, ᎠᏓᎵᏂᎪᎯᏍᏗᏍᎪ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft From whom the whole body fitly joined together and compacted by that which every joint supplieth, according to the effectual working in the measure of every part, maketh increase of the body unto the edifying of itself in love.

\ln Nasgino hia nitsiweha, ale itsvnetseha Ugvwiyuhi dudov gvdiha, nasgi nihi gohi iyudalenvdv itsehv tlesdi anisoi tsunadalenvdv anehv nasgiya yinusdesdi, nasgi uneguhiyu gesv dunadanvdv anisdawadisvi,
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏥᏪᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏨᏁᏤᎭ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏚᏙᎥ ᎬᏗᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎯ ᎪᎯ ᎢᏳᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎢᏤᎲ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎠᏂᏐᎢ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎠᏁᎲ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏱᏄᏍᏕᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎫᎯᏳ ᎨᏒ ᏚᎾᏓᏅᏛ ᎠᏂᏍᏓᏩᏗᏒᎢ,
\ft This I say therefore, and testify in the Lord, that ye henceforth walk not as other Gentiles walk, in the vanity of their mind,

\ln Unolisdiyi tsunalisihvselvhi, unatledv nahna Unelanvhi osiyu uyelvdi gesv alenidasdiyi, nasgi nanigatanavna gesv iyuwanisadv, nvdigalisdodisgv tsuninawi disdayiyu gesvi.
\syll ᎤᏃᎵᏍᏗᏱ ᏧᎾᎵᏏᎲᏎᎸᎯ, ᎤᎾᏞᏛ ᏀᎾ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎤᏰᎸᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴᏂᏓᏍᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏂᎦᏔᎾᎥᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬ ᏧᏂᎾᏫ ᏗᏍᏓᏱᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Having the understanding darkened, being alienated from the life of God through the ignorance that is in them, because of the blindness of their heart:

\ln Nasgi gvwanadolehohisdi nigesvna iyunalistanvhi gesvi dunadayosv unalisotlvisdodiyi, nudalesv gadaha gesv tsunilvwisdanediyi tsugvwalodi unigvvsgv nvtsulisdotanv.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏩᎾᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ ᏚᎾᏓᏲᏒ ᎤᎾᎵᏐᏢᎢᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᏄᏓᎴᏒ ᎦᏓᎭ ᎨᏒ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎤᏂᎬᎥᏍᎬ ᏅᏧᎵᏍᏙᏔᏅ.
\ft Who being past feeling have given themselves over unto lasciviousness, to work all uncleanness with greediness.

\ln Nihisgini vtla nasgi yinusdi yetsadeloquaelv Galonedv,
\syll ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎥᏝ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᏄᏍᏗ ᏰᏣᏕᎶᏆᎡᎸ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ,
\ft But ye have not so learned Christ;

\ln Iyuno howa etsadvganelvhi gesesdi, ale nasgi itseyonvhi gesesdi, nasgiya nusdv duyugodv uwehv Tsisa;
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᎰᏩ ᎡᏣᏛᎦᏁᎸᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏤᏲᏅᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎤᏪᎲ ᏥᏌ;
\ft If so be that ye have heard him, and have been taught by him, as the truth is in Jesus:

\ln Nasgi nusdv igvyiyi itsalenidolv ugvwali iyvdv itsvnediyi uweti yvwi nasgi tsigi, nasgiya nusdv udalidasdi adulvnvdi gesvi;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎢᎬᏱᏱ ᎢᏣᎴᏂᏙᎸ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎢᏨᏁᏗᏱ ᎤᏪᏘ ᏴᏫ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎤᏓᎵᏓᏍᏗ ᎠᏚᎸᏅᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ;
\ft That ye put off concerning the former conversation the old man, which is corrupt according to the deceitful lusts;

\ln Ale itse itsetsvnediyi nusdv detsadanvdvi;
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎢᏤ ᎢᏤᏨᏁᏗᏱ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏕᏣᏓᏅᏛᎢ;
\ft And be renewed in the spirit of your mind;

\ln Ale nasgi itse yvwi itsanuwosdiyi, nasgi Unelanvhi ditlilostanvhi gotlvnvhi tsigi duyugodv iyadvnedi gesvi, ale udohiyusv asganvisdi nigesvna gesvi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏤ ᏴᏫ ᎢᏣᏄᏬᏍᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏗᏟᎶᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎪᏢᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᏒ ᎠᏍᎦᏅᎢᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft And that ye put on the new man, which after God is created in righteousness and true holiness.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi iyvdv nitsvnehv atsigodi gesvi, nitsiv itsisiyvwiha gesv gayegogi nigesvna itsvdisgesdi detsadanetsehv nav itsadala; degadudadewisvyeno.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏂᏨᏁᎲ ᎠᏥᎪᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏂᏥᎥ ᎢᏥᏏᏴᏫᎭ ᎨᏒ ᎦᏰᎪᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᏨᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏕᏣᏓᏁᏤᎲ ᎾᎥ ᎢᏣᏓᎳ; ᏕᎦᏚᏓᏕᏫᏒᏰᏃ.
\ft Wherefore putting away lying, speak every man truth with his neighbour: for we are members one of another.

\ln Itsitalawosgesdi, ale tlesdi yitsisganvgesdi; tlesdi nvdo wudelitsvgi getsitalawosgi;
\syll ᎢᏥᏔᎳᏬᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏥᏍᎦᏅᎨᏍᏗ; ᏞᏍᏗ ᏅᏙ ᏭᏕᎵᏨᎩ ᎨᏥᏔᎳᏬᏍᎩ;
\ft Be ye angry, and sin not: let not the sun go down upon your wrath:

\ln Ale tlesdi etsilanvdadelvgi asgina.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎡᏥᎳᏅᏓᏕᎸᎩ ᎠᏍᎩᎾ.
\ft Neither give place to the devil.

\ln Unosgidvno gesv tlesdi hnaquo yunosgisesdi; dulvwisdanehesdiquosgini degvdisgesdi tsuwoyeni osdv gesv nadvnehesdi, nasgi gagvwanedi iyulisdodiyi nasgi unigvsehi gesvi.
\syll ᎤᏃᏍᎩᏛᏃ ᎨᏒ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎿᏉ ᏳᏃᏍᎩᏎᏍᏗ; ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᏕᎬᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏧᏬᏰᏂ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎬᏩᏁᏗ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᎬᏎᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Let him that stole steal no more: but rather let him labour, working with his hands the thing which is good, that he may have to give to him that needeth.

\ln Tlesdi gohusdi uyo gawonihisdi gesv nvdayunugotsvgi ditsiholi, osdvsgini gesv uwasv nasgi gvwadalinigohisdodi tsigi, nasgi udulvdi gesvi, nasgi iyuwanisodiyi gvwagatia udadolisdi gesv unilutsediyi anadvgisgi.
\syll ᏞᏍᏗ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏲ ᎦᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏓᏳᏄᎪᏨᎩ ᏗᏥᎰᎵ, ᎣᏍᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏩᏓᎵᏂᎪᎯᏍᏙᏗ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏚᎸᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏐᏗᏱ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᎠ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏂᎷᏤᏗᏱ ᎠᎾᏛᎩᏍᎩ.
\ft Let no corrupt communication proceed out of your mouth, but that which is good to the use of edifying, that it may minister grace unto the hearers.

\ln Ale tlesdi uyo yetsadanvdadisdisgesdi Galvquodiyu Adanvdo Unelanvhi utseliga, nasgi itsiyelvtanvhi tsigi gvni nahiyu iga etsudalesdi gesv asqualvhvha.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎤᏲ ᏰᏣᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏥᏰᎸᏔᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎬᏂ ᏀᎢᏳ ᎢᎦ ᎡᏧᏓᎴᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏍᏆᎸᎲᎭ.
\ft And grieve not the holy Spirit of God, whereby ye are sealed unto the day of redemption.

\ln Nigav adaniquadisdi gesvi, ale atalawohisdi gesvi, ale kanalvisdi gesvi, ale asdaya gawonihisdi gesvi, ale uhnalvhi gawonihisdi gesvi, iyvdv igvnedi gesesdi itsehvi, ulitloyasdesdi nigav usonv gesvi;
\syll ᏂᎦᎥ ᎠᏓᏂᏆᏗᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏔᎳᏬᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎧᎾᎸᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏍᏓᏯ ᎦᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎿᎸᎯ ᎦᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎢᏴᏛ ᎢᎬᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎢᏤᎲᎢ, ᎤᎵᏠᏯᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎤᏐᏅ ᎨᏒᎢ;
\ft Let all bitterness, and wrath, and anger, and clamour, and evil speaking, be put away from you, with all malice:

\ln Ale ditsadageyuhiyu gesesdi, itsadadolisdi ditsinawiyi, detsadanehesdi detsadasganvtsehvi, nasgiya Unelanvhi tsigetsinelv itsisganvtsv Galonedv tsinvdigalisdodiha.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏗᏣᏓᎨᏳᎯᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎢᏣᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᏗᏥᎾᏫᏱ, ᏕᏣᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᏕᏣᏓᏍᎦᏅᏤᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏥᎨᏥᏁᎸ ᎢᏥᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏥᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ.
\ft And be ye kind one to another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another, even as God for Christ's sake hath forgiven you.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi Unelanvhi etsisdawadegi gesesdi nasgiya iyunadvnedi gesv tsugeyuhi tsuwetsi;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎡᏥᏍᏓᏩᏕᎩ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏧᎨᏳᎯ ᏧᏪᏥ;
\ft Be ye therefore followers of God, as dear children;

\ln Ale adageyudi gesv gvnigesv nitsvnehesdi itsehvi, nasgiya nasquo Galonedv igigeyuhiyu tsigesvgi, ale tsidegadayohiselvgi, alisgolvdanedi ale atsilv geledi tsinulistanv Unelanvhi uganasdv uwewasvisdi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᏨᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᎢᏤᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎢᎩᎨᏳᎯᏳ ᏥᎨᏒᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᏕᎦᏓᏲᎯᏎᎸᎩ, ᎠᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏥᎸ ᎨᎴᏗ ᏥᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎦᎾᏍᏛ ᎤᏪᏩᏒᎢᏍᏗ.
\ft And walk in love, as Christ also hath loved us, and hath given himself for us an offering and a sacrifice to God for a sweet smelling savour.

\ln Edelidvsgini dinisidi gesvi, ale nudalesvquo gadaha gesvi, ale tsugvwalodi agvvhisdi gesvi, tlesdi kaneisdodi unv yigesesdi itsehvi, nasgi tsunililohvsga unadanvti;
\syll ᎡᏕᎵᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᏗᏂᏏᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏄᏓᎴᏒᏉ ᎦᏓᎭ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎠᎬᎥᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᎧᏁᎢᏍᏙᏗ ᎤᏅ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎢᏤᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏂᎵᎶᎲᏍᎦ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ;
\ft But fornication, and all uncleanness, or covetousness, let it not be once named among you, as becometh saints;

\ln Tlesdi ale gohusdi uneilvdi gesvi, ale alisganedv gawonihisdi gesvi, ale gawetlvdi gesvi, nasgi nosvna tsigi; alihelitsediyiquosgini [Unelanvhi] ugvwiyusesdi.
\syll ᏞᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎢᎸᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎵᏍᎦᏁᏛ ᎦᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᏪᏢᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏃᏒᎾ ᏥᎩ; ᎠᎵᎮᎵᏤᏗᏱᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯdata is invalid ᎤᎬᏫᏳᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft Neither filthiness, nor foolish talking, nor jesting, which are not convenient: but rather giving of thanks.

\ln Hiayeno nasgi itsigataha, nasgi gilo udelidv dinisihvsgi, ale agadahai, ale tsugvwalodi ugvvsgi, nasgi Unelanvhi ayelvhi adadolisdanehi gesvi, utseli iyulisdodi nigesvna gesv Galonedv utseligohi ale Unelanvhi utseligohi.
\syll ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᏗᏂᏏᎲᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎦᏓᎭᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎤᎬᎥᏍᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᏰᎸᎯ ᎠᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᏤᎵ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏤᎵᎪᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎪᎯ.
\ft For this ye know, that no whoremonger, nor unclean person, nor covetous man, who is an idolater, hath any inheritance in the kingdom of Christ and of God.

\ln Tlesdi gilo itsilonuhetanvgi gohusdi gvdodi nigesvna gawonihisdi gesvi; nasgiyeno hia nvdigalisdodiha unelanvhi utalawohisdi gesv unilutseha gohiyudi nigesvna gesv tsuwetsi.
\syll ᏞᏍᏗ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏥᎶᏄᎮᏔᏅᎩ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎬᏙᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎦᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏔᎳᏬᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏂᎷᏤᎭ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒ ᏧᏪᏥ.
\ft Let no man deceive you with vain words: for because of these things cometh the wrath of God upon the children of disobedience.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi tlesdi nihi yitsatloyasdisgesdi unaliwadvehvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏂᎯ ᏱᏣᏠᏯᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᎾᎵᏩᏛᎡᎲᎢ.
\ft Be not ye therefore partakers with them.

\ln Ilvhiyuyeno tsigesv ulisigv itsehvgi, gohisgini gesv igagadv itseha Ugvwiyuhi iyuwanisadv; igagadv tsuwetsi unedasdi gesv itsedohesdi;
\syll ᎢᎸᎯᏳᏰᏃ ᏥᎨᏒ ᎤᎵᏏᎬ ᎢᏤᎲᎩ, ᎪᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏒ ᎢᎦᎦᏛ ᎢᏤᎭ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ; ᎢᎦᎦᏛ ᏧᏪᏥ ᎤᏁᏓᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏤᏙᎮᏍᏗ;
\ft For ye were sometimes darkness, but now are ye light in the Lord: walk as children of light:

\ln (Adanvdoyeno gananugowisgo nigav osdv gesv ale duyugodv gesv ale gayegogi nigesvna gesvi,)
\syll ᎠᏓᏅᏙᏰᏃ ᎦᎾᏄᎪᏫᏍᎪ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎦᏰᎪᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ,
\ft (For the fruit of the Spirit is in all goodness and righteousness and truth;)

\ln Itsigoliyesgesdi nasgi osiyu uyelvdi gesv Ugvwiyuhi.
\syll ᎢᏥᎪᎵᏰᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎤᏰᎸᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ.
\ft Proving what is acceptable unto the Lord.

\ln Ale tlesdi yiditsaligonehesdi nasgi gohusdi gvdodi nigesvna ulisigi digalvwisdanedi gesvi, detsigvsgolvvsgesdiquosgini.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏗᏣᎵᎪᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎬᏙᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎤᎵᏏᎩ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏕᏥᎬᏍᎪᎸᎥᏍᎨᏍᏗᏉᏍᎩᏂ.
\ft And have no fellowship with the unfruitful works of darkness, but rather reprove them.

\ln Udehohisdiyuyeno kaneisdodiyiquo nasquo nasgi na nanadvnehv udelisvi.
\syll ᎤᏕᎰᎯᏍᏗᏳᏰᏃ ᎧᏁᎢᏍᏙᏗᏱᏉ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎾᎾᏛᏁᎲ ᎤᏕᎵᏒᎢ.
\ft For it is a shame even to speak of those things which are done of them in secret.

\ln Nigavsgini tsudalenvdv digvsgolvnvhi tsigeso igagati gvdi gvnigee idigvnelvhi gesoi; nasgiyeno gvnigesv idigvnehi gesv nasgi igagati.
\syll ᏂᎦᎥᏍᎩᏂ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏗᎬᏍᎪᎸᏅᎯ ᏥᎨᏐ ᎢᎦᎦᏘ ᎬᏗ ᎬᏂᎨᎡ ᎢᏗᎬᏁᎸᎯ ᎨᏐᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏗᎬᏁᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎦᎦᏘ.
\ft But all things that are reproved are made manifest by the light: for whatsoever doth make manifest is light.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi hia nigaweha, Hiyegi nihi hilihi, ale talehvga giyadanvsi tsuniyohusvhi giyadasuyvi, Galonedvno datsaneli igagati.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᎭ, ᎯᏰᎩ ᏂᎯ ᎯᎵᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏔᎴᎲᎦ ᎩᏯᏓᏅᏏ ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᎩᏯᏓᏑᏴᎢ, ᎦᎶᏁᏛᏃ ᏓᏣᏁᎵ ᎢᎦᎦᏘ.
\ft Wherefore he saith, Awake thou that sleepest, and arise from the dead, and Christ shall give thee light.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi itsagasayasdesdi nigav duyugodv itsalenidasdiyi, tlesdi uninegu iyunadvnedi, anigatanaisgini iyunadvnedi,
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏣᎦᏌᏯᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎢᏣᎴᏂᏓᏍᏗᏱ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᎤᏂᏁᎫ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᏁᏗ, ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎾᎢᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᏁᏗ,
\ft See then that ye walk circumspectly, not as fools, but as wise,

\ln Itsudalesgesdi gohi gesv aliyilisvi, nvdigalisdodisgesdi uyoiyu gesv gohi gesvi.
\syll ᎢᏧᏓᎴᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎵᏱᎵᏒᎢ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᏲᎢᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Redeeming the time, because the days are evil.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi tlesdi nitsoligvna yigesesdi, itsoligisgini gesesdi nusdv udulisgv Nvgvwiyuhi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏂᏦᎵᎬᎾ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎢᏦᎵᎩᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎬ ᏅᎬᏫᏳᎯ.
\ft Wherefore be ye not unwise, but understanding what the will of the Lord is.

\ln Nasgi tlesdi gigage aditasdi yiditsiyvsdesdisgesdi nasgi utsati uyoiyu tsigi; Adanvdosgini itsikaliwohi gesesdi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎩᎦᎨ ᎠᏗᏔᏍᏗ ᏱᏗᏥᏴᏍᏕᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᏲᎢᏳ ᏥᎩ; ᎠᏓᏅᏙᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᏥᎧᎵᏬᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft And be not drunk with wine, wherein is excess; but be filled with the Spirit;

\ln Detsalinohesgesdi detsvdisgesdi Unelanvhi dikanogisdodi, ale galvquododi dikanogisdi, ale adanvdo ugvwali dikanogisdi, detsinogisgesdi doditsadanvdv didalehvsgesdi Ugvwiyuhi detsinogisdisgesdi.
\syll ᏕᏣᎵᏃᎮᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏕᏨᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏗᎧᏃᎩᏍᏙᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᎸᏉᏙᏗ ᏗᎧᏃᎩᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᏗᎧᏃᎩᏍᏗ, ᏕᏥᏃᎩᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏙᏗᏣᏓᏅᏛ ᏗᏓᎴᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏕᏥᏃᎩᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
\ft Speaking to yourselves in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing and making melody in your heart to the Lord;

\ln Etsalielitsehesdi nigohilv Unelanvhi ale Agayvligei nvdigalisdodisgesdi nigav gohusdi ugvwali, itsvdisgesdi dudov Ugvwiyuhi igatseli Tsisa Galonedv;
\syll ᎡᏣᎵᎡᎵᏤᎮᏍᏗ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ, ᎢᏨᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏚᏙᎥ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ;
\ft Giving thanks always for all things unto God and the Father in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ;

\ln Detsadadohiyuhvsgesdi itsisiyvwiha gesv Unelanvhi etsinayesgvi.
\syll ᏕᏣᏓᏙᎯᏳᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎢᏥᏏᏴᏫᎭ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎡᏥᎾᏰᏍᎬᎢ.
\ft Submitting yourselves one to another in the fear of God.

\ln Itsigeyv, itsvsv digetsiyehi detsohiyusesdi, Ugvwiyuhi gohiyudi tsigi nasgiyai.
\syll ᎢᏥᎨᏴ, ᎢᏨᏒ ᏗᎨᏥᏰᎯ ᏕᏦᎯᏳᏎᏍᏗ, ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᏥᎩ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ.
\ft Wives, submit yourselves unto your own husbands, as unto the Lord.

\ln Asgayayeno nugvwiyusadegi udalii ehvi, nasgiya Galonedv nugvwiyusadegi tsigi tsunanelodi unadatlugv anehvi; ale nasgi Asdelisgi ayelvi.
\syll ᎠᏍᎦᏯᏰᏃ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ ᎤᏓᎵᎢ ᎡᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ ᏥᎩ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬ ᎠᏁᎲᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᏕᎵᏍᎩ ᎠᏰᎸᎢ.
\ft For the husband is the head of the wife, even as Christ is the head of the church: and he is the saviour of the body.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi tsunanelodi unadatlugv Galonedv gvwohiyudi tsigi, nasgiya anigeyv digvwaniyehi tsunohiyudi nigav [nigvwaniwesehvi.]
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎬᏬᎯᏳᏗ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎠᏂᎨᏴ ᏗᎬᏩᏂᏰᎯ ᏧᏃᎯᏳᏗ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏂᎬᏩᏂᏪᏎᎲᎢ.data is invalid
\ft Therefore as the church is subject unto Christ, so let the wives be to their own husbands in every thing.

\ln Itsisgaya, detsigeyusesdi ditsadalii, nasgiya Galonedv nasquo tsugeyuse tsunanelodi unadatlugvi, ale nasgi dasdelisgv uwasv tsidudayosei,
\syll ᎢᏥᏍᎦᏯ, ᏕᏥᎨᏳᏎᏍᏗ ᏗᏣᏓᎵᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏧᎨᏳᏎ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏓᏍᏕᎵᏍᎬ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏥᏚᏓᏲᏎᎢ,
\ft Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the church, and gave himself for it;

\ln Nasgi nasganvna iyuwanediyi ganvgalisgvi kanohedv gvdisgvi ama tsigosuledisgo nasgiyai.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᎦᏅᎾ ᎢᏳᏩᏁᏗᏱ ᎦᏅᎦᎵᏍᎬᎢ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎬᏗᏍᎬᎢ ᎠᎹ ᏥᎪᏑᎴᏗᏍᎪ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ.
\ft That he might sanctify and cleanse it with the washing of water by the word,

\ln Nasgi uwasv agatahv uwegodiyi digvwalvsadv tsunanelodi unadatlugvi, nuduyasdvna, ale nudanegoyusvna, ale nigav gohusdi nasgi iyusdi nudadalvna; nasganvnasgini iyulisdodiyi ale gohusdi naguisdvna.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎠᎦᏔᎲ ᎤᏪᎪᏗᏱ ᏗᎬᏩᎸᏌᏛ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬᎢ, ᏄᏚᏯᏍᏛᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᏄᏓᏁᎪᏳᏒᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏄᏓᏓᎸᎾ; ᎾᏍᎦᏅᎾᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎾᎫᎢᏍᏛᎾ.
\ft That he might present it to himself a glorious church, not having spot, or wrinkle, or any such thing; but that it should be holy and without blemish.

\ln Nasgiya anisgaya unvsv diniyelv nidunigeyusv nasgiya yinidunigeyuha tsunadalii.  Gilo udalii tsugeyuso uwasv udageyusoi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᏅᏒ ᏗᏂᏰᎸ ᏂᏚᏂᎨᏳᏒ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏱᏂᏚᏂᎨᏳᎭ ᏧᎾᏓᎵᎢ.  ᎩᎶ ᎤᏓᎵᎢ ᏧᎨᏳᏐ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎤᏓᎨᏳᏐᎢ.
\ft So ought men to love their wives as their own bodies. He that loveth his wife loveth himself.

\ln Vtlayeno gilo asi ilvhiyu yuniquatilo uwasv uquedalvi; gelohosgini ale asquanigodisgoi, nasgiya Ugvwiyuhi nidadvnehv tsunanelodi unadatlugvi;
\syll ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎠᏏ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᏳᏂᏆᏘᎶ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎤᏇᏓᎸᎢ; ᎨᎶᎰᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗᏍᎪᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏂᏓᏛᏁᎲ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬᎢ;
\ft For no man ever yet hated his own flesh; but nourisheth and cherisheth it, even as the Lord the church:

\ln Ayvyeno nasgi ayelv degadudata, nasgi uquedalv ale nasgi tsugola.
\syll ᎠᏴᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏰᎸ ᏕᎦᏚᏓᏔ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏇᏓᎸ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᎪᎳ.
\ft For we are members of his body, of his flesh, and of his bones.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi asgaya degvdegesdi udoda ale utsi, adlawasdisgesdino udalii, nasgino anitali saquoquo gesesdi uniquedalvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᏕᎬᏕᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᏙᏓ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏥ, ᎠᏜᏩᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗᏃ ᎤᏓᎵᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᏌᏉᏉ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᏂᏇᏓᎸᎢ.
\ft For this cause shall a man leave his father and mother, and shall be joined unto his wife, and they two shall be one flesh.

\ln Hia nasgi utsati udelidiyu; aseno Galonedv ale tsunanelodi unadatlugv gatsineisdiha.
\syll ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᏕᎵᏗᏳ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎠᎴ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬ ᎦᏥᏁᎢᏍᏗᎭ.
\ft This is a great mystery: but I speak concerning Christ and the church.

\ln Adina nitsiv itsisiyvwiha gesv howa detsigeyusesdi ditsadalii nasgiya itsvsv nitsadageyusvi; ageyvno ulvquodiyu gesesdi uyehi.
\syll ᎠᏗᎾ ᏂᏥᎥ ᎢᏥᏏᏴᏫᎭ ᎨᏒ ᎰᏩ ᏕᏥᎨᏳᏎᏍᏗ ᏗᏣᏓᎵᎢ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎢᏨᏒ ᏂᏣᏓᎨᏳᏒᎢ; ᎠᎨᏴᏃ ᎤᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᏰᎯ.
\ft Nevertheless let every one of you in particular so love his wife even as himself; and the wife see that she reverence her husband.

\ln Ditsiyoli, detsohiyusesdi ditsigayvligei Ugvwiyuhi gesv nvdigalisdodisgesdi; duyugodiyeno nasgi hia.
\syll ᏗᏥᏲᎵ, ᏕᏦᎯᏳᏎᏍᏗ ᏗᏥᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ; ᏚᏳᎪᏗᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ.
\ft Children, obey your parents in the Lord: for this is right.

\ln Hilvquodesdi tsadoda ale tsatsi, nasgi igvyiyi ulinetsv tsigi tsulitloyasdi aduisdvi,
\syll ᎯᎸᏉᏕᏍᏗ ᏣᏙᏓ ᎠᎴ ᏣᏥ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎬᏱᏱ ᎤᎵᏁᏨ ᏥᎩ ᏧᎵᏠᏯᏍᏗ ᎠᏚᎢᏍᏛᎢ,
\ft Honour thy father and mother; (which is the first commandment with promise;)

\ln Nasgi osiyu igetsalisdanedi yigi, ale gohidiyu getsalenidasdi yigi elohi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᎨᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎪᎯᏗᏳ ᎨᏣᎴᏂᏓᏍᏗ ᏱᎩ ᎡᎶᎯ.
\ft That it may be well with thee, and thou mayest live long on the earth.

\ln Ale nihi itsigayvligei, tlesdi yiditsihnalvsdisgesdi ditsetsi; detsadvhisdisgesdisgini Ugvwiyuhi utseli dideyodi gesv ale geyadovhisdi gesvi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏥᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏗᏥᎿᎸᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏗᏤᏥ; ᏕᏣᏛᎯᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏗᏕᏲᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎨᏯᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft And, ye fathers, provoke not your children to wrath: but bring them up in the nurture and admonition of the Lord.

\ln Etsinvsidasdi, detsohiyusesdi nasgi getsinvsidohi ani uquedali, gesvi, itsinayesgesdi ale detsinawisgesdi, osiyu itsiyelvhi gesesdi ditsinawiyi, Galonedv tsinetsadvneho nasgiyai.
\syll ᎡᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ, ᏕᏦᎯᏳᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏙᎯ ᎠᏂ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ, ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎢᏥᎾᏰᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏕᏥᎾᏫᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏥᏰᎸᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏗᏥᎾᏫᏱ, ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏥᏁᏣᏛᏁᎰ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ.
\ft Servants, be obedient to them that are your masters according to the flesh, with fear and trembling, in singleness of your heart, as unto Christ;

\ln Vtla tsidvdadikano iyusdi, yvwiquo osiyu uniyelvdi; Galonedvsgini tsunvsidasdi iyunadvnedi, Unelanvhi osiyu uyelvdi nitsadvnehvi, ditsinawiyi tsvdidalehvsgoi;
\syll ᎥᏝ ᏥᏛᏓᏗᎧᏃ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᏴᏫᏉ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎤᏂᏰᎸᏗ; ᎦᎶᏁᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᏧᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᏁᏗ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎤᏰᎸᏗ ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎲᎢ, ᏗᏥᎾᏫᏱ ᏨᏗᏓᎴᎲᏍᎪᎢ;
\ft Not with eyeservice, as menpleasers; but as the servants of Christ, doing the will of God from the heart;

\ln Osiyu itsiyelvhi gohusdi itsadvnehv, Ugvwiyuhi tsinetsadvneho nasgiyai, vtlano yvwiquo tsinidetsadvneho nasgiyai;
\syll ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏥᏰᎸᎯ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎢᏣᏛᏁᎲ, ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏁᏣᏛᏁᎰ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ, ᎥᏝᏃ ᏴᏫᏉ ᏥᏂᏕᏣᏛᏁᎰ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ;
\ft With good will doing service, as to the Lord, and not to men:

\ln Itsigatahv nasgi nigav gohusdi osdv dulvwisdanehv giloi, nasgiya iyusdi unedi gesv Ugvwiyuhi, nasquo atsinatlai yigi, ale natsinatlavna yigi.
\syll ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎲ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᎩᎶᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏥᎾᏝᎢ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏥᎾᏝᎥᎾ ᏱᎩ.
\ft Knowing that whatsoever good thing any man doeth, the same shall he receive of the Lord, whether he be bond or free.

\ln Ale nihi ditsadanvsidohi, nasgiya utloyi nasgi nidetsadvnehesdi, unelagi itselisesdi detsinayedanehvi, tsitsigataha nasgi nihi nasquo Itsinvsidohi galvloi ehvi; vtla ale yidusuyesdi yvwi digvwalvquododi gesvi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏂᎯ ᏗᏣᏓᏅᏏᏙᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎤᏠᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᏕᏣᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ, ᎤᏁᎳᎩ ᎢᏤᎵᏎᏍᏗ ᏕᏥᎾᏰᏓᏁᎲᎢ, ᏥᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎢᏥᏅᏏᏙᎯ ᎦᎸᎶᎢ ᎡᎲᎢ; ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᏱᏚᏑᏰᏍᏗ ᏴᏫ ᏗᎬᏩᎸᏉᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft And, ye masters, do the same things unto them, forbearing threatening: knowing that your Master also is in heaven; neither is there respect of persons with him.

\ln Ulisqualvdino gesvi, idalinvtli, ditsalinigidiyu gesesdi Ugvwiyuhi etsalisgasdodvi, ale itsalisgasdodv utsatanvhi ulinigidiyu gesvi.
\syll ᎤᎵᏍᏆᎸᏗᏃ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᏗᏣᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎡᏣᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏛᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏛ ᎤᏣᏔᏅᎯ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Finally, my brethren, be strong in the Lord, and in the power of his might.

\ln Nigadv Unelanvhi utseliga alisgasdodo itsatsanvda, nasgi yeli getsaledi iyulisdodiyi asgina asinasanv detsigatilvsdisgvi.
\syll ᏂᎦᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᎠᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏙ ᎢᏣᏣᏅᏓ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏰᎵ ᎨᏣᎴᏗ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎠᏍᎩᎾ ᎠᏏᎾᏌᏅ ᏕᏥᎦᏘᎸᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ.
\ft Put on the whole armour of God, that ye may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.

\ln Vtlayeno yidigatliyvha uquedali gesv ale gigv, unigvwiyuhisgini, ale tsunalinigidv, ale nunigvwiyusadegi ani elohi ulisigi gesvi, didanvdo uninegutsidv galvlo nunadvhnadegvi.
\syll ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᏱᏗᎦᏟᏴᎭ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎩᎬ, ᎤᏂᎬᏫᏳᎯᏍᎩᏂ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᎾᎵᏂᎩᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ ᎠᏂ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎤᎵᏏᎩ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏗᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᏂᏁᎫᏥᏛ ᎦᎸᎶ ᏄᎾᏛᎿᏕᎬᎢ.
\ft For we wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi itsagi nigadv ali sgasdodo Unelanvhi utseliga, nasgi yeli digetsatliyvdi iyulisdodiyi nahiyu uyoiyu iga gesesdi, nasgino nigadv itsadvnelvhi gesesdi, getsaledi iyulisdodiyi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏣᎩ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎠᎵ ᏍᎦᏍᏙᏙ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏰᎵ ᏗᎨᏣᏟᏴᏗ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏀᎢᏳ ᎤᏲᎢᏳ ᎢᎦ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎢᏣᏛᏁᎸᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎨᏣᎴᏗ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
\ft Wherefore take unto you the whole armour of God, that ye may be able to withstand in the evil day, and having done all, to stand.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi detsidogesdi, detsadatlosdesdi gayegogi nigesvna gesvi, ale duyugodv gesv detsadanetsasdulodesdi;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏕᏥᏙᎨᏍᏗ, ᏕᏣᏓᏠᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᎦᏰᎪᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒ ᏕᏣᏓᏁᏣᏍᏚᎶᏕᏍᏗ;
\ft Stand therefore, having your loins girt about with truth, and having on the breastplate of righteousness;

\ln Ditsalasidenino detsalasulodesdi advnvistanvhi gesv osdv kanohedv nvwadohiyadv adanehi;
\syll ᏗᏣᎳᏏᏕᏂᏃ ᏕᏣᎳᏑᎶᏕᏍᏗ ᎠᏛᏅᎢᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᎠᏓᏁᎯ;
\ft And your feet shod with the preparation of the gospel of peace;

\ln Aseno nasquo gohiyudi gesv itsaligvsuloda, nasgi itsvdisgv yeliquo digetsvdladedi iyulisdodiyi tsutsistli gani asgina tsutseliga.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏣᎵᎬᏑᎶᏓ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏨᏗᏍᎬ ᏰᎵᏉ ᏗᎨᏨᏜᏕᏗ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏧᏥᏍᏟ ᎦᏂ ᎠᏍᎩᎾ ᏧᏤᎵᎦ.
\ft Above all, taking the shield of faith, wherewith ye shall be able to quench all the fiery darts of the wicked.

\ln Alisdelvdodino alisdulo itsinagi, ale ayelasdiganvhidv Adanvdo utseliga, nasgi kanohedv Unelanvhi utseli tsigi;
\syll ᎠᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗᏃ ᎠᎵᏍᏚᎶ ᎢᏥᎾᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏰᎳᏍᏗᎦᏅᎯᏛ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏥᎩ;
\ft And take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God:

\ln Nigohilv itsadadolisdisgesdi nudalesv adadolisdi gesv, ale atayosdi gesv Adanvdo gvdi, ale itsiyawisgesdi nahnani itsvdisgesdi diyaweisdi nigesvna, ale atayosdi gesv getsisdelvdiyi unadanvti nanivi.
\syll ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎢᏣᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏄᏓᎴᏒ ᎠᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏔᏲᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎬᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏥᏯᏫᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏀᎾᏂ ᎢᏨᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏗᏯᏪᎢᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏔᏲᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎨᏥᏍᏕᎸᏗᏱ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ ᎾᏂᎥᎢ.
\ft Praying always with all prayer and supplication in the Spirit, and watching thereunto with all perseverance and supplication for all saints;

\ln Ale ayv vgisdelvdiyi, nasgi vqualisgolvdanediyi agiwonihisdiyi, agisduisdiyi tsioli nitsisgaihvna, gvnigesv iyaquvnediyi udelidv gesv osdv kanehedv;
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴ ᎥᎩᏍᏕᎸᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎥᏆᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᎠᎩᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎩᏍᏚᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᏥᎣᎵ ᏂᏥᏍᎦᎢᎲᎾ, ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏯᏋᏁᏗᏱ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏁᎮᏛ;
\ft And for me, that utterance may be given unto me, that I may open my mouth boldly, to make known the mystery of the gospel,

\ln Nasgi [osdv kanohedv] tsinvdigalisdodiha ayv vginvsidv vqualvidv tsigi; nasgi iyuwanisodiyi nahnani nitsisgaihvna agineisdiyi, nasgiya iyagiwesdiyi tsiduyugodi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛdata is invalid ᏥᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎠᏴ ᎥᎩᏅᏏᏛ ᎥᏆᎸᎢᏛ ᏥᎩ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏐᏗᏱ ᏀᎾᏂ ᏂᏥᏍᎦᎢᎲᎾ ᎠᎩᏁᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎢᏯᎩᏪᏍᏗᏱ ᏥᏚᏳᎪᏗ.
\ft For which I am an ambassador in bonds: that therein I may speak boldly, as I ought to speak.

\ln Nasgino itsigadovhisdiyi nasquo ayv naqualisdanelidegv ale naquadvhnadegvi, Digiga, otsigeyui otsalinvtli ale osdv iyadvnehi tsulvwisdanehi Ugvwiyuhi utseli ugvwali, gvnigesv nvdatsvneli nudalesv gohusdi;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎢᏥᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏴ ᎾᏆᎵᏍᏓᏁᎵᏕᎬ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏆᏛᎿᏕᎬᎢ, ᏗᎩᎦ, ᎣᏥᎨᏳᎢ ᎣᏣᎵᏅᏟ ᎠᎴ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᎯ ᏧᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ, ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏅᏓᏨᏁᎵ ᏄᏓᎴᏒ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ;
\ft But that ye also may know my affairs, and how I do, Tychicus, a beloved brother and faithful minister in the Lord, shall make known to you all things:

\ln Nasgi tsinvli ditsehvi nasgiquo ugvwali, nasgi itsigadovhisdiyi nogalisdanelidegvi, ale nasgi tsugalisdadisdiyi ditsinawi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏅᎵ ᏗᏤᎲᎢ ᎾᏍᎩᏉ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏥᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏃᎦᎵᏍᏓᏁᎵᏕᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᎦᎵᏍᏓᏗᏍᏗᏱ ᏗᏥᎾᏫ.
\ft Whom I have sent unto you for the same purpose, that ye might know our affairs, and that he might comfort your hearts.

\ln Uwadohiyadv dunikahnawadidohesdi analinvtli, ale adageyudi gesv ulitloyasdesdi gohiyudi gesvi, nvdayunalisgolvtanvhi Unelanvhi Agayvligei, ale Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv.
\syll ᎤᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᏚᏂᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎮᏍᏗ ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏟ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎵᏠᏯᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏅᏓᏳᎾᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏅᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ.
\ft Peace be to the brethren, and love with faith, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

\ln Gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv dunikahnawadidohesdi naniv nunatlonasdvna unigeyuhi igatseli Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv.  Emenv.
\syll ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏚᏂᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎮᏍᏗ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏄᎾᏠᎾᏍᏛᎾ ᎤᏂᎨᏳᎯ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ.  ᎡᎺᏅ.
\ft Grace be with all them that love our Lord Jesus Christ in sincerity. Amen.

\ln Quola ale Dimadi, Tsisa Galonedv gvwaninvsidohi, widosdowelasi naniv unadanvti Galonedv Tsisa gvwohiyuhi nasgi Quiligiyi anehi, dosgatloyasdiha dinigatiya ale aniyadohihi;
\syll ᏉᎳ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎹᏗ, ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎬᏩᏂᏅᏏᏙᎯ, ᏫᏙᏍᏙᏪᎳᏏ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏥᏌ ᎬᏬᎯᏳᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏈᎵᎩᏱ ᎠᏁᎯ, ᏙᏍᎦᏠᏯᏍᏗᎭ ᏗᏂᎦᏘᏯ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏯᏙᎯᎯ;
