\ft Paul and Timotheus, the servants of Jesus Christ, to all the saints in Christ Jesus which are at Philippi, with the bishops and deacons:

\ln Gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv, ale nvwadohiyadv itseladidohesdi nvdayunalisgolvtane Unelanvhi igidoda, ale Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv.
\syll ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᎢᏤᎳᏗᏙᎮᏍᏗ ᏅᏓᏳᎾᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏁ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᎩᏙᏓ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ.
\ft Grace be unto you, and peace, from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.

\ln Aquanelanvhi tsiyalielitseho iyusdiha itsvyanvdadigvi,
\syll ᎠᏆᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏥᏯᎵᎡᎵᏤᎰ ᎢᏳᏍᏗᎭ ᎢᏨᏯᏅᏓᏗᎬᎢ,
\ft I thank my God upon every remembrance of you,

\ln Nigohilv nigadadolisdisgv nitsitayohihv nihi nitsiv etsidolisdiyi, ulihelisdi aquadanvdv gadadolisdisgvi,
\syll ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᏂᎦᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᏂᏥᏔᏲᎯᎲ ᏂᎯ ᏂᏥᎥ ᎡᏥᏙᎵᏍᏗᏱ, ᎤᎵᎮᎵᏍᏗ ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏛ ᎦᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ,
\ft Always in every prayer of mine for you all making request with joy,

\ln Nvdigalisdodisgv itsatequalosv osdv kanohedv detsikahnawadisvi, igvyiyi iga nvdagvwadalenvdv gohi iyasti;
\syll ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬ ᎢᏣᏖᏆᎶᏒ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏕᏥᎧᎿᏩᏗᏒᎢ, ᎢᎬᏱᏱ ᎢᎦ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎪᎯ ᎢᏯᏍᏘ;
\ft For your fellowship in the gospel from the first day until now;

\ln Hia nasgi sudalegi gesv naquadlasidvehvna, nasgi na osdv digalvwisdanedi ulenvdv doditsadanvdvi nasgi uyeilvsdiyi gvlisquadisgi Tsisa Galonedv utseli iga aliyeliilolv gvdisgi;
\syll ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏑᏓᎴᎩ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏆᏜᏏᏛᎡᎲᎾ, ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎤᎴᏅᏛ ᏙᏗᏣᏓᏅᏛᎢ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏰᎢᎸᏍᏗᏱ ᎬᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᎩ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎢᎦ ᎠᎵᏰᎵᎢᎶᎸ ᎬᏗᏍᎩ;
\ft Being confident of this very thing, that he which hath begun a good work in you will perform it until the day of Jesus Christ:

\ln Nasgi tsiduyugodi nasgi itsvyelisediyi nitsivi, nvdigalisdodisgv aginawiyi itsvsquanigodvi; nasquoyeno vqualvidv gesvi, ale tsisdelisgv ale tsisdayidisgv osdv kanohedv nihi nitsiv itseladisdiha gvwagatiya vgidoligvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏚᏳᎪᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏨᏰᎵᏎᏗᏱ ᏂᏥᎥᎢ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬ ᎠᎩᎾᏫᏱ ᎢᏨᏍᏆᏂᎪᏛᎢ; ᎾᏍᏉᏰᏃ ᎥᏆᎸᎢᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᏍᏕᎵᏍᎬ ᎠᎴ ᏥᏍᏓᏱᏗᏍᎬ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏂᎯ ᏂᏥᎥ ᎢᏤᎳᏗᏍᏗᎭ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎥᎩᏙᎵᎬᎢ.
\ft Even as it is meet for me to think this of you all, because I have you in my heart; inasmuch as both in my bonds, and in the defence and confirmation of the gospel, ye all are partakers of my grace.

\ln Unelanvhiyeno aquatseli agatahi nigav itsvgeyusvli Tsisa Galonedv udageyudi gvdisgvi.
\syll ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ ᎠᏆᏤᎵ ᎠᎦᏔᎯ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎢᏨᎨᏳᏒᎵ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎬᏗᏍᎬᎢ.
\ft For God is my record, how greatly I long after you all in the bowels of Jesus Christ.

\ln Ale tsitayohiha gadadolisdisgvi, nasgi adageyudi gesv itsehv asi utli igai unequotsvsdiyi ulitloyasdodiyi agadovhisdi gesv, ale nigav duyugodv golisdi gesvi;
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏥᏔᏲᎯᎭ ᎦᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏤᎲ ᎠᏏ ᎤᏟ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎤᏁᏉᏨᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᎵᏠᏯᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎠᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎪᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ;
\ft And this I pray, that your love may abound yet more and more in knowledge and in all judgment;

\ln Nasgi itsigowadvdiyi tsudalenvdv dudalehnavi; nasgi nitsatlonasdvna itsalisdodiyi, ale nitsadahnasqualosdisgvna Galonedv utseli iga aliyilolv gvdisgi;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏥᎪᏩᏛᏗᏱ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏚᏓᎴᎿᎥᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᏣᏠᎾᏍᏛᎾ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᏣᏓᎿᏍᏆᎶᏍᏗᏍᎬᎾ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎢᎦ ᎠᎵᏱᎶᎸ ᎬᏗᏍᎩ;
\ft That ye may approve things that are excellent; that ye may be sincere and without offence till the day of Christ;

\ln Nasgi itsikalitsvhi iyulisdodiyi duyugodv gesv udalenvhi, nasgi Tsisa Galonedv iyuwanisodiyi, nasgi ulvquododiyi Unelanvhi ale gvnigesv iyuwanediyi nasgi galvquodiyu gesvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏥᎧᎵᏨᎯ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏓᎴᏅᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏐᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎸᏉᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏩᏁᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Being filled with the fruits of righteousness, which are by Jesus Christ, unto the glory and praise of God.

\ln Aseno idalinvtli aquaduliha itsigadovhisdiyi nasgi gudalenvdv naqualisdanelvi unequoisdiyiquo nuwanelv osdv kanohedv;
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ ᎠᏆᏚᎵᎭ ᎢᏥᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎫᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎾᏆᎵᏍᏓᏁᎸᎢ ᎤᏁᏉᎢᏍᏗᏱᏉ ᏄᏩᏁᎸ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ;
\ft But I would ye should understand, brethren, that the things which happened unto me have fallen out rather unto the furtherance of the gospel;

\ln Nasgi nvdigalisdodiha Galonedv agisdvdisgv vqualvvi ugvwiyuhi ganelv nigv gvnigesv nulistanv, ale nigvnadvquo;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎠᎩᏍᏛᏗᏍᎬ ᎥᏆᎸᎥᎢ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎦᏁᎸ ᏂᎬ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎬᎾᏛᏉ;
\ft So that my bonds in Christ are manifest in all the palace, and in all other places;

\ln Ale anigodiyu analinvtli Ugvwiyuhi tsunanelodi vqualvv iyuwanisadv dunaligosv dunadanvdvi, utli igai naninayesgvna nunalistanv kanohedv nanisgaihvna uninohediyi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᎪᏗᏳ ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏟ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎥᏆᎸᎥ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ ᏚᎾᎵᎪᏒ ᏚᎾᏓᏅᏛᎢ, ᎤᏟ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎾᏂᎾᏰᏍᎬᎾ ᏄᎾᎵᏍᏔᏅ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎾᏂᏍᎦᎢᎲᎾ ᎤᏂᏃᎮᏗᏱ.
\ft And many of the brethren in the Lord, waxing confident by my bonds, are much more bold to speak the word without fear.

\ln Igadv udohiyuhi advyugedi gesv ale adisvsdi gesv unadulisgv nvdigalisdodiha analitsidohvsga Galonedv aninoheha, igadvno nasquo osiyu uniyelvsvi.
\syll ᎢᎦᏛ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎠᏛᏳᎨᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏗᏒᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎾᏚᎵᏍᎬ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎠᎾᎵᏥᏙᎲᏍᎦ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎠᏂᏃᎮᎭ, ᎢᎦᏛᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎤᏂᏰᎸᏒᎢ.
\ft Some indeed preach Christ even of envy and strife; and some also of good will:

\ln Hia nasgi sunadalegi gesv analitsidohvsga Galonedv aninoheha adisvsdiquo gesv unadulisgv nvdigalisdodiha, vtlano nunatlonasdvna gesv yanvdiha, uninequosdiyi uniyelvha tsigiliyogv vqualvidv gesvi.
\syll ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏑᎾᏓᎴᎩ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎾᎵᏥᏙᎲᏍᎦ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎠᏂᏃᎮᎭ ᎠᏗᏒᏍᏗᏉ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎾᏚᎵᏍᎬ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ, ᎥᏝᏃ ᏄᎾᏠᎾᏍᏛᎾ ᎨᏒ ᏯᏅᏗᎭ, ᎤᏂᏁᏉᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏂᏰᎸᎭ ᏥᎩᎵᏲᎬ ᎥᏆᎸᎢᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft The one preach Christ of contention, not sincerely, supposing to add affliction to my bonds:

\ln Anisoisgini gvgigeyuhiyu gesv nvdigalisdodiha, anigatahayeno vginetselvhi gesv agisdelvdiyi osdv kanohedv.
\syll ᎠᏂᏐᎢᏍᎩᏂ ᎬᎩᎨᏳᎯᏳ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ, ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎭᏰᏃ ᎥᎩᏁᏤᎸᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎩᏍᏕᎸᏗᏱ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ.
\ft But the other of love, knowing that I am set for the defence of the gospel.

\ln Gadogeno?  Unelagi, nigavquo nanadvnehvi, nasquo asequoquo yinanadvneha, ale udohiyuhi yuniyelvha, Galonedv atsinoheha; ale nahnani galieliga, vv, ale ase galieligesdi.
\syll ᎦᏙᎨᏃ?  ᎤᏁᎳᎩ, ᏂᎦᎥᏉ ᎾᎾᏛᏁᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏎᏉᏉ ᏱᎾᎾᏛᏁᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᏳᏂᏰᎸᎭ, ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎠᏥᏃᎮᎭ; ᎠᎴ ᏀᎾᏂ ᎦᎵᎡᎵᎦ, ᎥᎥ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏎ ᎦᎵᎡᎵᎨᏍᏗ.
\ft What then? notwithstanding, every way, whether in pretence, or in truth, Christ is preached; and I therein do rejoice, yea, and will rejoice.

\ln Tsigatahayeno hia nasgi vgisdelvdiyi wuliyeilohisdi gesvi nihi itsadadolisdisgv nvdagalisdotani, ale Tsisa Galonedv Udanvdo vginehvi;
\syll ᏥᎦᏔᎭᏰᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎥᎩᏍᏕᎸᏗᏱ ᏭᎵᏰᎢᎶᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏣᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏔᏂ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏓᏅᏙ ᎥᎩᏁᎲᎢ;
\ft For I know that this shall turn to my salvation through your prayer, and the supply of the Spirit of Jesus Christ,

\ln Nasgiya utsati aquadulisgv ale udugi aquvsvi, nasgi nigav gohusdi aquadehohisdiyi nigesvna, nigavquosgini nitsisgaihvna gesvi, tsinusdoquo, nasgiya nasquo gohi, Galonedv tsilvquododi gesesdi tsiyelv gvdi, nasquo gvnodv gesv ale agiyohuhisdi gesvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎠᏆᏚᎵᏍᎬ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎠᏋᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎠᏆᏕᎰᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᏂᎦᎥᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᏂᏥᏍᎦᎢᎲᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏥᏄᏍᏙᏉ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎪᎯ, ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏥᎸᏉᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏥᏰᎸ ᎬᏗ, ᎾᏍᏉ ᎬᏃᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎩᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft According to my earnest expectation and my hope, that in nothing I shall be ashamed, but that with all boldness, as always, so now also Christ shall be magnified in my body, whether it be by life, or by death.

\ln Asiyeno yaqualenidolv Galonvdv tsilvquododi, yagiyohusvno ayv aginequotsedi.
\syll ᎠᏏᏰᏃ ᏯᏆᎴᏂᏙᎸ ᎦᎶᏅᏛ ᏥᎸᏉᏙᏗ, ᏯᎩᏲᎱᏒᏃ ᎠᏴ ᎠᎩᏁᏉᏤᏗ.
\ft For to me to live is Christ, and to die is gain.

\ln Iyusgininonv uquedalv yaqualenidolv, hia nasgi aginanugowisdi dagilvwisdagohvi; ale vtla yitsigataha nasgi iyusdi aquasuyesdiyi.
\syll ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎤᏇᏓᎸ ᏯᏆᎴᏂᏙᎸ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎩᎾᏄᎪᏫᏍᏗ ᏓᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᎪᎲᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏆᏑᏰᏍᏗᏱ.
\ft But if I live in the flesh, this is the fruit of my labour: yet what I shall choose I wot not.

\ln Taliyeno iyudalegi gesv asdayiyu naqualisdaneha, nvdigalisdodi aquadulisgv aquanigisdiyi, ale Galonedv tsehv waquadediyi; nasgi wudagonadvdv utli osiyu tsigi;
\syll ᏔᎵᏰᏃ ᎢᏳᏓᎴᎩ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏍᏓᏱᏳ ᎾᏆᎵᏍᏓᏁᎭ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᎠᏆᏚᎵᏍᎬ ᎠᏆᏂᎩᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏤᎲ ᏩᏆᏕᏗᏱ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᏭᏓᎪᎾᏛᏛ ᎤᏟ ᎣᏏᏳ ᏥᎩ;
\ft For I am in a strait betwixt two, having a desire to depart, and to be with Christ; which is far better:

\ln Usdalvsgininonv aqualenidasdiyi utli osiyu itsalisdanedi nihi.
\syll ᎤᏍᏓᎸᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎠᏆᎴᏂᏓᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏟ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᏂᎯ.
\ft Nevertheless to abide in the flesh is more needful for you.

\ln Nasgino hia tsinusdi tsaquohiyuha, tsigataha aqualenidasdiyi ale nitsiv itsvyeladidasdiyi, nasgi itsinequotsediyi ale itsalihelisdiyi itsohiyusvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏄᏍᏗ ᏣᏉᎯᏳᎭ, ᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᎠᏆᎴᏂᏓᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᏂᏥᎥ ᎢᏨᏰᎳᏗᏓᏍᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏥᏁᏉᏤᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏣᎵᎮᎵᏍᏗᏱ ᎢᏦᎯᏳᏒᎢ.
\ft And having this confidence, I know that I shall abide and continue with you all for your furtherance and joy of faith;

\ln Nasgi utsati unequotsvsdiyi itsaliheligv Tsisa Galonedv iyuwanisadv, ayv nvdigalisdodisgv, nasgi taline witsvlutsedi gesv iyusdi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᏁᏉᏨᏍᏗᏱ ᎢᏣᎵᎮᎵᎬ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ, ᎠᏴ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏔᎵᏁ ᏫᏨᎷᏤᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ.
\ft That your rejoicing may be more abundant in Jesus Christ for me by my coming to you again.

\ln Nasgiya adina Galonedv utseli osdv kanohedv tsulilohvsga nitsadvnelidohesdi; nasgi iyuno yiwitsvlutselv ale yiwitsvgov, ale yagigonelvquo, yigadvgvga nitsadvhnadegvi, ulinigidv detsidogv saquo adanvdogihi, saquo adanvtedi gvdi, atequalohi itsatlinigvnediyi itsisdelvdiyi gohiyudi gesv osdv kanohedv.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎠᏗᎾ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏧᎵᎶᎲᏍᎦ ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎵᏙᎮᏍᏗ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏃ ᏱᏫᏨᎷᏤᎸ ᎠᎴ ᏱᏫᏨᎪᎥ, ᎠᎴ ᏯᎩᎪᏁᎸᏉ, ᏱᎦᏛᎬᎦ ᏂᏣᏛᎿᏕᎬᎢ, ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᏕᏥᏙᎬ ᏌᏉ ᎠᏓᏅᏙᎩᎯ, ᏌᏉ ᎠᏓᏅᏖᏗ ᎬᏗ, ᎠᏖᏆᎶᎯ ᎢᏣᏟᏂᎬᏁᏗᏱ ᎢᏥᏍᏕᎸᏗᏱ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ.
\ft Only let your conversation be as it becometh the gospel of Christ: that whether I come and see you, or else be absent, I may hear of your affairs, that ye stand fast in one spirit, with one mind striving together for the faith of the gospel;

\ln Ale tlesdi gohusdi anadvnehv getsatludisgi yitsisgasdanehesdi; nasgi gvnigesv iyunvnehi getsidvdodi gesvi, nihisgini gvnigesv itsvnehi etsisdelvdi gesvi, ale nasgi Unelanvhi itsisdelvdi gesvi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎠᎾᏛᏁᎲ ᎨᏣᏡᏗᏍᎩ ᏱᏥᏍᎦᏍᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏅᏁᎯ ᎨᏥᏛᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏨᏁᎯ ᎡᏥᏍᏕᎸᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᏥᏍᏕᎸᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft And in nothing terrified by your adversaries: which is to them an evident token of perdition, but to you of salvation, and that of God.

\ln Nihiyeno etsinelvhi Galonedv gesv iyusdi, vtla etsoiyudiyiquo uwasv, nasquosgini etsigilitsediyi;
\syll ᏂᎯᏰᏃ ᎡᏥᏁᎸᎯ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᎥᏝ ᎡᏦᎢᏳᏗᏱᏉ ᎤᏩᏒ, ᎾᏍᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎡᏥᎩᎵᏤᏗᏱ;
\ft For unto you it is given in the behalf of Christ, not only to believe on him, but also to suffer for his sake;

\ln Nasgiya adisvsdi gesv itsehv nasgi ayv tsisgigoelvgi, ale gohi tsitsadvgiha aquehvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎠᏗᏒᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏤᎲ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᏥᏍᎩᎪᎡᎸᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎪᎯ ᏥᏣᏛᎩᎭ ᎠᏇᎲᎢ.
\ft Having the same conflict which ye saw in me, and now hear to be in me.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi iyuno Galonedvyi ugalisdi nvdagvwadaledi gesesdi, iyuno adageyudi gesv adanuwohisdisgi gvwadanedi gesesdi, iyuno gvtequalodi gesesdi Adanvdo vdatinedi gesvi, iyuno adadolisdi gesv ale udanvti gesv ehesdi,
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏳᏃ ᎦᎶᏁᏛᏱ ᎤᎦᎵᏍᏗ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏓᎴᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏓᏄᏬᎯᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᎬᏩᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎬᏖᏆᎶᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎥᏓᏘᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎠᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᏅᏘ ᎨᏒ ᎡᎮᏍᏗ,
\ft If there be therefore any consolation in Christ, if any comfort of love, if any fellowship of the Spirit, if any bowels and mercies,

\ln Itsikalitsa galieligvi, utloyi iyulisdodiyi itsadanvtesgvi, utloyiquo iyulisdodiyi detsadageyusvi, utloyiquo iyulisdodiyi detsadanvdvi, utloyiquo iyulisdodiyi ditsadanvdo.
\syll ᎢᏥᎧᎵᏣ ᎦᎵᎡᎵᎬᎢ, ᎤᏠᏱ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬᎢ, ᎤᏠᏱᏉ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏕᏣᏓᎨᏳᏒᎢ, ᎤᏠᏱᏉ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏕᏣᏓᏅᏛᎢ, ᎤᏠᏱᏉ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏗᏣᏓᏅᏙ.
\ft Fulfill ye my joy, that ye be likeminded, having the same love, being of one accord, of one mind.

\ln Tlesdi gohusdi yitsadvnehesdi adisvsdi gesv ale asequo atlvquisdi gesv gvdi; eladiquosgini nidetsvnv detsadanvdv itsisiyvwiha utli nidetsilvquodesdi anisoi esgaquo itsvsv.
\syll ᏞᏍᏗ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏱᏣᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᎠᏗᏒᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏎᏉ ᎠᏢᏈᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏗ; ᎡᎳᏗᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᏂᏕᏨᏅ ᏕᏣᏓᏅᏛ ᎢᏥᏏᏴᏫᎭ ᎤᏟ ᏂᏕᏥᎸᏉᏕᏍᏗ ᎠᏂᏐᎢ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎢᏨᏒ.
\ft Let nothing be done through strife or vainglory; but in lowliness of mind let each esteem other better than themselves.

\ln Tlesdi gilo uwasvquo utseli yugasayasdesdi, nanivsgini anisoi nasquo unatseliga.
\syll ᏞᏍᏗ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏩᏒᏉ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏳᎦᏌᏯᏍᏕᏍᏗ, ᎾᏂᎥᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏂᏐᎢ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ.
\ft Look not every man on his own things, but every man also on the things of others.

\ln Nasgi hia nusdesdi detsadanvtesdi, nasgiya nasquo tsudanvte Galonedv Tsisa;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᏕᏣᏓᏅᏖᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏧᏓᏅᏖ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏥᏌ;
\ft Let this mind be in you, which was also in Christ Jesus:

\ln Nasgi Unelanvhi tsagatlilostanvhi gesvi, vtla gadanasahvsga yelisge Unelanvhi nasgiya nusdv nudvnvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏣᎦᏟᎶᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎦᏓᎾᏌᎲᏍᎦ ᏰᎵᏍᎨ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏄᏛᏅᎢ.
\ft Who, being in the form of God, thought it not robbery to be equal with God:

\ln Aseno natsilvquodvna nudadvnele uwasv, ale atsinvsidasdi nusdv nasgiya nudadvnelei, ale yvwi nunasdv nasgiya nulistanei;
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎾᏥᎸᏉᏛᎾ ᏄᏓᏛᏁᎴ ᎤᏩᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᏓᏛᏁᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏴᏫ ᏄᎾᏍᏛ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ;
\ft But made himself of no reputation, and took upon him the form of a servant, and was made in the likeness of men:

\ln Ale yvwi nasgiya nusdv gesei, uwasv natsilvquodvna nudadvnelei, ale uwohiyuhisdv nulistane ayohuhisdi gesv gvdisgi, nasgi dadahnawasdv ayohuhisdodi gesvi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏴᏫ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎤᏩᏒ ᎾᏥᎸᏉᏛᎾ ᏄᏓᏛᏁᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏬᎯᏳᎯᏍᏛ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏗᏍᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏓᏓᎿᏩᏍᏛ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft And being found in fashion as a man, he humbled himself, and became obedient unto death, even the death of the cross.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi nasquo Unelanvhi utsati galvladiyu usaladanv, ale unelv tsudosdodi gesvi, nasgi utli galvquodiyu esgaquo nigav tsunadosdodi gesvi,
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎦᎸᎳᏗᏳ ᎤᏌᎳᏓᏅ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎸ ᏧᏙᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏟ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏧᎾᏙᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ,
\ft Wherefore God also hath highly exalted him, and given him a name which is above every name:

\ln Nasgi Tsisa dudov nigadiyu tsunaliniquanediyi nasquo galvloi anehi, ale elohi anehi, ale elohi hawiniditlv anehi;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏌ ᏚᏙᎥ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏧᎾᎵᏂᏆᏁᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎦᎸᎶᎢ ᎠᏁᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎠᏁᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎭᏫᏂᏗᏢ ᎠᏁᎯ;
\ft That at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, of things in heaven, and things in earth, and things under the earth;

\ln Ale nigadiyu diganoga gvnigesv iyunvnedi gesesdi nasgi Tsisa Galonedv Ugvwiyuhi gesvi, galvquodiyu iyuwanehi gesesdi Unelanvhi Agayvligei.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏗᎦᏃᎦ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏅᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎢᏳᏩᏁᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ.
\ft And that every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi itsvgeyui, nigohilvquo tsitsohiyuhvsgoi, vtla ayv tsigatahvquo iyusdi, gohisgini gesv agigonelvi utli igai ditsilvwisdasi etsisdelvdiyi gesvi, itsinayesgv ale detsinawisgvi;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏨᎨᏳᎢ, ᏂᎪᎯᎸᏉ ᏥᏦᎯᏳᎲᏍᎪᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᏴ ᏥᎦᏔᎲᏉ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᎪᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎩᎪᏁᎸᎢ ᎤᏟ ᎢᎦᎢ ᏗᏥᎸᏫᏍᏓᏏ ᎡᏥᏍᏕᎸᏗᏱ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎢᏥᎾᏰᏍᎬ ᎠᎴ ᏕᏥᎾᏫᏍᎬᎢ;
\ft Wherefore, my beloved, as ye have always obeyed, not as in my presence only, but now much more in my absence, work out your own salvation with fear and trembling.

\ln Unelanvhiyeno osiyu uyelvdi gesv deulvwisdaneha detsadanvdvi nasgi itsadulvdiyi ale nasquo ditsilvwisdanediyi.
\syll ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎤᏰᎸᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏕᎤᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎭ ᏕᏣᏓᏅᏛᎢ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏣᏚᎸᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏗᏥᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ.
\ft For it is God which worketh in you both to will and to do of his good pleasure.

\ln Nigadiyu tsudalenvdv detsilvwisdanehv gohusdi niditsadadelisehvna ale tsitsadisvhihvna gesesdi;
\syll ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏕᏥᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏂᏗᏣᏓᏕᎵᏎᎲᎾ ᎠᎴ ᏥᏣᏗᏒᎯᎲᎾ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ;
\ft Do all things without murmurings and disputings:

\ln Nasgi netsilawisehvna ale nitsatlonasdvna gesesdi, Unelanvhi tsuwetsi, gayetsuisdodi nigesvna, itsadasuyv unadatsinosquadiyedv ale unagolvdv yvwi anehvi, nasgi nahna anehv detsilvsadadiha elohi iga ditsatisdanehi nasgiyai;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏁᏥᎳᏫᏎᎲᎾ ᎠᎴ ᏂᏣᏠᎾᏍᏛᎾ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᏪᏥ, ᎦᏰᏧᎢᏍᏙᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎢᏣᏓᏑᏴ ᎤᎾᏓᏥᏃᏍᏆᏗᏰᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᎪᎸᏛ ᏴᏫ ᎠᏁᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏀᎾ ᎠᏁᎲ ᏕᏥᎸᏌᏓᏗᎭ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎢᎦ ᏗᏣᏘᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ;
\ft That ye may be blameless and harmless, the sons of God, without rebuke, in the midst of a crooked and perverse nation, among whom ye shine as lights in the world;

\ln Itsinanugowisgesdi kanohedv gvnidv adanehi; nasgi iyuwanisodiyi aqualihelisdiyi Galonedv utseli iga gesesdi, nasgi asequo digisqualvtanvhi nigesvna gesvi, ale asequo digilvwisdanelvhi nigesvna gesvi.
\syll ᎢᏥᎾᏄᎪᏫᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎠᏓᏁᎯ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏐᏗᏱ ᎠᏆᎵᎮᎵᏍᏗᏱ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎢᎦ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏎᏉ ᏗᎩᏍᏆᎸᏔᏅᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏎᏉ ᏗᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Holding forth the word of life; that I may rejoice in the day of Christ, that I have not run in vain, neither laboured in vain.

\ln Vv, ale iyu yaquadalisgolvtanv nahna atsilv itselohvi ale detsilvwisdanehv gohiyudi itsvdisgvi, galieliga, ale itsvyaligoneha itsaliheligvi.
\syll ᎥᎥ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏳ ᏯᏆᏓᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏅ ᏀᎾ ᎠᏥᎸ ᎢᏤᎶᎲᎢ ᎠᎴ ᏕᏥᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎢᏨᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᎦᎵᎡᎵᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏨᏯᎵᎪᏁᎭ ᎢᏣᎵᎮᎵᎬᎢ.
\ft Yea, and if I be offered upon the sacrifice and service of your faith, I joy, and rejoice with you all.

\ln Nasgi nasquo winigalisdoda nihi itsaliheligi, ale sgiyaligohvsi ayv galieligvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏫᏂᎦᎵᏍᏙᏓ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏣᎵᎮᎵᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏍᎩᏯᎵᎪᎲᏏ ᎠᏴ ᎦᎵᎡᎵᎬᎢ.
\ft For the same cause also do ye joy, and rejoice with me.

\ln Aseno udugi aquvha Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa iyuwanisodiyi Dimadi tsinvsdiyi ditsehv nigohilvna, nasgi ayv nasquo osdv agigalisdadisdiyi gadolehosvha nitsadvhnadegvi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎠᏋᎭ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏐᏗᏱ ᏗᎹᏗ ᏥᏅᏍᏗᏱ ᏗᏤᎲ ᏂᎪᎯᎸᎾ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎠᎩᎦᎵᏍᏓᏗᏍᏗᏱ ᎦᏙᎴᎰᏒᎭ ᏂᏣᏛᎿᏕᎬᎢ.
\ft But I trust in the Lord Jesus to send Timotheus shortly unto you, that I also may be of good comfort, when I know your state.

\ln Vtlayeno gilo yoginaligoha utloyi udanvtawadegi, nasgi ase gvwagasayasdodi gesv nitsadvhnadegvi.
\syll ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᎩᎶ ᏲᎩᎾᎵᎪᎭ ᎤᏠᏱ ᎤᏓᏅᏔᏩᏕᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏎ ᎬᏩᎦᏌᏯᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏂᏣᏛᎿᏕᎬᎢ.
\ft For I have no man likeminded, who will naturally care for your state.

\ln Nanivyeno unvsvquo unatseli gesv uniyohoi, vtlano Tsisa Galonedv utseli gesvi.
\syll ᎾᏂᎥᏰᏃ ᎤᏅᏒᏉ ᎤᎾᏤᎵ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏂᏲᎰᎢ, ᎥᏝᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft For all seek their own, not the things which are Jesus Christ's.

\ln Aseno etsigataha nusdv nasgi atsigoliyevi, nasgi gilo uwetsi udoda tsasdelisgo nasgiya agisdelvhidolv osdv kanohedv uliyilvsdiyi dagilvwisdanehvi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎡᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏥᎪᎵᏰᎥᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎤᏙᏓ ᏣᏍᏕᎵᏍᎪ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎠᎩᏍᏕᎸᎯᏙᎸ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎤᎵᏱᎸᏍᏗᏱ ᏓᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎢ.
\ft But ye know the proof of him, that, as a son with the father, he hath served with me in the gospel.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi udugi aquvha nasgi tsinvsdiyi igvwenvdv gadoleosvquo iyaquolisdanedi gesvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎠᏋᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏅᏍᏗᏱ ᎢᎬᏪᏅᏛ ᎦᏙᎴᎣᏒᏉ ᎢᏯᏉᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Him therefore I hope to send presently, so soon as I shall see how it will go with me.

\ln Aseno tsiyalisgasdodiha Ugvwiyuhi ulisgolvdodiyi ayv nasquo aquvsv nigohilvna witsvlutsediyi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᏥᏯᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᎵᏍᎪᎸᏙᏗᏱ ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏋᏒ ᏂᎪᎯᎸᎾ ᏫᏨᎷᏤᏗᏱ.
\ft But I trust in the Lord that I also myself shall come shortly.

\ln Adina ase yitsinvsv aquelisv Iqua'lodata witsilutsediyi, nasgi aginvtli ale oginatequalohi doginilvwisdanehvi, ale oginaligohi osdiyawisgi, nihisgini etsinvsidv, ale nasgi agisdelvdv agiwadvdiyi aginigohisehvi.
\syll ᎠᏗᎾ ᎠᏎ ᏱᏥᏅᏒ ᎠᏇᎵᏒ ᎢᏆᎶᏓᏔ ᏫᏥᎷᏤᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎩᏅᏟ ᎠᎴ ᎣᎩᎾᏖᏆᎶᎯ ᏙᎩᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎣᎩᎾᎵᎪᎯ ᎣᏍᏗᏯᏫᏍᎩ, ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎡᏥᏅᏏᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎩᏍᏕᎸᏛ ᎠᎩᏩᏛᏗᏱ ᎠᎩᏂᎪᎯᏎᎲᎢ.
\ft Yet I supposed it necessary to send to you Epaphroditus, my brother, and companion in labour, and fellowsoldier, but your messenger, and he that ministered to my wants.

\ln Utsatiyeno udulisgvgi itsigowadvdiyi nitsivi, ale utsati gagedv udanvtawadegvgi, nvdagalisdodisgvgi itsadvganv utlvtsvi.
\syll ᎤᏣᏘᏰᏃ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎬᎩ ᎢᏥᎪᏩᏛᏗᏱ ᏂᏥᎥᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎦᎨᏛ ᎤᏓᏅᏔᏩᏕᎬᎩ, ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᎢᏣᏛᎦᏅ ᎤᏢᏨᎢ.
\ft For he longed after you all, and was full of heaviness, because that ye had heard that he had been sick.

\ln Udohiyuhiyeno utlvgvgi ale alequo nuyohusvgi; aseno Unelanvhi uwedolitsvgi; vtla ale nasgiquo uwasv, ayvsgini nasquo, nasgi ulosilodv uyo aquadanvdadisdiyi nigesvna.
\syll ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏰᏃ ᎤᏢᎬᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎴᏉ ᏄᏲᎱᏒᎩ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏪᏙᎵᏨᎩ; ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩᏉ ᎤᏩᏒ, ᎠᏴᏍᎩᏂ ᎾᏍᏉ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎶᏏᎶᏛ ᎤᏲ ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.
\ft For indeed he was sick nigh unto death: but God had mercy on him; and not on him only, but on me also, lest I should have sorrow upon sorrow.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi utli tlegiyu tsinvli, nasgi hnaquo taline ietsigovha, getsalihelisdi yigi, ale ayv esga iyvdv uyo yaquadanvtawadega.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᏟ ᏞᎩᏳ ᏥᏅᎵ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎿᏉ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎢᎡᏥᎪᎥᎭ, ᎨᏣᎵᎮᎵᏍᏗ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴ ᎡᏍᎦ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎤᏲ ᏯᏆᏓᏅᏔᏩᏕᎦ.
\ft I sent him therefore the more carefully, that, when ye see him again, ye may rejoice, and that I may be the less sorrowful.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi tsetsadanilvgi Ugvwiyuhi dikahnawadegi gesv iyusdi utsati osiyu ayelvdi itsvda; ale nasgi iyunasdi detsilvquodesdi;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏤᏣᏓᏂᎸᎩ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏕᎩ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎠᏰᎸᏗ ᎢᏨᏓ; ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗ ᏕᏥᎸᏉᏕᏍᏗ;
\ft Receive him therefore in the Lord with all gladness; and hold such in reputation:

\ln Galonedvyeno utseli digalvwisdanedi gesv nvdagalisdodisgvgi alequo nuyohusvgi, nasquanigodisgvna gvnvi, nasgi usquadisdiyi galulogv aqualisdelvdodi itsinvi.
\syll ᎦᎶᏁᏛᏰᏃ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᎠᎴᏉ ᏄᏲᎱᏒᎩ, ᎾᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗᏍᎬᎾ ᎬᏅᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏍᏆᏗᏍᏗᏱ ᎦᎷᎶᎬ ᎠᏆᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ ᎢᏥᏅᎢ.
\ft Because for the work of Christ he was nigh unto death, not regarding his life, to supply your lack of service toward me.

\ln Ulisqualvdino gesv idalinvtli, itsaliheligi Ugvwiyuhi gesv iyusdi.  Hia nasgi witsvyowelanediyi, udohiyuhi vtla tsuyaweisdi yagiyelvha ayv, nihisgini unayehisdi gesv itsudalesgi.
\syll ᎤᎵᏍᏆᎸᏗᏃ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᎢᏣᎵᎮᎵᎩ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ.  ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏫᏨᏲᏪᎳᏁᏗᏱ, ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎥᏝ ᏧᏯᏪᎢᏍᏗ ᏯᎩᏰᎸᎭ ᎠᏴ, ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᎾᏰᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏧᏓᎴᏍᎩ.
\ft Finally, my brethren, rejoice in the Lord. To write the same things to you, to me indeed is not grievous, but for you it is safe.

\ln Detseyadotsehesdi gili, detseyadotsehesdi uyo tsunilvwisdanehi; detseyadotsehesdi dinihusdesgi.
\syll ᏕᏤᏯᏙᏤᎮᏍᏗ ᎩᎵ, ᏕᏤᏯᏙᏤᎮᏍᏗ ᎤᏲ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ; ᏕᏤᏯᏙᏤᎮᏍᏗ ᏗᏂᎱᏍᏕᏍᎩ.
\ft Beware of dogs, beware of evil workers, beware of the concision.

\ln Ayvyeno tsegiusdeselvhi, Unelanvhi Adanvdo gvdi edadadolisdanehi tsigi, ale idaliheligi Galonedv Tsisa edalisgasdodv iyusdi, ale uquedali gesv nigalisgasdodvna tsigi.
\syll ᎠᏴᏰᏃ ᏤᎩᎤᏍᏕᏎᎸᎯ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎬᏗ ᎡᏓᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏓᎵᎮᎵᎩ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏥᏌ ᎡᏓᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏛ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎨᏒ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏛᎾ ᏥᎩ.
\ft For we are the circumcision, which worship God in the spirit, and rejoice in Christ Jesus, and have no confidence in the flesh.

\ln Nasquosgininonv ayv agiha uquedali gesv gvqualisgasdododi gesvi.  Iyuno gilo yeli yuha yuyelv uquedali gesv gvwalisgasdododi gesvi, ayv utli igai [agiha;]
\syll ᎾᏍᏉᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎠᏴ ᎠᎩᎭ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏆᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.  ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᏰᎵ ᏳᎭ ᏳᏰᎸ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏩᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᏴ ᎤᏟ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎠᎩᎭ;data is invalid
\ft Though I might also have confidence in the flesh. If any other man thinketh that he hath whereof he might trust in the flesh, I more:

\ln Tsuneline iga vgihusdeselvgi, Isili unadatselidv gesv nvdvquadalenvhi, Queni anilasdalv gela, Tsiquilu Aniquilu nvdvquadalenvhi; dikahnawadvsdino detsikahnawadisv Tsiqualisi;
\syll ᏧᏁᎵᏁ ᎢᎦ ᎥᎩᎱᏍᏕᏎᎸᎩ, ᎢᏏᎵ ᎤᎾᏓᏤᎵᏛ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏛᏆᏓᎴᏅᎯ, ᏇᏂ ᎠᏂᎳᏍᏓᎸ ᎨᎳ, ᏥᏈᎷ ᎠᏂᏈᎷ ᏅᏛᏆᏓᎴᏅᎯ; ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗᏃ ᏕᏥᎧᎿᏩᏗᏒ ᏥᏆᎵᏏ;
\ft Circumcised the eighth day, of the stock of Israel, of the tribe of Benjamin, an Hebrew of the Hebrews; as touching the law, a Pharisee;

\ln Ulinigidvno adanvdadisdi gesv ugvwali, detsigiliyoisdisgvgi tsunanelodi dunadatlugvi; duyugodv iyadvnedi gesv ugvwali dikahnawadvsdi detsikahnawadisvi, gayvgilawisedi nigesvna gesvgi.
\syll ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛᏃ ᎠᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ, ᏕᏥᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᏚᎾᏓᏡᎬᎢ; ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏕᏥᎧᎿᏩᏗᏒᎢ, ᎦᏴᎩᎳᏫᏎᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎩ.
\ft Concerning zeal, persecuting the church; touching the righteousness which is in the law, blameless.

\ln Aseno nigav nasgi gvqualisdelvdodi agiyelvnvi, nasgi esgaquo iyaquvnehi agiyelvha Galonedv nvdagalisdoda.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏆᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ ᎠᎩᏰᎸᏅᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎢᏯᏋᏁᎯ ᎠᎩᏰᎸᎭ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏓ.
\ft But what things were gain to me, those I counted loss for Christ.

\ln Vv, udohiyuhi, ale nigavquo gohusdi esga iyaquvnehi agiyelvha nvdigalisdodiha udagonadvtanvhi gesv tsigadovhisdi gesv Galonedv Tsisa aquatseli Ugvwiyuhi; nasgi tsinvdigalisdodiha nigadiyu tsudalenvdv agiyohuselvhi tsigi, ale uneilvdiquo agiyelvha nasgi, Galonedv nasgi aquatseli itsayvnediyi,
\syll ᎥᎥ, ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᎥᏉ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎡᏍᎦ ᎢᏯᏋᏁᎯ ᎠᎩᏰᎸᎭ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎤᏓᎪᎾᏛᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏥᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏥᏌ ᎠᏆᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎠᎩᏲᎱᏎᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎢᎸᏗᏉ ᎠᎩᏰᎸᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ, ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏆᏤᎵ ᎢᏣᏴᏁᏗᏱ,
\ft Yea doubtless, and I count all things but loss for the excellency of the knowledge of Christ Jesus my Lord: for whom I have suffered the loss of all things, and do count them but dung, that I may win Christ,

\ln Ale nasgi detsiyanelodv vgiwadvdiyi, aquadudalesdodi aquvsv aquatseli nagihvna gesvi, nasgi dikahnawadvsdi gvwadanedi tsigi, nasgini Galonedv gohiyudi gesv tsvdidalehvsga, nasgi adudalesdodi gesv Unelanvhi nvdayudalenvhi tsigi, nasgi gohiyudi gesv gvdodi tsigi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏕᏥᏯᏁᎶᏛ ᎥᎩᏩᏛᏗᏱ, ᎠᏆᏚᏓᎴᏍᏙᏗ ᎠᏋᏒ ᎠᏆᏤᎵ ᎾᎩᎲᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎬᏩᏓᏁᏗ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩᏂ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏨᏗᏓᎴᎲᏍᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏚᏓᎴᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏙᏗ ᏥᎩ.
\ft And be found in him, not having mine own righteousness, which is of the law, but that which is through the faith of Christ, the righteousness which is of God by faith:

\ln Nasgi tsigadovhisdiyi, ale ulinigidiyu gesv nasgi uyohusv dulehisanvi, ale aqueladisdisgv nasgi ugiliyotsidolvi, ale uyohusv nasgiya agiyohuhisdiyi;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏲᎱᏒ ᏚᎴᎯᏌᏅᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏇᎳᏗᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎩᎵᏲᏥᏙᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏲᎱᏒ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎠᎩᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗᏱ;
\ft That I may know him, and the power of his resurrection, and the fellowship of his sufferings, being made conformable unto his death;

\ln Nasgi gohusdi nvdayuliyilvsdodiyi ayohusv dilehisodi gesv waqualiyeilohisdiyi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏅᏓᏳᎵᏱᎸᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎠᏲᎱᏒ ᏗᎴᎯᏐᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏩᏆᎵᏰᎢᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ.
\ft If by any means I might attain unto the resurrection of the dead.

\ln Vtlasgininonv gayula tsidaginiyvso nasgiya yagiyelvha, vtla ale agisquadvhi gayula yagiyelvha; tsisdawadegasgini, iyu yeli yigi, nasgi diginiyvdiyi nasgi nasquo ugvwali Galonedv Tsisa tsidaginiyvhvgi.
\syll ᎥᏝᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎦᏳᎳ ᏥᏓᎩᏂᏴᏐ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏯᎩᏰᎸᎭ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎩᏍᏆᏛᎯ ᎦᏳᎳ ᏯᎩᏰᎸᎭ; ᏥᏍᏓᏩᏕᎦᏍᎩᏂ, ᎢᏳ ᏰᎵ ᏱᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎩᏂᏴᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏥᏌ ᏥᏓᎩᏂᏴᎲᎩ.
\ft Not as though I had already attained, either were already perfect: but I follow after, if that I may apprehend that for which also I am apprehended of Christ Jesus.

\ln Idalinvtli, vtla gayula aginiyvdv sgiyelvha; sudalegisgini [nigadvnehoi;] aquvgewisgoi tsudalenvdv oniditlv nusdidegvi, igvyiditlvno tsudalenvdv nusdidegv widitsiniyisgoi,
\syll ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᎥᏝ ᎦᏳᎳ ᎠᎩᏂᏴᏛ ᏍᎩᏰᎸᎭ; ᏑᏓᎴᎩᏍᎩᏂ ᏂᎦᏛᏁᎰᎢ;data is invalid ᎠᏋᎨᏫᏍᎪᎢ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎣᏂᏗᏢ ᏄᏍᏗᏕᎬᎢ, ᎢᎬᏱᏗᏢᏃ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏄᏍᏗᏕᎬ ᏫᏗᏥᏂᏱᏍᎪᎢ,
\ft Brethren, I count not myself to have apprehended: but this one thing I do, forgetting those things which are behind, and reaching forth unto those things which are before,

\ln Digedv iditlv degalisqualiha asasdv diginiyvdiyi nasgi unelanvhi galvladi nvdayudalenvhi adayanvdodi gesv Galonedv Tsisa agvdisgvi.
\syll ᏗᎨᏛ ᎢᏗᏢ ᏕᎦᎵᏍᏆᎵᎭ ᎠᏌᏍᏛ ᏗᎩᏂᏴᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᎠᏓᏯᏅᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏥᏌ ᎠᎬᏗᏍᎬᎢ.
\ft I press toward the mark for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi, ayv nidiv igisquadvhi gesvi, nasgi nusdesdi igadanvtesdi; ale iyu gohusdi gesv nvwadale nusdesdi dotsadanvtesdi, Unelanvhi nasgi hia nasquo gvnigesv nvdatsvneli.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᎠᏴ ᏂᏗᎥ ᎢᎩᏍᏆᏛᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᎢᎦᏓᏅᏖᏍᏗ; ᎠᎴ ᎢᏳ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᏄᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᏙᏣᏓᏅᏖᏍᏗ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏅᏓᏨᏁᎵ.
\ft Let us therefore, as many as be perfect, be thus minded: and if in any thing ye be otherwise minded, God shall reveal even this unto you.

\ln Adina nahna gayula wigaliyilolvi, utloyiquo dikahnawadvsdi deganelodidisesdi, utloyiquo idadanvtesgesdi.
\syll ᎠᏗᎾ ᏀᎾ ᎦᏳᎳ ᏫᎦᎵᏱᎶᎸᎢ, ᎤᏠᏱᏉ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏕᎦᏁᎶᏗᏗᏎᏍᏗ, ᎤᏠᏱᏉ ᎢᏓᏓᏅᏖᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
\ft Nevertheless, whereto we have already attained, let us walk by the same rule, let us mind the same thing.

\ln Idalinvtli, itsatequalohi sgisdawadegi gesesdi, ale detsagasayasdesdi nasgi iyanadvnehi anedohvi, nasgi ayv sgiyadeloquaehi tsidesgiyakaha.
\syll ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᎢᏣᏖᏆᎶᎯ ᏍᎩᏍᏓᏩᏕᎩ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᏣᎦᏌᏯᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏯᎾᏛᏁᎯ ᎠᏁᏙᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᏍᎩᏯᏕᎶᏆᎡᎯ ᏥᏕᏍᎩᏯᎧᎭ.
\ft Brethren, be followers together of me, and mark them which walk so as ye have us for an ensample.

\ln Unitsatayeno anedoha, nasgi uwagutilodv gatsineistanvhi itsvnonelvhi, ale gohi gesv nasquo digagatloyihi itsvnoneha, nasgi anisgagi gesv tsudahnawadv Galonedv utseliga;
\syll ᎤᏂᏣᏔᏰᏃ ᎠᏁᏙᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏩᎫᏘᎶᏛ ᎦᏥᏁᎢᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎢᏨᏃᏁᎸᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏗᎦᎦᏠᏱᎯ ᎢᏨᏃᏁᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᎩ ᎨᏒ ᏧᏓᎿᏩᏛ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ;
\ft (For many walk, of whom I have told you often, and now tell you even weeping, that they are the enemies of the cross of Christ:

\ln Nasgi unisquadisdodi gesv adadvdisgi tsigi, Unanelanvhi unisquoliyiquo tsigi, ale unadehohisdisgiquo anatlvquisdisgi tsigi, nasgi elohiquo ehi unagasayasdi tsigi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᏍᏆᏗᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏓᏛᏗᏍᎩ ᏥᎩ, ᎤᎾᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏂᏍᏉᎵᏱᏉ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏕᎰᎯᏍᏗᏍᎩᏉ ᎠᎾᏢᏈᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᎶᎯᏉ ᎡᎯ ᎤᎾᎦᏌᏯᏍᏗ ᏥᎩ.
\ft Whose end is destruction, whose God is their belly, and whose glory is in their shame, who mind earthly things.)

\ln Ayvyeno galvladi idehi; nahna nasquo nvdayulohisdiyi tsidigatenoha Igisdelisgi, nasgi Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv;
\syll ᎠᏴᏰᏃ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎢᏕᎯ; ᏀᎾ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏅᏓᏳᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏥᏗᎦᏖᏃᎭ ᎢᎩᏍᏕᎵᏍᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ;
\ft For our conversation is in heaven; from whence also we look for the Saviour, the Lord Jesus Christ:

\ln Nasgi diginetliyvedi tsigi nidigalvquodvna didiyelvi, nasgiya itsuwanediyi uwasv galvquodiyu ayelv nusdvi, nasgiya ulinigvgv gvdisgv nigadiyu tsudalenvdv uwasv digvwanelododiyi iyuwanediyi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎩᏁᏟᏴᎡᏗ ᏥᎩ ᏂᏗᎦᎸᏉᏛᎾ ᏗᏗᏰᎸᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎢᏧᏩᏁᏗᏱ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏰᎸ ᏄᏍᏛᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎤᎵᏂᎬᎬ ᎬᏗᏍᎬ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏗᎬᏩᏁᎶᏙᏗᏱ ᎢᏳᏩᏁᏗᏱ.
\ft Who shall change our vile body, that it may be fashioned like unto his glorious body, according to the working whereby he is able even to subdue all things unto himself.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi idalinvtli itsvgeyui ale utsati itsvyanvti, sgiyalielisdisgi ale aqualisdulododi, nvwasdesdi ulinigidv detsidogesdi Ugvwiyuhi etsalisgasdodvi, itsvgeyui.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ ᎢᏨᎨᏳᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎢᏨᏯᏅᏘ, ᏍᎩᏯᎵᎡᎵᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏆᎵᏍᏚᎶᏙᏗ, ᏅᏩᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᏕᏥᏙᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎡᏣᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏛᎢ, ᎢᏨᎨᏳᎢ.
\ft Therefore, my brethren dearly beloved and longed for, my joy and crown, so stand fast in the Lord, my dearly beloved.

\ln Tsisdiyediha Yuodiya, ale tsisdiyediha Sinidigi nasgi utloyiquo itsunvnediyi dunadanvdv Ugvwiyuhi danikahnawadisvi.
\syll ᏥᏍᏗᏰᏗᎭ ᏳᎣᏗᏯ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᏍᏗᏰᏗᎭ ᏏᏂᏗᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏠᏱᏉ ᎢᏧᏅᏁᏗᏱ ᏚᎾᏓᏅᏛ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏓᏂᎧᎿᏩᏗᏒᎢ.
\ft I beseech Euodias, and beseech Syntyche, that they be of the same mind in the Lord.

\ln Ale gvsdiyediha nasquo nihi nitsatlonasdvna gvginatequalohi, gvgisdelvdiyi na anigeyv gvgisdelvhidolvhi dagilvwisdanelv galitsidonidohv osdv kanohedv, hiyatloyastanvha nasquo Tlemina ale anisoi utloyi tsogilvwisdanehi, nasgi dunadov tsidegowela gvnidv adanehi gowelihi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎬᏍᏗᏰᏗᎭ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏂᎯ ᏂᏣᏠᎾᏍᏛᎾ ᎬᎩᎾᏖᏆᎶᎯ, ᎬᎩᏍᏕᎸᏗᏱ Ꮎ ᎠᏂᎨᏴ ᎬᎩᏍᏕᎸᎯᏙᎸᎯ ᏓᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸ ᎦᎵᏥᏙᏂᏙᎲ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ, ᎯᏯᏠᏯᏍᏔᏅᎭ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏞᎻᎾ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏐᎢ ᎤᏠᏱ ᏦᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᎾᏙᎥ ᏥᏕᎪᏪᎳ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎠᏓᏁᎯ ᎪᏪᎵᎯ.
\ft And I intreat thee also, true yokefellow, help those women which laboured with me in the gospel, with Clement also, and with other my fellowlabourers, whose names are in the book of life.

\ln Itsaliheligesdi nigohilv Ugvwiyuhi nvdigalisdodisgesdi; itsaliheligesdi, gadiha taline.
\syll ᎢᏣᎵᎮᎵᎨᏍᏗ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ; ᎢᏣᎵᎮᎵᎨᏍᏗ, ᎦᏗᎭ ᏔᎵᏁ.
\ft Rejoice in the Lord always: and again I say, Rejoice.

\ln Itsadanvtiyu gesv nanvi yvwi anigatahesdi; Ugvwiyuhi navniyu dayai.
\syll ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏘᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏅᎢ ᏴᏫ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎮᏍᏗ; ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎾᎥᏂᏳ ᏓᏯᎢ.
\ft Let your moderation be known unto all men. The Lord is at hand.

\ln Tlesdi gohusdi yitselihisgesdi; nudalesvsgini gohusdi adadolisdodi ale atayosdi gesv gvdi alihelisdi gvwalitloyasdi, gvnigesv netsvnehesdi Unelanvhi nusdv itsadulisgvi;
\syll ᏞᏍᏗ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏱᏤᎵᎯᏍᎨᏍᏗ; ᏄᏓᎴᏒᏍᎩᏂ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎠᏓᏙᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏔᏲᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏗ ᎠᎵᎮᎵᏍᏗ ᎬᏩᎵᏠᏯᏍᏗ, ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏁᏨᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎢᏣᏚᎵᏍᎬᎢ;
\ft Be careful for nothing; but in every thing by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known unto God.

\ln Nvwadohiyadvno Unelanvhi udanedi gesv, nasgi tsigalosvsdiha nigav gvdanvtedi gesvi, tsusquanigododi gesesdi ditsinawi ale ditsadanvdo, Galonedv Tsisa nigvnisisgesdi.
\syll ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᎦᎶᏒᏍᏗᎭ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎬᏓᏅᏖᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏧᏍᏆᏂᎪᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏗᏥᎾᏫ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏣᏓᏅᏙ, ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏥᏌ ᏂᎬᏂᏏᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
\ft And the peace of God, which passeth all understanding, shall keep your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus.

\ln Ulisqualvdino gesvi idalinvtli, nigav gayegogi nigesvna gesvi, nigav galvquododi gesvi, nigav duyugodv gesvi, nigav gadaha nigesvna gesvi, nigav osiyu gvyelvdi gesvi, nigav osiyu aninohesgesdi; iyuno osiyu iyadvnedi yeha, iyuno gohusdi galvquododi gesesdi, nasgi detsadanvtesgesdi.
\syll ᎤᎵᏍᏆᎸᏗᏃ ᎨᏒᎢ ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᏂᎦᎥ ᎦᏰᎪᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏂᎦᎥ ᎦᎸᏉᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏂᎦᎥ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏂᎦᎥ ᎦᏓᎭ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏂᎦᎥ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎬᏰᎸᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏂᎦᎥ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎠᏂᏃᎮᏍᎨᏍᏗ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᏗ ᏰᎭ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎦᎸᏉᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏕᏣᏓᏅᏖᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
\ft Finally, brethren, whatsoever things are true, whatsoever things are honest, whatsoever things are just, whatsoever things are pure, whatsoever things are lovely, whatsoever things are of good report; if there be any virtue, and if there be any praise, think on these things.

\ln Nasgi gudalenvdv sgiyadeloquaelvhi gesvi, ale disgiyadanilvtselvhi gesvi, ale sgiyadvganelvhi gesvi, ale sgigoelvhi gesvi, nitsadvnehesdi; Unelanvhino nvwadohiyadv adanehi ditsikahnawadidasdi gesesdi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎫᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏍᎩᏯᏕᎶᏆᎡᎸᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏍᎩᏯᏓᏂᎸᏤᎸᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏍᎩᏯᏛᎦᏁᎸᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏍᎩᎪᎡᎸᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ; ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏃ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᎠᏓᏁᎯ ᏗᏥᎧᎿᏩᏗᏓᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft Those things, which ye have both learned, and received, and heard, and seen in me, do: and the God of peace shall be with you.

\ln Aseno Ugvwiyuhi utsati tsiyalielitsvgi, nasgi hnaquo uwohitsvhi sgiyanvdv taline atsehiyogi, nasgi nahna ugvwali nasquo sgiyanvdvgi, aseno vtla yitsadlanvdadehei.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏥᏯᎵᎡᎵᏨᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎿᏉ ᎤᏬᎯᏨᎯ ᏍᎩᏯᏅᏛ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎠᏤᎯᏲᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏀᎾ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏍᎩᏯᏅᏛᎩ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏣᏜᏅᏓᏕᎮᎢ.
\ft But I rejoiced in the Lord greatly, that now at the last your care of me hath flourished again; wherein ye were also careful, but ye lacked opportunity.

\ln Vtla adina aginigvsehv tsineisdisgv yigi, aquadeloquavyeno nigav naqualisdanelidegv osiyuquo agiyelvdiyi.
\syll ᎥᏝ ᎠᏗᎾ ᎠᎩᏂᎬᏎᎲ ᏥᏁᎢᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᏆᏕᎶᏆᎥᏰᏃ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎾᏆᎵᏍᏓᏁᎵᏕᎬ ᎣᏏᏳᏉ ᎠᎩᏰᎸᏗᏱ.
\ft Not that I speak in respect of want: for I have learned, in whatsoever state I am, therewith to be content.

\ln Tsigataha iyaquadvnediyi eladi yinaquadvhnadega, ale tsigataha iyaquadvnediyi utsati yagiha; nigav degesadisvi, ale nigav naqualisdanelidegvi, vqueyonv iyaquadvnediyi nasquo yaquolanv ale nasquo yagiyosiha, nasquo utsati yagiha ale nasquo yaginigvseha
\syll ᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᎢᏯᏆᏛᏁᏗᏱ ᎡᎳᏗ ᏱᎾᏆᏛᎿᏕᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᎢᏯᏆᏛᏁᏗᏱ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏯᎩᎭ; ᏂᎦᎥ ᏕᎨᏌᏗᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎾᏆᎵᏍᏓᏁᎵᏕᎬᎢ, ᎥᏇᏲᏅ ᎢᏯᏆᏛᏁᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏯᏉᎳᏅ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏯᎩᏲᏏᎭ, ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏯᎩᎭ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏯᎩᏂᎬᏎᎭ
\ft I know both how to be abased, and I know how to abound: every where and in all things I am instructed both to be full and to be hungry, both to abound and to suffer need.

\ln Nigavquo igvquadvnedi Galonedv iyuwanisadv nasgi tsaqualinigohisdiha.
\syll ᏂᎦᎥᏉ ᎢᎬᏆᏛᏁᏗ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏣᏆᎵᏂᎪᎯᏍᏗᎭ.
\ft I can do all things through Christ which strengtheneth me.

\ln Asesgininonv osiyu nitsadvnelv tsisginelv aqualisdelvdodi tsigiliyogv iyui.
\syll ᎠᏎᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎣᏏᏳ ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎸ ᏥᏍᎩᏁᎸ ᎠᏆᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ ᏥᎩᎵᏲᎬ ᎢᏳᎢ.
\ft Notwithstanding ye have well done, that ye did communicate with my affliction.

\ln Nasgino nihi Quiligiyi itsehi, itsigatahesdi nasquo, nasgi osdv kanohedv igvyiyi itsvyalitsidonelv nahiyu Masidoni aquanigisv, vtla ilvhitlv unadatlugv tsunanelodi gohusdi yigvquadvnele nasgi adanedi ale vdatinedi gesv ugvwali, nihi itsvsv.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏂᎯ ᏈᎵᎩᏱ ᎢᏤᎯ, ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎮᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᏉ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎢᎬᏱᏱ ᎢᏨᏯᎵᏥᏙᏁᎸ ᏀᎢᏳ ᎹᏏᏙᏂ ᎠᏆᏂᎩᏒ, ᎥᏝ ᎢᎸᎯᏢ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏱᎬᏆᏛᏁᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏓᏁᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎥᏓᏘᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ, ᏂᎯ ᎢᏨᏒ.
\ft Now ye Philippians know also, that in the beginning of the gospel, when I departed from Macedonia, no church communicated with me as concerning giving and receiving, but ye only.

\ln Desilonigayeno wigedohv saquo nitsadanvsvgi aginigvsehv aqualisdelvdodi, ale nasquo talinei.
\syll ᏕᏏᎶᏂᎦᏰᏃ ᏫᎨᏙᎲ ᏌᏉ ᏂᏣᏓᏅᏒᎩ ᎠᎩᏂᎬᏎᎲ ᎠᏆᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏔᎵᏁᎢ.
\ft For even in Thessalonica ye sent once and again unto my necessity.

\ln Vtla adina aquadulisgv adanedi gesv yinvdigalisdodiha; udatanvhisgini aquaduliha utsati itsalisdelvdodi iyulisdodiyi.
\syll ᎥᏝ ᎠᏗᎾ ᎠᏆᏚᎵᏍᎬ ᎠᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏱᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ; ᎤᏓᏔᏅᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏆᏚᎵᎭ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
\ft Not because I desire a gift: but I desire fruit that may abound to your account.

\ln Aseno nigavquo agiha ale utsatanvhi; agikaliwohi, diquadanilvtsvhi gesv Iqua'lodada uyolvhi nasgi nvdatsadanvsvhi, utsati uganasdv gawasvgi, atsilv gelasdi digvdanilvisdi, osiyu uyelvdi Unelanvhi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᏂᎦᎥᏉ ᎠᎩᎭ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏣᏔᏅᎯ; ᎠᎩᎧᎵᏬᎯ, ᏗᏆᏓᏂᎸᏨᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏆᎶᏓᏓ ᎤᏲᎸᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏓᏣᏓᏅᏒᎯ, ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᎦᎾᏍᏛ ᎦᏩᏒᎩ, ᎠᏥᎸ ᎨᎳᏍᏗ ᏗᎬᏓᏂᎸᎢᏍᏗ, ᎣᏏᏳ ᎤᏰᎸᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ.
\ft But I have all, and abound: I am full, having received of Epaphroditus the things which were sent from you, an odour of a sweet smell, a sacrifice acceptable, wellpleasing to God.

\ln Aseno Aquanelanvhi itsinedi gesesdi nigav itsinigvsehvi, nasgiya uwehnaiyu ale galvquodiyu gesvi, Galonedv Tsisa iyuwanisadv.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᏆᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᏥᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎢᏥᏂᎬᏎᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎤᏪᎿᎢᏳ ᎠᎴ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏥᏌ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ.
\ft But my God shall supply all your need according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus.

\ln Hnaquono Unelanvhi ale Igidoda galvquododi gesesdi nigohilv ale nigohilvi.  Emenv.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎢᎩᏙᏓ ᎦᎸᏉᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎪᎯᎸᎢ.  ᎡᎺᏅ.
\ft Now unto God and our Father be glory for ever and ever. Amen.

\ln Detsiyoliha naniv unadanvti Galonedv Tsisa anohiyuhvsgi.  Otsalinvtli ani tsotsedoha wigetsiyoliha.
\syll ᏕᏥᏲᎵᎭ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏥᏌ ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ.  ᎣᏣᎵᏅᏟ ᎠᏂ ᏦᏤᏙᎭ ᏫᎨᏥᏲᎵᎭ.
\ft Salute every saint in Christ Jesus. The brethren which are with me greet you.

\ln Naniv unadanvti wigetsiyoliha, ho ugvwiyuha nasgi na Sisa dudatinavi.
\syll ᎾᏂᎥ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ ᏫᎨᏥᏲᎵᎭ, Ꮀ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏏᏌ ᏚᏓᏘᎾᎥᎢ.
\ft All the saints salute you, chiefly they that are of Caesar's household.

\ln Gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv Ugvwiyuhi igatseli Tsisa Galonedv utseliga itseladidohesdi nitsivi.  Emenv.
\syll ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᎢᏤᎳᏗᏙᎮᏍᏗ ᏂᏥᎥᎢ.  ᎡᎺᏅ.
\ft The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.

\ln Quola, Tsisa Galonedv aginvsidv nasgiya osiyu uyelvnv Unelanvhi, ale Dimadi iginvtli,
\syll ᏉᎳ, ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎠᎩᏅᏏᏛ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎤᏰᎸᏅ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎹᏗ ᎢᎩᏅᏟ,
\ft Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, and Timotheus our brother,

\ln Witsvyowelasi itsadanvti Golosi itsehi ale itsalinvtli Galonedv etsohiyuhvsgi; gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv, ale nvwadohiyadv itseladidohesdi nvdayunalisgolvtanvhi Unelanvhi Igidoda, ale Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv.
\syll ᏫᏨᏲᏪᎳᏏ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏘ ᎪᎶᏏ ᎢᏤᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏣᎵᏅᏟ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎡᏦᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ; ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᎢᏤᎳᏗᏙᎮᏍᏗ ᏅᏓᏳᎾᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏅᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᎩᏙᏓ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ.
\ft To the saints and faithful brethren in Christ which are at Colosse: Grace be unto you, and peace, from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

\ln Otsalielitseha Unelanvhi ale Ugvwiyuhi igatseli Tsisa Galonedv Udoda, otsadadolisdisgo nigohilv itsvyanvdadisgoi,
\syll ᎣᏣᎵᎡᎵᏤᎭ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏙᏓ, ᎣᏣᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎪ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎢᏨᏯᏅᏓᏗᏍᎪᎢ,
\ft We give thanks to God and the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, praying always for you,

\ln Ogadvganvhi gesv Galonedv Tsisa etsoiyusvi, ale detsigeyusv naniv unadanvti;
\syll ᎣᎦᏛᎦᏅᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏥᏌ ᎡᏦᎢᏳᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᏥᎨᏳᏒ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ;
\ft Since we heard of your faith in Christ Jesus, and of the love which ye have to all the saints,

\ln Nvdigalisdodiha udugi itsvsv nasgi galvladi tsetsadvnvisdanelvi, nasgi gayula itsadvganvhi tsigi nahna gayegogi nigesvna osdv kanohedvyi,
\syll ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎢᏨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏤᏣᏛᏅᎢᏍᏓᏁᎸᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏳᎳ ᎢᏣᏛᎦᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ ᏀᎾ ᎦᏰᎪᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛᏱ,
\ft For the hope which is laid up for you in heaven, whereof ye heard before in the word of the truth of the gospel;

\ln Nasgi itsilutselvhi tsigi, nasgiya nigvnadv elohi tsunilutselv; ale tsigananugowisga udatanvhi nasgiya tsinigalisdi nihi itsehvi, nvdagvwadalenvdv itsadvganv nasgi, ale udohiyuhi itsigadovsv gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv Unelanvhi;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏥᎷᏤᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏂᎬᎾᏛ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏧᏂᎷᏤᎸ; ᎠᎴ ᏥᎦᎾᏄᎪᏫᏍᎦ ᎤᏓᏔᏅᎯ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏥᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏤᎲᎢ, ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎢᏣᏛᎦᏅ ᎾᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎢᏥᎦᏙᎥᏒ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ;
\ft Which is come unto you, as it is in all the world; and bringeth forth fruit, as it doth also in you, since the day ye heard of it, and knew the grace of God in truth:

\ln Nasgiya nasquo tsetsadvganelv Egaqua otsigeyui itsulaha oginvsidasdi, nihino tsinvdigalisdodi osdv iyadvnehi Galonedv unvsidasdi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏤᏣᏛᎦᏁᎸ ᎡᎦᏆ ᎣᏥᎨᏳᎢ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎣᎩᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ, ᏂᎯᏃ ᏥᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᎯ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ.
\ft As ye also learned of Epaphras our dear fellowservant, who is for you a faithful minister of Christ;

\ln Nasgi nasquo gvnigesv iyohvnelvhi detsadagesv Adanvdo iyuwanisadv.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏲᎲᏁᎸᎯ ᏕᏣᏓᎨᏒ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ.
\ft Who also declared unto us your love in the Spirit.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi ayv nasquo, ogadvganv nvdagvwadalenvdv, vtla yotsiyohisdisgo otsadadolisdisgv ale otsitayohihv nasgi adanvtesgv agadovhisdi gesv itsikaliisdiyi, nasgi nigav agadovhisdi gesv ale adanvdo ugvwali golitsidasdi gesvi;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᏉ, ᎣᎦᏛᎦᏅ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏓᎴᏅᏛ, ᎥᏝ ᏲᏥᏲᎯᏍᏗᏍᎪ ᎣᏣᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᎠᎴ ᎣᏥᏔᏲᎯᎲ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ ᎠᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏥᎧᎵᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎠᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᎪᎵᏥᏓᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ;
\ft For this cause we also, since the day we heard it, do not cease to pray for you, and to desire that ye might be filled with the knowledge of his will in all wisdom and spiritual understanding;

\ln Nasgi itsalenidasdiyi nasgiya Ugvwiyuhi dinikahnawadegi iyunadvnedi gesvi, nigav osiyu uyelvdi gesvi, nasgi osdv digalvwisdanedi gesvi, utsati itsinanugowisgvi, ale kanequogv etsigadovsgv Unelanvhi;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏣᎴᏂᏓᏍᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏗᏂᎧᎿᏩᏕᎩ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏂᎦᎥ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎤᏰᎸᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᏣᏘ ᎢᏥᎾᏄᎪᏫᏍᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎧᏁᏉᎬ ᎡᏥᎦᏙᎥᏍᎬ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ;
\ft That ye might walk worthy of the Lord unto all pleasing, being fruitful in every good work, and increasing in the knowledge of God;

\ln Detsalinigosgvi gvtanvhi utsati ulinigidv gesvi, nasgiya nulinigvgv galvquodiyu utseliga, nasgi nigavquo ugvwali ditsvnidiyu itsalisdodiyi, ale gohidiyu unelagi itselisgv itsigiliyogvi, ulitloyasdodiyi alihelisdi gesvi;
\syll ᏕᏣᎵᏂᎪᏍᎬᎢ ᎬᏔᏅᎯ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᎵᏂᎬᎬ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᎥᏉ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᏗᏨᏂᏗᏳ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎪᎯᏗᏳ ᎤᏁᎳᎩ ᎢᏤᎵᏍᎬ ᎢᏥᎩᎵᏲᎬᎢ, ᎤᎵᏠᏯᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎠᎵᎮᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ;
\ft Strengthened with all might, according to his glorious power, unto all patience and longsuffering with joyfulness;

\ln Etsalielitsehv Agayvligei nasgi yeliquo igatloyasdodi igvwalisdodi igvnelvhi tsigi unatseli iyulisdodi gesv unadanvti igagadv anehi;
\syll ᎡᏣᎵᎡᎵᏤᎲ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏰᎵᏉ ᎢᎦᏠᏯᏍᏙᏗ ᎢᎬᏩᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᎢᎬᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎤᎾᏤᎵ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ ᎢᎦᎦᏛ ᎠᏁᎯ;
\ft Giving thanks unto the Father, which hath made us meet to be partakers of the inheritance of the saints in light:

\ln Nasgi igudaledv tsigi ulinigidiyu gesv ulisigi, ale nasgi widigikanvhi tsigi nahna ugvwiyuhi gesv ugeyuhi Uwetsi;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎫᏓᎴᏛ ᏥᎩ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎵᏏᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏫᏗᎩᎧᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ ᏀᎾ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎨᏳᎯ ᎤᏪᏥ;
\ft Who hath delivered us from the power of darkness, and hath translated us into the kingdom of his dear Son:

\ln Nasgi iyuwanisadv egaguyvdv tsigi ugigv gvtanvhi, nasgi igisganvtsv egidolitsvi;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ ᎡᎦᎫᏴᏛ ᏥᎩ ᎤᎩᎬ ᎬᏔᏅᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎩᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᎡᎩᏙᎵᏨᎢ;
\ft In whom we have redemption through his blood, even the forgiveness of sins:

\ln Nasgi tsagatlilostanvhi tsigi nusdv gvgowadvdi nigesvna Unelanvhi, nasgi igvyi udenvhi tsigi nigadiyu geganelanvhi anehvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏣᎦᏟᎶᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎬᎪᏩᏛᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎬᏱ ᎤᏕᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᎨᎦᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᏁᎲᎢ.
\ft Who is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn of every creature:

\ln Nasgiyeno nigav gohusdi tsuwotlvnvhi, nasgi galvladi tseha, ale elohi tseha, gvgowadvdi ale gvgowadvdi nigesvna tsigi, iyu unigvwiyuhi tsunidiyi yigi, ale unigvwiyusadegi yigi, ale getsilvquodi yigi, ale tsunalinigidv yigi; nigadiyu nudalesv nasgi duwotlvnei, ale uwasv dudadotlvnanelei;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏧᏬᏢᏅᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏤᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏤᎭ, ᎬᎪᏩᏛᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎬᎪᏩᏛᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏥᎩ, ᎢᏳ ᎤᏂᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏧᏂᏗᏱ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎨᏥᎸᏉᏗ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᎾᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᏱᎩ; ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏄᏓᎴᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᏬᏢᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏚᏓᏙᏢᎾᏁᎴᎢ;
\ft For by him were all things created, that are in heaven, and that are in earth, visible and invisible, whether they be thrones, or dominions, or principalities, or powers: all things were created by him, and for him:

\ln Ale nasgi igvyi nehoi oni nigav tsudalenvdv, ale nasgi nigvnisiha nigav gohusdi tseha;
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎬᏱ ᏁᎰᎢ ᎣᏂ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎬᏂᏏᎭ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏤᎭ;
\ft And he is before all things, and by him all things consist.

\ln Ale nasgi usgoli a ayelv gesvi, nasgi tsunanelodi unadatlugvi; nasgi didalenvdisgi, tsudalenvtanvhi uyohusv tsulehisanvhi, nasgi nigadiyu nunadalesv igvyi iyulisdodiyi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏍᎪᎵ Ꭰ ᎠᏰᎸ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏓᎴᏅᏗᏍᎩ, ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏔᏅᎯ ᎤᏲᎱᏒ ᏧᎴᎯᏌᏅᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏄᎾᏓᎴᏒ ᎢᎬᏱ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
\ft And he is the head of the body, the church: who is the beginning, the firstborn from the dead; that in all things he might have the preeminence.

\ln Osiyuyeno ayelvnvhi gese nasgi uwehi iyulisdodiyi nigav akaliihi gesvi;
\syll ᎣᏏᏳᏰᏃ ᎠᏰᎸᏅᎯ ᎨᏎ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏪᎯ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎠᎧᎵᎢᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ;
\ft For it pleased the Father that in him should all fullness dwell;

\ln Ale nasgi agvdisgv uwasv dohiyi iyunvnediyi nigadiyu tsudalenvdv, ugigv dadahnawasdv utsvnvhi uwohiyustanv; nasgi agvdisgvi, iyuno elohi anehi yigi, ale galvladi anehi yigi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎬᏗᏍᎬ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏙᎯᏱ ᎢᏳᏅᏁᏗᏱ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ, ᎤᎩᎬ ᏓᏓᎿᏩᏍᏛ ᎤᏨᏅᎯ ᎤᏬᎯᏳᏍᏔᏅ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎬᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎠᏁᎯ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎠᏁᎯ ᏱᎩ.
\ft And, having made peace through the blood of his cross, by him to reconcile all things unto himself; by him, I say, whether they be things in earth, or things in heaven.

\ln Nihino ilvhiyu netsadalequo tsigesei, ale etsisgagi tsigese doditsadanvdvi nasgi uyo detsilvwisdanehvi aseno gohi hnaquo itsohisdanelv,
\syll ᏂᎯᏃ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᏁᏣᏓᎴᏉ ᏥᎨᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎡᏥᏍᎦᎩ ᏥᎨᏎ ᏙᏗᏣᏓᏅᏛᎢ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏲ ᏕᏥᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎢ ᎠᏎᏃ ᎪᎯ ᎿᏉ ᎢᏦᎯᏍᏓᏁᎸ,
\ft And you, that were sometime alienated and enemies in your mind by wicked works, yet now hath he reconciled

\ln Uwvtanv ayelv uquedali gesv ayohusgvi, tsugvwale gvnigesv itsvnediyi nitsisganvna ale gohusdi netsuisdvna ale gayetsilawisedi nigesvna nasgi agatahvi;
\syll ᎤᏮᏔᏅ ᎠᏰᎸ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏲᎱᏍᎬᎢ, ᏧᎬᏩᎴ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏨᏁᏗᏱ ᏂᏥᏍᎦᏅᎾ ᎠᎴ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏁᏧᎢᏍᏛᎾ ᎠᎴ ᎦᏰᏥᎳᏫᏎᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎦᏔᎲᎢ;
\ft In the body of his flesh through death, to present you holy and unblameable and unreproveable in his sight:

\ln Iyuno yinvwasdidiquo itsohiyusvi, gagusdvnvhi ale asdayidvhi gesvi, ale iyvdv igayetsvnedi nigesvna yigi udugi itsvsv osdv kanohedvyi, nasgi itsadvganvhi tsigi, naniv geganelanvhi gesv gegalitsidonelvhi tsigi galvlo hawiniditlv nunadvnvi; nasgi nahna ayv Quola gohusdi Gadvnehi tsinvquvnelv;
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᏱᏅᏩᏍᏗᏗᏉ ᎢᏦᎯᏳᏒᎢ, ᎦᎫᏍᏛᏅᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏍᏓᏱᏛᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎢᎦᏰᏨᏁᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏱᎩ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎢᏨᏒ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏣᏛᎦᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏂᎥ ᎨᎦᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎨᎦᎵᏥᏙᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎦᎸᎶ ᎭᏫᏂᏗᏢ ᏄᎾᏛᏅᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᏀᎾ ᎠᏴ ᏉᎳ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎦᏛᏁᎯ ᏥᏅᏋᏁᎸ;
\ft If ye continue in the faith grounded and settled, and be not moved away from the hope of the gospel, which ye have heard, and which was preached to every creature which is under heaven; whereof I Paul am made a minister;

\ln Ayv nasgi gohi gesv tsigalieliga itsvgiliyotsehvi, ale tsitsikalisisi asi unosvi galonedv ugiliyotsv nasgiya agiquedalv tsigiliyogvi, nasgi ayelv tsinvdigalisdodiha, nasgi tsunanelodi unadatlugv tsigi;
\syll ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏥᎦᎵᎡᎵᎦ ᎢᏨᎩᎵᏲᏤᎲᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᏥᎧᎵᏏᏏ ᎠᏏ ᎤᏃᏒᎢ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᎩᎵᏲᏨ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎠᎩᏇᏓᎸ ᏥᎩᎵᏲᎬᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏰᎸ ᏥᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬ ᏥᎩ;
\ft Who now rejoice in my sufferings for you, and fill up that which is behind of the afflictions of Christ in my flesh for his body's sake, which is the church:

\ln Nahna ayv digilvwisdanehi nvquvnelv nasgiya Unelanvhi udanetsedi gesvi, nasgi ayv tsvginelv nihi itsalisdelvdodi, nasgi akalii aqualitsidodiyi kanohedv Unelanvhi utseliga;
\syll ᏀᎾ ᎠᏴ ᏗᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᏅᏋᏁᎸ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏓᏁᏤᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᏨᎩᏁᎸ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎧᎵᎢ ᎠᏆᎵᏥᏙᏗᏱ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ;
\ft Whereof I am made a minister, according to the dispensation of God which is given to me for you, to fulfill the word of God;

\ln Nasgi udelidv gvsgalanvhi tsigesvgi eti tsigesv ale unadanetliyvsvsv nvdagvwadalenvdv, aseno gohi tsigi gvnigesv tsinigegvnelv unadanvti tsutseliga;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᎬᏍᎦᎳᏅᎯ ᏥᎨᏒᎩ ᎡᏘ ᏥᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏓᏁᏟᏴᏒᏒ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏓᎴᏅᏛ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎪᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏥᏂᎨᎬᏁᎸ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ ᏧᏤᎵᎦ;
\ft Even the mystery which hath been hid from ages and from generations, but now is made manifest to his saints:

\ln Nasgi [udanvti] Unelanvhi udulisge gvnigesv itsuwanediyi nigav galvquodiyu gesv hia nasgi udelidv gesv tsunadalenvdv yvwi anehv [gvnigesv tsinuwanelv;] nasgi Galonedv tsigi nihi itsiyai, nasgi udugi getsvdi tsinigvne galvquodiyu digesv witsinanugoisdiyi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏓᏅᏘdata is invalid ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎨ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏧᏩᏁᏗᏱ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᎨᏒ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᎠᏁᎲ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏥᏄᏩᏁᎸ;data is invalid ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏥᎩ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏥᏯᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎨᏨᏗ ᏥᏂᎬᏁ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᏗᎨᏒ ᏫᏥᎾᏄᎪᎢᏍᏗᏱ.
\ft To whom God would make known what is the riches of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles; which is Christ in you, the hope of glory:

\ln Nasgi na gvnigesv tsinotsvneha, naniv tsidotseyatahvsga, ale naniv tsidotseyohvsga tsotsvdiha nigav alisinahisdodi gesvi, nasgi naniv gvnigesv itsotsvnediyi nunigolvna Galonedv Tsisa dunanelodvi;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏥᏃᏨᏁᎭ, ᎾᏂᎥ ᏥᏙᏤᏯᏔᎲᏍᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏥᏙᏤᏲᎲᏍᎦ ᏦᏨᏗᎭ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎠᎵᏏᏀᎢᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏦᏨᏁᏗᏱ ᏄᏂᎪᎸᎾ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏥᏌ ᏚᎾᏁᎶᏛᎢ;
\ft Whom we preach, warning every man, and teaching every man in all wisdom; that we may present every man perfect in Christ Jesus:

\ln Nasgi nasquo ugvwali tsidagilvwisdaneha, tsigatlinigvneha nasgiya tsulvwisdanedi gesvi, nasgi ulinigidiyu tsidulvwisdaneha diquadanvdvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᏥᏓᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎭ, ᏥᎦᏟᏂᎬᏁᎭ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏧᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ ᏥᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎭ ᏗᏆᏓᏅᏛᎢ.
\ft Whereunto I also labour, striving according to his working, which worketh in me mightily.

\ln Aquaduliyeno itsigadovhisdiyi nigav tsigiliyogv gatlinigvnehv nihi gesv iyusdi, ale nasgi na Leodisiya anehi, ale nanivquo unigohvhi nigesvna aquakadv ani uquedali gesvi;
\syll ᎠᏆᏚᎵᏰᏃ ᎢᏥᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏥᎩᎵᏲᎬ ᎦᏟᏂᎬᏁᎲ ᏂᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎴᎣᏗᏏᏯ ᎠᏁᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏂᎥᏉ ᎤᏂᎪᎲᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎠᏆᎧᏛ ᎠᏂ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎨᏒᎢ;
\ft For I would that ye knew what great conflict I have for you, and for them at Laodicea, and for as many as have not seen my face in the flesh;

\ln Nasgi tsuninawi ugalisdi digvwadanvdadisdi iyulisdodiyi dunadudadewisdv adageyudi gesvi, ale wuniyilohisdiyi nigav galvquodiyu gesv nudlasidvsvna gohiyudi gesv nasgi golisdi gesv tsvdidalehvsga, unigadovhisdiyi udelidv gesv Unelanvhi utseliga, nasgi Agayvlige utseliga, ale Galonedv utseliga;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏂᎾᏫ ᎤᎦᎵᏍᏗ ᏗᎬᏩᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏚᎾᏚᏓᏕᏫᏍᏛ ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏭᏂᏱᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᏄᏜᏏᏛᏒᎾ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏨᏗᏓᎴᎲᏍᎦ, ᎤᏂᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ;
\ft That their hearts might be comforted, being knit together in love, and unto all riches of the full assurance of understanding, to the acknowledgement of the mystery of God, and of the Father, and of Christ;

\ln Nasgi tsidusquanigodi tsiduwasgala nigav utsati tsugvwalodi alisinahisdodi gesv ale agadovhisdi gesvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏚᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᏥᏚᏩᏍᎦᎳ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎠᎵᏏᏀᎢᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft In whom are hid all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge.

\ln Ale hia nasgi nitsiweha nasgi gilo itsilonuhediyi nigesvna nasgi uwoduhi gawonihisdi gesv gvdi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᏥᏪᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏥᎶᏄᎮᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏬᏚᎯ ᎦᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏗ.
\ft And this I say, lest any man should beguile you with enticing words.

\ln Agigonelvsgininonv agiquedalv gesvi, aseno aquadanvdo gesv itsvyeladidoha, galieliga ale degaganiha osiyu nitsadvnehv, ale ulinigidiyu gesv etsoiyusv Galonedv.
\syll ᎠᎩᎪᏁᎸᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎠᎩᏇᏓᎸ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏙ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏨᏰᎳᏗᏙᎭ, ᎦᎵᎡᎵᎦ ᎠᎴ ᏕᎦᎦᏂᎭ ᎣᏏᏳ ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎲ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎡᏦᎢᏳᏒ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ.
\ft For though I be absent in the flesh, yet am I with you in the spirit, joying and beholding your order, and the stedfastness of your faith in Christ.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi nasgiya tsetsadanilvtsvhi gesv Galonedv Tsisa Ugvwiyuhi, nasgiya nusdesdi etsisdawadisvi;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏤᏣᏓᏂᎸᏨᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏥᏌ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᎡᏥᏍᏓᏩᏗᏒᎢ;
\ft As ye have therefore received Christ Jesus the Lord, so walk ye in him:

\ln Nahna ditsihnasdedladvhi ale nahna etsanesgehvhi, ale ulinigidv iyetsvnelvhi itsohiyusvi, nasgiya etseyonvi, nasgi utsati gesesdi [itsohiyusvi] ulitloyasdesdi alihelitsedi gesv Unelanvhi.
\syll ᏀᎾ ᏗᏥᎿᏍᏕᏜᏛᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏀᎾ ᎡᏣᏁᏍᎨᎲᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᎢᏰᏨᏁᎸᎯ ᎢᏦᎯᏳᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎡᏤᏲᏅᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎢᏦᎯᏳᏒᎢdata is invalid ᎤᎵᏠᏯᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᎠᎵᎮᎵᏤᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ.
\ft Rooted and built up in him, and stablished in the faith, as ye have been taught, abounding therein with thanksgiving.

\ln Itseyatahesdi tlesdi gilo tsitsinasani, asinasdv gawonihisdi gesv gvdi ale atlonuhedi gvdi, nasgiya yvwi danadeyohvsgvi, nasgiya elohi dilenvdodi dadeyohvsgvi, vtlano nasgiya Galonedv dadeyohvsgvi;
\syll ᎢᏤᏯᏔᎮᏍᏗ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎩᎶ ᏥᏥᎾᏌᏂ, ᎠᏏᎾᏍᏛ ᎦᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏠᏄᎮᏗ ᎬᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏴᏫ ᏓᎾᏕᏲᎲᏍᎬᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏗᎴᏅᏙᏗ ᏓᏕᏲᎲᏍᎬᎢ, ᎥᏝᏃ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏓᏕᏲᎲᏍᎬᎢ;
\ft Beware lest any man spoil you through philosophy and vain deceit, after the tradition of men, after the rudiments of the world, and not after Christ.

\ln Nasgiyeno [Galonedv] ayelvi ayaa nigadv akalii Unelanvhi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎦᎶᏁᏛdata is invalid ᎠᏰᎸᎢ ᎠᏯᎠ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎠᎧᎵᎢ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ.
\ft For in him dwelleth all the fullness of the Godhead bodily.

\ln Ale etsikalilvhi nasgi iyuwanisanvhi nasgi nugvwiyusadegi tsigi naniv nunigvwiyusadegi, ale digeganelodi gesvi;
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎡᏥᎧᎵᎸᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏅᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ ᏥᎩ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎨᎦᏁᎶᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ;
\ft And ye are complete in him, which is the head of all principality and power:

\ln Nasgi nasquo iyuwanisanvhi tsetsiusdeselvhi tsigi, ahusdesdi gvtanvhi nasgi gilo tsuwoyeni tsuwatanvhi nigesvna, nasgi iyvdv nitsvnehv ayeli nasgi uquedali gesv usganvistanvi itsvdisgv Galonedv utseli ahusdesdi gesvi;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏅᎯ ᏤᏥᎤᏍᏕᏎᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᎱᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᎬᏔᏅᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎩᎶ ᏧᏬᏰᏂ ᏧᏩᏔᏅᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏂᏨᏁᎲ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏍᎦᏅᎢᏍᏔᏅᎢ ᎢᏨᏗᏍᎬ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎠᎱᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ;
\ft In whom also ye are circumcised with the circumcision made without hands, in putting off the body of the sins of the flesh by the circumcision of Christ:

\ln Etsinisanv nasgi atsinisanv didawosdi gesv gvtanvhi, nasgi nasquo gvtanvhi detsaletanv nasgi dagaletanvi nvtsulisdotanv itsohiyusv Unelanvhi dulvwisdanelvi, nasgi tsuletanvhi tsigi uyohusvi.
\syll ᎡᏥᏂᏌᏅ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏥᏂᏌᏅ ᏗᏓᏬᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏔᏅᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎬᏔᏅᎯ ᏕᏣᎴᏔᏅ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏓᎦᎴᏔᏅᎢ ᏅᏧᎵᏍᏙᏔᏅ ᎢᏦᎯᏳᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᎴᏔᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎤᏲᎱᏒᎢ.
\ft Buried with him in baptism, wherein also ye are risen with him through the faith of the operation of God, who hath raised him from the dead.

\ln Nihino ditsiyohusvhi nigesv utsatini nitsadvnelv itsadudalvi ale nidetsiusdeselvna gesv itsiquedalvi, ditsvnodv nitsvnelv nasgi gvnodv nagvnelvi, gayetsinelv nigadiyu utsatini nitsadvnelvi,
\syll ᏂᎯᏃ ᏗᏥᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᏂᎨᏒ ᎤᏣᏘᏂ ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎸ ᎢᏣᏚᏓᎸᎢ ᎠᎴ ᏂᏕᏥᎤᏍᏕᏎᎸᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏥᏇᏓᎸᎢ, ᏗᏨᏃᏛ ᏂᏨᏁᎸ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏃᏛ ᎾᎬᏁᎸᎢ, ᎦᏰᏥᏁᎸ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᎤᏣᏘᏂ ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎸᎢ,
\ft And you, being dead in your sins and the uncircumcision of your flesh, hath he quickened together with him, having forgiven you all trespasses;

\ln Ayosdisgv gowelv dikahnawadvsdi igatludisgi, nasgi igiyosdodanehi tsigesvgi, ale uhvsvgi, utseli dadahnawasdv uweyalvnvgi yvwi duwehatanvgi;
\syll ᎠᏲᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᎪᏪᎸ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎢᎦᏡᏗᏍᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎩᏲᏍᏙᏓᏁᎯ ᏥᎨᏒᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎲᏒᎩ, ᎤᏤᎵ ᏓᏓᎿᏩᏍᏛ ᎤᏪᏯᎸᏅᎩ ᏴᏫ ᏚᏪᎭᏔᏅᎩ;
\ft Blotting out the handwriting of ordinances that was against us, which was contrary to us, and took it out of the way, nailing it to his cross;

\ln Dunasanvno nunigvwiyusadegi ale digeganelodi gesvi, gvnigesv dunanugowisei, dadalinehidegei nasgi [dadahnawasdv] gvdisgvi.
\syll ᏚᎾᏌᏅᏃ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎨᎦᏁᎶᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏚᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᎢ, ᏓᏓᎵᏁᎯᏕᎨᎢ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏓᏓᎿᏩᏍᏛdata is invalid ᎬᏗᏍᎬᎢ.
\ft And having spoiled principalities and powers, he made a shew of them openly, triumphing over them in it.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi tlesdi gilo yiditsugodanehesdi alisdayvdi ugvwali, ale aditasdi, ale galvquodi iga, ale itse nvdo atlvnegvi, ale dunadodaquasgv iga;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎩᎶ ᏱᏗᏧᎪᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏗᏔᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᎸᏉᏗ ᎢᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏤ ᏅᏙ ᎠᏢᏁᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᎾᏙᏓᏆᏍᎬ ᎢᎦ;
\ft Let no man therefore judge you in meat, or in drink, or in respect of an holyday, or of the new moon, or of the sabbath days:

\ln Nasgi udawadisdodvquo gesvgi nasgi na tsudalenvdv uliyilohisdi gesvi; adawadisdodisgisgini Galonedv gesvgi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏓᏩᏗᏍᏙᏛᏉ ᎨᏒᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎤᎵᏱᎶᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎠᏓᏩᏗᏍᏙᏗᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎨᏒᎩ.
\ft Which are a shadow of things to come; but the body is of Christ.

\ln Tlesdi gilo tsitsilunuheli tsitsiyosdodaneli asasdv etsinediyi udulisgv udadolisdi iyulisdodiyi, ale dinikahnawadidohi tsunadadolisdanediyi, nasgi ulisalanehv ugohvhi nigesvna gesvi, asequoquo adequvhisdisgv gvdisgv uquedali udanvtedi gesvi;
\syll ᏞᏍᏗ ᎩᎶ ᏥᏥᎷᏄᎮᎵ ᏥᏥᏲᏍᏙᏓᏁᎵ ᎠᏌᏍᏛ ᎡᏥᏁᏗᏱ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎬ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏂᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏧᎾᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎵᏌᎳᏁᎲ ᎤᎪᎲᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᏎᏉᏉ ᎠᏕᏋᎯᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᎬᏗᏍᎬ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎤᏓᏅᏖᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ;
\ft Let no man beguile you of your reward in a voluntary humility and worshipping of angels, intruding into those things which he hath not seen, vainly puffed up by his fleshly mind,

\ln Ale niduniyvsvna gesv Asgoli, nahna tsvdidalehvsga nigv ayelvi duhitlewisvi ale tsuwaduna duwedolvi ulisdelvdodoi, ale dududadewisoi advsgoi nasgiya Unelanvhi unequosgvi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏂᏚᏂᏴᏒᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏍᎪᎵ, ᏀᎾ ᏨᏗᏓᎴᎲᏍᎦ ᏂᎬ ᎠᏰᎸᎢ ᏚᎯᏞᏫᏒᎢ ᎠᎴ ᏧᏩᏚᎾ ᏚᏪᏙᎸᎢ ᎤᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏙᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏚᏓᏕᏫᏐᎢ ᎠᏛᏍᎪᎢ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏁᏉᏍᎬᎢ.
\ft And not holding the Head, from which all the body by joints and bands having nourishment ministered, and knit together, increaseth with the increase of God.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi, iyuno Galonedv uyohusv ditsiyohusvhi gesesdi elohi ehi alenvdodi dideloquasdi ugvwali, gadono elohi tsitseho nasgiya dotsanelodi dikahnawadvsdi,
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏲᎱᏒ ᏗᏥᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎡᎯ ᎠᎴᏅᏙᏗ ᏗᏕᎶᏆᏍᏗ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ, ᎦᏙᏃ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏥᏤᎰ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏙᏣᏁᎶᏗ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ,
\ft Wherefore if ye be dead with Christ from the rudiments of the world, why, as though living in the world, are ye subject to ordinances,

\ln Yvwi uninetsvhi ale tsunadeyonvhi?  nasgi tlesdi tsasvnilvgi; tlesdi usdiunv tsagvgi; tlesdi tsayidolvgi;
\syll ᏴᏫ ᎤᏂᏁᏨᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏧᎾᏕᏲᏅᎯ?  ᎾᏍᎩ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏣᏒᏂᎸᎩ; ᏞᏍᏗ ᎤᏍᏗᎤᏅ ᏣᎬᎩ; ᏞᏍᏗ ᏣᏱᏙᎸᎩ;
\ft (Touch not; taste not; handle not;

\ln (Nigadvyeno nasgi unalidvdodi gohusdi dehvdisgv iyui;)
\syll ᏂᎦᏛᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᎵᏛᏙᏗ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏕᎲᏗᏍᎬ ᎢᏳᎢ;
\ft Which all are to perish with the using;) after the commandments and doctrines of men?

\ln Nasgi tsudalenvdv udohiyuhi alisinahisdodi gesv datselv, nasgi nahna owasv odanvtedv Unelanvhi adadolisdanedi gesvi, ale odadolisdi gesvi, ale nogasayasdvna gesv vyelvi, vtlano nasgi agalvquodisgvi, uquedali unigvsehv vwadvehvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎠᎵᏏᏀᎢᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏓᏤᎸ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏀᎾ ᎣᏩᏒ ᎣᏓᏅᏖᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎣᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏃᎦᏌᏯᏍᏛᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎥᏰᎸᎢ, ᎥᏝᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎦᎸᏉᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎤᏂᎬᏎᎲ ᎥᏩᏛᎡᎲᎢ.
\ft Which things have indeed a shew of wisdom in will worship, and humility, and neglecting of the body; not in any honour to the satisfying of the flesh.

\ln Iyuno howa Galonedv dulenv ditsalenvhi gesesdi, itsiyohesdi nasgi galvladi ehi gesvi, nahna Galonedv uwolv Unelanvhi agatisiditlv.
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᎰᏩ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏚᎴᏅ ᏗᏣᎴᏅᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎢᏥᏲᎮᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏀᎾ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏬᎸ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎦᏘᏏᏗᏢ.
\ft If ye then be risen with Christ, seek those things which are above, where Christ sitteth on the right hand of God.

\ln Itsagasayasdesdi nasgi na galvladi ehi gesvi, vtlesdino elohi ehi gesvi.
\syll ᎢᏣᎦᏌᏯᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎥᏞᏍᏗᏃ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎡᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Set your affection on things above, not on things on the earth.

\ln Ditsiyohusvhiyeno, detsvnvno galonedv wehv duwasgalv Unelanvhi.
\syll ᏗᏥᏲᎱᏒᎯᏰᏃ, ᏕᏨᏅᏃ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏪᎲ ᏚᏩᏍᎦᎸ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ.
\ft For ye are dead, and your life is hid with Christ in God.

\ln Galonedv galutsv iyui, nasgi gvnidv iginehi tsigi, hnaquo nasquo nihi itsinanugoisdi gesesdi nasgi itsehesdi galvquodiyu gesv itsanuwosdesdi.
\syll ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎦᎷᏨ ᎢᏳᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎢᎩᏁᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎿᏉ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏥᎾᏄᎪᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏤᎮᏍᏗ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏣᏄᏬᏍᏕᏍᏗ.
\ft When Christ, who is our life, shall appear, then shall ye also appear with him in glory.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi detsihihesdi ditsiyelv detsadudadewisv ani elohi; nasgi udelidv dinisidi gesvi, gadaha gesvi, agvvhisdi gesvi, uyo adulvnvdi gesvi, ale tsugvwalodi agvvhisdi gesvi, nasgi Unelanvhi ayelvhi adadolisdanedi tsigi;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏕᏥᎯᎮᏍᏗ ᏗᏥᏰᎸ ᏕᏣᏚᏓᏕᏫᏒ ᎠᏂ ᎡᎶᎯ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᏗᏂᏏᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎦᏓᎭ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎬᎥᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᏲ ᎠᏚᎸᏅᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎠᎬᎥᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᏰᎸᎯ ᎠᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᏥᎩ;
\ft Mortify therefore your members which are upon the earth; fornication, uncleanness, inordinate affection, evil concupiscence, and covetousness, which is idolatry:

\ln Nasgi nvdigalisdodiha Unelanvhi utalawohisdi gesv unilutseha unohiyuhisdv nigesvna yvwi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏔᎳᏬᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏂᎷᏤᎭ ᎤᏃᎯᏳᎯᏍᏛ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏴᏫ.
\ft For which things' sake the wrath of God cometh on the children of disobedience:

\ln Nahna nasquo nihi ilvhiyu tsitsedohvgi, nahiyu nasgi nitsadvnehv tsitsehvgi.
\syll ᏀᎾ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏂᎯ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᏥᏤᏙᎲᎩ, ᏀᎢᏳ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎲ ᏥᏤᎲᎩ.
\ft In the which ye also walked some time, when ye lived in them.

\ln Aseno gohi gesv nihi nasquo hia nigadv iyvdv nidetsvneha; atalawohisdi gesvi, kanalvisdi gesvi, adaniquadisdi gesvi, asotlvisdodi gesvi, uneilvdi gawonihisdi gesv ditsiholi nvdayunugotsvhi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏂᎯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏂᏕᏨᏁᎭ; ᎠᏔᎳᏬᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎧᎾᎸᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᏓᏂᏆᏗᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᏐᏢᎢᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᏁᎢᎸᏗ ᎦᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏗᏥᎰᎵ ᏅᏓᏳᏄᎪᏨᎯ.
\ft But now ye also put off all these; anger, wrath, malice, blasphemy, filthy communication out of your mouth.

\ln Tlesdi yiditsadatsigonehesdi, iyvdvyeno iyetsvnelvhi uweti yvwi dulvwisdanehv gvwalitloyasdi;
\syll ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏗᏣᏓᏥᎪᏁᎮᏍᏗ, ᎢᏴᏛᏰᏃ ᎢᏰᏨᏁᎸᎯ ᎤᏪᏘ ᏴᏫ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᎬᏩᎵᏠᏯᏍᏗ;
\ft Lie not one to another, seeing that ye have put off the old man with his deeds;

\ln Ale itse yvwi itsanuwostanvhi, nasgi itse igvnelvhi tsigi nasgi agadovhisdi gesv ugvwali, nasgiya nusdv nasgi uwotlvnvhi gesvi;
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎢᏤ ᏴᏫ ᎢᏣᏄᏬᏍᏔᏅᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏤ ᎢᎬᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏬᏢᏅᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ;
\ft And have put on the new man, which is renewed in knowledge after the image of him that created him:

\ln Nahnani vtla gilo Agoi yigi, ale Atsusi, atsiusdeselvhi ale atsiusdeselvhi nigesvna, nvwadale yvwi, Sidiyi ehi, atsinatlai ale natsinatlavna; Galonedvsgini nigav gohusdi nigalisda, ale nigadiyu diyai.
\syll ᏀᎾᏂ ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᎠᎪᎢ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏧᏏ, ᎠᏥᎤᏍᏕᏎᎸᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏥᎤᏍᏕᏎᎸᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᏴᏫ, ᏏᏗᏱ ᎡᎯ, ᎠᏥᎾᏝᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏥᎾᏝᎥᎾ; ᎦᎶᏁᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏓ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏗᏯᎢ.
\ft Where there is neither Greek nor Jew, circumcision nor uncircumcision, Barbarian, Scythian, bond nor free: but Christ is all, and in all.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi, nasgiya iyunadvnedi Unelanvhi tsusuyedv gesvi, unadanvti ale getsigeyui, itsanuwosda uwedolisdi adanvdadisdi gesvi, ale adadolisdi gesvi, ale udadolisdi gesvi, udanvti gesvi, gohidiyu unelagi didadelisedi gesvi;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᏁᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᏑᏰᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ ᎠᎴ ᎨᏥᎨᏳᎢ, ᎢᏣᏄᏬᏍᏓ ᎤᏪᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎠᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᏓᏅᏘ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎪᎯᏗᏳ ᎤᏁᎳᎩ ᏗᏓᏕᎵᏎᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ;
\ft Put on therefore, as the elect of God, holy and beloved, bowels of mercies, kindness, humbleness of mind, meekness, longsuffering;

\ln Unelagi detsadadelisehesdi, ale digetsadanehesdi detsadasganvtsehvi, iyuno gilo gohusdi yidanadadeliseha; nasgiya Galonedv gagetsinelv itsisganvtsvi, nasgiya nasquo nihi nasgi nitsadvnehesdi.
\syll ᎤᏁᎳᎩ ᏕᏣᏓᏕᎵᏎᎮᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎨᏣᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᏕᏣᏓᏍᎦᏅᏤᎲᎢ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏱᏓᎾᏓᏕᎵᏎᎭ; ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎦᎨᏥᏁᎸ ᎢᏥᏍᎦᏅᏨᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏂᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ.
\ft Forbearing one another, and forgiving one another, if any man have a quarrel against any: even as Christ forgave you, so also do ye.

\ln Ale ho ugvwiyusesdi itsanuwosdesdi adageyudi gesvi, nasgi digudadvsgi tsigi nigalulogvna.
\syll ᎠᎴ Ꮀ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᏎᏍᏗ ᎢᏣᏄᏬᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎫᏓᏛᏍᎩ ᏥᎩ ᏂᎦᎷᎶᎬᎾ.
\ft And above all these things put on charity, which is the bond of perfectness.

\ln Ale nvwadohiyadv Unelanvhi utseli ugvwiyusadegesdi ditsinawiyi, nahna iditlv nasquo etsiyanvdv tsigi nasgi saquo ayelv itsalisdodiyi; ale ulihelisdiyu itsadanvtesdi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎨᏍᏗ ᏗᏥᎾᏫᏱ, ᏀᎾ ᎢᏗᏢ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎡᏥᏯᏅᏛ ᏥᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏌᏉ ᎠᏰᎸ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᎮᎵᏍᏗᏳ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏖᏍᏗ.
\ft And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to the which also ye are called in one body; and be ye thankful.

\ln Kanohedv Galonedv utseli utsati itsiyaesdi gananugowisgesdi nigav alisinahisdodi gesvi; detsadadeyohvsgesdi ale detsadawonedisgesdi detsvdisgesdi Unelanvhi dikanogisdodi, ale galvquododi dikanogisdi, ale adanvdo ugvwali dikanogisdi, detsinogisgesdi, ditsinawiyi didalehvsgesdi Ugvwiyuhi detsinogisgesdi etsalielitsehesdi.
\syll ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎢᏥᏯᎡᏍᏗ ᎦᎾᏄᎪᏫᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎠᎵᏏᏀᎢᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᏕᏣᏓᏕᏲᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏕᏣᏓᏬᏁᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏕᏨᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏗᎧᏃᎩᏍᏙᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᎸᏉᏙᏗ ᏗᎧᏃᎩᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᏗᎧᏃᎩᏍᏗ, ᏕᏥᏃᎩᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᏗᏥᎾᏫᏱ ᏗᏓᎴᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏕᏥᏃᎩᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎡᏣᎵᎡᎵᏤᎮᏍᏗ.
\ft Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly in all wisdom; teaching and admonishing one another in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your hearts to the Lord.

\ln Ale nigav nitsadvnelidohvi, itsiwonisgv ale detsilvwisdanehv yigi, nigav Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa gadov itsvdisgesdi, etsalielitsehesdi Unelanvhi nasgi Agayvligei, nasgi nvdigalisdodisgesdi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎵᏙᎲᎢ, ᎢᏥᏬᏂᏍᎬ ᎠᎴ ᏕᏥᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᏱᎩ, ᏂᎦᎥ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᏙᎥ ᎢᏨᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎡᏣᎵᎡᎵᏤᎮᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
\ft And whatsoever ye do in word or deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God and the Father by him.

\ln Itsigeyv, detsohiyusesdi itsvsv digetsiyehi nasgi itsvdvnediyi tsiduyugodi ugvwiyuhi detsigahnawadisvi.
\syll ᎢᏥᎨᏴ, ᏕᏦᎯᏳᏎᏍᏗ ᎢᏨᏒ ᏗᎨᏥᏰᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏨᏛᏁᏗᏱ ᏥᏚᏳᎪᏗ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏕᏥᎦᎿᏩᏗᏒᎢ.
\ft Wives, submit yourselves unto your own husbands, as it is fit in the Lord.

\ln Itsisgaya, detsigeyusesdi ditsadalii, ale tlesdi yiditsiniquatihesdi.
\syll ᎢᏥᏍᎦᏯ, ᏕᏥᎨᏳᏎᏍᏗ ᏗᏣᏓᎵᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏗᏥᏂᏆᏘᎮᏍᏗ.
\ft Husbands, love your wives, and be not bitter against them.

\ln Ditsiyoli, detsohiyusesdi ditsigayvlii nigav nigetsiwesehvi; osiyuyeno uyelvdi Ugvwiyuhi nasgi hia.
\syll ᏗᏥᏲᎵ, ᏕᏦᎯᏳᏎᏍᏗ ᏗᏥᎦᏴᎵᎢ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏂᎨᏥᏪᏎᎲᎢ; ᎣᏏᏳᏰᏃ ᎤᏰᎸᏗ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ.
\ft Children, obey your parents in all things: for this is well pleasing unto the Lord.

\ln Itsigayvligei, tlesdi yiditsihnalvsdisgesdi ditsetsi, yiwanalihvyoliligaquoyeno.
\syll ᎢᏥᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏗᏥᎿᎸᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏗᏤᏥ, ᏱᏩᎾᎵᎲᏲᎵᎵᎦᏉᏰᏃ.
\ft Fathers, provoke not your children to anger, lest they be discouraged.

\ln Etsinvsidasdi, detsohiyusesdi nigav nigetsiwesehv getsinvsidohi ani uquedali gesvi; vtla tsidvdadikano nasgiyai, yvwiquo osiyu uniyelvdi, osiyusgini itsiyelvhi gesesdi ditsinawiyi, etsinayesgesdi Unelanvhi:
\syll ᎡᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ, ᏕᏦᎯᏳᏎᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏂᎨᏥᏪᏎᎲ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏙᎯ ᎠᏂ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎥᏝ ᏥᏛᏓᏗᎧᏃ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ, ᏴᏫᏉ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎤᏂᏰᎸᏗ, ᎣᏏᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᏥᏰᎸᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏗᏥᎾᏫᏱ, ᎡᏥᎾᏰᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ:
\ft Servants, obey in all things your masters according to the flesh; not with eyeservice, as menpleasers; but in singleness of heart, fearing God:

\ln Ale nigav gohusdi itsadvnehvi, ditsinawiyi osiyu itsiyelvhi detsilvwisdanehesdi Ugvwiyuhi tsinetsadvneho nasgiyai, vtlano yvwi tsinidetsadvnehoi;
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎢᏣᏛᏁᎲᎢ, ᏗᏥᎾᏫᏱ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏥᏰᎸᎯ ᏕᏥᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏁᏣᏛᏁᎰ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ, ᎥᏝᏃ ᏴᏫ ᏥᏂᏕᏣᏛᏁᎰᎢ;
\ft And whatsoever ye do, do it heartily, as to the Lord, and not unto men;

\ln Itsanvtesdi, nasgi Ugvwiyuhi itsinedi gesv etsaguyvdanedi itsatseli iyulisdodi gesvi; Ugvwiyuhiyeno galonedv gohusdi etsadvneha.
\syll ᎢᏣᏅᏖᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᏥᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎡᏣᎫᏴᏓᏁᏗ ᎢᏣᏤᎵ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᏰᏃ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎡᏣᏛᏁᎭ.
\ft Knowing that of the Lord ye shall receive the reward of the inheritance: for ye serve the Lord Christ.

\ln Gilosgini utsatini iyadvnehi atsisdvdisdodi gesesdi nasgi utsatini nudvnelvi; vtlano gilo atsilvquododi yigesesdi.
\syll ᎩᎶᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏣᏘᏂ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᎯ ᎠᏥᏍᏛᏗᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏣᏘᏂ ᏄᏛᏁᎸᎢ; ᎥᏝᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏙᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft But he that doeth wrong shall receive for the wrong which he hath done: and there is no respect of persons.

\ln Ditsadanvsidohi, detsinehesdi ditsinvsidasdi duyugodv ale yeliquo gesvi; itsanvtesdi nihi nasquo Itsinvsidohi galvladi tsehvi.
\syll ᏗᏣᏓᏅᏏᏙᎯ, ᏕᏥᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᏗᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎠᎴ ᏰᎵᏉ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎢᏣᏅᏖᏍᏗ ᏂᎯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎢᏥᏅᏏᏙᎯ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏤᎲᎢ.
\ft Masters, give unto your servants that which is just and equal; knowing that ye also have a Master in heaven.

\ln Itsadadolisdisgv gvwagudidisesdi, ale nahna itsiyawisgesdi ulitloyasdesdi alihelisdi gesvi;
\syll ᎢᏣᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᎬᏩᎫᏗᏗᏎᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏀᎾ ᎢᏥᏯᏫᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᎵᏠᏯᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᎠᎵᎮᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ;
\ft Continue in prayer, and watch in the same with thanksgiving;

\ln Alewo itsadadolisdisgesdi ayv sgiyanvdadisgesdi, nasgi Unelanvhi ogisdugiediyi galohisdiyi nahna ogalitsidodiyi, oginohediyi udelidv Galonedv utseliga, nasgi nasquo tsinvdigalisdodiha vqualvidv tsigi;
\syll ᎠᎴᏬ ᎢᏣᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᏴ ᏍᎩᏯᏅᏓᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎣᎩᏍᏚᎩᎡᏗᏱ ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏀᎾ ᎣᎦᎵᏥᏙᏗᏱ, ᎣᎩᏃᎮᏗᏱ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏥᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎥᏆᎸᎢᏛ ᏥᎩ;
\ft Withal praying also for us, that God would open unto us a door of utterance, to speak the mystery of Christ, for which I am also in bonds:

\ln Nasgi gvnigesv iyaquvnediyi, nasgiya tsiduyugodi iyagiwesdiyi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏯᏋᏁᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏥᏚᏳᎪᏗ ᎢᏯᎩᏪᏍᏗᏱ.
\ft That I may make it manifest, as I ought to speak.

\ln Itsalisinahisdi itsedohesdi anigatahv nasgi na anelv nigesvna, itsudalesgesdi gohi gesv aliyilisvi.
\syll ᎢᏣᎵᏏᏀᎢᏍᏗ ᎢᏤᏙᎮᏍᏗ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎲ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᏁᎸ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎢᏧᏓᎴᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎵᏱᎵᏒᎢ.
\ft Walk in wisdom toward them that are without, redeeming the time.

\ln Itsalinohesgv nigohilv udanvti gesv ulitloyasdesdi, ama ulotsidv gesesdi, nasgi itsigadovhisdiyi itsiwesdiyi detsinetsehv naniv yvwi.
\syll ᎢᏣᎵᏃᎮᏍᎬ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎤᏓᏅᏘ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎵᏠᏯᏍᏕᏍᏗ, ᎠᎹ ᎤᎶᏥᏛ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏥᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎢᏥᏪᏍᏗᏱ ᏕᏥᏁᏤᎲ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏴᏫ.
\ft Let your speech be always with grace, seasoned with salt, that ye may know how ye ought to answer every man.

\ln Nigadv naquadvhnadegv Digiga gvnigesv nvdatsvneli, nasgi otsigeyui otsalinvtli, ale osdv iyadvnehi tsulvwisdanehi, ale utloyi atsinvsidasdi Ugvwiyuhi utseliga;
\syll ᏂᎦᏛ ᎾᏆᏛᎿᏕᎬ ᏗᎩᎦ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏅᏓᏨᏁᎵ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏥᎨᏳᎢ ᎣᏣᎵᏅᏟ, ᎠᎴ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᎯ ᏧᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏠᏱ ᎠᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ;
\ft All my state shall Tychicus declare unto you, who is a beloved brother, and a faithful minister and fellowservant in the Lord:

\ln Nasgi tsinvli witsilutsediyi, nasgi nitsadvhnadegv udolehohisdiyi ugvwali, ale ditsigalisdadediyi ditsinawi ugvwali;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏅᎵ ᏫᏥᎷᏤᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᏣᏛᎿᏕᎬ ᎤᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏥᎦᎵᏍᏓᏕᏗᏱ ᏗᏥᎾᏫ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ;
\ft Whom I have sent unto you for the same purpose, that he might know your estate, and comfort your hearts;

\ln Anenvsda Onisima, osdv iyadvnehi ale otsigeyui otsalinvtli nasgi itsehv ehi tsigi, nasgi gvnigesv nvdagetsvneli nigadv nigalistanidohv ani.
\syll ᎠᏁᏅᏍᏓ ᎣᏂᏏᎹ, ᎣᏍᏛ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎣᏥᎨᏳᎢ ᎣᏣᎵᏅᏟ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏤᎲ ᎡᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏅᏓᎨᏨᏁᎵ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏔᏂᏙᎲ ᎠᏂ.
\ft With Onesimus, a faithful and beloved brother, who is one of you. They shall make known unto you all things which are done here.

\ln Elisdaga itsulaha osdiyvgi, witsiyoliha, ale Maga Quaniqua udo uwetsi, (nasgi ugvwali itsadvganvhi tsigi; iyuno witsilutselvha detsadanilvtsvha;)
\syll ᎡᎵᏍᏓᎦ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎣᏍᏗᏴᎩ, ᏫᏥᏲᎵᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎹᎦ ᏆᏂᏆ ᎤᏙ ᎤᏪᏥ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᎢᏣᏛᎦᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᏫᏥᎷᏤᎸᎭ ᏕᏣᏓᏂᎸᏨᎭ;
\ft Aristarchus my fellowprisoner saluteth you, and Marcus, sister's son to Barnabas, (touching whom ye received commandments: if he come unto you, receive him;)

\ln Ale Tsisa, nasgi Tsasda tsagosehoi; nasgi digetsiusdeselvhi tsigi.  Nasgi unvsv itsulaha tsogilvwisdanehi Unelanvhi utseligohi ugvwali, nasgi gvgigalisdadisgvgi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏥᏌ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏣᏍᏓ ᏣᎪᏎᎰᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎨᏥᎤᏍᏕᏎᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ.  ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏅᏒ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᏦᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎪᎯ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᎩᎦᎵᏍᏓᏗᏍᎬᎩ.
\ft And Jesus, which is called Justus, who are of the circumcision. These only are my fellowworkers unto the kingdom of God, which have been a comfort unto me.

\ln Egaqua nasgi itsehv ehi tsigi, Galonedv unvsidohi, witsiyoliga, nigohilv alinigvneha adadolisdisgv nasgi nihi itsalediyi nitsigolvna ale akalii nigav Unelanvhi osiyu uyelvdi gesvi.
\syll ᎡᎦᏆ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏤᎲ ᎡᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏅᏏᏙᎯ, ᏫᏥᏲᎵᎦ, ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎠᎵᏂᎬᏁᎭ ᎠᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏣᎴᏗᏱ ᏂᏥᎪᎸᎾ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎧᎵᎢ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎤᏰᎸᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Epaphras, who is one of you, a servant of Christ, saluteth you, always labouring fervently for you in prayers, that ye may stand perfect and complete in all the will of God.

\ln Ayvyeno tsiyoiyudaneha nasgi utsati itsadelihisdanehv nihi ale Leodisiya anehi, ale Hayilaquali anehi.
\syll ᎠᏴᏰᏃ ᏥᏲᎢᏳᏓᏁᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎢᏣᏕᎵᎯᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᏂᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎴᎣᏗᏏᏯ ᎠᏁᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎭᏱᎳᏆᎵ ᎠᏁᎯ.
\ft For I bear him record, that he hath a great zeal for you, and them that are in Laodicea, and them in Hierapolis.

\ln Luga atsigeyuhi aganagati witsiyoliga, ale Dima.
\syll ᎷᎦ ᎠᏥᎨᏳᎯ ᎠᎦᎾᎦᏘ ᏫᏥᏲᎵᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎹ.
\ft Luke, the beloved physician, and Demas, greet you.

\ln Detsiyolilvha idalinvtli Leodisiya anehi, ale Nimiqua, ale tsunanelodi nasgi ganelv tsunadatluga.
\syll ᏕᏥᏲᎵᎸᎭ ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ ᎴᎣᏗᏏᏯ ᎠᏁᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎻᏆ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏁᎸ ᏧᎾᏓᏡᎦ.
\ft Salute the brethren which are in Laodicea, and Nymphas, and the church which is in his house.

\ln Iyuno nasgi hia goweli itsigoliyevha, Leodisiya tsunanelodi unadatlugv nasquo unigoliyediyi nitsvnelvha; ale nasquo nihi itsigoliyevha Leodisiya nvdayulohisdi tsigi.
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎪᏪᎵ ᎢᏥᎪᎵᏰᎥᎭ, ᎴᎣᏗᏏᏯ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᏂᎪᎵᏰᏗᏱ ᏂᏨᏁᎸᎭ; ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏥᎪᎵᏰᎥᎭ ᎴᎣᏗᏏᏯ ᏅᏓᏳᎶᎯᏍᏗ ᏥᎩ.
\ft And when this epistle is read among you, cause that it be read also in the church of the Laodiceans; and that ye likewise read the epistle from Laodicea.

\ln Ale Agiqua hia netsiweselvha, Tsagasayasdesdi digalvwisdanedi gesv Ugvwiyuhi ugvwali tsetsayohiselvhi, nasgi tsakaliisdiyi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎠᎩᏆ ᎯᎠ ᏁᏥᏪᏎᎸᎭ, ᏣᎦᏌᏯᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᏤᏣᏲᎯᏎᎸᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏣᎧᎵᎢᏍᏗᏱ.
\ft And say to Archippus, Take heed to the ministry which thou hast received in the Lord, that thou fulfill it.

\ln Ayv Quola aquvsv aquoyeni gvdiha witsvyoliha.  Itsanvtesdi vqualvvi.  Gvwagatiya adadolisdi gesv itseladidohesdi.  Emenv.
\syll ᎠᏴ ᏉᎳ ᎠᏋᏒ ᎠᏉᏰᏂ ᎬᏗᎭ ᏫᏨᏲᎵᎭ.  ᎢᏣᏅᏖᏍᏗ ᎥᏆᎸᎥᎢ.  ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎠᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏤᎳᏗᏙᎮᏍᏗ.  ᎡᎺᏅ.
\ft The salutation by the hand of me Paul. Remember my bonds. Grace be with you. Amen.

\ln Quola ale Sayila ale Dimadi witsvyowelasi ditsanelodi itsadatlugv Desiloniga nasgi etsohiyuhvsgi Unelanvhi Agayvligei, ale Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv; gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv ale nvwadohiyadv getseladidohesdi nvdayunalisgolvtanvhi Unelanvhi Igidoda ale Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv.
\syll ᏉᎳ ᎠᎴ ᏌᏱᎳ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎹᏗ ᏫᏨᏲᏪᎳᏏ ᏗᏣᏁᎶᏗ ᎢᏣᏓᏡᎬ ᏕᏏᎶᏂᎦ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᏦᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ; ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᎨᏤᎳᏗᏙᎮᏍᏗ ᏅᏓᏳᎾᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏅᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᎩᏙᏓ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ.
\ft Paul, and Silvanus, and Timotheus, unto the church of the Thessalonians which is in God the Father and in the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace be unto you, and peace, from God our Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ.

\ln Otsalielitseho Unelanvhi nigohilv nihi nitsiv nvdigalisdodisgoi, itsvneisdisgo otsadadolisdisgvi;
\syll ᎣᏣᎵᎡᎵᏤᎰ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᏂᎯ ᏂᏥᎥ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎪᎢ, ᎢᏨᏁᎢᏍᏗᏍᎪ ᎣᏣᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ;
\ft We give thanks to God always for you all, making mention of you in our prayers;

\ln Nogvgewisgvna otsanvdadisgo detsilvwisdanehv itsohiyusv nvdayudalenvhi, ale itsalinigvnehv adageyudi gesv nvdayudalenvhi, ale ditsvnidiyu gesv udugi etsvsv Ugvwiyuhi igatseli Tsisa Galonedv, Unelanvhi agatahv nasgi Igidoda;
\syll ᏃᎬᎨᏫᏍᎬᎾ ᎣᏣᏅᏓᏗᏍᎪ ᏕᏥᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᎢᏦᎯᏳᏒ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏣᎵᏂᎬᏁᎲ ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏨᏂᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎡᏨᏒ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎦᏔᎲ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎩᏙᏓ;
\ft Remembering without ceasing your work of faith, and labour of love, and patience of hope in our Lord Jesus Christ, in the sight of God and our Father;

\ln Nasgi tsotsigataha, idalinvtli Unelanvhi itsigeyuhi, etsasuyedv gesvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏦᏥᎦᏔᎭ, ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᏥᎨᏳᎯ, ᎡᏣᏑᏰᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Knowing, brethren beloved, your election of God.

\ln Osdvyeno kanohedv ogatseliga vtla kanetsvhiquo gesv yitsiluhisdanelei, ulinigidiyusgini gesv nasquo tali udvdvi, ale Galvquodiyu Adanvdo, ale utsati nudlasidvsvna gesvi; nasgiya tsitsigataha nogasdv itsvyeladidolv nihi tsinvdagalisdodisgvgi.
\syll ᎣᏍᏛᏰᏃ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎣᎦᏤᎵᎦ ᎥᏝ ᎧᏁᏨᎯᏉ ᎨᏒ ᏱᏥᎷᎯᏍᏓᏁᎴᎢ, ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏔᎵ ᎤᏛᏛᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏄᏜᏏᏛᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏥᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᏃᎦᏍᏛ ᎢᏨᏰᎳᏗᏙᎸ ᏂᎯ ᏥᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬᎩ.
\ft For our gospel came not unto you in word only, but also in power, and in the Holy Ghost, and in much assurance; as ye know what manner of men we were among you for your sake.

\ln Ale ayv sgisdawadegi nitsalistanvgi, ale Ugvwiyuhi [etsisdawadegi,] detsadanilvtsv kanohedv utsati itsigiliyogvi, ulitloyasdv ulihelisdi gesv galvquodiyu Adanvdo nvdawadalenvhi;
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴ ᏍᎩᏍᏓᏩᏕᎩ ᏂᏣᎵᏍᏔᏅᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎡᏥᏍᏓᏩᏕᎩ,data is invalid ᏕᏣᏓᏂᎸᏨ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎢᏥᎩᎵᏲᎬᎢ, ᎤᎵᏠᏯᏍᏛ ᎤᎵᎮᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᏅᏓᏩᏓᎴᏅᎯ;
\ft And ye became followers of us, and of the Lord, having received the word in much affliction, with joy of the Holy Ghost:

\ln Nasgino tsunatlilosdodi nitsalistanvgi naniv anohiyuhvsgi Masidoni anehi ale Egaya anehi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏧᎾᏟᎶᏍᏙᏗ ᏂᏣᎵᏍᏔᏅᎩ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᎹᏏᏙᏂ ᎠᏁᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎡᎦᏯ ᎠᏁᎯ.
\ft So that ye were ensamples to all that believe in Macedonia and Achaia.

\ln Nihiyeno itsehv udalenvgi unoyvlisvgi kanohedv Ugvwiyuhi utseliga, vtla Masidoniquo ale Egaya uwasv yiwulutsei, nasquosgini nigav degesadisv Unelanvhi etsoiyusv duyelisv; nasgi iyusdi vtla ase gohusdi ogadvdi yigi.
\syll ᏂᎯᏰᏃ ᎢᏤᎲ ᎤᏓᎴᏅᎩ ᎤᏃᏴᎵᏒᎩ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎥᏝ ᎹᏏᏙᏂᏉ ᎠᎴ ᎡᎦᏯ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏱᏭᎷᏤᎢ, ᎾᏍᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏕᎨᏌᏗᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎡᏦᎢᏳᏒ ᏚᏰᎵᏒ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎥᏝ ᎠᏎ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎣᎦᏛᏗ ᏱᎩ.
\ft For from you sounded out the word of the Lord not only in Macedonia and Achaia, but also in every place your faith to God-ward is spread abroad; so that we need not to speak any thing.

\ln Unvsvyeno gvnigesv nigogvneha nusdv witsvlutselvi, ale nitsadvnelv Unelanvhi iditlv itsagatahvstanv detsiyosv Unelanvhi diyelvhi, ditsikahnawadvsdiyi gvnodv ale udohiyuhiya Unelanvhi tsigi;
\syll ᎤᏅᏒᏰᏃ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᎪᎬᏁᎭ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏫᏨᎷᏤᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎸ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᏗᏢ ᎢᏣᎦᏔᎲᏍᏔᏅ ᏕᏥᏲᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏗᏰᎸᎯ, ᏗᏥᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗᏱ ᎬᏃᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ;
\ft For they themselves shew of us what manner of entering in we had unto you, and how ye turned to God from idols to serve the living and true God;

\ln Ale etsigatidisdiyi nasgi Uwetsi galvladi nvdayulohisdiyi, nasgi uyohusv tsideuletanei, nasgi Tsisa, nasgi tsigudalesv utalawohisdi uluhisdi tsigi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎡᏥᎦᏘᏗᏍᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏅᏓᏳᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏲᎱᏒ ᏥᏕᎤᎴᏔᏁᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏌ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᎫᏓᎴᏒ ᎤᏔᎳᏬᎯᏍᏗ ᎤᎷᎯᏍᏗ ᏥᎩ.
\ft And to wait for his Son from heaven, whom he raised from the dead, even Jesus, which delivered us from the wrath to come.

\ln Itsvsvyeno itsigataha, idalinvtli, nusdv witsvlutselvi, nasgi asequoquo nigesvna gesvi.
\syll ᎢᏨᏒᏰᏃ ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎭ, ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᏄᏍᏛ ᏫᏨᎷᏤᎸᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏎᏉᏉ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft For yourselves, brethren, know our entrance in unto you, that it was not in vain:

\ln Nasquosgini igvyi nogigiliyotsoi ale nigogisotlvnoi Quiligiyi, nasgi tsitsigataha, notsisgaihvna Oganelanvhi otsalisgasdodv itsvnohehelvgi osdv kanohedv Unelanvhi utseliga, tali udvdvgi utsati atlinigvnedi gesvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᎬᏱ ᏃᎩᎩᎵᏲᏦᎢ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎪᎩᏐᏢᏃᎢ ᏈᎵᎩᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏥᎦᏔᎭ, ᏃᏥᏍᎦᎢᎲᎾ ᎣᎦᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎣᏣᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏛ ᎢᏨᏃᎮᎮᎸᎩ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᏔᎵ ᎤᏛᏛᎩ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎠᏟᏂᎬᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft But even after that we had suffered before, and were shamefully entreated, as ye know, at Philippi, we were bold in our God to speak unto you the gospel of God with much contention.

\ln Itsvwonetanvyeno vtla adalenasdisgi yigesei, vtla ale gadahai, vtla ale atlonuhedv;
\syll ᎢᏨᏬᏁᏔᏅᏰᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎠᏓᎴᎾᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎦᏓᎭᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏠᏄᎮᏛ;
\ft For our exhortation was not of deceit, nor of uncleanness, nor in guile:

\ln Unelanvhisgini yeliquo tsuyelvnv ogagenvdisdiyi osdv kanohedv, nasgiya otsinega; vtla yvwiquo osiyu uniyelvdi, Unelanvhisgini nasgi digoliyesgi tsigi diginawi.
\syll ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᏰᎵᏉ ᏧᏰᎸᏅ ᎣᎦᎨᏅᏗᏍᏗᏱ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎣᏥᏁᎦ; ᎥᏝ ᏴᏫᏉ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎤᏂᏰᎸᏗ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎪᎵᏰᏍᎩ ᏥᎩ ᏗᎩᎾᏫ.
\ft But as we were allowed of God to be put in trust with the gospel, even so we speak; not as pleasing men, but God, which trieth our hearts.

\ln Vtla ale otsiwonisgv ilvhiyu asequo adalvquododi gesv yotsvdisgei, nasgi tsitsigataha, vtla ale gohusdi yotsvdisge yotsutlvdisge tsugvwalodi agvvhisdi gesvi; Unelanvhi agatahi;
\syll ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎣᏥᏬᏂᏍᎬ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᎠᏎᏉ ᎠᏓᎸᏉᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏲᏨᏗᏍᎨᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏥᎦᏔᎭ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏲᏨᏗᏍᎨ ᏲᏧᏢᏗᏍᎨ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎠᎬᎥᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎦᏔᎯ;
\ft For neither at any time used we flattering words, as ye know, nor a cloke of covetousness; God is witness:

\ln Vtla ale yvwi gogilvquododiyi yogiyohei, vtla nihi yitsvyosehei, vtla ale nvwanadalei; yeliquo egano gagedv idigayotsvnedi gesvgi, Galonedv oginvsidv gesv iyusdi.
\syll ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᏴᏫ ᎪᎩᎸᏉᏙᏗᏱ ᏲᎩᏲᎮᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᏂᎯ ᏱᏨᏲᏎᎮᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴᎢ; ᏰᎵᏉ ᎡᎦᏃ ᎦᎨᏛ ᎢᏗᎦᏲᏨᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎩ, ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎣᎩᏅᏏᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ.
\ft Nor of men sought we glory, neither of you, nor yet of others, when we might have been burdensome, as the apostles of Christ.

\ln Ogadanvtiyusgini gesvgi itsvyeladidohvi, nasgiya tsudasdai tsidasquanigodisgo tsuwetsi;
\syll ᎣᎦᏓᏅᏘᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏒᎩ ᎢᏨᏰᎳᏗᏙᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏧᏓᏍᏓᎢ ᏥᏓᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗᏍᎪ ᏧᏪᏥ;
\ft But we were gentle among you, even as a nurse cherisheth her children:

\ln Utsatino itsvgeyusv iyusdi, ogatlayvquo ditsvyohisediyi vtla osdv kanohedv uwasv Unelanvhi utseliga, nasquosgini ogvsv dotsvnvi, nvdagalisdodisgvgi itsvgeyuiyu gesvi.
\syll ᎤᏣᏘᏃ ᎢᏨᎨᏳᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᎣᎦᏝᏴᏉ ᏗᏨᏲᎯᏎᏗᏱ ᎥᏝ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎾᏍᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎣᎬᏒ ᏙᏨᏅᎢ, ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᎢᏨᎨᏳᎢᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft So being affectionately desirous of you, we were willing to have imparted unto you, not the gospel of God only, but also our own souls, because ye were dear unto us.

\ln Itsanvtaquoyeno, idalinvtli, dogilvwisdanelv ale dogiyawetsidolvi; digvwagitsvdiyeno dogilvwisdanehv nogadulisgvna gesv iyusdi asiyvwi nitsadvnv gagedv iyotsvyvnediyi, itsvyalitsidonelvgi osdv kanohedv Unelanvhi utseliga.
\syll ᎢᏣᏅᏔᏉᏰᏃ, ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᏙᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸ ᎠᎴ ᏙᎩᏯᏪᏥᏙᎸᎢ; ᏗᎬᏩᎩᏨᏗᏰᏃ ᏙᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᏃᎦᏚᎵᏍᎬᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᏂᏣᏛᏅ ᎦᎨᏛ ᎢᏲᏨᏴᏁᏗᏱ, ᎢᏨᏯᎵᏥᏙᏁᎸᎩ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ.
\ft For ye remember, brethren, our labour and travail: for labouring night and day, because we would not be chargeable unto any of you, we preached unto you the gospel of God.

\ln Nihi itsigatahi nitsalisdiha, ale nasquo Unelanvhi, nigav nasganvna gesv ale duyugodv gesv, ale gaguhisdodi nigesvna gesv ogedolv itsvyeladidolv nihi itsohiyuhi;
\syll ᏂᎯ ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎯ ᏂᏣᎵᏍᏗᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᏂᎦᎥ ᎾᏍᎦᏅᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᎫᎯᏍᏙᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎣᎨᏙᎸ ᎢᏨᏰᎳᏗᏙᎸ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏦᎯᏳᎯ;
\ft Ye are witnesses, and God also, how holily and justly and unblameably we behaved ourselves among you that believe:

\ln Nasgi tsitsigataha itsisiyvwiha nitsvweselv itsvwonetanv, ale itsvgalisdadv, ale itsvyeyatanvi, nasgiya agayvlige tsinidegaweseho tsuwetsi,
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᎢᏥᏏᏴᏫᎭ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎸ ᎢᏨᏬᏁᏔᏅ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏨᎦᎵᏍᏓᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏨᏰᏯᏔᏅᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᏥᏂᏕᎦᏪᏎᎰ ᏧᏪᏥ,
\ft As ye know how we exhorted and comforted and charged every one of you, as a father doth his children,
