\ln Nasgi nihi itsedohv Unelanvhi osiyu uyelvdi itselisdiyi, nasgi itsiyanvdv tsigi witsiluhisdiyi utseligohi ale utseli galvquodiyu digesvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏤᏙᎲ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎤᏰᎸᏗ ᎢᏤᎵᏍᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏥᏯᏅᏛ ᏥᎩ ᏫᏥᎷᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏤᎵᎪᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᏗᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft That ye would walk worthy of God, who hath called you unto his kingdom and glory.

\ln Nasgi nasquo nvdigalisdodiha notsiyohisdisgvna otsalielitseha Unelanvhi, nasgi iyuno detsadanilvtsv kanohedv Unelanvhi utseliga, nasgi ayv sgiyadvganelvhi, vtla yvwiquo unatseli kanohedv iyusdi yiditsadanilvtsei, Unelanvhisgini utseli kanohedv, udohiyuhiya tsigi, nasgiya detsadanilvtsvgi, nasgi nasquo utsati tsidulvwisdaneha detsadanvdv nihi nasgi itsohiyunvhi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᏃᏥᏲᎯᏍᏗᏍᎬᎾ ᎣᏣᎵᎡᎵᏤᎭ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏃ ᏕᏣᏓᏂᎸᏨ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᏍᎩᏯᏛᎦᏁᎸᎯ, ᎥᏝ ᏴᏫᏉ ᎤᎾᏤᎵ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏱᏗᏣᏓᏂᎸᏤᎢ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ, ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏕᏣᏓᏂᎸᏨᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏥᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎭ ᏕᏣᏓᏅᏛ ᏂᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏦᎯᏳᏅᎯ.
\ft For this cause also thank we God without ceasing, because, when ye received the word of God which ye heard of us, ye received it not as the word of men, but as it is in truth, the word of God, which effectually worketh also in you that believe.

\ln Nihiyeno, idalinvtli, ditsisdawadegi nitsalistanvgi tsunanelodi dunadatlugv Unelanvhi tsutseliga Tsudiyi anehi, nasgi Galonedv Tsisa gvwohiyuhvsgi tsigi; nihiyeno nasquo utloyi detsigiliyotselvgi ditsatseliga yvwi, nasgiya nasgi tsidunigiliyotsele Anitsusi;
\syll ᏂᎯᏰᏃ, ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᏗᏥᏍᏓᏩᏕᎩ ᏂᏣᎵᏍᏔᏅᎩ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᏚᎾᏓᏡᎬ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᏤᎵᎦ ᏧᏗᏱ ᎠᏁᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏥᏌ ᎬᏬᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᏥᎩ; ᏂᎯᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᏠᏱ ᏕᏥᎩᎵᏲᏤᎸᎩ ᏗᏣᏤᎵᎦ ᏴᏫ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏚᏂᎩᎵᏲᏤᎴ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ;
\ft For ye, brethren, became followers of the churches of God which in Judaea are in Christ Jesus: for ye also have suffered like things of your own countrymen, even as they have of the Jews:

\ln Nasgi nasquo tsunilvgi Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa, ale anadolehosgi unvsv tsunatseliga, ale ayv gogadeyadotanvgi; ale vtla osiyu uyelvdi Unelanvhi yinanadvneha, ale naniv yvwi danigatilega;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏧᏂᎸᎩ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎤᏅᏒ ᏧᎾᏤᎵᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴ ᎪᎦᏕᏯᏙᏔᏅᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎤᏰᎸᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏱᎾᎾᏛᏁᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏴᏫ ᏓᏂᎦᏘᎴᎦ;
\ft Who both killed the Lord Jesus, and their own prophets, and have persecuted us; and they please not God, and are contrary to all men:

\ln Goginvsdadehoi tsotsiwonedodiyi tsunadalenvdv yvwi, nasgi gagetsisdelvdi iyulisdodiyi, unikaliisdiyi nigohilv unisganvtsvi; utalawohisdisgini gesv wasdv iyvdv unilutselv.
\syll ᎪᎩᏅᏍᏓᏕᎰᎢ ᏦᏥᏬᏁᏙᏗᏱ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎨᏥᏍᏕᎸᏗ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎤᏂᎧᎵᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎤᏂᏍᎦᏅᏨᎢ; ᎤᏔᎳᏬᎯᏍᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏒ ᏩᏍᏛ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎤᏂᎷᏤᎸ.
\ft Forbidding us to speak to the Gentiles that they might be saved, to fill up their sins alway: for the wrath is come upon them to the uttermost.

\ln Ayvsgini idalinvtli, tlega ogadadaletanv tsotsiyelvi, vtlano tsoginawiyi, utli igai ogatlinigvnelvgi detsakadv tsogigowadvdiyi, utsati adulvdi ogvtanvgi.
\syll ᎠᏴᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᏞᎦ ᎣᎦᏓᏓᎴᏔᏅ ᏦᏥᏰᎸᎢ, ᎥᏝᏃ ᏦᎩᎾᏫᏱ, ᎤᏟ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎣᎦᏟᏂᎬᏁᎸᎩ ᏕᏣᎧᏛ ᏦᎩᎪᏩᏛᏗᏱ, ᎤᏣᏘ ᎠᏚᎸᏗ ᎣᎬᏔᏅᎩ.
\ft But we, brethren, being taken from you for a short time in presence, not in heart, endeavoured the more abundantly to see your face with great desire.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi ogadulisgvgi witsvlutsediyi, ale ayv, Quola, ho ugvwiyusvgi, saquo ale taline aquadulvhvgi; aseno Sedani ogiyosdodanehvgi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎣᎦᏚᎵᏍᎬᎩ ᏫᏨᎷᏤᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴ, ᏉᎳ, Ꮀ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᏒᎩ, ᏌᏉ ᎠᎴ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎠᏆᏚᎸᎲᎩ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᏎᏓᏂ ᎣᎩᏲᏍᏙᏓᏁᎲᎩ.
\ft Wherefore we would have come unto you, even I Paul, once and again; but Satan hindered us.

\ln Gadoyeno udugi ogvha, ale gado osdv yigadanvdadiha, ale gado usdi alisdulo ogalihelisdodi?  Tlasgo nihi yigesesdi agatahv igatseli Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv nahiyu galutsvha?
\syll ᎦᏙᏰᏃ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎣᎬᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᏙ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏱᎦᏓᏅᏓᏗᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᏙ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎠᎵᏍᏚᎶ ᎣᎦᎵᎮᎵᏍᏙᏗ?  ᏝᏍᎪ ᏂᎯ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎠᎦᏔᎲ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏀᎢᏳ ᎦᎷᏨᎭ?
\ft For what is our hope, or joy, or crown of rejoicing? Are not even ye in the presence of our Lord Jesus Christ at his coming?

\ln Nihiyeno galvquodiyu isgiyvnehi ale sgiyalihelisdisgi.
\syll ᏂᎯᏰᏃ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎢᏍᎩᏴᏁᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏍᎩᏯᎵᎮᎵᏍᏗᏍᎩ.
\ft For ye are our glory and joy.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi hnaquo utli igohidv gayogadvnidisdi nigesvna nulistanv, osiyu ogiyelvnvgi ogvsv ogikahiyasdiyi Ediniyi;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎿᏉ ᎤᏟ ᎢᎪᎯᏛ ᎦᏲᎦᏛᏂᏗᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ, ᎣᏏᏳ ᎣᎩᏰᎸᏅᎩ ᎣᎬᏒ ᎣᎩᎧᎯᏯᏍᏗᏱ ᎡᏗᏂᏱ;
\ft Wherefore when we could no longer forbear, we thought it good to be left at Athens alone;

\ln Ale otsinvsvgi Dimadi, otsalinvtli, ale Unelanvhi gohusdi advnehi, ale ayv itsulaha tsogilvwisdanehi osdv kanohedv Galonedv utseli ugvwali, nasgi ditsalinigohisdodiyi, ale ditsikalisdadisdiyi itsohiyusv ugvwali;
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎣᏥᏅᏒᎩ ᏗᎹᏗ, ᎣᏣᎵᏅᏟ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎠᏛᏁᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᏦᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏣᎵᏂᎪᎯᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏥᎧᎵᏍᏓᏗᏍᏗᏱ ᎢᏦᎯᏳᏒ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ;
\ft And sent Timotheus, our brother, and minister of God, and our fellowlabourer in the gospel of Christ, to establish you, and to comfort you concerning your faith:

\ln Nasgi gilo atsitelvdiyi nigesvna hia nasgi agiliyoisdi gesv iyuwanisadv; itsvsvyeno itsigataha nasgi igalisdanediyi eginetselvhi gesvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎩᎶ ᎠᏥᏖᎸᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ; ᎢᏨᏒᏰᏃ ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎦᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᎡᎩᏁᏤᎸᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft That no man should be moved by these afflictions: for yourselves know that we are appointed thereunto.

\ln Udohiyuhiyeno tsitsvyeladidohvgi, nitsvnonelo igigiliyoisdi gesvi; nasgiya tsinulistanv, ale nasgi tsitsigataha.
\syll ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏰᏃ ᏥᏨᏰᎳᏗᏙᎲᎩ, ᏂᏨᏃᏁᎶ ᎢᎩᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏥᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏥᎦᏔᎭ.
\ft For verily, when we were with you, we told you before that we should suffer tribulation; even as it came to pass, and ye know.

\ln Nasgi nvdayulisdotanvgi, hnaquo utli igohidv gvquadvnidisdi nigesvna nulistanv, aquadanvsvgi aquadolehohisdiyi nusdv itsohiyusvi, gohusdi yvdiulisdotanv adagoliyesgi yunigoliyev, dogilvwisdanelvno asequo yinulistanidolv, aquelisvgi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏓᏳᎵᏍᏙᏔᏅᎩ, ᎿᏉ ᎤᏟ ᎢᎪᎯᏛ ᎬᏆᏛᏂᏗᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ, ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏒᎩ ᎠᏆᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎢᏦᎯᏳᏒᎢ, ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏴᏗᎤᎵᏍᏙᏔᏅ ᎠᏓᎪᎵᏰᏍᎩ ᏳᏂᎪᎵᏰᎥ, ᏙᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸᏃ ᎠᏎᏉ ᏱᏄᎵᏍᏔᏂᏙᎸ, ᎠᏇᎵᏒᎩ.
\ft For this cause, when I could no longer forbear, I sent to know your faith, lest by some means the tempter have tempted you, and our labour be in vain.

\ln Aseno hnaquo Dimadi ogilutselvhi tsigi, ditsehv nvdayulosvhi, ale osdv ayelvdi oginohehelvhi tsigi, itsohiyusv ale adageyudi gesv itsehv ugvwali, ale nigohilv osiyu sgiyanvdvi, utsati itsadulisgv sgigowadvdiyi, nasgiya nasquo ayv ogadulisgv itsvgowadvdiyi;
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎿᏉ ᏗᎹᏗ ᎣᎩᎷᏤᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᏗᏤᎲ ᏅᏓᏳᎶᏒᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎠᏰᎸᏗ ᎣᎩᏃᎮᎮᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎢᏦᎯᏳᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏤᎲ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎣᏏᏳ ᏍᎩᏯᏅᏛᎢ, ᎤᏣᏘ ᎢᏣᏚᎵᏍᎬ ᏍᎩᎪᏩᏛᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏴ ᎣᎦᏚᎵᏍᎬ ᎢᏨᎪᏩᏛᏗᏱ;
\ft But now when Timotheus came from you unto us, and brought us good tidings of your faith and charity, and that ye have good remembrance of us always, desiring greatly to see us, as we also to see you:

\ln Nasgi iyusdi, idalinvtli, itsvyadanvtelv ukalisdi ogadanvdadvgi nigav otsigiliyogv ale uwelihisdi ogadanvtawadegvi, nihi itsohiyusv nvdayulisdotanvgi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᎢᏨᏯᏓᏅᏖᎸ ᎤᎧᎵᏍᏗ ᎣᎦᏓᏅᏓᏛᎩ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎣᏥᎩᎵᏲᎬ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏪᎵᎯᏍᏗ ᎣᎦᏓᏅᏔᏩᏕᎬᎢ, ᏂᎯ ᎢᏦᎯᏳᏒ ᏅᏓᏳᎵᏍᏙᏔᏅᎩ.
\ft Therefore, brethren, we were comforted over you in all our affliction and distress by your faith:

\ln Gohiyeno tsigi tsotsvnodv, iyuno ulinigidv detsidogesdi Ugvwiyuhi detsanelodvi.
\syll ᎪᎯᏰᏃ ᏥᎩ ᏦᏨᏃᏛ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᏕᏥᏙᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏕᏣᏁᎶᏛᎢ.
\ft For now we live, if ye stand fast in the Lord.

\ln Ilagoyeno igai alihelisdi yotsaguyvdasi Unelanvhi nihi gesv iyusdi, nvdigalisdodisgv nigav osdv adanvdadisdi gesv nasgi otsadanvdadisgv nihi gesv ugvwali ogatseli Unelanvhi agatahvi;
\syll ᎢᎳᎪᏰᏃ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎠᎵᎮᎵᏍᏗ ᏲᏣᎫᏴᏓᏏ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏂᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎠᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏣᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᎬ ᏂᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᎣᎦᏤᎵ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎦᏔᎲᎢ;
\ft For what thanks can we render to God again for you, for all the joy wherewith we joy for your sakes before our God;

\ln Digvwagitsvdi utsati otsadadolisdisgv otsitayohihv, nasgi digayogigowadvdi iyulisdodiyi detsakadvi, ale ogikalisisodiyi nasgi galulotsidohv itsohiyusvi.
\syll ᏗᎬᏩᎩᏨᏗ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎣᏣᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᎣᏥᏔᏲᎯᎲ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎦᏲᎩᎪᏩᏛᏗ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏕᏣᎧᏛᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎣᎩᎧᎵᏏᏐᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎷᎶᏥᏙᎲ ᎢᏦᎯᏳᏒᎢ.
\ft Night and day praying exceedingly that we might see your face, and might perfect that which is lacking in your faith?

\ln Unalanvhino uwasv nasgi Igidoda, ale igatseli Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv, ogatinvsdi gesesdi ditsehvi.
\syll ᎤᎾᎳᏅᎯᏃ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎩᏙᏓ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ, ᎣᎦᏘᏅᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏗᏤᎲᎢ.
\ft Now God himself and our Father, and our Lord Jesus Christ, direct our way unto you.

\ln Ale Ugvwiyuhi iyuwanisodi gesesdi itsinequotsediyi ale utsati iyulisdodiyi detsadageyusvi, ale naniv detsigeyusvi, nasgiya ayv nihi itsvgeyusvi;
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏐᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎢᏥᏁᏉᏤᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏕᏣᏓᎨᏳᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏕᏥᎨᏳᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎠᏴ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏨᎨᏳᏒᎢ;
\ft And the Lord make you to increase and abound in love one toward another, and toward all men, even as we do toward you:

\ln Nasgi tsulinigohisdodiyi ditsinawi, nasgi gayetsuisdodi nigesvna iyulisdodiyi duyugodv nitsadvnelv Unelanvhi agatahvi, nasgi Igidoda, nahiyu galutsvha igatseli Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv anehesdi nigadiyu unadanvti tsutseliga.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᎵᏂᎪᎯᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏗᏥᎾᏫ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏰᏧᎢᏍᏙᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎸ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎦᏔᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎩᏙᏓ, ᏀᎢᏳ ᎦᎷᏨᎭ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎠᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ ᏧᏤᎵᎦ.
\ft To the end he may stablish your hearts unblameable in holiness before God, even our Father, at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ with all his saints.

\ln Ale nasquo, idalinvtli, itsvtayoseha, ale itsvsdiyediha, Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa nvdigalisdodiha, nasgi na sgiyadvganelvhi tsigi itsadvnediyi itsedasdiyi nasgi osiyu gvwayelvdi gesv Unelanvhi, nasgi nitsadvnehv kanequotsisesdiquo.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ, ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᎢᏨᏔᏲᏎᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏨᏍᏗᏰᏗᎭ, ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏍᎩᏯᏛᎦᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎢᏣᏛᏁᏗᏱ ᎢᏤᏓᏍᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎬᏩᏰᎸᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎲ ᎧᏁᏉᏥᏎᏍᏗᏉ.
\ft Furthermore then we beseech you, brethren, and exhort you by the Lord Jesus, that as ye have received of us how ye ought to walk and to please God, so ye would abound more and more.

\ln Itsigatahayeno nusdv detsvyohiselv dikahnawadvsdi Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa osiyu uyelvnvhi gesvi.
\syll ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎭᏰᏃ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏕᏨᏲᎯᏎᎸ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎤᏰᎸᏅᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft For ye know what commandments we gave you by the Lord Jesus.

\ln Hiayeno nasgi nusdi Unelanvhi adanvtesgvi, ditsadanvgalvdv itsalisdodiyi, nasgi ditsiyohisdiyi udelidv dinisidi gesvi;
\syll ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬᎢ, ᏗᏣᏓᏅᎦᎸᏛ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏥᏲᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᏗᏂᏏᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ;
\ft For this is the will of God, even your sanctification, that ye should abstain from fornication:

\ln Nasgi nitsiv itsisiyvwiha yitsigataha itsadvnediyi itsisquanigododiyi itsiyelvi udanvgalvdv gesv ale galvquodiyu gesvi;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᏥᎥ ᎢᏥᏏᏴᏫᎭ ᏱᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᎢᏣᏛᏁᏗᏱ ᎢᏥᏍᏆᏂᎪᏙᏗᏱ ᎢᏥᏰᎸᎢ ᎤᏓᏅᎦᎸᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ;
\ft That every one of you should know how to possess his vessel in sanctification and honour;

\ln Vtlano itselayohisdi gesvi, nasgiya nanadvnehv tsunadalenvdv yvwi Unelanvhi nanigatahvna tsigi;
\syll ᎥᏝᏃ ᎢᏤᎳᏲᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᎾᏛᏁᎲ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎾᏂᎦᏔᎲᎾ ᏥᎩ;
\ft Not in the lust of concupiscence, even as the Gentiles which know not God:

\ln Nasgi gilo ulosvsdanediyi ale ulonuhediyi nigesvna analinvtli tsinigavquo gohusdi ugvwali; Ugvwiyuhiyeno ditletsehi hia nasgi nagav tsudalenvdv, nasgi gayula itsvnonelvhi ale itsvyoiyudanelvhi tsigi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎩᎶ ᎤᎶᏒᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎶᏄᎮᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏟ ᏥᏂᎦᎥᏉ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ; ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᏰᏃ ᏗᏞᏤᎯ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᎦᎥ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏳᎳ ᎢᏨᏃᏁᎸᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏨᏲᎢᏳᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ.
\ft That no man go beyond and defraud his brother in any matter: because that the Lord is the avenger of all such, as we also have forewarned you and testified.

\ln Unelanvhiyeno vtla yigiyanvhv gadaha igalisdodiyi igadanvgalvdvsgini igalisdodiyi.
\syll ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏱᎩᏯᏅᎲ ᎦᏓᎭ ᎢᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎢᎦᏓᏅᎦᎸᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
\ft For God hath not called us unto uncleanness, but unto holiness.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi gilo adaniquotihi, vtla yvwi yiganiquatiha, Unelanvhisgini, nasgi nasquo utseli Galvquodiyu Adanvdo iginelvhi tsigi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎩᎶ ᎠᏓᏂᏉᏘᎯ, ᎥᏝ ᏴᏫ ᏱᎦᏂᏆᏘᎭ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏍᎩᏂ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎢᎩᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ.
\ft He therefore that despiseth, despiseth not man, but God, who hath also given unto us his holy Spirit.

\ln Asgini analinvtli tsunadageyudi gesv ugvwali vtla udulvdi yinitsalisdaneha witsvyowelanediyi; itsvsvyeno Unelanvhi itseyonvhi igi ditsadageyudiyi.
\syll ᎠᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏟ ᏧᎾᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏚᎸᏗ ᏱᏂᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᎭ ᏫᏨᏲᏪᎳᏁᏗᏱ; ᎢᏨᏒᏰᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᏤᏲᏅᎯ ᎢᎩ ᏗᏣᏓᎨᏳᏗᏱ.
\ft But as touching brotherly love ye need not that I write unto you: for ye yourselves are taught of God to love one another.

\ln Udohiyuhiyeno nasgi nitsadvneha naniv detsigeyuha analinvtli Masidoni anehi; aseno itsvsdiyediha, idalinvtli, itsinequoisdiyi utlihiyu igai;
\syll ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎭ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏕᏥᎨᏳᎭ ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏟ ᎹᏏᏙᏂ ᎠᏁᎯ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎢᏨᏍᏗᏰᏗᎭ, ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᎢᏥᏁᏉᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏟᎯᏳ ᎢᎦᎢ;
\ft And indeed ye do it toward all the brethren which are in all Macedonia: but we beseech you, brethren, that ye increase more and more;

\ln Ale itsatlinigvnediyi nvwadohiyadv itsadediyi, ale itsvsv itsatseli digalvwisdanedi ditsilvwisdanediyi, ale itsvsv ditsoyeni ditsvdodiyi gohusdi itsadvnediyi, nasgiya nitsvweselvi;
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎢᏣᏟᏂᎬᏁᏗᏱ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᎢᏣᏕᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏨᏒ ᎢᏣᏤᎵ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᏗᏥᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏨᏒ ᏗᏦᏰᏂ ᏗᏨᏙᏗᏱ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎢᏣᏛᏁᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎸᎢ;
\ft And that ye study to be quiet, and to do your own business, and to work with your own hands, as we commanded you;

\ln Nasgi osi gvyelvdi getsidasdi yigi anigatahv nasgi anela nigesvna, ale gohusdi nitsinigvsehvna yigi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏏ ᎬᏰᎸᏗ ᎨᏥᏓᏍᏗ ᏱᎩ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎲ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏁᎳ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏂᏥᏂᎬᏎᎲᎾ ᏱᎩ.
\ft That ye may walk honestly toward them that are without, and that ye may have lack of nothing.

\ln Aseno, idalinvtli, vtla nanigatavnaquo gesesdi yitsvyeliseha nasgi na unilinvtsvhi ugvwali, nasgi uyo itsadanvdadisdiyi nigesvna nasgi nvwanadale udugi nunvsvna nasgiya nunasdvi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ, ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᎥᏝ ᎾᏂᎦᏔᎥᎾᏉ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏱᏨᏰᎵᏎᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᏂᎵᏅᏨᎯ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏲ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴ ᎤᏚᎩ ᏄᏅᏒᎾ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᎾᏍᏛᎢ.
\ft But I would not have you to be ignorant, brethren, concerning them which are asleep, that ye sorrow not, even as others which have no hope.

\ln Iyuyeno yidohiyuhvsga Tsisa uyohusvi, ale dulehisanvi, nasgiya nasquo nasgi na Tsisa unalisgasdotanvhi unilinvtsvhi Unelanvhi tsutinohisdi gesesdi tsisa galutsvha.
\syll ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᏱᏙᎯᏳᎲᏍᎦ ᏥᏌ ᎤᏲᎱᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᎴᎯᏌᏅᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏥᏌ ᎤᎾᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏔᏅᎯ ᎤᏂᎵᏅᏨᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᏘᏃᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎷᏨᎭ.
\ft For if we believe that Jesus died and rose again, even so them also which sleep in Jesus will God bring with him.

\ln Hiayeno nitsvweseha otsvdiha Ugvwiyuhi unetsvi, nasgi ayv didvnodv ale idalenidohi Ugvwiyuhi galutsv iyui vtla yidogedigonv nasgi na unilinvtsvhi.
\syll ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ ᎣᏨᏗᎭ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏁᏨᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᏗᏛᏃᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏓᎴᏂᏙᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎦᎷᏨ ᎢᏳᎢ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏙᎨᏗᎪᏅ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᏂᎵᏅᏨᎯ.
\ft For this we say unto you by the word of the Lord, that we which are alive and remain unto the coming of the Lord shall not prevent them which are asleep.

\ln Ugvwiyuhiyeno uwasv dvtloasili galvladi nvdayulosvhi ulitloyasdesdi unelugvi, ale nugvwiyusv dikahnawadidohi kanegvi, ale atselugi Unelanvhi utseliga unoyvgvi;  tsuniyohusvhino Galonedv unalisgadotanvhi igvyi dodvnaleni;
\syll ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᏰᏃ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏛᏠᎠᏏᎵ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏅᏓᏳᎶᏒᎯ ᎤᎵᏠᏯᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎷᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎧᏁᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏤᎷᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᎤᏃᏴᎬᎢ;  ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯᏃ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᎾᎵᏍᎦᏙᏔᏅᎯ ᎢᎬᏱ ᏙᏛᎾᎴᏂ;
\ft For the Lord himself shall descend from heaven with a shout, with the voice of the archangel, and with the trump of God: and the dead in Christ shall rise first:

\ln Hnaquono ayv didvnodv ale idalenidohi nasgi itsulaha egatinawidvdi gesesdi ulogilvi, widedatloisdiyi Ugvwiyuhi galvloi; nasgino nigohilv Ugvwiyuhi itsulaha widehesdi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎠᏴ ᏗᏛᏃᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏓᎴᏂᏙᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎡᎦᏘᎾᏫᏛᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᎶᎩᎸᎢ, ᏫᏕᏓᏠᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎦᎸᎶᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᏫᏕᎮᏍᏗ.
\ft Then we which are alive and remain shall be caught up together with them in the clouds, to meet the Lord in the air: and so shall we ever be with the Lord.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi detsadagalisdadisdisgesdi hia nasgi tsidetsadawesehvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏕᏣᏓᎦᎵᏍᏓᏗᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏕᏣᏓᏪᏎᎲᎢ.
\ft Wherefore comfort one another with these words.

\ln Nahiyusgini gesvi ale nahiyu degesadisvi, idalinvtli, vtla udulvdi yinitsalisdaneha itsvyowelanediyi.
\syll ᏀᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏒᎢ ᎠᎴ ᏀᎢᏳ ᏕᎨᏌᏗᏒᎢ, ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᎥᏝ ᎤᏚᎸᏗ ᏱᏂᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᎭ ᎢᏨᏲᏪᎳᏁᏗᏱ.
\ft But of the times and the seasons, brethren, ye have no need that I write unto you.

\ln Itsvsvyeno osiyu itsigata nasgi Ugvwiyuhi utseli iga uliyeilohisdi gesv nasgiya ganosgisgi svnoyi tsigalugoi.
\syll ᎢᏨᏒᏰᏃ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏥᎦᏔ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎢᎦ ᎤᎵᏰᎢᎶᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎦᏃᏍᎩᏍᎩ ᏒᏃᏱ ᏥᎦᎷᎪᎢ.
\ft For yourselves know perfectly that the day of the Lord so cometh as a thief in the night.

\ln Nahiyuyeno nvwadohiyadv ale nunayehisdvna anadisgesdi, hnaquo nuyeloistanvdv adadvdisgi unilutsedi gesesdi, nasgiya agiliya tsulutseho ageyv ganelidv; ale vtla unadiwisedi yigesesdi.
\syll ᏀᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᎠᎴ ᏄᎾᏰᎯᏍᏛᎾ ᎠᎾᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎿᏉ ᏄᏰᎶᎢᏍᏔᏅᏛ ᎠᏓᏛᏗᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᎷᏤᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎠᎩᎵᏯ ᏧᎷᏤᎰ ᎠᎨᏴ ᎦᏁᎵᏛ; ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᎤᎾᏗᏫᏎᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft For when they shall say, Peace and safety; then sudden destruction cometh upon them, as travail upon a woman with child; and they shall not escape.

\ln Nihisgini, idalinvtli, vtla ulisigv yitseha, nasgi na nahiyu iga getsatlvtasdi iyulisdodiyi nasgiya ganosgisgi tsutlvtasgoi.
\syll ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ, ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᎥᏝ ᎤᎵᏏᎬ ᏱᏤᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏀᎢᏳ ᎢᎦ ᎨᏣᏢᏔᏍᏗ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎦᏃᏍᎩᏍᎩ ᏧᏢᏔᏍᎪᎢ.
\ft But ye, brethren, are not in darkness, that that day should overtake you as a thief.

\ln Nitsivi igagati tsuwetsi, ale iga tsuwetsi; vtla svnoyi ale ulisigv idehi yigi.
\syll ᏂᏥᎥᎢ ᎢᎦᎦᏘ ᏧᏪᏥ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᎦ ᏧᏪᏥ; ᎥᏝ ᏒᏃᏱ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏏᎬ ᎢᏕᎯ ᏱᎩ.
\ft Ye are all the children of light, and the children of the day: we are not of the night, nor of darkness.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi tlesdi yidilihesdi, nasgiya anisoi nanadvnehvi; idiyawisgesdisgini ale nidigiyvsdesgvna gesesdi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏗᎵᎮᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎠᏂᏐᎢ ᎾᎾᏛᏁᎲᎢ; ᎢᏗᏯᏫᏍᎨᏍᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᎴ ᏂᏗᎩᏴᏍᏕᏍᎬᎾ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft Therefore let us not sleep, as do others; but let us watch and be sober.

\ln Anilihiyeno, svnoyi danilihoi; ale nasgi na tsuniyvsdesgi, svnoyi duniyvsdesgoi.
\syll ᎠᏂᎵᎯᏰᏃ, ᏒᏃᏱ ᏓᏂᎵᎰᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏧᏂᏴᏍᏕᏍᎩ, ᏒᏃᏱ ᏚᏂᏴᏍᏕᏍᎪᎢ.
\ft For they that sleep sleep in the night; and they that be drunken are drunken in the night.

\ln Ayvsgini iga idehi tsigi nidigiyvsdesgvna gesesdi, adanetsasdulo gohiyudi gesv ale adageyudi gesv idadanetsisdulodisgesdi, egisdelvdiyino gesv udugi igvsv igalisdulodesdi.
\syll ᎠᏴᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᎦ ᎢᏕᎯ ᏥᎩ ᏂᏗᎩᏴᏍᏕᏍᎬᎾ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎠᏓᏁᏣᏍᏚᎶ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏓᏓᏁᏥᏍᏚᎶᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎡᎩᏍᏕᎸᏗᏱᏃ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎢᎬᏒ ᎢᎦᎵᏍᏚᎶᏕᏍᏗ.
\ft But let us, who are of the day, be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love; and for an helmet, the hope of salvation.

\ln Unelanvhiyeno vtla yigasuyesv utalawohisdi gesv igilutsediyi; alisdelvdodisgini igiwadvdiyi igatseli Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv iyuwanisadv;
\syll ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏱᎦᏑᏰᏒ ᎤᏔᎳᏬᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᎩᎷᏤᏗᏱ; ᎠᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᎩᏩᏛᏗᏱ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ;
\ft For God hath not appointed us to wrath, but to obtain salvation by our Lord Jesus Christ,

\ln Nasgi tsigiyohuhiselei, nasgi nasquo yidiliha ale nidilihvna yigi, nasgi itsulaha wigadediyi iyulisdodiyi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᎩᏲᎱᎯᏎᎴᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏱᏗᎵᎭ ᎠᎴ ᏂᏗᎵᎲᎾ ᏱᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᏫᎦᏕᏗᏱ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
\ft Who died for us, that, whether we wake or sleep, we should live together with him.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi, detsadagalisdadisgesdi, ale detsadalinigohisdisgesdi, nasgiya tsinitsadvneha.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᏕᏣᏓᎦᎵᏍᏓᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᏣᏓᎵᏂᎪᎯᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏥᏂᏣᏛᏁᎭ.
\ft Wherefore comfort yourselves together, and edify one another, even as also ye do.

\ln Ale itsvtayoseha, idalinvtli, nasgi ditsigatahi iyulisdodiyi nasgi na tsunilvwisdanehi itsehvi, ale digetsanelodi tsigi Ugvwiyuhi detsanelodvi, ale tsigetsanvdadisdiha;
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎢᏨᏔᏲᏎᎭ, ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏥᎦᏔᎯ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᎢᏤᎲᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎨᏣᏁᎶᏗ ᏥᎩ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏕᏣᏁᎶᏛᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᎨᏣᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗᎭ;
\ft And we beseech you, brethren, to know them which labour among you, and are over you in the Lord, and admonish you;

\ln Ale utsati ditsilvquodiyu iyulisdodiyi adageyudi gvdi nvdigalisdodisgesdi dunilvwisdanehvi.  Ale dohiyi nitsvnesdi itsvsv itsehvi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏗᏥᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎬᏗ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏚᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎢ.  ᎠᎴ ᏙᎯᏱ ᏂᏨᏁᏍᏗ ᎢᏨᏒ ᎢᏤᎲᎢ.
\ft And to esteem them very highly in love for their work's sake. And be at peace among yourselves.

\ln Ale itsvtayoseha, idalinvtli, detseyatahvsgesdi nasgi na nunanelvna, detsigalisdadisgesdi diwanagala tsunadanvti, detsiniyvsesdi diniwanagalai, ditsvnidiyu gesesdi naniv [utsatini nigetsadvnehvi.]
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎢᏨᏔᏲᏎᎭ, ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᏕᏤᏯᏔᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏄᎾᏁᎸᎾ, ᏕᏥᎦᎵᏍᏓᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏗᏩᎾᎦᎳ ᏧᎾᏓᏅᏘ, ᏕᏥᏂᏴᏎᏍᏗ ᏗᏂᏩᎾᎦᎳᎢ, ᏗᏨᏂᏗᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎤᏣᏘᏂ ᏂᎨᏣᏛᏁᎲᎢ.data is invalid
\ft Now we exhort you, brethren, warn them that are unruly, comfort the feebleminded, support the weak, be patient toward all men.

\ln Tlesdi gilo uyo nagvnelv yutlegesdi uyo yinadadvnehesdi; itsisdawadegesdisgini nigohilv nasgi osdv gesvi, nasquo itsvsv gohusdi detsadadvdisgv, ale nanivquo.
\syll ᏞᏍᏗ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏲ ᎾᎬᏁᎸ ᏳᏞᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᏲ ᏱᎾᏓᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ; ᎢᏥᏍᏓᏩᏕᎨᏍᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᏉ ᎢᏨᏒ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏕᏣᏓᏛᏗᏍᎬ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏂᎥᏉ.
\ft See that none render evil for evil unto any man; but ever follow that which is good, both among yourselves, and to all men.

\ln Itsaliheligesdi nigohilvi;
\syll ᎢᏣᎵᎮᎵᎨᏍᏗ ᏂᎪᎯᎸᎢ;
\ft Rejoice evermore.

\ln Nitsiyohisdisgvna itsadadolisdisgesdi;
\syll ᏂᏥᏲᎯᏍᏗᏍᎬᎾ ᎢᏣᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ;
\ft Pray without ceasing.

\ln Nigavquo nitsalisdanelidegv etsalielitsehesdi [Unelanvhi;] hiayeno nasgi Unelanvhi itsadanvtehehv Tsisa Galonedv detsanelodv iyusdi.
\syll ᏂᎦᎥᏉ ᏂᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᎵᏕᎬ ᎡᏣᎵᎡᎵᏤᎮᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ;data is invalid ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏖᎮᎲ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏕᏣᏁᎶᏛ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ.
\ft In every thing give thanks: for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus concerning you.

\ln Adanvdo adaweligisgv tlesdi yvtladisgesdi.
\syll ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎠᏓᏪᎵᎩᏍᎬ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏴᏝᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
\ft Quench not the Spirit.

\ln Tlesdi asequo yitsiyelvsgesdi adolehohisdi gesvi.
\syll ᏞᏍᏗ ᎠᏎᏉ ᏱᏥᏰᎸᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Despise not prophesyings.

\ln Nudalesv gohusdi itsigoliyesgesdi; asdaya detsiniyvsesdi nasgi na osdv gesvi.
\syll ᏄᏓᎴᏒ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎢᏥᎪᎵᏰᏍᎨᏍᏗ; ᎠᏍᏓᏯ ᏕᏥᏂᏴᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Prove all things; hold fast that which is good.

\ln Itsadanvehesdi nigav nudalesv uyoi.
\syll ᎢᏣᏓᏅᎡᎮᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏄᏓᎴᏒ ᎤᏲᎢ.
\ft Abstain from all appearance of evil.

\ln Unelanvhino uwasv nvwadohiyadv adanehi nigalulogvna itsinvgalvdi gesesdi; ale nigv itsadanvtediyi ale ditsadanvdo ale ditsiyelvi tsetsisquanigodanedi gesesdi, niduduhisdvna itsalisdodiyi igatseli Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv galutsv iyui.
\syll ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏃ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᎠᏓᏁᎯ ᏂᎦᎷᎶᎬᎾ ᎢᏥᏅᎦᎸᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᎠᎴ ᏂᎬ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏖᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏣᏓᏅᏙ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏥᏰᎸᎢ ᏤᏥᏍᏆᏂᎪᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᏂᏚᏚᎯᏍᏛᎾ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎦᎷᏨ ᎢᏳᎢ.
\ft And the very God of peace sanctify you wholly; and I pray God your whole spirit and soul and body be preserved blameless unto the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.

\ln Nudalidasdvna nasgi na itsayanvdv, nasquo nasgi ase tsinvdvdvneli.
\syll ᏄᏓᎵᏓᏍᏛᎾ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎢᏣᏯᏅᏛ, ᎾᏍᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏎ ᏥᏅᏛᏛᏁᎵ.
\ft Faithful is he that calleth you, who also will do it.

\ln Idalinvtli sgiyanvdadisgesdi itsadadolisdisgvi.
\syll ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ ᏍᎩᏯᏅᏓᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎢᏣᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ.
\ft Brethren, pray for us.

\ln Nigadv analinvtli galvquodiyu didadowedovsdi detsiyolisdisgesdi.
\syll ᏂᎦᏛ ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏟ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᏗᏓᏙᏪᏙᎥᏍᏗ ᏕᏥᏲᎵᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
\ft Greet all the brethren with an holy kiss.

\ln Itsvnetseha Ugvwiyuhi itsvneisdaneha, hia nasgi goweli getsigoliyediyi naniv unadanvti analinvtli.
\syll ᎢᏨᏁᏤᎭ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᏨᏁᎢᏍᏓᏁᎭ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᏪᎵ ᎨᏥᎪᎵᏰᏗᏱ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏟ.
\ft I charge you by the Lord that this epistle be read unto all the holy brethren.

\ln Igatseli Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv detsikahnawadidohesdi.  Emenv.
\syll ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏕᏥᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎮᏍᏗ.  ᎡᎺᏅ.
\ft The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you. Amen.

\ln Quola, ale Sayila, ale Dimadi, witsvyowelasi ditsanelodi itsadatlugv Desiloniga itsehi Unelanvhi Igidoda ale Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv detsanelodvi.
\syll ᏉᎳ, ᎠᎴ ᏌᏱᎳ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎹᏗ, ᏫᏨᏲᏪᎳᏏ ᏗᏣᏁᎶᏗ ᎢᏣᏓᏡᎬ ᏕᏏᎶᏂᎦ ᎢᏤᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᎩᏙᏓ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏕᏣᏁᎶᏛᎢ.
\ft Paul, and Silvanus, and Timotheus, unto the church of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ:

\ln Gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv ale nvwadohiyadv detsikahnawadidohesdi nvdayunalisgolvtanvhi Unelanvhi Igidoda ale Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv.
\syll ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᏕᏥᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎮᏍᏗ ᏅᏓᏳᎾᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏅᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᎩᏙᏓ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ.
\ft Grace unto you, and peace, from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

\ln Ogadudala nigohilv otsalielitsediyi Unelanvhi nihi idalinvtli ugvwali, tsiduyugodi nasgi iyogadvnediyi, nvdigalisdodiha itsohiyusv utsati tsadvsga, ale detsadageyusv nitsiv itsisiyvwiha gesv utsati tsikanequoga;
\syll ᎣᎦᏚᏓᎳ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎣᏣᎵᎡᎵᏤᏗᏱ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ, ᏥᏚᏳᎪᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏲᎦᏛᏁᏗᏱ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎢᏦᎯᏳᏒ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏣᏛᏍᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᏣᏓᎨᏳᏒ ᏂᏥᎥ ᎢᏥᏏᏴᏫᎭ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏥᎧᏁᏉᎦ;
\ft We are bound to thank God always for you, brethren, as it is meet, because that your faith groweth exceedingly, and the charity of every one of you all toward each other aboundeth;

\ln Nasgi iyusdi ayv ogvsv otsatlvquisga itsvneisdisgv tsunanelodi dunadatluwadisv Unelanvhi tsutseliga, nasgi ditsvnidiyu gesv ale itsohiyu gesv nigav udeyadodi ale agiliya itsilutsehvi;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏴ ᎣᎬᏒ ᎣᏣᏢᏈᏍᎦ ᎢᏨᏁᎢᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᏚᎾᏓᏡᏩᏗᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᏤᎵᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏨᏂᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏦᎯᏳ ᎨᏒ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎤᏕᏯᏙᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎩᎵᏯ ᎢᏥᎷᏤᎲᎢ;
\ft So that we ourselves glory in you in the churches of God for your patience and faith in all your persecutions and tribulations that ye endure:

\ln Nasgi gvnigesv igvnehi tsigi Unelanvhi duyugodv tsuwugodvdi tsuwugododi gesvi, nasgi yeli Unelanvhi utseligohi itsehi etselisediyi, nasgi nasquo ugvwali tsitsigiliyoga.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᎬᏁᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᏧᏭᎪᏛᏗ ᏧᏭᎪᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏰᎵ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎪᎯ ᎢᏤᎯ ᎡᏤᎵᏎᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᏥᏥᎩᎵᏲᎦ.
\ft Which is a manifest token of the righteous judgment of God, that ye may be counted worthy of the kingdom of God, for which ye also suffer:

\ln Nvdigalisdodiha duyugodvi Unelanvhi tsuguyvdanediyi agiliyoisdi gesv nasgi na getsigiliyoisdisgi;
\syll ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᏚᏳᎪᏛᎢ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᎫᏴᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᎠᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎨᏥᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗᏍᎩ;
\ft Seeing it is a righteous thing with God to recompense tribulation to them that trouble you;

\ln Nihino etsigiliyoisdisgi, atsawesolvsdodi gesv egaguyvdanediyi, nahiyu Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa galvlo nvdayudalenvhi gvnigesv nagvnelvha anehesdi tsunalinigidv tsutseli dinikahnawadidohi,
\syll ᏂᎯᏃ ᎡᏥᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗᏍᎩ, ᎠᏣᏪᏐᎸᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎡᎦᎫᏴᏓᏁᏗᏱ, ᏀᎢᏳ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎸᎶ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎾᎬᏁᎸᎭ ᎠᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᏧᎾᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᏧᏤᎵ ᏗᏂᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎯ,
\ft And to you who are troubled rest with us, when the Lord Jesus shall be revealed from heaven with his mighty angels,

\ln Atsilv adaweligisgi unuwosdesdi dagiliyoisdisgesdi nasgi na nigvwagatahvna Unelanvhi, ale nunohiyusvna osdv kanohedv igatseli ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv utseliga.
\syll ᎠᏥᎸ ᎠᏓᏪᎵᎩᏍᎩ ᎤᏄᏬᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᏓᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏂᎬᏩᎦᏔᎲᎾ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏄᏃᎯᏳᏒᎾ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ.
\ft In flaming fire taking vengeance on them that know not God, and that obey not the gospel of our Lord Jesus Christ:

\ln Nasgi getsisdvdisdodi gesesdi gegvdanedi winasdvna adadvdisgi ugvwiyuhi agatahv nvdayudalenvhi, ale galvquodiyu ulinigidiyu gesvi,
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᏥᏍᏛᏗᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎨᎬᏓᏁᏗ ᏫᎾᏍᏛᎾ ᎠᏓᏛᏗᏍᎩ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᎦᏔᎲ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ,
\ft Who shall be punished with everlasting destruction from the presence of the Lord, and from the glory of his power;

\ln Nahiyu tsutseli unadanvti gvwalvquododiyi ugvwali galutsvha, ale usquanigodi tsudanvdadisdodiyi naniv nasgi na gvwohiyuhvsgi nahiyu iga gesesdi, nvdigalisdodisgesdi gohiyunvhi gesv oginohelv itsehvi.
\syll ᏀᎢᏳ ᏧᏤᎵ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ ᎬᏩᎸᏉᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᎦᎷᏨᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᏧᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎬᏬᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᏀᎢᏳ ᎢᎦ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎪᎯᏳᏅᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎣᎩᏃᎮᎸ ᎢᏤᎲᎢ.
\ft When he shall come to be glorified in his saints, and to be admired in all them that believe (because our testimony among you was believed) in that day.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi nasquo nigohilv otsadadolisdisgo itsvyanvdadisgo, nasgi Oganelanvhi udayanvdi gesv itsiyanvtanvhi iyulisdodiyi, ale usquadisdiyi nigadv osdv uyelvdi gesv nvdayudalenvhi udanvtiyu gesvi, ale gohiyudi gesv tsulvwisdanedi gvtanvhi ulinigidv gesvi;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎣᏣᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎪ ᎢᏨᏯᏅᏓᏗᏍᎪ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᎦᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏓᏯᏅᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏥᏯᏅᏔᏅᎯ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏍᏆᏗᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎤᏰᎸᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᎤᏓᏅᏘᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏧᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎬᏔᏅᎯ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ;
\ft Wherefore also we pray always for you, that our God would count you worthy of this calling, and fulfil all the good pleasure of his goodness, and the work of faith with power:

\ln Nasgi iyuwanisodiyi dudov igatseli Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Dalonedv galvquodiyu iyulisdodiyi nihi itsvnisadv, ale nihi galvquodiyu iyetsvnediyi nasgi iyuwanisadv, nasgiya nusdv gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv Iganelanvhi, ale Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏐᏗᏱ ᏚᏙᎥ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᏓᎶᏁᏛ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏨᏂᏌᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎯ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎢᏰᏨᏁᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᎦᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ.
\ft That the name of our Lord Jesus Christ may be glorified in you, and ye in him, according to the grace of our God and the Lord Jesus Christ.

\ln Nasgino, idalinvtli, itsvtayoseha uluhisdi gesv igatseli Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv, ale nasgi wedadatlisanedi gesv ugvwali,
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ, ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᎢᏨᏔᏲᏎᎭ ᎤᎷᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏪᏓᏓᏟᏌᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ,
\ft Now we beseech you, brethren, by the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, and by our gathering together unto him,

\ln Nasgi tlegiquo tsetsitelvnadiyi nigesvna detsadanvdvi, ale itsadeyatanediyi nigesvna, nasquo adanvdo gvdi, ale gawonisvhi, ale goweli gowelanvhi gvdi ayv ogadanvsidv tsigeso iyusdi; nasgi Galonedv utseli iga usqualvhidenv tsigeso nasgiyai.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏞᎩᏉ ᏤᏥᏖᎸᎾᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏕᏣᏓᏅᏛᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏣᏕᏯᏔᏁᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎬᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᏬᏂᏒᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎪᏪᎵ ᎪᏪᎳᏅᎯ ᎬᏗ ᎠᏴ ᎣᎦᏓᏅᏏᏛ ᏥᎨᏐ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎢᎦ ᎤᏍᏆᎸᎯᏕᏅ ᏥᎨᏐ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ.
\ft That ye be not soon shaken in mind, or be troubled, neither by spirit, nor by word, nor by letter as from us, as that the day of Christ is at hand.

\ln Ase tlesdi gilo yitsilidastanesdi; vtlayeno [nahiyu iga uliyeilohisdi yigi] gvni igvyi anisuligogesdi, ale nasgi na asgaya asgana tsulvwisdanehi gvnigesv nagvnelvha, nasgi advdisgi uwetsi;
\syll ᎠᏎ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎩᎶ ᏱᏥᎵᏓᏍᏔᏁᏍᏗ; ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᏀᎢᏳ ᎢᎦ ᎤᎵᏰᎢᎶᎯᏍᏗ ᏱᎩdata is invalid ᎬᏂ ᎢᎬᏱ ᎠᏂᏑᎵᎪᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎠᏍᎦᎾ ᏧᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎾᎬᏁᎸᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏛᏗᏍᎩ ᎤᏪᏥ;
\ft Let no man deceive you by any means: for that day shall not come, except there come a falling away first, and that man of sin be revealed, the son of perdition;

\ln Nasgi tsidagatilega ale galvladitlv tsinadadvneha nigav Unelanvhi gegosedi tsigi, ale gegadadolisdanehi tsigi; nasgi iyusdi Unelanvhi nasgiya uwola Unelanvhi utseli adanelvi, uwasv gvnigesv nadadvneha Unelanvhi gesvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏓᎦᏘᎴᎦ ᎠᎴ ᎦᎸᎳᏗᏢ ᏥᎾᏓᏛᏁᎭ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎨᎪᏎᏗ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎨᎦᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᏥᎩ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎤᏬᎳ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎠᏓᏁᎸᎢ, ᎤᏩᏒ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎾᏓᏛᏁᎭ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Who opposeth and exalteth himself above all that is called God, or that is worshipped; so that he as God sitteth in the temple of God, shewing himself that he is God.

\ln Tlasgo yitsanvta, nasgi asi tsitsvyeladidohvgi nasgi hia itsvnohehelvi?
\syll ᏝᏍᎪ ᏱᏣᏅᏔ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏏ ᏥᏨᏰᎳᏗᏙᎲᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎢᏨᏃᎮᎮᎸᎢ?
\ft Remember ye not, that, when I was yet with you, I told you these things?

\ln Gohino tsigi idigataha iyusdi ayosdodisgv gvnigesv iyagvnediyi nahiyu gvnigesv iyagvnedi gesvi.
\syll ᎪᎯᏃ ᏥᎩ ᎢᏗᎦᏔᎭ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏲᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏯᎬᏁᏗᏱ ᏀᎢᏳ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏯᎬᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft And now ye know what withholdeth that he might be revealed in his time.

\ln Udelidvyeno asgana gayula dulvwisdaneha; gohisgini gesv ayosdodisgi tsigi uyosdodanehesdi gvni atsikahvsvha.
\syll ᎤᏕᎵᏛᏰᏃ ᎠᏍᎦᎾ ᎦᏳᎳ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎭ; ᎪᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏲᏍᏙᏗᏍᎩ ᏥᎩ ᎤᏲᏍᏙᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᎬᏂ ᎠᏥᎧᎲᏒᎭ.
\ft For the mystery of iniquity doth already work: only he who now letteth will let, until he be taken out of the way.

\ln Nahiyuno nasgi na asgana gvnigesv nvdayegvneli, nasgi Ugvwiyuhi tsvdvdvtani adanvdo aholi nvdayudalenvhi gvdi, ale tsvdvdvtani dagvtani gvnigesv nagvnehv nahiyu galutsvha;
\syll ᏀᎢᏳᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᏍᎦᎾ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏅᏓᏰᎬᏁᎵ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏨᏛᏛᏔᏂ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎠᎰᎵ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᎬᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏨᏛᏛᏔᏂ ᏓᎬᏔᏂ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎾᎬᏁᎲ ᏀᎢᏳ ᎦᎷᏨᎭ;
\ft And then shall that Wicked be revealed, whom the Lord shall consume with the spirit of his mouth, and shall destroy with the brightness of his coming:

\ln Nasgi na uluhisdi gesv nasgiya Sedani tsulvwisdanedi dulvwisdanehesdi gvdisgesdi utsati ulinigidv gesvi, ale usquanigodi ale gayegogi uyelvdvi,
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᎷᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏎᏓᏂ ᏧᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᎬᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎦᏰᎪᎩ ᎤᏰᎸᏛᎢ,
\ft Even him, whose coming is after the working of Satan with all power and signs and lying wonders,

\ln Ale gvdisgesdi utsati udalidasdi niduyugodvna gesv anehv nasgi getsidvdodi gesvi; nvdigalisdodisgv nidunadanilvtsvna gesv duyugodv ageyudi gesvi, nasgi gagetsisdelvdi iyulisdodiyi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎬᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᏓᎵᏓᏍᏗ ᏂᏚᏳᎪᏛᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏁᎲ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᏥᏛᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬ ᏂᏚᎾᏓᏂᎸᏨᎾ ᎨᏒ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎠᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎨᏥᏍᏕᎸᏗ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
\ft And with all deceivableness of unrighteousness in them that perish; because they received not the love of the truth, that they might be saved.

\ln Ale nasgi iyusdi Unelanvhi udanvsdi gesesdi unilutsediyi ulinigidv unilonuhesgi nasgi iyuwanisodi unohiyudiyi gayegogi gesvi;
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏓᏅᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᏂᎷᏤᏗᏱ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᎤᏂᎶᏄᎮᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏐᏗ ᎤᏃᎯᏳᏗᏱ ᎦᏰᎪᎩ ᎨᏒᎢ;
\ft And for this cause God shall send them strong delusion, that they should believe a lie:

\ln nasgi digvwanadugodanedi iyulisdodiyi naniv nasgi na nanohiyuhvsgvna duyugodv gesvi, niduyugodvnasgini gesv anohiyuhvsgi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎬᏩᎾᏚᎪᏓᏁᏗ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎾᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎬᎾ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏂᏚᏳᎪᏛᎾᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ.
\ft That they all might be damned who believed not the truth, but had pleasure in unrighteousness.

\ln Aseno ogadudala nigohilv otsalielitsediyi Unelanvhi nihi gesv ugvwali, idalinvtli Ugvwiyuhi itsigeyuhi, nvdigalisdodiha Unelanvhi tsudalenvhv nvdagvwadalenvdv itsasuyesv etsisdelvdiyi gvdodiyi Adanvdo itsinvgalisgvi, ale itsohiyusv udohiyuhi gesvi;
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎣᎦᏚᏓᎳ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎣᏣᎵᎡᎵᏤᏗᏱ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏂᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ, ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᏥᎨᏳᎯ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᎲ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎢᏣᏑᏰᏒ ᎡᏥᏍᏕᎸᏗᏱ ᎬᏙᏗᏱ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎢᏥᏅᎦᎵᏍᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏦᎯᏳᏒ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ;
\ft But we are bound to give thanks alway to God for you, brethren beloved of the Lord, because God hath from the beginning chosen you to salvation through sanctification of the Spirit and belief of the truth:

\ln Nahna tsideyokanv osdv kanohedv ogatseli tsitsiyanvtanv, itsiwadvdiyi galvquodiyu gesv igatseli Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv utseliga.
\syll ᏀᎾ ᏥᏕᏲᎧᏅ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎣᎦᏤᎵ ᏥᏥᏯᏅᏔᏅ, ᎢᏥᏩᏛᏗᏱ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ.
\ft Whereunto he called you by our gospel, to the obtaining of the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi, idalinvtli, ulinigidv detsidogesdi, ale detsiniyvsesdi dideyodi gesv nasgi nusdv etseyonvi, nasquo gawonisvhiquo yigi, ale witsvyowelanelvhi yigi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᏕᏥᏙᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᏥᏂᏴᏎᏍᏗ ᏗᏕᏲᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎡᏤᏲᏅᎢ, ᎾᏍᏉ ᎦᏬᏂᏒᎯᏉ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏫᏨᏲᏪᎳᏁᎸᎯ ᏱᎩ.
\ft Therefore, brethren, stand fast, and hold the traditions which ye have been taught, whether by word, or our epistle.

\ln Nasgino igatseli Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv uwasv, ale Unelanvhi, nasgi Igidoda, nasgi igigeyuhiyu tsigesvgi, ale tsiginelv ulisquadisdi nigesvna adagalisdadisgi, ale osdv udugi gvdi gesv nvdayudalenvhi gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesvi,
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏩᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎩᏙᏓ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎩᎨᏳᎯᏳ ᏥᎨᏒᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᎩᏁᎸ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎠᏓᎦᎵᏍᏓᏗᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎬᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ,
\ft Now our Lord Jesus Christ himself, and God, even our Father, which hath loved us, and hath given us everlasting consolation and good hope through grace,

\ln Nasgi ditsigalisdadedi gesesdi ditsinawi, ale ditsalinigohisdodi gesesdi nigav osdv gesv itsiwonihisdiyi ale ditsilvwisdanediyi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏥᎦᎵᏍᏓᏕᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏗᏥᎾᏫ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏣᎵᏂᎪᎯᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏥᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏥᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ.
\ft Comfort your hearts, and stablish you in every good word and work.

\ln Ulisqualvdino gesvi, idalinvtli, itsadadolisdisgesdi ayv sgiyanvdadisgesdi, nasgi kanohedv Ugvwiyuhi utseliga uyelihisdiyi, ale galvquodiyu iyulisdodiyi, nasgiya tsinusdi nihi itsehvi;
\syll ᎤᎵᏍᏆᎸᏗᏃ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᎢᏣᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᏴ ᏍᎩᏯᏅᏓᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᎤᏰᎵᎯᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏥᏄᏍᏗ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏤᎲᎢ;
\ft Finally, brethren, pray for us, that the word of the Lord may have free course, and be glorified, even as it is with you:

\ln Ale nasgi tsotsadudalaediyi uniyo ale anisgana anisgaya; vtlayeno naniv gohiyudi gesv yuneha.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏦᏣᏚᏓᎳᎡᏗᏱ ᎤᏂᏲ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᎾ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ; ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏳᏁᎭ.
\ft And that we may be delivered from unreasonable and wicked men: for all men have not faith.

\ln Ugvwiyuhisgini nudalidasdvna, nasgi tsvdatsalinigohistani, ale tsvlitsiyosdodaneli uyo itsadvnediyi.
\syll ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᏄᏓᎵᏓᏍᏛᎾ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏨᏓᏣᎵᏂᎪᎯᏍᏔᏂ, ᎠᎴ ᏨᎵᏥᏲᏍᏙᏓᏁᎵ ᎤᏲ ᎢᏣᏛᏁᏗᏱ.
\ft But the Lord is faithful, who shall stablish you, and keep you from evil.

\ln Ale otsalisgasdodi Ugvwiyuhi nihi gesv ugvwali, nasgi nitsadvnehvi, ale ase nasgi itsadvnedi gesv nusdv itsvnetsehvi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎣᏣᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏗ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏂᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎲᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏎ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏣᏛᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎢᏨᏁᏤᎲᎢ.
\ft And we have confidence in the Lord touching you, that ye both do and will do the things which we command you.

\ln Ale Ugvwiyuhi tsusehedi gesesdi ditsinawi etsigeyui iyulisdodiyi Unelanvhi, ale ditsvnidiyu iyulisdodiyi Galonedv nasgiyai.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏧᏎᎮᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏗᏥᎾᏫ ᎡᏥᎨᏳᎢ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏨᏂᏗᏳ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ.
\ft And the Lord direct your hearts into the love of God, and into the patient waiting for Christ.

\ln Hnaquono itsvnetseha, idalinvtli, otsvdiha dudov igatseli Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv, nasgi ditsadadaledanediyi naniv analinvtli utsatini iyanadvnelidohi, ale nidanikahnawadegvna dideyodi gesv ayv digogadanilvtselvhi,
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎢᏨᏁᏤᎭ, ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᎣᏨᏗᎭ ᏚᏙᎥ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏣᏓᏓᎴᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏟ ᎤᏣᏘᏂ ᎢᏯᎾᏛᏁᎵᏙᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᏓᏂᎧᎿᏩᏕᎬᎾ ᏗᏕᏲᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏴ ᏗᎪᎦᏓᏂᎸᏤᎸᎯ,
\ft Now we command you, brethren, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that ye withdraw yourselves from every brother that walketh disorderly, and not after the tradition which he received of us.

\ln Iyusvyeno itsigataha itsadvnediyi sgisdawadvsdiyi; vtlayeno utsatini yinotsadvnelidohe itsvyeladidohvi;
\syll ᎢᏳᏒᏰᏃ ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᎢᏣᏛᏁᏗᏱ ᏍᎩᏍᏓᏩᏛᏍᏗᏱ; ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᎤᏣᏘᏂ ᏱᏃᏣᏛᏁᎵᏙᎮ ᎢᏨᏰᎳᏗᏙᎲᎢ;
\ft For yourselves know how ye ought to follow us: for we behaved not ourselves disorderly among you;

\ln Vtla ale gilo asequo yotsalisdayvnanehei; dogilvwisdanehvgisgini ale dogiyawetsidohvgi gvwagitsvdi, nogadulisgvna gesv iyusdi ayv asiyvwi nitsadvnv gagedv iyotsvyvnediyi;
\syll ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᎠᏎᏉ ᏲᏣᎵᏍᏓᏴᎾᏁᎮᎢ; ᏙᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎩᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᎴ ᏙᎩᏯᏪᏥᏙᎲᎩ ᎬᏩᎩᏨᏗ, ᏃᎦᏚᎵᏍᎬᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏴ ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᏂᏣᏛᏅ ᎦᎨᏛ ᎢᏲᏨᏴᏁᏗᏱ;
\ft Neither did we eat any man's bread for nought; but wrought with labour and travail night and day, that we might not be chargeable to any of you:

\ln Vtla nogihvna gesv [nvwadale iyogadvnediyi] yinvdigalisdodisgei, ditsatlilosdodisgini notsadadvnehv ayv sgisdawadvsdiyi nvdagalisdodisgvgi.
\syll ᎥᏝ ᏃᎩᎲᎾ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᎢᏲᎦᏛᏁᏗᏱdata is invalid ᏱᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᎢ, ᏗᏣᏟᎶᏍᏙᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᏃᏣᏓᏛᏁᎲ ᎠᏴ ᏍᎩᏍᏓᏩᏛᏍᏗᏱ ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬᎩ.
\ft Not because we have not power, but to make ourselves an ensample unto you to follow us.

\ln Nahiyuyeno tsitsvyeladidohvgi, hia nasgi nusdvgi itsvnetselvgi, nasgi iyuno gilo nudulisgvna yigi, tsulvwisdanediyi nasquo ulisdayvdiyi nigesvna gesvi.
\syll ᏀᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᏥᏨᏰᎳᏗᏙᎲᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏛᎩ ᎢᏨᏁᏤᎸᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᏄᏚᎵᏍᎬᎾ ᏱᎩ, ᏧᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft For even when we were with you, this we commanded you, that if any would not work, neither should he eat.

\ln Otsadvgihayeno nasgi gilo getsadasuyv utsatini nanadvnelidohvi, gohusdi nanadvnehvna, aseno anadvnelidohi igi.
\syll ᎣᏣᏛᎩᎭᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎩᎶ ᎨᏣᏓᏑᏴ ᎤᏣᏘᏂ ᎾᎾᏛᏁᎵᏙᎲᎢ, ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎾᎾᏛᏁᎲᎾ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᎾᏛᏁᎵᏙᎯ ᎢᎩ.
\ft For we hear that there are some which walk among you disorderly, working not at all, but are busybodies.

\ln Nasgino iyunasdi gesvi, dotsinetseha ale dotsisdiyediha dotsineisdaneha igatseli Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv, nasgi dohiquo tsunilvwisdanediyi, ale unvsv unatseli alisdayvdi unalisdayvdodiyi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏙᏥᏁᏤᎭ ᎠᎴ ᏙᏥᏍᏗᏰᏗᎭ ᏙᏥᏁᎢᏍᏓᏁᎭ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏙᎯᏉ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏅᏒ ᎤᎾᏤᎵ ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗ ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᏙᏗᏱ.
\ft Now them that are such we command and exhort by our Lord Jesus Christ, that with quietness they work, and eat their own bread.

\ln Nihisgini, idalinvtli, tlesdi yiditsiyawegesdi osdv detsilvwisdanehvi.
\syll ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ, ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏗᏥᏯᏪᎨᏍᏗ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏕᏥᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎢ.
\ft But ye, brethren, be not weary in well doing.

\ln Iyuno gilo nigohiyuhvsgvna igesesdi otsiwonisgv ani otsowelisgvi, gvnigesv netsvnelvha nasgi, ale tlesdi itsulaha itsedolvgi, nasgi gvwadehohisdi iyulisdodiyi.
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᏂᎪᎯᏳᎲᏍᎬᎾ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎣᏥᏬᏂᏍᎬ ᎠᏂ ᎣᏦᏪᎵᏍᎬᎢ, ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏁᏨᏁᎸᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎢᏤᏙᎸᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏩᏕᎰᎯᏍᏗ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
\ft And if any man obey not our word by this epistle, note that man, and have no company with him, that he may be ashamed.

\ln Adina tlesdi etsisgagi iyusdi yetsadanvtesgesdi, etsigvsgolvvsgesdisgini itsadanvtli nasgiyai.
\syll ᎠᏗᎾ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎡᏥᏍᎦᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏰᏣᏓᏅᏖᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎡᏥᎬᏍᎪᎸᎥᏍᎨᏍᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏟ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ.
\ft Yet count him not as an enemy, but admonish him as a brother.

\ln Ugvwiyuhino nvwadohiyadv uwehi uwasv ase itsinedi gesesdi nvwadohiyadv nigohilvi.  Ugvwiyuhi nitsiv detsikahnadidohesdi.
\syll ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᏃ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᎤᏪᎯ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎠᏎ ᎢᏥᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᏂᎪᎯᎸᎢ.  ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏂᏥᎥ ᏕᏥᎧᎿᏗᏙᎮᏍᏗ.
\ft Now the Lord of peace himself give you peace always by all means. The Lord be with you all.

\ln Ayv Quola aquadayolisdi gesv aquvsv aquoyeni aquvtanvhi aquowelanvhi, nasgi digolisdodi tsigi nigadv goweli; nasgiya nigvneho gowelisgoi.
\syll ᎠᏴ ᏉᎳ ᎠᏆᏓᏲᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏋᏒ ᎠᏉᏰᏂ ᎠᏋᏔᏅᎯ ᎠᏉᏪᎳᏅᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎪᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᏥᎩ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎪᏪᎵ; ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏂᎬᏁᎰ ᎪᏪᎵᏍᎪᎢ.
\ft The salutation of Paul with mine own hand, which is the token in every epistle: so I write.

\ln Gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv igatseli Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv detsikahnawadidohesdi nitsivi.  Emenv.
\syll ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏕᏥᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎮᏍᏗ ᏂᏥᎥᎢ.  ᎡᎺᏅ.
\ft The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.

\ln Ayv Quola Tsisa Galonedv aginvsidv gvginetselvhi Unelanvhi igisdelisgi ale Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv nasgi udugi gvdi gesv igatseliga,
\syll ᎠᏴ ᏉᎳ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎠᎩᏅᏏᏛ ᎬᎩᏁᏤᎸᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᎩᏍᏕᎵᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎬᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᎦᏤᎵᎦ,
\ft Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the commandment of God our Saviour, and Lord Jesus Christ, which is our hope;

\ln wigvyowelasi Timadi aquvsv aquatseli aquutsi gohiyudi gesv iyuwanisadv; gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv ale udadolitsadv gesv ale nvwadohiyadv detsakahnawadidohesdi nvdayunalisgolvtanvhi Unelanvhi Igidoda ale Tsisa Galonedv Ugvwiyuhi igatseliga.
\syll ᏫᎬᏲᏪᎳᏏ ᏘᎹᏗ ᎠᏋᏒ ᎠᏆᏤᎵ ᎠᏊᏥ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ; ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏣᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᏕᏣᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎮᏍᏗ ᏅᏓᏳᎾᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏅᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᎩᏙᏓ ᎠᎴ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᎦᏤᎵᎦ.
\ft Unto Timothy, my own son in the faith: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God our Father and Jesus Christ our Lord.

\ln Nano tsigvtayoselvgi tsadigiyasdiyi Equisa, Masidone tsiwagilosvgi, nasgi tinvsdadediyi gilo danadeyohvsgv utsatini iyuniwesdiyi nigesvna,
\syll ᎾᏃ ᏥᎬᏔᏲᏎᎸᎩ ᏣᏗᎩᏯᏍᏗᏱ ᎡᏈᏌ, ᎹᏏᏙᏁ ᏥᏩᎩᎶᏒᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏘᏅᏍᏓᏕᏗᏱ ᎩᎶ ᏓᎾᏕᏲᎲᏍᎬ ᎤᏣᏘᏂ ᎢᏳᏂᏪᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ,
\ft As I besought thee to abide still at Ephesus, when I went into Macedonia, that thou mightest charge some that they teach no other doctrine,

\ln Ale unadvdasdodiyi nigesvna asequo gawonihisdi gesv ale winasdvna kanohedi gesv unadanetliyvsvsvi, nasgi gawonihisdiquo tsiwaliyilohiha vyono unelanvhi dineladodi gesv udvhisdiyi, nasgi gohiyudi gesv tsvdidalehvsga, [nasgi hnadvnelvha.]
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏛᏓᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎠᏎᏉ ᎦᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏫᎾᏍᏛᎾ ᎧᏃᎮᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎾᏓᏁᏟᏴᏒᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗᏉ ᏥᏩᎵᏱᎶᎯᎭ ᎥᏲᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏗᏁᎳᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏛᎯᏍᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏨᏗᏓᎴᎲᏍᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎿᏛᏁᎸᎭ.data is invalid
\ft Neither give heed to fables and endless genealogies, which minister questions, rather than godly edifying which is in faith: so do.

\ln Dikahnawadvsdi adageyudi gesv ugvwala nasgi gadaha nigesvna onawi nvdayudalenvhi, ale osdv digugododi gesv ale nutlonasdvna gohiyudi gesvi;
\syll ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏩᎳ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏓᎭ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎣᎾᏫ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏗᎫᎪᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏄᏠᎾᏍᏛᎾ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ;
\ft Now the end of the commandment is charity out of a pure heart, and of a good conscience, and of faith unfeigned:

\ln Nasgi nahna gilo unagolvdv tsigi, nulisalodvna gawonihisdi gesv wunagatahvstanv;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏀᎾ ᎩᎶ ᎤᎾᎪᎸᏛ ᏥᎩ, ᏄᎵᏌᎶᏛᎾ ᎦᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏭᎾᎦᏔᎲᏍᏔᏅ;
\ft From which some having swerved have turned aside unto vain jangling;

\ln Unadulisgvgi dikahnawadvsdi dinosisisgi iyunalisdodiyi, aseno nanoligvna nusdv aniwonisgv, ale nusdv anisdayidisgvi.
\syll ᎤᎾᏚᎵᏍᎬᎩ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏗᏃᏏᏏᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎾᏃᎵᎬᎾ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎠᏂᏬᏂᏍᎬ, ᎠᎴ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎠᏂᏍᏓᏱᏗᏍᎬᎢ.
\ft Desiring to be teachers of the law; understanding neither what they say, nor whereof they affirm.

\ln Aseno idigataha dikahnawadvsdi osiyu gesv, iyuno gilo udohiyuhiya yidakahnawadega,
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎢᏗᎦᏔᎭ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎨᏒ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᏱᏓᎧᎿᏩᏕᎦ,
\ft But we know that the law is good, if a man use it lawfully;

\ln Hia nasquo yagataha, nasgi dikahnawadvsdi udanvti yvwi agotlvnanelvhi nigesvna gesvi, dikahnawadvsdisgini nidunanelodvna, ale nunohiyusvna, unelanvhi nidunanelodvna, ale anisganai, anigadahai, ale osdv gesv aniniquatihi, tsunidoda dinihihi ale tsunitsi dinihihi, yvwi dinihihi,
\syll ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏯᎦᏔᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎤᏓᏅᏘ ᏴᏫ ᎠᎪᏢᎾᏁᎸᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᏂᏚᎾᏁᎶᏛᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᏄᏃᎯᏳᏒᎾ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏂᏚᎾᏁᎶᏛᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᎾᎢ, ᎠᏂᎦᏓᎭᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏂᏂᏆᏘᎯ, ᏧᏂᏙᏓ ᏗᏂᎯᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏧᏂᏥ ᏗᏂᎯᎯ, ᏴᏫ ᏗᏂᎯᎯ,
\ft Knowing this, that the law is not made for a righteous man, but for the lawless and disobedient, for the ungodly and for sinners, for unholy and profane, for murderers of fathers and murderers of mothers, for manslayers,

\ln Uninegutsidv, anisgaya dinanisihvsgi, yvwi dininosgisgi, aniyegogi, gayegogi anaselidvsgi, ale nasquo nigav gohusdi nasgi digatilegi osdv dideyodi gesvi;
\syll ᎤᏂᏁᎫᏥᏛ, ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ ᏗᎾᏂᏏᎲᏍᎩ, ᏴᏫ ᏗᏂᏃᏍᎩᏍᎩ, ᎠᏂᏰᎪᎩ, ᎦᏰᎪᎩ ᎠᎾᏎᎵᏛᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎦᏘᎴᎩ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏗᏕᏲᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ;
\ft For whoremongers, for them that defile themselves with mankind, for menstealers, for liars, for perjured persons, and if there be any other thing that is contrary to sound doctrine;

\ln Nasgiya nusdv galvquodiyu osdv kanohedv Unelanvhi nvwadohiyadv ehi utseliga; nasgi ayv vquasvgalotanvhi tsigi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᎡᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᎥᏆᏒᎦᎶᏔᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ.
\ft According to the glorious gospel of the blessed God, which was committed to my trust.

\ln Ale tsiyalielitseha Galonedv Tsisa Ugvwiyuhi igatseli tsaqualinigohistanv, yeliquo igvwadvnedi tsaqueliselv, tsaginetselv digilvwisdanediyi alitsidodi gesvi,
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏥᏯᎵᎡᎵᏤᎭ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏥᏌ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᏣᏆᎵᏂᎪᎯᏍᏔᏅ, ᏰᎵᏉ ᎢᎬᏩᏛᏁᏗ ᏣᏇᎵᏎᎸ, ᏣᎩᏁᏤᎸ ᏗᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᎠᎵᏥᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ,
\ft And I thank Christ Jesus our Lord, who hath enabled me, for that he counted me faithful, putting me into the ministry;

\ln Ayv nasgi ilvhiyu tsisotlvdisgi tsigesvgi, ale uyo idigvnehi, ale diganisotlvdi; aseno vgidolitsvgi, nvdagalisdodisgvgi nitsigatahnavna gesvi, ale naquohiyusvna gesv nasgi naquadvnelvi.
\syll ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᏥᏐᏢᏗᏍᎩ ᏥᎨᏒᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏲ ᎢᏗᎬᏁᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎦᏂᏐᏢᏗ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᎩᏙᎵᏨᎩ, ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᏂᏥᎦᏔᎿᎥᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏉᎯᏳᏒᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏆᏛᏁᎸᎢ.
\ft Who was before a blasphemer, and a persecutor, and injurious: but I obtained mercy, because I did it ignorantly in unbelief.

\ln Ale gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv Ugvwiyuhi igatseliga utsatanvhi equohiyu gesvgi, ulitloyasdvgi Galonedv Tsisa tsiyoiyudi gesv ale tsigeyui, iyulisdodi gesvi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᎦᏤᎵᎦ ᎤᏣᏔᏅᎯ ᎡᏉᎯᏳ ᎨᏒᎩ, ᎤᎵᏠᏯᏍᏛᎩ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏥᏌ ᏥᏲᎢᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏥᎨᏳᎢ, ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft And the grace of our Lord was exceeding abundant with faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.

\ln Udohiyuhiya hia nasgi igawedv, ale wasdv tsudanilvisdiyu, nasgi Galonedv Tsisa elohi ulutsvi, dusdelvhilv anisganai, ayv nasgi nagigvwiyusv tsisganai.
\syll ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎦᏪᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᏩᏍᏛ ᏧᏓᏂᎸᎢᏍᏗᏳ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏥᏌ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎤᎷᏨᎢ, ᏚᏍᏕᎸᎯᎸ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᎾᎢ, ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᎩᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᏥᏍᎦᎾᎢ.
\ft This is a faithful saying, and worthy of all acceptation, that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners; of whom I am chief.

\ln Aseno nasgi hia nvdayulisdotanvgi vgidolitsvgi; nasgi ayv gesv nagigvwiyusv Tsisa Galonedv gvnigesv iyuwanediyi wasdv gvnidiyu gesvi, nasgi tsunatlilosdodi iyulisdodiyi oni gvwohiyunvhi gvnidv alisquadisgi nigesvna widulugi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏅᏓᏳᎵᏍᏙᏔᏅᎩ ᎥᎩᏙᎵᏨᎩ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᎨᏒ ᎾᎩᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏩᏁᏗᏱ ᏩᏍᏛ ᎬᏂᏗᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᎾᏟᎶᏍᏙᏗ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎣᏂ ᎬᏬᎯᏳᏅᎯ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎠᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏫᏚᎷᎩ.
\ft Howbeit for this cause I obtained mercy, that in me first Jesus Christ might shew forth all longsuffering, for a pattern to them which should hereafter believe on him to life everlasting.

\ln Ka, Ugvwiyuhi alisquadisgi nigesvna gesv ehi, ayohusgi nigesvna, agowadvdi nigesvna, uwasvhi agatahnai Unelanvhi, galvquodiyu gesesdi ale galvquododi gesesdi nigohilv ale nigohilvi; Emenv.
\syll Ꭷ, ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎡᎯ, ᎠᏲᎱᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎠᎪᏩᏛᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎤᏩᏒᎯ ᎠᎦᏔᎿᎢ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎦᎸᏉᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎪᎯᎸᎢ; ᎡᎺᏅ.
\ft Now unto the King eternal, immortal, invisible, the only wise God, be honour and glory for ever and ever. Amen.

\ln Hia nasgi digalvwisdanedi gesv nihi degvyohisi, aquetsi Dimadi, nasgiya nuniwesv unadolehosv nihi getsanohesgvi, nasgino nihi nasgina dehvdisgv yaliga osdv alisdi gesvi;
\syll ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏂᎯ ᏕᎬᏲᎯᏏ, ᎠᏇᏥ ᏗᎹᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᏂᏪᏒ ᎤᎾᏙᎴᎰᏒ ᏂᎯ ᎨᏣᏃᎮᏍᎬᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏂᎯ ᎾᏍᎩᎾ ᏕᎲᏗᏍᎬ ᏯᎵᎦ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎠᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ;
\ft This charge I commit unto thee, son Timothy, according to the prophecies which went before on thee, that thou by them mightest wage a good warfare;

\ln Detsaniyvsv gohiyudi gesvi, ale osdv digugododi gesvi, nasgi gilo iyvdv iyunvnetanvhi tsigi, nasgi gohiyudi gesv gvwaniyotsidolv;
\syll ᏕᏣᏂᏴᏒ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏗᎫᎪᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎢᏳᏅᏁᏔᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏩᏂᏲᏥᏙᎸ;
\ft Holding faith, and a good conscience; which some having put away concerning faith have made shipwreck:

\ln Nasgi hia nunadvnelv Haminiya ale Eligi, nasgi degatsiyosv Sedani detsiyohiselv unadeloquasdiyi unisotlvdodiyi nigesvna gesvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᎾᏛᏁᎸ ᎭᎻᏂᏯ ᎠᎴ ᎡᎵᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏕᎦᏥᏲᏒ ᏎᏓᏂ ᏕᏥᏲᎯᏎᎸ ᎤᎾᏕᎶᏆᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏂᏐᏢᏙᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Of whom is Hymenaeus and Alexander; whom I have delivered unto Satan, that they may learn not to blaspheme.

\ln Nasgino tsinega igvyiyiquo gesvi, atayosdi gesvi, adadolisdodi gesvi, dinvdadisdi gesvi, ale alihelisdi gesv digalvwisdanediyi, nasgi naniv yvwi ugvwali,
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏥᏁᎦ ᎢᎬᏱᏱᏉ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᏔᏲᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᏓᏙᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏗᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎵᎮᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏴᏫ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ,
\ft I exhort therefore, that, first of all, supplications, prayers, intercessions, and giving of thanks, be made for all men;

\ln Unigvwiyuhi ale naniv ayeli tsunilvwisdanehi ugvwali, nasgi nvwadohiyadv ale nunayehisdvna igalenidasdiyi, dedikahnawadisv duyugodv gesv ale galvquodiyu gesvi.
\syll ᎤᏂᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎠᏰᎵ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᎠᎴ ᏄᎾᏰᎯᏍᏛᎾ ᎢᎦᎴᏂᏓᏍᏗᏱ, ᏕᏗᎧᎿᏩᏗᏒ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft For kings, and for all that are in authority; that we may lead a quiet and peaceable life in all godliness and honesty.

\ln Nasgiyeno hia osiyu ale tsudanilvisdiyu dakanv Unelanvhi Igisdelisgi,
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎠᎴ ᏧᏓᏂᎸᎢᏍᏗᏳ ᏓᎧᏅ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᎩᏍᏕᎵᏍᎩ,
\ft For this is good and acceptable in the sight of God our Saviour;

\ln Nasgi osiyu uyelvdi tsigi naniv yvwi getsisdelvdiyi, ale uniluhisdiyi agadovhisdi gesv duyugodv gesvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎤᏰᎸᏗ ᏥᎩ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏴᏫ ᎨᏥᏍᏕᎸᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᎷᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Who will have all men to be saved, and to come unto the knowledge of the truth.

\ln Saquoquoyeno eha Unelanvhi, ale saquo digohisdisgi ayeli dilenehi Unelanvhi ale yvwi, nasgi na yvwi Tsisa Galonedv;
\syll ᏌᏉᏉᏰᏃ ᎡᎭ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏌᏉ ᏗᎪᎯᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᎠᏰᎵ ᏗᎴᏁᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏴᏫ, ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏴᏫ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ;
\ft For there is one God, and one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus;

\ln Nasgi tsidudayose uwasv tsiduguyvhe nanivi, gvnigesv igvnedi aselvhi gesv nahiyui,
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏚᏓᏲᏎ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏥᏚᎫᏴᎮ ᎾᏂᎥᎢ, ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᎬᏁᏗ ᎠᏎᎸᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏀᎢᏳᎢ,
\ft Who gave himself a ransom for all, to be testified in due time.

\ln Nasgino hia ayv vginetselvhi galitsidohvsgi ale vginvsidv, tsunadalenvdv yvwi digatsiyeyohvsgi galonuhedv ale gayegogi nigvdisgvna; udohiyuhiya tsinega Galonedv agatahvi, vtla yigatsigovsga.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏴ ᎥᎩᏁᏤᎸᎯ ᎦᎵᏥᏙᎲᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎥᎩᏅᏏᏛ, ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᏗᎦᏥᏰᏲᎲᏍᎩ ᎦᎶᏄᎮᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎦᏰᎪᎩ ᏂᎬᏗᏍᎬᎾ; ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᏥᏁᎦ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎠᎦᏔᎲᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᏱᎦᏥᎪᎥᏍᎦ.
\ft Whereunto I am ordained a preacher, and an apostle, (I speak the truth in Christ, and lie not;) a teacher of the Gentiles in faith and verity.

\ln Nasgino aquaduliha anisgaya nigav degesadisv unadadolisdoyi, tsunisaladodiyi digadaha nigesvna tsunoyeni nunitalawosgvna ale nunadlasidvehvna.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎠᏆᏚᎵᎭ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏕᎨᏌᏗᏒ ᎤᎾᏓᏙᎵᏍᏙᏱ, ᏧᏂᏌᎳᏙᏗᏱ ᏗᎦᏓᎭ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏧᏃᏰᏂ ᏄᏂᏔᎳᏬᏍᎬᎾ ᎠᎴ ᏄᎾᏜᏏᏛᎡᎲᎾ.
\ft I will therefore that men pray every where, lifting up holy hands, without wrath and doubting.

\ln Ale nasgiya nasquo anigeyv danatsausgv utlvquodi nigesvna dananuwosgesdi, unadanayehisdi ale unalisinahisdi gesesdi; vtlasdino danisdeyohv dunistiyegvi, ale adelv dalonige, ale dagvnaiyunasdi, ale utsati tsugvwalodi dinuwo yidanatsanvdisgesdi;
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏂᎨᏴ ᏓᎾᏣᎤᏍᎬ ᎤᏢᏉᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏓᎾᏄᏬᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎤᎾᏓᎾᏰᎯᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᎵᏏᏀᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᎥᏝᏍᏗᏃ ᏓᏂᏍᏕᏲᎲ ᏚᏂᏍᏘᏰᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏕᎸ ᏓᎶᏂᎨ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᎬᎾᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᏗᏄᏬ ᏱᏓᎾᏣᏅᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ;
\ft In like manner also, that women adorn themselves in modest apparel, with shamefacedness and sobriety; not with broided hair, or gold, or pearls, or costly array;

\ln Osdvsgini digalvwisdanedi gesv danatsanvdisgesdi, nasgi tsunanelodi anigeyv tsunililohvsga.
\syll ᎣᏍᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏓᎾᏣᏅᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎠᏂᎨᏴ ᏧᏂᎵᎶᎲᏍᎦ.
\ft But (which becometh women professing godliness) with good works.

\ln Ale ageyv elaweyi adeloquasgesdi utsati uwohiyuhiyu gesesdi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎠᎨᏴ ᎡᎳᏪᏱ ᎠᏕᎶᏆᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᏬᎯᏳᎯᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft Let the woman learn in silence with all subjection.

\ln Vtlasgini unelagi yitsiyelise ageyv tsudeyodiyi ale udalinehidediyi asgaya, elaweyiquosgini uwadiyi.
\syll ᎥᏝᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏁᎳᎩ ᏱᏥᏰᎵᏎ ᎠᎨᏴ ᏧᏕᏲᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᎵᏁᎯᏕᏗᏱ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ, ᎡᎳᏪᏱᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏩᏗᏱ.
\ft But I suffer not a woman to teach, nor to usurp authority over the man, but to be in silence.

\ln Adawiyeno igvyi agotlvnei, gilano Iwi.
\syll ᎠᏓᏫᏰᏃ ᎢᎬᏱ ᎠᎪᏢᏁᎢ, ᎩᎳᏃ ᎢᏫ.
\ft For Adam was first formed, then Eve.

\ln Vtlayeno Adawi yatsilonuelei, ageyvsgini atsilonuelv usganvtsei.
\syll ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᎠᏓᏫ ᏯᏥᎶᏄᎡᎴᎢ, ᎠᎨᏴᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏥᎶᏄᎡᎸ ᎤᏍᎦᏅᏤᎢ.
\ft And Adam was not deceived, but the woman being deceived was in the transgression.

\ln Asesgininonv atsisdelvdi igesesdi diniyoli degananugowisgvi, iyuno danikahnawadisesdi gohiyudi gesv, ale adageyudi gesvi, ale duyugodv gesvi, ale alisinahisdodi gesvi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎠᏥᏍᏕᎸᏗ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏗᏂᏲᎵ ᏕᎦᎾᏄᎪᏫᏍᎬᎢ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᏓᏂᎧᎿᏩᏗᏎᏍᏗ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎵᏏᏀᎢᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Notwithstanding she shall be saved in childbearing, if they continue in faith and charity and holiness with sobriety.

\ln Udohiyuhiya igawedv; Iyuno gilo udutlasgesdi atsigatidisdi iyulisdodiyi, osdv digalvwisdanedi gesv udulisgesdi.
\syll ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎢᎦᏪᏛ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏚᏝᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᏥᎦᏘᏗᏍᏗ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎣᏍᏛ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
\ft This is a true saying, If a man desire the office of a bishop, he desireth a good work.

\ln Atsigatidisdi adina ase gohusdi nasganvna gesesdi, saquoquo adayehesdi, geyatahi, ulisinahisdi, osdv tsulvwisdanehi, tsudadanilvtsati, digvwadeyodi;
\syll ᎠᏥᎦᏘᏗᏍᏗ ᎠᏗᎾ ᎠᏎ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎦᏅᎾ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᏌᏉᏉ ᎠᏓᏰᎮᏍᏗ, ᎨᏯᏔᎯ, ᎤᎵᏏᏀᎢᏍᏗ, ᎣᏍᏛ ᏧᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ, ᏧᏓᏓᏂᎸᏣᏘ, ᏗᎬᏩᏕᏲᏗ;
\ft A bishop then must be blameless, the husband of one wife, vigilant, sober, of good behaviour, given to hospitality, apt to teach;

\ln Gigageaditasdi uganasisgi nigesvna, didadvnihi nigesvna, tsugvwalodi ugvvsgi nigesvna, udanvtisgini, tsutiyosati nigesvna, adelv tsugeyuhi nigesvna.
\syll ᎩᎦᎨᎠᏗᏔᏍᏗ ᎤᎦᎾᏏᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᏗᏓᏛᏂᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎤᎬᎥᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎤᏓᏅᏘᏍᎩᏂ, ᏧᏘᏲᏌᏘ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎠᏕᎸ ᏧᎨᏳᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.
\ft Not given to wine, no striker, not greedy of filthy lucre; but patient, not a brawler, not covetous;

\ln Uwasv dudatihnav osdv dikahnawadidohi, tsuwetsi gvwohiyuhiyu ale gvwalvquodiyu igvnehi.
\syll ᎤᏩᏒ ᏚᏓᏘᎿᎥ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎯ, ᏧᏪᏥ ᎬᏬᎯᏳᎯᏳ ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎢᎬᏁᎯ.
\ft One that ruleth well his own house, having his children in subjection with all gravity;

\ln Iyuyeno gilo nagatahvna yigi uwasv dudatihnav osdv tsukahnawadidasdiyi, gado yigalisdoda yidagasayasda tsunanelohi unadatlugv Unelanvhi utseliga?
\syll ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎾᎦᏔᎲᎾ ᏱᎩ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏚᏓᏘᎿᎥ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏧᎧᎿᏩᏗᏓᏍᏗᏱ, ᎦᏙ ᏱᎦᎵᏍᏙᏓ ᏱᏓᎦᏌᏯᏍᏓ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᎯ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ?
\ft (For if a man know not how to rule his own house, how shall he take care of the church of God?)

\ln Ale vtlesdi gilai uligononvhi yigesesdi, atlvquododiyeno gesv yalisaladoda nasgino usganvtsvhi gesv yidudugodasi nasgiya asgina dudugodanelvi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎥᏞᏍᏗ ᎩᎳᎢ ᎤᎵᎪᏃᏅᎯ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎠᏢᏉᏙᏗᏰᏃ ᎨᏒ ᏯᎵᏌᎳᏙᏓ ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᏍᎦᏅᏨᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏱᏚᏚᎪᏓᏏ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎠᏍᎩᎾ ᏚᏚᎪᏓᏁᎸᎢ.
\ft Not a novice, lest being lifted up with pride he fall into the condemnation of the devil.

\ln Alewo osiyu gvwanohesgi yigi iyvdv unvgudvi, usonvyeno atsinohesgi yinvgalisda, ale asgina usadv yuwehi.
\syll ᎠᎴᏬ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎬᏩᏃᎮᏍᎩ ᏱᎩ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎤᏅᎫᏛᎢ, ᎤᏐᏅᏰᏃ ᎠᏥᏃᎮᏍᎩ ᏱᏅᎦᎵᏍᏓ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏍᎩᎾ ᎤᏌᏛ ᏳᏪᎯ.
\ft Moreover he must have a good report of them which are without; lest he fall into reproach and the snare of the devil.

\ln Nasgiya nasquo aniyadohihi getsilvquodi gesesdi, vtlesdi tsudalenvdv iyaniwesgi yigesesdi, ale vtlesdi yigageaditasdi uniganasisgi yigesesdi, tlesdi tsugvwalodi unigvvsgi yigesesdi;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏂᏯᏙᎯᎯ ᎨᏥᎸᏉᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎥᏞᏍᏗ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎢᏯᏂᏪᏍᎩ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᎦᎨᎠᏗᏔᏍᏗ ᎤᏂᎦᎾᏏᏍᎩ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎤᏂᎬᎥᏍᎩ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ;
\ft Likewise must the deacons be grave, not doubletongued, not given to much wine, not greedy of filthy lucre;

\ln Duniniyvsesdisgini udelidv gohiyudi gesvi anvdisgesdi gadaha nigesvna digugododi gesvi.
\syll ᏚᏂᏂᏴᏎᏍᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ ᎠᏅᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎦᏓᎭ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏗᎫᎪᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Holding the mystery of the faith in a pure conscience.

\ln Ale nasgi hia igvyi digoliyevhi gesesdi, gila dunilvwisdanehesdi aniyadohihv gohusdi gageguisdodi nigesvna gesesdi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎢᎬᏱ ᏗᎪᎵᏰᎥᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎩᎳ ᏚᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᎠᏂᏯᏙᎯᎲ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎦᎨᎫᎢᏍᏙᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft And let these also first be proved; then let them use the office of a deacon, being found blameless.

\ln Nasquono tsunadalii getsilvquodi gesesdi, usonv anadanohelidohi nigesvna, aneyatahisgini gesesdi, yeligaya iyanadvnehi nigav gohusdi.
\syll ᎾᏍᏉᏃ ᏧᎾᏓᎵᎢ ᎨᏥᎸᏉᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎤᏐᏅ ᎠᎾᏓᏃᎮᎵᏙᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎠᏁᏯᏔᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᏰᎵᎦᏯ ᎢᏯᎾᏛᏁᎯ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ.
\ft Even so must their wives be grave, not slanderers, sober, faithful in all things.

\ln Ayadohihi saquoha adayehesdi, osdv dikahnawadidohi tsuwetsi ale uwasv dudatihnavi.
\syll ᎠᏯᏙᎯᎯ ᏌᏉᎭ ᎠᏓᏰᎮᏍᏗ, ᎣᏍᏛ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏧᏪᏥ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏚᏓᏘᎿᎥᎢ.
\ft Let the deacons be the husbands of one wife, ruling their children and their own houses well.

\ln Nasgiyeno osdv tsunilvwisdanehi gesv aniyadohihvi, aniwadvdiha osdv gegadanvtediyi, ale utsati nunayehisdvna adanvdadisdiyi gohiyudi gesv Galonedv Tsisa.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏂᏯᏙᎯᎲᎢ, ᎠᏂᏩᏛᏗᎭ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎨᎦᏓᏅᏖᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏄᎾᏰᎯᏍᏛᎾ ᎠᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗᏱ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏥᏌ.
\ft For they that have used the office of a deacon well purchase to themselves a good degree, and great boldness in the faith which is in Christ Jesus.

\ln Nasgi hia tsudalenvdv wigvyowelasi, ale udugi aquvha nigohilvnaquo wigvlutsediyi;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏫᎬᏲᏪᎳᏏ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎠᏋᎭ ᏂᎪᎯᎸᎾᏉ ᏫᎬᎷᏤᏗᏱ;
\ft These things write I unto thee, hoping to come unto thee shortly:

\ln Iyusgininonv aquohitselidolvha nasgi tsadolehohisdiyi itsadvnediyi ditsalvwisdanediyi Unelanvhi utseli adanelvi, nasgi tsunanelodi unadatlugv gvnidv Unelanvhi utseli tsigi, gagusdvdi ale ulisdayido tsigi duyuhidv gesvi.
\syll ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎠᏉᎯᏤᎵᏙᎸᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏣᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎢᏣᏛᏁᏗᏱ ᏗᏣᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎠᏓᏁᎸᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏥᎩ, ᎦᎫᏍᏛᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏍᏓᏱᏙ ᏥᎩ ᏚᏳᎯᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft But if I tarry long, that thou mayest know how thou oughtest to behave thyself in the house of God, which is the church of the living God, the pillar and ground of the truth.

\ln Ale nudlasidvsvna usquanigodiyu udelidv unelanvhi dinelodi gesvi; Unelanvhi gvnigesv nagvnele uwodali gesvi, nutlonasdvna gvnigesv nuwanele Adanvdo, dinikahnawadidohi gvwagohei, tsunadalenvdv yvwi gegalitsidonele nasgi atsinohesgei, ani elohi agoiyunei, galvquodiyu digesv widagadanilvtsei.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏄᏜᏏᏛᏒᎾ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗᏳ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏗᏁᎶᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎾᎬᏁᎴ ᎤᏬᏓᎵ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏄᏠᎾᏍᏛᎾ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏄᏩᏁᎴ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ, ᏗᏂᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎬᏩᎪᎮᎢ, ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᎨᎦᎵᏥᏙᏁᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏥᏃᎮᏍᎨᎢ, ᎠᏂ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎠᎪᎢᏳᏁᎢ, ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᏗᎨᏒ ᏫᏓᎦᏓᏂᎸᏤᎢ.
\ft And without controversy great is the mystery of godliness: God was manifest in the flesh, justified in the Spirit, seen of angels, preached unto the Gentiles, believed on in the world, received up into glory.

\ln Aseno Adanvdo kanegv gvnigesviyu nigvneha ulisqualvdi gesesdi gilo tsuniyohisdiyi gohiyudi gesvi, danadvdasdanehesdi unatlonasdi didanvdo, ale danadeyohvsgi anisgina,
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎧᏁᎬ ᎬᏂᎨᏒᎢᏳ ᏂᎬᏁᎭ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᎸᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎩᎶ ᏧᏂᏲᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏓᎾᏛᏓᏍᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᎤᎾᏠᎾᏍᏗ ᏗᏓᏅᏙ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᎾᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ ᎠᏂᏍᎩᎾ,
\ft Now the Spirit speaketh expressly, that in the latter times some shall depart from the faith, giving heed to seducing spirits, and doctrines of devils;

\ln Unatlonasdv gayegogi aniwonisgesdi, dunadanvdv digaleyvtanvhi talugisgi udilegi gvtanvhi;
\syll ᎤᎾᏠᎾᏍᏛ ᎦᏰᎪᎩ ᎠᏂᏬᏂᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᏚᎾᏓᏅᏛ ᏗᎦᎴᏴᏔᏅᎯ ᏔᎷᎩᏍᎩ ᎤᏗᎴᎩ ᎬᏔᏅᎯ;
\ft Speaking lies in hypocrisy; having their conscience seared with a hot iron;

\ln Uninvsdosgesdi ditsvsdiyi, aninegesdi gohusdi iyusdi alisdayvdi diyohisdiyi nasgi Unelanvhi uwotlvnvhi tsigi ulihelitsvhiquo tsunadanilvisdiyi anohiyuhvsgi ale unigadovsvhi tsigi duyugodvi.
\syll ᎤᏂᏅᏍᏙᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏗᏨᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᏂᏁᎨᏍᏗ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗ ᏗᏲᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏬᏢᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎤᎵᎮᎵᏨᎯᏉ ᏧᎾᏓᏂᎸᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᎦᏙᎥᏒᎯ ᏥᎩ ᏚᏳᎪᏛᎢ.
\ft Forbidding to marry, and commanding to abstain from meats, which God hath created to be received with thanksgiving of them which believe and know the truth.

\ln Nigavyeno gohusdi Unelanvhi uwetlvnvhi gesv osiyu, ale vtla gohusdi ayoisedi yigi, iyuno ulihelisdi odanvdv yidvdanilvga;
\syll ᏂᎦᎥᏰᏃ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏪᏢᏅᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎣᏏᏳ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎠᏲᎢᏎᏗ ᏱᎩ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎤᎵᎮᎵᏍᏗ ᎣᏓᏅᏛ ᏱᏛᏓᏂᎸᎦ;
\ft For every creature of God is good, and nothing to be refused, if it be received with thanksgiving:

\ln Gadahayeno nigesvna igvnelvhi gvtanvhi kanohedv Unelanvhi utseliga, ale adadolisdodi gesvi.
\syll ᎦᏓᎭᏰᏃ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᎬᏁᎸᎯ ᎬᏔᏅᎯ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏓᏙᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft For it is sanctified by the word of God and prayer.

\ln Iyuno analinvtli hia nasgi yigiyanvdadistanv, hosdv gesesdi etsanvsidasdi Tsisa Galonedv utseliga, etselastanvhi gesesdi kanohedv gohiyudi gesv tsikanoheha, ale osdv dideyodi gesvi, nasgi gayula ditsaniyvdv tsigi.
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏟ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᎩᏯᏅᏓᏗᏍᏔᏅ, ᎰᏍᏛ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎡᏣᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎡᏤᎳᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏥᎧᏃᎮᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏗᏕᏲᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏳᎳ ᏗᏣᏂᏴᏛ ᏥᎩ.
\ft If thou put the brethren in remembrance of these things, thou shalt be a good minister of Jesus Christ, nourished up in the words of faith and of good doctrine, whereunto thou hast attained.

\ln Detsayoisehesdisgini gawetlvdi gesv gohusdi gvdodi nigesvna ale anigayvlige uninohelvdi tsigi; ale tsalvwisdanehesdi Unelanvhi dinelododi gesvi.
\syll ᏕᏣᏲᎢᏎᎮᏍᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᎦᏪᏢᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎬᏙᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᎤᏂᏃᎮᎸᏗ ᏥᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᏣᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏗᏁᎶᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft But refuse profane and old wives' fables, and exercise thyself rather unto godliness.

\ln Ayelviyeno ugvwali digalvwisdanedi gesv usdigiyu adasdeliha; Unelanvhisgini dinelododi gesv nigav gohusdi ugvwali gvwadasdelvdi, nasgiyeno aduisdi atsinediyi gvnv gohi tsigi, ale nasgi uliyilohisdi gesvi.
\syll ᎠᏰᎸᎢᏰᏃ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏍᏗᎩᏳ ᎠᏓᏍᏕᎵᎭ; ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᏗᏁᎶᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᎬᏩᏓᏍᏕᎸᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎠᏚᎢᏍᏗ ᎠᏥᏁᏗᏱ ᎬᏅ ᎪᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎵᏱᎶᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft For bodily exercise profiteth little: but godliness is profitable unto all things, having promise of the life that now is, and of that which is to come.

\ln Udohiyuhiya igawedv, ale wasdv tsudanilvisdiyu;
\syll ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎢᎦᏪᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᏩᏍᏛ ᏧᏓᏂᎸᎢᏍᏗᏳ;
\ft This is a faithful saying and worthy of all acceptation.

\ln Nasgiyeno iyusdi degilvwisdaneha ale gayegisotlvdiha nvdigalisdodi edalisgasdodv gvnidv Unelanvhi, nasgi Disdelisgi tsigi naniv yvwi, nasgi ho ugvwiyuha nasgi na anohiyuhvsgi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏕᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎭ ᎠᎴ ᎦᏰᎩᏐᏢᏗᎭ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᎡᏓᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏛ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏍᏕᎵᏍᎩ ᏥᎩ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏴᏫ, ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮀ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ.
\ft For therefore we both labour and suffer reproach, because we trust in the living God, who is the Saviour of all men, specially of those that believe.

\ln Nasgi hia nusdesdi hinegesdi ale dehadeyohvsgesdi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᎯᏁᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏕᎭᏕᏲᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
\ft These things command and teach.

\ln Tlesdi gilo yusonvtselesidi hiwiniyu gesvi; gagetsadeloquaedisgini gesesdi anohiyuhvsgi, hiwonisgvi ale nitsadvhnadegvi, ale tsadageyuei, ale tsadanvtediyi, ale tsohiyusvi, ale gadaha nigesvna gesvi.
\syll ᏞᏍᏗ ᎩᎶ ᏳᏐᏅᏤᎴᏏᏗ ᎯᏫᏂᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎦᎨᏣᏕᎶᏆᎡᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ, ᎯᏬᏂᏍᎬᎢ ᎠᎴ ᏂᏣᏛᎿᏕᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏣᏓᎨᏳᎡᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏣᏓᏅᏖᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏦᎯᏳᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᏓᎭ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Let no man despise thy youth; but be thou an example of the believers, in word, in conversation, in charity, in spirit, in faith, in purity.

\ln Witsilutsvha iyasti detsalvwisdanehesdi goweli dehigoliyesgvi, ale dehiwonedisgvi, ale dehadeyohvsgvi.
\syll ᏫᏥᎷᏨᎭ ᎢᏯᏍᏘ ᏕᏣᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᎪᏪᎵ ᏕᎯᎪᎵᏰᏍᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᎯᏬᏁᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᎭᏕᏲᎲᏍᎬᎢ.
\ft Till I come, give attendance to reading, to exhortation, to doctrine.

\ln Tlesdi unelagi tselisvgi etsanelvhi nasgi tsitsaha, nasgi etsanelvhi tsigi anvdisgv unadolehosv ale degetsasitadv digeganelodi.
\syll ᏞᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᎩ ᏤᎵᏒᎩ ᎡᏣᏁᎸᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏣᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᏣᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎠᏅᏗᏍᎬ ᎤᎾᏙᎴᎰᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏕᎨᏣᏏᏔᏛ ᏗᎨᎦᏁᎶᏗ.
\ft Neglect not the gift that is in thee, which was given thee by prophecy, with the laying on of the hands of the presbytery.

\ln Nasgi dehadanvtesgesdi, nasgiquo detsalvwisdanehesdi, nasgino tsanequotsehv gvnigesv nunalisdanehesdi nigadv.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏕᎭᏓᏅᏖᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩᏉ ᏕᏣᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏣᏁᏉᏤᎲ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏄᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᏛ.
\ft Meditate upon these things; give thyself wholly to them; that thy profiting may appear to all.

\ln Tsadagasayasdesdi tsvsv ale nusdv dehadeyohvsgii, nasgi dehisdawadisesdi; nasgiyeno hnadvnehv tsvsv tadasdelvhi ale nasquo nasgi na getsadvdasdanehi dotisdelvhi.
\syll ᏣᏓᎦᏌᏯᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᏨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏕᎭᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏕᎯᏍᏓᏩᏗᏎᏍᏗ; ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎿᏛᏁᎲ ᏨᏒ ᏔᏓᏍᏕᎸᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎨᏣᏛᏓᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᏙᏘᏍᏕᎸᎯ.
\ft Take heed unto thyself, and unto the doctrine; continue in them: for in doing this thou shalt both save thyself, and them that hear thee.

\ln Udvsonvhi tlesdi yigvsgolvnesdi, hisdiyedisgesdisgini agayvlige nasgiyai, aniwinvno itsadanvtli nasgiyai,
\syll ᎤᏛᏐᏅᎯ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᎬᏍᎪᎸᏁᏍᏗ, ᎯᏍᏗᏰᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ, ᎠᏂᏫᏅᏃ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏟ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ,
\ft Rebuke not an elder, but intreat him as a father; and the younger men as brethren;

\ln Anagayvligeno anigeyv ditsatsi nasgiyai, aniwinvgeno anigeyv tsetsado nasgiyai, usonv nudasuyvna.
\syll ᎠᎾᎦᏴᎵᎨᏃ ᎠᏂᎨᏴ ᏗᏣᏥ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ, ᎠᏂᏫᏅᎨᏃ ᎠᏂᎨᏴ ᏤᏣᏙ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ, ᎤᏐᏅ ᏄᏓᏑᏴᎾ.
\ft The elder women as mothers; the younger as sisters, with all purity.

\ln Dehilvquodesdi tsunosulotsvhi, iyuno udohiyusv tsunosulotsvhi yigi.
\syll ᏕᎯᎸᏉᏕᏍᏗ ᏧᏃᏑᎶᏨᎯ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᏒ ᏧᏃᏑᎶᏨᎯ ᏱᎩ.
\ft Honour widows that are widows indeed.

\ln Iyusgini gilo uwosulotsvhi tsuwetsi ale tsulisi yaneha, nasgi anadeloquasgesdi tsunilvquododiyi dotsunenvsv anehi, ale tsunaguyvediyi tsunigayvligei; nasgiyeno osiyu, ale tsudanilvisdiyu Unelanvhi agatahvi.
\syll ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏬᏑᎶᏨᎯ ᏧᏪᏥ ᎠᎴ ᏧᎵᏏ ᏯᏁᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎾᏕᎶᏆᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏧᏂᎸᏉᏙᏗᏱ ᏙᏧᏁᏅᏒ ᎠᏁᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᎾᎫᏴᎡᏗᏱ ᏧᏂᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎣᏏᏳ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏓᏂᎸᎢᏍᏗᏳ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎦᏔᎲᎢ.
\ft But if any widow have children or nephews, let them learn first to shew piety at home, and to requite their parents: for that is good and acceptable before God.

\ln Nasgiyeno na udohiyuhi uwosulotsvhi tsigesoi, ale uwasvhiyu tsigesoi, Unelanvhi alisgasdodisgoi, ale dakahnawadiso atayosdi gesv ale adadolisdodi gesv nidulisinisv ale nidugitsvnisvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ Ꮎ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎤᏬᏑᎶᏨᎯ ᏥᎨᏐᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏩᏒᎯᏳ ᏥᎨᏐᎢ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏗᏍᎪᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᎧᎿᏩᏗᏐ ᎠᏔᏲᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏓᏙᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏂᏚᎵᏏᏂᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏂᏚᎩᏨᏂᏒᎢ.
\ft Now she that is a widow indeed, and desolate, trusteth in God, and continueth in supplications and prayers night and day.

\ln Nasgi na nunelvna ehi uyohusvhi geso asiquo alenidohvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏄᏁᎸᎾ ᎡᎯ ᎤᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᎨᏐ ᎠᏏᏉ ᎠᎴᏂᏙᎲᎢ.
\ft But she that liveth in pleasure is dead while she liveth.

\ln Ale nasgi hia nusdesdi hinegesdi, nasgi gageguisdodi nigesvna iyulisdodiyi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᎯᏁᎨᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎨᎫᎢᏍᏙᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
\ft And these things give in charge, that they may be blameless.

\ln Iyusginino gilo nidadvnvisdanehvna igesesdi uwasv tsutseliga, ale nasgi ho ugvwiyuha uwasv dudatihnavi, nasgi udayilv gohiyudi gesvi, ale utli uyoiyu esgaquo na nuwohiyusvna.
\syll ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂᏃ ᎩᎶ ᏂᏓᏛᏅᎢᏍᏓᏁᎲᎾ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏧᏤᎵᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮀ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎭ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏚᏓᏘᎿᎥᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏓᏱᎸ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏟ ᎤᏲᎢᏳ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ Ꮎ ᏄᏬᎯᏳᏒᎾ.
\ft But if any provide not for his own, and specially for those of his own house, he hath denied the faith, and is worse than an infidel.

\ln Uwosulotsvhi agasesdi gesesdi iyuno sudalasgohi iyudetiyvdv gesesdi, ale ulosvsdesdi, saquoquo asgaya unaneladvhi gesesdi.
\syll ᎤᏬᏑᎶᏨᎯ ᎠᎦᏎᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎢᏳᏃ ᏑᏓᎳᏍᎪᎯ ᎢᏳᏕᏘᏴᏛ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎶᏒᏍᏕᏍᏗ, ᏌᏉᏉ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᎾᏁᎳᏛᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft Let not a widow be taken into the number under threescore years old, having been the wife of one man,

\ln Iyuno osdv atsinohesgi gesesdi osi deulvwisdanehvi, iyuno diniyoli tsudvhistanvhi gesesdi, iyuno anedohi tsusquanigotanvhi gesesdi, iyuno unadanvti tsunalasideni tsuwosulelvhi gesesdi, iyuno tsusdelvdv gesesdi anigiliyogi, iyuno usdawadvdv gesesdi nigav osdv digalvwisdanedi gesvi.
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎠᏥᏃᎮᏍᎩ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎣᏏ ᏕᎤᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎢ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᏗᏂᏲᎵ ᏧᏛᎯᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎠᏁᏙᎯ ᏧᏍᏆᏂᎪᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ ᏧᎾᎳᏏᏕᏂ ᏧᏬᏑᎴᎸᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᏧᏍᏕᎸᏛ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎠᏂᎩᎵᏲᎩ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎤᏍᏓᏩᏛᏛ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Well reported of for good works; if she have brought up children, if she have lodged strangers, if she have washed the saints' feet, if she have relieved the afflicted, if she have diligently followed every good work.

\ln Aniwinvgesanisgini tsunosulotsvhi giyoisehesdi; iyuyeno nunanelvna nigalisda anehv, Galonedvno unelagi anela, hnaquo unadulisgo tsunatsvsdiyi,
\syll ᎠᏂᏫᏅᎨᏌᏂᏍᎩᏂ ᏧᏃᏑᎶᏨᎯ ᎩᏲᎢᏎᎮᏍᏗ; ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᏄᎾᏁᎸᎾ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏓ ᎠᏁᎲ, ᎦᎶᏁᏛᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᎩ ᎠᏁᎳ, ᎿᏉ ᎤᎾᏚᎵᏍᎪ ᏧᎾᏨᏍᏗᏱ,
\ft But the younger widows refuse: for when they have begun to wax wanton against Christ, they will marry;

\ln Tsunadugodanelvhi gesoi nvdigalisdodisgo deuniyosv igvyiyi unohiyunvi.
\syll ᏧᎾᏚᎪᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᎨᏐᎢ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎪ ᏕᎤᏂᏲᏒ ᎢᎬᏱᏱ ᎤᏃᎯᏳᏅᎢ.
\ft Having damnation, because they have cast off their first faith.

\ln Ale nasquo anadeloquasgo unadanulvdi iyunalisdodiyi, anedolidoho dadaneladisvi; vtla ale unadanulvdiquo uwasv yigesoi, nasquosgini kanohedv aniyidohi gesoi ale uniniladisati, aninohesgi nasgi niduyugodvna gesv uninohediyi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᎾᏕᎶᏆᏍᎪ ᎤᎾᏓᏄᎸᏗ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎠᏁᏙᎵᏙᎰ ᏓᏓᏁᎳᏗᏒᎢ; ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏓᏄᎸᏗᏉ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏱᎨᏐᎢ, ᎾᏍᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎠᏂᏱᏙᎯ ᎨᏐᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏂᎳᏗᏌᏘ, ᎠᏂᏃᎮᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᏚᏳᎪᏛᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏂᏃᎮᏗᏱ.
\ft And withal they learn to be idle, wandering about from house to house; and not only idle, but tattlers also and busybodies, speaking things which they ought not.

\ln Nasgino iyusdi aquaduliha aniwinvgesani tsunatsvsdiyi, diniyoli tsuninanugowisdiyi, tsunisquanigododiyi daninelvi, ale gvwanatludisgi tsunilanvdadediyi nigesvna gesv usonv gvwaninohediyi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏆᏚᎵᎭ ᎠᏂᏫᏅᎨᏌᏂ ᏧᎾᏨᏍᏗᏱ, ᏗᏂᏲᎵ ᏧᏂᎾᏄᎪᏫᏍᏗᏱ, ᏧᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏙᏗᏱ ᏓᏂᏁᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᎾᏡᏗᏍᎩ ᏧᏂᎳᏅᏓᏕᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏐᏅ ᎬᏩᏂᏃᎮᏗᏱ.
\ft I will therefore that the younger women marry, bear children, guide the house, give none occasion to the adversary to speak reproachfully.

\ln Gayulayeno igadv unagolvsv Sedani unasdawadenv.
\syll ᎦᏳᎳᏰᏃ ᎢᎦᏛ ᎤᎾᎪᎸᏒ ᏎᏓᏂ ᎤᎾᏍᏓᏩᏕᏅ.
\ft For some are already turned aside after Satan.

\ln Iyuno gilo gohiyuhvsgi asgaya ale ageyv duwekahesdi tsunosulotsvhi, unvsvquo dinisdelisgesdi, tlesdino tsunanelodi unadatlugv yidunidanelesdi, nasgi digvwanisdelvdi yigi udohiyusv tsunosulotsvhi gesvi.
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎪᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎨᏴ ᏚᏪᎧᎮᏍᏗ ᏧᏃᏑᎶᏨᎯ, ᎤᏅᏒᏉ ᏗᏂᏍᏕᎵᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᏞᏍᏗᏃ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬ ᏱᏚᏂᏓᏁᎴᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎬᏩᏂᏍᏕᎸᏗ ᏱᎩ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᏒ ᏧᏃᏑᎶᏨᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft If any man or woman that believeth have widows, let them relieve them, and let not the church be charged; that it may relieve them that are widows indeed.

\ln Ale digeganelodi tsigi osdv tsunilvwisdanehi tali iyuwagudi detsilvquodesdi, ale nasgi ho ugvwiyusesdi kanohedv ale dideyodi gesv tsunilvwisdanehi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏗᎨᎦᏁᎶᏗ ᏥᎩ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᏔᎵ ᎢᏳᏩᎫᏗ ᏕᏥᎸᏉᏕᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮀ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᏎᏍᏗ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏕᏲᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ.
\ft Let the elders that rule well be counted worthy of double honour, especially they who labour in the word and doctrine.

\ln Hiayeno nigadvha galvquodi goweli; Tlesdi yiyoyvsulanesdi waga agatadovdisgi; ale, Gohusdi advnehi agaguyvedi geso dulvwisdanelvi.
\syll ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᏂᎦᏛᎭ ᎦᎸᏉᏗ ᎪᏪᎵ; ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏲᏴᏑᎳᏁᏍᏗ ᏩᎦ ᎠᎦᏔᏙᎥᏗᏍᎩ; ᎠᎴ, ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎠᏛᏁᎯ ᎠᎦᎫᏴᎡᏗ ᎨᏐ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸᎢ.
\ft For the scripture saith, Thou shalt not muzzle the ox that treadeth out the corn. And, The labourer is worthy of his reward.

\ln Tsaganelodi gohusdi atsilawisehvi tlesdi yitsadvdasdisgesdi gvni anitali ale anitsoi uninohedv gesesdi.
\syll ᏣᎦᏁᎶᏗ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎠᏥᎳᏫᏎᎲᎢ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏣᏛᏓᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎬᏂ ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏦᎢ ᎤᏂᏃᎮᏛ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft Against an elder receive not an accusation, but before two or three witnesses.

\ln Nano anisganvgi dehigvsgolvvsgesdi nigadv anigatahvi, nasgi anisoi nasquo uninayesdiyi.
\syll ᎾᏃ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏅᎩ ᏕᎯᎬᏍᎪᎸᎥᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏂᏐᎢ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᏂᎾᏰᏍᏗᏱ.
\ft Them that sin rebuke before all, that others also may fear.

\ln Gvnetseha Unelanvhi agatahvi, ale Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv ale gegasuyedv dinikahnawadidohi anigatahvi, hia nasgi tsagasayasdodiyi igvyi gayehi nidugodisgvna, ale detsalvwisdanehv gilo niyaligonehvna.
\syll ᎬᏁᏤᎭ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎦᏔᎲᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎨᎦᏑᏰᏛ ᏗᏂᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎲᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏣᎦᏌᏯᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎢᎬᏱ ᎦᏰᎯ ᏂᏚᎪᏗᏍᎬᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᏣᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᎩᎶ ᏂᏯᎵᎪᏁᎲᎾ.
\ft I charge thee before God, and the Lord Jesus Christ, and the elect angels, that thou observe these things without preferring one before another, doing nothing by partiality.

\ln Tlesdi ulisdi yitiyasitadesdi giloi, ale tlesdi yateladisgesdi gilo anisganvgvi.  Tsadagasayasdesdi higadaha nigesvna gesesdi.
\syll ᏞᏍᏗ ᎤᎵᏍᏗ ᏱᏘᏯᏏᏔᏕᏍᏗ ᎩᎶᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏯᏖᎳᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎩᎶ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏅᎬᎢ.  ᏣᏓᎦᏌᏯᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᎯᎦᏓᎭ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft Lay hands suddenly on no man, neither be partaker of other men's sins: keep thyself pure.

\ln Hnaquo tlesdi amaquo yaditasgesdi, usdisgini gigageaditasdi haditasgesdi, gohusdi halisdisgv iyusdi tsolvhisdiyi ale yanoquo tsatlvtsiyesgvi.
\syll ᎿᏉ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎠᎹᏉ ᏯᏗᏔᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎤᏍᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᎩᎦᎨᎠᏗᏔᏍᏗ ᎭᏗᏔᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎭᎵᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏦᎸᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᏯᏃᏉ ᏣᏢᏥᏰᏍᎬᎢ.
\ft Drink no longer water, but use a little wine for thy stomach's sake and thine often infirmities.

\ln Gilo anisganvgv gvnigesv geso igvwenvdv, igvyi wigalugo digugododiyi gesvi, gilono ugesdawadegoi.
\syll ᎩᎶ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏅᎬ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎨᏐ ᎢᎬᏪᏅᏛ, ᎢᎬᏱ ᏫᎦᎷᎪ ᏗᎫᎪᏙᏗᏱ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎩᎶᏃ ᎤᎨᏍᏓᏩᏕᎪᎢ.
\ft Some men's sins are open beforehand, going before to judgment; and some men they follow after.

\ln Nasgiya nasquo gilo osdv dunilvwisdanehv gvnigesv geso igvwenvdv; gilono nasgi na hia nusdvna yigi, ase tla gagvsgalodi yigesoi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎩᎶ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏚᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎨᏐ ᎢᎬᏪᏅᏛ; ᎩᎶᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏍᏛᎾ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᏎ Ꮭ ᎦᎬᏍᎦᎶᏗ ᏱᎨᏐᎢ.
\ft Likewise also the good works of some are manifest beforehand; and they that are otherwise cannot be hid.

\ln Naniv digetsinatlai nasgi digetsigilanala tsigi utsati tsunilvquodiyu gesesdi digvwaninatlai, nasgi dudov Unelanvhi ale utseli dideyodi gesv asotlvhi iyulisdodiyi nigesvna.
\syll ᎾᏂᎥ ᏗᎨᏥᎾᏝᎢ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎨᏥᎩᎳᎾᎳ ᏥᎩ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏧᏂᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏗᎬᏩᏂᎾᏝᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᏙᎥ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏗᏕᏲᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏐᏢᎯ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.
\ft Let as many servants as are under the yoke count their own masters worthy of all honour, that the name of God and his doctrine be not blasphemed.

\ln Nano anohiyuhvsgi digvwaninatlai gesv tlesdi yiduniniquatilesdi yinvdigalisdodisgesdi analinvtli gesvi, gohusdisgini danadvnehesdi nvdigalisdodisgesdi anohiyuhvsgi ale getsigeyui gesvi, unatloyasdisgi osdv nagadvnelvi.  Nasgi hia nusdesdi dehadeyohvsgesdi, ale dehinetsehesdi.
\syll ᎾᏃ ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᏗᎬᏩᏂᎾᏝᎢ ᎨᏒ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏚᏂᏂᏆᏘᎴᏍᏗ ᏱᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏟ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎪᎱᏍᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᏓᎾᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎨᏥᎨᏳᎢ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᎾᏠᏯᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎾᎦᏛᏁᎸᎢ.  ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᏕᎭᏕᏲᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᎯᏁᏤᎮᏍᏗ.
\ft And they that have believing masters, let them not despise them, because they are brethren; but rather do them service, because they are faithful and beloved, partakers of the benefit. These things teach and exhort.

\ln Iyuno gilo utsatini nigawesgesdi dadeyohvsgesdi, ale osi nayelvsgvna igesesdi osdv uwonisv igatseli Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv, ale dideyodi gesv nasgi Unelanvhi dinilododi gesv tsidadeyohvsga;
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏣᏘᏂ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏓᏕᏲᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎣᏏ ᎾᏰᎸᏍᎬᎾ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎤᏬᏂᏒ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏕᏲᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏗᏂᎶᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏥᏓᏕᏲᎲᏍᎦ;
\ft If any man teach otherwise, and consent not to wholesome words, even the words of our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the doctrine which is according to godliness;

\ln Nasgi na utlvquodi, gohusdi nagatahvna, uliyetanehi gawonihisdi gesv, ale tsutiyosati alinohesgvi, nahna tsvdidalehvsga advyugedi gesvi, ale adisvsdi gesvi, ale asotlvisdodi gesvi, ale gohusdi didadelisedi gesvi,
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᏢᏉᏗ, ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎾᎦᏔᎲᎾ, ᎤᎵᏰᏔᏁᎯ ᎦᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏘᏲᏌᏘ ᎠᎵᏃᎮᏍᎬᎢ, ᏀᎾ ᏨᏗᏓᎴᎲᏍᎦ ᎠᏛᏳᎨᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏗᏒᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏐᏢᎢᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏗᏓᏕᎵᏎᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ,
\ft He is proud, knowing nothing, but doting about questions and strifes of words, whereof cometh envy, strife, railings, evil surmisings,

\ln Ale gvsgaisdagi uniwonihisdi gesv yvwi ugosidv tsunadanvti, uninigidv duyugodvi, genvisdi gesv Unelanvhi dinelododi itsulaha anelisgi.  Nasgi iyunasdi dehadanvehesdi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎬᏍᎦᎢᏍᏓᎩ ᎤᏂᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏴᏫ ᎤᎪᏏᏛ ᏧᎾᏓᏅᏘ, ᎤᏂᏂᎩᏛ ᏚᏳᎪᏛᎢ, ᎨᏅᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏗᏁᎶᏙᏗ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎠᏁᎵᏍᎩ.  ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗ ᏕᎭᏓᏅᎡᎮᏍᏗ.
\ft Perverse disputings of men of corrupt minds, and destitute of the truth, supposing that gain is godliness: from such withdraw thyself.

\ln Unelanvhisgini dinelododi gesv ale nvwadohiyadv adanvdadisdi gesv, nasgi utsati genvisdi.
\syll ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᏗᏁᎶᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᎠᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎨᏅᎢᏍᏗ.
\ft But godliness with contentment is great gain.

\ln Tlayeno gohusdi yigiyole ani elohi, ale gvnigeyuiyu tla gohusdi yvgedinugowa.
\syll ᏝᏰᏃ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏱᎩᏲᎴ ᎠᏂ ᎡᎶᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᎨᏳᎢᏳ Ꮭ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏴᎨᏗᏄᎪᏩ.
\ft For we brought nothing into this world, and it is certain we can carry nothing out.

\ln Iyuno yigiha alisdayvdi ale diganuwo yidiginaa, nasgi yeliquo igiyelvsesdi.
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᏱᎩᎭ ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎦᏄᏬ ᏱᏗᎩᎾᎠ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏰᎵᏉ ᎢᎩᏰᎸᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft And having food and raiment let us be therewith content.

\ln Unadulisgisgini tsigi unenvisdiyi, udalenasdiyi ale asadv widaninvgoi, ale utsati iyudalegi ulisganisdv ale uyo iyadadvnehi agvvhisdi gesvi; nasgi tsiduninoyvtisdiha yvwi nahna agiliyoisdi gesv ale ayohuhisdi gesvi.
\syll ᎤᎾᏚᎵᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ ᏥᎩ ᎤᏁᏅᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᎤᏓᎴᎾᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏌᏛ ᏫᏓᏂᏅᎪᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎢᏳᏓᎴᎩ ᎤᎵᏍᎦᏂᏍᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏲ ᎢᏯᏓᏛᏁᎯ ᎠᎬᎥᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏚᏂᏃᏴᏘᏍᏗᎭ ᏴᏫ ᏀᎾ ᎠᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft But they that will be rich fall into temptation and a snare, and into many foolish and hurtful lusts, which drown men in destruction and perdition.

\ln Adelvyeno digeyudi gesv nahna didalehvsga nudalesv uyoi, nasgi gilo unigvvsgvi unatlesv gohiyudi gesvi, ale unvsv dunadatistanv utsati uyo adanvdadisdi gesvi.
\syll ᎠᏕᎸᏰᏃ ᏗᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏀᎾ ᏗᏓᎴᎲᏍᎦ ᏄᏓᎴᏒ ᎤᏲᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏂᎬᎥᏍᎬᎢ ᎤᎾᏞᏒ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏅᏒ ᏚᎾᏓᏘᏍᏔᏅ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᏲ ᎠᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft For the love of money is the root of all evil: which while some coveted after, they have erred from the faith, and pierced themselves through with many sorrows.

\ln Nihisgini hisgaya Unelanvhi utseliga nasgi hia dehadanvehesdi, ale dehisdawadisesdi duyugodv gesvi, ale Unelanvhi ganayehisdi gesvi, ale gohiyudi gesvi, ale adageyudi gesvi, ale gvnidiyu gesvi, ale udanvtiyu gesvi.
\syll ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎯᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏕᎭᏓᏅᎡᎮᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᎯᏍᏓᏩᏗᏎᏍᏗ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎦᎾᏰᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᏗᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᏅᏘᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft But thou, O man of God, flee these things; and follow after righteousness, godliness, faith, love, patience, meekness.

\ln Gohiyudi gesv hvdisgesdi osdv alisdi gesv halihesdi.  Nalisquadisgvna gvnidv gesv tiniyv, nahna nasquo etsayanvdv tsigi, ale tsanonvhi tsigi osdv kanohedi gesv unitsati anigatahi anidutahvi.
\syll ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎲᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎠᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎭᎵᎮᏍᏗ.  ᎾᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᎬᎾ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎨᏒ ᏘᏂᏴ, ᏀᎾ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎡᏣᏯᏅᏛ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏣᏃᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎯ ᎠᏂᏚᏔᎲᎢ.
\ft Fight the good fight of faith, lay hold on eternal life, whereunto thou art also called, and hast professed a good profession before many witnesses.

\ln Gvnetseha Unelanvhi agatahvi, nasgi digvnidisgi tsigi nigav nunadalesvi, ale agatahv Tsisa Galonedv nasgi Quanidi Qualedi agatahv unonvhi tsigi osdv kanohedv gesvi,
\syll ᎬᏁᏤᎭ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎦᏔᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎬᏂᏗᏍᎩ ᏥᎩ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏄᎾᏓᎴᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎦᏔᎲ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏆᏂᏗ ᏆᎴᏗ ᎠᎦᏔᎲ ᎤᏃᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ,
\ft I give thee charge in the sight of God, who quickeneth all things, and before Christ Jesus, who before Pontius Pilate witnessed a good confession;

\ln Nasgi tsasquanigododiyi dikahnawadvsdi, nudadalvna ale gohusdi gayetselisedi nigesvna iyulisdodiyi igatseli Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv gananugotsilv gvdisgi,
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏣᏍᏆᏂᎪᏙᏗᏱ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ, ᏄᏓᏓᎸᎾ ᎠᎴ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎦᏰᏤᎵᏎᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎦᎾᏄᎪᏥᎸ ᎬᏗᏍᎩ,
\ft That thou keep this commandment without spot, unrebukeable, until the appearing of our Lord Jesus Christ:

\ln Nasgi tsvgananugowisi nahiyu tsunanugowisedi gesvi, nasgi nvwadohiyadv udanvti ale uwasvhi ulinigidv gesvi, Ugvwiyuhi Unigvwiyuhi anehvi, ale Ugvwiyusadegi Nunigvwiyusadegi anehvi;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏨᎦᎾᏄᎪᏫᏏ ᏀᎢᏳ ᏧᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᎤᏓᏅᏘ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏩᏒᎯ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏂᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᏁᎲᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ ᎠᏁᎲᎢ;
\ft Which in his times he shall shew, who is the blessed and only Potentate, the King of kings, and Lord of lords;

\ln Nasgi uwasvhi ayohuhisdi nigesvna gesv uhi, igagadv ehi gesvi, nasgi igagadv nahna gilo gvwaluhisdi nigesvna gesvi, nasgi gilo ugohvgi nigesvna, ale gvwagowadvdi nigesvna gesvi; nasgi atsilvquodiyu gesesdi ale ulinigidi gesv winasdvna gesesdi.  Emenv.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏩᏒᎯ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎯ, ᎢᎦᎦᏛ ᎡᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎦᎦᏛ ᏀᎾ ᎩᎶ ᎬᏩᎷᎯᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎩᎶ ᎤᎪᎲᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᎪᏩᏛᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏫᎾᏍᏛᎾ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.  ᎡᎺᏅ.
\ft Who only hath immortality, dwelling in the light which no man can approach unto; whom no man hath seen, nor can see: to whom be honour and power everlasting. Amen.

\ln Ginetsehesdi tsunehnai tsigi ani elohi nasgi unatlvquodi yiquo nigesvna, ale unalisgasdododiyi nigesvna udalidasdi genvisdi gesvi, Unelanvhisgini gvnidv analisgasdodisgesdi nasgi utsati iginehi tsigi nagav nudalesv osdv igalisdanedi.
\syll ᎩᏁᏤᎮᏍᏗ ᏧᏁᎿᎢ ᏥᎩ ᎠᏂ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᏢᏉᏗ ᏱᏉ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏙᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎤᏓᎵᏓᏍᏗ ᎨᏅᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎠᎾᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎢᎩᏁᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎾᎦᎥ ᏄᏓᎴᏒ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎢᎦᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ.
\ft Charge them that are rich in this world, that they be not highminded, nor trust in uncertain riches, but in the living God, who giveth us richly all things to enjoy;

\ln Ale osdv nanadvnehesdi, ale unehnaiyu gesesdi osdv nanadvnehvi, ale anigaliyesdi unadanediyi, aniyadohihi gesesdi unihvi,
