\syll ᎠᎴ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎾᎾᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎿᎢᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎾᎾᏛᏁᎲᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᎦᎵᏰᏍᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏁᏗᏱ, ᎠᏂᏯᏙᎯᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᏂᎲᎢ,
\ft That they do good, that they be rich in good works, ready to distribute, willing to communicate;

\ln Anadanelvsgesdi unvsv unatseliga osdv gagusdvdi asi nasqualisgvna nahiyu usqualvdi tsigi, nasgi nalisquadisgvna gvnidv digvwaniniyvdi iyulisdodiyi.
\syll ᎠᎾᏓᏁᎸᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᏅᏒ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎦᎫᏍᏛᏗ ᎠᏏ ᎾᏍᏆᎵᏍᎬᎾ ᏀᎢᏳ ᎤᏍᏆᎸᏗ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᎬᎾ ᎬᏂᏛ ᏗᎬᏩᏂᏂᏴᏗ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
\ft Laying up in store for themselves a good foundation against the time to come, that they may lay hold on eternal life.

\ln Dimadi, tsasquanigodesdi nasgi tsetsagenvyv, iyvdv nvnehesdi gawetlvdi gesv ale asequoquo gawonihisdi gesvi, ale adisvsdi gesv agadovhisdi niduyugodvna tsidudov;
\syll ᏗᎹᏗ, ᏣᏍᏆᏂᎪᏕᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏤᏣᎨᏅᏴ, ᎢᏴᏛ ᏅᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᎦᏪᏢᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏎᏉᏉ ᎦᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏗᏒᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗ ᏂᏚᏳᎪᏛᎾ ᏥᏚᏙᎥ;
\ft O Timothy, keep that which is committed to thy trust, avoiding profane and vain babblings, and oppositions of science falsely so called:

\ln Nasgi gilo anisdawadisv unatlesv gohiyudi gesvi.  [Unelanvhi] udadolisdi gesv detsakawadidohesdi.  Emenv.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎩᎶ ᎠᏂᏍᏓᏩᏗᏒ ᎤᎾᏞᏒ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.  ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯdata is invalid ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏕᏣᎧᏩᏗᏙᎮᏍᏗ.  ᎡᎺᏅ.
\ft Which some professing have erred concerning the faith. Grace be with thee. Amen.

\ln Ayv Quola aginvsidv Tsisa Galonedv nvtsulisdotanv Unelanvhi osi uyelvnvi, nasgiya aduisdv gvnidv eginediyi, nasgi Galonedv Tsisa tsvdidalehvsga;
\syll ᎠᏴ ᏉᎳ ᎠᎩᏅᏏᏛ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏅᏧᎵᏍᏙᏔᏅ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎣᏏ ᎤᏰᎸᏅᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎠᏚᎢᏍᏛ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎡᎩᏁᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏥᏌ ᏨᏗᏓᎴᎲᏍᎦ;
\ft Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, according to the promise of life which is in Christ Jesus,

\ln Wigvyowelasi Dimadi gvgeyui aquetsi; gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv ale udadolitsadv gesv ale nvwadohiyadv detsakahnawadidohesdi nvdayunalisgolvtanvhi Unelanvhi Igidoda ale Galonedv Tsisa igatseli Ugvwiyuhi.
\syll ᏫᎬᏲᏪᎳᏏ ᏗᎹᏗ ᎬᎨᏳᎢ ᎠᏇᏥ; ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏣᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᏕᏣᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎮᏍᏗ ᏅᏓᏳᎾᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏅᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᎩᏙᏓ ᎠᎴ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏥᏌ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ.
\ft To Timothy, my dearly beloved son: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.

\ln Tsiyalielitse Unelanvhi, nasgi tsidetsiyanelodi, nasgiya digigayvlige nunadvnelvi, tsigvdiha gadaha nigesvna aquadanvdo, nitsiyohisdisgvna, iga ale svnoyi gvyanvdadisgv gadadolisdisgvi,
\syll ᏥᏯᎵᎡᎵᏤ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏕᏥᏯᏁᎶᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏗᎩᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᏄᎾᏛᏁᎸᎢ, ᏥᎬᏗᎭ ᎦᏓᎭ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏙ, ᏂᏥᏲᎯᏍᏗᏍᎬᎾ, ᎢᎦ ᎠᎴ ᏒᏃᏱ ᎬᏯᏅᏓᏗᏍᎬ ᎦᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ,
\ft I thank God, whom I serve from my forefathers with pure conscience, that without ceasing I have remembrance of thee in my prayers night and day;

\ln Nasgi utsati aquadulisgv gvgowadvdiyi, ale ganvdadisgv detsatloyilvi nasgino agikaliisdiyi ulihelisdi gesvi,
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎠᏆᏚᎵᏍᎬ ᎬᎪᏩᏛᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᏅᏓᏗᏍᎬ ᏕᏣᏠᏱᎸᎢ ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎠᎩᎧᎵᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᎵᎮᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ,
\ft Greatly desiring to see thee, being mindful of thy tears, that I may be filled with joy;

\ln Iyuno ganvdada utlonasdi nigesvna gohiyudi gesv tsitsayaa, nasgi igvyi tsuyav tsalisi Losi ale tsatsi Yunisi, ale nudlasidvsvna agiyelvha nihi nasquo tsayavi.
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᎦᏅᏓᏓ ᎤᏠᎾᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏥᏣᏯᎠ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎬᏱ ᏧᏯᎥ ᏣᎵᏏ ᎶᏏ ᎠᎴ ᏣᏥ ᏳᏂᏏ, ᎠᎴ ᏄᏜᏏᏛᏒᎾ ᎠᎩᏰᎸᎭ ᏂᎯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏣᏯᎥᎢ.
\ft When I call to remembrance the unfeigned faith that is in thee, which dwelt first in thy grandmother Lois, and thy mother Eunice; and I am persuaded that in thee also.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi gvyanvdadisdiha tsatelvdiyi Unelanvgi tsanelvhi gesvi, nasgi tsitsayaa, nasgi degvyasitadv tsinvdigalisdodiha.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎬᏯᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗᎭ ᏣᏖᎸᏗᏱ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎩ ᏣᏁᎸᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏣᏯᎠ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏕᎬᏯᏏᏔᏛ ᏥᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ.
\ft Wherefore I put thee in remembrance that thou stir up the gift of God, which is in thee by the putting on of my hands.

\ln Unelanvhiyeno vtla yiginelv adanvdo udasgasdi, ulinigidvsgini ale adageyudi gesv ale osdv adanvtedi gesvi.
\syll ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏱᎩᏁᎸ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᏓᏍᎦᏍᏗ, ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎠᏓᏅᏖᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft For God hath not given us the spirit of fear; but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi tlesdi yadehosgesdi hinohesgv ugvwiyuhi igatseliga, ale tlesdi yisquadehosgesdi ayv tsiyvgi nasgi utseliga, tseladisdisgesdisgini agiliyogv osdv kanohedv, tsasdelisgesdi ulinigidi gesv Unelanvhi,
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏯᏕᎰᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎯᏃᎮᏍᎬ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᎦᏤᎵᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏍᏆᏕᎰᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᏴ ᏥᏴᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᏤᎳᏗᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᎩᎵᏲᎬ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ, ᏣᏍᏕᎵᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ,
\ft Be not thou therefore ashamed of the testimony of our Lord, nor of me his prisoner: but be thou partaker of the afflictions of the gospel according to the power of God;

\ln Nasgi igisdelvdv tsigi, ale igiyanvdv tsigi uwatanvhi galvquodi adayanvdi gesvi, vtla ayv degilvwisdanehv yinvtsulisdotanv, uwasvsgini udanvtelvi ale gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv nvtsulisdotanv, nasgi iginelvhi tsigi nvtsudalenvhvna, Tsisa Galonedv gesv iyusdi,
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎩᏍᏕᎸᏛ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᎩᏯᏅᏛ ᏥᎩ ᎤᏩᏔᏅᎯ ᎦᎸᏉᏗ ᎠᏓᏯᏅᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᏴ ᏕᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᏱᏅᏧᎵᏍᏙᏔᏅ, ᎤᏩᏒᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏓᏅᏖᎸᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏧᎵᏍᏙᏔᏅ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎩᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ ᏅᏧᏓᎴᏅᎲᎾ, ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ,
\ft Who hath saved us, and called us with an holy calling, not according to our works, but according to his own purpose and grace, which was given us in Christ Jesus before the world began,

\ln Gohino gesv gvnigesv igvnelvhi nasgi unanugotsilv Igisdelisgi Tsisa Galonedv, nasgi uyostanvhi tsigi ayohuhisdi gesv, ale unanugowisvhi tsigi gvnidv ale ayohuhisdi nigesvna gesv, osdv kanohedv gvtanvhi,
\syll ᎪᎯᏃ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᎬᏁᎸᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏥᎸ ᎢᎩᏍᏕᎵᏍᎩ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏲᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏫᏒᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒ, ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎬᏔᏅᎯ,
\ft But is now made manifest by the appearing of our Saviour Jesus Christ, who hath abolished death, and hath brought life and immortality to light through the gospel:

\ln Nasgi ayv vginetselvhi galitsidohvsgi ale vginvsidv ale digatsiyeyohvsgi tsunadalenvdv yvwi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᎥᎩᏁᏤᎸᎯ ᎦᎵᏥᏙᎲᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎥᎩᏅᏏᏛ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎦᏥᏰᏲᎲᏍᎩ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ.
\ft Whereunto I am appointed a preacher, and an apostle, and a teacher of the Gentiles.

\ln Nasgi nasquo nvdigalisdodiha hia nasgi tsudalenvdv tsigiliyoga; aseno vtla yigadeosga; tsigatahayeno nasgi tsitsiyalisgasdotanv, ale ulinigidiyu aquohiyuha yeliquo gvwasquanigododi gesv nasgi tsitsiyagenvyv gvni nahiyu iga asqualvhvha.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏥᎩᎵᏲᎦ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏱᎦᏕᎣᏍᎦ; ᏥᎦᏔᎭᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏥᏯᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏔᏅ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ ᎠᏉᎯᏳᎭ ᏰᎵᏉ ᎬᏩᏍᏆᏂᎪᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏥᏯᎨᏅᏴ ᎬᏂ ᏀᎢᏳ ᎢᎦ ᎠᏍᏆᎸᎲᎭ.
\ft For the which cause I also suffer these things: nevertheless I am not ashamed: for I know whom I have believed, and am persuaded that he is able to keep that which I have committed unto him against that day.

\ln Detsaniyvsesdi nasgi ditsatlilostanvhi osdv kanohedv nasgi squadvganelvhi tsigi, hvdisgesdi gohiyudi gesv ale adageyudi gesv nasgi Galonedv Tsisa nvdayudalenvhi.
\syll ᏕᏣᏂᏴᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏣᏟᎶᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏍᏆᏛᎦᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎲᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏥᏌ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ.
\ft Hold fast the form of sound words, which thou hast heard of me, in faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.

\ln Nasgi na osdv tsetsagenvyv tsasquanigodesdi, tsasdelisgesdi Galvquodiyu Adanvdo nasgi tsigiyaa.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏤᏣᎨᏅᏴ ᏣᏍᏆᏂᎪᏕᏍᏗ, ᏣᏍᏕᎵᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᎩᏯᎠ.
\ft That good thing which was committed unto thee keep by the Holy Ghost which dwelleth in us.

\ln Hia nasgi higataha, nigadv Esiyi anehi gvquvdetsvi, nasgi unadasuya Quatsela ale Hamatsini.
\syll ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎦᏔᎭ, ᏂᎦᏛ ᎡᏏᏱ ᎠᏁᎯ ᎬᏋᏕᏨᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᏓᏑᏯ ᏆᏤᎳ ᎠᎴ ᎭᎹᏥᏂ.
\ft This thou knowest, that all they which are in Asia be turned away from me; of whom are Phygellus and Hermogenes.

\ln Ugvwiyuhi tsunedi gesesdi udadolisdi gesv dudatihnav Onesiquola, yanoyeno agigalisdadisgvgi, ale vtla yaquodehohisehe aquatseli tsudadesvdv;
\syll ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏧᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏚᏓᏘᎿᎥ ᎣᏁᏏᏉᎳ, ᏯᏃᏰᏃ ᎠᎩᎦᎵᏍᏓᏗᏍᎬᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᏯᏉᏕᎰᎯᏎᎮ ᎠᏆᏤᎵ ᏧᏓᏕᏒᏛ;
\ft The Lord give mercy unto the house of Onesiphorus; for he oft refreshed me, and was not ashamed of my chain:

\ln Lomisgini uwedolv ulinigidv agiyolvgi, ale agiwadvhvgi.
\syll ᎶᎻᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏪᏙᎸ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᎠᎩᏲᎸᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎩᏩᏛᎲᎩ.
\ft But, when he was in Rome, he sought me out very diligently, and found me.

\ln Ugvwiyuhi unedi gesesdi uwadvdiyi udadolisdi gesv Ugvwiyuhi nahiyu iga.  Ale nigav agisdelvhidolv Equisa osiyu higataha.
\syll ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᏩᏛᏗᏱ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏀᎢᏳ ᎢᎦ.  ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎠᎩᏍᏕᎸᎯᏙᎸ ᎡᏈᏌ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎯᎦᏔᎭ.
\ft The Lord grant unto him that he may find mercy of the Lord in that day: and in how many things he ministered unto me at Ephesus, thou knowest very well.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi nihi aquetsi tsalinigohisdisgesdi gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv nasgi Tsisa Galonedv nvdayulisgolvtanvhi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏂᎯ ᎠᏇᏥ ᏣᎵᏂᎪᎯᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏅᏓᏳᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏅᎯ.
\ft Thou therefore, my son, be strong in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.

\ln Ale nasgi squadvganelvhi tsigi unitsati anigatahvi, nasgi dehagenvdisgesdi anosdv anisgaya nasgi yeli digvwaneyodi gesv nasquo na wunvgudvi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏍᏆᏛᎦᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏕᎭᎨᏅᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᏃᏍᏛ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏰᎵ ᏗᎬᏩᏁᏲᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᏉ Ꮎ ᏭᏅᎫᏛᎢ.
\ft And the things that thou hast heard of me among many witnesses, the same commit thou to faithful men, who shall be able to teach others also.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi nihi hvnidiyu gesesdi higiliyogvi, nasgiya osdv ayawisgi Tsisa Galonedv utseliga.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏂᎯ ᎲᏂᏗᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎯᎩᎵᏲᎬᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎠᏯᏫᏍᎩ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ.
\ft Thou therefore endure hardness, as a good soldier of Jesus Christ.

\ln Gilo dahnawa tsegoi vtla gvnv ulisdelvdodi deulvwisdanehv yadudalvdisgoi, udulisgo asgayegvsda osdv uyelvdi tsulvwisdanediyi.
\syll ᎩᎶ ᏓᎿᏩ ᏤᎪᎢ ᎥᏝ ᎬᏅ ᎤᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ ᏕᎤᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᏯᏚᏓᎸᏗᏍᎪᎢ, ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎪ ᎠᏍᎦᏰᎬᏍᏓ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎤᏰᎸᏗ ᏧᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ.
\ft No man that warreth entangleth himself with the affairs of this life; that he may please him who hath chosen him to be a soldier.

\ln Iyu ale gilo udasegogisdiyi tsatlinigvnehoi, vtla yatsisdulvsgoi gvni dikahnawadvsdi nigvnv iyudvnelvhi tsigesoi.
\syll ᎢᏳ ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏓᏎᎪᎩᏍᏗᏱ ᏣᏟᏂᎬᏁᎰᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᏯᏥᏍᏚᎸᏍᎪᎢ ᎬᏂ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏂᎬᏅ ᎢᏳᏛᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎨᏐᎢ.
\ft And if a man also strive for masteries, yet is he not crowned, except he strive lawfully.

\ln Digalogisgi tsidulvwisdanehoi igvyi uweladisdodi geso unanugowisvhi.
\syll ᏗᎦᎶᎩᏍᎩ ᏥᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎰᎢ ᎢᎬᏱ ᎤᏪᎳᏗᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏐ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏫᏒᎯ.
\ft The husbandman that laboureth must be first partaker of the fruits.

\ln Hadanvdadvli hia tsinitsiweha; Ugvwiyuhino witsahvsi tsagadovhisdiyi nigav tsudalenvdv.
\syll ᎭᏓᏅᏓᏛᎵ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᏥᏪᎭ; ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᏃ ᏫᏣᎲᏏ ᏣᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ.
\ft Consider what I say; and the Lord give thee understanding in all things.

\ln Tsanvtesdi Tsisa Galonedv, Dewi uwetsi, uyohusv dulehisanvi, nasgiya nigawesgv osdv kanohedv aquatseliga,
\syll ᏣᏅᏖᏍᏗ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ, ᏕᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ, ᎤᏲᎱᏒ ᏚᎴᎯᏌᏅᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎬ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎠᏆᏤᎵᎦ,
\ft Remember that Jesus Christ of the seed of David was raised from the dead according to my gospel:

\ln Nasgi nahna tsitsigiliyoga vqualvsdiyi iyvdv, uyo tsulvwisdanehi nasgiyai; Unelanvhisgini utseliga kanohedv vtla galvlvhi yigi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏀᎾ ᏥᏥᎩᎵᏲᎦ ᎥᏆᎸᏍᏗᏱ ᎢᏴᏛ, ᎤᏲ ᏧᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ; ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎥᏝ ᎦᎸᎸᎯ ᏱᎩ.
\ft Wherein I suffer trouble, as an evil doer, even unto bonds; but the word of God is not bound.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi unelagi geliha nigadv tsudalenvdv naqualisdanelidohvi gegasuyedv nvdigalisdodiha, ale uniwadvdiyi alisdelvdodi nasgi Tsisa Galonedv nvdayulisgolvtanvhi, ale alisquadisgi nigesvna galvquodiyu gesvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᎩ ᎨᎵᎭ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎾᏆᎵᏍᏓᏁᎵᏙᎲᎢ ᎨᎦᏑᏰᏛ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏩᏛᏗᏱ ᎠᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏅᏓᏳᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏅᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Therefore I endure all things for the elect's sakes, that they may also obtain the salvation which is in Christ Jesus with eternal glory.

\ln Udohiyuhiya igawedv, Iyuyeno itsulaha digiyohusvhi gesesdi, ase nasquo itsulaha dedvnesdi;
\syll ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎢᎦᏪᏛ, ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᏗᎩᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎠᏎ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᏕᏛᏁᏍᏗ;
\ft It is a faithful saying: For if we be dead with him, we shall also live with him:

\ln Iyuno dedvniesdi ase nasgi itsulaha igigvwiyusadegesdi; iyuno isvdadayilvha nasquo ase dagadayili.
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᏕᏛᏂᎡᏍᏗ ᎠᏎ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎢᎩᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎨᏍᏗ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᎢᏒᏓᏓᏱᎸᎭ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏎ ᏓᎦᏓᏱᎵ.
\ft If we suffer, we shall also reign with him: if we deny him, he also will deny us:

\ln Iyuno nedoiyunvna igesesdi ase nvwasdiquo gagohiyudi gesvi; vtla uwasv yvgvdadayiga.
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᏁᏙᎢᏳᏅᎾ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎠᏎ ᏅᏩᏍᏗᏉ ᎦᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎥᏝ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏴᎬᏓᏓᏱᎦ.
\ft If we believe not, yet he abideth faithful: he cannot deny himself.

\ln Hia nasgi dehanvdadisdisgesdi, ulinigidvya dehinetsehesdi Ugvwiyuhi agatahvi, unadisvsdiyi nigesvna gesv daniwonisgvi, gohusdi gvdodi nigesvna tsigi, danigatahvsgvquosgini gvwanadvdasdanehi.
\syll ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏕᎭᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛᏯ ᏕᎯᏁᏤᎮᏍᏗ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᎦᏔᎲᎢ, ᎤᎾᏗᏒᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒ ᏓᏂᏬᏂᏍᎬᎢ, ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎬᏙᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏥᎩ, ᏓᏂᎦᏔᎲᏍᎬᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎬᏩᎾᏛᏓᏍᏓᏁᎯ.
\ft Of these things put them in remembrance, charging them before the Lord that they strive not about words to no profit, but to the subverting of the hearers.

\ln Hatlinigvnehesdi gvnigesv itsvnediyi osiyu tsayelvsv Unelanvhi, ditsalvwisdanehi gesesdi getsadehohisdi nigesvna gesvi, osdv tiyadohehi gayegogi nigesvna kanohedv.
\syll ᎭᏟᏂᎬᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏨᏁᏗᏱ ᎣᏏᏳ ᏣᏰᎸᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᏗᏣᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎨᏣᏕᎰᎯᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎣᏍᏛ ᏘᏯᏙᎮᎯ ᎦᏰᎪᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ.
\ft Study to shew thyself approved unto God, a workman that needeth not to be ashamed, rightly dividing the word of truth.

\ln Iyvdvsgini nvnehesdi gawetlvdi gesv ale nulisalodvna gawonihisdi gesvi, nasgiyeno aninequosgesdi Unelanvhi dinelododi nigesvna gesvi,
\syll ᎢᏴᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᏅᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᎦᏪᏢᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏄᎵᏌᎶᏛᎾ ᎦᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎠᏂᏁᏉᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏗᏁᎶᏙᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ,
\ft But shun profane and vain babblings: for they will increase unto more ungodliness.

\ln Ale aniwonisgv adayesgesdi nasgiya ugosidv tsadayesgoi; nasgi nunasdi Haminiya ale Qualida,
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏬᏂᏍᎬ ᎠᏓᏰᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎤᎪᏏᏛ ᏣᏓᏰᏍᎪᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᎾᏍᏗ ᎭᎻᏂᏯ ᎠᎴ ᏆᎵᏓ,
\ft And their word will eat as doth a canker: of whom is Hymenaeus and Philetus;

\ln Nasgi duyugodv gesv unatlesv, hia tsinaniwea, ayohusv dilehisodi gesv gayula ulo sonv; ale daniluquadineha igadv unohiyusvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎾᏞᏒ, ᎯᎠ ᏥᎾᏂᏪᎠ, ᎠᏲᎱᏒ ᏗᎴᎯᏐᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎦᏳᎳ ᎤᎶ ᏐᏅ; ᎠᎴ ᏓᏂᎷᏆᏗᏁᎭ ᎢᎦᏛ ᎤᏃᎯᏳᏒᎢ.
\ft Who concerning the truth have erred, saying that the resurrection is past already; and overthrow the faith of some.

\ln Asesgininonv gagusdvdi Unelanvhi utseliga ulinigidiyu nigvnv; hiayeno nigvnv gowelvi, Ugvwiyuhi dagataha nasgi tsutseliga; ale hia, Gilo kaneisdisgesdi Galonedv dudov nasgi adanvehesdi asgani.
\syll ᎠᏎᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎦᎫᏍᏛᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ ᏂᎬᏅ; ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᏂᎬᏅ ᎪᏪᎸᎢ, ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏓᎦᏔᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏤᎵᎦ; ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ, ᎩᎶ ᎧᏁᎢᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏚᏙᎥ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏓᏅᎡᎮᏍᏗ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ.
\ft Nevertheless the foundation of God standeth sure, having this seal, The Lord knoweth them that are his. And, Let every one that nameth the name of Christ depart from iniquity.

\ln Aseno equa tsadanelo nahna daho ditelido vtla adelvquo dalonige ale adelvunegv uwasv digotlvtanvhi yigesoi, nasquosgini ada ale gada digotlvtanvhi; ale igadv digalvquodi igadvno digalvquodi nigesvna.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎡᏆ ᏣᏓᏁᎶ ᏀᎾ ᏓᎰ ᏗᏖᎵᏙ ᎥᏝ ᎠᏕᎸᏉ ᏓᎶᏂᎨ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏕᎸᎤᏁᎬ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏗᎪᏢᏔᏅᎯ ᏱᎨᏐᎢ, ᎾᏍᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏓ ᎠᎴ ᎦᏓ ᏗᎪᏢᏔᏅᎯ; ᎠᎴ ᎢᎦᏛ ᏗᎦᎸᏉᏗ ᎢᎦᏛᏃ ᏗᎦᎸᏉᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.
\ft But in a great house there are not only vessels of gold and of silver, but also of wood and of earth; and some to honour, and some to dishonour.

\ln Iyuno gilo udanvgalvdv yigi hia nasgi gesvi, nasgi na atelido galvquodi gesesdi, galvquotanvhi, ale yisdv igvnelvhi gohusdi uwadodiyi ganela; ale advnvistanvhi nagav osdv digalvwisdanedi gesv ugvwali.
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏓᏅᎦᎸᏛ ᏱᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᏖᎵᏙ ᎦᎸᏉᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎦᎸᏉᏔᏅᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏱᏍᏛ ᎢᎬᏁᎸᎯ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏩᏙᏗᏱ ᎦᏁᎳ; ᎠᎴ ᎠᏛᏅᎢᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎾᎦᎥ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ.
\ft If a man therefore purge himself from these, he shall be a vessel unto honour, sanctified, and meet for the master's use, and prepared unto every good work.

\ln Ale dehadanvehesdi gila dinadvsgi unadulvnvdi gesvi; hisdawadegesdino duyugodv gesv, ale gohiyudi gesv, ale adageyudi gesv, ale nvwadohiyadv gesvi, itsaligosesdi nasgi na Ugvwiyuhi anadadolisdanehi unawi gadaha nigesvna anvdisgi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏕᎭᏓᏅᎡᎮᏍᏗ ᎩᎳ ᏗᎾᏛᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᏚᎸᏅᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎯᏍᏓᏩᏕᎨᏍᏗᏃ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎢᏣᎵᎪᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᎾᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᎤᎾᏫ ᎦᏓᎭ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎠᏅᏗᏍᎩ.
\ft Flee also youthful lusts: but follow righteousness, faith, charity, peace, with them that call on the Lord out of a pure heart.

\ln Dehadanvehesdisgini nulisalodvna ale nvgatahvna duwonihisdi gesvi, higatahayeno ditiyosdi gesv waliyeilohihvi.
\syll ᏕᎭᏓᏅᎡᎮᏍᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᏄᎵᏌᎶᏛᎾ ᎠᎴ ᏅᎦᏔᎲᎾ ᏚᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎯᎦᏔᎭᏰᏃ ᏗᏘᏲᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏩᎵᏰᎢᎶᎯᎲᎢ.
\ft But foolish and unlearned questions avoid, knowing that they do gender strifes.

\ln Ugvwiyuhiyeno unvsidasdi vtla tsutiyosdi yigi, tsugeyuhisgini yigi nanivi, digvwadeyodi yigi, gvnidiyu yigi,
\syll ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᏰᏃ ᎤᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎥᏝ ᏧᏘᏲᏍᏗ ᏱᎩ, ᏧᎨᏳᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᏱᎩ ᎾᏂᎥᎢ, ᏗᎬᏩᏕᏲᏗ ᏱᎩ, ᎬᏂᏗᏳ ᏱᎩ,
\ft And the servant of the Lord must not strive; but be gentle unto all men, apt to teach, patient,

\ln Udanvti gvdisgv yigi degeyohvsgv gvwatludisgi; udugi yuwaha Unelanvhi tsunediyi tsuninetliyvsdiyi dunadanvdvi, ale tsunadanilvisdiyi udohiyuhi gesvi;
\syll ᎤᏓᏅᏘ ᎬᏗᏍᎬ ᏱᎩ ᏕᎨᏲᎲᏍᎬ ᎬᏩᏡᏗᏍᎩ; ᎤᏚᎩ ᏳᏩᎭ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᏁᏗᏱ ᏧᏂᏁᏟᏴᏍᏗᏱ ᏚᎾᏓᏅᏛᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᎾᏓᏂᎸᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ;
\ft In meekness instructing those that oppose themselves; if God peradventure will give them repentance to the acknowledging of the truth;

\ln Ale unadanvtisodiyi unvsv unadudalesdiyi asgina usadvi, nasgi guyvginvhi tsigi uwasvquo adanvtesgv itsuwanelvhi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘᏐᏗᏱ ᎤᏅᏒ ᎤᎾᏚᏓᎴᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᏍᎩᎾ ᎤᏌᏛᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎫᏴᎩᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎤᏩᏒᏉ ᎠᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ ᎢᏧᏩᏁᎸᎯ.
\ft And that they may recover themselves out of the snare of the devil, who are taken captive by him at his will.

\ln Hiano nasquo higatahesdi, ulisqua lvdi gesesdi ase udeyadodi uliyeilohisdi gesesdi.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎯᎦᏔᎮᏍᏗ, ᎤᎵᏍᏆ ᎸᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎠᏎ ᎤᏕᏯᏙᏗ ᎤᎵᏰᎢᎶᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft This know also, that in the last days perilous times shall come.

\ln Yvwiyeno unvsv unadalvquodiyu gesesdi, adelv unigvvsgi, anatlvquasgi, unatlvquodi, Unelanvhi gvwanisotlvdi, tsunigayvlige dinilasitisgi, nunalihelitsadvna, anigadahai,
\syll ᏴᏫᏰᏃ ᎤᏅᏒ ᎤᎾᏓᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎠᏕᎸ ᎤᏂᎬᎥᏍᎩ, ᎠᎾᏢᏆᏍᎩ, ᎤᎾᏢᏉᏗ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎬᏩᏂᏐᏢᏗ, ᏧᏂᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᏗᏂᎳᏏᏘᏍᎩ, ᏄᎾᎵᎮᎵᏣᏛᎾ, ᎠᏂᎦᏓᎭᎢ,
\ft For men shall be lovers of their own selves, covetous, boasters, proud, blasphemers, disobedient to parents, unthankful, unholy,

\ln Gohusdi tsunvna nidunigeyusvna, nunohistisvna, usonv anadanohelidohi, nunalisinahisdvna, unihnalvhi, anisgagi osdv,
\syll ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏧᏅᎾ ᏂᏚᏂᎨᏳᏒᎾ, ᏄᏃᎯᏍᏘᏒᎾ, ᎤᏐᏅ ᎠᎾᏓᏃᎮᎵᏙᎯ, ᏄᎾᎵᏏᏀᎢᏍᏛᎾ, ᎤᏂᎿᎸᎯ, ᎠᏂᏍᎦᎩ ᎣᏍᏛ,
\ft Without natural affection, trucebreakers, false accusers, incontinent, fierce, despisers of those that are good,

\ln Anadalonuhesgi, unigusiya, unadalisaladi, unigeyuhi yisdv unadanvdadisdisgi Unelanvhino nunigeyusvna,
\syll ᎠᎾᏓᎶᏄᎮᏍᎩ, ᎤᏂᎫᏏᏯ, ᎤᎾᏓᎵᏌᎳᏗ, ᎤᏂᎨᏳᎯ ᏱᏍᏛ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏃ ᏄᏂᎨᏳᏒᎾ,
\ft Traitors, heady, highminded, lovers of pleasures more than lovers of God;

\ln Unelanvhi dinelododi ditselidv unihi, aseno anadayihi Unelanvhi dinelododi gesvi.  Nasgi iyunasdi dehadanvehesdi.
\syll ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏗᏁᎶᏙᏗ ᏗᏤᎵᏛ ᎤᏂᎯ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᎾᏓᏱᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏗᏁᎶᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.  ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗ ᏕᎭᏓᏅᎡᎮᏍᏗ.
\ft Having a form of godliness, but denying the power thereof: from such turn away.

\ln Nasgiyeno hia iyunasdi tsidaniyvlidoho dadanelvi ale tsidanatinawidisgo nunadanvdvna anigeyv unikalitsvhi asganai, dunatinisv tsudalenvdv adulvdi gesvi,
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗ ᏥᏓᏂᏴᎵᏙᎰ ᏓᏓᏁᎸᎢ ᎠᎴ ᏥᏓᎾᏘᎾᏫᏗᏍᎪ ᏄᎾᏓᏅᏛᎾ ᎠᏂᎨᏴ ᎤᏂᎧᎵᏨᎯ ᎠᏍᎦᎾᎢ, ᏚᎾᏘᏂᏒ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎠᏚᎸᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ,
\ft For of this sort are they which creep into houses, and lead captive silly women laden with sins, led away with divers lusts,

\ln Nasgi nigohilv anadeloquasgoi, aseno vtla ilvhiyu yiwaniyeilohiho duyugodv agadovhisdi gesvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎠᎾᏕᎶᏆᏍᎪᎢ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᏱᏩᏂᏰᎢᎶᎯᎰ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎠᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Ever learning, and never able to come to the knowledge of the truth.

\ln Ale nasgiya Tseni ale Tsvqui tsanatludisge Mosi nasgiya nasquo hia anatludi duyugodv gesvi; anisgaya uyotsvhi dunadanvdvi, ale getsiyoisedv nasgi gohiyudi gesv ugvwali.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏤᏂ ᎠᎴ ᏨᏈ ᏣᎾᏡᏗᏍᎨ ᎼᏏ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎯᎠ ᎠᎾᏡᏗ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᏲᏨᎯ ᏚᎾᏓᏅᏛᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎨᏥᏲᎢᏎᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ.
\ft Now as Jannes and Jambres withstood Moses, so do these also resist the truth: men of corrupt minds, reprobate concerning the faith.

\ln Aseno vtla utli iyvdv gvwanenvsdi yigi, nanigatahnavnayeno gesv gvnigesv nvdayunalisdaneli nanivi, nasgiya nasquo tsinusde nasgi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏟ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎬᏩᏁᏅᏍᏗ ᏱᎩ, ᎾᏂᎦᏔᎿᎥᎾᏰᏃ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏅᏓᏳᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᎵ ᎾᏂᎥᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏥᏄᏍᏕ ᎾᏍᎩ.
\ft But they shall proceed no further: for their folly shall be manifest unto all men, as theirs also was.

\ln Nihisgini osiyu tsagadovsv nusdv daquadeyonvi, nusdv aqualenidolvi, nusdv daquegotanv diquadanvdvi, aquohiyusvi, gvnidiyu gesvi, aquadageyuhiyu gesvi, unelagi gelisgv tsigiliyogvi,
\syll ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎣᏏᏳ ᏣᎦᏙᎥᏒ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏓᏆᏕᏲᏅᎢ, ᏄᏍᏛ ᎠᏆᎴᏂᏙᎸᎢ, ᏄᏍᏛ ᏓᏇᎪᏔᏅ ᏗᏆᏓᏅᏛᎢ, ᎠᏉᎯᏳᏒᎢ, ᎬᏂᏗᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᏆᏓᎨᏳᎯᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᏁᎳᎩ ᎨᎵᏍᎬ ᏥᎩᎵᏲᎬᎢ,
\ft But thou hast fully known my doctrine, manner of life, purpose, faith, longsuffering, charity, patience,

\ln Uyo nvquvnelidolvi, agigiliyotsidolvi Vtiogi, Igoniya, Lisdinigav uyo nvquvnelidolvi; aseno nasgi nigadv nahna Ugvwiyuhi ayadalesvgi.
\syll ᎤᏲ ᏅᏋᏁᎵᏙᎸᎢ, ᎠᎩᎩᎵᏲᏥᏙᎸᎢ ᎥᏘᎣᎩ, ᎢᎪᏂᏯ, ᎵᏍᏗᏂᎦᎥ ᎤᏲ ᏅᏋᏁᎵᏙᎸᎢ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏀᎾ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᏯᏓᎴᏒᎩ.
\ft Persecutions, afflictions, which came unto me at Antioch, at Iconium, at Lystra; what persecutions I endured: but out of them all the Lord delivered me.

\ln Ale nasquo naniv unadulisgi Unelanvhi dinelododi gesv unisdawadvsdiyi Galonedv Tsisa anohiyuhvsgi iyunadvnedi nasgi ase uyo igegvnedi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎤᎾᏚᎵᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏗᏁᎶᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏂᏍᏓᏩᏛᏍᏗᏱ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏥᏌ ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᏁᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏎ ᎤᏲ ᎢᎨᎬᏁᏗ.
\ft Yea, and all that will live godly in Christ Jesus shall suffer persecution.

\ln Uniyosgini yvwi ale unatlonasdi aninequogesdi uniyo gesvi, danilonasdisgesdi ale getsilonasdisgesdi.
\syll ᎤᏂᏲᏍᎩᏂ ᏴᏫ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏠᎾᏍᏗ ᎠᏂᏁᏉᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᏂᏲ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏓᏂᎶᎾᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎨᏥᎶᎾᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
\ft But evil men and seducers shall wax worse and worse, deceiving, and being deceived.

\ln Nihisgini detsaniyvsesdi nusdv tsadeloquavi ale tsohiyunvi; higatahayeno nasgi hiyadeloquaelvhi gesvi,
\syll ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᏕᏣᏂᏴᏎᏍᏗ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏣᏕᎶᏆᎥᎢ ᎠᎴ ᏦᎯᏳᏅᎢ; ᎯᎦᏔᎭᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᏯᏕᎶᏆᎡᎸᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ,
\ft But continue thou in the things which thou hast learned and hast been assured of, knowing of whom thou hast learned them;

\ln Ale higataha tsasdi gesv nvdagvwadalenvdv dehigatahv digalvquodi goweli, nasgi yeli higatahnaiyu igvwanedi, tsalisdelvdodi gesv wigvwaliyilohisdi, Galonedv Tsisa hiyoiyusv iyuwanisodi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎯᎦᏔᎭ ᏣᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏕᎯᎦᏔᎲ ᏗᎦᎸᏉᏗ ᎪᏪᎵ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏰᎵ ᎯᎦᏔᎿᎢᏳ ᎢᎬᏩᏁᏗ, ᏣᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏫᎬᏩᎵᏱᎶᎯᏍᏗ, ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏥᏌ ᎯᏲᎢᏳᏒ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏐᏗ.
\ft And that from a child thou hast known the holy scriptures, which are able to make thee wise unto salvation through faith which is in Christ Jesus.

\ln Nigav goweli Unelanvhi udanvtelvhi digowelanvhi, ale osiyu udadeyodiyi, udagvsgolvdiyi, udagodiyi duyugodvi, udadeyodiyi osdv gesvi,
\syll ᏂᎦᎥ ᎪᏪᎵ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏓᏅᏖᎸᎯ ᏗᎪᏪᎳᏅᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎤᏓᏕᏲᏗᏱ, ᎤᏓᎬᏍᎪᎸᏗᏱ, ᎤᏓᎪᏗᏱ ᏚᏳᎪᏛᎢ, ᎤᏓᏕᏲᏗᏱ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ,
\ft All scripture is given by inspiration of God, and is profitable for doctrine, for reproof, for correction, for instruction in righteousness:

\ln Nasgi asgaya Unelanvhi utseliga usquadisdiyi, udanelisadv iyulisdodiyi nigav osdv digalvwisdanedi gesvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᎤᏍᏆᏗᏍᏗᏱ, ᎤᏓᏁᎵᏌᏛ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft That the man of God may be perfect, throughly furnished unto all good works.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi gvnetseha Unelanvhi agatahvi ale agatahv Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv, nasgi tsuwugodanedi tsigi dinvnodv ale tsuniyohusvhi nahiyu gananugotsilvha ale Ugvwiyuhi hnaquo nigalistanvha,
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎬᏁᏤᎭ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎦᏔᎲᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎦᏔᎲ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏭᎪᏓᏁᏗ ᏥᎩ ᏗᏅᏃᏛ ᎠᎴ ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᏀᎢᏳ ᎦᎾᏄᎪᏥᎸᎭ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎿᏉ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏔᏅᎭ,
\ft I charge thee therefore before God, and the Lord Jesus Christ, who shall judge the quick and the dead at his appearing and his kingdom;

\ln Halitsidohvsgesdi kanohedv, tsalinenvdesdiquo yeli gesesdi ale yeli nigesvna gesesdi, dehigvsgolvvsgesdi, dehisgagesdi, dehisdiyedisgesdi hvdisgesdi utsati gvnidv gesv ale dideyodi gesvi.
\syll ᎭᎵᏥᏙᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ, ᏣᎵᏁᏅᏕᏍᏗᏉ ᏰᎵ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏰᎵ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᏕᎯᎬᏍᎪᎸᎥᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᏕᎯᏍᎦᎨᏍᏗ, ᏕᎯᏍᏗᏰᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎲᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏕᏲᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Preach the word; be instant in season, out of season; reprove, rebuke, exhort with all longsuffering and doctrine.

\ln Dvsqualvhiyeno hnaquo nahiyu vtla yunadulisgesdi unadvdasdodiyi osdv dideyodi gesvi; duniyodesgvsgini dinileni anvdisgesdi unvsvquo unadulvnvdi gesv danisdawadisv danitlisisgesdi dinadeyohvsgi;
\syll ᏛᏍᏆᎸᎯᏰᏃ ᎿᏉ ᏀᎢᏳ ᎥᏝ ᏳᎾᏚᎵᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᎾᏛᏓᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏗᏕᏲᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᏚᏂᏲᏕᏍᎬᏍᎩᏂ ᏗᏂᎴᏂ ᎠᏅᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᏅᏒᏉ ᎤᎾᏚᎸᏅᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏓᏂᏍᏓᏩᏗᏒ ᏓᏂᏟᏏᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏗᎾᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ;
\ft For the time will come when they will not endure sound doctrine; but after their own lusts shall they heap to themselves teachers, having itching ears;

\ln Dinilenino danigatahvsgesdi anadvgisgv duyugodvi, asequono gawonihisdi gesv iditlv wanagatahvsdisgesdi.
\syll ᏗᏂᎴᏂᏃ ᏓᏂᎦᏔᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᎾᏛᎩᏍᎬ ᏚᏳᎪᏛᎢ, ᎠᏎᏉᏃ ᎦᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏗᏢ ᏩᎾᎦᏔᎲᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
\ft And they shall turn away their ears from the truth, and shall be turned unto fables.

\ln Nihisgini heyatahiyu gesesdi nigav nitsadvhnadegvi, hvnidiyu gesesdi higiliyogvi, detsalvwisdanehesdi alitsidonidohi tsulvwisdanedi gesvi; yeligaya hisquadisgesdi ditsalvwisdanedi gesvi.
\syll ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎮᏯᏔᎯᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏂᏣᏛᎿᏕᎬᎢ, ᎲᏂᏗᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎯᎩᎵᏲᎬᎢ, ᏕᏣᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᎠᎵᏥᏙᏂᏙᎯ ᏧᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᏰᎵᎦᏯ ᎯᏍᏆᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏗᏣᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft But watch thou in all things, endure afflictions, do the work of an evangelist, make full proof of thy ministry.

\ln Hnaquoyeno gadalisgolvdiha, ale nahiyu aquenvsdi gesv usqualvhidi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏰᏃ ᎦᏓᎵᏍᎪᎸᏗᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᏀᎢᏳ ᎠᏇᏅᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏍᏆᎸᎯᏗ.
\ft For I am now ready to be offered, and the time of my departure is at hand.

\ln Aqualilv osdv alisdi gesvi, agisquadv gadogiyasgvi, agisquanigotanv gohiyudi gesvi,
\syll ᎠᏆᎵᎸ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎠᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎩᏍᏆᏛ ᎦᏙᎩᏯᏍᎬᎢ, ᎠᎩᏍᏆᏂᎪᏔᏅ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ,
\ft I have fought a good fight, I have finished my course, I have kept the faith:

\ln Hnaquono tsvquadanelanelv alisdulo duyugodv iyunadvnelvhi gegaguyvdanedi, nasgi Ugvwiyuhi nasganvna digugodisgi adinvnedi nahiyu iga, vtla ale ayvquo aquvsv, nasquosgini naniv unanugoisdi gesv osiyu oniyelvhi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᏨᏆᏓᏁᎳᏁᎸ ᎠᎵᏍᏚᎶ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᏁᎸᎯ ᎨᎦᎫᏴᏓᏁᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎾᏍᎦᏅᎾ ᏗᎫᎪᏗᏍᎩ ᎠᏗᏅᏁᏗ ᏀᎢᏳ ᎢᎦ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴᏉ ᎠᏋᏒ, ᎾᏍᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎣᏂᏰᎸᎯ.
\ft Henceforth there is laid up for me a crown of righteousness, which the Lord, the righteous judge, shall give me at that day: and not to me only, but unto all them also that love his appearing.

\ln Hatlinigvnelvha nigohilvnaquo tsaluhisdiyi ani gedohvi.
\syll ᎭᏟᏂᎬᏁᎸᎭ ᏂᎪᎯᎸᎾᏉ ᏣᎷᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᏂ ᎨᏙᎲᎢ.
\ft Do thy diligence to come shortly unto me:

\ln Dimayeno aquvdetsv, nvdigalisdodiha utli uyelvnv gohi gesvi, ale Desiloniga wulosv; Tlesini Gelesiyi wulosv, Dadasi Delimesiyi wulosv;
\syll ᏗᎹᏰᏃ ᎠᏋᏕᏨ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎤᏟ ᎤᏰᎸᏅ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᏏᎶᏂᎦ ᏭᎶᏒ; ᏞᏏᏂ ᎨᎴᏏᏱ ᏭᎶᏒ, ᏓᏓᏏ ᏕᎵᎺᏏᏱ ᏭᎶᏒ;
\ft For Demas hath forsaken me, having loved this present world, and is departed unto Thessalonica; Crescens to Galatia, Titus unto Dalmatia.

\ln Luga uwasv osdedoha; Maga tiyadinesvha, gvgisdelvhidasdiyeno dagilvwisdanehvi.
\syll ᎷᎦ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎣᏍᏕᏙᎭ; ᎹᎦ ᏘᏯᏗᏁᏒᎭ, ᎬᎩᏍᏕᎸᎯᏓᏍᏗᏰᏃ ᏓᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎢ.
\ft Only Luke is with me. Take Mark, and bring him with thee: for he is profitable to me for the ministry.

\ln Ditsigasgini Equisa tsinvsv
\syll ᏗᏥᎦᏍᎩᏂ ᎡᏈᏌ ᏥᏅᏒ
\ft And Tychicus have I sent to Ephesus.

\ln Gasalena Tloya tsvdvginiyvgi Gaqua ganelvi tesv tinesvha, ale goweli dotinesvha nasgi ho ugvwiyusesdi ganega digowelodi.
\syll ᎦᏌᎴᎾ ᏠᏯ ᏨᏛᎩᏂᏴᎩ ᎦᏆ ᎦᏁᎸᎢ ᏖᏒ ᏘᏁᏒᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎪᏪᎵ ᏙᏘᏁᏒᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮀ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᏎᏍᏗ ᎦᏁᎦ ᏗᎪᏪᎶᏗ.
\ft The cloke that I left at Troas with Carpus, when thou comest, bring with thee, and the books, but especially the parchments.

\ln Eligi vtsayi gotlvnvvsgi uloti nosvna naquvnelvgi.  Ugvwiyuhi uguyvedi gesesdi nasgiya deulvwisdanelvi.
\syll ᎡᎵᎩ ᎥᏣᏱ ᎪᏢᏅᎥᏍᎩ ᎤᎶᏘ ᏃᏒᎾ ᎾᏋᏁᎸᎩ.  ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᎫᏴᎡᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏕᎤᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸᎢ.
\ft Alexander the coppersmith did me much evil: the Lord reward him according to his works:

\ln Nasquo nihi nasgi hiyeyadotsehesdi, ulinigidiyuyeno utlutanv otsiwonisgvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᏉ ᏂᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᏰᏯᏙᏤᎮᏍᏗ, ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳᏰᏃ ᎤᏡᏔᏅ ᎣᏥᏬᏂᏍᎬᎢ.
\ft Of whom be thou ware also; for he hath greatly withstood our words.

\ln Igvyiyi agiwonisv galisdelisgv vtla gilo nav yigadogei, nanivquosgini gvquadetsvgi; tlesdi unisganvtsv yidudugotanesdi;
\syll ᎢᎬᏱᏱ ᎠᎩᏬᏂᏒ ᎦᎵᏍᏕᎵᏍᎬ ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᎾᎥ ᏱᎦᏙᎨᎢ, ᎾᏂᎥᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎬᏆᏕᏨᎩ; ᏞᏍᏗ ᎤᏂᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᏱᏚᏚᎪᏔᏁᏍᏗ;
\ft At my first answer no man stood with me, but all men forsook me: I pray God that it may not be laid to their charge.

\ln Ugvwiyuhisgininonv nav gadogvgi ale aqualinigohistanvgi; nasgi ayv gesv agisquadisdiyi ayelvsvgi alitsidodi gesvi, ale naniv tsunadalenvdv yvwi unadvhidiyi; ale vgilesvgi tlvdatsi aholi tsilavi.
\syll ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎾᎥ ᎦᏙᎬᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏆᎵᏂᎪᎯᏍᏔᏅᎩ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎩᏍᏆᏗᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᏰᎸᏒᎩ ᎠᎵᏥᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᎤᎾᏛᎯᏗᏱ; ᎠᎴ ᎥᎩᎴᏒᎩ ᏢᏓᏥ ᎠᎰᎵ ᏥᎳᎥᎢ.
\ft Notwithstanding the Lord stood with me, and strengthened me; that by me the preaching might be fully known, and that all the Gentiles might hear: and I was delivered out of the mouth of the lion.

\ln Ale Ugvwiyuhi ase dvquedalesi nigav uyo digalvwisdanedi gesvi; ale dvgisquanigotani galvladi ehi ugvwiyuhi digesv wigalugi.  Nasgi galvquododi gesesdi nigohilv ale nigohilvi, Emenv.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᏎ ᏛᏇᏓᎴᏏ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎤᏲ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᏛᎩᏍᏆᏂᎪᏔᏂ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏗᎨᏒ ᏫᎦᎷᎩ.  ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎸᏉᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎪᎯᎸᎢ, ᎡᎺᏅ.
\ft And the Lord shall deliver me from every evil work, and will preserve me unto his heavenly kingdom: to whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.

\ln Giyolilvha Quisga ale Equila, ale Onesiquola dudatinavi.
\syll ᎩᏲᎵᎸᎭ ᏈᏍᎦ ᎠᎴ ᎡᏈᎳ, ᎠᎴ ᎣᏁᏏᏉᎳ ᏚᏓᏘᎾᎥᎢ.
\ft Salute Prisca and Aquila, and the household of Onesiphorus.

\ln Ilasda Golenidi dayudigiyvgi, Tloquamasgini Malida datsiyakahiyvgi utlvgi.
\syll ᎢᎳᏍᏓ ᎪᎴᏂᏗ ᏓᏳᏗᎩᏴᎩ, ᏠᏆᎹᏍᎩᏂ ᎹᎵᏓ ᏓᏥᏯᎧᎯᏴᎩ ᎤᏢᎩ.
\ft Erastus abode at Corinth: but Trophimus have I left at Miletum sick.

\ln Hatlinigvnelvha ani tsaluhisdiyi asiquo gola nigesvna.  Yuquela witsayoliga, ale nasquo Quedini, ale lanasi, ale Tlodiya, ale naniv analinvtli.
\syll ᎭᏟᏂᎬᏁᎸᎭ ᎠᏂ ᏣᎷᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᏏᏉ ᎪᎳ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.  ᏳᏇᎳ ᏫᏣᏲᎵᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏇᏗᏂ, ᎠᎴ ᎳᎾᏏ, ᎠᎴ ᏠᏗᏯ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏟ.
\ft Do thy diligence to come before winter. Eubulus greeteth thee, and Pudens, and Linus, and Claudia, and all the brethren.

\ln Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv dakahnawadidohesdi wadanvdo.  Udadolisdi gesv detsakahnawadidohesdi.  Emenv.
\syll ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏓᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎮᏍᏗ ᏩᏓᏅᏙ.  ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏕᏣᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎮᏍᏗ.  ᎡᎺᏅ.
\ft The Lord Jesus Christ be with thy spirit. Grace be with you. Amen.

\ln Ayv, Quola, Unelanvhi aginvsidohi, ale Tsisa Galonedv aginvsidv, nasgiya unohiyusv Unelanvhi tsusuyedv, ale [nasgiya] didanilvisdi gesv duyugodv gesvi, nasgi Unelanvhi ganayehisdi gesv nasgiya tsigi,
\syll ᎠᏴ, ᏉᎳ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎩᏅᏏᏙᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎠᎩᏅᏏᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎤᏃᎯᏳᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᏑᏰᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩᏯdata is invalid ᏗᏓᏂᎸᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎦᎾᏰᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏥᎩ,
\ft Paul, a servant of God, and an apostle of Jesus Christ, according to the faith of God's elect, and the acknowledging of the truth which is after godliness;

\ln Tsulitloyasdi udugi gvdi gesv gvnidv alisquadisgi nigesvna awadvdiyi, nasgi Unelanvhi tlewatsigodi nigesvna tsuduistane asi nadalenisgvna tsigese elohi;
\syll ᏧᎵᏠᏯᏍᏗ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎬᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎠᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎠᏩᏛᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏞᏩᏥᎪᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏧᏚᎢᏍᏔᏁ ᎠᏏ ᎾᏓᎴᏂᏍᎬᎾ ᏥᎨᏎ ᎡᎶᎯ;
\ft In hope of eternal life, which God, that cannot lie, promised before the world began;

\ln Aseno nahiyu aselvhi gesv gvnigesv nuwanele utseli kanohedv uwvtane alitsidodi gesvi, nasgi ayv vquagenvdvhi tsigi, nasgiya unetsv Unelanvhi Igisdelisgi;
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᏀᎢᏳ ᎠᏎᎸᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏄᏩᏁᎴ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎤᏮᏔᏁ ᎠᎵᏥᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᎥᏆᎨᏅᏛᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᎩᏍᏕᎵᏍᎩ;
\ft But hath in due times manifested his word through preaching, which is committed unto me according to the commandment of God our Saviour;

\ln Wigvyowelasi, Dadasi, aquetsiyai, nasgiya naniv anohiyuhvsgi unohiyusvi; gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv, ale udadolitsadvi, ale nvwadohiyadv, nvdayunalisgolvtanvhi Unelanvhi Agayvligei, ale Ugvwiyuhi tsisa galonedv Igisdelisgi, detsakahnawadidohesdi.
\syll ᏫᎬᏲᏪᎳᏏ, ᏓᏓᏏ, ᎠᏇᏥᏯᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᎤᏃᎯᏳᏒᎢ; ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏣᏛᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ, ᏅᏓᏳᎾᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏅᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎢᎩᏍᏕᎵᏍᎩ, ᏕᏣᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎮᏍᏗ.
\ft To Titus, mine own son after the common faith: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ our Saviour.

\ln Hia nvdagalisdodisgvgi Tlidiyi tsvdagvyakahiyvgi, nasgi osdv itsvnelidasdiyi nasgi tsudalenvdv unosvnvi, ale tigodiyi digeganelodi degaduwadisvi, nasgiya itsadvnediyi gvnetselvi;
\syll ᎯᎠ ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᏟᏗᏱ ᏨᏓᎬᏯᎧᎯᏴᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎢᏨᏁᎵᏓᏍᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎤᏃᏒᏅᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏘᎪᏗᏱ ᏗᎨᎦᏁᎶᏗ ᏕᎦᏚᏩᏗᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎢᏣᏛᏁᏗᏱ ᎬᏁᏤᎸᎢ;
\ft For this cause left I thee in Crete, that thou shouldest set in order the things that are wanting, and ordain elders in every city, as I had appointed thee:

\ln Iyuno gilo gohusdi naguisdvna gesesdi, saquo adayehesdi, anohiyuhvsgi duwekahesdi tsuwetsi, nigetsilawisehvna nunanelvna unalenidolvi, ale nidunadanelodvna.
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎾᎫᎢᏍᏛᎾ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᏌᏉ ᎠᏓᏰᎮᏍᏗ, ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᏚᏪᎧᎮᏍᏗ ᏧᏪᏥ, ᏂᎨᏥᎳᏫᏎᎲᎾ ᏄᎾᏁᎸᎾ ᎤᎾᎴᏂᏙᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᏚᎾᏓᏁᎶᏛᎾ.
\ft If any be blameless, the husband of one wife, having faithful children not accused of riot or unruly.

\ln Atsigatidisdiyeno gohusdi naguisdvna yigi, nasgiya osdv iyuwahnadegi Unelanvhi utseliga; vtla uwasv adanvtesgv utli uyelvhi, vtla uhnalvtsati, vtla gigageaditasdi uganasisgi, vtla adadvnihi, vtla tsugvwalodi ugvvsgi.
\syll ᎠᏥᎦᏘᏗᏍᏗᏰᏃ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎾᎫᎢᏍᏛᎾ ᏱᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎢᏳᏩᎿᏕᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ; ᎥᏝ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎠᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ ᎤᏟ ᎤᏰᎸᎯ, ᎥᏝ ᎤᎿᎸᏣᏘ, ᎥᏝ ᎩᎦᎨᎠᏗᏔᏍᏗ ᎤᎦᎾᏏᏍᎩ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᏓᏛᏂᎯ, ᎥᏝ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎤᎬᎥᏍᎩ.
\ft For a bishop must be blameless, as the steward of God; not selfwilled, not soon angry, not given to wine, no striker, not given to filthy lucre;

\ln Udasquanigododiyisgini osiyu uyelvhi, osdv gesv ugeyuhi, uyvsdesgi nigesvna, duyugodv iyadvnehi, nasganvna, ulisinasdi;
\syll ᎤᏓᏍᏆᏂᎪᏙᏗᏱᏍᎩᏂ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎤᏰᎸᎯ, ᎣᏍᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎨᏳᎯ, ᎤᏴᏍᏕᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᎯ, ᎾᏍᎦᏅᎾ, ᎤᎵᏏᎾᏍᏗ;
\ft But a lover of hospitality, a lover of good men, sober, just, holy, temperate;

\ln Asdaya tsuniyvhi nudalidasdvna kanohedv nasgiya ageyonvi, nasgi nvdayulisdodiyi yeliquo digvwawonedodi osdv dideyodi gesv gvdisgvi; ale gvwanadohiyunanedi igvwanedi dinigatilegi gesvi.
\syll ᎠᏍᏓᏯ ᏧᏂᏴᎯ ᏄᏓᎵᏓᏍᏛᎾ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎠᎨᏲᏅᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏓᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏰᎵᏉ ᏗᎬᏩᏬᏁᏙᏗ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏗᏕᏲᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏗᏍᎬᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᎾᏙᎯᏳᎾᏁᏗ ᎢᎬᏩᏁᏗ ᏗᏂᎦᏘᎴᎩ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Holding fast the faithful word as he hath been taught, that he may be able by sound doctrine both to exhort and to convince the gainsayers.

\ln Unitsatayeno nidunadanelodvna, asequoquo aniwonisgi, ale unatlonasdi, geugvwiyuha nasgi na digetsiusdeselvhi;
\syll ᎤᏂᏣᏔᏰᏃ ᏂᏚᎾᏓᏁᎶᏛᎾ, ᎠᏎᏉᏉ ᎠᏂᏬᏂᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏠᎾᏍᏗ, ᎨᎤᎬᏫᏳᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏗᎨᏥᎤᏍᏕᏎᎸᎯ;
\ft For there are many unruly and vain talkers and deceivers, specially they of the circumcision:

\ln Nasgi diniholi ase digetsisdunedi, nasgi naniv sidanelvhi anehi dinigatahvsgi, nasgi tsidanadeyohvsga niduyugodvna tsigi tsunadeyodiyi, tsugvwalodi gadaha unigvvsgv iyusdi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏂᎰᎵ ᎠᏎ ᏗᎨᏥᏍᏚᏁᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏏᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᎠᏁᎯ ᏗᏂᎦᏔᎲᏍᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏓᎾᏕᏲᎲᏍᎦ ᏂᏚᏳᎪᏛᎾ ᏥᎩ ᏧᎾᏕᏲᏗᏱ, ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎦᏓᎭ ᎤᏂᎬᎥᏍᎬ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ.
\ft Whose mouths must be stopped, who subvert whole houses, teaching things which they ought not, for filthy lucre's sake.

\ln Gilo iyusdi unvsvquo anehv ehi, adolehosgi unvsvquo unatseliga, hia nuwesei, Tlidiyi anehi aniyegogi geso nigohilvi, uniyo inage anehi, tsusganolv tsunisquoliyi.
\syll ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᏅᏒᏉ ᎠᏁᎲ ᎡᎯ, ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎤᏅᏒᏉ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᏟᏗᏱ ᎠᏁᎯ ᎠᏂᏰᎪᎩ ᎨᏐ ᏂᎪᎯᎸᎢ, ᎤᏂᏲ ᎢᎾᎨ ᎠᏁᎯ, ᏧᏍᎦᏃᎸ ᏧᏂᏍᏉᎵᏱ.
\ft One of themselves, even a prophet of their own, said, The Cretians are always liars, evil beasts, slow bellies.

\ln Hia nasgi igawedv tsigi ugohiyuha.  Nasgi iyusdi asdaya dehigvsgolvnvha, nasgi ugolv nigesvna iyulisdodiyi unohiyusvi;
\syll ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎦᏪᏛ ᏥᎩ ᎤᎪᎯᏳᎭ.  ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏍᏓᏯ ᏕᎯᎬᏍᎪᎸᏅᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎪᎸ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᏃᎯᏳᏒᎢ;
\ft This witness is true. Wherefore rebuke them sharply, that they may be sound in the faith;

\ln Nunagasayasdvnaquo iyulisdodiyi Anitsusi uninohelvdi gesvi, ale yvwiquo nasgi duyugodv gesv dinigolvsgi uninetsvhi.
\syll ᏄᎾᎦᏌᏯᏍᏛᎾᏉ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎤᏂᏃᎮᎸᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏴᏫᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒ ᏗᏂᎪᎸᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᏁᏨᎯ.
\ft Not giving heed to Jewish fables, and commandments of men, that turn from the truth.

\ln Nasgi na unadanvgalvdv gesvi, nigadiyu tsudalenvdv unadanvgalvelvhi gesoi; nasgisgini na gadaha iyunalistanvhi ale nunohiyusvna, vtla gohusdi unadanvgalvelvhi yigesoi; nasquosgini dunadanvdv ale tsunugododiyi gadaha idigvnelvhi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᎦᎸᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᎦᎸᎡᎸᎯ ᎨᏐᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ Ꮎ ᎦᏓᎭ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏄᏃᎯᏳᏒᎾ, ᎥᏝ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᎦᎸᎡᎸᎯ ᏱᎨᏐᎢ; ᎾᏍᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᏚᎾᏓᏅᏛ ᎠᎴ ᏧᏄᎪᏙᏗᏱ ᎦᏓᎭ ᎢᏗᎬᏁᎸᎯ.
\ft Unto the pure all things are pure: but unto them that are defiled and unbelieving is nothing pure; but even their mind and conscience is defiled.

\ln Gvnigesv nanvneha anigatahiyu gesv Unelanvhi; aseno dunilvwisdanehv igvwadayiha, nvdigalisdodiha uniniquatisdiyu gesvi, ale unohiyuhisdv nigesvna gesvi; ale nigav osdv digalvwisdanedi gesv getsisonvistanvhi.
\syll ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎾᏅᏁᎭ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎯᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᏚᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᎢᎬᏩᏓᏱᎭ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎤᏂᏂᏆᏘᏍᏗᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏃᎯᏳᎯᏍᏛ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎨᏥᏐᏅᎢᏍᏔᏅᎯ.
\ft They profess that they know God; but in works they deny him, being abominable, and disobedient, and unto every good work reprobate.

\ln Nihisgini hinohesgesdi nasgi osdv dideyodi gesv ulilohvsgi;
\syll ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎯᏃᎮᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏗᏕᏲᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎵᎶᎲᏍᎩ;
\ft But speak thou the things which become sound doctrine:

\ln Nasgi tsunadvsonvhi tsuniyvsdesgi nigesvna iyunalisdodiyi, getsilvquodi, unalisinahisdi, nugolvna gesv unohiyusvi, ale unadageyusvi, ale dinvnidiyu gesvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᎾᏛᏐᏅᎯ ᏧᏂᏴᏍᏕᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎨᏥᎸᏉᏗ, ᎤᎾᎵᏏᏀᎢᏍᏗ, ᏄᎪᎸᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏃᎯᏳᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏓᎨᏳᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏅᏂᏗᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft That the aged men be sober, grave, temperate, sound in faith, in charity, in patience.

\ln Anigeyv nasquo anigayvligei, nasgi dunilvwisdanehv duyugodv iyadvnedi gesv ulilohvsgi yigi, usonv anadanohesgi nigesvna, gigageaditasdi uniganasisgi nigesvna, osdv gesv dinadeyohvsgi;
\syll ᎠᏂᎨᏴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏂᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎵᎶᎲᏍᎩ ᏱᎩ, ᎤᏐᏅ ᎠᎾᏓᏃᎮᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎩᎦᎨᎠᏗᏔᏍᏗ ᎤᏂᎦᎾᏏᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎣᏍᏛ ᎨᏒ ᏗᎾᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ;
\ft The aged women likewise, that they be in behaviour as becometh holiness, not false accusers, not given to much wine, teachers of good things;

\ln Nasgi digvwaneyodi yigi aniwinagesani anigeyv unalisinahisdi iyulisdodiyi, tsunigeyuhi iyulisdodiyi digvwaniyehi, tsunigeyuhi iyulisdodiyi tsunetsi,
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎬᏩᏁᏲᏗ ᏱᎩ ᎠᏂᏫᎾᎨᏌᏂ ᎠᏂᎨᏴ ᎤᎾᎵᏏᏀᎢᏍᏗ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᏧᏂᎨᏳᎯ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏗᎬᏩᏂᏰᎯ, ᏧᏂᎨᏳᎯ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏧᏁᏥ,
\ft That they may teach the young women to be sober, to love their husbands, to love their children,

\ln Unalisinahisdi iyunalisdodiyi, aneyatahi, dunenvsvquo anedohi, anosdv, tsunohiyuhi unvsv digvwaniyehi, nasgi nvdayulisdodiyi kanohedv Unelanvhi utseli gagvwanisotlvdodiyi nigesvna.
\syll ᎤᎾᎵᏏᏀᎢᏍᏗ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎠᏁᏯᏔᎯ, ᏚᏁᏅᏒᏉ ᎠᏁᏙᎯ, ᎠᏃᏍᏛ, ᏧᏃᎯᏳᎯ ᎤᏅᏒ ᏗᎬᏩᏂᏰᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏓᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎦᎬᏩᏂᏐᏢᏙᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.
\ft To be discreet, chaste, keepers at home, good, obedient to their own husbands, that the word of God be not blasphemed.

\ln Aniwinv nasquo dehinetsehesdi unalisinahisdi iyunalisdodiyi.
\syll ᎠᏂᏫᏅ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏕᎯᏁᏤᎮᏍᏗ ᎤᎾᎵᏏᏀᎢᏍᏗ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
\ft Young men likewise exhort to be sober minded.

\ln Nigav tsudalenvdv gesv gvnigesv nvnehesdi digayetsatlilosdodi gesv osdv digalvwisdanedi gesvi; didenidi gesv ugvwali uyo nudasuyvna, gvlvquodiyu, nutlonasdvna,
\syll ᏂᎦᎥ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏅᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᏗᎦᏰᏣᏟᎶᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᏗᏕᏂᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᎤᏲ ᏄᏓᏑᏴᎾ, ᎬᎸᏉᏗᏳ, ᏄᏠᎾᏍᏛᎾ,
\ft In all things shewing thyself a pattern of good works: in doctrine shewing uncorruptness, gravity, sincerity,

\ln Hiwonisgv osdv yigi nasgi gvgonelohisdi nigesvna; nasgi na tsatludisgi gvwadehohisdi yigi nuhvnv gesv iyusdi gohusdi usonv lonohediyi.
\syll ᎯᏬᏂᏍᎬ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏱᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᎪᏁᎶᎯᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ; ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏣᏡᏗᏍᎩ ᎬᏩᏕᎰᎯᏍᏗ ᏱᎩ ᏄᎲᏅ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏐᏅ ᎶᏃᎮᏗᏱ.
\ft Sound speech, that cannot be condemned; that he that is of the contrary part may be ashamed, having no evil thing to say of you.

\ln Getsinvsidasdi dehinetsehesdi tsunohiyudiyi unvsv digvwaninvsidohi, nigavquo nanadvnehv osdv uniyelvdi tsunilvwisdanediyi; talinequo nvdininegvna.
\syll ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᏕᎯᏁᏤᎮᏍᏗ ᏧᏃᎯᏳᏗᏱ ᎤᏅᏒ ᏗᎬᏩᏂᏅᏏᏙᎯ, ᏂᎦᎥᏉ ᎾᎾᏛᏁᎲ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎤᏂᏰᎸᏗ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ; ᏔᎵᏁᏉ ᏅᏗᏂᏁᎬᎾ.
\ft Exhort servants to be obedient unto their own masters, and to please them well in all things; not answering again;

\ln Naninosgisgvna, gvnigesvsgini nanvnehesdi nigav osdv nudalidasdvna gesvi; nasgi unoduisdodiyi nigavquo nanadvnehv nasgi dideyonvhi gesv Unelanvhi Igisdelisgi utseliga.
\syll ᎾᏂᏃᏍᎩᏍᎬᎾ, ᎬᏂᎨᏒᏍᎩᏂ ᎾᏅᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏄᏓᎵᏓᏍᏛᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏃᏚᎢᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏂᎦᎥᏉ ᎾᎾᏛᏁᎲ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏕᏲᏅᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᎩᏍᏕᎵᏍᎩ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ.
\ft Not purloining, but shewing all good fidelity; that they may adorn the doctrine of God our Saviour in all things.

\ln Gvwagatiyayeno udadolisdi gesv Unelanvhi nasgi adasdelisgi naniv yvwi uninanugotselv,
\syll ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯᏰᏃ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏓᏍᏕᎵᏍᎩ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏂᎾᏄᎪᏤᎸ,
\ft For the grace of God that bringeth salvation hath appeared to all men,

\ln Igeyohvsga, nasgi idadayihv Unelanvhi dinelododi nigesvna gesvi ale elohi ehi adulvnvdi gesvi, igalisinahisdi ale duyugodvi, ale Unelanvhi galvquododi gesv yidalenidoha ani elohi gesvi;
\syll ᎢᎨᏲᎲᏍᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏓᏓᏱᎲ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏗᏁᎶᏙᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎡᎯ ᎠᏚᎸᏅᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎢᎦᎵᏏᏀᎢᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏚᏳᎪᏛᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎦᎸᏉᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏱᏓᎴᏂᏙᎭ ᎠᏂ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ;
\ft Teaching us that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we should live soberly, righteously, and godly, in this present world;

\ln Yidigatiya osdv udugi gvdi gesvi, nasgi galvquodiyu nudvnesdi gananugotsilv galvquodi Unelanvhi ale Igisdelisgi Tsisa Galonedv;
\syll ᏱᏗᎦᏘᏯ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎬᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᏄᏛᏁᏍᏗ ᎦᎾᏄᎪᏥᎸ ᎦᎸᏉᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎢᎩᏍᏕᎵᏍᎩ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ;
\ft Looking for that blessed hope, and the glorious appearing of the great God and our Saviour Jesus Christ;

\ln Nasgi ayv tsidegadaliyohiselei, nasgi nvdayulisdodiyi igaguyvdiyi igudalesdiyi nigav asganvisdi gesvi, ale tsunvgalvdiyi uwasv tsutseli itsuwanediyi unadatselidv yvwi, ulinigidv unadanvti osdv tsunilvwisdanediyi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᏥᏕᎦᏓᎵᏲᎯᏎᎴᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏓᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎢᎦᎫᏴᏗᏱ ᎢᎫᏓᎴᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎠᏍᎦᏅᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏅᎦᎸᏗᏱ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏧᏤᎵ ᎢᏧᏩᏁᏗᏱ ᎤᎾᏓᏤᎵᏛ ᏴᏫ, ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ.
\ft Who gave himself for us, that he might redeem us from all iniquity, and purify unto himself a peculiar people, zealous of good works.

\ln Nasgi hia nusdesdi hinohesgesdi, ale dehiwonedisgesdi, ale dehigvsgolvvsgesdi hvdisgesdi nigav tsasvgalvi.  Hvdisgesdi Tlesdi gilo esga yitsayelvsesdi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᎯᏃᎮᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᎯᏬᏁᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᎯᎬᏍᎪᎸᎥᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎲᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏣᏒᎦᎸᎢ.  ᎲᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎩᎶ ᎡᏍᎦ ᏱᏣᏰᎸᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft These things speak, and exhort, and rebuke with all authority. Let no man despise thee.

\ln Dehanvdadisdisgesdi tsunohiyudi gesv nunigvwiyusadegi ale digeganelodi gesvi, unohiyuhisdv iyulisdodi gesvi, nigohilvquo unadvnvisdi iyulisdodi gesv nigavquo osdv tsunilvwisdanediyi.
\syll ᏕᎭᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏧᏃᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎨᎦᏁᎶᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᏃᎯᏳᎯᏍᏛ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏂᎪᎯᎸᏉ ᎤᎾᏛᏅᎢᏍᏗ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏂᎦᎥᏉ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ.
\ft Put them in mind to be subject to principalities and powers, to obey magistrates, to be ready to every good work,

\ln Gilo usonv uninohediyi nigesvna, tsunatiyosati nigesvna iyunalisdodiyi, unadanvtisgini iyunalisdodiyi, gvnigesv iyunvnediyi nanivquo anigatahv utsati unadanvtiyu gesvi.
\syll ᎩᎶ ᎤᏐᏅ ᎤᏂᏃᎮᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᏧᎾᏘᏲᏌᏘ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏅᏁᏗᏱ ᎾᏂᎥᏉ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎲ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft To speak evil of no man, to be no brawlers, but gentle, shewing all meekness unto all men.

\ln Igvsvyeno nasquo ilvhiyu tsigesv iginegu gesvgi, nigohiyusvna, igilidastanvhi, gohusdi dedadvnehvgi tsudalenvdv adulvnvdi gesv ale osdv adadanvdadisdisgi gesvi, uyo gesv ale advyugedi idehvgi, iginiquatisdi, ale didadaniquatihi gesvgi.
\syll ᎢᎬᏒᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᏥᎨᏒ ᎢᎩᏁᎫ ᎨᏒᎩ, ᏂᎪᎯᏳᏒᎾ, ᎢᎩᎵᏓᏍᏔᏅᎯ, ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏕᏓᏛᏁᎲᎩ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎠᏚᎸᏅᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎠᏓᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᏲ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏛᏳᎨᏗ ᎢᏕᎲᎩ, ᎢᎩᏂᏆᏘᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏓᏓᏂᏆᏘᎯ ᎨᏒᎩ.
\ft For we ourselves also were sometimes foolish, disobedient, deceived, serving divers lusts and pleasures, living in malice and envy, hateful, and hating one another.

\ln Aseno hnaquo Unelanvhi Igisdelisgi udanvtiyu gesv ale yvwi dugeyusv uganugotsv,
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎿᏉ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᎩᏍᏕᎵᏍᎩ ᎤᏓᏅᏘᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏴᏫ ᏚᎨᏳᏒ ᎤᎦᏄᎪᏨ,
\ft But after that the kindness and love of God our Saviour toward man appeared,

\ln Vtla duyugodv digalvwisdanedi gesv gvdi ayv nasgi degilvwisdanelvi, nasgiyasgini udadolitsatiyu gesv igisdelvhvgi uwvtanvgi taline adedi gesv ugvwali adosulediyi, ale Galvquodiyu Adanvdo udanetliyvsdi gesvi;
\syll ᎥᏝ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏗ ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏕᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏣᏘᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎢᎩᏍᏕᎸᎲᎩ ᎤᏮᏔᏅᎩ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎠᏕᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᎠᏙᏑᎴᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᏓᏁᏟᏴᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ;
\ft Not by works of righteousness which we have done, but according to his mercy he saved us, by the washing of regeneration, and renewing of the Holy Ghost;

\ln Nasgi utsuquisdi tsigisonvyeli, Tsisa Galonedv Igisdelisgi iyuwanisadv;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏧᏈᏍᏗ ᏥᎩᏐᏅᏰᎵ, ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎢᎩᏍᏕᎵᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ;
\ft Which he shed on us abundantly through Jesus Christ our Saviour;

\ln Nasgi gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv digadudalestanvhi gesvi, nasgi nasgiya ulisquadisdi nigesvna gvnidv igatseli iyulisdodiyi nasgiya udugi igvsvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏗᎦᏚᏓᎴᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎢᎬᏒᎢ.
\ft That being justified by his grace, we should be made heirs according to the hope of eternal life.

\ln Udohiyuhiya igawedv; ale nasgi hia tsudalenvdv aquaduliha tsasdayidisdiyi, nasgi na Unelanvhi unohiyunvhi unagasayasdodiyi nigohilvquo osdv tsunilvwisdanediyi.  Hia nasgi osiyu ale gvwanalisdelvdodi yvwi.
\syll ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎢᎦᏪᏛ; ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎠᏆᏚᎵᎭ ᏣᏍᏓᏱᏗᏍᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏃᎯᏳᏅᎯ ᎤᎾᎦᏌᏯᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏂᎪᎯᎸᏉ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ.  ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᎾᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ ᏴᏫ.
\ft This is a faithful saying, and these things I will that thou affirm constantly, that they which have believed in God might be careful to maintain good works. These things are good and profitable unto men.

\ln Ulisganisdvsgini kanohelvdi gesv ale unadanetliyvsvsvi, ale ditiyosdi gesvi, ale adisvsdi gesv dikahnawadvsdi ugvwali dehadanvsvhesdi, gvwanadasdelvdiyeno nigesvna ale asequoquo nasgi.
\syll ᎤᎵᏍᎦᏂᏍᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᎧᏃᎮᎸᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏓᏁᏟᏴᏒᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏘᏲᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏗᏒᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᏕᎭᏓᏅᏒᎮᏍᏗ, ᎬᏩᎾᏓᏍᏕᎸᏗᏰᏃ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏎᏉᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ.
\ft But avoid foolish questions, and genealogies, and contentions, and strivings about the law; for they are unprofitable and vain.

\ln Gilo digalenvdisgi saquo ale tali iyageyatanvhi gesesdi etsiyoiselvha;
\syll ᎩᎶ ᏗᎦᎴᏅᏗᏍᎩ ᏌᏉ ᎠᎴ ᏔᎵ ᎢᏯᎨᏯᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎡᏥᏲᎢᏎᎸᎭ;
\ft A man that is an heretick after the first and second admonition reject;

\ln Itsigatahesdi nasgi na yinusdi gilo ugolvdv gesvi, ale usganvtsvi, uwasvquo dadadugodanehvi.
\syll ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎮᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏱᏄᏍᏗ ᎩᎶ ᎤᎪᎸᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏍᎦᏅᏨᎢ, ᎤᏩᏒᏉ ᏓᏓᏚᎪᏓᏁᎲᎢ.
\ft Knowing that he that is such is subverted, and sinneth, being condemned of himself.

\ln Iyuno Atima tsinvsvha witsalutsediyi, ale Digiga, hatlinigvnelvha Nagoquali sgilutsediyi; nahnayeno daquegotanv aquagoladiyvdiyi.
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᎠᏘᎹ ᏥᏅᏒᎭ ᏫᏣᎷᏤᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎩᎦ, ᎭᏟᏂᎬᏁᎸᎭ ᎾᎪᏆᎵ ᏍᎩᎷᏤᏗᏱ; ᏀᎾᏰᏃ ᏓᏇᎪᏔᏅ ᎠᏆᎪᎳᏗᏴᏗᏱ.
\ft When I shall send Artemas unto thee, or Tychicus, be diligent to come unto me to Nicopolis: for I have determined there to winter.

\ln Tsina dikahnawadvsdi digosisisgi ale Aquola hatlinigvnelvha Gisdelvdiyi anaisvi, nasgi gohusdi nuninigvsehvna iyulisdodiyi.
\syll ᏥᎾ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏗᎪᏏᏏᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏉᎳ ᎭᏟᏂᎬᏁᎸᎭ ᎩᏍᏕᎸᏗᏱ ᎠᎾᎢᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏄᏂᏂᎬᏎᎲᎾ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
\ft Bring Zenas the lawyer and Apollos on their journey diligently, that nothing be wanting unto them.

\ln Ale nasquo digatseliga wanadeloqua nigohilv osdv tsunilvwisdanediyi nasgi udulvdi nigalisdisgv gohusdi gvtanidasdi, nasgi aninequosgi iyunalisdodiyi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏗᎦᏤᎵᎦ ᏩᎾᏕᎶᏆ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏚᎸᏗ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎬᏔᏂᏓᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏂᏁᏉᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
\ft And let ours also learn to maintain good works for necessary uses, that they be not unfruitful.

\ln Nigadv ani nogadvnvi wigetsayoliga.  Dehiyolilvha nasgi na gegigeyuhi gohiyudi gesv nvdigalisdodisgvi.  Gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv itseladidohesdi nitsivi.  Emenv.
\syll ᏂᎦᏛ ᎠᏂ ᏃᎦᏛᏅᎢ ᏫᎨᏣᏲᎵᎦ.  ᏕᎯᏲᎵᎸᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎨᎩᎨᏳᎯ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬᎢ.  ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏤᎳᏗᏙᎮᏍᏗ ᏂᏥᎥᎢ.  ᎡᎺᏅ.
\ft All that are with me salute thee. Greet them that love us in the faith. Grace be with you all. Amen.

\ln Ayv, Quola, tsiyvgi Tsisa Galonedv agisdvdisgvi, ale Dimadi iginvtli, wisdvyowelasi Qualimani utsati isdvgeyui, ale utloyi digilvwisdanehi,
\syll ᎠᏴ, ᏉᎳ, ᏥᏴᎩ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎠᎩᏍᏛᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎹᏗ ᎢᎩᏅᏟ, ᏫᏍᏛᏲᏪᎳᏏ ᏆᎵᎹᏂ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎢᏍᏛᎨᏳᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏠᏱ ᏗᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ,
\ft Paul, a prisoner of Jesus Christ, and Timothy our brother, unto Philemon our dearly beloved, and fellowlabourer,

\ln Ale isdvgeyui Aquiya, ale Agiqua, itsulaha idiwawisgi, ale tsunanelodiunadaquigv hinelvi;
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎢᏍᏛᎨᏳᎢ ᎠᏈᏯ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎩᏆ, ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎢᏗᏩᏫᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗᎤᎾᏓᏈᎬ ᎯᏁᎸᎢ;
\ft And to our beloved Apphia, and Archippus our fellowsoldier, and to the church in thy house:

\ln Gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv ale nvwadohiyadv detsikahnawadidohesdi nvdayunalisgolvtanvhi Unelanvhi Igidoda ale Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv.
\syll ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᏕᏥᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎮᏍᏗ ᏅᏓᏳᎾᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏅᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᎩᏙᏓ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ.
\ft Grace to you, and peace, from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

\ln Tsiyalielitseho Aquanelanvhi gvneisdisgo nigohilv gadadolisdisgvi,
\syll ᏥᏯᎵᎡᎵᏤᎰ ᎠᏆᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎬᏁᎢᏍᏗᏍᎪ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎦᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ,
\ft I thank my God, making mention of thee always in my prayers,

\ln Gadvgisgv tsadageyusv ale tsohiyusvi, nasgi tsigeyuha Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa, ale naniv unadanvti tsidehigeyuha;
\syll ᎦᏛᎩᏍᎬ ᏣᏓᎨᏳᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏦᎯᏳᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᎨᏳᎭ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ ᏥᏕᎯᎨᏳᎭ;
\ft Hearing of thy love and faith, which thou hast toward the Lord Jesus, and toward all saints;

\ln Nasgi na tsohiyusv tseladisdisgvi nasgi yinigvnisv gvnigesv yinigalisda nigav osdv gesv itsiyavi Tsisa Galonedv nvdigalisdodisgvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏦᎯᏳᏒ ᏤᎳᏗᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᏂᎬᏂᏒ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏱᏂᎦᎵᏍᏓ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏥᏯᎥᎢ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬᎢ.
\ft That the communication of thy faith may become effectual by the acknowledging of every good thing which is in you in Christ Jesus.

\ln Utsatiyeno ulihelisdi ogeha ale ugalisdi adanvdadisdi gesv tsadageyusv iyusdi, dvdigalisdodiha unadanvti tsuninawi dehigalisdadehvi, vginvtli.
\syll ᎤᏣᏘᏰᏃ ᎤᎵᎮᎵᏍᏗ ᎣᎨᎭ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎦᎵᏍᏗ ᎠᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏣᏓᎨᏳᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᏛᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ ᏧᏂᎾᏫ ᏕᎯᎦᎵᏍᏓᏕᎲᎢ, ᎥᎩᏅᏟ.
\ft For we have great joy and consolation in thy love, because the bowels of the saints are refreshed by thee, brother.

\ln Udohiyuhisgininonv utsati agiha Galonedv aginelvi, nasgi gvnetsehv tsiduyugodi itsadvnediyi;
\syll ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎠᎩᎭ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎠᎩᏁᎸᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏁᏤᎲ ᏥᏚᏳᎪᏗ ᎢᏣᏛᏁᏗᏱ;
\ft Wherefore, though I might be much bold in Christ to enjoin thee that which is convenient,

\ln Aseno sgigeyuhiyu gesv nvdigalisdodiha utli tsiyelvsga gvsdiyedodiyi, Quola udvsonvhi iyaquasdi tsigi, ale gohi gesv ayvgi, Tsisa Galonedv agisdvdisgvi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᏍᎩᎨᏳᎯᏳ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎤᏟ ᏥᏰᎸᏍᎦ ᎬᏍᏗᏰᏙᏗᏱ, ᏉᎳ ᎤᏛᏐᏅᎯ ᎢᏯᏆᏍᏗ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏴᎩ, ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎠᎩᏍᏛᏗᏍᎬᎢ.
\ft Yet for love's sake I rather beseech thee, being such an one as Paul the aged, and now also a prisoner of Jesus Christ.

\ln Gvsdiyediha aquetsi Onisima ugvwali nasgi vqualvidv gesv aquadenelvhi tsigi.
\syll ᎬᏍᏗᏰᏗᎭ ᎠᏇᏥ ᎣᏂᏏᎹ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎥᏆᎸᎢᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏆᏕᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ.
\ft I beseech thee for my son Onesimus, whom I have begotten in my bonds:

\ln Nasgi tsuwagutanvsv nitsasdelisgvna tsigesvgi, gohisgini tsigi tsasdelisgi, ale ayv agisdelisgi;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏩᎫᏔᏅᏒ ᏂᏣᏍᏕᎵᏍᎬᎾ ᏥᎨᏒᎩ, ᎪᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᏥᎩ ᏣᏍᏕᎵᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴ ᎠᎩᏍᏕᎵᏍᎩ;
\ft Which in time past was to thee unprofitable, but now profitable to thee and to me:

\ln Nasgi taline vtsinvli; nasgi iyusdi nihi dehiyadanilvtsvha, nasgi aquvsv aginawi tsigi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎥᏥᏅᎵ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏂᎯ ᏕᎯᏯᏓᏂᎸᏨᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏋᏒ ᎠᎩᎾᏫ ᏥᎩ.
\ft Whom I have sent again: thou therefore receive him, that is, mine own bowels:

\ln Nasgi aquadulisgvgi tsiyakahiyasdiyi ani gedohvi, nasgi nihi sgisdelvhidasdi gesv agisdelvhidasdiyi vqualvidv gesv osdv kanohedv agisdvdisgvi;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏆᏚᎵᏍᎬᎩ ᏥᏯᎧᎯᏯᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᏂ ᎨᏙᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎯ ᏍᎩᏍᏕᎸᎯᏓᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎩᏍᏕᎸᎯᏓᏍᏗᏱ ᎥᏆᎸᎢᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎠᎩᏍᏛᏗᏍᎬᎢ;
\ft Whom I would have retained with me, that in thy stead he might have ministered unto me in the bonds of the gospel:

\ln Aseno nihi osiyu nitsayelvnvna vtla yaquadulvhe gohusdi aquadvnediyi; nasgi osdv nisquadvnehv osiyu tsayelvnv gvnigesv iyulisdodiyi, vtlano nasgi ase itsadvnediyi nitsalisdanehvi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᏂᎯ ᎣᏏᏳ ᏂᏣᏰᎸᏅᎾ ᎥᏝ ᏯᏆᏚᎸᎮ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎠᏆᏛᏁᏗᏱ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏂᏍᏆᏛᏁᎲ ᎣᏏᏳ ᏣᏰᎸᏅ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎥᏝᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏎ ᎢᏣᏛᏁᏗᏱ ᏂᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᎲᎢ.
\ft But without thy mind would I do nothing; that thy benefit should not be as it were of necessity, but willingly.

\ln Nasgiyeno iyusdi yigi tlega yudanvsv nasgi tiyadanilvisdi nigohilv udediyi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏱᎩ ᏞᎦ ᏳᏓᏅᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏘᏯᏓᏂᎸᎢᏍᏗ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎤᏕᏗᏱ.
\ft For perhaps he therefore departed for a season, that thou shouldest receive him for ever;

\ln Vtla hnaquo atsinvsidasdi nasgiyai, utlisgini galvquodiyu esgaquo atsinvsidasdi, onvtli ageyuhi nasgiyai, ayv ho ugvwiyuha tsigeyui, nihisgini nigav utlihiyu higeyui, nasgi na uquedali gesv ale Ugvwiyuhi desdanelodvi?
\syll ᎥᏝ ᎿᏉ ᎠᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ, ᎤᏟᏍᎩᏂ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎠᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ, ᎣᏅᏟ ᎠᎨᏳᎯ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ, ᎠᏴ Ꮀ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎭ ᏥᎨᏳᎢ, ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎤᏟᎯᏳ ᎯᎨᏳᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏕᏍᏓᏁᎶᏛᎢ?
\ft Not now as a servant, but above a servant, a brother beloved, specially to me, but how much more unto thee, both in the flesh, and in the Lord?

\ln Nasgi iyusdi iyuno oginatequolohi squelisehesdi, dehiyadanilvtsvha ayv tsidesquadanilvgo nasgiyai.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏳᏃ ᎣᎩᎾᏖᏉᎶᎯ ᏍᏇᎵᏎᎮᏍᏗ, ᏕᎯᏯᏓᏂᎸᏨᎭ ᎠᏴ ᏥᏕᏍᏆᏓᏂᎸᎪ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ.
\ft If thou count me therefore a partner, receive him as myself.

\ln Iyuno utsatini nitsadvnelesdi, ale hidugesde, ayvquo aquaguyvdi nvnelvha;
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᎤᏣᏘᏂ ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎴᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᏚᎨᏍᏕ, ᎠᏴᏉ ᎠᏆᎫᏴᏗ ᏅᏁᎸᎭ;
\ft If he hath wronged thee, or oweth thee ought, put that on mine account;

\ln Ayv Quola aquvsv aquoyeno gvda gowelvga, ayv dagaguyvhi; vtlasgininonv tsvsv gesv nasquo gvduga disquadayohisediyi yigvyoseha.
\syll ᎠᏴ ᏉᎳ ᎠᏋᏒ ᎠᏉᏰᏃ ᎬᏓ ᎪᏪᎸᎦ, ᎠᏴ ᏓᎦᎫᏴᎯ; ᎥᏝᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᏨᏒ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎬᏚᎦ ᏗᏍᏆᏓᏲᎯᏎᏗᏱ ᏱᎬᏲᏎᎭ.
\ft I Paul have written it with mine own hand, I will repay it: albeit I do not say to thee how thou owest unto me even thine own self besides.

\ln Vv, dinadanvtli, ulihesdi squadanvdadisda Ugvwiyuhi iyuwanisadv; higalisdadaquo aginawi Ugvwiyuhi denanelodvi.
\syll ᎥᎥ, ᏗᎾᏓᏅᏟ, ᎤᎵᎮᏍᏗ ᏍᏆᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏓ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ; ᎯᎦᎵᏍᏓᏓᏉ ᎠᎩᎾᏫ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏕᎾᏁᎶᏛᎢ.
\ft Yea, brother, let me have joy of thee in the Lord: refresh my bowels in the Lord.

\ln Tsohiyusv aqualisgasdodv wigvyowelanelvgi, tsigatahvgi nasquo tsalosvsdodiyi gesv hnadvnehv nusdv gvnetsehvi.
\syll ᏦᎯᏳᏒ ᎠᏆᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏛ ᏫᎬᏲᏪᎳᏁᎸᎩ, ᏥᎦᏔᎲᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏣᎶᏒᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎨᏒ ᎿᏛᏁᎲ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎬᏁᏤᎲᎢ.
\ft Having confidence in thy obedience I wrote unto thee, knowing that thou wilt also do more than I say.

\ln Ale nasquo squadvnvisdanelvha sgisquanigododiyi; udugiyeno aquvha itsadadolisdisgv iyuwanisodiyi taline witsvlutsediyi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏍᏆᏛᏅᎢᏍᏓᏁᎸᎭ ᏍᎩᏍᏆᏂᎪᏙᏗᏱ; ᎤᏚᎩᏰᏃ ᎠᏋᎭ ᎢᏣᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏐᏗᏱ ᏔᎵᏁ ᏫᏨᎷᏤᏗᏱ.
\ft But withal prepare me also a lodging: for I trust that through your prayers I shall be given unto you.

\ln Wigetsayoliga Egaquo, ditsulaha osdiyvgi Galonedv Tsisa oginisdvdisgvi;
\syll ᏫᎨᏣᏲᎵᎦ ᎡᎦᏉ, ᏗᏧᎳᎭ ᎣᏍᏗᏴᎩ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏥᏌ ᎣᎩᏂᏍᏛᏗᏍᎬᎢ;
\ft There salute thee Epaphras, my fellowprisoner in Christ Jesus;

\ln Maga, Elisdaga, Dima, Luga, itsulaha tsogilvwisdanehi
\syll ᎹᎦ, ᎡᎵᏍᏓᎦ, ᏗᎹ, ᎷᎦ, ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᏦᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ
\ft Marcus, Aristarchus, Demas, Lucas, my fellowlabourers.

\ln Gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv igatseli Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonesi tali udvdegesdi detsadanvdvi.  Emenv
\syll ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏏ ᏔᎵ ᎤᏛᏕᎨᏍᏗ ᏕᏣᏓᏅᏛᎢ.  ᎡᎺᏅ
\ft The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen.

\ln Unelanvhi, nasgi ilvhiyu tsigesv, iyvdvhaquo ale tsudalenvdv gvtanvhi tsidekanetsehe digigayvlige anadolehosgi degvdisgvi,
\syll ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᏥᎨᏒ, ᎢᏴᏛᎭᏉ ᎠᎴ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎬᏔᏅᎯ ᏥᏕᎧᏁᏤᎮ ᏗᎩᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᏕᎬᏗᏍᎬᎢ,
\ft God, who at sundry times and in divers manners spake in time past unto the fathers by the prophets,

\ln Gohi ulisqualvdi degesadisv iginetselv Uwetsi uwvtanv, nasgi uwekanv utseli iyulisdodiyi nigadiyu tsudalenvdv, nasgi nasquo gvdisgv elohi duwotlvnei;
\syll ᎪᎯ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᎸᏗ ᏕᎨᏌᏗᏒ ᎢᎩᏁᏤᎸ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎤᏮᏔᏅ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏪᎧᏅ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎬᏗᏍᎬ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏚᏬᏢᏁᎢ;
\ft Hath in these last days spoken unto us by his Son, whom he hath appointed heir of all things, by whom also he made the worlds;

\ln Nasgi digalvsadadisgi tsigesvgi utseli galvquodiyu gesvi, ale nasgiya ditlilostanvhi tsigesvgi nasgi nusdvi, ale nigadiyu tsudalenvdv tsidusquanigodidegvgi tsigvdisgvgi ulinigidiyu kanegvi, nahiyu uwasv udadvtanv unvgalvha igisganvtsvi, uwenei agatisiditlv Galvquodiyu gesv galvladi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎦᎸᏌᏓᏗᏍᎩ ᏥᎨᏒᎩ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏗᏟᎶᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᏥᎨᏒᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏛᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏥᏚᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗᏕᎬᎩ ᏥᎬᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ ᎧᏁᎬᎢ, ᏀᎢᏳ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎤᏓᏛᏔᏅ ᎤᏅᎦᎸᎭ ᎢᎩᏍᎦᏅᏨᎢ, ᎤᏪᏁᎢ ᎠᎦᏘᏏᏗᏢ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ.
\ft Who being the brightness of his glory, and the express image of his person, and upholding all things by the word of his power, when he had by himself purged our sins, sat down on the right hand of the Majesty on high;

\ln Nasgi igai utli iyudalinehiyadv nagvnele esga dinikahnawadidohi, nasgi utiyasdanedi gesv utli igalvquodi tsudosdodi tsuwadvtanv.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎤᏟ ᎢᏳᏓᎵᏁᎯᏯᏛ ᎾᎬᏁᎴ ᎡᏍᎦ ᏗᏂᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏘᏯᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏟ ᎢᎦᎸᏉᏗ ᏧᏙᏍᏙᏗ ᏧᏩᏛᏔᏅ.
\ft Being made so much better than the angels, as he hath by inheritance obtained a more excellent name than they.

\ln Dinikahnawadohiyeno gesv gago ilvhiyu hia nuweseloi, Aquetsi nihi gohi iga squadehvsi?  Ale nasquo hia; ayv Tsigayvlige gesesdi, nasgino na Ayatsi gesesdi?
\syll ᏗᏂᎧᎿᏩᏙᎯᏰᏃ ᎨᏒ ᎦᎪ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎶᎢ, ᎠᏇᏥ ᏂᎯ ᎪᎯ ᎢᎦ ᏍᏆᏕᎲᏏ?  ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎯᎠ; ᎠᏴ ᏥᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ Ꮎ ᎠᏯᏥ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ?
\ft For unto which of the angels said he at any time, Thou art my Son, this day have I begotten thee? And again, I will be to him a Father, and he shall be to me a Son?

\ln Ale nasquo, nahiyu igvyi udenelvhi elohi unanugowisv hia nuwesei; Ale naniv dinikahnawadidohi unelanvhi tsutseli wigvwadadolisdasi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ, ᏀᎢᏳ ᎢᎬᏱ ᎤᏕᏁᎸᎯ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏫᏒ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏗᏂᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᏤᎵ ᏫᎬᏩᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏏ.
\ft And again, when he bringeth in the firstbegotten into the world, he saith, And let all the angels of God worship him.

\ln Dinikahnawadidohino hia nidegaweseha, Nasgi dinikahnawadidohi tsutseli unole tsinidegvneha, ale atsilv adawelagisgi tsunvsidasdi tsinigvneha.
\syll ᏗᏂᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎯᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏕᎦᏪᏎᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏂᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏧᏤᎵ ᎤᏃᎴ ᏥᏂᏕᎬᏁᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏥᎸ ᎠᏓᏪᎳᎩᏍᎩ ᏧᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᏥᏂᎬᏁᎭ.
\ft And of the angels he saith, Who maketh his angels spirits, and his ministers a flame of fire.

\ln Uwetsisgini hia nigaweseha, Tsatseli gasgilv, Tsanelanvhi, nigohilv ale nigohilv nigvwasdiquo; adolanvsdi duyugodv advnedodi nasgi adolanvsdi gohusdi tsvdiha nahna tsagvwiyuhi gesvi.
\syll ᎤᏪᏥᏍᎩᏂ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᏎᎭ, ᏣᏤᎵ ᎦᏍᎩᎸ, ᏣᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᏂᎬᏩᏍᏗᏉ; ᎠᏙᎳᏅᏍᏗ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎠᏛᏁᏙᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏙᎳᏅᏍᏗ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏨᏗᎭ ᏀᎾ ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft But unto the Son he saith, Thy throne, O God, is for ever and ever: a sceptre of righteousness is the sceptre of thy kingdom.

\ln Osiyu tsayelvnv duyugodv gesvi; ale tsaniquatilv uyo gesvi, nasgi iyusdi Unelanvhi, nasgi nihi Tsanelanvhi utli igai tsalonetanv atlonedi osdv adadanvdadisdisgi, esgaquo nasgi na itsaligohi.
\syll ᎣᏏᏳ ᏣᏰᎸᏅ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᏣᏂᏆᏘᎸ ᎤᏲ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎯ ᏣᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏟ ᎢᎦᎢ ᏣᎶᏁᏔᏅ ᎠᏠᏁᏗ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎠᏓᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗᏍᎩ, ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎢᏣᎵᎪᎯ.
\ft Thou hast loved righteousness, and hated iniquity; therefore God, even thy God, hath anointed thee with the oil of gladness above thy fellows.

\ln Ale, nasquo [hia nigaweha] Nihi, Tsagvwiyuhi, didalenisgv elohi gagusdav tsanei; ale galvloi ditsoyeni tsotlvtanei;
\syll ᎠᎴ, ᎾᏍᏉ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᎭdata is invalid ᏂᎯ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᏗᏓᎴᏂᏍᎬ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎦᎫᏍᏓᎥ ᏣᏁᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎦᎸᎶᎢ ᏗᏦᏰᏂ ᏦᏢᏔᏁᎢ;
\ft And, Thou, Lord, in the beginning hast laid the foundation of the earth; and the heavens are the works of thine hands:

\ln Dvnalidvtani nasgi; nihisgini netsadvnesdiquo; ale nasgi nigadv dayunetatsi anuwo nasgiyai;
\syll ᏛᎾᎵᏛᏔᏂ ᎾᏍᎩ; ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᏁᏣᏛᏁᏍᏗᏉ; ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏓᏳᏁᏔᏥ ᎠᏄᏬ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ;
\ft They shall perish; but thou remainest; and they all shall wax old as doth a garment;

\ln Ale utanohi anuwo nasgiya dotiquenvhi, ale diganetliyvdv gesesdi; nihisgini netsasdiquo, ale detsadetiyilosgv vtla wustitsihisdi yigi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎤᏔᏃᎯ ᎠᏄᏬ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏙᏘᏇᏅᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎦᏁᏟᏴᏛ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᏁᏣᏍᏗᏉ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᏣᏕᏘᏱᎶᏍᎬ ᎥᏝ ᏭᏍᏘᏥᎯᏍᏗ ᏱᎩ.
\ft And as a vesture shalt thou fold them up, and they shall be changed: but thou art the same, and thy years shall not fail.

\ln Gadoge usdi dinikahnawadidohi gesv hia nuweseloi, Tsigatisiditlv tsolesdi gvni getsesgagi gasgilo ditsalasidiyi nigatsiyvnelvha?
\syll ᎦᏙᎨ ᎤᏍᏗ ᏗᏂᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎶᎢ, ᏥᎦᏘᏏᏗᏢ ᏦᎴᏍᏗ ᎬᏂ ᎨᏤᏍᎦᎩ ᎦᏍᎩᎶ ᏗᏣᎳᏏᏗᏱ ᏂᎦᏥᏴᏁᎸᎭ?
\ft But to which of the angels said he at any time, Sit on my right hand, until I make thine enemies thy footstool?

\ln Tlasgo nasgi na nigadv didanvdo getsinvsidasdi yigi, getsinvsidv tsunisdelvhidasdiyi nasgi na alisdelvdodi gesv unatseli iyulisdodi tsigi?
\syll ᏝᏍᎪ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏗᏓᏅᏙ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᏱᎩ, ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏛ ᏧᏂᏍᏕᎸᎯᏓᏍᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎾᏤᎵ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᏥᎩ?
\ft Are they not all ministering spirits, sent forth to minister for them who shall be heirs of salvation?

\ln Nasgi iyusdi utli igai igagasayasdodi yinigalisda nusdv igadvganvi, nasgi ilvhiyu digvsgaloisdiyi nigesvna iyulisdodiyi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᏟ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎢᎦᎦᏌᏯᏍᏙᏗ ᏱᏂᎦᎵᏍᏓ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎢᎦᏛᎦᏅᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᏗᎬᏍᎦᎶᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
\ft Therefore we ought to give the more earnest heed to the things which we have heard, lest at any time we should let them slip.

\ln Iyuyeno kanohedv dinikahnawadidohi gvnigesv iyunvnelvhi gesv ulinigidiyu yigi, ale nudalesv asganvtsvhi gesv ale nunohiyusvna gesv duyugodv getsisdvditanvhi yigi;
\syll ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏗᏂᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏅᏁᎸᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏄᏓᎴᏒ ᎠᏍᎦᏅᏨᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏄᏃᎯᏳᏒᎾ ᎨᏒ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏥᏍᏛᏗᏔᏅᎯ ᏱᎩ;
\ft For if the word spoken by angels was stedfast, and every transgression and disobedience received a just recompence of reward;

\ln Gado yigalisdoda yidadudalagi, iyuno nigagasayastanvna yigi nasgi igalvquodi alisdelvdodi; nasgi igvyi tsulenvhv tsunohele Ugvwiyuhi, ale nasgi ayv tsigegisdayidelvgi nasgi na gvwadvganelvhi;
\syll ᎦᏙ ᏱᎦᎵᏍᏙᏓ ᏱᏓᏚᏓᎳᎩ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᏂᎦᎦᏌᏯᏍᏔᏅᎾ ᏱᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎦᎸᏉᏗ ᎠᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎬᏱ ᏧᎴᏅᎲ ᏧᏃᎮᎴ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᏥᎨᎩᏍᏓᏱᏕᎸᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎬᏩᏛᎦᏁᎸᎯ;
\ft How shall we escape, if we neglect so great salvation; which at the first began to be spoken by the Lord, and was confirmed unto us by them that heard him;

\ln Unelanvhi nasquo degohiyudanehvgi, degvdisgvgi uyelvdv ale usquanigodi, ale usquanigodi digalvwisdanedi gesvi, ale Galvquodiyu Adanvdo udanedi gesv nasgiya uwasv osiyu uyelvdi gesvi.
\syll ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏕᎪᎯᏳᏓᏁᎲᎩ, ᏕᎬᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᎤᏰᎸᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎤᏰᎸᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft God also bearing them witness, both with signs and wonders, and with divers miracles, and gifts of the Holy Ghost, according to his own will?

\ln Dinikahnawadidohiyeno vtla nunigvwiyusadegi yiniduwanelv nasgi nahna elohi uliyeilohisdi tsigesvgi, nasgi tsidineisdiha.
\syll ᏗᏂᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎯᏰᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ ᏱᏂᏚᏩᏁᎸ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏀᎾ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎤᎵᏰᎢᎶᎯᏍᏗ ᏥᎨᏒᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏗᏁᎢᏍᏗᎭ.
\ft For unto the angels hath he not put in subjection the world to come, whereof we speak.

\ln Asiyvwisgini ilvhitlv unetse, hia nuwesei, Gado yvwi nasgi tsiyadanvtesgoi?  ale yvwi uwetsi, nasgi tsiyagatanihihoi?
\syll ᎠᏏᏴᏫᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᎸᎯᏢ ᎤᏁᏤ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎦᏙ ᏴᏫ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏯᏓᏅᏖᏍᎪᎢ?  ᎠᎴ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏯᎦᏔᏂᎯᎰᎢ?
\ft But one in a certain place testified, saying, What is man, that thou art mindful of him? or the son of man, that thou visitest him?

\ln Usdigidvquoyeno esga niyvnelv nigiyvnelv dinikahnawadidohi; digvwalvsada ale galvquodiyu gesv hisdulotanv, ale ugvwiyusadegi niyvnelv gohusdi tsotlvnvnvhi gesvi.
\syll ᎤᏍᏗᎩᏛᏉᏰᏃ ᎡᏍᎦ ᏂᏴᏁᎸ ᏂᎩᏴᏁᎸ ᏗᏂᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎯ; ᏗᎬᏩᎸᏌᏓ ᎠᎴ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎯᏍᏚᎶᏔᏅ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ ᏂᏴᏁᎸ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏦᏢᏅᏅᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Thou madest him a little lower than the angels; thou crownedst him with glory and honour, and didst set him over the works of thy hands:

\ln Nudalesv gohusdi tsulasideni hawiniditlv nidetsvnelv.  Nasgiyeno nigadv hawiniditlv tsinuwanelei, vtla gohusdi yunohiye nasgi hawiniditlv nuwanelvna gesvi.  Aseno gohi gesv vtla yidigowatiha nigadv hawiniditlv yinagvnelv.
\syll ᏄᏓᎴᏒ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏧᎳᏏᏕᏂ ᎭᏫᏂᏗᏢ ᏂᏕᏨᏁᎸ.  ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎭᏫᏂᏗᏢ ᏥᏄᏩᏁᎴᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏳᏃᎯᏰ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎭᏫᏂᏗᏢ ᏄᏩᏁᎸᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.  ᎠᏎᏃ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏗᎪᏩᏘᎭ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎭᏫᏂᏗᏢ ᏱᎾᎬᏁᎸ.
\ft Thou hast put all things in subjection under his feet. For in that he put all in subjection under him, he left nothing that is not put under him. But now we see not yet all things put under him.

\ln Tsisasgini edigowatiha nasgi usdigidv esga iyagvnelvhi dinikahnawadidohi gesv nigegvnelvi, nasgi uyohuhisdiyi, digvwalvsadv ale galvquodiyu gesv atsisdelotanv; nasgi nvdayulisdodiyi gvwagatiya Unelanvhi udadolisdi gesv gvdisgv naniv yvwi tsuyohusediyi.
\syll ᏥᏌᏍᎩᏂ ᎡᏗᎪᏩᏘᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏍᏗᎩᏛ ᎡᏍᎦ ᎢᏯᎬᏁᎸᎯ ᏗᏂᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏂᎨᎬᏁᎸᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗᏱ, ᏗᎬᏩᎸᏌᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏥᏍᏕᎶᏔᏅ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏓᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏗᏍᎬ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏴᏫ ᏧᏲᎱᏎᏗᏱ.
\ft But we see Jesus, who was made a little lower than the angels for the suffering of death, crowned with glory and honour; that he by the grace of God should taste death for every man.

\ln Aseyeno nasgi iyudvnedi gesei, nasgi na nudalesv gohusdi agotlvnanelvhi, ale nasgi iyuwanisadv nudalesv gohusdi gotlvnvhi tsigi, nasgi digvwalvsadv digesv widatinohihv unitsati tsuwetsi, nasgi unalisdelvdodi diwadvehi, nigalulogvna iyagvnediyi agiliyogvi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏛᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏄᏓᎴᏒ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎠᎪᏢᎾᏁᎸᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ ᏄᏓᎴᏒ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎪᏢᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎬᏩᎸᏌᏛ ᏗᎨᏒ ᏫᏓᏘᏃᎯᎲ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏧᏪᏥ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ ᏗᏩᏛᎡᎯ, ᏂᎦᎷᎶᎬᎾ ᎢᏯᎬᏁᏗᏱ ᎠᎩᎵᏲᎬᎢ.
\ft For it became him, for whom are all things, and by whom are all things, in bringing many sons unto glory, to make the captain of their salvation perfect through sufferings.

\ln Itsulayeno nasgi na diganvgalisgi gesv ale nasgi getsinvgalisgi gesv unitloyiquo; nasgi iyusdi vtla udehohisdi yuyelvha otsalinvtli tsuwosediyi;
\syll ᎢᏧᎳᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏗᎦᏅᎦᎵᏍᎩ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᏥᏅᎦᎵᏍᎩ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏂᏠᏱᏉ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏕᎰᎯᏍᏗ ᏳᏰᎸᎭ ᎣᏣᎵᏅᏟ ᏧᏬᏎᏗᏱ;
\ft For both he that sanctifieth and they who are sanctified are all of one: for which cause he is not ashamed to call them brethren,

\ln Hia tsinuwesei, Detsadov gvnigesv nvdagatsiyvneli otsalinvtli; tsunanelodi unadatlugv ayeli dodagvnogistani.
\syll ᎯᎠ ᏥᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᏕᏣᏙᎥ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏅᏓᎦᏥᏴᏁᎵ ᎣᏣᎵᏅᏟ; ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬ ᎠᏰᎵ ᏙᏓᎬᏃᎩᏍᏔᏂ.
\ft Saying, I will declare thy name unto my brethren, in the midst of the church will I sing praise unto thee.

\ln Ale talinei, Nasgi datsiyalisgasdotani.  Alewo, Gvniyuquo ayv ale nasgi na diniyoli Unelanvhi digikanelvhi gesvi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏔᎵᏁᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏓᏥᏯᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏔᏂ.  ᎠᎴᏬ, ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎠᏴ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏗᏂᏲᎵ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏗᎩᎧᏁᎸᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft And again, I will put my trust in him. And again, Behold I and the children which God hath given me.

\ln Ale nasgi diniyoli uniquedali ale gigv uninehi tsigi, uwasv nasquo nasgi utloyastane ugisei; nasgi ayohuhisdi gesv iyuwanisodiyi asequoquo iyuwanediyi nasgi na ayohuhisdi gesv ulinigvgv uhi, nasgi asgina tsigi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏂᏲᎵ ᎤᏂᏇᏓᎵ ᎠᎴ ᎩᎬ ᎤᏂᏁᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎤᏩᏒ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏠᏯᏍᏔᏁ ᎤᎩᏎᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏐᏗᏱ ᎠᏎᏉᏉ ᎢᏳᏩᏁᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎵᏂᎬᎬ ᎤᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᎩᎾ ᏥᎩ.
\ft Forasmuch then as the children are partakers of flesh and blood, he also himself likewise took part of the same; that through death he might destroy him that had the power of death, that is, the devil;

\ln Ale tsuwudalesdiyi nasgi na ayohuhisdi gesv aninayesgv tsinvdigalisdisge danvnv igohidv tsunadayosvhi tsigesv degetsinatlavi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏧᏭᏓᎴᏍᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏂᎾᏰᏍᎬ ᏥᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏗᏍᎨ ᏓᏅᏅ ᎢᎪᎯᏛ ᏧᎾᏓᏲᏒᎯ ᏥᎨᏒ ᏕᎨᏥᎾᏝᎥᎢ.
\ft And deliver them who through fear of death were all their lifetime subject to bondage.

\ln Udohiyuhiyeno vtla dinikahnawadidohi yiduwoyanesei, Equahamisgini unetlvtanvdv gesv duwoyanesei.
\syll ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏰᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏗᏂᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏱᏚᏬᏯᏁᏎᎢ, ᎡᏆᎭᎻᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏁᏢᏔᏅᏛ ᎨᏒ ᏚᏬᏯᏁᏎᎢ.
\ft For verily he took not on him the nature of angels; but he took on him the seed of Abraham.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi duyugodvgi nigav nudvnvnv analinvtli nasgiya nunasdv iyulisdodiyi, nasgi udadolisdi ale nudalisdvna nugvwiyusv Atsilvgelohi iyulisdodiyi Unelanvhi utseli ugvwali, nasgi alisgolvtanvhi aguyvdodi iyulisdodiyi unisganvtsv yvwi;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏚᏳᎪᏛᎩ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏄᏛᏅᏅ ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏟ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᎾᏍᏛ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏄᏓᎵᏍᏛᎾ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸᎨᎶᎯ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏅᎯ ᎠᎫᏴᏙᏗ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᏂᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᏴᏫ;
\ft Wherefore in all things it behoved him to be made like unto his brethren, that he might be a merciful and faithful high priest in things pertaining to God, to make reconciliation for the sins of the people.

\ln Nasgiyeno uwasv ugiliyotsvhi tsigi, nasgi atsigoliyesgvi yeliquo digvwasdelvdi nulistanv nasgi na getsigoliyesgi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎤᎩᎵᏲᏨᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏥᎪᎵᏰᏍᎬᎢ ᏰᎵᏉ ᏗᎬᏩᏍᏕᎸᏗ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎨᏥᎪᎵᏰᏍᎩ.
\ft For in that he himself hath suffered being tempted, he is able to succour them that are tempted.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi etsilvquodi idalinvtli, itsatloyasdisgi galvladi ugvwali vdatiyanvdi gesvi, etsadanvdvli Galonedv Tsisa Atsinvsidv ale nugvwiyusv Atsilvgelohi nasgi tsedanelodi tsigi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎡᏥᎸᏉᏗ ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᎢᏣᏠᏯᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᎥᏓᏘᏯᏅᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎡᏣᏓᏅᏛᎵ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏥᏌ ᎠᏥᏅᏏᏛ ᎠᎴ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸᎨᎶᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏤᏓᏁᎶᏗ ᏥᎩ.
\ft Wherefore, holy brethren, partakers of the heavenly calling, consider the Apostle and High Priest of our profession, Christ Jesus;

\ln Nasgi nulidastanvna gesv nasgi na unetselvhi, nasgiya nasquo Mosi nudalidasdvna tsigese nigav dudatinavi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᎵᏓᏍᏔᏅᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᏁᏤᎸᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎼᏏ ᏄᏓᎵᏓᏍᏛᎾ ᏥᎨᏎ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏚᏓᏘᎾᎥᎢ.
\ft Who was faithful to him that appointed him, as also Moses was faithful in all his house.

\ln Hiayeno nasgi asgaya utli atsilvquodiyu atsiyelvse esgaquo Mosi, giloyeno adanelv unesgehvhi utli atsilvquodiyu geso esgaquo adanelvi.
\syll ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᏟ ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏥᏰᎸᏎ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎼᏏ, ᎩᎶᏰᏃ ᎠᏓᏁᎸ ᎤᏁᏍᎨᎲᎯ ᎤᏟ ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏐ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎠᏓᏁᎸᎢ.
\ft For this man was counted worthy of more glory than Moses, inasmuch as he who hath builded the house hath more honour than the house.

\ln Nigavyeno dadanelv gilo tsuwotlvnvhi gesoi; nasgi na nigav tsudalenvdv uwotlvnvhi gesv Unelanvhi.
\syll ᏂᎦᎥᏰᏃ ᏓᏓᏁᎸ ᎩᎶ ᏧᏬᏢᏅᎯ ᎨᏐᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎤᏬᏢᏅᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ.
\ft For every house is builded by some man; but he that built all things is God.

\ln Ale mosi udohiyuhi nudalidasdvna gesvgi nigav dudatinavi atsinvsidasdi nasgiyai, nasgi gohiyudisgi iyulisdodiyi nasgi na tsudalenvdv gvnigesv igvnedi tsigesei.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎼᏏ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᏄᏓᎵᏓᏍᏛᎾ ᎨᏒᎩ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏚᏓᏘᎾᎥᎢ ᎠᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᎯᏳᏗᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᎬᏁᏗ ᏥᎨᏎᎢ.
\ft And Moses verily was faithful in all his house, as a servant, for a testimony of those things which were to be spoken after;

\ln Galonedvsgini aganvgi nasgiya nudalidasdvna gesvgi uwasv dudatinavi; nasgi na dudatinav itela tsigi, iyuno ulinigidv yidiginiyvha gvlisquadisgi nasgi na igalisgasdodv ale idatlvquisdodisgv udugi gvdi gesvi.
\syll ᎦᎶᏁᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᎦᏅᎩ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᏓᎵᏓᏍᏛᎾ ᎨᏒᎩ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏚᏓᏘᎾᎥᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏚᏓᏘᎾᎥ ᎢᏖᎳ ᏥᎩ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᏱᏗᎩᏂᏴᎭ ᎬᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎢᎦᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏓᏢᏈᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎬᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft But Christ as a son over his own house; whose house are we, if we hold fast the confidence and the rejoicing of the hope firm unto the end.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi, Galvquodiyu Adanvdo hia tsinigaweha, Gohi iga iyuno kanegv itsadvgodiyi itsadulisgesdi,
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᎦᏪᎭ, ᎪᎯ ᎢᎦ ᎢᏳᏃ ᎧᏁᎬ ᎢᏣᏛᎪᏗᏱ ᎢᏣᏚᎵᏍᎨᏍᏗ,
\ft Wherefore (as the Holy Ghost saith, To day if ye will hear his voice,

\ln Tlesdi yiditsisdayodisgesdi ditsinawi, nasgiya nunadvnelv tsigvginalvstanvgi, nahiyu iga tsigvgigoliyevgi inagei;
\syll ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏗᏥᏍᏓᏲᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏗᏥᎾᏫ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᎾᏛᏁᎸ ᏥᎬᎩᎾᎸᏍᏔᏅᎩ, ᏀᎢᏳ ᎢᎦ ᏥᎬᎩᎪᎵᏰᎥᎩ ᎢᎾᎨᎢ;
\ft Harden not your hearts, as in the provocation, in the day of temptation in the wilderness:

\ln Nahiyu ditsigayvlige tsigvgigoliyesgvgi, ale tsigvquagatisgvgi, anigowatisgvgisgininonv dagilvwisdanehv nvgasgohi tsudetiyvdv.
\syll ᏀᎢᏳ ᏗᏥᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᏥᎬᎩᎪᎵᏰᏍᎬᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᎬᏆᎦᏘᏍᎬᎩ, ᎠᏂᎪᏩᏘᏍᎬᎩᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᏓᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᏅᎦᏍᎪᎯ ᏧᏕᏘᏴᏛ.
\ft When your fathers tempted me, proved me, and saw my works forty years.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi gatsiniquotilvgi nasgi na yvwi, ale hia nagiwesvgi, Nigohilv dulenahiha tsuninawi; ale vtla unigadovsvhi yigi daginvnvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎦᏥᏂᏉᏘᎸᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏴᏫ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᎾᎩᏪᏒᎩ, ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᏚᎴᏀᎢᎭ ᏧᏂᎾᏫ; ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏂᎦᏙᎥᏒᎯ ᏱᎩ ᏓᎩᏅᏅᎢ.
\ft Wherefore I was grieved with that generation, and said, They do always err in their heart; and they have not known my ways.

\ln Nasgi nvdayulisdotanvgi aquaselitanvgi agitalawosgv, Nasgi uniyvsdiyu nigesvna gesv aquatseli atsawesolvsdodiyi gesvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏓᏳᎵᏍᏙᏔᏅᎩ ᎠᏆᏎᎵᏔᏅᎩ ᎠᎩᏔᎳᏬᏍᎬ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᏴᏍᏗᏳ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏆᏤᎵ ᎠᏣᏪᏐᎸᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft So I sware in my wrath, They shall not enter into my rest.)

\ln Itseyatahesdi, idalinvtli, tlesdiquo nihi gilo uwohiyuhisdv nigesvna unawi yuyaesdi, nasgi adanvehi gvnidv Unelanvhi.
\syll ᎢᏤᏯᏔᎮᏍᏗ, ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᏞᏍᏗᏉ ᏂᎯ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏬᎯᏳᎯᏍᏛ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎤᎾᏫ ᏳᏯᎡᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏓᏅᎡᎯ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ.
\ft Take heed, brethren, lest there be in any of you an evil heart of unbelief, in departing from the living God.

\ln Detsadawonidisgesdisgini nidugitsvnisvi, asiquo Gohi iga gagosedi tsigi; nasgi nihi gilo getsisdayohisdi nigesvna iyulisdodiyi udalidasdi asgani iyuwanisadv.
\syll ᏕᏣᏓᏬᏂᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᏂᏚᎩᏨᏂᏒᎢ, ᎠᏏᏉ ᎪᎯ ᎢᎦ ᎦᎪᏎᏗ ᏥᎩ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎯ ᎩᎶ ᎨᏥᏍᏓᏲᎯᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᏓᎵᏓᏍᏗ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ.
\ft But exhort one another daily, while it is called To day; lest any of you be hardened through the deceitfulness of sin.

\ln Degadudadewisvyeno Galonedv, iyuno yinvwasdiquo deginiyvsv ulinigidv gvlisquadisgi igvyiyi igalisgasdotanvi;
\syll ᏕᎦᏚᏓᏕᏫᏒᏰᏃ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᏱᏅᏩᏍᏗᏉ ᏕᎩᏂᏴᏒ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᎬᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᎩ ᎢᎬᏱᏱ ᎢᎦᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏔᏅᎢ;
\ft For we are made partakers of Christ, if we hold the beginning of our confidence stedfast unto the end;

\ln Hiayeno igawedv igi, Gohi iga iyuno itsadulisgesdi kanegv itsadvgodiyi, tlesdi yiditsisdayodisgesdi ditsinawi, nasgiya nunadvnelv nahiyu tsigvginalvstanvgi.
\syll ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᎢᎦᏪᏛ ᎢᎩ, ᎪᎯ ᎢᎦ ᎢᏳᏃ ᎢᏣᏚᎵᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎧᏁᎬ ᎢᏣᏛᎪᏗᏱ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏗᏥᏍᏓᏲᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏗᏥᎾᏫ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᎾᏛᏁᎸ ᏀᎢᏳ ᏥᎬᎩᎾᎸᏍᏔᏅᎩ.
\ft While it is said, To day if ye will hear his voice, harden not your hearts, as in the provocation.

\ln Gagoyeno hnaquo unadvganv, unihnalvstanei; tlasgo nigadv Itsiquiyi nidodayudinvstanvhi Yisi, nasgi yinunadvnelei?
\syll ᎦᎪᏰᏃ ᎿᏉ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅ, ᎤᏂᎿᎸᏍᏔᏁᎢ; ᏝᏍᎪ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎢᏥᏈᏱ ᏂᏙᏓᏳᏗᏅᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᏱᏏ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᏄᎾᏛᏁᎴᎢ?
\ft For some, when they had heard, did provoke: howbeit not all that came out of Egypt by Moses.

\ln Ale gago nvgasgohi tsudetiyvdv duniquatilei?  tlasgo nasgi na unisganvtsvhi tsigesei, nasgi na diniyelv inage tsidunvtsei?
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎦᎪ ᏅᎦᏍᎪᎯ ᏧᏕᏘᏴᏛ ᏚᏂᏆᏘᎴᎢ?  ᏝᏍᎪ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᏂᏍᎦᏅᏨᎯ ᏥᎨᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏗᏂᏰᎸ ᎢᎾᎨ ᏥᏚᏅᏤᎢ?
\ft But with whom was he grieved forty years? was it not with them that had sinned, whose carcases fell in the wilderness?

\ln Ale gago dunetsele aselidvsgv nasgi uniyvsdiyi nigesvna gesv utseli atsaweyvlvsdodiyi?  tlasgo nasgi yigese na nunohiyusvna tsigesei?
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎦᎪ ᏚᏁᏤᎴ ᎠᏎᎵᏛᏍᎬ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᏴᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎠᏣᏪᏴᎸᏍᏙᏗᏱ?  ᏝᏍᎪ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᎨᏎ Ꮎ ᏄᏃᎯᏳᏒᎾ ᏥᎨᏎᎢ?
\ft And to whom sware he that they should not enter into his rest, but to them that believed not?

\ln Nasgi tsinusdi idigowatiha nasgi wigvwaniyvsdi nigesvna gesv nvdigalisdodisgv nunohiyunvna gesvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏄᏍᏗ ᎢᏗᎪᏩᏘᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏫᎬᏩᏂᏴᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬ ᏄᏃᎯᏳᏅᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft So we see that they could not enter in because of unbelief.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi ayv idinayesgesdi nasgi svgiduisdanelv wigiyvsdiyi tsigi utseli atsawesolvsdodiyi, nasgi gvnigesv yinvgalisda nihi gilo esga itsohasvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏴ ᎢᏗᎾᏰᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏒᎩᏚᎢᏍᏓᏁᎸ ᏫᎩᏴᏍᏗᏱ ᏥᎩ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎠᏣᏪᏐᎸᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏱᏅᎦᎵᏍᏓ ᏂᎯ ᎩᎶ ᎡᏍᎦ ᎢᏦᎭᏒᎢ.
\ft Let us therefore fear, lest, a promise being left us of entering into his rest, any of you should seem to come short of it.

\ln Ayvyeno osdv kanohedv egalitsidonelvgi, nasgiyaquo tsigegalitsidonelvgi nasgi; aseno nasgi na kanohedv unadvganv vtla nvnisdelvhei nvdigalisdodisge gohiyudi gesv nudasuyvna gesv anadvgisgvi.
\syll ᎠᏴᏰᏃ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎡᎦᎵᏥᏙᏁᎸᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯᏉ ᏥᎨᎦᎵᏥᏙᏁᎸᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅ ᎥᏝ ᏅᏂᏍᏕᎸᎮᎢ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏄᏓᏑᏴᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎾᏛᎩᏍᎬᎢ.
\ft For unto us was the gospel preached, as well as unto them: but the word preached did not profit them, not being mixed with faith in them that heard it.

\ln Ayvyeno igohiyunvhi gesv idiyvhiha atsawesolvsdodiyi gesvi; nasgiya nuwesvi, Nasgiya aquaselitanv agitalawosgvi, nasgi uniyvsdiyi nigesvna gesv aquatseli atsawesolvsdodiyi gesvi; asquadvhisgininonv gesvgi degalvwisdanelv elohi tsudotlvu udagvwadaleudv.
\syll ᎠᏴᏰᏃ ᎢᎪᎯᏳᏅᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏗᏴᎯᎭ ᎠᏣᏪᏐᎸᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᏪᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎠᏆᏎᎵᏔᏅ ᎠᎩᏔᎳᏬᏍᎬᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᏴᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏆᏤᎵ ᎠᏣᏪᏐᎸᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎠᏍᏆᏛᎯᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎨᏒᎩ ᏕᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏧᏙᏢᎤ ᎤᏓᎬᏩᏓᎴᎤᏛ.
\ft For we which have believed do enter into rest, as he said, As I have sworn in my wrath, if they shall enter into my rest: although the works were finished from the foundation of the world.

\ln Ilvhitlvyeno galiquogine iga uneistanv hia nuwesv, Ale Unelanvhi galiquogine iga uyawesole uyohistane nigadv dulvwisdanehvi.
\syll ᎢᎸᎯᏢᏰᏃ ᎦᎵᏉᎩᏁ ᎢᎦ ᎤᏁᎢᏍᏔᏅ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎦᎵᏉᎩᏁ ᎢᎦ ᎤᏯᏪᏐᎴ ᎤᏲᎯᏍᏔᏁ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎢ.
\ft For he spake in a certain place of the seventh day on this wise, And God did rest the seventh day from all his works.

\ln Ale ani taline hia nigaweha, Vtla yvgvniyvha aquatseli atsawesolvsdodiyi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᎭ, ᎥᏝ ᏴᎬᏂᏴᎭ ᎠᏆᏤᎵ ᎠᏣᏪᏐᎸᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
\ft And in this place again, If they shall enter into my rest.

\ln Nasgino gilo ase nahna wuniyvsdi tsigi, ale nasgi na igvyi gegalitsidonelvhi gesv nanuniyvlvna tsigesei, nvdigalisdodisgv nunohiyusvna gesvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎠᏎ ᏀᎾ ᏭᏂᏴᏍᏗ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎢᎬᏱ ᎨᎦᎵᏥᏙᏁᎸᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏄᏂᏴᎸᎾ ᏥᎨᏎᎢ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬ ᏄᏃᎯᏳᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Seeing therefore it remaineth that some must enter therein, and they to whom it was first preached entered not in because of unbelief:

\ln Ale nasquo iga asuyeha, hia nigaweha uwohitsvhi oni Dewi agvdisgvi, Gohi iga, nasgiya hia igawedv tsigi, Gohi iga, iyuno kanegv itsadvgodiyi itsadulisgesdi, tlesdi yiditsisdayotanesdi ditsinawi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎢᎦ ᎠᏑᏰᎭ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᎭ ᎤᏬᎯᏨᎯ ᎣᏂ ᏕᏫ ᎠᎬᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᎪᎯ ᎢᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎯᎠ ᎢᎦᏪᏛ ᏥᎩ, ᎪᎯ ᎢᎦ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎧᏁᎬ ᎢᏣᏛᎪᏗᏱ ᎢᏣᏚᎵᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏗᏥᏍᏓᏲᏔᏁᏍᏗ ᏗᏥᎾᏫ.
\ft Again, he limiteth a certain day, saying in David, To day, after so long a time; as it is said, To day if ye will hear his voice, harden not your hearts.

\ln Iyuyeno Tsosuwa yidunele unatsawesolvsdodiyi, vtla [Unelanvhi] oni yigvwaneistane nvwadale iga.
\syll ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᏦᏑᏩ ᏱᏚᏁᎴ ᎤᎾᏣᏪᏐᎸᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎥᏝ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯdata is invalid ᎣᏂ ᏱᎬᏩᏁᎢᏍᏔᏁ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᎢᎦ.
\ft For if Jesus had given them rest, then would he not afterward have spoken of another day.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi asiquo unatiyeha unatsawesolvsdodiyi gesv Unelanvhi tsutseliga yvwi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏏᏉ ᎤᎾᏘᏰᎭ ᎤᎾᏣᏪᏐᎸᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᏤᎵᎦ ᏴᏫ.
\ft There remaineth therefore a rest to the people of God.

\ln Nasgiyeno na uyvlvhi tsigeso utsawesolvsdodiyi, nasquo uyohistanvhi geso dulvwisdanehv, nasgiya Unelanvhi nudvnelv uyohistanvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ Ꮎ ᎤᏴᎸᎯ ᏥᎨᏐ ᎤᏣᏪᏐᎸᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᏲᎯᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏐ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏄᏛᏁᎸ ᎤᏲᎯᏍᏔᏅᎢ.
\ft For he that is entered into his rest, he also hath ceased from his own works, as God did from his.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi idatlinigvnehesdi wigiyvsdiyi, yinvsegagiyeno gilo nasgi tsudeloquaelvhi gesv nasgiya nuwohiyusvna gesv yvganvisda.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏓᏟᏂᎬᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᏫᎩᏴᏍᏗᏱ, ᏱᏅᏎᎦᎩᏰᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏕᎶᏆᎡᎸᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᏬᎯᏳᏒᎾ ᎨᏒ ᏴᎦᏅᎢᏍᏓ.
\ft Let us labour therefore to enter into that rest, lest any man fall after the same example of unbelief.

\ln Kanohedvyeno Unelanvhi utseliga gvnodv, ale ulinigidiyu ale utlihiyu nigosdayv esgaquo ayelasdiganvhidv itsuladitlv digvgati digosdayv, degatiha tali nigadiha adanvtediyi ale adanvdo, ale duwitlvi ale dusdvwedogvi, ale digvwugododi igi nusdv adanvtesgv ale nusdv udulisgv unawi.
\syll ᎧᏃᎮᏛᏰᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᎬᏃᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏟᎯᏳ ᏂᎪᏍᏓᏴ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎠᏰᎳᏍᏗᎦᏅᎯᏛ ᎢᏧᎳᏗᏢ ᏗᎬᎦᏘ ᏗᎪᏍᏓᏴ, ᏕᎦᏘᎭ ᏔᎵ ᏂᎦᏗᎭ ᎠᏓᏅᏖᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏫᏢᎢ ᎠᎴ ᏚᏍᏛᏪᏙᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎬᏭᎪᏙᏗ ᎢᎩ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎠᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ ᎠᎴ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎬ ᎤᎾᏫ.
\ft For the word of God is quick, and powerful, and sharper than any twoedged sword, piercing even to the dividing asunder of soul and spirit, and of the joints and marrow, and is a discerner of the thoughts and intents of the heart.

\ln Vtla ale gohusdi anelanvhi gesv agvsgalanelvhi yigi; nigadiyuquosgini uyelvhai, ale tsutledv nasgi dodikanv nasgi na gvnigesv iyedvnedi tsigi nigadvnelvi.
\syll ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎠᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎬᏍᎦᎳᏁᎸᎯ ᏱᎩ; ᏂᎦᏗᏳᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏰᎸᎭᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏞᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏙᏗᎧᏅ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏰᏛᏁᏗ ᏥᎩ ᏂᎦᏛᏁᎸᎢ.
\ft Neither is there any creature that is not manifest in his sight: but all things are naked and opened unto the eyes of him with whom we have to do.

\ln Nasgino tsidigowadiha igikahv atsilvquodi nugvwiyusv Atsilvgelohi, nasgi galvlo wulosvhi tsigi, nasgi Tsisa Unelanvhi Uwetsi, asdaya deginiyvsesdi dedanelodvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏥᏗᎪᏩᏗᎭ ᎢᎩᎧᎲ ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏗ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸᎨᎶᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎸᎶ ᏭᎶᏒᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏌ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏪᏥ, ᎠᏍᏓᏯ ᏕᎩᏂᏴᏎᏍᏗ ᏕᏓᏁᎶᏛᎢ.
\ft Seeing then that we have a great high priest, that is passed into the heavens, Jesus the Son of God, let us hold fast our profession.

\ln Vtlayeno nugvwiyusv atsilvgelohi yigikaha nasgi gegidolisdi nigesvna gesv degiwanigalvi, nigavquosgini atsigoliyehvgi ayv nasgiyai, aseno nasganvna gesvgi.
\syll ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸᎨᎶᎯ ᏱᎩᎧᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᎩᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒ ᏕᎩᏩᏂᎦᎸᎢ, ᏂᎦᎥᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏥᎪᎵᏰᎲᎩ ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎾᏍᎦᏅᎾ ᎨᏒᎩ.
\ft For we have not an high priest which cannot be touched with the feeling of our infirmities; but was in all points tempted like as we are, yet without sin.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi nidisgaihvna idilugi nahna gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv gasgilvi, nasgi egidolisdiyi, ale igiwadvdiyi gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv nasgi nahiyu iginigvsehv igalisdelvdodi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏂᏗᏍᎦᎢᎲᎾ ᎢᏗᎷᎩ ᏀᎾ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎦᏍᎩᎸᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᎩᏙᎵᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᎩᏩᏛᏗᏱ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏀᎢᏳ ᎢᎩᏂᎬᏎᎲ ᎢᎦᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ.
\ft Let us therefore come boldly unto the throne of grace, that we may obtain mercy, and find grace to help in time of need.

\ln Nanivyeno nugvwiyusv atsilvanelohi gesv yvwi anehv gegotsaledv, yvwi osdv iyunalisdanedi getsinetsehoi, nasgi [tsunilvwisdanediyi] Unelanvhi utseligohi ugvwali, nasgi digvwanalisgolvdodi iyulisdodiyi adanedi gesv ale atsilvgelasdodi nasgi asgani ugvwali;
\syll ᎾᏂᎥᏰᏃ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏴᏫ ᎠᏁᎲ ᎨᎪᏣᎴᏛ, ᏴᏫ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏥᏁᏤᎰᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱdata is invalid ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎪᎯ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎬᏩᎾᎵᏍᎪᎸᏙᏗ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎠᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏥᎸᎨᎳᏍᏙᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ;
\ft For every high priest taken from among men is ordained for men in things pertaining to God, that he may offer both gifts and sacrifices for sins:

\ln Nasgi yeli digvwedolisdi nanigatanavna, ale nasgi na unalenalvhi; uwasvyeno nasquo duliduwisdvgi awanigala gesvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏰᎵ ᏗᎬᏪᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎾᏂᎦᏔᎾᎥᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᎾᎴᎾᎸᎯ; ᎤᏩᏒᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏚᎵᏚᏫᏍᏛᎩ ᎠᏩᏂᎦᎳ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Who can have compassion on the ignorant, and on them that are out of the way; for that he himself also is compassed with infirmity.
