\ln Ale nasgi iyusdi, nasgi yvwi unalisdelvdodi alisgolvdisgv nasquo uwasv ulisdelvdodi ase ulisgolvdodi gesoi, asgani ugvwali gesvi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏴᏫ ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ ᎠᎵᏍᎪᎸᏗᏍᎬ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎤᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ ᎠᏎ ᎤᎵᏍᎪᎸᏙᏗ ᎨᏐᎢ, ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft And by reason hereof he ought, as for the people, so also for himself, to offer for sins.

\ln Vtla ale gilo hia nasgi galvquodi [digalvwisdanedi] uwasvquo udanvtedv yagisgoi, gvni Unelanvhi uyanvdv yigi nasgiya Elini atsiyanvhvi.
\syll ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎸᏉᏗ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗdata is invalid ᎤᏩᏒᏉ ᎤᏓᏅᏖᏛ ᏯᎩᏍᎪᎢ, ᎬᏂ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏯᏅᏛ ᏱᎩ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎡᎵᏂ ᎠᏥᏯᏅᎲᎢ.
\ft And no man taketh this honour unto himself, but he that is called of God, as was Aaron.

\ln Nasgiya nasquo Galonedv vtla uwasv hia galvquodi digalvwisdanedi yugise nugvwiyusv atsilvgelohi nagvnelvi; hiasgini iyuweselvhi, Aquetsi nihi, gohi iga squadehvsi, [nasgi uyanvhei.]
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎯᎠ ᎦᎸᏉᏗ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᏳᎩᏎ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸᎨᎶᎯ ᎾᎬᏁᎸᎢ; ᎯᎠᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᏳᏪᏎᎸᎯ, ᎠᏇᏥ ᏂᎯ, ᎪᎯ ᎢᎦ ᏍᏆᏕᎲᏏ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏯᏅᎮᎢ.data is invalid
\ft So also Christ glorified not himself to be made an high priest; but he that said unto him, Thou art my Son, to day have I begotten thee.

\ln Nasquo ilvhitlv hia nigaweha, Atsilvhelohi nihi nigohilvi Meligisidegi nusdv nasgiyai.
\syll ᎾᏍᏉ ᎢᎸᎯᏢ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᎭ, ᎠᏥᎸᎮᎶᎯ ᏂᎯ ᏂᎪᎯᎸᎢ ᎺᎵᎩᏏᏕᎩ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ.
\ft As he saith also in another place, Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec.

\ln Nasgi na nahiyu uquedali gesv ulenidolv, udadolisdanelv ale utayoselv, asdayv datloyihv, ale dagasawoihv gvwatloyasdi nasgi na utayoselv nasgi yeliquo gvwasdelvdi gvwudalesdi gesv ayohuhisdi gesvi, ale agadvganele ganayesgv ugvwali;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏀᎢᏳ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎴᏂᏙᎸ, ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎸ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏔᏲᏎᎸ, ᎠᏍᏓᏴ ᏓᏠᏱᎲ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᎦᏌᏬᎢᎲ ᎬᏩᏠᏯᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᏔᏲᏎᎸ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏰᎵᏉ ᎬᏩᏍᏕᎸᏗ ᎬᏭᏓᎴᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎦᏛᎦᏁᎴ ᎦᎾᏰᏍᎬ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ;
\ft Who in the days of his flesh, when he had offered up prayers and supplications with strong crying and tears unto him that was able to save him from death, and was heard in that he feared;

\ln Uwetsisgininonv gesei aseno uwohiyuhisda iyulisdodiyi udeloquae ugiliyotsv ugadovhistanei;
\syll ᎤᏪᏥᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎨᏎᎢ ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏬᎯᏳᎯᏍᏓ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᏕᎶᏆᎡ ᎤᎩᎵᏲᏨ ᎤᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏔᏁᎢ;
\ft Though he were a Son, yet learned he obedience by the things which he suffered;

\ln Ale nugolvna nagvnelv, nasgi awatisgi nulistane winasdvna unalisdelvdodi gesv naniv gvwohiyuhvsgi;
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏄᎪᎸᎾ ᎾᎬᏁᎸ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏩᏘᏍᎩ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁ ᏫᎾᏍᏛᎾ ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎬᏬᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ;
\ft And being made perfect, he became the author of eternal salvation unto all them that obey him;

\ln Ale nugvwiyusv atsilvgelohi Meligisidegi nasgiya uwoseha Unelanvhi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸᎨᎶᎯ ᎺᎵᎩᏏᏕᎩ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎤᏬᏎᎭ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ.
\ft Called of God an high priest after the order of Melchisedec.

\ln Nasgi na otsinohesgv utsati gohusdi gayogadvdi, ale utsosdiyu digosisodiyi, nvdigalisdodisgv ditsisganoliyu gesv itsadvgodiyi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎣᏥᏃᎮᏍᎬ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎦᏲᎦᏛᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏦᏍᏗᏳ ᏗᎪᏏᏐᏗᏱ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬ ᏗᏥᏍᎦᏃᎵᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏣᏛᎪᏗᏱ.
\ft Of whom we have many things to say, and hard to be uttered, seeing ye are dull of hearing.

\ln Nahiyuyeno yeliquo digetsadeyodi etseliselvi, udulvdiquo nitsalisdaneha gilo taline itseyodiyi nusdv igvyiyi dideloquasdi gesv Unelanvhi utseli kanohedv; ale unvdi unadulisgi nasgiya nitsalistanv, vtlano uyvsdi alisdayvdi.
\syll ᏀᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᏰᎵᏉ ᏗᎨᏣᏕᏲᏗ ᎡᏤᎵᏎᎸᎢ, ᎤᏚᎸᏗᏉ ᏂᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᎭ ᎩᎶ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎢᏤᏲᏗᏱ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎢᎬᏱᏱ ᏗᏕᎶᏆᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᏅᏗ ᎤᎾᏚᎵᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏂᏣᎵᏍᏔᏅ, ᎥᏝᏃ ᎤᏴᏍᏗ ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗ.
\ft For when for the time ye ought to be teachers, ye have need that one teach you again which be the first principles of the oracles of God; and are become such as have need of milk, and not of strong meat.

\ln Nanivyeno gilo unvdi analisdayvdisgi vtla unigadovsvhi yigeso kanohedv adudalesdodi gesvi; diniyoliquoyeno.
\syll ᎾᏂᎥᏰᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏅᏗ ᎠᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏍᎩ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏂᎦᏙᎥᏒᎯ ᏱᎨᏐ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎠᏚᏓᎴᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᏗᏂᏲᎵᏉᏰᏃ.
\ft For every one that useth milk is unskillful in the word of righteousness: for he is a babe.

\ln Uyvsdisgini alisdayvdi tsunadvnaya unelisdayvdodi gesoi, nasgi na unigisahv iyusdi gvwanadolehohisdi geso osdv gesv nusdvi, ale nusdv uyo gesvi.
\syll ᎤᏴᏍᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗ ᏧᎾᏛᎾᏯ ᎤᏁᎵᏍᏓᏴᏙᏗ ᎨᏐᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᏂᎩᏌᎲ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎬᏩᎾᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏐ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎨᏒ ᏄᏍᏛᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎤᏲ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft But strong meat belongeth to them that are of full age, even those who by reason of use have their senses exercised to discern both good and evil.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi idihiyasgv alenvdodi Galonedv utseli dideyodi gesvi, nigalulogvna gesv iyvdv widiyeiloga; taline gagusdvdi nidihvsgvna ganetliyvsdi gesv odanvdv ugvwali, adahihiquo digalvwisdanedi tsigi, ale Unelanvhi gohiyudi gesvi,
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏗᎯᏯᏍᎬ ᎠᎴᏅᏙᏗ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏗᏕᏲᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏂᎦᎷᎶᎬᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏫᏗᏰᎢᎶᎦ; ᏔᎵᏁ ᎦᎫᏍᏛᏗ ᏂᏗᎲᏍᎬᎾ ᎦᏁᏟᏴᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎣᏓᏅᏛ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ, ᎠᏓᎯᎯᏉ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ,
\ft Therefore leaving the principles of the doctrine of Christ, let us go on unto perfection; not laying again the foundation of repentance from dead works, and of faith toward God,

\ln Didawosdi gesv dideyonvhi ugvwali, ale didasitadisdi gesv ugvwali, ale tsuniyohusvhi tsunalehisodi gesv ugvwali, ale ulisquadisdi nigesvna digugododi gesv ugvwali.
\syll ᏗᏓᏬᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏗᏕᏲᏅᎯ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏓᏏᏔᏗᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᏧᎾᎴᎯᏐᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏗᎫᎪᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ.
\ft Of the doctrine of baptisms, and of laying on of hands, and of resurrection of the dead, and of eternal judgment.

\ln Ale nasgi hia nvdadadvneli iyuno Unelanvhi yigalisgolvdanelv.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏅᏓᏓᏛᏁᎵ ᎢᏳᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏱᎦᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᎸ.
\ft And this will we do, if God permit.

\ln Gvwatlisdiyeno nasgi na ilvhiyu iga gegadisdanelvhi gesvi, ale unanelotanvhi gesv galvloi nvdayudalenvhi adanedi gesvi, ale Galvquodiyu Adanvdo gegatloyastanv getsinelvhi.
\syll ᎬᏩᏟᏍᏗᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᎢᎦ ᎨᎦᏗᏍᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏁᎶᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎦᎸᎶᎢ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᎠᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎨᎦᏠᏯᏍᏔᏅ ᎨᏥᏁᎸᎯ.
\ft For it is impossible for those who were once enlightened, and have tasted of the heavenly gift, and were made partakers of the Holy Ghost,

\ln Ale unanelotanvhi tsigi osdv kanohedv Unelanvhi utseliga, ale ulinigidv gesv ulisqualvdi gesvi,
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏁᎶᏔᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᎸᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ,
\ft And have tasted the good word of God, and the powers of the world to come,

\ln Nasgi tsuniyosvhi gesvi, gvwatlisdi taline itse igegvnediyi ganetliyvsdi gesv dunadanvdv wuniluhisdiyi; unvsvyeno taline unadadvnelvhi igi Unelanvhi Uwetsi, ale gvnigesv gvwadehohistanvhi igi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏂᏲᏒᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎬᏩᏟᏍᏗ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎢᏤ ᎢᎨᎬᏁᏗᏱ ᎦᏁᏟᏴᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏚᎾᏓᏅᏛ ᏭᏂᎷᎯᏍᏗᏱ; ᎤᏅᏒᏰᏃ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎤᎾᏓᏛᏁᎸᎯ ᎢᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏪᏥ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎬᏩᏕᎰᎯᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎢᎩ.
\ft If they shall fall away, to renew them again unto repentance; seeing they crucify to themselves the Son of God afresh, and put him to an open shame.

\ln Gadohiyeno tsaditasgo ama yano ugahnanihihvi, ale tsigananugowisgo advsvvsgi gohusdi unvdodi nasgi na gadohi getsiloganelvhi, nasgi Unelanvhi osdv nadvnehoi.
\syll ᎦᏙᎯᏰᏃ ᏣᏗᏔᏍᎪ ᎠᎹ ᏯᏃ ᎤᎦᎿᏂᎯᎲᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᎦᎾᏄᎪᏫᏍᎪ ᎠᏛᏒᎥᏍᎩ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏅᏙᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎦᏙᎯ ᎨᏥᎶᎦᏁᎸᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎾᏛᏁᎰᎢ.
\ft For the earth which drinketh in the rain that cometh oft upon it, and bringeth forth herbs meet for them by whom it is dressed, receiveth blessing from God:

\ln Nasgisgini na tsisdunigisdi ale kanugalv advsgvi adinvdiquo, ale asgaisdiyi gesv navniyu nusdidegoi, nasgi ulisqualvdi gesv agohvsdodi tsigi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ Ꮎ ᏥᏍᏚᏂᎩᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎧᏄᎦᎸ ᎠᏛᏍᎬᎢ ᎠᏗᏅᏗᏉ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏍᎦᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎨᏒ ᎾᎥᏂᏳ ᏄᏍᏗᏕᎪᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᎸᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎪᎲᏍᏙᏗ ᏥᎩ.
\ft But that which beareth thorns and briers is rejected, and is nigh unto cursing; whose end is to be burned.

\ln Aseno, nihi gesv itsvgeyui, nvtlihiyu osdv udugi itsvyvnaneha, ale alisdelvdodi gesv ugvwali tali udvdidegvi, hiasgininonv notsiweha.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ, ᏂᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏨᎨᏳᎢ, ᏅᏟᎯᏳ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎢᏨᏴᎾᏁᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᏔᎵ ᎤᏛᏗᏕᎬᎢ, ᎯᎠᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᏃᏥᏪᎭ.
\ft But, beloved, we are persuaded better things of you, and things that accompany salvation, though we thus speak.

\ln Unelanvhiyeno vtla niduyugodvna igvwadvnedi yigi nasgi uwagewisdiyi detsilvwisdanelv ale gvnigesv nitsvnelv itsigeyusv deudovi.  Nasgi detsisdelvhidolv unadanvti, ale asiquo detsisdelisgvi.
\syll ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏂᏚᏳᎪᏛᎾ ᎢᎬᏩᏛᏁᏗ ᏱᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏩᎨᏫᏍᏗᏱ ᏕᏥᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸ ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᏨᏁᎸ ᎢᏥᎨᏳᏒ ᏕᎤᏙᎥᎢ.  ᎾᏍᎩ ᏕᏥᏍᏕᎸᎯᏙᎸ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏏᏉ ᏕᏥᏍᏕᎵᏍᎬᎢ.
\ft For God is not unrighteous to forget your work and labour of love, which ye have shewed toward his name, in that ye have ministered to the saints, and do minister.

\ln Ale ogaduliha nitsiv itsisiyvwiha gesv gvlisquadisgi nasgiya igai itsatlinigvnediyi gvni utsati nudlasidvsvna udugi gvdi gesv witsiyilolvha;
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎣᎦᏚᎵᎭ ᏂᏥᎥ ᎢᏥᏏᏴᏫᎭ ᎨᏒ ᎬᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎢᏣᏟᏂᎬᏁᏗᏱ ᎬᏂ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏄᏜᏏᏛᏒᎾ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎬᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏫᏥᏱᎶᎸᎭ;
\ft And we desire that every one of you do shew the same diligence to the full assurance of hope unto the end:

\ln Nasgi iyusdi tlesdi itsadanulvdiquo yigesesdi, ditsisdawadegisgini gesesdi nasgi na unohiyusv ale dinvnidiyu gesv anvdisgv unatseli nunvnelv aduistanvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎢᏣᏓᏄᎸᏗᏉ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᏗᏥᏍᏓᏩᏕᎩᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᏃᎯᏳᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏅᏂᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏅᏗᏍᎬ ᎤᎾᏤᎵ ᏄᏅᏁᎸ ᎠᏚᎢᏍᏔᏅᎢ.
\ft That ye be not slothful, but followers of them who through faith and patience inherit the promises.

\ln Unelanvhiyeno Equahami uduisdanelv, nasgi gilo nvwadale utli iyatsilvquodi svhv gvwaselidodi nigesvna gesei, uwasv ehv uselidotanei,
\syll ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ ᎡᏆᎭᎻ ᎤᏚᎢᏍᏓᏁᎸ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎩᎶ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᎤᏟ ᎢᏯᏥᎸᏉᏗ ᏒᎲ ᎬᏩᏎᎵᏙᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎤᏩᏒ ᎡᎲ ᎤᏎᎵᏙᏔᏁᎢ,
\ft For when God made promise to Abraham, because he could swear by no greater, he sware by himself,

\ln Hia nuwesei, Udohiyuhiya utsati osdv nvdagvyadvneli, ale utsati dagvnequoi.
\syll ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏅᏓᎬᏯᏛᏁᎵ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏓᎬᏁᏉᎢ.
\ft Saying, Surely blessing I will bless thee, and multiplying I will multiply thee.

\ln Howano gohidiyu ugatidv atsinele aduistanvhi gesvi.
\syll ᎰᏩᏃ ᎪᎯᏗᏳ ᎤᎦᏘᏛ ᎠᏥᏁᎴ ᎠᏚᎢᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft And so, after he had patiently endured, he obtained the promise.

\ln Yvwiyeno udohiyuhi utli iyatsilvquodi ehv gegaselidodisgoi; ale aselitanvhi gesv (gohusdi) asdayidisdodi ayohisdisgi geso anadisvhihvi.
\syll ᏴᏫᏰᏃ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎤᏟ ᎢᏯᏥᎸᏉᏗ ᎡᎲ ᎨᎦᏎᎵᏙᏗᏍᎪᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎠᏎᎵᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎠᏍᏓᏱᏗᏍᏙᏗ ᎠᏲᎯᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᎨᏐ ᎠᎾᏗᏒᎯᎲᎢ.
\ft For men verily swear by the greater: and an oath for confirmation is to them an end of all strife.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi Unelanvhi udulisgv utli igai gvnigesv itsuwanediyi getsiduisdanelvhi nasgi gvwadanetliyvsdi nigesvna gesv nusdv adanvtesgvi, aselidvsgv usdayistanei.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎬ ᎤᏟ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏧᏩᏁᏗᏱ ᎨᏥᏚᎢᏍᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏩᏓᏁᏟᏴᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎠᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬᎢ, ᎠᏎᎵᏛᏍᎬ ᎤᏍᏓᏱᏍᏔᏁᎢ.
\ft Wherein God, willing more abundantly to shew unto the heirs of promise the immutability of his counsel, confirmed it by an oath:

\ln Ale nasgi tali nulinetsv dedvdisgv nasgi gvwadanetliyvsdi nigesvna gesvi, nahna gvwatsigodi nigesvna tsigeha Unelanvhi, ayv igiyolvhi tsigi igadisgalodiyi, ulinigidv igigalisdadisgi gegiwadvdi iyulisdodiyi, nasgi diginiyvdiyi udugi gvdi egiwasadanehvi;
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏔᎵ ᏄᎵᏁᏨ ᏕᏛᏗᏍᎬ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏩᏓᏁᏟᏴᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏀᎾ ᎬᏩᏥᎪᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏥᎨᎭ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎠᏴ ᎢᎩᏲᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎢᎦᏗᏍᎦᎶᏗᏱ, ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᎢᎩᎦᎵᏍᏓᏗᏍᎩ ᎨᎩᏩᏛᏗ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎩᏂᏴᏗᏱ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎬᏗ ᎡᎩᏩᏌᏓᏁᎲᎢ;
\ft That by two immutable things, in which it was impossible for God to lie, we might have a strong consolation, who have fled for refuge to lay hold upon the hope set before us:

\ln Nasgi udugi gvdi gesv nasgiya adanvdo ganahisdodi tsigi, esga nigalisdisgvna ale gvdisiyvsdi nigesvna, ale nasgi tsiwayvhiha nasgi ayedoladv udiditlv;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎬᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎦᏀᎢᏍᏙᏗ ᏥᎩ, ᎡᏍᎦ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᏍᎬᎾ ᎠᎴ ᎬᏗᏏᏴᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏩᏴᎯᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏰᏙᎳᏛ ᎤᏗᏗᏢ;
\ft Which hope we have as an anchor of the soul, both sure and stedfast, and which entereth into that within the veil;

\ln Nahna Tsisa igvyi egi wigiyvselvhi tsigi, nasgi nugvwiyusv atsilvgelohi nigohilv atsikanvhi tsigi, Meligisidegi nusdv nasgiyai.
\syll ᏀᎾ ᏥᏌ ᎢᎬᏱ ᎡᎩ ᏫᎩᏴᏎᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸᎨᎶᎯ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎠᏥᎧᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎺᎵᎩᏏᏕᎩ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ.
\ft Whither the forerunner is for us entered, even Jesus, made an high priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec.

\ln Hiayeno nasgi Madagisidegi, Ugvwiyuhi Sedamu, atsilvgelohi gesei Unelanvhi wasdv galvladi ehi utseliga, nasgi Equahami tsidutlose tsutsvsidisv widuhonvhi unigvwiyuhi, ale osdv tsunetselei;
\syll ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎹᏓᎩᏏᏕᎩ, ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏎᏓᎽ, ᎠᏥᎸᎨᎶᎯ ᎨᏎᎢ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏩᏍᏛ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᏆᎭᎻ ᏥᏚᏠᏎ ᏧᏨᏏᏗᏒ ᏫᏚᎰᏅᎯ ᎤᏂᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏧᏁᏤᎴᎢ;
\ft For this Melchisedec, king of Salem, priest of the most high God, who met Abraham returning from the slaughter of the kings, and blessed him;

\ln Ale nasgi nasquo Equahami nigadv tsugvwalodi ayehv asgohine gotsaledv tsunelvnei; igvyiyi gesv [dudov] anetlvtanvhi gesv Ugvwiyuhi duyugodv iyadvnehi gadvga, onino nasquo Selani ugvwiyuhi agoseha, nasgi Ugvwiyuhi nvwadohiyadv udulisgi tsigadvga.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎡᏆᎭᎻ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎠᏰᎲ ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏁ ᎪᏣᎴᏛ ᏧᏁᎸᏁᎢ; ᎢᎬᏱᏱ ᎨᏒ ᏚᏙᎥdata is invalid ᎠᏁᏢᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᎯ ᎦᏛᎦ, ᎣᏂᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏎᎳᏂ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᎪᏎᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎩ ᏥᎦᏛᎦ.
\ft To whom also Abraham gave a tenth part of all; first being by interpretation King of righteousness, and after that also King of Salem, which is, King of peace;

\ln Nasgi utseda ale utsi nanehvna tsigese, unanetlvtanvhi aninigidv tsigese, dugitsvnegv nvgudalenvhvna tsigese, ale ehv wusditsihisdi nigesvna tsigesei, Unelanvhisgini Nawetsi nasgiya tsinagvnelei, atsilvgelohi tseha nigohilvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏤᏓ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏥ ᎾᏁᎲᎾ ᏥᎨᏎ, ᎤᎾᏁᏢᏔᏅᎯ ᎠᏂᏂᎩᏛ ᏥᎨᏎ, ᏚᎩᏨᏁᎬ ᏅᎫᏓᎴᏅᎲᎾ ᏥᎨᏎ, ᎠᎴ ᎡᎲ ᏭᏍᏗᏥᎯᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏥᎨᏎᎢ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎾᏪᏥ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏥᎾᎬᏁᎴᎢ, ᎠᏥᎸᎨᎶᎯ ᏤᎭ ᏂᎪᎯᎸᎢ.
\ft Without father, without mother, without descent, having neither beginning of days, nor end of life; but made like unto the Son of God; abideth a priest continually.

\ln Etsadanvdvlinadi nigav atsilvquodiyu gesv hia nasgi asgaya, nasgi agayvlige Equahami uwasv asgohine gotsaledv udawonvdv ayehv unelvi.
\syll ᎡᏣᏓᏅᏛᎵᎾᏗ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᎡᏆᎭᎻ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏁ ᎪᏣᎴᏛ ᎤᏓᏬᏅᏛ ᎠᏰᎲ ᎤᏁᎸᎢ.
\ft Now consider how great this man was, unto whom even the patriarch Abraham gave the tenth of the spoils.

\ln Ale udohiyuhi Liwi tsuwetsi atsilvgelasdi digalvwisdanedi gesv getsinedi gesvi gegasvgalvdisge asgohine gotsaledv tsuninitlvdiyi yvwi nasgiya nigvnv dikahnawadvsdi, nasgi analinvtli gesvi, nasquo Equahami ayeli nvdayunadalenvhi gesvi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎵᏫ ᏧᏪᏥ ᎠᏥᎸᎨᎳᏍᏗ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎨᏥᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ ᎨᎦᏒᎦᎸᏗᏍᎨ ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏁ ᎪᏣᎴᏛ ᏧᏂᏂᏢᏗᏱ ᏴᏫ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏂᎬᏅ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏟ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᏉ ᎡᏆᎭᎻ ᎠᏰᎵ ᏅᏓᏳᎾᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft And verily they that are of the sons of Levi, who receive the office of the priesthood, have a commandment to take tithes of the people according to the law, that is, of their brethren, though they come out of the loins of Abraham:

\ln Nasgisgini na unanetlvtanvdv gesv Liwi anilasdalv nvtsudalenvhvna tsigi, asgohine gotsaledv dudanilvtsele Equahami, ale osdv unetsele aduistanvhi gesv tsagagenvya.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ Ꮎ ᎤᎾᏁᏢᏔᏅᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎵᏫ ᎠᏂᎳᏍᏓᎸ ᏅᏧᏓᎴᏅᎲᎾ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏁ ᎪᏣᎴᏛ ᏚᏓᏂᎸᏤᎴ ᎡᏆᎭᎻ, ᎠᎴ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎤᏁᏤᎴ ᎠᏚᎢᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏣᎦᎨᏅᏯ.
\ft But he whose descent is not counted from them received tithes of Abraham, and blessed him that had the promises.

\ln Ale nudlasidvsvna esga iyatsilvquodi gesv osdv unetseho utli iyatsilvquodi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏄᏜᏏᏛᏒᎾ ᎡᏍᎦ ᎢᏯᏥᎸᏉᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎤᏁᏤᎰ ᎤᏟ ᎢᏯᏥᎸᏉᏗ.
\ft And without all contradiction the less is blessed of the better.

\ln Ale ani yvwi diniyohusgi tsigi asgohine gotsaledv igetsinehoi; nahnasgini ugisei nasgi na eha agoselvhi tsigi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂ ᏴᏫ ᏗᏂᏲᎱᏍᎩ ᏥᎩ ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏁ ᎪᏣᎴᏛ ᎢᎨᏥᏁᎰᎢ; ᏀᎾᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᎩᏎᎢ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎡᎭ ᎠᎪᏎᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ.
\ft And here men that die receive tithes; but there he receiveth them, of whom it is witnessed that he liveth.

\ln Ale hiaquo yinagiwesv, Liwi nasquo asgohine gotsaledv didanilvgi tsigi, asgohine gotsaledv uguyvhe nahiyu Equahami uguyvhv.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠᏉ ᏱᎾᎩᏪᏒ, ᎵᏫ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏁ ᎪᏣᎴᏛ ᏗᏓᏂᎸᎩ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏁ ᎪᏣᎴᏛ ᎤᎫᏴᎮ ᏀᎢᏳ ᎡᏆᎭᎻ ᎤᎫᏴᎲ.
\ft And as I may so say, Levi also, who receiveth tithes, payed tithes in Abraham.

\ln Asiquoyeno udoda ayelv ayaei nahiyu Maligisidegi tsidutlosgei.
\syll ᎠᏏᏉᏰᏃ ᎤᏙᏓ ᎠᏰᎸ ᎠᏯᎡᎢ ᏀᎢᏳ ᎹᎵᎩᏏᏕᎩ ᏥᏚᏠᏍᎨᎢ.
\ft For he was yet in the loins of his father, when Melchisedec met him.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi iyuno atsilvgelasdi gesv Aniliwi tsigegasvgalode, nvsganvna igvwadadvnedi yigesei, (atsilvgelasdiyeno gesv ale dikahnawadvsdi dunadudate yvwi ganadanilvtsv) gadono asi udulvdi nigalisdisge nvwadale atsilvgelohi unanugoisdiyi Maligisidegi nusdv nasgiyai, Elanino nasgiya gayegosedi nigesvna gesvi?
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏳᏃ ᎠᏥᎸᎨᎳᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏂᎵᏫ ᏥᎨᎦᏒᎦᎶᏕ, ᏅᏍᎦᏅᎾ ᎢᎬᏩᏓᏛᏁᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ, ᎠᏥᎸᎨᎳᏍᏗᏰᏃ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏚᎾᏚᏓᏖ ᏴᏫ ᎦᎾᏓᏂᎸᏨ ᎦᏙᏃ ᎠᏏ ᎤᏚᎸᏗ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᏍᎨ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᎠᏥᎸᎨᎶᎯ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎹᎵᎩᏏᏕᎩ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ, ᎡᎳᏂᏃ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎦᏰᎪᏎᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ?
\ft If therefore perfection were by the Levitical priesthood, (for under it the people received the law,) what further need was there that another priest should rise after the order of Melchisedec, and not be called after the order of Aaron?

\ln Atsilvgelasdiyeno gesv udanetliyvdv gesvi, ase nasquo ganetliyvdv nigalisdiha dikahnawadvsdi.
\syll ᎠᏥᎸᎨᎳᏍᏗᏰᏃ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏓᏁᏟᏴᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᏎ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎦᏁᏟᏴᏛ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᎭ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ.
\ft For the priesthood being changed, there is made of necessity a change also of the law.

\ln Nasgiyeno na hia nasgi ugvwali atsineistanvhi gesv utsatini anilasdalv gela gesvgi, nasgi [anilasdalv] udalenvhi vtla gilo atsilvgelasdiyi yidulvwisdanehei.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ Ꮎ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᎠᏥᏁᎢᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏣᏘᏂ ᎠᏂᎳᏍᏓᎸ ᎨᎳ ᎨᏒᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏂᎳᏍᏓᎸdata is invalid ᎤᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᎠᏥᎸᎨᎳᏍᏗᏱ ᏱᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎮᎢ.
\ft For he of whom these things are spoken pertaineth to another tribe, of which no man gave attendance at the altar.

\ln Gvnigesviyuyeno nigalisdiha nasgi igatseli Ugvwiyuhi Tsuda anilasdalv tsudalenvhvi; nasgi anilasdalv Mosi vtla yiduneistane atsilvgelasdi gesv ugvwali.
\syll ᎬᏂᎨᏒᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏧᏓ ᎠᏂᎳᏍᏓᎸ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᎲᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏂᎳᏍᏓᎸ ᎼᏏ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏚᏁᎢᏍᏔᏁ ᎠᏥᎸᎨᎳᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ.
\ft For it is evident that our Lord sprang out of Juda; of which tribe Moses spake nothing concerning priesthood.

\ln Ale asi utli gvnigesv nigalisdiha, iyuno Meligisidegi nusdv nasgiya nvwadale atsilvgelohi yigananugoga,
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎠᏏ ᎤᏟ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᎭ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎺᎵᎩᏏᏕᎩ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᎠᏥᎸᎨᎶᎯ ᏱᎦᎾᏄᎪᎦ,
\ft And it is yet far more evident: for that after the similitude of Melchisedec there ariseth another priest,

\ln Nasgi atsigigelohi nagvnelv dikahnawadvsdi uquedali ugvwali nasgiya nagvnelvna gesvi, gvnidvsgini alisquadisgi nigesvna ulinigvgv nasgiyai.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏥᎩᎨᎶᎯ ᎾᎬᏁᎸ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᎬᏁᎸᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎬᏂᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎤᎵᏂᎬᎬ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ.
\ft Who is made, not after the law of a carnal commandment, but after the power of an endless life.

\ln Hiayeno nigaweha kanegvi, Atsilvhelohi geha nigohilvi Meligisidegi nusdv nasgiyai.
\syll ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᏂᎦᏪᎭ ᎧᏁᎬᎢ, ᎠᏥᎸᎮᎶᎯ ᎨᎭ ᏂᎪᎯᎸᎢ ᎺᎵᎩᏏᏕᎩ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ.
\ft For he testifieth, Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec.

\ln Udohiyuhiyeno iyvdv igvnelvhi nigalisdiha igvyiyi ulinetsvhi dikahnawadvsdi, awanigalahiyu gesv ale gvwadasdelvdi nigesvna gesv iyusdi.
\syll ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏰᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎢᎬᏁᎸᎯ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᎭ ᎢᎬᏱᏱ ᎤᎵᏁᏨᎯ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ, ᎠᏩᏂᎦᎳᎯᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᏓᏍᏕᎸᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ.
\ft For there is verily a disannulling of the commandment going before for the weakness and unprofitableness thereof.

\ln Dikahnawadvsdiyeno vtla galulogi nigesvna igvnehi yigese gohusdi; utlisgini itlasdv udugi gvdi gesv ayvtanilvhi tsigi, nasgi idvdisgv nav gayedilutsedi tsinigalisdiha Unelanvhi galulogi nigesvna nigvneha.
\syll ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗᏰᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎦᎷᎶᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᎬᏁᎯ ᏱᎨᏎ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ; ᎤᏟᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᏝᏍᏛ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎬᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏴᏔᏂᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏛᏗᏍᎬ ᎾᎥ ᎦᏰᏗᎷᏤᏗ ᏥᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᎭ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎦᎷᎶᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏂᎬᏁᎭ.
\ft For the law made nothing perfect, but the bringing in of a better hope did; by the which we draw nigh unto God.

\ln Ale nasgi aselitanvhi gesv gvtanvhi tsigi [Galonedv atsilvgelohi iyagvnelvhi tsigi,]
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏎᎵᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏔᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎠᏥᎸᎨᎶᎯ ᎢᏯᎬᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ,data is invalid
\ft And inasmuch as not without an oath he was made priest:

\ln (Nasgiyeno na atsilvanelohi nigegvnehe aselitanvhi nigesvna; hiasgini na aselitanvhi gesv agvdanelei, hia nasgi iyuweselvhi, Ugvwiyuhi uselitanv ale vtla aganetliyvna nihi atsilvhelohi nigohilvi Meligisidegi nusdv nasgiyai.)
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ Ꮎ ᎠᏥᎸᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᏂᎨᎬᏁᎮ ᎠᏎᎵᏔᏅᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ; ᎯᎠᏍᎩᏂ Ꮎ ᎠᏎᎵᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎬᏓᏁᎴᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏪᏎᎸᎯ, ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏎᎵᏔᏅ ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᎠᎦᏁᏟᏴᎾ ᏂᎯ ᎠᏥᎸᎮᎶᎯ ᏂᎪᎯᎸᎢ ᎺᎵᎩᏏᏕᎩ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ.
\ft (For those priests were made without an oath; but this with an oath by him that said unto him, The Lord sware and will not repent, Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec:)

\ln Nasgiya iyvdv ulosvsdi tali advdisgi wigvnele Tsisa kanohedv datlohisdvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎤᎶᏒᏍᏗ ᏔᎵ ᎠᏛᏗᏍᎩ ᏫᎬᏁᎴ ᏥᏌ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏓᏠᎯᏍᏛᎢ.
\ft By so much was Jesus made a surety of a better testament.

\ln Ale nasgi na hia atsilvanelohi unitsadvgi, vtlayeno gohidv gvwanadedi yigese ayohuhisdi gesv iyusdi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏥᎸᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᎤᏂᏣᏛᎩ, ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᎪᎯᏛ ᎬᏩᎾᏕᏗ ᏱᎨᏎ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ.
\ft And they truly were many priests, because they were not suffered to continue by reason of death:

\ln Hiasgini [asgaya] alisquadisgi nigesvna tseha ulosihvsdi nigesvna atsilvgelohi gesvi.
\syll ᎯᎠᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏍᎦᏯdata is invalid ᎠᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏤᎭ ᎤᎶᏏᎲᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎠᏥᎸᎨᎶᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft But this man, because he continueth ever, hath an unchangeable priesthood.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi nigohilv yeliquo nasquo digvwasdelvdi nasgi na uwasv gvwaluhisdanehi Unelanvhi anilutsehvi, winasdvnayeno eha tsulisdiyedanediyi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᏰᎵᏉ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏗᎬᏩᏍᏕᎸᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎬᏩᎷᎯᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᏂᎷᏤᎲᎢ, ᏫᎾᏍᏛᎾᏰᏃ ᎡᎭ ᏧᎵᏍᏗᏰᏓᏁᏗᏱ.
\ft Wherefore he is able also to save them to the uttermost that come unto God by him, seeing he ever liveth to make intercession for them.

\ln Nasgiyeno iyusdi atsilvgelohi igililohvsgi gesvgi, nasgi nasganvna, uyo igvwadadvnedi nigesvna, asgana nudanvgalvna, anisgana anehv agadadaletanvhi, ale galvlo udiditlv iyvdv atsisaladanvhi;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏥᎸᎨᎶᎯ ᎢᎩᎵᎶᎲᏍᎩ ᎨᏒᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᎦᏅᎾ, ᎤᏲ ᎢᎬᏩᏓᏛᏁᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎠᏍᎦᎾ ᏄᏓᏅᎦᎸᎾ, ᎠᏂᏍᎦᎾ ᎠᏁᎲ ᎠᎦᏓᏓᎴᏔᏅᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᎸᎶ ᎤᏗᏗᏢ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎠᏥᏌᎳᏓᏅᎯ;
\ft For such an high priest became us, who is holy, harmless, undefiled, separate from sinners, and made higher than the heavens;

\ln Nasgi na udulvdi nulisdanehvna nidugitsvnisv atsilvuwelasdiyi, nasgi nanadvnehv nunigvwiyusadegi atsilvanelohi, igvyi unvsv unisganvtsv aguyvdodi, iquono yvwi unisganvtsv aguyvdodi; nasgiyeno hia saquo nudvnelei, nahiyu uwasv udalisgolvtanv.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᏚᎸᏗ ᏄᎵᏍᏓᏁᎲᎾ ᏂᏚᎩᏨᏂᏒ ᎠᏥᎸᎤᏪᎳᏍᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᎾᏛᏁᎲ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ ᎠᏥᎸᎠᏁᎶᎯ, ᎢᎬᏱ ᎤᏅᏒ ᎤᏂᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᎠᎫᏴᏙᏗ, ᎢᏉᏃ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏂᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᎠᎫᏴᏙᏗ; ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏌᏉ ᏄᏛᏁᎴᎢ, ᏀᎢᏳ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎤᏓᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏅ.
\ft Who needeth not daily, as those high priests, to offer up sacrifice, first for his own sins, and then for the people's: for this he did once, when he offered up himself.

\ln Dikahnawadvsdiyeno yvwi diniwanagala nunigvwiyusv atsilvanelohi nunvnehoi; kanetsvhisgini aselitanvhi asdayidistanvhi gesvi, nasgi dikahnawadvsdi ulinetsv oni tsulinetsei, uwetsi [atsilvgelohi] nuwanele nasgi nigohilv galulogi nigesvna tsigi.
\syll ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗᏰᏃ ᏴᏫ ᏗᏂᏩᎾᎦᎳ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᏄᏅᏁᎰᎢ; ᎧᏁᏨᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏎᎵᏔᏅᎯ ᎠᏍᏓᏱᏗᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎤᎵᏁᏨ ᎣᏂ ᏧᎵᏁᏤᎢ, ᎤᏪᏥ ᎠᏥᎸᎨᎶᎯdata is invalid ᏄᏩᏁᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎦᎷᎶᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏥᎩ.
\ft For the law maketh men high priests which have infirmity; but the word of the oath, which was since the law, maketh the Son, who is consecrated for evermore.

\ln Nasgino hia tsidinoheha, hia nasgi ho nugvwiyusv nigalisdiha; nasgi nusdi igikaha nugvwiyusv atsilvgelohi, nasgi agatisiditlv Galvquodiyu gasgilv galvloi uwenv;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏗᏃᎮᎭ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮀ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᎭ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏗ ᎢᎩᎧᎭ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸᎨᎶᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎦᏘᏏᏗᏢ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎦᏍᎩᎸ ᎦᎸᎶᎢ ᎤᏪᏅ;
\ft Now of the things which we have spoken this is the sum: We have such an high priest, who is set on the right hand of the throne of the Majesty in the heavens;

\ln Tsulvwisdanehi galvquodiyu digesvi ale udohiyuhi digalitsodvi, nasgi Ugvwiyuhi ulitsotanvhi gesvi, vtlano yvwi.
\syll ᏧᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᏗᎨᏒᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᏗᎦᎵᏦᏛᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᎵᏦᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎥᏝᏃ ᏴᏫ.
\ft A minister of the sanctuary, and of the true tabernacle, which the Lord pitched, and not man.

\ln Nanivyeno nunigvwiyusv atsilvanelohi getsinetselvhi geso tsunalisgolvdodiyi adanedi gesv ale atsilvdigelasdodi gesvi; nasgi iyusdi hia nasgi asgaya nasquo ase gohusdi uyohisdi gese ulisgolvdodi.
\syll ᎾᏂᎥᏰᏃ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᎨᏥᏁᏤᎸᎯ ᎨᏐ ᏧᎾᎵᏍᎪᎸᏙᏗᏱ ᎠᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏥᎸᏗᎨᎳᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏎ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏲᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏎ ᎤᎵᏍᎪᎸᏙᏗ.
\ft For every high priest is ordained to offer gifts and sacrifices: wherefore it is of necessity that this man have somewhat also to offer.

\ln Iyuyeno elohi yigayehei, vtla atsilvgelohi yigagesei, ianehayeno atsilvanelohi adanedi gesv analisgolvdisgi dikahnawadvsdi nigvnv nasgiyai;
\syll ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏱᎦᏰᎮᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᏥᎸᎨᎶᎯ ᏱᎦᎨᏎᎢ, ᎢᎠᏁᎭᏰᏃ ᎠᏥᎸᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᎠᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎾᎵᏍᎪᎸᏗᏍᎩ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏂᎬᏅ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ;
\ft For if he were on earth, he should not be a priest, seeing that there are priests that offer gifts according to the law:

\ln Nasgi nahna tsidunilvwisdaneha ditlilostanvhi ale udawadisdodv galvladi ehi galitsodvi, nasgiya [Unelanvhi] Mosi tsunetsele nahiyu galitsododi tsvdigotlvnisei; hagasayastanvha tsudvnei, Dehotlvsgv nigadv tsudalenvdv nasgiya ditlilosdodi ahv nasgi tsetsananugowiselv odalv nvnelvha.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏀᎾ ᏥᏚᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎭ ᏗᏟᎶᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᏩᏗᏍᏙᏛ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎦᎵᏦᏛᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯdata is invalid ᎼᏏ ᏧᏁᏤᎴ ᏀᎢᏳ ᎦᎵᏦᏙᏗ ᏨᏗᎪᏢᏂᏎᎢ; ᎭᎦᏌᏯᏍᏔᏅᎭ ᏧᏛᏁᎢ, ᏕᎰᏢᏍᎬ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏗᏟᎶᏍᏙᏗ ᎠᎲ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏤᏣᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᎸ ᎣᏓᎸ ᏅᏁᎸᎭ.
\ft Who serve unto the example and shadow of heavenly things, as Moses was admonished of God when he was about to make the tabernacle: for, See, saith he, that thou make all things according to the pattern shewed to thee in the mount.

\ln Nasgino tsinusdi gohi gesv utli igalvquodi digalvwisdanedi gesv uwadvhv, nvdigalisdodiha ayeli alehvsgi gesv utli iyosdv kanohedv datlohisdv ugvwalvi, nasgi utli iyosdv daduisdv tsulisdayisdi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏥᏄᏍᏗ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏟ ᎢᎦᎸᏉᏗ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏩᏛᎲ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎠᎴᎲᏍᎩ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏟ ᎢᏲᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏓᏠᎯᏍᏛ ᎤᎬᏩᎸᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏟ ᎢᏲᏍᏛ ᏓᏚᎢᏍᏛ ᏧᎵᏍᏓᏱᏍᏗ.
\ft But now hath he obtained a more excellent ministry, by how much also he is the mediator of a better covenant, which was established upon better promises.

\ln Iyuyeno igvyiyi kanohedv datlohisdv gaguhisdodi nigesvna yigesei, vtla nvwadale kanohedv ditlohisdodiyi yigvwanitayolei.
\syll ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᎢᎬᏱᏱ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏓᏠᎯᏍᏛ ᎦᎫᎯᏍᏙᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏗᏠᎯᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏱᎬᏩᏂᏔᏲᎴᎢ.
\ft For if that first covenant had been faultless, then should no place have been sought for the second.

\ln Esgayeno uyelvnv hia niduweselei, Gvniyuquo, dvsqualvhi, adiha Ugvwiyuhi, nasgi itse kanohedv digatsiyatloisdanediyi Isili sidanelvhi gesv ale Tsuda sidanelvhi gesvi.
\syll ᎡᏍᎦᏰᏃ ᎤᏰᎸᏅ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎬᏂᏳᏉ, ᏛᏍᏆᎸᎯ, ᎠᏗᎭ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏤ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏗᎦᏥᏯᏠᎢᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᎢᏏᎵ ᏏᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏧᏓ ᏏᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft For finding fault with them, he saith, Behold, the days come, saith the Lord, when I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel and with the house of Judah:

\ln Vtla nasgiya kanohedv degatsiyatloisdanelv tsunigayvligei, nahiyu ganiyoyanesv gatsinugowisdiyi Itsiquiyi gada ahvi; vtlayeno yunisquanigotane kanohedv degatsiyatloisdanelvi, ale ayv vtla yigatsiyagasayastanei, adiha Ugvwiyuhi.
\syll ᎥᏝ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏕᎦᏥᏯᏠᎢᏍᏓᏁᎸ ᏧᏂᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ, ᏀᎢᏳ ᎦᏂᏲᏯᏁᏒ ᎦᏥᏄᎪᏫᏍᏗᏱ ᎢᏥᏈᏱ ᎦᏓ ᎠᎲᎢ; ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᏳᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏔᏁ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏕᎦᏥᏯᏠᎢᏍᏓᏁᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴ ᎥᏝ ᏱᎦᏥᏯᎦᏌᏯᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᎠᏗᎭ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ.
\ft Not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers in the day when I took them by the hand to lead them out of the land of Egypt; because they continued not in my covenant, and I regarded them not, saith the Lord.

\ln Hiayeno nasgi nusdesdi kanohedv dodagatsiyatloisdaneli Isili sidanelvhi gesv nahiyu galosonvha adiha Ugvwiyuhi; dunadanvdv dadatsilani diquatseli dikahnawadvsdi, ale tsuninawiyi dodagowelani; Ale ayv Gatsiyanelanvhi gesesdi, unvsvno diquatseli yvwi gesesdi;
\syll ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏙᏓᎦᏥᏯᏠᎢᏍᏓᏁᎵ ᎢᏏᎵ ᏏᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏀᎢᏳ ᎦᎶᏐᏅᎭ ᎠᏗᎭ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ; ᏚᎾᏓᏅᏛ ᏓᏓᏥᎳᏂ ᏗᏆᏤᎵ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏂᎾᏫᏱ ᏙᏓᎪᏪᎳᏂ; ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴ ᎦᏥᏯᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎤᏅᏒᏃ ᏗᏆᏤᎵ ᏴᏫ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ;
\ft For this is the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel after those days, saith the Lord; I will put my laws into their mind, and write them in their hearts: and I will be to them a God, and they shall be to me a people:

\ln Vtla ale gilo asiyvwi gesv nav itsunadali, ale dinadanvtli gesv yigeyohvsgesdi, hia yinigawesgesdi, Higadovhi Ugvwiyuhi; nanivquoyeno gvgigatahiyu gesesdi, usdikani ehv nvdagvwadalenvdv, utli iyatsilvquodi ehv wigvsdi.
\syll ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᎨᏒ ᎾᎥ ᎢᏧᎾᏓᎵ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎾᏓᏅᏟ ᎨᏒ ᏱᎨᏲᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎯᎠ ᏱᏂᎦᏪᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎯᎦᏙᎥᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ; ᎾᏂᎥᏉᏰᏃ ᎬᎩᎦᏔᎯᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎤᏍᏗᎧᏂ ᎡᎲ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏓᎴᏅᏛ, ᎤᏟ ᎢᏯᏥᎸᏉᏗ ᎡᎲ ᏫᎬᏍᏗ.
\ft And they shall not teach every man his neighbour, and every man his brother, saying, Know the Lord: for all shall know me, from the least to the greatest.

\ln Dagatsiyadolitsiyeno utsatini nunadvnelvi, unisganvtsvno ale uyo nunadvnelidolv vtla hnaquo aquanvdadisdi yigesesdi.
\syll ᏓᎦᏥᏯᏙᎵᏥᏰᏃ ᎤᏣᏘᏂ ᏄᎾᏛᏁᎸᎢ, ᎤᏂᏍᎦᏅᏨᏃ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏲ ᏄᎾᏛᏁᎵᏙᎸ ᎥᏝ ᎿᏉ ᎠᏆᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft For I will be merciful to their unrighteousness, and their sins and their iniquities will I remember no more.

\ln Nasgino saquo itse tsigoseha, soi uweti nigvneha.  Gohusdiyeno uweti igvnelvhi ale uwetatsvhi tsigeso, uyotsidenv gesoi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏌᏉ ᎢᏤ ᏥᎪᏎᎭ, ᏐᎢ ᎤᏪᏘ ᏂᎬᏁᎭ.  ᎪᎱᏍᏗᏰᏃ ᎤᏪᏘ ᎢᎬᏁᎸᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏪᏔᏨᎯ ᏥᎨᏐ, ᎤᏲᏥᏕᏅ ᎨᏐᎢ.
\ft In that he saith, A new covenant, he hath made the first old. Now that which decayeth and waxeth old is ready to vanish away.

\ln Alewo udohiyuhi igvyiyi kanohedv datlohisdv dikahnawadvsdi degotlvsvgi unelanvhi utseli digalvwisdanedi ugvwali, ale elohi ehi galvquodiyu galitsodvi.
\syll ᎠᎴᏬ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎢᎬᏱᏱ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏓᏠᎯᏍᏛ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏕᎪᏢᏒᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ, ᎠᎴ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎡᎯ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎦᎵᏦᏛᎢ.
\ft Then verily the first covenant had also ordinances of divine service, and a worldly sanctuary.

\ln Galitsododiyeno unotlvnei, galvquodiyu gesv tsanosehei, nahna igvyiyi dadahidvi, tsigakahe atsvsdodi gagodiyi, ale gasgiloi, ale nahna tsatlahe agadodi gadu;
\syll ᎦᎵᏦᏙᏗᏰᏃ ᎤᏃᏢᏁᎢ, ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᏣᏃᏎᎮᎢ, ᏀᎾ ᎢᎬᏱᏱ ᏓᏓᎯᏛᎢ, ᏥᎦᎧᎮ ᎠᏨᏍᏙᏗ ᎦᎪᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᏍᎩᎶᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏀᎾ ᏣᏝᎮ ᎠᎦᏙᏗ ᎦᏚ;
\ft For there was a tabernacle made; the first, wherein was the candlestick, and the table, and the shewbread; which is called the sanctuary.

\ln Talineno ayedoladv udiditlv hia nasgi galitsodvi utli igalvquodi tsanosehei;
\syll ᏔᎵᏁᏃ ᎠᏰᏙᎳᏛ ᎤᏗᏗᏢ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎵᏦᏛᎢ ᎤᏟ ᎢᎦᎸᏉᏗ ᏣᏃᏎᎮᎢ;
\ft And after the second veil, the tabernacle which is called the Holiest of all;

\ln Nasgi nahna tsahe gohusdi gvdodi adelvdalonige gotlvtanvhi gawasvgi atsilvgelasdi galodi, ale nahna tsitsiye ganesai dikahnawadvsdi digalodiyi adelvdalonige gutlvtanonvhi tsigesei, nahnani tsigale adelvdalonige gotlvtanvhi atelido mana tsigalodei, ale Elani udolanvsdodi tsatsilvsgei, ale nvya diyatenv nahna tsigowele kanohedv datlohisdvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏀᎾ ᏣᎮ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎬᏙᏗ ᎠᏕᎸᏓᎶᏂᎨ ᎪᏢᏔᏅᎯ ᎦᏩᏒᎩ ᎠᏥᎸᎨᎳᏍᏗ ᎦᎶᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏀᎾ ᏥᏥᏰ ᎦᏁᏌᎢ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏗᎦᎶᏗᏱ ᎠᏕᎸᏓᎶᏂᎨ ᎫᏢᏔᏃᏅᎯ ᏥᎨᏎᎢ, ᏀᎾᏂ ᏥᎦᎴ ᎠᏕᎸᏓᎶᏂᎨ ᎪᏢᏔᏅᎯ ᎠᏖᎵᏙ ᎹᎾ ᏥᎦᎶᏕᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎡᎳᏂ ᎤᏙᎳᏅᏍᏙᏗ ᏣᏥᎸᏍᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏅᏯ ᏗᏯᏖᏅ ᏀᎾ ᏥᎪᏪᎴ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏓᏠᎯᏍᏛᎢ.
\ft Which had the golden censer, and the ark of the covenant overlaid round about with gold, wherein was the golden pot that had manna, and Aaron's rod that budded, and the tables of the covenant;

\ln Ale [ganesai] tsiyv galvladitlv anigiluwi galvquodiyu iyanvnehi, nasgi tsunutlvde ganesai gutlvdi; nasgi ugvwali vtla gohi gesv nigadv ganeisdodi yigi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎦᏁᏌᎢdata is invalid ᏥᏴ ᎦᎸᎳᏗᏢ ᎠᏂᎩᎷᏫ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎢᏯᏅᏁᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏄᏢᏕ ᎦᏁᏌᎢ ᎫᏢᏗ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᎥᏝ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎦᏁᎢᏍᏙᏗ ᏱᎩ.
\ft And over it the cherubims of glory shadowing the mercyseat; of which we cannot now speak particularly.

\ln Hiano nasgi osdv igvnehonvhi gesei, atsilvanelohi nigohilv waniyvhihe igvyiyi dadahitlv galitsodvi, widunilvwisdanehe [Unelanvhi] utseli ugvwali.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎢᎬᏁᎰᏅᎯ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎠᏥᎸᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᏩᏂᏴᎯᎮ ᎢᎬᏱᏱ ᏓᏓᎯᏢ ᎦᎵᏦᏛᎢ, ᏫᏚᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎮ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯdata is invalid ᎤᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ.
\ft Now when these things were thus ordained, the priests went always into the first tabernacle, accomplishing the service of God.

\ln Talinesgini wigalitsodv nugvwiyusv atsilvgelohi uwasv saquo winayvhihe nidadetiyvhisvi, vtla ale gigv niganetsehvna yigesei, nasgi uwasv usganvtsv aguyvdodi, ale unitsati yvwi unisganvtsv aguyvdodi.
\syll ᏔᎵᏁᏍᎩᏂ ᏫᎦᎵᏦᏛ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸᎨᎶᎯ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏌᏉ ᏫᎾᏴᎯᎮ ᏂᏓᏕᏘᏴᎯᏒᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎩᎬ ᏂᎦᏁᏤᎲᎾ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎤᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᎠᎫᏴᏙᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏂᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᎠᎫᏴᏙᏗ.
\ft But into the second went the high priest alone once every year, not without blood, which he offered for himself, and for the errors of the people:

\ln Nasgi Galvquodiyu Adanvdo hia nusde gvnigesv nigvnehei, nasgi na utli igalvquodi digesv wiganvnv asi gvnigesv igvnelvhi nigesvna gesvi, asiquo tsinigvwasde igvyiyi galitsodvi;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏍᏕ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᎬᏁᎮᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᏟ ᎢᎦᎸᏉᏗ ᏗᎨᏒ ᏫᎦᏅᏅ ᎠᏏ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᎬᏁᎸᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᏏᏉ ᏥᏂᎬᏩᏍᏕ ᎢᎬᏱᏱ ᎦᎵᏦᏛᎢ;
\ft The Holy Ghost this signifying, that the way into the holiest of all was not yet made manifest, while as the first tabernacle was yet standing:

\ln nasgi galitsodv ditlilostanvhiquo tsigese nahiyu gesvi, nahnani tsidanalisgolvdisge adanedi gesv ale nasquo atsilvgelasdodi, nasgi na iyudvnelvhi yeli nasganvna igvwanedi nigesvna tsigese adanvdo ugvwali gesvi;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎵᏦᏛ ᏗᏟᎶᏍᏔᏅᎯᏉ ᏥᎨᏎ ᏀᎢᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏀᎾᏂ ᏥᏓᎾᎵᏍᎪᎸᏗᏍᎨ ᎠᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏥᎸᎨᎳᏍᏙᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎢᏳᏛᏁᎸᎯ ᏰᎵ ᎾᏍᎦᏅᎾ ᎢᎬᏩᏁᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏥᎨᏎ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᎨᏒᎢ;
\ft Which was a figure for the time then present, in which were offered both gifts and sacrifices, that could not make him that did the service perfect, as pertaining to the conscience;

\ln Nasgi dilisdayvdiyiquo gesv ale aditasdiyiquo gesv ale digosulediyi gesvi, ale dikahnawadvsdi uquedaliquo gesv tsugvwalei, nasgi iyunadvnedi tsinigegvnele udanetliyvsdi gesv uliyeilohisdi gesv igohidv.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱᏉ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏗᏔᏍᏗᏱᏉ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎪᏑᎴᏗᏱ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎤᏇᏓᎵᏉ ᎨᏒ ᏧᎬᏩᎴᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᏁᏗ ᏥᏂᎨᎬᏁᎴ ᎤᏓᏁᏟᏴᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎵᏰᎢᎶᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᎪᎯᏛ.
\ft Which stood only in meats and drinks, and divers washings, and carnal ordinances, imposed on them until the time of reformation.

\ln Galonedvsgini ulutsvhi tsigi nugvwiyusv atsilvgelohi iyulistanvhi tsulvwisdanediyi osdv gesv ugvwali uliyeilohisdi tsigesvgi, nasgi gvdisgv itli igalvquodi ale nigalulotsidohvna galitsodvi, gilo tsuwoyeni tsuwvtanvhi nigesvna uwotlvnvhi, nasgi yadvnv, anelanvhi nigesvna gesvi,
\syll ᎦᎶᏁᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᎷᏨᎯ ᏥᎩ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸᎨᎶᎯ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᏧᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᎤᎵᏰᎢᎶᎯᏍᏗ ᏥᎨᏒᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏗᏍᎬ ᎢᏟ ᎢᎦᎸᏉᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᎷᎶᏥᏙᎲᎾ ᎦᎵᏦᏛᎢ, ᎩᎶ ᏧᏬᏰᏂ ᏧᏮᏔᏅᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎤᏬᏢᏅᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏯᏛᏅ, ᎠᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ,
\ft But Christ being come an high priest of good things to come, by a greater and more perfect tabernacle, not made with hands, that is to say, not of this building;

\ln Vtla ale yvwi dinihanulvhi ale waga anigina unigigv gvdisgvi, uwasvsgini ugigv gvdisgvi, saquo nuyvle galvquodiyu digesvi, hnaquo nasgi winasdvna aguyvdodi igiwadvelv.
\syll ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᏴᏫ ᏗᏂᎭᏄᎸᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏩᎦ ᎠᏂᎩᎾ ᎤᏂᎩᎬ ᎬᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᎤᏩᏒᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᎩᎬ ᎬᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᏌᏉ ᏄᏴᎴ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᏗᎨᏒᎢ, ᎿᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏫᎾᏍᏛᎾ ᎠᎫᏴᏙᏗ ᎢᎩᏩᏛᎡᎸ.
\ft Neither by the blood of goats and calves, but by his own blood he entered in once into the holy place, having obtained eternal redemption for us.

\ln Iyuyeno waga tsunagonvsdali unigigv, ale awi dinihanulvhi unigigv, ale waga agisi ugonvhi gosdu degetsiquayovsgv anigadaha, nanisganvna igvwanvnedi yigi nasgi uniquedalv ugvwali gesvi.
\syll ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᏩᎦ ᏧᎾᎪᏅᏍᏓᎵ ᎤᏂᎩᎬ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏫ ᏗᏂᎭᏄᎸᎯ ᎤᏂᎩᎬ, ᎠᎴ ᏩᎦ ᎠᎩᏏ ᎤᎪᏅᎯ ᎪᏍᏚ ᏕᎨᏥᏆᏲᎥᏍᎬ ᎠᏂᎦᏓᎭ, ᎾᏂᏍᎦᏅᎾ ᎢᎬᏩᏅᏁᏗ ᏱᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᏇᏓᎸ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft For if the blood of bulls and of goats, and the ashes of an heifer sprinkling the unclean, sanctifieth to the purifying of the flesh:

\ln Ilago iyvdv igai utlihiyu Galonedv ugigv, ditsadanvdo dodatsinvgalveli dodatsikahvsi adahihi detsilvwisdanehvi, gvnidvno Unelanvhi tsetsanelododiyi nvdatsvneli nasgi winasdvna ehi Adanvdo gvdisgv nudanvgalvna [asgana,] Galonedv uwasv udalisgolvtanvhi tsigi Unelanvhi udalisgolvdanelvhi tsigi?
\syll ᎢᎳᎪ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎤᏟᎯᏳ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᎩᎬ, ᏗᏣᏓᏅᏙ ᏙᏓᏥᏅᎦᎸᎡᎵ ᏙᏓᏥᎧᎲᏏ ᎠᏓᎯᎯ ᏕᏥᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎢ, ᎬᏂᏛᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏤᏣᏁᎶᏙᏗᏱ ᏅᏓᏨᏁᎵ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏫᎾᏍᏛᎾ ᎡᎯ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎬᏗᏍᎬ ᏄᏓᏅᎦᎸᎾ ᎠᏍᎦᎾ,data is invalid ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎤᏓᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏓᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ?
\ft How much more shall the blood of Christ, who through the eternal Spirit offered himself without spot to God, purge your conscience from dead works to serve the living God?

\ln Nasgi iyusdi ayeli alehvsgi nigalisdiha itse kanohedv datlohisdvi, nasgi uyohusvhi gesv gvdisgv digvwudalesdi iyudasdodiyi igvyiyi kanohedv datlohisdv uniyostanvi, nasgi getsiyanvdv tsigi unatseli iyulisdodiyi aduisdv winasdvna unatiyasdanedi gesvi;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎠᎴᎲᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᎭ ᎢᏤ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏓᏠᎯᏍᏛᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏗᏍᎬ ᏗᎬᏭᏓᎴᏍᏗ ᎢᏳᏓᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎢᎬᏱᏱ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏓᏠᎯᏍᏛ ᎤᏂᏲᏍᏔᏅᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᏥᏯᏅᏛ ᏥᎩ ᎤᎾᏤᎵ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎠᏚᎢᏍᏛ ᏫᎾᏍᏛᎾ ᎤᎾᏘᏯᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ;
\ft And for this cause he is the mediator of the new testament, that by means of death, for the redemption of the transgressions that were under the first testament, they which are called might receive the promise of eternal inheritance.

\ln Kanohedvyeno ditlohistanvhi tsigesoi, ase ahisdi geso asdayidisgi kanohedv datlohisdvi.
\syll ᎧᏃᎮᏛᏰᏃ ᏗᏠᎯᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᏥᎨᏐᎢ, ᎠᏎ ᎠᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏐ ᎠᏍᏓᏱᏗᏍᎩ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏓᏠᎯᏍᏛᎢ.
\ft For where a testament is, there must also of necessity be the death of the testator.

\ln Kanohedvyeno datlohisdv asdayiyu geso alisgolvdodi gesv alvhi tsigesoi; vtla ale asdayidvhi yigeso alisgolvdodi asiquo tsigvnoi.
\syll ᎧᏃᎮᏛᏰᏃ ᏓᏠᎯᏍᏛ ᎠᏍᏓᏱᏳ ᎨᏐ ᎠᎵᏍᎪᎸᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎸᎯ ᏥᎨᏐᎢ; ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏍᏓᏱᏛᎯ ᏱᎨᏐ ᎠᎵᏍᎪᎸᏙᏗ ᎠᏏᏉ ᏥᎬᏃᎢ.
\ft For a testament is of force after men are dead: otherwise it is of no strength at all while the testator liveth.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi igvyiyi kanohedv ditlohistanvhi gesv vtla asdayidvhi yigese gigv gvtanvna nigesvna yigi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᎬᏱᏱ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏗᏠᎯᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎥᏝ ᎠᏍᏓᏱᏛᎯ ᏱᎨᏎ ᎩᎬ ᎬᏔᏅᎾ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏱᎩ.
\ft Whereupon neither the first testament was dedicated without blood.

\ln Mosiyeno nigadv dikahnawadvsdi nigawesgv dunanugowiselv yvwi nasgiya nigvnv dikahnawadvsdi, waga anigina unigigv ale awi dinihanulvhi unigigv unegisei, ale ama ale uwanv gigagei, ale disoqui, dusdutleno goweli ale naniv yvwi.
\syll ᎼᏏᏰᏃ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎬ ᏚᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᎸ ᏴᏫ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏂᎬᏅ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ, ᏩᎦ ᎠᏂᎩᎾ ᎤᏂᎩᎬ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏫ ᏗᏂᎭᏄᎸᎯ ᎤᏂᎩᎬ ᎤᏁᎩᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎹ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏩᏅ ᎩᎦᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏐᏈ, ᏚᏍᏚᏞᏃ ᎪᏪᎵ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏴᏫ.
\ft For when Moses had spoken every precept to all the people according to the law, he took the blood of calves and of goats, with water, and scarlet wool, and hyssop, and sprinkled both the book, and all the people,

\ln Hia niwesgei, hia nasgi gigv, kanohedv datlohisdv asdayidisgi nasgi Unelanvhi tsitsinetse ditsikahnawadvsdiyi.
\syll ᎯᎠ ᏂᏪᏍᎨᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎩᎬ, ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏓᏠᎯᏍᏛ ᎠᏍᏓᏱᏗᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏥᏥᏁᏤ ᏗᏥᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗᏱ.
\ft Saying, This is the blood of the testament which God hath enjoined unto you.

\ln Ale nasquo gigv dusdutlistane galitsodvi, ale nigadv gohusdi digvtanidasdi dunilvwisdanehvi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎩᎬ ᏚᏍᏚᏟᏍᏔᏁ ᎦᎵᏦᏛᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏗᎬᏔᏂᏓᏍᏗ ᏚᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎢ.
\ft Moreover he sprinkled with blood both the tabernacle, and all the vessels of the ministry.

\ln Ale nigavquo iyusdi dikahnawadvsdi nigvnv gigv ganvgalvdodi gesvgi; ale gigv atsvnvhi nigesvna yigi, asganvtsv vtla yvgayvdadidoligi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᎥᏉ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏂᎬᏅ ᎩᎬ ᎦᏅᎦᎸᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᎩᎬ ᎠᏨᏅᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᎥᏝ ᏴᎦᏴᏓᏗᏙᎵᎩ.
\ft And almost all things are by the law purged with blood; and without shedding of blood is no remission.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi udulvdi nigalisdisgvgi hia nasgi nigadv nusdidanv galvladi tsehi ditlilostanvhi gesv diganvgalvdodiyi hia nasgi (dilisgolvdodi,) galvladisgini tsehi gesv nayogo utli idigalvquodi dilisgolvtanvhi diganvgalvdodi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᏚᎸᏗ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏄᏍᏗᏓᏅ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏤᎯ ᏗᏟᎶᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏗᎦᏅᎦᎸᏙᏗᏱ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎵᏍᎪᎸᏙᏗ, ᎦᎸᎳᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᏤᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏲᎪ ᎤᏟ ᎢᏗᎦᎸᏉᏗ ᏗᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏅᎯ ᏗᎦᏅᎦᎸᏙᏗ.
\ft It was therefore necessary that the patterns of things in the heavens should be purified with these; but the heavenly things themselves with better sacrifices than these.

\ln Galonedvyeno vtla yiwuyvlv galvquodiyu degesvi gilo tsuwoyeni tsuwvtanvhi tsuwotlvnvhi gesvi, nasgi udohiyuhi (galvquodiyu gesv) ditlilostanvhi gesvi; galvladisgini nigesv wuyvlv, gohi gesv Unelanvhi agatahv gvnigesv igadvnediyi;
\syll ᎦᎶᏁᏛᏰᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏭᏴᎸ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᏕᎨᏒᎢ ᎩᎶ ᏧᏬᏰᏂ ᏧᏮᏔᏅᎯ ᏧᏬᏢᏅᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᏗᏟᎶᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎦᎸᎳᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᏂᎨᏒ ᏭᏴᎸ, ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎦᏔᎲ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᎦᏛᏁᏗᏱ;
\ft For Christ is not entered into the holy places made with hands, which are the figures of the true; but into heaven itself, now to appear in the presence of God for us:

\ln Ale vtla udulvdi nigalisdisgv iyusdi iyvdvhaquo udalisgolvdodiyi, nasgiya nidadetiyvhegv, gohusdi unigigv gvdi nugvwiyusv atsilvgelohi tsinadvnehe galvquodiyu gesv tsiwayvhihei;
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏚᎸᏗ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏴᏛᎭᏉ ᎤᏓᎵᏍᎪᎸᏙᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏂᏓᏕᏘᏴᎮᎬ, ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏂᎩᎬ ᎬᏗ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸᎨᎶᎯ ᏥᎾᏛᏁᎮ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᏥᏩᏴᎯᎮᎢ;
\ft Nor yet that he should offer himself often, as the high priest entereth into the holy place every year with blood of others;

\ln Iyuyeno nasgi yinusdei hnaquo utsati ase iyugiliyotsvhi yinigalisdisge elohi tsudotlvnv nvdagvwadalenvdv;  gohisgini gesv uwasv adalisgolvdisgv asgani gesv ahvsgvi saquo gvnigesv nudadvnelv ulisqualvdi degesadisvi.
\syll ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᏄᏍᏕᎢ ᎿᏉ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎠᏎ ᎢᏳᎩᎵᏲᏨᎯ ᏱᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᏍᎨ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏧᏙᏢᏅ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏓᎴᏅᏛ;  ᎪᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎠᏓᎵᏍᎪᎸᏗᏍᎬ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎲᏍᎬᎢ ᏌᏉ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏄᏓᏛᏁᎸ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᎸᏗ ᏕᎨᏌᏗᏒᎢ.
\ft For then must he often have suffered since the foundation of the world: but now once in the end of the world hath he appeared to put away sin by the sacrifice of himself.

\ln Ale tsugagotanvhi tsigi yvwi saquo itsuniyohisdiyi, onino digugododi iga gesvi;
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏧᎦᎪᏔᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ ᏴᏫ ᏌᏉ ᎢᏧᏂᏲᎯᏍᏗᏱ, ᎣᏂᏃ ᏗᎫᎪᏙᏗ ᎢᎦ ᎨᏒᎢ;
\ft And as it is appointed unto men once to die, but after this the judgment:

\ln Nasgiya nasquo Galonedv saquo iyagalisgolvtanvhi ugisdiyi unitsati gesv unisganvtsvi; nasgino na gvwagatenohi gesv taline gvnigesv nidodvadvneli tsusdelvdiyi, asgani aguyvdodi nayehvna
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏌᏉ ᎢᏯᎦᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏅᎯ ᎤᎩᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏂᏍᎦᏅᏨᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩᏃ Ꮎ ᎬᏩᎦᏖᏃᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᏙᏛᎠᏛᏁᎵ ᏧᏍᏕᎸᏗᏱ, ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᎠᎫᏴᏙᏗ ᎾᏰᎲᎾ
\ft So Christ was once offered to bear the sins of many; and unto them that look for him shall he appear the second time without sin unto salvation.

\ln Dikahnawadvsdiyeno osdv uliyeilohisdi gesv udawadisdodv tsuwehvgi, ale akalii ditlilostanvhi nigesvna tsigesvgi, vtla yeliga, nasgi didasgolvdodi danvdisgv, nidadetiyvhisv nigohilv tsidanalisgolvdisgei nahna anilugi nunigolvna igvwanvnedi yigesei.
\syll ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗᏰᏃ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎤᎵᏰᎢᎶᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏓᏩᏗᏍᏙᏛ ᏧᏪᎲᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎧᎵᎢ ᏗᏟᎶᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏥᎨᏒᎩ, ᎥᏝ ᏰᎵᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏓᏍᎪᎸᏙᏗ ᏓᏅᏗᏍᎬ, ᏂᏓᏕᏘᏴᎯᏒ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᏥᏓᎾᎵᏍᎪᎸᏗᏍᎨᎢ ᏀᎾ ᎠᏂᎷᎩ ᏄᏂᎪᎸᎾ ᎢᎬᏩᏅᏁᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ.
\ft For the law having a shadow of good things to come, and not the very image of the things, can never with those sacrifices which they offered year by year continually make the comers thereunto perfect.

\ln Iyuyeno yeliquo yigesei, tla yigvwaniyohistane tsunalisgolvdisgvi; analisgolvdisgiyeno gesv saquo yinunadanvgalvhe vtla hnaquo anisgana yigvwaniyelvsei.
\syll ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᏰᎵᏉ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ, Ꮭ ᏱᎬᏩᏂᏲᎯᏍᏔᏁ ᏧᎾᎵᏍᎪᎸᏗᏍᎬᎢ; ᎠᎾᎵᏍᎪᎸᏗᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎨᏒ ᏌᏉ ᏱᏄᎾᏓᏅᎦᎸᎮ ᎥᏝ ᎿᏉ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᎾ ᏱᎬᏩᏂᏰᎸᏎᎢ.
\ft For then would they not have ceased to be offered? because that the worshippers once purged should have had no more conscience of sins.

\ln Nasgisgini na danalisgolvdisgvi, nidadetiyvhisv unanvdadisisodiquo nigalisdisgo unisganvtsvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ Ꮎ ᏓᎾᎵᏍᎪᎸᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᏂᏓᏕᏘᏴᎯᏒ ᎤᎾᏅᏓᏗᏏᏐᏗᏉ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᏍᎪ ᎤᏂᏍᎦᏅᏨᎢ.
\ft But in those sacrifices there is a remembrance again made of sins every year.

\ln Vtlayeno waga tsunagonvsdali ale awi dinihanulvhi unigigv yeli gvwanihvsdi yigese asgani gesvi.
\syll ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᏩᎦ ᏧᎾᎪᏅᏍᏓᎵ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏫ ᏗᏂᎭᏄᎸᎯ ᎤᏂᎩᎬ ᏰᎵ ᎬᏩᏂᎲᏍᏗ ᏱᎨᏎ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft For it is not possible that the blood of bulls and of goats should take away sins.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi (Galonedv) elohi unanugotsilv, hia nuwesei, Atsilvgelasdodi ale ilisgolvdodi gesv vtla yeli yiditsayelvnei, ayelvsgini squadvnvisdanelv.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏥᎸ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎠᏥᎸᎨᎳᏍᏙᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎢᎵᏍᎪᎸᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎥᏝ ᏰᎵ ᏱᏗᏣᏰᎸᏁᎢ, ᎠᏰᎸᏍᎩᏂ ᏍᏆᏛᏅᎢᏍᏓᏁᎸ.
\ft Wherefore when he cometh into the world, he saith, Sacrifice and offering thou wouldest not, but a body hast thou prepared me:

\ln Tsunosdv atsilvdigelasdodi ale dilisgolvdodi asgani aguyvdodi vtla osiyu yiditsayelvnei;
\syll ᏧᏃᏍᏛ ᎠᏥᎸᏗᎨᎳᏍᏙᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎵᏍᎪᎸᏙᏗ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᎠᎫᏴᏙᏗ ᎥᏝ ᎣᏏᏳ ᏱᏗᏣᏰᎸᏁᎢ;
\ft In burnt offerings and sacrifices for sin thou hast had no pleasure.

\ln Hnaquono hia nagiwesvgi, Gvniyuquo tsilugi, [gowelihi gowela vginohesgvi,] [tsilugi] nusdv tsadulisgv iyaquadvnedi yi, Tsanelanvhi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎾᎩᏪᏒᎩ, ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᏥᎷᎩ, ᎪᏪᎵᎯ ᎪᏪᎳ ᎥᎩᏃᎮᏍᎬᎢ,data is invalid ᏥᎷᎩdata is invalid ᏄᏍᏛ ᏣᏚᎵᏍᎬ ᎢᏯᏆᏛᏁᏗ Ᏹ, ᏣᏁᎳᏅᎯ.
\ft Then said I, Lo, I come (in the volume of the book it is written of me,) to do thy will, O God.

\ln Gayula hia iyuwedv tsigi, Atsilvgelasdodi ale alisgolvdodi, ale tsunosdi atsilvdigelasdodi, ale dilisgolvdodi asgani aguyvdodi, vtla yeli yiditsayelvnei, vtla ale osiyu yiditsayelvnei; nasgi dikahnawadvsdi nasgiya nigvnv dilisgolvtanvhi tsigesei;
\syll ᎦᏳᎳ ᎯᎠ ᎢᏳᏪᏛ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᏥᎸᎨᎳᏍᏙᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎵᏍᎪᎸᏙᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏃᏍᏗ ᎠᏥᎸᏗᎨᎳᏍᏙᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎵᏍᎪᎸᏙᏗ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᎠᎫᏴᏙᏗ, ᎥᏝ ᏰᎵ ᏱᏗᏣᏰᎸᏁᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎣᏏᏳ ᏱᏗᏣᏰᎸᏁᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏂᎬᏅ ᏗᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏅᎯ ᏥᎨᏎᎢ;
\ft Above when he said, Sacrifice and offering and burnt offerings and offering for sin thou wouldest not, neither hadst pleasure therein; which are offered by the law;

\ln Hnaquo hia nuwesei, Gvniyuquo, tsilugi nusdv tsadulisgv iyaquadvnediyi Tsanelanvhi.  Igvyiyi [uneistanv] ayosdiha, nasgi taline [uneistanv] usdayidisdiyi.
\syll ᎿᏉ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎬᏂᏳᏉ, ᏥᎷᎩ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏣᏚᎵᏍᎬ ᎢᏯᏆᏛᏁᏗᏱ ᏣᏁᎳᏅᎯ.  ᎢᎬᏱᏱ ᎤᏁᎢᏍᏔᏅdata is invalid ᎠᏲᏍᏗᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎤᏁᎢᏍᏔᏅdata is invalid ᎤᏍᏓᏱᏗᏍᏗᏱ.
\ft Then said he, Lo, I come to do thy will, O God. He taketh away the first, that he may establish the second.

\ln [Unelanvhiyeno] osiyu uyelvdi eginvgalvdiyi Tsisa Galonedv ayelv saquo iyalisgolvtanvhi gesv iyuwanisadv.
\syll ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃdata is invalid ᎣᏏᏳ ᎤᏰᎸᏗ ᎡᎩᏅᎦᎸᏗᏱ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎠᏰᎸ ᏌᏉ ᎢᏯᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ.
\ft By the which will we are sanctified through the offering of the body of Jesus Christ once for all.

\ln Ale naniv atsilvanelohi danidoge dunilvwisdanehe nidadodaquisvi, ale nigohilv utloyiquo atsilvdigelasdodi tsunalisgolvdisgei, nasgi asgani gesv ilvhiyu yeli gvwahvsdi nigesvna gesvi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎠᏥᎸᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᏓᏂᏙᎨ ᏚᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎮ ᏂᏓᏙᏓᏈᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎤᏠᏱᏉ ᎠᏥᎸᏗᎨᎳᏍᏙᏗ ᏧᎾᎵᏍᎪᎸᏗᏍᎨᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᎨᏒ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᏰᎵ ᎬᏩᎲᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft And every priest standeth daily ministering and offering oftentimes the same sacrifices, which can never take away sins:

\ln Hiasgini asgaya saquo iyulisgolvtanvhi gese atsilvgelasdodi asgani agugododi, uwene ulisquadisdi nigesvna agadisiditlv Unelanvhi uwolvi;
\syll ᎯᎠᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᏌᏉ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏎ ᎠᏥᎸᎨᎳᏍᏙᏗ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᎠᎫᎪᏙᏗ, ᎤᏪᏁ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎠᎦᏗᏏᏗᏢ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏬᎸᎢ;
\ft But this man, after he had offered one sacrifice for sins for ever, sat down on the right hand of God;

\ln Ale hnaquo nigohilv agatiya gvni gvwasgagi tsulasidiyi gasgilo nigegvnelvha.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎿᏉ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎠᎦᏘᏯ ᎬᏂ ᎬᏩᏍᎦᎩ ᏧᎳᏏᏗᏱ ᎦᏍᎩᎶ ᏂᎨᎬᏁᎸᎭ.
\ft From henceforth expecting till his enemies be made his footstool.

\ln Saquoyeno iyulisgolvtanvhi gesv uwvtanv ulisquadisdi nigesvna nunigolvna niduwanelv nasgi na nanisganvna igegvnelvhi.
\syll ᏌᏉᏰᏃ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏮᏔᏅ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏄᏂᎪᎸᎾ ᏂᏚᏩᏁᎸ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎾᏂᏍᎦᏅᎾ ᎢᎨᎬᏁᎸᎯ.
\ft For by one offering he hath perfected for ever them that are sanctified.

\ln Ale nasquo Galvquodi Adanvdo ogohiyudanehi; gayulayeno hia nasgi iyuwedv nigesoi,
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎦᎸᏉᏗ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎣᎪᎯᏳᏓᏁᎯ; ᎦᏳᎳᏰᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏪᏛ ᏂᎨᏐᎢ,
\ft Whereof the Holy Ghost also is a witness to us: for after that he had said before,

\ln Hia nasgi nusdesdi kanohedv dodagatsiyatloisdaneli nahiyu galosonvha adiha Ugvwiyuhi; Diquatseli dikahnawadvsdi tsuninawiyi dodatsilani, ale dunadanvdv dodagowelani.
\syll ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏙᏓᎦᏥᏯᏠᎢᏍᏓᏁᎵ ᏀᎢᏳ ᎦᎶᏐᏅᎭ ᎠᏗᎭ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ; ᏗᏆᏤᎵ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏧᏂᎾᏫᏱ ᏙᏓᏥᎳᏂ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᎾᏓᏅᏛ ᏙᏓᎪᏪᎳᏂ.
\ft This is the covenant that I will make with them after those days, saith the Lord, I will put my laws into their hearts, and in their minds will I write them;

\ln Ale unisganvtsv ale uyo nunadvnelidolv vtla hnaquo aquanvdadisdi yigesesdi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏲ ᏄᎾᏛᏁᎵᏙᎸ ᎥᏝ ᎿᏉ ᎠᏆᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft And their sins and iniquities will I remember no more.

\ln Nasgino hia nasgi asganvtsvhi gesv gayvdadinelvhi yigi, vtla hnaquo asgani aguyvdodi alisgolvdodi yinigalisdiha.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᎦᏅᏨᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎦᏴᏓᏗᏁᎸᎯ ᏱᎩ, ᎥᏝ ᎿᏉ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᎠᎫᏴᏙᏗ ᎠᎵᏍᎪᎸᏙᏗ ᏱᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᎭ.
\ft Now where remission of these is, there is no more offering for sin.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi, idalinvtli, nidinayesgvna wigegiyvsdi tsinulistau utli igalvquodigesv Tsisa ugigv iyuwanisanvhi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᏂᏗᎾᏰᏍᎬᎾ ᏫᎨᎩᏴᏍᏗ ᏥᏄᎵᏍᏔᎤ ᎤᏟ ᎢᎦᎸᏉᏗᎨᏒ ᏥᏌ ᎤᎩᎬ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏅᎯ.
\ft Having therefore, brethren, boldness to enter into the holiest by the blood of Jesus,

\ln Nasgi na itse ale gvnidv adanehi ganvnv gvtanvhi, nasgi igisdayidelvhi tsigi ayedoladv ulosvi, nasgi uquedalv tsigadvga;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎢᏤ ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎠᏓᏁᎯ ᎦᏅᏅ ᎬᏔᏅᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎩᏍᏓᏱᏕᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎠᏰᏙᎳᏛ ᎤᎶᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏇᏓᎸ ᏥᎦᏛᎦ;
\ft By a new and living way, which he hath consecrated for us, through the veil, that is to say, his flesh;

\ln Ale [tsigikaha] nugvwiyusadegi atsilvgelohi Unelanvhi utseli adanelv ugasayasdidegi;
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏥᎩᎧᎭdata is invalid ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ ᎠᏥᎸᎨᎶᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎠᏓᏁᎸ ᎤᎦᏌᏯᏍᏗᏕᎩ;
\ft And having an high priest over the house of God;

\ln Nav idilugesdi idvdisgesdi nutlonasdvnv diginawi, ale ulinigidv gohiyudi gesvi, ale diginawi tsegisdutlelvhi tseginvgalvhi uyo adanvtedi gesvi, ale didiyelv gadaha nigesvna ama tsegosuledanelvhi.
\syll ᎾᎥ ᎢᏗᎷᎨᏍᏗ ᎢᏛᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏄᏠᎾᏍᏛᏅ ᏗᎩᎾᏫ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎩᎾᏫ ᏤᎩᏍᏚᏞᎸᎯ ᏤᎩᏅᎦᎸᎯ ᎤᏲ ᎠᏓᏅᏖᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏗᏰᎸ ᎦᏓᎭ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎠᎹ ᏤᎪᏑᎴᏓᏁᎸᎯ.
\ft Let us draw near with a true heart in full assurance of faith, having our hearts sprinkled from an evil conscience, and our bodies washed with pure water.

\ln Asdaya deginiyvsesdi gvnigesv nigvnelv udugi igvsv nigadlasidvehvna; nudalidasdvnayeno nasgi na uduistanvhi gesvi.
\syll ᎠᏍᏓᏯ ᏕᎩᏂᏴᏎᏍᏗ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᎬᏁᎸ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎢᎬᏒ ᏂᎦᏜᏏᏛᎡᎲᎾ; ᏄᏓᎵᏓᏍᏛᎾᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᏚᎢᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Let us hold fast the profession of our faith without wavering; (for he is faithful that promised;)

\ln Ale dedadadanvtesgesdi, adageyudi gesv ale yisdv digalvwisdanedi gesv digadaniladediyi diginuwisdanediyi;
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏕᏓᏓᏓᏅᏖᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏱᏍᏛ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏗᎦᏓᏂᎳᏕᏗᏱ ᏗᎩᏄᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ;
\ft And let us consider one another to provoke unto love and to good works:

\ln Tlesdiquo yidisuligogesdi idadatlisanidohvi, igadv nasgi iyunadvnedi tsigi; detsadawonedisgesdisgini; ale ho ugvwiyusesdi, nasgi nitsadvnehesdi tsitsigowadi usqualvhidisv nahiyu iga.
\syll ᏞᏍᏗᏉ ᏱᏗᏑᎵᎪᎨᏍᏗ ᎢᏓᏓᏟᏌᏂᏙᎲᎢ, ᎢᎦᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᏁᏗ ᏥᎩ; ᏕᏣᏓᏬᏁᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗᏍᎩᏂ; ᎠᎴ Ꮀ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᏎᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᏥᏥᎪᏩᏗ ᎤᏍᏆᎸᎯᏗᏒ ᏀᎢᏳ ᎢᎦ.
\ft Not forsaking the assembling of ourselves together, as the manner of some is; but exhorting one another: and so much the more, as ye see the day approaching.

\ln Iyuyeno igvsv igadulvdv yidisganvgv duyula gegiganevsvhi duyugodv gesvi, vtla nvwadale yalinohiya atsilvgelasdi asgani aguyvdodi,
\syll ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᎢᎬᏒ ᎢᎦᏚᎸᏛ ᏱᏗᏍᎦᏅᎬ ᏚᏳᎳ ᎨᎩᎦᏁᎥᏒᎯ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᏯᎵᏃᎯᏯ ᎠᏥᎸᎨᎳᏍᏗ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᎠᎫᏴᏙᏗ,
\ft For if we sin wilfully after that we have received the knowledge of the truth, there remaineth no more sacrifice for sins,

\ln Unayehisdiquosgini odanvdv agatenasdiyi digugododi iga gesvi, ale utalawohisdi gesv atsilv nasgiya, nasgi unidvdodi tsigi gvwasgagi.
\syll ᎤᎾᏰᎯᏍᏗᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎣᏓᏅᏛ ᎠᎦᏖᎾᏍᏗᏱ ᏗᎫᎪᏙᏗ ᎢᎦ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏔᎳᏬᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏥᎸ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᏛᏙᏗ ᏥᎩ ᎬᏩᏍᎦᎩ.
\ft But a certain fearful looking for of judgment and fiery indignation, which shall devour the adversaries.

\ln Gilo Mosi utseli dikahnawadvsdi iyvdv iyuwanetanvhi tsigese ayohusge gayetsidolisdi nigesvna anitaliha anigatahi uninohelvhi gvtanvhi;
\syll ᎩᎶ ᎼᏏ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎢᏳᏩᏁᏔᏅᎯ ᏥᎨᏎ ᎠᏲᎱᏍᎨ ᎦᏰᏥᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎠᏂᏔᎵᎭ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎯ ᎤᏂᏃᎮᎸᎯ ᎬᏔᏅᎯ;
\ft He that despised Moses' law died without mercy under two or three witnesses:

\ln Tlasgo utli igai yinidogvwayugodi atsisdvdisdodiyi gilo Unelanvhi Uwetsi ulasdaelvhi, ale nasgi na gigvkanohedv ditlohisdotanvhi nasgi udanvgalotanvhi gesv gadaha uyelvnvhi, ale gagvwasotlvtanvhi gvwagatiya adadoligi Adanvdo.
\syll ᏝᏍᎪ ᎤᏟ ᎢᎦᎢ ᏱᏂᏙᎬᏩᏳᎪᏗ ᎠᏥᏍᏛᏗᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎤᎳᏍᏓᎡᎸᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎩᎬᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏗᏠᎯᏍᏙᏔᏅᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏓᏅᎦᎶᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎦᏓᎭ ᎤᏰᎸᏅᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᎬᏩᏐᏢᏔᏅᎯ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎠᏓᏙᎵᎩ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ.
\ft Of how much sorer punishment, suppose ye, shall he be thought worthy, who hath trodden under foot the Son of God, and hath counted the blood of the covenant, wherewith he was sanctified, an unholy thing, and hath done despite unto the Spirit of grace?

\ln Edigatahayeno nasgi na hia iyuwedv tsigi, Atleisdi gesv ayv aquatseliga, ayv dagaguyvhi, adiha Yihowa.  Ale talinei, Yihowa dodagugodaneli tsutseli yvwi.
\syll ᎡᏗᎦᏔᎭᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎯᎠ ᎢᏳᏪᏛ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᏞᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏴ ᎠᏆᏤᎵᎦ, ᎠᏴ ᏓᎦᎫᏴᎯ, ᎠᏗᎭ ᏱᎰᏩ.  ᎠᎴ ᏔᎵᏁᎢ, ᏱᎰᏩ ᏙᏓᎫᎪᏓᏁᎵ ᏧᏤᎵ ᏴᏫ.
\ft For we know him that hath said, Vengeance belongeth unto me, I will recompense, saith the Lord. And again, The Lord shall judge his people.

\ln Unayehisdiyu gvnidv Unelanvhi tsuwoyeni widiginvisdiyi.
\syll ᎤᎾᏰᎯᏍᏗᏳ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᏬᏰᏂ ᏫᏗᎩᏅᎢᏍᏗᏱ.
\ft It is a fearful thing to fall into the hands of the living God.

\ln Aseno itsanvdada tsuwagutanvsvi, nasgi nahiyu iga nidetsadisdaneloi, utsati itsatlinigvnelv detsigatilvsv agiliyoisdi gesvi;
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎢᏣᏅᏓᏓ ᏧᏩᎫᏔᏅᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏀᎢᏳ ᎢᎦ ᏂᏕᏣᏗᏍᏓᏁᎶᎢ, ᎤᏣᏘ ᎢᏣᏟᏂᎬᏁᎸ ᏕᏥᎦᏘᎸᏒ ᎠᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ;
\ft But call to remembrance the former days, in which, after ye were illuminated, ye endured a great fight of afflictions;

\ln Nasgi ilvhiyu tsigayetsisotlvdvi, ale tsetsigiliyoisdisgvi; ilvhiyuno detsaligonelv nasgi igegvnelvhi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᏥᎦᏰᏥᏐᏢᏛᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏤᏥᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ; ᎢᎸᎯᏳᏃ ᏕᏣᎵᎪᏁᎸ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎨᎬᏁᎸᎯ.
\ft Partly, whilst ye were made a gazingstock both by reproaches and afflictions; and partly, whilst ye became companions of them that were so used.

\ln Vqualvidvyeno gesv iyusdi vsgiyadolitsvgi, ale ulihelisdiquo vtsadanvdvgi etsiwonvhv tsugvwalodi itsihvi, itsigatahvgiyeno galvladi witsisquanigodv utli iyosdv ale ayogi nigesvna tsugvwalodi.
\syll ᎥᏆᎸᎢᏛᏰᏃ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎥᏍᎩᏯᏙᎵᏨᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᎮᎵᏍᏗᏉ ᎥᏣᏓᏅᏛᎩ ᎡᏥᏬᏅᎲ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎢᏥᎲᎢ, ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎲᎩᏰᏃ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏫᏥᏍᏆᏂᎪᏛ ᎤᏟ ᎢᏲᏍᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏲᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ.
\ft For ye had compassion of me in my bonds, and took joyfully the spoiling of your goods, knowing in yourselves that ye have in heaven a better and an enduring substance.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi tlesdi iyvdv itsvnetanvgi itsohiyusvi, nasgi utsati udaguyvedi tsigi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎢᏨᏁᏔᏅᎩ ᎢᏦᎯᏳᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᏓᎫᏴᎡᏗ ᏥᎩ.
\ft Cast not away therefore your confidence, which hath great recompence of reward.

\ln Ditsvnidiyu itsalisdodiyi udulvdiyu nitsalisdaneha; nasgi hnaquo Unelanvhi usiyu uyvlvdi gesv itsadvnelvhi gesesdi, itsatseli igvwalisdodi yigi nusdv aduisdvi.
\syll ᏗᏨᏂᏗᏳ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᏚᎸᏗᏳ ᏂᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᎭ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎿᏉ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏏᏳ ᎤᏴᎸᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏣᏛᏁᎸᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎢᏣᏤᎵ ᎢᎬᏩᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᏱᎩ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎠᏚᎢᏍᏛᎢ.
\ft For ye have need of patience, that, after ye have done the will of God, ye might receive the promise.

\ln Hnaquoyeno nigohilvnaquo, nasgi uluhisdi tsigi dagalutsi, ale vtla yvdvdohidi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏰᏃ ᏂᎪᎯᎸᎾᏉ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎷᎯᏍᏗ ᏥᎩ ᏓᎦᎷᏥ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᏴᏛᏙᎯᏗ.
\ft For yet a little while, and he that shall come will come, and will not tarry.

\ln Unadanvtino gohiyudi gesv unadvnidisdesdi; gilosgini iyusdi iatsvsgesdi aquadanvdo vtla osiyu yuyelvsesdi nasgi.
\syll ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘᏃ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎾᏛᏂᏗᏍᏕᏍᏗ; ᎩᎶᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᎠᏨᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏙ ᎥᏝ ᎣᏏᏳ ᏳᏰᎸᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ.
\ft Now the just shall live by faith: but if any man draw back, my soul shall have no pleasure in him.

\ln Aseno vtla anatsvsgi tsigi [unadatlugv] itela yigi, nasgi getsidvdodi gesv iyvdv tsiwaniluga, nasgisgini na unadatlugv itela, nasgi unohiyusv tsidanisdelvdi tsunadanvdo.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎠᎾᏨᏍᎩ ᏥᎩ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬdata is invalid ᎢᏖᎳ ᏱᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᏥᏛᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏥᏩᏂᎷᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ Ꮎ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬ ᎢᏖᎳ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏃᎯᏳᏒ ᏥᏓᏂᏍᏕᎸᏗ ᏧᎾᏓᏅᏙ.
\ft But we are not of them who draw back unto perdition; but of them that believe to the saving of the soul.

\ln Gohiyudino gesv hia nusdi gadvgvi, ulinigidv gohiyudiyi agowadvdiyi gesv nusdv udugi owasvi, ale nudlasidvsvna iyudalisdanediyi ehv nasgi na asi agohvhi nigesvna gesvi.
\syll ᎪᎯᏳᏗᏃ ᎨᏒ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏍᏗ ᎦᏛᎬᎢ, ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᎪᎯᏳᏗᏱ ᎠᎪᏩᏛᏗᏱ ᎨᏒ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎣᏩᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏄᏜᏏᏛᏒᎾ ᎢᏳᏓᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᎡᎲ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᏏ ᎠᎪᎲᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Now faith is the substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen.

\ln Nasgiyeno anvdisgv eti unadenvhi osdv getsinohediyi uniwadvhvgi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎠᏅᏗᏍᎬ ᎡᏘ ᎤᎾᏕᏅᎯ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎨᏥᏃᎮᏗᏱ ᎤᏂᏩᏛᎲᎩ.
\ft For by it the elders obtained a good report.

\ln Gohiyudi gesv idvdisgv idoliga Unelanvhi kanegv gvtanvhi gesv elohi dudotlvnvi, nasgino tsudalenvdv agowadvdi tsigi vtla nasgi na gvnigesv iyulistanvhi gesv digotlvtanvhi yigi.
\syll ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏛᏗᏍᎬ ᎢᏙᎵᎦ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎧᏁᎬ ᎬᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏚᏙᏢᏅᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎠᎪᏩᏛᏗ ᏥᎩ ᎥᏝ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏗᎪᏢᏔᏅᎯ ᏱᎩ.
\ft Through faith we understand that the worlds were framed by the word of God, so that things which are seen were not made of things which do appear.

\ln Gohiyudi gesv gvdisgv Equili utli iyosdv ulisgolvdanele Unelanvhi atsilvgelasdodi gesv esgaquo Geni, nasgi nudvnelv uwadvtane gohiyudisgi udaudiyu gesvi, Unelanvhi gvnigesv nuwanele dudanilvtselv ulisgolvtanvhi gesvi; nasgino nudvnelv gvdiha kanega nasquo uyohusvhi tsigi.
\syll ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏗᏍᎬ ᎡᏈᎵ ᎤᏟ ᎢᏲᏍᏛ ᎤᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᏥᎸᎨᎳᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎨᏂ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏛᏁᎸ ᎤᏩᏛᏔᏁ ᎪᎯᏳᏗᏍᎩ ᎤᏓᎤᏗᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏄᏩᏁᎴ ᏚᏓᏂᎸᏤᎸ ᎤᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏄᏛᏁᎸ ᎬᏗᎭ ᎧᏁᎦ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᏥᎩ.
\ft By faith Abel offered unto God a more excellent sacrifice than Cain, by which he obtained witness that he was righteous, God testifying of his gifts: and by it he being dead yet speaketh.

\ln Gahiyudi gesv gvdisgv Inagi agatinawidvhe nasgi ayohuhisdi gesv ugowadvdiyi nigesvna; ale vtla yatsiwadvhei, Unelanvhiyeno utinawidvhei; asiquoyeno nagatinawidisgvna gese Unelanvhi osiyu uyelvdi gesv dulvwisdanehv gvnigesv nagvnelei.
\syll ᎦᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏗᏍᎬ ᎢᎾᎩ ᎠᎦᏘᎾᏫᏛᎮ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎪᏩᏛᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ; ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᏯᏥᏩᏛᎮᎢ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ ᎤᏘᎾᏫᏛᎮᎢ; ᎠᏏᏉᏰᏃ ᎾᎦᏘᎾᏫᏗᏍᎬᎾ ᎨᏎ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎤᏰᎸᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎾᎬᏁᎴᎢ.
\ft By faith Enoch was translated that he should not see death; and was not found, because God had translated him: for before his translation he had this testimony, that he pleased God.

\ln Gohiyudisgini gesv nidvdisgvna yigi gvwatlisdi osdv uyelvdi [Unelanvhi] digilvwisdanediyi; giloyeno Unelanvhi yigalutseha ase yigohiyuhvsga ehvi, ale nasgi diguyvehi gesv ulinigidv gvwayohi.
\syll ᎪᎯᏳᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏒ ᏂᏛᏗᏍᎬᎾ ᏱᎩ ᎬᏩᏟᏍᏗ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎤᏰᎸᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯdata is invalid ᏗᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ; ᎩᎶᏰᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏱᎦᎷᏤᎭ ᎠᏎ ᏱᎪᎯᏳᎲᏍᎦ ᎡᎲᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎫᏴᎡᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᎬᏩᏲᎯ.
\ft But without faith it is impossible to please him: for he that cometh to God must believe that he is, and that he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him.

\ln Gohiyudi gesv gvdisgv Noya, Unelanvhi uweyatanv uneisdanelv tsudalenvdv asi ugohvhi nigesvna gesvi, unayesei, udvnvistane tsiyu unalisdelvdodi dudatinavi; nasgi nudvnelv uwvtane duwugodanele elohi, ale utseli nulistane nasgi duyugodv gesv gohiyudi gesv tsvdidalehvsga.
\syll ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏗᏍᎬ ᏃᏯ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏪᏯᏔᏅ ᎤᏁᎢᏍᏓᏁᎸ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎠᏏ ᎤᎪᎲᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᎾᏰᏎᎢ, ᎤᏛᏅᎢᏍᏔᏁ ᏥᏳ ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ ᏚᏓᏘᎾᎥᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏛᏁᎸ ᎤᏮᏔᏁ ᏚᏭᎪᏓᏁᎴ ᎡᎶᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏨᏗᏓᎴᎲᏍᎦ.

\ft By faith the walls of Jericho fell down, after they were compassed about seven days.

\ln Gohiyudi gesv gvdisgv Lehawi unegutsidv vtla yatsidvtane getsidvtanv nasgi na nunohiyusvna tsigesei, nasgi dohiyi tsidudanilvtse iyusdi unigadvnidohi.
\syll ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏗᏍᎬ ᎴᎭᏫ ᎤᏁᎫᏥᏛ ᎥᏝ ᏯᏥᏛᏔᏁ ᎨᏥᏛᏔᏅ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏄᏃᎯᏳᏒᎾ ᏥᎨᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏙᎯᏱ ᏥᏚᏓᏂᎸᏤ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᏂᎦᏛᏂᏙᎯ.
\ft By faith the harlot Rahab perished not with them that believed not, when she had received the spies with peace.

\ln Ale gado asi dagadvni?  vtlayeno gvgisquadisdi yigi yigatsinohelv Gidiyani, ale Quelegi, ale Samisini, ale Tsequida; Dewi nasquo, ale Sami, ale anadolehosgi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎦᏙ ᎠᏏ ᏓᎦᏛᏂ?  ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᎬᎩᏍᏆᏗᏍᏗ ᏱᎩ ᏱᎦᏥᏃᎮᎸ ᎩᏗᏯᏂ, ᎠᎴ ᏇᎴᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏌᎻᏏᏂ, ᎠᎴ ᏤᏈᏓ; ᏕᏫ ᎾᏍᏉ, ᎠᎴ ᏌᎻ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ.
\ft And what shall I more say? for the time would fail me to tell of Gedeon, and of Barak, and of Samson, and of Jephthae; of David also, and Samuel, and of the prophets:

\ln Nasgi gohiyudi gesv anvdisgv ayeli degotlvsv tsidanadalinehidehei, duyugodv tsidunilvwisdanehei, unatseli tsinanvnehe nusdv getsiduisdalvi, tlvdatsi uninodenv diniholi tsidanisduhvsgei,
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏅᏗᏍᎬ ᎠᏰᎵ ᏕᎪᏢᏒ ᏥᏓᎾᏓᎵᏁᎯᏕᎮᎢ, ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᏥᏚᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎮᎢ, ᎤᎾᏤᎵ ᏥᎾᏅᏁᎮ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎨᏥᏚᎢᏍᏓᎸᎢ, ᏢᏓᏥ ᎤᏂᏃᏕᏅ ᏗᏂᎰᎵ ᏥᏓᏂᏍᏚᎲᏍᎨᎢ,
\ft Who through faith subdued kingdoms, wrought righteousness, obtained promises, stopped the mouths of lions,

\ln Atsilv usgasedi tsanvdladisgei, ayelasdiganvhidv tsanadiwisehei, diniwanagala gesv tsunalinigidv tsinigegvnehei, nanisgaihvna ninanalisdisge danalihvi, tsidanigehidohe nvwanadale aniyawisgi.
\syll ᎠᏥᎸ ᎤᏍᎦᏎᏗ ᏣᏅᏜᏗᏍᎨᎢ, ᎠᏰᎳᏍᏗᎦᏅᎯᏛ ᏣᎾᏗᏫᏎᎮᎢ, ᏗᏂᏩᎾᎦᎳ ᎨᏒ ᏧᎾᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᏥᏂᎨᎬᏁᎮᎢ, ᎾᏂᏍᎦᎢᎲᎾ ᏂᎾᎾᎵᏍᏗᏍᎨ ᏓᎾᎵᎲᎢ, ᏥᏓᏂᎨᎯᏙᎮ ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴ ᎠᏂᏯᏫᏍᎩ.
\ft Quenched the violence of fire, escaped the edge of the sword, out of weakness were made strong, waxed valiant in fight, turned to flight the armies of the aliens.

\ln Anigeyv digvwaniyohuhiselvhi dinvnodv taline nidogetsiyohisehei; igadvno tsigetsigilvsgei, nidanadanilvgvna gegudalesgvi; nvdigalisdodisge utli iyosdv uniwadvdiyi unadulisgv dilehisodi gesvi;
\syll ᎠᏂᎨᏴ ᏗᎬᏩᏂᏲᎱᎯᏎᎸᎯ ᏗᏅᏃᏛ ᏔᎵᏁ ᏂᏙᎨᏥᏲᎯᏎᎮᎢ; ᎢᎦᏛᏃ ᏥᎨᏥᎩᎸᏍᎨᎢ, ᏂᏓᎾᏓᏂᎸᎬᎾ ᎨᎫᏓᎴᏍᎬᎢ; ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨ ᎤᏟ ᎢᏲᏍᏛ ᎤᏂᏩᏛᏗᏱ ᎤᎾᏚᎵᏍᎬ ᏗᎴᎯᏐᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ;
\ft Women received their dead raised to life again: and others were tortured, not accepting deliverance; that they might obtain a better resurrection:

\ln Igadvno getsigoliyesge gagetsisotlvdisgv ale degetsilivnihvi, ale nasquo degegalvihv ale degetsisduhvsgvi;
\syll ᎢᎦᏛᏃ ᎨᏥᎪᎵᏰᏍᎨ ᎦᎨᏥᏐᏢᏗᏍᎬ ᎠᎴ ᏕᎨᏥᎵᎥᏂᎲᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏕᎨᎦᎸᎢᎲ ᎠᎴ ᏕᎨᏥᏍᏚᎲᏍᎬᎢ;
\ft And others had trial of cruel mockings and scourgings, yea, moreover of bonds and imprisonment:

\ln Nvya degegvnisdisgei, diganudogi gvdi degetsigalisgei, degetsigoliyesgei, ayelasdiganvhidv degetsiisdisgei; awi uninodena ale awi dinihanulvhi tsuninegalvnvhi tsunanuwai anedohei; uninigvsehi gesei, anigiliyotsidohei.
\syll ᏅᏯ ᏕᎨᎬᏂᏍᏗᏍᎨᎢ, ᏗᎦᏄᏙᎩ ᎬᏗ ᏕᎨᏥᎦᎵᏍᎨᎢ, ᏕᎨᏥᎪᎵᏰᏍᎨᎢ, ᎠᏰᎳᏍᏗᎦᏅᎯᏛ ᏕᎨᏥᎢᏍᏗᏍᎨᎢ; ᎠᏫ ᎤᏂᏃᏕᎾ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏫ ᏗᏂᎭᏄᎸᎯ ᏧᏂᏁᎦᎸᏅᎯ ᏧᎾᏄᏩᎢ ᎠᏁᏙᎮᎢ; ᎤᏂᏂᎬᏎᎯ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎠᏂᎩᎵᏲᏥᏙᎮᎢ.
\ft They were stoned, they were sawn asunder, were tempted, were slain with the sword: they wandered about in sheepskins and goatskins; being destitute, afflicted, tormented;

\ln [Nasgi hia vtla elohi gvwanadedi yigesei;] inage anedohei, ale dodalvi, ale dusdagalvi, ale gadohi datalesvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎥᏝ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎬᏩᎾᏕᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ;data is invalid ᎢᎾᎨ ᎠᏁᏙᎮᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏙᏓᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏍᏓᎦᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᏙᎯ ᏓᏔᎴᏒᎢ.
\ft (Of whom the world was not worthy:) they wandered in deserts, and in mountains, and in dens and caves of the earth.

\ln Ale nasgi nigadv hia osdv getsinohesgi tsigese unohiyusv iyuwanisadv, vtla nusdv getsiduisdanelv yidunadanilvtsei;
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎯᎠ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎨᏥᏃᎮᏍᎩ ᏥᎨᏎ ᎤᏃᎯᏳᏒ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ, ᎥᏝ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎨᏥᏚᎢᏍᏓᏁᎸ ᏱᏚᎾᏓᏂᎸᏤᎢ;
\ft And these all, having obtained a good report through faith, received not the promise:

\ln Nasgi Unelanvhi igadvnvisdanelvhi gesv iyusdi gohusdi utli iyosdv, nasgi nunilulotsehvna igegvnediyi nigesvna ayv nigatloyasdisgvna.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᎦᏛᏅᎢᏍᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏟ ᎢᏲᏍᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏂᎷᎶᏤᎲᎾ ᎢᎨᎬᏁᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎠᏴ ᏂᎦᏠᏯᏍᏗᏍᎬᎾ.
\ft God having provided some better thing for us, that they without us should not be made perfect.

\ln Nasgino iyunitsuquisdi anigatahi tsidegegaduwisdi, iyvdv nidvneda nudalesv gagedv igvnehi, ale asgani ahidv gegatlvtasdi tsigi, ale didvnidiyu gesesdi idadogiyasgesdi adogiyasdi igvyiditlv negvnelvi,
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎢᏳᏂᏧᏈᏍᏗ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎯ ᏥᏕᎨᎦᏚᏫᏍᏗ, ᎢᏴᏛ ᏂᏛᏁᏓ ᏄᏓᎴᏒ ᎦᎨᏛ ᎢᎬᏁᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᎠᎯᏛ ᎨᎦᏢᏔᏍᏗ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏛᏂᏗᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎢᏓᏙᎩᏯᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᏙᎩᏯᏍᏗ ᎢᎬᏱᏗᏢ ᏁᎬᏁᎸᎢ,
\ft Wherefore seeing we also are compassed about with so great a cloud of witnesses, let us lay aside every weight, and the sin which doth so easily beset us, and let us run with patience the race that is set before us,

\ln Widedaganisgesdi Tsisa nasgi iyuwanisadv, ale asquadisgi tsigi igohiyusvi.  Nasgi ulihelisdi gesv igvyiditlv nagvnelv iyusdi gvnidiyu dadahnawasdv ugiliyotsei, ulisaliquo uyelvse udehohisdi gesvi, ale agatisiditlv uwenv Unelanvhi uwesgilvi.
\syll ᏫᏕᏓᎦᏂᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏥᏌ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏍᏆᏗᏍᎩ ᏥᎩ ᎢᎪᎯᏳᏒᎢ.  ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎵᎮᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᎬᏱᏗᏢ ᎾᎬᏁᎸ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎬᏂᏗᏳ ᏓᏓᎿᏩᏍᏛ ᎤᎩᎵᏲᏤᎢ, ᎤᎵᏌᎵᏉ ᎤᏰᎸᏎ ᎤᏕᎰᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎦᏘᏏᏗᏢ ᎤᏪᏅ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏪᏍᎩᎸᎢ.
\ft Looking unto Jesus the author and finisher of our faith; who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross, despising the shame, and is set down at the right hand of the throne of God.

\ln Etsadanvdvliquosgini na nasgi igai gagvwasotlvdv anisgana unelagi duweliselvi, nasgino tlesdi ditsiyawetsvgi ale tlesdi tsuwanagalotsvgi detsadanvdvi.
\syll ᎡᏣᏓᏅᏛᎵᏉᏍᎩᏂ Ꮎ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎦᎬᏩᏐᏢᏛ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᎾ ᎤᏁᎳᎩ ᏚᏪᎵᏎᎸᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏗᏥᏯᏪᏨᎩ ᎠᎴ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏧᏩᎾᎦᎶᏨᎩ ᏕᏣᏓᏅᏛᎢ.
\ft For consider him that endured such contradiction of sinners against himself, lest ye be wearied and faint in your minds.

\ln Vtla asi itsigigv utsvisdiyi iyvdv yiditsatliyvhv asgani detsatliyvehvi.
\syll ᎥᏝ ᎠᏏ ᎢᏥᎩᎬ ᎤᏨᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏱᏗᏣᏟᏴᎲ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᏕᏣᏟᏴᎡᎲᎢ.
\ft Ye have not yet resisted unto blood, striving against sin.

\ln Ale itsvgewisvhi igi etsiwonedisgv diniyoli tsigetsiwonedisgo nasgiyai, hia tsinigaweha, Aquetsi tlesdi nvlisali yitsayelvsesdi Ugvwiyuhi tsagiliyoisdisgvi, ale tlesdi wana hiyusigalogesdi tsagvsgolvisgesdi,
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎢᏨᎨᏫᏒᎯ ᎢᎩ ᎡᏥᏬᏁᏗᏍᎬ ᏗᏂᏲᎵ ᏥᎨᏥᏬᏁᏗᏍᎪ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᎦᏪᎭ, ᎠᏇᏥ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏅᎵᏌᎵ ᏱᏣᏰᎸᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏣᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏩᎾ ᎯᏳᏏᎦᎶᎨᏍᏗ ᏣᎬᏍᎪᎸᎢᏍᎨᏍᏗ,
\ft And ye have forgotten the exhortation which speaketh unto you as unto children, My son, despise not thou the chastening of the Lord, nor faint when thou art rebuked of him:

\ln Nasgiyeno na Ugvwiyuhi ugeyuhi agiliyoisdisgoi, ale degalivniho naniv tsuwetsi nasgi tsudanilvtsvhi gesvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ Ꮎ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᎨᏳᎯ ᎠᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗᏍᎪᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᎦᎵᎥᏂᎰ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏧᏪᏥ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏓᏂᎸᏨᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft For whom the Lord loveth he chasteneth, and scourgeth every son whom he receiveth.

\ln Iyuno etsigiliyoisdisgesdi, nasgiya tsuwetsi nidadvnehv nitsadvneha Unelanvhi; gagoyeno eha ayoli nasgi udoda nugiliyoisdisgvna?
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᎡᏥᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏧᏪᏥ ᏂᏓᏛᏁᎲ ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎭ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ; ᎦᎪᏰᏃ ᎡᎭ ᎠᏲᎵ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏙᏓ ᏄᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗᏍᎬᎾ?
\ft If ye endure chastening, God dealeth with you as with sons; for what son is he whom the father chasteneth not?

\ln Iyusgini ilvhiyu netsigiliyoisdisgvna yigi, nasgi nigadiyu diniyoli nasgi igegvnedi tsigi, hnaquo iyvdvquo itsadenidolvhi, vtlano osdv itsadenvhi yigi.
\syll ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᏁᏥᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗᏍᎬᎾ ᏱᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏗᏂᏲᎵ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎨᎬᏁᏗ ᏥᎩ, ᎿᏉ ᎢᏴᏛᏉ ᎢᏣᏕᏂᏙᎸᎯ, ᎥᏝᏃ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎢᏣᏕᏅᎯ ᏱᎩ.
\ft But if ye be without chastisement, whereof all are partakers, then are ye bastards, and not sons.

\ln Alewo, uquedali gesv Digidoda degehvgi, nasgi tsigegigiliyoisdisgvgi; ale gedilvquodiyu tsigesvgi; tlasgo utli yinidogvwayugodi tsedadayohisediyi digadanvdo tsuwotlvnvhi tsigi, ale igadvnidisdiyi?
\syll ᎠᎴᏬ, ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎨᏒ ᏗᎩᏙᏓ ᏕᎨᎲᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᎨᎩᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗᏍᎬᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᎨᏗᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᏥᎨᏒᎩ; ᏝᏍᎪ ᎤᏟ ᏱᏂᏙᎬᏩᏳᎪᏗ ᏤᏓᏓᏲᎯᏎᏗᏱ ᏗᎦᏓᏅᏙ ᏧᏬᏢᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᎦᏛᏂᏗᏍᏗᏱ?
\ft Furthermore we have had fathers of our flesh which corrected us, and we gave them reverence: shall we not much rather be in subjection unto the Father of spirits, and live?

\ln Nasgiyeno na udohiyuhi tlega gegigiliyoisdisgvgi unvsv anadanvtesgv nanadvnehvgi; [unelanvhisgini] osdv igalisdanedi ugvwalv, nasgi itsatloyasdisgi iyulisdodiyi uwasv asgana nigesvna gesvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ Ꮎ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᏞᎦ ᎨᎩᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᎤᏅᏒ ᎠᎾᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ ᎾᎾᏛᏁᎲᎩ; ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏍᎩᏂdata is invalid ᎣᏍᏛ ᎢᎦᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎤᎬᏩᎸ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏣᏠᏯᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎠᏍᎦᎾ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft For they verily for a few days chastened us after their own pleasure; but he for our profit, that we might be partakers of his holiness.

\ln Ale nigavquo agiliyoisdi gesv gohi gesv vtla osdv odanvdadisdisgi yigi, uyoquosgini; onisgininonv iyvdv nvwadohiyadv adanvdadisdi gesv gananugowisgo duyugodv gesv unanugowisvhi, nasgi iyunalisdanelvhi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᎥᏉ ᎠᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎥᏝ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎣᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᏱᎩ, ᎤᏲᏉᏍᎩᏂ; ᎣᏂᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᎠᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎦᎾᏄᎪᏫᏍᎪ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏫᏒᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᎸᎯ.
\ft Now no chastening for the present seemeth to be joyous, but grievous: nevertheless afterward it yieldeth the peaceable fruit of righteousness unto them which are exercised thereby.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi ditsisaladvga ditsoyeni eladi itsulistanvhi tsigi, ale ditsinigeni diwanagalai;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏗᏥᏌᎳᏛᎦ ᏗᏦᏰᏂ ᎡᎳᏗ ᎢᏧᎵᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏥᏂᎨᏂ ᏗᏩᎾᎦᎳᎢ;
\ft Wherefore lift up the hands which hang down, and the feeble knees;

\ln Vnadesgi nitsvga deganvnv itsilohisdiyi, nasgino ayouli gesv tlesdi yunigolvstanesdi; kanvwodiquosgini gesesdi.
\syll ᎥᎾᏕᏍᎩ ᏂᏨᎦ ᏕᎦᏅᏅ ᎢᏥᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎠᏲᎤᎵ ᎨᏒ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏳᏂᎪᎸᏍᏔᏁᏍᏗ; ᎧᏅᏬᏗᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft And make straight paths for your feet, lest that which is lame be turned out of the way; but let it rather be healed.

\ln Nvwadohiyadv detsikahnawadisesdi nanivquo gohusdi detsadadvdisgvi, ale nasganvna gesvi, kanigidv yigi nasgi, vtla gilo yeli Ugvwiyuhi gvwagowadvdi yigi;
\syll ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᏕᏥᎧᎿᏩᏗᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᏂᎥᏉ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏕᏣᏓᏛᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎦᏅᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎧᏂᎩᏛ ᏱᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ, ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᏰᎵ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎬᏩᎪᏩᏛᏗ ᏱᎩ;
\ft Follow peace with all men, and holiness, without which no man shall see the Lord:

\ln Itseyatahiyu gesesdi nasgino tlesdi gilo esga uwohasvgi Unelanvhi gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesvi; tlesdi uyvsdi uhnasdetlv gananugogv itsadeyadotanvgi, ale nasgi iyuwanisadv unitsati gadaha iyunalistanvgi;
\syll ᎢᏤᏯᏔᎯᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎩᎶ ᎡᏍᎦ ᎤᏬᎭᏒᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᏞᏍᏗ ᎤᏴᏍᏗ ᎤᎿᏍᏕᏢ ᎦᎾᏄᎪᎬ ᎢᏣᏕᏯᏙᏔᏅᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎦᏓᎭ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏔᏅᎩ;
\ft Looking diligently lest any man fail of the grace of God; lest any root of bitterness springing up trouble you, and thereby many be defiled;

\ln Tlesdi gilo udelidv dinisihvsgi yitsadasuyesdi, ale asgana yvwi, Iso nasgiyai, usgi saquoquo iyalisdayvdi tsidugvwalotane tsunadinvse igvyi ehi gesvi.
\syll ᏞᏍᏗ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᏗᏂᏏᎲᏍᎩ ᏱᏣᏓᏑᏰᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏍᎦᎾ ᏴᏫ, ᎢᏐ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ, ᎤᏍᎩ ᏌᏉᏉ ᎢᏯᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗ ᏥᏚᎬᏩᎶᏔᏁ ᏧᎾᏗᏅᏎ ᎢᎬᏱ ᎡᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Lest there be any fornicator, or profane person, as Esau, who for one morsel of meat sold his birthright.

\ln Itsigatahayeno oni iyvdv osdv iyagadvnediyi tsudulisge tsatsisonvistanei; vtlayeno [udoda] udanvdv gvwanetliyvsdi gesv yuwadvhei, ulisinahisdiyusgininonv ale digvgasawoihi uyolei.
\syll ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎭᏰᏃ ᎣᏂ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎢᏯᎦᏛᏁᏗᏱ ᏧᏚᎵᏍᎨ ᏣᏥᏐᏅᎢᏍᏔᏁᎢ; ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᎤᏙᏓdata is invalid ᎤᏓᏅᏛ ᎬᏩᏁᏟᏴᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏳᏩᏛᎮᎢ, ᎤᎵᏏᏀᎢᏍᏗᏳᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎬᎦᏌᏬᎢᎯ ᎤᏲᎴᎢ.
\ft For ye know how that afterward, when he would have inherited the blessing, he was rejected: for he found no place of repentance, though he sought it carefully with tears.

\ln Vtlayeno odalv gvsvnisdi gesv yitsilutsv, ale nasgi tsadaweligisgei, vtla ale gvhnage ulogilvi, ale ulisigiyu hosv ale ganolvvsgvi,
\syll ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᎣᏓᎸ ᎬᏒᏂᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏱᏥᎷᏨ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏣᏓᏪᎵᎩᏍᎨᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎬᎿᎨ ᎤᎶᎩᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏏᎩᏳ ᎰᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎦᏃᎸᎥᏍᎬᎢ,
\ft For ye are not come unto the mount that might be touched, and that burned with fire, nor unto blackness, and darkness, and tempest,

\ln Ale atselugi unoyvgvi, ale kanegv unoyvgvi; nasgino unadvganvhi unitayole taline nasgi igeniwesediyi nigesvna.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎠᏤᎷᎩ ᎤᏃᏴᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎧᏁᎬ ᎤᏃᏴᎬᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅᎯ ᎤᏂᏔᏲᎴ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎨᏂᏪᏎᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.
\ft And the sound of a trumpet, and the voice of words; which voice they that heard intreated that the word should not be spoken to them any more:

\ln Vtlayeno osiyu yuniyelvne nusdv ulinetsvi, Nasgi ganadlaiquo nasquo yunotlista odalvi ase nvya tsagvnisdodi gesvi, ale atsiyosdiquo gesv digvwalosvhi.
\syll ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᎣᏏᏳ ᏳᏂᏰᎸᏁ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎤᎵᏁᏨᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎾᏜᎢᏉ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏳᏃᏟᏍᏔ ᎣᏓᎸᎢ ᎠᏎ ᏅᏯ ᏣᎬᏂᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏥᏲᏍᏗᏉ ᎨᏒ ᏗᎬᏩᎶᏒᎯ.
\ft (For they could not endure that which was commanded, And if so much as a beast touch the mountain, it shall be stoned, or thrust through with a dart:

\ln Ale unigohv utsati unayehisdiyu gesv nasgi iyusdi Mosi hia nuwesei, Utsati tsinayesga ale aginawiha.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᎪᎲ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᎾᏰᎯᏍᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎼᏏ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎤᏣᏘ ᏥᎾᏰᏍᎦ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎩᎾᏫᎭ.
\ft And so terrible was the sight, that Moses said, I exceedingly fear and quake:)

\ln Sayanisgini odalv itsilutsv, ale gvnidv Unelanvhi utseli gaduhvi, nasgi Tsilusilimi galvladi ehi, ale digvsehohvsdi nigesvna getsinvsidasdi tsunadatlugvi,
\syll ᏌᏯᏂᏍᎩᏂ ᎣᏓᎸ ᎢᏥᎷᏨ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎦᏚᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎬᏎᎰᎲᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᏧᎾᏓᏡᎬᎢ,
\ft But ye are come unto mount Sion, and unto the city of the living God, the heavenly Jerusalem, and to an innumerable company of angels,

\ln Ale nahna nigadiyu unadatlisahvi, ale igvyi unadenvhi tsunanelodi unadatlugvi, nasgi [dunadov] galvladi tsidegowela, ale nahna Unelanvhi nigadiyu Digugodanehi [ehvi,] ale nahna tsunadanvdo unadanvti yvwi nanisganvna igegvnelvhi [anehvi,]
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏀᎾ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᎤᎾᏓᏟᏌᎲᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᎬᏱ ᎤᎾᏕᏅᎯ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᎾᏙᎥdata is invalid ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏥᏕᎪᏪᎳ, ᎠᎴ ᏀᎾ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏗᎫᎪᏓᏁᎯ ᎡᎲᎢ,data is invalid ᎠᎴ ᏀᎾ ᏧᎾᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ ᏴᏫ ᎾᏂᏍᎦᏅᎾ ᎢᎨᎬᏁᎸᎯ ᎠᏁᎲᎢ,data is invalid
\ft To the general assembly and church of the firstborn, which are written in heaven, and to God the Judge of all, and to the spirits of just men made perfect,

\ln Ale nahna Tsisa [ehvi] nasgi ayeli alehvsgi itse kanohedv datlohisdvi, ale nahna gigv asdutlvhi gesvi, nasgi utli iyosdv atayohihi tsigi esgaquo Equili [ugigv.]
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏀᎾ ᏥᏌ ᎡᎲᎢdata is invalid ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎠᎴᎲᏍᎩ ᎢᏤ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏓᏠᎯᏍᏛᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏀᎾ ᎩᎬ ᎠᏍᏚᏢᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏟ ᎢᏲᏍᏛ ᎠᏔᏲᎯᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎡᏈᎵ ᎤᎩᎬ.data is invalid
\ft And to Jesus the mediator of the new covenant, and to the blood of sprinkling, that speaketh better things than that of Abel.

\ln Itseyatahesdi tlesdiquo etsiyoiselvgi nasgi na tsikanega.  Iyuyeno nunadadiwiselvna yigi nasgi na uniyoisedv elohi unetsvhi, utlihiyu gvwatlisdi igadadiwisediyi iyuno iyvdv yinedadvnelv galvladi tsvdikanega;
\syll ᎢᏤᏯᏔᎮᏍᏗ ᏞᏍᏗᏉ ᎡᏥᏲᎢᏎᎸᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏥᎧᏁᎦ.  ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᏄᎾᏓᏗᏫᏎᎸᎾ ᏱᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᏂᏲᎢᏎᏛ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎤᏁᏨᎯ, ᎤᏟᎯᏳ ᎬᏩᏟᏍᏗ ᎢᎦᏓᏗᏫᏎᏗᏱ ᎢᏳᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏱᏁᏓᏛᏁᎸ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏨᏗᎧᏁᎦ;
\ft See that ye refuse not him that speaketh. For if they escaped not who refused him that spake on earth, much more shall not we escape, if we turn away from him that speaketh from heaven:

\ln Nasgi na kanegv nahiyu elohi utelvnei; aseno gohi gesv uduistanv, hia nuwesv, Asi saquo nvdatsitelvni vtla elohiquo uwasv, galvloisgini nasquo.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎧᏁᎬ ᏀᎢᏳ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎤᏖᎸᏁᎢ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏚᎢᏍᏔᏅ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒ, ᎠᏏ ᏌᏉ ᏅᏓᏥᏖᎸᏂ ᎥᏝ ᎡᎶᎯᏉ ᎤᏩᏒ, ᎦᎸᎶᎢᏍᎩᏂ ᎾᏍᏉ.
\ft Whose voice then shook the earth: but now he hath promised, saying, Yet once more I shake not the earth only, but also heaven.

\ln Nasgino hia tsinigaweha Asi saquoi, nasgi iyvdv idigvnedi gesv nasgi ditelvnvhi gesv gadvga, nasgi digotlvnvhiquo nasgiyai, nasgino na tsudalenvdv digvtselvdi nigesvna gesv nahnaquo disquanigododi iyulisdodiyi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᎦᏪᎭ ᎠᏏ ᏌᏉᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎢᏗᎬᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏖᎸᏅᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎦᏛᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎪᏢᏅᎯᏉ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ Ꮎ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏗᎬᏤᎸᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒ ᏀᎾᏉ ᏗᏍᏆᏂᎪᏙᏗ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
\ft And this word, Yet once more, signifieth the removing of those things that are shaken, as of things that are made, that those things which cannot be shaken may remain.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi nasgi ayv digadanilvtsvhi tsigi ugvwiyuhi utseligohi gesv nasgi gvtelvdi nigesvna, gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv igihesdi, nasgi idvdisgv Unelanvhi osdv uyelvdi digegilvwisdanedi yigi, galvquodiyu gesv, ale Unelanvhi ganayehisdi gesv tali igvdidegvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᏗᎦᏓᏂᎸᏨᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎪᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏖᎸᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᎩᎮᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏛᏗᏍᎬ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎤᏰᎸᏗ ᏗᎨᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᏱᎩ, ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎦᎾᏰᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏔᎵ ᎢᎬᏗᏕᎬᎢ.
\ft Wherefore we receiving a kingdom which cannot be moved, let us have grace, whereby we may serve God acceptably with reverence and godly fear:

\ln Iganelanvhiyeno atsilv adagohvsdisgi.
\syll ᎢᎦᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ ᎠᏥᎸ ᎠᏓᎪᎲᏍᏗᏍᎩ.
\ft For our God is a consuming fire.

\ln Analinvtli digeyudi gesv nvwasdidisesdiquo.
\syll ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏟ ᏗᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏩᏍᏗᏗᏎᏍᏗᏉ.
\ft Let brotherly love continue.

\ln Tlesdi yitsvgewisgesdi niditsadagatahvna ditsisquanigododiyi; giloyeno nasgi nanadvnehv galvladi anehi getsinvsidasdi tsunisquanigotanvhi igi.
\syll ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏨᎨᏫᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏂᏗᏣᏓᎦᏔᎲᎾ ᏗᏥᏍᏆᏂᎪᏙᏗᏱ; ᎩᎶᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᎾᏛᏁᎲ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎠᏁᎯ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᏧᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏔᏅᎯ ᎢᎩ.
\ft Be not forgetful to entertain strangers: for thereby some have entertained angels unawares.

\syll ᏕᏣᏅᏓᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏗᎨᎦᎸᎢᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᏥᏕᏣᎸᎣᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᏲ ᎢᎨᎬᎾᏕᎩ, ᎢᏨᏒᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏰᎸ ᎢᏤᎭ.
\ft Remember them that are in bonds, as bound with them; and them which suffer adversity, as being yourselves also in the body.

\syll ᏗᏨᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏂᎥᏉ ᎠᏁᎲ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏓᎾᏤᎲ ᎦᎳᏫᏎᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᎤᏕᎵᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᏗᎾᏂᏏᎲᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎾᏓᏲᏁᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏙᏓᎫᎪᏓᏁᎵ.
\ft Marriage is honourable in all, and the bed undefiled: but whoremongers and adulterers God will judge.

\ln Detsilvwisdanehv tlesdi tsugvwalodi agvvhisdi gesv yulitloyasdesdi; ale yeliquo itsiyelisesdi nusdv gohusdi itsihvi; hiayeno iyuwedv igi, Vtla ilvhiyu unelagi yvgagvyelisi, vtla ale yvgagvyvdegi.
\syll ᏕᏥᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎠᎬᎥᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏳᎵᏠᏯᏍᏕᏍᏗ; ᎠᎴ ᏰᎵᏉ ᎢᏥᏰᎵᏎᏍᏗ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎢᏥᎲᎢ; ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᎢᏳᏪᏛ ᎢᎩ, ᎥᏝ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᎤᏁᎳᎩ ᏴᎦᎬᏰᎵᏏ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᏴᎦᎬᏴᏕᎩ.
\ft Let your conversation be without covetousness; and be content with such things as ye have: for he hath said, I will never leave thee, nor forsake thee.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi nidinayesgvna hia igegiwesdi, Ugvwiyuhi agisdelisgi, ale vtla yvgatsisgaya yvwi igagvquvnedi gesvi.
