\ft So that we may boldly say, The Lord is my helper, and I will not fear what man shall do unto me.

\ln Detsanvdadisgesdi nasgi na getsagasayasdidegi, nasgi na Unelanvhi utseli kanohedv getsinanugowiselvhi; nasgi nusdv unohiyusv itsisdawadisesdi, osdv itsadanvtehisadv gesesdi nusdv wuliyeilolv dunilvwisdanelvi,
\syll ᏕᏣᏅᏓᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎨᏣᎦᏌᏯᏍᏗᏕᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎨᏥᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᎸᎯ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎤᏃᎯᏳᏒ ᎢᏥᏍᏓᏩᏗᏎᏍᏗ, ᎣᏍᏛ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏖᎯᏌᏛ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏭᎵᏰᎢᎶᎸ ᏚᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸᎢ,
\ft Remember them which have the rule over you, who have spoken unto you the word of God: whose faith follow, considering the end of their conversation.

\ln Tsisa Galonedv nvwasdiquo usvhi tsinusdv, ale gohi iga, ale ulisquadisdi nigesvna.
\syll ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏅᏩᏍᏗᏉ ᎤᏒᎯ ᏥᏄᏍᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᎪᎯ ᎢᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.
\ft Jesus Christ the same yesterday, and to day, and for ever.

\ln Tlesdi gudalenvdv ale nitsigatahvna dideyodi gesv yiditsatinidohesdi; osiyuyeno gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv yulisdayidisdi onawi; vtlano nusdvquo vlisdayvhvsgvi, nasgi gohusdi unalisdelvdodi wuliyeilolvhi nigesvna gesv nasgi iyusdi unagasayastanvhi gesvi.
\syll ᏞᏍᏗ ᎫᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎠᎴ ᏂᏥᎦᏔᎲᎾ ᏗᏕᏲᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏱᏗᏣᏘᏂᏙᎮᏍᏗ; ᎣᏏᏳᏰᏃ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏳᎵᏍᏓᏱᏗᏍᏗ ᎣᎾᏫ; ᎥᏝᏃ ᏄᏍᏛᏉ ᎥᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎬᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ ᏭᎵᏰᎢᎶᎸᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᎾᎦᏌᏯᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Be not carried about with divers and strange doctrines. For it is a good thing that the heart be established with grace; not with meats, which have not profited them that have been occupied therein.

\ln Atsilvgelasdiyi igotlvha, nahna vtla yiduyugodi unalisdayvdiyi galitsodvquo gohusdi anadvnehi tsigi.
\syll ᎠᏥᎸᎨᎳᏍᏗᏱ ᎢᎪᏢᎭ, ᏀᎾ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏚᏳᎪᏗ ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ ᎦᎵᏦᏛᏉ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎠᎾᏛᏁᎯ ᏥᎩ.
\ft We have an altar, whereof they have no right to eat which serve the tabernacle.

\ln Alewo nvgi dininvsadi unigigv galvquodiyu digesv tsiwiganetsvsdisge nugvwiyusv atsilvgelohi asgani aguyvdodi, nasgi diniyelv galitsodv doyiditlv danagohvsdisgei.
\syll ᎠᎴᏬ ᏅᎩ ᏗᏂᏅᏌᏗ ᎤᏂᎩᎬ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᏗᎨᏒ ᏥᏫᎦᏁᏨᏍᏗᏍᎨ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸᎨᎶᎯ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᎠᎫᏴᏙᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏂᏰᎸ ᎦᎵᏦᏛ ᏙᏱᏗᏢ ᏓᎾᎪᎲᏍᏗᏍᎨᎢ.
\ft For the bodies of those beasts, whose blood is brought into the sanctuary by the high priest for sin, are burned without the camp.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi Tsisa nasquo, nasgi, nanisganvna itsuwanediyi yvwi uwasv ugigv gvdisgvi, galohisdiyi [Tsilusilimi] doyiditlv ugiliyotsei.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏥᏌ ᎾᏍᏉ, ᎾᏍᎩ, ᎾᏂᏍᎦᏅᎾ ᎢᏧᏩᏁᏗᏱ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎤᎩᎬ ᎬᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻdata is invalid ᏙᏱᏗᏢ ᎤᎩᎵᏲᏤᎢ.
\ft Wherefore Jesus also, that he might sanctify the people with his own blood, suffered without the gate.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi idena wedilutsi galitsodv doyiditlv, igatloyasdisgesdi gayetsisotlvdisgvi;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏕᎾ ᏪᏗᎷᏥ ᎦᎵᏦᏛ ᏙᏱᏗᏢ, ᎢᎦᏠᏯᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎦᏰᏥᏐᏢᏗᏍᎬᎢ;
\ft Let us go forth therefore unto him without the camp, bearing his reproach.

\ln Aniyeno vtla ayogi nigesvna yigiduha, igiyohasgini nasgi iyusdi uliyvilohisdi gesvi.
\syll ᎠᏂᏰᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎠᏲᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏱᎩᏚᎭ, ᎢᎩᏲᎭᏍᎩᏂ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᎵᏴᎢᎶᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft For here have we no continuing city, but we seek one to come.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi, nasgi iyuwanisadv nigohilv Unelanvhi galvquododi gesv idalisgolvdisgesdi, nasgi degihagalv tsunanugowisvhi idalisgolvdisgesdi, nasgi deudov gvnigesv nidvnehv edalielitsehvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎦᎸᏉᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏓᎵᏍᎪᎸᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏕᎩᎭᎦᎸ ᏧᎾᏄᎪᏫᏒᎯ ᎢᏓᎵᏍᎪᎸᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏕᎤᏙᎥ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᏛᏁᎲ ᎡᏓᎵᎡᎵᏤᎲᎢ.
\ft By him therefore let us offer the sacrifice of praise to God continually, that is, the fruit of our lips giving thanks to his name.

\ln Osdvsgini ditsilvwisdanediyi ale itsadanediyi tlesdi itsvgewisvgi; nasgiyeno iyusdi dilisgolvdodi gesv osiyu uyelvha Unelanvhi.
\syll ᎣᏍᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᏗᏥᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏣᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎢᏨᎨᏫᏒᎩ; ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏗᎵᏍᎪᎸᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎤᏰᎸᎭ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ.
\ft But to do good and to communicate forget not: for with such sacrifices God is well pleased.

\ln Detsohiyusesdi nasgi na getsagasayasdidegi, ale detsadayosgesdiquo; ditsadanvdoyeno dunagasayasdidega, nasgiya iyunadvnedi tsigi nasgi na gvnigesv iyunvnedi tsigeso nunadvnelidolvi; nasgi analiheligv gvnigesv igvwanvnedi yigi, vtlano uyoquo dunadanvdvi; nasgiyeno vtla getsalisdelvdodi yigi.
\syll ᏕᏦᎯᏳᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎨᏣᎦᏌᏯᏍᏗᏕᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᏣᏓᏲᏍᎨᏍᏗᏉ; ᏗᏣᏓᏅᏙᏰᏃ ᏚᎾᎦᏌᏯᏍᏗᏕᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᏁᏗ ᏥᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏅᏁᏗ ᏥᎨᏐ ᏄᎾᏛᏁᎵᏙᎸᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎾᎵᎮᎵᎬ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᎬᏩᏅᏁᏗ ᏱᎩ, ᎥᏝᏃ ᎤᏲᏉ ᏚᎾᏓᏅᏛᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎨᏣᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ ᏱᎩ.
\ft Obey them that have the rule over you, and submit yourselves: for they watch for your souls, as they that must give account, that they may do it with joy, and not with grief: for that is unprofitable for you.

\ln Itsadadolisdisgv ayv sgineisdisgesdi; ogohiyuhayeno osiyu nidogvnv tsogadanvdo, ale ogaduliha nigavquo notsadvnelidohv yisdv iyogadvnediyi.
\syll ᎢᏣᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᎠᏴ ᏍᎩᏁᎢᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ; ᎣᎪᎯᏳᎭᏰᏃ ᎣᏏᏳ ᏂᏙᎬᏅ ᏦᎦᏓᏅᏙ, ᎠᎴ ᎣᎦᏚᎵᎭ ᏂᎦᎥᏉ ᏃᏣᏛᏁᎵᏙᎲ ᏱᏍᏛ ᎢᏲᎦᏛᏁᏗᏱ.
\ft Pray for us: for we trust we have a good conscience, in all things willing to live honestly.

\ln Hiasgininonv itsadvnediyi utli igai itsvsdiyediha, nasgi tleganage ditsehv taline wvquatinohisdiyi.
\syll ᎯᎠᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎢᏣᏛᏁᏗᏱ ᎤᏟ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎢᏨᏍᏗᏰᏗᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏞᎦᎾᎨ ᏗᏤᎲ ᏔᎵᏁ ᏮᏆᏘᏃᎯᏍᏗᏱ.
\ft But I beseech you the rather to do this, that I may be restored to you the sooner.

\ln Unelanvdino nvwadohiyadv adanehi, nasgi igatseli Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa uyohusv taline tsuletanvhi tsigi, nasgi na atsilvquodi Awidigatiya iyagvnelvhi, gvtanvhi gigv, ayogi nigesvna kanohedv datlohisdv asdayidisgi,
\syll ᎤᏁᎳᏅᏗᏃ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᎠᏓᏁᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎤᏲᎱᏒ ᏔᎵᏁ ᏧᎴᏔᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏗ ᎠᏫᏗᎦᏘᏯ ᎢᏯᎬᏁᎸᎯ, ᎬᏔᏅᎯ ᎩᎬ, ᎠᏲᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏓᏠᎯᏍᏛ ᎠᏍᏓᏱᏗᏍᎩ,
\ft Now the God of peace, that brought again from the dead our Lord Jesus, that great shepherd of the sheep, through the blood of the everlasting covenant,

\ln Nitsigolvna itsvnedi gesesdi, nigav osdv digalvwisdanedi gesv nasgi digetsilvwisdanedi osiyu uyelvdi iyulisdodiyi, nasgi osdv uyelvdi gesv itsadvnediyi nitsvnehv Tsisa Galonedv iyuwanisadv; nasgi atsilvquododi gesesdi nigohilv ale nigohilvi.  Amenv.
\syll ᏂᏥᎪᎸᎾ ᎢᏨᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᏂᎦᎥ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎨᏥᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎤᏰᎸᏗ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎤᏰᎸᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏣᏛᏁᏗᏱ ᏂᏨᏁᎲ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎪᎯᎸᎢ.  ᎠᎺᏅ.
\ft Make you perfect in every good work to do his will, working in you that which is wellpleasing in his sight, through Jesus Christ; to whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.

\ln Ale itsvsdiyediha, idalinvtli, udanvti ditsadanilvisdiyi itsvwonedisgvi; ilvsgiquoyeno ikanetsvhi itsvwoneda ani gowelihi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎢᏨᏍᏗᏰᏗᎭ, ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᎤᏓᏅᏘ ᏗᏣᏓᏂᎸᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎢᏨᏬᏁᏗᏍᎬᎢ; ᎢᎸᏍᎩᏉᏰᏃ ᎢᎧᏁᏨᎯ ᎢᏨᏬᏁᏓ ᎠᏂ ᎪᏪᎵᎯ.
\ft And I beseech you, brethren, suffer the word of exhortation: for I have written a letter unto you in few words.

\ln Itsanvtesdi nasgi Dimadi idalinvtli uneladvi; iyuno nigohilvna igalutsvha itsvgowadvdi igesesdi nasgi osdehesdi.
\syll ᎢᏣᏅᏖᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎹᏗ ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ ᎤᏁᎳᏛᎢ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᏂᎪᎯᎸᎾ ᎢᎦᎷᏨᎭ ᎢᏨᎪᏩᏛᏗ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏍᏕᎮᏍᏗ.
\ft Know ye that our brother Timothy is set at liberty; with whom, if he come shortly, I will see you.

\ln Detsiyolilvha nigadv getsagasayasdidegi, ale nigadv unadanvti.  Idali anehi wigetsiyoliga.
\syll ᏕᏥᏲᎵᎸᎭ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎨᏣᎦᏌᏯᏍᏗᏕᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ.  ᎢᏓᎵ ᎠᏁᎯ ᏫᎨᏥᏲᎵᎦ.
\ft Salute all them that have the rule over you, and all the saints. They of Italy salute you.

\ln Gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv detsikahnawadidohesdi nitsivi.  Emenv.
\syll ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏕᏥᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎮᏍᏗ ᏂᏥᎥᎢ.  ᎡᎺᏅ.
\ft Grace be with you all. Amen.

\ln Tsimi, Unelanvhi ale Tsisa Galonedv gvwanvsidv, witsiyoliga taladu nitsilasdalv itsadigaleyotsvhi tsigi.
\syll ᏥᎻ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎬᏩᏅᏏᏛ, ᏫᏥᏲᎵᎦ ᏔᎳᏚ ᏂᏥᎳᏍᏓᎸ ᎢᏣᏗᎦᎴᏲᏨᎯ ᏥᎩ.
\ft James, a servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ, to the twelve tribes which are scattered abroad, greeting.

\ln Idalinvtli, utsati ulihelisdiyu itsiyelvsesdi, iyuno tsudalenvdv itsigoliyesgi itsaliwadvehesdi.
\syll ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᎵᎮᎵᏍᏗᏳ ᎢᏥᏰᎸᏎᏍᏗ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎢᏥᎪᎵᏰᏍᎩ ᎢᏣᎵᏩᏛᎡᎮᏍᏗ.
\ft My brethren, count it all joy when ye fall into divers temptations;

\ln Hia nasgi itsigatahesdi, itsohiyusv agoliyedi gesv itsvnidiyu nitsvnehvi.
\syll ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎮᏍᏗ, ᎢᏦᎯᏳᏒ ᎠᎪᎵᏰᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏨᏂᏗᏳ ᏂᏨᏁᎲᎢ.
\ft Knowing this, that the trying of your faith worketh patience.

\ln Adina itsvnidiyu gesv ukalitsvhi tsulvwisdanedi gesv dulvwisdanehesdi; nasgino nihi itsikalitsvhi ale itsinosdv gesesdi, gohusdi nitsigolvna.
\syll ᎠᏗᎾ ᎢᏨᏂᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎧᎵᏨᎯ ᏧᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ; ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏥᎧᎵᏨᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏥᏃᏍᏛ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏂᏥᎪᎸᎾ.
\ft But let patience have her perfect work, that ye may be perfect and entire, wanting nothing.

\ln Iyuno gilo nihi itsehv agadovhisdi gesv unigvgesdi, Unelanvhi atayosehesdi, nasgi naniv nulisinvdvna dinehitsigi, ale nidasgagvna tsigi; ale ase atsinedi gesesdi.
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏤᎲ ᎠᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏂᎬᎨᏍᏗ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᏔᏲᏎᎮᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏄᎵᏏᏅᏛᎾ ᏗᏁᎯᏥᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᏓᏍᎦᎬᎾ ᏥᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᎠᏎ ᎠᏥᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all men liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.

\ln Adina uwohiyuhiyu gesesdi atayohihesdi, gohusdi nudlasidvehvna; Udlasidvehiyeno nasgiquo amequohi dalisdilanegv unole tsunolvtanidoho ale tsugehidohoi.
\syll ᎠᏗᎾ ᎤᏬᎯᏳᎯᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎠᏔᏲᎯᎮᏍᏗ, ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏄᏜᏏᏛᎡᎲᎾ; ᎤᏜᏏᏛᎡᎯᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩᏉ ᎠᎺᏉᎯ ᏓᎵᏍᏗᎳᏁᎬ ᎤᏃᎴ ᏧᏃᎸᏔᏂᏙᎰ ᎠᎴ ᏧᎨᎯᏙᎰᎢ.
\ft But let him ask in faith, nothing wavering. For he that wavereth is like a wave of the sea driven with the wind and tossed.

\ln Tlesdi nasgi asgaya, Ugvwiyuhi gohusdi dvgineli, yelisgesdi.
\syll ᏞᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ, ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏛᎩᏁᎵ, ᏰᎵᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
\ft For let not that man think that he shall receive any thing of the Lord.

\ln Asgaya tali iyudai udanvdvi unetliyvsati gesoi nigav dulvwisdanehvi.
\syll ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᏔᎵ ᎢᏳᏓᎢ ᎤᏓᏅᏛᎢ ᎤᏁᏟᏴᏌᏘ ᎨᏐᎢ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎢ.
\ft A double minded man is unstable in all his ways.

\ln Itsadanvtli gesv uyo iyudvhnadegi waliheligi atsisaladanvi,
\syll ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏟ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏲ ᎢᏳᏛᎿᏕᎩ ᏩᎵᎮᎵᎩ ᎠᏥᏌᎳᏓᏅᎢ,
\ft Let the brother of low degree rejoice in that he is exalted:

\ln Uwehnaisgini eladi nagvnelvi; kanosgayeno utsilvsv tsigalosgo nasgiya dagalosoni.
\syll ᎤᏪᎿᎢᏍᎩᏂ ᎡᎳᏗ ᎾᎬᏁᎸᎢ; ᎧᏃᏍᎦᏰᏃ ᎤᏥᎸᏒ ᏥᎦᎶᏍᎪ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏓᎦᎶᏐᏂ.
\ft But the rich, in that he is made low: because as the flower of the grass he shall pass away.

\ln Likalvgiquoyeno nvdo udilegi, hnaquo gvyvdisgo kanosga, ale utsilvsv gadoasgoi, ale uwoduhiyu gesv udotlvsv ayogoi.  Nasgiya nasquo uwehnai dagvyvsi dulvwisdanehvi.
\syll ᎵᎧᎸᎩᏉᏰᏃ ᏅᏙ ᎤᏗᎴᎩ, ᎿᏉ ᎬᏴᏗᏍᎪ ᎧᏃᏍᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏥᎸᏒ ᎦᏙᎠᏍᎪᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏬᏚᎯᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏙᏢᏒ ᎠᏲᎪᎢ.  ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᏪᎿᎢ ᏓᎬᏴᏏ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎢ.
\ft For the sun is no sooner risen with a burning heat, but it withereth the grass, and the flower thereof falleth, and the grace of the fashion of it perisheth: so also shall the rich man fade away in his ways.

\ln Osiyu iyulisdanedi nasgi na asgaya ugoliyesgi tsuyilidoho gvnidiyu tsigesoi, atsigoliyevhiyeno gesesdi gvnidv alisdulo atsinvnedi gesesdi, nasgi Ugvwiyuhi tsuduisdanelvhi tsigi gvwageyuhi.
\syll ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᎪᎵᏰᏍᎩ ᏧᏱᎵᏙᎰ ᎬᏂᏗᏳ ᏥᎨᏐᎢ, ᎠᏥᎪᎵᏰᎥᎯᏰᏃ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎠᎵᏍᏚᎶ ᎠᏥᏅᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏧᏚᎢᏍᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎬᏩᎨᏳᎯ.
\ft Blessed is the man that endureth temptation: for when he is tried, he shall receive the crown of life, which the Lord hath promised to them that love him.

\ln Tlesdi gilo iyuno atsigoliyesgesdi, Unelanvhi agigoliyeha udvnvgi; Unelanvhiyeno vtla gayetsigoliyedi yigi uyo agvdanehvi, vtla ale uwasv gilo yagoliyesgoi.
\syll ᏞᏍᏗ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᏃ ᎠᏥᎪᎵᏰᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎩᎪᎵᏰᎭ ᎤᏛᏅᎩ; ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎦᏰᏥᎪᎵᏰᏗ ᏱᎩ ᎤᏲ ᎠᎬᏓᏁᎲᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎩᎶ ᏯᎪᎵᏰᏍᎪᎢ.
\ft Let no man say when he is tempted, I am tempted of God: for God cannot be tempted with evil, neither tempteth he any man:

\ln Gilosgini atsigoliyesgoi iyuno uwasv udulisgv tsutinehi ale tsusadvvsgoi.
\syll ᎩᎶᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏥᎪᎵᏰᏍᎪᎢ ᎢᏳᏃ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎬ ᏧᏘᏁᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏧᏌᏛᎥᏍᎪᎢ.
\ft But every man is tempted, when he is drawn away of his own lust, and enticed.

\ln Hnaquono adulvdi gesv adotlvna asgani gananugowisgoi; asganino asquada hnaquo ayohuhisdi gesv gananugowisgoi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎠᏚᎸᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏙᏢᎾ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᎦᎾᏄᎪᏫᏍᎪᎢ; ᎠᏍᎦᏂᏃ ᎠᏍᏆᏓ ᎿᏉ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎦᎾᏄᎪᏫᏍᎪᎢ.
\ft Then when lust hath conceived, it bringeth forth sin: and sin, when it is finished, bringeth forth death.

\ln Tlesdi inilidasdanvgi, itsvgeyui idadanvtli;
\syll ᏞᏍᏗ ᎢᏂᎵᏓᏍᏓᏅᎩ, ᎢᏨᎨᏳᎢ ᎢᏓᏓᏅᏟ;
\ft Do not err, my beloved brethren.

\ln Nigav osdv adanedi gesvi, ale nigav osani adanedi gesv galvladi didalehvsga ale atloasihiha didalehvsga Agayvligesdvyi igagati uwehi, nasgi gvwadanetliyvsdi nigesvna gesvi, ale gvwagatahvsdi gesv nudayvladvwi gesvi.
\syll ᏂᎦᎥ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎠᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎣᏌᏂ ᎠᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏗᏓᎴᎲᏍᎦ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏠᎠᏏᎯᎭ ᏗᏓᎴᎲᏍᎦ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᏍᏛᏱ ᎢᎦᎦᏘ ᎤᏪᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏩᏓᏁᏟᏴᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᎦᏔᎲᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏄᏓᏴᎳᏛᏫ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, and cometh down from the Father of lights, with whom is no variableness, neither shadow of turning.

\ln Uwasv udanvtedv iginanugowisv uwatanv kanohedv gayegogi nigesvna, nasgi ayv igvyi eganelanvhi nasgiya igalisdodiyi nasgi geganelanvhi gesvi.
\syll ᎤᏩᏒ ᎤᏓᏅᏖᏛ ᎢᎩᎾᏄᎪᏫᏒ ᎤᏩᏔᏅ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎦᏰᎪᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᎢᎬᏱ ᎡᎦᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎢᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᎦᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Of his own will begat he us with the word of truth, that we should be a kind of firstfruits of his creatures.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi itsvgeyui idalinvtli, naniv osinuliyu gesesdi na udvgodiyi, usganoliyu gesesdi unineisdiyi, usganoliyu unitalawohisdiyi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏨᎨᏳᎢ ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᎾᏂᎥ ᎣᏏᏄᎵᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ Ꮎ ᎤᏛᎪᏗᏱ, ᎤᏍᎦᏃᎵᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᏂᏁᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᎤᏍᎦᏃᎵᏳ ᎤᏂᏔᎳᏬᎯᏍᏗᏱ.
\ft Wherefore, my beloved brethren, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, slow to wrath:

\ln Yvwiyeno utalawosgvi vtla yigananugowisgo duyugodv Unelanvhi utseliga.
\syll ᏴᏫᏰᏃ ᎤᏔᎳᏬᏍᎬᎢ ᎥᏝ ᏱᎦᎾᏄᎪᏫᏍᎪ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ.
\ft For the wrath of man worketh not the righteousness of God.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi iyvdv nitsvnehesdi nigav gadaha gesvi ale ulosvstanvhi uyo gesvi, ale udadolisdi itsvtanvha detsadanilvtsvha kanohedv gvyitlanvhi, nasgi yeliquo digvwasdelvdi tsigi ditsadanvdogi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏂᏨᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎦᏓᎭ ᎨᏒᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎶᏒᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎤᏲ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎢᏨᏔᏅᎭ ᏕᏣᏓᏂᎸᏨᎭ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎬᏱᏝᏅᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏰᎵᏉ ᏗᎬᏩᏍᏕᎸᏗ ᏥᎩ ᏗᏣᏓᏅᏙᎩ.
\ft Wherefore lay apart all filthiness and superfluity of naughtiness, and receive with meekness the engrafted word, which is able to save your souls.

\ln Aseno kanohedv nigawesgv itsadvnehi gesesdi, tlesdino itsadvgisgiquo uwasv yigesesdi, itsvsv yitsadalidasdisgesdi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎬ ᎢᏣᏛᏁᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᏞᏍᏗᏃ ᎢᏣᏛᎩᏍᎩᏉ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎢᏨᏒ ᏱᏣᏓᎵᏓᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
\ft But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.

\ln Iyuyeno gilo advgisgiquo yigi iyadvnehino nigesvna yigi kanohedv nigawesgvi, nasgi asgaya datselv tsagowatisgo nusdv uwasv ukadvi adagediyi;
\syll ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎠᏛᎩᏍᎩᏉ ᏱᎩ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᎯᏃ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏱᎩ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎬᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᏓᏤᎸ ᏣᎪᏩᏘᏍᎪ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎤᎧᏛᎢ ᎠᏓᎨᏗᏱ;
\ft For if any be a hearer of the word, and not a doer, he is like unto a man beholding his natural face in a glass:

\ln Uwasvyeno adagowatisgoi, ale adanvsgoi, gilaquono iyvdv uwagewisgo nusdvi.
\syll ᎤᏩᏒᏰᏃ ᎠᏓᎪᏩᏘᏍᎪᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏓᏅᏍᎪᎢ, ᎩᎳᏉᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎤᏩᎨᏫᏍᎪ ᏄᏍᏛᎢ.
\ft For he beholdeth himself, and goeth his way, and straightway forgetteth what manner of man he was.

\ln Gilosgini osdv agoliyesgesdi akalilvhi dikahnawadvsdi gvdakahvsgi tsigi, ale gayaisesdi, nasgi asgaya osdv udanvdadisdi gesesdi dulvwisdanehvi, nasgiyeno uwagewisati nigesvna advgisgi, tsulvwisdanehisgini digalvwisdanedi gesvi.
\syll ᎩᎶᏍᎩᏂ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎠᎪᎵᏰᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᎧᎵᎸᎯ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎬᏓᎧᎲᏍᎩ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᏯᎢᏎᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎤᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎤᏩᎨᏫᏌᏘ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎠᏛᎩᏍᎩ, ᏧᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft But whoso looketh into the perfect law of liberty, and continueth therein, he being not a forgetful hearer, but a doer of the work, this man shall be blessed in his deed.

\ln Iyuno gilo itsehv yudasuya tsunelodi yinvwasdi, niganahisdisgvnano yigi ganogoi, uwasvquosgini unawi galidasdisgi yigi, nasgi asgaya tsunelodi gesv asequoi.
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏤᎲ ᏳᏓᏑᏯ ᏧᏁᎶᏗ ᏱᏅᏩᏍᏗ, ᏂᎦᏀᎢᏍᏗᏍᎬᎾᏃ ᏱᎩ ᎦᏃᎪᎢ, ᎤᏩᏒᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᎾᏫ ᎦᎵᏓᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᏱᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᏧᏁᎶᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏎᏉᎢ.
\ft If any man among you seem to be religious, and bridleth not his tongue, but deceiveth his own heart, this man's religion is vain.

\ln Osdv dinelododi gesv ale gadaha nigesvna agatahv Unelanvhi Agayvligei, hia nusdi, Diwadvhidasdiyi tsunadaniyadv ale tsunosulotsvhi uyo nunadvnadegvi, ale ulisquanigododiyi uwasv nuduyasdvna iyulisdodiyi elohi anehi nunasdv iyulisdodiyi nigesvna.
\syll ᎣᏍᏛ ᏗᏁᎶᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎦᏓᎭ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎠᎦᏔᎲ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏍᏗ, ᏗᏩᏛᎯᏓᏍᏗᏱ ᏧᎾᏓᏂᏯᏛ ᎠᎴ ᏧᏃᏑᎶᏨᎯ ᎤᏲ ᏄᎾᏛᎾᏕᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᏂᎪᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏄᏚᏯᏍᏛᎾ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎠᏁᎯ ᏄᎾᏍᏛ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.
\ft Pure religion and undefiled before God and the Father is this, To visit the fatherless and widows in their affliction, and to keep himself unspotted from the world.

\ln Idalinvtli, etsoyusv Galvquodiyu Ugvwiyuhi igatseli Tsisa Galonedv, tlesdi tali yudvdesdi didalvquododi gesvi.
\syll ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᎡᏦᏳᏒ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᏔᎵ ᏳᏛᏕᏍᏗ ᏗᏓᎸᏉᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft My brethren, have not the faith of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Lord of glory, with respect of persons.

\ln Iyuyeno gilo asgaya yuyvlilv detsilawivi adelv dalonige uliyesusdogi tsuwoduhi tsunuwai, nasquono yuyvlilv uyo iyudvnadegi digadaha tsunuwai;
\syll ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᏳᏴᎵᎸ ᏕᏥᎳᏫᎥᎢ ᎠᏕᎸ ᏓᎶᏂᎨ ᎤᎵᏰᏑᏍᏙᎩ ᏧᏬᏚᎯ ᏧᏄᏩᎢ, ᎾᏍᏉᏃ ᏳᏴᎵᎸ ᎤᏲ ᎢᏳᏛᎾᏕᎩ ᏗᎦᏓᎭ ᏧᏄᏩᎢ;
\ft For if there come unto your assembly a man with a gold ring, in goodly apparel, and there come in also a poor man in vile raiment;

\ln Yetsilvquotanvno tsuwoduhi tsunuwai, ale hia yinetsiweselv, Ani osdv gesv hihvga, uyono iyudvhnadegi hia yinetsiweselv, Nahna na hidogesdi, ale ani hihvga hiqualasidiyi agisgilv hawiniditlv;
\syll ᏰᏥᎸᏉᏔᏅᏃ ᏧᏬᏚᎯ ᏧᏄᏩᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏱᏁᏥᏪᏎᎸ, ᎠᏂ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎯᎲᎦ, ᎤᏲᏃ ᎢᏳᏛᎿᏕᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏱᏁᏥᏪᏎᎸ, ᏀᎾ Ꮎ ᎯᏙᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂ ᎯᎲᎦ ᎯᏆᎳᏏᏗᏱ ᎠᎩᏍᎩᎸ ᎭᏫᏂᏗᏢ;
\ft And ye have respect to him that weareth the gay clothing, and say unto him, Sit thou here in a good place; and say to the poor, Stand thou there, or sit here under my footstool:

\ln Tlesdi hnaquo detsadanvdv yiditsadalvquodiha, ale tlasgo ditsugodisgi uyo itsadanvtesgi yinitsalistanv?
\syll ᏞᏍᏗ ᎿᏉ ᏕᏣᏓᏅᏛ ᏱᏗᏣᏓᎸᏉᏗᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᏝᏍᎪ ᏗᏧᎪᏗᏍᎩ ᎤᏲ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏖᏍᎩ ᏱᏂᏣᎵᏍᏔᏅ?
\ft Are ye not then partial in yourselves, and are become judges of evil thoughts?

\ln Itsadvgvga itsvgeyui idalinvtli, Tlasgo Unelanvhi yidusuyesv uyo iyunadvhnadegi elohi anehi, unehnaiyu gohiyudi gesvi, ale unadoliga utseligohi nasgi tsuduisdanelvhi tsigi gvwageyuhi?
\syll ᎢᏣᏛᎬᎦ ᎢᏨᎨᏳᎢ ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᏝᏍᎪ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏱᏚᏑᏰᏒ ᎤᏲ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᎿᏕᎩ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎠᏁᎯ, ᎤᏁᎿᎢᏳ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏙᎵᎦ ᎤᏤᎵᎪᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏚᎢᏍᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎬᏩᎨᏳᎯ?
\ft Hearken, my beloved brethren, Hath not God chosen the poor of this world rich in faith, and heirs of the kingdom which he hath promised to them that love him?

\ln Nihisgini vtla yetsigasayastanv uyo iyudvhnadegi.  Tlasgo tsunehnai uyo yinigetsvhnadegoi, ale yidigetsatinohiho digugododiyi?
\syll ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎥᏝ ᏰᏥᎦᏌᏯᏍᏔᏅ ᎤᏲ ᎢᏳᏛᎿᏕᎩ.  ᏝᏍᎪ ᏧᏁᎿᎢ ᎤᏲ ᏱᏂᎨᏨᎿᏕᎪᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏱᏗᎨᏣᏘᏃᎯᎰ ᏗᎫᎪᏙᏗᏱ?
\ft But ye have despised the poor. Do not rich men oppress you, and draw you before the judgment seats?

\ln Tlasgo yanisotlvisdisgo galvquodiyu deudov nasgi nihi tsetsostanvhi tsigi?
\syll ᏝᏍᎪ ᏯᏂᏐᏢᎢᏍᏗᏍᎪ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᏕᎤᏙᎥ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎯ ᏤᏦᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ?
\ft Do not they blaspheme that worthy name by the which ye are called?

\ln Iyuno itsikaliihesdi galvquodiyu dikahnawadvsdi nasgiya nigvnv gowelvi, "Tsvsv tsinitsadageyuha nigeyusesdi nav idisdadala," tsadiha, osiyu yinitsadvga.
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᎢᏥᎧᎵᎢᎮᏍᏗ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏂᎬᏅ ᎪᏪᎸᎢ, data is invalidᏨᏒ ᏥᏂᏣᏓᎨᏳᎭ ᏂᎨᏳᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᎥ ᎢᏗᏍᏓᏓᎳ,data is invalid ᏣᏗᎭ, ᎣᏏᏳ ᏱᏂᏣᏛᎦ.
\ft If ye fulfill the royal law according to the scripture, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself, ye do well:

\ln Iyusginino dotsadalvquodisgesdiquo, itsisganvgesdi, ale dikanawadvsdi detsugodanehesdi itsisganvtsvhi gesvi.
\syll ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂᏃ ᏙᏣᏓᎸᏉᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗᏉ, ᎢᏥᏍᎦᏅᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎧᎾᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏕᏧᎪᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᎢᏥᏍᎦᏅᏨᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft But if ye have respect to persons, ye commit sin, and are convinced of the law as transgressors.

\ln Giloyeno nigadv dikahnawadvsdi yidakahnawadega, sudalegiquono gohusdi yayosdiha, nigadv duyostanoi.
\syll ᎩᎶᏰᏃ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏱᏓᎧᎿᏩᏕᎦ, ᏑᏓᎴᎩᏉᏃ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏯᏲᏍᏗᎭ, ᏂᎦᏛ ᏚᏲᏍᏔᏃᎢ.
\ft For whosoever shall keep the whole law, and yet offend in one point, he is guilty of all.

\ln Hiayeno iyuwedv tsigi, "Tlesdi tsadayonelvgi," nasquo hia iyuwedv igi, "Tlesdi tsadalvgi;" nasgino iyuno nitsadayonelvna yigi, aseno yitsadalv, Hnaquo dikahnawadvsdi hiyosdisgi nulistanv.
\syll ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᎢᏳᏪᏛ ᏥᎩ, data is invalidᏞᏍᏗ ᏣᏓᏲᏁᎸᎩ,data is invalid ᎾᏍᏉ ᎯᎠ ᎢᏳᏪᏛ ᎢᎩ, data is invalidᏞᏍᏗ ᏣᏓᎸᎩ;data is invalid ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎢᏳᏃ ᏂᏣᏓᏲᏁᎸᎾ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᏱᏣᏓᎸ, ᎿᏉ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎯᏲᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ.
\ft For he that said, Do not commit adultery, said also, Do not kill. Now if thou commit no adultery, yet if thou kill, thou art become a transgressor of the law.

\ln Itsinegvi ale detsilvwisdanehvi nasgiya gesesdi nusdv unineisdi gesv ale tsunilvwisdanedi gesv nasgi na digegugodanedi tsigi dikahnawadvsdi gvdakahvsgi gegvdanedi tsigi.
\syll ᎢᏥᏁᎬᎢ ᎠᎴ ᏕᏥᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎢ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎤᏂᏁᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏗᎨᎫᎪᏓᏁᏗ ᏥᎩ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎬᏓᎧᎲᏍᎩ ᎨᎬᏓᏁᏗ ᏥᎩ.
\ft So speak ye, and so do, as they that shall be judged by the law of liberty.

\ln Natsidoligvnayeno tsagugodanedi gesesdi nudadolitsvhi; adadolisdino gesv adalinedideha digugododi gesvi.
\syll ᎾᏥᏙᎵᎬᎾᏰᏃ ᏣᎫᎪᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏄᏓᏙᎵᏨᎯ; ᎠᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏃ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏓᎵᏁᏗᏕᎭ ᏗᎫᎪᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft For he shall have judgment without mercy, that hath shewed no mercy; and mercy rejoiceth against judgment.

\ln Gado gvdodi, idalinvtli, iyuno gilo aquohiyuha yadiha, nidulvwisdanehvnano yigi?  Uwohiyusvsgo yeliquo yusdelv?
\syll ᎦᏙ ᎬᏙᏗ, ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎠᏉᎯᏳᎭ ᏯᏗᎭ, ᏂᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎾᏃ ᏱᎩ?  ᎤᏬᎯᏳᏒᏍᎪ ᏰᎵᏉ ᏳᏍᏕᎸ?
\ft What doth it profit, my brethren, though a man say he hath faith, and have not works? can faith save him?

\ln Iyuno gilo iginvtli ale igido tsuniyelvha yigi, ale yuninigvga nidugitsvnisv alisdayvdi gesvi,
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎢᎩᏅᏟ ᎠᎴ ᎢᎩᏙ ᏧᏂᏰᎸᎭ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏳᏂᏂᎬᎦ ᏂᏚᎩᏨᏂᏒ ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ,
\ft If a brother or sister be naked, and destitute of daily food,

\ln Gilono nihi itsadatlugv hia yiniduweselv; Nvwadohiyadv tsitsena, itsiganawosvhi ale ditsolvsvhi gesesdi; niditsinehvnano igesesdi ayelv ulisdelvdodi gesvi; gado gvdodi nasgi?
\syll ᎩᎶᏃ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏣᏓᏡᎬ ᎯᎠ ᏱᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸ; ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᏥᏤᎾ, ᎢᏥᎦᎾᏬᏒᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏦᎸᏒᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᏂᏗᏥᏁᎲᎾᏃ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎠᏰᎸ ᎤᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎦᏙ ᎬᏙᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ?
\ft And one of you say unto them, Depart in peace, be ye warmed and filled; notwithstanding ye give them not those things which are needful to the body; what doth it profit?

\ln Nasgiya nasquo gohiyudi gesvi, iyuno tali nudvdvna igesesdi digalvwisdanedi gesvi, uliwotsvhi, uwasvquo gesv iyusdi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᏔᎵ ᏄᏛᏛᎾ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᎵᏬᏨᎯ, ᎤᏩᏒᏉ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ.
\ft Even so faith, if it hath not works, is dead, being alone.

\ln Udohiyuhi gilo hia yinvgawi, Nihi tsohiyuha, ayvno dagilvwisdaneha; gvnigesv nisquvnisi tsohiyusv detsalvwisdanehv nvdisgvna gesvi, ayvno gvnigesv nvdagvyvneli aquohiyusv dagilvwisdanehv gvdisgvi.
\syll ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎩᎶ ᎯᎠ ᏱᏅᎦᏫ, ᏂᎯ ᏦᎯᏳᎭ, ᎠᏴᏃ ᏓᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎭ; ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᏍᏋᏂᏏ ᏦᎯᏳᏒ ᏕᏣᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᏅᏗᏍᎬᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᏴᏃ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏅᏓᎬᏴᏁᎵ ᎠᏉᎯᏳᏒ ᏓᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᎬᏗᏍᎬᎢ.
\ft Yea, a man may say, Thou hast faith, and I have works: shew me thy faith without thy works, and I will shew thee my faith by my works.

\ln Nihi hohiyuhvsga asiyvwi ehv Unelanvhi.  Osiyu hnadvneha.  Anisgina nasquo anohiyuhvsga, ale duninawiha.
\syll ᏂᎯ ᎰᎯᏳᎲᏍᎦ ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᎡᎲ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ.  ᎣᏏᏳ ᎿᏛᏁᎭ.  ᎠᏂᏍᎩᎾ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏂᎾᏫᎭ.
\ft Thou believest that there is one God; thou doest well: the devils also believe, and tremble.

\ln Tsadulisgono tsagadovhisdiyi, nitsadanvdvna hisgaya, gohiyudi gesv uliwotsvhi gesv digalvwisdanedi gesv tali nudvdvna yigi?
\syll ᏣᏚᎵᏍᎪᏃ ᏣᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗᏱ, ᏂᏣᏓᏅᏛᎾ ᎯᏍᎦᏯ, ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎵᏬᏨᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏔᎵ ᏄᏛᏛᎾ ᏱᎩ?
\ft But wilt thou know, O vain man, that faith without works is dead?

\ln Tlasgo Equahami igidoda yududalestane dulvwisdanehvi, ulisgolvtanv uwetsi Esigi atsilv gelasdiyi?
\syll ᏝᏍᎪ ᎡᏆᎭᎻ ᎢᎩᏙᏓ ᏳᏚᏓᎴᏍᏔᏁ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎢ, ᎤᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏅ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎡᏏᎩ ᎠᏥᎸ ᎨᎳᏍᏗᏱ?
\ft Was not Abraham our father justified by works, when he had offered Isaac his son upon the altar?

\ln Higowatiha gohiyudi gesv usdelvhv dulvwisdanelvi, nasgino dulvwisdanelv uwatanv gohiyudi gesv ukalilvi.
\syll ᎯᎪᏩᏘᎭ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏍᏕᎸᎲ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸ ᎤᏩᏔᏅ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎧᎵᎸᎢ.
\ft Seest thou how faith wrought with his works, and by works was faith made perfect?

\ln Gowelvno udohiyunei hia tsinigaweha; "Equahami uwohiyunvgi Unelvnvhi, nasgino duyugodv digalvwisdanedi gesv utloyi atsiyelvnanelvgi."  Nasgino Unelanvhi Unalii agosehvgi.
\syll ᎪᏪᎸᏃ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᏁᎢ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᎦᏪᎭ; data is invalidᎡᏆᎭᎻ ᎤᏬᎯᏳᏅᎩ ᎤᏁᎸᏅᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏠᏱ ᎠᏥᏰᎸᎾᏁᎸᎩ.data is invalid  ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎾᎵᎢ ᎠᎪᏎᎲᎩ.
\ft And the scripture was fulfilled which saith, Abraham believed God, and it was imputed unto him for righteousness: and he was called the Friend of God.

\ln Nasgino itsigowatiha yvwi deulvwisdanehv adudalesdisgvi, vtlano gohiyudiquo gesv uwasv.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎢᏥᎪᏩᏘᎭ ᏴᏫ ᏕᎤᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᎠᏚᏓᎴᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᎥᏝᏃ ᎪᎯᏳᏗᏉ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏩᏒ.
\ft Ye see then how that by works a man is justified, and not by faith only.

\ln Ale nasquo Lehawi unegutsidv tlasgo deulvwisdanehv yududalestanei dudanilvtsv nasgi na nvdagetsinvsidv ale dunvwistanv utsatini iditlv wunilohisdiyi?
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎴᎭᏫ ᎤᏁᎫᏥᏛ ᏝᏍᎪ ᏕᎤᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᏳᏚᏓᎴᏍᏔᏁᎢ ᏚᏓᏂᎸᏨ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏅᏓᎨᏥᏅᏏᏛ ᎠᎴ ᏚᏅᏫᏍᏔᏅ ᎤᏣᏘᏂ ᎢᏗᏢ ᏭᏂᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ?
\ft Likewise also was not Rahab the harlot justified by works, when she had received the messengers, and had sent them out another way?

\ln Ayelvyeno adanvdo nuwehvna yigi udawotsvhi tsigesoi, nasgiyaquo gohiyudi gesv tali nudvdvna yigi digalvwisdanedi gesv nasquo uliwotsvhi gesoi.
\syll ᎠᏰᎸᏰᏃ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᏄᏪᎲᎾ ᏱᎩ ᎤᏓᏬᏨᎯ ᏥᎨᏐᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯᏉ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏔᎵ ᏄᏛᏛᎾ ᏱᎩ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᎵᏬᏨᎯ ᎨᏐᎢ.
\ft For as the body without the spirit is dead, so faith without works is dead also.

\ln Idalinvtli tlesdi itsitsati ditsadeyohvsgi yigesesdi, itsigatahayeno utli igai igisdvdisdi gesvi;
\syll ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎢᏥᏣᏘ ᏗᏣᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎭᏰᏃ ᎤᏟ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎢᎩᏍᏛᏗᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ;
\ft My brethren, be not many masters, knowing that we shall receive the greater condemnation.

\ln Utsatiyeno iyudalegi nidiv idisganvgoi.  Iyuno gilo gawonisgv nasganvgvna tsigesoi, nasgi nugolvna geso asgaya, yeliquo nasquo gvwenahisdodi nigv ayelvi.
\syll ᎤᏣᏘᏰᏃ ᎢᏳᏓᎴᎩ ᏂᏗᎥ ᎢᏗᏍᎦᏅᎪᎢ.  ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎦᏬᏂᏍᎬ ᎾᏍᎦᏅᎬᎾ ᏥᎨᏐᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᎪᎸᎾ ᎨᏐ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ, ᏰᎵᏉ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎬᏪᏀᎢᏍᏙᏗ ᏂᎬ ᎠᏰᎸᎢ.
\ft For in many things we offend all. If any man offend not in word, the same is a perfect man, and able also to bridle the whole body.

\ln Gvniyuquo dedihanaladisgo soquili gegohiyudiyi, ale nigv diniyelv dedigolvsidohoi.
\syll ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᏕᏗᎭᎾᎳᏗᏍᎪ ᏐᏈᎵ ᎨᎪᎯᏳᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎬ ᏗᏂᏰᎸ ᏕᏗᎪᎸᏏᏙᎰᎢ.
\ft Behold, we put bits in the horses' mouths, that they may obey us; and we turn about their whole body.

\ln Gvniyuquo nasquo tsiyutsudvna tsequohiyusgininonv ale usgasedi unole deganidohoi, aseno danigatahvsidoho anvtisgo usdigiyu gasadvsdi nahnaquo iditlv udulv gasadvsgi.
\syll ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏥᏳᏧᏛᎾ ᏤᏉᎯᏳᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏍᎦᏎᏗ ᎤᏃᎴ ᏕᎦᏂᏙᎰᎢ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᏓᏂᎦᏔᎲᏏᏙᎰ ᎠᏅᏘᏍᎪ ᎤᏍᏗᎩᏳ ᎦᏌᏛᏍᏗ ᏀᎾᏉ ᎢᏗᏢ ᎤᏚᎸ ᎦᏌᏛᏍᎩ.
\ft Behold also the ships, which though they be so great, and are driven of fierce winds, yet are they turned about with a very small helm, whithersoever the governor listeth.

\ln Nasgiya nasquo ganoga usdigiyu, aseno equohiyu gawonisgoi.  Gvniyuquo usdi atsilv nutsata ada datsistlvsgoi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎦᏃᎦ ᎤᏍᏗᎩᏳ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎡᏉᎯᏳ ᎦᏬᏂᏍᎪᎢ.  ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎠᏥᎸ ᏄᏣᏔ ᎠᏓ ᏓᏥᏍᏢᏍᎪᎢ.
\ft Even so the tongue is a little member, and boasteth great things. Behold, how great a matter a little fire kindleth!

\ln Ale ganoga atsilv nasgiyai ale elohi akalii niduyugodvna gesv nasgiya.  Nasgiya nusdi ganoga udasuyv igadotlvsvi, nasgi gadaha igvnehi nigv ayelvi, ale atsistlvsgi aisv anelanvhi gesvi, ale tsvsginoi udayudalenvhi atsitsistlawisdisgi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎦᏃᎦ ᎠᏥᎸ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎠᎧᎵᎢ ᏂᏚᏳᎪᏛᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ.  ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᏍᏗ ᎦᏃᎦ ᎤᏓᏑᏴ ᎢᎦᏙᏢᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏓᎭ ᎢᎬᏁᎯ ᏂᎬ ᎠᏰᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏥᏍᏢᏍᎩ ᎠᎢᏒ ᎠᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏨᏍᎩᏃᎢ ᎤᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᎠᏥᏥᏍᏝᏫᏍᏗᏍᎩ.
\ft And the tongue is a fire, a world of iniquity: so is the tongue among our members, that it defileth the whole body, and setteth on fire the course of nature; and it is set on fire of hell.

\ln Nunadalesvyeno inage anehi ale aninohilidohi ale anadanasinidohi ale amequohi anehi, didanvtisododi ale tsudanvtisotanvhi yvwi.
\syll ᏄᎾᏓᎴᏒᏰᏃ ᎢᎾᎨ ᎠᏁᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏃᎯᎵᏙᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎾᏓᎾᏏᏂᏙᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎺᏉᎯ ᎠᏁᎯ, ᏗᏓᏅᏘᏐᏙᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏧᏓᏅᏘᏐᏔᏅᎯ ᏴᏫ.
\ft For every kind of beasts, and of birds, and of serpents, and of things in the sea, is tamed, and hath been tamed of mankind:

\ln Ganogasgini vtla gilo yeli yvgvdanvtisoda, nasgi uyoi gvsegogisdi nigesvna, akalii adahihi nvwoti.
\syll ᎦᏃᎦᏍᎩᏂ ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᏰᎵ ᏴᎬᏓᏅᏘᏐᏓ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏲᎢ ᎬᏎᎪᎩᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎠᎧᎵᎢ ᎠᏓᎯᎯ ᏅᏬᏘ.
\ft But the tongue can no man tame; it is an unruly evil, full of deadly poison.

\ln Nasgi idvdisgoi edilvquodisgo Unelanvhi Agayvligei, ale nasgi idvdisgoi dedisginvdisgo yvwi nasgi Unelanvhi nusdv igegvnelvhi gegotlvnvhi
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏛᏗᏍᎪᎢ ᎡᏗᎸᏉᏗᏍᎪ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏛᏗᏍᎪᎢ ᏕᏗᏍᎩᏅᏗᏍᎪ ᏴᏫ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎢᎨᎬᏁᎸᎯ ᎨᎪᏢᏅᎯ
\ft Therewith bless we God, even the Father; and therewith curse we men, which are made after the similitude of God.

\ln Nasgi saquo aholi diganugogo galvquododi gesv ale asginvdisdi gesvi.  Idalinvtli, vtla osiyu yigi nasgi tsinusdi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏌᏉ ᎠᎰᎵ ᏗᎦᏄᎪᎪ ᎦᎸᏉᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏍᎩᏅᏗᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.  ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᎥᏝ ᎣᏏᏳ ᏱᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏄᏍᏗ.
\ft Out of the same mouth proceedeth blessing and cursing. My brethren, these things ought not so to be.

\ln Tsigo saquo ganugogv diganugogo uganasdv ama ale uyvsdi?
\syll ᏥᎪ ᏌᏉ ᎦᏄᎪᎬ ᏗᎦᏄᎪᎪ ᎤᎦᎾᏍᏛ ᎠᎹ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏴᏍᏗ?
\ft Doth a fountain send forth at the same place sweet water and bitter?

\ln Idalinvtli, tsigo svgataiyusdi tlugv yeliquo yanadadvga oliwa tlugv anadadvsgi, ale tsigo telvladihi svgalaiyusdi yanadadvga?  Nasquosgini vtla yeli saquo ganugogv yvdvganugoi ~ama ulotsidv ale ~ama ulotsidv nigesvna.
\syll ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᏥᎪ ᏒᎦᏔᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏡᎬ ᏰᎵᏉ ᏯᎾᏓᏛᎦ ᎣᎵᏩ ᏡᎬ ᎠᎾᏓᏛᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᎪ ᏖᎸᎳᏗᎯ ᏒᎦᎳᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏯᎾᏓᏛᎦ?  ᎾᏍᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎥᏝ ᏰᎵ ᏌᏉ ᎦᏄᎪᎬ ᏴᏛᎦᏄᎪᎢ ᎠᎹ ᎤᎶᏥᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎹ ᎤᎶᏥᏛ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.
\ft Can the fig tree, my brethren, bear olive berries? either a vine, figs? so can no fountain both yield salt water and fresh.

\ln Gago nihi nitsadvnvi udasuya asinasani ale agatanii?  Nasgi wigananugowa deulvwisdanehvi wigvdoda osiyu nadvnehvi, ale wigvdoda asinasaniyu gesv tali udvdesdi udanvti gesvi.
\syll ᎦᎪ ᏂᎯ ᏂᏣᏛᏅᎢ ᎤᏓᏑᏯ ᎠᏏᎾᏌᏂ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎦᏔᏂᎢ?  ᎾᏍᎩ ᏫᎦᎾᏄᎪᏩ ᏕᎤᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎢ ᏫᎬᏙᏓ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎾᏛᏁᎲᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏫᎬᏙᏓ ᎠᏏᎾᏌᏂᏳ ᎨᏒ ᏔᎵ ᎤᏛᏕᏍᏗ ᎤᏓᏅᏘ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Who is a wise man and endued with knowledge among you? let him shew out of a good conversation his works with meekness of wisdom.

\ln Iyusgini itsisquanigodesdi doditsadanvdvi advyugedi ale adisvsdi gesvi, tlesdi yitsatlvquasgesdi ale tlesdi yitsatsegovsgesdi udohiyusv yitsiyosgesdi.
\syll ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᏥᏍᏆᏂᎪᏕᏍᏗ ᏙᏗᏣᏓᏅᏛᎢ ᎠᏛᏳᎨᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏗᏒᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏣᏢᏆᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏣᏤᎪᎥᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᏒ ᏱᏥᏲᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
\ft But if ye have bitter envying and strife in your hearts, glory not, and lie not against the truth.

\ln Hia nasgi asinasaniyu gesv vtla galvladi nvdayudalenvhi yigi, elohiquosgini ehi ale uquudalvquo ehi ale asgina iyusdi.
\syll ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏏᎾᏌᏂᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎥᏝ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᏱᎩ, ᎡᎶᎯᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎡᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏊᏓᎸᏉ ᎡᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏍᎩᎾ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ.
\ft This wisdom descendeth not from above, but is earthly, sensual, devilish.

\ln Nahnayeno advyugedi ale adisvsdi anehvi, nahna eho tsudalenvdv ale nigav uyo digalvwisdanedi gesvi.
\syll ᏀᎾᏰᏃ ᎠᏛᏳᎨᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏗᏒᏍᏗ ᎠᏁᎲᎢ, ᏀᎾ ᎡᎰ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎤᏲ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft For where envying and strife is, there is confusion and every evil work.

\ln Galvladisgini nvdayudalenvhi tsigi asinasaniyu gesv igvyiyi gadaha nigesvna gesoi, hnaquono gohisdisgi, ale udanvti, ale uwohiyuhisdv, ale akaliwohi adadolisdi gesvi ale osdv digalvwisdanedi gesvi, ale nudalvquodvna, ale utlonasdi nigesvna.
\syll ᎦᎸᎳᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎠᏏᎾᏌᏂᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎢᎬᏱᏱ ᎦᏓᎭ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏐᎢ, ᎿᏉᏃ ᎪᎯᏍᏗᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᏅᏘ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏬᎯᏳᎯᏍᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎧᎵᏬᎯ ᎠᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏄᏓᎸᏉᏛᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏠᎾᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.
\ft But the wisdom that is from above is first pure, then peaceable, gentle, and easy to be intreated, full of mercy and good fruits, without partiality, and without hypocrisy.

\ln Anohisdisgini anohisdisgvi aniwisgo duyugodv unanugowisdi gesvi.
\syll ᎠᏃᎯᏍᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏃᎯᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ ᎠᏂᏫᏍᎪ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏫᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft And the fruit of righteousness is sown in peace of them that make peace.

\ln Hatlv didalehvsga dahnawa ale dilisdi gesv nihi itsehvle?  Tlasgo nasgi adulvdi gesv ditsiyelv hawini tsidaliha nahna yvdidalehvsga?
\syll ᎭᏢ ᏗᏓᎴᎲᏍᎦ ᏓᎿᏩ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏤᎲᎴ?  ᏝᏍᎪ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏚᎸᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏗᏥᏰᎸ ᎭᏫᏂ ᏥᏓᎵᎭ ᏀᎾ ᏴᏗᏓᎴᎲᏍᎦ?
\ft From whence come wars and fightings among you? come they not hence, even of your lusts that war in your members?

\ln Igaduligoi, aseno vtla yitsiwatisgoi; detsadahihoi ale itselihisgo itsiwadvdiyi aseno vtla yitsiwatisgoi; detsalihoi ale dahnawa itsegoi, aseno vtla yitsiwatisgo nvdigalisdodisgo nitsitayohihvna gesvi.
\syll ᎢᎦᏚᎵᎪᎢ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏥᏩᏘᏍᎪᎢ; ᏕᏣᏓᎯᎰᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏤᎵᎯᏍᎪ ᎢᏥᏩᏛᏗᏱ ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏥᏩᏘᏍᎪᎢ; ᏕᏣᎵᎰᎢ ᎠᎴ ᏓᎿᏩ ᎢᏤᎪᎢ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏥᏩᏘᏍᎪ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎪ ᏂᏥᏔᏲᎯᎲᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Ye lust, and have not: ye kill, and desire to have, and cannot obtain: ye fight and war, yet ye have not, because ye ask not.

\ln Itsitayohihoi, aseno vtla yitsiwatisgoi, nvdigalisdodisgo niduyugodvna gesv itsitayohihvi, itsadulisgv nasgi itsvdodiyi osdv itsadanvdadisdisgi itsiwadvdiyi.
\syll ᎢᏥᏔᏲᎯᎰᎢ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏥᏩᏘᏍᎪᎢ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎪ ᏂᏚᏳᎪᏛᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏥᏔᏲᎯᎲᎢ, ᎢᏣᏚᎵᏍᎬ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏨᏙᏗᏱ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᎢᏥᏩᏛᏗᏱ.
\ft Ye ask, and receive not, because ye ask amiss, that ye may consume it upon your lusts.

\ln Ditsadayonehi itsisgaya ale itsigeyv, tlasgo yitsigataha elohi unalii gesvi Unelanvhi asgagi gesvi?  Nasgino iyusdi iyuno gilo elohi unalii iyulisdodiyi yadanvteha nasgi Unelanvhi asgagi gesoi.
\syll ᏗᏣᏓᏲᏁᎯ ᎢᏥᏍᎦᏯ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏥᎨᏴ, ᏝᏍᎪ ᏱᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎤᎾᎵᎢ ᎨᏒᎢ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᏍᎦᎩ ᎨᏒᎢ?  ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎤᎾᎵᎢ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏯᏓᏅᏖᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᏍᎦᎩ ᎨᏐᎢ.
\ft Ye adulterers and adulteresses, know ye not that the friendship of the world is enmity with God? whosoever therefore will be a friend of the world is the enemy of God.

\ln Asequosgo nigawe itsiyelvha hia tsinigawe goweli; Adanvdo tsigiyaa udulisgv advyugedi gesv wagati.
\syll ᎠᏎᏉᏍᎪ ᏂᎦᏪ ᎢᏥᏰᎸᎭ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᎦᏪ ᎪᏪᎵ; ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᏥᎩᏯᎠ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎬ ᎠᏛᏳᎨᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏩᎦᏘ.
\ft Do ye think that the scripture saith in vain, The spirit that dwelleth in us lusteth to envy?

\ln Aseno utli igai gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv danehoiNasgi iyusdi hia nigaweha; Unelanvhi unatlvquodi datludisgoi, unadadolisdisgini gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv danehoi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏟ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏓᏁᎰᎢᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᎭ; ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎾᏢᏉᏗ ᏓᏡᏗᏍᎪᎢ, ᎤᎾᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏓᏁᎰᎢ.
\ft But he giveth more grace. Wherefore he saith, God resisteth the proud, but giveth grace unto the humble.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi tsetsaleyohisi Unelanvhi; Tsetsatliyvsi asgina, ale ase datsadanveli.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏤᏣᎴᏲᎯᏏ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ; ᏤᏣᏟᏴᏏ ᎠᏍᎩᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏎ ᏓᏣᏓᏅᎡᎵ.
\ft Submit yourselves therefore to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.

\ln Nav etsilutsisi Unelanvhi nasgino nihi nav datsilutseli.  Ditsosuli ditsoyeni itsisganai, ale ditsinvgalv ditsinawi tali itsudai ditsadanvti.
\syll ᎾᎥ ᎡᏥᎷᏥᏏ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏂᎯ ᎾᎥ ᏓᏥᎷᏤᎵ.  ᏗᏦᏑᎵ ᏗᏦᏰᏂ ᎢᏥᏍᎦᎾᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏥᏅᎦᎸ ᏗᏥᎾᏫ ᏔᎵ ᎢᏧᏓᎢ ᏗᏣᏓᏅᏘ.
\ft Draw nigh to God, and he will draw nigh to you. Cleanse your hands, ye sinners; and purify your hearts, ye double minded.

\ln Uyo itsadanvdada ale ditsiyvla ale ditsatloyiga; itsiyetsasgvi ayvlisdi gesv wadanetliyvsda, ale itsaliheligv uyo adanvdadisdi gesv wadanetliyvsda.
\syll ᎤᏲ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏓᏓ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏥᏴᎳ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏣᏠᏱᎦ; ᎢᏥᏰᏣᏍᎬᎢ ᎠᏴᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏩᏓᏁᏟᏴᏍᏓ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏣᎵᎮᎵᎬ ᎤᏲ ᎠᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏩᏓᏁᏟᏴᏍᏓ.
\ft Be afflicted, and mourn, and weep: let your laughter be turned to mourning, and your joy to heaviness.

\ln Itsadadolisdi gesesdi Yihowa dodikanisgvi, nasgino datsisaladani.
\syll ᎢᏣᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏱᎰᏩ ᏙᏗᎧᏂᏍᎬᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏓᏥᏌᎳᏓᏂ.
\ft Humble yourselves in the sight of the Lord, and he shall lift you up.

\ln Tlesdi usonv yiditsadanohesgesdi idadanvtli; usonv tsikanohesgo tsikaneisdisgo dinadanvtli ale tsidegugodaneho dinadanvtli, Nasgi usonv kanohesgo kaneisdisgo dikahnawadvsdi ale degugodaneho dikahnawadvsdi; iyuno dikahnawadvsdi yidugodaneha vtla dikahnawadvsdi tikahnawadegi yigagi dugodanehisgini.
\syll ᏞᏍᏗ ᎤᏐᏅ ᏱᏗᏣᏓᏃᎮᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎢᏓᏓᏅᏟ; ᎤᏐᏅ ᏥᎧᏃᎮᏍᎪ ᏥᎧᏁᎢᏍᏗᏍᎪ ᏗᎾᏓᏅᏟ ᎠᎴ ᏥᏕᎫᎪᏓᏁᎰ ᏗᎾᏓᏅᏟ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏐᏅ ᎧᏃᎮᏍᎪ ᎧᏁᎢᏍᏗᏍᎪ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏕᎫᎪᏓᏁᎰ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏱᏚᎪᏓᏁᎭ ᎥᏝ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏘᎧᎿᏩᏕᎩ ᏱᎦᎩ ᏚᎪᏓᏁᎯᏍᎩᏂ.
\ft Speak not evil one of another, brethren. He that speaketh evil of his brother, and judgeth his brother, speaketh evil of the law, and judgeth the law: but if thou judge the law, thou art not a doer of the law, but a judge.

\ln Asiyvwi eha dikahnawadvsdi gotlvsgi yeliquo gvwadasdelvdi ale gvwadahisdi; gago nihi nvwadale tsidehiyugodaneha?
\syll ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᎡᎭ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎪᏢᏍᎩ ᏰᎵᏉ ᎬᏩᏓᏍᏕᎸᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᏓᎯᏍᏗ; ᎦᎪ ᏂᎯ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᏥᏕᎯᏳᎪᏓᏁᎭ?
\ft There is one lawgiver, who is able to save and to destroy: who art thou that judgest another?

\ln Ka hia itsiwesgi; Gohi iga ale sunalei dayotsesi gehi digaduhvi, sudetiyvdvno wotsehesdi ale wotsinodisgesdi ale woginequotsehesdi;
\syll Ꭷ ᎯᎠ ᎢᏥᏪᏍᎩ; ᎪᎯ ᎢᎦ ᎠᎴ ᏑᎾᎴᎢ ᏓᏲᏤᏏ ᎨᎯ ᏗᎦᏚᎲᎢ, ᏑᏕᏘᏴᏛᏃ ᏬᏤᎮᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏬᏥᏃᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏬᎩᏁᏉᏤᎮᏍᏗ;
\ft Go to now, ye that say, To day or to morrow we will go into such a city, and continue there a year, and buy and sell, and get gain:

\ln Nitsigatahvnano iyulisdodi gesv sunalei; Detsvnvyeno gado usdi?  Ugvhadvquo nasgiyai nasgi tlega tsigananugogoi hnaquono tsalidvdisgoi.
\syll ᏂᏥᎦᏔᎲᎾᏃ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏑᎾᎴᎢ; ᏕᏨᏅᏰᏃ ᎦᏙ ᎤᏍᏗ?  ᎤᎬᎭᏛᏉ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏞᎦ ᏥᎦᎾᏄᎪᎪᎢ ᎿᏉᏃ ᏣᎵᏛᏗᏍᎪᎢ.
\ft Whereas ye know not what shall be on the morrow. For what is your life? It is even a vapour, that appeareth for a little time, and then vanisheth away.

\ln Nasgino iyusdi hia Yugvwiyuha yinitsiweha; Iyuno Ugvwiyuhi osi yuyelvnv, dotsvnesdi ale hia notsadvnehesdi ale hiaquo.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎯᎠ ᏳᎬᏫᏳᎭ ᏱᏂᏥᏪᎭ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎣᏏ ᏳᏰᎸᏅ, ᏙᏨᏁᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏃᏣᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠᏉ.
\ft For that ye ought to say, If the Lord will, we shall live, and do this, or that.

\ln Gohisgini gesv itsaliheliga itsatlvquasgvi; nigadv nasgi iyusdi alihelisdi gesv uyoquo gesoi.
\syll ᎪᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏣᎵᎮᎵᎦ ᎢᏣᏢᏆᏍᎬᎢ; ᏂᎦᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᎵᎮᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏲᏉ ᎨᏐᎢ.
\ft But now ye rejoice in your boastings: all such rejoicing is evil.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi gilo tsagatahoi osdv iyadvnedi gesvi, nasgino nadvnehvna tsigesoi, nasgi nahna asganvgoi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎩᎶ ᏣᎦᏔᎰᎢ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎾᏛᏁᎲᎾ ᏥᎨᏐᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏀᎾ ᎠᏍᎦᏅᎪᎢ.
\ft Therefore to him that knoweth to do good, and doeth it not, to him it is sin.

\ln Ka nihi ditsehnai ditsatloyiga ale ditsiyvla winigalisdoda itsigiliyoisdi itsilutsedi tsigi.
\syll Ꭷ ᏂᎯ ᏗᏤᎿᎢ ᏗᏣᏠᏱᎦ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏥᏴᎳ ᏫᏂᎦᎵᏍᏙᏓ ᎢᏥᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗ ᎢᏥᎷᏤᏗ ᏥᎩ.
\ft Go to now, ye rich men, weep and howl for your miseries that shall come upon you.

\ln Tsugvwalodi itsihvi ugosv; ditsanuwono tsisgoyv ganiyav;
\syll ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎢᏥᎲᎢ ᎤᎪᏒ; ᏗᏣᏄᏬᏃ ᏥᏍᎪᏴ ᎦᏂᏯᎥ;
\ft Your riches are corrupted, and your garments are motheaten.

\ln Ditsatseli dalonige adelv ale unegv adelv duyasdladv, duyasdladvno itsinohesgi gesesdi, ale uweyesdi gesesdi itsiquedalv atsilv tsigayesgo nasgiyai.  Itsitlisanv tsugvwalodi ulisqualvdi iga gesv ugvwali.
\syll ᏗᏣᏤᎵ ᏓᎶᏂᎨ ᎠᏕᎸ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎬ ᎠᏕᎸ ᏚᏯᏍᏜᏛ, ᏚᏯᏍᏜᏛᏃ ᎢᏥᏃᎮᏍᎩ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏪᏰᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎢᏥᏇᏓᎸ ᎠᏥᎸ ᏥᎦᏰᏍᎪ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ.  ᎢᏥᏟᏌᏅ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᎸᏗ ᎢᎦ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ.
\ft Your gold and silver is cankered; and the rust of them shall be a witness against you, and shall eat your flesh as it were fire. Ye have heaped treasure together for the last days.

\ln Gvniyuquo atloyiha gegaguyvdanedi tsunilvwisdanehi unisgudesvhi detsilogesvi, nasgi ditsinahisdanelvhi tsigi, unalisdvno nasgi unisgudesvhi duliayvlv Ugvwiyuhi dahnawa anegi unatseliga.
\syll ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎠᏠᏱᎭ ᎨᎦᎫᏴᏓᏁᏗ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᎤᏂᏍᎫᏕᏒᎯ ᏕᏥᎶᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏥᏀᎢᏍᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏛᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᏍᎫᏕᏒᎯ ᏚᎵᎠᏴᎸ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏓᎿᏩ ᎠᏁᎩ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ.
\ft Behold, the hire of the labourers who have reaped down your fields, which is of you kept back by fraud, crieth: and the cries of them which have reaped are entered into the ears of the Lord of sabaoth.

\ln Utlvquodi itsehvgi elohi ale nitsanelvna; detselolv ditsinawi, nasgiya tsinanadvneho dihisdiyi gesv iga asqualv.
\syll ᎤᏢᏉᏗ ᎢᏤᎲᎩ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏂᏣᏁᎸᎾ; ᏕᏤᎶᎸ ᏗᏥᎾᏫ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏥᎾᎾᏛᏁᎰ ᏗᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎨᏒ ᎢᎦ ᎠᏍᏆᎸ.
\ft Ye have lived in pleasure on the earth, and been wanton; ye have nourished your hearts, as in a day of slaughter.

\ln Degugodanelv ale etsilv nasginvna, vtlano yitsatletseha.
\syll ᏕᎫᎪᏓᏁᎸ ᎠᎴ ᎡᏥᎸ ᎾᏍᎩᏅᎾ, ᎥᏝᏃ ᏱᏣᏞᏤᎭ.
\ft Ye have condemned and killed the just; and he doth not resist you.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi idalinvtli ditsvnidiyu gesesdi gvni Ugvwiyuhi galutsvha.  Gvniyuquo ulogedv agatiyo galvquodi elohi unanugowisvhi, ale gvnidiyu geso agatiyoi, gvni uganasi igvyiyi ale oniyi uganodi gesvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ ᏗᏨᏂᏗᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎬᏂ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎦᎷᏨᎭ.  ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎤᎶᎨᏛ ᎠᎦᏘᏲ ᎦᎸᏉᏗ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏫᏒᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᏗᏳ ᎨᏐ ᎠᎦᏘᏲᎢ, ᎬᏂ ᎤᎦᎾᏏ ᎢᎬᏱᏱ ᎠᎴ ᎣᏂᏱ ᎤᎦᏃᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Be patient therefore, brethren, unto the coming of the Lord. Behold, the husbandman waiteth for the precious fruit of the earth, and hath long patience for it, until he receive the early and latter rain.

\ln Nihi nasquo ditsvnidiyu gesesdi; ditsalinigohisda ditsinawi, Ugvwiyuhiyeno uluhisdiyi usqualvhidi.
\syll ᏂᎯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏗᏨᏂᏗᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᏗᏣᎵᏂᎪᎯᏍᏓ ᏗᏥᎾᏫ, ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᏰᏃ ᎤᎷᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏍᏆᎸᎯᏗ.
\ft Be ye also patient; stablish your hearts: for the coming of the Lord draweth nigh.

\ln Idadanvtli tlesdi yiditsadasgagesdi yidetsugodasiyeno itsisganvtsvi.  Gvniyuquo Digugodisgi galohisdiyi gadoga.
\syll ᎢᏓᏓᏅᏟ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏗᏣᏓᏍᎦᎨᏍᏗ ᏱᏕᏧᎪᏓᏏᏰᏃ ᎢᏥᏍᎦᏅᏨᎢ.  ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᏗᎫᎪᏗᏍᎩ ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎦᏙᎦ.
\ft Grudge not one against another, brethren, lest ye be condemned: behold, the judge standeth before the door.

\ln Idadanvtli adolehohisdodi agiliyoisdi gesv ale gvnidiyu gesvi, anadolehosgi Ugvwiyuhi deudosdv unineistanvhi tsigi, ditsikahnawadvsdi gesesdi.
\syll ᎢᏓᏓᏅᏟ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏙᏗ ᎠᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᏗᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏕᎤᏙᏍᏛ ᎤᏂᏁᎢᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᏗᏥᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft Take, my brethren, the prophets, who have spoken in the name of the Lord, for an example of suffering affliction, and of patience.

\ln Gvniyuquo osiyu iyunalisdanedi igiyelvso dinvnidiyu tsigesoi.  Itsadvganv gvnidiyu gesv Tsoqui, ale itsigohv nusdv wuyeilohisdi gesv Ugvwiyuhi, ale nasgi Ugvwiyuhi utsati udanvtiyu gesv ale udadolitsatiyu gesvi.
\syll ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎢᎩᏰᎸᏐ ᏗᏅᏂᏗᏳ ᏥᎨᏐᎢ.  ᎢᏣᏛᎦᏅ ᎬᏂᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᏦᏈ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏥᎪᎲ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏭᏰᎢᎶᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᏓᏅᏘᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏣᏘᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Behold, we count them happy which endure. Ye have heard of the patience of Job, and have seen the end of the Lord; that the Lord is very pitiful, and of tender mercy.

\ln Aseno idadanvtli, wudagonadvdvi, tlesdi yitsaselidvsgesdi yitsineisdisgesdi galvloi, ale elohi, ale tlesdi nudalesvquo aselidodi gesvi; ale tlesdi nudalesvquo aselidodi gesvi; itsatselisgini vv itsadvdi gesv vv gesesdi, ale itsatseli vtla itsadvdi gesv vtla gesesdi; nasgino tlesdi tsetsugodanelvgi itsisganvtsvi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎢᏓᏓᏅᏟ, ᏭᏓᎪᎾᏛᏛᎢ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏣᏎᎵᏛᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏱᏥᏁᎢᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎦᎸᎶᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎡᎶᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏄᏓᎴᏒᏉ ᎠᏎᎵᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏄᏓᎴᏒᏉ ᎠᏎᎵᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎢᏣᏤᎵᏍᎩᏂ ᎥᎥ ᎢᏣᏛᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎥᎥ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏣᏤᎵ ᎥᏝ ᎢᏣᏛᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎥᏝ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏤᏧᎪᏓᏁᎸᎩ ᎢᏥᏍᎦᏅᏨᎢ.
\ft But above all things, my brethren, swear not, neither by heaven, neither by the earth, neither by any other oath: but let your yea be yea; and your nay, nay; lest ye fall into condemnation.

\ln Gilo itsehv udasuyesdi agiliyogesdi, adadolisdisgesdi; Gilo ugalisdi udanvtesdi dekanogisgesdi.
\syll ᎩᎶ ᎢᏤᎲ ᎤᏓᏑᏰᏍᏗ ᎠᎩᎵᏲᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ; ᎩᎶ ᎤᎦᎵᏍᏗ ᎤᏓᏅᏖᏍᏗ ᏕᎧᏃᎩᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
\ft Is any among you afflicted? let him pray. Is any merry? let him sing psalms.

\ln Gilo itsehv udasuyesdi utlvgesdi, widayanisgesdi digegadilodi tsunanelodi unadatlugvi, nasgino anadadolisdisgesdi anitayohihesdi atsisdelvdiyi, gvwalonedisgesdi atlonedi anvdisgesdi Ugvwiyuhi dudovi;
\syll ᎩᎶ ᎢᏤᎲ ᎤᏓᏑᏰᏍᏗ ᎤᏢᎨᏍᏗ, ᏫᏓᏯᏂᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏗᎨᎦᏗᎶᏗ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎠᎾᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᏂᏔᏲᎯᎮᏍᏗ ᎠᏥᏍᏕᎸᏗᏱ, ᎬᏩᎶᏁᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᏠᏁᏗ ᎠᏅᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏚᏙᎥᎢ;
\ft Is any sick among you? let him call for the elders of the church; and let them pray over him, anointing him with oil in the name of the Lord:

\ln Gohiyuhino adanolisdodi gesv dayusdelvhi utlvgi, Ugvwiyuhino dodayuletani; iyu ale usdunvtsvhi gesesdi nasgi tsatsinihisedi gesesdi.
\syll ᎪᎯᏳᎯᏃ ᎠᏓᏃᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏓᏳᏍᏕᎸᎯ ᎤᏢᎩ, ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᏃ ᏙᏓᏳᎴᏔᏂ; ᎢᏳ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏍᏚᏅᏨᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏣᏥᏂᎯᏎᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft And the prayer of faith shall save the sick, and the Lord shall raise him up; and if he have committed sins, they shall be forgiven him.

\ln Gvnigesv nidetsadadvnehesdi itsisganvtsvdi, ale detsadadolisdanehesdi, initayohihesdi ditsadiwisdiyi.  Udohiyuhiya uyelvhi udadolisdodi gesv udanvti utsati adasdelisgoi.
\syll ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᏕᏣᏓᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᎢᏥᏍᎦᏅᏨᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᏣᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ, ᎢᏂᏔᏲᎯᎮᏍᏗ ᏗᏣᏗᏫᏍᏗᏱ.  ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎤᏰᎸᎯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏓᏅᏘ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎠᏓᏍᏕᎵᏍᎪᎢ.
\ft Confess your faults one to another, and pray one for another, that ye may be healed. The effectual fervent prayer of a righteous man availeth much.

\ln Ilaya yvwiquo gesvgi ayv nigalisdanehv nasgiya igvwalisdanedi gesvgi; ale ulinigidv udanvdvgi udadolistanvgi utayolvgi uganodiyi nigesvna; howano nudunanvna gesvgi gadohi tsoi tsudetiyvdv sudalino iyanvdo igohidv.
\syll ᎢᎳᏯ ᏴᏫᏉ ᎨᏒᎩ ᎠᏴ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎢᎬᏩᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᎤᏓᏅᏛᎩ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏔᏅᎩ ᎤᏔᏲᎸᎩ ᎤᎦᏃᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ; ᎰᏩᏃ ᏄᏚᎾᏅᎾ ᎨᏒᎩ ᎦᏙᎯ ᏦᎢ ᏧᏕᏘᏴᏛ ᏑᏓᎵᏃ ᎢᏯᏅᏙ ᎢᎪᎯᏛ.
\ft Elias was a man subject to like passions as we are, and he prayed earnestly that it might not rain: and it rained not on the earth by the space of three years and six months.

\ln Alewo udadolistanvgi, galvloino uganodanelvgi, godohino unanugowisvgi unanugowisdi gesvi.
\syll ᎠᎴᏬ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏔᏅᎩ, ᎦᎸᎶᎢᏃ ᎤᎦᏃᏓᏁᎸᎩ, ᎪᏙᎯᏃ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏫᏒᎩ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏫᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft And he prayed again, and the heaven gave rain, and the earth brought forth her fruit.

\ln Idalinvtli, iyuno gilo nihi nitsadvnv atlesgesdi duyosgesdi duyugodv gesvi, gilono iugatahvsgesdi,
\syll ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᏂᎯ ᏂᏣᏛᏅ ᎠᏞᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏚᏲᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎩᎶᏃ ᎢᎤᎦᏔᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ,
\ft Brethren, if any of you do err from the truth, and one convert him;

\ln Nasgi agatahesdi, nasgi asgana agatahvsgi nahna ulidastanvhi aisvi, nasgi asdelisgv gudalesgv adanvdo ayohuhisdi gesvi, ale utsati iyudalegi asdunvtsvhi gesv gvsgalvsgvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎦᏔᎮᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᎦᎾ ᎠᎦᏔᎲᏍᎩ ᏀᎾ ᎤᎵᏓᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎠᎢᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᏕᎵᏍᎬ ᎫᏓᎴᏍᎬ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎢᏳᏓᎴᎩ ᎠᏍᏚᏅᏨᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏍᎦᎸᏍᎬᎢ.
\ft Let him know, that he which converteth the sinner from the error of his way shall save a soul from death, and shall hide a multitude of sins.

\ln Ayv Quida Tsisa Galonedv aginvsidv witsvyowelasi itsadigaleyotsvhi Quvdiyi itsedohi ale Gelesiyi ale Gequadosi ale Esiyi ale Quidiniyi;
\syll ᎠᏴ ᏈᏓ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎠᎩᏅᏏᏛ ᏫᏨᏲᏪᎳᏏ ᎢᏣᏗᎦᎴᏲᏨᎯ ᏋᏗᏱ ᎢᏤᏙᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎨᎴᏏᏱ ᎠᎴ ᎨᏆᏙᏏ ᎠᎴ ᎡᏏᏱ ᎠᎴ ᏈᏗᏂᏱ;
\ft Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, to the strangers scattered throughout Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia,

\ln Etsasuyedv nasgiya nagataho Unelanvhi Agayvligei, gvtanvhi udanvgalvdi gesv Adanvdo, nasgi nahna tsvdidalehvsga gohiyudi gesv ale asdutlisdi gesv ugigv Tsisa Galonedv; Gawagatiya udadolisdi gesv ale nvwadohiyadv utsati itsatseli gesesdi.
\syll ᎡᏣᏑᏰᏛ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᎦᏔᎰ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ, ᎬᏔᏅᎯ ᎤᏓᏅᎦᎸᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏀᎾ ᏨᏗᏓᎴᎲᏍᎦ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏍᏚᏟᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎩᎬ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ; ᎦᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎢᏣᏤᎵ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft Elect according to the foreknowledge of God the Father, through sanctification of the Spirit, unto obedience and sprinkling of the blood of Jesus Christ: Grace unto you, and peace, be multiplied.

\ln Galvquododi gesesdi Unelanvhi nasgi Ugayvlige Tsisa Galonedv Ugvwiyuhi igatseliga, nasgi utsati udadolitsatiyu gesv tsinvdigalisdodi taline tsiginanugowisv udugi gvdi gesv tsiginelv gvnidv igigowadvdiyi nvdayudalenvhi uyohusv dulehisanv Tsisa Galonedv;^
\syll ᎦᎸᏉᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᎦᏤᎵᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏣᏘᏳ ᎨᏒ ᏥᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᏔᎵᏁ ᏥᎩᎾᏄᎪᏫᏒ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎬᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏥᎩᏁᎸ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎢᎩᎪᏩᏛᏗᏱ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᎤᏲᎱᏒ ᏚᎴᎯᏌᏅ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ;data is invalid
\ft Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, which according to his abundant mercy hath begotten us again unto a lively hope by the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,

\ln Tsiginelv igatseli iyulisdodi tsugvwalodi ayogi nigesvna, ale gadaha nigesvna, ale asgolvgi nigesvna, tsosv etsisquanigodanelvhi nihi,
\syll ᏥᎩᏁᎸ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎠᏲᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᏓᎭ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏍᎪᎸᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᏦᏒ ᎡᏥᏍᏆᏂᎪᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᏂᎯ,
\ft To an inheritance incorruptible, and undefiled, and that fadeth not away, reserved in heaven for you,

\ln Nasgi gohiyudi gesv itsvdisgv Unelanvhi ulinigidiyu gesv gvdi tsetsisquanigodi etsisdelvdi gesv gvdisgi, nasgi etsisdelvdi gesv tsadvnvisdi gvnigesv igvnediyi ulisqualvdi gesesdi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏨᏗᏍᎬ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏗ ᏤᏥᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᎡᏥᏍᏕᎸᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏗᏍᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᏥᏍᏕᎸᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏣᏛᏅᎢᏍᏗ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᎬᏁᏗᏱ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᎸᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft Who are kept by the power of God through faith unto salvation ready to be revealed in the last time.

\ln Nasgi nahna utsati tsitsaliheliga, gohisgininonv tlega, iyuno osiyu gesesdi, ehisdi itsadanvtawadega udigalisdodiha tsudalenvdv itsigoliyesgi itsaliwadvehvi,
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏀᎾ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏥᏣᎵᎮᎵᎦ, ᎪᎯᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᏞᎦ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎡᎯᏍᏗ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏔᏩᏕᎦ ᎤᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎢᏥᎪᎵᏰᏍᎩ ᎢᏣᎵᏩᏛᎡᎲᎢ,
\ft Wherein ye greatly rejoice, though now for a season, if need be, ye are in heaviness through manifold temptations:

\ln Nasgi itsohiyusv agoliyedi gesv utli galvquodiyu esgaquo adelv dalonige agoliyedi gesv nasgi ayogi tsigi, nasquo atsilv gvtanvhi agoliyevhi yigi, yiwaliyeiloga galvquododi gesvi, ale osdv ayelvdi gesvi, ale galvquodiyu gesvi, Tsisa Galonedv gananugotsilv iyui.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏦᎯᏳᏒ ᎠᎪᎵᏰᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏟ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎠᏕᎸ ᏓᎶᏂᎨ ᎠᎪᎵᏰᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏲᎩ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏥᎸ ᎬᏔᏅᎯ ᎠᎪᎵᏰᎥᎯ ᏱᎩ, ᏱᏩᎵᏰᎢᎶᎦ ᎦᎸᏉᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎠᏰᎸᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎦᎾᏄᎪᏥᎸ ᎢᏳᎢ.
\ft That the trial of your faith, being much more precious than of gold that perisheth, though it be tried with fire, might be found unto praise and honour and glory at the appearing of Jesus Christ:

\ln Nasgi [Tsisa Galonedv] etsigovhi nigesvna ietsigeyuha; ale nasgi gohi gesv netsigowatisgvna, aseno etsohiyuhvsgvi etsaliheliga itsvdiha alihelisdi gesv ganohedi nigesvna ale galvquotanvhi;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛdata is invalid ᎡᏥᎪᎥᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᎡᏥᎨᏳᎭ; ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏁᏥᎪᏩᏘᏍᎬᎾ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎡᏦᎯᏳᎲᏍᎬᎢ ᎡᏣᎵᎮᎵᎦ ᎢᏨᏗᎭ ᎠᎵᎮᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎦᏃᎮᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎠᎴ ᎦᎸᏉᏔᏅᎯ;
\ft Whom having not seen, ye love; in whom, though now ye see him not, yet believing, ye rejoice with joy unspeakable and full of glory:

\ln Ale etsalisgolvdaneha itsohiyusv nusdv ugvwalvi, nasgi ditsadanvdo disdelvdi gesvi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎡᏣᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᎭ ᎢᏦᎯᏳᏒ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎤᎬᏩᎸᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏣᏓᏅᏙ ᏗᏍᏕᎸᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Receiving the end of your faith, even the salvation of your souls.

\ln Nasgi na alisdelvdodi gesv anadolehosgi osdv onigedvnvhi ale uniyolvhi, nasgi unadolehosvhi unineistanvhi nihi etsidolisdi gesvi;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎣᏂᎨᏛᏅᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏲᎸᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᏙᎴᎰᏒᎯ ᎤᏂᏁᎢᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᏂᎯ ᎡᏥᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ;
\ft Of which salvation the prophets have inquired and searched diligently, who prophesied of the grace that should come unto you:

\ln Uniyohvgi iyu gesvi, ale iyulistanidasdi gesv gadvgvi Adanvdo Galonedv utseliga nasgi uniyavi, igvyi gayehi gvnigesv tsinigvnehe ugiliyoisdiyi Galonedv ale galvquodiyu gesv oni unanugoisdiyi.
\syll ᎤᏂᏲᎲᎩ ᎢᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏔᏂᏓᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎦᏛᎬᎢ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᏯᎥᎢ, ᎢᎬᏱ ᎦᏰᎯ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏥᏂᎬᏁᎮ ᎤᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎣᏂ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᎢᏍᏗᏱ.
\ft Searching what, or what manner of time the Spirit of Christ which was in them did signify, when it testified beforehand the sufferings of Christ, and the glory that should follow.

\ln Nasgi gvnigesv igegvnelvhi tsigesei unvsvquo nanalisdelisgvna gesvi, ayvsgini gegisdelisgvi geginohehelv nasgi gohi gvnigesv tsinigetsvneha nasgi osdv kanohedv getsalitsidonelvhi tsigi, anvdisgv Galvquodiyu Adanvdo galvladi nvdayetsinvsidv; nasgi dinikahnawadidohi tsunaduliha unigoliyediyi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᎨᎬᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎨᏎᎢ ᎤᏅᏒᏉ ᎾᎾᎵᏍᏕᎵᏍᎬᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᏴᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᎩᏍᏕᎵᏍᎬᎢ ᎨᎩᏃᎮᎮᎸ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᎯ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏥᏂᎨᏨᏁᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎨᏣᎵᏥᏙᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᏅᏗᏍᎬ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏅᏓᏰᏥᏅᏏᏛ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏂᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏧᎾᏚᎵᎭ ᎤᏂᎪᎵᏰᏗᏱ.
\ft Unto whom it was revealed, that not unto themselves, but unto us they did minister the things, which are now reported unto you by them that have preached the gospel unto you with the Holy Ghost sent down from heaven; which things the angels desire to look into.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi ditsitloga detsadanvdvi, itsalisinahisdiyu gesesdi, ale gvlisquadisgi udugi itsvsesdi etsinediyi gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv nihi etsiyohedi tsigi nahiyu Tsisa Galonedv gvnigesv nagvnelvha.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏗᏥᏠᎦ ᏕᏣᏓᏅᏛᎢ, ᎢᏣᎵᏏᏀᎢᏍᏗᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᎩ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎢᏨᏎᏍᏗ ᎡᏥᏁᏗᏱ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏂᎯ ᎡᏥᏲᎮᏗ ᏥᎩ ᏀᎢᏳ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎾᎬᏁᎸᎭ.
\ft Wherefore gird up the loins of your mind, be sober, and hope to the end for the grace that is to be brought unto you at the revelation of Jesus Christ;

\ln Itsohiyuhisdv gesesdi, tlesdi ilvhiyu tsinitsasdv tsitsadulvnvvsgv nahiyu nitsigatahnavna tsigesvgi;
\syll ᎢᏦᎯᏳᎯᏍᏛ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᏥᏂᏣᏍᏛ ᏥᏣᏚᎸᏅᎥᏍᎬ ᏀᎢᏳ ᏂᏥᎦᏔᎿᎥᎾ ᏥᎨᏒᎩ;
\ft As obedient children, not fashioning yourselves according to the former lusts in your ignorance:

\ln Nasgisgini itsiyanvdv asganahi nigesvna tsigi, nasgiya nasquo nihi itsisganahi nigesvna gesesdi nigav nitsadvhnadegvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᏥᏯᏅᏛ ᎠᏍᎦᏀᎢ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏥᏍᎦᏀᎢ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏂᏣᏛᎿᏕᎬᎢ.
\ft But as he which hath called you is holy, so be ye holy in all manner of conversation;

\ln Hiayeno nigvnv gowela, "Itsisgana nigesvna gesesdi, ayvyeno tsisgana nigesvna igi."
\syll ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᏂᎬᏅ ᎪᏪᎳ, data is invalidᎢᏥᏍᎦᎾ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎠᏴᏰᏃ ᏥᏍᎦᎾ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᎩ.data is invalid
\ft Because it is written, Be ye holy; for I am holy.

\ln Iyu ale etsadadolisdanehesdi Agayvligei, nasgi nidigalvquodisgvna tsidegugodaneha naniv anisiyvwiha nusdv dunilvwisdanehvi, nigohilv [ani] itsalenidohvi itseyatahi gesesdi itsehvi.
\syll ᎢᏳ ᎠᎴ ᎡᏣᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᏗᎦᎸᏉᏗᏍᎬᎾ ᏥᏕᎫᎪᏓᏁᎭ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎠᏂᏏᏴᏫᎭ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏚᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎢ, ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎠᏂdata is invalid ᎢᏣᎴᏂᏙᎲᎢ ᎢᏤᏯᏔᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎢᏤᎲᎢ.
\ft And if ye call on the Father, who without respect of persons judgeth according to every man's work, pass the time of your sojourning here in fear:

\ln Itsigatahayeno gohusdi ayogi, adelv unegv yadvnv ale adelv dalonige, etsaguyvtanvhi nigesvna gesvi, egudalesvi gohusdi gvdodi nigesvna itsalenidolvi ditsigayvlige digetsiyohiselvhi gesvi,
\syll ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎭᏰᏃ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎠᏲᎩ, ᎠᏕᎸ ᎤᏁᎬ ᏯᏛᏅ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏕᎸ ᏓᎶᏂᎨ, ᎡᏣᎫᏴᏔᏅᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎡᎫᏓᎴᏒᎢ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎬᏙᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᏣᎴᏂᏙᎸᎢ ᏗᏥᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᏗᎨᏥᏲᎯᏎᎸᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ,
\ft Forasmuch as ye know that ye were not redeemed with corruptible things, as silver and gold, from your vain conversation received by tradition from your fathers;

\ln Galvquodiyusgini gigv etsaguyvtanvhi gesvi, ugigv Galonedv nasgiya awiagina gohusdi nugolvwi ale nudadalvna;
\syll ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎩᎬ ᎡᏣᎫᏴᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᎩᎬ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎠᏫᎠᎩᎾ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏄᎪᎸᏫ ᎠᎴ ᏄᏓᏓᎸᎾ;
\ft But with the precious blood of Christ, as of a lamb without blemish and without spot:

\ln Nasgi udohiyuhi natsigatahoi asi elohi nadotlvsgvna tsigesei; aseno gvnigesv nagvnele gohi ulisqualvdi degesadisvi nihi itsalisdelvdodi,
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎾᏥᎦᏔᎰᎢ ᎠᏏ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎾᏙᏢᏍᎬᎾ ᏥᎨᏎᎢ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎾᎬᏁᎴ ᎪᎯ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᎸᏗ ᏕᎨᏌᏗᏒᎢ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ,
\ft Who verily was foreordained before the foundation of the world, but was manifest in these last times for you,

\ln Nihi nasgi iyuwanisadv tsetsohiyuhvsga Unelanvhi nasgi uyohusv tsiduletanei ale tsunele galvquodiyu gesvi; nasgi itsohiyusv ale udugi itsvsv Unelanvhi iditlv iyulisdodiyi.
\syll ᏂᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ ᏤᏦᎯᏳᎲᏍᎦ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏲᎱᏒ ᏥᏚᎴᏔᏁᎢ ᎠᎴ ᏧᏁᎴ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏦᎯᏳᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎢᏨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᏗᏢ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
\ft Who by him do believe in God, that raised him up from the dead, and gave him glory; that your faith and hope might be in God.

\ln Nasgino ditsinvgalvdv tsigi ditsadanvdo detsikanawadvsv duyugodv tsinvtsulisdotanv, [Galvquodiyu] Adanvdo tsitsvtanv, nutlonasdvna adageyudi gesv itsvdodiyi ditsigeyuhiyu iyulisdodiyi itsalinvtli, ulinigidv detsadageyusesdi itsvdisgesdi gadaha nigesvna itsinawi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏗᏥᏅᎦᎸᏛ ᏥᎩ ᏗᏣᏓᏅᏙ ᏕᏥᎧᎾᏩᏛᏒ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᏥᏅᏧᎵᏍᏙᏔᏅ, ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳdata is invalid ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᏥᏨᏔᏅ, ᏄᏠᎾᏍᏛᎾ ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏨᏙᏗᏱ ᏗᏥᎨᏳᎯᏳ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎢᏣᎵᏅᏟ, ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᏕᏣᏓᎨᏳᏎᏍᏗ ᎢᏨᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎦᏓᎭ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᏥᎾᏫ.
\ft Seeing ye have purified your souls in obeying the truth through the Spirit unto unfeigned love of the brethren, see that ye love one another with a pure heart fervently:

\ln Taline itsadenvhi gesvi, vtla ayogi ugata itsadetanvhi yigi, ayogisgini nigesvna, kanovdv Unelanvhi utlili iyuwanisadv nasgi gvnodv tsigi ale nigohilv ehi tsigi.
\syll ᏔᎵᏁ ᎢᏣᏕᏅᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᏲᎩ ᎤᎦᏔ ᎢᏣᏕᏔᏅᎯ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᏲᎩᏍᎩᏂ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎧᏃᎥᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏟᎵ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏃᏛ ᏥᎩ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎡᎯ ᏥᎩ.
\ft Being born again, not of corruptible seed, but of incorruptible, by the word of God, which liveth and abideth for ever.

\ln Nigavyeno uquedali gesv kanosgaquo nasgiyai, ale nigav udalvquododi gesv yvwi, kanesga utsilvsv nasgiyai.  Kanesga kayvsgoi, ale utsilvsvi gadoasgoi, kanohedvsgini Ugvwiyuhi utseliga nigohilv eha.
\syll ᏂᎦᎥᏰᏃ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎨᏒ ᎧᏃᏍᎦᏉ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎤᏓᎸᏉᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏴᏫ, ᎧᏁᏍᎦ ᎤᏥᎸᏒ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ.  ᎧᏁᏍᎦ ᎧᏴᏍᎪᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏥᎸᏒᎢ ᎦᏙᎠᏍᎪᎢ, ᎧᏃᎮᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎡᎭ.
\ft For all flesh is as grass, and all the glory of man as the flower of grass. The grass withereth, and the flower thereof falleth away:

\ln Nasgino hia kanohedv nasgi osdv kanohedv etsalitsidonehvi tsetsalitsidoneha.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎡᏣᎵᏥᏙᏁᎲᎢ ᏤᏣᎵᏥᏙᏁᎭ.
\ft But the word of the Lord endureth for ever. And this is the word which by the gospel is preached unto you.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi iyvdv nitsvga nudalesv uyo gesvi ale nudalesv galonuhedv ale utlonasdi gesv advyugedi ale nudalesv uyo didanohedi gesvi,
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏂᏨᎦ ᏄᏓᎴᏒ ᎤᏲ ᎨᏒᎢ ᎠᎴ ᏄᏓᎴᏒ ᎦᎶᏄᎮᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏠᎾᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏛᏳᎨᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏄᏓᎴᏒ ᎤᏲ ᏗᏓᏃᎮᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ,
\ft Wherefore laying aside all malice, and all guile, and hypocrisies, and envies, and all evil speakings,

\ln Nasgiya gilai unadenonvhi diniyoli unvdi tsunadulisgoi itsadulisgesdi galonuhedv nudasuyvwi kanohedv, nasgi ditsadvhisdodiyi;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎩᎳᎢ ᎤᎾᏕᏃᏅᎯ ᏗᏂᏲᎵ ᎤᏅᏗ ᏧᎾᏚᎵᏍᎪᎢ ᎢᏣᏚᎵᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎦᎶᏄᎮᏛ ᏄᏓᏑᏴᏫ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏣᏛᎯᏍᏙᏗᏱ;
\ft As newborn babes, desire the sincere milk of the word, that ye may grow thereby:

\ln Iyuno itsadolehosesdi Ugvwiyuhi udanvtiyu gesvi.
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᎢᏣᏙᎴᎰᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏓᏅᏘᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft If so be ye have tasted that the Lord is gracious.

\ln Nasgi etsilutsehvi, nasgi gvnodv nvya uniyoiselvhisgininonv udohiyuhi yvwi, aseno Unelanvhi usuyedv ale galvquodiyu,
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᏥᎷᏤᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏃᏛ ᏅᏯ ᎤᏂᏲᎢᏎᎸᎯᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᏴᏫ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏑᏰᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ,
\ft To whom coming, as unto a living stone, disallowed indeed of men, but chosen of God, and precious,

\ln Nihi nasquo ditsvnodv nvya etsanesgehvhi adanvdo adanelv iyetsvnelvhi, etsilvquotanvhi atsilvitselohi, etsalisgolvdanediyi atsilvgelasdi adanvdo ugvwali yeliquo digvadanilvisdi gesv Unelanvhi, Tsisa Galonedv iyuwanisadv.
\syll ᏂᎯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏗᏨᏃᏛ ᏅᏯ ᎡᏣᏁᏍᎨᎲᎯ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎠᏓᏁᎸ ᎢᏰᏨᏁᎸᎯ, ᎡᏥᎸᏉᏔᏅᎯ ᎠᏥᎸᎢᏤᎶᎯ, ᎡᏣᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᎠᏥᎸᎨᎳᏍᏗ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᏰᎵᏉ ᏗᎬᎠᏓᏂᎸᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ.
\ft Ye also, as lively stones, are built up a spiritual house, an holy priesthood, to offer up spiritual sacrifices, acceptable to God by Jesus Christ.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi nasquo hia nigvnv gowelihiGvniyuquo tsihvga Sayani nugvwiyusv unvsiyv adi nvya asuyedv, galvquodi, ale gilo nasgi gohiyuhvsgesdi vtla udehohisdi yigesesdi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏅ ᎪᏪᎵᎯᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᏥᎲᎦ ᏌᏯᏂ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎤᏅᏏᏴ ᎠᏗ ᏅᏯ ᎠᏑᏰᏛ, ᎦᎸᏉᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᎯᏳᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏕᎰᎯᏍᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft Wherefore also it is contained in the scripture, Behold, I lay in Sion a chief corner stone, elect, precious: and he that believeth on him shall not be confounded.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi nihi etsoiyuhvsgi tsigi galvquodiyu eniyelva; nasgisgini na nanohiyuhvsgvna, nasgi na "nvya dinanesgesgi uniyoiselvhi nugvwiyusv unvsiyv adi nunalisdanelv;"
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏂᎯ ᎡᏦᎢᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᏥᎩ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎡᏂᏰᎸᎠ; ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ Ꮎ ᎾᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎬᎾ, ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ data is invalidᏅᏯ ᏗᎾᏁᏍᎨᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᏲᎢᏎᎸᎯ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎤᏅᏏᏴ ᎠᏗ ᏄᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᎸ;data is invalid
\ft Unto you therefore which believe he is precious: but unto them which be disobedient, the stone which the builders disallowed, the same is made the head of the corner,

\ln Ale "nvya adahnasqualosdisgi ale nvya didadodesdisgi," nasgi na kanohedv tsiduninasqualosdiha, nanohiyuhvsgvna gesv iyusdi, nasgi iyunalisdanediyi nasquo tsidegetsikanei.
\syll ᎠᎴ data is invalidᏅᏯ ᎠᏓᎿᏍᏆᎶᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ ᏅᏯ ᏗᏓᏙᏕᏍᏗᏍᎩ,data is invalid ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏥᏚᏂᎾᏍᏆᎶᏍᏗᎭ, ᎾᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎬᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏥᏕᎨᏥᎧᏁᎢ.
\ft And a stone of stumbling, and a rock of offence, even to them which stumble at the word, being disobedient: whereunto also they were appointed.

\ln Nihisgini etsasuyedv itsitloyi gesvi, itsigvwiyuhi atsilvitselohi, etsilvquotanvhi itsadatselidv gesvi, utsati ditsagvwalanvhi yvwi, nasgi gvnigesv itsvnediyi atsilvquodiyu gesv nasgi tsulisigvwitsiyanvdv, usquanigodiyuno iga galvsadv witsikanvhi;
\syll ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎡᏣᏑᏰᏛ ᎢᏥᏠᏱ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎢᏥᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᏥᎸᎢᏤᎶᎯ, ᎡᏥᎸᏉᏔᏅᎯ ᎢᏣᏓᏤᎵᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᏣᏘ ᏗᏣᎬᏩᎳᏅᎯ ᏴᏫ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏨᏁᏗᏱ ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᎵᏏᎬᏫᏥᏯᏅᏛ, ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗᏳᏃ ᎢᎦ ᎦᎸᏌᏛ ᏫᏥᎧᏅᎯ;
\ft But ye are a chosen generation, a royal priesthood, an holy nation, a peculiar people; that ye should shew forth the praises of him who hath called you out of darkness into his marvellous light:

\ln Nasgi ilvhiyu tsigesv itsadatselidv nigesvna gesei, gohisgini tsigi itsadatselidv Unelanvhi tsutseli nitsalistanv; nasgi vtla etsidolitsvhi yigesei, gohisgini tsigi etsidolitsvhi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᏥᎨᏒ ᎢᏣᏓᏤᎵᏛ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎪᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᏥᎩ ᎢᏣᏓᏤᎵᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᏤᎵ ᏂᏣᎵᏍᏔᏅ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎥᏝ ᎡᏥᏙᎵᏨᎯ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ, ᎪᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᏥᎩ ᎡᏥᏙᎵᏨᎯ.
\ft Which in time past were not a people, but are now the people of God: which had not obtained mercy, but now have obtained mercy.

\ln Itsvgeyui, itsvtayoseha, nasgiya nigetsigatahvna ale anedohi iyunadvnedi nitsadvga, ditsiyohi uquedalv ugvvhisdi gesvi, nasgi adanvdo tsidanedahnawiya.
\syll ᎢᏨᎨᏳᎢ, ᎢᏨᏔᏲᏎᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏂᎨᏥᎦᏔᎲᎾ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏁᏙᎯ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᏁᏗ ᏂᏣᏛᎦ, ᏗᏥᏲᎯ ᎤᏇᏓᎸ ᎤᎬᎥᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᏥᏓᏁᏓᎿᏫᏯ.
\ft Dearly beloved, I beseech you as strangers and pilgrims, abstain from fleshly lusts, which war against the soul;

\ln Ale itsalenidohv osdv gesesdi anehv tsunadalenvdv yvna, nasgi getsatludisgv uyo tsunilvwisdanehi tsigetsoseha, nasgi osdv detsilvwisdanehv anigowatisgv yinvdagalisdoda yanilvquoda Unelanvhi nahiyu iga dawadvhilvha.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎢᏣᎴᏂᏙᎲ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎠᏁᎲ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᎾ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᏣᏡᏗᏍᎬ ᎤᏲ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᏥᎨᏦᏎᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏕᏥᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᎠᏂᎪᏩᏘᏍᎬ ᏱᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏓ ᏯᏂᎸᏉᏓ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏀᎢᏳ ᎢᎦ ᏓᏩᏛᎯᎸᎭ.
\ft Having your conversation honest among the Gentiles: that, whereas they speak against you as evildoers, they may by your good works, which they shall behold, glorify God in the day of visitation.

\ln Ugvwiyuhi nvdigalisdodisgesdi, detsohiyusesdi naniv yvwi digeganelodi gesvi^nasquo ugvwiyuhi nugvwiyusv gesesdi,
\syll ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᏕᏦᎯᏳᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏴᏫ ᏗᎨᎦᏁᎶᏗ ᎨᏒᎢdata is invalidᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ,
\ft Submit yourselves to every ordinance of man for the Lord's sake: whether it be to the king, as supreme;

\ln Ale nasquo analisdelisgiquo gesesdi nasgi nidodayunvsidv Ugvwiyuhi getsigiliyoisdodiyi uyo tsunilvwisdanehi, ale getsilvquododiyi osdv tsunilvwisdanehi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᎾᎵᏍᏕᎵᏍᎩᏉ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᏙᏓᏳᏅᏏᏛ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏥᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᏲ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎨᏥᎸᏉᏙᏗᏱ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ.
\ft Or unto governors, as unto them that are sent by him for the punishment of evildoers, and for the praise of them that do well.

\ln Nasgiyeno hia osiyu uyelvdi Unelanvhi, nasgi osiyu detsilvwisdanehv elawe ditsvdiyi nanigatahnavna ale uninegu yvwi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎤᏰᎸᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏏᏳ ᏕᏥᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᎡᎳᏪ ᏗᏨᏗᏱ ᎾᏂᎦᏔᎿᎥᎾ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏁᎫ ᏴᏫ.
\ft For so is the will of God, that with well doing ye may put to silence the ignorance of foolish men:

\ln Nasgiya nidigetsinatlavna iyunadvnedi nitsadvnehesdi, vtlasdi adina nidetsinatlavna gesv yitsvdisgesdi yitsutlvvsgesdi uyo digalvwisdanedi gesvi, Unelanvhisgini tsunvsidasdi iyunadvnedi nitsadvnehesdi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏂᏗᎨᏥᎾᏝᎥᎾ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᏁᏗ ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ, ᎥᏝᏍᏗ ᎠᏗᎾ ᏂᏕᏥᎾᏝᎥᎾ ᎨᏒ ᏱᏨᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏱᏧᏢᎥᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᏲ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᏧᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᏁᏗ ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ.
\ft As free, and not using your liberty for a cloke of maliciousness, but as the servants of God.

\ln Detsilvquodesdi nanivi; detsigeyusesdi analinvtlvi; Unelanvhi etsinayesgesdi; ugvwiyuhi etsilvquoquasdi.
\syll ᏕᏥᎸᏉᏕᏍᏗ ᎾᏂᎥᎢ; ᏕᏥᎨᏳᏎᏍᏗ ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏢᎢ; ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎡᏥᎾᏰᏍᎨᏍᏗ; ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎡᏥᎸᏉᏆᏍᏗ.
\ft Honour all men. Love the brotherhood. Fear God. Honour the king.

\ln Tsetsinatlai, detsohiyusesdi digetsinatlai uloti ganayehisdi itsvdisgesdi; vtlesdi anosdv ale unadanvti unvsv yiditsohiyusesdi, nasquosgini uninalvtsati.
\syll ᏤᏥᎾᏝᎢ, ᏕᏦᎯᏳᏎᏍᏗ ᏗᎨᏥᎾᏝᎢ ᎤᎶᏘ ᎦᎾᏰᎯᏍᏗ ᎢᏨᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ; ᎥᏞᏍᏗ ᎠᏃᏍᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ ᎤᏅᏒ ᏱᏗᏦᎯᏳᏎᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏂᎾᎸᏣᏘ.
\ft Servants, be subject to your masters with all fear; not only to the good and gentle, but also to the froward.

\ln Nasgiyeno hia galvquodiyu, iyuno gilo Unelanvhi tsudanvdv ulvquodiyu gesv yinvdigalisdodiha gvnidiyu yigi agiliyogvi, niduyugodvna atsigiliyoisdisgvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᏓᏅᏛ ᎤᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᏱᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎬᏂᏗᏳ ᏱᎩ ᎠᎩᎵᏲᎬᎢ, ᏂᏚᏳᎪᏛᎾ ᎠᏥᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ.
\ft For this is thankworthy, if a man for conscience toward God endure grief, suffering wrongfully.

\ln Gadogeno galvquododi nigalisdiha, iyuno utsatini nitsadvnelv itsisdvdisgesdi etsilivnihesdi itsvnidiyu gesesdi; iyusgini osdv nitsadvnehesdi ale itsigiliyogesdi itsvnidiyu gesesdi, nasgi osdv ayeli gesv Unelanvhi adanvtesgvi.
\syll ᎦᏙᎨᏃ ᎦᎸᏉᏙᏗ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᎭ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎤᏣᏘᏂ ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎸ ᎢᏥᏍᏛᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎡᏥᎵᎥᏂᎮᏍᏗ ᎢᏨᏂᏗᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏥᎩᎵᏲᎨᏍᏗ ᎢᏨᏂᏗᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬᎢ.
\ft For what glory is it, if, when ye be buffeted for your faults, ye shall take it patiently? but if, when ye do well, and suffer for it, ye take it patiently, this is acceptable with God.

\ft For it is better, if the will of God be so, that ye suffer for well doing, than for evil doing.

\ln Galonedvyeno nasquo saquo nugiliyotse asganvisdi gesv usdvdei, asgana nigesvna anisgana dugiliyotselei, nasgi Unelanvhiyi widigatinohisdiyi; atsilei uquedali gesvi, aseno Adanvdo uwanidei.
\syll ᎦᎶᏁᏛᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏌᏉ ᏄᎩᎵᏲᏤ ᎠᏍᎦᏅᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏍᏛᏕᎢ, ᎠᏍᎦᎾ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᎾ ᏚᎩᎵᏲᏤᎴᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏱ ᏫᏗᎦᏘᏃᎯᏍᏗᏱ; ᎠᏥᎴᎢ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᏩᏂᏕᎢ.
\ft For Christ also hath once suffered for sins, the just for the unjust, that he might bring us to God, being put to death in the flesh, but quickened by the Spirit:

\ln Nasgi nasquo [adanvdo] uwatane uwenvse widulitsidonele didanvdo didasdudiyi tsaniyaa,
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏓᏅᏙdata is invalid ᎤᏩᏔᏁ ᎤᏪᏅᏎ ᏫᏚᎵᏥᏙᏁᎴ ᏗᏓᏅᏙ ᏗᏓᏍᏚᏗᏱ ᏣᏂᏯᎠ,
\ft By which also he went and preached unto the spirits in prison;

\ln Nasgi ilvhiyu nunohiyusvna tsigesei, nahiyu Unelanvhi gvnidiyu gesv tsagatiyei, Noya nahiyu tsevi, tsadvnvisdisge tsiyu, nahna ilvsgi nasgi tsunelaquo iyanidv tsigetsisdelvhei, ama tsigetsisdelvtanei;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᏄᏃᎯᏳᏒᎾ ᏥᎨᏎᎢ, ᏀᎢᏳ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎬᏂᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᏣᎦᏘᏰᎢ, ᏃᏯ ᏀᎢᏳ ᏤᎥᎢ, ᏣᏛᏅᎢᏍᏗᏍᎨ ᏥᏳ, ᏀᎾ ᎢᎸᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏁᎳᏉ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᏥᎨᏥᏍᏕᎸᎮᎢ, ᎠᎹ ᏥᎨᏥᏍᏕᎸᏔᏁᎢ;
\ft Which sometime were disobedient, when once the longsuffering of God waited in the days of Noah, while the ark was a preparing, wherein few, that is, eight souls were saved by water.

\ln Nasgiya nasquo didawosdi gesv gohi gesv igisdeliha; vtla iyvdv nagvnehv ayelv gadaha gesvi, kanetsedisgini Unelanvhi gvdodi osdv adanvtedi gesv igisdeliha nvdigalisdodiha dulehisanv Tsisa Galonedv,
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏗᏓᏬᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎢᎩᏍᏕᎵᎭ; ᎥᏝ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎾᎬᏁᎲ ᎠᏰᎸ ᎦᏓᎭ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎧᏁᏤᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎬᏙᏗ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎠᏓᏅᏖᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᎩᏍᏕᎵᎭ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᏚᎴᎯᏌᏅ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ,
\ft The like figure whereunto even baptism doth also now save us (not the putting away of the filth of the flesh, but the answer of a good conscience toward God,) by the resurrection of Jesus Christ:

\ln Nasgi galvladi wulosv Unelanvhi uwolv agatisiditlv wuwola, dinikahnawadidohino ale digeganelodi ale nunigvwiyusv digvwanelodi nulistanv.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏭᎶᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏬᎸ ᎠᎦᏘᏏᏗᏢ ᏭᏬᎳ, ᏗᏂᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎯᏃ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎨᎦᏁᎶᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᏗᎬᏩᏁᎶᏗ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ.
\ft Who is gone into heaven, and is on the right hand of God; angels and authorities and powers being made subject unto him.

\ln Galonedvno uquedali gesv igigiliyotselvhi tsigi, nihi nasquo nasgi iyusdi adanvdo itsalisgasdododi nitsvga; nasgiyeno na uquedali gesv ugiliyotsvhi tsigesoi duyoso asganvisdi gesvi,
\syll ᎦᎶᏁᏛᏃ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎨᏒ ᎢᎩᎩᎵᏲᏤᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᏂᎯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏙᏗ ᏂᏨᎦ; ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ Ꮎ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎩᎵᏲᏨᎯ ᏥᎨᏐᎢ ᏚᏲᏐ ᎠᏍᎦᏅᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ,
\ft Forasmuch then as Christ hath suffered for us in the flesh, arm yourselves likewise with the same mind: for he that hath suffered in the flesh hath ceased from sin;

\ln Nasgi hnaquo udediyi nigesvna iyulisdodiyi nigohilv uquedalv igohidv ulenidasdi gesvi, nasgi yvwi unadulvdi gesvi, Unelanvhiquosgini osiyu uyelvdi gesvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎿᏉ ᎤᏕᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎤᏇᏓᎸ ᎢᎪᎯᏛ ᎤᎴᏂᏓᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏴᏫ ᎤᎾᏚᎸᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎤᏰᎸᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft That he no longer should live the rest of his time in the flesh to the lusts of men, but to the will of God.

\ln Yeliquoyeno yigiyelvha gayula igalenidolv degilvwisdanelv osiyu uniyelvdi gesv nanigatanavna, nahiyu tsidedohv udelidv dinisidi gesvi, ale adulvdi gesvi, ale gigageaditasdi gvdayvsdesdisgi gesvi, ale alisganawasdi gesvi, ale danaditasgv geladidasdi gesvi, ale niduyugodvna unelanvhi diyelvhi didadolisdanedi gesvi;
\syll ᏰᎵᏉᏰᏃ ᏱᎩᏰᎸᎭ ᎦᏳᎳ ᎢᎦᎴᏂᏙᎸ ᏕᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎤᏂᏰᎸᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏂᎦᏔᎾᎥᎾ, ᏀᎢᏳ ᏥᏕᏙᎲ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᏗᏂᏏᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏚᎸᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎩᎦᎨᎠᏗᏔᏍᏗ ᎬᏓᏴᏍᏕᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎵᏍᎦᎾᏩᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᎾᏗᏔᏍᎬ ᎨᎳᏗᏓᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᏚᏳᎪᏛᎾ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏗᏰᎸᎯ ᏗᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ;
\ft For the time past of our life may suffice us to have wrought the will of the Gentiles, when we walked in lasciviousness, lusts, excess of wine, revellings, banquetings, and abominable idolatries:

\ln Nasgi usquanigodiyu uniyelvha, nahna nitsaisvna gesv anaisv wanigadv ulosvstanvhi uyo iyadvnelidasdi digesvi, nasgi usonv getsinohesgvi;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗᏳ ᎤᏂᏰᎸᎭ, ᏀᎾ ᏂᏣᎢᏒᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎾᎢᏒ ᏩᏂᎦᏛ ᎤᎶᏒᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎤᏲ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᎵᏓᏍᏗ ᏗᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏐᏅ ᎨᏥᏃᎮᏍᎬᎢ;
\ft Wherein they think it strange that ye run not with them to the same excess of riot, speaking evil of you:

\ln Nasgi gvnigesv iyunvnedi gesesdi agatahv nasgi ugvwalei tsulinenodi tsuwugodanediyi dinvnodv ale tsuniyohusvhi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏅᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎠᎦᏔᎲ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎬᏩᎴᎢ ᏧᎵᏁᏃᏗ ᏧᏭᎪᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᏗᏅᏃᏛ ᎠᎴ ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯ.
\ft Who shall give account to him that is ready to judge the quick and the dead.

\ln Nasgiyeno iyusdi osdv kanohedv tsuniyohusvhi nasquo gegalitsidonelei, digegugodanediyi uquedali gesv nasgiya yvwi tsunugododi gesvi, Unelanvhisgini tsuwugododi gesv dinvnodv iyulisdodiyi tsunadadvdogihi gesvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎨᎦᎵᏥᏙᏁᎴᎢ, ᏗᎨᎫᎪᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏴᏫ ᏧᏄᎪᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᏧᏭᎪᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏗᏅᏃᏛ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏧᎾᏓᏛᏙᎩᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft For for this cause was the gospel preached also to them that are dead, that they might be judged according to men in the flesh, but live according to God in the spirit.

\ln Nudalesvsgini gohusdi ulisquadidi, nasgi iyusdi itsalisinahisdi gesesdi, ale itsiyawisgv itsadadodasdisgesdi.
\syll ᏄᏓᎴᏒᏍᎩᏂ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᏗᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏣᎵᏏᏀᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏥᏯᏫᏍᎬ ᎢᏣᏓᏙᏓᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
\ft But the end of all things is at hand: be ye therefore sober, and watch unto prayer.

\ln Ale ho ugvwiyusesdi ulinigidv detsadageyusesdi; adageyudiyeno gesv dagutlvni utsati iyasganvisdi gesvi.
\syll ᎠᎴ Ꮀ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᏕᏣᏓᎨᏳᏎᏍᏗ; ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗᏰᏃ ᎨᏒ ᏓᎫᏢᏂ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎢᏯᏍᎦᏅᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft And above all things have fervent charity among yourselves: for charity shall cover the multitude of sins.

\ln Ditsadasquanigodiyu gesesdi gohusdi niditsadadelisehvna.
\syll ᏗᏣᏓᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏂᏗᏣᏓᏕᎵᏎᎲᎾ.
\ft Use hospitality one to another without grudging.

\ln Nitsivno etsinelvhi tsigi, nasgi detsadanehesdi nasgiya iyunadvnedi anosdv getsigatidisdi tsudalenvdv Unelanvhi gvwagadiya udanedi gesvi.
\syll ᏂᏥᎥᏃ ᎡᏥᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏕᏣᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᏁᏗ ᎠᏃᏍᏛ ᎨᏥᎦᏘᏗᏍᏗ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎬᏩᎦᏗᏯ ᎤᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft As every man hath received the gift, even so minister the same one to another, as good stewards of the manifold grace of God.

\ln Iyuno gilo gawonisgesdi, nasgiya Unelanvhi nuwesv gawonisgesdi.  Iyuno gilo dayadohehesdi, nasgi yeli igvwadvnedi gesv ulisgolvdanehv Unelanvhi nasgi nadvnehesdi; nasgino Unelanvhi nigav detsilvwisdanehv atsilvquodiyu igvwalisdodi yigi Tsisa Galonedv gesv yinvdigalisdodiha; nasgi utseliga galvquodiyu gesv ale ugvwiyuhi gesv nigohilv ulisquadisdi nigesvna.  Emenv.
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎦᏬᏂᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏄᏪᏒ ᎦᏬᏂᏍᎨᏍᏗ.  ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᏓᏯᏙᎮᎮᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏰᎵ ᎢᎬᏩᏛᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᎲ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ; ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏕᏥᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎢᎬᏩᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᏱᎩ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎨᏒ ᏱᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.  ᎡᎺᏅ.
\ft If any man speak, let him speak as the oracles of God; if any man minister, let him do it as of the ability which God giveth: that God in all things may be glorified through Jesus Christ, to whom be praise and dominion for ever and ever. Amen.

\ln Itsvgeyui, tlesdi usquanigodi yitsiyelvsesdi galigv tsitsiyilideha nasgi itsigoliyedi tsigi, nasgiya gohusdi usquanigodi tsitsilutseloi;
\syll ᎢᏨᎨᏳᎢ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᏱᏥᏰᎸᏎᏍᏗ ᎦᎵᎬ ᏥᏥᏱᎵᏕᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏥᎪᎵᏰᏗ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᏥᏥᎷᏤᎶᎢ;
\ft Beloved, think it not strange concerning the fiery trial which is to try you, as though some strange thing happened unto you:

\ln Itsaliheligesdisgini nvdigalisdodisgesdi Galonedv ugiliyotsv itseladisdisgvi, nasgino utseli galvquodiyu gesv gvnigesv igvnelvhi gesesdi nihi nasquo utsatanvhi getsalihelisdi gesesdi.
\syll ᎢᏣᎵᎮᎵᎨᏍᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᎩᎵᏲᏨ ᎢᏤᎳᏗᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᎬᏁᎸᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏂᎯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᏣᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏣᎵᎮᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft But rejoice, inasmuch as ye are partakers of Christ's sufferings; that, when his glory shall be revealed, ye may be glad also with exceeding joy.

\ln Iyuno gayetsisotlvdesdi Galonedv dudov nvdigalisdodisgesdi osiyu itsalisdanedi gesesdi, Adanvdoyeno galvquodiyu Unelanvhi utseliga itseladidoha; nasgi na gesv gagvwasotlvdi, nihisgini gesv atsilvquodiha.
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᎦᏰᏥᏐᏢᏕᏍᏗ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏚᏙᎥ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎠᏓᏅᏙᏰᏃ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᎢᏤᎳᏗᏙᎭ; ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎨᏒ ᎦᎬᏩᏐᏢᏗ, ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏗᎭ.
\ft If ye be reproached for the name of Christ, happy are ye; for the spirit of glory and of God resteth upon you: on their part he is evil spoken of, but on your part he is glorified.

\ln Adina tlesdi gilo nihi nitsadvnv yugiliyotsesdi yvwi ulvi yusdvdisgesdi, ale unosgisvi, ale uyo dulvwisdanelvi, ale ulisalanehi gesv nvwanadale tsunilvwisdanedi gesvi.
\syll ᎠᏗᎾ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎩᎶ ᏂᎯ ᏂᏣᏛᏅ ᏳᎩᎵᏲᏤᏍᏗ ᏴᏫ ᎤᎸᎢ ᏳᏍᏛᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏃᏍᎩᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏲ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏌᎳᏁᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft But let none of you suffer as a murderer, or as a thief, or as an evildoer, or as a busybody in other men's matters.

\ln Iyusgini gilo Galonedv asdawadidohi gesv usdvdisgesdi agiliyogesdi, tlesdi yadehosgesdi, wigalvquodaquosgini Unelanvhi nasgi winigalisdoda.
\syll ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎩᎶ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎠᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏍᏛᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᎩᎵᏲᎨᏍᏗ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᏯᏕᎰᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᏫᎦᎸᏉᏓᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏫᏂᎦᎵᏍᏙᏓ.
\ft Yet if any man suffer as a Christian, let him not be ashamed; but let him glorify God on this behalf.

\ln Usqualvhvyeno nasgi digugodoti gesv Unelanvhi utseli adanelv udalenvdiyi; iyuno ayv yegalenvtanv gado usdi wunaliyilohisdi gesesdi nasgi na nunohiyusvna osdv kanohedv Unelanvhi utseliga.
\syll ᎤᏍᏆᎸᎲᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎫᎪᏙᏘ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎠᏓᏁᎸ ᎤᏓᎴᏅᏗᏱ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᎠᏴ ᏰᎦᎴᏅᏔᏅ ᎦᏙ ᎤᏍᏗ ᏭᎾᎵᏱᎶᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏄᏃᎯᏳᏒᎾ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ.
\ft For the time is come that judgment must begin at the house of God: and if it first begin at us, what shall the end be of them that obey not the gospel of God?

\ln Iyu ale udanvti usegatsvhi atsisdelvdi gesesdi, hatlv wunanugoisdi gesesdi unelanvhi nidunelodvna ale asganai.
\syll ᎢᏳ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᏅᏘ ᎤᏎᎦᏨᎯ ᎠᏥᏍᏕᎸᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎭᏢ ᏭᎾᏄᎪᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏂᏚᏁᎶᏛᎾ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏍᎦᎾᎢ.
\ft And if the righteous scarcely be saved, where shall the ungodly and the sinner appear?

\ln Nasgi iyusdi, nasgi na nusdv adanvtesgv Unelanvhi anigiliyogi, widaniyohisi tsusquanigododiyi tsunadanvdo, osdv deunilvwisdanehvi, nasgiya nudalidasdvna Uwotlvnvnvhi tsidaniyohisehoi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎠᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᏂᎩᎵᏲᎩ, ᏫᏓᏂᏲᎯᏏ ᏧᏍᏆᏂᎪᏙᏗᏱ ᏧᎾᏓᏅᏙ, ᎣᏍᏛ ᏕᎤᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᏓᎵᏓᏍᏛᎾ ᎤᏬᏢᏅᏅᎯ ᏥᏓᏂᏲᎯᏎᎰᎢ.
\ft Wherefore let them that suffer according to the will of God commit the keeping of their souls to him in well doing, as unto a faithful Creator.

\ln Digeganelodi tsigetsadasuya gatsitayoseha, ayv nasquo tsvquanelodi ale tsigatahi Tsisa Galonedv ugiliyotsvi, ale nasquo aquetadisdisgi galvquodiyu gvnigesv igvnedi tsigi^
\syll ᏗᎨᎦᏁᎶᏗ ᏥᎨᏣᏓᏑᏯ ᎦᏥᏔᏲᏎᎭ, ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏨᏆᏁᎶᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏥᎦᏔᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᎩᎵᏲᏨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏇᏔᏗᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᎬᏁᏗ ᏥᎩdata is invalid
\ft The elders which are among you I exhort, who am also an elder, and a witness of the sufferings of Christ, and also a partaker of the glory that shall be revealed:

\ln Detselohesdi unadatlugv Unelanvhi tsutseliga tsigetsadasuya, detsigatiyesdi, vtlesdi osiyu nitsiyelvsvna osiyusgini itsiyelvhi gesesdi, ale vtlesdi tsugvwalodi itsigvvsgv yinvdigalisdodisgesdi, osiyusgini itsiyelvsv nvdigalisdodisgesdi;
\syll ᏕᏤᎶᎮᏍᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᏤᎵᎦ ᏥᎨᏣᏓᏑᏯ, ᏕᏥᎦᏘᏰᏍᏗ, ᎥᏞᏍᏗ ᎣᏏᏳ ᏂᏥᏰᎸᏒᎾ ᎣᏏᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᏥᏰᎸᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏞᏍᏗ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎢᏥᎬᎥᏍᎬ ᏱᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎣᏏᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᏥᏰᎸᏒ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ;
\ft Feed the flock of God which is among you, taking the oversight thereof, not by constraint, but willingly; not for filthy lucre, but of a ready mind;

\ln Ale detsigatiyv [Unelanvhi] tsutseliga tlesdi unigvwiyuhi nanadvnehv yinitsadvnehesdi, gagetsadeloquaedisgini gesesdi nasgi unadatlugvi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏕᏥᎦᏘᏴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯdata is invalid ᏧᏤᎵᎦ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎤᏂᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎾᎾᏛᏁᎲ ᏱᏂᏣᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ, ᎦᎨᏣᏕᎶᏆᎡᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬᎢ.
\ft Neither as being lords over God's heritage, but being ensamples to the flock.

\ln Nugvwiyusvno awidigatiya gananugotsilvha etsinvnedi gesesdi galvquodi alisdulo asgolvgi nigesvna.
\syll ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒᏃ ᎠᏫᏗᎦᏘᏯ ᎦᎾᏄᎪᏥᎸᎭ ᎡᏥᏅᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎦᎸᏉᏗ ᎠᎵᏍᏚᎶ ᎠᏍᎪᎸᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.
\ft And when the chief Shepherd shall appear, ye shall receive a crown of glory that fadeth not away.

\ln Nihi nasquo itsiwinv detsohiyusesdi tsunadvsonvhi; Vv, nitsivi detsadadohiyusesdi, ale itsanuwosdesdi udadolisdi adanvdadisdi gesvi; Unelanvhiyeno unatlvquodi datludisgoi, unadadolisdisgini gvwagadiya udadolisdi gesv dalisgolvdanehoi.
\syll ᏂᎯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎢᏥᏫᏅ ᏕᏦᎯᏳᏎᏍᏗ ᏧᎾᏛᏐᏅᎯ; ᎥᎥ, ᏂᏥᎥᎢ ᏕᏣᏓᏙᎯᏳᏎᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏣᏄᏬᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎠᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ ᎤᎾᏢᏉᏗ ᏓᏡᏗᏍᎪᎢ, ᎤᎾᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᎬᏩᎦᏗᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏓᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᎰᎢ.
\ft Likewise, ye younger, submit yourselves unto the elder. Yea, all of you be subject one to another, and be clothed with humility: for God resisteth the proud, and giveth grace to the humble.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi itsadadolisdi gesesdi Unelanvhi ulinigidv uwoyeni hawiniditlv nitsadvnadegvi, nasgino getsisaladodi gesesdi aselvhi gesv nahiyui.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏣᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᎤᏬᏰᏂ ᎭᏫᏂᏗᏢ ᏂᏣᏛᎾᏕᎬᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎨᏥᏌᎳᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎠᏎᎸᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏀᎢᏳᎢ.
\ft Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God, that he may exalt you in due time:

\ln Ale nasgi nigadiyu uwelihisdi itsehv tsetsiyohisi, nasgiyeno itsadanvtesgoi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᎤᏪᎵᎯᏍᏗ ᎢᏤᎲ ᏤᏥᏲᎯᏏ, ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏖᏍᎪᎢ.
\ft Casting all your care upon him; for he careth for you.

\ln Itsalisinahisdi gesesdi, itsiyawisgesdi, itsatludisgiyeno asgina, tlvdatsi unodena uwelugi nasgiya edoha duyoha tsuweyesdi.
\syll ᎢᏣᎵᏏᏀᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎢᏥᏯᏫᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎢᏣᏡᏗᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎠᏍᎩᎾ, ᏢᏓᏥ ᎤᏃᏕᎾ ᎤᏪᎷᎩ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎡᏙᎭ ᏚᏲᎭ ᏧᏪᏰᏍᏗ.
\ft Be sober, be vigilant; because your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walketh about, seeking whom he may devour:

\ln Nasgi tsetsatliyvsi, ulinigidv gesesdi itsohiyusvi, itsigatahayeno utloyi agiliyoisdi gesv anikaliihv itsalinvtli elohi tsaneha.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏤᏣᏟᏴᏏ, ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎢᏦᎯᏳᏒᎢ, ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎭᏰᏃ ᎤᏠᏱ ᎠᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏂᎧᎵᎢᎲ ᎢᏣᎵᏅᏟ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏣᏁᎭ.
\ft Whom resist stedfast in the faith, knowing that the same afflictions are accomplished in your brethren that are in the world.

\ln Adina Unelanvhi utsatanvhi udadolitsati nasgi igiyanvdv tsigi utseli ulisquadisdi nigesvna galvquodiyu gesv wigiluhisdiyi, Tsisa Galonedv agvdisgvi, nasgi tlega itsigiliyotsvhi gesesdi, nitsigolvna winitsvga, ale witsalinigohisda, ale itsalinigidv winitsvga, ale gayetsitelvdi nigesvna winitsvga.
\syll ᎠᏗᎾ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏣᏔᏅᎯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏣᏘ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎩᏯᏅᏛ ᏥᎩ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᏫᎩᎷᎯᏍᏗᏱ, ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎠᎬᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏞᎦ ᎢᏥᎩᎵᏲᏨᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᏂᏥᎪᎸᎾ ᏫᏂᏨᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᏫᏣᎵᏂᎪᎯᏍᏓ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏣᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᏫᏂᏨᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᏰᏥᏖᎸᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏫᏂᏨᎦ.
\ft But the God of all grace, who hath called us unto his eternal glory by Christ Jesus, after that ye have suffered a while, make you perfect, stablish, strengthen, settle you.

\ln Nasgi utseli gesesdi galvquodiyu gesv ale ugvwiyuhi gesv nigohilv ulisquadisdi nigesvna.  Emenv.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.  ᎡᎺᏅ.
\ft To him be glory and dominion for ever and ever. Amen.

\ln Itsvyowelasi gayoli Siluweni unvsdi nasgi galasidvdi nigesvna itsalinvtli gadanvtesgvi, isvtayoseha, ale gvnigesv nitsvyvneha nasgi hia nahna tsidetsidoga udohiyusv Unelanvhi udadolisdi gesvi.
\syll ᎢᏨᏲᏪᎳᏏ ᎦᏲᎵ ᏏᎷᏪᏂ ᎤᏅᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎳᏏᏛᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᏣᎵᏅᏟ ᎦᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬᎢ, ᎢᏒᏔᏲᏎᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᏨᏴᏁᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏀᎾ ᏥᏕᏥᏙᎦ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft By Silvanus, a faithful brother unto you, as I suppose, I have written briefly, exhorting, and testifying that this is the true grace of God wherein ye stand.

\ln Dadaloni anehi gegasuyedv nihi etsasuyedv gesv nasgiyai wigetsiyoliha, ale nasquo maga aquetsi.
\syll ᏓᏓᎶᏂ ᎠᏁᎯ ᎨᎦᏑᏰᏛ ᏂᎯ ᎡᏣᏑᏰᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ ᏫᎨᏥᏲᎵᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎹᎦ ᎠᏇᏥ.
\ft The church that is at Babylon, elected together with you, saluteth you; and so doth Marcus my son.

\ln Detsadayolilvha itsvtanvha adageyudi didadowedovsdi gesvi.  Nvwadohiyadv itseladidohesdi nitsiv Tsisa Galonedv etsiyai.  Emenv
\syll ᏕᏣᏓᏲᎵᎸᎭ ᎢᏨᏔᏅᎭ ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᏗᏓᏙᏪᏙᎥᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.  ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᎢᏤᎳᏗᏙᎮᏍᏗ ᏂᏥᎥ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎡᏥᏯᎢ.  ᎡᎺᏅ
\ft Greet ye one another with a kiss of charity. Peace be with you all that are in Christ Jesus. Amen.

\ln Ayv Sawani Quida, alvnatlai ale aginvsidv Tsisa Galonedv, gatsiyowelasi nasgi na getsinelvhi tsigi oginelv nasgiyai, galvquodiyu gohiyudi gesv nvdayudalenvne udanvtiyu gesv Iganelanvhi ale Igisdelisgi Tsisa Galonedv.
\syll ᎠᏴ ᏌᏩᏂ ᏈᏓ, ᎠᎸᎾᏝᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎩᏅᏏᏛ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ, ᎦᏥᏲᏪᎳᏏ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎨᏥᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎣᎩᏁᎸ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ, ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᏁ ᎤᏓᏅᏘᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎢᎦᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎢᎩᏍᏕᎵᏍᎩ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ.
\ft Simon Peter, a servant and an apostle of Jesus Christ, to them that have obtained like precious faith with us through the righteousness of God and our Saviour Jesus Christ:

\ln Gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv ale nvwadohiyadv etsinequoedi gesesdi nvdayudalenvhi agadovhisdi gesv Unelanvhi ale Tsisa igatseli Ugvwiyuhi.
\syll ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᎡᏥᏁᏉᎡᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᎠᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏥᏌ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ.
\ft Grace and peace be multiplied unto you through the knowledge of God, and of Jesus our Lord,

\ln Nasgiya utseli ulinigidi gesv uwatanvi iginelvhi tsigi nudalesv gohusdi dedvnv ugvwali ale Unelanvhi ganayehisdi gesv ugvwali, nvdayudalenvhi agadovhisdi gesv nasgi na igiyanvdv tsigi gvtanvhi galvquodiyu gesv ale duyugodv isdvnedi gesvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏩᏔᏅᎢ ᎢᎩᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ ᏄᏓᎴᏒ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏕᏛᏅ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎦᎾᏰᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ, ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᎠᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎢᎩᏯᏅᏛ ᏥᎩ ᎬᏔᏅᎯ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎢᏍᏛᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft According as his divine power hath given unto us all things that pertain unto life and godliness, through the knowledge of him that hath called us to glory and virtue:

\ln Usgi nahna wudagonadvtanvhi equohiyu ale galvquodiyu egiduisdanelvhi tsigi, nasgi hia detsvdisgv getsatloya sdodi yinigalisda Unelanvhi nusdvi, etsadiwiselvhi gesv uyoi elohi tseha adulvdi gesv tsvdidalehvsga.
\syll ᎤᏍᎩ ᏀᎾ ᏭᏓᎪᎾᏛᏔᏅᎯ ᎡᏉᎯᏳ ᎠᎴ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎡᎩᏚᎢᏍᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏕᏨᏗᏍᎬ ᎨᏣᏠᏯ ᏍᏙᏗ ᏱᏂᎦᎵᏍᏓ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏄᏍᏛᎢ, ᎡᏣᏗᏫᏎᎸᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏲᎢ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏤᎭ ᎠᏚᎸᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏨᏗᏓᎴᎲᏍᎦ.
