\ft Whereby are given unto us exceeding great and precious promises: that by these ye might be partakers of the divine nature, having escaped the corruption that is in the world through lust.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi utsati ilotlinigvnehv itsohiyusv tali itsvdisgesdi duyugodv iyadvnedi gesvi; ale duyugodv iyadvnedi gesv tali itsvdisgesdi agadovhisdi gesvi;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎢᎶᏟᏂᎬᏁᎲ ᎢᏦᎯᏳᏒ ᏔᎵ ᎢᏨᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏔᎵ ᎢᏨᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ;
\ft And beside this, giving all diligence, add to your faith virtue; and to virtue knowledge;

\ln Agadovhisdino gesv tali itsvdisgesdi alisinahisdodi gesvi; alisinahisdodino gesv tali itsvdisgesdi ditsvnidiyu gesvi; ditsvnidiyuno gesv tali itsvdisgesdi Unelanvhi ganayehisdi gesvi;
\syll ᎠᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗᏃ ᎨᏒ ᏔᎵ ᎢᏨᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᎵᏏᏀᎢᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎠᎵᏏᏀᎢᏍᏙᏗᏃ ᎨᏒ ᏔᎵ ᎢᏨᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏗᏨᏂᏗᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᏗᏨᏂᏗᏳᏃ ᎨᏒ ᏔᎵ ᎢᏨᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎦᎾᏰᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ;
\ft And to knowledge temperance; and to temperance patience; and to patience godliness;

\ln Unelanvhino ganayehisdi gesv tali itsvdisgesdi analinvtlv digeyudi gesvi; analinvtlvno digeyudi gesv tali itsvdisgesdi igvniidvquo digeyudi gesvi.
\syll ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏃ ᎦᎾᏰᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏔᎵ ᎢᏨᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏢ ᏗᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏢᏃ ᏗᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏔᎵ ᎢᏨᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎢᎬᏂᎢᏛᏉ ᏗᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft And to godliness brotherly kindness; and to brotherly kindness charity.

\ln Iyuyeno nasgi hia tsudalenvdv otseha ale yikanequoga, nasgi yinigvnisa vtla itsisganolv ale nitsinequotsadvna yigagi agadovhisdi gesv Tsisa Galonedv Ugvwiyuhi igatseliga.
\syll ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎣᏤᎭ ᎠᎴ ᏱᎧᏁᏉᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᏂᎬᏂᏌ ᎥᏝ ᎢᏥᏍᎦᏃᎸ ᎠᎴ ᏂᏥᏁᏉᏣᏛᎾ ᏱᎦᎩ ᎠᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᎦᏤᎵᎦ.
\ft For if these things be in you, and abound, they make you that ye shall neither be barren nor unfruitful in the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.

\ln Nuwehvnasgini nasgi hia tsudalenvdv nasgi digewiquo ale iyvdv gvwagowadvdi nigesvna, ale uwagewisvhi atsinvgalvdv gesv ilvhiyu usganvtsidolvi.
\syll ᏄᏪᎲᎾᏍᎩᏂ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎨᏫᏉ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎬᏩᎪᏩᏛᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏩᎨᏫᏒᎯ ᎠᏥᏅᎦᎸᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᎤᏍᎦᏅᏥᏙᎸᎢ.
\ft But he that lacketh these things is blind, and cannot see afar off, and hath forgotten that he was purged from his old sins.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi idalinvtli utli igai itsatlinigvnehesdi nudlasidvsvna itsvnediyi etsiyanvhv ale etsasuyesvi; iyuyeno hia nasgi tsudalenvdv yinitsadvneha, vtla ilvhiyu yidogetsinvgi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ ᎤᏟ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎢᏣᏟᏂᎬᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᏄᏜᏏᏛᏒᎾ ᎢᏨᏁᏗᏱ ᎡᏥᏯᏅᎲ ᎠᎴ ᎡᏣᏑᏰᏒᎢ; ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏱᏂᏣᏛᏁᎭ, ᎥᏝ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᏱᏙᎨᏥᏅᎩ.
\ft Wherefore the rather, brethren, give diligence to make your calling and election sure: for if ye do these things, ye shall never fall:

\ln Nasgiyeno nitsadvnehv utsatanvhi etsinedi gesesdi itsiyvsdiyi ulisquadisdi nigesvna Ugvwiyuhi digesv igatseli Ugvwiyuhi ale Igisdelisgi Tsisa Galonedv.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎲ ᎤᏣᏔᏅᎯ ᎡᏥᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎢᏥᏴᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏗᎨᏒ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎢᎩᏍᏕᎵᏍᎩ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ.
\ft For so an entrance shall be ministered unto you abundantly into the everlasting kingdom of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi vtla unelagi yvdagelisi nigohilv itsvyanvdadisdodiyi nasgi hia tsudalenvdv, itsigalahasgininonv, ale detsalinigosv nahna duyugodv gesv gohi tsitsadvgiha.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏁᎳᎩ ᏴᏓᎨᎵᏏ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎢᏨᏯᏅᏓᏗᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ, ᎢᏥᎦᎳᎭᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᏣᎵᏂᎪᏒ ᏀᎾ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎪᎯ ᏥᏣᏛᎩᎭ.
\ft Wherefore I will not be negligent to put you always in remembrance of these things, though ye know them, and be established in the present truth.

\ln Vv, duyugodi geliha igohidv ani hia galitsodv tsiyavi, itsvyesdvdodiyi itsvyanvdadisdisgvi;
\syll ᎥᎥ, ᏚᏳᎪᏗ ᎨᎵᎭ ᎢᎪᎯᏛ ᎠᏂ ᎯᎠ ᎦᎵᏦᏛ ᏥᏯᎥᎢ, ᎢᏨᏰᏍᏛᏙᏗᏱ ᎢᏨᏯᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ;
\ft Yea, I think it meet, as long as I am in this tabernacle, to stir you up by putting you in remembrance;

\ln Nvdigalisdodisgv tsigatahv nigohilvnaquo iyvdv agidiyi gesv aquatseli galitsodvi, nasgiya Ugvwiyuhi igatseli Tsisa Galonedv gvnigesv naquvnelvi.
\syll ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬ ᏥᎦᏔᎲ ᏂᎪᎯᎸᎾᏉ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎠᎩᏗᏱ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏆᏤᎵ ᎦᎵᏦᏛᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎾᏋᏁᎸᎢ.
\ft Knowing that shortly I must put off this my tabernacle, even as our Lord Jesus Christ hath shewed me.

\ln Ale dagatlinigvneli agilosonvhi gesesdi nigohilv getsvgewisdi nigesvna iyulisdodiyi, nasgi hia tsudalenvdv.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏓᎦᏟᏂᎬᏁᎵ ᎠᎩᎶᏐᏅᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎨᏨᎨᏫᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ.
\ft Moreover I will endeavour that ye may be able after my decease to have these things always in remembrance.

\ln Vtlayeno alisinahistanvhi asequo gawonihisdi gesv yogisdawadvse gvnigesv nitsvyvnelv ulinigidi gesv ale uluhisdi gesv igatseli Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv; yigigohvhisgini gesvgi galvquodiyu gesv utseliga.
\syll ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᎠᎵᏏᏀᎢᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎠᏎᏉ ᎦᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏲᎩᏍᏓᏩᏛᏎ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᏨᏴᏁᎸ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎷᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ; ᏱᎩᎪᎲᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏒᎩ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ.
\ft For we have not followed cunningly devised fables, when we made known unto you the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, but were eyewitnesses of his majesty.

\ln Unelanvhiyeno Agayvlige ulisgolvdanelvgi galvquodiyu gesv ale igadulvsadvi, nahiyu kanegv tsulutselv utsati galvquodiyu igadulvsadv nvdayudaleuhi, [hia tsinigawesgvgi,] Hia tsigeyui Aquetsi, nasgi osiyu tsiyelvi tsigi.
\syll ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᎤᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᎸᎩ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎢᎦᏚᎸᏌᏛᎢ, ᏀᎢᏳ ᎧᏁᎬ ᏧᎷᏤᎸ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎢᎦᏚᎸᏌᏛ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᎤᎯ, ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᎦᏪᏍᎬᎩ,data is invalid ᎯᎠ ᏥᎨᏳᎢ ᎠᏇᏥ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏏᏳ ᏥᏰᎸᎢ ᏥᎩ.
\ft For he received from God the Father honour and glory, when there came such a voice to him from the excellent glory, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.

\ln Nasgino hia unetsv galvladi nvdayulosvhi ogadvganvgi, nahiyu galvquodi odalv itsulaha otsedohvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏅᏓᏳᎶᏒᎯ ᎣᎦᏛᎦᏅᎩ, ᏀᎢᏳ ᎦᎸᏉᏗ ᎣᏓᎸ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎣᏤᏙᎲᎢ.
\ft And this voice which came from heaven we heard, when we were with him in the holy mount.

\ln Ale nasquo utli igai nudlasidvsvna kanohedv adolehosvhi igiha, nasgi osiyu yinitsadvga yitsagasayastanv nasgiya igadulvsadv ulisigv tsvgasayasdisgoi, gvni iga dagadogi, ale sunale ehi noquisi dakalvgi ditsinawiyi;
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᏟ ᎢᎦᎢ ᏄᏜᏏᏛᏒᎾ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏒᎯ ᎢᎩᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏏᏳ ᏱᏂᏣᏛᎦ ᏱᏣᎦᏌᏯᏍᏔᏅ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎢᎦᏚᎸᏌᏛ ᎤᎵᏏᎬ ᏨᎦᏌᏯᏍᏗᏍᎪᎢ, ᎬᏂ ᎢᎦ ᏓᎦᏙᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏑᎾᎴ ᎡᎯ ᏃᏈᏏ ᏓᎧᎸᎩ ᏗᏥᎾᏫᏱ;
\ft We have also a more sure word of prophecy; whereunto ye do well that ye take heed, as unto a light that shineth in a dark place, until the day dawn, and the day star arise in your hearts:

\ln Igvyi nasgi hia nitsigadovsesdi nasgi saquo unv adolehosvhi gowelvi uwasv gesv digvnetlvdodi nigesvna gesvi.
\syll ᎢᎬᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏥᎦᏙᎥᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏌᏉ ᎤᏅ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏒᎯ ᎪᏪᎸᎢ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎨᏒ ᏗᎬᏁᏢᏙᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Knowing this first, that no prophecy of the scripture is of any private interpretation.

\ln Unadolehosvyeno ilvhiyu tsigesei vtla yvwiquo adanvtesgv yvdidalenei; anosdvsgini anisgaya Unelanvhi tsutseliga aninege iyuniwesdiyi nunvnehv Galvquodiyu Adanvdo.
\syll ᎤᎾᏙᎴᎰᏒᏰᏃ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᏥᎨᏎᎢ ᎥᏝ ᏴᏫᏉ ᎠᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ ᏴᏗᏓᎴᏁᎢ; ᎠᏃᏍᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᏤᎵᎦ ᎠᏂᏁᎨ ᎢᏳᏂᏪᏍᏗᏱ ᏄᏅᏁᎲ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ.
\ft For the prophecy came not in old time by the will of man: but holy men of God spake as they were moved by the Holy Ghost.

\ln Aseno unatlonasdi anadolehosgi igvwanadasuye yvwi, nasgiya unatlonasdi dinadeyohvsgi getsadasuyvdi tsigi, nasgi udelidv uniyvtanihisdi gesesdi unadatselidv gesv adadvdisgi, nasgi anadayihesdi Ugvwiyuhi unaguyvdv, ale unvsv iyunvnisadv unilutsedi gesesdi tlegiyu unidvdisgi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᎾᏠᎾᏍᏗ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎢᎬᏩᎾᏓᏑᏰ ᏴᏫ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎤᎾᏠᎾᏍᏗ ᏗᎾᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ ᎨᏣᏓᏑᏴᏗ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᎤᏂᏴᏔᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏤᎵᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏓᏛᏗᏍᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎾᏓᏱᎮᏍᏗ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᎾᎫᏴᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏅᏒ ᎢᏳᏅᏂᏌᏛ ᎤᏂᎷᏤᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏞᎩᏳ ᎤᏂᏛᏗᏍᎩ.
\ft But there were false prophets also among the people, even as there shall be false teachers among you, who privily shall bring in damnable heresies, even denying the Lord that bought them, and bring upon themselves swift destruction.

\ln Ale unitsatesdi dvnisdawadesi nasgi unatseli adadvdisgi; nasgi nvdvnvnisani duyugodv nvnohi unisotlvisdodi gesesdi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏣᏖᏍᏗ ᏛᏂᏍᏓᏩᏕᏏ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᏤᎵ ᎠᏓᏛᏗᏍᎩ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏛᏅᏂᏌᏂ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᏅᏃᎯ ᎤᏂᏐᏢᎢᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft And many shall follow their pernicious ways; by reason of whom the way of truth shall be evil spoken of.

\ln Ale tsugvwalodi unigvvsgv iyusdi, ale galonuhedv anvdisgv aniwonisgv ganododi dagetsiyelvtsi; nasgi tsunadugodanedi gesv eti nvdagvwadalenvdv vtla yalinahisdiha, ale unidvdisgi vtla yigalvsga.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎤᏂᎬᎥᏍᎬ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᎶᏄᎮᏛ ᎠᏅᏗᏍᎬ ᎠᏂᏬᏂᏍᎬ ᎦᏃᏙᏗ ᏓᎨᏥᏰᎸᏥ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᎾᏚᎪᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎡᏘ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎥᏝ ᏯᎵᏀᎢᏍᏗᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏛᏗᏍᎩ ᎥᏝ ᏱᎦᎸᏍᎦ.
\ft And through covetousness shall they with feigned words make merchandise of you: whose judgment now of a long time lingereth not, and their damnation slumbereth not.

\ln Unelanvhiyeno  nidugeyunvna tsigese dinikanawadidohi unisganvtsvhi, tsvsginoquosgini tsiwidudainvsei, ale tsiduyose tsudadesvdv digegalvsdodiyi ulisigv getsisquanigododiyi digegugodanedi gesv iyui,
\syll ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ  ᏂᏚᎨᏳᏅᎾ ᏥᎨᏎ ᏗᏂᎧᎾᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎤᏂᏍᎦᏅᏨᎯ, ᏨᏍᎩᏃᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᏥᏫᏚᏓᎢᏅᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᏚᏲᏎ ᏧᏓᏕᏒᏛ ᏗᎨᎦᎸᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᎵᏏᎬ ᎨᏥᏍᏆᏂᎪᏙᏗᏱ ᏗᎨᎫᎪᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᎢ,
\ft For if God spared not the angels that sinned, but cast them down to hell, and delivered them into chains of darkness, to be reserved unto judgment;

\ln Ale nugeyunvna tsigese eti elohi tsigesei, Noyasgini tsunela tsudvdei gesv nasgi alitsidohvsgi duyugodv dikanawadidohi tsigesei, ale tsidunohugotane elohi anisgana anehvi,
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏄᎨᏳᏅᎾ ᏥᎨᏎ ᎡᏘ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏥᎨᏎᎢ, ᏃᏯᏍᎩᏂ ᏧᏁᎳ ᏧᏛᏕᎢ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎵᏥᏙᎲᏍᎩ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᏗᎧᎾᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏥᎨᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᏚᏃᎱᎪᏔᏁ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᎾ ᎠᏁᎲᎢ,
\ft And spared not the old world, but saved Noah the eighth person, a preacher of righteousness, bringing in the flood upon the world of the ungodly;

\ln Sodamino ale Gomali degaduhv gosdu tsiniduwanelei, ale tsiduwugodanele tsuluquadinvdiyi, ale nasgi uneyatahvsgi tsiniduwanele oni unadedi unelanvhi nidunanelodvna gesvi,
\syll ᏐᏓᎻᏃ ᎠᎴ ᎪᎹᎵ ᏕᎦᏚᎲ ᎪᏍᏚ ᏥᏂᏚᏩᏁᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᏚᏭᎪᏓᏁᎴ ᏧᎷᏆᏗᏅᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᏯᏔᎲᏍᎩ ᏥᏂᏚᏩᏁᎴ ᎣᏂ ᎤᎾᏕᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏂᏚᎾᏁᎶᏛᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ,
\ft And turning the cities of Sodom and Gomorrha into ashes condemned them with an overthrow, making them an ensample unto those that after should live ungodly;

\ln Ale Lodi udanvti tsuwudalesei, udeyatanelv nunalisinahisdvna anehv anisdunai.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎶᏗ ᎤᏓᏅᏘ ᏧᏭᏓᎴᏎᎢ, ᎤᏕᏯᏔᏁᎸ ᏄᎾᎵᏏᏀᎢᏍᏛᎾ ᎠᏁᎲ ᎠᏂᏍᏚᎾᎢ.
\ft And delivered just Lot, vexed with the filthy conversation of the wicked:

\ln (Nasgiyeno udanvti asgaya anehv tsehei, agowatisgv ale advgisgv [nusdv dunilvwisdanehvi] udanvti udanvdo nidugitsvnisv udeyadodi udanvte nvdigalisdodisge niduyugodvna dunilvwisdanehvi,)
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎤᏓᏅᏘ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎠᏁᎲ ᏤᎮᎢ, ᎠᎪᏩᏘᏍᎬ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏛᎩᏍᎬ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏚᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎢdata is invalid ᎤᏓᏅᏘ ᎤᏓᏅᏙ ᏂᏚᎩᏨᏂᏒ ᎤᏕᏯᏙᏗ ᎤᏓᏅᏖ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨ ᏂᏚᏳᎪᏛᎾ ᏚᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎢ,
\ft (For that righteous man dwelling among them, in seeing and hearing, vexed his righteous soul from day to day with their unlawful deeds;)

\ln Ugvwiyuhi agataha iyudvnediyi tsuwudalesdiyi unadanvti unigoliyesgi uniyeilidohvi, uniyono tsusquanigododiyi getsigiliyoisdodiyi digugododiyi iga gesesdi:
\syll ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᎦᏔᎭ ᎢᏳᏛᏁᏗᏱ ᏧᏭᏓᎴᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ ᎤᏂᎪᎵᏰᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᏰᎢᎵᏙᎲᎢ, ᎤᏂᏲᏃ ᏧᏍᏆᏂᎪᏙᏗᏱ ᎨᏥᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏗᎫᎪᏙᏗᏱ ᎢᎦ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ:
\ft The Lord knoweth how to deliver the godly out of temptations, and to reserve the unjust unto the day of judgment to be punished:

\ln Ale nasgi ho ugvwiyuha [genigiliyoisdodi gesesdi] uquedali anisdawadegi unigvvsgv gadaha gesvi, ale dinisgagi nunigvwiyusadegi.  Unisgaisdi, unvsv anadanvtesgv unilvquodi; vtla yanisgaiha digvwanisotlvdodiyi getsilvquodi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮀ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎭ ᎨᏂᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗdata is invalid ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎠᏂᏍᏓᏩᏕᎩ ᎤᏂᎬᎥᏍᎬ ᎦᏓᎭ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏂᏍᎦᎩ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ.  ᎤᏂᏍᎦᎢᏍᏗ, ᎤᏅᏒ ᎠᎾᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ ᎤᏂᎸᏉᏗ; ᎥᏝ ᏯᏂᏍᎦᎢᎭ ᏗᎬᏩᏂᏐᏢᏙᏗᏱ ᎨᏥᎸᏉᏗ.
\ft But chiefly them that walk after the flesh in the lust of uncleanness, and despise government. Presumptuous are they, selfwilled, they are not afraid to speak evil of dignities.

\ln Dinikahnawadidohisgini utli itsunalinigidv tsigi vtla gohusdi usonv yidanilawiseho Ugvwiyuhi agatahvi.
\syll ᏗᏂᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏟ ᎢᏧᎾᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᏥᎩ ᎥᏝ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏐᏅ ᏱᏓᏂᎳᏫᏎᎰ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᎦᏔᎲᎢ.
\ft Whereas angels, which are greater in power and might, bring not railing accusation against them before the Lord.

\ln Hiasgini nasgiya gohusdiquo tsehnaa gegotlvnvhi gegeisdiyi ale getsidvdodiyi, nasgi anisotlvisdigo tsudalenvdv nanoligvna gesvi, ale dvnalidvtani unvsv uniyoiyu gesvi.
\syll ᎯᎠᏍᎩᏂ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎪᎱᏍᏗᏉ ᏤᎿᎠ ᎨᎪᏢᏅᎯ ᎨᎨᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᎨᏥᏛᏙᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏂᏐᏢᎢᏍᏗᎪ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎾᏃᎵᎬᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏛᎾᎵᏛᏔᏂ ᎤᏅᏒ ᎤᏂᏲᎢᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft But these, as natural brute beasts, made to be taken and destroyed, speak evil of the things that they understand not; and shall utterly perish in their own corruption;

\ln Ale dvniwadvhi gegaguyvdanedi niduyugodvna dunilvwisdanehvi, nasgiya [gegaguyvdanedi tsigi] osiyu utsiyelvhi iga gesv osdv tsunalisdayvdiyi.  Tsidudadaloi ale gohusdi tsusdoi nasgiyai, osiyu uniyelvha unvsv anadalidasdisgvi, nahiyu itsulaha itsalisdayvhvsgvi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏛᏂᏩᏛᎯ ᎨᎦᎫᏴᏓᏁᏗ ᏂᏚᏳᎪᏛᎾ ᏚᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎨᎦᎫᏴᏓᏁᏗ ᏥᎩdata is invalid ᎣᏏᏳ ᎤᏥᏰᎸᎯ ᎢᎦ ᎨᏒ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏧᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ.  ᏥᏚᏓᏓᎶᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏧᏍᏙᎢ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ, ᎣᏏᏳ ᎤᏂᏰᎸᎭ ᎤᏅᏒ ᎠᎾᏓᎵᏓᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᏀᎢᏳ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎬᎢ.
\ft And shall receive the reward of unrighteousness, as they that count it pleasure to riot in the day time. Spots they are and blemishes, sporting themselves with their own deceivings while they feast with you;

\ln Dinigadoli tsukalitsvhi adayonedi gesvi, ale digvwaniyohisdi nigesvna asgani gesvi:  dinilonuhesgi nidunalinigvgvna ganadanvdvi; tsuninawi tsugisadv agvvhisdi digalvwisdanedi gesvi; agiliyoisdi gesv tsuwetsi,
\syll ᏗᏂᎦᏙᎵ ᏧᎧᎵᏨᎯ ᎠᏓᏲᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎬᏩᏂᏲᎯᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᎨᏒᎢ:  ᏗᏂᎶᏄᎮᏍᎩ ᏂᏚᎾᎵᏂᎬᎬᎾ ᎦᎾᏓᏅᏛᎢ; ᏧᏂᎾᏫ ᏧᎩᏌᏛ ᎠᎬᎥᎯᏍᏗ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎠᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏧᏪᏥ,
\ft Having eyes full of adultery, and that cannot cease from sin; beguiling unstable souls: an heart they have exercised with covetous practices; cursed children:

\ln Unvdetsv duyugodv ganvnvi, ale unaleyov, unisdawadenv ulosv Quelami Quosa uwetsi, osiyu tsuyelvse niduyugodvna digalvwisdanedi gesv aguyvdi,
\syll ᎤᏅᏕᏨ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎦᏅᏅᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᎴᏲᎥ, ᎤᏂᏍᏓᏩᏕᏅ ᎤᎶᏒ ᏇᎳᎻ ᏉᏌ ᎤᏪᏥ, ᎣᏏᏳ ᏧᏰᎸᏎ ᏂᏚᏳᎪᏛᎾ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎫᏴᏗ,
\ft Which have forsaken the right way, and are gone astray, following the way of Balaam the son of Bosor, who loved the wages of unrighteousness;

\ln Aseno atsigvsgolvne usganvtsvi: uwagewi digalianvhidv yvwi uneisdi uwatane unetsei, usgatse nudanvdvna gesv adolehosgi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᏥᎬᏍᎪᎸᏁ ᎤᏍᎦᏅᏨᎢ: ᎤᏩᎨᏫ ᏗᎦᎵᎠᏅᎯᏛ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏁᎢᏍᏗ ᎤᏩᏔᏁ ᎤᏁᏤᎢ, ᎤᏍᎦᏤ ᏄᏓᏅᏛᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ.
\ft But was rebuked for his iniquity: the dumb ass speaking with man's voice forbad the madness of the prophet.

\ln Hia nasgi datalesv amaditlvdiyi ama nidiganehvna, [ale] ulogilv unole tsunolvtanidohoi, nasgi na gvnage ulisigv tsigegadvnvisdanelv ulisquadisdi nigesvna.
\syll ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏓᏔᎴᏒ ᎠᎹᏗᏢᏗᏱ ᎠᎹ ᏂᏗᎦᏁᎲᎾ, ᎠᎴdata is invalid ᎤᎶᎩᎸ ᎤᏃᎴ ᏧᏃᎸᏔᏂᏙᎰᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎬᎾᎨ ᎤᎵᏏᎬ ᏥᎨᎦᏛᏅᎢᏍᏓᏁᎸ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.
\ft These are wells without water, clouds that are carried with a tempest; to whom the mist of darkness is reserved for ever.

\ln Aninegiyeno utsati atlvquasdi gohusdi gvdodi nigesvna aniwonisgvi, danilonuhesgo anvdisgo uquedali adulvdi gesvi, [ale] nolisinahisdvna nidasdi gesvi, nasgi udodiyuhi tsunadiwiselvhi nasgi na asi udalidasdi gesv analenidohi tsigi.
\syll ᎠᏂᏁᎩᏰᏃ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎠᏢᏆᏍᏗ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎬᏙᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎠᏂᏬᏂᏍᎬᎢ, ᏓᏂᎶᏄᎮᏍᎪ ᎠᏅᏗᏍᎪ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎠᏚᎸᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴdata is invalid ᏃᎵᏏᏀᎢᏍᏛᎾ ᏂᏓᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏙᏗᏳᎯ ᏧᎾᏗᏫᏎᎸᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᏏ ᎤᏓᎵᏓᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎾᎴᏂᏙᎯ ᏥᎩ.
\ft For when they speak great swelling words of vanity, they allure through the lusts of the flesh, through much wantonness, those that were clean escaped from them who live in error.

\ln Daniduisdaneho digetsinatlai nigesvna iyulisdodiyi, unvsvno uyo gesv digvwaninatlai gesoi:  giloyeno atsisegogi nasgi na usegogidv unatlai nigalisdisgoi.
\syll ᏓᏂᏚᎢᏍᏓᏁᎰ ᏗᎨᏥᎾᏝᎢ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎤᏅᏒᏃ ᎤᏲ ᎨᏒ ᏗᎬᏩᏂᎾᏝᎢ ᎨᏐᎢ:  ᎩᎶᏰᏃ ᎠᏥᏎᎪᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᏎᎪᎩᏛ ᎤᎾᏝᎢ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᏍᎪᎢ.
\ft While they promise them liberty, they themselves are the servants of corruption: for of whom a man is overcome, of the same is he brought in bondage.

\ln Iyuyeno unadiwiselvhi yigi gadaha gesv elohi ehi, anvdisgv agadovhisdi gesv Ugvwiyuhi ale Igisdelisgi Tsisa Galonedv, talineno yiunesv nahnani ale yigetsisegogisv, ulisqualvdi nunalisdanelv utli uyoiyu esgaquo igvyiyi.
\syll ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᎤᎾᏗᏫᏎᎸᎯ ᏱᎩ ᎦᏓᎭ ᎨᏒ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎡᎯ, ᎠᏅᏗᏍᎬ ᎠᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎢᎩᏍᏕᎵᏍᎩ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ, ᏔᎵᏁᏃ ᏱᎤᏁᏒ ᏀᎾᏂ ᎠᎴ ᏱᎨᏥᏎᎪᎩᏒ, ᎤᎵᏍᏆᎸᏗ ᏄᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᎸ ᎤᏟ ᎤᏲᎢᏳ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎢᎬᏱᏱ.
\ft For if after they have escaped the pollutions of the world through the knowledge of the Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ, they are again entangled therein, and overcome, the latter end is worse with them than the beginning.

\ln Utliyeno osiyu iyunalisdanedi yigesei nunigadovsvna yigese duyugodv ganvnvi, ano unigadovsvhi gesv yanagatahv yiduniyosga galvquodiyu dikahnawadvsdi nasgi digetsiyohiselvhi.
\syll ᎤᏟᏰᏃ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ ᏄᏂᎦᏙᎥᏒᎾ ᏱᎨᏎ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎦᏅᏅᎢ, ᎠᏃ ᎤᏂᎦᏙᎥᏒᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏯᎾᎦᏔᎲ ᏱᏚᏂᏲᏍᎦ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎨᏥᏲᎯᏎᎸᎯ.
\ft For it had been better for them not to have known the way of righteousness, than, after they have known it, to turn from the holy commandment delivered unto them.

\ln Aseno nasgiya nunalisdanelv hia udohiyuhi igawedv tsigi, gili uwasv duligastanv taline wvagatahvsda; siquono agosulevhi udawosdiyi tlawoduhi wvagatahvsda.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᎸ ᎯᎠ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎢᎦᏪᏛ ᏥᎩ, ᎩᎵ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏚᎵᎦᏍᏔᏅ ᏔᎵᏁ ᏮᎠᎦᏔᎲᏍᏓ; ᏏᏉᏃ ᎠᎪᏑᎴᎥᎯ ᎤᏓᏬᏍᏗᏱ ᏝᏬᏚᎯ ᏮᎠᎦᏔᎲᏍᏓ.
\ft But it is happened unto them according to the true proverb, The dog is turned to his own vomit again; and the sow that was washed to her wallowing in the mire.

\ln Hia nasgi taline goweli hnaquo itsvyowelasi itsvgeyui; nasgi nahna detsvyesdane utlonasdi nigesvna detsadanvdv nasgi itsvyanvdadisdisgvi,
\syll ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎪᏪᎵ ᎿᏉ ᎢᏨᏲᏪᎳᏏ ᎢᏨᎨᏳᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᏀᎾ ᏕᏨᏰᏍᏓᏁ ᎤᏠᎾᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏕᏣᏓᏅᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏨᏯᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ,
\ft This second epistle, beloved, I now write unto you; in both which I stir up your pure minds by way of remembrance:

\ln Nasgi itsanvdadisdiyi kanohedv ilvhiyu uninohedv getsilvquodi anadolehosgi, ale ayv tsogadeyonvhi oginvsidv Ugvwiyuhi ale Disdelisgi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏣᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗᏱ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᎤᏂᏃᎮᏛ ᎨᏥᎸᏉᏗ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴ ᏦᎦᏕᏲᏅᎯ ᎣᎩᏅᏏᏛ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏍᏕᎵᏍᎩ.
\ft That ye may be mindful of the words which were spoken before by the holy prophets, and of the commandment of us the apostles of the Lord and Saviour:

\ln Hia nusdesdi igvyi itsanvtesdi, nasgi ulisquanvdi gesesdi uniluhisdi gesv anisotlvisdisgi unvsv unadulvnvvsgv anisdawadegi,
\syll ᎯᎠ ᏄᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᎢᎬᏱ ᎢᏣᏅᏖᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᏅᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᏂᎷᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏂᏐᏢᎢᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᎤᏅᏒ ᎤᎾᏚᎸᏅᎥᏍᎬ ᎠᏂᏍᏓᏩᏕᎩ,
\ft Knowing this first, that there shall come in the last days scoffers, walking after their own lusts,

\ln Ale hia iyaniwesgi, Gado ulistanv uluhisdiyi uduistanvi?  Anigayvligeyeno gvwanilinvtsvhi nvdagvwalenvdv, nvwasdiquo nigav gohusdi tsinusdvquo tsudalenvhv uwotlvnvnv nvdagvwadalenvdv.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᎢᏯᏂᏪᏍᎩ, ᎦᏙ ᎤᎵᏍᏔᏅ ᎤᎷᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏚᎢᏍᏔᏅᎢ?  ᎠᏂᎦᏴᎵᎨᏰᏃ ᎬᏩᏂᎵᏅᏨᎯ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᎴᏅᏛ, ᏅᏩᏍᏗᏉ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏥᏄᏍᏛᏉ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᎲ ᎤᏬᏢᏅᏅ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏓᎴᏅᏛ.
\ft And saying, Where is the promise of his coming? for since the fathers fell asleep, all things continue as they were from the beginning of the creation.

\ln Hiayeno unvsv unadulvdv nanigatahvna tsigi, nasgi Unelanvhi unetsv nvtsulisdotanv galvlo ilvhiyu tsigesei ale elohi amayi gadu tsugadudei, ale awuhi tsigadogei;
\syll ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᎤᏅᏒ ᎤᎾᏚᎸᏛ ᎾᏂᎦᏔᎲᎾ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏁᏨ ᏅᏧᎵᏍᏙᏔᏅ ᎦᎸᎶ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᏥᎨᏎᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎠᎹᏱ ᎦᏚ ᏧᎦᏚᏕᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏭᎯ ᏥᎦᏙᎨᎢ;
\ft For this they willingly are ignorant of, that by the word of God the heavens were of old, and the earth standing out of the water and in the water:

\ln Nasgi elohi nahiyu tsigese amayiha tsinulistanei, uyotsei.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏀᎢᏳ ᏥᎨᏎ ᎠᎹᏱᎭ ᏥᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᎤᏲᏤᎢ.
\ft Whereby the world that then was, being overflowed with water, perished:

\ln aseno galvloi ale elohi gohi tsigi, nasgiquo unetsv nvdigalisdodiha dasquanigodi, atsilvyi wunaliyeilohisdiyi dasquanigodi gvni digugododiyi iga gesesdi ale getsidvdodiyi anisgaya unelanvhi nidunanelodvna.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎦᎸᎶᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎪᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩᏉ ᎤᏁᏨ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᏓᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ, ᎠᏥᎸᏱ ᏭᎾᎵᏰᎢᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏓᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᎬᏂ ᏗᎫᎪᏙᏗᏱ ᎢᎦ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎨᏥᏛᏙᏗᏱ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏂᏚᎾᏁᎶᏛᎾ.
\ft But the heavens and the earth, which are now, by the same word are kept in store, reserved unto fire against the day of judgment and perdition of ungodly men.

\ln Aseno itsvgeyui, hia nasgi sudalegi tlesdi nitsigatahvnaquo yigesesdi, nasgi saquo iga gesv Ugvwiyuhi dodikanisgv saquo iyagayvli itsudetiyvdv utloyi, saquono iyagayvli itsudetiyvdv saquo iga gesv utloyi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎢᏨᎨᏳᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏑᏓᎴᎩ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏂᏥᎦᏔᎲᎾᏉ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏌᏉ ᎢᎦ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏙᏗᎧᏂᏍᎬ ᏌᏉ ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ ᎢᏧᏕᏘᏴᏛ ᎤᏠᏱ, ᏌᏉᏃ ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ ᎢᏧᏕᏘᏴᏛ ᏌᏉ ᎢᎦ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏠᏱ.
\ft But, beloved, be not ignorant of this one thing, that one day is with the Lord as a thousand years, and a thousand years as one day.

\ln Ugvwiyuhi vtla usganoliyu yigi nusdv uduistanv iyudvnediyi, nasgi gilo nasganola tsaneliha, gvnidiyusgini ayv igigatiyvi, nudulisgvna gesv gilo uyohuhisdiyi, nigadiyusgini uniluhisdiyi ganetliyvsdi gesv odanvdvi.
\syll ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏍᎦᏃᎵᏳ ᏱᎩ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎤᏚᎢᏍᏔᏅ ᎢᏳᏛᏁᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎩᎶ ᎾᏍᎦᏃᎳ ᏣᏁᎵᎭ, ᎬᏂᏗᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏴ ᎢᎩᎦᏘᏴᎢ, ᏄᏚᎵᏍᎬᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗᏱ, ᏂᎦᏗᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏂᎷᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎦᏁᏟᏴᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎣᏓᏅᏛᎢ.
\ft The Lord is not slack concerning his promise, as some men count slackness; but is longsuffering to us-ward, not willing that any should perish, but that all should come to repentance.

\ln Ugvwiyuhisgini utseli iga ase dagalutsi nasgiya ganosgisgi svnoyi tsigalugoi, nahiyu galvloi dagalosoni utsati unoyvgesdi, gotlvtanvhino adaweligisgv dvgoni, ale elohi nahnano gotlvnvnvhi gesv agohvsdodi gesesdi.
\syll ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎢᎦ ᎠᏎ ᏓᎦᎷᏥ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎦᏃᏍᎩᏍᎩ ᏒᏃᏱ ᏥᎦᎷᎪᎢ, ᏀᎢᏳ ᎦᎸᎶᎢ ᏓᎦᎶᏐᏂ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᏃᏴᎨᏍᏗ, ᎪᏢᏔᏅᎯᏃ ᎠᏓᏪᎵᎩᏍᎬ ᏛᎪᏂ, ᎠᎴ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏀᎾᏃ ᎪᏢᏅᏅᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎪᎲᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft But the day of the Lord will come as a thief in the night; in the which the heavens shall pass away with a great noise, and the elements shall melt with fervent heat, the earth also and the works that are therein shall be burned up.

\ln Nasgino nigadiyu tsudalenvdv udisvhvsdi tsigi, nigav nitsisganvna yigi itsalenidohvi ale unelanvhi ganayehisdi gesv itsehvi!
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎤᏗᏒᎲᏍᏗ ᏥᎩ, ᏂᎦᎥ ᏂᏥᏍᎦᏅᎾ ᏱᎩ ᎢᏣᎴᏂᏙᎲᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎦᎾᏰᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏤᎲᎢ
\ft Seeing then that all these things shall be dissolved, what manner of persons ought ye to be in all holy conversation and godliness,

\ln Yitsigatenoha ale utsati yitsaduliha uluhisdiyi Unelanvhi utseli iga, nahiyu galvlo utsistlv tsvdvdisvni, ale nasgi gotlvtanvhi adaweligisgv dvdisani.
\syll ᏱᏥᎦᏖᏃᎭ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏱᏣᏚᎵᎭ ᎤᎷᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎢᎦ, ᏀᎢᏳ ᎦᎸᎶ ᎤᏥᏍᏢ ᏨᏛᏗᏒᏂ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᏢᏔᏅᎯ ᎠᏓᏪᎵᎩᏍᎬ ᏛᏗᏌᏂ.
\ft Looking for and hasting unto the coming of the day of God, wherein the heavens being on fire shall be dissolved, and the elements shall melt with fervent heat?

\ln Aseno nasgiya nusdv uduistanv idigatenoha itse galvloi ale itse elohi nahna ehv duyugodv gesvi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎤᏚᎢᏍᏔᏅ ᎢᏗᎦᏖᏃᎭ ᎢᏤ ᎦᎸᎶᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏤ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏀᎾ ᎡᎲ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Nevertheless we, according to his promise, look for new heavens and a new earth, wherein dwelleth righteousness.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi, itsvgeyui, nasgi hia tsudalenvdv tsitsigatenoha, itsatlinigvsi nasgi nvwadohiyadv itsvdanvdv itsiwadvdiyi nudadalvna ale gohusdi netselisehvna.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᎢᏨᎨᏳᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏥᏥᎦᏖᏃᎭ, ᎢᏣᏟᏂᎬᏏ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᎢᏨᏓᏅᏛ ᎢᏥᏩᏛᏗᏱ ᏄᏓᏓᎸᎾ ᎠᎴ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏁᏤᎵᏎᎲᎾ.
\ft Wherefore, beloved, seeing that ye look for such things, be diligent that ye may be found of him in peace, without spot, and blameless.

\ln Nasgino gvnidiyu gesv Ugvwiyuhi igatseliga alisdelvdodi itsiyelvsesdi; nasgiya nasquo edigeyui idalinvtli Quola gvdisgv agadovhisdi gesv atsinelv tsitsowelanelv;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎬᏂᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᎦᏤᎵᎦ ᎠᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ ᎢᏥᏰᎸᏎᏍᏗ; ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎡᏗᎨᏳᎢ ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ ᏉᎳ ᎬᏗᏍᎬ ᎠᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏥᏁᎸ ᏥᏦᏪᎳᏁᎸ;
\ft And account that the longsuffering of our Lord is salvation; even as our beloved brother Paul also according to the wisdom given unto him hath written unto you;

\ln Ale nasquo nigadv nasgi tsuwowelanvhi nasgi nidegvneho kaneisdisgo nasgi hia tsudalenvdv; nahna udasuya igadv asdayiyu golisdiyi, nasgi na niwunadeloquavna ale diniwanagala daninetliyvha, nasgiya nasquo disoi goweli nidanvnehvi, unvsvquo unidvdisgi gesvi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏬᏪᎳᏅᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᏕᎬᏁᎰ ᎧᏁᎢᏍᏗᏍᎪ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ; ᏀᎾ ᎤᏓᏑᏯ ᎢᎦᏛ ᎠᏍᏓᏱᏳ ᎪᎵᏍᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏂᏭᎾᏕᎶᏆᎥᎾ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏂᏩᎾᎦᎳ ᏓᏂᏁᏟᏴᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏗᏐᎢ ᎪᏪᎵ ᏂᏓᏅᏁᎲᎢ, ᎤᏅᏒᏉ ᎤᏂᏛᏗᏍᎩ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft As also in all his epistles, speaking in them of these things; in which are some things hard to be understood, which they that are unlearned and unstable wrest, as they do also the other scriptures, unto their own destruction.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi nihi itsvgeyui, nasgi gayula tsitsigataha, itseyatahesdi, tlesdi aninagana unilidastanv detsatinisv ditsinvtsvgi ditsiyosvgi ulinigidv nitsadvnvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏨᎨᏳᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏳᎳ ᏥᏥᎦᏔᎭ, ᎢᏤᏯᏔᎮᏍᏗ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᎠᏂᎾᎦᎾ ᎤᏂᎵᏓᏍᏔᏅ ᏕᏣᏘᏂᏒ ᏗᏥᏅᏨᎩ ᏗᏥᏲᏒᎩ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᏂᏣᏛᏅᎢ.
\ft Ye therefore, beloved, seeing ye know these things before, beware lest ye also, being led away with the error of the wicked, fall from your own stedfastness.

\ln Itsinequogesdisgini gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv ugvwali ale etsigadovhisdi gesv Ugvwiyuhi igatseli ale Igisdelisgi Tsisa Galonedv; nasgi galvquododi gesesdi gohi gesv, ale ulisquadisdi nigesvna.  Emenv.
\syll ᎢᏥᏁᏉᎨᏍᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᎠᎴ ᎡᏥᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᎠᎴ ᎢᎩᏍᏕᎵᏍᎩ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎸᏉᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.  ᎡᎺᏅ.
\ft But grow in grace, and in the knowledge of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ. To him be glory both now and for ever. Amen.

\ln Nasgi didalenisgv tsehei, ayv ogadvganvhi, tsotsigadoli tsogvtanvhi ogigohvhi, nasgi tsogakahnanvhi, ale tsogoyeni tsogvtanvhi ogasvnilidolvhi, kanohedv gvnidv^
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏓᎴᏂᏍᎬ ᏤᎮᎢ, ᎠᏴ ᎣᎦᏛᎦᏅᎯ, ᏦᏥᎦᏙᎵ ᏦᎬᏔᏅᎯ ᎣᎩᎪᎲᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏦᎦᎧᎿᏅᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏦᎪᏰᏂ ᏦᎬᏔᏅᎯ ᎣᎦᏒᏂᎵᏙᎸᎯ, ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎬᏂᏛdata is invalid
\ft That which was from the beginning, which we have heard, which we have seen with our eyes, which we have looked upon, and our hands have handled, of the Word of life;

\ln Gvnidvyeno gvnigesv nulistanvgi, ale ogigohvgi, ale otsinoheha, ale itsvnanuwiseha nasgi alisquadisgi nigesvna gvnidv, nasgi Agayvligei ehv tsehei, ale gvnigesv iyogvnelvhi tsigi^
\syll ᎬᏂᏛᏰᏃ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎣᎩᎪᎲᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎣᏥᏃᎮᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏨᎾᏄᏫᏎᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎬᏂᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ ᎡᎲ ᏤᎮᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏲᎬᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩdata is invalid
\ft (For the life was manifested, and we have seen it, and bear witness, and shew unto you that eternal life, which was with the Father, and was manifested unto us;)

\ln Nasgi na ogigohvhi ale ogadvganvhi gesv itsvnanuwiseha, nasquo nihi itsateladisdiyi ogadudadewisvi; ale udohiyuhiya ogadudadewisv Agayvligei ale Uwetsi Tsisa Galonedv.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎣᎩᎪᎲᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎣᎦᏛᎦᏅᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏨᎾᏄᏫᏎᎭ, ᎾᏍᏉ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏣᏖᎳᏗᏍᏗᏱ ᎣᎦᏚᏓᏕᏫᏒᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎣᎦᏚᏓᏕᏫᏒ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏪᏥ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ.
\ft That which we have seen and heard declare we unto you, that ye also may have fellowship with us: and truly our fellowship is with the Father, and with his Son Jesus Christ.

\ln Hia ale nasgi itsvyowelaneha itsaliheligv ukaliisdiyi.
\syll ᎯᎠ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏨᏲᏪᎳᏁᎭ ᎢᏣᎵᎮᎵᎬ ᎤᎧᎵᎢᏍᏗᏱ.
\ft And these things write we unto you, that your joy may be full.

\ln Hiano nasgi kanohedv otsadvganelvhi tsigi ale tsitsvnanuwiseha nasgi Unelanvhi igagati gesvi, ale usdi unvulisigi nuwehvna gesvi.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎣᏣᏛᎦᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎠᎴ ᏥᏨᎾᏄᏫᏎᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᎦᎦᏘ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎤᏅᎤᎵᏏᎩ ᏄᏪᎲᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft This then is the message which we have heard of him, and declare unto you, that God is light, and in him is no darkness at all.

\ln Iyuno nasgi dogadudata yidadiha, ulisigvno yidedoha, yidatsigovsgaquo ale vtla yigedisdawadega udohiyuhi gesvi.
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏙᎦᏚᏓᏔ ᏱᏓᏗᎭ, ᎤᎵᏏᎬᏃ ᏱᏕᏙᎭ, ᏱᏓᏥᎪᎥᏍᎦᏉ ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᏱᎨᏗᏍᏓᏩᏕᎦ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft If we say that we have fellowship with him, and walk in darkness, we lie, and do not the truth:

\ln Igagadvsgini yidedoha, nasgiya nasgi igagadvi tseha, degadudadewisv igvsv gesvi; ale uwetsi Tsisa Galonedv ugigv iginvgaliha nigav igisganvtsvi.
\syll ᎢᎦᎦᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᏱᏕᏙᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎦᎦᏛᎢ ᏤᎭ, ᏕᎦᏚᏓᏕᏫᏒ ᎢᎬᏒ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᏪᏥ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᎩᎬ ᎢᎩᏅᎦᎵᎭ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎢᎩᏍᎦᏅᏨᎢ.
\ft But if we walk in the light, as he is in the light, we have fellowship one with another, and the blood of Jesus Christ his Son cleanseth us from all sin.

\ln Iyuno vtla asgani yogeha yidadiha, igvsv yidadalidasdiha, ale vtla yigegeha udohiyuhi gesvi.
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᏲᎨᎭ ᏱᏓᏗᎭ, ᎢᎬᏒ ᏱᏓᏓᎵᏓᏍᏗᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᏱᎨᎨᎭ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft If we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.

\ln Iyuno yidinohvsga igisganvtsvi, nudalidasdvna ale udanvtiyu, nasgi iginediyi igisganvtsvi, ale iginvgalvdiyi nigav uyo digalvwisdadi gesvi.
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᏱᏗᏃᎲᏍᎦ ᎢᎩᏍᎦᏅᏨᎢ, ᏄᏓᎵᏓᏍᏛᎾ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᏅᏘᏳ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎩᏁᏗᏱ ᎢᎩᏍᎦᏅᏨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᎩᏅᎦᎸᏗᏱ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎤᏲ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.

\ln Iyuno vtla yogisganvtsv yidadiha, ediyegovsgaquo, ale kanohedv utseliga vtla yigegeha.
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏲᎩᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᏱᏓᏗᎭ, ᎡᏗᏰᎪᎥᏍᎦᏉ, ᎠᎴ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᎥᏝ ᏱᎨᎨᎭ.
\ft If we say that we have not sinned, we make him a liar, and his word is not in us.

\ln Ditsiyoli diquetsi, hia nasgi itsvyowelaneha, itsisganvisdiyi nigesvna.  Iyuno gilo yasganvga, igeha digohisdanehi Agayvlige ehvi, Tsisa Galonedv nasganvna.
\syll ᏗᏥᏲᎵ ᏗᏇᏥ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏨᏲᏪᎳᏁᎭ, ᎢᏥᏍᎦᏅᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.  ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᏯᏍᎦᏅᎦ, ᎢᎨᎭ ᏗᎪᎯᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᎡᎲᎢ, ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎾᏍᎦᏅᎾ.
\ft My little children, these things write I unto you, that ye sin not. And if any man sin, we have an advocate with the Father, Jesus Christ the righteous:

\ln Ale nasgi alisgolvtanvhi aguyvdodi ayv igisganvtsvi, ale vtla ayvquo igvsv igisganvtsvi, nasquosgini elohi nigvnadvi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏅᎯ ᎠᎫᏴᏙᏗ ᎠᏴ ᎢᎩᏍᎦᏅᏨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᎠᏴᏉ ᎢᎬᏒ ᎢᎩᏍᎦᏅᏨᎢ, ᎾᏍᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏂᎬᎾᏛᎢ.
\ft And he is the propitiation for our sins: and not for ours only, but also for the sins of the whole world.

\ln Hiano nasgi idadolehohisdiha edigatahvi, nasgi yidigisquanigodi tsutseli dikahnawadvsdi.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏓᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏗᎭ ᎡᏗᎦᏔᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᏗᎩᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᏧᏤᎵ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ.
\ft And hereby we do know that we know him, if we keep his commandments.

\ln Gilo tsigataha adisgi, aseno nidusquanigodvna yigi tsutseli dikahnawadvsdi, nasgi gayegogi ale udohiyuhi gesv nuwehvna.
\syll ᎩᎶ ᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᎠᏗᏍᎩ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᏂᏚᏍᏆᏂᎪᏛᎾ ᏱᎩ ᏧᏤᎵ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏰᎪᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏄᏪᎲᎾ.
\ft He that saith, I know him, and keepeth not his commandments, is a liar, and the truth is not in him.

\ln Gilosgini yusquanigodi nasgi unetsvhi, nasgi udohiyuhiya Unelanvhi ageyudi gesv ukalitsvhi gesoi:  nasgi hia idadolehohisdiha ediyavi.
\syll ᎩᎶᏍᎩᏂ ᏳᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᏨᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎧᎵᏨᎯ ᎨᏐᎢ:  ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎢᏓᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏗᎭ ᎡᏗᏯᎥᎢ.
\ft But whoso keepeth his word, in him verily is the love of God perfected: hereby know we that we are in him.

\ln Gilo [Tsisa] tsiyaa yadiha, [Tsisa] uwedolv nasgiya nasquo yedoha.
\syll ᎩᎶ ᏥᏌdata is invalid ᏥᏯᎠ ᏯᏗᎭ, ᏥᏌdata is invalid ᎤᏪᏙᎸ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏰᏙᎭ.
\ft He that saith he abideth in him ought himself also so to walk, even as he walked.

\ln Idadanvtli, vtla itse dikahnawadvsdi yitsvyowelaneha, uwetiquosgini dikahnawadvsdi nasgi tsitsihvgi didalenisgvi; uweti dikahnawadvsdi nasgiquo kanohedv didalenisgv nvdagvwadalenvdv tsinetsadvgisgoi.
\syll ᎢᏓᏓᏅᏟ, ᎥᏝ ᎢᏤ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏱᏨᏲᏪᎳᏁᎭ, ᎤᏪᏘᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏥᎲᎩ ᏗᏓᎴᏂᏍᎬᎢ; ᎤᏪᏘ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩᏉ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏗᏓᎴᏂᏍᎬ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏥᏁᏣᏛᎩᏍᎪᎢ.
\ft Brethren, I write no new commandment unto you, but an old commandment which ye had from the beginning. The old commandment is the word which ye have heard from the beginning.

\ln Alewo, itse dikahnawadvsdi itsvyowelaneha, nasgi udohiyuha [Galonedv] gesvi ale nihi gesvi; ulisigvyeno ulosonv, hnaquono duyugodv igagati dulvsadv.
\syll ᎠᎴᏬ, ᎢᏤ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎢᏨᏲᏪᎳᏁᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎭ ᎦᎶᏁᏛdata is invalid ᎨᏒᎢ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎤᎵᏏᎬᏰᏃ ᎤᎶᏐᏅ, ᎿᏉᏃ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎢᎦᎦᏘ ᏚᎸᏌᏛ.
\ft Again, a new commandment I write unto you, which thing is true in him and in you: because the darkness is past, and the true light now shineth.

\ln Gilo igagadv gea yadiha, dinadanvtlino yasgaga, ulisigvquo eha gilahiyu.
\syll ᎩᎶ ᎢᎦᎦᏛ ᎨᎠ ᏯᏗᎭ, ᏗᎾᏓᏅᏟᏃ ᏯᏍᎦᎦ, ᎤᎵᏏᎬᏉ ᎡᎭ ᎩᎳᎯᏳ.
\ft He that saith he is in the light, and hateth his brother, is in darkness even until now.

\ln Gilo dinadanvtli yugeyuha igagadv eha, vtla ale gohusdi adadodesdisgi yuweha.
\syll ᎩᎶ ᏗᎾᏓᏅᏟ ᏳᎨᏳᎭ ᎢᎦᎦᏛ ᎡᎭ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎠᏓᏙᏕᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᏳᏪᎭ.
\ft He that loveth his brother abideth in the light, and there is none occasion of stumbling in him.

\ln Dinadanvtlisgini asgagi ulisigvquo eha, ale ulisigvquo edoha, vtla ale yagataha wagadvi, ulisigvyeno dugewadv.
\syll ᏗᎾᏓᏅᏟᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏍᎦᎩ ᎤᎵᏏᎬᏉ ᎡᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏏᎬᏉ ᎡᏙᎭ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᏯᎦᏔᎭ ᏩᎦᏛᎢ, ᎤᎵᏏᎬᏰᏃ ᏚᎨᏩᏛ.
\ft But he that hateth his brother is in darkness, and walketh in darkness, and knoweth not whither he goeth, because that darkness hath blinded his eyes.

\ln Itsvyowelaneha ditsiyoli itsisganvtsvyeno etsidolitsv nvtsulisdotanv Tsisa deudovi.
\syll ᎢᏨᏲᏪᎳᏁᎭ ᏗᏥᏲᎵ ᎢᏥᏍᎦᏅᏨᏰᏃ ᎡᏥᏙᎵᏨ ᏅᏧᎵᏍᏙᏔᏅ ᏥᏌ ᏕᎤᏙᎥᎢ.
\ft I write unto you, little children, because your sins are forgiven you for his name's sake.

\ln Itsvyowelaneha itsigayvligei, etsigadovsvyeno didalenisgv nvdagvwadalenvdv tseha.  Itsvyowelaneha itsiwinv, etsisegogisvyeno unegutsidv.  Itsvyowelaneha ditsiyoli, etsigadovsvyeno Agayvligei.
\syll ᎢᏨᏲᏪᎳᏁᎭ ᎢᏥᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ, ᎡᏥᎦᏙᎥᏒᏰᏃ ᏗᏓᎴᏂᏍᎬ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏤᎭ.  ᎢᏨᏲᏪᎳᏁᎭ ᎢᏥᏫᏅ, ᎡᏥᏎᎪᎩᏒᏰᏃ ᎤᏁᎫᏥᏛ.  ᎢᏨᏲᏪᎳᏁᎭ ᏗᏥᏲᎵ, ᎡᏥᎦᏙᎥᏒᏰᏃ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ.
\ft I write unto you, fathers, because ye have known him that is from the beginning. I write unto you, young men, because ye have overcome the wicked one. I write unto you, little children, because ye have known the Father.

\ln Itsvyowelasi itsigayvligei, etsigadovsvyeno didalenisgv nvdagvwadalenvdv tseha.  Itsvyowelasi itsiwinv, ditsalinigidiyuyeno, ale kanohedv Unelanvhi utseliga itsiyaa, ale etsisegogisv unetsutsidv.
\syll ᎢᏨᏲᏪᎳᏏ ᎢᏥᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ, ᎡᏥᎦᏙᎥᏒᏰᏃ ᏗᏓᎴᏂᏍᎬ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏤᎭ.  ᎢᏨᏲᏪᎳᏏ ᎢᏥᏫᏅ, ᏗᏣᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳᏰᏃ, ᎠᎴ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᎢᏥᏯᎠ, ᎠᎴ ᎡᏥᏎᎪᎩᏒ ᎤᏁᏧᏥᏛ.
\ft I have written unto you, fathers, because ye have known him that is from the beginning. I have written unto you, young men, because ye are strong, and the word of God abideth in you, and ye have overcome the wicked one.

\ln Tlesdi yitsigeyusesdi elohi, ale gohusdi elohi ehi.  Iyuno gilo elohi yugeyuha, vtla yigvwageyuha Agayvligei.
\syll ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏥᎨᏳᏎᏍᏗ ᎡᎶᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎡᎯ.  ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏳᎨᏳᎭ, ᎥᏝ ᏱᎬᏩᎨᏳᎭ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ.
\ft Love not the world, neither the things that are in the world. If any man love the world, the love of the Father is not in him.

\ln Tsinudaleyeno elohi tseha, ayelv udulvdi tsigi, ale tsvgadoli udolvdi tsigi, ale atlvquodi alenidasdiyi, nasgi vtla Agayvligesdvyi nvdayudalenvhi yigi, elohiquosgini udalenvhi.
\syll ᏥᏄᏓᎴᏰᏃ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏤᎭ, ᎠᏰᎸ ᎤᏚᎸᏗ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏨᎦᏙᎵ ᎤᏙᎸᏗ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏢᏉᏗ ᎠᎴᏂᏓᏍᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎥᏝ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᏍᏛᏱ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᏱᎩ, ᎡᎶᎯᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏓᎴᏅᎯ.
\ft For all that is in the world, the lust of the flesh, and the lust of the eyes, and the pride of life, is not of the Father, but is of the world.

\ln Ale elohi galosohvsga, ale nasgi nahna adulvdi gesvi, nasgisgini na Unelanvhi adanvtesgv tsulvwisdanehi nigohilv eha.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎦᎶᏐᎲᏍᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏀᎾ ᎠᏚᎸᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ Ꮎ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ ᏧᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎡᎭ.
\ft And the world passeth away, and the lust thereof: but he that doeth the will of God abideth for ever.

\ln ditsiyoli, hnaquo ulisqualvdi, itsadvganvhino tsigi uluhisdiyi galonedvatludisgi, ale gohi gesv unitsata galonedvanatludisgi; nasgi iyusdi idigataha ulisqualvdi gesvi.
\syll ᏗᏥᏲᎵ, ᎿᏉ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᎸᏗ, ᎢᏣᏛᎦᏅᎯᏃ ᏥᎩ ᎤᎷᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎦᎶᏁᏛᎠᏡᏗᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏂᏣᏔ ᎦᎶᏁᏛᎠᎾᏡᏗᏍᎩ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏗᎦᏔᎭ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᎸᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Little children, it is the last time: and as ye have heard that antichrist shall come, even now are there many antichrists; whereby we know that it is the last time.

\ln Gegadotsalaelvgi, aseno vtla nahna anela yigesei, iyuyeno nahna aneta yigesei, ase yinigvwanadvnei, aseno [unadotsalesvgi] gvnigesv iyunalisdodiyi nahna nigadv anela nigesvna gesvi.
\syll ᎨᎦᏙᏣᎳᎡᎸᎩ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏀᎾ ᎠᏁᎳ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ, ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᏀᎾ ᎠᏁᏔ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ, ᎠᏎ ᏱᏂᎬᏩᎾᏛᏁᎢ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᎾᏙᏣᎴᏒᎩdata is invalid ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏀᎾ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎠᏁᎳ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft They went out from us, but they were not of us; for if they had been of us, they would no doubt have continued with us: but they went out, that they might be made manifest that they were not all of us.

\ln Nihisgini nasganvna itsilonev, ale itsigatahiyu nigavi.
\syll ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎾᏍᎦᏅᎾ ᎢᏥᎶᏁᎥ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎯᏳ ᏂᎦᎥᎢ.
\ft But ye have an unction from the Holy One, and ye know all things.

\ln Hia tsitsvyowelasi vtla yinvdagalisdoda nitsigatahvna gesv duyugodvi, itsigatahiyusgini gesvi, ale itsigatahiyu gesv nigav gayegogi kanohedv duyugodv nvdayudalenvhi nigesvna gesvi.
\syll ᎯᎠ ᏥᏨᏲᏪᎳᏏ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏓ ᏂᏥᎦᏔᎲᎾ ᎨᏒ ᏚᏳᎪᏛᎢ, ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎯᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎯᏳ ᎨᏒ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎦᏰᎪᎩ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft I have not written unto you because ye know not the truth, but because ye know it, and that no lie is of the truth.

\ln Gago gayegogi, iyuno nasgi nigesvna yigi na adayihi Tsisa Galonedv gesvi.  Nasgi na galonedvatludisgi, adayihi Agayvligei ale Uwetsi.
\syll ᎦᎪ ᎦᏰᎪᎩ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏱᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᏓᏱᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ.  ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎦᎶᏁᏛᎠᏡᏗᏍᎩ, ᎠᏓᏱᎯ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏪᏥ.
\ft Who is a liar but he that denieth that Jesus is the Christ? He is antichrist, that denieth the Father and the Son.

\ln Gilo [Unelanvhi] Uwetsi adayihi, nasgi vtla yuweha Agayvligei; [nasgisgini na gohiyuhvsgi uwetsi nasgi uweha nasquo Agayvligei.]
\syll ᎩᎶ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯdata is invalid ᎤᏪᏥ ᎠᏓᏱᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎥᏝ ᏳᏪᎭ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ Ꮎ ᎪᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏪᎭ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ.data is invalid
\ft Whosoever denieth the Son, the same hath not the Father: (but) he that acknowledgeth the Son hath the Father also.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi didalenisgv nvdagvwadalenvdv tsitsadvgiha nasgi nihi itsiyaesdi.  Iyuno nasgi didalenisgv nvdagvwadalenvdv tsitsadvgiha itsiyaesdi, nihi nasquo etsiyaesdi Uwetsi ale Agayvligei.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏗᏓᎴᏂᏍᎬ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏥᏣᏛᎩᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏥᏯᎡᏍᏗ.  ᎢᏳᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏓᎴᏂᏍᎬ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏥᏣᏛᎩᎭ ᎢᏥᏯᎡᏍᏗ, ᏂᎯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎡᏥᏯᎡᏍᏗ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ.
\ft Let that therefore abide in you, which ye have heard from the beginning. If that which ye have heard from the beginning shall remain in you, ye also shall continue in the Son, and in the Father.

\ln Ale hia nasgi igiduisdanelvhi tsigi, nasgi alisquadisgi nigesvna gvnidv.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎩᏚᎢᏍᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎬᏂᏛ.
\ft And this is the promise that he hath promised us, even eternal life.

\ln Nasgi hia nusdi itsvyowelasi gatsineisdisgv nasgi na getsilidasdisgi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏍᏗ ᎢᏨᏲᏪᎳᏏ ᎦᏥᏁᎢᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎨᏥᎵᏓᏍᏗᏍᎩ.
\ft These things have I written unto you concerning them that seduce you.

\ln Nasgisgini Tsisa itsilonetanvhi gesv tsitsiyaa, ale udulvdi nitsalisdanehvna tsigi gilo itseyodiyi, nasgiyeno Tsisa itsilonetanvhi tsitseyohvsga nigavi, ale udohiyusv tsigi, ale gayegogi nigesvna tsigi, nasgiya nusdv itseyohvsgv etsiyaesdi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ ᏥᏌ ᎢᏥᎶᏁᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏥᏥᏯᎠ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏚᎸᏗ ᏂᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᎲᎾ ᏥᎩ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏤᏲᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎢᏥᎶᏁᏔᏅᎯ ᏥᏤᏲᎲᏍᎦ ᏂᎦᎥᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᏒ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᏰᎪᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎢᏤᏲᎲᏍᎬ ᎡᏥᏯᎡᏍᏗ.
\ft But the anointing which ye have received of him abideth in you, and ye need not that any man teach you: but as the same anointing teacheth you of all things, and is truth, and is no lie, and even as it hath taught you, ye shall abide in him.

\ln Ka, ditsiyoli, Tsisa etsiyaesdi, nasgino nahiyu gananugotsilvha nidinayesgvna gesesdi ale nidadehosgvna gesesdi agatahvi nahiyu galutsilvha.
\syll Ꭷ, ᏗᏥᏲᎵ, ᏥᏌ ᎡᏥᏯᎡᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏀᎢᏳ ᎦᎾᏄᎪᏥᎸᎭ ᏂᏗᎾᏰᏍᎬᎾ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏂᏓᏕᎰᏍᎬᎾ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎠᎦᏔᎲᎢ ᏀᎢᏳ ᎦᎷᏥᎸᎭ.
\ft And now, little children, abide in him; that, when he shall appear, we may have confidence, and not be ashamed before him at his coming.

\ln Iyuno yitsigataha nasganvna gesv Tsisa, itsigataha [nasquo] naniv duyugodv tsunilvwisdanehi nasgi tsunanugowisvhi gesvi.
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᏱᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᎾᏍᎦᏅᎾ ᎨᏒ ᏥᏌ, ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᎾᏍᏉdata is invalid ᎾᏂᎥ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᎾᏄᎪᏫᏒᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft If ye know that he is righteous, ye know that every one that doeth righteousness is born of him.

\ln Gvniyuquo nusquanigodi adageyudi gesv Agayvlige iginelv, nasgi unelanvhi tsuwetsi gayegosedi tsigi.  Elohi ayv nigigatahvna tsigi, nvdigalisdodiha nasgi nugatahvna tsigesvgi.
\syll ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᏄᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᎢᎩᏁᎸ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᏪᏥ ᎦᏰᎪᏎᏗ ᏥᎩ.  ᎡᎶᎯ ᎠᏴ ᏂᎩᎦᏔᎲᎾ ᏥᎩ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᎦᏔᎲᎾ ᏥᎨᏒᎩ.
\ft Behold, what manner of love the Father hath bestowed upon us, that we should be called the sons of God: therefore the world knoweth us not, because it knew him not.

\ln Itsvgeyui, hnaquo Unelanvhi tsuwetsi ayv, aseno vtla asi gvnigesv yinigalisdiha igalisdodi gesvi; aseno idigataha nahiyu gananugotsvha nasgiya nusdv nigasdesdi, nasgiyeno nusdv nasgi dayedigoi.
\syll ᎢᏨᎨᏳᎢ, ᎿᏉ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᏪᏥ ᎠᏴ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎠᏏ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏱᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᎭ ᎢᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎢᏗᎦᏔᎭ ᏀᎢᏳ ᎦᎾᏄᎪᏨᎭ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏂᎦᏍᏕᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏓᏰᏗᎪᎢ.
\ft Beloved, now are we the sons of God, and it doth not yet appear what we shall be: but we know that, when he shall appear, we shall be like him; for we shall see him as he is.

\ln Gilono nasgi hia tsinusdo udugi tsuwaso [Tsisa], uwasv adanvgalisgoi, nasgiya [tsisa] nunvgalvna tsigi nasgiya nadadvnehoi.
\syll ᎩᎶᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏄᏍᏙ ᎤᏚᎩ ᏧᏩᏐ ᏥᏌdata is invalid, ᎤᏩᏒ ᎠᏓᏅᎦᎵᏍᎪᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏥᏌdata is invalid ᏄᏅᎦᎸᎾ ᏥᎩ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏓᏛᏁᎰᎢ.
\ft And every man that hath this hope in him purifieth himself, even as he is pure.

\ln Gilo tsasganvgo ayosdisgo nasquo dikahnawadvsdi, asganiyeno ayosdisgi dikahnawadvsdi.
\syll ᎩᎶ ᏣᏍᎦᏅᎪ ᎠᏲᏍᏗᏍᎪ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ, ᎠᏍᎦᏂᏰᏃ ᎠᏲᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ.
\ft Whosoever committeth sin transgresseth also the law: for sin is the transgression of the law.

\ln Ale itsigataha nasgi gvnigesv nagvnelv igihvediyi igisganvtsvi; uwasvsgini vtla yuweha asgani.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎾᎬᏁᎸ ᎢᎩᎲᎡᏗᏱ ᎢᎩᏍᎦᏅᏨᎢ; ᎤᏩᏒᏍᎩᏂ ᎥᏝ ᏳᏪᎭ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ.
\ft And ye know that he was manifested to take away our sins; and in him is no sin.

\ln Gilo tsayao [Galonedvyi] vtla yasganvgoi; gilo tsasganvgoi vtla ugohvhi yigesoi, vtla ale ugadovsvhi yigesoi.
\syll ᎩᎶ ᏣᏯᎣ ᎦᎶᏁᏛᏱdata is invalid ᎥᏝ ᏯᏍᎦᏅᎪᎢ; ᎩᎶ ᏣᏍᎦᏅᎪᎢ ᎥᏝ ᎤᎪᎲᎯ ᏱᎨᏐᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎦᏙᎥᏒᎯ ᏱᎨᏐᎢ.
\ft Whosoever abideth in him sinneth not: whosoever sinneth hath not seen him, neither known him.

\ln Ditsiyoli tlesdi gilo yitsilonuhelesdi; duyugodv tsulvwisdanehi nasgi nasganvna, nasgiya [Galonedv] nasganvna tsigi.
\syll ᏗᏥᏲᎵ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎩᎶ ᏱᏥᎶᏄᎮᎴᏍᏗ; ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᏧᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᎦᏅᎾ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎦᎶᏁᏛdata is invalid ᎾᏍᎦᏅᎾ ᏥᎩ.
\ft Little children, let no man deceive you: he that doeth righteousness is righteous, even as he is righteous.

\ln Asgani tsulvwisdanehi, asgina nvdayudalenvhi gesoi, didalenisgvyeno nvdagvwadalenvdv asgina asganvgoi.  Nasgi iyusdi Unelanvhi Uwetsi gvnigesv nagvnelvgi, uyosdodiyi asgina dulvwisdanelvi.
\syll ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᏧᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ, ᎠᏍᎩᎾ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᎨᏐᎢ, ᏗᏓᎴᏂᏍᎬᏰᏃ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎠᏍᎩᎾ ᎠᏍᎦᏅᎪᎢ.  ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎾᎬᏁᎸᎩ, ᎤᏲᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎠᏍᎩᎾ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸᎢ.
\ft He that committeth sin is of the devil; for the devil sinneth from the beginning. For this purpose the Son of God was manifested, that he might destroy the works of the devil.

\ln Gilo Unelanvhi udetanvhi tsigeso vtla asgani yidulvwisdanehoi; nasgiyeno utseliga ugata uwehoi, vtla ale yeli gvwasganvisdi yigesoi, nvdigalisdodisgo Unelanvhi udetanvhi gesvi.
\syll ᎩᎶ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏕᏔᏅᎯ ᏥᎨᏐ ᎥᏝ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᏱᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎰᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᎤᎦᏔ ᎤᏪᎰᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᏰᎵ ᎬᏩᏍᎦᏅᎢᏍᏗ ᏱᎨᏐᎢ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎪ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏕᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Whosoever is born of God doth not commit sin; for his seed remaineth in him: and he cannot sin, because he is born of God.

\ln Hia nasgi nahna Unelanvhi tsuwetsi gvnigesv nanalisdiha, ale asgina tsuwetsi; gilo duyugodv tsulvwisdanehi nigesvna tsigesoi, vtla Unelanvhi nvdayudalenvhi yigesoi; ale dinadanvtli ugeyuhi nigesvna tsigesoi.
\syll ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏀᎾ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᏪᏥ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎾᎾᎵᏍᏗᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏍᎩᎾ ᏧᏪᏥ; ᎩᎶ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᏧᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏥᎨᏐᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᏱᎨᏐᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᏗᎾᏓᏅᏟ ᎤᎨᏳᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏥᎨᏐᎢ.
\ft In this the children of God are manifest, and the children of the devil: whosoever doeth not righteousness is not of God, neither he that loveth not his brother.

\ln Hiayeno nasgi kanohedv tsitsadvgiha didalenisgv nigetsadvgisgoi, nasgi digadageyuhi iyulisdodiyi.
\syll ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏥᏣᏛᎩᎭ ᏗᏓᎴᏂᏍᎬ ᏂᎨᏣᏛᎩᏍᎪᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎦᏓᎨᏳᎯ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
\ft For this is the message that ye heard from the beginning, that we should love one another.

\ln Vtla nasgi gena nudvnelvi, nasgi unegutsidv nvdayudalenvhi tsigesei, ale unvtli tsule.  Gadono iulei?  Nvdigalisdodisgesgini uwasv dulvwisdanehv uyoiyu gesvi, unvtlino dulvwisdanehv osiyu gesvi.
\syll ᎥᏝ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᎾ ᏄᏛᏁᎸᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎫᏥᏛ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᏥᎨᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏅᏟ ᏧᎴ.  ᎦᏙᏃ ᎢᎤᎴᎢ?  ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᎤᏲᎢᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᏅᏟᏃ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Not as Cain, who was of that wicked one, and slew his brother. And wherefore slew he him? Because his own works were evil, and his brother's righteous.

\ln Tlesdi yitsisquanigosgesdi, idadanvtli, iyuno elohi igisgagiyu igesesdi.
\syll ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏥᏍᏆᏂᎪᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎢᏓᏓᏅᏟ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎢᎩᏍᎦᎩᏳ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft Marvel not, my brethren, if the world hate you.

\ln Idigataha ayohuhisdi gesv igilosvi gvnidvno wiginanugotsvi, nvdigalisdodiha didigeyuhiyu gesv idadanvtli.  Gilo ugeyuhiyu nigesvna yigi dinadanvtli, ayohuhisdi gesv eha.
\syll ᎢᏗᎦᏔᎭ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᎩᎶᏒᎢ ᎬᏂᏛᏃ ᏫᎩᎾᏄᎪᏨᎢ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᏗᏗᎨᏳᎯᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏓᏓᏅᏟ.  ᎩᎶ ᎤᎨᏳᎯᏳ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏱᎩ ᏗᎾᏓᏅᏟ, ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎡᎭ.
\ft We know that we have passed from death unto life, because we love the brethren. He that loveth not his brother abideth in death.

\ln Gilo dinadanvtli asgagi yigi nasgi yvwi ahihi; itsigatahano yvwi ahihi gvnidv nuwehvna gesvi.
\syll ᎩᎶ ᏗᎾᏓᏅᏟ ᎠᏍᎦᎩ ᏱᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏴᏫ ᎠᎯᎯ; ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎭᏃ ᏴᏫ ᎠᎯᎯ ᎬᏂᏛ ᏄᏪᎲᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Whosoever hateth his brother is a murderer: and ye know that no murderer hath eternal life abiding in him.

\ln Ani idigo watiha udageyudi gesvi, nvdigalisdodiha gvnv eladi iginelvi, ale nasquo ayv dedvnv eladi yididineha idadanvtli.
\syll ᎠᏂ ᎢᏗᎪ ᏩᏘᎭ ᎤᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎬᏅ ᎡᎳᏗ ᎢᎩᏁᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏴ ᏕᏛᏅ ᎡᎳᏗ ᏱᏗᏗᏁᎭ ᎢᏓᏓᏅᏟ.
\ft Hereby perceive we the love of God, because he laid down his life for us: and we ought to lay down our lives for the brethren.

\ln Gilosgini elohi ehi alisdelvdodi gesv tsuwehoi, ale tsagowatisgo dinadanvtli unigvgvi, aseno nasgi tsasdunehoquo unawi, gado yigalisdoda yuweha Unelanvhi ageyudi gesvi?
\syll ᎩᎶᏍᎩᏂ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎡᎯ ᎠᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏧᏪᎰᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏣᎪᏩᏘᏍᎪ ᏗᎾᏓᏅᏟ ᎤᏂᎬᎬᎢ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏣᏍᏚᏁᎰᏉ ᎤᎾᏫ, ᎦᏙ ᏱᎦᎵᏍᏙᏓ ᏳᏪᎭ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ?
\ft But whoso hath this world's good, and seeth his brother have need, and shutteth up his bowels of compassion from him, how dwelleth the love of God in him?

\ln Ditsiyoli diquetsi, tlesdi idinegvquo ale didinogoiquo yididvdisgesdi yigadageyusesdi, degilvwisdanehvsgini ale udohiyusvi.
\syll ᏗᏥᏲᎵ ᏗᏇᏥ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᎢᏗᏁᎬᏉ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏗᏃᎪᎢᏉ ᏱᏗᏛᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏱᎦᏓᎨᏳᏎᏍᏗ, ᏕᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᏒᎢ.
\ft My little children, let us not love in word, neither in tongue; but in deed and in truth.

\ln Ale nasgi hia idadolehohisdiha duyugodv nvdagadalenvhi gesvi; dohiyino nidodadvneli diginawi nasgi agatahvi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎢᏓᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏗᎭ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᏅᏓᎦᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᏙᎯᏱᏃ ᏂᏙᏓᏛᏁᎵ ᏗᎩᎾᏫ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎦᏔᎲᎢ.
\ft And hereby we know that we are of the truth, and shall assure our hearts before him.

\ln Iyuyeno diginawi igisganvtsv yidigugodiha, Unelanvhi utli galvquodiyu esgaquo diginawi, ale agatahiyu nigavi.
\syll ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᏗᎩᎾᏫ ᎢᎩᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᏱᏗᎫᎪᏗᎭ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏟ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᏗᎩᎾᏫ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎦᏔᎯᏳ ᏂᎦᎥᎢ.
\ft For if our heart condemn us, God is greater than our heart, and knoweth all things.

\ln Itsvgeyui, iyuno diginawi nidigugodanehvna yigi, ugalisdiyu igadanvta unelanvhi edadanvtesgvi;
\syll ᎢᏨᎨᏳᎢ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᏗᎩᎾᏫ ᏂᏗᎫᎪᏓᏁᎲᎾ ᏱᎩ, ᎤᎦᎵᏍᏗᏳ ᎢᎦᏓᏅᏔ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎡᏓᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬᎢ;
\ft Beloved, if our heart condemn us not, then have we confidence toward God.

\ln Ale nigav gohusdi iditayoha iginehoi, nvdigalisdodisgo igisquanigodv utseliga dikahnawadvsdi, ale degilvwidanehv nasgi osdv uyelvdi gesv degikanvi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎢᏗᏔᏲᎭ ᎢᎩᏁᎰᎢ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎪ ᎢᎩᏍᏆᏂᎪᏛ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᎩᎸᏫᏓᏁᎲ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎤᏰᎸᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏕᎩᎧᏅᎢ.
\ft And whatsoever we ask, we receive of him, because we keep his commandments, and do those things that are pleasing in his sight.

\ln Nasgino hia nusdi utseliga dikahnawadvsdi, igohiyudiyi deudov Uwetsi Tsisa Galonedv, ale digadageyuhi iyulisdodiyi nasgiya iginetselvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏍᏗ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ, ᎢᎪᎯᏳᏗᏱ ᏕᎤᏙᎥ ᎤᏪᏥ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎦᏓᎨᏳᎯ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎢᎩᏁᏤᎸᎢ.
\ft And this is his commandment, That we should believe on the name of his Son Jesus Christ, and love one another, as he gave us commandment.

\ln Gilono nasgi utseliga dikahnawadvsdi asquanigodisgi nasgi ayaoi [Unelanvhiyi], ale nasgi uyaoi [Unelanvhi].  Ale adanvdo iginelvhi gesv nasgi idadolehohisdiha ayv igiyavi.
\syll ᎩᎶᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎠᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏯᎣᎢ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏱdata is invalid, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏯᎣᎢ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯdata is invalid.  ᎠᎴ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎢᎩᏁᎸᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏓᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏗᎭ ᎠᏴ ᎢᎩᏯᎥᎢ.
\ft And he that keepeth his commandments dwelleth in him, and he in him. And hereby we know that he abideth in us, by the Spirit which he hath given us.

\ln Itsvgeyui, tlesdi naniv didanvdo yiditsohiyuhvsgesdi, detsigoliyesgesdisgini didanvdo, Unelanvhi nvdayudalenvhi gesv, ale Unelanvhi nvdayu dalenvhi nigesvna gesvi.  Unitsatayeno unatlonasdi anadolehosgi anedoha elohi.
\syll ᎢᏨᎨᏳᎢ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏗᏓᏅᏙ ᏱᏗᏦᎯᏳᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᏕᏥᎪᎵᏰᏍᎨᏍᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᏗᏓᏅᏙ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᎨᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏅᏓᏳ ᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.  ᎤᏂᏣᏔᏰᏃ ᎤᎾᏠᎾᏍᏗ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎠᏁᏙᎭ ᎡᎶᎯ.
\ft Beloved, believe not every spirit, but try the spirits whether they are of God: because many false prophets are gone out into the world.

\ln Hia nasgi nusdi itsolisdodi Unelanvhi utseli Adanvdo; nasgi adanvdo hia igawesgi, Tsisa Galonedv uquedali unanugotsilei, nasgi Unelanvhi nvdayudalenvhi.
\syll ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏗ ᎢᏦᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎯᎠ ᎢᎦᏪᏍᎩ, ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏥᎴᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ.
\ft Hereby know ye the Spirit of God: Every spirit that confesseth that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh is of God:

\ln Nasgino adanvdo hia igawesgi nigesvna, Tsisa Galonedv uquedali unanugotsilei, vtla Unelanvhi nvdayudalenvhi yigi.  Nasgisgini hia galonedvatludisgi utseliga adanvdo, nasgi uluhisdiyi itsadvganvhi tsigi, ale hnaquo gayula elohi eha.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎯᎠ ᎢᎦᏪᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏥᎴᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᏱᎩ.  ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ ᎯᎠ ᎦᎶᏁᏛᎠᏡᏗᏍᎩ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎷᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎢᏣᏛᎦᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎿᏉ ᎦᏳᎳ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎡᎭ.
\ft And every spirit that confesseth not that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh is not of God: and this is that spirit of antichrist, whereof ye have heard that it should come; and even now already is it in the world.

\ln Nihi Unelanvhi nvdatsadalenvhi, ditsiyoli, ale detsisegogisv nasgi; nvdigalisdodiha utli ulinidigidiyu gesv itsiyai esgaquo elohi ayai.
\syll ᏂᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏅᏓᏣᏓᎴᏅᎯ, ᏗᏥᏲᎵ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᏥᏎᎪᎩᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ; ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎤᏟ ᎤᎵᏂᏗᎩᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏥᏯᎢ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎠᏯᎢ.
\ft Ye are of God, little children, and have overcome them: because greater is he that is in you, than he that is in the world.

\ln Elohi nvdayunadalenvhi nasgi, nasgi iyusdi elohi ehi aniwoniha, ale elohi unadvganehoi.
\syll ᎡᎶᎯ ᏅᏓᏳᎾᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎡᎯ ᎠᏂᏬᏂᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏁᎰᎢ.
\ft They are of the world: therefore speak they of the world, and the world heareth them.

\ln Ayv Unelanvhi nvdayogadalenvhi; nasgi na Unelanvhi agatahi ogadvganehoi.  Nano Unelanvhi nvdayudalenvhi nigesvna vtla yogadvganehoi.  Nasgi nvdigalisdodiha dedigataha duyugodv iyanadvnehi adanvdo, ale duyugodv iyasadvnehi nigesvna didanvdo.
\syll ᎠᏴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏅᏓᏲᎦᏓᎴᏅᎯ; ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎦᏔᎯ ᎣᎦᏛᎦᏁᎰᎢ.  ᎾᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎥᏝ ᏲᎦᏛᎦᏁᎰᎢ.  ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᏕᏗᎦᏔᎭ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎢᏯᎾᏛᏁᎯ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎢᏯᏌᏛᏁᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏗᏓᏅᏙ.
\ft We are of God: he that knoweth God heareth us; he that is not of God heareth not us. Hereby know we the spirit of truth, and the spirit of error.

\ln Itsvgeyui, degadageyusesdi; adageyudiyeno gesv Unelanvhi udayudalenvhi, gilono tsudageyuso Unelanvhi unanugowisvhi gesoi, ale agataho Unelanvhi.
\syll ᎢᏨᎨᏳᎢ, ᏕᎦᏓᎨᏳᏎᏍᏗ; ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗᏰᏃ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ, ᎩᎶᏃ ᏧᏓᎨᏳᏐ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏫᏒᎯ ᎨᏐᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎦᏔᎰ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ.
\ft Beloved, let us love one another: for love is of God; and every one that loveth is born of God, and knoweth God.

\ln Udageyuhino nigesvna, vtla yagataho Unelanvhi; Unelanvhiyeno udageyudi gesv dudov.
\syll ᎤᏓᎨᏳᎯᏃ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎥᏝ ᏯᎦᏔᎰ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ; ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ ᎤᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏚᏙᎥ.
\ft He that loveth not knoweth not God; for God is love.

\ln Ani hia gvnigesv nulistanvgi Unelanvhi igigeyusvi, Unelanvhiyeno tsunvse uwasvhiyu udenelvhi Uwetsi elohi uluhisdiyi, nasgi iyuwanisodiyi gvnidv igiwadvdiyi.
\syll ᎠᏂ ᎯᎠ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᎩᎨᏳᏒᎢ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ ᏧᏅᏎ ᎤᏩᏒᎯᏳ ᎤᏕᏁᎸᎯ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎤᎷᎯᏍᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏐᏗᏱ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎢᎩᏩᏛᏗᏱ.
\ft In this was manifested the love of God toward us, because that God sent his only begotten Son into the world, that we might live through him.

\ln Ani hia adageyudi gesvi, vtla Unelanvhi edigeyuiyu nulistanvi, ayvsgini igigeyuhiyu nulistanvi, ale tsunvsv utseliga Uwetsi alisgolvtanvhi aguyvdodi igisgastsvi.
\syll ᎠᏂ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎡᏗᎨᏳᎢᏳ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎢ, ᎠᏴᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᎩᎨᏳᎯᏳ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏅᏒ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎠᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏅᎯ ᎠᎫᏴᏙᏗ ᎢᎩᏍᎦᏍᏨᎢ.
\ft Herein is love, not that we loved God, but that he loved us, and sent his Son to be the propitiation for our sins.

\ln Itsvgeyui, iyuno Unelanvhi nasgi igai igigeyuhiyu iyulistanvhi yigi, ayv nasquo digadageyuhiyu yigi.
\syll ᎢᏨᎨᏳᎢ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎢᎩᎨᏳᎯᏳ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏗᎦᏓᎨᏳᎯᏳ ᏱᎩ.
\ft Beloved, if God so loved us, we ought also to love one another.

\ln Vtla ilvhiyu gilo Unelanvhi ugohvhi yigi.  Iyuno digadageyuhiyu yigi, Unelanvhi igiyaa, ale ayv edigeyusv ukalitsvhi gesoi.
\syll ᎥᏝ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎪᎲᎯ ᏱᎩ.  ᎢᏳᏃ ᏗᎦᏓᎨᏳᎯᏳ ᏱᎩ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᎩᏯᎠ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴ ᎡᏗᎨᏳᏒ ᎤᎧᎵᏨᎯ ᎨᏐᎢ.
\ft No man hath seen God at any time. If we love one another, God dwelleth in us, and his love is perfected in us.

\ln Hia nasgi idadolehohisdiha ediyavi ale ayv igiyavi, nasgi nvdigalisdodisgv igalisgolvdanelvhi gesv uwasv utseli Adanvdo.
\syll ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏓᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏗᎭ ᎡᏗᏯᎥᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴ ᎢᎩᏯᎥᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬ ᎢᎦᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ.
\ft Hereby know we that we dwell in him, and he in us, because he hath given us of his Spirit.

\ln Ale ayv ogigohv ale otsinoheha Agayvlige tsunvsv Uwetsi elohi Asdelisgi iyulisdodiyi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴ ᎣᎩᎪᎲ ᎠᎴ ᎣᏥᏃᎮᎭ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᏧᏅᏒ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎠᏍᏕᎵᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
\ft And we have seen and do testify that the Father sent the Son to be the Saviour of the world.

\ln Gilo hia igawesgi Tsisa Unelanvhi Uwetsi gesvi, nasgi Unelanvhi oyaoi, ale nasgi Unelanvhiyi ayaoi.
\syll ᎩᎶ ᎯᎠ ᎢᎦᏪᏍᎩ ᏥᏌ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎣᏯᎣᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏱ ᎠᏯᎣᎢ.
\ft Whosoever shall confess that Jesus is the Son of God, God dwelleth in him, and he in God.

\ln Ale ayv igigadovsv ale igohiyunv Unelanvhi igigeyuhiyu gesvi.  Unelanvhi adageyudi gesv dudov, adageyudino gesv ehi Unalanvhi ayaoi, ale Unalanvhi nasgi uyaoi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴ ᎢᎩᎦᏙᎥᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎢᎪᎯᏳᏅ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᎩᎨᏳᎯᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ.  ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏚᏙᎥ, ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗᏃ ᎨᏒ ᎡᎯ ᎤᎾᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᏯᎣᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᎳᏅᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏯᎣᎢ.
\ft And we have known and believed the love that God hath to us. God is love; and he that dwelleth in love dwelleth in God, and God in him.

\ln Ani hia igadageyudi gesv ukalitsvhi, nulistanv nasgi nidinayesgvna iyulisdodiyi digugododiyi iga gesesdi, nvdigalisdodiha nasgiya nusdv nasquo nasgi nigasdi ayv ani elohi.
\syll ᎠᏂ ᎯᎠ ᎢᎦᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎧᎵᏨᎯ, ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᏗᎾᏰᏍᎬᎾ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏗᎫᎪᏙᏗᏱ ᎢᎦ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᏍᏗ ᎠᏴ ᎠᏂ ᎡᎶᎯ.
\ft Herein is our love made perfect, that we may have boldness in the day of judgment: because as he is, so are we in this world.

\ln Vtla ganayehisdi gesv yudasuya adageyudi gesvi, ukalitsvhisgini gesv adageyudi ganugowisga ganayehisdi gesvi; ganayehisdiyeno gesv agiliya uweha; gilo tsiganayesgoi vtla ukalitsvhi yigeso adageyudi gesvi.
\syll ᎥᏝ ᎦᎾᏰᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏳᏓᏑᏯ ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᎧᎵᏨᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎦᏄᎪᏫᏍᎦ ᎦᎾᏰᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎦᎾᏰᎯᏍᏗᏰᏃ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎩᎵᏯ ᎤᏪᎭ; ᎩᎶ ᏥᎦᎾᏰᏍᎪᎢ ᎥᏝ ᎤᎧᎵᏨᎯ ᏱᎨᏐ ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft There is no fear in love; but perfect love casteth out fear: because fear hath torment. He that feareth is not made perfect in love.

\ln Edigeyua nasgi nvdigalisdodiha ayv igvyi igigeyuhiyu nulistanvi.
\syll ᎡᏗᎨᏳᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎠᏴ ᎢᎬᏱ ᎢᎩᎨᏳᎯᏳ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎢ.
\ft We love him, because he first loved us.

\ln Iyuno gilo Unelanvhi tsigeyua yadiha, yasgagano dinadanvtli, gayegogi nasgi, ugeyuhiyeno nigesvna yigi dinadanvtli nasgi ugohvhi, gado yigalisdoda ugeyuhiyu yigi Unelanvhi ugohvhi nigesvna gesvi.
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏥᎨᏳᎠ ᏯᏗᎭ, ᏯᏍᎦᎦᏃ ᏗᎾᏓᏅᏟ, ᎦᏰᎪᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ, ᎤᎨᏳᎯᏰᏃ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏱᎩ ᏗᎾᏓᏅᏟ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎪᎲᎯ, ᎦᏙ ᏱᎦᎵᏍᏙᏓ ᎤᎨᏳᎯᏳ ᏱᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎪᎲᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft If a man say, I love God, and hateth his brother, he is a liar: for he that loveth not his brother whom he hath seen, how can he love God whom he hath not seen?

\ln Hiano nasgi dikahnawadvsdi iginelvhi, nasgi iyuno gilo ugeyuhiyu gesesdi Unelanvhi, nasquo ugeyuhiyu gesesdi dinadanvtli.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎢᎩᏁᎸᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎤᎨᏳᎯᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᎨᏳᎯᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏗᎾᏓᏅᏟ.
\ft And this commandment have we from him, That he who loveth God love his brother also.

\ln Gilo yigohiyuhvsga Tsisa nasgi Galonedv gesvi, nasgi Unelanvhi udetanvhi, gilono yugeyuha udananugowisvhi, nasquo atsinanugowisvhi ugeyuhiyu gesoi.
\syll ᎩᎶ ᏱᎪᎯᏳᎲᏍᎦ ᏥᏌ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏕᏔᏅᎯ, ᎩᎶᏃ ᏳᎨᏳᎭ ᎤᏓᎾᏄᎪᏫᏒᎯ, ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏥᎾᏄᎪᏫᏒᎯ ᎤᎨᏳᎯᏳ ᎨᏐᎢ.
\ft Whosoever believeth that Jesus is the Christ is born of God: and every one that loveth him that begat loveth him also that is begotten of him.

\ln Unelanvhi edigeyui tsigesoi, ale tsigisquanigodo utseliga dikahnawadvsdi, nasgi idadolehohisdisgo gedigeyuiyu gesv Unelanvhi tsuwetsi.
\syll ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎡᏗᎨᏳᎢ ᏥᎨᏐᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᎩᏍᏆᏂᎪᏙ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏓᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏗᏍᎪ ᎨᏗᎨᏳᎢᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᏪᏥ.
\ft By this we know that we love the children of God, when we love God, and keep his commandments.

\ln Nasgiyeno hia nusdi Unelanvhi ageyudi gesvi, nasgi digisquanigododiyi tsutseli dikahnawadvsdi; utselino dikahnawadvsdi vtla gagediyu yigi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎩᏍᏆᏂᎪᏙᏗᏱ ᏧᏤᎵ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ; ᎤᏤᎵᏃ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎥᏝ ᎦᎨᏗᏳ ᏱᎩ.
\ft For this is the love of God, that we keep his commandments: and his commandments are not grievous.

\ln Nigavyeno gohusdi Unelanvhi udetanvhi asegogisgo elohi.  Igohiyusvno nasgi asegogisgi elohi.
\syll ᏂᎦᎥᏰᏃ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏕᏔᏅᎯ ᎠᏎᎪᎩᏍᎪ ᎡᎶᎯ.  ᎢᎪᎯᏳᏒᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏎᎪᎩᏍᎩ ᎡᎶᎯ.
\ft For whatsoever is born of God overcometh the world: and this is the victory that overcometh the world, even our faith.

\ln Gago na elohi asegogisgi iyuno nasgi nigesvna yigi nasgi na gohiyuhvsgi Tsisa Unelanvhi Uwetsi gesvi?
\syll ᎦᎪ Ꮎ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎠᏎᎪᎩᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏱᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎪᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᏥᏌ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎨᏒᎢ?
\ft Who is he that overcometh the world, but he that believeth that Jesus is the Son of God?

\ln Nasgi ama ale gigv uluhistanvhi, hia Tsisa Galonedv; vtla amaquo uwasv, amasgini ale gigv.  Gvwatloyasdi ale Adanvdo nasgi kanohesgi, Adanvdoyeno gayigogi nigesvna.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎹ ᎠᎴ ᎩᎬ ᎤᎷᎯᏍᏔᏅᎯ, ᎯᎠ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ; ᎥᏝ ᎠᎹᏉ ᎤᏩᏒ, ᎠᎹᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᎴ ᎩᎬ.  ᎬᏩᏠᏯᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎧᏃᎮᏍᎩ, ᎠᏓᏅᏙᏰᏃ ᎦᏱᎪᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.
\ft This is he that came by water and blood, even Jesus Christ; not by water only, but by water and blood. And it is the Spirit that beareth witness, because the Spirit is truth.

\ln Anitsoiyeno aninohesgi galvladi; Agayvligei, kanohedv, galvquodiyuno adanvdo; nasgino hia anitsoi gesv saquoquo.
\syll ᎠᏂᏦᎢᏰᏃ ᎠᏂᏃᎮᏍᎩ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ; ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ, ᎧᏃᎮᏛ, ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳᏃ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ; ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏂᏦᎢ ᎨᏒ ᏌᏉᏉ.
\ft For there are three that bear record in heaven, the Father, the Word, and the Holy Ghost: and these three are one.

\ln Anitsoino aninohesgi elohi, adanvdo, ama, ale gigv, nasgino hia anitsoi gesv utloyi aninoheha.
\syll ᎠᏂᏦᎢᏃ ᎠᏂᏃᎮᏍᎩ ᎡᎶᎯ, ᎠᏓᏅᏙ, ᎠᎹ, ᎠᎴ ᎩᎬ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏂᏦᎢ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏠᏱ ᎠᏂᏃᎮᎭ.
\ft And there are three that bear witness in earth, the spirit, and the water, and the blood: and these three agree in one.

\ln Iyuno yididiniyiha yvwi uninohelvhi, Unelanvhi unohelvhi utli galvquodiyu; hiayeno nasgi Unelanvhi unohelvhi, nasgi uneistanvhi tsigi Uwetsi.
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᏱᏗᏗᏂᏱᎭ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏂᏃᎮᎸᎯ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏃᎮᎸᎯ ᎤᏟ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ; ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏃᎮᎸᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎢᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎤᏪᏥ.
\ft If we receive the witness of men, the witness of God is greater: for this is the witness of God which he hath testified of his Son.

\ln Gohiyuhvsgi Unelanvhi Uwetsi nasgi uwasv gesv uweha gohiyudisgi; Unelanvhi gohiyuhvsgi nigesvna, nasgi Unelanvhi uyegonv, nvdigali sdodiha nigohiyuhvsgvna gesv Unelanvhi unohelvi Uwetsi uneistanvi.
\syll ᎪᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏪᎭ ᎪᎯᏳᏗᏍᎩ; ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎪᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏰᎪᏅ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵ ᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᏂᎪᎯᏳᎲᏍᎬᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏃᎮᎸᎢ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎤᏁᎢᏍᏔᏅᎢ.
\ft He that believeth on the Son of God hath the witness in himself: he that believeth not God hath made him a liar; because he believeth not the record that God gave of his Son.

\ln Hiano nasgi nusdi kanohelvhi gesvi, nasgi Unelanvhi iginelv winasdvna gvnidv, ale nasgi hia gvnidv Uwetsi utseliga gesvi.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏗ ᎧᏃᎮᎸᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᎩᏁᎸ ᏫᎾᏍᏛᎾ ᎬᏂᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft And this is the record, that God hath given to us eternal life, and this life is in his Son.

\ln Gilo Unelanvhi Uwetsi uwehi, nasgi gvnidv uweha; Unelanvhino Uwetsi nuwehvna vtla yuweha gvnidv.
\syll ᎩᎶ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎤᏪᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎤᏪᎭ; ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏃ ᎤᏪᏥ ᏄᏪᎲᎾ ᎥᏝ ᏳᏪᎭ ᎬᏂᏛ.
\ft He that hath the Son hath life; and he that hath not the Son of God hath not life.

\ln Nasgi hia nusdi itsvyowelasi itsohiyuhvsgi dudov Unelanvhi uwetsi, itsadolehohisdiyi gvnidv itsehvi gesvi, ale itsohiyudiyi dudov Unelanvhi uwetsi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏍᏗ ᎢᏨᏲᏪᎳᏏ ᎢᏦᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᏚᏙᎥ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏪᏥ, ᎢᏣᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎢᏤᎲᎢ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏦᎯᏳᏗᏱ ᏚᏙᎥ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏪᏥ.
\ft These things have I written unto you that believe on the name of the Son of God; that ye may know that ye have eternal life, and that ye may believe on the name of the Son of God.

\ln Ale nasgi hia nusdi edoiyusvi, nasgi iyuno nigav gohusdi editayosi osdv uyelvdi gesvi, igadvganehvi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏍᏗ ᎡᏙᎢᏳᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏃ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎡᏗᏔᏲᏏ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎤᏰᎸᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎢᎦᏛᎦᏁᎲᎢ.
\ft And this is the confidence that we have in him, that, if we ask any thing according to his will, he heareth us:

\ln Iyuno yidigataha igadvnehvi, nigav gohusdi editayosi idigataho iginehv iyusdi editayoselvi.
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᏱᏗᎦᏔᎭ ᎢᎦᏛᏁᎲᎢ, ᏂᎦᎥ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎡᏗᏔᏲᏏ ᎢᏗᎦᏔᎰ ᎢᎩᏁᎲ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎡᏗᏔᏲᏎᎸᎢ.
\ft And if we know that he hear us, whatsoever we ask, we know that we have the petitions that we desired of him.

\ln Iyuno gilo yugohv dinadanvtli yusganvtsv ayohuhisdi nigesvna asganvisdi gesvi, nasgi atayohihesdi ale ase gvnidv dayetsineli ayohuhisdi nigesvna unisganvtsvhi nvdigalisdodisgvi.  Eha asganvisdi ayohuhisdi gesvi, vtla atayohihesdi nasgi atsidolisdiyi yigadiha.
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᏳᎪᎲ ᏗᎾᏓᏅᏟ ᏳᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎠᏍᎦᏅᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏔᏲᎯᎮᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏎ ᎬᏂᏛ ᏓᏰᏥᏁᎵ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎤᏂᏍᎦᏅᏨᎯ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬᎢ.  ᎡᎭ ᎠᏍᎦᏅᎢᏍᏗ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᏔᏲᎯᎮᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏥᏙᎵᏍᏗᏱ ᏱᎦᏗᎭ.
\ft If any man see his brother sin a sin which is not unto death, he shall ask, and he shall give him life for them that sin not unto death. There is a sin unto death: I do not say that he shall pray for it.

\ln Nigav duyugodv nigesvna nasgi asgani, ehano asganvisdi gesv ayohuhisdi nigesvna.
\syll ᏂᎦᎥ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ, ᎡᎭᏃ ᎠᏍᎦᏅᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.
\ft All unrighteousness is sin: and there is a sin not unto death.

\ln Idigataha gilo Unelanvhi udetanvhi tsigesoi vtla yasganvgoi, Unelanvhisgini udetanvhi ulisquanigodoi, nasgino na unegutsidv vtla yusvnihoi.
\syll ᎢᏗᎦᏔᎭ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏕᏔᏅᎯ ᏥᎨᏐᎢ ᎥᏝ ᏯᏍᎦᏅᎪᎢ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏕᏔᏅᎯ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᏂᎪᏙᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ Ꮎ ᎤᏁᎫᏥᏛ ᎥᏝ ᏳᏒᏂᎰᎢ.
\ft We know that whosoever is born of God sinneth not; but he that is begotten of God keepeth himself, and that wicked one toucheth him not.

\ln Idigataha Unelanvhi nvdagadalenvhi gesvi, ale nigvnadv elohi unoyvtsv uyo gesvi.
\syll ᎢᏗᎦᏔᎭ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏅᏓᎦᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎬᎾᏛ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎤᏃᏴᏨ ᎤᏲ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft And we know that we are of God, and the whole world lieth in wickedness.

\ln Idigatahano Unelanvhi Uwetsi ulutsvi, ale iginelv igolisdiyi, nasgi edolisdiyi nasgi gayegogi nigesvna tsigi; ale nasgi ediyaa gayegogi nigesvna tsigi, nasgi Uwetsi Tsisa Galonedv.  Nasgi hia udohiyuhiya Unelanvhi, ale winasdvna gvnidv.
\syll ᎢᏗᎦᏔᎭᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎤᎷᏨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᎩᏁᎸ ᎢᎪᎵᏍᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᏙᎵᏍᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏰᎪᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏥᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᏗᏯᎠ ᎦᏰᎪᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏪᏥ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ.  ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏫᎾᏍᏛᎾ ᎬᏂᏛ.
\ft And we know that the Son of God is come, and hath given us an understanding, that we may know him that is true, and we are in him that is true, even in his Son Jesus Christ. This is the true God, and eternal life.

\ln Ditsiyoli, detseyadotsehesdi Unelanvhi diyelvhi.  Emenv.
\syll ᏗᏥᏲᎵ, ᏕᏤᏯᏙᏤᎮᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏗᏰᎸᎯ.  ᎡᎺᏅ.
\ft Little children, keep yourselves from idols. Amen.

\ln Ayv aquadvsonvhi witsiyoliga agasuyedv ageyv ale nasgi tsuwetsi, nasgi gatsigeyui duyugodv gesvi, ale vtla aquvsvquo yigi nasquosgini nigadv unigadovsvhi duyugodv gesvi;
\syll ᎠᏴ ᎠᏆᏛᏐᏅᎯ ᏫᏥᏲᎵᎦ ᎠᎦᏑᏰᏛ ᎠᎨᏴ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏪᏥ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏥᎨᏳᎢ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᎠᏋᏒᏉ ᏱᎩ ᎾᏍᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎤᏂᎦᏙᎥᏒᎯ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ;
\ft The elder unto the elect lady and her children, whom I love in the truth; and not I only, but also all they that have known the truth;

\ln Nvdigalisdodiha nasgi duyugodv gesv tsigiyaa, ale nasgi ase tsigeladidohesdi nigohilvi.
\syll ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒ ᏥᎩᏯᎠ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏎ ᏥᎨᎳᏗᏙᎮᏍᏗ ᏂᎪᎯᎸᎢ.
\ft For the truth's sake, which dwelleth in us, and shall be with us for ever.

\ln Gvwagadiya udadolisdi gesvi itseladidohesdi ale udadolisdi gesvi ale nvwadohiyadv gesvi, nvdayunalisgolvtanvhi Unelanvhi Agayvligei ale Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv Agayvlige Uwetsi, duyugodv gesvi ale adageyudi gesvi.
\syll ᎬᏩᎦᏗᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ ᎢᏤᎳᏗᏙᎮᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ ᎠᎴ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏅᏓᏳᎾᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏅᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᎤᏪᏥ, ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Grace be with you, mercy, and peace, from God the Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, in truth and love.

\ln Utsatanvhi aqualihelitsvgi aquadolehosv igadv ditsetsi duyugodv gesv anaisvi, nasgiya dikahnawadvsdi iginelv Agayvligei.
\syll ᎤᏣᏔᏅᎯ ᎠᏆᎵᎮᎵᏨᎩ ᎠᏆᏙᎴᎰᏒ ᎢᎦᏛ ᏗᏤᏥ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎾᎢᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎢᎩᏁᎸ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ.
\ft I rejoiced greatly that I found of thy children walking in truth, as we have received a commandment from the Father.

\ln Hnaquono gvtayoseha higeyv, digaligeyuhi iyulisdodiyi; vtla adina itse dikahnawadvsdi tsigvyowelaneho iyusdi yigi, nasgiquosgini tsinegihoi, digadageyuhi iyulisdodiyi.
\syll ᎿᏉᏃ ᎬᏔᏲᏎᎭ ᎯᎨᏴ, ᏗᎦᎵᎨᏳᎯ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ; ᎥᏝ ᎠᏗᎾ ᎢᏤ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏥᎬᏲᏪᎳᏁᎰ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏱᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᏥᏁᎩᎰᎢ, ᏗᎦᏓᎨᏳᎯ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
\ft And now I beseech thee, lady, not as though I wrote a new commandment unto thee, but that which we had from the beginning, that we love one another.

\ln Ale nasgi hia nusdi adageyudi gesvi, nasgi igedasdiyi nasgiya dikahnawadvsdi utseliga nigawesgvi.  Nasgi hia dikahnawadvsdi didalenisgv nvdagvwadalenvdv tsinetsadvgisgoi, nasgi ditsikahnawadvsdiyi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏍᏗ ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎨᏓᏍᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎬᎢ.  ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏗᏓᎴᏂᏍᎬ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏥᏁᏣᏛᎩᏍᎪᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏥᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗᏱ.
\ft And this is love, that we walk after his commandments. This is the commandment, That, as ye have heard from the beginning, ye should walk in it.

\ln Unitsatayeno utlonasdi anedoha elohi, nasgi anohiyuhvsgi nigesvna Tsisa Galonedv uquedali unanugotsilvi; nasgi hia utlonasdi ale galonedvatludisgi.
\syll ᎤᏂᏣᏔᏰᏃ ᎤᏠᎾᏍᏗ ᎠᏁᏙᎭ ᎡᎶᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏥᎸᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎤᏠᎾᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎦᎶᏁᏛᎠᏡᏗᏍᎩ.
\ft For many deceivers are entered into the world, who confess not that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh. This is a deceiver and an antichrist.

\ln Itseyatahesdi tlesdi yigiyohuselesdi degilvwisdanelvi, idiwadvhvquosgini ukalitsvhi egaguyvdanedi.
\syll ᎢᏤᏯᏔᎮᏍᏗ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᎩᏲᎱᏎᎴᏍᏗ ᏕᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸᎢ, ᎢᏗᏩᏛᎲᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᎧᎵᏨᎯ ᎡᎦᎫᏴᏓᏁᏗ.
\ft Look to yourselves, that we lose not those things which we have wrought, but that we receive a full reward.

\ln gilo tsasganvgoi ale nidakahnawadegvna tsigeso galonedv tsudeyonvhi, nasgi vtla unelanvi yuwehoi.  nasuligogvnasgini na dakanawadisv dikahnawadegi galonedv tsudeyonvhi, nasgi duweha itsula agayvlige ale uwetsi.
\syll ᎩᎶ ᏣᏍᎦᏅᎪᎢ ᎠᎴ ᏂᏓᎧᎿᏩᏕᎬᎾ ᏥᎨᏐ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏧᏕᏲᏅᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎢ ᏳᏪᎰᎢ.  ᎾᏑᎵᎪᎬᎾᏍᎩᏂ Ꮎ ᏓᎧᎾᏩᏗᏒ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏕᎩ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏧᏕᏲᏅᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᏪᎭ ᎢᏧᎳ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏪᏥ.
\ft Whosoever transgresseth, and abideth not in the doctrine of Christ, hath not God. He that abideth in the doctrine of Christ, he hath both the Father and the Son.

\ln Iyuno gilo yitsilutselv ale nuyolvna yigi hia nasgi dideyodi gesvi, tlesdi detsinelv yidetsalinilvtsesdi, ale tlesdi yetsiyolilesdi;
\syll ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᏱᏥᎷᏤᎸ ᎠᎴ ᏄᏲᎸᎾ ᏱᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏕᏲᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᏕᏥᏁᎸ ᏱᏕᏣᎵᏂᎸᏤᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏰᏥᏲᎵᎴᏍᏗ;
\ft If there come any unto you, and bring not this doctrine, receive him not into your house, neither bid him God speed:

\ln Nasgiyeno na ayolihi uweladisdiha uyo dulvwisdanehvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ Ꮎ ᎠᏲᎵᎯ ᎤᏪᎳᏗᏍᏗᎭ ᎤᏲ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎢ.
\ft For he that biddeth him God speed is partaker of his evil deeds.

\ln Utsadvgi iyudalegi itsvyowelanedi agihvgi, aseno vtla goweliquo ale digowelodi digvdodi yagiyelvsei, udugiyeno aquvha itsvwadvhvsdiyi, ale didiholi digvdodiyi igalinohediyi, ale idaliheligv ukaliisdiyi.
\syll ᎤᏣᏛᎩ ᎢᏳᏓᎴᎩ ᎢᏨᏲᏪᎳᏁᏗ ᎠᎩᎲᎩ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎪᏪᎵᏉ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎪᏪᎶᏗ ᏗᎬᏙᏗ ᏯᎩᏰᎸᏎᎢ, ᎤᏚᎩᏰᏃ ᎠᏋᎭ ᎢᏨᏩᏛᎲᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏗᎰᎵ ᏗᎬᏙᏗᏱ ᎢᎦᎵᏃᎮᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏓᎵᎮᎵᎬ ᎤᎧᎵᎢᏍᏗᏱ.
\ft Having many things to write unto you, I would not write with paper and ink: but I trust to come unto you, and speak face to face, that our joy may be full.

\ln Agasuyvdv etsalvi tsuwetsi wigetsayoliha.  Emenv.
\syll ᎠᎦᏑᏴᏛ ᎡᏣᎸᎢ ᏧᏪᏥ ᏫᎨᏣᏲᎵᎭ.  ᎡᎺᏅ.
\ft The children of thy elect sister greet thee. Amen.

\ln Ayv aidvsonvhi witsiyoliga atsigeyui gaya, nasgi ayv tsigeyui.
\syll ᎠᏴ ᎠᎢᏛᏐᏅᎯ ᏫᏥᏲᎵᎦ ᎠᏥᎨᏳᎢ ᎦᏯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᏥᎨᏳᎢ.
\ft The elder unto the wellbeloved Gaius, whom I love in the truth.

\ln Gvgeyui, utli igai aquaduliha osdv tsanequotsediyi ale nvwadohiyadv tsalenidasdiyi, nasgiya tsadanvdo osdv unequotsehvi.
\syll ᎬᎨᏳᎢ, ᎤᏟ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎠᏆᏚᎵᎭ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏣᏁᏉᏤᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᏣᎴᏂᏓᏍᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏣᏓᏅᏙ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎤᏁᏉᏤᎲᎢ.
\ft Beloved, I wish above all things that thou mayest prosper and be in health, even as thy soul prospereth.

\ln Utsatanvhiyeno aqualihelitsvgi, idadanvtli unilitsv ale uninohelv tsatlonasdi nigesvna gesvi, nasgi hedohv duyugodv gesvi.
\syll ᎤᏣᏔᏅᎯᏰᏃ ᎠᏆᎵᎮᎵᏨᎩ, ᎢᏓᏓᏅᏟ ᎤᏂᎵᏨ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏃᎮᎸ ᏣᏠᎾᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎮᏙᎲ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft For I rejoiced greatly, when the brethren came and testified of the truth that is in thee, even as thou walkest in the truth.

\ln Vtla gohusdi utli igai aqualihelisdi sgiya yigi nigav aqualihelisdigv gadvgvga diquetsi duyugodv gesv anedohvi.
\syll ᎥᏝ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏟ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎠᏆᎵᎮᎵᏍᏗ ᏍᎩᏯ ᏱᎩ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎠᏆᎵᎮᎵᏍᏗᎬ ᎦᏛᎬᎦ ᏗᏇᏥ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏁᏙᎲᎢ.
\ft I have no greater joy than to hear that my children walk in truth.

\ln Gvgeyui, duyugodv hnadvneha nigav nidehadvnehv unaligohi ale anedohi.
\syll ᎬᎨᏳᎢ, ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎿᏛᏁᎭ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏂᏕᎭᏛᏁᎲ ᎤᎾᎵᎪᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏁᏙᎯ.
\ft Beloved, thou doest faithfully whatsoever thou doest to the brethren, and to strangers;

\ln Nasgi uninohelvhi tsigi tsadageyuhiyu gesv tsunanelodi unadatlugv anigatahvi; iyuno nasgi yitisdelvhv anaisvi, Unelanvhi gvwasdawadidohi iyunadvnedi, osiyu nvtadvneli.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᏃᎮᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ ᏣᏓᎨᏳᎯᏳ ᎨᏒ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎲᎢ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᏘᏍᏕᎸᎲ ᎠᎾᎢᏒᎢ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᏁᏗ, ᎣᏏᏳ ᏅᏔᏛᏁᎵ.
\ft Which have borne witness of thy charity before the church: whom if thou bring forward on their journey after a godly sort, thou shalt do well:

\ln Nasgiyeno dudov nvtsulisdotanv anedoha gohusdi nidaninitlisgvna tsunadalenvdv yvwi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᏚᏙᎥ ᏅᏧᎵᏍᏙᏔᏅ ᎠᏁᏙᎭ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏂᏓᏂᏂᏟᏍᎬᎾ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ.
\ft Because that for his name's sake they went forth, taking nothing of the Gentiles.

\ln Nasgi yinvdigalisdodiha yididadanilvga nasgi iyunasdi, nasgi itsulaha degilvwisdanehv yidisdeliha duyugodv gesvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᏱᏗᏓᏓᏂᎸᎦ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᏕᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᏱᏗᏍᏕᎵᎭ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft We therefore ought to receive such, that we might be fellowhelpers to the truth.

\ln Tsunanelodi unadatlugv na gatsiyowelanelvgi, aseno dayaloqui igvyi ulediyi udulisgi, vtla yidogadanilvga.
\syll ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬ Ꮎ ᎦᏥᏲᏪᎳᏁᎸᎩ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᏓᏯᎶᏈ ᎢᎬᏱ ᎤᎴᏗᏱ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎩ, ᎥᏝ ᏱᏙᎦᏓᏂᎸᎦ.
\ft I wrote unto the church: but Diotrephes, who loveth to have the preeminence among them, receiveth us not.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi iyuno wiyagilutsv daganvdadi dulvwisdanehvi, nasgi uyo gawonisgvgvdi tsogatludiha, ale vtla nasgiquo yeli yuyelvha, vtlayeno nidadanilvgvnaquo uwasv yigi anadanvtli, nasquosgini deganvsdadeha digvwanadanilvisdi tsigesvi, ale deganugowisga tsunanelodi unedatlugv.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏳᏃ ᏫᏯᎩᎷᏨ ᏓᎦᏅᏓᏗ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏲ ᎦᏬᏂᏍᎬᎬᏗ ᏦᎦᏡᏗᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᎾᏍᎩᏉ ᏰᎵ ᏳᏰᎸᎭ, ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᏂᏓᏓᏂᎸᎬᎾᏉ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏱᎩ ᎠᎾᏓᏅᏟ, ᎾᏍᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᏕᎦᏅᏍᏓᏕᎭ ᏗᎬᏩᎾᏓᏂᎸᎢᏍᏗ ᏥᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᎦᏄᎪᏫᏍᎦ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎤᏁᏓᏡᎬ.
\ft Wherefore, if I come, I will remember his deeds which he doeth, prating against us with malicious words: and not content therewith, neither doth he himself receive the brethren, and forbiddeth them that would, and casteth them out of the church.

\ln Gvgeyui, tlesdi usonv gesv yitsasdawadvsesdi, osdvsgini gesv hisdawadegesdi.  Osdv tsulvwisdanehi nasgi Unelanvhi nvdayudalenvhi; uyosgini tsulvwisdanehi nasgi vtla Unelanvhi ugohvhi yigi.
\syll ᎬᎨᏳᎢ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᎤᏐᏅ ᎨᏒ ᏱᏣᏍᏓᏩᏛᏎᏍᏗ, ᎣᏍᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏒ ᎯᏍᏓᏩᏕᎨᏍᏗ.  ᎣᏍᏛ ᏧᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ; ᎤᏲᏍᎩᏂ ᏧᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎪᎲᎯ ᏱᎩ.
\ft Beloved, follow not that which is evil, but that which is good. He that doeth good is of God: but he that doeth evil hath not seen God.

\ln Dimitliya nanivquo osiyu gvwanoheha, ale nasquo duyugodv gesv osiyu unoheha, ale nasquo ayv otsinoheha, ale itsigataha otsinohesgv duyugodv gesvi.
\syll ᏗᎻᏟᏯ ᎾᏂᎥᏉ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎬᏩᏃᎮᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎤᏃᎮᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏴ ᎣᏥᏃᎮᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᎣᏥᏃᎮᏍᎬ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Demetrius hath good report of all men, and of the truth itself: yea, and we also bear record; and ye know that our record is true.

\ln Utsadi iyudalegi aquowelodi agihvgi, aseno vtla digowelodi yidodagvtani na yvdagvyowelaneli;
\syll ᎤᏣᏗ ᎢᏳᏓᎴᎩ ᎠᏉᏪᎶᏗ ᎠᎩᎲᎩ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏗᎪᏪᎶᏗ ᏱᏙᏓᎬᏔᏂ Ꮎ ᏴᏓᎬᏲᏪᎳᏁᎵ;
\ft I had many things to write, but I will not with ink and pen write unto thee:

\ln Aseno udugi aquvha tlegiyu gvgowadvdiyi, ale hnaquo diniholi diginvdodiyi ginalinohediyi.  Nvwadohiyadv nitsadvidegesdi.  Igalii wigetsayoliha.  Ganadoadisv giyolilvha igalii.
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎠᏋᎭ ᏞᎩᏳ ᎬᎪᏩᏛᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎿᏉ ᏗᏂᎰᎵ ᏗᎩᏅᏙᏗᏱ ᎩᎾᎵᏃᎮᏗᏱ.  ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᏂᏣᏛᎢᏕᎨᏍᏗ.  ᎢᎦᎵᎢ ᏫᎨᏣᏲᎵᎭ.  ᎦᎾᏙᎠᏗᏒ ᎩᏲᎵᎸᎭ ᎢᎦᎵᎢ.
\ft But I trust I shall shortly see thee, and we shall speak face to face. Peace be to thee. Our friends salute thee. Greet the friends by name.

\ln Ayv Tsudasi, Tsisa Galonedv aginvsidasdi ale Tsimi tsosdadanvtli, witsvyoliga nihi nitsisganvna itsvnelvhi Unelanvhi Agayvsegei, ale Tsisa Galonedv iyuwanisadv etsisquanigotanvhi, ale etsiyanvdv itsadanvti itsalisdodiyi;
\syll ᎠᏴ ᏧᏓᏏ, ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎠᎩᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏥᎻ ᏦᏍᏓᏓᏅᏟ, ᏫᏨᏲᎵᎦ ᏂᎯ ᏂᏥᏍᎦᏅᎾ ᎢᏨᏁᎸᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎦᏴᏎᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ ᎡᏥᏍᏆᏂᎪᏔᏅᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎡᏥᏯᏅᏛ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏘ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ;
\ft Jude, the servant of Jesus Christ, and brother of James, to them that are sanctified by God the Father, and preserved in Jesus Christ, and called:

\ln Udadolisdi gesv ale nvwadohiyadv ale adageyudi gesv etsinequoedi gesesdi.
\syll ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎡᏥᏁᏉᎡᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft Mercy unto you, and peace, and love, be multiplied.

\ln Itsvgeyui, iyuno aquatlinigvnelv witsvyowelanediyi nigadiyuquo igatseli igalisdelvdodi ugvwali, udulvdi naqualisdanelvgi witsvyowetanehv itsvsdiyedodiyi, nasgi ulinigidv itsadisvsediyi gohiyudi gesv nasgi gayula digetsiyohiselvhi tsigi unadanvti.
\syll ᎢᏨᎨᏳᎢ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎠᏆᏟᏂᎬᏁᎸ ᏫᏨᏲᏪᎳᏁᏗᏱ ᏂᎦᏗᏳᏉ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᎢᎦᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ, ᎤᏚᎸᏗ ᎾᏆᎵᏍᏓᏁᎸᎩ ᏫᏨᏲᏪᏔᏁᎲ ᎢᏨᏍᏗᏰᏙᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᎢᏣᏗᏒᏎᏗᏱ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏳᎳ ᏗᎨᏥᏲᎯᏎᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ.
\ft Beloved, when I gave all diligence to write unto you of the common salvation, it was needful for me to write unto you, and exhort you that ye should earnestly contend for the faith which was once delivered unto the saints.

\ln Giloyeno iyunasdi anisgaya udelidv uniyvlvhi igi nasgi ilvhiyu nvdagvwadalenvdv digegovhi tsigi nasgi iyusdi digegugodanediyi; Unelanvhi nidunanelodvna anisgaya, gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv Unelanvhi aninetliyvsgi nalisinahisdvna alenidasdi gesv iyanvnehi, ale anadayihi uwasvhiyu Ugvwiyuhi Unelanvhi, ale igatseli Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv.
\syll ᎩᎶᏰᏃ ᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᎤᏂᏴᎸᎯ ᎢᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏗᎨᎪᎥᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏗᎨᎫᎪᏓᏁᏗᏱ; ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏂᏚᎾᏁᎶᏛᎾ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ, ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᏂᏁᏟᏴᏍᎩ ᎾᎵᏏᏀᎢᏍᏛᎾ ᎠᎴᏂᏓᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏯᏅᏁᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎾᏓᏱᎯ ᎤᏩᏒᎯᏳ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ.
\ft For there are certain men crept in unawares, who were before of old ordained to this condemnation, ungodly men, turning the grace of our God into lasciviousness, and denying the only Lord God, and our Lord Jesus Christ.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi aquaduliha itsvyanvdadisdodiyi nasgi hia gayula tsitsigataha, nasgi na Ugvwiyuhi tsiduwudadase yvwi Itsiquiyi gada ahv, oni tsidudvtane nasgi na nunohiyunvna.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏆᏚᎵᎭ ᎢᏨᏯᏅᏓᏗᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎦᏳᎳ ᏥᏥᎦᏔᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏚᏭᏓᏓᏎ ᏴᏫ ᎢᏥᏈᏱ ᎦᏓ ᎠᎲ, ᎣᏂ ᏥᏚᏛᏔᏁ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏄᏃᎯᏳᏅᎾ.
\ft I will therefore put you in remembrance, though ye once knew this, how that the Lord, having saved the people out of the land of Egypt, afterward destroyed them that believed not.

\ln Ale dinikahnawadidohi nunisquanigotanvna tsigese nunigvwiyusadegi nigegvnelv tsunvdetsequosgini unatseligohi anehvi, tsudadesvdv digvwayoisdi nigesvna degegalvsdi ulisigvi, galvquodiyu digugododiyi iga asqualvhv gvdisgi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏗᏂᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏄᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏔᏅᎾ ᏥᎨᏎ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ ᏂᎨᎬᏁᎸ ᏧᏅᏕᏤᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎪᎯ ᎠᏁᎲᎢ, ᏧᏓᏕᏒᏛ ᏗᎬᏩᏲᎢᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏕᎨᎦᎸᏍᏗ ᎤᎵᏏᎬᎢ, ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᏗᎫᎪᏙᏗᏱ ᎢᎦ ᎠᏍᏆᎸᎲ ᎬᏗᏍᎩ.
\ft And the angels which kept not their first estate, but left their own habitation, he hath reserved in everlasting chains under darkness unto the judgment of the great day.

\ln Ale nasquo Sodami ale Gomali, ale nasgi na nav tsidegaduhei, nasgiya nanadvnehe danadayosge udelidv dinisidi gesv tsunilvwisdanediyi, ale anisdawadidohe uquedali asdayudvsdi uquedali nigesvna gesvi, adadeyatahvsgi nigegvnelei anigiliyoge unisdvdisdi gesv gvtlosgi nigesvna atsilvyi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏐᏓᎻ ᎠᎴ ᎪᎹᎵ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎾᎥ ᏥᏕᎦᏚᎮᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᎾᏛᏁᎮ ᏓᎾᏓᏲᏍᎨ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᏗᏂᏏᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎮ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎠᏍᏓᏳᏛᏍᏗ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᏓᏕᏯᏔᎲᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᎬᏁᎴᎢ ᎠᏂᎩᎵᏲᎨ ᎤᏂᏍᏛᏗᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏠᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎠᏥᎸᏱ.
\ft Even as Sodom and Gomorrha, and the cities about them in like manner, giving themselves over to fornication, and going after strange flesh, are set forth for an example, suffering the vengeance of eternal fire.

\ln Nasgiya nasquo hia anasgidasvvsgi gadaha nanvneha uniquedalvi, dinisgagi nunigvwiyusadegi, ale digvwanisotlvdi getsilvquodi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎯᎠ ᎠᎾᏍᎩᏓᏒᎥᏍᎩ ᎦᏓᎭ ᎾᏅᏁᎭ ᎤᏂᏇᏓᎸᎢ, ᏗᏂᏍᎦᎩ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎬᏩᏂᏐᏢᏗ ᎨᏥᎸᏉᏗ.
\ft Likewise also these filthy dreamers defile the flesh, despise dominion, and speak evil of dignities.

\ln Suyigilisgini nugvwiyusadegi dikahnawadidohi asgina unadisvlv, unadisvlv aniwonisgv Mosi ayelvi, mayigili vtla gohusdi usonv yulawiselei, hiaquosgini nuwesei, Ugvwiyuhi witsasgagi.
\syll ᏑᏱᎩᎵᏍᎩᏂ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎠᏍᎩᎾ ᎤᎾᏗᏒᎸ, ᎤᎾᏗᏒᎸ ᎠᏂᏬᏂᏍᎬ ᎼᏏ ᎠᏰᎸᎢ, ᎹᏱᎩᎵ ᎥᏝ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏐᏅ ᏳᎳᏫᏎᎴᎢ, ᎯᎠᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏫᏣᏍᎦᎩ.
\ft Yet Michael the archangel, when contending with the devil he disputed about the body of Moses, durst not bring against him a railing accusation, but said, The Lord rebuke thee.

\ln Hiasgini usonv aninoheha nasgi nanigatahvna; nasgisgini unvsv gesv tsinagataha, nasgiya gagolisdiquo tsanehnaa anigatahvi, nasgi nahna uyo nanadadvneha.
\syll ᎯᎠᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏐᏅ ᎠᏂᏃᎮᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏂᎦᏔᎲᎾ; ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏅᏒ ᎨᏒ ᏥᎾᎦᏔᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎦᎪᎵᏍᏗᏉ ᏣᏁᎿᎠ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏀᎾ ᎤᏲ ᎾᎾᏓᏛᏁᎭ.
\ft But these speak evil of those things which they know not: but what they know naturally, as brute beasts, in those things they corrupt themselves.

\ln Uyo winunalisdasi!  Genayeno unvnv unisdawadenv, ale gegaguyvdanedi unadulisgv unigvvsgv unigehena Quelami ulidastanv, ale getsidvtanv, dunigatilvsv Goli tsugatilvdv gesvi.
\syll ᎤᏲ ᏫᏄᎾᎵᏍᏓᏏ  ᎨᎾᏰᏃ ᎤᏅᏅ ᎤᏂᏍᏓᏩᏕᏅ, ᎠᎴ ᎨᎦᎫᏴᏓᏁᏗ ᎤᎾᏚᎵᏍᎬ ᎤᏂᎬᎥᏍᎬ ᎤᏂᎨᎮᎾ ᏇᎳᎻ ᎤᎵᏓᏍᏔᏅ, ᎠᎴ ᎨᏥᏛᏔᏅ, ᏚᏂᎦᏘᎸᏒ ᎪᎵ ᏧᎦᏘᎸᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft Woe unto them! for they have gone in the way of Cain, and ran greedily after the error of Balaam for reward, and perished in the gainsaying of Core.

\ln Hia nasgi nvyohi dudadala ditsanelodi detsalisdayvhvsgvi, nahiyu itsuladetsalisdayvhvga naninayesgvna analisdayvhvsgoi; dulogilv ama nidunehvna, unole tsuyilegoi; detlugv tsulasduwoatahi, gohusdi nunadadanehvna, tali iyuwagudi uwayvsvhi tsigesoi, diyehidv dikanasdetlvtanvhi tsigesoi.
\syll ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏲᎯ ᏚᏓᏓᎳ ᏗᏣᏁᎶᏗ ᏕᏣᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎬᎢ, ᏀᎢᏳ ᎢᏧᎳᏕᏣᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᎦ ᎾᏂᎾᏰᏍᎬᎾ ᎠᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎪᎢ; ᏚᎶᎩᎸ ᎠᎹ ᏂᏚᏁᎲᎾ, ᎤᏃᎴ ᏧᏱᎴᎪᎢ; ᏕᏡᎬ ᏧᎳᏍᏚᏬᎠᏔᎯ, ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏄᎾᏓᏓᏁᎲᎾ, ᏔᎵ ᎢᏳᏩᎫᏗ ᎤᏩᏴᏒᎯ ᏥᎨᏐᎢ, ᏗᏰᎯᏛ ᏗᎧᎾᏍᏕᏢᏔᏅᎯ ᏥᎨᏐᎢ.
\ft These are spots in your feasts of charity, when they feast with you, feeding themselves without fear: clouds they are without water, carried about of winds; trees whose fruit withereth, without fruit, twice dead, plucked up by the roots;

\ln Amequohi uhnalvhi dilisdilanegi, unvsv unadehohisdisgi aninanugowisgi; noquisi uninvnv unatledv, nasgi utsati gvhnage ulisigv tsigegadvnvisdanelv ulisquadisdi nigesvna.
\syll ᎠᎺᏉᎯ ᎤᎿᎸᎯ ᏗᎵᏍᏗᎳᏁᎩ, ᎤᏅᏒ ᎤᎾᏕᎰᎯᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᎠᏂᎾᏄᎪᏫᏍᎩ; ᏃᏈᏏ ᎤᏂᏅᏅ ᎤᎾᏞᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎬᎿᎨ ᎤᎵᏏᎬ ᏥᎨᎦᏛᏅᎢᏍᏓᏁᎸ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.
\ft Raging waves of the sea, foaming out their own shame; wandering stars, to whom is reserved the blackness of darkness for ever.

\ln Ale Inagi, Adawi udenv galiquogine wehi, nasquo adolehosgv hia nasgi duneistane hia nuwesei, Gvniyuquo, Ugvwiyuhi dagalutsi datinehesdi asgo iyagayvli tsudoli unadanvti,
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎢᎾᎩ, ᎠᏓᏫ ᎤᏕᏅ ᎦᎵᏉᎩᏁ ᏪᎯ, ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎬ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᏁᎢᏍᏔᏁ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎬᏂᏳᏉ, ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏓᎦᎷᏥ ᏓᏘᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᎠᏍᎪ ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ ᏧᏙᎵ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ,
\ft And Enoch also, the seventh from Adam, prophesied of these, saying, Behold, the Lord cometh with ten thousands of his saints,

\ln Tsuwugodanediyi nanivi, ale tsugvsgolvdiyi naniv Unelanvhi nidunanelodvna nvdigalisdodisgv nigav utsatini digalvwisdanedi dunilvwisdanelvi, ale nigav niduyugodvna nuniwesv Unelanvhi nidunanelodvna nasgi gvwatludisgvi.
\syll ᏧᏭᎪᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᎾᏂᎥᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᎬᏍᎪᎸᏗᏱ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏂᏚᎾᏁᎶᏛᎾ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎤᏣᏘᏂ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᏚᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏂᏚᏳᎪᏛᎾ ᏄᏂᏪᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏂᏚᎾᏁᎶᏛᎾ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏩᏡᏗᏍᎬᎢ.
\ft To execute judgment upon all, and to convince all that are ungodly among them of all their ungodly deeds which they have ungodly committed, and of all their hard speeches which ungodly sinners have spoken against him.

\ln Hia nasgi unigonelohisati, unelihisgi, unvsv unadulvnvvsgv anisdawadegi; diniholino danvdisgo utsati atlvquisdi aniwonisgoi, yvwi dunakadv danilvquodisgo osdv igvwanalisdanedi udugi unvsv iyusdi.
\syll ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᎪᏁᎶᎯᏌᏘ, ᎤᏁᎵᎯᏍᎩ, ᎤᏅᏒ ᎤᎾᏚᎸᏅᎥᏍᎬ ᎠᏂᏍᏓᏩᏕᎩ; ᏗᏂᎰᎵᏃ ᏓᏅᏗᏍᎪ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎠᏢᏈᏍᏗ ᎠᏂᏬᏂᏍᎪᎢ, ᏴᏫ ᏚᎾᎧᏛ ᏓᏂᎸᏉᏗᏍᎪ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎢᎬᏩᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎤᏅᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ.
\ft These are murmurers, complainers, walking after their own lusts; and their mouth speaketh great swelling words, having men's persons in admiration because of advantage.

\ln Aseno, itsvgeyui, itsanvdada kanohedv ilvhiyu uninohedv getsinvsidv Ugvwiyuhi igatseli Tsisa Galonedv tsutseliga;
\syll ᎠᏎᏃ, ᎢᏨᎨᏳᎢ, ᎢᏣᏅᏓᏓ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᎤᏂᏃᎮᏛ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏛ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏧᏤᎵᎦ;
\ft But, beloved, remember ye the words which were spoken before of the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ;

\ln Nasgi hia tsinuniwesvgi, ulisqualvdi gesesdi anehesdi anisotlvisdisgi, nasgi unvsv unadulvnvvsgv niduyugodvna anisdawadegi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ, ᎤᎵᏍᏆᎸᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎠᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᎠᏂᏐᏢᎢᏍᏗᏍᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏅᏒ ᎤᎾᏚᎸᏅᎥᏍᎬ ᏂᏚᏳᎪᏛᎾ ᎠᏂᏍᏓᏩᏕᎩ.
\ft How that they told you there should be mockers in the last time, who should walk after their own ungodly lusts.

\ln Hia nasgi na anadadaledisgi tsigi, uquedaliquo anisdawadegi, Adanvdo nunehvna.
\syll ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᎾᏓᏓᎴᏗᏍᎩ ᏥᎩ, ᎤᏇᏓᎵᏉ ᎠᏂᏍᏓᏩᏕᎩ, ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᏄᏁᎲᎾ.
