\syll ᎡᏣᎫᏴᏏ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎢᏣᎫᏴᎡᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏔᎵ ᎢᏳᏩᎫᏗ ᎡᏣᎫᏴᏏ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸᎢ; ᎤᎵᏍᏈᏗ ᎤᎧᎵᎸᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏔᎵ ᎢᏳᏩᎫᏗ ᎡᏥᎧᎵᎢᏏ.
\ft Reward her even as she rewarded you, and double unto her double according to her works: in the cup which she hath filled fill to her double.

\ln Nasgi nigav uwasv udalvquotanvi ale utlvquodi udenvi, nasgi igai agiliya ale uyo adanvdadisdi gesv etsivsi; unawiyiyeno hia nigaweha, agigvwiyuhi aquola, vtla aquosulotsvhi yigi, vtla ale uyo adanvdadisdi gesv yvgatsigowadv.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎤᏓᎸᏉᏔᏅᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏢᏉᏗ ᎤᏕᏅᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎠᎩᎵᏯ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏲ ᎠᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎡᏥᎥᏏ; ᎤᎾᏫᏱᏰᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᎭ, ᎠᎩᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᏉᎳ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᏉᏑᎶᏨᎯ ᏱᎩ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏲ ᎠᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏴᎦᏥᎪᏩᏛ.
\ft How much she hath glorified herself, and lived deliciously, so much torment and sorrow give her: for she saith in her heart, I sit a queen, and am no widow, and shall see no sorrow.

\ln Nasgi iyusdi udeyadodisgi gesv siquono uluhisdi gesesdi, ayohuhisdi gesv, ale diyvlasdi gesv, ale agolv; ale agagohvsdodi gesesdi atsilv gvdi; ulinigidiyuyeno Ugvwiyuhi Unelanvhi nasgi tsuwugodanehi tsigi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᏕᏯᏙᏗᏍᎩ ᎨᏒ ᏏᏉᏃ ᎤᎷᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏴᎳᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎪᎸ; ᎠᎴ ᎠᎦᎪᎲᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎠᏥᎸ ᎬᏗ; ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳᏰᏃ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏭᎪᏓᏁᎯ ᏥᎩ.
\ft Therefore shall her plagues come in one day, death, and mourning, and famine; and she shall be utterly burned with fire: for strong is the Lord God who judgeth her.

\ln Ale unigvwiyuhi elohi anehi, nasgi udelidv tsunanisinidolvhi gesvi, ale utlvquodi itsulaha unadenvhi, nasgi dagvwasgonili, ale nasgi nvdagalisdotani dodvniyvlasi, hnaquo anigohvha dugasvsdv nasgi agohvsgvi,
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎠᏁᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᏧᎾᏂᏏᏂᏙᎸᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏢᏉᏗ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎤᎾᏕᏅᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏓᎬᏩᏍᎪᏂᎵ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏔᏂ ᏙᏛᏂᏴᎳᏏ, ᎿᏉ ᎠᏂᎪᎲᎭ ᏚᎦᏒᏍᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎪᎲᏍᎬᎢ,
\ft And the kings of the earth, who have committed fornication and lived deliciously with her, shall bewail her, and lament for her, when they shall see the smoke of her burning,

\ln Inv dinidonaesdi anisgaihv agiliyogv nvdigalisdodisgvi, hia naniwesgesdi, Uyosdvquo, uyosdvquo, nasgi na equa Dadaloni, nasgi ulinigidv gaduhvi!  sutlilodvquoyeno igohidv ditsadugodanedi gesv tsalutsisi.
\syll ᎢᏅ ᏗᏂᏙᎾᎡᏍᏗ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᎢᎲ ᎠᎩᎵᏲᎬ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏂᏪᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎤᏲᏍᏛᏉ, ᎤᏲᏍᏛᏉ, ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎡᏆ ᏓᏓᎶᏂ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᎦᏚᎲᎢ  ᏑᏟᎶᏛᏉᏰᏃ ᎢᎪᎯᏛ ᏗᏣᏚᎪᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏣᎷᏥᏏ.
\ft Standing afar off for the fear of her torment, saying, Alas, alas, that great city Babylon, that mighty city! for in one hour is thy judgment come.

\ln Aninotanvhvsgino elohi anehi dodvnatloyili ale dodvniyvlasi dagvwasgonili nasgi; vtlayeno hnaquo gilo yigvwaniwahiseha ganododi;
\syll ᎠᏂᏃᏔᏅᎲᏍᎩᏃ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎠᏁᎯ ᏙᏛᎾᏠᏱᎵ ᎠᎴ ᏙᏛᏂᏴᎳᏏ ᏓᎬᏩᏍᎪᏂᎵ ᎾᏍᎩ; ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᎿᏉ ᎩᎶ ᏱᎬᏩᏂᏩᎯᏎᎭ ᎦᏃᏙᏗ;
\ft And the merchants of the earth shall weep and mourn over her; for no man buyeth their merchandise any more:

\ln Nasgi adelvdalonige ganododi gesvi, ale adelvunegv, ale utsati tsugvwalodi nvya, ale dagvnaiyunasdi, ale usidoli doledv, ale didehalugei, ale diwanagei, ale digigagei, ale nagav digalvquodi ada, ale nigav ditelido kamama tsudanudonvhi digotlvtanvhi, ale nigav ditelido utsati tsugvwalodi ada digotlvtanvhi, ale vtsayi, ale talugisgi, ale anidawisgage nvya,
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏕᎸᏓᎶᏂᎨ ᎦᏃᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏕᎸᎤᏁᎬ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᏅᏯ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᎬᎾᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏏᏙᎵ ᏙᎴᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏕᎭᎷᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏩᎾᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎩᎦᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᎦᎥ ᏗᎦᎸᏉᏗ ᎠᏓ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏗᏖᎵᏙ ᎧᎹᎹ ᏧᏓᏄᏙᏅᎯ ᏗᎪᏢᏔᏅᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏗᏖᎵᏙ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎠᏓ ᏗᎪᏢᏔᏅᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏣᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏔᎷᎩᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏓᏫᏍᎦᎨ ᏅᏯ,
\ft The merchandise of gold, and silver, and precious stones, and of pearls, and fine linen, and purple, and silk, and scarlet, and all thyine wood, and all manner vessels of ivory, and all manner vessels of most precious wood, and of brass, and iron, and marble,

\ln Ale sinimani, ale digawasvgi, ale atlonedi, ale adla uganasdv gawasvgi, ale gigageaditasdi, ale goi, ale wanage utsalesdi isv, ale utsalesdiugadv, ale ganatlai, ale awiuninodenv, ale soquili, ale tsusdidaqualelu, ale yvwidiganatlai, ale yvwi tsunadanvdo.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏏᏂᎹᏂ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎦᏩᏒᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏠᏁᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏜ ᎤᎦᎾᏍᏛ ᎦᏩᏒᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎩᎦᎨᎠᏗᏔᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎪᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏩᎾᎨ ᎤᏣᎴᏍᏗ ᎢᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏣᎴᏍᏗᎤᎦᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᎾᏝᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏫᎤᏂᏃᏕᏅ, ᎠᎴ ᏐᏈᎵ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏍᏗᏓᏆᎴᎷ, ᎠᎴ ᏴᏫᏗᎦᎾᏝᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏴᏫ ᏧᎾᏓᏅᏙ.
\ft And cinnamon, and odours, and ointments, and frankincense, and wine, and oil, and fine flour, and wheat, and beasts, and sheep, and horses, and chariots, and slaves, and souls of men.

\ln Ale udatanvhi nasgi tsadanvdo tsugvvsgvgi tsadanvelv, ale nigav utlvquodi ale digalvquodi tsigesv getsadanvelv, ale vtla hnaquo widigetsawadvdi yigesesdi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᏔᏅᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏣᏓᏅᏙ ᏧᎬᎥᏍᎬᎩ ᏣᏓᏅᎡᎸ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎤᏢᏉᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎦᎸᏉᏗ ᏥᎨᏒ ᎨᏣᏓᏅᎡᎸ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᎿᏉ ᏫᏗᎨᏣᏩᏛᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft And the fruits that thy soul lusted after are departed from thee, and all things which were dainty and goodly are departed from thee, and thou shalt find them no more at all.

\ln Hia nasgi tsudaledv aninotanvvsgi, nasgi tsuwenvistanvhi, inv dinidonaesdi nvdigalisdodisgesdi agiliyogv anisgaihvi, danatloyihesdi ale daniyvgesdi,
\syll ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏓᎴᏛ ᎠᏂᏃᏔᏅᎥᏍᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏪᏅᎢᏍᏔᏅᎯ, ᎢᏅ ᏗᏂᏙᎾᎡᏍᏗ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᎩᎵᏲᎬ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᎢᎲᎢ, ᏓᎾᏠᏱᎮᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏓᏂᏴᎨᏍᏗ,
\ft The merchants of these things, which were made rich by her, shall stand afar off for the fear of her torment, weeping and wailing,

\ln Ale hia naniwesgesdi, Uyosdvquo, uyosdvquo, nasgi na equa gaduhv nasgi usidoli doledv, ale dehalugei, ale gigagei tsidutsanodvgi, ale adelvdalonigei, ale utsati tsunagvwalodi nvya, ale dagvnaiyunasdi, tsidutsanodvgi!
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏂᏪᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎤᏲᏍᏛᏉ, ᎤᏲᏍᏛᏉ, ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎡᏆ ᎦᏚᎲ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏏᏙᎵ ᏙᎴᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᎭᎷᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎩᎦᎨᎢ ᏥᏚᏣᏃᏛᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏕᎸᏓᎶᏂᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏧᎾᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᏅᏯ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᎬᎾᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗ, ᏥᏚᏣᏃᏛᎩ
\ft And saying, Alas, alas, that great city, that was clothed in fine linen, and purple, and scarlet, and decked with gold, and precious stones, and pearls!

\ln Sutlilodvquoyeno igohidv nasgi igai tsugvwalodi asequo nigalistanidv.  Ale naniv unigvwiyusadegi tsiyu tsutanv daninidohvi, ale naniv tsiyuhi unatsai, ale tsiyu dininidohi, ale nanivquo amequohi aninotanidohi, inv dvnidonavgi,
\syll ᏑᏟᎶᏛᏉᏰᏃ ᎢᎪᎯᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎦᎢ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎠᏎᏉ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏔᏂᏛ.  ᎠᎴ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎤᏂᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ ᏥᏳ ᏧᏔᏅ ᏓᏂᏂᏙᎲᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏥᏳᎯ ᎤᎾᏣᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᏳ ᏗᏂᏂᏙᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏂᎥᏉ ᎠᎺᏉᎯ ᎠᏂᏃᏔᏂᏙᎯ, ᎢᏅ ᏛᏂᏙᎾᎥᎩ,
\ft For in one hour so great riches is come to nought. And every shipmaster, and all the company in ships, and sailors, and as many as trade by sea, stood afar off,

\ln Ale unelunvgi iyuno unigohv dugasvsdv nasgi agohvsgvi, hia naniwesgvgi, Gado usdi nasgiya gese nasgi hia equa gaduhv nusdvi?
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎷᏅᎩ ᎢᏳᏃ ᎤᏂᎪᎲ ᏚᎦᏒᏍᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎪᎲᏍᎬᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏂᏪᏍᎬᎩ, ᎦᏙ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎨᏎ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎡᏆ ᎦᏚᎲ ᏄᏍᏛᎢ?
\ft And cried when they saw the smoke of her burning, saying, What city is like unto this great city!

\ln Dinisgolino gosdu dunitlanvgi, ale unelunvgi danatloyihvi, ale daniyvgvi, hia naniwesgvgi, Uyosdvquo, uyosdvquo, nasgi na equa gaduhvi, nahna tsunehnai tsinunalistanvgi nigadv amequohi tsiyu dininidohi, nvdigalisdodisgv utsati uwehnaiyu gesvi, sutlilodvquoyeno igohidv nvta nagvnelv.
\syll ᏗᏂᏍᎪᎵᏃ ᎪᏍᏚ ᏚᏂᏝᏅᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎷᏅᎩ ᏓᎾᏠᏱᎲᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᏂᏴᎬᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏂᏪᏍᎬᎩ, ᎤᏲᏍᏛᏉ, ᎤᏲᏍᏛᏉ, ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎡᏆ ᎦᏚᎲᎢ, ᏀᎾ ᏧᏁᎿᎢ ᏥᏄᎾᎵᏍᏔᏅᎩ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎠᎺᏉᎯ ᏥᏳ ᏗᏂᏂᏙᎯ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᏪᎿᎢᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏑᏟᎶᏛᏉᏰᏃ ᎢᎪᎯᏛ ᏅᏔ ᎾᎬᏁᎸ.
\ft And they cast dust on their heads, and cried, weeping and wailing, saying, Alas, alas, that great city, wherein were made rich all that had ships in the sea by reason of her costliness! for in one hour is she made desolate.

\ln Itsaliheligi nasgi nulisdanelv iyusdi, nihi galvloi ale nihi itsadanvti ale etsinvsidv, ale itsadolehosgi; Unelanvhiyeno nihi gesv iyusdi nasgi agatletsi.
\syll ᎢᏣᎵᎮᎵᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᎵᏍᏓᏁᎸ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᏂᎯ ᎦᎸᎶᎢ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏘ ᎠᎴ ᎡᏥᏅᏏᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏣᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ; ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ ᏂᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎦᏞᏥ.
\ft Rejoice over her, thou heaven, and ye holy apostles and prophets; for God hath avenged you on her.

\ln Ulinigidvno dikahnawadidohi nvya ugisvgi, utanv disdosgi nvya nasgiyai, amequohino wudinvsvgi, hia nuwesvgi, Nasgiya gvsgaisdagi nasgi na equa gaduhv Dadaloni atsiyosdodi gesesdi, vtla ale hnaquo gvwadvdi yigesesdi.
\syll ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛᏃ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏅᏯ ᎤᎩᏒᎩ, ᎤᏔᏅ ᏗᏍᏙᏍᎩ ᏅᏯ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ, ᎠᎺᏉᎯᏃ ᏭᏗᏅᏒᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎬᏍᎦᎢᏍᏓᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎡᏆ ᎦᏚᎲ ᏓᏓᎶᏂ ᎠᏥᏲᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎿᏉ ᎬᏩᏛᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft And a mighty angel took up a stone like a great millstone, and cast it into the sea, saying, Thus with violence shall that great city Babylon be thrown down, and shall be found no more at all.

\ln Ale dikanogisdodi dininogisdisgi, ale dininogisgi, ale atsotasdi dininogisdisgi, ale dinitseluhisgi unadanoyvlisdv vtla hnaquo etsadvganedi yigesesdi; itla ale gotlvnvvsgi nudalesvquo gohusdi gotlvsgi hnaquo yetsawadvelesdi; ale nvya asdosgi unoyvgv vtla hnaquo etsadvganedi yigesesdi;
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏗᎧᏃᎩᏍᏙᏗ ᏗᏂᏃᎩᏍᏗᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏂᏃᎩᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏦᏔᏍᏗ ᏗᏂᏃᎩᏍᏗᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏂᏤᎷᎯᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᏓᏃᏴᎵᏍᏛ ᎥᏝ ᎿᏉ ᎡᏣᏛᎦᏁᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᎢᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎪᏢᏅᎥᏍᎩ ᏄᏓᎴᏒᏉ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎪᏢᏍᎩ ᎿᏉ ᏰᏣᏩᏛᎡᎴᏍᏗ; ᎠᎴ ᏅᏯ ᎠᏍᏙᏍᎩ ᎤᏃᏴᎬ ᎥᏝ ᎿᏉ ᎡᏣᏛᎦᏁᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ;
\ft And the voice of harpers, and musicians, and of pipers, and trumpeters, shall be heard no more at all in thee; and no craftsman, of whatsoever craft he be, shall be found any more in thee; and the sound of a millstone shall be heard no more at all in thee;

\ln Ale atsvsdodi dulvsadv vtla hnaquo ditsalvsadadedi yigesesdi; ale adesvhvsgi ale atsiyehi aninegv vtla hnaquo etsadvganedi yigesesdi; ditsatseliyeno aninodisgi getsilvquodi gesvgi yvwi elohi danewadisvi; nigadiyuyeno unadatselidv gesv yvwi danewadisv adonvdi detsalvwisdanehv dehilonuhetanvgi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎠᏨᏍᏙᏗ ᏚᎸᏌᏛ ᎥᏝ ᎿᏉ ᏗᏣᎸᏌᏓᏕᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᎠᎴ ᎠᏕᏒᎲᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏥᏰᎯ ᎠᏂᏁᎬ ᎥᏝ ᎿᏉ ᎡᏣᏛᎦᏁᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᏗᏣᏤᎵᏰᏃ ᎠᏂᏃᏗᏍᎩ ᎨᏥᎸᏉᏗ ᎨᏒᎩ ᏴᏫ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏓᏁᏩᏗᏒᎢ; ᏂᎦᏗᏳᏰᏃ ᎤᎾᏓᏤᎵᏛ ᎨᏒ ᏴᏫ ᏓᏁᏩᏗᏒ ᎠᏙᏅᏗ ᏕᏣᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᏕᎯᎶᏄᎮᏔᏅᎩ.
\ft And the light of a candle shall shine no more at all in thee; and the voice of the bridegroom and of the bride shall be heard no more at all in thee: for thy merchants were the great men of the earth; for by thy sorceries were all nations deceived.

\ln Ale nasgi atsiwadvelvgi unigigv anadolehosgi, ale unadanvti, ale nigadv elohi digetsilvhi gesvi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏥᏩᏛᎡᎸᎩ ᎤᏂᎩᎬ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏗᎨᏥᎸᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft And in her was found the blood of prophets, and of saints, and of all that were slain upon the earth.

\ln Nasgino nulistanidolv aquadvganvgi asdaya aninegv unitsati yvwi galvladi iyvdv, hia nvdvniwesgvgi, Yihowa edilvquoda; alisdelvdodi gesvi, ale atsilvquododi gesvi, ale osdv atsiyelvdi gesvi, ale ulinigidv gesvi, utseliga gesesdi Ugvwiyuhi iganelanvhi;
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏂᏙᎸ ᎠᏆᏛᎦᏅᎩ ᎠᏍᏓᏯ ᎠᏂᏁᎬ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏴᏫ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎢᏴᏛ, ᎯᎠ ᏅᏛᏂᏪᏍᎬᎩ, ᏱᎰᏩ ᎡᏗᎸᏉᏓ; ᎠᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎠᏥᏰᎸᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᎦᏁᎳᏅᎯ;
\ft And after these things I heard a great voice of much people in heaven, saying, Alleluia; Salvation, and glory, and honour, and power, unto the Lord our God:

\ln Nasgiyeno tsuwugododi gesv duyugodvi ale osdv; nasgiyeno duwugodanelv utsati unegutsidv ageyv, nasgi udelidv danisinidohv uniyo tsiniduwanelv elohi anehi, ale utletsv tsunvsidasdi unigigv dutsvnelvi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᏧᏭᎪᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏚᏳᎪᏛᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎣᏍᏛ; ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᏚᏭᎪᏓᏁᎸ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᏁᎫᏥᏛ ᎠᎨᏴ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᏓᏂᏏᏂᏙᎲ ᎤᏂᏲ ᏥᏂᏚᏩᏁᎸ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎠᏁᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏞᏨ ᏧᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎤᏂᎩᎬ ᏚᏨᏁᎸᎢ.
\ft For true and righteous are his judgments: for he hath judged the great whore, which did corrupt the earth with her fornication, and hath avenged the blood of his servants at her hand.

\ln Ale taline Yihowa edilvquoda unadvnvgi.  Ale nasgi utseli tsugasvsdi dalehvsgvgi nigohilv ale nigohilvi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏔᎵᏁ ᏱᎰᏩ ᎡᏗᎸᏉᏓ ᎤᎾᏛᏅᎩ.  ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏧᎦᏒᏍᏗ ᏓᎴᎲᏍᎬᎩ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎪᎯᎸᎢ.
\ft And again they said, Alleluia. And her smoke rose up for ever and ever.

\ln Nasgino na nvgitsone iyanidv tsunadvsonvhi, ale na nvgi iyanidv dinvnodv eladi dunadanvnvgi, ale Unelanvhi unadadolisdanelvgi, nasgi gasgilv uweli, hia naniwesgvgi, Emenv; Yihowa edilvquoda.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ Ꮎ ᏅᎩᏦᏁ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᏧᎾᏛᏐᏅᎯ, ᎠᎴ Ꮎ ᏅᎩ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᏗᏅᏃᏛ ᎡᎳᏗ ᏚᎾᏓᏅᏅᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎾᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎸᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏍᎩᎸ ᎤᏪᎵ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏂᏪᏍᎬᎩ, ᎡᎺᏅ; ᏱᎰᏩ ᎡᏗᎸᏉᏓ.
\ft And the four and twenty elders and the four beasts fell down and worshipped God that sat on the throne, saying, Amen; Alleluia.

\ln Ale gilo kanegv gasgilv dayudalenvgi, hia nigawesgvgi, Etsilvquoda Oganelanvhi nihi nitsiv itsinvsidasdi tsigi, ale nihi etsinayesgi tsigi, ditsasdiga ale ditsatanv.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᎧᏁᎬ ᎦᏍᎩᎸ ᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎬᎩ, ᎡᏥᎸᏉᏓ ᎣᎦᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏂᎯ ᏂᏥᎥ ᎢᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎯ ᎡᏥᎾᏰᏍᎩ ᏥᎩ, ᏗᏣᏍᏗᎦ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏣᏔᏅ.
\ft And a voice came out of the throne, saying, Praise our God, all ye his servants, and ye that fear him, both small and great.

\ln Ale aquadvganvgi unitsati tsaninego nasgiyai, ale utsati ama tsusquanoyvgo nasgiyai, ale utsati dayvdaqualosgv tsidusquanoyvgo nasgiyai, hia naniwesgvgi, Yihowa edilvquoda; Ugvwiyuhiyeno Unelanvhi Winasdvna ulinigidv ugvwiyusadega.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎠᏆᏛᎦᏅᎩ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏣᏂᏁᎪ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎠᎹ ᏧᏍᏆᏃᏴᎪ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏓᏴᏓᏆᎶᏍᎬ ᏥᏚᏍᏆᏃᏴᎪ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏂᏪᏍᎬᎩ, ᏱᎰᏩ ᎡᏗᎸᏉᏓ; ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᏰᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏫᎾᏍᏛᎾ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎦ.
\ft And I heard as it were the voice of a great multitude, and as the voice of many waters, and as the voice of mighty thunderings, saying, Alleluia: for the Lord God omnipotent reigneth.

\ln Osdv idadanvdada ale idaliheligi, ale nasgi edilvquoda; Unodenayenoagina tsagatsvsdodiyi asqualv, udaliino advnvistanona.
\syll ᎣᏍᏛ ᎢᏓᏓᏅᏓᏓ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏓᎵᎮᎵᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᏗᎸᏉᏓ; ᎤᏃᏕᎾᏰᏃᎠᎩᎾ ᏣᎦᏨᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎠᏍᏆᎸ, ᎤᏓᎵᎢᏃ ᎠᏛᏅᎢᏍᏔᏃᎾ.
\ft Let us be glad and rejoice, and give honour to him: for the marriage of the Lamb is come, and his wife hath made herself ready.

\ln Ale nasgi agalisgolvdanelvgi usidoli doledv tsunuwosdiyi, digadaha nigesvna ale tsunegv; usidoliyeno doledv duyugodv nunadvnelidolv unadanvti gadvga.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎦᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᎸᎩ ᎤᏏᏙᎵ ᏙᎴᏛ ᏧᏄᏬᏍᏗᏱ, ᏗᎦᏓᎭ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎠᎴ ᏧᏁᎬ; ᎤᏏᏙᎵᏰᏃ ᏙᎴᏛ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᏄᎾᏛᏁᎵᏙᎸ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ ᎦᏛᎦ.
\ft And to her was granted that she should be arrayed in fine linen, clean and white: for the fine linen is the righteousness of saints.

\ln Hiano nagiweselvgi, Howelvga, (hianvga,) Osiyu iyunalisdanedi nasgi na Unodenaagina tsagatsvsdodiyi tsunalisdayvdiyi gesv uniluhisdiyi getsiyanvdv gesesdi.  Hiano nagiweselvgi, hia nasgi udohiyuhi iyuwedv Unelanvhi.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᎾᎩᏪᏎᎸᎩ, ᎰᏪᎸᎦ, ᎯᎠᏅᎦ, ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᏃᏕᎾᎠᎩᎾ ᏣᎦᏨᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏧᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏂᎷᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎨᏥᏯᏅᏛ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.  ᎯᎠᏃ ᎾᎩᏪᏎᎸᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎢᏳᏪᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ.
\ft And he saith unto me, Write, Blessed are they which are called unto the marriage supper of the Lamb. And he saith unto me, These are the true sayings of God.

\ln Dulasgvno aquadanvnvgi datsiyadadolisdanelisvgi.  Hiano nagiweselvgi, Vtlesdi.  Ayvyeno utloyiquo egininvsidasdi, ale ayv nasgi itsalinvtli tsigesv nasgi Tsisa utseli gohiyudisgi unihi; Unelanvhi hiyadadolisdasi; adolehohisdodiyeno gesv adanvdo ale Tsisa gohiyudanediyi utloyiquo.
\syll ᏚᎳᏍᎬᏃ ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏅᎩ ᏓᏥᏯᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎵᏒᎩ.  ᎯᎠᏃ ᎾᎩᏪᏎᎸᎩ, ᎥᏞᏍᏗ.  ᎠᏴᏰᏃ ᎤᏠᏱᏉ ᎡᎩᏂᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏣᎵᏅᏟ ᏥᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏌ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎪᎯᏳᏗᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᎯ; ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎯᏯᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏏ; ᎠᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏙᏗᏰᏃ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎠᎴ ᏥᏌ ᎪᎯᏳᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᎤᏠᏱᏉ.
\ft And I fell at his feet to worship him. And he said unto me, See thou do it not: I am thy fellowservant, and of thy brethren that have the testimony of Jesus: worship God: for the testimony of Jesus is the spirit of prophecy.

\ln Agigohvgino galvloi ulisduidv gesvgi, ale gvniyuquo unegv soquili (vtsigovgi;) ale nasgi nahna ugili, Nudalidasdvna Ale Duyugodv (iyadvnehi) agosehvgi, ale duyugodv gvdisgv degugodiha ale dahnawa gotlvsga.
\syll ᎠᎩᎪᎲᎩᏃ ᎦᎸᎶᎢ ᎤᎵᏍᏚᎢᏛ ᎨᏒᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎤᏁᎬ ᏐᏈᎵ ᎥᏥᎪᎥᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏀᎾ ᎤᎩᎵ, ᏄᏓᎵᏓᏍᏛᎾ ᎠᎴ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᎯ ᎠᎪᏎᎲᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎬᏗᏍᎬ ᏕᎫᎪᏗᎭ ᎠᎴ ᏓᎿᏩ ᎪᏢᏍᎦ.
\ft And I saw heaven opened, and behold a white horse; and he that sat upon him was called Faithful and True, and in righteousness he doth judge and make war.

\ln Digadoli atsilv adaweligisgi nasgiya gesvgi, asgolino utsati dulisdulvgi; ale dudov gowelvgi nasgi gilo gvwolisdi nigesvna uwasvsgininonv goligvgi.
\syll ᏗᎦᏙᎵ ᎠᏥᎸ ᎠᏓᏪᎵᎩᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎨᏒᎩ, ᎠᏍᎪᎵᏃ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏚᎵᏍᏚᎸᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᏚᏙᎥ ᎪᏪᎸᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎩᎶ ᎬᏬᎵᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎤᏩᏒᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎪᎵᎬᎩ.
\ft His eyes were as a flame of fire, and on his head were many crowns; and he had a name written, that no man knew, but he himself.

\ln Ale gigvhi gvnvhi anuwo unuwavgi; ale Unelanvhi Utseli Kanohedv agoseha atsiyanisgvi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎩᎬᎯ ᎬᏅᎯ ᎠᏄᏬ ᎤᏄᏩᎥᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎠᎪᏎᎭ ᎠᏥᏯᏂᏍᎬᎢ.
\ft And he was clothed with a vesture dipped in blood: and his name is called The Word of God.

\ln Ale aniyawisgi galvladi anehv gvwasdawadvsvgi uninegv soquili tsunagilvdi, tsusidoli doledv dinuwo dunanuwosdvgi, tsunegv ale digadaha nigesvna.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏯᏫᏍᎩ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎠᏁᎲ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏛᏒᎩ ᎤᏂᏁᎬ ᏐᏈᎵ ᏧᎾᎩᎸᏗ, ᏧᏏᏙᎵ ᏙᎴᏛ ᏗᏄᏬ ᏚᎾᏄᏬᏍᏛᎩ, ᏧᏁᎬ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎦᏓᎭ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.
\ft And the armies which were in heaven followed him upon white horses, clothed in fine linen, white and clean.

\ln Ale aholi diganugoga gosdaya hayelasdiganvhidv, nasgi tsuwanisdodiyi unadatselidv yvwi danewadisvi; ale talugisgi gvdi digvwanelododiyi nvdagvneli; ale telvladi gatsvwasdodiyi alasdaeha nasgi udasuyi usgasedi ale utalawohisdi gesv Winasdvna ulinigidv Unelanvhi utseliga.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎠᎰᎵ ᏗᎦᏄᎪᎦ ᎪᏍᏓᏯ ᎭᏰᎳᏍᏗᎦᏅᎯᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏩᏂᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᎾᏓᏤᎵᏛ ᏴᏫ ᏓᏁᏩᏗᏒᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᏔᎷᎩᏍᎩ ᎬᏗ ᏗᎬᏩᏁᎶᏙᏗᏱ ᏅᏓᎬᏁᎵ; ᎠᎴ ᏖᎸᎳᏗ ᎦᏨᏩᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎠᎳᏍᏓᎡᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏓᏑᏱ ᎤᏍᎦᏎᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏔᎳᏬᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏫᎾᏍᏛᎾ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ.
\ft And out of his mouth goeth a sharp sword, that with it he should smite the nations: and he shall rule them with a rod of iron: and he treadeth the winepress of the fierceness and wrath of Almighty God.

\ln Ale unuwogihi ale gagaloi tsudosdodi gowelvgi, (hia nigvnvgi,) NuNiGvWiYuSaDeGi ANeHv NuGvWiYuSaDeGi, ALe UNiGvWiYuHi ANeHv UGvWiYuHi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎤᏄᏬᎩᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎦᎦᎶᎢ ᏧᏙᏍᏙᏗ ᎪᏪᎸᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏅᎩ, ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ ᎠᏁᎲ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᏁᎲ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ.
\ft And he hath on his vesture and on his thigh a name written, KING OF KINGS, AND LORD OF LORDS.

\ln Dikahnawadidohino vtsigovgi nvdo igaehi kalv gvdogvgi; ale uwelunvgi asdaya unetsvgi, hia niduweselvgi nahiv tsisqua galvlo ayeli aninohilidohi, Etsena itsadatlisa atsilvquodi Unelanvhi utseli alisdayvdiyi gesvi;
\syll ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎯᏃ ᎥᏥᎪᎥᎩ ᏅᏙ ᎢᎦᎡᎯ ᎧᎸ ᎬᏙᎬᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᏪᎷᏅᎩ ᎠᏍᏓᏯ ᎤᏁᏨᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ ᏀᎢᎥ ᏥᏍᏆ ᎦᎸᎶ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎠᏂᏃᎯᎵᏙᎯ, ᎡᏤᎾ ᎢᏣᏓᏟᏌ ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ ᎨᏒᎢ;
\ft And I saw an angel standing in the sun; and he cried with a loud voice, saying to all the fowls that fly in the midst of heaven, Come and gather yourselves together unto the supper of the great God;

\ln Nasgi itsigisdiyi unigvwiyuhi uniquedalvi, ale anisgayegvsda uniquedalvi, ale tsunalinigidv anisgaya uniquedalvi, ale soquili uniquedalvi, ale nasgi na tsunagilvdi, nidigetsinatlavna ale digetsinatlai, nasquo tsunasdi ale tsunatanv.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏥᎩᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏂᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏂᏇᏓᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏰᎬᏍᏓ ᎤᏂᏇᏓᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᎾᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᏂᏇᏓᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏐᏈᎵ ᎤᏂᏇᏓᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏧᎾᎩᎸᏗ, ᏂᏗᎨᏥᎾᏝᎥᎾ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎨᏥᎾᏝᎢ, ᎾᏍᏉ ᏧᎾᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏧᎾᏔᏅ.
\ft That ye may eat the flesh of kings, and the flesh of captains, and the flesh of mighty men, and the flesh of horses, and of them that sit on them, and the flesh of all men, both free and bond, both small and great.

\ln Ale nasgi na nvgidiganvsadi vtsigovgi, ale unigvwiyuhi elohi danewadisvi, ale nasgi tsunatseli aniyawisgi, unadatlisanvgi dahnawa iyunvnediyi uniyelvsvgi nasgi na soquilihi ugili, ale nasgi tsutseli aniyawisgi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏅᎩᏗᎦᏅᏌᏗ ᎥᏥᎪᎥᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏓᏁᏩᏗᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᎾᏤᎵ ᎠᏂᏯᏫᏍᎩ, ᎤᎾᏓᏟᏌᏅᎩ ᏓᎿᏩ ᎢᏳᏅᏁᏗᏱ ᎤᏂᏰᎸᏒᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏐᏈᎵᎯ ᎤᎩᎵ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏤᎵ ᎠᏂᏯᏫᏍᎩ.
\ft And I saw the beast, and the kings of the earth, and their armies, gathered together to make war against him that sat on the horse, and against his army.

\ln Nvginodiganvsadi atsiyvginvgi, ale agatloyastanvgi utlonasdi adolehosgi nasgi agatahv usquanigodi tsidulvwisdanehvgi, nasgi tsidegalonuhedisgvgi nasgi na nvgidiganvsadi utseli udayelvdodi digetsiyelvtanvhi, ale nasgi na tsagatlilostanvhi anadadolisdanehi.  Hia nasgi itsula digvnvnodv widegegadainvsvgi atsilv tsvdalv nahna sagonige adawelagisgi didawelagisgvi.
\syll ᏅᎩᏃᏗᎦᏅᏌᏗ ᎠᏥᏴᎩᏅᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎦᏠᏯᏍᏔᏅᎩ ᎤᏠᎾᏍᏗ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎦᏔᎲ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᏥᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏕᎦᎶᏄᎮᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏅᎩᏗᎦᏅᏌᏗ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎤᏓᏰᎸᏙᏗ ᏗᎨᏥᏰᎸᏔᏅᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏣᎦᏟᎶᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎠᎾᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎯ.  ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏧᎳ ᏗᎬᏅᏃᏛ ᏫᏕᎨᎦᏓᎢᏅᏒᎩ ᎠᏥᎸ ᏨᏓᎸ ᏀᎾ ᏌᎪᏂᎨ ᎠᏓᏪᎳᎩᏍᎩ ᏗᏓᏪᎳᎩᏍᎬᎢ.
\ft And the beast was taken, and with him the false prophet that wrought miracles before him, with which he deceived them that had received the mark of the beast, and them that worshipped his image. These both were cast alive into a lake of fire burning with brimstone.

\ln Unalinohiyvhino hayelasdiganvhidv soquilihi ugili utseliga degetsiistanvgi, nasgi aholi tsvdaganugogvgi; nigadvno tsisqua nasgi uniquedalv dunolvhistanvgi.
\syll ᎤᎾᎵᏃᎯᏴᎯᏃ ᎭᏰᎳᏍᏗᎦᏅᎯᏛ ᏐᏈᎵᎯ ᎤᎩᎵ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᏕᎨᏥᎢᏍᏔᏅᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎰᎵ ᏨᏓᎦᏄᎪᎬᎩ; ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᏥᏍᏆ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᏇᏓᎸ ᏚᏃᎸᎯᏍᏔᏅᎩ.
\ft And the remnant were slain with the sword of him that sat upon the horse, which sword proceeded out of his mouth: and all the fowls were filled with their flesh.

\ln Dikahnawadidohino vtsigovgi galvladi dayutloasvgi, ganehvgi asduisdi winasdvna atalesvi, ale utsati equa tsudadesvdv usvgalvgi.
\syll ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎯᏃ ᎥᏥᎪᎥᎩ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏓᏳᏠᎠᏒᎩ, ᎦᏁᎲᎩ ᎠᏍᏚᎢᏍᏗ ᏫᎾᏍᏛᎾ ᎠᏔᎴᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎡᏆ ᏧᏓᏕᏒᏛ ᎤᏒᎦᎸᎩ.
\ft And I saw an angel come down from heaven, having the key of the bottomless pit and a great chain in his hand.

\ln Uniyvhvgino inadv, nasgi agayvli inadv, nasgi Asgina ale Sedani tsagosehoi, saquono iyagayvli itsudetiyvdv agalvlvgi,
\syll ᎤᏂᏴᎲᎩᏃ ᎢᎾᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎦᏴᎵ ᎢᎾᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᎩᎾ ᎠᎴ ᏎᏓᏂ ᏣᎪᏎᎰᎢ, ᏌᏉᏃ ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ ᎢᏧᏕᏘᏴᏛ ᎠᎦᎸᎸᎩ,
\ft And he laid hold on the dragon, that old serpent, which is the Devil, and Satan, and bound him a thousand years,

\ln Ale winasdvna ditalesv wagadainvsvgi, ale atsisdunvgi, ale uyelvtanvgi asduhvi, nasgi digvwalonuhedi hnaquo nigesvna iyulisdodiyi tsunadalenvdv yvwi danewadisvi, gvni saquo iyagayvli itsudetiyvdv yulosonv; onino hnaquo atsigodi igesesdi tlega.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏫᎾᏍᏛᎾ ᏗᏔᎴᏒ ᏩᎦᏓᎢᏅᏒᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏥᏍᏚᏅᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏰᎸᏔᏅᎩ ᎠᏍᏚᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎬᏩᎶᏄᎮᏗ ᎿᏉ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᏓᏁᏩᏗᏒᎢ, ᎬᏂ ᏌᏉ ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ ᎢᏧᏕᏘᏴᏛ ᏳᎶᏐᏅ; ᎣᏂᏃ ᎿᏉ ᎠᏥᎪᏗ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏞᎦ.
\ft And cast him into the bottomless pit, and shut him up, and set a seal upon him, that he should deceive the nations no more, till the thousand years should be fulfilled: and after that he must be loosed a little season.

\ln Ale dagigohv degasgilvi, nahnano unanvnvgi ale tsunugododiyi vgegalisgolvdanelvgi; ale dotsigovgi tsunadanvdo dige tsisgudesvhi nasgi Tsisa aninohesgv unisdvdvhi ale kanohedv Unelanvhi utseli aninohesgvi, ale nasgi unadadolisdanelvhi nigesvna nvgidiganvsadi, ale nasgi tsagatlilostanvhi, ale digegowelanvhi nigesvna dinigvdageni, ale tsunoyeni; ale nasgi Galonedv itsulaha anehvgi ale unigvwiyuhi vgesvgi saquo iyagayvli itsudetiyvdv.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏓᎩᎪᎲ ᏕᎦᏍᎩᎸᎢ, ᏀᎾᏃ ᎤᎾᏅᏅᎩ ᎠᎴ ᏧᏄᎪᏙᏗᏱ ᎥᎨᎦᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᎸᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᏙᏥᎪᎥᎩ ᏧᎾᏓᏅᏙ ᏗᎨ ᏥᏍᎫᏕᏒᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏌ ᎠᏂᏃᎮᏍᎬ ᎤᏂᏍᏛᏛᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎠᏂᏃᎮᏍᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏅᎩᏗᎦᏅᏌᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏣᎦᏟᎶᏍᏔᏅᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎨᎪᏪᎳᏅᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏗᏂᎬᏓᎨᏂ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏃᏰᏂ; ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎠᏁᎲᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎥᎨᏒᎩ ᏌᏉ ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ ᎢᏧᏕᏘᏴᏛ.
\ft And I saw thrones, and they sat upon them, and judgment was given unto them: and I saw the souls of them that were beheaded for the witness of Jesus, and for the word of God, and which had not worshipped the beast, neither his image, neither had received his mark upon their foreheads, or in their hands; and they lived and reigned with Christ a thousand years.

\ln Anisoisgini tsuniyohusvhi vtla yanehe gvni saquo iyagayvli itsudetiyvdv dulosonv.  Hia nasgi igvyiyi dilehisodi gesvi.
\syll ᎠᏂᏐᎢᏍᎩᏂ ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᎥᏝ ᏯᏁᎮ ᎬᏂ ᏌᏉ ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ ᎢᏧᏕᏘᏴᏛ ᏚᎶᏐᏅ.  ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎬᏱᏱ ᏗᎴᎯᏐᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft But the rest of the dead lived not again until the thousand years were finished. This is the first resurrection.

\ln Osiyu iyulisdanedi ale nasganvna nasgi na uweladisdisgi igvyiyi dilehisodi gesvi; nasgi vtla gohusdi yvgvwanvga taline ayohuhisdi gesvi, atsilvsginidinelohi gesesdi Unelanvhi ale Galonedv, ale [Galonedv] itsulaha unigvwiyuhi gesesdi saquo iyagayvli itsudetiyvdv.
\syll ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎦᏅᎾ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᏪᎳᏗᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᎢᎬᏱᏱ ᏗᎴᎯᏐᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎥᏝ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏴᎬᏩᏅᎦ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᏥᎸᏍᎩᏂᏗᏁᎶᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᎶᏁᏛdata is invalid ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎤᏂᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏌᏉ ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ ᎢᏧᏕᏘᏴᏛ.
\ft Blessed and holy is he that hath part in the first resurrection: on such the second death hath no power, but they shall be priests of God and of Christ, and shall reign with him a thousand years.

\ln Saquono iyagayvli itsudetiyvdv galosonv, Sedani dvatsikani dvatsinugowisi atsisduhvi;
\syll ᏌᏉᏃ ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ ᎢᏧᏕᏘᏴᏛ ᎦᎶᏐᏅ, ᏎᏓᏂ ᏛᎠᏥᎧᏂ ᏛᎠᏥᏄᎪᏫᏏ ᎠᏥᏍᏚᎲᎢ;
\ft And when the thousand years are expired, Satan shall be loosed out of his prison,

\ln Ale dvedoli tsulonuhediyi tsunadalenvdv yvwi nasgi nvgi nidudaadisv danewadisvi elohi tsaneha nasgi Goga ale Megoga, nasgi tsuwetlisodiyi tsunalisdiyi; nanivno noyu amequohi ahv naniv.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏛᎡᏙᎵ ᏧᎶᏄᎮᏗᏱ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᎩ ᏂᏚᏓᎠᏗᏒ ᏓᏁᏩᏗᏒᎢ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏣᏁᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᎦ ᎠᎴ ᎺᎪᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏪᏟᏐᏗᏱ ᏧᎾᎵᏍᏗᏱ; ᎾᏂᎥᏃ ᏃᏳ ᎠᎺᏉᎯ ᎠᎲ ᎾᏂᎥ.
\ft And shall go out to deceive the nations which are in the four quarters of the earth, Gog and Magog, to gather them together to battle: the number of whom is as the sand of the sea.

\ln Ale nigvnadv elohi unedolvgi, ale dunaduwistanvgi aninv unadanvti, ale osdv ayelvdi gaduhvi; atsilvno Uhilanvhiyi galvladi dvulosvgi ale dunihonvgi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏂᎬᎾᏛ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎤᏁᏙᎸᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᎾᏚᏫᏍᏔᏅᎩ ᎠᏂᏅ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ, ᎠᎴ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎠᏰᎸᏗ ᎦᏚᎲᎢ; ᎠᏥᎸᏃ ᎤᎯᎳᏅᎯᏱ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏛᎤᎶᏒᎩ ᎠᎴ ᏚᏂᎰᏅᎩ.
\ft And they went up on the breadth of the earth, and compassed the camp of the saints about, and the beloved city: and fire came down from God out of heaven, and devoured them.

\ln Asginano nasgi unilonuhelvhi atsilv ale sagonige adawelagisgi vdalv wagadainvsvgi, nahna anehv nvgidiganvsadi ale utlonasdi adolehosgi, ale getsigiliyoisdodi gesesdi nigohilv ale nigohilvi.
\syll ᎠᏍᎩᎾᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᎶᏄᎮᎸᎯ ᎠᏥᎸ ᎠᎴ ᏌᎪᏂᎨ ᎠᏓᏪᎳᎩᏍᎩ ᎥᏓᎸ ᏩᎦᏓᎢᏅᏒᎩ, ᏀᎾ ᎠᏁᎲ ᏅᎩᏗᎦᏅᏌᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏠᎾᏍᏗ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎨᏥᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎪᎯᎸᎢ.
\ft And the devil that deceived them was cast into the lake of fire and brimstone, where the beast and the false prophet are, and shall be tormented day and night for ever and ever.

\ln Ale agigohvgi equa unegv gasgilo, ale nasgi nahna uwoli, nasgi ukadvi elohi ale galvloi gvwalielvgi, vtla ale ilvhitlv gvwalielvgi, vtla ale ilvhitlv gvwadvdi yigese wunilohisdiyi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎠᎩᎪᎲᎩ ᎡᏆ ᎤᏁᎬ ᎦᏍᎩᎶ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏀᎾ ᎤᏬᎵ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎧᏛᎢ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎦᎸᎶᎢ ᎬᏩᎵᎡᎸᎩ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎢᎸᎯᏢ ᎬᏩᎵᎡᎸᎩ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎢᎸᎯᏢ ᎬᏩᏛᏗ ᏱᎨᏎ ᏭᏂᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ.
\ft And I saw a great white throne, and him that sat on it, from whose face the earth and the heaven fled away; and there was found no place for them.

\ln Ale tsuniyohusvhi vgatsigovgi, tsunasdi ale tsunadvna, Unelanvhi uwolv igvyiditlv dunalenvgi; gowelino dunisduisvgi; ale nvwadale goweli unisduisvgi, nasgi gvnidv adanehi tsigi; tsuniyohusvhino dogegugodanelvgi nasgiya nigvnv gowelv gowelihi, nasgiya nusdv dunilvwisdanelvi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᎥᎦᏥᎪᎥᎩ, ᏧᎾᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏧᎾᏛᎾ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏬᎸ ᎢᎬᏱᏗᏢ ᏚᎾᎴᏅᎩ; ᎪᏪᎵᏃ ᏚᏂᏍᏚᎢᏒᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᎪᏪᎵ ᎤᏂᏍᏚᎢᏒᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎠᏓᏁᎯ ᏥᎩ; ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯᏃ ᏙᎨᎫᎪᏓᏁᎸᎩ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏂᎬᏅ ᎪᏪᎸ ᎪᏪᎵᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏚᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸᎢ.
\ft And I saw the dead, small and great, stand before God; and the books were opened: and another book was opened, which is the book of life: and the dead were judged out of those things which were written in the books, according to their works.

\ln Amequohino duyosvgi tsuniyohusvhi nahna nunadvnvi; ayohuhisdino ale tsvsgino duniyosv tsuniyohusvhi nahna anehvi; ale degegugodanelvgi nigadiyu anisiyvwiha nasgiya nusdv dunilvwisdanelvi.
\syll ᎠᎺᏉᎯᏃ ᏚᏲᏒᎩ ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᏀᎾ ᏄᎾᏛᏅᎢ; ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗᏃ ᎠᎴ ᏨᏍᎩᏃ ᏚᏂᏲᏒ ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᏀᎾ ᎠᏁᎲᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᏕᎨᎫᎪᏓᏁᎸᎩ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᎠᏂᏏᏴᏫᎭ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏚᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸᎢ.
\ft And the sea gave up the dead which were in it; and death and hell delivered up the dead which were in them: and they were judged every man according to their works.

\ln Ayohuhisdino gesv ale tsvsgino atsilv tsvdalv widegegadainvsvgi.  Hia nasgi taline ayohuhisdi gesvi.
\syll ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗᏃ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏨᏍᎩᏃ ᎠᏥᎸ ᏨᏓᎸ ᏫᏕᎨᎦᏓᎢᏅᏒᎩ.  ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft And death and hell were cast into the lake of fire. This is the second death.

\ln Nanivno gilo (dunadov) nidigowelvna gesv hia nasgi gvnidv adanehi gowelihi, widegegadaiegvgi atsilv tsvdalvi.
\syll ᎾᏂᎥᏃ ᎩᎶ ᏚᎾᏙᎥ ᏂᏗᎪᏪᎸᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎠᏓᏁᎯ ᎪᏪᎵᎯ, ᏫᏕᎨᎦᏓᎢᎡᎬᎩ ᎠᏥᎸ ᏨᏓᎸᎢ.
\ft And whosoever was not found written in the book of life was cast into the lake of fire.

\ln Dagigohvgino itse galvloi ale itse gadohi; igvyiyiyeno galvloi ale igvyiyi gadohi tsigesvgi unilosonvgi; ale vtla hnaquo amequohi yigesei.
\syll ᏓᎩᎪᎲᎩᏃ ᎢᏤ ᎦᎸᎶᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏤ ᎦᏙᎯ; ᎢᎬᏱᏱᏰᏃ ᎦᎸᎶᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎢᎬᏱᏱ ᎦᏙᎯ ᏥᎨᏒᎩ ᎤᏂᎶᏐᏅᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᎿᏉ ᎠᎺᏉᎯ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ.
\ft And I saw a new heaven and a new earth: for the first heaven and the first earth were passed away; and there was no more sea.

\ln Ale ayv Tsani agigohvgi galvquodiyu gaduhv nasgi itse Tsilusilimi dayutloasvgi Unelanvhiyi galvloi, udvnvisdvgi nasgiya atsiyehi tsadoduisdisgo tsadvnvisdaneho uyehi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴ ᏣᏂ ᎠᎩᎪᎲᎩ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎦᏚᎲ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏤ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᏓᏳᏠᎠᏒᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏱ ᎦᎸᎶᎢ, ᎤᏛᏅᎢᏍᏛᎩ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎠᏥᏰᎯ ᏣᏙᏚᎢᏍᏗᏍᎪ ᏣᏛᏅᎢᏍᏓᏁᎰ ᎤᏰᎯ.
\ft And I John saw the holy city, new Jerusalem, coming down from God out of heaven, prepared as a bride adorned for her husband.

\ln Aquadvganvgino asdaya kanegv gilo galvladi dvdalehvsgvgi hia nigawesgvgi, Gvniyuquo Unelanvhi ulitsodv yvwi anehv udasuya, ale Unelanvhi nasgi anehv dvdeni, ale nasgi tsutseli gesesdi yvwi, Unelanvhino uwasv nasgi anehv ehesdi unatseli Unelanvhi gesesdi.
\syll ᎠᏆᏛᎦᏅᎩᏃ ᎠᏍᏓᏯ ᎧᏁᎬ ᎩᎶ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏛᏓᎴᎲᏍᎬᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎬᎩ, ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎵᏦᏛ ᏴᏫ ᎠᏁᎲ ᎤᏓᏑᏯ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏁᎲ ᏛᏕᏂ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏤᎵ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏴᏫ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏃ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏁᎲ ᎡᎮᏍᏗ ᎤᎾᏤᎵ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft And I heard a great voice out of heaven saying, Behold, the tabernacle of God is with men, and he will dwell with them, and they shall be his people, and God himself shall be with them, and be their God.

\ln Ale Unelanvhi dodaganvgalvhi nigadv danigasawoihvi; vtla ale hnaquo yehesdi ayohuhisdi, ale uyo ayelvdi gesv, ale ditloyasdi gesvi, vtla ale hnaquo yehesdi ehisdi gesvi; igvyiyiyeno tsudalenvdv tsehv ulosonv.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏙᏓᎦᏅᎦᎸᎯ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏓᏂᎦᏌᏬᎢᎲᎢ; ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎿᏉ ᏰᎮᏍᏗ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏲ ᎠᏰᎸᏗ ᎨᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏠᏯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎿᏉ ᏰᎮᏍᏗ ᎡᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎢᎬᏱᏱᏰᏃ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏤᎲ ᎤᎶᏐᏅ.
\ft And God shall wipe away all tears from their eyes; and there shall be no more death, neither sorrow, nor crying, neither shall there be any more pain: for the former things are passed away.

\ln Gasgilvno uwoli, hia nuwesvgi, Gvniyuquo nigadiyu tsudalenvdv itse nigvneha.  Ale hia nagiweselvgi, Howelvga; hiayeno nasgi kanohedv gvdlasidvedi nigesvna ale udohiyuhiya.
\syll ᎦᏍᎩᎸᏃ ᎤᏬᎵ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ, ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎢᏤ ᏂᎬᏁᎭ.  ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᎾᎩᏪᏎᎸᎩ, ᎰᏪᎸᎦ; ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎬᏜᏏᏛᎡᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ.
\ft And he that sat upon the throne said, Behold, I make all things new. And he said unto me, Write: for these words are true and faithful.

\ln Ale hia nagiweselvgi; Nasgi nisalisda.  Ayv Eliqua ale Omiga, igvyiyi gesv ale ulisqualvdi gesvi.  Utadegisgi ama gvnidv adanehi ganugogv datsineneli tsugvwalodi nigesvna.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᎾᎩᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᏌᎵᏍᏓ.  ᎠᏴ ᎡᎵᏆ ᎠᎴ ᎣᎻᎦ, ᎢᎬᏱᏱ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᎸᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.  ᎤᏔᏕᎩᏍᎩ ᎠᎹ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎠᏓᏁᎯ ᎦᏄᎪᎬ ᏓᏥᏁᏁᎵ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.
\ft And he said unto me, It is done. I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the end. I will give unto him that is athirst of the fountain of the water of life freely.

\ln Gilo adasegogisgesdi nigadiyu tsudalenvdv utseli iyulisdodi gesesdi; ale ayv Tsiyanelanvhi gesesdi, uwasvno ayv aquetsi gesesdi.
\syll ᎩᎶ ᎠᏓᏎᎪᎩᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴ ᏥᏯᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎤᏩᏒᏃ ᎠᏴ ᎠᏇᏥ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft He that overcometh shall inherit all things; and I will be his God, and he shall be my son.

\ln Unisgaenasgini. ale nunohiyusvna, ale unisgaisdi, ale dinadahihi, ale uninegutsidv, ale dinadonisgi, ale Unelanvhi diyelvhi dinadadolisdanehi, ale nigadiyu aniyegogi, unatseli igegvnedi gesesdi vdalv nahna adaweligisgv atsilv ale sagonige adaweligisgi; nasgi taline ayohuhisdi tsigi.
\syll ᎤᏂᏍᎦᎡᎾᏍᎩᏂ. ᎠᎴ ᏄᏃᎯᏳᏒᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏍᎦᎢᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎾᏓᎯᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏁᎫᏥᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎾᏙᏂᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏗᏰᎸᎯ ᏗᎾᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᎠᏂᏰᎪᎩ, ᎤᎾᏤᎵ ᎢᎨᎬᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎥᏓᎸ ᏀᎾ ᎠᏓᏪᎵᎩᏍᎬ ᎠᏥᎸ ᎠᎴ ᏌᎪᏂᎨ ᎠᏓᏪᎵᎩᏍᎩ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᏥᎩ.
\ft But the fearful, and unbelieving, and the abominable, and murderers, and whoremongers, and sorcerers, and idolaters, and all liars, shall have their part in the lake which burneth with fire and brimstone: which is the second death.

\ln Agilutselvgino asiyvwi nasgi na galiquogi iyanidv dinikahnawadidohi, nasgi tsidaniyehvgi duliquogi gugu galiquogi ulisqualvdi udeyadodi ditlisdi, ale aqualinohetanvgi, hia nuwesvgi; Ehena, dagvyasehelino atsiyehi unodena agina udalii.
\syll ᎠᎩᎷᏤᎸᎩᏃ ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎦᎵᏉᎩ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᏗᏂᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏓᏂᏰᎲᎩ ᏚᎵᏉᎩ ᎫᎫ ᎦᎵᏉᎩ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᎸᏗ ᎤᏕᏯᏙᏗ ᏗᏟᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏆᎵᏃᎮᏔᏅᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎡᎮᎾ, ᏓᎬᏯᏎᎮᎵᏃ ᎠᏥᏰᎯ ᎤᏃᏕᎾ ᎠᎩᎾ ᎤᏓᎵᎢ.
\ft And there came unto me one of the seven angels which had the seven vials full of the seven last plagues, and talked with me, saying, Come hither, I will shew thee the bride, the Lamb's wife.

\ln Aquatinawidvhvgino diquadanvdv equa ale inv igati tsodalvi waquatinvstanvgi, ale aginanugowiselvgi na equa gaduhvi, nasgi galvquodi Tsilusilimi, eladi nvdayusdidisvgi galvladi Unelanvhiyi dvdalehvsgvgi.
\syll ᎠᏆᏘᎾᏫᏛᎲᎩᏃ ᏗᏆᏓᏅᏛ ᎡᏆ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏅ ᎢᎦᏘ ᏦᏓᎸᎢ ᏩᏆᏘᏅᏍᏔᏅᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎩᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᎸᎩ Ꮎ ᎡᏆ ᎦᏚᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎸᏉᏗ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ, ᎡᎳᏗ ᏅᏓᏳᏍᏗᏗᏒᎩ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏱ ᏛᏓᎴᎲᏍᎬᎩ.
\ft And he carried me away in the spirit to a great and high mountain, and shewed me that great city, the holy Jerusalem, descending out of heaven from God,

\ln Galvquodiyu gesv Unelanvhi utseliga utsanodvgi; ale nasgi dulvsadv, nvya utsati tsugvwalodi nasgiya gesvgi, nasgi tsasqua nvya nasgiyai digvwalvsadv gesvgi.
\syll ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᎤᏣᏃᏛᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᎸᏌᏛ, ᏅᏯ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎨᏒᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏣᏍᏆ ᏅᏯ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ ᏗᎬᏩᎸᏌᏛ ᎨᏒᎩ.
\ft Having the glory of God: and her light was like unto a stone most precious, even like a jasper stone, clear as crystal;

\ln Asoyvgino equa inv igati, galohisdiyino taladu degotlvsvgi, ale galohisdiyi taladu iyanidv dinikahnawadidohi [danidogvgi,] dunadovno degowelvgi galohisdiyi, nasgi taladu nanilasdalv Isili tsuwetsi dunadovi.
\syll ᎠᏐᏴᎩᏃ ᎡᏆ ᎢᏅ ᎢᎦᏘ, ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱᏃ ᏔᎳᏚ ᏕᎪᏢᏒᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏔᎳᏚ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᏗᏂᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏓᏂᏙᎬᎩ,data is invalid ᏚᎾᏙᎥᏃ ᏕᎪᏪᎸᎩ ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏔᎳᏚ ᎾᏂᎳᏍᏓᎸ ᎢᏏᎵ ᏧᏪᏥ ᏚᎾᏙᎥᎢ.
\ft And had a wall great and high, and had twelve gates, and at the gates twelve angels, and names written thereon, which are the names of the twelve tribes of the children of Israel:

\ln Nvdo dikalvgv iditlv tsoi galohisdiyi [degotlvsvgi,] tsuyvtlvno iditlv tsoi galohisdiyi; tsuganawvno iditlv tsoi galohisdiyi; wudeligvno iditlv tsoi galohisdiyi.
\syll ᏅᏙ ᏗᎧᎸᎬ ᎢᏗᏢ ᏦᎢ ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏕᎪᏢᏒᎩ,data is invalid ᏧᏴᏢᏃ ᎢᏗᏢ ᏦᎢ ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ; ᏧᎦᎾᏮᏃ ᎢᏗᏢ ᏦᎢ ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ; ᏭᏕᎵᎬᏃ ᎢᏗᏢ ᏦᎢ ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ.
\ft On the east three gates; on the north three gates; on the south three gates; and on the west three gates.

\ln Asoyvno gaduhv taladu degagusdavgi, degagusdavno taladu dunadovi [degowelvgi,] nasgi taladu iyanidv Unodena agina tsunvsidv dunadovi.
\syll ᎠᏐᏴᏃ ᎦᏚᎲ ᏔᎳᏚ ᏕᎦᎫᏍᏓᎥᎩ, ᏕᎦᎫᏍᏓᎥᏃ ᏔᎳᏚ ᏚᎾᏙᎥᎢ ᏕᎪᏪᎸᎩ,data is invalid ᎾᏍᎩ ᏔᎳᏚ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᎤᏃᏕᎾ ᎠᎩᎾ ᏧᏅᏏᏛ ᏚᎾᏙᎥᎢ.
\ft And the wall of the city had twelve foundations, and in them the names of the twelve apostles of the Lamb.

\ln Nasgino aqualinohetanvhi ganehvgi adelvdalonige atlvtanvhi atlilosdi, gaduhv atlilosdi, ale galohisdiyi ditlilosdi, ale asoyv atlilosdi.
\syll ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎠᏆᎵᏃᎮᏔᏅᎯ ᎦᏁᎲᎩ ᎠᏕᎸᏓᎶᏂᎨ ᎠᏢᏔᏅᎯ ᎠᏟᎶᏍᏗ, ᎦᏚᎲ ᎠᏟᎶᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏗᏟᎶᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏐᏴ ᎠᏟᎶᏍᏗ.
\ft And he that talked with me had a golden reed to measure the city, and the gates thereof, and the wall thereof.

\ln Gaduhvno nvgi tsunvsiyv gesvgi, ganvhisv ale ayadvv utloyiquo gesvgi.  Utlilovgino gaduhv uwatanvgi atlilosdi, hisgigadu iyasgohitsuqui iyutlilodv nigvgi.  Niganvhisv ale nayadvhv ale nigadvi utloyiquo gesvgi.
\syll ᎦᏚᎲᏃ ᏅᎩ ᏧᏅᏏᏴ ᎨᏒᎩ, ᎦᏅᎯᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏯᏛᎥ ᎤᏠᏱᏉ ᎨᏒᎩ.  ᎤᏟᎶᎥᎩᏃ ᎦᏚᎲ ᎤᏩᏔᏅᎩ ᎠᏟᎶᏍᏗ, ᎯᏍᎩᎦᏚ ᎢᏯᏍᎪᎯᏧᏈ ᎢᏳᏟᎶᏛ ᏂᎬᎩ.  ᏂᎦᏅᎯᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏯᏛᎲ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛᎢ ᎤᏠᏱᏉ ᎨᏒᎩ.
\ft And the city lieth foursquare, and the length is as large as the breadth: and he measured the city with the reed, twelve thousand furlongs. The length and the breadth and the height of it are equal.

\ln Aseyvno utlilovgi asgohitsuqui nvgasgohi nvgigali iyagiyusquidv utlilovgi, nasgi yvwi utlilosdi iganvhidv, nasgi dikahnawadidohi utlilosdi.
\syll ᎠᏎᏴᏃ ᎤᏟᎶᎥᎩ ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏧᏈ ᏅᎦᏍᎪᎯ ᏅᎩᎦᎵ ᎢᏯᎩᏳᏍᏈᏛ ᎤᏟᎶᎥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏟᎶᏍᏗ ᎢᎦᏅᎯᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎤᏟᎶᏍᏗ.
\ft And he measured the wall thereof, an hundred and forty and four cubits, according to the measure of a man, that is, of the angel.

\ln Asoyvno tsasqua nvya anesgedvgi; gaduhvno gohusdi nasuyvna adelv dalonige gotlvdvgi, tsulvsadv adagedi nasgiyai.
\syll ᎠᏐᏴᏃ ᏣᏍᏆ ᏅᏯ ᎠᏁᏍᎨᏛᎩ; ᎦᏚᎲᏃ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎾᏑᏴᎾ ᎠᏕᎸ ᏓᎶᏂᎨ ᎪᏢᏛᎩ, ᏧᎸᏌᏛ ᎠᏓᎨᏗ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ.
\ft And the building of the wall of it was of jasper: and the city was pure gold, like unto clear glass.

\ln Degagusdavno asoyv gaduhvi degoduisdvgi nudalesv digalvquodi nvya; igvyiyi gagusdav tsasqua gesvgi, talineno saquaya, tsoineno galisidoni, nvgineno emila,
\syll ᏕᎦᎫᏍᏓᎥᏃ ᎠᏐᏴ ᎦᏚᎲᎢ ᏕᎪᏚᎢᏍᏛᎩ ᏄᏓᎴᏒ ᏗᎦᎸᏉᏗ ᏅᏯ; ᎢᎬᏱᏱ ᎦᎫᏍᏓᎥ ᏣᏍᏆ ᎨᏒᎩ, ᏔᎵᏁᏃ ᏌᏆᏯ, ᏦᎢᏁᏃ ᎦᎵᏏᏙᏂ, ᏅᎩᏁᏃ ᎡᎻᎳ,
\ft And the foundations of the wall of the city were garnished with all manner of precious stones. The first foundation was jasper; the second, sapphire; the third, a chalcedony; the fourth, an emerald;

\ln Hisgino sadonigi, sudalineno sadiyi, galiquogineno gisoladi, tsunelineno queli, soonelineno doquasi, asgohineno tlisaquesa, sadusineno tsesini, taladusineno amidisi.
\syll ᎯᏍᎩᏃ ᏌᏙᏂᎩ, ᏑᏓᎵᏁᏃ ᏌᏗᏱ, ᎦᎵᏉᎩᏁᏃ ᎩᏐᎳᏗ, ᏧᏁᎵᏁᏃ ᏇᎵ, ᏐᎣᏁᎵᏁᏃ ᏙᏆᏏ, ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏁᏃ ᏟᏌᏇᏌ, ᏌᏚᏏᏁᏃ ᏤᏏᏂ, ᏔᎳᏚᏏᏁᏃ ᎠᎻᏗᏏ.
\ft The fifth, sardonyx; the sixth, sardius; the seventh, chrysolite; the eighth, beryl; the ninth, a topaz; the tenth, a chrysoprasus; the eleventh, a jacinth; the twelfth, an amethyst.

\ln Taladuno degotlvsv disdudi taladu dagvnaiyunasdi degotlvdvgi; saquo asdudi saquo dagvnaiyusdi gotlvdvgi edasdiyi udlanvdv gaduhv gohusdi nasuyvna adelv dalonige atlvdvgi, tsulvsadv adagedi nasgiyai.
\syll ᏔᎳᏚᏃ ᏕᎪᏢᏒ ᏗᏍᏚᏗ ᏔᎳᏚ ᏓᎬᎾᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗ ᏕᎪᏢᏛᎩ; ᏌᏉ ᎠᏍᏚᏗ ᏌᏉ ᏓᎬᎾᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎪᏢᏛᎩ ᎡᏓᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏜᏅᏛ ᎦᏚᎲ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎾᏑᏴᎾ ᎠᏕᎸ ᏓᎶᏂᎨ ᎠᏢᏛᎩ, ᏧᎸᏌᏛ ᎠᏓᎨᏗ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ.
\ft And the twelve gates were twelve pearls; every several gate was of one pearl: and the street of the city was pure gold, as it were transparent glass.

\ln Vtla ale yagigohe nahna digalawiisdiyi; ugvwiyuhiyeno Unelanvhi Winasdvna ulinigidv ale Unodenaagina nasgi digalawiisdiyi igi.
\syll ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᏯᎩᎪᎮ ᏀᎾ ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ; ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᏰᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏫᎾᏍᏛᎾ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏃᏕᎾᎠᎩᎾ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎢᎩ.
\ft And I saw no temple therein: for the Lord God Almighty and the Lamb are the temple of it.

\ln Gaduhvno vtla yunaduli nvdoigaehi ale nvdoenoyiehi ugalihisdiyi nahnani; galvquodiyuyeno gesv Unelanvhi utseli iga utisdv nahnani, ale Unodenaagina iga atisdisgi igi nahnani.
\syll ᎦᏚᎲᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏳᎾᏚᎵ ᏅᏙᎢᎦᎡᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏅᏙᎡᏃᏱᎡᎯ ᎤᎦᎵᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏀᎾᏂ; ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳᏰᏃ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎢᎦ ᎤᏘᏍᏛ ᏀᎾᏂ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏃᏕᎾᎠᎩᎾ ᎢᎦ ᎠᏘᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᎢᎩ ᏀᎾᏂ.
\ft And the city had no need of the sun, neither of the moon, to shine in it: for the glory of God did lighten it, and the Lamb is the light thereof.

\ln Tsunadalenvdvno yvwi nasgi getsisdelvdv gesv nasgi dulvsadv anedohesdi; unigvwiyuno elohi anehi nahna aniyvhiha getsilvquodv ale tsunatseli tsudalenvdv digalvquodi.
\syll ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛᏃ ᏴᏫ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᏥᏍᏕᎸᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᎸᏌᏛ ᎠᏁᏙᎮᏍᏗ; ᎤᏂᎬᏫᏳᏃ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎠᏁᎯ ᏀᎾ ᎠᏂᏴᎯᎭ ᎨᏥᎸᏉᏛ ᎠᎴ ᏧᎾᏤᎵ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏗᎦᎸᏉᏗ.
\ft And the nations of them which are saved shall walk in the light of it: and the kings of the earth do bring their glory and honour into it.

\ln Ale galohisdiyi nahna degotlvsv vtla tsunisdudi yigesesdi iga, vtlayeno svnoyi yigesesdi nahnani.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏀᎾ ᏕᎪᏢᏒ ᎥᏝ ᏧᏂᏍᏚᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎢᎦ, ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᏒᏃᏱ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏀᎾᏂ.
\ft And the gates of it shall not be shut at all by day: for there shall be no night there.

\ln Ale nahna aniyohihesdi tsunadalenvdv ayv unatseli galvquodiyu gesv ale tsadalenvdv digalvquodi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᏀᎾ ᎠᏂᏲᎯᎮᏍᏗ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎠᏴ ᎤᎾᏤᎵ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏣᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏗᎦᎸᏉᏗ.
\ft And they shall bring the glory and honour of the nations into it.

\ln Ale vtla ase nahna uyvsdi yigesesdi gohusdi gadaha, ale uniquatisdi tsulvwisdanehi, ale gayegogi; unvsvsgini [uniyvsdi gesesdi dunadov] digoweli gvnidv adanehi gowelihi Unodenaagina utseliga.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᎠᏎ ᏀᎾ ᎤᏴᏍᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎦᏓᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏆᏘᏍᏗ ᏧᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᏰᎪᎩ; ᎤᏅᏒᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏂᏴᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏚᎾᏙᎥdata is invalid ᏗᎪᏪᎵ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎠᏓᏁᎯ ᎪᏪᎵᎯ ᎤᏃᏕᎾᎠᎩᎾ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ.
\ft And there shall in no wise enter into it any thing that defileth, neither whatsoever worketh abomination, or maketh a lie: but they which are written in the Lamb's book of life.

\ln Aginanugowiselvgino unegv uweyv ama gvnidv adanehi, digvwalvsadv gesvgi, dagananugogvgi gasgilv Unelanvhi ale Unodena agina unatseliga.
\syll ᎠᎩᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᎸᎩᏃ ᎤᏁᎬ ᎤᏪᏴ ᎠᎹ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎠᏓᏁᎯ, ᏗᎬᏩᎸᏌᏛ ᎨᏒᎩ, ᏓᎦᎾᏄᎪᎬᎩ ᎦᏍᎩᎸ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏃᏕᎾ ᎠᎩᎾ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ.
\ft And he shewed me a pure river of water of life, clear as crystal, proceeding out of the throne of God and of the Lamb.

\ln Ayelino udlanvdv nahna edasdiyi, ale itsuladitlv uweyvi, tlugvgi gvnidv adanehi tlugvi, nasgi taladu iyudalegi adadvsgvgi ale nidatsolanisv gvnasgvgi udatanvhi; ulasdusvno unanvwodi gesvgi tsunadalenvdv yvwi.
\syll ᎠᏰᎵᏃ ᎤᏜᏅᏛ ᏀᎾ ᎡᏓᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏧᎳᏗᏢ ᎤᏪᏴᎢ, ᏡᎬᎩ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎠᏓᏁᎯ ᏡᎬᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏔᎳᏚ ᎢᏳᏓᎴᎩ ᎠᏓᏛᏍᎬᎩ ᎠᎴ ᏂᏓᏦᎳᏂᏒ ᎬᎾᏍᎬᎩ ᎤᏓᏔᏅᎯ; ᎤᎳᏍᏚᏒᏃ ᎤᎾᏅᏬᏗ ᎨᏒᎩ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ.
\ft In the midst of the street of it, and on either side of the river, was there the tree of life, which bare twelve manner of fruits, and yielded her fruit every month: and the leaves of the tree were for the healing of the nations.

\ln Vtla ale hnaquo yehesdi usonvi; Unelanvhisgini utseli ale Unodena agina utseli gasgilo nahna gasgilesdi; tsutselino tsunvsidasdi gvwadadolisdanehesdi;
\syll ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎿᏉ ᏰᎮᏍᏗ ᎤᏐᏅᎢ; ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏃᏕᎾ ᎠᎩᎾ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎦᏍᎩᎶ ᏀᎾ ᎦᏍᎩᎴᏍᏗ; ᏧᏤᎵᏃ ᏧᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎬᏩᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ;
\ft And there shall be no more curse: but the throne of God and of the Lamb shall be in it; and his servants shall serve him:

\ln Ukadvno anigowatisgesdi; dudovno nasgi dinigvdageni degowelesdi.
\syll ᎤᎧᏛᏃ ᎠᏂᎪᏩᏘᏍᎨᏍᏗ; ᏚᏙᎥᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏂᎬᏓᎨᏂ ᏕᎪᏪᎴᏍᏗ.
\ft And they shall see his face; and his name shall be in their foreheads.

\ln Vtla ale svnoyi yigesesdi nahnani, vtla ale yunaduli atsvsdodi, ale nvdo igaehi iga utisdvi; Ugvwiyuhiyeno Unelanvhi iga datisdaneha, unigvwiyuhino gesesdi ulisquadisdi nigesvna.
\syll ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᏒᏃᏱ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏀᎾᏂ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᏳᎾᏚᎵ ᎠᏨᏍᏙᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏅᏙ ᎢᎦᎡᎯ ᎢᎦ ᎤᏘᏍᏛᎢ; ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᏰᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᎦ ᏓᏘᏍᏓᏁᎭ, ᎤᏂᎬᏫᏳᎯᏃ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.
\ft And there shall be no night there; and they need no candle, neither light of the sun; for the Lord God giveth them light: and they shall reign for ever and ever.

\ln Hiano nagiweselvgi, Hia nasgi kanohedv gvdlasidvedi nigesvna ale udohiyuhiya.  Ugvwiyuhino Unelanvhi getsilvquodi anadolehosgi unatseliga tsunvse utseli dikahnawadidohi gvnigesv itsuwanediyi tsutseli tsunvsidasdi, nasgi tsudalenvdv nigohilvnaquo iyulisdodi gesvi.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᎾᎩᏪᏎᎸᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎬᏜᏏᏛᎡᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ.  ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎨᏥᎸᏉᏗ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ ᏧᏅᏎ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏧᏩᏁᏗᏱ ᏧᏤᎵ ᏧᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏂᎪᎯᎸᎾᏉ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
\ft And he said unto me, These sayings are faithful and true: and the Lord God of the holy prophets sent his angel to shew unto his servants the things which must shortly be done.

\ln Gvniyuquo tlegiyu datsilutsi; osiyu iyulisdanedi asquanigodisgi kanohedv adolehosvhi ani gowelihi gowelvi.
\syll ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᏞᎩᏳ ᏓᏥᎷᏥ; ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎠᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗᏍᎩ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏒᎯ ᎠᏂ ᎪᏪᎵᎯ ᎪᏪᎸᎢ.
\ft Behold, I come quickly: blessed is he that keepeth the sayings of the prophecy of this book.

\ln Ale ayv Tsani agigohvgi hia nasgi tsudalenvdv, ale aquadvganvgi.  Aquadvganvno ale agigohv, eladi aquadanvnvgi dagadadolistanisvgi dulasgv nasgi na dikahnawadidohi hia nasgi tsudalenvdv aginanugowiselvhi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴ ᏣᏂ ᎠᎩᎪᎲᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏆᏛᎦᏅᎩ.  ᎠᏆᏛᎦᏅᏃ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎩᎪᎲ, ᎡᎳᏗ ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏅᎩ ᏓᎦᏓᏙᎵᏍᏔᏂᏒᎩ ᏚᎳᏍᎬ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎠᎩᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᎸᎯ.
\ft And I John saw these things, and heard them. And when I had heard and seen, I fell down to worship before the feet of the angel which shewed me these things.

\ln Hiano nagiweselvgi, Vtlesdi.  Ayvyeno utloyiquo egininvsidasdi, ale ayv nasgi anadolehosgi tsigesv itsalinvtli, ale nasgi anisquanigodisgi kanohedv ani gowelihi gowelvi; unelanvhi hiyadadolisdasi.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᎾᎩᏪᏎᎸᎩ, ᎥᏞᏍᏗ.  ᎠᏴᏰᏃ ᎤᏠᏱᏉ ᎡᎩᏂᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᏥᎨᏒ ᎢᏣᎵᏅᏟ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗᏍᎩ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎠᏂ ᎪᏪᎵᎯ ᎪᏪᎸᎢ; ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎯᏯᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏏ.
\ft Then saith he unto me, See thou do it not: for I am thy fellowservant, and of thy brethren the prophets, and of them which keep the sayings of this book: worship God.

\ln Hiano nagiweselvgi, Tlesdi tsasdunvgi kanohedv adolehosvhi ani hia gowelihi; usqualvhidiyeno.
\syll ᎯᎠᏃ ᎾᎩᏪᏎᎸᎩ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᏣᏍᏚᏅᎩ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏒᎯ ᎠᏂ ᎯᎠ ᎪᏪᎵᎯ; ᎤᏍᏆᎸᎯᏗᏰᏃ.
\ft And he saith unto me, Seal not the sayings of the prophecy of this book: for the time is at hand.

\ln Gilo asgana gesesdi, asiquo asgana gesesdi; gilono gadaha gesesdi, asiquo gadaha gesesdi; gilono osiyu iyadvnehi gesesdi, asiquo osiyu iyadvnehi gesesdi; gilono asgana nigesvna gesesdi, asiquo asgana nigesvna gesesdi.
\syll ᎩᎶ ᎠᏍᎦᎾ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎠᏏᏉ ᎠᏍᎦᎾ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᎩᎶᏃ ᎦᏓᎭ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎠᏏᏉ ᎦᏓᎭ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᎩᎶᏃ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎠᏏᏉ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᎩᎶᏃ ᎠᏍᎦᎾ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎠᏏᏉ ᎠᏍᎦᎾ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
\ft He that is unjust, let him be unjust still: and he which is filthy, let him be filthy still: and he that is righteous, let him be righteous still: and he that is holy, let him be holy still.

\ln Ale gvniyuquo tlegiyu datsilutsi; ale aquaguyvdi tsiyehesdi, gatsinediyi naniv anisiyvwiha nasgiya nusdv dunilvwisdanelvi.
\syll ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᏞᎩᏳ ᏓᏥᎷᏥ; ᎠᎴ ᎠᏆᎫᏴᏗ ᏥᏰᎮᏍᏗ, ᎦᏥᏁᏗᏱ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎠᏂᏏᏴᏫᎭ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏚᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸᎢ.
\ft And, behold, I come quickly; and my reward is with me, to give every man according as his work shall be.

\ln Ayv Eliqua ale Omiga, didalenvdisgi ale asquadisdisgi, ale igvyiyi ale ulisqualvi.
\syll ᎠᏴ ᎡᎵᏆ ᎠᎴ ᎣᎻᎦ, ᏗᏓᎴᏅᏗᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏍᏆᏗᏍᏗᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᎬᏱᏱ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᎸᎢ.
\ft I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the end, the first and the last.

\ln Osiyu iyunalisdanedi nasgi na utseli dikahnawadvsdi nigawesgv iyanadvnehi, nasgi gvnidv tlugv unatseli iyulisdodiyi, ale wigvwaniyvsdi iyulisdodiyi galohisdiyi gotlvsv gaduhvi.
\syll ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎬ ᎢᏯᎾᏛᏁᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏂᏛ ᏡᎬ ᎤᎾᏤᎵ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏫᎬᏩᏂᏴᏍᏗ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎪᏢᏒ ᎦᏚᎲᎢ.
\ft Blessed are they that do his commandments, that they may have right to the tree of life, and may enter in through the gates into the city.

\ln Doyiditlvyeno anedoha gilo, ale dinadonisgi, ale uninegutsidv, ale dinadahihi, ale Unelanvhi diyelvhi dinadadolisdanehi, ale nigadiyu osiyu uniyelvhi gayegogi gesv, ale gayegogi anotlvsgi.
\syll ᏙᏱᏗᏢᏰᏃ ᎠᏁᏙᎭ ᎩᎶ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎾᏙᏂᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏁᎫᏥᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎾᏓᎯᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏗᏰᎸᎯ ᏗᎾᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎤᏂᏰᎸᎯ ᎦᏰᎪᎩ ᎨᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᏰᎪᎩ ᎠᏃᏢᏍᎩ.
\ft For without are dogs, and sorcerers, and whoremongers, and murderers, and idolaters, and whosoever loveth and maketh a lie.

\ln Ayv Tsisa ditsinvsv aquatseli dikahnawadidohi gvnigesv itsvnediyi hia nasgi tsudalenvdv tsunanelodi dunadatluwadisvi.  Ayv Dewi uwetsi ale nasgi unetlvtanvdv gesvi, ale noquisi tsugadoyvisdi ale sunale ehi.
\syll ᎠᏴ ᏥᏌ ᏗᏥᏅᏒ ᎠᏆᏤᎵ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏨᏁᏗᏱ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᏚᎾᏓᏡᏩᏗᏒᎢ.  ᎠᏴ ᏕᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᏢᏔᏅᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏃᏈᏏ ᏧᎦᏙᏴᎢᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏑᎾᎴ ᎡᎯ.
\ft I Jesus have sent mine angel to testify unto you these things in the churches. I am the root and the offspring of David, and the bright and morning star.

\ln Adanvdono ale atsiyehi Ehena anadiha.  Ale advgisgi Ehena adisgesdi.  Ale gilo utadegisgi wigalugi; ale gilo udulisgesdi ganegisgesdi ama gvnidv adanehi tsugvwalodi nigesvna.
\syll ᎠᏓᏅᏙᏃ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏥᏰᎯ ᎡᎮᎾ ᎠᎾᏗᎭ.  ᎠᎴ ᎠᏛᎩᏍᎩ ᎡᎮᎾ ᎠᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ.  ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏔᏕᎩᏍᎩ ᏫᎦᎷᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎦᏁᎩᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᎹ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎠᏓᏁᎯ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.
\ft And the Spirit and the bride say, Come. And let him that heareth say, Come. And let him that is athirst come. And whosoever will, let him take the water of life freely.

\ln Gvnigesvyeno nigatsiyvneha nanivquo gilo anadvgisgi kanohedv adolehosvhi ani gowelihi tsigowela, nasgi iyuno gilo  ikanequosgesdi hia nasgi tsudalenvdv ani gowelihi tsigowela, Unelanvhi ase unequoedi gesesdi udeyadodi gesv ani gowelihi tsigowela;
\syll ᎬᏂᎨᏒᏰᏃ ᏂᎦᏥᏴᏁᎭ ᎾᏂᎥᏉ ᎩᎶ ᎠᎾᏛᎩᏍᎩ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏒᎯ ᎠᏂ ᎪᏪᎵᎯ ᏥᎪᏪᎳ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ  ᎢᎧᏁᏉᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎠᏂ ᎪᏪᎵᎯ ᏥᎪᏪᎳ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᏎ ᎤᏁᏉᎡᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᏕᏯᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏂ ᎪᏪᎵᎯ ᏥᎪᏪᎳ;
\ft For I testify unto every man that heareth the words of the prophecy of this book, If any man shall add unto these things, God shall add unto him the plagues that are written in this book:

\ln Iyu ale gilo igotsalesgesdi igadv kanohedv gowelihi hia nasgi adolehosvhi gesvi, Unelanvhi ase dayuwotsalaeli utseli gesv gvnidv adanehi gowelihi, ale galvquodiyu gaduhvi, ale tsudalenvdv gowelv ani gowelihi.
\syll ᎢᏳ ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᎢᎪᏣᎴᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎢᎦᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎪᏪᎵᎯ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏒᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᏎ ᏓᏳᏬᏣᎳᎡᎵ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎠᏓᏁᎯ ᎪᏪᎵᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎦᏚᎲᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎪᏪᎸ ᎠᏂ ᎪᏪᎵᎯ.
\ft And if any man shall take away from the words of the book of this prophecy, God shall take away his part out of the book of life, and out of the holy city, and from the things which are written in this book.

\ln Hia nasgi tsudalenvdv gvnigesv igvnehi, hia nigaweha, udohiyuhiya tlegiyu datsilutsi.  Emenv; howaquo; tlegiyu hilugi Tsagvwiyuhi Tsisa.
\syll ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᎬᏁᎯ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᎭ, ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᏞᎩᏳ ᏓᏥᎷᏥ.  ᎡᎺᏅ; ᎰᏩᏉ; ᏞᎩᏳ ᎯᎷᎩ ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ.
\ft He which testifieth these things saith, Surely I come quickly. Amen. Even so, come, Lord Jesus.

\ln Gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv igatseliga itseladidohesdi nitsivi.  Emenv.
\syll ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎢᎦᏤᎵᎦ ᎢᏤᎳᏗᏙᎮᏍᏗ ᏂᏥᎥᎢ.  ᎡᎺᏅ.
\ft The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
